title: Shoal Creek Dental Care
address: 8015 Shoal Creek Blvd #120, Austin, TX 78757, United States

user_reviews.Name: Narrie Moye
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Harger is the best! He's been my dentist for the last 19 years. I moved way South Austin back in 2013 and I will still make the drive because I do not wish to see anyone else. He provides great care and has patience. Highly highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Megan Hagins
user_reviews.Description: I started going to Shoal Creek when I needed an emergency crown on a cracked tooth last summer (2025) and received excellent care. I just returned for a 6 moth teeth cleaning and had the best, most gentle but thorough cleaning experience of my life. Thanks, Jennifer Egan! No more white knuckles for me!

user_reviews.Name: L B
user_reviews.Description:
My husband and I are both patients of Dr. Harger at Shoal Creek Dental. Hubby had an appointment today with Leo (who is the best hygienist ever!) for a cleaning.

Coincidentally, I had a crown come off last evening. I called Shoal Creek Dental and left a message to ask if it would be possible to have the crown repaired during the time my husband was in his appointment.

I got a call bright and early this morning to say they had time to see me and to come on in.

Thank you, Dr. Harger, Leslie, Juliana, Jessica, and Leo. We so appreciate all of you❣️

user_reviews.Name: Scott Saunders
user_reviews.Description: Love Shoal Creek Dental, my wife and I have been going there for years. They are friendly, on time, respectful of patient choice, and conscious of costs. I would highly recommend Dr Grimm at Shoal Creek Dental!

user_reviews.Name: Ali Smith
user_reviews.Description: I have been going to SCDC “Dr Jenkins” from 1976 until he retired. I miss him!  He left behind a great staff. Jennifer  Egan has been my primary hygienist for the last 20 years. The team,  technology and services provided has transformed significantly since 1976, their commitment to provide exceptional care continues. I no longer live in Austin, but for me personally they are worth the drive  Here’s a big shout out to Jennifer!!!

user_reviews.Name: Charlie Angulo
user_reviews.Description:
I can't recommend Shoal Creek Dental Care enough! After skipping dental visits for a while, I was quite nervous about going back, but my experience here has been fantastic. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, which immediately put me at ease.

I've had regular cleanings, and each time, the hygienists have been thorough yet gentle. They took the time to explain everything they were doing and made sure I was comfortable throughout the process.

I also decided to get Invisalign, and the team has been amazing in guiding me through the entire process. They answered all my questions and made sure I understood what to expect, which really helped alleviate my anxiety.

Shoal Creek Dental truly cares about their patients and provides exceptional care.

user_reviews.Name: Robert Perez
user_reviews.Description: Superb dentist.  My crown fell out on a Saturday morning.  I met him at his office that same morning and he re-inserted it.  Saved my weekend.  Superb caring service.   Robert

user_reviews.Name: Tamara S
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely love this dental office. The staff is always so warm and inviting and kind. Dr. Grimm is amazing and truly a unicorn of the dental world. She is an incredible wealth of knowledge & experience. I highly recommend Dr. Grimm and this office. We’ve had the absolute best experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachelle Fonseca
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jen is the best dental hygienist I have ever been to. The entire team is personable and wonderful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janice S Longridge
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love love Shoal Creek Dental.  I’ve been with this practice since about 1978 and would not change.  Love Dr Harger, Leo and Leslie!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Staples
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a longtime patient at Shoal Creek Dental, and I feel fortunate to have had consistently professional, considerate, and excellent dental care over the decades. I appreciate the outstanding work of my dentist, my dental hygienist, and even the referral to a specialist (in the Shoal Creek clinic) as needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: tom collins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nice people who make every visit pleasant from cleanings to implants. Happy to recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kendra Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always excellent service! Super friendly all around! Couldn’t ask for a better dentist than Dr. Grimm! She is just amazing and everyone there is top notch!

user_reviews_extended.Name: lemurgal lemurgal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall, it is a great office with competent care. That said, the teeth whitening offered in the office was a complete disappointment. The office oversold the effectiveness of the in-office lightening - it barely lightened my teeth. It was a total waste of money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bettie Erb
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place failed to tell me in advance that they were out of network. My mistake for not asking more carefully. Asking if the took my insurance was not enough. I ended up paying much more than expected.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Truss
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent professional service with knowledgeable, caring staff! I was able to enjoy the cleaning, as dental hygienist, Leo Cantu, worked gently and diligently to clean my teeth. I love when I walk away learning more about my teeth and how to keep them in good shape. The front staff are so welcoming and kind. I can’t imagine going somewhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susie Richter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Dr. Robert Harger and his team at Shoal Creek Dental. For 37 years they have taken excellent care of me and my teeth. They fixed a tooth I broke with a crown that took only one visit. Always kind, thoughtful, and highly skilled, I highly recommend Shoal Creek Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shantee Goeman (Shae Goeman)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love the office and the staff! Very clean and Highly-qualified and very well educated Dentist and I am looking forward to them doing the work I need done! Perfect smile here I come!

Just had another appointment with Dr. Grimm and it was such a great experience just like previous appointments. They were funny, Kind, and have expert knowledge and awesome personalities! They even have a cute little space to relax while waiting for my crowns and It felt very comfortable and private.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Matthews
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this whole operation. Everyone is friendly and professional. I sometimes fall asleep in the chair because Jenn is so precise and gentle when she does my cleaning. I enjoy going to the dentist... I know that sounds weird, but it's true with Shoal Creek.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beverly Roland
user_reviews_extended.Description:
2024 Update to review made 6 years ago: As seniors, our main concern is excellent dental care. Next would be the pricing. After Dr. D. Jenkins retired, we decide to make a switch to another practice. We still get great dental care at the new place that is closer to us, and the prices, while not cheap, are more reasonable.

We still trust that you will get great dental care at Shoal Creek Dental, and should consider them in your research in finding a dentist you can trust to take care of your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin Lucas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional team, great communication, ready for any situation. They worked with me on a tight schedule and I am pretty sure that Dr. Grimm put off vacation time to fit me in. Following my consultation, in addition to x-rays, they used state of the art diagnostic tools such as a 3d scanning instrument that creates a 3d model of your teeth and gums in full color. The scan was helpful to look at for better understanding of the journey ahead. I received a clear cost estimate so there were no surprises. Dr. Grimm recommended a path forward, explained my options and answered all of my questions. When I arrived for dental work a couple of days later, she had prepared a custom numbing agent blend just for me with less epinephrine. She and her assistant walked me through the procedure step-by-step (an option that I elected) and I wore headphones to relax at other times. The assistant did careful work setting my crown. I was well-informed about what to expect for recovery time, and Dr. Grimm checked in with me that evening. Years had passed since I visited a dentist, and the staff used their connections to secure an appointment for me to have additional work with an oral surgeon the following day. All around, a great dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Chance
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was my 4th or 5th appointment. I am disappointed with the last visit, yesterday. 6/19/24
I will be looking for a new dentist.
Quickly: the hygienist was nice, but it was the worst experience I have had in a dentist chair during a cleaning. The dentist made me feel like she was in a hurry and not available to take time to answer my questions. I felt very rushed with her. Also, I requested information  about a mouth guard and no one followed up with me to schedule the next step.

I would give more information, but I find that it’s a waste of time; unless the office sincerely wants to know.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Roberson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Visited Shoal Creek Dental Care for the first time a few months ago. I am new to Austin so needed to find a dentist in town. Everyone is so kind and welcoming and made me feel at ease. My hygienist was SUPER helpful in explaining problems she saw in my teeth and giving me advice on how to improve my overall oral health. For the first time ever, I am actually motivated to improve my habits because I understand why they are helpful. The dentist was very kind and professional as well. I got two cavities filled and he was attentive to my comfort levels and got everything done quickly. Could not be more satisfied with my visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bradley Gibbs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ive been going to Dr. Harger for a while now, and he offers great service and makes you feel comfortable during the whole process. My Dental Hygienist; Leo Cantu, is also amazing and makes my teeth feel very clean by the end of my service. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camille Gaines
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Grimm is a holistic dentist in Austin. She used my biocompatability report to determine the materials she could use for the first two fillings she did for me. She was gentle during the process. I like that she takes the time to explain things to me. Leo does a great job cleaning. He's very thorough and pleasant. Staff is also great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Curran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone have always been a pleasure to work with. Leslie has been giving amazing service for years. She and everyone are very professional and also knowledgeable about coverages and always work out a payment plan if something’s not covered. Dr Harger does awesome work. I’ve gone long periods of time with neglecting my teeth so he had his work cut out for him but we are almost there and he has been top notch along the way! Also had a very thorough cleaning recently … haven’t had one in a while and my teeth look awesome so appreciate the great work always from everyone! I would recommend Dr Harger and Shoal Creek Dental to anyone looking for a new place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Daugherty
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic place for all things dental and ortho!!!! Love the entire staff! You won’t regret coming to this location!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James McNguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: My hygienist Leo always does such a great job comfortably cleaning my teeth.  The dentist office is always spotless and all of the staff are so welcoming.  Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Deckert
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit to the Shoal Creek Dental care was excellent! From the front desk person to the chat with Dr. Harger it was an informative, relax and non-pressure visit. I particularly loved the hygienist Tysha! She was the most thorough , personable and professional hygienist I've had in a long time. I never thought I'd say this, but I'm actually looking forward to my next appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Buchanan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a new patient and I  am very pleased with the entire staff.  From the receptionist, hygienists and Dr. Harger, everybody is warm, knowledgeable and patient centered.  So glad my friends referred me to Shoal Creek Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: GO Mull
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a routine cleaning, check for my previous done root canal & fitting for invisalign. There was a miscommunication which I wanted fixed during my appointment I only noticed when I left & they were very understanding, took ownership, brought me back in straight away & made sure I was happy leaving. I trust places like this that take accountability & put patients first.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Betsi Newbury
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a new patient at Shoal Creek Dental Care and have been so impressed with the wonderful care and service I have received from the entire staff. I highly recommend Dr Harger and his team. Thanks to you all for helping me keep my teeth in excellent condition.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Applewhite
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shoal Creek Dental  & Dr. H have been my dentist for over 10 years - I have referred many friends & co-workers, everyone loves them as much as I do. Very professional, caring, & always prompt. They have the latest equipment and great service always. Highly Recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Saunders
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am thankful for all of the people I’ve interacted with at Shoal Creek Dental. The front office staff, Dr. Grimm, Bianca, Sian, and Leo. I specifically sought out Dr. Grimm after learning that she was a biological dentist, trained in dentistry and is a naturopathic physician. Dr. Grimm is by far the best dentist I’ve ever had! She takes the time to listen to me and answer questions, and she is a great communicator. She explains what she is doing and why. I feel like I am part of the decision-making, rather than having things done TO me without my consent (which is how I have felt at other dental practices). I also have been so happy with my interactions with the dental assistants. Bianca and Sian have both helped me, and they are incredibly kind and friendly. I also really appreciated that when I asked to not have x-rays done at my last visit, I didn’t receive any pushback. (Again, I have had experiences at other offices where I felt very pressured into having things done that I was not comfortable with). I was so grateful that Sian listened to me and respected my preferences as a patient. I also loved my experience with Leo as my hygienist. As someone with “dental anxiety”, I felt so relieved after my cleaning with Leo. I know he will take care to do thorough work without causing me any pain!
The office environment is also lovely. I have never had to wait long, and it is a clean, inviting space. The front desk staff is so friendly, which is huge! They always greet me with a smiling face. I’ve been so incredibly pleased with my experiences at Shoal Creek Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kurt Lewchuk
user_reviews_extended.Description: A state of the art dental practice that always is up on the latest techniques. The people are really easy to get along with and I would highly recommend them. I have been going to the same practice since the early 90's and I am under the care of Dr. Harger now and he is a great dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Mechem
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Harger and his staff are wonderful! I have been going to this office for over 25 years. This year, I started the Invisalign treatment and I am thrilled with the results! I wish I would have done it years ago. I highly recommend the entire office for all your dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jennifer the hygienist and Dr. Harger are amazing. They do a great job with both reluctant children and adults and take great care of their patients. The office staff are always so sweet and helpful and happy. I love going there! It's stress free.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stan Wedel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jennifer is such an exceptional hygeniest. And she has the best attitude. I always set my next appointment with her. And Dr. Harger is the best. The experience at Shoal Creek Dental is always so much better than at my previous dentist. So Shoal Creek Dental, you’re stuck with me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Emken
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Shoal Creek Dental! From the front desk staff to my amazing hygienist Shelley, to the fabulous Dr. Harger - I have been a client for 20 years and have never had a bad experience here! Wonderful people, thorough, detailed, and expert service and my teeth are always happy and clean!😁😁😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobby Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always, Shelly and Dr. J were kind, gentle and very thorough with my 6-month cleaning and checkup.  It is comforting to know that they maintain such a comprehensive history of my 66-year-old set of teeth.  Yes, I still have all of them, thanks to Dr. J and his awesome team of professionals!

user_reviews_extended.Name: C. Patricia Huerta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Previously I've always had a great experience. Staff has always been both welcoming and helpful. Note, I've been coming here for years. However, this new receptionist at the front desk is extremely rude! We had a disagreement on my insurance and instead of helping aleviate the situation or giving other options chose to have an attitude because I was frustrated with the fact that when she called to confirm my appt she didn't mention any insurance discrepancies until the morning of. Furthermore, when I called the next day to update her with my new insurance and asked her to please make sure it went through before my appt instead of listening to my request proceeded to continuously cut me off until I asked her to stop... I showed up to my appointment today and she didn't even have the courtesy of saying hello, eye contact or asking me my name. Nothing. Just that I was checked in. Please remind Cassandra 1. Learn to handle frustrated customers with a solution-based approach not your ego 2. You handle REOCCURING customers, continue to have attitude and I'll take my service elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Connaughton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Shoal Creek dental for 17 years. They've always been professional, helpful, and polite. They are constantly updating their techniques with the latest technology. While in 2002 I needed a cavity filled with drills, now they use lasers. No shots of novocaine needed. The work looks great too. I've recommended them anytime I hear someone is looking for a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: dougele
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Yesterday I had a cavity in a molar filled by Dr. Harger using the new laser technology. It could not have been a swifter, smoother experience - no needles, no numbing, no pain and less than 30 minutes in and out. Seamless procedure. And this is coming from a patient with an extreme phobia when it comes to dental work of any kind.
Dr. Harger is always kind, compassionate and patient with explanations, information and encouragement. His work is impeccable. I enthusiastically recommend him.
The staff up front, May and Leslie, are the best. Both are thoroughly professional making scheduling appointments, processing insurance and any other business a breeze. And all the while they are warm and welcoming making you feel at comfortable and at ease. Well done to everyone at Shoal Creek Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom Cammack
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend Shoal Creek Dental. I have been seeing Dr. Jenkins since 1982 and have nothing but good things to say. High integrity and excellent work on my very difficult teeth. This group truly cares about providing high quality care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dorothy Greenwood
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a client of Shoal Creek Dental  Care for longer than I remember.  I  am always greeted and very rarely have to wait past my appointment time.  My hygienists Jennifer and Dr Jenkins are what keeps me coming back to Shoal Creek Dental Care and I have no plans to change.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shoal Creek Dental always does an excellent job. I drive a considerable distance to have all my dental work done here because they're the best. I highly recommend them to anyone who asks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve W Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is one of the most pleasant dental experiences I’ve had in years. The staff is friendly & efficient. Dr. Harger is very friendly and spends quality time with his patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Decker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Leonard is a black belt hygenist! Love watching a documentary while he cleans too. Went by fast. It's so great to have a team so experienced at what they do. Everything is smooth. Dr. Harger is friendly, knowledgeable and flexible to the needs of both me and my wife. And... easy access from Mopac and parking, which is appreciated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thy Hooks (acupofthy)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Shoal Creek Dental for 2 years now and the dental hygienist I go to is Shelly. She's really sweet and very considerate to make sure you're comfortable during a teeth cleaning. I would highly recommend her and the staff at Shoal Creek Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kate crisp
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit was a check up. The staff was friendly, lobby was quiet and clean w comfortable chairs. Everything was explained as we went along. The X-ray tech did not cross contaminate her gloves while working with me (I’ve contracted a virus from another dental office in the past).  I’m pleased and relieved to be a pt here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone who has never loved going to the dentist, I’ve never felt more comfortable in the chair. Shelly was friendly and professional and made the whole experience easy. Dr. Harger was also very professional and I will be a life long costumer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Toohey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing. I have never felt so confident that I am getting the care that I want. It’s so refreshing to have a dentist that is willing to hear what you want, give you all the options then helping you decide. The work they have done this gas has been stellar. I have my new family dentist!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelley Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: My new bridge fits wonderfully.   The process was painless and I’m so happy to have this big job behind me.   Thanks Dr.H.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got several fillings last year. I had an abnormal amount of sensitivity for almost a year and since switching dentists they told me that those fillings are terrible. They are ugly and not well done. They have increased the likelihood of more problems in those areas going forward because the fillings will trap even more food there. The staff is very friendly and nice, but I wouldn't trust Dr. Harger with any procedures even as simple as a filling.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Friedman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very dental phobic. I avoid the dentist like the plague. After 3 years without a cleaning, I decided to get the courage up to schedule a visit. If anyone is like me, PLEASE SCHEDULE A VISIT AT SHOAL CREEK. They are kind and wonderful and caring and it didn’t hurt at all. They scheduled extra time for my cleaning in case I needed breaks, and let me stop whenever I needed with no judgement or anything other than actual concern and kindness.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Crone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Harger has seen my family of 8 as well as my parents. He was my mom's dentist when she had Alzheimer's, and he and his staff were excellent and patient with her. He now sees my dad, who has dementia, and again, the staff are so patient and kind. I highly recommend Dr. Harger.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Russ Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doc Harger has taken care of me for something like 12-13 years now.  I drive in from Georgetown to get worked on.  Well, this go around I had a tooth that had to be removed...one of my prominent front teeth.  Dr. Harger walked me through the process, and I just got the final implant...it looks perfectly natural and feels perfectly natural as well.  My staff all say they can't tell anything ever happened.  I'm actually surprised at how perfect they can make these things.  Great job Doc and staff!  :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anita Janke
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m grateful for the wonderful staff - from Leslie to all the hygienist who have provided care- all staff are top notch.

The care, skill and service they provide is consistently excellent!

Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casey Boyle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I called to set up an initial appointment for an emergency situation. They were very nice and got me in for first thing after the weekend on Monday morning. I received text notices all weekend as a reminder that my appointment was due Monday morning at 8am. One text said that if I don't cancel within 24 hours, I would have to pay 50 dollars.  Then, at 7:30am Monday morning, they cancelled citing "short staff." I chose to come here because they assured me that they could get me in (needed to travel for the next week or so).

Anyway...They probably have good relationships with some patients and do help some people, but I wouldn't know. I'd just say that in at least one case, they left someone out and didn't follow through.

user_reviews_extended.Name: KELLEY MARSHALL
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been with Dr.Grimm for 10+ years and proudly refered a friend to her last week.  He was just as impressed. I found that over the years her passion and profesional approach to her work has been impecable. The kindness of her techs is an extention of the family-like feel that resonates with me after a visit.  She cares about her pateints she has somehow made my approch to going to the dentist a pleasant one. Thank yoiu

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy LeBrun
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in today to be fitted for a new nightguard and bottom retainer, and was pleasantly surprised that I didn't have to get any impressions.  Dr. Harger has this new technology that generates a 3D image of your teeth.  Really high tech!  The technician (sorry, I didn't get her name) used a wand with a light beam to scan my teeth, inside & out, top and bottom, and I could see the image on the computer screen.  I was impressed.  I've always had good experiences at Shoal Creek Dental.  My hygienist, Shelly, is fantastic, as is Dr. Harger and all of the staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Li
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was reminded a week before my appointment which is deeply appreciated.  My hygienist was on time, professional and super friendly.  I felt very comfortable and at ease for an appointment I am not all that fond of!

user_reviews_extended.Name: George Randle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just could t have found a more caring holistic team to help me have the best smile possible. As a public speaker - every little bit counts and this team is making some insecurities become strengths!  My smile!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maureen Howell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental experience. Dental office is well staffed and very attentive to my dental needs. Polite and energetic. Dr. Harger spoke to me very directly and confidently. He answered my questions very directly. Looking forward to my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy cooper
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was terrified of going to the dentist because of a previous experience. My friend urged me to see Dr. Grimm, and I am so grateful.

Dr. Grimm is kind, understanding, she answered all my questions, and let me go at my own pace. She's just awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edie Schumann
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My visit was great.
Everyone is so friendly and takes such great care to make sure you are comfortable  while any procedure is being done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at Shoal Creek Dental for many years. Dr. Jenkins was my first doctor and then he retired I considered going to another clinic because I had just moved to Wimberley. I was lucky enough to be teamed with Dr. Grimm when I went back for my “last appointment,” but she was/is phenomenal. She is truly gifted. She’s down to earth like Dr. Jenkins. She has an amazing bedside manner, and I look forward to visiting with her when I go to my appointment. Did I mention that I live in Wimberley? They’re just that good. I feel at home when I’m there. Leslie works up front and I’ve known her for as long as I did Dr. Jenkins. That sweet lady is NEVER in a bad mood. I absolutely adore her. The turnover is minimal if at all. I think most of them retire and that’s the only way they will leave, haha. If you’re reading this, you know how difficult it is to find an honest Dentist. I’ve been to many other practices and I always left feeling financially violated, and some others that I went to intentionally caused dental damage. Dr. Grimm and the team are nothing like that. I trust them and plan to continue driving over an hour to see them forever.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I just got four same-day crowns done here and it was a great experience! To be clear, no one loves getting dental work done, but everyone here made it as nice as possible for me. Sarah was so wonderful and accommodating with my financial questions and scheduling, she really went above and beyond in talking everything over with me. Dr. Trinh and Jessica took care of my actual dental work, and they made me feel very comfortable and at-ease as it really took all day for the crowns. They were incredibly compassionate, patient, kind and communicative throughout every step. They kept me distracted too with conversation - as much as you can communicate with an open, numb mouth - and they were fun to be around, believe it or not! He has filled many a cavity for me; I am prone to dental anxiety but he is so skillful at using the lidocaine to ensure I’m pain-free, and I can tell he is a perfectionist in making sure all decay is removed. I come in twice a year to have my teeth cleaned and I love the results they give me.
They say that one of the the keys to good health is having healthy teeth and gums. It is very important to me that my family receives good dental care.

The staff here are great, prices are reasonable and the service is top notch.
I plan on coming here for a long time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynta de Narvaez
user_reviews_extended.Description: In the quest to relieve Chronic Fatigue I pursued the dental arena, i.e. cavitations.  This office advertised that they have a Cone Beam CT scanner. The first scan, besides making me pay for and endure a sales consultation by their head dentist, had too low a resolution to be used by my doc.  The head dentist had had no idea what he was looking at.  When I told them the scan was unusable they stated that there were no settings on the machine.  So my doc sent them instructions on how to change their settings.  I went back and had another scan done. They had agreed that I could get my $350 dollars back if this scan also did not work.  Well, it didn't.  They advertise equipment they don't know how to use and don't make good on their mistakes.  On a real scan I have 7, yes seven, cavitations. And they have still not refunded my money.  Bad business.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Glennon and his staff are wonderful.  I feel as though they have known me a long time even though I have only seen them 3 times in 8 months. user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have used Austin Dental Center & Dr Glennon for almost 20 years. Everyone is kind and thorough-from the front office staff to the dental hygienists and I honestly don’t trust the health of my teeth to anyone else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susie Higley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Some people tell bad jokes about their trips to the dentist, but I love going to Dr. Glennon. It feels like "old home week" ... we catch up on each other's lives and while I get my teeth cleaned, I get great music, wonderful cleaning, and a sense of "family." Not only is every one caring and pleasant, but they KNOW what they're doing. Once, while cleaning my teeth, Sylvia noticed a swollen gland and Dr. Glennon referred me to my ENT for further consultation. It turned out to be benign, but it's that kind of care that makes me grateful for the expertise as well as the caring attitude of all the folks with Austin Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LindaKathryn Stone-Cueva
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very bad toothache that needed to be seen right away. I made this call on Monday July 30th. Sarah informed me the first appointment was on Thursday August 2nd. She calls me at 7:59am in July 31st to tell me there had been a cancellation. Can I make it by 10am? Emphatically I say yes. Upon arrival I'm checked in by Katherine and then Sarah informs me that all insurance information had been taken care of. I'm then taken back by Connie whom x-rays my mouth in the most delicate way. She does this and doesn't cause me any pain. Dr. Glennon comes in and tells me what needs to be done. Over an hour later the procedure is complete. I have to say this staff at Austin Dental Center is amazing. They turned my tooth pain that I thought I'd have to be with for the majority of the week into a much less painful situation. I have anxiety about the dentist, with them you can't go wrong. Thank you all so much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Micah Zapotechne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came in because of nerve pain from a wisdom tooth, and couldn't my primary dentist because of covid-19. I get very fearful at dentists from prior bad experiences and Dr. Trinh and her dental assistant went above and beyond to relieve my anxiety coming in. They were exceptionally kind, genuine, and especially gentle. I have never had such a positive experience from a dental office in my life. The dental assistant, who told me her name... but I'm terrible at remembering names, and if you read this I'm so sorry, you were amazing...... asked me what my favorite music was and put it on to help me relax. She made me feel so cared for while I was incredibly anxious and on edge and alleved so much of my fear. They are the best I've ever experienced in their field and will be coming back for any issues I may experience down the line hands down. If dentists scare you, these dentists will change your mind.

Edit: the dental assistant's name was Kaili. Sweetest person.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Arnold
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I found these guys off a $99 first-time patient special they had advertised on Facebook on July 9. It had been a few years since I'd gone to the dentist, so my chain of logic went like this:
1. Hey, that's a pretty good deal
2. Hey, they're right in my neighborhood
3. Hey, they're in my health insurance network (Humana)
4. Hey, they have good reviews

This lead inexorably to:
5. Hey, go book an appointment

So I did.

I had to play a bit of phone tag with the receptionist in order to get my appointment booked, which was partly my fault due to being busy enough to not return their calls promptly. My appointment was a bit far out - by July 21, the soonest they could see me was September 3. However, it's not like my need was urgent, and so a bit over a month was fine with me. They sent plenty of email reminders, plus a text the day of.

The actual 8:50am appointment went about as smoothly as you could ask for. I showed up at 8:45am, finished my paperwork in about 10 minutes, and was seen at 9am. The special included the following things:
- X-rays
- A full cleaning by a hygienist
- An examination by Dr. Glennon
- A home teeth whitening kit thing

I received all of that, done promptly and professionally, and I was out of there by 10:45 for exactly $99. They recommended some additional work, but it was surprisingly little for someone too lazy to go to the dentist for literally years beforehand and who still had all their wisdom teeth. I went ahead and booked my 6 month followup appointment with a clear mind, a light heart, and much cleaner teeth.

user_reviews.Description: I had such a great experience at ATX Family Dental.
