He was honest, conservative, and didn’t rush me into unnecessary treatment. The whole team was kind, thorough, and made me feel comfortable right away. I finally feel like I’m in good hands, highly recommend!!

user_reviews.Name: Anais Pegias
user_reviews.Description:
I had my first visit at ATX Family Dental today for a filling after deciding to switch from my previous dental practice, which had been a really bad experience. I am so glad I made the change.

Amanda did an incredible job on my filling. She is extremely skilled, gentle, and made the whole process feel easy and smooth.

My assistant Kirsten was also wonderful and made me feel very relaxed throughout the appointment.

The whole team was professional and welcoming, and the experience was smooth from start to finish. I would absolutely recommend ATX Family Dental to anyone looking for a great dentist in Austin.

user_reviews.Name: Rachel Kohlman
user_reviews.Description:
If I could give ATX Family Dental six stars, I would. This was my first dental experience in Downtown Austin and I cannot say enough great things about this practice. The office is beautiful and bright and colorful, the people are incredibly kind and bubbly, the dental cleaning and exam were super professional. I had a few dental concerns and was walked through all of the options possible, many of which have never been a possibility at other dentists.

Dr. Adam and his wife have done a fabulous job with their practice, and it feels like way more than a local family practice. The only way I will ever get a new dentist is if I leave Austin, and even then, flights aren’t that expensive.😂

I love you guys already @ ATX Family Dental!

user_reviews.Name: K L
user_reviews.Description:
ATX Family Dental's Wellness Plan saved me when I found out my employer's dental insurance wasn't accepted by any dental offices and my previous dentist kept pushing my appointment months out. I was able to sign up for the plan and be seen within 2 days of making the change.

When I arrived, parking was simple and the office was gorgeous! Everyone was so nice. Then I saw the technology. Ever had the goopy, nasty impressions on your teeth? ATX Family Dental said NO MORE! They have a machine that takes 1,000s of photos per second and builds a model of your mouth. They also had TVs on the ceiling so I got to watch Planet Earth while my teeth were cleaned. When I was done, they literally gave me a gold star sticker for taking care of my teeth. I'm an adult and I don't think we get NEARLY enough stickers anymore, so that was a very pleasant surprise!

I am happy to say that after feeling lost and forgotten with my previous dentist, I now LOVE my dentist! I have cancelled my insurance and will go to ATX Family Dental from now on!

Keep up the great work and see you in 6 months! :)

user_reviews.Name: Silas Demetriou
user_reviews.Description:
If we’re being real…nobody likes going to the dentist. But ATX Family Dental completely changed the experience for me.

First off, the space is chic, modern, and actually feels intentional. Not sterile and cold , but stylish and welcoming. The waiting room is super cute and thoughtfully designed, which already makes you feel more relaxed walking in.

Every treatment room has a TV on the ceiling (because seriously… why do dentists put them on the wall where you can’t even see them while laying back?). And yes — they give you the remote. Full control. As they should.

They also give you these cool heart-eye sunglasses while they work on you, which is such a small but fun touch that makes everything feel less clinical and more comfortable.

Beyond the aesthetics though — the environment felt inclusive and diverse. I felt safe in more ways than one, and that matters. A lot. 🏳️‍🌈

If you’re in Austin and have been putting off a dentist visit, this might be the place that changes your mind.

user_reviews.Name: Shauna Smith
user_reviews.Description:
I came to ATX Family Dental based on recommendations from two friends I trust.  I had my first cleaning and exam with Dr. Adam a couple of weeks ago and I went back the following week for specific work, also with Dr. Adam.  For a person who isn't easily satisfied in a dentist's office, I am highly satisfied with ATX Family Dental, so far.  My experiences both times had consistency from the front desk to the exam room.  People here make eye contact with you, communicate what to expect with clarity- from the front desk, to the waiting room, to the dental chair.  I also like that they seek further clarity with me by asking if I have questions at each transition.
The friends who recommended Dr. Adam's office know my back story.  Without sharing all the details, I had terrible dental experiences with two dentists many years ago.  I'm not proud to say it, but for 14 years, I became dentist avoidant.  Fortunately, I overcame my fears, but suffice it to say, I look for traits that go beyond framed credentials.  I'm looking for professionalism and interpersonal skills that signal the people I'm going to for my dental care are trustworthy.  That criteria will not be the same for everyone.  So far, Dr. Adam and his team are ticking all the right boxes.

user_reviews.Name: Cara
user_reviews.Description:
Would you believe me if I said I kinda look forward to going to the dentist now?

Like many people, I used to dread dental appointments after a few not-so-great experiences and even delayed care because of it. ATX Family Dental completely changed that. Every team member leads with kindness, respect, and empathy. They take the time to clearly explain your care plan, answer all your questions, and never pressure you into optional or elective treatments. It’s a judgment-free zone! They manage to bring professionalism and humor into the experience, even though laughing with dental tools in your mouth can be tricky.  They all seem to genuinely enjoy their jobs and working together.. idk, It’s just a good time! I never thought I would write a review for a dental office, but here we are. Big fan. Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Byron Smith
user_reviews.Description:
Excellent experience at ATX Family Dental. Sandy and Dr. Adam Gutwein were incredibly attentive, efficient, and welcoming. You can tell they truly care about their patients and take pride in what they do. The office is modern, clean, and very well run.

After searching around, I’ve officially found my dentist in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Serena Raynard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great experience at ATX Family Dental. I came in with pain from previous dental work done elsewhere, and the dentist took the time to really listen and explain what was going on. He was honest, conservative, and didn’t rush me into unnecessary treatment. The whole team was kind, thorough, and made me feel comfortable right away. I finally feel like I’m in good hands, highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anais Pegias
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had my first visit at ATX Family Dental today for a filling after deciding to switch from my previous dental practice, which had been a really bad experience. I am so glad I made the change.

Amanda did an incredible job on my filling. She is extremely skilled, gentle, and made the whole process feel easy and smooth.

My assistant Kirsten was also wonderful and made me feel very relaxed throughout the appointment.

The whole team was professional and welcoming, and the experience was smooth from start to finish. I would absolutely recommend ATX Family Dental to anyone looking for a great dentist in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Kohlman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If I could give ATX Family Dental six stars, I would. This was my first dental experience in Downtown Austin and I cannot say enough great things about this practice. The office is beautiful and bright and colorful, the people are incredibly kind and bubbly, the dental cleaning and exam were super professional. I had a few dental concerns and was walked through all of the options possible, many of which have never been a possibility at other dentists.

Dr. Adam and his wife have done a fabulous job with their practice, and it feels like way more than a local family practice. The only way I will ever get a new dentist is if I leave Austin, and even then, flights aren’t that expensive.😂

I love you guys already @ ATX Family Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: K L
user_reviews_extended.Description:
ATX Family Dental's Wellness Plan saved me when I found out my employer's dental insurance wasn't accepted by any dental offices and my previous dentist kept pushing my appointment months out. I was able to sign up for the plan and be seen within 2 days of making the change.

When I arrived, parking was simple and the office was gorgeous! Everyone was so nice. Then I saw the technology. Ever had the goopy, nasty impressions on your teeth? ATX Family Dental said NO MORE! They have a machine that takes 1,000s of photos per second and builds a model of your mouth. They also had TVs on the ceiling so I got to watch Planet Earth while my teeth were cleaned. When I was done, they literally gave me a gold star sticker for taking care of my teeth. I'm an adult and I don't think we get NEARLY enough stickers anymore, so that was a very pleasant surprise!

I am happy to say that after feeling lost and forgotten with my previous dentist, I now LOVE my dentist! I have cancelled my insurance and will go to ATX Family Dental from now on!

Keep up the great work and see you in 6 months! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Silas Demetriou
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If we’re being real…nobody likes going to the dentist. But ATX Family Dental completely changed the experience for me.

First off, the space is chic, modern, and actually feels intentional. Not sterile and cold , but stylish and welcoming. The waiting room is super cute and thoughtfully designed, which already makes you feel more relaxed walking in.

Every treatment room has a TV on the ceiling (because seriously… why do dentists put them on the wall where you can’t even see them while laying back?). And yes — they give you the remote. Full control. As they should.

They also give you these cool heart-eye sunglasses while they work on you, which is such a small but fun touch that makes everything feel less clinical and more comfortable.

Beyond the aesthetics though — the environment felt inclusive and diverse. I felt safe in more ways than one, and that matters. A lot. 🏳️‍🌈

If you’re in Austin and have been putting off a dentist visit, this might be the place that changes your mind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shauna Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came to ATX Family Dental based on recommendations from two friends I trust.  I had my first cleaning and exam with Dr. Adam a couple of weeks ago and I went back the following week for specific work, also with Dr. Adam.  For a person who isn't easily satisfied in a dentist's office, I am highly satisfied with ATX Family Dental, so far.  My experiences both times had consistency from the front desk to the exam room.  People here make eye contact with you, communicate what to expect with clarity- from the front desk, to the waiting room, to the dental chair.  I also like that they seek further clarity with me by asking if I have questions at each transition.
The friends who recommended Dr. Adam's office know my back story.  Without sharing all the details, I had terrible dental experiences with two dentists many years ago.  I'm not proud to say it, but for 14 years, I became dentist avoidant.  Fortunately, I overcame my fears, but suffice it to say, I look for traits that go beyond framed credentials.  I'm looking for professionalism and interpersonal skills that signal the people I'm going to for my dental care are trustworthy.  That criteria will not be the same for everyone.  So far, Dr. Adam and his team are ticking all the right boxes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cara
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Would you believe me if I said I kinda look forward to going to the dentist now?

Like many people, I used to dread dental appointments after a few not-so-great experiences and even delayed care because of it. ATX Family Dental completely changed that. Every team member leads with kindness, respect, and empathy. They take the time to clearly explain your care plan, answer all your questions, and never pressure you into optional or elective treatments. It’s a judgment-free zone! They manage to bring professionalism and humor into the experience, even though laughing with dental tools in your mouth can be tricky.  They all seem to genuinely enjoy their jobs and working together.. idk, It’s just a good time! I never thought I would write a review for a dental office, but here we are. Big fan. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Byron Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent experience at ATX Family Dental. Sandy and Dr. Adam Gutwein were incredibly attentive, efficient, and welcoming. You can tell they truly care about their patients and take pride in what they do. The office is modern, clean, and very well run.

After searching around, I’ve officially found my dentist in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've started telling everyone I know to make the switch. You won't regret it. Doctor Amanda does a great job, and all the staff help explain everything that is going on. I like having my hand held at the dentist, and it doesn't hurt that I can pick a show to watch to distract me from whatever is going on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Sunberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: My 2 kids loved their dentist appointment! They felt cared for and were entertained by tvs and stickers and toys. Dr Adam was fabulous with helping them feel confident about the whole process. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Caballero
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to this office by a friend. I was initially put off by the requirement for deposit for scheduling an appointment, but once I was there it made sense. They called me a few minutes before my appointment time, and I was out at exactly the estimated time for the appointment. As someone who values punctuality, it made the deposit worth it. The office itself is designed with attention to detail. The staff are all friendly and knowledgeable. My dentist was so kind and took the opportunity to get to know me a bit and make conversation. One of the most pleasant experiences I've had at a dentist's office with the newest technology, treatments, and practices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah S
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is always great and very encouraging of even the smallest steps toward better dental health. I’ve never once been guilted even though I’m horrible about not flossing. They’re also great at helping come up with alternatives that work better for YOU (eg flossing is hard? Try a water pick once a week at first and work your way up).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robyn Schoen
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have been patients of ATX Dental for several years now. The care we’ve  received from this facility has been fantastic! I appreciate their time and care when it comes to our dental health! Their new building is just icing on the cake! :) would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deb Ranelle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently went to ATX Family Dental for whitening gel and trays. My experience was excellent as the staff (Fey, Dr. Amanda, and Bethany) were professional and knowledgeable.

They listened to my concerns about sensitivity and recommended a plan to address the concerns.

Once my trays and gel came in, they were able to answer my questions around how long to use the gel, how to handle if my teeth did experience any sensitivity, and avg. time it may take for my teeth to start whitening.

The office is new, modern, and  has the latest technology. Parking is also easy as there is a good size parking lot.

Highly recommended if you’re considering or looking for a new dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Wagner
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family Dental is outstanding! The office is vibrant, contemporary, and inviting. Dr. Nadia expertly repaired two fractured teeth and made the entire experience comfortable and stress-free. I've undergone extensive dental work over the years, and she is by far the most skilled dentist I have seen. I can’t recommend them highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sean Runge
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to ATX Family Dental for years, and their new office just makes the whole experience even better. It’s bright, modern, and somehow makes going to the dentist feel… normal? Pleasant, even?

I had a cavity filled recently, and honestly the worst part was trying to pick which Netflix show to watch while they worked. The dentist walked me through everything with photos and super clear explanations, so there were zero surprises. Basically,  just a smooth, painless fix and me halfway through an episode of my favorite show.

The whole team is friendly, efficient, and consistently great every visit. If you want a place that actually makes dental work easy, ATX Family Dental is an easy yes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beej
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had another amazing experience at ATX Family Dental! Everyone is genuinely welcoming and helpful. I saw Haley and Dr Adam today- very knowledgeable, gentle and truly my advocate for best dental health. I wouldn't go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Worley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first appointment today at ATX Family Dental and everyone was so nice from the moment I walked in. Haley was my hygienist and she was amazing — super thorough, explained everything she was doing, and did such a great job on my cleaning. Then Dr. Nadia came in, and she was the best! She took her time going over my scans and X-rays, explained everything in a really clear way, and answered all my questions without ever making me feel rushed. The whole office has such a friendly, comfortable vibe. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Tiffany
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was genuinely the first dental appointment where I’ve ever felt excited to keep going back. The entire team was so supportive & kind during my exam/cleaning. Couldn’t recommend this practice enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Our whole family goes to ATX Family Dental, and the entire staff is fantastic. Every provider we’ve seen has been top-notch — they’re great with both kids and adults, and they make every visit feel easy and comfortable.

I recently had all four wisdom teeth removed, and the experience couldn’t have been better. From the procedure itself to the follow-up care, Dr. Nadia and the team took all the stress out of the process and made sure I felt supported every step of the way. They also work seamlessly with our insurance, which makes everything incredibly easy and fully transparent.

We highly recommend Dr. Nadia and the entire ATX Family Dental team. They truly go above and beyond.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Stidd
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great team that always does an excellent job. Every step of the appointment they're telling you what is going on and why. Also, great logistics in terms of pre/post appointment communication. Plus, the office is really nice. What's not to like?

user_reviews_extended.Name: adrian saenz
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time patient, the location is amazing/modern and welcoming! Breaks the mold of traditional dentist offices 👊 Dr. Vinh and her team that assisted me with both appointments leading up to my first wisdom tooth extraction was 10/10. Peace of mind during the whole process and a very clean office as well. 👍 Definitely a return patient in the future, highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Dahmann
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough great things about ATX Dental! Dr Amanda is one of the best dentists I have ever seen. She is so kind and truly cares about her patients. All the hygienists and front desk staff are also so nice and friendly! Never a bad experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chloe Bates
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best practice in Austin. I’ve tried countless places and was so excited to discover this one! Beautiful lobby space, bright clean rooms, friendly staff, Netflix with headphones (a requirement for me), and excellent doctors. This is my forever dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma Jean Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience with the ATX Family Dental team! Dr. Adam, Victoria, Jazmine, and Hailey took amazing care of me a couple weeks ago. I’ve been a patient with them since 2016 and am glad to be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clint Duross
user_reviews_extended.Description: Well, I appreciate the professionalism of this office. I had a crown placed a little over a year ago. It was very dissatisfied with the occlusion or lack there of an over adjustment of the crown resulted and added pressure to the other side of my mouth. The office is denying that that is an issue, but has admitted that the aesthetics of the crown Are inadequate. It was significantly shorter than the tooth on the other side and it would have been possible to receive the aesthetic look while remaining structurally sound. They are now offering to redo the crown, which I already told them. I have no interest in doing because it jeopardize the overall health of my tooth. I offered them a much more inexpensive solution for them, which is to simply give me a filling in another tooth to help make things right and right now it does not seem that they are willing to do that. It’s very unfortunate. I feel my time and my money has been wasted.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke A Cutler
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a pleasant experience in their new office off south 1st street! Everyone has always been very pleasant and nice. Today was no different. Dr. Adam was great and made sure I was very comfortable for a small dental procedure that's not normally super comfortable for me. The nitrous oxide and suction mouthpiece were game changers for my overall experience. I've also really enjoyed their cinnamon essential oil treatment in the past. It's very refreshing and almost makes the dentist trip feel like a bit of a spa. The energy and music always feel very calming in the space and I appreciate that. For some of your anxious patients you should try using the weighted xray vests- super calming for the sensory system when so much is happening! Side note- they have also been super great with my highly sensitive toddler! 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zetterina Salomon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have received excellent Dental care here. I used to be nervous all the time but everyone here is so patient and helpful. They have all you need for a pain free and comfortable visit. Bethany has also been the most helpful when it came to my insurance. She has gone above and beyond to make sure my dental work was covered as the insurance had not processed paperwork correctly. Thanks so much Bethany!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Manitzas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful group of people working here! My hygienist Kristen was kind, informative, and skilled, she explained things through the whole appointment. I will definitely use this dentist for all my needs in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gracen Cohen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great experience here. Dr. Nadia was incredibly thoughtful, kind, and thorough. She kept checking in throughout my visit and made sure I was comfortable the entire time. When one of my fillings needed to be fixed, the office got me in right away. Dr. Nadia not only resolved the issue quickly but also took the time to explain what had happened and how she was going to prevent it from recurring. Truly professional and caring. I can’t recommend this place enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Adelia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn’t been to the dentist in 13 years, and had a lot of anxiety searching for one after I chipped a molar and needed to get it fixed. The team at ATX Family Dental took such good care of me, they had options for a same day appointment to get me in asap to look at it. I was able to get it fixed within a week. Dr Amanda and everyone who helped me were patient, gentle, and asked the right questions. I would highly recommend them for anyone who’s at all anxious about the dentist! Their office is so serene with natural light and full of local art too, which I found such a nice relaxing setting!

user_reviews_extended.Name: lucy warden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient at ATX family dental for over 10 years and the reason for it is in their staff, their wonderful service, their doctors. They welcome you with a warm smile and the best customer service. Dr Adam has always been the best, great sense of humor, very professional and excellent work. And the new location is so relaxing and beautiful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend Dr Adam and ATX Family Dental. I’ve been a patient since moving to Austin 3 years ago and am so happy to have been recommended here by a co-worker. The entire team is friendly and professional and the new office is state of the art.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Damian Mc Loughlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hate going to the dentist. I love going to this dentist! Can’t recommend Dr. Adam and entire team (special mention to Sarah and Tian) at ATX Family Dental enough - front office team are all super nice, helpful and welcoming - back office team are tops, great bedside manner and polite - Nothing feels rushed, the practice itself looks and feels zen-y which helps for those of an anxious disposition. 10 out of 10.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brady Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dental experience I’ve ever had. After moving to ATX 6 months ago, finding trustworthy care was a challenge – but ATX Family Dental came highly recommended and more than delivered. From the advanced technology to the warm, well-designed space, everything felt like the gold standard of modern dentistry. Dr. Adams and his team provide outstanding care from start to finish, so their near-perfect reviews come as no surprise. Looking forward to my next visit in 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carolyn Overbeck
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a new patient appointment today and my experience was a 10/10. The dental hygienist was extremely thorough and kind and the doctor was very knowledgeable. Their new office on South 1st is a gorgeous facility. Looking forward to having them as my new dentist :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary Siegel
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you are new to the area, or are on the hunt for a new dental care team….look no further. No words can adequately express how grateful I am for ATX Family Dental. Not only are they extremely professional and truly talented within their work, they are warm, friendly and honest with their plan of care. I personally despised going to the dentist, and ATX Family Dental has completely changed my perspective. I want to also shout out Idalis and Dr. Amanda who are rockstars. Thank you ATX  Family Dental for getting my smile back!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariel Morado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really enjoyed my experience. Sarah was great and very trauma informed. I will definitely be referring folks, because good dentist offices are hard to find.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dana Hidalgo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve visited twice now and had exceptional experiences! They don’t just help me with any issues but they teach me preventative care so I can do better for myself. They also make sure I’m comfortable and explain everything they’re doing so I feel safe about all the decisions I’m making. Everyone there is super helpful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lulu Carranza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to ATX Family Dental for a few years now and I love it. However, I recently switched my 3 kids over to them because we don’t have dental insurance and our amazing pediatric dentist was becoming unaffordable. I was a bit heaitant because my 8-year-old has several tricky dental issues, including extremely sensitive teeth, so even a routine viait to the dentist is a nightmare for us. I have to say our experience for our 8yo has been nothing short of miraculous. The technicians and doctors have been SO kind and patient. Always respectful and sweet and somehow still able to do an excellent job. I must also note that they check my kids’ mouth and neck for signs of disease and I have never seen any other dentist do that to my kids.
I am so appreciative for everyone at ATX Family Dental for taking such great care of our teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corey Stockton
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is exceptional. Dr. Amanda and the rest of the staff are friendly and professional, and always communicate well with me. I’ve never looked forward to dentist visits in my life, but I look forward to my appointments at ATX Family Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mauricio S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going here for a few years and Cailee is always amazing. She is super kind, easy to talk to, and always makes sure I’m comfortable. Can’t recommend her enough!

Also want to shout out the front desk staff for always being so friendly, helpful with scheduling, and clear about costs before my visits. The whole team is great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jo Ariola
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to ATX Family Dental for years! I absolutely love their team. They go above and beyond to make you comfortable! If I ever have questions, they’re happy to educate me on any best hygiene practices or to expand on what they’ve observed on my x-rays. I always leave feeling confident and excited to come back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay McKenna
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best dental practice in Austin. Clean, efficient, friendly and wonderful at talking you through any problems that might pop up now and again.

If you're cavity free, you always get a gold star no matter your age...

Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Cunningham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient of Dr Gutwein for about ten years now. He is the best dentist I have had for sure!
He is very professional, nice and in addition, his staff is also very friendly. His new office is welcoming !
👉🏼You guys Rock!
From an over 60+ year old dude with great teeth …..😂 🎸🤩

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Richard
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I have been patients of ATX Family Dental for years and continue to be so impressed with their entire staff. They’re great with our kids, always quick and efficient getting us in and out, plus their new office is gorgeous!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alaina Hoffmann
user_reviews_extended.Description: A beautifully designed building full of caring and honest professionals. It is very refreshing to feel as though I can trust my dental team and feel like I’m in control of my treatment plan rather than feeling like I’m being sold unnecessary services. Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia Donnelly
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely hate going to the dentist and I’m a big baby siting in the chair. I trust Dr. Adam’s and ATX Family Dental and would recommend going there 100 percent. He and everyone else that works here does everything they can to make me feel comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liz Alanoori
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved everything about this place. The front desk helped me get in sooner than expected and both my hygienist Cailee and Dr Amanda were fabulous. I’ve never enjoyed going to the dentist until I found ATX family dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine C
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had two experiences here that went above and beyond my expectations so far. Haley is the best dental hygienist I’ve ever had- she really cared about my experience as a patient, walked me through everything, and did an amazing job on my gums (as seen in follow up X-rays!) Can honestly say I’ve never wanted to stay at the dentist instead of going back to work before. Dr. Ida was so patient with me during my first emergency appointment too. The phone and front desk staff have also done a great job at answering any questions and sometimes before I even have to ask. Anjelica was so helpful! Thank you all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christiaan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly, ATX and staff were "shockingly" amazing.  The doctor(s) were highly professional and took their time explaining options and recommendations.  The building is immaculate, and I see myself here decisively over any dentistry in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mel Dominguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had all four wisdom teeth extracted (as a women in her 40’s) with Dr. Nadia and her dental assistant Sandy. As someone with severe dental anxiety, I cannot express how grateful I am for how kind and patient they were with me. They explained every step with detail and gave me a clear explanation of all of my options. I was very comfortable and Dr. Nadia was quick, but thorough with the removal. Sandy was reassuring the entire time. I was dreading this appointment but I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Thank you! - Mel

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Maxin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to ATX Family Dental for 5 years. Their new office is beautiful and has ample parking. The hygienists and dentists are always so nice and friendly. They are super communicative and want to make you feel as comfortable as possible going to the dentist. Scheduling has always been a breeze and they are always on time with appointments. I'd recommend them to anyone in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nanette Acklin
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family Dental is amazing. I could not recommend them more. In addition to x-rays/cleanings, I’ve had 3 crowns and a filling done over the last 5 years and they are always gentle and accommodating. Love the option for blanket, headphones and tv on ceiling. The location is great and it’s a very modern office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maxwell McClelland
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife and I have been going here for 6+ years. Dr. Adams and his entire staff are nothing but fantastic! Dentists can put a bad taste in your mouth, but ATX Family Dental makes sure you walk away with fresh breath. Run, don’t walk… no other dental practice is better!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Polli Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I walked in and was greeted by several cheerful receptionists, which is saying something because my appointment was bright and early at 8am. Check in was quick, I immediately knew how much my appointment was going to cost and was able to use tap to pay.

I grabbed a free toothbrush and headed to the brushing station, the music was on and I could hear the staff happily chatting before the day began. When the staff is laughing it up with each other you really get a sense that everyone who works here is in a good groove with each other. You can tell when the staff of a place isn’t happy! The new office is stunning and clearly had a lot of thoughtful design choices because it still felt very familiar to the previous location but just fresher and bigger.

Haley was my hygienist and she was attentive as always. She is great at anticipating my needs and walking me through my appointments. I was worried about being overdue for my cleaning because I had a baby this year and just couldn’t make it in any sooner. Haley was not only non-judgmental but actually proud of me for coming in at all and sticking to my brushing and flossing routine through the new baby days. I had some questions about future elective procedures (a wisdom tooth, maybe doing Invisalign again) and never felt pressured to sign up for anything while at the same time felt really informed about my options.

I had a treatment earlier this year on some “pre cavities” and was told that it sometimes takes a few applications once a year for it to fully work. I was due for updated X-rays today so they were able to check on the spots earlier than usual and I was pleasantly shocked to learn that the treatment was already doing its job! These are spots that have been mentioned to me at previous dental offices for YEARS and never given an option to prevent them from getting worse. I have dental anxiety when it comes to injections so I jumped at the chance to avoid that when they offered the new treatment and I’m so glad I did!

Dr Adam did my exam and he is extremely thorough. He checks not only the top of your teeth but also the sides and makes sure to answer any questions you have. He will show you pictures and X-rays on a screen and then point to the spot in your mouth so you know exactly what he’s talking about. It always seems like his goal is to keep you out of his chair and just coming in for cleanings because he mostly talks about preventative measures unless there’s something that seriously needs to be addressed.

I left with a gold star (IYKYK) and clean teeth 🤩 I love my dental office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Crystal Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great first visit and teeth cleaning. A great place if you have any sort of dentist anxiety 🦷 Really smart and youthful staff, and good thorough overall treatment planning and care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stevie Golding
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience here! The doctors and hygienists are so kind and thorough. The best part is a gold star after your exam ⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Spelber
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was visiting family in Austin when I needed an emergency dental visit for an infected wisdom tooth. The office is bright and welcoming, and the staff made what could have been stressful feel simple.

I was seen the same day, got treatment right away, and was given a clear estimate of what insurance would cover. The pricing was fair, and now that I’ve received my bill, it matched exactly. ATX Family Dental came highly recommended by my friends in town, and I’m so glad I went instead of trying to wait it out until I got home.

Highly recommend this office to anyone looking for an emergency dentist in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Starbuck
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So far I've had a great experience at ATX Family Dental, which is saying a lot because I normally get incredibly anxious about going to the dentist. At my first cleaning, my hygienist (I'm so sorry I don't remember your name!) made me feel really at ease, despite some not so great news, albeit expected. I met Dr. Adam at this visit and he explained his plan very thoroughly and KINDLY.

At my next and most recent visit, I had three (apparently difficult) fillings done. Dr. Adam took his time to make sure I was comfortable and couldn't feel any of the procedure. His assistant (also don't remember your name and I'm so sorry about that!) was also incredibly kind and helped me calm down prior to starting the appointment. I left feeling numb, as expected, but also feeling much better about going to the dentist. To my surprise, Dr. Adam even checked on me that evening to make sure everything felt alright after the numbness wore off!

TLDR: if you're anxious about dental visits like I am, I highly recommend visiting Dr. Adam. He and his staff are so kind and really try their best to put you at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Louise
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dentist I’ve ever been to, so much so that i genuinely looked forward to my visits! Cleanings were easy and comfortable, and when I had to have a filling replaced, they took the time to ensure I was sufficiently numb so that I never felt any discomfort. I no longer live in Austin, but am considering traveling back for dental appointments because ATX Family Dental is truly THAT GOOD! The team are super caring, and the office is always very clean and well kept. 10/10 recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Dube
user_reviews_extended.Description: We had a great time with our twins first dentist appointment here! One of them was nervous and crying at first and then was smiling and giggling by the time we left. The dental hygienists worked some magic getting an X-ray on her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Jeter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going here for 8 years. Cannot speak more highly of the staff and hygienists. Very trustworthy and quality care. Best dentists in Austin, hands down!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alice Woods
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient with ATX Family Dental for over 3 years and have had an exceptional experience with them. The hygienists and front desk staff are consistently friendly, professional, and efficient. My appointments always start on time. I appreciate the wellness plan as an option for those without dental insurance to understand exactly how much cleanings will cost each year.

Dr. Ida in particular is fantastic. She has replaced several old fillings for me and always goes above and beyond to make sure I am comfortable and never in pain, in a way I have never experienced at a dentist before, even checking in via text after my appointments to make sure everything still feels okay.

The new office is beautiful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: dakota chandler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved every step of the process with ATX Family Dental. They got me in as soon as possible, the staff was so friendly, and Dr. Adam was forreal the gentlest dentist I’ve ever met. He did constant check-ins, and Sandy made me feel right at home with a blanket and straight forward pricing and expectations. Would recommend to all my friends. Definitely the best dental experience I’ve ever had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Schwerdtfeger
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family dental is phenomenal. We’ve even moved 45 minutes away and our entire family still makes the trip! They provide such good care for my husband, son and I. We can’t recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Cicciarelli
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to ATX Family Dental for years now and they are by far my favorite dentist. Everyone is so nice and I have always trusted the dentists that I have seen there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rob Lifford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been a patient of theirs for a long time: initially chose them because they were conveniently located on my commute home, but have stayed with them because they are a warm, friendly, well-run practice in pretty much every way. The new office on South 1st is beautifully set up with huge windows in front of the chairs so it's flooded with natural light and you feel nestled under a canopy of live oak branches.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This dental office has been an incredible relief to find since moving back to Austin. I’ve had poor experiences at the dentist before that have left me in physical and financial pain, but ATX Family Dental staff made sure I was comfortable during my entire appointment and communicated very clearly what payment I would be responsible for after insurance, but also helped recommend certain procedures that could be done later so I wouldn’t break the bank in one day.

I’m extremely anxious and self conscious about the dentist, but this is the first time I’ve walked out of a dentist feeling confident. Couldn’t suggest this place more.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joley Kirkland
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family dental is the best in Austin! The staff here is so friendly and welcoming. I usually hate going to the dentist but always feel at ease here. Thank you Kristen and Dr. Adam!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mohammed Alberznji
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just happy with my decision to switch. They are very professional and detailed. They take time to keep you informed of your dental health in every step.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doug Diamond
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nadia and Erica were extremely kind and caring to me.  I came in with a broken tooth and left feeling better than I could have expected.  Best experience I’ve ever had at the dentist! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Estefany Gomez
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place really treats you like family! Everyone is so sweet and kind and my experience has been that consistently. Dr. Ida was great, very caring and thoughtful throughout our process. All the beautiful plants in the lobby are a plus! Definitely recommend this dental office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to ATX Dental for the last 3 years. They’re incredibly professional and their office is gorgeous. I always feel very comfortable and everyone is so friendly! I hate going to the dentist but they make it tolerable - thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Schmidt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited to have a molar removed. From the moment I walked in the door, the staff was kind and helpful and everyone had a smile on their face. Dr Ida did a great job removing the tooth and there were no pain or complications afterwards. Everything healed as expected. ATX Family Dental  took over a seemingly abandoned building that was a graffiti covered eye sore and turned it into an attractive and welcoming environment. I am glad to have found dental services so close to home and they are doing a great job of building trust.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brent Sodman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It takes a lot to get me to write a review.

I can say, without question, that not only is ATX Family Dental the best dentist I have ever been to, my experiences there have been better than I would have imagined going to a dentist could be. The experience so far outstrips any other medical experience I've had that it feels unfair to even compare them.

Dr. Amanda Vinh and both of the wonderful hygienists who have helped me (Deedee and Fey, you're both incredible) could not have been more helpful, more kind, more friendly, more expedient, or more accurate in their administrations.

The facilities are clean, stylish, reassuring, and well-equipped both for the task at hand and for the comfort and entertainment of the patients.

I had to return for a follow-up the day after my first appointment, and I was almost looking forward to it. If that isn't a compelling review for dental work, I don't know what to tell you.

ATX Family Dental, thank you. I'd write ten reviews if I could.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jake Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here for a couple years now.  Their new facility on South 1st is very nice.  Everyone has been friendly and supportive.  Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nova
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have pretty intense dental phobia/anxiety due to unfortunate dental visits in my past. To the point where I stopped going to the dentist all together for a couple of years. I became a patient at ATX Family Dental at the recommendation of a friend, and read several similar reviews to my situation so I cautiously went it to seek treatment.

From the get go, everyone here has been so incredibly warm and friendly. Staff is very gentle - providing blankets, stress balls, sunglasses to help with the bright light, and headphones/remote access to relax. They also offer nitrous (laughing gas) treatment if you need it. I cannot tell you how much this has helped ease my fears. They also don’t treat you with any judgement and are patient when they explain things.

Dr. Ida is the best, even going above and beyond to message me after appointments to check in on how my teeth are feeling after a filling. I can really tell she cares about her patients, and it’s super thoughtful.

I also really appreciate their investment into new tech! It’s cool to see scans of my teeth in real time. Also the tool they use for X-rays here are much more minimal and quick, which I appreciate as someone with a sensitive gag reflex and fear of those bulky X-rays.

Although my dental fear is not completely cured, I’m surprised how much it’s reduced already.

Another plus is how beautiful their office is! You almost don’t feel like you’re going to the dentist (which in my case, has helped tremendously in tricking myself haha)
Definitely not your typical sterile clinical dentist vibe.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriela Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The high quality of work this place does is incredible. I love the employees. I always love my dental hygienist and dentist. Sometimes I still get really scared to go to the dentist, but then I feel so comfortable afterwards they Really make your experience so nice. Thank you to all the staff again for such a wonderful time,  my teeth feel and look great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evan Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: First dentist visit in a while and was recommended ATX Family Dental by my coworker. My first visit was great! I was treated amazing from start to end and staff was very encouraging to me to ask any questions I had. They explained everything very well for me to understand, and I felt the support. Amazing work done, too! The building itself is vibrant and reminiscent of SoCo, has a comfortable Austin feel to it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Esther Teller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very kind front desk people, techs and dentists. The atmosphere and art in the place feels relaxing as a home-not a medical or dental waiting room. Good options for payment, scheduling, explanations and work is all great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Groover
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The front desk staff was incredibly helpful in scheduling an appointment that fit my availability. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and well taken care of.

My hygienist, Jazzy, was both personable and knowledgeable, making the cleaning process as quick and painless as possible. The office even has a TV mounted above the chair for those who prefer a distraction, but I found the experience so smooth that I didn’t need it!

After my cleaning, Dr. Amanda thoroughly reviewed my X-rays and took a closer look at a couple of areas. She identified the early stages of a cavity between my teeth and explained my treatment options clearly. Instead of requiring drilling, she recommended a simple, non-invasive solution that could be applied in just 15 minutes. Scheduling the follow-up was effortless, and the entire process was efficient and stress-free.

Everyone at the office was an absolute pleasure to work with, and I genuinely look forward to my next cleaning. If you're looking for a dental office that is professional, welcoming, and committed to top-notch care, I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hollie Jarratt
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the dentist office you've been looking for! The office is modern, clean, and relaxing. The staff is incredibly kind. Loved my hygienist!!! They go out of their way to make you comfortable. Finding this place feels like good luck, so I'm writing this positive review to pass along the good luck to others!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Lang
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here are incredible and efficient. After neglecting cleanings for several years, they were able to make me feel extremely comfortable while quickly coming up with a plan to get my oral health back on track. Everything was explained in an articulate manner, and I did not feel pressured to make any decisions or appointments that I was not ready or financially prepared for. While I am not one who is easily bothered by dentist visits, my first visit here was easily the best experience I have ever had, and I look forward to continuing my treatment plan with the warm, welcoming staff at ATX Family Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Sheeran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Amanda and the whole ATX dental team is incredible. They are unbelievably professional and efficient. I’m always super impressed at how in sync their whole office is. I’m always comfortable and feeling safe when I’m there. Plus, the new location is so freaking cool. I love it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheena Yz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ida is the best dentist we could ever imagine for our almost 2 year old kiddo. She is patient, kind, extremely knowledgeable, and non-judgmental. The whole staff was SO sweet with him and he had such a fun appointment with them. We left with no tears! Highly recommend for people of all ages. Super cool office too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Glass
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Been coming to ATX Dental for quite sometime & the new office on 1st is an awesome upgrade. The place is even nicer, larger, & keeps that Austin vibe. I highly recommend because the staff is top tier & Dr.
Adams has done wonders to keep my teeth elite. They also continue to keep up with all the newest technology & upgrades.
#GoGetYourGoldStar

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lex Cribbs
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family Dental is the best dentist in Austin, full stop… maybe the best dentist I’ve been to in my 34 years of life (and I’ve lived in four states and two countries). The amount of time and energy the hygienists and the dentists put into your education about your teeth, and empower you to make decisions that are right for you AND your wallet is incredible. There’s no shame and no discomfort — if you have anxiety about cleanings, they have solutions for you. Specifically, Dr. Amanda, Polly, Hayley, and Cailee have taken amazing care of me over the last two years. I’m grateful for this team and their new office is beautiful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Somerville
user_reviews_extended.Description: The front desk staff are very friendly and always send helpful appointment reminders. Dr. Adam and Dr. Amanda are thorough and do excellent work! I've had a few cavities treated, and everything has gone smoothly. Every team member goes out of their way to ensure you're comfortable, and you can tell they genuinely enjoy being there. Highly recommend ATX Family Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Arana
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had friends refer me to ATX Family Dental and was hopeful, but my experience was mixed. I appreciated that they squeezed me in early when I was in pain, and the dentist and dental tech were excellent, gentle, caring, and even made sure I’d be able to eat later in the day with less discomfort.

However, the front desk experience was disappointing. While it was made clear that payment was required upfront, I was initially told they had third-party financing options available, which gave me some relief. Later, I learned that CareCredit was the only financing option they accept, and that wasn’t clearly communicated at first. Front Desk Staff also felt rushed and unsympathetic, and when I had trouble with the digital forms, the paper ones ended up being easier—despite being told online was “easier.” It was never clearly communicated that I needed to turn in the paperwork after finishing, and the front desk staff seemed frustrated that I had already completed it. There were no clear instructions on where or how to return the paperwork. At most places I’ve been, the technician usually collects the paperwork, so this response was not expected.

Before leaving, I requested my X-rays be sent to me so I could forward them to another office. They weren’t sent initially because the email address on file was incorrect. After I followed up and the error was corrected, the X-rays were promptly resent. Although the email communication was polite, it didn’t compensate for the cold and impersonal in-person and phone interactions.

Despite receiving great dental care from the clinical team, whose friendliness and professionalism were much appreciated, the prices are too high for me. Unfortunately, the overall experience was affected by the front desk staff, whose cold and impersonal attitude set the tone from the moment they answered the phone and when I walked into the office. I expected a warmer, more empathetic environment, especially after being referred, and will be looking elsewhere for more affordable care with a friendlier atmosphere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Em C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sarah was a gem! She kept me informed every step of the way and was very profesional. Doctor Nadia was really nice too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Wayne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
ATX Family Dental is so wonderful! They always create a warm and welcoming space. They have TVs & headphones in each room to help distract you if you’re nervous. They provide sunglasses for the bright lights and use various tools/practices to make dental work as comfortable as possible.

If I have any questions, whether about recommended work or payments, they take the time to answer them. They are not pushy about any services, but ensure you know your options. I have seen multiple different hygienists and doctors (for fillings and/or cleanings) and have had a good experience each time.

I recommend ATX Family Dental to anyone I can!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will
user_reviews_extended.Description: Easily the best dental office I've visited in many years. The staff are all wonderful. The space is incredibly pleasant and inviting and Dr. Adam went above and beyond to make the experience painless, comfortable and quick. I can't recommend this group enough, and I'm happy to have found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gracen Cohen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have such a pleasant experience at ATX Dental. The new office itself is exceptionally clean, well-organized, and had a calming atmosphere. My dentist and hygienists were gentle yet thorough, explaining everything along the way, which made the process smooth and stress-free.They took the time to answer any questions and ensure I was comfortable. Overall, it was a great visit, and I left feeling well taken care of and love coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawn Kobayashi
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is amazing! From the people all the way down to the awesome new location. When you walk in, the vibe itself is relaxing and doesn’t give you the typical “I’m at the dentist” anxiety… kinda makes you want to fake a tooth ache as an excuse just to visit. Thank you Dr. Adam (always on his A-game), Faye, and all the team for making this a great experience! -Shawn

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Morris
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cailee is the best! I have never felt so comfortable at the dentist. She truly makes you feel at ease and is very kind. My teeth already feel so much better!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Kravanek
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit at ATX Family Dental and first impressions go a long way. Love the new office and all the staff there are very welcoming and friendly. Glad I found ATX and I would recommend them to everyone 🦷🪥

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Pickering
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Firstly, this place is nice and so are the people. I feel like the services are good as well.

My issue is that this place always seems to have some sort of up charge or trying to convince you to spend money with them. I’ve never had this with any other dentist. I went from not minding the dentist to anxiety over what service they are going to sell me this time.

Worse than that, today I receive a bill for $32 seemingly out of the blue for a normal cleaning. I’ve never been charged for a cleaning in my 38 years of going to the dentist. Why the random charge?  Frustrating and paid but won’t return any longer.

Great facility and people BUT beware to feel sold to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: ​I can’t say enough great things about ATX Family Dental! The staff are incredible—super friendly, knowledgeable, and always make you feel at ease. The new office space is absolutely beautiful and so peaceful; it feels more like a spa than a dentist’s office. I especially love the little touches, like getting a gold star for keeping up with flossing. Amazing. Highly recommend to anyone looking for the absolute best dental care in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darcee Douglas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a patient at ATX Family Dental for years because they are simply the BEST!  Every moment at ATX is a joy.

The receptionist are friendly and helpful, the oral hygienists are warm, careful, and informative, and the dentists are patient, communicative, and  thorough.

The office is absolutely FABULOUS! It is beautifully furnished and decorated. The waiting room is lovely - I often kick myself for not coming earlier to enjoy lounging there longer. The treatment spaces are extremely comfortable and include TV’s above the chairs so if you prefer distraction while having your procedures, you can watch a show. The overall vibe of the whole place is simply wonderful.

I’ve been recommending ATX Family Dental to all my friends for years. If you are searching for dental health care that actually feels like you are truly being cared for,  check out ATX Family Dental. Relax and truly enjoy going to the dentist for a change.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Patrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: They do a phenomenal job educating and caring for their patients. They stand out from the norm in the best possible way. I’ll be returning and recommending them to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Sonders
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a really lovely experience here. Everyone is very nice and friendly and professional, and I felt like everyone had a good attention to detail with no aggressive upsells.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sandra alvarado
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I look forward to going to my dental visit, front desk are always so helpful in scheduling my appointments. The waiting room is warm and comfortable.

I had such a great experience with Cailee my dental hygienist. Super friendly easy to talk to and made me feel completely at ease. She was careful and gentle during my cleaning. I love feeling like I’m going to a day spa for my mouth.  After my cleaning Dr. Ida came in for the exam and I was just as impressive. She was friendly, knowledgeable, and took the time to go over everything clearly. I never felt rushed and I appreciate how they answered all my questions. ATXFD is a great office to have all your dental needs met.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anabelle Seybert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience at ATX Family Dental! I felt so comfortable, at ease and cared for. I loved how they focused on preventative care as well. Would absolutely recommend going here for any dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Haro
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at ATX Family Dental.  Everyone was so friendly and very professional!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morgan Carpenter
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family Dental is amazing. Every person I encountered was so kind and helpful. The Dentist, Dr. Ida is one of the best I’ve ever worked with. She takes her time, makes you feel comfortable and clearly explains what and why she is recommending certain things. I had a cavity filled with her and it was a great experience. I will absolutely be returning and will be recommending ATX Family Dental to my friends/family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maggie Oxman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience with this office was excellent. We made an emergency appointment and got in within a few days, and the questions that they asked about my history and experiences with previous dental work really helped me feel more confident that they care. Thien (I hope I spelled that right) was great and Dr. Adam was so sweet and helpful, and referred me to an oral surgeon immediately so I really felt like a priority.
If you're an autistic adult or someone with dental trauma, they don't do sedation in-house besides laughing gas, but they really accommodate and take into consideration sensory needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ezgi Ozcan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had a great experience here. The team is helpful, the quality of the work is excellent, and everything is explained clearly and transparently. I always feel well taken care of

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joanne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dental practice I’ve ever been to! Their new office is beautiful, clean, and modern with ample parking. Doctor Adam and the entire staff is lovely and their state of the art technology is next level. I’ll be recommending this place to anyone needing a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vivi Verges
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just started here last week and it’s been great! They took great care of me with my dental cleaning last week and told me I needed a cavity filled. I had that done this morning by Dr. Amanda and Erika and they did a fantastic job. It was an easy experience and I was in and out in an hour — and I didn’t feel a thing! Bonus points for having a TV on the ceiling so you can watch Netflix while they go to work. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gregory Carlson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going here for years and I really enjoy the experience! Dr Adam and the team are so pleasant to work with!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lexi Sully
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ida is great, she makes the experience less stressful and as pain free as possible. I think the hygienists/other staff are also great, they're kind and pleasant. The office is pretty cute too. I've had past offices make me feel insecure about my teeth or try to convince me to get veneers or whatever else - I've never felt any kind of judgment here or that they were trying to sell me something  (which is super weird for a doctors office imo). I would reccomend this place to others :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Shabino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great experience as always! I’ve gone to a few dentists in the 10 years I’ve lived in Austin and ATX Family Dental is hands down the best start to finish. Been going for years now- Highly recommend 🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Galluccio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Nadia and Thien and Angelica are amazing best dentist group i have ever been to!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madi Taskett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming here for 5 years and every time, I get great service. I'm never upsold anything I don't need, and my teeth have remained cavity free and in great shape!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kinsey Christian
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had several presenting problems when I came to ATX Family Dental and the hygienists and dentists were so well informed and equipped to help me with every concern I had. They even fit me into a same-day appointment for a filling. They made me feel so comfortable by keeping me in the loop and being transparent at every step of the process. I especially appreciate Dr. Adam, Dr. Amanda, Ella, and the hygienist that assisted Dr. Amanda with my filling. I feel happy that I can show off my smile now instead of hiding my full smile because of insecurities!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Costa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Do not fall for their “wellness plan” scheme!
This place will get you to prepay for two cleanings. They will not let you use your second cleaning until you pay them for many extras needed that they will find on their first exam. When asked if they can at least apply the cost of the second cleaning to the huge estimate needed, they will not. It’s really hard to find an honest dentist in Austin. Highly do not recommend this company. I know they have moved since I was there but their office also did not seem to be clean or sanitary!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Gilliam
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to ATX family dental for two years now and only have had amazing experiences. Wonderful staff and the new location is great! Can’t recommend this place enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mrs. Infinite
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Amanda and her team were wonderful. I came in for emergency adjustment to two crowns and the relief that was achieved was so good. I am grateful for the help and it feels good to be pain free :) I feel she has a high level of dexterity.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Tamez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The overall experience here is very calm and friendly. This is definitely a standout in terms of patient care and attentiveness to anyone who has a fear of going to see the dentist. The staff make sure all patients feel comfortable during their appointments

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anita Tschurr
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm a huge believer in dental care and I've only had 3 dentist over the last 30 years. I happened upon these folks because they are in my neighborhood. This whole office is conscientious, great manner, obviously very well trained and for real, the very best dental experience I have ever had. I had a painful tooth, they took X-rays  and Dr. Ida got to work. No pain. Diligent cavity repair and I'm gone. Dental success.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlin Haisler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had some rough experiences with dentists in the past, but this practice does a great job of working with you to make sure you’re receiving the care you need. They do excellent work. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitchell Locey
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at ATX Family Dental has been great! The entire staff is professional and polite. Kristin, my hygienist, gave me the best cleaning of my life! Dr. Amanda made getting an old filling repaired a breeze. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Kaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: This crew does great work and is a super comfortable environment for what is not everyone’s favorite visit to make. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connor Petros
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a bad experience with a cavity filling at another office. Reached out to ATX Family dental and they were night and day in comparison. Everyone was incredibly nice and professional. Dr. Adam and his team were great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blake Broussard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love ATX Family Dental! The entire staff is so friendly and the doctors are great. Always an awesome experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Price
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a poor experience with the office prior to my appointment. There was poor clarity about what is covered by insurance, and what is possible to know beforehand. I had to request multiple times to get a response on if they even took my insurance at all. Each time they said "it takes a few days to find out" then I didn't hear back, and had to call/text again. Eventually I was assured that they "expected" no out of pocket, but they had not run the insurance. I understand they can't know what extra treatments are needed until they see me in person, but for an exam and cleaning, they should be able to run that through insurance. At the appt, the hygenist was obviously knowledgeable, but the tone was that of upselling. She recommended additional treatment beyond cleaning which seemed unnecessary to me. Somehow they were able to run that through insurance immediately, which I'm grateful for, but was frustrating, since apparently that was always possible. She had responses to my questions, but they were glib and aimed at getting me committed to 6 months visits, which is not necessary. I've never experienced a tone like this at a dentist before, except this appt and my previous at ATX family dental. I was left frustrated because I do understand the need for proactive care even if it costs extra, but my experience of poor communication prior the appt and the upselling tone during the appointment, paired with the memory of a surprise out of pocket fee of $500 last time for the exact same treatment they were suggesting this time (gingivitis treatment + followup) left me totally unwilling to trust the recommendation. Normal cleaning was not available due to the perceived need to treat the gingivitis. I have no idea whether this is typical practice, I have to rely on trust in situations like this, and I did not feel like I could trust this business after these experiences. So I opted out of the treatment.
I was told that they would try to charge the X-ray to insurance, and they'd let me know if there was any difference (out of pocket). They expected there would be no out of pocket, but this still frustrated me since I expressed over and over again that I wished for them to run my insurance before I received any treatment. Even though I was very careful asking for this, I still managed to stumble into a treatment where the out of pocket cost is unknown. "We'll let you know if there's a difference!" is really a bummer of a response when I've asked so many times for clarity on this, and we both know you are able to run the insurance beforehand, or now. I left without pressing the issue further. I didn't feel like it was possible to communicate with trust anymore. I want to be clear I don't fault the hygenist or office staff. I'm sure they are just following guidance from their management.

Update: I was able to get an appointment with a different, well-established popular dentist office in town. They told me my gums had "a little bleeding, but were fine and we can definitely do a normal cleaning today." No cavities or any other issues either. Glad I got a second opinion, frustrated I needed one for something so routine. I cannot remotely recommend ATX Family Dental now that a second opinion showed they were clearly prescribing unneeded treatments and high frequency visits for no reason.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth J
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was looking to find a dentist in the SOCO area and came across this office. I was really excited due to the reviews about this place. I tried making a New Patient appt online but was having trouble doing so, so I decided to give the office a call. Liz took my call but was definitely not in a good mood. I didn’t like her demeanor over the phone. I stated that I was a new patient and what kind of appt I was looking for. She mentioned that it will be a 2hr appt and that I had to leave a $50 deposit to book my appt. Didn’t bother asking if I had Dental INS or never mentioned if the $50 dlls where refundable until I asked. Asking for INS is important because if they don’t take your INS then why continue w the call? She Didn’t bother asking what day worked for me or if I had any particular day in mind. She just told me the day she had available and the time which I responded I was looking for something during spring break which she immediately responded with “I DONT KNOW WHEN THAT IS!” Ok… I felt very confused didn’t know if I was calling the right place w awesome reviews. After that I didn’t want to continue the conversation and ended the call. I’m sure her demeanor doesn’t reflect the dentist or the assistants in the back but that interaction made me not want to continue forward w the scheduling process. Throughout the call it felt rush and from her part the urge to get it over with. It’s too bad! By the reviews this place looks very promising! Hope nobody else experiences this and catches Liz in a better mood next time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kayleigh Treanor
