user_reviews_extended.Name: AriellePizano
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Up to date review:
Today Feb 3rd I had a root canal.
I’m going to be honest. When I was told I was going to need a root canal I had chills go down my spine. But it is something that needed to be done. Fast forward to today. It’s the day of the procedure. I’m anxious and nervous. I was guided to where the procedure was going to take place and sat in the chair. Erica immediately made me feel calm and welcomed. She went through every step and made sure I understood what was to happen. My anxieties started to go away. Then came Dr. Ida to explain once again what is to happen. Another layer of assurance. ❤️ Then began the procedure. I will say, this was the most relaxing dental procedure I’ve ever had! If you have any doubts about where to go. No need to look anymore. ATX dental is the place to go. Thank You Dr. Ida and Erika for making what was an anxiety ridden visit to a painless relaxing procedure.

Truly amazing!
Love this place❤️
I felt at ease and felt heard. I’m very pleased with this place. Staff were professional and courteous. Dr. Ida did my cleaning alongside Karen and they were amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Adam and his staff provide excellent service, attention to your comfort and knowledge as a patient. During every step, Dr. Adam and his staff explained treatment recommendations by showing me my x-rays and photos of my teeth. Everyone was kind, professional and knowledgeable. I was very impressed by ATX Family Dental and highly recommended them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: vivianna beltran
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was very friendly but my visit was not pleasant. I came in for a cosmetic appointment to have a tooth bonded for a small chip on my front tooth. I understand the practice was busy that Friday and was grateful to have been given an appointment. Once the X-rays were done and the first dentist came in to examine what was needed I was disappointed to find out that they still had to see if they had time to do the procedure that day. Their website states “This relatively simple procedure can be done in a single dentist visit.” Once I was waiting to find out if it was possible to do the procedure the same day I was then quoted $500 after already paying $150 for my initial visit as I’m an out of pocket patient. While everything was being reviewed to me I still had to ask if there was time to do the procedure which then finally was told yes. I decided not to move forward with my visit. After leaving I felt that I had been hassled. In my previous experiences with dentists I had never been quoted so high for something so minimal. Even my previous dentist mentioned that my quote was overpriced.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Basti
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dentist I’ve ever been to! Dr. Adam Gutwein is so friendly and welcoming, the office is modern and comforting, and the staff overall is extremely helpful and accommodating. Going to the dentist can obviously be a stressful experience, but they do all they can to alleviate that. I cannot recommend them enough

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christy Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I rarely write reviews but I just had my first visit at ATX Family Dental and it was a great experience. The vibe is very relaxed and cozy, and my hygienist really took the time to hear my concerns and walked me through everything she did along the way, making sure I felt comfortable. I was a little nervous about my visit due to previous experiences at another place, but I quickly felt at ease and would definitely recommend them to anyone seeking dental care. Many thanks to Dr. Adam and the whole team there!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dhvanit Vora
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great services. Poor finance management. I went and had dental clean up at Atx Family dental. They were very professional and results were up to the mark. Excellent job. No complain on that behalf. We agreed on what will I be charged - what will I pay and what will insurance cover. After that I got the message that insurance did not cover what they thought and now I have to pay around 900$. This is very unprofessional, they already had details of my insurance so they should have known this earlier. Anyways will not wish this to happen to anyone else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Russell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my second visit to ATX Family Dental and I love it! The staff are friendly and engaging. They stay current on the newest options for various treatments and have a great facility. I had Haley today as my hygienist and she was wonderful. It also doesn't hurt that there is a super tasty poke place right next door!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley DiStefano
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have TERRIBLY  bad anxiety from childhood trauma about the dentist so it’s very very hard for me to get the courage to actually go to the dentist.

While it’s not ideal to have this kind of anxiety they are very kind and patient while working with me, even though I know it was challenging for them.

I am really grateful they are so willing to work with my dental anxiety.

Dr. Amanda is the kindest dentist I have ever met, she made me feel so comfortable and spoke with me about my anxiety. I felt so embarrassed by how nervous I was and she made me feel better. I had Kaleigh as my dental hygienist and I almost let my nerves get the best of me and left but I didn’t and Kaleigh was very gentle  and kind.

This was my second visit, I highly recommend ATX Dental if you have dental anxiety.

Thank y’all so much for being so kind to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Baynham
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit. Everyone was friendly, kind and professional. They did a great job of showing me what they were talking about and explaining what needed to be done. They really listened. This place was recommended by coworkers and I am very happy to have changed dentists to come here : )

user_reviews_extended.Name: Micah Cain
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at ATX Family Dental really made an impression on me. I wouldnt recommend you go anywhere else! The team here were all so kind, caring, and very knowledgeable. They were willing to help discuss any questions you had and made sure all billing was clear. They clearly want the best for you and you feel that everytime youre talking with them

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becky Shaheen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I finally found a dentist I love!  I was with my other dentist for a while, but I wanted to find someone closer to work/home. The whole process with ATX Family Dental was smooth. They do have long waits when you book an appointment, but it’s totally worth it. My hygienist (Polly) was thorough and very knowledgeable. Dentist was awesome as well and I am so happy I have a new dentist just minutes from me. And since I don’t have dental insurance, I appreciate the dental plans they offer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Klein
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had broken my tooth and was able to get in the next morning within an hour of calling. Amazing service and very transparent pricing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karina Soto
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always felt taken care of by all the staff since my very first visit to ATX Family dental. They never made me feel self conscious of my dental issues, especially since I had only been to the dentist once in 30 years, and have taken great care of my smile for the past 5 years. Everyone in the office is always friendly and constantly making sure I am comfortable and taken care of. You guys are awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Ryan
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit A+. The hygienist was great-very thorough & knowledgeable. I liked how they were able to walk me through a plan of pricing according to my insurance and based off my personal needs. So friendly and efficient. Such a relief to have a great dentist in ATX after moving from out of state.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zach Groesbeck
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Amanda and the team were really kind and empathetic to my needs and financial constraints. They quickly contacted my insurance, developed a plan, and went over the options with me very thoroughly. They also were able to get me in for a filling the same day as my initial visit, which was very relieving.

The office itself is really modern, has a laid back vibe, despite being a pretty busy place. Feels both futuristic, vintage 50’s, relaxing, and very hip. When you’re there for an appointment, you feel like you’re at the place to be.

The procedure rooms are very mellow and calming, and they have TVs with Netflix and HBO Max that you can watch while getting work done.

I feel confident in making Dr. Amanda and the team at ATX Family Dental my new go to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jane Gallegos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Exceptional care and friendly staff! The front desk staff are super helpful too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Front office staff was so well organized and I loved being able to fill out all of my forms digitally. Shelby was the perfect amount of sociable to me and didn’t stress me out with small talk at the beginning of my exam. Dr. Amanda was truly such a blessing. I was really stressed out coming into my appointment thinking a million things were wrong with me, but she was wonderful about alleviating my fears and letting me know what was a priority and what we could take some time with. I would recommend ATX family dental to anyone who hasn’t been to the dentist in a while and is a little stressed about everything that could go wrong. I’m excited to make this my dental office and will be so much more comfortable and at ease at my next appointment. ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Quinn Daly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience at ATX family dental. Dr Ida and her team are amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Amanda and Faye went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and confident with my treatment plan. Prior to and throughout the planned procedure, they would check in with me to make sure I was comfortable. If you’re looking for a fantastic dentist and staff, I can’t recommend Dr. Amanda and ATX family dental enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessi Santos Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This dentist office is so cute! Front staff was really friendly. My dental hygienist Haley was incredibly informative, careful and kind! She was understanding of me having to have my fidget toy and noise canceling headphones for sensory issues. :)
They also provide a pair of heart shaped sunnies to help with the bright lights, another huge help for folks with sensory issues. They have a TV on the ceiling! Overall great experience and glad I came here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annahi Aviles
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cailee is my dental hygienist. She is a true gem! This office always assists me so fast. Cailee always keeps me accountable with my flossing and brushing. She always does an amazing job and is also so quick. She is very personable. Feels like I’m catching up with a friend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: River C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Saved a broken tooth. Dr. Ida even called me during labor day weekend when my temporary crown fell off to give me advice. Everyone here is so welcoming and nice.
Im autistic and have had a lot of dental trauma, and every visit has been met with understanding and kindness.
Not in my network but I dont care; this dentist is the greatest, and the dental plan was worth it with how much work I still need done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna Griffis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I usually dread going to the dentist and know I'm not alone in that, but ATX Family Dental really goes above and beyond to make sure you have a comfortable experience. Even a simple teeth cleaning can be scary when you've had dental trauma, but Polly who has cleaned my teeth twice now, was so great at asking me if I was okay and telling me everything she was doing while she was doing it. Dr. Adam is also great and every staff member I've interacted with at the front desk. Thank you guys for such wonderful and caring service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Sunter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have honestly been scared to find a new dentist because I am self conscious about the poor job I’ve done taking care of my teeth. I finally went to ATX Family Dental because my partner goes here and I’m so glad I did! They were so sweet and helpful! They explained everything very clearly to me and laid out a plan that was financially reasonable for me to get my mouth health back on track. There was also no judgement if I chose not to do the plan. I am so relieved to have this weight off my shoulder! Added bonus I got to watch Netflix during the cleaning :) thank you Haley and Dr. Amanda!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley McDonough
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very welcoming to the little ones. I brought my 3 year old in for routine cleaning/exam. Before the appointment he had told me that he was feeling nervous, but the Dr and dental assistant put him right at ease. They explained each step to him in a way he could understand and answered all my concerned-mom questions as well. Zero tears from either of us (which is more than i can say about his daily brushing routine). 10/10 recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Frumkin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent overall experience. Front desk and reminders are prompt and friendly, every hygienist has been beyond competent, and Doctor Adam is straight forward and truly compassionate. All that said, I am compelled to write a review (I almost never) because of Sandy. I’m pretty sure she’s a hygienist; but that title hardly paints the picture of her knowledge, ownership of work, and incredible organization. A five star dental office even without Sandy, but with her?! 10* (For reference, I have been to 3 other dentists in Austin, and none of them want me to write a review 😂)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ali Riegel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really great place. Hip decor and S. Congress location made me worry that they would try to make money off of me with unnecessary services, but that wasn't the case at all— they stuck very close to my insurance coverage, no surprises. Dr. Adam was really kind and spent more time with me than any dentist ever has, probably a half hour (I've always had the kind who pop in after the hygenist is done cleaning, glance at my mouth, then leave). Very laid back and chill office environment. Fantastic experience overall

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcia Espinal
user_reviews_extended.Description: We've loved Dr. Adam and his staff since our first visit 3 years ago. We picked his practice because we lived South and it was convenient for us. Since then, we've moved North, but we still go to ATX Family Dental because they've been absolutely amazing. They are all incredibly warm and friendly, Dr. Adam has a great bedside manner and sense of humor, and we've always had appointments start and end on time. The clinic is easy to get to, always impeccable, and they have great music and TVs on the ceiling above the chair to keep your mind off the drills. Scheduling is a breeze and I love the text and email reminders I get from them. I've (luckily) never had anything major done, but I like that Dr. Adam and his staff stick to non-invasive treatments and they are thorough when explaining the course of treatment, costs, and any alternatives. My most recent visit was my first time for a checkup after having a baby, and I appreciated how nice and accommodating everyone was. At one point,  Victoria, Dr. Adam's wife popped in to chat with my baby as she was about to break into a meltdown. Because of Victoria , the meltdown was averted and I was able to complete my check up without a major hitch. Little things like that are what distinguish this as a family practice and one of the many reasons we keep coming to ATX Family Dental. I highly recommend Dr. Adam and his team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Keating
user_reviews_extended.Description: This team of people is incredible. From the moment you walk in you know you are going to be well taken care of. I can’t recommend enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: GEORGINA BAUR
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing experience with Austin family -
Last min appointment was accommodated - exceptional professional care -unbelievable experience- have decided to keep them as my future Dentist -
So happy I found them -
G

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kirsten Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best experience! The staff is absolutely incredible. Smart, sweet, compassionate and quick!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becca Rainwater
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely accommodating doctors and staff, a truly beautiful office, and state of the art technology - what more could you want?!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Florez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came here for 8 years and thought they were very good for the most part.  I am only knocking 1 star off because I had a few frustrations with them regarding insurance and my dental health cleaning plan, but in the end they reached out were very willing to address these concerns. Overall I am very satisfied with the service I received here over the last 8 years, the staff and dentists are very friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Mora
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I have ever been to. Had a dental emergency and they took me right in and made me feel extremely comfortable!! The best staff I have ever dealt with at any doctors office. 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Karder
user_reviews_extended.Description:
ATX Family Dental is, hands down, the best dental office I have ever been to. The inviting and soothing environment instantly puts you at ease, and the front office staff greets you with smiles and warmth, giving the impression that they truly prioritize your experience.

During my first and only visit, I had a checkup and cleaning with Cailee, who was incredibly friendly, professional, and thorough in her work. She showed me some imaging of my teeth and eagerly answered any questions I had. It was incredibly refreshing to be a patient at an office where they value ensuring you leave with all the necessary information rather than simply rushing through appointments.

After the cleaning, I saw Dr. Amanda Vinh for my oral exam and to review the results from the hygiene visit. Dr. Vinh has a calming and kind demeanor, taking the time to discuss everything in detail according to my preferences. She patiently addressed all my questions about the results, explaining them in a way that was easy to understand, even for a non-technical person like myself. This was a pleasant surprise as it saved me from having to ask "what does that mean?" It was even more remarkable considering she was attending to multiple patients simultaneously, yet she made me feel like I was the sole focus of her attention. These small gestures turn an ordinary visit to the dentist into a truly enjoyable experience and motivate me to schedule regular checkups.

Overall, I couldn't be happier with my experience at ATX Family Dental. There isn't a single thing I would have changed or asked for during my first visit. I highly recommend this dental office if you're seeking the best dental care, a relaxing and professional environment, and the opportunity to support a local business rather than a corporate chain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at ATX Family Dental is amazing! They are all the best! Started going there a few years ago and I have never looked back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Barron
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was visiting Austin for work, and my crown popped off at 1:30 on a Friday. I thought I was in for a weekend of pain until I called ATX Family Dental. 2 hours later, my crown was re-cemented and I was on my way. The front staff was wildly friendly, the dentist was extremely professional and skilled, and the hygienist/assistant was even better. The bill was incredibly reasonable and it couldn’t be any easier. Highly recommend. Thank you all again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mila A
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was super nervous about going to the dentist but I had the best experience! They made sure to make me as comfortable as possible, I got to wear heart sunglasses, watch TV, and even got a gold star for not having cavities 😝. This is the most high-tech dental office I’ve ever been to. I even got screened for oral cancer which no dentist has ever offered me before. Also, the office is super cute and the entire staff is great! Really happy to have found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawn Kotoske
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentists and hygienists at ATX Family Dental. I have met with Dr. Amanda and Adam and they are both highly skilled, explain everything clearly, give you multiple treatment options, and allow you to choose with no pressure. I also like the technology that they use, they take macro pics of all your teeth and show you the problems at 10x. Lastly, they are not overrun with patients, so there is room in the schedule to book without waiting months. If you are in need of a new dentist you should give them a try for sure. BTW I am a single guy with no kids, so even though it says family dental they are good for anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: N Z
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just want to write the biggest thank you to this dental office. I'm literally close to tears and want show my gratitude and also help others that have anxiety around taking care of their dental health because of "white coat" syndrome.
Dr. Adam, Dr. Amanda, Sandy and the general staff there, thanks so much for being so kind and patient. These professionals are so knowledgable and just genuinely good people from what I gathered at my visit.
I was super fearful of getting my wisdom tooth extracted (especially late into my 20s) but I am sitting here with no pain 24 hours later... none. And no pain during the procedure with local anasthetic alone. If anyone is afraid to take care of their dental health, please visit Dr. Adam or Dr. Amanda. They know what they are doing and it doesn't feel like a money grab practice. It is a tad bit on the pricier side (nothing too bad)  but I think they pay their staff well and prices are going up everywhere from what I hear and you can't put a price on your health.
I also want to say that I was suffering from a low level of fatigue for a long time and I can't believe that after having my wisdom tooth extracted I am feeling so much better. So thank you so much. I can't believe it :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sammie Parks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist experience by far! The care and transparency provided by atx family dental is unmatched.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peter Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Moved to Austin and went with ATX because they took my Cigna dental discount plan. Next visit they said they stopped accepting Cigna perhaps they had enough customers. Slightly unfair for an existing client. I purchased their Wellness Plan which would take me through to retirement when my Medicare Aetna dental kicked in. BUT they take Aetna but not Medicare. Again slightly unfair as an existing client. Another example of profit over patient care I'm afraid.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Alexander
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at ATX Family Dental is so friendly.  They did a great job. Listened and shared options. I'm glad I found my new Austin dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bea Kosa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sydney was my dentist and she was great! It was my first time there the other day and I had a wonderful experience, the entire staff made me feel very comfortable. Everyone was super friendly and informative. I definitely recomend making ATX Family Dental your primary Dentist. Fun and friendly environment as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Landeros
user_reviews_extended.Description: Their staff are so kind and helpful.  My little one was super happy! 🦷👏🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: gabriella
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had my first appointment! As a very anxious dentist goer! I felt completely at ease here! The decor was trendy and happy! Good music and even a little drink fridge! My gal (unfortunately I missed her name) was so friendly and was so good at explaining every step in the process! She told me what she was looking for and what she was doing. Made me feel like I was involved! And the TV on the ceiling was a major plus for a distraction. Overall really satisfied with my experience today! Thanks ladies!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie Mast
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Customer service here is great, they're always so nice!

*update - changing from 5 stars to 1*

I was told I needed a crown. I had no pain or any problems with the tooth but I trusted them. They told me they checked with my insurance and that the insurance would cover half. After I paid half of the cost (~$600)and received the crown, ATX Family Dental sent me another bill saying my insurance didn't cover it. My insurance said they had dentists look at the xrays and information, and the crown was not necessary. I now have sensitivity near this spot that I did not have before. Again, I was not having any problems with the tooth before the crown. Do not trust them when they say they have cleared something with your insurance!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Grant
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family Dental is amazing on every level. I had a dental emergency a few months ago and the amazing staff was able to fit me in on the day I requested. I’ve now been there 3 times for follow up procedures and each time I’m blown away by their friendliness, compassion, professionalism, and beautiful facilities. I cannot recommend ATX Family Dental enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Clem
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They were fantastic, as always! Super efficient and friendly. Great setup with Tvs on the ceiling and headphones so you can watch a show while you are worked on.

My girlfriend has pretty strong "white coat syndrome" and she loves this place, as they genuinely want to make sure you understand what the procedure is and that you are comfortable.

If you have kids, or have just had terrible experiences at prior dentists, ATX is a wonderful choice to make sure things go smoothly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Antonio Renaud
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have a knee replacement scheduled soon and I wish Dr. Amanda could do that because the extraction she did was so pain free and professional I could not believe it went so well.
The entire staff is cheerful yet concerned. The decor is comfortable and comforting.
An incredible experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jon Bearn
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here is excellent and welcoming.  Everyone is very knowledgeable and personable and they don’t push you to get any services done that are not necessary, they merely make suggestions and make you feel comfortable with whatever decision you make. There is even a TV on the ceiling that you can watch while getting a cleaning or work done! (Sometimes conversation with the hygienist is even better than watching TV though)  I’d recommend ATX dental to anyone moving to Austin and in search of a great dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard White
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love ATX Family Dental. My job recently had a mobile dentist come that provides routine cleanings on the company's dime and I didn't do it so I could still come here. Dr. Adam is really personable and will actually give you good information for any questions you have. Usually my hygienist is Polli, who I love, but on my most recent visit I got Haley, who I also loved. Great personality, care and attentiveness for both of them. They also have modern equipment and a stylish and clean facility. Definitely recommend coming here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan Kennedy
user_reviews_extended.Description: It's wild to actually enjoy going to the dentist. Staff is great, everyone is super nice, technology is super modern. I tell everyone I know to go here when they're looking for a recommendation and not one who has done it has anything negative to say.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrey Kuhl
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very pleasant experience at ATX Family Dental. I was having a hard time getting into any dentist around Austin due to them being backed up and ATX was able to get me in right away to check on my cavity. I hadn't been to the dentist in quite some time so I was nervous about going in, but I got nothing but smiles and comforting words from the women who work here. The offices are also very clean the waiting room is comfortable. They have TVs on the ceiling and offer Netflix as you're getting a filling! I will definitely be using this office as my main dentist and highly recommend it to anyone in the Austin area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Eads
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband switched jobs and with that new dental insurance. Sadly, ATX is out-of-network. I just had my first appointment with another office near the area, and I can 100% say that I will be missing the ATX dental office. I could see the CLEAR difference in care from the dental hygienist and dentists. At ATX Dental, they took the time to talk me through anything they would be doing on my teeth, and I could tell that they had attention to detail when working on cleanings, fillings, etc. They worked with my sensitive teeth, and altered they way they worked with me when dealing with my dental work because of it. At my cleaning at the new office, the dentist was in and out in like 3 minutes. Definitely not the same experience I got from this office. Going to miss ATX Family Dental. Hopefully, one day, I can be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika Delfini
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough wonderful things about ATX family Dental - I have been coming here since 2018 where I used to see Dr. Adam, he does amazing work and is so patient. I usually see Dr. Amanda now and she is equally as amazing. All of the hygienists are so great too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down, one of the best practices in Austin. Yesterday was my first visit after leaving my previous dentist office of five years and let me tell you, I wish I left and come here years earlier. Between the hygienist and Dr. Amanda, I can’t say enough good things about their knowledge, patience and overall demeanor. (Currently forcing a few friends of mine to make the switch!)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan G
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved my experience at ATX Family Dental and will recommend to my friends and family. I felt like my concerns were addressed and I was properly taken care of. The cleaning was easy and my dental hygienist made me feel cared for. I never got the feeling they were trying to upsell me or make me pay for things i didn't actually need. Very lovely experience overall.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ally G
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love ATX Family Dental! I’ve been coming here for years and they just keep getting better. The staff is kind and helpful and always willing to answer questions. I always get a gold star during my cleanings so I’m giving them 5 gold stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary Gattrell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amanda was amazing! First time coming here and I would recommend it to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Recommended by a friend who currently goes to ATX Family Dental and absolutely loved it. AFD is super vocal about what is happening inside of your mouth biome and does well at explaining why I needed to change my brushing habits. They are also super clear about the options you have and took the time to explain each one. I will definitely be going back!

2024 Update: I was reviewing my transactions for taxes and realized they overcharged me and had no plans of telling me. It was only revealed to me when I called myself. Not super transparent about this aspect. Hopefully this was not the case for other people who visit the dental clinic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ginny Patrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: They incredible. So kind, so skilled. They think of all of the small touches to make sure you're comfortable during procedures (vibrating device when injecting you, all of the streaming services on tv's overhead, blankets if you need them). Would highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Bent
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I decided to change my dentist and try ATX Family Dental. I am overjoyed with the service I received and the friendliness of the staff.
Thanks for
Making me feel at home

Chris B

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Zaremba
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at ATX dental were awesome with my 8 yr old son! Made him feel very comfortable while getting fillings. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: George Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clean professional business.  They should revisit their sales strategies however.  Upon arrival they attempted to sell me on their membership plan.  I declined and was presented with a price for my daughters cleaning.  Seemed high, asked what it included and they included a treatment without asking.  After asking for a treatment to be removed they performed a really short cleaning on my daughter.  The dentist came in for 2 mins checked off and told the hygienist to do the treatment I declined earlier.  At checkout I was informed there was an additional charge for "special" x-rays beyond the ones I already paid for.  Apparently asking my 10 year old if she has sensitivity to cold (her reply was maybe sometimes) resulted in these special x-rays.  The whole experience really rubbed me the wrong way.  Had to get back to work or would have argued the charge.  Instead I won't return.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Sobolewski
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist and staff!  The hygienist was very efficient, communicative, and accommodating to my tooth sensitivities.  Dentist is very kind, personable, peppy, and knowledgeable.  He is a former elementary school teacher and you can tell!  The experience was so seamless I ended up signing up for their wellness plan which provides 2 cleanings and exams annually, as well as discounts on any other services. It is cheaper than my employers dental insurance and definitely a good deal considering price/market value and quality of care. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best office I’ve been to. Everyone there is kind and fun. Been going there for 3 years now and love it! There new building on south 1st is amazing too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rob Jonsson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Adams and his team are super patient oriented, and they make sure to do the job right on their first try. They make sure to stay up to date on the newest technology within dentistry, so patients like myself can get the best care possible. ATX Family Dental South is the best dental experience I’ve ever had. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: nini osborne
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am in love with this place. So many people don’t like the dentist, me included, and quite frankly I could’ve hung out with the staff and been there all day if I needed to. I learned so much, I was told how to understand my own X-rays and nothing was hidden from me. Every detail was explained (I asked for them to talk through the process) and it really made me comfortable. Other places I’ve been to I usually shake in the seat but here I was so happy and relaxed. Professional but fun which is hard to find. Prices were so reasonable and I wasn’t scared to pull my card out especially being a cash patient. After tons of bad experiences in different cities and states, this place = 100000/10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim McDonough
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience with Dr Adam and his team. The atmosphere is friendly but professional. I was initially surprised that my first new patient appointment would be so long--two hours--but the dentist and hygienist were very thorough and comprehensive so it made sense why they needed so much time.

I ended up having a small cavity in one of my molars but the hygienist had spotted it first and warned me that it might be the case which eased the news when Dr Adam confirmed it. When i returned for the filling (which admittedly no one looks forward to) Dr Adam and his assistant made the process feel straight forward and easy. I haven't thought about the tooth since.

Added bonus: there are TVs on the ceiling!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Weiner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super attentive, empathetic staff and dentists. Usually, I’m really anxious and sensitive about dental appointments, but they made sure I was completely taken care of. 5/5 recommend ATX Family Dental! Their new location is stunning. And even though I’ve moved north, I still travel down to ATX Family Dental because they do such a wonderful job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Max G
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After a bad protein bar destroyed one of my back teeth, I had a emergency situation and was looking for help. ATX family dental not only moved things around to find a same-day appointment, they were helpful, kind and sensitive to the issues I was dealing with. We all worry about money especially when it comes to dentistry. They took care of my pain and issues first and worried about money later, helping to draft an affordable payment plan we could both agree on. I plan on going here for all my dental needs in the future. Would highly recommend.

Update: Having gone back and getting my permanent crown, Dr. Adam's work is spectacular. The crown fits wonderfully and I'm eating burgers again. He even followed up personally asking if anything could have been improved. I say none. I admire his dedication to perfection and exemplary work; Truly a man who has mastered his trade.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Helene M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a cavity filled by Dr. Amanda and I have to say it was the best I’ve ever gotten! I know that’s weird to say about a filling but it’s true. I never felt a tinge of pain and didn’t get the gas, just the numbing gel. Everything she and her assistant Erika did was perfect during the entire process! They made sure I was comfortable. Kept checking to see if I was ok and I never had any pain afterwards either. Dr. Amanda even texted me later that evening to see how I was doing! A truly remarkable experience! Thanks Dr. Amanda and Erika! Job well done!!! 👍 🤩🥳

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Hotchkiss
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is super friendly and helpful and the dental techs explain things thoroughly and make sure you understand the procedures that they will be doing. I hadn’t been to the dentist in far too long and had a lot of anxiety about going, but that fear was alleviated during my first appointment. They also send text reminders of appointments which is helpful for people like me who have small kids and sometimes forget to add appointments to their calendar.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victor Pedraza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at ATX Family Dental was very friendly and super helpful. I hadn't been to a dentist in over 5 years and they made me feel super at ease. I would recommend them to anyone looking for a new Dental location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Molly Lingafelt
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family Dental is the best!! I’ve never had a bad experience here. Everyone is so friendly, professional, caring, and respectful. I’ve had normal cleanings and fillings done, and they always make sure I’m comfortable and aware of what they’re doing. They always provide helpful recommendations but never push! Best dentist in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlin Duff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shelby was excellent with my teeth cleaning. She was very precise and gentle. She was also honest about the work that I will eventually need and broke down the process so it doesn't sound too scary or intimidating. My husband and I love ATX Family Dental and highly recommend it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Leslie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I couldn’t be more happy and blessed to have ATX family Dental. From the front desk staff to all the assistants and the Doctors…special shout out to the wonderful Sandy, the amazing and talented Dr. Amanda and front desk Angelica and Jazmine!! Thank you so much for everything!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Crystal Howe
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter picked this dental office because it was close to our home.  She had a regular dentist but decided that this was a place she wanted to try.  Needless to say, she received excellent care and after her treatment, Dr. Adam followed up with my husband to see how she was recovering.   My experience was very positive from the moment I walked in to the office.  Dr. Adam, Tasha, and Chastity were so warm and welcoming.  I felt very comfortable with them.  Dr. Adam followed up with me in the afternoon which I appreciated.  I look forward to getting my 6 month check up.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AlexThor16
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Adam is the kindest person I have had the privilege of meeting and he is an exceptional dentist. ATX Family Dental provides excellent one-on-one care, and doesn't make you feel like another patient walking through the door. In essence, Dr. Adam and his dental team are welcoming and make you feel like you are part of their ATX family.The dental team is professional, passionate, and they love their profession. The quality of care is extraordinary, and like no other dental office. I highly encourage parents to bring their children and join the ATX Family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best Dentist in Austin - Friendly Staff and Great Facility.

I had been searching for a good dentist for about a year, and I finally found the best one in Austin. As soon as you walk in the door you can tell that this is a different place. Everyone greeted me with a big smile and they were extremely kind. This was at 7am too! I am kind of blown away that every single employee was so good. It is the dream team of dentistry. Now I know why the other dentist offices in Austin are so terrible - ATX Family Dental is hording all of the best employees. Dr. Adam was great. If you prefer a dentist that isn't condescending and cold then Dr. Adam is your guy. He was very thorough, but he was also very down to earth to enjoyable to be around. I can't say enough about this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Spagnoletti
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family Dental is undeniably the best dentist office I’ve ever been to. Not only is the service and treatment great, but the staff genuinely cares for their patients. They will always do what’s right for them, and above all make sure they feel comfortable and cared for. They 100% deserve their high reviews.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dani Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to this practice for 2 or so years and met every doctor. Exactly what you’d want out of a dentist office: literal blankets, great British baking show & laid back friendly staff. They have never been pushy & i have never felt like I was being bamboozled with expensive services. The times I have needed something done, it was never wildly expensive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rommel Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great staff and service - always a welcoming and calm environment! My first visit was an emergency root canal and the doctor was incredibly accommodating. The follow up sessions were incredibly helpful, very informative, and resulted in reducing my bleeding gums to nearly nothing.
I will most certainly continue to be a patient here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: michelle han
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome dental practice. I’ve had both Drs. Sydney and Amanda and both are great. Everyone else I interacted with from the front desk people to the hygienists and assistants were very friendly. Faye (sp?) was the nicest person I’ve ever met. The office is nice too,  just bring a jacket because they keep it arctic in there 🥶 Will continue my dental care here as long as I live in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cody R
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Adam is a great dentist! The entire staff is top notch and I couldn't be more happier with the work they did! Everyone makes you feel very welcomed and is extremely friendly. Personally, I had a cleaning there and also had some filling work done as well. Without a doubt, I will be back to this office for all future dental work/cleanings!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Fuchs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great dentist! Plus COVID precautions taken seriously.

ATX Family Dental is managed and operated professionally and I’m always impressed with the care they put into their practice. I’ve been over five times now for cleanings, fillings, night guard fittings and have worked with several different members of the dental staff over the past year or two. All of the employees have been fantastic, the hygienists are thorough and knowledgeable, the dentist never keeps me waiting and does not try to sell me on anything. The office is cute, clean and modern.

Had multiple negative experiences at Aloha Dental with crazy wait times, dentist double booking me, poor administration, sales tactics for unnecessary procedures (dentist was nice herself, but poor management). So glad I found ATX Family Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy Sasakura
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was amazing. Front desk was very sweet. Dr. Amanda and Fay (hope I spelled that correctly) were so sweet and walked me through step by step and that definitely helped my anxiety. I was also able to watch and listen to Friends while they worked on my teeth and that was awesome. My favorite show always helps me with my anxiety as well. They are very informative and answers all your questions. Best dentist experience I’ve ever had. And I’m 28 lol took long enough. 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin Chaumont
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family Dental is amazing. Great customer service, great hours and a great environment. They are very memorable and are very knowledgable when it comes to your dental needs. They will accommodate your schedule and if you have any issues they will get you on their schedule fast. I will recommend them to all my family, friends and to everyone on Yelp. If you are looking for a dentist in the 78704 go to ATX Family Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie at Texas Green Realty
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Loved my visit with ATX Family Dental.  Dr. Adam and his staff were a true professionals and I have never felt better about a dental experience.
If that isn't enough the space is well designed and comforting with lots of natural light and great decor.  Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: shane tapia
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit with ATX was amazing. Everyone was very thorough and helpful. Just had my second visit and it was just a great. The whole team was knowledgeable and kind. Definitely making it my permanent local dental office now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Houtman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm not the best dental patient after having LOTS of work done (I'm English so it 's kinda world known that we don't have the best teeth)! over the years.  I loved the practice really clean and modern.  Dr Gutwein was awesome and made me feel totally at ease.  Check in and front desk staff were very friendly and super helpful.  The nitrous was a great way to help me relax, overall loved the place, totally gonna be back in 6 months for my next check up! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taka Calderon
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time at ATX Family Dental and it was a great experience. Everyone was really nice and my dental hygienist was awesome! She answered every question I had very professionally and helped me gain more knowledge about keeping my teeth clean. Fully recommend ATX Family Dental for anyone looking!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Manda Mosley Maier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Adam and his wife are such a great team! Dr. Adam handled my cleaning/exam appointment with ease and Victoria was an excellent greeter/front desk manager. They both followed up with me about an issue I'm having with a tooth in a timely manner and offered a few solutions to choose from. They are both positive people and it comes through in their service and care. The office is bright, clean,  inviting and in a convenient central location with plenty of parking. I would highly recommend ATX Family Dental to anyone looking!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Willard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Amanda and the team at ATX Family Dental are by far the best dentists we’ve ever had. I was very nervous about a procedure today and they went out of their way to ensure I was comfortable every step of the way. 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Doffing
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Doctor Adam and his staff are amazing.  They provided a professional but relaxed environment with truly personalized modern care.  Doctor Adam not only performed a thorough exam, but he took the time to explain the reason for additional care if I elected to do it and the pro's and con's if I decided not to or if I wanted to delay the treatment.

I'm so happy to have found MY dentist in Austin.  I highly recommend that ATX Family Dental becomes YOUR dentist in Austin too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at ATX Family Dental was excellent. Everyone was very friendly and professional. I went in for a cleaning and even though I got some bad news about additional work that I needed, ATX Family Dental offered me options to make dealing with the expense much more reasonable. I will definitely be a returning patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geoff G
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is where you need to go if you don't like going to the dentist. Everyone on the team is incredibly capable and understanding. I've come in for everything from routine cleanings to broken teeth, and thanks to this team, I actually enjoy going to the dentist now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ingrid Powell
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was an absolute pleasure to visit ATX Dental! We felt immediately at home. It was also a great place to take our toddler, as they have a wonderful play area and are very sweet with kids. The dental procedure was quick, painless, and very efficient! I've had a family work on my teeth for most of my life, so it was wonderful to find a place that felt just like family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becca Meyer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Before I had children, I worked in the dental office for 10 years. 4 years as a chair-side dental assistant. I was very impressed with the whole staff and their friendliness. Doc seems conservative and not likely to recommend treatment that isn't necessary. And he is also respectful to his staff. The RDA did great with my xrays - no gagging, very gentle.

My last experience with a different dentist in South Austin wasn't the same - the dentist wanted to do unnecessary treatment and he was rude to the dental assistant, right in front of me. Glad to have found a good fit for my whole family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Ruff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved how clean, quick, and attentive the team was. Have had some really bad dental experiences in the past, but this was likely the best I’ve encountered. Dr. Ida was thorough, and although they could have likely charged me extra to do some elaborate procedure I didn’t need, they went the correct route which was also the least costly. Refreshing in an age of chain dental locations that are looking solely at their bottom line.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Howe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been to more dentists and had more dental work done than you can imagine.  Dr. Adam Gutwein and his staff are definitely the best I've ever been to.  I had a major procedure done by him and the work was absolutely top notch.  He and his staff are always very attentive, respectful and professional with everyone in my family.  And if you're looking for a dentist that charges reasonable prices, this is your place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ash moreno
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the interior design, feels welcoming compared to other dental clinics. Love their heart shaped glasses which they put on you to protect your eye! Staff is amazing, very warm and welcoming. I felt like a kid again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diego Menchaca
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family Dental has proven to be a fantastic dentistry. The staff is incredibly kind, approachable, and easy to work with. Can’t recommend them enough

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen King
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have very bad dental anxiety, but I have a toothache that last night caused me legitimately some of the worst pain I have ever felt, so I finally decided to swallow my fears and get it addressed. As soon as I walked into this place, I saw a sign at the front desk that said “Everything is Figureoutable”, which is the exact phrase my mom always says to me when I’m going through something tough, so immediately I had a good feeling about this place. And the visit itself was great. Everyone who worked there was very kind and patient with me and understanding of my anxieties, and they were very helpful in answering any of my questions and explaining to me what the issue was with my tooth and what my options were for proceeding. Definitely recommend

—UPDATE: The next day, the pain was so bad that I couldn’t eat at all, and none of the pain medications that had been prescribed to me were working, so I called here in a bit of desperation asking them if they knew of literally anywhere in the Austin area that could take my tooth out that day (it was a broken wisdom tooth with the nerve exposed). Bethany took my call and expressed a very sincere sympathy, and told me she would look into it. 15 minutes later, she called me back and told me she had found an oral surgeon who said they could take me in that day. 4 hours later, the tooth was out of my mouth. To top that off, about half an hour after I got home from the oral surgeon, I got a text from Bethany checking in to make sure I was doing alright. I cannot express enough how absolutely above and beyond she went for me that day, and I am so grateful to her for not making me have to go even a single extra day with that impossibly excruciating pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amudhan A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very happy with the treatment I received here. Been here a few times and everybody has been very professional and provided good services. Dr.Amanda was especially very good at explaining everything in detail.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camille Giarrusso
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I spent a lot of time researching dentists in austin that my insurance covered. I was nervous going into my appointment today b/c I only had the internet to hear reviews. ATX family dental rocked it. Everyone at the facility from front desk to hygienist to dentist were exceptional. Big shout out to the hygienist (Polli) — she was very thorough, explained every detail to me, was gentle and reviewed insurance/finances with me. I wish more offices were as detail oriented and educational as this one. Highly recommend.

(Please note I’ve only done a cleaning no major appointments yet).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ingrid Bearden
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was a wonderful first experience at this dental office!! They were careful and attentive, and made me feel very safe and secure when normally I’m very nervous. The office is adorable, and the chairs are comfortable, and I love having the tv on the ceiling to watch netfliX. It’s little details like this that show that they really care about the patient experience! Booking was extremely easy, and I would very much recommend this place to anyone looking for a new dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been coming to Dr. Adam's practice for 2 years now. He's always warm, professional and funny. The staff is great and I feel like they're always looking ahead at the most modern ways to manage my dental issues. Really appreciate all they do, so much I'll probably keep going here even though I moved away from the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcos Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience for splint removal and replacement. As always, I felt like I was in the hands of pro's.  Dr. Adam, Larissa, and Polly (front desk, too!). All great, much personal care, and exceedingly knowledgeable (what more can a patient/client hope for? :). I'm grateful for ATX Family Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zoey Sweeny
user_reviews_extended.Description: Looking for a new dentist in the area, I thought ATX Family Dental would be a great spot! Turns out they are extremely unresponsive, unorganized, and flat out dismissive. I tried to make a first time appointment on several occasions only to be ignored or ghosted. It might be great once you're there but I wouldn't know since I never got a call, email or text back. Don't recommend for new patients!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mason Gillespie
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff are very welcoming and efficient in providing excellent dental care. The TV screens above the cleaning room chairs are a nice amenity as well! Highly recommend Shelby for your teeth cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Rice
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love ATX Family Dental. Always responsive and flexible. Been coming now for a couple years and they do a great job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had work done by Dr. Amanda and Ericka and they were so kind and made sure I was comfortable at every step. Really the whole staff is really great from hygienist to receptionist. I’d highly recommend this office if you’re at all apprehensive about dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luisana Lumbreras
user_reviews_extended.Description: We moved last year from south Austin to Pflugerville and we knew we were not changing the kids dentist. These folks are amazing and are worth the drive. They treat you like family and make my daughter feel at ease every time we visit. She actually looks forward to seeing the dentist. I know I never did when I was a kid.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gino G. Angulo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had a cleaning here a couple of months back. Adam and his staff are very professional and utilize state of the art equipment. The space is modern and spotless with a very comfortable vibe. His staff is courteous and considerate and Adam is a consummate professional(even on the weekend) I had some tooth pain on a Sunday and he met me at the office 20 minutes after I called him while in unbearable pain. Customer service and patient care are concepts they grasp and live by. I will be coming back.
They did a great job on my crown and are competitively priced. If you are in the 78704 check them out, totally worth it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: syd hennighausen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love coming to this place they’re so nice and Fey is my best friend and I feel so looked after and taken care of thanks guys! even with two crowns (ish) I had such a good time

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hosam Zedan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
On Oct 7th 2022, I had a regular cleaning with the hygienist. Upon entering the office I'm greeted with this policy of paying before my appointment starts. I'm told this is to help move patients in and out faster. The problem is they won't know all the services you're going to receive that day and charge you the right amount. So you'll have to stop at the front again. Last time I had a fluoride application and had to stop to get charged again. Checking out at the end like you would for any service is tried and true. Not sure what they're trying to do with this change.

I've been a regular patient at this office and have been very happy with the service up to this point. The hygienist was new to me but I don't know if she's new to the office. Everything was well and fine until she started cleaning my permanent retainer. She was using excessive pressure that I hadn't experienced in any prior cleaning and she broke the retainer.

I wasn't concerned honestly because I thought they'll do the right thing and take care of it. I asked for my retainer to be removed and they said they'll give me a quote on the treatment plan. The quote was $465 and it was their mistake. I made them aware I wasn't going to proceed with the plan and just to remove the retainer.

While I was waiting for the doctor to see me one of the admins comes up to me to show me the same sheet of paper with the treatment plan I was shown prior with the quote. I told her I already said I'm not doing that and she said "if you'll just read it". It said zero dollars, I thought great they're doing the right thing here.

I go back to the chair and I'm asking about the scans. One of the assistants was confused and asked me to go brush my teeth and she'll be back. When I get back to the chair, the person there who I think is the office manager apologizes that there's been a confusion. The paper I was being handed for zero dollars was for removing the retainer they broke and not for a new replacement. I think it was a given they weren't going to charge for removing the retainer they broke but it was very disappointing they didn't honor a replacement that was their mistake.

I don't know if this change in service is due to them being popular and getting busy. But I've already started looking for another office that treats their patients fairly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blake Kraft
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the dental hygienist Paulina and she’s great at her job. I got all the details on what I needed to do in the future and got my teeth well cleaned. I also loved my dentist Adam. So I’m glad I found this office and definitely would recommend it to a friend or family member. :) Great staff too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bradley Sutton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall great experience with Dr. Adam and his professional staff. They're very good about talking through their work and explaining why it's important and how it affects you over time. I recently went in to get two fillings done, and it was very quick and completely painless. I did not feel any pain during or after the procedure. Dr. Adam even called me the next day to check in and see how I was doing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nash G.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I spent years ignoring my dental problems due to fear and anxiety about the dentist. I've been going to Dr. Gutwein since 2017 and have completed the many treatments necessary to fix the issues my inattentiveness caused. The entire staff is very kind and makes you feel comfortable. I have worked with many different dental assistants there and the treatment is consistently above and beyond. I've particularly worked with Laryssa multiple times and she is awesome! I am very happy to have found ATX Family Dental because I was living in unnecessary pain that is now gone. I cannot recommend ATX Family Dental enough. If you are afraid of the dentist like I was you should definitely schedule an appointment with Dr. Gutwein, it will be worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ida and the ATX Family Dentistry team are incredible! I had never been before and called in to see if they could fix a chipped front tooth. They got me in the same day so that I could go out of town that afternoon looking like myself. They really went above and beyond!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sadie Pitzenberger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Literally in Love with this place - the cutest, sweetest, most Southernly charmed service you'll ever receive for your teeth! 🦷🪥 I watched Schitt's creek in heart-shaped shades that they provided, while some seriously gentle mouth investigation and restoration was happening! 🙏

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I've been to. Very thorough cleaning and not pushy on the extras. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lina Alyse
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in today for a quick consultation. Everyone was very friendly, responsive, and comforting. I was in and out very quick and it was a smooth process. Will definitely recommend! The waiting area is also very cute and I love how they let you watch any show on the TV!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Logan McGiboney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very good dental facility. I’ve always had bad experiences at the dentist, but these guys and gals did an amazing job. Most knowledgeable and friendly dentists I’ve ever had.  I switched here after a bad experience with another Austin dentist, I won’t mention names for their sake, but rest assured ATX family dental is your best bet in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alana Crabtree
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Super kind and gentle with someone who was way past due for a dentist check up! While
I don’t have too much dentist anxiety to speak of it was nice to have the TV to watch during the cleaning to distract! The staff was SO friendly and it was a pleasant experience all around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Goldman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is by far the most friendly, kind and helpful dentist I have ever been to. My wisdom teeth were all coming in and they booked me an appointment for the next day, when other dentist I called wanted to book me weeks out. My appointment was swift, informative, and everyone made me feel very safe with the extra COVID precautions being implemented. They referred me to a great oral surgeon for my surgery as well. Not only is the office cute as can be, the music is great and the workers are all very nice and patient. I even had an emergency over 4th of July weekend (when they are closed) and I was reached out to personally by my doctor.

Fantastic in every aspect- highly recommended. Thank you Dr. Sydney and Dr. Adam!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karina sanroman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing dentist!!! The TV on the ceiling is a nice touch and it makes the time fly by so fast. Dr ida is a wiz with a Novocain shot

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sakura Stephens
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATE: I had a filling from two years ago pop out a couple of times, and each time, ATX dental fixed it free of charge.  I am continuously impressed with the care and integrity of this practice.

I'm wary of shady dental practices, and so after a multitude of horrible experiences at franchise dentists, I finally decided to pay for a better dental insurance plan.  WORTH IT. I found ATX Family dental and I'm never leaving. I appreciate a dentist that has a patient's best interest in mind.  The dentist and hygienist were very friendly and transparent every step of the way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AnnaK Beezley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Greatest 👍👍👍 the reassurance from staff with the British baking show on in the background is the best. All the dentists I’ve seen here over the past 5 years in two locations have been nothing but excellent

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gloria Macias O'Brien
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really love the customer service and Dr. Amanda is amazing doing her work... literally magic. I will totally recommend ATX Family Dental to my friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Peebus
user_reviews_extended.Description: After dealing with a toothache all weekend, ATX Family Dental was able to schedule me in first thing on a Monday. The staff was all very caring and friendly and the environment is welcoming.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kurt Foeller
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve now gone through cleanings and major procedures, and it’s clear that ATX Family Dental is top notch. Appointments start on time, everything is communicated perfectly. The staff from front office to dentist chair are incredibly talented and they care. Two thumbs up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abigail Cheatham Pope
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Not a trustworthy place — expensive, deceitful malpractice.

I went to ATX Family Dental and was told I needed 2 crowns by Dr.Adam. Given the expensive cost, I could only afford to have one done at a time. They offered a small discount if I paid for the first crown up-front, so I did. Now I believe they offer that discount to discourage the client from getting a second opinion. The procedure was never explained so I had no idea they filed away your whole tooth. I had the crown done and it has been painful ever since — I went back in 3 times to have the crown "adjusted" which offered no relief — they even began to file my normal tooth down which was unsettling.

I recently saw a new dentist and he said not only did I not need a crown on my left side, it is doubtful that I ever needed a crown on the right. Now, I have a fake tooth that constantly hurts because this dentist wanted to make money, rather than provide quality care. The procedure was also very expensive. Thanks ATX Family Dental!

My husband was also told he needed a filling — the filling fell out 2 weeks later. I doubt he needed it considering he never had a cavity before coming to this dentist...odd.

user_reviews_extended.Name: The Pilars
user_reviews_extended.Description: From Check in to check out ATX Family dental has it all together. I am normally a nervous wreck at the Dentist but since I am 28 weeks pregnant I couldn’t get nitrous oxide to calm my nerves. The team made sure I was comfortable the whole time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarretta McCaslin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Because of the Covid pandemic, I had been putting off my dental appointments - until I couldn't!  Severe pain in my lower jaw convinced me I needed to see a dentist. We recently moved back to South Austin and I turned to Yelp to help me find a GOOD dentist. And in case you don't want to read the WHOLE review, ATX Family Dental is AWESOME!!

ATX Family Dental had such glowing reviews, I called them as soon as they opened on Monday. They were able to squeeze me in that afternoon. BTW, they have staggered hours (10 am - 7 pm on M_T, and 7 am -  They have phone/text check in to limit contact. I arrived early and texted then waited in my car until they texted me to come in. Masks are required and my temperature was taken before I completed a form and was directed to the small, but out-of-the-flow-of-patients waiting room.

Sandy, my dental tech, came to get me right on time (I was amazed since the appointment was so late in the day and expected them to be behind schedule). She took me back to a comfortable exam room, took my blood pressure and then Xrays using a handheld models I'd never seen before. Dr. Sydney came in thereafter and checked the xrays and photos then examined the tooth and talked with me about my past experiences and history. (She was the first medical person to ever tell me that families of redheads often had different tolerances and responses to analgesics!)

They presented me with three plans: 1- go home with antibiotics for the infection they found under a crowned molar and see if that alone helped;  2 - get a root canal through the crown, then replace the crown (to be done by Dr. Paul in a few days); or 3 - extract the tooth and decide on getting a bridge or implant later.  Dr. S said she could remove the tooth immediately, if that was my choice, and that was my decision, despite being very apprehensive.

Long story short, after using several types of analgesic, they were finally able to deaden the area and remove the tooth (not fun, but not nearly as painful as previous tooth issues have been).

Everyone in the office was friendly and respectful and a total pleasure to work with! I HIGHLY recommend this dental office!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Adam and his team are absolutely amazing. Not only does Dr. Adam and his team provide exceptional care to their patients, but also explains all procedures and operations prior to enacting them. Additionally, Dr. Adam is willing to provide options based on various factors such as price and location. He truly cares about his patients and sees treatment as much more than just another procedure or another payment. I cannot recommend him and his awesome team enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: teri sarver
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been very nervous after a bad experience with crowns from another dentist.  Front staff were welcoming.  Hygienist Taylor put me at ease by explaining everything before and during.  I feel confident that Dr Amanda will do a good job on my next crowns.  They were conservative in recommendations and did try to upsell me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma Mendez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would absolutely recommend ATX Family Dental to anyone looking for quality dental care and outstanding patient relations. Dr. Adam is an outstanding dentist and I really enjoy the time he takes to explain your dental procedures and talk you through your x-ray results. His attention to patient care really makes coming here an enjoyable experience. The dental hygienists (Hailey and Polli) are all kind, professional, and attentive to patients' needs. ATX Family Dental you get a GOLD STAR!!! Thank You!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Bookout
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first appointment with them, my overall experience was great, have zero complaints. Can not wait to return for next appt. I had an excellent hygienist named Polli,  very professional and well mannered, did a great job as well when it came to explaining everything, for as many cleanings I have gotten today was the first day I had a cavitron used on me! user_reviews_extended.Name: Arami Z

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ahide Garcia

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susel Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: ATX Family Dental has done the impossible -- they've made me like going to the dentist. Everyone there, from the front office staff to the dentists themselves, is incredibly kind, caring, and friendly. I can't say enough good things about my experience with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beau Willis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a 10/10 experience at ATX Family Dental.Coming from someone who was very afraid of the dentist. Everyone treated me with excellent service.The office is very inviting and calm. I would definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Black
user_reviews_extended.Description: the best dentist experience i've ever had! Faye and Dr. Amanda were so sweet, gentle, attentive, and thorough. they made me feel heard and made sure i was comfortable the entire time. they would be so considerate for anyone with dental anxiety or trauma. thank you both!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jane Jenkins

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Porterfield

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Fernandez

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Spears

user_reviews_extended.Name: mike swartout

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Cantu
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was my first trip to the dentist EVER. Haley was so nice and comforting! I watched The Great British Baking show on the ceiling while she cleaned my teeth. Such a sweet experience thank you so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randi Neubeck
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am new to Austin and have had no prior issues with my teeth until just before my 30th birthday. I have been diligent about going to the dentist twice a year and am consistent with brushing and flossing. This appointment was new territory for me and the lack of knowledge of the assistant was really concerning, so I won't be going back. The office staff has been courteous as well as Dr. Adam.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samir Patel

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Hernandez

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carla Faustino

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt O'Connor

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ricky Cooper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience very professional and nice staff. Excellent nurse and dentist staff . Answer all questions and provide solutions to all problems glad my wife found them

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brien Silver

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roger Stirm
user_reviews_extended.Description: It had been a little while since I'd seen the dentist ( a little skittish) and I was pleasantly surprised at how good Dr. Gutwein was. user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Odems

This office is amazing!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karina Cooper

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Green

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haleigh Winfrey
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are always SO nice. Bethany was so sweet walking me through my billing and Sandy went out of her way to make me feel comfortable while we she took my x-rays😻 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: john bashant

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Clarke

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cara Ferguson
