user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Amanda is great! Very professional and efficient. And the dental hygienist Erika makes the experience very pleasant. Overall a great experience at the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Kay
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Amanda and Dr. Ida are great. Our family has seen them both. Recommend this place for kids as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Genna Wade Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t express how accommodating & comforting the staff and physicians are! I’ve had nothing but great experiences and felt heard with any concerns. The modern approach such as televisions also add a calming touch during your appointment. Would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lily DeWitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is hands-down my most favorite dentist in town; trust me I’ve been to a few. Love everything about it, the team are fantastic, the technology is awesome, and they have always been incredible at checking in and taking really great care of my really challenging teeth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Cooley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is kind and friendly. I am treated with respect and all of my questions are answered! They do a great job of taking care of my sensitive teeth! I love ATX Family Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yoseph Elfakahany
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been twice & it’s been an amazing experience. Everyone is friendly, professional, & knowledgeable. Not only do they provide great service but also will educate which I’ve never experienced to this extent before. I will constantly recommend them to anyone seeking dental care !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Terry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Get a second opinion from a different office for $$$ work. They told me I needed an invasive root canal & implant before I could get a crown. Upon second opinion, the root canal & implant was deemed unnecessary. It was the first time I was told that should I ever eventually need a root canal in the future, they could do it with the crown already in. I had enough tooth structure left from a cracked tooth that the implant was avoided. As an autoimmune individual, it was especially important to avoid permanent metal in my mouth. I spent a month wallowing over how I afford ATX's plan before I found Enamel Dentistry (who did free Xrays too). ATX Family quoted me $3351, and with the other provider I was able to get the treatment I truly needed for $1210. ATX didn't give me an option of just having a crown.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Fernando Hernández Hurtado
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place!! I’ll recommend it to everyone, I use to freak out about going to the dentist but this is next level! Totally loved it, thank you guys.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kayla Toncre
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is amazing!! And provide a super calming experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rene Owens
user_reviews_extended.Description:

The office staff and dental assistant were great. Thats what they 2 stars are for.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corey Keyser
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great team and beautiful office, best dentist I've been to

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Dominguez-Montez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I took my husband in with a really bad tootchache minutes before they were supposed to closed. They took him in! Everyone was so nice and friendly. My husband was a happy camper and pain free when we left. We DEFINITELY will be going back for further dental work. This place is our dental office home forever!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sean Runge
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent all around! Location is clean and accessible. The team immediately greeted me upon arrival and was ready with my information.
The hygienist did amazing work and was friendly all the way. The doctor swung in to double check, and even though it was brief, she made sure all of my questions were answered.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annette Morales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place! It was my first time here, everyone is so friendly, efficient and helpful, I didn’t feel pressured into buying expensive treatments like in other dental offices I’d experienced before. Highly recommend it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Daoust
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a really great first experience! Friendly staff and understanding associates.

user_reviews_extended.Name: It-Xetl Salas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Changed dental practices to ATX family dental based on reviews and I have never made a better choice. Every one is accommodating me toward my fear of dental procedures. I also had covid and was able to reschedule with ease

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peter Parsons
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff, and great communication about when your appointment is coming up. The hygienists let you know what they're doing so you're put at ease.  Dr. Gutwein is super friendly and gives honest feedback/suggestions on what to do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evgeni Zikov
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The worst dental office experience I ever had. It’s my first negative review on the internet, but it was so bad that I decided to inform people about it. I found ATX dental via google and because they had a great reviews I made appointment with them. I just needed a regular cleaning and diagnostic. But they managed some how to put me in disbalance with my insurance. Of course, I was not aware of it and in 2 months, I made another appointment for a treatment. This dental office has a rule that requires you to pay 50% of your treatment fee before an appointment, of course I paid. And guess what? :) the day before an appointment I’m receiving a call from a dental office and they informing me that they do not guarantee the rates since I’m in disbalance. I asked why I’m in disbalance and the answer was because insurance rep provided wrong info, the cleaning and x-rays weren’t fully cover. So I decided to cancel an appointment and talk to my insurance first. And meanwhile, I asked for a refund for 50% of the treatment that I already paid.
Today I received a call from the insurance company they said they have investigated, they have listened to direct call and they didn’t find any false information provided to the dental office. So I called again to the dental office and remind them about refund. user_reviews_extended.Name: Dr. Akua
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot give ATX Family Dental enough rave reviews. In my opinion, it’s hands down the best dental practice in town. I’ve been coming here for a couple years and have recommended them to many of my loved ones and colleagues. Everyone is super friendly and accommodating. The women at the front desk and in billing are the absolute best. They are warm and welcoming, and always go out of their way to listen and help. Dr. Adam is very personable and knows how to connect with his patients and truly see them. I know I’m in good hands with him and that I will receive exceptional care at fair prices. Dr. Amanda recently installed my dental implants and I love them. She carefully guided me through the entire process, patiently answering my many questions along the way. The dental hygienists consistently provide me with deep and thorough cleanings. I’ve had significant changes and improvements since I started coming here. Today, I came in for my professional whitening treatment and left with a million dollar smile. Kristen, you did your thing, girl. Thank you! I am in front of the camera a lot these days, so I’ve become even more particular about my smile. I’m grateful to have an entire dental team that I can count on. If you are looking for exceptional care in a warm and welcoming environment, give ATX Family Dental a call. You won’t be disappointed.

Everyone I have talked to in the past 2 visits have been so lovely and kind from the receptionists, assistants, and doctors. Very inviting. I got my wisdom teeth extracted by Erica and Dr.Nadia. They were amazing and made the experience that much better. I recommend this office to anyone and everyone because they are just that awesome....shout out mom for putting me on🙌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonah
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The BEST in ATX!

ATX Family Dental has been absolutely amazing to me and my pearly whites.

Dr. Adam and Dr. Amanda have the most exceptional practice I’ve visited, including every hygienist and receptionist!

If you’re looking for the most welcoming, comfortable, professional and efficient dentist office in Austin… you’ve found it right here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meena Rancourt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had such a wonderful experience at ATX Family Dental. I’m typically a very nervous dental patient, but Sarah was absolutely amazing from start to finish. She was professional, kind, incredibly skilled, and made me feel completely at ease. Her attention to detail and gentle approach actually made the entire process enjoyable, something I never thought I’d say about a dental visit!

The office itself is beautiful and exceptionally clean, and the entire staff creates a welcoming, positive atmosphere the moment you walk in. Dr. Adam is attentive, thoughtful, and clearly cares about each of his patients’ comfort and experience.

Overall, a fantastic experience. I’m so grateful to have found a dental office that makes me feel comfortable and genuinely cared for. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Fox
user_reviews_extended.Description: They give you a literal, physical gold star for your checkup!? Hands down the best dentist I've been to, and I truly dread checkups and establishing new car. They took the time to genuinely understand my needs and goals for my first visit as a new patient, and even referenced several things I'd put in the notes during the introduction. They were incredibly understanding when I had a last-minute reschedule for my first visit. They took the time to thoroughly explain every step of the examination and cleaning, and then took time to really walk through the results in a way I could understand. There was never a rushed feeling, and they even had time to add on some preventative treatment I wanted. They also gave me honest insight about things like teeth whitening, even if it meant I wasn't going to ultimately give them business as a result / might use OTC options instead. When I wasn't watching the TV on the ceiling, I had an amazingly relaxing view out the window. The environment is calm and the team is so friendly, understanding, reassuring, and respectful. They even have laughing gas available in each room as needed. I LOVE that they avoid anything invasive if at all possible, explain treatment options without pressure, focus on prevention, use an Isolite (had never seen that before), and could even make my night guard using scanning technology instead of doing impressions. Highly, highly, highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was referred here for dental work after finishing my Invisalign treatment with Dr. Kunik, and I’m so glad I found them! I needed some bonding redone, and they have taken excellent care of me throughout the entire process.

I had a lot of questions along the way, and the team was always patient and never made me feel like a bother. Dr. Amanda did an amazing job. I had my two front teeth bonding redone (along with some other teeth), and they look fantastic. I feel so much more confident in my smile now!

I’ve been about four times in the span of three weeks, and every visit has felt like such an upscale experience. They go above and beyond with little touches like offering a blanket, providing access to streaming services, and even giving me a lavender-scented towel at my last appointment.

I’m so happy I found them and will likely be switching to them as my regular dentist. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: The Kogane (livhard)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is the one. You can stop looking for a new dentist now.

Here's my story:
I got tooth-lazy when the pandemic hit. I had a couple of root canals done pre-covid that ended up awaiting their crowns for farr too long post-covid. So long, in fact, that the dentist who did the root canals up and retired.
Avoidance at that point was way too easy and time just went flying by. Eventually one of those teeth chipped and all those warnings from my old dentist about the dangers of not crowning a tooth that's had the nerve/blood supply removed came flooding back. A friend recommended ATX Family Dental-and to this day that girl has not steered me wrong. Take her advice.

(Oh, and they have Netflix on the ceiling.)

I came in for a routine cleaning and left with two root canals (both of which multiple second opinions later confirmed were unnecessary). One of those procedures, performed by Dr. Jinal Patel, resulted in a sizable fragment being pushed into my sinus cavity, something that my new dentist has warned could lead to long-term issues involving infection and pressure. It’s unbelievable that I wasn’t referred to an endodontist and instead had such a complex procedure handled in-house with clear incompetence.

My sincere recommendation: Do not come here unless you want to be upsold, overtreated, and put at risk by practitioners who do not act in the best interest of their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: mickey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The highlights: RUDE and unprofessional staff, dentist just ok.
They hung up on me, the receptionist chastised me for being hung up on, there was karaoke blasting in the waiting room, and people can see you in the exam rooms.

The good: late Friday night I started having a problem I have had in the past and no other dentist could fit me in. I was able to make an appointment for first thing Monday morning. The dentist was ok and seemed to be proficient at dentistry.

The not so good: Before my appointment I received a phone call and voicemail from the office, I believe her name was Ava. The message said I needed to call back and confirm the appointment or they would cancel it. I called back, Ava answered and asked if I would wait on hold, I said yes, and after one minute of waiting on hold it hung up on me. I called back and a male answered the phone. He was obviously new as he made some mistakes with switching lines but he was very polite and handled everything. I was sent a new patient form through a text message that was very lengthy and I filled it out two hours prior to my appointment. When I arrived they asked me to fill out all of the same information by hand. When I mentioned I only had a digital insurance card Ava chastised me in a nasty tone saying "You're supposed to give us that info BEFORE the appointment." I responded with "I called back and was hung up on." No one apologized, the two of them just stared at me. They asked me the same info about my insurance and personal info multiple times which was a bit irritating because there was karaoke music blasting in my ear. Yes, karaoke music. The tv was playing YouTube karaoke pop music with commercials inbetween [see picture]. It took 22 minutes before I was called back despite the fact that there wasn't another patient in sight the entire time (maybe they were all in back?). The room itslef is a bit strange for a dentist's office - they kept asking if I wanted a blanket and there was a tv in my face that they kept asking if I wanted Netflix on [see picture]. I guess that's nice if you're a kid or have a lot of anxiety but it seemed strange that they kept pushing it. Also, the blinds were open so several people who were walking past looked in at me [see picture]. One person actually waved at me. I would not be comfortable with this if I was having a full exam. I could hear the receptionists and staff chatting about me through the walls. The dental hygenist was nice and polite. The actual dentist talked down to me a bit and didn't listed to anything I said. She also asked me all the questions that were on the forms I had already filled out twice before.

Overall, I got in for a last minute appointment as a new patient but they were rude and not as professional as I would have liked.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlyn Chapa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience with this dental office was a nightmare and the worst medical experience of my life. I recommend every person stay far away from this dentist.

My first visit for a dental cleaning was pleasant; the hygienists and front desk reps were kind, and I was seen quickly. I was told to return to have some old fillings replaced. This was the end of my positive experience.

My next appointment was at 2pm and I waited 20 minutes after my appointment time in the lobby for insurance processing. The treatment will cost $412. Once the dentist starts working on my teeth, she lets me know that I will need a root canal. However, before they can start the root canal, their treatment coordinator must come in and get my consent, talk to me about payments, etc. This coordinator doesn’t come for 20 minutes, and the doctor has stopped the procedure while we wait. When the coordinator comes, she informs me that I will have to pay an extra $540. I agree because the dentist has told me that a root canal is necessary. The coordinator does not mention any other payments that I will owe for this procedure or how many appointments this will take to complete.

After I give consent to move forward, the doctor leaves the room for another 20 minutes. She doesn't give a reason for this. At this point, it is 5pm (I got here before 2pm) and I have been in this chair having my teeth worked on for 3 hours. I am in extreme pain, my mouth is dry from not being able to close it during the procedure, the numbing shots have worn off, and my teeth are drilled in half as I wait for the dentist to return. When the dentist finally comes back to continue the procedure, I could feel the tools and drills in my teeth. This was extremely uncomfortable. I let the dentist know and had to be re-injected with numbing agent. She also badly burned my lip with a hot metal tool (while I was numb) and she could not even finish the root canal on this day because the office closed at 6pm. She gives me a temporary filling and does not tell me when I will return to have this temporary filling replaced with a permanent crown. I was likely the last patient in the building that day and was there from 2-6pm. I was in so much pain and in such distress that I cried my entire drive home.

The next morning, the temporary filling falls out while I am home and my root is exposed. I call the office to inform them I’m not happy with the service and am still in a lot of pain, so I need to come back in to have my crown implanted. They tell me they can get me in next week. To not be surprised by any unexpected charges, I ask if I will have to make any additional payment. I was quoted an additional $1,300, due at my next appointment. The treatment coordinator did NOT mention this before I consented to a root canal, and if I had known this, I would have sought out a second opinion with a different dentist. The coordinator also would not have mentioned any extra payment when I called to make this appointment, so it would have been a shock to me to realize at my next appointment I’d need to pay over $1,000 more.

For my next appointment, I wait in the lobby for 40 minutes after my check-in time. When I finally get in the chair, they inform me that I am getting a permanent filling instead of a crown as they do not have the mold for my crown done yet. I will need to come back again.

When I return a week later, they inform me that I will only be getting a TEMPORARY crown and will need to COME BACK in a week or so to get my permanent crown. At this point, I’ve been coming to this dentist once a week for a month and am there for hours at a time. On top of my horrific experience, the dentist was very rude and unfriendly throughout and now my crown is slightly crooked and misshaped compared to the rest of my teeth.

It's been a year since my procedure, and I hope they’ve improved their standard of care since then. However, I would never step foot in this place again and have warned all my friends, family, and coworkers to do the same.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
The WORST dental experience I have ever had! I was the last patient of the day on a Saturday and so I get low priority, whatever low percentage of effort is left after having a full work day? Don’t waste your time coming here if you want any kind of thorough dental exam and to be actually treated like a patient deserving of time and effort.

I went in on Saturday as a new patient for my annual dental exam and cleaning. I work until late all week so a Saturday appointment is perfect timing to get it done. But not at this dental office!!! Everyone was nice but I guess there was some motive with that. I had my pictures done, with no problems by the nice young lady. Then I see Dr. Abourass, he was nice, but he clearly had somewhere more important to be because out the door he goes 2.5 seconds, no time wasted there. So I’m waiting, thinking I’m getting my teeth cleaned, at least that’s the impression that was given to me.

I don't remember her name but a young lady came in, very nice, checked my gum health and I briefly explained some things I noticed to check for when I’m getting my teeth cleaned….There was no teeth cleaning. I get complimented on my teeth, which I appreciated, but the agenda was set that I wouldn’t get my teeth cleaned because clearly I’m holding everyone up from leaving work. I get that you’re nice but I don’t get the level of treatment, time and care like all your other patients that came in that day? I was clearly wasting their time. So after I get told that there was no need for me to do a cleaning because my teeth were fine enough with not too much plaque, so then I didn’t need a ‘deep cleaning’ therefore let’s wait 6 months and see where it goes? And whatever I said prior was clearly not much of a matter.

So after all this, I get told I can leave, I don’t get checked out, because I’m clearly wasting their time with my appointment that was accepted. I’m thinking that maybe I need to pay some copay, but no one is at the front desk but I get told if I owe anything they’ll just give me a call?!?!?

I would have rather had my appointment canceled then to have to go through that and be treated like I was such a low priority and not worth the time to actually give me a thorough dental exam and visit. I don’t recommend this place and I hope you don’t end up being their last patient of the day because whatever level of professionalism they have leftover that day is exactly what your going to get. If you all had plans or somewhere you needed to be, please just cancel the appointment and avoid giving any other patient the same low treatment I was given. It’s not worth the appointment.

She wasn’t using the device you attach to the sensor to align the X-ray which was probably why she kept having to redo it. Then in between X-rays she would put the sensor that was in my mouth ON THE TABLE. Not on the sterile pad, but the plain wooden table. And then put it back in my mouth multiple times. After about 35 minutes another employee comes in and asks “you’re still doing X-rays? I guess I’ll do it” then I’m left alone for 10 minutes. The 2nd lady comes back and they delete ALL of the photos already taken and redo them ALL. Probably had like 40 X-rays. Also the first employee was using the wrong sensor the entire time. I told the second employee about the first employee putting the sensor on the table and back in my mouth and she goes, “well we wipe off the table.” Then I go to see the dentist and she tells me that I need about 1200 dollars of dental work done. I have no pain and had a clean bill of health with my old dentist 6 months ago so I was immediately skeptical. Then they say (an hour and a half into my cleaning appointment) we will do the cleaning. The first employee who couldn’t even do X-rays comes in to do my cleaning and she cleaned my teeth for all of 60 seconds. And then left. Mind you I still had grit ALL over my teeth so I get up to rinse. They then tell me that I should wait in the room so they can go over pricing. I stand there for a few minutes but at this point I’m already certain I’m not coming back so I decide to go see if I need to do anything to check out. The front office employee was chit chatting with the VERY person who was supposed to come talk to me about pricing (I know this because when I walked up she handed my sheet to the front office employee and then left). So I’m not entirely sure how long I was supposed to wait in the room but I’m glad I didn’t. About 10 minutes after I left I called and asked them to cancel my 6 month follow up to which the response I got was “is that it?” Also the entire time (X-rays, dental exam, and cleaning) no one cared whether or not saliva or any other fluid got anywhere and I was not given tissues or anything. So as they would not wipe up I was using my own hands to keep water and spit from sliding down. If not for my glasses I would have had fluoride in my eye and ended up with some on my shirt. DO NOT RECOMMEND

user_reviews_extended.Name: Loretta RN
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Exceptional Dental office. Positives definitely outweigh the negatives.

Dental anxiety is a common reason people avoid dentist visits. Guilty of this delay, I can relate to the reasoning.
My review from entrance to exit.
The entrance was welcoming, clean and quiet. Intake staff were professional and pleasant.

(-):
During my X-ray there was 0 privacy provided. Multiple staff members passed the doorway to X-ray room (over 12x during NOMAD X-rays) and no one shut the door. Even when other patients stood in the doorway and watched me having oral X-rays completed with staff. People (patients and staff) smiled even said hello, no one provided privacy. This did not bother me, however may disturb someone else. Privacy is paramount in healthcare (regardless of field).

(+):
Jazmin was very sweet and professional.  She stayed with me from entrance to exit, her approach and professionalism provided a comfort to my anxiety. She provided clear education and details pre-during-post care. She even asked non-dental questions in between. This is an effective approach at distracting a patient that may be nervous. Jazmin initiated the exam portion of my visit. Jazmin was awesome and the perfect first impression for the exam portion of my visit. Nicely done Jazmin, nicely done!

(-):
When the dental chair is facing the window, staff that enter the room should announce themselves. Door to exam rooms should not be opened and closed with the patients back facing door. Dental anxiety is common, providing a space of comfort for patients is key in reducing this anxiety.

(+)
The office was very clean and welcoming.
Dr. T was exceptional. I prefer a “no fluff” approach and he delivered the results from my exam and treatment plan clearly & the identified priority areas with clear explanations.

(-/+):
Hygienist may need a small reminder that a mask does not mean facial expressions and responses go unnoticed. I understand starting ann exam and having to pause due to a patients pain. However, as providers let us be guided to our response to changes in treatment during treatment.  After exam hygienist provided education with a softened approach, education delivered quite proficiently.

(-/+):
Treatment planner: when entering exam room for your portion an introduction is key. Giggling and smiling when I have to ask, “I’m sorry, who are you”? Does not give a feeling that you are competent In your job….  Response like:
“that’s weird-huh” “it’s like” “hmm, well that’s weird”, “ummmm I’ll ask” “but yeah”. A professional tone, delivering information with confidence and accuracy gives way to the patient feeling confident that information. Confusion is not a great feeling leaving the office. Everything provided was very clear…. Until my exit…. I guess (per the treatment planner), “yeah, if you wanna just like, um wait a bit or a few days, or check tomorrow or something like that, we may have more information on your next appointment”. ME: well I have some areas that are priority that I would like to get scheduled as soon as possible”…… yeah, so there will be like um like different charges, so like um if you give us some time, someone will like um, call or email you about that…. I stood at the desk waiting to pay. She returned: “oh yeah, so you’re like, um done, if there is a bill someone will like um, call or email you, thank you and have a great rest of your day……

Overall a great first visit. Small areas that can be addressed and make this clinic even better. I am excited to have found a dental office and (surprisingly for me) excited for my treatments. The team works as a team. Quiet rooms and very little disruptions/noise. Entertainment in the exam rooms gives way to a relaxing setting.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jose Castelan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jasmine was very kind and helpful with us , we were very pleased with her service. Thank you so much

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Freeman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was so appalled at our treatment here that I feel compelled to write a review. We came here Halloween week of 2022 and the front office was incredibly helpful and welcoming, and the office was decorated in a way that would have been great for young kids to dissuade dental fears and make dentist visits fun. So definitely credit there. But my husband went in for a cleaning and x-ray and had no problems at all with his dental hygienist, who was wonderful. It was after the cleaning that we both felt so confused and ripped off. The dentist came in and spent maaaybe 4 minutes in the room, said, “you have cavities here and here, let’s schedule fillings. Also, you have metal fillings, and those are no good, so let’s also schedule a time to replace and upgrade those. Also, have you ever considered braces for cosmetics?” My husband had not once said he had an issue with how his teeth looked, it was not brought up a single time. There was zero medical reason for suggesting braces, corroborated by my dentist that he visited after this. It felt like the cash-grabbiest thing he could have possibly said and was frankly just really rude. If he didn’t say he had a problem with how his teeth look, and they’re not causing problems, why say something like that and make someone feel insecure or less than? We were charged hundreds of dollars even though the cleaning and x-ray should have been covered by dental insurance. After calling later about it we were refunded, and after going to Urbina Family Dental (they’re the best!!! Extremely good work and very transparent and honest. They’ve never once overcharged us or made us feel like they were after our money) we were told his metal fillings were absolutely fine, no reason to upgrade them, and braces would have served no practical purpose. I do want to clarify and say that when I called about the charges I didn’t have to fight for a refund and the service was very friendly- I really only have an issue with feeling exploited by the dentist, not the hygienists or customer service at all. But seeing as though the reason to go see a dentist is for medical advice and treatment, I would never recommend this place to anyone, as the advice given to us was given to us as an attempt to make money, not improve his dental health.

Very knowledgeable professional that are there to take good care of your teeth. My hygienist(Monica)was super gentle with my cleanings and made sure I was comfortable throughout the appointment. user_reviews_extended.Name: Vikin Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Moving out from North Carolina I have finally found my favorite Dentist. The staff here is extremely professional, very talented and super helpful. I would recommend everyone to see the hygienist there (Monica). She is very thorough and takes care of every detailed information. I cannot explain in words how great the experience was. Keep up the good work, definitely will be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: esther gallegos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly staff, always very welcoming. Jasmine is great, makes sure you are comfortable with all procedures. Don't mind visits at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jade Nadzak

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johnny Kim
user_reviews_extended.Description:
To MyDental @ Techridge,

Dr. Hwang (New) and Victoria (Assistant - my apologies if I got this title incorrect): I have been going here for more than a few years now and would like to say that Dr. Hwang is very knowledgable and very kind. The procedure for my filling was one of the best experiences I have ever had. I truly never write reviews, but I was willing and eager to write this as credit should be given where credit is due. Another things I would like to say is that Victoria was very kind and easy to speak with as well. I enjoyed seeing how attentive both her and Dr. Hwang were. I do enjoy seeing her learn from Dr. Hwang, but also seeing Dr. Hwang willing to teach her as well. Great job everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aparna Savant
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at myDental. The front desk team is friendly and welcoming. Clinic is clean and has a pleasant vibe. The hygienist and doctors are professional and are good at it. Recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Foster
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horrible experience! After receiving my care plan it was determined that I needed to reduce my blood pressure before extraction could be performed. Understood! I contacted the team in Feb. 2023 to reschedule. I was asked to come in to the office which is 45min away from my home. Still, no problem. When I arrived the tech was preparing me for a full oral care cleaning, exam, etc  and looked surprised when I told her I just needed to reschedule my procedure.  I waited almost 1 hour for the scheduler to show up with a brochure of my surgeon, his picture, full biography of his education history, etc telling me I’d receive a call within 2 days, but if not I should text HIM! 5 days later after NOT receiving a call I called the surgeons office who told me they’d never even received the referral from the MyDental Tech Ridge office!! I called Tech Ridge to inquire “why” and was placed on hold for almost 10min at which point I disconnected the call. The surgeons office contacted me 45 min later to say they’d JUST received my referral but no one at Tech Ridge ever called me back to follow up, apologize for the hold or the failure to send my referral! The other locations may be great! But this particular office never made me feel as if they truly cared about providing the care that I needed. I was literally just another number. Someone else interrupting their day with dental needs. Heartbreaking to say the least. Austin is big enough to find another office that will give my needs the consideration I deserve. I most definitely wasn’t important enough for this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: C Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Told me I needed a deep cleaning so I agreed. Had I known my insurance would not cover it I would’ve not agreed. Wish they could’ve been more upfront about the costs. They also did multiple scans and X-rays that my insurance stated would not cover either. This was my first experience in Austin and not a pleasant one. Will not be returning, they are just looking to make money off you and not transparent at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Vo
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time visiting and everyone was so sweet. I got seen very quickly!! Sandy was so considerate when she took my x-ray and made sure I was comfortable the whole time. Then Bri did my gum check and she was so gentle even tho I do not floss. Dr. Hwang has great bedside manner and made me laugh despite me having cavities 😭. Finally on my way out, Selene reviewed my bill and discussed my appointment and got me all set up. Either way, IM GONNA BE BACK, and tell my friends about this dental office. Thank you guys for making the dentist office very chill and reminding me to floss bc I’m problematic and have never ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: nichole navarro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super affordable and very nice staff. I was referred here by a friend and they did not disappoint. They got me in right away. All of the staff was super sweet and accommodating. I ended up needing fillings and was surprised at how low the cost was. Will refer friends here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Yandell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Giving two stars because there wasn't much of a wait when I went and the dentist answered any questions I had - everything else afterwards was negative. I wasn't going to post a negative review but the office scheduled a six month follow up appointment without my permission and I just got off the phone with them cancelling it since I never made it in the first place. The rest of the review below outlines why I would never have made another appointment with this office:

My initial appointment, I was told that I have a cavity that needs to be filled. No big deal - I schedule the appointment, pay for my cleaning and am told I need to pay UPFRONT for the next appointment. Seems weird to prepay for services not yet rendered but whatever. So I pay for the cavity filling and services for the next appointment. I get to the office for the follow up appointment and cavity filling. Upon walking in, I am told I have an outstanding balance that needs to be paid. I say, No no, I already paid all of this. And the receptionist says that my file reflects that I haven't paid in full. Luckily, I'm a psychopath about keeping receipts and retrieve my receipt from the previous visit in my car. It shows balance due is $0 and paid in FULL. AND the charges on this "new" invoice are different that what my receipt reflects so it seems as though they were altered after the fact. The receptionist calls another person over after I decline to pay what seems like an unnecessary charge and that person says it's fine not to pay today but my insurance will bill me for the extra overage. I said that's fine. I'll pay it when it comes directly to me. Cavity is filled, I go on my merry way. Guess what never comes? A bill from my insurance! So, this confirms my gut feeling that MyDental was trying to double collect from me. This is why I would never make another appointment with this office and yet, they took the liberty to make one without my permission.

If you go to MyDental, know your dental coverage, keep your receipts, and speak up if something seems off.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Frenzel
user_reviews_extended.Description: First of all I am completely terrified of the dentist but I went into MyDental tech ridge and the staff made me feel great. I will continue to go to the location and recommend it to anybody 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Rubio
user_reviews_extended.Description:
DO NOT RECOMMEND FOR TREATMENTS LIKE INVISALIGN. WAIT TIMES WILL TEST PATIENCE. I UNPROFESSIONAL STAFF MEMBERS.

I was doing my Invisalign treatment with MyDental and the process has been a nightmare. The last two visits where I had to meet with my doctor I arrived 10-15 minutes before my appointment and I was still made to wait 15-30 minutes more after for less than 5 minutes with my doctor. I wasn’t satisfied with the result and asked to have my area of concern address. They rescanned and said they would be submitting it right then and there to Invisalign to get the trays made and sent back. I waited a whole month before calling to follow up since I had not heard anything. I spoke with the person at the front desk and he “followed up” with the person in charge of handling those calls, Zaida. He let me know it could take anywhere from 4-6 weeks. Okay I understood that. After two months I called again because I still hadn’t heard back. I spoke directly with the Invisalign lead this time and she said that the treatment request had still not been set and that she was going to get on it right away and they should be in the following week. Now this week I got on Tuesday saying that they are ready for pick up. I was glad because I had been stuck using the last trays for over two months and although I’ve been routinely cleaning them they aren’t in the best shape. I also did not want to be wearing them any longer since the trays were suppose to be worn only for two weeks. I made sure that I did not have to see the doctor and that I could pick them up at the front desk. When my boyfriend tried to get them they wouldn’t release them and stated that they couldn’t release prescriptions (Invisalign) to anyone beside the patient due to them following standard prescription release procedures. I know this is not true because I work at a pharmacy and we follow the same procedures  and all that is necessary is that the person picking up is able to verify the patient information. When I mention this she tried to say that it was because if the person loses them MyDental would have to pay to replace them. I told her that when I agreed to the treatment with them I signed the agreement that I would be responsible for any replacement if lost. She had no response to that but to try to add another excuse. I would not recommend anyone looking to be treated here by this unprofessional staff that doesn’t respect it’s patients time. The fact that they tried to put the blame on me for them making mistakes and forgetting to do things on time is unacceptable.

Fast forward to 11months later I get a text saying I have a bill of $590 due?? I CALLED AND NOW THE BILLING DEPARTMENT IS “OUT OF OFFICE” “THEY WORK FROM HOME” “I NEED TO WAIT 5 BUSINESS DAYS”????? this place is a scam if I could give ZERO stars I would!!! Be aware

title: Daylight Dental South Austin
address: 6501 S Congress Ave suite 2-201, Austin, TX 78745, United States

user_reviews.Name: Ben Googins
user_reviews.Description:
I've been a patient here for 6 years or more.  The staff have always been knowledgeable and friendly.  I enjoy the atmosphere in the lobby.  The wi-fi works well.  They play cool music while you're getting cared for.  The offices are always clean, as is the bathroom.   The doctors are always professional.  I will say, a couple years ago, there was a doctor that I did not like, but she no longer works there.  Otherwise, I've always had an excellent experience with all the dentists at this location.

Honestly, the best dental care I've received over 40+ years of consistent dental care is from Dr. Song, who practices at this location.  He has been my dentist for about a year and half and he has always been attentive, caring and honest.

I highly recommend this location.

P.S.  There is a great bakery just to the side, which you should also visit. ;)

user_reviews.Name: Amir
user_reviews.Description:
I strongly recommend anyone coming to Daylight Dental to get a second opinion before agreeing to any treatment. I do not trust the reviews for this practice. I also do not like to leave bad reviews for any businesses specially a women owned ones. I switched my dentist after relocating to Austin and selected this office based on these reviews. Unfortunately, my experience was highly unsatisfactory.

The cleaning I received was the worst I have ever had. I was informed that I had two cavities, despite the fact that my previous dentist had identified no issues during years of routine checkups — including within the past six months. This discrepancy raised immediate concerns.

Unfortunately I trusted them. After two fillings were performed, I experienced persistent pain for several weeks. Following an extended evaluation, the office acknowledged that the filling had been placed improperly by Dr. Pham and too close to my tooth pulp (nerve). As a result, I was told I would now require a root canal — a procedure they were not even able to provide. The filling was also uneven and could be felt distinctly with a fingernail.

Also, when I reported noticeable buildup remained after the cleaning, the issue was attributed to “personal hygiene.” Additionally, I felt pressured to undergo a fluoride treatment, which I declined.

I strongly advise caution and recommend not solely relying on these reviews when choosing this practice. Do yourself a favor: save your money, time, and most importantly your health by seeking more professional practice.

user_reviews.Name: Emily H
user_reviews.Description: I had a wonderful experience at this dental office. The dentist was incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and thorough in explaining everything before starting the procedure. The staff was welcoming and made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in. The office was clean, organized, and very professional. I truly appreciate how gentle and attentive everyone was. Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality dental care!

user_reviews.Name: Reyna Shah
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot recommend Daylight Dental enough! I’ve had a few experiences with dental offices in the past, but the level of care here is truly on another level.

The entire team is professional, punctual, and—most importantly—genuinely kind. They handled my appointment with such efficiency and made sure I felt completely at ease. I especially appreciated how the dentist took the time to answer all my questions thoroughly without making me feel rushed.

user_reviews.Name: GaZa Neill
user_reviews.Description:
They were wondering, my wisdom teeth were growing sideways and pushing against other teeth until it broke teeth # 19.

They removed my teeth and did a bone graft for me. The removal was not was painful at all, and I was relieved to finally be free of the discomfort.

user_reviews.Name: Holly Holland
user_reviews.Description: My second time into the office for a checkup and they really are a cute spot. They are efficient and make sure you are comfortable. I have had issues with tooth decay and I am always nervous about getting work done(even a cleaning!). They made sure to do a fast job without hurting me, which is rare. Couldn’t be more thankful to leave a dentist office without sweating all over the chair 😂 best part is I also got a free grape scented lip balm after my cleaning and this girl be feeling fresher than your cars air freshener.

user_reviews.Name: Amanda Drake
user_reviews.Description:
The entire staff at Daylight are so incredible. As someone with high dental/medical anxiety, they often made sure I was comfortable, were understanding, and were a pleasure to work with. Everyone at the front desk, to the dental assistants, and the doctor was all top notch. I actually look forward to visiting, which is something I’d never expect to say. They were also super open about costs, etc.

Whether you suffer with medical anxiety, or looking for a new provider, I cannot recommend them enough.

user_reviews.Name: Stephanie Cao
user_reviews.Description: I really enjoyed my visit here at Daylight Dental. Both the dentist and dental staff were absolutely amazing and walked me through the examination. The office was clean and I was seen on time for my appointment with little to no wait time. I had a wonderful experience here and would highly recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anseh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would not recommend this clinic. My experience was very disappointing. I initially went in for a routine dental cleaning, but instead of performing the cleaning properly, they pressured me into getting an unnecessary filling. At my previous dental visit just six months earlier, my former dentist had found no issues with my teeth.

During my appointment, they did not actually perform a proper cleaning during my visit. It felt more like they were pretending to do the procedure rather than providing real care. I was extremely unsatisfied with the experience and really do not want to return to this clinic to ask them to complete the cleaning they were supposed to provide.

Unfortunately, my husband had a similar experience. He was also persuaded to get an unnecessary filling, which caused him significant pain for several weeks. After seeking further evaluation, we learned that the filling had been placed improperly and too close to the nerve. As a result, he now requires a root canal.

Based on my experience, it felt like their priority was not patient care, but charging for unnecessary treatments and taking advantage of patients. I do not recommend this clinic and will not be returning. If you are considering treatment here, I encourage you to think twice and do not trust on the high fake online ratings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desertico
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic experience! My dentist explained everything she was doing and what she had found on my x-rays, which I really appreciated. The front desk staff was also so helpful—they even rescheduled my appointment to double-check my insurance coverage, making sure there were no surprises.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Young
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am not scared of many things, but for some reason, I get really anxious at the dentist. I came here nervous, embarrassed and not feeling good about people having their hands in my mouth or drilling, etc. Dr. Song was the nice, relaxing person I needed. I didn’t get his assistants name, but she had a red streak in her hair and she was really nice too. I felt so relieved after as well when I had a root canal. They also were so nice about rescheduling me, making it easy for me for payment and just overall a great experience. I wish other places functioned like this. They are locked in and focused & it really makes a difference for me as a patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Hewitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Daylight Dental South Austin was awesome! I highly recommend this office! The staff and Doctor were fantastic!!! It was the third dentist I went to for a chipped tooth, they were fair priced, didn't waste any time and did a phenomenal job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin Wise
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wish I had a better experience like the other reviews, but unfortunately that wasn't the case for me. I came in for painful sore gums and 2 cracked teeth that were very sore and painful that were on the top right of my mouth. My visit started okay with filling out paperwork and then after I got called back. The dental assistant started taking x-rays of my teeth. Even when I expressed that I had sore teeth and gums were sore she made me and me to bite down harder for the x-ray. This mad everything more painful. Then after that I was taken to another room. My experience only got worse from here.

I waited for the Dr. Pham to examine my x-rays. She found a lot of things wrong with me teeth. When she came to go over the x-rays she put the examination chair back and started poking at my teeth not even explaining what she was doing. Causing me more pain in sensitive areas and then proceeded to blow air on them irritating my mouth more. Not even bothering with walking me through what was going on. Then I did tell her that I had anxiety with people working on my teeth. She took that too literally and told me that she could only refer me out to a oral surgeon and that she wouldn't do the procedure of extracting teeth. I was in pain then and I am still in pain. I may have been calm during the appointment. But I have a strong pain tolerance.

I asked if she could offer a pain killer for my sore gums and teeth. She said no at first and said I could just get an over the counter medicine. I had to ask twice to just get some ibuprofen to stave-off the pain until I can get help me my teeth. She then proceeded to ask why I came to this dental office and not Happi Dental where I initially got my teeth worked on. I told her that I thought these offices were sister companies and thought it wouldn't matter.

She then asked if I went to the doctor regularly and pryed at asking me about  my medical history. In which was very invasive. I feel that she doesn't have very professional bedside manner. I told her I was getting frustrated that she wouldn't help me with my pain with my gums or teeth and wouldn't help me in house for the procedure that I needed. After that talked he just left the room abruptly with the assistant telling me that she could only help me with the referral. She left me there for a little while without any way to know what I should expect next. They left me waiting in the exam room for awhile. I didn't she Dr. Pham any time after that.

She ruined my experience and wasn't very professional. After all of this I am still in pain and only have a referral for a oral surgeon that I am waiting to hear back from. All in all, it was very disappointing. I don't recommend Dr. Pham based on how she treated me and I think she needs to work on being more sensitive to patients.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Really great experience at Daylight Dental. The team is super friendly, professional, and do their best to make you feel comfortable. The office is clean/modern, and they do a great job of making everything quick/easy without rushing the visit. Definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Don’t know why you solicit reviews so heavily. Your staff honked at me as I turned into the confusing parking lot (signage is misleading and I had a massive tooth ache — surprise surprise)

You advertise emergency services online but you couldn’t see me same day despite my insurance being compatible but you didn’t hesitate to do X-rays and an “exam” that caused me to pay more at another actually good dentist.

You have children in a room playing video games and SCREAMING at the top of their lungs. If I was more irritable, I would have said something.

And the children only acted by the example set by your staff; gossiping LOUDLY for everyone in the waiting room to hear your business. I’m all for a fun working environment but for a place that performs dental procedures, one would hope that there would be an adult in the room.

I’m giving 3 stars because you did refer me to a very good dental surgeon who was able to help me so I’m VERY grateful for that.

Outstanding Dental Care Experience!

I had an exceptional experience at Daylight dental office at SOCO.   From the moment I walked in, the staff was warm, welcoming, and highly professional. The office was clean, and well-organized, creating a comfortable and reassuring atmosphere.

The entire team provided top-notch care, explaining every step of the procedure and ensuring I felt at ease throughout my visit. Their attention to detail, gentle approach, and commitment to patient comfort truly set them apart.

I highly recommend Daylight practice at SoCO to anyone looking for expert dental care with outstanding customer service. I will definitely be returning for future visits!

user_reviews_extended.Description: True professionals. I was able to schedule an appointment online the night before for a Saturday morning and they accepted my insurance. When I arrived, I was quickly greeted with a smile and tended to immediately. The receptionist and X-ray tech, whose names I didn't catch were kind and helpful. They were fast but I didn't feel rushed. Aracely and Dr. Song took great care throughout the new patient exam and completed the cleaning while I was there since they had time so I wouldn't have to return for a separate visit. They were thorough, gentle, considerate, quick and understanding. Highly recommend this place. The care is excellent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Estelle Santini
user_reviews_extended.Description: I honestly don't know how this place has such high of ratings. I went here 2 years ago, and they said I had 7 cavities. Note I have never had a cavity before this. I got half of them filled, asked for the imaging, then decided to go somewhere else as I had an odd feeling. The next place I went to, I asked them to read the imaging and they confirmed I only had 1 cavity. I do not trust this place based on my personal experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angi Sanders
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience. They were kind and compassionate. I was a nervous emotional mess, but they did not judge and helped me make the best decisions for my care. Very much recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tanisha Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great Staff, But the Dentist Was Awful

I had a mixed experience at Daylight Dental. The front desk staff and the dental assistant were absolutely fantastic—friendly, professional, and very welcoming. They made the start of my visit smooth and pleasant.

However, my interaction with the actual dentist (an Asian woman whose name I didn’t catch) was a nightmare. Her demeanor was cold and dismissive, and she didn’t take the time to explain anything properly. She rushed through the appointment and made me feel like my concerns didn’t matter.

What was even worse was the outrageous dental work she recommended. I’ve never had any dentist tell me I had several cavities and needed crowns all at once. It felt like she was trying to upsell unnecessary procedures rather than genuinely addressing my dental health. Given that I’ve always maintained good oral hygiene and never received such diagnoses before, her recommendations seemed highly questionable.

It’s unfortunate because the rest of the staff was amazing, but I can’t trust a dental office where the dentist’s care and recommendations feel so unprofessional and opportunistic. I won’t be returning to Daylight Dental and wouldn’t recommend it to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valentina Henson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The first visit I was so terrified as I hadn’t been to a dentist in a long time and had a ton of work that had to be done. I was so scared and beyond nervous and the staff and everyone explained everything to me and what needed to be done and were extremely understanding of my anxiety and fear of being seen and getting care. They eased my anxiety and were very patient with me when I began to get anxious and fearful or felt any sign of pain or sensitivity they were able to help me get through the process by numbing medication and helped me get the work I needed done. Every time I come in now I know I’m in good hands, I’m less fearful and grateful that I have a dentist I can go to now that I trust and feel comfortable. I still have a lot more work that needs to be done but my crowns look beautiful and feel great. Anytime I’m in pain or any discomfort I know there just a call away and will make sure to see me right away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gwynlon Hample
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were efficient, professional, and courteous of my time. They have state-of-the-art machines. I feel all of my health questions and concerns were met. I am incredibly pleased to be a new client at this facility.

user_reviews_extended.Name: VALENTINE PRICE
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great vibes here! Esme is very personable and disarming, she took care of the preliminaries/X-rays/cleaning etc. Dentist was professional and straightforward, I appreciate her for this. My previous dentist retired so I am glad to finally find someone I trust. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a new home for their teeth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasen Lawson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is awesome everyone was so nice and friendly and the work was a great price. Would recommend 10/10.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Murgatroyd
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall very thorough, fast and informative. My consultation was quick and efficient but addressed all of my issues. I learned I needed a deep cleaning but only on a few teeth and they weren’t over-zealous to do all of them which I appreciated. I’m only taking a star away because when I went in for my deep cleaning and filling, I wasn’t really walked through the process/told what was happening next, the doctor just came in and asked me to open my mouth and went straight in with the nerve block injections (the hygienist has already applied topical numbing to the gums), which I didn’t really have the chance to prepare for or try to distract myself and I am not good with needle injections in general. The filling and cleaning were SO FAST which was amazing, she certainly is experienced. But again, I didn’t really know what was happening and then it was just over. My fiancé goes here too and said his doctor was really amazing and talking through everything and he had a great experience. Overall really great dentist office but if you have dentist anxiety just let them know.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Stoessel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just a routine cleaning this time. I was in and out in no time. I always feel good about coming here. They do great work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Gil
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing experience. My boyfriend had a cracked tooth and was in extreme pain, I called and they were able to fit him in the next day. They ended up squeezing him into their schedule For an emergency tooth extraction. We are so greatful. 10 out of 10 service. Happy to find a new dental office.

Side note they have a sister office up north called happi dental. This is where they were able to preform the actual extraction and was a super fast easy stress reliving appointment for my partner. Also 10/10 experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: laura liscano
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office staff is so nice and friendly! Beautiful office, they scheduled me in right away for tooth pain and I was in and out of there so quickly. Definitely recommend and will be back in July!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kamryn Chapman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wasn’t sure how to feel about this place until reading some other one star reviews.

Like many other folks here, I went in for a regular cleaning as a first time patient. I left with no cleaning done, a diagnosis for about a dozen cavities and gingivitis (I have never had a cavity before or any other dental disease) and a “health plan” for just over $1.6k out of pocket.

Obviously, I am not a dentist. I was originally going to take the dentist (who was cold and short for the approximate 2 minutes it took her to diagnose me) at her word, but something felt off when I walked out. I may very well have a few issues that should be assessed and treated, but a diagnosis to this degree is outrageous, especially considering the others here in similar situations.

Thanks dental patients of Austin for your reviews! I’ll be heading to another dentist for a second opinion and a lower medical bill.

P.S. The hygienist was super nice by the way! I hope she has a wonderful life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M.A Jimz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Pros; Place was clean, receptionist, Tech, Dr. Where kind, and informative with all the procedures for the consultation.
Cons; It was warm, no hot, but could be little cooler. My appt was at 5pm, lasted over an hour, felt rushed after 6pm.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maw And Pop
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Highly recommend!!
Dr Pham is so friendly, gentle, and extraordinary at what she does. Her assistant Esme took the time to explain my treatment and made me feel comfortable. Olivia at the front desk is so kind. She makes you feel like you are apart of their family. Everyone at Daylight Dental is truly the “dream team”.

-Maryam

user_reviews_extended.Name: Henry Acker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Felt like a tooth chop shop. My teeth still have plaque on them which is the whole reason I came in. Sat in the chair waiting for the dentist for about 20 minutes. She came in and just banged my teeth with the drill. Recommended a sleep guard. Sounds like everyone gets that rec though. 2 stars is fair.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kat
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and professionalism. The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and caring, making sure I felt comfortable every step of the way. The clinic itself is modern and clean, which added to the overall positive experience.

Dr. Aleeahna is exceptional. Not only is she highly skilled, but she also takes the time to explain procedures thoroughly, easing any concerns I had. Her expertise was evident in the quality of care I received.

Whether it was a routine cleaning or a more complex procedure, I always felt confident in the hands of the team at Daylight Dental. They prioritize patient care above all else, and it truly shows. If you're looking for a dental clinic that goes above and beyond, look no further. Thank you to everyone at Daylight Dental for providing such outstanding service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: amy rogans
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was in pain had tears running down my face .. called them ....they said could take care of my situation.... went there and paid $75 to be looked at ...just to be told my   tooth needs to be pulled ....when I called I told them my tooth needs to be pulled ....and that I need to make a appointment and will cost $480 ..  drove 3 hrs to Eagle Pass .. .seen immediately $45 to pull tooth and $9 for medicine.. . The dentist has no passion.... all about $$$....Dr.s should care about patients but these days more like a politicians ..

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came back to Daylight Dental for my 6-month check-up, and everything was just as great as the first time! The doctor and assistant were super kind, gentle, and thorough again. They always make me feel comfortable and really pay attention to the little details. I’d definitely recommend Daylight Dental to anyone needing dental care. Plus, getting to watch my favorite Netflix show during the appointment is such a great bonus.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cicely Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice. I appreciated the fact they were able to see me the same day I called. I also appreciated the break down of treatment plan.

user_reviews_extended.Name: p. s.
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is incredible! Everyone is so kind and the exam rooms are relaxing. They explain things clearly and make sure patients are aware of everything that they will do or suggest to have done. Thank you to Dr. Phan and her assistant for great service! So glad I came here :)  - X.S.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra Molina
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was awsome at Daylight Dental.  Carolina was so attentive, personable,  and funny. She made me feel like it was a day at the spa for my teeth when the Dr. had finished.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ItsUrBoyJadin '
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was done with my cleaning pretty quick and the people seem knowledgeable and nice

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sergio Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I Love coming to Daylight Dental, EVERYONE always nice with us and treat us wonderful.Anna is great,always helping me and all my family. She always giving me advices on how to better on my oral hygiene,it's clear that she loves her job,always smiling and treating  everyone very well.
Thank you Daylight Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allie Deleon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience here every time. Great customer service overall and kind, safe, and efficient staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charla Gayle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm very thankful and grateful to GOD for you Anna! You were so kind, nice, understanding and professional about fixing my teeth. You really took the time to my sure that I was satisfied with my teeth before getting out of the chair!!! GOD BLESS YOU Anna!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Breanna Solis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t know how this place has more than 4 stars. I had some tooth pain, came here, and they told me I needed 2 root canals. The doctor herself spoke to me for about 2-3 minutes and did not listen to any of my concerns. They gave me a curated “dental plan” that was about 4k with insurance. As I was leaving, they kept pushing me to pay a deposit and book my appointment asap. Things felt off so I went to another dental office for a second opinion, and they told me I needed a crown and some fillings (about 500 with insurance). Please don’t go here. The doctors were impatient and unkind, and my experience was terrible. I still get automated text messages from them asking for a deposit for an appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yezzenia Salinas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I dread going to the dentist to the point that I delayed dental care when the dental hygienist quit at my previous dentist office. Not only is this place is close to my home, they have extended hours and it's easy to make an appointment within a short period of time. Staff are polite and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Lyons
user_reviews_extended.Description: been going to see them for the last 3 years and honestly my favorite dentist i’ve ever been too. love Aracely! always so sweet and knows how to do her job efficiently and with care!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: abril resendiz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing, everyone had great hospitality and the nurses were very understanding and patient.

I had gone for a usual check up with my daughter, despite her not cooperating and such the staff was very warm welcoming and patient as well, this was one of the best experiences I’ve had in a while and would recommend going here

user_reviews_extended.Name: She’s Grateful
user_reviews_extended.Description: Olivia did an amazing job helping me feel comfortable explaining the full process. I definitely recommend daylight dental. I give their service five stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annette Canales
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve always dealt with anxiety when it comes to going to the Dentist but for whatever reason I haven’t had that problem here. They make me feel comfortable, they’re polite and always able to answer all my questions. Esme was last taking care of me and she was great! One of the many great people in this team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Urie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was here recently for a consultation and came in feeling really anxious. However, the staff was so lovely and put all fears at ease. I worked closely with Ravi who was so wonderful. He took time to make me comfortable and feel informed about the entire process. I can’t recall my dentists name, but he was equally great! He developed rapport quickly and provided knowledgeable information with no shame. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennell Renai
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service and I always love the music

user_reviews_extended.Name: itswhatevertho
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are very professional and friendly. Love everyone that I meet and interact with during treatment. I always recommend this office to my friends and patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Timothy Goh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited Daylight Dental and had a great experience. The office is clean and modern, and the staff is friendly and professional. In particular, I want to highlight my experience with the dental assistant Ravi. He was very patient and kind, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire visit. He took the time to explain each step of the procedure and answered all of my questions. I appreciate his attention to detail and his commitment to providing excellent patient care. Overall, I highly recommend Daylight Dental and specifically Ravi.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linh Huynh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My daughter Vivian recommended me to come to Daylight Dental. I came in for a new patient exam and filled out all the necessary paperwork online which made it quick and easy once I got into the office. The office is very clean and modern.

One of dental assistants called me back to take my X-rays and the sat me in one of the rooms. Dr Phan was very knowledgeable and took the time to explain potential issues that she noticed in the X-rays. She did my cleaning and I scheduled another appointment for my cavities to be filled.

Overall I had a great experience. Everyone was friendly and welcoming and I highly recommend Daylight Dental for anyone looking for a professional dental provider!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kylena Parks
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Be careful here! They will try to upsell you on needs!
Husband and I went in for a regular check-up/cleaning and were both denied cleanings. They said we needed multiple fillings for cavities (went to dentist less than a year ago and had 0 cavities or concerns) and also forced us to get a “panoramic” x-ray on top of the normal x-rays or they “wouldn’t proceed with the exam” - we both left without any cleanings. I ask you, if your goal is to help people live healthier lives and prevent gum disease and further cavities wouldn’t you want to give a cleaning? Even S a bare minimum? If it wasn’t for having a close family friend who is a dentist giving us valuable advice on what is necessary we probably would have bought in and spent $100’s we don’t have.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edwin Tsang
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven't been to the dentist in so long and I was really nervous at first. The staff made was very attentive and the professional so that's always a really good sign for me. I had some old fillings that needed to be changed out and the doctor that helped me was super skillfull! I didn't feel the shot and before I knew it I was already done! I wish I came here sooner. The facility is very clean and the service is so efficient. I'll be sending my friends and family here that have just moved to Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thuy Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came here recently and had the best experience! Dr. Phan made me feel very comfortable and made sure that I wasn’t in any pain during my procedure, she even took the time to explain everything that was going on. The staff was also very friendly and welcoming. My family and I will definitely be returning for future dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Cerda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is very friendly and helpful.  Dentist took her time and was very gentle.  Excellent service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas Vu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at Daylight Dental for years, and I always enjoy each visit. The staff and doctor are incredibly friendly, and that makes every appointment comfortable. I always get a great cleaning, and they’ve truly made it so I don’t dread going to the dentist anymore. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: aimie pierce
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dental tech Vanessa was so sweet and helpful! It was my first time coming to the dentist in a while and I didn’t know what to expect. She explained things to me and got me to laugh which put me at ease and made me feel less nervous. The whole staff is exceptional, but Vanessa really stood out. I just moved to the area but I’ll definitely return to this location for my annual visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Wang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Daylight Dental and the staff offers outstanding care, and made me feel welcome throughout my visit. I especially appreciate Renee, who took the time to walk me through the procedure.The office is clean and professional, highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lesly Mendez
user_reviews_extended.Description: everyone is always so sweet and helpful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alejandra Perez Meza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great customer service and attention to detail! Thank you Jocelyn for explaining my procedures and making sure I was calm throughout the whole process! I highly recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Faviola Olivo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow just had the best experience Daylight  dental. This place is really nice. And all of the assistants and especially the doctor was so kind and gentle. They made me feel so comfortable. I got to watch my favorite Netflix show while I got my filling done so that distracted me. I would recommend this office anyone looking a new dentist! Two thumbs up and definitely!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yasmin Saenz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a current patient of Daylight. My experience has been amazing since the very first consultation. My doctor, Dr. Pham, has been nothing but understanding and kind. I recommend making them your main dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: hien tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a toothache and Daylight Dental took amazing care of me. The staff was friendly and attentive, the doctor was great, and the facility is modern and spotless. They made what could have been a stressful visit feel easy and comfortable. I’m so glad I came here and highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Henry Laguna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service, very friendly and professional

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maree Haney
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the team here at Daylight Dental. Dr. Phan & Pham do incredible work. Ana is my favorite ✨

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Iredia
user_reviews_extended.Description: all of the staff and dentist were nice! I didn’t have to stay long for my visit but they were also very thorough. Vanessa is the girl that did my polishing and she also helped me a lot with understanding the costs and expenses of everything. You also get a little goodie bag for every routine exam and cleaning which is nice 👍🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ramiro Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
2025 Update: Still a great dental office. Esme was awesome today. She answered all my questions and she and the doctor did a great job with my cleaning.

Great dental office! My mouth feels really, really clean! Awesome doctor and assistant! This is going to be my regular dentist now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Borders
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist that removed my wisdom teeth for a reasonable price.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrian Serdan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Walk in immediately the dental lady rolled her eyes. The exam $75 dollars just so they can say they don’t feel comfortable after she pounded my wisdom tooth and knowing it was in pain! They only stick to cleaning teeth if they can handle even that.  They have no knowledge of anything else at all. Stay away from this place if anything run!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Ha
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience at this dental office.
