user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad R
user_reviews_extended.Description:
disappointed in this dental clinic I wouldn’t recommend it at all
it’s a money grab  I’ve been to dentist’s all over the world and this was the worst experience I would definitely look for other options in South Austin

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jewel Quenga
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Came in as a new patient and Wow. The assistant that helped me was very nice and explained every to me. I really loved how they personalize a treatment plan and break everything down. They go above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and content.
Will definitely come back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Jackmack
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were amazing. Got me in for an appointment in a very timely manner. After my x-rays the doctor came in a gave me a very simple yet very detailed review of each tooth she saw something in and what the next step for each tooth would be. At the end of my appointment they supplied me with a detailed list of the recommended procedures for each tooth with price points & sent me off until my next visit! Will be coming back for sure and highly recommend. Very friendly and great environment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana María Topete
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been thinking if I should post this or not, but I don’t want anyone to have the same experience.

I went over here when we first move to Austin like a year and a half ago, dentist said I had 4 (or 5 can’t remember) cavities that she needed to fill. We schedule the procedure but then I had to cancel for changes in my life and we moved to a different city. As soon as we settled in the new city I ran to the doctor to get my cavities filled, Daylight sent my X-rays and all, the dentist look at my teeth, and the x-rays and said I had NONE. She ran another set of X-ray to double check and again, she didn’t find anything to fix. So I’d recommend anyone to get a second opinion on initial diagnose.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clifton Long Jr.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful experience! The culture of this office is very kind and hard-working, and Dr. Song is very sweet. I've been to many dentists in the past where you feel like a customer, not a patient -- the Daylight Dental team makes sure you are comfortable and will be taken care of. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: shylo rayne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got my wisdom teeth out here, they were great

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Clifton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love coming here. The staff is incredibly kind and will do whatever you need to make you comfortable. They redid fillings that were causing me pain for no extra cost, and were extremely validating about my pain.  I highly recommend Dr. Phan and her team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ada Wences
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Daylight Dental!!!  Everyone in the office was very kind and no-one judged that I haven't been to the dentist in a very long time. Dr. Phan was so sweet and gentle with my cleaning. One of the best experiences I've had. Thank you so much Daylight!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maritza Yanez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Daylight Dental a few months ago but want to share my experience. The front desk staff and everyone is very nice. I believe that is an essential part of running a business. You feel welcome.. However, when it came to the dental work, I was not happy at all. I was told I needed deep cleaning and a cavity that needed new filling. I was disappointed with the lack of care, explanation and rushed work they did. I felt like the Dentist was not careful and just grinded away at my tooth unnecessarily. I have gone to Dentists that truly work around the tooth very carefully and explain to me what they will do next so I know what to expect. Once he was done filling, I could feel very rough surface that was scraping and hurt my tongue. I asked him if he could smooth it out and he acted like I was exaggerating and almost sighed in a complain. Again, I have been to other dentists, that ask you before they put their tools down to see how you feel, to bite down and see if it's uncomfortable. We only get one set of teeth, and I do not feel like this dentist cared for my teeth the way he should have. Will not be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ms Chapman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone that works there gets five stars! The Dr. the staff are wonderful!! The staff gets a gold star! ⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmine Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really fast and easy to book overall,quick cleaning and care dr was amazing and so as the person doing my cleaning (Esme) i recommend coming here and for future visits .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandy Riojas

Dr Song is truly wonderful and talented. Staff is super sweet which always makes my experience leaving me wanting to go back even though I don't need anything done!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Magenta Pola
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter had an a great experience at Daylight dental!! The whole staff is very welcoming and kind! The dentist is so compassionate and made my daughter feel calm even though she was very nervous. Thank you Daylight Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathon Rocha
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love going to daylight dental they make sure ur comfortable with anything they do they are honest and I would definitely recommend this dentist spot for anyone who is trying to look for a dentist 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krystal Saenz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn't been to the dentist in years but after reading other reviews I felt like this would be a place where I'd feel comfortable. They're affordable, friendly, and not judgmental. Every staff member  I've interacted with has been professional and courteous. I started taking my daughter there too because I was so impressed. They and the assistants (especially Araceli) are so attentive, and make it a point to frequently ask about comfort levels and explain thoroughly what they're doing and what individual treatment plans will look like. I'm glad I worked up the courage to go!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hugo Jimenez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is super Scammy!
I sent my mom alone and she came out with a 13 thousand dollar treatment plan and loan approvals
. So I went to the cleaning appointment and the litterally rinsed my mom’s mouth out with water for five minutes and moved on to the next patient then left the dental assistant alone to complete the cleaning service. I am absolutely disgusted that they would take advantage of my mom’s insurance for a quick buck without showing any care towards her . This place needs to be under review . user_reviews_extended.Name: Chermaine Fullinck
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are great at Daylight Dental (and also Hapii Dental - the sister org). Everyone is friendly and great at what they do. If you have a dental emergency…these are the folks to call.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Han
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place! Best service from all of the workers, especially Jocelyn as she made me feel very welcomed! Highly recommend and would definitely be back!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hai-Duy Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient with this office for the last 3 years and would like to offer my input. I have lived in Austin for close to 5 years and was with another office before this current one. I’ve had multiple cleanings done from both locations, where I was told I had cavities. The differentiator here is that my last office pressured me into treatments that I didn’t prefer. Whereas this current location offers the same option but is kind enough to help demonstrate better habits to mitigate the risk. No office is perfect, but the fact that the fluoride from my last office didn’t necessarily eliminate the cavities, I left without learning anything else about how to better care for my teeth. Whereas in the current office my teeth looked just the same as with any cleaning done before. Instead, I was informed of the basics in the normal look for teeth and how it should be able to function in spite of its colorization. The general public thinks of ‘cleaning’ as going all white but like I said before, my treatment from both office locations looked the same after. But learning the basics of how teeth function day to day helped me develop habits. I still hear that I get cavities but it is very much controlled for when I practice what was given. I think the general public forget that dental offices aren’t there to make your teeth last forever. They are there to help sustain a healthy life function for your teeth the same way a medical doctor is trying to sustain you for the rest of your life for the lifestyle you lead. Staff were clear on the insurance they take and super approachable people. My cleaning was done thoroughly and procedures for treatments were also made clear to me. That helped ensure my problems were diagnosed and treated properly. Thank you to all at Daylight Dental. I recommend them to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James G
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was nervous at first, just because I haven't been to the dentist in forever.   You know how it is, well I finally decided to use my insurance to get my free x-ray and teeth cleaning. While I was there they were very nice and professional, I felt relieved is the best way I could explain it . They were informative and helpful which helps me move forward to the next step on keeping my teeth healthy. THANKS AGAIN DAYLIGHT DENTAL SEE YOU SOON FOR MY NEXT APPOINTMENT.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathan Phifer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quick and easy! Great experience, highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Rendon
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dental plan consists of 2 dental cleanings per 12 months. Regular dental cleanings would be no copay. Staff of location is friendly and doctors are knowledgeable. However, it appears that this business is very money hungry. The staff and dentist suggested cleanings every 3 months with the more advanced dental cleaning instead of regular cleaning because of the benefits. After I refused service and asked for only 1 Regular cleaning per 6 months, the staff refused and stated that is not how their offices work. They go based on what the dentist is suggesting regardless. I went to another dentist for a second option and the other dentist stated regular cleanings once every 6 months is perfectly fine. Disappointed at Daylight Dental as I had a gut feeling something was wrong and I didn't automatically go with suggestion of an advanced cleaning every 3 months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Gripentrog
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit to Daylight Dental was very pleasant. The staff was conscious about safety measures and very considerate about me feeling comfortable. Dr. Hani was very nice and knowledgeable. I was given tips on oral hygiene to help prevent cavities that I had never been given before. They are also upfront about all costs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vivian Ma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Daylight Dental has been the best dental office I have been to in Austin. I always have a great experience during my visits. The rooms are very clean and the staff and doctors were welcoming and very professional. I always feel very comfortable during my visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Solis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been there twice and love the people just wish the wait time to get called back would be less. Both times I waited over 25 minutes to get to the back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don't know how this place has so many good reviews. I tried to sign up as a patient here but I was told I had to get "panoramic xrays" in addition to traditional x-rays. Panoramic are not covered under most insurances because they are not necessary to service most patients. It feels like they are just trying to milk every dollar they can from insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bridget S.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Daylight Dental is awesome! They are so nice and understanding and help you any way they can. Aracely made sure I was comfortable and explained everything and made sure I understood my plan. I definitely recommend this dental office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: dwight jensen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Over last 2 days I’ve had dental pain like I’ve never experienced, 10/10 pain and I was to the limit. I also hated going to dentist before coming here, after todays visit my perception. #1 they got me in same day Saturday and Dr. Pham took great care of me and this pain is manageable. I look forward to going back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathrine Tarrant
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Pham and Aracely (I hope I spelt that right) were great at not only doing a good job, but making sure I was comfortable each visit as well. I didn't have dental insurance, so Daylight Dental set me up with a financial assistance plan that made all the work I needed done so much more affordable than before. All around great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Bost
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Daylight Dental is one of my favorite dentists I’ve ever been to. I moved to this area over a year ago and was struggling to find a dentist in the area that was affordable and was flexible with my work schedule.

They have appointments up until 6:30pm (major bonus points!!!!) and are open on Saturdays, so I’m always able to find time to visit.

Daylight is quick - cleanings take 20 minutes max and the team is always super friendly.

With Covid-19, they’re taking extra precautions and you can tell they really do put safety first, rather than just saying “we’re all in it together.”

Definitely check them out if you’re in the market for a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gissel Ivanna
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really like the fact that they walked me through my dental experience. The office is very welcoming and most importantly very clean. My treatment was explained and all my questions were answered. I enjoyed the fact that you are able to watch a movie on Netflix while you are getting your treatment done as well. The technology is very advanced. I will definitely be coming back every six months for my dental cleaning and check up.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aracely Medina
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience at this place ……

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Aparicio
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience, staff is super friendly !
Esmeralda help me that day and she was amazing and did an awesome job explaining everything to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Orth
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Pham is kind, efficient, and transparent in all of her work! She makes sure I am comfortable and completely understand everything that’s happening in each visit. She triple checks everything feels okay and ensures that I’m always doing okay and aware of what procedures or what I’ll be feeling. I really enjoy seeing her the wonderful staff at Daylight Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Delia Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have dentist anxiety..  Daylight Dental and their staff made me feel comfortable. My husband and I went in for a basic cleaning and left doing more. They are not pushy very professional and not overly expensive with insurance. Very very clean and I felt safe especially during the pandemic of Covid-19.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jeremy westine
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had the best possible experience one can have while visiting the dentist after 5+ years without a checkup! The equipment is very modern and much better than I ever experienced before. The staff was very nice and helpful and Doctor Phan was quick and gentle. I was feeling quite apprehensive about my appointment because I haven't been to the dentist in years but the whole experience was much more pleasant than I thought possible.

I won't feel any anxiety going back for my next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Vest
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall great experience. Got in for an appointment on short notice and the staff was very friendly. Was able to do treatment same day and the doctor gave simple but detailed explanations of everything that needed to be done. Will definitely be returning for future treatments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Toby Spinks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was nice and very professional. I would recommend Daylight Dental to everyone. They explain everything to you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a pleasant experience at Daylight Dental. The appointment was quick and the staff were nice, professional, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the process. The cleaning was thorough and done with care. I will be returning here in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adee Yatuma
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve seen both Dr. Phan and Dr. Song and I would recommend either for your dental needs. The staff is friendly and accommodating. This is the easiest dental experience I’ve had in a long while. And shout to Esmeralda for being so gentle during X-rays and polishing. In general, I usually leave the dentist feeling super sore but since I’ve been coming here, it’s been a great experience and I don’t avoid the dentist anymore!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Hoang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a bad toothache and they were able to see me on Saturday for an emergency exam.  Dr. Song was able to do my root canal the same day and the procedure was painless.  Everyone was nice and I was able to watch my favorite show on TV.  Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Curry
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had my first visit here today. Staff was friendly, and the wait was short. I (unfortunately) wound up needing fillings. They were able to do the fillings as part of my original appointment, so I didn’t have to come back or reschedule.
They also very thoughtfully have TVs with Netflix and headphones available to you during waiting, cleaning, and other procedures.
So far, nothing but good experiences!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Priyanka Ambati
user_reviews_extended.Description: Daylight Dental is very easy to work with! The staff is extremely friendly and the doctors are very easy to talk to about your needs. They clearly care for their patients and listen to them. They are very affordable as well. I plan to continue with them for as long as I can!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ella
user_reviews_extended.Description: Can we just take a second here to stop and RECOGNIZE amazing service and work!!! I mean, I’ve got to give credit where credit is due. I don’t think my teeth have been this clean since I was a baby!!! These dentists take true pride in their work and are absolutely amazing 💕 would recommend 10/10!!! I even got to watch my favorite TV show during the cleaning 🥰 love love love! I will be back!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Ward
user_reviews_extended.Description: Decent place for cleanings, although they will try to sell you on a “recommended” procedure every time you visit. DO NOT use their teeth whitening service. It was $450 and my teeth didn’t get any lighter. They basically stick a whitening tray in your mouth for 60 minutes and afterward your teeth hurt for weeks. Complete rip-off.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica Silva
user_reviews_extended.Description: Took my 1 year old for her first dentist visit. The front office staff were warm and welcoming. They have a nice space for children in the waiting room. The doctor was great with our little one and made it a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Durgan Koch
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first dental visit in 5 years. I had to have cavities filled and was naturally pretty nervous. The staff was very kind, knowledgeable, communicative, and helped me feel comfortable. The procedure was quick and painless. I'm glad I found this spot, would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lemus (Jess)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have now been here 3 times and my husband has been here once. He cracked a tooth and got an appointment for the very next morning to fix that, and got a cleaning and a cavity filled as well. He had such a great experience, I came to get work done too. All the staff I've seen are real friendly and help you feel at ease when you're nervous. I've had braces and teeth pulled out elsewhere so going to the dentist has not been the best. Getting my cavities filled was a breeze. They're really on top of their stuff. Work doesn't take long with all these ladies being rockstars. I'm so glad we found our new go to dentist spot. Don't hesitate to come in. Thanks to these ladies I learned that going to the dentist doesn't have to be scary or nerve wracking. Thank you all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yvette Mae Caratao
user_reviews_extended.Description: Daylight Dental is awesome! Recently came in for my routine check-up. The rooms were nice and clean, front desk staff were friendly, and the DR was super nice and knowledgable. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Solomon Rhima
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been using Daylight Dental for one year now and they have been great every visit. Their super flexible hours and easy scheduling though Zocdoc have been exactly what I need.
Staff is always incredibly friendly and patient with any questions you have.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea S
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is super caring and attentive! I‘d absolutely recommend Daylight Dental to anyone. They’re all super friendly, do great work, and walk you through everything so you understand. They’re very patient & keep you informed on everything. I will definitely be returning here in the future!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobby Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I took my 2 kids, 6 and 8, to this office. And we were all able to be in the same room, as they had a twin room with 2 beds. The ladies at the front along with the doctor were very friendly and understanding to my children who are terrified of the dentist. They were able to watch Netflix with headphone to stay calm during their cleanings. The kids were cooperative and left with smiles. As a parent I am extremely grateful and impressed with the amount of care and effort  the ladies at this office  put into their work. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bucks B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience at Daylight Dental.  It's never fun going to the dentist but they explained the procedures, the billing and they were able to get everything done within a few days.  I didn't have to wait a month to see my dentist.  Very friendly staff, they follow strict Covid-19 guidelines so everyone is safe.  I'd certainly recommend Daylight Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Hastings
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Truly horrible experience with Daylight Dental. My husband came here because they were open on Saturday, had an available appointment, and he had cracked his molar on Friday night.

They claim to have Covid protocols in place: they told him to wear a mask, we had to call to be let into the building, and I wasn’t able to go into the waiting room. However, they don’t enforce all their safety measures; there were people in the waiting room without masks that weren’t told to put one on.

The real issue is the disorganization. We called when we arrived 15 minutes before his appointment, but he wasn’t allowed into the building until 15 minutes after his initial appointment time. At that point, he was sent to multiple rooms because they kept sending him to the wrong room, the nurse incorrectly took x-rays and had to call him back multiple times to correct them, and they incorrectly billed our insurance. The doctor’s bedside manner is very concerning; the lack of compassion is evident. We don’t even know her name because she never introduced herself.

We are so disappointed that my husband spent money to spend an hour and a half in their office, only to have the dentist crack his tooth even worse and cause him to have to start the process at another dentist’s office. We would highly recommend staying far away from this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy Meadors
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went to get checked for a tooth emergency. They were very nice to me and gave me the meds I needed until I could get to my regular dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcel Mattern
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist gives me a LOT of anxiety, but I found myself on a Friday in an emergency situation where I had to make a Saturday appointment. The office was actually able to accommodate me on such short notice when no one else could. Dr. Song and Aracely walked me through the entire process and made sure I was comfortable and okay throughout the whole experience (even holding my hand when I felt anxious). I cannot say enough positive things about them and this practice, they’ve greatly helped me get over a lot of my fears around dental offices/procedures and I would recommend them over again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrian Mendez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great clinic! Very friendly

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been mean to my mouth — I’m talking years of neglect due to anxiety around dental care and I’m so glad I found Daylight Dental.

Dr. Song, Dr. Phan and Dr. Huq have all been amazing at caring for all my dental issues without judgment and helping me make a plan for repair and maintenance.

All of the dental techs I’ve had are SO incredibly nice and patient as well. The office is very clean and welcoming. I feel like I’m in good hands here, highly recommend!

I want to give shout outs to Esme and Aricely for being such caring people. Please know that you’re doing amazing work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: etelvina santibanez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great customer service, Olivia was very professional, Dentist explain the best option for me do a great job. I happy and I recommend Daylight Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tania Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff as always are extremely courteous and timely. Going to the dentist used to be such a nerve wrecking experience for me, but at Daylight Dental I truly feel taken care of. I appreciate the attention to detail in services provided and explanation of care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Wong
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Daylight Dental. They're always efficient, clean, and communicate well with me about any procedures or treatments. Between the friendly staff and the TVs you can watch during your appointments, you can't go wrong! I also recently visited soon after they reopened due to COVID-19 and they were extremely professional and careful every step of the way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Cazares
user_reviews_extended.Description: Most pain free dental visits I've had in my life. I would highly recommend especially since they are open on Saturdays.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DeWayne Long
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enjoyed my Dentist visit extremely nice and friendly very impressed by there customer service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ray Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place and amazing staff! My son has always had a hard time getting dental work done but the staff here made him comfortable put on a movie and gave him headphones to block out the noise of the drills. They had him in and out in a hour even though we didn't have an appointment! Happy to say we found a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Kees
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m happy to have found a dentistry that I like and is so close to my house. I was able to come early for appointment and they got started right away. They explained everything with my treatment plan and then I was able to watch Netflix while I got my teeth cleaned! I also appreciate that they weren’t pushy with selling me extras but still recommended things that should use. Excited to be back for my fillings!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Asha Unni
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I scheduled a cleaning last week and it was a frustrating experience. First, they told me the wrong appointment time on the phone (they said 2pm), but when I called to confirm that they told me it was 1:30pm and they didn’t have the 2pm open. They also told me the cost would be out of pocket bc my insurance wasn’t covering it. Given the mix up in the time, and them letting me know about the out of pocket cost right before the appointment, I was hoping I could reschedule to a time I could afford to pay that (and that was the correct time for my schedule). However, they told me I would have to pay a late cancellation fee that came to almost the same amount as out of pocket cost.. so I figure, okay, guess I’ll move things around in my day and come to this appointment today. I show up and they made me wait for so long that I ended up being seen for the original agreed upon time at 2pm! 😅  this was really frustrating considering I moved a lot of things around in my day to avoid the late cancellation fee. Then when I was seen, there was an even longer wait for the dentist and the dental assistants - for a 1:30 appointment I ended up being seen by the dentist at 2:45. She said I had four cavities when I went to a different doctor 6 months prior and they said I had none - and I haven’t had cavities in more than 5 years. I noticed another reviewer said the same thing happened; wish I had seen that before this appointment.

The dentist also ended up accidentally pulling out a part of my permanent retainer but didn’t say anything - I had to bring it to the hygienist’s attention. I’ve never had that happen to me before at any dentist, but they kept saying it “usually happens” and then it became a whole ordeal where they were saying I might still be charged for their mistake… at the end I had to cancel more of my day’s plans to be able to stay there and have the doctor fix it right then and there. They fortunately did not charge me for that but I was frustrated it was even a consideration. My 1:30 appointment finally finished at 4pm, and they asked me if I could leave a review to waive the cost of the fluoride😅 so now it’s making more sense to me why there were so many high reviews. The front staff was kind, but I have never had this kind of experience going to a dentist before. I definitely won’t be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abigail Vintu
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit was great, the staff was really nice and friendly. The office is pretty new and well-kept, they also offer patients the option of watching shows/movies while they wait. I would definitely go back for future consultations.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mohsin Naqvi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great time at the dentists office today. Initially I was very anxious to go in however, Dr. Rizvi made me feel very comfortable. She took the time to listen to me and explained the entire process really well, in such a way that I felt safe about it. Thank you again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dania H
user_reviews_extended.Description:
they offer free fluoride treatment if you post a positive review.
came here two years and got four fillings. I needed dental care and trusted the dentist. she did them all so fast and drilled one deeply and said it might be sensitive so she put something at the bottom to help with that. what she didn’t tell me is she also drilled TOO DEEP on the tooth next to it. I had soooo much sensitivity even the air hurt my tooth. I ended up having to get a ROOT CANAL because of dental error and there has not been a day since then that I am not in pain. would not recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sydister D
user_reviews_extended.Description: They did my cleaning fast. Which I like. But also took time to make sure I was comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was really nice and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: nature lover
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The good reviews are fake. Just click into the google profiles, the profiles leave the same fake good review for another dentistry Hapii dental. The two places are both owned by the same dentist. If you look up who owns these places but the same dentist is not at both places, very sketchy.

Response to commenter: It would be surprising for you to have a patient with only the name M. I have gone to one of your locations and have seen how you tried to scam my family members, the poor job you all did doing a less than 10 minute cleaning and charging insurance for that. Then I come see your reviews and they’re nearly all fake. I am just here to warn others about it, don’t fall for the seemingly good reviews, if you click into the profiles most of them leave almost the exact same good review (the exact same words) for the other dentistry or they are accounts that have only one review. The google accounts are fake and so are the reviews. I would upload picture evidence but you all block those types of reviews so others can’t see them. It’s shameful and appalling that you all reply to the fake good reviews, I’m sure you all “verified” those fake patients are real. Stop taking advantage of people in need, let them see your real rating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gizelle Cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience, Esmeralda was very kind and even taught me how to floss! The doctor were very informative and patient with me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Daylight Dental is the best dentist office. I’ve been coming here for 2 years and every time I come in they make me feel so comfortable. I have dental anxiety so be able to watch TV during my cleaning helps a ton plus they explain everything before they do anything. Would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rey G
user_reviews_extended.Description: Esmeralda did a great job of explaining the things that were being done or the things that should be done. Very patient, welcoming, and educated on her skills. I recommend Daylight to anyone looking for a dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia Deng
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Daylight Dental. They are so attentive to my dental needs and explained treatments and costs to me very transparently. Ravi is a wonderful DA and took excellent care of me and made me feel very comfortable. I highly recommend Daylight Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Flora
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had regular cleanings and ortho done here for almost a year now!
The gals and dentist are all nice and great, tx has also been okay!
But they really need a better scheduling system or AT LEAST HIRE a hygienist to do all the cleanings & not have the dentist(s)do them… -_-
This place is very slow as soon as you check in keep in mind that you will wait at least 30-45 just to be seen by the dentist. It’s extremely irritating, because you really have to clear your entire schedule that day just for a dental visit.
The previous visit I had was a cleaning & when I left I still had plague behind my bottom front teeth 🦷 not to mention they call and remind you daily about your visit but when you show up they take a very long time to see you!
This office needs improvements and maybe even a manager because as of now being an existing client I haven’t meet one to speak about my minor concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kale Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: so gentle and a breeze! thank you so much .. everyone here is so kind and sweet . it's very clean and smells great. I wouldn't change a thing. if I wasn't moving I'd make this my permanet dentistry

user_reviews_extended.Name: Halee Watel
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Daylight Dental is wonderful. They were accommodating, friendly and FAST. I am very impressed with how well this practice is run. Esmeralda and Olivia deserve all the kudos.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Herrera Barbee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great front office and back office care and quick quotes & verification of possible benefits. I need a mouth guard and the office quickly informed me of approval or not.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Adagbon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental care I have ever had. From the front office staff to the dentist there, they are very nice and professional. Thank you Daylight for great service & care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mohammad Zaidi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rizvi was by far the most professional dentist I have ever had the pleasure of dealing with. Had quite a successful, painless visit that could not have gone any better. Would 100% recommend to others and plan on bringing my children here as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eva Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and professional staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: B Whitley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today I met with Dr. Pham and Nelli and my experience was awesome! I don't do well with dentist visits but Daylight dental was so patient with me. They gave me great advice and got me in and out very quickly! Every one was very nice and accommodating. Thank you! I strongly recommend Daylight Dental for your dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If your looking for a very passionate, kind, comfortable dentist, this is the place to go.  Dr. Liu is the best 😊
She took the time to answer all my many questions and most importantly she has a very light touch!  The shots I got were seriously painless, I didn’t feel it at all.   I just scheduled my whole family with her!  She is amazing!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mandy Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Daylight Dental! They treat both adults and children which makes it efficient for scheduling all family appointments simultaneously. The staff is very friendly, professional and helpful. The dentists are very knowledgable and do a fantastic job keeping our teeth clean and cavity free. I definitely recommend Daylight Dental to anyone looking for a new dentist. They're the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office was incredible, they were extremely professional and had zero wait time. They were very thorough in everything they did. Would 100% recommend them to anyone. The staff is very sweet and friendly as well as professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madeline Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience. Dentists were very thorough and seemed to really care about my health as an individual. The experience was easy and (relatively) painless. I will definitely come back here to get more work done in the future :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Osegi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Phan is an excellent dentist who has gentle hands and keenly sensitive to her patients. My cleaning was fast and painless. Her staff was helpful and accommodating to my dental fears, and for that I would highly recommend this office. Love this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kristen garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: They did an incredible job with my 3 year old. I was amazed at how well she did because they were so gentle with her. My husband and I also got our teeth cleaned. The whole family in one day and we were all super happy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Tedder
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m one of those people who hates going to the dentist (and any dr office for that matter). I went here seeking help for an odd condition that I got zero assistance with. I left the visit being told I had 12 cavities that were going to cost me $4K+ with insurance. I knew I needed a second opinion as I had no pain and would imagine with that much decay I would feel some discomfort. After a visit to a new dentist, I was told I have one minor cavity and good dental health. The cost to fill the one cavity is about 1/3 the cost per filling I was quoted at Daylight Dental. I do not recommend this place AT ALL! I left my appt feeling like I never wanted to go back and like my dental care didn’t matter. I was just a customer that would foot the bill for services that were not needed. Luckily I suspected some shady practices and I was right.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tess Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been nearly impossible to get a hold of to schedule and continue services. Dont try to make your experience comfortable in anyway ( in comparison to most new dentist offices)

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Macapagal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff! Very affordable services! I love their ceiling TVs. They explained my treatment plan and costs really well. Would definitely recommend this location to my friends and family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office did not deal with me honestly. I came in for a cleaning after about a year from my previous cleaning and they told me I had 2 cavities and needed a root canal. They wanted me to schedule the root canal right then for the next day, a Saturday. They also told me their records showed I had 3 cavities from my previous visit that I never had filled, BUT those 3 cavities didn’t show up on the current X-rays, and 2 different ones did. That seemed suspicious, especially since I don’t remember ever being informed that I had 3 cavities on my previous visit. I would have gotten them taken care of. When I asked them how it was possible the cavities weren’t there anymore they shrugged their shoulders and had zero explanation for me. I was also not impressed with the impatient dentist who moved me through as quick as possible and asked me in a very irritated tone to breathe through my nose during the cleaning. Like, I get it, but I’ve never had a dentist or hygienist be annoyed with me before. I decided to get a 2nd opinion before scheduling a sudden next day surgery. I went to Dr Katz in Westlake on a recommendation and he told me I had absolutely no cavities and did not need a root canal. He diagnosed that I had too much pressure on my bite from a crown I had a few years ago and that was why I was having some pain. He and his hygienist expertly filed that side until my bite felt right and I have had no pain since. I am so glad I didn’t get the procedure before asking for another opinion. I saved a lot of money and pain and potential future issues from an unnecessary root canal. My advice would be to get a second opinion before having work done, or to go somewhere else in the first place. Also, when I had my teeth whitened here after my first cleaning they left me in the room with the whitener on for way too long. I was in the room longer than she said I would be and I thought that was weird. I could hear them chatting as my gums were burning very badly. I finally had to get up and go in the hall and tell them my gums were on fire and the dentist downplayed the whole thing and said, yeah this happens, it’s normal, you’ll have some pain for a few days. It definitely was not normal as I’ve had my teeth whitened before. She was very dismissive and not apologetic. Not to mention, they increased the price from what they had quoted me on my last visit by $200, only after I had them done. It seems like they are just trying to get as much money as possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: F Goodman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a easy experience with Daylight Dental’s crew. Everyone is nice and just seems happy to be there and happy to help. Aracely was super helpful explaining some of my options and setting expectations on next steps. 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hien Vu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Finally found my a dental office that can fit me in with my busy schedule.  The staffs are extremely nice, my cleaning was very thorough and I enjoyed watching my favorite show on Netflix, highly recommend!  Already told all my family and friends about them.  Looking forward to my next visit to start on my treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holley Higgins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Daylight Dental for about a year and a half. All I really want in a dentist is someone who doesn’t try to scam me (I once had another dentist tell me I had 9 cavities - I got a 2nd opinion and, hey, zero cavities!) or sell me a bunch of services I don’t need. Daylight delivers. I have not had to wait long for my cleaning appointments. Good experiences all around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina La
user_reviews_extended.Description: Julissa was wonderful! Super friendly and helpful. This was my first time coming to Daylight Dental and I definitely made the right choice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Cantu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was able to get appointments simply and able to get me in quickly. Wonderful staff, very nice and pretty quick. Not a wait. Office is modern and clean. I always recommend this dentist office to friends. They have done a wonderful job with my daughter also.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Duran
user_reviews_extended.Description: I genuinely do not think I have ever left a bad review before but my experience was so traumatizing that I feel like I need to warn other people. I had 9 cavities filled here, (I told them about my extreme dental anxiety beforehand) and not only did they do all of them in the amount of time it should take to do 1-2 fillings but I was in pain the whole time and let them know, even had a panic attack and they essentially told me i was fine and did not stop or check in on me at all. The fillings were so poorly placed and done that I had to have my bite adjusted 4 different times until I just gave up and decided to live with it. I was in pain for over a year bc of what they did to me, I could not chew on the right side of my mouth for over a year also, and I had to have 3 of the fillings replaced already because they were broken. My new dentist was so alarmed at what they had done to me and while she wouldn't speak on others dental work she let me know none of this is normal. My dental anxiety is so bad that it took me years to work up the courage to even go and i thought i was in good hands because of all the great reviews but clearly I was wrong. Its been 2 years and I am still dealing with the repercussions (and paying hundreds of dollars to have this poor dental work fixed) Do not come here. also to daylight dental- do not contact me, i will not be coming back ever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rue Noriega
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Daylight dental staff is awesome.
From Ana in reception to dr. Liu. Everyone was patient and friendly. I usually am very anxious to go to the dentist, But they have TV on the ceiling & it really helped my experience. Olivia is so gentle, and reviews all of your options thoroughly. She’s great at explaining, and listens to any concerns you might have.  Give them a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susy García Silva
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really love Daylight, all the associates are kind and always explaining everything, Thank you Esme. 🥰🥰

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone I’ve interacted with here has been very kind. Unlike most dentists I’ve been to, I can usually get an appointment here on a last minute notice if something is hurting or is urgent. Also, they are VERY clear about making sure you’re aware of whatever something may cost (and they have very fair pricing in my experience) so you don’t get any unfortunate surprises when you are leaving. As someone who was swindled out of thousands from a past dentist, I appreciate so much how they are upfront on every cost before you begin any treatments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jodi Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: An overall great experience. Dr. Phan was gentle and informative as well as the dental hygienists. They made sure I was comfortable and provided headphones, Netflix, and even an eyelash protector for my glasses. Definitely worth a visit if you’ve been scared of the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Belinda Espinoza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so happy I found this place today! My grandson had a filling come out and I called hoping to have him seen immediately. Sure enough, they made time for him and had him all fixed up in under two hours. Great, friendly, knowledgeable staff and Dr. Excellent service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vy Vu
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dental service I’ve had in a while! Ravi Lai attended to all my needs and questions and made my experience as comfortable as possible. My teeth feels so clean and bright. LOVE THIS PLACE 🙌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Liu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ravi Lai is an exceptional dental assistant who works at Daylight Dental. He is extremely knowledgeable and skilled in his field, and always goes above and beyond to make sure patients are comfortable and well-informed during their visits. Ravi is also very friendly and easy to talk to, which helps put patients at ease. I highly recommend Ravi and Daylight Dental for all of your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susannah Osegi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to daylight dental for a while now and I am very happy I found this place! The doctor is super gentle and the office is really clean. As soon as I filled out my papers they called me back to get my cleaning. At other offices I usually have to wait 20-30 minutes before I get called back. My cleanings are always quick but thorough and I very much appreciate that!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martha Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been to 3 dental offices and I can honestly say this one has been my most favorite of all. Not only I go here but my whole family does. My son had work done to his crown from another dental office and it kept falling off after only having it on for one week, and on top of that I kept having to pay to seal it back on. Came to this office and they only charged me half of what I payed for at the other office and they where not the ones who originally put my sons crown on, so after the first time they sealed it on it has not fallen off since. The staff is very friendly and always greet you and make sure you feel comfortable while being worked on. I will definitely recommend going here I’m very satisfied.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bertha Davila
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience awesome staff highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cady Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: I normally don’t enjoy going to the dentist, who doesn’t. But the staff at Daylight dental made the experience an exceptional one. The staff was friendly, and answered all my questions. I’m glad I finally found a dentist that I feel comfortable enough to have work on my teeth, and that they care enough to make to provide me with the plan best for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Concepcion Montoya
user_reviews_extended.Description: Couldn’t be more grateful for the staff here. When I told them I couldn’t afford my children’s annual cleaning, the didn’t just say ok and hang up, they helped me in a major way. Everyone was beyond sweet, helpful, and courteous to my kids that were nervous. Great experience. Will definitely be returning and referring ppl to them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin P. Morgan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very good service!  The dentist and the technicians are very knowledgeable and are willing to thoroughly explain your individual experience and reasons why you should be treated certain ways.

There is a focus on how to improve your oral health, rather than make money on unnecessary procedures.  I appreciate such concern, and I am sure you would, too.

The office is contemporary and conveniently located.  It is also outfitted with the latest in technology, such as a sophisticated x-ray machine and a device that takes a full-color photograph of teeth up-close.

Thanks for the excellent care!

(Compensated for my review)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Kunkel
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time seeing a doctor here. I was pleased by how quickly I was scheduled in to see the doctor and how thorough the exam was. The staff was friendly and made sure I felt comfortable the entire time. Netflix is available throughout your entire time in the chair. However, it was a little disappointing that cleaning and fluoride treatment was not included with the exam.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alma Rosado
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time visiting a dentist office in 5 years, since I was removed from my insurance. Everyone was very pleasant in working with me, and very quick service! I have anxiety when visiting any medical professional, but I really felt comfortable at Daylight Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarada Golla
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really great job by Dentist Tran

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Dykowski
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great care! Everyone was very friendly and professional. I was seen on time and everything is explained well before they began any procedures. Will be back in 6 months for sure. Highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dentist experience i've ever had! The staff is so professional and friendly. They respect your appointment time, they make sure you're comfortable (even have a TV above the chair so you can watch Netflix while you're getting your cleaning done!)  They do a thorough job checking and cleaning your teeth then they make sure you understand what the next course of action is and the payment expection so you won't be greeted by an unexpected bill later. I definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amelia Dial
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After going to another dentist office in south Austin which a complete train wreck and caused major stress and anxiety, I'm so happy to have found Daylight dental!

The staff is very friendly, knowledgeable, and gentle. It's rare I have to wait longer than 10 minutes for my appointment. I literally check in, sign the waiver forms, then am immediately called back for my cleaning every time. In and out in there in less than an hour. They are also great with children and make my ten year old feel comfortable/relaxed during his visits. They let him watch a movie on Netflix while they work on his teeth.

I definitely recommend Daylight Dental to anyone! Check them out, you'll be glad you did!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julissa Resendiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctors were so kind and patient. The staff was just as kind they helped me stay calm and positive throughout the whole appointment. Thank you!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana M Chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to this dental office for teeth cleaning and X-rays done. They did a thorough job with the X-rays and pics however they seemed to over diagnose. They wouldn’t do my teeth cleaning because they said I needed deep cleaning which would require novocaine. I go to the dentist every 6 months and have never required a deep cleaning with novocaine so I found it very strange. They went over a treatment plan which consisted of four cavities. The cost would’ve been over $1,400 out of pocket. I followed my gut and got two different opinions from dentists. I did have to get one cavity filled but was able to get my regular teeth cleaning. They seemed nice but I would be cautious.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica De La Torre
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really loved the location and would definitely come again. Dr. Phan was polite and explained what to do to help prevent dental issues along with her wonderful staff, who also helped explain everything that should be done throughout the next couple of months. Everything done was recommended and asked prior to being done without any hidden costs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Magdalena Rangel
user_reviews_extended.Description: As you walk in the office is very clean and modern with a small separate  area for children. The entire staff is very friendly. All of the equipment is up to date. They played some Netflix while they worked, it helped to ease some of the anxiety of being at the dentist. Dr. Phan was very patient and helpful as she explained my treatment plan and problem areas. I definitely recommend it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Lucero
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Daylight Dental staff is great! Informative and very friendly. They make sure you're comfortable, and even play Netflix for you while you get dental work done. I usually avoid the dentist, but they made the experience easy and stress free.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenna OBrien
user_reviews_extended.Description: Office is very clean and efficiently run, I arrived early and was taken care of early, and Dr. Phan saw me right after my x-rays. After doing a exam they went through my options and laid everything out in a easy to understand and well-thought through manner. Plus you get to watch Netflix during!! I would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sunho Robert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was very welcoming and the dentist was thorough with my exam and cleaning. Vanessa was my assistant and she was very accommodating as well! I never feel nervous going here for my dental visits

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Santana
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first visit with Daylight Dental and had such a great experience. The staff are all efficient and I was in and out in under an hour. I would highly recommend this place to anyone who is needing a new dentist in south Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Armitano
user_reviews_extended.Description: I definitely have recommended Daylight Dental to all my family and friends that live here in Austin. I originally came here because of an emergency. I just left here again after getting my six month check-up and I still feel the same: everyone is so kind and understanding. The doctor is very sweet and the assistant is also sweet. I cannot say enough good things about this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Galindo
user_reviews_extended.Description: First off, I booked my 12pm appointment at 10am the same day. And it was confirmed within 30 minutes. Great staff and great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Malenie Leyva Portillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is very friendly and professional. Everything is thoroughly explained from the beginning. I usually get very anxious at the dentist but they do everything they can to make me comfortable during my visit. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Mercado
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a great place! Great staff, positive energy, and happy smiles! They explain things so well when it comes to making appointments, and explaining treatments. Very clean, would love to work in a place like Daylight dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thanh Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Office is modern and clean, everyone is very friendly. I was seen promptly and they went over my treatment plan thoroughly.  The cleaning was painless.  Get to watch Netflix during my treatment.  Excellent service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie N
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been avoiding seeing the dentist for 5+ years because of a bad experience from a previous dentist. Then I cracked my tooth and thankfully found this place. Everyone is so friendly and Dr. Phan is awesome! It was a pain free experience getting my cavities filled and getting my teeth cleaned. Definitely recommend coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: AZ Moyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an incredible first time experience at Daylight dental. Everyone was extremely nice and the Doctor was very thorough and taught me a lot that I had not learned about my teeth in the 28 years I have been with them. I highly recommend Daylight Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Wells
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a pleasant first visit. The staff are friendly and attentive.  Esme made me laugh so I knew I was in good hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerry Campos
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit to Daylight Dental and I had a great experience. I went in for an initial consultation and the staff was very friendly and helpful throughout my visit. Everything went smoothly and efficiently. I definitely recommend this to anyone who is looking for a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriela Alcala
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got two crowns done here and highly regret it. From the beginning I felt it was a mistake but thought it couldn't get any worse. Well, now 7 months later both of my crowns came out two weeks apart. I had them re-cemented at another location but was told if they fall out again I'll have to get them re-done. user_reviews_extended.Name: TraY Trau
user_reviews_extended.Description: The atmosphere is amazing ! They’re very helpful and quick ! They have the most amazing people that work there! They sooo sweet

user_reviews_extended.Name: Agix Ard
user_reviews_extended.Description: My son was happy with the nice and prompt service Daylight Dental gave him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheira A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Brought my children in and they loved it  they had tablets  with games available and loved that they also had small toys for my little one. They where really helpful and explained the whole process to my kids which allowed them to let the dentist actually do all the treatment without them being reffrered! Dentist had a lot of patience and the staff made it fun for my children. Also loved that they had Tvs in each room that kept my kids entertained while getting their work done. Definitely a Family friendly environment!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniela Robles
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time seeing a dentist since I moved to Austin and this place will be my go-to. The staff and doctors are very friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. They keep everything super clean and sanitized which makes me feel at ease because of COVID. Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darlene Olarte
user_reviews_extended.Description: They got me in quick and everyone was so nice! Dr. Liu is very thorough and explains everything well. Olivia also did a great job. Definitely recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent care and the staff are very understanding of my extreme sensitivity during cleaning. Esmeralda did a great job of flossing, the best job I’ve had in a long time

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paula Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I didn’t want to leave a bad review because the ladies here are lovely and really nice. HOWEVER this is my 3rd bad experience and I thought it was just me in the beginning. PROS: This place is modern and you get to watch Netflix while getting your work done. Now I get anxiety when going to the dentist because of this place so the other 2 times I blamed myself and said it’s all in my head because they have 5 star reviews so I had to be wrong. I don’t think they know what they are doing and it’s seriously a concern. I’ve gotten work done like crowns and fillings, tooth cleaning and lastly a simple extraction. All of which were VERY painful I’ve been to other dentists and it was painless. I’ve been told several times my wisdom teeth grew in simple and should be easy to remove. I went somewhere else to get one out fast because it was bothering me and he numbed me and had my tooth out within seconds the hardest part was numbing. Painless, easy experience.  Now here they have extracted 2 wisdom teeth and both were so painful felt like my jaw has going to break and it felt like they were pulling my teeth out with NO medicine. I got at least 8 shots to numb. And was horrible.  I also know the difference between the pressure your suppose to feel opposed to pain because I’ve been to other dentist that was not right. Even when I got a cleaning it was painful I’m not sure what they are doing wrong but it’s horrible. The PAIN is just so bad dosent seem right. TRAUMATIC to say the least and I will be listen to myself next time instead of second guessing myself. Also there are far better places with better bedside manner and better communication.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Phan was amazing. My situation occurred unexpectedly and I just moved here. I didn’t think I would have luck finding someone same day. But Daylight got me in with Dr Phan on a Saturday (next day). She diagnosed my fractured tooth and gave me a temp filling till I could come back in 2 days for the crown. She was kind, put me at ease and went right to work. I’m very satisfied with  her and she will be my new local Dentist moving forward. I highly recommend Dr Phan!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karly Melendez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My boyfriend came here and was overcharged over $400. We realized this and worked with billing for a couple weeks to sort it out. They are reimbursing us for the amount overcharged. However, had we not questioned it or did some research, the situation would have been left as is which is a scary thought. It is not our job to be thorough in the work they are doing. The staff was nice but he should not have been overcharged that much in the first place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: erica curtis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
[short version] visited Daylight Dental, was told I had several cavities and it would be $1,000 to have them filled, felt weird about my experience, had a second opinion else where and showed 0 cavities and a healthy mouth.

[full experience]
I just moved to Austin and needed a teeth cleaning, so I just looked up a place that was close to me and had good reviews. I found Daylight Dental and thought it was modern so I scheduled an appointment telling them I really was just interested in a teeth cleaning but would take an exam since it has been a while. They told me that they would do an exam ($99) and a teeth cleaning if there was time. That isn’t usually what I’ve experienced as a new dental patient at other places but it’s okay, maybe they just do things different here.

I get there, it’s not as modern as the photos made it out to be. That’s okay. Everyone who worked there WAS super nice and I appreciated that. So I begin to fill out my paperwork and before I’m finished they’re calling me to the back and said I can finish my paperwork later. That hasn’t happened before, but again, okay. I get my x-rays done and follow the hygienist into a room where she begins to take my blood pressure. The machine errors so she try’s a different machine, it errors. After a few attempts she decided to move me to another room, where then she told me I can finish filling out my paperwork while I wait. It just felt a little hectic and unorganized.

She takes additional photos of my teeth, that all went well. The dentist comes in to explain what’s going on in the photos; so she says I had SEVEN dark spots, aka cavities, and bone loss from my permanent retainer. She moved through the photos and x-rays explaining cavities she saw, even saying one was close to a nerve. So I’m freaked out about this information AND already having an intuitive feeling that something just doesn’t feel right. I’ve always had healthy teeth habits and have only had maybe 3 cavities ever when I was young. This was just strange for me.

The dentists forms a treatment plan where it explains all of the work that needs to be done and the cost balance that would come out to $1,000 for JUST the fillings, not including the retainer that they wanted to remove. I knew something was off, so I called my dad, told  him my experience, and he agreed something didn’t sound right.

Today I went to a different family dental office and had a MUCH better experience! I felt more confident and had a lovely experience. They did a full new patient exam that included x-rays and a full teeth cleaning. They did agree that my permanent retainer was problematic but not resulting in uncommon bone loss, that everyone who has permanent retainers pretty much experience that to a small degree. They seen stains on my teeth but were not concerned, and the stains came off as soon as my teeth were cleaned. They checked throughly for cavities looking at x-rays, photos (before and after cleaning), and physically feeling for soft or tacky areas on my teeth. I actually had 0 cavities and minimal issues with my teeth or gums, I just needed a cleaning.

I was told by Daylight Dental that I needed $1,000 worth of work done, and that doesn’t include the physical pain of getting my teeth drilled into and going through that entire process. My point is people, trust your intuition. I knew something didn’t feel right about my Daylight Dental experience and I was right. It saved me a lot of money and dental pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lola Less
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Daylight Dental have been so wonderful since I started coming here about 6 months ago. They are kind, flexible, and provide excellent care. I could recommend them to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lance Rangel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly! Very professional and I highly recommend to anyone who needs dental work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Vainwright
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t know how this place has such good reviews. I did not like my experience here at all. The doctors and assistants were rude, and I waited in the dental chair while listening to them laugh and talk for over 15 minutes. My cleaning was rushed and I had to remind her to do things that she forgot... Just not good customer service and made me feel unwelcome. I also never ever leave reviews especially bad ones. Disappointed :(

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy Tang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ravi was an excellent Dentist. He did an amazing job polishing my teeth and made me feel very comfortable. He is the reason I will be returning to Daylight Dental for future cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janice Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: It has been such a pleasure getting dental treatment from Dr. Krystal Liu. She has one of the best bedside manners I have ever seen. Dr. Liu explains treatment very thoroughly and shows me where my cavities are. I never feel like she is selling me anything because everything just makes sense. She is also very kind to her staff, which is important to me. I leave feeling great and confident!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabrina Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist here told me I had 11 cavities and that I have 30% gum recession. The dentist said if I don't follow his treatment plan my teeth will deteriorate and fall out. This was alarming to me since they had only spent about 1 minute looking at my teeth. I went to another dentist for a second opinion who did a thorough exam on each tooth. They told me I had some concerning teeth with periodontitis. Every charge I have on the treatment plan from Daylight Dental is $100 more adding up to $3200 greater than my second opinion dentist. Did you see Erica's review from a year ago here? She experienced the same thing!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Rund
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was our first visit for my wife and me.  We researched the staff and other reviews. We were very pleased with all the kind and professional service we received and intend to continue to go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Quay Bird
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ana is wonderful!  My child had extreme anxiety during her appointment.  Ana calmed her and guided her through the entire procedure.  Thank you, Ana:)  On another visit, even though it was back-to-school busy, Dr. Liu was attentive and thorough during my child's exam and procedures.  Thank you, Dr. Liu:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Green
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Daylight Dental.  My teen son and I both have excellent experiences here.  Fast, thorough, and super nice staff.  I was looking for a new dentist.  We found them at Daylight.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brent Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very happy with my visit! From the front desk, to the assistant to Dr. Aleeahna Phan herself, everyone was very kind and professional. Very gently and communicative. Definitely my dentist from here out.

Edit: I ended up still having some pain/ache in a molar root after my visit and upon hearing of this Nelly from Daylight specifically called me with concern and worked to set up the appropriate appointment to figure out what the issue was. I must say I am very pleased with the way they took action and showed concern for my tooth pain. They're great people working there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Asad Rizvi

user_reviews_extended.Description:
BEWARE OF HIPAA VIOLATIONS.

I had a terrible experience at  Daylight Dental. I called to schedule an appointment as a new patient, and they required me to provide all of my personal and insurance information. They knew that I had Aetna dental insurance, and they scheduled an appointment for me. However, the day before my appointment, they called to cancel and said that they do not accept Aetna dental insurance. This is a HIPAA violation, as it is illegal to collect patient information without the intent to provide services. They could have easily told me that they did not accept Aetna dental insurance when I provided them with my insurance information.

I am very disappointed with the unprofessional behavior of Daylight Dental. I would not recommend this dental office to anyone. Please be aware of this HIPAA violation and stay away from this scammy business.

She showed me the xrays and I agreed that *possibly* 3 were showing faint shadows so I reluctantly had her to do 3 fillings.  The other 4 supposed cavities I told them I'd wait because I wanted a second opinion.  I go back to an old dentist that I used to like a lot (this is again a different dentist than the 3 prior to coming to daylight dental), he does xrays and an exam, compares them to my last ones from 2018 and says they're the exactly the same and I have no cavities. This was by far the best dental experience I've ever had.  I booked through ZocDoc which allowed me to fill all my info out prior to arriving.  Upon arrival, I was greeted and asked to sign a short doc confirming all my info from ZocDoc was correct.  Then I was asked to have a seat and before I could reach the chair Gladys called me back.

Went to the first room where I had Xrays done and everything was so on point.  I didn't once find myself just waiting around for someone to arrive.  After xrays, went to the 2nd room where I was asked if there's a particular show on Netflix I like watching...in which I replied "The Flash" (<--Marvel nerd alert).  I spent the next 45 minutes with Dr. Phan and her assistant both cleaning my teeth and filling in some chips while I laid back and watched a full episode from the TV hanging above me.  They were efficient, effective and the overall experience was very pleasant.

I ended my session with before and after pics of the cleaning and smiles from everyone at the office telling me to have a great day.  I can't recommend Dr. Phan and her team enough.  They were awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Ibarra-peyton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I decided to go here because they are open on weekends, I was skeptical at first because of the bad reviews but I needed a root canal and I needed it fast, I couldn't wait weeks for it to be diagnosed and then longer to have the procedure at other places. Daylight was able to do it asap soon as I was able to come in. I went in for my procedure early in the day which was great and im going to be honest it started off a little rocky, after drilling into my tooth, from the sound of it they were going back and forth that they didn’t have the right tools set up, they continued to to try and sort out the tools looking for the right sizes to do my root canal. Sounded like it was a new set they had just gotten and it was out of order. In the end they got it figured out! Dr. Pham who did the procedure was amazing! I didn't feel a thing when she first numbed me up, in the middle I started feeling it again and she was quick to numb me again and explained everything thoroughly, she checked on me often to make sure I was doing okay, she was quick with the procedure as much as she could be, I was so nervous because I have only had one Dr. do all my root canals and having someone new that I don't know was nerve racking but it turned out great and I am pain free! Thank you Dr. Pham!
