title: Austin Dental Works
address: 4601 N Lamar Blvd #503, Austin, TX 78751, United States

user_reviews.Name: Fer
user_reviews.Description:
My husband and I feel so fortunate to have found Austin Dental Works, and we absolutely recommend their services!
After trying out several different dentists across the Austin area, we finally found our "dental home" here about four years ago and haven't looked back since.
The entire staff is consistently friendly, welcoming, and knowledgeable, making every visit—from a simple cleaning to more complex work—a smooth and stress-free experience.
A special shout-out to Dr. Jaros, who is truly in a league of her own. She is incredibly patient and has such wonderful manners. She never rushes through an appointment; instead, she takes the time to thoroughly answer and clarify every single question we have with genuine understanding. It’s so rare to find a doctor who makes you feel heard and comfortable.
If you’re looking for a team that truly cares about both your smile and your peace of mind, this is the place to go. We can’t think of a better practice to trust with our dental health.

user_reviews.Name: Nicole Contero
user_reviews.Description:
I LOVE the team at Austin Dental Works! They have been taking care of my dental health for several years, and I recommend them all the time. The staff is incredibly friendly, comforting and professional. Dr. Jaros makes understanding my dental health approachable and not intimidating.

ADW is super easy to book and communicate with, and Tiffanie ensures all the insurance/financial questions are covered.

Thanks for all y’all do!

user_reviews.Name: Teresa Thy Le
user_reviews.Description: Staff is amazing!!! Tiffanie, Valentina and Dr. Jaros were all kind, informative and professional. I loved my experience and felt at ease the entire duration of my visit. They did not make me feel anxious one bit and the process was very transparent and easy-going. I would highly recommend Austin Dental Works for your dental care needs!

user_reviews.Name: Anuj Bellare
user_reviews.Description: I have only been through 3 appointment - an introductory appointment, dental cleaning and cavity filing + crown prep. The experience has been great until now. Everyone here has been super friendly. Dr Jaros is clearly skilled at dentistry, explaining every step of the process. She also often asks how you are doing which is very comforting. Nobody in the world ever said “I look forward to my next dental appointment” but this place comes close to making you feel that way. 😊

user_reviews.Name: Tanya Embers
user_reviews.Description: I love Austin Dental Works! The staff is so lovely and kind, and Dr Jaros is a great dentist. Always can trust their recommendations and care. They never try to sell you more than you need and are super easy to schedule with.

user_reviews.Name: Todd McDougall
user_reviews.Description: Austin Dental Works has been my dentist for over 5 years now. The staff is super friendly and head Dentist is excellent.  They also give free whitening every 6 months!  Romans 10:9

user_reviews.Name: Alicia Lewis
user_reviews.Description: Best dentist I’ve had and you never have to wait. They schedule people perfectly so you are in and out. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Description: Dr Lindsey Jaros' expertly found a dental issue that was unseen by my last dentist. Her expertise to resolve this issue improved my health & well-being. Her staff is amazing: kind, helpful,& friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Austin Dental Works for years and each visit has been great! The team is so friendly and professional. My appointments always start on time, and I’ve never had a surprise bill. I trust Dr. Jaros and have never felt pressured into any unnecessary procedures. The couple of fillings I have had have been super smooth, in and out appointments. I’ve referred most of my family to Austin Dental Works, and we’re all happy to have a dentist we love!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent!  Warm, welcoming, efficient, thorough, informative and they absolutely have their patients best interest as their priority!  This place is above and beyond in care!  Book with Austin Dental Works, you'll have no regrets. Dr. Jaros and her team are rock stars at what they do!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Gorgone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Jaros is the BEST. I’ve been going to her for 3 years or so and she’s fantastic. I trust her to provide the best care. Everyone in the office is super sweet and kind! I have referred many friends to Dr Jaros who all were blown away by how great she and the office are!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Medina
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dream team of experts!

We had just moved to town, with no dentist set up, and my crown popped off while I was eating on a Tuesday night. I needed the crown reattached asap so I called and left a voicemail at Austin Dental Works, that night.

Tiffanie called me as soon as they opened the next day, gave me options, and booked me for a 2pm appointment. I was willing to pay the quote at face value in order to get the crown reattached. She THEN managed to get our insurance on the phone before the appointment was over. Which ended up covering a portion of the visit, the cherry on top that this location qualified.

They made me feel like I had been a patient of theirs for years. Dr. Jaros was welcoming and quick. Then I was out of there! Highly recommend this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lydia Forsyth
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Good communication, quick in and out, the cleaning is nice, I have sensitive teeth and always dread the cold air and water, but here I don’t worry about that, one of the best cleaning experiences! Jessica was great with cleaning my teeth!

Adding on to this, Austin Dental Works continues to be the best dental experience I have had. Jeremiah cleaned my teeth today and it was so nice, my teeth are so sensitive and he was very good with making sure the cleaning was tailored to that. Also Sarah is always a joy to have clean my teeth and Dr
Jaros is so knowledgeable. I always feel so cared for here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved over to Austin Dental Works after a terrible experience at Swish. It's been a great experience each and every time I visit their office. Dr. Jaros and their team are detailed, kind and knowledgeable. Their office is efficient and clean and it's easy to make or change an appointment. I've been very happy with my move.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christianna Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was genuinely the best experience I've ever had at a dentist's. From scheduling to the actual appointment. The dentist was extremely gentle and told me everything that was happening before it did. She did a great job replacing a filling that fell out after seeing another dentist. The office was very clean and comfortable. The receptionist was so sweet and the aid was great! The entire team made me feel very comfortable and welcome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morgan Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are always so lovely and nice when I go in for appointments. They go the extra step!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zoja Ülesoo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Jaros is always wonderful but her assistant was amazing today (I wish I could remember her name)!

I have trauma from a motor vehicle accident which resulted in a broken jaw and several missing teeth, so the dentist is always a nerve-wracking experience. The team definitely made me feel at ease and checked in throughout the appointment to make sure I was okay both physically and emotionally. They answered all of my questions in detail and made sure I understood my treatment plan. I really appreciate them being so patient and thorough.

I definitely recommend this office if you have a fear of the dentist—they’re kind, compassionate, and knowledgeable.

Tiffanie at the front desk was super helpful and friendly too! Thanks for such a great visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Paul
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As a patient with plenty of dental anxiety, I would 10/10 recomend this practice to anyone. I already have! Everyone is kind, prompt, and gentle.
In previous reviews I've noticed complaints about "new unnecessary problems/payments."
I felt the exact opposite. I felt I was thoroughly examined, listened to, and well informed on what was suggested for my dental game plan.
If you want to feel comfortable and heard in a calm setting with an excellently trained (and happy!) staff, then make this your place. You won't regret it. Thanks ladies!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meridith Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend! Dr.Jaros and her team have resolved my dental anxiety! My anxiety prevented me from going to the dentist but everyone was kind in understanding this and judgment free. Baylee did a great cleaning and Dr.Jaros took care of my fillings (she was thoughtful and quickly efficient!). Everyone greeted me with a smile and with friendly presence and conversation that I no longer fear my visits and look forward to continuing great dental health with their care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Reino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for my first appointment as a new patient this week and had a great experience. The staff at the front desk were incredibly friendly and answered my questions about the new patient/cleaning process and what my insurance would cover. I expected to only have a diagnostic appointment (X-rays, scans, etc) but they offered me a cleaning right then and there, as well, due to some space in the schedule. Bailey did my cleaning and was incredible! Thorough, friendly, and welcoming. I am looking forward to returning in 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Derryck Peters
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Austin Dental Works for about 2 years now and I’ve gotta say that I’ve never met such a pleasant and friendly staff before. Everyone is constantly smiling and willing to talk to me the second I walk in the door. Even when I overhear conversations with other patients, the staff are very friendly and sociable. The atmosphere is extremely welcoming and comfortable for a place that most people (as far as I know) dread going to.

As far as dental work goes, my cleanings have been top-tier with little to no pain (basically no pain). The staff have also been very open with discussing my exams and providing helpful suggestions when I’ve needed work done. They walk me thru all possible scenarios so that I can make the best decisions for myself both with the actual dental work and far as insurance/payments go. I have never been surprised (negatively) about the dental work or financial aspects of my visits.

Overall, the Austin Dental Works staff is extremely professional and caring of all their patients. I have never had such a pleasant experience with dentist offices like I have with them and will be going there for all dental work for as long as I’m in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you’re reading this, then you, like I once was, are looking for a reasonable dentist in Austin. Luckily for you, your troubles are over. I’ve been a patient (customer?) of Austin Dental Works for the last three years, and it’s been a great experience. Dr. Jaros and her team are friendly and professional, and they make what otherwise would be an awful experience (who hasn’t had that dentist’s experience?) pleasant and stress-free.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kasper M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at ADW have been great to me - from Dr Jaros herself, to Tiffanie who is always up for answering all my questions and Sarah who recently made my periodontal therapy a breeze to get through. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camila Ugaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Austin Dental Works for 2 years, they really helped me get healthy, beautiful teeth! Staff is amazing, and Dr. Jaros is truly knowledgeable and cares deeply about her patients. I could not be happier with their service, 100% recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Arrivo
user_reviews_extended.Description: What an awesome group of people. Trust the amazing reviews and schedule your cleaning asap!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krystall Escobedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental hygienists, but Dr. Jaros is wildly heavy-handed. I've had cavities before, but I've never experienced such a painful filling - in fact none of my other fillings have ever been painful. If you expect to have any simple dental work completed, beyond a cleaning - do NOT go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlie Hare
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently visited Dr. Jaros' office for a few cavity fillings and my routine teeth cleaning, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. From the moment I walked in, Tiffanie at the front desk made me feel welcome and ensured everything was seamless.

Sarah, the dental hygienist, went above and beyond to make sure my cleaning was done thoroughly and gently. She took her time, addressing areas that had been overlooked in previous cleanings at other offices, which made a world of difference for me.

Dr. Jaros was incredibly thorough, patient, and kind throughout my visit. She explained everything in detail and made me feel completely at ease. Yulissa, the dental assistant, was also fantastic, providing great support during my treatment.

What truly stood out was the office’s willingness to offer alternative payment methods so I did not have to front several hundreds of dollars after having recently relocated to the city, making it easier to prioritize my oral care. The entire team, from Tiffanie to Dr. Jaros, Sarah, and Yulissa, was exceptional. As someone with VERY extreme anxiety when it comes to going to the dentist and absolutely HATES it - I highly recommend this office to anyone looking for top-notch dental care, literal angels as staff and clean/well maintained office and I will be making this location and team my home for regular visits moving forward!

I'd also like to note this is an honest first hand experience and review - I was not prompted or directly asked to leave a review which often happens with other offices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L Osborne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely my best dental experience. They are consistent, professional, and really kind. Bailey has been my hygienist for a couple of years and she is THE BEST. The entire staff is incredible. I moved from the area two years ago and I come back to the practice from across town (and out of state sometimes depending on the time of year). Cannot recommend them highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Moya Harmon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience here. Everyone is super nice. The best part is having Dr. Jaros come in fast after the hygienist is done. I’ve waited hours for some dentist before so that definitely won me over. They are all so sweet and will break everything down for you and share your options. Book your appointments today!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabbie aschim
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this team! I have had to go in for a lot of dental work recently and I have never had a bad experience. The entire team is so helpful, friendly, and professional. I used to have dental anxiety but now I feel totally comfortable going to the dentist and I even look forward to it because of how amazing my experience always is here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Marzan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Decided to finally make an appointment at Austin Dental Works after a few years of not seeing one. Super clean and comforting space. Everybody was amazing with their care. Yulissa was really accommodating and making sure I was good throughout the initial examination (I have slight dental anxiety). Dr. Jaros was also very helpful and knowledgeable about my teeth and what needed to be done with them. Lastly, Tiffanie (who’s at the front desk) was incredibly nice and helped me understand every charge that would be happening. It was only my first visit but it was a great first visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Barr
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros and the team are all fantastic! Sarah gave me the best cleaning I’ve ever had, no lie. So so so glad I switched to this practice! No long wait times, a very communicative team, no annoying papers to sign on every visit, and instant email post-appointment expectations — what else could you ask for?? Wow, amazing. ❤️🦷🙏🥳

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hector Jurado
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Jaros and her team are amazing. Super friendly, great communication of the entire process, explained everything as they were doing it. Felt super welcomed and not at all judged because of my less than perfect dental hygiene. I have a deep cleaning coming up so will review on that after treatment, but great first impression. Tiffanie at the front desk was super helpful, thorough, friendly and had a great personality. I felt like the prices were a little high but that was just out of ignorance, after i did a little research and found the exact treatment i was getting i found out that the prices are fair and even a little less than the average market price. Also, HUGE plus, they had The Office on the TV when i was there so I felt right at home !

user_reviews_extended.Name: salma dejesus
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here is absolutely amazing. I’ve never been to a dentist that cared so much for their clients. I have very sensitive teeth, and the hygienist and dentist are always super caring about my needs. They have always accommodated to my tight schedule as well. The staff here always makes me feel welcomed from the moment I walk in until the moment I leave. The quality of care and expertise here is the best I’ve seen thus far, and I’ve been to MANY different dentists prior to finding Austin dental works. Overall if you’re in search of a friendly and knowledgeable dentistry establishment, this is the place to go.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryce Livingston
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love this place! I usually feel really uncomfortable at the dentist, but Dr. Jaros was super good at explaining everything for my visit, and Bailey was super informative and good at making me feel comfortable during my cleaning! 10/10 would recommend!

10/12 UPDATED
Had to come back and say this place is still great. The whole staff! Bailey is always super professional and makes ya feel comfortable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathie Story-hewtty
user_reviews_extended.Description: The last dental visit I had elsewhere was a very painful and horrifying experience to where it left me with anxiety to go to a dentist, and because of that I hadn't been to a dentist in 2 or 3 years. Dr. Jaros and her assistant were very gentle and patient, didn't even feel the shots. She did a great job on informing me what she was going to do and answered my questions without me feeling like she was rushing. Kathryn did a very thorough job on cleaning, usually it's a little painful for me but I've been to her twice now for a cleaning and not once was it uncomfortable. The front desk coordinator's are very nice as well. Overall this was one of the best experience I've had going to a dentist and will definitely be coming back for all my future dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsey Coburn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely love going to Dr. Jaros and her staff! They have always been extremely friendly, responsive and knowledgeable. Dr. Jaros makes sure to always address all my concerns and thoroughly explains each and every one. Best of all they are always on time for your appointment, no long waiting to see your dentist!

I use to hate going to the dentist, but since finding Austin Dental Works I look forward to getting my teeth cleaned twice a year and the warm greetings their staff brings!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eli Cortez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just started as a new patient here and really happy so far! Dr. Jaros is really clear in setting treatment plans and also just sweet and kind in her practice. It’s a really welcoming environment and everyone who works there has been so nice to interact with! Highly recommend especially if you get a chance to snag that new patient deal on their website. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krissi Couture
user_reviews_extended.Description: I spent over $1,500 on two deep cleanings, and they did phenomenal work ... So I had asked them to zoom bleach my teeth and they refused ( because I have cavities in the back ) they told me they would not zoom bleach my teeth until I fill the cavities ( greedy ) that would have cost me another $1,500 to fill my cavities. I have done zoom bleaching before, and they only laser bleached the first six top and bottom teeth. So then when I went up for my follow-up for my deep cleaning they gave the appointment to somebody else. I wasted time, I missed money from work, and I took a Lyft and they gave my appointment to someone else. I will not be returning to them ever again 👎 very unprofessional and greedy 👎

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura P (Zoetic)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros and her staff are amazing! The ladies at the front desk are great at working with your schedule and making sure insurance is set up right for your appointment. The dental assistants are very professional and will make sure you're comfortable while they do x-rays and get impressions of your teeth. Today I saw Bailey, the dental hygienist, and she did a very thorough job cleaning my teeth. I highly recommend everyone in this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Batya Porter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros and her team are AMAZING! They are always super patient with me, as someone with horrible reflex. A special shoutout to Marlene and the ladies at the front desk- they are super patient with scheduling over the phone and take their time to find an appointment that best fits your needs. I would highly recommend Austin Dental Works to anyone looking for great customer service and squeaky clean teeth 🦷

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike McIntyre
user_reviews_extended.Description: Valentina was friendly and gentle and truly cares. Dr Jaros is equally awesome & Tiffany too. They’re efficient,  thorough & very respective of time constraints. Excellent experience & my new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zach Hooks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very happy with Austin Dental Works. Dr. Jaros is very knowledgeable and takes the time to explain everything thoroughly. I’m also impressed with their communication before the appointment. There were several automated appointment reminders and Tiffanie went out of her way to check with my insurance and let me know exactly how much my co-pay would be in advance. 5 Stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Warmate
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional atmosphere with a warm and friendly staff. Dr. Jaros takes excellent care of her patients! I recommend her to everyone I know!!!  I have a perfect smile!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susie Salce
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you care about your dental health go see Dr. Jaros. My overall oral care has improved vastly via her recommendations and I could not be happier. I am someone who is super nervous going to see any dentist but every time I come here I feel very relaxed in knowing that the entire staff has my back. The staff in the front are informative, knowledgeable and always kind. I found Dr. Jaros through the same reviews you are reading so I hope this helps your decision.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Provenzano
user_reviews_extended.Description: From start to finish I had a wonderful and positive experience with Dr. Jaros. I’ve seen several dentists since I moved to Austin last year and I just didn’t feel comfortable with any of them. A friend recommended me to Austin Dental Works and I’m so glad they did! The entire staff was kind, professional and thorough. Not to mention, the office was extremely clean and vibrant. It sounds strange to say, but I can’t wait to go back and see Dr. Jaros and her amazing team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Rubin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have a positive experience at Austin Dental Works! They have super friendly and professional staff, they are quick and efficient with procedures and cleanings, and Dr. Jaros is really nice and knowledgeable. It’s hard to find a dentist to trust because you never know if they are trying to get more work done than you need, but Dr. Jaros is always forthcoming with information needed to make the best decision possible for the situation at hand. I trust her and the entire staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vincent Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros are her staff are helpful, friendly, and make going to the dentist a good experience. As someone who has hated going to the dentist, I feel very comfortable coming here with all my dental needs, and know I'm in capable hands with Dr. Jaros. I've had a lot of work done here over the last couple years and highly recommend it! The staff make you feel welcome and get to know you as a person, so it doesn't feel like I'm just another patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Blair
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great year with Austin Dental Works.  I say "year" because I'm not a low touch patient, and needed a fair bit of work.  Dr. Jaros is extremely thorough, kind, and sensitive to your needs. Most importantly she's very good at her job. This leadership shows clearly through all the staff as they've all been fantastic. Cleanings have been great and painless, and Tiffanie at the front desk is a joy to work with. BY FAR the best Dentist office I've ever been to, and I simply can't rate them highly enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan Kelt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I used to hate going to the dentist but Dr. Jaros and her team do a wonderful job. I always feel incredibly comfortable and welcomed. Shout out to Baylee for being super detailed with my cleanings. I recommend highly…love the complimentary whitening kit too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: T. Porter
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My fiance and I have been coming here for the last year, and Dr. Jaros and her staff have been nothing but amazing. Very friendly and helpful people! They'll recommend treatment if they see you may need it, but they won't pressure you to get it done.

This last appointment, I got a composite filling re-done because some of the composite material wore off after 5 years (likely due to me grinding my teeth at night), and I felt very comfortable during the entire process.

I would definitely recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geri Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Jaros could not  be more personable and comfortable to be with. I felt completely at ease from the moment we met. She’s incredibly confident and seems to have state-of-the-art equipment. She surrounds herself with talented and excellent staff . I highly recommend her and her great team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am beyond happy with Austin Dental Works. I was so nervous about getting my fillings done because I've had some bad experiences with getting them before. Once I expressed how nervous I was, they were super empathetic and made sure I was comfortable the whole time. Yes the numbing shots were not fun but the doctor made it as bearable as possible, which I appreciate so much. They asked me how I was doing throughout the whole ordeal, explaining each step in detail and stopping to numb me more once they saw my teeth were still too sensitive. My last dentist didn't do that when I told him I was still sensitive so the entire process was painful, so I'm so happy to have found a dentist that cares. It means a lot. I highly recommend going here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Wilcox
user_reviews_extended.Description: Office and staff are great! I don’t favor going to dentist appointment, but from the questionnaire asking about my comfortability / anxiety with dentist , to the first greet at the front desk. Everyone is amazing. Highly recommend coming here !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Goodwin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a fantastic experience at Austin Dental Works.  Dr. Jaros was extremely nice and knowledgeable, and took the time to show me detailed pictures of the things she saw and explain how treatment and routine care could help slow damage to these areas. As a physician myself, I was quite impressed as this level of care is becoming more rare with increased demands these days.  Even took the time to go through all of the charges with me ahead of time and how much insurance was going to cover to make sure I didn't have any questions.  Everyone from the front desk to the dental hygienist were extremely professional.  Would absolutely recommend Austin Dental Works!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Crissy Hager Bowler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best dental experience ever! Everyone in the office is friendly professional and respectful. Everything was explained to me before hand including the billing, which is quite reasonable. My cleaning was painless and thorough. I look forward to my next appointment, Excellent!
Both my husband and I are patients from now on!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savanna Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly HIGHLY recommend Austin Dental Works. I’ve been able to overcome dentist anxiety being a patient here bc everyone is so nice and careful with how they explain and do things. Bailey is the best— she is detail oriented and so friendly. I trust Dr Jaros’ professionalism and recommendations. Thank you to this team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika Polner
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is really special in the care it provides to its patients. From the very start, their New Patient form gives you the opportunity to disclose any bad experiences you've had with dentists in the past, so that they can be conscientious in providing a welcoming and safe environment for your visits. Everyone is very kind, from the desk staff, to the hygienists and Dr. Jaros herself. I was recommended this office from a friend after moving to Austin, and I'm so glad I was! It can be hard enough around here to find offices that are accepting new patients, so to find one that was able to see me right away AND provide a high standard of care was such a gift.

user_reviews_extended.Name: H P
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is amazing!!
Dr. Jaros and the entire staff are so friendly and awesome!
Going to the dentist can be intimidating for some, but everyone here is so great about answering any questions/concerns you might have about treatments or procedures.
I really appreciate the time they take to put you at ease.
I always leave feeling great about my dental care!!  I highly recommend  them!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Giulia Restrepo
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit was great! The staff were efficient and friendly. The office itself is clean and nicely decorated. They seem to have high quality equipment in place. Dr. Jaros was thorough in her explanations of what treatment was appropriate for me and made sure my questions were answered. To top it all off, the new patient special included whitening trays!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Ferrell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Seriously the nicest, most helpful dental professionals I have ever met! I hadn’t been to the dentist/hygienist in 3 years (I chose this place because of the wonderful reviews) and they definitely live up to the hype! Every person on their team is welcoming, warm, and kind! I had to get my first filling ever with them and the process was completely painless, easy, and efficient! Not to mention the hygienist does an absolutely stellar job; my teeth have never felt/looked this good after a cleaning! If you need/want to switch to a new dentistry office I highly recommend Austin Dental Works!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cem Özdemir
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It has been more than 2 years with Austin Dental Works. Dr. Jaros is so professional at her job. There is no problem that she cannot fix. Whenever I have hard time with my teeth, she is there to help and get it done. I got all my fillings an a nice crown here.

Tiffanie, the Financial Coordinator, she is amazing. Whenever my insurance caused some problem of paying my scaling, she fought hard and let them pay it. Apart from that, she is so kind and thoughtful. This place cares about your well-being

Finally, I want to thank my dental hygenist, Baylee. She helps keep my teeth clean and healthy every couple of months. She is super careful with her job. I am always super satisfied with my dental cleanings.

I am happy with this place and I would recommend it to anyone. Do not hesitate to come here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: HBL
user_reviews_extended.Description: Outstanding experience. Communicated well for pre-appointment details - easy process to upload all the insurance / background info. Super friendly front-office staff. Hygienist was conversational and friendly. Doctor was informative and friendly as well. Very clean office. Also showed photos of the teeth on a TV screen in front of me to educate me / walk through everything going on teeth wise. Will be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yasmina Fawaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Austin Dental Works! Bailey has a gentle touch and is always attentive to my needs. The front staff is kind and helpful which makes insurance questions less stressful. Finally, Dr. Jaros is amazing, she always explains exactly what’s happening with my care and doesn’t make me feel like she’s in a rush to leave the room. Overall ADW is one of the best dental practices I’ve gone to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janna Lusk
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So relaxing to sit back in the chair while Dr. Jaros chats calmly, gives the occasional feedback about what she's doing to my teeth, and plays music in the background. She's excellent at giving injections, never mentions when I haven't waxed my chin, and  gives great detail about her treatment. I've already had 2 crowns put in and 2 more to go. No issues with pain or results. The whole staff are lovely and likable.

Yes, go to this dentist. Just trust me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Izzy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m someone who hadn’t been to the dentist in years and so to walk into a new one in a new city for me and be greeted with such warmth and insight and knowledge in a competent non judgmental atmosphere has been such a blessing and my whole experience had been made easy because of the attention to detail and kind guidance along the way. I will definitely be recommending them to anyone I know who needs to find a dentist their whole team are warm knowledgeable people who also stay in touch throughout any procedure as to how you are feeling about whatever they are doing. Very appreciative I found out about them through a friend who had also gone to see them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Leszczynska
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my initial appointment with Dr. Jaros today and had a great experience. The staff takes photos of each tooth and Dr. Jaros reviews every single one with you! That’s a lot of teeth! 🙂 She is very sweet and did a very thorough job reviewing my treatment plan. Her staff was awesome too! They were able to fit me in for a cleaning today so I don’t have to come back twice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie
user_reviews_extended.Description: A million stars! This place is a god send. I hadn't been to the dentist in about 7 years (gross I know) cause I was so anxious based on previous experiences. Even on the intake forms they're asking you what you want from the appt and what they can do to make it a good experience for you. They talked me through everything they were gonna do and gave me options, they explained everything to me from what's going on in my mouth to what my insurance will/won't cover, and never made me feel ashamed or embarrassed of how long it has been since I got a cleaning. The woman who did my cleaning was incredibly patient and sweet. I had obviously made her job a lot harder since I had years of build up so she really had to work at it but never made me feel bad. It was painful but she let me chose a show to watch to distract me and encouraged me saying I was doing amazing and told me I could tell her to stop if I needed a break. The woman at reception was so kind and understanding. She never seemed annoyed when she had to go back and check if something was covered by my insurance and even volunteered to send things in to get a pre estimate for a service so I could know the cost for me upfront. I could keep going with all the interactions I had with multiple members of the staff there but pretty sure they're just all amazing. The communication is top tier and you're treated like a real person, not just another patient to make money off of. I cannot recommend or thank them enough!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carlos Solis
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time at Austin dental works since moving from Houston, all I can say is the staff was very welcoming as soon as you walk thru the door you are greeted and was checked in right away. The dentist even took the time to explain everything that was going on while the examination and teeth cleaning was happening. This was the first time in 30+ yrs of going to the dentist that I was actually shown pictures and explained everything about my teeth. Couldn’t be happier with this visit and they will be my go to Dentist here in Austin from now on!.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Shoutout to my hygienist, Sarah!
Everyone here has been kind and knowledgeable. The process was smooth sailing and I was clearly walked through every step of the billing and insurance. Going to the dentist felt more relaxing and less clinical than it usually does. The best part: no long waits!

user_reviews_extended.Name: nikncutt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for years and have had an amazing experience. I used to have receding gums, jaw pain, and a snaggle tooth. I don’t have any of these now, thanks to Austin Dental works.  The hygienists are always very responsive and friendly, the front desk staff remembers who I am every time, and Dr. Jaros is such a patient & professional provider.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen “Kathy” Constant
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit. I will say they were very communicative prior to my appointment with emails and texts for pre-appointment paperwork, as well as appointment reminders. I appreciate an office that make the effort to get what they need in advance so I don't spend 20 minutes filling out forms on my first visit. At my appointment, the staff were all very friendly, efficient, and informative.  I found Dr. Jaros personable and she made me feel at ease (not always easy when someone is poking around in your mouth!) . A thorough assessment was done, options discussed, and a plan was mapped out for the work I need. I left with a very positive feeling.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evan S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Jaros is awesome and super friendly ! Took plenty of time to answer my questions review x rays and photos and gum line recession and brushing habits and dental history. They got me in quickly for a cancelled appt by chance after new consult.  I must have been lucky today! but the dental hygenist was excellent too! Great experience. Bonus points for the spa like atmosphere of a waiting room. Happy to be with a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: King B
user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone who have been in and out of multiple dentist office, I can honestly say I had a very pleasant experience with Austin Dental Works. The staff are  friendly, and welcoming, I had little to no wait time, the dentist and the assistants made everything that was being done easy to understand and showed that they are exceptionally knowledgeable about dentistry. overall I highly recommend this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cody McLeland
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Dr. Jaros for all my dentistry needs for a while and have always had a good experience. The staff is always friendly and pleasant to interact with, and I always find myself getting seen and taken care of faster than I could have imagined. I'd recommend this office any time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Conner Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Dental Works is the best dentist I’ve ever been to. The attention to detail, clear billing information, friendly hygienists, and modern technology made my visit a breeze. Can’t recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Saffell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros and her staff at Austin Dental Works are the nicest dental team I’ve ever met. They will make sure you are comfortable and feel safe during your visit. I used to avoid going to the dentist unless it was an emergency, but now I’m going for regular cleanings and check ups because it’s such a great experience, one I no longer dread.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ebony Rios
user_reviews_extended.Description: Incredible staff, Dr. Jaros is warm and made me super comfortable. I highly recommend Austin Dental Works ✨

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Neal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Austin Dental Works since I moved to Austin 3 years ago and its the best decision I ever made. I honestly never liked going to the dentist. But Dr. Jarros and the entire staff make the process super comfortable, quick and easy. I like to make appointments during my lunch break from work and they always have me in an out in a timely manner. I would recommend them to all my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darren Chambless
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Dental Works is awesome! Been going here a couple of years now, and have always had a great experience. Dr. Jaros is easy to talk to, professional, and cares about her patients. The staff and dentists are so nice and do a great job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dylan Harrison
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient of Austin Dental Works for almost a year now and am super happy I chose this place as my usual dentist when I moved to Austin! Dr. Jaros and her team do a great job at explaining everything in detail and everyone is super friendly. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to get dental work done in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Florence
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Convenient location. Office was clean, staff was very nice and helpful. My visit was quick and easy. I will go back again.

UPDATE: I have since been back for several cleanings as well as a crown. Everything has been smooth, no issues. They did a great job with the crown.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sagar Ghimire
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience! I had my fillings and gum therapy done professionally and efficiently. The staff and the dentist all know their job very well and make the experience of going to a dental office very smooth and pleasant! I feel like eveyone at this office really cares, and it makes a huge difference! Fancy that. ✌️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bridgit Giedeman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff at ADW were welcoming, professional and just downright sweet! This was my third visit. I'm beginning to feel like family!  The service was impeccable and effective. My teeth have never felt or looked better! Dr. J is very well educated and a blessing to TX!

I highly recommend this business!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassidy Driskell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great first experience here! All parts of the appointment were very thorough - the exam, X-rays and photos, cleaning and dental plan. During the exam they took plenty of time to explain what was needed or could potentially be needed at each tooth. The cleaning was painless, and informative. Made sure that I understood what was going on and how to continue good practices to prevent further damage! For long term dental plans they had multiple options to show price points and were understanding and willing to help with any and all questions about the payment process. Great group of professionals here and would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Iker Urquiola
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff was super knowledgeable, friendly, and patient. They provided me with information and an update about my cleaning from my first visit to my second visit and how things were progressing. Both times I was seated right at my appointment time and the wait was almost non existent. I’d highly recommend visiting Dr. Jaros and Austin Dental Works if you’re looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cole Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time back at the dentist after a while and had a lovely experience with Dr. Jaros and her team.  Dr. Jaros was very knowledgeable and was great at explaining everything we went through.  Tiffanie at the front desk was a pleasure to talk with and helped me with understanding my insurance coverage.  I’ll definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elliott Boswell
user_reviews_extended.Description: We had to find a new dentist upon moving to Austin and I'm so glad we found Austin Dental Works! From the first phone call through the first appointment, everybody has been wonderfully friendly and professional. All of the new patient forms were easy to do online prior to arriving and the web/mobile follow up are very appreciated. An easy recommendation!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Maldonado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was very happy with this practice, very nice and professional staff . Turned out great. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Se,Veyon Willis-Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros was great at educating me on what I needed to know while she was providing service. I had to get several fillings done and she would explain the process, even the small details to what she was doing so I knew what was going on and the why behind it. No other dentist has been honest about the process and treated me with such care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anita Lam
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Anna was my hygienist today. I really appreciate that she lets me know ahead of time the area she was going to work on. She was very gentle and made sure she checked on me in sensitive areas.
Dr. Jaros is great as usual. Authentically nice.
I love this place. Clean, minimal, no fuss, convenient location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neek Razavi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been to a few dentists within the Austin area and I have to say Dr. Jaros and her team (especially Ali) were excellent. They were quick and prompt on getting me in and treated.
It speaks volumes when someone explains everything that’s going on with your treatment, what is needed to be done and why (with the help of pictures) in a clear and concise manner.

Looking forward to my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Wells
user_reviews_extended.Description: Efficient, very welcoming, professional. They really made me feel comfortable and informed about my dental treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Dr. Jaros since I moved to austin 4 years ago. She is the best - I recommend her to all my friends and I actually love going to the dentist. All the hygienists are so friendly too. I love everyone there!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kendall Naft
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience! Everyone is so friendly and my appointments have all been on time and efficient. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Goodwin
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Austin dental works! I started in Austin like many, moving here from my home town and neglected dental work during the pandemic. I tried a few of the “trendy chain-like dentists” and felt like I was being SOLD vs cared for. That all changed when I found dr Jarvis and Austin dental works. From the first interaction with Tiffanie who is so caring and on top of it-  to the techs, Sarah & Baylee, and dr Jarvis herself, we couldn’t be happier! My boyfriend and I remarked tonight how well run they are. We’ve never had an unexpected bill. The offer full transparency, excellent care, and put us as patients first, instead of us as money! Big big fans. Thank you guys for all you do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Long
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would rather walk over hot coals than go to the dentist.  Honestly.  But Dr Jaros and her staff always make me feel comfortable.  Check-in at the front desk with Tiffany was quick and friendly.  Cleaning with the hygienist Bailey was painless and comfortable.  Exam with Dr Jaros put me at ease.  We discussed what treatment I needed and she was patient, kind and so knowledgeable.  If you have to see a dentist ( and we all do at some point ) give Austin Dental Works a try. You'll be glad you did!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vivian Pepper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands-down the best Dentist office in Austin!  The staff is always friendly, accommodating and delightful to interact with. Dr. Hap is an excellent, thorough dentist with a dry sense of humor that I find very amusing. He has helped me and several situations And was so nice. He gives me useful information to improve my dental hygiene. I would highly suggest anyone looking for a new dentist to go here. Vivian p

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessie Marie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros and her team are amazing. I would definitely recommend this place to get your dental needs done. I always leave here with a positive attitude 🤗 I also would like to say that the front desk ladies are all Cool and always Welcome me with a big smile! 😁 Thank you for all you do!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dewy Brooks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very pleasant experience. Although this was my first time there, the staff, the hygienist  and Dr. Jaros made me feel very comfortable from the moment I entered the waiting room through to the end of my procedure.  During my procedure I felt very relaxed and comfortable with the hygienist and Dr Jaros.   The staff, the hygienist and Dr Jaros were friendly and very professional. I would highly recommendation this office to anyone for any dental care they may need. Looking forward to my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jason smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff that is nice and also knowledgeable is hard to find, probably because they all work here at this office. Everyone seemed happy to be there. It was refreshing. The place was exceptionally clean, and they had all the newest gear to make things as comfortable as possible. This is some very high quality technology. If I could be asleep while they work, it would be the only way to improve my experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Odem
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic group!  First time at the office  - staff was super friendly and Dr. Jaros was delightful. Looking forward to my next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Opramolla
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had such a great experience here. Every single person--from Dr. Hap to the assistants to the receptionists--was professional, personable, and welcoming. They answered all of my questions and did everything possible to make it a pleasant dental visit.

I'd recommend highly to anyone in the area.

(Oh, and Tool and Blink 182 were playing in the waiting room, so that's an even better plus.)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim Hess
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a great dental office!  I was a new patient, but the process was quick and easy -- just fill out a few forms online, which took all of 5 minutes.  When I showed up to the office, I was greeted by the friendly staff, who showed me to the dentist's chair.  The hygienist and dentist both explained everything that they were doing and went over any of my concerns.  Best of all, in and out in under an hour!  Definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Schumacher
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience at Austin Dental! The staff were friendly, professional, and efficient, and Dr. Jaros, Sarah and Yulissa provided thorough and gentle care. Highly recommend this practice for your dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sydney Treviño-Hiler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient here for a few years now and have never had a bad experience.  The staff are caring and knowledgeable. I love that they are willing to work with your schedule. I’ve never had a problem scheduling, rescheduling or canceling an appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: XuanHuong Pham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Hap Nguyen is very courteous and professional. I received thorough examination and was presented with a good plan of treatment. The staff is very pleasant and makes me feel welcome and comfortable.
The appointments were made quickly and timely reminded.
The dental procedures were done skillfully with minimum pain which made me comfortable.
He is our family dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morgan Neal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is nice and friendly, until they try to hit you with highway robbery.

They scheduled me for only exams and x-rays, and then wanted me to reschedule to comeback AFTER and get a teeth cleaning; where do they do that at? I work for a living and honestly had they told me that upfront, I wouldn't have scheduled with them.

They tried to charge me $1200 for an "advanced gingivitis cleaning,"  (which I have never had dental issues with in my life) and when I declined they refused me any service.

Hate that I cannot support an all women modernized practice, but these women are only here to get paid, and not to help. Don't let the "cool vibes" fool you.

Please be wise and choose somewhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keoki Stauber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a friendly and professional staff all around! Tiffany is fantastic and able to fit me in on such short notice, I will be a repeated customer here for sure! Thank you Austin Dental Works and Dr. Jaros for the accommodation!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Matz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone here is so nice and welcoming! Dr. Jaros is extremely patient and friendly, and her positivity filters through the entire experience. The schedulers are accommodating and personable, and you really feel like everyone wants to help as much as they can.

Can’t recommend enough!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: P K
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this place.  Friendly and professional.  Dr. Jaros answers my questions with patience and kindness. Baylee is my dental hygienist and she is amazing -always giving me tips on how to improve my dental care at home!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Waguespack
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros is the best! I have had bad dental anxiety my whole life. Dr. Jaros and her team make me so comfortable it has made going to the dentist an enjoyable experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nora Sawyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome place. I have seen dentists in multiple states and this practice is by far the best! Literally the kindest people work here and it’s very clear that they work well together. Dr.Jaros is super direct and helpful in explaining everything. I would have all my family members go here if they lived closer!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leesey Suggs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quick and effcient visit during Covid. The office had me complete paperwork by phone & computer to avoid a wait. I was taken directly back when I arrived at the office to dive into my exam. All of the staff including the Dr. Jaros took their time to explain each step of the exam. My teeth are fresh after my cleaning which I was able to squeeze in before work. I will be back to pick up my whitening trays soon. Super excited! (:

user_reviews_extended.Name: June Silva
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit with Dr Jaros went great, positive vibes from the whole team. I had a cleaning done and got fitted for whitening trays, free whitening for life special going on how could you not take advantage of this deal! Office was clean and modern. I can’t wait till my next check in with Austin Dental Works!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Liu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Hap and everyone at the clinic were extremely nice.
My resin cavity fill looks great (can't tell it apart from my real tooth) and Dr. Hap was very attentive to the patients' comfort level throughout the whole procedure.
Highly recommended for people that are scared of dental visits as Dr. Hap is a very reassuring and patient dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend Dr. Jaros and team. Clean office, great staff, up to date equipment and they make it really easy to schedule/reschedule. My teeth have never felt so clean and cared for. Nothing scary about this dentist! I'd leave 6 stars if possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Gates
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros and staff were so comforting when I went in to get my first fillings. I was a little nervous and everyone did what they could to understand and comfort me, always checking in on me through the whole process, which made it very pleasant, even though my mouth was getting drilled in. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience and a great new dentist here in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A A
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is such an amazing dental office. I’ve been to other dental offices and nothing compares to the friendliness and attention to detail Austin Dental Works has! Got some dental bonding + gum therapy and this place made me feel comfortable. Every single person from the front desk to the back of the house has been professional and have made my experience really great. SO THANK YOU ALL.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Louis DeLone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Jaros is a great dentist. Her office is well organized and you feel very comfortable. The big TV screens in front of every chair are great. I recommend Austin Dental Works every chance I get.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Almond
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience I have ever had! Both Sarah and Dr. Jaros were phenomenal. Queana (hygiene coordinator) was incredibly responsive and helpful as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J. Abel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Needlessly lost a molar to decay, though had been under Dr. Janos’s care very recently. New to area, had had no previous dental issues, own teeth. Surprised with unexpected pain over a weekend. Dr Janos very attentive, but unnecessary added aggravation & cost.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyra Seay
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the team you want caring for your teeth! It's such a welcoming atmosphere and the dentist (and her team) truly dedicated to making sure I have the best experience and care. I've struggled with migraines for years with no medical explanation until one of the dental assistants here explained why that might be happening that I was able to seek help. Who knew my teeth held the answer? I'll forever be grateful. I love going here. Don't forget to ask  about their teeth whitening program- seriously theyre the best dentist in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Errol Neider
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Hap and his staff are extremely caring and accommodating.  The prices are fair and reasonable; the explanations are transparent and thorough.    Dr. Hap truly cares about my dental health, and he has a passion for what he does - He gets excited about being helpful.
And, he laughs at my jokes...that's good customer service!
I highly recommend Dr. Hap's services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norelia Wiggans
user_reviews_extended.Description: The most wonderful dentist for me and my family. He was the only one who successfully treated our sleep apnea. He is always very nice and concerned about your health. The staff is also great in making appointments and doing cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peter Hofstad
user_reviews_extended.Description: My hygienist was very friendly, thorough and knowledgeable. I have a little anxiety about going to the dentist but he was calm and reassuring. The Dr. was also kind and extremely helpful. My teeth feel great and so do I.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Dental Works is great! I’ve been going here for years and the entire staff is friendly and helpful. Dr. Jaros is has come in and improved the practice since the old dentist left. Definitely recommended if you’re looking for a new dentist in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trung Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Getting dental work has always been a fear of mine. However, Austin Dental Works has completely changed my mind. The entire staff is super friendly and knowledgeable. I completely trust this place and strongly recommend them. Thank you for all you do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Braun
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Austin dental works for almost 4 years now and always get the highest level of care. I am in and out for cleanings within 30 minutes and always feel that doctor Jaros and the hygienists (which could also be an incredible band name) are honest, helpful and concise about any next steps. Couldn’t be happier!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jo Jo Cortright
user_reviews_extended.Description: dr jaros and her team are so kind and do an amazing job!! i definitely recommend them if you’re kind of anxious about going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lily Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Walked in as a new patient today and by far was the best experience I’ve had at a dentist. Tiffanie communicated before the appointment what the cost would be so there are no surprise payments. Everyone was friendly, made me comfortable and are professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Dental works is a great dental office in all aspects. From the highly professional, kind and organized front desk to the skilled, caring and efficient dental staff. Dr. Jaros uses the latest technologies to alleviate pain and discomfort and explains what to expect before, during and after procedures. She is ably assisted by really smart and capable dental technicians. I highly recommend using Austin Dental Works for your family's dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Restrepo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I very much enjoyed my experience at austin Dental Works. Dr. Jaros very professional and caring when it came to informing me and performing my filling. She was also very quick and thorough in the procedure. I highly recommend and plan on remaining a customer here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Holley
user_reviews_extended.Description: An incredible office! Dr. Jaros is a skilled, kind dentist that has treated me with respect during every appointment. The staff are also lovely. Even more impressive is that I’ve never waited more than 3 minutes to see a hygienist or Dr. Jaros. I couldn’t recommend Dr. Jaros and Austin Dental Works more!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Fish
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands-down best dental experience I've had.  The staff members are really nice and Dr Nap was very very thourough. I knew every step of the way what was going on. They even had an adjustable overhead TV for you to watch while they work.  I literally Netflixed and chilled! Definitely coming back here every six months to get my regular cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luke Huston
user_reviews_extended.Description: Typically you would feel extremely wary and uncomfortable during a cleaning of the gums.  Kathy at Austin Dental Works made sure that wasn't the case.  She continuously checked on me and ensured my visit was as comfortable as possible.  One more visit to get the other half cleaned up and I have no worries whatsoever.  I highly recommend this place for your dental needs.  Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Conrad
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wish I could give this place 0 stars, first of all they overcharge and second, you pay when you are in office and then they will charge you again later. I paid over $100 for a teeth cleaning with insurance and the charged me again after I already paid in office.

It happened to both my roommate and I & we have different insurance. If you want to get scammed, go to Austin Dental Works!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Bradshaw
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't express what a great experience I had. I hadn't been to the dentist in 7 years, and I was very self-conscious about my overcrowding and staining. Not only did everyone in the office treat me kindly, but we came up with a comprehensive plan to address every single one of my concerns. Thank you so much, Austin Dental Works!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lissette Negron
user_reviews_extended.Description: What impressed me the most was the excellence in customer service. Everyone is so pleasant and they seem to enjoy their job and that reflects on their service. Dr. Jaros was so attentive. I like that she provided options and it gave me hope that my issue will be resolved. I came all the way from Elgin and I am happy I did.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily List Gray
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Austin Dental Works, Dr. Jaros, and her staff. Every experience has been over the top pleasant. From first visit, to fillings (x2), to routine cleaning. They are so friendly and informative, make the whole experience comfortable, quick, and easy, and the location is bright and clean. They kind of make you feel like a celebrity lol

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bagus Hanindhito
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros is awesome and very friendly. My first visit was great; she performed x-ray and gave me thorough explanation on what procedures should I expect in the next visits. Her team also great and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Matt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updated review...

If you have dental insurance and you aren't bothered by getting unnecessary dental procedures this office is for you. 👌

I realized this dental office was hustling me. I had never had any problems with my teeth. I had been getting cleanings regularly my whole adult life. Then I came to Austin Dental Works and upon my second cleaning visit they suddenly "found" some cavities to fill... I later realized that these could have been super small cavities that didn't really need to be filled and could have gone away with regular fluoride rinsing... or I never actually had any cavities in the first place. I was naive, having moved to Austin from a small town. I thought all dentists were honest. I later did my research and found out there are a lot of ways to charge for unnecessary dental work if an office wants to put profits first.

I looked around and I found a German trained dentist in Austin that was known to be conservative and recommended for patients who do not have dental insurance and can't afford unnecessary dental procedures. Lo and behold, I have not had any "cavities" since switching to this dentist, even if I skip a few biannual cleanings in a row.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Britt Dobson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros is a wonderful dentist! The facility is clean, staff are friendly and you never feel pressured into optional services. My teeth have never looked better - thanks Austin Dental Works!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marta Leboeuf
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lindsay Jaros and staff are great on the service they provide to their patients.  I have been a patient since 2021.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hillary Kruger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was really nice. I had a cavity filled and it was pain free--even the part when they inject the numbing medication, which is notoriously awful. They were really clear when explaining costs. The facility was also really clean and up to date. I'm glad I decided on them for my dental care in austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathania Morehead
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros is the best dentist I have had in my 65 years of life. She is exceptional in her ability to put you at ease, minimize pain, and ensure a perfect outcome. I recommended her to someone seeking a new dentist, and he is now a happy and satisfied patient of Dr. Jaros.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Mullins
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit at Austin Dental Works. Great experience from making the appointment to walking in and being seen by the dentist and her staff. Very friendly and professional. Definitely glad I made the choice to give them a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: christian glakas
user_reviews_extended.Description: dr. Jaros and her team are awesome!  Super friendly, very professional, on time, and they make the insurance part of it SUPER easy.  Can’t recommend them highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A. Perkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have a huge fear of the dentist but Dr. Jaros and her  staff have been wonderful.  Earlier this year she removed both top wisdom teeth then in July I had to have 2 root canals done and even though I was in pain at times they still made this a very enjoyable experience I was able to be seen within 48hrs or less  and never did I have long wait times or felt rushed and I'm a huge baby when it comes to the dentist.  I drive from Elgin to see her and will continue she's just that good.   Big Thanks to Dr. Jaros and her staff🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: melissa Pemberton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros and her staff were so friendly and helpful. I went in with tooth pain and they quickly evaluated the situation and were able to fix it the same day. Dr. Jaros took the time to explain everything to me and checked throughout the procedure how I was doing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordona Jackson Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in to the office with sunburned lips. I thought maybe I should cancel the appointment but I decided not to. The staff and Dr. Jaros we're awesome. They were super gentle and careful, which I appreciated. I'd definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Brynes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would absolutely recommend Austin Dental Works to anyone looking for quality dental care and outstanding patient relations. Dr. Nguyen is an outstanding dentist and I really enjoy the time he takes to explain your dental procedures and talk you through your x-ray results. His attention to patient care really makes coming here an enjoyable experience. The dental hygienists are all kind, professional, and attentive to patients' needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: hinh gia dinh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been to lots of dentists in Austin but Dr. Hap is the best dentist I have ever seen. I cannot be happiner after many years cannot enjoy food, now I can able to eat anything I want to. Dr. Hap and his dental staffs are incredibly professional, caring, and kind. I am extremely satisfied with their service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sunny Griffin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely amazing! I was a bit afraid to go back to Austin Dental Works once Dr. Hap left BUT....the new Doctor and Hygienist are awesome! I’m really happy that I went back. They even gave me options for further dental procedures that I need done. Thanks ladies for the amazing job its much appreciated!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Shropshire
user_reviews_extended.Description: The all time most wonderful experience I have ever had and it was a three hour non stop experience repairing my 2 front upper teeth after a slam dunk first time face plant onto concrete on Saturday at age 77. Dr Jaros and her assistant had me totally fixed up with my temporary bridge by Monday afternoon.  Nothing short of a miracle. I'm not from here. I'm from Georgia and I may just have to fly here from now on for my care. The cost was very reasonable for the extensive work and care she provided. Her assistant was also excellent. A great tem who communicated well with each other. Austin you have a dental star team in your midst. USE THEM❣👍😁😁😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Duvic
user_reviews_extended.Description: My previous dentist left practice. Unfortunately I experienced tooth pain and had to find a replacement quickly. Dr. Jaros made time in her busy schedule, diagnosed my problem, and arranged for treatment. The staff were friendly and helpful.  I now have a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rojina Aldib
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Hap does very detailed and gentle work. They have the best technology, he explained the before and after results with me very patiently. I've done many fillings here and all the staff was professional and discussed every step with me before taking action. On my last appointment Dr.Hap didn't charge me for two special technics of numbing, it was very kind and considerate of him. Also, they gave my boyfriend a gift card to Starbucks for referring me to them. Highly recommend Austin dental works.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Hulse
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have been seeing Dr. Hap for years. I had an implant put in and multiple cavities filled with Dr. Hap. I see him for all my cleanings. Every visit has been pleasant, as pleasant as it can be with getting a cavity filled. Dr. Hap is very through and pays very close attention to detail. He always shows me pictures of my teeth before and after I've gotten work done. I highly recommend Dr. Hap for any dental work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Jaime
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely loved the atmosphere!! Dr. Jaros and her staff are amazing. Everyone was so helpful, kind, and professional!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barret
user_reviews_extended.Description: I started here when Dr Hap ran the practice, and transitioned over to Dr Jaros after he left Austin. Dr Hap is an amazing dentist, so she had big shoes to fill. Both her, and her staff have done an amazing job, picking up an existing practice, and carrying forward Austin Dental Works impeccable legacy. Let them care for your teeth, you won’t be sorry you did.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Layla Hanna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jaros is great. She explained everything about my dental condition clearly and gave me a manageable  treatment plan. Everyone on staff has been lovely.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brady Pieper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic experience with the staff at Austin Dental Works. I had a set of implants put in and felt comfortable and supported through the whole process. Definitely would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitch C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've never enjoyed going to the dentist. I 've never really had a great experience with dentists until now.  I went into Austin Dental Works and the entire staff, from Dr. Jaros to Tiffanie at the front desk, could not have been more helpful or professional.

user_reviews.Name: Casey Christensen
user_reviews.Description: I've been a Breeze customer/patient for around four years - they are truly the best! I was initially recommended Breeze by a friend with dental anxiety who had been singing their praises; they have really blown me away and far exceeded my expectations. They have put so much into the space including regular upgrades/renovations over the years to always keep it updated, fresh, and clean. The front staff are amazing - so kind, clear, and patient. I've seen every staff dentist through the years and have appreciated the honesty, professionalism, and kindness of each. Recently, I've really enjoyed Dr. Josh who is very thorough in providing customized recommendations and solutions to any patient concerns. Lastly, I have to say - Thalia is the most incredible dental hygienist I have EVER had! She is so gentle, but precise and detailed, as well. Thalia makes the time pass so easily; I cannot say enough praise about her, truly!! Overall, I'd highly recommend Breeze to anyone looking to transform their view of going to the dentist into a positive one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel Colmenares
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Bad experience and i would avoid.

TL;DR: they’ll discuss your treatment with different dentist to get you to do a more invasive procedure than originally discussed.

After my routine cleaning and x rays, the dentist came in and discussed options for my recently fallen filling. she suggested a crown. i asked if i can just get it filled, she said crown would be best to avoid doing a root canal later.

i went to the office to discuss the financials for the crown, we started discussing appointment scheduling for the crown. i asked if it can be done sooner than later. they said they’ll ask and they came back saying i need a root canal instead. i insisted that the dentist thst evaluated me said i needed a CROWN to avoid a root canal in the future. instead of speaking with said dentist that did MY evaluation, they kept wanting me to be seen and evaluated again by a DIFFERENT dentist that wanted me to get a root canal instead.

I talked to them on the phone. they kept on insisting i see a different dentist to evaluate to see if i needed a root canal. mind you, it’s the same dentist that said i needed a root canal, to let me know if i needed a root canal or not.

i just want to get the crown that the dentist that evaluated me suggested i get. should’ve been a simple transaction.

So, book at your own risk. the dentist will say one thing, front office and office manager will discuss your treatment with a different dentist, just to get a more invasive, more expensive procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Went here yesterday after not going to the dentist in over a year because of a bad experience the last time I went (different practice). My hygienist was Cathy and she was super sweet and very good at explaining about what she was doing and what the x rays and 3D scans were showing about my gums. The place itself is super well kept and very clean.
