user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! I was overdue for a Cushing and worried it would hurt or that I’d bleed everywhere or get scolded for not flossing enough. Worried for no reason! “Angel Hands” took incredible care of me and deserves accolades!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phillip Akhzar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ask for Jax. She was super thorough and friendly. The whole staff was tbh. Huge leap from service that I got at my last dentist. Grateful to have found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Kordzik
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have only been in their care for a short time, but my experience has been phenomenal.  All the staff members have been so kind and understanding.  My dentist, Dr. Sirage, has helped me set up an excellent treatment plan and was very upfront with what was needed.  He felt very trustworthy and professional.  The office space itself is very inviting too! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: luke johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great consultation with Dr. Sirage. I’ve never had a dentist give such a detailed in debt consultation. He listens very well to your concerns and will spend the time to answer all of your questions in detail. 10/10 experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient here for a long time. They have taken excellent care of my oral health. They are always careful to outline my options without trying to upsell me on anything. Very happy to be a patient at Breeze.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonas White
user_reviews_extended.Description: New to Breeze and had a great experience all around. Bailey at the front was amazing handling all the back end and insurance stuff. Very happy I made the change!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jarod Buckles
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for my annual cleaning and had a great experience with Jax! She did a great job  and took the time to thoroughly answer any questions I had. Very pleased with the entire staff and their work!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Piotr Kostrzeński
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can definitely recommend it. I had a difficult situation and everything was taken care of quickly and efficiently.
The Netflix screen and getting a crown without any follow-up visits were definitely very impressive. The pricing is also very clear. I even got a partial refund some time later after wisdom teeth extraction with my dental insurance. I'm not sure how much was it due to Breeze's interaction with them, but I am definitely satisfied and can't complain about anything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bethelhem Moges
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love love this place! This is hands down the best dental office I’ve ever been to! From the moment you walk in, everyone is so welcoming and friendly. Dr. Saja is amazing, very attentive, informative and caring! Everyone here is truly wonderful and great at what they do.

I can’t say enough good things about this place. They make something most people dread feel easy and even enjoyable. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Solodar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Top tier staff with all of the new technology. When people are working inside your mouth, the new technology makes it much easier to handle. I cannot recommend this office enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kasia Szalus
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I decided to tackle two years’ worth of dental work in a single day—and I couldn’t be happier with the experience at Breeze. Dr. Josh and his team were incredible. In one visit, I had my wisdom teeth removed, a filling done, and two crowns placed—all seamlessly. Breeze makes the crowns in-house, so no need for a temporary or follow-up visit.

Despite my usual dentist anxiety, they made me feel completely at ease. I had zero pain during or after the procedure, and—believe it or not—no bleeding from the wisdom teeth at all. It was genuinely the best dental experience I’ve ever had. I’ve been going to Breeze for years, and they continue to exceed expectations.

The office is incredibly clean, scheduling (and rescheduling) is easy. I also love that they offer early AM appointments (i.e. 7am).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peggy Erback
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sarah was amazing. We discussed things I wanted her to do and she did them.  I got there early for the appointment due to your parking. If there was any complaints it would be the parking which Sarah didn’t have any control over.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sydney Preston
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved! Tbh I only went here bc I heard someone from my work mention they were good. When I looked at their website I was extremely skeptical (idk why but “modern” and “trendy” healthcare spots scare me) but I booked the apt bc it was super easy, they had a pretty flexible schedule and the lady was really nice. Ok shame on me for judging a book by its cover!!!! I’m obsessed. They were amazing. My teeth feel so clean. They explained everything in very simple terms and looked up my insurance to give me cost up front. No one tried to upsell me, if anything they told me to get a grip I don’t need the $150 water flosser, I’d be fine with the string lol. No in all seriousness I can’t recommend this place enough! P.s I never write reviews- so this is saying something

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Koich
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming for a couple years now. Highly recommend. Shoutout to Jax for taking it easy on me and putting the game on the ceilingTV.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M Dotson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! Best staff, highly recommend Jax as your dental hygienist - she’s the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesus Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Every visit to Breeze Dental has been a great experience. I’ve never waited more than three minutes, and the atmosphere is always super comfortable, with just the right temperature. The office is clean, modern, and thoughtfully designed—everything feels welcoming and easygoing.

The staff is incredibly friendly and always makes sure you feel at ease. They’ve added nice touches like TVs on the ceiling and headphones, making it a socially comfortable experience no matter the situation.

Their technology is clearly up-to-date, which makes every visit feel efficient and smooth. I always leave with a big smile, feeling well taken care of. Honestly, going to the dentist here is as relaxing as it gets. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Berman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Felisa and Dr. Josh were great.  They were both interesting to talk to, and got my 2 fillings done fast.  Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sally Todd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don't usually write reviews - but this place seriously rocks. A dental assistant remembered me from almost a year ago and had even remembered to follow up some big life changes I had had (Sarah - you're so great!!) I was touched. Also, they are honest about the services you need, and they check your insurance in real time to let you know prices before they offer services. (for example I needed to redo a filling that was going bad and they told me the exact dollar amount before I agreed to it.)  I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mario Moreno
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and doc did a really good job making me feel at ease before the procedure. Highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: K Lippy
user_reviews_extended.Description: A wonderful experience all round at Breeze. Friendly, clean, well run, professional, as well as an amazing office space.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pietra Amaral
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve never had a better experience with a dentist.
This office is beyond clean, and the staff I so friendly. I was very scared to go to the appointment because I had previously had a really bad dentist experience with another provider… but these people went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and calm.

Loved my first appointment!

They had blankets for the patients to stay warm, they had a 3D scanner that would generate a virtual image of your mouth, gave me a welcome box…

I would 100% recommend them !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff members and  hygienist and dentist are Amazing at their work! Really good at giving information And helping me

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Fine
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Breeze (formerly Lydian) for a few years now and I have never felt more comfortable at a dentist’s office. The office staff are so friendly and every dental assistant I’ve had has been professional and personable. I was one of those “the dentist scares me” people my whole life, but now I look forward to my 6 month cleanings! Dr Josh and his staff are truly amazing. Highly recommend seeing them - even if the idea of the dentist scares you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is very welcoming when I go and they really do all wonderful job i will never go anywhere else that's for sure great job guys i will definitely refer friends and family

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Breeze Dental was easy to get an appointment and quickly assessed my dental health and needs. They gave me several options to address and treat. The staff was polite, helpful and keep it light. My overall experience was very positive and I hate going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evan Baehr
user_reviews_extended.Description: A friend of mine referred this place to me and it’s right down the street from where I live. So I thought I’d try it out. I had an absolutely wonderful experience. They have every cool new technology that give you super clear imaging of your teeth, the staff is super friendly. The place looks like a spa. I asked if I could coworker there, only sort of joking.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roger Vidal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The Dental Cleaning technicians are very nice and good, but in my most recent cleaning visit I was told at the end of the cleaning that the dentist was not available to see me as he was delayed in traffic.  Then they told me that the doctor would review my results and call me, but that never happened!

This is the second time that I have a case where they said they would call me with some follow-up doctor advice and it does not happen.

I would like to see them improve in their followups and not put me in a situation where I have to call them back to get the pending items from my visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gerardo Buelna (Potato)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place, everyone was very kind and helpful. They also utilize new equipment that made each aspect a lot more comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thalinna Lynn Faren
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am AFRAID of the dentist. I thought I was deathly afraid but I learned that some people are more afraid than I am and that I'm actually fine with going once I am through the door and in the seat. Went for my annual cleaning and then went back a few weeks later to get fillings on 3 cavities. Super quick, and despite how anxious I felt going in, I was fine during the procedure. Painless (except for a little around one of the teeth during the filling, but they gave me more anesthesia quickly after I called it out.)

Staff are so awesome and they really help you calm down if you'r an anxious patient like I am.

10/10 would recommend. Now I'm afraid of the day I move out of Austin and have to get another dentist somewhere else. I love Dr. Sirage! Thank you Breeze Dental Team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Grimm
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Breeze Dental for years and have always had a great experience. The hygienist are friendly and thorough, and Dr. Josh is both kind and informative. Their new office setup is modern, clean, and super comfortable, making every visit pleasant! Highly recommend!

Recent Update: Just finished my whitening appointment and I can’t say enough good things about this office. Melanie did my treatment and she was absolutely wonderful, so kind, knowledgeable, and made me feel completely comfortable the entire time. She explained everything clearly, checked on me often, and made the whole experience really easy and stress-free. My results already look amazing. So grateful for my dental team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Blaine
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love love love Dr. Josh and his whole team! I did Invisalign with them and what a great experience. So kind, so clean, always on time and very knowledgeable. 100% would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daisy Alvarado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I originally left a negative review due to some issues I experienced, but I’m happy to say the team at Breeze Dental went above and beyond to address my concerns. The owner, Dr. Turnbull, personally reached out to me, and we worked together to find a solution that I was happy with. His commitment to patient satisfaction and genuine care made all the difference. I’m glad to continue being a patient here and truly appreciate their dedication to making things right.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Naty Alfonso
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love how well they explained what I need and the thorough examination. Very kind dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I didn’t want my only message about this clinic to be left in a review, but here I am. I’ve called, left a voicemail asking for a return call or an email to discuss my concerns, but it’s been over a week and there’s been no attempt to contact me in any way—despite their history of being very responsive. I wanted to feel positive about this place, especially after seeing the reviews, but every time I left the office, I felt like I was being pushed to rack up hundreds or even thousands of dollars to achieve the “perfect” smile, even when they promised me a “killer deal.”

One thing I noticed was that it seemed like everyone who walked in was being recommended Invisalign, almost as if it was the only solution. Be wary of that bc I didn’t ~need~ that like I was influenced into thinking I might need it. I’m also frustrated with how my appointments have been handled. I drive over an hour to get there, and for a scheduled appointment made three weeks in advance, I wasn’t even notified that it was canceled. I found out as I’m being seated the dental chair the dentist was overbooked, and as a result, I wouldn’t be able to get my buttons on my teeth removed as planned. I waited nearly an hour just to make sure my buttons came off, and during that time, the doctor made a joke about whether it was “worth the drive.” Worth the drive? For an appointment that essentially was canceled but because I waited an hour more I was able to get what I needed to get done?

At the end of the visit, I was given a brief sales pitch about needing professional whitening and two veneers for a small chip and a stain that, honestly, only a dental professional would notice. There’s never a mention of less invasive, less expensive alternatives—it's always the full treatment. It’s made me reconsider whether these fancy clinics and young doctors are worth the cost. What kind of debt are they still trying to pay off?

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt W.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Broke a crown visiting Austin on vacation. Annoying emergency and they fit me in the same day just hours after calling.

The staff were all super sweet and honest.

Lots of tech innovation in their process and a really nice hip office.

If I lived here this would be my dentist! Highly recommend 👌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Inaiana Gama
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best experience I ever had! I was a little afraid of going to the dentist, but I felt so comfortable from the first appointment. The attention they give you, checking in to see if you’re okay after your appointment, makes a difference.  Dr. Sirage and his assistant were amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leila Iris
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience I’ve had at the dentist!! My dentist and hygienist were both so sweet and informative. Even with no dental insurance it was way more affordable than other places in austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly one the best dental experiences I've had. Dr. Sirage is awesome and handled my two filling appointments great. No pain at all during my fillings and very little pain after the anesthetic wore off. The bite was perfect the next day and could floss easily. The office is modern and clean - they provide sunglasses and you can watch netflix while you're getting work done. Highly recommend for Austin dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sofía Covarrubias
user_reviews_extended.Description: I couldn’t love Breeze more. I mean, who genuinely says “I look forward to my dentist appointment”. Breeze and every person in their team makes me feel that way. Zero judgement, genuine folks, truly invested in your oral health and overall wellness. I’ve referred multiple and now they all love going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really great dentistry with amazing staff and technology! I had a first time appointment last week and scheduled a follow up today to fill some cavities. The procedure was over quickly and everything went well. The staff really goes above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and trusting in their hands! They are definitely experts at their craft!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pierce Arvizu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
1 Star – Mysterious Man Tries to Finance His BMW With My Teeth
The front desk? Friendly. The hygienist? Solid. But the dentist? A shadowy figure who swept in like a ghost, told me I needed a full set of fillings, then disappeared before I could catch his name. Almost like he didn’t want me to know it… wonder why?

I’m 25. I’ve never needed a filling in my life — not one — until I showed up here. Suddenly I’ve got a mouthful of “urgent” (7 fillings recommended) cavities and a treatment plan that reads like it was written by a car salesman trying to hit his bonus number.

They offered me free teeth whitening just to get me in the door, then refused to honor it unless I agreed to the 7 fillings they pushed. Still waiting for a cavity diagnosis that doesn’t sound like a financing scheme.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alli Cook
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to breeze dental since I moved to Austin 5 years ago. I recently went to get cavities filled and I absolutely dread going to the dentist, however Dr.Josh and Karina made it such a comfortable environment. They talked me through the procedure every step of the way and eased my anxiety. They were quick and efficient and it’s always a pleasure going to Breeze dental! Highly highly recommend for anyone looking for a great dentist and team! Also his office is very esthetically pleasing and like no other dentist office I’ve ever been to!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ednar Jacques
user_reviews_extended.Description: My coworker recommended this dental office and I was pleasantly surprised. The staff were all so nice. And the office was esthetically pleasing to the eyes. They offered free drinks (sparkling water) and a gift on your first consultation...I  do see myself going back for all of my dental care needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Shaffer Beeler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Josh is the best! So knowledgeable, honest and straight forward. His team is so kind and friendly, I felt so welcomed from the second I walked in. Dr. Josh also does incredible dental work, aside from being so nice and easy to talk to. Love their holistic approach to dentistry as well. Breeze is my favorite dentistry I have ever been to!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Chinery Hearn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Breeze! Cute/minimal aesthetic, friendly hygienists. Jacqueline is the best!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: BF
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service and my dentist took time to educate me throughout my appointment. I also really appreciate the constant check in’s to make sure I felt comfortable and didn’t feel any pain. I found my forever dental office for sure! 10/10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Esther Amos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Breeze Dental on S. Lamar is incredibly caring. They go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and ensure all your questions are answered during your appointment. They even stepped up to help me when my car broke down in their parking lot—something they didn’t have to do but did anyway. The team is truly amazing, and you’ll be in excellent hands with them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Callino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Karen at breeze dental is the most amazing!! She made getting my Invisalign super easy and always keeps me laughing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alec Slight
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m biased cause I live literally next door, but great care and they get you in & out fast as hell. Seriously, like I left work at 11:15 and was back at my desk at noon. AND they complimented my teeth. Much needed ego boost, highlight of my week.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Amadio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall superb experience, efficiency meets luxury -- combined with making patients feel like real unique humans. Dr. Josh is a rockstar. Balanced, conservative patient centered approach, but not afraid to use advanced technology and take steps outside the conventional cookie-cutter recommendations.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Albert Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time coming to this dentist office and absolutely glad I did! Great vibe, employees were great! Dr. Sirage and hygienist Katy were beyond sweet and helpful. I came away with an awesome experience and cleaner and healthier teeth than when I first walked in!! Definitely gonna make this my new go-to dentist in Austin :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Grey
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team over the phone, at the front desk, and cleaning my teeth were amazing. They were informative without it being overwhelming, nonjudgmental , and super supportive. Will recommend to everyone !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Leighton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Breeze was incredibly helpful when I needed an emergency dental appointment

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kourtney Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Verma, AMAZING!!! Will go back for her and the dental assistant Angie alone. They are kind, thorough, and want to make sure you understand the treatments you need, and while treating your teeth.
The office staff is a little lacking in responsiveness. Still waiting for my treatment plan to be emailed. Followed up with an email to ask for it, and still.havent received a response. Who knows.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Akhzar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super sweet team. Least painful cleaning I have ever had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miranda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m not typically a “dentist anxiety person”, but my coworkers recent horrible experience (at a different dentist!) changed that. I walked in for my appt full of anxiety, but the front desk staff put me at ease. Once I got in the chair for my procedure, Carolina took the time to talk me through what to expect, understand my concerns, and alleviate them. From there I knew I was I good hands, and Dr Verma and Caro made the experience a breeze. No pun intended 😉. The women are all so personable, making this dentist office stand out from the rest. I’ve already recommended Breeze to my friends. The newest most up to date dental tech and equipment are added bonuses. Overall great experience, big fan of the care and empathy the staff all excude.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Weir
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had a wonderful experience at Breeze dental. I’m moving out of Austin this week but I’ve gone to them for three years and I am so grateful I found them. They really know customer service, from the front desk, to the service to when you walk out the door. They prioritize comfort and friendliness and on top of this, it’s some of the best dental work I’ve had done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Kai
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved how easy, professional and balanced with holistic and modern practices! I have a cancer history so before my appt the DDS chatted with me about X-rays and my needs and concerns! We made a perfect plan to keep my teeth and mouth healthy but protect my overall health! I would definitely recommend if you want a DDS that cares about holistic and natural approaches!

user_reviews_extended.Name: DANYELL H
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I first started getting care/treatment they were Lydian Dental before becoming Breeze Dental. I located this office online. From the 1st appt up until now they have always made me feel welcomed. No matter how small or big the situation was they put me at ease. Always assured me through the process. I would take my kids with me to some appointments. When I didn't they always asked about them. The LOVE, CARE and CONCERN they provided me made me feel like I am family to their office. The office and staff are AMAZING.

user_reviews_extended.Name: HANIA ALKUDMANI
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sirage is a fantastic dentist. he is very kind and gentle, he took his time to examine and talk to me about the needed work. he has high attention to details and provided impeccable results and esthetics working on my crown and front filling. i did not even feel the injection!! loved my experience and will be back for sure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: CROWNED LOCAL
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient at Breeze (formerly Lydian Dental) for almost two years since moving to Austin, and my experience has been nothing short of fantastic. Dr. Josh Turnbull is one of the coolest dentists I've ever had, completely transforming my smile. Sydney P, my dental hygienist, is amazing – she has such a gentle touch and is incredibly sweet and kind. Karen P, the lead dental assistant, is fantastic as well. I love her big personality! Dora U, the treatment coordinator, is so sweet and responsive to all my questions.

I must also mention Candice Herrera, the most amazing operations manager I have ever met. Her hospitality and bright personality make every visit a pleasure, and she never forgets to bring her smile to work.

This dental office is simply outstanding, and I highly recommend them to anyone seeking exceptional dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaclyn “Jackie”
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here since I moved to Austin in 2020. They are definitely on top of things! I get my regular cleanings here, and did Invisalign. I have seen both Dr Josh and another woman doctor and they are both great. Cute office & friendly staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vmarie Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dentist office was amazing. The atmosphere is so relaxing and nice. The staff made me feel so comfortable and were very attentive and polite. The dentist was very direct and provided clarification on everything. She explained the process to me and was very detail oriented. I felt very insecure walking into the dentist office due to my crown falling out and being a new patient. When I left I felt better about myself and my smile.  Highly recommend this dentist office to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dimarie Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved my visit to Breeze! From the moment I opened the office door, the service was incredible. Also  the confidence they gave me with their knowledge was outstanding. I can confidently say I recommend them 200%! Thank you for your excellent service.  🫶🏻🩷

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Greco
user_reviews_extended.Description: In town on business and my temporary crown fell out and I called around local dentist to see if they could cement it and put it back in for me. One dentist off said they would do it for $350 for a 5 minute fix! Another said they had no openings till mid March?? Again, a 5 minute fix. Next up was Breeze by elimination as I was trying to find the closest dentist to my hotel. Breeze receptionist (Candice) I think her name was... made it so easy, listened to my issue and gave me a fair price of $107. Went in the following morning and got it done. Thank you to the team there. It's one thing to find an urgent care for medical issues when your awayxfrom home, but dental care for a issue or emergency shouldn't be so hard, especially for a quick fix. Thanks again Breeze,  well done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charles M.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited Lydian Dental for the first time and was impressed. Brandon at the front desk was very nice and helpful. I was greeted by Crystal and she informed me step by step of what to expect during my visit. She was extremely knowledgeable and made me feel comfortable during my visit. I did a number of scans and photos and their technology made everything transparent on the screens for me to see. They really try and work with you to find a solution that works best for your mouth and your budget. Definitely recommend Lydian Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabe McKinney
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a really great experience at Lydian Dental. Dora and Dulce (from the front desk) both welcomed me in with great care and excitement. They treated me like an individual and not just another transaction.

Aubrey is great at her job. She's meticulous to ensure everything is done excellently. She constantly let me know what was going on and what would happen next. She made sure the TV was on something I enjoyed and my teeth feel and look great. One of the better experiences I've had with anything teeth-related.

Great office and people. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heston Priestley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place! Jacklyn does a great job every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Breshears
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is welcoming, very clean and fun! Always feels like Breeze has the most up to technology. The staff is extremely easy to work with and has been very thorough in all of their services. Scheduling appointments is very easy and I appreciate the appointment reminders. 10/10 recommend this location

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yana Novikova
user_reviews_extended.Description: My overall experience at the dental office was fantastic. The staff were awesome and took the time to thoroughly explain everything I  needed to know. I love the place - it has a comfortable and welcome atmosphere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience here. The team is very thorough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Ricaurte
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love this place! They have TVs mounted to the ceiling so you can watch Netflix while you get your teeth cleaned. Everyone I interacted with was great, I didn’t wait long for my appointment or for the dentist. Shout out to Sydney who was lovely.

Continued love for this business - 6 months later in and out. Arrived early, got started early, finished very refreshed and happy in 30 minutes and genuinely enjoyed the banter with the hygienist and dentist, good vibes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kerri Dorsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit. The office personnel was very pleasant.  I loved how I was able to complete all my paperwork online prior to my visit and I appreciate how they sent notification reminders.  My cleaning was performed by Krystal Sisson.  She is very knowledgeable and took time to listen to my concerns.  She checked those areas of concern to propose my treatment plan with the dentist.  Dr. Josh was very pleasant and thorough.  Additionally, I was surprised at the low cost for my treatment plan.  I came hime and compared it to my husbands plan from another dentist.   He will soon be a patient at Lydian too.   If you visit their website Dr. Josh states the mission clearly as they put patients before profits.  This was my experience.  I highly recommend Lydian Dental in Austin, Texas.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Schreiber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian Dental has been my family’s provider for years.  There has been some turn over in this time span, but somehow Lydian has replaced one great employee with another from the admin staff, to hygienists and even a Dentist.  Scheduling is a breeze, and insurance issues have always been handled without any headaches.  Very competent is how I’d summarize this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki
user_reviews_extended.Description: BEST experience I’ve had at the dentist. I have suffered from severe dental anxiety since I was a child and I can say with 110% honesty that I have never felt as comfortable and cared for like I was at Lydian Dental at any other dental office. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful and professional. The Doctors are so down to earth and knowledgeable and actually take the time to help me understand procedures and how they can benefit my oral health. My Hygienist Sydney was so kind and accommodating and put me at ease the moment I sat down in her dental chair. I will DEFF be back for all of my future services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wendell Norris
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place! I recently moved to Austin and was sad to leave my old dentist but this guys are coming really close to be as good or even better. EVERY SINGLE PERSON that I interacted with was not only doing their job and a good job they were all very intentional to make sure I was comfortable and that I have a great experience.  From the doctor to the techs to the ladies at the counter from my first call to when I left.  Everyone it's really knowledgeable,  the place looks clean and has a great atmosphere.  The actually services were also top notch.  They offered me multiple payment plans for an expensive ortho treatment that I need. I jumped on them last minute and they really try hard to acomodating me on their already booked schedule. Would recommend 100% stop looking this is your new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AJ Durand
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Lydian based on great reviews and still they exceeded my expectations. I had a long term lapse in dental care and I was feeling incredibly self conscious. When I was introduced to my hygienist, Sarah she had reviewed my notes and started our first session with a compassionate and intentional conversation. She asked thoughtful questions and listened to my concerns. I’ve since come back for two deep cleanings, a filling and a follow up visit. Dr. Sirage is incredibly skilled at administering anesthesia (I’m not good with needles but it was a breeze) and he is both informative and encouraging about my long term care. The administrative team members do a great job of demystifying insurance and are always kind and helpful. Everyone at this office has taken a masterclass in communication and are solid experts in their roles. Lydian has set the standard in my mind for what dental care should be.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophie M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian Dental is the best dentist I have ever been to. The dentists and hygienists are compassionate and incredible. I have some dental anxiety and avoided going to the dentist for years, but my appointment went smoothly, and everything they were doing was communicated to me. The staff was patient and understanding of my anxiety, and did a great job. I have been wanting to get my wisdom teeth extracted for years, but avoided it due to my hatred of the dentist. I finally scheduled an appointment to get them taken out, years after I initially wanted to. I never felt like they were trying to overcharge me or perform unnecessary work. The office was clean, well run, and had some really awesome tech. For as long as I live in Austin, I will be going to Lydian.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Curt Young
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dental care experience I ever had. Everyone is so friendly, kind, and truly interested in your dental health without annoying upsell. Had a crown and filing done today and it was remarkably pain free and stress free. And the staff is simply amazing, checking in on my comfort level st all times. The modern equipment also gave me a higher level confidence I'd found the perfect place for my dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: So happy with my experience at Breeze Dental. The dentist, hygienist, and staff were respectful, thorough, friendly, and transparent. Feel like they truly care about their patients. Super clean and serene environment  too. 100% recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Stearns
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Verma and the team at Breeze Dental are amazing!!! They care so much about my comfort and keeping me informed about what they are doing, what’s coming next and what they found. I’ve been 3 times and every visit makes me so happy to have found this place. My last visit I was offered a blanket, pillow and to pick out a show on Netflix while my teeth were cleaned. Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doug Schmidt (US)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sirage and his team are highly proficient at what they do. I get extremely anxious going to the dentist after several uncomfortable exams in the past. When I went into Lydian for a cleaning, I was expecting it to hurt. Far from it, it was like they were barely in there. They gave me great advice on how to care for my gums afterward and offered a reasonable-cost treatment to boot. When I had to get a crown on a broken tooth, I was expecting a terrible morning with multiple shots in my mouth and    a sore jaw. Nope, they gave me one shot, did the work while I watched cartoons above, and then finished up without me wincing once. Very good job on the crown too, a perfect fit from the get-go. They even sent me a figurine from the cartoons I was watching as a gift. The best dentist I have ever visited. I will go here for life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suzanne Marshall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience at my teeth cleaning from Angie, a dental hygienist at Lydian.  My overall dental hygiene has improved thanks to her suggestions and the care she takes with her cleaning.  I.loved the technology used at Lydian to suggest future needs or improvements.  Dr. Sirage and his staff are wonderful to work with--I highly recommend this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Fleetwood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Marsha, Dora, Karina and Dr. Sirage were all AMAZING! I moved to Austin last fall and had yet to find a dentist for me. Finding a new dentist is always so intimidating and can be nerve wracking finding someone you can trust. A few of my coworkers came to Breeze and had such good things to say so I had to come check it out. I had a couple of fillings from past that needed a little touching up and Dr Sirage was so gentle and walked me through everything. They also offer $50 referral so if you refer someone then that person gets credit and so do you. ALSO they have blankets and headphones with TVs on the ceiling so you can literally watch Netflix and chill while you’re getting work done. Marsha and Dora at the front are soo sweet and really make an effort to get to know you. 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Velez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been to many dentist and NONE have come close to Breeze dental.

Every part of the experience from beginning to end was top notch. The receptionist, the assistant, and the doctor we're all extremely professional, curtious and most of all honest.

They offer smaller x-ray devices that fit in your mouth so you don't have to gag and choke, and they also offer bio testing to get to the root cause of your gum health issues. Unlike 99% traditional dentist.

10 stars‼️🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Rose Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love Lydian! I was skeptical because the offices are so nicely designed and have thoughtful perks (like tvs on the ceiling to watch during cleanings) but don't be like me & wait forever to book your appointment here.

I had the most gentle, delicate cleaning of my life here–major shoutout to Katie!!! Can't emphasize enough how great she was, I was in genuine awe the whole time. I didn't know dental cleanings could be so painless!

I also love that the doctors here give genuine advice and don't upsell services just for the profit of it. They will tell you straight up if things like invisalign or veneers are a bad fit for you, and refer you to specialists that could handle more complex issues. This place knows what they're talking about & have really earned my trust after some terrible experiences at other dental practices. I'll be sticking with them as my dental provider!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Foster
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Lydian based on great reviews and they have been excellent ever since. Ilsa especially has been so helpful during my new teeth era. Ive have to get 1 root canal fixed, an implant, just started invisalign, and have to get my wisdom teeth removing in 2023. Every time I need assistance, Ilsa has been my go to during this journey. Dr. Josh is also awesome, the service is outstanding, they are very friendly like family and i wouldnt have anyone else work on my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lukas Facker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow! The reviews don’t lie. I’ve never felt so comfortable at a dentist office. Everyone there seemed so happy and genuinely cared to be there and cared to help you. This is unusual I feel like at any business. I am terrible with names and I can’t remember the names of who I worked with by I believe one of them was Sarah and maybe Ilsa? They were all fantastic and kind and efficient and took such great care of me. So glad I found this place my husband and I will happily be making this our home dental office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tricia Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome experience.  Staff friendly and attentive. I am so looking forward to going to the dentist. Dr Shirage is the best dentist ,I have had in years.Actually looking forward to my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wendy G Henshaw
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had great experiences since switching to Lydian Dental. Krystal, the hygienist, is absolutely amazing. She’s thorough, super friendly and talks you through what she’s doing. The dentist and all of the staff is lovely as well. Great location and great office. 10/10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Wiktor
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Josh is so kind, and made me feel like all concerns were addressed during my initial visit. Krystal was my hygienist and she put me right at ease, then Melanie assisted Dr. Josh for my follow up. Reception has also been wonderful to work with - professional and kind. They are all wonderful! If you’re an anxious patient, they have streaming services for distraction and provide a comfy setup with sunglasses, headphones, blanket, and pillow! I may just come by if I find myself needing a nap! :)
This team is all around fantastic, and I’m so happy to have found my dentist in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlie Castro
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff at Lydian dental are fantastic! They’re professional, courteous and always do a great job on my teeth. I would highly recommend this group to anyone looking for an exceptional dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Burditt
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff have really helped me achieve a beautiful smile with expert guidance on straightening and whitening options plus easily maintaining good oral hygiene. The best part is they give me tips and tricks to help my child have good oral hygiene too even though he’s not a client there. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chandler Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First I want to say, everyone is SO nice!!!!
I was first greeted by Dulce at the front. She is so welcoming and really made the check in process easy.
From there, I was taken to the back by the Sydney. Not only was she helpful with the information she was providing. But she made sure I understood what was going on and explained each scope of work.
She ensured I was comfortable through out the entire process.
Once Sydney cleaned up my grill, I was introduced to Dr. Iana. She was SO nice as well!!!!
She walked me through the work we needed done on my teeth, she was so helpful and ensured that she will be with me every step of the way and showed much excitement for my teeth transformation (which made me excited)
Lastly, I met with Dora to discuss treatment plan and financials. She was very informative and made the financials part very stress free!!
Overall- my experience has been tremendous because of these ladies.  I cannot wait to continue my journey with Lydian Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Sandrock
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is a very bad customer experience. The dentist misses appointment time several times whereas there is a charge if the patient misses the appointment. This is totally unfair.
Also, the dentist deals with the patient as an employee who should  comply with what should be options; this business is corrupted and unethical. There is no way to recommend this team of dentists.
I was an actual client and this Lydian (now Breeze) Dental replied with a preset response. This is a way to diffuse the impact of bad customer service, starting with the dentist Dr Josh including the dental staff and front desk.
Highly recommend looking for a better option.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Carlozzo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot recommend Lydian Dental enough! I made a phone call this morning hoping to get more information on crowns after being referred to this location by several people. Not only were they able to schedule me for this afternoon, but they were able to complete the crown procedure efficiently and effectively over the course of several hours. The office is bright, welcoming, friendly, and comfortable, and the staff is wonderful. From Crystal who scheduled my appointment, to Billy and Norma who assisted with x-rays and the crown procedure itself, to Dr. Josh who was kind, informative, non-judgmental, highly knowledgeable, and talented, my entire experience was warm, welcoming, and caring. I felt like they treated me like a human and they were very kind and human themselves if that makes sense. I grew up dreading the dentist, so for anyone who has had similar experiences hear me out: I feel that I have found a place where the patient’s best interest and well-being is truly valued, and I look forward to continuing care with Lydian Dental. A big thank you Dr. Josh and all the staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariah Odom
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve struggled finding a dentist since moving to Austin two years ago. Everyone at Lydian instantly made me feel welcome and comfortable. They worked very efficiently and had me in and out in a reasonable time. Very modern and clean facility. They also have an orthodontist on staff at which is very rare and so accommodating. I’m so impressed by them and will recommend them to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the front desk people to the man Dr. Josh himself, I have been beyond happy with the level of service I've been provided here.  Every time I come in I enjoy a fantastic conversation at the front desk with some of the friendliest and most helpful people you'll meet.  Considering the length of time I had gone between dental appointments I knew I would need considerable work done but was pleasantly surprised with the level of detail and explanation about the treatment that would need to be done.  I cannot recommend the quality of people and treatment at this clinic enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Streig
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit to Lydian Dental on Lamar and it was a really nice experience. The office staff are very friendly and the setup is very modern! The atmosphere is really relaxing and comfortable. I'd definitely recommend this dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alania Cater
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came here for a routine checkup and cleaning.  The hygenist wouldn't complete the procedure, insisting that I needed a "special cleaning" that was not covered by insurance and that couldn't be done that day.  I asked to just get the regular cleaning and they refused.  The dentist also told me I needed a filling replaced.  I decided to go back to my old dentist (whom I trust implicitly but isn't on my new insurance) and paid out of pocket to have my teeth cleaned today (normal cleaning) and was told the filling is fine for now.  So basically Breeze is trying to oversell procedures.  Total scam, find a dentist you can trust (hint, there is one less than a block away).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Broder
user_reviews_extended.Description: There are few things i hate worst than going to the dentist. I’m sure I’m not alone in that. However, Lydian dental makes it as easy and comfortable as possible. The main dentist is super conservative on making recommendations on what is necessary, so you don’t leave feeling like you were robbed. Plus all of the staff make the experience while you are there as pleasant as possible. Two TVs in each unit and they will search your exact Netflix show and episode you want to watch 😆. Plus lots of modern dental technology so you can get in and out efficiently.  I leave each time thinking ‘that wasn’t as bad as I thought it would be’, and I can’t say that about any dentist offices I’ve used before. Since we all have to go to the dentist at some point, I recommend using Lydian  💯

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Herselman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic service! The team are so friendly and made my various procedures an extremely smooth process. It was also very easy to get an appointment with a ton of availabililty that suited my scheduled. Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jake
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hate leaving bad reviews but I had a pretty bad experience with Lydian. Most of the issue was with billing, context: I work in healthcare and am quite comfortable navigating insurance plans, long story short I was charged for services that Lydian told me would covered by insurance. That is the insurance company would cover the cost of each specific service I agreed to receive, not that I was merely in-network. I left my last appointment and confirmed with front desk that I had no balance. A month later here I am with Lydian pushing a bill on me they specifically told me wouldn’t exist. I don’t go to the doctor a lot, but I expect that the provider accurately quote costs and explain any margin for unpredictability in those costs. Lydian’s process felt misleading and shady. Upon my protest to the bill their responses, when I’ve been lucky enough to receive them, has been dismissive and patronizing.

Outside of my billing issue I found the overall experience to be lack-luster. It was extremely impersonal, I never saw the same person 2x in any role. Everything is tightly time boxed and at times I felt rushed through questions or felt steps of services being rushed through to keep time. Any unplanned service requires another appointment, maybe that’s normal. I’ve had several better dentists in the area though.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren F
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best dental experience I’ve had! Found it on google reviews shortly after moving to Austin and was not disappointed. Sarah was an incredible hygienist - she walked me through everything she was doing and was very thoughtful about price transparency and insurance coverage. The dentist who checked my teeth was super friendly as well. Definitely will be coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Robichaux
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole group is very personable and welcoming. They easily  work with you to find the most economical choices. Their services are state of the art.  The dentists are at the forefront of dentistry . I also appreciate that they have a wholistic approach . They really treat you like family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Whirley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The dental team here is amazing and so professional. I went in a couple times to get some work done and they were always quick and efficient, always making sure I was comfortable and knew what was going on. The front desk ladies are super sweet, they even double and triple checked with my insurance before billing me and dropped my bill down to be super affordable!

It's also of course great that they have TVs with Netflix over every chair to get you through the long appointments. Will definitely always go here while living in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree Griffin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had the best experience at a dental office one could ask for. The level of care before, during and after my visit is by far the finest customer service I've had in years. I had my 4 year old son with me, he was throughly occupied in the kid area. The office is welcoming beautiful and clean. All staff was warm and kind. I recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Gavin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Lydian had great reviews so thought I’d give it a go as I have recently moved to Austin and needed a new dentist. I’m so glad I did! They are all SUPER nice and make you feel so comfortable which is really important to me as I get quite nervous. They talked me through everything ahead of time so I knew what to expect, they took all covid precautions and they have TVs on the ceilings 😆 one of the best dentist experiences I have ever had!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devin Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: been going here for years. absolutely love the doctors and all the hygienist are the best. really cool vibe in there as well. feels more on the expensive side of the market for dental services but i guess that’s just how dental healthcare is now. They’ll run your dental insurance but not health insurance so i end up paying out of pocket for some things and have to submit a claim back to my primary insurance provider. otherwise top notch, worth my personally perceived price premium to other options, and is extremely close to where i live

user_reviews_extended.Name: Avery Caudill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience at Breeze Dental!!! Dr. Sirage and Melanie ensured I was comfortable and informed, taking the time to answer all of my questions. Wonderful staff, very professional and kind!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Iain Black
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience here, Jax was awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bistra Anguelova
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental office with modern technology. Hygienist Kathy & Dr Verma were really great, they did a super thorough cleaning and gave me great advice. Would recommend this clinic to everyone. I've been to ~5 in the Austin area and this was by far my best experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: World Famous *BOB*
user_reviews_extended.Description:
When my Husbear found our new dentist upon arriving in ATX I was thrilled! Dr. Josh is skilled, personable, and very focused on patient comfort. My hygienist Crystal is so awesome I actually look forward to seeing her at my cleaning. I suggested Lydian South Lamar to my Drag Daughter and she loves it too!
I just had a little pool party last night for three of my drag kids, some friends, and my sister. We were in the pool and my drag daughter said, " oh I went to lydian dental today" and I said "oh! I'm going tomorrow" and my other drag daughter said "oh I went yesterday"! She had just moved here and found them based on reviews. How many times are you at a pool party & your dentist is so awesome you find yourself talking about them?

Update : 05/21/24
Still a great place! My new hygienist Sydney is awesome!!!!
If you're nervous about going to the dentist, this is a great choice.

Update: it's 06/03/25 and this is still the BEST dentist 🦷 in town!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexander Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not even sure what to say, this is the best dental office in Austin. They treat each other like family and have a pretty fast system, operates like a well-oiled machine. Definitely recommend to anyone in Austin or Bastrop.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love coming to see my dentist and hygienist! Such a fun, enjoyable experience every time. Super friendly team, cute & clean design of the office. I always feel welcomed and well taken care of. love it at Lydian dental on South Lamar.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lorna Noelle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was very stressed about having four cavities filled.  I had been in for cleanings and gotten great care but I still felt nervous.  I decided to get nitris for my appointment to help with my anxiety and it helped so much.  I received thoughtful care and kindness during the process.  I loved the calm caring environment and health practitioners taking time to listen to me and make me feel safe.  I am super impressed and totally at ease about my next appointment. I would highly recommend Lydian dental to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Fry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m an anxious dental patient and have needed several crowns and extractions in the past year. Dr. Josh and the rest of the Lydian staff have been warm, patient, and skilled. I’ve been able to get nitrous when it has been necessary to calm my anxiety, and they have been innovative in their approach to my tooth grinding. They offer blankets and pillows to keep patients comfortable, and TVs on the ceiling are a great distraction. Treatment plans and pricing are always reviewed thoroughly in advance, and the staff are a genuine pleasure to work with. I *almost* look forward to going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaylee Painter-Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great providers, I saw Dr. Verma and Karina to take care of my filling and they ensured I was comfortable and continuously asked if I needed breaks. Karen was excelled at whitening my teeth, and Linner my hygienist was so awesome and gave me great information on how to maintain healthy teeth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: chich3chich
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had a deep cleaning done at Lydian dental and I was really impressed with overall service.
😃
This is a brand new office. The waiting area is really nice. The back area is really nice too. They have televisions on the walls and the ceiling so you can watch movies. The staff is very friendly. I had a very comfortable experience and I would recommend them greatly. They even gave me a goodie bag filled with toothpaste and a toothbrush and dental floss.
Dr. Chad Whiting gave me the shots before the cleaning and he did a great 👍 job.
The assistant did fantastic job on my deep cleaning as well. 🙌🙌🙌
🦷 👨‍⚕️👩‍⚕️
✨“ it’s the professionalism that I respect”✨
Thank you 🙏😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosie Matula
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best! This office is very welcoming, everyone you interact with is very kind and helpful. Very transparent and consistant care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan Esparza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quite literally the best dentistry I’ve seen. The staff is very welcoming and hospitable. Never have I had any issues or complaints about them. 5 stars for me

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sal Calise
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at your office was very pleasant to say the least. A sincere and welcoming  greeting walking in and top priority customer service that followed  after my visit as well. Baja is an excellent hygienist. She is warm and personable and took the time to answer all of my questions. The dentist seemed very knowledgeable and trusting as well. Thank you for the great work on my 😀

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Krarup
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Lydian for about 1.5 years now, and I absolutely love this place! I have had a bit of work done in this time period, and the Lydian team never fails to do a great job with my teeth. A few highlights: they are super thorough, and I know that they have saved my teeth from severe future damage by taking preventative measures. They also make dental crowns with a 3D-printer, meaning that you never have to deal with temporary crowns and several appointments; the crowns are made and inserted in less than an hour. They even have Netflix installed on monitors at the ceiling. This might seem redundant, but it truly makes the whole experience more pleasant. And they took up a battle with my insurance company (and won!), meaning that I had to pay a lot less out of pocket than I otherwise would have.

Finally, the staff is AMAZING. They are so friendly and caring, and they always make me feel welcome and comfortable each time I go. They always call me the day after any procedure to make sure that everything is going well. Furthermore, they are quick to fit me into their busy schedule if I am experiencing any pain or discomfort.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richelle Hoo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My entire experience with Lydian was excellent! I will be going back to have a crown and will update after that fun.

Getting my crown completed in one appointment was fantastic. All went smooth, no pain and very happy with the outcome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby McCormick
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can’t recommend Lydian enough! I had my normal check ups but also went through Invisalign through them. They are always friendly and helpful, even when I had billing questions on Invisalign.

I finally got my husband to switch to them and as someone who hates going to the dentist, he had a great experience with them too! They even checked in on him the next day.

Looking for a dentist? Go here!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddy Avila
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came here after ten-plus years of not seeing a dentist (hey, I still brush and floss daily, folks). I figured it was time since, well, I’m finally ready to date again. Anyway, I was scared and embarrassed. But the moment I walked in I knew this place was different. Instead of the typical almost hospital-like office setting I’m used to, this place looked like a damn spa. Check-in was quick and easy and I was seen right on time after Sara introduced herself.

I have to again mention the aesthetics. A relaxing vibe is one thing, but framed dental humor told me that this was the right place for me. I don’t practice mindfulness for nothing. This tells me they’re more passionate about dentistry than their competitors.

Anyway, my dreaded cleaning by Sara was done with hardly any discomfort despite the extra muscle she had to use to scrape away the coffee and pastries. In short, I left feeling great and with my teeth clean enough to not have to visit again for another ten years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laurel Starkey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Josh and the entire staff here are truly amazing. In under 14 months he was able to correct a severe open bite and reposition my jaw that had locked up and caused me chronic pain for years. Not to mention teeth crowding. This was not a simple case, in fact I had been turned down by previous Ortho's due to the complexity. I am forever grateful to Dr. Josh and his team for building me a new smile with Invisalign!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andie Haddad
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Aubrey was so lovely and did a great job cleaning my teeth. She made sure to talk through everything that she was doing and why, as well as taking extra care to make sure she wasn't being too harsh with the tools. This was the best cleaning I've had.
Everyone else in the office was great and professional. I never felt rushed and everyone answered all my questions. Very pleased!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Ramos-Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
OMG! So impressed with Breeze. There was an outdoor event where I scheduled my appointment!
Upon arrival everyone was so welcoming and my hygienist was so informative! Here's the luxury treatment! I was watching Netflix while my teeth were being cleaned! Wowzar 🤪 I was also impressed with the updates technology and ways to see my teeth In 3D and scanned! I look forward to future appointments!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great spot for the whole familys teeth evaluations and cleanings. Really nice atmosphere very friendly people and feel like they have set a big bar for any future dentist office I visit.

My kids love going to the dentist, which is hilarious and I think so much down to the care of the people and the details of the space.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dana Fitzpatrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian always goes above and beyond. They were able to get me in right away for surgery and took great care of me the whole time. Even though I moved three hours away, it is well worth making the trip to see Dr. Josh and his entire team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristi Roeder
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update:

I saw a new dentist and they did not agree with any of the work Lydian wanted to do. This place is a scam and I am so happy I got I second opinion before having my mouth drilled apart.

I think this place is shady and I don’t recommend.

First of all, the dentist told me I needed over $1,000 worth of dental work and wanted to replace every filling. I had just gone to the dentist 6 months ago and they told me my teeth were fine. So it’s clear he was just trying to take advantage of me. I left the office feeling very uneasy.

Then they told me they told me they would call me back about scheduling treatment and just never did. I already decided I would not be returning to this place, but them not calling me makes me think they thought their dentist was being shady.

Dentists will try to scam you and unfortunately Lydian on lamar is one of those dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: I received amazing treatment from everyone at Lydian. They made sure to make me feel comfortable during my treatment. I’m so excited I finally found a dental practice that I really love!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristina Hoffmann
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best people in Texas. I had severe dental anxiety of any kind. But everyone at Lydian on Lamar is so welcoming, and they make you feel safe and taken care of.

Got my wisdom teeth procedure with Dr. Sharaf, it wasn’t the easiest of the extraction but Dr. Sharaf and his assistant were absolutely amazing, and patient with me and my anxiety.

I won’t be going anywhere else for my dental appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: gil garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I literally only picked this place because I noticed they had a Womb chair in the waiting area. Like, if I’m gonna wait, I’d like to wait in that. Thank you for respecting my wait time, Lydian...I feel seen. But seriously, The entire staff here is awesome. Warm, personable, confident and professional. All strong hires. The technology they use is in the office is all latest and greatest. You sign in and input all your info on an tablet, and I was really impressed at the resolution and imaging of my teeth that the hygesnist was able to show me on a big screen. The music mix is good and they offer fruit infused water, which I could care less for, but appreciate the touch none the less. You can tell people like coming here and the staff enjoy working here. Positive vibes all around.10/10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Palmer Earley
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best dentist I’ve ever been to. My teeth are stronger, healthier and look better than they have in 20 years. Dr. Josh and his amazing team make visits as painless as possible. Everybody there is super pleasant and knowledgable. They have invested in the best technology and do everything possible to make sure you’re comfortable. I’ve found my forever dentist. Thank you guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Peanick
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and doctors are amazing.  Very friend and professional staff.  There  is saying people say they'd would rather go to the dentist and get a tooth pulled instead of something else they dread.  Well i went to the dentist and got my tooth pulled and I had to pay for it. The gas was great. Would highy recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krista Fonseca
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Salehi and staff are absolutely amazing! I can honestly say that my fear of going to the Dentist is behind me.. I like it so much, I’ve been back twice in one week! All kidding aside, they are all very kind, were focused on making sure that I was understanding to my plan of care, I was comfortable during my treatments, appointment times are honored, and the follow up phone call to make sure all went well was unexpected but very much appreciated! So very thankful to you and your staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Munson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm not afraid to go to the dentist anymore! My experience here the last couple of visits has been life-changing. Dr. Whiting and my hygienist Bajareh are incredibly kind, gentle, patient, and informative. I like to ask questions and know what's going on while they work, and they entertained to let me know everything they were doing and explaining how and why. They were very understanding and gave suggestions/recommendations in a genuinely helpful and non-judgmental way. The customer service in general from front-desk to back-office is above and beyond.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annabel Mihalache
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an awesome experience here. Incredibly nice and considerate staff and very talented and knowledgeable doctor! They were EXTREMELY accommodating- they squeezed me into their tight schedule last second so I could get work done before my insurance policy ended. They seem to really care about their clients and seriously went out of their way to provide the best possible service. 10/10 would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan De León
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent service! This has been the most complete dental service I have ever had. Very good explanation of the exam from both the technician and doctor. Also, excellent explanation and treatment from the rest of the personnel.

Extra points for bilingual service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jayne Faul
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit at Lydian and I was so impressed. I called last week and they got me in within the following week. The hygienist spent about 1.5 hours with me to get a thorough check-in (multiple different x-rays, photos, cleaning etc.). She was very friendly and explained everything as she worked. The office is beautiful and has such a cool, hip Austin vibe.

user_reviews_extended.Name: S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
While I was under laughing gas they pushed a filling they had not mentioned beforehand (redoing a filling).  This should really be viewed as malpractice.  They also gave me a crown on a tooth unnecessarily when another option was available, damaging the integrity of the tooth per second opinion.

There was also a situation with an implant that took three tries to correct. Worse, not the actual implant or integrity of it from years previous,  but the substance covering the exposed metal on the crown which is a very easy placement, 15 minutes.  This coating had simply fallen off after a decade and needed to be reapplied.

Both situations were the same male dds.

I do request that I not be called anymore. I have received multiple calls today after leaving the review.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Saling
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best dental experience I've ever had and I'm no stranger to the dentist. My two front teeth are chipped and so I have had bonding on them since I was 8. I also grind my teeth really bad and have just always had a bad relationship with my teeth. Everytime I go to a dentist they always just rebond over the bonding that is already there and its hit or miss if someone can shape them properly. Never had I been suggested an actual solution until going to Lydian.

This dentist office is very well operated and the entire staff is extremely attentive and kind. You can tell everyone loves working there.

I'm grateful to Candace who consulted me on my cost and walked my through several options to make it affordable.  Dr. Josh, who luckily for me studied cosmetic dentistry came up with a long term solution for my teeth and showed me what it would look like through a digital replica on a screen. Part of my treatment is invisalign, which I just received today and have to give a shout out to Ilsa. I was late for my appointment but had to leave early and she KILLED it. She told me everything I needed to know and got me on my way so quickly and just made me feel so comfortable. I seriously couldn't recommend this dentist office more.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Centeno
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been going here for years and was pretty happy with the quality but today they tried to force me to have an Xray while pregnant. Seriously do not recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carla Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been afraid of the dentist all my life.... I was in so much pain 2 weeks ago. Then a friend referred me to Lydian Dental. Best referral ever...The staff is welcoming and friendly. The Dr is knowledgeable and informative. I love this place. I am excited about my treatment plan and can't wait to see my before and after results. I would recommend this place to anyone who has dental anxiety like I do!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sunil Mathew
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very welcoming, friendly, and customer-centric with no hard upsell after a routine cleaning (my experience with other dental practices in Austin has been somewhat unpleasant in this regard).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harold Stone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff, modern office,great place to get your dental needs taken care of!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Bolden
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great and friendly staff so far since I’ve started going!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mikhail Suris
user_reviews_extended.Description: Pleasant and welcoming experience every time! Thank you to Dr. V and Caro for taking good care of me and providing a smooth Invisalign experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Summer Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Unreal. Best dental experience I have had the pleasure to stumble across - nearly my entire office goes to Lydian, and we’re converting more every day. They are kind, competent, and exceptional. Also... Netflix during procedures??? Adorable treats gifted to my office? Lydian is the place to be, and I wish them nothing but warm and happy days to come.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Creel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful experience!!! Staff where all very polite and polished. Very cool layout for a dentist office, calmed my nerves a bit. Yes I neglected to go to the dentist for yrs. Glad I found Lydian Dental. Dr. Josh and staff are 👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Barros
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian has been providing me with orthodontic care for almost a year now. I've received great customer service throughout my experience of getting my teeth aligned with Invisalign, and through routine cleanings. They've got a great team, and I'll be going there for the foreseeable future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Smylie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always hated the dentist since I was a kid, but everyone I’ve seen at Lydian has changed that. They all have made me feel much more relaxed at my appointments and never shame you for issues with your teeth like dentists I’ve been to in the last. They take the time to explain what they’re seeing, show you the scans and what treatment plan is needed. I’ve had appointments with Krystal, Melanie, Isla, and Dr. Sirage and have not had one negative experience. I’m so glad I found this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Augustine
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really enjoy this dental office. Each hygenist has shown great care and were personable. Dr. Josh is also very friendly and someone I have a lot of confidence in while making dental plans or recommendations. I would highly recommend this dental practice to anyone seeking a reliable and positive dental experience in the area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Ramos-Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm so grateful for my peeps at Breeze! I got to meet the founder and have pics taken for the website! Lol! I really feel appreciated and taken care of here. How amazing is it to watch Netflix while your mouth is wide open!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Porsche Howard
user_reviews_extended.Description: All of the staff at this location were more than welcoming to me as a first time patient! I loved everything from the tour of the facility to the televisions at each chair to ease our minds while being at the "dentist". The experience was by far the most pleasant one that I've encountered at any type of healthcare professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben S (Ben)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful new patient experience at Lydian Dental on Lamar. Dr. Sirage and the other staff were fantastic and made an experience I was initially less than excited about extremely pleasant. I’ll be returning to this office for all of my dental care needs in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bracho Nacho
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian Dental is hip and happening. Angela, the office manager, is super nice. Had me checked in and ready to go in less than 10 minutes. Baha, my hygienist, was fantastic. Answered all of my questions about my teeth and did a great job with the cleaning. Couldn’t recommend enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Schwartz
user_reviews_extended.Description: They saw me last minute as I am from out of town. Everyone was very helpful. Dr. Saja was fantastic. They deserve the five stars.
