user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Garrison
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place!! Went there first time yesterday. Staff there were so friendly and made sure you are comfortable  Kristy the assistant was so nice and patient with me. Sarah the hygiene was awesome she was so friendly. Salisbury (sp) who took care of my tooth extraction was so patient and made sure i was comfortable. I couldnt say more about this place.  Highly recommended its also a clean place and very chic!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicholas Morgan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sarah was awesome. She was so friendly and personable. The office itself was so clean and high tech 10/10 experience!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jancy Jacob
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Lydian Dental has been amazing! The front desk staff are very helpful and friendly. Candice is always willing to answer all my question. Krystal, the hygienist, is absolutely amazing!  Dr. Josh and Mariela go above and beyond every time they work with me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Strick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ilsa and Dr. Yiana were awesome! This has been my first time to the dentist in an embarrassing amount of time but they made me feel comfortable and taken care of. The facility is cute and welcoming. Looking forward to continuing to come here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best experience I've ever had at the dentist. Their office has a  beautiful modern design and the staff is friendly, professional and made me feel right at home.  I'm actually looking forward to my next visit and who says that about going to the dentist?

user_reviews_extended.Name: michelle alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience at Lydian. Totally recommend getting treatment done with Dr.Josh. Mariela was an awesome dental assistant was super informative on my post operative instructions. Dora at the front desk did an amazing job discussing my treatment plan. 10/10 at Lydian!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Marrs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing facility and very nice staff. I definitely feel like I can trust them with my pearly whites. Last year I visited a different dentist's office that claimed I needed 5 fillings and then aggressively pushed me to get them done that day. I thought it sounded fishy so wanted a second opinion. Dr. Salehi said there was one area that could become a cavity, but it was small enough that it didn't require filling yet. What an honest assessment compared to the previous dentist I saw. Will definitely be back, everyone there was very kind and eager to answer any questions I had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Prenon Islam
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife and I have been going here for the past 2 years since we made the move to Austin. The staff is always friendly. The scheduling software is great. They have also done a great job of taking the proper precautions during the pandemic. If you’re new in town and live in the area, definitely give Lydian a try.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen S
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was first time at this place and I was really nervous because I already have a fear of the dentist. I went in to get a cap for my recent root canal and the two ladies helping me were super nice. They each were very friendly and explained exactly how the cap was going to be places and what the process was. It was very easy and I watched Netflix the entire time. I would highly reccomend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Bridges
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I've ever been too. They have TVs on the ceiling, which make the procedures so much more enjoyable. The entire staff was so nice and the office was pristine. I saw Dr. Verma and she really took her time to walk me through all my options.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Preston Grimes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best dental experience I’ve ever had. Employees were friendly and accommodating, facility was clean, and there was almost no waiting at all.

I had x-rays taken, checked for cavities, and teeth cleaning done in less than 45 minutes. Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Bass
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everything from booking to staff to equipment to processes were all top notch.

Staff was super nice, everyone. Like the people that work there actually enjoy their job. Made the experience super enjoyable. They have all of the newest equipment (coming from a former dentist that was more of a family practice and never upgraded their equipment, this was immensely appreciated). And their subscription program for 2 cleanings/checkups a year is great too (if you don't have insurance, I guess even if you do, it's affordable is what I'm saying).

AC in Austin is cold. No problem! They have a blanket if you'd like it. You get sunglasses so that you don't get blinded by the light. Decent sunglasses too, if you want to take them home with you, just ask. They of course said yes! Want to pop on some music or something on Netflix with the mounted TV screens in the ceiling - go for it! Request something or they will just throw some nice nature scenery at you.

And finally comes the 3D teeth scan. Not with that gross Play-Doh stuff, but just a modern machine that maps out your teeth in real time as they move it around your mouth. How cool and painless! Dental tech has come such a long way. I'm glad someone is upgrading.

And for those reasons, my wife and I will be going back and telling all our family and friends.

Speaking of which... They also have a referral program: not sure if they are going to like this (happy to remove it if not), but I suppose if you give them my name, they will give us both a $50 credit - a win-win! So I suppose if this review is what got you over the line, feel free to use my name. ☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Shane Sales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian Dental is great. They are fast and efficient when it comes to your dental hygiene. They are also super friendly! Aminta, Tori, and Dr. Iana are all really personable and good at their jobs. I felt at ease and in good hands the entire experience of getting my teeth cleaned as well as filling a few cavities. Great and convenient! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eduardo Cabrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: The folks at breeze dental are so helpful and nice. Marsha and Dora were at the front when I went. They made the process enjoyable and greeted me with a smile!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sierra Adkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so pleased with the entire staff at Lydian dental. They were extremely kind, knowledgable and professional. Explained everything to me very clearly and we're extremely comforting with the stress that sometimes comes with dental work. I will be recommending them to absolutely everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Femi Olasupo
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the very best customer experiences I've ever had! I wish my doctor's appointments were like this...the staff is very customer focused, kind, energetic, knowledgeable, and it's the first dental appointment I've been to where I felt like I was not only having fun but looking forward to my next visit! :-) A lot of businesses could learn from the way Lydian does it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ola Owoputi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sparkling clean, posh & very cozy dental clinic. Staffs are pretty affable, willing to help, answered all my questions, and addressed my concerns. In-house insurance program seems a good deal compared to that of other dental clinics around town. I'll choose Lydian Dental again, if presented the opportunity.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessa Lundell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Being a nervous dental patient, I was pleasantly surprised by my experience at Lydian Dental.  The ascetics and professionalism of the office and the colleagues working there immediately put me at ease.  Dr. Salehi is absolutely amazing, and the hygienists are equally impressive.  She is tremendously knowledgeable, has the best "bed-side" manner and took the time to answer all of my questions.  Not only is the office beautiful, it is state-of-the-art.  The convenience of being able to walk away with a real crown the same day of your appointment over a temporary crown is remarkable.  I never thought I would say that I enjoyed a dental experience, but it is the truth.  I can't say enough positive things about Dr. Salehi and the entire staff at the Lydian Dental.  I highly recommend this dental office for their phenomenal service and incredible expertise.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ash B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After years of being a very happy and satisfied patient of Lydian & Dr. Josh, I was finally able to talk my husband into making an appointment! My Oh My! What an incredible experience he had with the entire front office staff and Dr. Josh. If you have a dentist avoidant person in your life, please do them the favor of sending them to Dr. Josh. The care and warmth you receive when stepping into their office will make you smile every single time you make an appointment to go see them.

Thank you Lydian!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah French
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dental office is wonderful! You can tell they truly care about their patients and are passionate about what they do. Dr. Whiting and his team went above and beyond for me when they didn’t have to at all! My insurance was going to run out in two days and after a checkup it turned out I needed 3 fillings and a crown. Dr. Whiting and his tech Olga stayed after hours to get all of this done for me so I wouldn’t have to pay out of pocket. Not only that, they made me feel comfortable and at ease even though we were performing so much work in one sitting. I would recommend them a million times over.  I can’t thank them enough for going that extra mile for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Cervantes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved my experience at Lydian. Everyone is extremely nice and help you feel comfortable. The environment is really calm and relaxing which really made a difference! They were also really gentle when I got fillings which was really nervous about, but they did a great job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Solis
user_reviews_extended.Description: My kids and I enjoyed our visit. The office is nice and so is the staff. Angie, my hygienist, was pleasant and was very knowledgeable about good dental hygiene.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alison Tripp
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve never enjoyed the dentist so I put off going for an embarrassing amount of time… After reading a ton of reviews, I made an appointment with Lydian. I was met with a friendly staff that provided a very transparent and honest evaluation of my dental health. My biggest fear was someone telling me I needed a crazy expensive amount of work done, so I was pleasantly surprised to walk away without any additional work suggested.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Fredlund
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall I've had a very difficult situation with this bougie dentist. The original dentist I was seeing their recommended all of these expensive treatments and then a woman saw me the next time and she said all of that was unnecessary. They are definitely out for your money. I don't trust them. In addition, I prefer hand scaling. Nobody knows how to do that anymore. I had one hygienist there who did a fabulous job and then they gave me this girl last time I was there and she was literally terrible. My teeth didn't even look clean. I'm going to find a less bougie California dentist. I'm over it. And on top of that they kept trying to Bill me $75 for a missed appointment after they said they wouldn't. Candice corrected that and I don't have any negative thing to say about her, however, I'm going to find something that's a little less bougie and dishonest and inept

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrey Hickox
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I could not be more thrilled with my first experience at Lydian Dental! From the moment I walked through the doors 'til the moment I walked out I felt welcomed, cared for and was never left to wait. Each staff member was fantastic, thorough and efficient.

So looking forward to being a long term patient at Lydian!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dr ATX
user_reviews_extended.Description:
What a great experience.

Like so many people these days I have been putting off going to the dentist. Before moving to Austin I had been seeing the same dentist for over 20 years and wasn’t thrilled to see someone completely new and unknown. I was nervous because I knew I had a few issues, but finally sucked it up and as I drive by Lydian every day, gave them a shot. Such a good move. Just through our initial interaction on the phone I knew this place was different. Walking in to the office I was blown away, it’s so beautiful! Gone are the days of drab decor, weird smells and kids toys strewn about the waiting room. Long story short I ended up needing a crown and because the office is so high tech they can do almost anything in house. Although I came in for a cleaning Dr. Salehi took the time to get me taken care of. I guess my biggest take away here is that everyone at Lydian Dental is just so damn good at their job. They make you feel comfortable at all times, really care about what they’re doing and offer great alternatives to insurance which really says a lot about the company. Go see Dr. Salehi. You’ll be happy you did.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Marcus
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Go here for cleanings don't go for anything else. They try and sell you on needing additional services that are not 100% necessary. I went in for a cleaning about 6 months ago and they told me I needed an on-lay to my back right molar because I "grind my teeth". Despite the fact that I wear a retainer/ mouth guard. They completely botched the procedure leaving my tooth with a huge hole and made me come back the next day because "they didn't have time to fix it."

Would not recommend this dentist to any peers/family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can only say this is the best care, most compassionate dental outfit I’ve ever had the benefit of being a part of. Crystal, the hygienist in charge of my periodontal cleaning is an absolute Angel; professional, caring, diligent. She made my experience with Lydian dental something I look forward to instead of flee from!! I wouldn’t go anywhere else from now on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fred Stadelbauer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm a big fan of Lydian. The customer service is always attentive and positive from Dentist to manager to administration. They've been great with my Invisalign treatment - valuable consultation, never rush me out the door. It's a 20 minute drive for me and totally worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cait Moorhead
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is always so friendly and efficient. I’ve never had a bad experience and would highly recommend Breeze if you’re looking for a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Sivilli
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is SUPER friendly and the interior is very modern and cute. You get to watch Netflix on the ceiling while you get your teeth cleaned and everyone is transparent about what they are doing while they work on your mouth. I’ve been twice and have another appointment in 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ken Erback
user_reviews_extended.Description: I thought the whole process was professional, modern & friendly.  Jax was was excellent in what she did and making me comfortable

user_reviews_extended.Name: Autumn Reyna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely amazing, I felt comfortable and taken care of. Also, all my needs and questions were met beyond what I could imagine. I suffer from a lot of anxiety and they were so understanding.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was really great hospitality and service, people were so nice, only thing was the differences between their website and the in person experience. Website said free x-rays, and extractions up to almost $300, but then was told the basic visit was 150, then extraction was 497. Then this other thing they wanted to do was another 590.. ending bill would have been 1200 if I continued services.. Definitely not what I was looking for in "low cost dental work for dental emergencies"

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim Cook
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Fast, friendly, and efficient.
Dentist and staff were great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Seth Ellsworth
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is awesome and it smells nice but more importantly the staff and my dentist were patient, caring and took the time to listen and explain my options. I'm very happy I chose this office. I can't say enough how impressed I am with this office, and it's nice to have finally found a dentist that treated me like more than just a paycheck.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Dadds
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love my experience with Lydian! This past year I worked with them during my first treatment for Invisalign and it was great & I loved my results. The staff is always super friendly too. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Closson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been afraid of the dentist my whole life and finally decided I could go back and face my fear and found out I had quite a bit of work to be done. I have had three procedures already and I'm going back for my fourth today and I am actually looking forward to it. I have been being taken care of by Ilsa and Dr. Sirage. They make it so comfortable and fun and easy, it's changed my whole perspective on dentistry. Last time I went, I was so comfortable that I started falling asleep while I was getting teeth drilled.

I highly recommend checking out Lydian if you have the same fear I did, this place is the best and hopefully you're lucky enough to get Ilsa and Dr. Sirage as your providers!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Myra Austin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing service! Karina and Dr Verma did a great job with my husband and I. Personally I have a lot of anxiety at the dentist and I can’t say enough how much I actually enjoyed it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosie D
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have a lot of anxiety regarding needles and just being at the dentist in general. Dr. Whiting and his entire office were very kind, had incredible patience, and were very accommodating. I have a bit more work to do and I am so glad I found their office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trevor Grant
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellently experience! They were very thorough and we're happy to elaborate any time I had questions. The Dentist was very friendly and got to know me a bit before beginning her exam. The facilities are also very nice. Nothing bad to say.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachael Choplick
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Lydian Dental! The front desk offers is extremely courteous and has helped tremendously with insurance paperwork. I went to Lydian dental after a few years of not going to the dentist regularly. They have helped me fall back in love with my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blair Kessler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clean and professional dentist. Could not be more pleased with the service and responsiveness. Nice to have in the neighborhood. Thanks to Sydney & team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cary Mead
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian Dental on Lamar in Austin, Tx was a great place to go for my dental needs.  I was on an out-of-state vacation and they did an excellent job fitting me in to do an emergency crown.  I was impressed with their state of the art equipment and their professional and caring dental team.  I wish they were in my home town, because I’d return to them if I could.  I recommend them highly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eden Hirsche
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Lydian Dental! I’ve always had a fear of the dentist but I’m never scared when I go to Lydian. They’re super gentle, kind, and provide such a wonderful environment overall. You get to watch Netflix using Beats headphones which is also a great perk. :) I recommend everyone in Austin go to Lydian!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitrin Cassie Bishop
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr.Tarek Sirage is an exceptionally skilled and knowledgeable dentist, with an especially friendly, approachable demeanor  By paying the utmost attention to every detail, and offered a clear explanations each step of the way, he clearly intent on gaining a better understanding of my dental history and current needs.
Similarly, the dental hygienist I met with was top notch.
With an outstanding staff, an especially conducive environment and an very convenient location, Lydian Dental Lamar is by far the best dental practice I have been to in here in Texas, (Connecticut or Spain, for that matter)!
I'm very thankful to have found this great dental practice, and look forward to going back in a couple months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexa Lund
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cant speak highly enough about Dr Josh at Lydian Dental. I have extreme anxiety when it comes to dental work and struggled for years to find the right dentist. They have made me feel comfortable and thoroughly discussed all of my options and what makes the most sense.
I had years of lingering work that needed to be done and they worked quickly and knocked most of it out in just a few visits.
Most importantly, there are TVS with Netflix on the ceilings that you can watch and tune out during your appointment :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hector R
user_reviews_extended.Description: Courteous and pleasant office. Felt well taken care of and any discomfort or pain addressed. Exam was thorough and appreciated the run down of treatment plan. Treatment has been fantastic so far! Great team all around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Reiling
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is great! I had to get two fillings done and was in and out in about 30 minutes. They are very accommodating, professional, and will work with you on payment if you need them to. They also have TVs on the ceiling so you can watch Netflix to drown out all those uncomfortable noises that the tools make- it makes the experience much more comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marina Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Iana and staff were friendly and mindful of my anxiety while carrying out my procedures, but I have had a terrible experience on the administrative side. Receiving incomplete and incorrect financial estimates that included procedures not discussed or necessary, not sending prescriptions before my procedure in a timely manner and then sending it to the pharmacy the morning of my operation, and not implementing my payment plan in a timely manner nor providing all the necessary dental records to my insurance provider. There have been so many errors and items overlooked which is unfortunate and so stressful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Quintero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super friendly staff, very organized. And open later on Tuesdays and Wednesdays which is very appreciated! Got some fillings and they have been so kind and eased my anxiety about it all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wake Up to Real Love podcast - Dawn Richard
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the receptionists to the hygienist, to the Dentist, everyone is great there!! Cool photos and branding too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathalie Nicole Iglesias
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience! I got to meet Aubrey and Dr. Josh and they’ve made my time there so pleasant. They were able to identify which problems I had with my teeth and help work out a plan that’s best. Highly recommend! Can’t wait to go back for my deep cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carly R DeDear
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great first appointment! I feel like my concerns were addressed in a very timely manner and I feel that the hygienist and dentist both knew their stuff!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Levi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very satisfied with every single visit I’ve had with the friendly staff over at Lydian in their clean, upbeat and comfortable dental office on south Lamar. They were very timely, knowledgeable, friendly and efficient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristy Barnes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian Dental is the perfect example of how a dental office should be ran and conducted. From the front desk to the back, communication is over the top. Such a friendly environment. Dr. Sirage is very good at numbing patients for treatment. I got 4 filling s on the right side today. I didn’t even know he numbed me because he was very gentle and I could not feel the needle AT ALL. They are extremely cautious when it comes to infection control. They even  offer Invisalign, zoom whitening, and same day crowns:) this is the place to be for all of your dental treatment needs…

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is trendy, relaxing, and clean. The staff are friendly and helpful. I really enjoy being able to watch a show while they work on my teeth. Makes the whole experience better and go by very fast.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Royan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Don't let the tech savvy site and patient form fool you, this team does NOT have their act together. They are all siloed: techs only do tech things, your hygienist only cleans, etc. I was initially helped quickly, scans done (even a worthless one in case I wanted to get braces as 45) and then wait for another hour before I began wandering and asking the receptionists and someone else sitting around when i would be helped. During this time, 3 men of varied colors were helped (cleaned) individually. The hygienist acted put out that I thought 40 minutes was too long of a wait. Then she started working and her tools or the electric in the area was malfunctioning. I walked out! The dentist/ owner texted and called me, saying that they love giving me good experiences and this is not their MO. She then proceeded to offer me a worthless teeth whitening (valued at $485) but not to cover my fillings. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J.R. Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Lydian team is fantastic. I was there today starting my Invisalign treatment and Ilsa was awesome. A very relaxing and smooth dentist office experience as always with them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Cavendish
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic experience!!!  I cracked a molar and found Lydian Dental got a same day appointment.  Dr. Salehi and the entire staff were incredible.  Impressive state of the art technology.  They made me a permanent crown for my tooth that day!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ankitha gadag
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The 3 stars is for the dental hygienists who are great and the office has great tech and comfy vibes. It's really the dentists who are subpar. I had fillings done here by a female dentist and my bite has never been the same since. Major regret.
The owner/dentist is always a bit more aggressive and I feel like he's trying to sell me on things I don't need. Maybe it's just me. But that lack of trust made me change dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alessandra Margello
user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved to Austin about eleven months ago and did not have a dentist here. My co workers suggested I go to Lydian for my yearly check up. During my check up I inquired about the possibility of getting veneers. Doctor Salehi told me I was a great candidate for veneers and provided me with all of the information necessary to make an informed decision. I made the final decision to get veneers in March 2019, the process consisted of four different appointments. I am extremely happy with the way my veneers turned out. I am so thankful for Doctor Salehi and the rest of the staff at Lydian for making me feel so confident in my smile! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cole
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wanted a second opinion about some work that needed to be done from another dentist office. I found Lydian Dental and I am ever so happy that I did. Dr. Whiting and staff are amazing. During my initial visit Dr. Whiting was patient with me and even went over some key things to improve the health of my teeth/gums. I ended up needing a crown and was very nervous. Dr.Whiting and Senia made my experience amazing. Very happy that I found this office. Everyone here is very happy, helpful, and kind. I don’t enjoy the dentist, but when I have to go this will be my new dentist home. Thanks again Dr. Whiting, Angela, Senia, and Baha Rah for making my experience beyond 5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marty Sampson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist office I have been to. I highly recommend. The staff is the friendliest, my hygienist Bahareh was perfect in every way - fast, painless, thorough and informative. I’ve learned something new every visit about how to take care of my teeth, I wish I was taught all of this as a child. Dr. Whiting is the nicest guy who takes his time and works painlessly. They have the nicest newest equipment. My crown was built in house with a 3D printer like device so it fit perfectly and was put in same day. It was amazing. Plus, Dr. Whiting believes in fluoride treatment so much he gives them for free. I’ve had to ask every other dentist and they charged me. 10 stars in my opinion overall!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Hanak
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly, I had the best experience I've ever had at a dentist office at Lydian on Burnet Rd, which is saying ALOT coming from me. I was very on edge about trying out a new dentist because I've had such horrible experiences in the past, but everyone who works there is so kind and caring, not to mention the office itself is so cute and modern. I'm going to look forward to going to the dentist now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: karaquebedeaux
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service, very fast and friendly staff

user_reviews_extended.Name: megan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very welcoming and very friendly staff and a very clean facility with some high-tech equipment. No more waiting for xrays to develop, it's all digital and a lot quicker than it used to be.

I had to get my first cavities done there....I have a lot of anxiety about the dentist. But, this place is a little different.

During my fillings, they gave me headphones to watch netflix, put a blanket on me to help calm my nerves, and even handed me a hot towel afterwards to clean up my face and  soothe my frazzled soul.

The staff all have wonderful, welcoming attitudes and really care for and care about their patients.

High recommendations for this place, even if it is the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Hilton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow. That's really all I can say. I can honestly say I've never been treated so well and felt so comfortable. There was no pressuring to get services. The doctor actually spent time with me and was so thorough and thoughtful. I really liked him. You've got a new patient for sure with me. Thanks again to everyone!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jack Aldridge
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very comfortable place, clean and fast. I haven't been to the dentist in nearly 20 years due to anxiety but these guys made everything easy from the start. They have Netflix and Beats by Dre headphones so you can relax while they fix your chompers

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimi Inch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent first time appointment. I felt well taken care of, the staff was friendly and the dentist was obviously an expert in his field. I would absolutely come back again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Pham
user_reviews_extended.Description: State-of-the-art clinic, but more importantly state-of-the-art hospitality and customer care! As a new patient the staff couldn't have been more welcoming. Its one thing to "hear" the assessment of your teeth, but I really enjoyed the visual aspect they have during the consultation with the scans/pictures thrown up on the TV monitors so you can actually see what they're talking about.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda McCoy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my braces tightened today. Dr. Blake is amazing- so friendly and gentle. It is always nice to see him. Jenny and the front office staff are always so helpful and personable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Noah Zeidman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Updated: after a few years, I keep coming back to Lydian even though I’ve now moved pretty far away. They’re great. Amazingly quick and efficient, for both regular appointments and other treatments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Bambini
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian Dental welcomed me so warmly and kindly as a new member to the community. They ensured I understood what they were doing and how it was going to benefit me. I felt confident in the education I received during my visit, and I appreciate the time they spent so thoroughly with me. Thank you, Lydian!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desmond Garden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot begin to tell you how much I love Lydian. I grew up without dental insurance and then had to get 3 emergency root canals which were badly done in college. Hence, I was very scared to find a dentist once I moved into the real world and received dental insurance. The staff and Lydian has always made me feel comfortable and cared for, while also really giving me all the facts about my dental health. Please, please, please choose them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martin Lyons
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was nervous about finding a new dentist after moving from Florida - but this was a great experience, start to finish! I know, at a dentist's, right!
But Jax, the hygienist, took x-rays so quickly with the most modern easy equipment ever, she was great at her job, very personable and efficient at the sane time ... and then the doctor came in, put me totally at ease, told ne hiw everything looked and what to keep an eye on ...
I left feeling really well taken care of - great place, great staff, I'll give Lydian an A+ !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kendra Wentling
user_reviews_extended.Description: So far, I’ve only had good experiences at this dentist...which says a lot because going to the dentist is stressful! They have state of the art technology, the staff is very kind, and the dentist herself is efficient and gentle. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Lovekin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Easily the best dentist experience I've had. The staff is welcoming, jovial and professional. The facility is immaculate with any service you could possibly need relating to dentistry, orthodontics or oral surgeries.

Also have a referral incentive for any friends you know scared of the dentist :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Trihub
user_reviews_extended.Description: A great place with great people.  The staff is very helpful and professional.  Their courtesy is exceptional.  Love Lydian Dental and would highly recommend this dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrey Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Aubrey did a fantastic job with my cleaning, and honestly the whole staff was amazing! 10/10 all around, and this is coming from someone who very much doesn't like going to the dentist. Theyve somehow made me look forward to my next appointment! I suspect magic, but either way, I will be coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lary Kennedy
user_reviews_extended.Description: So impressed with Breeze dental. I was a patient when they were named Lydian. Loved them then and love them now!! Love the new remodel!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I thought all hope was lost, Lydian came to my rescue! Everyone I interacted with was so kind and helped ease my anxiety for the dentist. And Dr. Iana is the best dentist I have ever had. I’m so excited to call Lydian on Lamar my new dentist here in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Katona
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am convinced the casting director of Game of Thrones works in the Lydian Dental hiring department because I have rarely seen people so perfectly fit for their roles. From reception to dental assistants to doctors, they're all wonderful. Not only do I adore these people because they're fun and caring, but they're genuinely great at their jobs, I have full confidence in them, and they make sure I know what's going on. Dr. Josh is the most attentive doctor I've ever had, and I've had surgery and other major health issues where doctors should be caring (and aren't). He's also incredibly empathetic and literally changed my life by working with me to help me afford the dental work I need so that my bottom teeth don't chip (more) due to my (former) tremendous bite issues. Special mention to Dora at reception & Theresa at everywhere bc they're stars that brighten my day every time I go in. Tyvm Candace for working with me and my finances. I have nothing but respect and warmth for people at Lydian and may your seasons all be bangers and you be exempt from a Season 8 flop like GoT xoxo

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hayley Noah
user_reviews_extended.Description: They told me I could get a refund for a night guard because it just wasn't working and was giving me jaw problems. A week and a half later I called because the refund still hadn't shown up but they said I had to talk to the dentist instead. Turns out they had decided to just get a new nightguard made instead of doing the refund without telling me or asking if that's what I wanted. So I basically had to wait two weeks to tell them no I don't want this thing you didn't ask me about and I still want my refund.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam O'Cain
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian is the best! From the front desk, to the hygienists, and the rest of the team, they always make you feel comfortable, are friendly, communicative, and provide a great experience. Would recommend to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jody Hopson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I LOVE THIS OFFICE! Definitely recommend Tori (assistant) and Dr. Josh (dentist)! I don’t usually get nervous but even if I were, Tori and Josh are soooo relaxed and informed, they made me feel like we were all just hanging out as friends! The best duo/teamwork I’ve ever seen! I got every one of my questions answered I left with so informed I could practically get a job there.

Update: Tori also placed my invisalign buttons on my teeth and not a single one fell off during my entire time using them. What a queen! Request her!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Ayers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience at a dentist I’ve ever had. The front desk staff is incredibly nice and helpful. I got a new job recently and I was having trouble finding the correct insurance information, they literally found it for me. Nothing but good things to say about this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa F
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was an interesting experience in many ways. Long story short, they spend way too much time on the fluff and not on the essentials of dentistry. The tour of the office is unnecessary and the REQUIRED selfie booth is a bit much. The actual cleaning was probably the worst that I have had. I left there wondering what I had spent the last 90 minutes doing. Did not leave with that 'just got a cleaning' feel in my mouth. If you are looking for a cute social experience with the bare minimum of actual dental work this is for you.

Update: much like another reviewer mentioned here, I was told that I had 3 cavities which was surprising because I get cleanings every six months and never had any mention of cavities. I then went back to my hometown to my primary dentist and was told that I have zero cavities... AND THAT WAS BASED ON LYDIANS XRAYS that they sent over.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nate Foss
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very happy with how my teeth turned out with Dr. Josh. I did invasalign, whitening and replaced a really old veneer with two new ones up front - all this year. Really professional from top to bottom at the office and everything turned out great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patty Koebele
user_reviews_extended.Description: From start to finish, the folks at Lydian always take great care of me. They explain everything thoroughly and completely. I get my teeth cleaned there every 5-6 months and I love it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Russell Clayton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely the best decision I made years ago was moving to Lydian. You just can’t beat the professionalism, technology on-site, quality of service, location, and vibe. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Board
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had Invisalign, dental work and teeth whitening and my service has always over the top. My teeth are the whitest and brightest ever.  Lydian Dental staff rocks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: allye tank
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best place ever! Clean facility, top notch staff, excellent dental care, etc. The dental hygienists and doctors take time to educate about proper dental hygiene, as well as listening to patient needs and working with them to provide quality care. 12/10 will definitely go there again

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kirby Kluth
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best dental experience of my life at Lydian Dental on Lamar. Aubrey was my dental hygienist for my new patient visit. In all my days of dental visits I had never left an appointment without sore gums and a broken spirit, but because of Aubrey and everyone at Lydian Dental on Lamar I walked out of their office better than when I walked in. Go to Lydian Dental on Lamar. Request to be seen by Aubrey.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Silvia Gates
user_reviews_extended.Description: Decided to take out whole family here conveniently located, staff is friendly, clean and nice, pricing seems a little high. Was a bummer we all came out each time with more work and $$ to spend, that wasn't the case at other dentist. The work they did do was well done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob Garrett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a fantastic team at Breeze!  They've created a very fun and relaxing environment which helped me relax.  Dr. Josh is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: rachel fuggiti
user_reviews_extended.Description: everyone was super nice and made me feel comfortable and answered all my questions. I don’t remember her name but the lady with the pink hair was amazing, answered all my questions, and super helpful and easy to talk to loved her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Go K
user_reviews_extended.Description: Karen and Dr Sirage are amazing. Saved my tooth and were supportive with me through my on/off invisalign  journey. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Louise Leonczyk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist. I came in with an issue I had mentioned to another dentist 6 mos prior, which had been overlooked. We were able to solve it in two visits, and I didn’t go through any pain - also Netflix in the chair is pretty awesome. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bex H
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a huge fear patient of dentists and this place is the absolute best!! They are so kind, gentle, knowledgeable and Thorough. I felt so safe and there was absolutely zero judgement. I Recommend them to absolutely anyone who needs a dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Galvan
user_reviews_extended.Description: An amazing unplanned visit in the chair.  Dr. Salehi and Lori,  without hesitation, offered to squeeze me in for a small dental issue.  The office is beautiful and clean and the staff is very friendly and they care about their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maddie Elizondo
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Lydian were extremely knowledgeable and kind. And for a girl that doesn’t love going to the dentist, Lydian made me extremely comfortable. So I will definitely keep coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Budd
user_reviews_extended.Description: Leaving a review is the Internet equivelant of basically declaring your love by shouting as loud as you can. Well, that’s what I’m doing...shouting as loud as I can about my incredible experiences at Lydian Dental. The staff remembers your name, teeth, and those little life stories you shared the last time you had an appointment, no matter how long ago it was. Do your soul and teeth a favor, visit Lydian the next time you wanna treat yourself.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Bernal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great office and staff. I’ve been seeing Amanda for years and she has always done a great and thorough job!!  Thank you Amanda and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I’ve ever been to. They really want to make sure your experience is comfortable! You can even catch up on a few episodes of your favorite shows on Netflix, or Hulu. The Doctors are knowledgeable and share what they are doing with you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kan Lamat (Vans & Villains)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t stress enough how the incredible team here really makes the difference. I’ve been here a good many times, and absolutely every single person — even those only met briefly — really leave an impression: warm, professional, and more than happy to answer any random questions I’ve put forward. I’m leaving Texas, and the only suggested improvement would be to open a new one out in Las Vegas. You’re too awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meredyth Ellington
user_reviews_extended.Description: So friendly and made my visit really comfy! The intro gift is really sweet too💖

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandria “Alex” Leyva
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Josh is super great! I am doing Invisalign and the staff is super attentive and helpful throughout the process. If I have any concerns or questions, I just call and ask to speak to someone regarding my Invisalign and there is always someone available to answer.

During my routine teeth cleaning, Aubrey, one of the hygienest, is always super nice. Any hygienest assigned to you makes great conversation and also provides tips to better your specific teeth care.

Dr. Josh also provides his own direct number for any major issues. Would highly recommend as a dentist office and if you are thinking about Invisalign!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Melomo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super helpful and informative! Took the time to help me know what was going on and assist me financially which was really stress relieving. Krystal was super sweet and made me feel very comfortable! Also got to watch Netflix while getting a deep clean. Would 100% recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Melody abs Karen were so sweet! Invisalign sent me here and told me they were under my insurance but they let me know from the very beginning that it was out of network. I was so disappointed I couldn’t stay at that office, I really wish they were in network because they were so understanding and kind!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Don Brimberry
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit to Lydian on Burnet. Everyone was very nice, friendly and professional. I felt like their dental service was very high quality, and my hygienist Buha (?) was very pleasant. Will return to this dental practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dany Magana
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was able to get me in the same day to fix a crown and were very courteous and straightforward with all the procedures and charges. Office is new and very modern and they even have Netflix at every chair for when you wait.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Stokely
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Impressive! I have had the opportunity to have services at the brick and mortar on Lamar as well as the mobile unit that visits our office.
Mobile clinic is high tech and comfortable. I have a bridge made and placed, root canal and yearly cleanings there. Sound proof headphones, a ceiling TV with Hulu, and some of the best damn staff I have ever met are a wonderful bonus for something I initially thought was going to be very bare bones. Wow!
B&m location blew me away. Such an unassuming building that opens into a large delightful and comfortable area - there's a really cool swing hanging from the ceiling in the kids section - but still obviously high tech and efficient working area. Again the staff = amazing
Overall - if the mobile visits your area, go! Insanely convienent, and very little they can't take care of. If you need the Lamar location, go! Immediately put at ease in a situation no one realllly wants to be in and you can be confident in the work all the way to handling your insurance! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roxanne Nolasco
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lydian Dental is a very welcoming office. Asia and jenny at the front desk are very nice and professional. My tech was very friendly and explained everything thoroughly. Overall great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia. Lynn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a full day if dental work done…and throughout the procedures I was asked about my comfort…the folks are very attentive and organized. They work hard to make the experience as painless as possible…and all the folks have lovely personalities.

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Hunt (Ryan)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dental office is really nice and they are really great. They really tried to upsell you quite a bit on everything which is pretty common I guess unfortunately. But they do a great job if you can ignore the other stuff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Guillermo Murcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: As soon as I walked through the doors the staff was super friendly and accommodating. Went in for Invisalign and they were very informative and walked through the entire process. So excited to see the end result :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doug Keenan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Each visit to Lydian Dental has been a positive experience. I am happy with the services received and will recommend them to friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Olivero
user_reviews_extended.Description: As good a time as one can possibly have at the dentist. Everyone was patient and pleasant and accommodating. I knew what was going on, what was about to happen and why and there was a constant sense that any question I had we could stop for an answer. Thank you very much, great team and I look forward to having this be my dentist for years to come!

user_reviews_extended.Name: NayDeSancho
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn’t been to the dentist in quite a long time, and this office made it very easy for me! Everyone was very nice, and the experience was fast and smooth. They even offer Netflix if you’re bored or want your mind occupied lol!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Naples

user_reviews_extended.Name: ian rosi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My 18 year old was in the process of finding a new dentist to treat several cavities. Like many, dentist visits cause her trauma. Last Tuesday, she had an appointment with Dr. Salehi at Lydian. She liked her so they agreed to do two sessions to complete the work to avoid as much trauma as possible.

The next day, Wednesday, the Lydian office called to ask if another doctor could replace Dr Salehi. My daughter agreed.

So on Thursday, she leaves for her appointment and returns a few hours later in tears. Apparently, Dr Josh Turnbull wasn't aware of the agreed upon treatment plan. Not only did he treat all of the cavities instead of half as discussed with the first dentist.. but he also asked her permission to do a crown while she was in the chair!

Luckily she was aware enough to decline until speaking with her parents!

I called Lydian, spoke with the dentist(Josh Turnbull). He apologized for not knowing the treatment plan but not for just pushing a last minute Crown.

We went to another dentist for a second opinion...and that dentist said there was NO need for an immediate crown.

To top it off, I told Dr.Turnbull that he literally made my daughter cry... He offered to apologize to her but has yet to do a darn thing.

I would avoid this dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Yes, they go to great lengths to make you comfortable.  I was provided sunglasses to block the bright exam light, Netflix to watch on the ceiling tv, beats headphones to hear said tv, a blanket because it’s cold outside. But- when the dentist lacks basic bedside manner, all of that ‘extra’ is just fluff.  I received 2 crowns today.  There was a lot of drilling, 35 minutes constant.. timed along with the Netflix episode I had on.  When the drill nicked the inside of my lip, the drilling stopped and instead of admitting to the accident, she said maybe the instruments pinched me.  Possible I suppose so I shrugged it off.  2 hours later I’m in the car, feeling some kind of pain, look at the inside of my lip in the mirror and can clearly see the nick.     I have a small mouth, it’s a tight space.. but I am certainly no stranger to dental work or the drill, and don’t ever appreciate being lied to.
And if the crown doesn’t fit, please don’t start to drill along an existing, opposing crown.  And especially without discussing this first. Honestly

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve carried a fear of the dentist since I was a teenager—mostly because of the pain. Even when I found a hygienist who made my cleanings comfortable (and even enjoyable), I still dreaded going.

When she moved to Breeze Dental and recommended Dr. Sirage, I decided to follow her—and that decision changed everything.

For the first time, the fear and pain I used to associate with dental visits has faded. Dr. Sirage is honest, skilled, and genuinely cares about his work. There’s no pressure, no unnecessary treatments—just trust.

I never thought I’d say this, but I actually look forward to going to the dentist now.

If you’ve been putting it off because you’re scared or had bad experiences, I hope this gives you the push to try again. This place is different.

title: Emergency Dentist of Austin
address: 1030 Norwood Park Blvd #324, Austin, TX 78753, United States

user_reviews.Name: Shahidah H
user_reviews.Description:
I had to have a tooth pulled and was referred to see an oral specialist, but I found Emergency Dentist of Austin instead — and I’m so glad I did. I was able to get a same-day appointment, which was such a relief.

From the first phone call, Amber gave me so much helpful information and made me feel completely at ease before I even scheduled. Dr. Smitherman and Savannah were phenomenal — kind, transparent, and thorough. They went over all my options and even asked questions other dentists never asked. That really stood out to me.

The extraction was quick and smooth, and they completely took away my fear of extractions. Both receptionists were incredibly sweet and welcoming as well.

If you’re nervous about dental work, this is the place to go. They truly care about their patients, and it shows. I truly appreciate each and every one of you ❤️❤️❤️❤️

user_reviews.Name: Freya Hilinski
user_reviews.Description: I had to come in for a possible infection, and the staff were great! Amber took awesome care of me, and made sure I understood the procedures and what would go into them, as well as how to navigate my insurance. Very grateful they’re open on weekends as well so I’m not having to take as much time off of work.

user_reviews.Name: Kayla Rae
user_reviews.Description: Here for an emergency extraction, everything has been smooth and staff straight to the point. Luckily found the right emergency dentist to get same day work. Amber and Dr. Dudeen have been very helpful. Will use this clinic for emergency services going forward.

user_reviews.Name: Steven Mufalli
user_reviews.Description: I entered in so much pain I could barely think, because of this my blood pressure was soaring, and I was feeling extremely frustrated. This crew went out of their way to make me feel comfortable and relaxed, until I was ready for my extraction. Everything went quick and smoothly, and I appreciated all their patience with me during my visit. Dr. Smitheran was excellent, Amber and Maggie were so helpful in making me feel calm and relaxed, and the manager Raouf was extremely kind and understanding with his pricing to help meet my needs in this emergency situation.

I highly recommend this practice for anyone facing an emergency or looking for quality dental care!

Tyler and Dr. Smitherman were thorough and took the time to explain everything clearly. Monse, my treatment coordinator, was supportive and friendly, making the process stress free. I never felt pressure to undergo any procedures I wasn't comfortable with. Check in was quick and easy. The front desk team, along with Manager Raoof, provided outstanding service. I highly recommend this practice for anyone facing an emergency or looking for quality dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: CodyT O
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a broken tooth that needed a crown, and the entire experience was great from start to finish. The dentist did excellent work and explained everything clearly, which really helped put me at ease. The crown looks and feels natural. Every staff member I interacted with was friendly, helpful, and professional. You can tell they genuinely care about their patients. I highly recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience I've ever had at the dentist today. My technician Amber and Dr S were able to talk me through my anxiety and I handled this better than I ever have. There was no judgment for my dental needs and I feel better about going to the dentist now. Thank you for helping me in my time of need.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Peltz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just wow! I live and hour from this location. I have a dental phobia and have seen 4 doctor's in my area,m before coming here (all of them said I need to be sedated for my procedure (extractions). Not only was I scheduled within the following morning (Sunday), but the doctor was absolutely very kind and explained the procedure and process in a way I've never heard. Yes, I was still scared, but the doctor somehow took that fear away from me. I'm 45yrs old! I've been dealing with dental phobia since I was 19yrs old. 4 dentists   that sent me out, to having my procedure done within the hour of arriving here. I can't thank you enough. Literally,  thank you. You took my pain away. You helped me overcome my fear. The staff and the nurse that assisted were also very kind. 100% recommend this wonderful place to anyone anyone.  Then the payments were so flexible! ❤️ 😍  Thank you guys! Ya'll are the best 👌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ms Kimberly
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amber was absolutely amazing while helping my son, James, with his dental work. From the moment we arrived, she showed so much patience, kindness, and professionalism. She made sure James felt comfortable, explained everything clearly, and truly went above and beyond to ease his anxiety and pain.

As a parent, it meant everything to see someone treat my child with such care and compassion. Amber’s support made a stressful situation so much easier for our family. I am beyond grateful for her help and highly recommend her to anyone needing dental care. Thank you, Amber, for everything you did for my son!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Beware 5 star reviews, they pressure you into leaving one before you leave the office. user_reviews_extended.Name: christian bass
user_reviews_extended.Description:
had a great experience here. The staff explained everything clearly — from the finances to what was going on with my tooth — and made the whole process way less stressful. They were able to get me in same-day for a wisdom tooth extraction plus the tooth in front of it, and the entire procedure was quick and straightforward. Everyone was professional, patient, and took the time to answer every question I had.

If you’re in pain and need fast, reliable dental care, I definitely recommend Emergency Dentist of Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Unplanned admissions / issues are the absolute worst…..I can’t say enough good things about Emergency Dentist of Austin and how they handled ours. My son (9) had about half of his front tooth knocked off while playing with friends. I quickly called around and found Emergency Dentist of Austin and raced over there….Sunday afternoon, right before the Super Bowl. Time is critical when bonding tooth parts together and they were able to get us right in. My son had never so much as had a cavity to this point, so it was a lot to process. Sincere thanks to the young woman at the front, the dental assistant, and the dentist…..you all did so much to both alleviate my son’s anxiety and ensure a great outcome. There is absolutely no visible evidence of the fractured tooth and he said he feels great.

Thank you!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: V H.A

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jay Harvey
user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jan V
user_reviews_extended.Description: My tooth and crown broke off and I don't do my normal dental care in Austin.  It was a relief to find this emergency dental care option.  It was quick and easy to schedule my appointment and I was very satisfied with the care they provided.  Their admin staff was also responsive and helpful related to questions and requests I had when filing my insurance claim.  I hope not to have to use them again, but would not hesitate to return to them if another emergency arises.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nelson Click
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was an emergency and I was in pain.  They took me in quickly and we had to pull the tooth as it was infected.  They gave me two shots to numb me up.  I'm not going to lie.  It was a little traumatic as it was a front tooth and I felt it a little.  Not a fault of the excellent doctor, Dr Smitherman'; who worked deftly to get this rotten painful sick tooth out of my head. God Bless her.  A shoutout to Savannah; who comforted me like a guardian angel when I was sitting there crying. She is in the right vocation, for sure. She was kind and understanding.  Second shoutout to Nova who helped with all the paperwork.  She didn't mind walking me through it all for the dunce that I am.  She truly wanted to help.  To be honest, it was a beneficial experience but I hope I never have to visit an emergency dentist again but thankful they exist because it was the only alternative.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sierra Tressler
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the front desk to the doctor, everyone was so sweet and attentive. I felt heard, cared for, and very comfortable the entire time. The doctor was professional and reassuring. I would absolutely return!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sue Bee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in, in terrible pain and not a nice or happy camper. I can say, with Amber's attentiveness, patience and just being nice,  she and Dr Dudeen, made sure I was comfortable and definitely in better mood then when I got there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Antoinette Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I Love every staff member, especially Dr. Dudeen and his special assistant with the beautiful teeth  Maggie. The front staff awesome beautiful smile. Highly recommend using them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelina Gamez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in for a cavity. Dr Dudee was great. Definitely has a strong personality but overall i truly feel as if he did a great job. The dental assistant Cici was amazing. So sweet and attentive and over all great service. Thank you guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Ceccato
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amber and Dr. Smitherman were great! Had root canal pain, and they adjusted my crown and made me feel a lot better and calmer. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: blake sayers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience at this emergency dental office. The staff was truly amazing—kind, patient, and incredibly professional. The quality of their work was impeccable, and they made a stressful situation feel so much easier. I would highly recommend this office to anyone needing prompt, reliable dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margarito Avila
user_reviews_extended.Description: I received a very good service at The Emergency Dentist of Austin clinic. I had a bad tooth bothering and they ended up removing it. It was fast and no pain. I highly recommend Doctor Dudeen and her assistant Ambar.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kath
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The RDA Janie and Dr. Dudeen were excellent. Janie answered all of my questions before I could even think of them! I really appreciated her keeping me in the loop about what was happening and why. I think I actually learned a few dental facts leaving my appointment 🤣 Janie knows her job very well, and if she’s on the path to becoming a doctor she will do amazingly! And if she’s not…she should! The two made sure all my concerns were addressed and I was pain free before leaving.

Now the reason I docked the rating 2 stars…

I will preface this by saying I am not one to complain and most of the time sidebar conversations don’t bother me. I’m a retail manager so I understand how things can be with customers. However, both the person I came with and myself were off put by the service at reception. Today is 12/7/25 and I was at the office from 8:50a-11:30a. The two receptionists (not trying to put them on blast btw) were both teenagers/young adults, one brunette and the other had red dyed hair. Didn’t catch their names.
The brunette was either new to working there, or just didn’t know the job well. I understand not knowing things or being unfamiliar, but she didn’t make up for that with professionalism or hospitality. First she accused me of calling the wrong office before I could even finish my sentence. I had called 45 mins earlier and I was seen yesterday…so no, I was not at the wrong location. Then after a moment of confusion told me to sit down. Again, I am NOT one to complain, so for this to bother me enough to write about, it definitely left a negative impression on the office’s reputation.
The entire time I was waiting, the two were having conversations that shouldn’t take place on the floor. The person waiting for me now knows what the girls’ dads are getting for Christmas, who to go to for eyelash lifts, and about the sale going on at Ulta where you get a free blanket. Among other things! Not only were they loud enough to where the person I was with was practically a part of the conversation, I was told they never stopped talking once and it was never about work. It would be fine if they were actually working while doing so, but it was just social hour. The brunette even complained about how bored she was. The office was dirty and dusty so she could’ve been sweeping or vacuuming lol!
The receptionists yesterday were more professional but the entire receptionist crew as a whole gave off mean girl energy. The two today were gossiping about another receptionist and how she never does her work and never admits when she’s wrong. They then played a game about the most annoying things customers do. The brunette goes, “i HATE when they ask about insurance!!” um? hello? you’re working in a medical facility (where I was charged $5k for a root canal lol) of COURSE people are worried about that! Regardless, if you feel that way about customers, keep those conversations in the back OFF the floor.
The brunette at one point apologized to the doctor (or some guy) about how she wasn’t laughing at him earlier, her and the other girl were just playing a game about a list that kanye west also has (his betrayal list i think????) and when he walked in she had just got the text from the other girl and it made her laugh. She must’ve been talked to right before we got there. Not once did they talk about work related things! The single moment of silence was when she left the desk for a bathroom break.

The medical team who assisted me were professional and great. The teenagers up front need coaching and clearly more things to do. But hey if you’re looking for a lash tech, miss girl definitely knows someone she can refer you to! :D

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan Barrientes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr , Dudeen, Janie, and Adi here were very patient with me, worked out a payment plan I could afford and was taken care of same day.  Wish I could’ve  saved the tooth but the extraction process was fast and painless. Will be back again. 🙏🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: Water Mouse
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Yikes, dentists appointments.  I am seriously so deathly afraid of dentists i put it off, unfortunately for to long.  This is a review for Dr Dudeen and Amber.  Friday night i had severe tooth pain,  the pain that shocks your whole skull, i thought i would have to live through pain until Monday but then i found this place.  Immediately booked an appointment and got in when i wanted to go in,  seriously they are genius to operate on a FRI-MON schedule and we thank you!.  I had to get 2.5 extractions and while i have bad dental anxiety, it was over in a flash.  I still twitch during visits and i hate that but Dr Dudeen and Amber made me feel super comfortable.  Also Dr Dudeen, Aretha Franklin, really?  How do you not know her,  ha ha.
I recommend this place and it's the only place open on weekends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Avril Cardenas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Full disclosure: I am actually the office manager for this location, but I thought it would be an interesting experience to put myself in the patients shoes for once. I still had my wisdom teeth as of today, but I decided to put myself in the care of Dr. Dudeen today and finally rid of these teeth I should have taken out ages ago. The team was as compassionate as always and reassured me along the way as I too, as many patients have shared, can get quite anxious in the dental chair… which is probably why I had not gotten my wisdom teeth removed until now. Dr. Dudeen was speedy and efficient, I did not feel an ounce of pain and he was very careful to ensure I was comfortable during the procedure by checking in with me as much as possible, I am extremely happy to know this is the care patients get everyday. Angelica (one of our amazing RDAs) assisted with the procedure and was precise and caring throughout the whole process, explaining to me very well how to take care of the site post-op. Finally, the front office team (Nova, Maggie and Alfredo) were very supportive and very excited to learn about how it feels to be a patient in the care of EDoA. I am excited to be able to have even more extensive knowledge on exactly how every single step of a wisdom tooth extraction feels and looks like for a patient, and most of all, I am very excited to share that I am very confident in the expertise and compassion of this team and that we will ensure you are in good hands with us!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christie Zamarripa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Emergency Dentist of Austin office on Norwood Pkwy Austin, TX is AMAZING!  They saw me today, Sunday afternoon/evening for severe tooth pain that gradually became worse throughout the weekend.  I called at 3:30pm & they saw me right away at 4:30pm.  Based on the panoramic x-ray and exam, I needed an immediate extraction and again, right away prepared me for the procedure.  I felt no pain, the tooth was out in minutes.  The cost was absolutely affordable & I was not charged for unnecessary things.  Staff, Dentist, & Dental Assistant were professional, thorough, kind and compassionate.  I was given a completely realistic treatment plan, along with care instructions.  Thank you Emergency Dentist of Austin, you guys came in CLUTCH!! 🤩🌸🤩

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Smitherman and Sura were amazing and explained my options. The staff in general were great and super sweet. The appointment was easy to book and they were very fast.

user_reviews_extended.Description:

In one week I had my new veneer on and it was a perfect match. I was there less than an hour for them to make a great solid fit. Next day I am now off on a trip to Mexico for my anniversary with beautiful teeth!
I highly recommend them and think they were very professional and responsive.

user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is awesome. Sunday; March 5, I got scheduled for an appointment from the night before. My doctor was so quick at getting out a very complicated tooth. So happy with the service and the tech who did my XRays and who championed the doctor as he really did an incredible job. There were a couple girls back there who weren’t working with me, but they ignored making eye contact with me, and they were also the same women who were speaking so loudly when I was trying to relax, and when I made mention of being ready to get started, the girls yelped in laughter as if I was high. user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was so amazing and definitely painless I was shocked and enjoyed everything actually I wish I could make them my regular dentist

user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for a wisdom tooth consultation, everything was clear and up front. I have severe anxiety and they put me at ease. Looking forward to continuing with routine care. You guys rock!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shiba Studios
user_reviews_extended.Description:
While in Austin for the eclipse, I ended up with a split molar.  It had to be extracted.  It split, of course, on a Friday night.  I stumbled upon this place while searching in desperation on Saturday night, filled out some online forms, and had a 10 am Sunday appointment.  That was fantastic.  As far as the place, they did a really good job explaining everything to me and a perfect job executing on the extraction.

Let me add a note on the billing.  Another reviewer said they were charged a large amount before their procedure and never got refunded.  That was not my experience.  For my issue, they couldn’t tell until they dug in whether I needed the root canal (expensive) or an extraction (cheaper).  I too paid the higher amount but I ended up needing only the extraction.  I got refunded the difference on the same day that the charges posted.  No problems.

The reason I can’t give five stars, and maybe some opportunities to improve are:

1.  They only prescribe ibuprofen for the pain afterwards.  This doesn’t really cut it.  I get it though, narcotics =risk.

2.   They don’t take any insurance.  It would be nice if they were in network but I understand.  Their business model maybe can’t support all the paperwork and reimbursement delays, caps, etc.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cory Pugh
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are amazing and took very good care of me didn't take to long thank you everyone

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eba Bejarano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow! Dr. Campbell is so kind and a master at his craft. His staff were all very accommodating and supportive. Their office hours are Friday through Sunday if you happen to need a dentist 🦷 for an emergency tooth situation. Alandra, Ellaine, Salma, Dalyceth and Gyani were so caring and they each get 5 stars ⭐️ in my book! I highly recommend coming to Emergency Dentist of Austin for any dental emergencies.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel T

user_reviews_extended.Description: It was overall a great experience. Everyone was so welcoming and helpful. I brought my daughter with me and they made it a memorable experience for her.
