user_reviews_extended.Name: Breanne MacNaughton
user_reviews_extended.Description: If I could rate this office lower, I would. Avoid unless you absolutely have to come here for an emergency and no other options are available. I came in for a tiny chip in my front tooth that happened on a tooth with old composite bonding just on the bottom edge. I was leaving town on a Monday morning and was needing the tiny area smoothed out on the weekend, or I would’ve of course visited my normal dentist. It was not even noticeable cosmetically because of how tiny the chip was, but sharp on my tongue, so I thought it would be a super safe fix to have it smoothed until I could address the chipped bonding later on (if I even wanted to—again, wasn’t noticeable). The dentist smoothed the affected area as expected, but unfortunately, he filed the tooth next to it as well which had no damage or issues whatsoever when I came in. It was my natural tooth with no composite bonding, and it’s now a totally different shape than when I came in, and is way worse than the minuscule chip I went it to fix. The tooth (the one he incorrectly filed away) is not only a different shape, but now this creates a gap in between my teeth that was not there before—all of this that I’m referring to is unrelated to the actual chipped tooth I needed to be smoothed (that part is fine). This is extremely unfortunate that a natural tooth next to the affected tooth was filed in error, but I understand mistakes can happen so I let the dentist know straight away while in the office, as well as called back later when I was really able to confirm my natural tooth (next to the chipped one) was filed in error. All I asked is that I receive a refund for the just the service cost—I was okay to pay for the exam cost—to account for this permanent mistake that I now have to go elsewhere and pay hundreds of dollars to correct. And it’s not even what I went in there for! They were not willing to work with me or provide any sort of resolution, and did not own up to their mistake—this is the part I take the most issue with. They keep claiming that, because it was bonding material, it just “came off” and this is what caused the gap. This is 100% false because the tooth that they’re referring to had no bonding and was fully my natural tooth, and it’s a totally different shape than before now. They’re acting like I don’t know what my teeth looked like (as if I don’t have pictures of my smile before to prove it) or like this was somehow my fault for having bonding on my front tooth, even though that’s not the part they filed away in error. It’s insane to not be willing to own up to it or be willing to refund a small service cost ($150). I regret my decision to come here so much and my tooth will never be the same 😔 Do not come here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liv Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called and made an appointment for a consultation and extraction, they were the only dentist open on a sunday and the pain i was experiencing was excruciating! Maggie was very calm and quick to send the necessary paperwork for me to fill out before I came in for my appointment, and Nova helped me figure out a payment plan that worked for me as hastily as possible (not out of negligence, but because they could tell I needed the procedure to begin as quickly as possible!). While waiting for the procedure, my pain intensified substantially and Dr. Dudeen was kind enough to administer topical anesthesia a bit earlier than usual which I can’t even put into words how relieving that was after 72 hours of nonstop intense and searing pain. Juana has great bedside manner and candor, which pairs very well with Dr. Dudeens calming and conversational approach. I felt reassured about the brevity of the procedure and they took good care to check in on my level of sensitivity throughout. Juana talked me through aftercare and Nova and Maggie helped me set up an appointment to get stitches removed on my way out. Honestly the best experience i’ve had at a dental clinic, and to be frank, i’ve had more than my fair share. Hats off to these saints!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marlen Contreras
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place definitely recommend it especially if tooth ache happens during the weekend dentist open Saturday and Sunday.hands up to all the staff especially Adi who helped with financials and communication on understanding different options.

The technician reassured us that there are payment plans and ways they have to pay so it’s not too stressful.

Overall: Great communication. Tidy clinic. Charismatic staff. Unfortunately they couldn’t help our situation as desired but were able to direct us to a professional who might can help. Also, I’m sure they could benefit someone else who may need a quick cleaning or consultation as they are well resourced and knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evan Reid
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend!! I am new to Austin & have yet to establish a dentist here, so I was freaking out when I had a dental emergency over the weekend where my front tooth broke in half & one of my dental implants was messed up. I was luckily able to get an appointment here on Saturday at 8am. The staff was so helpful & friendly and the location was very well kept. Dr. Smitherman was amazing! user_reviews_extended.Description: Not only were they able to fit me for an emergency wisdom tooth extraction, but they also made things as calm as possible. My dentist communicated everything she was doing and was done in about 15-20 minutes. I hardly felt the injections and everyone was so kind and not aggressive about pricing at all. My nurse was so kind and took her time going over the post op care information and prescriptions. Definitely would recommend to anyone feeling uneasy about emergency dental work especially tooth extractions! I showed up anxious and bawling, I am comfortably back home typing this review with minimal pain!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Platt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sura and Isabella were great help, very friendly. Doctor was comforting and informative!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Really nice folks who helped me out during an emergency with a broken tooth that was infected. Got in and out within a couple hours, and the cost was reasonable. I’m one day post-op and feeling a lot less pain than yesterday after the extraction, and hopefully continue to improve from here out.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t usually leave reviews, but I felt this experience needed to be shared. I was asked to pay for my office visit up front, and when I explained that I wasn’t able to, the assistant just stood there silently for a couple of minutes before bringing someone else over—without any explanation. user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Gill
user_reviews_extended.Description:
dismissive, negligent, sloppy, and incorrectly advertised.

went in due to the option of a payment plan, and horrible jaw/tooth pain, was told i’d only need to pay the $90 to get seen then can pay the treatment overtime. nope, i was quoted $1500 + $50/month for two years to even start treatment, and that was only for some cavities which wouldn’t even help the pain. dentist kept ignoring me, turns out i need 4 extractions along with all of the cavities filled & 3 caps.
don’t get me wrong, i understand that this isn’t an office equipped to perform impacted tooth surgery (but the others could’ve been removed lol), if it weren’t for the dr interrupting, ignoring my issues, and the scheduling team straight up lying to me i wouldn’t be giving a bad review. i expected to at least have some sort of relief that would work with my budget, instead i got a “eh we can fill your cavities for $1500 down but no it won’t help the pain” and when asked if it looked infected a literal “i dunno maybe”
grossly exaggerated their capabilities & mislead their ability to work with a budget. i was already aware of most of the issues, infact they didn’t even catch half of them. now im out $100 just to find out dentists can’t do dentist things i guess.

when i declined cavities being filled for that price i was perscribed some advil.  (and finally amoxicillin because i kept pushing for SOMETHING to help, this isnt normal pain and i was worried my tooth was infected) & that was it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Prince
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This review is for Emergency Dentist of Austin located at 1030 Norwood Park Blvd
Unit 324
Austin, TX  78753
United States

I came into this facility on a Saturday because my dentist was closed. It turns out I have a fractured tooth which is causing excruciating pain. I’d been awake for 18 hours as the onset of this pain occurred at midnight. Since then, I have been taking 800 mg of ibuprofen every six hours. This has effectively done nothing to help. So my options as provided by the dentist were to have a referral to an endodontist, a bite force reduction which had already been done last Wednesday, or an extraction. I have had a few teeth extracted in my life. It hurts like hell for a few days. This dentist, as a solution for pain management, post surgically, was ibuprofen. Refused any other options. I can’t believe that I’m going to have to suffer until Monday because this dentist refuses to prescribe hydrocodone. To force someone to remain in pain either awaiting the appointment for an endodontist, or post surgically, is absolutely incontrovertibly barbaric.

I do not recommend this dentist office. Dr. Smithman (or maybe Smitherman) should be absolutely ashamed of herself. I have no other options but to suffer with level eight on a 1 to 10 scale of pain until Monday due to the psychopath thinking it’s funny to withhold pain management/control measures from a patient who desperately needs it.

I am a 50 year old commercial truck driver who possesses hazmat and tanker endorsements, with no history of substance abuse, subject to frequent drug screening and she wants to withhold perfectly justifiable pain management? Even pulling the tooth and offering two days of pain relief from the surgery would have been adequate. Maybe 8 tablets if taken every 6 hours would have been fine. I understand there is an epidemic of opioid abuse but this situation exceeds ridiculous.

She left me in AGONY, which I’m still in at present, awaiting my dentist to open at 0730 Monday morning. I pray he has an availability for me because this is horrible. All because a power tripping dentist refused to help a patient in pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika F
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m so happy I found this gem! My crowns fell out and my tooth was very sensitive. Was quickly seen the following day and it was a relief to know that this place was available on the weekends. My new go to place for emergency’s!  Thanks to Dr. Dudern and Michelle for taking care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tania Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I  can’t recommend Emergency Dentist of Austin enough! I was in town for the Texas v. Clemson game when I had I pretty much flew off a scooter late Friday night and knocked out a tooth. It was a holiday weekend, and finding a dentist to see me on a Saturday morning felt impossible—until I called here. They were pretty much fully booked, but after hearing my situation, they managed to get me in at 10 AM and immediately jumped into action.

Dr. Smithermann, CC, Nova, and the entire team (I wish I remembered everyone's names, but y'all are the bomb!) were incredibly thorough, answered all my questions, and made sure I felt at ease every step of the way. Their bedside manner was spectacular—so caring and attentive. They took X-rays, examined my tooth (which I’d managed to reinsert myself that night prior to coming in), and splinted it to keep it stable. They even prescribed antibiotics and provided clear follow-up instructions for my home dentist. The visit fee was just $89, and the total cost beyond that was absolutely reasonable, especially considering the extent of my situation.

The clinic was clean, the payment options were patient-friendly, and the staff truly cared. I’m so grateful for how understanding they were and how hard they worked to help me. I was in and out in under 2 hours and still made it to the Texas v. Clemson game! If you ever need emergency dental care or any dental care for that reason, I’d recommend them 100%. I would even drive back from my hometown to come see them for dental work, if necessary!!!! 10/10 experience! Thank you again! <3

user_reviews_extended.Name: Missy Lyttle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went to get a healing cap screwed back in - they took me in right away and were so kind and patient through the whole process! Hannah was so sweet and explained everything, helped me stay calm, and made a scary dentist visit into a great experience. Thanks so much, y’all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got it last minute, was seen quickly. Wasn’t upsold a fix I didn’t need, was told the tooth might heal in its own and to just keep an eye over the weekend. Doctor even offered to let me take a 20 minute nap in the chair after if I needed it as I have a 1 week old at home lol. Great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: chanandler bong
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got a same day appointment but managed to reschedule to the next afternoon, last minute when personal issues came up, with no penalizing - huge bonus. Everyone was extremely professional, helpful and efficient. Seems like this location can't operate on the more impacted teeth but I got an emergency referral to somewhere that can, and was prescribed antibiotics which already have me feeling 500x better than I have the last 2-3 weeks (after various urgent cares didn't take my symptoms seriously). Would 1000% come back here for any dental needs

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Horrible practice. I would recommend finding anywhere else to go. I was made to wait for 50 minutes past my appointment time without so much as an acknowledgment of my wait. Once I was finally seen I was taken to the “room.” This was a completely public area where other patients were walking by and could see my x-rays and hear discussions of procedures and finances. It was humiliating.

As for the examination, the doctor spent less than 30 seconds looking at my tooth and just said “you need an extraction.” No explanation or elaboration. I was then told the treatment specialist would see me to discuss. The “specialist” was the receptionist who just gave me the price with again no details to the procedure. All of this for a waste of $90. Being made to wait 50 minutes to be seen for 5 was beyond frustrating. After choosing to forgo treatment the “treatment specialist” asked if I wanted antibiotics. I asked her if I needed them and she simply said “well it’s included in the $90, if you want a perscription.” I asked if the doctor thought I needed them and she said “if you want you can have them.” I asked again if I needed them and she again said “if you want.”

For me, as for a lot of people, dentists can cause a lot of anxiety and shame. They made this feeling so much worse on top of being incredibly unprofessional on both a business and medical basis. Stay away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Dekeratry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very bad tooth ache and was able to make an appointment on a Sunday. They were great from the time I checked in. Taneal was amazing and help with my anxiety. The dentist was professional and able to help me right away. 10/10 experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the front desk, the dental assistants, to the dentists themselves, this place is TOP NOTCH! They have gone over and above for me. My teeth are horrible but I've never had judgement. I will need total dentures. I'm terrified of dentists but I've never once been scared with them. No joke. Make them your go-to. You won't regret it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in to have a tooth pulled out, first time patient. All the staff are very polite and professional, excellent service. Loved that they have a payment plan option! Their hours and availability are also great and fit any schedule. Will definitely continue to come here for dental services, and highly recommend them! Huge thank you to the Emergency Dentist of Austin staff at Norwood Park location!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Gallagher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
*NOTE: 5-star reviews mostly exist because they explicitly asked people to give them 5 stars when leaving (vs. how you truly felt, I even gave 5 at first because I just wanted to leave)

Positive: medical techs were very nice and professional

Negatives: mostly everything else, extended what should have been a 2 appointments into 10+ and focus on $ vs. patient care

I never write google reviews, but these people gave such terrible service I feel obligated to. I got 3 separate crowns, the first fell out, the second was not the correct one (which they didn’t even check fit before ripping open my mouth), and the third fell out.

All 3 of my temporary crowns fell out as well, and I went back to get my them and my actual crowns put back in 5-6x. Instead of just giving me a new one, they kept acting like everything was fine.

Had to fight hard to get my money back (which I only partially did). They will ask for payment without transparency on price during your initial visit then have a a 3rd party (which will mess up your credit score if unpaid) constantly email you about your payments.

The waits are another pain point, so please avoid.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clair Linette
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very helpful and so gentle 10/10 recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Buechler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Made n app Sunday morning got in that evening. I'm a traveling phlebotomist and I needed a dentist quickly and Dr. Duneen was GREAT and so was Nayla. Very quick efficient and professional.  Highly recommend

Angela, Nova and Dr. Smitherin saved my day! Coming back from a funeral in San Antonio my filling got pulled out by a Buccees Pecan snack and maybe 2-hours later I was in their chair. They helped me for a very reasonable price, I need additional work but at least we have a fix in and I'll be able to return to work tomorrow. Thanks y'all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori Dunlap
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was extremely friendly and helpful. No judgement and very helpful. The dr was straightforward with me and didn’t sugar coat my issues

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caleb
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was having severe nerve pain after hours on a weekend. I called and they were able to get me in right away as they have very flexible hours. The staff were very friendly and knowledgeable. Dr. Campbell was great and knew how to fix my pain quickly. The offices were very nice and clean. I would return and get treatment here anytime.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caroline Padon
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place was awful. They had one dentist working on three different people simultaneously and would go long stretches leaving patients with mouths open waiting for them. Pain management was awful and insufficient. My partner was sobbing crying at many points from the pain, and they were not very helpful. It was $2k for a root canal, by the way. I do not know how or why this place has such a high rating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amarylis Serrano
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was very kinda and efficient! My husband was able to get a painful and infected wisdom tooth removed. We were in and out in under an hour and he was grateful for the relief. Definitely recommend them for emergencies!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matej Bzdil
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dental emergency are not fun to deal with. This was our second time using their services. Same day service, transparent pricing, very professional and accommodating staff. Overall great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sadrah Black
user_reviews_extended.Description: SURA was the best!!!!!! Didn't feel a thing!  Never have to wait. Awesome!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Contreras
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a quick and easy tooth extraction, no wait got taken care of quickly. Cici was amazing !  she explained all the details  to us about the procedure and financial part.  If you’re in need of a tooth pulled this is the place to go to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dawn P
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am an absolute chicken about dental work. Had an emergency weekend visit ... I was scared and in severe pain ... The entire staff was wonderful and nurturing and made the process easy and safe.

Dr. Patrick Campbell performed my procedure. He is competent, kind and caring.

I am grateful to the entire staff for walking me thru this experience. 🦷

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucy Senderling
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great experience with them! CC, Nova, Marissa, and Dr. Campbell took such great care of my boyfriend who busted his teeth this morning, we were in need of an emergency fix up. They were giving him stress balls, a blanket, and got him fixed up with a great set of temporary caps. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Frias
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome place to get my dental work  very happy with the service and all employees are awesome very nice especially and friendly The assistant Stephanie explained everything to us so well will for sure be back 100%recommended

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcy Metzler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Teeth whitening guck and painless. Save up it's worth it. Thank you for helping and serving Austin with your heart. Peace and love.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Keenan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just spoke with someone I guess a receptionist and she was very nice and gave me information for the regular scheduling times for non emergency dentist appointment thank you

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mohsen Malekshahi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
"My experience with Emergency Dentist of Austin has been nothing short of terrible. Last year, my wife had a tooth extracted based on a poor decision by the dentist that only added to her pain and confusion. This unnecessary procedure ended up costing us $3,500 for bridges to fix the issue, the pain was for sinus, not the tooth.
More recently, we were grateful we canceled a wisdom tooth extraction at the last minute after they numbed her teeth and then informed us that we would have to wait over an hour longer due to unorganized schedules, we went home and Instead, we sought out an experienced surgeon in Round Rock, who performed the procedure skillfully for only $290 compared to the over $900 they were charging.
Now, despite canceling our appointment a month and a half ago, they had the audacity to charge us a monthly fee, and the manager did absolutely nothing when I tried to resolve the issue. Their latest management is even more incompetent than before, and they’re not even available for three days at a time to address complaints. If you want to waste your money, endure unnecessary pain, and deal with complete incompetence, this is the place for you."

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Stanford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Could not get a basic cost for a tooth extraction. No insurance not a lot of money and you must pay to see an we tell you after that. What really ..

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laleeana
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing service!! Scheduled an appointment around 10pm on Friday and was seen the very next day for an extraction. They offer great financing options based off of a soft credit pull.
The dentist and assistants were so polite and made me comfortable through the entire surgery.
I highly recommend this place for all emergency needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Guillen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had a tooth extraction done at Emergency Dentist of Austin clinic, like an hour ago lol and I must say, it was an excellent experience from start to finish. The level of professionalism and friendliness exhibited by the entire staff was truly impressive.

First and foremost, I was struck by how well the clinic was taken care of. It was clean, organized, and had a calming atmosphere that immediately put me at ease. The attention to detail in maintaining a pristine environment was evident, which made me feel confident in the quality of care I would receive.

The dentist and their team were exceptional in their approach. They were not only highly skilled but also made sure to explain the entire process to me, ensuring that I felt comfortable and well-informed. The tooth extraction itself was fast and easy, thanks to their expertise. I appreciated their efficiency without compromising on the quality of care.

Moreover, the staff's friendly and welcoming demeanor made the entire experience even more pleasant. They were attentive and empathetic, making sure to address any concerns or questions I had. Their genuine care for their patients was evident in every interaction.

Overall, I cannot recommend Emergency Dentist of Austin and their clinic enough. From the professionalism and friendliness of the staff to the well-maintained environment, my tooth extraction experience was top-notch. If you're in need of dental services, I highly recommend giving them a visit. You won't be disappointed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madi Laney
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is AMAZING. If I could give more than 5 stars I would. Came in with excruciating pain and was immediately greeted and assured by front desk staff. Within five minutes Dr. Campbell and his staff were taking care of me. Removed 2 teeth completely painless. The numbing is always the worst part and Dr. Campbell was the best. Will definitely be returning and using him for our regular dentistry needs. Thank you Emergency Dentist of Austin!! Great staff and service!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Razio The Death
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had unbearably awful tooth pain that was engulfing my whole head. And been turned away from other offices because of no payment options and high costs. Called at 6am on the dot and got super fast helpful advice on what to do and quickly scheduled an appointment a few hours from that same call. Fixed me up right with all the info along the way to help my ease of conscious. Thanks again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariana Lange
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If I could give this place 10 stars I would.
I woke up Saturday middle of the night in excruciating pain from a tooth abscess. I’ve never been in so much pain in my life and of course it’s the weekend so my regular dentist isn’t open. Made an appointment for 2pm that day but when I called to see if they could fit me in sooner, they did everything to help me out.

Thank god for this place!

The staff were all friendly and helpful. Dr. Campbell assessed me and empathized with my pain. He gave me a quick anesthetic and gave me my options for treatment. I decided not to extract until I could wait to see my Endodontist on Monday- but Dr. Campbell and the staff here provided some much needed immediate relief to hold me over for 48 hours.

I would have not survived the weekend if this place wasn’t open.

If you have an emergency, call them now. I know I will in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Costello
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cici and Doctor Dudeen were very patient with me and had my wisdom tooth out in under an hour.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gladvin George
user_reviews_extended.Description: Don't know how I'll feel later but consultation was quick and easy! Dr. Smitherman answered all my questions and CiCi was a joy to be assisted by. Extraction was quick and they made absolutely sure that I would not experience pain during the process. Very happy with this part of my wisdom tooth extraction.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Culling
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot recommend this place. I had a veneer pop off on a Friday night and needed it glued back on. Called them and they gave me a 10:30am appointment. Showed up and there were 4 people in the waiting room.  By 11:15am the same four people were still waiting and we overheard the receptionist to someone checking in there would be a delay because of “several surgeries and the doctor leaves for a bit at 11:30am for religious purposes.” I understand that this was on a Saturday and we are dealing with dental emergencies but you should be upfront with your patients about timelines.  One of the guys in the room had a 9:30am appointment and got called back right as this was happening so they knew the were already an hour behind when I got there.  Ended up just leaving. Went down the street to Forest Family dentistry and they got me in and fixed up in less than 30 minutes.  Just no regard for the patients at Emergency Dentist of Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: 10/10 to this place. Amazing staff. I came in with an emergency and needed so much done. They got me in and out in about about 2 hours or less. They explain everything from the procedure, cost, plans and after care in such a great way, I was about to understand. They answered all my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: GSA
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Relieved my 3day pain in 30 minutes.
They ladies at the front desk are so helpful and sweet. Recommend 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kase Gabel
user_reviews_extended.Description: After my terrible experience I had at another dentist I went to this place and it was super quick and easy with no complications! Super helpful and friendly staff as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Marceron
user_reviews_extended.Description: People are so nice and welcoming and the dentist was awesome! Great experience and would come again

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leticia Casiano
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First visit was great! I liked the hours available to come in, for me I needed something in the evening and they had availability the same day if needed/wanted, at the time I booked. I chose to tough it out a few days before coming in.

The staff was friendly! They walked me through all that was going on, answered my questions and were patient.

Payment was explained easily. I was happy there was payment option! They gave me time to run my numbers on which plan I was most comfortable with.

This may sound silly but I didn't realize I would get my issue dealt with same day. I now walked out with excitement to not have my pain no more!

Thank you all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abigail Metsch
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been terrified of the dentist for years, following a bad experience in my past. I cannot explain to you how wonderful my experience at Emergency Dentist of Austin was. From the front desk staff to the dental assistants to the dentist himself, they took amazing care of me. They were kind, funny, and explained the procedure to me in great detail so I understood what was happening while it was happening. I recommend this office to anyone searching for a new dentist. 5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a filling break and fall out early morning. Was seen my Dr. Campbell by 3pm and out the office with it all corrected by 4pm. Procedure was a breeze for him and his assistants with high confidence. Hope I never have another emergency again but if so I wouldn't hesitate to return. Very satisfied.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing! Dr.Dudeen did an extraction and a root canal. He listened to my concerns, and was patient with me and my anxiety. He made sure the procedures were painless and talked me through all of it. His assistant Marissa was so kind and comforting the entire way, giving me updates and encouragement. I would definitely recommend them to any and everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Mendoza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Words cannot express how appreciative I am with Emergency Dentist of Austin! Everyone one else was putting me 4 to 5 days out for an appointment, they did it that same day! The staff are simply amazing, thank you fpr giving me my peace and comfort back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Crenshaw
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone on staff was stellar.  I had an emergency procedure done with no wait.  The doctor and assistant’s bedside manner was stellar. They answered all of my questions concisely and they were even a bit jovial which helped alleviate a lot of my stress during the procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cyndy G
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Husband had a bad tooth and in a single phone call, he was squeezed in for an emergency extraction, ON A SATURDAY, that very afternoon. The receptionist on the phone was patient, was upfront about the initial cost, and even helped me check out any availability they had on SUNDAY (insane, what other dental practice does this?! This is the place if you have an emergency!) The wait was pretty long, the clinic is very full on Saturdays, but so worth it. Dr. Campbell was also very patient with me, the anxious and worried spouse, and answered all my questions clearly and even used the xrays to show us exactly what the issue was, gave us recommendations, and even took a moment to grab us a quote for care. While a little pricey, the clinic has an okay payment plan (maybe interest free for some!) and compared to the previous quote we got from a competitor, this place beats them out.

Please keep in mind you’ll be making payments up front for care and the payment plan requires a debit card and a soft credit check.

During the procedure, Dr. Campbell kept open communication and checked in with my husband periodically for any issues or discomfort. The Dr also spoke respectfully to his attendant and took her suggestions for additional tools as needed for the procedure without offense. The attendant was also very kind and didn’t shrink at her work. She was confident in her work and that reassured me that my husband was in good hands. It was hard work but the team did not make us feel judged (I had rushed out the door in pajamas, oh Lord I was not looking my best) or treat us as a burden (I asked so many questions…). Dr. Campbell is excellent at his craft! He didn’t waste any time getting that extraction done! 48hrs after the procedure, my husband says he feels much better and having no post-op complications. The staff was very kind and professional, shared in our weird humor, and we couldn’t help but sing our praises out the door. Probably mostly because my husband felt so much better after the procedure but that’s all due to Dr. Campbell and his team!

See ya’ll next week to get that stitch removed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alvaro Castelan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had extreme wisdom tooth pain, scheduled an appointment online for same day which was super easy. Everyone I interacted with was very professional, welcoming, reassuring and made the process super smooth. I was provided with a ton of information as well and and was in and out super quickly. I would highly recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chuk Chukwuka
user_reviews_extended.Description: I appreciate the dentist for working with me to fix my chipped tooth, but the front desk associates straight-up lied to me. They told me I was paying for the root canal and that all I would need to do next was get the crown, but that was a complete deception. They only did half the procedure, and now I have to shell out more money to the referred dentist to finish the root canal. It's incredibly frustrating and unprofessional! Beware of this—if you're not in a lot of pain, just wait to go to your regular dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marina Avila
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just had a broken inflamed wisdom tooth I had been putting off for 3 weeks and came in Sunday and had an appointment for removal the NEXT DAY. Super happy with the service, any pain was lessened with numbing too. I felt super taken care of.
All the front desk staff is amazing as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andre Burrell
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is amazing…. The staff is awesome, everyone was so helpful and nice and I was in and out. You’re definitely in good hands when it comes to this dental office and the staff. Thank you so much for everything you guys have done, EDA really cares about their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krista Costa
user_reviews_extended.Description: After a few days with some mouth pain, the pain became unbearable on a Saturday morning...when dentist offices aren't open. I felt so fortunate to fi d this facility and was able to be seen within a couple hours of calling. The staff was amazing and helpful. My dentist communicated the issues and resolutions and helped me feel at ease. Within a few hours, I was on my way home feeling much better! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Colleen Dickens
user_reviews_extended.Description: My Fiancé was having severe pain from a broken tooth and needed to see a dentist. We called Emergency Dentist of Austin and they were able to see him within the hour. The RDA that took his xrays was very quick and kept him at ease through the entire appointment. Dr. Campbell was thorough and very knowledgeable. He gave us several treatment options, and ended up offering a same day extraction at our request. Overall the entire experience was very positive and the entire staff was compassionate and knowledgeable. I work for a pediatric dental office, so I have very high expectations of dental care for my family. They went above and beyond to make sure my fiancé was pain free, and they very clearly value patient care above all else. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacie Atteng
user_reviews_extended.Description: Brittney was wonderful and so comforting. Unpleasant process of course, but I am definitely feeling better thanks Dr. Esplin and Brittney.

user_reviews_extended.Name: dawn parma
user_reviews_extended.Description: They made my root canal completely painless and I was even relaxed b enough to enjoy the music.  Excellent dental team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy A Fox (Faith Ambassador)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great experience during this painful time in my mouth. The team was great and Hannah and Dr Smitherman helped me tremendously. Thank you ladies for your great work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becky Ahlgrim
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were really good. They called to offer my son an earlier appointment as requested and got us in quickly. The numbing process was better than he had ever experienced. He says he would go here again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lexx Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: They really put me at ease. I was nervous the first time I came in but after my third visit I was fine. They really made me extraction experience an easy one. I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angeline S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an extremely disappointing experience at Emergency Dentist of Austin about a week and a half ago. My temporary crown had popped off, and I needed it cemented urgently. While the check-in process was smooth + front desk was sweet and knowledgable, the rest of my visit was far from acceptable.

The dental assistant who treated me seemed highly incompetent. He repeatedly dropped the temporary crown and struggled with what appeared to be the wrong tools for the job. It was clear he was using an inappropriate tip, which only exacerbated the problem ( as the other coworker had to give him the proper tool) . To make matters worse, he didn’t offer any numbing options and instead flashed me with bursts of air, countless painful times.

Throughout the procedure, the assistant gaslight me about the issues I was experiencing, which made the whole situation even more frustrating. I didn't feel safe at all here.

He stated " I'm not killing you aren't I?"  I ended up in tears the whole time, which is something I’ve never done at a dentist before. The lack of professionalism and care left me deeply traumatized. The dentist I believed took over and quickly placed my temp crown in under a minutes.

I recently mentioned this emergency dental care facility to my dentist, but she had never heard of it before. This was surprising and concerning to me, as it raises questions and validity of the services.

I strongly urge anyone considering this place to do thorough research beforehand. My experience was distressing and not reflective of what one would hope for in an emergency dental situation. Please proceed with caution.

I will stick to my dentist location and call them, now I now that services are available on the weekends.

If I could I would like a refund but I will not take back my review. My temporary was also barely on my dentist didnt even try much to take it off.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizette Vela
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Got my tooth filled in the end of July, it’s already chipped off again, they don’t have any openings with my dentist until 4/19 that’s a long time to wait in my opinion, I don’t want to be out in public with a chipped tooth, I paid over 600 dollars, I wasn’t told it wouldn’t last even a year. Right now I am not pleased and would not recommend.

Edited my review, Dr Campbell explained to me why my tooth chipped off and took care of it at no charge, I really appreciate the customer service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pika Wong
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff and super grateful for Dr.Min. He is to the point with a touch of personal and very efficient in his service. His assistant was very encouraging with her words during the process and made sure all my questions were answered. Dr.min also made sure i was comfortable before my tooth extraction and did it so quickly. I have had some trauma going to the dentist as a child all the time and i felt really comfortable here. The staff is super nice in the front and back. They always answer their phones quickly and are accommodating if you are a bit past your appointment time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Chopp
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ceci was great! And so was the whole team. I have a lot of anxiety around anything medical and they were so kind and patient. Hopefully I don’t have to come back for another dental emergency but if I do, I’ll definitely come back here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ken Hilton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I made an appointment on Saturday morning. They got me in as they agreed. They did a really good job on my filling and we're very pleasant to work with. I recommend him highly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Garrett Russell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful staff, very understanding and patient! Came in for an extraction and was out within the hour! Highly recommend! Thank you Dr. Smitherman, Angelica and Nova!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Bora
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service from Amber and Sura. Definitely recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here are the sweetest and most kind souls I have ever had for a dental team! I am very picky about who gets to touch my teeth and they exceeded my own expectations, especially through the emergency I was having! Please consider coming here just as I will for my future routine care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cameron Inc
user_reviews_extended.Description: Maggie talked me out of being nervous and it helped me out a lot, this place is great I was in and out

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deanna Alexander
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The dental work itself was fantastic. However I was "purposefully overcharged" as we were originally unsure if I would need just a crown or a root canal but it was likely I needed a root canal. They assured me if I ended up with a crown only it would be easy and quick to refund me and they would do that before billing my insurance. I trusted the advice and swiped my card because of course I needed the work done.

Well I ended up only needing a crown, and I appreciate the dentist on staff being honest about that and trying to save me some money. However I have been calling and emailing since NOVEMBER and have still not received a refund for the difference and because of that I haven't been able to bill my insurance either since its not been corrected! I'm not even sure I still CAN bill my insurance. All payment is required upfront so I have just been throwing money at credit card payments for this $4000 overcharge for months. Everyone I have talked to have been friendly and apologetic and I really hate to leave bad reviews for anything  or feel like a Karen but I don't know what else to do. I don't care how sorry you are, this is seriously unacceptable. Something that should have cost next to nothing because my insurance would cover is costing me $4000 because they can't figure out how to refund me or don't want to. Would never recommend this place to anyone it will make you bankrupt.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aralyn Vragel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very understanding and efficient staff. We had a minor issue with finances and it was cleared up quickly and painlessly. The actual dental work was equally painless and attentive. I will be recommending to family & friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Galindo
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Doctor was great and her assistant Angelica. They helped my husband feel very comfortable and got it done fast.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Eischens
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So grateful that we're open on a sunday the day before memorial day and that I was able to get an appointment immediately.  The staff was exceptional and they made sure I was ok and comfortable.   They explained every step and discussed the cost up front.  The dentist did a great job and both wisdom teeth were extracted very quickly.  I didn't feel a thing even now 3 hours later I have minimal pain.
I highly recommend them for any dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in to get a crown put on. The doctor and Hannah were amazing! I recommend to anyone for any needs you may have. The staff was really great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassandra Bryant
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing communication. Made me feel so comfortable and my wisdom tooth was extracted within 5 minutes of numbing. I highly recommend this spot. Dr Campbell was amazing and the hygienist (I didn’t get her name :() was also fantastic! The front desk girls were so sweet too. Great experience for someone terrified of the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miranda Villazana
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience here at first was very welcoming. The ladies upfront were nice enough and the nurse helping me was as well. They were very accommodating with prices and what plan to do. I was very very excited as I’ve been in so much pain due to my tooth and was ready for my procedure. During the numbing process, I told the nurse that usually I am very resistant to anesthetic and have had experiences during procedures where I feel everything. She confirmed. This is where it all went down hill. We began the needle numbing and I will admit I had an overreaction to the taste of the anesthetic but I apologized and we moved on. They kept asking if I was numb and I said mostly but not enough. They gave me one more shot. During that shot however, I did feel pain in my cheek and the doctor did ask but seemed dismissive. We continued and started the extraction with him drilling my teeth. I then felt an awful pain and reacted and began crying but the doctor seemed super dismissive. He did give me another shot but the pain continued. We then got to the nerve of my tooth which I believe he touched and I immediately broke down. Crying during most of the procedure and flinching at the pain as I decided that I just wanted to get it over with as the doctor didn’t seem to care at all. When I kept reacting, the doctor said to me “Are you stressed. You shouldn’t be in pain, it’s just stress.” Which made me feel like I was more of a problem than a patient. Crying and apologizing after, the doctor said nothing to that and left as soon as he could. I felt pain during the entire procedure. I will also say my partner accidentally moved the chair down and we admitted it was our fault. It happened a second time which wasn’t our fault but the doctor seemed to blame us? However after everything, the nurse said it was finicky the whole day. So I don’t understand why the doctor seemed to blame us for that. I got into my car after the procedure sobbing to my partner. I wanted to give the benefit of the doubt but I think because the appointment and procedure was so late, it seemed the doctor just wanted it to be over with. Which I would understand but it simply wasn’t fair for me to go through pain because of that. I don’t recall the doctors name but I would recommend waiting for another doctor or going to another practice if he’s still there. An absolutely humiliating and painful experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: randy mcgraw
user_reviews_extended.Description: Needed an emergency root canal done on a Sunday and everywhere in the city was closed. I love that they were open and able to get me in, in under an hour. The fully explained the procedures and got me out of there in less than two hours. Everyone was very pleasant to me and very accommodating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Jafari
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Accommodated my emergency quickly and painlessly. And I mean painlessly! Everyone was extremely courteous and friendly. Dr. Campbell was the best. Kris and RK, in the office were super friendly and helpful. Tooth extraction was completely painless. Definitely will come back for future needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Briana Treese
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had tooth pain that was only getting worse and they were able to get me in same day! Everyone from the front desk to the dentist were so kind and answered any questions I had. Definitely recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Cordova
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic front staff! Check in was easy and smooth. The Dr and back staff were very helpful and friendly. Got treatment done same day and their urgency was handled very well with care. 10/10 would definitely recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paty Dominguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience! The staff was very nice and approachable. Additionally, they were very communicative and adaptable to price, procedures, etc. The doctor herself was the best part. She was equally as communicative and kind as the staff, but she was also extremely knowledgeable. She was willing to discuss future plans regarding my dental issues/history and willing to work and consult me in the future even though this place is an emergency center. 10/10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Saunders
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They were great. I had an emergency with a toothache that was extremely painful.
They were open on a Sunday unlike most dentist

I was in and out within 30 minutes and my pain is gone thank you so much

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Collier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful experience! I had a dental emergency on a Sunday and they were the only place open. I was so thankful to find someone open…I drove an hour and a half to get to them and it was absolutely worth it! The staff was friendly, compassionate, and provided the BEST care and got me fixed up. I didn’t mind the hour and half drive to my post-op bc of how great they are. Highly recommend and will absolutely use again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia W
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was nervous about having my wisdom tooth removed, but Cici and Dr. Smitherman were very professional and checked on me frequently during the procedure. The process was fast and painless. I was in and out in just over an hour.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Bauer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was at the end of my rope with the pain I was having in one of my wisdom teeth at the end of last week. I called as soon as I woke up, they got me an appointment within 90 minutes, and my painful tooth was out before the afternoon started. Very courteous and polite staff, comfortable setting, good parking, I definitely recommend in any scenario. But especially if you need help fast.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alisa Saf
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very good, prompt, friendly team and honest: No unnecessary charges! So recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Vanzant
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend. I was sitting in a chair within 90 mins from the time I called. The ladies up front were very friendly, helpful and professional. They were upfront about their prices and procedures. All my questions were answered and they had multiple ways to pay. I will be back for my dentistry needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clint F
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was on vacation and got a tooth infection and came to this clinic, The staff and the doctor is really really amazing if I lived around here this would be my dentist.!! The staff and doctor made me feel so comfortable and the tooth removal was painless and quick. I would recommend this place to everyone!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karla Monagas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in for an emergency cracked tooth and got seen by Dr. Dudeen and his assistant Cici within 10 minutes of arriving, they explained everything to me and had me fixed and out the door within 90min. Prices are the expected average for dental care in the area, especially for emergency but they do offer financing. 10/10 recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super helpful staff made for a great experience today! Had a tooth ache over the weekend and I called to make an appt to take care of it. Was able to get an appt same day and was provided kind and attentive care. I was given flexible treatment options for my tooth that were easy to comprehend also. 10/10 Would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cameron Coleman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and professional staff. I received excellent care. If you need any dental services completed, please consider Emergency Dentist of Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karina Velarde
user_reviews_extended.Description: We will definitely be coming back to this dental office! The staff was soo friendly. My boyfriend was in a lot of pain and does not have any dental insurance and they put him down for an appointment right away. They got started immediately and the procedure only took about an hour. Dr. Campbell was amazing and extremely helpful. Thank you to all the staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby DeNoble
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came here after falling and breaking my two front teeth badly on a weekend and no one else was open. Every single person in this office was AMAZING. The hygienists felt like friends after 30 seconds… they are incredibly kind, personable and caring. Dr Campbell was the best dentist and overall human being EVER. The calmest, gentlest, reassuring presence during a really upsetting time. He speaks calmly, softly and slowly which is really appreciated during a time when you feel overwhelmed or nervous. I never once felt rushed or bombarded with too much information or fast talking. He took his time, gave me his full attention at all times, and did an excellent job.  I highly highly recommend him and the whole team here. Can’t say enough good things about the staff and my experience. Thank you Dr Campbell :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oscar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was dying from a toothache and found this place last second. I was able to make an appointment for the next day. The service was quick and efficient. All the employees were amazing and helpful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Valdemar
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was awesome, so welcoming full of smiles, they took fantastic care of me. Dr. Smithermen was AMAZING and Marisa was so sweet and helpful. I might form cavities just to be back. In all seriousness, they were able to accommodate me same day, and were very professional

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kobi Troiani
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had some serious worries with my gums. they got me in as soon as they could, And gave me a fair deal to help in this economy. They were quick, informative, and lovely.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mirtha Tabasco
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff was kind, friendly and extremely helpful. Dr. Dudeen was great! He made the extraction process very smooth and was constantly verifying that I was doing good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Letcher
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was an amazing experience and I am so grateful this service is available on a Sunday evening. Dr. Dudeen and Angelica made all the difference to allow us to understand the risk and options of a dental emergency. Kind, thorough and absolutely professional. ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arthur Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a couple of extractions done. I have bad anxiety when it comes to dentist . Dr. Dudeen and his assistant Marisa were great . Made me feel relaxed and was the best dentist experience I’ve ever had . I will definitely be back for future treatments. You guys are awesome. Would highly recommend. Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonona Ellis
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was horrible.  Along with the overwhelming prices, the dentist did not address my pain.  I left worse than when I came in.  I left in tears and the dentist didn’t talk to me at all about my pain level.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jon Uptergrove
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today I woke up with a very bad cavity in my mouth wasn’t sure how I was going to get it fixed. The pain was unbearable and within five minutes the people at emergency dentist of Austin got me booked for a same day treatment. The work they did was quick painless and affordable. This is the best dentist I’ve ever been to in my life. Anytime I need my teeth worked on in the future I will be coming back here. Cannot recommend this place enough seriously if you want same day pain removal from your teeth come here

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Collins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been dealing with a toothache for over a week, nothing was helping. I was recommended here by an ER I went to for pain management. The staff was amazing. It was a bit costly but you can’t really put a cost on relief. I came in at 8:30ish & was out by 9:30ish. I had a tooth extraction of an infected tooth. Highly recommend them. They don’t take insurance so expect to pay some money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Benitez
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is simply amazing. From the scheduling/reception staff to the dental assistants/dentists. I was in horrible pain due to a filling that fell out, I have a fear of dentists like many people do. Called and left a voicemail on Saturday morning before they opened, received a call back and scheduled for that afternoon. Dr. D examined my X-rays and recommended an emergency extraction, he and Brittany took such great care of me. I was amazed and so grateful. I just left my follow up appointment, all healed up and 100% satisfied with the entire experience. I can not thank them enough for their compassion, accessibility and service. If you are considering using this location stop overthinking it and just book your appointment now. You will not regret it!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ben shew
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super friendly staff!  Everyone who helped me took great care and didn't make fun of me for being a shaky little baby (at least while I was there).  The lead dentist was awesome. Super calm and collected, fast and professional.  The lady that helped him was very sweet and had a few jokes up her sleeve for the comedic relief.  Hope I don't have to go through that again but if I have to i'll be coming back here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Toria
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you have a serious dental emergency, this place is exactly what you're looking for. I was able to get a same-day appointment for my partner. He was in a lot of pain/discomfort. They were quick and efficient. They told us what was wrong and how to fix it, then gave us a precise quote. There were no hidden fees or surprises when it came to billing. All and all, it was a good experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TIJAON PARRAMORE
user_reviews_extended.Description: Raoof & Dr. Smitherman  .Fast and friendly and super professional service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: chaya bussey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentistry ever. I went in on Sunday afternoon in severe pain and a bad infection. The dental assistant was very nice and as well as the front staff. The doctor was super awesome. He made sure I was comfortable and not in pain as he extracted two teeth. I’m so glad I went to Emergency Dentist of Austin. They took good care of me and I will definitely recommend them to friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LeahB L
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Tooth pain set in Friday morning, called my dentist and they couldn’t see me until Monday. Ok I can make it I thought. Well Friday night about 10 I wanted to ask someone to knock me out with a frying pan because the pain was just unbearable.

Went online, found a few emergency dentists in Austin and chose this one based on the reviews. I am SO thankful I chose this office. They got me in early Sat morning. I got to the office, they had a  very clean and modern waiting room, and
amazingly friendly staff at check in. Waited about 5 min and they got me back for some X-rays.

Needed an extraction from a cracked and broken molar unfortunately, but it was not painful at all. A few shots to numb the area and some laughing gas, I was completely relaxed during the procedure. Dr. Smithermann was so caring and she explained everything honestly and compassionately. She made quick work or the extraction and placement of the bone graft. And that was it!

I would recommend this office to anyone needing emergency dental work done. The reviews are what made me decide on coming here and I hope my review helps anyone out there chose to come to this clinic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shida Rabi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was the worst dental experience I’ve ever had. I got an emergency appointment from them. They started my treatment with a one-hour delay, administered local anesthesia, and then made me wait for another half an hour. When I asked why they hadn’t started yet, they informed me they were behind schedule and that I either needed to wait for two other patients to finish or I had to reschedule for next day. This should have been communicated before administering the anesthesia, not after making me wait for two hours They didn’t care that I had to leave with a numb gum that made me suffer a lot.
Extremely irresponsible and unprofessional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Monnich
user_reviews_extended.Description:
These guys were honestly very surprisingly good. I had a tooth that desperately needed to be extracted with a nasty abscess. They numbed me, popped out the problem tooth and sewed it shut in a matter of minutes!
They were really understanding and helpful with my anxiety which was a huge plus. Thank you to all of you! 🙏🙏

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Marin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in excruciating pain and they got me in quick and completed the procedure in about 10 minutes. Dr. Campbell and his staff were awesome, helping me get through my first wisdom tooth extraction.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Giezel Lababit
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in for an emergency, as my filling fell off. I do not live in the area, so I’m very thankful this office was open on a Sunday & able to accommodate my needs in a timely manner. Receptionists had great energy & the hygienist was very nice. Doctor was great, also.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laurie “LT” Taraboulos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Emergency Dentist of Austin was amazing. They fit me in quickly for a bridge that had broken took care of me quickly, efficiently, and kindly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nilah Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have terrible dental anxiety and the level of professionalism, compassion and care that I received here today is unmatched! The team walked me through every step and made me very comfortable and it was over so quickly! amazing experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jay Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was great and took care of me.  I was able to get an emergency root canal on a Sunday morning after not being able to get into my regular dentist for several days. Pricey, but I’d have paid even more for the pain to stop.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Weatherl, Jr
user_reviews_extended.Description: it was not a great day for me when i visited, but afterwards i started feeling much much better, thanks yall

user_reviews_extended.Name: tattooed momma32
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dentist did amazing!! Kris, Sydney, and Dr Campbell were amazing, great communication, explained everything to me.  My 10 year old was scarred and terrified at last dentist, the way they handled the patients here, my son was not scarred one bit and allowed them to do what they needed too! The  best part…..this was all on a Sunday for a dentist emergency! Thank you to the whole team here, even the receptionist who answered all my questions respectfully before I made the hour and half drive here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tonya Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience today at the dentist was amazing! Past experience has kept me from the dentist for years. However, Dr. Campbell and his assistant (including front desk) help me redeem trust years later when coming to a dentist. The process was short and sweet! Thank you  to the entire Sunbit  staff for making this experience amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mj Huey
user_reviews_extended.Description: My permanent retainer broke and they were able to get me in on a Saturday and smooth out the broken wire quickly. I really appreciated the quick fix, cost $150.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Texas Dirt Hawker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very polite and on top of everything. They weren't cheap but when your in an Emergency and in pain it's worth every cent. I could not go another day with the pain I was in and on a Sunday there wasn't any other option available to me especially the week before Christmas. Had a better experience than I ever did at my normal dentist and if I had another Emergency I would go here again! Good job Emergency Dentist of Austin and Thank you very much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew L.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wonderful group of people. I rescheduled about 2-3 times due to a rough month. I was running late and called on the way to let them know and they totally understood. I'd still give them 5 stars if they charged late fees because that's time they could use give such great care to someone else!

If you have dental anxiety, know that they offer nitrous oxide. If you have EXTREME anxiety, they offer "sedation". The method of "sedation" is generally common practice among dentists. If so, you have nothing to worry about (even if you tried!).

Lastly, these guys offer more than routine cleanings. That doesn't mean they're at you like car salesmen. The doc only recommended what she believed was necessary and pointed out what was optional.

Only one piece of constructive feedback here: please put an "Our Staff" page for everyone working there! I'm terrible with names, but I loved the doctor, the male and female hygienist and the lady who discussed options. Shout out to those working August 14!

Looking forward to seeing y'all again for my cleaning next week!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emu Jean
user_reviews_extended.Description: YIPEEE!! Give Cici and Dr. Dudeen a raise. I know you want to. Do it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Bradham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cici and the doctor helped me a ton and were very quick

user_reviews_extended.Name: tyler gier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic team! My partner needed an infected tooth removed and they were able to take that and a wisdom tooth out. He has severe dental anxiety and they were supportive the whole way and helped him have a painless procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: erianna d
user_reviews_extended.Description: First tooth pulled, and I want them as my first dentists. The dentist and her dental assistant knew I was anxious- brought me a weighted blanket and a stress ball, the procedure was painless. The financing options suited our needs well, and everyone was friendly and honest. These dentists rock. Now my mouth feels better than it has in years, even now, that the numbing wore off! I am very grateful for this clinic, can't wait to get the stitches out next week!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Haugh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wonderful staff and dentists.

Easy check in, I only waited like 3 minutes after filling out medical history.

The Dr took the time to answer questions and I did not feel rushed.

The staff is excellent. They are very nice, I had same day exam and treatment; surgical extraction. I was presented with options  which I appreciate.

The office is  clean, not cluttered and I was treated like family.

I had two follow up texts and a follow up call.
Emergency Dentist of Austin is a pleasant and calm place which helps especially when you’re anxious and in pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LoveToMakeBandz Eue
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very good service from Ms.CeCe and Dr . Campbell and the rest of the staff their they did an amazing job getting my wisdom pulled ! I was comfortable,  not in pain and the procedure went fast and gave me great proper advice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Suzanne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The women who work there MAKE this
Place. They are the reason behind the high rating.

Chris has an extraordinarily kind and gentle touch. As did an assistant (Brianna/breanna?)

Their bedside manner and care shows they clearly aren’t jaded by the craft and take the edge off of the anxious-ridden experience of going to the dentist.

Took a star off for not ever answering their phone, not answering my voice messages, not alerting me my permanent crown was ready, doc kinda felt burnout and not personable but he did great work.

Was booked in within an hour of
Calling. Great clean facility. Overall happy with the experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jay Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: EVERYONE had great customer service and didn't mind repeating themselves when I couldn't hear (deaf in one side) I came in to get a tooth extraction and it was painless! Even though they seemed kinda busy they were still really fast and definitely helped me find a good payment plan!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe GV.
user_reviews_extended.Description: My situation was extremely unique. I had a root canal scheduled already with another provider. While waiting for that root canal, i heard a pop and pain came over me. Called these lovely people prior to making my way over. Came in on a Sunday from out of town at that! Was seen promptly within minutes of my arrival. I filled out all the forms beforehand as well.  After the consultation, they had multiple plans for my care. I picked what was best for myself at the time given my circumstances.

user_reviews_extended.Name: No No
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you’re thinking about it then do it ! I was in extreme pain & I searched online to find somewhere to go. They asked me if I wanted to come in the same day. Everyone was friendly & respectful. My appointment was at 8:00 am & I was out at 9:30 am. They gave me payment options & sent my paperwork over so that I could bill my insurance. I was scared & the assistant asked if I wanted her to sit with me. It took 10 minutes to remove my actual tooth. I cried because I’m so happy to be pain free so fast. I will recommend this place forever! 10 out of 10🥰

user_reviews_extended.Name: Atia Light Beings
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sorry but I can’t give 5 stars. I came on 11-26-2022 for an tooth infection emergency and I will never come back again. When I arrived there were a guy that was waiting for 3 hours, another lady was there for 2 hours. They both left short after I came. I waited 1 hour and half for my turn (less than I had expected since two patients left before me so I consider I was lucky). Only one dentist on site. When I was called there were another lady waiting. Once called I waited another 25 minutes and I had plenty of time to look for details. When I left, there were around 10 people in the waiting room and it was 4:30pm. Still wondering how they could pass 10 people before they close. The Dentist was completely burnt out, he barely followed what I was saying but he did the effort. You could see he and the staff was eager to finish with me because they were overwhelmed. I didn’t feel really any concern from the dentist and I wasn’t offered a follow up either. Also sorry again but this place was REALLY dirty. I had 25 minutes alone to look for details. I was about to ask the staff when was last time this facility has been cleaned but the dentist arrived. Disgusting. On Saturdays it is only on appointment. I was shocked to see so much people for only one dentist. I drove 25 miles to get there. Why taking so much people in a so short time with only one dentist working? Over staffed as well, they were embarrassed about the situation.  So unfortunately not a good experience for me. You are already stressed because you are suffering or have a real concern about your teeth but if the place that is supposed to heal you put more pressure on you like it did today, no thanks. I came just to get an antibiotic prescription and I ended up being there for almost 3 hours. Since we all receive a text message on our phone three hours after our visit inviting us to leave a review here it is. Sorry, whenever the problem was that day, I will never come back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison H
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here is super nice. I've been here twice and both times have been the best dental care I've received. The payment plans are through sunbit which they have linked through their site. I cannot express how well these people have taken care of me while working with financial situations.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JustTaylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office staff is very exceptional. They are very inviting, sweet, accommodating and welcoming! Dr. Joo and Kris, Samantha, and Noah were all so very nice and patient. This office is an example of what Dental care professionals should be and I am so happy I chose them for my experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Destiny Gomez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was desperate to see a dentist and no one had available appointments until after Christmas. I came across Emergency Dentist. When I came in for my appointment check in was smooth, x-ray and treatment all happened within one hour! I had two of my teeth extracted due to an infected wisdom tooth. Thank you guys for your care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: jorge oliva
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jennifer (tech) & Dr. S are awesome!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cece and Dr. Smitherman were amazing! My husband came in really anxious and left with a new perspective of the dentist. Thank you for all that you do!

user_reviews_extended.Name: DJ Keaton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ashley Smitherman and Mr. Lazaro both took great care of me! I have not had good experiences with dentists in the past, but these two were top notch individuals! I will recommend  to everyone and if I could give 10 stars I would!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T M
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were very prompt in returning by my call and getting me scheduled and were so very nice which is always a great first impression. They checked with the dentist before I came in to make sure they were familiar with the particular issue I had going on and confirmed they were. I was having pretty excruciating pain when I walked in there, and unfortunately left with the same pain. The dentist was very friendly and familiar with the potential condition I had going on but just did X-rays and discussed seeing an orthodontist for more 3D X-rays. I think it’s a good plan, but he never did an exam or even opened my mouth to look to see if gums were inflamed or to look at the sensitive tooth.  I went in to an emergency dentist because I needed some pain relief. I’m back home and this flare is bringing me to tears. He just told me to continue the ibuprofen and Tylenol I’m using that I said wasn’t touching it. I was hoping they could just at least give me a shot to numb the current pain to get some temporary relief. Or send me with a lidocaine viscous rinse to use to numb the area. When I called ahead to see if they were familiar with the condition I’m suspecting, i assumed that meant they might actually be able to help me. But I’m back home and in tears right now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had severe tooth pain and I was so grateful that this dentist works weekend and night they jumped through hoops to get me financd at an amount I could afford. All the staff was so friendly and helpful even at the late hour when anyone else would be exhausted they were still attentive I would recommend emergency dentist to anyone and everyone

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Barr
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dr and his assistant were able to diagnose the tooth pain in 5 mins. Very professional - great asset for Austin on a Sunday night. Id recommend them for sure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laurie Beutler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was able to be seen the same day I made the appointment! Doctor D and the staff were welcoming and made me feel comfortable, despite needing an emergency extraction. They explained my options and went over pricing and aftercare before the procedure. I highly recommend this practice!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Manoj Samtani
