user_reviews_extended.Description: Sydney and the front desk staff are AMAZING and super friendly!!  They are very accommodating with a great payment plan that won’t break the bank!  Thank you ladies- Job well done!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norm Austin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff and got us in same day. Assistant and Dentist were thorough with their questions and exam. Would recommend to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Ochoa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to get two extractions in a day and was worried sick about the cost and pain. But they managed to let me pick an agreeable payment plan, and I hardly felt anything during the process. Much love to the doc for her experience and the staff on hand.

user_reviews_extended.Name: eric Lucio
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in the worst pain I ever even new was possible but fortunately emergency dentist of Austin was able to help me. The staff was extremely helpful and even helped me find a way to pay without all the stress in these difficult times. Thank you I will be back and continue to recommend to anyone still afraid of going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bella Vasquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time ever coming to an Emergency Dentist and it was a great experience. They promised I wouldn’t feel pain when removing an already painful wisdom tooth. Sure enough the process was so quick and painless! Staff was so nice and worked with me all the way through!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roger Nunes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went there on Saturday. Was in unbearable pain. Without a proper diagnosis they insisted on extracting the tooth. The X-ray looked fine. I was hesitant to extract it. I overheard them insist on extracting the teeth for most patients in the adjoining rooms. This is insane! This should not be the first line for diagnosis!! One nurse came in with a paper with all the payment breakdown for the procedure. I then requested them I would need pain meds/ antibiotics and take a second opinion. After I requested them this there was a shift in their attitude towards me. The doctor did not even come back to the room. They discharged me with no meds and I was still in pain. They said follow up with your doctor and manage by yourself during the weekend. What a discrimination place. Some action should be taken here for this kind of malpractice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chrissy Poole
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in with an impacted wisdom tooth, which is something they say they are able to take of on the website. I had excruciating pain and needed it removed immediately. They said there was a surgeon that may be able to do it the next day and they sent me to the front to pay. The dentist came back and told me he was not finished giving me information so I was told to go sit back down in the room. 10 minutes later a lady (not the dentist) comes in and gives me a referral sheet for a different oral surgeon. I was confused so I asked if they were not able to see me anymore for some reason and they said they did not want to take the tooth out because they were not familiar with the situation. The actual dentist did not give us any information on what was happening/ that plans were changing. The oral surgeon they referred me to was not open until Monday (my appointment was Friday 4pm) so I wasn’t able to even leave a message. The dentist told me to simply use ibuprofen for my pain when I was having no luck with it already. They sent me away with the same excruciating pain, no information and no way to make any appointment with the oral surgeon they referred me to. The staff also seemed a bit unprofessional. They were all waking around and talking to each other, yet we weren’t able to get any information from them. They are an emergency dentist, I was appalled that they did not care I was in horrible pain and couldn’t do anything for me. After all of this, all I had to do was call around the area and I was able to find a different oral surgeon that was closer than the other they referred me to, open on Saturday and was able to see me immediately on the day i called and took care of all my issues. East Austin Oral Surgery is absolutely the way to go if there’s any emergency you have, not the EMERGENCY dentist. They will make sure you are taken care of and won’t send you away even more frustrated than you were before.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing service. Kris was so sweet and caring. Shes the best! Made us feel right at home. Dr Joo did an exceptional job handling a dire emergency for us. Definitely coming back for our next service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Castillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: i had an over all great experience. the only reason i gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because the wait was pretty long but the staff was super kind and helpful. i got a root canal and it was pretty painless!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophie A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was super friendly, helpful and professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Massaro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in for pain and all they could do was clean my teeth. They did such a rushed job that there’s not much cleaned and the assistant let water overflow out of my mouth, and even suctioned my lip instead at one point… and the dentist just let all of this happen. Then when it was the assistant’s turn to finish up, she was in such a hurry that she didn’t even “polish” my teeth.. the paste even got in my hair because she was so bad at using the tool to apply it.  I have never experienced such negligence in my life. The front office staff are really nice but I will absolutely not come back here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Quartey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr.Wharton & Stephanie were awesome!
Stephanie made sure I remained calm by using the Tapping Method to help me relax as they numbed my mouth & pulled out my back & wisdom tooth & Dr. Wharton was very sweet as you re-assured me that I was doing just fine
as she slowly & efficiently pulled out my teeth. Equally, they both entertained my
5YR old son who was so inquisitive &
excited to be at the dentist office with me! From the time I walked in I felt the love & pleasantry of this office

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beverly Shittu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is nice, but they don't ask about your insurance. You have to pay an $89 fee upfront and the place was dirty

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maya
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best dental experience here. The staff was so helpful, patient, and knowledgeable. I cannot recommend this place enough if you are in need of emergency dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: the_og_goose gamer epic
user_reviews_extended.Description: On a Sunday I called and they worked in an appointment understanding my sense of urgency in regards to my dental emergency.They are Friendly, knowledgeable, fast, caring, professional and reassuring making my experience a calm and good one. Dr. Dudeen, and assistant. Highly Recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joan Greene
user_reviews_extended.Description: Chipped my front tooth visiting my daughter in Austin over the holiday weekend.  This place was great for quick weekend appointments and they fixed it quickly.  Prices were very reasonable too.  Highly recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly staff and the dentist is really thorough with testing to see what options they can do for you. I thought I needed an extraction, but it turns out I didn't. Very honest place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karina Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience here! Woke up with the left side of my face being swollen and I knew it was from my cavity being infected.  Luckily they were open on a Sunday morning, I wasn’t sure any spot was gonna be able to get me in but we called and were able to make an appointment same day!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adriana Chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife was in major pain because of a wisdom tooth that broke and I called emergency dentist at 10 am and she was seen and treated the same day we called. The staff was super friendly and helpful, the doctor was quick and gentle, the payment plans they have in place made it super easy to get treatment right away and the prices are the best we have seen in town. We will return and every single person in there was amazing. Thank you to everyone!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel W
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been here a couple times and couldn’t be more grateful for them. My regular dentist was not able to help me for weeks, but I knew just who to call after a previous experience with Dr. Campbell and crew. I have extreme dental anxiety and they listened to my concerns and fears which definitely helped make the whole process easier. Pricing is emergency but worth it for the immediate resolution. Would definitely recommend if you need care now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Poor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best place to go for dental emergencies, I had lost a filling in my front tooth on Friday night and was in the chair on Saturday morning getting it fixed. I’m traveling soon and was very upset this happened, who wants to go home for the first time in 7 years with a swinging door for a front tooth! NOT ME! These Ladies are amazing, the dentist was thorough and fast. I appreciate each and everyone one of you for all you do! Also they have payment plans y’all! 🦷❤️😉

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Evans
user_reviews_extended.Description: I needed an extraction on a budget. I called at 1:30pm to inquire about price. I spoke to Noah on the phone and he offered to wave the consultation fee. I made an appointment for 4pm the same day. Got X-rays, the extraction, and was out of the office by 5:30pm. Dr. Dudeen had an amazing bedside manner. He was funny and comforting. All around a great experience. They put me on a payment plan of $78 down payment, $66/mo for 15 months. Thank you so much! I had been putting this off for over a year before the pain became unbearable. Y'all are my heros!

user_reviews_extended.Name: DaNeisha Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just came in for an emergency root canal and I can honestly say this was my best experience ever with a dental office. The receptionist was so nice as well as my dentist and the assistant. They constantly made sure I knew why they were doing what they were doing and I really appreciated that cause I know nothing about dental work. I won’t even be going back to my primary dentist. I’ll just be returning here. Thank y’all soooo much!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eisha Humphries
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve had a major fear of dentists since I was a child due to some trauma I experienced with a dentist.
Over the last week I’ve had some unbearable pain with two broken teeth and haven’t been able to eat, sleep, even wash my face because the touch alone is excruciating.
I was able to get into Austin emergency dentist to hopefully get some relief. I ended up needing a tooth extracted, and a partial root canal. Not gonna lie, I cried. Scary but had to be done. Dr Campbell was so incredible. Super kind, patient, good energy and patient with me. And the dental assistant (I can’t remember her name- sweet lady, glasses, dark hair and an accent), man, she was incredible! She held my hand, made jokes to help me out, even helped me to the restroom when I thought I was going to be sick.
I can’t recommend this place more. Top notch care from every single person in that building. Everyone was so nice and comforting.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan Andrade
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Campbell helped me with my filling, and I am very impressed! Marissa was the assistant and she made me feel very comfortable. They even have a few payment plans available! Definitely recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Morris
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Staff are so nice and helpful! The Dr The tech very informative and kind! Ty Nova for helping me with the financial questions and being patient! 10 outta 10 recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keke Michelle
user_reviews_extended.Description: THANKS SO MUCH HEALED MY PAIN AND CALMED ME AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE DURING THE EXTRACTION

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Weiss
user_reviews_extended.Description: The biggest lifesavers ever. I chipped a tooth on a Saturday and they got me in within an hour of calling. They were transparent on price and offerings, and the quality of the filling was amazing. Staff was incredibly nice and friendly across the board. Despite the dentistry being far away from me, I’ll make them my go to for everything — routine or emergency — moving forward

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: They did an amazing job with me, I had a tooth extraction that needed to be done and had tried going to another place but my anxiety was just so bad and I couldn’t do it and once again when I came here my anxiety was high again but the dentist and dental assistant were so assuring and patient with me and made the experience so good for me. I’m so grateful that they helped me get through it because I was in so much pain because of that tooth. I’d also like to mention I was able to get in same day and was in out and very quickly! The whole staff was so welcoming and nice. I’m just very impressed with this office. I’ll be coming to them everytime!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry May
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and wonderful service! I highly recommend! They took care of me at the last minute and took my pain away I'm extremely grateful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Earley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff were all really nice. They got me in right away.  Dr saw me immediately gave me my options and then repaired my tooth.  In and out no fuss.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rach Ev
user_reviews_extended.Description: From Dr.S to Stephanie, Samantha, RK and others too (I’m not too great with names!)  everyone here took the time to make sure my dental work was perfect. I know they had to jump through some hoops to find the right dental lab but I’m very appreciative for all their work and communication. Their hours are very convenient, I didn’t need to take any time off of work which is a big plus and sets them apart from other dental offices too.  I’m extremely happy with my results and although I hope I won’t ever have to have emergency (or any) dental work done, if I do I won’t hesitate to come back and recommend to others as well. Thank you guys!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elora Kindred
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Baic and staff are absolutely amazing!

From setting up a same day appointment on a Friday evening to completing a wisdom tooth extraction — the process was simple and smooth.

Dr. Baic reviewed and discussed my x-rays. Then she talked me through the extraction process — before, during, and after — which brought me comfort and reassurance. Also, as she numbed my gums, I didn’t feel a thing.

I’m so grateful for their guidance and kind service. Their staff is personable and compassionate. Though I arrived horrified getting my tooth pulled, I was relaxed (and numb) by the time I left.

I highly recommend their service and will return if/when needed with confidence!

🌱Elora

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hind m.m
user_reviews_extended.Description: Unfortunately I would like to update my review. I do not recommend this place at all and I will not send anyone to it and I will not return to it and I will inform everyone about it too ! they took from me three times more than other clinics who called me today , they said that they can back the bridge for $ 100, but this place cost me $400 and something in addition to that they $89 visit fee. And they told me that they can make a new bridge for three teeth for $5,000 and something,today I got a price of $3,000 today from big, fancy clinics in Austin, and they're excellent. I'm sorry, I trusted the receptionist who said it was the cheapest clinic in Austin and today it turns out she wasn't completely honest! Dr.Assistant Stephanie she was great and really helpful! No start for this place

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Balistrieri
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you so much!! The staff and doctor did an amazing job! They all stayed late so that my friend could have an emergency surgery. I can’t thank them enough! We appreciate all that you do! Everyone was very thoughtful and kind.:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Mahoney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in with extreme tooth pain after dealing with it for a very long time. The staff was quick to get me back and comfortable. It took 20 minutes to get an exam and go over options. Had 2 extractions with one being particularly difficult and was on my way within the hour.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Daniel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Positive experience. Accommodated me on a Saturday a few days before leaving for my honeymoon. The staff was very friendly and explained what was going on in a way that made sense. It was well worth the drive up.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Fleming
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were wonderful! Kris was so gentle and kind, so was Dr. S. I have VERY bad anxiety when it come to dental work, and I was scared/shaky during my root canal and extraction. But they made me feel comfortable and talked to me in such a friendly manner. I am so grateful! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gilberto Medina
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Stephanie and Dr. Campbell are amazing! The staff is nice and very kind with anyone needing an emergency. They'll explain everything and get you the right plan to get you fixed. E
Also, if you need any kind of emergency on a weekend, they are definitely a must go to!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leti Bocanegra
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole experience and team were fabulous. I had a severe tooth ache and They took me in the same day. It waa a Saturday determined I needed a root canal and scheduled me for that the next day even though it was a Sunday. The procedure went smoothly. In fact I almost fell asleep because I was so relaxed. I recommend them highly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went with my sister today for some tooth pain she was experiencing , and the ladies and doctor was very friendly and the visit was quick and efficient! Best services hands down!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rob Cunningham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been living with a bad tooth for over a year until the pain got unbearable. Found emergency dentist of Austin and not knowing anything about them went there. They fit me in took X-rays and determined what I already knew. It had to come out. The office personnel to the dentist made me feel really comfortable and relaxed. The tooth came out and a day later no pain. Also a lot less expensive than anywhere else I looked.
Thank you. EDofA

user_reviews_extended.Name: victoria young
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was so fast and easy, and they had great payment options for people with no credit like myself.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Addie Sturman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ms. Marisa and Dr. Campbell were amazing! They made me feel very comfortable and we’re vary patient with me. Also the front desk was amazing. They knew what they were talking about and answered all my questions.  Amazing place and the prices are great too!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ricardo Santos IV
user_reviews_extended.Description: Whole experience was amazing,Shahrzad and Sidney were amazing, very helpful and patient. Dr. Smitherman was so great, very quick and easy, explained everything and answered all of my question. Will gladly drive across town every time in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LaCole Foots
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff has been amazing. Professional, patient, and empathetic. Special shout out to Kris who helped me calm down before a tough procedure and made sure I was comfortable  throughout. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Azalia Andrews
user_reviews_extended.Description: Angelica was great both times I had to come in. Made me laugh and more comfortable during my experience which is appreciated when you come in with pain and have to get a tooth pulled!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casey
user_reviews_extended.Description: They scam into a payment plan at a 34.99% interest rate. You will wait an hour after the appointment you schedule they don't care about patients .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harlow McKinney
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Really lovely front desk staff. I came in for mild-severe pain, they charged me 88$, I was in the room for less than 10 minutes before they just referred me to an oral surgeon, and that was it.
Didn’t really discuss any options on how to help with current pain until I can afford the surgery, didn’t even ask very crucial questions. Just got an X-ray, got looked at, and got dismissed. Probably won’t be coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Cabin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dentist and staff were extremely professional and informed me all the options available to correct the tooth. Facility and equipment was clean and well maintained. I would have given 5 stars but they don’t work with insurance; have to submit for reimbursement in my own.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional, kind and efficient. I had an emergency tooth extraction done the very next day after I called. Saw me on time if not slightly prior to my actual appointment and got me taken care of quickly. They kept me in the loop as to what was happening and made sure I was taken care of afterwards. Highly recommend using this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carla Paredes-Keese
user_reviews_extended.Description: Do not come here if you have children. My toddler broke his tooth, I was frantic, I called this emergency dentist and was told he could be seen. We set an appointment for a few hours later and arrived on time. We were billed up front for the visit, waited over an hour to be seen, only to be told my child needed to be seen by a pediatric dentist and sent on our way. Total cash grab. I asked to be refunded the $100 billed for this visit since there were no x-rays taken, no exam and were told we needed to be seen elsewhere, and have received no response, over a month later.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danyce Harrison
user_reviews_extended.Description: This has been one of the best dental experiences I have had in a very long time ! The Doctor was very gentle and patient with me when administering the anesthesia , and for that alone I am very grateful . 🫶🏼 They have an amazing staff and an even more exceptional doctor . I highly recommend 10/10 .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Scheduled and appointment last night and came in today to have an emergency removal. Staff was very caring and very informative about my options. I was taken care of quickly and with much care. I am so appreciative of the staff here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kylee Kirby
user_reviews_extended.Description: My fiancé needed a tooth extraction and they were able to get us in same day - Saturday appointment! Dr. Smithermann was very kind and I struggle with feeling comfortable with doctors, dentists etc. She was amazing! My finance has had issues in the past with extractions and Dr. Smithermann made sure she was completely numb and had the broken tooth extracted and the bone graft inserted within seconds. Sydney explained financial aid and options clearly and had a lot of patient. I really appreciate this staff and their commitment to dental care. TV with Netflix in the patient room. Bathroom was clean. The pricing is more than what we have paid in the past, but that is expected at an emergency center. Thank you Emergency Dental Care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmine Whittaker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Baik and her team are absolutely amazing! I called them early Saturday morning and they got me in the same day! Everyone from Front desk, the dental assistant, and the dentist herself were kind and supportive. She helped ease my mind about the trouble I was having with my healing process from another dentist. And was very kind about the fact that it was a piece of PICKLE causing my pain lol!

Overall a great experience with this team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johannah Lindsay
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was stuck in Austin due to a pulmonary embolism, and just before I was able to finally travel home, one of my teeth broke. I came in and was examined by wonderfully kind staff, given options for a treatment plan, and made to feel comfortable the entire time. The dentist who did my actual treatment was very professional and ethical, making an effort to come up with an option for me that would get me home to my normal dentist and minimize the costs to me (so I wouldn't have to pay for things twice), while still safely treating my problem. My dentist at home was impressed with the work done at this office. Costs were very affordable and everyone was very kind. Highly recommend this place. I broke my tooth late on a Friday evening and I was seen first thing Saturday morning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liiu OhSoiicY
user_reviews_extended.Description: I woke up in so much pain I didn’t know what to do. I called early on a Sunday morning and was happy to find out they could fit me in within the hour. The staff is so friendly and welcoming. I was in and out within two hours .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Rouhiainen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place for quick care with my emergency gum infection. Appointment and treatment on same day and all the staff were super friendly and helpful

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renee Lynn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nice and organized. Everyone was amazing. Dr Campbell was incredible with my son. And so friendly. And an emergency appointment on a Saturday was easy to get. Incredible. Definitely will be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandria Counts
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got me in so fast, minimal waiting for an emergency root canal appointment, talked me through my options, transparent about costs, very knowledgeable dentist who answered all my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neil Roben
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great front staff! Xochill and Shafaq were very kind and helpful! Doctor Dudeen, Shahrazad and Marisa did a phenomenal job with the procedure! Highly recommend, will come back for future visits!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Service and staff were awesome. Cost, as with any dentist, not so much but they had reasonable payment options. The fact they are open late on Saturday was a blessing to end my suffering from this toothache.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Verkest
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nice folks, very friendly, however, Personally , I found it strange they do not bill or use insurance…you pay out of pocket then get the “opportunity” to try and get reimbursed from your insurance. I guess I get it, but for me that’s a red flag. Again that’s just me. Also, price seemed very high…a little research you can find customary charges for certain procedures. They were 3x higher. Good in a pinch I suppose, but wasn’t for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan Wiggins
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you have a weekend dental emergency, this is the place.  Traveling and came back home Saturday... lesson learned, never fly with a toothache/abscess... the worst....   Excruciating pain all night, Sunday morning called these folks.   At 11:00AM I was in the chair, with diagnosis and options presented.  After a root canal I was out by 1:30 and on the road to recovery.  They were very open and candid the entire time and recommended how to proceed from here.  A+

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robyen Baxter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Took my sister n law here to get her tooth pulled, she was in excruciating pain. The wait took less than 30 minutes. Big thanks KHRIS she was delightful and very informative. Also Joo was great did an amazing job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tonia Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am on vacation in Austin and had to have an emergency wisdom tooth extraction on a Sunday! The doctor and the entire staff were amazing from the moment I called. They were compassionate, patient, informative, and most importantly, they did what was necessary to get me on the path to healing and feeling better to get to enjoy some of my vacation. I could not have asked for a better experience under such painful circumstances.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Burleson Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was flying out to NY to start a new job on Sunday. The filling between my two front teeth popped out Thursday night leaving me with a gaping hole; not the first impression I was hoping to make. This team got me in for an appointment, fixed the filling, and gave me a deep cleaning all in about an hour and half. The best dentist experience I've ever had. Hands down. I am now a very happy permanent client.

user_reviews_extended.Name: love v
user_reviews_extended.Description: The girl with the bad haircut and bleached eyebrows should be fired.  I get that people have bad days, but you don’t get to take it out on the public like a child.   Get a therapist like the rest of us.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chane Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place!! They saw us right away and immediately handled the emergency with care!!  Loved the service and positive attitude!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ro Ni
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was a very positive experience for me starting with customer service when making the appointment to having the procedure done by the dentist. The assistance that prepped me took care to make sure that I was given a pre numbing type ointment prior to having an injection which was very nice because that injection normally would hurt. Everyone was professional, helpful and pleasant.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Chen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. D and Marissa were amazing!!! Great bedside manner and reassured me throughout the whole process. They answered all my questions! Thank you so much for helping me out in a pinch. I appreciate all that you do!

user_reviews_extended.Name: christopher raines
user_reviews_extended.Description: My son had an accident at work and broke 4 of his teeth on a Saturday. I was so worried that he was going to have to wake up Sunday with missing teeth. These guys got him in and got temporary caps put on starting at 4pm to 8:30. I as a parent am so thankful for these guys for getting him looking normal again after an unforeseen accident

user_reviews_extended.Name: McCall Richardson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited Emergency Dentist of Austin to address an abscessed tooth directly after relocating to Texas and finding myself in severe pain on a weekend. Stephanie was absolutely amazing in answering all my questions and ensuring that I had the most comfortable experience possible. Combined with Dr. Campbell’s wonderful work and genuine care, I can confidently say this was my best dental experience so far and that I would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suraj Mehta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dudeen and the dental team on site were amazing! He was straight to the business of taking care of my crown re-cement right away and with no issues! Everyone was very kind, thank you for the prompt service- you all are very appreciated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Javeline Curtis
user_reviews_extended.Description: easy , I was scared but Hannah and the ladies in the front made me feel safe and prepared. Dentist answered all my questions for my anxiety and was very patient

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wasn't sure if I would be able to find a dentist on a holiday weekend and much to my surprise I found this place. Everyone was very kind and patient. Dr Smith and her assistant were exceptional. They answered all of my questions and made sure I was comfortable and calm. Pulled a wisdom tooth with absolutely no pain. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc Cowlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience!   I was on vacation and had the crown for my implant break- so missing front tooth- not at all attractive. These guys got the lab to rush an order of a retainer with built in fake tooth so I could look normal until I could see my home dentist. 10/10. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Tavey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was in SEVERE pain from a back tooth and they were able to get me in within hours. Didn’t keep me waiting long at all and had me back, X-rays done, and figured out the problem within 15-20 minutes. They were then able to immediately fix the problem by extracting my tooth, doing a bone graft, and stitching me back up. Will definitely come back here if future issues arise!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bazquez Brothers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing dentist! Had a toothache that kept waking me from my sleep & I started looking for a dentist on a weekend & found this place. Arrived a few minutes before they even opened & they took me in immediately. Within the hour I was much better! Friendly staff. Affordable. Loved it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Quach
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a weekend dental emergency and found this place based on their reviews! All the stellar reviews are true! They are friendly, knowledgeable and transparent on everything that needed to be done. They do not take insurance but offer payment plans to reimbursement. Thank you Dr. Patrick Campbell and the staff for seeing me on Sunday morning! I would this place to all friends and family for all dental emergency needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Farah M.
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is an excellent clinic. The dentists are experienced professionals. They advise you according to what’s best for your needs. The staff handle you with care and respect. The nurse, Kris, who took care of my husband was wonderful. A BIG Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Kround
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called all around to see a dentist for an emergency tooth ache that left me weeping like a baby this morning and these folks were the only ones who could!. They got me in quick for a great deal and a script for antibiotics. I will be recommending to other students who struggle to find dentists covering time slots not usually done by other offices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark
user_reviews_extended.Description: Set up an appointment for an hour after I called and was in and out in 45 minutes with my wisdom tooth extracted, staff had great service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phyllis Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: First, I wholeheartedly believe this is a 5-star facility based on the initial customer service, availability, and dental professionals. Having excruciating tooth pain, I called for an appointment and was seen within three hours of calling. Not only that, the young lady I spoke to on the phone was absolutely amazing (Izzy)! She calmed my nerves and assured me that I would be taken care of. Everyone was so professional and kind when I entered the office. The dentist extracted a very stubborn, painful tooth (with the help of another dentist) and another minor procedure with success. However, I did have one issue, and that was post-procedure pain management. It took some time to get my pain manageable, Dr. Kumar personally addressed my pain issue, and eventually, I was taken care of. My next tooth extraction (yes, another one) was easy and painless. I plan to return for more dental work in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rodney Kelley
user_reviews_extended.Description: IF you’re in pain and don’t care about cost and you have a lot of money to spend then this might be A good option, I was in pain and needed A Tooth pulled first option they pitched me was thousand dollars. Second option five hundred dollars. If you can wait to see A regular dentist it’s much cheaper. I spent 90 bucks on A few X-rays they  didn’t even look inside my mouth. Just to get A pitch on spending more money. If you have insurance don’t waste your time wait on A normal dentist.staff was very friendly and the facility was clean

user_reviews_extended.Name: HUNTER 128
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were very helpful, I came in for an an emergency extraction and spreading infection and was seen in very short order. They were very professional, and I was done and out the door less than an hour after being seen. I very much recommend them, hands down the best experience I’ve ever had at a dentist despite how worried I was coming in.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Latarsha Willis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Elaine , Linda , Kirsten , and Dr. Hugue were really nice , friendly , and patient. They were very professional and made me very comfortable. Their rates are fair, and the service that they provided was great. I recommend them to anyone wanting their teeth fixed. I am very satisfied!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cesar Leon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff! Very sweet and make you feel comfortable! I got an extraction and felt nothing! Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Riad Bakeer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had an emergency and Dr. Min, Snehal, and the team took amazing care of me. They don't take insurance so be ready to pay out of pocket and request a reimbursement. There's also a financing option in-house as well.

Dr. Min was very kind and ensured that me having a painless procedure as possible was his top priority aside from doing a good job. Thank you so much!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holly Findlater
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very efficient use of time in the office and chair.  The dentist told me everything they were doing and reassured me when it was helpful.  They are one of the few places where dental work can be financed reasonably and are available when most dentists are not.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Hankins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cece and all the ladies working were amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jade
user_reviews_extended.Description: CeCe and Dr.Dudeen got me on quickly, and answer all my questions. I'm very grateful and would definitely come back of need be

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lyssa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place! My husband had a dental emergency on a Saturday night, and they were able to see him on Sunday and get his problem solved. The staff and the doctor were all very great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: logan olson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The kind and welcoming staff make it easy to come into the dentist. Work I've had done was always quality and in a timely manner. Having Sunbit as a payment option makes visits very affordable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dylan Kennedy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in for a consultation and was able to get a painful wisdom tooth removed the same afternoon. This was the day before July 4th, when all other offices were closed for an extended holiday weekend. The staff were extremely friendly, helpful and informative, and the extraction (performed by Kris and Dr. Joo) was quick, efficient and painless. I would happily return to this office for all of my emergency and non-emergency dental health needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: BDB
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dental assistant Kris and Dr. Vaik (sorry about spelling) were wonderful. I have dental phobia and it was a VERY intense and difficult emergency extraction and they were able to do the nitrous therapy and get the work done in one day. Scheduled me in when I called. Staff was gentle and friendly and accommodated my needs  Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph du Lac
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in with a painful tooth infection and in desperate need of an extraction. The staff was understanding and empathetic, and before long I was under the care of a competent doctor that did an excellent job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff was amazing.

They were able to get me in on a Saturday evening Complete, a root canal and get me out in time for a business meeting.

Professional, personable, and excellent experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Caldwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of my crowns came loose at 10pm on a Saturday night as I was chomping away at Swedish Fish. I panicked, and started googling around. Luckily I found this office, and called them promptly at 8am Sunday morning. They were able to get me in by 9am same day, and the temporary crown was placed, my new crown was ordered & I was out the door by 11am. Amazing service, I feel so grateful this team is operating at these hours. Not having to wait until Monday (and miss work) was a great relief. Thanks to everyone in the office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neil Wang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and easy-going staff, simple and efficient process, and most importantly excellent doctor. We had an emergent situation and came here just because other places were all closed. Dr. Joo provided accurate evaluation, proper treatment, and professional guidance - everything perfectly done and latterly confirmed, verified, and praised by our regular/family dentist. This is a five star place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Hallett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The Dentist can be a nightmare for some people. I needed 3 removals, and I was nervous about the task at hand. Dr. Joo could sense my presence and he assured me that everything was going to be okay. For anyone getting extractions, just know the anticipation is way worse than the actual procedure. I HIGHLY recommend this place of practice to anybody who wants a family-friendly environment and a true professional like Dr. Joo. I can’t see myself going anywhere else!!!

& a special shoutout to everyone in the front for providing great customer service. I wish you all wonderful days ahead ✨

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Professional and courteous service. After two visits, I believe the hygiene of the facility needs attention.
The surface where the instruments rest had red stains, and the instruments connected to the chair had a white residue, like a mirror after brushing your teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sarah heller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing! I had a serious tooth pain for about a week and my regular dentist appt wasn't for another week.. knowing I wouldn't be able to last, I found this place and was not disappointed. They got me in the same day & did some xrays.. I needed a tooth extracted and they were prepared to do it that same day but couldn't due to my high blood pressure (a me issue, they tried 3 times). They told me to come back in a week and they will try again, which I did. My BP was better and they took out my tooth in a matter of minutes. They even let me go to my car and get my headphones too cuz I really had no interest in listening to all that lol. The staff was super friendly as well and the payment plan they offer was very easy to see if you qualify and set up. I even recommended this place to a coworker already.. If you need something in a pinch, definitely check them out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anderson Baarclay
user_reviews_extended.Description: True emergency that I have never experienced. Dr Beck, Linda, Nicole, & Kirsten were professionals in every aspect of the visit. They were my Heroes today. I highly recommend the practice. Blessings to all there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: karen porter
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were very nice and accommodating! I also like that I was able to be seen so quickly and I was in and out within an hour and a half for two extractions!

user_reviews_extended.Name: khoa pham
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very bad tooth infection and it was weekend so almost all dentist places are closed. I called Emergency Dentist of Austin, the receptionist was extremely kind and arranged me for a emergency oral surgery schedule right away. After 15'' wait, I got taken care by Dr Minn, she's very very patient to ensure the procedure was painless. She made the complicated operation went through easily.100% recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brianna Ruiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor was super quick, very kind and knowing that people get stressed out with them to work. As always into work is expensive, but I will stay for an emergency. It was very affordable and I love that they have financing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Breanna Souther
user_reviews_extended.Description: the staff was wonderful! everyone was so kind as soon as i stepped into the door and helped me so much. i feel like everyone always has anxiety around going to the dentist and they really helped to calm my nerves.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are a rip off.  On the phone I was told they accept all PPO insurance.  After arriving I found out they require full up front payment then you can file a reimbursement.  I'm in desperate need of an extraction. I paid the 89 fee to be seen then 450 for the extraction. Filled out paperwork describing my medical issues as well. While I'm in the chair the dentist asked if I had medical issues which I'm diabetic and it isn't well controlled.  As a result she said she would only do the extraction if I got a bone graph for another 400 dollars. There was no way I could afford that and 450 for an extraction seems really high as well. Only good thing is I got a refund. I asked where the poster was for the number to file a complaint with the medical board and they didn't have one. The nice person at the front desk was nice to look it up. Very incompetent and unprofessional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: djfairyaries
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very helpful and informative, made my appointment the night before. Saw me first thing the next morning. I used their $89 emergency special and got an X-ray, referral to get my tooth extracted from an oral surgeon and a prescription for antibiotics in the meantime. Satisfied with my experience and grateful for their help (:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Larue
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in with immense pain. They helped me out with a root canal and provided me with a payment plan. The staff was very professional, bedside manner was amazing. Everyone was so nice! Would recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Nicole
user_reviews_extended.Description: The care I received here was the best. Shout out to the dental assistants and Dr Campbell for really taking care of me and making me feel comfortable even with my extreme anxiety. They are also straightforward with pricing and options.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yolanda King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was very disappointed, have been in pain for a week, was Quoted over $800 for just an extraction, one tooth with laughing gas, without still almost $500!  The dentist was not friendly all!  Would not recommend this place at all!!!  $89 just to walk in, asked for a receipt, just got ignored!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Akeila
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service! I was having pain and was able to be seen within a couple of hours on a Sunday when everyone else was closed. Staff was amazing and made an otherwise traumatizing experience comfortable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Evans
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a bad tooth infection. They took me in right away. Their service is top notch. The people are so nice. They care of all their patients with 5 star service. Highly recommend if you have a dental emergency.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daisy Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came into Emergency Dentist of Austin with a terrible tooth pain on my upper back teeth. They took x-rays, and listened to my concerns. I was sure it was an abscess or fractured tooth. Turns out, I had a sinus infection, and the pressure causing inflammation. I would have never connected the two if it wasn’t for my Doctor. Thank you to Dr. Dudeen for properly diagnosing and discussing this with me. Thank you to the staff who was so welcoming and supportive. I’d highly recommend this place 10/10.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynd
user_reviews_extended.Description: wow. this is the most compassionate dentistry I’ve ever been to. I came in last minute due to a tooth ache and was taken care of by Dr. Noor who was kind and patient with me. The nurses and receptionists were perfect angel and I actually left with a hug by the same woman who scheduled me. Her name starts with an L, she was fantastic. Thank you team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Garrett Kemple
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Front seat girl was so cool and Dr. Min and his assistant did an amazing job. Got 3 impacted wisdom teeth and didn’t feel a thing. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Rosenberg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dentist: She was great and fast. I did have a lot of pain for a few days after the root canal (which I normally don’t) so I would say the only downside is she doesn’t have a soft touch. Other than that she was great.

Dental Assistants: they were the best part. They were super kind and fun and made the whole experience fun!

Office staff: they were kind.

Price: they are very expensive and do not accept insurance even though they say they do on their website. I have previously paid $2000 for a root canal and crown in Houston at an emergency dentist and around the same at my normal dentist but here it was almost $4000. They do not give you a discount for paying cash. They don’t even give you a breakdown of the cost.

Lunch break: the staff has a lunch break from 1-2pm everyday. This isn’t bad but it’s not advertised so if you walk in at 1 expect to wait.

I made an appt online and that was easy to use.

Bonus plus: they have smart tvs where you can watch Netflix.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anngela Velez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called and they got me in asap! They were very kind and the dentist got straight to it and walked me through everything and genuinely cared about my comfort! Loved it !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mykal Landry
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was great! Was in pain all night was able to come next day and get it taken care of. Thank goodness you guys were open. Everyone was so nice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny Callahan
user_reviews_extended.Description: great experience! my veneer fell out and i’ve never had it put back in so quickly! kind staff - would recommend to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: avyel leyva
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing service and everything done in a great timely matter! All the staff so friendly and welcoming!!! Definitely the place to go!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: K. Alexander
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was the smoothest dental visit ever
The process was very informative and easy. The tech was amazing and very well knowledgeable

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree McEnturff
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wisdom tooth was bothering me and I was scared it was going to be an infection and luckily they were able to see me the very next day on a Sunday no less. The whole experience went by so quickly! Everyone was friendly and was reassuring throughout the whole ordeal I would definitely recommend this place to anyone that might need an emergency dentist visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Villalobos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience here. I have a set of porcelain veneers I had put in about 8 years ago by a different dentist. Since then, most of those veneers have popped off at least once. Each time I go to an emergency dentist to get the veneer recemented. This time I found Emergency Dentist of Austin and they were able to book me in right away to get my veneer back in. Not only did I get SAME DAY service (on a Sunday of memorial weekend!) the team was super professional, kind and gentle. I highly recommend this place and their work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Perri Osattin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was able to see Doctor Baik almost immediately for an emergency appointment. While I didn’t have an urgent situation that night, she explained what was causing my pain, what to look out for in the future, and how to prevent it from happening again. The entire office team was really friendly and helpful as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got me in and out same day. Everyone was wonderful and nice. Help walk through everything ease my anxiety which is bad when coming to the dentist. Very helpful here .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Vela
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience I've ever had. Friendly, fast and efficient.  Will hopefully not have to come back but if I do it will be here  💕

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Craig
user_reviews_extended.Description: So nice from the front desk to the financial person who tells you how much you owe. If you don’t have insurance this is the place to come. Dr Campbell and Angelica were wonderful to me. Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phil Petescia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had a crown put in 2 weeks ago at Wolf Ranch Dental.  It came off on a Saturday afternoon when I was traveling Monday. Wolf Ranch dental says on their website “Emergency Service” but I found out that means they only answer the phones on weekends to make an appointment during the week.
Made an on line appointment here for Sunday morning and had it glued back in for what I felt was a reasonable price.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Wetherby
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in terrible pain with dry socket, dr Campbell diagnosed it at once and gave me pain relief and started treatment, he and his staff were wonderful, thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jodi Brinkley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Called first thing in the morning and they got me in within the hour. Explained everything in detail. Answered all my questions. Fixed my broken tooth and done in no time. And after several hours I feel no pain. All the staff and doctor are very pleasant. I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Ware
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Campbell and CeCe were great. They pulled my wisdom tooth and sent me on my way. Thank you for making my life a heck of a lot better.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Axon
user_reviews_extended.Description: My mom had a loose tooth and on a Friday she started feeling a lot of pain. We live in Round Rock so we tried to call an emergency dentist here but they wouldn't take her until Monday. My mom called Emergency Dentist of Austin and they made an appointment for her that night! It turned out that she needed her wisdom tooth pulled and she has a lot of anxiety about the dentist. Everyone there was nice and compassionate. Would definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jackie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m so happy I found this place. I started having a lot of pain in my wisdom tooth the night before and the next day I called and they took me in the same day. I got both wisdoms extracted for a fair price and I’m so relieved now that they’re out. The staff was an absolute dream, so kind and patient. I’ll be coming here from now on for all my dental work 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tomy Tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here is great! The doctor and their assistants are incredibly nice and looks after your teeth. Please come see them if you feel the need!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terri Dean
user_reviews_extended.Description: My x-rays were really bad and I had a lot going on. Every staff member was so sweet and helpful. They are my Heroes! Thank you Krys and Dr. Joo. This is the best dental office in austin. The best staff! I was so happy I danced out of the office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kendrick Eckman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a filling fall out on a Friday evening. Everywhere else was closed or closing and they were able to get me in within an hour of me calling. The staff was incredible and by the end of my visit everything was fixed. Very grateful this service was available and would recommend to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Calhoun
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was not very good they wanted to charge me 600$ for a tooth to be filled. With out financial help my wisdom tooth extraction would have also been 600$ I spent 89$ to get them to look at it but won’t prescribe me pain med even though I can’t sleep because of it, they said ibuprofen and Tylenol would work which I’ve been taking and it has not helped. Super annoyed and I’m a lot of pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best dentist I’ve ever been at. The dentist was definitely caring and the nurse was comforting I would absolutely come back if my teeth were ever bothering me again. Front desk was very nice too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Vargas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff is always friendly and communicative. Doctor pays close attention to details and facility is always clean inside. Wait time is always minimal.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devon Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter had a real bad toothache, I’m up 4 in the morning trying to find the next availability for a dentist and Emergency Dentist of Austin was exactly what I needed. My daughter was seen that afternoon . Office was nice and clean the staff were wonderful and welcoming and the dentist 🦷 was outstanding. I appreciate you guys 💚 thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eiram Llaeb
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Kerala was extremely helpful and professional on the phone.
Keys was so sweet and understanding,
Dr. Dudeen  very professional, great manners, likeable, I just met him and I already love him. Very friendly and clean atmosphere.congratulations. RK was also kind and understood. Thank you!
Noah is so helpful and kind., very polite! Thank

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jana Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We're in from out of the country, and I had a veneer come off unexpectedly. I cannot say enough good things about the Emergency Dentist of Austin. They were able to get me an appt within an hour of me calling. They were so understanding and compationate. The dentist was fast and professional. It also did not break the bank.
Thank you for saving our vacation!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vicki Bass
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am terrified of going to the dentist, but this place made me feel so comfortable. I barely felt a thing. They are a little pricey, but worth every penny!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shongile Mabasa
user_reviews_extended.Description: After having a tooth extracted, I experienced intense pain while still at the dentist's office. Despite informing the staff, they mentioned there was nothing they could do. I had to visit the Emergency Room, where I received stronger medication to alleviate the pain. The ER doctor was surprised by the prescription from the dentist. The pain was so severe that I feared I might faint. It seems like after the procedure, there is a lack of care from their end.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Fierro
user_reviews_extended.Description: The most caring crew that helped me with all the options that wouldn’t bankrupt me! So gentle and efficient, would recommend to anyone having a dental emergency especially on a weekend or Friday! Called me back and got me in same day and I was out in an hour and a half! Now I’m set up for long term tooth health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an Emergency extraction and I was able to get in the the very next day after contacting them over night I love how Friendly they are here . I love how nice and welcoming the nurse assistant was she helped me understand all my questions Stephanie was awesome and so was Doctor Dudeen come check them out if you need your teeth done

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony V
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not going to lie, I was leery with all of the amazing reviews. You just never see that especially in the medical field. I had am amazing experience here for the root canal needs I had. Kind, fast, upfront about costs, and over helped me find a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very impressed! They got me right in, clean place, supportive/friendly staff that got to the point but explained everything, and I enjoyed how friendly and positive the staff/dentist was to each other. Recommending to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: marnie tattooedmom03
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best service. Doctor was very courtous and fast. Great job on everything. The pain is already going down.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ricardo D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Needed an emergency extraction done on a Sunday. Was in severe pain. The staff was friendly and very comforting. The dentist was extremely gentle. I am sure to return if I need anymore work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Dennis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to go get a tooth pull and I had to pay $89 for what they didn't even pull my tooth at all talking about I have to pay again to get my tooth pull that's not right at all they robbing people for there money if they ain't going to do what you come to there office for than they needs to refund people there money back because y'all ain't pull no tooth

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corey DiStefano
user_reviews_extended.Description: All staff and Dr. Smitherman are friendly and attentive. I had an issue with billing and the office manager was kind in explaining and helping to resolve it. Overall good experience and I would go back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Carson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Smitherman was AMAZING! She was very kind and gentle, and made sure I knew what was going on and gave me a say in what was done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leigh de la Reza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cici and Dr. Campbell were great. They got us in on a Sunday for a dental emergency. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexander Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kat was very very nice and patient would definitely recommend coming here and getting checked out by her you’ll love her I also would like to give shout to all the people in the front who helped me understand the financial part the doctor doing the work on me was also professional would recommend going.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Noel King
user_reviews_extended.Description: So patient with me as a patient. Incredible staff all around. Heard them calming other patients with the care what a mother would do for her child. 10/10 would recommend to anyone, especially those afraid of the dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sean Graef
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had excruciating pain in my upper left jaw due to a cracked and cavity infested wisdom tooth and contacted EDOA and they booked me in immediately and removed the tooth quickly and painlessly and now I’m on the way to healing and feeling better super friendly staff! I suggest you contact them for any and all dental emergencies you experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabrielle Stautzenberger
user_reviews_extended.Description:
AHHHMAZING! I called my dentist this morning, for an emergent wisdom tooth extraction, it had broken and pretty sure the nerve was exposed because of the pain with any breath I took. They scheduled me for Jan 4th the earliest and said they would call me back in a few minutes to see if there's anything they can do sooner or even refer me out.
I called emergency dentist of Austin and had an appointment within 2 hours. When I got in the dentist seat, my tooth was removed within 10min. I seriously thought he was joking when he said he was done. But it was done !! So quick and painless !! All of their staff from over the phone, front desk, all the way to the back.
THANK YOU SOOOOO MUCH!

title: Austin Emergency Dental
address: 4419 Frontier Trail # 104, Austin, TX 78745, United States

user_reviews.Name: Perez Landscapes services
user_reviews.Description: My wife came in for a tooth extraction and Dr.Cambell did an amazing job ! Quick and easy and explain everything we needed to do. They where also patient and careful! Will definitely be coming back.

user_reviews.Name: Mar Ana
user_reviews.Description: This place is amazing! If I could give 10stars I would. Staff is all friendly, makes you feel comfortable from front desk to assistants & MDs . In & out! Fast easy process. I was experiencing wisdom tooth pain & I was taken care of.

user_reviews.Name: Think Through Tactical
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Campbell is the GOAT 🐐... like the best dentist ever! I have extreme dental anxiety and him and his whole staff made me right at home and was EXTREMELY patient with me. He opened my eyes noting that not all dentist are scary! Went in with horrible tooth pain, left with a quick tooth removal and a temporary bridge. Quick fix and a permanent solution! Highly recommend if you're in Austin and in need of top of the line emergency work!

user_reviews.Name: Craig Kirby
user_reviews.Description: Exceptional Service That Saved My Smile – Daniel Pettit is a Dental Desk Deity! (5/5 – If I could give 10 stars, I would!) Oh, where do I even begin with Daniel Pettit, the absolute legend manning the front desk at Austin Emergency Dental? This man isn't just an employee; he's a superhero in scrubs, a beacon of hope in the chaotic world of dental disasters! I stumbled in late one night with a throbbing toothache that felt like a tiny volcano erupting in my mouth, and Daniel greeted me with a smile so warm and genuine it could melt polar ice caps. Within seconds, he had me checked in, calmed my nerves with his witty banter (seriously, his jokes are better than any painkiller), and coordinated with the dentist like a symphony conductor leading an orchestra of oral experts.Daniel's efficiency is otherworldly – he juggles phones, schedules, and patient queries with the grace of a Cirque du Soleil performer, all while making you feel like you're his only priority. He's got that rare combo of professionalism and personality that turns a stressful emergency visit into a downright delightful experience. Thanks to him, what could have been a nightmare became a five-star adventure in dental care. Austin Emergency Dental is lucky to have this gem; he's the reason I'll recommend this place to everyone I know (and even strangers on the street). Daniel Pettit, you're not just front desk royalty – you're the king of customer service! If dental awards existed for desk dynamos, you'd win them all. Thank you, sir – my smile (and sanity) owes you big time!

user_reviews.Name: Ray Moore
user_reviews.Description:
First time patient here. Very clean property, the staff were super duper friendly and helpful! Gave me multiple payment options and plans to choose from.

It’s Always very nerve wracking when going to new dentist as a new patient but after my first appointment here, I can assure you that this team will 100% take care of your needs.

Thank you again!

user_reviews.Name: Conley Onetime
user_reviews.Description:
Let’s just say this Dentistry  is one of the best I’ve been too. Procedure,  x rays, cleaning, the all around courtesy was a blessing. Let’s start with ms Christine, wonderful respectfully and outgoing for her clients.
Dental assistant, Saire, outstanding assistant she really do above and beyond her job. One of the brightest I’ve seen. Front desk workers, Shirinika & Nibraas, can’t thank them enough for the great communications the thought of explaining every little detail to the T before you choose your next move. Last but not least Dr. Lee great service and skills one of the best pull a tooth and leave no pain that’s what I love. If yall need anything COME HERE!!

user_reviews.Name: G Chavez (The G)
user_reviews.Description: Daniel Lazaro and Dr. Peoples were the best. Came in with broken veneer on incisor and they took care of us. Great attitude, great service. If you have an emergency dental need this is the place to go. They worked us into the schedule, and did an excellent job. I can function and will come back for the final repair. Front desk staff also very nice.

user_reviews.Name: narutos5
user_reviews.Description: Thank you so much for your service and attention while this process of my wisdom tooth extraction. You all have been very helpful and supportive solving my doubts and questions. I highly recommend "Austin Emergency Dental" as they provide high quality service!!! Thanks to Daniel for checking up on me and my follow ups!! 😁😁😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michaela Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Campbell did an excellent job.
From beginning to end the staff and Dr. Campbell were friendly, very helpful and caring.
We called and set up an appointment the day after Thanksgiving and they got us in on that Saturday.
We came in for an emergency extraction of an upper left wisdom tooth plus another next to it.
The consultation fee was very reasonable. Only $49. Which included X-rays. They helped us set up financing in a flash and we were  in and out in about 2hrs. I will definitely be giving recommendations for this Dental office.
Thank you guys so much.
M&M Flores

A week later we are back again
My poor husband
Again from beginning to end Austin Emergency Dental surpassed our expectations. All the staff was friendly and helpful. Brittany was our nurse this time. She was very friendly and knowledgeable with any questions or concerns we might have. And as always Dr. Campbell did an excellent job. 👏 Thank you all so much
Happy Holidays

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elsa Alejo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I took my husband in on a Sunday because he was in a lot of pain from his molars. The day before, we had gone to a different dentist and they sent him home still in pain with only ibuprofen. Thankfully, we found this place. They were able to help him right away and removed four molars that were causing the problem. The staff was caring, professional, and made a very stressful situation much easier. We’re so grateful we found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drew Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Where do I begin? My toothache was debilitating. I was struggling to even make it through the day. My friend recommended I contact Austin Emergency Dental because their experience. So I just called the number from Google Maps and I was instantly connected to Daniel Pettit, who I will hereafter refer to as Daniel P..

In the midst of my pain and agony, Daniel P.’s soothing voice was angelically therapeutic. His deep voice, expansive knowledge of dental insurance, and emergency dental practices put me into a type of rest that can only be found in the Hebrew scriptures.

I hope that I never have the type of pain I experienced on that fateful day. But if I do, I know who I will call… Daniel P. (I actually have it saved in my phone as Daniel Pettit and it’s on speed dial so I can navigate to it more easily in the future if I am in a time sensitive situation).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cash Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Daniel Pettit is the best!!! I’ve been running away from the dentist for years but he made my experience one that I’ll never forget. I’ll definitely be back in six months again thank you so much again for a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience with Austin Emergency Dental. My crown came out Saturday night and I was quickly able to book an appointment for first thing Sunday morning. Christine and Dr. Campbell took great care of me kindly and quickly. Super satisfied with the convenience, quality of care, and reasonable cost, especially on a weekend between the holidays.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabby Bourgeacq
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Campbell was amazing. I came in from a scooter accident and knocked out my front tooth and the tooth next to it. The whole staff was very accommodating and sweet. They made sure i was okay and reassured me that everything will get fixed. I got two fillings and was just so happy they were able to fix me up on a sunday! Dr Campbell answered all my questions and is an extremely talented dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nibraas Syed
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely amazing experience at Austin Emergency Dental! From the moment I walked in, the team made me feel comfortable and cared for. They hand emergencies quickly and professionally, and I never felt rushed or anxious. Truly top-notch service, I wouldn’t go anywhere else for dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ikyra Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife went in super fearful due to a previous bad experience at a different dentist. Turned out she had to get a root canal but was pleasantly relieved that there was no pain. Staff were super friendly and helpful explaining all the pricing and treatment options. Definitely recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meghan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Super easy process. Dr presented several
Options, and I was pleased they did not try to push the most expensive. His opinion seemed to really focus on what was best. Everyone was great and helpful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachael Schultz Transaction Coordinator
user_reviews_extended.Description: My permanent retainer came undone. This team was able to see me same day. They were super friendly and all worked very well together. They helped me navigate the best way to go about fixing it. All in all I’m a very satisfied patient!! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dylan Odekirk
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had to get a wisdom tooth extraction last minute due to inflammation.
The clinic is super clean and professional inside. Everyone was super patient, informative, and kind. Dr. Campbell and Lazaro were superrr attentive, like super attentive. My wisdom tooth was out in an impressively fast amount of time. Luckily they gave paper after care instructions, because I was so out of it from the insane experience of my wisdom tooth being pulled while conscious, I couldn’t process anything they were saying. Hopefully recovery is smooth, they gave an antibiotic prescription and pain meds, will update is anything changes.
Also if you have insurance, they were super transparent about helping with the reimbursement process. It seems to range from $600-800 up front for one wisdom tooth removal depending on how simple the extraction process is.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Steglich
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came into Austin Emergency Dental with a broken front tooth and I was super nervous. Dr.Campbell was very thorough and informative  about all of my options.. Him and his staff were very supportive with the decision I made. His assistant Adrian was very attentive during my procedure and made sure I was comfortable from beginning to end. I am more than happy with the temporary results. I cannot wait to see the final results!!! I’ve had issues with my top 4 teeth because of an impact several years back, so with that being said I’ve had different dental procedures done with multiple dentists and I can admit this has been by far the happiest I’ve ever been with my smile in almost 20 years! Also, Quincy was very helpful when it came to my payment options. She was very sweet and patient while I figured things out for my financial plans! If you are having any type of dental problems this is your place, hands down!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bella Gavin
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best Dental Office in Austin! I went for a teeth cleaning and filling and Dr. Campbell was very nice and efficient. The staff was very helpful and super nice!!! I highly recommend this clinic!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brett Hassan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Campbell is extraordinary! Compassionate, empathetic and just overall super kind. Made the entire experience so easy. Highly recommend. There’s a reason why they have 5 star reviews across the board! Came here for a tooth extraction when another dental office wouldn’t touch it. Dr. Campbell had the tooth out in 5 minutes. Thanks again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie McCormick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you for your expert care for my husband. Came in with a 10/10 pain level and is now home resting with no pain. The facility was clean, the check-in was quick, and Dr. Campbell and his team took care of it right away. Everything was explained thoroughly and they were helpful with us filing an insurance claim after the fact since it was an emergency. THANK YOU!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: TJ Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an amazing experience with Dr. Campbell and his team!
