user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Ponton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have had a completely different experience with Austin Emergency Dental, and it was a negative one!!

When I first arrived, I was also a bit confused as there were two dental companies Celebration dental & Austin ER in the same office. I was told that because this was an er dental visit, I would have to pay $150 out of pocket for the visit itself, I was not able to use my dental insurance for it and would need to get with my insurance for a reimbursement. So, heads up with that! I was immediately prompted to get a 3-d scanner x-ray which I quickly declined, because I had expressed to the male hygienist that I don't want to have anymore radiation because I have already gone to 4 CT scans and numerous other x-rays within this year. He looked at me like I was crazy. But I notice a lot of dentists push patients to have this done because often times they get incentives for the use of those scanners.

I initially just wanted to fix my flipper tooth, but they talked me into getting a bridge. I kind of was leaning on getting a bridge, but was just thinking about it, I read that a Maryland bridge was a great alternative and didn't require numbing. Which I thought this bridge would be. I also wanted to keep my other front tooth as is and not touched, because I planned on getting a veneer later on. So, I went and got this bridge financed and asked the female hygienist if I would need to get numbed up with this temp bridge and she said no you don't need to. I also asked Dr. Campbell just to confirm the no numbing, and he told me Yes! I would need to be numbed and I said why??? I really don't want to get numbed and this is just a temp. He told me that he needed to do this because he would be using a string for some reason, I had no idea what he was talking about. Well, he did not use any string that I had remembered, which upset me, because I feel he was just telling me that so I wouldn't give him any pushbacks. He did not once tell me what he was about to do step by step with this bridge like other dentists had told me before doing any dental procedure if I knew he was going to grind my front tooth down to a nub I would have never consented to it period! He was drilling around my teeth, and my mouth was numb, so I had no idea he was drilling my front tooth down. I thought he was doing something to the other teeth to make room for the temp, but I was still confused because this was just a temp bridge. by the time he showed me the mirror I was so shocked and was speechless my front tooth was a nub!!! I was internally furious but did not want to make a scene, but I felt violated and angry that I was not communicated that this was going to be done this way at all! This is now irreversible! I also noticed that the bridge would look ill-fitting in my mouth and Dr. Campbell said that I would need to see a periodontist to revise my gums and bone this was also not communicated to me until after the fact! I am still so pissed!  I don't how this place is rated 5 stars??? This is why I also came to get my tooth fixed because of the ratings and I don't understand how he communicated so thoroughly with others in these reviews but not with me?? I did not consent to whatever he did! This is so damn unacceptable! And people need to be warned and informed with this unprofessionalism!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m editing this review, changing from a 2 to a 4, because the Tylenol 3 I was prescribed on the second attempt at pain management ended up being mostly effective. I was originally prescribed weak and ineffective Tramadol, and was still in the worst pain of my life well over an hour after taking it, so they finally called in the Tylenol 3 with codeine after a couple of phone calls. They give you paper prescriptions at the office because somehow in 2025 they don’t have an electronic system, which is required to get THE REAL pain meds that we all know work the best and shouldn’t be withheld from responsible adults with no drug abuse history to get rid of the horrible, excruciating pain following a tooth extraction and bone graft. I would argue the lack of the electronic system is by design so they can use it as an excuse not to prescribe them. Would recommend this office prescribe Tylenol 3 as a FIRST RESORT rather than the patient having to call back in agony multiple times, only to have to drive across town AGAIN and pay for another prescription WHILE IN HORRIBLE PAIN.

Im happy over all tho, because they got me in very quick and the staff was nice and professional. For those wondering about price, I spent $1200 for the extraction and bone graft plus nitrous oxide. The extraction alone would have been around $450-500… the same as my regular dentist. They don’t seem to inflate things like a medical ER does.

REMEMBER TO REQUEST TYLENOL 3 INSTEAD OF SCAMADOL UPON LEAVING to avoid the extra hassle and expense.

Update: it’s the next day, and my pain is significantly better. This was my first time having a tooth extracted, so I didn’t know what to expect. The day of was rough, but today, after a good night’s sleep, the pain is drastically reduced.

In the reply to this review, It’s stated that offering a pain-free recovery is their priority. However, when I called the first time to request something stronger than Tramadol, Nancy told me that I had just had my procedure a few hours prior, so pain should be expected. But actually, right after the procedure is when pain management should be taken the most seriously. So which is it? Should patients expect to be in pain early on, or is it their priority to ensure a pain-free experience? It can’t be both. This is why we have modern medicine.

Based on my experience, this is an area where there is room for improvement at this practice. For one, get an electronic prescriptions system for patient convenience as well as broadening the scope of what can be prescribed. Second, don’t prescribe ineffective Tramadol to someone who just endured having a whole  molar pried from their jaw. And last but not least, don’t minimize the patient’s pain experience when something stronger is requested.

Update 12/25/25: I’m 6 days into this now, and pain comes and goes. It’s not getting worse… but the dull ache is still present, especially at night. Tylenol 3 isn’t as effective as I’d hoped. There have been times when a single dose doesn’t work at all, and more often than not, it wears off before it’s time for another dose. This is not effective pain management. The comment in the reply to this review states that Tylenol 3 is a powerful opiate, but a Google search reveals it’s meant for mild pain (which we all know isn’t the case for a dental procedure of this magnitude).

I’m not changing my 4-star rating, though, because this is a nationwide trend. Providers are under enormous pressure to avoid anything that could be interpreted as over‑prescribing. The result is:

• People with legitimate pain being under‑treated
• Doctors defaulting to the lowest possible dose
• Patients being told “this should be enough” when it clearly isn’t
• A weird, patronizing tone where they act like your experience is the issue, not the inadequate plan
• Patients around the country are being gaslit by providers and being told “pain management is our top priority” solely as a reputation management strategy, but it does not align with the reality of the patient experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karla D
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can't recommend this office enough.

I came here for a second opinion after another dentist recommended a root canal on a tooth that wasn't even causing me pain. I was nervous, but I left feeling so relieved and well taken care of.

The dentist took the time to thoroughly evaluate my tooth and confirmed that a root canal wasn't necessary at this stage. The decay, while close to the nerve, didn't even require a pulp cap. What mattered most to me was treating the tooth before the decay reached the nerve — and he made that happen. He treated it with a deep filling to stop the progression, worked within my limited budget as a cash patient, and recommended a crown in the near future, noting that keeping the tooth alive matters even when a crown is eventually needed. He also did an excellent job with the aesthetics of the filling — it looked great.

His approach was conservative, thoughtful, and patient-centered. He saved me from an irreversible procedure and thousands of dollars in unnecessary costs.

If you're ever unsure about a treatment recommendation — especially a major one — come here for a second opinion. I'm so glad I did.

The cost wasn’t nearly as bad as I expected, and they even offer payment plans. I would recommend this place 100 times over and will probably only get procedures done here from now on. The entire office is amazing, from the front desk staff to the welcoming atmosphere!

Highly recommend Dr. Fan and the whole dental team for excellent care and service.

user_reviews.Name: EJ Park
user_reviews.Description:
Nice office, but I hope the cleaning experience can be improved.

This was the first dental office I’ve visited in the U.S. where a cleaning took less than 15 minutes. There was no gum exam, just a very quick cleaning and done, which felt rushed and incomplete.

Another uncomfortable experience was having to ask for a goodie bag every time. On one visit, a staff member laughed and said they didn’t have toothpaste or floss and asked if I still wanted it. I said yes, and it was given to me while laughing. I’m not sure why this was treated as something laughable.

Considering patients are charged if they are late, it was also disappointing that I once waited about 20 minutes, only to receive a very short cleaning.

I’m not sure if I will return, but I hope these issues can be addressed and improved.

user_reviews.Name: Terrence Trujillo
user_reviews.Description: Josh Martinez was amazing! This was hands down the best experience I’ve had for a routine cleaning. It was my first visit to this office, so I needed X-rays and a full cleaning—everything was fast, efficient, and completely pain-free. Couldn’t be happier. Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: Yue Wang
user_reviews.Description: Had an excellent experience at The Dental Centre. The team was incredibly friendly. I was specifically impressed with the cleaning—they did an amazing job removing the stains on my teeth, and they look better than they have in a long time! Highly recommend Dr. Fan and his staff for their professional and positive attitude.

user_reviews.Name: Angela Chung
user_reviews.Description:
I was a patient here for several years after moving to the U.S. and clearly told the office about my prior periodontal disease and past periodontal surgery. I maintained regular cleanings and repeatedly reported gum swelling (front tooth and molar area) over the past year.

My experience was that my symptoms were managed conservatively (e.g., mouthwash/desensitizing treatment and ‘come back in a couple of weeks’) rather than being escalated to a comprehensive periodontal reassessment or early specialist referral. After changing providers and seeing a periodontist, I was diagnosed with advanced periodontal pocketing in a molar requiring extraction and additional treatment.

Upon reviewing my records, I did not find documentation of comprehensive annual periodontal charting, which I would have expected given my history.

While routine visits were completed, I wish there had been more structured periodontal monitoring and earlier specialist involvement.

I have since transitioned my care elsewhere.

user_reviews.Name: Pamela Rogers
user_reviews.Description: I’m very impressed with Dr. Fan and his staff. I highly recommend him after today’s deep cleaning followed by fixing a couple of cavities. Of course, they numbed me and then I had two very minimal injections in the gum. His assistant was very nice and professional. Overall, a very pleasant experience and not painful at all. I made a follow-up appt in four months.

user_reviews.Name: Hui Lin
user_reviews.Description:
Doctor Fan saved my tooth! I broke one of my front teeth accidentally. Dr. Fan's clinic made an effort to squeeze me in next day. I though it would be a big job with many trips to fix the tooth. Dr. Fan was able to use the original crown and fix my tooth with one visit!
Dr. Fan is professional and knowledgeable. His assistant is experienced and fun. The front desk receptionist is friendly and efficient. I just started with this clinic for my dental care, and am planning to stay for many years to come.

user_reviews.Name: Tainea Bayo
user_reviews.Description: Mark is an amazing Hygienist he educated me on everything teeth. I had never had a cleaning that good. The dentist was very knowledgeable  as well. I highly recommend this place if you are in the Austin area.

user_reviews_extended.Description: This has become my new go-to for dental work and check ups. user_reviews_extended.Description:

In 2024, we planned a major procedure, and due to our insurance policy, we wanted the cost to be spread throughout the entire process. They agreed so we did the procedure. But to our surprise, they pre-charged the entire amount on the first day of the procedure. They did, however, send the bill later. But this has no effect on the insurance since insurance look at when the charge occurred, not when the bill was sent. Either they are ignorant, or they intentionally did it.

The procedure was not satisfactory either. We will no longer use them.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Fan is very thorough, knowledgeable and gentle. I was a little concerned about the cavity filling and how much it will hurt, but it was really quick and efficient. He is definitely the best dentist near me in Austin :)

user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved everyone. The staff are wonderful. Dr Fan is excellent : extremely excellent bedside manner, real smart.  I love the cheerful waiting room. user_reviews_extended.Description: The Dental Centre at 4391 W William Cannon Ste B240 is the best experience. I’ve had 2 follow up appointments and Tori was amazing both times. user_reviews_extended.Description:

I had been afraid of the dentist growing up.  But Dr. Jack Fan changed my fear to braveness.

Thank you so much for the phenomenal work and professionalism.  I highly recommend them to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I believe I was one of the very first patients back in 2018. I immediately recognized Dr Fan as a gifted Dentist and even though I have moved much further away I still to this day make the trip back every six months to see him because I think he is one of the very best.

all of my friends that I have referred to him have been delighted with my recommendation

Highly recommend for anyone seeking top-notch care in a friendly environment."

D'Ann Lewis Andrade

user_reviews_extended.Description: Everything from calling to inquire, setting up an appointment, x-rays and deep cleaning were so streamlined and efficient. All the employees were friendly and very informative. In the past, I had been terrified of dental visits due to many horrible past experiences. The whole experience was made as painless as possible and over very quickly. I was informed about Candid straightening trays after inquiring about them. If I would’ve known about this place I would’ve came sooner! Highly recommend, especially if you were previously terrified of dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aimee Talarski
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went here for a regular cleaning, and I also have a tooth infection because I'm 46 and still have 3 wisdom teeth.. I was dreading going because my previous dentist was a bit brutal, but it did not end up being scary at all. The tech was very gentle and friendly, and I had a positive experience at a dentist. Which is not something I have really said before. They also seem honest because I do take care of my teeth and they said that they could see that, whereas my previous dentist always found problems and wanted to do more procedures.. I'm so glad I switched! I was kind of sad that they can't pull my wisdom teeth but that's actually a compliment. Hopefully the oral surgeons will be as nice. Thanks Dental Centre!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hayley Segura
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here was so nice and inviting. The hygienist was very gentle yet thorough. The doctor was very helpful and willing to listen to me and my needs. I love it here. I haven’t felt this good about my dentist since I moved from San Antonio. Thank you Josh (hygienist), Dr. Fan, and Fernanda at the front desk. I’m telling all my friends and family to go here. Because who doesn’t love a great experience with your dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharyn Dobbins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you, Devin, for seeing me on such short notice yesterday to replace my temporary crown. You put me at ease very quickly and had me out the door in no time. You're the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy Bach
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys are great. I have a lot of dental trauma and am very sensitive to light, noise, textures etc. and they didn't bat an eye when I showed up to my first appointment dressed as a pink fox, toting a stuffed unicorn and fidgets to help keep myself calm. They worked quickly, let me take wiggle breaks (tho I definitely tried to keep them to a  minimum so I could be done faster) and addressed some major concerns I had with minimal invasiveness which was amazing. The front desk has been great helping me with insurance questions and repeating things until I am sure I understand properly. I have had one issue where an apt I had scheduled disappeared off of their scheduling system (probably not their fault considering electronics malfunction around me constantly) but they rescheduled me for two days later no problem. Thanks to these guys I have gone from only seeing a dentist when vitally necessary to getting my checkups yearly and cleanings every six months (it makes the cleanings go faster and easier). All of the staff is very friendly when I come in.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim McCord
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Once again, everyone at The Dental Centre is so nice! They really care about my tooth and gum health and they all do a terrific job! I'm very pleased with the service and care I receive!
I went today to get a filling and check the fit for my denture, and you talk about gentle dental, absolutely painless...I didn't feel a thing! Dr. Jack Fan's the man, he came with a plan. You can try all the rest but Brother Jack Fan's the best! Also, FYI...Mark does a phenomenal job at making sure my teeth are CLEAN!!! Go see 'em, they'll take great care of you! *UPDATE* - 08/07/2024: I can EAT AGAIN! Dr. Fan did an adjustment on my denture and everything is great again (in my mouth)! And man-o-man do they look beautiful! Thanks again for a great visit...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daley South
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr Fan and his team. They are kind and very knowledgeable without trying to push expensive and unnecessary procedures. The service is always pain free and fast. In and out in under and hour even for cavities. Very impressed and will continue to be a patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benita Trevino
user_reviews_extended.Description: The cleanings are thorough and everyone on staff is professional and friendly but the reason I keep coming back is because Dr Fan is so incredibly gentle! I can barely tell he is cleaning my teeth, and then it’s done and my teeth are looking great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassie Abbott
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Things I like:
- They are on time and run like clockwork which I appreciate
- The staff and my hygienist were nice and efficient

Things I didn't like:
Lack of communication or discussion about treatment plans. I went in for a basic cleaning (covered by my dental insurance) and was sold into a "deep cleaning." I made the appointment to do half of the service (because instead of it being covered by my insurance, it was $150 per quadrant... because it goes slightly below the gumline).

There was zero discussion about the elevated risks that come from cleaning below the gumline and how that can lead to other issues. Nope, you have to get this because we say so.

During the first treatment (we were about halfway through), the dentist came in to give me anesthesia which I didn't consent to or know was happening until there was a needle in my mouth. There was ZERO discussion of what was happening in advance or talking with me about the recovery of that (my face was numb half the day and I had business meetings afterward... I would have declined).

After I finished the first treatment (2 quadrants), I asked them if I could get the regular cleaning that's covered by my insurance and carries less risk for the remaining 2 quadrants, and they said no. They could not do the lower service at all and refused to allow me to speak to the dentist about my own healthcare. In the end, they would rather you have zero health services than make less money. It's not about your health or understanding - it's about how much they could possibly bill you for.

I've been to several dentists over the years and I was very excited to get work done given the positive reviews but I can't believe the lack of dialogue about healthcare and the risks and only wanting to serve the higher services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M Pearson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Fan got me right in to check on a crown that was hurting. I thought i might need a root canal! He ground the crown down and so far there is no more pain! Everyone in the office is so nice and helpful. I have gone to Dr. Fan for about 5 years and he always does a good job!

user_reviews_extended.Description: My $7,000 dentures are complete crap. Teeth have intentional stains, I have never had stained teeth in my life. Upper broke when I dropped in sink. I paid $300 for replacement.  Year later bottom broke while I was eating a ripe banana.  I'm livid

user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist in Austin, tx, and the staff is so friendly. My adult son and I both go here. My son couldn't stop talking about how happy he was with his appointment, and after my appointment today went so well, I'm not even afraid to go to the dentist anymore.

user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is absolutely amazing. I have a wedding coming up and had an unfortunate situation happen. They made it a point to get me in quickly and made sure I would have a good smile for the wedding. The entire team deserves praise. I am beyond thankful for them.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
1st time and looking for to the next time. I have had 3 dentist in my life and the longest one was for 20+ years. user_reviews_extended.Name: Berenise Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Recently found this dental office online because I was looking into Candid aligners. When I called I specifically mentioned to the receptionist that I was wanting to come in for Candid. Maybe this was my fault but she did not set any expectations or details on what to expect - cost of the scans and that she was scheduling me for xrays and a dental exam. I understand they would want to check that I have no cavities and such before getting the aligners, but I felt dumb when I was there because the dental assistant after taking my x rays was going to go straight into a cleaning.  I had to stop him and tell him I was there for Candid. So he proceeded to do the scans instead. Then one of the Ortho/Dentist- I don't know what he was but came and told me I was a candidate and it could help - he was nice but was super vague.. I thought that was they consult but no. After that the front desk/care coordinator told me I had to come back to do the scans and consult because one of the doctors wasnt there and it would take 3 weeks.. not knowing I had done the scans already. It was evident the staff hadn't communicated. Turns out, I had to wait for Candid to receive the scans, which can take 1-2 weeks and I had to look out for an email to schedule the consultation so they could tell me the treatment time. Almost two weeks later their care coordinator texted me and said I had to go in and redo one of the scans. I was so annoyed at this point and asked for a refund, to which the coordinator told me I had to talk to the manager for the refund, but then not even 20 seconds later when I tried to clarify/confirm that I could get a refund she said, "yes like we already discussed" and I said,"when?" She proceeds to say that she had already discussed me getting a refund as an option with the manager??? Just weird, but in the end, I got my refund for the scans($300). Compared to other reviews this seems unusual, so maybe I just caught them on a bad day. But I had a terrible experience here and it's disappointing because this office has the best price for Candid aligners. I ended up going with Invisalign instead.

I told her I did not bring in my Care Credit card to pay and told her I would call them. user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: My last exam was 4 years ago and I didn't want to go to the same place so I chose Dental Centre bc of a cat named Duchess.  I left an appointment request over the weekend and on Tuesday received a call to schedule and Wednesday I had an appointment with Dr. Fan!  I liked that I was able to be seen so quickly, I had no time to freak out however I was offered later appointments as well, variety, spice of life.  I have not been going anywhere but the grocery store because of the virus and honestly I was pretty scared not knowing how things were going to be different.   I"m glad I woke up late and had to run out my door I would have wasted my time worrying for naught.   It was very clean inside, there are marked spots for SD and the now familiar plexiglass guards and they told me exactly where to stand, I never know what to do now, where to stand, having somebody to tell me was so nice.  I was greeted warmly and filled out my paperwork only bc I forgot to do it before. Tori took me to get my x-rays all the while being friendly and explaining what was happening, she definitely is an asset to that office!  When Dr Fan came in he took the time to chat, I mentioned how crazy things are nowadays which of course we all agreed on and I found having the doctor and assistant and FD staff addressing the weirdness give me more confidence in the entire office.  Tori really is great.  After my exam Dr Fan told me what he thought my plan of action should be and why, he could have looked and left but he didn't.  Not delegating that to someone else is awesome so that I could ask questions and it made me feel important.  I go back tomorrow (one day later, woohoo!) for the first part of my treatment plan, the costs were explained to me by Vanessa I believe, another really nice person, seriously Dr Fan you have a great staff take care of them, and in addition to all this I was given a goody bag (dental theme) and the treatment plan estimate was emailed to me which I'd already forgotten and they wrote me reminders because I have the worst memory!   I will update this tomorrow after Mark cleans my teeth and in a few more weeks because I'm finally getting a new bite guard, yay oh yay oh yay!!!  Needless to say I'd totally recommend scaredy cats to come here and if you're worried about dental work in the time of Covid there is no need to if you come here!!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Description: They do a good job cleaning, nice and organized staff but their finance team doesn’t have it figured out. When your insurance indeed covers an entire visit the office insists on you paying out of pocket still which makes you feel uncomfortable, confused and frustrated. Thankfully they refund you but it takes around a month to do so. With insurance being a confusing space already you hope to be able to rely on the people providing you the service but unfortunately they speak false information.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shakayla Beckum
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm disliking my experience for 6 months now, So my root canal will be my last work with this office who is passive aggressive about patient concerns. The lady dentist was so rude to my kid that I never took him back, and eventually I asked to stop seeing her and only be given other dentists. Very insensitive and not personable. After all these appointments where she tried to put a filling over a cavity that I have now proven needs a root canal, the new receptionist is even ruder. I called to confirm my apt two days away and she said did you pay your 100$ deposit? WHAT 100$? Never been asked for a deposit, but she was rude and insisted I pay it even though when I booked it no one said anything about it. If this is the case this will be my last service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miguel Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great - service and friendly atmosphere has not changed , ‘Has gotten Better’. Everyone was kind and understanding and easy to speak with.  Thanks fir everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gloria Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: It has been a while since I've been able to go to the dentist due to work/life I saw Dr. IM I was a little nervous and had anxiety at first since it had been a while since the last time I was at the dentist but he was very kind and professional making sure to check in on me to see how I was doing along the way. Front desk were nice and friendly at arrival. I had such a great experience that I brought in my husband due to him having some pain. He had pain and was able to get in to do his treatment . He was super impressed on how professional the doctor was with the treatment. I then returned for my treatment that was a couple of fillings. Dr.Im was so gentle I did not feel anything I was supper impressed and surprised due to previous experiences I have felt pain when getting a filling done. I will be returning and referring my family and friends here for sure !

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at River City Dental as usual. The dental hygienist was gentle and handled me well. They were able to research my insurance and bill me correctly.

user_reviews_extended.Description: After years of bringing up a specific painful area and being ignored by the dentists, I finally went to a different place. user_reviews_extended.Description:

Returned for more dental work and not disappointed in any way! The staff here I can’t stress enough is so helpful and knowledgeable with any questions or issue I have! They’re patience is greatly appreciated when I had a tedious procedure done that took a good while and the staff that helped was too kind, patient and helpful to me and each other in every way! Will continue to come here

user_reviews_extended.Description: They were all so friendly and informative. They were able to get me scheduled swiftly and made sure that I was well taken care of. Highly recommend to anyone who is anxious or scared of dentist offices! Thank again!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

I was seen in a very timely manner for at an early morning evaluation for the purpose of  obtaining a second opinion. Since I live in the lovely Mueller Community ;  I also want to support our local businesses . I decided to
schedule a later procedure the same day .
I highly recommend River Rock Dental in Mueller . Convenience of parking is also a plus . Thank you for promptly and professionally helping me today ! Happy to say I now have excellent dental care in Mueller .
