She also has a gentle touch and my mouth was not hurting for the rest of the day after treatment as with other dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jake Doyle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been going here for a few years and have been very satisfied with the work I've had done. I even had to come by on short notice a few months ago when my crown popped off and was seen promptly and not charged anything.

Some of their pictures of their office are outdated, but it has always been very clean and professional. All of the receptionists, hygienists, and dentists that I have interacted with have been very friendly and encouraging.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sadly, I cannot say anything good about this office. First off please look at all the pictures they are 5-8 years old. This office does not look like any images. The cute kids playroom is now a storage closet filled with boxes and paperwork, the lobby and all throughout the office the paint is chipping and the lights are dimly lit. The staff looked disheveled and none of them were wearing the same thing. (some were wearing tshirts and holy jeans and others were wearing scrub bottoms but a tshirt) It was truly hard to determine who worked here and who was a patient. The dental hygienist assigned to me was probably the most aggressive dental person I have come across. She made me bleed and stabbed me twice having to apologize - she did not even attempt to make small talk - just very routine, quick, and cold. The dentist had little to say but was probably the only semi-pleasant thing about this office because she smiled a few times. She did try and sell me on several unnecessary items and was a bit pushy. To top it off I did paperwork beforehand electronically and then when I arrived, they had no record of it - so I spent the first 10 mins refilling everything out. Honestly, this place needs a facelift and some nicer staff. I would not recommend and I will not be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miloboy5
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Do not go here.

This was my first time going to River Rock Dental. Dr. Maxey refused to clean my teeth and said I needed to do an upcharged deep clean. When I asked questions, she became defensive, saying she could tell I had done it before (I have not) and that my insurance "showed a history" of periodontitis (I do not have periodontitis.)

I went to another dentist who looked at my teeth, laughed, and said I definitely do not need a deep clean and asked for the name of the prior dental practice just to keep a mental note of it. He went ahead and gave me a regular cleaning.

Seriously. Don't go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gracie Key
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is great! Always provide great customer service. The dentist provides up-front information and provides solutions in treatments. The hygienist are amazing with the kids. This team makes my hour drive, completely worth it!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. M and staff are so accommodating.  My old crown failed this morning and they were able to squeeze me to set it temporarily until I could schedule the appointment for next week.  They have strict Covid-19 protocol and I felt comfortable the whole time I was there.  Dr. M and his staff are really good at easing any anxiety you might feel about going to the dentist.  I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ericnisha Coleman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Enjoyed my first visit to river rock dental(Mueller) the staff was very nice, pleasant, understanding and helpful. The wait wasn’t long at all. So happy I choose this dentist office for my journey!

The vibe was so humble organized and calm, that is what you need when you returning back to the dentist after many years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: michael frohlich
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Maxey did a great job of repairing my first cavity in many years.  It was very quick and painless.  I didn't even feel the injection-she asked her assistant to tap my shoulder a few times so I would be distracted.  That worked!   I've been coming here for years with complete satisfaction.  Thanks for taking care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra Acosta
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Edited later to add: I recently needed a new night guard. I called them to verify it would be covered by my insurance, so I gave them ALL of my insurance information and they verified over the phone with me that it would be $150 to replace it because my insurance covers half. The next morning I went in for my appointment and the woman at the front desk told me it's NOT covered by my insurance, and that I owe $300. This irresponsible miscommunication and misinformation by employees was incredibly irritating and there were no apologies given. However, when I left feedback that the price I was told wasn't honored, Sheila (not sure if spelling right) called me and apologized for the miscommunication, and said that they should have honored the price they originally told me, and refunded me. A HUGE thank you to Sheila for following up with service I wasn't happy with. She was so kind.

I love this dentist! I'd been going to the same dentist for 20 years back home in Houston but had to find a new one when I moved here. Everyone was super friendly and really cared about any issues I was having with my teeth. (Ex: my teeth were feeling a little sensitive so the dentist was extra careful when he blew air onto my teeth.) I've only been once but I'm excited I found a great dentist close to my house!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Corrales
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first experience at River Rock Dental Mueller was great. I haven’t been to the dentist in a long time and have been wanting to take better care of my teeth. Found out I had a few cavities which is a bummer but they made the process easy and painless. Got my x-rays, teeth cleaning and fillings done in one appointment. This was nice because I don’t like to miss work for these kinds of things and they made it seamless to get it all taken care of at once so I didn’t have to make another appointment. Everyone was so nice and friendly on top of all of that. I highly recommend this place and will come back for my regular cleanings!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great, friendly staff. Had an emergency extraction needed right before the holidays and River Rock fit me right in same day. Experience with front desk, dental assistant and dentist were all great. They made me feel at ease about my extraction. And went over the process on aftercare several times even though I was tye last patient of the day they didn't rush me. The dentist was super proficient and had my tooth out in less than 5 mins. Thanks River Rock!! Went back for hard-core cleaning and once again they are all super nice & efficient! My hygienist rocks!! Will definitely keep coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Homez ForYou
user_reviews_extended.Description: I shy away from dentist offices.  But this office is great.  I am an older woman with less than perfect teeth, and they treat me with utmost respect.  From letting me schedule appointments around my payday, to the dentists being Super Gentle while working on my teeth, I love this place.  Although I am moving an hour away, I will drive to them for their fantastic personalized service.  No pressure here to get everything fixed asap like some other dentists offices do.  They rate 5 stars for sure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Ha
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Very chill process and dentists! Felt very relaxed and trusted their words on tips for my dental health. No long wait times. Scheduling very easy. Plenty of reminders and updates via text.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaliyah Allison
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love when Bella does my teeth, she’s great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aly Humphreys
user_reviews_extended.Description: Front desk was very friendly and informative. Chelsea was my hygienist and she was incredible! She made sure I was not in any pain and addressed every question and concern I had. Will definitely be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Cortez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Im and the whole staff at River Rock are always so kind and help you feel comfortable. They never push any treatment on you and are super helpful in helping you come up with a dental plan that works for you. I’ve even recommended several folks there that also had a great experience. Thank you for all that you all do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: KC Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first time here, and my visit was done timely and professionally!  Dr Im is very patient and willing to explain things multiple times until you feel comfortable with what he is suggesting for your treatment. I really appreciate that I was treated as a person. Trish is s hoot and very pleasant to be the one doing the dirty work (deep cleaning)  and it was done before I even knew it. I'll defiantly recommend this location to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Foster
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Highly recommended! Everyone that I have been attended by has been wonderful, and Dr. Drew has always been incredibly attentive and accommodating. I struggle with anxiety
& depression, so I sometimes have a tough time taking good care of myself, setting up appointments, and being scared of being judged for the state of my teeth, so my experience here has been such a relief, and I cannot thank them enough for making me feel comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Hoovestol
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff who alleviate so much of the anxiety of going to a dentist. Everyone from the front desk to the hygienists and the doctors are so good at their jobs and making sure you are receiving the best dental care. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel Chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dealing with Depression puts you in position where you don’t want to take care of yourself. And with a lot work needed for your teeth it’s embarrassing but river rock makes you feel very comfortable and they care about you and that helps me a lot and makes me happy knowing they have your back. Very organized and supportive. Fast and great work that they do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allan leviner
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went for my 6 month cleaning and i spoke with Myra on the phone who was absolutely amazing, addie helped me schedule my 6 month cleaning, Denise checked me out and had all my paper work ready. They made my appointment quick and easy. Attained  all the proper information. Great team.

I had my cleaning done with Andrea who’s is a hygienist, and she made me feel very comfortable. And very professional. The following morning i had a filling done within Dr. Jarrett who has is probably one of the coolest dentist i know and super  laid back. I appreciate you sir.  Awesome job! And Denise, Denise his assistant  hands down made me laugh, she made me comfortable, explained in detail
The procedure. Just an overall great experience.

Thank you River Rock dental mueller location

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Shirk
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff is wonderful to work with and the office is very pleasant. The dentists themselves were very attentive to my concerns, provided excellent recommendations, and were able to get me in promptly. I will keep River Rock - Mueller as my dental office due to its fantastic staff and top notch medical facilities and recommend it without reservation

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jackie Wisniewski
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly easy communication with this office. Love the text message reminders and confirmations. I’ve never had to wait here, and the professionals have been fantastic. I made them aware of my anxiety around dentists and they have been so accommodating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cherie Gaspar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommended dental practice. Very well-run very informative staff. Teeth cleaning by Madison was professional and thorough. Knowledgeable staff. Dentist was amazing I trusted him at the start. They are Rock Solid and what they know and explaining my insurance benefits to me was so much appreciated. From the moment I walked in to the moment I left, this experience every bit of 5 stars

user_reviews_extended.Name: sarahi butron
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love the dentist and the staff! Everyone is very friendly and polite. I was referred out of my wisdom teeth extractions and due to my schedule I wasn't able to schedule anything. I called them to let them know my situation and they informed me that they had a dentist in-house who would be able to do them. Dr. Drake (I believe is his name) went out of his way to make a special visit just to see me on the day I was able to take off. They are absolutely wonderful. Always feel comfortable there!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex S
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here are all very friendly, professional, and helpful.  I had my teeth cleaned and a wisdom tooth extracted.  For my extraction, I had to reschedule multiple times, and the staff was very understanding and helpful each time.  I was taken care of with no complaints.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Junwon Park
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist around Austin area! Nice clean facility and great staff! Every time I go in for check-up, they are always nice and welcoming. 5 stars arent enough! Could give 10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Constancio
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff & the dentist are dedicated to giving you the best dental care you deserve!!! I'm obligated to return high reviews for a well-deserved Doctor & Staff. This is an Extremely Clean Environment with a Zen-like ambiance. The music was not at all dull or classical; it was Up-beat & in Good Taste. The office was not cluttered & the patient rooms were spacious & clean. The location was also Great – HEB, Eatery’s & so much more!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rae Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was very nervous about going to to the dentist since it had been a very long time since I’ve been to one. The drill noises scare me so I’ve never made the effort to go back. The staff at River Rock Dental (Muller location) were so friendly and nice and made sure that I knew everything that was going on with my visit. They were so clear with all of the information that they were giving me and after the consultation they reassured me that everything was going to be okay, even the nice woman at the front desks reassured me that I was going to be fine before she made my next appointment. I left with some confidence about my teeth. Like I said it’s been awhile since I’ve been to the dentist so this was a huge step for me. I’m not as nervous for my next visit I’m kind of looking forward to it :) I’m glad I chose River Rock.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Paik
user_reviews_extended.Description: The front office ladies were kind and amazing. They were able to fit me in for an emergency chipped tooth procedure for that day! Dr. Daniel Im was fantastic as well! I was scared and anxious heading into my dental procedure but Dr. Im calmed my nerves and thoroughly explained everything before proceeding. He is very skilled at what he does and made it a painless process for me. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arturo Fernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Omg ! I don't know where to start..  The staff is so amazing  and kind . I got my cleaning done today by Roshni and  she also did great job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Q is such an amazing doctor. Every time I come in, she makes sure that I’m comfortable and informed. She’s very gentle when she does each of my procedures and also follows up days after, just to make sure that things went well. I definitely will recommend River Rock Dental to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Tarver
user_reviews_extended.Description: From my experience, all of the staff are friendly and helpful.  The doctors are knowledgeable and professionally guiding and have never been too pushy.   They make you feel comfortable here.  I really love my hygienist. Even after moving out of this neighborhood area, I still come to this office as a preference.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kendra Rice
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been to other dentist’s in Austin and have been pretty displeased. River Rock was very different! I really enjoyed the hygienist, she was skilled and made me feel very comfortable. She and the doctor listened to my concerns and were able to get me started with being fitted for a night guard. Very thorough and professional and I believe they take most insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ada Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
“An outstanding dental experience from start to finish. Dr. Im Hong provides exceptional care with patience and professionalism. His remarkable team ensures every visit is comfortable and efficient. I am grateful to this dentistry for addressing all my dental needs with such excellence.” I am happy to be apart of your dental family. If you want the best go see Dr. Hong.

P.S. I love my Dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitchell Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best part of going to the dentist is the fact that I look forward to each and every visit. The entire staff especially Whitney at the front desk helped make sure everything went smoothly administratively. Dr. Hong is a true pro at his job and helped make sure I was comfortable during a scary and tough surgery by making it as easy as anyone could expect and with good advice that was helpful during the healing process. A great experience overall. Thanks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dee Brosnan
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is so accommodating and kind. After a wisdom tooth extraction (which went great) they brought me in for a last minute check-up to ease my mind over some concerns I was having. They educated me, assured me and make sure that my pain was well controlled. I’m grateful to have had this experience at River Rock Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tami Estaniss
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Iryna Daline is an exceptional doctor, very caring and professional! My husband had a retreatment root canal and it was hard to find a good endodontist in Austin but very glad to have come to see Dr. Daline, will definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Muir
user_reviews_extended.Description: Bad dentist and even worse patient care.  I think this dentist office is a scam becuase they pressued us into buying my mom "their" version of dental insurance.  Worst part is the insentivive uncaring why they treat their patients.  My mom is an elderly handicapped person in a wheelchair with dementia.  They know this.  Yet, when I called to tell them we were running 5 min late for her filling appointment they said "Oh we sent your mom an email to come 30 minutes early and since she didn't we are all booked and she has to reschedule."  We are talking about a handicapped person who has to arrange travel in advance and cannot even read email.  Then they claimed they called my number and left me voice mails which they did not.  I am taking my mom to another dentist. She went in for a teeth cleaning and A WEEK LATER they called to say they noticed a cavity on the Xrays.   A week later?  They don't look at the xrays while the patient is there?  Very fishy. Don't use.  I am taking my mom's xrays to a REAL DENTIST and not some strip mall scam like river rock dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Freda Bruton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Im and his staff have always provided expert care. Best dentist that I have had.
I appreciate the patience and time he spends to make sure that my dental care is of utmost importance. His entire staff are welcoming and kind which is a reflection of Dr. Im. Best dentist around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lea Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My dentist retired. I’m on Medicare & have a supplement that covers cleaning, X-rays & examinations twice a year. I checked the coverage with my insurance as it is by the dentist name NOT the practice name & made an appointment. First is canceled Re weather.
At the next appointment I had so many X-rays taken & then an exam??? I my experience examinations occur after the cleaning.
Much to my surprise I’m told I can go after the exam. I say I made an appointment for cleaning I’m then told that I have to make another appointment for that. So three weeks later I’m still waiting. I’m only going to be in this neighborhood another week so it’s looking like I’m not getting my teeth cleaned so it’s impossible for me to recommend this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather “Lady” Reed
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First! I absolutely loves the girls up front!
It was a great expererience. They were knowledgeable and kind.
I would definitely recommend them to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marta Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Im is great. He is very efficient, patient, and professional. Really appreciate him being attentive and making sure I’m comfortable. I’ve always disliked and feared going to the dentist but Dr. Im has made it a good experience. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a dentist. I’ll be moving soon but hope to continue coming here for future appointments if I can :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dr Trent
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Nice, professional, friendly and courteous.  I fell in love with this dentist office on my son's first visit.  It pays to shop around because the values of good service and professional compassion still exists
Dr Trent
Aka
Diva Divine Hostess of Video Breakfast

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas Fackler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It was a normal day...a bit windy, with a few scattered clouds. It was cool, but the kind of cool where the sun hits you just right. It was the day of the dentist visit *queue jarring drum beat* and I was going to have to leave the sunshine behind *brief hi-hat solo*.

Fortunately I was going to River Rock Dental @ Mueller where the windows let in enough light that, at one point, I was offered shades and the foyer has comfortable comfortable seating. That was nice. It wasn't as windy inside as out, but that was okay. It was spacious so that if I had become the wind I wouldn't have minded wending my way through the front area or hanging out in the visiting area. As a human I was offered a smile, advice, and a TV remote; the former in person and the latter while I waited. I enjoyed talking with the Doc who answered all of the questions I could think of at the moment and I enjoyed talking with the hygienists who were helpful, polite, and knew I couldn't answer questions with my mouth stretched open. Overall it was the dental visit I had expected and look forward to having in the future.

Also, the bathrooms were well-maintained ;)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennette Everett
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock Dental is great!  I didn’t take as good of care of my teeth during the pandemic (hadn’t seen  a dentist in 2.5 years as I didn’t want to see one in 2020-2021).  Had an appointment yesterday during which they cleaned my teeth and they didn’t make me feel bad about my lack of care.  They fixed me right up and kept me smiling during my visit.  They were great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Shaffer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best hygienists and dentists every time I go! They are so fast, efficient, and kind. A plus that they don’t hurt my gums and always make sure I’m comfortable and the office ladies are the best :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Daniel is the best a true artist but for teeth! The ladies in the front and the assistants are all so nice and professional. I really hate getting work done but I am always glad with the finished product. I've had a lot of work done with this location and I'm so happy with my smile.♥️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom Rogan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I needed my first root canal after a pretty major tooth ache. Hadn't been to the dentist in years and the last time I went was a terrible, expensive experience that made me never want to go again. I found River Rock Dental on Google with spectacular reviews and when I called they got me in that morning (still in great pain) and really took care of me. They definitely changed my mind on dentists, and after a quick consultation I was scheduled for a root canal early the next morning. It was easy, and I left with no pain and feeling like I'd found a dentist I can trust to care for my teeth and treat me like a human rather than a dollar sign. Dr J, thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalia Elliott
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the one dentistry that I am not afraid of at all. Dr. Im knows his job very well, knows how to tune the patient in a good way, it is very important! Dr. Im did a good job with me, he works quickly, efficiently, without pain. This is unbelievable, but I always go to my dentist in a good mood, because I trust myself to excellent doctors! I am grateful to everyone in this clinic for their professionalism, friendliness and care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sara acevedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this dental clinic! They’re so attentive and helped me in a pinch. I had broken a front tooth just a few days prior to a big conference presentation and it was all resolved within 24 hours thanks to their great care. It’s hard to find a place where I feel like staff genuinely care and a patient’s  wellbeing. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhonda Stanley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr M was very kind and efficient during my crown replacement.  He was so patient while coaching me through the process all the while keeping my exponentially high anxiety completely in check.  He was fast and made it painless.  I trust him enough to keep going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came in a mess of bad life choices. Never once did I feel embarrassed by my mouth or hear any negative words against my previous dentists.
The entire staff, including front desk, are welcoming and easy to talk to. I ended up bringing my toddlers who have never been to the dentist. One did great and the other had a melt down where I was sure I'd be asked to leave but the staff stuck it out with us.
I had a bridge done over two teeth, anchored to two teeth. I've been struggling with this bridge for 4+ years. After getting my permanent one today, I chewed gum without pain for the first time 4+ years. I ate pizza with no pain. I'm about to eat a bowl of ice cream and I am am confident there will be no pain. Just in time for all the holiday treats!
If you're on the fence, jump off and make the appointment. Every single person in that building has a beautiful personality waiting to brighten your day. (Don't forget to return the kindness!)

user_reviews_extended.Name: LeeAnn Trevino
user_reviews_extended.Description: The first dentist I had who was less experienced, made my two front teeth uneven and too long to match my other teeth. I was about to walk out in tears. The very kind receptionist said I should have the owner of the dentistry try to improve the shape of my teeth. He did so very well and I left feeling much more content. The first dentist assistant also made me feel ganged up on when I complained, for she said that I should have chose a crown instead of a filling if I was looking for the best aesthetics, like that was suppose to make me feel better. I’m 19 and had no parent around me. If the dentist emphasized the difference between a crown and filling, I would have understood better.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeddy Stailey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Office staff is friendly and the hygienist was as well.  Did not feel like I was informed enough by actual dentist. The woman who checked me out explained my exam findings to me. Wasn’t pleased with that. Automatic lights turned off on me 3 times I sat in room without someone coming in if that says anything. Really wished the dentist would have explained my treatment plan better and was more thorough.

*****Updated 3/28****
After my initial review of this office, Dr M definitely listened to my concerns. It shows me as a patient that he does care about his practice and the experience of the patients.

I do believe that there are 5 star factors about this establishment and I believe there are 3 star factors.

The positives about this front office staff hands down is Sheilah. I was never able to get an answer as to who the office manager is but if you have ANY questions, Sheilah is the person to speak to. She’s friendly, knowledgeable and to me, goes the extra mile to make sure things are clear. If she is not there however is one reason they do not get that 5th star. You need consistency and it is not there when she is not.

As far as the technicians who assist Dr M, they are all kind and respectful. I would still say the gentlemen in my first review who did my xrays needs to learn bedside manner.

Dr M helped me understand my situation, made me feel comfortable that an issue a past dentist had caused was now fixed and that he genuinely takes pride in what he does. It seems this office is a work in progress but in the most positive way and that’s why I changed my rating from a 3 to a 4 start service.

Be mindful of who you speak to and ask lots of questions.

*****Updated 10/13/19

After trying to schedule a cleaning and having to deal again with yet another office staff who could not answer my questions, I decided I was done with this office. I decided to go to another office within the River Rock family and had a night and day experience. The main two reasons I’m changing my rating to a 1 Star is the difference in the office staff and seeing firsthand the work of one of my crowns that was done at the Mueller office.

I asked the new dentist how my two crowns were doing since they were fairly new and one of them was poorly placed. He put it up on the screen and showed me the part of the crown that stuck out that answered my question as to why whole flossing it keeps catching. He also told me this could potentially create a place for decay and bring a whole new crown. The options are to continue to maintain good hygiene or he could sand it but it would involved some of my gums being damaged because of the small place it is located. The irony is one of the crowns I had replaced at the Mueller location by Dr M was one that he said was not placed correctly. Then he turns around and does that to me. So I am making payments on a crown I am likely to have issues with. Very frustrated and disappointed considering both Dr M and Sheila, the office manager, spoke so highly of their facility and that there would be no further issues.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Oh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great place to go to for your teeth! Focused on patients and not the money!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tran Le Abraham
user_reviews_extended.Description: The receptionists and dental assistants and Dr. Im himself were so welcoming and sweet!! It seemed like the staff were happy to be working there, which made me happy (or at least as happy as I can be at a dentist’s office). Dr. Im is the most thorough dentist I’ve ever had, pointing out a couple of potential concerning things that no one had before, which just goes to show how much he cares about your person dental hygiene. Highly recommend this practice if you’re in Austin!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexia LeMoine
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven’t been to the dentist since before the pandemic so I was very nervous. My last dentist tried to sell me a bunch of unnecessary things/procedures but this one didn’t.They were so thorough and kind! They were also super quick which was a pleasant surprise. I’ve never loved going to the dentist but they made it such a nice experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time here. I had a filling that fell out and needed it to be fixed. Dr. Im was very compassionate to my needs and listened to my past experience. Dr. Im was very tentative always asking if I was doing ok through the whole process. He made me feel very comfortable and at ease. The staff is very nice and I am so thankful I gave this place a try. I am the lucky one to have had such an awesome doctor like Dr. Im.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rudy Stewart
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I'm in my 30s, so this isn't my first time for a routine cleaning but when my dentist office of several years had a change in staff, I decided to give River Rock Dental in Mueller a try since they are close to my home.

The receptionist helped me fix a problem with my confusing dental insurance and was patient with me the entire time. Max, my dental hygienist, was truly exceptional though. Since it had been a few years from my last cleaning, he explained some of the specific things he was going to check and the problems that could occur. He kept making sure I was comfortable and easily kept up a conversation getting to know me while he worked. He did a thorough job and didn't cause me any discomfort while doing so.

I found my new dental office. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ayiana Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I got my wisdom teeth out almost 2 weeks ago.   I was so nervous because before my appointent I was watching a you tube videos of the procedure.   When I got to the office, the ladies at the front desk were really nice.   When I got back to the room Dr Jake and his assistant really helped my calm down and after the procedure I couldn't remember how nervous I was.  They even call me after the procedure to see if I was ok.
Man this office is so much better than the other place we used to go to, and it so neat and.clean and it smells good.   I really love this place

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Witt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Dentist Office. The staff is friendly, the office is clean, and they are efficient in getting you in and out.  Dr.Jha is approachable and professional. She answers all my questions and it is obvious she cares about her patients.  Getting your teeth cleaned is never "fun," but Eli does a great job and the time flew by.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Philip Tucker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
River Rock Dental Rocks!
All the staff are professional, caring and courteous.
I've never had to wait more than 10 minutes to see my hygienist or dentist.
When the work is completed they take the time to see if I have any questions or concerns.
Their prices are reasonable.
I'd gladly recommend River Rock Dental at Mueller to anyone looking for excellent dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was child’s first time at the dentist and the entire staff made him feel very welcome. The dentist’s assistant walked him through everything that was going to be happening during the appointment from X-rays to the cleaning. Friendly and helpful staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Dearmon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service & follow-up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Kruse
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot stress how much care and compassion the staff here provides, nearly enough.
I am incredibly self-conscious of my teeth and have had chronic pain in the past that made me not take care of myself as well as I should.

The hygienists here are kind and have the absolute apex of bedside manner.

5 stars! You all earned it! Thank you for helping me feel better ❤️🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle G
user_reviews_extended.Description: Up until recently I would’ve referred anyone to Dr. Im, but he’s so slammed and distracted now. My last visit was an entirely different experience. He was reviewing other people’s X-rays while drilling in my mouth. At least 3 different people came in to discuss other cases, while he was drilling. The assistant failed to suction a pool at the back of my throat. I had to remove the gag to spit, and it was never put back in. My lip was too numb to realize Dr. Im was absolutely shredding my lower lip, likely applying hard pressure to keep my mouth open. I was still actively bleeding 4 hours later. It took over a week to heal, and now I have scar tissue which translates to less feeling. If he hadn’t shredded my lip, I would’ve been ok with one unusual day of bad customer service. Unfortunately, I can speak from experience that when you’re that slammed (especially at a corporate medical job) customer service and actual medical care drop off.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Slow rolling Slow rolling
user_reviews_extended.Description: I enjoyed the shaft looking forward for my next appointment

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Ferro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall, the cleaning went well.  Very nice hygienist with a gentle touch.  I declined pending treatment and was told the dentist didn’t need to see me.  I found that rather strange.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Williamson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I could not be happier to have found Dr. Im!! He has helped me repair and replace the poor quality veneers done by my old dentist. He is meticulous and has great technique. I usually struggle with dentists having a heavy hand or being too rough, but not Dr. Im. He is very gentle and mindful to what of what he is doing at all times. My latest experience with Dr. Im was for an emergent root canal that was bringing me to tears. For those who have had one on the past know the pain that I’m talking about. I called ahead to notify his office, by the time I showed up the staff was on point and had a room ready, they were very kind and accommodating. Within minutes I was in a room and getting treated. Ten minutes into the procedure I was so relieved and relaxed that I ended up napping through most of the root canal procedure. :D I’d highly recommend both the facility and this dentist a 10 out of 10 if I could!! Thank you Dr. Im.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fabian Juarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Place is fine. My complaint is that they gave me less than 3 hours to confirm my appointment, during business hours, or else they'd cancel my appointment and charge me $50 for a "cancelation fee". Under 3 hours is not enough time for a working person to confirm.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex DT
user_reviews_extended.Description: Easy breezy, no issues here. I have been coming to this location for a while now and have had no issues being seen in a timely manner. Everyone is fairly nice and I haven't run into any kind of issues. I got two fillings this morning and it was a quick pinch and easy to sit through. The only reason I've considered a switch was to try a dentist closer to work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theresa Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I regret getting my crown here! My teeth is still sensitive today. The assistants there are always goofing around and don’t wash their hands when they go inside and out. The front desk is incompetence and always needs to follow up with managers! Would not recommend this at all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blanca Betancourt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thanks for your services to the hygienist who cleaned my teeth! She was gentle and took her time doing so.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily K
user_reviews_extended.Description: Let’s be real, I don’t like dentist appointments. Gives me major anxiety. But Dr Im is personable and caring. He is the most honest dentist I have come across. When he feels he could have done something better he will offer to re-do it at no additional cost. I feel safe in his care, even if seeing the dentist is not my favorite thing

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shane Parks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been terrified of the dentist due to past horrible experiences. I went to River Rock Dental and was given a true angel!!! Dr. Im  and Isaura treated me like a person  not a patient and not a number, listened to me about my concerns. He asked me to trust him when he was going to pull my wisdom tooth and I was hesitant at first bit the procedure was painless & over before I knew It! I truly can say after this I am liking going to the dentist thanks to them! I recommend anyone who has a fear of dentists  to this man, from my stand point he is amazing and I look forward to my next visit with ease!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Wood
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was able to make an appointment for myself and my two sons all at one time. The staff was curteous and helpful.  The treatments and financing options were explained in full before proceeding.  Looking forward to being a long-time client.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TYLER MACHALA
user_reviews_extended.Description: 24 hours after my wisdom teeth removal and the front office still hadn’t sent in my prescription. This was after calling them several times and being reassured they would do it. I was told I’d receive a call from them when they sent it and no call. Wife left a message and no response from them. I called this morning and they still hadn’t sent it and clearly weren’t working on it. I really liked the dentist and hygienists but this office is so incompetent i will not be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rashed Jarmon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend has done great work for me and my smile over the years the front desk is very nice and helpful the orthodontist are very knowledgeable and does wonderful work!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Z
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience! I was with Dr. Maxi and she was very professional, polite and straightforward. It was my first time visiting the dentist on my own and I’m glad it was here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jan Watson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience today. Excellent cleaning and Dr Imm was thorough, professional, and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Gamble
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t think I’ve ever actually recommended a dentist at the level I recommend this office. The entire office is great, from the front desk to the hygienists and everyone else. Never any surprises, they follow up, I can’t ask for more.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harris Bailey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff and caring! I was in and out within an hour for a regular cleaning. My hygienist and dentist had great bedside manner and answered all my questions. Would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Javs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The team is nice and thoughtful. Provide you not only with the dental care needed but also are there to listen to questions and educate how to improve your dental hygiene. This gave the impression that the diagnosis and treatment plan were personalized.

Due to Covid, members of staff opened the door to limit amount of surfaces touched. A simple yet nice touch to take care of clients. Additionally, there is a text service which is used to communicate when to come into the office, further limiting potential transmission.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aly Bueno
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this dentist! They are so friendly and playful with my toddler! They work with you to get the best treatment on a time line and price you can afford! They are absolutely wonderful. Always feel comfortable here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhonda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thanks to River Rock Dental, I have had constant mouth pain for several years because of a botched cap over a back molar.  What makes it especially galling is that I didn’t have a cavity or anything.  I moved to Austin and went to them for a cleaning and they convinced me that I should proactively cap the tooth because of a hairline crack they say they found that MIGHT someday mean the tooth would chip.  Major hard-push selling.  I should have gotten up and walked away.  Because they built it wrong - I had to go back to them 3 times because it kept cracking or falling off - it has created a pocket between my teeth that food gets stuck in every single time I eat.  Floss can’t reach it so I now have to carry a portable waterpik in my purse every time I go to a restaurant so I can get stuff out immediately.  Between the constant aching and the burning when food gets stuck, I am now in pain 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.  My new dentist says I have impeccable dental hygiene - they never find any tartar on my teeth.  This pain is not because of a cavity.  It is because the cap is shaped & sized incorrectly.  He can’t reverse the damage done but can recap the tooth which means another $1600 to try and fix a tooth that was fine until River Rock pulled their hard sell tactics.  AVOID LIKE THE PLAGUE.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff was nice and patient with my daughter, they explain the procedures that needed to be done, in a friendly and caring matter.
beside a professional service, customer service is very important to me, it is the main reason I change from my last dentist office, his personal was not nice at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debreka Bourgeois
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Im is super nice and great at what he does. I walking in the office and hit it off with the staff and doctor. I don’t like going to the dentist office but the staff and doctor made me very comfortable. If you are looking for a great dentist and great atmosphere this is the office to go to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clarence Conner
user_reviews_extended.Description: All representatives were very pleasant, very through with the routine cleaning. Not pushy about up-selling services or anything. I told the assistant Ellie that my wife was pregnant and she asked a few questions to make small and then made a prediction about the baby's gender. She said she'd been right 9 out of 10 times. Well, make that 10 out of 11 now! We are having a girl!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmin Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had terrible service with them.  I sat in the waiting room for almost two hours! I'm 38 weeks pregnant and was very uncomfortable, while also trying to keep my 1year old occupied! Just so they could brush and put fluoride on his teeth which takes all of 15 mins. Instead there were others being called before us with later appointments then us.  I was very patient but I did leave. I couldn't wait any longer it was to much with being so pregnant and with my one year old and all the receptionist could say was sorry! 🤷🏼‍♀️
I find it Very unprofessional to have someone waiting that long. I don't intend on going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Wang
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I went here for years and finally made the switch to Swish Dental and never looked back. I had no idea how outdated the equipment was at River Rock and always had a hit or miss experience. I usually left my cleanings with my teeth or gums in pain and I believe it’s because they rushed the cleaning or were not using great equipment. Swish is incredible and has all the modern tools I never knew existed for a dentist and is a painless experience! Sorry River Rock! 🤷‍♀️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frankie Nowhere
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in to Mueller River Rock Dental yesterday with a broken tooth. The staff was as nice as they could be. Dr.Hong IM (I hope I'm getting his name right) was awesome! It was by far THE best dentist experience I've ever had. He kept me comfortable and informed through the whole extraction.I highly recommend!!! 5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Castro (Spazmanic2015)
user_reviews_extended.Description: It had been a few years since I’ve gone to a dentist so when I finally got insurance, I checked around for a place to get my teeth cleaned after so long. I called River Rock and immediately set up an appointment. I went and didn’t have any judgement for not going to the dentist since before college and after I was done, they offered if I wanted to correct my teeth with the orthodontist team. Y’all, I really got lucky with them on my first time looking for a dentist. I never felt scared or worried as some might feel when they’re getting a check up, instead I got people taking time to talk about their day and life as did I (as much as I could with them fixing my mouth lol) and always felt safe and relaxed when I went to the office. They did amazing with recommending me to park side dental to remove my wisdom and baby teeth and quickly we managed to pull my tooth up in my gums in about 5/6 months. I’m so sad I won’t be going to river rock anymore as I’m moving states but if I was staying, I’d def stay with them. Dr. Albertson is professional and kind, he cares for his patients and actually laughed at some of my bad jokes lol. The staff were amazing, helping me set up appointments around my weird schedule, not making me feel bad if a bracket broke off and laughed and joked around. They were amazing and if I return to Austin, I’d definitely would return to them if I needed any dental assistance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Magner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had a great first visit! Whoever works the front desk was so patient and helpful on getting ahold of my confusing insurance to make sure everything was in order before my first visit. The staff were calming, professional and very helpful! It’s hard starting over at a new dentist but absolutely recommend coming to rover rock at mueller!

user_reviews_extended.Name: adamelama
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going to RiverRock for years, had to be one of their first patients and overall it’s been great until this last time. They called me to change my appointment and I agreed but I misplaced the time and when I showed up there was no urgency to accommodate the same day or even later on another day. The front desk was a bit rude only saying sorry we can’t help. I understand I was late but the emphasis on helping wasn’t even an option.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Omar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I scheduled an in office whitening and spoke on the phone with the receptionist on two different occasions. They asked me if I wanted an exam and I said no. I asked if they would be able to do the whitening the day of the appointment and they said yes. When I arrived they told me I had to pay for a $70 exam before they would do anything more and that I'd have to come back another day because they were too busy. They hadn't mentioned the mandatory exam or its cost when quoting the price. They also didn't tell me they were too busy before I showed up, so they wasted my afternoon. They apologized when I expressed frustration but otherwise made no effort to remedy the situation or compensate me for my time. They charge their patients a penalty if they don't give the office 24 hours notice, yet their patients don't deserve the same courtesy. The whole experience was unprofessional. I do not recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Engelsman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have consistently had issues with the front office not having their things together.
First: I show up for my appointment & turns out they did not schedule me correctly even after showing them my confirmation email & text, they could not see me that day.
Second: I show up for my re-try first appointment & they didn’t schedule me for a cleaning even though I specifically stated that is why I was making the appointment. So at this appointment they took all of my XRays, Doc came in, checked me out, etc. I have to then leave & make a new appointment for the cleaning.
Third: I show up for my cleaning appointment. The hygienist begins attempting to take XRays, etc like I already have done. I tell her I already have done this, she then looks over my documents and realizes I am correct. She cleans my teeth and I leave.
Now they are trying to say my insurance won’t cover all of the “exams” I have had. I try to explain the situation & all the woman could say was “hmm that’s weird.” I tell her I am not surprised and it has been so incredibly difficult working with them. No resolution as of now.
I DO NOT recommend this place. Do not waste your time here. It has been the most drawn out, unorganized, & frustrating healthcare establishment I have ever dealt with. Go to one of the many other places nearby. You will be thankful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Collette Beasley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Daniel Im was my guy for my journey this year. I went 12 years without a dentist and made some questionable life choices as well, I needed to have something like 6 cavities filled, a root canal, and a crown and 4 wisdom tooth removals and they took really great care of me here making sure I knew the process and having an in-house membership program to save some money since I was uninsured. One important thing that stood out to me about my experience here was that if I was having any Ill-effects after any procedure they would ALWAYS answer the phone and  they would bring me back in the same day to make sure I didn’t suffer needlessly, this can not be said about a lot of other dentist offices here in Austin who will make you wait a week living in hell.

I did have to go elsewhere for the root canal and ended up going to Dr Ruma with endidontics associates of austin whom gave me the most relaxing root canal to ever happen and was confirmed to be perfect by 2 other dentists.

I also Went elsewhere for my crown but to be honest I wish I had spent the extra money to have it done here because the place I went just wasn’t as organized, skilled, or prompt with their treatment but Im Daniel confirmed they did the job well enough. Also, one of the first people I went to for my crown wanted to cut into my gums!!! Neither River Rock Dental nor the place I ended up getting it done wanted to do that, so—- be careful!!

Thank you guys for everything, will always recommend to my friends, especially when comparing y’all to other offices in the area,

user_reviews_extended.Name: B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
You wanna get over booked? Have the dentist touch other people's mouths in between the work they doing on you? Sit in the dark? And then have to go to the hospital for facial palsy and gum infection? All in the same day? And then have to go get tested for all the transmittable viruses you normally get from STIs? Then this place is perfect for you I promise.

Look as they frantically try to put in fake reviews to cover the truth of my review. Cute. But nice try...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rod Merritt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice reception staff as well as dentist and hygienist. These people take the time and actually seem to care! Also, I don't have a lot to compare but their price is reasonable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jocelyn eide
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and dentists here are always attentive and caring. Dental work is no fun, but they make sure you're comfortable. I had some trouble with my insurance payments and their accounts payable person (basically a wizard) got me what I needed in less than 15 minutes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for a cleaning. Andrea, my hygienist, was the most friendly person I've ever met. Did a wonderful job. I'll be coming back in soon for a procedure and have full confidence in the folks at RRD.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lyon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely awesome experience! They helped assist me with insurance when I had issues designating the provider. The women at the front desk were sweethearts and excellent at helping my son and I feel comfortable.  Doctor Shroyer, the Endodontist, was beyond professional and courteous with both my son and I. He found the problem left by an old dentist and fixed it quickly and with no pain to my son. It is soooo hard to find a really great dentist and even harder to find an Endodontist to trust but I recommend Dr. Shroyer highly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Leah was a fantastic hygienist! I dislike go to the dentist and she did an amazing job of easing my fears. The office staff is caring and pleasant every time I go there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leigh Snyder
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super place. I had the best hygienist, super detailed but very gentle. Loved everything about this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J.S. Lohr
user_reviews_extended.Description: I shouldn’t have to hold the x-ray machine to my face because the business is too cheap and/or cash-strapped to fix their own equipment. Also, I need a lead vest on my chest for x-rays, but it's okay to hold the unit in my bare hands? And I'm not quite sure why I need to wear a pair of sunglasses during my visit, but I'm 99% certain those superfluous sunglasses were not cleaned in-between patients. (Frankly, the lenses looked like they had been in a baby's mouth an hour earlier.) And as for that thousand-dollar cleaning? Yeah, I'll be getting a second opinion on that from someone who DOESN'T try to rush to start a procedure before telling the patient how much it's going to cost.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Genaro Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The first visit was very welcoming. Staff was courteous and professional.  They did an excellent job with my exam. Explained my options, and answered all my questions.  Thank you RVD

user_reviews_extended.Name: sara rice
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Im is AMAZING!!! He's so kind and gentle and he's my favorite dentist in Austin. I highly recommend him and this office. The staff is very friendly and they don't overcharge for services. I never feel cheated when I leave here. A++

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrea R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to see Dr. Im Hong for 4 years or so. I love this clinic! I always get sound advice, they’re flexible and patient with me as I postpone my treatments over and over lol I have some dental work fears from childhood but they always make sure I’m comfortable and do excellent, efficient work. Thanks Dr. Im & Audrey!

user_reviews_extended.Name: bingo bango
user_reviews_extended.Description:
the nicest staff ever! they were all very helpful and professional.
im usually terrified of the dentist but this was my first experience not hating a dentist office
you could tell they genuinely want to help and that they care for people

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dave Weber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff. Experienced technicians. They are always willing to discuss and questions I have at length. Clean, professional, and efficient. This is what a dental visit should be like. I have personally recommended friends and family to go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rocio Sosa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going here for a few years now and I’ve had a few issues with them. They seem unorganized every time I go and this appointment I had on Dec 29th, 2018 was the worst experience. I arrived just in time for my appointment at 10:30am and the hygienist did the cleaning which was okay (not the best) but then I waited about 30 minutes after she was done to speak with the dentist and have them tell me if my teeth are okay/free of cavities and he/she never came to my room. I was frustrated at that point after waiting for 30 minutes and I needed to leave so I left without seeing the dentist. Terrible experience. Their excuse is that they were busy and had an emergency which made me more upset because they could’ve just told me that right after my cleaning was done and I would’ve left instead of waiting 30 minutes and wasting my time and end up not even seeing the dentist. I wonder how much longer they would’ve kept me waiting... In the past they have also taken xrays that aren’t approved by my insurance and later I got a bill for those xrays that weren’t supposed to be taken and that I never asked for or had been talked to about beforehand. They also did a procedure that they told me would be partially covered and I paid the other half at the clinic but later received an almost $300 bill. I’ll definitely be reconsidering going to this place and finding another convenient place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: StClair
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best service ive ever experienced at a dental office. Friendly staff all around and even though being in that chair scares me my dentist always made sure I wasn’t in pain or discomfort. Also first office to actually offer a payment plan since my insurance is up.

user_reviews_extended.Name: warren jizzle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. IM is very professional and knowledgeable of his practice. He always keeps it real with me. Dr. Laura Maxey is very efficient and professional. Their customer service is A1. I look forward to my next appt. (Side Note) #GoCowboys

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tab
user_reviews_extended.Description: The front desk, the dental assistant, the dental hygienist and the dentist were all very nice! I felt like I had a thorough exam and cleaning and wish I found this place sooner. Would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jean Baptiste
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great dental practice from the office staff to my actual dentist.  Everyone is friendly, respectful and the overall atmosphere is very positive. The dental services are top notch as well. If your looking for a dentist look no further.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mercedes Saenz
user_reviews_extended.Description: The hygenist was awesome the first time I went. After my second visit I was told I needed to refill one of my fillings, so I scheduled an appointment. Day of the appointment, I was not talked through the procedure at all what so ever. Next thing I knew, they were numbing my cheeks and didn't say anything until they stuck the needle in. They refilled the filling and that same day I called back because I could not chew/drink anything on my left side, not even soft bread or breathe in cold air because it iritated my tooth that badly and my bite was completely off. They told me to wait a week and see if anything changed. NO CHANGE, so we rescheduled a check up. She tried filing it down some more so my bite would go back to normal and to see if it'd help my ability to chew on that side. It still hurt, so she suggested removing the filling and doing the procedure all over again. By that time I was too frustrated because I was having no problems chewing or no pain before I went to them. Obviously, I did not agree to redoing the procedure. I am NEVER going back.  It's been 6 months since that happened and I am scared to trust in another dentist because I still cannot chew or drink without pain/irritation on my left back moler.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor M
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t write reviews, but after going to River Rock Dental, I had to type this up. The staff were friendly, attentive, and thorough. They answered all my questions and even provided me with education on why my teeth are the way they are. They were respectful in every way. I highly suggest going here for quality dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vince Stermer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update: 11/13/19. Teeth cleaning scheduled by Addie, she was very friendly, and knowledgeable about everything the patient needs to know! Teeth cleaning from Teri! Very good at her work! I followed all her recommendations
over the last year and my mouth feels and looks amazing! Thanks River Rock team you guys are the best!
03/21/19: Dr. Hong and the dental assistant Lee were amazing! I was extremely nervous going into the office and getting my 4 wisdom teeth pulled. The moment i walked in the super nice receptionists at the desks really helped put my mind at ease before i saw Lee and Dr. Hong. What little anxiety i had left, was buried away under laughing gas and numbing medicine. They were very attentive to make sure i didnt feel any pain. I didnt feel a thing besides a couple pokes!  Incredible team, 5 stars for the receptionists, 5 for Lee and 5 for Dr. Hong! Thank you so much!

1 year ago: Double tooth extraction and a bone graft from Dr. Smith and LaKesha. They were awesome! Very thorough in their explanations and what to expect during the procedure. I was nervous but they made me feel comfortable and took great care to make sure it was not a painful process for me. I'll be back for implants! Thanks alot Dr. Smith and LaKesha!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Sepulveda
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience is always great coming to River Rock Dental- Mueller. The staff is always very friendly. The Doctors are great as well; they want the best for you and explain everything in great detail!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sahjabin Kabir
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyday my phone is bombarded with this spam. No matter how many times I send this to junk, its coming back. Tired of this.

user_reviews_extended.Name: elia jaimes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went here for a routine exam and cleaning. Front staff is very polite and always greets me at the door. Victoria was my hygienist and she did a great job being thorough yet gentle. I highly recommend this place!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra Ash
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am visiting from out of town and on my first night here the temporary crown on my front tooth fell out. I found River Rock Dental on google because it was one of the few places open on a Saturday. They were able to make a same day appointment for me and cement the tooth back in.  The whole experience was quick and pleasant - the waiting room was nice and had good wifi.  Dr. Im and Isaura were helpful and got the job done. My problem was very simple to fix, so I can't really speak to how this dentist practice might be for anything else, but they were great in a minor dental emergency and saved my vacation. They let me know how much it would cost over the phone which was helpful, and even though it was more than I think it should be, it was similar in cost to what other dentists I had been too charge for similar services.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Though the people at River Rock Dental are all extremely friendly and polite, none of that helps when it comes to the quality of their work. user_reviews_extended.Name: T.J. Rollings
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got hit with the ole bait and switch.  I went in for a cleaning, they  told me I needed a deep cleaning.  I have dental insurance and was given a total to pay, you have to pay before services are rendered.  The cleaning was done very well and  I left. I had to go in  a few weeks later to have a wisdom tooth pulled, again I paid before the services were rendered. A month goes by and I get a bill in the mail for $400!  I was told by them that my insurance had downgraded the amount paid so I was left with the balance...I don't have an extra $400 lying around, that is why I have insurance, also I explained to them that the reason I left my last dentist is because it was way too expensive and I did not want to go through with the services until I accepted the price.  I have been paying it off a little at a time but they keep calling me to ask for more money even though I have been paying every 2 weeks to a month...this is not a good way to keep someones business by assuring them that the amount paid before services were rendered was suffecient and then hitting them with a $400 bill, seriously please get someone who knows billing etc and if your services are that expensive tell your customers up front so they can make the decision to pay  or find more affordable services elsewhere....lesson  learned I suppose.

user_reviews_extended.Name: yuxin fang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a disappointing experience at this clinic.

I came in expecting a simple check and possibly a sealant or minor work. During the visit, the dentist decided to proceed with a filling and administered local anesthesia without clearly explaining the plan or obtaining my explicit consent beforehand.

My main concern is not the treatment itself, but the lack of communication. As a patient, I expect to be informed about what is being done and why, especially when it involves anesthesia. I would have appreciated a brief explanation and the opportunity to agree or ask questions before proceeding.

The treatment itself may have been clinically appropriate, but the process felt rushed and left me uncomfortable with how decisions were made.

I hope the clinic can improve their communication and ensure patients are properly informed and involved in their care decisions.

It has been several years since our family has been seen by a dentist. We were grateful River Rock Dental made scheduling a new appointment easy. Unfortunately, we had an experience with one dental hygienist which will end any future relationship with River Rock Dental.

During my cleaning, this hygienist made more than one comment about crying children being seen at this dental practice. While our family felt welcomed by the front office administrators, it was clear the experience would not be consistent throughout our visit.

She commented on the "type" of children she perceived most of the crying and yelling to come from
-- Medicaid patients --
I do not believe she received the response from me she'd been hoping for. The dentist can be a scary place for all children, understandably.

Incredibly disappointing that this dental hygienist felt the need to class discriminate. Our oldest son attends an elementary school with many students whose families are on Medicaid. They are our friends, our neighbors.

We will find another dentist.

Deborah

The dentist mentioned to me at my first visit if I was still in pain to give them a call she will prescribe me antibiotics. However when I gave them a call I explained the situation with the receptionist the issue she explain she will inform the dentist so she will be able to prescribe some medication for me. Over the phone she informed me the tooth that’s giving me the problem is the tooth that’s need a filling. However no one returned a phone call back several days later I realized no one had called me back. I called them back to follow up with my concerns no one knew anything about the call that was made or the receptionist that I spoke with. I was very disturbed by that 😧. I did try to scheduling my dentist appointment at another dental facility but my insurance wouldn’t cover the x-rays that needed to be done at the other dental facility. So I called My Dental to be seen. Once I schedule my appt I waited for about an hour to be seen by the doctor, I began to walk out of the door and came back the dentist was somehow ready to see me. She didn’t really give me more than 5mins of her time. She just told me my tooth needed to be extracted. My first response was if my tooth needed to be extracted I would’ve never scheduled this appointment and took off of work, waste my time just so someone can state the obvious. I schedule the appointment to get a filling? Somehow she thought I schedule the appointment to get pain medication. I was in total complete shock, angry 😤 and upset at this establishment. This is not the way to treat your patients, especially paying patients. Now I have to take more time off to schedule to see an oral surgeon.

Thanks, My Dental 👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claiborne Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at MyDental was great! The customer service was great, everyone was kind, friendly, and receptive of my questions. Which I really appreciated. After x-rays, Dr. Alex Li presented his diagnosis and we discussed at length the findings and his recommended treatments. After this discussion, before proceeding with any of the treatments I had the opportunity to speak with billing to discuss details on what my insurance would cover and what I would have to pay out of pocket. This was refreshing because I have been to dentists who would commit to procedures before discussing how much it would cost. The upfront and forthcoming approach of the office was one that made me confident in trusting them with the procedures. Overall, I have all positive things to say about my visit and would recommend anyone looking for a dentist in Austin to strongly consider MyDental.

title: South Austin Dentist
address: 3901 S Lamar Blvd Ste 480, Austin, TX 78704, United States

user_reviews.Name: Elizabeth Hampton
user_reviews.Description: The team at South Austin Dentist has been providing me exceptional dental care since my first visit as a young adult new to Austin 25 years ago! Dr Van Wicklen, Jamie my hygienist, and all staff create a professional, welcoming environment where they know you and prioritize patient connection,  while at the same time being current in best dental practices. I no longer live in South Austin, but I make the drive to South Austin Dentist because I know I am well cared for there.

user_reviews.Name: craig bligh
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Van Wicklen and his team at South Austin Dentist are kind, efficient, professional and highly skilled. Jamie, my dental hygienist, is the best. They offer pragmatic advice on dental care; I do not feel they are trying sell products and services that are not necessary. I highly recommend South Austin Dentist, they get a 10 out of 10 in my opinion based on my experience.

user_reviews.Name: Yvonne G.
user_reviews.Description: High quality service. Jamie, my dental hygienist, is thorough and I value her friendship. The front office is professional, and Dr. Steven Van Wicklin uses modern dental techniques for a smooth visit.

user_reviews.Name: Sam Avila
user_reviews.Description: Before I started coming to South Austin Dentist I never looked forward to a dental visit. But since my first visit there I look forward to it. Everyone from the front desk to the dental hygienist to the dentist is wonderful and thanks to them I no longer dread my dental visits. I highly recommend them.

user_reviews.Name: Elizabeth O'Brien
user_reviews.Description: Best dentist in town: Steven van Wicklen: skilled, calm, warm and friendly. We’ve been loyal customers for many years. And Jamie, the dental hygienist, is extremely thorough—and fun…great personality!

user_reviews.Name: Tom Jenkinson
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Steven Van Wicklin, the best kept dentist secrete in south Austin and his team of assistamts, dental hygenists and top notch office manager, are simply fantastic. You will be listened to, assesed, taken care of, and treated with expert clinical care while receiving the best dental outcomes.
Been going to Dr.  for decades. Call his office and ask for an appointment and check him out.

user_reviews.Name: Raquelle Godbey
user_reviews.Description: I've been a patient with Dr Van Wicklen since around 1988, and have had a range of dental work performed over the years, all excellently. This dental office is the most pleasant and comfortable I have been to. The professional staff is so friendly and committed to patient service and comfort.

user_reviews.Name: Laura Havlick
user_reviews.Description: This dentist was a very welcome change from my previous two dental groups!  My previous dentist had gotten too busy and not responsive to my questions/concerns, and was pushing me to get major dental work.  After I left them and signed up for new insurance that better covered my needs, my 2nd previous dentist overcharged me and also said I needed major dental work.  Then I went to UT Health Sci Ctr in SA, but they were too far for me.  Finally, I checked Yelp for a nearby dentist and found this one (South Austin Dentist) who has been a dentist for about 30 years and was highly recommended. He was wonderful — welcoming, knowledgeable, reassuring, and available for not only a consultation but a quick sealing of exposed gums at short notice.  He’s my dentist now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I lost my trusted night guard in a gas station in Houston. (It’s probably embedded in a semi truck tire.) The night guards are tooth and jaw muscle savers, especially while driving! Get one if you need one, it will change your life.

So, I got fitted for a replacement night guard at South Austin Dentist. The technician was super kind, and used a scanner machine to map out my jaw and teeth. Back in the old days, a night guard involved a slimy mold. This week, it was a way faster, cleaner, more accurate and comfortable process.
