title: Swish Dental Downtown
address: 201 W 5th St Ste 175, Austin, TX 78701, United States

user_reviews.Name: Dennelle Walton
user_reviews.Description:
I visited several dentists in 2025 while trying to find the right solution for my dental concerns, but none truly understood my goals or presented a plan that felt thoughtful and well-considered. On top of that, I also needed to find a dentist for my son. Surprisingly, Swish Dental checked every box.

From the moment we arrived, the entire staff was warm, welcoming, and kind to both me and my son. I’ll update this review with my dentist’s name, but she was incredibly easy to talk to and took the time to create a real, personalized plan aligned with my goals. The team was accommodating, professional, and genuinely thoughtful throughout the entire experience.

I was impressed by the treatment plan, the staff’s knowledge, their professionalism, and the cost. Swish Dental quoted me an excellent price for all the work I plan to complete with them, which made the decision even easier. From start to finish, the service was outstanding—I truly have nothing negative to say.

I intentionally waited to write this review until after completing a procedure. I recently received crowns, and both the process and the results were amazing. The crowns are high quality, and the dentist took great care to adjust them so they fit perfectly. I’m truly glad I trusted Swish Dental with my teeth.

user_reviews.Name: Clint Duross
user_reviews.Description: This is the worst general experience I’ve ever had . From the moment you walk in the music is blaring. It doesn’t get much better when you get back to an office. There’s a sense of chaos in the entire place. I had a young assistant placed my first temporary crown, and I’m not sure how he made it into this office. He clearly had no business putting that crown on me. It was horribly done, and I told him that and they said if this one falls out, we can give you another one… who has time for that do it right the first time. I did end up having to get a second temporary crown and then when they went to place the final crown, they had an issue with their equipment and their office manager after I had been sitting there for 30 minutes doing nothing and reached out to my office to let them know where I was and why I was running behind. She barked at me to get off my phone so that they could proceed… they placed what was supposed to be the final crown and one of the assistance even looked me straight in the eyes and said it looks great. It looks wonderful. Didn’t they told me they would need to send it out to a lab to have another one remade because this one wasn’t sitting properly I told them that they knew that I would be moving out of town and even if I wasn’t again who has time to keep going back to the same office. I’ve never had to have a crown redone once let alone twice. When I got into my car, I noticed the color was completely wrong. It was a very low quality crown with the shade, not even matching. I told them that I no longer want to allow another office location of theirs to place the final crown that it didn’t matter what office they sent me to I would no longer be doing business with their company. It took them seven months. 7 months ! To process my refund at which point I was no longer working for the same company in the majority of the refund went to an insurance company. There was no longer going to be providing me care. I informed them three weeks ago that they took so long to resolve the issue that it did not resolve the issue. I should be able to go get a crown and not have to come out of pocket since I already did once and that I expected for them to pay for a crown at an office of my choosing that would do it right they said they would get back to me just like before they have not gotten back to me and once again, I’m about to leave Texas. I have given them ample time to resolve these issues. Nine months is more than enough time to fix a problem if I were you, I would run away from this place

user_reviews.Name: Madison Leal
user_reviews.Description: My visit this week was amazing. I requested the same hygienist that I had the very first time. The last time I got a hygienist that spent at most 15 minutest cleaning my teeth and she was very rough, I could tell she didn’t really care. I got a notification that I was due for my cleaning and called to express this concern and they assured me that I could see my normal hygienist Casidy. You guys need to request her, I’ve learned very quick how important it is to stay consistent with someone you’re comfortable with and knows what she’s doing. I also really appreciated how willing the front desk was to accommodate to my needs and preference.

user_reviews.Name: morgan cunningham
user_reviews.Description: I just switched to Swish and can’t recommend them enough. From the front desk to the hygienist and doctors, everyone is so nice and welcoming. They explain everything clearly, and they walked me through every step of my Invisalign treatment, answered all my questions, and made me feel really confident about getting started. The staff is friendly, professional, and you can tell they genuinely care about their patients. Highly recommend to anyone looking for great routine dental care or cosmetic treatment!!!

I picked Swish because it was two blocks from my house.  I loved the staff, their equipment was state of the art.  Everyone was so Proffessional, knowledgeable and nice.  I found my new dentist.  Hopefully for the next 25 years!!

user_reviews.Name: Elizabeth Gomez
user_reviews.Description: Friendly staff though the only thing is they forgot to add on the fluoride service they immediately asked me pay for at check in and I had to come back and remind them after I was told I was good to go. The individual from billing could’ve also offered better customer service when discussing my treatment plan/quote. Ultimately, I would not recommend the downtown location as this is not the first time I visit and had an experience like this.

user_reviews.Name: Gabrielle Swenson
user_reviews.Description:
I’m sharing my experience so others can make an informed decision.

Since April 2025, I have been trying to resolve a billing issue related to a root canal that was performed incorrectly at Edge Endodontics. During this process, I discovered that Edge issued a refund or credit to Swish Dental Downtown instead of to me — the patient who actually paid. I was never informed that this transfer had occurred.

I only learned about it after requesting receipts and financial statements, which showed over $800 in credits sent from Edge (and it appeared that additional funds may have been applied as well). When I asked Swish for a refund, I was then told the statement was incorrect and that the money actually belonged to their office.

After communication stopped, I had to go in person to continue trying to resolve the issue. At that point, I was told they attempted to issue a refund of $478, but it was sent to a card that was not mine. I was also told they had called me, but I never received any call, voicemail, or communication.

This raises serious concerns. If more than $800 in credits were received from Edge, why was only $478 refunded? Where did the remaining funds go?

I am still left asking:

Why was Edge Endodontics’ refund sent to Swish instead of directly to the patient?

Why was only a partial refund of $478 attempted when the records showed a higher credit amount?

Why was the refund processed to the wrong card without confirming with me first?

Throughout this process, I have made every effort to handle this professionally and respectfully, but communication has been inconsistent and resolution has not been straightforward.

Patients should not have to chase multiple offices to recover money that is owed to them. The lack of coordination, transparency, and accountability between providers has been extremely stressful, time-consuming, and concerning.

I strongly recommend asking detailed questions about billing and refund policies and carefully reviewing patient experiences before choosing care.

Swish Dental Downtown, I welcome the opportunity to resolve this professionally. Please issue the full refund owed directly to me using the correct payment method and provide a clear accounting of all funds received from Edge Endodontics, including where the remaining balance was applied.

user_reviews.Description:
Hygienist Cassidy was amazing! I did my deep cleaning there and it was a very enjoyable experience. She was patient, caring, and excellent at what she does. I felt great after doing it - 100% recommend.

Also shoutout to the office that plays music that girls *actually* wanna listen to.

Great vibe, music, equipment, and team. However! The treatment plan felt overly aggressive; my research suggested some steps weren’t necessary. Worth double-checking before committing!

I went in for a small emergency, which was quickly attended to and resolved by Dr. Bekah, who also performed a full evaluation and identified some priorities I needed to address. Thank you, Swish Dental! Highly recommended.

Mauricio

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kylie Dupont
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I used Swish for several years. I had multiple issues to which they attempted to correct. Although, after my last cleaning | was told I had 5 cavities and needed a night guard.
Thousands out of pocket costs. The dentist was extremely rude in terms of the issues I was facing and almost seemed as she was bullying me into scheduling immediately. Made statements like "wow, this is bad" "hmm what have you done differently this is concerning??" I decided to get a second opinion. To my surprise, he stated I had ZERO cavities and no evidence of needing a night guard. Apparently swish just wants to run your insurance. Stay AWAY.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe K
user_reviews_extended.Description: Took me at the time of my appointment- discussed my treatment plan before doing any work and explained my options- my first time visiting was awesome. All associates were kind and patient with me and my hearing impairment

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miss Ana Choo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Billing issue – keep documentation!

We received dental services at this office in 2024, and our account was paid in full at that time. We have not returned since and have not received any additional services.

In 2025, we were contacted regarding a billing question, which was discussed and resolved.
In January 2026, we were contacted again regarding the same matter, despite no new visits or services.

This required us to formally request documentation to clarify the account. We recommend that patients keep copies of receipts and request written confirmation of account balances.

We hope this is corrected promptly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathryn Chappell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience at Swish over three visits hasn’t been what I was hoping for, and I’ll be changing to a different provider. My reason for coming was proximity to work and hope for a seamless, modern experience with easy scheduling.

What I experienced felt like a dental factory designed to squeeze every penny they can out of you, often without explaining the reason for the cost.

First, you have to start with a diagnostic visit. That’s understandable to some extent - they insisted they wanted to do a thorough review to get a baseline. However, that appointment was an hour taken up by things like them taking a photo of my face abruptly, putting it through Invisalign AI, rolling in a screen with three versions of my face and smile for how it could look better and leaving it positioned in front of me to “consider” it by myself for five minutes. Then, I was asked no less than 3 times if I would like to have Invisalign, maybe just see pricing, etc - by everyone including the dentist. The questions wouldn’t stop until I finally agreed to see pricing.

They insisted on taking their own x-rays, saying their equipment is better than other dentists. I was fine to agree to this as they said on my scheduling call that if my insurance didn’t cover it, they would waive the costs. At the end of my diagnostic visit, they told me I owed $80 for x-rays, and that their policy is actually different than their scheduler quoted. It took insistence from me and approval by the office manager to get those refunded.

The only way they would treat me was to schedule two additional visits following my diagnostic - one for treatment/cleaning and one for a follow-up check. In my treatment visit, they sent consent forms that implied I was having a much more intensive treatment and that I needed to agree to be on a liquid diet for multiple days. This was sent an hour before the appointment with no context. Upon asking when I got there, they said they just send forms that include bunches of treatments because it’s easier for them to get clearance for everything. Let me tell you, it’s not easier for the patient.

At each check-in in the very small lobby, the receptionist greeted me and asked about my treatments and decisions loudly with no regard for my privacy, given there were multiple other patients in the room.

On my third visit, meant to just be a checkup, they added a cleaning to the plan for the visit without any advance notice or context (8 weeks after my last cleaning) because they said I had a “credit” and it would essentially be free. No one had told me about the credit - apparently an overcharge they made to my insurance - and I had to ask to have it refunded instead of applied to an unnecessary cleaning. The hygienist on this visit was the only member of the staff who listened and resolved my issue promptly, switching the appointment to a checkup only.

The space is modern, the equipment is state of the art and the scheduling is easy. But, I’ve never felt more like a number to any medical office. I really wanted to like it here - even came three times to really try it. But, in the end, it’s not the place for me. Hopefully my experience helps others evaluate it for themselves too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree Jerrells
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a dentist appointment for an emergency on Brodie lane & I was able to get a surgery appointment the next day! Avery & Dr.Laurie are Amazing! And as well the staff there too! I had anxiety but they made me feel very safe and relaxed the whole time. I would definitely recommend swish dental to anyone(;

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casey Saldana
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in last minute for a painful toothache. I was seen immediately and given options and ultimately we decided it was best to have the tooth removed. I have high anxiety and low tolerance for pain but the entire time I was there Dr Noor and her assistant, Kayla, were completely fabulous and took care of me that was the best care I have ever had. So much empathy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniela Valle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had three of my fillings done late August of 2025 — never had I have as many cavities so I was very surprised. A month after, I still could not eat on my left side, so I called with a complaint and they asked me to come in and they confirmed that the fillings were defective and would need replace all of them.

Fast foward to the day they replaced my fillings, they mentioned that they will only be replacing one of the fillings as all the others were perfectly fine. (I thought that was an interesting plot twist) They also mentioned they would use a better composite this time — which makes you wonder why they don't ask you what quality of a composite you want before performing the procedure. When they re-did my filling it was one of the most painful things I've had to go through (FYI). Doctor said that I could be able to eat without problem in 30 minutes.

Guess what? To this day, I cannot properly eat and still have sensitivity in two of those molars on my left side, my food experience has been diminished and there is no possible way that I can recommend Swish.

I called again on November 13 to express my concern and asked for a refund. Front desk said they would review and call back, I still haven't heard back.

Depricating service overall.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna
user_reviews_extended.Description: My hygienist Cassidy was amazing. Very informative, patient, and extremely knowledgeable. I had a lot of questions and I’m sure that can get annoying after awhile and she took the time to go into depth on each one of my questions to make sure I understood coming from a non dental educated background. I didnt love the push for Invisilign, but I will be returning to see Cassidy as well as referring my colleagues to her! Ask for hygienist Cassidy (not sure her last name)!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tabitha Sutter
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place does not feel genuine. The standard dental work itself is fine. In my time, I went in for the standard annual cleanings and one shallow filling – each did the job as intended. However, each visit displayed a lack of care and customer service to some degree. Leaving me feeling as though they don't prioritize the well-being of their patients but rather whether they're meeting their revenue goals. This made each experience feel transactional instead of welcoming or concerned for patient care.

During my most recent visit, I confirmed wanting fluoride during my cleaning both online and in-person. I also paid at the beginning of my appointment. However, after leaving, I realized the fluoride had never been applied. When I called, they said the dental hygienist claimed I declined the application service. I refuted that claim stating I confirmed both online and in-person and kindly requested a refund. They accepted, but when the refund later appeared, it was less than the original full amount. After calling and being on hold for over 10 minutes, they said it was because I never paid for my fluoride application during the last cleaning earlier in the year. I was never informed I owed anything in the six months since my last visit. To some extent, this felt a little retaliatory, or at least icky. In the end, it wasn’t about the money, but rather the principal and lack of customer service.

While this instance was small, that paired with all the other small instances during my visits, felt like a look into the bigger picture of this place, and my reason to look elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rodalyn Tayag
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just wanted to share the deceptive pricing practices I experienced at this dental office. I was originally quoted approximately $2,000.00 for my procedure. Based on that estimate, I agreed to move forward.

However, during the actual procedure, the cost suddenly increased to over $4,000.00 due to insurance change. I was put in a position where I had to continue because the procedure was already underway. Now, I am being told that I still owe an additional $2,000.00 because of my insurance again, bringing the total cost to three times more than what was originally quoted.

This is unacceptable and feels extremely misleading. It appears that patients are being encouraged to proceed with treatment under one price, only to be charged significantly more after they are already committed and vulnerable. This practice is not only unethical, but it also erodes trust and creates financial hardship for patients who rely on accurate estimates to make informed decisions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fernando Llanos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff here are friendly and professional, but I decided to switch to another dentist. When I started treatment, I was told that certain services were covered by my Delta Dental insurance. Several months later after the service was provided, I was contacted and told that the insurance had denied payment, and that I was responsible for the full amount.

I understand that these things can happen, but it would have helped if the office had confirmed coverage with the insurer before assuring me otherwise. In the past, other clinics have done that so I could make a more informed decision. It left me feeling that the situation was handled casually, and that the financial risk was placed on me rather than shared responsibly.

I don’t mind paying; I just value transparency and trust in these matters.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I made an emergency appointment due to extreme pain from a loose tooth with an infection under it. Everyone who worked with me was informative and patient as I was having trouble retaining information due to the excruciating pain I was experiencing. The dentist and assistant who did the extraction were amazing with me, comforting me throughout the entire procedure as I was very anxious and scared.
One thing I’d change is the payment at the end of the procedure - I was still experiencing an extreme amount of pain and I had to fill out forms and use the interest free credit card they offer which was amazing because dental work is not cheap - however - I was in such pain that it made it really difficult to complete the paperwork and fully understand what I was signing. This was discussed prior to the start of the extraction so I would suggest in the future its completed prior so the patient can feel more in control and confident in what I’m signing and paying for.

I also suggest they provide which parking garage they validate for because that wasn’t listed and I parked across the street and was told that’s the wrong one, after the fact, giving me another large bill to pay for. Just a suggestion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Gaynor
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My "treatment plan" was estimated at $4,700 claiming I needed 7! fillings... I've had healthy teeth and 2 fillings in my entire life so I knew these folks were sketchy. Went and got a second opinion at a LOCAL dentist about a half mile away and I was told my teeth were in great shape and I only had one cracked old filling that needed to be repaired. $200 out the door.
Don't trust these new shiny hedge fund backed dental chains - profit is their number one goal. Can you imagine getting seven healthy teeth drilled into and filled for no reason? Can you imagine doing that to someone? I can't. Shady shady shady.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kai ye
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would be very cautious about this place. A few weeks ago, I visited for mild tooth pain, and Rebekah Salinas (DDS) examined me for about ten minutes. She told me I had a cracked tooth and needed a crown, which would cost over $800. Since their schedule was full and they couldn’t fit me in the following week, I decided to go to another Swish Dental location instead. The dentist there examined me carefully and said there was no crack—the discomfort was actually from a small cavity in the neighboring tooth. After getting that cavity treated, the pain completely went away. If I hadn’t sought a second opinion, I would have paid for an unnecessary crown and had a healthy tooth drilled. I’m sharing this to remind others: always get a second opinion before agreeing to major dental work. Please go to another dentist !!! Avoid this one to save yourself unnecessary stress and cost! Always get a second opinion before agreeing to any major dental procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Weltner
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Swish staff made me feel so comfortable from start to finish. Your girl is scared of going to the dentist… so I really appreciated the education about my teeth and the warmth of the visit! Not to mention they are so organized with their services. 6 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Alvarado
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dont waste your money and time there! I was advised the need for a crown. Came there, paid $1.2K with insurance for it, asked them to show me the crack before shaving my toot and they move forward with it without showing me that it was actually something there!! Then, two weeks later and come here for the permanent crown,.. it was not even the color of my toot it was yellowish. And I complained with them and got a “free whitening session”total joke!!! Dont come here

user_reviews_extended.Name: Iryna C.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cassidy is my absolute favorite, no one likes going to the dentist but she makes it enjoyable! She is very patient knowledgeable and competent. Thank you swish for hiring the best of the best

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Loflin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Noor and Manny did a fabulous job fixing my front and center snaggletooth! It is absolutely picture perfect. The color matches beautifully and she polished it so smooth, it truly looks as if  the chipped tooth was never there. My only negative has nothing to do with the incredible work on my tooth.  There was a large bunch of dust accumulation spots on the ceiling by the heating and air conditioning vent that needs to be cleaned on a regular basis. It’s rather off putting to see when you’re laying down looking up at it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you’re considering Invisalign, avoid this location, or Swish Dental in general at all costs.

When I first started, everything went smoothly because the orthodontist was someone I knew, and she got things done. Unfortunately, after she left, the service went downhill fast. Since my case was already here, I felt stuck.

Aaron (I think is his name, not sure who I’ve spoken to at this point considering I’ve been calling the last 6 weeks asking where my trays are) and his team constantly give you the runaround whenever an issue comes up. They’ll put you on hold for long periods, avoid giving clear answers about what’s causing the problems or delays, and promise call-backs that never happen.

It’s extremely frustrating to pay thousands of dollars for treatment and deal with such poor customer service. At this point, I’m seriously considering paying extra just to transfer my Invisalign case to another orthodontist because the headaches and lack of professionalism here simply aren’t worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Mims
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you have severe TMJ issues and are looking for help, this is NOT the place to go (despite what their website says). A TMJ consult is $150 (which goes toward your treatment if you treat with them). Before the consult even started, they asked me about Botox. How do they know I’ll need it before even completing an exam? I appreciate that they told me what I’m already doing is the route to go (mouth guard, PT), but I don’t appreciate that I paid $150 for minimal examination (eg they didn’t even check my mouth guard to see if it was helping/hurting, just felt around on my jaw for a couple of minutes) and then a recommendation for Botox (which they charge a whopping $16/unit for). It feels like a huge waste my time and of $150, and I’m certainly not spending another $1K+ with them on Botox.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa del Rosario
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love getting my teeth cleaned and my dental hygienist is the best! I highly recommend Ashley Call! Even my boyfriend has made the switch to Swish to see Ashley.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sankalp Saoji
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hannah, my hygienist did a great job with teeth cleaning and fluoride application. Super knowledgeable and fun to work with. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vica Andries
user_reviews_extended.Description: Natalie was very attentive and provided a great service. I really enjoyed my visit. It felt more like a spa than a dental appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Wu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Recently moved to Austin and was really excited to go to Swish. Unfortunately did not have a good experience. I would strongly recommend to read my review so you aren't caught off guard like I was. More details below.

Pros: Friendly staff, clean, and played great music

Cons:
- I was contacted a few days before to change my appointment and then contacted the day before to change my appointment once again.

- When I got there I had to wait 20 minutes after my appointment started to be seated.  My appointment also ended up going over 30 minutes.

- I confirmed multiple times with the admin team that I was getting a cleaning and initial exam but when I was there, they did not have me scheduled for a cleaning. They had to ask one of the dentists to step in and do the cleaning. Unfortunately she had another patient and stopped midway through to tend to the other patient before coming back to finish the cleaning.

- At the end I was charged for fluoride toothpaste and I wasn't made aware that there was going to be this charge.

- When I was there they told me I needed to get a filling. I felt pressured into making an appointment and since leaving I have tried to contact them multiple times to cancel the appointment and have not heard back.

Clearly this wasn't the experience of everyone who has gone to Swish and I hope they are able to ensure no one has the same experience that I had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Lang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Pretty disappointing experience overall, and I would caution any new patients. My first visit (over a year ago) raised red flags: despite consistent clean bills of health from my previous dentist, this office found three “cavities”. The dentist said they were superficial enough that no numbing was needed, yet the cut my gum so badly with dental tape that I had to leave with gauze in my mouth. The total bill was about $450 after insurance, and I left questioning whether I ever had cavities at all.

Fast forward to today’s routine cleaning. I arrived early to accommodate their schedule change request, only to be told by a dental hygienist that since I declined X-rays, they could not perform a cleaning or continue the appointment. No one had mentioned this policy in advance — despite the fact I had already made clear during my initial visit that I did not want additional X-rays after my first intake.

This office invests heavily in creating a polished, high-tech atmosphere, but the quality of care and basic courtesy are severely lacking. Over two weeks, I received multiple reminder texts including this line: “At Swish, we respect your time and ask the same in return.” The irony is hard to miss, considering how much of my time and money they wasted.

If mandatory X-rays are truly required just to get a cleaning, that should be disclosed upfront — not sprung on patients after they’ve rearranged their schedule and shown up for the appointment. At the end of the day, you’re paying for a showroom-style office, not genuine, patient-focused dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Kunzel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish dental was very busy the day that I was there. But my appointment was on time and they were attentive and provided excellent care would highly recommended them

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I needed some emergency dental work and they got the job done. I personally would have preferred a more professional healthcare setting. When you walk in, the music is way too loud and thumping, plus there is a very overwhelming room fragrance in the waiting area. I have asthma and immediately had a reaction. The staff were friendly enough but some were on their phones laughing and dancing. I questioned one of the items on my bill that said “zirconia upgrade” for my crown, and no one could tell me why it was being billed as an upgrade for an additional amount. I was there for over three hours and was exhausted so just decided to let it go.  I work in healthcare and this is not professional. If you want a fun hip place to get your dental work done then this is a great place for you! I’m just not a fan.
******I’m lowering this to two stars now since the office manager called me and bribed me with free teeth whitening if I give them five stars and take my negative review off!  That is unethical!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Rosenberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: The hygienist was wonderful.  I don’t appreciate the music. And now all of the sudden my teeth need $5k in fixing?

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valeria Ruiz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
l Hello Swish Downtown,
I just wanted to take a moment to sincerely thank you all. From day one, you have welcomed me so warmly—I truly feel like family every time I see you. Your smiles are so genuine, and the kindness with which you treat your patients is truly wonderful.

Today, I came in to begin my treatment and received exceptional help from Brandon—his support was outstanding. I also had the pleasure of meeting a wonderful woman named Marnyce. Her approach to assisting and providing excellent service at the office is remarkable.

More places should be like this—especially when it comes to visiting the dentist. Being here doesn’t feel like a typical dental visit; it feels safe, comfortable, and genuinely pleasant. The dentists are incredibly professional, and the entire staff is amazing.

Thank you all so much—I’ll see you again very soon, and next time, we’ll take a photo together!

Love you guys!
Val Ruiz

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Whiteman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I felt seen. This is a wonderful crew of hard working people that enjoy what they do and it shows. Can’t wait to kick it with them again in 6 months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lissa Regets
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish downtown is the best. Dr. Noor is always very thoughtful, kind and thorough. They also use the latest tech and I know they’ll catch something early. I had Ashley today for my cleaning and she was great - super helpful and thorough. Honestly everyone I meet at this office is really nice. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy Rosner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I unexpectedly needed a reliable and skilled dental office, and it was past noon on a Friday. Being near my work and the few open past one, I called Swish Dental, and the fantastic front desk staff had me scheduled the same day. The check-in process wasn't overly complicated. When they called me back, they made me feel comfortable and informed about everything. This was my first experience needing dental work, and they made my comfort and concerns their top priority. Check-out was fast and personable, and overall, I am so happy to have found this location by chance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larry Covert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Superb experience. Dr Noor, Shannon, and Natalie each and all care very much… it shows in everything they do… and how they do it! Highly recommend getting your pearly whites taken care of by this incredible team. Great vibes too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jayden Jira
user_reviews_extended.Description: I usually have a lot of anxiety around going to the dentist and have had some bad experiences in the past, but this visit was completely different—in the best way. The whole team made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in. They were kind, patient, and explained everything clearly as we went, which helped ease my nerves. I really appreciated how transparent they were about what they were doing and why. It was honestly the most relaxed I’ve ever felt at the dentist. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Levi Avalos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at Swish Dental – Downtown location. The entire visit went smoothly, and everyone on the team was incredibly kind, professional, and helpful. They made me feel comfortable throughout the process and took the time to explain everything clearly. I really appreciate the welcoming atmosphere and excellent care. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Craveiro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist and staff I’ve ever experienced! Very good work, kind, efficient. I love them! They actually make dentist appointments enjoyable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Legalo Sualoa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great experience! Both locations super clean, staff is friendly, and they really take their time to make sure you’re comfortable. I went in for an extraction at the Domain location but they sent me at this location. Dr Nora and her assistant explained everything clearly. You can tell they care about their patients. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc Nathan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Noor and assistant Leslie made a fairly unpleasant tooth extraction quite tolerable. I would definitely recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheri
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough great things about this dental office. I had a bad experience at the last 2 dental office’s I have tried since switching providers, so needless to say I went into my appointment expecting the worst and hoping for the best. Swish Dental completely exceeded my expectations and then some. I was taken to Cassidy after my new patient images, she was the nicest, sweetest, most bubbly, comforting, and knowledgeable dental hygienist I have ever had in my life. I truly felt like I was hanging out with one of my friends. THANK YOU Cassidy and Swish Dental for turning around my whole dental experience, I will be referring my entire office here moving forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Galexander Mata
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit to this dental office was awesome! The place is super modern and fresh, which made everything feel really cool. Justine, the hygienist, was so friendly and made the cleaning easy. Brandon took care of me at the end and made sure I left happy. Plus, Marnise, the office manager, was super interactive and helpful. Definitely recommend this place if you want a comfy and cool dental experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leigh Wyttenbach
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve had nothing but great experiences at Swish Downtown! Everyone is kind and attentive. I appreciate how the team takes the time to discuss my goals, explain treatment options, and align on a plan.
Natalie is an absolute gem and has done a great job with my cleanings. Dr. Noor is skilled, knowledgeable, and so caring — I really trust her. The clinic manager is also awesome, sitting with me to review cost estimates and making sure I’m comfortable with each treatment before proceeding.
Thank you, Swish Downtown Team! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Zubricki
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently started Invisalign through Swish and visited for a routine appointment. I had a few questions about insurance claims, and the team was incredibly helpful. Leslie & Marnyce sat down with me and walked through everything in detail, making sure I understood the process. Every time I’ve been in, the entire staff has been so kind, friendly, and caring with every question I’ve asked. They really make you feel listened to. From start to finish, they’ve made my Invisalign journey smooth and stress-free.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Valverde
user_reviews_extended.Description: This has been the absolute best dentist experience I’ve ever had in my entire life. Seriously I used to dread the dentist office but this place has changed my perspective on what dentistry and the patient experience should actually be.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raquel Valdez Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish has been the best dentist I have gone to.  They have open availability that works for my busy schedule.  Their dentist and hygienist make coming in a comfortable experience.  The customer service is always on point from the calls, texts, and way they interact at the appointment. Can I also mention the financing available is so easy. I can’t speaker any higher of Swish and appreciate their ability to make going to the dentist so easy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki Wadley
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here is so friendly and professional and they have every kind of technology possible to make your visit efficient and comfortable.  I will be a client for as long as I am in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Blinka
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very thorough, very professional, I’m 56 years old, best dentist experience ever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ally Gellatly
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit at Swish was far better any dentist appt. should honestly should be. Ashley and Dr. Rofaeil were so personable, friendly and professional!  Then there was a cancellation and Cassidy came by to let me know she could fit me in sooner for the second half of my initial eval. My experience with Cassidy was wonderful! I’ve absolutely never have felt so comfortable at a dentist appt…(which are typically my least fav type of appts). So thankful I tried Swish Dental Downtown!!! Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandria Zozos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an amazing experience at Swish dental downtown! Natalie was fantastic—thorough, professional, and made the entire appointment effortless. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie McWilliams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish dental is the best, especially the one downtown. You can park in the parking garage and they validate your parking for free. I saw Dr. Bekah and she was amazing, took care of all my concerns and needs. I was able to make a same day appointment and come back to take care of a few fillings, which was amazing. The dental assistant made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire process. I am always happier and leaving with a better smile after my Swish appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Prokesch
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can’t say enough good things about Swish Dental Downtown! From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming. The office is modern, spotless, and has a great vibe—plus, having Netflix to watch during appointments is a nice touch.

The team is professional, thorough, and genuinely cares about their patients. I did Invisalign with them, and the results are amazing—my teeth look better than I ever imagined. The entire process was smooth, and they made sure I was comfortable every step of the way.

If you’re looking for a great dentist who’s skilled, kind, and makes dental visits a breeze, I highly recommend Swish Dental Downtown. Love these people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Lipman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was very impressed with my first visit!  Super friendly staff, right on time, and the equipment looked to be state of the art.  I felt very comfortable at the downtown office.

The follow up visit went smoothly and while it wasn’t inexpensive I thought it was a good value for the extensive work I had done (2 implants and three crowns).

I've now finished with the implant and crown procedures, and I have to say I'm very happy with the final result.   I'd been to multiple "one dentist" offices over the past 10 years, and because of retirements and in one case an untimely passing away, I've been to four different dentists, and of course all of them had intake fees and innumerable X-Rays.   By choosing Swish, I trust there will be extended continuity - even between offices.

Kudos to Dr. Rebekah Salinas, who undertook my restorations.  She is now on maternity leave, but I felt completely comfortable in the office.  Everyone with whom I interacted was professional and friendly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shanetra Fowler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m definitely a big baby when it comes to pain and anything dental!
The Doc and team were amazingly patient and put forth great effort to keep me relaxed throughout the procedure. Highly recommend if you’re anything like me 🤣
I’m also grateful for the office manager we both share a love for tiny designer handbags. Please forgive me for not remembering names 💕

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jodie Stautner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is always SO friendly every time I come in! Justine was my hygienist today, and she not only took the time to kindly answer all of my questions and give detailed explanations that really helped, but she was also so thoughtful and careful when it came to the sensitive teeth I have. Such a great group of people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eliza Pooler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Extremely disappointing experience. I mistakenly enrolled in their coverage last year and quickly regretted it. The pricing is unreasonable—they overcharge for everything. I had several fillings done, and within a short time, cavities developed inside those fillings. Clearly, the work was not done properly. When I asked to have them fixed, they agreed—but only if I paid $250 just for the dentist to look at them.

I’ve since moved and have a new dentist. I’ve already paid for an exam and X-rays, and the new office confirmed that the fillings in question are the same ones done last year. Even with clear X-ray evidence, this place is completely disorganized and no one can give a consistent answer. If you’re looking for quality care or professional service, I strongly advise going elsewhere. The customer service is awful, and the manager was shockingly rude and unhelpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edwing Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nicole was so kind and did an amazing job! The team did great work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely felt at peace when a gentleman working at the back helped me understand my insurance. And especially him being a fluent Spanish speaker! Made it feel just like home. Great community, great service, 100/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan McDonald
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to swish for a little over 3 years. They’re my preferred dentist no matter what area of Austin I’ve lived in. Their staff is very friendly and accommodating. Shannon did my images today and it was such a breeze I was in and out in maybe 20 minutes. Dr. Rebekah is also my fav. She’s very nice and patient to work with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Wooten
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter and I have been to two Swish locations in Austin (because of our scheduling needs) and both are awesome! The staff are all welcoming, happy, make us feel comfortable, and are upfront about costs and treatment plans. They are a busy, but bright, smiling and positive environment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katrina Scheihing
user_reviews_extended.Description: They actually took the time to read my intake forms which made for a great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hennesty N
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely pleased with the way my appointment went. I was terrified to go to the dentist but I needed to get some thing’s checked. From the moment I walked in (even before hand bc I couldn’t find the entrance ) everyone was so kind and pleasant. They made me feel comfortable and explained everything to me without any hesitation. I can’t say enough good things about the entire staff, they genuinely care and it showed. Huge thank you again

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Poehling
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn’t been to the dentist in almost three years - so naturally wasn’t too excited to go in. I chose Swish because it was super easy to book online and was conveniently located to wear I live. Everything about the experience was great. Every staff member I spoke to was really nice, thorough, communicative and really helpful. It’s a classic updated type of studio so there are screens to watch TV and all of those nice perks. I also love that they come and tell you the pricing of everything before you do it versus after you’re already done, I had never had that before. I was going to do everything I needed anyways, but it’s nice to have that price transparency. Overall will be back and recommend to anyone else in the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sahr John
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place with futuristic equipments; I mean 3D scans etc. the staff are very welcoming and the overall atmosphere was very soothing. Definitely my new dental care clinic

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit yesterday was smooth and pleasant from start to finish. The front desk check-in process was efficient, and they thoroughly explained my insurance benefits, letting me know my copay upfront, which I really appreciated. Tyler, the treatment coordinator, was very kind and confirmed that my visit would be completely covered based on my diagnosis. I can’t express enough gratitude to Nicole, the hygienist. She was incredibly informative about my gum health and, despite my less-than-perfect flossing habits, she was gentle and very helpful with post-care instructions. The cleaning itself was comfortable and pain-free. I would definitely recommend Swish to my friends and colleagues. Thank you, Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsey Jacobs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been going to Swish downtown for years and have always had a pleasant experience. Cassidy the dental tech is so sweet and makes the cleanings feel like a breeze. She answers questions and doesn’t make you feel silly for asking. Jessica is also helpful when it comes to questions about teeth whitening or Invisalign and payment options that are available.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andres Castillo-Lares
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highway recommend going to Swish dental! Super effective and easy going people. Natalie was my dentist and definitely recommend ! Looking forward to my next appointment

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peter Hession
user_reviews_extended.Description:
There are so many things to love about Swish Dental.

Location -  smack dab downtown with free validated parking!  It's a very modern building that is always impeccably clean. The security staff are kind and there is always ample parking, even if you have to go up a few floors. I live close by, so it makes it super easy.

Staff - Dr. Noor always brightens my day (and smile).  From the front desk staff and admin to the dental hygienists and dentists, everyone is professional and compassionate. I know many people that get scared of going to the dentists (I did as a kid), and they go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and at home.

Office - Sleek, modern, inviting. It smells amazing and there are TVs at each treatment booth.  The waiting area is also comfy.

Technology - Modern scanners, state-of-the-art equipment, easy communications with text reminders so I don't forget I have an appointment

Service and Care - My teeth feel so healthy! At the end of the day, this probably matters the most.  I make sure to come twice a year for cleanings and even when I have fillings, whitenings, or extra work required, I've been super satisfied with the results. Well done!

I highly recommend Swish to anyone the ATX metro area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: We had the amazing Dr. Parth Patel for my daughter’s tooth extraction. He got her in and out quickly and it was amazing! Alyssa was his assistant and she was so quick and efficient. The office manager was Marnyce and she was AMAZING. This is the best dentist office I’ve ever been to. I love it, genuinely.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelley Waltrip
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an emergency (from an accident) while spending a few days in Austin and was able to get right in the next day for evaluation & treatment.  They were all EXCELLENT & I also found the prices extremely reasonable.  No up charge for emergency & I was able to stay infection free etc till I returned hm for my dentist to do the work needed to repair the tooth & gums.  THANk YOU so
Much for your care & attention to detail.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Doss
user_reviews_extended.Description: Simply amazing. Humans are not supposed to enjoy the dentist. I did. Had a blast watching shows with the crew.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Bulla
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Noor Makda is amazing!!! Very patient, thorough, and I felt very taken care of. Rest of the staff was very knowledgeable and informative in each of the process for my X-rays and cleaning. Jessica the front desk staff helped me with verifying insurance and payments. Overall great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camie Fillpot
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had some terrible experiences at dentist’s offices and was really nervous to go in for treatment for a broken tooth. Staff was wonderful and made me feel at ease. They also gave me a prioritized list of dental procedures, with prices, so I could make an informed decision for my dental plan. The transparency definitely decreases the stress and makes me comfortable in going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leo Brunnick
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First time in my life I have taken the time to give social media feedback about a dentist’s office … so you know it must be good!

I’ve been going to Swish in downtown Austin for the past 2 years, and it is awesome.  Actually makes going to the dentist a pleasurable experience!

Dr. Bekah is amazing, and does amazing work.  And a shout out to Marnyce for making even the payment side of it not hurt!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suresh Venkataswamy
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Swish downtown was fantastic. Both Doc Natelie and Dr.Brendan( both fun and friendly) took care of me in a very sophisticated facility with all latest gadgets from taking X-Rays to all dental cleaning procedures. Would highly recommend Swish Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: dylan dupras
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was my first time going. They were so nice and quick deaf will be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Talbot
user_reviews_extended.Description: Natalie at Swish Dental is the best! During my cleaning, she was so kind, helpful, encouraging and a great listener. It was honestly one of the most fun dental cleanings  I’ve ever had. We jammed out to Swish’s playlist, which was an incredible playlist of female power singers and just chatted about life! Not only were my teeth getting cleaned but it felt like a fun girls’ hang out. I can’t recommend Natalie enough - thank you Natalie for such a great experience and clean teeth! 😊🦷🪥

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellen Boucher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've always had a great experience at Swish and have gone to many of the locations due to convenience and proximity to my home or work. Earlier this year I had to get a few small fillings done and Dr. Noor Makda was incredible at explaining what she was doing before, during, and after the procedure.

More recently I have been going to Swish Downtown for my Invisalign treatment and Marnyce has and continues to provide a joy and great energy to the team.

I've been most impressed with my Invisalign technician, Alyssa. Alyssa is a great listener and as a result, she's truly unmatched when it comes to understanding what her patients need to feel comfortable and educated. Alyssa is very skilled at narrating what she's doing and what to expect, which makes the experience a lot easier and as stress free as possible. On top of it all, you can tell right away how kind and accommodating Alyssa is to her patients.

In a world where it's easy to simply get people in and out of the door, Dr. Noor, Marnyce, and Alyssa at this Swish are really committed to giving you their time to ensure you have everything you need for the best treatment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vimi Taneja
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Nice meeting with the doctor. The team was very quick and responsive. I appreciate their listening to my concerns and quick diagnose.  They are very very expensive dentists. Moreover, they keep on increasing their prices even after 8 months of treatment. They showed me $1800 as the cost of 2 crowns initially which they increased to $4000 after 8 months. When I told them about insurance discounts, they increased the price to $4800. Price of one porcelain crown -$1600. Who changes their price after 8 months of treatment? I would recommend any other dentist in Austin but not at all this one or any other swish location. Moreover the crown came off after 8 months.Cost of 2 crowns till now- $3300 out of pocket for just the dentist!!!! Very unethical billing. They want to get money out of the patient in one or the other way. There is no end to their billing.
When the crown came off for the second time, the doctor fixed it for free and also replaced it with new crown for free since the old one didn’t fit. Overall, they rectified their mistake.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ec915
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole staff was very friendly and professional. They were able to see me the same day for an emergency tooth extraction that went very smoothly. They provided me with a very detailed care plan to fix other issues they discovered during the new patient exam. The cost summary was very well laid and easy to understand what the insurance covered and what my out of pocket would be. I was very satisfied with their service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caroline T.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Larissa, Dr. Martina Rafael and my dental hygienist (from Wisconsin name starts with C) were ALL FABULOUS. I don't think it is normal to love your dental team but I love my dental team and am very grateful and thankful for their kindness, humor, and skill. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wish I would have listened to reviews I saw on here. Run - as fast as you can from this place. Everything said is true - unnecessary or incorrectly done dental work, charging you for nothing, they sent me to the wrong appointment 50 mins away and sent the wrong client file to their sister location….refused to cancel my appointments and then tried to charge me for it. They’ve refused to reimburse me for anything, and seem to have no idea what is going on. I had to threaten them with legal action after a week straight of being ignored via email and phone just to get my client data. All they sent me was the x rays - I requested my entire file (they ran an insane amount of tests I never asked for) but are refusing to release anything else except the ray’s, after I asked twice. So I paid for tests and information that I now can’t even access…
These people are nice in person but will screw you over and then ignore you. go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pedro Ortega
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never had a bad experience at Swish. The staff are always incredibly kind and communicative and the service is fast straightforward. Shout out to Natelie for making sure my experience was a great one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Olivares
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had fillings done at Swish Dental Downtown on July 1, 2025 with Dr. Parth Patel. Within days, I had pain, gum inflammation, and couldn’t floss properly. I got a second opinion on July 9 from another Delta Dental provider, who found:
•	Tooth #20: Overcontoured restoration with ledge
•	Tooth #29: Undercontoured restoration with open composite
•	Tooth #30: Broken restoration with open margin and excess material

They confirmed these fillings were defective and needed to be replaced. Only 1 of the 4 teeth Swish treated actually needed a filling; the others should have been monitored.

I emailed Swish requesting a refund, provided the findings, and they replied once saying it would be “reviewed” — but never followed up despite multiple emails. I paid out-of-pocket to fix the work elsewhere.

Be aware of overtreatment and poor accountability.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carla Burger
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was advised to replace my fillings. The entire back of 2 teeth are now cracked and missing. I would not recommend coming here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Beaudoin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a wonderful experience at this location! Dr. Bekah and Manny were amazing, answered all of my questions, and had me feeling cared for. The office manager Marnyce was absolutely phenomenal and made the experience so special and Brandon the checkout was so perfect! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A H
user_reviews_extended.Description: I scheduled for a teeth cleaning at Swish a few weeks ago. They contacted and told me they only had an hour for my appointment so they could only do my X-rays/exams and my cleaning would take a whole other hour, since I was a new patient. Okay, sounds fine, I just went for my exams. They took X-rays, etc for an hour. The doctor comes in and tells me I have two cavities, gingivitis, and need six fillings for $400. They can do the fillings right now, but not the cleaning. I had never had a cavity before, and 6 months ago did not even have any teeth to "watch" for cavities. I felt weird and left. Went back to my other dentist (who was out of network), and sent them the X-rays. The X-rays taken by Swish were so grainy, my other dentist had to take new scans. Then after a cleaning and comprehensive look at everything, they confirmed I had zero cavities and my "gingivitis" was nothing a basic cleaning could not fix. Glad I listened to my intuition and got a second opinion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Faleasha Lynn Triunfo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went for an emergency tooth extraction— I felt so taken care of. Even during my follow-up to get my stitches removed, Dr. Nor and Shannon were so kind and accommodating to me. I wish I had gotten the name of the lady that helped with my extraction— she was fantastic as well. These are the kinds of folks who should work in this field!! Thank you so, so much for everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucas Barnes
user_reviews_extended.Description: New to Austin and was searching for a dentist. I saw good review after good review about Swish dental and decided to go here. The office is super clean, the staff is friendly, and the experience was stellar. Every room has a smart tv and the hygienist will put on a show or movie of your choice to make you feel more comfortable. I left with a clean smile and no unanswered questions. I appreciate the team at Swish downtown, their attention to detail, and dedication to their work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Pickering
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Rafaeil and Shannon were so patient and calming throughout a long appointment—they were aware of my anxiety and never once made me feel anything but comfortable and understood. I can’t thank them enough. I have always been anxious/fearful of dental appointments but I feel very confident here and will continue with this dental team for all future appointments. Thank you!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Manalich
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience at Swish! A good enough experience where I thought it was worth writing a review about. Everyone was very nice and informative, especially Cassidy. The equipment was super modern and their processes were super efficient. Would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: monica dominguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly atmosphere’  The girls were all nice and made me feel comfortable.  Thank you all🤗

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Carns
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never trusted a dentist more than I trust everyone at the Swish office I go to. They are so caring, calm, and informative. I am so happy with everything I have gotten done there so far-which has included invisalign, crowns, and a bridge for my Hypodontia (missing my lateral incisors)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marie Lara
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a person who hasn’t been to the dentist in years and is not comfortable with going to the dentist, when I first entered swish Ally welcomed me with kindness and made me feel so comfortable getting back on track with my gum health. She was very thorough throughout my new patient appointment and explained everything to me. She was very knowledgeable and answered all my questions and made me feel like I was going to be taken good care of, thank y’all so much I will definitely be coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Dominguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is very nice and makes you feel comfortable 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Holder
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great clinic! I've gone for my first cleaning and will be continuing extensive treatment in the future :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cathy Staerk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cassidy is literally the best dental hygienist I have ever had. She makes you feel incredibly comfortable and at ease with the process and managing your oral health. 10/10 good vibes!! Can’t wait to see her again in September

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaime Chaire
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been 2 times now to swish dental for dental cleaning and let me say… Justine is super nice if you ever go do yourself a favor and ask for Justine. She is super gentle and nice! 10/10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Chen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place! Dr. Marina, Marie, and my hygienist Justine took really great care of me with lots of work this year, including deep cleaning, tooth extraction, and now Invisalign. All the latest dental tech! 5th and Colorado location is where you’ll find them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan Crelinsten
user_reviews_extended.Description: To anyone new or native to Austin, I strongly recommend you make this your go-to dental clinic. I had the absolute best experience with Cassidy; the X-rays, cleaning, dental advice and overall professionalism / expertise in that business is second to none. Go check them out, I recommend asking for Dr. Noor!

user_reviews_extended.Name: joannacan2
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you’re looking for the BEST place to get dental work done, look no further!! Swish dental is the prime example of professional, empathetic, patient, and knowledgeable, on top of being extremely welcoming with its friendly staff and clean environment. I really appreciated Dr. Noor and the staffs attention to detail, by carefully addressing every concern that I had. Being that I have had terrible dental experiences in the past, they made sure to provide me with the constant reassurance I needed to keep my nerves and anxiety grounded.
THANK YOU SWISH DENTAL FOR BEING SO AMAZING!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zach Cox
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service. Very transparent. Super easy. Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabel Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really nice front desk Roberto is amazing and thorough team Ashley is a great dental technician and my mouth feels so much better. I have worked with a few different dentists there and they have all been fantastic. Definitely will be back for the rest of my dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nicole was incredible! Not only did she make sure my teeth were as healthy and clean as they could be, she also made extra sure I was comfortable during the cleanings and well educated on every step of the process. Not to mention the entire staff being incredibly kind and respectful of my schedule. Shout-out to both Tyler and Nicole for making this experience the best it could be.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carey Rouse
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was very nice.  I didn't free pressured to get more work done than what was necessary.  They were extremely efficient.  And my god...talk about high tech.  This was the first dentist I've been too using some of the tech.  And I love new tech.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Luckow
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m from out of town and cracked my implant and was very distraught! They were so understanding and got me in right away and resolved the issue ! I am truly grateful for their service and I highly recommend them for any issues that arise! Dr. Loehr and his assistant Amanda were both very supportive and helpful to me! I’m so thankful for their help with my 🦷!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chloe Ellis
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place far exceeded my expectations. I walked out of here with dental work and therapy🥹 The team here was not only knowledgeable, and quick; but they made this whole process SEAMLESS. Not to mention, the compassion, patience, and empathy they showed my daughter and I in our ‘hot mess’ is immeasurable. Will always recommend the Swish downtown team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jed Needle
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole team was helpful, knowledgeable and most of all, caring. Visiting from out of town, some temporary dental work failed, and I was too uncomfortable to wait until I returned home. Swish fit me in and took care of the issue. They treated me like a long-standing patient even though I was just passing through. Aside: office playlist is🔥

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Hanson
user_reviews_extended.Description: BEWARE of backward cancellation policy. Moved my appointment time on me without confirming and then canceled day of because of an ‘event’ in the office. Recommended unnecessary expensive procedures, prioritizing profits over patients. If the desk staff’s dental status is any indication of expertise I would stay far far away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ruben Ortega
user_reviews_extended.Description:
How I almost was mislead into more dental work.....As a new patient, I gave this place a try (yes, I am a sucker for great marketing and modern offices), and was perplexed by a few things.
First, for new patients, there are two separate appointments, 1 hour for the X-rays and then another hour for the cleaning (booked a couple weeks apart). I thought this was very unusual, but I went against my gut feeling and trusted the process.

Second, during my first appointment, my hygienist was taking longer than usual to do x-rays and kept fidgeting with the machine. I had a sense he was new, so I asked him, "oh what dentist office did you last work at? / you must love it here because the office is beautiful"... he responded with "oh, this is my first job, I started a couple weeks ago". I'm not saying a new joiner is bad thing, but he did need coaching and eventually after 10 minutes, he went to grab someone to help him with the machine.
Third, after all my x-rays were done, I was told I have 1 cavity that needs immediate attention, and 1 crown to be replaced. I was surprised given I haven't had cavities in many years and I go to the dentist twice a year. With my insurance, I was looking at over $1K in dental work. I was shocked, and felts something was wrong. But this time I listened to my gut.

Takeaway: I got a second opinion. Two weeks later, I go to a different dentist group and it was like night and day. I have zero cavities, and don't need a new crown.  As a new patient at this other dentist office, I was able to get my x-rays and cleaning done in 1 hour! I think it would be harsh to say Swish Dental is a "scam" because everyone's situation is different.....but in my case, it certainly felt like I was severely mislead. Not being able to trust your local dentist is not a world I want to live in.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyndall Brooke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really wanted to be impressed, but the experience was not good. My cleaning was fine, but the follow-up work was a mess. They clearly did not manage the calendar well that morning and my dentist was in a massive rush, coming in and out of the room, leaving things in my mouth as she rushed out to check out other patients. The work was so rushed that when I mentioned my bite still felt a little off, I was met with a massive sigh and "ok we will look at it again" (it was still off and had to be adjusted). Also, my teeth still felt gritty and unpolished, and I was having bits of filling come from between my teeth throughout the day. After the visit, I got my explanation of benefits from my insurance which showed I was overcharged and good lord it has taken constant work to get them to agree. I have had to call multiple times to be told I will be called "right back" then when they finally did admit to an overcharge, it was added as a credit "to my account" vs. back to my card without notifying me that this would be done. Very frustrating experience overall.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Akshara Ramasamy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ashley and Dr. Rofaeil were absolutely wonderful during my procedure! I was feeling really faint after the process, but they supported throughout it all. They’re both an asset to the practice, and I’m really thankful for them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: alyssa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had the pleasure of visiting  Swish dental, and I must say, it was an outstanding experience. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by a friendly and professional staff who made me feel welcome and comfortable. Dr. Noor is incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to explain every step of my treatment, which really put me at ease. The office is modern, clean, and equipped with state-of-the-art technology. I highly recommend Swish

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andre Ferrari
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is so caring and kind! Definitely makes all the difference in the world for any dentist visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had originally gone to another local dentist with an emergency situation. Those visits didn’t go well and I was still dealing with a lot of pain and some pretty pressing issues that couldn’t be ignored.
I scheduled an emergency appointment with this Swish office and they got me in the same day. This was not a simple appointment, and they took their time to explain every single step of the process with me. Dr Salinas and George were so kind and patient even though I was in a LOT of pain and the visit took multiple hours. They were not going to let me walk out of there without taking care of everything they could, though. Everyone, from the office manager Joseph, to other staff who stepped in to assist, were all so helpful and caring. The follow up from the practice has been fantastic as well. No one wants to get dental work done, especially not in a crisis type situation, but I am grateful for the care and support I received there to get my dental issues worked out. Thanks so much to the entire team there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Staton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish is the most efficient and personable dentistry I’ve ever used. The staff are always so welcoming and I feel very confident in the dental care I’m receiving there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Paris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience with Swish today was exceptional.
I developed a very unexpected dental abscess yesterday and called my dentist of four years and was told it would be almost two weeks before I could be seen. Swish offered me multiple same day visit options and I chose the downtown option.
I was in an out in about an hour with the likely outcomes and  treatment plan, a prescription for antibiotics, and a plan to see a specialist that could address my specific need - I received a text message to schedule that visit before I got to my car! Dr Noor was super approachable and not rushed. Yvette and the rest of the staff were friendly, clearly very good at their jobs, and good at relieving the stress of last minute dental care.
There was never a point at which was wondering what was going to happen next. That is rare in healthcare.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Simon Wainwright
user_reviews_extended.Description: Like most people i am not a fan of going to the dentist.  However, the Swish downtown and Dr. Noor could not be better.  Everything is very professional and efficient.  And i appreciate that they tell you exactly what they recommend and why and what options there are.  The location is also great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DJ Diaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire Swish staff was friendly, knowledgeable, and conscious of my time.  My appointment started on time, and I felt fully heard and taken care of.  Thanks, team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shaan Jani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here was amazing! I tend to ask a lot of questions, and they were very patient with me. I felt like everyone was more than willing to explain why they were doing what they were doing, and I got all the necessary care I required. Shout out to Manny and Dr. Becka!

user_reviews_extended.Name: dusty braswell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Justine was great! Very professional and informative. Walk through every step. First time I’ve ever, that I can think of, wanted to fall asleep in a dental chair! Thanks Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joy Lin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the new patient exam and regular dental cleaning today. The clinic and equipment are great. The staffs there are very nice and friendly, would explain every step before they start doing the check or scanning the teeth etc. The hygiene check is very helpful. It is appreciated that the lady proactively asked me if I want to do the fluoride treatments which is not usually covered in the insurance rather than do it directly without asking me. After I was done with the dental cleaning, they already reached my insurance company and summarized the pricing of some treatments mentioned during the hygiene check for me. This is really efficient and helpful service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kirea Mazzolini
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff! Comprehensive initial appointment. Very happy with the service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: allison ross
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m a new patient at Swish and recommend all others to stay away. I’m an NYC transplant that thought this was the Tend equivalent. It is not.

On my first visit (which took almost 3 hours for X-rays and cleaning) they told me I needed 5 crowns. Um, yeah, no.

Today I went in for a cosmetic front tooth repair and it took 2 hours. They maybe worked in my mouth for 30 minutes. Said my tooth needed to be cleaned before the procedure, that did not happen. And, now done, it doesn’t look great. They built up the opposite side of the tooth I was hoping to repair. They then said they would keep working on it if I wanted them to, but I knew I just needed to get out of there.

At the end of the appointment they asked if we could schedule my most pressing crown, and I declined. Also to note, ahead of my appointment (over the phone) they tried to upsell a teeth whitening, which I declined, and today during my appointment they did the repair using the brightest composite available so it would match my teeth.

Looking for a new dentist now. What scam of a place. Stay away. Apologies to everyone who works there as they are all very kind and polite, but there’s a HUGE flaw in this practice. Feels like a used car dealership. ✌️
