user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Hoelscher
user_reviews_extended.Description: I usually go to the South 1st location, but had to take the first open spot I could find, which so happened to be at the Downtown location. I was a little nervous about going to a different location, but the Swish team made everything seamless and easy! They gave me great, clear parking instructions and only had me wait for 3min in the lobby before getting seen by a dentist. By the way, Dr. John was wonderful! He did a great overall check on my teeth, gave wonderful and approachable recommendations on how to better them, and sat patiently with me while I asked questions. Swish does a great job at upholding every location to an exceptionally high standard and each team delivers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roel Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: I returned back to this Dental office for a follow up visit and routine cleaning and was impressed yet again. I was greeted kindly and taken to the chair within minutes of arrival. All staff and dentist were professional and educational. I was in and out within the hour and I also was compensated with free parking near the building. Overall another great experience! A+

user_reviews_extended.Name: aletse rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love coming to get my check ups. I have closer swish offices by my house but still decide to come to this location. From Dr. Noor to Justine my hygienist and the front desk people everyone is simply amazing.
I look forward to my cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Klar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Natelie always makes my experience fun when it comes to my teeth cleaning. She is fast and meticulous with her work. When I’m done I am always wanting to go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edna Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Noor was very professional and took the time to explain all the procedures clearly. I felt at ease throughout my appointment, and the dental hygienist did a fantastic job with my cleaning. They were gentle yet thorough, and I left feeling like my teeth were sparkling clean.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lamar Humphreys
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience they took great care of me will highly recommend to family and friends. I appreciate the time they took to explain everything to me. Dr. Noor and Ashley are the best. I wont go anywhere else. Thank you for the great experience in taking great care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Shady Shady Shady.

I went in for a routine cleaning, granted it has been a while since I did so. I was told that I had some gingivitis and they would have to "go a bit deeper" to clean everything up. They sent in their sales person to speak with me about the treatment plans. My original cleaning was supposed to be completely covered by insurance and because I needed "extra cleaning" they told me that not only would the different cleaning not be covered by my insurance (which is truthful), they also told me that because gingivitis was identified that ***my insurance would not cover a regular cleaning*** (100% lie).

My BS Meter was going off so I called my insurance who told me that what they were saying is a lie. First of all, do not let them use this line on you. It is a lie and a deceptive business practice.

If anyone has had a similar experience, I recommend you take the following steps as I am going to:

File a complaint to:

Your state dental board
Your state insurance department
The American Dental Association (ADA)
Your insurance provider

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paula Mariano
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I really enjoyed how modern the office is! Not only in aesthetics but also in operations — I appreciate being able to correspond with the team through text (no more avoiding calls wondering “who’s number is this?” Plus, I can reply asynchronously).

The staff is also super friendly and informative. They gave me a thorough review and even showed me a pressure map of my teeth.

Highly recommend!! 😊

2024 Update: I’ve been seeing Nicole at Swish Downtown for years now, and she always makes me feel comfortable. She’s super sweet, and very thorough in her work. 5 ⭐️ rating remains strong!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bradlay Pryde
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I typically don’t leave 1 star reviews, but this feels like an important public notice…At the end of the day dentists are doctors. You visit them hoping to find someone you can trust in a time of need and poor health. This establishment takes advantage of that vulnerability for an unreasonable financial gain. I went here with toothache and like others in the reviews I was given a strong recommendation on an over the top list of treatments. Being new to town and having never previously encountered a dentist like this I at first thought “damn I must of messed up bad in the past year or so”. Then I got other dental opinions. The consensus was that not only were the recommended treatments over the top, in some cases completely unnecessary. Of course, these were accompanied by absorbent prices. After the appointment, I was chased up by them using scare tactics to try to urge me to come back in. No thanks, Swish.

This place is a VC backed sales office. Not a credible practice. As other reviews have mentioned, the employees seemed outgoing and friendly, but the organization does not combine business practices and social/professional responsibility effectively.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Glasel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had a cleaning appointment here and I was blown away by how wonderful the staff was. They made the experience so easy and comfortable. Cassidy was my hygienist and made my cleaning so easy. She was very nice, thorough, and clearly very knowledgeable. She answered all my questions and taught me so much. I will definitely be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the most pleasant dental experience! I can’t recommend Swish enough. Everyone is so kind and patient. They walked me through what was going on every step of the way, checked in constantly, and made me feel so comfortable. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Simone Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental experience here and I hate going to the dentist. They do well to make sure you’re comfortable with their processes and in full understanding. Lots of new flashy technology if you like that type of thing. A bit expensive but great location with validated parking. Super kind and knowledgeable staff. Love that you can watch Netflix while they work on you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great people to work with!! Easy and efficient care and had a plan set up with me the same day. Doctors and staff were very friendly and explained dental plans effectively.

user_reviews_extended.Name: cata core
user_reviews_extended.Description: First filling was with a doctor who is no longer there and it was a dream so I went back despite the very Walmart feel of their business. This time I got fitted with what I can only describe as porous cement after being drilled to far the nerve. I should be glad I had Dr Han while he was here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Cordova
user_reviews_extended.Description: RDA Ashley and Dr. Noor are amazing. They are like a dynamic duo. They make sure that you're not only aware what's going on but that you're as comfortable as can be. I would hugely recommend these 2 amazing ladies.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jade Hudson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I made the switch to Swish earlier this year and have had the best experience ever since. The entire team is so kind and welcoming, Dr. Noor is so sweet, genuine and just has the best energy. She takes the time to explain everything that she is doing when it comes to treatment and her recommendations, which helps ease any nerves that you may have when coming to the dentist. Cassidy was my wonderful hygienist, and provided the most thorough & gentle cleaning. I even came back for a teeth whitening treatment, and was able to watch Netflix while getting that done. Highly recommend visiting the Swish Downtown team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaylee Belle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited Swish Dental Downtown and had an excellent experience. The staff was incredibly friendly and made me feel very comfortable throughout my visit. The office was clean and modern, and the dental care I received was top-notch. I highly recommend Swish Dental Downtown for anyone looking for a great dental practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mikey Botta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great location, super new and clean and modern office. The TVs are a nice touch to have some entertainment during your cleaning/appointment beyond just staring at the ceiling. and best of all, such a friendly awesome team (Tyler is great!!!! And Dr. Noor) that I confidently trust with my dental care & advice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fabian Ricardo Prado
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love their downtown location! Parking is a breeze and they validate. Dr. Noor is great! She takes her time and makes sure you understand the procedure and feel super comfortable. I have super sensitive teeth and the hygienist, Cassidy, was very understanding and patient. I hate going to the dentist but the team downtown made it enjoyable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsey Snedeker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental practice in the state of Texas. I’ve been very apprehensive of getting a new dentist after moving to Texas from the East Coast and having the same dentist for 30 years and I could not say enough amazing things about this practice. When I first arrived I was greeted by the very sweet front desk lady and was offered a COLD bottle of water after walking 2 miles from my apartment. The office is very modern, warm feeling, and everything is so clean. I had the pleasure of working with Cassidy, Noor, and Tyler (I apologize if I got any names wrong) and they made my very first experience at swish, my very best dental visit ever. If you are looking for a new dental office I HIGHLY recommended, this place is amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin McSpadden
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went in for a routine teeth cleaning and they attempted to push me into a $500 deep cleaning that I'm still not entirely sure was the correct diagnosis. I visited other dentists after this experience and they said my teeth are fine.

The real problem is I was not allowed to get the cleaning and potentially get the more expensive service later. I understand I may have needed the treatment, but typically a diagnosis is followed up with a scheduling. Then, at least, the patient can mentally (and financially) prepare for the treatment.

I try not to leave negative reviews because I understand everyone is trying to run a business, but my experience was extremely dodgy, and it felt like I was just being squeezed for a P&L.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emilee Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ok so let’s be real, who likes going to the dentist? Well, I never thought I’d say this, but I actually really love when it’s time for my appointments at Swish (Downtown location). First, the staff is professional and so personable. They really make you feel comfortable and at ease while they take care of you. Second, the aesthetics are incredible. There’s such a fun, effortlessly cool vibe about this place. It’s clean, there’s good music playing, and you can watch Netflix while you get your teeth cleaned? I mean, COME ON. That’s pretty friggen cool, in my opinion. I also want to shout out Dr. Noor. We talked about the possibility of me getting the Cosmetic Bonding Procedure to fix an internal stain inside my front two teeth (something that occurred while my mom was pregnant with me lol - it’s okay, mom, you didn’t know!). Although most people would never notice it, it bothered me and I was self conscious about it. Dr. Noor answered all my questions / addressed all concerns about the procedure (trust me, I had a lot!!) and was so kind throughout the entire process. Anyway, I got the procedure done and she CRUSHED it. My stain is no longer visible and I loved that this procedure was non invasive. Definitely a great route if you don’t want actual vaneers. Thanks Swish Team! Y’all Rock.

user_reviews_extended.Name: GREGORY CALDERA
user_reviews_extended.Description: The customer service, experience, and the friendly reminders that Swish Dental provides continues to be exceptional. The entire team that consistently treat me are always professional and knowledgeable.  I do want to give Diana kudos for friendly customer service and making sure everything was correct with the day’s appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: SK
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dentists can be scary but Dr. Noor always makes me feel so comfortable at Swish! She really takes the time to explain things and the entire staff is so incredibly sweet and genuine. The office itself is stunning & the best place to get your dental work done in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ROSA GARCIA
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you to the Swish dental team! From the office manager Maureen to Dr knorr and the dental assistants Alice for making the process of starting my Invisalign journey a breeze from finding financing to the Invisalign fittings y’all make it happen. Thank You!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Skelding
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved my experience with my x-rays and cleaning, Justine the Dental Hygienist is exceptional. (I have not had any other work done beyond cleanings, but very happy with the technology, office ambience and DT convenience.)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haseeb Syed
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough great things about Swish Dental Downtown! The entire team is fantastic, but Dr. Noor is truly the best thing to happen to this practice. Her expertise, warmth, and genuine care for her patients make every visit a pleasant experience. I literally drive all the way from Round Rock just to see her, even though there's a Swish Dental right by my house. The downtown location is welcoming, modern, and incredibly efficient. If you're looking for top-notch dental care with a personal touch, Dr. Noor and the team at Swish Dental Downtown are unbeatable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ishika Shah
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here is really friendly! I had a great experience with Dr. Lauren Conway. Dr. Conway was very candid around my options and the cost of services. She took the time to get an estimate for a periodontal consultation appointment and find time to fit me in for a cleaning so that I could use my coverage before the new year. I had a bad experience with a previous dentist that I felt was trying to upsell me on services such as unnecessary fillings, gingivitis cleaning, and laser gum therapy. Dr. Lauren Conway assured me my teeth health was relatively good, and she takes a conservative stance on recommending fillings, which I prefer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cara Fox
user_reviews_extended.Description: I made a new patient appointment for a cleaning that I assumed was about an hour. Arrived to spend an hour getting nine million scans and then be told that the cleaning is a separate appointment? When I was annoyed, a second staff person  told me “new patients are usually 2 hours - first for scan, second for cleaning”. NONE of this was mentioned up front, nor was the parking garage that would have saved me from paying for street parking. The staff all seemed nice and the dentist was great , but jeez - left thoroughly scanned but with dirty teeth and now I have to go back next week! Unimpressed thus far.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawn Fogarty
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been going here for a few years. The facility is clean and pleasing, the people are all extremely nice, and everyone is great to work with and come up with the right plan. The one thing I've noticed is every time I go there's someone new. There's no consistent dentist you see and when your dentist leaves you don't get any notice or update that you will have a new dentist. So you lose that personal connection with a dentist or hygienist that you might have at a different office. And I've noticed that experience has drained some of my trust. I don't know what to expect each time I'm there since it's a different person. And that extends to the billing team, the front desk, etc.

Swish is good but if you have the option, I'd find a dentist you know will be there in a few years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Autumn Ayers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing clinic! Absolutely love it. So clean and staff are amazing! Highly recommend it for all your dental needs! Cassidy Hicks is the hygienist I would recommend if you are looking for someone you can trust and who will really focus on your dental needs! She’s amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Ahmad
user_reviews_extended.Description: WOWWW!! Swish dental downtown is amazing! Their entire team is so caring and attentive! Could not have found a better dental clinic if I tried ❤️ Dr. Noor is the best!! And so are both of the hygienists I have had cleanings from - Justine & Cassidy ✨

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Kenney
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was visiting Austin for work and had a dental emergency that happened after their office had closed. Dr. Loehr texted with me and got me settled for the evening making recommendations and sending pictures of things to buy from the drug store - his care and compassion was incredible and he booked me an appointment for 8:00 am when the office opened. Dr. Noor and her assistant were amazing and got me fixed up for my plane ride home that afternoon. This was an exceptional experience but I suspect that it's actually not out of the ordinary for Swish. Thank you for taking such fantastic care of me at a time when I was in crisis.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krislyn Castillo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The kindest people, they were very informative and patient. Such positive attitude from Manny and others. 💓
I’m usually not a fan of the dentist but they made my visit very comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Benavides
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an exceptional experience at Swish Dental Downtown with Dr. Noor in Austin. From the moment I walked in, the staff was nice and welcoming, making me feel at ease. Dr. Noor was incredibly professional and took the time to explain every step of my treatment in detail, ensuring I was comfortable and well-informed. The office is modern and spotless, reflecting their commitment to top-notch care. Highly recommend Dr. Noor for anyone seeking excellent dental care in Austin!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobby McWatters
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don't usually feel compelled to write reviews, but I had a very poor experience at Swish - and wanted to share mine in the event that it could help others.

I visited Swish on 6/10 for a cleaning & exam. During the exam, the dentist recommended two fillings - no problem. However, during the cleaning, the hygienist recommended a full deep cleaning of my mouth. I rarely have dental issues, so this caught me by surprise... as did the $500+ price tag.

Feeling uncomfortable with Swish's treatment recommendation, I went for a second opinion at a local dentist this morning, Forest Family Dental. Their recommendation was completely different. The dentist recommended watching the two potential cavities (vs treating now) and said a deep cleaning was definitely NOT needed for my teeth. If anything, if needed, she could do a localized deep cleaning around the one or two teeth that had deeper pockets. This made much more sense to me. Fun fact, I asked Swish for a copy of my records to transfer to Forest Family, which they provided. That said, the x-rays screenshots they sent were too low quality to be actionable... so I had to get a completely new set.

Unfortunately, it feels like Swish is operating a money grab. I wouldn't be surprised if they're owned by private equity and heavily incentivizing their dentists and hygienists to propose overly aggressive treatment plans to drive revenue. Beware, and go elsewhere if possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darnell Craig
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was a great experience to be able to go to Swish Downtown and get updates on my dental health after not seeing a Dentist in 4 years. Each staff member was polite, informative, and very helpful when it comes to figuring out next steps for me. I would recommend this dentist location to anyone I know easily!

user_reviews_extended.Name: O'Neal Saunders
user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Dr. Makda and it was a wonderful experience! Swish made the process clear so I felt comfortable prior to my appointment. Everyone I encountered was helpful and friendly. Dr. Makda was extremely thorough and explained everything step by step. I will definitely be back to see her, now that I've found a dentist in Austin that I love!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Starr Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was my first time here & I was really nervous because the office is so boujie & I hadn’t been to the dentist in 6 years! They made me feel so welcome & comfortable right away. Shannon was there my entire exam & he was so sweet, helpful, & also very funny. I hate x-rays but he did so much to keep me comfortable. :) There was a tv & also music playing which I loved! Cassidy the hygienist was so thorough with explaining what issues were at hand & I felt so comfortable with her! Lastly Dr. Norr was so genuine & I loved seeing a POC women in front of me. Being chicana it scares me a bit being in such an upscale clinic but seeing another woman of color was so relieving! Dr. Norr was so sweet & I want her & Swish Dental to be my regular dentist forever!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a cleaning with getting some fillings done. I was a little bit nervous, but everyone was so sweet and kind checking in with me and giving me the information that I needed. Great visit overall!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nat is the best to ever do it, she’s the main reason I stay at this dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan Docter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with my first ever visit to Swish Dental Downtown. The office was clean, modern, and easy to get to. The staff were really friendly and easy to work with, especially Cassidy. I would highly recommend anybody looking for a dentist in the area to go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Lukes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at this office is fantastic. They made my first visit to a dentist in ~5 years (I'm not exactly proud of this btw!) as painless and transparent as possible, explaining everything they were doing, why they were doing it, and ways I can protect my teeth on my own time. The cleaning was fantastic, and the filling treatment for a cavity was as painless as they could make it. Again, the staff, from the front desk to the hygienists to the dentist, made this a positive experience for me and actually got me eager to improve my oral health in the future. Plus the location is very convenient, and the office is clean and new. Cannot recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy Cope
user_reviews_extended.Description: I originally went to Swish Dental for an emergency toothache.  The team at the downtown Swish Dental is great. They got me in first thing the next morning, were able to treat my pain and come up with a long-term plan for my mouth. I love Dr. Noor. She has been nothing but great and George has been great too.  Thank you all for making me feel comfortable during am uncomfortable process.  As long as I live Austin I will be getting my dental work here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JR Earl
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Noor is caring and friendly, and has done a good job for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aspen Noack
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this location! Super sweet people at the front desk and my hygienist Natalie is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brett Provance
user_reviews_extended.Description: Would give 6 stars if I could. The team worked quickly and efficiently throughout my new patient examination. My hygienist, Justine, gave me a terrific cleaning while being gentle and working carefully around areas of concern that I had. 10/10 will go again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicholas Cancelliere
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They do all the paperwork online, sent to your phone before the appointment. They are convenient for people living downtown. The staff are all friendly and professional. Never had to wait for my appointment, they were always on time.

My only complaint is that the receptionist could smile, say "good morning," and be welcoming and friendly. They could be replaced with a kiosk and the overall experience wouldn't change a bit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Iglinski
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experiences with Swiish Dental have been all positive.  It’s a clean, friendly and professional atmosphere.  Their use of technology and techniques making dentist visits almost fun.  Upbeat music and a movie while having procedures really helps take the stress away.  This was probably the first time I’ve had a completely pain free dentist visit ever!  Thank you Swish Dental Downtown.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tre Leoni
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental was one of best dental experiences I’ve ever had! I booked the wrong thing to be performed and they were able to accommodate the additional treatment. Justine was an amazing hygienist. She went above and beyond to get my teeth shining!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Needah Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
WARNING!!! DO NOT GO TO THIS DENTIST!!!!! READ FULL REVIEW!!!

I am grateful for being seen for an emergency appointment when I noticed something different with my teeth. I was seen by Dr. Noor Makda, who was very nice. However, I was told I had two cavities between my teeth just by looking at an intraoral image, all without taking X-rays. She said the cavities had reached the second layer of my tooth and suggested filling them immediately to prevent worsening. Feeling uneasy about this, I decided to leave.

I called another dentist who had done an exam a week prior (I went to Swish Dental because I was unable to see her). She said she did not notice anything during both the visual and clinical exams and suggested I go back and get X-rays taken for comparison. I returned to do this and Dr. Noor Makda still insisted I had cavities and offered to fill them.

I sent the X-rays to the dentist I spoke to, who confirmed I had no cavities. I then consulted two other dentists in Austin, and they both confirmed I did not have cavities and that filling anything would’ve led to a whole road of problems.

I maxed out my insurance benefits, so I had to pay out of pocket: $131 for two images that could have been taken with a phone and an examination where the dentist just scratched around and said I had cavities. And then $45 for two X-rays for confirmation. All for a misdiagnosis because Dr. Noor Makda did not follow the standards of care. She failed to ensure a proper examination, causing me immense anxiety and trouble. As a result, I had to visit multiple other dentists and incurred additional out-of-pocket expenses.

After I posted my initial review, Swish Dental called me asking to take it down in exchange for a refund because they thrive off their reviews. They even offered me a free whitening LOL. However, they wouldn’t refund me regardless for the misdiagnosis and the anxiety caused because “services were still rendered”. Even if I did remove my review, services were still rendered.

Swish Dental also tried to have me sign an NDA because I mentioned legal matters, to protect Dr. Noor, Dr. Viraj (the owner), and anyone associated with Swish. That NDA was already null and void because multiple dentists in Austin, along with my family and friends, were aware of this situation. This was highly unethical. I didn’t sign anything, so I believe the right thing to do is to warn the public.

Swish manipulates public perception by bribing people who post honest reviews of their negative experiences and is driven by overdiagnosing and pushing unnecessary treatments to drive revenue. I recommend going to a standalone doctor who is more experienced instead of a corporate chain. Such doctors are more likely to follow appropriate standards of care, ensure correct diagnoses, avoid pushing aggressive treatments to drive revenue, and maintain overall ethical practices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Wise
user_reviews_extended.Description: Trendy, with competent cleaning and exam services. More than a little pushy in upselling Invisalign and extra procedures. A "ten-minute" filling procedure was priced at $360, and primarily suggested by emphatic digging in my tooth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Boots Stribling
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Bait and Switch to get you to buy the membership.

I called the downtown location to see the cost of cleaning and exam. The person at the front desk told me the cost would be approximately $500 for a basic cleaning, but they had a membership that got you two basic cleanings a year plus an exam for ~$250.

Well, I purchased the membership. No brainer right? I go do the exam and apparently I have a VERY serious case and I need a "deep" cleaning. Out come the extra charges. Attached is the total bill they wanted me to pay to even get a cleaning.

$2800+ I was going to have to pay to even get a cleaning. I left getting nothing done.

Don't waste your money. It's a big ol' scam. Bait and switch to the max.

Of course, they're happy to do payment plans with extensive interest costs.

Thanks for nothing Swish, I paid 289$ and didn't even get a toothbrush.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Sofonia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Noor & the team at swish are the best! Never have I been to a dental office where I didn’t have to wait forever to be seen (I only waited 1 minute in the waiting room). The advanced technology used, flow of the appointment, & friendly service was top notch! I even got to watch tv while I got my teeth polished! Can’t wait for my next visit @ swish !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nidal Gadban
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had my first experience with Swish about 2-3 weeks since their opening. Finding the clinic is a little tricky as you have to go through a side door not nearest to the clinic, but once in it was really nice.

The clinic is brand new and the decor is all very high end. Rather than the dentist offices that I’m used to that can sometimes be intimidating in nature with harsh lighting, this instead felt comfortable and dare I say, actually relaxing. The staff was incredibly nice including the assistants, hygienist and dentist and made for a welcoming visit that I’m actually looking forward to my follow-up.

A really great clinic for fellow downtown dwellers who would like to go to a place they can walk to

user_reviews_extended.Name: holly moffitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Misleading - I went in for implants and they did a full work up and tried to schedule me for a cleaning. I told them I was there and had booked an initial implant appointment and they told me the at they would have another surgeon contact me. Never contacted. They source out the implant. They need to be upfront and be knowledgeable about what each customer comes in for. I wasn’t there for a cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drake Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: They do a great job on everything, my rating has nothing to do with service. Go elsewhere for crowns. You can get just as high quality crowns elsewhere for 1/2 the price(or less). And that’s including their in house “insurance” discounted price. Mouth guard cost is really high too. Didn't shop around filling prices but I would imagine they are high as well. Once again, great service, just very high priced.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ella Hatfield
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first appointment with swish today and it was such a fantastic experience! The staff are super polite and friendly, plus very efficient and professional. The office is clean and well kept, with really nice high tech equipment. They explained everything they were going through clearly, and  answered all of my questions throughly. Plus their membership program is an amazing deal! 10/10 definitely recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Innes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The best dental service in Austin! I’ve had a lot of issues after having a full mouth makeover (at another office). Swish Downtown has been the only facility to not only address the issues, but have taken the time and care to correct the issues. I couldn’t be more pleased.
Thanks Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great visit! Had my new crown “seated.” It feels like just another one of my teeth. No pain at all. Time will tell on durability, but so far so good and I’m still singing Dr. Noor’s praises!

6- month check-up:  All is well. New hygienist did my cleaning, Natalie! She’s fantastic! Sweet, gentle, knowledgable. Saw Dr. Noor for a few minutes who  was all smiles. Note: I believe they take most insurance!

user_reviews_extended.Name: mark magee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had two crowns and an older filling replaced with composite material this morning. While these dental visits are never something I would want to pursue as a hobby, Dr. Noor and her assistant made it as “pleasurable” as possible. Both of them are very friendly and caring and they work together very well and very efficiently. I’m a tad sore, but that’s to be expected. All in all, my various visits with Swish downtown have always been positive experiences.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Wu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved my experience here. Very high tech, and everyone was friendly and took the time to explain things to me and show me exactly what they were referring to via my scans and X-ray. They were very honest about what I needed, what I didn’t need, the state of my teeth, and how I can continue maintaining the health of my teeth and gums. They were able to identify a small cavity and get that taken care of immediately and very quickly. They had no problem continually smoothing down my filling until it was perfect and I was absolutely comfortable. I have TMJ issues with visible wear on my teeth due to grinding and clenching, and they were able to identify it and refer me to masseter Botox. Every time I come, I can see how the pressure on my teeth continues to get better and better now that I’m consistent with it. They also have someone in house to come chat with you about Botox options and pricing which was super informative and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trever Cutler
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with swish dental has been great both for my routine cleanings and going through them for Invisalign. Special call out for Cassidy who has made multiple experiences great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: CM Cummings
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had a dental cleaning with Nicole and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Although I am usually apprehensive about dental visits, Nicole was incredibly gentle and thorough. My teeth felt and looked great after the exam. I highly recommend her services to anyone looking for excellent dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rabail Gilani
user_reviews_extended.Description: I feel so lucky that I found Dr. Noor! I had severe anxiety when going to the dentist & it wasn’t until I started going to Swish that I’m finally at ease when going in for check ups. I come all the way from Round Rock because she’s the only one who has ever made me feel comfortable. Dr. Noor & her team is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elle Lindig
user_reviews_extended.Description: Scheduling an appointment was easy and the front desk staff were friendly and helpful. Cassidy was my dental hygienist and was super:  professional and personable and very considerate.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amrith Sundar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have had 4 visits so far with Swish: 3 cleanings and an extraction.

I have to say, this has so far been the best dental experience I have ever received.  All of the Hygienists, Assistants, Front Desk and Dentists have been wonderful, and my teeth look and feel amazing.  Super happy I chose Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Mason
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for a cleaning after moving to downtown Austin a few months ago. While the staff was extremely friendly and nice the experience was more about finding a litany of things they could upsell me on and not cleaning my teeth (which didn’t happen). All the x rays, pictures and scans took about 30 minutes. I sat in the chair waiting for another 35 minutes and then had to schedule another appointment a month out to get the cleaning I thought I was getting but instead presented with a $3,000 treatment plan. Before ever working with them or so much as having a simple cleaning to build any trust in the dentist/office. They also make you pay half up front to even schedule which I had never experienced before.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alberto Morell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you all so much I feel like a new person after my dental visit! Huge thanks to Dr. Noor, Cassicy, and Marnyce for the wonderful care. And a special shoutout to the young lady who assisted with the X-rays much appreciated!

user_reviews_extended.Name: antonio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome staff, make you feel taken care of

user_reviews_extended.Name: Em Sage
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a wonderful experience here. I always feel anxious when I visit the dentist and everyone really put me at ease. Definitely recommend to anyone looking to establish themselves at a reliable clinic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Pike
user_reviews_extended.Description: Visited Swish downtown location today for the first time. Dr. Nessler and her team are absolutely fabulous. It was the most thorough dental experience and for a very reasonable price. Full X-rays, cleaning, exam, whitening all for $199 and you get another cleaning in 6 months. (I don’t have insurance at the moment) the facility is brand new, immaculate, modern, great energy. Very professional team, from the receptionist who asked what Netflix show I wanted to watch during my cleaning, to each person throughout the visit. Just a very happy group servicing patients. I’ll be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Aguero
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was fantastic. Tough to make a dental visit enjoyable but these folks knocked it out of the park. Justine and the rest of the team were awesome. 10/10 recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I previously had a bad review, then improved because they reached out and helped me resolve the issue, but further visits to other dentists have soured me.
I got a crown here (which I had a whole myriad of issues getting). However in the time it took to get + the adjustment have caused significant bite issues that are creating more and more dental problems which cost me a lot more money. In addition, despite offering me a discount on the crown for my troubles, I got a surprise bill that was almost $1000 months later.
In an effort to have a laid back image, other aspects suffer. consider other options

user_reviews_extended.Name: KL Ring
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is wonderful.  Staff and docs are so up beat, professional and accommodating.  Super nice and efficient.  My Invisalign journey is complete.  My teeth never looked this good   Thx swish team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adnan Ratani
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been to several dental practices in Austin as I have lived here for over 8 years-- this is by far one of the advanced (in terms of technology). Dr. Noor and Justine were exceptionally knowledgeable, friendly through out my appointment. As a new patient to this practice, this location has state of the art equipment and was insightful feedback into my oral health

Highly recommend this to anyone, thanks Dr. Noor for being awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Loretta Dilger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental Downtown was an amazing experience today. No paperwork because you add your info online before the appointment. Also, there was no waiting between arrival, X-rays, photo imaging, analysis with the Dentist and cleaning.  Their technology is the newest in the field and the staff are friendly and professional. Even if you don’t have insurance, all of the above is $350. You’re worth it. Take care of your teeth.  Wonderful dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Weaver
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Waited a couple years to post my review. I had high hopes for the Downtown location but I would never recommend to anyone. While I’ve enjoyed my experience with the various dentists (seem to get a new one each time I show up though so no real relationship or consistentcy with a Doctor) and the office itself…however the back office staff needs major major upgrades. It became a running joke that every appointment I had that something would go wrong whether it was their side canceling an appointment and never informing me, trying to mislead with Invisalign (which I had to fight for a  reimbursement after insurance didn’t cover even though they “confirmed and verified”), forgetting to order my permanent retainers (and then telling me it was never in the treatment plan when it was…), dental assistants not having enough training (a lot of newbies so I became a Guinea Pig, etc (the list goes on). This company is VERY corporate and VERY focused on profitability and not necessarily doing the right by the patient (compared my experience with a family office).

Overall it was a very poor experience and I’ll be looking for a more qualified practice that focuses on its patients experience vs the bottom line.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devilish Smiler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First impressions are really important and even though I showed a bad one through coming late(snooze button took a beating), the folks are amazing.
Upon completing my new patient form and getting checked in, They gave me a tour of the office, the rooms, and upcoming areas.
Once i got into my room, I was given access to netflix while they checked my teeth. While they were collecting data on my teeth, I got introduced to the dentists that will be working with me on my operations.
New patient sign up did take 2 hours but I did enjoy myself the whole time.

I have an operation planned for next week, will update if my rating changes but i have a good feeling that i am in good hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taz P
user_reviews_extended.Description: another bad experience at Swish. Very nice doctor but also very inexperienced. I came in with a crown that had fallen off. He recommended a new root canal and a bunch of other stuff to fix to replace that crown or a 6-month process for an implant. I kinda freaked out. I went to another dentist right after. And I will end up only needing something simple using the same root canal and reconstruct the teeth and get a new crown. Every time I go to swish it’s a nightmare

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney DeCleene
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and patient staff. I had an unusual case because I had to transfer Invisalign which caused some confusion; however, throughout the process, the staff was always helpful and patient, making sure to keep me up-to-date on what needed to get done and communicating any changes to me. I highly recommend Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bridgette
user_reviews_extended.Description:
No cleaning was offered during my new patient appointment. The appointment involved 4 to 5 different types of unnecessary 3D/X-Ray/Photographic measurements. When I inquired about a cleaning, the assistant told me a cleaning was not included. What is the point of a "preventative" appointment? They tried to break up the appointments by booking a separate cleaning.

Seems like this place cares more about selling you retainers and a-la-cart services than customer satisfaction. Added a star because the dental hygienist gave me a quick cleaning anyway.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clara Godkin
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys are great at what they do! Very friendly and professional staff, and clean environment. They set you at ease and make you feel comfortable. You can even watch Netflix or a movie if you'd like! My dental hygienists was very knowledgeable, she knew what she was doing, was gentle and thorough.  With locations all over austin, I definitely recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maddy Davidson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an amazing experience at Swish Dental! This was my first time coming here since I moved from out of state & will definitely keep coming back. The staff was super friendly & my teeth feel/look amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Craig Lakey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience for emergency care. I was able to get a same day appointment during the holiday. The staff was helpful and professional. The facility was new and the process was very efficient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Spence
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental downtown has the most beautiful space and extremely up to date with all the latest technology! I had a dental cleaning here and they fixed my bottom retainer. Both appointments were a breeze! I truly can’t say enough good things about this office especially the assistant I had, Allie. She was exceptional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: austin hatzinger
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The office has an aura that is absolutely electrifying, makes me want to come back quarterly instead of semi annually. The whole team is inviting and fun. Cassidy’s professionalism and demeanor had me scheduling out my dental appointments for the next decade.

When people ask me where I get this smile from. I say “Like a perfect 3 pointer, when my teeth need a cleaning… I go to swish! When my mouth can’t take it anymore…I go to swish. When the chickens are clucking and the horns are honking… I go to swish.”

#WouldRecommend #WillBeBack

user_reviews_extended.Name: Macy Minze
user_reviews_extended.Description: My regular hygienist has moved on and today I had the best traveling hygienist from Cincinnati!  She was every bit as perfect as Nicole, if not more-so!  I love her!!!  I wish I could give her more Stars!!!!  She’s friendly, sooo knowledgable, and fantastic!!!  And FAST ⚡️⚡️⚡️She does an incredible job!!!  Anyone would be lucky to have her clean their teeth!  Total rockstar and the dds at the downtown location is so smart and efficient and perfect too!!!  Rockstar hygienist and dentist!!!!⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cassidy was amazing, the doctor was so sweet as well! I recommend this place to anyone with dental fears. They are the sweetest most kind and understanding individuals. I will definitely be coming here again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassandra Cortez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish dentals downtown location is a life saver!! I live next door so it’s convenient to walk to and they were able to get me in for an emergency appointment same day! The staff is super friendly and made me feel completely comfortable throughout my visit. If you are in the downtown area I 100% recommend Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Business Use
user_reviews_extended.Description: Marnyce is horrible she doesn’t have a clue on what she’s talking about. - negative stars if I could Stay away they are very up sales kind of dentist office who thrives on bonus’s from patients. Yikes !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fatimah Quraishi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist and staff it doesn’t feel like a normal depressing dentist office at all. Music is always playing Netflix is provided for their patients. Water/ sparkling water was provided as well and the staff and the doctor seemed like you can actually be friends with them. Best doctors office I have ever been to! The environment feels like family.  Now,  every time when I go it will feel like an event to gather with friends I haven’t seen in a while rather than a depressing visit to a doctors office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was hesitant to go to a chain dentist, but I was pleasantly surprised with the quality and professionalism I experienced at swish. Didn’t feel like I was overcharged for the services provided. Never have I been to a dentist that is so vocal about what is happening while they’re in your mouth, which is very appreciated

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Ballweg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic clinic.  Very modern and clean.  I highly recommend Cassidy Hicks if you are looking for a new hygienist who genuinely cares about your dental health and makes going to the dentist feel like something you get to do, not something you have to do.  Shes the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Cusick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really amazing staff and technology. Super modern equipment and highly capable team LOVE IT!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dionne Freund
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cleanings and such went well and I really liked my hygienist. However, if you’re planning to do Invisalign here, think again. First, they did it WRONG, so after it should’ve been DONE, they had to redo it bc they put the wrong attachment on a tooth. I had several different dentists while here without them warning me because I guess they kept leaving???? ALSO, they didn’t remove all of my attachments all the way and I moved, so I had to get them removed at a different dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eavan Matz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATED REVIEW: I’m updating my review due to a conversation I had with the manager of the downtown office. He was very kind to reach out and inquire about my first experience at Swish. He also helped me schedule an earlier appt that was more convenient for me which was very much appreciated, and feel that I’ll be taken care of moving forward.

Original review:
Swish definitely has the setup catering to millennials. It has a boutique type feel for the dentist and aim to provide best in class service as if they’re more of a retail  shop rather than a provider of clinical treatment. They’re too focused on the frills instead of actually providing efficient care. They’re more concerned with upwelling patients additional aspects of their treatment plans, and it’s exhausting and frustrating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Scelsi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great environment, pleasant people, all the workers were really nice and understanding of the fact that I haven’t been to the dentist in a few years. They had a TV and let me choose what show to put on which helped me stay distracted! Explained everything down to exactly what I was paying for and what could or couldn’t be covered by insurance. Great experience for someone terrified of the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariel Vaile
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shannon and Dr Rafaeil were so kind and helpful. I laughed the whole time and felt so welcomed! The atmosphere of this dentist office is unmatched!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maya Yes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've gotta tell you about my incredible experience with Dr. Evan and his team. I was seriously freaked out about going to the dentist, but Dr. Evan was a total hero. He was patient, and understanding, and helped me conquer my dental anxiety after 10 years of avoiding it like the plague. And let me tell you, Emily, the dental assistant, was a straight-up rockstar. She held my hand throughout the appointment, making sure I was comfy and informed every step of the way. And Joseph, the treatment plan coordinator, was seriously impressive. He was professional, welcoming, and even gave me a hug every time I came in for my appointments - now that's some next-level customer service.

Overall, Dr. Evan and his team are the real deal. They're highly skilled, and compassionate, and make going to the dentist a lot less terrifying. Trust me, if you're looking for a top-notch dentist, these guys are the ones to call. Don't miss out on the chance to have an exceptional dental experience - hit up Dr. Avens and his team ASAP.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dimitrius Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough about swish. I went almost 20 years without seeing a dentist and they welcomed me with open arms. I don’t have insurance so I got their plan to help with some basics. What I love most is how comfortable they make me feel and also how they explain everything in a way that makes it easy to understand. Moreover, I wanted to completely redo my top teeth with veneers and Dr Nessler said she’d be happy to but thought it was really unnecessary as I have really good bones. Such integrity.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Ryan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this clinic. The atmosphere is fun and clean. Parking garage is super convenient. I would recommend Cassidy Hicks as your hygienist if you’re looking for someone who’s easy to talk to and genuinely cares about your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie Cooper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Downtown location: Extremely friendly staff, very accommodating especially if you are nervous/anxious with dental work they really put you at ease and make sure you are comfortable. The office is beautiful and super clean and inviting. It is the nicest dental office I have been to and would HIGHLY recommend it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Kavelman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hygienist was slow and I was in the chair for an hour and forty five minutes. My dentist moved and I was not notified until a different dentist walked in. Not really sure the aesthetic appeal and the ease of making appointments makes up for the lack of a good patient-provider experience. Not bad, but I’ll probably go back to a more traditional experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Storm Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just moved to Austin from Indiana and was a little nervous to go to a new dentist. However, the super clean office and friendly staff made it exciting to have a new dentist! Riley was super efficient and informative with my Invisalign consultation and made me feel welcomed and comfortable during the process. He went above and beyond and exceeded my expectations with any dental assistant I have ever interacted with, a great guy! Also, Doctor Nessler was also insanely nice and really took the time to understand my goals with my teeth. I was shocked by my experience and when checking out Kristy and another lady were very helpful and took the the time to get to know me. Looking forward to my Invisalign journey and future cleanings at this office! Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Max Gil
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I have ever been to, and I went again today and it was lovely , easy and Very affordable. Dr Noor is an expert and She is highly skilled and she makes you feel calm and at ease 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Barnett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
To preface: I became a patient at the Swish Downtown location after experiencing some problems with a previous dentist in which I had two fillings that were executed improperly—one of which was done so poorly that the tooth was cracked in the process. This caused a few indirect, residual issues which were impossible for me to gain any sort clarity on due to the severe lack of transparency, honesty, and accountability of that previous dentist. But I’m not writing this review to outlet my frustrations about past experiences, so that’s the extent of the context I’ll provide on that.

Attempting to get those issues fixed had been an arduous 3-month-long journey in which I’d endured a tremendous amount of distress and frustration (not to mention the constant physical pain). There were many occasions in which I felt completely defeated—as if I’d be far better off yanking out all of my teeth with a set of needle-nose pliers and ingesting only oatmeal, tapioca pudding and Go-Gurt for sustenance in perpetuity. However, all that changed once I became a patient at Swish. First of all, they were efficient and accurate in terms of identifying the root cause (pun intended) of my issues, as well as all the collateral damage that had been done. Then, they tailored a specific treatment plan that suited my unique set of circumstances to precision. And, on a personal level, what was most important to me was that they were exceptionally communicative throughout every single step of the process. It was as if the doctor and each staff member I encountered had intrinsic understandings of how to provide explanations that involved highly-technical medical and procedural terminology in a fashion that was both comprehendible and digestible to a layman such as myself. As I’m sure we’ve all experienced to a varying degree, sometimes, the worst part about having a medical problem is feeling like you’re in the dark about what’s going on with your own body—and having to try to decipher all the medical jargon in real time (which, without fail, always evaporates into thin air just as soon as the doctor leaves the room). It can be exhausting: engaging in endless speculation about what could possibly be going on inside you. And although we know it’s a futile gesture to do so, we simply can’t help it—as is human nature.

The point being: I can honestly say that this is the first time in my 35 years of existence on planet earth that I’ve felt entirely informed about my medical predicament. And not only that, but I felt 100% trust and unwavering confidence in the entire Swish team that I, and my teeth, would be handled with care, respect and efficacy.

For some tangible evidence: I had an appointment at 10am yesterday in which they went above and beyond my wildest imagination—and that’s not hyperbole; that’s the unequivocal truth of the matter. I went in with the expectation of having the slightest of adjustments done on a temporary crown. I left with a new permanent crown on one side which solved the issue of the cracked tooth. On top of that, they put in a replacement filling on the other side that fixed the other previously improperly-executed filling (which had evidently caused a buildup of bacteria that was causing me intermittent, and thus, perplexing pain). Over a three-hour timespan, Swish successfully repaired every physical problem, and in doing so, helped me begin the healing process from the three months of mental anguish.

In summation: I feel like a new man today. The seemingly-endless barrage of physical and mental torment is finally over. I’m sure of it; I can feel it in my bones (and not just the ones protruding from my gums). I can finally eat comfortably. I can finally live comfortably. I attribute this abrupt up-shift in my entire state of wellbeing entirely to Swish. I cannot stress enough how satisfying and relieving my experience has been. I’ll be eternally grateful I made the decision to become a patient. If you care about your oral health—and just your general health as a conscious human being—I highly recommend you do the same.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Pedregon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As someone who reeeaalllly dislikes going to the dentist, I've always had really positive experiences with Swish. I've been to their East, Domain, and most recently their Downtown location and no matter where, their great service and friendly staff never falter.

They are always informative with my dental health and transparent about cost - and I appreciate that. Thanks ya'll 🤠

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katelyn Murff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish has been consistently friendly, professional, accommodating, while providing great care. They have been upfront about costs and don’t push an cosmetic services. I’ve been able to relax while at the dentist while watching an entire episode on Netflix.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: It's always a relief to not dread the Dentist. Downtown Swish is efficient and professional, as you would expect, but the customer service is above and beyond. The staff is always in a good mood, and I can imagine why with EDM playing all day. Thanks y'all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathan Carpentier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Recently visited this office and was impressed by the overall treatment and care I received. Every piece of the process was completed in a timely manner. The Dentist and assistants made sure I was comfortable through the whole process. I will definitely be back again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Robert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish is always a great experience - front office, hygienists, & doctors take excellent care of me!  The hygienist today, Maggie, gave me such a fantastic cleaning.  My teeth felt amazing all day 😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pedro Ortega
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly professional staff. The aesthetic is really cute and the check in process is straightforward. Every step of the cleaning and X-rays was explained to me. I felt comfortable and taken care of.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen McKee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was visiting Austin for a conference and the wire on my fixed retainer that had been in place for 20 years broke leaving sharp edges that were cutting up my tongue.  I called Swish over lunch and spoke with a wonderful staff member who said I could come right away.  I dropped what I was doing, walked over from my hotel, got checked in and the rest of my fixed retainer taken off.  And I was back to my hotel in time for my next meeting.  This was an INCREDIBLE dental experience.  If I lived in Austin I’d def go here for regular dental care;). Thanks to the Swish team for saving my trip - would have been VERY miserable with a cut up tongue all weekend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ha Lam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nessler is a really great dentist. Very knowledgeable and a great communicator. She really went the extra mile when I had a dental emergency while out of town. She was able to help virtually and saved the day. That's the kind if service you will not get most places. I'll be a loyal patient for that kind of service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ginny Patrick
user_reviews_extended.Description:
BEWARE! This place will scam you out of money, perform unnecessary procedures and you’ll end up needing to find another dentist to fix what they screw up. Don’t let the fancy interior fool you.
I spent 3 weeks repeatedly visiting trying to get them to fix a filling they put in that was preventing me from eating without pain only to have them finally say it was a fracture (which they said was always visible on the X-ray even though it wasn’t) and that I needed a crown.
Turns out it wasn’t a fracture and I didn’t need a crown. I’m still dealing with bills and insurance from the mess they made. Find someone else!
UPDATE: 4 months later had to get another 2 of their fillings fixed. Horrible place and horrible dental work

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizz Helms
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have now been to 2 of the SWISH Dental locations and loved both. (S 1st & downtown)

They definitely know how to create an experience when it comes to going to the dentist.

I provided them with current issues or questions I had about my teeth and the cleaning. They took them seriously and made sure my experience was one of a kind.
I was shown all the images they took of my mouth, explained what they were for, and where I measured on the results/ explained the treatment plan in layman terms.

I am one of “those girls” when it comes to going to the dentist.. it’s scary, it’s my smile, I know my pain points and they don’t…
This is a top of the line experience, just be honest and upfront about your concerns. They take them seriously and do everything they can to make it the best experience.

10 out of 10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental is very professional with a clean, welcoming, and friendly atmosphere. I enjoy going to the dentist and this place made me really love my entire experience there. The technology, upscale environment, and incredible professionals made this a five star experience. Thank you Swish Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yaseen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolute waste of my time, would give 0 stars if I could. Firstly, I had an appointment at 4pm and was not sat until around 5pm. In my appointment notes I put exactly what I was there for: my jaw joint is dislocated which is causing pain, two specific teeth have been sensitive for almost two years, and I need a cleaning. At the end of the appointment after going back and forth with the "doctor" for an hour, she concluded that my jaw joint was dislocated and that was causing me pain, her prescription was a retainer and to sit on it for 4-6 weeks? The "doctors" immediate recommendation was also Botox and a surgery. They care more about selling procedures than actually fixing what's wrong. Also the two teeth that were sensitive were apparently fine and I was just hallucinating, and no cleaning was done due to their delayed appointment. Absolute embarrassment and waste of my time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meg Ramon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every visit is so nice! I love being in control of Netflix during my exams. My last visit, I decided to go ahead with my night guard and Joseph made pick up so easy. He’s the best office manager!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Cusick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Moved to ATX and chose Swish (after doing my research). Well, I made the right call. Amazing, modern, clean, great technology…and truly professional staff all around. Special shout out to my hygienist - Nicole!!! The Best!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oshri P
user_reviews_extended.Description: Their business model is to get you for cleaning in their cool looking place and every six months they'll find something that need to be fixed, even when other dentists with 30 years of experience won't see anything wrong. Do yourself a favor and go see a real dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Halle Pszeniczny
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental is amazing! I just left and had a great cleaning with the hygienist Cassidy H- she does such a good job and really cares! Very kind and thorough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Pumpelly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quick and easy to make an appointment. They work very efficiently and don’t waste time. No preaching or lectures. They evaluate your situation and make a plan. Nice snd simple.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nella Arledge
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience , everyone was so professional and sweet. I specially loved the dental assistant I believe her name was Ally , my apologies if spelled incorrect. She was just so wonderful and helpful the whole time .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maggie Chan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
EDIT: I said I'd leave another review after I got my crown redone. I did have a bad experience like I previously wrote (Below), but the clinic did make a new crown for me for free and I had Dr. Puzio. She was fast and thorough and did a GREAT job. I am very happy with the result; it's been a few weeks and overall I think SWISH made up for the previous bad experience.

--------

This place is fine for cleanings. Actually they’re easy to book and friendly hygienists.

However i had a crown fall off and needed to be recemented. I commented before recementing that it seemed like there was still glue on my tooth. The dentist, dr. Arti Patel, said she cleaned it, when in reality she only blew in it with air. She said it was in good condition to put the crown on. I said fine, and she cemented the crown on. I now know that is not the procedure to recement a crown. A tooth should always be polished until there is no glue left to adhere the new crown. There was no polishing or scraping off my tooth except with AIR.

The crown was completely off. It didn’t fit correctly and was way too high as I suspected it would be because the glue hadn’t been cleaned off my tooth. The crown wasn’t in the position it had been, as more of my tooth underneath was exposed. My bite was off. I couldn’t floss or reach my gum.

She grinded down my crown which did not help and She took an X-ray and said it was perfect but I knew it didn’t feel right to me.

Then she tried to get it off to reposition which did not work after 4 tries and pulling on my tooth. I’m going to have to get it cut off and completely replaced with a new crown.

The dentist was not explaining what she was doing and i felt disregarded during the session. The risks of the recementing were not explained and thus as the treatment progressed i felt further like this happened due to either negligence or incompetence or inexperience. I don’t know how difficult it is to recement a crown and if the risks were too high then that should have been explained and expectations managed. If it didn’t fit anymore or I needed a new crown I could have been prepared to do that treatment instead. I didn’t feel my concerns about the glue on my tooth prior to cementing was addressed, and it caused more problems instead of fix my problem I came in with.

I left very unhappy but at least the management agreed to discuss with the regional manager about a new crown which I felt like was done in good faith.

It is of note that in the 1.5-2 years I’ve been doing cleanings here I’ve never once had the same dentist. They may have a retention issue.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tania Mendoza Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am currently getting Invisalign with them. They state on their website that they would schedule follow ups for the treatment to check on progress. Well, I just went to the *ONLY* follow up for my whole treatment and they weren’t gonna have me see a dentist. They were just gonna give me the complete rest of the trays (so what if something wasn’t working then? New trays would have to be printed ?). I asked to see a dentist, and I might as well not have… she just looked at my teeth and said, “perfect, they’re moving”.
Why charge so much if you’re basically smile direct with an added inconvenience of going to pick up the trays - there’s no extra care here at all.
This is not just 1 star thanks to the receptionists and other staff that are actually super nice. It’s the dentists you never see at this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacqui Simses
user_reviews_extended.Description: Recently starting going to Swish downtown and it’s been a great experience! I love Dr. Noor - she’s very attentive, thorough, and helpful. So happy I switched from my old dental group to Swish :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cameron Garvin

For me, it was akin to torture—I have had an extreme gag reflex to this procedure for years (as I told the hygienist).  After several painful, unsuccessful attempts, I couldn’t take any more.  She refused to accommodate me with the external X-rays provided to me there and at previous providers in the past.  Complete lack of sensitivity to a patient’s needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bethanie Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved my experience!!! Everyone is so nice, especially Justine the Dental Hygienist. So glad I chose Swish Dental Downtown to take care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Schafroth
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely love this practice and location. The tech and overall approach allow for very thorough and precise treatment. All of the staff is incredible but my hygienist, Nicole, is the best of the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Grey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend - was in Austin, travelling for work, when I needed a last minute rush appointment. Called them right away and they saw me at 8am the next morning, and sorted me out quickly. Saved my trip!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Swish downtown is located inside a  bank building- important to know as you drive around looking for this space. There is a small blue neon sign that indicates Swish location.
Street parking or public garage parking is available.
Overall my experience was informative and pleasant however they insist their lengthy questionnaire is filled out prior to appointment. These forms take up to 30 mins to go over.
First appointment takes over an hour due to multiple XRays and examinations. There is no angle of your mouth they will not capture with their multiple machines.
It is a clean modern environment with state of the art equipment.
Workers are upbeat, intelligent and know their dentistry-
Membership price is $200 w/out insurance for 2 thorough exams, X-rays and 2 cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacqueline Ommen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! Very thorough in their questioning and evaluation. I felt very cared for and the staff was so kind and personable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daylon Schiffel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Would highly recommend Dr Nessler, she is great!! Visited multiple times and felt like the staff was accommodating and knowledgable.  Got a cleaning and my teeth scanned on the first visit, they have a really great machine to show an in depth scan of your teeth. Second visit I had old fillings from a previous dentist years ago changed out for new one, Dr Nessler was very personable and efficient with the procedure! Felt very comfortable and informed! Again, 10/10 would recommend Dr Nessler for any of my dental work, high quality!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frank Nourozi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience at Swish Dental downtown. The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. I visited for both teeth cleaning and dental work, and I highly recommend them to anyone seeking quality dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lund
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is generally kind and efficient when I'm at this office, but the client communication is really lacking. I have now twice been scheduled for an appointment that did not happen, and I was only notified after going through the effort of arriving at the office. Once, I needed to reschedule for personal reasons and was told by staff I had a confirmed reschedule, only to arrive at the office and they had no record of my appointment that day, or any other day. And this morning, although there is some icy weather, I had spoken to a staff member yesterday to reschedule my 8:30am appt to a noon slot because she said they would be opening later in the day. When I arrived, they were closed because of winter conditions but I received NO notice that this was the case and that my newly rescheduled appt had been cancelled. Then when I called to inquire, the representative implied I had been told by an automated message of the reschedule which was just insulting after the annoyance of them messing the scheduling up. I totally understand closing for the day to keep staff safe off the roads...but you would think they would notify their clients in order to keep them safe off the roads for no reason as well, right? I won't be returning to any Swish dental location after now being repeatedly inconvenienced by their negligence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Garcia Galarza
user_reviews_extended.Description: They made me make an appointment to pick up my mouthguard only for me to wait 45 minutes and then the front desk person give it to me with paper instructions. Waste of time.

user_reviews_extended.Description: My most recent experience at this location was disappointing. The dentist came in after my cleaning and did not speak to me. All comments were directed to the dental tech. After seeing an issue on my tooth, he did not ask me about it, inform me of the issue, or seek to engage me at all. He looked at the tech and said "we're going to fill that" and then poked a few of the teeth and left. No explaining the process, what he found, checking of my bite or addressing the sensitivity I came in with. I am sure the other dentist are fine, but Dr. Evan seemed to not care or be interested at all.
