user_reviews_extended.Name: Odessa Betancourt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Swish! They make the whole process simple and seamless, walking you through every step.  The whole team is consistently incredible. Swish takes dental to a whole new level changing the game. I highly reccomend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Legeer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently left my dentist to come to Swish and boy did I make the right choice. My last dental visit before Swish felt transactional, and not that great, plus the new downtown location was perfect for me to be able to plan a late afternoon appointment and meet with friends after. All those points are no longer the most important.

I’ve seen Dr. Nessler twice, and hope I continue to have her taking care of me, but I’d bet bottom dollar the other dentists are equally as good. The techs and hygienist are fantastic as well. Dr. Nessler takes time to explain things as detailed as you would like. I never feel like she’s rushed or my questions are wasting her time. You can really feel her passion for her profession in these moments too. For me its always the soft skills that make the difference with any medical professional, and Dr Nessler has them in spades.

What I love most about Swish all together is their preventative approach to dentistry. They use cutting edge dental imaging technology that can spot where you’re teeth are wearing down, where you’re bite has the most pressure and where decay is starting to form so they can formulate a game plan for treatment to prevent issues before they arise.

Unfortunately for me, I came a little too late to catch a filling that had gone bad, so I had to come back and get it re-filled. Most pleasant filling I’ve ever had put in. Dr Nessler had a gentle touch with the novocaine and the whole thing was wrapped up in like 15 minutes and I felt more than comfortable the whole time.

They also have perfectly positioned TVs with Netflix on them for your viewing pleasure while you’re getting worked. The office lay out is open, airy, modern, and welcoming. Feels more like the starship enterprise than a dental office.

I’m happy I made the switch to Swish. If you’re looking for the epitome of what the highest level of dental care looks like, it’s time to make the switch to Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ruth Vail
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been going there for two years and spent a lot of money getting cleanings and xrays. Last Month I wasted my time coming in to find out they refuse to do a cleaning and referred me to a specialist. I went to Westgage Family Dental, where they have been in business since 1979! They were able to do a deep cleaning and took xrays. They found 4 cavities, which was never told to me by Swish! Unbelievable that they are terrible at assessing teeth! But that's what you get when you go somewhere that has a revolving door! Don't waste your money here!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a bridge come loose and my dentist was not available for several days. Swish took me in that day and did a professional repair the same day. I am thankful and grateful! Fantastic service. Folks highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Wondra
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Swish Dental, the fast-food equivalent of a dental office. Am I unsatisfied?  Extremely...beyond.  Have any of my concerns/issues been resolved?  Absolutely not.  I am not a difficult customer, I do not complain, I treat others with professionalism and respect, and yet here we are.

My experience: came in for an Invisalign consultation, was immediately pressured into payment by Nyssa at the downtown location.  After asking to follow-up with the dentist for orthodontic-related questions, I was not contacted.  I came in for additional comprehensive cleaning appt, still committed to making this work and was still not able to communicate with the dentist about my Invisalign-related questions.  Waited an additional week, requested a refund and was told I initially had a 30-day window of the original Invisalign quote but because I had already made (a $1000) deposit/down-payment, there were no refunds allowed.  I then shared my concerns with the regional manager, Delilah, who still has not made any attempt to resolve the issue.  Literally has not returned a single phone call since after promising to follow-up with me.   I am now out $1000 for an Invisalign scam of a ponzi scheme with no Invisalign treatment.

Trust your suspicions, take your business [[actually, run]] to a properly managed & professional dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia T
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am in my third trimester of pregnancy, so before booking this appointment I made it clear that I could not commit to a procedure requiring multiple visits. I was specifically told the crown would be done in one appointment.

When I arrived, the receptionist asked whether I wanted to pay in full or half now and half at my follow-up appointment. That was the first time anyone mentioned a follow-up. I then found out they were only planning to place a temporary crown that day.

I was also given a consent form stating that gum tissue would be removed as part of the procedure. That had never been disclosed to me during the initial discussion, and I believe that is something a patient should be told in advance.

At that point, I cancelled the appointment because what was being presented to me was not what had been explained beforehand. I was then charged a $50 cancellation fee.

After that, I asked for confirmation of my refund and requested my X-rays so I could get a second opinion. I was told the refund email would be sent later that day, but by the end of the business day I had received neither the refund confirmation nor my X-rays.

What bothered me most was the inconsistent communication. I received different information from the hygienist, the receptionist, and the doctor. Afterward, the doctor told me the gum tissue might not actually need to be removed and that the crown normally takes 2 to 3 weeks, which contradicted what I had been told before.

As a pregnant patient trying to plan care carefully, I found this experience stressful and frustrating. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Ok - so this time I had two visits - the first was a 6 month checkup with whitening and the second was to remove old silver fillings (very old) and replace them with new fillings since Dr. Minnie spotted decay around the edges of the nearly 50 year old fillings.

First visit - as alway - the team is awesome! VERY professional, prepared, cordial and personable. The cleaning and exam went well - Dr. Minnie identified 2 old fillings that had to be replaced.  Whitening treatment also was excellent and easy! zero discomfort - applied by a well trained professional with personal care.

Second visit - one week later I scheduled my filling replacement - Dr. Minnie and team had me in and out in just over an hour - the before and after photos were shocking - and pleasing, how these old fillings had shrunk and needed replacement with up to date materials. They took extra care to ensure the silver amalgam was safely removed and not swallowed (by me) and levels the bite perfectly!

As I've said before, this is one of the best dental teams I have ever experienced! Incredibly nice, funny, professional and caring. They should easily be rated top in Austin - possibly in Texas and beyond!

If you need top notch dental care - you cannot do better!

Everyone from the front desk to checkout was professional and, again, extremely kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Clendennen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist and staff.  They did an awesome job fixing my tooth and I would definitely recommend them.  I've had a lot of dental issues and have seen many dentists, so trust me when I say they are great 😀

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia McCune
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a dental emergency and everyone at Tech Ridge Dental was quick to help solve my problem immediately! They were kind and thorough and completely professional. Best of all, problem solved! I look forward to seeing them again in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachael Gravelin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech Ridge Dental went above and beyond, as always. I was having trouble scheduling, due to my own schedule, and Ken & Dr. Minnie would reach out with appointments that would become available frequently. They also really helped me out after an insurance change. Dr. Sean & Teresa were absolutely wonderful to work with during my appointment. Thank you for being so amazing. I’m proud to be a patient of Tech Ridge Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: april Villarreal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The entire team at Tech Ridge Dental are absolutely amazing. From the welcoming front desk members greeting me by name to the technicians care and conversation to put me at ease and the dentist explaining their course of action. Dr. Minnie Ma called me herself to check on me after my visit to ensure I was feeling okay and was recovering well.
Thank y’all so much for everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Russ and Naomi Bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Min listened to complex details of my puzzling  dental needs and used her compassionate and knowledgeable expertise to come up with helpful next steps with fair prices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience every time! Minnie and Sean are both so nice and knowledgeable. The hygienists also know their jobs very well. And the front desk staff are friendly and knowledgeable. They even have TVs on the ceiling so you can watch something while you get your teeth cleaned!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Our Kev
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have taken young (4-6yrs) children here, as well as had serious work done myself.  Excellent level of care and professional office staff kept me on schedule.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelvin Stenson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff was great and I appreciate how they checked on me throughout my visit to insure that I was comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diego Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Tech Ridge Dental exceeded my expectations.  The interior design really transports you from the strip-mall location.  So if you hate strip malls like me, don’t let that deter you.

The team were extremely competent and kind which made the entire flow from my entrance to my exit simple and easy.  There’s something to be said for the clarity they provide during the experience as well.  After my exam they were clear with me about work that might need to be done in the future while walking me through my x-rays. They even presented me with a print out of my teeth, labeling them green/yellow/red to represent healthy/monitoring/needs-attention, respectively, which allowed me to feel knowledgeable and in control of my dental health.

I’m actually excited to be going back for my fillings!

If you’re looking for a dentist in Austin, you can’t go wrong here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Pretorius
user_reviews_extended.Description: Stop searching- you’ve found your dentist! After trying a bunch of different dental practices, a friend referred me to Tech Ridge Dental years ago. I love this place! I completely trust the dentists (who are also lovely people) and feel super comfortable and confident receiving my dental care here. The dental hygienist I saw today was fabulous and they all provide such thorough and comprehensive care. Highly highly recommend. They’re the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonell Kuntschik
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am so thankful for finding this Dental office. You walk in and you are greeted by Whitney, Destiny and Zeida.  They are very professional and their smiles make you feel welcomed. Dr. Tarek and his assistants, Cali and Cabi, are the best. You are told up front what the cost is. Love how they make you feel comfortable, almost painless,  during your procedure. Dr. Tarek has the best sense of humor. I cannot praise this group enough.
JoNell K

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was pleasantly surprised. From my initial call wanting to schedule my first appointment to my actual appointment, the experience has been very professional and helpful. I liked the office and the atmosphere, feeling comfortable and welcomed. I’m so glad I chose this dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melinda Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Tech Ridge for 13 years and I couldn't be happier. They know me; they're incredibly helpful and friendly -- they meaning everyone on staff. Despite the very intimate and small-town feel (that's how I'd describe it), the facility and all their equipment is state of the art! Can't say enough good things about them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Lester Strings
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech Ridge Dental has been amazing! The staff are incredibly welcoming and friendly. The doctors were very efficient and professional, and they even gifted me a teeth whitening appt as a wedding gift! You can tell they care about their patients, and I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for dental care. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khushboo Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: My best experience in lifetimes. Appointment went very smoothly and staff was very friendly. I went for traditional cleaning of teeth. Doctor was very polite and my hygienist was super sweet in nature. She explained everything in detail and answered all my questions. At the end of appointment, they also gave me goodies!! I would definitely visit again. I am absolutely making them as my regular dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Riccobene
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a first class 5* dental clinic. I am glad to be one of their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is so so nice, everyone was super pleasant and kind. The best dental office I’ve been to. You can tell everyone is well taken care of because of how friendly they are. I immediately felt comfortable here which is rare for me. My concerns were addressed and I am super happy with my visit. I highly recommend this location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shauna Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love, love, love this place! Dr. Minnie listened to my concerns and requests, then provided me with options on how to proceed with my dental work. You can tell she is a genuinely kind person by the way she treats her staff and patients. Highly recommend this dental office.

What is a dentist's favorite animal? The molar bear!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brennan Russo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Outstanding experience! If you’re looking for the best dentist in Austin look no further!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paulina Prado
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had scheduled a routine check-up and cleaning, and I must commend the entire team for exceeding my expectations. From the moment I entered the facility, I was greeted with professionalism and warmth. The atmosphere was welcoming.

I particularly want to highlight the outstanding service provided by the hygienist. Their attention to detail and expertise resulted in a thorough and comfortable cleaning experience, earning them a perfect score in my assessment.

Overall, my visit to Tech Ridge Dental was truly commendable, and I wanted to take a moment to express my gratitude for the exemplary service provided.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theresa Greyson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is dentist office is such a safe space. Everyone there was incredibly nice and welcoming; the dentist was super informative and answered all my questions. My favorite person was the dental tech who did my cleaning, she was a blast to talk to! I came in with a stress ball because I was nervous, and she put me so at ease that I didn't end up needing it. Highly HIGHLY recommend this dental office, please go here and support them. They are amazing ✨️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Griffith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love tech ridge dental. I have been with them for about 3 years now. The staff is always amazing and friendly. I have gotten the chance to have both doctors and both are great. The staff always keeps you informed on your appointments and any changes that may come up. They keep up to date with your insurance and let you know if any changes (recently happened to me and they called me weeks in advance to let me know). Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Gomez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely recommend this office to everyone! I’ve had some horrible experiences since childhood and let me tell you they have completely changed my perception of a dental appointment. I am so happy I have finally found a dental office I can feel confident in going back to. No unnecessary work done & the honesty I am so grateful for. Thank you Dr. Sean, his assistant, and all of the front office staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Wenzel
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place and everyone who works here is incredible. I’ve had dental fears my entire life and the great people at Tech Ridge Dental have alleviated all of them! Painless cleaning and painless fillings and they were so transparent and detailed with everything and everyone there was so kind. I actually look forward to my next cleaning! I wish I could give more stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Britt Ricke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr. Ma! She is very informative and gives precise directions and explanations. She listens to your concerns and develops a plan to accomplish your desired goals! All the staff are very friendly and customer service is A1, which we can't find anymore these days!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bethany Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctors and dental assistants here are extremely honest and knowledgeable on what they’re talking about. Let me also add that I was unfortunately late by 15 mins and they still managed to squeeze me in. I would most definitely come back here and recommend others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonia Silva
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit was wonderful! The staff was very professional and thorough during my exam.

user_reviews_extended.Name: 王聖芬
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience with Tech Ridge Dental. I’ve visited several dental clinics before, but this is the first time I’ve found a doctor who genuinely cares about their patients rather than just focusing on profit. They explained everything clearly and made sure I was comfortable throughout the visit. I highly recommend them to anyone seeking professional and compassionate dental care! I’ll definitely be recommending this place to all my family as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Harmon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First Session: Very professional and friendly staff, and excellent service.  I highly recommend them if you are seeking an overall positive experience.

Second session: I had the pleasure of receiving services from Lucy, the hygienist.  I was impressed by her professionalism.  She did a great job of educating me on every aspect of care.  To be honest, I thought bleeding gums was a requirement of flossing.  I had this assumption because many other hygenists at other dentist offices are aggressive in their use of this cleaning aid.   This brings me to my second point, Lucy exhibited a high degree of care in the treatment.  I didn't have a moment of discomfort, everything was done mindfully and with sensitivity.  She even told me to let her know if anything was uncomfortable during the treatment.  The final aspect of treatment was that she was personable, and relatable.  I know I am receiving a service, but at the end of the day, we are all people first making our way through the world together.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Stevens
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t normally leave reviews but my visit here went off amazingly well! I hadn’t been to the dentist in quite some time and was extremely nervous but they were all very kind, respectful, and professional and made things very easy and gave a straight/non-judgmental path forward to resolve issues that had been neglected for quite some time. Many thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Britney Rossman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Always a 5-star experience at Tech Ridge Dental! The staff is super professional, kind, polite, and fast.

I had a change in insurance that I was unaware of this time around. Before I could figure out how to address it, the front desk had already, conveniently texted me that they’ve got it handled. I just love them!

Update:

Just to update everyone on how amazing they are…

I’m currently pregnant with our second child and within hours of me getting home from a routine appointment, Tech Ridge Dental had sent me a box of diapers for our new bundle of joy 🥹. That’s the kind of special touch that keeps patients for a lifetime. I have never experienced the attention to detail that TRD has anywhere else.

Another Update:

They’re still giving five star service over at Tech Ridge Dental. I was forced to bring my 2 year old to this appointment and the team made him feel like a very special guest!! He enjoyed watching mommy get her teeth cleaned and loved the sticker options (smile). I just really appreciated how welcomed I still felt, even with a little one. He was on his best behavior because the energy was so loving. Thanks so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my second visit.  The staff is exceptional!  Check in is a breeze thanks to the office staff.  Ellen, the hygienist, has my gratitude for always providing me with the best patient education. She takes the time to thoughtfully answer my follow up questions.  My oral health and teeth cannot be in better hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robyn Mayo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech Ridge Dental has always been a pleasure. The staff is amazing, and so helpful with information.  They always put me at ease, even when I have major issues that need to be dealt with.  I love my dentist! And try and tell anyone about them when they are looking for a new dentist. Drs. Minnie Ma and Sean Ma are Amazing!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Ligad
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s no wonder they have 5 stars! Great office, great doctors.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental! They do an awesome job of caring for my teeth, and I so appreciate all the information and explanations they provide! Also, they are all very kind! Thank you, Tech Ridge Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie Stokes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone was so awesome at TRD. From the  time I walked in I was greeted by Lindsey who gave me the best directions and a warm smile. My hygenist Lucy has the best bedside manner ever!  Professional,  personable , she made me feel so at ease,  snd explained everything in detail . Dr. Minnie was kind and  Professional
as well. She gave me plenty of options for my treatment along with a warm friendly handshake. Going out the door I met Ken whom helped me understand the billing part of it all. Great advice Ken! Thank you guys See you all again soon!!!!

Angie S.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Catano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down best cleaning i’ve had ever. Lucy was so gentle and made sure if I had any pain to let her know. Went in expecting the worst discomfort and pain but left smiling and happy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Piper Makenzie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Neverrrr had such a good experience at a dentist office . Friendly atmosphere everyoneeee there is sooo nice.
I dident even wait 15 mins before being taken back.
They are bot trying to jip u for ur money, they are transparent with prices and what best fits ur standards and needs

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juanita Breedlove
user_reviews_extended.Description: For over eight years, Tech Ridge Dental has been our family dentist, and we absolutely love Dr. Minnie. She is efficient, gentle, and intelligent. My children always leave feeling comfortable with clean teeth. Thank you for being a part of our family's support system.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Latiolais
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love tech ridge dental, everyone that works here is friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful! Dr Minnie and Lucy are awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: amy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was really worried going in as this was my first experience with a dentist office in Austin. After my visit, I can confidently say that my worries were unnecessary as everyone here is incredibly kind, welcoming, and thoughtful! From the moment I walked in until I left, there was nothing but pleasant interactions. Would wholeheartedly recommend to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barbara Hanlon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental. I've been a client for many years and they've taken great care of me.  They are very knowledgeable, professional, and friendly. I feel at ease when I'm there and I also appreciate how they don't pressure me to have work done if it can wait.  I signed up for their dental plan since I don't have insurance coverage and it's worked well for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: myra
user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone with dental anxiety, tech ridge has healed that for me. All of the staff are super kind and friendly. Dr. Minnie is so comforting, professional and sweet. Dreaded going to the dentist before but I am looking forward to coming back regularly :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Cohen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is very nice here. They have a friendly staff and a great annual program for cleanings and discounts on dental work. They are not high pressure and give you the necessary data to make decisions with transparency and no scare tactics that I’ve experienced at other dental offices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isa Moreno
user_reviews_extended.Description: Timely, friendly, informative and it’s the first dental cleaning that I wasn’t wincing during the cleaning or x-rays. I was actually comfortable and relaxed. I enjoyed my hygienist, Ellen and Dr. Sean. I look forward to our continued medical relationship. Feels so good to have clean teeth. 🦷🪥😬😀

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krishella Chandler Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am extremely pleased with the service I receive when I visit Dr. Ma and his staff!  Everyone is amazing.  This is one of the best choices I have made regarding my dental health and wellbeing.  I would recommend this business to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gregory Robertson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Nguyen Ma is the best dentist I've had. Their new location at Tech Ridge is superb and their service is excellent!!

Update:  I went for a teeth cleaning last week during the middle of all of this Covid-19.  Their services are still incredibly professional and I felt completely safe in the environment. Still a 5/5 for delivering such incredible quality.

Update: I went back in June 2021, the staff is still incredibly deserving of a 5 star rating!

Update: I went back November 2024, Dr. Sean helped me and I'm very grateful for his expertise. I highly recommend this office to anyone in ATX.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liana Rawley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Good service from whole team, informative and detailed in after care. I liked that they went over insurance coverage estimates for the visit so I know the amount I'll be covering for the most part.

Gental touch for abcess doctor and nurse helped relieve, tested for possible cause and described steps in moving forward for a root canal needed due to dead nerves in tooth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really liked this office it was clean and the entire staff is so nice. I came here because I had a tooth ache for a couple months and other offices I went to did not help at all but when I came here the dentist did several testing to find the solution and given instruction and have been tooth ache free. This is the first time I come across dentist that actually care for your need and want to help.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Wade
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My granddaughter was somewhat fearful and started to feel overwhelmed but Luciy made sure she took the time out to reassure her all was gonna be ok multiple times.
Excellent customer service from the front desk personnel as well

Tech Ridge Dental rocks 💜

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jay Zavaleta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech Ridge Dental has professional, knowledgeable staff and up to date technology! I highly recommend them to anyone needing preventative dental care or anyone needing extensive dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tabish Chasmawala
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely great experience. I honestly was nervous about going to the dentist for years. The entire experience, from scheduling to diagnosis to cleaning, at Tech Ridge Dental was smooth and they took extra steps to make sure I was comfortable the entire time.

Dr. Minnie was amazing at explaining what was going on and treatment options.

Ellen was absolutely incredible at cleaning - 11/10 experience! Could not recommend her more. Didn’t feel much discomfort at all and I swear she must have done something different because my previous cleanings were not as easy. Super friendly as well!

Ken was easy to work with on scheduling and payment - very clear and upfront on what to expect.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Cogossi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Due to covid and other factors, I had not been to the dentist in a couple years.  I had my first dental visit at Tech Ridge yesterday (6/19) and WOW-Impressive!  Everything you hope to find in a dental office.  VERY friendly, professional, knowledgeable, thorough, efficient, honest, transparent and reasonable.  Awesome experience and my teeth feel amazing after one cleaning/check-up.  Not much more to say except go see Ellen (hygienist) and you will not regret it.  It was nice to leave the office and know I found my new dentist and hygienist as long as I live in Austin! Michael-49

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabi Boyle
user_reviews_extended.Description: An office full of kind people who want to help! I love how understanding and patient everyone is, and I appreciate that both the techs and doctor explain exactly what’s happening to me. They will also show pictures to you of what’s going on in your mouth, and the ceiling TV makes it way more comfortable. The dentist usually makes me so nervous but I love this one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ruth cong
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don't really like to write reviews, but feel like my dentist and his team deserve this one! I am very happy with their caring manner and professionalism. I will be referring my friends and co-workers. 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ngoc Do
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been to Tech Ridge Dental for a few years now and the team here is simply the best. They always address all my concerns and make me feel comfortable. Ellen is who I always go to for my routine cleanings and she is super sweet and gentle.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Kazakov
user_reviews_extended.Description: I switched to Tech Ridge Dental in 2023, and very happy so far after 4-5 visits. Dr. Minny, dental hygienists and assistants are all very professional, friendly and quick. They always give a detailed answers, match my insurance prices and i trust their recommendations on 100% (no upsell). Thanks again, and i already referred 2 of my friends to you

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tylan LeDuff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Minnie is the best along with the other staff! You will always be welcomed with a bright smile and receive excellent customer service and care. I've been with Tech Ridge dental since I was a kid and I am so happy they have taken care of me all of these years. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Bassett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough kind words regarding  Tech Ridge Dental. The location is easy to find and nicely furnished. I was able to fill out my forms online with their customer portal which made check in a breeze. I was even offered water or coffee while in the waiting room to go back which I felt was a very nice touch. The technology they use is very impressive and they explain it all so well. The staff is by far my favorite part. They were all very kind and understanding regarding my fears for being at the dentist. They made a difficult situation so much better just by taking the time to work through everything they planned to do which helped a lot for me. They took my concerns to heart and adjusted our treatment plan to best work around what I was comfortable with. I felt like I was in good hands and will continue to work on my smile knowing I have a great team behind me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Burrow
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've loved my experience here. They're responsive, easy to work with, and make me very comfortable. They communicate great over email and phones, they've helped me with everything from choosing my insurance plans to recommending ointments for my face acne... unexpected benefits for a dentist! After having two cavities filled here, I can say that the experience has been quick, clean, and satisfying.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick P
user_reviews_extended.Description:
At 67 years old, I have had a lot of dental visits to a lot of dentists. Tech Ridge Dental was recommended to me recently by my manager at work and, aside from the office being a little hard to find the first time you go there, I consider that office visit to represent how focus and commitment can work wonders.
Information presented very well. and the bottom line is what I saw and heard impressed me enough that I am never getting dental care elsewhere. These guys rock!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Crosswhite
user_reviews_extended.Description:
8/21/24 Update: they are still amazing - Tech Ridge Dental is the best dental practice I have ever been too.

I was referred to Tech Ridge Dental from my neighbors and could not be happier! The entire  staff is incredibly nice and thorough. Both Dr. Minnie and Dr. Sean came to say hello, and Dr. Sean broke down all of the things he was looking for during the consultation. I know they also offer treatment if you are afraid of the dentist- our neighbor sees them with nitrous gas and it is a pain free experience. They are very upfront with pricing and the cleaning was gentle and quick!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MJ Gerhard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had sooo many dentists and never wrote a review until TRD. Tech Ridge Dental is the best dentistry I've ever experienced. Everyone there is incredibly pleasant and the visits are always great! I would've never thought I'd look forward to dental appointments

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abrar Chowdhury
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I LOVE Tech Ridge Dental! The staff is incredibly personable and knowledgeable. The dentists, in turn, are accommodating, empathetic, and professional. Difficult to go elsewhere after here. To everyone at Tech Ridge Dental🦷🪥, thank you for being incredible, cheers 🥂

(Thank me later 🤪)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ma is a great dentist and my experience with him and his partner (also Dr. Ma) has been nothing short of amazing. They really care about the patient, give great advise, and I have never felt any pain with any work that has been done on my teeth. My choppers look great and I will keep this as my dentist even if and when they have to replace all my teeth cause of my age. Ya gotta go see them. Mr and Mrs are down to earth, and give a real “family” comes first feeling.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriel Long
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Doctor Sean and his wife are truly great. I’ve been a patient for some months now. Customer service is so good, the assistants are super gentle and cheerful.
Procedures are well done and very professional.
I had a crushed porcelain veneer and they did the replacement, no questions asked, no issues at all, perfect the first time, and it looks exactly the same as the original one. Thanks for your support and care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental office so friendly and professional just love it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this dentist. I've been going here for every cleaning and check up since 2018. Every dentist, hygienist, assistant, and front office staff are super friendly and caring. They answer every question I have (and sometimes more than once because I want to make sure I fully understand). Love this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judy Kitchens
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The best dentist office ever! The staff is always very friendly and cheerful every time I visit. Plus, there is no wait time. We love this place!

My husband and I became their patients recently, and we are in love with them! Both doctors genuinely care about our total well-beings, they are patient, they take time to discuss the treatment plans with us and they do a super job! The staff is amazing as well, they are friendly and efficient! We would recommend them to anyone without hesitation!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Mork
user_reviews_extended.Description: The care at Tech Ridge Dental has been excellent. My appointments have been very thorough and comfortable . It’s a friendly, professional practice. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Jahren
user_reviews_extended.Description: I will never go to any other dentist in austin! Lucy the hygienist was super friendly, answered all of my questions and got my teeth super clean. Dr. Sean was very kind and thorough, he actually found a couple things that my previous dentist never bothered mentioning to me. It felt like he actually cared and spent the time to explain anything I had questions about as opposed to just trying to rush me in and out like my previous dentist 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: J
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Today was my first visit to Tech Ridge Dental, and I couldn’t be more pleased with the entire experience.  Booking the appointment could not have been easier, and it was even followed up with a welcome call prior to the appointment by Dr Sean.
I appreciated the prompt, professional, and friendly service from the very beginning, and my actual visit was perfect.  The entire staff was pleasant and cheerful, and very professional.  The exam by Dr Sean and cleaning I had performed by Paige was excellent and thorough, and they made me feel comfortable and well taken care of the entire time.  I’m looking forward to going back to take care of a few issues that were highlighted during my visit.  Yes, actually looking forward to visiting the dentist again!

These guys are 100% pros.   I couldn’t recommend Tech Ridge Dental more highly.  Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morris Haywood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a wonderful experience. I love when they clean my teeth. Because of Tech Ridge Dental, I have a more confident smile. Also, there music selection and TV channel selection while getting my teeth cleaned is the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bianca Frisaura
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It’s been two years since I’ve been coming here and let me just say my first review (below) is still 100% true! I can even go as far to say that I ENJOY going to the dentist because of how amazing everyone at tech ridge dental is. Look no further this is by far the best dentist I’ve ever been to.

ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC! As soon as I come in I am immediately taken care of (no waiting around like a typical doctors office). The staff are all incredibly polite and nice- they genuinely seem to love their job. Everyone is extremely informative, efficient and helpful. Dr. Sean is a great dentist who is thorough and truly cares for his patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rita Fish
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Tech Ridge Dental for 4 years now, and I’ve always had a positive experience. I’ve never had a long wait time, the front desk staff is super friendly and helpful, the dental hygienists are thorough, and Dr Sean Ma is personable and knowledgeable. I don’t have dental insurance, so I use their dental savings program and it is an awesome program. Even though I only see this crew twice a year, I’m always greeted by name and enjoy small talk with every employee. I feel like they truly care. They even sent me a personalized baby gift when I had my first baby this year. Who’s dentist office does that?!?! Love this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Lippitt-Drohan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience during my first visit at Tech Ridge Dental. My hygienist Ellen and the front desk associates were all super sweet and friendly. Dr. Sean was also great, really informative and kind. I would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janet Sharkis
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s always a great experience to visit this dental office.  They are knowledgeable and caring.  The dentists actually call to check on patients themselves. The hygienists and dental assistants are top notch. (I am not an easy patient.) The business staff is helpful and efficient.  My kids and I have gone here for years and we all love the folks at Tech Ridge Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Pham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update August 2024
My family has grown since the last review. My little girl is 6 1/2 and I now have a 4 year old son. The littles see Dr. Minnie for their cleanings as she's known as the kid whisperer in the office. They really do love her so I'm a believer of the nickname her staff gave her. I go back & forth between Dr. Minnie and Dr. Sean depending on my schedule. Either way, you're getting an amazing dentist and their team have always been awesome & helpful. I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental for you & your family!
_____
Dr. Minnie & Dr. Sean are awesome!  They take so much time with you and explain every part of the process with you.  My 16 month daughter got her 1st cleaning with Dr. Minnie and was all smiles afterwards.  The staff are extremely nice and makes us feel so welcome each time.  You can definitely feel the positive vibes coming from everyone when you're in the office.  I'm glad we found Tech Ridge Dental to take care of me & my family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jazmine Lockman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place. My family come here and my brother in law family come here. I hated going to the dentist and I have not seen anyone  over 10 years. There very good at what they do and very kind. I love talking to the staff super kind and always friendly.  I would not go anywhere else. Promise they will not let you down.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Guzman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sean and Mercedes were so great today for my visit. Although their office is out of network with my dental insurance I continue to go there because of how comfortable the entire office makes me feel. You can catch me there every 6 months getting my teeth cleaned. Schedule your appointment now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fernando Carrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Tech Ridge Dental is awesome. The hygienists are extremely nice and friendly. The doctor is polite, respectful and very professional. Outstanding service and very positive results. They really go out of their way to make the visits as safe as possible for everyone during these times.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miriam E
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent service! Then dental hygienist was very gentle with my daughter's cleaning and seemed to genuinely care about her experience at the dentists office. The dentist was great! Definitely recommend!

UPDATE: Had a 6 month follow-up and new patient appointment for our son and the service blew me away! The hygenist was friendly and gently with the kiddos and very accommodating as I had both kids scheduled back to back. Our son had had a horrible experience at a different place before finding tech ridge dental and was worried about seeing the dentist. But, awesome service made his day! He said he REALLY enjoyed his cleaning and is looking forward to his follow up! We are patients for life! Thank you for the great work y'all do!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alecxander J Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Minnie is great! Same to Dr. Sean, Ken, and Lindsey!

Eta:
I've never waited longer than a minute in the waiting room, and when I'm in there, I feel super welcomed. All of the staff does a great job getting to know you and the level of care and attention you get is great. They're all very nice and they do their job amazingly well! Shout out to Dr. Sean and Ken for being fun to joke around with!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Harbin
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff is so friendly and efficient. I love my hygienist Ellen. She has genuine concern about my dental health and healing. Dr Sean is very gentle when working on my teeth, and he always takes his time talking to me about my progress. When I leave their office, I feel like I was the only patient there, because I get so much personalized treatment. I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Dooley
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Dr. Sean and Dr. Minnie! We tried several dentists in town, but were constantly pushed to buy different products/services. You won’t encounter that at Tech Ridge Dental. We’ve been regular patients for a few years now. They’re easy to work with and very transparent with their pricing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Tech Ridge Dental has been great. I had not been to a dentist in too long. What I needed done was explained in a straight forward manner, with enough detail that I understood everything that was going on.

The staff is very pleasant, responsive, and professional... despite my shenanigans. The facilities are comfortable, everything seems clean and in working order. The dental hygienists were very competent and friendly. They even have blankets for if you get chilly! I would recommend this dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allyssa Asban
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to Tech Ridge Dental is an experience. I’ve had only my initial cleaning appointment, and I’m so impressed. I had put off going to the dentist for years and not once did they didn’t make me feel ashamed of it. Dr. Sean was very kind, he went through my x-rays and our plan of action in detail. Didn’t feel pressured at all, and provided plenty of options for treatment. Ellen was so great, she was so friendly, incredibly personable and really made sure I was comfortable. The cleaning itself was a breeze, and after the cleaning, Ellen throughly went over tips on how to maintain gum and overall teeth health. The front staff and their office manager Ken were so friendly and personable. They’re an all star team. They also offer a self-pay plan that really helps those without insurance. They are truly unlike any office I’ve ever been to before. I wish I visited sooner! I trust them with my oral health and would recommend them to anyone! Especially for those with any kind of anxiety!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shwu-Jiun Yang-Murguia
user_reviews_extended.Description: My whole family and children been going to Tech Ridge Dental since they open.  The location is great. Facility is clean.  The doctors and their whole team are awesome.  They listen, caring and  skillmatic!!  I love going to them.  I also love the clean feeling on my teeth after the visit.  They gave me the confidence because my teeth are health and looks great. Definitely will continue going till Dr Ma retired.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandy Howard
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is so friendly & so welcoming! I appreciate how thorough & gentle each of my hygienist have been--Krista & Ellen. Dr. Sean greeted me on my first visit & went over my treatment in detail. Ken, the office manager & insurance coordinator, keeps me informed on what I should expect to pay before each scheduled visit. He even updated me on some changes coming this fall with my insurance that way there are no financial surprises. This office is run superbly & I think they should receive more than 5 stars. I'm glad I found my new dental team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raghav Kidambi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lucy and Dr.Minnie were friendly, professional, and extremely courteous. I never felt like I was made to do something I didn’t want or like. Overall a very pleasant experience. Glad my wife recommended me to switch dentists. Delighted with the service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Forrest Brandenburg
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with the team at Tech ridge dental has been nothing short of amazing. Chrissy, Paige, Dr. Sean, Yamila, and Ken are all top notch (the rest of the staff haven’t immediately interacted with me but let’s be real- good people bring good people together. I trust everyone here ) and they have been nothing less than accommodating for me. I consider myself an anxious patient and through every interaction the staff remained respectful and empathetic. I hadn’t been to a dentist regularly in nearly a decade and now, I have obtainable goals concerning my oral health. Thank you for helping me find my smile again, you truly made a difference in my life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Steinberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: I never thought I would EVER say this, but I love going to the dentist! 😃 The staff at Tech Ridge Dental are amazing! Everyone is kind, friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable every time, all the time. Everyone greets me by name and answers every question I have, from billing to the nitty-gritty details of the dental work I'm having done. Tracey is especially terrific with a light touch, attention to detail,  funny, and so kind. Dr. Minnie is gentle, precise, and quick! She always calls to check on me a couple of days after a procedure. I appreciate the kindness and care shown by Dr. Minnie and the extended team at Tech Ridge Dental. Thank you for all you do!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: In search of an amazing dentist office? Look no further! I have had countless horrible experiences at previous places and I’m pleased to say that Tech Ridge Dental made my experience pleasant from the moment I walked in. All staff that I came in contact with was friendly yet professional. My dentist was Dr Sean and I loved the fact that he walked me through everything he as doing, it made me feel at ease. Paige was my hygienist today and the constant conversation helped with my fear and anxiety of being at the dentist. Thank you to everyone at the office for the wonderful visit, I’ll be back soon!

user_reviews_extended.Name: May Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient at Tech Ridge Dental for almost 10 years. Dr. Minnie MA has been my dentist during this time. She makes you feel comfortable and take time out to go through the process of the procedure.

All the staff is friendly and the environment is awesome. I would recommend this Dental office to adults and there children.  They're children friendly also.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ian Noble
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update 03/2024 - They have taken care of all of my family's teeth since 2015. On my last visit, the found popcorn in my teeth...what are the odds!? Great consistent work and a friendly staff.

Original- Their team is extremely personable and the office is a great environment. They'll continue to do well since they take such great care of their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miranda Price
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've always been a bit fearful of dentist offices, but Dr. Minnie and Tracey were so nice and made me feel very comfortable while getting my wisdom teeth removed! Everyone in the office is so friendly and thoughtful. Strongly recommend Tech Ridge Dental to anyone wanting a welcoming and knowledgeable office. So glad I found them!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mata Mata Media
user_reviews_extended.Description: My name is CK and I truly can't say enough positive comments about Tech Ridge! Dr Minnie and the whole team at Tech Ridge take customer service and quality above and beyond any expectations. I just recently had 2 crowns placed, on my front teeth, and not only am I'm more than satisfied with our results but the professionalism and care they provided throughout the entire process was more than comforting. I was followed up with after appointments, given great directions for proper care, and treated with compassion during every interaction. I feel every dental practice should take notes from Tech Ridge because in my opinion they are the leaders in the industry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Philip Yang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My family and I have gone to this practice since 2018. They’ve taken care of us from the start and through the pandemic.

We love that they have our dental care covered, handle all of the insurance details and are always friendly and welcoming. One of the best parts is the ceiling TVs with a huge selection of channels.

I’d confidently recommend this practice to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniela Nunez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is friendly, respectful, and knowledgeable from the exam to the cleaning to the billing. Dr. Sean is thorough, kind, and explains everything I need to know to protect my teeth. Tech Ridge Dental has the best service and highest quality dental services I've experienced!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bellisant Corcoran-Mathe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my wisdom teeth out at Tech Ridge and was really impressed by the care I recieved. The staff are welcoming, super friendly and knowledgeable. Dr. Sean was my doctor and he did a great job with my surgery. Really a stellar facility/business. I also really appreciate their payment options for those us without dental insurance. All in all, a great place with great people that I heartily recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edwina Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lindsey and Dr. Mini are awesome. Everyone I encountered at the office was warm and kind. Dr. Mini has excellent bed side manner and is honest. I’ll definitely be back! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cameron Fiddes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Really a fantastic dentist in every way possible. I hadn't been to the dentist in 10 years and was experiencing pain. I messaged Tech Ridge Dental and they responded extremely quickly and professionally. I was able to quickly set up an appointment and get an exam. I needed three teeth extracted and within a few hours of my initial appointment it was done. I had the three teeth taken out with only local anesthesia and I must say the experience was wonderful and I felt no pain. Every staff member from the front desk to the assistants and doctor were top notch. They were very clear about what was being performed and what would be necessary during aftercare. I just recently moved to Texas and I feel no need to look elsewhere for a dentist at this point. They have earned my business with great service and fair prices.

EDIT: 11/22/2025: Doubling down on the 5 star review. Another visit 5 years later and they are just as good as the first time. Very professional, fast, and efficient. Can't recommend this place more.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Tran Pham
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you want the best dental experience, come to TRD!!!!! Dr. Sean and Dr. Minnie are wonderful as well as the team in their office. Ellen is my hygienist and she has taught me so much about my teeth and gums and what I need to do to care for them. The process is simple and easy. TRD goes over everything in great detail so that their patients can understand. I have been a patient for over 11 years and would not go anywhere else. I love TRD!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriel Ventura-Swift
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everybody is so amazing and caring. I'm so thankful to have them as my dentist office. Every time I come they are also so sweet and I feel so safe and comfortable. Definitely recommend them!!! I will always be thankful for all they have done over the years, they are more than just a dentist's office, they are family!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alaina Fernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: These people are amazing! By far the best dental experience you will ever have. I have severe anxiety about the dentist and they are so sweet and caring. They offer nitrous which I need even for cleaning. They will give you a blanket if you’re cold. ❤️  10/10 would recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reyna Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the friendliest staff! I've been seeing Dr. Sean Ma for about 3 years now and I've been through it all, fillings, cleanings, and recently even had my wisdom teeth removed. There's never been a time where I didn't feel as though Dr. Ma and his staff were giving me the best possible care. They also work with you on payments and explain any questions you may have, needless to say they are very understanding. I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental to anyone looking for a dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: CHRISTIAN MUNOZ
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here is amazing and talented, they are young and very energetic. They are always smiling and always in a great mood, so contagious! They remember your name and face and make you feel at home from the moment you walk in. I never have to wait more than 5 minutes in the lobby, they are always on schedule. Their services and prices are unbeatable, they explain everything in detail and always go over my benefits with me. The place is so clean, neat and modern. Never thought that going to the Dentist would be such a pleasant experience. Can't wait to go back! Totally recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ian M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience! Wonderful front staff! Mrs Theresa and Dr. Minnie were informative and really diligent! 10/10 will be back again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dorothea Pitikas
user_reviews_extended.Description: It doesn't get much better then Tech Ridge Dental. My husband and I have been going here for about 9 years now and we've remained with our dentists here despite moving to Buda 6 years ago; they're just that good. I think it also speaks volumes that all their staff (front desk/admin/hygienist) have been there for years. Everyone knows us, it's easy to get an appointment, and they are gentle, kind, compassionate in their approach. If you are looking for a dental clinic that will take excellent care of you, Tech Ridge Dental is your place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Dahlstrom
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have a great experience at this dentist every time I visit. The wonderful staff here have taken the time to get to know me (and my husband too!) rather than making me feel like just another patient. Thank you Dr. Sean, Dr. Minhha, and the rest of the Tech Ridge Dental team for being so knowledgeable, professional, and friendly at each of my appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Herzog
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience at Tech Ridge Dental! Every person I interacted with from the receptionist who answered my first phone call, to the dental hygienist, to the dentist were all extremely kind and professional. Also they have a helpful financial option for those who are either out of network or who don’t have dental insurance. I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariane Dongho
user_reviews_extended.Description: Woow! What an amazing experience. I got my tooth extracted today by Dr Minnie. She is very nice as well as her staff. She put me at ease and I did not know when she was done. She explained all the process,  I really recommend Tech Ridge dental. Affordable for out of pocket too. Love it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Wilmer
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a new patient, the staff at Tech Ridge Dental created a friendly, professional, and comfortable first experience. The facility is very clean with small touches (like TV’s on the ceiling to watch during cleanings) that make the patient feel special. Both my hygienist and dentist offered me helpful tips to keep my teeth healthy without pushing a new product/ trying to upsell me. The front desk staff is also very kind and responsive. This is exactly the kind of dentist office I’ve been searching for! I’m looking forward to being a patient for years to come. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chuck Le
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time, and experience was much better than all my other dental visits. I needed a checkup/cleaning and Paige was amazing. Most painless visit ever. Dr. Sean was very nice as well and I’ll definitely make my cleanings every six months now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Stewart
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dental practice is by far the best in Austin. Everyone who works there is friendly, kind, and knowledgeable.  You're treated with dignity and respect and they listen to and honor your concerns.  Also, my appointment time is honored.  They are ready to see me when I get there. No waiting to get into the chair and be taken care of.  Excellent dental practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kira Lowery
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Tech Ridge Dental is incredible! I have never had a better experience with a dentist office. Dr. Sean is supportive and understanding of his patients needs. Paige is a wonderful hygienist. She is kind and takes the time to really explain what is happening and what needs to be done. I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental. They truly care about their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patty Pierce
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am the typical scared of the dentist girl, who put off going for way too long. Everyone was so nice and professional that it blew me away. The moment I called; I knew the experience was going to be a good one. You can tell ALOT about a business by their front desk staff and let me just stress, these people are awesome. I knew my teeth were bad, but everyone was so Non-judgmental, that they put me at ease and gave me a plan to move forward. If you are scared, like me, don't wait, make an appt at Tech Ridge Denta, you will not be disappointed

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittani Cunningham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went to Tech Ridge Dental today for a second opinion on some work that was quoted by another dental practice last week, and they were so kind and helpful. I absolutely hate going to the dentist after an unfortunate dental mishap from my teen years, but they were friendly and knowledgeable.

I was also nervous about asking for a second opinion after the previous dentist quoted me for thousands of dollars in dental work to take place over the next two years, but Dr. Sean gave me straightforward advice and answers and confirmed that I was right to seek out more information. They even provided new x-rays for no cost since the x-rays that the other office sent over were low quality and difficult to read. I appreciated their amazing staff, and I wish I would have gone here first.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barton Springer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my wisdom teeth removed last week. They were absolutely accommodating to me. I have never had any kind of dental work (or anything with a doctor at all!) so I was very nervous. Tech Ridge Dental made it a very easy and caring experience and I’m so pleased with every step!

user_reviews_extended.Name: M Esquivel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I'm so glad I called Tech Ridge Dental part 2!!
I've now had 2 appointments with Dr. Ma and his team.  Painless dentistry!!  I'm so impressed with this office.  I would recommend them to anyone!!
I get pretty anxious prior to my dental appointments.
Not this time, I'm so comfortable there.  I'm actually looking forward to my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michiko Matsuura
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update 2019 - I couldn't recommended Tech Ridge Dental more. We are at the end of a long care plan and they have guided me through thick and thin; from insurance woes to scheduling conflicts. I am very grateful to have found such an amazing group of people. They truly care about your well being and it shows at every step of the way. If you're looking for the best dental care in Austin this is the place to be.

2017- If there is anything I dislike more than writing a review (I almost never write reviews), it is going to the dentist.Years of wearing braces that induce headaches will do that to you. However, I had the BEST dental appointment today. Dr. Sean Ma made sure I was comfortable and explained the process throughout. This place has changed my outlook on going to the dentist. And while it's far from being my favorite activity, at least now I won't dread it as much. Thank you Tech Ridge Dental for treating me so kindly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peter Hayes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Been a client of Tech Ridge Dental since 2016 and cant recommend them enough.

Their staff has largely remain unchanged in that time which speaks highly of the management and team. Along with this, my partner used a nearby chain dental clinic who quoted a significant and expensive set of procedures, which seemed suspicious, and decided to get a second opinion at Tech Ridge, who didn’t see any need for what the other place quoted and insisted upon.

I keep coming back to Tech Ridge Dental for these reasons. Great staff and great service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courteney Feld
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was a great experience for my first time! Paige was super sweet and friendly. Everything seemed very sanitary and orderly for the covid situation, and it was a pretty quick visit, especially considering that there were new patient protocols to take care of. The people at the front desk were also very friendly, and I'm really happy with my choice to go to this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Sands
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys are amazing. Best dentist I have ever been to. They are very professional, incredibly easy to work with, very polite staff. They focus on their patients a lot, they are incredibly attentive, they really take the time to get to know you as a person and make sure they are addressing any concerns you may have!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristy Trinh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a patient for over 5 years and plan to keep coming back unless I move out of the Austin area.

Tech Ridge is friendly and personable. I trust their expertise and enjoy their bedside manners. Truly a win-win

user_reviews_extended.Name: Garrett Kost
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely love Tech Ridge dental - they have a great system to send text reminds and you can fill out paper work on your own time over the internet. You literally just walk on, tell them your name, and sit down while you wait for your appointment time, I’ve always gotten in a few minutes early even.

One thing that stood out to me was how great their X-ray equipment was - no pain or discomfort from biting on the mouth piece, which I previously thought was the norm.

Ellen and Dr.Sean are fantastic. In particular, Ellen is very thorough at the cleanings and you can tell she really cares about your health and oral hygiene. The front desk personnel also always know what insurance will and will not cover, making going to the dentist so much less stressful.

I can’t recommend this dental team enough, I don’t see myself going anywhere else in Austin

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Wooley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Still feel the same all these years later!
Still feel the same! —> Love Tech Ridge Dental! Everything about them is great! The vibe is so happy and the staff is so friendly. You can’t help but smile while there. I really feel like they care for my well being/oral health. Had a tooth extracted yesterday but it was a breeze!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Barger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech Ridge Dental gives the rare experience of a smile & cheerful greeting the moment their clients walk in the door.  In addition, every staff member including the doctors are pleasant and professional.  They fully understand how your Insurance plan works & that sometimes work has to be done incrementally for financial reasons. They are just a great group!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carolyn Markgraf
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was recommended to Tech Ridge Dental and so glad I was. All the staff is extremely friendly and welcoming. They are following guidelines due to Covid-19 and I felt very safe and comfortable.  Everyone is professional, very thorough, and super easy to talk to. Happy to have switched. If you need a new dentist, this one is sure to make you smile!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ari Cohen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Honestly, the nicest and best first experience I've ever had at any dentist in my 42 years.

I have unfortunately been to a lot of dentists, as I have moved a lot in my life. I take good care of my teeth, but I've had a fair amount of work done. I'm always nervous to go to a new dentist because they usually give me the runaround and try to sell me expensive "packages" and fearmonger me into fixing things that aren't even really bothering me.

From the moment I walked into Tech Ridge, the staff were super friendly and ACTUALLY LISTENED TO ME, instead of spewing some regurgitated sales pitch. They gave me a discount for their savings plan and I am very impressed. My teeth are healthy and it encourages me to come back. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Budnick
user_reviews_extended.Description: I Love the team at Tech Ridge Dental. Everyone is very competent, professional & very personable. The doctor was awesome & has a real eye for details on the current condition of my teeth and what I need to do to help preserve my teeth. Love the front desk team too! Great experience & would highly recommend TRD.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim Sass
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service. The Hygenists is knowledgeable and informative. Such a great place to go when you have get your dental work done. The Receptionist is always jolly and enthusiastic. If you have questions, they have answers. Let my family know about them and they are allowing new appointments. Must have as a provider.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kat Glur
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was a little apprehensive about all the 5-star ratings. But after my first visit I can see why. The hygienist was very knowledgeable and talked of recent studies she had read, which tells me she keeps up with changes in the industry. The dentist was super-friendly and made me feel at ease. I feel like I got a very thorough cleaning and check up and even learned a little.

UPDATE: since my original review in 2018 above, I've continued to see Paige and Dr. Minnie. They continue to be amazing. And I actually look forward to my cleanings/checkups. The front office staff is so friendly as well it feels like I've been going there for decades. And they have excellent Covid protocols.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lourdes Lizett Melgarejo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing, caring, efficient staff. Prices are great for those of us that don’t have dental insurance. I had an amazing service! They were very great at explaining everything, they took their time with me, and actually helped me see what my better options were instead of just trying to shove a product to you. The best dental care I’ve received.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobby Orr
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the front desk, to the hygienists and dentists, this office is the absolute best. They do things the right way and everyone at TRD treats you like family. My hygienist, Ellen, will do a wonderful job making sure that you are comfortable throughout the entire appointment. Highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melodie Lundquist
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just Love everyone that works at Tech Ridge Dental.
They are always so happy when they see me,  they always
make you feel so welcomed there. They don't hound on you too spend an arm and a leg on getting working done on your teeth that doesn't need to be done.  I have referred some of my coworkers there and they come back to work telling me how awesome they are all there.  Thank You  Tech Ridge for all that you do... 😘

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Weisheit
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love this place. I have already recommended this place and I just left the office this morning!
The team was very inviting and friendly. My hygienist and sweet and listened to my concerns and was very gentle with her hands while cleaning. The doctor took time to speak with me before we did anything. They were so clear in showing everything they did on the screens so I could understand. Being deaf often causes issues of miscommunication and uneasy feelings at the dentist.
They understood that I had avoided the dentist for over 4 years because of bad experiences. This time was by far my best visit and they welcomed me with bright smiles!
Anyone who is not a fan of dentists this is the best place to go. On the real.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lorna Marks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot rave about this office enough!! I dread dental visits historically and since finding Tech Ridge Dental, I no longer cringe at the thought of dentistry!! Everyone here is so accommodating and kind and they really care about your quality of care. Regardless of who you interact with, you will have such a pleasant experience you’ll look forward to returning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Pedroza
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire team at Tech Ridge Dental is wonderful and caring. They are attentive and patient in explaining care and treatment plans.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janet Sharkis
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is by far the best dentist my family has had. I am not an easy patient (though I try.) I have a tongue that has a mind of its own and an overactive gag reflex. They have a very experienced team. Super gentle, kind, truly personal service. The dentist actually calls herself to check on patients. I never even knew that was a thing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dee Villa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Tech Ridge Dental was recommended to me, and now I highly recommend them to anyone as well! They are all very professional, approachable, and most importantly extremely knowledgeable.
In my experience, Ellen is the definition of an amazing dental hygienist! She is not only very detailed in taking the most possible quality care of you, she also takes the time to explain, educate, and recommend the healthiest and most practical solutions to improve your dental health to it’s best attainable condition. She’s simply the BEST!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lilly C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Let me start off by saying I WAS extremely terrified of the dentist from past childhood experiences. Now my feelings have changed. I wish I had taken better care of my teeth and found this wonderful place sooner. I recommend it 100% of the way. Everyone is friendly, caring and keep you updated so on your upcoming appointments. I feel like now a days customer satisfaction isn't what it used to be. Then I find places like this and I stand corrected.

Point of my whole review, stop searching for a dentist and just come here! I promise you won't regret it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Washington Jr.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATE 12/12/18: I continue to highly recommend Tech Ridge. After three years I went from being at risk to lower risk due to the doctors and staff at Tech Ridge.

All of my experiences here have been amazing. I rarely write reviews (this may be my first), but they deserve it at Tech Ridge. The staff is extremely nice, the place is clean and modern. I get the notion that they are using the best equipment available to them to get the job done. My previous experience with a dentist was terrible and Tech Ridge is a welcome change. I'd highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlin Lowery
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called Tech Ridge Dental when a crown suddenly came off at 7am one morning. Even though I was not a current patient, they worked hard to get me in immediately and provide exquisite care. They were very considerate of any discomfort I might experiencing and explained what they were doing and why throughout the entire process. They were also transparent about cost from the start and checked for my consent before conducting each additional step. They’ve made a fan out of me for life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shae Goeman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved the easy going, very kind, very patient, dental team woh greeted us with bright smiles and warm attitudes! Very clean with a very nice astatic keeps people calm and collected and they are very reasonable for anyone out of pocket or no insurance patients. Thank yall so much, my family and I appreciate yall!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Creekstone Creekstone
user_reviews_extended.Description: been going here for 8+ years love it and will keep going even though it is far-far from my home. Page is absolutely amazing (i feel like we are friends) Lindsey (at the front desk) is super friendly & inviting. and lets not forget about Dr.  Sean that keeps this place going. The entire team at Tech Ridge Dental are amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle De La Paz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've enjoyed every one of my visits to Tech Ridge Dental—and I've had six cavity fillings this WEEK. From scheduling my first appointment to my procedural recoveries, the Tech Ridge Dental team has made everything so easy!

First off, they are incredibly prompt with their scheduling—I've had to wait three months for an appointment at some other dental offices in town. They also provide detailed cost summaries during every visit, and they are 100% transparent with all out-of-pocket costs. The office manager, Ken, is very knowledgeable about insurance coverage and has helped us find the most affordable options.
