Furthermore, Dr. Minnie is incredible! I didn't feel a thing with the shots she's administered—I've had four in the past three days—and my recovery (jaw/gum soreness) has been a breeze. She also saved me from having a root canal, while other dentists I've seen this year didn't even catch my hidden cavity!

To avoid writing a novel, I'll list out the remaining perks of choosing Tech Ridge Dental, including but not limited to:
- Minimal appointment wait time (0-10 minutes)
- Ceiling TVs
- Quality sunglasses to block out the lights during cleanings/procedures
- Good music is always playing
- Advanced technology
- Intelligent, friendly staff

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Cooper
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot express enough how overwhelming relieved I am to have found this amazing team!
I made a phone call due to a emergency dental need. Lindsay answered and listened to my exact need and guided me in the most caring way. When I arrived to my appointment every protocol was followed with social  distancing, mask, hand sanitizer and a very clean office. Ms Sean was very comforting in my needs to understand my options. She was very thoughtful and attentive. Very grateful because I was in so much pain.
When Dr. Sean Ma came in he was a true heart for the matter at hand, he talked me through what exactly would be in my best interest and I was very comfortable with the next steps and understanding of procedure to follow and why,
Upon a follow up I was greeted again with care by Mercedes. It was so pleasant to be around a team that cares through every detail small or big! Thank you so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jolo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly people, they helped find out about my teeth grinding that I never realized. They are also very organized, appointments move at a nice pace.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been an active patient with Tech Ridge Dental for many years and truly enjoy the experience - very friendly staff and both Dentists are so engaging and patient. I am so Thankful to have them! And now I’ve returned from CA and came right back where I left off. I know that I am well taken care of with Tech Ridge and I will be referring family members to Tech Ridge.

Jason Gutierrez

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Onstot
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enjoyable, for a dental visit. Everyone was friendly and they all explained what they were going to do - before they did it. Thr Dr explained the plan, as we move forward!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rob Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love Dr Ma and the whole team at Tech Ridge Dental. Now that our kids are adults, the whole family, as well as some extended family go.

Update... had an appointment recently (May 2020) and felt they had done a lot of work prior to reopening to ensure patients felt safe going to the dentist,  as well as the steps they took upon my arrival and during my appointment.  Felt completely comfortable and safe.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chase Von Ach
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The most positive experience I've had in healthcare.

The staff here really know what they're doing. They communicate extremely well, present themselves pleasantly, and make you feel right at home.

The cleaning I received was exceptional (as the tech was thorough yet gentle). Going to the dentist usually gives me high anxiety (as I have very sensitive teeth) so this was really helpful.

From the moment I walked in I could tell this place was different. The office is kept in immaculate condition and well decorated.

From first being greeted by the front desk to my final conversation with
Dr. Sean, this place delivered exemplary performance.

In short:

I won't be going to get dental work elsewhere; and look forward to their continued efforts at setting the bar within their field.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin O'Neill
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't speak highly enough about the team at Tech Ridge Dental. Everyone is exceptionally kind, compassionate, professional, and dedicated to providing top-quality service. And they listen! I've had a molar extracted, an infected socket cleaned up, a large cavity redone, three deep cleanings, and several follow-ups, all with ZERO pain or discomfort -- both during and after the procedures. Dr. Minnie is fantastic, Ellen is the best hygienist ever, Chrissy is always personable, and Lindsey is just The Bomb. :) This team helped me really turn around my oral health, and I'm extremely grateful. If you've had really bad experiences with dentists in the past and have been putting off getting your smile in check, just go. You won't be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yolanda Whitehead
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After receiving a crown, my daughter developed an abscess on her gum. I notified Dr. Minnie over a weekend who immediately prescribed antibiotics to prevent the infection from spreading even more. The side of her face continued to swell over the next couple days so I reached out to Dr. Minnie for an update about it and she prompted me to take her into the office on Monday (her off day) so she could treat her ASAP!

The level of concern, care and urgency was so reassuring as a mother!! She safely extracted my daughter tooth and got her back to her normal self!!

That’s not all… a few days later we received a small token of love from Dr. Minnie in the mail, a gift card to Starbucks for my daughter!!! Omg as if she hadn’t done enough.. it melted my heart to know how much she cared to show my daughter that she was loved ❤️

I absolutely love Dr. Minnie.. she does amazing work, she’s thorough, kind and patient all while providing exceptional service!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miranda Fulenchek
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updated review: They are still amazing. ❤️

Posted 6 years ago: I've been going to Tech Ridge Dental for several years. The dentists and staff are wonderful. They always make me feel informed and comfortable while I'm in their care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Dang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a wonderful experience here at Tech Ridge Dental. Being a dentist myself, I spent a lot of time looking for an office that I can trust to do good works. But the search has come to an end because I have found my dental home. Went in today to replace a crown that was done 10 years ago. The whole process was easy, precise and totally PAINLESS (even the shot and that takes some skills!) But that was not it. I had virtually no post-op pain when I came home. The numbness went away quickly and I was able to eat like normal. The temporary crown felt great and it was only a temporary! Thank you Dr. Sean Ma and Tracie for taking good care of me. I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental to anyone looking for honest, excellent care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jermaine Jordan
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always I have never any complaints or issues when I go see these great folks. Very friendly and professional staff. Great service, great prices and great dental work. I have been 3 or 4 times already for anything ranging from cleaning to fillings and teeth grinding issues. I highly recommend them. Very calm, friendly, clean and efficient environment. 👍🏽

user_reviews_extended.Name: V
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everything was so great! This was my 1st time at the dentist and with having no insurance. Pleasant energy, explained everything thoroughly, sufficient timing. I will definitely be going back. Already passed their number on to my other family members 👍🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kandy Sowards
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful people and wonderful care. Everyone is kind and on top of keeping things running smooth. Dr. Sean was gentle and I had a good recovery with no problems. I got the perfect amount of numbing shots and didn't feel a thing.  The bad tooth is gone and I'm healed up. Definitely a recommendation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place and great people with fantastic service, would recommend to anyone who asks which dentist office to go to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: butterfly431000
user_reviews_extended.Description: I think Tech Ridge dental is the best dental place in the whole world. Ken and the rest of the staff team there are incredible. I give this place 10 stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julija Matevosyan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great family practice! Attentive dentists that are doing a great job! Been going there for years now and am very satisfied. They also never push any unnecessary treatments on you and, therefore, when some procedure is really needed I trust their advice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hillary England
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Minnie and all of the Tech Ridge family are just wonderful. Top notch quality of care. Remarkable attention to detail. Thorough and comprehensive patient-centered approach. Delightful, friendly, thoughtful and engaging staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Griffin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just joined this dental office and completed my first visit today! Great staff that listens and address your needs. Dr. Ma was very informative and helping me get back to a healthy status with my teeth. Can't wait for my future visit that will lead to an amazing smile. Keep up the good work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lara Barraza
user_reviews_extended.Description: After getting ripped off by those dental groups, I decided that it was time to look around  for a private practice. A friend recommended me to go to Tech Ridge Dental and I love it. I highly recommend Dr Sean M.  I have been to this dental office several times and  Dr. Sean explained me very well about the different treatments and recommended me the one that was more suitable for case and the most affordable for my pocket. He was very informative, answered all my questions, and offered any help he could give me. Dr Ma really takes the time to talk to you so you understand everything he is going to do. The staff is super friendly and helpful as well. I highly recommend.  I feel much better at Tech Ridge Dental than going to one of those dental groups where their  dentists are under pressure to meet their monthly quota.

user_reviews_extended.Name: C Oconnor
user_reviews_extended.Description: The minute you walk in the door, you are greeted with such friendliness. Everyone there, so kind. I am a scaredy-cat when it comes to dentists, but I am never nervous about going there. I’ve had two dental hygienist, Both of which are exceptional. It is just the best place ever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maddie Wheeless
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always the best experience at Tech Ridge Dental! Front desk is super friendly and always makes me feel welcomed. I have seen both Dr. Sean and Dr. Minnie and they are so professional and gentle. 10/10 experience every time I go!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chuck Mork
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The most efficient dental experience I’ve ever had. Clear communication and professional explanation during my initial visit.
Just had a cleaning, again a great visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kip Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience!  The whole team is super friendly.  As a dentist myself I would highly recommend either doctor Mr or Mrs Ma-- they've both taken excellent care of my teeth for the last 12 years.  Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: TETIANA DE LEON
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was my first time visiting Tech Ridge Dental and I’m beyond happy with my experience. Everyone is so welcoming, friendly and professional. Dr Sean and hygienist Paige provided the best dental experience I’ve ever had. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary McLaughlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is awesome. My wife and I have different dentist and we always go back and forth on how good they are. When it came to getting our two year old her first appointment, n=there was no question we were going with Tech Ridge. Dr. Minni is great with children and made our daughter feel super comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christin Vasquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is just incredible. They clearly strive to provide the best customer service possible. They send holiday cards, follow up calls after your appointments to make sure you're doing ok, and they even surprised us by mailing a baby gift when we were expecting! I have never received that kind of customer care anywhere else, let alone from a dentist's office. Love this entire staff. They're great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jackie Ayala
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Year after year, Nothing beats the friendly service you will find at Tech Ridge Dental.
From the amazing welcome staff at the front desk that always remember my kids names, to the fabulous dental hygienists who are both so knowledgeable and so funny. Drs. Minnie and Sean  are a amazing and are the heart that make Tech Ridge the family friendly clinic perfect for my family and yours!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theresa Alumkal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have a wonderful experience regardless of the nature of the visit. Both doctors are stellar and treat you like family! It’s great catching up with them, just regret that I only see them twice a year. I wish every healthcare experience was as good as here. This office has set the bar extremely high!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Curtis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had another great experience at Tech Ridge Dental. Everyone was very professional and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Threads Embroidery
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first appointment at Tech Ridge Dental. For me, the location is extremely convenient. The equipment is very modern and results in comfortable and fast x-rays and helpful in showing my problem areas. Front desk to Mr. Minnie Ma, all wonderful, courteous, fast and friendly. I'm happy to find such a wonderful office nearby!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael R. Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was recommended Tech Ridge Dental by a hygienist out-of-state, and they did not disappoint! I've been looking for a kind, courteous, comfortable dentist and I've finally found it. Best cleaning I've had in a long time too. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Hesting
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have been trying to find a dentist for the longest time. Recently decided to get my teeth fixed and my ortho recommended tech ridge dental. My husband and I went and we love the staff and Dr Sean and Dr Minnie! They’re personable, friendly and don’t try to make you do things you don’t need! The office itself is very warm and inviting! I’d recommend tech ridge dental to anyone looking for a dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frank L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Another great cleaning- Ellen is an excellent hygienist; the whole staff is always professional. Ken's scheduling office always extremely fast and efficient and  immaculate- I'm always quickly seen moments after arriving etc! Updated treatment plan, no hard selling- the best Dentists are HERE!! HIGHLY recommended!  Easy to get to, right off IH35 at Parmer, 6 Stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marla Jensen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hadn’t been to the dentist in quite some time as I had a traumatic past experience with several dental visits. The staff at Tech Ridge was extremely friendly, calming and gently discussed all aspects of my visit.
I’m so thankful to have found this great group of people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Sledge
user_reviews_extended.Description: My entire family has been seen and treated at Tech Ridge Dental and they're great. Hanging out at any dentist's office is not exactly my idea of fun, but visiting with them comes pretty close. They're the most courteous, timely and caring office I've found. I would recommend them to anyone in need.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful experience!!! The hygienist and the ladies at the front desk were awesome!! Everyone explained things in detail so that I understood.  I was told by another dentist that I needed work that Dr. Sean said was unnecessary now but that I would need in the future.  I felt that he was trying to do what was right for me regardless of how it affected the practice financially. In addition, I felt like Dr. Sean was the most knowledgeable dentist I have ever been to.  Highly recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suellen Lussier
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After 8 years and 3 other dentist offices around the Austin area I finally found a great one!
Everyone in this office was knowledgeable, professional, thorough and kind.
The office was sparkling clean and because of Covid they have implemented many safety protocols. I have been extremely cautious because of Covid and felt very comfortable during my appointment.
I really liked Ellen, my hygienist and Dr Sean!
I booked my next cleaning for 6 months out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marlet Yanez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Tech Ridge Dental is amazing. My kids and I have been going to them for more than 10 years. The entire staff is knowledgeable, friendly and make you feel at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claireen Finch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Moved to Round Rock and changed all my services (PCP, massage therapist, hair dresser, etc) except my dentist bc these people are awesome! The front desk staff (Lindsey and Ken) are so friendly and social. Dr Ma is awesome and really creates a personalized treatment plan and doesn’t judge me when I admit I didn’t floss between visits 🤷🏻‍♀️. Of course my favorite is Ellen who is gentle, thorough and fun to chat with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kellsie Kice
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My family has been going to Tech Ridge Dental for years now. They are very accommodating and willing to work with both your budget, and your personal preferences.

I have a rather large fear of injections, and both the hygenists and doctors are very attentive. We were able to find a solution that both numbs the pain of the procedure and allows me peace of mind.

The ladies at reception are amazingly sweet, and you can even pick your tv channel- it's ceiling mounted over each dental chair- during your visit.

I hope to continue to see the wonderful folks at Tech Ridge for years to come!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nia V
user_reviews_extended.Description: ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! I had a broken tooth that was causing me severe pain and they saw me the same day, and pulled it the same day even though it wasn't scheduled and took me straight to the back no wait just to relieve me of my pain. Everybody was so kind, and caring from the lady at the front desk to the doctors and nurses. I've never had a designated dentist but I do now and will be taking my son there as well. If you want honesty and a dentist who truly cares, this is the place to go without a doubt!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Wandrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've gone in for two visits since I moved to Austin a little over a year ago. Each member of the staff I've interacted with is insanely personable, and the service I've received has been great, albeit I haven't required anything beyond cleanings, x-rays, and fluoride. This was my first time moving to a new city and choosing a new dentist's office, and Techridge has definitely won me over for as long as I'm here in Austin. This place has great reviews for a reason and couldn't recommend it more

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Harkreader
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech Ridge Dental has been a great place to get my dental implant done. Sean Ma and his team are all super nice and the office is clean and modern. The technology they have is by far the most advance I've seen in a dental office. I do say they're a little more aggressive in their treatment plans, but in the long run it will help prevent any future problems.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Winkley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am scared stiff when I need to go to the dentist.  This was the first time a tooth was pulled without being knocked out.  Dr Minnie is fantastic!!!!!   She made me feel comfortable, cared about my anxiety, and her soft voice got me through the pull.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Q H
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So, I haven't been to the dentist in five years. I was a little bit hesitant about going to the dentist in general. Today was my first day at Tech Ridge Dental.

When I first walked in the door, Lindsey's bright red hair and big smile. She was very friendly and took care of my insurance paper work right away. I couldn't help but notice how clean nice this office looked.

My hygienist, Kim was very thorough with my cleaning and really took the time to show me how to care for my teeth. I could tell that she really cares for her patients.

Then Dr. Minnie came did my consultation. She was very knowledgeable and answered all the questions, and I had a ton. She was very patient and made sure that I was comfortable with all the treatments options. I would recommend her to anyone.

At the end of the consultation, Ken helped figure out insurance and my payment options. He made sure I knew exactly how much I was going to need for everything and made sure I was in budget.

Overall, 5 stars experience. I am looking forward to coming back and fixing my teeth. 😀

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Noble
user_reviews_extended.Description: I actually enjoy going to the dentist!  They are always timely, and the entire staff is very personable.  Dr. Minnie and Dr. Sean are absolutely wonderful, and I know that my teeth are in good hands.  I have been going to them for over 6 years now, and every time I've had a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: O O'Brien
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sean and his staff are fantastic. Such an upbeat and super friendly atmosphere. For great service at reasonable prices, I would absolutely recommend Dr. Sean. The office is clean and stylish. Not what you expect when you see the outside. Check in and check out very seamless. They use technology to make it as easy for you as possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Tech Ridge Dental! The whole staff is always really friendly and polite. Dentist, Hygienist and front desk are always very informative with everything pertaining to your visit at this office. I will always recommend this dental office to my friends and family. Keep up the good work guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: B Fusumada
user_reviews_extended.Description: Empathic, polite, sweet and professional staff. A real TEAM, this practice is everything you would want when searching for a great Dentist. Both Dr Minnie and Dr Sean strive to provide personal quality care in a family environment and are very understanding. Ken and the whole staff are wonderful and very united, you can feel the team work when you are a patient at Tech Ridge Dental. I have always hated going to the dentist due to anxiety and costs but here I always feel welcomed and cared for when I come here. When I couldnt afford the work to be done in the past they found a solution for me and I have recommended them to many friends and will continue to do so for the service they provide. This is an honest good, transparent practice that takes pride in what they do and always with a geniune smile. You guys are great. We will see yoi soon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michel Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It’s a great place with really good friendly people. I’ve been doing my routine yearly dental cleanup here for the last four years.

Every cleaning they do an oral cancer check and if it wasn’t for the professional work they do I wouldn’t have ever know that I had a thyroid problem. Went to a specialist and they verified that I had a thyroid issue. I wouldn’t have expected this coming from a dental cleanup but I’m very grateful.

They are honest and will work with you for whatever dental plan you need.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Briana Mahanay
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love everyone here! You can always tell when people love what they do. The Dr’s are amazing. And all their staff must be like family because you just get that vibe. Other business’ should take notice. When your employees are happy, the customers are happy. 10/10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Fuller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place. Will never go anywhere else. From the moment you walk in you can sense they are a family and they welcome you in. You can trust in their advice and know they care.  They try their best to accommodate any emergency you have. My husband and I have been loyal customers for years and we will continue to be loyal customers as long as they let us.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teo Jaimes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
TRD is the best. They are friendly, honest, knowledgeable, and kind.  We recommend TRD to everyone.

Covid Update:  I had been staying away, trying to limit my exposure since Covid began. A year later I finally went to my 6 month dental appointment.  I should have known better than to stay away this long. TRD has implemented all available safety measures and implemented a new and intuitive check-in procedure. It's truly amazing that their awesome service is not impacted by these tough times. Way to go TRD!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Merry M.
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys are the best!  Both the dentists and the dental hygenists are skilled professionals who really care about their patients and they offer the newest equipment and procedures. Everyone who works there is committed to making sure you are comfortable and your needs are met.  The entire office also has a very nice and clean atmosphere. Definitely worth the drive from Georgetown for me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allie Rolison
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely love the staff here. The facilities are clean and they use the latest tecgnology. With 2 dentists on staff, there are always appointments available at convenient times. Never a problem with insurance claims and they also accept Care Credit. I started going here about 5 years ago and am so glad I did. Best dental experience I've had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: emily sekul
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here has always been so nice and so accommodating from the front door and out! my teeth have been taken such good care of and i feel like they pay attention to every detail. they are very educational and listen to your needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MrKnobs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful combination of expert, caring dentistry and friendly, efficient , helpful staff!  They easily figured out what was causing my pain after another practitioner guessed wrong.  Of equal importance is their professionalism in keeping the patients, staff and doctors all COVID safe by  keeping the air in their office clean and circulating, and all except the patient  masked at all times.   And finally, they know who the best specialists are should you need one.  Great husband and wife team, two very skilled dentists working together to set a very high standard of care.  Try them!  :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evan Kice
user_reviews_extended.Description: These people are fantastic. Dr. Minnie is very professional, and walked me though ask the work done on my teeth with detailed photos. Everyone is always very friendly and happy to chat. They have a tv on the ceiling and let you watch movies while you get your cavities filled. It's great, 10/10.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gmail Account
user_reviews_extended.Description: You can feel extremely safe and secure going to Tech Ridge Dental through all this epidemic craziness. As always, the staff is friendly, courteous, and efficient. They make it seamless and my teeth are still perfect. Thanks for everything and stay safe!

user_reviews_extended.Name: courtney allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful dentist office! I had a minor tooth emergency when my filling broke over the weekend, I called first thing Monday morning and they squeezed me in at 11:30. They didn’t even have me wait in the waiting room, they took me to a room and got straight to work. I am 7.5 months pregnant and they were making sure i was very comfortable and okay during the entire procedure. Everything went so smoothly!! It was the best dental procedure I’ve ever had! They even made sure to get my bite right! Definitely will be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alvin wu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Highly recommend this place.  Ellen is one of the best hygienists I've had.  Super friendly and doesn't stab your gums to death while cleaning.  All the staff in the office are great.  Top tier all around.

Equipment and office are always clean.  Added bonus, TV's on the ceiling so you can watch home remodeling when reclined back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy Hicks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here is wonderful! The whole staff is friendly and helpful. I went here after not having been to a dentist for several years and ended up needing several fillings. I had them done over a series of weeks and the staff and doctors have been great every time I went. Dr. Sean even called later in the day after procedures and left his cell number to call him back in case of any issues. I would (and have) definitely recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LA T
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great experience yesterday. I haven’t been to a dentist for 4 years because of a very bad experience. I was so afraid but they really put me at ease. They were very professional and kind and gave me really good advices. I loved it !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morris Haywood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome experience. The dentists are wonderful experts. Been coming here for 10 years and I've learned how to take care of my teeth. This has been a positive dental journey that I can appreciate. Thanks again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Orlando
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don't often leave reviews, but Dr Sean, his wife Dr Minnie, Ellen and the rest of the crew at Tech Ridge Dental have always done such a great job for me that I want to say thanks with this review.

Here you will get so much attention and care from a staff that truly makes their office a positive environment.

I've been to other dentists that really seem to be all about squeezing as much money out of their practice as possible. They barely see you, try to tack on extra fees, try to push you into unnecessary procedures or make procedures you DO need more expensive (such as recommending full anesthesia for my wisdom teeth extraction). I had Sean perform my wisdom teeth extraction and that went as smoothly as could be with an oral sedative, full anesthesia was indeed not necessary at all.

Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Naomi Hoang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just recently came in for my routine checkup and cleaning with TRD. As usual, it was a wonderful experience! Ellen is an amazing hygienist, she really listens to her patients and makes sure they have all questions answered before the end of the appointment. She has a gentle hand all the while being efficient with her cleanings. My family and I have been coming here for over 10 years, I can't recommend TRD enough. Along with their hygienists and front desk, Dr. Minnie and Dr. Sean are fantastic as well.  If you're looking for a new dental home , TRD's the one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Tekleab
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech Ridge Dental is an amazing clinic with wonderful hospitality and professional work. Paige is very professional and her top-notch work and explaination is amazing. Dr. Sean gives thorough walk-through of everything and my overall experience was above and beyond ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis Lind
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Sean and the entire Tech Ridge Dental team are always so kind, friendly, supportive, and talented!

If you have had a bad experience with another dental team and you want help, but need a team you truly trust...

Tech Ridge Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Yannone
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience! Everyone was very nice, especially Lucy my hygienist!

The office is new and always clean! They have a lot of new technology that makes it one of my best experiences at a dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brianda Tamez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech Ridge Dental is the best dentist I have ever been to. The facility is super clean and comfortable with tv screens on the ceiling to distract you while they clean your teeth. Everyone is very nice and helpful with any questions or concerns. I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental and am even switching my 2 little girls over from their pediatric dentist as I just found out they also work with children!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Rico
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Tech Ridge Dental has always been very careful about keeping Covid Safe and they still manage to do their job in a very safe, secure, relaxing manner. I have the best hygienist who has superb hands (I hate having my teeth scraped with the ultrasonic machine and she does an amazing job of not making me jump from the sensitivity)
I wholeheartedly recommend them

user_reviews_extended.Name: AD D
user_reviews_extended.Description: I made an appointment to get checked on a wisdom tooth that was bothering me. The staff was amazing from the minute you walk in to the point you leave. A friendly knowledgeable staff. They are also taking all procedures during this pandemic which is very nice. Dr Sean introduced himself and took the time to answer all the questions I had and explained everything they had found based on the x-rays and pictures taken. I definitely recommend this dental office and will be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ricky Ratley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Sean was amazing! The entire staff and process was quick and seamless. I was a new patient with a very specific reason for my visit. They got me straight in, took one quick X-ray of the affected tooth and then explained my options for proceeding. They immediately gave me a cost for the procedure, and within minutes they were at work. Although initially they told me that it would be oral surgery and cost a bit more, within only a few minutes the doctor already had the extraction complete with zero pain and even reduced the agreed upon cost because to save me some money afterwards. All of this was music to my ears! So many offices that I’ve visited in the past would have taken a full mouth of xrays so that they could bill my insurance, rescheduled the procedure for another visit, and then charged the highest amount possible all while not really taking into consideration my input for my own treatment. The doctor and team at Tech Ridge truly provide excellent patient care like a well oiled machine. I will go back for all of my future needs. If you are looking for a new dental office you will not be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Me Me
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a painful situation and was expecting to get in the following day. Staffing was able to get me in the same morning,  dental needs and pain were taken care in a professional timely manner. I cannot thank the employees of Tech ridge dental for being so accommodating polite and welcoming, was truly a wonderful experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Burris
user_reviews_extended.Description: Drs. Sean Ma and Minnie Ma, I could not be happier with, as my dental consultants. Been going to these guys for years. When your a kiddo your moms picks your dentist and procedures. When you become an adult you pick and you want to feel great about the decision’s you make. My decision to use Tech Ridge Dental couldn’t come with a higher feeling of greatness. I asked Dr. Ma the other day, How come you guys don’t open more offices. He stated “It would become more of a business with added stress and less family like connections with patients” (or how I kind of perceived). Second thing he added was Dr. Ma ( the wife (as well as he)) gets to spend more time with the kids. For these reasons, you just found yourself a lifer my friends. Looking forward to our future visits and being added to the amazing Tech Ridge Dental calendar. To all the amazing staff at TRD. Thanks for being y’all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebeca
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went this morning for a cleaning, was referred by a coworker who sad they are awesome. They are! From the way I was greeted, to watching them interact with other patients. Sweetest people, excellent customer service, you feel very comfortable! They take their time to talk to you.  I just scheduled my second appointment here for 2 days from now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deana Deana
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional, skilled, caring and friendly. Exceeds expectations. Have been going to this exceptional dentist in my neighborhood for years since they opened in Tech Ridge and my teeth have been well cared for ever since. Good use of technology for appointment reminders, monitoring, treatment, and patient comfort. Very well run. Exceptionally clean and organized.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonya Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are great!! When we moved here three years ago I was so sad because we had a wonderful dentist.  But I didn't need to worry - we found this office when they first opened and they are so nice, helpful, have the latest equipment, and just really great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can not compliment Dr. Minnie and the entire staff at TRD enough. They are so attentive and personable. I had my wisdom teeth extracted and they made the procedure painless (literally) and stress free. Dr. Minnie took extra care to make sure I was comfortable and calm. She always goes out of her way to ensure that I completely understand the procedure and that any questions or concerns are addressed. If you have to go to the dentist,  I highly recommend this dental practice. You will not be disappointed.

I’ve only been a patient with Tech Ridge Dental for about a year and a half. I chose them after my previous dentist retired and after reading all of the great reviews. I had very high expectations going in, and I have to say TRD exceeded my expectations. The staff are great. They’re personable, knowledgeable, and very pleasant. I’ve seen both Dr. Minnie and Dr. Sean. They’re the best dentists I have seen. They go out of their way to make sure you are comfortable and they are always willing to take a few extra minutes to answer and explain any questions you have. I’m so glad I found them.

I recommend TRD every chance I get. “Amazing” is not a word that is normally used to describe a dental procedure, but the staff at TRD go out of their way to make sure your experience is the best it can be. The entire staff is great. Drs. Sean and Minnie really make their patients feel at ease about what is being done. They explain everything simply and clearly. And they always make sure I leave with all of my concerns addressed and my questions answered. If this is not your primary dentist, it should be.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Schumann
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So let me tell you this, if I could give Tech Ridge Dental a million stars I would. I just moved here from another state and had to find a new dentist asap. I am so grateful that my husband took the time to do some research and found them.
Best dentist ever!!! The whole team is just amazing, everyone is super nice, they took my fear and Dr. Minhha (Minnie) delivered exceptional dental work. They even called me a couple days later to check on me and my tooth. If you are looking for a great dentist  Dr. Minhha (Minnie) and her Team are the BEST!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Hoff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you thank you thank you! I had a horrible experience at my last dentist over the last 6 years. I liked  her a lot but the company she worked for not so much. I felt trapped and my teeth were only getting worse. My friend recommended me to your practice and I finally feel a a huge weight has  lifted off of me. All of your staff is extremely professional too! By the time I left we had a plan for my dental work and I feel good about my future smile and dental stability in a way that I have never felt before. So again thank you !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Londono
user_reviews_extended.Description: The front desk staff are the sweetest! Big shout out to Lindsey she always pleasant over the phone and in person.  Dr Sean and his assistant are both sweet and make you feel as comfortable as possible. Every person I have come across  in that office is always smiling and welcoming. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ahmed
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing doctors and staff ! They took care of my broken filling and filled my other cavity getting my cleaning here also! Would definitely recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Acevedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Minnie for any of your dental concerns. She did a fantastic job cementing back my crown that had fallen off two days before the new year. She was able to fit me in her busy schedule the day before the new year without me even having an appointment. I will forever be grateful. ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Amber
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was afraid of the dentist for years and a friend referred me to Tech Ridge Dental. They have helped make my teeth healthy and were so caring! They made me feel comfortable and now I feel safer when visiting for services. Best dental experience I’ve had in years!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larry Mathis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and caring staff. Exceptionally pleased with the quality of care I received. Will continue to go back for all my dental needs. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Sullivan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I felt very comfortable throughout the entire cleaning/comprehensive exam.  The hygienist was very knowledgeable, gentle, and kind.  The dentist that I saw informed me of everything I needed and, more importantly, everything that I didn't need to get done in a very direct and non-judgemental way.  I will be heading back here for a second time soon.  Thanks very much, Tech Ridge!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nghiep T. Tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: All dental equipment and tools are complete. The staff, including the dentists, are very attentive, enthusiastic, and honest, with no deceptive practices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kailee Mayo
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is incredibly friendly! made me feel safe and calm even after my nerves took over. They fixed a chipped tooth and made it look PERFECT. So compassionate and talented. Highly recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sarjina islam
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have enjoyed this dental office for a few years now. They don’t do procedures to take your money unnecessarily. I have been to many offices who offer unnecessary procedures. The staff, doctors and dental hygienists are amazing in this office. I never had a bad experience. They are very thorough with effective communication and very caring. I even got my wisdom tooth removed here and highly recommend it. They pay attention to details.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikia Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Tech ridge was great. Came in to get an filling and left out with just that and feeling amazing. I was comfortable, they attended to my needs, and made sure to ask about any pain or discomfort. If you are looking for a clean, comfortable, high tech facility, this is the perfect place. I highly recommended. Thanks Tech Ridge!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon Swarn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Picking this dental office has been great for me and my Husband I really enjoy having Dr. Minnie as my dr. she is very formative with her diagnosis and I will continue to go to this office as long as I live in the Round Rock / Austin Area never have I experienced anyone to be unprofessional it smell really nice and its clean the staff and nurse are amazing they help the patients understanding what we can do financially you have options and that’s always good to know because we all know that it can be very expensive so I give them FIVE STARs!!! Great Job Team for working together to make us as patients have a great experience.🥰🥰🥰🥰😍😍😍😍❤️❤️❤️❤️🦷🦷🦷🦷🦷🦷🦷!!!!  Thanks again Sharon Swarn

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Ko
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Lindsay (sp?), Ken, Dr. Sean, and Dr. Minnie are world class and it’s even more evident to me now that I’ve decided to stray from them for one cleaning/exam. What a world of a difference. I called them from out of state literally right after I had an appt with another dentist, running back to them after a painful teeth cleaning experience. They got me squared away with an appointment when I plan to be in town and Lindsay proactively called the other office to get my x-rays.

Yes, they are so good that I will cross state lines to see them. Thanks for being such an awesome team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Hartsell
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always, the team at Tech Ridge Dental knocked it out of the park. This is my 3rd or 4th visit and I have yet to receive anything less than stellar service. The receptionist didn’t even have to ask my name and already had me checked in once I walked in the door. My dental hygienist, Paige, is the best! She remembers all the little shop talk from my visits, which is nice, because on each visit we pick up on life stories where we left off the last time.  It makes dentist visits oddly “fun”, with how they make you feel right at home. There isn’t a single person in that office that I haven’t seen smiling almost the whole time. I recently moved further away from their office, but won’t even consider going any where else. Keep up the great work ladies and gents!

user_reviews_extended.Name: E
user_reviews_extended.Description: Knowledgeable and very friendly staff. They make going to the dentist a pleasure. I opted to finally get my teeth whitened "in-house" in addition to my teeth clean. The staff set proper expectations and provided me with all of the potential minor risks and benefits. It was well worth it! I will continue to have TRD as my primary DDS for the foreseeable future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: carolyn stephens
user_reviews_extended.Description: The services i received, were above and beyond from start to finish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: K
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sean Ma and his entire staff are very personable and pleasant. They always make my appointments as good an experience as can be expected. I'm very pleased with the care I receive and would recommend Dr. Ma to anyone who asks. Thank you Dr. Sean and all at Tech Ridge.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Carroll
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going in to see Dr Sean for several months now.  I cannot rave enough about this dental office.  All of the staff is prompt and extremely courteous.  Dr Sean takes the time to explain exactly what needs to be done, and gives the pros and cons of any procedures you need to undergo.  It's a sign of a good company that the front desk recognizes you by name on only your second trip in.

I've been pointing all off my friends to Tech Ridge Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Little
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful group of folks. Very professional, never judge your teeth, and always wanting to help your teeth health. Lindsey, Paige, and Dr Sean are always warm and welcoming every visit I have. I’ve been happily going here for the past four years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Fazin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience. I felt a little apprehensive in the beginning, because I was in search of a new dentist.  I had been with my former dentist for over 10 years and she sold her business.  I was so relieved to find a new dentist.  I also received a call the day before so Dr. Minnie could introduce herself to me.  I was impressed.  Thank you !!  I finally have a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Lawn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience for a first time visit. Ellen was very informative and let me know exactly what was happening. Learned  a lot about my teeth and gums and will take what she taught me home to treat my mouth better. Highly recommend the team at Tech Ridge Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Autumn Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly they make going to the dentist stress free. Paige always ensures I'm receiving the best care. The customer service is outstanding. One example is during the down pour they offered to walk out with me with an umbrella! I love rain so I politely declined

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon Morrone
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best dental experience I have ever had.  I wonder why my other dentists didn't use anesthetizing solution before cleaning my teeth.  My cleaning proceeded without pain which I greatly appreciated.  The staff is very friendly, and Dr. Ma is personable, professional, gentle, and discussed all my concerns quite satisfactorily. I am very pleased to have found this practitioner.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roxanne Kline
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was very good and Ellen did a great cleaning and she's very sweet and gentle. My teeth feel nice and clean. Thank you so, your office is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Toni D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Four years later I still give them 5 stars. Everyone, across the board, at this office is fantastic. The doctors, hygienists, the admin team are top notch. They make dental care EASY!  Year after year they take great care of my family's dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Bliss
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update 3/2021:  Same great service.

Update 12/2021:  Same great service.  You're treated with care and they remember your name.

Update 3/2021:  Just a cleaning, but I had my position "eliminated" so no insurance.  I found out Tech Ridge has their own plan for those of us without dental coverage--it gets you 2 vleanings, xrays, and exam for a nice discount, and ensures a discount for emergencies.  Sign me up!  Now if only I could get my wife to not "fear the dentist" in general.  😁🙃😷

Update 12/1/2020:  Went in for a cleaning and get a filling for a small hole that appeared in my tooth.  Fast work, and painless--I even got to see digital pics before and after, and my dentist followed up a couple days later to make sure all was well.  In a nutshell, this place cares about its clientelle.  The staff is always ultra-frienfly.  And they figure out the insurance so you don't have to.  It's a trifecta!

Update 8/26/2020:  Staff is still great  COVID precautions are still in place..looks like I need to floss around my bridges more, but at leastbefore I left I hot the pricing w/ insurance figured out gor me for a deep cleaning in the future and filling a small hole in a tooth.  Happy as always getying taken care of here.

Update 5/27/2020:  Things are as good as they can be with COVID-19.  Sonic tools are barred but my cleaning was fine and procedures are in place to stay safe.  I come here 3x/year and don't review each time, but I'll reiterate the staff is great and billing is the easiest I've had anywhere with insurance.

Update 5/28/19: Routine cleaning, great service...my wife's insurance decided her tooth replacement was a pre-existing condition since her company used a different insurer the year before and she was in progress...utter BS...but Tech Ridge was willing to work out a payment plan, though I just paid for the post they installed in full when I found out.  Another display of customer focus at TechRidge Dental.

Update 5/1/18:  I came in for a routine cleaning, but chatted about my wife's insurance--she's on mine and has hers--same ins. company, but boy, the ins. company was lost applying benefits from each...here's what's great about Tech Ridge:  they took care of all the red tape and headaches dealing with Cigna....that's the kind of service you get at Tech Ridge Dental.  Stellar folks!

Adding some more from 1/3/2018.  No changes in service or people.  I got to see the other dentist this time...he's as good as his wife.  They really pay attention here and work the extra mile to see that you're in the know and satisfied--there just aren't businesses anymore that seem to care about customers 1st...this is one that differentiates itself through customer care, however--from gentle handling if your dental work to really helping with billing and maximizing your insurance.  A+

2017:  Adding to this from a new visit-- Friendly staff, great dentist, and everyone is gentle with the person in the chair.  Communication is always ongoing and procedures, costs, opinions, insurance, etc. are discussed with all options laid out--very transparent.  You can trust your teeth and wallets here and know that pain is a foreign word during cleanings and fillings (I've had each).

1st Visit:  Great team!  I searched around for a dentist...the reviews brought me here.  They lived up to expectations.  They reviewed my insurance in advance and when I arrived, a tech was out so I had my teeth cleaned by 1 of the actual dentists!  Very gentle and thorough.  You can tell they like to know people here, not recruit clients--the difference may be lost on some, but this is differentiation through personalization--and it works.  I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Fontaine
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Well let's face it not many people wake up in the morning pumped and excited about thier dental appointments. Its just a fact.

If you are open if those people like I am I am here to tell you those fears can be put to rest.

This experience was by FAR the most pleasant experience I have ever encountered in 56 years.

From the moment you walk in you are greeted with a friendly smile and addressed by your first name, kind makes you feel at home.

Once they have you seated comfortably they go over the planed procedure in a way you can understand.

I was fearing that first shot to numb my gums kinda tense had the death grip on the chair arms.

I Closed my eyes and waited and waited and waited
Then the doctor said let that set for a few minutes and ill be back.

Wait what ?? Your done ??
I DIDN'T feel the slightest bit on pain.

Fast fwd and the end of my procedure I had still not felt one single bit of pain what so EVER.

This is by FAR the best and most professional group of providers I have ever had the pleasure of going to.

I can say with out a doubt that my next procedure i have I wont have a single worry.

If you are looking for a doctor that cares about your oral well being,  cares about you over all levels of comfort, cares about you and what you think

Go see this guy youll write a review and thank me I personally guarantee it.

Thank you Tech Ridge Dental for a awesome experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryy C
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best of  best! They took me same day and pulled my tooth all under 500$ and less than 2 hrs! Very friendly & knowledgeable! Thank you all so much! What a wonderful place! My life savers🥰

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The administrative staff is knowledgeable and patient. Dr. Sean is affable and personable. Great service all around. Everyone is so welcoming. They are like family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rena Kastris
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit was somewhat of an emergency-3 days of an annoying pain due to crack temporary bridge had gotten to me and I couldnt have picked a better dental group-very friendly-professional and efficient. Dr Minnie and assistant have the most calming voice reassuring me her repairs will be the best of her abilities-and it was perfect!! 60 minutes I felt like normal-thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Brackensquires
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was running late and everyone was very helpful and friendly. Excellent service, I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental!
Thanks again! See you in 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelley Pridgen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Tech Ridge will go above and beyond to adapt to any situation, from accommodating an impromptu appointment when possible to entertaining a very active four year old.  It is always good to see familiar faces and feel so comfortable at the dentist. Thank You Tech Ridge Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been a patient here for many years now. Great customer service from the front desk that is paired with friendly doctors and hygienists, make this an all around outstanding dental office. They are always honest about your health status without berating you about it. In all fairness, I'm sure the majority of us could do a lot more flossing outside of cleanings lol. If you're looking for a new dentist, or just a better dental experience I would totally recommend tech ridge dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Cardenas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ma  and to their team are amazing . They are huge about educating you. They listen to your concerns and take time to get to know you. They treat you like family. Dr. Ma truly cares about your teeth and smile. I have referred many friends and family. The practice is clean and modern and beautiful. 5 stars isn’t enough to rate them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyler Wood
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Extraordinary service. Like anyone, I've never enjoyed going to the dentist, but WOW! This office has it all figured out. Very friendly, courteous, and skilled staff with cutting edge technology in the office.

Highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dustin Mata
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was great to work with. Very thorough process.

user_reviews_extended.Name: André Foster
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very good looking dental office that gives a feeling of comfort. The staff are awesome! They make you feel so welcomed and they are eager to assist you. Very thorough in communication. I will be looking to change my dental provider soon!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Rico jr.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Sidney, my dental Hygienist and Dr. Sean both were great. I arrived on time, very clean office with good Covid-19 precautions taken. Sidney has stable gentle hands and I didn't feel a thing despite no use of the ultrasonic scraper (all manual now due to Covid). Dr. Sean took the time to explain everything properly and professionally and had a great way of explaining things so it's understandable.
Glad I went there, my wife and son are getting their appointments set up.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thet Mar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called the office on Monday to see if I can fit in for my sensitive tooth. Lindsey courteously got me in Wednesday at 11AM. Well, Dr. Sean was really concerned about my tooth cavity was too close to my nerve, so he worked on my tooth through his lunch time. Now I have no problem eating and drinking since I saw Dr. Sean. Everyone in Tech Ridge Dental is very helpful and really take care of patients!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Yohn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Despite exemplary care for the procedures I had done here, I am rating it low for two reasons - first, when I went in and had my xrays done, and talked to the main dentist about improving my smile, he loaded up a giant photo of my teeth and belittled me for my previous care, as well as for my aspirations to improve it. While he did agree to do the work, he did so begrudgingly, like he was doing me some massive favor, and laid the guilt on pretty thick. From then on I basically felt like a wallet whenever I went back, and not particularly welcome.
Second, and I found this out later, I was not on their insurance network and they failed to inform me of this, even after specifically stating more than once that I did not understand how my insurance was supposed to work and did not understand why their rates were so high. I was met with "This is what your insurance will cover." instead of informing me that I could have saved another 40% by going to a dentist that was within my network. Because of this I was swindled out of several hundred dollars that could have been put towards my own medical care, just to help  their profitability. This in turn only made me feel more like a walking check book. The staff was friendly but continued to hound me for more procedures even after I explained that I could not afford their rates and was looking elsewhere for a better solution.
Aside from the smug and unfriendly attitude of the lead dentist, I found the rest of the staff to be very friendly and professional. That being said, guilt trips don't encourage change, and a medical provider should know better.
I found out from another dentist as well that many of the dental problems that I was being guilted for were in fact due to things beyond my control, such as teeth alignment and acid reflux, which this team either failed to see or failed to acknowledge in favor of more expensive procedures than I currently need.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to this place by a friend who loves it and I was not disappointed!!!! The whole staff was extremely friendly, patient, and so accommodating. The dentist was very thorough  and took a lot of time explaining procedures and even asking me questions to get to know me as a person, not just another patient. I am soooooooo pleased with my experience there and cannot say enough positive things!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benita Chasmawala
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ellen and Dr. Minnie were so nice and friendly! They explained everything in detail. I recommend them for all your dentist needs! Oh and they have ceiling TVs so you can watch while they work on your teeth

user_reviews_extended.Name: spencer coleman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Squeezed us in on a holiday weekend when my daughter cracked her tooth. Dr. Ma was amazing and made explained everything so both me and my daughter could understand what was happening!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Tech Ridge Dental. I had a 7:30am appointment and doors were open when i got there. No waiting to have doors unlocked. Got checked in and called back within minutes. Staff is very friendly. Love this place. It's been several years that I can say that about a dentist and staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynnita Six
user_reviews_extended.Description: Finally, a well-educated, thoughtful dentist and staff that really put me at ease. Dr. Minhha Nguyen and her staff made me feel comfortable and confident in my care plan for the future. Thank you, Tech Ridge Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nickolas Buitink
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lauren was so friendly and professional, which helped me feel very comfortable. Sean, the doctor, was also just as friendly as Lauren, and he was fast! I got so much relief, and the staff helped me get in right away, which was very important for my situation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: P Markert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been there 3 times for different reasons and I have been very please with the entire staff. Everyone is kind and friendly. I'm not much for going to the Dentist but I will continue to return here for all my dental needs. I have referred friendly and family because I know this is a great place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lyn Hockaday
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was dreading the thought of getting my needed dental work done. To my surprise, it has not been the nightmare I was expecting.  The friendly and professional staff has certainly made a huge difference.  And Dr. Sean is so aware of his patients' comfort.

Thank goodness I ended up in that office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barton Springer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven't been to the dentist since I was 12 but after this trip I feel like I missed out on a lot! The staff was so warm, welcoming and helpful. They answered all my questions and handled everything smoothly and happily! Glad to have found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gaynelle Roach
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sean Ma and his AMAZING staff were all very professional, made sure I understood ‘everything’ related to my needs, provided clear options and answered all of my questions. I never once felt anxious during the procedures which is a first for me. This is the greatest group of positive and endearing individuals who offer excellent service!! I want what they have regarding a workplace. Namaste to their entire team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evaristo Celis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In my opinion, best thing I can say is I wish I had gone into dentistry and wound up working here. My review is pretty much the same as everyone else's. The entire staff is awesome and welcoming. This may sound a little twisted but I don't even mind when it comes time to pay the piper, in this case Ken.

Both my wife and I have had more than your average work done and have gotten calls the next day and a couple of days later to see how we're doing.

Having said this, my best contribution to spreading their awesomeness is a friend of mine was in serious pain due to a wisdom tooth coming out wrong. At the time we worked night shift together and he had told me that he couldn't get an appt for another 2 weeks. I told him to let me see if I could do anything. I called the office that morning and asked if it would be ok for him to call. They of course said sure so I provided him with the number. They got him in right away and although I don't remember the specifics I do remember that everything was taken care of or planned out that same day.

They will stop being my dentist when they retire, I retire and move out of state, or the last certainty in life. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DeAnna Dennis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist. The whole office staff is helpful and accommodating. They always have the latest in technology and are gentle. Makes me not dread going to the dentist! And they always remember details about me, my nick name, they ask about my family, and the tv channel  I like is playing on the ceiling tv! :) I recommend them!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Nowotny
user_reviews_extended.Description: We always have the best experience at Tech Ridge Dental! We've been with Sean and Minnie since they opened their doors! Love sending people their way!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pam Sands
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office caused me a great deal of anxiety and I would absolutely not recommend this practice to anyone. Their customer service and processes are inadequate. The front desk is okay and helpful but the management and dentists are unprofessional.  Do not uses this practice if you expect them to do their job in acquiring information needed to work on your teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniella Maria
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for a little over a year now and everyone from the receptionists to the dental hygienists and assistants to the wonderful dentists themselves are just so kind, helpful and knowledgeable. I always trust my teeth are in good hands. I will never go anywhere else if I can help it! Highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristine Dalmacio
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at tech ridge dental is the best!  I've gone through many dentists/hygienists and dental office staff in my adulthood, and I will say that the service at this office is the best I have ever had.  I have sent many friends and family to this place and they all love it as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renan Evangelista
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We'd been to several dental clinics in search for the good service and I guess the search is over. In the last 2 years with Tech Ridge, they did  a tremendous jobs: nice and friendly staff; knowledgeable and accommodating Hygienist; and Dra. Minnie and Dr. Sean expertise  are outstanding.
Even my kids notice that big difference.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arly Alexander.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been seeing Dr Sean (and sometimes Dr Minnie) for about 7 years now. I begrudgingly  came here after an extremely fractured relationship with my previous dentist, and had absolutely no trust in them. Both Dr Sean and Dr Minnie handled me with kiddie gloves as we established a plan to address my weakening teeth. Overtime my trust in them grew due to their patience and consistency. What started out as tearful anxiety ridding appointments have turned into chatty laughter sessions. I always see the hygienist Ellen who always greets me with a smile that radiates from behind her mask. I’m impressed by the things she remembers about my family or details from a conversation she’s had with either myself or my husband. Lindsey, the badass tattooed redhead that holds the front desk down makes you feel great from the moment you call or walk in with her energetic greetings and smile. Ken is always willing to talk Basketball if you’re a sports fan. Even more so if you love the Spurs. They’re all amazing- Chrissy, who also helps up front, Shaun who assists Dr Sean, and Paige another hygienists.

I’ve learned that a few folks are apprehensive with going to the dentist. If you have any level of anxiousness this is where you need to be. You will not feel pressured to buy unnecessary products, services, or shame for having bad teeth. However you will feel they genuinely care about your oral health and want to see you thrive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Kittle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dentists typically make me a little nervous. The experience I had yesterday was miles ahead of any other dental experience I’ve had. Shoutout to Lucy for the painless experience and attention to detail.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Hart
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech ridge dental, and of course the dentists that work there, are fantastic. I moved from Austin in January and still have business in Austin, so I have not even bothered to look in my new city. They are probably the best dentists that I have been to in my life. (56 yrs old , 4 major cities). Love them. You can’t say that about most Drs or dentists I bet!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Carreon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech Ridge dental doctors and staff have been so kind and caring to myself and my daughters...my daughters did not have the best experiences with their past pediatric dentist but Tech Ridge truly made my girls experience a new found experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Acevedo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have always been apprehensive toward reviews on Google and Facebook because it usually those that have poor experiences that write them. However you can see that this place has nothing but glowing reviews and with reason.
I started seeing Dr. Minni back in the spring of 2015 and have not missed a 6 month cleaning since (I never had consistent dental coverage prior). I initially just went in to see her about a broken molar, but have continued to see her and her awesome staff despite living on Slaughter Lane.
As many have mentioned, the staff is incredibly kind, they answer all of your questions and insurance issues are dealt with quickly. My hygenist Ellen is so awesome and sweet. I usually make my appointments to meet with Ellen and Dr. Minni, but one time I had to meet with Dr. Minni’s husband who was just as kind. I highly recommend this facility and hope they never move or retire or close!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit ,So informative gave me every option to see which one was best for me. Very friendly and welcoming staff . I haven’t had my dental work done you but I will keep you guys informed .Iam expecting great work done from the impression I got and I’ve only heard good things about their work.They also have an awesome insurance guru that will help you understand and tell you the best options to help save you money.I don’t remember her name sorry but shout out to her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: karla lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our family has been going to Tech Ridge Dental since 2015 and will continue doing so. They have excellent service, and their staff is amazing - you really feel like a part of their big family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Wates
user_reviews_extended.Description: Stop what you are doing right now and make an appt with Dr Minnie 💕💕 hands down the best dentist (& staff) I have ever been with! I have EXTREME anxiety and fear of the dentist, and ever tech and each time I saw Dr. Minnie was great! They explained everything in detail and literally held my hand through every cleaning and filling! Calling to set appointments or talk about insurance is a dream because the front desk staff and Ken are the most helpful and patient people! You can tell it is a family run business and the whole team feels like a family! Also, Dr Minnie has tiny skilled hands, so you can’t even tell she’s working on your cavities lol!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for years and always have a great experience. The staff is friendly and personable and the doctors work with me to ensure the best outcome possible. My insurance is not in their network but I would rather pay out of pocket than go elsewhere. 5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Harness
user_reviews_extended.Description: It is always a great experience to get my teeth cleaned by the beautiful people at Tech Ridge Dental. The attention to detail is immaculate, and the genuine quality of care is ever present.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dana Liburdi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I drive 3 hours just to see my dentist and their staff. They are the BEST!  Want a top-notch dentist who also makes you feel relaxed? Go to them one time and you’ll never go to anyone else again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deserrae De Leon
user_reviews_extended.Description: We found Tech Ridge Dental 5 years ago & it’s been amazing!! The doctors are the sweetest! Staff is superb, facility is always welcoming. Wish we would have found them sooner.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tomislav Sicaja
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Tech Ridge Dental for few years now for a reason. Every single staff member is super nice, they all make you feel very comfortable, and the service is excellent. I highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mari Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a first time guest I was very pleased! The Staff is super friendly and I felt like they really took their time cleaning my teeth when in comparison to my former dentist ! I highly recommend visiting Tech Ridge Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marie Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: It's just like "Cheers" you walk in and they know your name. I've been coming to see Dr. Minnie for a couple of years now. I love this place, I love the staff, I love the easy to find location. I get my goodie bag every time I have a cleaning. I get to take home a toothbrush, toothpaste and floss. I keep these at my work office desk, so easy and convenient. Thank you to everyone there!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dr Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had an old filling replaced by Dr. Minnie (Dr. Minhha Nguyen Ma) and I have to say it was the most comfortable and painless experience I have ever had for this type of work.  This tooth was in the far back of my mouth so I'm sure it wasn't' an easy task.  Dr. Minnie and staff are very professional, super-clean and safe environment, and I was in and out quicker than I expected.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tech Ridge Dental is the absolute best! Dr. Sean and Dr. Minnie, and the entire team, are some of the nicest people I have ever met. I always feel comfortable and relaxed when I am there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: heather balusek
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone in the office is AMAZING, attentive, friendly & and highly competent! I actually love going to the dentist!!;) Dr Sean, well I can’t say enough good things about him! He is so compassionate towards his patients and treats them like family! I definitely recommend TRD!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gerri Hoffman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great care given while cleaning.  Excellent staff!!! I was under a significant time crunch and they moved my appt up, kept track of the time, and got me out super early so I wouldn't have to rush to my next commitment.  Thank you so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jairus Pegues
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love my dentist, they have so much to offer in the lobby alone; assorted coffee a computer and Stylus pens! Front desk is awesome you can contact them via email. Third there are 📺s in the ceiling. Finally the range of dental services provided are above top notch, its a family affair, literally!

user_reviews_extended.Name: katie bynum
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dentist is by far my favorite I’ve ever been do. I just recently moved here and needed a dentist, due to my anxiety of dentist and just teeth in general I put this off for as long as possible. I did my research and decided to call tech dental. Just walking in the door you get a good warm welcome. Lindsey (the receptionist) welcomes you with a big smile and loud hello (not loud in a bad way). She will welcome you by name, if it’s your first time she questions it but still says your name. Which is quite nice and makes you feel comfortable and welcomed. And hygentist (I cant remember her name) was very nice. She conversated with me throughout the whole visit about good places to eat & other things. It wasn’t just awkward silence or just talk about teeth. Dr. Sean is very knowledge and helpful. They both answered all my questions. I had to come back a week later to get my cavity filled, Lindsey remembered my name even after a very big dramatic hairstyle that most people don’t recognize me with (I chopped my dreads off after 5 years of having them).
