My hygienist, Hannah was very bubbly and good to talk to. She answered all my questions and conversated about things other than just teeth. This is the best dentist I have ever been to. I highly recommend them to anyone and everyone. They answered all your questions and just make you feel like family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wenping Zhu
user_reviews_extended.Description: This clinic is not honest. It is not in my dental network, but they never mentioned this to me until one of the claim they submitted and it got denies, my insurance company contacted me and stated this out.  However, I have paid over $2000 co-pay already. The guy name Ken is responsible to explain each bill and co-pay to patient. He never mentioned they are not in my insurance net work. He seems also worry about I can not afford the co-pay more, and called me and leave message in urgent manner when my claim got rejected. I will never go to this clinic any more. They are not honest and not really care for patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Gilfillian
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist gives me so much anxiety, so the fact that I returned for a second visit says a lot. At Tech Ridge Dental, they’re always warm, friendly and caring. I would definitely recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mai Le
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A great place for dental care with very nice, courteous  people, very clean and quiet office, reasonable prices .  They usually remind me for the appointment and even call me 2 days in advance to make sure I’m coming.
Dr. Ha is very gentle and always explains details for patient. She’s willing to answer any question and gives some good advice too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been going to them for over 10 years, great doctors and all around staff, from the front desk to the hygenists everyone is amazing. 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: zarbins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first visit at Tech Ridge Dental and would give it 5 stars!  Great check-up, cleaning, and communication. Look forward to my return visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frances Muzquiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very kind staff at Tech Ridge Dental.  Ellen is an amazing hygienist!! I always feel comfortable with her, she answers all my questions and very thorough. Ellen, thank you for always taking care of me❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katti Rios
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in to deal with a problem that I have had for over 8 yrs! I had very high anxiety and flash back ptsd moments and even had a little breakdown. The doc put me at ease and told me he could take care of it! His assistant was also amazing and made sure everything went smooth!! Over all I will be going back for sure and I will let others know also! Thank y’all so so much

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Waxman (Bill Waxman)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent dental treatment. Friendly staff, fair fees for service. No hustling for unnecessary treatments by the staff. Highly recommend Tech Ridge Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LadySmith
user_reviews_extended.Description: The service and the care that I received here was the best experience that I've ever had in my whole entire life! From the care of the dental hygienist to the orthodontist the service and the treatment was impeccable. This was courteous service and they were friendly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: B Bu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ma is phenomenal. I plan on being his patient forever. His staff is so kind and comforting, Lindsey at the front is absolutely wonderful!  I recommend him to everyone I know, including you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Without a doubt the best dental care I've ever received. Ellen is an amazing hygienist and Dr. Sean sets the standard for others to follow. Keep up the great work Tech Ridge Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennylynn Hunter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am new to the area and was a bit skeptical about finding a new dentist just by the reviews the establishment received. However this lived up to the reviews. Great staff, flexible appointments and very clean up to date equipment. This is now my dentist from now on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jak Fuller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental practice I have ever been to. The doctors, techs, and office staff are top notch. They always care if you are comfortable and explain everything in detail. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anusuya Iyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always enjoyed coming to TechRidge dental. Everyone at this place is so amazing .  They are very friendly, honest and do amazing job. I am so grateful for who they are. Thank you so much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Faust
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a great dentist office.  The staff is super friendly and genuine, the doctors are professional and personable and the office is very clean and has the latest technology.  It is not in the most convenient place to where i live and work but the service is so good that I will never go anywhere else in Austin for my mouth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Garrison
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've dealt with dental issues my whole life and have encountered numerous dentists along the way. This is by far the best dental office I've been to and actually look forward to my visits. Both Sean and Minnie Ha are incredibly professional and kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick B.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! They are very courteous, respectful and professional! Glad to have chosen Tech Ridge Dental as my primary care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gustavo Palacios
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great atmosphere and kind people. Funny story…. My insurance doesn’t have the best coverage for this place. However, I’m still going back because of how amazing everyone is. Definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Riley Nix
user_reviews_extended.Description: Caring, kind, and friendly staff! Very accommodating to anxiety and sensory struggles. Their goal is always helping you find a way to take better care of your teeth at whatever point in life you find yourself.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donnie Gilliam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Minnie is absolutely amazing!!  I am treated like family every time I come in.  A great facility with wonderful staff!!  If you have dental needs look no further than Tech Ridge Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justi Trauernicht
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place. The staff, dental hygienists, and dentists are always so friendly and they take care to make you feel like more than just a patient.  My DH is the best!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was my first visit to Tech Ridge Dental and everyone was so nice, even Dr. Sean was personable and they all seemed to genuinely care about their patients. Looking for a new dentist, give them a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yolie Fernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff and very helpful when I had to go in as an emergency.   Dr.Sean Ma knew exactly what I needed and who to refer me too!   Can wait to schedule my and my kids dental appointments!  So glad I was able to find a great and understanding team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Braziel
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and Dr. Sean are awesome. No matter if I have an appointment or stop in, the staff always remembers me and what's going on. Dr. Sean is the best dentist I've ever had. Ellen is the best dental hygienist ever!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom Carpenter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am probably the worst patient that this dentist has as far as scheduling goes. I have to be a pain with moving farther away, adding new insurance, leaving the dentist for awhile and coming back, and so on. However, when I finally do make it to the office, I always feel welcomed. Every employee is courteous and prompt. I always leave happy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic dental care! Ellen was both gentle and thorough with my cleaning. Dr. Minnie and Dr. Sean are genuinely honest doctors, providing a comfortable and above standard experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen Appel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was so friendly. Filled all paperwork out online. The employees respected my wishes for not using fluoride.  They listened to all my questions and answered them completely.  Very pleasant experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joey Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful experience! First time appointment at Tech Ridge Dental, they were very thorough, timely and professional. Happy to have found a great Dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patty Aboytes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Ma! He is the best dentist in Austin along with his staff too!! They treat you with the best care from the moment you get in the door and even after you leave to call and check after treatments. Thank you TechRidge Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Hedegard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Finally a dentist who sticks to the schedule. I have waited an average of only 1 min for each appt so far!  Up front pricing before you schedule anything. Friendly staff. Convenient location for North Austin. What else could you want?

user_reviews_extended.Name: Parrish Brady
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to Dr. Ma by another dentist who rarely gives out high recommendations to other dentist.   Dr. Ma listened to my concerns about not wanting a root canal and took the time to discuss the pros and cons of various procedures.   He was able to give me a filling instead that healed up nicely.   His office was very neat complete with a tv on the ceiling above you as you sit in the chair.   One of the amazing parts about the procedure was the numbing of the teeth.  When he numbed my molar, I could not feel any other part of my mouth net numb.  But I felt no pain from the tooth during the procedure.   There was no numbness in my lip or anything or tingling when it came off.   I highly recommend this dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joy Emberton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an emergency dental issue and Dr. Minnie sqeezed me in for an exam. She diagnosed the problem, prescribed antibiotics and referred me to a specialist. She explained the procedure that would be performed and answered any questions I had regarding the next steps in the process. Would highly recommend for any/all dental care needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Spraggens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Making the appointment was wicked easy, we did it all by email (which was awesome). Paige and Dr. Sean are both super wonderful and were happy to address my questions and concerns. I cannot recommend them enough!!! 😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gus Castellanos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first deep cleaning at Tech Ridge Dental and it was a really good experience.  Ellen is a wonderfully talented dental hygienist and I've had zero pain after the procedure.  Thanks for the great work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: K P (Kaisi888)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great visit. Friendly staff, patient and always on point with the coverages from the insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: pat ma
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very clean and punctual.
Arrive on time and finish on time.
Watched all small details.
Great job.
Feel great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Gaudin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Once again on Friday, January 10  Dr. Shaun came to my rescue. I had an abscess on a tooth that I had a root canal 2 years ago (by another dentist) and he had me come in right away. He did an x-ray & referred me to an entodonist. Dr Shaun is always kind, thorough,  and takes time to explain everything. You never feel rushed and he really listens to you and your concerns.  The first time I saw him I had chipped a tooth and just like my visit on Friday he made time to work me in. I feel so fortunate to have found Dr. Shaun especially since my last experience with a dentist was not a good one. Thanks,  Dr shaun!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg MacDonald
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very competent and knowledgeable staff. I had three fillings done and it was quick and painless. Great bed side manner. Listened to all of my concerns. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Michand
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hate the dentist. They are fear inducing to me.  Tech Ridge isn't like the near Stephen King memories I have of the dentist.  I mean like early King like Cujo and the Shinning King the kind of fear that your Apple Watch buzzes to warn you about your heart rate The entire team listens to you well.  They are very kind, very understanding professional and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harney Dinopol
user_reviews_extended.Description: All very nice people and very professional.  Doctors Sean and Mini are awesome. They are not the type who recommends a lot of things even if unnecessary just to make money. They will give you the right advice. Thumbs up for the couple.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kieu Lien
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Tech Dental for over 7 years.  The staff is always so friendly and treat you like family. Great service and never a long wait to be seen.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Morris

title: Aloha Dental
address: 1614 E Riverside Dr, Austin, TX 78741, United States

user_reviews.Name: Chelsea Kwot
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve come to Aloha for two years now and I feel well taken care of! I recommended my husband to go here too and we both love it. We love Hawaii too so the theme is relaxing.

The dentist makes sure to tell you exactly what they’re doing to your teeth and the hygienists clean well. Appointments are easy to schedule with a quick phone call and they text/email reminders!

There’s some parking right in front or even the free garage.

It seems they are always changing up the chairs and tables when I come here so there’s always something new.

Efficient and they do what they say. Insurance is accepted. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Eric
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Wharton and Nellie make an excellent team. The processes were well explained, and I understand thoroughly from up front the costs.

Aloha Dental is high volume, but I never felt pressured or rushed.

The cleanliness of the room was 4.5 out of 5 stars, because I could see white spots on some things.

Overall I'm highly satisfied and look forward to another visit.

user_reviews.Name: Tiffany Baltierra
user_reviews.Description: I had such a great experience at Aloha Dental. The front staff is honestly amazing — super welcoming and on top of everything. The dentist and hygienist were really educational and took the time to explain what was going on and how I can take better care of my teeth. Everything felt efficient, honest, and actually helpful. I’ll definitely be coming back.

user_reviews.Name: Cristian Benavides
user_reviews.Description: When I got my first real big boy job, the first thing I did was finally take care of my teeth and get work done. I had multiple cavities taken care of and have been working with Aloha Dental for over a year to straighten my teeth. Needless to say, for someone who was very self conscious about my teeth my whole life, going to a dentist was pretty anxiety inducing! Aloha’s staff, from day one, made me feel comfortable and immediately eliminated that anxiety. They run things in an incredibly organized way and the staff is super kind. Because of all the work I’ve had done, I’ve probably had like 90% of the staff work on me at some point and they have all been kind, capable, and informative. I moved about 40 minutes from Aloha but I’ll gladly continue making the drive here for any and all dental work.

user_reviews.Name: Devon S
user_reviews.Description:
I had a great experience at Aloha Dental! Dr. Wharton took the time to explain all of my options and let me know that, based on my specific crack, I could do just a crown instead of a root canal plus a crown—which saved me a lot of money and stress. I truly appreciated her honesty and transparency.

Throughout the crown procedure, Dr. Wharton and the dental hygienist were very informative and made sure I was comfortable the entire time. This was the easiest and smoothest crown experience I’ve ever had.

user_reviews.Name: tamara vogt
user_reviews.Description: I really like Aloha Dental. My husband, brother & some of our friends go here. The staff is friendly & helpful. I just got a temporary crown today. The Dentist did a wonderful job giving me the numbing shot. I barely felt anything. I highly recommend Aloha Dental!

user_reviews.Name: Lexx Vallejo
user_reviews.Description:
Service is fast but also detailed. Everything was explained in great details for all work, pricing seems very fair, and open later for those who work normal 9-5 hours to be able to make it in.

Staff always pleasant and after just a couple of visits they recognize by face and already acknowledge you by name. Felt more personable that way.

Would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mena Abdelmalak
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was by far the worst dental experience I’ve had in Austin.

At this clinic, the dentist told me I had 12 cavities that needed treatment, which I trusted at the time. However, since leaving this clinic 2 years ago, I’ve seen two different dentists at two separate practices in Austin, and neither of them has found a single cavity requiring treatment. This has made me seriously question the accuracy of the diagnosis I received here.

There was also a concerning incident during a crown procedure. While taking measurements for my crown, the staff left material stuck between my teeth that pushed on my gums for 3 days, which caused significant inflammation. It remained there for three days until a dentist at another practice removed it, and the response I received was simply “sorry”. Situations like that could easily have caused more serious gum issues.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this clinic. I strongly suggest getting a second opinion before agreeing to major dental work here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Kyalla
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! Very thorough yet speedy first time appointment for X-rays cleaning and consult. I am glad I found Aloha Dental as my new primary dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Hackerd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to cancel my appt due to my car breaking down. Life happens. I was considerate and called to cancel.  They charged me $40 apparently, but never called, emailed, or mailed me a notification.  Then, over 3 months later, say I'm going into collections if it's not paid.  Greg was rude, and had zero empathy for his own clerical mistake.  The Drs are nice from what I remember, but I'll never go back. This jerk left a bad taste in my mouth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mercedes Rathvon
user_reviews_extended.Description: My friend recommended Aloha Dental to me and I am so happy she did! They are all so helpful here and really help you get on track for the best dental plan! Plus they always have good music playing in the office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew McLaughlin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In my short time here, I was quick to realize that this office will do whatever they can to bill, bill, bill insurance regardless of the patients requests. I kindly asked multiple times to skip the X-rays on this visit since I had them done 6 months ago at my previous dentist out of state. Also, after reading reviews that their dental assistants frequently mess up their X-rays and take them repeatedly, and have had my mouth cut up in the past from these, I wanted to opt out as I’ve always had a perfectly clean dental record and no concerns. The doctor told me “I have no choice” and told me the law requires him to take x-rays every 6 months. I later confirmed with my new dentist that this is false, especially for patients with no previous dental issues. It was clear that this is only done to rack up their insurance billing. After I was told that I “have no choice” and given a smug attitude, I had to leave the office without receiving the dental cleaning. It’s unfortunate how many doctors will prioritize money over doing what’s best for their patients who spend their hard earned money on health and dental care.

They will also try to make you sign a paper stating that they can perform a whole list of “extras” without further consent and hold you responsible for the bill knowing that insurance won’t pay for it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby V
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Aloha for probably 6 years. They had been amazing and I recommended them to everyone. This past visit I specifically needed to address concerns over gum inflammation related to an autoimmune disease. The hygienist did the cleaning, x-rays, and pictures in my mouth. She said my gums are healthy (great news), but when the dentist (I've never seen before) came in and I told her about my gums the hygienist told her there was no swelling. They determined that I just feel like they're "puffy" at times. I was medically gaslight and if they compared the pictures from this visit to my past 6 years, they could have verified what I was saying. However, the swelling is visible by anyone! The dentist didn't even look in my mouth. They no longer do the super quick cancer check or the depth of the gum pockets, which seems like a pretty important thing with my issues. The hygienist told the dentist that I had reported that due to the "puffiness" my clear retainers push on my gums and cut off blood flow and she said, "oh, well don't wear them when it does that." That was an obvious and I already knew that. My mouth has always been really healthy and the one time I had a true concern, they absolutely failed me. I have loved this office until now and I won't ever return.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Art James
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time at this dental office ... I was very pleased with the service received. The office staff, technician-Elizabeth, and Dr. Wharton were friendly and thorough in caring for and explaining my dental needs and cost.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Davis Dunham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a lovely experience! Staff was professional and helpful and set me up with the appointments and fixes (tooth related) I needed quickly and easily. Aloha will be my dentist office from now on!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Haywood
user_reviews_extended.Description: My Bridge cracked this past Saturday. My OLD dentist couldn't see me and matter of fact, said they were booked. I said, Let me call Aloha because my Niece goes there, and they sure did fit me in the same day. I told them I was sad because I had Mother/Son Football pictures and I wouldn't be able to smile. They were able to put my bridge back in! I felt comfortable right when I walked through those doors. From the Front Desk Ladies, to Dr. Jessica Wharton, and Eddie I was in good hands. I have found my new Dental office! Thank You Aloha Dental! I'll see you all again soon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Asmaa Salem Farag
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m very disappointed with this office. Before my treatment, I specifically asked them to check my insurance and tell me my total out-of-pocket cost. They confirmed the amount, I paid it in full, and was told I would not be billed anything further. Months later, I was suddenly sent to collections for an extra $500. On top of that, one of the teeth they treated was left with a hole and I no longer feel safe going back there and have to seek treatment elsewhere.

I feel misled both financially and medically and would not return to this dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Callie Turbitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming here for a few years and am very happy with my experience! The front desk staff is friendly and helpful and the dental hygienists are awesome. I most recently saw Kyle - he does a great job cleaning and answers all my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Cloud
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is great and the place is nice. They use modern dentistry technology and digital imaging. I go very often for my cleaning and they are always helping in helping me understand if it's a visit covered by insurance or if I am coming in between and need to pay out of pocket. I am happy to pay because I go more frequently than the insurance offers. The dr's are great. I have been going to this location for over 5 years and would recommend them to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sianne Boreham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Wharton is the absolute best (her assistant Ed was also amazing). I will never see another dentist again — even in this office.

Last time I was here, I was telling the doctor where I had pain. He numbed me with a needle 3 times but kept missing the spot that hurt and telling me there’s nothing he can do. I was in tears and had to suffer through what should’ve been an easy temporary crown procedure. He never came back to check on me and for the next two weeks I had a wonky crown and continuous pain.

When I came back for my permanent crown and saw Dr. Wharton, I told her where I was having pain. She listened intently and hit exactly the spot I needed numbed. She checked on me multiple times and the experience was flawless.

That other doctor could really learn something from her instead of gaslighting his patients.

Dr. Wharton forever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie Gamez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really like this place! They’re honest and efficient and make the dentist a more enjoyable experience than I’ve had anywhere else. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy Kalt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Aloha Dental! Been with them for years. My hygienist Kyle is like an old friend who also does an incredible job cleaning my pearly whites and leaving them sparkly white after. Always top notch dental service here from the staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: R P (VoodooRanger)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Never looked forward to going to the dentist, but Aloha makes the experience infinitely better. Always walks through every procedure and my teeth have never felt so good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mason Gillespie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional, good clean, and my personal favorite amenity was the numbing gel to ease the process. I had Shelby as my hygienist and Dr. Whaton was my dentist, highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen Cortes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Aloha Dental for years.  Dr. Chaudhari is my favorite!  He has great bedside (chair side?) manner, and my boyfriend even changed dentists so he could start seeing Dr. Chaudhari.  I’ve never had any issues with Aloha Dental.  Highly recommend them, esp Dr. Chaudhari.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maribel Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My 1st time getting a cleaning ant Aloha and I honestly enjoyed it. I didn’t feel as I was getting rushed. I would for sure recommend anybody looking for a dentist or a second opinion when it comes to your teeth to visit with Aloha Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcia Banegas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to Aloha Dental since pre-pandemic, moved away for a few years, and continue going here now that I've moved back, even if it is a little out of my way since I now live in a different neighborhood. All of the staff is great, but the cherry on top is the dental hygienist, Kyle. He makes dental cleanings not be a daunting task. He's gentle, approachable, and makes me look forward to visiting the dentist (yep, you heard that right).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nadia Mahmood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Chaudhari was very kind, thorough and efficient. He answered all of my questions right away and made me feel confident. The staff at aloha are also very kind, professional, and helpful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Beware of fake diagnosis and serious upselling!! I went to this dentist a year ago and was told I had 4 cavities! I got two of them fixed by them and then never got around to the other two, given I felt completely fine.  I was chatting with 3 of my friends who also live at Amli South shore and had gone to Aloha, and every single one of them had been told they had at least 4 cavities! One friend got one fixed and the others never did.  None of us had ever had a cavity before.. we’ve all since been to new dentists (each of us to a different one) and none of us have cavities.. the upselling on top of this misdiagnosis was also extreme, suggesting invisiline and crowns when I hadn’t even mentioned wanting any cosmetic dental work.. ridiculous!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pierce Arvizu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am absolutely disgusted by my experience at Aloha Dentistry in Austin. They told me I needed six cavities filled, which immediately felt excessive. I went to my trusted hometown dentist for a second opinion, and he confirmed my instincts, there was no need for any fillings. Just one small area to monitor.

It is a shame that people who are supposed to care for our health are instead knowingly trying to create lifelong dental issues just to line their pockets. Dentistry should be about helping people live happier, healthier lives, not preying on patients to hit profit targets.

These corporate, private equity owned dental chains don’t care about you or your long-term health. You are just a number, a paycheck, a way for someone to pay off their luxury car and student loans. Please do yourself a favor and stay far away from this place. Find a dentist who actually practices with integrity and cares about preserving your natural enamel, not destroying it for a quick payout.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gail March-Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: The administrative and medical staff are welcoming and professional. The doctor was unrushed and thorough with the initial consultation. He made certain I understood the dental implant process for my situation and why it was phased.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ruta Zilinske
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just visited Aloha Dental in Riverside (Austin) and I can honestly say — WOW. From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed with warm smiles and genuine kindness. The team is incredibly friendly, professional, and took the time to explain every single detail to me in a way I could understand.

We came up with a clear treatment plan together, and I felt truly cared for, heard, and respected throughout the entire process. There was absolutely no pressure — just honesty and real support. The environment is calming, clean, and full of positive energy.

Huge thank you to everyone there for making me feel so safe and taken care of — and most importantly, for bringing my smile back. 🙏✨
Highly, highly recommend Aloha Dental to anyone looking for real care with real heart.❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Jeacock
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Wharton is very kind and non- judgmental! The staff is friendly and the treatments are quick and seamless.

user_reviews_extended.Name: mark lit
user_reviews_extended.Description: As good an experience as I have ever had at a dentist. Dr Chaudari is great, all assistants kind and caring. Several visits and I just love this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brett Misenhimer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I walked in for a cleaning and walked out with a $900 bill for “future” work. My teeth are fine. They only care about $$$. Finding a new dentist that cares about their patients and is honest.

user_reviews_extended.Name: veronica gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s a really family oriented dentist office and I’ve been bringing myself and family to this office for years. Excellent service, very accommodating to work and school schedules.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madelyn G Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great care! I’ve been coming here for years with no issues. Honestly, used to be scared of the dentist but they’ve really worked with me and it’s gotten much better over time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Carlos Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service by attentive professionals. All my dental needs have been met here with great satisfaction. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yvonne Luna
user_reviews_extended.Description: The service is great. I highly recommend Aloha Dental. I’ve been coming here for years . They’re friendly staff and they take great care of you .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Baris Vefali
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a fantastic experience at my appointment today. The front desk area felt warm and welcoming right from the moment I walked in. It was clean, cozy, and had a calm vibe that helped put me at ease. The front desk staff were super friendly and helpful—they made the check-in process smooth and were happy to answer any questions I had.

Priscilla, my dental hygienist, was amazing. She was kind, professional, and had such a calming presence. She explained everything she was doing, checked in with me throughout the cleaning, and made sure I was comfortable the entire time. It’s clear she really cares about her patients.

Dr. Langendorfer was also excellent. She took her time, was very thorough, and made sure I understood everything about my dental health. I never felt rushed or overlooked—just well taken care of.

Overall, I couldn’t be happier with my visit. Everyone I interacted with was kind, professional, and made me feel completely at ease. I honestly look forward to coming back, which I never thought I’d say about a dental visit. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Iglesias
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My favorite dentist I have ever been to. So kind, professional, fast and they make me feel really safe.

I love it here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Greye
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional and helpful people.  They were very thorough and very thoughtful.  I would recommend this dental office

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pablo Moreno
user_reviews_extended.Description: I brought my mother in for an appointment, and although she was initially very nervous, the staff provided exceptional care throughout our visit. Everyone was warm, welcoming, and made her feel at ease. We truly appreciated the professionalism and kindness shown by the entire team. My mother also asked me to be sure to mention how helpful Veronica, a young woman in her twenties, was throughout the entire process. She took the time to clearly explain both the treatment and the billing, which made everything much easier to understand. Her professionalism and patience were truly appreciated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachael Reiter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really appreciate how they take the time to explain what they’re doing and why in detail. Very helpful for any dentist anxiety folks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Val T
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Aloha Dental for many years. It’s a nice, clean facility with friendly staff and dentists.
I recommend trying them out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Howard Porter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service as usual. This dental clinic is organized, good at what they do, attentive, and thorough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lyndsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Aloha Dental for a couple of years and they’re wonderful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis Mccloud
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff at Aloha Dental always does a wonderful job. From the moment that I walk in, they are very quick and efficient with everything that they do. My dental hygienist Priscilla is the absolute best! She is thorough, diligent and uses great care whenever I'm being treated. The dentist also are patient and thorough in explaining things and are extremely personable.
I highly recommend Aloha Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rose Wong
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming here for over a a year and love the staff and doctors! You make it so nice to come and feel comfortable ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary Hert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Aloha dental, I feel like they are quick and value my time. They don’t charge an outrageous amount to get work done like the other places I was quoted.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Roth
user_reviews_extended.Description: The aloha team is great for routine (and other) work. Strongly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosa Elena Tejado
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole team is very nice and professional.  The hygienist did a great job and Dr Chaudhari took his time to answer questions about my concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: veronica mandujano
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff there were all so nice and they explained everything before doing anything first. I will definitely recommend Aloha Dental to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniela
user_reviews_extended.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Priscilla at Aloha Dental is absolutely amazing! She’s so gentle, thorough, and makes every cleaning feel easy and comfortable. I always leave with my teeth sparkling and a smile on my face. She genuinely cares about her patients and takes the time to explain everything. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a kind and professional hygienist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel Rios
user_reviews_extended.Description: Traditionally on your first appointment you get your X-rays followed by a cleaning. Aloha only does the X-rays followed but the dentist discussing any work needed, I was told “we will see if there is time left for a cleaning”. Sole purpose of my appointment was the cleaning but I had to a schedule a whole other appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khalil Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist and team all around. So professional and easy to work with. Cant recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Byrd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Aloha Dental. Dentist visits are usually a place of anxiety and stress for me, but they made the experience really pleasant for me. The doctor and hygienist Kyle were phenomenal!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Claire Brewer
user_reviews_extended.Description: i like the fact that they have the aloha plan for affordability with folks who don't have dental insurance. dr. chaudhari is very nice and talks you through the whole procedure before starting and constantly checks in to make sure you're comfortable. would recommend for patients needing financial assistance and for patients with anxiety about dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis Trahan
user_reviews_extended.Description: They will recommend you thousands of dollars of work that you don’t need, if you happen to go here make sure you get a second opinion before letting them do anything significant to your teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ron Bragg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience as always, awesome team very professional and as pain free as possible. I live over an hour and half away but still travel to Austin for the dentist. Exceptional treatment trumps all else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nithya Balasekaran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been a happy patient at aloha dental for 5+ years! They always take great care of patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I needed to establish a dentist here in Texas, as I’ve been getting my teeth cleaning from my sister in her office back in Ca for the last 6 years, and happened to notice the great reviews that Aloha Dental had and thought I’d give it a shot. I’m so glad I did.

The office staff were very welcoming, friendly, and efficient. Elizabeth was my hygienist and she was very thorough and gentle. Dr. Mulgrew was very caring, patient, and answered all my questions. Overall, great experience with this office, would highly recommend. This is a trustworthy place and I felt very comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you’ve been putting off the dentist for way too long because of nerves, embarrassment, or just life getting in the way — this is your sign to call Aloha

I walked in feeling nervous and self-conscious, expecting a lecture, maybe even some shame. What I got instead was kindness, professionalism, and zero judgment. The whole team made me feel completely at ease. They were gentle, patient, and explained everything in a way that made me feel empowered, not scolded.

They didn’t make me feel bad for the gap between visits — just helped me focus on how to move forward. That kind of care is rare, and I’m honestly so grateful I found them.

If you’re anxious, overdue, or just feel weird about going back... this is the place for you. Your teeth — and your peace of mind — will thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Codron
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going here for over a decade and while a lot has changed in Austin, Aloha Dental has always delivered care at a high level and I’m always happy leaving my appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Georgia Cann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Aloha dental is the best! It’s the only place I actually will come to every six months. The checkups are always easy and painless! Thank you, Aloha dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: brianna wilkens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here for a few years now- I think this place is great if you’re looking for a new dentist check them out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Coonce
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can’t recommend Dr Holly enough. I have a not-so-great history with dentists, and I had neglected to go in quite a while because of those poor experiences. Yes, I had a lot of work that needed to be done, but I am so grateful to have her as my dentist. She is SO knowledgeable, kind, funny, and cares about her patients. I truly consider her, and everyone at Aloha dental, to be friends.

Tl;dr going to the dentist sucks, but it sucks way less at Aloha.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hou C.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Wharton and the entire team, including Ed and the wonderful dental hygienist (whose name, unfortunately, escapes me), were nothing short of exceptional. Their kindness, warmth, and professionalism stood out from the moment I walked in. They went above and beyond to ensure I felt comfortable, taking the time to explain every step of the process clearly and thoughtfully. I also appreciated their honesty and integrity—they didn’t try to upsell me on anything I didn’t need. For example, they recommended trying an affordable over-the-counter dental guard before considering a more expensive custom option. On top of that, they were efficient and accommodating, even providing a temporary filling on the same day as my cleaning. Truly an outstanding experience with a fantastic group of people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clarissa Jaime
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently switched insurance and visited Aloha Dental for the first time. The staff was friendly and professional, and I truly appreciated the care and attention they provided during my visit. I take excellent care of my teeth, brushing twice daily and flossing almost every day, and as an adult, I’ve only ever needed one filling.

The main reason for my visit was to get my teeth cleaned, but the appointment ended up focusing on scans and photos instead. While I understand the importance of a comprehensive evaluation, it is inconvenient to not include both services during the same appointment.

I was also informed that I needed FOUR fillings, which seemed unexpected given my dental history. While I appreciate the proactive approach taken by the practice, I personally lean toward a more conservative philosophy for dental care. After reading reviews from other clients, I noticed similar concerns about potentially overaggressive treatment recommendations. This difference in philosophy leads me to believe another provider may better align with my preferences.

Overall, I’m grateful for the friendliness and professionalism of the team at Aloha Dental. While their approach might work well for others, I’ll likely switch to a provider whose style feels like a better fit for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kayla Meech
user_reviews_extended.Description: Beautiful, clean, high tech facilities. Reception and staff are all great. Highly recommended, especially Kyle & Dr. Wharton!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a good experience here - honest dentists who want the best for you and don’t beat around the bush. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hershal Shaw
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my 3rd time visiting Aloha Dental and it was my 2nd time having Kyle do my bi-annual teeth cleaning. Kyle is always super professional, has great bedside manner, is very personable and super easy to talk to. I always love having Kyle do my cleaning and look forward to him calling me back when I’m there. In addition to my cleaning today, I also had the a filling done where I had the pleasure of meeting for the first time Dr. Rohit as well as Lucero (I make it a point to ask for and remember names). They were both such a pleasure to meet and took the time to not only properly do my filling, but because I also wear clear retainers they made sure that after the filling was put in that my retainer still fit snug on my teeth so I can continue to keep my straightened smile. I expressed how much I appreciated the attention to detail and the consistent checking in with me on pain and discomfort where there was absolutely none. I highly doubt I got this great group of staff just by chance, meaning the entire office staff members are definitely amazing professionals even down to the checking out and checking in process. I would highly recommend this office. Thanks again to you all and see you in six months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristofher Tobias (Cris)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I feel listend to and im glad they are addressing all of my concerns. The staff have been so friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Ha
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience. Kyle was the best hygienist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Townsend
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visits to Aloha Dental are always very pleasant. Everyone is very friendly but very professional at the same time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabelle Stone
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience here, they worked with me for my paperwork and insurance. The staff and doctors are diligent and kind!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Goodwin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Would be 0 stars if I was able to. Don’t trust their diagnosis nor treatment recommendations. Historically I’ve had cleanings about every 6 months for every year of my adult life. Went in for a routine cleaning after 2 years of being between dentists. After several pictures, x rays and measurements, I was told the recommendation was for a deep cleaning. Not only would this cost significantly more and not be covered by insurance like a routine cleaning, but would require I return on 2 later dates and that no cleaning would be done on the day of my visit. I told them, no thank you, I would much prefer a regular cleaning to the best of your ability and then I would reevaluate. They flat out refused, pointing to certain deep tartar buildups on the pictures and x rays, that a normal cleaning wouldn’t suffice and couldn’t reach these hard to get to areas. I ended up telling them thanks but no thanks, went to my normal dentist back in Dallas, who showed me all the same tartar buildups, problems areas, etc, followed by a routine cleaning, albeit with a little more care. After cleaning x rays and pictures revealed, surprise surprise, no more buildup. All those problem areas and my “gum disease that only a deep cleaning can solve” resolved. Just come back again in 6 months for another cleaning. All covered by insurance and done in a single visit. Kick rocks Aloha Dental, go try and scam someone else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My appointments are always enjoyable. My hygienist Priscilla and the staff are always very friendly. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erik Duran
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience at! The staff was incredibly friendly, professional, and attentive to my needs. The office was clean and welcoming, and the entire process, from scheduling to the actual appointment, was seamless. Dr. took the time to explain every step and made sure I was comfortable throughout. I highly recommend this practice for anyone looking for top-notch dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amaya Armstrong
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here for years and they always take care of me! Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for a reliable dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lilly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horrible last visit. A complete waste of my time today. Assistant was not very knowledgeable or communicative in letting me know what was happening. As a result, I will no longer be a customer at Aloha Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Aloha is top notch all around! They have an amazing staff and awesome dental team. They communicate wonderfully.

I forget about appointments all the time so having a real person text reminders a couple days prior is a huge plus! I highly recommend Aloha.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Alexander
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wasn’t as nervous as I usually am when I go to the dentist.
Steps were explained as she went.
It didn’t hurt either so I’ll be going back.
It’s close and convenient to my job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: hallie m
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Similar to other reviews I’m seeing, I was a victim of this establishment pushing unnecessary dental work. I was told I had cavities that needed fillings and thankfully I went and got two other second opinions (with X-rays, full imaging, etc) and was told there were no signs of any decaying. Both doctors were appalled that someone would recommend drilling into perfectly healthy teeth. I will not be returning and I do not recommend coming here as I do not find it to be a trustworthy or honest business.

UPDATE: Since this business is trying to claim I’m not a customer in their response I’m including proof of my most recent visit. I’ve been a patient since 2019. Pretty concerning that they can’t find me in their system anymore.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Germano
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was able to get an appointment quickly...not 4 weeks out. The team there was just wonderful. I have a severe dental phobia but they were patient and worked to make me feel comfy. Def returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lilly Costello
user_reviews_extended.Description: Saw a review that said they would give them 0 stars if possible and I 10000% agree. I went in to get a cleaning and they told me they needed to fill 2 cavities. They filled them, made one tooth EXTREMELY SHARP and the on the other one, the filling chipped and I had to come back. When I came back, I had to pay for the additional service even though it was their filling problem. Then, after getting it refilled, it chipped again. I moved cities and went to a new dentist and now I have a crown because Aloha messed up my filling so bad it was in between my teeth causing me MONTHS of pain and inability to chew on my right side. Now I have accrued a huge number of dental costs all because they messed up my teeth in the first place. The hygienists are nice and that’s about it. Would not recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place has good cleanings and customer service, but I have to base my review on the trustworthiness of the dentists.

This place pushes for unnecessary dental work. I have never had any cavities in my life, but every time I went to Aloha Dental, they told me I needed atleast 2 fillings and possibly had 4+ cavities.

I got TWO second opinions, in which both dentists said I did NOT need ANY fillings, and the “cavities” Aloha Dental found was just staining.

Because of this, I will not be returning to Aloha Dental because I feel like they do not have the patient’s best interests at heart and want to make $$ off of fillings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Kotzur
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was my first time visiting today.. needless to say it was amazing! They made me feel comfortable, and Kyle did a fantastic job on my teeth cleaning! Nothing but good things to say!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobby Durben
user_reviews_extended.Description: Easy, friendly, and always available for appointments! Been going here for a few years now and I still continue even after moving out of the neighborhood

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Shannon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A long, long process, delayed multiple times. And then the $250 discount I was promised was shrunk to $100 when I paid. That's not the fault of the person taking payment, it's deceitful by the business office.

Having voiced my beef, the staff is amazing, every one top notch. Kind, informative and top of their game.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Schoenstein
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Aloha Dental is personable and efficient. I have been going here for cleanings for a few years and recently got more extensive dental work done. I was nervous, but the staff and doctor made me feel much better. I knew I was in good hands. I’m extremely happy with the work they did! I highly recommend signing up for their in house benefits, it’s a great deal and will save you alot of money if you need dental work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josephine Bingler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been using Aloha Dental since I moved to Austin 7 years ago. The dental hygienists are wonderful. I also appreciate how transparent the front desk team are when listing out procedures and costs. I feel like I’m in good hands here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Ramsey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The entire staff at Aloha Dental were very helpful
kind and professional.
I would highly recommend to family and friends. Kyle is one of the best hygienists  I have had. Very gentle and thorough.All of the staff went out of their way to make me feel comfortable and to help me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Maze
user_reviews_extended.Description: Liz has the gentlest touch and got my teeth super clean! Both Liz and Dr. Holly had calming presences and made me very comfortable, as someone who gets scared at the dentist. Thank you both for the great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: George Hearne
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had dental work completed on Monday, December 8th with Dr. Jessica Wharton who was fabulous! Her assistant David was equally fabulous! The procedure was completely pain free! I am very pleased to rate their treatment as worthy of a ten star rating! I highly recommend Dr. Jessica Wharton and Aloha Dental. They are totally awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Analyssa Reddy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a long time patient at Aloha Dental and it’s always a great experience, especially for going to the dentist. I see Dr. Holly who is always enthusiastic when it’s to do a check up or fill your cavities, she is such a joy to see. Her dental assistant Rebecca is so sweet and really ensures you’re comfortable during your time in the chair. Plus, the music is amazing in the waiting room!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Kersch
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the dentist I actually look forward to visiting. Always available for cleaning appointments (in fact they remind me to stay current), also if remedial work is needed can always fit me in quickly. The hygienists are friendly and thorough, mostly relying on water-powered tools so cleanings are quick and comfortable. They take photos of any areas needing attention, so I never have to worry about unjustified fillings, and the office is pristine. user_reviews_extended.Name: ash knight
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I initially visited Dr. Wharton because I was in pain and looking for an affordable solution. I wanted my tooth extracted, as it would be less invasive and cheaper. I explained to Dr. Wharton that I couldn't afford a root canal, but she insisted it was the better option and convinced me to go ahead with it. To accommodate the cost, she spaced out my appointments.

Now, four months later, I’m shocked to receive a bill for a crown that I didn’t need, and I’m being told my insurance didn’t cover the quoted amount. When I reached out to Greg in the financial department, he was of no help and told me I was responsible for the balance because I signed the treatment plan. I really regret not just having the tooth extracted in the first place, as this experience has left me with unexpected costs and frustration.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cari Marshall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Aloha Dental! Everyone in my family has been going to Dr. Mulgrew for years and we just adore him, including my teenage daughter. He is so friendly but very professional and doesn't push a bunch of unnecessary procedures. The entire staff is great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sergio Nicolas Amaya
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As a trained dentist who regularly visits the dentist and prioritizes preventive care, I went to this clinic expecting a straightforward cleaning. I had no pain or issues, especially since I visited another dentist less than six months ago in my previous city.

To my surprise, I was referred for numerous procedures, including multiple crowns, unnecessary fillings—simply because of some pigmentation—and even a few potential root canals. They also recommended a mouth guard, despite it being clear that I’d need a new one after completing the restorative procedures they proposed.

The cleaning itself was ok (?)—not even close to the deep cleanings I’ve had in the past. Additionally, the gum probing was performed incorrectly, which further lowered my confidence in their methods.

As a dentist who truly cares about patient well-being and takes a minimally invasive approach, I urge you to think carefully before agreeing to any procedures at this clinic. Once your enamel is drilled or invasive work is done, there’s no going back.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to Aloha for over a decade. There have been a number of different dentists over the years, but they have all taken care of me. I always feel I am in good hands with the entire staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Providing an update to my previous 1 star review, and unfortunately not to raise the rating. I had fillings done here that I could tell were being done with haste. Little time was spent to review my teeth and the status of these fillings when I went in. After having extreme sensitivity and pain in one of these fillings I left a poor review which prompted Aloha to call me and offer to have a free look at my work and see what might be causing me pain.

At least I thought that it was free, I saw after the fact that while I was not charged, my insurance sure was. I guess they thought I wouldn’t notice that or check my benefits usage/coverage.

Anyways, when I went in I saw a different dentist who after doing some quick diagnostic informed me that I would need a root canal and that my tooth was dead. I went ahead and sought a second opinion from a specialist who only does root canals - who upon doing the same tests, and hearing the same feedback from me on my status informed me that the nerve was irritated due to how high it was sitting in the tooth and that my condition would likely continue to improve as it had been getting better slowly.

Any dentist that doesn’t have their name on the business is likely owned by private equity, my ondodontist informed me that they have heard of - and seen quite a bit of turnover from these folks and I am not surprised on my end.

It’s amazing how a specialist could sit down and look at my x-ray with me for 5-10 min to really see what was going on and that these folks just wanted to go full speed ahead into heavy dental work.

If you just need a teeth cleaning then Aloha is probably fine, but I wouldn’t let these folks drill on you without getting a second opinion. I would not recommend them at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you scroll down you’ll see other reviews like this… they are trying to bury them but I’d read all of the bad reviews for the truth. I do NOT recommend this Dentist. They are 100% out for money and will try to over-drill your teeth and sell you on a bunch of stuff to make $. You’ll suddenly have a bunch of cavities, need mouth guards, retainers, special toothpastes, on and on. I’ve been going to the same dentist almost my whole life in my home town and he never saw anything that they claim I need to spend thousands on to fix. I just saw him and my teeth were totally healthy with no cavities… My husband has seen multiple other dentists and he’s never had a problem or a cavity. THEN all of the sudden we both go here and have a bunch of cavities and need a bunch of work. We highly recommend you do not go here.. and if you already have get a second opinion. We tried to get the pictures they took of our teeth for our own review and they won’t send them to us either. Super sketchy. They say that they take them as a courtesy for patients but then when you want them for your own records they won’t give them or they try to charge you for them because it “takes time out of their day.” Pretty sure that’s illegal. But it’s funny that that do images as a “courtesy” but only as ammo to scare you about your teeth, not actually a courtesy for the PATIENT. There are many other huge red flags we could go on and on… but you’ll see consistency in the bad reviews. All the same stories. Hope this helps someone!

UPDATE: Aloha told me I suddenly had SEVEN cavities that needed to be drilled for HOURS. Got a second opinion. Only one of the cavities they claimed I had was real. And it was extremely minor. They also said I don’t need a mouth guard for teeth grinding, found no sign of teeth grinding. I don’t need prescription toothpaste, or anything else Aloha said I needed, and they were absolutely baffled at my story. There was no sign of anything else that could have been mistaken as another cavity let alone grinding SEVEN of my healthy teeth down? I asked multiple times, are you sure you don’t see ANYTHING? This should be illegal. It’s so sad people go here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Orlando M Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient at Aloha Dental since 2020. Every single time I have gone I have had a very positive experience. Dr. Mulgrew is kind, caring, attentive, and a master of his craft. His dental team is overall great as well. They communicate clearly and do great work.

However, I am giving this review 3 stars because of the lack of specificity as it pertains to their cancellation policy and what that constitutes.

the language regarding their cancellation charge (which in itself is already very expensive) is as follows (in automated text messages):

"Please arrive 10 minutes early and check in. Cancellations with less than 48 hours notice will be charged a $50 cancellation fee."

I reached out a day before my appointment not to "cancel", but rather, CHANGE my appointment date and time. For starters, cancelling vs. changing an appointment time are 2 very different things. As someone who worked in HR I know that wording is important.

If I was to know that changing my appointment date and time would constitute a $50 fee then I would not have changed it and tried my best to show up for the original date and time. Moreover, the person who changed my appointment date and time did not let me know that a fee would incur.

I believe that if a medical practice is going to charge such a steep price for changing your appointment 2 things should be taking place.

1. There needs to be an amendment in the language as it pertains to cancellations vs. appointment changes.

The language should read "Cancellations or appointment changes with less than 48 hours notice will be charged a late fee."

2. Your front office team should make it standard practice to let patients know verbally that those charges will be incurred.

As someone who has been a patient at this practice for such a long time, as well as someone who just got laid off from their job less than a week ago, I found myself stunned and saddened at the fact that I was being charged so much money for changing my appointment time, especially because of the nebulous language around it and the lack of communication from the front office team when I asked about it.

I understand that no one likes a last minute change, especially as a physician, however I think patients should be made aware of, and have a right to know, exactly what that entails.

I sincerely hope to hear back from someone regarding this matter. At least want to know if amendments to the language will be made.

Edit: Changing my review to 5 stars because Aloha Dental reached out to me to discuss my concerns and they remedied the matter to my satisfaction. Very grateful for the quality of service I received pre and post appointment.

That dentist was surprised they'd recommended the Gross debridement for my teeth considering. My guess is they heard I hadn't been to a dentist in over a year and thought they could make a quick buck.

They only reason they get 2 stars instead of 1 is because the Dentist was incredibly nice and super knowledgeable and the Technician did try to reduce the cost, which I appreciated.

Still get e-mail from them asking when I'm coming back lol

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawna Fenley
user_reviews_extended.Description:

I cannot recommend Dr. Mulgrew and his team highly enough. Their commitment to excellence, combined with their compassionate approach to patient care, truly sets them apart. If you're in search of a dentist who prioritizes your comfort and well-being, look no further than his practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Lombardo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went here in June 24th at 2:30pm, for a normal cleaning.  Did X-rays. My husband felt suspicious so I held off on going back since I felt no pain. I went to a new dentist today who said I have one TINY cavity. It’s wrong and save your teeth from this dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jill Palanov

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Canoutas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here for over 10 yrs. Soup to nuts, the experience at Aloha is as fine an experience one can have at the Dentist. Dr Mulgrew is tact, professional and a caring practitioner who makes each visit a joy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Nabulsi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I absolutely would NOT recommend this place.
First, they get you to sign papers that for them "standard" but they are not, one of them is financial polices which is literature paragraphs than actual policies to tell you they will bill you if the insurance doesn't cover the procedures even though they've checked your plans and know what's in and what's not. second one for procedures that you don't need but they make you acknowledge they are not covered, they also make you sign their own proposal of treatment even if you don't chose it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Womack
user_reviews_extended.Description: Do not go here! All of the good reviews are from previous management. I was recommended work that another dentist told me was unnecessary, was overcharged by several hundred dollars that it took me months to resolve, and 6 months after a crown installation that was much more painful and time-consuming than previous similar work, I’m having to see a specialist to get the shoddy crown fixed. user_reviews_extended.Name: Andres Tirado
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best and must gentle cleaning
Professional Services, best costumer service and very knowledgeable staff

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Hieber
user_reviews_extended.Description:
DO NOT GO. HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE. DR MULGREW DAMAGED MY ONCE HEALTHY TOOTH REQUIRING A ROOT CANAL AND CROWN.

I went to Dr Mulgrew when my previous dentist retired. During my first visit  I was told two unexpected things, that- 1. a filling I had was deteriorating and 2. I needed a night guard as I was grinding my teeth while sleeping. A custom night guard (I believe in the neighborhood of $600) was recommended.

I was told that I should expect pain for 2-3 weeks. (I've since learned from multiple sources that the standard is 1-2 days.  Don't get a filling from Dr Mulgrew unless you're prepared for 10 times the industry standard for recovery.)  Additionally, Dr Mulgrew told me that the tooth that he worked on had a very deep cavity and that it was probable that I would likely need a crown or root canal at some point as there was little healthy tooth left.  This was surprising as I had no pain in my tooth and had never been told that there was an issue with my tooth. I was once again strongly encouraged to purchase a custom night guard.

After 1 1/2 weeks, I was still unable to chew on the right side of my mouth, had considerable pain if my upper and lower teeth made contact, and persistent, continual pain 24/7.  I scheduled a follow up appointment as I was about to head out of town for 2 months.  At that appointment, Dr Mulgrew ground down some high spots. When I told him that it felt as though I was making contact with the left side of my mouth prior to the right, he told me that was "contradictory" to the symptoms I was reporting and told me that I was still within the 2-3 week window for expected pain.

I went out of town and the same symptoms continued requiring me to visit and pay for two emergency out of town appointments one week apart.  Each of these dentists were well regarded by several family members so I have confidence in their opinions.  Each separately drew the same conclusions- 1.  The initial cavity was very shallow with a small filling, 2. The replacement filling that Dr Mulgrew did was poorly and improperly done. It was also created with a low valley leaving a gap on the right side of my both when my left side made contact,  3.  My previously healthy tooth was now DYING as a result of Dr Mulgrew's work. The X-rays, taken one week apart, clearly showed the dramatic infection that was now surrounding my entire tooth. 4. I now needed a root canal and a crown. and 5. I had no need for a night guard.  One dentist went so far as to say "I make it a practice to not comment on another dentist's work but it is clear, this dentist damaged your tooth and was trying to lay the ground work to cover for that.  You would not need a root canal if he had not killed your tooth."

So, I am now approximately 5 weeks out from my encounter with Dr Mulgrew and Aloha Dental.  Dr Mulgrew poorly and unnecessarily replaced a filling and killed my tooth, and I've paid for 2 appointments with him, along with 2 emergency out of town appointments and will be paying for a root canal, temporary crown and permanent crown.  Additionally I've been in pain for 5 weeks and am still unable to able eat anything but soft foods.

Prior to writing this review, I called Aloha Dental, explained the situation to the office manager and let him know that I wanted to give Dr Mulgrew the courtesy of discussing things prior to posting a review.  I understand that mistakes can happen and wanted to afford him the chance to accept responsibility for this situation. To his credit, he did give me a call. Regrettably, he did not take any ownership for the mistakes that were made, assumed no responsibility and made no attempt to try to rectify things.  On the positive side, the office staff at Aloha Dental has always been courteous and, when I was left waiting for 30 minutes for an appointment, they offered an HEB gift card (which I declined).

If you are seeking dental care, I would STRONGLY advise against Dr Mulgrew. There are many talented, responsible dentists in Austin. He does not appear to be one of them.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Prompt, friendly staff- very much enjoyed my first visit. Tessa was insightful, gentle and listened to all concerns.  Will definitely be back!

The dental assistant Collete was very nice and helped me feel comfortable. The dentist was also down to earth and helpful. I would recommend Aloha dental to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a new patient to Aloha and had a great visit. Laura, my dental hygienist, was super friendly and a pleasure to talk with. She made the appointment go by quickly! The dentist was great too. He gave me honest recommendations to improve my oral hygiene. Another plus - they have Netflix and a pacman machine in office! Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leighla Molina
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hygienist and dentist were clear and informative. However, reception staff was very rude when I asked about payment plans when I noticed the cost was steep. She recommended that I put a $2800 charge on a credit card and even laughed during the process. Never returning and would not recommend, even with good insurance. I wish I would’ve looked at the google reviews before going.

Not only did Dr. Blake M. And Mayra provide top-notch dental care, but they also showed genuine care and concern for my well-being.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Dotson

The staff is very nice and professional. Even with me now living in north Austin, I will continue to use this location. If you're new to Austin and looking for a dental office or just wanting a new dentist, I highly recommend Aloha Dental on Riverside Dr.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place has been consistent as far as services go.

I was told on my last visit that I’d be seeing a new Dds because my previous one had had moved on to another practice out of state. Yes, I would have liked to have been notified, but I wasn’t.
