All of the staff is professional that doesn’t waiver.

My whole family visits her now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gillian McGlynn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super friendly staff and a great care team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andie Rocca
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In 2021 I went to Dr Mulgrew for dental work. He told me I needed ~14 fillings. I had not been getting regular cleanings, so I assumed it was my fault and didn't question it. He proceeded to do the fillings over 2 visits. After getting the fillings, I had cold sensitivity in one of my molars and went back in.

He told me the tooth had become infected and would need a root canal. At the appointment for the root canal, he had me sign a form that I was accepting the risks for this procedure e.g. nerve damage, and tooth cracking which made me a bit uneasy.

Once he started drilling, I informed him I could feel the drill. He asked me if he should add more numbing, and I responded "I don't know what you should do." He said "you need to communicate better." I was so uncomfortable with the form, his bedside manner, and the fact that I didn't have issues with my teeth but am now needing a root canal before 30. I walked out of the office with a hole in my molar.

A friend recommended an endodontist who I was able to see the next day. When he looked at my teeth, he said "I wouldn't have filled half of these" and told me that the molar in question had been drilled too deep for the initial filling that it had exposed the nerve, and that's why a root canal was required. There was no infection.

I left one star in 2021 after this whole experience, but I'm writing my review 2 years later because I read an eerily similar story in another review and I'm not sure what is going on in this practice. I hope no one else has to go through this experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Duffy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So i used Aloha Dental for a lot of work over the last 12 months , i will say the doctors did great work , but i had a customer service problem after something went wrong and i decided to go to look for a new Dentist . After a few months i was hit with a $700 bill from Aloha which they just pulled out of thin air because i had paid them after every procedure and my Insurance covered the rest . So i went to speak with Aloha and i was handed over to the owner or Boss lady , she asked me why i would not come back and i explained the situation (That i had a bad experience with their customer service ) , so she proceeded to offer me a deal i could not refuse , she said if i cam back she would discount the $700 bill to 200 and during my next appointment i would have cleaning done (which would be covered by my insurance) and i also needed a flipper which she promised i would only pay the lab fee of $70 , i was so happy and i payed the $200 and re-scheduled my next appointment (which was this morning ) .
I had my cleaning done and then when it came to preparing the mold for the new flipper i was hit with the bill of $700 , they circled part of the bill that read $230 and said this is what i will pay and to sign here , i was confused and i signed the form , but when i realized that this was not the $70 deal i had made with the boss i immediately stopped the procedure and tore up the form , i went to reception and explained that i had made this deal and that they did not keep their end of the bargain , the lady just sat there and had nothing to say , so i was charged another $55 for the cleaning which they said would be covered by my Insurance , and i will probably receive  another shock bill in a few months saying i owe for something else they decide to pull out of thin air . This woman (Owner , Boss ) is a liar and a cheat , the rest of the staff are just doing their job and i have no beef with any of them , but i will never ever use Aloha Dental again , and i will be posting reviews about what has happened to me on as many sites as i can so this will not happen to anybody else . I am a very honest person and i am a very fair person , and i truly believe that when somebody makes a deal that they should keep their end instead of being a sneak and a cheat . If you want to have an honest experience do not use Aloha Dental , they will cheat you out of every penny you work hard for . They are a disgrace to the service that America prides itself on and this Owner/boss lady should be ashamed of herself . Please take this review seriously people , stay a million miles away from Aloha Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meghan Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Aloha for over four years. I really liked my pervious dentist, Dr. Rho, but she left the practice, and now I am getting a sense as to why. I called to check on my crown since it has been over TWO months since getting a temporary post installed and I hadn't heard from them. I was also experiencing major pain in my front tooth, which I chipped the week prior. I was worried there might be a deeper crack or infection due to the pain in my jaw and face. I called and they informed me that they LOST the scans of my mouth and the labs for my crown were never submitted due to a technological error. They asked if I could come in same-day to get re-scanned and they would take a look at my tooth. Dr. Holly is my new dentist and I had only seen her once before. They did an x-ray and examination. She said the tooth wasn't dead, cracked, or infected. She said it did have two small cavities and while I was in a lot of pain, went ahead with the fillings since she said that would clear up any infection. She also refused to give me anything for pain in addition to the steroids she suggested. I was worried since I was already in a lot of pain and then she drilled in that same spot for 45 minutes, that when the local anesthetic wore off, I would be in pain again. I again advocated for myself for pain management and was denied, told to call back the next day if it was still bothering me. Well at 2:20 am in the morning, I awoke and I was crying out in excrutiating pain. They also never called in the steroid to my pharmacy, so I was a day behind in receiving the medication she suggested. So I have to call the office to see what happened with my prescription. Greg, the office manager, was telling the Dr. my concerns. She was supposed to call me and never did. TWICE.  They called in a temporary pain medication the next day, after that horrible night of no sleep and throbbing pain. Well, low and behold after the round of steroids, the pain persisted. I had to see ANOTHER doctor and pay another co-pay to get antibiotics for a sinus infection. I ASKED her if she thought this could be the issue (a sinus infection versus a tooth infection) and if I needed antibiotics and she was like "no, the filling should take care of it". Well, it didn't and my face raged in pain for almost a week and a half. I SAID I was worried about infection - why on EARTH would she not prescribe them as a rule out. I don't take antibiotics often, b/c I get that resistance can build, but come on. Ask me! Read my chart! It felt like she wasn't hearing me and she also gave anecdote about her boyfriend being a hypochondriac and going to the ER when she thought he was fine. If you don't believe your partner in pain, why would you believe me? I'm so upset about my treatment here and I have to go back to get my crown seated. After that, I'll be finding another dental practice that uses CRITICAL THINKING skills, compassionate bed-side manner, and listens to their patients. This could have been avoided. Never again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ana kapxhiu

GET A SECOND OPINION.

i had been going here for a year or so for cleanings before they told me i needed work done, so i listened. i had my face drilled into in like 5 spots despite having exceptional oral hygiene. not to mention the whole thing was really traumatic and i couldn’t stop shaking for half a day afterward when i’d never before had anxiety around dentistry. two+ years later they said i needed MORE work done, so i went to my childhood dentist and he said nothing needed to be done at all. he pulled up his scans of my teeth from just a few years prior (shortly before the drilling aloha did) and nothing appeared to be needing drilled then either. one of the teeth they were saying needed to be drilled into the second time was the same one they drilled into the first time. which is pure insanity. i strongly STRONGLY recommend getting a second opinion with a dentist you trust because i could have avoided spending exorbitant amounts of money, not to mention pain and trauma had i done that.

The dentist did a great job and I will recommend him in the future. Plus I have undiagnosed can't stand filth disease and the cleanliness of the office kept me calm. Definitely a 5!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dakotah Hicock
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They were able to get me in on short notice because I chipped a tooth. They were very professional and friendly the entire time. I never felt I was being rushed or being an inconvenience to anyone.

I felt that they did what they could that was best for *me*, not the most expensive.

I am going to continue using them as my primary dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Schlemmer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went here about a year ago to get cleaning and xrays. They pointed out a few fillings that they said needed to be re filled "ASAP". I couldn't afford it at the time with my current insurance that offered terrible coverage. Jump forward a year later, and I visit my family dentist in Dallas. Here I'm told my teeth are fine and don't need urgent work. I'm recommended to keep visiting every 6 months and if they find anything wrong, we will get work done.

On top of that, Aloha messed up my insurance and tried to bill me in full for my cleaning and x-rays. They said it was an honest mistake. Maybe it was..

So, this makes question this place. Lots of dentists out there will jump at any chance to work on your teeth, whether you really need it or not. As someone who saved $1,200 by getting a second dentists opinion, I urge you to look elsewhere.

Goodluck, because finding a new, trustworthy dentist can be frustrating!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Ramsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Wharton and her assistant were very nice. They did a good job and I felt comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Asher Delampyr
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Able to fit me in same day, not only that but able to deal with my nearly crippling anxieties and fears about having anything in my mouth.
Kevin and Dr. Wang took excellent care and explained each step fully, always going at a pace designed to keep me comfortable with the procedure. Ive seen over a dozen different dentists, this was by far the best experience possible

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Vannett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
they were very accommodating because i needed to make an emergency appointment for my son.
they already had all of his insurance information through zocdoc, which made the checkin seamless, even though it was his first appointment.
the doctor was really straightforward with everything that needed to be done.
he didn't talk to me like i was dumb, either. which is nice since i have had experiences like that with previous dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucas Tomicki
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a long term happy customer. Recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description:
DO NOT GO HERE! They lie and make up issues for money!!!! They use a camera to manipulate you and "show you" your issues. All the good reviews are probably fake. Here's what happened to me:

- The staff all gave me horrific vibes. They immediately seemed sickly sweet (but also subtly rude like a teenage girl making microaggressions) as if they were trying to scam me off the bat. Got MAJOR sleazy car salesman energy.

- I was 10 mins late so they didn't clean my teeth, only did the exam, which would've been fine if that's all that happened. but of course they're only gonna do the part that they make money from. I was already suspicious at this point.

- They said I had cracks in my teeth from grinding my teeth at night, cavities, and that the enamel was worn down on my teeth and I needed a special toothpaste. My hometown dentist I've seen for years had never said anything about any of those things. I had one suspect cavity that we'd been watching but that's it. They said I had several fully formed cavities.

- They use that camera to manipulate you!!! They show you spots on your teeth as if it's evidence. But I straight up think they were lying when they showed me the "crack" in my teeth. So shady. Other reviews have people amazed that they "found something no other dentist noticed" but that's bull

- I rejected everything they tried to sell me and left. Went to my hometown dentist, didn't even mention any of the stuff they said before the exam, and he said I was all good. I then asked if he noticed any of those things and he said no he didn't notice any of that, double checked to make sure and said "yeah I have no idea what they were talking about"

And I'm not even the type to always think medical professionals are out to get me or anything. This dentist is just extremely sketchy. My SIL's mom is a retired dentist and professor at a dental school and always says that students she teaches seem so eager to charge their patients instead of doing what's best for them bc they're more worried about paying off their dental school debt than public health. I would find an older dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Forest Waggoner
user_reviews_extended.Description: This location is awesome. Take it from a guy who avoids going to the dentist at all costs. Aloha made checking in a breeze and their staff is ON IT. I came completely unprepared with my insurance information (as I do with all things in life). They were able to quickly find my information while I had my teeth cleaned. Highly recommend Dr. Mulgrew!

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Acosta
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in today for a deep teeth cleaning and it was a great experience. I went in a little early and was taken to the back earlier than schedule appt which was awesome. Dr wang gave me shots to numb the right side of my mouth and he did a great job didn't feel anything! Zoi the hygienist was awesome! She was sweet and so polite about the whole procedure. Im definitely coming back. Checkout was polite and courteous. This office was great today!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Saldana
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a terrible experience dealing with the front desk representative when I was reaching for a treatment I did years ago. He was super disrespectful, he was sarcastic and provoking me. He stated “go ahead and make a bad review in our 5 start reviews” so here you have

Customer services is everything on business and I was not expecting that from a formal well named and  respected agency. Customers could may not have the full information about how things are, but the staff has to be respectful by explaining things.

I am really disappointed and I would not ever have a treatment in a place that have an staff that could be as rude as him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob
user_reviews_extended.Description: I first used them when I did not have any insurance and they were very well priced, easy to work with, and accommodating. Now that I have insurance I made them my dentist. Staff is helpful and friendly. Dr. Mulgrew has a great memory and does a fantastic job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Shaffer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Langendorfer was very professional, kind, and knowledgeable!  She performed a quality assessment, put my concerns at ease, and shared valuable insight.  Top notch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Stanton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is ok. They recommended to update my old cavities which I agreed to do even though I had no pain or discomfort , ended up having a root canal, no problem. The BIG problem is whatever they did, has caused EXTREME pain in the teeth around it and they are not taking responsibility for it. SOOOO, if you want to end up having more discomfort and horrible consulting, go here. If not, stay away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Schreiber
user_reviews_extended.Description: People can get stuck going to a service provider year after year because it's just easier, but the time has come for us to move on.  I've been taking my sister to Aloha on Riverside Dr. for years and honestly feel remorse every time we leave the office.  I can't ever seem to make sense of their non-insured cash discount, which is weak/vague/inconsistent...but the BIGGEST turn-off is the office staff's "we're doing you a favor" mentality. Unfortunately, convenience doesn't outweigh feel-good.  Aloha also means good-bye.

user_reviews_extended.Name: karen acuna
user_reviews_extended.Description: No one likes going to the dentist, but this place has a nice staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: haley d
user_reviews_extended.Description: They’re fine for a standard dental cleaning, but I do not recommend trusting them for anything further. Please get a 2nd opinion if they tell you that you need costly work done. I was told I had 6 expensive cavities. I got a second opinion - 0 cavities, just needed a few preventative sealants done (which barely cost me a hundred dollars). Same thing happened with THREE of my coworkers who went here. We all felt like a client being upsold vs. a medical patient (they find and market to you on LinkedIn and everything).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Colunga
user_reviews_extended.Description: Pricilla was great and very professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ari
user_reviews_extended.Description: Using the Google appointment was easy. I got all the information I needed through email  and I got a quick confirmation of my appointment. I even got a text a few hours before my exam. When i arrived everyone was very friendly and welcoming. Kevin helped me out and he was super cool, I get s bit nervous during visits but he kept me cool and calm. I also met with Dr. wang. He was verg nice and answered all my questions! Zoey did my cleaning. She was nice and took very good care of me ! I would recommend Aloha Dental to others !

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Peterson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly, comprehensive, and comfortable. I went in for cleaning and xrays- they were efficient and thorough. They even showed me images/photos of my teeth that were enlightening (to say the least) and have great feedback on at home care. A+

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liliana Franco
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit , I was very pleased with the warmth and attention of Lily , Dr and recepcionist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savannah
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went yesterday as a first time patient. All the way through I had a pleasant experience. Answered all of my questions and took care in making sure I was comfortable. Hats off to Dr Mulgrew and his team for providing great care, see y'all in 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roger Toledo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been a patient for years, I’m very happy with the service I’ve received.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Chaudhari was great with my fillings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Terres
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the second or third time that I have specially requested a service and taken time off to go only to show up and be told that what was scheduled couldn't be done.  I get 75 reminder calls and emails for the appointment but not one of your horrible staff can tell me that a simple cleaning can't be done the same day as X-rays for some unknown reason. You continually waste my time. I could have a mouthful of broken and razor sharp teeth with blood pouring out of my mouth and I wouldn't darken your doorstep for free treatment. Every aspect of every experience I've had with Aloha has been excruciating and horrible. Please kiss the entirety of my considerable posterior. Horrible horrible horrible. That's how I feel about my recent visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Franklin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got 3 fillings and 2 wisdom teeth pulled. Everyone was nice and helpful and encouraging which really is good in a rough time like this.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the first Dental office I tried after moving to Austin. Priscilla and the rest of the staff are amazing. Usually going to the dentist is not something I like doing. But I always  look forward to going to this Dentist Office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Raskin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just be very. very careful with any dentist or healthcare practitioner.  The actual CARING in healthcare seems like it was absent in my dentist. While examining my mouth, the dentist showed me a small growth in the roof of my mouth. I asked what it was, and the answer I received was a slight shrug of the shoulders and "I don't know."  Which I took to mean not such a big  deal. The dentist didn't say a biopsy should be performed.  It should have been.  No referral was given, or even an offer of any information.  The same dentist did a crown for me the following month and still said NOTHING.
Two months after that, I went to my GP about it because it had gotten in the way of saying my S's.  My doctor was shocked my dentist did nothing. My GP had to send me to an ENT for that biopsy, and it turned out to be cancer.  This Aloha Dental dentist could have saved me from the more serious prognosis I have now. They get plenty of information about oral cancers in dental school. The dentist did NOT do due diligence.
I'm withholding the dentist's name because I agree with the other review on here that says they're about making money for the practice, and as a result, acting like scam artists.  In that sense, I don't think it was only this dentist who failed at patient care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriel Estrada
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going to aloha for 3-4 years now. Very friendly and knowledgeable staff and Always flexible when something comes up. The place is also very tech forward and that they have TV's if you want to see something while being worked on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cherrel’s Conclusion
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! I did not want to disclose my social security number and they did not hassle me. They used my insurance information and made me feel secure. I would definitely recommend this office. They took real good care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lee Wonner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found the best place Kyle thank you very much. Front desk are so nice. Appreciate it. My doctor was amazing explaining she’s the best anyway A2Z you guys are awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Georgia Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got to the appt and we where in about 5 min getting treated. The Assistant was very knowledgeable of the procedure and the dentist was very clear about the x-rays and what needed to be done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna Seelbach
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this location. It's clean, the staff is pretty friendly and very professional. I would recommended them to any adult.. not so much for small children though. The lobby has stuff for the kids to play with and even a movie playing for them when they're getting their teeth cleaned. BUT I just feel like children are not their specialty. I'll probably bring my 5 year old back once he gets a little older because right now he's not the most cooperative patient. (He gets scared) But other than that, it's a very nice location and I wouldn't mind going there for myself. I recommend a pediatric dentist for small children, especially if they don't like the dentist!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luke Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Aloha! Dr. Mulgrew is very skilled and professional. Whenever it’s tooth-hurty I will always visit Aloha Dental. Great place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Payton Giles
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So, I'm going to start by saying over the years the dentist has been a nightmare for me. (Didn't take care of my oral health for a while and had a few chipped teeth from being a wily adolescent. 0__0 ) The thought of anyone touching my shame teeth made me cringe deep into my soul.
With alllll that being said...
Dr. Rho and Alex her assistant, listened to my fears with out making me feel like a cray and irrational human. (Even though I was shaking and sweating like a psycho.) I actually went back to have a second procedure. I left feeling cared for each time and am not scared to go back. Which is a huge deal for me. The teeth whitening trays are a great perk too!
Thanks again Dr. Rho and Alex! See ya'll in 6 months for my cleaning!
:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Guy Forsyth
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great people, I really appreciate this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phil Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hated going to the dentist until I found Aloha!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shobi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Aloha! This is easily the greatest dentist office I have ever gone to. I emailed them before opening hours and requested an appointment as early as possible due to a wicked tooth ache. They called back promptly and fit me in that same afternoon. The staff is ridiculously friendly and more than accommodating. Dr. Bernal explained in great detail the madness that was taking place inside my molar in a manner that was actually comprehensible. Minus the extreme amounts of pain designated to my poor, weakened tooth, my overall experience was nothing short of spectacular. Their administrative assistants also happen to be an absolute delight as well. Lindsey has gone through a great deal of trouble to make sure that my insurance is doing their part, as well as making sure that all my visits have ended with a smile, metaphorically speaking of course, it's hard to smile with a numb face.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna Parizek
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Mulgrew is the best doctor of any kind I've ever had. I avoided the dentist for YEARS due to my fear of them. This of course led to a LOT of work being done. Friday I had 6 extractions and bone grafting in two of those and I still haven't had pain (it's Sunday morning). He is seriously the best - so understanding and comforting. I don't plan on going anywhere else!!

Also, my husband was able to get in for an emergency extraction due to such pain same day as calling.

Best office ever!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Canaan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a good first-time experience at Aloha Dental. Staff was friendly and professional. Dr. Rho and Shelby were friendly, competent, and took good care of my teeth 👌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie Kwot
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist, staff are friendly and helpful

user_reviews_extended.Name: Glynn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hate to give bad reviews and never do, even more so because I really have liked working with Dr. Mulgrew and the medical staff at Aloha but I will never go to this office again. I had to cancel an appointment last minute, which is admittedly a terrible thing to do, but as we all know life happens sometimes. The staff member I spoke with was immensely rude and unpleasant over the phone during this conversation in a quite overtly passive aggressive way. It’s very understandable to be frustrated with a client who has to cancel last minute but it is grossly unprofessional and disrespectful to express that frustration in this way, especially as someone who is in a customer service position. This was not the only occasion where this person or the front desk staff were extraordinarily rude over the phone.

I imagine this won’t be seen or taken into account based on other similar low reviews that received no response and the predominantly high reviews given otherwise. Perhaps I’m an outlier, but I couldn’t NOT leave this review given the experience I had. Hope it is helpful to whoever reads.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tori
user_reviews_extended.Description: A dentist office that isn’t terrifyingly tooth themed? Love it. Staff here is phenomenal. Big fan of being able to watch Netflix during procedures too. 10/10.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth G
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was looking for a new dental place for me and my 3 year old and saw an ad for this place and gave it a try.  Love the office love the staff.  They make me and my daughter very welcome every time we visit. I liked it so much I recommended to my parents and they have also change dentist. They are great with kids!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Garrett Adkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Can’t say enough great things about Aloha Dental! Was in and out, amazing staff, friendly, amazing work.. If you’re looking for a Dentist you can trust this is place to go 👍 🦷

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Aloha Dental is the best place you can go to for all your dental needs. The staff is very professional, and nice. They know you by name, and take the time to explain everything you may not fully understand. Do yourself a favor and book an appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Merita Zoga
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had an appointment for the first time with Aloha Dental today.  I scheduled for a quick cleaning as I have my own doctor in Dallas I've gone to for a decade but live in Austin.  The Dr's administrative staff was very kind and welcoming.  However, when I informed the staff and hygienist that I would not like an xray and merely a cleaning since I already had an xray a few months ago and I need work done but I'm saving to see my dentist in Dallas.  The hygienist said she'd have to check with the doctor.  He came in and told me it's against law for them to perform a cleaning without an xray.  I asked to sign a waiver and he said it was against the law.  I am upset with his handling as I have a right under law to refuse an x-ray, just as he has a right under law to refuse service.  I have been to other dentists in the past where this has 1-I was not required to have an x-ray or 2- their office ate the costs for the xray.  I found that I received unwelcomed treatment since I provided full disclosure that I only want to frequent their office for cleanings.  The Doctor should have stated it is his office's decision (or corporate) to require x-rays so they could get some more money in basic cleanings and not falsely blame state statute.  I don't like to waste time and am honest and direct, would have expected the same.  Unfortunate experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rob Swofford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent from the front office to the back office including the good doctor. The only way you could improve the service is to add bong hits, pina coladas and surf lessons

user_reviews_extended.Name: kira kouzounas
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was so friendly. I had to reschedule and they helped me with no problem! Very patient and kind

user_reviews_extended.Name: isai pozos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you to ALL the Aloha  staff! My elderly parents were very grateful for your thorough care from the beginning to the end!  You guys are awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aydan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Kyle was a very professional and knowledgeable hygienist, and Dr. Holly was very helpful and easy to talk to. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Swenda Collier
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I called and specifically scheduled a regular cleaning as a new patient. When I went to my appointment not only did they take forever in getting to me, but they told me they don't do cleanings the same day as an exam - which they should have told me when I tried to schedule a cleaning. Typical dentist visit is (basic) cleaning > exam > x-rays > treatment plan. To make matters worse, they did the exam (on dirty teeth) and tried to tell me I needed several root canals and a deep cleaning.
I went to another dentist for a second opinion, and shocker MY TEETH WERE COMPLETELY HEALTHY. I didn't even have a cavity, didn't need a deep cleaning, and most definitely did not need multiple root canals. As someone with severe TMJ this could have seriously messed up my life.

This happened close to 2 years ago, and still keeps me up at night.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yahjah Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff! Kyle was amazing! Very thorough, patient,  and kind! I rhino I found my new dental home. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janine Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place! They don't try to upsell me on things I don't need, they don't try to tell me I have 6 cavities when I only have 1 (this actually  happened at another dentist), they're friendly and genuinely concerned about patient comfort, AND they play awesome music in the waiting room. I actually look forward to going to the dentist these days!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrianne Grubic
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for an assessment of a crown after I broke a tooth, besides the sticker shock ( I was quoted twice of what my savings plan was supposed to be through Aetna) and the shock that I actually need two crowns. I have no problem with dentist Dr. Mulgrew, he seems fine, the assistant on the other hand acted like it was her first day which makes me very uneasy when I am paying a lot for medical care to have someone who just doesn't seem to know how to do their job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Soto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff throughout the clinic. Everyone gave easy to understand and thorough information, as well as a great teeth cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc Saucier
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best ‘bedside’ manners I’ve come across. We normal folk who forget to go every six months need understanding and patience. That’s why I like them

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Bardov
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this spot! Super close and convenient - great team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Cesar Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the atmosphere at Aloha.  The staff is very friendly and even when I had trouble with my insurance they did a diligent job of following up with me and my insurance.  I recommend this location to anyone in the downtown area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trent Gillaspie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Two words: massage chairs. If that isn't enough, their personnel are fantastic, and the service is great. Their technology is also top-notch, and their music playlist is world-class. I just wish my teeth were always as clean as they were right after leaving.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Lagus
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Aloha dental is superb!  Always accommodate schedules and provide excellent service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ally Chubaty
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Aloha Dental! They’re always efficient, thorough, transparent about costs, and overall kind! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Jou
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm a patient of Dr Blake Mulgrew and since I've seen this physician and their office, I've been very happy with the level of service here. The office takes seriously its COVID protocol and the office itself is very clean. Can't really ask for more from a dental office. Dr Mulgrew takes his time to answer all questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joanna Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in for my father in law Dr. was very thorough and explained everything so perfectly. Amazing and fast staff!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyndal Irene
user_reviews_extended.Description:
On 11/14/2014 I had my wisdom teeth removed. The bill at the time of service was $1771.00. The amount covered by insurance on my receipt shows $1109.20. The amount my mother paid upon the date of the service was $661.80. to make the account ZERO.

Owner Dr. Mark Jumper and Accounting Clerk Dawn White failed to file a service with my one of my two insurances Blue Cross Blue Shield of Kansas PPO - I even called BCBS they don't ever show that Aloha Dental attempted to file the service.

They are now trying to say I have a balance that is owed to them and have sent the balance to collections. I have tried to reach out to Dawn via email two times to get the owner Dr Mark Jumper to contact me directly regarding their own mistake Aloha Dental made. I have not heard one thing back from the vendor.

I would hope Dr. Mark Jumper accept responsibility for Aloha Dental not billing both insurance providers I provided the vendor with on the date of service.

If they check their security footage and my file it shows that I did make the vendor aware of both of my insurance providers - on my new patient paperwork I wrote down both blue cross and Cigna.

I want them to let me know when you have accepted responsibility for the error Aloha Dental made and when they have cleared my account of a balance. This is a bad debt Aloha Dental will have to accept. I will not accept it for them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Chemaly
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hate the dentist, always have…but if I’m being honest, it was the best experience I’ve had at a dentist ever. Staff is filled with great people.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jason woodyard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Holly is an absolute rockstar. My whole family has been coming here for years. And from cleanings, to extractions, Dr Holly is the only dentist I’ll ever go to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elly call
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best info I’ve ever received on my teeth plus SUPER nice staff! I did feel like I was being push-sold their prescription fluoride toothpaste though.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Robledo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Aloha Dental has been a great experience for years!  All the staff and doctors are kind, patient and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Olguin
user_reviews_extended.Description: So far I've had a great experience with Aloha Dental. I'll definitely be back for my next cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional staff, hygienists, and dentist. I was so impressed with the work that addressed my immediate needs that I booked more appointments for cosmetic dentistry. Thank you to Dr. Mulgrew and Aloha Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vidhya Rajaprabhakaran
user_reviews_extended.Description: love it here ! my best dental experience yet they really take care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marisol Vasquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience here at Aloha, both Priscilla and Veronica were both thorough and made me feel extra comfy! 🤍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Lerma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience. They were able to quickly get us in before school started and the whole process today was fantastic. Love the staff!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beverly Shaw
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dentist, Dr Holly is everything one would want. I am doing Invisaline and she has been great. Staff and owner …. all great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Marie Falvo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here for quite a while and have always had a positive experience.  Nice hygienists and dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mélanie Lamotte
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic place. The dentists and staff are very nice and caring. Their methods are non-invasive and they are super affordable. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krys
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff from the beginning to the end are so helpful, nice and accommodating. I usually have so much anxiety and they are so thoughtful in making sure I am okay. They are very good at their jobs and I will not go anywhere else except for them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Tagle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rho is amazing! I'm so glad to have found a great dentist in Austin. Also, the wait is rarely more than 3 to 5 minutes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sky Piron
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place every one is nice and very professional

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis Scott

user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff was so nice, but I can't say I'd recommend this place. I went in for a checkup and to fix a chipped front tooth and they recommended extensive work that other dentists haven't. (I don't know whether to trust them or not but will have to check elsewhere to see.)

On the follow-up visit to have my chipped tooth fixed, I was told I needed another X-ray that the insurance company "likes to do yearly." I asked if insurance would cover that and the tech said yes, but I was charged for part of it upon leaving. I felt that was sprung on me and that I was taken advantage of.

The dentist fixed my chipped tooth but after leaving, I found that I could no longer floss between those teeth and that my tooth was exceptionally rough. I returned and they fixed it for free, but I was a little shocked that the dentist didn't check those things while I was still in the chair. The dentist was very friendly, but it seemed like he did a slightly sloppy job. My tooth is still rougher than I'd like, but I honestly don't trust the dentist at this point and will just have someone else look at it in the future.

Overall, these people were exceptionally friendly but I just don't feel like I trust them enough to return. There were so many upsells and hidden charges and it's frustrating that this kind of thing never happens at a doctor's office, only a dentist's.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Went to the dentist for a routine cleaning and evaluation and they said I had 4 cavities without barely looking at my x-ray scans or explaining the severity of the cavities or giving any details- for context I have never had cavities in my life. While I was having my cleaning, the hygienist was very rough and left my mouth irritated and sore from how hard and careless he was when he was cleaning my teeth- the pain lasted for a week and my lymph nodes were swollen from how rough the whole procedure was. They also said my routine cleaning and evaluation was going to be fully covered at the front office but I had just gotten a bill for $100 in the mail. Overall the experience I had at this dentist was one of the worst experiences I’ve had at any dentist, granted I’ve had braces and oral surgery at previous dentists without any issues. I do not recommend this dentist to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Parysh Bailey
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first dental experience in Austin. Nice office. My complaint about this place is that it feels like the retail version of a dentist office. They were constantly trying to upsale me on something. They were offering me things that they made to seem like necessities, but they weren't. They told me I had 12 cavities. Went to another dentist office for a second opinion and I actually have 2. Overall, it wasn't a bad experience. Just be aware that they will try to upsale you on things you don't actually need. I wish I'd skipped the $25 toothpaste!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas LaPak
user_reviews_extended.Description: While traveling out of town I had a front crown fall out while sitting on plane from Chicago to Austin, Texas. The crown was a front tooth 🦷 so I didn’t want to walk around for days without a front tooth. I contacted Aloha Dental and they were able to fit me in right away and fix my crown! Everyone @ Aloha was very friendly and helpful! Highly recommend! A+

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Le
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently visited this dental office and had a mixed experience. The deep cleaning service was excellent—thorough, gentle, and handled with great care. The staff made sure I was comfortable throughout the process, and I was very satisfied with the results.

However, my experience with the cavity fillings was not as positive. The procedure felt more discomfort than expected. Communication during that part of the visit could have been better. One aspect of my visit that was disappointing was the water system used during treatment. Instead of a built-in water line, the office relied on a refillable bottle, which appeared to run out frequently. This made rinsing during the procedure inconvenient, as I often had to request it multiple times. Even then, only a small amount of water was provided, which made the experience uncomfortable.
Additionally, it felt as though the staff were reluctant to refill the bottle promptly, which contributed to a sense that the procedure was being rushed. This affected my overall comfort and experience during the visit.

Overall, while I appreciate the quality of the cleaning service, I hope the office can improve the patient experience when it comes to restorative treatments like fillings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devon Elise
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here is great and supportive. They go out of their way to make me feel comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Comfortable, informative, efficient. You gota like that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordin Lineback
user_reviews_extended.Description: I like going to Aloha. The staff is always friendly and this newest set of doctors and hygenists they have seem really knowledgeable and helpful. I recommend it to my friends who are looking for a new dentist office. Parking is also easy with the big garage right there for retail parking.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stevie D. Smith Photographer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctors & Associated Staff-Friendly & helpful

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Snider
user_reviews_extended.Description: The friendliest staff around!!! And they give amazing service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Jose Colell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kyle was great and kind!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geno Gottschall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really like this place 😎👍 Friendly staff, and they are good at what they do

user_reviews_extended.Name: Guadalupe
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been going to Aloha Dental for years now! Thanks to them, my dental health has never felt better.

Most recently, though, much to my chagrin, I had to make an emergency visit after an old crown popped off after flossing too hard. 😅 I was dreading having to make the appointment, submit sick leave, make transportation arrangements, blah, blah, blah–what a hassle!

But as I was driving to work, I called Aloha, spoke with Veronica about the situation, and she gladly informed me that Dr. Wharton was available to see me until 11am. So I hurried over to Aloha from downtown and made it in the chair by 10am.

Once I got there, Ed, the dental asisstant, got straight to work taking x-rays, getting imaging, and assessing the situation. After prepping my tooth, Dr. Wharton came in and quickly patched me up and sent me on my way. 😊

From the receptionists to the hygienists to the doctors, everyone is thorough, reliable, and a master in the area. The last few times I've seen Dr. Wharton, she's been extremely helpful, honest and compassionate. Plus, the team of dental assistants are efficient and highly skilled.

In the past, I've had dentists who were patronizing and condescending, which totally ruined the experience for me, so I really enjoy that I can ask all my questions and bring all my concerns and nobody will judge me for them. As someone with traumatic dental experiences, honesty and clear communication go a long way.

Since I started going to Aloha, I've referred over eight of my friends and family members! (I do wish there was a little prize or bonus for that. 😉) If you're looking for a non-judgmental place to get dental work done, I recommend Aloha.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Bertodatto
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a crown on my tooth come off this morning. By 2:30 Aloha had it cemented back in place.  I am from out of state and the staff and service was EXCELLENT!
Thank you,
George Bertodatto

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheree Subramanyan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff and always prompt and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Al fin encontre una clinica dental
Q se ajusta a todas mis nesecidades
Un lugar my limpio , respetan tu tiempo de cita , muy amables y sober todo muy profesionales
Y lo mejor    Precios  muy accesibles !
100%recomendado

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mayelin Mayta
user_reviews_extended.Description: El servicio un  Poco débil en cuanto a programación de cita, pero la atención de los Doctores y asistentes de los dores son excelentes

user_reviews_extended.Name: yaneli ulloa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Muy buena experiencia tanto del personal como de la asistente y doctora . Enseguida nos pasaron y le realizaron los exámenes y limpieza necesarios a mi hija . Aceptaron su seguro y no trataron de cobrar nada de mas .Sin duda volveria a esta clinica muy profesionales y amables.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana López
user_reviews_extended.Description: Muy buena atención son muy educados te explican todo el procedimiento hacen buen trabajo 😍

title: Smile Haus Austin
address: 3701 Guadalupe St Ste 104, Austin, TX 78705, United States

user_reviews.Name: Shiva Baghaie
user_reviews.Description: I had a great experience with Smile Haus. Dr. Ida Ettehadieh was an amazing provider! She ensured that I understood my treatment and explained everything thoroughly. She made sure that I was comfortable during the entire procedure. She showed a lot of respect towards my opinions on certain treatments and had a positive attitude even though I asked so many questions. She didn’t put any pressure on me to do unnecessary treatments. I’m very happy with my results! Definitely recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Paige Cox
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely one of the best experiences at a dental office I have ever had. I had a tooth crack on me over the weekend. I called the office first thing Monday morning. They were able to squeeze me in and fix the issue. Both the dental hygienist, Gabriel and Dr. Ida Ettehadieh were amazing. They were professional and kind. They explained each step of the procedure in detail. I really appreciate them both. Also want to give a shout out to the Smile Haus front of house staff too for going above and beyond with dealing with my insurance company. Brazo Smile Haus staff!

user_reviews.Name: Nguyen Thanh Tu
user_reviews.Description: I recently had my first experience at Smiley Haus Austin, and it was absolutely amazing. The team is incredibly professional and excels at minimizing anxiety. They were always on time and communicated clearly about the purpose of the x-ray and other procedures. Dr. Ida took the time to thoroughly explain everything, provided gentle treatment, and shared valuable tips for aftercare. I can confidently say that I’ve found my dental home for life, and I highly recommend them, especially for those with a low pain tolerance. You won't regret it!

user_reviews.Name: Aida Fica
user_reviews.Description:
TLTR: After a disappointing experience getting a root canal and crown here I have requested my dental records and the remaining balance in my account. Nobody has cared to reply.

I cannot longer recommend this office because the constant changes in doctors and personnel is insane. So if you are looking for a longterm treatment I would look somewhere else. I came here because of the good reviews and the proximity to my workplace but be advised that they pay $25 for giving a positive review.

Full story:

I have been in pain for years with one particular tooth after this office filled a painless cavity about 2.5 years ago.  The filling got cracked after a couple of months. When I came back to treat it there were no doctors available and they sent me to another Smilehaus office. At that time a female doctor whose name I don’t remember filled the cavity again. After that procedure I was having more pain than before. They told me I needed a root canal. I was very disappointed since the original cavity was small to begin with but the second filling was very poorly done and in a rush. I came back for the RC and the crown. They had changed doctors again by that time. Dr. Fern did the RC and then Dr. Saez took care of the crown. After that I was still in pain. Many visits to the office forward and still in pain. Dr. Saez left and Dr. Ida took over. She said I needed a retreatment. And again they sent to another smilehaus office with another doctor (Levo) who also didn’t offer any good explanation on why I was still in pain and offered a retreatment for another $1000+ usd, even though in his opinion the original RC was perfect. After that I left because I couldn’t keep dealing with the situation.

Now that Dr. Saez has left I no longer want to be patient of this office. And all I want is my x-rays and remaining balance in my account.

user_reviews.Name: Alexyss Lange
user_reviews.Description: Smile Haus provides the most personable, thorough, and patient-centered dentist experience I have had. I have been going for over 1.5 years and feel my dental health is very well attuned to and taken care of. I also appreciate the way they slow down and explain things about my dental health to me so I can make informed decisions, and I appreciate that they provide full price transparency when making recommendations. I would highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Mark Feldman
user_reviews.Description: Everyone I interacted with was great. The dental hygienist Lizeth not only did an excellent job of checking for signs of gingivtis as well as a thoroughly removing plaque and tarter, but in addition she  with was friendly. The dentist Ida also was quite friendly and from everything I observed she too appears to did excellent work. Finally,   the office manager Valerie, also friendly, provided clear and detailed answers to my questions regarding the nature of forthcoming scheduled visits.

user_reviews.Name: Andrew LeQuang
user_reviews.Description: Honestly I’m not someone who ever leaves reviews but this place deserves one. The staff is super friendly and never makes you feel bad for not flossing enough. The dentist is really patient and explains everything without making it weird. No hard sell or pressure to get any work done and I actually don’t dread going anymore which says a lot. Definitely recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Elizabeth English
user_reviews.Description: I’m so happy to find this place. Every time I’m treated so nicely, and every time my teeth are as clean as possible WITHOUT being a painful and long experience. Both Dentists I have met were kind, communicated clearly, and are not pushy. I genuinely trust them — plus they have a GREAT membership for people without insurance!!!
