user_reviews_extended.Name: Deanna Hartsook
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The employees here have always been friendly and I've had no major issues. It's a dentist and they clean my teeth. My latest visit had a new hygienist and dentist, both of which I liked.

I do feel they sometimes encouraged spending more money than strictly necessary. The previous dentist found cavities in my teeth more often than other dentists I've been to over the years. It's entirely possible I did need fillings, but it felt a little too frequent and my insurance actually said they couldn't bill me for one because they'd just claimed they filled the same tooth 12 months prior. I had to reach out to the office multiple times to get the charge removed from my account. Additionally, when I wanted a new retainer, my only option was to buy 4  (for ~$400), when I only wanted one. I hope to not feel like I'm overpaying going forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to Smile Haus Austin for several years, and the experience is always great. Nina, Celine and Pablo were fantastic, friendly, personable, and really put me at ease. They're thorough, knowledgeable, and gave me helpful tips for taking better care of my teeth. Everything was smooth and on time, as always. I really appreciate the whole staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diego Salinas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I honestly cannot recommend getting work done here.

Like other reviews, I came for cleanings but had the x-rays reveal 3 supposed SMALL cavities. I was assured that the procedure would be quick and painless.

I came back to get 3 fillings under anesthetic and can say that they were botched. They left one of my teeth too tall, which then caused me tremendous pain because of the pressure. I went back TWICE to get it adjusted and the pain has just never improved.

The doctor said to wait a while and the swelling will go down. Well I’ve tried to be patient and after five or so months my teeth remain sensitive whenever I chew. I’ve never had such a bad experience with dental work, and my teeth have never been this sensitive in my life. I’m disappointed and honestly appalled that my health was jeopardized

If they “see cavities” in you, get a second opinion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert BlairVega
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Saez and his team are phenomenal! Great care of patients and always willing to answer questions about treatment plans. Highly recommend if you are looking for a great Dentist that does amazing work and makes your smile look like a Hollywood celebrity!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Roberta Bencivenga
user_reviews_extended.Description: Smile Haus has an experienced and knowledgeable dentist, who is very nice!  The hygienists are excellent -- they do a great job, and are very easy to communicate with.  The staff who handle scheduling, insurance, and billing are also very good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristina Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Maintenance dental care is fine, work provided was appropriate and well done but watch out for pushy Invisalign sales when not asked for or warranted. I had been with this practice for several years (and had never had Invisalign brought up by myself, a dentist or hygienist, ever) and had a few days of TMJ pain so I went in for a consult and a mouthguard fitting. I did not get a proper consult on this issue and instead was heavily pushed to purchase a $5000 “solution” of Invisalign which includes a lifetime retainer commitment all for this new acute issue that Invisalign has no guarantee of resolving. And my teeth are very straight and do not need Invisalign. I was very frustrated with this experience. I called back to order the mouthguard and they claimed they didn’t have the appropriate scan for that and I’d have to return for another appointment.  Because of this experience I have decided to leave the practice. Very frustrating.

I found an office to provide me with a helpful consult on my TMJ pain and symptoms and received a reasonable and appropriately conservative treatment plan including a mouthguard (priced better I’d note). They also informed me that Invisalign would not help with TMJ but would rather only disguise the issue temporarily. They explained options for TMJ pain which Smile Haus did not even touch upon with me. That conversation almost immediately went to Invisalign and the dentist spent probably 20 min trying to sell me on it. They just make a big commission on it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Haskell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Chill neighborhood dentist vibes and everyone is very friendly. Pablo, Elizabeth were great as I became a new patient and Celine is one of the better hygienists I’ve had. Dr Saez is busy, but seems like a very nice guy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlie Chauvin
user_reviews_extended.Description: They tend to have a lot of turnover but they seem to hire really nice people. I've been going to this place since it was owned by Dr Jim Root. I nearly left but they seemed to have worked out the kinks (most of them) and are very  friendly. The dental hygienist has been super nice and helpful at getting me flossing and helping me take care of my teeth. She is very good at what she does. I'm giving a four stars because there is always works to do but generally pretty satisfied with this office. Keep smiling.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hana Belmonte-Ryu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I want to say that I am not a dental expert so please take my review with a grain of salt. I have never left a negative review on any place before- I just can’t stop thinking about what happened when I went here and I wish I had been aware of what might happen.

I recently saw my old dentist about 2 months ago (who I trust - she’s been with me and my family for like 40 years, she’s even my grandma’s dentist) and they told me my teeth were fine, maybe one back tooth that needed to be watched and flossed/brushed well. Then I moved cities so needed a new dentist in Austin. Came here because the reviews seemed solid but now some of them seem like they might be written be ChatGPT idk.

Basically they did a ton of x rays even though I said multiple times I didn’t really want x rays this time. Then they said based on those x-rays that I had THREE full cavities and that we should do procedure on them in two weeks. I was so confused but I trusted them so we scheduled the appointment. Something didn’t feel right about it so I asked my old dentist for a second opinion (on the new x-rays). After looking, she told me very firmly that I did NOT have any cavities and that I “absolutely should not do anything to those teeth.”

The dental assistant at Smile Haus was so kind and gentle and I had a lovely time talking to her. Dentist was nice too. But I just cannot trust coming here anymore. I feel really weird even leaving this review honestly but I would feel guilty if this were happening to other people too. So I guess - come to Smile Haus if you want, just be ready to get a second option!

I’ve heard of this happening with other dental and doctor offices once they are owned by someone other than an actual dentist/doctor - it becomes for-profit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Charlton
user_reviews_extended.Description: First experience at Smile Haus on Guadalupe was great! They were very communicative from the start. I had the nicest hygienist. And the dentist was great. Looking forward to going back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Berg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love Smile Haus!

I’ve been coming here for a little over half a year, and the staff have been nothing but wonderful. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AEC
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental hygienist was perfect in every way.  The dentist was the opposite.  She was very removed and rude and tried to push for unnecessary and absolutely ridiculous procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Olexa
user_reviews_extended.Description: They got me in asap for a pain in my jaw. Great communication, very friendly staff and great bedside manner. Will return.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcelo Barredo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Exceptional care and comfort from start to finish. The staff was incredibly kind, and the dentist made sure I felt at ease every step of the way. Truly the best dental experience I’ve had—highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Valencia
user_reviews_extended.Description: First off I was extremely nervous and they quickly put me at ease! Dr Saez was awesome and there was no pain whatsoever. Pablo and Holly were gentle with everything that needed to be done. Thank you Dr Saez for making what I thought was a difficult situation into a very easy one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Ruff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ida and team were amazing, professional, and had me in and out for a procedure in record time while completing it to a high degree of excellence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim Felkner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great and very helpful staff. Will definitely keep them as my dentist of choice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lina Villarreal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Smile Haus has friendly staff and quality dental care. Dr. Levo and his team are doing a great job serving our community. We recommend you check them out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maryam Anis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ida is really sweet! I also like the staff. I was running late and they have been very accomodating

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Scheidler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such kind staff, very efficient and good at what they do! Makes going to the dentist a not-bad experience (which is saying a lot!)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cyd Rios
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice experience , as somebody who hasn’t been to the dentist in a while and wasn’t sure what to expect

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dom
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was disappointed with my experience at Smile Haus Austin. They initially stated they didn’t accept my insurance, which turned out to be incorrect. I was referred to another location that supposedly accepted it, but I never received the promised follow-up call. The lack of clear communication and follow-through was frustrating. I’d suggest looking elsewhere for a more reliable dental office.

Update: I was finally contacted by a different location, where I had a positive experience. However, the original Smile Haus Austin Guadalupe location seems to believe they deserve credit for the good service provided elsewhere, which is surprising since they played no role in my positive outcome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Jennings
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great service, very high quality radiography and scanning as well.
They have a well-priced membership option for folks like me without employer insurance

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reagan Huggins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Smile Haus is the best! Super friendly and genuinely cares! I’ve gone here for about 2-3 years and have never had any issue, whether that be with staff, cleaning, or dental work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Lemon
user_reviews_extended.Description: SmileHaus is always quick to get me into my appointment and the dentist, hygienists and assistants have always been friendly and patient. I also don’t feel like I’m being upsold on services like I have at other dentist’s offices. I recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellen Zhang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Service was great! Staff are very welcoming and patient with me when asking I was questions. During the procedure, the team made sure to keep me out of any unnecessary pain, and afterwards, made sure I knew what to do post operation. Great experience, highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mia Cash
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had nothing but great experiences with Smile Haus Austin! They are timely, efficient, and so friendly, and they’ve helped me with some sensitivity that I’ve been dealing with for years. Looking forward to being a loyal patient!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Collett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I decided to Smile Haus a chance after seeing their good reviews. They do a great job and keep things upbeat. I’ve been going for about 6 months and look forward to every visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessie Wong
user_reviews_extended.Description: They told me my appointment was canceled when I arrived there and claimed that they called me once at 8am to tell. While my phone was off and no one answered that call, they didn’t try to call again or text me anything before I showed up. Great waste of my time 🙄🙄🙄

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Griswold
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I'm 75 years old, and so have seen dentists hundreds of times.
Dr. Saez and Dental Tech-Assistant, Pablo, (and the administrative staff here) are wonderful.
Dr. Saez and DT-A Pablo have found and filled several cavities, capped three cracked teeth, exrayed my teeth, provided mouth guards (I asked for two) to protect my teeth from grinding at night, etc.
The experience(s) have all been great.  Dr. Saez and his assistant Pablo listen, ask questions, are patient and don't hurry, explain, and know what they are doing, instilling faith and comfort in me.
I highly recommend them and their great team.
And I find the price quite reasonable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ron Yam
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctor and his staff are very efficient in a small older office in central Austin where parking can be a problem. I had two dentists over the last few years and they are both good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love this dentist office! Easy to schedule, reschedule, and communicate. I appreciate that they can text you because my job is super busy and I can’t always take calls during the day.

The hygienists are quick, gentle, and kind, and the main dentist I speak to is always very professional and helpful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: joyce flachmeier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly - caring about my comfort :) seem to be working with me on insurance issues.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maggie Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was anxious about switching dentists, but I'm thrilled I did! Dr. Saez and the staff are incredible, making me feel at ease from the moment I walked in. They are friendly and respectful, and Dr. Saez has a fantastic attitude and is easy to talk to. I highly recommend them! Thank you, Dr. Saez, and staff for being so incredible!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cat Anh Tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited Smile Haus dental office for a routine check-up and cleaning. I couldn’t be more pleased with the experience. From the moment I walked in, the staffs were incredibly welcoming and professional. I highly recommend Dr. Saez and his team to anyone looking for a top-notch dental experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melvin Espinoza-Rosa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Smile Haus is the best!

Personally, I’ve never liked the dentist…I had not been in 2 years, BUT the staff at Smile Haus made me feel safe and sound from the start. I’ve been three time now (cleaning, temporary crown and now permanent crown) and all three times have gone smoooooothly, to say the least.

From the receptionists clarifying everything to the dental assistants (Destiny and Pablo) helping out with X-rays and all that jazz. Dr. Saez made each visit painless and stress free. Looking forward to coming back for future appointments! Definitely in great hands here at Smile Haus. Gracias!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was great. No problems. Everyone was very pleasant.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Barton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had an extraction and am
currently going through the implant process.  Dr. Baik has been absolutely wonderful!   She takes the time to  throughly explain the diagnosis and what to expect during a procedure.  Answering any questions you may have. It took a while for me to to get numb before my procedure and she made sure that I was comfortable feeling no pain. Her techs are are very sweet, personable and gentle.  I never have to wait long for my visit.  Front desk staff are also very friendly, sweet and personable.  Cost estimates are provided and explained.  The staff do their best at working with your insurance. Overall truly amazing dentist with an awesome team!! Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Huy Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Customer service at Smile Haus Austin was excellent. Receptionists were very nice and helpful. I went to this dental clinic for cleaning and filling. Dr. Jose Saez took care of me, and he did a great job. He gracefully kept me calm when I was scared of medical tools. The nurses were friendly too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vicky Valdez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great customer service and quality dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alice K Newberry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience at Smile Haus. Making an appointment was easy and they were able to fit me in quickly. The front desk team was extremely kind and thoughtful. The dental team was experienced, thorough, and deliberate. I never felt that I was wasting my time or energy. I was advised and never monetarily pushed on anything and still feel I got the best service. Thanks for being my new go-to dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Hendren
user_reviews_extended.Description: Found this place after I felt like my old dentist was always trying to upsell me / pressure me into stuff I didn’t need or want. I really like everyone involved in the practice from the front desk to the assistants to the doc. My wife also goes here and likes it. They’re also super organized and easy to communicate with. They have a texting option I use to confirm / request / change appointments frequently. We heard about them through friends and are really happy to have found Smile Haus.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Camp
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place! Friendly & thorough - I highly recommend checking them out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keyori Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is amazing and very accommodating to their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynnae Basom
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office does great job making me feel comfortable. The dental hygienist’s are kind and non-judgmental and genuinely care about you. Makayla was my hygienist at my most recent visit and she was awesome! The office staff is also great at working with your schedule and letting you know about any appointments that open up. Would highly recommend, especially for people who are nervous about going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Busby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Good service, quick, great environment, staff is very friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan F.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really great staff and really great dental service.  Dr Baik explains everything really well and is always making sure you are alright and comfortable.  My previous dentist, Dr Root, retired and I was very comfortable with him. Dr Baik made the transition so seamless and I felt confident in the dental work I was receiving.  The front receptionist/office worker is just awesome (Lucinda?).  Can't recommend this office enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gerri Foster
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. Root for  30 years. I was pleased to know his staff has stayed on after he retired.  I was very apprensive trusting a new dentist after all these years.  Dr. Baik is a great dentist, she listens to you and goes above and beyond to make sure you are pleased.  I appreciate her professionalism and kindness.  Shout-out to the wonderful staff, Olga, Nancy, Camille, Lynn and Josh. 🙂  Still very Happy with Dr. Back and staff.  They are very compassionate and friendly 🥰

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ima Eridink
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've had a few regular cleanings here (at least 4, I think), Invisalign, a filling, and now prep for a crown to cover a broken tooth with a huge filling in it.

The office staff run everything from scheduling to billing/insurance smoothly. I like that they schedule my regular cleanings 6 months out - it helps keep me on task with these visits. They text reminders and request verification replies, and reschedule if things change for the patient in the interim between scheduling and reminders. I appreciate that they contact me via text, but they also call for reminders if you don't use texting.

All of the procedures I've had done by the dental team have been done very well. In my experience, Dr. Baik and staff working with her run like a well oiled machine and they appear to have good working relationships.

I highly recommended this office. Everything is well done. The staff is all friendly and welcoming. The office is flexible and efficient. Overall, my relationship with this office has been a really good experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Hartig
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the people at Smile Haus. I was a patient of Dr Root before he retired.  He picked a great group of people to take over his practice.  Dr Baik is a really warm and friendly person and super smart. The front desk folks are like old friends. Lynn stayed on with the new group so its nice to see a friendly face when I come in. They have all the latest equipment.  Not only do I get my teeth cleaned but I have also had an implant and Invisalign.  I am extremely happy with the quality of service.  I highly recommend giving Smile Haus a try.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mason Putonti
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were very friendly and professional, also completely transparent about the costs associated with whatever procedures would be necessary in the future. I look forward to my next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Castignoli
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've always had a really good experience at smile Haus with Dr. Baik. She explains the options clearly and is focused on long term dental health. I understand what issues could come up in the future and any follow up is quick. I also leave understanding exactly what I need to do in the meantime to maintain my dental hygiene. I appreciate the front desk ladies who always make check in and check out very smooth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daiso
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time going there. Great customer service. Staff spoke spanish which is always a plus. Dr. Duarte explained everything she was doing. While I was getting my procedure done with the laughing gas, I remember there were times I was feeling anxious, but either Dr. Duarte or her assistant reassured me and it helped me relax. Dr. Duarte has a very gentle touch, I barely felt when she was numbing my mouth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aina Ongcheap
user_reviews_extended.Description: Carolyn (my hygienist) and Dr. Saez are the best and most professional dental care staff I have ever met! I really enjoyed their careful and thorough care, and they explained what was going on every step of the way. I will be referring Smile Haus Austin to all of my friends and family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice staff, easy to make appointments and the dentist was very thorough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rl McGruder
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to the dentists at this location for the past 20+ years. When the former dentist retired, I was wary of the replacement, but decided to give her a chance. Dr. Baik and the rest of the team (some former, some new) are simply wonderful, and I’m SO glad I stayed. They are friendly, kind, and caring, and you’re not just another patient to them. If you’re lucky, you’ll get to pet a dog to soothe your nerves!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yaniv Goldstein
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The best dental services in town. Friendly crew, highly professional, easy parking, caring & giving a lot of empathy. They are super fair, no surprise fees and always let you know upfront before paying out of pocket - which is really rare these days.
Thank you ! Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kyle shebby
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very good experience at Smile Haus on Guadalupe. I had a crown come out over the weekend, I called Monday morning and they were able fit me in their schedule that day and had it taken care of! Great service and communication!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Hyder
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Ive had a ton of dental work done and i have to say these are by far some of the best dentists and oral surgeons I've ever seen. Tooth pulled perfectly, bone graft phenomenal, and even after i was an idiot and caused my stitches to come out early they redid them quickly and better than the seams of an Italian tailored suit.
Professional, nice, and talented, 10 out of ten recommend doctor wharton and doctor phan. Google needs to make a 6 out of 5 stars option just for this business

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom Yudichak
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going for regular checkups (as well as some less routine work) at Smile Haus Austin for two years now. Everyone on the staff has always been friendly and cheerful, making my visits here invariably pleasant. Dr. Baik, who has become my primary dentist in this time is a skillful dentist beyond being quite personable herself. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jess R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very satisfied with the care and attention that I receive at Smile Haus. I have been a patient there for several years. Dr. Baik is very attentive and courteous. She always explains in detail the procedures she performs. Lynn and the rest of the staff are always welcoming and friendly. They always take the time to answer any questions I have.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carolyn Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Appointment was on time!  Very professional staff!  They are all interested in your overall health!  Best dental cleaning I have ever had! The dentist came in and suggested some improvements that I could make to my smile and teeth.  They were not pushy whatsoever and I agreed with the recommendations!  State of the art equipment!  I was very impressed!
Carolyn Wilson

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Pospisil
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Baik and her staff do a great job. I am always greeted with a smile and there is no wait time passed my scheduled appointment. They make going to the dentist about as enjoyable as it can be. They are fast ,efficient and very accommodating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriela Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was a patient of Dr. Root’s for a long time and continued to see Dr. Baik when she took over. I’ve been here for two wisdom teeth removals and they both went easily and smoothly. My family has known Lynn for years and the staff will always make you feel welcome. If you’re ever scared or worried about seeing the dentist, the staff here will make sure you are comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ted Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great crew and very efficient and s great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Birgit Schulz
user_reviews_extended.Description: They really show empathy in what can normally feel like a vulnerable situation. The dental staff are thorough, pain-free and friendly.  Great communicators via text and phone. Someone is always reachable.  They love dogs and allow me to bring mine to share and give comfort!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cornchips Novemberland
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was a patient of the awesome Dr. Root for many years. I miss him and visiting with his fluffy dog. Since he retired, I have continued with Dr. Baik and the new staff and have had consistently great experiences. The new hygienist Jenny is AMAZING with masterful skills...she is gentle, thorough and focused. Given her easy and chill vibe, this was the best cleaning experience ever! Dr. Baik is very friendly, articulate and a complete professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Warden Weaver
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred from a branch office.  Staff were all professional and friendly.  Dr. Baik was very reassuring.  She explained ahead of time what she was going to do and made sure that I understood it.  During the procedure she let me know what she was doing and made little comments about how well things were going. I really liked her.  Her assistant was also good at distracting me when I needed to be distracted, like during shots.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Kim
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Baik is very skilled and personable; I feel very comfortable as her patient and confident in her skills. The front office is always very helpful and friendly. It's a special place and my entire family goes here, and we are very satisfied with the care we have received.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Schmidt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super accommodating, quick, and they give excellent tips and explain how to care for your teeth every time. Will work with your insurance and checks in every time before beginning the procedure to make sure you’re all on the same page! Highly recommend it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Portia Fono
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Baik and the staff at Smile House have been so helpful and professional in how they treat me. They fixed my spaced out teeth gaps with invisalign, did a beautiful crown on my back molar and were very careful with my tooth sensitivity. They worked with me on payment options to give me the best care for my teeth. I would recommend Smile Haus as a great place to call home for dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Subrah Fatima
user_reviews_extended.Description: always have a good experience at smile haus!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Finally, a dentist that I don’t fear - In general, I hate going to the dentist because it gives me such bad anxiety. I had gone 6 years without going to the dentist, but I had a tooth problem that I really needed to get addressed, so I sucked it up and finally decided to go to Smile Haus in late 2021 for a check up and teeth cleaning. Since then, I’ve had to go back multiple times for a dental implant procedure, and I can now honestly say that I’m not afraid of the dentist anymore! Dr. Baik and the staff here take such good care of me every time. Scheduling is flexible and pricing is reasonable too! Highly recommend if you need dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terri Brotherton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our visit to Smile Haus on Guadalupe was an excellent experience!  Our appointments were right on time and the entire staff was friendly and professional!  The office staff was caring and took time to go over financial estimates and worked with our schedule for future appointments!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mia durst
user_reviews_extended.Description: They explain everything in detail. Great personalities great service I was very pleased. I have really bad anxiety and they made it a little bit easier for me to go in and get my teeth done. They’re very comforting I am very professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Collins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve only ever had great experiences at Smile Haus. I was recommended this location as someone with a prior dentist phobia. The staff is so friendly and welcoming! From routine cleanings to extractions and cosmetic work, they’ve been so flexible and easy to work with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becca Covington
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Smile Haus makes you feel welcome, calm and cared for! Lynn at the front is a ray of sunshine and will always give you a smile. Today my hygienist was Melissa and she was gentle, kind and thorough. Dr. Baik is warm, knowledgeable and I know my teeth are in good hands. Thank you all for making every experience a positive one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abed Mikati
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve visited Smile Haus Austin to place three crowns. I honestly like this place so much, the whole team that works there are amazing and Dr. Saez is a professional's dentist and so friendly. They follow up with the patient and are really caring.
I will definitely visit again when I need to fix any tooth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Cosby
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Smile Haus! They are quick, efficient and don’t try to “sell” on things you don’t need. I like to keep it simple, but they offer a lot of services like whitening. They also have great front desk staff! I’ve been going to this location for nearly a decade.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Itamar Benitez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I called in for an emergency consultation on a Monday after being in the ER for a throat and potential tooth infection. They where beyond polite and scheduled me a visit for that same day. Dr. Baik was very patient and kind explaining her diagnoses. They scheduled surgery for that Wednesday and I walked out with three less teeth but feeling tons better.

A great, compassionate, and efficient group of people from the reception to the operating chair.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melba Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Thank you Dr. Baik and Smile Haus!
What a relief to find a Dentist and Staff that care! I I’ve had several dental emergencies, as in front tooth chipped or crown broke, but my smile was quickly restored.
Thank you for utilizing cutting -edge solutions to solve old dental phobia’s!
🌹🙏🏾😃🙏🏾🌹

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Neumann
user_reviews_extended.Description: As pleasant as it gets going to the dentist. Extremely impressed with the quality of service, both customer and professional. Felt very taken care of from start to finish. Highly highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nina Haimowitz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great first experience! I know picking a new dentist is hard but I’m so happy with Smile Haus. All of the staff was friendly and answered any questions I had. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Summer Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was easy to find and parking was good, the ladies in the office we're very nice and accommodating to our situation. Everyone was very sweet and the waiting room is very comfy and have a Keurig machine with different flavors tea and coffee. Will definitely recommend to friends and will be back for all my dentistry needs!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tianyu Zhou
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Baik is the best! I had one of the best experience extracting a teeth with her. She is very experienced and patient with my every question. I didn’t feel any pain during the whole process and even it’s a wisdom teeth, I haven’t got any face swelling after the teeth extraction.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Medina
user_reviews_extended.Description: I get my teeth cleaned more often than most people, and I've gotten Invisalign at Smile Haus -- which means I've spent a lot of time there. I'm very pleased with the services I've received and the friendliness and professionalism of the staff. Highly recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brent Zhuang
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is friendly, professional, and efficient. It’s clear they care about patient experience - highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connor Dent
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The purpose of my visit to Smile Haus was to attend to a root canal, crown, and routine cleaning. I did this directly under Dr. Baik.

One thing I like about Dr. Baik was her willingness to share specific knowledge of my dental work with me. I ask a lot of questions, and talk a lot in general. As a massage therapist, I have an itch to know exactly what is happening anatomically. She would honor my desires to have a comprehensive understanding and demonstrated her own proficiency along the way.

The root canal was successful and I’m happy to no longer be in pain.

The rest of the support staff was kind and helpful. I look forward to seeing them at my next visit.

Also, the dog that hangs out in the office became my friend when I was sitting around waiting for the numbing injections to set in. 10/10. Would play fetch with him again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Lehmusvirta
user_reviews_extended.Description: First, what a lovely, serene and actually meditative atmosphere! The staff, some of whom are long-term colleagues that I now consider friends, are so professional and efficient, and also sincerely personable and fun. Of course, the technicians and Dr. Baik are top notch; very thorough and they explain everything at each step. I'm not afraid of dentists, but those who get the squeamies, this team will calm you just being around them. And, by golly, they stay on schedule, which matters a lot to me fitting visits into a packed timeline!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sunny Morales
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm writing this review on behalf of my elderly mother who doesn't have a Google account. Dr. Levo and team are currently working on implants for my mom. Due to her lack of dental insurance she has been putting this off for so long, since the quotes in other offices were sky high. Smile Haus worked with her financially and treated my mother so well with expert precision to prepare for implants. Highly recommend this group for any dental work, particularly any challenging/difficult scenarios. She is thrilled with their work so far and is extremely excited to have teeth again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrienne Romine
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is amazing! I had previously gone to another dentist who told me that I needed 10 fillings and I was saving up to do all of that work but Dr. Baik said none are needed! I’m so glad I stumbled upon this office and saved thousands of dollars of unnecessary dental work. On top of that, everyone I encountered was so friendly and warm.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renee Bain
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is the most friendly! All of them. The hygienists are thorough and Dr Balk is super thorough. I feel like for the first
Time in a long time my teeth are in fabulous shape. I highly recommend this team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie A Valenzuela
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wish I found this place sooner! It took me a long time to find a place that has amazing staff, dental hygienists, and a fantastic orthodontist.

The staff is very kind and will go above and beyond to help you! I always felt welcomed, and I could tell that my needs truly matter. Excellent customer service! They even have a hypoallergenic emotional support animal, Pete, that is there to make your day brighter! Pete is a special touch and a real asset to have around. I couldn't stop talking about him for days!

The dental hygienist I had left my teeth feeling spotless! During the cleaning the dental hygienist was very kind, thoroughly cleaned my teeth, and took the time to listen to any questions and/or concerns.

Dr. Baik is fantastic! She is extremely smart, well educated in her field, has a big heart, and will above any beyond to help you in anyway possible. She helped to diagnose a problem I had been having for two years, while my primary care doctor and former dentist disregarded my pain, Dr. Baik listened and literally found the root of the problem! She took immediate action, and I felt like the number one priority the entire time. Now for the first time in two years, my mouth is pain free! During the procedure she listened to my concerns, explained the process, what was going to happen, and narrated while it was happening. I fully understood my options and any possible risks.

Something else that I found rare in a dental office, but extremely important, is this office will support pre-dental students with their educational goals. As someone who values community outreach/volunteering, I think this is really cool, and it demonstrates the positive impact this office is making on a larger scale! Bravo!!

Everyone here is extremely nice, thoughtful, compassionate, and makes you their number one priority. Great establishment to go to for your oral health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yvette Alvarado
user_reviews_extended.Description: Even though I arrived early, I was seen right away. Sage made sure I was comfortable throughout my procedure. They care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: delfina lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience from the first moment that I walked into Smile Haus has been nothing but pleasant. I was referred by someone, based on my specific needs and not so positive past experiences. Everyone in the office is professional, calm and kind. Dr.Yeu Jin Baik is gentle, attentive and to the point. I'm extremely content to have found Dr Baik and the rest of the family of dentistry at Smile Haus.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terry Eureste-Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Prior to Smile House, I was with Dr. Root close to 20 years. At first, I was concerned if I would continue to receive the same thorough dental service. Since Smile House has taken over, it has been a wonderful transition. Dr. Levo and the staff have been awesome to me. Thank you!
Terry E-T

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Hobbs
user_reviews_extended.Description: When our long term dentist retired, we panicked, as finding a good dentist is difficult. Smile Haus took over the practice, and we gave it a try. Right away we were comfortable with the new doctors, and much of the previous staff had remained  We feel we receive top of the line, quality care at Smile Haus from Dr Baik, and everyone there.so glad we didn’t have to go searching!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this dentist since 2011and since the new ownership I remained at the practice and I’m so happy that I did.  My daughter goes there too and had Invisalign which was great. We were able to do a payment plan. I also signed up for the membership which saved me money. I needed a filling last year and was concerned about novocaine because I don’t like to be numb for a long time. The Dr. was able to give me a short acting numbing agent so I was able to eat shortly after my appointment. So although my insurance isn’t accepted at the practice I won’t switch. I love Lynn, she knows my name and always makes me feel welcomed and has for 11 years!

user_reviews_extended.Name: George Schorn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always friendly, remarkably low-stress!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental hygienist I worked with was very gentle and made my cleaning so much more comfortable than I’ve experienced in the past

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Aronin Sherrill
user_reviews_extended.Description: I initially met Dr. Baik at the emergency clinic on Christmas eve and was so impressed with her that I sought out where she practiced the rest of the time.  That led me to Smile Haus and I haven't been disappointed.  The staff is friendly and efficient and Dr. Baik is highly skilled and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Blackman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a better experience at this dentist than I am used to having. Everyone was very friendly and took their time with me. I felt very comfortable here, even though I have anxiety around the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Shepherd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was shocked to learn that my dentist of 30 years had abruptly retired. We had worked through an extreme dental phobia to a place I could have routine cleanings and crowns set without anesthesia. After the initial stress of a new dentist, the experience has been great. Dr. Baik and team are amazing. She is empathetic and with comforting "chair" side manner. Would add a 6th star if allowed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cookie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a pleasure to see my dentist and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: MJ Messinger
user_reviews_extended.Description:
DR.Saez and entire staff were excellant. I had new dentist made since the others were well over 15 years old...I was afraid they would break if I dropped them and did not want to have do without teeth
..that would be embarrassing...no one really knew I wore dentures...I would recommend these services because they are professional and take pride in their work. THANK YOU..MJ MESSINGER

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lillie S.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice staff, quick and on time visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Micki Amstead
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Smile Haus does it again!

This time in Giving me Christmas is July!  They fixed my Two Front Teeth! 🦷 🦷.   The Staff is always so friendly and welcoming and the atmosphere is comforting and always seasonally decorated (it’s the small things!)

Dr. Jose Saenz and Destiny made the entire procedure down right enjoyable!

Thank you for taking good care of me and My Family for years now ❤️🦷❤️

Xoxo
Micki Amstead

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Smile Haus has made me enjoying coming to the dentist! The front desk ladies are so cheerful and funny, my hygienist made great small talk, and Dr. Baik listened to me and didn’t make me feel rushed. I highly recommend Smile Haus on Guadalupe!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Islas
user_reviews_extended.Description: i love smile haus! i just recently moved to austin and i am so glad i found them! everyone always answers my questions and make me feel so comfortable when im there for my appointments! they are the best and i HIGHLY recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erich D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Smile Haus took over for Dr. Root, who I saw for decades and is/was a tremendous dentist.  Thankfully, little has changed. Some of the former staff (like Lynn) remain, and the quality of dental care, from the dentists, hygienists, and those at the front, is exceptional.  Props to Dr. Levo for his work on my bridge.  I haven’t considered going anywhere else.  Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Loignon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don't say this lightly. Dr. Baik is the best dentist I've had my entire life, and I'm 58. I've needed a lot of work lately due to the age of the fillings I got when I was young. It's not fun, but Dr. Baik is a perfectionist. She's even fixed work of other dentists who didn't do as good of a job. She also understands my needle phobia and does so much to help me through the injection part.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Garrett Chase
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience at Smile Haus Austin! I had to switch dentists after some negligence from my last provider, and I've experienced nothing but knowledgeable and compassionate care from the staff here. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cara Hayward
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough amazing things about Dr. Levo, Dr. Farn, and their entire staff! I’ve now received cleanings/checkups, whitening trays, Invisalign scans, and most recently a fixed chipped front tooth. I was expecting a little binding to “patch it up” but they completely transformed my two front teeth and made them even better than they were before! The whole office is extremely professional but also relaxed. High quality work with fantastic bedside manner. They provide offers and recommendations based on your wants/needs but are never pushy. Thank you Smile Haus! (Ps look at my smile transformation!)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary U
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was a previous client here of Dr. Root and so the changeover made me a bit nervous, but Dr. Baik gives equally as great service and really cares about helping you achieve a perfect and healthy smile. She’s very kind and I appreciate her expertise.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Medrano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is super nice and communicative. Really helps ease my nervousness!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Soo Kim

title: Toothbar
address: 211 Walter Seaholm Dr LR 160, Austin, TX 78701, United States

user_reviews.Name: Harrison Coley
user_reviews.Description:
What business in the new world is all about.

9/10 service, 9/10 delivery, and 9/10 pricing.

Amazing systems for reminders.

Admin staff - Krystal - are amazing. Knowledgeable, kind, and results oriented.

Dental techs - Selinda - are friendly, focused, and show attention to detail and client care.

Dentists - Dr. Gibbons - are always kind while being direct about what needs to be done and what isn’t worth worrying about.

Clearly a company with a good culture.

Been avoidant of dentists my whole life due to negative experiences. Here I don’t feel that way.

user_reviews.Name: Larry T
user_reviews.Description:
Outstanding experience from start to finish!
I decided to try Toothbar after my dentist of over 30 years retired—and I’m so glad I did. The technology and level of service here are truly top-notch. Mars and Tess were not only highly skilled but also incredibly compassionate, making the whole visit comfortable and stress-free. Dr. Jacobsen has a calm and patient demeanor, and she took the time to thoroughly answer all my questions. I’ll definitely be returning and highly recommend Toothbar to anyone looking for exceptional dental care.

user_reviews.Name: Dana Arnold
user_reviews.Description: My teeth have never been this clean before!! Seriously this was the most thorough cleaning I’ve ever had. Ally was my hygienist and she was so helpful and communicative and DETAILED. Dr. Gibbons was also super patience with my questions and talked through everything I was interested in having done to my teeth! Really grateful. I can’t recommend enough! & can’t fail to mention how gorgeous the office is.

user_reviews.Name: Gordon Buie
user_reviews.Description: I will strongly recommend Toothbar to family and friends seeking dental care.  The crisp contemporary interior design of the facility sets the stage for the well-coordinated and efficient teamwork of the staff.  Dr. Jacobsen clearly outlined the plan for treatment and readily answered the few questions I had.  Over the course of the procedure, she monitored and made adjustments to minimize any discomfort.  All went exactly as outlined. All these factors, from reception to treatment to checkout, combine to result in exceptional dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
What business in the new world is all about.

9/10 service, 9/10 delivery, and 9/10 pricing.

Amazing systems for reminders.

Admin staff - Krystal - are amazing. Knowledgeable, kind, and results oriented.

Dental techs - Selinda - are friendly, focused, and show attention to detail and client care.

Dentists - Dr. Gibbons - are always kind while being direct about what needs to be done and what isn’t worth worrying about.

Clearly a company with a good culture.

Been avoidant of dentists my whole life due to negative experiences. Here I don’t feel that way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larry T
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Outstanding experience from start to finish!
I decided to try Toothbar after my dentist of over 30 years retired—and I’m so glad I did. The technology and level of service here are truly top-notch. Mars and Tess were not only highly skilled but also incredibly compassionate, making the whole visit comfortable and stress-free. Dr. Jacobsen has a calm and patient demeanor, and she took the time to thoroughly answer all my questions. I’ll definitely be returning and highly recommend Toothbar to anyone looking for exceptional dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dana Arnold
user_reviews_extended.Description: My teeth have never been this clean before!! Seriously this was the most thorough cleaning I’ve ever had. Ally was my hygienist and she was so helpful and communicative and DETAILED. Dr. Gibbons was also super patience with my questions and talked through everything I was interested in having done to my teeth! Really grateful. I can’t recommend enough! & can’t fail to mention how gorgeous the office is.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gordon Buie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I will strongly recommend Toothbar to family and friends seeking dental care.  The crisp contemporary interior design of the facility sets the stage for the well-coordinated and efficient teamwork of the staff.  Dr. Jacobsen clearly outlined the plan for treatment and readily answered the few questions I had.  Over the course of the procedure, she monitored and made adjustments to minimize any discomfort.  All went exactly as outlined. All these factors, from reception to treatment to checkout, combine to result in exceptional dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Al Leffler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Visiting with Dr. Barclay and her team is always a pleasure. They are so confident and understand the most current and important Dental science to maximize our care!  Keep up the wonderful work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Nelms
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Dr Baake was warm and professional and my results were better than expected. Would highly recommend if you are considering a whitening treatment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Klaudia Marino
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always, great job. Particularly happy with Selina today. She found a way to clean my teeth without the dreaded pain from that dang sonic water cleaner thingy.  Wish I could just request her each time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bruce Barrett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Toothbar is amazing!  Outstanding dentistry and a great team.  Beautiful, happy office!

Can’t thank Dr.Jacobson and Suzette on the team or seeing me over the New Year’s holiday and dealing with a very painful toothache! toothbar is there for you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Haefner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Dr Jacobsen at Toothbar ever since they opened, several years ago. I genuinely look forward to my appointments and catching up with her and her staff. They are so friendly and fun to be around, and they truly care about your comfort and having a good experience at the dentist, not something you dread! Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctors and staff at the Toothbar are top notch! At Toothbar they operate as a team. Everyone is smart, friendly, sincere and hardworking. It’s a professional yet very happy environment. I look forward to going for cleanings or any treatment I need. I’m uninsured but their prices are reasonable and accommodating. I love the Toothbar!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to this dentist for a mouth guard from my physical therapist. They have exceeded my expectations in allowing me to come in for multiple adjustments. They take their time and get the appliance just right for me. I can’t say enough god things about this entire office. Always a pleasant and upbeat place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan N
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great team here at Toothbar! They’re always thorough and make the cleaning a quick and smooth experience. Highly recommend!

P.S. their cocofloss is awesome

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zoya
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you're looking for a posh place to get your teeth cleaned, this office is not bad. However I would NOT recommend getting serious treatment. The crown the doctor put in was way too big and I had gone back twice to get it adjusted. Finally the doctor just told me there's nothing she can do about it. The crown cracked from the adjustments. When I called asking for an appointment to discuss the crack, I was told I had to pay for the visit because the doctor who worked on my tooth is no longer with the office.  Although the office has my visiting records in the system, the staff who answered the phone said he can't attest to my actually being there because he wasn't there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M Chau Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Toothbar has always been great. From the people at the front desk, to the hygienists, to the dentists; everyone has always been AMAZING.

My dentist, Dr. Bakke has always had my best interests in mind when discussing my treatment plan. So grateful for her.

Additionally, I had the absolute BEST experience today when I was lucky enough to have Nikki as my hygienist. (Sorry if I misspelled her name).

Nikki is truly an AMBASSADOR for oral health and education. I can’t say enough good things about her!
She listens to your needs, is patient, and kind. She educates you about your oral health and offers recommendations to fit your needs. Nikki was attentive and her work was gentle yet extremely thorough. It was amazing how clean my teeth felt!!

She truly cares about your experience and is a GEM of an addition to the Toothbar team.

TOOTHBAR IS THE BEST IN AUSTIN!!

Thank you for everything; I will never again test out another dentist while in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lee Rogers
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I visited the Tooth Bar today for the first time today. The experience was exceptional! Unfortunately I have had numerous dental experiences throughout my life - today was by far my best dental experience. Front the customer service oriented front desk team, to the stellar hygienist to my dentist, Dr. Bakke - the experience was stellar. I had an extremely thorough initial exam and left with a well thought out plan to resolve my dental concerns that incorporated my preferences.

Did I mention the office is gorgeous!

Thanks,

Lee Rogers

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Medina
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is nice but dentist was not gentle with my teeth and suggested treatments I didn’t need. I needed to find a new dentist, going was just a waste of time

user_reviews_extended.Name: J B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got my teeth fixed up by them back in 2021. Leading up to when they were fixed and during, great service! Not so much after... They did not give me my retainer for my teeth after sizing and dismissed my concerns over a swelling spot on my gum from needle injections. I am writing this review today because these past 4 years, that injection site has continued to be an issue, front and center on my smile. Today, it is incredibly painful and swollen and I just want the team to know that I asked for help and have been suffering for many years since. I paid good money for good service and the follow through was not there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Sms (ss)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Barclay fixed and sculpted my teeth like an artist, using high-end quality materials, I can tell the difference. Her level of care and detail are amazing, also personable and charismatic. This office adheres to the highest quality standards and efficiency, (including dealing with insurance) from the front office to the dental assistants and tools they use, I haven’t had such a seamless experience ever. This place should be studied and replicated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Meehan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I adore the dentists here, and have seen them for seven years.
I don't understand why the billing is consistently a nightmare.
They can't seem to stay in network with any dental insurance company for more than a few months. You won't find out about it until after the fact, or days before your appointment.
I love my dentist, but not enough to deal with such an unprofessional hot mess of a billing department.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very pleasant experience. Hygienist was informative at each step. Staff friendly and you can tell they are proud of their office, team, and practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Lisa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have loved this dentist office since day ONE Everyone is so professional and kind. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Morrow
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bakke is always super positive, encouraging, and a pleasure to see. She takes time to address treatment plans and concerns, is always thoughtful, and I'm so glad I chose The Toothbar for all of my dental needs! A great experience each time I visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia and Blake
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great experience at the Toothbar! We enjoy every person we come in contact with at with at our appointments. Allie Booher is the best hygienists!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maddie Lipe
user_reviews_extended.Description: i’ve wanted permanent fangs for so long and the wonderful staff was able to bring that to life for me! i’m so happy with my results and will highly recommend this beautiful office to anyone in need of dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: R Buchanan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend Toothbar. The whole experience was wonderful!  Dr Bakke and the entire staff are exceptional. I really appreciate the modern technology and Lexi did an excellent job on my cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: B R
user_reviews_extended.Description: Unfortunately, my experience with this office was disappointing,not because of the dental care itself, but because of the way the practice has been managed recently. The front office seems disorganized, leading to scheduling issues and long wait times. More concerning, the employees appear overworked and undervalued, which affects the overall atmosphere of the clinic. A supportive and well-managed workplace benefits both the staff and the patients, and sadly, this office lacks that level of care. I truly hope they make improvements to support their team, as it would enhance the experience for everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yvonne L. Hidrogo
user_reviews_extended.Description: My very first time at toothbar.  They came highly recommended by my daughter.  I was not disappointed! In fact I was very impressed from the time I walked in until I left. The staff was courteous and polite. The hygienist was professional and informative, and took her time with my teeth cleaning. The dentist was informed of my concerns and scans before meeting with me and gave her recommendations and was very pleasant. They will now be my dentist of choice for all my dental needs. I also love that they are available for dental emergencies.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Fabiani
user_reviews_extended.Description: They’re super attentive in my cleaning and even gave me a comfy blanket when I was cold. They did a thorough job with my cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith Ikard
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My hygienist is Tess and she is so professional. She always lets me know exactly what’s going on with my teeth and what she is about to do. She also gives great advice on bettering my teeth care at home.

Between Tess and Dr. Jacobsen I know I have a solid team taking care of me at Toothbar.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Destinee Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: The actual dental providers are amazing and valet parking is clutch. The insurance issues is the reason they are getting this low review. There is a lot of miscommunication regarding the insurance they accept and it’s been an absolute nightmare for the last year. One day they will tell you are covered and you only pay $29 and then 2 weeks later you’ll get a bill for over $500 telling you you’re not covered. Please call your actual insurance provider before doing business with this office. So sad because I thought this was my forever dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife has extreme dentist anxiety, and finding someone who can help her feel comfortable is always a challenge. Dr. Danielle Gibbons at Toothbar exceeded all expectations! She was incredibly patient, understanding, and went out of her way to make sure my wife was calm throughout the entire visit. Not only did Dr. Gibbons do a fantastic job with her treatment, but she was also kind and gentle, which made all the difference. We’re so grateful to have found her, and I highly recommend Dr. Gibbons to anyone, especially if you’re nervous about seeing the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leela Gupta
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had nothing but great experiences here, especially with my dentist Dr. Danielle Gibbons. Since day 1, she she has been extremely patient, explained everything thoroughly, and consistently delivered excellent care. It’s refreshing having a provider be transparent about costs and treatments before committing to them. I’ve been following her for the past 2 years through my Invisalign treatment and I would recommend her to anyone, she is wonderful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great experience with the team and Tess as my hygienist! The team makes process a breeze and do everything they can to make you feel comfortable. New patient visits are a bit longer due to the intake process but you can appreciate the thorough background and imaging take.

They also offer several cosmetic procedures for those interested without pressuring you into anything you’re not ready for, and they offer 2 hour parking validation in the Seaholm garage.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great first experience at Toothbar!  From the time you walk in until you leave, you are treated like a VIP. The staff is welcoming and the office and location are beautiful.  Tess was the most gentle hygienist I've ever had. My teeth are super sensitive and she made sure to have a gentle touch. And I have to give a shout out to Jewel, who took my x-rays. She is so friendly and explained everything in detail. It was the best cleaning I ever had. Dr. Bakke provided a great exam too. Gentle dentistry at its finest. I highly recommend the Toothbar and I'm happy to make them my new dental home!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clint Herzog
user_reviews_extended.Description: Increíble service, professional staff, and great Dentists.  Best dental experience in years!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Rahe
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent service by all staff, which started at booking. My insurance was verified promptly and I was able to get in as a new patient in a more than reasonable time. The office actually felt posh with a television I could  watch during my cleaning with me controlling the remote! They were thorough with gathering background, concerns I had and with my cleaning. I did end up electing to do a preventive procedure and my insurance coverage for it was determined on the spot and was completed same day. The staff was on time, friendly and welcoming across the board, and knowledgeable. I was alerted and educated on things I had not been advised of with my previous multi-practice chain dentist office - and it wasn’t to sell me procedures.

Super pleased with Dr. Bakke for taking a thorough look at everything, her professionalism and recommendations.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Pearl Woolston
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great first experience at Toothbar in Seaholm! Ricardo was super helpful and so lovely. Excited to get started on my teeth whitening journey!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haven Barrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: From beginning to end my experience was amazing. They helped with paying for parking and were very patient. When I got taken back I was given a little tour of the office and when I got sat and was explaining my dental history, she was very clear in explaining what could be the issue and how to best resolve them. I think her name was Morgan. While she was cleaning my teeth she made sure I comfortable the whole time and kept checking to see if I need a break which I very much appreciated. They came and explained my dental plan very clearly and made sure I understood what was being said and the pricing. I spoke with multiple staff members and all of them were patient, helpful, and made sure I was comfortable and understood everything through my whole appointment. I also very much enjoyed being able to watch Netflix during the tooth cleaning

user_reviews_extended.Name: kishi harutaka
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Toothbar! The team is fantastic, offering incredible customer service and professionalism that stands out. Rescheduling appointments is always a breeze, which I deeply appreciate. Dr. Barclay is a talented dentist who has transformed my smile for the better. Highly recommend for anyone seeking top-notch dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Klein
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Toothbar for many years. Dr. Jacobsen and the team are fantastic. She’s the best dentist I’ve ever been to. Excellent staff that takes the time to explain everything to you. The office is clean and modern. It is truly one of the best experiences that excites me for my dentist appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marta Zinyuk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tessa gave me one of the (if not the best) cleaning I have ever had! Highly recommend Toothbar. Dr. Gibbons did the exam and was extremely honest in her recommendation. I will definitely be coming back to Tooth bar for all my future cleanings and any work I need done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Morrow
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Toothbar is wonderful! Confident, professional, friendly doctors and staff make  visits here a welcome experience - leave your dental anxieties behind! Each team member here is committed to providing five-star service to their clients - thorough communication/consultation; a can-do / will-do approach to service; a tranquil atmosphere and kindness. These people enjoy what they do and it shows! Thank you, Toothbar! Keep shining!

user_reviews_extended.Name: AwesomeATX
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing service, location and expertise. Dr. Gibbons is truly amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Pierce
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Went in for a teeth whitening and the entire process felt very luxury and the person who did the whitening did an excellent job! Would definitely return if they were in network for my insurance but unfortunately they are not.

Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aimee Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tooth Bar offers an exceptional dental experience!! Dr. Barclay's professionalism and gentle approach make visits very enjoyable. The entire team ensures patients are comfortable and well-informed, fostering a welcoming atmosphere. Modern amenities and attention to detail further enhance the experience. Highly recommend Tooth Bar for outstanding dental care and service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cat Cadwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place has been a pleasant surprise. As soon as I walked in, they offered me either sparkling water or sparkling flavored water, this instantly made me smile. talk about southern hospitality.  This location is accessible and respectful.  My dentist was a woman, and instead of telling me about the things that I have done wrong, she told me about the things that  I have been doing right. I definitely left my appointment with a big smile on my face. And once I was done, I was able to treat myself, with some macaroni and cheese from Trader Joe’s right next-door. Very respectful, kind, accessible place. Oh, I want to mention, I am extremely afraid of going to the dentist, this was a wonderful experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katelyn Crawford
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Toothbar for years. Such great providers and customer service. I’ve been to many dental offices before where I feel like they want to find every little cavity and fill it immediately. I have found the providers here are very honest and transparent. Monitoring when needed versus jumping right in to more procedures. I live in north Austin, with many options closer but choose to travel to go here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heath Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience from start to finish. I love having my teeth cleaned and they are so gentle.  Every service I’ve had with Toothbar is exceptional.  My Dentist is amazing, Dr Lauren - she takes the fear out of these experiences and is always so communicative.  She goes above and beyond and her team is always gracious and on top of it.  If you haven’t been to Toothbar…imagine 1 part dental office, 1 part spa, and 1 part Four Seasons service.  Keep up the great work -

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Isbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very clean and professional atmosphere. The ENTIRE staff is very welcoming and friendly. I am extremely bad remembering names; however, the dental hygienist is amazing, funny, and brilliant in her job, pain free.  I apologize, and wish I could remember her name. I saw several dentists there and all are wonderful. Most importantly, the practice is trustworthy. I never felt like they were trying to push procedures I didn't need. If there is a problem, they will monitor and provide options. That said, you can't go wrong with any hygienist or dentist, all are amazing, I am including the x-ray technician, cool dude.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ADK Villa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Unprofessional Billing Practices and Zero Accountability

I had an extremely disappointing experience with Toothbar in Austin. Over a year ago, I received a filling and was quoted an $800 contribution for my portion of the cost, which I agreed to and received the treatment.

Fast forward nearly 11 months, and I’m now being hit with an additional $750 bill. According to Toothbar, this extra charge is due to their error: they originally provided a quote based on the wrong material, leading to incorrect billing.

It’s unacceptable to burden a patient with nearly double the initial agreed-upon cost due to internal miscommunication and mistakes. Rather than taking responsibility for their error, Toothbar is now trying to force me into an unexpected financial position long after the treatment was completed. I urge anyone considering their services to proceed with caution and insist on transparent, accurate pricing from the start.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Today was a weird experience in this office and I won’t be returning again. The customer service by the staff unprofessional in so many ways.

Late service delivery:

I’ve been a patient here for some period of time and always came to appointments on time. Generally when I arrive to appointments the dentist always starts late (15-20 mins late on average) and the dentist is generally double booked. However I’m always patient considering my service always starts late when I’m on time.

Non-transparent billing practices:

I came to get my permanent retainer bracket replaced about two weeks ago and had a strange experience where their billing department did not submit my claim to my insurance and as a result overcharged me by 50%. The guy who works in the front told me the reason he “couldn’t” submit my claim to insurance was because it was related to orthodontics, which made absolutely no sense at all. I requested the billing department submit my claim to insurance to discover I was charged double the price. I then found out from the office manager that the dentist was out of network. Which was a completely different story the guy in the front explained to me.

Their staff needs more training to understand billing best practices and that you should always submit a claim to insurance for every service provided otherwise it comes off as unethical because you can charge more when billing someone without considering their insurance discount. With all of this, I still decided to give this practice a try.

Today, November 26th, I was running 18 mins late to appointment due to an emergency. This is the first time I’ve ever been late with all of my appointments. I was courteous enough to call ahead of time and inform the front office. I was informed the window is 15 minutes and since I would be 3 minutes outside of the window the dentist states she couldn’t see me. I decided to show up anyway since I would only be 3 minutes outside of the policy timeframe. When I arrived, I was not greeted by any of the staff or the dentist when she walked to the front when I was talking to the office manager (keep in mind it was four staff members in front). Instead of greeting me, I received looks from the staff as if I would be a “problem”, which is a very outdated frequency notion we should all steer away from in 2024.

I spoke with the office manager and she was kind enough to accommodate me and allow me to be seen.

If you attend this office, make sure they’re billing your insurance for every claim.

Moving forward, you should hold your employees to the same time standard that you hold your patients to. Meaning employees should start appointments timely and use their best judgment when enforcing the policy on patients. Today was not a good look for this office and I personally refuse to engage with a dental practice who has employees with outdated mentalities.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom K
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not a great experience. They have all the bells and whistles here, but no one seems happy. My dentist treated me (the patient) like I was inconveniencing her for asking to have my $850 bite guard (that I purchased there) adjusted. I just wanted to not choke on the thing at night. I was the bozo asking for too much there apparently. I’ve been there three times and she’s never introduced herself or addressed me (I assume my name is on the chart). When I asked if her name was Danielle (it was on her lab coat) she said “uh NO, it’s DOCTOR Gibbons”. I looked to the hygienist to gauge whether that was a practical joke. Whatever, they got my money. I’ve been to a lot of dentists and this is the only one where they talk AT you from behind your back as opposed to normal eye contact. So yeah it’s impersonal and weird. As most small business owners know — you have to (at least pretend to) care about your clients. That helps, in this case, to develop trust before they drill into your teeth. Anyway, big car dealership vibe here and surprised by the positive reviews to say the least. The hygienists do good work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Boykin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bakke is really great. I like that she comes around to face you when talking to you as opposed to other dentists I have had who talk to you while sitting behind you. The rest of the staff are also really pleasant. Thanks, Toothbar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connie Jacobsen
