user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have a very wonderful experience when I visit Toothbar, whether it is for a check-up, cleaning or whitening.  From the moment I enter, until I check-out.  The receptionists, always greet me with a smile and I have never waited for my appointment time to begin.  The staff is very professional and excellent at whatever treatment I am receiving.  The dentists are superb. Upon check-out, the process is smooth and pleasant.  Toothbar raises the bar in Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Talla Farivar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I pass about a hundred dentist practices while driving to toothbar and none can compare to this amazing place. This place is the absolute best of the best especially if you have dental anxiety like me. I love how kind and knowledgeable everyone is at toothbar.

user_reviews_extended.Name: McKenna West
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful first visit. Everyone there was lovely. The staff members were professional yet personable, and never once made me feel uncomfortable like health and dental care clinics can often do. From the moment I walked in the door, the clinic itself was spotless and it was clear that sanitation and cleanliness were top priority. They made recommendations for services and products that I would benefit from but never once pressured me into a sale. Very easy choice to make Toothbar my default for dental care and services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexa Chally
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love how professional the team is and how at ease they make me feel! Dr. Barclay helped me achieve my perfect smile and is a joy to work with. Hands down best dentists in town!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paige Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have nothing but great things to say about Toothbar. Most recently, I had to have an emergency crown put in and my dental insurance didn’t cover any of it, so I had to pay out of pocket, but the part they should have covered was not what they should have paid. Jeremy at the front desk not only took the time to kindly explain my insurance and the costs, but we realized another discrepancy in the bill. It’s this extra time and attention that really means the world because so often I pay healthcare bills without questioning them because I don’t understand them, especially after such a high out of pocket bill. I so much appreciate his understanding with my stress in owing more money than I’d already paid, his follow up call to me once he looked into it further, his explanation of my insurance, and his overall kindness and patience to making a stressful situation less so. Thank you again, Jeremy! 💕 it’s very refreshing to know you all are on our side!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Welch
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Until Google lets me add more stars, 5 will have to do for now :)

My experience at Toothbar truly set the standard for dental care, and I can't recommend it enough. Between the incredibly kind and welcoming staff, an atmosphere that negates any apprehension around dental work (I can watch Great British Baking Show while getting my teeth cleaned?!), and the knowledgeable yet friendly Dr. G, I never thought I'd ever say I'm looking forward to my next visit?

The immaculate interior and attention to detail and thoughtful care from all staff warrants 6 out of 5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellen Barraza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Toothbar is the best dental experience I’ve ever had! Could not recommend more!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Pedraza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Barclay is one of the best dentists I have had treat me. The assistants are great and well experienced too. I always come out of this place feeling well taken care of and happy. Staff is super friendly and the place is extremely well kept with some awesome refreshments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jai Goodwin
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Toothbar was great. It was just a retainer repair, but I have an unpleasant history with dental work so I typically feel anxious in these types of offices. Everything was wonderful from the staff to the fact that they were playing Planet Earth on a Tv in the room they put me in. Both the doctor and the technician were great and made me feel very comfortable. It was a super quick, pain free process and it didn’t break the bank! Highly recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Regina Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Getting a crown and filling is never anyone’s favorite thing to do, but my visit went great! Thank you Dr. Bakke and Bri for all your hard work and compassion during my appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Lucas
user_reviews_extended.Description: This facility is an absolute Godsend!  Dr. Barclay has the most up to date equipment and warm bedside manner. She’s knowledgeable, personable, and friendly with her staff. The staff is also friendly and efficient. I trust her completely with my advanced care. The location is perfect and it’s so clean inside the office. Did I mention the perks of a coffee keg and sparkling water?  I’m so blessed. Thank you Dr. Barclay for your exceptional care!  I appreciate your bright spirit because it shines as bright as your talent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma Varela
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a wonderful feeling to be able to trust your dentist and actually feel excited about coming back to get your cavities removed! They are up to date with technology and made the process easy and fearless. I cant say enough about their staff and the office set up! Very cool and hip! They are all sweet, knowledgeable, fun and professional! Dr. Barclay is awesome! No problems with parking and you can go shop/eat or head over to any near by happy hour! Kudos and much success to all of you. Thank you for a wonderful visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Glenn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best dentist I’ve ever been to.

The atmosphere and friendliness of all the staff really helps set it apart. Definitely makes going to the dentist a better experience than it normally is.

user_reviews_extended.Name: N A.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved my first appointment and visit to Toothbar. Overall, I would give this place a 9.5 out of 10. Every single person I ran into was extremely nice, and the service was impeccable. Also, their facilities are extremely clean and in good shape. My only constructive piece of criticism is that the front desk attendant did not appear to be too thrilled to answer some of my questions after my appointment was done, which kind of felt like a bad way to end the visit. Overall, extremely great service, location, and employees.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jul M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I followed my dentist from one location to another. In fact, I had to track her down. She is now a co-owner of the Toothbar. She and her business partner have built an exceptional dental program for their clients. Unlike the other place I never feel sold, manipulated or cheated. She as always is outstanding and she has hired an outstanding crew of hygienist. I feel the value is worth driving for no matter where I may roam.

Time does sometimes change things and not always for the better. The Toothbar is now a concierge type of practice. They no longer take insurance held by one of the largest employers in Austin-UT. The service is not what it used to be but somehow they got full of themselves, and forgot their customers. I have now changed dentists.

If you have money to burn this may be the perfect place for you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren P.
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is beautiful, but further the people are amazing. Dr. Jacobsen is awesome and knows her stuff -- she explains things in a way I can understand, while getting straight to the point. I can't remember the last time I've had a "good" or "great" experience at the dentist, and this was SO refreshing to be able to have a pleasant time at the dentist. I also have super sensitive teeth with overactive nerves and the doctor gave me an opportunity to feel comfortable expressing that and provided me with different ways to resolve that for future procedures and visits. I am consistently made to feel heard and comfortable, it’s a pleasure to go here. Wish that every dental office was like this. I’ll be coming back for as long as I’m in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Choi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my first time as a new patient at Toothbar. Bailey who works the front desk is super friendly and helpful. She got me all taken care of with all the forms to fill out before I arrived. The dental office is very chic and modern. It's got a cool Austin vibe you'd expect just in the form of a dental office. By far the coolest/state of the art dentist office I've been too. Tess was my Dental Hygienst who helped me. She was very knowledgeable and answered all my questions. I got a cleaning and xrays done within an hour. I loved the music that they played at the office. And the retractable Netflix TV was a nice touch. Something to distract your mind with. Dr Jacobsen had such a calming presence. She went over my teeth and offered her suggestions. I felt an immediate rapport with her. She seems to care a lot about her patients and offering them services that they need. Overall I had a great experience at Toothbar. Would highly recommend. Convenient location, 2hr validated parking, friendly staff, and modern facility!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drosto Montgomery
user_reviews_extended.Description: Toothbar is an amazing Dentist office.  It’s unique in its own way.  I like the vibe and the ambiance.  The staff is courteous and they know what they are doing.  Come here and get a Dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lorin Gottsacker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Barclay is a very talented dentist. I’ve driven a little under three hours round trip to see her more times than I can count. Not only did she do a beautiful job but she very graciously accommodated my OCD requests.  The entire staff is very warm and welcoming and ON TIME 👏🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Howard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Gibson is fantastic! She was so thorough walking me through my first (hopefully last) crown. She's so knowledgeable, friendly, and detail-oriented. Toothbar facility is clean, staff is cheerful. Great place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ray Capitelli
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First let me be 100% clear - Dr. Jacobsen is the best dentist I’ve ever had and I’m leaving this review after many, many year of great care bc the Toothbar Business Office is in dispute with my insurance company and notified me one week before my appointment that I could either pay out of pocket or find another dentist.
After reaching out to my insurance company, I asked the Toothbar Business Office to consider a reduced rate so I could keep my apt for next week, while paying out of pocket and getting reimbursement (about $150 less for them the usual) - they quickly declined. No consideration for the fact that I’ll need to find a new dentist and get an apt (when Toothbar themselves need 6 months advance notice for appointments) - just a bad decision made for their bottom line.
It’s a business, I get it. However I listen when a medical provider tells you that if the moneys not good enough, they’re not interested.

Profit over Patients - all current and future patients should consider this.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I usually hate going to the dentist but my experience here was just so amazing that I’m kind of bummed I have to wait 6 months to go back again. Everyone here is just so lovely and kind. They made me feel so comfortable and were incredibly friendly. The office itself is beautiful and quite luxurious. I will be recommending Toothbar to all of my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ioana Biggers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely amazing experience! I have never been excited or literally looked forward to going to the dentist. It feels like you’re going to a spa and the prices are actually the lowest I’ve ever seen! Dr. Barclay is an angel! She will make sure you feel no pain and you are as comfortable as possible. If you’re putting off going to the dentist like I used to, make an appointment with Toothbar. You will NOT be disappointed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsey Polarolo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve always been so anxious about going to the dentist, and usually put it off way longer than i should because my previous experience with other dentists have been mostly painful/unpleasant. I was pretty nervous about going somewhere new, however, I am SO GLAD I came to Toothbar! Not only were they so gentle when cleaning my teeth, they were also able to help with pain from night grinding. Plus, literally every single person I interacted with - front desk, technician, hygienist, dentist, check out, etc. - was SO nice/personable that I’m actually looking forward to my next appointment. 10/10 would HIGHLY recommend, especially if you have anxiety about dentist visits like I used to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelly Mattson
user_reviews_extended.Description: My favorite dentist for many, many years! Dr. Barclay has been amazing every time. I actually look forward to my cleanings!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had multiple bad experiences. I resonate with all the other reviewers who say that they’ve never been told they had that many cavities in their life. I also take fairly good care of my teeth, and I’ve never had an adult cavity in my life. When I went there, they told me I had 7 to 10 cavities that needed to be filled. Which seemed absolutely crazy to me. Especially that I go twice a year and I’ve never had any issues. I had a friend who is a dentist out-of-state review my x-rays and they confirmed that a lot of the recommended treatments were unnecessary.

On another occasion, I had my teeth whitened. I had gotten through the first of something like three to five sets of whitening in the same day. After the first one, I was in so much pain. It was to the point that I was on the verge of crying. I have a fairly high pain tolerance and never cry. I asked them if there was anything that they could do to help me and they didn’t even get the dentist to come look at me. To add injury to insult they would not refund me for majority of the treatment that I did not receive. I left crying because I was in so much pain.

Another time they tried to sell me on fluoride toothpaste. As a medical provider myself, I know that this is also given as a prescription, and my insurance can cover it. Ive had multiple prior dentists in the past so this without issue or as the standard. I asked them if they could send me a prescription my pharmacy. They refused and wanted me to buy the markup price of the fluoride toothpaste in their office.

At one visit, I went to have my annual check up and the dentist with someone I never met before. And was not someone I recognized as being one of the regular dentist. I thought it was odd, and expected her introduce herself or explain what was going on. But no one did. I finally asked and it was a temp that was covering vacation for the regular dentists. I understand people take vacation and should totally deserve that but it should be explained and made sure that you’re comfortable with seeing other dentist.

My last straw was when I had set a dentist appointment six months in advance as you do. I had gotten multiple reminders that my appointment was coming up and I had confirmed it. The day before in a TEXT, they let me know that they are no longer accepting my insurance and making sure I was okay with paying $357. Find it crazy that’s the cost for a regular checkup. They’d had multiple opportunity is to let me know when they were confirming my appointment for days and weeks before. And instead of calling me to inform me of this important information, they send it through a text. I'm sure if I had randomly cancelled on them less than 24 hours prior to my appointment, it would be unacceptable and I would incur a cancellation fee and/or couldn't get rescheduled for months. Similarly it's very frustrating to only be notified of it last minute when I have had to rearrange my work schedule and other obligations in order to keep this appointment for the past 6 months.

It seems that there’s a lot of dental practices now that try to make their offices seem modern and chic, while they mark up their prices and recommend unnecessary treatments. If anyone find a great family dentist in Austin, please let me know.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jacobsen and the entire team including the lovely ladies at the front desk, are AMAZING! I was in need of an extended dental procedure, and Toothbar has been working with me on the most efficient way to get it done since I drive in from Dallas for my appointments. The quality of care, customer service, location and the attention to the aesthetic design in the building make the travel worth it! Can't recommend Toothbar enough. A gem!

user_reviews_extended.Name: andy penaskovic
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist ever. Kelsey the hygienist is easily the most professional and funny hygienist I have ever had. Made me comfortable the whole time. Dr. Jacobsen was amazing, gave me a game plan and process of when we will do rest of the work. Could not recommend this place more everyone needs to check it out!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Porritt
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Toothbar is a great group of accomplished professionals and they made sure that I felt welcomed and appreciated from first contact to the time I left. Dr. Barclay is a top-ranked dentist and she went out of her way to make certain that my dentistry would be completed before the holidays, which is just a few days away. I recently moved to Austin and I highly recommend Toothbar to anyone in Austin looking for their life-time dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ian Richard Morrissey
user_reviews_extended.Description: State of the art equipment excellent service by both the hygenist and the dentist. Very happy with these professionals after moving to Austin a year ago. As long as I have teeth these guys will be helping me keep them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Silverman
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is hands-down the best dentist I've ever been to. The location is very convenient, the staff are personable and attentive, and everyone is always on time (I don't think I've ever waited to be seen more than 10 minutes). I see Dr. Gibbons - quite often, unfortunately, given my disastrous dental history - but she makes every visit about as painless as a trip to the dentist can be. I work a lot, and they're extremely flexible with my schedule (which is particularly impressive given how often I've had to last-minute reschedule on them). My wife sees Dr. Morren and feels the same way. Can't recommend Toothbar and Dr. Gibbons enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Bourque
user_reviews_extended.Description: Toothbar was the best dentist I’ve ever been to. The space itself is beautiful, the staff is so sweet and welcoming. The whole experience from the moment you walk in is first class. I would recommend this place to everyone! Finally, a dentist experience that I will look forward to again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Toothbar is honestly such a friendly, clean, trendy, quick yet personable environment. Their front office team to every single person that works here you can talk to like a friend that cares for you. They are happy to help you get the smile you’ve been waiting for and are just glad to be a part of making that happen. I have never felt like I have been listened to and heard as well as I have here at Toothbar. Everyone is amazing and my Invisalign results are immaculate! I would recommend this office to anyone and everyone no matter what your needs are.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Vu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been committed to a dentist before, so it came as a shock to me when I came here! I will no longer be jumping around from dental office to dental office as I have found a home for my teeth at Toothbar! Let me first start off by saying that I rarely write reviews and that in itself is indicative of exactly how exceptional Toothbar is from any other dental office, or business even. From setting up to finishing an appointment I have been met with only the sweetest, kindest and friendliest staff and professionals, and trust me when I say I have been here quite a few times and have interacted with quite a few people. The level of comfort I feel while getting my teeth done is astonishing. Not only do you feel like they have your teeth’s best interest in mind, but your interests as well. Before I finish up my rant on why Toothbar is the place to go, I have to give a quick shout out to Brittany, at the front desk, and Dr. Morren as they have been extremely thoughtful, amazing and are one of the main reasons why my experience has been nothing short of phenomenal. All in all, I cannot emphasize enough how truly amazing Toothbar is. If you are debating, stop and just do it. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily De La Cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ugh, I have nothing but great things to say about this place. For 12 years I had spent so much time in different dentist offices trying to find the right place to get my teeth done. I could never get myself to buckle down and finally do it. From the first time I walked into Tooth Bar I just got the best vibes from the office staff and the office itself. Brandy and other ladies in the office staff are so friendly and so extremely helpful. I always felt so comfortable coming in and so welcomed by them. I don’t remember the guys name who helped me with my teeth whitening but he also made me feel at ease during my procedure. Diana and Shelby were so amazing while I got my teeth as well, they brought me blankets and made sure I was comfortable during my stay. Lastly, Dr. Morren. There’s not enough words for me to describe how grateful I am to her and this experience. After an awful bike accident years ago, I finally got my teeth done by her. I wake up every morning and I am so excited to smile, my teeth look amazing because of her! She went above and beyond to  make sure my teeth were just how I wanted and they’re even better than I imagined! I get so many compliments on my teeth, I 10000000% recommend this place to anyone wanting a new smile! Thank you Tooth Bar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brynn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Normally I dread dentist appointments, but ever since I became a patient at Toothbar I don’t mind going at all. The staff are all so friendly & the atmosphere is incredibly well done (especially love the TVs above the chairs). It doesn’t even really feel like a dentist’s office when you’re in there. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dave Conner
user_reviews_extended.Description:
At the risk of making appointments harder to get , I feel compelled to tell you what a great experience I’ve had with Dr Jacobsen as a dentist. The overall vibe at the Toothbar is so much different than your typical doctors office. Relaxed. Welcoming. People working there seem genuinely happy.

But the top line is the skill and competency of Jacobsen. Quick without being rushed.

And on top of that- she is a super nice person. I can’t believe that I enjoy going to the dentist. How crazy is that? But for me the results speak for themselves.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jeremy impellizeri
user_reviews_extended.Description: I didn’t know you could love going to the dentist…. I honestly do now. They make dental hygiene comfortable, curated, and full of love. I would travel the country to come here if I didn’t live close. They are a family and the best in the business by far.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Mentzer-Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have had terrible, terrible experiences with dentistry in my life and so I found it best to just avoid it altogether. I came to Toothbar at the insistence of a concerned friend and I am so glad that I did!!!!!! I'm not the sort of person to utilize excessive punctuation, either.

Dr. Barclay listened attentively to all of my concerns, her staff is unfailingly kind to me. They are transparent with costs, too.

My teeth looked so bad that I hated smiling in photos. By my second appointment with Dr. Barclay, though, I just couldn't stop! My last dentist told me that I would need veneers if I wanted to improve anything cosmetically but I have the teeth I want now. It has been almost entirely painless. They use bumpers to keep your mouth open so you don't get tired and they tuck you in with blankets and Netflix.

Completely life-changing to have found Toothbar. I will forever be grateful.

Bonus points: I came in to get cavities filled on my birthday and they decorated my room with birthday decorations! And Debbie at the front desk is one of my favorite humans, she is just charming and on top of everything.

Update: Toothbar has fixed my smile entirely. This is the first time in my life that I have ever looked forward to going to the dentist. Thanks, Toothbar, from the bottom of my heart!

Update again: Still the best staff, best doctors, best office of all time. I wish they were a full-service medical facility and nightclub too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Nolan
user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone who’s had many bad experiences with dentists and absolutely hates going, I have to say I am beyond impressed and SO GLAD I found this place!! The facility is clean and super high tech. The dental hygienists are friendly, and gentle, they actually listened to me when I was nervous cause my mouth is sensitive. I specifically had Ren and loved her. Also they all make you feel extremely safe as far as corona precautions go. The place is spotless and of course all hygienists are in masks. All cleaning stations are separated. Highly recommend Toothbar.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenny Hampton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Literally the best experience I’ve had going to the Dentist so far. Dr. Morren was great, thoroughly explained the treatment plan she was suggesting for, no up selling, and straight forward. The assistant she had helping was awesome in making me comfortable and removing all the anxiety I normally get going to the Dentist. It’s safe say I will be returning for any and all dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AJ Romero
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Gibbons and her staff are amazing!  So empathetic and kind.  They bring the human element to dentistry.  I won’t go anywhere else for my teeth!

Not to mention the office is very cool and they have everything you could ever want to be comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexander Santos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist in Austin. The place is well located downtown and they pay for your parking in the garage so it makes it easy. The dentistry is beautiful on the inside and has great views of Austin with all the modern amenities you could think of and more. They work with my complicated schedule and make sure everything is always perfect before and after I leave, they really care. You get what you pay for, and they are the very best by far in all categories.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Le
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the only dentist I’ve ever been and not have not had anxiety and I actually enjoy the visit. Thank you so much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Duncan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for a cleaning today and the office was so nice and modern. My hygienist Lexi was amazing, very professional and concise.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin Begnaud
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Barclay and the rest of the staff at Toothbar are INCREDIBLE! They’re so accommodating and knowledgeable, and they genuinely care about me. They consider every detail and make me feel at ease. It’s a positive experience every time I go to see them! Thank you all for taking such good care of your patients!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Briana Dillard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love my Toothbar! I followed Dr Barclay from another dental practice to Toothbar and I always love seeing her. She was a perfectionist on my upper front tooth bonding years ago and has remained the same with my teeth ever since. Plus, ever staff member is warm and welcoming. It’s a happy place to be!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Stevens
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great service and wonderful staff! This location is in the Seaholm district in the downtown Austin area. I went to this location because of a recent chip on a molar. After getting an appointment, I was able to get crown work done. They have a very nice set up using iOS tablets to sync data as well as do crown work. They communicate the work that is needed, as well as dollar amounts, based on insurance plans.

The location for this dental office is near Trader Joe’s and the Baked Bear ice cream place. Note that they are closed on Friday if you do attempt to go to that location on that day.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kendall Peters PR
user_reviews_extended.Description: Since my first appointment a few years ago, I've been recommending Toothbar to my entire network in Austin. Not only is my dental health in good standing thanks to this team, but cosmetically my smile has transformed. I have had problem teeth all my life and often cringed at the idea of going to the dentist. Not anymore! Not everything you have done at a dentist is going to feel great, but they have the most well-equipped, modern practice to ensure you're comfortable throughout the experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best dentist experience I’ve ever had. Their service is amazing - they have the nicest staff, showed great attention to detail, and their office technology is top of the line. I would absolutely recommend Toothbar to everyone looking for a dentist. They were world class.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Lerma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a wonderful experience. The staff, hygienist and Doctor Barclay, were so professional and awesome. I was there for a routine cleaning. This new office is state of the art and has a very modern approach to oral health. Definitely recommending to all my friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan K.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is a nice and up-to-date dental office, and they really seem to have all of their processes in place to get you in and out quickly.
Probably the most comfortable filling/crown I've ever had, though the assistant seemed to have not had their morning coffee and was a bit rough (very minor complaint here :) )
I watched a nature documentary while they did the filling and crown. A tiger shark ate a baby albatross.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jayneese Fitzgerald
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It took me a while to get the parking down. You can park in the garage and they will validate your parking for up to 2hrs. I didn’t know and parked on the street.

I honestly thought I was going to get tequila with my visit but that’s okay. I was extremely nervous but that’s my thing. The check in process was smooth and modern with an I pad and submitting a cute selfie along with other new patient docs to complete prior to my visit.

The staff are beautiful- like model type- they were also very warm and welcoming. The X-ray room made me feel confident seeing all their education and accomplishments.

The view from the procedure room was very nostalgic as I love wild life, trains and street art. While getting my procedure completed I was able to watch Netflix. I feel very confident in the staff and will be retuning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Pev
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great front and back of the house admin guest services. Transparency on reviewing insurance coverage. No pressure or sales-y office. Very nice, chic facility and technology. Parking is easy with the Seaholm garage.  Staff is great in treating patients and Dr.Kimberly is awesome with taking her time to get to know you, listening and providing treatment care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katy Fritz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I'm not joking when I say I look forward to going to the dentist now. Super thorough, super friendly, and super professional. The office is beautiful, and every single staff member is incredible. It's like getting your teeth worked on by friends. The hardest part about getting two fillings was trying not to laugh at their stories during the whole procedure!

They're also very transparent with costs and prioritizing suggested treatments. Which is much appreciated.

As someone else noted, parking is validated for an hour and can be expensive if you're there for longer. I made the mistake of garage parking on my first visit and it cost me $6. I street park now and it's fine. A few bucks to park is worth it to visit this office.

Take care of them pearly whites and go see them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diamon Higgins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. J was so nice. She explained everything to me very thoroughly and really listened to everything I said. She gave me a lot of options to choose from for my teeth. Highly recommend because of her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Serg Pedan (Pedan.Production)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I want to express my sincere gratitude to Hygienist Chelsea and Dr. Andrea Bakke for their exceptional care during my recent visit. Chelsea’s attention to detail, friendly conversation and gentle approach made my dental cleaning a comfortable experience. Dr. Bakke expertise and thorough examination reassured me that I'm in capable hands. Thank you both for your professionalism and dedication to patient well-being

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brent Biedel
user_reviews_extended.Description: White glove service every time at ToothBar! Dr Kim, Tess and all the staff are great. Got scanned with their iTero machine and then Dr Kim talked me thru what we saw on the scan. Really cool technology here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmine Yu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I think anytime anyone thinks of a dental office, it’s not associated with a pleasant feeling. This office has truly changed that perception for me and my two teen children! Parking is great (it’s in a garage and they validate), and the office is beautiful inside!

Debbie booked our appointments and has been beyond helpful with insurance and always making us feel so welcomed, as well as the other front office members.

Dr. Barclay sees my daughter and I, and she is by far the best dentist I have ever had. She’s so knowledgeable, sweet, and truly cares for us as if we are her own family! I got invisilign and some fillings redone and I am so amazed by Dr. Barclay’s work that she has done on my teeth. The hygienists are also so amazing and we love Matt!

Dr. Jacobsen sees my son and she has been so great at prepping him for braces and making sure he knows how to properly care for his teeth.

We won’t go anywhere else, this dental office is AMAZING! Thank you, Toothbar for being so great and really reshaping all of our views on going to the dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Rasberry
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Toothbar is a superb group of dentist and hygienist. Dr. Jacobsen and her team are so professional and friendly!! My family and I have been patients for almost 3 years and I recommend Dr. Jacobsen to anyone looking for an Austin dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caroline Silva
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been hesitant to go out during the pandemic, but this entire experience felt so welcoming and safe. I have been trying to find a new dentist and I will for sure be sticking around here! The staff was amazing and I felt informed the whole time. Someone from the front desk came in with a price sheet for me telling me what my insurance would and would not cover, which was super helpful since I needed some extra work done. Natalie was my dental hygienist and she was great about making sure I was comfortable and giving me recommendations for better dental health. Dr. Morren made my teeth feel great and I walked out of the office smiling bright (behind my mask of course)! Please come here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! Everyone is kind and welcoming (and beautiful!!) They even worked around me needing to nurse my newborn. Love that you get your own private room and can watch something on TV during the apt. They asked multiple times how I was doing during my filling and I appreciate that so much. It's also such a beautiful office!! Highly recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jill Janszen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Toothbar was so helpful in my need of crisis! I had an urgent dental emergency which they were able to see me during the global pandemic we are all experiencing. Upon my arrival, the staff was very thorough and took my temperature and had me fill out a questionnaire to ensure that I was a “safe” patient to see. The staff is so professional and kind and the facility is super clean. I felt very comfortable during my visit. Thank you ToothBar for taking such good care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chloe Costello
user_reviews_extended.Description: Now I understand why this place is 5 stars. I am blown away by their excellent work in exams, cleaning and cosmetic bonding. They did an incredible job on all areas. The dental assistants are so thoughtful and caring from the moment you step in to walking you to the front desk after. Such a modern experience with netflix, blanket etc. I feel taking care of here and will continue to go for my regular cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Marks
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very efficient staff. The facility is top notch. Calming videos on the monitor. Hi tech rooms allow the patient to have a clear understanding of what the dentist wants to do. I recommend this practice.
Best fit I have ever had in a new crown.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Hopkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife and I both had separate but similar disappointing experiences with billing/payment mistakes that were only corrected after awkward and time consuming back-and-forth with the billing guy “explaining” some illegible treatment plan and then going back to… wherever he goes back to… to “check” and come back with another offer. Multiple times. At best, they’re disorganized and bad at math. At worst, they’re purposely hoping most people don’t catch their attempts to charge more than is owed. Paying for dental services shouldn’t be like buying a used car. We will not be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Omar Hatoum
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience at a dentist ever! Friendly staff, spa-like environment, state of the art equipment, and really appreciated the fact that they made suggestions on additional services, but never once did I feel pressured by them. Teeth look great and I would truly recommend them to anyone and everyone in the Austin area. It’s a no-brainer!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ron Pritchett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place! The staff is amazing, the dentists are very skilled and accommodating! I go to Jacobson and she was quick to make changes for me with no hassle. The DA Faith gave me tons of info about corrective trays and I’m definitely going that route now. Great atmosphere, and you even get to watch TV while getting serviced in the dental chair!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mason Rush
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office and staff are nice but do NOT get your teeth bonded here. I went once and then twice to have it fixed and both times were absolutely awful. Ended up having to go to a new dentist in California who immediately saw and fixed the issue. 0/10 for bonding / cosmetic procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Terry
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updating my original review after a horrible filling experience that led to my first root canal.

After getting a filling done (my second ever), and then a crack to said filling (because it was too high) repaired, I was in unbearable pain for two weeks --unable to chew or sleep on that side and taking Advil and Tylenol around the clock. I went back to my prior dentist for a consultation and numbing injection, and after quickly reviewing the x-rays from Toothbar they said it was because of how my nerve sits in the tooth, and the placement of the filling relative to my nerve meant the tooth pulp wouldn't have a chance to heal.

I was never told by Toothbar that there was a risk of a root canal or given any kind of warning based on the anatomy of my tooth and felt completely unprepared, and this happened right before Thanksgiving so it was a scramble to find an endodontist. Between cleanings and this experience, I noticed they are far less transparent and patient education-focused than my previous dentist, who I've gone back to despite moving across town. I will give Toothbar that I'm happy with my Invisalign treatment.

Previous review:------------

I have bad dental anxiety after a poor experience at a different practice, but the team here are really compassionate and prioritize your comfort. I also highly recommend them for Invisalign.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allyson Murphy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I used to hate going to the dentist. It was painful, stressful...just something I had to do. I also hated my teeth but I was told the only way to fix my overbite was with surgeries and metal braces. Toothbar corrected my overbite and gave me a perfect smile using Invisalign - something other dentist had told me could not be done, and for a fraction of the cost. I now have a wonderful smile that I'm proud of. The staff is always so kind and compassionate- this place is the best. I'm so happy I found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiana Beil
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love toothbar! The staff and dentists are all friendly and knowledgeable. The office aesthetic is awesome and very modern + fun. 10/10 would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie
user_reviews_extended.Description: My favorite things about Toothbar is they were timely! My biggest dread with dentists is not the drills, or flossing or x-rays, but rather the promise of an 8am appointment that starts at 8:30. The doctors, staff and assistants were amazing. None of my time was wasted. I was given all the information I needed plus more and I’m so thrilled I’ve found a dentist who does such a great job! Love this place!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia R
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great 1st time patient experience.   Lots of attention to the details. Both in office aesthetic and cleanliness and patient care.  Impressive use of technology without seeming to over do it.  After trying two other Dentists in Austin.  One with gross baseboards and lack of cleanliness the other with a hygienist who got all in my grill while cleaning my teeth. I’ve found a great place in Toothbar.  The staff. The office.  All really great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is always so welcoming and attentive.  The details to service quality and experience are phenomenal. America was great with the teeth cleaning and super friendly.  Dr. Barclay as always was great and couldn’t be happier with my visit and strangely enough can’t wait to go back for my next visit! Lol thanks again team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aleshia Bonilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: We've been with Dr. Barclay since Floss on 5th and it has always been a wonderful experience. Both her and Dr. Jacobsen are friendly, attentive and shoot you straight. Their staff is wonderful, which is VERY refreshing in any medical office.  Their new space in Seaholm is beautiful without being pretentious. I never thought I would find myself looking forward to going to the dentist, but they have pulled it off. HIGHLY recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Francesca Faris
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire Toothbar experience has been and continues to be top notch. I’ve really never had any healthcare office treat me with such care, productivity, and helpfulness than Toothbar. This is a female owned and operated business, too! From the first phone call to schedule an appointment, to them walking you out after your appointment, they make sure your care is the best quality it can be while treating like a normal human being. They’re relatable, understanding, and always offer the best options for patient. So glad I found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Schulze
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time coming to this dentist office! Very welcoming and helpful answering any questions. I will be moving my wife over to this office, and will have my kid in the future go here as well. All the operating cubbies have full windows to bring in natural light and make the experience even more comforting. Matthew and Jennifer were both great support for the doctors! Very happy that I stumbled on this location while downtown in Austin. Thank you Toothbar staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wonderful first-time experience as a new client!  This was, by far, the nicest dentist office I've visited.  The office is extremely clean, bright, neat, modern and relaxing.  Bethany (I think I have that right), the hygienist, was super nice and really took the time to explain everything in detail.  She also had a gentle touch during the cleaning.

Dr. Jacobsen was just as nice when going over my x-rays.  After a visit with a previous Austin dentist more inclined to try to scare me and hard sell work and procedure, I was a little on guard.  Dr. Jacobsen, Bethany and the Toothbar staff didn't do any of that, and really exceeded my expectations.  Great job, Toothbar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Michelle Plaza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Choose Toothbar!!!  Best service I have ever had hands-down at a dental office! Everyone is so easy to talk to and everyone has a sense of humor which I greatly appreciate. Dr. Jacobsen is who I had the pleasure of working with alongside two of the funniest guys who assisted her (can’t remember heir names darn it but I believe they’re the only men who work there). The beautiful assistant who cleaned my teeth was so thorough and straight to the point with advice on what I really need to be doing at home. The front desk girls are SO NICE and by far it isn’t a sterile dental office that just rushes you in and out.
Love love love them all there. Thank you Toothbar for taking such great care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Morris
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is so nice and comforting. The idea of going to the dentist can be scary for a lot of people and you can tell the staff makes every effort they can to make someone feel better. I also like that they are not pushy or try to up sell anything which has been a major problem in my past. I am definitely recommending them to friends and family in the Austin area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gunnar Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient atToothBar for almost two years. They  have a friendly and knowledgeable staff. My doctor, hygienist, and assistant are always kind, caring, and do a great job. My mother was a dental hygienist for about 30 years, so,,….. I am fairly familiar with what should be standard at a dentist office. I highly recommend this practice (ToothBar) to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scotch McClure
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am in a high profile, highly visible professional role every day. My smile is a big part of my success. I broke a front tooth in the morning a couple days ago. I called Toothbar and Dr Kimberley Barclay opened a spot in her super packed schedule to make a same day emergency repair for me. It is *identical* to the rest of the tooth. It's something of a work of art. She was able to hand sculpt the repair for me just a couple hours after the injury happened! She and her staff were very caring and supportive for me, emotionally, during the process. They are very kind, compassionate and incredibly skilled. I'm absolutely wowed and so grateful to have such an amazing professional as my dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deanna Krolowitz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Calming environment. Made my dentist visit less stressful- which helps especially with someone who suffers from jaw pain post dental appointments.

The staff was extremely educated and welcoming. Happy I found such a convenient location downtown as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mo Awadalla
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Toothbar staff  hands down provides the best dentist experience in Austin. Everyone is always so helpful. I’ve referred many friends and family to the Toothbar over the years and my one regret is not writing a Google review sooner :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katrina Dessavre
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience at Toothbar. Everyone was very kind, patient and welcoming. The space is beautiful and they make every effort to put you at ease. I would highly recommend this to anyone who wants to upgrade their dental experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Cristelli
user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone who has been afraid of the dentist for years, I can not speak more highly of my experience with Toothbar! My dental hygienist Bri was truly the most wonderful person, made me feel so comfortable and took the time to walk me through each of the steps involved with my visit. I can’t recommend this place enough!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leon Zunil
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience from the moment you walk in! Staff is super friendly and they immediately make you feel as if you were a long time client. I was given a tour of the establishment and I have nothing but good things to say about it. It was definitely VIP treatment. Went in for an Invisalign consultation thinking I would leave having doubts about it. But no, as soon as they finished explaining everything, I knew for sure I would sign up. I’m excited to call them my new dentists!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down best dental experience EVER. Dr. Kimberly Barclay and her entire staff is warm, professional, intelligent, and kind. The office itself is also very modern and beautiful with gorgeous views. Don’t go anywhere else for your dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thankfully, I was able to get back to Toothbar for a teeth cleaning and check-up today. The office and professional staff are very conscientious about protecting staff and patients during this Covid 19 pandemic. My experience was very positive and I felt extremely safe. Thanks again to the Toothbar staff for their kindness and consideration.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Brown, MD
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Patients Beware-
they don’t take most insurances, and are totally uninterested in working with you to come up with alternative arrangements. Sure, it’s a nice place and I have been a patient since 2020, but NOT ANYMORE.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Saucedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Toothbar! Starting going about 4 months ago, and the office is just as sharp as the customer service. Love this place and so glad we found a home here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Gibler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Be VERY careful with what you allow them to do here. They have messed up my teeth beyond repair and scammed me.

In January of 2023, I went in for a regular cleaning and xrays as usual. I never have had a cavity in my life and they told me I had 7 cavities. Concerned, I went back a week later and got 3 of the cavities filled on my top right side. My teeth felt abnormally sensitive for weeks and I when I went back in still concerned and asking if they could have messed something up (because it didn't feel right), they talked down to me and told me "that wasn't possible". They shaved some more off my teeth and said that should fix it.

Months go by, and by May 2023 I STILL can't chew on that side of my mouth. I got a second opinion at another dentist, they looked at my original xrays from January, and I was told I NEVER had any cavities and had perfectly healthy teeth and that the Toothbar dentist drilled into my teeth and gave me huge fillings for no reason.

It is now August 2023, and I still cannot chew on the right side of my mouth and have major sensitives. I never had issues before going to Toothbar. I feel I was manipulated and taken advantage of by the dentist to get me to do a procedure that was not needed just so they could charge me $1700. They have completely scammed me and messed up my mouth.

Yes, the location is beautiful -- if you care more about going to a trendy dentist than a competent one.

BEWARE. I am reporting them to the BBB. DO NOT TAKE THEIR RECOMMENDATIONS.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristy Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very happy with my experience!!  I work nearby and had constant pain the last few days. I was wary of going to the dentist, like many scaredy-cats, but Dr. Jacobsen was absolutely wonderful and addressed all my concerns with understanding and empathy.  I’ll definitely be back for my routine care. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I couldn't have had a better experience. I called for an appointment and was seen the same day. Lauren was extremely knowledgeable and got me the right treatment plan I needed. The cleaning was exceptional, the technology is way better than I've ever experienced. I'm hard critic of dental practices but it's clear why they are 5 stars across the board

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shahan Noorani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Having moved to Austin mid-last year, I was looking to for a dentist where I can really start to take better care of my teeth and explore Invisalign, which will help with my teeth alignment and assist with my jawline. The staff here makes you feel friendly anytime you visit and their technology is state of the art. Really mind blowing stuff. I’ve been happy with my results and can’t wait to see how my teeth continue to get in better shape for a warmer smile.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Jaffery
user_reviews_extended.Description: Toothbar has consistently been there for me whenever I’ve had a a general dental appointment or when I had a brutal dental emergency. They text you first thing when they open, their response turnaround time is very fast, they waste no time in getting you in, the entire staff is beyond welcoming, and words cannot describe how much I love and am thankful for Dr. Jacobsen. She is amazing and helped me with my anxiety during my procedures. Dr. Jacobsen is precise yet gentle, and explains every detail, along with giving you the opportunity to ask her questions. Their fees are extremely reasonable and am very thankful that this office has opened its doors.

user_reviews_extended.Name: D Scans-
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best denistry in Austin! The dental hygienist are exceptional but beyond their expertise they are attractive, fun spirited and make your dental visit a big time enjoyable experience. The dentists run a crisp detail and are bright, fun and always have time for you. Try them once, i promise you won't go anywhere else plus, the office is state of the art and the location is a perfect destination for an enjoyable day in Austin-

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheryl Winarick
user_reviews_extended.Description: ToothBar is the best! My appointment was right on time. Everyone is kind and extremely good at what they do. They take their time with you and make sure all your questions are answered, and they thoroughly discuss any issues or concerns. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Moreau
user_reviews_extended.Description: Full disclosure: Before I started coming to Toothbar, my previously awful and traumatic dentist experiences kept me from seeing one for almost 10 years.  Needless to say, when I arrived on that first visit, I was petrified. My hygienist was Rynn, and she was INCREDIBLE.  She was so kind and made me feel comfortable, went at my pace, was extremely thorough, and never once made me feel embarrassed or ashamed that I hadn't been taking care of my teeth.  She and Dr. Jacobsen provided me with excellent education about my dental health and walked me through the next steps of getting my (many) cavities filled.  This process was also the best experience I've ever had at the dentist.  Dr. Jacobsen was calm and patient, which immediately put me at ease. She did an amazing job with the anesthesia injections and I had NO pain during the procedure (I'm talking 10 fillings, 5 on 2 separate visits!).  The use of the headphones and ability to distract myself with the TV overhead was also a huge bonus. All the staff are so very thoughtful and the entire visit process is extremely efficient.  I can't say enough great things about Rynn, Dr. Jacobsen, and the staff at Toothbar.  If you'd asked me before, never in a million years would I have said "I love the dentist!", but now because of Toothbar, I do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Wheeler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the Toothbar!  Who says that a dentist appointment cannot be like being in a spa. Great atmosphere and the staff are incredibly friendly and are top notch.  Dr. Barclay and Dr. Jacobsen can do it all and I highly suggest booking your next appointment with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffani Jenkins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can not say enough about the friendly and professional staff. They are time conscious but caring; and went out of their way to make me feel comfortable.
Dr. Kimberly Barclay is a wonderful dentist (and trust me I know).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Burton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love how there is never a long wait in the waiting room and I’m seen right away.  Everything is explained to me so that I understand it.  Dr. Barclay is the best at making me feel at ease and makes me feel like we’re friends while also being completely professional.  I trust her judgement 100%.  The office staff is so nice and helpful and I love it that we can text for any communications.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kathy pengelly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Jacobsen is the best!  I have never had a dentist (or doctor) that has been so caring and interested in my well being. The staff at Toothbar is also amazing!! Great practice and exceptional care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Davison
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found this dental office to be like no other that I have been to as a patient in the past.  I was very impressed not only with the very friendly and competent staff, but also with the state of the art technology that was being incorporated in their practice.  I will certainly recommend to family and friends, and to anyone that is seeking dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candace Cook
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I usually dread going to the dentist, but after my experience at the Tooth Bar, that has totally changed!
Everyone was so wonderful and made me feel sooo comfortable.  The office is a work of art.
Dr. Barclay is excellent.  I look forward to my next visit.
::::::Smiling:::::
C

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martin G
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My dental experiences At Toothbar have always been very wonderful.
Dr. Jacobsen & Dr. Barclay are meticulous in their work and at the same time quite pleasant and professional.
I would recommend both doctors to anyone seeking dental attention.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elianne C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing / friendly staff! This place deserves the office awards it’s won, such a clean and aesthetic office. Love my hygienists, they’re so friendly and precise with their work. Will continue to see Dr. J, shes a great dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ruthie D
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a really pleasant experience here! Going to the dentist isn't fun, but Kelsea my dental hygienist made it a good experience. Great staff all around. Keep up the good work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Onawole
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super nice office! Was looking for a new dentist after receiving consistent bad service  from my previous dentist. If you’re reading reviews and wondering if toothbar is for you, it is! Beautiful office, netflix and headphones while you get work done, super friendly and sensitive staff. 10/10 recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Curtiss Norman
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Toothbar experience is excellent from start to finish. The entire staff from reception to the hygienists is amazingly kind and helpful. Dr. Barclay takes great care of her guests and offers suggestions and treatment options without it ever feeling pushy or insincere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Henslin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn’t been to the dentist for about a year (don’t judge) after moving around so I was a bit nervous about going in. Let me tell you, these ladies are PHENOMENAL. They were so upfront & honest about treatment, pricing, cleanings, everything. The office is set up so nicely and it’s very personal. The receptionist knew everyone by name and was so friendly. My hygenist was Beth and she walked me through every single thing she was doing, told me about the cleanings... so helpful. Toothbar is changing the way dentists work. I will go back every time and i’ve alrwsdy told everyone at work about this amazing office! Taking the scary out of dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Woody
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best dental office experience ever. Loved the very chill female dentist. I’m female and just feel more comfortable with female practitioners and providers.

Only negative was the insurance and care plan coordinator used optionary on 4 occasions. Please tell her that is not a word. The correct word is OPTIONAL. 🤣

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassandra Ramirez Madorsky
user_reviews_extended.Description:
How do I give more than 5 stars!

Netflix while you’re getting your procedure is the such a nice touch.

The space is really pretty and the staff is so kind. They were extremely clear and communicative from start to finish.

The easy access teeth whitening bar is great.

The consultation for Invisalign was cool to see my teeth on a screen go from start, to where I’d finish. They offer payment installments that make it easy and less of a big, upfront commitment. The teeth cleaning was smooth (normally hate these.) Loved having Netflix the entire time and not having to listen to the dental sounds!!! This was a wonderful experience.

I ended up getting Invisalign and all my visits have been quick and pleasant. Love the staff at Toothbar and love smiling with more confidence. : )

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jared Burck
user_reviews_extended.Description: Toothbar is amazing!! Friendly staff, very knowledgeable doctors, and super helpful. Whether a routine cleaning or major work, Dr Jacobsen and Dr Barclay are truly amazing. Don't just take my word for it. Go and see them for yourself. I guarantee you will not be disappointed!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julianna Scruggs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is always incredible. My dental hygienists are brilliant, skilled, gentle and kind. And I’m so happy to be back with Dr. Jacobsen. My insurance is nothing special but it covers all my 6-month cleanings here. My gums have been receding for a long time and at one point I was looking into gum graft surgery. I didn’t like any of the surgeons I could find back then and that type of surgery couldn’t address my most problematic areas. With regular flossing, brushing the way Dr. Jacobsen recommends, and other treatments for sensitivity, I have been able to stop my gums from receding and avoid that PITA surgery.

The Toothbar staff are incredible about helping their patients with any fear they may have about going to the dentist. They went so far as to design their entire office and end-to-end experience to help with this. When you first visit Toothbar, you are given a tour of the office where they show you each space and what it is used for. It’s not at all scary, even for people who are scared of the dentist. You get to see the full spectrum of what it means to have good dental hygiene and it’s actually pretty motivating. They demystify any questions you might have about office cleanliness and how movie stars get those rows of perfect white pearls.

If you happen to have your appointment scheduled after lunch, there is a “Toothbar” where you can freshen up before your appointment. Or anytime! If you like the way your teeth feel after you get them polished, you can book this service alone between cleanings. They even introduced me to a type of floss that makes it easier to floss! They have wifi and champagne…basically this place is nothing like a dentist office except that they provide expert dental care. I was so proud of my clean bill of dental health after my last few cleanings that I started booking teeth whitening appointments. Why not put the money I’m saving on fillings towards something I actually want, right?

There are lots of great dentists out there but very few great dental experiences. You get both here and it doesn’t cost more than any other dentist. Actually, it costs less because it’s such a great experience every time that I no longer procrastinate on booking my appointments. Instead, I book my next appointment every time I check out and I’m happy to do it. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy Gratton
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Toothbar staff is amazing!  The office is absolutely beautiful.   Dr. Barclay has taken such good care of me!  First time I've had work done without novocaine,  she's that good!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicholas Cancelliere
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Toothbar are all very professional. They have the latest technology and thoroughly explain everything to you. While they present a variety of treatment options to you, they are not at all pushy and leave it totally up to you whether you want to proceed with anything or not. I would recommend them to anyone who works or lives downtown and is looking for a neighborhood dentist. Even if you live outside downtown you should still consider them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Pugh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My rating is purely on the price/charges I had from my appointment, and not on the staff. The staff were very friendly and welcoming and seem to have great expertise in cosmetic dental work.

I came to toothbar for bonding on a tooth that had chipped. At my consult appointment they provided a quote of the cost breakdown, which I signed as a record that I received the quote. It was pricey, so I removed a few of the services that I didn't feel like I needed and scheduled my appointment the following week.

After receiving the services, I was taken to pay at the counter. The cost was $500 over what I was quoted. I was surprised, but paid thinking I must've overlooked something on my quote. After checking it when I got home, I saw the overcharges. I followed-up via email asking what the new charges were (with the photo of the original quote). They admitted an error and refunded me $500.

This could have just been a mistake that never happens, but in today's world of doctors/dentists overcharging for random services it hurts a bit to feel like they were trying to take advantage of the situation and overcharge. I gave this office 3 stars because of the "trust" + peace of mind that I've lost because what they called a "mistake". Although a mistake, it's a mistake that would've cost me $500 if I hadn't asked for an itemized receipt at check-out and followed up with my concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I feel like I won the lottery after becoming a patient here. Dr. Jacobsen is patient, skilled and thoughtful and the office staff could not be nicer. The assistant, Chris, is friendly and great at his job. This is a real state-of-the-art office but with a warm and personal feeling to it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Agustin Garfias
user_reviews_extended.Description: Listen. I don't know anyone who enjoys going to the dentist. There is nothing gratifying about feeling the scraping of metal on your teeth. But at least at Toothbar I feel like they're doing it in good faith. The staff is the best, super kind and always looking out for your smile 😁 10/10 Plus even in my 30's I want to watch TV while work is being done to distract me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Sutton
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctors made me feel extremely comfortable and remembered things from my previous appointment 6 months prior, very on top of their game and high quality treatment! Lovely office as well with very friendly staff and lots of gadgets for those who like to be destructed with Netflix during their visit. I’ve also never had to wait long at all and they get you in and out quickly while still giving you the attention and care you need. Great goodie bag to go as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Barclay and staff get 5+ stars for the red carpet treatment received for Invisalign.  The service and results were superior and beyond expectations!  I highly recommend Toothbar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Farah Shalwani
user_reviews_extended.Description: This review is long overdue. After a gruesome accident and injury to my mouth, Dr Barclay went above and beyond to make sure I was taken care of, and that my smile was back to normal. So incredibly grateful for her and her staff. Worth every penny. Thank you for everything!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Burke
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I followed Dr.Barclay here as I haven’t found a dentist that can make shots not hurt and with better customer service.  You are treated with upmost respect and painless Dentistry along with quality dentistry.  The staff is amazing and I couldn’t be happier.
Thank you to everyone at the Toothbar for all you do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suzanne Barbano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist in Austin! The office is clean, staff is very friendly and personable. They have TVs in each room that you can watch (catch up on Nextflix) while you are getting your teeth cleaned. I recommend this dentist to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlin Roach
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience from all involved! They were on-time and listened to the problems that I was having and have a treatment plan to help address those issues. I was able to get an appointment with only a week's notice, but it wasn't empty when I went either. They also do a great job of making having cavities and needing any further treatment not feel like the end of the world.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Navarrete
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kimberley Barclay is the best dentist I've ever had. She is so welcoming and takes the time to explain everything. She also won't stop pursuing perfection. I got Invisalign and she wasn't in a hurry to end after the initial time we set... constantly tweaking and ordering more sets to make it perfect. If you want to keep improving, she is hands down your best partner!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki Robles
user_reviews_extended.Description: I struggle wildly with dentist visits. Extreme anxiety. This is the only dentist I have ever been comfortable with. I still have my anxiety, but I know I will be taken care of well no matter what when I go here. They go out of their way to make me feel calm and informed. Thank you Dr. Barclay and the whole team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailey Snyder
user_reviews_extended.Description: The ToothBar is incredible. This was by far the best dental experience of my life. The staff is amazing and the cleaning was a breeze. I hadn’t done my best caring for my teeth in the past year or so and they didn’t make me feel guilty, but instead made me feel encouraged and excited for my tooth health

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Fink
user_reviews_extended.Description: Words cannot begin to describe how amazing this place is.  I was traveling and had a dental emergency.  I walked into Toothbar and experienced friendly professionalism.  They took me in right away and were able fix my issue when I was in so much pain.  Thank you to the friendly people at the front desk and the dentist and her team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Riquet Aouad
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is extremely nice here. Definitely recommend them. They give you sunglasses and headphones and you lay under a TV playing whatever Netflix show you want to distract yourself while you're getting work done. 10/10 They make going to the dentist bearable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Cornett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Literally the best dentist visit I've ever had. Couldn't recommend these guys/gals enough!

Great location, great service and great people. 5 Stars all day!

UPDATE: I hate dental work... But these folks are on it. Just had 3 fillings done otdayt and they made it extremely easy to relax and get in/outta there fast!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaitlyn Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist experience I've ever had.  All costs were broken down before anything was done so I could make an informed decision on my care, I got the most information I've ever gotten about my teeth and oral health and the entire staff was nothing but friendly.  Will definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devin-Marie Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first dental visit in Austin, first in 9 months and I’ve been doing SmileDirectClub for 4 months so I was scared of cavities! Rynn and Dr. Jacobson were both so friendly and explained everything they were doing, which I really liked. I was extremely comfortable, they have a TV that goes above your head and soundproof headphones for your cleaning, so cool! My initial visit took about an hour and a half including xrays and an additional cleaning service. It was a great experience and I already scheduled my next visit for the summer!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trent Dollarhyde
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Toothbar has consistently been an awesome place to have my teeth poked and drilled! These are some of my top reasons why I love going here:

- Dr. Jacobsen is one of a kind and she does outstanding work
- I never wait more than five minutes for my scheduled appointments
- Clean/modern office in a nice part of town with parking
- Takes most dental insurance plans
- TV’s with streaming services and Bose headphones during procedure’s
- Friendly staff and reschedules are not a problem if done at a reasonable date

Wishlist:

- Crown molding machine in-office
- Two hour parking validation because that garage can get pricey! (Currently one hour)

I chose right the first time and I’ll be sticking with Dr. Jacobsen and the team at Toothbar. Don’t think twice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Berryhill
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been to quite a few "boutique" dentistry areas to less than stellar experiences or outcomes so I have held off on going back to the dentist for four years.

From the moment I entered until I left this was a 5 star and dare I say fun time. Well worth every cent. If you can get an appointment (took four months in advance) get one right away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Todd
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is amazing!!! Dr. Barclay and Dr. Jacobsen are the friendliest!! Super professional staff!! The doctors were so helpful and courteous and walked me step by step through my treatment plan and dental goals! My visit was quick, efficient and easy!! But let’s talk about their location and office!! The toothbar is absolutely stunnning!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Contessa Samoan
user_reviews_extended.Description: If I could give them more than 5 stars I would! They have 5 star reviews for a reason! I was in Austin on business and I was in search of teeth whitening and OMG! The service, staff, location, the RESULTS.....all 5 stars! They are attentive, knowledgeable and they care about the service they provide. This place is a gem everyone should know about. If you're the type of  person that reviews determine if you will choose something or not then trust their reviews and get to the Toothbar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m not sure of my dental hygienists name…but she was so thorough and my teeth feel amazing. This is the second time she has done my cleaning and both times I couldn’t stop talking about how great my teeth feel. I didn’t get to see Dr. Jacobsen this time, but I’m so glad to have a dentist that I love!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They will happily lie to you about the state of your teeth and gum health to try and get you to spend much more than what insurance will cover. Don't risk your dental health with these scammers.

They lied and told me I had 4 cavities. They wanted to drill into my teeth!!! I never had a cavity in my life so I knew they were lying. I went to a different dentist for a second opinion to confirm this.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas houle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great consult and cleaning today. Appreciate the easy new patient paperless system.  This office has the latest technology and professional and personable staff.  Thanks Dr Jacobson and team for an easy appointment and clear treatment plan. See you soon!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth P
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience I’ve had. Obviously a beautiful office and space with advanced technology and equipment but more importantly the entire team goes above and beyond to make you feel comfortable, relaxed and educated. They definitely raise the “bar” (get it?) for other practices in the area and I can’t imagine going anywhere else in Austin for my general/cosmetic dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oliver Yude
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Toothbar Dental Clinic is Phenomenal, it's my first time visiting a dental clinic here in United States and it's amazed me on how accommodating and high tech they can be.
