I'm a J1 (Exchange Culture) here in Austin and I didn't thought that I'll be needing a dental care here because I'm just here for a short period of time, but anyways I just want to share how happy I am and satisfied about their services. When I went there I thought that they will just check and figure out what is wrong about my tooth like usual dental clinic but they're different in Toothbar because they're just not planning and figuring out how they can fix your tooth, they will also come out with a plan on how you'll maintain it after they treat it, and not only their services can satisfy you there they also have an awesome lounge and the thing that I can't forget is the refreshing area and it's look like a bar. Hey y'all Longhorns if you need any dental care, Toothbar is the right place.
Big shout out to Dr. Barkclay for taking care of me. Thank you sooo much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kurt Jacobsen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Doctor Lauren Jacobsen Ballard is a true professional and a kind human being. I loved my teeth cleaning and dental exam by Holly and Dr. Lauren
Amazing Toothbar Dental Practice in Downtown Austin, Texas
Loved it

user_reviews_extended.Name: Russell Lemmer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Toothbar was amazing! Beautiful facilities, amazing staff, and Dr Barclay did EXCELLENT work!

I chipped a tooth while I was traveling... I came back and got 1) a next day appointment for whitening (my color is now amazing! I did Zoom. Yes it can be painful, but the huge rust made sure to apply desensitizing gel which made it easy. I made it through all four rounds); and 2) am appt two days later to fix the chipped tooth.

Within 72 hrs I whitened and had some of the best dental work of my life done. I was comfortable, enjoyed Netflix, able to text back and forth with the staff and felt informed through... all at competing pricing.

I’ve found a new dentist in Toothbar and couldn’t be happier!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit. Nice modern office, staff is friendly and made me feel welcome. My dentist and hygienist were both friendly and patiently answered my question. I have no complaints and will be back again. Thank you for the great service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martin Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: My friends at Toothbar, it is always great to come to my appointments at Toothbar for I know that the dental care that I and my family receive is of superior quality and enjoy the attention provided by each member of Toothbar. Thank you very much, Martin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Nichols
user_reviews_extended.Description: $10/unit for Xeomin! Don't go to an inexperienced MedSpa injector when you could get better results with LESS units from an actual Doctor at Toothbar. Great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic group. Dr Barclay and team have created the perfect welcoming, cool, modern-day dentist office. Everyone is nice, professional and cares. Accessible location for we downtown dwellers. They’re the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Kroll
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Barkley and the entire team were so warm, professional, and helpful. From reception to tech, There was no shaming, fear mongering, or hard sale. I wish everyone could experience this type of healthcare!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marietta Metcalfe
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is by leaps and bounds the tip of the sword dental practice. The front desk staff is prompt and concise. The techs, hygienist and dentist are each phenomenally committed to ensuring that their knowledge & experience provides a state of the art visit. Every effort is made to ensure each visit is comfortable and both preventative & cosmetic issue are addressed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Talita Cochran
user_reviews_extended.Description: I truly love going to the dentist and it’s because Dr. Jacobson and the staff makes going to the dentist a relaxing and enjoyable experience. You know you’re  in good hands! Attentive, knowledgeable, and personable. As long as Toothbar is around, I will never have the dread of going to see the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Let me start by saying going to the dentist can be incredibly nerve racking especially if it’s been a bit and you have been busy with other things. The old stuffiness and drill noises of most dentist office is enough to deter one for good. ToothBar was anything but. The office was designed like it belong on one of those HGTV channels and the staff was so amazing and accommodating. All my fears begin to dwindle as my appointment went on. I loved how they worked with me for alternative options and weren’t just trying to upsell. I’ll definitely be back and will be referring friends to them as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: yiannis kapetanopoulos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cant say enough about Dr. Jacobsen, the team, and the entire dental experience at Toothbar. I recently had veneers put in and cant be more happy with the end result. I have also had my teeth whitened there and go for my annual cleanings. HIGHLY RECOMMEND !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peter
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Quit seeing whoever you have for a dentist and come sign up with this office!  I had my first visit to the Toothbar as a new patient yesterday and was blown away how professional and best-in-class they were.

From sign in (iPAD - no papers) to the treatment rooms (brand new state of the art equipment) every step was explained and the cleaning/checkup I had was seamless.

Dr.'s Barclay and Jacobsen have created the ultimate dentist experience with Toothbar. It's a refreshing update to the ordinary standard of Dentistry.  They've examined the various processes and elevated the game with the patient in mind.

I recommend you sign up with them soon because this next-level practice is going to get all the patients they can handle.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie N
user_reviews_extended.Description: Toothbar has a great, convenient location in the growing Seaholm District with both parking garage and street parking options. The staff was phenominal on my first visit, extremely friendly and knowledgeable. I love the office inside and out, and great places nearby to kill some downtime before or after appointment. Check them out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ALEX SCHMANDT
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lovely & professional people.  My only disappointment was that no Southern-Pacific locomotives sounding their low and long whistle passed by while I had a front row seat overlooking the railroad bridge.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Left this place so happy! After so many years of going to many dental offices, no one was ever able to remove my white stains from my teeth, and toothbar removed them within 10mins! I’m so shocked still, looking forward to whitening my teeth here soon. I will highly recommend this place to everyone! Thank you for perfecting my smile!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Schweers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is very friendly and helpful. Their office is very clean and comfortable. They also provide TV's in each room so you can watch Netflix while you have your teeth cleaned which can he a helpful distractions if you don't like the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin-Kate Earnest
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love going to Toothbar! Their lounge is so inviting and the atmosphere doesn't feel like going to the dentist. The staff is amazing and always so friendly. I walk out with a huge smile every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bridget M
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dentist I’ve ever had, i don't dread my dental appointments at the Toothbar. They always make sure I am comfortable and don’t feel any pain. Great staff, and great service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is always so friendly! They do everything they can to make you feel comfortable.

I did a deep cleaning and they numb’ed me so I would feel anything. I kicked back while they did their thing, watched some Netflix and it was over pretty quick.

I’ve since moved and still make the trek to come in.

Thanks team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cathryn Lavery
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazingly helpful and efficient staff, no waiting time (even though their waiting area is legit with nespresso and drinks). They even had a TV for patients to watch while having procedures done, never seen that before but it was great. Best dentist I've ever been to!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maddy Wieber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a really really great first visit! It was the most relaxing dental experience Ive had so far 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Speaking from someone who has been known to seriously shy away from dentists, the Toothbar is a refreshing change to what you think a dentists office is like or is from memory.  The Toothbar is more spa like reducing your stress in a potential stressful situation  Dr. Lauren and her team were awesome from check-in to check-out.   Their facility is state of the art creating a relaxing atmosphere is the waiting room and "the chair."  I've found me dentist in Austin.   Cheers

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Capozzoli
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience start to finish. Friendly staff. Clean environment. Everything is state of the art. The best part is that rather than have a bright light shining in your face while sitting in the dentist chair, you get to watch Netflix on a TV mounted to a retractable arm. I was watching old episodes of The Office, but something tells me they would be willing to change the channel for you. A+

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristie Edmonson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is new and beautiful. The staff was very friendly. I was seen in a timely manner without feeling rushed. Very informative about all my dental care. They make you feel very welcome

user_reviews_extended.Name: D T
user_reviews_extended.Description:
***Dr. Kim Barclay and her OUTSTANDING ToothBAR team define EXCELLENCE in modern dentistry!***

From the moment you walk into her immaculately appointed office you realize very quickly the caliber of care and attention to detail that she puts into every aspect of her unmatched practice.

Utilizing the most up to date methods and technology, patients at ToothBAR experience more of a “Spa day for your teeth” than just another trip the dentist. Between the telescoping, large-screen televisions that you can watch DURING your check-up/procedure, to high-tech, digital scans, painlessly taken by the most competent and capable staff, using the most state of the art equipment you will find ANYWHERE!

Any doctor/dentist is only as good as their staff, and Dr. Barclay has the best of the best! Rest assured, you can be 100% certain that you are working not only with the very finest of hygienists, but more so, with a teammates and advocates for your dental health.

Simply put, if you are in need of a simple cleaning or extensive dental surgery, Dr. Kim Barclay and her ToothBAR team are not only the most qualified and capable practice in Austin, they provide the single most important element of any health professional...

They care about YOU. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennelle Walton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had reasonable expectations about the service and the consultation but I was not impressed. Dr. Bakke contradicted herself during my consultation and I still didn’t receive the treatment plan.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher French
user_reviews_extended.Description: Can’t beat the location and the office is beautiful! Dr. Barclay, as well as the rest of the staff I have met on my three visits, are extremely personable and hospitibale! Highly recommend Toothbar to anyone looking for a new dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony Reid
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best dental experience I have had. The entire staff was more comprehensive, helpful, and informative than any dentist office I've visited before. The office was also super nice and comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bry Maty Moehling
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hadn’t been to a dentist in...way too long. But I felt at ease the second I walked into ToothBar. Because I was new to ToothBar and didn’t have any of my dental history, I spent a lot of time getting X-rays and pictures taken. Beth was amazing! She took her time so I didn’t feel rushed or stressed and explained everything she was doing and why she was doing it.
The Netflix also made the teeth cleaning go by extra quick!
Dr. Barclay was also very friendly and efficient, explaining everything she was doing and went over all the photos of my teeth they had taken that day.
I also appreciated how they explained next steps and options on dental care without making me feel pressured or worried about anything and even outlined my insurance coverage with me so I understood everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: McKala Touponse
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t rave about them enough. Absolutely amazing experience! If I had to choose between going to the dentist or swimming in lava, I would choose the lava. Not anymore! Toothbar is how going to the dentist should be. And the staff is next level. Thank you so much for taking such good care of me <3

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Groulx
user_reviews_extended.Description: The ladies are toothbar were amazing! I was experiencing some anxiety when I went in and they made me feel at ease and comfortable.  The establishment is very estetically pleasing and I love the theme they are going for.  The dentist, hygenist, assistant and receptionist were all very lovely, pleasant women.  The icing on the cake was the fact they have friends on Netflix playing in the dental chair.  Two thumbs up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Hatfield
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great customer service. I lost a retainer and needed replacement. Because I was traveling it’s unlikely I’ll ever be back but they were so accommodating!  Same day appointment, quick service, new retainer in less than an hour. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edward Gallant
user_reviews_extended.Description: The facility alone transports patrons to a high end oral care spa nestled in the heart of downton. The staff and Doctors were all friendly and very knowledgeable.  I received their Zoom Whitening.  They have large flat screens that swivel so you can receive your treatment in comfort and style! Highly recommend it.  Dr. Kim is an angel!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caleb Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dental experience I’ve ever had! Office staff quickly greeted me and brought me back for my appointment. I’ve never been to a dental office where the staff was so friendly. Thank you for the great cleaning and changing my thoughts on visiting the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diego Alegre
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My initial interaction with the receptionist over the phone was not great, and I had decided to not use this practice. HOWEVER! Dr. Barclay immediately reached out after finding out and made sure to go out of her way to make things right.

I appreciate her business ethics and customer service, and look forward to entrusting her with my dental health :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carley Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Barclay is the best! She is thorough, clear, and a perfectionist. A great combo for such an important thing (your smile!). The office location is excellent and it is beautiful! My hygenist (Wren) was also delightful. Great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark BOGAN
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Jacobsen, Miss Tessia,  & Dr Jacobsen’s staff, as usual, are very polite, professional, and very personable.
I still have no cavities 🦷 by following Dr Jacobsen’s suggestions (Proxy Brushes & electric toothbrushes) for my daily dental hygiene & routine.
Miss Tessie periodically checks to make sure that I’m pain free and comfortable during the cleaning procedure. She took time to explain the “anomalies” that she discovered, as well as informing Dr Jacobsen of her discovery.
As usual,  Dr Jacobsen takes time answer questions. It’s clear that she cares about her patients, even the elderly ones.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jean Gee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been waiting for months to go here because I was a prior patient of Dr Barclay’s !  From the first contact with appointment securing to check out after services , you are met with professionalism, respect, friendliness, helpfulness, and disclosure of fee’s.  Super cool “techy” office - spotless and sleek!  NO pressure to make $ restorations, only appropriate suggestions.  Do yourself a favor and take the best care of your teeth at TOOTHBAR!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sissy Bowers
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First the toothbar is quite an amazing experience.  The atmosphere is so cozy,  warm and quite inviting.  The staff are always friendly, courteous, extremely accomodating, and wear infectious smiles.  But, my most favorite person and reason I come back over and over again, is because of Dr. Jacobsen.  She is phenomenal and exhibits both inner and outer beauty.  She has a charismatic disposition and when she enters a room, her dynamic presence is felt.  Her smile is like a breath of fresh air.  Consequently, she is absolutely by far, the best dentist in the universe!  Love her and her wonderful staff!

Sunshine regards,  Sissy Chambers

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Cheatham
user_reviews_extended.Description: So... I HATE the dentist. In the past I’ve skipped years because it is the worst to me. All that said, these people are the BEST. Everything about the experience was perfect. The place feels like a high end spa. The staff was knowledgeable and friendly. The equipment was cutting edge. I don’t hate the dentist anymore.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bedzaida Chaparro
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit and was a great one. The personnel provide a tour and explain the work in each area. The service is great and the dentist a professional person, I will return to continue with my treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: The Bills chronicles
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Toothbar is hands down one of the best dental experience, team and company in Austin. I was super excited to have found them! They walked me through every step and gave me great other options if I was hesitant about one thing or another.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ernie Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Who likes going to the dentist? The anxiety around what will hurt versus the reality can prevent you from going or have you clenching the chair so tight you leave marks! NOT at the Toothbar!

From the moment I arrived I was greeted by a friendly group of individuals who all appeared to enjoy their roles and the service they were providing. Wiithin a few minutes, I was having a tour of the clinic, xrays, and digital imaging of my teeth completed.

Dr. Barclay came in and we chatted a little about what was needed and the future of my dental care. It was great to see her again and talk about the lovely establishment she had created.

I needed a deeper cleaning today and the dental hygenist, Rynn, did an amazing job! She is very knowledgable and concerned with patient comfort. Half way through, my anxiety had dissipated and I was able to relax and watch a TV show on the adjustable flatscreen above while Rynn completed her work.

Debbie came in after and we went over insurance and future needs. She was also knowledgable about what the provider was asking for which made it appear that the whole team, regardless of their role, were all part of the smooth dental process.

I am so impressed by this place and although my fear of the dentist is still a real thing for me, I know future visits will not be as concerning knowing that the team at Toothbar are trustworthy and leaders in their industry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: katherine medeiros
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Toothbar makes me love going to the dentist. It’s like low key luxury dentistry. Dr. Barclay has completely transformed my smile and I’ve never felt more confident. I tell EVERYONE to go to Toothbar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie Chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dear Lord, pain! So much pain! They tell you that magic paste numbs your teeth and gums, but who's ever really tested it! Anywho, when has visiting the dentist ever been a fun time?
The fine group of cheerful pleasant professionals at "Toothbar" understand this and do all that's possible to make up for it. Calm and comforting the tone they set. Step by pleasant step they make sure you understand their procedures from the specifics of billing to the joys of tooth drilling. I've found the dental team for me and I am actually looking forward to my next appointment, you can tell by the smiling polished tooth grin I am now sporting. Ouch, but thank you so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khalilah Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have major anxiety when going to the dentist and sometimes have tremors before even going in. Lame I know but the folks at Toothbar took care of me, made me feel super comfortable, and gave sound advice on next steps. Nicest dentists I’ve met in Austin so far.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alix Vargo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very clean and professional! The tooth cleaning for me was a bit aggressive for the first time, but I have somewhat sensitive teeth I think. I didn’t get quite as thorough of a cleaning as I would have liked, but it also might have been because it was my first time and they took X-rays. Everyone there very incredibly nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Myrna Shonk
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great experience at the ToothBar. They fit me in at the last minute for a filling that fell out. My tooth was fixed in no time. Honestly, I couldn’t believe how fast and easy my appointment was. The last time an old filling popped out my dentist “encouraged” me to put a crown on it to be extra safe, which led to a root canal bc he went too deep with the crown, which led to oral surgery bc he did not do a thorough root canal. What a huge difference between my two experiences!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Bohn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nice office, great location.  The entire staff from reception, hygienist and Dr. Jacobson made my dental experience a positive one.  I would recommend Tootbar to anyone in need of a dentist in ATX.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vincente Sly
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A medical experience so good that it has relit my nearly burnt out candle of hope for America.

From the moment that you open the door and are gracefully welcomed, to the gentle swipe of your credit card (and I mean that both in reference to the charges and the vibe of the office staff) this will very likely forever alter your perception of what’s possible, not just in dentistry, but, in an American business.
I’m legitimately teary eyed.

Having a dental emergency can turn the most handsome and stoic bear of a man into a wincing toddler with the social insecurity of a pimple faced freshman.

Booked out for many months, the office staff and Dr. B took me same day, within hours, treated me like I was the only patient they had all month, and charged me the most reasonable dental fees that I’ve ever had.

The only weird part for me was the unsettling feeling that my visit was over and I had to leave the presence of these amazing people.

Thank you all 100 times.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carter Basham Amick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to Toothbar was an absolute pleasure! I raved to my husband the whole rest of the day about how I felt so taken care of. I have a rather complicated set of teeth and both the doctor and insurance specialist sat down with me to talk about treatment plans and how payment would work. If I move away from Austin, I will probably travel back just to stay with Dr. Lauren. HIGHEST PRAISE.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey O'Neill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist in the world! I was laying down watching Netflix during my whole visit and I didn’t want to leave. user_reviews_extended.Name: Natascha Seifritz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the Toothbar since my first visit and have referred many friends and colleagues without hesitation. Their modern equipment paired with excellent professional service makes each visit a breeze.

user_reviews_extended.Name: lydia gee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Drs, location, staff, services. Toothbar makes going to the dentist a positive experience. I can’t say enough good things and consistently recommend them to friends, family, coworkers, etc!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Lucero Coleman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Toothbar for the last 5 years. Everyone from the front office staff to the doctors are top-notch. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cameron Chen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very picky about dentists — I have changed dentists many times, but I’ve stayed at Toothbar for several years. They are so friendly every single time I visit and they never push unneeded procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Solis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience! Staff is very friendly and the office is so clean. My favorite part is watching Netflix with headphones while getting my teeth cleaned. Can’t wait for my next appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Schatte
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was nervous about finding a new dentist, because I was long overdue for a check-up. I'm so happy to have found Toothbar. I highly recommend this place. The entire staff is incredibly friendly!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Farsh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cleanest most modern and comfortable dentist ever-Dr. Jacobson is very professional, easy to work with and always has the best interest for your health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alastair Gamble
user_reviews_extended.Description: Toothbar is terrific. The dentists do the best work, and the staff is helpful, friendly, and accommodating. It is one of the few places where I can expect excellent customer service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Kohler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the Toothbar for the first time was an incredible experience. From the customer service of every person I interacted with to the actual dental treatment itself, it was top notch. Kudos to Toothbar for thinking of every detail from the customer perspective and crafting this type of experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in such pain with my TMJ while visiting Austin that I made an appointment. I loved everything about the office from Kevin who made my appointment on the phone, to the tech who walked me through the procedure and the Doctor who saw me and advised me on getting Botox to relieve my pain. And it worked! So glad I found relief.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Manzur
user_reviews_extended.Description: Never thought I could have a good time at the dentist but it's possible here! Cool concept and the friendliest staff ever! I highly recommend this place so that you look forward to your dentist appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Page
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful in every respect!  Toothbar is by far the best dental practice I've ever been to -- all elements of the experience are truly excellent.  Very highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lyndel Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I will not not use a dentist other than Dr. Jacobsen. She was my dentist and I moved from Austin for a short period of time and immediately sought her out. Her staff is very friendly  and make you feel very comfortable. I highly recommend her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Kirchner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly mine blown, it’s a beautiful well oiled machine in there. I was seriously so Impressed with the whole experience!!! Didn’t run me thru the mill, took great care, and everyone was over the top nice and knowledgeable. 20/10 recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Theis
user_reviews_extended.Description: hands down the best dental office in Austin. From the moment you walk in everything is clean, modern, and oraganized. The front desk team is friendly  and polite. I have had two hygienists at this office and they were both knowledageable, easy to talk to and both were throughou with the cleaning. The office it's self is chic, yet comfy. You can watch Netflix while getting services done. My densit is Lauren Jacobsen and I feel so lucky that I get to be her patient! She is passionate about what she does and you can feel that just by being in her office. Congrats to them for creating such a beautiful enviroment can't wait to go back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: KRISTY LYNN
user_reviews_extended.Description: America, my hygienist today, was friendly, professional and informative. The dentist office is not always the easiest place to have a great conversation with your mouth wide-open, but she did a perfect job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel Warren
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. The office staff were outstanding, excellent customer service and knowledgeable. I did not feel like a new customer being onboarded and sold services; I felt like a client and patient receiving valuable advice and individual treatment options. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savanna Mauldin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone I encountered at Toothbar was kind and inviting. In particular, Dr. Bakke was very thorough, making sure I felt comfortable and understood everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taya Awad
user_reviews_extended.Description: I attempted scheduling an appointment at Toothbar (with any dentist, I had no preference whatsoever) and was told that the first available appointment would be in 3 months. Although that's much longer than I would have hoped to wait on my tooth issue, I decided to be patient. I called multiple times in the months after to see if any earlier date had freed up with no luck, although I was initially told it is extremely likely I can get an appointment sooner. When I called A MONTH before my appointment to reschedule because I couldn't make it on that specific day only, I was told the next available appointment would be in another 3 MONTHS!!! I'm appalled by their inflexibility and how inconsiderate they are, allowing a potential patient to wait 6 months before their tooth issue can be addressed. I felt extremely unwelcomed as a new patient and wish I hadn't wasted my time with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: C Jacobsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was greeted kindly the moment I walked in the door and treated professionally throughout my visit. The hygienist did a fabulous cleaning!  I have sensitive gums and she knew just what to do. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was super helpful and pleasant. Dentist was excellent and efficient. Office was very clean and modern. Toothbar has become my permanent dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lawrence Wong
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a dentist in Dallas. One of my patients recently moved to Austin and needed some emergency work. I called on my patient’s behalf, and they got him in same day and fixed him up. Much appreciated! He said y’all were great

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Black
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Jacobsen is simply amazing, in fact, I get excited to go to the dentist!  Everybody at ToothBar is outstanding, they make my teeth look great.  One of my front teeth broke in half a couple years ago and with Dr.Jacobsen you can’t even tell that it happened, she always exceeds my expections.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James W. Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had scheduled cleaning, check up and then Zoom whitening. All were a pleasant experience. Dr Barkley and all the staff are very professional and fun. I have a lot of more work to do and looking forward to continue.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexa Botha
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I visited toothbar after an extremely negative experience at another dentist office. I had a crown that was causing IMMENSE discomfort. I called toothbar and told them my about my situation- I was given an appointment the same day and the entire process took maybe 30 minutes. I can’t even describe the relief. Tooth pain is no joke,  especially not being able to eat or sleep normally for almost a week. What an incredible experience —everyone felt like a friend and you find yourself looking for an excuse to go back (who would have ever thought you would feel that way about the dentist?😂)

Thank you so much toothbar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wes W
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time going to Toothbar. I’ve heard wonderful things about this place and my friend suggested it so highly she basically forced me to go here. Haha I went in for the zoom whitening treatment and I was not disappointed at all!! It was everything she said and then some. Lovely staff. Thorough doctors. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Spees
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is honestly the best dental clinic in Austin, with all the state-of-the-art scientific dental interventions for your dental pleasure. They really make going to the dentist a fun experience. 🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nik York
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to the Toothbar before it was the “Toothbar”. Since i left my home town in 2008, it has been difficult finding a dentist, so I was really happy to try Dr Jacobsen & Barclay probably 5 years ago. They’re great, I can’t recommend them enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bonnie Sullivan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Barclay & Dr. Jacobsen are both AMAZING! extremely professional and the best General & Cosmetic Dentists I’ve been to. The entire staff is friendly and knowledgeable as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deena Mader
user_reviews_extended.Description: Spotless, hi tech, hi service practice. My husband and I both were very impressed. With the technology, pano, small camera and quick x rays, consult , cleaning, fluoride and even some cosmetic options . Love everything about this practice .. can’t wait to come again

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Bowers
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dental experience I’ve ever had! The office is so nice and the rooms have beautiful floor to ceiling windows and nice views. The entire process was seamless. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Saroya Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here is super kind and helpful! They accommodate patients in the waiting area and while getting their tooth worked on. Everything about toothbar is such a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kylie Mathews
user_reviews_extended.Description: As soon as you walk in the staff are so friendly. It’s a beautiful entry and waiting area; very clean. Got to watch Netflix while I got my teeth cleaned. Everything was explained to me and got the cutest little goody bag on the way out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jimi Ballard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had not seen a dentist for far too long. No guilting me for that, just a clear focus on what I needed to do to get back on track. Very nice office, modern tech, scrupulous attention to Covid safety, and all staff I interacted with were professional and caring.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cortney Bode
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Toothbar! Alyssa is the best and does a great job of explaining and teaching.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Marten
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is so friendly and professional. They explain everything so clearly every time I have an appointment. They’re flexible and try to make every appointment your best to leave you walking away with a brighter and bigger smile than what you came with. 10/10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heidi Korman
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is always friendly, the dentists and hygienists all provide high quality care, the facility is top notch, and it's in a great location. Love the Toothbar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Weltner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this staff! I had horrible anxiety about going to the Dentist and they made me feel sooooo welcomed and comfortable. Super friendly, efficient and educational.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Hermann
user_reviews_extended.Description: After some bad experiences elsewhere I am terrified of the dentist but the staff here made me feel so comfortable and confident getting everything fixed up. They didn’t make me feel stupid for being scared as an adult and did an amazing job! So glad I chose ToothBar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mario Villa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great service and staff the only downfall will be the parking. They validate for an hour at the Trader Joe’s garage, but the validation ticket did not work once and you might have to go for more than hour sometimes! Besides that great dentist office! 🦷
💯

user_reviews_extended.Name: Therese Condit
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was blown away by the great service here. The staff are knowledgeable, efficient, considerate, kind and fun!  Going to the dentist has never been so enjoyable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kamryn B
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist began shaving my bottom teeth on two separate occasions without asking permission. I had to stop her and ask what she was doing. Consent is imperative and not I have permanently shorter bottom teeth and sensitivity that wasn’t there before this.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Moran
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for recommended Zoom teeth whitening service. Wow my teeth came out many shades lighter. I cannot quit looking at them. Sparkling white! Very impressive service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Conor Drake
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist/facility I have ever been to. They have great facilities/amenities, but the employees are awesome. I couldn’t recommend this facility more for anyone in Austin looking for dental services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawn Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: The space was cool, and the staff was great. Was able to get my teeth worked on while watching The Office, and then received a comprehensive and actionable plan for fixing my smile. Impressed for sure!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mack R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven’t been to the dentist in a little while so going in I was nervous but after my cleaning I felt very comfortable and everybody was nice. Super convenient location too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Adamson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Beautiful faculties, friendly staff and expert dental work. I chipped a tooth and Dr. Jacobsen was able to see me quickly and did a masterful job. Highly Recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Sechrest
user_reviews_extended.Description: My favorite dentist of all times! I’m 80 years old and have had multiple dentists so i feel qualified to say they are the best !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Christie
user_reviews_extended.Description: the best dentist experience i’ve ever had. consistent, kind, gentle, fast. toothbar staff is fantastic. thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jayme Dinnerstein

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ruth Tiller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience. Thank you Dr. Gibbons, Tess, and Bailey! This dental practice is the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg'ry Baladez

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Pinto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jacobsen is the best.  She does a great job of making you feel comfortable and I’ve never had any pain with any procedure.  Excellent care and I refer everyone I know to her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Likarich
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have a pretty complicated case. It was handled with professionalism and respect. The dentist and assistants were incredibly knowledgeable, and helpful with setting up a step by step process to getting me the smile I deserve.

user_reviews_extended.Name: EmJae Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: Debbie is rockin’. Juliana got me all setup and was as sweet as can be, and knows all about the sweet jams they were blasting overhead. Oh and Netflix in the exam rooms...saaaweeeet! “Friends” all day!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Luna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Matty was amazing! I had the zoom whitening done and it was such a great & smooth experience, He made me feel so comfortable and relaxed during the whole procedure! 10/10 would recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chessney Goodman
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time in awhile I DIDNT feel like I was being SOLD on something I didn’t need at a dentist office. Breathe of fresh air! Got in for same day cleaning and treatment! Excited to continue working with Toothbar

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Kimball Nagpal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience from start to finish. Professional, friendly, detail oriented, and knowledgeable staff. As a NYC transplant, my expectations are very high and Toothbar absolutely delivered.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kerry McGowne
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is awesome. I’m a very uncomfortable dental patient who gets very nervous and anxious. They went out of their way to make me comfortable and more relaxed. I wouldn’t go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsey Brewer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Exceptional in every way! Huge thank you to Shannon for an outstanding job as my hygienist. Can’t wait to come back for my teeth whitening!

user_reviews_extended.Name: L Cooper
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was concerned because I recently had oral surgery. Nicky took care of my issues and explained what I needed to do. Can’t thank her enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Zipprian
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience at the Toothbar! The whole crew did an exceptional job and very welcoming. Highly recommend Toothbar, will be returning for future needs! Thanks again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim U
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental cleaning experience to date! Awesome service and very knowledgeable staff.  Beautiful spa-like office. So happy I found Toothbar!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oksana Hays
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved the space and hospitality at Toothbar. Dr. Gibbons was very friendly and guided me step by step through the procedure which made my first visit very comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nolan Wehr
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dentist I’ve ever visited. The people who work there are kind, professional and do an excellent job. The technology was better than any I’ve ever seen at a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fang Fang

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mel Safi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough amazing things about Toothbar! Perfect facility, the best attention to detail, warm friendly staff, awesome results... By far my best experience with any dental office EVER!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Wyble
user_reviews_extended.Description: I felt at home every moment I was there. The front office is stunning, and the staff is incredibly friendly. Ren, my hygienist, is a sweetheart. Everyone is so professional. Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jarek Sedlacek
user_reviews_extended.Description: Definitely the nicest and most modern dentist office I've ever been in. Great ambiance and decor, friendly staff, and I've been very happy with the dental work I've gotten

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Greeson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve never felt so comfortable going to the dentist.  What a great group of professionals.  Patient care is definitely top of the list for this group. Thank you all so much!
Austin

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juliana Winters
user_reviews_extended.Description: Incredible experience! Toothbar’s quality of service and the attentiveness of their staff never stops to amaze me! By far the best dental experience you’ll ever have!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marta Tienda
user_reviews_extended.Description: very courteous and efficient service, from the first phone call to appointment scheduling and quality service. I especially appreciated the care taken to protect patients and staff with ample PPE.  State of the art equipment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shelby and Dr. Jacobson are amazing! The whole aura of this place is positive and they are so transparent and upfront about everything. I would pay more to come back here for the experience for sure!:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Soo Jin Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jacobsen has a pleasant and calm bedside manner. Very comprehensive and conservative treatment planning, I trust her expertise and will visit her again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Sims

user_reviews_extended.Name: Avis
user_reviews_extended.Description: So love this place!! The staff is fantastic and treat you so well! State of the art equipment and I love everything about this place! I need to get a "crown" done but told them they need to call it a "Tiara" cause they treat you like royalty!!! 😎

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was a step up from any previous Dental office visit. It was more of an experience, actually.  With a friendly and knowledgeable staff providing good service in a more pleasant environment — it’s hard not to give it 👍🏼👍🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Courts
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is very friendly and the space was cute. Also, the option to view different apps like Hulu and Netflix on a flat screen above me during the procedure is so cool!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Hedrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience - friendly folks and a very nice office. Only downside was getting in the schedule was tough - but I viewed that as the sign of a good dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Toni Barcellona
user_reviews_extended.Description: Can’t say enough great things about the Toothbar, Dr. Jacobson and the whole team! I’ve been a happy patient/client since they opened their doors. Toni B.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description: LOVE Toothbar! The whole staff is AMAZING! It’s unbelievable how comfortable they make you feel in a normally uneasy/awkward situation! HIGHLY recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John McIver
user_reviews_extended.Description: Top to bottom the staff is very nice. I came from an old school dentist so all the new technology and TVs and headphones are probably the norm now, but it's nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Summer McKain
user_reviews_extended.Description: Two very talented Dentists with an even more impressive staff! Very professional, accommodating and friendly they make going to the dentist a joy. Thank you Toothbar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Francesca

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Szedeli
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kimberly was wonderful. The office is amazing! Netflix to occupy you and even an espresso machine upon waiting! Great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Owsley Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Barclay and her staff are awesome. I’ve lived in a lot of places and used a lot of dentists. She is my favorite.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Mercer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always friendly, always professional, such a great dental experience. Very clean and modern. Love Toothbar!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Unknown

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole French
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience, staff is so caring and attentive! Dr was gentle and made to sure to  check in on comfort level often. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lo He
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome as usual. Dr Barclay and staff are great to work with, just all around nice people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Smith

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori Rubio

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsey Havelka

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sydney Everett

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ed Blechschmidt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lauren Jacobson is the best dentist in Texas.  There's no better dental experience in Texas than at Toothbar.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Lee

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Feeley

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabrina Witherspoon

user_reviews_extended.Description:
It was my first visit today, and I’d absolutely recommend this place. The front desk staff were both friendly and welcoming, and I was called back quickly with hardly any wait. My dental hygienist was incredibly kind, made me feel comfortable right away, and kept things relaxed the whole time. They even offer a blanket and a neck warmer, which is such a nice touch because who wants to be cold in the dentist chair?

Both the hygienist and the dentist took the time to explain anything that needed attention and clearly walked me through what to expect moving forward. It’s not easy to find a great dental office, but I’m really glad I chose this one.

title: Downtown Dental Design
address: 507 Pressler St #350, Austin, TX 78703, United States

user_reviews.Name: CarolK Aidoo
user_reviews.Description:
I have been a client of Downtown Dental Design over 10 years! Recently had a new crown done and it fits like a glove! The preparation on the front end by Dr. Esami, the lab,  and completion were all seamless. The entire staff are wonderful! My hygienist, dental assistant, Evelyn, and Hillary keep things running smoothly. Appointments are on time!!!
I highly recommend scheduling and experiencing their professional services for yourself!

user_reviews.Name: Andrew Gerland
user_reviews.Description: I can’t say enough good things about this dental office. I see Rachel as my hygienist, and she is always so thorough, gentle, and friendly.. she makes every cleaning feel easy. Dr. Eslami is absolutely incredible, extremely skilled, and takes the time to explain everything in a way that makes me feel comfortable and confident in my care. I actually look forward to my twice-a-year visits, which says a lot! This has truly been the best dentist I’ve ever been to, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for exceptional care.

user_reviews.Name: Debra Grebe
user_reviews.Description: I never like getting a filling, but there was no reason to have dreaded the one Dr Eslami did. She and Evelyn were quick and efficient. They told me what to expect both before and after procedure. I was very appreciative of their skill, professionalism, and caring. Highly recommend for any dental work!

user_reviews.Name: Becki Farrah
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Eslami and her staff are great.  Always friendly, great about reminding me of appointments and working with my busy schedule.  Parking is easy (a plus for downtown). user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Bruni
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went here yesterday for a standard cleaning and thought I was having a great experience until I met Dr. Eslami. I am currently in Invisalign with another dental office and after Dr. Eslami reviewed my teeth she had very concerning and negative comments to say about my current alignment/bite. After alarming me with her negative comments and telling me she would not have put me in Invisalign to begin with + would recommend I see an orthodontist specialist ASAP to fix my (supposedly) really bad / off bite, it was brought to my attention that this is not the first time she has done this with patients. She made very certain and negative comments about my teeth without knowing anything about my current treatment plan, which she should have never done. Doctors need to be very careful with the feedback they provide patients, especially when they are under *active* care by another provider to fix said issue. I spent all yesterday concerned about my bite/alignment when I didn't need to be because she was more focused badmouthing my current practitioner than anything else. She should be more cognizant of the words that come out of her mouth and the impact it could have to patients. After visiting my other dentist, who I fully trust and have the uttmost respect for (Toothbar -- they are the best!), I will not be seeing Dr. Eslami again. I'd be wary of the tactics she uses and the level of concern she raises with patients without offering a solution.

user_reviews.Name: Hema Basnet
user_reviews.Description: I had a great experience with all the team. They explained my Invisalign treatment clearly and made me feel comfortable during every visit. The office is clean and the staff is very friendly. I highly recommend this orthodontist. The whole team is amazing! Brooklyn takes care of me at all my appointments, and she is the best.

user_reviews.Name: Jian Jakosalem
user_reviews.Description:
I had such a great experience at this office! Alyssa was my dental assistant and she was so kind, patient, and made me feel completely comfortable from the moment I sat down. Dr. Shadman was my doctor for both my annual exam and Invisalign consult, and she was incredibly thorough, professional, and clear in explaining everything.

The entire visit felt smooth and organized. The office was clean, modern, and welcoming, and the team truly took their time to make sure all my questions were answered. I never felt rushed, and I really appreciated how transparent they were with the treatment options and recommendations.

Highly recommend this dental office especially Alyssa and Dr. Shadman!

user_reviews.Name: Tanya Chung
user_reviews.Description:
I would never recommend this place to anyone. I’ve been battling with Premier Dental Group since December 2025. It is now February 2, 2026.
Long story short, they had their dental assistance, Daniella, working on my crown the majority of the time. I only saw the eentist, Dr. Homsi, about 10%, and this includes communications throughout. He just did a little drilling to resize and prep my tooth for the new crown. Daniela, the assistant, not even a hygienist,  did everything else, and was responsible for cementing the permanent crown herself. After inquiring about whether the dentist will do anything else, she said no, she does everything else. Apparently she did everything else including the work for the general manager. After Daniela did my temporary crown, I was in excruciating pain for 3 weeks straight (because she didn’t do it right. It was sitting high so I couldn’t bite down normal without being in pain,) I came in to have it readjusted and it still didn’t help. After some thought, I didn’t like that Daniela was doing the majority of the work, including work that her general manager, Monica, was responsible for. She told me that since she’s been working on me the entire time then she should be the one communicating with me about my issues. I decided that I didn’t want  my services done there anymore. Having the assistant take care of the dentist’s work and handling Monica’s responsibilities did not sit well with me one bit. To top it all off, she didn’t put the temporary crown in correctly causing me a lot of pain and headaches for 3 weeks straight.
When I informed her I want to stop all services and I want my refund for the crown and my night guard, the lack of communications and the getting the run around started. They were very sketchy and told me that it would take them 4-6 weeks to process my refund for the crown, that I paid out of pocket for.
Today I went to my new dentist to get my crown finally placed and we were about to work on my night guard that Premier Dental sent me. It turns out they sent me someone’s else’ night guard. It didn’t even fit in my mouth and the night guard had two extra mats in the back that I don’t have.
I sent them another message (that they’ve been ignoring) and again no reply.
Do not go to this place if you want quality service. They look nice on the surface, that’s not what you or I pay for. We pay for good, quality, genuine, caring service, that you will NOT get here. I am still fighting this because I got horrible service that I paid over $1000.00 for. I got nothing but pain and suffering. I had to take time off from work to see another (WONDERFUL) dentist who I HIGHLY recommend!!! My procedure for my crown went smoothly with no pain and I was able to hit normal with the temporary crown that the dentist (not the dental assistant) put in herself.
Premier Dental is poorly run, unprofessional, and they just want your money.

user_reviews.Name: Mr Roberts
user_reviews.Description: Called and set up an appointment for the downtown location. Went downtown and before I parked, called and asked if they had parking. Had to park in the parking garage and when I get there, they are closed. I was on the phone with the lady twice before this and she never told me the office was closed. Waste of time and money

I’m terrified of the dentist and from the beginning to the end of cleaning, x-rays, getting a crown in. I give it 5 ⭐️ the doctor and the staff are amazing and even though I was so nervous they treated me with so much kindness and patience. This will
Definitely be my main dentist moving forward!

The staff is incredibly friendly and so gentle in informing you of processes and procedures throughout your visit. They’ll answer any questions you may have and ensure you leave your visit feeling confident and comfortable in your providers. I’ve already highly recommended this office to a few colleagues!

user_reviews.Name: Mike Anderson
user_reviews.Description: Dr Potter has been my dentist for a few years now and he and the staff at East Austin Dental are fantastic.  I actually look forward to the 6 month cleanings.  Dr Potter has replaced 3 old fillings with impressive skill.  One was likely to require a crown but he was able to save the tooth.  No pain, super fast and they feel and look great.  Thanks Dr Potter and East Austin Dental.  You all are the BEST!

user_reviews.Name: Benjamin Buzan
user_reviews.Description: Went in to get a cleaning and get fitted for trays (I have clenching issues) and I got held up at work and they were EXTREMELY kind and understanding and even saw me anyways when I got there a little late, way better attitude then I was expecting considering I was late and being an inconvenience. They were even nice enough to make sure I was comfortable while getting scanned for my dental trays. I know my insurance isnt very good, but for the quality of my cleaning and how kind everyone was the price was more than worth it. Front desk, assistants, hygienists and doctors are all 10/10

user_reviews.Name: Corine Murat
user_reviews.Description: GO TO DR. BERNAL! He is so good at what he does. He is such a great trustworthy dentist. He did crowns on my two front teeth and let these pictures speak for how amazing of a job he did. The two crowns match perfectly with my other teeth and I am constantly getting complimented on my teeth. No one can even tell they are crowns. I forget sometimes too :) ! Dr. Bernal made sure they were the perfect match before finalizing his work and I APPRECIATE him so much for this. GO TO HIM. TRUST ME.

user_reviews.Name: Philippa Mason
user_reviews.Description: They did an AMAZING job on my cleaning - I was blown away by how white they got my teeth. I have always hated going to the dentist and I feel like a lot of dentists will shame you in one way or another and that was not the case here at all. The dentist and staff were really kind and warm and attentive. It was easy and quick to get an appointment too - I was able to book a cleaning as a new client only a few days out which I feel like can be rare!
