Dr. Bernal made sure they were the perfect match before finalizing his work and I APPRECIATE him so much for this. GO TO HIM. TRUST ME.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Philippa Mason
user_reviews_extended.Description: They did an AMAZING job on my cleaning - I was blown away by how white they got my teeth. I have always hated going to the dentist and I feel like a lot of dentists will shame you in one way or another and that was not the case here at all. The dentist and staff were really kind and warm and attentive. It was easy and quick to get an appointment too - I was able to book a cleaning as a new client only a few days out which I feel like can be rare!

user_reviews_extended.Name: G
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist for the past month and a half has been a terrible experience BUT the staff and the Doctor made this visit enjoyable. I only got an exam and xray but he took the time to actually speak to me and educate me. I’m excited to get work done here in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katrina O Day
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place has the most amazing staff all across the board! I drive over 80 miles for my check ups and cleanings because of the comforting service I receive. They put my dental anxiety to rest. As soon as I get in the chair I know I am in good hands!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camille Gan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Potter and the staff are outstanding! They take their time to explain everything in details and make you feel so comfortable no matter if the issue is big or small. Amazing experience every time. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Pennebaker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a broken filling and visited East Austin Dental with a lot of anxiety.  Dr. Bernal and his team were smart, friendly, and efficient. They immediately put me at ease. The office uses state-of-the-art technology, and I was blown away by how painless and quick my crown procedure was. This is the first truly positive dental visit I have ever had! The office is unassuming and has a family-like vibe.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Cummings
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Bernal is the man! He is thorough and kind. I appreciate the treatment from his entire staff every time I have to go to the dentist! 🦷

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Lane
user_reviews_extended.Description: Prior to moving to Austin, I had been going to the same dentist since I had my first tooth. After 3 decades with one dentist, I was nervous to find one I’d love just as equally anywhere else. Lucky for me, I found East Austin Dental! Dr. Adrian Bernal and his entire team are absolutely the best. Everyone is so kind, thoughtful, helped me understand the billing process and always offer overall wonderful service. Special shout out to them also having such a **beautiful** office as well. I look forward to every 6 month cleaning & know I’m in good hands. I couldn’t recommend this office enough!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Briana Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a new patient here, and had the best experience ever at a dental office. The staff were all so welcoming and kind. Very knowledgeable and detailed when it came down to procedures and pricing. Dr Potter is an amazing doc, keeps you calm and interacts with you during any procedure, so that’s a plus!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: I want to start by saying I do not like getting me teeth worked on, it has always been scary to me! I love going here though! You feel so welcomed and reassured that you will be taken care of. The staff is always friendly and uses my name (personal touch) when arriving. Dr. Bernal is by far the best dentist I have ever been to! Always making sure I am OK during anything that is needed because he knows how nervous I get. I would recommend this place over and over again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: delphino masangcay
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot recommend this dental office enough! From the moment I walked in the door, Griz greeted me with a smile and gave the best advice on how to get the best out of my policy.  The office is modern, clean, and well-maintained, which immediately put me at ease.
During my visit, Dr. Bernal  took the time to listen to my concerns and thoroughly explain any necessary treatments. They were patient, gentle, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire procedure. I was impressed by their attention to detail and commitment to providing the best possible care.
The dental hygienist Duyen was also fantastic. she was thorough yet gentle during my cleaning, and provided valuable advice on how to improve my dental hygiene routine at home.
Overall, I had an excellent experience at this dental office, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for top-notch dental care. The staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction, and I can't thank them enough for their outstanding service. Five stars all around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Tracy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely the best dental experience I’ve ever had.

Have gotten a deep cleaning and two fillings repaired and was in and out in record time. The day after the deep cleaning, I would have never known I had it done. With other dentists in the last, my jaw would have been throbbing for weeks.

Had two fillings replaced today... I was in and out in less than an hour.

On top of all of this, they’ve got awesome art in the office and play great music. The staff is super nice. I can’t wait to go back for a cleaning in 3 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to East Austin Dental since they opened, and the service has changed over the years. Dr. Potter is one of the best dentist I have seen and has been super helpful over the years when I have had an issue. All my fillings done by him have been great. He also helped me with a 15 year old root canal, and I loved the person he referred me to to resolve that issue.

As another reviewer mentioned, they are the only doctor's office that does not put you on the waiting list if you want to come in sooner. You must either make an appointment or be on the waiting list; there is no both.

I have stuck around because the doctors are excellent, but my last straw has been the weird issues with the insurance they take but don't take.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Lu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient at East Austin Dental for roughly 1.5 years now and I have to say, I'm completely satisfied with the care and treatment they provide. I switched over to East Austin Dental from another dentist and the experience is like night and day! Very professional and I 100% agree with the other reviews that they do not try to up-sell you on anything. You feel like a patient, not a "customer". Everyone there knows what they're doing, very gentle and efficient, and their whole operation runs like a well-oiled machine. I also really appreciate the TV on the ceiling to pass the time while you get your teeth cleaned. It's a little hard to schedule appointments sometimes because they're very busy and always booked - for good reason! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Sodine Parr
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great first experience at East Austin Dental. Dr. Potter and his team took great care of me. I was seen right away, they were gentle on my teeth, and they didn't try to force any unnecessary dental work on me. I'm glad I finally found a good dentist in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best teeth cleaning I have ever had. Duyen, my dental hygienist, was very thorough, caring and attentive. She took the time to really take care of my teeth and gave me advice to maintain my oral hygiene at home. I will definitely keep going to East Austin Dental from now on. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: courtney mangas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about this dentist office. First, everyone is beautiful, kind and charming- they make you feel right at home and well taken care of. I’ve had a cleaning and a filling repaired (two different visits) and each time I felt little to no discomfort and was in and out under 40 minutes. The office itself is swanky and comfortable, it feels luxury. This dentist is as good as it gets!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marisol Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Want to start by saying that I suffer from anxiety and panic attacks. I didn't know how I would handle a visit to the dentist. I had a broken tooth and needed to take care of it Dr. Potter and his staff were AMAZING. Every time I thought I was about to escalate my anxiety I felt reassured by how Dr. Potter informed me of what was going to happen and what to expect. The staff were also kind and attentive. I had a positive experience and would recommend East Austin Dental to anyone who has anxiety issues and is cautious but needs to address dental care.  Parking Garage is easy to access and parking is validated. I read about Dr. Potter and that he speaks Spanish is a plus.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Belen Downs
user_reviews_extended.Description: After moving to Austin and having dental work that was less than IDEAL and very expensive, I was fortunate enough to be referred to East Austin Dental. Dr. Potter and his assistant Rachelle Penny were very professional, courteous, informative and clearly addressed my dental needs.  At 60+ years old I have been to many dental offices and East Austin Dental is truly the best starting with the lovely reception ladies, to the great service and honest prices. ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Gelber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I’ve ever been to. I had a very complex case of crowding along with a lower bridge of front teeth. I was really needing braces and dentists before could not recommend a plan without referring to a specialist.  Adrian not only helped me straighten my teeth without damaging my bridge, he did it with only using Invisalign and in less than 8 months! I couldn’t be happier and I won’t go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Buckheit
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went here for my first couple cleanings after moving to Austin and had bad experiences both times.

The first appointment the hygienist wouldn’t do a fluoride treatment, saying that I needed to ask for that ahead of time. I found this odd as other dentists had always done this by default rather than needing to explicitly order it ahead of time. But obviously not a dealbreaker.

The next cleaning my teeth were hyper sensitive due to missing the fluoride treatment, and the hygienist asked if she could put a numbing agent on my teeth. I agreed, but to my surprise it made caused intense pain, so I asked her to stop and just proceed without it. She got upset with me and continued putting it on the other side of my mouth, at which point I asked her to stop again. When she did the cleaning she was working hastily and continually stabbing/scraping into my gums. I asked her if she could slow down and be more gentle. She responded to by telling me that nobody else had a problem with how she cleaned teeth. She applied the fluoride equally carelessly and wrapped things up with passive aggressive comments about how she’d schedule me with the other hygienist next time.

I left East Austin Dental and went to The Local Dentist down the street. They were able to clean up the mess with a pain-free and far more effective cleaning. They also helped me work through my tooth sensitivity issues. They have been amazing with listening, communicating, and working collaboratively with me and it's a night and day difference in both the experience and the end outcome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Douglas King
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Potter and his team are phenomenal. I chipped my front tooth and Dr. Potter made it look AMAZING. Plus I just genuinely enjoy coming here because the staff is great and very personable.

It's not often that you look forward to going to the dentist. Already can't wait for my next cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: zach groesbeck
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dentists here are exceptional, and so are their assistants. They have a great office and make you feel very comfortable. They also do excellent work very quickly.

Giving them three stars because the admin staff is very rude, curt, and will ask you to pay for things upfront that your insurance will cover.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abhinav Prakash
user_reviews_extended.Description: After looking around for a long while finally found a good dentist in Austin, now my dentist Dr. Bernal. Very happy and satisfied with extremely friendly and professional service. Location is awesome too, in the hip and happening part of the city, cherry on top they validate parking in the building property parking lot, can't beat that deal. Tough to get short notice appointments clearly validates their excellent service and hence the high demand. What worked for me was calling regularly and checking for openings against cancellations and be ready to be seen on a short notice :) I am a happy camper.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa R
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience with East Austin Dental was unlike any other medical office visit I've ever had. From the moment I walked through the door, the staff was incredibly welcoming and friendly. The receptionist greeted me by name and introduced herself, making it feel more like meeting some friends-of-friends rather than going to the dentist.

I haven't been to the dentist in several years. Probably like 5-7 years. I always hated going. Cleanings would hurt, the staff would be condescending, and God forbid you have a cavity (which I've had 3 in the past). East Austin Dental was nothing like that. Dr. Bernal and his assistant were conscientious of my comfort at all times and the cleaning was surprisingly bearable compared to previous experiences. They always explained what they were doing as they did it, showed me pictures and xrays of my teeth and described what the issues were as well as different approaches to treatment. I felt extremely comfortable under their care. I even got to watch an episode of House of Cards while they cleaned my teeth! At the end, I even got a free whitening session! Their prices are very affordable given the quality of care they provide. I made my followup appointment without any reservations whatsoever. Their office is also really cool!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Faith Bella
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just moved to Austin, and was in need of a new dentist, and read about Dr Bernal, and let me tell you he’s such a great doctor! He’s very detailed and honest in the work you need, and will do everything in his power to make sure what you need will be done! The staff is amazingly helpful and welcoming, they make you feel at home from the moment you walk into their door. The location is very convenient!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Little
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a patient for 2.5 years and  customer service is consistently subpar and lacking. Parking is challenging and not made clear. Was not told where to park and then told I’d receive a late fee for being “late” to go and re-park my car. Further, was told at my most recent visit that East Austin Dental will change to no longer accepting insurance plans. The team seemed very confused by what this means and  when it will be happening. Which, I get, insurance is confusing. But not being fully aware and restricting patients who cannot pay out of pocket seems lacking of diverse clientele. No longer will be a patient here.
And lastly, my partner was also a patient who was to have a dental procedure done with them. They day of the procedure told him that they were unable to complete the procedure when they knew they didn’t have the resources to complete the surgery.
If your are looking for empathic and clear  communication go somewhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachele Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been seeing Dr. Bernal for a few years now, and I love this office. Dr. Bernal has a very calming presence, I have a lot of anxiety around my dental needs- but after a visit with him I feel at ease. He gives me practical approaches to my extensive dental needs. Last year he dropped off my insurance coverage, but I will continue to come see him. His staff are always pleasant and courteous, and his office is always clean and bright. I recommend him to anyone on the hunt for a new dentist!  Thank you Dr. Bernal!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Knox
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been going here for a year or two and have generally liked it. The office aesthetic is great and I've valued Dr. Potter. However, this morning I was scheduled to have a tooth bleached (after a recent root canal). I was given two documents to sign. One seemed to be consenting to getting a root canal, which wasn't quite right—I already had a root canal—but I signed it anyway.

The other one was a consent form for a teeth-whitening treatment I'd never heard of, which was fine, since I didn't expect to know the name of my planned treatment. This consent form contained a passage saying that I had discussed the treatment with my dentist and that all of my questions had been asked, which was certainly untrue. I asked the receptionist about that passage, expecting that she would explain the discrepancy, tell me to strike it out, or do something else to address my concern. Instead, she said that the treatment named in the consent form is actually *different* than the one I'd be getting, that they don't have a consent form for my actual treatment and need to use this one as a stand-in, and that if I don't sign it then I can look for treatment elsewhere. She went nuclear on me. Maybe she was just having a bad day. But I felt completely stonewalled. After I objected to signing something that was both untrue and not for my actual treatment, she walked back to consult with someone (her practice manager, Dr. Potter, ...?) and came back and repeated that if I'm not comfortable signing it, I can go somewhere else. Feeling flustered, mistreated, and frankly angry, I declined to sign and left.

I understand that much of the non-legal world plays fast and loose with legal documents. For instance, title insurance folks give you 100 documents to sign and expect you not to read them all. But I've never had someone balk when I ask to have an obvious mistake in a legal document corrected before I sign it. It's unethical to pressure people to sign false documents. Further, besides being horrendous customer service, forcing patients to sign consent forms for treatments they aren't getting (and not for treatments they are getting) might be a malpractice liability for East Austin Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had 10 dentists in 7 different states over the years  and Dr. John Potter is  by far the most skilled. He's very patient and answered all my questions. I have a low pain threshold and he was very attentive to giving the right amount of numbing so I experienced no pain while he worked on my tooth. He referred me to an excellent endodontist  when I needed a root canal. It gave me piece of mind knowing my dental care was in such good hands. I hope to keep Dr. Potter for my dentist for any future dental work (even returning to Austin should I move away.) Both of the dental assistants who worked with Dr. Potter during my appointments also  excellent. The office is very relaxing and everything is up-to-date. If you need a dentist, whether your dental problem is large or small, I highly recommend Dr. Potter at East Austin Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Irfan Ari Syed (Ari)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Honestly, this is the most badass dental clinic I've been to. Dr. Bernal is an absolutely, hands-down, the best dentist in town. He's incredibly detailed oriented and honest about the work you need. I work in downtown so I was looking for a dentist close by. I chose East Austin Dental based on these google reviews I'll never go anywhere else.

The staff are incredible and make you feel like you're visiting old friends you haven't seen in a while. Special shout out to Lindsey for being amazing! You are a rock-star.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karol Zdebel
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the first poor experience I had at a dentist. The receptionist informed me orthodontics weren't covered under my insurance and tried to charge me the full fee for a retainer repair. After singing the invoice I checked my insurance plan and found out the true coverage is 70% for orthodontics. After informing her about this she proceeded to tell me that because they're a regular dentist clinic this coverage might not apply. At no point prior to going ahead with the procedure did anyone refer me to an orthodontist, or suggest going to one so that I would be eligible for the coverage. She didn't even bother trying to go through the insurance until I instructed her to. For what it's worth the actual Doctor was cool!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam G
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is the hippest, coolest dental office I've ever been to.  Let me start by saying that this is a very professional establishment with a very big concern to fill your needs and leave you walking out the door satisfied with your dental work, and not leave you concerned with your expenses.  Meaning: Did I get my monies worth?  Damn right I did, and didn't leave me thinking, how am I going to go out this weekend.  The staff was awesome!  They were very comfortable to be around with the feeling that they were friends you never knew you had.  Making an appointment  was a breeze.  I got there on time and went right in.   Dr. Bernal was great. He was very knowledge, and concerned for my well being.  Which is extremely important to me.  He laid it all out there and assessed my options.  Never once did I feel like he rushed me into anything I didn't want to work on.  I will recommend East Austin Dental to anyone that even mentions going to the dentist.
P.S. I've never wrote a review like this about any Dr., and the second review to anyone.  I'm kind of a hard ass (skeptical) when it comes down to medical professionals.  Great job Dr. Bernal and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Binder
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Adrian Bernal and his staff are wonderful. I previously had dental trauma at other doctors in the past and I have sensitive teeth - I'm a tough case. Dr. Bernal and his assistant took the time and care to make me comfortable and ensure I was fully numb. The work was meticulous and PAIN-FREE. I had at least three cavities fixed.

I am so thrilled I found this office. Very high-tech, all the latest equipment, and even great lighting (non-fluorescent) - this helps patients stay calm. You can watch TV overhead (Netflix). Good location with parking validation. This is not your stodgy grandpa's dentist office - it's very modern. I 100% recommend Dr. Bernal!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah L Nash
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wouldn't trust anyone else with the care of my teeth. Dr. Bernal is gentle, yet thorough, and quick! I always walk away from East Austin Dental proud of my smile, they are the best 😁 Thank you Dr. Bernal!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Nash
user_reviews_extended.Description: The folks at East Austin Dental will exceed your expectations.  We should expect this level of attention and care from all of our medical service providers.  East Austin Dental fixed an issue my previous dentist could not or would not - it just took a little more time and attention which East Austin Dental seems to do quite well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: russell cavin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
AMAZING, I wish I could give 6 stars!

I had not had my teeth cleaned in close to 2 years.  I know, that's gross but the last dentist I went to I just wasn't extremely happy with.  I finally booked an appointment with East Austin Dental on a recommendation from a friend and I will tell you, I have found my dental office for life!

Not only is the atmosphere and design of the office really cool, everyone I met working there is awesome.  I am a very organized person but life still gets hectic so the confirmation call from Lindsay was really great to make sure I didn't miss my appointment.  She also called a few weeks ahead of my schedule to let me know they could squeeze me in earlier from a cancelled appointment.  I wasn't able to make it that day so she was happy to keep me in my current appointment.

As soon as I came into the office I was immediately greeted by Lindsey and one of the assistants, Jason.  Everyone was so friendly, it really calmed my nerves about going to the dentist.  I was asked to complete paperwork and as soon as I was done, they were ready for me.  NO waiting time!  I also made sure to be on time for my appointment though. I work in a business where I am meeting with people constantly so I understand how important it is to be punctual or at least let them know if you're going to be running late.

I was then greeted by Colette, who would be the hygienist cleaning my teeth that day.  I'm not sure where they found this girl, but she's so incredibly friendly and such a genuine person.  She made small talk but I could tell she actually cared about what I had to say which is rare in this world.  She talked me through what she would be doing then asked what I wanted to watch on Netflix.  The TV on the ceiling is such an awesome touch.  The chair was extremely comfortable as well.

I get a little nervous going to the dentist but Colette was incredible.  She is extremely gentle and I wasn't in any pain at all which is a lot less than I can say about my last dentist visit.  She even apologized a few times because she had to dig in hard in a few spots but I still never felt any pain.  She was concerned about one tooth and that I might have the beginning of a cavity.  At this point I thought I was going to be paying a lot more of out of pocket.  At this point she brought Dr. Bernal in to meet with me.  She showed him the area she was concerned about so he could take a look.  After they both reviewed the x-rays they concluded that it could potentially turn into a cavity but they would just watch it for now.  I definitely didn't expect that from a dentist, I just assumed they would try to get as much money out of me as possible.  This was such a pleasant surprise to actually be treated like a human being and not just a cash cow.  I can't tell you how much I appreciate both of their diligence and assessment.

Speaking of Dr. Bernal, this is the coolest dentist I have ever met.  Not only did he serve for our country but he's an awesome artist with a lot of his work adorning the walls of the office.  Overall his demeanor, staff, and office made me feel extremely comfortable.

My teeth are all clean now and I feel great, but I can't wait to go back in 6 months for my next appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: carly siegel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Be careful with this office and Delta Dental Insurance. They stopped accepting this insurance and did not inform me when I called with my updated policy information. Instead they said they sent a mass email months back and that’s how they were telling patients. Not when specially asked or updating insurance info. My father was a dentist and this is not ethical.

Additionally I then asked to just cancel my appointment and they said they would charge me a same day cancellation fee.

user_reviews_extended.Name: james Thorne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Did not think I could have an experience this amazing at the dentist. The staff was friendly (and sexy especially Jeff), the work was thorough/ affordable, and the whitening was free. The office is conveniently located off 35 in downtown Austin and the appointment was just as quick as it needed to be! Also you can watch Netflix above you during the appointment. I would highly recommend East Austin Dental to anyone looking for a Dentist in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chop Choplin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Legit the coolest dentist office I've ever been to and I've been to several in different cites. They have Netflix so you can watch your current binge while they work on you. Most transparent staff when it came to explaining my treatment plan. Super professional but super laid back. Easy to confront and they look past the mistakes you've made that caused damage to your teeth and focus on what needs to be done to start the repair process. The magic Dr. Bernal and the amazing ladies performed on my jacked up teeth was wild. I got my smile back! 🙏🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was a patient of East Austin Dental for the last year with 2 cleaning visits. I found it hard to make an appointment, and when I needed to reschedule for my 6-month visit, I was offered a spot on the waiting list or an appointment several months out. I was only given an appointment in a reasonable time when I expressed frustration and said something to the extent of "How am I supposed to be a patient of yours if I can never get in your schedule?" After feeling like I wasn't getting great care and that the office was difficult to schedule with, I finally saw another dentist and had to call to get some information from my records as in my 2 visits at East Austin Dental, it was brought to my attention and discussed at length that I had gum recession on a specific tooth. When I asked for the notes on the recession, I was told there was nothing in my records about this. Again, I expressed frustration and the office assistant said she'd check with the team and call me back, which she did and said they were unable to find a record. As this comes after the 2 visits where they flagged the gum recession and I asked how we could prevent it from receding further and I was told "we'll just have to wait and see", and now a year later, I have to get a gum graft because there was no prevention offered, I will never go to this dentist office again. I have never experienced such poor care and attention as a patient. All the latest equipment and the kind hygienists cannot negate the fact that the approach to dentistry I experienced here was unprofessional and not patient-centered at all.

UPDATE 7/14/19: After posting this, Dr. Bernal reached out directly to me and we had a long phone conversation where we both discussed the issues I noted in this review (for which he was very apologetic) and he gave me helpful advice and a referral for my current dental issues. I believe Dr. Bernal to be a knowledgeable, honest and kind practitioner and that the majority of the issues I mention are related to how the office has been run. While I have not returned to see if these issues have been resolved, if I were to return to the practice, I would request to see Dr. Bernal (as I was seeing his associates) to ensure consistency of care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janelle Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lamison is amazing! She listened to me and made me so comfortable. I had a tooth extracted and it was virtually painless including recovery. I have never had such a pleasant experience at the dentist. Wow!!! If you have had bad experience with dentist this place will change your mind. So professional. Love this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Hutton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am a new patient here and I’m really pleased with the entirety of this office. The young woman at the front was so sweet and  very knowledgeable in making me feel comfortable in the process. Dental offices make me nervous, but the atmosphere here is very laidback and staff was great!

Also they have parking available in the same building they’re in and validate.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aimee Scarbrough
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands Down- The Best Dental Experience I've Ever Had. From the Doctor to the Techs to the Office. The entire staff is genuinely a pleasure to interact with and truly care about their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Trevino
user_reviews_extended.Description: After horrible experiences, I had not been to the dentist in years - eeek. From start to finish, the team at East Austin Dental was top notch and I've already told 3 close friends they should check it out. I felt they took noticeable extra precautions to deal with Covid19 and I left there feeling with a whole new outlook on "going to the dentist." It's modern, the team is very welcoming and warm, and they are not there to 'drill and bill'. 5 stars across the board.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Meekings
user_reviews_extended.Description: It's taken me years to find a dentist I love, where I don't feel like they are just trying to wring money out of me. The office is modern and Austin funky, and the staff are so friendly. I recommend them to anyone I need of a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doré D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Since childhood I've been absolutely mortified to go to the dentist! So...I just NEVER go! I've never in my entire life left a dentist office happy until yesterday. I can't stop smiling either! I was so scared and embarrassed about the condition of my teeth going in but Adrian and his whole staff made me feel so positive and comfortable about them. user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Lynch
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot recommend East Austin Dental highly enough, especially for patients with complex dental histories. I came to the practice as a challenging case, having previously undergone extensive craniofacial and jaw surgery along with two separate rounds of braces. After my surgery, I began seeing Dr. Potter. While my bite was technically adequate at the time, he had the expertise to suggest that seeing an orthodontist for further refinement was still worthwhile. My jaw surgeon agreed with his assessment, and I am incredibly glad I followed his advice. The minor improvements made to my bite and the overall aesthetics of my teeth have truly made a world of difference.

The quality of care extends to the entire team, as the hygienists are always exceptionally kind and do a thorough, professional job with cleanings. Beyond the clinical excellence, the office is modern, clean, and conveniently located. They are incredibly efficient with email communication, and it is a relief to find a practice where you don’t have to wait on hold for hours on the phone. For anyone in a similar situation, I also highly recommend Dr. Tim Brunson for orthodontics. Between his work and the team at East Austin Dental, I couldn’t be happier with the results.

title: Authentic Smiles
address: 1717 W 6th St Suite 365, Austin, TX 78703, United States

user_reviews.Name: martha league-calhoun
user_reviews.Description: I love this place. I’m so glad I found them. I started with red light therapy and now he is my full dentist. The best hygienist experience I’ve ever had. So relaxing and thorough. The staff is super friendly and accommodating. Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Brandon H Eisenberg
user_reviews.Description: If you need a dentist, This is the one you want. Calm & polite bedside manner, and his skill set is master class. I can see why he retains his patients. Dr Matt is an artist when it comes to  teeth, and he's earned my trust. As long as Dr Matt has a dental practice, he's the only dentist I will go to. Cannot say enough about this rockstar dentist. Likewise, his staff is very impressive—top tier and rockstars in their own right.

user_reviews.Name: Yenkai Wang
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Matt is absolutely one of the most responsible and detail-oriented orthodontists I've ever met. He is very hands-on and personally takes care of the critical steps in the treatment, which gave me a lot of confidence.

My teeth are difficult because they shift position easily, so my treatment took quite a while. However, Dr. Matt was committed to getting the best possible outcome for me and didn't stop until everything was aligned perfectly. I'm really happy with the results. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Joel Duhon
user_reviews.Description: What can I say, Authentic Smiles has THE BEST staff ⚕️ of industry professionals on Earth 🌎 and not just Austin, Texas. Dr. Matt is the "Dentist to the Stars" and you feel like family and not just a patient. Recommended highly.

user_reviews.Description:
From the moment I walked in, the experience was exceptional. The front desk, especially Mia, is incredible. She tells you everything you need to know before you even think to ask. It truly feels like she can read your mind, and it makes the whole visit stress-free. Dr. Matt is really cool and great to talk with about any concerns I might have.

Everyone I worked with was kind, skilled, and gentle. They explain everything clearly and keep a level of professionalism that never feels stuffy. The office has a friendly, family-style warmth.

I highly recommend Authentic Smiles without hesitation. They make going to the dentist easy.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an unfortunate accident as a child that rendered a couple of my frontal teeth useless,  so I've had my share of dental visits in several states across two countries for decades to fix crowns and such.
That said, I happened to have met Dr. Matt as a business neighbor just over 10 years ago, and we had brief casual contact. Then I decided to have him give me a consultation for my overall mouth health and to fix/advance my crown treatments (which eventually turned into implants).
I've never had such a good dentist experience as I've had with Dr. Matt - he explained throughly the treatment options plan in detail and with easy to understand vernacular. He is approachable and will take time to study and share all viable options so that you can make the best next decision on what procedures to get next (or not).
With all that said,  all the Authentic Smiles office and dental team (Mia & Ms. B) are always fantastic, friendly and efficient,  no less.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Authentic Smiles, and I must say it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by a warm and friendly receptionist who made me feel welcome and at ease.

The atmosphere of the clinic is incredibly inviting, blending modern aesthetics with a comforting ambiance that immediately puts you at ease. The clinic also provides blankets as well to make your visit less stressful. The Dental Assistants are not only professional but also genuinely caring, ensuring that each patient feels valued and comfortable throughout their visit.

Dr. Matt is a true expert in the field, combining skillful expertise with a gentle touch. The Dental Assistants took the time to explain every procedure in detail and answered all my questions with patience and clarity, which I greatly appreciated. I was thoroughly impressed by the top-notch treatment I received.

Moreover, the clinic operates with impressive efficiency, ensuring that appointments run on time without feeling rushed. This attention to detail and respect for patients' time is truly commendable.

A standout aspect of Authentic Smiles is their impeccable cleanliness and hygiene standards. The clinic is spotless, and it is evident that the staff adhere to stringent protocols to maintain a safe and clean environment. This commitment to hygiene is especially reassuring and enhances the overall experience.

Overall, my experience at Authentic Smiles was nothing short of fantastic. I left the clinic not only with a brighter smile but with the assurance that my dental health is in excellent hands. I highly recommend Authentic Smiles to anyone seeking high-quality dental care in a friendly and caring environment!

The absolute best experience I've ever had at the dentist! Dr. Shane, Brianna, and Mia made me feel welcomed and cared for every time I visited. They always made me feel like family. They worked with me to create a reasonable payment plan so I could proceed with my treatment when I didn't have insurance and provided a variety of options, always making me feel like help was within reach.

When I ultimately had to move out of Austin, I was saddened that I couldn’t continue my treatment with them. However, Dr. Shane ensured I could complete my care by referring me to a trusted dentist in my new city. I was well taken care of here, and I highly recommend their services!

title: Enamel Dentistry Saltillo (East Austin)
address: 901 E 5th St. Suite 170, Austin, TX 78702, United States

user_reviews.Name: Robert VanHover
user_reviews.Description: I was there for a consultation referred from my dentist. I was greeted warmly by Amy at the main desk. After waiting for a short time I was taken into the office for a full mouth scan. Afterward, Dr Daline displayed the results on their digital display unit. She is thoroughly professional in her approach. She informed me about a lot of the latest information regarding my particular situation.  Very friendly and easy to talk to, she answered all my questions. I even got a bag of swag to take home. ❤️ I would highly recommend Enamel Dentistry Saltillo!!

user_reviews.Name: Jason Daniel
user_reviews.Description: This is the best dental practice ever!! Started with the ease of entering my information over their website prior to my first visit. Upon arrival, greeted by name and with a genuine smile. Explained what was going to take place and took me for a tour of the facility (which is modern, comfortable and well equipped). Hygienist took good care of me and dentist spent time reviewing my treatment program and explaining what I needed to do. Billing was completely transparent and no attempt to upsell anything. Just good, honest, skilled people that care about patients! Experience couldn’t have been any better!

user_reviews.Name: JaQuarius Daniels
user_reviews.Description: The staff was extremely polite. The mood in the office was relaxing. Everything was clean, and the doctor was vocal and knew how to keep patients calm. I would recommend them to anyone, Great Job!!

user_reviews.Name: Timothy
user_reviews.Description:
I had such a great experience with my dentist Dr. Jane Quintana. She’s incredibly caring and always takes the time to ask how I’m doing, which makes me feel really comfortable. My cleaning was super smooth—I didn’t even need to get my mouth numbed, which was a relief! She also shared helpful tips and explained everything in a way that put me at ease.

I also want to mention the front desk lady—she’s always so kind, welcoming, and helpful. From scheduling to checking in, she makes the whole process easy and stress-free.

I really appreciate the whole team’s kindness and professionalism, and I definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a dentist who truly cares about their patients.

user_reviews.Name: Christy
user_reviews.Description: What an exceptional experience! I am about to finish up a year of Invisalign and it was an easy, straightforward process here. My dentist and everyone there is so nice and welcoming :) All adjustments needed have been simple. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Vanessa De Leon
user_reviews.Description: I had such a great experience today! Everyone was very friendly and made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in. The dentist was so kind and informative and took the time to explain everything clearly. I truly loved my visit and would definitely recommend this office!

user_reviews.Name: James Robert
user_reviews.Description: One of the most unprofessional Medical visits I’ve ever had. Extremely unprofessional and medical “diagnosis” seemed extremely sales oriented here as opposed to what’s best/comfortable for the client. Felt like I was speaking with car salesman with the poor attempts at trying to strong arm me go through with something I clearly stated I was not interested in. Literally 3-4 employees attempted this ineffective sales tactic. As if it was my first time at a dentist or something and I was wasn’t privy to the fact that their office makes commission off of what they were pitching lol smh Maybe if they understood the customer service aspect of sales instead of trying to manipulate clients, they might be more successful. Would absolutely not go anywhere near this place if you are looking for a competent and professional staff.

user_reviews.Name: Aly May
user_reviews.Description:
Karina was absolutely amazing!
This was by far the best dental cleaning I’ve ever had. She was incredibly gentle, thorough, and made the whole experience comfortable and stress-free.
You can really tell she cares about her patients and takes pride in her work.
I left with my teeth feeling spotless and a big smile on my face! 10/10 highly recommend Karina(:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Rangel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I didn’t know a dental visit could feel this good. From the moment I walked in Enamel Dentistry Saltillo it was calm, spotless, and welcoming. The front desk greeted me warmly and had me checked in right on time.
Daniella and the team are on another level. They explained every step, checked on my comfort constantly, and delivered care that was incredibly gentle yet meticulous. You can tell they take pride in every detail—professional, precise, and genuinely kind.
What really stood out? No pressure, just honest recommendations, clear pricing, and results I can see and feel. I left with a brighter smile and a lighter heart. If I could give ten stars, I would. Consider me a patient for life. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dj Karp
user_reviews_extended.Description: Qualified for a dental voucher through a city program so I am thankful, however this meant I got X-rays and pictures taken for over an hour and was never seen for a cleaning. After a failed fear mongering attempt about the state of my teeth (I’ve never had a cavity and don’t have any now), I was told I would have to pay out of pocket on my next visit. Some things may have changed since the last administration, but this was a waste of my time and I ended up feeling like I was at a mechanic shop and not a dentists’ office. Would highly recommend going to a dentist office that just looks like a professional health care facility and not a trendy east sixth bar. I did not appreciate feeling extorted or having my time wasted, but maybe they wouldn’t have to if they focused on clients over vibe and aesthetics.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dylan Fisher
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very caring dentist office who will take good care of you. They make every appointment a comfortable, seamless experience from scheduling your appointments to filling your cavities. Front of house and back of house run this office flawlessly. Trust them with your dental needs! Shoutout to Doctor Quintana for setting the industry standard!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom Scambilis
user_reviews_extended.Description: These folks are top notch!  Dr. Quintana is the best in the business.  Dr. Brazil is also amazing on surgical procedures.  The staff is excellent, courteous, helpful, and kind. They have helped me through multiple dental scenarios and all of the technology and care and compassion is very much appreciated.  I can't say enough good things about the team.  They do a great job and keep you on track.  From easy cleanings, to fillings, repairs and crowns, to implants, their care and dedication has been amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Cove
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience at Enamel Dentist Saltillo for my exam and cleaning. The staff was very professional, attentive, and explained everything clearly. The office itself is modern, clean, and welcoming — with good music and TV screens in the rooms that make the visit more comfortable.
The dentist actually did my cleaning and was extremely thorough. Because I have sensitive gums, they numbed them beforehand, which made the whole experience so much more comfortable than cleanings I’ve had elsewhere. I was very happy with the results and left feeling well cared for.
I’d recommend this office to anyone looking for a professional, modern, and patient-centered dental experience in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicholas Marquardt
user_reviews_extended.Description: After far too many years without dental care, the pain in one of two broken teeth finally forced me to visit to the S. Lamar location, sure the teeth couldn't be saved, but they found that they could and referred me to the Saltillo location (this location) for the root canal. Dr Daleen did a wonderful job, the root canal was so good and I was so comfortable that I briefly fell asleep several times during the procedure, not even kidding. Today I got my permanent crown on that tooth, and will go back soon to start on the other tooth. They save teeth that I was sure were unsalvagable, and they did such an amazing job here that it went a long way to getting rid of my childhood fear of the dentists office

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jovanna Aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely amazing dental office! From the second I walked in, the receptionist greeted me like family, so warm and genuine. My hygienist was fantastic, taking her time and making sure I was completely comfortable the whole way through. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: N A.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jane Quintana is by far one of the best dentists in Austin. I felt like I was in such good hands during my latest visit for a big procedure and would highly recommend her to anyone! Will definitely be referring others to this fantastic practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larisa Corder
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Enamel Dentistry. They are kind, professional, timely, and honestly super accommodating for patients that suffer from anxiety !! Going to the dentist can be such an uncomfortable thing for some folks, and if that's the case for you - look no further, they will take such good care of you here :) They also take informed consent really seriously!! So you always know what is going on with your treatment, and there is never peer pressure - just solid education on your options. Anytime someone asks me for a recommendation I can't wait to talk about the Saltillo office, since its such a 10 out of 10.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot recommend this dentist enough. Besides the fact they listen to you and are attentive, they also have some special services I’ve never received at any other dental office. Despite semi-annual cleanings and exhaustive daily oral care (I’m very meticulous), I suffered from gum inflammation and bleeding for years. Thinking this was just “what is was,” I dealt with it, until I came to Enamel. They offered me an under-gum laser treatment that CHANGED MY LIFE. No more inflammation or bleeding for more than six months, and the treatment took less than 20 minutes. I genuinely have more quality of life.

TLDR: They’re excellent, so give them a try.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Service, set up, and the staff are all top notch professionals! The people are all warm, welcoming, and focused on making your experience enjoyable. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a skilled dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roopa Kansagra
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Quintana at Enamel Dentistry Saltillo is the best.  She’s kind, caring and thorough.  I never feel rushed or pressured and always leaving confident with my teeth and smile.  I highly recommend her and her staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: Definitely the place to go! The very best staff Austin could offer. From admin to the doctor, flawless. I moved away to dean Keaton but still travel for this team. Can’t leave what feels like family ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Carlson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really enjoyed my experience here and honestly kind of excited for my next cleaning. They gave me recommendations of products to use and had a tv to watch while I was getting teeth cleaned, overall 10/10 experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beau Helbert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent quality dentist. Very honest. I went there for a second opinion. I haven't had a cave in 40 years and I went to this other dentist that said I had several. So I went to this dentist. They did a full set of x-rays and confirmed I had no cavities and needed no procedures. Very reputable. Will go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Rabuse
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing experience - the entire staff is incredible - they are incredibly friendly and personable. Such positive moods and energy throughout the office. They talk you through every step of the way, give detailed explanations, next steps, etc - breaking it down in a very polite yet educational manner.

Personally, I️ am not a fan of dentists/doctors who dumb things down,  sugar coat, or act like you won’t understand something - as someone very science-minded, I️ prefer the intelligent explanations backed up by science and the visuals they provided, and they made time to do just this as well as answer any question I️ could possibly have. They broke down every charge when laying out my plan as well, with options included and insurance factored in with financing options, if needed.

To summarize - the entire office is welcoming thorough, and considerate in all they do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Moffett-Matheson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It was a wonderful first experience there. I had previously been at another Enamel Dentistry location and moved due to proximity.

They were super communicative beforehand (both with what they needed from me as well as with reminders) and very welcoming when I arrived. Everyone gave a warm and informative intro, were transparent with what to expect at each stage of the visit, and were considerate during the cleaning process to accommodate concerns and work around sensitive spots.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joaquin Souberbielle
user_reviews_extended.Description: The facility is clean and ascetically pleasing. There was no wait and I was able to see both the dentists and get their opinion on what course of action made most sense for the removal of my wisdom teeth. Would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Herman Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enamel Dentistry East Austin's team is warm and caring. They are knowledgeable and professional. I encourage those who are looking for dental care to give them a chance. You won't be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Ogenche
user_reviews_extended.Description: Probably the best experience I’ve ever had a dentist — which I treated as a terrible necessity before. This was  really pleasant visit, I was in excruciating pain and they were able to fit in me as early as possible. The appointment was fast and my concerns addressed in a compassionate and professional manner. The dentist and dental assistant were both exceptionally kind and answered all my questions. This was an emergency situation but I will transferring dentists to this office for all my future care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joyce Mauban
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience at Enamel Dentistry at Satillo! Dr. Quintana and Rebecca took their time to address and explain my dental needs and made me feel comfortable with my decision on treatment. I highly recommend coming to see them if you are looking for top notch specialists that are kind, compassionate and professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Montoya
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love my dentist! The entire team is so professional, thorough, and knowledgeable. They offer so many services including teeth cleaning, whitening, preventative care, and even cosmetic procedures like veneers, Invisalign, etc. highly recommend this dentist office to anyone in the Austin Texas area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Demetriana Pritchett
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit and immediately felt comfortable. The staff welcomed me with smiles and looked happy to help with any concerns. The doctor was very gentle and clear in her exam of my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Schmidt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t usually review places but my visit here was so great! The vibes in here made me so cozy with the sunglasses and the TVs on the ceiling. They also worked with me on pricing since I do not have dental insurance. The dental assistant, hygienist, and Dr. Quintana all made me feel comfortable and not shamed for my hygiene. Definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariel Hurwitz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Quintana met me for an emergency appointment the day after my permanent retainer fell off. She offered multiple solutions and her team worked quickly to get me a quote through my insurance. Her staff was kind and helpful. I appreciate her team greatly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Henry Price
user_reviews_extended.Description: The TV’s are awesome and chairs are comfortable. Watched back to the future during my appointment. Super friendly, efficient, and skilled dentist and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan K Yergensen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m very disappointed with this dental office. They let go of the one hygienist who actually made the experience personal. She took her time, made sure everything was done right, and always made me feel comfortable. That kind of care is what kept me coming back. Unfortunately, now it feels more like a factory than a place that values patients. For that reason, I’ll be taking my business elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justine Hughes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Quintana was easily the most thorough and compassionate dentist I have been to. She was informative and carefully listened to my concerns and was conservative with her approach in meeting my needs. The staff were kind and the process of receiving care was very easy. I highly recommend Enamel for anyone looking for gentle but comprehensive dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deena Fournier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was attending a conference here in Austin and a part of my molar broke off.  Enamel Dentistry was within walking distance from the hotel and had good reviews.  Scheduled a next day appt.  Dr. Quintana and staff are FANTASTIC. They provided me with excellent, gentle and caring dental service.  Highly recommend!  Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josiah Lindquist
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist and experience. I’ve been in for routine work and today I had to get in to have a crown re-cemented. They got me in same day!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kalyn Mcqueen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here really made me feel welcome and gave me a shoulder to cry on when I found out I have to get a wisdom tooth removed. Definitely recommend and will be back !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Craig Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enamel Dentistry has been so kind and patient with me. The entire staff is very professional, making sure you feel comfortable and communicated with on everything they do during the procedures. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tumi Eldawi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this Enamel Dentistry for the last three years and I am really impressed by their office, their dentist, And hygienists. I really appreciate the transparency. They have with pricing and how they always try to get me a discount or ways I could use my insurance better really great dentist here. Also the location super convenient right in the center of East Austin so can’t really complain. Also, they have two TVs for you to watch so even when you’re laying Teeth cleaned you can watch TV on this ceiling and if you’re sitting up right, you have another TV that you can look at. 5/5

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rain Leviathan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is extremely professional fostering a pleasant environment. The Doctor was very informative about my current issues and explained everything. I would recommend this Dentistry for any dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lonnie G.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brazil and his team at Enamel made my wisdom teeth removal process very easy. They explained the surgery and rehab process thoroughly, and then the surgery itself didn’t take long at all. Although it was very efficient, it didn’t seemed rushed at all and I could tell they care about their patients. I would definitely recommend Dr. Brazil and the Enamel team to anyone needing wisdom teeth removals.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: There is not enough space for me to explain how wonderful Dr Quintana and her staff have been from the very beginning. If I could give more stars, I would. Please go see them. Especially if you are like me, and haven’t been to a dentist in a long time and are apprehensive. They will take care of you and get your oral health back in no time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: alissa harlow
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This clinic cares about dentist anxiety…constantly asking if I’m okay, bringing me headphone to watch tv and stay distracted…

Had such a great experience! Top notch technology & great bedside manners, I felt very comfortable. I hate going to the dentist and getting my teeth cleaned, but Daniella was so gentle — no pain, just squeaky clean!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ricki Wax
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had a great experience at Enamel Dentistry. From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming. Becca did an outstanding job in getting me set up and ensuring a smooth and comfortable visit.

My hygienist was also excellent, providing thorough and gentle care. The dental technology was impressive and very modern, making the entire experience more efficient and comfortable. I even enjoyed watching TV during my appointment, which made the time fly by.

I highly recommend the team at Enamel Dentistry for their professionalism, friendly service, and utilization of the latest dental technology.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Raimondi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super friendly staff, Dr was great, easy parking. Teeth nice and clean :) 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah
user_reviews_extended.Description: THE BEST:) The dentist here is so sweet, calming, and knowledgeable. She took time to explain how my autoimmune disorder affects my teeth. They have super strong numbing gel so no shots or nitrous needed for procedures. Some dentists are really lax with sedatives and I found it very refreshing that they avoid them if not necessary. I feel like they really look after my overall health here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience and highly recommend going to Enamel Dentistry! I was recommended to check them out by a friend that went to them for her wisdom teeth surgery and had a smooth experience. I went in for a wisdom tooth consultation and everyone was super kind, attentive, and communicative, walking me through every step of the process! I will definitely be keeping them as my dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitch Cohen
user_reviews_extended.Description: For someone who hates the dentist, this place does a very great job of changing that experience for me. Dr. Quintana and  her team really care about their patient experience and it really tells. Definitely recommend coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Montejano
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time here and it was great! I came for a new patient cleaning which included x-rays. The staff were super friendly and knowledgeable. They checked in with me throughout the entire time which helped ease any anxiety I had. The TVs and the music were also really nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Combs
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had missed calls and emails for my routine cleaning and exam due to being in a slump over grieving the loss of my parents and family over the past few months. When I came in and expressed this being the reason behind falling behind on commitments, they took the time to talk to me and refund the change for a missed appointment. I felt seen and heard. I’m glad I said something and allowed the space for Enamel treat me like a human before a patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an excellent experience at Enamel Dentistry - Saltillo! From the moment I walked in, the friendly staff made me feel at home. The clinic's clean, modern vibe sets a positive tone.

Ashleigh, RDH, was awesome. She explained everything clearly and took the time to answer all my questions. The hygienists were gentle and focused on my comfort, making the whole process enjoyable. Such a great team!

Their commitment to patient care really stood out. I left feeling confident about my dental health and actually looking forward to my next visit.

I highly recommend Enamel Dentistry for anyone seeking a friendly and professional dental experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Walters
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came into Enamel initially due to some soreness in one of my teeth. During the visit, Dr. Q and the team identified a couple of additional cavities which were filled beautifully and without issue. However, the original tooth pain continued to escalate (unrelated to the fillings, which were done flawlessly, thank you!). I was then referred to Edge Endo for a root canal, which went smoothly, and I returned to Enamel for the final restoration.

Through this unexpectedly eventful dental journey, the team at Enamel was consistently incredible. The environment was always warm, professional, and surprisingly fun. I know “fun” and “dentist” rarely show up in the same sentence, but the energy, personalities, and overall vibe at Enamel really make the place feel different in the best way possible.

If you’re a downtown Austinite looking for top-notch dental care in a convenient location, I can’t recommend Enamel highly enough. Great people, great atmosphere, and I’m actually looking forward to my 6-month check-up. See y’all then!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Wiscombe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I switched over to enamel dentistry last year and have had two appointments so far. I was hesitant to switch because I really liked my last dentist, but my experience with enamel has been even better! The staff are all so attentive and explain everything to you thoroughly. They make the experience as comfortable and relaxing as possible. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Breanna Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Quintana and the whole staff from start to finish is absolutely amazing. Her chair side Manor is so comforting. I didn’t feel anxious nervous or scared anytime during my appointment. Everyone shows so much empathy to the point where you will feel like you’re their only patient. I’ll have to get confirmation on everyone’s names, but I believe Wendy and Rebecca assisted. I honestly cannot wait to go back. They deserve 10 stars.⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alejandro Villarreal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came to get a root canal and so far it was the best dentist experience I ever had. I’m very nervous when it comes to the drilling and grinding and stuff but I never felt a thing at all. Dr. Daline did a wonderful job and I’d trust her with my life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Hare
user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone who loathes going to the dentist, I have to say the Enamal Dentistry location at 901 east 5th is awesome. They have state of the art equipment and the space is super clean & sleek, plus Dr. Quintana is amazing - super friendly, warm and knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sasan Askari Variani
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was at work today and on my lunch break I got my front tooth broken when I tried to open something with it , I in panic mood and scared of how it looked in the mirror. I called my dentist office Dr.Q and they were so helpful and nice to give me an appointment just right away and I left work . It was 1:30pm and I got an appointment for 3:30 pm !!  Amy and rest of the team are always kind and supportive and make the visit feel like home and easy. Dr.Q did a great a job on my broken tooth even it was so last minute and late on the day she patiently worked on my teeth and I appreciate you all for saving the day and make me smile again :)
I tried couple of different dentists in Austin and this newer team and place been my favorite place for any dental work .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Tyndall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Claimed a treatment would be covered, then months later a bill arrived for said treatment. I paid the amount and asked for a follow-up call. The office manager called and explained the situation as an oversight. I was fine with this explanation...she should have stopped there. She then kept on: Essentially said it was my fault, and my job to 'know my coverage better to avoid the office needing to call my insurance company, a 30-45 min call, that they don't want to have to do'. Now I'll have to beware of any future claims, as this office cannot be counted on based on their word. After giving this office thousands of dollars over the past year for various treatments, I guess I'll be finding a new one that can execute a basic expectations of giving me correct information ahead of treatments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom Ugarte
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Enamel has been my go-to dental office for the past few months and I continue to be impressed by their exceptional service. The moment you walk into their modern, welcoming office, the friendly staff greet you with a smile. During cleanings and procedures, they play good music and have TVs available if you want to watch something while you’re in the chair.
The hygienists at Enamel are highly skilled - they efficiently clean my teeth while also being gentle. I've never experienced any pain or discomfort during cleanings here, unlike some other dental offices I've tried. They take great care to make sure you're relaxed and comfortable.
All of the dentists I've seen have been very personable and take the time to explain what they are doing while they examine you. I truly appreciate that personal touch. Overall, I'm very happy with the dental work I've had done at Enamel and I will continue recommending them to anyone looking for a dentist. Their modern office, friendly staff, and gentle and quality care make going to the dentist an enjoyable experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jess Ching
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was really disappointed in the first time service I received at the office. As a customer, I really appreciate transparency in pricing for the services you will receive to avoid any surprises. I booked an initial appointment and asked for exams and routine cleaning. However, the dentist and hygienist who assessed me kept uncomfortably pushing deeper dental cleanings and then spent considerable time trying to upsell me on not only this deeper clean, but also a laser service to help prevent future plaque.

When I declined these offers since my insurance would not cover majority of these costs, and I would need to pay a significant sum out of pocket, I was told they would not be able to proceed with any cleaning that day. I spent 90 min in the office to only leave disappointed and told that they would only continue if I booked two separate deep cleans (1x side of my mouth to be cleaned at a time). This meant that to just get my teeth cleaned and checked that it would take a total of 3 sessions and a dental cleaning plan that I didn’t agree with.

It’s one thing if that was explained to me ahead of expending such a long time for my check in and if I had known that if you don’t want to proceed with deep cleans, that you cannot advocate for yourself to get a routine clean instead. It made me think what happens to those who cannot afford to spend the out of pocket extra costs that are above and beyond their insurance.

Overall, I thought it was in poor taste, and then upon checking out, I was told I had no balances. Fast forward 3 weeks later, I receive a text message out of the blue saying I owe them an amount- no details on what the costs are.

Bottom line: I think the dental office is clean and they offer Netflix as you wait and get assessed; however, they need to really improve on their transparency for pricing and provide that upfront. Additionally, they should tell people before they assess you that if you don’t agree with their expensive plans or recommendations, you cannot opt out and just get a normal dental cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Selena Obregon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn’t been to a dentist in 6 years - ( I know that’s very un-healthy of me, but it’s ok i’m working on ME) - and I was struggling finding a great dentist office who would look out for me and my teeth needs. Then I came across ENAMEL DENTISTRY in East Austin, this office really helped me improve my teeth in less than a month and i’m so grateful and my teeth/mouth are grateful as well, shoutout to Dr. Quintana for making me feel comfortable & for breaking down everything i needed to know and not holding back any knowledge of what she was going to do to help me improve and also big shoutout to the insurance/check out lady Miranda for also breaking down costs and helping figure out my insurance for me cause I know I would’ve stayed lost without either of them! GIVE THEM BOTH A RAISE AND A HIGH-FIVE!!! THANK YOU ENAMEL DENTISTRY FOR THE FILLINGs AND CLEANING SERVICES. I can eat sweets again!!! Looking forward to my wisdom teeth Extractions :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had very bad experiences with dentists in the past.  I’m a bartender so my lifestyle is a little rough on my teeth and gums. They were very understanding and extremely nice. Right off the bat Ashley was very comforting.  There was no judgement given like most dentist do.  Dr Jade was so nice as well.  I can’t tell you how happy I was when I left in regards to the fact that I’ve finally found a really great dentist practice.  It also seemed a little more adult and not a bunch of kids books and toys every where in the waiting room.  Very excited to start my work with these ladies and definitely feel like I’m in good hands!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Cendrowski
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time going to a different dentist than my family one and I had no idea going to the dentist could be such a positive experience. The technology is impressive and the quality of service is remarkable. I was clenching my jaw and need a bite guard. One employee stayed late to ensure I could get it sale day! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: matthew click
user_reviews_extended.Description:
LOVE LOVE LOVE ENAMEL DENTISTRY AT SALTILLO!!! everyone is so kind and helpful! i’ve never had a bad experience and if im ever unsure or confused with anything there’s always someone who can help me!! i’m so grateful for my dental providers <3

to be a little more specific:

dr. quintana is truly incredible. i have never had a provider make me feel so seen, heard, and genuinely cared for. from the moment i walk through the door, it’s clear how much respect and compassion she has for her patients. she truly wants the best for us and consistently goes above and beyond to ensure we receive the absolute best care possible. the joy and sense of relief i feel when she walks into the room is unmatched. i am endlessly grateful to be in her care and am so lucky to not only call her my provider, but also my friend.

i also want to give a HUGE shoutout to my besties wendy, amy, and the rest of the amazing staff who make every single visit so special. they truly make me feel like i’m family and have me laughing every time I’m there. there is no shortage of kindness in this office; only genuine love and care. the sense of community is unmistakable, and there is truly no place like it. there’s nowhere else I’d rather call my home. 🫶🏼🫶🏼🫶🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adelaine Orpin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Since I was a child, I’ve been incredibly self-conscious about the white spots I have on my two front teeth. Dr. Quintana is absolutely fabulous and has twice done noninvasive corrective Icon to both of my front teeth in roughly an hour with results that last nearly 2 years (for me personally). I could not be happier with the results. She’s the only person I would trust for this!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Dr. Jane Quintana and her team did a great job at thoroughly explaining everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mavis Sandoval
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been a long term patient with Enamel and am never disappointed with the outstanding service they provide. I recommend them to all my friends and family, they go above and beyond!

user_reviews_extended.Name: H D
user_reviews_extended.Description: I actually get excited to go to the dentist now! Every time I walk in, it feels like visiting friends because everyone is super friendly. From the start, it was clear how much this office cares about patients' needs and dental fears. They go above and beyond to make you comfortable, offering things like weighted blankets, Netflix during appointments, and constant verbal reassurance. Dr. Quintana recently did some cosmetic work on my smile, and I can't stop raving about how great it looks! Her passion for dental care and dedication to her patients are truly evident.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassidy Wen
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is by far my favorite dentist office I have ever been to! They have very kind staff there, I have never had a bad experience. They also don’t leave you waiting for an exuberant amount of time like other dentist offices I have been to. They make it easy to make an appointment online and keep you very informed. They are also very accommodating and considerate while you’re at your appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amal S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was very disappointed with the service I received during my first visit to this place. When I booked my first appointment, I specifically requested a routine cleaning. However, during my visit, the dentist and hygienist repeatedly pushed for deeper dental cleanings and spent a significant amount of time trying to upsell me on the deep cleaning and extra services (laser cleaning and cavity prevention)
