When I declined these services, I was told they couldn’t proceed with any cleaning at all that day since the dentist could “loose” her license for not doing the “right” cleaning. After spending TWO HOURS hours in the office, I left feeling frustrated and disappointed, as they made it clear that they would only continue if I agreed to schedule a deep and more expensive ($700) cleaning.

Their whole demeanor changed once I refused the higher cost procedure. On top of that, the experience was disorganized—my check-in was done under the wrong patient, the TVs in the room didn’t work, and I was left waiting for long periods without any updates.

Horrible service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keela J
user_reviews_extended.Description: LOVE IT HERE! The staff is extremely nice and very pleasant to speak to, the hygienist, the dentist and every single person I met introduced themselves and told me what they were doing before each step of my cleaning. Everyone was so nice and welcoming it’s always such a pleasure to visit. They always ask about my day, give great suggestions for oral care  and overall just a really great office. Everyone is always very clean and tidy when I visit. It’s truly a wonderful experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny Martinello
user_reviews_extended.Description: Place was very welcoming and friendly. Everyone made sure to keep me informed about the price points and procedures as we went along. I’d recommend this place and their staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: I p
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Quintana at Enamel Dentistry Saltillo is the best dentist I have ever had and I’ve moved a lot the past several years. She is very friendly and approachable. She presents her treatment plans in depth with you. I had a bad experience at a dental practice in Dallas prior to moving to Austin in April 2023, they tried to tell me I needed several hundred dollars of unnecessary dental work. Dr. Quintana respects her patients and does not push unnecessary treatments which I appreciate it. Dr. Quintana and her team have a great dynamic and can tell they have a great working relationship in her practice because she is that amazing! Her dental assistants and hygienists are all super friendly and knowledgeable as-well.

On a side note: on one of my visits my hygienist had to leave due to a personal emergency, instead of rescheduling me, Dr. Quintana did my cleaning herself and was very thorough. That is a class act you don’t see too often.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Morales
user_reviews_extended.Description: It takes a lot to say that i’ve never felt ANY anxiety coming to this dentist’s office! The staff is so friendly and helpful, everyone is always on time and respectful of my time, and Dr. Quintana is so knowledgeable and sweet! She takes her time with each patient to make sure all concerns are addressed and everything is properly checked. Everyone that works here is amazing and patient and will go in detail when answering all my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Merlin Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Quintana and staff are all really execptioal!  I've had urgent dental issues, they've been super quick to respond and orchestrate an action plan. I'm always given options and feel that the guidance from the doctor and the staff has been always spot on. I've been super happy with all the work that I've had done from a simple cleaning to an extraction. Dr. Quintana and staff are top-notch professionals and will be my only "go to" office in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bo French
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have had nothing but positive experiences and things to say about the Enamel Team! I always refer my friends and anyone who needs a great dentist. They always go above and beyond to ensure each patient has as positive of an experience as possible, while fixing any and all concerns/issues ect.

I am so grateful for all the incredible help I've received, and can't recommend them enough for anyone and everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Graubard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist in town! Had been looking for a dentist that took Delta Dental and Im so glad I went to see Dr. Quintana. She is very sweet and does an amazing job. My experience in Enamel Dentistry Saltillo has been exceptional. All the employees treat you with a lot of care and make sure your experience is as comfortable as posible. They have a very holistic approach which I appreciate. Parking is validated and right in across the street of the office so it’s super easy to access.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anandhi Mani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lovely folks and everyone is so helpful and friendly. Excellent cleaning and care. Can’t recommend enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Watson
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment you walk in the door everyone working here puts you at ease. The front desk staff and hygienists are always friendly, and Dr. Q is a great dentist. My least favorite part of the dentist is the numbing shots and I couldn’t even feel when Dr. Q gave them to me, which amazes me. I had a crown placed and the entire process went smoothly from temporary to permanent crown. As a bonus, the office offers Netflix, a weighted blanket or regular blanket and a stress ball if you’re anxious. I highly recommend this location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven Fullen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love love love this office and the staff. Everyone is so sweet. The place is super clean and modern. I had to have some work done and it was as comfortable as it could’ve been. They gave me a weighted blanket and I watched The Crown (go figure) on Netflix on a TV hung on the ceiling. 10/10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Laguna
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first visit with Enamel Dentistry @ Saltillo location and it was nothing short of amazing! I moved here from Houston and had the best dentist there, but this place exceeded my expectations. The customer service was amazing! Super sweet and courteous and made me feel so comfortable. They educated me on a lot of things and also have TV’s in the ceilings so you can watch TV while you lay down?? Like what?! Now that’s something I would go back for lol.They also have high tech machines if that’s something you care about. Found my new permanent dentistry 🥰.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Shaffer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with Enamel. Very efficient with their time. First time in and they got all of my X-rays, exams, cleaning and even took care of sealing a chipped tooth. Totally expected to have to come back to get that taken care of. Really couldn’t recommend them enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elaine Juch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great customer service, preventative care, and knowledgeable staff. Turns out my bite is off which is causing gum recession but they caught it early! There are TVs on the ceiling which I didn’t realize how much of a great addition that is- you don’t mind being in the chair watching Netflix. Overall pleasant experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Klein
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every time I go to Enamel, I have a positive experience. They are incredibly patient, knowledgeable, and make sure patients are as comfortable as possible. They’ve worked with me to make sure I can get the best care regardless of insurance issues, travel, etc. I want to highlight Dr. Quintana in particular who has really made the time and effort to make sure all my questions are answered and concerns resolved. I would recommend to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: magdalena bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve had a fine experience with the dental team (dental procedures and cleaning — with the exception of one dental hygienist), but, overall, the experience is just brought down by their billing system, which is not up to par. Charges were murky and getting a reimbursement for overcharges was nearly impossible (which happened more than once). They even charged me for a cleaning that never happened, and it took me over 3 weeks to get them to acknowledge it and give me a refund.
I think there are other dentists out there with a better overall service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Compton Bruton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a really great experience here. The staff were lovely, friendly and very helpful, They made me feel comfortable and took care of me so I couldn’t ask for anything anymore.

If you see this while looking for a dentist, just go ahead and book the appointment

user_reviews_extended.Name: Avery E Dyson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience with any dentist I’ve ever had here!! Everyone here is so so sweet and personable and you can really tell that they care about making their clients feel comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: My overall rating of this office is 5 out of 5. I don’t usually give reviews but this one I had too. I haven’t been to a dentist in years, except one last year when I was having pain, but it wasn’t as a good visit as this one was. I knew when I walked in, vibe was chill. Didn’t feel so judged. They pulled me back, introduced me to their office (most people don’t do that, even with my appearance). They walked me through all the things they were doing, so it just didn’t seem like I was not welcomed. Once the doctor stepped, she walked me through everything I needed, and surprised it wasnt a lot (since my wife is always on me about my oral care). The doctor explained everything well. She even helped me understand what I needed, why I needed to do it. I trusted more of the GREAT reviews over the bad. When I scheduled the appointment. And those are what I look at before doing anything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: michael dorazio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Quintana has assembled a great team here. Due to a couple bad experiences and losing insurance for a while, I hadn't gone to a dentist in 10 years. As you can imagine, I had a lot of tooth issues as a result. Two reasonably priced visits later, my teeth look amazing. All the staff members have been friendly, communicative, empathetic, and just plain good at their jobs. The rooms use plenty of newer tech to make things efficient (important to me), and the ceiling TVs are a nice touch. Definitely recommended if you're looking for a local dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Siavash
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience, very good and clear explanation of each steps and all the options i had to continue having a better experience. Very nice and clean space and super helpful dentist and lovely staff! Thanks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriela Jaimes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this location! They’re so caring and welcoming. Very thorough and informative. I look forward to my cleanings all the time :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniela Serpa Montes de Oca
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an incredible experience at Enamel Dentistry Saltillo. I set up an appointment online as a new patient and came in the next day. My experience was 10/10. The staff is so nice and friendly, the office is so neat and has great vibes. You can even watch tv while in your room - laying down or sitting up. One of the coolest set ups I’ve seen. The staff were so knowledgeable and explained every step and thing they were doing, took their time to explain what each thing was for and answered all my questions. Dr. Jane Quintana was wonderful. She took great care of me and made me feel so comfortable. Im relatively new to Austin and have been searching for a place that made me feel taken care of. I definitely recommend Enamel to anyone in Austin! 10/10 experience. Thanks so much to the team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: rebecca
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tried to scare me into spending $1300+ on unnecessary medical treatment. Not only that but they charge almost double what private dentists charge for normal services like exams and x-rays.  I went to this place for the first time this week and they told me I needed a deep cleaning and other procedures that would’ve taken 2 visits and $1300+ (after insurance!) or else I would be risking bone loss and further damage to my teeth and gums. This was extremely surprising to me since my last cleaning was less than a year ago but I almost went through with the treatment anyway since I’m not a doctor and I thought I should just trust them when they told me it was necessary for my health. But I decided to get a second opinion from my usual dentist and thank god I did because they told me my teeth were completely fine, and that all I needed was a regular cleaning. They told me the treatments Enamel were trying to persuade me were necessary are only needed when there is a diagnosis of gum disease, which I did not receive. I only went to Enamel because I moved recently and it’s closer to my house but it’s safe to say I will never be returning to this place and will stick to my usual dentist from now on. I truly believe they prey on your vulnerability and ignorance of dental health in order to scam you into costly and unnecessary treatments. I’m upset that I wasted my time and money here only to be taken advantage of, but also grateful I got a second opinion since it could’ve been much worse if I had gone through with the “necessary” treatments they tried to give me. Ultimately I could not recommend this place any less, unless you are okay with throwing away hundreds/thousands of dollars on unnecessary treatments, and paying double for routine procedures such as x-rays and exams. Save your money and avoid commercial dentists office such as this one, they are exploitative and untrustworthy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailey Dow
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is amazing! Best dentist I have ever been to. This is the most thorough dental exam and cleaning I have had. So high tech also! They walk you through everything they are doing and give you the full rundown of what they see. They give you their recommendations but don’t pressure you into buying anything/getting anything done - because it is ultimately our own decision! The people in the office are so friendly and show that they care. So glad I found this place! If you’re looking for a new dentist, look no further - come here!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Regan Sawyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist. Super modern. They are very kind and make you feel comfortable. It's quite a luxurious experience with the TV, sunglasses, and they will give you a stress ball or weighted blanket if you'd like.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Ferrell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enamel Dentistry is the best. They make the experience to book the appointment and get checked in so easy and seamless. The practice has a great vibe, friendly staff, and does fabulous work. They go above and beyond with the little touches, and they make me look forward to going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheyane Reisner
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist I’ve been to in Austin. They were able to help with my teeth sensitivity and give me warnings and suggestions for the problem areas without jumping straight to fillings. I’d highly recommend going here! Plus it’s very cozy and calming for a dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robin Baessler
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a great office. They are very kind and helpful. The doctors and staff make a nerve wracking experience a lot more soothing. They accommodate my wish for hand scaling. Scheduling is extremely easy. I highly recommend this dental office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriela De Freitas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist visit ever! 20/10 experience! They make you feel super comfortable and the staff is super friendly. I had Dr. Quintana and she did an excellent job explaining everything. Ally did my cleaning, and she did an amazing job. Literally the best cleaning I have ever had! Also the office looks amazing and super modern! Looking forward to my next appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Jagdeo
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dentist experience ever! Natalie and Savannah were so friendly and welcoming. Victor & Bryan we’re great assistants and were able to scan me for cavities in only 3 minutes! Ally, the hygienist was very thorough and informative also extremely gentle for her cleaning. Dr Smalls was so compassionate and took time to explain my treatment and educate me. I will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana McGarrahan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enamel Dentistry & their whole team/staff are very nice and welcoming! Dr. Quintana is the best! My kids & I love it and recommend them! 🙏🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathaniel Price
user_reviews_extended.Description:
May 13, 2022:
Amazing first experience. I felt very taken care of, from the front desk staff, to the DA (Victor) , to the DH (Ali), to the Dr (Dr. C), and even up until I checked out.

End-to-end - a very pleasant experience. I really dug the vibe at this location and appreciated how friendly, informative, and helpful everyone was! I look forward to my next appointment(s).

Sep 14, 2022:
Thanks to the whole team at Enamel Saltillo for another great cleaning experience. Super smooth appointment.

As expected based on my previous visit, everyone was extremely welcoming, friendly, and engaging. I enjoy the light-hearted conversations I have with the staff and also appreciate their professionalism and focus on my care - reminding me to wear my night guard and floss!

Jan 11, 2023:
Another wonderful cleaning and exam experience! Abby and Dr. Q were super friendly and their front desk staff, as usual, were welcoming and accommodating. Thanks again team!

May 11, 2023:

Yet again, another great experience. Abby and Dr. Q were great as usual!

May 16, 2023:

I went in for a Boost Whitening service. The process was straightforward. Bryan took care of me and did a very good job of explaining the process, side effects, and aftercare considerations.

My appointment was about 1.5 hours long and covered prep, applying a gum barrier, and applying two 20m sessions of whitening gel. I simply sat back, watched some TV, while the gel did its thing.

Regarding sensitivity, during the first session, no sensitivity at all. During the second session, about half way through, I started to feel the “zingers”.

On the trip home, I felt more but this seemed to taper off over the next 5-6 hours. At the time of this writing, approximately 12 hours later, I’m not noticing any intense zingers, but I do get milder ones at a reduced frequency and have a dull achy feeling. It’s all normal and I hope it’ll pass in the next couple days!

Overall, great experience. I was told what to expect which helped me prepare.

Sep 5, 2024:
A great experience yet again!

May 6, 2025:
Yet another great experience getting a cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ken Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team is always so nice and hospitable.  They remember each of their patient's and refer to us by our names when we arrive.  I love Dr. Quintana, she is super chill and professional.  Never have any pain with Dr. Quintana, she is an awesome Dentist.  I had a great experience with Dr. Brazil too! He was amazing! I felt super safe and he made me feel relaxed before my procedure.  He is super relatable, chill but professional and knowledgable. Don't think I'll see any other oral surgeon but him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Paylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: A friend in the dental industry recommended Enamel Dentistry Saltillo. It turned out to be a great recommendation. The staff is friendly, the experience is quick and pleasant, and the office uses all of the latest in dental technologies. Very deserving 5-stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gerg Freenstein
user_reviews_extended.Description: Be careful of their discount for first time patients. I thought I was getting a full treatment, only to find out that the actual cleaning would be a lot more, only after I completed the consultation. I told them I thought the service was confusing and they refused to work with me. The dentistry is fine but I left feeling bad about their business practices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raul E
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Enamel Dentistry Saltillo (East Austin). Great staff! Dr.Q is awesome! I've been blessed to find them. They truly care. You won't be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaime Balcaceres
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience today. I want to shout out Rebecca for putting me on F1 Netflix. Ally for an amazing cleaning. Dr.Quintana was such a sweet person. I was the last patient of the day, we even got a chance to make Tik Tok video which Wendy recorded for me. I recommend this dental office 10 out of 10 ⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Satterfield
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this dentist. Very vibrant and welcoming environment. The staff knows how to turn your day around with their kindness. I also leave with my teeth feeling very clean.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooklyn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Won’t be going anywhere else for my dental work! Dr. Q and Chris made my experience very comfortable. These two set the tone for my crown, and fillings appointment today, and made sure I was comfortable and happy with the work. The environment at this location is upbeat, clean and friendly. Highly recommend getting your dental work done with this great team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Castro
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Awesome office with amazing people!
Natalie and Savannah at the front desk were phenomenal, couldn’t have been a quicker and easier procedure.

Hygienist Ally, was excellent with the cleaning process and it was a rather faster process than I thought it would be. She made it a smooth sailing while keeping everything safe.

Dr. Quintana was very thoughtful and explained everything to me thoroughly, would most definitely recommend her to anyone I know.

The spot is amazing, you enjoy watching Netflix while they do what they gotta do, I think I’ll most definitely keep coming back, for my benefit and the environment. :D.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan D Lira
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist experience ever! Everyone was attentive, caring and transparent about my oral health. I haven’t been to the dentist in a bit, but the experience today was amazing. Ashley, Wendy and Dr. Quintana are awesome and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cole Tucker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Incredible dentist. Friendly, fair pricing, at a good location with plenty of parking, good at explaining everything, takes care of things fast. Already recommended this place to friends and family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miranda Ailleen
user_reviews_extended.Description: From my daughter’s point of view: She loved it there. She made everyone laugh. She said she really liked the TV on the ceiling, because she got to watch her favorite show, and how her new friend Ashleigh (hygienist), she helped cleaned her teeth. The staff is really great with my sassy kiddo. 😂

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaime Barraza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Hello - I was apparently the first patient seen at this dentist's office haha -

When I found that out I was a little bit worried, but after I walked in and saw how friendly everyone was it was actually a pretty cool experience!

I saw a flyer in my mailbox and it had a really good deal for a cleaning and whitening. I hadn't seen a dentist since before COVID, so I decided to take advantage of the offer. Dr. Gulati and the hygienist (I feel terrible for forgetting his name, he was so nice!) were nothing but kind to me. They walked me through each procedure we were doing, and made the cleaning/whitening pain free. I was able to watch a few episodes of the office while here, their TV set up makes the time fly by.

Before any of the procedures happened, the billing manager sat down with me to make sure I knew what the end cost would be for the day. I really appreciated this, because sometimes with dental it is hard to know what you're going to end up agreeing to/walking out paying. The costs that I agreed to and the final cost at check out matched, so no complaints there. Also, at no point did any one try to mention "Oh there's a cavity, oh you should add this procedure" etc, that is another thing that was great about this place, they seemed up front/honest - even complimenting how I take care of my teeth/how my prior invisalign has worked out.

I will definitely be coming back - I live close to the area, and had a great first experience here

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mimi Downen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Well I never knew going to the dentist could be fun! This office is state of the art! The exam they gave me was super thorough with imaging that I had never had done before! The rooms are super comfy- and they have awesome TVs to watch whatever you want while you are getting your treatment (which was an awesome distraction) for me since I was a little nervous! Dr. Gulati and his technicians were above average. I am so happy with my treatment and the customer service I received. I would highly recommend them! The location is awesome too and right next to cool shops and super convenient. Definitely not your average dentist office! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Son Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently moved to Austin and had a great experience with this dentist. Dr. Quintana and her staff were great and friendly. The dental hygienist all worked well and efficient. Dr. Quintana is very gentle and steady with orthodontic work. Highly recommend this dentist and location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Crystal De La Rosa
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was THE BEST Dentist visit I’ve ever experienced. The staff was so understanding and very thorough with their explanations. They really worked together as a team to offer me the best home care tips, explained each X-ray and 3D picture in detail, and presented my plan of care that adhered to my schedule. Not only did they offer great customer service, but the place looks so nice, they have Wine, beer, sparkling water, a TV on the ceiling for you to watch Netflix while you’re in the chair, a free pair of sunglasses and AWESOME music playing the entire time! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Addie Winford
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience with Enamel Dentistry! Every single person I interacted with was kind, attentive, friendly, knowledgeable, and went above and beyond to help me. Dr. Smalls went out of her way to make sure I had the knowledge to make informed decisions about my health and was so patient with answering all my questions. I felt completely at ease with her during all stages of my visit (which included getting some fillings). I highly recommend this dentist office and greatly appreciate the work these people are doing to make a sometimes scary place more comfortable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Lam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Right off the bat I want to say that the staff were amazing!  I was able to get an appointment (new patient) in a day. When I went in for my appointment I was quickly taken in and they ran basic scans on me and got me into their system. After a few scans the dentist came and explained to me everything about my dental health, while showing me a scan of my teeth (that was a new experience). He was very engaging and answered any questions I had. I also had my teeth cleaning done and the staff again as usual were very polite and helpful. It was a quick procedure and I really appreciated it. I was in and out in under 90 mins. I’ll be going in for further procedures. I 100% recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy Whisney
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is the best!

Originally went in because a crown fell off. Turns out it needed to be replaced - and they did the the same day! Took maybe four days to get the actual crown back, but when I went in to get the real one - 20 minutes in and out.

The staff was super accommodating to my overall dentistry nerves. Got scheduled for a cleaning after the crown was placed, went back and got some cavities filled and it was legitimately painless.

I consider myself a seasoned vet when it comes to cavities WHICH I'm not proud of, but I've had some awful dentistry experiences because of them. Enamel Dentistry is by far the best dentist I've ever been to.

The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful, professional, and most importantly - really good at their jobs.

Absolutely, 100% go here. You will not be dissapointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Moten
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great first visit today. The staff were friendly, gave a tour of the office which I appreciated. Dr Smalls and her team were very thorough and detail oriented. They explained all of my dental options and assisted me in making the best decision. Never have I looked forward to future dentist visits!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: B Feve
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the minute you walk in the door the staff and space are welcoming. Coffee and other drinks are offered and the office is super comfortable and modern. Your choice of TVs in front and above you to watch while you get your teeth worked on. From the reception, To the technician and Dr. Ashwin they were all super nice and knowledgeable. The whole experience was great from start to finish. I definitely found my new dentist office where I will frequent now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Elsner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love enamel dentistry! They’re always willing to work with my schedule and having so many convenient locations made it easier when I moved to find one near me. They also have Netflix available for every room in front of the chair and on the ceiling so the exam goes by so fast!

user_reviews_extended.Name: cameron harris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to Enamel Dentistry Saltillo for the past 6 months and I have to say they are an excellent team and provide great service. I was in search of a new Dentist read reviews and found Enamel Dentistry through word of mouth.

The first thing I needed to have done was to get a cleaning which had been about 1 year since my last and also needed to get 4 wisdom teeth pulled so I could get Invisalign. I had the wisdom teeth surgery done with no complications and have now been on my Invisalign journey through Enamel Dentistry for the past 3 months and I have seen excellent results this far! I highly recommend you give this team a try! They are fun, create a very friendly environment, very welcoming and transparent about work you need done. They are also efficient and very knowledgeable which is great especially when they are handling your oral needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shayne Sakowitz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was so anxious about coming to the dentist! Everyone here makes me feel welcome, comfortable, and eases all my worries. Could not recommend this place highly enough - especially if you’re queer!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna King
user_reviews_extended.Description: The sweetest group! Highly recommend if you are looking for a new dentist. Worked with me on pricing and answers all of my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Wasenius
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t emphasize enough how much I appreciate the work EDS has done for me! I was needing a new dentist in Austin and since day one, the whole staff has been friendly, communicative, knowledgeable and understanding at every turn. I feel confident in my decision making and ongoing dental maintenance because of their approach. I highly recommend them to everyone I can!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert McDonald
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jade Wylie was amazing. Definitely would recommend her if you hate shots in the mouth cause whatever magic she was able to perform I couldn’t even feel it on the initial shot so yeah, definitely great doctor.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paula Diaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have to start off with the fact that im deeply afraid of dentists. I have never had a positive experience. This is until Enamel Dentistry Saltillo. From the front office to the assistants and to Dr.Jane - everyone was amazing! Made me feel calm and were constantly asking if i felt comfortable or what they could do to make it so. Closed eyes recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mona Acosta
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Outstanding service! It was my first time there and they made me feel so welcomed.
The entire staff was so kind and very thorough in explaining every little detail. They have incredible state-of-the-art equipment, so nothing gets overlooked. So happy to have found a Dentist that i will forever keep, and look forward to keeping up with having regular  check ups. Oh! And a cool set up with happy hour drinks, both alcoholic and non- alcoholic. And I can't forget to mention the music...SO much fun.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kennedy J
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Smalls is amazing! She is so patient and very understanding to her patients needs. I am very nervous of the dentist and have not been in 3 years until today. She kept telling me what was next & asking me if I was okay during the whole appointment. She is very easy going & is not only an outstanding doctor but an amazing person.

I cannot forget Brian! He is the dental assistant and took care of all my needs. He was the first person I talked to about my anxiety at the dentist. He continued to reassure me that all would be well and also took the time to explain everything to ensure my nerves would be low. He talked to me as a person & not just a patient. Asking about myself & he is truly wonderful.

I have nothing but great things to say & would recommend this office to anyone & everyone. Brian & Dr. Smalls showed seamless teamwork & can’t wait to come back for my next appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a long-time patient at Enamel Dentistry Saltillo, but my recent experience left me deeply disappointed.

During my cleaning, a tool was accidentally hit against my teeth, resulting in a chip. Instead of taking responsibility, they framed the repair as a “courtesy” but still billed my insurance. They also stated I was "in the right place at the right time" rather than accepting responsibility. When I questioned this, I was told it was necessary so future providers could see my dental history—something that could easily be shared through medical records.

Additionally, this damage rendered my night guard unusable. Rather than replacing it, they attempted to grind down both my tooth and the night guard for nearly an half hour before I finally requested a replacement.

To make matters worse, they presented the new retainer as being offered at a substantial discount, but in reality, they were only replacing the top portion—making the “discount” just the full price of half a set. On top of that, the material used was a lower-quality in-house version instead of the Guardian material I originally had. They refused to replace the retainer with the equivalent product that I had purchased from them years earlier. They stated they would make it in house, despite taking scans and "sending them off" without my signature.

When I asked for a fair resolution, they simply told me to go elsewhere. This experience made me feel unheard and undervalued as a patient. I can no longer recommend this practice. Below are direct communications.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentistry in Austin, TX! I was referred by my friend when I first moved to Austin and it has been the best experience every time I go! They are so nice, it’s super clean, and super meticulous! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denis Casey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent dentist practice. Marsha and all the staff were very knowledgeable

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for emergency exam for a toothache. Everyone I talked to was very kind and empathetic! The doctor was very transparent, but still made me feel super comfortable and heard. After so previous bad experiences with other dentists, I went in very anxious and scared. Walked out comforted and feeling taken care of. Will definitely be coming back for much needed dental care.☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ram Karamchandani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really love this dentist office! The office - updated tech with multiple tv's per room showing details of my chart as well as if I want to watch something to be entertained while in the chair. The people - the staff always has a smile on their face and willing to answer any questions I may have and go above and beyond for their customers. Dr. C - always a great experience with him when I need to schedule time with him. He goes out of his way to make sure I have the best experience when I come in. Would 100% recommend this dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Collyn Cody
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am terrrrrrified of the dentist and I’m also 8 months pregnant. From the front desk, to dental assistant, to dentist (Dr. Quintana), and patient care plan everyone is beyond nice, caring and empathetic. It’s the kind of place that doesn’t make you dread the appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Quintana and her team are always very lovely and professional. Communicative at each step of the visit. Thanks for another great visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly A
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATE: I went in today for a filing and again, every single person you interact with is a gem! They have a great office culture, you can tell by how much they care! Dr. C is a magician, I was in and out so quickly!  I can’t rave enough about how genuine, kind, and professional every one is!

————-

This office is AMAZING. Every single
Person and I mean EVERY PERSON is sincere, accommodating, and so friendly! They go over and beyond to make you comfortable. I was nervous about a dental procedure -they talked me through the entire process and made sure I was entirely comfortable before they began. They offered me a blanket, headphones, and turned on Netflix!  During the procedure I was often asked about my comfort, given breaks as often as I needed and had a few laughs in between. The entire group is kind and truly care about patient experience! You can tell by the amenities they offer, like beer, wine, and awesome music, but more so through their actions. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailee Jennings
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful service and clean office! Front desk staff were very helpful and informative helping me set up appointments, figure out insurance stuff, and get all checked in! Dr. Gulati and Brian were awesome and took the time to ask questions and address my concerns throughout my exam/cleaning. They also helped me plan for my wisdom teeth removal, which I will be going back to the office for! So happy I chose Enamel Dentistry :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Best Dental Care!   Amazingly thorough and very attentive and conscientious of their patients.   Ithey made my apprehension and nervousness disappear.   In an emergency, they made my experience terrific and I look forward to my visits!!  Doesn’t matter the driving distance because the environment there makes you want to return!!   My Dr  dentist is amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Corsbie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hi, I gave Dr. Quintana the highest rating available.  She treated me with amazing aplomb, respect, and helped me have some time to make some important decisions about a tooth of mine that I'd rather not part with. She carefully explained to me what was going on with my tooth and what my options were for treatment. Her compassion, courtesy thorough medical knowledge, support staff, and effective use of animation and technology helped me understand what was causing my pain, what she can do to help me, and what my options are to meet this serious medical need, and keep my tooth, and lose the pain...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dane Wilkins (Dane The Geographer)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have had a great first visit to this dentist's practice, the staff is very friendly and knowledgeable about their craft. I chose to schedule other visits and will update accordingly!

Update:
I tried their whitening and went for the double dose. It was one of the most painful experiences I’ve ever had, but they did warn me and the staff is great. I’d recommend crest 3D whitening strips and use Enamel for everything else other than whitening!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alaina Mattix
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don’t usually leave reviews, I went in today for a cleaning and I was so impressed! This is by far the BEST experience I’ve ever had at a dentist’s office. You feel right at home, they play awesome music, and it’s decorated with such a fun vibe. Plus I was able to watch Netflix in the chair. Savannah at the front desk is so welcoming and kind and offered complimentary wine, beer, or seltzer (talk about cool). Brian is an amazing assistant and makes you feel at ease. Dr. Gulati is so friendly, knowledgeable, and made sure I was comfortable during the cleaning.
If you are looking for a new dentist in Austin, this is 100% the place to go. All of the staff is top tier!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherree Simonson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Enamel Dentistry for a couple years and everyone has been so fantastic! Super communicative, great vibes , and I leave with my teeth feeling and looking the best! Everyone at the Saltillo location has been a gem to work with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Wyrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was very friendly and went out of their way to make me feel comfortable.  They are also very open with everything.  They not only discussed what treatments they were recommending but they showed me the problem spots, walked me through different options, gave me pricing of each...all without being asked or questioned.  I felt like they cared.  I have never had a dentist explain things they way they did.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Lerma
user_reviews_extended.Description: I (like many) put off seeing the dentist during COVID so it had been a minute between cleanings, xrays etc. Dr. Quintana was terrific, understood my anxiety and was thoughtful and thorough. The facility is immaculate, and they will even stream netflix for you to help keep you distracted. My daughter comes here also.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blaze Simmons
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great experience at the dentist!  Bring your kids!
The staff was professional and steadfast, not to mention down to earth too!
They have you in and out of there rather quickly and make sure you are copiously informed about the status of your teeth before AND after the cleaning is done, They even have a tv screen on the ceiling to keep you occupied throughout the procedure.

This incorporated with the artistically inclined music choices and the complimentary beverages, enamel dentistry is sure to change the way you view an experience to the dentists office! Thanks again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonya Medel
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time there today. I am a person who needs to see an overview of all costs prior to committing to any procedure, I need to plan out dates, times, financials, etc. for anything and they understood all of that. Very respectful, very communicative, very transparent and respected what I wished to view prior to committing to any procedure or advanced cleaning. The hygienists walked me through what they were looking at in order to create a treatment plan (the transparency) and they told me why they placed the treatment plan the way they did (the communication to help me understand) and when I declined treatment up front, they were very very respectful, did not try to push me into anything and gave me my space to look things over. They offered to purchase some items in house but also gave me the option to buy over counter at Walmart or heb! They also brought up techniques in front of me on google and helped guide me on what is best practice at home while I decide if I would like to proceed with my treatment plan or not. Very impressed to say the least! Made my next appointment so I can start the treatment plan that was created for me. Highly recommend and have already sent their site to my friends who just moved to town and is seeking a new dentist. I also really love the convenience around it too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: liz Taylor-White
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love Dr Quintana & staff;  Brian, Gina (front desk) formerly Natalie who was awesome & others whose names escape me.
Dr Q is respectful, kind and dedicated. She is thorough and painstaking in her ability to provide an excellent finished product. I love that she calls me “dear!”

I’m getting brand new dentures and I can’t wait to see how they will  look and feel because she’s taken many measurements, impressions and a wax try to get them just right. She is even working with pictures from my past to get the right look.  So much more exacting than my last denture adventure!!

The clinic is welcoming and beautiful. Everybody is warm & friendly. So much so that one doesn’t even feel like they’re at the dentist until you’re told “open wide.”

I like that Enamel has it’s own brand & logo. You generously gave me a box full of goodies. I use the water bottle all the time. The cute glass floss bottle and wooden handled toothbrush went to a friend who still have their teeth lol!!!

Another thing that Enamel has going for it is that they work with HAAM, to which I belong. It is because of the generosity of both organizations that I am able to get these new dentures. Otherwise I could not afford them and I am so very appreciative of this great gift.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Abdalla
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely loved my experience at Enamel! It’s always hard to find the right place go to when moving to a new place and I’m glad I went with my gut when doing research. Dr. Smalls is fantastic along with the hygienist who did all my X-rays and teething cleaning. Everyone is informative and friendly, and you just feel so comfortable the second you walk in the door. I will say I’ve always been afraid of the dentist from having horrible experiences as a teenager and I will say the staff has definitely eased my worries during the appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Temi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely loved my experience here! From making my appointment over the phone to my actual visit, everyone was so kind and welcoming and made sure I was getting what I wanted. Everything was about my comfort and my understanding. I personally appreciated the youthfulness and diversity of the staff! Felt like everyone was a friend. Will be a returning patient as long as I’m in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura PLATAS
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first experience at a dentist office and it was honestly an amazing one at that. The entire staff is so kind and welcoming, they walked me through the entire process and kept me informed at all times. I will absolutely recommend all my family and friends to Enamel Dentistry. Truly a wonderful experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Renz Ambrocio
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire Enamel team and experience far exceeded my expectations! From their friendly welcome; stylish, clean, and covid-conscious space; high-quality technology; complimentary drinks; and their warm hospitality and cool vibe, they live up to the customer service they promise. Every person I had contact with on their team took the time to greet me and get to know me. I usually associate dentist visits with the typical bland and sterile office space. Enamel is a breath of fresh air (no pun intended)! As a new customer, I was impressed and would highly recommend to anyone looking for exceptional care for their dentistry needs. Thanks guys! Looking forward to my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Pownall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I usually hate going to the dentist but they made the experience so pleasurable. They made me feel very comfortable the entire visit and continued to check on me. They offer a variety of drinks including alcoholic beverages, to help calm the nerves. Great music, great environment, and great vibes! I honestly am looking forward to my next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Vaughan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience as always! I've been going to Enamel at Saltillo for 4 years now and it's always top notch. Excellent care and high tech equipment. Also do my whitenings with them along with cleanings and check ups. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morgan Jordan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super nice staff and clean updated office. Everyone I spoke with was very informative and patient. Fun perks like TVs on the ceiling and a nespresso machine!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caleb Cox
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enamel in Saltillo is awesome! I love the ultra-modern style of the office, it was super nice and comforting. The staff were very friendly and informative, and they even gave me a gift since it was my first visit with them. I’m glad I chose them as my dentist in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laine Kay
user_reviews_extended.Description: All the staff and doctors were very nice, helpful and sympathetic. The office was very clean and hip. They also offer a great dental care package

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Saenz
user_reviews_extended.Description: The tech they have is on par with the beautiful decor they have. Chris and Dr. Quintana were very easy going and accomodating. They gave great recommendations for toothblush selections and floss for my sensitive teeth. You can tell they truly care about what they teach. Highly recommend this location for the people and how high tech everything is.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob & Madeline
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had a great experience at Enamel Dentistry at Saltillo! Overall the staff is friendly, accommodating, and helpful. The customer service is top notch and always a quick visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katalin Kiss
user_reviews_extended.Description: It took me 2 years to find my doctor who is the best in Austin. I am so grateful I found you as my Dentist Dr. Jane Quintana Until I am leaving here in Austin you will be always my Doctor. Thank you for providing amazing services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Ngo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really liked this place. Dr. Ashwin was nice and personable. He clearly answered the questions I had and recommended different options for my teeth. The lady at the front was very welcoming, and my tech was great handling my scans and answering questions. My teeth felt nice and clean afterwards. I really liked the 3 TV setup in each room, and the complimentary drinks. I was able to watch football with a beer before getting my teeth cleaned. This is definitely my go to dentist moving forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katy B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had such a wonderful experience! The staff is so welcoming and friendly, and the atmosphere overall is very inviting and swanky. makes you completely forget you're at the dentist!!

Dr. Gulati was very knowledgeable, and gave me lots of advice on how to address any concerns I had without paying top dollar. Not to mention he has such a fun personality!  I highly recommend him and Enamel to anyone in search of a new dentist office, and i'm looking forward to returning in 6 months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alisha Varela
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very great experience for it being my first time. From the moment I walked in to the moment i stepped out the office. Savannah was well very very welcoming and friendly. Victor was amazing, and friendly, loved him. Answered all my questions and concerns, explained my 3D teeth perfectly.  Ale was fantastic, she was the bomb, very helpful and straight forward, also recommend great things to perfect my smile. Dr. Smalls was amazing as well, took the time to explain my treatment and educate me a little on my teeth lol. But very welcoming and was overall amazing 10/10 very clean and organized. My fav place ever, my new Dentist! 🥳

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roxanne V Springman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lovely dental office! Everyone was incredibly sweet and attentive. I went in for a tooth that cracked suddenly, and within the day they had me fully informed about a care plan, a breakdown of costs, and I was out with a temporary crown! Might I add that they were very quick considering the situation and comforting during the intensive procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: O T
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental practice! The dental work has been excellent but in addition to that they have super nice, welcoming staff, and a great office setting as well. After wisdom tooth removal the doctor was texting me to see how I was, I really appreciated the follow up and personal attention! Definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melena Kiriaki
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved my visit with Enamel Dentistry Saltillo!! I genuinely felt so cared for as each hygienist and Dr Quintana were extremely professional and informational. I trust their expertise and look forward to having them as my go to. I would recommend this dentist location if you are looking for one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jiahna Ornelas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely loved my experience at Enamel in Saltillo! Alejandra was my hygienist and was so sweet but also super informative and took pride in my cleaning that I truly haven’t experienced at any other office. Dr. Smalls was also very informative and took the time to inform me of some tips that will help with my TMJ issues. Brian was so patient and even my whitening session with him and Ale was an educational experience. Natalie and Savanah in the front and at check-out always made me feel comfortable and welcome and I’d 100% recommend this office specifically! I can’t wait for my next visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Ward
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is delightful. The office is lovely. The hygienists are kind, informative, thorough, and gentle. My dentist, Dr Deanna Smalls, is marvelous. I not only trust her expertise, but I like her as a person.
A few other nice things: bottled water and sparkling water when you arrive, sunglasses so you don’t get blinded, Netflix if you need it, and a really modern office.
But, the thing I liked most- no up selling for Invisalign or any other procedures. Just friendly, professional, respectful care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria del Mar Arocha Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where do I start.. The office is absolutely beautiful. The staff is very welcoming and nice and the doctor is amazing. You feel very relaxed and the doctor made feel very comfortable and made me laugh a lot! I loved the TV in the ceiling! Also the 3d print of my teeth. Will recomend to everyone I know!!😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Botros Toro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff and work done seemed okay during treatment/visit. Friendly folk. However, the office will try to extract more money of you after the fact. I made it a point to get proper estimates for all treatment before agreeing to anything. A few months later, they reached out harassing me for more money. Scammy practice. Avoid.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Merlin Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Quintana and her team are superb!  We have had a series of items come up over the past years and the doctor and her staff are always quick to respond, have a plan and are courteous!  Definitely our go-to dentsl office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Manoj Samtani
user_reviews_extended.Description: I must say this location is really good!  I’ve been to others and have not had a good customer service experience! I would like to say the two young ladies at the desk were super nice and friendly!  I believe it was Natalie and Hannah I think if not, sorry about that.  The dentist was very nice as well as the hygienist. I will definitely be coming back to this location. Thank you for the great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paola Pina
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The Saltillo location was very clean and organized, which is much appreciated, especially amidst a pandemic! Everyone was very accommodating and kind, I was shocked how attentive they were to my needs. I really appreciated how chill and low-key funny Dr. Gulani is, it's refreshing in a doctor not to feel judged and have a laugh too. The hygienist and dental assistant were very patient in listening to my questions and checking in on me when I was overwhelmed/freaking out during my cleaning, offering breaks when I needed them. My first dental experience as an adult on my own and I am glad I came here. (:
Edit: Also found out not every dentist tells their patient they have gingivitis and I found out today I had it. Glad they told me while I can still save my teeth/gums. Thank you!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samisha Hutchison
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place with an amazing team. My dentist was awesome. She was so gentle. I felt no pain whatsoever. And I loved the story she told me how when she was little her dad use to complain about the dentist and the pain. So she decided to become a dentist and make everyone feel as comfortable as possible and minimal pain. She rocks🥰

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Mancio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist experience I have ever had. Good tunes, authentic and super nice staff, drink selections and Netflix while you get a cleaning??! Not to mention all their equipment makes it feel like dentistry in the future. Overall highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great inviting staff. Staff explained every step of my plan of Care. Bryan was so patient and kind . Ally did a excellent job cleaning my teeth And Dr.Smalls was so nice and attentive to my needs! Will be coming back. Have to make her my permanent dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anais Matelat
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wait times were absolutely ridiculous. I got there 5 minutes early for my appointment for a cavity filling which I had scheduled online. I waited 30 minutes to see the dentist and when I finally got seen I was notified that I was mistakenly schedule for a cleaning instead and the dentist didn't have time for the cavity I really made the appointment for. They told me I needed to come back the next day and since I had time I took the appointment. The next day I waited another 30 minutes to be seen and then in the middle of my appointment I was left waiting another hour in between fillings and cleanings because they had overbooked people that day. All in all my appointment ended up lasting over 3 hours because of how busy the dentist and the dental hygienist were. Very disappointing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Huebner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I’ve been to. Everyone is very friendly and you don’t have to wait long like most dentists. They have helped me fix my gum issues tremendously over the past year. Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: It’s Chelli
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best experience ever when it comes to any destistry work done. Kind, gentle, attentive and very thorough and competent. Can’t recommend it enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Regina Phalange
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys deserve all the stars. They make going to the dentist as pleasant as humanly possible. Before I found Enamel I would go years in between dentist visits because of sheer dread. They’ve got ceiling TVs, they jam awesome tunes that were mixed by a DJ, and even offer drinks while you wait. So far I haven’t indulged since I’ve never waited more than 5 minutes. The staff are SUPER delightful and nonjudgmental. My hygienist makes me feel comfortable and gives me realistic advice for ongoing care without shaming me for things like not flossing daily. The vibe here is to promote mouth care as much as possible with encouragement and enablement - not the usual low key scolding and fear tactics. Recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jay K
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wow, wow, wow! Just got back from my first dental visit since moving to East Austin, this place is AMAZING. Located right next to the new Whole Foods and Target on the East Side.  I’ve never experienced a dental visit like this. Aesthetically, it’s by far the coolest vibe I’ve ever experienced at a dentist’s office. Very modern, cool vibe lighting, all new equipment... even a TV monitor on the ceiling with Netflix access (and more) so I felt even more relaxed while getting some dental work done.

From the moment I walked in, the customer service was great. They offer drinks (coffee, sparkling water, etc) upon entry. Cool,  modern art, the whole place has a chic feeling all around.

Loved my dentist, Dr Gulati. He put me at total ease, he’s a naturally light-hearted, warm guy.

In summary, 10/10 would recommend this place to anybody. This is the future of dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristina Priotto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall I had a good experience here with my annual cleaning. They do try to offer you more cleaning services (laser gum treatment, fluoride, etc.) but I stay away from them because to me it seems unnecessary and ultimately makes your bill go way up instead of what is covered by my dental insurance. I got all 4 of my wisdom teeth removed here, too, by Dr. Cohl R. Brazil. I told him about my trauma getting injections and IV in the past, and although he listened to me, he was very cocky and insisted that he was "better than most people" with IV. After saying this he inserted the IV in a blocked vein on my right arm (as had been done to me by ignorant physicians in the past being the root of my trauma) and ended up having to re-insert in my left arm after much time had passed and the IV hadn't been working. This wouldn't have been a problem if he hadn't been so cocky about it in the first place. Other than that, the assistants to the oral surgeon were very nice (although Dr. Brazil got onto them for not doing enough), and I felt supported by the staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: They’re very efficient and I don’t really particularly like going to the dentist.  They’re state of the art and I would always be getting my teeth cleaned at a place like this.  They even sold me a new tooth brush and explained to me what is happening to my teeth and not keeping me in the dark and just telling me to floss more.  The patient education was on point.  So much efficiency .  The new way of doing dentistry

user_reviews_extended.Name: f F
user_reviews_extended.Description: The receptionist was very kind and attentive. We appreciate the bilingual dental assistant's help with translating. My mom had a good experience with Dr. Gulati. The office is clean and they even offer a variety of drinks in the front. Overall, everyone made us feel at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Omar A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down one of the best visits I have had to the dentist!  What a delight and surprise to find this office.  It is located near 5th street and San Marcos street in the Saltillo Plaza.  The office is brand new and state of the art with a lovely decor and large screen tv's in each room.  Thank you so much Dr. Gulati, Brian and Megan.  I appreciated all of your professionalism and care with the handling of my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cam Haas
user_reviews_extended.Description: This has been by far my favorite dentist office I have ever been to. They have set the bar high and always deliver. Everyone who works in the office is kind, they work efficiently, and seem to enjoy working together. I would highly recommend checking them out if you're looking for a new dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ajay Ramiah
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience at Enamel Saltillo was unlike any experience Ive had going to my dentist! In that the staff and office makes me excited for my next dental visit

Enamel Saltillo has a unique modern design and the amenities offered to patients including Wanderlust Wine, this makes the experience unlike any other dental visit you will go on.

When I arrived for my new patient appointment, Dr Gulati and his team were extremely thorough in analyzing my oral health and answering any questions I had. The cleaning was quick and painless!

Most importantly though it is very clear that the entire Saltillo team is deeply invested in their patients, from their experience in the waiting room through to end of the detail visit!

I highly recommend Dr Gulati and the entire Saltillo team to anyone in the Greater Austin Area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawn Farahzadi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Let me preface my review by sharing that I typically dread going to the dentist and have had  horrible past experiences with dental procedures.

I recently moved to Austin and was on the hunt for a good and honest dentist. One of my colleagues recommended Dr. Gulati. The impression I got from when I first made made my appointment to meeting with Dr. G put all my worries to ease. I was concerned about maintaining/slightly improving my alignment. While my previous dentist suggested a lengthy, costly treatment plan, Dr. G took the time to listen to all my concerns, ask detailed questions on my dental goals and suggested a more feasible, cost effective approach that gave me a similar outcome. He didn’t rush me to make a decision during my first visit but instead gave me all the information I needed to take my time and make an educated decision.

It’s this thinking outside the box and putting the patient first approach that I appreciate about Dr. G and the entire staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gretchen Upton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where to begin...I have never received better customer service in my life. From the moment I walked through the door, I was greeted with such a warm and inviting introduction. I was offered something to drink - such a variety of options! I was provided a tour of the office and I must say, everything from the lighting, the art, and the music made me feel like I was in a professional, reputable and friendly place. Once I was taken back to my exam room, I had not one, but two TVs with Netflix pulled up for my selection of what to watch. I can truly say without a doubt that every single employee who I interacted with had my best interest at heart, was brilliant, answered my questions with patience and a desire to make sure I was well-informed and comfortable, and brought a warm and refreshing sense of humor to the room, which made me feel like I could be myself. Thank you!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keller Barks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enamel Saltillo is the best! They are always very friendly, welcoming, and determined to make my teeth look perfect :) I would highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laurisa Letang
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was amazed at the level of service from beginning to end. The entire staff was friendly and the environment is very relaxed. I for one enjoyed their playlist. I told my hygienist that if I worked there I’d be dancing every single second. I’ll be recommending to everyone. I had Dr. C and he was amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Rayworth
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lovely and knowledgeable staff. Up to date dentistry technology and a comfortable environment. I have only had great experiences and interactions after 4 or so cleanings!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tomas Gustavsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down one of the best dentist experiences I have had. Received a warm welcome from the moment I walked in the door and was offered some refreshing condiments. They did a thorough job with x-rays and 3D scans making sure everything looked okay. I had some cavities that needed filling, so after the anesthetic was injected I could just lay back, relax and watch some Netflix whilst Dr. Gulati did his job. He made sure I was comfortable throughout the whole treatment and asked me multiple times if I could feel anything making sure the anesthetic was working properly. The cleaning was thorough and can't say my teeth have been this clean in a while! Overall the experience was great and couldn't have chosen a better spot, would definitely recommend! Thank you Dr. Gulati!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savanna Carl
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great experience! I hadn’t been to a dentist in about 5 years due to not having dental insurance. I decided to take advantage of enamel dentistry’s new patient special and went in for an exam. Savannah(what a beautiful name) at the front desk was very welcoming and kind. I had my X-rays taken and Dr Gulati came in and reviewed them with me. He was very easy to talk to, it felt like I was speaking with a friend. I returned yesterday to have my cavity filled and it was a quick and painless experience, it was also helpful that I got to watch Netflix on the ceiling the entire time! After the procedure the assistant took a 3D scan for my Invisalign treatment. They offer financing, which helped tremendously since I’m uninsured. I’m very excited to return to start my Invisalign journey, and looking forward to the wine they have on draft in the waiting room.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were friendly and had a very modern facility on my cleaning visit. I remember being upselled a lot and having to decline a lot of unnecessary extras but other than that I enjoyed it.  Transparency is very important in this industry as it's easy to do a lot of unnecessary work.  Some facilities in the industry make it seem like I'm impacting my health by declining unnecessary extras.  As long as they are not pushy with services and transparent I will continue coming back.  I will continually update my review based on future visits and if I feel like they are pushy or not transparent it will be reflected in the rating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jack nxumalo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience ever, I will recommend any one who believes in professionalism to visit this place for dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Windle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very first time at Enamel Dentistry Saltillo and am definitely staying. Everyone was absolutely amazing. And did a great job on my cleaning:) Process was fast and efficient. Highly recommended!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra Caldwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was visiting Austin on vacation and to visit my boyfriend's family. The day I landed I chipped my front tooth. Enamel not only fit me in fast but treated me so well when I arrived. I saw Dr. Deanna Smalls and she was amazing. The work she did to fix my front tooth was incredible. I mentioned to her the reason I needed it fixed -- meeting my boyfriend's family for the first time -- and she even checked in later to see how I was. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fahima Hyder
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow amazing experience! They sit you down and breakdown your treatment plan by priority and really walk you through your teeth issues. Service is fast and friendly and organized. They also have TVs on the wall in front and the ceiling for you to watch Netflix on, unparalleled.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jack
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great place! I made an appointment for the same day and it ended up being the cleanest, most modern dentist office I’ve ever been to. I didn’t use the 3 TVs in my room, but I appreciated the option.

Easy and efficient to visit, so I recommend this dentist to anyone in the area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael O'Leary
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Quintana and the staff were extremely attentive and professional while keeping great energy around the office! 10/10 recommend if you’re looking for a new Dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebekah Hogan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at Enamel! Everyone was friendly, they provided great service, and explained everything well. I went in for a cleaning, exam, and some pain. They provided different treatment plan options but didn’t pressure me or make me feel guilty for how I care for my teeth. I plan to go back regularly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Georgios G.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience at Enamel Dentistry Saltillo yesterday. The staff was friendly, the facility was clean, and the dentist was thorough and professional. Highly recommended for anyone in need of dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Cox
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely amazing service. Friendly staff and they are super quick and responsive via email and text. My tooth broke in half and I was able to get in to see them the very next morning! Great facility and the staff are extremely kind, understanding, and patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sai Uppati
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was a great first visit to this dentist office. They got me in immediately, and the scans/exams were quick and seamless. Dentist was also very friendly. The cleaning was quick and painless. Overall I'd recommend this dentist for a pleasant experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: perla hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental office I’ve ever been to. The staff made me feel welcomed and cared for! Thank you Dr. Quintana for your amazing work!! Will definitely be coming back :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: D'Arcy Snodgrass
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit was awesome! Everyone on staff is super friendly, knowledgeable and helpful and Dr. Gulati is the man. I’ve never had a more in depth dental appointment and appreciated being able to see actual images and scans of my teeth and being walked through exactly what was going on. My teeth suck but this place is the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremiah Dupin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ashwin and team at Enamel Dentistry took extremely good care of me. The Design of the space is refreshingly unique, relaxing and uplifting .  The team working there was present and felt like they actually cared rather than just treating me transactionally.  I love their approach to providing dental services and I will be a lifelong customer as long as I’m here in Austin .  Check this place out, you will be grateful you did

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin E Hiemerr
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service from start to end. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve never felt more comfortable with a dentist!! I really love the team at Enamel. They take great care of me and take away the anxiety that comes with going to a dentist. The TV on the ceiling to watch while you’re having your work done doesn’t hurt either :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reviews
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Keep in mind this is a FOR PROFIT/Commercial dental office.
The vibes are like walking into a car dealership. If this isn’t your cup of tea (the upsells, etc) then don’t go here. I’m an introvert. I just want the job done & to be left alone.
1. You get 3 texts asking you to confirm that you are coming.
2. You get a survey text after the visit.
3. You get a follow up phone call survey after the text.
4. You get a text to set up next apt if applicable.
5. You get a phone call reminder to set up next apt if applicable.
6. Finally you get an email reminder to set up your next apt if applicable.
If you don’t mind the incessant follow ups then this place is for you.
I won’t be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Howard
user_reviews_extended.Description: BEST DENTIST EVER. I can’t express this enough I have never been more taken care of by a staff. The staff is amazing and creates such a safe environment. 15/10 the best dentist in Austin!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Barnaby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Easy same-day scheduling for a tooth emergency! The office was way too noisy, due to the combo of high ceilings, music, conversations, thin walls/cubicles all together. All nice, helpful personnel. Everything was well- explained. I'm scheduled to return next week!

user_reviews_extended.Name: tommie garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in today as a new patient and I can gladly say I will be returning for future appointments. Dr. Gulati and his dental assistant Bryan made my dental anxiety go away with how comfortable they made me feel. Anyone looking for a dentist in the area should definitely stop by this office and give enamel a shot. Great service. 👍🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy Giraldo
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best experience I've ever had a a dentist, hands down. Excellent customer service from everyone in the office, and some really fun amenities for your visit. If you're on the fence, just book your first appointment now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wonderful place! Great dentist! Dr. Quintana!
No waiting around. Really good professional staff. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Cates
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience - hadn't been to the dentist in way too long and felt at home and taken care of. Personable employees, fun atmosphere and already looking forward to my June appointment. 5/5.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LaKesha Stevens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had the best dental visit ever!! Dr Smalls and the staff are friendly and accommodating. They thoroughly explained my treatment and have me all the tools I would need for home use. I would recommend Enamel for sure💕

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carly Ng
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow I cannot rave enough about this place! It was my first appointment since the pandemic so I was really nervous, but it was an amazing experience start to finish (so much that I’m compelled to write my second ever review on Google, lol).
