Right from the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with a warm welcome from the front desk and directed to the assortment of coffee, sparkling / still water, even wine on tap! Since they get all your info before, no need to fill out any paperwork or provide other info, which I appreciated. They play great music (I’m an early 2000’s hiphop fan so, it was right up my alley) and have two screens in your room for Netflix (one in front of you when sitting up, one on the ceiling for when you’re laying down during service!). I waited for maybe 2-3 mins in the waiting room, aka nothing compared to some offices (and this was apparently a busy / understaffed day). It’s a whole VIBE I’m telling you. This was also the most high tech place I’ve been to; the tech took pictures of my teeth with a hand held camera device thing and I was able to play around with a digitized display of my teeth and ask him questions about what I was seeing. He always made sure that he was answering all of my questions, and was so kind! Dr. Smalls is also amazing; so kind, clearly passionate about what she does, and really focuses on educating. I hadn’t been to the dentist since 2019 and there was no shaming, just educating about how I can get my teeth hygiene / regular visits back on track! Her whole team was amazing and super informative, and I feel motivated to do them proud on my next 6 month cleaning. Thank you Dr. Smalls and Team!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Tyler Pelham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here for several years and I appreciate the clean high tech environment along with the customer service I receive. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Damar Christopher
user_reviews_extended.Description: Truly a great experience!  Friendly and fun team of professionals who really seem to like their job and customers.  Dr. Gulati is a warm and knowledgeable dentist, willing to answer questions and describe your treatment.  I’m happy I found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tania Ortega
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enamel Dentistry has such a cool atmosphere as soon as you walk in. Their employees were so welcoming and knowledgeable that I felt super comfortable. They also have tvs on the wall and ceiling of each room so you can have a nice distraction during your visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karla Gowing
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the staff and Dr Quintana at Enamel, they are very thorough and helpful and great at scheduling!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitchell Hendee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great location, new building with drinks and amenities in the front.

Everyone was extremely friendly and welcoming. Multiple TVs to watch Netflix while having your teeth looked at. It’s a modern and well designed dental office.

Dr. Gulati was personable, attentive, and responsive to questions and concerns. He has an extremely upbeat, almost carefree personality (the entire studio screams young and hip) but can immediately shift into knowledgeable and professional advice at a moments notice.

This may be a turn off for folks who don’t really want to be “friends” with their dentist. But in regards to breaking the ice and feeling comfortable with someone drilling holes into your mouth—I was happy with the chair side manners!

In and out with a teeth cleaning within the hour. Felt comfortable and COVID-safe. Can’t wait to revisit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Yu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I feel like a new woman after seeing Dr. Gulati and his team.  This office is truly amazing. I came in for a teeth cleaning and it was by far the best dental experience I’ve ever had. From the x-rays, to impressions, cleaning, and whitening, Dr. Gulati and his team made sure I was comfortable every step of the way and educated me on ways to improve my oral health. Not only was the exam and cleaning amazing, they have a stylish and modern office with a cool open concept design. They have beer and wine on tap, sparkling beverages, TVs in every room with your choice of Netflix, upbeat music, and a fun staff to make you feel like you’re hanging out with your friends. I can’t suggest this office enough. You’ll be glad you Dr. Gulati’s your dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryce Holt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Took me same day when my regular dentist was closed. Broken molar was painful but they had me fixed up with a temporary crown and the ability to eat and drink within a few hours. Compassionate and up front about pricing. Highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hanna Salem
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came in for a whitening and was blown away by this office. Not only is it located in a central and convenient location, but the office itself is beautiful. The artwork on the walls and the friendly staff really make this dental office feel like a comfortable lounge. After checking in for my appointment I was offered Nespresso or sparkling water while the room was being prepped.

My whitening procedure was 20 minutes long but the time flew by! There are three screens in the room (2 directly in front of the chair and 1 on the ceiling) and I was able to chose any Netflix show while I was doing my whitening but even if you're not interested in watching anything, the music in this office is amazing! It was so difficult trying to sit still for 20 minutes because all I wanted to do was dance! My teeth have never been whiter and I feel so much more confident when I smile now.

I seriously could not recommend this office enough. Dr. Gulati and his team really made me feel so special during my visit and I can't wait for my next dental appointment (never thought I would say that haha!)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Cohn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Can't say enough about the whole staff here. They have been so accommodating, helpful and courteous. From booking appointments to when I'm in the chair, it's got to be the top standard for a dentist's office.

Thank you so much Enamel!

Plus they have TVs on the ceiling!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Billy The Rake
user_reviews_extended.Description: We all know that dreaded feeling of going to the dentist to have your teeth cleaned, gagging on the X-ray clip thingy's in your mouth,  the tartar scraping tool that looks like a pirate 's hook, and pure torture of polishing.  Now, 8 years later like the green toilet you bought the technology has changed and it actually flushes.  They have this 3D scan where you from all angles see every chip and cavity filling in you teeth and that gap meat gets caught in to use a tooth pick to punch out.  They advertised  Netflix while these procedures are performed.  I was like;  yeah right the bait & switch...  I thought a lap top streaming Netflix.  Nope, there are 3 sports bar size TV''s!  They give you purple sunglasses which you could wear @ your favorite club.  I reluctantly suggested Breaking Bad thinking that's rated R cable material.  No,  they put it on and I was plunged into the world of Walter White in his tighty whities.  Last part of this Magical Mystery tour was, The Dentist.  She explained the 3D photos scan and didn't tell me I should floss daily.  I brushed my teeth and used mouthwash that morning just so they didn't have to suffer my dry heaved breath.  I can't wait for the next cleaning to watch Better Call Saul!  All @ Enamel... it's not a beauty parlor.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shardae Barnes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every visit has been 5/5. Dr. Quintana and the staff of Enamel Dentistry Saltillo have been nothing but the best during each visit. They make you feel like family from the moment you walk in the door. Thank you all again for what you do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Jiravisitcul
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was my second or third visit to this office since moving to Austin. My prior experiences with Dr. Gulati and this office were more positive. This recent visit was fine, but I felt uncomfortable with how much they were pushing the products sold at the dental office ($65 Sonicare toothbrush, $26 Closys mouthwash, $9 floss, etc.) and later realized they didn't provide the typical complementary toothbrush and sample floss that usually comes with these visits. I also didn't realize that Dr. Gulati was no longer there. My prior check up and cleaning last fall took about 40 minutes, but I was there for closer to 75-80 minutes because of them getting to know me as a "new" patient, doing x rays, and talking about these specific products sold at the office. Would have been better if I had a heads up about the timing expected here.

In addition to promoting their products, they were firmly suggesting other investments that may or may not have been mandatory such as coming for cleanings every 3 months, even though I replied my insurance only covers one visit every 6 months ("Insurance shouldn't dictate your health!"). I felt vulnerable and self conscious with what sounded like harsh critique of my manual toothbrush and store brand anti-bacterial mouthwash. I am going to upgrade my toothbrush, but I told them I would shop around and not make a purchasing decision on the spot.

They suggested a non-urgent procedure that would have cost $50, and I would have gone for it if not for the sticker shock of an additional $350 for a retainer that wasn't mentioned until the hygienist and dentist were out of sight and I was just talking to their team member about billing. Anyway, I needed time to think about it and will consider scheduling it in the near future, but the whole vibe felt a bit aggressive and upsell-y to me on top of everything else. I purchased their suggested floss, and it is satisfactory.

The cleaning and fluoride treatment were what I expected. I am relieved to not have cavities. I liked the flavor options of Waterloo in their waiting area fridge and I took a strawberry for the road.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Romano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Quintana is my favorite dentist ever. I have never felt more comfortable in a Dentist's office than I do there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachele Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great office, location and staff! Dr. Gulati did a great job at listening and giving me the options I needed to get done with my teeth. I will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arjun
user_reviews_extended.Description: BEST DENTIST EXPERIENCE I'VE EVER HAD. Let me preface with..I never leave reviews unless a business goes above and beyond or the total opposite. It's been a while since my last dentist appointment so saying I was nervous was an understatement. As soon as I walked into the office, I was greeted by a friendly staff that was extremely attentive, sweet, and caring. The music playlist-TOP NOTCH and got me in a comfortable mood from the get go. I was then greeted by Victor who went above and beyond. He offered rosé on tap, netflix, sunglasses, and a weighted blanket. I was amazed by hospitality and attentiveness to go above and beyond. I enjoyed the funny pop art and 3 flat screen monitors in each room. (one on the ceiling) They then had me do 3d scans where I can see the health and everything going on in my mouth. INNOVATION HAS COME A LONG WAY. Dr. Gulati was extremely attentive, professional, and explained everything well where I felt more than comfortable. He took care of all my lingering issues and oral pain. He did an awesome job and provided a 5 star dentist experience. I am confident I will never go to another dentist office. Five stars

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenden Knecht
user_reviews_extended.Description:
TL;DR... This office takes advantage of your trust to up-sell you unnecessary dental treatment. And will give you a breakdown of what your expected bill to be, that is far from what the actual bill will be.

Also as a warning, dental treatment is incredibly suggestive so the following review is just my opinion. I sought a second opinion on the care provided, but I am not a dental healthcare provider.

---------------------------------------------

I would steer clear of this location, and commercial dentistry in general... I thought that it would be convenient coming out of COVID to go to a dental office near where I lived in order to get my routine cleaning and dental exam. What I walked away with was a an exceptionally high bill for unnecessary dental work.

I cannot even give a higher rating for my experience (which was mostly comfortable) because after a second opinion from two other dental professionals (a dental hygienist and another dentist) they found the work done to be totally unnecessary. I only needed a routine cleaning and they upsold me to a deep cleaning (root planing and scaling). At the time, I thought that made sense because I hadn't been to the dentist in three years. After reviewing my x-rays to other dental professionals they noted how unnecessary the treatment was because the little calculus buildup I had did not constitute need for root planing and scaling. It wouldn't be such an issue but that deep cleaning costs about 10x what a routine cleaning would be and is not covered by my insurance.

In hindsight maybe I should've understood my coverage more, but they gave a breakdown of my coverage through my insurance and what my expected bill would be. It was higher than I would've liked, but I thought it was a necessary procedure. Fast forward to getting my Explanation of Benefits from my insurance, and nothing that they told me would be covered by my insurance was actually covered, so I have a much larger bill than expected.

I feel like my trust was betrayed, but in the end it really is my own fault for not fully understanding my own benefits. With that being said I found the business practices at Enamel Dentistry Saltillo to be predatory in nature; taking advantage of the everyday individual's lack of understanding when it comes to dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natasha Demehri Kathuria
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Gulati is amazing. I just moved to Austin and needed a new dentist, and his entire team was great. Gulati is extremely patient, kind, and committed to solving his patients dental problems. He’s well-versed in every aspect of dentistry from sleep medicine to orthodontics. He knows his stuff in and out, and he’s dedicated to his patients, I could tell from my first visit! Not to mention he had the most amazing dental staff and office! Highly highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down best dental office I’ve ever been to. The overall vibe of the place was so cool and the staff was so incredibly friendly. I felt so comfortable there and now look forward to going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amarro Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dentists have burned me previously, and for that reason, I have neglected my oral health.  I've had a dentist say I had nine cavities, and then I received another opinion stating that I only had 1.

I understand everyone is trying to make money, and if you have adequate insurance, people want to milk it, but this is also my health we are discussing.

There is one thing pitching me braces/Invisalign because my insurance will cover most of the cost, but when you are making up how many cavities I have, I immediately lose trust.

When I went into Enamel, I rolled my eyes.  Beer on tap, wine, Hip Hop playing.  The dentist is probably going to say I have 11 cavities!

I guess I am a curmudgeon and probably only trust old dentists that have Kenny G playing in the background.

Yes, that was my childhood dentist's.

I was immediately greeted by Jodee, who was professional and put me at ease; she was upbeat but not fake.

She seemed very confident, and I was sure that if I had any questions about my billing/ insurance, she would be able to speak to it pretty well, which she did.

Let's cut to the chase.  My X-Rays were, and they had some hi-tech technology that gave me a good indicator of my mouth's state.  I have not had a cleaning in 5 years, which was obvious, but Dr. Gulati did not judge me but was more adamant about getting my oral health under control.  He is very upbeat and positive and puts you at ease.

Dr. Gulati is very knowledgeable and addressed any questions I had and explained what was going on in my mouth.

I had two cavities, and he was able to show me and explain the reason behind getting a filling.

He talks to you like an old friend, and what I enjoy is that he is concerned about the health of your mouth, but he also wants you to love your smile, so you can talk to him about what your "smile goals" are, and he can help create a roadmap to love your smile.

I wish I would have known about Dr. Gulati years ago.  I can promise you that my teeth would be in a lot better shape, and I would not have to spend so much money from years of being frightened to go to the dentist or feeling like I am getting ripped off.

I highly recommend this practice, and I will have Dr. Gulati as my dentist for as long as I am in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Preston Glace
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great communication, clean facilities, friendly staff and top notch dental work. Everything about this place is highly professional and I never dread going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: lorenzo jett
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was a clean, safe environment. The dentist was cool, as well as the assistant and the receptionist. Very professional and welcoming. Overall I enjoyed the experience and I would recommend to all

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alan Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ashwin & the team here are super dope and kind. They offer the best service with super advanced technology that’s really cool. They work with you and your needs. This will be my new dentist office! Thank Enamel Team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reveance Bill-ings-lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: The most friendly & professional people ever. Plus the vibes and comfortability is amazing

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krista Pera
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I broke a tooth and was seen by Dr Gulati. He told me I needed a root canal. With the first injection of local anesthesia to numb my tooth, I begin swelling dramatically. When I felt my cheek and noticed, I asked him why I was swelling because I’ve never had an allergic reaction before when my mouth was numbed. He denied that there was any swelling and even had his assistant hand me a mirror to view. I noticed the swelling in the mirror also yet he continued to deny that there was any. With my persistence, he finally admitted there “was a little swelling and it was perfectly normal.”
Reluctantly, I continued with his treatment. My dentist was out of town and I needed my tooth fixed.
A very uncomfortable rubber isolation suction tool was placed in my mouth which forced my mouth open past its comfortable expansion level. So much so, that for several days after the procedure, I could barely open my jaw to eat. His procedure was multiple hours and my mouth was forced open that far most of it.
Dr Gulati then told me he would need to cut some of my gum-line. I assume he was attempting to use a soft tissue laser but neither he nor his assistant could get it to work. He asked his assistant to get the manual but they couldn’t get it to work.
Suddenly, the game plan changed and I no longer needed a root canal....just a crown.
My tooth was then prepped and impressions taken for a crown. A temporary crown was then attached and Dr Gulati described it as a “trash can lid”.
I asked Dr Gulati how long it would take to get the swelling to go down and he said it should be down by the next day. I expressed how uncomfortable I was that there was swelling with a simple procedure like this and he gave me a number to contact him at.
The next morning my face was even more swollen so I followed up with him. He stated “this is perfectly normal when an extraction is done.”  I informed him that an extraction was NOT done.  He didn’t have much of reply to that. He simply said to watch it and call if I needed anything.
With my dentist still out of town, I was able to get in with another local dentist to address the concerns I had. This dentist informed me that Dr Gulati had punctured a blood vessel and if he had simply applied pressure, he could have stopped the swelling.
This dentist also stated that he refused to touch Dr Gulati’s work because it was not prepped correctly.
4 days out from seeing Dr Gulati, I was finally able to see my regular dentist. I walked into his office with a swollen black and blue cheek. I also was still unable to easily open my jaw. He validated the other dentist’s statements that a blood vessel had been punctured and simple pressure application  would have helped tremendously. There was also concern regarding the preparation of the tooth for the crown.
After leaving my regular dentist, I called Dr Gulati’s office and stated that I would like to speak with him regarding the treatment I received. Instead of calling me back, he called my dentist first. When he returned my call he talked in circles and took no responsibly for his poor bed-side manner (lying about the swelling when he knew he had busted a blood vessel. Clearly any responsible ad experienced dentist would.) and the poor tooth prepping for a crown. I stated that I would not allow him to continue treatment for this tooth and wanted to pick up the crown (even though my regular dentist thinks a new one will have to be ordered). However, I paid cash that evening and wanted what I had paid for.
I was then told I could pick my crown up the following week. When I arrived to pick up my crown, it was withheld unless I signed a written statement from Dr Gulati. Who does that?
Worst dental experience of my life with Dr Gulati!

title: Treaty Oak Dental
address: 2905 San Gabriel St #202, Austin, TX 78705, United States

user_reviews.Name: Carmen
user_reviews.Description:
I do NOT recommend the place, if you don't have insurance, and you're paying out of pocket, like me!

Undoubtedly, the staff at the Treaty Oak Dental are all very friendly! Dr. Bruce is equally as cordial and nice as his staff. However, it takes more than just cordiality to provide a quality service!

My experience with Treaty Oak Dental was not positive at all, despite being very well greeted by everyone.

#1 - The place is extremely expensive! I needed a dental cleaning, and I've got an estimate of almost $4,000 for a treatment! I understand that I had more than just the cleaning to do, but it’s still frustrating... Keep reading to understand why!

#2 - Even being recommended by my Orthodontist, Treaty Oak Dental would NOT work the cost of my treatment with me! Meaning, if I don't have the money to pay in full, or have no insurance, no treatment will be done! I would get ONLY what I could pay!

#3 - They refused to do only the prophylaxis cleaning that I wanted, which I understand, as I kinda figured I had more than just a cleaning to do, but NEVER thought it would almost reach $4,000 for a treatment, nor I thought I wouldn't be able to have ongoing payments plans available to me, since I would pay out of pocket. With that being said, why not just do the cleaning I requested in the first place?

#4 - And last, but not least, I was charged $140 for wasting my time with them! The No Surprises Act (which is a federal law) never happened! I'm sure they'll say something was done, or that they charged for the visit, etc. However, nothing can justify a charge of $140 for an estimate of treatment! I say that, as upon booking the appointment, their secretary said before anything, the office needs “to establish me as a patient” before any treatment is done. I didn't think I would be charged for being established as a patient!

Disappointment and frustration define what I'm feeling right now!

user_reviews.Name: Lily Kley
user_reviews.Description:
Love my small family practice dentistry.

Have been going here for five years and it’s always been an incredible experience, Tina my dental hygienist is amazing, so thoughtful and really cares about you. BEST DENTIST IN AUSTIN!

Especially during Covid they have been taking extra safety precautions.

user_reviews.Name: Jynner
user_reviews.Description: Update 8/28/25: Stay Away! 👎Dr Jay's attitude is worse than last yr. Today he was rude & interrupted me when i was trying to explain about my new condition. Am tired of Michelle, the hygienist who is pushy & patronizing & kept asking me about medication and other PHI. THERE ARE NO DOORS in the ofc, it's a big horse stable with open stalls where everyone can hear everything! 😡 Have been coming here since 2001 (original dentist was Dr. Brender who was wonderful) but the level of service has gone down in the past few years; I always feel rushed out of there. IMPORTANT: When treatment is needed, ALWAYS ASK DR. JAY TO GO OVER OPTIONS NOT THE HYGIENIST! I respect dental hygienists' knowledge & their work but they are NOT dentists so DO NOT let them "run" the appt. YOU HAVE THE RIGHT to ask the dentist about  procedures and options! Also, make sure to find out how much your Out of Pocket cost will be BEFORE letting them schedule you for major dental work! One of the hygienists  (Michelle) used scare tactics & verbally pushed a treatment plan on me with no other options.....IMO, the dentist is best qualified to do that and you'll save time asking him instead of asking the hygienist who may not know all of the answers. When it was Dr. Brender's office, he was ALWAYS the one who discussed treatment options with me, including fillings. If you go to Dr. Jay's ofc, you'll need to be assertive & DEMAND to have him go over the options with you. Julie is friendly & efficient, as well as Theresa the Office Mgr, who is great at finding out what your Out of Pocket costs will be in advance. I recommend Treaty Oak Dental, just with the caveat that you'll need to make sure that Dr. Jay goes over options with you & answers any technical questions you may have.

user_reviews.Name: Dory Bennett
user_reviews.Description:
Wonderful calming experience.
Very professional clean high tech equipment.
I felt I was in good hands with Dr. Jay and assistant. Front desk lady was very prompt to notice me. Can you believe they all called me by my name upon my follow up visit.  Very impressed. My Daughter has been there and my husband now. This our family  dentist now.

user_reviews.Name: Drew Colcher
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Jay is the best dentist I've ever visited. He's helped me fix several issues caused by other, less-scrupulous dentists, and his pricing is fair and transparent, unlike many other offices I've been to. Their availability is much more accommodating than many other offices as well. His front desk staff is extremely courteous and helpful, and his dental assistants and hygienists are very skilled and thorough. It seems like the majority of the staff is Spanish-English bilingual, including Dr. Jay. I would recommend this office to anyone, and wish I had found them sooner.

user_reviews.Name: Dawn R
user_reviews.Description:
Today's service left me deeply disappointed. Despite coming to Treaty Oak for years and having positive experiences previously with the hygienists, this visit left me feeling incredibly uncomfortable. It has significantly impacted my view of this establishment. I’m considering canceling my next appointment and seeking an alternative provider.

My primary issue stems from the sense of shame, embarrassment, and disappointment I experienced regarding the way dental hygiene was communicated. Unfortunately, the communication lacked constructive advice and instead came across as patronizing from the doctor.

Moving forward, I strongly advocate for the adoption of a more proactive approach centered around preventative and value-based care. It's imperative to foster an environment that not only educates patients about potential areas for improvement but also positively reinforces and rewards good dental practices. This shift would significantly enhance the patient experience by focusing on wellness and support, rather than instilling a sense of fault or blame for existing dental concerns.

user_reviews.Name: J Dacy
user_reviews.Description: Great staff!!  When I called to make my appointment, Theresa assured me that  the entire staff makes all the necessary precautions to ensure my safety at the office due to the virus.  Dr. Jay is very professional and by far the best dentist in Austin and I've lived here for 43 years!   I'll keep coming back!

user_reviews.Name: Zachary Hogan
user_reviews.Description:
Love it! I've been to a few spots in Austin but this one is top notch. Highly recommended.

I've also had multiple hygienists clean my teeth here and they've all been excellent. Love feeling good from the interactions, in addition to feeling good as I walk out with extra clean teeth :-)

Dr. Jay’s is is very pleasant and gentle.  His lovely staff is the same.  I felt safe.

Thank you for making a dental visit during COVID easy and pleasant.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paula Rigling
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient of this practice for many years.  I appreciate the outstanding care I receive from all the members of their staff. Nissan has been my hygienist and provides the highest level of care. I made a point of telling Dr. Jay during my visit last month how much I appreciated the extra safety precautions the practice has implemented for COVID-19. I felt very safe and would wholeheartedly recommend Treaty Oaks Dental to anyone seeking a new home for dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M S
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this dentist for 15+ years.   This place has been purchased by Dr Jay and I'm still impressed with the service.  He has a great staff that keep the office running smoothly.  The dental hygienists all pay attention to detail and are highly experienced.  Dr. Bruce Jay  is highly qualified and never tries to upsell you on expensive dental treatments or surgeries.  Highly recommended.  Plenty of parking around the office.  Central Location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhonda McCollough
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. Brender since 1989. I love him, my children love him, my husband loves him. Nilsa and Cindy are just wonderful people and great in their jobs.  I think that Cindy has been there for the whole 21 years that i have been seeing Dr. Brender, and I can understand why- she is great in her job and the office environment is a great one to work in.  Don't let the bad review throw you off- I have been seeing him for years and have nothing but good things to say.  Competent, caring, friendly and efficient.  Love, love love Dr. Brender and his office staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristina Schlegel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Dr. Brender for well over 15 years. He and his staff are like a second family to me. I know I am going to receive the best care and feel good about myself and my oral health whenever I step out of their office. I honestly look forward to going whenever my appointment comes up.  Even when I have problems (i.e. crowns), I wouldn't trust anyone more to take care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Duke Lambert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would definitely suggest Dr. Brender and his staff to anyone who is looking for a friendly environment when it comes to their dentistry. I am very nervous when it comes to seeing the dentist, but I have no anxiety about my appointments here. Everyone working in his office is very welcoming and kind, and you are guaranteed to leave in better shape than when you arrived. Dr. Brender himself is a philanthropist in his personal life, and this altruistic attitude shines through to his practice as well. He and his staff are there to help improve your quality of life and make you feel comfortable about taking care of yourself. Whether you are new to the area or just need a better dentist, this is your guy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Schattman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was apprehensive when my former dentist retired, but figured it was worth trying the new dentist because the hygienists had not changed.  Boy am I glad I did!  Dr. Jay is top notch.  I was super impressed by the fact that he says please and thank you to the hygienist when asking for instruments.  In all my years have never had a dentist do that!   Fortunately his courtesy is matched by his professional skill.  I won’t be changing dentists any time soon that’s for darn sure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bianca Covington
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Dr. Brender's office for seven years now. I have always received excellent service- from the teeth cleaning to optimizing my dental routine, I have never been led astray by their friendly staff. They never push their services on you but have a large range of services that you can request as needed (like teeth whitening).  Nilsa has been my dental hygienist each time and works to accommodate my lunchtime schedule.  She is very friendly and does an excellent job with my teeth!  She's the best!  Dr. Brender and his associate are very professional.  I recommend all of my friends to come here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Escamilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brender is fantastic.  After seeing two other dentists before him, he was the only one to tell me that the real reason for my root canal was due to my bite.  Now that I have that information I can make a more informed decision about what to do next.   I saw two other dentists who didn't mention that, or know that. He's experienced and genuinely cares about his patients.  His staff is super friendly and relaxed and they don't judge! :) I was in good hands.  Dr. Brender was recommended by a friend, but he is now my dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Murray
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am honestly totally speechless after the incredible experience I had at Dr. Brender's office. From the moment I called in with concern over tooth pain until I walked out of the office after my visit, I experienced nothing but the utmost professionalism, friendliness, patience, kindness, and really felt seen and heard. I can't believe how informative my hygienist was; so patient and kind, as well! And then when Dr. Brender came in to see me, he actually sat down and spent about 30 minutes with me. This has NEVER happened before. I left feeling very cared for, heard, and valued. I'll most definitely be recommending this office to anyone I know who is looking for a dentist. Absolutely superb.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Gomez Montalvo
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dental hygienist was the sweetest and most gentle person that I have ever encountered. The Dentist was so knowledgeable and explained the few questions I asked him throughly! The receptionist was so sweet and so welcoming. Truly loved the practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nanette Forbes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Blender and staff are the best.  I would highly recommend them for any dental needs.  I have been seeing them for all my dental needs for over 10 years.  Nelsa, dental hygienist, does an outstanding job not to mention an incredible personality.  They now have a new dentist Dr. Jay, who is wonderful, personable and thorough.  Every time I go for an appointment, I look forward to seeing friends who always provide the best of  care.

All that being said, if you need a dentist, call Dr. Brender.  I promise you will be pleased.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hamed Samadi
user_reviews_extended.Description: People in this office are awesome from the secretary to assistances. All of them do their best to help you. Mr Brender is really awesome he is fun and good in his job. First he describes everything for you then he starts his job, and he constantly checks the steps with you. I was there about 4 months ago for a regular filling but he saved my teeth and so far I'm okay.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Riki Bradshaw
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr Brender and all of his staff!  He is the ONLY dentist who knows how to properly anesthetize me (due to my medications).  He is an expert, and I don't want to have to go anywhere else!  Also, he just took a partner who is very nice, and I'm VERY sure that anyone Dr. Brender has brought into his practice has passed the litmus test!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Crook
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brender has been my dentist for 16+ years.  Love, love him and the entire staff.  They are like family to me and always friendly but professional, as well.  I would not hesitate to recommend Dr. Brender for your dentistry care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sally Ryan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend!! I was treated with the upmost care and respect on my first visit! Nilsa was thorough and explained the details of my oral care throughout. I am so pleased to have a kind and trustworthy dentist in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Master Gohring
user_reviews_extended.Description: It will be a sad day when Dr. Brender retires. Been going here for cleaning every six months since 1985. Rikes! Same friendly staff. Very professional all around. Reasonably priced ... I don't use insurance. Dr. Brender has a steady clientele so you may have a challenge getting in. I appreciate getting my next appointment scheduled right after I finish my current appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bradley Cuccio
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time visit was excellent. Staff made me feel comfortable and explained thoroughly their approach to my dental care. Would give 5 stars if this wasn’t my first visit. So far, best dentist office I’ve been to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sienna Wareham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly the best dental office in Austin. I absolutely hate going in but everyone was able to make sure I was comfortable. They were even nice enough to take me ASAP when my fillings needed to be shaved down more.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Newton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Brender is the best. Skillful, knowledgeable, friendly, intelligent and slightly goofy.  I just love the guy. Been going to him for 17 years or more.
I refuse to have anyone but Nilsa clean my teeth. She's the best, too. Dr Brender has made going to the dentist a pleasant experience, and has helped me keep my teeth! The highest praise!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Hudson
user_reviews_extended.Description: There has never been a better dental office.  These are absolutely the people to see for all your dental needs!  From wonderful support staff, to great hygienists, to the man, the myth, the legend, Dr. Brender himself, they are the best at what they do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Smadi
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is amazing! I'm always very well taken care of. I smile walking in and out of the office. I've been going to Dr. Brender for years and honestly wouldn't go anywhere else :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horrible Reception...this isn't managed like it was back when Dr. Brender owned the office. I had been going to his practice since I was a kid, but the new front desk team for Dr. Jay is so bad I had to find a new dentist. The receptionist never answers the phone. They're also closed on Fridays which makes scheduling even harder. Once you finally do manage to squeeze yourself in on their schedule, the wait time in the office is ridiculous. Then this receptionist told my mom and myself that she would call us with insurance pre-auth info regarding dental work we needed done and never did...we got fed up asking because she was terribly rude ("Well I wasn't in the exam room during your visit so I had no idea you needed that". It's called reading the chart...) and since she's the only one working the desk we couldn't get anyone else to assist. We both ended up finding new dentists. I work in customer service and am still apalled at how bad this experience was. The dentist is already a bad place for lots of people. There's no need to make it worse with bad customer service like this. It's a shame because Nilsa and Dr. Jay are great, just need to find themselves a professional front desk team...maybe I should apply for her job so I can get paid to do nothing...

A first-rate practice in the Heart of Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pat Ellison
user_reviews_extended.Description: World's best dentist office! Julie, Nilsa, young Dr. Brent Herrington, and Teresa are the most helpful, accommodating, kind, and competent people to be found. user_reviews_extended.Name: PH
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is top notch. The facility itself is very clean and modern. The equipment is also all new and of the best quality. The staff and Dr. Jay are all easy to talk with and always communicate the procedure. Lucky to have these guys in town!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Johnson (Playstatement)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Before discovering treaty oak and the team I had not been to the dentist in almost a decade. My negligence cost my a nasty gum infection right before I was due to go on vacation.

Not only did Theresa squeeze me into a last minute appt but Dr. Jay, nilsa and , julie were beyond amazing not only in their expertise but their kindness. These folks are FANTASTIC.

Thanks again

Ben Johnson

title: Austin Cosmetic Dentistry by Tejas Patel, DDS
address: 221 W 6th St #940, Austin, TX 78701, United States

owner.name: Austin Cosmetic Dentistry by Tejas Patel, DDS (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Victoria Herrera
user_reviews.Description:
10/10 in all ways!
From the consultation, Kelly made great suggestions and had a listening ear on what i wanted and what I wanted to prevent. Carmen is absolutely delightful and welcoming.

I was extremely afraid of dentists. I have always had abrasive and uncomfortable experiences, but Dr. Patel and Ms. Julie made me feel comfortable and heard. I’ve never been excited to go back for a dentist visit except to see this pair.

Dr Patel is a perfectionist who takes his craft seriously, and it shows with his attention to detail. The experience, work, and bedside manner is worth every single penny. I’m incredibly grateful to have stumbled upon them when I was researching cosmetic dentists. Thanks to the team!

user_reviews.Name: Jessica Taveras
user_reviews.Description:
Hi all,
I’m just here to hopefully get my question answered by those who have had the experience of getting their porcelain veneers done by Dr. Patel. I really want to get my smile done by Dr. Patel I can tell he does phenomenal work, but are we really talking about $30,000-39,000 price range for veneers?, and at that not even a full mouth just the amount of teeth you show when you smile. That’s way too of an exaggerated price, I mean might as well get a down payment for a house instead.

Can someone please share the price they paid, I’m just trying to clarify on pricing.

Thank you! 🫂

user_reviews.Name: Katie Corcoran
user_reviews.Description: I can’t say enough great things about the team at Dr. Patel’s office. First of all, everyone there is incredibly friendly and made my husband and I feel like family. Dr. Patel and his assistants are incredibly detail oriented and spent every minute needed to make sure we had the smiles of our dreams. The whole process to get veneers was much easier than I had assumed and we had new smiles within a month or so. They listened to our thoughts and opinions and edited our temporary veneers until they were absolute perfection. I’ve followed instagram accounts of dentists in other countries for veneers for years and I can’t express how glad I am that we went to ACD. I’ve never seen before and afters like the ones on their page….absolute perfection. One million percent will refer anyone we know here. Thank you guys for being so wonderful and welcoming and making the process to amazing smiles as easy as possible <3 - Steve & Katlyn C.

user_reviews.Name: Firas Hannawi
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of receiving dental work from Dr. Tejas Patel, who specializes in veneers, and I couldn't be more thrilled with the results. From the initial consultation to the final placement, Dr. Patel demonstrated exceptional expertise and a keen eye for detail. The veneers are flawlessly crafted and have transformed my smile beyond my expectations. The process was seamless, with Dr. Patel meticulously ensuring that each veneer was perfectly aligned and matched my natural teeth.

Not only did Dr. Patel deliver outstanding cosmetic results, but the overall experience was also remarkably comfortable and reassuring. The staff was professional and friendly, creating a welcoming environment that eased any apprehensions I had. Dr. Patel took the time to explain each step of the procedure, and their dedication to patient satisfaction was evident throughout. I highly recommend Dr. Patel to anyone considering veneers—my smile has never looked better, and the confidence boost has been incredible.

user_reviews.Name: Tony & Liz McD
user_reviews.Description:
100% would recommend Dr. Tejas Patel and team! My only regret is that I didn’t do this sooner. I did 4 separate consults and Dr. Patel was very honest with me in his suggestions and recommendations. He definitely was not the cheapest but he was the one that felt just right for me!

From initial consultation online to veneer day, the communication and overall process was superb!

user_reviews.Name: Kayla Hale
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Patel and his entire team is superb. I had the best experience! I was from out of state and they made the process simple and easy for me. Besides this- I am in love with my new smile! My teeth are perfect, I love my new shape and color! If you are from out of state I highly encourage you to set up a consult, you don’t regret it! I interviewed 2 cosmetic dentist and chose Dr. Patel and I would do it all over again.

user_reviews.Name: melanie little
user_reviews.Description: From the first call to the day you get your veneers the staff and Doctor Patel make you feel like family. The offices are bright and inviting.  This was the easiest experience ever!   I’m super happy with my “smile makeover!”  My teeth finally show in pictures and look bright and white.  I love the size as well!  Thank you to all the staff and Doctor Patel for a beautiful confidence builder!

user_reviews.Name: Allison Reiss
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Tejas Patel and his incredible team! From the moment I walked into the office, I was greeted with warmth and professionalism. Kelly, Carmen and Julie are beyond welcoming—they truly go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and cared for every step of the way.

Dr. Patel takes a consultative approach that immediately put me at ease. He was incredibly thorough in explaining the entire process, answering all my questions, and ensuring I felt confident in every decision. His attention to detail and expertise were evident from the start, and I knew I was in the best hands.

The entire experience was seamless, and I felt genuinely cared for throughout. And now, I can’t stop smiling—I absolutely LOVE my veneers! They look natural, feel amazing, and have completely transformed my confidence.

If you’re considering cosmetic dentistry, look no further than Dr. Patel and his team. Their skill, care, and dedication to patient happiness are unmatched. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy Raper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Painless. Isn't that the biggest concern about going to the dentist?  Tejas Patel and his staff make every visit as comfortable and worry-free as possible: from warmly greeting you when you arrive, to filing the insurance paperwork, to validating your parking ticket when you leave. They are respectful of my time by not keeping me waiting. He takes his time to fully explain treatment plans which assures me that he is concerned about my needs and isn’t advocating unnecessary procedures. Both he and his technicians are very considerate and gentle during procedures.   His facility has the newest of equipment and the kindest staff. Many of them have been there for decades-I know because I've gone there for decades with his predecessor who retired. I was apprehensive about Dr. Patel because he was unknown to me, and I seriously considered finding a new dentist more convenient to my work/home. However, my previous dentist would not have recommended him to his patients if he didn't have full confidence in Dr. Patel’s abilities.  And more significantly is that Allison - one of the best hygenists ever- also elected to stay with Dr. Patel, and she certainly wouldn’t put me in the wrong hands. Granted, I have never looked forward to dental visits, but my experiences with Dr. Patel and his staff  make those visits as pleasant as possible, so I don’t dread going. If you want a small town family feel in the middle of downtown, then he is your new dentist.  I highly recommend Dr. Patel.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Ricciardi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience choosing Dr. Patel as my cosmetic dentist! I traveled from NYC to Austin to have 8 porcelain veneers placed. user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa H.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It took me a few days to write this review because theres way too many good things to say about Dr. Patel and his staff. I had an extremely complicated case which included fixing a cross bite and veneer revisions due to the poor placement of the primary by another dentist. The process was super easy to get a consultation with them specially for someone who is an out of town patient. To say their hospitality was excellent is an understatement, I had concerns over my high anxiety and ptsd of my past dental experiences and thats when Dr. Patel's assistant, Julie, made sure I was comfortable she gave me noise canceling headphones, they offer "laughing" gas and Netflix to tune out any noise and calm your nerves even gave me some medication to help me relax. Both Julie and Dr. Patel checked in on how I was feeling during the procedure multiple times, I have never in my life felt so happy to be at a dentist office and can not wait to go back for my 2nd visit to get my permanents done. Let me also point out that Dr. Patel isn't only concerned with the cosmetic side to veneers he also talked about how we can keep my gums healthy and overall what is best for my health regarding my new bite. He also sent me home with a post procedure kit to help the healing process and maintenance. Let me also add that the ladies who work with him are extremely kind and caring both Carmen and Kelly have helped me throughout the entire process since day 1.They answered all my questions and concerns, made sure I got all the impressions right, helped me schedule my consultations and gave amazing recommendations for our hotel. Overall giving Dr. Patel and his staff a 10/10 plus an amazing experience my teeth have never looked better and this is only the temps I can't wait to see the end results. Huge thank you to everyone who made me feel my best when visiting!

PART 2, 2nd VISIT UPDATE: Needless to say my permanents look and feel perfect! I didn't think the permanents could beat the temps because of how great they looked but seriously I have been getting so many sweet compliments on my new smile, the healing process was so easy with the permanents I was already biting into things by the 3rd day! If I could write 100 good reviews for Dr.Patel and his staff I would. if you are looking for an amazing cosmetic dentist in or out of town look no further. Again, huge thank you for the confidence I have when I smile now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffery LeDoux
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First of all my apologies to the team that took such great care of me for the delayed review.

I found Dr. Patel because I moved to Dallas from Austin and I was getting my veneers replaced after 14 years.  I had just moved so my brain/comfort was still in Austin so I wanted to find someone there.  Dr. Patel was on a late night dental program that usually I'd flip past but seeing as I was in the market for some work I paid attention and was impressed so researched him.  I'm pretty spontaneous so I booked an appointment and took the 3 hour trip down pretty quickly.  Prior to arrival Karmen was my contact and was amazing.  She makes you feel like you're the only person even coming in.  Once I got there VIP treatment ensued.  Kelly and Dr. Patel got me comfortable and went over what I was trying to accomplish.  To my surprise they were ready to knock it out and set aside their day (I thought it was just a consultation). Complimentary Panasonic toothbrush and cleaning (Daniellllll!!!!!! sea lion!..inside joke), 6 hours, and temporary veneers I was out of there feeling amazing.  Scheduled me to come back for the actual veneers and they looked amazing!  I'm a bit of a wimp when it comes to dental work so taking off the temps and putting on the permanents wasn't fun but other than completely knocking me out they catered to every single discomfort.  Veneers were in and I came back a few weeks later to receive some retainers because I clench at night.  My teeth look amazing!!!!!! I no longer cover my mouth when I smile and I was surprised how quickly  I just stopped thinking about it because I knew they looked good.

Summary: I love these guys and gals.  We joked around, hugs over handshakes, and had a good time!  I will be back for any serious work regardless of where I live in the US.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Kreitz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I unfortunately was born with bad genetics when it comes to my overall oral health. I have a narrow gum line that did not allow room for my adult teeth. I wore braces all four years of high school, but many of my issues weren't corrected. Issues such as an end on end bite that continued to erode my front teeth until my roots were exposed, baby teeth that were never extracted, missing adult teeth that never grew in, enamel eroding away from most teeth, and the ability to chew with only two back molars on one side of my mouth. Needless to say, my mouth was in constant pain, food was impossible to chew, and I was extremely insecure with my smile. I was overwhelmed with the recommendations from every dentist suggesting a 3-5 year plan with braces, jaw surgery, and a price point unattainable with my budget. My sister even decided to forgo the 3-5 year plan suggested by her dentist and proceed with dentures. I knew dentures come with a lifetime of discomfort, so I began my research for alternative methods. During my months of research I came in contact with an old friend of mine, that I hadn't seen in quite some time, and noticed his impeccable smile. He told me his issues were solved through cosmetic dentistry and couldn't recommend his dentist enough. I took his advice and made my free appointment expecting some pretentious doctor's office pressuring me into the most expensive procedure until I became uncomfortable and left disappointed. I COULDN'T BE MORE WRONG!!!! Number 1: His staff couldn't be more friendly. They were very upfront about the cost of the procedure and were more than happy to explain every detail about the world of cosmetic dentistry. Number 2: Do yourself a favor and research Dr. Patel's resume. After his in-depth explanations about the recommended procedure and cost, what truly sold me was the fact that another dentist from out of state brought his staff to simply observe Dr. Patel in action. That should tell you that this guy is the best of the best. Number 3: After understanding what expertise is required for cosmetic dentistry, and the fact that my problems could be solved without jaw surgery, braces, and a 3-5 year time frame, I quickly appreciated the cost of my procedure. IT'S WORTH IT!! My procedure was a total of four appointments that corrected my end on end bite with my front teeth. My crowns have the perfect size, shape, color, and look very NATURAL. Also, I can finally chew properly. The end result is a much healthier mouth, beautiful teeth, and no more pain. Please don't procrastinate about your oral health. I waited too long to get this done, but I couldn't be happier about my experience. Hopefully this helps you in your research. Cheers!!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Mostly recently with a dentist “fixing” my front two teeth by placing veneers in January.

But the process was extremely painful, emotionally jarring, and he explained nothing. I was in pain for days as he most certainly over prepped my teeth. My temps came off multiple times even though I followed instructions.
Additionally, he left me in temps for over 8 weeks. And prepped my teeth TWICE in that amount of time.
And the veneers he finally gave me were off color—yellow—compared to my actual teeth. He never even asked me and shape, placement, color, etc. Just stuck some big, buck, yellow front teeth on my face and acted like he did a good job.
Needless to say, I was in complete shock/traumatized. I set out and did a LOT of research on dentists/dental work and the most reputable places in Texas before finding Dr. Patel. And consulted at a few places of similar pricing/reputation.
Let me tell you. He is the man for the job. Whatever your concern is. He is kind, compassionate, and extremely good at what he does. I can’t even describe how night and day my experience has been in his clinic as compared to what happened to me before.
I’m not even in my finals yet, but my temps look 100% better than what I had going on before. The prep was amazing. I felt nothing and was able to get back to work immediately.
I can’t wait for my final results and am sure my smile is going to be more stunning than I imagined.
If this is a decision you want to (or need to, as in my case) make cosmetically, these are the best hands you can be put in!!!
