She is one of coolest people  I've ever met! Love her vibe! Finally, I bet with the one and only Dr. Tejas Patel, killer name by the way. He has been the most respectful, kind and understanding throughout out this experience. Between Kelly and him, they have made me feel so comfortable and explained the process thoroughly. All I remember thinking during my  first visit was “I found it, this is it!” I spent more than a decade looking for the right place. Let me help you make your decision - Dr. Patel , Kelly and Carmen is who you need. Thank you guys! My family and I are so grateful for what you do. I will forever be grateful for my smile make over!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsey Doughtie
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best experience I've ever had at the dentist. My hygienist (I cannot remember her name, I'm the worst) was so so knowledgeable and put me at ease. I never once felt pain or discomfort, and she explained everything to me throughout the entire process (x-rays, cleaning, etc. ) Dr. Patel was super kind and I felt cared about and focused on the entire time I was there. Very impressed and happy with my experience, highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desirae Pierce
user_reviews_extended.Description: I never looked forward to the dentist office until I visited Tejas Patel's practice. The office is amazing with a great view of downtown. The process is quick and very easeful. My teeth feel great and look great. I look forward to my appointments now. It's great to find people you look forward to seeing and this office is one of them. Thank you for everything you do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brent Rayfield
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel and his entire staff are beyond the best. My new smile is perfect and looks as natural as can be. Thanks again to him and his incredible team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy Bhandari
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Patel and his entire staff are incredible. For anyone who wants to enhance their smile, and do so in a fun, uplifting environment, I would highly recommend going through this team. The results are amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Top Shelf Mixtress
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Finding Dr. Patel was not an easy task, but well worth the effort. I can’t say enough great things about this office. After countless consultations and research I found the absolute best! Coming from a dental background I am well aware of the overcharging and neglect that can take place. I interned at multiple dentists offices and saw the good and bad that goes on behind the chair!  During my search many dentists tried to add on extra procedures like Invisalign and all kinds of “gadgets” that would speed the process up! Dr. Patel was no nonsense and worked with my budget for the quickest results without jeopardizing quality of work!

Dr. Patel is genuine and a man who has crafted his craft! I live in San Antonio and driving to Austin for dental appointments wasn’t my first choice, but Austin Cosmetic Dentistry was the only choice. They made me feel like I was on a makeover show and rolled out the red carpet! He gave me back my confidence! By utilizing technology he was able to make you feel secure in your final decisions. He puts all of his photos on Instagram and trust me I looked at them all (probably twice... ok maybe three times)!

To anyone and everyone, search no more! You won’t find a better person to call your dentist! I still drive to his office for my cleanings, he is worth it. What other dentist will send you an Instagram video during the middle of their busy day to show you how to brush with your new veneers.... Dr. Patel! I am a patient for life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holly Anfinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven’t stopped smiling since I left my last appt with Dr. Patel. He and his team were meticulous and thorough every step of the way to make sure that my results were exactly what I was looking for. I wanted my smile to look bright but natural, and to maintain some of the character of my original smile. I couldn’t have asked for a better outcome! Thank you Dr. Patel and team for the attention to detail, and for the warm experience every step of the way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Piña
user_reviews_extended.Description: I must say i should brag about Dr Patel and his staff. His staff is exceptionally accommodating and they made sure i felt comfortable. I am extremely happy with my results and don't regret going through process.  I really appreciated Dr Patel's honestly and his suggestions and i LOVED the end result.  I recommend him 100%! THANK YOU AGAIN Dr Patel!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annabel Booth
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Where do I start - I had braces when I was a teenager. I didn’t wear my retainer like I should have, and my teeth unfortunately shifted. I hated my teeth. It was such an insecurity of mine for so many years. I had always wanted veneers but didn’t know where to even start with the process. If you’re going to pay the money and make the investment, you want to go to someone you trust. I had “shopped” around for a long time but was never really drawn to a particular practice.
I found Dr. Patel via social media and instantly fell in love with his work. I told my friends and my family that I was going to Austin, TX to get my teeth done. They all thought I was crazy to travel that far (I live right near Washington D.C).
I didn’t care what they said - I knew I was making the right decision. It was honestly the best decision and best investment I have ever made. I almost cried when I first saw my teeth. I felt like a brand new person. I am so confident now. Smiling all the time!!! I love how natural they are but still so white and so beautiful. People ask if I did something different, but they can’t pinpoint exactly what it is. Which I love.
From the moment I stepped into his office, he made me feel like a family member or friend. It can be a nerve wrecking experience for a lot of people but I couldn’t have felt more comfortable and confident in the work they did.
I will seriously continue to recommend Dr. Patel to everyone and anyone. Thank you so much again Dr. Patel. You are AMAZING!!!!! Thank you for giving me my confidence back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: karla salinas
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best cosmetic dentist in the world. Changed my life! Dr Patel and his staff are so friendly and so professional! Not to mention super accommodating! I watched an entire season of a show on Netflix while they did my procedure and didn't feel a thing! I got the smile of my dreams!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan Mandujano
user_reviews_extended.Description: I work downtown and the location is great for me.  I can walk over and get back to work quickly.  I was a new patient and went in for the first time.  I was able to download all of my new patient forms online, which made the initial process way easier.  My exam and cleaning was gentle an thorough.  Dr. Kaye and the staff were really concerned for my comfort.  They did a great job educating me on their plan for me and my health without making me feel lectured.  I have full confidence in their office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan Courter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where do I start? I found Dr. Tejas Patel on Tiktok and I’m forever grateful for the universe bringing me to him. From my initial consultation with Kelly to finally meeting Dr. Patel and his amazing team in Austin, Texas - I felt at home. Mind you I traveled all the way from Pennsylvania!! I got veneers because I had gone through double jaw surgery and three rounds of braces. I was tired of being self conscious of my smile in pictures and tired of always covering my smile with my hand when I would talk to people and laughed. I’ve always struggled to love the smile I was born with. I’ve always dreamed of having that perfect smile, one that would compliment me and not make me look fake and I finally manifested it into existence. Dr. Patel and his team LISTEN to what you want and take all of your concerns, thoughts, critiques and turn it into a beautifully crafted smile. Dr. Patel isn’t in this business to slap some piano white keyboard teeth on people. Him and his team are there to give you what you want, change lives, and most importantly make you feel amazing, and it shows in his work, in his team, and his nature. It’s honestly the most perfected team he has built. He’s literally an icon and I hope he knows that. To everyone at his office I’m forever in love with smiling again. Thank you Kelly for being so in-depth throughout the whole process and making me feel comfortable and translating my vision to words. Thank you Carmen for setting up my appointments and working with me when I had Covid to get things back on track with my veneers. Thank you Julie for making it a painless process and helping me with my anxiety as the work began in the chair. Thank you Jarett for capturing this entire experience in the office! And lastly, THANK YOU Dr. Patel for changing my life, I cannot thank you enough and I’m forever changed by this experience. If anyone is reading this review go look at his work on instagram and TikTok. It’s unmatched and you will not be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Trumbull
user_reviews_extended.Description: So let me first start by saying I can not stand the dentists and I sadly admit that it is rare that I find the time to fill our reviews however this one called for it. It was 18 years since I last saw a dentist before my wife convinced me to go gee Dr. Patel. They work extremely well with patients who have dental anxiety, and I can tell you that yes there is such a thing and for some like me suffer the most. Nevertheless, since about 8 months ago I have now had two cleanings, a few cavities filled and more than halfway through my Invisalign treatment for straightening my teeth and although I am never excited to go to a dental appointment, I always look forward to seeing the Downtown Lakeway Smiles staff!! Thank you all for being the kindest, most professional!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ginger Lowry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Five stars plus for Tejas Patel, DDS Downtown and Lakeway! My adult children and I have been going to Dr. Patel for five years. Living in Austin for 40 years and having several very good dentists, I can say that Dr. Patel and his staff deserve more than 5 stars for excellent care, accounting, efficiency and friendly professional customer service. He creates healthy beautiful smiles. Love it each time we visit Dr. Patel and staff downtown.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isis Elise
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Tejas did such an amazing job on my smile makeover! He walked me through the whole process and explained the whole procedure of what was to come! Him and his staff took their time with my smile and me feel very welcome! I got the perfect smile that I always wanted and because of him and his staff, I will forever be grateful for their services. I HIGHLY recommend them if you are thinking about changing your smile. Believe me they are worth going to!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bev Lucas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to the 6th street office. The office staff were extremely pleasant and helpful. The dental assistant was gentle, thorough, and kind. Dr. Patel was friendly and to the point. At no time did anyone lecture me on how to care for my teeth or shame me about the condition of my teeth (not that they were in bad shape). The view was beautiful. Sitting on the 9th floor, you can see a great deal of Austin including airplanes taking off and landing at the airport. I would recommend Dr. Patel's office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gypsiee
user_reviews_extended.Description: My smile stopped me from doing so many things because I hated smiling and even talking at some point because I felt people were staring at my teeth and judging me. But OMG I am soooo blessed to have found Dr.Patel I’ve been following his work and decided to travel from Cali and it was one of the best decisions I have ever made from my first consultation to my last visit Kelly, Carmen & Dr. Patel made me feel so at ease and soo comfortable I love how precise everything was and how every detail was laid out and explained to me this was definitely an amazing experience and well worth every penny it feels amazing to be able to smile and not have to worry truly thank you Dr. Patel and your very AMAZING team!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Wish I could give you guys 1,000,000 stars because you guys deserve it!!!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jay’s Hair Studio
user_reviews_extended.Description: HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!! If you are looking for a dentist in Texas, look no further, Dr. Tejas Patel is the BEST!!! His expertise in veneers is outstanding! I was extremely satisfied with his work, his professionalism and his entire staff!!!. They make you feel welcomed, comfortable, safe, and satisfied with the results. He is a very kind and nice person over all. He and his staff take their time with you and never rush the process and that is a plus for me!!! His gifted talent will deliver nothing but amazing results!! You will first meet the kindest most friendliest receptionist ever (Carmen). Gracias Carmen eres un amor!!! And of course his AMAZING assistant Kelly, she is so sharp-friendly-on top of things-just overall the perfect assistant any dentist would love to have. Kelly is so knowledgeable with the years of experience in working in the dental field. The two of them are the perfect team!! So happy he has such a wonderful assistant (Kelly) by his side, feels like you’re getting two for the price of one lol. Sitting in the chair, you are extremely relaxed and comfy!!  The entire process is just amazing!  Thanks again Dr. Tejas Patel and your staff for making me feel 10X happier! 5 stars! ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Francesca P
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would recommend this dental practice to everyone! They're always very attentive, friendly and professional. If you're in Austin and looking for a fantastic dentist, do yourself a favor and go to Dr Patel.

Update 2021:
I’ve been trying to get help for a loose crown I had put in here in 2017 and I’m disappointed with how impossible it’s been to get in touch with anyone at this dental practice. I’ve called, left voicemails, tried the online patient portal and weeks later, not so much as a call back has been received.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rika232
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you want a true and honest review, this is truly it! I NEVER leave reviews (good or bad), unless it has really created a huge impact on me. Dr. Patel and his team have made such a huge impact over the years, that they've become family.

My work involved crowns, extractions, and bridge work.

My dental issues began at 4-years-old after experiencing a serious fall. It caused severe damage to the root and my nerve in the front tooth. Several dentists refused to do the work, and the repair and "cosmetic" costs (very visible chipped tooth) were just too much for my family to bear. I'm a huge extrovert and a people person. So as you can imagine, these dental issues caused huge insecurities in my life. I was determined to get this resolved, but I just needed the right professional to complete the work.

I was working in Lakeway at the time and just happened to call and stop by their office after work. They were closing for the day, but welcomed me in with open arms. They took a look at my teeth, took x-rays right away (because I was living and going to college in Waco at the time), and wrote up a treatment plan all in that 1 short visit. About 2 hrs later, and there were absolutely no complaints that it had become dark outside.

I'm sure you can imagine the joy I felt knowing that this would finally get done. As a young, married college student paying out-of-pocket for my education, family, and dental work, I needed time and flexibility to pay for my work. Jenny (o how I love Jenny...and you too Angela :) ) always stayed so positive and patient with our situation. We paid for certain treatments as we could afford them, and they always found ways to work with our insurance and try to lower the costs as much as possible (sorry Pearl P...but I have to disagree with your post). Just thinking about our constant calls and emails just makes me tear up. What should've been a 6-month treatment plan, ultimately turned into almost 3 years!

Graduations, several moves, and a new baby later, and we have finally finished!! Dr. Patel and Kelly are truly miracle workers. They are soooo amazing and always make sure that I'm comfortable and relaxed during each visit. I live in Dallas now, and I refuse to go anywhere else. They are truly the best!! I hold an exec position at work, and now I'm so comfortable controlling my meetings and chatting with my employees. You can now find me holding my head up high, laughing, and smiling without covering my mouth with my hands. I'm beyond grateful for Dr. Patel and his team. You guys gave me the confidence I needed to find my old self again (& here comes the water works again ha)! Please do not hesitate to trust them with your business. They are truly the best!! :)

Thank you guys!!
~Rika

user_reviews_extended.Name: Orlando Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel is awesome. Knowledgeable, helpful and attentive to his patients needs. All of the staff demonstrates the same level of excellence. Best dentist/office I have ever gone to. Highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Gentry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel and staff were so supportive and diligent during my dental process. My case was complex, but Dr. Patel and staff helped me to feel comfortable. They were available to answer all questions and I am extremely happy with the outcome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John LaMunyon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Tejas Patel is one of the kindest men I have ever met. He is professional, courteous , and skilled. And this shapes the entirety of his whole practice. From the moment you walk in to the moment you leave everyone is welcoming and hospitable. As long as I live in Austin He will be my family’s dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Damron
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel and staff have helped me address some very complex and extensive dental issues. They are knowledgeable, professional, friendly, and helpful at every turn. My case is quite extensive so I was looking for someone with whom I could feel totally confident in addressing these issues. There is no doubt that I made the right choice in choosing Dr. Patel and staff. I would give a 10+ recommendation to anyone looking for dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dentist, hands down! Not just because of the work, but they do everything in their power to make me feel comfortable and at ease. The dentist is always anxiety inducing, but not here. The staff and Dr. Patel are just wonderful. You couldn’t pay me to go to a different dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Reidy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have to admit, I was a little nervous when I heard that Dr. Haddad was leaving. I was mainly nervous that I would have to have a new hygenist. As it turned out, all the staff is the same, which was so reassuring. This is the first time I have been able to go to the dentist and get my teeth cleaned quickly and painlessly! Also, I had the opportunity to meet Dr. Patel already, and he is warm and friendly. It doesn't hurt that the front desk staff is super sweet and always friendly. An all around positive experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barbara Carter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel and his friendly staff are always great to see.  Dr Patel has helped me with some extensive dental work and I am very grateful  for his caring and knowledgeable attitude.  They are always willing to help in any way that they can, I always feel at ease when I visit.  I would highly recommend Dr. Patel if you are looking for a new Dental professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A Michel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Tejas Patel is always attentive and wants to make sure all is going well with my dental health and my invisalign progress.  I appreciate that Dr. Tejas takes the time to get to know me.  All the staff is very helpful friendly and caring.  I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan Welcher
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient of Dr. Patel since he took over this practice from my previous dentist.  As someone who's had a lot of dental work (a bicycle accident in 1998 resulted in a broken jaw, which over time meant a lot of crowns were needed to fix my smile), I can recommend this practice wholeheartedly. They use up-to-the-minute techniques and equipment, and the entire office is efficient, professional, and humane in its treatment of patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sidney M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
At my first appointment at the downtown Lakeway Smiles office the staff was very accommodating, polite, and informative and I will definitely return for all my future dental services.

Unfortunately, I showed up a little late to my teeth cleaning appointment, but regardless I was given quality care and didn’t feel rushed at all. After my examination the dentist and her assistant carefully explained to me what they found in my x-rays, physical examine and what my next course of action should be to best address my dental issues. Upon checkout, one of the receptionists was very thoughtful and helped me find a great oral surgeon nearby and even called to set up an appointment for me. She also chatted with me more about future oral care at home and provided me with the costs of all my future procedures so I could better plan and save.

I can honestly say the cleaning I received was quick, efficient, and utterly painless. And the overall assistance I got was genuine and remarkably noteworthy. I advise anyone needing dental assistance to call Lakeway Smiles as they have now gained just one more committed customer, me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karlee Dahlstrom
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I called this office as a potential new patient, referred from a periodontist and could not have had a more unprofessional experience talking with the coordinator on the phone. I informed her I was looking to have 10-20 cosmetic veneers, and that I was looking to have a DDS work along side my periodontist to ensure the best treatment. Instead of acknowledging that, she gave me steps to follow to fill out forms online and to upload photos of my smile prior to the consultation. When I asked if she wanted the information of my periodontist for my FMX, CT, and treatment plan (which is very extensive) she did not take it, and told me the doctor would request if he needed it. I told her I would prefer if Dr Tejas would have my tx plan from her prior to him making one for me (I want them to work together) she told me she’s worked in the field for 32 years.

Sadly, I will not be taking this referral recommendation and did not appreciate the unprofessional coordinator on the phone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Stone
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I first moved to Austin...I needed a dentist. I forget how Austin Cosmetic Dentistry popped up (formerly Lakeway Smiles when I first scheduled an appointment) and I discovered they offer THE BEST dental care in Austin. They are attentive to your needs, thorough with cleaning, provide amazing customer service, and really care about your teeth. My teeth are in probably the best shape they have ever been since going to them. I highly recommend them if you need a dentist in the Austin area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Hildreth
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel and his staff are not only personable, but considerate of every individual that walks through the door. They make you feel right at home, and are always happy to answer questions/ concerns. Not only will you experience incredible customer service, but you will walk away feeling like a new person. Dr. Patel’s close attention to detail is what separates his work from the rest. I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Price
user_reviews_extended.Description: I lucked out when I found Dr. Patel and his staff.  Carmen in reception makes you feel like family the moment you walk in the door.   I have been a patient here for over 5 years and I wouldn't think about letting anyone else take care of my dental needs.  Great job, Dr. Patel!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Fisher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Visiting Lakeway Smiles in the downtown location is a very refreshing experience.  The Zen-like décor is very attractive and calming and the panoramic view of downtown Austin from the ninth floor in each of the dental rooms is beautiful, even on rainy days.  The modern up-to-date equipment is the final touch to a very progressive dental practice!

Dr. Patel is amazing and so personable.  He makes you feel very comfortable and explains in detail at each visit what procedures he will be performing.  He will also answer all of your questions.  He makes going to the dentist a very pleasant
experience.

The people who support Dr. Patel are amazing!  His dental hygienist,
Allison, and my family go way back.  Her first job out of college was
with Dr. Alexander.  My husband started going to Dr. Alexander when
he was 16 years old.  Once we married, I became a patient also as
did our two daughters when they were of age.  Allison is, without a
doubt, the “cream of the crop” when it comes to cleaning teeth.  It is always
fun to go for our semi-annual cleanings and get caught up from where we
left of with Allison during the previous visit.

Also supporting Dr. Patel are Laura and Stacy.  We have known Laura
for many years, too.  When Dr. Alexander was contemplating retirement,
he brought Dr. Haddad into the practice.  Once Dr. Haddad moved to the
downtown location, Laura joined the staff.  Laura is very sweet and caring.
and she has a great sense of humor.  Once Dr. Patel took over the practice
when Dr. Haddad retired, then Stacy joined the staff.  Stacy is a gem.

The thing I noticed when I first went to Lakeway Smiles was that it was
such a happy atmosphere with everyone always smiling – beautiful,
pearly-white smiles.  What a great advertisement for Dr. Patel’s dental
practice!

I highly, highly recommend Lakeway Smiles and Dr. Patel and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krystal M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Patel is THE GOAT!!! I have searched years for someone to do my veneers and this man wowed me. Everybody is saying my teeth are beautiful. I’m smiling at everyone I see now, and that’s something that I never did before. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND Dr. Patel, you won’t regret it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Mayorga
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Patel is amazing! His entire staff makes the process so easy. My only regret is not doing my bottom teeth at the same time 😂. Don’t wait too long, if you know you want to do it, call them right away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: richard matta
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best Dentist EVER!!

Dr. Patel fixed 3 of my teeth that needed to be removed and replaced them with an awesome smile! It has been 2 years since they were put it and they're still strong and white. Highly recommended!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelley Stalder
user_reviews_extended.Description:
What a delight to find two great dentists and a professional and cheerful staff all within walking distance of my office downtown!

The office manager, Laura, treats me like family instead of a patient number.  My Hygienist, Allison, is always pleasant and speaks Mouthfullatools fluently!

Drs. Patel and Johnson (Dr. Kaye) have both had to put up with me and I've been very pleased with both.  Its a good thing too, cause we're going to be seeing a lot of each other.

Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dave Kunz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I broke a front tooth and came to Doc Patel to get it fixed. It was too far gone to repair so he had to remove it and start the process of replacing it with an implant. It involved a 10 month sequence of removing the old tooth, grafting more bone into the root cavity, letting the graft grow in, setting an anchor in the grafted bone, designing and ordering a replacement to match the removed tooth and eventually fitting the replacement to the anchor. It was almost a perfect match and required only some minimal sculpting to perfect it. Doc did the whole process expertly with as little pain as could have been expected.. In addition It's always a pleasure to visit with Doc Patel and his very skilled and professional technicians.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Raney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in to get impressions made for Invisalign treatment.  Kalyn did the impressions. She is professional, explained each step in process, was gentle making the impressions.  Dr Patel came in and looked at molds and reviewed w me what next steps will be.  He's great, as always.  I know what to expect and am confident the Invisalign procedure is needed and appropriate.  All office staff are helpful, knowledgable abt work I'm having done.  As always, they actually listen to patients, a rare skill.  Really good service and really talented at dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suzy Stone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had the absolute pleasure of speaking with KELLY yesterday on a FaceTime phone consultation. She is such an incredibly informative, professional, sweet and wonderful person!  Her sincerity was fabulous. Look forward to discovering more.! Customer Service 10 out of 10!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oscar Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came in after chipping the face of one of my front teeth and Dr. Patel did an amazing job of helping it look like nothing ever happened. I had a little trouble with it at first but the office made it extremely easy to come back in for minor adjustments.
I would 100% recommend friends and family to try this dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morgan Bayer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I LOVE this dentist! Every time I go, I feel very welcomed. Everyone's always smiling, friendly and professional. Customer service means everything to me and I always get the best at Dr. Patel's office :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Springer
user_reviews_extended.Description: While my experience has been nothing short of 5 stars (criteria being: end result / diagnostics / options / patient care / latest technology / cost / location / ease of scheduling / great team & environment) I know of at least 10 others whom also have Dr. Patel as their DDS and would agree with a 5 star rating.  My only regret: not finding out about Dr. Patel & team much earlier in my search for quality dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deanna V
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist EVER!!!! :) I love him and the office staff, they make me feel comfortable and calm.  I will NEVER go to another dentist. If you are having problems deciding, just go, meet him and his office staff, you will love them too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Incredible Doctor and amazing staff!! I have been to Dr. Patel’s office a number of times! They are always very friendly and accommodating! Beautiful location downtown with amazing views of the city!! A great place to chill and get your dental work done!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kelly westmoreland
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this team! They are so sweet, and they genuinely want to help you reach your goals when it comes to your smile. This is the first time in my life I have loved going to my dentist- for not only the regular cleaning a but they rock at anything cosmetic as well!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tenecia Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel is hands down THE BEST!! He completely transformed my whole smile..I have gotten sooo many compliments..Best money ever spent!! And let me not forget his staff; they are completely awesome..Love them ALL!!❤️

title: High Point Dentistry
address: 2719 E 7th St, Austin, TX 78702, United States

user_reviews.Name: Celina Garcia
user_reviews.Description: Recently went in as a new patient and I was very happy with my experience. All staff were very professional and friendly. I felt comfortable there and really liked that things were explained to me during my cleaning as well as after for the financial aspect. I highly recommend this practice as they are honest, professional and compassionate. Thank you all.

user_reviews.Name: Leanne Molini
user_reviews.Description:
High Point Dentistry is amazing! From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel comfortable and taken care of. Everyone was friendly, patient, and professional. They explained everything clearly and made sure I understood what was going on with my teeth. The office is clean, modern, and the whole vibe is calm and welcoming.

I hadn’t been to the dentist in a while, but they never made me feel judged, just supported. They helped me figure out what I needed, and the care I received was top-notch. I’m really grateful for how smooth and stress-free they made the whole experience.

Highly recommend High Point Dentistry to anyone looking for a place that truly cares about their patients!

user_reviews.Name: Mark Norman
user_reviews.Description: So I chose this dentist office because it’s just a 3 block walk from my home, but I keep coming back because it’s awesome in every way. The cleaning is thorough and comfortable. The exam is also thorough and they make sure I understand the results. They listen and they’re helpful. But the best part is how friendly everyone is here. I don’t you can make a better dentist office.

user_reviews.Name: Michael Canton
user_reviews.Description:
I want to give a special shout-out to Dr. Kaiser. She is the first truly patient-friendly dentist I’ve had, and she made me feel comfortable and genuinely cared for from the start.

I’d also like to say that everyone in the office is incredibly kind and welcoming. From the moment you walk in, you feel at ease. There’s never a sense that you’re being “sold” services you may or may not need—everything is transparent and clearly explained. Overall, this is by far the friendliest and most trustworthy dental office I’ve worked with, and I can wholeheartedly recommend them.

user_reviews.Name: Rose Valdez
user_reviews.Description: My visit today went very well. The staff at the front desk are always very nice. And my dentist hygienist always makes me feel comfortable She’s always very sweet does a great job cleaning my teeth. thanks to everyone keep up the good work.🙏🏼👏😊

user_reviews.Name: Emily Wood
user_reviews.Description: This dentistry practice is taking advantage of people. I arrived at my appointment only to realize I no longer had dental insurance (my own error). I explained the situation to the woman at the front desk. She refused to waive the same day cancellation fee of $50. I had no intention of not showing up for my appointment. Instead, I arrived and chose not to go through with the appointment because I did not want to use their in-house insurance or pay out-of-pocket. I understand the policy for no-shows, but blatantly disregarding my situation is truly intensive. I do not recommend this practice if you’re looking for an administrative policy that works with people their changing situations. I will not be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Schuster
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This practice used to be really nice. After the acquisition, I've ran into issues. I am no longer a patient now.

Overcharged
I was overcharged for a fluoride treatment. My EOB clearly states I owe a lower amount for the treatment than I was charged.

Billing No Help
Billing claimed they didn't get the EOB from my insurance and were very dismissive. I don't believe they looked at the copy of the EOB I sent them. I followed up offering help to get the EOB from my insurance, but was ignored. I just forwarded the email chain to the same practice email I sent them. Maybe I won't be ignored this time.

Still No Help
I cancelled my appointment and informed the practice l would no longer be a patient and why. Someone took a look and still thought I was wrong. Life is stressful enough without added stress from dealing with your dentist. Maybe someone at the practice will read this and take a closer look.

Broke HIPPA?
Oh and pretty sure they broke HIPPA with my husband. They called me to confirm his appointment. If this had been an appointment of sensitive nature, that would have been really bad.

Update: Practice still refuses to acknowledge that they can not charge me more than the amount l owe per my EOB.
My phone number is only on my account. If I'm on my husband's as an emergency contact, an appointment confirmation is not a reason to contact me.
Very dissatisfied with owner response. Will be calling. Very glad I left.

if you're looking for a dentist or are unhappy with your current one I would highly recommend Dr. Necker and Central Family Dental Center.

title: Dr. Kenneth Schaefer DDS
address: 1605 Nueces St, Austin, TX 78701, United States

user_reviews.Name: AM NOYB
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Schaefer has been our family dentist for over 20 years. Staff is great and friendly. He's on point and honest. Like I said we've been going to him for a long time and he's never steered is wrong. We recommend highly.

user_reviews.Name: Rebecca MacKay
user_reviews.Description: I originally went to Kenneth to fix noticeable flaws in my front teeth. On the last appointment, he drilled into my central incisor while filling a cavity in my lateral incisor. When I went in to get it fixed, Kenneth insisted that the hole already existed. He showed me an x-ray (in which there was no huge divot in my tooth) and tried to tell me that it showed the hole. I have a photo of my tooth before the visit, and there is no noticeable divot. I also floss every morning and night - that morning before the visit there was no catch on that tooth when I flossed, and now there is. He said that he would fix it for free (a strange offer if he genuinely believes the hole already existed) but insisted that it was not him that caused it. I left because I no longer found Kenneth trustworthy, and didn’t want him anywhere near my teeth ever again.

user_reviews.Name: Sue Singh
user_reviews.Description:
I am glad i found this dentist in Austin. He explains each step in very simple vocabulary before doing the procedure and during the procedure. He greets with a smile and is in time. No long waitings
Does not offer unnecessary procedures and his rates are reasonable too. I will give him 5/5

user_reviews.Name: PavelQR
user_reviews.Description: Seriously, Dr. Schaefer is the bee's knees! He's super knowledgeable, explains everything clearly, and his office might not be the fanciest but that's because he's an honest man that puts his patients' mouth pearls before profit. I felt heard, understood, and left knowing what was going on with my health. Finding a dentist this good is like finding a unicorn riding a bicycle – rare and awesome. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Anaís Castellanos
user_reviews.Description: Love this place! It's a family practice, so every visit feels more like catching up with friends. They do solid work and are super considerate when it comes to budgets—no pressure, just honest advice, even if it means referring you to someone else.

user_reviews.Name: T Brian
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Schaefer always has my best interest in mind. He is so attentive and patient, and will thoroughly explain all the procedures to me so I can decide what’s best for my teeth. All the staff here are super nice as well. I go to UT so I just picked the closest dentist near campus when my tooth was hurting, but my visits here have been extremely pleasant and I highly recommend this place.

user_reviews.Name: Mark Feist
user_reviews.Description: I grew up with a family dentist my entire life (58 years) that put saving your natural teeth as his top priority, but he finally retired 4 years ago. I've been looking for a dentist in Austin with absolutely no luck since then.  Dr. Schaefer is a dentist with old fashion dentist values / ethics. You know, when dentist actually tried to help people save their natural teeth and not replace them so they can take the family to Cancun. He truly has an interest in you... and your teeth. He does not try to upsell you on procedures you do not need and spends a lot of time explaining to his patients the health of their mouth as he honestly sees it while looking at x-rays together. Today I found the dentist I have been looking for finally. Thank you for your honesty Dr. Schaefer... I will see you again in 6 months.

user_reviews.Description: My husband has been seeing Dr Schaefer for over 25 years. I've been seeing him for over 15 years. My boys also started seeing him when they were a little older. Everyone at this office is wonderful from front desk, to hygienists and of course, Dr Schaefer has great bedside manner and explains everything and is thorough. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Johnson Jr
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Dr.Pradeeep for years and I love her. She is so nice and gentle. Her work is always great and she has a good team. If you need a dentist in the Austin area Aqua Dental is the place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jadyn Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was a UT student looking for dental places near campus and came across this one, assuming it would be good due to its great reviews. Turns out, while they’re getting you ready to leave, the hygienist pressures you into writing a review on Google and even checks for proof, which probably explains why there’s so many good ones.

The main reason why I came to them was for a consultation about a possible cavity on my molars. After the consultation, I left with them telling me I had 1 cavity that needed to be filled, and was given a quote. I came back in for my next appointment to get that cavity filled, and all of a sudden, I actually had TWO cavities to be filled. I asked how much it’d cost and figured getting that cavity filled sooner rather than later would be helpful. But after I got those two cavities filled (mind you, the surfaces of them feel completely different compared to my own molars— they’re smooth and no prominent ridges), they then told me I had THREE MORE to fill. I should’ve known when I miraculously had another cavity to fill, but it was ridiculous to hear.

I went to a trusted dentist back in my hometown many months after that and they said I had no cavities, so i’m highly suspicious about what they told me. The staff there are all lovely, especially the front desk staff. It’s just disappointing seeing how they try to get every single penny out of their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jane Tabb
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone I interacted with including Dr Pradeep was very kind during my visit. The cleaning seemed very good and the dentist answered all of my questions. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Clean, friendly and competent! Dr. Pradeep clearly cares deeply about her patients. She always makes sure I’m comfortable and understand everything before she starts. Everyone in the office is friendly and easy to communicated with.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Gone here for a year and had a few cleanings and a handful of fillings done. The office is alright, the staff has seemed to completely turned over within the year I have been here. I don't like the care provided mainly because the doctor doesn't try very hard to provide you with information. However, she did make sure to shame me for having plaque build up and tell me how I should cut down on sugar.
I came back in a month or so after getting a filling done (by her) to describe a problem with sensitivity and floss getting stuck, and she just told me she didn't see a problem.
She also told me I have really bad wear on my teeth and proposed their expensive mouth guard. After receiving a second opinion from a practicing dentist they said they didn't agree at all.
I know doctors have varying opinions, and I don't think the doctor has any ill-will. But it seems the practice is more catered to making money as opposed to assisting their patients in regards to their concerns and goals. I normally only write reviews when I had a sub-par experience and I won't be coming back here.

She values the quality of her work.  I am happy she is my dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddy Hudson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m a student at UT, and I started Invisalign treatment here after Dr Pradeep insisted on it multiple times. I started the treatment right before summer 2023 started. Since I left Austin for an internship that summer, I apparently lost my insurance coverage and as a result, Dr Pradeep’s office claims that I owe them a good chunk of my Invisalign treatment fees.

I understand if this is indeed true. But why wait till a whole year has passed to let me know that I owe them more than a thousand dollars in fees? If they had notified me immediately that their insurance claims were being denied I would’ve stopped Invisalign treatment right away, and started it after leaving school. Feels like I got pressured to do Invisalign, and then surreptitiously tricked into staying till the end.

I got the pdf statement from the dentist’s office, and I see that I was being billed for each and every single visit however perfunctory. All the while they knew that there were issues with my insurance billing and yet they kept adding stuff to my bill. This just reeks of deceptive business practices.

Aside from the billing and finance issues, the quality of care has also significantly gone down over the years. The quality of my second Invisalign attachment points were awful (with ragged and sharp edges). I had to come back and get it touched up. The heat gun they used the second time round was actually painful. My final appointment a few days ago was also a mess. The person taking the impression of my teeth was actually hurting me as she pressed the mould down on my lower set of teeth, and she appeared frustrated when I told her this. There were also random last minute schedule changes in the last year.

All in all, this has just been a pretty awful experience for me.

user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Description: My family has been with Aqua Dental since I was a child and we love Dr. Pradeep. From the front desk to the dental hygienists, everyone is always so kind and respectful. If I could recommend any dentist office it would be this one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reno Navales
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been a regular at Aqua Dental for over four years, and the transformation in my dental health has been nothing short of remarkable. Before coming to this practice, I used to experience constant tooth pain and had issues with bleeding gums that made eating an ordeal. However, since being under the care of Dr. Pradeep, all those problems have vanished. Thanks to their Invisalign treatment and aftercare, my teeth are not only clean but also straight, boosting my confidence immeasurably.

The office at Dr. Pradeep's practice maintains an immaculate environment. I've never had to wait for my appointments; they are always punctual and provide plenty of reminders, which is incredibly helpful in today's busy world. This punctuality, combined with their transparency in billing and willingness to answer insurance questions, creates a smooth and stress-free experience from start to finish.

What sets this practice apart is the personal touch. Dr. Pradeep isn't just a dentist to me; she's become a friend who genuinely cares about me and my well-being. She always inquires about my life and has even gone above and beyond by supporting my art, which has meant the world to me.

In terms of professionalism, comfort, and care, Aqua Dental stands unparalleled. Dr. Pradeep and her team have not only improved my dental health but have also played a significant role in enhancing my overall quality of life. I can't thank them enough and would highly recommend them to anyone in need of dental care. Thank you Dr. Pradeep!

title: Swish Dental East 4th
address: 1800E E 4th St Unit 136, Austin, TX 78702, United States

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Perez
user_reviews.Description:
Disappointing experience at Swish on 4th. I went in for a routine cleaning at 10:00 AM and didn’t leave until 11:51 AM — nearly two hours for a basic cleaning is unacceptable.

They were clearly short-staffed, with only one dentist and not enough hygienists for the number of patients scheduled. The staff kept apologizing and thanking me for my patience, which I appreciate, but apologies do not fix the issue.

If you know you’re understaffed, you shouldn’t schedule so many appointments at once. Better scheduling and management would make a big difference. Unfortunately, this missed the mark.

user_reviews.Name: Tiffany Wooten
user_reviews.Description: Everyone at Swish is always amazing. They are welcoming, seeming to genuinely care about us and how we are. They remember our family, share kind words and compliments, and are very professional. They’ve never made any of our family of 4 feel anything but kindness and calm, which is not easy for a dentist! Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: M C
user_reviews.Description: Both my hygienist, bless her heart, she had a tough job on my teeth, it had been too long, and the doctor were excellent. They couldn’t have been more knowledgeable or accommodating. Bedside manner and professionalism were exactly as one would hope for. Forgive me I don’t have their names with me, but my initials are C.M. and my appointment was earlier today at 2pm  E 4th st location.

user_reviews.Name: Andrea Jaquez
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Springer and Yusuf were so so friendly and great! I had to get a tooth that has chipped too many times filled again which is usually long and uncomfortable. They got it done super quick and easy and the results look great!

I went here after having a bad experience at the Brodie location and I couldn’t recommend this location more. The entire team was very communicative, friendly, professional, and made everything simple from start to finish. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Paula De La Torre
user_reviews.Description: I went to the Swish Dental East 4th location and my visit was easy and efficient! Tyler was incredible. He helped me book the appointment and made me feel so comfortable. Also shout out to the other staff, everyone at this office was so sweet. I can’t wait for my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: V. Ram
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve always had a phenomenal experience when visiting Swish, until my last visit. The assistant/tech (her name was Veronica I think) was beyond incompetent. She spent 20 minutes trying to scan my teeth and take X-rays, rubbing my mouth with the plastic apparatus back and forth, hurting my mouth and still couldn’t get it done. She called another person to help her, and he did the entire scan in less than 2 minutes. When polishing my teeth, she kept missing my teeth and instead polished the outside of my mouth, scratching my face. During my cleaning, her belly was resting on the crown of my head, which was awkward. During the swishing part, barely added any water to my mouth so that I could properly rinse. I’ve now had a sore on my mouth since that visit that hasn’t gone away. I’m certain it was due to Veronica’s uncleanliness or bad habits when handling my mouth.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Your billing department is very poor in settling down claims with Dental insurance company.

Finally I got involved and brought down insurance & your team memebrs to settle down it. Your team members inserted incorrect address of your location and that was considered as out of network. After discussion, they realized that mistake but still bugging me pay the money since the claims are not settled down yet. Very fustrated your service and wouldn't visit and recommend anyone to avail your services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kyle church
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The only reason I’m giving Swish 2 stars is because of my first few visits, which were genuinely great. I hadn’t been able to afford dental care for a few years, so I was nervous about going back and worried it would be an uncomfortable process. I ended up needing a deep cleaning and was told it might be a little painful because of the plaque buildup. Thankfully, my first hygienist was amazing—she made me laugh through the entire two-hour appointment and helped me forget the discomfort. She even came up with a plan to make it easier for me to keep up with cleanings.

When I came back three months later, I saw a different hygienist who was also very friendly and did a wonderful job. Those early experiences instilled a great deal of trust and confidence in Swish. I decided to return for a third cleaning, and unfortunately, that experience was one of the worst I’ve ever had.

I have a permanent retainer that’s been fused to my front teeth since I was 13 (I’m now 36). It has always been a sensitive area and a challenge to clean, so I make sure to tell every hygienist ahead of time to please be careful around it. This time, however, my hygienist never introduced herself, wasn’t friendly, and didn’t ask how things had been going. After taking scans and briefly pointing out a few issues—though overall my gums were showing improvement—she proceeded to give me the most brutal cleaning I’ve ever experienced. I kept expressing my discomfort and reminding her about my permanent retainer, but it didn’t seem to matter. She applied so much pressure to that area that I was bleeding more than I had during my original two-hour deep cleaning.

At the end of the appointment, she told me not to worry about my permanent retainer because it was “no longer attached to each other.” I was shocked. I floss between those teeth at least twice a day—including right before this visit and it was entirely attached. When I asked how this could be possible, she didn’t answer my question and instead brought in a dentist. Rather than explaining, he shifted the conversation to an old filling he said needed to be replaced. When I asked again about my retainer, he implied it was already ruined due to poor care on my part, which was confusing since my previous and even the current hygienist had told me everything looked great. I left upset, frustrated, and now worried about whether my teeth will shift.

Because of this, I will be canceling my Swish Membership and unfortunately cannot recommend their services.

Highly recommend to anyone, especially those who struggle with dental fear , you’ll be in great hands.

I’ve also been working with her on my Invisalign journey, and her attention to detail and encouragement have made such a difference. She’s always patient, upbeat, and genuinely invested in her patients’ progress. Her office is welcoming, her team is incredible, and you can really feel that she loves what she does. user_reviews_extended.Description:
had such high hopes when I chose Swish Dental for my dental care, but sadly, my experience has left me feeling frustrated, disrespected, and emotionally drained. I was literally crying at the Pflugerville location, questioning if I made the right decision trusting Swish with something so important and personal to me.

I’ve had tooth problems since I was young, and my smile is something that I’ve always been very sensitive and emotional about. This journey meant a lot to me—not just medically, but personally. But what I experienced at Swish was a complete breakdown in communication and professionalism…………

UPDATE: After sharing my concerns, Swish Dental really listened. They were super helpful and made sure I was taken care of. I feel so much better now—thank you to Shanita and Bailey for always listening to my concerns and making sure everything is good. Thank you 💙

user_reviews_extended.Name: jaime evans
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so glad I found this location. Vicky, Tyler and Dr. nick were all so kind and made me feel like I was really being cared for. I went to another location and did not have this same experience. I almost looked for a whole different company but decided to try the 4th st location. I’m so glad did I actually look forward to continuing my dental journey because of this incredible staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucie Cantrell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have nothing but great things to say about my experience at Swish Dental East. I haven't been very consistent with my dentist appointments in recent years after some poor experiences. With that being said, the new patient process at Swish was excellent.

I was given x-rays and an exam to begin. I spoke with both a hygienist (Vicky) and dentist (Dr. Tina), who put together a care plan. Then, another member of the team came in to explain the costs of everything, including what would and would not be covered by insurance. I was given the option to select which options worked for me, and proceed from there.

I then had a cleaning with Vicky, who was absolutely wonderful. She took her time to explain the different steps of the cleaning to me, and made sure to pause often to check if I was comfortable. In addition to all of this, the space was clean and fun, with music playing and nice decor. All of the staff I interacted with were kind and helpful. I am excited to have finally found a dentist I can get into a good routine with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nishan Thapa
user_reviews_extended.Description: After my husband raved about this place, I went in for my first dental cleaning and exam. I had the BEST experience and was met with staff from check-in to check-out that were incredibly sweet, warm, and welcoming. I really appreciated the dentist and how thorough she was. Had the pleasure of having Vicky as my dental hygienist! She was super kind, gentle, thorough and made the whole experience extremely easy. I actually enjoyed the conversations in-between the cleaning and you can tell that she genuinely cares about her patients. I was provided a lot of insight into ways that I can maintain my dental health. Already looking forward to the next cleaning in 6 months. Thank you Vicky and Swish Dental!

I got to watch a show while getting my teeth done, which made the whole experience even more amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Higbie
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was very friendly and not pushy. They even added a cleaning in for me last minute so I didn’t have to come back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerrica Newkirk
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was hands-down, the best dentist appointment I’ve ever had. This is my first time at swish. I’ve gone to another dentist for some time and after having a pretty decent experience but towards the end, they started trying to upsell and say I needed work done that I didn’t. I ended up at swish at first for an outside opinion, but this will now be my dental office.

First and foremost, the customer service was amazing. Every single person was super nice. I didn’t wait for very long and while I was waiting at least four different employees walked past me and greeted me with a smile and hello.

My dental assistant, Crystal was absolutely amazing. From the very beginning, she wanted to try to make the process as seamless as possible. With x-rays she was super efficient and even at one point when she was struggling, she pulled someone else in immediately to help. This also stood out to me because a lot of times dentist office are very busy and you can feel it. Despite the fact that every chair was full in the office at the time, they didn’t hesitate to come over and help.

Dr. Sarah was amazing. She was super nice, very informative, and overall cared more about my dental health, then the most expensive treatments. Dental work can obviously be very expensive and I never felt pressured to make a big financial decision. She constantly presented multiple solutions to allowing me to choose. My last dentist office told me I needed to get four of my crowns replaced. Dr. Sarah informed me that that didn’t need to happen right away and proposed other solutions to make sure my teeth stayed as healthy as possible.

My treatment plans were laid out to me by the front desk assistant, whose name I wasn’t able to grab, but was just as amazing as Dr. Sarah and Crystal.  She didn’t over or under explain and she left the ball in my court for treatments I wanted to receive.

All in all, it was the most comfortable, high-quality, easy dental experience I’ve ever had. Tens all around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Basti
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Allie and Ana are wonderful - so friendly and made it feel like I was hanging out with a friend instead of being at the dentist.

Special shout out to Shanita & Bailey for answering all my questions and being extremely helpful.

The rest of the team is prompt, personable, friendly, and comforting as well. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Jennings
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit was a great experience! Everyone was so nice but especially Ana!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larry DeHoyos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a not so favorable experience a time ago with another location of Swiss Dental, but this visit made up for it 100% … Thank you !!!  Great service and all treatments fully explained to help make the best decisions and there was no feeling of a sales pitch at all …

user_reviews_extended.Name: J W
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got a comprehensive exam and full cleaning on my first visit. I saw the dental assistant that took my x-rays and the hygienist came in to check my teeth and advise on cleaning, the Dr. came in to discuss my x-rays and give me an oral cancer screening and finished up with the hygienist that was very thorough and made my smile brighter. It was a well-orchestrated operation with modern tech and although I changed hands a few times, never was I waiting for very long. Great option if you're looking for a dentist in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sundi Wheatland
user_reviews_extended.Description: My hygienist and dentist were so gentle, informative, timely and I even made each laugh a little. The ambiance was nice, an informative video had my attention. New technology and tools allowed for a smooth cleaning without needing to ask me to bills anything. I’ll be back soon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience at Swish Dental on E 4th is nothing short of EXCELLENT. Prompt service, amiable dental assistants, knowledgeable and responsive front desk, tech-savvy processes.

I’ve been coming for almost 3 years now and even if I’ve moved and now have to drive longer just to make my appointments, switching dental offices never crossed my mind.

I specifically want to shout out Shanita and Marissa at the front desk for just being rockstars - always ready to help me out with schedule changes and receiving feedback on optimizing some of the processes!

Absolutely love and adore my dental team: Dr. Sara, Bailey and Savannah. I may or may not have taken naps during dental work because of how at ease I feel with them 🙏

11/10 recommend this office to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandria Sayegh
user_reviews_extended.Description: this is one of the best places I’ve gone to. when I walked in, everyone was so nice and welcoming. They did a couple of scans on me to make sure my teeth looked good, then were able to squeeze me in for a quick cleaning. i’m excited to go back in 6 months!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabe Farrell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic dental experience at Swish Dental. This place is extremely clean, well-kept, modern, and welcoming. The staff were super friendly and knowledgeable. The actual dental procedures went very smoothly and I felt comfortable the whole time. This place also seems to have the latest and greatest technology - they viewed 3D scans of my mouth on the monitor using the X-rays in real-time, and used AI to see the bite pressure on my teeth and help find where my cavities are! It was all very cool and I'm looking forward to my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chet Pettingill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my first experience with Swish dental. All of the employees were very polite. The dentist and hygienist were great at answering my questions and helping me map out a plan for my dental care. Their online checkin process made it so I was able to walk in  and get started as soon as I arrived. Would definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Enciso Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service, always feel better once I leave! The digital experience is very modern, and they staff is attentive the entire time. I highly recommend going to the east office. From the dentists to the hygienists, to the ambiance, technology, and furniture, this is a great place to maintain your dental health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jackie Neve
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Swish was really great. I went in for a consult and was in a ton of pain. They helped me get a referral right away for continuing care and built a treatment plan for me. I felt right at home and am looking forward to working with them in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Phan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been genuinely impressed with the staff and services at this facility. The level of attention and detailed information I've received is outstanding, truly setting them apart. The environment is not only clean but also equipped with high-tech features that provide a welcome distraction during procedures.

I attempted to have my mom receive her care here as well, but unfortunately, her insurance didn't cover everything needed. Despite this setback, the staff went above and beyond, offering comprehensive information on available services, specialist recommendations, and other viable alternatives. Their effort to assist, despite the insurance limitations, was remarkable and greatly appreciated.

I deeply wish my mom could join me here, purely for the convenience and the quality of care that I've come to trust and value. Highly recommended for anyone seeking top-notch medical care with a compassionate and informative approach.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bianca Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience friendly staff!! Will definitely be my new favorite dentist 🪥

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Ohrtman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a pleasant experience at Swish Dental East! I haven't been to a new dentist in awhile but needed to set something up since I just moved to Austin. It was easy to book with them online and, while there, the people were super nice and welcoming. They also had TVs with Netflix so I got to binge my favorite show during my cleaning ;) Even more so, there was a small mix-up when I first arrived and the office manager went out of her way to apologize and offer some free services to help- really incredible customer service in my opinion. I will be back and recommending to my friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: michael cowles
user_reviews_extended.Description: My long term dentist retired and this place was covered by my insurance so I gave it a try. This place has a ton of tech that they used on me, making me think that they would give me more accurate information. I was escorted through the many machines they used without really being told why they were necessary or how much they would cost, though I was told insurance would cover it. The diagnosis after all of that was that I had to get a crown on a tooth as soon as I could. Because I didn't feel all that confident in them, I went to another dentist to get a second opinion. She was much more low tech, took a look at with some old school x-rays and told me it was actually just a superficial cavity and did a quick filling. Much later, I got a hefty bill for this appointment for all the images, etc., even with great dental insurance. Had they not given me a seriously bad diagnosis, I would've been a little frustrated by the bills. As it is, I will be certain not to go back. I recommend finding a local dentist you trust.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margo Donnelly
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Friendly staff. Easy to communicate with. Prompt service.
Great hygienist and a really wonderful dentist.
Definitely recommend !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madisyn Horton
user_reviews_extended.Description: No one loves going to the dentist, but the team at Swish East make it such a great experience! This is the first dental office I’ve been to where they don’t just give you instructions, but they actually educate you on WHY it’s important to floss, walk you through your X-rays, and go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and relaxed during visits. I know each visit that I’ll leave informed about my dental health and always feel comfortable asking questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Morley
user_reviews_extended.Description: A baffling ordeal for a new patient appointment, you will NOT get a cleaning just a full hour of scans and measurements. Then you will have to book another appointment, and they will bill you for a "treatment" which will cost you out of pocket but there is no difference between this a regular cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vic
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience at this location. The staff is incredibly professional and friendly, making me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in. They are very time-conscious, ensuring appointments run smoothly and on schedule. I also appreciate their budget-friendly approach, offering clear pricing and options that fit my needs. Highly recommend for top-notch dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Belt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After my second visit at Swish East, I am finding a different dentist office. I’m incredibly disappointed at the lack of empathy from my hygienist and dentist, who would not complete my visit over something out of my control. I’m not sure how you can take X-rays and do an exam on a patient, but not complete their cleaning because of an issue I have. In fact, I was told they “typically don’t do cleanings” with issues like mine. So you pick and choose who you want to give a cleaning to with an issue like mine? Still unclear. I’ll give them the benefit of the doubt when they tried their best to explain why they wouldn’t do my cleaning, however, it still didn’t make sense since they already had their hands in my mouth from X-rays and an exam. I was lucky enough to be able to schedule a cleaning within two weeks & thankful I have a flexible job that let me take off again.

I have never had a problem with my issue at any other dentist office until today. It was extremely embarrassing, and I felt judged. I wasn’t given a chance to discuss anything. I was simply told it wasn’t a possibility, and that I should have called beforehand to clear something like this up before coming.

Outside of this, I was seen by a different hygienist during my second visit, which is unlike other experiences I’ve had at a dentist office and I prefer to be seen by the same hygienist. I would not recommend Swish East if you are looking for a small, hometown vibe. If this doesn’t matter to you then disregard.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing location! White glove service from start to finish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marty Z
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update:  I was recently seen at Swish Dental and am very happy with my care.  The hygienist was skilled and gentle with her work.  She explained everything as she worked which I appreciated.  The area is clean and the equipment is modern and updated.  The dentist who did my exam was thorough and pleasant.  My husband and I both use their inhouse dental plan which is reasonably priced and saves up a good deal on regular checkups and cleanings.  We will continue to be seen at this dental practice.

This is for my husband’s experience. Generally he is unhappy with going to the dentist. This time, he came home saying the experience was good. The hygienist and her assistant were efficient and helped make the cleaning comfortable. He will keep using this office for dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dimas Castillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been waiting for my new set of invisalign trays for over 3 months and till this day I have no idea what's going on. I paid off my account within 6 months and ever since then, the service has been mediocre. I was even charge $700+ more then amount owed and the only way I got my refund was because i saw on my bank statement a few months later. I would not recommend swish dental. They seem to care more about taking your money then providing honest service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geoffrey Belcher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Recently switched insurances and Swish is one of the few places where I am now covered. Was easy to make an appointment, staff was really friendly.
I didn't realize that the first appointment was more of a consultation where they take x-rays and do a 3D scan of your teeth. When I arrived I told them I really just needed a cleaning and would have a hard time scheduling an additional appointment due to moving soon. They were so accommodating answering any questions about their procedures. They squeezed me into their schedule on the spot and cleaned my teeth. Walked out with no extra fees, completely covered by insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: rosie garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was so excited to be able to get an appointment so fast since I was in so much pain..! And also, had  done exactly what I wanted ..! My dentist and staff are awesome and had very great customer service!
I will recommend to all my friends & family! ☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Siri Chakka
user_reviews_extended.Description: My regular dentist, they're awesome and modern and really easy to schedule and work with, been going here for years. Deciding to finally post a review because I had an exceptional appointment with Bailey this afternoon and wanted to give her a shout out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camille Chow
user_reviews_extended.Description:
One of the best dentists I’ve ever been to. They started right at my appointment time, were efficient with my x rays/cleaning, and transparent about billing (gave me a cost breakdown at the end of the appointment). I’ve been struggling with teeth sensitivity for years and no dentist has been able to help me. As soon as I saw the dentist at Swish he was able to diagnose my issue and schedule me for a follow up appointment.
All the staff was friendly and professional, and the office was clean and comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Mungujia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was visiting family in Austin and chipped a crown. SWISH got me in right away. The staff was super nice.
Dr. Loehr filed it down and said I could wait to have it replaced when I got back to Dallas.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lindgren
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ana was so sweet & made sure I was comfortable the whole time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Terrible experience !!!  It felt rushed during the cleaning. Not a friendly hygienist, event the doctor felt rushed.  I feel like my teeth did not get cleaned.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristal Offutt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Well, instead of private feedback surveys or responses to their unorganized texts I keep getting review requests to Google instead 🤷‍♀️

I used to love Swish. I was going to it before it was Swish up by the domain and then migrated even when I moved to South Austin. Over the last 2 years it’s just gone downhill. Idk what changed behind the scenes but here is my take from the years and years I’ve been with them:

1. Doctors are inconsistent now - I always used to have the same doctor and idk if they rotate or what happens but I seem to never see the same one.
2. They don’t talk about billing or the appt up front anymore. Even this morning I got asked THREE TIMES about my X-rays and visits and I had to educate them on THEIR systems that the local swishes don’t talk or share info with each other. I have ALWAYS been every 6 mo on the dot patient for 14 years. 😂
3. It wasn’t until after I was already brought back that they start throwing on the xray cover (also not needed if they just communicated) when all of a sudden I say no I don’t need X-rays and then they had to actively send someone else back for me to sign a waiver lol like again efficiency just add it to your stupid every appt paperwork or ask when I check in and save us all time and money.

I just think due to what I had experienced, to now, and the relentless texts and emails from different swishes because my normal one was booked so I had to go to one 1.5 miles away and they don’t talk to you anymore like a human, they don’t set the right customer journey expectations, etc. I’m just over it. I’ll find a new local dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Simmons
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great work! Amazing people! And very diligent work in fixing bite on new fillings. I had a filling fall out and they were able to accommodate me same day, your results may vary here, but they were very kind, thorough, and clear on instructions and what they were doing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this office, Vicky is the best! She always does a great job cleaning my teeth and she’s super nice. I needed a filling the last time I was there and Shanita did a great job explaining my insurance and payment information.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ad Glz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing service today, the staff was amazing and helpful explained everything they offered me and in detail.
I hated the dentist until my time with Swish, looking forward to the future visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keegan Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient at Swish Dental East for a few years now, and they are truly exceptional. Every visit is consistently pleasant, professional, and relaxed. Dr. Andrew and the staff are incredibly patient and kind. I highly recommend Swish Dental East to anyone seeking top-notch dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alejandra Amezola-Velazquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental on East 4th is fantastic! The staff there is so accommodating and understanding. My dentist was kind, informative, and personable during my first visit. I am a new patient to them but I can already say that I highly recommend!
