user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariposa Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Swish today for the first time for the full X-ray/cleaning routine and I have to say, from start to finish this team was really great. They answered my questions about insurance straight forwardly. The intake was easy. All of the staff are personable. J or Jay, who did my cleaning was gentle while explaining what I could do better in a clear and non-judgmental way. Dr. Andrew was efficient and seemed  kind. I also like that you get email and text communication and that the technology also worked. I’ve filled out client intake forms online before thinking that it will save me time only to find I have to do it all again on-site. I have a busy schedule and it’s nice when things like this work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Caldwell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am consistently impressed with the service and quality of care at Swish! Their hygienist and dentists are gentle, friendly and efficient. Superb bedside manner.

As a Member at Swish you get some great perks and the ease of access for making appointments, e-signing documents ect is so refreshing. You never feel like you are being up-sold treatment or being rushed/double booked with other patients - they are just awesome!

Highly highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tre' Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental in Austin off 4th st is AMAZING!!! From the booking, check in, actual appointment, and meeting with the business manager! I haven’t been to the dentist in about 7 years and TODAY was a reminder of why I love the dentist. Everyone was super kind and knowledgeable and made me feel very welcome even with not have been to the dentist is so long. Needless to say my next appointment is already booked and I’m now preparing for my Hollywood smile! Who knew scrolling on instagram would bring me to my new favorite dentist office! Thank you Swish and Team! 🫶🏾

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amna Khan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I understand the nerves that go with going to the dentist but this place is such a positive vibe that it kinda makes me look forward to my next cleanings! The staff is super duper friendly especially Tracey and Dr. Sara. Would definitely recommend this place to all of my friends and anyone who is looking for a different dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Barkley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Andy did good work installing the crown on my implant today. I recommend him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Afshad Dholakia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Seriously my favorite dentist - I've had a great experience with Dr. Burk and the rest of the team at Swish East. The office operations are efficient, the cleanings and exams are thorough, and I've never run into any issues with billing/payments. What more can you ask for?

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel Weinbrot
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience at Swish Dental on E 4th st. The entire staff was super friendly. Dr. Sara is a first-rate dentist. A real pro with a lovely bedside manner. I had a king-sized cavity in a molar, but she was able to save the tooth, no sweat. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Delany
user_reviews_extended.Description: I adore this place! I’m an absolute baby in that chair but they always make sure I feel comfortable and Dr Sara Burk is an angel and artist my teeth feel and look great! Every staff member has been so friendly and helpful I’m so appreciative of Swish for making a not so fun experience for me a good one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Bailey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a thorough cleaning. No cavities. Hygenist and other staff did well. Dentist told me about option for adjusting front overbite and some attrition on front teeth if I am interested. I didn't feel like there were any scams or upsells. Xrays and photos etc were fine. I would go again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Komal Shah
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience at Swish Dental East! I called prior to my appointment to inquire whether or not I could have my New Patient appt and cleaning on the same day, and they were very accommodating. Dr. Abigail and the hygienists (Amy and Jireh) were very thorough and informative. I appreciated their use of newer technology and 3D imaging! They offered me free custom whitening trays as a new patient; which I’ve never been offered at other offices. At the end of my visit, one of the staff members went over my insurance coverage and what my out of pocket cost would be if I pursued my suggested treatment plan. I found that very helpful and I appreciated her spending the time to review that information. I never once felt that the staff was “pushy”, everyone was extremely professional. I was very happy with my visit and look forward to the next one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica C
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first time at a new dental office in awhile and my experience was exceptional! The hygienist, Sam, was AMAZING!! I even got a little free marriage advice from him throughout my cleaning appt! I will definitely be going back to get my cleanings done there with Sam especially! The staff and Dr was awesome as well can’t forget them! Go to Swish Dental for all your teeth needs! 😉

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aabram Tierranegra
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to this Swish Dental East location for a few years now and I've always gotten great care. I don't usually write these reviews but I felt compelled to leave this review after Mallory (dental assistant) went out of her way to help me out on a last minute request. Great staff would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizette Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to get a wisdom tooth removed due to infection. Swish dental got me in as soon as possible. The staff was amazing and soothe my nerves as I have a fear of needles. I am a new patient as I am new to Austin, but I definitely will come to Swish for my dental needs in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Aguire
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great environment & experience thanks to staff including Dr Laurie & Yusuf.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ultima Castro
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updated visit September 2023:
The dental hygienist and dentist were once again super friendly and excellent. I'm thankful for their expertise and professionalism.

I did have a payment issue with my card- flagged their membership website as fraudulent. I'm not sure how their payment system but the front desk associate was clearly annoyed with the situation which was not the best experience - especially given that I haven't had a payment issue before. I'm sure it happens here and there so it would be great if there was a way to charge my card immediately through a other merchant/payment processor/method.

Previous review August 2022:
My visit was wayyyy overdue and the team at Swish- East made it simple and understandable. They explained every step and made me feel very comfortable with my treatment plan. Would recommend to anyone else who's been putting off their visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Ussery
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been using Swish for 2 years now and the dental work has been great. However, I have had a couple billing issues. I have found this frustrating, but management has reached out and corrected the issue. They do care about your experience and will do what they can to make things right. All in all great dental work and experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Babaeiha
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience today at the Swish East office. The office was beautiful, brand new and they had the latest equipment.

Veronica at the front was very nice, welcoming, and the staff were super professional.

Allie was very professional, competent, and friendly as she did my teeth whitening.

Dr. Shadman did a very good job explaining everything about my oral health and she got the procedure done in a timely and efficient manner. I am very happy and will recommend this office to anyone looking for a great dentist, staff and dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alea Laurence
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Swish dental was great! They were prompt in seeing me and great at explaining the procedures they were doing. I also appreciate that they did a cost breakdown for the work before they got started, as well as future fillings I would need.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Joyce
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone here was very professional and highly competent. They also use some wildly advanced tools (3-D modeling, etc.). My first visit was great.

My second with Vickie was amazing. She cleaned my teeth better than anyone ever has.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candace Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I needed emergency dental work and after searching online,I made the appointment. Filled with tears and anxiety(past history scarred me), the Swish East team walked me through the process. Although numb walking out from root canal, I thank them all.    I saw my treatment plan and will be going step by step until it's completed. Thank you for easing my nerves.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Lapitka
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have gotten both dental cleanings and Invisalign through Swish East - they've been great.  Dr. Andrew is who I've seen as a primary dentist, he's excellent.  All the staff I've encountered have been very friendly and the facility is very nice.  Almost makes me like going to the dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Gerhart
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience at this dental office! I've always had high anxiety going to the dentist, getting my teeth cleaned, and getting fillings done, but everyone here made me feel super comfortable and at ease. Amanda did my cleaning and I HIGHLY RECOMMEND - she was so gentle and very diligent. Dr. Shadman did my fillings and crowns and did an amazing job. She ensured there would be no pain and there wasn't! It was by far the best dental experience I've ever had. Thanks to this wonderful team of highly skilled individuals - I will most definitely be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mae Vela
user_reviews_extended.Description: Like many people I dread going to the dentist. As soon as I walked in I loved the atmosphere. It didn’t feel like the traditional, small rooms I was accustomed to being stuck in as a kid while waiting to be attended to. Some rooms had windows which I thought was amazing! They have TVs as well which contributes to keeping a very welcoming, warm, and casual environment. As soon as I sat down, I was asked what I wanted to watch. Sitting comfortably in the chair and watching Netflix felt more like a break from work rather than a dentist appointment! Aside from the vibes, they were incredibly informative. They reviewed the scans of my teeth and broke everything down for me, walking me through exactly what I was looking at. I highly recommend this place. If you’re looking for a dentist that has both a cozy atmosphere and friendly, knowledgeable staff, this place is for you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jadyn Brittner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Everyone is so nice and helpful. LEMME TELL YOU THOUGH.. if you want the cleaning of your LIFE.. Jerry the hygienist is amazing. She talks you through everything and gives amazing and thoughtful advice. My teeth have never felt so clean.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Reese
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I felt like a product - swallowed, chewed up, and spat out of factory - by going here. I've been going for 3 years now, because at least the cleanings were done well, but enough is enough; I'm going to be switching to a dentist that treats me like a human.

Some examples from this last visit:
1. I asked the hygenist to turn off the TV because I wasn't interested in it, but instead she brought it over and turned it so it was 2ft in front of my face when I was laying down for the cleaning so that I was "distracted for the procedure."
2. Being handed off from tech to tech for no reason several times, losing time in between.
3. Arriving 5 minutes before my 6-month-old appointment, and still not getting taken in until 20 minutes after it was supposed to start.
4. Generally nice but inauthentic conversations with the tech and dentist, making me feel like just another cog coming through the machine.

I get the concept they're trying to go for here, and I was hopeful that they'd figure it out a little better, which is why I kept going. But unfortunately that didn't come before my patience ran out, so it's time for me to move on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caroline
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Swish Dental (East) for the first time in January/2021 and had such a great experience. The dentists I usually saw in the past kept the atmosphere serious as well as conversation to minimum. So I was surprised when SAM came in and not only did a great job on my teeth but chatted with me the entire time. It definitely made me relax and be comfortable while in the chair. This was my favorite dental experience I've had thus far and wish I wasn't moving soon so that I could be a regular customer. Highly recommend Sam as he knows his stuff and is also very friendly! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taponne
user_reviews_extended.Description: This clinic and the other 2 (Brodie and Mueller Family) are always clean and friendly. So long as you show up on time and don't cause an issue, the staff makes everything SO easy for you. Just let them do their work, watch Cake Boss, and sit back and relax. Seriously be grateful there are people willing to do this kind of work. We'd all be pretty screwed otherwise. 😂

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Pham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Honestly, the staff here are really great and the New Patient exam is very detailed with lots of images. However, I'm very disappointed with the structure of the New Patient Appointment and lack of communication around not having a cleaning in the first visit.

The first visit is filled with lots of pictures, x-rays, and 3D models. They measure your gum health and look at the overall health of your teeth.

The office space and attention to details is phenomenal, but not doing cleaning in the same visit feels like a huge violation of patient expectations.

Please find a way to list this on your website or communicate what to expect in a New Patient Visit. If time doesn't permit for both imaging and cleaning, then allow people to schedule BOTH the imaging and the cleaning at the same time to reduce scheduling headaches.

UPDATE 7/12/21:

The same day I posted the first review, Adrian, their Operations Manager reached out. He was understanding, apologetic and quick to action.

He let me know that there were some processes that were missed which led to my one-off experience that he was going to improve. Adrian rescheduled me for an earlier cleaning and offered a complimentary whitening as well. He even stopped by to check in on me during the visit!

The staff at Swish Dental again proved to be very kind, communicative, and accommodating. They demonstrated an impressive ability to act quickly to turn a disappointing experience to a 5-star patient experience.

Many healthcare organizations could learn a lot about patient experience from the team here.

By the way they’ve handle this, they’ve also convinced wife to become a future patient at Swish Dental East. Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cecilie Desabris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first cleaning with Swish was so great! Staff were so nice, very transparent, and overall were super professional. The east location is so cute with their neon signs and stylish lobby. I even got to watch my favorite TV show while they did the cleaning. Definitely a huge upgrade from the dentist office I’ve been going to since I was 10!

Thanks to the Swish team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachael Shah
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was my first time at Swish Dental East and I actually enjoyed my visit. I haven’t been to the dentist in some time and also suffer dental anxiety, but the entire staff made me feel comfortable and at ease. Dr. Andrew and his staff
explained all my options and provided me with great care! 100% recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kellie Roop
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Swish to get a second opinion of my regular dentist's dental plan consisting of 1 crown and 3 veneers. I was concerned that 2 of the veneers was unnecessary. The dental assistant was very personable. I was very pleased with the updated technology they had to take x-rays. Dr. Shadman was very nice and patient while I asked her a lot of questions. Overall, it was a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: CURT WALKER
user_reviews_extended.Description: I want to preface with I am extremely picky about dental offices as my mom works in the industry. This place was amazing, the doctor had amazing bedside manners, of course extremely knowledgeable while also conversational! Victoria, my hygienist, was amazing, so funny and kind, also so detail orientated. As someone who’s only been here half a year and needed a new office, I strongly recommend Swish on the East side!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a lovely experience I had at this dental practice. I was very nervous as this was my first dental visit after moving to Texas. The staff here was amazing. Bree was friendly and efficient while taking all of my x-rays and the supercool 3D photos. Dr Celia Rathmell was very warm and caring. She took her time explaining to me the condition of my teeth and gums. The 3D pictures were a great visual aide for what she was describing to me. I’m so glad I went to this Swish dental office!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Duke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Communicative, efficient, and friendly. Everyone I met were very kind and helpful and made the new patient process smooth and easy. Lovely facility, but a little difficult to find. I would recommend getting there a little early to find parking/walk to the entrance! Overall, very happy to have found a great location in East Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Woolfolk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Im usually not a reviewer but Dr. Sara Burk and the entire swish team are exceptional. I visited swish for the first time in early 2024 for a sensitive tooth which turned out to need a crown, Dr. Sara was so pleasant and kept working until the crown fit perfect. The office manager suggested the "membership options" for payment, I automatically declined because thats what I do, after doing the math it was a no brainer to add the yearly payment method, it comes with free whitening and other discounts, its paid for itself. I left my previous dentist because they were constantly upselling me while their hands were still in my mouth?! This is not the case with swish, I feel like im getting above and beyond service at a fair price. I would HIGHLY recommend Dr. Sara and the East Austin Swish team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corina Oliva
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff and high tech equipment made my experience super comfortable. The office was clean, bright, and a street view to see outside while still keeping your visit confidential. TV with Netflix services to keep your mind occupied. I had Dr. Andrew and he explained my dental needs in terms that a non medical patient could easily understand. I never felt like I was being judged or ignored of my dental needs. The whole staff was professional and knew what they were doing. I will definitely be making my routine visits here again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ainara almeida
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I previously left a great review because I felt genuinely taken care of. Unfortunately, my experience has changed and I no longer trust this office.

I was sold Invisalign using before-and-after projection images of what my bite would look like. But when I came in to pick up my trays, the projection images were completely different from what I was shown during the sales process, and the projected “after” bite actually looked worse than my current bite. By that point, I had already been charged.

What made it worse: I was asked what I want my bite to look like. That question shocked me. Shouldn’t a dental professional be guiding this based on what is healthy and functional, not asking me to “choose” an outcome like it’s cosmetic preference? It made me feel like Invisalign was sold to me for revenue rather than care.

I asked to speak with the dentist because the assistant helping me (who was kind, to be clear) could not answer basic questions about the process or what was going on. I was then told there was no dentist present, at 1:30pm on a weekday.

They told me to come back and they would have a new projection ready. When I asked how I could be sure the dentist (who wasn’t even there) would understand what I was asking for, the response was: she didn’t know.

At this point I’ve lost trust in their ability to manage my dental health, both due to lack of clarity/knowledge and the feeling that the priority is selling rather than patient care. I’m very disappointed, especially since I’ve already paid and now feel stuck continuing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gordon Butler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was reluctant to go to Swish for two reasons; my anxiousness about going to the dentist and the fear that they would "up sell" me on cosmetic treatments. My experience was amazing. The staff front the front desk to when I was in the chair were professional and friendly. I am actually looking forward to going back to the dentist, which I have never said in my life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Quach
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been coming here for over a year and always have a pleasant experience! I grew up never enjoying going to the dentist, but Swish Dental makes the experience so warm, that I almost enjoy coming in for my cleanings. They use pretty high-tech equipment and I like that they are very text-savvy - they will personally text you if they have earlier openings to see if you want to come in earlier. Their communication is awesome, from instructions on where to park, COVID precautions, and the check in process. All of the staff are beyond friendly and do a great job at explaining things, and overall making sure your time spent there is enjoyable (as it can be at the dentist). They play Netflix TV shows
while working on your teeth and they are very upfront about costs (I get fluoride each time) which I really appreciate.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keegan Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been using Swish East for over a year now. A few days ago I had a cleaning, but I booked it incorrectly (as a new client vs returning client). It was going to be an extra hour before the technician could see me due to my mistake, so I requested to reschedule as it was the middle of a work day. Just after requesting to reschedule, several people on their team came out and shifted some things around, minimized the delay, and got me in right then and there. I was able to get back to work on time with clean teeth. Also, the technicians are always so cool and sweet. Always great work. Thanks, Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Membrey
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire Swish East team did a fantastic job of making me very comfortable and at ease throughout the entire appointment. They were patient, explained everything thoroughly, and went to great lengths to make sure I always understood what was going on. I can’t recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been so embarrassed in my life the dentist scrolled me like child - I am will to continue this appointment schedule again but if I am spoke to again like today - I will find another dentist !!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: wendy barrett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm so glad to have found Swish. I go to the one on East 4th Street and everyone on that team is friendly, helpful and excellent at their jobs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Rowe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience and cleaning. They did lots of imaging and everyone was very professional and kind. The facility was very clean and welcoming. There were some issues with scheduling. They changed my appointment time without informing me and the automated texts do not seem to be working properly yet. They accommodated the issues I had by offering my fluoride treatment for free. I will be going back for my dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Atticus Li
user_reviews_extended.Description:
⚠️ GO AT YOUR OWN RISK!!! ⚠️

I had been going to swish for more than a year, but not anymore.

This is a business dentist, NOT a doctor dentist.

Meaning they are here to max out your insurance to make the most profit out of you.

Your care is not their concern. Their profit is.

Ask for your itemized bill and double check the billing codes.

I have delta insurance and I went for my second yearly regular clean up and they charged me over $400 for a regular visit.

It’s the same visit I have visited the last 2 years!! Same exact regular cleaning but 6x the cost?

They will bill you for everything to maximize your insurance payout. Including unnecessary procedures and billing codes of servicing that wasn’t provided.

Many people don’t understand how insurance work and they just pay out.

Check your bill for unnecessary or unasked procedures. Unless you have serious issues you do not need to get x-ray every time you go.

The dental hygienist here have very high turnover rate - just go look at their Glassdoor review and see how they treat their workers

I waited a long time before writing this review, but the truth needs to be said.

Yeah Netflix is nice but do you really want to spend hours trying to figure out what they overcharged? On the phone for hours with insurance to figure out exactly which billing code is what?

I thought I was going to be a customer for life but now I am disappointed at how shady this place is

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cailyn Carl
user_reviews_extended.Description: I LOVE SWISH DENTAL! Allie the dental assistant was so kind and made sure I was comfortable during my appointment. I really liked their comfort menu that had a list of all the stuff that made my appointment so much better. The comfort menu had stuff like a soft blanket, beats headphones, a charger for my phone and Netflix. Overall a great experience, would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: George Mavritsis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Exceeded my expectations. Everyone was great! From the front desk girls to the dental hygienist, just exceptional! They were thorough & explained all the procedures. I never felt like they were trying to nickel and dime me by pressuring into unneeded procedures. The dentist answered all my questions. Simply put I would recommend this place. Went to the East Austin location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Heyden
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Swish operates as a for profit business first and foremost, prioritizing maximizing insurance bill codes over long term patient care. The facility is clean and modern, fits the neighborhood aesthetic well.

Pro’s: High end technology, friendly staff, good at cleanings.

Cons: Dentists will recommend work you don’t need to maximize bill codes with your insurance. The high end technology only serves as a way to upsell cosmetic services (no clear benefit to oral health). Often represented inaccurate pricing and will send a large additional bill weeks later.

Ultimately, moved to a different dentist after multiple bad experiences here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Avery Daly
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to Swish East for a few years now, and I would highly recommend them! I worked with the hygienist, Vicky, who was very friendly and gentle during the cleaning. I also worked with Darian and Dr. Andrew who were great and very helpful when explaining their recommendations.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today i got a cleaning with Victoria. And honestly she was the best hygienist i’ve ever met. She did an absolutely amazing job!!! I’ve had glue on my teeth from my braces i got removed a while ago and no one ever wanted to take it off. But she did and now my teeth feel extremely smooth and pretty! I would definitely recommend getting your cleaning done with her as she talks to you and makes you feel comfortable and explains what she’ll be doing and why. if i could give her more stars i would. 💖 Thank you victoria!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: sloane ramras
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s been wayyyy too long since I’ve been to the dentist (a couple of years don’t judge) so I was nervous to see the state of my teeth. The whole team at Swish was incredible. The made it simple painless and straight forward. Will be coming back regularly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Herrmann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Swish. Hate going to the dentist office but really enjoy going to Swish. Everyone on staff has taken great care of me and they're all really nice. Their subscription plan is extremely reasonable and a deal for the care you receive. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sally Grand
user_reviews_extended.Description: From check in (prompt), to the X-ray technician (completely friendly), to the Netflix show (so relaxing!), to the Dr (calm and efficient), to the hygienist (so good! No pain at all in the cleaning) to the account manager (no pressure on additional treatments) who literally waved me out the door – Swish East really was a five star experience :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional all the staff was extremely nice. Fixed my tooth chip the same day I made an appointment. Honestly my best experience at a dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Declan O Reilly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very expensive and push unnecessary treatments. A year after paying for my treatment they are sending me new bills. Staff are friendly and facility is nice but I would recommend going somewhere with better price transparency.

user_reviews_extended.Name: christine roman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Seriously- the east location is AMAZINGGGG. From the initial phone call and interaction with the kind woman at the desk, the dental assistants and doctors- they are all INCREDIBLE. I left with my issue immediately resolved and thought how i want to work there because i loved everyone so much lol

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaan S
Jesse Frausto
user_reviews_extended.Description:
they did an exam and went over it and explain everything what I wanted to hear .
The lady that clean my teeth did a very good job , I recommend anybody to Swish Dental .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Byron Landry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have only been to this office once, and many things were nice about it, but overall I was disappointed. The location is nice, and the interior is tastefully decorated. The lab is filled with lots of advanced equipment, and my entire first visit was spent undergoing imaging and examination. However, in the past, it was usually possible for me to undergo whatever necessary examination and receive cleaning and treatment and even a filling in the same visit. It appears that, due to a very aggressive billing strategy, swish was not able to do any of those things during my first visit. It will take me three visits to get my teeth cleaned, and maybe that is what it takes to pay for a tasteful reception area. In their defense, many of these practices have become widespread in large American cities, so I will grin and bear it, even though my teeth are still dirty.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Magdiel Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome staff! Got my wisdom tooth removed in like 10 minutes, no pain. Doctor Buhluer and the dental assistants there are great. Very nice and professional. Definitely recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Kodawa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It was my first time at Swish Dental and I really enjoyed my time there. My highlight was my time with Sam the Dental Hygienist. He was funny and had great stories to distract me from the discomfort of taking my jaw bone pictures.
Dr Shima was also really sweet and took a short time to look at my teeth, the x rays and give a diagnosis.
I was in an out in an hour and a half and I would gladly refer everyone I know to go back. I am actually looking forward to going back which is not something I say regarding the dentist's office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Timmy Marquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was so nice! A very welcoming environment and they were playing Taylor Swift and as a huge swiftie I appreciate It lol

user_reviews_extended.Name: Loc Trinh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The dental hygienist was great, very nice and personable. However, the visit with the dentist was very transactional and felt super rushed and not friendly. I was told that I needed a crown because there was a crack in one of my fillings and she showed me the image of the tooth, but it was super pixelated so I couldn’t even see anything. I was also suggested to get a night guard to protect my teeth from grinding, but was told to get a prescription for it through them which will cost me $500 because my insurance doesn’t cover it, even though over the counter options exist.

I was then passed onto a billing person who explained to me my insurance coverage and out of pocket expenses for the crown and night guard and she could care less if I lived or died. She rushed through my “treatment plan”, pointed out what insurance covered and what I owed out of pocket and I couldn’t read all the details because she scrolled through it quickly on an iPad. Once I got the treatment plan in my email, I looked over it in detail and there were all of these additional upgrades that were not explained to me. So if I wanted to go through Swish for my “treatment plan”, it would be $1400 out of pocket. I’m definitely getting a second opinion and not going back to Swish.

I had a great dentist in NYC who was warm and didn’t see me as a transaction. When he explained to me why I needed something done, he took the time and was patient with me and ran through all of my options, so I felt like he actually cared for me and my dental health and didn’t see me as dollar signs, trying to milk every penny he could out of me like Swish.

If you like your dental experience like trying to buy a car on a car lot, then Swish is great!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drew Soucy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very happy to have found my new dentist! I normally hate going to the dentist because I have really bad lock jaw. They were accommodating and made the whole process easy. They did an extensive cleaning on my teeth and it made a noticeable difference! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tejal Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing modern details to a dental office. Very thoughtful touches to ensure comfort throughout the experience. You fill out all forms prior to appointment via text, and same with touch less payment options etc.... never enjoyed my experience more. The music is beyond and I was able to view Netflix during my visit. Love this place. Also the demeanor of my dentist Dr. Shadman was so gentle and lovely.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Whalen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience! As a lifelong fearful patient, leaving a review for a dental office is a big deal. I had a dental emergancy on a holiday weekend, and was able to get a next day appt. Dr Minsker was very kind and gentle. Diagnosed my issue quickly and follow ups have been great. Office is modern and clean. Can’t say enough good things about swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Rene'
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Swish!! All the staff are always such a delight. Letty is super.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lydia M
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place rocks! The staff is super friendly and helpful… Got a teeth cleaning recently & it was great and I felt comfortable. My teeth/mouth feels much better and clean.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kat Aldrich
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Editing for clarity and conciseness.
I was told I had to replace an “old” filling (1 year old), the dentist broke a tool while working and seemed very impatient, and I’ve now been in pain for about 2 months. I went back around the 4 week mark and a different dentist fixed the bite as the first one couldn’t be bothered to take the time there. However, it still hurts where the teeth touch. I had 0 sensitivity or pain before the fillings and now cold and heat hurt it, along with flossing (where the teeth touch - not at the gums).

I also received an unforeseen charge when I already paid for my fillings but to Swish’s credit, they did help with that.

Edited 7/20: I had a different dentist redo the filling and, had he been my initial dentist, would likely provide 5 stars. Both Dr. Andrew Hatashima and Savannah (who assisted) kept my comfort top of mind and not only took the time, but actually explained to me what was going on and providing reasoning behind any requests. It’s been just 2 days but I don’t have any pain - truthfully have been afraid to floss that tooth still, but I’ll do so tonight. I may update accordingly and do appreciate that Swish took the time to listen to my concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Houston
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first visit to Swish today. I had an examination and a teeth cleaning. My teeth have never been cleaner.   I think the high-tech equipment makes a huge difference.  The doctor and his assistant made me feel very relaxed. Everyone I encountered was pleasant.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suzanne Gehrman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very impressed with the entire experience.  I was introduced to the office and each of the different areas by Jordan prior to starting an exceptionally thorough and complete examination, cleaning, and working on a plan for future work.  The equipment is state-of-art and provides a clear understanding of every step of dental health. Glad I found my new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonja Corbin King
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a bad toothache and went to what I thought was my favorite dentist place. I have been coming to Swish East for well over 2 years now. Upon scheduling an appointment I was told that they no longer take my dental insurance. This is something that should be communicated to customers before they have a toothache or appointment. No letter or text stating I was no longer in their orbit. I committed to the appointment anyway because I was in serious pain and I trust this place. $250.00 for a 20 minute dental appointment felt like a rip off. I have anxiety at the dentist so having a familiar place is imperative for me. I felt rejected and dismissed. It felt like I got dumped and had to find out the day of our date! Atmosphere is nice and place is cool. I will miss this place. Better communication when you are not taking certain insurance would be nice to current customers. Now on top of tooth pain I am searching for a new dentist. Ouch!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: C. Bailey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATED REVIEW (3 stars):
I was contacted by Adrian, the director of operations for Swish, to address the concerns I had (the same day I posted this review). Adrian listened to my frustrations, provided me with additional information on how appointments were made, and heard my concerns. They agreed with me regarding the unprofessional treatment I received from the hygienist (details in original review), ensured I would not be seeing that provider any longer. (I also certainly hope this hygienist is made aware that her conduct was inappropriate.)
Adrian also provided me with an appointment the next day and complimentary whitening treatment.
At this point I am sticking with the practice until I relocate out of Austin. I believe they took the necessary steps to support the patient experience and attempt to rectify mistakes made.

ORIGINAL REVIEW (1 star):
Frustrated with this whole location right now. I came to Swish based on a word-of-mouth recommendation, and they happened to have a deal for Invisalign at the time so I paid for that in-full. I've been wearing the same set of trays for 3+ weeks now, thus DELAYING MY TREATMENT, because this office has such difficulty with communication.
I've left multiple voicemails, sent text messages, emails, with poor response rates each time. I received a call from them regarding an upcoming appointment I had yet to confirm, and I cancelled it over the phone. This apparently was not recorded, as I got another notification that I had a new appointment a month later (that I did NOT schedule), and then the office sends me a text saying they "missed me" at my previous appointment. I've been trying to cancel this upcoming appointment I didn't schedule for 2 weeks now.
ON TOP OF ALL OF THIS: The dental hygienist I saw last time I was in for a cleaning actually told me I should not use nitrous oxide because "she has dental trauma too, and that's how she got over it." I'm sorry, I'm a clinician myself and this is highly inappropriate, violating and unprofessional. You don't compare trauma histories and discourage patients from using services provided by the office to ease their anxiety. I will say I spoke to Kassandra, the office manager, and she seems nice, but I'm very close to finding another practice after I pick up my last set of trays.
TL;DR: Dental hygienist will get into a "trauma competition" with you and discourage using services including nitrous oxide to ease anxiety; very, VERY poor communication and response time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Dorsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Even though I was Very late, they still seen me. The office is very clean and tidy and quiet. Everyone was very kind and friendly. They even have let you watch Netflix while getting examined! The other dentist office I went to was taking forever to get my teeth pulled but the dentist at this office took one look and referred me to an oral surgeon, I am beyond thankful for that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morgan-Taylor Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the first time I had been, but I had a wonderful experience at Swish Dental East. When I got there, the front desk assistant, Lacett, was very attentive and eager to help me. Then, when I got to the back, Allie, the dental assistant, made me feel very comfortable before Dr. Shadman came. Overall, it was a very comfortable, professional, and clean office. The people and atmosphere made it even better. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachariah
user_reviews_extended.Description: After scheduling and confirming with them, they text me an hour before my appointment telling me they didn't schedule enough time for my exam and cleaning. Next appointment availability was a month later. Bad first impression, and I can only assume the quality of their front desk reflects the quality of the rest of their services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly staff and always answer any questions you may have. They’ll explain any treatment you may need and are gentle with cleanings or treatment. Also they will do payment plans through affirm if a treatment is at high cost and you can’t pay upfront which can be helpful. Definitely recommend this place. I’ve been to the one on 4th st and the one in Pflugerville and always a great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oliver Shea
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is so incredibly professional and friendly. As much as I hate the dentist, I always have a good experience with Swish - they even saved me a call to my insurance to make sure everything was sorted out.  Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Patlan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been twice to this office, and both times have been great! I've seen two different dentists and enjoyed them both. The staff is nice, and my hygienist Vicky was phenomenal!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leigh Ann Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jerry was my dental hygienist today and she was outstanding!  She is detailed and thorough.  She explained and showed things to me that will help me take better care of my teeth.  I have requested her for my next cleaning.  Thank you Jerry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Berrones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff. Great service. Very transparent. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Young
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I visited this dentist for a regular check up. I was introduced to an overly complicated tooth scanning process that took over an hour (similar to FleetFeet). They then stated that I had 3 cavities and aggressively prompted me to schedule a follow up.

The office alone has a hastily furnished Airbnb energy with neon, fake vines, and cheap furniture. I had suspected that I was being sold rather than consulted during the session. As a result, I decided to get a 2nd opinion from a reputable dentist. After another series of X-Rays, I learned that I had no cavities nor real issues with my teeth. That saved me from pulling and capping three of my adult teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Alexander
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Swish Dental today as a new patient for  teeth cleaning. I was a little apprehensive because the last time I went to the dentist (Not Swish), the dentist really tried to up-sell me on procedures I didn't think I needed. Needless to say the rest of the appointment was very awkward. Today was a completely different experience. My appointment, from beginning to end was excellent!  I recommend Swish Dental to anyone looking for a good experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiala Pham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super quick and effective wisdom teeth extraction!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ba N
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very modern clean and professional clinic. Tools and methods used at this clinic are cutting edge technology such as the 3D mesh sampler to model the teeth. The dental assistant and hygienist working here (Patricia and Jireh) are patient, precise and gentle. Cassandra was clear to review the insurance coverage. They gifted me an electric toothbrush which was unexpectedly nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Lorfing
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to had a tooth pulled, and I really wasn’t in the mood. Then, I had to fill out new patient paperwork online before my appointment, then I had to fill it out on actual paper once I got to my appointment. So I was really annoyed going in. My tooth was in bad shape and had a pretty big hole on the backside so I feared that it would break apart when the dentist tried to pull it. BUT, he numbed up up good and he got it out all in one piece, and it was really all done pretty quick. The 5 stars is because everyone was calm and helpful the whole time. And everything went as smooth as it could have. I also haven’t had any real pain or bleeding since. So I say job well done Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rene Miranda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lety, Shanita & Alondra are amazing front staff team. Answered all my question and help me through out everything. The back is amazing too. Love this office so much!!! So excited for my Invisalign treatment!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Czarnecki
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental East is great! The staff is super friendly and professional. The facility is very clean and modern. I loved the playlist they were playing, fun Rufus Du Sol music. Great atmosphere and staff! I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jean Paul laroix
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to have a filling redone 7 times, they ignored my requested for a refund, cause excruciating pain. Passed me off to multiple dentists to fix the issue. Worst experience of my life. Dentist office should have doctors, not tech hacking to pump numbers and profits. Most of the staff is way too under qualified

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Newhome
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is friendly and helpful. Great experience! Waited a very long time for invisilign spent a lot of time looking for the right place and couldn’t have asked for a better dentistry office. I LOVE Swish EastSide!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johnna DiGrigoli
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to SWISH dental for the first time today and will definitely be going back. I really liked the aesthetic and prefer this modern look to the dentist offices I grew up going to. Everyone was super friendly and they explain the treatments to you thoroughly. Oh also, they let you watch Netflix during your visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arun Gopal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist office! Staff is all friendly and laid back, office is new, spacious and well lit and Dr. Shadman is excellent. Plus they have an easy-to-use app where you can coordinate your appointments and get questions answered. They even have a rewards program where it's easy to rack up points. Would recommend Swish Dental East to anyone and everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ella Schmit
user_reviews_extended.Description:
★★★★★

I had such a wonderful experience at Swish Dental! All of the ladies were so sweet, welcoming, and truly amazing. They made me feel completely comfortable and never judged — it’s clear they genuinely care about helping you achieve your healthiest, happiest smile. They also offer a variety of payment options, making it easier to get the care you need without added stress. I’m so grateful I found them and can’t recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassidy Dutton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nothing but honesty and transparency for everything!! LOVED the girlies that helped me! I was quoted $450 to have my broken permeant retainer fixed at other places, the best orthodontist I have ever met did it for $150 and was the sweetest person ever. Grateful for y’all! Even though it’s out of network idc I’m coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Layne McKelvy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish on East 4th has the cutest atmosphere! The office is bright and fun, and the employees are really friendly and know what they’re talking about. I have some anxiety when I go to the dentist, but everyone there made me feel so at ease! Will definitely come back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connor Woods
user_reviews_extended.Description: People were great, payment process is strange. Unsure what’s covered by insurance and what’s paid out of pocket until you get the bill. After this review, the team promptly reached out to clarify the itemized bill, which I appreciate.

user_reviews_extended.Name: emily everingham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly staff and clean office! I was greeted with a warm and welcoming smile by Lacett when I first walked in. I enjoyed my visit with Dr. Shadman! She has the most kind and considerate heart. The assistant Allie was also wonderful as well. Thank you all for everything!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandy Balthazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super friendly and knowledgable staff. They take great care of my teeth. They always feel squeaky clean after visiting. 10/10 recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luke Wildeboer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They try and scam you to do additional work that is unnecessary, and pressure you to put unnecessary down payments just to book another appointment.
Also they didn't even clean my teeth at all on the first appointment. I even had a problem with a gum and a certain tooth, but they didn't do anything to resolve or fix it and said I would have to come back in 2 weeks for a "deep cleaning". This deep cleaning had to be done in two separate appointments they said as well, just to try and scam me of more money for more visits. They only looked at them and did x-rays and photos of each teeth, and did nothing to solve my issues

I ended up going to another dentist who advised that the cavities they said I had, weren't actually cavities and can disappear and be healed with more brushing. Also the early signs of "gum disease" they wanted to charge me and work on, was actually false information according to the two other dentists I saw after this appointment.

Don't waste your time here or let them talk you into unnecessary procedures

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Schultz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had by far the best experience at this dentist. The environment inside is very nice. They accepted my insurance, everything was affordable and procedures went smoothly. Will be a returning patient!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Brooks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've used Swish for a year. I don't have dental insurance but am a member of the Swish program which has saved me a lot of money. I have a new crown and it was one of the least painful dental procedures I've ever had. Dr. Andrew and his staff are awesome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Helsel
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s next to impossible to get an appointment less than 3 months out. I managed to get one 2.5 months out. They called me the day before to reschedule because they had booked it wrong. They were unable to reschedule in a timely manner. I wanted to do Invisalign which requires frequent appointments but I can’t continue to see a dentist that doesn’t respect my time or schedule.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ian Helm
user_reviews_extended.Description: Couldn't recommend Swish to enough people. Whether you're new to Austin or just looking at changing offices, Swish is the spot. Check-in process was very smooth, staff was incredibly friendly all around, and they're very sensitive of every patients time. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alan Yepez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ana was super kind and attentive. Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jakari Wrencher
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kind humans. It helped calm me to have my sister with me in the beginning. They answered all our questions. I am very happy to keep my tooth after it was pulled! Pain is managed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Koen DHoore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had dental surgery and couldn't be more happy with this dentist practice and doctor. Great and fun team, always a smile and friendly AND very professional. Nothing but rave for this one. Going to the dentist doesn't feel like torture anymore! Thanks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Celeste Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: This places you feel so comfortable and everyone who works there is so welcoming! I now enjoy going to the dentist! 🤗

user_reviews_extended.Name: AG Motwani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jerry is an amazing hygienist whose bedside is excellent due to both intrinsic compassion and clearly experiential learning. It felt as if she approached her work as her craft (kindness and all), and i always felt I was in professional hands (and well informed) at every stage of my first half deep cleaningi.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christy Botello
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team is incredible and very attentive to specific needs during the appointment. My dental anxiety was very high and the team made me feel so comfortable and at ease from the second I walked in the door.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Olivia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best visit to the dentist I’ve ever had!! Everyone on the team was so friendly and very knowledgeable. They really know their stuff!

I used to hate going to the dentist but they made me feel very comfortable! I highly recommend Swish Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynn Weiner
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From ease in making an appointment to actual exam, Swish East was top notch! The website is very informative and the patient interface is easy to use. Appointment reminder came by phone text and call. The office is easy to find and there was ample free parking at 4th& building. (Entrance for parking is on 4th St. but office entrance is on 5th St.) I was greeted by a friendly receptionist and she processed my new patient paperwork and payment very quickly. Ally the assistant, was efficient in getting the x-rays, pictures and scans done. She explained what she was doing and why. Her chair side manner was lovely. Dr. Houston also has a lovely manner. But, most importantly, this may be the most thorough exam, explanation, recommendations, and cleaning I have ever had.! Very happy to have found Swish East as my new dentist in Austin!

Post script:  My dentist's name was Dr. Austin Anderson.  I believe there is also a Dr. Clifford Houston in this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Russell
user_reviews_extended.Description: For a few years now, I have had some hesitation to go to a dental office, simply from a terribly bad experience I have had in the past. Usually when I schedule appointments I go in trying to get out as fast as possible, cringing the whole time. However this fear has officially vanished thanks to Dr. Shadman and the Swish team here at their east side location. I went in for a simple cleaning and to get information about Invisilign, hoping to have a dentist close to my home that made it easier for me, and that is exactly what I found. This office was not only clean to the fullest extent, but the office staff was so sweet and polite that I had almost forgotten I was at the dentist. Veronica was working at the desk, who after she greeted me with a humongous smile, made me feel comfortable since I had mentioned my fear. The cleaning was done quickly and properly, then followed by my Invisilign. Dr. Shadman was so nice I can’t say it enough, making sure I was comfortable while holding a great conversation. The assistant, Ally I believe, was very informative and funny. My overall experience was one I had to write about, as I am happy and over my fears of the dentists now. Instead of rushing in and out, I will be excited to stay around and chat with the staff as I did today. Thank you SWISH! You guys rock.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Karkovice
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team was excellent, helped to identify an issue I was having that my previous dentist had skipped over for years — highly recommend this group if you’re looking for a thorough and organized business to handle your teeth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Matthews
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is an awesome office full of great people.   Dr. Shima Shadman is an amazing dentist and is extremely thorough in every aspect of her job.  My visit here was pain free and comfortable throughout my entire appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: My review here is for the office manager, Shanita. I had an issue and needed to be transferred to another office and she handled everything for me. I really appreciate that she went out of her way to make sure I was taken care of even though it wasn’t at this location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phillip J
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love going to this Swish location! Everyone I've worked with has been great and it's always an enjoyable experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ljalem hadush
user_reviews_extended.Description: The service in this place is incredibly smooth. Thank you for fast and friendly work all members of Swish! starting from front desk staff! keep up the good work.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Great communication. Team was knowledgeable and patient. Technology was first rate. I was impressed. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved the staff! They helped me get all signed up for their membership and took good care of me. The doctor and hygienist explained everything thoroughly and made me feel comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Very impressed. Had a 1.5 hour cleaning where they not only cleaned my teeth but also taught my a lot about oral hygiene. Would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniela Anthony
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't express how much I love swish no matter what I am getting done, today I had my wisdoms removed & I have always hated the dentist but every single staff member always makes me feel welcomed and comfortable and makes sure I understand what I'm getting done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Genelin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff were all incredibly friendly, helpful, and efficient.  They're great about explaining how insurance will work with any procedures that need to be done so there are no surprises. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: FromADOM Music
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional and friendly surgeons, thanks for everything!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Landon Flaniken
user_reviews_extended.Description: THEY LIED TO ME ABOUT HAVING CAVITIES. Do not go to swish dental!! They told me I had 3 cavities and then I got a second opinion and they said I had none. This place is trying to profit off of you by drilling into your teeth when it isn’t necessary! The other dentist I went to had a receptionist who told me she use to work at Swish and left because the same thing happened to her husband. DON’T GO HERE

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Horne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! The explanation of services and work done was communicated effectively. Will be returning to this location.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Not good.

Have been a member for 2 years almost.

They messed up my morning appointment after I called to confirm I needed a filling not a cleaning. I came back later in the day.

Both fillings the dentist completedbroke the same day and still no returned phone call to fix them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mireya Bustamante
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly kind of obsessed with going to the dentist now! I recommend this place now to all my friends and family. I am so happy I came here. It is clean, beautiful inside, and the staff is so NICE.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Gelinas
user_reviews_extended.Description: The equipment they use is up to date but I have never gone to a pushier dentist in my life (and I’ve had some pretty bad ones). Every single visit they push more and more on you from lasers, to invisaline (for already straight teeth), to prescription mouthwash for no reason. It’s to the point where I’d rather go through the annoyance of finding a new dentist in the area then sit through this again. There are plenty of places in the area that show a little more care for their patients rather than looking at them as a dollar sign.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Alyssa was so wonderful and attentive! 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hope Herrera

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caroline Drew
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly love going to the dentist here. Everyone is friendly and the care is comprehensive and straightforward

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucie Beatrix
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing service!!! I love Swish. My cleaning was extremely thorough and I really appreciate the attention and care I’ve received here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Shifrin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Impeccable experience and staff was super accommodating. Not your typical dentist office or experience, I would highly recommend you switch your dentist to the folks over at Swish Dental East. They know what they're doing!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the crew at Swish east Austin. They are so friendly and professional, I actually look forward to all my appointments. Thanks for the awesome service, team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaley Bevins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been to Swish twice now—once for several fillings back in September and most recently for a cleaning—and overall I’ve had a really positive experience.

The office is very clean, modern, and well-equipped with updated technology, which I really appreciate. Everything feels efficient and professional. The staff have been consistently kind, welcoming, and easy to talk to, which makes a big difference.

My fillings from September went smoothly with no issues. At this most recent visit, I saw a different dentist who took the time to point out a potential area for a sealant, which I thought was helpful and proactive.

There was one slightly uncomfortable moment during my cleaning with one of the water devices, but it was brief and didn’t take away from the overall experience.

Overall, I’d definitely recommend Swish—great staff, clean environment, and quality care.

My procedure was super quick, I was told it was barely even 45 minutes (I had deep sedation, 4 teeth removed). I’m having a very smooth recovery & my doctor was super attentive as far as checking back in with me to make sure I was feeling okay. I definitely recommend!

title: BLVD Dentistry & Orthodontics of 5th Street
address: 1011 W 5th St #120, Austin, TX 78703, United States

user_reviews.Name: Ellen Scott
user_reviews.Description: When I moved to Austin I found a wonderful old school dentist in the early 80s - Bobby Arnold. He had a modest practice on the east side and my family of 5 enjoyed his careful and informed choice style of dentistry for decades. When he retired I was lost. I quickly realized the overall art of dentistry had changed drastically, with many new technologies and new focus. It also became very clear that the dental hygienist is the heart of a dentist's office. I tried several different offices through the years and became very discouraged. Just having my teeth cleaned was often torture. Until I found LouAnn @ BLVD @ 5th street. She is extraordinary. She calls me her "star patient." I look forward to her gentle, thorough, and personal care. The office just changed dentists and I have had no experience with the new DDS, so the jury's still out, but I would use BLVD  just to have my teeth cleaned by LouAnn. She will lower your blood pressure and change the way you feel about going to the dentist.

user_reviews.Name: Adriana Marcela Castro
user_reviews.Description:
I have been a patient at BLVD for the past five years and have never had any complaints about the service or the staff. However, this time I feel the need to especially highlight the incredibly gentle, attentive, and thorough care I received from KATIE!!.

This was the first time I truly felt treated with exceptional care and unmatched delicacy during a dental cleaning. I am sincerely grateful to Katie for making the experience completely painless and for sending me home with perfectly clean teeth. Thank you for such an outstanding experience!!!

user_reviews.Name: Jeremy Campbell
user_reviews.Description: My appointment started on time and the cleaning was performed very quickly. It’s a nice facility and everyone is friendly. Three stars only because every time I go there there’s this hard sale for various products and services that makes me feel like I’m in a used car dealership.

user_reviews.Name: Lizzie Burton
user_reviews.Description: Always enjoy my experience at BLVD dentist. Katie did a great job with my cleaning today, proactively explaining everything she was doing so I was comfortable. I was in and out in 40 minutes, never have to wait to long after checking in. The front desk is very friendly and offices are clean! Would recommend!!

user_reviews.Name: Melissa Nguyen
user_reviews.Description: i’ve been a patient of Dr. Andrew Cummings at w5th st. Blvd Dentist for over 5 years, so when he moved and Dr. Bright took over the practice, i was nervous about the change—having had 2 appointments with Dr. Bright now, i can say with absolute confidence she and her staff are excellent! i am an anxious dental patient (shout out to Richelle as the best hygienist and most gentle and accommodating - ask for Richelle as your hygienist if you have sensitive teeth or are sensitive to sound/medical procedures); Dr. Bright made me comfortable and at ease and is so friendly, bubbly and kind. she fixed a chipped tooth with patient precision and it looks very natural. she made sure to continually check in that i was doing ok and if i wanted to change any part of the repair. i highly recommend Dr. Bright and Richelle at west 5th st Blvd Dentist!

user_reviews.Name: Luke Melcher
user_reviews.Description: I just had an appointment with Brittany who was incredible! She was extremely thorough in her work fixing a problem with my Invisalign treatment and helped answering some questions I had. She took her time and really made sure the appointment was a success, I’m in good hands!

user_reviews.Name: Emily Bacon
user_reviews.Description: As always -- was excellent care by talented, meticulous, and kind people. Not only do they always have the answers to my questions, but they offer more information than I'd even know to ask. Absolutely recommend! Thanks and see you next time!

user_reviews.Name: Deanna Alexander
user_reviews.Description: Chipped my tooth unexpectedly and had to make a last minute appointment. I couldn’t be more pleased with the service here! The front desk staff, dentist, and dental assistant were all super friendly and inviting, transparent about billing, and the procedure was quick and painless. They also color matched my tooth pretty much perfectly. Literally can’t tell it was ever chipped. Looks and feels great. I haven’t had insurance for awhile prior to this but luckily finally have insurance again. I didn’t have a dentist for routine treatments and checkups for this reason and was already on the hunt for a new office when the chip happened and I guess forced my hand to find somewhere. I admittedly picked this place on a whim because it was close to my home, took my insurance, and because of the positive reviews, I just needed to go somewhere quick. But I’m so incredibly thankful they took me in for this as a new patient. I will definitely make this my regular office for routine appointments now!!!
