user_reviews_extended.Description: Nice enough people but unprofessional with scheduling. Schedule an initial consult and I’m waiting in lobby for 30 minutes until I’m seen. Schedule follow up standard cleaning, get text day before “can you reschedule to later in the day?”. Tell them no. Show up at scheduled time of 8:30am and I’m told it’s actually for 9:30. I show them reminder screenshots received from them that shows 8:30 and they say they need to reschedule. No idea if they’re good or not but there’s probably better options.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harlan Robnett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming for three years, and I’ve had nothing but wonderful experiences. Fantastic, caring staff with incredible attention to detail and kindness. Extra special thank you to Brittany for being so amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Weinberger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Louanne was PHENOMENAL and thoroughly clean my teeth! The staff was super nice and the cleaning results were great. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Molly Millington
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s a nice place and I’ve been going here for a few years. But I don’t feel like they do a very thorough job unless I get Richelle as the dental hygienist, which I don’t always. So I am switching dentists unfortunately

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nelson Tao
user_reviews_extended.Description: Reception is high rude and focused on charging fees instead of patient care. I had been going to BLVD since 2020 but will avoid due to lack of professionalism. An improperly placed crown has fallen out multiple times and caused expensive er visits for pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kelli walsh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here for a couple of years now - The hygienists are always thorough and personable. LouAnn particularly is great and very knowledgeable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ezekiel
user_reviews_extended.Description: BLVD dentistry is honestly one of the friendliest places I’ve too in austin. The staff are amazing and kind. Recommend going here for a wonderful experience and dentistry stuff

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am VERY skeptical of dentists after many not-so-ideal encounters. I have feared the dental chair for decades, so after moving to a new city, one of my biggest tasks has been to find a dentist. I took a chance on this practice after looking up several options online, and I’m glad I did! From the moment I walked in, it just felt right. One of my favorite parts was that they asked if I had any comments on my intake form, which allowed me to express that I had dental trauma in the past. Both Richelle (honestly, the most fabulous and thorough hygienist I have ever encountered) and Dr. Cummings were incredibly sensitive to this. They were friendly, kind, and answered all of my questions (I had a lot of them).

I was able to get through the entire appointment without anxiety or pain, and I’m honestly not scared to go back. I look forward to a future where I’m not terrified to go to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooks Rhinehart
user_reviews_extended.Description: For going to the dentist, she made feel calm and did not make me wait around. I was in a and out. 5 stars

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Okafor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Pleasant and professional experience- from the Front desk to the hygienists and Dr Bright! Quite the A team! Skilled, patient and kind.  Thank you for taking care of my dental health!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was introduced to the new dentist at BLVD and really enjoyed meeting with her. Always very professional and helpful. Answered all my questions and concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Oliver
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love how BLVD dentistry is always on time and on top of their schedule. Dr Bright is so bubbly and sweet. Definitely made me feel at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zach Holman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an amazing experience at Blvd of 5th street. Went in twice for a cleaning, Lou Ann was my hygienist both times. She made me super comfortable, answered all my questions, and was a wealth of knowledge. I appreciated her calming and professional demeanor. I made sure to schedule with her again in a few months for my next cleaning. Would 1000% suggest Blvd of 5th to anyone looking for a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nadia Shaheen
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were quick and easy to communicate to! They saw me right when my appointment was scheduled, and the staff was so nice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Kinser
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Athina did an amazing job on my braces and I would highly recommend her to anyone in need of a straighter smile!

Dr. Athina/jazz ortho

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Blake
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just got an old filling replaced. It was pretty big and required quite a bit of work. No pain, both the doctor and technician were wonderful. I'm so grateful to have such an excellent place to go for my dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super nice team all around! They make you happy to be around them, even though you’re at the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connor Johnston
user_reviews_extended.Description: BLVD is and excellent dentist. Can’t recommend them highly enough. Great service and high quality dental professionals.

user_reviews_extended.Name: T&R Logistics
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place to visit! I’ve AVOIDED coming to the dentist FOR YEARS. Knowing I needed treatment, I was hesitant. I’m so glad that I came in! EVERYONE ant the office are friendly and professional, from the front office, to the dental assistant, to Dr. Cummings himself. Very thorough & relatable. Dr. Cummings even had time the same day to start treatment in which I did! I’m scheduled to come back to see the hygienist next week. Great staff, diverse group that you can tell cohesively works together! 5-Stars for sure!

user_reviews_extended.Name: sawyer kinser
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Athina and assistant Susi are the best! They’ve made me very comfortable throughout my entire experience at BLVD. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: nature_lover
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful dental experience! Danielle was very helpful with figuring out my possible estimate before the appointment, it made things a lot easier. She also informed me about someone cancelling their appointment and held the opening for me, so I had my visit scheduled for the very next day which was great. Dr. Cummings was very thorough and knowledgeable, he explained everything clearly and made sure to only apply treatment only where absolutely necessary - great approach! I was delighted to find out that the whole treatment could be done on the same day of the checkup, it saved me a lot of time and energy. Dr. Cummings’s assistant (could you please remind me her name?) was sweet and comforting during the whole process. Thank you for the great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: allison ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent practice. Lou Ann was my hygienist and she was the absolute best. Kept me posted throughout my appointment, and was so kind and gentle. Dr Andrew was also great. I really appreciated how he broke down things to keep an eye on vs things to address now. So happy I found this place after a terrible experience with Swish Dental downtown. I highly recommend BLVD. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Bowman
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the best dentist experiences I have had in a while! Great location, beautiful office, everyone is so nice and accommodating!

user_reviews_extended.Name: anton szpitalak
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing orthodontics experience. 11yr old needed braces and Dr. Athina Karatzea and Susi were very supportive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Kilbourn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Come here and ask for Lou Ann as your hygienist. She's the best. Sooooo friendly. Dr Cummings is a young smart guy who actually has a personality and makes you feel like you made the right decision. I'm going to be going to him until one of us passes away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: F R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I like this Dentist office but lost a lot of respect for them since they recently started pushing (guilt tripping) their customers to get laser bacterial reduction (LBR). This is not covered by insurance and there is no medically documented studies that prove this is effective. Not necessarily a scam, but definitely a money grab. Educate yourself.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Brenner and his team did an amazing job correcting my smile! I’d been seeing them for 2 years and every single visit was a great experience. Very professional, friendly and welcoming environment. I’d definitely recommend them and out of 5 stars I would give 10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Delicia Mclean
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've  been been coming to this dental practice for 2-3 years and plan to continue. It's where I have my biannual teeth cleaning done with Richelle, best dental hygienist ever. She's knowledgeable, caring, and careful. I feel completely at ease in her chair and I have sensitive teeth! It's where I've had my fillings replaced by Andrew Cummings, DDS. He's extremely professional, skilled, and friendly. I'm glad he's my dentist. And, Danielle, the office manager should write a book on the practical application of health administration and customer service!

This is a great practice. I highly recommend it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gini Ward
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist I’ve ever been to. Everyone in the office is friendly and professional. Anytime I’ve had a problem they get me in right away. They excel at working with my insurance. I always know upfront how much my copay will be (if any). They remember me even if it’s been a year between visits. I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Scheider
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great visit to Dr. Cummings and his awesome team! It was very easy to make an appointment ahead of time and tell them what I wanted to come in for. Check-in was a breeze and I was waiting just a couple minutes before I started my visit. They have all the newest technology and everything from x-rays to other imaging and a deep cleaning were quick and easy. They arranged a treatment plan at a fair price and I’m looking forward to continued visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabel Villacorta
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't recommend my dentist clinic enough! The staff is incredibly friendly and professional! It feels as if you know them personally! They offer great flexibility with scheduling appointments, which makes it so convenient for me. I think they are the best in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmine V Winston
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ll never go anywhere else! This team is AMAZING!

user_reviews_extended.Name: TJ Dumser
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm newer to visiting BLVD but Alexia (Lexi) made my visit to see the orthodontist truly wonderful, today. The entire office is really great and friendly. Everyone I've interacted with has always greeted and helped me with a smile (pun very intended). I'm looking forward to starting on my Invisalign journey and the team was very helpful and informative. Would definitely recommend if you're looking for a new dental office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Pettyjohn (Sasa)
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here are so nice! We love coming in for our yearly cleanings - at least as much as anyone can love going to the dentist. Any time I need additional dental work done, they explain the problem clearly to me and answer any questions I have in a helpful way that allows me to weigh my options. Love that they have free parking in the garage too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriela Bastidas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great first appointment. Rochelle, my dental hygienist, was very kind and friendly (and answered my many questions). Dr. Cummings was also great! He took the time to walk me through everything he found regarding my oral health, even small things.  Very kind and friendly as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Pyle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Check it out! My amazing hygienist, Louann,  gave me a lesson on the modified bass technique back in 2024 and I listened! Well I’m finally back in her chair and because of her great, memorable teaching, the teeth actually look good—cavity-free baby! So listen to your hygienist everybody!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Lyles
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Cummings and his staff of hygienists are extremely friendly, but more importantly, knowledgeable and excellent at dentistry. Their services and customer care are top notch....with no pressure for unnecessary procedures. Seeing them twice per year for the past few years has my oral hygiene in very healthy condition.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I bit down a little too hard on a fork and chipped one of my teeth, causing a very sharp point that irritated my tongue. Luckily BLVD was able to fit me in the next day and discussed with me the options of filling in the chipped area or sanding down the protrusion. We decided to sand it down I'm very happy with the work; my tongue is no longer in pain from getting scratched up by the sharp tooth!

edit: I was so excited to find that BLVD was covered under my new dental insurance, but insurance didn't cover sanding down the protrusion. Luckily it was only $60.

I'm removing two stars because I went in for my first standard cleaning and after poking around my gums and calling out numbers, they decided I needed to be on a treatment plan which would cost me over $400 for each "deep clean" (instead of a free twice-yearly normal cleaning like it's supposed to be under my insurance), plus I'd have to go in for 3 or 4 cleanings a year until the issue was resolved (slightly more space between my teeth and gums than is ideal).

I told them I'd go get a second opionon somewhere else before making BLVD my new dentist and I'm glad I did. I went to another nearby dentist that takes my insurance. A family practice, not a corporate, porofit-driven dentist like BLVD. This new dentist said there is absolutely no way they would recommend a deep cleaning for my teeth, and that BLVD is known for over-prescribing expensive cleanings. I'm sure BLVD does great work, but right now I need a regular dentist, not a cosmetic surgeon pushing expensive procedures. I also wasn't fond of all their signs for BOTOX. So I won't be going back, sorry BLVD.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Murray
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was a very pleasant experience and the whole staff was extremely relatable and friendly. Very thorough, and honest approach with their information and answers. I have grown to trust them and their approach which is vital in this field.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ever Onward Ink
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Bright and her staff are incredibly pleasant, and informative.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maddy Vila
user_reviews_extended.Description: Blvd was a breeze. From start to finish, my hygienist (Louann) was detail-oriented, a joy to talk to, and kept me in the loop every step of the way. Dr. Cummings was professional and provided his honest feedback. First time I’ve genuinely enjoyed going to the dentist. Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ritika Bhattacharjee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was really impressed with the quality of care and attention to detail! My dentist took 18 different x-rays in addition to 4 bite wing scans and 1 full panoramic x-ray. This was in addition to getting dental pictures and doing a full cleaning. I don’t normally leave reviews but I was very happy with the quality of care here. Also, everyone who works here has excellent bedside manner and they were so polite. I have never liked coming to the dentist but would be happy to visit this place again. Dr. Nisha really knows her stuff!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vipin Tyagi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
HIGHLY recommend if you are looking for a overall fantastic experience. I was looking around for a good dental care spot and super glad I found this place. Everyone from Dr. Bright to LouAnn are absolutely awesome and very caring about patients. LouAnn has been a blessing in dental health education for me and she truly provides the best experience possible.
Extremely thorough cleaning and the dentist was one of the most attentive & knowledgable I’ve been to. 10/10 on this one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doug Clements
user_reviews_extended.Description: The folks at BLVD took care of me from start to finish. They were flexible in scheduling and rescheduling my appointment. The office was clean and safe. Dr. Cummings was as friendly as his staff. He worked quickly and without any pain. I’m looking forward to coming back in 6 months, and that’s the first time I’ve ever said that about a visit to the dentist. Can’t recommend strongly enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Ortega
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an amazing experience today! Each staff member was so sweet and made me feel welcome. They made sure to explain all that was going on and checked on me constantly. Will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Treks & Bites
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office staff is amazing — they always have every detail covered when I come into the office. My dental hygienist, Richelle, is so friendly and competent did a very thorough job cleaning my teeth! And, Dr. Cummings is a fantastic dentist. He makes plenty of time for questions and concerns, and explains the procedures in an easy to understand manner!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Jourdan
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at BLVD Dentistry are GREAT! As someone who greatly dislikes going to the dentist, I have had only good experiences with BLVD. They always offer helpful tips to keep my teeth in tip top shape in between visits. And when I do what they say, it really works! THANK YOU for helping an anxious dentist goer relax a little. I appreciate you guys!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ripley filipowich
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going to BLVD for a few years and they are sooo amazing. They did a crown and veneer on my two front teeth to fix an issue I had been dealing with for years. They both look amazing and you’d never be able to tell the teeth are veneers. Every time I go into BLVD for a cleaning or anything else it is always such a pleasant and painless experience. Staff is wonderful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bella Sofia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This office is literally the BEST! Everyone is extremely friendly and helpful, I couldn’t feel more at home when I come in and that is special all on its own. To actually look forward to seeing everyone in a dental office is just hard to come by. So I’m very appreciative of that.

Dr. Cummings is a very well rounded dentist, so I was able to not have to go to a specialist to get a tooth removed and it was all done with his utmost care and attention and without pain or any problems. I also had zero issues getting the stud put in for my upcoming implant procedure. In fact when I get to scanned for my implant they called the facility that specializes in that that and was told I could go in right then so I had no waiting period and it took less than 10 minutes to get in and out. All has gone swimmingly. I’m so grateful that I found this office!

If you are looking for a dentist and staff that truly cares about their patients and go the extra mile with being incredibly sweet and polite, I can’t stress enough that THIS is your place! Thank you all for such wonderful care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Lutze
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Back story: a few years ago I chipped my front cap. I’ve had it filled with composite a few times from a handful of different dentists. It needs to be replaced but I’ve been putting it off for a few reasons. Needless to say, the old composite fell off.
When I called in they were very friendly and accommodating. I had to leave two days later for my cousin’s wedding and didn’t want to look like a backwoods hick for pictures. They fit me in very quickly.
The front staff is so welcoming and kind. Very easy to work with. I didn’t fill out the online paperwork since I didn’t get it, but they immediately re-sent it and I got it done pretty quick. It was processed quickly and I was sitting in a chair less than 5 minutes later, on time or maybe even a little early. No hassle, very efficient. No “processing for 20 minutes”, no “waiting room for 30 minutes”.
I was seen relatively soon. Everyone was very friendly. The exam was quick and soon we were on our way…
Dr. Cummings is a true artist. Having this done a few times, this is the first time I felt like someone either a) cared about the job they were doing or b) were competent enough to do it right. His initial sculpt was almost perfect. Of course it needed to be touched up and that went off without a hitch.
The cap feels exactly how it did when it was first put in. Seamless, correct thickness and shape. It is as perfect as it could get.
To be honest I had a little sticker shock, but it was worth every. Single. Penny. It feels and looks great.
I very much look forward to working with Dr. Cummings and his staff in the future for my general and cosmetic needs. HIGHLY recommended. The best dental experience I’ve ever had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience with this team! Just recently became a new client and can't say enough good things. Was able to make my appointments in a timely manner. They did a consult of my teeth and then set up a game plan. My hygienist Ali was a rockstar!! She made me feel so comfortable the entire time and my teeth have never looked so clean. Dr. Nisha is also wonderful and very knowledgable! Highly recommend BLVD.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Mesri
user_reviews_extended.Description: 10/10 Danielle was OUTSTANDING! She contacted me at 7am after I'd left a message about my daughter, who had a horrible accident, chipping a chunk of tooth off and splitting her lip so badly it needed multiple sutures. Danielle arranged an emergency dental appointment THAT MORNING in addition to Oral Surgeon recommendations and a plethora of useful advice and information. My daughters' appointment was on time, efficient and effective and she told me everyone in the offices were kind, patient and made her feel safe and cared for. A HUGE plus for the out-of-state Mom who just wanted to be there in person. She's gone home with a new front tooth filling that looks great! We cannot recommend this practice enough.  You made an awful day end well. Thankyou all so much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Howsley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have a smile that I can feel proud of. Thank you, Dr. Athina!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Talia Kussman
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time here and I had a 10/10 experience. I popped in the week before to see if this location took my insurance (they do), so I was easily able to book an appointment for the following week. SUPER CLEAN office, friendly staff, spoke with such a kind and educated dentist: and of course, they did such an incredible cleaning on my teeth! After not having gone in a year due to Covid, I felt very comfortable and it was a very smooth and fairly quick visit. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheena Sinclair
user_reviews_extended.Description: This practice is wonderful! I’ve been here twice and I didn’t think my experience could get any better than the first time- but I was wrong. My hygienist was amazing (Gabriel- hope I spelled that right ☺️) he was he gentle but efficient. He also explained everything he was doing as well as tips on how to make my teeth and gums healthier at home. The dentist is also great- he pops in, gets in there and  checks everything-  he always seems kind, engaging and I never feel rushed or over sold on anything. You have definitely gained my trust and earned my business ☺️ Side note- I work in a client relationship  industry myself and something I’ve noticed both times is how this business feels like a team atmosphere. Everyone is constantly checking in with each other and offering help if need be. Maybe this is why you feel good vibes at this location- everyone seems really supportive and happy to be there. From the time I walk in to the time I leave I feel happy to be there.... honestly I never thought I’d say that about going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MAM
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was by far the best dental visit I have ever experienced. I waited for leas than 3 minutes for my appointment. They actually took me back a bit early.  The dentist listened, was attentive, and provided great suggestions.  I received my referral before I was even left my chair.  My hygienist provided the best dental cleaning I’ve ever received.  Highly professional, efficient, and overall a great experience.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariana
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Cummings is the best, the staff here are so nice and knowledgeable. They made me feel so welcome and the cold brew was delicious

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Munguia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional team. Was leery about going to BLVD for the first time, but my reservations quickly dissolved when I met Juhi who, made my appointment, Cathy who handled my insurance claim, Rachel the Dental Tech and Dr. Cummings who handled my dental care. They treated me like I had been a customer for years. They went over all the details for me and took time to answer all my questions. The office setting was nice. I felt very comfortable with my Dental team and looking forward to the follow up. Thanks guys great customer service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Varun Gadiraju
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bharania is great - takes time to ask and listen to what the patient wants and then goes through the options, answering any and all questions. She’s warm, friendly, and during my deep cleaning kept checking in to make sure I was comfortable. When I had gum areas that were sensitive and painful she took great care. It’s clear that she cares and is dialed in to providing the best experience and care for her patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob Curcio
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Emergencies handled with complete attention and care. Totally appreciate the kind and expert staff. And of course, the expert care of Dr Cummings. Appreciated!
Best cleanings I’ve ever had from Luane. Checks and cross checks all areas of your mouth to have the cleanest teeth. Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roxann Leija
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great doctors and excellent and friendly staff. Had a tooth pulled and Dr. Cummings was great made sure I didn't feel the pain. Definitely recommend this dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Sims
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist ever!  Staff was extremely polite and friendly. Dr. Cummings was thorough in explaining options and timelines as well as setting expectations. Answered all my questions in a way that was very easy to understand. Going to the dentist has always caused me some anxiety, but within the first 5 minutes I was completely at ease and comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Merket
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to BLVD for a while now and had all good experiences. They are great for cleanings and other dentistry. However, I did a whitening treatment this morning and was pretty disappointed. I was there for 1.5 hours and saw no change to the color at all. The woman who did it was very nice and professional, but the treatment literally did nothing other than make a white dot on one tooth and then I now have scratch marks on a front tooth from being scraped with a metal tool. My teeth aren’t any lighter or brighter at all.  They are great for regular dental care and are very nice/professional so giving three stars, but do not waste your time or money on whitening. I feel like my teeth look slightly worse now and I would definitely not do this again here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Boyle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very short waiting time, super friendly staff and Dr Cummings is knowledgeable and personable. They are great about reminding me for my appointment and communication is smooth and easy. I’m not even that mad that I have to go back in for a follow up. Thanks BLVD!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Springer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our first dental visit here in Austin as recent transplants.  Very satisfied with scheduling, dental workmanship and personalities throughout the organization.  Glad to have found a solid Dentist nearby

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kareem Yaghnam
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is the best of the best!! Had a nightmare experience prior to switching to BLVD dentistry and it’s been the best decision. Dr.Cummings and his staff are super knowledgeable and they have the most up to date equipment. Danielle at the front desk is also great to work with! The free nitro cold brew is a plus!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy Gentry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Updating after a call trying to reschedule an appt. I’ve never experienced an unhelpful and curt employee at this location until today. I cancelled the appt.  I have used Blvd. for over 3 years and always received the best service. No wait on scheduled appt. They are usually able to complete any additional work needed on same day as preventative care. The dental hygienist is amazing- sorry can’t remember her name.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jorge Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: From my initial registration call and my appointment with BLVD, I was very impressed.  Subsequent calls scheduled the appointment and even helped me find the office. The office staff, Danielle and Carmen, were congenial, patient and helpful in all aspects. While Michelle, the hygienist and Dr. Cummings were conversant, considerate and professional. Overall, a great experience. Glad I found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Wigley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I could not be happier with BLVD and Dr. Cummings! The office staff is amazing too! I highly recommend them. If you’re anxious about dentist visits like I am, they make that disappear. Definitely go see them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith Brandtjen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve only had great experiences with BLVD. Great dentists and hygienists. Excellent care and only recommend doing work that is necessary. They are also great about reviewing costs with you as well so there are no surprises. Can’t recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt P
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great, friendly staff. I had a bunch of quick x-rays to complete, a full exam, a cleaning, and then a polish. Everyone took great care of me and listened to my questions. They answered all my questions and genuinely care for my health and what is best for me and my teeth! Highly recommend and I got to watch Netflix while I waited 🙂 I left with extremely clean teeth and great advice on how to maintain my smile 😬

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shantis Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: BLVD Dentistry is has been my best dental choice I’ve made since moving to Texas in 2019! I love that the office is located directly downtown. This is a great and remarkably clean place to go to take care of your teeth, and the best dental care I’ve ever experienced. The staff and doctors are great, friendly, professional, honest, compassionate, welcoming and very knowledgeable. I always have a pleasant, smooth, and hastily service/experience here. 10/10 highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madeleine Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: BLVD is a great choice for dental work! Their staff is so kind, patient, and very good at explaining things to you plainly. Their office is very clean and calming, and follows COVID protocols. They made me an excellent treatment plan and have been very flexible with anything I needed. 10/10 would recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen M.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My boss went in for some dental work thinking that BLVD was in network. He paid up front for the service figuring he would sort the insurance stuff out after and be reimbursed.

BLVD was not in network, but was kind enough to give him a $150 refund even knowing he wouldn't be back since he would be staying in-network going forward.

We really appreciate the empathy and generosity shown to us. Thanks BLVD!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelli raisler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for a few years and everyone that works here is so nice! I used to have a lot of anxiety about going to the dentist but they help me feel so comfortable when I’m there. I never hesitate to ask questions and trust that they give me their honest thoughts on treatments without feeling pressured to spend more money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sullie Stephens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Cummings is a great. Highly recommend. Never have to wait very long which is a big plus. The staff is super friendly and accommodating. He treats my husband and kids as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Marin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
These guys are great! I'm one who typically gets stressed when visiting a dentist, but Gabriel has a nice manner to him that puts you at ease during the cleaning. Dr. Cummings, the dentist, is great too. He's quite the professional. He recently did an extraction, and I'm very pleased with the quality of service and personal bedside manner - a combination not typically found throughout the healthcare community in my experience. Finally, Danielle at the front desk is a pleasure to work with. She takes the time to make sure that I'm her number 1 priority.

Thanks BLVD Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adan Gaona
user_reviews_extended.Description: Blvd has been my place to go for my dental work and now my orthodontic. The staff are always very friendly and welcoming. I really like the proactive approach they take here. They lay out your options of “ while you’re here let’s do this that and this “ vs adding 3 visits. Works for for me always. I highly recommend it to anyone. Great staff, clean , lots of parking space ( great for downtown location).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna Sandoval
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist office. Amazing staff - warm & friendly. Book an appointment today. I received an amazing cleaning, exam from Dr. Cummings, and tried the Boost whitening treatment. Amazing results - whiter teeth in a matter of an hour! Dr. Cummings is talented, caring, and the best dentist in town! Thank you, Team BLVD! I can't wait for my next appointment in 6 months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nadia Alsado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about this office and Dr. Nisha. I had delayed care and knew I needed work done. She was so clear in describing next best steps and started the work. The front desk staff was also so helpful and organized. I ended up needing a referral and they got me in the same day. This office really feels like partners in care

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mikaela Novak
user_reviews_extended.Description: Never going to another dentist again! I have had a lot of dental work done in my life and Dr. Cummings and his staff’s level of service surpasses all my prior experiences. They are kind, caring, attentive, and go out of their way to make everything as comfortable and painless as possible. I refer all my friends and family here - there is no one in Austin I trust more with my dental health. This place is the real deal!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming to Blvd for about 2 years now and I’ve received nothing but great service and care from the employees here. I’ve had routine cleanings, pulled teeth, and recently finished up with braces. Never had any issues and if I’ve ever had questions they are quick to respond. I’ve used insurance for all of my procedures. Recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eliot Fleming
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Cummings and his staff were very professional and friendly.  They put together a plan to fix my teeth and dental health going forward, and explained everything clearly and in detail.

*Update* My dental care plan is going great!  Excellent customer service and top quality dental work, I am extremely happy with this team and thankful for all their work improving my dental health!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in today for three fillings. Dr. Cummings and Angela were amazing. The injections were painless and they took their time making sure my bite was normal post fillings. Everyone was super nice as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adaobi Kanu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had dental pain for close to 3 years and after seeing 10 different dentist in 3 different states (I wish I was exaggerating) DR. Cummings was only one willing to go in and fix someone else's mistake. Now I no longer have fear when I eat and am so happy I found this team.
I can't recommend this doctor and this office highly enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jorge Vela
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff, friendly service and very quick with appointments. Honest and up front with pricing.  All the dentists that work here are friendly. Always happy with the work they perform. They make going to the dentist as easy as possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alec Irion
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here for 3 years, and it’s always a great experience! Nice office, free parking, very friendly staff. The free Nitro cold brew tap deserves a 6th star.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susannah Kay
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a really bad experience here today. Seems like this isn't the norm, the front desk told me they were having a "bad day". The dentist couldn't identify which tooth was bothering me, went to see another patient while we were mid conversation, the tech had me sitting for over 20 min without explaining what was happening, I felt like I was in a bad dream. I left with no answers, no X-rays, nothing. horrible experience and won't be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meredith Drukker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had such a good experience at BLVD! I don’t love getting my teeth cleaned (who does) but the team at BLVD walks you through it, helps you relax and offers breaks if needed throughout. Dr. Cummings and his whole staff are wonderful, I’m VERY thankful to have found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Voigt
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist and assistants were 5 star. Dr Cummings was effective and expert. The reason for the 3 star rating is that the front office changed my appointment time without informing me. This has happened  before. It is a massive dissatisfier, and should be addressed by practice management.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Boushra Hashem
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Cummings and his entire staff are amazing! They are honest, and professional. I get the best treatment and the best service on each and every visit. Also, they take the time to answer all my questions and address all my concerns always. Love em and highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geoffrey Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From walking in to me leaving 12/10 experience. The WHOLE staff is always  on point. I’ve never been to a dentist that I’ve felt so chill while getting a rounding clean. I actually almost fell asleep I was relaxed.

If you’re looking for a dentist practice that is consistent, look no further.

Check them out, make them your dentist while you’re in Austin! You won’t regret it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve never enjoyed going to any dentist office, most offices make me feel un-easy and always seem to make the billing complicated and confusing. I rarely write any reviews for any service let alone the Dentist.

This office is different, the friendly and informative  Administrative & Dental team made the entire experience enjoyable (as enjoyable as a Root Canal & Crown can be) and easy. The billing was well explained and I’ve been very happy with the services received.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsey Fujan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first appointment here today and it was a great experience! Everyone is so friendly, from the front desk staff to the hygienist and the dentist. Teeth cleaning was gentle. Great music in the office and fun conversations. I would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kara Hosman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Let me just start by saying I have a huge fear of the dentist, so after seeing Dr. Bhorania, I felt compelled to write a review.

I saw Dr. Nisha Bhorania for a teeth cleaning and checkup- she made me feel so comfortable. She was extremely knowledgeable, listened to my requests and concerns, and was very personable. It seemed she truly cares for the overall well-being of her patients and I think that is hard to find.

I gave 4 stars simply because I have only seen her once, but so far, nothing but great things to say! (Front desk woman was fantastic as well).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Patman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very rude front desk. Please listen to the call from 12/01 at 9:16 am.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roderick Robeson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This location was formerly owned by Floss Dental. And ever since new ownership has taken over it has been the best dentist I’ve ever had in  lifetime. I’ve considered changing dentists to have a location closer to my new home, but after visiting a few other dentists, I can’t see changing ever. They are more thorough, friendly yet always professional and they listen to my concerns, have always been very patient, and always give me several options for treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Molly Thrush
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best dental hygienist I have ever had yesterday- Keisha provided an exceptional cleaning and gave a physical of my jaw and neck checking for other diseases just to be proactive and double check. I have never had a hygienist be so thorough and knowledgeable.  The whole staff is great and welcoming but be sure to request Keisha!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristina Navarro
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn’t ever been to the dentist and they made me feel super comfortable. From the office staff to the assistants and doctors, they were all super great. I had a completely painless procedure done. This will definitely be my go-to dentist. Definitely come here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jean McArthur
user_reviews_extended.Description: Delta Dental insurance fully covers the checkups. Everyone is pleasant and professional.  I'm entirely satisfied with the dental office and the quality of dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley O'Dell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love BLVD Dentistry on 5th! The staff is so kind and prompt. Dr. Cummings is very patient with me as I have severe dental anxiety. He and his staff consistently check to make sure that I am comfortable and offer breaks if I need them. I highly recommend this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Valadez
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s hard to believe but going to the dentist at BLVD dental is so easy! Dr.Cummings and his team makes the whole procedure as painless as possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geoffrey Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the BEST experience! From the correspondence pre appointment, to front desk to getting your teeth cleaned and the Dr. coming 10 out 5 stars! Love this place the everyone here is amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Storms
user_reviews_extended.Description: BLVD Dentistry is the coolest dentist you can go to in ATX. Everyone working is approachable, knowledgeable and super fun to chat with (when you don't have someone cleaning your teeth). Even the actual dental work is not terrible! The work that is being done is clearly explained, there is a chance to ask questions and talk about concerns you have BEFORE they get into your mouth, making it a very collaborative experience. Dare I say, I love going to this dentist? No, I do love going to this dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mafer Paparone
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just went to have my general cleaning, my experience was great. They were following all of the precautions for social distancing and I felt very safe. Aubrey was amazing! She was super gentle and nice! I totally recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Brennan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Cummings was awesome at answering my questions and referred me to a great orthodontic surgeon for my concerns that he could not address. Amanda (hygienist) did an amazing job and made sure I felt comfortable during my cleaning; easily the best I've ever visited. Highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Baize
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love my team of professionals at BLVD on 5th! They are courteous and gentle. No waiting, always accommodating to a random schedule change. They always take the time to talk and explain issues, answer my questions and provide estimates quick and easily so I always know what to expect before diving into any procedures. I’ve never paid more than $150 out of pocket if something isn’t covered. Oh and FREE parking garage!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brent Pillow
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved Dr. Cummings and the entire office and hygienist staff! They were all so friendly, knowledgeable, and helped ease any anxiety or nervousness. Costs were completely transparent and easy to understand. I would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aldrin Sansano
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love this place!! Everyone is so friendly! I met Dr. Nishha today (sorry if I’m butchering her name) but she was very welcoming and answered all my questions. My hygienist (can’t remember) I’m sorry!! Was awesome!! Definitely will recommend to my friends and family!!

-Jeff

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan McMurrough
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everything went like clockwork. I experienced no waiting. I did have some dread of the procedure as I’d had it done years ago at a different dentist’s and found it very painful with an uncomfortable recovery time. This was NOT the same at all! I’ve experienced no pain at all since the anesthetic wore off.

user_reviews_extended.Name: katlyn stonestreet
user_reviews_extended.Description: BLVD Dentistry was an amazing experience! I have dentist anxiety and have for years. I finally bit the bullet and made an appointment here thanks to the already amazing reviews I read. Nisha was very kind and informative through the whole appointment and made me feel at ease. There was a tv to watch while I waited which helped with my anxiety a ton. Overall an awesome experience and i’m thankful to have found this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Fernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great first dental visit! The entire team was very friendly and helpful! Definitely would recommend to a friend. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Renee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got checked in about 10 minutes before appointment. Clean and friendly office. Got x-rays done in about 30 minutes. Teeth looked at for another 30. Overall spent a little over an hour here. Everything that was wrong and needed to be corrected was explained to me in a professional and understanding manner. Mind you all I was very hesitant to come here. Definitely would recommend you all and my friends/family to visit this office and this location in particular!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Morrison
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent. Couldn’t ask for a kinder more considerate service. I feel valued as a client and my dental health has improved greatly since I joined this surgery. Thank you

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Skipton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so very glad that I found out about BVLD! I was afraid at first about finding parking since this location is near downtown, but there are tons in the above parking garage. The front office is very clean and welcoming, and all who have been at the front desk have been very kind. I went for a cleaning last Thursday, found out I needed a filling, and just got it today in all about 30 minutes. Everyone (including Dr. Nisha, Gabriel, Angela, and more) is very nice and easy to talk to, which makes for a more comforting experience. I feel like my teeth and I are in good hands. (:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at BLVD was incredibly nice and did an even better job. Felt like I had been going there for years! They had a plan for me, communicated my options and made sure I was comfortable with it all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Apple oli
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best Denist experience of my life!
I love this office and the amazing professionals who run it!
My teeth are now shiny and clean af.
Thank you BLVD dentistry.
Special thanks to ANGELA and Ally. The dentist was so thorough. I'm a fan.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cat Weigt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff and doc were awesome!
I was a little disappointed that they didn't even do the initial cleaning as I was told was part of my 1st visit. I understand they want to schedule me for a deep cleaning but not at this time. So why not a regular cleaning 1st??

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dawn Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got me in right away. Dr. Cunningham and Nyla were awesome! Identified the problem and put a temporary crown on the same day! Staff took care of the insurance and communicated quickly. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wangala Mbuzi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It was my first time to this location and after my visit I booked my son the next day because I liked it.

Awesome bunch people. It’s rare for children to enjoy time at the dentist office but my son did. He loved everyone he encountered at the premises.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan McCue
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lost part of filling over the weekend,. Monday morning got an appointment (wasn’t an emergency). They got me in Tuesday morning, now I have a temporary crown and appoint for new permanent crown. This team is quick efficient and empathetic. I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love coming here! Easy, free parking and they’re transparent about costs of various treatments. Everyone is super friendly and they explain things to you very well about how you can improve your oral hygiene. Very happy with everyone there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Fain
user_reviews_extended.Description: Danielle is the absolute BEST! I am a person that puts off going to the dentist because I get anxiety. From the Doc to the Staff to the location and ambiance…it’s top notch (and they have a free parking structure which is also nice being in the downtown area). I felt like my needs and concerns were met and that I was actually listened to. Things that are huge for an apprehensive dental patient. I will never go anywhere else as long as I live in Austin. Thank you!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Thuy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved from Houston last year and was looking for a new dentist! I’ve had two dental cleanings, and my hygienist, Allie, does a great job in cleaning my teeth and spotting issues. She’s given me tips to keep my teeth healthy. Everyone is friendly, especially Dr. Nisha!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ali Gates
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly office! From the moment I walked in everyone was kind and considerate, and Rick introduced me to everyone as we were walking back - made me feel so welcome! Dr. Grover was very thorough and considerate, and took the time to explain everything to me. He patiently answered all of my questions and took the time with my care, but was also personable and funny! Haven’t ever laughed as much during a dental exam. Thanks to Rick and Dr. Grover for a positive experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came here out of convenience of location. Braces require lots of appointments and was a 5 min walk from office. Somewhat regret the choice as I had a lot of trouble with the office staff/billing and insurance. At the end it was all corrected but I had to do all the leg work. Medical staff was great though. Also they don’t have the latest technology. Recently had my retainer chewed up by friends dog and needed replacement. They don’t keep the molds of your teeth so would’ve required the process all over again at WHOLE cost ($500). Had I known better would have gone to an orthodontist that does the 3-D scanning of your teeth. I know it’s a pricey machine but there’s even some tools that connect to a laptop so you don’t need the screen/monitor part of the machine that are cheaper. For a pricey office in downtown Austin I highly suggest they upgrade.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Schatz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Cummings and team are simply the best around.  I've had an unhealthy fear of dentists for years and avoided the dreaded trip to the dentist for as long as possible.  That has all been changed by Dr. Cummings.  He and the team are extremely professional and kind.  I've referred many friends and colleagues to BLVD and all have had similar excellent experiences as my own.  Don't let a fear of dentists avoid taking care of your teeth.  If you share that fear like me make an appointment with Dr. Cummings.  He'll take great care of you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Max Villarreal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First time patient here and I had a great experience! Front-desk handled insurance before I even arrived and I was met by a friendly assistant who took x-rays and prepped everything for Dr Bhorania, who was very friendly and communicative throughout the cleaning process.

Great place all around and I would definitely recommend to all

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Hollander
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the 1st time i have been back since the change in business. The overall experience was good and professional/friendly. My hygienist on the other hand tanked my perception of the new staff. I don't know if it was just a bad day or lack of experience but my basic teeth cleaning was very poor. I felt like she was going through the motions and didn't want to be there and just phoned in my cleaning. Dragging the polisher across my teeth like a mop to a floor and placing the floss between my teeth but not even performing the action of flossing mystified me. Since our company is located in the same building several of us have gone and had similar experiences. Needless to say I will not be back until i hear things have been addressed and improved upon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Wheeler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have a positive experience at BLVD Downtown. Easy parking, always on time. Super clean, very professional, and they’re great at explaining things and billing promptly and accurately. Have had to get a few fillings, and that all went more smoothly than it has at other dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Conger
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Don't go here.  I have never written a Google review before but feel compelled to based on the experiences I have had at this office over the last 6 months.

I went in initially for a cleaning and was told I had one cavity that I needed filled.  I came back in a few days later and was worked on by another dentist who could not find the cavity that Dr. Cummings had previously identified.  After an awkward wait, Dr. Cummings came in and found the cavity and got to work.  I paid my bill that day and went on my way but felt odd at that experience to say the least.

I received an additional bill in the mail 5 months later with no explanation as to what services it was for.  When I inquired about it, I was told the old office manager had billed things incorrectly and my insurance didn't cover what had previously been expected.  After paying the additional amount, I checked the claim on my insurance website and come to find out none of the numbers match up.  I've essentially double paid for something that I should have owed nothing on.

It gets better...during my 6 month cleaning, Dr. Cummings identified a tooth that needed a root canal.  This wasn't entirely surprising and I was willing to move forward with it until his assistant took pictures of another area of my gums and told me it was very concerning and looked like it may be cancer.  I responded by saying that "cancer" isn't a word that should be used casually and I'm sure that there could be several other explanations.  (all I need are gum grafts, which I know, but they were never once mentioned).

I called another Dr. this morning to get an appointment for a second opinion and they were appalled that a) I had been given a possible cancer diagnosis with no grounds or basis and b) that a root canal had been scheduled without ever having x-rays taken.

I would not have taken the time to write this if I didn't feel very compelled to warn others.  I had a coworker go here for a root canal in the fall which landed him in oral surgery because the procedure was botched.  I don't know the details surrounding this and can't speak to them but I am concerned at the lack of professionality and the coincidences that exist between the two situations.

Be very careful with the team at Blvd Dentistry.  Ask questions and get a second opinion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Garner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this dental office and the staff. Everyone is so kind and professional. I am very satisfied with the services they offer and provide. 5 stars doesn't do any justice. They are off the charts!! ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nisha & dental hygienist were fantastic. As someone with very sensitive skin, I always dread going to the dentist, due to the fear of a potential flare-up my Perioral dermatitis (ie due to rubbing around the mouth area & dental cleaning products having contact with my skin). The dentist was very gentle throughout the entire treatment and took extra care to make sure I was upmost comfortable throughout the entire visit. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
BLVD Dentistry at 5th St. is a clean, bright office with a professional and friendly staff. I went there for an emergency dental visit. They were very accommodating and took excellent care of me.
Dr.Cummings is a kind, patient and intelligent dentist. Rachel and Danielle are extremely helpful as well. I would highly recommend this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Celeste Molina
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wish pricing for my service was upfront. When I called to book the appointment I asked to see how much it would cost to remove old Invisalign attachments and I was told they didn’t know. I had gone a few years prior and only paid $50, so I figured it would be about the same since they “didn’t” have a set price. I walked out of there paying over $200 too remove 3 attachments. If I would’ve known prior to the service I could’ve called around for prices or just said no thanks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karie Winfree
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist isn’t my idea of a good time, but my postpartum puffy gums had me worried enough to go ahead and book an appointment. Loved the easy online booking and I didn’t have to wait for an appointment. They were quick, friendly and professional. The office is nice and parking is plentiful. Would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ty Snowden
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience, very informative and comforting. Even for having to get a molar pulled there was no discomfort!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Azure S
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first time having a visit with BLVD was May 10, 2021. They all were so polite and friendly! When I asked what certain procedures were they showed a video and explained it so I had better understanding. Dr. Andrew Cummings was so friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Visagie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Do not get your orthodontic work here.

I had an appointment on 10/18.
On that day, I scheduled my final appointment for 12/20.
This was the appointment I was eagerly waiting for.
It's when I would get everything off and finally be done.

I got a call today 12/13 saying there was a mistake...they shouldn't of booked me then because the orthodontist is out of town.
They had to push it back even further to 1/17 (the earliest).

The kicker- they KNEW he wouldn't be in town the beginning of November.

So for 1.5 months they had this information yet didn't let me know until a week prior.

Another kicker- the orthodontist only comes to the office 1 or 2 times out of the MONTH.
So it's not like there's a complicated schedule.

You'd think you'd get better customer care paying $3,400 out of pocket...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Edit: I came back to finish the crown procedure that was accidentally scheduled and Dr. Cummings and I had a discussion about the frustrations I had the last time, and he was kind enough to hear me out and refund me for the misunderstanding. I’m obv very pleased and grateful about this, especially because I was not expecting that and I was fully prepared to just front the cost. What a pleasant surprise, and so generous of him. Changing my review to 5 stars because it really is a great place. I’m glad that everything was cleared up. Definitely going to return, as exceptional service can be hard to come by.

Original: Truthfully I don’t know if I should give it a 3 star or 2 rating. It’s a great place, with updated equipment and tools, it’s clean, parking is free, everyone seems friendly enough and the waits are decent.

Now. I’m a pretty patient person and I’m not high maintenance. But they seem to have messed up my appointments and etc on multiple occasions (on all occasions I’ve been there), I believe all 4 times and that’s frustrating to me. I’m pretty sure I’m speaking loud enough otherwise they’d tell me to speak up.

It’s like they are just scheduling what they want anyway, despite me telling them explicitly what I wanted the next appointment. It’s frustrating. I was told that I don’t have to follow their plan in order, I can “jump around”. So that’s what I did. I scheduled for the two mercury fillings to be removed. But to my surprise, when I came there they scheduled me for something else. I was not planning or budgeting to spend the money for the crown procedure they accidentally scheduled me for that week, as I was planning to do that in two months. Now, my tooth is so sensitive and that’s not what I wanted at all at this time. But whatever. Apparently I “signed the consent forms” — yes true but the consent forms simply told me about the dangers of a list of procedures… fillings being one of them. Which I thought I was getting. Never was I told by any of them what was actually going to happen. Just, hey, sign these consent forms so we can get started. I guess I trusted my appointment would be made correctly — just the mercury fillings as discussed with the assistant my last visit. So now I spent $450 that I really was not planning to spend at the dentist at that time. I think that the break down of the procedures should be explained up front, before the consent forms. I don’t know what these dental terms are and I don’t need to. Telling me to sign a consent form for a crown and fillings isn’t out of the ordinary for me since I don’t know what goes into a removal of mercury fillings. A crown may be required. Idk.

The other time I was mischeduled. I said a specific date and they said okay, only to find out it was the wrong date, for the following month. Good thing I told the other girl at the front desk what my intended date was and she caught it.

Then, the other time, I scheduled just a regular cleaning, not gingivitis cleaning. And yet, lo and behold, when I went there, they took it upon themselves to do/schedule me for the gingivitis cleaning. Another unintended expense I did not plan for. They said “oh we just made the decision to do the gingivitis cleaning instead”. I get that it’s a deeper clean and I intended to do it, but I would just like to schedule things that I schedule and not have someone override them without bringing it up to me first because there are reasons why I schedule them the way I do. That said, great experience, I’m glad it was done ultimately.

Another thing that was disheartening - one lady was digging into my gums with the end of the larger suction and it really hurt. It was like she was resting her entire weight on it but I didn’t say anything because my mouth was numb and I couldn’t speak from the liquid in my throat. I just prayed it would stop, and eventually it did.

I’ll see how things pan out and edit my review if anything changes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rob Metcalfe
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was not actually greeted, the receptionist, while pleasant, just asked what my last name and date of birth was. I wasn’t even sure if they knew I had scheduled an appointment. They made no mention of whether I was on the schedule, how long the wait was gonna be or anything like that. No acknowledgement of me being expected or anything. Then they asked for my insurance card and asked me to fill out the paperwork which took a few moments. When they did call me in, the tech actually said “welcome to the practice” but didn’t introduce himself, nor why I was being asked to stand in front of a large white contraption. Eventually I was instructed to bite on a piece of plastic that was wrapped in plastic, after having a lead vest placed on me, so obviously it was an X-ray machine. Would have been nice to know that ahead of time. Call me old fashioned.

Then I was asked to sit in an exam room, fair enough, yet there were three chairs including the exam chair...so I picked the exam chair but didn’t sit all the way down because I figured I would have to move in case I might have to be relocated or something. The room was devoid of decoration which I found somewhat unsettling but I got over it. The music was pretty good, so I jammed out to Rick James while I waited, which lightened the mood. The tech returned to take my blood pressure, which, again, I didn’t know was happening but should have guessed due to the cuff that inflated on my arm, but I’m sorry, I don’t remember getting my blood pressure checked at the dentist before....call me old fashioned.

When the tech returned, he instructed me to sit all the way in the exam chair and we discussed the x-rays a bit which turned out to be positive and he made me feel better about my lack of dental visits for the last 25 years, because my xrays looked good. He continued to explain that I would see some new technology since I hadn’t been in a dentists office in so long, which I appreciated.

The tech’s tools and gloves had a less-than-pleasant taste and I couldn’t help but wonder, would it be that difficult to make these things taste minty or maybe have a choice of flavors to make the experience more pleasant?

The device used to take additional xrays (I guess, another lead vest was administered so again I’m deducing, but was never actually ‘told’ what was happening) was odd in that I had to clamp my teeth over it and while doing so I felt the need to swallow, but was instructed not to move so I tried my hardest not to do so.

When the dentist came in, he was the first person to introduce himself, And welcomed me to the practice, which was nice, he reaffirmed the good news that my X-rays looked good. He began to poke around and talked to the tech about their findings and did a good job about explaining what was happening. Once he was done, he explained the treatment plan, then he said Danielle will be in to explain the billing. Danielle came in and it turned out to be the same person who “greeted” me. She welcomed me to the practice again,
and was very sweet and explained everything clearly and even complimented me on my insurance.

So, I had to schedule a future appointment to actually get any cleaning done, which I didn’t realize until speaking with Danielle, but given my length of non-care, I can understand. It would have been nice for someone to say this before beginning the whole ordeal, but things could have been much worse.  I can tell they value “welcoming to the practice” but they could work on their introductions/greeting skills and general intake process, being more informative and asking if the patient has any questions. Call me old fashioned.

title: Swish Dental South
address: 3715 S 1st St suite b, Austin, TX 78704, United States

user_reviews.Name: Hank Day
user_reviews.Description: Very nice experience. Something I can’t say about my previous dentist. They have state of the art equipment and the staff are great. The dentist was thorough and explained all options. The dental hygienist was excellent. She did an excellent job on cleaning and help me understand what I needed to do to keep my teeth and gums healthy. I would recommend Swish to anyone.

user_reviews.Name: Christiana Scheibmeir
user_reviews.Description: Amazing experience at Swish Dental! I had a wisdom tooth extracted, and Amanda was absolutely fantastic. She did an incredibly fast, smooth, and pleasant job. I was honestly shocked at how easy it felt! The entire team was so kind, accommodating, and transparent throughout the whole process. Couldn’t recommend them more!

user_reviews.Name: Mandy Marino
user_reviews.Description: My experience was really great. Check in went smoothly, and both Dr. Marx and hygienist were understanding and supportive of my nerves around going to the dentist. They answered all my questions and got me quickly scheduled for a follow up.

user_reviews.Name: Morgan Belcher
user_reviews.Description:
Staff is friendly but definitely not like a normal dentist I’ve ever dealt with.

Came for my normal cleaning and apparently only had time for X-rays. I ended up having to come back two days later for my cleaning, and was told I’d have to have a follow up visit to fix my bite even though it was supposed to be done during the first visit.

Neither of those two visits did any of the dentist see me. Just the person dealing with X-rays and scans during the first visit and the hygienist the second visit. Nobody went over my X-rays or scans with me either.

Don’t recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Jett Elliott
user_reviews.Description: Thank God for Dr. Marx. She just did my root canal and I can say without a doubt I've never had a better dentist. Her and her assistant are a wonderful team. So pleased. Big recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Lily Cook
user_reviews.Description: I had a toothache that made me go home early from work on Thursday, and I was able to make an appointment here at Swish for Friday morning. I wasn’t sure how it would go, as I have out of state insurance, and this was my first time going to a dentist in Austin. Patricia greeted me a few minutes before my appointment and walked me to the exam room where she explained the process for new patients, including quick x-rays in the exam room, a panoramic X-ray down the hall, and a cool 3D Itero scan I had never heard of before! The whole process took about 2 hours from start to finish. This sounds long but it was efficient and thorough, my two favorite things. Patricia was kind and friendly and we had nice conversation while she cleaned my teeth before the Doctor came in for my exam. Every team member I interacted with, from Patricia as my hygienist, to Nelly who helped with the Itero scan, everyone was so friendly! The doctor came in and examined me after Patricia had finished the cleaning. She was able to suggest a night guard for my tooth pain, and even showed me the muscles in my head and neck that were contributing to my aches! I feel lucky and thankful that they didn’t try to perform any additional dental procedures when they identified that my ailments were muscular and not dental. I already booked my next cleaning and I am excited to be a new customer at this location.

user_reviews.Name: Martha Lopez
user_reviews.Description: If I could give it negative stars, I would.  Took my nephew because he accidentally broke his tooth.  After consultation they gave us a price for a procedure, so I went and paid for it. He had to come back at a later time to get it done and after the procedure was done, he was told that he needed to complete the rest of the procedure at a later time and it was additional money.  This was never explained to us.  The representative tried to apologize for the "miscommunication" but there was deception, not miscommunication, on their part.  I asked all the right questions and made sure I was fully informed at the first visit.  They chose not to give me the full information and that is outright deception.  I will never go nor recommend Swish Dental.  Very sweet and nice people working there, but that does not change the experience of being outright deceived.  Neither does them trying to hush me with a free whitening treatment.

user_reviews.Name: Maribel Snider
user_reviews.Description: Another good dental experience at this site!  The office seems to have the latest in technology. Staff is very helpful, kind, and friendly.  Hygienist (Robbie) and Dentist were very patient with me as I asked questions.  I was well informed about methods and options for my situation.  I was even offered entertainment during my exam with a remote and a TV!   I felt like I was in competent hands my entire visit.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been searching for a dental office that would be understanding to all of my understanding ofmy issues and embarrassment of the consequences of my actions with my oral health. After my initial appointment I felt empowered with the words of encouragement for a brighter future Swish,Just had the right environment for me to begin realizing confident that my-dental goal would be met within reason.My family especially my daughter expressed she could hear in my voice I was making the right decision. I appreciated that I was not scolded or belittled for the negligence, The focus was on my oral health and regaining a smile that I felt confident being around people.

user_reviews_extended.Name: m p (mp1146)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Never again. My appt was for broken tooth extraction. Swish checked me in and when the dr came in, she proceeded to tell me she didn't do extractions and why, and told me all about her back problems. She said she would refer me to someone else and sent me to ck out. They charged my insurance, i paid the office visit copay , nobody ever called to follow up. For 30 mins of nothing except a sob story about back pain, nvrmind my broken tooth, they keep texting me to pay additional $117.90 after my insurance was billed. I'm not paying it. Send me to collections. I'll fight in court, whatever. Charge my estate when i'm dead. I'm not paying any more money for 30 mins of nothing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: R P
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an extremely frustrating experience with Swish Dental, starting with being overcharged for services. That alone was bad enough—but two months later, I am still waiting to be reimbursed.
I reached out multiple times by email and was completely ignored. No follow-up, no explanation, no sense of urgency. I eventually had to involve my insurance company just to get any movement at all. Thankfully, they stepped in and confirmed the issue. A representative from Swish then stated that a reimbursement would be issued.
That was two weeks ago. Still nothing.
This isn’t a one-off mistake—it reflects a serious lack of organization, communication, and accountability. Patients should not have to chase down their own money or rely on their insurance company to do the clinic’s job for them.
To be clear: this is only the first of three negative experiences I’ve had with Swish. I will be posting reviews for the other two as well.
I strongly recommend thinking twice before trusting this clinic with your care or your billing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: brittney wade
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dulce was the best with my cleaning per usual ! Love when you can just feel at home while in the ops chair. Dr.Shadman was the sweetest! Ale was amazing at check in and OM Dominique always so personable!
Best crew ever!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika Coffey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They gave me a temp crown, said to come back in a month, they’d put in the permanent crown. When I came back they rooted around in my mouth and then told me it wasn’t right bc the lab did it wrong and I had to wait longer. Put the temp crown back in… poorly. It ripped out the next day, leaving my face swollen and my mouth tender. Unable to eat, barely sleeping, VISIBLE swelling on the outside. Called to tell them I needed an emergency appointment, thinking they understood the urgency (i.e. the inability to rest or eat). They worked kindly with my schedule to get me in 2 days after I called. Less than 2 hours before my appointment they cancelled on me and sent me to another location over 20 miles away. I asked for emergency time off of work and missed out on pay to make it to the 2pm. Disappointing and frustrating.

Edit: they gave me an infection, had another office fix it, that office put the crown in wrong so I can’t chew. Then less than a week from the NEW date they said they’d put my permanent crown in, they cancelled on me. Don’t go here they do not respect their patients

user_reviews_extended.Description: Lady at front desk was rude. Got a root canal and it broke. Dentist said I can come in anytime to fix it, the lady said I had to pay $500 to get it fixed despite the dentist’s promise to help me and my budget. Never going back. My teeth are now infected b/c of false promises and the fact I don’t have stable income. If it becomes something life threatening, good. At least my family will
