Was able to these slight sedation, everything went smoothly, felt nothing and still have no pains after ......Amazing

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler U
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone from the doctor to the office manager made sure to explain all the details and treatment options to me before I made any decisions. They made sure any questions I had were answered and if I thought of anything afterwards to be sure to call. Everyone was incredibly friendly and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luki Martino
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I decided to give Swish Dental another chance because my new dentist moved. Big mistake.

I never got a text confirmation of my appointment, and when I called to verify, the girl on the phone started asking me a bunch of questions while I was just trying to confirm the time. Then 30 minutes before my appointment, I finally get a text with paperwork to fill out, not when I booked and not days ahead, but thirty minutes prior, while I was already driving.

I showed up 7 minutes late due to traffic, and they told me they wouldn’t do my cleaning, only the exam, since I hadn’t filled out the paperwork. When I said I’d just reschedule so I could do everything at once, they told me there would be a $50 reschedule fee because I was late and hadn’t done the forms in advance, the same forms they didn’t send until 30 minutes before.

To top it off, earlier that same morning I got a call at 10:08am asking if I could come in for a 10am appointment because someone canceled. As if I could travel back in time.

I left Swish years ago because they kept pushing Invisalign at every visit and doing 3D scans of my teeth without explaining why. Going back was a mistake, and I won’t be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kris Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was scheduled quickly. They were able to do the extraction the same day as my exam as the doctor was in the office that day. Dr. Marx was very understanding, explained the quick procedure and offered options to make the experience virtually pain free. My anxiety subsided & this was the best experience at a dental office! Excellent Doctor & support staff! Will be back for more work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emmanuel Effiong
user_reviews_extended.Description: Pretty cool place. Everyone (and I do mean everyone) was kind and helpful ensuring that the visit was smooth and without hiccups or surprises for the future. Got a whitening for the first time ever and got to binge a couple of episodes of Brooklyn 99 while I waited for the procedure to finish. Overall, 10/10 would do again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Don’t go here unless you want to donate money to a medical chain for no reason. Other 1 star reviews echo this notion— they will diagnose you for treatments you do not need.

Went in for a standard clean, got upsold on a $200 gum treatment that looking back on it, I doubt I needed. Got diagnosed with 8 cavities with several more needing to be watched for treatment within 6 months. I have never had a cavity in my life and have no mouth pain, so I questioned this. Especially when I was quoted nearly $1000 for the 8 fillings.

Went to a second dentist to get another opinion, to find out I have 2 cavities that actually need treatment and the rest they diagnosed were staining or small soft spots. It’ll cost $100 to get those 2 filled with my new dentist.

I also tried to get my X-rays released to me, but they were having system problems and couldn’t send my records. Once it came back online, they sent to the wrong email. Told me they would correct and send again, never did.

Go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Goldman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been coming to this office for several years now seeing Dr. Marx and I can’t recommend it enough! Everyone is kind, professional, and the whole experience is always smooth and stress-free.

I especially want to shout out my dental hygienist, Dulce! She is so friendly and always makes me feel completely comfortable during my appointments. I really appreciate how she takes the time to explain things and she genuinely cares about her patients!

If you’re looking for a place where you feel well taken care of from the moment you walk in, this is it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: JOHN GENTRY
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service in an emergency.  Staff reacted quickly to an individual who was obviously in pain. Dr was the epitome of professionalism and compassion. This is the place to go.

user_reviews_extended.Name: len c
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hate going to the dentist!!! BUT this group was awesome. They were so warm from the initial call setting up my appointment to the hospitality throughout the visit. My hygienist was quick , thorough and kind.  The dentist didn't try to drill out every little dark spot she saw on my tooth as an up charge cavity filling. We discussed a plan for my teeth grinding, which no dentist had ever talked to me about before. She didn't try to up-sell every procedure to me.   I really liked everything about them! I found my new dental practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alejandro SA
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience at Swish Dental! The staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and made me feel comfortable throughout my visit. They provided clear and helpful information about all my treatment options, and went above and beyond to help me get the best possible price for Invisalign. I truly appreciated their honesty, professionalism, and the genuine care they showed. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Macatuno
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a patient of Swish for four years and have always had a wonderful experience. Brad was my hygienist at this most recent visit and honestly, it was the best cleaning experience I’ve ever had. He was so nice, very gentle, and when he did the X-rays I didn’t feel any pain with the piece being placed around my mouth (usually that’s the most uncomfortable party for me). I also really like that Swish offers a yearly plan. The dental insurance through my work isn’t good, but Swish’s package is so reasonably priced and it covers everything you need for Bi-yearly cleanings and maintenance.

Two years ago I also went through Swish for Invisalign. It was a great experience overall and they really took care of me throughout the process.

Everyone from the front desk staff, to the hygienists, to the Dr are communicative, pleasant, and warm. If you’re looking for a change, Swish on South 1st should be at the top of your list!

user_reviews_extended.Name: S. Ra W
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dental hygienist I’ve ever had, Dulce. My routine dental cleanings are usually painful as they tend to be rough with me and stab me a lot. But I was comfortable the whole time and the end result was flawless. I didn’t know that kind of experience was possible. The front desk staff and the dentist were also excellent and the office and tools are the most modern/advanced that I’ve experienced. I’m also grateful for the promotional discount on Invisalign. I’ve been wanting to do it for 5 years, and the discount finally made it accessible to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sarah standard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience at Swish Dental on South First! From the moment I walked in, the staff was welcoming, friendly, and professional. The office has a calm, clean and safe environment, making it easy to feel relaxed. Dr. Shadman, Dr. Marx, RDA Victor, and Dominique at the front desk took the time to explain everything clearly and answered any and all of the questions I could throw at them while also making sure I felt comfortable throughout the entire process. I was in and out quickly with excellent care, and my teeth have never felt better! I can’t wait to continue my dental journey with swish on south first! I highly recommend this team for anyone looking for a top-notch dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelli Sue Thompson, NP-C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Natalie, my dental hygienist was absolutely phenomenal. I have a lot of gum sensitivity and she took every precaution to make sure I didn’t feel a thing. Thank you, Natalie.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Philip Ortega
user_reviews_extended.Description: This location is fantastic! Dulce took wonderful care of my teeth during my cleaning, and Dr. Marx was very informative, reassuring, and cheerful. I felt very well taken care of, and will be using this location for my dental needs for the foreseeable future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connie Pi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every visit is awesome! I appreciate the attention and care. Everyone is always in a great mood. Makes me wanna come back every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: SharkTheBear
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Swish Dental! They take care of my teeth so well. I used to go to the Bullcreek office before I moved to this area and started coming here. Natelie and Dr. Marx take such great care of my teeth, and they have a very positive attitude. They really take the time to explain the status of my teeth and what I need to do to get them to their healthiest state. I would highly recommend this clinic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Olesky
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an emergency dental issue while I was travelling from out of the country to Austin for a few days. My friend referred me to Swish and the entire team there at the office on 1st Street were so kind and friendly. Dr Marx listened to my needs and provided me with exactly what my dentist back home had recommended. She was knowledgeable and precise and ensured that my care was affordable. Bailey was super helpful and found me a pharmacy close to where I was staying since I didn't know the city. And Dominique was very patient and sent me on my way with the documentation required for me to make a travel claim with my insurance company.
Thanks again team! I only wish I was from the area so I could become a permanent patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kris
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love the team at Swish Dental on South First! I’ve gone to many dentists in my life but none have made me feel as comfortable and supported as Dr. Marx and the rest of the amazing staff. Every visit I’ve been greeted with my preferred name, smiles, and kindness. Dr. Marx comes in and does her magic. I leave with the best checkout experience and the peace of mind I’m taking care of my dental health. This will be my dental team as long as they’ll have me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nayeli Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I want to start by saying — I hate the dentist. Dental visits have always filled me with dread: painful treatments, judgmental attitudes, and cold, uncomfortable office vibes.

However, Swish Dental completely changed that experience for me. From the moment I checked in to the moment I checked out, every staff member was welcoming, attentive, and truly tailored the experience to meet my needs. They were punctual, professional, and kind.

Each chair comes with a private TV, which was a nice touch to help ease my anxiety. Every service was thoroughly explained, including costs, so there were no surprises.

Dr. Amanda Marx, DDS was incredible. She walked me through my X-rays and images, explaining everything in detail. She was thorough during the cleaning and even double-checked her work with additional images to ensure everything was addressed. Throughout the entire appointment, she made sure I was comfortable, informed, and understood each step — which I truly appreciated as someone with anxiety.

Dr. Marx was patient, funny, and extremely professional. We discussed my treatment plan in detail. Instead of pressuring me into unnecessary or potentially harmful procedures — like I’ve experienced elsewhere — she broke down the pros and cons of every option, empowering me to make informed decisions about my care.

I still hate going to the dentist — but if I have to go, I’ll definitely keep going back to Swish Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Noel Craft
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely adored my visit to Swish! It was easy, breezy, and so pleasant! From the staff to the setting- I was made to feel so comfortable and welcomed. My teeth feel squeaky clean and I cannot wait to be back for next steps on keeping my teeth happy. 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacquelyn Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dulce is the absolute best!!! She makes me feel so comfortable and at ease. And this last time she put something very special and meaningful on the TV. Thank you, Dulce! You're so lovely. 100/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shane Lawson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called Swish Dental - South because I was experiencing immense pain in one of my upper teeth. They were able to get me in early the following morning and discovered that I urgently needed a root canal. Because I was leaving for a trip out of the country that same day, they did everything they could to squeeze me in for the root canal that same day! Dr. Marx was so professional and friendly. Her passion for her work really shined through! Even better, after the root canal they were able to fit me in for my routine dental cleaning! I am so grateful for this office and the entire team that worked to help me out in my time of need. They are awesome people doing great work here in Austin! I highly recommend Swish Dental - South to anyone looking for an AMAZING dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelli Sue Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Loehr was very attentive. I am a little bit worried about pricing. I guess I’ll find that out next week. But he helped me to feel better about my situation. I’ve been struggling with dental issues since 2017. He was very thorough and explained his planned course of action. The reassurance was priceless.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gita Sinha
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was visiting my kids and grandkids from Atlanta when I experienced severe pain in my tooth. I was able to get a quick appointment at Swish Dental Clinic. Everyone was super friendly, efficient, professional and I had a wonderful experience overall. My problem was fixed, I was given great advice and suggestions on next steps when I returned home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Leinen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience!! I moved from another location and I’m glad I did. The staff was welcoming and informed. The hygienist and Dr were calm and gentle with a great positive attitude. Highly recommend! Also if you don’t have dental insurance like myself, the membership plan is the way to go. It covers your annual cleaning and so much more. And it’s under $300 for the year.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meghan Crawford
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I do not recommend Swish as a dental provider. I rarely write reviews, but I feel compelled to share my experience to help others make informed decisions—especially since dental work is so important and permanent.

I visited the South 1st Swish location in fall 2024. Although I hadn’t been to the dentist in about a year, I have always maintained regular dental care and never had major issues and no previous crowns. After my appointment at Swish, I was given an extensive treatment plan that included two crowns, multiple fillings, and a recommendation for Invisalign "touch up". This was surprising, as no dentist in the past 29 years had ever suggested I needed this much work.

Concerned, I sought a second opinion from an independent dentist. After a routine cleaning, they recommended only three minor fillings (no numbing required). When I showed them the treatment plan from Swish, they were shocked. The new dentist examined the teeth Swish said needed crowns—one only needed a shallow filling, and the other was perfectly healthy. The same was true for the other recommended work (fillings) and found no need for Invisalign.

Based on my experience, it appears Swish may be motivated by sales rather than patient care. It felt as though unnecessary procedures were being recommended to meet sales targets.

Dental work is permanent, and you only get one set of teeth. I am grateful I trusted my instincts and got a second opinion. My new dentist is even writing a letter to my insurance company to help explain why the original treatment plan from Swish was excessive to see if they aren't willing to cover the additional x-rays I needed when getting another opinion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ludi Alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Words can't express how GRATEFUL I am with Dr. Marx and entire staff. As a new patient,they were able to get me in same day to relieve me from unbearable pain. Now, I am pain free and enjoying life. (Its the little things that make a difference)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Springer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always friendly and great service. They make any effort to make sure I am taken care of in a timely manner. They are prompt at getting me in the dental seat at my appointment time. The front desk is always willing to help out with any paperwork needed for insurance or FSA purposes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reilly Jorgensen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am the worst dental patient. I cry everytime because I have so much anxiety. This office is so incredibly kind, patient, and professional with me as I’m a mess. I went way too long without seeing a dentist and they have never made me feel any kind of way about that. They are just here for me to fix with needs fixing. They took out my wisdom teeth today and it was so fast! So even though I was anxious I didn’t have to feel that way for long. I love every employee I have met here they are the best. Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Griselle Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent and friendly service! It was my first time. I was called in quickly, got a regular cleaning done same day.🤩 The Technician and the Doctor were amazing. I really liked the experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Morales
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience has wished never just disappoints! Never in my life I enjoyed going to the dentist until I met Dr. Mark's and the fabulous hygienist Natalie! If you’re looking for a new dentist, which is definitely the way to go!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiara Crawford
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Quick Storytime:

I had a periodontal scaling procedure done here in 2019. It was a great experience. Life did life things and I failed to upkeep my oral health.

Fast forward to 2025...
Embarrassed, I went to a different dentist for a consultation. I had such a headache of an experience, so I decided to go back to Swish.

Night and day, folks!

They verified my insurance was in-network before I even scheduled my first appointment. The staff was approachable, non-judgemental, and seemed to genuinely care about my experience. I appreciate the treatment recommendations were focused on what was necessary and what I wanted rather than a barrage of upsells.

From scheduling to my post-procedure follow-up, I have felt supported by the whole Swish staff.

I don't review often.

Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracey Zee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very caring and engaged staff. My son loved this office as well. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lyric Prikryl-Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at this Swish is so kind. The check in reception has impeccable customer service skills and my hygienist, Fred, was very quick and professional. On my way out the dentist, check out staff, and I had a fun little yap session. Looking forward to my next cleaning in August!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bethany Duma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience at the south 1st Swish location! Robby was my hygienist the last time and he was quick, on time, and very personable and very validating on the progress I have made with my gums and over all dental health. Certainly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: c k
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've never felt more comfortable in a dental office ever. The front desk, studio Manager, and Dr. , all were very kind and super helpful with all my concerns and questions.  The music 🎶 is good, views from the chair, and the fact that you can watch Netflix while having dental procedures helps so much!  I'm claustrophobic, so having a retail front window is like 5 stars already for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Crenshaw
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been to a few Swish locations due to living in different areas of Austin over the years, but Swish Dental South I think is my best experience of the locations I've tried, and Swish overall is a great dental practice.

TL;DR: Transparent about cost and billing, friendly and caring hygienists, TVs to help you be distracted from pain/anxiety is a plus.

As a practice, Swish is always highly transparent about pricing, billing, insurance, etc. I appreciate that it's easy to call and check that a service will be covered ahead of the appointment and it's always made clear what extra services I will or won't be paying for out of pocket. When I was in my early 20's, I had a terrible experience at a previous dentist where they charged me over $200 for the 360 x-rays of my mouth without letting me know ahead of time what a massive cost it would be. Swish does these same types of x-rays but completely for free as part of the checkup process. It's also great that at S 1st, they have TVs on swivel arms so that you can watch TV while you get your cleaning. It may not be necessary for everyone, but I know some people have a lot of anxiety around dental work so I could see this being helpful for those patients. Even if you don't have anxiety, cleanings can sometimes be a little painful so it's nice to have a distraction.

I also love the hygienists at Swish S 1st because they're thorough but still manage to be gentle, they give brushing tips if they're seeing extra buildup, etc. They are overall super thoughtful with their care, letting you know to raise a hand if you need a break, letting you know when they're moving to a new area of your mouth, asking ahead of time if you have any sensitive areas, etc.

Really just love this location and this chain of practices overall.

Editing to add:  I had Dulce as a hygienist at my most recent appointment, and she was the best. Super friendly, thorough but still gentle, she let me know what she was doing along the way, etc. Overall she was so thoughtful and caring, which I so appreciate given that dental work can be uncomfortable and sometimes painful. Thanks Dulce!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Michael
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my like fifth appointment here today and had a great experience. I arrived right on time and they saw me right away. I was able to fill out all my information online beforehand, which made check-in very easy. During the appointment/cleaning, their technology seemed very up to date and helpful to me to see their recommendations - overall extremely knowledgable and friendly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailey Carnline
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Robby at swish south is so amazing. Knows what he’s doing and cares about his patients.
Dr.Marx is very experienced and awesome at what she does. The assistant Victor is very sweet and cares for the patients.
I highly recommend this location for all your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kalispel Fisher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
READ THIS BEFORE GOING HERE

Do NOT go to this dentist for invisalign!! It is a scam! I was offered a half off deal and ended up paying $6000 in total after they messed up my bite three times, the treatment had to continue for TWO EXTRA YEARS because they kept messing up. They cut open my face while shaving my teeth, they shaved too much of my teeth off so now I have a huge gap between my teeth. I now have to get braces after coming here for invisalign.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sydney Grignon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a pretty complex patient, and the team here handled everything with total grace. Everyone was welcoming, helpful, and genuinely knowledgeable. The office is super clean and calming, and I felt really taken care of from start to finish. Great experience all around, I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update to my review:

While I was initially frustrated by the lack of response and accountability regarding the billing issues, I want to acknowledge the efforts of Nancy, the office manager. She has been understanding, proactive, and instrumental in resolving the issue. Her professionalism and dedication have restored some of my trust in your service.

That said, I still encourage Swish Dental to improve its overall billing processes and communication to prevent similar situations for other patients. I’m revising my review to reflect 4 stars due to Nancy’s outstanding support.

——-
Original comment:

“Repeated Billing Issues and Lack of Prompt Response”

I’m leaving this review because I’m frustrated with Swish Dental’s lack of accountability and delayed response to billing issues. Earlier this year, my family overpaid for a service, and it took three months and multiple follow-ups to receive a refund. Now, we’re being charged again for a service that was already included in our prepaid treatment plan from nearly two years ago—an overcharge we discovered only after reviewing our original agreement.

Despite providing proof of payment and the agreement, Swish has not responded as promised. I’ve since had to dispute this charge through my credit card company.

This is the second time this year that Swish has failed to address billing errors or communicate effectively. I encourage others to carefully review their agreements to avoid similar issues. I’m sharing this in hopes of a prompt resolution, but if not resolved soon, I will consider filing complaints with relevant agencies.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Jenkins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Not able to deal properly with insurance
Made me feel like a third class citizen  with prepaid rescheduling.  Will not return ever.

Update: They wanted to charge me up front for everything and they still filled a claim my insurance... This is fraud and will be reported.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna G
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Always a good experience at this location! The front desk employees are fun and kind, no judgment here. If you’re scared of the dentist this is the place for you, they explain everything in detail and are very gentle. This office has the latest equipment, (seriously, I didn’t realize how dated my latest dental office was before coming here). Plus each room has a tv you can watch a show of your choice on -giving a nice distraction.

Dr. Shadman is so patient and understanding; I’ve never felt shamed or judged while under her care. I won’t be going anywhere else while I’m in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Athlink Co.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was a great 6-month cleaning with Dr. Marx and Dulce! Very kind and welcoming, not to mention speedy and on their A-game! Highly recommend. Will be smiling the rest of the day!!! So lucky to live near here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teri Citterman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I go to Swish for regular cleanings and it's been really good. They use the latest tech, are on time and efficient. Things I value in a dentist.  Recently, one of my crowns popped off. They got me in right, fixed the crown - and the experience and service was amazing. Highly recommend the team at Swish Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriel Chavez-Yondorf
user_reviews_extended.Description: Listen - I have anxiety about the dentist. Serious anxiety. These folks are Swish make you feel like you’re not a societal pariah for falling behind on your teeth hygiene. Dulce the hygienist is an absolute blessing to the profession and the world - she’s helped me get back on track and finally feeling like I’m making progress on keeping my teeth healthy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Buchanan
user_reviews_extended.Description: An awesome upbeat dental practice! From start to end of visit, everyone there was friendly, cheery and quick to smile. The equipment they use is all state of the art and compact. No more squinting at X-rays with the doctor pointing to small light or dark defects. Their 5D imaging system was the first time I could see a real time comprehensive color view of all my teeth along with color imaging that clearly showed cavities, misalignment, and areas affected by grinding pressure. Impressive. The only thing that I didn't like was the use of distraction techniques to keep the patient's attention diverted. I prefer to focus on the ongoing treatment and not have a TV screen turned on and positioned close to my face. Also annoying was the  dental blow gun used to shoot gusts of air indiscriminately over my arms and legs so that I wouldn't focus on the dentist who was injecting pain killers. A patient should be informed of these techniques ahead of time and asked  if they would mind. It is an issue easily rectified and, other than that, the hygienists and the doctor herself were very caring and explained everything thoroughly. This was my first trip to this practice yet, overall, it was one of the best dental visits I've had!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny McQueen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Marx and her team were fantastic.  She was super gentle and kind, but worked fast and painlessly. They cared about me as a person not just a bill.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aron Boyle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a professional, welcoming vibe at Swish South. Top notch hygienists and Dr. Marks (I think that’s her name) is incredible!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Chapman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing dentist and hygienist team.  I went for my first appointment and they made me feel at ease.  They were very friendly and knowledgeable and made me feel comfortable.  The hygienist was amazing and had my teeth looking great.  The dentist was thorough and great.  Overall I was very happy with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sundi Wheatland
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Such a fun, updated dental experience!
I just relocated from out of state and damaged a front crown. The gals polished it up, did a wonderful cleaning. Let me know what to expect in the future with the status of my crown. I can’t wait to schedule a consultation to work on perfecting my smile! This crew is awesome!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Acosta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always have great experiences at Swish! Rarely have to wait, and from what I can tell the pricing is pretty competitive! I did my Invisalign there and everyone who works there is very helpful and knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grayson Goodrich
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amanda Marx is an excellent Dentist!  She is gentle and highly competent.  I’m grateful to have her as my Dentist!  The front office staff is very friendly and professional.  I really like the hygienist but can’t remember his name.  Overall, I am very happy with Swish Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Myranda Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came here with past dental trauma and I am so glad I did. Robbie was absolutely amazing. One of the best cleanings I have ever had all while creating a very calming environment. I would 10/10 recommend Swish south Congress!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Petitjean
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shoutout to Robby! He was the best tech I could have asked for. He was very thoughtful and attentive. He took his time with my teeth cleaning and even switched tools when one was too much for my sensitive spots on my teeth. He made me feel comfortable and gave me a whole different idea of what “going to the dentist” means. Thanks Robby!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was extremely nervous to get all 4 of my wisdom teeth extracted, but the dentist, A.Marx, did such a great job at getting it done relatively quickly and stress-free. She guided me through the operation while I was "under" and it was honestly not worth getting so nervous about. After my first day of recovery, the pain is minimal and I have almost no swelling. The nitrous "laughing gas" oxide works, and the local anesthetic she rubbed onto my lip and gums made everything numb within 10 seconds. I'm writing this to anyone who is nervous about getting it done. It really isn't that bad and I felt no pain just some pressure. And I'm writing this to the dentist. Great job and I will be recommending you to anyone in the future. Thank you, Marx. OH, and my bill ended up being $917 when I was originally told $657 due to an insurance mishap, but they ended up bringing my bill back down to the original price. I'd give 6 stars if I could.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sera Bonds
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today I had the most positive fatal experience of my adult life. Thank you to Shadman + Kendra for taking such tender + competent care of me. I’ll def be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Francheska
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is what I shared with my friend:

"Yo you’re gonna love this dental office - super legit - the first doctor I saw was nice but I’m getting another consult with another dentist this week for a second opinion bc I wasn’t thrilled about the treatment plan with the first doctor. [I got the membership so the second consult was free]

Super thorough examination, super clean, the dental hygienist was super sweet, they had super high tech too.

Loved the 3D imaging they used too - felt like it was more detailed than other ones I’ve gotten. It even breaks down where your putting pressure on your teeth."

Additional comments:
After the second opinion with the second dentist, I was a lot happier with my treatment plan, she was a lot more conservative and less invasive which was a better match for me overall. The first dentist wanted to do a crown where I had a small chip (most likely a filling that fell out) whereas the second doctor agreed with me that another small filling would most likely suffice.

Overall, I high recommend checking them out :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: emily segel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Shadman and Victor were great! I was diagnosed on a Monday afternoon and was back in the chair Tuesday morning. The two worked very well together and were attentive to all my needs/requests. Office staff were very helpful as well.
Emily Segel

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kayla Donaldson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great first visit here and will definitely be returning! Being new to Austin, finding a dentist you trust can be difficult. Luckily, I found Swish and couldn’t have had a better experience here! The staff was extremely diligent, communicative, and welcoming. They explained everything happening and were very informative. Dulce was amazing! Can’t recommend Swish and her enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karla Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental S 1st is awesome! The staff is super friendly and helpful. Dr. Shadman has done such a fabulous job at meeting all of my dental needs. I finally got my dream smile. Highly recommend it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kasey Reese
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved that the hygienist was super quick and still through and this dentist gave me honest feedback on what was really needed. My past experiences were much slower and they have tried to pressure me to do things this dentist told me weren’t necessary. Swish also sends WAY too many text messages and tries to auto schedule appointments that never work with my schedule so it’s a pain to call and reschedule so I don’t get charged. This visit was great but I don’t love this system.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brando Lapuh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Treated with care and made me feel comfortable and at ease. Dr. Marx, Dominque, Gabby and Victor were all truly amazing. Huge thank you to them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Young
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental takes great care of my teeth. I recently moved here and selected Swish Dental from other reviews. I have had two appointments and appreciate the relationships I’ve formed. I feel like they know me. They use great technology, share a variety of options for any kind of treatment (so I never feel like I’m being forced to do one thing), and have gentle cleaning practices. The hygienist I have seen both times (Dulce) is great at her job as well as such a nice person.

user_reviews_extended.Name: garret halstrom
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole experience was great quick and painless all the staff also where very polite and professional

user_reviews_extended.Name: Niko Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience I’ve had in years. Comfortable, everyone was welcoming and attentive. Happy to be a new patient. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dana Arnold
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best dentist experience ever! Highly recommend and I'm actually excited to come back for my next cleaning. Everyone was super friendly & informative. The hygienists and the doctor were quick and efficient but also thorough with my cleaning.

Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: britt ione
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Marx and Vic were so kind and very patient with my root canal. I am a new patient who needed to find a dental office quickly! And they came through and offered so much support and education! 100/10, got my business from now on ⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this location, I went in Thursday to get some tooth pain looked at. They scheduled me the next day to get a root canal. The procedure was painless and I really enjoyed how my doctor took care of my pain. I highly recommend staff is always nice and courteous.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Noelle Soltero
user_reviews_extended.Description: The BEST experience! Dr. Marx is amazing! I was very afraid of getting dental work and she talked me through the entire process, took her time, and was just a real person. I felt so well taken care of and changed my perspective of going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frederick Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Dulce the dental hygienist was very thoroughly and kind. Made the visit very pleasant. Every visit leaves you feeling like your in a warm friendly family atmosphere.  I highly recommend this dentist to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Niaya Gadison
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is so nice, dentist offices can be scary but I love coming to swish bc they make you feel so comfortable and it’s such a calm/fun environment when you come in!

user_reviews_extended.Name: aradia lawrence
user_reviews_extended.Description:
LAST UPDATE!!! 1/13/25
They followed through, took ownership (kinda) of their mistakes and FINALLY reimbursed my money back. Today.

There are several people involved.
And I'm going to name them.

Deliah- at the Domain.
Short call, but  kicked everyone into gear.

Nancy- (read down below) at the South 1st location.
For her consistent communication, even though I was the last person I'm pretty sure she wanted to talk to on a regular basis, but she did and I give her credit for that!

Adrian Gallardo- Director of Operations.
This is your shining star in Swish, take note.
He made it all happen.

The doctor that did my root canal.
She did a great job, and i would have returned, but....

Will I go back? No.
Do I recommend them? No.
If you choose Swish, should you be a hawk about how they bill you. Absolutely.
My story is that if you are going through this, don't stop being a thorn in the side, cold call every office to work your way up and save all of your receipts!!
It's a tedious process.

I'm raising my review a star for ending this decently. Only that.
I'm so glad thIs is over, and i have another dentist that is finishing my root canal with a crown, which i was originally told wouldn't be possible and that I would HAVE to have either a bridge or implant.
WRONG.

It's now 1/8/25 this is the last day that my refund would have been processed through my bank. Called bank, there is nothing. Called Swish, Rashelle no longer works there, convenient. Nancy (office manager) called on December 30th to let me know that I would be receiving my money as well. Nothing.
Emailed Rashelle's boss Adrien all the screen shots of Rashelle letting me know that I would get my refund.
Give me my money back!

Oh I got a treatment plan alright.
They ended up charging my Care Credit $1595 for a root canal they said my insurance didn't cover. Then they turned around, billed AND got paid in FULL by my insurance. I only caught it because I had a balance of 200 that I wasn't sure about so I called my insurance to ask, and everything unraveled from there. My insurance then called Swish and spoke with a woman named Nancy that pushed back saying they called my insurance to check, and i was not covered. My insurance (who was on the phone, AND call was recorded because it was on 3 way because my insurance called them) looked at her log and said nope, your office NEVER contacted us. They then tried to say i wasn't covered for another thing they did, again insurance was like NOPE shes 100% covered for that too. Now a bigger manager, Rashell is involved, and i will get reimbursed in full or they will be heavily investigated by my insurance.
Shady. Shady. Shady.
Do the right thing Swish, and I'll bump up my stars for accountability.
There are quite a few reviews on BBB I found all about this type of thing happening to them too, im not alone.
Watch yourselves people, take note.

I haven't had any work done yet, but the treatment plan we have in place makes sense, and the office staff are awesome and lively!
Tomorrow is my root canal.
So far, I like them a lot!
Went back today for my root canal and filling. So far, so good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John McKamy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My wife hadn't been to the dentist in over 5 years due to her intense phobia. It's from an extremely traumatic experience from a prior dentist, which resulted in botched root canal.

I was worried about her going in alone since she's prone to panic attacks, but when she called me after the appointment she was ecstatic. The staff wasn't overly/annoyingly nice yet still casual and friendly. Her nurse was AMAZING and she said they had a good conversation before the procedure. My wife knew everything that was happening, and they even helped her after she nearly had a panic attack. All of their technology is up to date and makes the process faster AND easier, in turn making it more comfortable for you.

We will definitely be coming back for more procedures and cleanings. Their plan is worth getting if you want to come here regularly, the only downside is that the modern tech makes it pretty pricey. The only reason it doesn't have 5 stars is because of the price, but I definitely say it's worth it and a good investment to your dental health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brody Hiipakka
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Marx is the best. I got in an accident and had to get 5 teeth pulled, 2 root canals, and 8 crowns. She did fantastic work, really cared to get to know me as a person, and made a miserable experience way less miserable. Swish on south 1st street has a great team all around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kay Harvard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with you guys. Thank you for your support.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jennifer huggins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone was exceptionally nice! The hygienist explained everything and was very gentle. The desk made sure I fully understood my billing and insurance options! Super high tech!!
Look forward to my next cleaning! They stayed late for me on a holiday week because of an emergent issue! Wonderful and amazing people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Ybarra
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wanted to update my review to say this place has really turned it around. Their staff is friendly and explain things perfectly for scheduling. Of course, the dental staff remain very informative and helpful. I’m so thankful that I can continue going to swish and getting excellent service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karlton Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall I had a great experience here! Everyone on staff made me feel comfortable and welcomed. The dental hygienist, Monica, explained everything thoroughly by not only letting me know what she was doing, but why - I feel like I learned a lot. This was my first visit to the dentist on my own insurance (no longer on my parents) and the office manager Samantha helped me understand exactly what payment options existed and how I could best utilize my plan. Dr. Patel was also very professional and helped me prioritize my next visits. I’ll be back and would recommend them to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Santi Gallegos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish dental is the best. I’ve been with this dentist for 4 years and every time I go there to have my cleaning done they do a very good job. I just had my 2 front teeth fixed and they looked amazing. I really recommend this place to any one who would like to have their teeth done. Dr. Lee is the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Talya
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went in for a new patient appointment today and highly recommend this office!

Appointment: I got x-rays, high tech scans of my teeth, teeth/gums/jaw all looked at individually, SUPER comprehensive cleaning, oral cancer screening, etc. They showed me all the x-rays and imaging, and explained everything to me.

Pros:
- Everyone was friendly and professional. I felt at ease.
- All of my concerns were addressed (stains on teeth, jaw popping/locking, overcrowding teeth, etc.). The Dr. explained which of my concerns should be addressed now, which should be monitored and when it might warrant treatment, and which concerns should not worry me. They were clearly not trying to convince me to get any unnecessary dental work.
- They did a wonderful job explaining what they were doing and why they were doing it.
- Transparent pricing.

Cons:
- will update if I have any in the future, really great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: benjamin turrubiarte
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff at South Location was very friendly. It had been over 20 years since I had been to the dentist and they explained everything that needed to be done thoroughly. Lucky for me I only needed a deep cleaning, it was bloody but didn’t hurt too much. I got put on a care plan and now I have a dentist that I will go back to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ihor Bodnarchuk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Yulia seemed knowledgeable but overall I felt rushed, didn’t get all the answers, didn’t cement crown back in (what I came for) and got a 10k invoice for suggested work needed (after insurance). Even if I agree to procedures in the invoice I’d get them done elsewhere. Rushing a new client that you hitting with 10k invoice not gonna make them confident in you just FYI. Slow down, explain charges, go over insurance coverage limits, etc. And dont throw $35 fluoride treatment on invoice along with cleanings as if it’s required!  Sneaky! You should ask the client if they want it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel Bard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I use Swish dental. It’s great! Dulce always takes really good care of me, Dr Lee does phenomenal work, and all the staff add personal touches that let you know they actually care about you as a person. The office is super clean, modern, and you can watch Netflix while you get your work done. Thanks y’all! 🦷✨

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Karnes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved here two years ago and started going to Swish dental they’re very thorough friendly office. They have a great package for those without insurance. They are very efficient with your time. And good at following up and keeping you posted on your next visit. I highly recommend you going there, if you’re looking for a dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny Romero
user_reviews_extended.Description: 4 different doctors through Invisalign and had constant issues. Nobody ever got back to me after telling them about my bad experience. Recently went to a cleaning and they cracked as well as chipped one of my teeth. They were good a couple years ago but the staff turnover is clearly really hurting the patients in the process. I would recommend you stay away. I won’t be coming back here and have cancelled my yearly membership. They are happy to take money but not actually care about the patients. What a waste.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Sheridan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dulce is an absolute gem at South 1st. I have pretty bad sensitivity yet whenever she’s done my cleaning it’s seamless — I used to dread cleanings previously because of my sensitivity. She is so kind and funny the time goes by quickly, but also because she’s so efficient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tori V.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update: upon posting the below review I received multiple phone calls and texts from a Swish rep asking me to take down my review. I do not think under any circumstances it’s okay for an operations team to take my phone number from my patient information to contact me about a review. When I hung up upon realizing that the call was about my review, I was then contacted again from a different phone number by both text and email. Further, I got a second opinion on the care plan Swish gave me and do not need any of the work they said I did. I absolutely do not trust this place and would not recommend to go.

—

Go with discretion - this place has great Google reviews but poor BBB reviews and is not accredited.

I visited for the first time today and did not have a positive experience. My hygienist seemed very unsure of herself while taking x-rays and also did an exam to determine what kind of cleaning I needed which I thought seemed strange for a hygienist to do, especially since she seemed so new. When she told me I needed gingivitis cleaning I informed her that I had a deep clean recently so would like to talk to the dentist about it before committing. Once the dentist came in, she told me that since I had just had a cleaning she wasn't sure why I had bone loss. I've never had a dentist tell me they just "weren't sure what was going on." Then, she told me she had figured it out and I needed to see a specialist and get a crown for which they quoted me $2,000. As someone who takes care of my teeth and gets regular cleanings this seemed ridiculous to me. After digging further into their reviews and their BBB complaints I would not trust this dentist nor will I be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khalil Coffield (KeepingUpWithKhalil)
user_reviews_extended.Description: The customer service that I received at Swish Dental South was superb. Fred did an amazing job with my cleaning making sure the entire process was smooth and not painful. I was also very excited when I saw him there because since going there for the past two years I haven't seen many people that look like me. Overall the staff is great and provides a nice welcoming space when you come to this dentist. Everyone should be applauded.

user_reviews_extended.Name: lrroge55
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone there is super nice and professional. I get a lot of work done there and I've been a patient for almost 2 years now. I horribly bad with names but I think the upfront receptionists' name is Sylvia. She's been there the longest.  She is super nice and always smiling. I came in on Wednesday the 10th for a cleaning and there was a new face up front. The new person seemed visibly annoyed and was very short with me. I could tell that she was not friendly, warm, or kind like the others. She answered my questions of Abruptly and really made me feel unimportant.. I told her that she was not nice like everyone else. She immediately gave my file to the other lady ( whom I think her name is Sylvia). And Sylvia replied, no worries Mr Young, I got you.
She turned a bad experience In two a good one. Thank you. I love this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rena F
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Swish Dental is kind, welcoming, and provides high quality care. I have never felt so comfortable at a dentists’ office before. Dr. Christie Tu is wonderful! And Kristen went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable. All of my procedures have gone smoothly and healed quickly. I never thought I’d ever actually enjoy going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to the Swish on S 1st St today! It’s such a clean office. I went into the appointment with a ton of anxiety, I hadn’t been to the dentist is almost 10 years. From walking in until I walked out I was so taken care of! The check in woman was super friendly, my hygienist let me tell y’all was the kindest woman ever - I may or may not have cried and she was there with the tissues telling me how good I was doing- and the dentist was so sweet too and wanted to make sure I understood the situation and the plan! Finally, the guy at the end was so patient with me and helpful! Phew. Y’all it was a great experience. I also got to watch Gilmore Girls the whole time which really helped me relax!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candice Fritz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Review from a new Swish patient - You know it's bad when even my insurance advised me to, "proceed with caution, as it seems they provided you with false information." Don't be fooled by the 5 star reviews like I was. Swish Dental is shady and misleading. Pretty advertising and posh offices is what you might see from the outside, but proceed with caution. They provide false estimates, without ever contacting your insurance to actually verify a pre-estimate.

Long story short, I now owe the $1500 they told me my insurance would cover. Chris, office manager, quick to get you to sign up for a care plan without any explanation or painting a clear picture of the documentation they are providing. Had I known the estimate they provided me was in fact not an accurate one i.e. not directly from my insurance, I would have contacted my insurance on my own. I trusted them. And am now locked in to a very expensive care plan, owing what my insurance won't cover. Don't make the same mistake.

Be advised the individuals presenting the care plans are not billing specialists and if it's anything like my experience, they are offering information to trap patients into an expensive care plan, without any basis or accurate information from your insurance. I was also rushed to make my decision, as "special promotion ends next week." I should have known better and hope this review helps others avoid this nightmare.

They are hiding behind the word "estimate," and are now conveniently not returning my phone calls or texts. Do yourself a favor and don't get involved with this practice, no patient deserves to be tricked and deceived by a clinical practice for their own profit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlotte Bergmann
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Swish Dental at South 1st is AMAZING! Being an extremely anxious patient, they bent over backwards to make me comfortable with welcoming smiles and jokes.
And Dr Amanda is my new best friend! She carefully explains every step which is occurring which makes you feel so much better. The nitrous gas literally made me LOL during the root canel procedure, a welcome  pain relief.
I cannot recommend them enough, as caring humans and dental providers. Make this your forever dentist, like I am!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Wan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Probably the best experience I had at the dentist. Went in for x-rays and a cleaning: I met with several people and everyone took their time explaining what needed to be done and did so with precision and care. The technology being used is on another level and I was able to watch Seinfeld the whole time. I was there for quite a bit but it was as enjoyable as it could have been for something most people don't look forward to. Staff was super friendly as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: brianna everett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Almost every single appointment I had here was cancelled within a hour of the appointment time. Now if I do this, I get charged a fee, but they think it’s acceptable to continually cancel appointments with little notice. They are clearly overbooking clients to make as much $$ as possible. That’s one major issue is that they do not respect their customers time.

Anyways, I went in for a cleaning, doctor told me I had 4 tiny cavities that she could fill at once. Came back, had them fill all 4 cavities, for her to tell me the cavities were huge, so it took forever. They took x rays so I’m not sure why she thought they were tiny at first.

Since I had these cavities filled my mouth has been in extreme pain on the left upper and lower sides. I went back and the doctor was annoyed saying it’s my fault because I grind my teeth. She filed down my teeth more saying that should help. Well it didn’t, so I went back again but requested a different dentist. This dentist ended up giving me a prescription for fluoride and said that should help. Well guess what, it’s months late and I’m still in extreme pain. It’s very obvious that something went wrong when the original doctor did my fillings.

Before the fillings I had 0 pain and now I can barely eat or drink on that side of my mouth. Doctor told me there’s nothing they can do besides the fluoride, so now I’m seeking a new dentist with a new place. I am still in a ton of pain to this day, and nothing has been done to fix this. I will never go back to swift dental, they are inexperienced doctors and staff, and they could care less about your health, all they care about is what’s in your pockets.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norm Hartwell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Squeezed me in, verified my insurance and got started on my dentures! Yay! Excited! Took me calling the insurance company in their office to verify though even though I've got the best insurance offered through #FedVip, MetLife still have to prove it, go Swish! Dr Marx is great. And her whole front office! Chomp chomp.
Follow up on subsequent visit to schedule lower denture replacement.... trying to bill me as if they were putting new implants WAY OVERPRICED...and they didn't bill my uppers in delivery so my flex didn't pay it out of this years as discussed previously.  Different person in the front office now talking down to me like it's my first rodeo... not a happy camper sigh.  Search is on for someone in network...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Whitney Russell
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Swish is so welcoming and friendly. They really know what they are doing and what they are talking about. They want the best for their patients/don't just charge them.  I felt like more than just a patient in their office and more like part of an experience . Best customer care from any dentist office I have been to. They really worked with me to accommodate what I needed and even changed their lunch break to make time for me. They are seriously great people. I would definitely recomend Swish! Everyone there was wonderful.. I'm amazed a dentist office can be so cool!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Steemers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Swish! Dulce is the best hygienist and the rest of the team is so lovely. Really appreciate everything they do to keep my teeth feeling and looking good!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kara Coronado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been to the Alamo and South first location. Each time I had the pleasant and fast visit! Thankfully I was greeted by Brittney W. each time with such professionalism and kindness! She has always been very sweet and VERY helpful. Appreciate all the friendlessness within the staff as well but had to give a special praise to Brittney W. THANK YOU!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kallie Volkert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Josh was the real talk with compassion that I needed in my life. Tips for home care without being judgmental. I felt like he sincerely wanted to be there to help me! The whole staff was amazing, from advocating for me to making sure I understood extra costs BEFORE they performed anything that went beyond what my insurance covered. I have major dentist anxiety and they all put me at ease. I actually felt good about myself leaving the dentist for once (and not just wallowing in guilt for not having perfect oral hygiene). I have to go back for a tooth extraction and I am not even stressing bc I know they are gonna take great care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camila Milon
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my first time at swish dental and it has been a great experience. My x-rays, scans, and cleaning were done by Dulce. She was very sweet and gentle when doing all the cleaning and taking the x-rays. Recommend this going to see them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bertha Duran
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I did not have any pleasant experiences with Swish Dental. I have been to the South 1st, East, and the Domain offices.
I had a procedure done at the East office. They quoted me an amount before going in for the procedure. Then charged me more before starting the procedure. The billed me for another $500 after. I paid it just so it would not go on my credit report and they reported it anyway. Then it was up to me to prove it had been paid. Which I did, so they had to remove it. Yesterday I had an appointment to pick up my invisalign and was told they had them sent to the wrong office. They didn't call to tell me. I took time of my job to go to the office. Had I not shown up they would have charged me $50.00.
I went back to the office today. They wanted to polish/shave my teeth for the second time. I asked them not to. They said I would need to make a 3rd appointment to pick up my invisalign because she had to consult, before I could have the invisalign that my insurance has already paid for.
Be careful who you choose to work on your teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sweeziee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Greedy dental office that over charges their long term patients for inferior products that are known wear down within a couple of years. My bottom retainer developed a small hairline crack randomly after just a little over a year since I started using them and I reached out to them to get a replacement.

Lures customers in with their permanent "promotionary discounts" (think the sales that seem to be year-round at Macy's, Kohl's, etc.) to get Invisalign with them without telling them that the the "permanent" post-care retainers that you are supposed to wear forever are designed by Invisalign to break down every couple of years, just so that they can then charge $650 to replace just half a set of these retainers, or if you want to buy replacements for these inferior products in bulk you can opt to buy 4 replacement sets for $750. When I brought up how ridiculous the cost of these replacements are, especially for something that clearly seemed to be made with inferior quality on purpose as a cash cow product, they decided to "lower" the cost for 1 replacement from $650 to $300.

Just the pricing structure alone clearly tells you that they know these retainers won't last despite them supposely to be used forever, and has it in their business model to charge these ridiculous replacement fees for something that is literally a 2mm thick piece of 3D printed plastic.

Moral of the story is: do not get Invisalign done with them (or in general to be honest given their lack of quality and predatory pricing tactics) unless you like paying $650 every couple of years or get 4 replacement sets for something that us supposed to last forever for a great deal of $750 instead of 1 for $650.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki Boudreaux
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best dental visit today at Swish Smiles on South 1st. My dental hygienist was the best. She was very thorough and made me feel comfortable during my visit. I hope she is my hygienist every visit ☺️ When my dentist came in she gave me new information that most dentists have overlooked in past visits. Very knowledgeable staff, great technology and the office was decorated very cute for the holidays. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abbey Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dulce did my annual cleaning at Swish S 1st. She was incredibly nice, personable and efficient! I was in and out quickly and had a really positive experience. She’s the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sebastian Cevrim
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist in Austin, I go to the S.1st location. The office is clean and all of the staff are very friendly. Maggie the hygienist was amazing. Dr. Lee is phenomenal along with her assistant Gabby. Silvia at the front desk was very helpful with helping to solve a billing issue and expediting my retainers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sidney Hoshko
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist herself was friendly but the rest of the staff really wasn't. They wanted me to pay $800 for deep cleaning, I got a second opinion and it's going to be $200 for it. Only gets the two stars for how nice the dentist was.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariah Barrett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental is SO wonderful. I have had huge fear about seeing a dentist and it's been about a decade before I bit the bullet and scheduled an appointment based on the reviews I read. Its all true, the assistants, hygienists, and dentists are compassionate and caring, and the front desk crew are the best.  They've taken really good care of a scaredy-cat new patient. You guys are awesome

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Valencia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Miss Tracy was Spectacular.  She made my son feel at ease with his cleaning.  Then made room for my daughter and had nothing but great things to say. She's an asset to this company she deserves a raise because she gives the best vibes ever coming to the dentist! We love her She's amazing!!! Thank you Tracy!!!! If I could give you ten stars 🌟 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 I would!!!! Thanks again Tracy! You Rock!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Valdez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the service and professionalism of the hygienist and dentist at Swish dental. This last experience was no different. It made me feel comfortable and most importantly pain free. Ask for the desensitizing gel. I trust my smile to them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Amador
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental South consistently provides the best patience experience. Fred the hygienist, gave me the best cleaning I've ever had (without being painful too). The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful and I felt safe with the COVID procedures. I can't say enough good things about Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lee Green
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience at Swish Dental South. Despite being amidst the covid pandemic, I felt perfectly safe. They checked temps at the door. Every person on staff was wearing a mask, and all areas were well sanitized and managed in a very safe way.
Beyond that, I had a very positive experience of every staff member I interacted with. I was welcomed when I entered, and kept up to date on my wait times while waiting to be taken back to a room.
The hygenist, the doctor, and the financial advisor were all incredibly helpful and friendly. They made sure I understood everything that was being done during my initial exam and walked me through all the work they saw that needed to be done as well. All future expenses were walked through and explained.
I will definitely be returning to these guys and I highly recommend them if you're looking for a positive dentist experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jose Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: This has honestly been the best dental visit I’ve been to! I am a new patient with them. They made sure to remind me of my appointment, once I got to their office, I filled out the usual paper work on one of their iPads and soon after I was given a tour of the office, which I got to say is very nice. They then proceeded with the X-rays and cleaning; most importantly they answered any questions I had and made sure I was comfortable at all times. The staff is very friendly specially the hygienist, even after I accidentally bit her finger more than two times. Overall I would highly recommend this dental office to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Amps
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience (at least for a dental visit)! The office staff was super nice and welcoming. Dr. Gulati did a great job explaining everything and not only checking my teeth/gums, but also doing the entire cleaning himself. It's a really nice office and a very laid back, which definitely helps with the nerves. I will definitely be back in 6 months and will send my friends and family there too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough about each member of the Swish team, from front of house to dentist! I get a bit of anxiety when going to the dentist, and appreciate how each part of my appointment was handled with not only great care, but compassion. I would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corin Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just stopped in for the first time after having walked by a few times before. The staff at Swish Dental was extremely helpful in sorting my insurance and made me feel right at home. It felt as though I have been having my teeth cleaned here my whole life.  The location is excellent, mostly due to my living nearby.  Can't wait for my first cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jorge Urquidi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been going to Swish Dental South for some years now. Extremely good service, almost immediate check-in after arriving, easy procedure, friendly staff, thorough explanations of procedures, and I've never had an issue with how they handle my insurance. Exceptional work!

Be prepared to be without service while you're there. The concrete building makes it very difficult to get a signal once you're inside.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luan Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Scam / Non-Existent Dentist

I went here for over a year. At first, my experience was very good. I rarely saw the dentist, but the two dental hygienist that I would often see were great. As time went by, both of the good dental hygienists left to join their other location and I would only see another dental hygienist who was clearly overworked and did not do a good job. The dentists at this location like to sit in the back and show up to say hi for 5 minutes once every 3-4 visits. I never been to a dentist office where the dentists were so lazy.

On my last visit, the overworked dental hygienist attempted to give me a free teeth whitening, but left me unattended for 20 minutes as the bleaching agent did it’s thing. Unfortunately for me the bleaching agent got into my gums and the dental hygienist was no where to be seen. All this time the dentist was no where to be found. I had to scream to get anyone’s attention but by then it was already too late and my gums were burned.

If you want to pay a lot of money to be seen by overworked dental hygienist and lazy dentist who you never get to see then I would recommend you go here.

If you are looking for good quality care where the dentist actually does his job I would highly recommend Lady Bird Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J. Fein
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Marx is the best. Assistant Jules is so nice. Hygienist Justin is the one to have. Office Manager Chris keeps the ship straight and true.

I had a big problem with an implant crown. First it was too high. Next the top of it was ground down flat and looked like a piece of metal in my mouth, rather than a tooth.

Dr. Marx then came on the case. With her 25 years of experience, she knew exactly what to do and how to do it. In just 10 minutes, she carved the top of the crown and made it look just like the tooth it is replacing. With that, the entire problem was solved! No need to go through waiting for a new crown to be made. Dr. Marx is now the only dentist for me.

Jules assisted Dr. Marx and also made a new retainer for me. She is so nice and the retainer is excellent.

Hygienist Justine has the lightest touch I ever had. She makes the cleaning experience relaxing.

Office Manager Chris really cares. He was on the case with my implant crown problem and was very happy to have Dr. Marx take over the situation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizzie-Ann Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATE: I no longer go to Swish. I feel as of late, they are too focused on being trendy than actually cleaning teeth. Rude hygienist and staff, no all but far too many. They are great at marketing but I cannot recommend them anymore. The nail in the coffin so to speak was the bedside manner from the dentist when she came in to the room for my Invisalign check up. She made a snarky comment insinuating that I did not care enough to keep my appointments that I recently missed and how important it was to come and get the trays. Normally this would be good advice but I JUST told her and the hygienist that I missed due to my father passing suddenly and dealing with the mental strain of that. You, your practice, Invisalign and all the other things are the very last thing on my mind. I have since changed dentist and I am loving my new place. Also, change the way you message/call people. I do not need to feel threatened to attend my appointment. You can send reminders without them coming across as rude and if you cannot, put some money into marketing that way instead of on social media.

Previous review: Always a great experience. Ive been with them for over a year (closer to two years I believe) and I cannot imagine going anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kerry Patton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I get that people have to learn but I would’ve preferred being given the choice to have a super green hygienist. Super awkward young man fumbled with all the tools and dripped water on my face a few times. Also, please let people choose whether or not they want x-rays every six months or annually. They’re really not necessary twice a year if your teeth are in good shape, and if you question the necessity please don’t say how low the risk of brain radiation is when I’m also wearing a lead vest to cover my other important organs.  Patients should come before the need to bill insurance for everything possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Migdalia Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shari Claros was my dentist today and after three years of not seeing a dentist because of a bad experience and severe anxiety I have found the best and I’m overjoyed! Every person I encountered was professional, patient, empathetic and knowledgeable! I felt well informed. All x-rays, and 3D pics of my entire mouth were explained and shown to me. It was the best experience I’ve ever had and will be a regular patient as long as I live in Austin! Cannot recommend enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone I encountered was super nice and accommodating. They were extremely thorough from the level of care in the exam to the explanation of my treatment plan and out of pocket costs I would encounter. Best Dentist I have been to! They play good music in the office too :-D

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tarryn Britt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went in for a very very bad cavity and I'm TERRIFIED of dentist. Even waiting in the lobby made me almost panic, but they are so nice, patient, and accommodating,

My tooth was so bad that even though the dentist COULD preform the procedure, she was more worried about my fears and and health she recommended a specialist. She would've loved to help, but I could tell she didn't want to make this a bad experience for me. I really appreciate the care they took in making sure I wasn't scared or have a panic attack.

That one little gesture, even if she couldn't do the procedure, shows they cared for me and its what will make me go back after my tooth is fixed!

Thank you Dr. Li for making this the best time I've ever went to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Val Aguirre
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Swish were friendly, efficient, well trained and attentive.  I have had a lot of bad experiences with dental work but this office kept me calm and comfortable during my entire visit.  The dentist looked at my x-rays and offered options instead of insisting on just one.  Thank you for a good dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kameron Kinebrew
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Marx and the team is amazing! She did amazing with all of my dental work as well working with me to maximize my insurance. Best dental experience ever

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theron Mercadel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Swish. They’re always super professional, communicate very well. They’re flexible and tech savvy. I started only doing Invisalign here, but I brought my routine dental work here as well. Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Haynes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Took 10 min to clean and polish. they always take great care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Riojas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely HORRIBLE experience. I’ve been done with Invisalign for 7 months now. Randomly was charged $250. When I reached out I got a text saying they were “restarting my payments”. Took me 2 weeks to get ahold of someone on the phone and turns out their payment processesor broke and they hadn’t been charging me. Mind you I was in the office 4x where I asked about billing to make sure nothing was being missed and I was always told I owed nothing. Now I owe 1100 somehow?? And the best they could do was offer a free whitening. Will never be going back as this is SO SCAMMY.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shahab Sandhu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely clean, friendly, professional, high-tech and well organized. The entire staff is coherent with their mission to provide you the best possible and most reasonable approach to solving your needs. I had very high expectations coming in and they exceeded them.
