The entire process of the x rays and photographs was remarkably comfortable and accurate, and extremely well communicated. The hygienist was very detail oriented, and a magician at being very gentle yet through. It'll be very hard to find a better place. 💯% recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is truly worthy of 5 stars! The great location, new modern technology, and friendly staff made going to the dentist (dare I say) an enjoyable experience. Dr. Gulati was so fun and personable and made sure I was comfortable and understood what he was doing the whole time. He addressed my concerns and gave me options, but wasn't pushy like other dentists I have been to. They even offer a discount if you are a Tree resident! I definitely recommend Swish to anyone looking for a great dental experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I scheduled a cleaning for 3pm. I confirmed insurance would cover my scheduled cleaning and was told the only charge I might have is for fluoride but that was an optional $25. They took me back 5-10min after 3pm. The technician took X-rays and measured my gums and made an assessment. She said I may be in need of a deep cleaning and would go get the dentist. The dentist evaluated and explained that I have a cavity that needs to be fixed and would benefit from a crown rather than a replacement since the prior filling was large. She told the technician that she could just clean more around the molars. Then the front desk person came to explain the $200+ cleaning they were proposing. I asked if I could just have the regular cleaning as planned that my insurance should cover. The technician said I only had 10min left of my appointment so, no, I would need to reschedule. It was just so disappointing and felt like a bait to get me in and switch to upsell services. They should have done the regular cleaning as I requested. I will not be going to Swish anymore because I don’t feel like I can trust them to respect my time or give me the service I actually need and not upsell me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea McCormack
user_reviews_extended.Description: I picked this dentist because the reviews were so good -- and they weren't wrong! I made an apt because a veneer fell off, my normal dentist is in San Antonio, and I just couldn't take the time to drive all the way down there. They got me in that afternoon, and it was a great experience! The waiting room and patient rooms are so clean and nice. They have TVs in every room that swivel so they are right over you while getting work done (so you can actually see it), and they have Netflix so you can choose whatever you want to watch! I am someone that gets really nervous at dentist appointments, so I really appreciate the good distraction. The Dentist herself was very professional and informative. I enjoyed the experience so much so, that I am now going to make them my regular dentist! Highly highly recommend to anyone -- plus they have 3 Austin locations!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Schwartz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so glad my friend referred me to Swish! I love my membership package and the care I get there. I highly recommend Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome experience! Robby was a fantastic dental hygienist. Best I’ve had. Ask for him! I will be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: camille cochran
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I will never go to another dentist or hygienist again. I had an absolutely wonderful experience at swish. My check in and time to X-ray was under 5 minutes. My hygienist was kind and informative, she walked me through every step of what she was going to do. She was able to finally detect something wrong with an old surgery site that two other dentists weren’t able to - and she fixed it! They have TVs and will put on any Netflix show you’d like (great for kiddos and adults like me who can’t sit still and need distraction).
Overall, 10/10. Can’t wait to go back to the dentist lol

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Cameras
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience as Swish was definitely a 5 star experience! From start to end, it was seamless and the entire staff was a joy, making it such a good experience to go to the dentist. The office is very warm and modern and the equipment is new and state of the art. The part I enjoyed best were the friendly and thorough explanations throughout. I had to come back to fill 2 cavities and they took the time to provide a breakdown of cost from what insurance covers to the out-of-pocket cost for the visit. They make me look forward to my next dental cleaning in 6 months, haha (how is that possible?!). I highly recommend Swish Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a really great experience with Dr Lee and all the staff at this location. Very Friendly, clear, efficient, and also super detailed. I had an initial deep clean, whitening and then some crowns/veneer work. They were super clear with the process, and most importantly, the end result was amazing. Great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Koch
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Swish since I moved to Austin about 2 years ago. They make going to the dentist so much more enjoyable! I like how modern the facility is and the atmosphere they create. I absolutely love that you can watch Netflix during your teeth cleaning! It’s also a nice feeling knowing that they have several locations around Austin in case I relocate at some point and don’t have to start from scratch with a new dentist. I definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at the S 1st location! The clinic is ran very efficiently and smooth. Upon entry you are greeted very nicely and there is not much of a wait if you are on time. All the staff is very friendly and nice. Oh yea and they do great dental work. I feel better every time I walk out. Thank you

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcos Olmos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my daughters first dental appointment the other day, and it was great experience for her! The hygienist was kind and made sure she was comfortable the whole time, even when my daughter couldn't handle the x-ray machine because it was too big for her. The dr answered all my questions, and they were all very clear about any concerns I may have.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holley Truitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a pleasant experience at Swish! Every single member of the staff was friendly and information. My assistant, Marissa, gave me a tour of the facility and was wonderful through the whole visit  Their facility was cute and cleanly! They also keep local rotating art up on the walls! I'm excited to go back for my next cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phillip Bedford
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very pleasant experience with Swish. It was my first visit and the staff was very friendly and accommodating. After filling out initial paperwork, I was called in with 5 minutes. They gave me a quick tour and had Netflix playing during the cleaning. They were very thorough and answered all of my questions. Looking forward to going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Galuban
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient at Swish Dental South since February 2021. All my visits have been great, but this past visit, was outstanding! Fred, my dental hygienist, went above and beyond. While it was just a simple 6 month cleaning, Fred was extremely intentional. He was thorough and paid attention to small details (like consistently wiping off my mouth to make sure I didn't have spit on my face). He was calm and made me feel at ease. Also, he explained literally everything before he did it. As someone who has studied trauma-informed care, this is something I truly appreciate. Thank you, Fred for making my experience such a good one! Not only do my teeth feel clean, but I feel cared for too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Hurley
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Swish was so great. The staff was so friendly, knowledgeable and professional. Fred was my dental hygienist, and he did a thorough job. I had a lot of plaque built up from skipping cleanings with covid, and my teeth feel great. I will definitely return for future treatments and dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edye Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I want to preface this review by saying, I am the type of person who hardly ever writes reviews, but my experience here warrants one. I was initially super hyped about this place: close to my house, membership plan that would still allow me to pay for care without having insurance (whitening included). I am the weird person who loves the dentist, I take care of my teeth and I enjoy going to get them cleaned every 6 months. Honestly, everything up until my checkup with the doctor was incredible. The  receptionists were lovely and professional. My hygienist, Dulce was a delight and we hit it off immediately! I have a background in dental hygiene and we really got along well, chatting about all the things! A super personable experience. I would've given 5 stars on them alone. However, the dentist I saw told me that I have bone loss on my lower anteriors that quite frankly is not there. I was shocked when I heard there was, considering how well I take care of my teeth. But I have had issues with my bite being misaligned for some of my life and just finished Invisalign, so in theory it could’ve been that. I asked for my x-rays and had my previous dentist from out of state compare them. They couldn't find anything wrong. I reached out to both orthodontists I've seen as well and they don't see anything concerning. Not only that, but my periodontal chart shows that I have no issues. I'm torn because I partially loved my experience here, but considering the doctor's lack of empathy and her diagnosis coming from seemingly out of left field, something is fishy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Wolfgang
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had a fair amount of work done here in the last 6 months and love it. If you have anxiety about the dentist, the staff here will treat you well. Best bedside (chairside?) manner I’ve ever experienced, they gently talk me through my tears and stress. Special shout out to the person who does their insurance billing. When I maxed out my old plan and couldn’t afford all the work, she immediately worked with the Dr. to prioritize my treatment plan and help me figure out how to spread out payment. Amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: stephan metzner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at swish dental today, the service was exceptional, and the office was comfortable with TVs to watch while getting work done. Everyone is extremely friendly and willing to help out. I had to switch from Careus Dental because of the horrible job they did, causing pain and making me bleed everywhere. Swish dental restored my faith in trusting dentists again. I highly recommend signing up for dental work at Swish dental to anyone looking for a nice, relaxing and professional experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leonel Tovar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love everything every one rhere very frienly I'm definitiva going back to this office

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becky
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely helpful and patient staff. Dr. Brooks is very friendly and straightforward (in a good way) he's not upselling you products but is genuinely interested in your dental care and progress. The location is perfect and the office is super clean and all their equipment is modern. EDIT 12/2025: I’m disappointed to say this practice has declined in quality. While the space remains clean and parking is convenient, the experience now feels heavily focused on upselling. Communication between locations is frustrating, and reaching either office is challenging. Previously, the doctor reviewed my medical history thoroughly and made me feel at ease. That consistency and care no longer seem reliable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandria Welch
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Money Grab Dentistry.
After reading the negative reviews I will say they are true because it's like the experience I had back in April. They really try to sell you on upgrades, like the fluoride rinse and Invisalign treatment. I had already had Invisalign so I told the lady I would pass. (They wanted to correct a "bite" problem). What really turned me off here was the treatment plan that I thought was unnecessary. They had found a cavity that was in a tooth with a previous filling and the lady explained how she thought a crown would be the best option due to it being in a tooth with a filling already.  I was quoted $700-$900 to fix that one tooth.... I had never had a dentist tell me I need a crown. I knew it was a red flag and never went back, I simply wanted another 6 months to see a new dentist and get it treated then and I'm glad I did!! I went to Enamel Dentistry and got quoted $54 dollars for a re-filling on the same tooth! I didn't tell them how the other dentist wanted to do a crown and the new dentist didn't mention anything of that kind of treatment!! Some people's reviews are similar to mind, which has me thinking this practice wants to offer the most expensive treatment plans even if they are unnecessary for the patient. Two stars instead of one due to the friendliness of the workers though.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tessa Sliwa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Swish Dental South. Their level of service is next level. Their front desk staff is always kind and super accommodating with scheduling and being available via email. I did Invisalign with Swish  and could not be happier. Dr. Shari and her team of assistants always made sure I was happy with the results and always explained each step of the process in detail. Keep up the great work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edward Varipapa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update: After multiple calls from the operations team to take this review down, I WILL NOT be removing this review. This is an accurate reflection of the experience we had and the multiple calls received are NOT professional.
This amount of care and attention should have been given to us over the 8 weeks of calling to receive a refund for services not provided. Upon further review, this business is not Better Business Bureau Accredited and this should be noted for future customers. This office has lost all trust.

Padded pricing, erroneous charging, and bad financial practices. Account Manager “Chris” does not appear to be performing his job functions. Have been waiting 8 weeks for a $2500 bill to be refunded to my fiancé’s credit card through affirm. They will not return calls or follow up.

Have been quoted over $2400 over my insurance for unnecessary cleanings. Upon second opinion, this was not needed. Staff is condescending and demeaning to most patients only to provide unnecessary and overpriced services. We will not be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Carrasco
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Back to change my review. My review is to say get 2nd opinion!

I had been using Swish on S 1st for 4+ years.  I've had cleaning and fillings done with them. My first filling had been giving a lot of trouble for the past few years. They were great about trying to help me and had even redid the filling but the discomfort never changed. I missed my last year appointment so i went 1 year without a cleaning.  During my most recent visit I was asked more than once when my last cleaning to the point where I was started for feel ashamed. During my general cleaning they told me some shocking news and then told me I needed a more expensive cleaning. Shocking because I do all of the things you should do when taking care of your teeth.  I felt pressured into having to do what they were recommended.  I ended up not going through with what they told me and got a 2nd opinion. I'm so glad i did! I ended up not needing this more expensive cleaning and this Dr. was able to help me with the long term discomfort i had that Swish couldn't narrow down.

Things to keep in mind they are on the higher end for cost. They may not be in network for your insurance.  I would highly recommend getting 2nd opinions when it comes to needing additional work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ty Carbajal
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place was absolutely delightful. Admittedly,  I have not been to a dentist in a while, but this was not what I remember a dentist office looking like. It was bright and inviting.  I watched Netflix through my entire cleaning. I almost forgot I was at a dentist office for a bit. The staff was incredibly nice from when I walked in to when I left. They presented all my options with no pressure in other procedures, but gave me all my options for future visits. It was a great experience overall, and it's weird to say I'm Excited about my next dentist appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benjamin Figueroa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Welcoming front desk, great ambiance, minimal wait time, friendly service, quick cleaning. Robbie, the Hygienist, made me feel safe and relaxed during the cleaning. 👏

user_reviews_extended.Name: amanda villarini
user_reviews_extended.Description: Showed up 10-15 minutes late cause of traffic but they still were able to squeeze me. Definitely recommend if you’re afraid of dental work or have ever had a bad experience. Tracy did my cleaning, she was so kind and gentle! Best cleaning I have ever had. Thank you!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carley Arnold
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clean, friendly, thorough, affordable and concerned with helping make sure you can afford it (being up front and offering options!), and very comfortable procedures. Super professional and knowledgeable folks who are also down to earth. I was highly impressed. I'll be returning for some additional work and I've recommended to my husband and to two coworkers to set up appointments there!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sofia Basurto
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Swish!! I have been a patient here for almost a year, my doctors are so knowledgeable, i love how they Take their time to explain everything to me. Everyone is so nice and professional. I have never waited for more then 5 minutes for my appointment. Overall, i have never had an experience like this at any other dental practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Tijerina
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was pretty impressed with all the advanced technology. My old dentist office apparently lived in the stone age. My first visit, it was nice I did not have a long wait, the staff was nice, and the dentist himself was nice. I had a great experience! I would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just want to take a minute and rate my experience at Swish Dental South. As I walked in, I was greeted by the lovely professional young lady in the front. She was nice, helpful and very friendly. The whole staff was very professional. Dr Gulati is very easy to talk with and made me feel comfortable during my procedure. I will definitely be back. Thanks Swish Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hermel Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Christie Tu and her staff were AMAZING!! My teeth whitening procedure was quick/painless, and my teeth have never looked so good. I couldn't be happier with my smile. I will definitely be referring my friends and family to visit Dr. Tu and the staff over at Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcus Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm new to Austin and was having trouble deciding where to get my teeth cleaned, but really happy with my decision to try out Swish. It is hands down the best dentist office I've ever visited! Dr. Gulati and his staff were super friendly and made sure I was comfortable during my entire appointment. I loved the atmosphere in the building and will definitely be going back. If you are looking for a great dental experience I highly recommend you give Swish Dental a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucero Huayhua
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved my experience at the South 1st office, everyone was friendly and very informative. I felt like they took their time thoroughly explaining everything they did along they way, their recommendations, and how future treatment would look like, as well as the cost and payment options. Also, their patient portal is very user friendly - one of the best ones I've interacted with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Claire
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish was my first choice with my new dental insurance. We all know in this country it’s truly a privilege & blessing to have dental insurance.After having no coverage for some time…  I knew I would be going to Swish, I’ve seen their advertisements & did research… read awesome reviews & Swish offers great deals. Even with insurance dental care can get get pricy! They had discounts applied to the services i will doing. Today I was seen for an over all checkup, Invisalign consult, & to talk about my sleep apnea. During my visit the staff made me feel comfortable & talked me through everything. I can see why they are so busy!! My visit went great!! We did X-rays , mouth scans , & they laid out the cost of every future visit we talked about. This made me feel secure & know what to expect. I was seen quickly, the visit was thorough but It wasn’t overly long! I recommend Swish to anyone like me who’s a little nervous at the dentist. The staff at the front desk were welcoming & informative as well both in person & over the phone. Go to Swish even if you don’t have insurance I wish I would have. They have an amazing yearly fee you can pay with free X-rays, cleanings, & a 30-50% off discount of services. Had I known this existed I certainly wouldn’t of waited until I was covered. The cost of the plan if you’re not insured was totally affordable so definitely don’t do what I did it will be a lot more cost efficient to get their plan. Im looking forward to my braces & improving my sleep with a mouth guard.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Licona
user_reviews_extended.Description: Robbie is gentle and easygoing. I'm an anxious patient and the did everything in his power to make my experience easy and pain free. South 1st spot. Really great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ally Seider
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Bad becomes worse…. Updated from 11/3 to 11/22

11/22:
The ethical practices at Swish Dental are concerning at best. After seeking a second opinion at another dental office due to seemingly excessive costs included on Swish treatment plan, my concerns were confirmed. Not only was my bill padded with unnecessary treatments, I was informed by the second dentist office that Swish erroneously billed my insurance for a cleaning that had never been provided. After calling Swish in attempt get clarity and in hopes this was a simple error, the office manager Chris, said the office visit notes confirmed that the hygienist completed a cleaning. I explained to him I never saw a hygienist and that only an exam had been performed. I had him confirm that my cleaning was scheduled for December 1st and canceled via a text which was responded to the same day. He confirmed he could see the cancelation, but unable to explain the premature and incorrect billing to my insurance. He said “upper management” would be contacting me. I still have not received a call.

Unable to resolve the issue, I contacted my insurance company who has made several attempts to contact the front office and billing, without success. The insurance company informed me they not only billed for a cleaning but fluoride that also was never provided.

The best case scenario is that they incorrectly documented in my chart and by accident they billed my insurance. Worst case, this is fraudulent and without a call from “upper management” a formal grievance with my insurance company will need to be filed so that I can receive the care that I sought.

11/03:
There seems to be a theme here — scheduled a regular cleaning. Was brought back and given a TWO HOUR exam. Told I needed a deep cleaning and quoted me nearly $4,000 for a crown and $149 for a cleaning. I’ll be going elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chrissy Hughes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Continually fantastic! I've recommended so many friends and they say the same thing . Dr. Marx and Robbie always got me and I love em...Swish on 1st is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Somogye
user_reviews_extended.Description: The service and the professionalism at Swish is outstanding. This was my first time today, the process was simplified and almost all electronic saving you time and the hassle of filling out paper forms. All the staff I interacted with were accompanying and knowledgeable. Definitely would recommend to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Arellano
user_reviews_extended.Description: There is never a bad experience at Swish! Their Office Manager Samantha makes things super easy from the beginning, taking your phone calls and answering any insurance questions you need. The entire staff from the point you walk in, are in the room, and get checked on are all kind and smiling, making things so much more calming. We all know no matter what age, dental experiences are not fun, but Swish changes that. I mean, you can get your Marie Kondo on, watch some Queer Eye, and get your teeth cleaned all at the same time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kayla Bridges
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super clean, super state of the art. I had put off going to the dentist for a while, and was impressed by the tech in place and also felt super taken care of. I was feeling pretty nervous about going after having put it off for a while. They made sure I was comfortable, explained everything and put a lot of care into helping me out. They didn’t try to pressure me into any other services but were informative about everything they have to offer and their deals. Definitely recommend this dentist and will be going back for all needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allí Bee Levy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Nicole did a great job cleaning my teeth and doing my x-rays for my night guard. She was super sweet and helped to keep me comfortable.❤️💫 I’ll be back!

Second review - 5 stars! I got my front tooth cap fixed and now love my smile! So grateful for this team at the south 1st location 🙏🏼🙏🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: B Chumz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend Dr. Patricia Lee! She just did a filling replacement for me on a front tooth(helping me avoid a crown at least for a while), and it looks and feels great. Appreciative she advised to go this route and pleased with the results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Emden
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is amazing very friendly, honest and informative. They make sure to tell you exactly what they are doing as they are doing it and explain everything in depth. The office is clean, modern and in a great location! William Brooks is the best dentist I’ve ever had!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Leoni
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Marx and her team were great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Holmes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental is a blessing to the Austin community. There is a warm, inviting feeling to Swiss Dental, as opposed to the usual cold & worrisome environment of a dental office. The staff is professional, personable & excited to answer any of your questions or concerns. I had the pleasure of Fallon & Dulce working on my teeth today. They were fantastic!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff, amazing doctors their work is top notch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jean Paul laroix
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to have a filling redone 7 times, they ignored my requested for a refund, cause excruciating pain. Passed me off to multiple dentists to fix the issue. Worst experience of my life. Dentist office should have doctors, not tech hacking to pump numbers and profits. Most of the staff is way too under qualified

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis McGehee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Swish Dental! The staff is always so friendly and fun! The office feels very refreshing and I always feel comfortable there. The dentist is awesome and they do amazing work at a very good price.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizz Helms
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing staff from beginning to end! Front desk ladies, amazing!
Hygienist were friendly and explained everything they were doing.
Dr. - awesome! Very concerned with any issue I brought to his attention, and he had a solution or explaination for everything!

Very clean and they go above and beyond to make sure you are comfortable and enjoying the experience!

Every personal issue I have with my teeth and the things that make one nervous about being at the dentist, was addressed with care! ie. I have tempature sensitive teeth, they would switch instruments if anything was too warm/cold, without taking away from the cleaning!

Already scheduled my 6month follow up with them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindy Watkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is pretty quick! We were in and out in 35 min for a cleaning. Dentist is conservative in her approach and really nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Myha Knowles
user_reviews_extended.Description: Takes forever. Different dentist on different days means different results. 2+ hours and an unwanted procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: César Ruano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Given them all the chances possible. Miss-scheduled appointments, forgotten appointments, did not submit scans (2 times), confimed appointments(multiples asked to re- confirm), arrived for scheduled appointment and staff not prepared for procedure. On scheduled visits, did not have time and handed me the Invisalign without consult or review. Invisalign posts poorly applied. Non trained person finished my cleaning. The hygienist tend to be good and offer good advice, but appears the office culture is toxic. Invisalign not fully aligned and stopped, yet expected better evaluation and advocacy for my oral health since they pushed it. Ran out of my passives because the forgot to submit imaging and assumed it my obligation to follow up on a service already purchased. Although convinient, I recommend finding someone else. I have been there with another customer experiencing the same issues.

user_reviews_extended.Name: D T
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a wonderful experience coming for my biannual check up. Jahfi, my hygienist, was extremely friendly, skilled, and professional. The teeth cleaning experience was a breeze thanks to her, and my visit was quick and painless. The whole staff was very courteous and they even played my favorite Netflix show on the TV, which was great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizzie' Ann
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m not scared to go to the dentist, but it’s not something I get excited about. I went in today to get some fillings done (appointment 1 of 4 for filling) and from the time I stepped in, until I left, I thoroughly enjoyed my experience. I was SO nervous, I kept canceling and reschedule trying to avoid it but I desperately needed it. I’m so happy I just womaned up and got it done. The ladies here are amazing and I’m so excited for my boyfriend to have his first appointment as well. Looking forward to my next visit. Thank you, Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: samantha rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Shadman, Vic and Nanal - thank you! I never thought I'd be writing a review for a dental practice, but here we are...

Bedside manner is easily forgotten in this industry, sadly, but at Swish Dental South it's just natural and not a requirement. Appreciate it more than you know.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy Goodwin
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and dentist here are excellent! I had an emergency problem yesterday (my filling came out and I cracked that same tooth = pain) and they saved me…Marybeth at front desk super helpful AND she even texted me before to get an idea what was going on. Walked out there within 45 mins fixed up pain free with my new filling. Swish has lots of locations which makes it nice especially when you are having a major problem that needs asap help.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zipporah Sustaita
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had been going to this Swish location for ~3 years. This is a great place to go IF you have the money. If you cannot afford the suggested services immediately this may not be the place for you.

I need and use a night guard. The dentist had no issue that mine was otc but of course offered a customized one for 200+ when I declined at the front I was essentially lectured about how my otc one was not good enough and I would cause more expensive problems down the line; when I commented that the price was my issue. I looked passed this because the densit I saw was great and went in for my next cleaning. I need a cap on a tooth again spoke to the dentist that I could come back in 3 months as I needed to save. Went to the front to pay my copay and was again lectured that I was only causing more expensive problems for myself down the line. It was a different receptionist and they were rude, unlike my first encounter, I told them that was the best I could do and was told "Well I'm just letting you know."

After that I decided to switch densist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Hector
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish dental is amazing! Samantha was so nice and made sure that I knew all my options when paying for everything, she had great attitude and greeted me when I walked thru the doors like I was her friend! ! My cleaning went so swift and fast I was so distracted with friends playing on the TV I didn’t even realize they were done. The doctor and the tech were very nice and made me feel super comfortable. I thought the bathrooms with different types of mouthwash was the coolest thing! i've never seen that before.  I’ll definitely be coming back and referring family and friends to swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Sepulveda
user_reviews_extended.Description: This swish dental location is very clean & friendly! The Dr’s & staff are so kind, informative and always have a smile on their faces. Fred - dental hygienist was very gentle and very thorough with my teeth cleaning. He’s your go to guy for teeth cleanings!  I referred by boyfriend to swish dental south and can’t wait for him to have a pleasurable experience as I always do!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Jimenez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My appt. Was for Tues I called Swish earlier cause I was hurting. They took me in earlier this place was excellent the young lady that helped me Jessica was excellent  along with the Dr.William Brooks She help me out off pain. Everyone was very nice and polite here. I give this place 100 plus it was great!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis sifris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The best dental practice in Austin by far. I went for a routine check-up and cleaning. Dr Patel, my hygienist Danielle and the whole staff are well qualified, friendly and made the experience extremely pleasant. Everything is very well run and all the procedures are explained in detail. Dr Patel reviews the X-rays and offers excellent advise on oral care.
There is no over diagnosis as with some other practices, and the consultation is individualized and personalized and I was not rushed. The prices on a membership are very reasonable. I would highly recommend to anyone looking for an excellent dental practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Gill
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctors and assistants were amazing and so nice. They did a great job and I always have a great time seeing swish associates. The dentist fixed my horribly ugly chipped tooth from another dentist and made it look natural again. Thanks guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria D Jaso
user_reviews_extended.Description: It went well but I have to give Vincent my thanks for being so professional, his bed side manner is excellent very caring person, Dr. you too thank you Swish Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jetara Robertson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update: nothing was ever done to make things right for me.  I requested my membership be completing canceled and just got over the waste of money.  A year later they are trying to charge me for a membership when they have told me they can't help my issues and I have never been back.  Management has no follow up.  This place is a scam, beware.

Only person who was nice was the tech; she did her job and was kind.  Doctor didn't spend more than 2 mins examing me; just to tell me she couldn't help me with all my issues. Told me I have an infection; but didn't give me anything to fix it. I sent waiting on her longer than she spent explaining things.  I came in knowing I needed a deep cleaning and a referral for missing teeth replacements. I left without an appointment for that or any referrals. I was told they are very busy and so are the doctors they are sending me to; not sure if it's cause I am paying out of pocket. The front desk told me if they dont call me to call them. That's bad business; front desk whole job is to book appointments and follow up; but I was told they are to busy to help me. I gave dates all the way until October; but the front desk guy wasn't even listening to me. Only thing he was able to do is give me a bill for $30,000; but no date on when to start treatment.  I had to tell him my dates again and I am still not sure he even got them. I still don't have an appointment or a referral. The 3D exam is cool; but without follow up its worthless. Paid $200 and didn't get any cleaning or appointment for cleaning and that's my number 1 need is a cleaning.

If your so busy maybe stop the ads so you can serve the people you book.  Leaving without a appointment was the biggest disappointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marrisa Candela
user_reviews_extended.Description: Good experience overall, but don’t agree with the additional charges for COVID. When I asked what the additional 10 dollar fee was, I was told it was to cover their PPE- which was no different than previous visits. The staff was friendly and the office was clean, but I would’ve liked to see more protective gear such as face shields. I gave them 3 stars because of the COVID fee and I would’ve liked additional protective gear especially because we are being charged for it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Inman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I genuinely loved Swish. I'm new to Austin and needed a cleaning. This one happened to be in network, and they didn't have a wait time like some other places I called. They were incredibly nice, professional, and I watched Netflix while I got my cleaning done. They were also super fast bc they have great technology. They did try to push Invisalign, which is something I've heard others say they do, but it wasn't aggressive or anything. It was a really pleasant experience. I usually hate going to the dentist but I won't mind going next time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isaac
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for a regular check up, even got myself an Invisalign. The gentleman up front was very helpful and indeed insightful. It’s not often you go to a dental office and the front desk is so well knowledged on their products. It’s shows they care about what they do. Thank you Chris!

user_reviews_extended.Name: mrseratx
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice Place!  Staff was very professional and friendly.   Cool and clean facility with good music and T.V.s in each room to make you feel relaxed and comfortable.   From the moment you walk in,  till the time you leave everyone will make sure you have what you need to make your visit as pleasant as possible.   I highly recommend Swish Dental to friends and family for all dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Jayant
user_reviews_extended.Description: going to switch dentists because it takes months to get an appointment here and then I never wait less than 45 mins at an appointment. today I had a cleaning, waited 40 mins after the cleaning was done then told the dentist was still held up and they asked me to leave and come back another day for the visual exam

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Fisher
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dental hygienist was rough and unprofessional. They didn’t tell me they were doing a deep cleaning until after it was finished, which was a cleaning not explained or covered by my insurance and an unexpected expense. The dentist was not helpful when explaining my X-rays. The room I was in had a see through glass that looked out into the street and a sidewalk where people walked by and could see in. For these reasons, I decided to switch to another dental office to get my work done. I had serious complications getting my X-rays sent over to my new dentist. They did not send them over like they said they would. I ended up just having to get new X-rays done. My experience with Swish South was poor and I would not recommend them to anyone who wants a comfortable experience at the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Synthia Britton
user_reviews_extended.Description: First experience at swish was a success! I first learned about them from the radio and after reading the amazing google reviews, I decided to give them a try. The staff is so sweet and they make every effort to be up front with you about procedures and costs. I highly recommend swish dental for your next appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sierra Terrebonne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ll be the first to tell you that any doctor visit gives me major anxiety, especially going to the dentist. But after lots of research, I decided to give this place a try because I was due for an annual check up and was beginning to feel pain. The front desk ladies were super nice, check in was swift, offered me water and my favorite part: a comfort menu designed to make your experience as relaxing as possible. Netflix, beats headphones, blanket, etc. To be able to take my mind off of my appointment was a huge relief and dare I say enjoyable. The wait time was short before I went in the back, got a tour of the office, x-rays and room set up for me. I apologize in advance because I honestly don’t remember anyone’s name, but the dental assistant, hygienist and doctor were all very accommodating, explained every procedure thoroughly and answered all my questions. And the best news: for the first time in years I didn’t have a single cavity! I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who is a newbie to Austin, like myself, and is looking for piece of mind when it comes to your smile.
Side note: I also love that I’m supporting a woman-owned business which a goal to empower women in dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Saebryn Peel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! Fast, comfortable, and efficient. Dulce was my hygienist and she made me super comfortable. Dr. Lee was amazing too! Love that they have TV’s.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Guy Vogel
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you love scheduling appointments, confirming appointments, and then showing up to find out your appointments been cancelled and they didn’t tell you then this is the dentist for you. The enthusiastic staff will endlessly upsell you on additional treatments and services while someone is knuckle deep in your mouth. I would rather pull out all my teeth with pliers and eat room temperature buffet pudding as my only form of sustenance than return here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Aleman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had the very best experience at Swish Dental South today. It was my first visit at this office. As soon as I opened the door to enter, the office manager, Sam was there to greet me with a genuine friendly hello and smile. She was happy to answer all the questions I had. The dental assistant, Allysen was so nice! She took me on a tour of the dental areas before getting started. She explained the different types of xrays and photos that would be taken. She also took the time to chat with me and made me feel comfortable.
Dr. Patel is amazing! She made me feel even more comfortable and relaxed. She didn't rush through when going over my xrays and photos. She gave in details what I was looking at. She really made me feel that I made the right choice coming to Swish. I really liked the music playing throughout the office. A fantastic place. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Howell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr. Shadman andJaffie.They are the best!  The whole team at South 1st is amazing!. They have always made my daughter and I feel welcome and put my fears of going to the dentist at ease. I have never felt shamed or lectured there like I have at other places. The office has a fun, family atmosphere. Highly recommend this place!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Mahomes Cerney
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve definitely loved my dentist experience after coming to this location. The staff really seems to care and ensures such a comfortable and positive time. Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leticia Powell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great experience! Everyone was very friendly and professional! Wonderful staff.
Very impressed that the dentist actually cleaned my teeth have never had that done before.. will continue to make the trip to make sure this office is my go to for all my dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitch Gillespie
user_reviews_extended.Description: My fiancé and I just moved here and she recommended Swish Dental and Dr. Patel after her visit. Now we're 2 for 2 on 5-Star trips. Clean office, extremely friendly and helpful staff. They really take the time to explain what they're doing and what they're seeing. There's no confusion. I've also never had my teeth cleaned while watching Netflix at the same time, but I don't want to have my teeth cleaned any other way now. I would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ceci Guevara
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My favorite dentist 🦷 office ever!! No one should be this excited to go to the dentist, but they make me feel like the adopted family member. ☺️ I was at the South office A LOT in 2021.🪥

Not having insurance and having their Smile Membership has been a blessing and meant huge savings!💰

Big fan of the entire staff: friendly, professionals who go above and beyond!🏆

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Stewart
user_reviews_extended.Description: DO NOT USE SWISH DENTAL FOR YOUR DENTAL SERVICES. My initial experience at the actual dentist was great, however, this office owes me almost $1,000 for an invisalign service that I never even started because they told me I needed actual orthodontics. They told me I would be refunded everything and not only did it never happen, I continued to be charged for the invisalign plan on my credit card AND to my insurance. I talked to Billing in March and was told I would receive a refund within a couple weeks, ever since then I’ve continued to hear nothing and have had to call over and over only to be told my refund will be received in weeks for it to never come. It is absolutely ridiculous to charge someone $1000 out of pocket AND to insurance for a service they NEVER STARTED OR RECEIVED. If I don’t receive my money back soon I’ll have no choice but to contact the BBB. I’m not a person to leave reviews like this, but if you want a dentist office that you can trust with your money - STEER CLEAR of this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Medina
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is very kind and have also made sure i was always comfortable. Getting to watch Netflix helps keep your mind off all the instruments in your mouth. They even offer me a blanket during my winter appointment. Love the cleanliness and look of the place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Lutz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Probably the best dentist I’ve been to thus far. I rarely ever leave reviews but this is warranted. The staff was very efficient and engaging from the moment I walked in the door. Best review for a dentist is when you can truly leave the dentist smiling. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Damy Gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing, I am a traveling nurse and they have been more than accommodating. Very understanding and do such a great job. The staff is amazing. They have restored my trust in dentists! Thank you for everything you do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: S Vanos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a horrible experience with Invisalign at Swish. I decided to do Propel which they said would make the process go faster. With propel they said it would take 3 months. Over a year later, after 2 painful propel treatments, and after my 3rd round of refinements my top teeth looked exactly the same and my bottom teeth now had a gap in them. Huge waste of time, pain and money.
Also almost every time I came into the office I had a new person who I had to explain why I was there. Everyone seemed confused on where I was at in my treatment every appointment. Overall, my experience with swish dental was really frustrating and I would not recommend to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yordano Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shout out to the Swish Dental team at South 1st, and specifically my dental hygienist Nicole V - by far one of the most gentle and thorough experiences I've had at the Dentist. Thank you for the attention to detail and great customer service. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kellie Sauriol (Maggard)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist isn’t everyone’s (or anyone’s) idea of fun, but the staff at Swish make my experience pleasant every time. I’ve been in 3 times now, and everyone has been attentive and friendly. Growing up having a mom as a dental hygenist I never wanted to have anyone else clean my teeth, but I’m glad I found Swish to make my experience positive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Wyborny
user_reviews_extended.Description: booked an appointment for my boyfriend and had to wait two weeks and take off work to go in. He went in and they took images of his teeth for an hour and a half and then said they couldn’t do a cleaning and would have to reschedule. A waste of time and absolutely ridiculous.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Seversen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I actually wrote my first yelp review immediately after my visit because it was the best dental visit I’ve ever had and I’m 42 years old so I’ve had a lot.

Everyone was so nice, even though I was grumpy and freaked out because I don’t love getting my teeth worked on. The office was spotless, cheerfully decorated, and high tech but not overly so. Staff was excellent at explaining everything, professional and just so nice (as I mentioned before but it deserves emphasis. No upselling or weird vibes. I bought a night guard but that was something I brought up as my primary doctor said I needed one. This office is right in my building but even if it was inconvenient I’d definitely be back. Lots of deals and my insurance covered everything but the night guard. I did accidentally call the billing gal and you guessed it, she was incredibly nice. Definitely go especially if you hate the dentist, this place is amazing. (They had Netflix but it wasn’t working when I was there. I could have asked them to reset or something and didn’t though, I put my AirPods in)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Salter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service, friendly, helpful folks and they know their stuff! Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alanna Russell
user_reviews_extended.Description: My teeth are terrible. It’s always a humbling experience going to the dentist but the staff at Swish made me very comfortable despite my extreme nervousness. Very clean, very cool imaging capabilities, and a swivel tv that kept Stranger Things front and center during my exam. I hate going to the dentist but this team made it a lot less frightening.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathryn Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not impressed. The dentists all seem to rotate or whomever I see I never see the same person again, then they expect me to travel across town to another location to visit someone who I guarantee won’t remember having seen me in the first place. Last time I came in they used some addition when I got fillings but never mentioned to me until I was on my way out and of course had to pay another upcharge. Also, don’t let them upsell you on the nightgard.

user_reviews_extended.Name: carlos soria
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dulce did an awesome job cleaning my teeth! She was super friendly and did everything so well, made sure I was comfortable! Totally recommend swish south as well as Dulce!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you for a great experience as a new patient! Everyone was very friendly, supportive and profesional.  Everything was very modern, efficient and painless.  Pricing is very reasonable and transparent with range of choices for patients.  There is a commitment to healthy and holistic treatment - at an affordable price.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Lassiter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Here is my literal first impression walking into my appointment at 0800 this morning. Office and rooms are *super-clean, receptionist is overwhelmingly helpful at the beginning and end of the appointment. The dental assistant introduces herself and quickly appears to also be an informed, polite and friendly staff member. Dr. Gulati follows in the room shortly after. He has jovial inviting charisma and professional bedside manners; he's easy to speak with, and even takes the time to explain in detail his procedures and assessments. He gave me plenty of time to answer all of my questions and concerns as well as effortlessly demonstrated his competency as a quality Dentist. Needless to say he and his staff earned my trust considerably quickly for my first appointment. I'm certainly coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julian Duarte
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Marx and Victor were the shiz. Everybody was cool and friendly, definitely recommend the Swish South location!

user_reviews_extended.Name: amanda smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely great. Every single person there was polite, most especially the wonderful technician that did my cleaning. The office was clean and comfortable. Probably the best dental experience of my life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johnny Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in dire pain from a tooth gone bad. From the time I made my appointment online to saying goodbye I was treated with the highest hospitality and well accommodated. The staff was extremely informative and prior to even starting the evaluation process I was given a grand tour of the facility that made me feel right at home. This office is contemporary and host art work from local artist around Austin. Each room is equipped with an adjustable tv screen and Netflix for your entertainment throughout the visit. Dr. Ashwin Gulati treated me with great care, respect, and compassion. He thoroughly explained the procedure and answered all questions and concerns I had. The level of professionalism and hospitality I experienced from the entire staff has made me a lifetime customer of Swish Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Cramer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to swish south 1st for almost 3 years. They do an excellent job cleaning my teeth and I would recommend them to anyone else that needs a dentist. There is also a TV you can watch during the cleaning. Bonus feature.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Weaver
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist that I have been to! They spend a lot of time talking through every detail with you, and ensure you are 100% comfortable with everything. Amazing and friendly staff too! Will definitely be coming back again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Regan Sinquefield
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have nothing but great things to say about Swish Dental. I just went and was in and out in an hour! Fred was friendly, helpful, and so knowledgeable. I’ve been going here for about three years and always have a pleasant experience, but this one was extra impressive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Gee
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is wonderful. Dr. Patel is knowledgeable and kind,  and her assistants and support staff were confident and helpful. There pricing is very reasonable (believe me, I checked out 7 other dentists). They allowed me to pay for a night guard in two installments. I'm grateful for their help.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kestle Eldridge
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely welcoming and knowledgable. Excellent work. I’ve never been to a dentist like this ever before. Extremely impressed walking through the door until I left. New experience with actual people instead of medical robot staff. Plus my teeth are so clean!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Haboush
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Marx and Fred were outstanding!!! Highly recommend if you want a friendly staff.

The music isn’t great but I can deal with it ;)

user_reviews_extended.Name: KimMarie Suhr
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional and very caring. Great surgery with options shared and no pressure to make immediate decision. Felt she really wanted what was best for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Canis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience I’ve ever had, I’m so thankful! Really good membership if you don’t have insurance. Honest feedback on what I needed and price breakdowns. incredibly fast and gentle cleaning after 6 years of putting it off

user_reviews_extended.Name: Akshay Kamath
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was forced to get a deep clean and pay extra when all I wanted was a regular cleaning. Will get a second opinion next time. The cleaning itself was really well done. The person that did it was kind and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sasha Khalifeh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was friendly, accommodating, and fast -- no crazy wait times or feeling like you're not a priority. Bonus: I didn't have to book an appointment weeks in advance, and they're open on Fridays, unlike my old dentist, which makes scheduling a breeze.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elena Stefanopol
user_reviews_extended.Description: They seem nice and are ok for cleanings and basics. However they botched my root canal and billed me twice for it - they suddenly became very insistent I pay that bill asap. When I asked about the double billing, as it happens that when they realized it was a mistake. Tried to justify it with the fact that they have separate systems in each location and no visibility…the classic, confuse them strategy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ickymuffin (ickymuffin)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place. I’ve had a lot of dental office nightmares so I always expect the worst. Swish is great. The staff is friendly, and I’ve never felt like they are trying to hit a monthly quota(like some of the larger chain dental offices). I trust their team a lot, and I whole heartedly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: stella velasco
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Patel and her assistant were so friendly and explained everything to me in detail. Dr.Patel walked through my x-rays and pictures with me and it was really helpful actually being able to see what was going on with my teeth. Definitely going to come back here to get my retainer and for future cleanings!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit to Swish was great! They were very professional and thorough. They will definitely be my go-to dentist now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Bernard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Blissful experience here. Jackie, Kristen, and MaryBeth all made me feel at home and Dr. Tu surprised me with great news that I don’t need 4 fillings like Castle Dental said I did. Thanks to my friend for recommending Swish. I owe you one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelli Neuman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best visit to the dentist I’ve ever experienced. The facilities and techniques are modern. Everyone is fun, friendly, and chill. For the first tome, I’m not wondering what’s going on while the dentist is working. I’m feeling fully informed and satisfied upon leaving!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Baião
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is very clean and the staff is also very polite. From the first contact over the phone I felt welcomed and the staff was always showing interest in fulfill my needs. This office is most of the times all booked out and it can be a pain to find a spot available, so I would recommend plan a little bit ahead of the time and make sure you make appointments for the next visits if you have to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sylvia Casarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: 1st visit at SWISH on South 1st Street was AWESOME.  From the time I walked, I was greeted by Samantha and Kristy with friendly smiles, to Amanda step by step explanation, to Dr Claros AMAZING personality, her continued concern on how I was doing during the procedure.  Plus watching FRIENDS on Netflix during the procedure and music jamming through out the office was very relaxing. The atmosphere was incredible for being a dentist office. Everyone made me feel comfortable, I will definitely be back.  DESIGN of the OFFICE: 10 stars. STAFF: 10 stars. Smiles by STAFF: 10 stars!!!   Highly HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raul Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first experience​ at Swish Dental South was superb. I was referred​ by a close friend of mine to the office. I had heard nothing but positive things about the office. So I decided to set up an appointment​ in need of dental care. From the moment I walked in, ​I was greeted by a warm staff. Sam the Dental Assistant at the front desk was such a delight. She made sure I was at home and comfortable as it was my first time. The vibe of the office was posh and chill and I was all about it. Raven, another kind Dental Assistant at the office took me in for my appointment and gave me a complete walkthrough of the office. I found that to be very considerate​ as a new patient. Raven also provided information​ on their services and capabilities​ at the office. As well, the pop art that was displayed around the office by local artists was such a quiche and cool touch in the office.

Raven did my initial​ intake and got all my Xrays​ before being seen by the dentist. Using up to date equipment​ it was quick and efficient​ which I was impressed by. Raven was very comforting​ along the way. Making nice conversation and getting to know me on a personal level which I appreciated. She set me up in my dental chair making me comfortable and having the TV playing which are located in every dental chair station.

I then met my dentist​ which would be Dr. Patel. She had such a warm vibe and aura about her. Not to mention very cute and pretty. I felt very comfortable and was​ reassured​ that I was in good hands. Seeing the dentist makes me a bit nervous but Dr. Patel really made sure that I was feeling comfortable and talked me through my whole process. Reviewing​ all my xrays with me beforehand​ and giving me her honest thoughts on my care. Dr. Patel​'s chairside manner was on point and I felt that my dental care was very important​ to her. She was very thorough with her work and made sure that I was satisfied​ with the work and addressed all my dental questions. She also gave me a run through of my dental plan/work that is to follow. By the end of the session, ​I was a VERY happy camper with a fresh and clean mouth. I also got complimentary​ teeth whitening​ trays! Which I was grateful​ for! :D

Alexi the male Dental Assistant was very cool and personable. He then came in after Dr. Patel to complete my dental care by thoroughly cleaning my mouth after my dental work and making the molds of my teeth for my trays. He made ​sure that I fully understood my dental plan before I left. I then received​​ a cute bag with swag in it! I thought​ it was very thoughtful​ and a nice gesture​.

All around I was just taken​ back by this office's attention to detail and how they strive to really make their patients experience​ an efficient, personable, and detailed one. I couldn't​ have asked for anything else.
I HIGHLY RECOMMEND SWISH DENTAL! To all my friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeanette Bozied
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brooks is fabulous! If you have the opportunity to have Fred be your hygienist, you will ensured for a thorough, professional, and gentle cleaning. The front desk staff is friendly and helpful. Go see them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Heggelund
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service from the receptionist to the assistant all the way to the dentist. Clean and modern looking, with Netflix to watch while they work on you're teeth. One of the most pleasant dentist offices I've visited with great, helpful, and welcoming staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yoni Best BBQ
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went here because I chipped a tooth and I needed it repaired.

From the moment I got there they seemed very concerned about making sure they got my credit card information.

Although their postcard said my comfort was important that seemed to go out the door when I arrived.

I was coldly led through X-Rays and getting my teeth scanned for invisilign. I never asked for invisilign but they seemed to talk about it the most. I'm guessing it's their highest profit.

A very nice woman came to check my gums and proceeded to poke my gums with a very sharp instrument which hurt repeatedly. I told her it hurt halfway through and she continued without seeming to care. She was still friendly while she was hurting me.

A nice doctor came in later and told me they would refer me to a specialist for my chipped tooth. She also told me they'd give me antibiotics for a possible infection. I was never given antibiotics and they seemed to forget about this by the end.

Then a woman came in to show me my "treatment plan" which was a laundry list of procedures, invisilign and cleanings. She didn't ask how I felt or if I was still in pain. She just wanted to show me all the things I need to pay for. She scrolled on an iPad showing me $8000+ of treatments they decided I needed after me being there for 15 minutes.

Then they tried to get me to apply for financing before I left the office. No one asked how my visit was.

I made this appointment as an "emergency" for tooth pain and it ended with them trying to sell me almost $10,000 in dental work. I never got the "referral" for the specialist and my tooth is still super painful.

At no point did I feel like I was cared for and I was never offered "Plush blankets, phone chargers and all around comfort vibes" they offer on their post card. Mostly I just felt rushed through and handed off to many people. It feels like a factory to just get people in and make as much money as possible.

They got my $199 for their "membership" but I'm not sure they'll get any more of my money.

If you actually read these reviews feel free to contact me, you have my #.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Lamb
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is soooo cool and upbeat compared to other boring [scary] dental offices! They were playing energetic music and also had tvs at each station to keep you entertained during the waiting time!

Also those same screens double as an interactive viewing session for you to see the tooth in concern while the D.M.D. Ms. Patel is discussing it! She’s super knowledgeable and very concerned with what’s BEST for you! Not to mention when she cleaned my teeth, I felt nothing! She was super gentle which is way different than other dentists I’ve been to- Ouch!

Lex is a killer dude with his fun and crazy attitude and was great conversation - and not to mention knowledgeable of each question and concern I had!

Sam is at the front desk and I know why! She’s very personable and helped me out when I was running late by adjusting my schedule and me on the forms!

All in all I can tell you one thing - this is my dentist for life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Maushart
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Horrible experience and terrible service.  I called to make an appointment for a cleaning and on the call was told by the receptionist that a membership is $200 and that the cleaning i made the appointment for would be included in that .  I confirmed 3x on that call that $200 would be the total cost of the visit.

I took off work to make this appointment (which was the only time the had available for 3 months I was told) only to arrive to the Swish South office and be told that the total cost of my visit is actually $200 + $120 for my cleaning.

I am so angry and have little patience for issues like this.  I am on a tight budget and planned for the $200 out of pocket cost I confirmed would be the only cost of this visit on the phone 3x with Swish just to arrive to be told that was false and that my total cost was going to be $320.

Additionally, after telling the front desk ladies that I planned on $200 since that’s what was told to me 3x on the phone and didn’t have anymore money — I asked if they could bill me for the other $120 and they said NOPE!

I recommend GOING ELSEWHERE TO A DENTAL OFFICE THAT PRACTICES HONESTY AND TRANSPARENCY because you’re not going to get those things at Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Smartoneinok
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is one of those places where everyone inside is way too happy. Like, I know you guys aren't that happy to be here, so just be chill. There are a lot of extra frills (3D digital models, Netflix, etc), but I don't really care about all that stuff. I just like to get my teeth cleaned every six months. It was a tad odd to me that the hygienist didn't actually polish/floss my teeth...the assistant did. It wasn't a problem, but I could tell the assistant was new at polishing. Girl, learn how to use that pedal.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Destiny Lovejoy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently went to this dentist office after relocating to Austin, it was my first cleaning in 8 months. When I got home my teeth still had build up on them on the back side. Won’t be going here again. 12/13/24

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish is so great! I have a lot of anxiety around the dentist but I always feel very relaxed and at ease here. Very professional staff! Definitely recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amberly Washington
user_reviews_extended.Description: Don’t move out of state while in the middle of your Invisalign treatment! Although Invisalign has a pretty cut and dry policy allowing transfers to another dentist, they are trying to force me into paying the entire remaining balance even though I paid a $1000 deposit, several monthly payments, and only made it through 1/4 of my treatment before moving. They won’t release my records to my new doc until I pay the remaining balance of almost $2000. Again moving is completely allowed. Eventually one person in billing said I could, another person overrode them. I gave them ample notice and documentation of the situation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mired Lara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brooks is an amazing doctor I had a broken tooth and I was in and out with my tooth restored. No pain or sensitivity afterwards. Highly recommend my tooth looks great and feels great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gloria Velasco
user_reviews_extended.Description: They’re impossible to get a hold of. Took over a week for them to finally answer the phone and correct my email address. And I still haven’t received my new patient forms for an appointment that’s in less than 48h. If this is how bad their customer service is, can’t imagine what their office is like.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sanaz Oskouy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Tu is the best dentist! She is so nice and thorough and makes you feel at ease. I also love that you can watch Netflix on a TV above your chair while you get your cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carolina Vinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the SPA of the dentist! My first experience EVER! Would definitely go back there and I highly recommend this places as a first and unique option. The treatment, the safety measures, the quality, the professionalism, everything is above and beyond.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Timothy Treadway
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently moved to Austin and was looking for a good dentist to go to. I heard good things about Swish so I gave it a ty. I couldn’t be happier with the level of service and functionality of this dentist office. Everything is nice and modern, the staff is extremely helpful. Highly recommend Swish to anyone

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mayra Ruiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Swish Dental are always friendly and attentive. The service is fast. They answer all my questions and concerns. I always leave with a peace of mind. I strongly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been coming to Swish Dental for a while and each time we go in they are very friendly and always take care of the kids  Taking 4 children in at the same time could definitely be difficult for a parent but we have no issues at all.  I highly recommend Swish Dental for all your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Colby T.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely clean work areas plus everything is professional and kept up. Everyone I met here is a sweetheart. I’ve never been to a dentist where they let you choose what you want to watch on Netflix as you’re having your teeth worked on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benjamin Padolsky
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctor was fine.  Everything else has been horrible.  I had a TMJ guard made and paid during my visit.  I received a notification a month later that I owed money for the guard. I called several times and left messages but never heard back.  I received another bill.  I continued to call and when I did get in touch with someone I was told they would get back to me.  They never did.  This cycle has continued.  I have proof I paid but have been completely unable to get in touch with anyone there to provide that proof.  This has gone from a slight frustration to completely aggravating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Bernal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lee and the staff are amazing. Best I’ve ever had! They really make sure you are always comfortable and content. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben whiteley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish dental is great, but they’ve started to charge customers a new COVID fee. I’m giving them 3 stars, because of this unnecessary fee. Nothing in the office, other than a temperature check when you walked in is different. Everyone is feeling the affects of COVID, charging your customers a made up fee isn’t cool. The dentist and hygienist have always worn a mask, so saying that they need the fee for masks doesn’t fly with me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devon Olner
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I walked in to the moment I left the office, every single person that I came in contact with at swish dental was kind, confidence, compassionate, helpful, and knowledgeable. It was only my first time in the office, however, I know I will be back and will be recommending this dental office to my family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jon King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service and incredible staff, Dulce did an excellent job with my exam and was pleasant and professional the whole way through. Will definitely be making this my regular dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nickolas Velliquette
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dental office in Austin, TX.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Villavicencio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental practice I’ve ever been to. They made sure I was comfortable and followed safe Covid protocols. The staff were great, unfortunately I’m from out of town otherwise this would be my permanent dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Thomsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great atmosphere, comforting staff, bubbly doctor. For those hesitant about the dentist you have to check this place out! They are super professional and know how to walk through everything with you. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel and her staff are amazing. I have never really had a regular dentist and now I do! The office is fantastic and I highly recommend. They make you feel very comfortable

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martha Mefferd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I get great care and a warm reception from staff, dental assistants and the dentists at swish. I highly recommend Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizette Tovar
user_reviews_extended.Description: My Swish Dental experience was amazing! Sam, Aleczi, and Dr. Gulati make such a great team! We may have been laughing a little too loud, but that's because they made me feel so comfortable. Dr. Gulati is a smart and funny guy, but also very informative. He let's you know everything he is about to do and explains what it means when he calls out different numbers and codes. The office is beautiful, laid back and the atmosphere doesn't make it seem like every other dental office. I think Swish Dental is going to fit in perfectly in the Austin area. So if you're looking for a new dental office, new doctor, or just awesome pricing, then I highly recommend this place. I don't think you've ever heard this before, but I look forward to going back and continuing care with Dr. Gulati and his team. #SwishSwishBish

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paige Ruby
user_reviews_extended.Description: my experience with Swish was great! Robbie did an excellent job, I can't recommend them enough ✨

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drew Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and welcoming staff. They got me in at the time of my appointment. Everything from insurance coverage, procedures to be completed, results of findings, and follow up information were explained clearly and thoroughly.
