No wasted time; they got me in and out in a timely fashion. I will be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Rothenberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love it here. Daniella is the sweetest, kindest most hospitable hygienist you’ll ever meet. The hour teeth clean flew by and I’m weirdly looking forward to next time. I highly recommend Swish dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gus Manke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Update: dentist was very honest and gave me insight on a tooth that had staining but didn't necessarily need a filling that was scheduled for me. Appreciated the honesty and focus on preventative health rather than pushing more business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeshua Loh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Glad to be done with Swish. They always tried to charge me for flouride treatments even though my insurance covers it. I had multiple other billing issues that was always unclear what I was charged for. New person cleaning my teeth every time, so you never know your dentist and I never got to meet the actual dentist I originally requested when I signed up. The TVs you have to stare at the whole appointment just show a Netflix loading screen because they won't fix their bad internet/wifi. The new unnecessary $10 COVID fee that others are posting about was icing on the cake. Do yourself a favor and go to a dentist who isn't afraid to put their own name in their dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew James
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctor and staff were super attentive and kind, provided all the info I needed and were extremely streamlined in all that was provided. I definitely recommend their dental expertise for any in the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Space Cat
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had some concerns after a recent root canal and bridge prep, and Rashelle was an absolute rockstar and got me help at another nearby location when there were no openings at South First.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raj Roy
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you’re tired of unrelatable, stodgy old dentists, get an appointment at Swish! I had a longer conversation with Dr. Gulati than I have had with my last 3-4 doctors. Combined. Friendly service, pretty high tech office, and some nice art by local artists makes them a go-to for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrian Saravia
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best place in Austin to go!!! 10/10 service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Stephens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience I have ever had at the dentist! The staff was incredible, everything was state of the art and you don’t even feel like you’re at the dreaded dentist office. Actually looking forward to going back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blake Britton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Swish Dental! Very professional and explained my x-rays in easy to understand terms then outlined a plan for me. It was the best dental experience I have ever had. Thank you Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience...the staff is super friendly and they go above and beyond explaining what they’re doing so you have a full understanding. Doesn’t hurt that you get to choose a Netflix show to watch during your cleaning! Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blanca Beltran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome Experience! Really knowledgeable people, from start to finish you know you have the best professionals taking care of your dental health!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Malesa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly, best experience at the dentist I've ever had. Nice and hip environment. Everyone was super professional and had great bedside manner. 10/10 would recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Bandy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quick and easy, actually the first time I enjoyed the dentist. And the girl who took my X-rays was very sweet and made that experience easy, because i hate having to bight down on that clip. And shes cute so that helped.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt McGehee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is frequently condescending. Speak to your adult patients like adults, not like children. Additionally, probably refraining from using words like “investment” when you’re referring to a toothbrush head that’s insignificant from a cost perspective. Further reinforcing the air of superiority some (not all) of the staff have here. Know your audience, you may be OKAY dentist, but have some tact. Utterly distasteful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larissa Puente
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazingly clean and professional. Dulce is excellent to work with - she is personable and knowledgeable. The whole staff take care of you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Niraj Jayant
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very efficient check in process and the dentist and hygienist were really nice and answered my questions. Would recommend to anyone for their dental needs

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Vaghi
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best cleaning that I have had. From the moment that I walked in to when I left, the staff was excellent and made me feel comfortable. They also let you watch Netflix during the cleaning. What else can you ask for.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edward Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Anyone tired of hating your dentist or looking for a fresh dental experience, definitely check out Swish. They’re professional, timely, and super super down to earth. Dr. Desai and the entire staff created an awesome experience overall (can’t say I’ve ever said that about a dentist office).

user_reviews_extended.Name: randy mcgraw
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was in and out for a teeth cleaning within 40 mins and was super easy. Staff is always very helpful and kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peter Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was friendly, helpful, and on time. The facility and equipment were clean and modern.  They even had Netflix for patients to watch during their cleaning. I'd recommend Swish to other patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff with attention to detail and great customer service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Rogers

This  sounded incredible to me so I asked that her X-rays be sent to our doctor. He didn't see that so he prescribed her an antibiotic and wait for Christmas break. She needed a filling only. 40 min in and out and no pain any longer. I am not saying they would have done a poor job on this root canal or implant. It was just completely unnecessary. user_reviews_extended.Name: José Costa Rodrigues
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As a business owner responsible for a 700-person company, I know firsthand how important it is to treat clients with integrity, honor obligations, and maintain accurate records.

Unfortunately, Swish Dental, specifically their South Studio, completely fails in all of these areas.

If I could give zero stars for their accounting and management, I would.

More than three years after I stopped going to them, they randomly started chasing me for a fabricated, mistaken debt of over $700 without ever giving me a courtesy call.

Every treatment I actually received was paid on time and according to schedule.

I had a monthly subscription with no contract that I rightfully canceled. They tried to pressure me into renewing it, and I explicitly declined over the phone and in writing.

Even when I was an active patient, their billing was a total mess.

I was repeatedly billed for treatments I never received and scheduled for appointments I never requested.

When I asked their billing department (through a collections company), to provide a clear, professional excel ledger to explain where they theoretically found this $700 discrepancy, they sent back an incredibly low-quality, illegible PDF riddled with mistakes.

The South Studio is severely mismanaged. They have incredibly high employee turnover (you never speak to the same person twice – I have met Gabi, Linda and Josh, all of them no longer working there), they rarely answer the phone or answer emails on time – and their accounting department operates in chaos.

It is a poor representation of a business to wrongfully chase clients for unowed dollars using these aggressive and incompetent tactics.

I have had to involve my legal counsel just to get them to back off. Remember, an hour of a lawyer costs me more than the supposed $700 they say I owe them, but I would not let my honor be questioned, as a matter of first principles.

Don't be fooled by their apparently cool-young brand and marketing, because behind the scenes, namely the billing practices, there is a total mess going on, which will cost you time and patience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim-Jamy Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
One of my biggest regrets is choosing to go to swish dental to get my Invisalign. I had an awful experience at a place that I thought was a well oiled machine.

My final appointment was horrifically painful AND started 50 mins late and I had to stay an extra hour.

The teeth whitening was one of the most excruciating pain I’ve ever felt. I was actually wondering if it was suppose to feel like torture. Apparently, my mouth guard wasn’t in place and while I was left to my own device, I was also suffering away as my gums burned and burned.

I wish someone, anyone had just preface - that BURNING is not normal. I was almost in tears by the time I jump out of my seat and nearly ripped off the mouth guard, and whimpering before the tech came to check on me.

My bottom gums were all either bleached white or burned.

Invisalign is a huge investment - my invoice 7k or over from Swish and I really think that your local dentist could do it for cheaper (the discounts/deal isn’t great bc they have such a high mark up at Swish) and you probably won’t be tortured and left with WHITE GUMS after a simple whitening.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A Vallecorsa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Swift on S 1st's dentist at this location is abrasive and confrontational. I reached out to the regional manager, Aaron, two weeks ago and still have not received a reply. I also asked for a summary of my appointments from the reception desk and have not received that email either, it's been 2 weeks.
Here are the details why: I started going there because their website talks a lot about gentle care and sedation options for people who get anxious at the dentist, big deal for me since I have enormous dental anxiety.
When I booked my appointment, I specifically asked to not see the same dentist who, frankly, is not nice at all.  She caused me pain on purpose (she was very rough) during my previous appointment.
When I made this appointment, the person who set my appointment said she noted to not make my appointment with her. When I got there, the dentist who I asked NOT to see came in anyway.
She started asking me why I said she hurt me last time, what she did wrong, and she just would not drop it. I asked twice to stop the conversation, to leave me alone, but she kept pressing me about it until I had to ask the hygienist to help me out of the chair to leave. It was honestly really uncomfortable.
I reached out to the regional manager, Aaron, afterward to share what happened - both via email and phone, but no one ever responded.
For a place that promotes being gentle and understanding with anxious patients, that really disappointed me. If you have dental anxiety and need sedation, I’d be careful, my experience at Swish S 1st wasn’t what they promised.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Mendez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was a bit hesitant going in. Nervous. But the staff made me feel welcomed and had me feeling like they'd help me. The dentist, Dr. Marx was amazing. She just lit up my day. Her enthusiasm and joy are amazing. I cannot wait to see how they'll help me gain my smile back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Curtis Menchaca
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Marx and Victor are the
absolute best team I have ever seen!! I simply can’t say enough about Dr Marx - I would not go to anyone else ever. Everyone in my family absolutely loves her and trust her. She is hands down The best dentist in all of Austin. She’s made me wanna smile again!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenneth Headrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: It has been several years since I have seen a dentist. There was no judgment and they gave me all the options and I was surprised at the cost. In a good way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kitty sibille
user_reviews_extended.Description: Another great experience with Swish Dental, this time at their 1st St. office. Excellent staff at reception, friendly and helpful with billing process and making appointments as well as discuss different services offered there. Saw a different dentist this time because it was a root canal. Loved the dentist, she was knowledgeable and taught me things about what was going on with my tooth and how she planned to treat it. Gotta say she has a feather touch, the procedure was painless. Dental assistant was friendly and helped get me comfortable before the procedure began. Highly recommend the team here at Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leticia Menchaca
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and quick. I appreciate that!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica S
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great visit, comfortable and pleasant atmosphere & the staff was very nice! Robbie was awesome!

title: South Austin Dental
address: 6905 West Gate Blvd B, Austin, TX 78745, United States

user_reviews.Name: Nancy McKenzie
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Hauser and his entire staff are absolutely incredible, caring, and thorough!  The dental technology and equipment he has is mind blowing for diagnosis and treatment planning. All options were explained in detail and respected colleagues were contacted for additional opinions and possible additional procedures needed. The time Dr. Hauser spent with me was way beyond the norm.
My situation is complicated with previous cancer and mouth surgery, radiation side effects, plus more. So glad I drove from Georgetown to south Austin; I would go a lot further to have this caliber of care.
What a God send Dr. Hauser and his staff/dental family are!

user_reviews.Name: Shelby Hansen
user_reviews.Description: I love this staff. I’ve been going to this office for many years and Romana makes you feel like family the minute you walk in! Dr. Hauser has been such a welcome addition. He is very knowledgeable, caring, and professional.

user_reviews.Name: Christina Mitchell
user_reviews.Description: Everyone is so friendly and seems to genuinely enjoy their jobs. They treat you as a patient instead of a customer which really helps put you at ease if you are afraid of the dental chair!

user_reviews.Name: Domonique Jennings
user_reviews.Description: The entire staff, from front office to back are incredible-so professional and friendly. I have never felt more comfortable in a dental office. They made me aware of everything that was going to happen during my appointment and made a plan for the future. I am so happy to have found them-HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend!!

user_reviews.Name: Chris M. Smith
user_reviews.Description:
First timer to South Austin Dental and I will definitely be coming back from now on! Every associate was very wonderful and friendly/informative. Very comfortable atmosphere all around. Both Christine & Carolyn were both AMAZING on helping get me cleaned up and ready for the doc. Dr. HAUSER made everything in the process very informative and comforting. Overall had a WONDERFUL experience. I will happily be going back there in the future and highly recommend this establishment. Ramona & Tori are ultra helpful at the front desk with any scheduling/additional information as well.

Highly recommend this location as a local business all around. Great location, professional services, w/ outstanding results.

user_reviews.Name: Olivia Phillips
user_reviews.Description:
This was my first time with Austin Dental and it’s been the best dentist appointment I’ve ever had. They listened, answered all my questions, and I felt safe. Now, my teeth are whiter after the hygienist and I look forward to my follow up in 6 months time.

Highly recommend!!

user_reviews.Name: Brad Shearer
user_reviews.Description: Over my life I’ve probably had 6 different dentist. Dr Hauser is definitely the most professional and knowledgeable of the bunch. The staff is also amazing. I highly recommend Dr Hauser for all of your dental needs.

user_reviews.Name: Leslie Luciano
user_reviews.Description: This dental office is local as opposed to the chains. From start to finish all is seamless. They are really wonderful. So grateful someone recommended it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the front desk to the dentist chair you will feel totally cared for at South Austin Dental. Excellent service, excellent care, and friendly staff that exceed expectations. Thanks for taking care of my family!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda K
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve found my forever Dentist! Dr. Hauser and his staff make you feel like their most important patient. He’s exceptionally thorough and even discovered/corrected issues my former Dentist overlooked. Easily the most comfortable, caring and comprehensive dental experience in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan Lee Vogler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Adam Hauser at South Austin Dental is easily the best dentist in Travis County,.. these people are no compromise perfectionists, with state of the art equipment and procedures, all while keeping any pain near zero.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have great trust in Dr. Hauser, Ramona, and the staff at South Austin Dental. They’ve done Dr. Radwanski justice in carrying on an excellent practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis Ciani
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had a great experience during my dental cleaning today. The hygienist was not only thorough but also really informative. She explained the important connection between oral health and heart health, Even though I use a Waterpik regularly, she emphasized that traditional flossing is still important — something I’ll definitely take to heart. I left feeling well cared for and better educated. Highly recommend!

Exceptional care! Dr Hauser and his staff at South Austin Dental made me feel comfortable and well-cared for, They explained my options for a new crown and answered all my questions without making me feel rushed. D Ciani

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie Hooks
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Team is excellent! Thanks for each of your kindness and each of your beautiful smiles! All Marilyn’s and my love to the entire Team ❤️‍🩹🌹😇🦁🦖

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Burden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I truly enjoy Dr. Hauser's approach and manner. Everyone at South Austin Dental is so friendly and comforting, it makes going to the dentist way less stressful than it has been for me in the past. I also love that when I schedule future work and ask for an estimated cost, they accommodate me so I don't feel taken by surprise when I come in for dental work. Highly Recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bruce Simmons
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great friendly knowledgeable staff with a new teeth cleaning approach that is much better than gritty tooth paste!  Dr Adam is fantastic and his other dental assistants are friendly and provided a great experience for teeth cleaning as new patients. Whether you’re looking to change dentists or need a new one due to insurance changes you can’t go wrong with S Austin Dental! Top notch treatment and service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drea Russolillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I’ve been to since my childhood provider, who I saw into my 20s. After bad experiences, I avoided the dentist for an embarrassingly long time. As a service provider, I really notice how people are treated. Dr. Hauser and team are intentional and genuine with EVERY interaction. I had a deep cleaning and struggled with it, I can be very sensory-sensitive, and at my second visit they had adjusted everything to support me. You just feel safe. It is self-pay, but they’ll file with your insurance for you. AND OKAY - Romana at the front desk is an angel from heaven. I’m not even joking, the woman is absolutely wonderful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Granai-Sisk
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hate going to the doctor but I love seeing my dentist & teeth cleaning crew at S. Austin Dental!  They help me keep my pearly whites in great shape.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with South Austin Dental has always been exemplary. Everybody there is friendly, inviting and professional. Dental care is gentle and comprehensive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Capi Bohn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient for years and the vibe at this office is great, the people are warm and the dentistry/cleanings are excellent. Can’t say enough good things about how they treat me and how they treat each other. If you need a dentist in South Austin, these guys are the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: jaylan espinoza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Oh my gosh—Dr. Hauser and his team are the absolute BEST! I’m still blown away at how fast and smooth everything went—from my cleaning to my filling, it was like magic! ✨ Dr. Hauser is such a sweetheart—so easy to talk to, super gentle, and you can really tell he cares about his patients. He doesn’t do “too much” or try to upsell you on things you don’t need; he just wants you to feel good and leave happy (and trust me, you will!). 🦷💫

From the moment you walk in, it feels like home—like you’re part of the family. And my tooth? Let’s just say Dr. Hauser made it picture-perfect! 📸 I would recommend him 1000000000% for all your general dentistry needs—he’s a total gem!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maddy Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great experience at South Austin Dental! Everyone was wonderful and so happy! I immediately felt comfortable from the moment I walked in. I hadn’t been to the dentist in longer than I care to admit—but they did not make me feel bad whatsoever about that. The dentist sat down first and got to know me and all the wonderful hygienists were so happy and sweet. I would recommend them to anyone! I actually look forward to going back—which is all I could ask for.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amelia Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hauser and his staff are amazing!  I’ve been coming here for years and I highly recommend them.  I had my first tooth filling today and I did not feel anything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Unachukwu
user_reviews_extended.Description: At South Dental I met the most amazing people, so professional and timely. I smile with my mouth wide open, showcasing my teeth. You need to experience them to understand. I love you all guys and Dr you have my heart. God bless you all amen.

user_reviews_extended.Name: chris duncanson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient here for over a decade. It’s always a good experience, the staff are all so nice,  friendly and put you at ease and they do excellent work. My teeth could not be in better hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The South Austin Dental is the place to go for your dental needs. They are so amazing. You do not just become a patient you became a family. Love them all! At the front window you get the best humans on this earth. Ms. Ramona is  my favorite !!!
Dr. Houser gives all his attention to you, no rush!!!
I have a horrible fear of dental work  and Doc took his time making sure I am okay every second of the process. He probably spent an hr working on my mouth just to make sure I can handle a care and I am okay !! Please try them, you will be grateful you did! Superb group of good people !!!!
Love them ♥️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lia Strange
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a client of South Austin Dental for several years. I love the personal care that I get.
I drive from San Antonio to South Austin because it is well worth the trip for me. I know that I will be treated with respect at all times and by all staff members.
I feel like I am a part of the South Austin Dental family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Murray
user_reviews_extended.Description: After many years of avoiding dentists, I'm relieved to have found Dr. Hauser to help with a recent problem.  The Dr. and his staff were genuinely warm and kind, and the exam was gentle and focused on my current issue without pushing any unrelated or unnecessary treatments.  I was pleasantly surprised by the reasonable cost.  I would highly recommend them, particularly for anyone like myself with anxiety about dental visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucas Hudgins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. Hauser for years now and highly recommend this dental family. The entire staff is very friendly and I couldn't be happier with the work I've had done. If you are looking for a Dentist in the Austin area you won't find anyone better to care for all your dental needs! Ramona and Tori at the front desk are always there to help. Dr. Hauser and his team make sure I'm always taken care of.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martha Dodds
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at South Austin Dental for over 35 years.  I’ve taken my husband, my retired parents,  and now my adult children are also their patients. In the past, Dr. Radwanski and his team of professionals always took great care of us, and I’m so pleased that Adam Hauser DDS has now taken the torch and is running with it!  He, Ramona, Tori, Caroline, Jules, Christine, and Wendy give five star care. Everyone in the office is knowledgeable and pros at what they do and have my highest recommendation!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth A Darrah
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to South Austin Dental for more than 20 yrs. and have always been impressed with their Kindness and Professionalism. There are many Dental offices much closer to my home but I remain loyal to South Austin Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Roddenberry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Entire team is top notch! Dr. Hauser is extremely skilled.  Entire staff is friendly and inviting.  Coming to the dentist is like visiting with old friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Reed
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Hauser and his entire staff is wonderful!  Everyone is compassionate and provides patient-focused care and believe me, i have asked all of the questions!
Great place!  Ten stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Hundley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very clean and welcoming office! The staff were all SO kind and helpful! Dr. Adam was very thorough and gentle with his work and truly seemed to enjoy what he does! I have a lot dental anxiety but as soon as I walked in I felt very relaxed, definitely going to be my regular dental office now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Lawton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience overall at South Austin Dental! Jules cleaned my teeth and she did such a great job. She explained everything beforehand and made me feel very comfortable. She also made my teeth feel so clean. I had Dr. Hauser come in and look at my X-rays and my teeth, which made me feel even better. I could tell he took his time to look at my teeth and answered all of my questions even though I made him answer the same question multiple times!!! We talked about how to make my smile even better for the future and I walked out of there feeling so good about my dental care. Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Waldon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've never had such a relaxed dental experience in my life! All of the staff were super friendly, down to Earth and made me feel so at home! This will be my forever dentist 🦷💓

user_reviews_extended.Name: Coral Arce
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I have been coming to South Austin Dental for over 20 years. South Austin Dental transformed my life and helped me gain self-confidence after patiently working with me and my orthodontist in fixing my teeth and jaw overbite. Romona, Tori, Julie and Dr. Hauser are awesome. They make you feel welcomed and really care about providing a great experience. They are the best team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the staff and my hygienist is superb at deep cleaning. Very thorough, friendly and great listener. Ramona at front desk should be in the dictionary for too rate customer service! She is genuinely so kind and gentle. Dr.Radwatski is exceptionally nice and does an amazing job. He listens and comes up with solutions that are perfect for the request. He is like a grandpa and so sweet. Love this place of dentistry. Forever home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Hauser
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was by far the best experience that I have had at the dentist. Carolyn did a fantastic job and made sure I was comfortable throughout the full appointment. Dr. Hauser is very professional and the whole office is extremely accommodating. Going to the dentist is something that has frightened me my whole life and this experience completely changed my perspective.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Solomon Rhima
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had a visit with Dr. Hauser’s team for the first time and came away thoroughly impressed. Right from the start, their Office Manager Ramona had everything from scheduling to insurance follow-up seamlessly organized. Ellie was fantastic and incredibly attentive. Dr. Hauser is super knowledgeable, and the entire team is exceptionally personable. Their transparency and commitment to prioritizing cost-effective and non-invasive solutions was reassuring. It was like catching up with old friends, who just so happen to really care about my teeth. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a new dental home!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Wilkinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m newly arrived in Austin. Asked friends for recommendations for good dentists. Adam Hauser, DDS. Great choice. Personable, professional, attentive with good assessment, not aggressive with treatment, but talks about options moving forward. Friendly and professional staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: laura maldonado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr Radwinski and his team. I have been coming here for over 3 years and I moved north but I will drive anywhere to get my dental services here. From the front desk Ramona and Sarah to all his hygienists Carolyn and Julie and of course Dr Radwinski. They are so professional and caring and always looking forward to seeing me again. My teeth always feel so clean and fresh after I leave them! I highly recommend Dr Radwinski and his team! They are wonderful

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Gerlach
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to get a new crown.  The whole experience was great! Despite the work that had to be done, the staff took good care of me and told me what to expect through the entire process.  They made me feel comfortable and Dr. Hauser reached out that evening to make sure all was well.  Thank you for all the kindness.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Kappmeyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hauser is great! He filled in a gap in my front teeth, which I was a little nervous about, but I can't even tell which is my part of the teeth and what he filled in. Great guy really cares. His staff is exceptional. My family will not go anywhere else. Thanks Dr. Hauser and team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellie Honzel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr. Hauser’s office. It’s really an incredible experience, just like the other reviews said. I got some work done today and getting numb was the best experience I’ve had so far. Everyone is very gentle and does extra steps to ENSURE you feel comfortable. Dr Hauser is a perfectionist and really cares about his work, that’s why I love him as a dentist, I fully trust him and I know he’s going to offer every option, and then help me decide the right option for me. I would give them all 10 stars if I could!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aurora Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: We always have the best experiences here. Dr Hauser and his staff are top notch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Garrison Leinberger
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best dental practice in Austin! Dr. Hauser and his team continue to deliver exceptional patient care, so much that you’ll forget you’re even at the dentist. Thank you for giving me my best smile and making every visit comfortable and painless!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitchell Oldenburg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely thorough and professional. Dr. Hauser and his staff made it very clear that my dental health and goals were the only priority, and gave all the time I needed to walk me through every path forward. Trust was built right away. Strongly recommend if you are looking for a dentist who is not pushy and guided only by what is best for you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kariokus Worthy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Oh my goodness. I’m so glad my sister referred me to her dentist. I saw Dr Houser today and was so impressed with him and his staff. You know how you feel when you’ve had the same dentist for 20 years?  Like they’re family, right?  So comfortable?  Well that’s exactly how I felt from the moment I walked in and talked to Romano. She greeted my like an old friend. Then I met Christine and Dr Houser. Even though they were totally professional, they spoke to each other like friends. He never talked down to her like I’ve heard some doctors/dentists do. All in all it was a very comfortable experience. I can’t say that about many of my previous dental visits. AND I get to go back next week. How’s that for fast service?  If you’re new to the area or are ready for a change, check him out. You won’t be sorry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JoAnne Youngkin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best Dentist!!
The office keeps up with the latest and greatest equipment and techniques etc.. Love Ramona at front desk so thorough with insurance etc..

Dr Hauser is amazing!! He assumed the practice from Dr Radwanski and we are so pleased. My cleanings are great and his skill for more complex dental procedures are great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: carolyn williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went for orientation on products for purchasing regarding sleeping. Dr Hauser as usual was very pleasant and very patient in explaining what would be entailed in my procedure. He gave several options and even drew up a plan I could take and share with my insurance company. The staff as usual were very nice and always a warm reception walking in. If it’s any sort of dentists work you need to get done going to his practice best place to go.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristopher Lake
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hauser and his staff were extremely friendly and professional. They all took excellent care of me when getting my wisdom teeth pulled. I will not go anywhere else in regard to dental care. Dr Hauser has my business going forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A P
user_reviews_extended.Description: An excellent experience, as always. My visit began with a courteous greeting by the front desk, after which there was a professional x-ray imaging session and an efficient cleaning appointment. The final step was an examination & consultation with Dr. Radwanski … who is friendly, caring and extremely competent. Our family has been coming to this location for ~25 years, and will continue to do so.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Belinda Casey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Phobia of dentists for years! Dr. Hauser and all staff were great. This is the first time in years that I will go back to a dentist for a second visit.  Happy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellen Brunjes-Brandt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I appreciate the calm environment and excellent personalized customer service of this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edna Lynn Porter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was a patient of Dr. Radwanski for about 30 years, and really appreciated him!  The transition to Dr. Hauser has been absolutely smooth, and Dr. Hauser is just as personable and kind as Dr. Radwanski! Very happy to still be going to South Austin Dental.  I love the staff!  And a shout out to Romona… don’t know what I would do without her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Hurdle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Radwanski was my dentist for at least a decade and when he retired recently, he could not have picked a more lovely successor than  Dr. Houser. Dr. Houser is very personable and makes you feel at ease. I also love Romana at the front desk as well as my hygienists Caroline and Jules. I highly recommend this dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: AJ Forsythe
user_reviews_extended.Description: What an amazing experience and place to visit - Dr. Hauser + his staff were the best I've worked with. Super friendly, little to no wait time, and great dental office. Highly recommend! 10/10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Spears
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit at South Austin Dental, and I feel so relieved to find a dentist that is so patient and thorough. I felt like everyone in the office was really listening to my concerns. Extremely compassionate staff, and a great experience overall.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jay Woods
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every 5 star review you read here in 100% accurate. The experience is consistent. Extremely warm, welcoming, calming, understanding professional people.  I scheduled a last minute tooth extraction as I feared an abscess was coming. Danali & the reception team responded to emails promptly, and with a compassion i'm not used to. ❤️ She even got me in a day early. Dr. Hauser & Ellie walked me through every step of the 2 tooth extractions I needed. Answered every question. I have severe dental anxiety, and they worked with me through that without ever making me feel like it was an inconvenience to them.  Had I known how wonderful these people are, how painless the experience would be, I wouldn't have waited so long to get the work done. The numbing procedure was amazing. Dr. Hauser really did a lot of small things that go the extra mile to make me comfortable. They treated me like a person, they made an effort to relate to me, I did not feel like 'just another nervous patient'. (although, it seems they treat EVERY patient with dignity & compassion & respect). I just cant say enough wonderful things about my experience. Accolades & appreciation & gratitude to every person in that office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tonya Hicks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Radwanski and his entire team are so wonderful!! He is fast, gentle and thorough, best Dentist ever! His assistants are also so friendly and professional, this has been my best dental visit! I came for a cracked tooth and he did a great job on my crown.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laurie Courter
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole staff makes sure you are cared for comfortable and informed. We’ve been going to South Austin Dental for over 10 yrs and have never been disappointed! And Dr. Hauser is an excellent dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karolina Russo
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff at this office are great. They make me feel safe and comfortable, and make sure I'm ok at all times. I am profoundly scared of dental work, so this is really important for me. Dr. Radwanski educated me and showed me things about my teeth that no dentist has ever pointed out before, and he really takes time to answer any questions or concerns. You can tell that he and his staff really cares about their patients. They even offered me a blanket so I wouldn't be cold! Thank you South Austin Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Summers
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dental office I've ever experienced.  I have been going for a couple of years now, and highly recommend.  With my background in Org Psych I always determine the culture of a company by observing the style of the top person. user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Gordon

January 2024:
Dr Wayne Radwanski retired last year and will be spending time surfing. Dr Adam Hauser is the new dentist and he’s really nice and caring.

March 2025:
I had a filling replaced and they had nice surfing videos for me to watch the whole time. Dr Hausler and the assistant were very nice and made sure that I was as comfortable as possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always courtesy, professional and thorough and very honest. That is much appreciated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonia Prusaitis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Radwanski has been my dentist since I was a child, aside from some years living outside of Austin. user_reviews_extended.Name: Cecelia Ercolino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Hauser is truly the best dentist I’ve ever seen. user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Wilder

user_reviews_extended.Name: Toni Guckert
user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ted A

Thank you Mindy for for giving such good care and Sarah for taking the time to secure a quick appointment with Dr. Radwanski's recommended oral surgeon. Very pleased with my new dentist!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Carrington
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved the time and care Dr. Hauser and his team spent explaining  and discussing treatment plans. Friendly, kind and caring service.  The entire experience was top notch!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elena
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve only been there once so far and I’m pleased to say that my first visit with Dr. Hauser and his staff (Andria and Ramona) at South Austin Dental today went really well!

I have been looking for a new dentist and went to two dentists over the last 2 months trying to find the right dentist for me.

In addition to a dentist with sufficient experience and great reviews, I was looking for a dentist that didn’t pawn me off to another dentist in his/her practice, a dentist who would actually read through my dental/medical history and discuss it with me and do a full oral exam including initial screening for cancer, and a dentist who listens and communicates well, including asking the right questions and answering my questions until I was clear. Also, a dentist with competent and kind staff and staff who he/she treats with respect. South Austin Dental checked all of these! Dr. Hauser and Andria listened and communicated well and were also friendly and kind, which made me feel more relaxed.

The two previous dentists that I visited in South Austin met some of this criteria but feel short in terms of how they treated me. I did not feel heard nor seen but instead felt that I was just a number - someone on whom to do procedures and collect payment. Both those dentists (one male and one female) became abrupt and non communicative at which point I decided not to proceed with them.

I have dental phobia and I’m actually looking forward to having my dental work done at South Austin Dental. I will update my review once I’ve had another appointment there.

address: 1901 W William Cannon Dr Ste 143, Austin, TX 78745, United States

user_reviews.Name: Landra Valadez
user_reviews.Description: All staff so friendly and helpful. I was cold on my surgery day and the tech brought me a blanket. Also when getting my shots she was so nice .rubbing my arm knowing the shots hurt. I love the thoroughness of the Dr. And taking time to answer my questions as well as knowledge me to what he was going to do. Always smiles. I will never go anywhere else. Thank you

user_reviews.Name: Roman Torres
user_reviews.Description: Had a great experience at Vida Dental and Brittany was able to get me squeezed into their schedule last minute.  Brittany briefed me on what would happen before and after my cleaning and  whitening.  During the process she constantly checked on me to make sure I was not having any pain and was comfortable.  It was such easy, pain free and relaxing process that it almost put me to sleep.  I highly recommend Vida Dental to everyone and ask for Brittany.

user_reviews.Name: Orenzo Brown
user_reviews.Description:
I had a very upsetting experience at Vida Dental South and would not recommend them. From the start, I felt profiled and treated differently than other patients. I was repeatedly pushed toward higher charges without clear explanations, and when I questioned the costs, the staff became dismissive instead of transparent.

What’s worse is that my root canal was mishandled. I left in pain, had complications afterward, and ultimately had to seek care elsewhere to fix the problem. No patient should have to pay more than expected and deal with poor-quality dental work.

Dental care requires trust, and that trust was completely broken here. If you’re considering Vida Dental South, I strongly suggest getting a second opinion and carefully reviewing any charges before agreeing to treatment.

user_reviews.Name: keila saenz
user_reviews.Description:
I had an emergency situation with a veneer that came loose and I did not get my veneers done at this office. A lot of dentists won’t touch work they didn’t do, but Dr. Patel and his team took me in right away, no hesitation.

From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly kind and welcoming. Dr. Patel made me feel comfortable, explained everything, and re-cemented my veneer quickly and professionally. The result looks perfect, secure, natural, and done with care.

If you got veneers out of town and need help with re-cementing or maintenance, this is the spot. They don’t make you feel judged or “inconvenient.” They just help you, right away.

I’m so grateful I found this office. I already booked my cleaning here.

Thank you, Dr. Patel, and the entire team at Vida Dental South!

user_reviews.Name: Savanah Brown
user_reviews.Description: I was a customer at Vida Dental and referred multiple people here but I was shocked to learn of a $200 rescheduling fee that was being charged after we had over $3000 worth of service done and still continuing to do so. Before any procedures were done we had let them know our schedule is not very flexible and asked for patience. After them not being flexible with the rescheduling fee they told us it would be waived… however they also did not disclose to us we were given a refund from the insurance and they just took the fee out of that and cut us a check for the rest. Seems like a huge money grab after spending thousands here. Disappointed they did not tell us about the refund and then just taking the rescheduling fee out of the refund.

user_reviews.Name: Noelle Barbosa
user_reviews.Description: My children and I have been coming to Vida Dental South for a few years now. Everyone is always friendly and welcoming. I have referred several other family members as well. We will continue to be patients for years to come!

user_reviews.Name: Dan Foehner
user_reviews.Description:
My experience at Vida Dental was deeply disappointing and felt more like a sales pitch than a dental visit. After my previous dentist stopped accepting my insurance, I was referred to Vida Dental by my insurance and was hopeful for a new, positive experience. Unfortunately, the visit was a complete waste of time.

Despite my consistent six-month cleaning schedule with my previous dentist, they refused to perform a cleaning on my first visit. Instead, they insisted on a full exam and took numerous x-rays. This felt like a forced procedure to justify their next move.

Following the exam, they presented me with a lengthy and expensive treatment plan. This plan highlighted issues my previous dentist had never mentioned, including the need for a crown and an extraction. This was particularly concerning, as my last check-up just a few months prior had shown no such problems. It felt as though their primary goal was to maximize revenue rather than address legitimate dental health issues.

If you are a new patient looking for a dentist who prioritizes your long-term health and well-being, I would strongly advise you to look elsewhere. The lack of transparency and the aggressive up-selling tactics at this practice are a major red flag.

user_reviews.Name: Aaron Hernandez
user_reviews.Description:
Had several cavities filled about 3 years ago at their central location (which I believe they sold or shut down. Within less than a year 2 fillings fell out. So I had to go in, request a different doctor (had to get pretty forceful about it too, because they weren’t going to let me at first).

Since then, those 2 cavities fell out, and I had to go to a new dentist. The first thing the new dentist asked, without prompt, was “so did you get these done at a dental school by chance?”

Today a 3rd filling has fallen out and my new dentist wants to replace a 4th because it was not flush to my tooth and is clearly getting snagged when I floss, and I’m going to have to pay to have them all redone. I did ask the dentist, what’s the standard for a filling to stay in. He said if they’re flush they should be good for life. I can understand 10 years or so. But it’s not 5 fillings having to get redone in less than 5 years.

I regret having paid any money to this dental office. All that dental work is going to have to be redone.
