user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff are so friendly and so accommodating! My brother and mother come here and I can see why they’ve continued coming here. Nina was my dental assistant, and she was so friendly with a great personality and funny.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Graney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Relieved we finally found a thorough dentist. Brittany did an excellent job during my deep cleaning! She offered me noise canceling headphones to calm my nerves and made sure I wasn't in pain. I asked for book recommendations and dietary solutions for gum disease. She sent me a great list of resources for long-term hygiene / lifestyle adjustments. Highly recommend Vida for efficiency and detailed care from their staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda DeLeon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am new to the practice but my daughters and I have had a great experience. I haven’t gone to a dentist in a while and they made me feel very comfortable. The admin staff is also very pleasant every time I visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kara Mauerhan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Vida Dental is the only dentist I've been to in my adult life that hasn't tried to scam me out of my money and trick me into getting work that I don't need. They are the literal best, and they're usually super fast. They'll also text with you about booking if you're busy working like I am. Would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elena Garanzuay
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an extremely unempathetic experience at VIDA. They left me in a room alone with numbing gauze for 5 minutes with just the air sucker thing i guess for me to use myself but who knows how to use that? I then discussed with the tech which options are required and which are optional. She then went in the hallway to discuss it with another tech in ears range of me. I chose to opt out of the optional procedures to which they discussed in the hallway to “try and convince me to get it and sell how important it was”. Once they came back they said that it was now required to follow through with the cleaning. I then was treated for something they didn’t even tell me I had to begin with and the trip was 300$ with insurance… Not to mention while they were working on my teeth I said it hurt and she sounded extremely annoyed and said it’s either this or a shot. 0 empathy and didn’t ask how I was doing in between breaks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Orenzo Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Disappointing and their customer service isn’t good at all. I felt like I was being profiled because they know I have money and I’m also a black man. Highly don’t recommend this place to anyone. They messed up on my root canal which caused me more pain and they tried to charge me additional charges without me knowing. Absolutely the worst experience I’ve ever been through.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carlos Castellanos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m happy and comfortable going to vida dental, everyone treats me very polite and respected, their always able to explain everything about what’s going to happen and also answered questions in a very polite manner and knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesel Quiroz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about Vida Dental in Buda! Dr. Erica Ryan is absolutely incredible — hands down the best dentist I’ve ever had. Her assistant, Mia Dunn, was just as amazing. From start to finish, the care, patience, and professionalism they showed made me feel completely comfortable and at ease. I had a root canal and deep cleaning done, and the experience was better than I ever thought possible. If I could give them 100 stars, I would! If you’re nervous about dental work or just need a great dentist, this is the place to go. Vida Dental is my go-to from now on — thank you so much for the outstanding service today. Truly grateful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Maggard
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience at Vida Dental South. Their team was very welcoming and made my visit not tense at all. I highly recommend using them if you need dental work or a cleaning done.

Addition: On 6/27, I had my bottom two wisdom teeth removed, as well as my upper left one. I had never been given anesthesia before and was really nervous before the procedure. Dr. Patel did an amazing job with explaining what to expect, and did an even better job with the procedure. Dr. Bednarski administered my anesthesia and was outstanding as well. I’m home resting and have ZERO pain or discomfort. I can’t recommend this place more. Excellent service and professionalism all around.

Adding:  On 7/21 I had a deep cleaning done by Brittney (sorry if misspelled). She did an outstanding job and was great at explaining each part of the procedure. Just another great staff member at this dental office, and another reason why I will be a patient for life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geovanny Ventura
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dhanish and all the staff are super friendly and supportive. They take the time to educate you on what needs to be done and why and what takes more priority. Highly recommend any of the Vida Dental spots. They're amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kat Gibbs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went to Vida hoping for a routine visit and left in tears. The dentist was fine, but the dental hygienist I saw was incredibly condescending and full of ego—going on and on about how she was “specially trained” to use their expensive laser treatment, which of course, she insisted I needed. Without even examining my mouth, she told me my mouth was likely “full of infections” and that I’d need a bone graft, deep cleaning, and laser therapy—potentially hundreds of dollars worth of unnecessary treatment.

I was visibly crying during the consultation, and no one acknowledged it or showed any concern. The entire experience was deeply shame-based, manipulative, and transactional. Before I could even process what they told me, I was being pressured into scheduling the procedures on the spot.

Thankfully, I got a second opinion at Swish two weeks later. They did a REGULAR cleaning, confirmed I had no infections, no need for a bone graft, and no reason to worry. For context: I’ve had one cavity in my entire life.

Vida preyed on fear and shame to push unnecessary, high-cost treatments. Do yourself a favor and avoid this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristel Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had a great experience at Vida Dental South. I used to have terrible anxiety going to the dentist because I would always leave with pain after just a simple cleaning. I've had 2 deep cleanings with them and experienced no pain at all. The staff are super friendly, professional, and attentive. I absolutely love the dental hygienist, Brittany! She is so thorough and gentle. They take the time to explain procedures and why they're being done. I highly recommend this office to anyone looking for top-notch dental care!”

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Rang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super great visit! Went for an initial exam. Staff was super helpful, kind, and knowledgeable. They truly work as a team and make sure that you are comfortable. They explained everything and ordered the treatment plan in a way that made sense. I"m very happy I went to see them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen Ash
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Bednarsky is gentle,  skilled and very comforting.  The entire crew is efficient and pleasant. Highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Selena Bahadur (sellywabbit)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horrible experience. Crown lasted 1 year, they admitted the purposely did no have me sign the warranty and then  demanded I pay for the replacement. They do not stand behind their errors.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen Prince
user_reviews_extended.Description: Vida Dental is one of the best! I’ve been a patient  for at least 5 years if not more.  The staff is kind and helpful. The dentists are top notch, explaining every thing in depth.  Honestly sharing which procedure is the most important so I can plan  and save.  Thanks for always taking such good care of me and my family’s dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Mares
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an appointment for both my parents at this location. The ladies at the front desk, nurses & Dr. Sama were so respectful and patient the whole time. Their explanation of the options available were thorough and easy to understand. Additionally, they were prepared with all the documentation my parents’ insurance needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark de la Rosa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff was amazing as always and Dr. Patel was very professional..Have the best Holidays You all. See you next year
Vidal Dental and all the staff ARE AMAZZING.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tre North
user_reviews_extended.Description:
*5/5 Stars*

I'm so grateful to have found Vida Dental South! After years of avoiding the dentist due to anxiety, I was blown away by the exceptional care and kindness I received from the entire staff.

From the moment I walked in, I was made to feel comfortable and at ease. The team is incredibly professional, explaining every step of the process in detail so I knew exactly what to expect.

The office itself is immaculate and modern, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The front office staff are absolute gems - friendly, efficient, and genuinely caring.

I can't recommend Vida Dental South highly enough. If you're like me and have been putting off dental care due to anxiety, please don't hesitate to give them a try. You won't regret it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: UnkleMeesh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Thank you to the friendly and professional team.  I had a very last minute emergency and needed a tooth to be extracted.  It was simple, quick enough to get in and out, and the team was very insightful/helpful.  Thank you Doc for the help today.

-Lance

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariana Gallagher
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is by far the best dentist office I’ve ever been to. As a woman of a few decades and different residencies I can say I have been to several dentists in my lifetime. They are not only kind and approachable and knowledgeable but they never upsell anything they are fully transparent about literally everything from what they are doing in your mouth to how they are charging you at the end. They even work with cherry financing for those who don’t have health insurance. These guys will be one of those providers I will travel to no matter how far of a drive (as long as I’m in Austin of course lol)

user_reviews_extended.Name: A W
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I LOVE going to the dentist! Well…. not exactly, but I love Vida Dental and have been seeing their team since 2018. From the front desk staff to the assistants to Dr. Dhanish, I have consistently felt well taken care of and the anxiety I’ve experienced at other dental offices in the past is non-existent.
SHOUT OUT to dental hygienist Brittany who is wonderful. She is very knowledge and presents as genuinely invested in the health of my teeth and gums.  I’m so grateful for her professional care. I refer family and friends to Vida and everyone has also been pleased with the services. Highly recommend! Over five stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MaryLiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to Vida for a few years now and love them! They’re always timely and kind and have helped keep my teeth in tip top shape! I highly recommend, especially if you’re scared of the dentist. They will put you at ease and discuss everything with you thoroughly and treat you well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chloe Maitland
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first visit at Vida and I'm very happy with the experience. The office is nice, spacious, and clean. Staff is friendly and thorough in explaining any issues I have and the right treatments. I'll be going in for a cleaning soon and I've heard good things about Brittany!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jose Vasquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: After trying out so many offices, I have found the one I will be going to for now on! The booking site was easy to navigate, the clinic was so welcoming, and the amazing service I got from everyone in the office made it all worth it! So excited for my follow up… and I usually get anxious going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rodrigo Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Plain and simple: going to the dentist sucks. However, the whole team at Vida make the experience 1,000 times better. Couldn’t ask for more from a dental team. Brittany is an amazing hygienist and she takes the time to answer EVERY SINGLE question I’ve thrown her way, with tons of patience and so much knowledge. 100% would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: meglet
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an excellent new patient appointment with Dr. Patel after Swish Dental told me I needed multiple fillings and crowns with little explanation. Dr. Patel explained that all I actually needed was for two old fillings to be replaced, and went over non-invasive treatment options to address nighttime clenching. They clearly prioritize care and doing as little damage as possible here, rather than profit. The assistant Nina was very kind and sweet! The other dentist (can't remember her name) did a really great job with my fillings, explaining/checking in with me throughout the process.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blake Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was great and incredibly kind, shout out Nina for being so wonderful when taking my X-rays.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Budd
user_reviews_extended.Description: Scheduled an appointment and gave them my insurance, they told me I was good to go. Then they say later my insurance needs to be updated via text, I am unable to respond right away. Then they threaten to charge me 100$ if I don’t get my info updated within 72 hours of my appointment. Then they just cancel my appointment the day before. I’d give 0 stars if it would allow me. Do not recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Chisikovsky
user_reviews_extended.Description: Vida Dental South was a fantastic experience! The staff was incredibly friendly and professional, making me feel comfortable and well-cared for. All of their Docyors are very knowledgeable and explained everything clearly, and the procedure was painless. I highly recommend Vida Dental South for anyone looking for a great dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: V P
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was once a great dental office. It has become a place where they try to get the latest equipment and forced their recommendations on you. I’ve been to several Dental offices, where this office recommendation was and is not needed till this day. Glad I found a dental office that is there to provide what is needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Rowles
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel is so nice and helpful! Answered all of my many questions about my wisdom teeth removal with a smile and lots of reassurance. The rest of the staff is also so kind and sweet!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isak Kurbasic
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been to a few dentists around town and they are the best. Super friendly, got me in quick and last minute, and did a Greta job. Highly recommend Vida Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josie Esparza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am nearing the end of my teeth straightening journey with Vida Dental South. I switched over at the recommendation of a good friend. I’m so glad I did. Dr.B and his team are top notch! I have dentist anxiety and they are always so patient and accommodating. My teeth already look amazing but Dr B wants them as close to perfection as he can get them and I  appreciate that so much. His assistant Elena is super sweet and gentle and knows what she’s doing. I love chatting with her when I go. I would highly recommend Vida Dental South to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Garcia-vera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I want to give a big thanks to Mr.Bednarski making my smile happen. He has been very nice and patient with me. He made me get my confidence back. Also big thanks to the ladies for always taking care of me and Maribel for always helping me work out my payments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Stokes
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dental office is not good for people that are pain sensitive. The hygienists are not friendly, patient or empathetic and seem annoyed when you need a break or jump from the pain.  It’s also not the friendliest place in town. I don’t think I’ve ever been a patient of a dentist office where the hygienists don’t even chitchat with you at all, it’s just complete silence. Makes for a miserable experience all the way around.  I even mentioned it at my last visit to the front desk, and no one ever even followed up about it they just said they wouldn’t put me with that hygienist again.    So, that must just be the entire office vibe.   I’ve been going for about a year and will be trying to find a new dentist soon.  This one was just close to my house, and that was a mistake choosing it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elise Covas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great first visit at Vida Dentistry. I felt like the team took a lot of time to hear my concerns and develop my treatment plan. Special shout out to Nina who made me feel really comfortable and  helped me during the whole visit. Her energy made me feel really welcome at the visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my first time there, and I am so happy with how it went. Everyone was so kind and helpful. The dentist was very indepth and made sure I was well informed on my options. I would highly recommend this office to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ivan Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my first visit here. The waiting area was very clean and had nice furniture, and the young ladies behind the counter were all very pleasant, even though it was late on a Monday afternoon. They even laughed at my silly jokes. The facilities are modern and the exam room was very clean and well lit. The doctor seemed very interested in my concern and gave me several options to consider. They did some work on my teeth and provided me with an easy to understand treatment plan with clear costs. I gave only 4 stars because I didn't have any major work done and didn't really spend much time there, so I can't honestly say the practice is deserving of a full 5 stars. But my experience was CERTAINLY pleasant and I am looking forward to my next visit (which is at a very convenient time for me).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Idalia Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have nothing but great things to say about Vida Dental. My two kids and I are patients here and have had great service. Very thorough cleanings and Dr Patel has always just done what is necessary. I've never felt like they were pushing unnecessary work just for the charge. They have really helped get our oral hygiene back on track at a resonable price. Biggest thing for me is I have never been overbooked, so I'm usually in and out, which I appreciate the most. Super clean facility and super nice staff that actually knows what's going on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Crecelius
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dentist makes it easy to keep my appointments. I hate the dentist, but I love clean teeth. They ask me how sensitive my mouth is prior to using the tools, and adjust their tools based on my answers. They all seem joyful and genuinely happy to be working on teeth. I am used to getting an oral cancer screening now, and I feel spoiled. They have a very high standard of practice. It really makes a difference for me, and I will keep my family at this office as long as I live in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: s garg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel and his staff are excellent. I had the best exam and evaluation was top notch. He discussed in detail the condition of my teeth and gums and offered a comprehensive plan and care. They have the state of the art equipment and the patient care was high quality. After going through all the cleaning procedures, I would have the most healthy teeth and gums. Thanks for such intense exam, I feel that I have the best Dentist and staff forever. I actually look forward to my next cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Lomeli
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in as a new patient. It was recommended that I get a deep cleaning, however they gave me an estimate for the deep clean of around $2k even after insurance. I called today to ask if I could schedule a surface level cleaning for now until I allocate the funds for a deep cleaning, but the receptionist told me they strictly could not do that if it was recommended I get a deep cleaning. They were friendly and seemed professional, however that seems like a ridiculous policy to me and I will be going elsewhere for future dental services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cameron Lilley
user_reviews_extended.Description: After a really bad experience with another dentist about 5 years ago, I was extremely nervous and hesitant to go in. However, from the start they were amazing . Scheduling was extremely easy, they were so kind and explained everything throughout the appointment and they addressed all my concerns which made me feel much more comfortable .They talked me through my treatment plan and went above and beyond to find a way to work with my schedule to get everything done so I don't have to miss work. Just knowing that they listen and care is a huge relief, 10/10 recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessi McWilliams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience ever! I have a fear of the dentist, which everyone in the office took into consideration. Everything was explained in detail before it happened, and it was painless. Nina took special care to make me feel relaxed and at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pablo Nunez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nina and Brittney were very professional and accommodating. This was my first time here and I just appreciated all the help they are going to do for me. Definitely coming back here. Very thorough checkups and makes me feel good that I am taken very seriously with my concerns I give them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica McG
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updated review:
I've been coming here for a long time now. I go in every three months for a cleaning so I'm there pretty regularly. I've gotten Invisalign and several veneers as well as crowns on my front teeth. They have done a lot of work and it all looks great! Even my husband went in for a complete redo of his teeth, his teeth looks so nice and natural!

I keep seeing reviews saying that they ask for good reviews on exchange for stuff, but they've never asked either of us for anything like that. They have never pressured us to get any procedures done or anything like that. I've also never had any issues with billing or any issues really. I've had nothing but good experiences coming here even though it is a dentist and no one likes having to go!

_______
They are always really nice and welcoming. No one talks down to me about how I clean (I admit I wasn't flossing like I really needed to be), they don't try to force unnecessary work on me, they actually try to help me save money, and care about what I think.

I HATE going to the dentist, but it's not bad here like other offices. I'm always going to be nervous going, but they help to make it a lot more comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna Oviedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience at Vida Dental - they fit me in within a few days, Nina made the X-rays extra pleasant (not painful or awkward!), and my teeth are squeaky clean thanks to Brittney. I added the cancer check and feeling great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tonya
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very first dental office I felt like a person. Everyone was great. My dental assistants where so nice and very professional. The Dr. was nice, respectful and patient to answer all of my questions or concerns. I recommend them 💯     Update I been going to them for a year now and appreciate everything they have done for me they are a great dental office.  Dr. B is great and really takes the time to listen to my concerns I really appreciate it. My husband is now a going to them as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle D'Alessio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone has been incredibly kind and accommodating. I have anxiety and sensory issues and everyone performing services goes out of their way to explains procedural steps and makes sure I’m comfortable. Brittany is my hygienist and she was thorough and patient with my gum scaling. Overall a great dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia Almstedt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nina (my dental assistant) was the sweetest ever. She tapped my shoulder to distract me while getting my numbing shot. She was patient with me because I had high blood pressure. Very good experience at Vida Dental. Super thankful for all the ladies that work there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Bethel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Respect to everyone at Vida. Everyone working there is super nice and helpful. It’s always quick and easy and I would definitely recommend this location to anyone looking for an easy dental experience. Thank you guys.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krista Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Don’t let the reviews fool you. I was looking for a good dentist in South Austin, and was pleased with the reviews here. After my first appointment, they told me I needed a lot of extra work that I didn’t actually need. They also billed my insurance company for a cleaning that NEVER happened. When I told Vida that they fraudulently billed me they tried to convince me that the cleaning happened .. which it did not I was there. After I called my insurance company to report this Vida apologized. They are not ethical and will recommend deep gum cleaning, and other things you don’t actually need.  After my appointment at another dentist the bill was 1/5 the price with 100% more personable care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelina Trevino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got serviced by two ladies names Nina the assistant and Nina the hygienist both Very nice and friendly I give them a 5 star review. However A few months ago the doctor ordered me to schedule cleaning every 3-4 months. I come here for my cleaning 4 months later, now they want to say the insurance only covers 2 cleanings every 6 months. So they force me to pay out of pocket even though this visit was my second of the year cause they decide to now schedule me in 6 months until next year of 2025. So in a way they find a way to make their money here cause they Made it to where my second cleaning don’t fall until next calendar year.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margret Geltemeyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: everyone was super kind. i had a couple of cavities and they were not judgmental at all. great place for anyone nervous about the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy Andrews
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a factual review: I had the best cleaning I've EVER had with Vida Dental. It was my first visit and the staff was so warm and helpful. The cleaning was thorough and gentle and the hygienist and the doctor were both extremely knowledgeable. They explained the entire process and also answered any questions I had about additional services. I definitely recommend giving them a try. You won't be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariah Storey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I absolutely love this office! Dr. Patel was very informative  and answered all of the questions I had about my treatment plan without hesitation. He definitely knows what he’s talking about!

I also want to shout out their hygienist, Brittany! She did an amazing job cleaning my teeth, she was quick but very thorough. I left feeling squeaky clean!! 10/10 recommend making this your forever dental home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alekhya Aelety
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at Vida Dental South! From the time I checked in and came out after a new patient cleaning, it was a seamless experience. Dr. Sama did an awesome job and she walked me through any issues I had. The staff was also very nice and welcoming! I felt very welcomed and taken care of at Vida Dental South. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie Palacios
user_reviews_extended.Description: This practice is amazing! Nina, Brittany and Dr. Sama were all the best, best, and the best!! My teeth have never felt so clean in my life! Everyone was so kind and knowledgeable. I’m very happy I found them

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaime Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always friendly and inquisitive staff. Help easy the burden of appointments by sending constant reminders

user_reviews_extended.Name: Britney Babineaux
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Vida dental has been nothing but kind to me and my beautiful daughter Reighla. The entire staff honestly have always been extremely understanding as I have gone through some very difficult times as a single mother and have provided us with excellent care and worked with me even when I became VERY behind on my payment for services, never have they mistreated us or made us feel uncomfortable or bad because of the struggle I have encountered, they’ve made us feel quite the opposite, cared for, just as important, always giving top quality care for my daughter and her journey through the beautiful teeth she deserves with braces and healthy teeth. Thank you from Reighla Campos and I to all at Vida dental, I would recommend them a billion times to anyone looking for an amazing dentist and an amazing team that support us and each other. You all are a blessing to us, truly. I wanted you guys to know how much we appreciate all you do.
:) You Rock!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Castaneda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for a cleaning and had the best experience ever. Gema took my x-rays which was very quick and easy, Brittany did a thorough job with my preventative cleaning and made sure to focus on the areas of concern for me, the front desk ladies Kim, Val and Maribel were very kind and super helpful. I would most definitely recommend this office to all my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rodrigo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Unfortunately, issues with cost transparency is something that will deter me from continuing to be a patient here. The dental service itself is good, and the dentists and hygienist give tailored recommendations on holistic care. However, a combination of billing schedules, a lack of transparency in payment expectations, and insurance time-frames, leaves a bad taste not only because of unexpected bills - and even past due notices with collections warnings - but also being a time sink with follow ups and trying to understand their cost breakdowns after they estimated something different. While insurances play a role on this, a good dental office will inform you of which services will be covered and how by your insurance plan, something that Vida Dental doesn't do well. Hope they put better effort in this. After 1 year and a half, I'm more inclined of going to a smaller dental office as they tend to have better cost transparency.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corey Saucedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dentist worked well with my toddler. Just a quick check up. Staff was all very kind. Even forgot my phone and the young girl assisting the dentist on our visit made it an effort to run out and make sure I didn't leave without it!! Thank you so much. We will back later in the year.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Linares
user_reviews_extended.Description: Front desk assistance was nice and helpful(when I had questions about the info form). Lobby was nice, complimentary water, and coffee. Nice modern set up for the examining rooms, flat screen with Netflix, headphones for long procedures. The Doc and the assistants were very nice and professional. I went in for a check up and a deep cleaning(it's been years since I've last seen a dentist). The doc went over everything that needed to be done, things that need immediate attention and other things that can wait. They go over all the financial stuff with you before they do anything, so this way it won't stuck with a bill that was more than you were expecting to pay. During the procedure I felt a little discomfort, I informed the assistant and she applied more numbing agent for the pain. She said "we want all our patients to be comfortable" puts my mind at ease to know that. Overall, my experience was really great. I believe I've found my new dentist. I already have my next appointment scheduled. I recommend giving this place a try.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Wa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love coming here, they are all super sweet and very upfront when it comes to costs and what is covered or isn’t. Nina and Brittany were both wonderful. They did a great job of making me feel comfortable and informed, I recommend them both highly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate
user_reviews_extended.Description: I scheduled a whole dental plan in February and was so nervous, but everyone at Vida was so calming and stellar right from the start. They probably see so many patients but every time I go in they make it seem like they remember me specifically. They pay attention to my chart and never make me feel like just another patient, and they're all happy to answer any questions I might have. Both Dr Patel and Brittney are so efficient and the whole office runs like a well oiled machine. I'm not afraid to go to the dentist anymore!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Padilla
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Was having a issue with one of my wisdom teeth
And was able to set an appointment within a day of contacting vida dental, walking in the staff was very nice and welcoming, I was in the back in no time, and the doctor was able to preform a same day extraction and made me feel super comfortable during the whole process, I was beyond nervous but before you know it the tooth was out and I was out the door, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience, will definitely be back for any future dental work. 10/10 all around

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Pacheco
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff here is incredibly welcoming and helpful.
I would highly recommend to others.
They care, and it actually shows!!.. This is only my daughter's second time here. And we couldn't be more happy and pleased with her care. Thank you Vida dental for being amazing at what y'all do!! You are appreciated!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natascha Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Don’t come here if you dont like surprise charges.I went it with anticipation of getting a root canal and crown just minutes before the procedure began the  Dr said she wanted to do a 3D scan  before starting I said is this an additional charge because I don’t want to do it if it is so she and the Asst both said no (verbatim ) I always ask about charges because I know how these things can be and I’m thinking I’m protecting myself so I left that day not owing and left with  2 options for me to decide from .Allll of a sudden I’m going through my email and I have a statement showing a charge for the CT scan and now no one ever stated this to me it’s a very sad that this is the way I find out I have charges
something I thought I wasn’t going to be charged for  Trying to get help for issues and now they pile new issues on top of that so if you truly want honest transparency I would not recommend at all.

Re: In response to yours ,you should really watch the footage of me sitting  in my chair already terrified only to be asked for me to go step into another area because the Dr wanted to do the scan. What I’d recommend is that you allow your patients ample amount of time to properly review and ensure that the insurance covers these charges when the patient  asks these questions to your staff and to be provided the most accurate information. This is a daily task that your business specializes in  so when me “a new patient” asks am I going to be responsible for this I should get a correct answer so I can make proper decision on what is best for my situation. I don’t do these types of things such as leaving reviews but I haven’t even became a new patient and I’m dealing w things that should’ve been informed on the initial date of the evaluation of my exam not right before I get my procedure done, that’s all I’m saying it’s not right.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marco Andrade
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Vida Dental! What can I say the best experience I’ve ever had hands-down!!!!! Definitely recommend!!!! All the staff we’re awesome! I’m not from town, was recommended by a friend. Dr. Dhanish Patel. DMD! Very professional address all my concerns and made me feel at home!

The dental assistant that help me, forgot her name sorry!! so sweet and efficient Love my experience!

My hygienist Brittany stood out the most in my visit!!! Literally loved her hands! very gentle, did not feel discomfort in my cleaning at all not even once! Call me the next day to make sure I didn’t have any questions or concerns! Will be requesting her for my visits for sure!!!! Definitely recommending her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Angel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
2025: Came back for wisdom teeth extractions. Dr. Patel and his staff were very caring and professional. The whole process was quick and they made sure I was taken care of and comfortable before releasing me.

2022: The whole staff has been amazing to work with through my Invisalign process. I highly recommend Dr. Patel to anyone who wants the best dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mehul Virmani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Vida dental was able to accommodate my schedule and help me receive retainers in less than two days. I really appreciated Dr. Patel's hospitality and client-focused mindset. Top quality service, efficient, and affordable. Customer experience was top notch. Loved it.Will be back again very soon

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zach McLean
user_reviews_extended.Description: Vida Dental South is an awesome dentist that treats all their patients with care and respect! I couldn’t recommend them more I’ve been twice in the past couple of weeks and have been delighted with the care and treatment I’ve received from both the dentist and the people at the front desk! Brittany has been my hygienist and she’s awesome and always takes great care of me would highly recommend her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Daniel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I look forward to going to see my dentist Dr. Dhanish Patel. He is an amazing dentist and his staff are just as awesome. Dr. Patel and his staff are professional, polite, and personable. Always fair in pricing and handles my insurance with ease. Never had an issue. Last time I went Sam was awesome at coordinating my services. With I could give 10 stars!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maribel Zuniga
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was a little hesitant on the procedure but Dr Dhanish and the wonderful assistants Elena Gema and Jenny got me all set up and eased my nerves. And scheduling was quick and easy not long of a wait mrs Kimberly explained well what the visit was going to look like and that I was in good hands. Even the grate hygienist Brittany stopped by and gave me some words of encouragement. Over all the best experience and care that I have had at a dental office. Thanks again to Dr Dhanish for his fast work I know wisdom teeth can be tough but you handled it very fast and with care! Thank you so much Vida Dental South!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Goodyear
user_reviews_extended.Description: I neglected dental care for 25 years and my teeth required deep cleaning and fillings around the gum line. The entire restoration process took about four months and six visits. I am amazed with the results of their work. The fillings match perfectly, you can hardly tell there were stains and terrible cavities. I didn’t think it was possible to do what they did. Brittany is a fantastic and thorough hygienist. Drs. Sama and Patel made the filling match and feel perfect. The other staff are all great and the office is much more relaxing than I remember the dentist as a kid. I will be a patient of theirs for life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica S Rosales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a teeth cleaning today.  Everyone is always friendly.  I am just wondering why  Dr.’s Patel & Bednarski are no longer there? It would have been nice to know that they left, if they have.  Their names are still on the door.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marisa Rojas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went in for A cleaning and the assistant Sherly was very helpful. The hygienist Brittany did an outstanding job on my cleaning.

I always went in for my fillings and Doctor Dhanish and his assistant Gema explained everything that they were doing. I totally recommend this office. Staff was super sweet !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Jankowski
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience at Vida Dental with Dr. Bednarski & his entire staff! One of my best friends was previously my dentist so I obviously had high expectations. The staff really made an effort to make me feel comfortable and to get me out in a timely manner since they knew I was coming in on my lunch break. I am so happy that I chose to go with Vida after moving to Austin and I strongly encourage others to give them a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dentist is the best one l've been to! staff is friendly & they insured my kids were comfortable!! finally found us a good one! and one staff member that helped us I believe her name was Mia (I hope) she was sooooo sweet and so patient!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Getting any dental work can be a little stressful but the team at Vida South makes the whole process go as smooth as possible. They take the time to make sure I am comfortable throughout each appointment! I’m really grateful for their amazing dental hygienist, Brittany. She provides very thorough cleanings and is so gentle!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vikram Sundaram
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I believe it's not just about dentistry but overall quality of service that matters, which was lacking very much at Vida.
Their billing system and front-desk needs to be reworked, there's absolutely no transparency or explanation for your bill.

During my second visit someone from the front-desk was unhappy that I hadn't paid my dues from the previous visit(because I received a $$ number and no explanation for it) to the extent that she interrupted me from being prepped after receiving an anesthetic, made me walk over to the front again to deal with it. I just don't get how that could not have waited until after.
I'm happy to pay for the services that I signed up for but its absurd that they just expect you to shell out hundreds of dollars with absolutely no explanation.

This wasn't a one off, I just received an email(I check my spam folder too) stating I'm past due with an added penalty and this was their first attempt in ever doing so. With no timeline or warning whatsoever and again absolutely no explanation what and why!

P.S: The high star reviews I believe are from the rewards mechanism where you submit a 5 star review for a chance to win something.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allie Samilpa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got my top left back molers pulled. They  were really nice and explained everything to me about the procedure and what to do after the extraction was done it was well explained. Of course, I called and asked questions before I went in.. Overall, everything was great !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Meehan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff here are awesome. Everyone is genuinely kind and patient. Dr. Graham is very thorough, gentle, and explains everything before he does it. I went in for a procedure that was pretty much horrible at my last dentist. Under Dr. Graham, I had almost no pain afterwards. He stayed late on a Friday night with his staff to do a good job.

It's also great to see a staff that genuinely likes each other. The rapport they have with one another at this office is really great to see.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sess Austin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm so Extremely grateful to have been recommended to this location! Everything about this place is just wonderful! The staff is great and Dr. Bednarski is extremely kind, caring and Thoughtful!!!! I can tell he truly cares about his patients!! I've never experienced the thoughtfulness like I have here from another dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Alverson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely terrible customer service and billing. I received an email today telling this was my final notice before my billing was sent to collections. This was a surprise to me, as I had not received any prior emails regarding the amount. When I called to get more details, their billing department said I probably wasn't getting the bills because my address was wrong. They confirmed my address correctly and said "Yeah, its probably wrong because there's no apartment number on it" When I told them I live in a single family home, they were so insulting and hardly able to believe I was capable of such a feat. A 25$ late charge applied despite this again being THE FIRST TIME I was notified of my balance.

Before my appointment, I was either called or texted telling me my appointment was about to be cancelled because I had not provided my insurance. This again was a lie, as I had texted my insurance card to the customer service reps. But even if I didn't have insurance, is that a reason to cancel an appointment? I guess they're discriminating against uninsured people?

Finally, I was called last month regarding a scheduling change to a July appointment (no mention of my apparently pass due bill) and the customer service rep who called me was speaking Spanish to me. No biggie, I don't care. But she acted very frustrated when I said I only spoke English.

Overall, very crass employees and even worse internal documentation.

Pros: The dental staff have always been beyond amazing and kind and gentle and informative.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing! The staff is so sweet and knowledgeable, and so patient with my boisterous toddler. I had gone years without going to a dentist due to past experiences with other providers, but Dr.Dhanish is the best! The whole staff goes above and beyond to ensure your satisfaction. I live in Round Rock, but it is definitely worth the drive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yash Shah
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience from Vida Dental! Staff was very professional and provided a great cleaning service for me. Dr. Patel has a way of making you feel relaxed and at ease all while doing an amazing job checking your teeth. Will definitely be coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesus Santos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for a regular dentist visit at Vida Dental South and was very pleased with the service both at the welcome desk and in the dental chair. I was also impressed by how clean, orderly, and prompt the overall experience was, from the facilities to the method of checkout and payment. Great job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren P
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had nothing but great experiences here. The hygienists are SO knowledgeable, Brittany in particular is above and beyond. They are very thorough and have taught me things I never knew about mouth health/ gum health as it relates to other areas of our health. Most of all, they get to the root cause of issues and always give me multiple solutions or actions I can personally take, rather than immediately selling me on some kind of procedure like so many other dentists do. Can’t recommend enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pratik Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel is very attentive and knowledgeable. All the staff members I came across are caring, easy to talk. Their check in check out process is quick. And I am really impressed with their wait time. I was with castle dental before and compare to them Vida dental is really quick with wait time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Childs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Vida Dental South has a wonderful, friendly staff with a clean environment . I have had great dental check ups every time I visit and very happy with my experience when I leave!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dashawn Marshall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience at vida dental south! Marissa was very nice and helpful. The staff here made sure to go over everything with me about my teeth and how to take good care of them. Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Addie Broyles
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really love Dr. Patel and his staff at Vida Dental South. They don't take my dental insurance, but they have a yearlong membership program that covers my cleanings and costs about the same as dental insurance. If It weren't for the customer service I get,  I would probably find another dentist that is in network, but they take great care of both me and my kids every time we visit. Also, my oldest had braces that were both 1) relatively affordable 2) the fastest braces ever. He was in and out of them in about a year.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Seth Klasko
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first two visits with Dr. Patel and his staff have been amazing! First doctors to sit down and explain treatment to me so that I Could understand. The staff is very patient and caring, constantly asking how you are doing to fully implement painless dentistry. They made me feel very welcome as a new patient. I would highly recommend their services to anyone needing dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tgm Brett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Read all! —Avoid this place, I made edits responding to provider. They lied in their response then after I call them out they “corrected it”. Don’t trust these people. Reviews are fake bc they offer a raffle.

When an appointment is made for a certain time, you expect them to be ready at that time. Checked in and sat in a room for 45-1hr before I saw the provider. Was so close to walking out, but at that point you’re in too deep. I’ll be finding a new provider for sure.

Editing my review to reply to service provider’s lies in the reply they left:

My appointment was scheduled for 11am. I checked in at 10:58. Y’all called me back at 11am and made me sit in the room doing nothing for 50 minutes. It was a free consult visit for Invisalign so you got no money out of me, which is why you did not care to be timely.

The fact you say I checked in 30 minutes early is a complete lie to try and cover your poor time management.

Now I really hope someone can see this review and also know that yall are liars that blame the patient to cover yourself.

The response you’ve given me 100% convinced me to find a new provider. Will not return for your services. And whoever is replying to these reviews needs to talk to your PR department which I’m sure yall don’t have based on how you handled this.

Also I would love to know how you even identified me to get the scheduled appointment times considering I’m using an account to leave this review that has no personal information connected to myself. Funny!

Also all the 5 star reviews are from a raffle you are entered into if you submit a 5 star review which they spam you for after your appointment.

Edit 2: the provider changed their message.

Now you can see they say “correction: you were actually here at 10:58”

It should say “sorry, you called us out and we lied, we shouldn’t lie to cover ourselves”

Also it’s funny how they literally admit to having a raffle for reviews lol.

Avoid this place at all cost.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Randall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I needed to be seen for an emergency visit and was contacted quickly with an appointment time. With everything going on i was surprised how quickly they could see me. My appointment was quick and efficient. They broke down the costs of everything for me very easily. They gave me options for financing my work that needs to be done despite not having any insurance it all seems very reasonable in comparison to other places I've seen. Dr. Bednarski was extremely kind and patient with me and all my questions. He took his time to explain to me what was wrong with my teeth in a way I understood to make the whole process less scary.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Jacob
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr. Sama and the Vida team. They are thorough, explain each step of the process, and collaboratively approach treatment plans. Dr. Sama is incredibly knowledgeable and personable. They also take you back pretty quickly, so I've never had to wait more than a few minutes. I would highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Manuel Robledo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a new client to Vida Dental and can say that right from the start the staff makes you feel very welcomed and is always eager to answer any questions. The location is perfect for any true Austinites who reside in South Austin and the office itself is really kept up with--very clean!!! Dr. Patel and the young lady whom was assisting him throughout the visit were amazing people and I am super stoked to continue to work with them moving forward. Dr. Patel was very honest in his work and made sure to keep me in great hands that care for me rather than the money I might be spending.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Maranatha
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow! This is truly a hidden gem! I took all three of my children and they loved Dr.Patel and Dr.Bednarski! They are great with children and made my nervous 4 yr. old feel very comfortable. She keeps asking if she can go for another cleaning. The doctor's thoroughly  explained every step of the process and educate you on the treatment. The staff are super friendly, something that is rare now. Highly recommend Vida Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Autry
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist I’ve ever been to! The staff and doctor are amazing and make you feel comfortable! They are fast and do great quality work! Doctor explains everything to you very well and answers every questions you may have! I would recommend to anyone looking for a dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dhanish Patel is awesome! He's extremely friendly and professional. He explains everything in detail. I just had my first filling and I was impressed with how smooth it went.  When I first moved to Austin, I had a hard time finding a good dentist. Very happy I found Vida!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennyfer Montes
user_reviews_extended.Description: First off let me start this was my first time being in this dental office and it’s very clean and welcoming. The staff welcomed me and my daughter with such big smiles ! Just the second I got to the counter I got a great vibe from the two ladies that were there at the moment. And other staff just smiling always and very welcoming. I’m glad I changed to this dental office for my daughter ❤️ Simply AWESOME !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elena Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love the atmosphere in the office always with a positive attitude and always going overboard for patients. Dr.Patel and Dr.Bednarski, and Brittany (Hygienist) are wonderful providers that make sure you understand all questions you may have.
If you need a great dental experience then this is the correct office to come to.:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: omar nieto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff great communication system. Loved the appointment reminders. The dentist provided me with a new smile my insurance gave me great coverage.After a long time of not being able to address my dental health I am glad I chose this dental practice as my dental care facility. Thank you Vida Dental south.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Wierzbicki
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys are awesome! I haven't been to the dentist in over 15 years because I was nervous about the whole situation. The doctors, assistants, and office staff are all very caring and want to get to know about you. I'm always greeted warmly whenever I walk into the office, and they're willing to work with my wacky work schedule and payment issues. Overall, I'd say Vida Dental is the best dentist office in Austin! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrian Alva
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m very weary of Dentist Offices. I don’t like being shuffled into a room and trying to be sold on a $500 mouth guard 🙄 or feeling like an opportunity to hit a sales goal.
This place was way different. Dr Dhanish was very welcoming and spent time to talk to me about the process of that days visit and expectations to come.
Sam the hygienist was so professional and didn’t make me feel rushed or self conscious.
The clinic mgr up front and the other front desk girls were amazing. They present a laid back atmosphere and you feel like an actual person. Not a number.
Definitely recommend this place. Glad I found it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexander Kenis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
VISIT 1: Cleaning/X-Rays
Have you ever walked into the dentist and immediately felt like you were stepping into the warmth and familiarity of your own home? When I walked into Vida Dental this morning, I immediately felt the embrace of three bright smiles behind the counter. The entire process was laden happy faces and a very thorough and caring dentist. If you want to completely alter your perspective about what a dentist experience is made of, try out Vida Dental, for you shall certainly discover a new "vida" in your dental process.

VISIT 2
So as if one visit was not enough, I had to try Vida Dental again to make sure it was not too good to be true. Big surprise: I had an even better time  than I did previously. I had to get fillings, and Dr. Graham walked me through every step of the process and heeded any questions or concerns that I had. The doctor and his team were insistent upon hearing my weekend plans;  the doctor's elephant-like memory was able to recall specific details about my life that I shared with him during my previous visit. Vida Dental is the paradigm of where quality meets true customer care. I have never been so enthused about a choice of dentist than I am now with Dr. Graham and his amazing staff.

Simple question: Do you want the best dental service possible?
Simple answer: Call Vida Dental and let them change your life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bradley Crecelius
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dental experience I've had.  Until I visited Dr Sama, I thought all dentists were the same and all dental work was painful and unpleasant.  She showed me how easy, pain free and pleasant dental work can be.  5/5.  I found my new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: S Seth
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family friend recommended me to Vida Dental after she completed total replacement of her teeth with implants and dentures. I myself was told by another dentist several years ago I needed to remove all my teeth but was afraid. Dr.Dhanish was very patient with me, explained the process, and worked with my Finances. The process was pretty scary but the care provided by him and his team was outstanding and in the end, I am very happy with my implants! I look to do the bottom next year with the Vida Dental team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: arthur urias
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome experience.  If you're looking for a new generation dentist who uses the latest technology, this is the place. On top of that, an orthodontist works in their office to help all of their patients to straighten their teeth. The customer service is top-notch  and I love the feel of the office. They will take very good care of you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Dental Lab Specialists
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been working with the Docs at Vida Dental for over 7 yrs. Always a pleasure to collaborate on cosmetic and implant cases with. They are delivering the highest quality for their patients, making our job super easy. If you are looking to get great cosmetic and surgical work done, this is the spot to get it done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashlee Barden
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Erika Ryan and her staff were extremely professional, kind and made me feel really comfortable from start to finish!

I have never been given as much detailed information on how to properly protect and care for my teeth. After trying a few different options in Austin... I’ve definitely found the right spot!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Scheduled an appointment for cleaning and  checkup at Vida recently. I had not been to a dentist in over 5 years so I was a bit nervous. My experience was great! Dr. Bednarski and my dental hygienist were both lovely and helped me form a thorough dental hygiene and care plan. I would reccomend Vida to anyone I know!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gianna Cala-Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love that they didn't write my teeth off as useless and try to sell me $14,000 worth of veneers (I have had a couple of other dentists do this right off the bat!). Instead, Vida told me that I had "beautiful teeth" (a.k.a. strong teeth with improving gum health & favorable soft tissue) while also pointing out the problem areas and what we can do to fix those problems. The staff was incredibly accommodating and friendly; I would definitely recommend Vida to a friend or two!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robbie Cave
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This team is awesome.!  Excellent in every way.  Dr D is a genius.  His partners are as well.  If you want beautiful teeth with a Team well trained and  knowledgeable in such a specific field, you will not be disappointed with this very professional and people centered practice.

From the moment you walk in, you will be graced with a caring friendly staff.  This is a group determined to listen to your desires and communicate well. It is also evident that this is a practice where each staff member is family together.  This is a happy office.

Since this is a group with their own lab and Master Craftsman, this Team excells at working hard to attain as close to complete perfection as possible.  I am amazed at how fantastic this process is and really grateful as a patient.

In this day & time, it is unusual  to bring to the table the outcome wanted and then see it come to life.
I am delighted to have been included at all times as a part of the Team.  The results are even more beautiful and outstanding than I dared to hope for.

Vida Dental Group is exactly who they say they are and they are what every patient hoped for coming in.

I personally have never been more pleased! I have beautiful strong teeth and a fantastic smile for life!

Should our paths cross,  you will be greeted by a bright and beautiful smile!
In my smile of happiness there is huge appreciation for every step in the process that produced my brand new teeth.

Dreams fulfilled is so remarkable!
It just does not get better than that!

Robbie Cave

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kavi Morgan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went for a later appointment due to work, but they welcomed me and made me feel comfortable right away. Everyone is friendly and makes you feel at home. Arthur and Dr. Patel did all the messy work, but they were great. Explained everything and just made it an awesome experience. Super happy I found these guys and I look forward to seeing them again in 6months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Parth Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m getting my braces done and have a quite complicated case. The doctors here are highly knowledgeable and are using cutting edge technology. My case requires implants because I have missing teeth these guys are using 3-D guides to place my implants, and I'm excited and confident that Dr.Dhanish can get it done right. Highly recommend going in, they are really friendly and welcoming to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vishal Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Haven't had a cleaning in years so finally got one at Vida. Probably the best decision I made in 2017. My teeth look great and I had an awesome experience with Dr. Dhanish. He answered all my questions about my cleaning (I ask a lot about medicine just for my own knowledge) and was as thorough as can be. If you need a simple cleaning or something more intense like implants, give 'em a call!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Priya Ghelani
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm such a fan of this place. Dr. Patel offered to fix my permanent retainer at a really low cost (the last time I received an estimate was a few months ago, and that person quoted me at $500!). This is an easy-going, chill office and the secretaries, hygienists, and dentists are really easy to work with. They take most insurances and they always do a great job. Dental cleanings are usually kind of uncomfortable, but here not so much! Also Dr. Patel is really nice and the staff never makes me feel uncomfortable. I am definitely planning to come back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Armin Poorfard
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I did extract my tooth in Vida dental South which was a good experience but they charged the same bill twice. I called them five times within 5 months to get my refund but every time they tell me that someone will call from management  but nobody will call. If you are going to have your dental work here make sure you are checking your payments and bills because  these people will not give you any refunds for overcharging you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karla Monroe

user_reviews_extended.Name: Priya Vij
user_reviews_extended.Description: i hate going to the dentist, but vida dental makes it something i actually look forward to now! the team is welcoming and super knowledgeable. they explain everything thoroughly, and i feel very comfortable in the office. highly recommended and definitely coming back

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katlynn Blakely
user_reviews_extended.Description: So, I had moved to Austin and hadn't gone in to see a dentist in some time. Not only was everybody there at Vida extremely personable, they made sure I was well-informed and comfortable the entire time. Both of the dentists are top-notch and it's clear they truly care about their patients and their staff (want a true measure of a business? look at how they treat their own). If there is such a thing as a pleasant dental experience, lol, you'll find it here. They got me out of pain and back into the holiday spirit - able to enjoy my family and friends for the holidays. There's no doubt they are my dental practice of choice now. I'm so happy I found them! You will be too! :-)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ray O'Hara
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm so happy I found Vida Dental, Dr Patel is a fantastic dentist. They all go out their way there to make you comfortable and have all the latest tech. I've been going here for two years, very satisfied and won't go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: juanita villarreal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience! beginning the moment you walk in the door. The staff is very friendly and courteous. The dentist is so knowledgeable and professional along with the dental assistants. I highly recommend Vida Dental to all my friends and family. !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maryanna Kaighen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience I have ever had! user_reviews_extended.Name: swetha sama
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall great experience from start to finish. The staff and dentist were super friendly, thorough and helpful. The ladies in the front office were great and broke down all of the costs for me and  answered any questions I had. It was a 10/10 experience :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew “C” Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dhanish and Dr. Bednarski are just awesome dentists, and their team is incredible. user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Muniz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was extremely nervous for my root canal and cleaning with my bad habits of neglecting my own teeth , they definitely knew I was nervous and eased every fear from the moment the two women up front greeted me . All of the assistants each also said hello and if I needed anything extra than what they presented me with . My procedure was absolutely painless and I knew step by step what was going on . If anyone is looking for a permanent office to make a home out of with your family and their needs for all ages , I strongly suggest Vida Dental . Doctors Bernardski and Doctor Patel are the way to go. New dentistry has arrived and it's painless and worryfree !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Pendleton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctors Bednarski and Patel are not only dedicated to their craft but also sincerely care about their patients. They are constantly attending courses to improve upon their skills and are so driven to give the Austin community their absolute best. I highly recommend Vida dental to all of your family and friends. All of your dental needs will be well taken care of!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geneva Wacker
user_reviews_extended.Description: First of all, I'm terrified of dentists! I was referred there by a friend and I'm so glad i went! Everyone there was so friendly and really helped calm my nerves! I will definitely be going back every six months. Hands down the best dentist I have been to ever! Dr. Graham was amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: EJ Cub
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff is very friendly and professional here. Hadn't been to the dentist in over a year and wasn't really looking foward to the experience but an aching wisdom tooth forced me in. Dr. Patel is an excellent and thorough dentist, he explained everything before and throughout my procedure which included a few small fillings and a cleaning. Next is the dreaded wisdom teeth that he will be extracting tomorrow. If you need a dentist in South Austin, look no further, Vida dental is top notch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jinny Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Patel is one of the best dentists I have been to.  He is caring, knowledgeable and intentional about making sure the patient feels cared for and safe.  I have been putting off taking my Wisdom teeth out and even though it was a little unpleasant, Dr. Patel made sure that my pain was managed and that I felt safe.
Thank you Vida Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: gamophyte
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Because I needed so much work, backed up for years, I was very nervous about jumping in just anywhere to get it done. By chance this is close by where I live, and with that I started my dental reintroduction here. And boy am I happy I did.

I'm halfway through my overall plan to get up to date, and I wanted to stop to praise this place for the experience so far. Everything has been clear and easy to understand, and the basic check in and check out has been great. Good communicators if anything changes.

Dr. Swetha Sama is amazing, knowledgeable and for all my nervousness, has made great efforts to explain everything and put me to ease.

Brittney, the hygienist, was a rockstar and not at all what I would have expected. She seemed to have a pulse on the latest science in regards to healthy flora.

Speaking of science, they use pretty state of the art tools in my mind. Then again, I've not been to a dentist in years haha. I was amazed.

Everyone's pretty professional for sure, but also human and not stringent in the way I think would have worried me. I'm happy to continue my dental to-do list here for sure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camille Vargas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited the W. William cannon location as a first time patient. The office is great with a very friendly and helpful staff. I usually have a lot of anxiety going to the dentist but Dr. Dhanish did a phenomenal job explaining the different services vida offers and was also thorough but gentle while cleaning my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arathi Shah
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved the kind welcome, smooth flow throughout my visit- given that it was my first time there. Impressed by the succinct treatment plan laid out by Dr Sama!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie B
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience here blew me away, from the industry leading technology, beautiful office, and amazing staff. My hygentist Maxene was informative and gentle. user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Vida Dental deserves a huge shout-out! They greeted me with smiles and made sure I was comfortable from beginning to end. I’ve never been excited to go to the dentist, but now, with the help from the Vida staff, I look forward to my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I just wanted a routine cleaning or scaling done, but they won't even give me the option. They want me to do scaling plus many "adjunctive" services, which would cost $600+ out of pocket. Now I'll have to wait 6 months for my insurance to cover a visit to another dentist office. Believe the reviews about upselling and watch out for the unnecessary "adjunctive" services.

Moral of the story, the ladies at the front desk were very helpful, patient, and nice. They went above and beyond to help me. Based on my short lived experience with them, I'd recommend Vida Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ivonne Saldana
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Doctors and staff are always friendly and welcoming. They take the time to get to know their patient’s needs and explain the work that must be done to improve their smile. I highly recommend coming to Vida Dental.

I'm looking forward to my results and a brighter smile thanks to Vida!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Guy Zehavi

I highly recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place! The staff is exceptionally helpful and friendly. I have not attended the dentist as often as I would have liked but from previous experiences, this doctor (Dr. Graham) made sure I understood everything in the process. I highly recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Craig
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel literally the nicest dentist I’ve encountered in 33 years! I left a voicemail at 1am when the worst tooth pain I’ve ever had hit. No pain at all during procedure and all staff exceptionally friendly. I was allowed payments for what my insurance did not cover, which was a huge plus being that it was an unplanned visit. Thank you so much Vida Dental, I will be visiting this location for all mine and my families dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret Sanger

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kirby Pereira
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Vida Dental was excellent; as a new patient Dr. Patel was very reassuring, and thoroughly explained all the expectations for my visit. So glad to have found a great dental group on my first try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Reetz
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Vida Dental South is amazing. From the first visit the staff has been understanding and has put my child at ease with every visit. Thank you team Vida.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mihir Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dhanish and Dr. Bednarski are some of the best dentist I have seen around. user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place.  Fast, thorough, honest!  I hadn't been to the dentist for over a year due to a bad experience from another dental place. user_reviews_extended.Name: Candace Clemons
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office staff are very friendly and helpful. You are seen right away. They hygienist was gentle and very informative when it came to proper gym health. The drs are both knowledgeable and make you feel very comfortable when speaking about oral health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Weisiger
user_reviews_extended.Description: So on Friday 10/14/16 I had my upper wisdom teeth removed! I was super nervous but the Dr's there made everything go super easy & slow. They did not rush thru the procedure, they took their time & both teeth came out with no problems. I did not feel a thing! And I was not in any pain afterwards. I went home & did not need any pain meds. I was back to normal on Saturday. On Sunday I did have a little soreness on my cheeks but I was able to go back to my normal routine PLUS I was able to eat solid foods just tried to stay with soft foods. I would totally recommend Vida Dental to my family & friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hana Heberlein
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dhanish Patel and his dental assistant, Lisa, gave me an amazing experience. They provided excellent service and truly care about what you need. The team members were also very friendly and welcoming. Recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Minal Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you Vida dental for the 5star service! The front desk was really helpful and friendly. I personally dread going to the dentist but Dr. Dhanish was awesome! He has great bedside manner and made me feel comfortable through  my dental procedure. Thank you Vida Dental and Dr. Dhanish for your wonderful service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall I had a great experience.  From the receptionist, to the Dental Assistant and the Doctor.  All were thorough and made me feel comfortable through the process of a cleaning and filling.  I have found my dentist location here in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Hodges
user_reviews_extended.Description: Vida dental was such a great find for me! The experience was positive and informative from start to finish. I was able to come in early due to a cancelation, and there was virtually no wait to get started once I arrived. I felt the Dr. and his staff were very thorough and efficient and I am I very please with the results of the appt. Would definitely recommend! 5 Stars!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ATX TWillis

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yathin Patil

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rozalynda Sepeda
