The staff was so consider of my needs & treated me not like a person not a patient. They explain all the procedures that I was going to need. Since then I recommended several persons.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Anders
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was sweet and helpful, my dental hygienist was very knowledgeable and helped put my anxiety at ease. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: WC W
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is really top notch! Dr. Patel is both knowledgeable and also careful to NOT suggest undertaking unnecessary and expensive procedures without having first tried more conventional means to alleviate the problem.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariana Matamoros
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love going to Vida Dental ! All the employees are so nice from the receptionist to the assistants everyone is always welcoming asking if I have any questions about my appointment they always help make me feel comfortable during my cleanings and treatment’s.

user_reviews_extended.Name: james ganzer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm in my young 40's now and visited several different dentist locations in my life, but between the relaxing atmosphere, the kindness that all the employee's gave to me and how they informed me on what they were going to do that day and what they suggested in the future.. Will be going there on a permanent basis now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hanna Barakat
user_reviews_extended.Description: Vida Dental has treated me so well over the years! They are thorough and keep it to necessity in stead of loading on services and charges. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Payal Kothari
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Patel is by far the best, and the most professional dental expert I have ever seen. He and his staff are caring, compassionate and very kind. I will never go anywhere else, neither will my family - nor should you, if you're reading this. Dr. Patel is world class in every aspect of what he does. Rarely will you find a doctor that will ONLY do what is best for you and Dr. Patel exemplifies this wonderful principle every day. Words cannot express how special this man and his staff are.
Thank you Dr. patel.

user_reviews_extended.Name: F F
user_reviews_extended.Description: Vida dental is under new management and better than ever! I had a five star experience undergoing some fillings and extractions and I will be returning for a couple implants next year. The oprocedures were explained to me clearly and executed flawlessly. The pain was minimal to none with the topical and injected pain medication. All of my questions were answered and my after care instructions were provided to me along with prescribed medication. I felt good about the experience overall and would return to vida dental for further dental work. It has been almost a week since my extractions and I'm healing up very nicely. I would recommend vida dental to anyone who wants a pleasant dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cyndi Roman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental office I've ever been to. Staff is super awesome and Doctor Graham is amazing. My whole family switched when I told them it was a great atmosphere and everything is explained in detail before they start any procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: donna hornbrook
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If I could give 10 stars - I would for many reasons:
CHECK IN - very friendly smiling faces offering a bottled water or tea/coffee
WAITING PERIOD - not much of a wait at all but while I did wait there was 2 televisions running with a movie on one and a cooking show on the other (very comfortable atmosphere)
REASON FOR VISIT - cleaning and to fill a root canal. The hygienist was very friendly courteous and did a very thorough job. My teeth feel great
FILLING - now this was the part I was a bit apprehensive about. I thought there would be a needle involved to numb the tooth but instead they used a numbing gel the Dr. Explained the process thoroughly and told me each step. Also, I watched a movie in the room (Christmas with the Kranks why not?! Right?!)
They used the most updated technology and each staff member I interacted with was very professional and personable and friendly.

Check them out next time - I bet you’ll feel the same!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Deleon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sama and Nina were so nice and talked me through the whole procedure. I was nervous coming in as a new patient but they made me feel at ease!

I have a very bad dental anxiety and they help me get through that in every way. Dr. Bednarski even spent extra time and care today to give me a filling in a tooth without the numbing medicine due to the fact that I hate the shots the worst. He had to be very careful and truly it's more work for him, however he graciously did it. I could jot be more thankful. From the staff at the front desk to the three gals that took me to the back I really felt very comfortable. Jay was helping Dr B today and she was so kind and understanding. I will be referring everyone I know to this clean, knowledgeable, caring practice. Seriously....I'm picky, I've gone through a few places. Thanks y'all!

I left a VM and sent an email through the website to no avail.
I had to call another dentist office to get out of pain and finish the crown since I cannot get a hold of Vida.
At this point I would give 0 stars but have to give 1.

The dentist actually called to reassure that this power outage happened.
Still not completely happy since I had to go to another practice, but if true then not much they could do.

title: South Austin Dental Associates
address: 4419 Frontier Trail # 104, Austin, TX 78745, United States

user_reviews.Name: Deb Wilson
user_reviews.Description: I had a dental emergency but no dentist in Austin. I feel extremely fortunate to have found South Austin Dental Associates.  Everyone in the practice was kind, welcoming, helpful and good at their jobs.  The office staff worked me in quickly, and then helped with my insurance.  Dental Asst. Heather got me set up and then Dr. Elhosary not only put me at ease while discussing my choices, but then very skillfully handled my situation. I felt very well taken care of both physically and emotionally.  I am happy to now have them as "my" dentist's office and recommend them without reservation.

user_reviews.Name: Eric U
user_reviews.Description:
I can't say enough good things about South Austin Dental. Before finding them, I had visited half a dozen dentists, and none came close to the level of care, professionalism, and genuine compassion I’ve experienced here. My teeth were worn down to nubs, and I was extremely embarrassed about my smile. From the moment I walked in, I knew I was finally in the right place.

Dr. Evan Matthysse, Amy, Roger, and the entire team are absolutely incredible. They treat you like a person, not just a patient. You can tell they truly care about what they do and the people they help. I’m currently wearing temporary arches, and even those are amazing—they’ve already made such a difference in my confidence and appearance.

The quality of work, attention to detail, and kindness I’ve received have all been exceptional. I’m so grateful to have found this team and highly recommend them to anyone who’s looking for top-notch dental care from people who truly care.

user_reviews.Name: J K
user_reviews.Description:
I came here because I was having issues with my teeth from recent dental work done. I refuse to continue with current dentist and needed help.

My initial experience with the front desk was great when making my first appointment. She was personable and empathetic. I was able to get in for a consult quickly.

I consulted with the dentist and he asked if I would like an antibiotic called in and I said yes. The tech took my pharmacy information.

It was a few days later when I had not heard from the pharmacy for pick up that I decided to call to find out what happened. Turns out, it was not called in.

I came here for help and I’ve been through enough with dentists. I’m thankful I was shown right away that this will not be the dentist I am going to for help.

user_reviews.Name: Norma Archibald
user_reviews.Description: I had my first visit today, after my dentist of 37 years retired. I tried two other dentists before finding South Austin Dental Associates. I was impressed with the friendly environment, and the professional staff, who took care of my every need-answered questions, addressed comfort levels (I'm a nervous patient) and had affordable options for necessary dental work. I felt clear about what work was needed and why, and and what to prioritize. user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonia Gongora
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My dentist joined this practice and when I went in for my cleaning, they informed me that my dental x-rays didn't transfer and i needed new x-rays, I let the hygienist know I only wanted my teeth cleaned on this visit, she informed me I would need to talk to the doctor.  Next walked in the office manager telling me it was a state regulation that I needed to have an x-ray since my last x-ray was in 2024.  So, which is it records didn't transfer or is it a state regulation...I left the office immediately.   Texas dental regulations do not explicitly require an X-ray for every cleaning; instead, the American Dental Association (ADA) recommends X-rays only when there is a clear clinical benefit that outweighs the associated risks, based on professional judgment and evidence-based criteria. While Texas law mandates specific X-ray equipment performance evaluations, the decision to take X-rays is a clinical judgment by the dentist. Patient beware.

In response to the SADA (Owner):

1. The records not transferring is YOUR issue not mine.
2. The office manager said it was a state regulation (lie).
3. There was no offer of free x-rays.
4. Good-bye.

I literally couldn’t recognize myself when I smiled it was a nightmare.

Despite going back THREE times to get it fixed, I was repeatedly brushed off with excuses that it was just "new" and would settle. Well, after almost a YEAR, it’s still crooked and looks worse than before. They took my $3,000 and showed zero care or responsibility for doing a proper job.

I went there hoping to feel confident again, but they destroyed my smile and my confidence. This experience has been emotionally painful, and I regret entrusting them with something so important. South Austin Dental Associates failed me completely and I can’t warn people enough to stay away.

I’m only leaving this review because I was asked to, and I’d give this place 3.5 stars if I could. The staff was friendly and the cleaning was okay overall, but I’m knocking off points because they clearly don’t respect people’s time.

I booked a new patient appointment for 3:30pm, which was supposed to be 1.5 hours and include X-rays, an exam, and a cleaning. I even confirmed the day before that the cleaning was included. When I got there, the X-rays and exam dragged on way longer than they ever have at my previous dentist in IL.

By the time the X-rays were finally done (at 4:27pm), the hygienist told me she didn’t have time to do the cleaning because they close at 5pm. That made no sense—I was booked until 5, so why even offer new patient appointments at 3:30 if they can’t follow through? I had childcare lined up and chose this time specifically so I could get everything done in one visit. After I expressed my frustration, she went ahead with the cleaning, which was done by 4:57, and I was out the door by 5:05. So… what was the issue?

Bottom line: the cleaning was fine (not amazing because my previous dentist’s office used the Airflow technology which is a lot less aggressive) and the staff was nice, but I wouldn’t count on them being efficient.

user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone who is HIGHLY dental phobic, I can sincerely say that this dental practice is the absolute best.  Dr. Evan is so amazing!! They have actually changed my perspectives and for me to say that I am looking forward to coming back for next appointment, is nothing short of a miracle.  Please don't hesitate in coming here.  They are truly not like the rest.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Platt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience in a long time! Friendly staff and Kaylie was  Amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerry Mills
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone, from receptionists to Dr. Matthysse, are friendly and professional!  Since I left the military in 1985, I have never been to any other dental facility. Dr. Butcher was great!  Dr. M and his staff have continued that tradition, even made it better!  Only the best and most modern equipment and procedures. Thank you Evan. You are the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Dappen
user_reviews_extended.Description: South Austin Dental Associates has taken care of my dental needs for more than a year now. All good people! I appreciate their expertise and excellent patient service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailey R McKernan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff, great comprehensive care, and clean facilities! I don’t normally leave reviews but have found it hard to find a solid dentist practice near me. Will be recommending to family/friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terri Barton
user_reviews_extended.Description: After moving to Austin, Texas, I had to find a new dentist. After some online research, I made an appointment with South Austin Dental. I’m glad I did!  The entire staff is so friendly. My hygienist, Patty was so professional and caring! Dr. E took his time and answered all my questions. I am so pleased I landed with a great dental practice. Dr. E even said, “Welcome to the practice!” Love it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alfredo Carmona Jr (Al)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love going to South Austin Dental Associates! The front desk staff and everyone behind the scenes are great. I started going there with Mari as my hygienist, but since she's left, I now see Susan, who is amazing. I definitely recommend SADA if you're looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Witherspoon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really love this place! I love walking into a place that instantly feels like home! My appt was with Susan (Hygienist) and she did an excellent job. Dr Matthysse is so friendly and takes the time to explain things so thoroughly and I appreciate that. 10/10 would recommend this to everyone..needle in a haystack and checked all my boxes on my first visit!! Congrats..FOUND MY DENTIST!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Wilkinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is fantastic! I chipped my front tooth and there was no way I was walking around that way, so I called the office and Alaina got me an appointment immediately! She squeezed me in right away! Thank GOD for her! When I got to the office everyone made me feel warm and welcome, which doesn’t usually happen at dentist offices. And nobody made me feel insecure about my teeth. Once we went over a plan, Madison went over the finances and she was awesome at helping find the right plan for me! She’s a doll! Then Dr. E came in and went to work. I’m always nervous with dental work (bad past experience) he made me feel completely at ease and I’m SO impressed with how great he fixed my cracked tooth! It looks better than before! For once I actually “enjoyed” a dentist visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy Kinnison
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Matthysse is the absolute greatest. Not only is he a very well trained Dentist, he and his staff go above and beyond for their patients. We are so grateful for the entire team to quickly work my daughter into their busy schedule when she chipped her front tooth. Our family highly recommends South Austin Dental Associates.
Randy K.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Bushnell
user_reviews_extended.Description: South Austin Dental was the first place I called and luckily it was the right place! When I started this journey I was deathly afraid of what I was facing but the time had come that I couldn’t put it off anymore. Thankfully the staff explained everything in detail and made me feel so much more comfortable. I have to say Roger is an artist and did an amazing job on my finals and will forever be grateful. I know he bent over backwards to make me happy and I appreciate it so much! This was a major change in my life that was causing a lot of anxiety but I couldn’t be happier with the final results and I would recommend it to anyone who needs it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobbie Juarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome staff!  Very thorough and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alaina Fletcher
user_reviews_extended.Description: Karina cleaned my teeth and she was real thorough and delicate. She also gave me some helpful tips to keeps my gums healthy. I met Dr. She’s for the first time and he was  easy to talk to, very knowledgeable and took his time with me. Front office ladies were really nice and welcoming as usual. Everyone works well together and is super friendly and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan Diaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional and friendly.  This is my first visit and it is my hope to excellent results soon!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Xandria Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a new patient, my experience at South Austin Dental Associates was exceptional from start to finish. From collecting my insurance information to devising a care plan, every staff member I encountered was incredibly helpful, transparent, and knowledgeable. I came in for an emergency visit in pain, and left feeling so much better. I couldn’t thank them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Hamel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best Experience! My permanent retainer broke and they were able to get me in quickly. Everyone was really friendly. Both the doctor and his assistant,Amy, took very good care of me. I was in and out in less than an hour.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellen Kallman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m very happy with South Austin Dental Associates.  The hygienist does an amazing job & the ladies in the office are always very friendly & helpful.  Dr. Shea has treated me with the respect & consideration that makes me feel like he truly cares that I’m happy with every detail of his work, and I am!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Florence F
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Evan Matthysse has been my dentist, I believe, at least 5 years now. I started seeing him since my previous dentist retired who at that time strongly recommended Dr. Matthysse. I see him every 6 months and he has proven to be as outstanding a dentist as I understood that he would be from my previous dentist. My late husband went to him as well and really liked him. His dentistry skills are excellent. I have never had a complaint about him. He put us at ease immediately. He has a great sense of humor. He’s kind, professional and very skilled at his work. I find him clearly as a 5* dentist. I went on line and noted that he has won at least one award for his excellency. I will see Dr. Matthysse for the remainder of my life as I trust him and personally I oily go to A+ doctors. I am a retired nurse and am very particular about my doctors.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ross Schumann
user_reviews_extended.Description: My Dental Hygienist did a great job. She deserves a lot of credit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: dororthy gorecki
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been to many dentists in my life and Dr Matthiasse is really good.  Super knowledgeable conscientious.  Was recommended to me by a friend and would him to anyone looking for a dentist. His staff if great too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ernesto Prado
user_reviews_extended.Description:
South Austin Dental is unbelievable. Everyone there, Dr Matysse is great. Roger is the best. His attention to Detail is unparalleled. My only regret is that I didn't know about them sooner. They make everything painless. I'm thankful for them and their entire staff.

E.P.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary Dunivan
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at South Austin Dental Associates was top notch!  I had the best cleaning I’ve ever had with Susan and a great experience with Dr Matthysse and Melissa.  They truly know how to alleviate your dental fears.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karla Bahena
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Matthysse and his employees are top notch! I recently got some fillings and the process was smooth. The team made sure I was taken care of and eased my anxiety! Would recommend to anyone especially my friends and family:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: yazmin melero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super sweet people and great service! I am cery happy with my services!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gary Pfeffer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my first visit to the office and was amazed at how quick and efficient everything was during the whole process.  All of the staff was friendly and the hygienist Chelsea was very good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristina Coro
user_reviews_extended.Description: So far, so good after my first visit. Was not happy with previous dentist due to the fact that I felt they were trying to just get money out of me by telling me I needed work done that wasn't necessary. Did quite a bit of research online and decided to go with SADA. Front desk staff: very friendly and accommodating when I couldn't find my insurance card. Veronica, my dental hygienist was also very friendly and gentle, answered many of my questions, didn't pressure me to get any extra treatments or advise me to have any extra work done. Dr. E was super friendly, informative, laid back and made me feel very comfortable. Again, no pressure to have me get any extra work right away - showed me an image of a tooth he says he will keep an eye on but assured me it could be done a little later, which I appreciated. The facilities were state of the art - more up to date than my previous dentist and they took my insurance (Delta dental). Over all a very good experience. Very happy to have found a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been in search of a new dentist and haven’t had the best luck finding one that I trusted and liked. I saw this location had great reviews online and decided to give it a shot. Im so glad I did. The office was clean and organized. This was a great first impression. Then Susan welcomed me in and I was immediately impressed again at how attentive, kind, welcoming, and thorough she was with my cleaning. I think Susan excels at what she does and I can tell she takes pride in her work. I absolutely appreciated this extra level of care and attention during my routine cleaning. Dr. C was great and made me feel welcome as a new patient as well. I’ve found my new dentist! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Barraco
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to South Austin Dental for 8 years.    The techs and Doctor E are fantastic.   I have had a lot of work done because I love sweets.    I always feel welcome and taken care of.   I never wait long for my appointment and thoroughly enjoy the interaction with the whole crew.   They send me appointment reminders and process my insurance when applicable.   I would recommend them to anyone.   Kristi, Cindy, and Susan are the best.   👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Solomon
user_reviews_extended.Description: The most thorough cleaning I've ever had done by Karina, Dr. Matthysse was very down to earth and knowledgeable, everyone was extremely friendly from the hygienists to the receptionists and worked to get me fit in and scheduled. I was also very impressed by the technology used for 3D pictures and the cleaning tools used. I appreciate that they have individual membership type plans for those who don't have dental health insurance and a new patient special, and found the prices to be very reasonable. Finding a good dentists can be intimidating so I'm thankful to have found this spot.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Rich
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Doctors and Staff! Our whole family goes here as well as extended family and have always had a great experience. Both doctors have great chair side manners, and coming from someone that has high anxiety from previous dental experiences that’s saying a lot. I always feel at easy going to South Austin Dental Associates!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma Archibald
user_reviews_extended.Description: Courteous staff, comfortable environment, professional and skilled doctors and hygienists, friendly atmosphere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Albertson
user_reviews_extended.Description: South Austin Dental has been my dentist spot for over 10 years when Dr. Butcher led the practice. I now see Dr. E and he’s awesome. The transition was seamless, making appointments are easy, everyone is personable and kind. I’ve had a considerate amount of complicated dental work done. Dr. E is super smart, thoughtful & thorough and considerate. He’s made some fantastic updates to the office and technology of the practice. I’d highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsie Macray
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mattheist is awesome- knowledgeable and down to earth. I always feel like my teeth are in good hands and getting accurate updates and what they need with great photos and detailed X-rays on why. The office is a little old school but the equipment is cutting edge and top of the line. The hygienists and staff are great too, super consistent and friendly over the last few years I’ve been going. The Dental hygienists I’ve seen are thorough and really experienced which I feel like is something you don’t always get.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Susannah Frost
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office was fantastic when it was run by Dr. Butcher. The new dentist, Dr. Matthysse, seems more interested in upselling unnecessary treatments, including teeth whitening, fluoride, and a new laser treatment for cleaning to add an additional charge to your cleaning. His office will also pressure you to get X-rays every year, even when you have healthy teeth, so they can charge you. This is not medically necessary when you have healthy teeth. His office will also recommend that you get cleanings every 5 months instead of every 6 months, which is the standard of care. In short, this office appears to care more about profit than about applying the appropriate standard of care to the patient in front of them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelli Fogle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The entire staff is marvelous!
My family feels blessed to find a Dental office that makes us all feel comfortable and safe.
I have a 92 year old Dad that is going through several different dental treatments.
They treat him with the utmost respect.
And make sure he and I understand what is important for his health and recovery.
I can’t express enough how much we love this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Greene
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Evan Matthysse and his staff are absolutely wonderful. They are prompt in the service; happy, pleasant, and professional in their actions; and most of all, they make you feel comfortable and at home during services that typically aren't described like that. The work they did on my teeth was wonderful. Everyone was very personable. They were always eager to set up appointments that fit my schedule. I cannot recommend them more and made me love going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Kirk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Karina was by far the best dental hygienist I’ve ever experienced. She has a gentle and quick hand and was very caring and would routinely check to see how I was doing, although I was doing just great the whole time. Dr. Chelkowski was warm and upbeat, and extremely accessible to patients by offering his cell phone for dental emergencies. The front desk & check out staff were friendly and helpful, and the office has what seems to be the latest dental technology although the office itself is quaint and sweet. This was my first visit and I was very happy with my experience. I think I’ve found “my dentist” here in Austin finally.

user_reviews_extended.Name: S B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent and professional dental care from Doctor Evan Matthysse,I came with a big dental concern, and after I arrived was checked inn immediately, the front desk and all the team were very friendly. Doctor  Matthysse took his time and expertise to explain me step by step all about my dental concerns, I feel relief after that.
To set my appointment was easy and the person over the phone worked with me at my best convenient time,thanks.
My first visit and Xray was complementary, I really appreciate, thank you and I will see you soon
S.B

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Selvera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love love South Austin Dental and Associates. From my very first visit I felt at home there!  I love Dr. Matthysse!  He has great bed side manners. He is easy to talk with and a great sense of humor. I can’t say enough about Susan the hygienist. She is amazing and really takes time to do a thorough job cleaning my teeth. They are all so friendly. I totally recommend South Austin Dental and Associates!

user_reviews_extended.Name: The Helpers- The Good Ones
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is great. The dentists are attentive, they’re helpful. I’ve been coming here for years. Everyone is so nice, they work with you on credit issues and are always willing to help. I’m really grateful they’ve been my dentist for many years. They fixed two cavities and have taken good care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Silberman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Grateful to have found this office. Dr. Matthysse along with the many techs and office staff are kind and thorough. Scheduling has been a breeze and the reminders they send are very helpful. My fillings and crowns are holding strong and while I don’t enjoy dental work, this office makes it easy and as enjoyable as a dentist visit can get. Thanks y’all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret Schwarz (Peggy)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is the place for me and I have issues with past dental providers. Every person in the office made me feel more at ease and comfortable. Explained everything.  Patient with me. This is where I have decided to have some work done on my teeth.
P.S. - back again and I love these people here! I noticed that my dental anxiety is gone. I am relaxed here. I trust there people.
If only there were more stars to give in this review.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Leonard
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love my hygienist and I always feel safe and comfortable there.  Dr. C is always upfront and honest and doesn’t try to tell me I need dental work that is unnecessary. They notate teeth  as ones to watch for the next visit.  Easy with scheduling and insurance, too!
Dr. E is great too!! And the other new staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: lauren s
user_reviews_extended.Description: For someone who has a lot of anxiety around dentist visits, this was the best dental experience I've had in 10 years! The staff are so warm and friendly. Karina is hands down the best dental hygienist ive ever had - her bedside manner is wonderful and she is so gentle in her work. Dr. C is so personable and really makes you feel like you're a part of the family even on a first time visit! Highly recommend this practice!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darryll Knight
user_reviews_extended.Description: Another great visit to the Dentist office thanks to Susan! She is most certainly one of the best Dental Hygienists I've known.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shirley Arredondo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough good things about south Austin dental crew!! They are the best!They have treated me with nothing but love and respect and honesty since day 1..... Thank you guys sooo much! See y'all soon! 🥰❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: lbesher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I needed a second opinion after being tortured and overcharged (long story) by the one my insurance covers, they worked me in when I took my mom in for her appt. Gave me some honest answers and advice regarding what my dentist in Missouri did (not my dentist much longer, if ever!)
Staff does their best to be professional while very personable and that was my experience today.
Dr. Evan is the only dentist in ages I haven't been terrified of which at my age (50's) may sound silly but I don't care, I'm speaking the truth.
He & his staff help me mentally and physically with my dental fears, much appreciated!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shedrack Okojie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Evan @ South Austin Dental Associate is a wonderful doctor! He is a great clinician. I highly recommend him to carry out your surgical needs - especially implants and full mouth restoration.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr E and EVERYONE here are so fun and friendly! This office is very well staffed, as well as welcoming. The dentures (upper only) that they did for my dad today look great. My dad is happy that we came here. They also have very good prices and up to date technology!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica Azios
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great, friendly staff that are helpful and easy to work with. They did a very thorough, amazing teeth cleaning that was pain free. The dentist is very nice and personable, he knows what he’s doing and clearly enjoys and takes pride in his work. The dental office is  organized, efficient, and easy to communicate with. I’m glad this place was recommended to me. After very bad experiences at two different Brident locations in Austin I’m definitely sticking with this dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chantal Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: AMAZING experience with Melissa! She was so friendly and very helpful.  Very knowledgeable young lady. It's so hard these days to find places that have such friendly staff!! I highly recommend coming here.  They put you at ease and make you feel very comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Francine Swift
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome staff,  goes above and beyond to satisfy their clients.  Very professional service. Would recommend to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny DeMarco
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going here for 10 + years and really enjoy this small practice. I am greeted like an old friend. They do great work and its just a nice experience overall. We had a change over in dentist, Dr. Butcher retired and Dr. Mathysee bought the practice. It's been a pleasure seeing his passion for bringing in new technology and pushing the practice forward into its next chapter. Highly recommend. Also they run the practice like a tight ship and they are never behind in appointments which, as a business owner and mom, I value my time not being wasted waiting in a waiting rooms.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Vanleeuwen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient for about 25 years and have been very happy. Dr. Evan Matthysse took over from retiring Dr. Butcher some time ago and transition was very smooth. Very pleased that Dr. Matthysse is modernizing and improving practice. Dr. Matthysse and his staff are quite skillful and very nice to work with. I don’t have dental insurance, but rates are quite reasonable. I’d highly recommend South Austin Dental Associates to anyone looking for a great dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: C. Marrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly people, quick reliable service. Comfortable experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Beyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a newer patient but I am impressed with the friendliness of the office staff, dental hygienists and dentist. They are also very knowledgeable and the technology they use is top notch! I would recommend South Austin Dental Associates to anyone wanting quality care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob Frazer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was pleasant and helpful.  I was able to have an appointment scheduled the same day as a new patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this practice for over 10 years. The staff is wonderful and Dr C is wonderful as well. The hygienist does a great job and is the sweetest person. Mona who is Dr C's assistant is great as well as the appointment person Yvette. I would recommend this practice to anyone who wants a really good dentist and staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cat Hyland
user_reviews_extended.Description: Caring, knowledgeable, experienced multi-talented staff! I feel  Confident that my dental needs are being met by Dr. Matisse, by Roger,  by Amy, by the whole crew. Visit South Austin Dental Associates if you want to have a first class experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: RosieRe RosieRe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Katrina did a great job cleaning my teeth & explaining things as I asked questions. Dr. Matthysse & staff are all wonderful & very knowledgeable. Cindy at the front desk was helpful in setting up next appointment. The restroom & waiting room were clean & had a new paint job & furniture, everything looks great.  I highly recommend this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tristan Sauvageau
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am not exaggerating when I tell you that I am TERRIFIED of the dentist. Yet today was the first time in ANY medical office that a pressure cuff was removed and I was normal. The staff is incredibly friendly… from the assistants and hygienists to the receptionists to Dr. E himself. AMAZING. I was literally in and out and left feeling confident that I was well looked after.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Modesto robles
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is very cordial, caring and professional. I've been a client for years and have nothing to say but good things. I would refer SADA to all my friends, because of the service I've experienced during all my visits. Good job South Austin Dental Associates, you're at the top of my list.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alfredo Carmona Jr (Al)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always enjoy my visits to South Austin Dental Associates. Friendly, knowledgeable staff, and very responsive to communications. Definitely recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shea Hancock
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time here and also my first time at the dentist in years! I got no judgements from them. They were so kind! The dental hygienist was amazing, fast but not rushed, and so sweet. I will be back after my specialist visit and I’ll be sending my husband as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ernest Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time patient and the staff was great, I had oral surgery somewhere else and was getting the run around from them, the staff at South Austin Dental figured everything out for me by doing all the leg work. I am happy I found this place. I will be going back for dental work in the future. I recommend this place!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casey Wong
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team were excellent to deal with. I got a root canal done by Dr. Matthysse that was a close to pain free experience as you can get when at the dentist.  I have had no issue with it. Dr. Matthysse was great at setting the expectations making the experience much better than I thought.  Needed multiple visits and every time it was a great experience.  I recommend this place to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norm Ballinger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Coming in as a new patient to a dental office, there's often a degree of uncertainty. The staff at South Austin Dental was very good communicating leading up to the appointment. When I got there I was met by Susan the hygienist whom I found to be very experienced and efficient. Dr C answered my questions and concerns. I feel very good about my first visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gary Saucedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was super friendly and treated me well. It made me feel like family .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tommy Dean
user_reviews_extended.Description: This incredible clinic has it all - really smart staff with decades of first class service between them,  plus the very latest in technological advances, which absolutely knocked my socks off.  But best of all?  They’re about the nicest bunch of people you’ll ever meet!  Seriously - I just had my first appointment and I know now without a doubt - this is MY dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meera Hoffman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The original dentists associated with this practice and its stellar reviews are no longer with there. When Dr Chekowski left there wasn't any notification of his retirement / departure. When asked why I wasn't informed they said they mailed me a letter, but who knows, I never got it. I had an appt for a filling closer to the end of the day (that I had been waiting 6 months for so my insurance could renew and cover it).  They let me know that unfortunately Dr Matisse (the new dentist) was booked and unable to perform the procedure. Then at check out I see him joking around with the other staff members, so I guess he could have seen me but didn't want to work a few extra minutes? When Dr C was there he would work late to ensure all the appts were completed and gave out his cell if you ever had an urgent need after hours (now the clinic number just hangs up with no option to leave a VM if it's after hours)

When I had seen the new dentist (Dr Matisse) during one of Dr Cs vacations, he immediately started recommending a lot of pricey services that I didn't need. Seems like the quality and true care for patients apparently isn't the primary focus anymore, so I've moved on and would caution others to be wary as well.

Only silver light is Karina the hygienist. She's always been sweet and kind, and was one of the best. Will be sad to not been seen by her anymore but won't risk a 3rd miss by the new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: So far my experience has been great.  The Dr and Staff are very professional and they have worked with my finances to help me get the dental work I need.  I would recommend SADA to anyone needing dental work.  They've made me feel comfortable during my visits and I actually look forward to my appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Happ
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is absolutely amazing. I've always had anxiety about the dentist so I avoid going when I can. The staff, from the front desk to the hygienists,  took such good care of me, explaining everything they would be doing for my regular cleaning, deep cleaning, and cavity fillings. I felt so relieved knowing that they cared about my comfort and would be taking great care of me! Will definitely be continuing to visit this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devin Dang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly highly recommend visiting the awesome staff here!! Evan recently took over and has done a great job with improving the place from the new renovation to top of the line equipment. I generally have resistance to coming to the dentist but Susan the hygienist and Dr.Matthysse made it an easy and comfortable process. I’ll definitely be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Antonio Bermudez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office staff is courteous, professional, and their service is second to none. Dentistry, from cleanings, to injections, to crowns, is relatively painless and my visits are not only pleasant, but enjoyable -- I've been known to laugh during injections. I have been a South Austin Dental Associates patient since 1996, first with Dr. Butcher (retired), and now with Dr. Evan Matthysse. South Austin Dental Associates -- simply the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Hansen
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a great office!  The hygienist was extremely thorough yet gentle.  I'm not sure if I've ever had a better cleaning in my entire life.  Dr. E took the time to explain everything to me and seems to really care about the well being of his patients.   Great experience front to back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Elderbaum
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where one dentist office in town failed, this one picked up their slack and did the job I asked for! Thank you. Recommended to my partner, and they made an appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriella Valdez
user_reviews_extended.Description: South Dental Associates has A fantastic staff! Especially Cindy, who is very kind when helping me schedule my appointments! Everyone who has helped me here is always Professional and Welcoming! I highly recommend coming here if your searching for quality treatments and dental work!  Dr. Matthysse and his excellent staff truly make you feel right at home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient of Dr. C's for many years.  Would not go anywhere else.  I had a problem, called his office and he and his staff saw me immediately.  He is very caring and will listen to what you have to say.  Dr. Chelkowski will discuss the treatment plan and you always feel like you have a say on the when and how the plan will proceed.  I highly recommend him and his staff if you need a dentist in Austin.

Thanks Dr C for all you have done for me.
b

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabrina Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was more than happy to answer my questions and do as much as they could to help me with my dental care. The office is small but very nice and cozy. I felt comfortable and valued at south austin dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wayne Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff are friendly and efficient, and Dr. K. provides great care. The office location is also very convenient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phyllis Howard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am impressed with Dr. M and his work. I have been coming to the dental clinic since the late ‘80’s and I am impressed on the improvements he has made in bringing it into the the 21st century. His staff is always courteous and respectful, which is always appreciated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Morris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I like my dentist Dr Chelkowsi. He is so personable. He diagnosed several medical diagnoses before I or my physician noted. He is very professional and polite.
His dental assistant Mona is great. She is very knowledgeable and considerate.
Yvette is great with my billings and knowledgeable.
Everyone is  relaxed and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Being my first visit there i would say   it was very welcoming. In my case  I was in and out in about an hr.. Doctor and his assistant along with the staff I interacted with as I'm sure to the rest of the staff were great they helped make things as easy as possible..

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Floyd
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been going to South Austin Dental Associates for about 10 years. Dr. Chelkowski’s hygienist Karina is the best! She has a  very gentle touch and is super sweet. I’ve never had to wait more than a couple minutes to be taken back to the exam room or to see Dr. C after Karina is finished with the cleaning. Fortunately for me, I haven’t had to have any major dental work, but Dr. C has fitted me for a night guard, and it came out really good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: william clements
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Doctors and staff at South Austin Dental Associates are amazing.  They make you feel like family and they know who I am.  There work is superior and thorough.  My family and I have been treated by them for over 10 years and I wouldn’t go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Bernal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Warm, welcoming and attending staff, from the front office to the hygienist and assistant and doctor! So glad to have found this dental office !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bhavik Makwana
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent care by Dr Matthysse, Dr Shea , Roger, Jack , Sophie and all the team members. Super impressed with attention to detail and customer service .. 10/10 !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Regina Kavanagh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff-friendly and knowledgeable.  Gave me good advice on taking care of my teeth!  Met one of the new docs-very nice.  Will miss Dr. Matthysse though🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Chelkowski has been my dentist for decades. He’s always recommended the correct and best treatment. And now I have a new, beautiful smile thanks to his amazing “cosmetic” work. I love his long term staff too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Rangel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient there for over 30 years. I’ve always had a good experience. The staff is super nice and always been pleasant. The Dr.’s are very caring and gentle. Can’t wait for my next cleaning. Very professional too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miriam Quast
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First let me say how much I despise going to the dentist. We called our dentist “the crusher”.

Recently went to this practice and loved my experience.  The office has such a welcoming environment. The dentist was so terrific.  Good sense of humor. Cares about his patients. And most importantly very gentle. Explained everything and was very thorough.

Would definitely go back there with any fears. Highly recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ruth Libbey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Both my husband Carl and I have great words for Dr Chelkowski's dental hygienist Karina.  She is gentle and thorough.  Teeth feel so smooth after.  She watches for gum health while checking your teeth for decay to stop any gingivitis.  Great job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janice Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. C has been caring for my teeth for over ten years. He is gentle, thorough, and, frankly, the best dentist I have ever had. He and his entire staff treat you like family and go out of their way to insure that your mouth is healthy and you are happy. They’re all terrific.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Matthysse is the only Dentist I currently trust. He is very knowledgable and has demonstrated excellent clinical skills on multiple occasions. He has taken care of various emergency situations and fixed treatment that was done by other providers. Cannot thank him enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherri Serna
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to South Austin Dental Associates for several years and have always gotten Excellent personalized care. Dr Evan Matthysse has participated in Dental Mission trips to Mexico and displays the same compassion for his patients in Austin. If you’re looking for a dentist with a great personality and expertise in new techniques and innovative dentistry, I highly recommend “Dr. Evan” - you won’t be disappointed in him or the rest of the Awesome staff! 😃

user_reviews_extended.Name: Resolute Media
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was looking for a great dentist near my home and because of t friends who have come here, I am now a patient. All the staff were so friendly, the cleaning was gentle and stress free and Dr. Evan Matthysse only suggested what I needed for future procedures and wasn't trying to upsell me. Can't wait for my next appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristina Coro-Dickson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Matysse and his staff are very friendly. I never feel pressured to have anything extra done that isn’t necessary or urgent so I always feel comfortable knowing I’m going in to have done only what I planned on. Dr. Matysse has a kind and laidback bedside manner and the front office staff are helpful. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daisy Quinonez-Allwood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Evan Matthysse And his staff were  very warm and welcoming. The Doctor took his time to explain the treatment plan that he put together for me. He was empathetic and patient. I will definitely be returning for future work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Powell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to Dr. Chelkowski and his Dental Assistant, Karina, for over 7 years, and they are fantastic. In fact, I've continued going even after I stopped working nearby and I live very far away, but the trek is worth it because I value trust them so much. In the past, I had a DIFFERENT dentist who sold braces in his office recommend that I *needed* braces medically, and I was skeptical and found later dentists never even mentioned it. I've never felt like Dr. Chelkowski was trying to upsell me on something that wasn't necessary. It's clear how much Dr. Chelkowski and Karina genuinely care about their patients. I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy valdez-gainer
user_reviews_extended.Description: South Austin Dental Associates is wonderful. I’ve been a patient of Dr. Chelkowski for 29 years. Everyone in the office is friendly and welcoming. I drive in from San Marcos because I couldn’t dream of finding a better dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Merideth
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called for an abscessed tooth that has been bothering me pretty badly.  After calling around to multiple places and being turned away due to availability.  I called South Austin Dental and Alina was able to fit me into their tight schedule so that they could get the initial visit out of the way and get me on something to help with the infection and pain.  Upon arriving I was greatest warmly by Alina and the anxiety of being at a dentist started to wash away.  I didn't have to wait very long at all before the Dental Hygienist Susan called me to the back.  She too was very kind and gentle and helped me to get my teeth selfies taken.  Initially I had come in looking just to get the bad tooth pulled and the infection gone but after my experience I decided to become a new patient instead.  Thank you South Austin Dental you and your staff are Amazing!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: laurie ronk
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit to South Austin Dental Associates made me feel at ease. Susan did a great job with my cleaning! I felt heard and cared for by all the staff. Thank you so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy McCormick
user_reviews_extended.Description: The only Dentist in Austin that could fix my teeth. They were a  Train Wreck, they have always made time for me if something happened and I needed a repairs. Amy and Roger are Awesome 😎

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy David
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my wisdom tooth out - it was typical and no complications, but he did a great job pulling it in such a way that I hardly had any swelling post-procedure. Good place to get that taken care of.

user_reviews_extended.Name: GOLFTEC Austin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The previous reviews appear to be the same angry man posting twice and probably couldn't ever be made happy with anything.
My mother in law, my wife, and myself have been coming here for 30 years.  My kids for 12 years.  They do great work and are VERY competent in all phases of dentistry including insurance.  I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Greig
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so glad to have found Dr. Matthysse. He is incredibly knowledgeable and a gifted dentist. Most importantly for me, Dr. Matthysse spends the time I need to understand the options available to me for the best dental care. South Austin Dental Associates also accepts every insurance I’ve ever had…that’s hard to find nowadays in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Spears
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently moved to Austin and was happy to find this office. Evan Matthysse DDS recently joined the practice and is making changes to make the office more tech focused. I got my teeth cleaned and they have never been cleaner. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Burkhalter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone associated with this practice  puts the patient first. Dr. Matthysse even met me for on consult on his day off! I can't say enough about the kind, compassionate professionals who will go the extra mile to take excellent care of all your dental problems.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry Key
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always good, professional service. Susan is an excellent and caring hygienist, Cristina is very helpful at the front desk.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reese Nickerson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Susan did a great job with my cleaning, was very gentle. this was my first dentist since moving to Austin recently and I will definitely be back. Dr. Matthysse was very pleasant when i met him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim Tucker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was very professional and friendly.  Going through a couple of tooth implants.  Still more follow up and work to be done but all went well today.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Minor
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to this dentist office about four years now. I am very pleased with the care. The hygienist is gentle doesn’t poke at my gums until they bleed and she’s very pleasant.
Taz Explained every step very well as I was getting a crown replaced, very kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Canava
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love my dentist office! My hygienist Karina does a wonderful job and is always informative. Dr. C and his staff are the best, I feel confident in my dental care every time I go in for an exam.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Capasso
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. M is a gem! I am usually skeptical about dentists saying "you have a cavity" and always doing more work than what needs to be done, but he didn't do that. He was very honest with procedures I would need done over the next year and worked with me on what was most important to address versus saying "we have to do it all now". His openness and honesty were so refreshing, so happy I found my dentist!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victor Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description: For the longest time ( years!!!) I have kept myself away from a dentists office because of previous bad experiences. After finding SADA I can say my outlook on the dentist has changed dramatically. Thanks to the amazing staff I am now comfortable with going to the dentist regularly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Chestnut
user_reviews_extended.Description: Susan is the most thorough hygienist I have experienced in over 20 years! She’s also very caring and professional. Also, Dr. Evan and staff are always very friendly and I feel like one of the family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a decades long fear of coming near a dentist office but the friendly smiles, professional treatment and great work done at South Austin Dental Associates took all the pain away and transported it into a beautiful smile for me! Thank you everyone at South Austin Dental Associates but especially Dr Evan Matthysse for restoring my faith in the dental profession and my smile!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Perna
user_reviews_extended.Description: I know a thing or two about dental care, so I know Dr. Matthysse and his wonderful staff provide truly excellent service.  He takes pride in his treatment and has a gentle hand.  He's an honest Doc who explains what he is doing and executes it well.  I highly recommend Dr. Matthysse for you and your family's dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alma Medina
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient for over 20 years. They provide quality service in a  friendly way. The current dental hygienist, Karina, shows that she cares, gives at-home care directions and explains in-office procedures with clarity. Yvette, who is at the desk, handles transactions with professionalism and friendliness.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Duran
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were able to get me in quick, took X-rays immediately. As I had a very bad tooth infection. They were also able to set me up with an oral surgeon appointment the same day to have the tooth extracted. As it was an emergency and couldn’t wait any longer. All around great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Besher
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Matthysse and his staff saw me promptly to resolve intense, ongoing pain I'd had for 3 weeks resulting in the need for a root canal/crown. They all went above and beyond to accommodate me for my issues. To say I'm extremely appreciative for that is a huge understatement!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Vanderpool
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow! Can't say enough about this practice.  From my first call to getting my missing tooth replaced with a dental implant, Dr Evan and his team made the entire process seamless.  The vibe at this practice is non-judgey, but comprehensive at the same time.  Definitely a hard balance to strike when talking about a dental practice.  I'm looking forward to many more years of care at South Austin Dental Associates!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori Kruczek
user_reviews_extended.Description: The hygenist, Susan,  is always super thorough and patient. I am happy to be her cleaning patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: avery Mclaurin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Been going here since i was a kid!
And
I have gone NOWHERE else...
Always had problems with my teeth and im happy to give them all my money.
On a real note Dr. Chekowski is the absolute best. He does everything to make a sometimes hard and painful experience as easy, non painful and manageable as he possibly can.
From laughing gas, to heating up the needle under warm water before numbing you up. To just always being there.
Over 15 years i wouldnt and wont go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abu Faisal Hasme
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited South Austin Dental. This is the BEST dental experience I have had! Dr. M immediately put me at ease. He is caring, extremely knowledgeable, such a positive energy! I recommended Dr. M to all my friends in Austin area! I would  him give six stars if it was possible!😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robin Sirles
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been seeing Dr. C for many years. Love how he genuinely cares for his patients. Dental asst Mona is such a sweet person and dental hygienist Karina is so patient and knowledgeable. Love, love, love this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cory Garrard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great first experience. My dental hygienist (Carina) was amazing, the communication was clear and I look forward to continuing to work with these fine folks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Arevalo
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time going and they absolutely made me feel so comfortable. Maria was amazing and such a great personality. Everyone had such a great attitude and were so helpful throughout the whole visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DJV
user_reviews_extended.Description: I normally am pretty uneasy going to the dentist. Karina gave me a great, gentle cleaning. I recommend to anyone, as I’ve shopped around for a bit for a dental office after moving to the Austin area. Karina was particularly helpful in making me feel comfortable, talking me through steps before prodding away at my teeth and gums.

user_reviews_extended.Name: niko bonilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time at South Austin Dental and it was a really pleasant first experience. All the staff was very professional and very friendly. If you’re looking for a new dentist I really recommend this one!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eden M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Coming here has always been such a great experience! The dentists and staff are skilled and are always positive and encouraging, regardless of how minor or major the dental work. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t recommend Dr. Matthysse highly enough. His staff is wonderful and friendly and he is a superb dentist. I always feel comfortable during my visits and appreciate his sound judgement and ability and willingness to answer all of my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Milton H Jamail
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental hygienist Susan was great as she always is! I wrote this same review a few months ago and nothing has changed. Susan is awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: angiebilby_
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dentist offices make me really anxious but i got a cleaning and x-rays done, Veronica was really nice and made me feel less nervous about my visit! user_reviews_extended.Name: Timothy Yanosko
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Chelkowski has been my Dentist for over 25 years and he explains things in a way you can easily understand.  The staff is always tip top and i've always enjoyed my time in the chair,  I mean as much as you can in a dentist chair.  :-)  Give South Austin Dental Associates a try.  I doubt you will be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bianca Salazar- Wise
user_reviews_extended.Description: South Austin Dental is the greatest. Dr. C is the best. I keep moving farther north in Austin and I’ll still make the drive down south to my favorite dental office! Mona, Carina and Yvette have been so consistent and helpful in my experiences each time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Williamson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this office Dr Matthysse is a great dentist he doesn’t overwhelm he explains everything. His front office girl Cindy and Alina always explained treatment and if you need to come in on a last minute for an emergency Cindy gets you in and will explain your insurance if needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Hale
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to South Austin Dental Associates for 15 years. Dr. C., Karina and Mona are great! They get to know their patients and provide excellent care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dirk Albrecht - Oral Designs Dental Lab
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Butcher is amazing. We've had the pleasure of working with him and his team for several years. He is very passionate about his work and each of his patients. Highly recommend South Austin Dental for ALL your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Ruff
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at South Austin Dental were kind and helpful every step of the way.  I felt that I was always in good hands and appreciate their family like atmosphere. We will continue to come here for years to come.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gail Hines
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr. Matthysse and his team. I had to find a new dentist last year when my previous dentist didn’t have a dental hygienist, and I’m so lucky to have found South Austin Dental Associates. Great decision.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L Coutee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was looking for a new dentist and choose South Austin Dental Associates after reading the reviews online. Dr. Matthysse and his staff are professional, thorough, and friendly.  I’m glad I chose their office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roma Hoffman
user_reviews_extended.Description: South Austin Dental Associates is a professional and caring practice. I recommend them for comprehensive dental care! We have been going there for several years and are very satisfied.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry Darvin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved everything about my exam. Very thorough for my first visit to this office and discussed everything that has previously been mentioned to me plus a plan for the future for all findings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Motal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My dental appointment was timely.
No waiting. The hygienist was thorough and professional.
Dr Matthysse was great.
Would definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Skincare Company
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Mary said she called three times before they sent me to collections.  Since I’ve paid, it will come off my record, at some point.
They were sending mail to the wrong address. If you do go here, make sure your information is up to date and they have your insurance info. Mary never left a message saying she was going to send me to collections. THEY WILL SEND YOU STRAIGHT TO COLLECTIONS. $250 for a teeth cleaning is just not worth it, they don’t have any new equipment. The two separate teeth cleanings were not that special.
North Austin denistry will give you free teeth bleaching trays and verify your information is correct and updated every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margo Gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Susan is a fabulous dental hygenist! She's so conscientious and thorough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suzanne Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: All my visits have been productive everyone has listened to my needs. Always efficient professional and welcoming

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lexy Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. C is THE absolute best dentist in the state of Texas,  but it just so happens that he resides where I live in Austin (lucky me)!  Before I came to him I was terrified of needles and would cry and Hyperventilate in the chair while receiving any type of work that was being done.  After a lot of work and patients in his part and his staff and I am now proud to say that I have over come all fears and have zero issues while being at the dentist.  Dr. C makes you feel like family and I couldn’t ask for a better dentist!  Go to him you won’t regret it.
-Lexy Turner

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Hodges
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had terrible experiences with other dentists in the past. South Austin Dental were professional, patient, and kind. It was a whole new experience for me. I now actually enjoy going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phyllis Spoor
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit at South Austin Dental Associates was last week and I was impressed.  Based on the professional, efficient and friendly treatment received, I know my ongoing dental care there will be excellent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Carranza
user_reviews_extended.Description: The absolute best customer service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A. C

I definitely recommend this place and I won’t go anywhere else :))))))) thank you Dr Evans !!! Big hug from Abel !!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Sullivan

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bernice Rostad

I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Griffin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have only been there for one cleaning so far, but the office staff is nice and friendly and the doctor that I met with was professional and courteous and informative. I will be returning here for all my dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Rogers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was really kind and professional. I appreciated how detailed they were in explaining everything to me, helped with my anxiety.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Karina the hygienist was very detail oriented. Dr. Elhosary was great as always.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lourdes Flores

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yan Zhou
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had tooth issue. Dr. Matthysse and staff took in very quickly. I'd highly recommend this dental office. The staff are very friendly. The facility has very latest equipment for routine dental checking or diagnostic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Kindig
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Dr. Chelkowski for  over 25 years. He has always been there to take care of our family”s dental needs. user_reviews_extended.Name: Cammie Davie
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a wonderful experience South Austin Dental Associates makes dental work. Such a lovely staff, kind, and quick. Very grateful to have found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Fearn

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zene Colson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a friendly staff and environment! Dr. Vogelsong and his team made the whole visit seamless and efficient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darryll Knight
user_reviews_extended.Description: Another successful visit to my favorite dental hygienist. Susan does an amazing job cleaning my 72 yo teeth. Painless and very thorough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vaughn Bradley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very knowledgeable, professional, and on time.  The dental hygienist is exceptional in her knowledge and so gentle and careful not to hurt. The Dr. was very personable and is very knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Simon Brodsky

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wendy Stodghill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Karina is the best hygienist I’ve ever had. She’s been cleaning my teeth for 10 years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Flores

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dee Nordentoft
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a friendly and pleasant staff .  If you're looking for a good dentist who isn't going to tell you that you need a lot of things done....when you don't ....I recommend Dr John Chelkowski.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Gerard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been going to this group for over 30 years. Only one dentist change due to retirement. Friendly folks. Explain (in understandable English) exactly what needs to be done. Excellent review.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Price
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to South Austin Dental for the past 4 years. I am very happy with the work that they do. Everyone there is friendly and professional and do a great job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Mangar

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very disappointing experience. I was quoted one price for my aligner, then only two weeks later they increased it by $2,000 when I went back to confirm, saying the price had gone up. I also had to wait months to get my aligner.

I did not feel they were carefully checking whether my teeth were straightening properly unless I pointed out issues myself. It felt rushed and not very thorough.

I was also told that retainers would be included in the plan for five years after treatment, but when it was time to get the retainer, they tried to charge me again.

Overall, I felt misled and overcharged.
