user_reviews_extended.Description: Outstanding work.  It's obvious they take great pride in their work, wanting to make sure it is perfect. A minor detail I would have dismissed, slight misalignment to the side, one that i hadn't really noticed, he wanted to make sure he got it aligned on my final set of prosthetics.   I will continue to recommend them and refer them where I can.  Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracey Becken
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great care above and beyond what I expected

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Ybarra
user_reviews_extended.Description: 6 month check in. Ck in a breeze, Korine (dental hygienist) was exceptional! Cking out again a breeze. Office staff very courteous & friendly. Love Dr. K. I look forward to a long dental relationship with this office. Highly recommend!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vicky Coffee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Visit was on time, thorough cleaning, front desk staff are always friendly and helpful. Office location is convenient to me and is always clean.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jolene Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They all were so down to earth and easy to talk with, very knowledgeable and good at explaining all the details. Made sure you knew you could call or what have you with any questions.
I would definitely refer them to anyone. They were just awesome. Good vibe

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debra Gutierrez-Riley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at this dental office is professional and courteous.  Susan has to be one of the best dental hygienists I’ve ever had. She’s gentle, thorough, and explains procedures as she goes a long. I’ve been going to South Austin Dental Assoc. for a few years now and I have always had great service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: gary davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cheryl McCoy says, Great people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johnnie “j5” Cade
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience with every visit here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The dental assistant was very thorough during my teeth cleaning, no pain and was very pleasant and helpful.
I look forward to my next cleaning appt.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miranda Arrington
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always answers my questions and gentle on my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Troy Petty
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really appreciate having explained to everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judy V
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my 1st treatment day and it couldn’t have gone smoother.

user_reviews_extended.Name: D Ann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was so kind and personable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Mendez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not a very good place, the people are good, the issue is being charged twice on services and having to ask to be refunded, I shouldn’t have to catch your mistake. Expressing wanting Invisalign to getting the pictures taken and then nothing to no response as to what’s next then I’m told we have to do it all over again bc my teeth shifted bc there was no process after the pictures being taken. I waited over a year to get Invisalign here and nothing. Equipment is outdated for the majority which at first I didn’t pay much attention to until I went to my current dentist office. My emails wouldn’t get responses and it was just frustrating. Great people but there are much better options out there for the same price along with better services. My current dentist had my Invisalign ready for me after meeting them for the 3rd time in less than 3 months, I spent over a year here and all they did was take pictures and make me start that process over.

user_reviews_extended.Name: adelaida Ramos
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is great. The doctor explains the procedures clearly is gentle and mindful. There is little waiting time. I really like this dental facility, and highly recommend it.

title: Lane Dental of South Austin
address: 1901 W William Cannon Dr Ste 137, Austin, TX 78745, United States

user_reviews.Name: Charles L Raby
user_reviews.Description:
My teeth were perfectly cleaned. The young lady who cleaned was polite and very conversational, which helped me take my mind on something else! She also did my X-rays and made that process comfortable!
Dr Lane examined my teeth and gave me encouraging news. His exam was thorough!
The reception desk was courteous and helpful!

user_reviews.Name: Ashley Matthews
user_reviews.Description: Usually hate dentist offices but this one is exceptional. Staff is really warm and the office has good energy. My hygienist was Margaret who did my biannual cleaning. She was very gentle and caring & didn't hound me too much about my need to floss more. Afterwards, Dr. Lane came in and poked my gums a bit and scraped some teeth, he was very thorough and skilled. He referred me to a periodontist for my gum recession and answered all the questions I had. Dr. Lane is really knowledgable and you can tell he really cares about his patient's comfort. My insurance paid for the cleaning and they booked my next appt afterwards. Best cleaning experience I've ever had, truly- highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Mary Jane Clarkson
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Lane’s dental practice is worthy of a 10 out of 10 rating.  The staff is super nice, helpful & efficient.  The surroundings are pleasant & the wait-time is excellent.  Dr. Lane is top-notch!  He is very transparent about procedures & explains what he is doing clearly.  I have complete confidence in his expertise.

user_reviews.Name: Lauren Goldberg
user_reviews.Description:
I've been going to this practice since I moved to Austin - and when Dr. Lane took over the practice, it remained excellent in all regards. It is easy to schedule - you are always offered your next appointment before leaving. The physical space is bright and clean. Front office staff, hygentists and Dr. Lane are all warm and effective.
I'm a pretty easy patient, but I have family and friends that have presented more serious challenges and they've all been pleased with the care they've received. And a shout out to Layne Parker, who not only makes my teeth shine every six months but makes me feel like a welcome part of the family.

user_reviews.Name: Alexa Kantzavelos
user_reviews.Description: I found Dr. Lane through a recommendation from my neighbors after having a really terrible experience with another dentist. It started with the initial phone call with Lindsey, who is so sweet and made the whole process easy. Kerrie, my hygienist was thorough in the exam and explaining what was going on and what I would need. She took the time to make sure that the scaling and cleaning I had was thorough and what the expectations are for my future cleanings. Dr. Lane was friendly, direct and made me feel comfortable. I really appreciate how conservative they are with treatment compared to other clinics that I have gone to. They don’t try to sell you on a bunch of treatments you don’t need. I would recommend them to anyone looking for a friendly and honest practice!

user_reviews.Name: a g
user_reviews.Description:
I was first referred to Dr. Lane by my orthodontist Dr. Moody after my former dentist retired. My case is a bit complicated after having upper jaw expansion surgery and I am so grateful to have Dr.Lane and his team throughout this process. He performed gum contouring on my front 4 teeth and I was relieved when the numbing shots were completely painless and the results were perfect! Next will be bonding for a few teeth, which Dr lane has taken a lot of time planning and measuring for. It’s very apparent he cares and wants the best outcome for his patients.

Kerrie is my dental hygienist and she is the absolute best I’ve ever come across. I’m always excited for my appointments with her because she is really focused on making sure everything perfect.

Other thing I want to mention is the family vibes here. Everyone is getting along and having fun and it really does make the patient experience so much better when it’s obvious the staff are having a good time. The office ladies not only make me laugh, they go above and beyond to get things approved by insurance that I never had covered in other offices. So grateful to have these folks as my dental team!

user_reviews.Name: Sheri Guess
user_reviews.Description: Lane Dental is the best!  I moved my entire family to this practice recently, as I have followed my very perfect hygienist, Jayme Roy Smith, for almost 23 years.  Where she goes, I go, because I trust her implicitly to choose employers that are not only EXCELLENT at their job, but also are a business based in integrity and authenticity.  I couldn’t have asked for a better place to land!  Dr. Jonathan Lane is kind, thorough, and he actually listens to and authentically responds to all of his patients.  As a person who highly values doing business with people of integrity, I feel blessed to have been led here.  I simply cannot say enough good things about this place!  If you’re looking for a new or better dental practice, you should come to the best dentist!

user_reviews.Name: Marge Bailey
user_reviews.Description: Margaret is an exceptional dental hygienist. She’s thorough, while being gentle. My teeth look so much better once she’s cleaned them. The front desk staff and Dr Lane are the BEST!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Molony
user_reviews_extended.Description: New patient here! Really amazing dentist and kind staff! They aren’t trying to upsell you on all the gadgets and unnecessary dental work. Seems like they genuinely care and are trustworthy. My husband also recently joined after a toothache and he had nothing but extremely positive things to say. Great dental practices are hard to come by!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Usakewicz
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dental hygienist was awesome today. Great job explaining all that everything  she was doing. Lots of 2’s a few 3’s on the gums. Would certainly request her for my next cleaning. She talked me into buying the dentist-supplied toothbrush ha ha

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Bergman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Lane Dental is wonderful. I have never had a dentist I’ve enjoyed going to so much. I also have had experience before where I feel that the office is more a cosmetic place than medical. I don’t get that with Dr Lane, and I feel that if he had a concern I would believe it. He also did some repairs on my daughter’s teeth and his pricing was much more reasonable than our other estimates. He did a great job too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: My kids and I enjoy all of the staff at Dr. Lane’s and the dentist. Staff is efficient and trustworthy. Professionals and keep things on schedule for busy families and don’t provide unnecessary services. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vicki Lancaster
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Lane Dental is so friendly and kind! I feel very well cared for and Dr. Lane and his crew are all so professional and skilled!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Tovar
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is such a friendly dental practice that I feel like I am surrounded by family. The staff is very professional and helpful.  Dr. Lane is gentle and very thorough.  Prices are reasonable. I actually look forward to going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cohen Rigdon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so pleased with Lane Dental!  We went to a new practice following our favorite hygienist, Jayme Roy Smith, as she is literally the BEST and my mom has been following her since before I was born (I’m 20 now).  The entire staff is amazing!  They are kind, completely on top of scheduling (even when our family forgets things all the time!)), and so efficient.  i highly recommend this practice to anyone looking for an awesome dentist and the best hygienist on the planet!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Kiffe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Phenomenal team. Almost make sure I’m aware of my appointment and treat me like family when I walk in the door. Thorough cleaning and great service. Highly recommend Lane Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhonda B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lane is an outstanding dentist! The rest of the team is fantastic as well…. Everyone is very kind and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Usen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am grateful I found Lane Dental, a friend referred me after having a bad experience at another dentist. Dr Lane is the person/dentist I want because he cares deeply about his work and patients. Which aligns with what I am looking for: someone to protect my teeth at all cost, avoiding doing unnecessary work. He’s honest, transparent and trustworthy. These qualities extend to the entire staff as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Low
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Lane Dental is so nice and made me feel very comfortable about getting major work done.  Dr. Lane is very nice and personable and tells you exactly the treatment plan.  Next time go in I won’t feel so nervous (maybe just a little 😄)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Morgan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Several close familymembers recommended Dr. Lane to me when I moved back home to Austin after many years away. I am grateful for the recommendation. Dr. Lane and all  in the office super competent and extremely pleasant. They make going to the office a pleasure

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Z
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lane and his staff treat you like family. I normally do not like going to the dentist because of past experiences but I am happy to say I found a dental office that has changed my opinion! Lane Dental in South Austin is a professional and friendly environment. I finally look forward to my 6 month check up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peggy Howell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lane Dental is a caring practice. Dr Lane a goes the extra mile to ensure you quality care. If needed he will meet you at the office on the weekend if needed. I needed this help and he was there for me. His staff are personable  and very good at what they do. You can’t go wrong choosing this practice for your for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chloe Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had a wonderful experience with Lane Dental! The front desk staff scheduled my next appointment before I even sat down! Loved the extra touch of complimentary snacks, and a tv to watch while I'm waiting:)
My favorite part, of course, was my service with Layne, she's so friendly and easy to chat with:) My teeth feel so clean  and refreshed ☺️
I would recommend Lane Dental to friends and coworkers!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joan Byrne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Appointment was on time, the staff friendly and helpful, the hygienist very competent, Dr. Lane also very competent and charming. I always leave the office delighted! Thanks for the positive experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lane and his office have always given me quality professional care with a smile.  There are much closer dental offices to my home, but Lane Dental is definitely worth the drive in.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maribel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lane is truly the best dentist I’ve ever had! From the moment you walk into the office, you’re greeted with warmth and professionalism. Dr. Lane takes the time to explain every procedure, answers all your questions with patience, and makes sure you’re comfortable throughout the entire visit. The care and attention to detail are unmatched, and the results speak for themselves. I actually look forward to my dental visits now—something I never thought I’d say! Highly recommended to anyone looking for exceptional dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Stewart
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to this dental office for over 15 years. I’ve never had a bad experience. They are super cheerful and careful of the patients’ needs. But they’re also professional at the same time which really makes a difference. I would not hesitate to recommend anyone to see Dr. Lane and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lane was truly excellent! From the moment I walked into the office, I felt welcomed and comfortable. The staff was friendly and professional. Dr. Lane took the time to explain my dental health concerns in a way that was easy to understand. He was incredibly gentle and patient during my procedure, and I felt relaxed and in good hands. I highly recommend Dr. Lane!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree Huffman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been with Lane Dental long before it became Lane Dental. Dr. Lane has continued the whole reason I have been a loyal patient for over 30 years. Compassionate and always allies my dental anxieties with his knowledge on all things dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: K Coffey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really love Dr Lane and his team! Their hours are super accommodating to my work schedule (I always get the 7A appointment since I commute from Hutto) and rescheduling or booking an appointment is super easy. Everyone is incredibly friendly; when you walk in, it’s not a “hi, have a seat”, they personalize the experience and they’ve made some office updates! But most importantly I always feel safe and never judged on my less than perfect cleanings. Some cleanings are gold stars and a few pointers whereas others are a clean start. Going to the dentist can be intimidating, and I’ve been on a journey with my teeth, but I love it here so much I choose to use an out-of-network provider because the services and experience are exactly what I need. If you’re on a search for a dentist, this is the place! I get compliments on my smile frequently; I like to think it’s my face, but I’m sure Dr Lane’s team has a hand in it too! 😆

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geoff Garner
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Recently , Dr Lane repaired my lower front incisors, as they we chipped and cracked from 70 years of use. 5 crowns, they turned out GREAT thanks to Dr Lane,  and his associate, Z’s great skills.  As usual it’s the quality of the care and the people who deliver the care that earn the rating and are the stars.
Dr Lane has assembled a great team!
Thanks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vedant Jain (Ari)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lane Dental is outstanding! The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, and I received the best cleaning I’ve ever had. Thank you all so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: D Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: After years of being with the same dentist who longer accepts insurance, I had to look for a new one. Dr. Lane and his staff were very helpful and caring from the initial phone call. They made me feel comfortable and explained everything during the entire process (Pricing, check in, exam, cleaning, check out). No complaints and would recommend anyone looking for a new dentist to try Dr. Lane and his amazing staff!! They went above and beyond to get me in right away. Thank you for the sweet goodie bag and electric toothbrush 🪥 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lane dental was great!! They scheduled my appointment , approved insurance, and got me seen in a matter of days. Everyone was super nice and helpful!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becky Sterzing
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Semi annual check up.
Took some X-rays and cleaned and polished my teeth!  Everyone is so nice, love Dr Lane!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lane is great ! And staff so nice ! I highly recommend him for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clayton Maderia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for the free toothbrush, found a dentist that truly cares. I am so grateful for Dr. Lane and his staff.  Dr. Lane is one of the kindest health professionals (and people) I’ve ever worked with. You can see in the tenure and personalities of his staff how much the people who work there care about their work. After decades of feeling incredibly anxious when going to the dentist, I am thankful that Lane Dental exists and will forever be a patient for as long as I’m in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ernie Renteria
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience at Dr. Lane’s. Staff if friendly and efficient. My dental hygienist, Layne, is awesome and does a great job. Dr. Lane is always professional, thorough and reassuring in his care and treatment! I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stella
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a good experience here. Dr. Lane provides gentle treatments without any rush. Explains everything really well. He has treated my children, too. My son was receptive to getting his teeth treated due to Dr. Lane’s calming personality. He looks for things in common with patients which puts them at ease during treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Hawkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been with Dr Lane since he started in Austin and will tell you that his care and skill are top notch. He truly cares about his patients and it shows. He also uses the latest equipment and has beautifully upgraded the office. When he started practicing he took over from my previous dentist who retired, and who gave such a glowing recommendation I was immediately set at ease starting with Dr Lane. As long as we’re living in Austin both my wife and I will continue to be in his care. I also have to commend both his hygienist and office admin staff who are very friendly and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terry Lord
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm in the process of getting a tooth implant done. Dr. Lane and his staff have been WONDERFUL in walking me through everything and checking on me. I 🩷 Lane Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Reed
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Every visit with Lane Dental is a positive experience.  Every employee there is friendly, helpful and encouraging.
Lane is a very knowledgeable, encouraging dentist. He offers advice on how to best care for your dental health and only suggests procedures that are necessary. I have great confidence in his abilities and honesty.

Carol Reed

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stagg Clan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent front office staff, really like the doc, the cleaning gals and dental assistant were all great too. They are great with kids!  We’ve had cleanings, exams, an extraction, and some cavities filled. We are cash pay and they have been flexible and have competitive rates. We recommend Dr Lane and his crew.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Garrett Naumann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice Very Friendly extremely knowledgeable and can work with any payment plan that fits ur budget fast service very clean environment and they make u feel like ur the only patient their very pleased with all my dental services I have received highly recommend great team excellent attention to detail explains everything throughly I’ll give them 5* Happy Holidays to y’all at Lane Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: sam birchall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lane is a great dentist. He doesn't try to upsell me at every opportunity like many dentists. He has a genuine personal interest in his patients. His office staff are friendly and  knowledgeable. Great dental experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ty Alan Webb
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had two teeth pulled and had a good experience. The Dr explained what he was doing all thru the process. He also took the time to make sure my mouth was completely deaden with Novocain. I will definitely be going back on a regular routine schedule.  The front office staff are very accommodating and helpful.  A++

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Tessmann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lane has done a great job with dental care. The new office runs smoothly, quickly and efficiently, but it hasn't lost any of the local, friendly feel!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ron W
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lane is a one of a kind.  So appreciate how he goes about his practice and helps you feel at ease.  Great work inside and to all the support staff, well done in there.  You all are great.  Which is a lot to say when talking about a dentist visit.  Thanks for taking away the fear of being there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica Siller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lane has been mine, and Joe's dentist since we were fortunate enough to find him. We were at a loss and just needed an honest Dentist who was patient, and knowledgeable to perform some tough dentistry for a reasonable price. With true confidence I  am willing to refer everyone we know to Dr. Lane. He has seen 2 of our children 1 of our parents a couple of our friends, and im happy to include my personal testimony on this platform. Dr. Lane is not only an incredible Dentist he's a good person we are happy to know him, and we are very grateful to be his patients!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: SUSIE COBB
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lane is great! I love his big smile and relaxed manner. I have felt so comfortable talking with him about my concerns. For example, I chipped a tooth and the office offered me an appointment the same day. He smoothed the edges perfectly. We talked about doing something cosmetic, but he said it would be a pretty invasive process and that he leaned away from it. I really appreciated that his honest advice was to just leave it alone. It’s one of my bottom teeth, so I can live with it. Less is better! **And Layne is the best dental hygienist!**

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerry Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful experience! The front desk people were very helpful and kind. They went out of their way to make sure I had all the information I needed. Dr. Lane was very professional and kind. He took plenty of time to make sure I understood the situation I was dealing with and offered perfect recommendations. I will certainly be returning to this great dental environment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chet Gentry
user_reviews_extended.Description:
5 star review for Dr Lane and crew. I have spent many hours under the lights at their clinic and it was well worth it. Saved several teeth with no pain and lotsa laughs.

My grandson was in an accident, and Dr Lane met my son and grandson after hours to make sure he was cared for.

Do not hesitate to visit and see for yourself.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karolina Russo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a wonderful experience here at every touch point. Dr. Lane and his team are all wonderful, kind, and honest. They made me feel comfortable and cared for despite my dental anxiety. I am actually looking forward to my next cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I have severe dental anxiety due to a bad dental experience during my childhood, but I can't say enough about how great my experience was with Dr. Lane. title: South Austin Family Dental
address: 135 W Slaughter Ln C, Austin, TX 78748, United States

user_reviews.Name: Ryan Callahan
user_reviews.Description: Most honest dental office in Austin. Dr. Shelby and one of the hygienists, Crystal, have been my go to for all my dental work and it stopped here. Crystal is super helpful and kind and she always takes my concerns seriously and helps me with any questions I may have. Dr. Knight is really personable and he makes it clear he cares for his patients and always is so welcoming and helpful. 10/10, if you’re looking for a dental office, look no further, this is the one!

user_reviews.Name: Ceren CeCe Scott
user_reviews.Description: I honestly don’t understand how this place has good reviews. The way my appointment and insurance were handled was extremely unprofessional. I was called less than 24 hours before my appointment and told I might have to pay out of pocket. After providing all my insurance details, my appointment time was suddenly changed and I was left with unclear answers about whether my cleaning would even be done. When I called to confirm, I was met with confusion and asked if I wanted to cancel instead. As a pregnant patient, this was stressful and disappointing. This is not how a dental office should be run.

user_reviews.Name: Marshall Daum
user_reviews.Description: Visited here and needed a cleaning while I was in town. Dude with the crazy mustache (Brian) treated me well and help set everything up super efficiently. Rest of staff was all super friendly as well, highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Mike Wilson
user_reviews.Description: Best dentists I've ever visited.  Dr. Torrey is quiet and reserved, but very nice and attentive.  When I needed a refill on my antibiotic, she checked with me, then immediately sent it to a pharmacy out of state where I was visiting.  Dr. Knight picked up the next phase of my care and he was amazing.  He's kind and friendly.  Just a warm, caring human being who just happens to be a dentist.  He extracted one of my molars and talked me through the entire process, both before, but also while he was working on me to assure me that things were going well.  I had very little discomfort after the procedure, but what was most impressive was his thoughtfulness.  He paused frequently to give my jaw a rest since extracting a tooth requires a good deal of pressure.  He explained why he was stopping and made sure I was comfortable all the way through.  He asked me about my pain med preferences while making it clear that he prefers to minimize the use of opiods, which matches up with my preferences.  Even though I'm moving out of state soon, I'm coming back to see Dr. Knight to finish my procedure rather than find a more convenient option in my new  home town.  I don't think anyone really enjoys going to the dentist, but I can say that working with Dr. Knight is as pleasant as a dental experience can be.

user_reviews.Name: Rachel Phillips
user_reviews.Description:
I am so sad South Austin Family Dental won't be in my network anymore. I still highly recommend their office. First, front office employees are always welcoming. Second, every hygienist has been thorough and I never felt like I was being sold on or pressured into a service I didn't need - one hygienist even suggested I probably didn't need to get crowns from my previous dentist.

Dr. Torrey is always straightforward, and explanatory of your dental needs. And like all other professionals at this establishment, super kind.

I only saw Dr. Knight once - for a wisdom tooth extraction. He and the hygienist were extremely careful to make sure I wouldn't feel a thing (can't do anything about that cringe-inducing sound of the tooth coming out) and made pretty quick work of it. Not sure if the procedure itself explains the very easy and painless recovery or if I was just lucky.

I would absolutely continue being a patient here if I financially could.

user_reviews.Name: Robert Madden
user_reviews.Description: I've been a patient at South Austin Family Dental since 2017. The entire practice is top notch. I have never had a bad visit. Dr. Torrey has been my dentist since Dr. Euers retired about 5 years ago. I cannot compliment Dr. Torrey enough. She is incredibly kind and highly skilled. She is so meticulous in her work and always makes sure I am happy with the result of a procedure. There was a particular time when she went out of her way to ensure a crown was done flawlessly. I recommend her completely. Because I have been a patient there for 7 1/2 years I have been fortunate to meet most of the staff and each of them exhibit the utmost professionalism and courtesy. They all personally care about their patients and take pride in their work. I especially want to acknowledge Melissa, Vann and Cindy for their years of kindness, care and dedication.

user_reviews.Name: Michael Wilson
user_reviews.Description: Have been going to River Rock Southpark for about 6mo now. Dr. Carlson has helped me with a couple of different dental procedures. He’s incredibly nice and helpful and his staff are amazing. 10/10!

user_reviews.Name: AreenMarie Morrison
user_reviews.Description: It is not easy to find a skilled dentist and team. After returning to Austin last year my first dentist did some damage. I finally found SAFD. The entire staff are professional yet fun. The hygienists are thorough, patient, gentle. Dr. Knight was amazing, no pain, and he took considerable time to fix the problems from the first dentist. I will be a client here for many years to come. Thank you.

Thank  you for being great! Getting a root canal and a crown is a rather intimidating experience but with a great staff it has gone very smoothly.

The staff is always very friendly and makes you feel right at home, which is VERY helpful in the dental chair! All in all if you want a great dental experience this is the place for you.

Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been to such an amazing dentist as Dr. Shelby Knight!  I have seen Dr. Knight for years and love how calm, patient, gentle and kind he is. Dr. Knight takes time with his patients! He gets to know you and what your wishes are. Dr. Knight is awesome and I will forever go to see him for all my dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shelby Knight at South Austin Family Dental is the best dentist I've ever had. user_reviews_extended.Description:
Gentle, conscientious and happy to see you.
I moved to Austin a little over two years ago. Went to 3 other dentists before this one. Couldn't find one I was comfortable with and kept leaving them with tooth/gum pain and a huge quote for more work.  Came here, they told me everything the other dentists said, then told me what was necessary at a reasonable cost.
Also, last time I went, they stopped me as I headed out the door to tell me how I could reschedule my appointments in order to save $200.  They go above and beyond at the front desk too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christi Spencer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
OH MY!!! I gave a terrible review by mistake. I'd gone to another dentist whose practice name was very similar to this one. In short, I said that I felt as if I were being oversold. The estimate was too expensive. The staff was overly friendly.

I correct this by saying, I have been a patient of Dr. Euers for over 10 years. He is an excellent dentist who is caring and gives excellent care. One of the things I love is that he's very cognizant of his patient's level of pain. He makes sure that he causes no discomfort during treatment.

I just had a temporary bridge made and it looks amazing. His charge was $500 less than the other practitioner. Dr. Euers cost includes a temporary bridge unlike the other dentist, The bridge looks amazing!!! Can't wait to get my permanent bridge.

Please accept my sincere apologies for the erroneous review. If I could, I'd rate this practice 10 stars.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I went for a checkup and cleaning today. The staff are very friendly and efficient. Crystal was my dental hygienist. I have never received such a thorough cleaning. She took off years of stains and my teeth were white afterwards. I’m very pleased with the service I received today.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got the best work done here! The entire staff was friendly. I’ve been in several times for what I had done… I will say it was so easy and painless. Also, they sure know what they are doing!

They made the whole experience comfortable, welcoming, and stress-free. It truly felt like they were invested in helping me get back on track with proper dental care, and I’m genuinely grateful for their professionalism and kindness.

If you’re looking for a team that goes above and beyond, I highly recommend Tru Dentistry. Exceptional people, exceptional care.

They go out of their way to make sure I am comfortable and the work they do is great! I have had very minimal pain every time I’ve gotten something done. This is a truly amazing dentist.

user_reviews.Name: Courtney Smith
user_reviews.Description:
I found Dr. K through a women’s group I’m part of, and I cannot overstate how grateful I am that I did. She is, without question, the best dentist I’ve ever had. From the moment you sit down with her, it’s clear how intelligent, caring, and thorough she is. She explains everything in a way that’s easy to understand, she’s incredibly personable, and she’s genuinely invested in her patients’ comfort and long-term health. She even worked with me on pricing without me ever having to awkwardly ask — that level of humanity is rare and deeply appreciated.

And her staff? Truly exceptional. Gaby and Reif set the tone the minute I walked in. They’re warm, funny, attentive, and made what could have been a stressful appointment an actual joy. The entire team mirrors Dr. K’s energy and values, and it shows in every interaction.

If you’re looking for a dentist who treats you like a human being and not a number — someone brilliant, compassionate, and honest — please go see Dr. K. I’m genuinely excited for my next appointment, which says everything.

user_reviews.Name: Alexei Racila
user_reviews.Description: Just finished my dental cleaning at TRU Dentistry and I’m genuinely impressed. From check-in to check-out, the staff was welcoming and professional. The doctor Nichole did a careful exam and didn’t push any unnecessary treatments—just honest guidance. Clean, modern office, easy parking, and they respected my appointment time. Five stars!

user_reviews.Name: Fathom Woods
user_reviews.Description: Run, don't walk to Tru Dentistry! I hate the dentist. But I actually had the best time. It felt like family, like home. You just have to experience it to believe it.  Everyone of the staff smiled and greeted me upon entry. Every staff member that worked on me from start to finish was absolutely lovely. They were friendly and warm and it felt like we were old friends. The dentist was awesome, she explained everything in a way that was super easy to understand. The vibe is chill and the people are warm and friendly. I hate that I am moving out of state soon. I wish I could pick them up and move them all with me!

user_reviews.Name: Regina Bachmeier
user_reviews.Description: You can tell the staff and office love and take pride in what they do. They have all of the latest in dentistry but still make you feel a part of their home and community. Dr. Kostiuk is pragmatic while being realistic. They take care of their patients and care about their experience. It really is a treat going into an office like this!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Walsh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had my second appointment at Tru Dentistry and I'm so pleased. I used to dread going to the dentist, but this team is friendly, modern and careful. I highly recommend using them. Reef in particular was awesome today, he did my cleaning and it was the most comfortable teeth cleaning I've ever had. None of the gum stabbing and uncomfortable scraping that you get when they're rushing.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Tru Dentistry off Brodie is hands-down one of the best dental offices I’ve ever been to. The entire staff is incredibly pleasant, and Gabby and Dixie were absolutely amazing.

They made the whole experience comfortable, welcoming, and stress-free. It truly felt like they were invested in helping me get back on track with proper dental care, and I’m genuinely grateful for their professionalism and kindness.

If you’re looking for a team that goes above and beyond, I highly recommend Tru Dentistry. Exceptional people, exceptional care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kostiuk and her staff provides exceptional services. We have been seeing this office for our dental needs since we moved to Austin in 2024, and have been so impressed with everyone. Dr.K is very knowledgeable and takes whatever time is necessary to provide the best dental treatment. We cannot say enough about the outstanding quality of her skills and the expertise of her staff. We highly recommend her office.

Transparent and kind/capable care is exactly what you can expect from your visit here

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Ritchie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where do I start in explaining how amazing this place is? I've been here twice already, once for an emergency extraction and the second to actually establish care. Both times, the staff have been absolutely amazing and thorough. I honestly haven't been to a dentist in quite a while due to my own PTSD, anxiety, etc., with trauma experiences at previous dentists. After explaining that I do have dentist anxiety, the staff made sure that was the forefront of my visits. While they made sure I was comfortable, they also took the time to actually explain their procedures, what was happening, and next steps for continued care. Also, Chase at the front desk has been absolutely amazing while providing transparent prices and making sure I understood what my insurance covers. I know damn well that I waited too long to better my dental health, but it was worth the wait on finding someone worth actually taking the time to legit give a damn. Also, candy apple toothpaste, don't ask questions, just opt in.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot express how amazing these people are. I was having difficulty with a previous dentists office. user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to TRU Dentistry for years, and I absolutely adore the team! They have always treated me with warmth, kindness, and patience. user_reviews_extended.Name: Phyllis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first visit at TRU Dentistry and was impressed.  Everyone involved in my treatment demonstrated respect, friendliness, positive energy and high expertise.  I feel good about continuing my care there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Quarles
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience I’ve had in Austin. Was able to get treatment same day as a new client. Very reasonably priced for someone without dental insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Fuentes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist isn’t usually my favorite activity, but visiting this office makes it a pleasure! I can’t recommend them enough to my family, friends, church family, and neighbors. I trust them completely with any dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hayley Rick
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great experience with Dr. Kostiuk today! I came in genuinely nervous after a painful filling with a different dentist at the same office (no longer there), where I didn’t get fully numb and had to push through it. This time was completely different. Dr. Kostiuk made me feel safe, calm, and cared for from the moment I walked in. She numbed me perfectly (on the first try!) and was so gentle, quick, and professional the entire time. I didn’t feel a thing and left feeling so relieved and grateful. So glad I found her, can’t recommend her enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Zdunek
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the most exceptional experience with Dr. Kostiuk! You owe it to yourself to schedule your next dental appointment with her, especially if dental visits give you anxiety. I was open about how my past experiences with other dental practices were awful and she took the time to reassure me and followed through with such amazing care! 5/5 stars all day, will not recommend anyone else for dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff, Dr. K not so much. After several deep cleanings by capable techs, was informed of cavities by Dr. K., who never even  introduced herself after acquiring the practice. Went in for my first filling ever- and she didn’t bother to explain what she was going to do/explain anything about the procedure, except that it would be “quick”-not a good sign. During my previous visits, I overheard that term used too many times. During the procedure, not before, the dentist told me “I’m adjusting your bite!” several times loudly. Having not been informed of any of the details of the procedure, I was of course confused and concerned. After the procedure my bite was “high” and painful. After 3 more visits for “quick” bite adjustments, the dentist was still unable to fix my bite. The dentist not only belittled my issue (“It’s just a little filling”), she also summarily dismissed me and said “there’s nothing wrong, you’re just going to have to get used to it”. She then agreed to address the issue “in 5 months”(!) if I was still suffering. Shortly thereafter, I terminated services and requested a call from the dentist. After waiting a month, I called the office. When I asked why the dentist hadn’t called me back , I was told “we deal with hundreds of patients that move on to other practices, we don’t ask why”. (Wow, hundreds? Maybe you should ask why) I then became irate and asked to speak with the dentist. The dentist explained that she would like to start over and re-fill the tooth. I told her that was unacceptable. She then mentioned a zero tolerance policy for verbally mistreating her staff. Since she seemed oblivious to my concerns, I had to then explain that she did a rush job on my filling, gave me zero info about the procedure beforehand (she admitted it was unprofessional but didn’t apologize), then had to explain that leaving a patient to twist in the wind for 5 months in pain was not compassionate care(still didn’t apologize), and that her NEGLIGENCE was the causal factor for not only the pain I’m still in, but also for my demeanor. She said she understood but still didn’t apologize. As a former HR professional, I offered to listen to the recording of our conversation and point out some de-escalation tips and active listening techniques her staff could utilize to assist patients in distress, but there was no interest. Dr. K then offered to see me in a more timely fashion for a fourth bite adjustment. But I don’t think I’m going back, would you ? Response to response update- wow, LIARS too! No verbal explanation AT ALL. No scheduling issues, just rush jobs. Staff knew I wanted to speak to dentist, but I was ignored, incredible. Didn’t raise my voice and certainly didn’t belittle anyone, I was belittled. And there was no apology from the dentist, ever. How unprofessional! It’s one thing to do a poor job, another to lie about it, shameful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brendon Sparkman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Look no further than here if you're looking for a new dentistry practice. Dr. Kostiuk's knowledge and professionalism is only matched by the courtesy of her staff - by far the smoothest and easiest dental appointment I've ever made and I'll definitely be back in the future.

Let these guys work with you. Your teeth will thank you for it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristina Carrillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: My whole experience at TRU Dentistry was nothing short of excellent from the moment I walked in. Chase at the front desk was so welcoming & friendly! He’s my new favorite hygienist! Everyone is extremely knowledgeable at what they do. Dr. Kostiuk displayed a gentle, comforting approach to her work which is vital in a dentistry environment. Dr. K and her team really are the definition of “excellent care.”

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mika
user_reviews_extended.Description: The welcoming atmosphere was so apparent the moment I walked in - Chase, Gabby, Reef, and Dr. K were all kind, professional, and informative! They provided everything I look for in my dental care and I feel very comfortable in their care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Noah Day
user_reviews_extended.Description: I, like many, do not enjoy going to the dentist. My teeth need a lot of love and I’m embarrassed and overwhelmed with the amount of work I need to have done. I needed an exam and cleaning so I decided to give Tru a chance with a new patient visit yesterday and wow, they are the best! From the moment you walk in the door you feel at ease. It was clear to me, they want patients to feel valued and respected. They truly succeed at that. Patient for life here! ❤️ AND they are incredibly LGBTQ+ safe and inclusive! Thanks Tru Team!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Baleigh Blankenship
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Highly recommend!! Somewhat of a dentist snob as I used to LOVE the dentist , but haven’t been able to find one here in Austin that I feel is up to the standard of care I was receiving in my previous city. Great experience from start to finish and I will certainly be using them for the foreseeable future!!

user_reviews_extended.Description: The ladies were super friendly and made me feel very comfortable from the moment I arrived. Dr. Nichole explained everything very clearly and patiently. I definitely recommend this place. ☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just prior to spring break, I had severe oral pain from a tooth out of alignment. My regular dentist was on vacation & her first appointment was March 27.Two weeks of pain? Yikes!

I stumbled on an ad online for TRU Dentistry.The front office staff was professional, friendly, kind & able to book an appointment within a few days.

I am a Registered Nurse so am extremely picky about my care. The clinic was very clean & welcoming.

Dr. Samantha Hollinger was AMAZING! She went over my treatment options & even offered to refer me to another dentist to try to save my tooth. However, I had already consulted an orthodontist & had a plan in place. She is highly skilled in performing extractions. She took time to explain the procedure & after-care.

Honestly, I wish this office was covered under my dental plan. I’d make them my primary dental office.

Thanks for being there & giving outstanding care! Their high reviews are well-deserved.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Bernard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m usually nervous about the dentist, and haven’t been in some years between Covid, anxiety, life and such. The crew here made me feel so at ease, were so kind from the minute I walked in the door, and really took the time to walk me through a treatment plan that would get me back on track while still making sure I’d have a good experience. So happy I found them as my new dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Val Leal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely thrilled with my experience at TRU Dentistry with Dr. Kostiuk! From the moment I walked in, the friendly staff made me feel welcome and at ease. Dr. Kostiuk's expertise and gentle approach took away all my dental anxiety. The state-of-the-art equipment and meticulous attention to detail were impressive. Whether it’s a routine check-up or a complex procedure, Dr. Kostiuk ensures exceptional care and comfort. Highly recommend this top-notch dentist for anyone seeking professional and compassionate dental care in a modern, welcoming environment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband, my son, and I have been to the dentist a couple times now and the staff here is super!! Jessica at the front desk is amazing. I have been to Dentist offices all over the East Coast and she is by far one of the ever been to! So glad I found this place! ~Desiree

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Garreffa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just saw Dr.K for a semi emergency.  All the staff was great, very helpful and answered all my questions. I feel confident that Dr. K did a great job fixing what another dentist should have done right. I'll be going back

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Junk
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently needed find a new dentist in Austin, so I was referred to TRU Dentistry by my amazing girlfriend. I went in for a general check-up and teeth cleaning, and the entire experience was fantastic from start to finish. The staff was friendly, efficient and knowledgable; they made sure I knew what was happening every step of the appointment. The facility is modern, clean, and inviting (had Netflix going in my room); which is very important for someone who does not enjoy going to the dentist. Lastly, I felt the whole process was extremely transparent and easy (the conversations with the hygienist/dentist were helpful/constructive, and they communicated the pricing of everything throughout). Overall, I was couldn't be more pleased with TRU Dentistry and I'm, happy to say I have found myself a new permanent dentist in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Jacinto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Impressed with their professionalism, their staff is not only friendly but also highly skilled, felt very comfortable and reassured with any concerns I had. Highly recommend for any of your dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Schumann
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place was comprehensive, caring and so incredibly thorough. I have been to many dentists and have not had great experiences. TRU Dentistry did not make me feel bad for lapsing on my dental health, showed me exactly what was going on with my teeth and did it with a smile on their faces. Also, they handled my insurance very well and discussed the treatment plan with you before acting. I have definitely found a new dentist and would highly recommend to family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Welbes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I rarely ever write reviews and I hate the dentist. So you can see how writing a review for a dentist is rare for me.

This was one of the best experiences I've had from a healthcare professional. The front desk staff (hi Chase!) we're so nice and explained all my insurance coverage/cost to me. The dental staff was phenomenal. In an hour and 15 minutes, they were able to take new patient x-rays of my mouth, deep clean my teeth, fill a cavity, take a scan for a mouth guard/retainer and do a fluoride treatment. All of that would have taken multiple visits at my last dentist.

Cannot sing the praises of this group enough. So happy I found a dentist I can enjoy going to!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mackenzie Spadoni
user_reviews_extended.Description: I truly cannot think of a better first visit to a dentist! I came in for a regular cleaning since I had not had one in 6 months.. during the time I was there which was an hour and a half they were able to do X-rays of my teeth, scan my teeth for a night guard, clean my teeth and fill two cavities that were easy and painless! The office has a very welcoming and calming vibe to it and the staff is very friendly! If you’re trying to find a new dentist in Austin I HIGHLY recommend coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cayla Collins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just recently moved to Austin and was needing to find a new dentist. My first appointment was for a cleaning and I fell in love with the entire staff. Each and every person made me feel super welcome and were giving me phenomenal service! I usually don’t like the dentist because it causes pain or they make me feel bad about my teeth, but not this place. The atmosphere is very uplifting! I had 4 fillings my next visit and they were more than considerate of my pain tolerance and did what they could to make me feel comfortable. Honestly, it was the least painful filling I’ve ever had and it was the most amount of fillings at once I’ve ever had. I highly recommend this place to anyone in search for a dentist! You won’t regret it, seriously. 10/10. Thanks Tru Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: lauren nicole
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was so warm and friendly, they made me feel very comfortable. I went in and got two crowns replaced. The experience was great! No pain, and very informed dentistry! My last dentist told me that in order to have this done I would need my gums to be filed down and that it would cost triple the price! TRU dentistry steered me in the right direction, did an incredible job, and saved me a lot of money- plus the safety of my gums!! They even removed some coffee stains on my teeth and fixed a chipped front tooth without me even having to request it...they just really care about their patients!  I would definitely recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sergey Laptik
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service! Definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristina Wiltjer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff at TRU Dentistry Austin were very friendly, but I found the pricing to be quite expensive, which aligns with some of the lower-rated reviews. Initially, I was hesitant to go elsewhere due to the many positive reviews. However, I was shocked by the price difference when I visited a family practice instead.

The final straw for me was the issue with insurance coverage. When I first visited, I was assured that my insurance was accepted and that Dr. Kostiuk was in-network. However, I later received a bill from my insurance stating that Dr. Kostiuk was out of network, and I would need to contact the dentist's office directly. When I called, the front desk initially confirmed Dr. Kostiuk was covered, but then changed their statement, saying, "Dr. Kostiuk is going through the process of being covered." At that point, I canceled my appointment and requested my records to be emailed to me.

This was my experience, and I wanted to share it so others can form their own opinion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trey McClelland
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing support staff, fantastic dentist.  These folks truly understand how to take care of their patients from start to finish.  I am so glad that I was referred to them.  This is my new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Gabriel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As clichés as this may sound,  this place is AMAZING!!!!   The quality of care one is given is unmatched by all the other dentist offices I've been treated at.   From the moment you walk in,  Chase and Alex, the 2 front office people, welcome you with the biggest caring smile and make you feel like they've known you forever.   You are not a stranger in their office.   They introduce you to everyone. Everyone else also welcomes you with truly open arms.   It's a feeling of warmth and not over whelming attack of your space.   Very comfortable.   If you have a great fear of dentist office, you won't after a visit to TruDentistry.  It is a MUST experience you'll enjoy.   Reef was my dental hygienist.   He was gentle and precise to get in every nook and cranny with hurting you and he made sure to ask you if you're doing ok.   Destiny was the dental assistance who closed and polished my teeth after Reef and made sure to be careful as well when flooding and polishing.   Then they brought in the big guns,  Dr. Nicole Kostiuk.  The sweetest human I've ever met.  Dr. K, as they refer to her is very thorough caring as all the rest of the office.   She let me know that I have a very healthy set of teeth.  I was surprised because the other dentist office are always trying to get me to have my wisdom teeth pull and Dr. K didn't even mentioned them.   I asked her about them and she said they're fine and not in the way of my life.   An HONEST dentist office.  I never take the time to write it review, but this place deserves to be recognized.   Bravo TruDentistry.

Sincerely,
Michael

user_reviews_extended.Description: Y’ALL! I wanted to put 10+ stars but they don’t have an option for that. I needed immediate attention to my teeth and was hesitant to find a dentist last minute. Now I can go on my vacation and enjoy it with no worries😌. 20 STARS ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karlee C.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had the privilege of visiting Tru Dentistry for an emergency dental procedure, and I must say that it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. As someone with a phobia of dentists, I was terrified. To my delight, Dr. Kimberley Nguyen and her team at Tru Dentistry exceeded my expectations in every way possible.

From the moment I stepped into the beautifully designed facility, I was greeted warmly by the gentlemen at the front desk. Their friendly demeanor immediately put me at ease, and their attentiveness to my needs made me feel welcomed and valued as a patient.

The true highlight of my visit was meeting Dr. Nguyen. Not only is she exceptionally intelligent and knowledgeable in her field, but she also possesses a remarkable ability to provide comfort and reassurance to patients with dental phobia. Dr. Nguyen went above and beyond to accommodate my specific concerns, taking the time to understand my fears and ensure that I felt safe throughout the procedure.

What impressed me the most about Dr. Nguyen was her unwavering commitment to my overall well-being. She took into account my pre-existing health issues and disabilities, and with great care, she tailored the treatment to meet my unique needs. Her compassion, patience, and professionalism were evident in every interaction, and I felt genuinely cared for throughout the process.

Thanks to Dr. Nguyen's exceptional care, I can confidently say that she has become my dentist for life. Her expertise and understanding of dental phobia have transformed my perception of dental visits. For the first time, I found myself feeling calm and even comfortable in the dentist's chair. My procedure was completely painless and she even stayed late that evening to call and ensure I was okay afterwards.

Tru Dentistry as a whole deserves high praise for maintaining a beautiful facility that creates a welcoming and soothing atmosphere. The commitment of the staff, including the amazing gentlemen at the front desk, further enhances the overall experience. They truly understand the importance of creating a positive and inclusive environment for all patients.

If you are someone with dental phobia, specific health concerns, or just in need of a fantastic dentist, I highly recommend Tru Dentistry, and particularly Dr. Kimberley Nguyen. Her exceptional intelligence, comforting demeanor, and willingness to go above and beyond to accommodate individual needs set her apart. I am grateful to have found such an outstanding dental office, and I look forward to continuing my dental care with Dr. Nguyen and the team at Tru Dentistry for years to come.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabby DeJesus
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice people , and very clean place! BUT WOW  it’s very expensive here  ! I been trying to look for a dental place that i can go get some work done , and get a second opinion ,so i been to a few dental place but this one was the most expensive ! I was quoted for an implant a pretty crazy amount, and then i just received a bill in the mail for the portion that my insurance couldn’t cover , so after they paid a portion i still owe almost $300 just for some X-rays , I am sure they’re great at want they do just make sure you have amazing insurance!  Honestly there’s a lot of great dentist in south Austin and more affordable!

user_reviews_extended.Description: TRU Dentistry is the best dentist I've ever been to! Dr Hollinger is super sweet and does the cleanings herself instead of leaving it to the assistant, as many dentists do. She does a stellar job too! Alex, the receptionist, is amazing. He worked with me on payments while I was waiting for my dental insurance to kick in, and has been super responsive and helpful whenever I've had questions. I can't recommend TRU Dentistry enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eros Vela
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Super attentive and very hospitable dental work.
Jessica the dentist did a great job on my whitening and made sure to pay close attention to me while she worked. She’s very kind and caters to my teeth very carefully and diligently. The handsome gentleman up front chase is always so patient with me and has put up with my tardiness to well. I appreciate all the great work that tru dentistry does for me the staff is great and does a phenomenal job on dental and ortho related issues.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elisia Velasquez

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Iwabuchi
