The atmosphere is clean & welcoming, & they let you watch Netflix while you’re getting your teeth worked on (: I seriously can’t rave about the people enough. They make a note to remember your name, they do extra things to make sure you’re comfortable, and make sure you leave with a cleaner, bigger smile.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabrielle Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Tru dentistry Austin was able to get me in as a new patient quick and easy! I met with Dr.Nguyen who was amazing! They take an awesome scan of your teeth and show you what you could look like if you wanted to correct your bite.
Reef the hygienist was great and was super gental while cleaning which I really appreciate!
If you’re looking for a new dental office, look no further. Tru Dentistry is an office that can take care of all of your dental needs. I will be recommending them to all my friends and family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Morgan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just went to Tru Dentistry Austin for the very first time today and I was thoroughly impressed. Dr. Hollinger and all of her staff couldn't have been more friendly and accommodating. The office itself was beautiful and immaculately clean, and the work I had done was quick, painless, and comprehensive ... in short, everything you'd want from a dentist. They also take plenty of different insurances here. Very highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laurie Comeaux
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff are actually happy people doing their jobs. Everyone is warm, welcoming and friendly.  They genuinely care about their patients.  For those folks who suffer from dental anxiety they have a resident therapy dog to calm your fears and anxiety. Amazing place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have to give this office a 5 STAR!!!!!  I have gone to the same dental hygienist and dentist for 12 years!  I needed a closer and more convenient location! From walking in to TRU Dentistry and being sweetly greeted by Alex, to the kind and most professional assistant Zandra, and the most gentle and awesome doctor Dr. Hollinger! Let's just say I have found my new dental home!  I loved an office where patient care is first and foremost the importance of each individual.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wesley Faulkner
user_reviews_extended.Description: The visit here was an excellent experience. I was greeted by a friendly face at the front desk. I had a casual brief conversation with the dentist before I even finished filling out the intake forms. The dental hygienist explained everything to me and gave me tips on cleaning that I have never heard of. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a great and kind environment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashton Correll
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a good experience here at Tru dentistry! Love that this place is like home, everyone here is always so warm and welcoming.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicky Cadman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I still remember the first conversation I had when I called TruDentistry. I was in tears explaining the situation with my car accident and how two prior dentists had messed up my crowns. Alex’s first response was “things will be different here.”
That was three years ago, and I don’t think I’ve ever been more amazed with the time and patience the entire staff gives to their patients. Alex, Chase, Ashton and Dr. H have all been truly phenomenal🖤

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Dalton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great experience with TRU dentistry.  From the moment you walk in you will be greeted by Chase, the owner of TRU dentistry, who is amazing in all aspects of the experience, even willing to help with insurance issues that might arise!!  The staff provides excellent service - being very knowledgable and willing to answer any questions you have, meanwhile creating an extremely friendly environment.

On top of that, if you're looking to continue your latest Netflix binge they have tv's set up you can enjoy during cleanings.

Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawn Dhammi
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a pleasant, thorough, and quick experience -- at the dentist no less! Doctor Hollinger personally cleaned my teeth - been a long time since my teeth were cleaned by anyone but a hygienist. She also walked me through all the progressions and things I need to watch out for instead of just talking over my head or simply not explaining what is going on. Glad I found a wonderful dentist in Austin, finally.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Iulia Enea
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an awesome experience at Tru Dentistry. I was very impressed by the high technology used: at the first appointment I received a comprehensive oral evaluation and a treatment plan explained very clearly. Dr Hollinger is a true professional, very gentle and warm personality. Her work is exquisite. The staff is great, always ready to help and answering any question one may have. I highly recommend TRU Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: DeNeshia Echols
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was very nice and welcoming. The dentist explained everything thoroughly. However, I would advise you list the services you don’t do so people won’t waste their time and money. The website stated they perform extractions, but it doesn’t state they don’t do wisdom teeth extractions. I was in pain and needed that tooth gone. Had it listed on the website they don’t extract wisdom teeth, I would’ve never scheduled the appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L K
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great experience with a phenomenal staff! Chase and alex at the front are so warm and welcoming. From the minute you check in, walking through finances yo check out, they are so helpful every step of the way. Dr
Hollinger and the hygienist, Ashton, are friendly, gentle and walk you through your appointment keeping you informed. I always feel confident coming to this office knowing i’m in great hands and feel taken care of. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Spielman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn’t been to the dentist in ages because of a bad experience in the past. As a result, I had a number of problems that needed to be addressed. When 2 of my crowns cracked and I was in extreme pain, TruDentistry gave me an emergency appointment. The entire staff is well-trained, personable and incredibly kind. I’m really quite fortunate that I found them. My “dentist phobia” is thing of the past.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Nemes
user_reviews_extended.Description: It wasn't too long ago that I would avoid the dentist just based on past poor experiences. I had anxiety about going to the dentist and always felt dread walking through those doors. That all changed when I started going to TRU Dentistry. Dr Hollinger and her staff are friendly, welcoming, and professional but in a laid back environment. No longer do I feel any sort of anxiety about my dental care.  I'd highly suggest this practice if you're looking for a dentist in south Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: The front receptionist boy is so nice.  He makes you feel welcome and brightens up your day.  Dr. Hollinger is amazing .  The dental hygienist named Ashton was very thorough in her cleanings and very informative.   If you want to be treated like family you need to go to this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Noel Morales
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best Dentistry I’ve been to! This was actually the second time I visited this location. It’s awesome! Everyone is great, happy and helped me a lot! I’ve had a total of 3 teeth extractions here and I wouldn’t go anywhere else. Quick and fast but still gentle. Not as expensive as others or long wait times!

Dr. Hollinger is the BEST!!!🎉🎊🎉

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melodi E
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really nice/cool and accommodating staff. Dr. Hollinger was awesome, very meticulous, and knowledgeable. I was able to quickly get an appointment and get all my dental work addressed. Cute office and overall a great experience. I had been with my childhood family dentist and needed to find an austin doc and am glad I found this local gem.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Atwood
user_reviews_extended.Description: TRU Dentistry goes above and beyond to make the experience in their chair is comfortable. The Dr. & Staff are friendly and take the time to really talk with you making sure the patient is informed. I always leave feeling they actually care about my oral health and well being. Thank you to the TRU Dentistry Team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: OldmanG
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at TRU were great!!! They were Friendly bust most important COMFORTING!! Great options for payment so u don’t feel overwhelmed by the bill. Ashton was the 1st face I saw and she was awesome at making me feel welcomed and knew I was in the right spot. Not to take anything away from the rest of the staff they were all just as awesome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eva Hansson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came here to get a crown done and was really nervous since I have never had one before, but I had a really good experience with Dr. Hollinger! The office is modern, clean, and they provided headphones and a blanket which helped me relax. Dr. Hollinger and her assistant did a good explaining the process to me and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the treatment. I highly recommend this office, I’ll definitely be coming back for my cleanings!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ricky Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service overall! Came here for a second opinion and found out I didn’t need as much dental work as another dentist had suggested. I didn’t feel like I was nickel and dimmed and the staff was super transparent about what I actually needed. Finally found a dentist in Austin that I trust! Also, love that they are LGBTQIA+ friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brennan Rex
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went here a few years back and a dog jumped in my lap while i was getting novocaine. Forgot all about this until today when it came up in conversation about therapy dogs and I can't believe that happened or that I didn't say anything at the time. I don't like dogs and did not request a therapy animal, and I had a lot of discomfort about an animal in a medical setting around
sterile instruments meant to go in my mouth and into my gums.

I found this wildly unprofessional,  found another dentist, and hope that this is no longer a feature.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tricia Thorson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tru Dentistry is the best!! The front desk staff was extremely welcoming and happy to be there. The office is very well designed, calming, and stocked with the most modern tools and technology, plus TV's in the rooms! Dr. Hollinger is awesome. She's friendly, professional, and genuinely excited about dentistry and helping you with your problems. Will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Grills
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was terrific at Tru Dentistry! It began with the quick scheduling of my appointment by the friendly, extra helpful Chase, the young man at the front desk, continued with the patient and kind Amber, the dental assistant, and ended successfully with Dr. Hollinger’s fine work. Easy no pay parking as well. I’ll be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Triana Cover
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was nervous about finding a new dentist because I just moved to Austin but the staff at TRU Dentistry was so welcoming I immediately felt at home! Dr. Hollinger was very informative and easy to talk to. I learned a lot from my visit and also felt the team was very transparent about dentistry options. Will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Batt
user_reviews_extended.Description: TRU Dentistry is wonderful! I chose TRU for a routine cleaning after my previous dentist could not fit me in. I'm happy to say I'll be sticking with TRU going forward! Dr. Hollinger, Alex and Jaime were so welcoming! I felt like I had been a patient of theirs for years. Thanks TRU team - love y'all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiernan Rien
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best! Everyone in the office is absolutely awesome. This was my first time back to the dentist and I am so happy I chose them. They're professional, friendly and super talented. Seriously awesome experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy Talamantez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From my first visit I felt more than welcomed and like a friend more than a patient. It had been some time since I had been to a dentist knowing that I would need a lot of work; and I have a strong case of white coat syndrome. I did my initial consultation and Dr. Hollinger was more than confident in being able to help me without having to refer me out to a specialist. I had so many questions and the staff was more than happy to answer them all, multiple times. When I arrived for my appointment I was greeted and made sure I was comfortable and relaxed. Dr. Hollinger and Jessica have the absolute best chair side manner! They could almost read each others minds and were on the same wavelength during the procedure and constantly made sure I was comfortable. After they were finished with the extensive procedure they comforted me noticing I was worked up and tense. A couple days later Dr. Hollinger personally called to check on my recovery and we confirmed a day for a post op exam. I’m actually now excited to go back to the dentist for follow up work!

I can not thank Dr. Hollinger and ALL staff enough for making this the best experience I’ve had in a medical atmosphere!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Pilat
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have to start off by saying WOW Tru is the most clean, easy going office I have ever been to! Dr. Hollinger is AMAZING! She is gentle, kind and very knowledgeable! I was able to get same day treatment done after my cleaning and everything went very smooth! Everyone in the office is super sweet and honestly I forgot I was even getting dental work done! I highly recommend Tru Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Maske
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love TRU dentistry! Great dentist and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Penna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Being a dental professional myself, I’m very pleased and excited to be a patient here! Everyone is so welcoming and passionate about the dental field. Very professional, immaculate, and modern establishment with top of line dental equipment. Thank you to everyone on the Tru Team for exceeding my expectations! Leaving with so much confidence in my smile and couldn’t be more pleased. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Roman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is by far the best Dentistry I have ever been to. As soon as you walk in the people at the front are smiling and happily great you. Chase and Alex make sure you are taken care of and that everything from scheduling to insurance is flawless and precise. They always take great care of every individual that comes in. I’ve even asked them to call a friend who was too scared to deal with the hassle and fears of getting teeth worked on. And now, they’re all set up and rocking their Invisalign too. They truly care about helping you and making sure you’re happy with your teeth, smile and overall well being.

Dr. Hollinger is an amazing Dentist. Super nice, very careful, gentle as can be and personable like a friend. I’ve had some discomfort before from previous Dentist whom I’ve seen (hence the reason for now choosing Tru Dentistry) but with Dr. Hollinger it was easy and painless. I can’t stress enough about the ease I have now knowing I don’t have to dread ever getting my teeth worked on or cleaned. I’m going to continue recommending and giving out their business cards because it’s a necessity to take care of your mouth, and it shouldn’t for any reason be a chore or stressful.

You won’t have a bad experience here. From the moment you walk in to even after you leave. You’ll feel good about your choice. I just finished my last tray of Invisalign and I love my smile now. Whatever you need done, these people will help you and make it easy, I can’t recommend this place enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: emre gebes
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you have any kind of dentophobia I definitely recommend you to visit Dr Samantha and her amazing crew. I had broken and buried roots she made extraction smoothly and nicely.Everything was perfect. If you have little anxiety go ahead and make your reservation get over it They will take good care about you Thank you again

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jae Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the BEST dentist I've ever been to!!! I had to get a route canal and cap. I went to another dentist office 1st and they told me they would have to refer me out to a specialist to get the route canal done because they didn't feel confident enough to do it cause they couldn't see the nerve.  Then I would come back to them to get the cap on, that was going to be $2200 and the actual route canal from the specialist was another $2500. I knew I could find a dentist confident enough to do it all and way less expensive.  I called TRU Dentistry and I was beyond impressed! The Dr, her staff, EVERYONE was happy to be there and so passionate about what they do. I've never experienced this in my life from a dentist office.  This will be my forever home♡

user_reviews_extended.Name: Z L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow, I’m so sad I learned about this place my last week in Austin! I’m moving out of the country and I started to get some tooth pain so I figured I’d better go get it looked at; my regular dentist didn’t have time but these folks fit me in. I figured I’d also get a cleaning while I was there and they did an awesome job, explained the tooth pain in clear terms and helped me resolve it ... and charged me half price because they knew about my moving expenses! The dentist and dental hygienist were both that perfect mix of professional and good-humored that leaves you feeling confident but not cold. Actually everyone in the office was friendly, which isn’t always the case at doctors offices during Covid (hard to blame them but still). I like my old dentist but had I known about this place I definitely would have picked them as my primary. I probably won’t ever go to this office again since our time in Austin is up, but I can at least confidently send other folks their way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madeline Hume
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love them at tru! They’re so friendly and made my first time back to the dentist in too long a breeze. I also love that Dr Samantha brings her sweet pup to the office sometimes to make patients feel comfortable. Thanks ladies!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candice R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have a fear of going to the dentist because of fear and the expense. The staff really eliminated all of my fears. The Hygienist was so gentle and friendly. The staff helped me feel really comfortable and took the time to address all of my concerns. The billing process was explained and the staff didn’t make me feel any pressure about going beyond my financial means. This was by far the best dental experience I have ever had!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Sharp
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone in the office was super nice and knowledgeable but most importantly, made me feel comfortable. I hadn't been to the dentist in 20 years, never liked going so if nothing hurt, I didn't feel the need to go. From the moment I walked in the door, I felt at ease, which is uber-high on my list of must haves. I was offered a blanket and earphones to calm me if I wanted them 😁   From the x-rays, to the exam and the cleaning, everything was explained all the way through, so I knew exactly what was going on and why it was happening. Going back in 6 months for my next cleaning, woo-hoo. Not waiting another 20 years!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Simmons
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just moved back to Austin and was looking for a new dentist office and kept hearing great things about this place from many people so decided to give it a try. From start to finish everyone I talked to was very informative, and made me feel at ease. I can honestly say I’ve never had so much fun at the dentist before. I am sold on the Tru Crew and want to encourage everyone to give them a try, you won’t regret it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lena
user_reviews_extended.Description: TRUly a wonderful experience! A super cute & modern office in such a convenient location. Upon arrival, the place had a real Austin vibe to it & the staff is so friendly. They really care about their patients and made going to the dentist a breeze. Dr. Hollinger is very informative & calmed my dental nerves. Plus she’s got a bubbly personality. Again, Austin vibes all around. Recommend this place to everyone :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley McDonnell
user_reviews_extended.Description: New to Austin and would not recommend this location. The dentist was nice but the cleaning was a mess and was so rushed. I didn’t feel that I had enough time to actually talk to the dentist or for her to get to know me as a recurring patient, I was being pushed out the door as fast as possible. For those who are nervous about new dentists like me, I would recommend elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: RIVA Wellness (Riva Z. Robinson, MD)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I chipped my bottom tooth last night, called Tru this morning, and they were able to get me in by 9am. WOW!

It was my first time visiting Dr. Hollinger, and she was so friendly and attentive. I loved meeting her therapy dog Lucy, too!

This was one of the fastest, friendliest dental office visits I’ve ever had. And it won’t be my last ☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler English
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at TRU Dentistry Austin. They got me in and out quickly. My dentist provided lots of information to help keep my teeth healthy at home. Excellent service, clean facility and a comfortable experience. I highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: daniel wilkinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had not been to the dentist in years and I was ashamed at the poor state my teeth were in.  It took a bad tooth infection and a neccessary emergency extraction to get me back in to see the dentist.  I cannot say enough about courteous, professional, and accommodating treatment that I recieved.   Dr. Samantha, Alex, Jaime, Ashton, and the whole team went above and beyond.  I am now back on track to healthy teeth and gums and much more smiling!  Good people highly reccomend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Sauer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Let me start this by saying I was VERY happy to have found TRU Dentistry. It’s been more years than I’d like to admit since I’ve had a cleaning... I was greeted with a smile by Alex at the front desk on both visits I’ve made so far. Amanda & Dr. Hollinger were the ones who did my cleaning. They let me know that it would be a bit of a deep cleaning since it’d been a while since I’ve gone to a dentist, but they were very patient with me and did an excellent job to make sure I was comfortable throughout the entire cleaning! Next on the agenda, I was in need of a new retainer since my old one of 7 years had not been fitting properly for months due to not wearing it enough. So on my second visit they did a 3D mapping of my teeth, instead of that nasty foam fitting trays like the old days. They got me set up with a express Invisalign, so in 50 days my smile would be right back to the original place it was when I got my braces removed over 7 years ago! The best part is I keep the Invisalign trays for if my teeth ever shift again to realign them!
All around the best experience I could ask for and will continue to come back for any dental work I need!
Thank you TRU Dentistry team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lex Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall, I felt taken care of as a patient. Very thorough cleaning. It took longer than I was expecting but that could have mostly been due to the fact that they were helping a new trainee and I hadn't had a cleaning since pre-pandemic. I also wish that the Dr would have spent a bit more time assessing and addressing the sensitivity and pain that I was experiencing in one tooth, but to her credit, she referred me to a really good Endodontist that did a thorough review before proceeding with a root canal.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana Bora
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient of Dr. Samantha Hollinger for a year now and am compelled to recommend her! She has great bedside manner and is always very considerate of my financial concerns when discussing treatment options. Dr. Hollinger is also just a nice, genuine person and someone I’ve grown to trust. Thanks, TRU Dentistry! 🦷

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah B.
user_reviews_extended.Description: When a piece of a silver filling I've had since childhood broke off, I called for a consultation. They were able to get me in quickly. After a consultation with Dr. Hollinger, I decided to replace both of my silver fillings. She filled two new small cavities as well. At my request, she did all if this without novocaine and was great about letting me have breaks when the sensation got to be too much, which I know made her job harder and took more time. She was respectful of my wishes and made me feel like it wasn't a problem at all for her to spend the extra time. I am sensitive about getting X-Rays and they were amenable to only taking what was absolutely needed for this visit. Dr. Hollinger and her staff were friendly and welcoming.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sofia Aponte
user_reviews_extended.Description: These people are the best dentists and the sweetest humans. My experience here is always painless and comfortable, with Lucy- their pet dog- on my lap and Netflix playing in my room. I love it here I highly recommend for any of your dentistry needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriella Ruiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience here was great. The Dr thoroughly explained everything that needed to be done. I have severe anxiety and she put that at ease as well as the nurses. I couldn’t have felt more comfortable. Thank you Tru Dentistry for taking me in so fast.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eleanor Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: After years of avoiding the dentist I found Dr Hollinger and am starting to get over my dental phobia. I’ve had two crowns done with this practice and through the intake, annual clean, initial treatment plan, and execution I couldn’t be happier. The hygienist, assistants, and Dr Hollinger were all very understanding and patient, the process and pricing was transparent and reasonable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenafer Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Man every time I go in there it’s such a great experience.... for the freaking dentist. What I dig the most is how upfront and honest dr. Hollinger is! I like being told what’s up right then and there with information and facts and man, she’s got it. She’s very gentle and sweet and cute n cool as is everyone else who works there. Especially Chase! You don’t get many sweet dudes like him in this world!! You can tell they all love what they do and that just makes the experience so pleasant and comfortable! 10/10 - goooooo!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarrah Brooke Sheppard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Tru Dentistry for over a year now. They are so WONDERFUL!! I highly recommend them! The staff is awesome and always so friendly. Also, Dr. Hollinger is super relatable and kind! They’ve gotten me back on track with the health and wellness of my teeth and mouth— without making me feel totally guilty about not always flossing! Moreover, it’s such a breeze sitting in their chair watching Netflix while they go to work. Definitely visit them! You’ll love your experience!! 🌟🦷🌟

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Copija
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven’t been to the Dentist in awhile, and I must say that this the BEST visit EVER!! Very comfortable and attentive staff. Everyone is so friendly and absolutely knows their teeth! Come here for excellent care! See you soon Doc

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larry Lehew
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was able to get in at kind of the last minute.  A big part of my tooth was gone and there was a lot of pain. They set me up great for an endodontist to finish a root canal in about an hour. Replacing the temp crown the following morning.   My one fear is the dentist and they treated me really well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Pilat
user_reviews_extended.Description: At first I was scared to go to the dentist, but when I met Dr Hollinger she made me feel unbelievably comfortable and at ease. We started my Veneers today and I never would have imagined having such a great time and experience at the dentist. Dr Hollinger was very confident and professional as well as the rest of the staff! IM SO EXCITED FOR MY BEAUTIFUL SMILE!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: tom ricks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really like this place. The fact that dogs are hanging out is a good sign. But the staff is nice, helpful and efficient, too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had to go as a emergency. They had no problem fitting me in. All employees very friendly and helpful. I have never enjoyed going to the dentist but they sure made my experience awesome. I will for sure be back for future issues.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you to the team and Dr Hollinger! I’m in the dental field and know how important it is to make your patients feel comfortable when in your office however when it’s your family it’s even more important. My sister had an emergency over the weekend and Alex quickly responded and was able to get her taken care of today. Thank you for treating my sister with excellent chairside service and for the doctor- she said you were amazing!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vikky Vikky
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best service ever! Dr. Nichole Kostiuk is a high-qualified dentist! She can deal with any kind of problem! Have pain or issue go to Tru Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renee Buikema
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really love TRU! I appreciate how welcoming, friendly, and relaxed the environment is. They go above and beyond by walking you through all of your X-rays and photos to tell you what they see and help you understand your teeth better! Highly recommend going here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Les Weiler
user_reviews_extended.Description: In quick (check up and getting a dental plan going for cleanings and such). Staff was polite and friendly. They explained everything they were doing, and the bill. Found my new dentist, I think.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Weiss
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and knowledgeable.   They explain everything so well that it made us feel very comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Gale
user_reviews_extended.Description: My appointment was after the ice storms cleared up and everything was back to business. I had to cancel my appointment, and tried calling and emailing multiple times that day. Checked their socials and website to see if they were having any issues and nothing was posted. Luckily I didn’t show up. Turned out they had a downed tree and no power still. Sure not a big deal, except they could of posted on social or their website. It took them many weeks to get back in contact with me and the person on the phone was rude and hung up when I expressed frustrations over a reschedule date many months out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julian Bauers
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is amazing from the dental team down to the reception and customer service.
They are very personable and professional.
I am always relaxed and looking forward to my next visit with Tru dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsey LeFevre
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tru dentistry is truly the best!! From their friendly staff to their clean facility and not to mention their fast service! title: Alta Dental
address: 6104 S 1st St STE 103, Austin, TX 78745, United States

user_reviews.Name: Hannah Lee
user_reviews.Description:
I have been going to Alta dental for several years and in that time there have been many change overs in staff and management. Dr. Groh and Dr. Gao were both incredible and helped change my life for the better. Unfortunately, the new doctor and the new management team have been so unhelpful and actually disrespectful. I spent months playing phone tag with them and they never called me back and they never sent me confirmations and never told me when they cancelled appointments. Dr.Lin told my wife her mouth was "like a toilet" and both her cap and filling fell out only a few months after getting them. She also seems to always pick the cheapest quickest options instead of the options that will last longer and look best. If I needed the cheaper option I would appreciate that but having it be something I will have to repay for later is not what I would want.

Very sad Dr. Gao is no longer there as I owe a lot to her helping me improve my confidence and I hope she is doing well.

Unfortunately, I do not recommend going to Alta Dental anymore until they fix their customer service. I will not be going back.

user_reviews.Name: Kristen A
user_reviews.Description: I have been so happy with my experience at Alta Dental! Everyone is very nice and welcoming, as well as caring and receptive to your needs. As someone who waited too long to go to a dentist and ALSO has big white coat syndrome, I feel very respected and supported here. Dr. Lin is very good at checking in, answering questions, relieving your worries, and making the experience as pain free and pleasant as possible. Heads up though that their parking lot always seems full, and people often park along the curb which makes it hard for cars in spots to leave.

user_reviews.Name: Autumn Casarez
user_reviews.Description: The team at Alta Dental was so welcoming, supportive and thorough. They did an amazing job with my hyper sensitive gums and made sure I was comfortable the entire time. I don’t want to go to any other dentist. Thanks again!

user_reviews.Name: Dylan Collins
user_reviews.Description: Came in for an emergency filling and they got me in right away and fixed the tooth in about 20 minutes! Such an easy and friendly experience! Can’t thank them enough for helping me such last minute! Also had some good jams playing in the exam room

user_reviews.Name: Logan Cowley
user_reviews.Description: From the moment I walked through the door, the staff was incredibly welcoming and friendly. My hygienist did an amazing job and checked in with me regarding some issues that had occurred previously with sensitivity in my teeth. I could tell they value me as a patient, and I appreciate their consistent efforts to improve the experience.

user_reviews.Name: Trezz Bailey
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been going to Alta Dental for a few years now. The staff is very friendly and welcoming. They try to make your experience as comfortable as possible. The care given by the dentist & assistants is also top tier. They walk you through exactly what they are doing as they do it and are always happy to provide additional insight.

user_reviews.Name: Jessi Roesch
user_reviews.Description: Been going here for years! The staff is very kind and accommodating with schedules. If you don't have insurance, their pricing is very competitive for out of pocket costs or in-house insurance. Gentle and knowledgeable hygienists.

user_reviews.Name: Adara Ostdiek
user_reviews.Description: I felt so compelled to leave this review after receiving such great care by Dr. Lin and her team. I hadn’t been to the dentist in about a decade and was super anxious. I made an appointment with Alta and opted for their “membership plan” and paid out of pocket. Let me just say. I did a TON of research, read reviews on best places to go to in town and I’m SO GLAD I found Alta. My first appointment I got X-rays, cleaning and a treatment plan for some work I needed done. Their team laid out everything I would need to pay BEFORE getting the work done and were super flexible about spacing out my appointments in a timeframe that worked for me. I was a bit embarrassed about the length of time but Dr. Lin was so reassuring I never felt uncomfortable or like I was pushed to do anything I didn’t need to do! (Like some other places reviews say 😅) It feels like a huge weight has been lifted off me and my teeth look and feel great. Also they even gave me a gift card at the end of all of my treatment :) Telling all of my south Austin friends about Alta!

user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I walked into Alta Dental, I knew I was in good hands. Estephaney greeted me at the front with a warm smile and a great sense of humor—instantly putting me at ease. America handled my trays and was incredibly efficient, precise, and impressively light-handed. She made the whole process feel effortless. Dr. Gao was just as amazing—attentive, kind, and working with a gentle yet meticulous touch that really shows her expertise. The entire team made what could have been a stressful visit feel smooth and even enjoyable. Easily a 5-star experience all around!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at Alta Dental! The office manager and doctors are professional, friendly, and truly care about their patients. Highly recommend this office for anyone looking for quality dental care in a welcoming environment!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a really pleasant experience when I came in for my cleaning. The staff here is very professional and also very welcoming and kind. Highly recommend Alta Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Description: The team here is excellent—friendly, professional, and great to interact with. Coming from Canada, I was only familiar with manual dental tools, so experiencing hypersonic cleaning for the first time was a shock. However, after three visits, their expertise and technique have completely changed my opinion. Now, I actually appreciate the process and the results. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Stover
user_reviews_extended.Description: Definitely the best care I have ever received! Estephaney greeted me with a smile and made me feel like we had known each other forever-she made the whole check in process personable, welcoming, and put me at ease.  Dr Gao was so caring and genuinely talked to me about concerns I was having as well as tips and explained my treatment to me in a way that I wasn't left overwhelmed or confused.  I definitely recommend checking them out, especially if you are like me and have some anxiety and fear behind being at the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Front desk staff were very nice. Carina was my hygienist and she was very thorough and gentle. Would definitely recommend this office to family or friends

user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist and her staff were all so amazing. I told them my concerns and fears prior to scheduling to ensure they could help me get the care I needed. Christina assured me things would go well and would make sure I was comfortable throughout my visit. They all delivered as promised.  I will definitely be going back and recommending to my family/friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jackie Ontiveros
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit to the Alta Dental was excellent! The pre-filled forms made check-in quick and easy, and the pricing was transparent with clear explanations of coverage. The dentist walked me through my x-rays, explaining what was being measured and how my dental hygiene could be tailored to my specific anatomy and gum health. She provided practical advice to reverse and prevent common issues, all without judgment. We created a clear plan moving forward, and for the first time in a long time, I left feeling motivated rather than apprehensive about routine dental visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Satterwhite
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had my first dental appointment at Alta Dental office and was incredibly impressed. The staff was welcoming and friendly. Estephaney at the front desk was so helpful and kind. I would highly recommend this Dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caleb Alexandra
user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone with a lot of anxiety around dentists, I will only go here. The staff at Alta are so friendly, patient, soothing and go at a slow pace.  Dr. Gao is very matter of fact in her communication and poised in her presence, very easy to put my confidence into her.  Today I got anesthesia injections in my gums and she had a staff member apply a face massager as she told me exercises to be doing with my body to distract me from the pain. I haven't had experiences with healthcare providers across the board showing so much care and professionalism.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daleysha Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very fast and friendly! Aside from the actual appointment, Estephaney is amazing, I was feeling a little light headed when I came in and she gave me refreshments and made sure I was okay! Wonderful staff you all have!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marsh D
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently visited Alta Dental and had the absolute pleasure of being treated by Dr. Groh, and I can confidently say that my experience was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment I walked through the door, I was greeted with warmth and friendliness that immediately put me at ease. The entire staff at Alta Dental is incredibly nice—unlike any other dentist's office I have ever been to.

Dr. Groh and her team are the epitome of professionalism. They took the time to carefully explain every aspect of my treatment, ensuring I fully understood their conclusions and recommendations. This level of attention to detail and patient care is truly rare, and I deeply appreciated their commitment to making me feel comfortable and informed.

I have never had a more pleasant dental experience in my life. Dr. Groh's expertise, combined with the genuine kindness of the staff, has completely changed the way I view dental visits. I can honestly say that I cannot see myself going to another dentist after experiencing her practice. And trust me, that is not hyperbole. Alta Dental has set a new standard for what dental care should be, and I am beyond grateful to have found such an incredible dentist. Highly, highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ddot921
user_reviews_extended.Description: Like most people, I don't love going to the dentist. I went to Alta for what turned out to be some pretty extensive work- four extractions, bone grafts, and some deep cleaning. Dr. Groh and her staff made the entire experience pleasant, and mostly pain free. Everyone is extremely friendly and professional, and it will definitely be my regular dentist for as long as I stay in Austin.  I couldn't be happier with my experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Flinn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff and experience at Alta
Dental has been first class since I started seeing them a few years back. I couldn’t be happier with their services and level of care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelley Wang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Alta for a few years now and the team has always been fantastic but I wanted to share my experience with the new dentist Dr Lin.

She does incredible dental work for front teeth - I had a few old fillings that needed replacing and nervous because they were my front two teeth. She did such an amazing restorative job and they look so much better than before- also, you would never be able to tell they aren’t my natural teeth.

I highly recommend her, especially if you need work on your front teeth. She’s also extremely lovely and cares a lot about her patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: McKenna Greenwood
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am not a fan of going to the dentist and was nervous because it had been a while since I went to get my teeth checked. However, Dr. Groh and her staff (I believe her assistant's name was Letty) were unbelievable nice and did their best to make me feel comfortable. They are willing to answer any questions and hold good conversation between working. The lady at the front desk (I don't want to butcher her name) was kind and answered so many questions for me to help me understand insurance. I am grateful to have found this wonderful dentist and staff at Alta Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m leaving 2 stars because I’m nice lol. First offense for me was having ZERO technicians when I went for an appointment. I drove all the way here to have no one in the office? And it was the middle of the day, not sure how it can be so understaffed. Also, the cleaning didn’t leave that WOW factor afterwards. Actually, the cleaning technician even got the top of my tooth with a cleaning drill and left the smalllesssssttt barely noticeable chip but hey, that’s business! So, to avoid that I’m going somewhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Ive been coming here since 2021 and I love this office. The staff here is kind, compassionate, caring and filled with grace. It is their desire to ensure quality service to each patient. I was not able to make it in for a cleaning during 2023. I walked into the office and the front staff knew my name and genuinely remembered me. Honestly its these details that keep life long customers coming back. I don't ever want to go to another dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casey Kidwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall great experience! Everyone is super friendly and my office visits are quick and easy! Alta Dental has helped me manage my teeth grinding as well which has drastically improved my teeth and quality of sleep, too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raul S. Casso
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Yiwei Gao has been my dentist for 13 months. She's very knowledgeable and explains every little detail to you about your dental needs. The staff was also exceptional. I highly recommend Alta Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Degnan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Highly recommend!! The support staff are friendly and always had a sense of urgency and gave me the impression that they value their patients time and do everything to make the visit as efficient as possible which is great because no one enjoys going to the dentist.

The dentist is friendly and knowledgeable and made sure that i left with a full treatment plan printed out which  included  a cost breakdown. Plus, I was in an out in less than an hour which was amazing .

So, if your looking for a good quality affordable dentist in Austin I  highly recommend giving Alta Dental a try.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blythe Rutherford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Alta Dental has been everything I needed from a dentist and more. The dentist is always so sweet and nice. She always tells me what she’s doing and why she’s doing it which I really appreciate. She also makes sure that I’m comfortable and not in any pain throughout the whole process. Filled in my cavities and I didn’t feel a thing! She definitely knows what she’s doing. I’ve had some problems with my teeth for the past 8 years and I’m very happy I chose Alta Dental to fix them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Macke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Alta Dental! Been going for years and they are always quick and helpful ☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m generally a dentist’s worst nightmare because of how sensitive I am but Dr. Hannah Groh is so incredibly good at her job. She maintains heavy communication throughout the process and is extremely patient with me. I’ve had numerous visits and it never ceases to amaze me how kind and meticulously cautious she is when she works with me and I can’t recommend her enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ajay Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient at Alta Dental for almost two years. Assuming it doesn't change, I have no plans to switch providers. Everyone is so nice and friendly, and I actually look forward to my appointments. I feel everyone from reception, to the hygienists, to Dr. Groh are effectively communicative and truly care that I understand what's happening with my dental health. I highly recommend Alta Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Helen L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Groh and her entire team are wonderful!  From dental implants to root canals, I received the most compassionate care I could of ever asked for.  I am so happy with the quality of all dental work that was completed. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renan Branco
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience. I scheduled an appointment to fix a chipped tooth. The staff was very friendly and welcoming. They took x-rays and explained the costs. Dr. Groh was very pleasant and competent, explaining everything throughout the procedure, and I had my tooth fixed on the same day. And the cost was very affordable, considering I don't have dental insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa K
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Groh and the hygienist did a great job with my initial appointment today. I have some dental anxiety and felt like everyone was very friendly and knowledgeable and I felt very comfortable. I will be happy to return to the office for continuing care. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dat V
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at Alta Dental with Dr. Hannah Groh! I needed some dental fillings and Dr. Groh along with her team did an amazing job. Besides her expertise,  Dr. Groh has great bedside manners, she makes the experience so much better and painless. I would recommend anyone who needs some dental work to check Alta Dental out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chandler Shea
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have autism and getting my teeth cleaned is truly my worst nightmare (it hurts my mind, body AND soul). Thankfully, Alta Dental understood when I said “I have autism” and Lisa changed how she did certain aspects of the teeth cleaning, all the while, checking in on how I was doing. This experience was fantastic- highly recommend for anyone ASD!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Emmert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Diamond and the rest of her staff are truly amazing. I've never particularly loved going to the Dentist, but Dr. Diamond not only makes the experience painless, but it's also actually quite enjoyable. The appointment times are accurate (9:00 am appointment means you will be in the dentist's chair at 9:00 am), they review all procedures with your insurance before you make any decisions and my teeth are pearly white/clean after my bi-annual checkup. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edna Vazquez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is very friendly and on point! Everybody was very objective and clear about what it needed to be done for my teeth.  Dr. Chelsea was very kind and ordered x rays, she immediately knew what was going on, and what needed to be done!
Im not from this town, but she saw me that same day as an emergency! My insurance didn’t cover for this and I was charged $50 for everything! Very affordable for a touring musician!
I highly recommend this place!🙏🏽
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Arthur

user_reviews_extended.Name: Albert Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Front office awesome.  Dentist chair all working on me great job. I recommend these professionals.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dara Meekins

High attention to detail and great at making sure patient is educated and is as comfortable as possible during the dental visit.

Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca M Raphael
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful new patient visit a few days ago. Dr. Groh greeted me and explained everything that would happen. Her assistant was also kind and efficient taking me through the x-rays. Good down-to-earth dentistry with a great staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Nero

user_reviews_extended.Name: Selina W.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trey Byers

user_reviews_extended.Name: Georgia McMillen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Groh and her team at Alta dental are amazing. Highly recommend. This was my third appointment and all three appointments have been punctual, efficient, and I have been well informed. I can’t say enough good things.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jena Seiber
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Alta dental were absolutely amazing ! A few months back I started my Invisalign journey. user_reviews_extended.Name: Charbel Rached

Alta Dental is the place to go if You want things to be done.
A big thanks to Dr Diamond and Mandy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lora Hoff

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Barroso
user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica paiva
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was here down in Texas visiting family, I had a dental emergency and I was recommended to Alta Dental. I had an amazing experience! user_reviews_extended.Name: Priscilla Linnemann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Let’s face it, it’s never an experience that anyone looks forward to. I was referred by another office. They explained the entire process before we got started and made sure that any and all questions were answered. I knew instantly that, not only was I in the right place, but that I’d be willing to travel to Austin to continue my treatment with them. Dr. Diamond, Ashley, Amanda, and I wish I could remember the lady’s name who checked me in (I was nervous!) but they were all simply fantastic! I experienced no pain, and knew I was in GREAT hands! If you’re looking for a new dental office, THIS IS IT! Schedule. I promise, you won’t regret it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juliana M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr. Diamond and her friendly staff. Experience is really nice and pain-free, she does good work and my visits feels like I'm just hanging out with a bunch of friends. Very relaxed and intimate office, no frills, love it!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Alta Dental staff is professional, friendly, respectful and available for questions pertaining to your teeth.There isn't  hidden cost for dental care. user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Barron
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is so friendly and personable at Alta Dental, and the doctors and techs create a calm environment in the treatment areas. user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy Rhoades
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very clean, knowledgeable, caring and gentle place to go! We have been going here. My family goes here. I tell everyone to go here and I’m telling you to go here. Great experience, great place great staff! Going to the dentist is never fun, but they make it as easy and comfortable as possible

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsey M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I do not recommend this practice.

Billing and scheduling issues aside, Dr. Groh recommended almost $1,000 worth of dental work out-of-pocket that I learned was not medically necessary when I sought treatment at another practice. This new practice analyzed the same x-rays and conducted a new exam to confirm I did not need *any* dental work.

I will never return to this practice due to this medical misconduct or incompetence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Boni Guzman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Didn’t realize my tooth was out, BEST EXPERIENCE EVER!!   Staff members were professional. I Highly Recommend Alta Dental.   Thank you for taking care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Briana Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent new dental office in South Austin. Very professional and friendly staff that expressed genuine care and concern for me. user_reviews_extended.Name: Bethany Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Is it normal to look forward to your dentist appointments?? Not only do I look forward to them, but I have two dentist offices within a 2-3 minute walk of my downtown apartment and yet I gladly drive to my appointments at Alta Dental. When I relocated to Austin, I stumbled upon their office on ZocDoc- I’m so glad I did!!! I have been seen by both Dr. Arif and Dr. Adjan - I’ve never felt more comfortable. Stephanie and the rest of the team make me feel so welcome and their positive attitudes brighten my day. Their office is spotless and relaxing. They even asked me what music I liked so that a pandora station of my choosing plays while I’m in my room during appointments! Amazing.

I would definitely recommend this office and staff to any friend (or stranger!) here in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love it here! I never wait longer than 5 minutes past my appointment time, and everyone is always super nice. Lisa did my cleaning this visit, and I almost completely forgot I was at the dentist she had me laughing so much! **UPDATE** 2 years later and I still love y’all

user_reviews_extended.Name: Threejs Mama

No longer will my teeth keep me from smiling, speaking in public and enjoying life. I can't recommend this office enough. From the front desk, to the dental assistants, everyone is so warm and personable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meghann Morrow

user_reviews.Name: Cherish Olive-Sweetland
user_reviews.Description:
Service was very personable. Good night to you too. Kayle was nice and down to earth. I have enjoyed the hospitality that I received at the last few Dave & Buster’s that I went to very down to our fairy family oriented. Service never feels robotic always feels relatable.
Food is really really good chefs. Do a great job in the kitchen. If you’re able to go during the middle of the day it’s slower and if you have real little ones, I’d like to take off and run. It’s easier to keep up with them when there’s not a crowd to breakthrough.

user_reviews.Name: Ester Lin
user_reviews.Description:
The first and second experiences are not too bad (it's not the best for sure)

Today's experience is so horrible that I won't come back to this place again!!

Other dentists have a better environment, better equipments, with better attitude and more professional…etc.

Why should I stay at this clinic and cause myself trouble and distress？

user_reviews.Name: Joseph Russell
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely amazing! From the front staff to the back they’re amazing! Dr.Binder has absolutely made my smile come back to life and made me feel heard and understood in the process. Thanks for the support for a great smile.

user_reviews.Name: Isaac Vasquez
user_reviews.Description: Always have a great experience at River Rock Dental. The team is professional, friendly, and runs a very organized office. The lead dentist always explains everything clearly and makes the visit easy and comfortable. The space is clean, modern, and appointments are efficient without feeling rushed. Overall, a solid, trustworthy dental office—I’d definitely recommend River Rock Dental.

user_reviews.Name: Omar Diaz
user_reviews.Description:
I can’t say enough great things about Dr. Zachary Carlson and his team! I had an embarrassing tooth break and was pretty stressed walking in, but Dr. Carlson and his amazing staff immediately put me at ease. They moved quickly to address the issue, explained every step clearly, and found a fast solution that worked perfectly for me.

Within no time, they had a crown made that looks absolutely amazing — completely natural and better than I could’ve imagined. The professionalism, kindness, and efficiency of the whole office truly stood out. I’m so grateful for the care and attention they gave me. Highly recommend Dr. Carlson and his incredible team!

user_reviews.Name: Maria Marquez
user_reviews.Description: We’ve been seeing this Dr. Carlson for years, and they truly take care of our entire family. From the moment you walk in, the staff is warm, friendly, and incredibly professional. They always make everyone—from kids to adults—feel comfortable and well cared for.

user_reviews.Name: Sabrina Kirkland
user_reviews.Description: They’re always great, the dentist and orthodontist! My appointment today was with the dental hygienist & was awesome! I always get nervous at the dentist, but she chatted with me and did amazing on my cleaning. Sorry I don’t remember her name! :) -Sabrina

user_reviews.Description: Excellent orthodontic services! I had Invisalign braces from the fantastic orthodontist at River Rock.  Love the office staff, short wait times, convenient location. Highly recommend!
