user_reviews_extended.Name: Sire
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment you step into this dentist's office, you're greeted with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The front desk staff are incredibly friendly and efficient, making check-in a breeze. The waiting area is clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully designed to help you relax before your appointment.

The dental team is top-notch, demonstrating both expertise and genuine care for their patients. They take the time to explain procedures thoroughly, answering any questions with patience and clarity.

It definetly makes me feel more like family than just another “patient” they truly care about everyone, Dr Zachary and his whole team are just FRIENDLY & amazing. I can’t complain. 100 % recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drew
user_reviews_extended.Description:
When I went to this place for the first time I loved it. However my issue is that booking an appointment after your new patient appointment is extremely difficult. I tried booking online and there was no option for a returning patient appointment so I booked under a new patient appointment. They canceled it because I had been prior and couldn’t do the alternative appointment they offered due to a work trip.

I called them yesterday and asked what they had available, they has one open in two days and I couldn’t do that because of a business trip and the next available date they had was in December. On their website, they have 30 new patient appointments over the next 3 weeks, but cannot see a returning patient for 4 months. Due to this, I am sadly going to have to go to another practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Shuster
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got Invisalign here and they were incredibly professional and helpful. My teeth have truly never looked better and I’m so glad I did this right in time for my wedding!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosalinda Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr. Aponte!! For a long time I never wanted to smile because my teeth were so crooked and crowded, now this smile never leaves my face!! Thank you Dr. Aponte for making my smile journey smooth and easy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience today, everyone from the front desk staff, dental hygienist and Dr. Carlson were amazing and definitely felt more at ease after leaving the appt. Thank you 🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fletcher Guinn
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock Dental engages in unethical appointment cancellation practices. They will repeatedly text you to confirm your appoint via text but say the only way to cancel your appointment is to call their office. I have called in the past and have been unable to connect with their office, and now have been hit with their "cancellation fee." I would strongly suggest taking your business somewhere that respects and cares about their patients, instead of their wallets.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rob Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: All my claims are getting denied. They charged me for nitrous but I literally felt nothing. I don't know if this is their fault or insurance fault but I am fed up.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recommend avoiding this place. The staff is kind and the dentists are professional, but the administration is abysmal. I have had disappointing billing and scheduling issues with this office one too many times. Will be looking for a new dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellie Katherine
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a wonderful experience with Dr. Carlson and his staff. They were very communicative, informative, quick and comfortable. My cleaning and fillings were some of the most comfortable I’ve had in a while. I loved that I was never in the room waiting for long and they always let me know what they were doing so I wasn’t left guessing. They didn’t try and upsell me on a bunch of stuff and I liked that they showed me pictures of my teeth and the areas of concern as they explained a treatment plan. Very happy to have found a dentist and staff that I enjoy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Cobb
user_reviews_extended.Description: This team is amazing! As a younger adult learning to manage all these things on my own, so they were super kind and helpful about the whole process (: I had multiple time/scheduling needs and they made an effort to get me in on time. I also made a payment mistake and they were quick to help and understanding when I came back to fix it. I felt really comfortable there!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marisol Work
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First time patient, I got some treatment here on Monday and the doctor was fantastic! The fillings that she did were painless, easy and not bulky! You can tell the doctor and assistants want to be as thorough as possible and you are not just a number to them.

I 100% recommend river rock dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vincent Chau
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've moved around the country quite a bit before settling down in Southeast Austin, I randomly picked a dentist in the area and I really hit the jackpot because Dr. Klintmalm and the crew at River Rock Dental are the best.

They've demonstrated to me, on multiple occasions, that they really take pride in their work and that they really care about their clients.

Dr. Klintmalm also just helped me place a gold molar implant in a spot that has been missing one for over 20 years! 🤩

user_reviews_extended.Name: Crystal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really love this dentist office. It's one that I used several years ago and then moved farther north and was unable to continue using. In recent years I've moved back down south and I'm so grateful that they are still in business. They are friendly and kind and super understanding when it comes to having dental anxiety at the dentist. Dr. Carlson is patient and understanding, so personable and respectful. I highly recommend this dentist if you have had previous bad experiences elsewhere as they take care of you and really listen to your needs as a patient and a person.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juany Castilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Rebecca Rightmer—she was kind, gentle, and incredibly attentive. Her assistant, Ms. Vanessa, was also amazing and made me feel very comfortable. I don’t tolerate pain well, so I truly appreciated how patient and gentle they both were throughout the entire visit. They really took great care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lida Saunders
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a tooth filled and Dr. Binder is a wonderful Dentist. Very Thorough and attentive to detail and comfort of patient. I had expected the tooth she worked on to maybe be root canal and crown but turned out to be only a filling. Love this dentist. And the technicians are well trained and very nice and efficient with patients. Thank you so much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Escobar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very happy with River Rock South Park meadow dental. The staff are always so friendly and helpful and are genuinely concerned about the patient from the time you walk in to the time you walk out. Doc Binder is an excellent oral surgeon, she explained everything that was going to happen and made sure I was comfortable through our the procedure. THANK YOU 🙏

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shantel Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ale is amazing and super thoughtful! Made me feel comfortable and welcome. 5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katy Mastren
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend you do NOT go here. If you do pleaseee get a second opinion before letting them do any drilling!!! The dentist here told me that I had four cavities, one in each corner of the mouth and one might need a root canal. For a few reasons I was a little iffy about this and it felt off. So I went to another practice the next day for a second opinion and surprise surprise... I actually only have one very small cavity! The dentist at the new place even said what this practice told me was so completely wrong and definitely a fear tactic. The dentists at River Rock Dental were going drill into three perfectly healthy teeth either from just incompetence or outright lying to make some more money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ash D (A DS)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shady, unprofessional, poorly run, scammy dental outfit. Switched cleaning appointment from dentist to hygienist without consent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edward Benavidez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m giving one star because they do try.
Had crowns put on about a month ago. Temporary crowns fell out 3 times in a weeks time, finally had permanent crowns put in, that fell out less than a week later, it’s been now three days since they corrected their error and now a piece of adhesive has fallen out leaving a hole in the back of my tooth which is strange because there shouldn’t be a hole. Anyways this is the last chance they get to correct their errors. I had crowns put on at plum creek dental years ago and I have NEVER had an issue. I’ve wasted about hours of my employers time in order to fix this once and for all. I recommend finding a different location or dentist if you’re doing crowns.
I’ll be wasting more of mine and my employers time today trying to fix their mistakes.
I don’t enjoy using sick time to come into the dentist 6 times in a month for the same issue.
They are nice folks but use rather have a ruder dentist with quality work than a nice dentist with sub par work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: trenae wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this dental place. I’ve been coming here for 2-3 years. Doctor Laura usually attends me and she is professional and kind. I always feel comfortable with her and know I get a good cleaning. All the staff are very nice and the hygienists are very sweet and professional. I appreciate having a good dental practice I enjoy going to!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Called yesterday about a tooth extraction, was seen first thing this morning and back at home before lunch. Great staff, great patient care and service. Very happy with the price. I'd highly recommend to anyone. Thanks Dr. B!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lionel Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist can be stressful but the staff here were amazing, especially how helpful they were. I had a positive experience while having a dental procedure, which I'm sure is rare. I would recommend this location to others! Thankful I chose this location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabella Suarez Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at this dentist has been extremely wonderful. I have had the most help and understanding at this establishment, as they have been extremely helpful, assisting me in my journey with braces. This has been a wonderful place for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Gandy
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock Dental continues to be my favorite office! I recently moved, but I never considered switching dentists because everyone here is so excellent. They are timely, kind, professional, and incredibly empathetic. I went in with some pain last week; they were thorough in their examination and worked with me to develop next steps that aligned with some of my other health needs. So grateful for this crew!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miriam Ramirez (BSN RN CCRN)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to River Rock Dental for a long time now and have had a great experience with everybody in the office.  The dentist and hygienist are very kind and explain everything they are doing.  They have the BEST chair side manner!  LOL.  They are always looking out for the patient to make you feel more comfortable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lissette TH
user_reviews_extended.Description: Stormi is an amazing dental assistant! She is professional, kind, and makes every visit comfortable. Her attention to detail and friendly attitude truly stand out. Highly recommend!”

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barbara TREVINO
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Carlson & his entire team give 100% customer care service towards any procedure you may be having. Their concern for your overall health of your teeth & gums is so apparent.. they are personable.. informative., and I highly recommend River Rock Dental … who are very fortunate to have Dr Carlson in their practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karla Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I walked in, I knew this was going to be a great experience. The staff were so friendly and I felt like I could see their smile through their masks. Everything was also nice and clean. I also enjoyed all the Star Wars art everywhere. Everyone was so kind and professional. I feel lucky to have found this place and that it’s so close to my home. Dr Binder was amazing and calm. I plan to make this my new dentist for a loooong time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabel Bautista
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock is absolutely amazing! The people at the front desk are the sweetest and the assistants are amazing and most importantly Dr. K has completely changed my outlook on going to the dentist. I’ve never met a dentist I trust so much and who has been so incredibly kind to me. Everyone there has helped me out so very much and I don’t think i could thank them enough. They work with you through payment plans as well if you need it! River rock is definitely the place to go!! If I could give 10 stars I absolutely would, thank you Dr. K

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Dennis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr. C and his team, they are fast, efficient, friendly, and always explain everything in the best terms. Best dental team I’ve had in long time! Only place I’ve ever “enjoyed” getting cavities filled, which I haven’t had since initially coming here two years ago!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blake Barker
user_reviews_extended.Description: My lordt! Where do i start? RiverRock is the issssh hands down. They got me in within 7 days of calling, and I cant even get a second date that quick these days. Look, they diagnosed and treated my issue with 1 appointment for a very small $50 copay for my entire visit and treatment that my last dentist quoted me $700 for (I wont mention any names.......southpark meadows dentistry and orthodontics *cough cough*. Bedside manner was great, everyone from the front desk to the dental assistant were kind and competent. I might even chip a tooth on purpose just to go back. RiverRock Dental is my forever dental "home". 10 out of 10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalia Lugani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at River Rock Dental is always so helpful and nice. I am so grateful that the  team could fit me in to fix a chipped tooth. It was so quick and my teeth look great! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Wotta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Carlson was very friendly and helpful! He explained exactly what was going on with my tooth pain, explained all my options, and answered any questions I had. Then the tech came by and presented me with the estimated cost, including insurance coverage. Everyone was very professional but relaxed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheyenne Clint
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly, fantastic experience!!! Genuinely life-changing! I have had generally unpleasant and painful experiences at the dentist: whether not being heard when I'm advising that I'm in pain (the numbing products have a hard time being effective on me), being spoken to in a condescending way, and not even attempting to use my dental insurance when I know I'm in-network and the service is covered thus attempting to charge me thousands of dollars more than I know I should be charged; so, I just started avoiding them (not my greatest idea of course but anyways). Did some research and chose this office and I am so, SO glad I did! Dr. Zachary Carlson, the assistants, and ladies at the front desk (wish I got their names to personally name and thank them) were incredibly nice, so sweet, and understanding and empathetic of my situation and feelings towards coming to the dentist. Dr. Carlson didn't just go through the motions of the service (a cleaning) but stopped to listen to my concerns, feelings, and health goals, and really listened and spoke to me like a person, which I really appreciated. Of course, having exceptional bedside manner like his and the other employees isn't necessarily required to technically provide dental care, but the lack thereof has made me avoidant of putting my dental health first. That is not the case here at River Rock Dental. This review is not sponsored by them, I didn't receive compensation or anything for this post. The experience I had here totally and completely changed my feelings about coming to the dentist office, and I'm so excited to come back for my future appointments! Never thought in my life I would be one to say that. Thank you to them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: nb
user_reviews_extended.Description: We moved to austin last year and I went to 7 dentist ( yes 7!!!!) in a year to find the BEST dentist who will give us the best treatment and not really try to rip our bank account. I can’t tell how happy I am that I found Dr Binder. She is absolutely fantastic. She is the best.  If you are looking for a dentist to trust with the best quality treatment with full confidence look no more! And the staff at south Meadow are just so sweet and awesome! Love the entire experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: stacey stein
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient at River Rock Dental Southpark for several years now and today, even though I had to get two crowns, was the best experience by far!  Dr. Carlson definitely has his patients’ best interests in mind!  He explains everything in detail, he is a very skilled dentist, he ensured that I was comfortable throughout the procedure and his bedside manner is outstanding!  AD, his assistant, is just as professional and skilled, ensured that I was comfortable, worked diligently and answered all my questions thoroughly. Erica at the front desk is so warm and welcoming!!  She ensured that I understood all the charges, confirmed my insurance so as to avoid any issues, confirmed the timeline to my permanent crowns, booked my next appointment, answered my questions and wished me a wonderful day!  Can’t ask for a better experience!!!  This was an entirely different ethnicities experience than when I got two crowns on the opposite side of my mouth, in the most positive way!!  On a side note, I had a wonderful cleaning appointment 3.5 weeks ago here as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhonda Guajardo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have a great experience at this office. The staff is very friendly and welcoming, appointments run on time, and the care is always thorough. It’s also very convenient, which makes visits even easier. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosa Mercado
user_reviews_extended.Description: A couple of visits as a new patient and I have been welcomed and acknowledged as a real person.  Friendly staff and dentists. Very clean. Location near my home is a plus too.  Hoping the upcoming visits stay the same!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Haile
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Enjoyed my first dental experience here! Unfortunately very difficult to get an appointment here. Tried 2 different months to get a cleaning and they told me it would take 3 months since they are so booked 🥲.

3 stars primarily for the inability to make an appointment. Now looking for a new dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where do I start! The entire staff at this office was incredible. I had so much anxiety about my dental visit since it’s been a while and I knew I needed some work done, but these amazing professionals made the experience so comfortable and made sure to explain everything thoroughly as I’m preparing to start on braces. Mayra and Dr. K constantly asked if I was okay or if I had any questions during my cleaning and exam, which I extremely appreciated. I genuinely can’t wait for my next appointment. Highly recommend this office to anyone! Thank you again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan ybarra
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a pleasant experience. From the moment I walk in every one is great. I’ve had cleanings, fillings and even an emergency wisdom tooth extracted and in each case the dentist that helped were always patient, calming and caring.   I’ve always had a fear of dentist but have no hangups coming here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Ethridge
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent care provided within 30 minutes of my distressed phone call. The front office staff showed compassion and assisted with getting me in quickly. The Dr. and other clinical staff were informative, caring, and did an amazing job. Pain is gone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ciara Fields
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in 30 min early and they got me back there right away even though I was prepared to wait until my actual appt time. Dr. Binder was amazing, did a fantastic job numbing me despite my fear of needles and did a great job with my filling. She didn't even ask me questions while her hands were in my mouth!  Ofc the front office ladies as well as the assistants who helped my dentist were excellent and helpful as always. 10/10 experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Landon Reed
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was one of best experiences I have had at the dentist's office.  The entire staff were welcoming and professional.  Christina and Dr. K were both amazing.  They both listened to my concerns and understood what was most important to me.  They did not make me feel bad about my teeth and they explained everything.  It was refreshing to find a dentist that wanted to build a good rapport with his patients.  I will definitely continue to use them and would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Green
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience and have definitely found my new dentist. Dr. C and his staff were extremely welcoming, thorough, and explained everything I'm great detail. One of the best cleanings I've honestly had in a few years. Super excited I found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynette Patton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had a great experience each time I've come here.  The front office staff is pleasant, knowledgeable and helpful.  Dr. Carlson and his team are great! They explain what they'll be doing, answer any questions and make sure you're comfortable the entire time.  I highly recommend River Rock Dental for all your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Letty Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Binder is the best! I have terrible health anxiety and Dr. Binder is always very understanding and helpful. Recently got my wisdom teeth taken out and of course I’m always paranoid but River Rock Dental has been able to get me in quickly for a check up whenever I’m feeling nervous. Thank y’all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved my experience here. Dr. Carlson and his assistant Vanessa were so great, took their time explaining things, and made me feel really comfortable throughout visit. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Soorya
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Do not recommend this practice!

I went in for a regular cleaning(for the first time at this location) and was told I had 4 cavities. I should have gotten a second opinion at this point but I went ahead with it. For one of the fillings I had to follow up 4 times and they even redid the filling which did not help.
I ended up going to another dentist and was recommended to get a root canal because the previous dentist had drilled in too deep to the tooth nerve!
To top it all the dentist who did my fillings is not even listed on their website. I can’t even find any Bio or details for this dentist in the southpark meadows team’s listing ( I am guessing that page has never been updated since they started!!)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonia Ybarra
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at River Rock Dental are always pleasant, helpful & running on time. The location is always clean & peaceful. So glad I was referred here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerry O
user_reviews_extended.Description: Outside of being the absolute best dentists and oral hygienists that I've visited in the past 20 years, they are also the most professional and friendliest. The atmosphere is that of positivity and wellness and everybody seems to love their job and love their customers. The rooms are enjoyable to sit in because they have really awesome artwork and they do everything they can to make you feel comfortable and accommodated. The prices seem to be at or below what I'm used to ( I've lived all over this country) but the results are much better. Everybody greets you as you walk by and everybody offers you a salutation as you leave. They give you reminder cards, reminder texts and emails if you ask. They even call you if they haven't heard back from you. You're not going to miss an appointment with them and you're never going to regret going. I will never go to another dental office....and neither should you! 😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: A M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly staff! They don’t make you feel uncomfortable and they are no judgment zone! They all work together to help each other as a team! They know how to speak to their patients. Also, they break down the billing part also breakdown everything you need done and let you know why they explain everything to you as well. Overall amazing establishment couldn’t just shout out one person because everyone from the front desk to the back rooms were amazing! That I mentioned they are Also fast at their job!!! Thank you guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jake Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Very kind staff, clean facilities, didn’t feel rushed, I felt like I had their full attention, and they took their time to explain pricing/insurance. Will definitely go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Sicklethorp
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely loved my first experience here - everyone was super helpful and friendly; my hygienist was lovely and did a great job cleaning my teeth (and she was gentle!! I actually didn't come out bleeding like I do after most cleanings). The doctor was super nice and easily explained everything I needed to know about my teeth and did a great job addressing any questions I had. 10/10 would recommend <3

user_reviews_extended.Name: Colton Leach
user_reviews_extended.Description: The service and staff are wonderful! I was going through a bunch of stuff while I had to schedule several dentists appointments, causing me to reschedule a few times, and the staff always treated me with kindness and respect. The dentist is always willing to answer any questions, even if they're not related to my procedure. Will continue to recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Austin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently switched dentists and found myself at river rock dental in Southpark Meadows and was pleasantly surprised with my visit. Everyone was kind and chipper from the hygienists to the doctor himself, even the sweet ladies at the front desk were a delight. Since my first visit, a simple cleaning, I have gone back for a few fillings and have a few more scheduled. The staff is very good about setting up my appointments and calling to schedule later as well. Debbie is amazing! She did my cleaning and was so friendly and engaging. She talked to me the entire time and made me feel extremely comfortable, which going to the dentist is usually not a super comfortable thing. Debbie was truly my first point of contact at this office and I think she made my experience all the better. Not only did she make me feel comfortable by talking to me about my upcoming wedding and vacations but also she made me feel very comfortable with her transparency in the best options for tooth brushes and the proper way to floss, there are just some people you trust more than others and she is definitely one of those people. The doctor did my fillings in what felt like record time which I'm happy for because the sound of the drill is not something I enjoy. I will be back to do teeth whitening soon before my wedding in Paris! Never going anywhere else! Thank you river rock dental and the awesome staff and southpark Meadows!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Greenwood
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is amazing. The staff is so helpful and friendly from front desk to the girls who help you in the back.  DR ERIK KLINTMALM is amazing.  He is always so kind and never rushed.  He gives you choices of what you can have done.  His procedures are painless and flawless.  If you ever have an issue you can always call and will get a return call so they can help you.   I don't mind going to the dentist now and my teeth are showing the difference.
Thanks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candace Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. Zach Carlson for a few years. Dr. Zach made me feel comfortable and relieved any anxiety I had about going to the dentist. I highly recommend him and the team at River Rock Dental! They truly care about the well being you and your teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Callan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I seriously love going to the dentist when I’m going here. The staff is so friendly and Dr. K is amazing! He’s quick, efficient, and kind to his staff. I can’t say enough great things about this dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherryl Walters

user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for a broken tooth that was causing alot of pain.  I have anxiety so I was nervous as I have never been here before. user_reviews_extended.Name: Loretta J
user_reviews_extended.Description: They fit me in early. Dr Binder and the staff were very helpful. They made ne feel very comfortable .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelina Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock Dental-SPM has never been better. The new crew is wonderful. Christina is the best hygienist I’ve ever had. user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Coleman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve always been a little apprehensive going to the dentist but my experience through multiple appointments and procedures with Dr. Carlson has been phenomenal. His expertise and knowledge really helped me understand certain aspects of what Dental work I needed done.

I was even more impressed with Dr. Carlson’s level of care for me during the procedure always making sure I was comfortable and never in pain. I felt like his #1 priority while under his care and I would recommend him to anyone looking for a patient focused, caring dentist.

The staff in the office was also amazing and took care of all my inquiries promptly and professionally.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Ferris
user_reviews_extended.Description: I used to hate going to the dentist until I came here for the first time. The staff is so kind and truly care about you. Dr. K goes above and beyond to address dental concerns and is a wonderful human! I look forward to my dental appointments now, and would travel lengths just to stay loyal to this office. 10/10.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Motl
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had my first appointment and couldn't be happier! The entire experience was first-class and you can tell the Doctors and Staff truly care about their patients. My Hygienist, Christina, was extremely easy to work with and did a fantastic job of explaining exactly what she was doing and how to prevent future issues. Dr. Carlson took the time to answer any questions that I had and I didn't feel like he was "rushed" or that I was just another number in a file. Overall, I highly recommend these folks and, even with my dental anxiety, I'm looking forward to my next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather V
user_reviews_extended.Description: I couldn't possibly speak more highly of this practice. After years of dental anxiety due to previous dental practices placing blame and shame, I finally found myself with Dr. K. His compassion, kindness, and calm demeanor really made the experience so much better. He explains everything, gives clear instructions, and is so patient. I walked in with terrible anxiety, and walked out with a smile on my face, knowing I've found the best dentist for me for this dental work journey I'm now embarking on. Thank you Dr.K and Evelyn for making today as easy and anxiety-free as it could have been. I'm sorry if my earbuds were able to be heard over the sounds of the drills 🤣

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Shoemaker
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the first dentist I’d been to since moving to Texas and I loved it! The entire staff was helpful, welcoming, and explained everything to me in a way no one had before. Miriam did my teeth cleaning and it was the most gentle and pain free cleaning I have ever had. Definitely coming back and recommending to everyone I know, thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience I’ve ever had!! I was there for a new patient exam. The hygienist was amazing - funny, warm, welcoming, and really knowledgeable. She emphasized repeatedly how much they care about educating their clients and explained each step of what she was doing. She kept me laughing the whole time. Dr. K was the same - really friendly and wonderful. I had a chip in one of my front teeth, and he asked if I wanted it fixed. He smoothed out the chip in about a minute and didn’t charge me at all for it. Everyone was so kind and accommodating. I was really impressed and will absolutely be going there from now on for all my future dental services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Winchester
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I'm scared of dental work, and thats kept me out of the dental chair for too long, ended up doing some research on reddit for a dentist thats patient, and willing to deal with major dental fears, 4 appointments later, and some major work I feel so much better, if you're worried about anxiety, or judgement, this is the place... I've even moved out of Austin, and still make the drive in to get my work done. Dr K, has been amazingly patient with me, and solved all my issues.

Office is great, they answer the phone every time, and go over options, and work with you to make sure you understand everything, and are comfortable. I couldn't ask for anything better.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Stokely
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were very passionate and understanding of my anxiety with dentists. They spent the time to communicate everything with me and made me feel so much more confident about my treatment plan. The Doctor was very honest and made me feel very comfortable, he even gave me a few compliments.  I will definitely be seeing them again. May even see about switching the kiddos to them 🥰

user_reviews_extended.Name: carolyn porter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Even though I was surprised by the staff changes since my last visit, I had a pleasant visit! The front office staff was very warm, yet professional(not a fan of 'stuffy' office personnel). Dr. K was very engaging and, the hygienist(name escapes me)🤔 was one of the best I've encountered over the years; she was humorous, patient, and left me with a smiling face! If you're looking for a dental office that's clean, friendly, and professional River Rock deserves a spot at the front of your list.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeddy Stailey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr K and Deb helped me here at my first visit at this office. I had been to another location but was very dissatisfied. So I thought I would give this one a chance. Everything was smooth and on time. Deb was my hygienist and was very nice and professional. She has a good bedside manner and the xrays and cleaning were pain free. She explained everything she would do and why.

The office staff were all very friendly over the phone and in person.

Dr K is a very enthusiastic man. Very friendly and made me feel comfortable. He addressed exactly what needed to be addressed and answered all my questions. He gave me options for some things but was very honest as to what was a need and what was not. Also showed me an error that was made by the other office i came from which I appreciate the honesty and integrity in that. I will have work done with him next week so I hope that it equates to the good experience I had with this evaluation.

My only critique is at the end when discussing possible plans that involve major work, I felt some pressure to make a decision that moment then as to take the time and really thinking it through as it will be a costly investment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: justin coleman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Carlson was so caring and considerate during my visit. He always made sure I was comfortable and discussed my treatment options clearly so i could prioritize nccisssry treatment. His staff was polite and courteous as well. A great office all around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martha Marin
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doc and his assistant were great.. haha I don’t remember there names right of hand. but I would recommend river rock Dental. It’s a friendly office. Customer service is good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leon Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So disappointed in their treatment of returning patients.

Went for my new patient appointment here around 6 months ago and everything was good. They’re definitely a 15-min-per-patient type of place but most places seem to be that way.

The big problem came today when scheduling another appointment. Their online system directs returning patients to call the office as they can’t book online - when I called, I was told the next available appointment would be 12 weeks from now, which I would have accepted, if not for the fact that that if you go online and book as a new patient, you can get an appointment today and every day after.

I called back to ask about this and got connected to a different woman - she first said that if I found availability online, I could take it. I confirmed with her that returning patients were directed to call the office and then she asked “are you a new patient?”. I confirmed I was a returning patient and she soon switched up and confirmed my next available appointment would be in August. When I asked why, she said “they’re different appointment types”. She had no answer for why they are accepting new patients when they can’t schedule their existing patients for 3 months.

Ultimately, an appointment is for the staff’s time - if they’re available, they’re available. The fact that they are turning down bookings from returning patients when they are available just in case a new patient schedules is ridiculous. We know that the reason is that they charge more for new patient appointments (and maybe have to enroll so many new patients to meet corporate quotas?).  In reality, they probably aren’t “available” - they’re just willing to squeeze a new patient into their schedule, at the cost of quality of care, just for the money.

If you’re someone who can schedule an appointment months in advance and know you won’t need to move it, it might work for you. But if anything comes up, you’re looking at another 3 month wait and even if you do make your appointment, you’ll find yourself waiting in the chair for 30 minutes at a time because the Dr. is in and out of treatments with multiple new patients all scheduled at the same time.

Bad business practice, terrible customer service, complete lack of ethics.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donavan Starghill
user_reviews_extended.Description: The experience was stupendous. The front desk rep Jessica was brilliant. She has an awesome smile and met me with a warm greeting. Deb my hygienist took great care and explained thoroughly what she was looking for and what she found. Finally, the new owner and lead dentist Kevin, greated me with his amazing smile and upbeat personality. I hadn't been to the dentist in a while. He complimented me on my smile multiple times and also made me feel very comfortable about next steps for maintenance. I will be making a return visit for a deep cleaning very soon. The office is very modern and clean. It smells great and full of expert staff that are very friendly. They have TVs that show the news and your exrays in the back rooms! Really great equipment. Go stop by!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margo Fusilier
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to River Rock Dental for over 15 years. All Staff and Doctors are professional, pleasant, and go above and beyond for their patients.  Plus, the location is very convenient. Thank you for everything❣️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elana King
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been coming here for about a year now, after many years of being afraid of the pain and cost of taking care of my issues. I was foolish to wait so long, but I'm so glad that River Rock Dental has been my team on this adventure.

The have always made treatment plans and payment options clear and easy. Every time I'm in there, the entire staff is happy and friendly and started to remember me on sight since I've been there every 3 months for a while.

I've been through 2 root canals, 2 crowns, 1 filling, and a deep scale clean. I would be foolish to suggest a painless experience, but no part of this has been agony.

Big shout outs to their office manager, whose name escapes me I'm so sorry but you are super amazing, Erica makes checking out easy and fun,  thanks for putting up with my cleanings Kathy, and while I'll miss Dr. Tristan, I know I'm in good hands with Dr. Carlson.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia Luna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Friendly staff, clean place, always greeted with a smile. Lots of space in waiting lobby. The dental hygienists are wonderful. Would go back

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ilona
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was provided with exceptional care at River Rock Dental by the dentist and every staff member I interacted with. They offered same day and next day appointments for emergency issues. I will say, I am terrified of the dentist, but I felt so comfortable here, thanks to the dentist and the staff who explained everything each step of the way. The dentist went above and beyond to make sure I was not in pain, and that I understood the risk/benefit of the procedure. As a fellow medical professional, I really appreciate the care provided by this location and I will continue to come here for routine visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Hauger

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharee C.

Alphonso G.

user_reviews_extended.Name: louis sharpe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great dental visit at River Rock Southpark today. Dr Binder and the whole team were fantastic!  If you aren’t letting that outstanding team take care of your dental needs you are missing out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Skrocki-Hebb (Kiki)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Edit 10/19/2022: came here after a foiled attempt at another provider closer to home (I moved) - came back and will forever trust my dental care to Dr. Carlson. Worth the extra drive! Thanks again - ☺️
Original post: I am phobic when it comes to dentists thanks to childhood trauma - but I like my teeth...  so I try to take care of them. 😁 Dr Carlson is honestly the best dentist I’ve ever been to! Don’t let that cute face fool you - he may look young but he impressed even me with his knowledge, kindness, and enthusiasm for his work.  He didn’t just work in my mouth, he cared for me... I know what the term ‘patient care’ really means now!  And his assistant too... sweet girl but I didn’t get her name I was so nervous lol - seriously, he even outranks my dentist in Florida that was the only one I’d go to for 20 years before moving to Texas.  Not only is Dr Carlson amazing, the entire staff is! Sometimes it’s either or you know... I am thrilled I found this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Cordes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Klintmalm is extremely patient, thorough, and professional. This extends to his staff as well, in particular Erica and Mayra who helped to make me feel comfortable and accommodated. I have sensitive gums and an even more sensitive disposition when it comes to dentist visits, and I've been to multiple offices over the years in search of the right fit. My recent visit to River Rock was the first time I felt that all of my needs were met, and the periodontal maintenance that has historically been difficult for me to endure was an absolute breeze with zero pain or discomfort. I'm sincerely grateful to the River Rock staff for restoring my faith that dentist visits can be an positive and enjoyable experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaitlin moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Carlson, dental hygienist and everyone were FANTASTIC! I always hate going to the dentist but they make sure you understand everything and make you feel comfortable. You get no pressure if you aren’t able to do everything needed at one time. I usually need multiple breaks and numbing creme but my dental hygienist (forgot her name) was amazing and careful! I have never had a cleaning like this! For sure will be back and recommending to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Boone
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time using River rock dental and I was very impressed! The technology and education provided is like no other dentist I’ve been to! Everyone was very friendly and professional. They made sure all questions and needs were taken care of. Highly recommend, I had Dr. Carlton!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone there was super friendly. I have crazy anxiety about the dentist and they were great about putting me at ease. I highly recommend Dr. Binder and her staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Simone Pollard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Erik Klintmalm is excellent. I have never had fillings before, and didn't know I needed them. They were small, but he said they would eventually get larger. Needless to say, the bacteria started taking over my mouth. I went in to get the fillings, and his bedside manner was excellent! I was scares to death! He was patient and explained everything. Kudos to him and his team! The best part is the state of the art equipment, they don't cost a fortune, and the accounting clerk itemizes every detail. They even tell you your bill ahead of time; if you ask. I love this place, and my son does too!!! Awesomeness 👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Moe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here for a year now and I love everything about this office. From the friendly front staff, to the Dental assistance, to the amazing Doctors. I’ve had the fastest wisdom tooth removal here, minimal pain. Excellent over all!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Segovia
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place has changed ownership twice in the span of about a year. Under the second ownership--which was about 6 months ago--I wasn't as pleased so I began looking for a new dentist, but with my in-house membership plan about to expire, I went in for what I thought would be a final visit. Right away, I noticed new dentist names on the door. Again? Well, I didn't know what to expect but as it turns out, things have noticeably improved. This is not the old place at all. The overall office vibe was positive and all of the staff were friendly. Beginning with the assistant who took my x-rays, she was nice and professional. Next was Dr. K for the examination. He  demonstrated that he 'treats his patients like family'. He took the time to discuss my concerns in a caring fashion. He's very knowledgeable and believes in educating his patients. The positive experience continued with Christina the hygienist. She did a great job at answering my questions and explaining her actions as she cleaned my teeth. She too was friendly, and professional. David, the office manager (?) provided great customer service as well. Was told that Dr. K is planning to stay long term which is great news as far as I'm concerned. No need to change dentists now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David E. Scally Jr
user_reviews_extended.Description:
10/4/22- Needed a little bit of a filling adjustment and called this morning ... they got me in same day and Dr. K got me out and done in 40 minutes. Still the BEST!

i used to drive 45 minutes to someplace off of Mopac/Balconnes up north Austin but they screwing with me on billing and weren't in my employer plan when I switched employers. River rock dental IS in-plan (and I am always anxious about switching dentists) and I cannot get over how much difference it made. this whole gang is just an awesome group. they use very current digital technology for x-ray/photo reviews. very up-to-date and very congenial and friendly staff. What impressed me most was I was given a full print out of exactly what insurance would pay for and what they would not so I knew what to save up for for example for a crown procedure. This is what Oprah talks about every doctor should do this!!! Plenty of parking & central location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica J
user_reviews_extended.Description: The nicest dentist I’ve ever been to! Very kind, informative, and thorough. Going to the dentist can be so scary/daunting/intimidating/embarrassing but everyone makes it so approachable and you can tell they care about their patients. Clean facility and fast service. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carly Pack
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a broken tooth causing severe pain and called to make an appointment and was worked in the next day.  The Front desk was kind and welcoming, Dr.Klintmalm and his dental assistant were phenomenal.  The Doctor went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable and talked me through the procedure and it was just an overall good experience considering the circumstances.  I highly recommend this dental office to anyone looking to find dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabel Bautista
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to this place for about 6 years and have seen my fair share of dentists and Dr. K is the absolute best dentist I’ve ever experienced in my life. He’s very gentle and extremely talented at what he does!! And all of the staff in the front are the sweetest people ever!! They will work with you if you’re having trouble financially too! I definitely recommend coming here !! If I could give more than 5 stars I absolutely would

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Henley
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock Dental is my favorite place in Austin! Erika was my dental hygienist, and she was so friendly. I am always impressed with the speed of service, quality care, and hospitable team! They always take updated X-rays and pictures of my teeth, and I love the fresh feeling after my routine 6-month cleanings. Highly recommend South Park Dental if you want a team that truly cares about your overall experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rita O
user_reviews_extended.Description: My whole family has been going to River Rock Dental since originally opening several years ago. I really like that the staff and dentists know who I am, and remember me when I come in for my bi-annual check ups they ask how my family is doing and it just truly shows how much treating the family as a whole is very important to thier practice!  They always strive to provide excellent service, and they aren't satisfied until you're 100% happy with your dental work!  I always leave feeling like I've been giving top-notch care, and that's because I have!

user_reviews_extended.Name: barb trevino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional… personable.. very caring. ….are just some of the ways I can describe the personnel at Southpark Meadows At River River Rick  dental…..Dr. Zachary‘s one-of-a-kind dentist and so knowledgeable and shares that knowledge to the patient for better care and concern to have a healthy dental experience. His hygienist is the very best that I’ve ever experienced in all my cleaning ..At my current age … that’s a lot of years lol. It’s not the provider you are with but who gives you the best dental care for your teeth River rock dental is in a league all of their own… the right doctor the right hygienist has made a world of difference in caring for my teeth .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Rodas
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock Dental is always great. Quick visits. The dentist answered all of our questions and did a great job at explaining the work our daughter was getting done. The staff is great with our kids and super friendly. Didn't have to wait weeks for an appointment

user_reviews_extended.Name: nazia durvesh
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff is very nice and helpful. Dr. K is incredibly talented doctor and a very kind person. I would highly recommend for any dental care, reach out to River Rock Dental at South Meadow

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nazia Bilwani
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at River Rock Dental with Dr. K and with all his staff members. Dr. K is amazing and have been a great help in taking care of dental health for my kids and for myself. They are very efficient, explain the process well and over all very polite and helpful. I highly recommend River Rock Dental for any type of dental treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith Youngblood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience from staff and providers. Will be back again for another cleaning

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob Barnett
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental assistant was very friendly and efficient as was all of the office staff and dentist. And the surprise of the visit, the dentist actually cleaned my teeth. It's been over 50 years since I've had that happen.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rochelle McConico
user_reviews_extended.Description: My mom's teeth went from being partially useful to not useful at all after paying them for a repair. How do you repair something and make it worse?! The people were nice but the service was terrible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A. B. Colbert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient at this Southpark Meadows practice since 2012 and highly recommend Dr. K, Dr. Carlson, and the staff. The doctors are dedicated, compassionate, and incredibly knowledgeable of the latest in dentistry.  The dental assistants are friendly and hard-working. The front desk team are consummate professionals-- always on top of insurance, appointments, and ready to help with just about anything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyneisha Ellis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly Dr. K is the best. After some horrible dental work and over all experiences from another south Austin practice I was reluctant to reach out to anyone. So happy that I did! Great work and great team. Very grateful for their care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: V Simp
user_reviews_extended.Description: Terrified of going to the dentist, even to get my teeth cleaned. I have nothing but positive things to say about my experience. Staff are very nice and polite. Dr. K is excellent. He explains everything so well. Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheron Fowler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just experienced my very first infected tooth over the Thanksgiving holiday. Dr. K was the on call doctor and from that point to today he has been nothing but spectacular. I’ve been going to Riverock for many many years. I see doctors come and go, but his care and bedside manner was heart touching. He came in early today to help me! He sat there and went through every step of what we could do and why this was good but this way was better. I’ve been hesitant on taking my kids back because of Covid and we are battling an Insurance situation but they were so amazing. I apologize for not getting her name but the woman who helped me at the front desk was so kind. She could see how much pain I was in and how much I needed this done but was worried about money. They are so helpful. I’m so glad we haven’t changed dentists, but they did. My heart is full. Thank you again for being so kind and helpful to me. It made me feel special and making every patient feel that way is what makes a place great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia Kottke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Rover Rock. If I could come more than twice a year for a cleaning I would! The office staff is so friendly, I love seeing my hygienist Mayra (she’s the sweetest!! I get so excited to see her), and Dr. Carlson is the best. I’ve never been one to like the dentist, but at River Rock I actually get excited to go! By far my favorite dentist office I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: There are a few of the staff that are so rude. I just felt like I couldn't or shouldn't ask questions because I was disturbing them. When I called to get my son's record transferred the girl on the phone was rude and at the end she just hung up. I thought we got disconnected so I called back and said, "I think we got disconnected." She said, "No, I hung up so I could send the records over." I had a two more questions but like I said, it seems to be a bother for them. I was trying to be nice and said I was switching Dental offices due to location but no its because of the careless service. As far as the Dr. we had a great experience at first but then a younger Dr. filled my sons cavity and he had no patience whats so ever for kids. His first Dr. was so funny and caring with my son but I'm not this young guy. We had been with him since he was 1yr old now hes 6yrs old. Good luck to whoever goes there now, its not how it used to be.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Please be aware and hesitant of this place. I went in for a cleaning and was told I had many cavaties by Dr.Erik. The bizarre thing is I got one of the fillings done by him and left with pink hard stuff coming out of my mouth for a week. He never flossed in between my teeth after he was done. He also mentioned I need a crown and said he couldn’t see it on the X-rays but I needed one. Why wouldn’t he go over and show me my X-rays?!!?! Or take a picture of the area I needed a crown?!? That was the last red flag for me. I know once he said that I wasn’t coming back. The next day after my visit/filling my teeth were uneven and I couldn’t eat for almost a week because I was so sore.
I noticed food was constantly getting stuck in between one of the areas he did a filling in. Fast forward I canceled all my visits and Dr.Erik called me… why wouldn’t the office manager call?!?  So strange!!! He was telling me he treats everyone like his mom and etc. I don’t know how he treats his mom or the relationship he has with her so that was weird.

I saw a second opinion and found out he left a gap in between my teeth where he did the filling at and I have to redo the whole filling. This place is a scam, they want you to come back over and over so you rely on their services. These reviews must be bots.

My new dentist looked at the X-rays I had down at River rock SPM and surprise surprise he didn’t see any cavaties and doesn’t believe I need a crown at all. Please get a second opinion and be careful if you pick this place. It’s terrifying.

Also I’m in the good night ranch Facebook group and asked my neighbors about this place a bunch of other people mentioned they were told they had cavaties and never did when they opted to get a second opinion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalia Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had 2 extractions and 2 fillings done and the dentist and assistants were GREAT! Very informative and the procedure went quickly. I was nervous but the dentist made sure I was comfortable which I really appreciated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevan Sinclair
user_reviews_extended.Description: Attempted extraction...Did not have a good experience. I suffer from anxiety and a extreme fear of needles. I expressed that initially. They had me take two blue pills to help me relax, otherwise there would be no possible way anyone would be able to get a needle anywhere near me. This I also warned them in advance. I was rushed to the room. I sat there for almost two hours waiting while nothing is changing. No inebriation. So they offer gas which is supposed to help. But MY examinator isn't qualified for that. Which was one of the agreements leading up to the ENTIRE event. Heaven forbid they ask the one person who is qualified...By the time they come back they denied service to me. Hurried me out of the office after. Worst experience ever. This is why I believe dentist are just sadist with newer magazines.. time to find an ACTUAL DENTIST.

user_reviews_extended.Name: C H
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you like to get talked down to and be almost assured of extra out-of-pocket charges for a 'deep clean', then call here! They will be happy to talk down to you about it and encourage you to call somewhere else if you don't want to pay out of pocket for services not covered by your insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: So I have been going here for over 5 years never missed an appointment or been late, today I had appointment for my kiddos (2 of them) as I walked in I was greeted with you missed your appointments 😔 I was so embarrassed I got the time wrong that was on me. I asked if we could still be seen still they went to ask and I told no I had to be rescheduled. The next available is 3 months out so there is not much availability if that is that you are looking for. I do like the staff but 3 months out ?? They are back to school and have to be pulled from school due to my mishap and availability.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casey Clay
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Would not recommend going to this practice. After a routine teeth cleaning, Dr. Carlson recommended that I fill several 'cavities'. Trusting the doctor, I had the fillings done and returned home assuming that was the end of it. Having to return three separate times due to discomfort and growing pain, I was told that micro-adjustments were needed for my bite and that my teeth just needed time to heal. Pain persisted and got to the point where I could not eat, drink or brush without discomfort. One filling FELL OUT, so I reluctantly let them re-do the filling and a second that was causing discomfort. Pain continued to get worse as time went on.

Three weeks later I went to another dentist for a second opinion who said that I needed to have a crown put on my back molar as the tooth was now cracked. Having shown the new dentist my original x-rays from River Rock, I was told that the several fillings were likely done prematurely. I can't definitively say that this dentist's decision to recommend several fillings was a direct cause of my now extensive dental tab but can say confidently that I won't be going back to River Rock Dental. I can only give so many second chances before I question the integrity of the staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcus Figueroa
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place advised that I have my daughter get her wisdom teeth extracted and I went along with it. When we showed up for the extraction , they took so long on one tooth and informed me that they would not be able to pull out the other because it would be difficult.  They still made up pay for the procedure and my daughter's gums ended up swelling. I would advise going to a better dental clinic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ayreis Sleight
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot speak highly enough about this office! Dr. Erik Klintmalm is so attentive and educated when it comes to what you need when coming into their office. I went in with tooth pain and expected to get a filling. Turns out I needed a root canal and he fit me in same day to make sure I wouldn’t be in pain. He was so helpful and kind during my root canal I am very glad I found this office!

The office staff is very friendly too! They are very understanding about all financial situations!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jean Vassar
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is amazing the staff rocks and Doctor K is the best. Had a lot of dental work done a one time and they made sure I was in no pain the whole time and made me feel super comfortable . I will definitely come back would recommend to any one especially if you dislike having dental work like I do they make it as easy and relaxed as possible .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Petitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Carlson and his team are amazing! They are very professional as well as personable. I am highly satisfied with their work. I definitely recommend River Rock Dental - Southpark Meadows to anyone looking for a dentist & dental team. Check them out. You will be glad you did!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff was wonderful, I have huge anxiety when it comes to visiting the dentist but the staff and Dr. Samir were simply perfection. They made me feel super relaxed and explained to me with ease everything I would be experiencing that day. My extraction was quick and virtually painless I have never felt more at ease with a procedure in my entire life. Defiantly major kudos to Dr. Samir and the staff, wish I could give 6 stars lol

-Andrew

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really great staff. Attentive and very communicative. The dentists here seem to really have your interests at heart and I’ve never had anyone suggest something unnecessary or pressure me to take action on anything I didn’t really need. Clean environment. Hygienists aren’t too heavy handed and still do a great job. Mara was excellent!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Wells
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place! The staff is friendly and kind. Dr. Klintmalm is the absolute best! He makes sure I feel comfortable during my visits and I never feel rushed. Procedures are painless and efficient. I would definitely recommend him and this location to my family and friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were so sweet to my baby... held her and played with her while I filled out paperwork. The dentist tickled around her mouth to get her to open up and never got frustrated or flustered when she closed her mouth and held her lips together so tight. Dr. Tristan was great with her. Everyone was so friendly and efficient. They scheduled our next appointment for us right then, and gave my daughter a little stuffed animal and goodies. It was such a pleasant and enlightening experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karla Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It’s been so great!! From the beginning I was taken care of pretty quick and the doctor and the assistants really explained everything so that I can understand the procedure to be done. Everyone is so nice as well. Really great customer service and patient care.

Def recommend coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karina Abigail
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. K was awesome, friendly, and informative. He made my 10 year old feel comfortable with getting her tooth pulled. His assistant was very pleasant and front office was very welcoming. Had a great experience overall.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel Blackthorne
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family have been patients of River Rock Dental since they opened in Southpark Meadows.  As a special needs household, I cannot say enough about how wonderful Dr. K is.  Dr. K takes the time to really understand your medical history to ensure he prescribes the best care.  No judgement, just compassion from a skilled staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Logan Bufford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Do not recommend. Refused to let me get a regular cleaning because the doctor recommended for me to get a level 2 (gingivitis cleaning) which my gums were slightly inflamed but I am not having any pain or bleeding in my gums. I told the check out lady that I just wanted a regular cleaning and said that if I didn’t want to get what the doctor recommended, I could go else where. I did exactly that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nimai Larson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly staff, thorough cleanliness and professionalism. One of the administrators even offered me a blanket when I was cold during my cleaning! This type of personal customer service is rare to find. I highly recommend trying this dentist out ☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Binder is always gentle and a great dentist. My visits are good and I don’t fear my cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Buckingham
user_reviews_extended.Description:

Sarai was very professional and helped ease my fears while in the dental chair.
