user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Guitart
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic office, went out of their way to make me feel comfortable. Felt very taken care of. Definitely suggest River Rock and Dr. Carlson for anyone looking for dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Sands
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wowowow! These guys were awesome. Friendly, super informative, and easygoing. Dr. Klintman was super thorough and you could tell he was really enthusiastic about his practice. The dentist is not usually a “fun” visit, but I had a blast during my cleaning. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Ybarra
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole office staff ROCKS!!! Not only I was knowledgeable of what my treatment plan was by the staff but they made me feel welcomed and comfortable knowing I get nervous with Dentist visits. Overall customer service was outstanding. I will for sure be recommending my co employees and family, very helpful as well couldn’t thank them enough for helping me during the WHOLE visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheyenne Dobson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great experience, it has been years since I went to the dentist, I was nervous and had several questions. Every person I encountered was so nice, understanding and willing to answer any questions big or small.
It was the perfect environment and I look forward to continuing my dental plan with them this year. See y’all in March 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelvin Demps
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great visit with Deb and Dr. Klintmalm today! They are a wonderful team. Deb makes the cleaning fun and very painless. Dr. Klintmalm made the exam quick and comfortable. I loved how he laid out my treatment plans and described what was going on. No pressure on me to get lots of things taken care of at once. He made me feel included and empowered in my oral healthcare journey. I look forward to future visits with this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ivan Tercero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Explained everything to me about my teeth, as well as live video explaining what it is my hygienist saw. Incredible helpful and hard working receptionists. The Dentist himself took his time to explain and evaluate my teeth and any pains/issues I had. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description: The kindest man works here. I had a flat tire and Dr.Erik came over to offer help. He spent 30 minutes working on my old heap of junk and recommended a spot down the road to get a new tire. He saved my day!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our whole family goes here for dental and orthodontic work. The office is clean and pleasant. The staff are efficient and personable. Would definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: eric lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow. Best oral care I have ever recieved. I'm usually not a big fan of hygiene, but these guys really turned me on to the idea of oral health. I got a sonicare and schedule regular cleanings, just great. Stephanie was my assistant and she was the nicest professional I've ever known. Doctor Carlson really knew his stuff too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travel Curious Often
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been patients of Dr. Klintmalm at River Rock Dental for several years now. We appreciate his professionalism, knowledge and experience. He is extremely capable and skilled. Beyond his technical ability, Dr. Klintmalm is sensitive to his patients’ needs and quick to respond. His  staff is also well-trained and efficient. From simple cleaning to implants, we have always had a great experience, so highly recommend River Rock Dental at Southpark Meadows.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daisy Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience with staff and Dr. Carlson is the best, he really takes the time to explain if anything needs to get done. I would highly recommend River Rock Dental to all my family and friends. I’ve been coming here for years!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariana
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Unfortunately one bad experience ruins your overall perceived rating

I have been to this dentist office for about a year now. I had not had bad experiences before. I always enjoyed the friendly staff but didn't care for the times that I had to wait for a while to be seen. But I felt like that was expected at most offices. My husband did have a bad experience because one of his teeth after a filling ended up hurting more afterwards, and had to get it basically redone.
My last appointment there was last week, it was about 2 hrs of new fillings since I had been putting them off for a while. My mouth was open for a long time and I felt like the hygienist would some times use the suction tube a little too rough. The tube was jammed a bit into the end of my mouth and I jumped a bit but you know you cant really complain when you have your mouth open and a drill in your mouth.
Anyway, the work in my teeth seems to be fine, it takes a while to get adjusted to the new feeling of the bite but from the appt Tuesday to Friday morning I developed a very sharp pain in my throat. Saturday, became an excruciating pain that did not let me eat or even swallow my own spit. My glands were swollen all through my neck, first on one side then both. I developed a fever of 101 and I had chills for a couple of hours. So obviously I was fighting a bad infection, I took pain medication most of this time, but it didn't ease the pain a lot. Sunday morning I decided to go to Urgent care because I could not sleep from the pain and at that point I was pretty sure I had strep throat. Test was positive and I got a shot of antibiotics.
So, I know I can't prove that I got this infection from this dentist office without testing their instruments and their people on the day of the appointment. But my own conclusion is that, I got the infection there. I have never had strep throat, and nobody in my circle had it and the timing of the infection fits perfectly with the exposure at the dentist appointment. Sucked really bad, I have had sore throat before but strep throat is another level of pain and discomfort.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mandy Atkisson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was nice,  however I finally found a dentist in my network and I get referred to someone else so now I have to start over. Very frustrating!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Villela
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today I had to get a clean up and my dad as well and the workers here treated me and my dad with all the respect and made us feel at home. And the hygienist  Christine was awesome we talked about sports and made me feel comfortable for my cleaning. I just want to thank everyone here for making me feel welcome and a special thanks to Angelica & ReIna had best customer service. I always leave this place with bright whites and a BIG TEXAS SMILE on my face.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryoko Mundine
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best dental appointment I've ever had. Everything was clearly explained. I left feeling like I know exactly what needs to be done and how. Staff is knowledgeable, kind, and encouraging. The technology in this location is cutting edge. I'm so relieved I found this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Orrin Sandlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dentist was great. They got me in and out quickly and even performed the fix I needed same day instead of having me come back in later that week. Will be a future patient for a long time

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marlene Gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely best experience I have had with the dentist. Everyone is super friendly. The doctors and hygienists involve the patient in every step of the process and are genuinely interested in the well being and comfort of the patient. Please come here!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Stenzel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Claudia is AMAZING! Dr K helped my crazy fear of dentists decline and Gaby has the patience of an angel for x-rays... I had a horrible experience with the dentist of my nightmares about 10 years ago and some friends convinced me Dr K was the way to go... There was no judging... Just getting my teeth on a plan to get them back on track.  If you're scared of the dentist or just putting it off, do yourself a favor and come here... Its like a huge weight off my shoulders knowing I'm getting back on track!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Every time I step into the office I am blown away by the professionalism and friendliness of all the staff.  Having the receptionist give a courtesy call the day before helped remind me that I even had the appointment!

Being able to have a consistent relationship with the hygienist (Jannet) helped avoid any awkwardness of having to meet a new person every time.  She was very friendly, genuine, and provided quality dental cleaning!  I know that whenever I see her, I'll be updated on good movies and books to read.

Dr. Ghang is equally as impressive as his staff. Having those "cool shades" helped avoid the harsh glare of those lights and made things very comfortable.  I always felt like he had my best interest in mind whenever he worked with me.  The office is clearly a reflection of his own professionalism and love for patients and staff.

I'd personally endorse this place for all people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Castille
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock Dental is a great place! I’ve been a patient here with Dr. K for 3+ years and always had a positive experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amairani Fruechte
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would recommend you go somewhere else. They found an incredible amount of cavities in my teeth, I got three corners of my mouth fixed before I hesitated to go back. Guess my sixth sense kicked in! I had to go back two more times just so they could sand down one of the top fillings that was hitting the bottom tooth. Never had this happened to me before. I think that says a lot about how they "fill" your cavities. That's when I decided to never return.

My new dentist looked at my fillings and called them terrible (he used another word, you get the point). He also didn't find as many cavities as I supposedly had yet to be filled. I am so relieved I stopped going to River Rock!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eduardo Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zachary Carlson and staff were fast, professional, knowledgeable and friendly. I now understand first hand why my wife raves about this dentistry, and I will do so as well. Thank you River Rock Dental. See you in 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Eckstrom
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and doctors at River Rock dental in Southpark Meadows  have always been extremely informative, upfront and helpful. They take the time to educate me on dental hygiene and what they will be doing for me on each specific  visit. They have the best bedside manner. I no longer fear going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: NA
user_reviews_extended.Description: I couldn’t be happier with my 1st visit at the Southpark location. The staff were very polite, friendly and helpful. Very clean office. Dr. Klintmalm was exceptional in the experience he provided. Not only did he listen to my needs and offer me options but he educated me and was judgement free. A dentist with professionalism and sense of humor! Can’t wait for my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: rvelas09
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to River Rock Dental since my little guy was six months and now he’s six years old. I’m proud to say that their customer service is always above and beyond, their office is always kept clean and maintained. My son loves going to the dentist! Keep up the great work River Rock Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: OldSoul
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was my first time at River Rock. I went for a simple cleaning to remove stains on my teeth. It was wonderful place, no complaints whatsoever- except for the X-rays.
I'm a healthy 18 year old who has never had any issues- not even a cavity- and I've gone to the dentist annually or bi-annually for years. I don't care if it's "required," I do not need 18 X-rays! This is ridiculous! My last X-rays were "not recent enough" because they were a year old. Big whoop. If they're doing this just for money, it's backfiring. I will not continue to go to the dentist on a regular basis if that means getting X-rays for no apparent reason. I'm asking myself why I even went today. X-rays should be patient-specific period. And if the X-rays are not harmful (as I was assured), why did they keep asking to make sure I wasn't pregnant?

user_reviews_extended.Name: San Zlu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was the first time my 5 year old has ever experienced a Dentist. Everyone was extremely friendly, kind and genuine. Made him feel safe and comfortable. I will be switching my personal dental services there as well now. Love them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Estrada
user_reviews_extended.Description: Recently switched over to River Rock Dental- Southpark Meadows and I couldn’t be happier. Dr. Carlson is absolutely amazing. I’ve never so at ease at the dentist. The staff is also very friendly and professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and Doctors were absolutely amazing. I went in with a toothache, ended up getting a root canal. I was sure I would be in a lot of pain, the Doctor answered all of my  questions that I had. Numbed my face up really well proceeded with my root canal. I truly appreciated all the help. Taking away the pain, really recommend River Rock Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Neely
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience at River Rock Dental! Even having the dreaded Root Canal was a painless and fast experience at the hands of the professional and caring staff there! Would highly recommend River Rock Dental for any needs you may have or have been putting off!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Doan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been a patient at River Rock Dental for about 3 years now and it's been an awesome experience! I had been looking for a good dentist since I moved to Austin, but never really found anyone that I trusted. When I went to River Rock Dental for the first time, I was greeted with a friendly and helpful staff. They helped me with my paperwork and insurance information. (I was a recent grad from college so all of this was new to me.) They give me reminder calls when my appointment is coming up and are always so professional.

On my last visit a few months ago, Jannet was the dental hygenist that cleaned my teeth and she was wonderful! Gentle, easy to talk to, and did a great job!  Once she was done, she went and got Dr. Yohan to do the examination. Even though they were busy, there was little to no wait for him to come in and start. I would recommend Dr. Yohan to anyone I know! He's very careful during examinations and always explains thoroughly potential issues and how I can best take care of my teeth to prevent any further issues in the future. He's incredibly friendly, knowledable, and trustworthy. As long as I'm in Austin, I'll definintely continue to go to River Rock for my dental needs!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and professional staff. Jannet the hygienist , did a great job on my cleaning and makes it fun while doing so. she definitely takes pride in her profession .. I say five star over all. Would definitely recommend River rock dental !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lupe Naomi Padilla-Arenivar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Yoon and Mired are an amazing team! They got me through my root canal with no pain! Everything was explained to me and I felt confident with the procedure. Mired even postponed her lunch to stay with me, being that it was my first visit with Dr. Yoon! Such dedication! Dr. Yoon was thorough and attentive! Erica was also very helpful, as are all the staff at Southpark! My son and I have been going there for at least 8 years and we have never been disappointed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benjamin Castruita
user_reviews_extended.Description: Anxiety going to a dentist is perfectly natural, however with Dr. K and his staff I have felt quite at ease with all my visits, especially since my 1st one was an emergency. Everyone is professional and courteous.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Never Again!  Worst Dental cleaning experience of my life!!!  It felt like the hygienist was going to break my teeth while she cleaned them!  I was literally squirming in my chair from the pain and fear of what damage she was going to do that day!  At one point she stopped to tell me that the patient before me make her stop in the middle of the cleaning and got up and left!!!!!!   I was in shock that she was able to tell this story and still not understand that she was being way too rough!!!  The Dentist wasn't any better.  Like I said, never again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tavi Israel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Needed a second opinion and this office helped me with no problem. Previous dental office left me feeling so discouraged as they over priced the work I needed done. After being in pain for quite some time this office helped me alleviate the issues and even offered payment options. Don't think I'll go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Barrett Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had immediate dental needs and was fortunate to see Dr. Klintmalm at River Rock Dental, SPMeadows. The entire staff was professional and caring. I have never experienced a dentist or assistants this informative throughout the entire procedure. I highly recommend this dentistry team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Castille
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Dentist and Staff! It’s a super friendly and caring environment with cool Star Wars art (I’m a nerd). I always receive top tier care and they get you in very quickly. 10/10 recommend to a friend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelby Stark
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for an orthodontic FREE consultation. They said they don't charge insurance for the consultation. So I thought okay, I'll try them out to see if I like them. The assistant was kind of rude but besides that nothing was wrong I just thought they weren't a good fit. When I'm leaving they give me a price for braces and say my insurance doesn't cover it. Which I know my policy does, I checked before I made the appointment. Then a couple weeks later I get a bill from my insurance for my copay saying they charged insurance! After 1.they said they don't charge insurance for a consultation and 2. They said my insurance wouldn't cover it and wanted to charge me full price! They are very shady and will not be getting my business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcella Perry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. K and his staff are quite professional with an awesome sense of listening to my needs and concerns.  I highly recommend this dental practice to anyone that wants a great dentist and an excellent staff that mirrors his professionalism and caring sense for their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ho Jang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Long time user but first time reviewer. You know it has to be either an incredibly good or bad experience to write your first review and I'm happy to say that this is a very positive one. I don't live in Austin and was visiting a friend when I woke up with terrible pain. It was a Saturday and I wasn’t even sure if any place was open, but a quick search and a phone call later, I was on my way to River Rock Dental. The facility looked very clean and modern. After a short wait, I was seen by Dr. Yohan who performed some wizardly magic (I think the technical term is a root canal). Thank you to the staff and Dr. Yohan for saving the remainder of my trip to Austin and taking such good care of me on such short notice! You guys are the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Hundley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Klintmalm and his staff are awesome! Always thorough and super friendly! You are in good hands with every visit. Clean office space/practices as well, which is especially efficient with all of the COVID-19 happenings! Will be returning for future appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie Pacheco
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quick, painless and friendly. Can’t stand the dentist but since my wife makes me go, I’m glad this place is there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Arroyo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Yohan and his staff are always professional and helpful. I go in twice a year for cleaning and (once for a cavity--shame on me) and I always experience excellent service. I highly recommend River Rock Dental in Southpark Meadows!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Borden
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are amazing! They made me feel super comfortable and took the time to explain everything to me and make sure that I understand what is going on. They didn't try to upsell anything to me and were fully transparent about pricing and procedures. I will definitely be recommending them to family and friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: S K
user_reviews_extended.Description: I could honestly kick myself for not remembering the name of the dentist I saw, but he was amazing! He had a cool tattoo on his right upper arm, to narrow it down. For someone who hasn’t been to the dentist in (low murmur) years, it was essentially painless. I wish I were staying south so I could go back for my next cleaning! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosendo Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every time I go in for an appointment they make it super easy and stress free. I can be prone to stressing out and over thinking. Their staff and doctors have been a huge relief and support for me on my way back to dental divinity.

user_reviews_extended.Name: tina keener
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went here for my 5 YR old grandson and they were an awesome establishment and were great with him. Made him feel safe comfortable and he actually isn't worried about the idea of going back that alone made me very happy. b all out just a great dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexy A
user_reviews_extended.Description: We’ve made River Rock Dental our dentist for the entirety of our kids lives and we are always happy with our visits. The dentist is always kind, funny, and very knowledgeable. They answer any questions or concerns we have with care and consideration.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Me and my son have been coming here for at least 4years. Staff is amazing and friendly, they accept medicaid which helps and also have a great plan for anyone who doesn’t have insurance/Medicaid.
Very well managed and clean. I love coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Showalter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going here for almost a year and I love it. They are so nice and they work with you. I couldn’t come in for a filling during the week and they opened on the weekend just for me! When I had to get work done I couldn’t pay the thousands it cost so they helped me work out a payment plan. I’d put 10/10 stars if I could.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerry Reed
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. K and his team are fantastic. He truly cares about his patients. I am so glad that I finally found a dentist that does not make you feel bad about your teeth, but instead works with you to correct and maintain them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: arelys garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dental appointment I've had in my entire life.  Cristina is the best hygienist I've ever met, she is very gentle and professional.  Dr K is the best.  Thanks to the entire team of River Dental Southpark Meadows

user_reviews_extended.Name: Crystal Ramon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I tried to schedule an appointment for a Saturday, but had to wait a week to find out which Saturdays they'd be open for the month of November. Finally, a week later when I got an appointment, I asked for it to be at 8:30. The man on the other end first agreed to the time, then paused and asked if 9:30 would be ok. I agreed to 9:30 then asked for him to call me after he verified my insurance. He never called back. Two weeks later when I go in for my appointment the girls at the counter tell me I'm late! My appointment was for 8:30, and I could come back at 1:00. I explained that I wanted it at 8:30, but that the man told me no. I had even received a confirmation call the day before! Weeks of my time wasted because I could have gone somewhere else, somewhere that knows what Saturdays they are open, somewhere with competent employees! I'm sure the dentists are great, but it's not worth dealing with the unprofessional employees at the counter.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jimmy Castro
user_reviews_extended.Description: My name is Tina. I wanted to express my sincerest gratitude to Dr. Klintmaln and his team. Thank you for being able to see what your patients need and working with them to reach their goal. This is a good place, period. Good vibes, happy atmosphere....❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bekah Self
user_reviews_extended.Description: I took my children to this dental practice and had a wonderful experience. After looking for a good fit for my large family, I think we finally found our family dentist! So pleased!! Highly reccommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dee Forbes
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is amazing and friendly. Their office is very clean and tidy. Dr. K is great! He's very professional and gave me the best experience I've had at a dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Chandler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to this location for a while. The doctor is really nice and gentle, but the front staff (especially Erica) have become rude. I recieved my first bill on a Thursday 3/1 saying it was due on 3/16. On 3/3 I recieved a phone call threatening to send me to collections?? The bill isn't even due yet and you want to send me to collections!!! I will never return to this location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly, professional and efficient! Second time being with them and they are simply perfect. No pain, no discomfort, best dental experience I’ve had! Highly recommend :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ce'Nandra Franklin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very scared of dentists to be honest, but I loved Dr. Ghang's office. He is very patient and explains everything really well. His entire staff is very friendly, especially Esme. Very beautiful clinic, and it's great for people of all ages especially families.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Deese
user_reviews_extended.Description: Scheduling was a really frustrating experience. I never ended up going because they canceled my appointment. You have to confirm the appointment after making it. I get that it costs money when people flake out but clients (Especially new ones) should be able to make an appointment and just show up when they say they will.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Chairez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had our first appt for our 3 children. The staff was very friendly and patient with us. Had good experience and everything went smoothly and quickly. Extremely happy the check out person even offered to help me out to car.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hayden Doughty
user_reviews_extended.Description: Entire office is amazing they’re very friendly and offer best service I’ve ever received from a dentist! Debbie is wonderful every time, she’s a delightful woman and she even remembers my name. Strongly recommend using this place of business to anyone searching for a dentist office they can trust and use time and time again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renuka Rajan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr K is a very attentive person.  He takes good care of my dental health, answers all my questions patiently and is extremely prompt when a situation arises.  All in all 5 stars to Dr K and the River Rock dental staff

user_reviews_extended.Name: Glenda Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wanted to share with everyone,  my experience ,I really love this place my Dentist is Dr.yohan his very nice and very professional,he explain to me very clearly and honest what I need to work on. As we'll  my dental hygienist  Janet she is so kind and gentle  she made my teeth feel wonderful, she explain to me how to floss and brush my teeth . I  highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Mojica
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can honestly say I love going to the dentist, Only if my appointment is at River Rock Dental. The staff are great and make your feel very comfortable during your visit. ( that's very hard to do at a Dentist office ) ;-)
Thank you River Rock Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: jennifer orozco
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super nice and friendly staff that were happy to answer all my concerns and questions. I was especially concerned I couldn’t afford the work I needed since I’m not insured but they were very affordable and broke down all the prices. Not to mention I broke my tooth last night and they were able to see me the very next morning! They seriously saved me from having to go thru a weekend in pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annmarie B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience, Dr. K was wonderful, professional and caring. Took the time to go over all of my concerns.  Everyone in the office was polite, professional and very friendly.  Could not have had a better experience, highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma Jean Actress (KillersoftheFlowerMoon)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely LOVE Dr. Klintmalm. Professional, always caring, gentle, kind, patient and FUNNY! I would recommend him to everyone reading this. If you live nearby, don’t think twice - go see him, you’ll thank me. Another great thing - they are open on Saturdays!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rene Botello
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Carlson and his team are amazing. Everyone is super helpful and polite. I didn’t have to wait long, and the treatment I received was very sensitive and kind. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Furst
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Carlson is the best.  My cleaning with was excellent!  I highly recommend River Rock Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: angie herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First off I have to say my first experience was great! But now every time after it get worse and worse. Let me start off with my second appointment I showed up and they had rescheduled me without notifying me they claimed to call me and left me a voice-mail when I showed them the text they had sent me confirming my appointment!! Secondly, i had to wait an extra 30 min to get seen after everyone that had there appointments even though I had one also. The lady that cleanned my teeth rushed the whole way through it she was done so fast I felt like it was a waste of my time and money. Then they claimed they switched message provideres this was the reason for the discrepancy.

Now this appointment the same thing happens they claimed they called me to reschedule when I have text messages from the week before advising me of my appointment and one todayto confirm.  So I confirm the appointment 5 min later. When I call after work to see if I could pay out of pocket since my insurence changed and wont be valid for a while they put me on hold and say the hygienists wont be in if I can change my time??? I already requested the time off 3 weeks ago I can't just change it. So I explain O can't change the time they give me a futher out appointment!!! For the second time, they had already recheduled me. They are either over booking or don't care to call and change the appointment for the customers. If I would not have called I would had never know they had no hygienist for me available when I showed up. I am definitely looking around for a diffrent dentist place to go.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adriana
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Dr. Klintmalm, he was very kind and patient with my needs! Answered every question I had with full detail. As well as gave me options for treatment. I will definitely recommend him to all my family and friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kelsey gray
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and doctor are really nice and comforting. I have bad anxiety at the dentist and they made sure I was okay and comforted. I recommend this location. It’s very clean and nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Milner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Stay well clear, I had a family member visit them, on their website they said they took our insurance and my insurance said they were in-network as well. We came in for cleaning, afterwards they decided to let us know that they do not actually take our insurance, in contrary to everything we were informed of before the appointment. Ended up with a $300 bill for a routine cleaning. Complete scam, I would recommend all to take their business elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vincent DeLuna-Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everything was great! Super friendly office staff, assistants, and doctors. The doctor was so great I fell asleep twice during my visit. I was there four hours and it felt like just one! Definitely going back

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justine Griffith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dentist experience I’ve ever had! The entree staff was lovely and extremely informative. I will definitely be recommending to others! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I been going to this location since 2019 the dentist have always helped me since then I went in on 10.9.24 for a cleaning had the worst experience mainly from the front desk and office manager. I plan to look for another dental office because they lost my business for sure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roland Trevino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Very professional and helpful. Courtney did a great job with the teeth cleaning. 👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Duley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Positive experience overall; I never find dentist visits enjoyable, but these folks make it as tolerable as possible and are always pleasant and professional.

They also seem to be taking COVID protocols very seriously.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ali Murad
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wish there is less than one star to give them. They refused to give a regular check up for my 3 years old kid because he was little bit scare and he started crying. Dr. Carlson who rejected to give the baby a medical service, and he kicked my wife and my baby out of the clinic. they were very rude because this was first experience for my kid and Dr. Carlson messed up with him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Cantu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Woke up at 8 AM with the worst toothache! I called and was able to be seen by 11 when I got there I filled out paperwork got my consultation and spoke to the dentist about what the best options where for my teeth! Maybe a 2 hr process but they were also very busy! THE STAFF WAS SUPER FRIENDLY AND HELPFUL!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Locker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is always friendly and helpful! Seeing Dr K always makes my day- he’s such a nice guy and he makes you feel like you’re in great hands! Love him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Lynn Amos
user_reviews_extended.Description: They all take great care of me and explain how and what they were going to do for me and my mouth! I’m very happy with them! Deb did a wonderful job cleaning my teeth and Dr. Yoon was wonderful taking out my tooth. Thanks so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krystal Tellez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. A and Stephanie are the best! They know I am always nervous but they make feel at ease and have me laughing at the end of each visit.  And Erica in the front is so nice and very helpful on any questions I may have.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jess Fox
user_reviews_extended.Description: My mother has a severe dental phobia and a genetic condition that is severely worsened by dental pain which causes her muscles to constrict without release, she loves this dentist so much she comes from Houston to have work done at this office. They make her comfortable and keep her out of pain. If it's worth a 3+ hour drive then I'm sure it's worth it for locals.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Navarro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ortho braces team sucks. These girls are so darn rough  it’s always someone different replacing wires and bands which is no issue but most of these people speed through, stabbing and being rough. I kindly made a note to please be gentle with the tool they use and the girl became offensive.Very rude and  unprofessional. I don’t recommend getting braces from them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: America Villarruel
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time here and I will definitely be coming back! Very quick and easy paperwork, the Dentist along with the MA were very helpful and nice. Place is clean.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Chatham
user_reviews_extended.Description: A warm blanket.  Vaseline on my lips so they didn’t dry out.  Everything to ensure I was comfortable.  Pain free dentistry.  Can’t recommend enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savannah Billingsley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ghang and his staff are friendly and patient with my children at their checkups. They fit in any extra needed procedures in a timely manner. I would highly recommend this dentist especially for kids.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leticia Amaro
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am giving this office 2 stars because they are very customer friendly, however, they have made two major billing errors on my account which cost me $1,000. I would have rethought my plan off action if I knew the amount I would pay or saved money and used my flex pay account. I was a new customer and 2 major errors in the first month is too much.  If you decide to go with this office I would know the dates and tooth number of all major procedures before going into the office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Avery Flores

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lydia Dobbins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wish I’d never gone to this place.
Do NOT recommend. I only needed a couple things done but had to go in 6 times in two months. Read the bad reviews. Wish I had, several experiences similar to mine.

As most say, nice staff. I’ll give them that. But it doesn’t make up for the rest of it.

I was told I needed several fillings and a crown and to replace one crown. I have terrible teeth, so I believed them (should’ve gotten a second opinion but I had an exclusively breastfeeding newborn at the time and it’s a lot to get a sitter.)

At the first appointment, they did the fillings, one crown and a cleaning. The cleaning was a total joke. No scraping of plaque or anything. Just a quick swab of polishing stuff and that was it.

The fillings were way to high and gave me horrible pain for several days, finally got a sitter again to go and get them shaved down some so my bite wouldn’t be as uneven. They shaved too far on one tooth and now there’s pain on it each time I chew, but I don’t want to go to them to fix it. Also, thankfully insurance covered that visit, cause they wanted to charge me for correcting their mistake.

I went to get the other crown and fillings done on the other side. One of my teeth now feels like it has a crack in it that it did not have before and I can’t hardly eat on that side either. They had to call me in an extra time because they screwed up the scans. So another babysitter. The temporary crown has fallen off twice while waiting for the permanent crown. So more arranging childcare and more dealing with the temporary cement and my bite shifting because they didn’t make sure the crown was on there correctly one of the times.

I’ve been waiting till I get the permanent crown done so I can never go back to that place. It’s been a very frustrating experience to say the least. I chose it because they had good overall reviews and it was close to me, which was ideal with my baby. Wish I’d never gone there and just taken the time to go somewhere better even if it was further away.

title: Peak Dental - South Austin
address: 11330 Menchaca Rd, Austin, TX 78748, United States

user_reviews.Name: Michael Canton
user_reviews.Description:
I was a patient of their’s for about 3 years and I just now realized that you should always get a second opinion. They tried to sell me a dental cap when all I needed was a filling. Dentists are also inconsistent and you’re guaranteed to not have the same one on the second or third visit.

I’m happy I finally switched dentists. These folks never made me feel comfortable about my smile and I always felt like I was being judged.

user_reviews.Name: Rob Figueroa
user_reviews.Description:
Be careful with Peak Dental!

This is a rudderless business with have no management and therefore no communication.

Dr. Luis Oraca and Dr. Zizi who first saw me have since vanished and left their clients to deal with their mess.

Keisha the office manager for the north location who promised to help track someone down for us to at least get our money back has also decided to take the same direction and told us there was nothing they could do nor would she put us in contact with anyone.

I have been passed around the over 2 years with my Invisalign treatment and have made no attempt to resolve the issue.

I've been taken for more than 12,000 dollars by this dental chain and I have nothing to show for except lost time and a refusal to do anything about it.

user_reviews.Name: Donna Pitts
user_reviews.Description: This place has to be one of the worst dental spots I've been to in a long time. Had a few crowns done in which they had left globs of cement around each one with out fully cleaning them out leaving me with extreme sensitivity and pain. They also misaligned my teeth and my bite had to be completely corrected. I had to take out a care credit card to spend 5400 dollars on work that had to be completely corrected by my new dentist. Also, the dental assistants are very inexperienced and while the dentist was working on my tooth she had to constantly correct everything she did. Complete scam and took a lot of money from me that can't be replaced. I have to say I'm actually traumatized of this dental office.

user_reviews.Name: Jay R Wooley
user_reviews.Description: I've been coming here for years and always great and affordable service.  Dr. Ishtiaq is great, as is all the staff I've dealt with.

user_reviews.Name: Peter Schwarck
user_reviews.Description: Went here for a while. Always seemed like they were trying to up sell me on everything. Then they drilled a cavity with out letting novocane fully kick in. Very painful. On the last scheduled appointment the office was close with no notice. No matter,  wont be going back anyway.

user_reviews.Name: adrian perez
user_reviews.Description: My two son have their braces work done there, they both towards the end of having them on, and there last three appointments have been cancelled by them due to one thing and other, they have not got back to me, one of my sons metal rods was cutting inside of his mouth so he took it out, but these guys have not help me at all to get thing taken care . I have paid good Money but they have not help me .

user_reviews.Name: Racheal Rae
user_reviews.Description: Peak Dental - South Austin is a dental gem! The staff greeted me warmly, and I was seen promptly. Dental Assistant Crystal was incredibly sweet and gentle, guiding me through each step of the process with care. Dr. Zaffetti was not only knowledgeable but also took the time to thoroughly explain all my treatment options, alleviating any concerns I had about my dental plan. One thing that stood out was the clean and comfortable atmosphere of the office, which helped ease any nerves I had about my appointment. Layah (hope I spelled that right) at the front desk was also fantastic, making the checkout process seamless and scheduling my next visit a breeze! Overall, Peak Dental exceeded my expectations, and I'm relieved to have found such a welcoming and professional dental home.

user_reviews.Name: Sonja Ballance
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Zizi is absolutely amazing! She has the best bed side manner and makes you feel very safe. She’s also very confident and knows exactly what your best options are for your oral health. She goes above and beyond while being so kind and thankful to have you as a patient. Anytime I was extremely anxious for treatment she’d get me through it letting me know I was safe and how efficient she was/is. I had extensive work done by her and I wish I still lived in the area to continue my care with her. Also, she aesthetically improved my smile/front teeth in a way I didn’t even know was possible! 😊

user_reviews_extended.Description: Was supposed to be sedated  and have 4 wisdom teeth extracted. Turns out. I WAS AWAKE the entire painful time. What a horrible experience and to top it off, they gave me ibuprofen for the pain LOL. I asked for something stronger and was given Tylenol 3s. DO NOT have an extraction done here. I am in extreme pain and the meds they prescribed aren't doing a single thing for it. Shame on Peak Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diandra King
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Office and staff were completely amazing!! They made me feel right at home, even had coffee available for patients. Front staff girls were so welcoming when I first walked in, they had sent all new patient forms via text so it made everything so convenient and fast.
Hygienist and doctor  are happy to educate you answer all my questions, and do same day treatment! Assistants were comforting during the whole process and made sure my experience was fantastic.
Who knew coming to the dentist could be fun. Definitely coming back!
I recommend Peak Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: alicia rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: this place helped my mom out in an emergency tooth pull, day of, when her usual dentist wouldn't. the professionals that helped us were so kind and considerate that i decided to come back for my own dental health. the people i was helped by were still so kind and non judgmental about my situation. i could not be more satisfied and they communicate very well! even when i woke up late for a consultation appointment, they were still understanding and helped me reschedule for later that day! i HIGHLY RECOMMEND this location, you WILL be taken care of thoroughly :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today around 3:00 my crown popped off I called they got me in with 1 hour to close. Both assistant and dentist were professional. I will be back to get more work done as I felt comfortable and welcomed. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: C H
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend getting a second opinion if they tell you the following: you have an infection or you need a deep clean + your insurance doesn't cover said intervention(s). I had a long history of being told my teeth and gums were in great shape. Went to this place and they recommended cleanings that weren't covered (I declined), was then charged a fee that shouldn't have even existed per my insurance, and then told by another practice that my teeth were in great shape and needed nothing that was recommended by Peak. Sadly, it is so prevalent these days for these chain practices to recommend services that are unnecessary just to make a buck. Unfortunately, they get you sucked in because you've already likely taken off work, they now have your X-rays, and then they refuse to even do your routine cleaning if you decline their upcharge (deep clean). I'd love to know how many of the folks reviewing here were told they needed something insurance didn't cover... 🧐

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meighan Knight
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful staff! I explained how high anxiety I am and they worked with me to keep me calm. I felt safe and comfortable. Been back 4x to complete all the dental work needed. I highly recommend this place. Amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim Hollis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Daniel Zaffetti with Peak Dental, South location, along with his amazing staff, have provided me the highest quality of dental care, with results to prove it, along with impressive professionalism, courtesy, compassion, and great communication and technical skills as well. I have previously had extremely high levels of anxiety at the thought of a dental appointment, and while it’s still not the best part of my day or week, as a result of their gentle, kind and compassionate approach, I have been willing and emotionally stable enough to schedule regular visits for maintenance and repairs, as needed, which previously was the biggest obstacle for me maintaining good oral health. Thank you Dr. Z and team…your exceptional bedside manner, along with your expertise and knowledge, are very much appreciated!!!
Sincerely,
—Jim

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nina Keller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really great office! Every staff member was super nice and positive. The Dr was very clear and concise.  Everything was completely painless, I could have napped haha. Also didn't have to spend much time waiting around, that's always a plus at a doctor's office when they respect your time.  Looking forward to my next cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Maier
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough good things about Peak Dental South Austin! I came to them with a tooth emergency after not having had a proper dentist in 2 years or more. They helped relieve the pain and remedy the situation -- on a Saturday, no less. And then I continued using them as my dentist. To this day Dr. Z and her team have done incredible work. Their communication and accommodations and spirit are outstanding. My teeth. . . have never looked nor felt so good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas Hobbs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Gave up on trying to get my kids scheduled with their previous (and very well known) dental group. Peak was perfect and great to deal with! No issues at all, and their entire staff is amazing and polite. We've found our new family dentist and the location is wonderful for us. Thanks, y'all!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rodrigo Machuca
user_reviews_extended.Description:
TL;DR outstanding customer focused service

I've been coming for more than 2 years to this location and even though I was generally happy with the service, recently they have revamped and shifted focus to not only great actual dentist service but also with what feels personal and intimate customer relationship. I did not feel rushed at all with my appointment and I could feel comfortable asking any question or comment I had. Also conversations felt relatable and not just small talk to fill a checkbox.

With regard to my actual dentist service, it was greatly explained beforehand and executed flawlessly without any pain at all. I also got follow up tips on how to properly recover and how to make the process more bearable.

Would recommend to others. Keep it up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I applied for financing then had to cancel, before the service was started. You would think it would be relatively easy to resolve this but it wasn't. I was told by Peak that it would take 4 weeks to process on their side, but over 5 weeks later I have to call in again to find out they haven't done it... they finally do it, with just the click of a finger, moments after they get the call, amazing. Now I have a bill due for a service I didn't get while a refund that should have been processed at least a week ago is finally in the beginning stage of being processed. I can't get the bill date moved far enough for me not to have to pay it so that sucks...

Basically, if you cancel a service and use financing here you will never be able to get your refund or cancel future payments with out "pulling teeth" (figuratively of course, lol).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan Welch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very easy to work with staff. Dr's were very knowledgeable and honest. Didn't try to sell me on a bunch of recurring work like all before have. I have had bad teeth for awhile and they were understanding and logical with the treatment plan moving forward. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS BUSINESS!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you hate avoidable fees avoid this dental office! I was contacted a year after my appointment and told I owed $96 dollars for a “deep clean” that my insurance provided.

I have never paid for a routine cleaning or exam in other dental offices. Feel like I was tricked into a “deep cleaning” experience without clear education regarding the expected cost.

Definitely be cautious if you are visiting this location for secret fees and payments you may see a year from service…

Update: called the office. Told me it would take 14 days to review my case…my balance for this extra “deep cleaning” was +$200 just for my top teeth. If you’re a customer please inquire about extra cleanings to avoid cost!!!

user_reviews_extended.Description: They were great with my anxiety around pain and the trauma of my previous dentists. user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Ochoa Vargas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Pros: amazing customer service, you’ll get text reminders for your appointments, the dentists and staff are nice and pleasant.

Cons: terrible dental care. I went in for a cleaning and got told that I needed a “deep cleaning”, which involves going deep into the gum line, getting my mouth numbed, replacing my only 2 fillings, and adding 2 new ones. Estimate care was around $1600, suspiciously close to my insurance-covered max. I decided to get a second opinion.

Turns out this overblown estimate was more the dentists trying to churn a profit rather than a medical necessity. The second dentist told me a normal cleaning, one filling replacement, and a prescription mouth rinse would suffice. Definitely way less than the $1600+ they quoted me. Once you start with deep cleanings, you will consistently need to go back to them, and they are not cheap or easy on your gums. No wonder they welcomed me to the “Peak family” after giving me my estimate. Definitely recommend going to a less branded dental office, with less marketing overhead to cover.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Banton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Expeditious and professional service! I have never sat in the waiting room for more than a few minutes. The staff is friendly and do their best to make their patients feel comfortable. Peak Dental has raised my expectations for quality dental service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: tankrizzo1
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In short.  Super - clean facility, great - caring staff, awesome scheduling and the best emergency dental work I've had yet. Thank you Dr. Mimi, Sama and Lara!

Long story. Drove down from Colorado to central TX to visit family for Memorial day weekend. Noticed some extreme pain in one of my teeth and needed to get it checked out ASAP. I called ~10 local dentists, all of which were closed or weren't scheduling anything until after the long weekend. Peak was the only place that was able to see me on Saturday (next day).

Scheduling was easy, facility was super clean and welcoming. A quick exam and xray confirmed a cracked tooth and we decided on an extraction.

Dr. Mimi, Sama and Lara all were working on me to make sure everything went smooth. Up until this point I had never needed ANY kind of dental work, no cavities, just regular cleanings and wisdom teeth, so I was worried about the procedure.

The process went as smooth as it could get, I didn't feel any discomfort or had any question about the abilities of the staff. One of the techs gave my shoulder a reassuring small rub during the initial process to take my mind off of the process, it really helped. Such an amazing - caring staff!

After the tooth was successfully extracted, I felt immediate relief, they gave me a quick - thorough outbrief and wished me the best. If I lived in the area, no doubt they would be my dental team for life. The treatment I recieved was worth the 1.5 hour drive, I'd do it again in a heart beatLove them. Thank you all so much!

Its been 4 days since the procedure and havent had any issues. Thank you again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary South
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went here about a year ago and the visit was honestly just so chaotic. They tried to charge me for a service I didn’t even get (I’m sure they weren’t trying to swindle me but still very unprofessional if I had not caught it I would have paid more than I should have) and after my visit I decided to switch dentists. I’ve tried to call Peak Dental to get my dental x rays and they agreed to send them over and never did. I’ve tried to call several times over the past few days and NO ONE PICKS UP THE PHONE or even responds to voicemails. I’m not a person that posts bad reviews but this is honestly the reason I hate dentists. Do better please!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Hartman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Peak Dental told me I had 3 cavities, needed a deep clean so bad that they needed to numb my whole mouth, and needed a night mouth guard because I grind me teeth = $900 with insurance (mouth guard $500 alone). All to be done over 2 seperate appointments.
2 weeks later...
Family Dentistry next door told me my teeth look great and white, gums are healthy with almost no bleeding, NO CAVITIES, and no mention of mouth guard or teeth grinding! They did say I needed a little deep clean in 2 places, but nothing that needed numbing and was totally fine to do with regular cleaning. They are even trained and certified to laser deep clean which was painless! And they were all so amazingly kind, sweet, caring, encouraging, and fun! Especially Dr. Nguyen 10/10. Everything covered by insurance except laser which was only only $50. All of this, x-ray and cleaning since it was my first time, only took 1 hour and 30 mins from in to our the door.
DO NOT GO TO PEAK DENTAL! GO TO FAMILY DENTISTRY NEXT DOOR! Brush and floss too :)

title: Austin Primary Dental
address: 6700 West Gate Blvd STE 103, Austin, TX 78745, United States

user_reviews.Name: Victoria
user_reviews.Description: I, like many others, detest going to the dentist. However, my experience here has been incredibly positive. The service is exceptional, and the staff is incredibly kind and knowledgeable. When I entered the office, I was greeted with warm smiles, and my cleaning left me feeling refreshed, not sore or prodded. The dentist herself is incredibly kind and knowledgeable. She came in to check me out, and I could tell she truly understood her work. Overall, I had a fantastic experience and would highly recommend this office to anyone seeking dental care.

user_reviews.Name: Slappy Chicken
user_reviews.Description: If you’re an American like me, you probably have spent your wad on medical coverage which leaves little for dental coverage. That’s ok because the deep cleaning prices are fair here at only $1,000. This is actually fair for Austin TX. Luckily I only spend $1,500 a month/$18,000 a year for me and my wife’s medical coverage.  That’s why it was so easy to find the extra $1,000 laying around.  It’s great to finally be rich enough to get medical care after deciding to start a small business and working more than I’ve ever worked. Every day. Every weekend for years. Some times working over 200 days straight without any time off. I feel so lucky to be in this position to get my teeth cleaned.

user_reviews.Name: Sumitha Tharasingh
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Rupa Rajanna has been my dentist for the last two years. I had stopped going to dentist during Covid and had some serious work to be done. Dr. Rupa’s office was responsive in getting me in and Dr. Rajanna took care of my needs quickly and professionally. She has outstanding knowledge and fine mirror skills. She was thorough in her evaluation and ensured I am comfortable throughout the procedures and ensured work was done per my satisfaction. Now my entire family sees her for dental care. I’d recommend Austin Primary Dental to any one needing dental care.

user_reviews.Name: Izabel Brelage
user_reviews.Description: LOVE LOVE this dentist!! Staff is super friendly and I'm not a huge fan of teeth cleaning (who is??) but I felt super comfortable the whole time. The doctor was very professional and overall a very nice experience, 10/10 would recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Grecia Helena
user_reviews.Description:
About a month ago I came here for a cleaning, I heard on their speakers the commercial about Immigrants going back to their country (maybe the radio, so I ignored it)

A few weeks later I came here to bring my sister, and I see Sydney Sweenie magazine, front and center. (again maybe they just get it in the mail, I didn’t assume anything) it wasn’t until the receptionist turned on the tv, struggled with it for about 5 minutes and CHOSE Fox News to play on full blast, talking about “our president is saving Venezuela” (mind you it’s ONLY me and her in the waiting area at this point) so I asked her to turn it off which she did. If we’re going to push a political agenda, why is it a hateful one? this was sketchy thing number three, so I decided I didn’t want to be here.

Later my sister comes out and they had failed to tell  her that her process was TWO PARTS until they were finished with part one. That they needed to send off a crown to the lab, so she had a temporary crown for two whole weeks. So after I had decided to not return here, we HAD to come back. I needed the same procedure and found that other dentist practices can do it in one sitting.  (Austin modern dentistry, down the road, does the root canal crowns in office same day and it’s about the same price I went to them a day after the Fox News incident for my own crown and everything was good)

Safe to say I did not make my next cleaning appointment here and will not return.
If you don’t mind a place with racist undertones then the staff is pretty friendly. They’re also friendly at Austin Modern Dentistry, and there’s no weird commercials, or conservative news outlets (:

user_reviews.Name: Rohit Ranganath
user_reviews.Description: Great experience at this Austin dental clinic! The staff was friendly, the checkup and cleaning were thorough, and everything was handled professionally. Dr. Rupa Rajanna was especially kind and clear in explaining next steps for my dental health. Highly recommend for quality care in Austin!

user_reviews.Name: Marisa Silva
user_reviews.Description: I have only been here a few times in the past 4 years, because I live out of state and then was trying to save money. But now I have returned with alot more work to do on maintaining my teeth help. I have had positive experience with everyone that works there doing their work and their role very well to help me, including Dr. Rupa Rajanna, they are consistent and approach me with truth, dental education, and realness. I have only had teeth cleaning and fillings. I also have gotten a lot of great advice with help with enamel loss that occurred after i drank acidic beverages consistently for a few years, and the dental hygienist helped reveal to me that this is what was happening.  And gave my alot of great advice to assist me in my personal habits. Thanks so much.

user_reviews.Name: Jocelyn Knezevich
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been coming to Dr. Rajanna's for a while and always have a good experience. Everyone is friendly, gentle, and professional, and the office is clean and well run. I always feel well taken care of.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rupa Rajanna and her staff are wonderful. Marina at the front desk is very nice, friendly and professional. I had a great experience with all of the staff. I recommend this place. They all made me feel welcomed.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Primary is great! I never feel pressured to have work done unless I absolutely need it. They are very reasonable and take a prevention seriously with products that help extend the time between my cleanings. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been using them for 2 years. The staff does a good job in cleaning my teeth and are very attentive in answering questions about billing which I think is the most important thing at a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harry Singletary
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited the dental facility... I was very impressed with the staffs professionalism, dental knowledge and their sincere concern for my dental needs.  I will most certainly recommend Dr. Rajanna to all my family and friends...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edye Melton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been seeing Dr. Rajanna for regular cleanings every six months, and more recently, I've started Invisalign treatment to straighten a few teeth. Every visit has been a genuinely positive experience.
What I especially appreciate is that the office is run entirely by women—it's calm, quiet, and incredibly welcoming. The space is always clean and comfortable, which makes a big difference during appointments.
As someone who is disabled, I’m especially grateful for how accommodating and thoughtful the staff is. They go out of their way to ensure I’m comfortable, never rushed, and always well taken care of.
Dr. Rajanna is gentle, attentive, and highly professional. I feel fully confident in her care, and I truly look forward to each visit (which is saying a lot when it comes to dental work!).
Highly recommend this office to anyone looking for skilled, compassionate dental care in a peaceful and respectful environment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patty Gorchs
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dental visit went very well. Keri, the hygienist, was very informative, explaining what she saw on my x-rays. She made sure I was comfortable during my root planning and scaling. Dr. Rajanna gave me a thorough check-up, My visit was a pleasant experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suhas Ravi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience at this dental clinic in Austin! I went in for a general checkup, teeth cleaning, and dental scans. Everything was handled with great care and professionalism. The staff was friendly and made me feel comfortable throughout the process.

Dr. Rupa Rajanna was especially helpful she not only ensured the procedures were done thoroughly, but also took the time to guide me on the next steps for my dental health. Her explanations were clear and reassuring, and I really appreciated her recommendations.

Highly recommend this clinic if you're looking for quality dental care in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry Lepine
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff are friendly and Dr. Rupa Rajanna is easy to work with on any dental issue. She is a joy to work with as far as dentists go!

user_reviews_extended.Description: My favorite dentist’s office. Amazing staff, service is always quick and efficient. I’ve never had a bad experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Saira Chaudry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love coming to this dentist the whole staff is amazing and always takes care of me. Kerry is a gem and does my cleanings. They always send me with goodies and aftercare directions. I drive all the way from Sealy to see them. Definitely give them a try 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyndal Lothery
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist in Austin the doctor and everyone in the office is so kind , punctual and personable . Service is always great . I wouldn’t go to any other dentist in Austin . I left with a squeaky clean smilie today and I haven’t had dental work in some time . They explained everything to me as they did it and which tools were what and that is just another example of how wonderful they are .

user_reviews_extended.Name: benjamin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rajanna and each of the dentists took great care of me and accommodated my time constraints exceptionally! She was very reassuring and consistently made sure I had the best treatment. Super grateful and would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a loyal patient for many years and can honestly say that the staff at Austin Primary Dental is so helpful and friendly. They always take great care of me and offer flexible treatment options when appropriate.

If you are looking for a new dentist, I highly recommend this one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret von Paumgartten
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Both my husband and I have been going to Austin Primary Dental for about 4 years now and we can’t say enough great things about everyone there. Kind, compassionate and professional. Today was another example of going above and beyond. I had a (front) crown (from 14 years ago) come out and I called them with my issue and they squeezed me in. On a Friday. That’s customer care/ service.
Thank you ladies!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anuart Zarate
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rupa and all the staff member have always been great,I have been a client of Austin primary dental for a few years now and it has always been great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Bonilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent team at Austin Primary Dental! The women here are very friendly and professional. Dr. Rajanna and her team were thorough and addressed all of my dental concerns during my initial appointment. They worked seamlessly together to keep me comfortable and informed during each step of my visit, and I spent almost no time waiting. I am extremely happy with the services I received and will definitely be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Cates
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here for a few years and feel like my concerns are taken into consideration and procedures are explained to me thoroughly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cody Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a professional and friendly visit to the dentist. I've seen Dr Rajanna for pretty much every appointment over the last two years and it's clear she cares for her patients' health. Totally different from other practices where you might see a different doctor for every visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucian Klier
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was SO SWEET and accommodating. I haven’t been to the dentist in my adult life and everyone was so kind and gentle

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Kakareka
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental practice in the Austin area. Would definitely go again!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valeria M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lovely and super friendly staff! They definitely help take some of the anxiety out of big dental work. I’ve been going to them for about a year now and have had everything from a routine cleaning to a crown, and they’ve be so kind every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeana Kingsbury
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have an excellent experience when I come to Primary Dental.  I live North and travel South for my appointments.  Dr. Rajanna addresses me by first name and I like that.  Marina has been with this office since the day I started coming here and her personality is sparkling any time I come I for my appointments.  The dental assistant, Carrie educated me on my care and we she talks to me during my visit even though I cannot respond to her.  If you are looking for a dentist give the office a call and speak to Marina.  You will not be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrienne Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cannot recommend Dr. Rajanna and her team at Austin Primary Dental enough! Everyone, from Marina at the front desk to her assistant and the hygienist, are so wonderfully welcoming and kind. They're standard of care is stellar (they constantly checked to make sure was okay,  applied Vaseline to my lips to help with chapping, listened and acted swiftly when I indicated I was feeling pain, etc.). I got four fillings done so it was a marathon of a session and they stayed amazing for the entire process. They also got me in ASAP to take care of a filling that fell out. I'm so thankful to have found them and will definitely going to be going back. Sending all the family and friends that I can to them as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Shea
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my best dental office I’ve ever been to. I have had a lot anxiety about going to the dentist based on past experiences with other dentists and everyone at Austin Primary has done such amazing work and made me feel completely at ease. Everyone here is so friendly and always makes you feel comfortable. Thank you Austin Primary Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David L
user_reviews_extended.Description: I took my 9 year old son to get a cleaning and exam.  He felt right at ease with Dr. Rajanna and enjoyed his exam with her.  She didn't make him nervous and was nice and gentle with him.  This makes it a pleasant experience as a parent trying to take a child to the dentist, too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eduardo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was accommodating, educated and super helpful. Eased my dental anxiety. Doctor was thorough and extremely patient! Great experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Harkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was nervous after several years to go back to the dentist and they made it easy the first time in. Great folks doing great work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geronimo Ornelas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff, super attentive and wholesome people! Will be keeping this place as my family dentist for decades to come. They don’t just stop at the door and dental service, this practice creates a new smile and life for you! The work that is done is so diligent and if you have any questions, the team is sure to check in on you post dental procedure. I hope everyone gets to enjoy this dental family the way my family has.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Was looking for a new dentist and stumbled into this place . Super nice staff and very knowledgeable! Recommend

user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't count how many years I've been going to Austin Primary.   Always have great service every visit.  Love the staff.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rajanna and dental hygienist Carrie provided exceptional care during my visit. Their kindness and friendliness created a welcoming atmosphere, easing any anxieties I had about dental appointments. Their professionalism was evident in every aspect of the visit, from thorough explanations to gentle treatment. Carrie's expertise left my teeth feeling super clean and refreshed. I highly recommend their services for anyone seeking compassionate and top-quality dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicolette Ebner
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dental practice. Everyone is so nice from the front desk to the dental hygienist and doctor. They never make me feel bad even when I haven't been taking the best care of my teeth. So if you've been putting off going to the dentist because you're embarrassed go here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kacie Gilmore
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to Austin Primary Dental for a few years now and they have never disappointed. I've always felt comfortable and taken care of. Its a small and cozy environment. Everyone is so friendly and helpful, but also honest enough to shoot it straight with me which I highly appreciate. I couldn't recommend them enough. I don't plan on going anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Analucia Alegre
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place! Dr Rajanna and all the staff are just marvelous. Dr. R has literally the most delicate and precise hands for doing dental work (I’ve been to a handful of dentists in my life!); she will make the procedures as painless as possible and also ensure your bite and teeth feel as natural and comfortable as possible. She is very knowledgeable and patient with answering questions. I have now done quite a bit of dental work with this office (I was waiting to find the right doctor!), and now on my latest regular cleaning, I am so happy to report that my chompers and gums are clean and healthy! I am so thankful to the entire staff for helping me take care of my teeth, from the smiling & cheerful Marina (welcomes you at the front desk and makes you feel immediately less stressed), to all of the staff. Thanks for making going to the dentist way less scary!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Magaly Arredondo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Marina (the administrator at the front desk) was so kind over the phone and in person.

The dental assistant, dental hygienist, and dentist were all really helpful and kind. It’s been a while since I came to the dentist so I was scared and intimidated, but they were nonjudgmental and so so helpful.

The dental hygienist was patient with me and talked me through options for a water glosser and an electric toothbrush.
