user_reviews_extended.Name: ky
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an unfortunately similar experience today as some of the other one star reviews. I go to the dentist every six months and am embarrassingly, which was why I was so shocked when the dental hygienist was recommending that I receive several fillings, despite the dentist not even examining my teeth at that point. They kept saying that “you don’t want it to get worse,” but could not clearly tell me whether or not I had a cavity. Additionally, they never actually provided me with a treatment plan-- it felt like the hygienist was trying to get me to make an on-the-spot decision based on the concern that it "could get worse," not that there was actually decay present. The day after this visit, I went to get a second opinion and the dentist told me that there was one tooth that they would keep an eye on, but they would not recommend that I receive three fillings.

I feel like I was purposely disoriented with vague explanations for what they were showing me. They also had me pay $80 out of pocket for a regular cleaning (i'm insured) because they said they were “doing more than a traditional cleaning,” but that it was “not a deep cleaning.” I’m not sure what this means still, because the cleaning I received was identical to the one I had six months ago, save the unnecessary numbing gel that they placed on my gums.

Would recommend against going here
due to severe over treatment. Or, if you do, be sure to get a second opinion before you accept any type of treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dexter Ellison
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wanted to give my deepest and most sincere thanks to Dr. Rajanna and the Austin Primary Dental Team (shout out to Nancy, Marina and the oral hygienist that got me back on track this morning... please forgive me for missing the name intro) for their excellent work and genuinely respectful and courteous bedside manner they provided today. From my initial consultation and exam, a couple weeks back, to the start of care provided this morning, Dr. Rajanna and her team were informative and sincere in their attention and focus on me as an individual patient. From Marina's informative and prompt communication on appointment scheduling.. Nancy's calm yet very fun demeanor getting me acquainted to the practice.. the hygienist's careful attention to my anxiety about the visit and helpful information about personal care.. to Dr. Rajanna's clear expertise and bedside manner throughout were just what I needed coming back from the unfortunate dog attack I experienced a few months back and wasn't sure I would recover from.. heck, I wasn't sure I would smile again.. but thanks to this experience I have re-learned that beyond aesthetics I have so much more to smile about. Your work is more than hygiene and physical health.. you are doing great mental health work for your patients as well. I could go on and on.. but in conclusion I would 1,000% recommend this practice if you are looking for a new primary care dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATED REVIEW (2/19/26):
You can see my original review from several years ago below, but I wanted to leave an updated review. I'm ashamed to admit it, but prior to today, my last dental cleaning was 2019 when I was pregnant. After my child was born, I missed my second bi-annual cleaning. Then the pandemic hit. And two years went by. And then the anxiety of having missed several cleanings hit...and I didn't go back for a cleaning until today. When I scheduled my cleaning, Marina the receptionist (she's the best btw), could have guilted me about how long it has been but she didn't. When I got my X-rays done, the tech could have shamed me, but when I told her why it had been so long, she reassured me it was OK. Same thing when it came to my cleaning with the dental hygienest and the actual exam with the dentist, Dr. Rupa Rajanna. They all reassured me it was OK and they all said they were just glad to see me back in the office.

As for the cleaning, exam, and treatment - perfection! Clean, transparent, and they communicate every step along the way. Dr. Rajanna was clear with her evaluation of my dental needs and what steps I need to take next.

So yeah, if you're looking for an incredible dental care team, you found it with Austin Primary Dental.

user_reviews.Name: William D Covey
user_reviews.Description: I had a first time visit into their office today and was met with wonderful customer service.  The office itself was clean, modern, and comfortable which is a massive deal to me.  The dental hygienists were very thorough with my x-rays.  Although the office was a little busy today, Dr. Peterson took the time to answer every question I had and was very encouraging to me and didn't make me feel rushed.  Overall, it was a smooth, professional, and surprisingly pleasant dental visit. I would definitely recommend this office to anyone looking for quality care and a friendly team.

user_reviews.Name: Marissa Sanchez-jasso
user_reviews.Description:
Dr.Peterson, assistant Anna & Sonia were amazing to me! I’m terrified of Dentist but they made my experience so welcoming, fast, and comforting. They truly made what is usually a stressful appointment feel manageable and positive.They explained everything to me that was happening. Reassuring and incredibly supportive throughout the entire visit.
I’m very grateful for their care and would highly recommend them to anyone who feels nervous about visiting the dentist.

user_reviews.Name: S K
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Peterson was wonderful. Her office surprisingly got me scheduled for a next day appointment. The office was easy to find. The staff checked me in super fast & had me set in a room in less than 10 minutes. The tech was really friendly & attentive. Dr. Peterson gave it to me straight. Her years of practice & experience noted in her profile on my insurance locator definitely showed. I appreciated her candor mixed with appropriate humor. I’ll definitely go back.

user_reviews.Name: Jen Reel
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Wang is terrific! She was so thorough and informative during my session, and did an amazing job on my teeth and gums. I had a great experience with Leticia and Michelle as well, who were assisting that day. Everyone was so warm and kind. I'm actually looking forward to going back to the dentist!

user_reviews.Name: Deborah Hayes
user_reviews.Description: I had a great first appointment here!  Dr. Peterson had been my dentist years ago at a different practice and I was so glad to have found her here.  I came in with a problem tooth, and after my initial exam they were able to explain all of my options with no judgement.  Lily was very thorough in all my payment options.  I was able to get my problem tooth taken care of and Dr. Peterson was encouraging every step of the way.  Gabbie was a great help to her and explained my follow up care.  Angie was very friendly and helpful at checkout.  All in all, every person I came in to contact with was friendly and helpful and made me feel comfortable in coming back.

user_reviews.Name: Sabrina Graves Castillo
user_reviews.Description: I just found my favorite dentist…. Seriously!!! Walking in, the office is quiet and welcoming. Front office staff is efficient and very kind!! Leticia is so kind and great at what she does! Leticia has a very calming presence (which I appreciated because I have high dental anxiety and have not been to the dentist in FAR too long). Dr. Wang was AMAZING. I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Wang. She was so very kind, patient, and non judgmental about the shape of my teeth. I fully trusted her, and felt she truly only recommended what I needed (no upsells). If you have similar dental anxiety (or have had bad experiences with other dentists in the past) I would highly recommend Dr. Wang.  I had an amazing experience and will definitely be back every 6 months for years to come. Thank you all so much!

user_reviews.Name: Jacky Wu
user_reviews.Description: I had a really great experience at my dental appointment! From the moment I walked in, the front desk staff was welcoming and made check-in super easy. Dr. Peterson was gentle, thorough, and took the time to explain what she was doing, which helped me feel relaxed. She was very professional and informative, answering all my questions and giving helpful advice for maintaining good oral health. The office was clean, modern, and had a calm atmosphere. Overall, it was one of the best dental visits I’ve had, especially after going years without a cleaning! I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending them to friends and family!

My cleaning was good and thorough and Dr. Wang answered all my questions and took time to explain things in depth. I’d recommend Dr. Wang to anyone looking for a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I almost cancelled my appointment today due to a sensitivity issue I’ve been having. I’m so glad I didn’t - Dr. Wang and Leticia were amazing, both really put me at ease, I felt like I was chatting with friends, my anxiety immediately went away. Both Dr. Wang and Leticia were really gentle on my sensitive and receding gums. I’m so happy that I’ve found my new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suzanne Pressman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wanted to love it here after reading all the great reviews, but unfortunately my experience here was subpar. I'm giving 2 stars because Dr.Peterson and her staff are pleasant but that's where it ends. They have some serious communication issues here. I showed up to my first appt and I was told that there was a family emergency which is totally understandable. The left me a voicemail very early in the morning and did not text or email so I feel the communication was poor and driving there was very inconvenient to my work schedule. The biggest issue I had was that while I was numb, I bit my cheek very badly when in the chair and a month later, I am still bruised. Lastly I got another bill form them after I paid in full. I guess how insurance works sometime, but they could have communicated with me that this was a possibility. I do not suggest going here.  The photo is from a couple days after the incident but it ended up turning almost black, let alone the pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Grossner
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff were friendly and doctors too. They discuss with me first with my insurance agreement and payment first and very respect. I do appreciate. Maybe other people should’ve done the same thing and be patient with them too and they’ll cooperate with you like they did with me. I’ve absolutely no problem with them. I love them. They’re so friendly and tried the best they could provide the service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trisha Agrawal
user_reviews_extended.Description: All the staff and Dr. Peterson are really nice, but I was recommended a $936 irrigation that wasn't covered by insurance. They worked with me to bring the cost down to $488, but I found out through my own research after the fact that it wasn't necessary at all. The service took maybe 8 minutes tops. I would still recommend coming here but do your own research about the things they recommend that aren't covered by insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Markowski
user_reviews_extended.Description: What an excellent practice. For someone like myself who deals with terrible anxiety surrounding dental procedures I’ve always had an amazing experience. Every person I’ve encountered in this office has been wonderful and I always feel cared for when I’m here. Not to mention they’ve done an excellent job fixing my mouth haha. Dr Peterson is so kind and does a fantastic job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheetal Krishna
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I visited for a routine annual dental cleaning, which should have been fully covered with no out-of-pocket expense with insurance. After a series of X-rays, I was informed that my teeth and gums looked generally healthy, with no new cavities or concerns—great news.

However, I was then advised to undergo several additional treatments, including irrigation/flushing ($22x4), gingival scaling ($56), bacterial laser treatment ($130), and a fluoride application ($22), totaling approximately $296. I declined the laser treatment and the fluoride treatment, but was told that the laser treatment would need to be done if the irrigation was performed. When I expressed hesitation, the staff checked with the doctor and ultimately removed the irrigation ($88) and fluoride ($22) from the recommended list.

Dr. Peterson was kind, friendly, and took the time to explain each procedure. She generously offered to perform both the irrigation and fluoride treatments at no charge, which I genuinely appreciated. That said, the procedures themselves felt a bit rushed—services totaling $296 were completed in under 10 minutes.

At checkout, I learned I had still been charged an additional $22 for irrigation that I had been told would be waived. I attempted to clarify this, but they insisted on the charge. I ended up paying because I felt uncomfortable disputing the fee further, even though I had been assured by the doctor that it would be waived.

What should have been a fully covered annual cleaning ultimately cost me $208 with several add-on treatments, and I left unsure whether those treatments even provided any significant benefit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maryann Holder
user_reviews_extended.Description: All the staff members are friendly and helpful. Everything is explained as you go along and then they set you up for future success. Dr. Peterson was quick and efficient with pleasant bedside manners. The establishment is in a great area and has plenty of parking. I will definitely be returning for continued oral health care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina vela
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lindsay is amazing! She was very thorough with the process and procedures being done. She made me and my daughter feel very comfortable. Everyone in the office was so kind. The dentist is not always easy so I appreciate everyone being so patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just left Southpark Meadows Dental group. They do a great job every time and their customer service always makes me feel taken care of. They stay on schedule and do good work. My hygienist Veronica does a fantastic job and cares enough to remember things about me personally through dialogue. She pays attention to her clients. My dentist and very knowledgeable and I can say they helped turn my mouth around. I feel more clean and more confident thanks to them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cam Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was extremely dissatisfied with the service at SMDG due to significant scheduling issues. I scheduled a root canal with Dr. Granados around my busy work schedule for what should have been a routine procedure, but it turned into a 4.5–5 hour ordeal.

Two weeks before my appointment, the office called to confirm the date and time (Monday afternoon). On the day of my appointment, I waited 20 minutes past that time only to be told my appointment was actually an hour and a half later. The staff denied any change to my scheduled time and could not recall the confirmation call. When I returned at the new time, I waited an additional 15 minutes in an empty waiting room.'

Additionally, after my first root canal procedure, I contacted SMDG requesting a prescription for pain relief due to constant shooting pain and sensitivity. The representative stated they would contact Dr. Granados to have the prescription filled but it was never done.

Although Dr. Granados was friendly and performed the procedure well, the office staff's poor scheduling, lack of attention to detail and disregard for patients' time make this practice one I cannot recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chaundi B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lindsay is so amazing and so is her assistant. I’ve have been a patient for about a year and I have had incredible experiences both times. This is the best dentist office I have been to. The staff is amazing. Everyone is so kind and understanding and are willing to work with you to find an appointment time that works for you. I have nothing but positive things to say about this dentist office and I’m so glad it was recommended to me by one of my coworkers and now my mom is a patient of Dr. Lindsay! The staff is so personable and if I could give South Park Meadows dental group in South Austin 10 stars I would! I am very happy with my results and experience with Dr. Lindsay.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raquel Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They were quick, efficient, and friendly. They told me the total price upfront and asked me before proceeding with any work. And Dr. Peterson explained everything she was doing. I purchased a cleaning and 2 caps thus time around.
I was there 2 years ago to have a tooth removed and decided then this was going to be my go to dentist. Really like the vibe there and the Dentists/Doctors are nice.  I saw Dr. Lin the last time. Tbh, I originally chose this Dentist because Dr. Lin had a cool bio lol
If you're looking for fast, efficient, and friendly service by competent and good Doctors, I highly recommend Southpark Meadows Dental Group.

user_reviews_extended.Description: It was a great experience. Dr Wong was very helpful with giving insight on flossing my bridge, she also pointed out some concern for one of my other teeth. She’s a great addition to your dental group

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa F
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hate hate hate going to the dentist! BUT I love SPM Dental Group! Went today for my annual cleaning/check up and Ana and Dr. Peterson were both wonderful! Efficient, super friendly and didn’t have me waiting around. Been going here for YEARS and will probably never go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Brannen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staggering levels of incompetence, poor quality operations, and astoundingly rude customer service. I have now had 3 appointments get scheduled, I’ve shown up (on time) and then get cancelled the day-of. The first time, I was scheduled for 7:30am and waited for them to open to be told “we don’t open until 8, I’m not sure how you made an appointment.” Hmm, okay. Second time, I show up, wait, and am then told the doctor has called in (mind you, they cannot keep dentists on staff because in my 3+ years of going I’ve never had the same ones). The 3rd time, I arrived for my appointment (after having filled out the pre-check in docs the day prior) only to wait 40 minutes and then be asked, “do you even have insurance?” Unbelievable. Of course I do, it’s why I’m here - and it’s the same one you’ve had on file for 3+years — not to mention, you could have added this to the checkin paperwork if you didn’t already have my card on file…but the presumption that I just walked in off the street for a medical procedure to your shopping-center office is just weird. I have requested that they do not contact me again, and recommend you do the same if you value your time and money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: MATT WILD
user_reviews_extended.Description: Either I was having a nightmare are the 5 star reviews are written by the owner. Added charges to my bill that weren’t performed, lied about being in network, extremely painful and to top it all off had to be redone 6 weeks later by my hometown dentist. I guess this is why they got me in do quickly. $1,500 down the drain.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a terrible experience at this clinic. I've never had any serious dental or gum health issues, but they examined me and the results were highly over-dramatic. user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Wang was great! She ensured I was comfortable during the cleaning and answered all my questions. Leticia and Michelle helped with everything else—they were awesome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Kelly
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going here for a few years now, and I've always disliked going to the dentist, but Dr. Lindsay Peterson and the staff at South Park Meadows dental have been fantastic! Dr. Peterson has been great since my very first visit. And I no longer begrudgingly go to the dentist. I would recommend Dr. Peterson and Southpark Meadows Dental to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: msobmsob22
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great checkup with Dr. Peterson today. Highly recommend this staff for any dental work. I have had an implant, crowns, fillings and now have had several great checkups after getting my teeth all fixed up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christie Vanhorn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Peterson is my favorite dentist ever. I have always been so anxious about the dentist but she is so calming and reassuring. She has always explained my treatment options and told me which ones she thought were truly necessary and which ones could wait due to money concerns. I was a patient of hers at another dental office and when I found out she had left there I had to hunt her down to find out where she went and I followed her to Southpark Meadows Dental. I have had a great experience here so far with scheduling and the office staff. They have all been great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katelyn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Completely over the moon with my dental care from Dr. Peterson, she is the BEST. I’m a high anxiety patient, and I had some pretty extensive work done here. Through the process of a root canal, tooth extraction, multiple fillings, and an infection that persisted for months, Dr Peterson and the whole staff at Southpark took amazing care of me. They’re friendly, supportive, and they actually care about their patients on a personal level. My partner referred me to Dr Peterson after being a long time patient of hers, and I’m so grateful! ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa DCS Quimby
user_reviews_extended.Description: So glad I found Dr. Peterson! We had her years ago until we had to change because of insurance. The office staff here was also very friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Rea

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Evan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Southpark Meadows Dental Group for about 6 years. For a while it seemed like I had a new dentist every time I went. Staff is friendly and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: George The Greatest

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mackenzie Machold

user_reviews_extended.Description: I have severe stress going to the dentist caused by a difficult root canal done years ago at a different dentist’s office. I came in today for a teeth cleaning and he and everyone from the office staff to the hygienist were so kind and caring. I need a mouth guard and they didn’t try to force it on me but simply presented my options. It definitely helps my anxiety with so many friendly and caring people here. I would highly recommend this dental office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barbie Chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Title: Disappointing Customer Service Experience at Southpark Meadows Dental Group

While Dr. Peterson at Southpark Meadows Dental Group is an excellent dentist, I must express my deep disappointment with the customer service provided by the office staff. My husband recently visited to fix a tooth cap and was informed it would cost $940 out-of-pocket, as per the insurance estimate provided by the staff.

Upon returning home, we realized we had a coupon that could have significantly reduced the cost. However, when my husband returned to the office with the coupon, he was told it couldn't be applied since it wasn't presented at the time of payment. The office staff showed no interest in understanding our situation and simply dismissed our concerns.

To add insult to injury, we received an additional bill for $128 a month later. It was only then we were informed that the initial amount quoted was merely an estimate. We find this lack of transparency regarding costs to be unacceptable and believe patients should be given accurate pricing information upfront.

Consequently, we've decided to cancel our future appointments with Southpark Meadows Dental Group. While we appreciate the quality of dental care provided by Dr. Peterson, the unprofessional conduct and poor communication demonstrated by the office staff have left us with no choice but to seek dental care elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Erin Wernig
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Southpark Meadow Dental Group after probably a 5 year stretch of not having good insurance and being afraid of the costs. I was so pleasantly surprised by how well my first visit here was. I was due for a deep clean and gum therapy. The techs and my dentist, Lindsey made the experience lighthearted and as quick as possible. Really appreciated that they alleviated some of the nerves I was having. Now I’m back here a couple months later for a follow up cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: William O (Will)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Southpark Meadows Dental offered a smooth and insightful experience, supported with excellent hospitality and reinforced by top-tier dental care. I was seen to by both Cam and Dr. Josh, and their combined expertise left me reassured and confident I was in exceptional hands. I’m glad to have found this place and look forward to continuing my dental care journey here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: P CA
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ll start by saying I’m terrified of dental procedures which caused my need for an emergency appointment. I ended up having to get 2 extractions. It was definitely the best dental experience I’ve ever had! Everyone I encountered there were great as well. Southpark Meadows Dental and Dr. Peterson are now my people. I’ve already got 2 more appointments scheduled. They also helped me with finding an affordable payment plan, they went out of there way to make sure I got out of pain that same day.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emerson Clarke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Josh was an exceptional dentist, providing expert care with a friendly and comforting approach that made my visit stress-free. user_reviews_extended.Description:

We looked at the options. They explained everything to me including costs and timing and we installed a temporary crown that day as well as scheduled my root canal and permanent crown.

Dr. Joshua was patient, kind and truly cares about taking care of you! I highly recommend

She stands out as a medical professional who cares. A special shout out to Anna, who took my x-rays and was Dr. Peterson‘s assistant. All of the staff there are very nice, friendly and professional.  I have found my new Dentist home!  I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Contreras
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent work at this place! It was my first time ever coming to this dentist and I was super nervous. Dr. Peterson did a great and walked me through every step of the procedure. She’s super friendly and has positive energy! Her assistant Paul the technician was awesome too! Definitely coming back for future appts!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Irwin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've gone here for 4 years. The first few visits were fine and the dentists are never the same, but they are professional. The dental techs/assts are thoughtful, mature and friendly—they pretty much hold the place together. But in the last 2 years there's been a steady decline in customer service, especially at the front desk.

I've stuck by them through incorrect scheduling, long waits to get checked in, and repeatedly botched insurance record-keeping and claims. I have sympathy that the front desk is likely understaffed and overworked. But good customer service is about how you talk to people, making them feel welcome at your business, and if there's an issue, handling it with grace and calm.

Today they were pretty busy. After I'd been waiting 20 minutes, they checked in someone who arrived after me. I realized they forgot I was there, even though I was sitting right in front of the counter. Finally, I mentioned I'd been waiting 20 minutes, the woman at the desk said "don't get smart with me", as if I had said something nasty. Zero apology for forgetting that I was there. Zero accountability or acknowledgement for the wait. In fact she blamed me for causing the wait. I was just sitting there, quietly, until I realized I’d been passed over. Seriously, how can you blame your customer for that?? Be an adult.

As customers, we have choices, and my whole family goes to this dentistry, but now because of this treatment, we aren’t coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Velondra Rice
user_reviews_extended.Description:
