user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc Drouin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
2nd time going to this dentist. They are well run and have a solid front staff. Booking process is pretty seamless and they have earlier appointments (7-7:15am timeframe) which I appreciate as other dentist I've been to don't offer. Everyone here from the front staff, to x-ray techs to the doctors have been very prompt in my experience, which I greatly appreciate.

Past appointment I just have 2 critics to mention that just through me off. First was my teeth cleaning from the dental hygienist. Maybe it's just me, but when I leave a 6 month teeth cleaning I want to feel like I had my teeth cleaned. It was so gentle I remember thinking to myself during it, like come on give it to me what are you doing. I was complimented on my dental hygiene during it, which was good to hear, so maybe my teeth were just in tip top shape according to the hygienist. Not the biggest deal but noteworthy for what I would expect at a 6 month cleaning. The doctor followed up promptly after and looked at teeth and also complimented my teeth and dental hygiene. They did a little bit of extra work with the water pick, but again said my teeth looked great. Who would be disappointed to hear that from their dentist? I will note I recall have a typically teeth cleaning experience the first time I came here.

This is where the second critic came into play. For some reason a dentistry norm these days seems to be to do a fluoride treatment post teeth cleaning that is usually like $20 out of pocket. I'm not sure if dentists started doing this to help increase their revenue or what but I always have been annoyed by this. Nothing against fluoride - put in my public drinking water, whatever. I recognize it's good for one's dental hygiene. To me a once every 6 to 12 month fluoride treatment when you already have good dental hygiene isn't gonna do squat and its just a way to collect $$. Maybe that's wrong thinking, but again I don't believe the maybe 7-8 fluoride treatments I've had in 20 years is the reason I have good dental hygiene. It's because I've developed good daily dental hygiene practices. Well the moment of dread comes where I'm asked if I want the fluoride treatment and I say "I'd like to pass if I can", to which the doctor says "is it because it's a financial issue?". My first thought was, wow that was kind of bold and rude, but no it's not because I can't afford $20 thank you. I respond and say "no it's because I haven't had a cavity in over 2 decades". I don't know, maybe it was just early and they were figuring out how to use their words for the day; I just think that could have been phrased or asked differently without being questioned of the bat if I could afford $20 or not.

Between that and the gentle teeth cleaning, I'm a bit disappointed but don't think it's a bad dentist to go to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christy Libson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Do you enjoy wasting time by having your appointment cancelled after you confirmed it, multiple times? Are you looking to spend $1000 to acquire chronic pain and a dysfunctional bite when your teeth worked perfectly well before? If so, your search is over. Otherwise, save yourself a lot of pain, heartache, and toothache and get your teeth taken care of somewhere else.

I have had several issues with the front officer staff cancelling appointments after I spoke with a human on the phone to confirm them, then trying to gaslight me into believing I didn't confirm the appointment. They did the same thing to my husband before he found another dentist. I wish I had done the same then.

Far worse, Dr. Peterson pressured me into getting a crown over an old filling that had never given me trouble. She told me AFTER shaving down my tooth that I would know in a few weeks if I would need to come back for a root canal. Never mentioned that before we got started! So much for informed consent. Was my filling fine all along and she just wanted to charge me for two separate procedures? Did she intentionally drill next to my nerve so that I would have to get ANOTHER painful expensive procedure?! Why wasn't this mentioned until we were past the point of no return?!

Afterwards, my tooth was miserably and painfully sensitive, poorly fitted, and incredibly painful to bite with. I can eat room temperature bread after multiple return appointments to shave it down and a round of steroids, but its horribly sensitive and hurts to take a deep breath. I have to chew basically everything on the opposite side of my mouth. I will need a root canal to fix her hack job but will absolutely be getting that done elsewhere. Please avoid these disorganized butchers at all cost!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Iza Camacho
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hi! As one of the biggest chickens you will ever meet (Me). I highly recommend Southpark Meadows Dental Group. I did not feel any pain at all. My dentist Lindsay Peterson talked me through the whole process made me feel at ease. The front desk experience was very welcoming.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Ash
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Terrible Customer Service and Lack of Professionalism

I had an absolutely awful experience with this dental office while trying to get a referral for specialty pediatric care—all in the span of one day. It began with me making multiple phone calls to get a referral form properly completed. Initially, they emailed me the form, but it was missing the required dentist’s signature, which meant I had to call back. When I followed up, I was told the form would be signed and sent over. Hours went by, and I still didn’t receive anything.

Frustrated, I called again and ended up speaking with an incredibly rude individual named Sam. She claimed to be the only person answering phone calls and said that the office manager, Kristen, was the only one who could sign the form. According to Sam, Kristen was “currently busy,” and she had no idea when Kristen would be available to handle it. Worse, it seemed like Sam had to look up Kristen’s name—how do you not know the name of your own manager?

I explained that my daughter had an appointment scheduled for Monday, and I needed to know by the next day whether I needed to cancel. Sam was dismissive, unhelpful, and acted like my request was a burden. She insisted there was no one else I could speak with, yet when I hung up and called back, a completely different person answered—someone who was much friendlier and more professional.

Advice for the staff: Stop lying to customers by saying no one else is available when that’s clearly false. Learn your manager’s name and availability—it’s the bare minimum for professionalism. And most importantly, act like you care about helping families. If you can’t do that, you’re in the wrong line of work.

This nightmare of an experience is exactly why my husband and I stopped going to this dental group in the first place. I regret ever considering them for my children. Avoid this office at all costs—they desperately need better training, communication, and customer service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Bertotti
user_reviews_extended.Description: The strangest dentist experience. The dentist called me from the waiting room (not an assistant?) I got tons of x-rays. About twice as normal. Then the dentist measured all my gum lines and after he said they were excellent, I showed him my receding gum line. He was surprised and looked at it again. Then an office lady came in and said that they checked my insurance — the cleaning and fluoride would be 100% covered. She assured me again after I asked about the fluoride charge. The dentist(yes, not a dental hygienist) cleaned my teeth, leaving plaque around my permanent metal retainer. He didn’t ask me if I had any sensitive teeth, how often I brushed, or if I flossed. I also did not receive the usual complementary tooth brush or floss. To top it off, I got a bill in the mail for the fluoride lol. I sort of was expecting a bill for the whole visit based on my experience…

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria West
user_reviews_extended.Description: Due to my experience at this location , I would highly recommend Dr. Josh to my friends and family he highly professional, very courteous, caring to my needs I spent a full day in that office and in that time Dr. Josh and his assistant showed nothing but care for me , I felt very comfortable and at ease due to my nervousness felt when I arrived because I don’t like pain but Dr. Josh took care of me. I most definitely will continue to come to him when needed. Thank you Dr. Josh I truly appreciate your dedication to your field on making sure you make your patients smile again! And thanks to the whole staff professionals all the way!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sue Castor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nice staff. Short wait. Good cleaning, polish and check. I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kad orix
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Old review January 2024: This has been a frustrating experience with this office. I went in mid January for an exam/cleaning. Waited 30 min after x-rays for a dentist to see me. Go through the process, fine. Dentist was friendly but there was no time to do the cleaning. Had I not been sitting idle for 30 minutes, I could have had the cleaning knocked out in the same visit!

I get a 3 hr appointment scheduled for 1/30, that's fine but then I get a call a few days after making the appointment that there was a conflict with the provider. Fine, it happens but it has been a nightmare to actually get something scheduled! I called back right away on 1/22 Mon when I got the call. Never got a call back even though the rep said they would forward my call to the office. Did not get an offer to schedule anything at all (even though they confirmed all of the services I needed). Called again 1/26 Fri. Got the same rep on the phone. Once more, my message would be forwarded to the office. No offer to schedule any of my services. Called again today 1/29 Mon got the same rep for the 3rd time. She said she could schedule everything but my cleaning but the whole point was to try to get everything done in one go to avoid taking time off work. Why am I being told on my 3rd call she could schedule all but one part of the appointment? Why is the simplest part of scheduling (the cleaning, which I can do in the patient portal) something the rep on the phone cannot? Why did I have to jump through hoops just to get this information from the person I talked through the whole time?

The advice I got on the phone was to go in person to make the appointment which is absolutely ridiculous. I want to give these guys a chance but this is absolutely ridiculous. Two stars only because the x-ray tech and the dentist were very nice on my first visit so the staff can be nice...once you get yourself scheduled.

Edit 3/13/24: I have gone back three more times and I have to say the service has done a complete 180. The staff has been really helpful in getting me scheduled, even in an impromptu emergency visit! The new dentist Lindsay is an absolute delight. I am happy to continue using this dental office for the future! Thank you for making a frustrating experience a great one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Dew
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I simply can't say enough good things about Dr Lindsay Peterson. She is personable and professional. I found her to be truly concerned with my well being. I was impressed with her knowledge.  She promptly referred to me to an Oral Surgeon and she was able to have me seen the following day. The Southpark Dental practice also provides their patients with having a highly trained team that works closely with the Oral Surgeon, Dr Sheng Lin and the icing on the cake is that the team comes to you. You don't have to go to a different location, you're in familiar surroundings and you have the consistency of the same front office team. Which by the way are outstanding. I'm impressed with all aspects of the practice.
I will continue my care under Dr Peterson because I didn't feel like I was just a number, which is very hard to find.
I will be posting another review on the care Dr Peterson gave my daughter today.
Thanks goes out to the entire practice with special thanks to Dr Peterson, Oral Surgeon, Dr Sheng Lin and the dental assistants for making my  experience great.  I can't believe I just referred to a visit to the dentist as great, lol.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ciara Oszajca
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I were clients here- but after having multiple appointments cancelled, when we scheduled to take time off from work to attend the appointment, we decided that they must not really want our business. We don't want to give them anymore money and waste our time with the repeated rescheduling nightmare, never actually knowing if you will get your needed services. I suggest finding another dentist office, unless you enjoy the 'thrill' of gambling with your dentist appointments and love trying to play phone tag to reschedule.

user_reviews_extended.Name: SouthTX Gal
user_reviews_extended.Description: 5 stars for Dr Lindsey Peterson! She has a gentle hand when administering those nasty gum numbing shots.  I could barely feel it when she was doing it.  I was there for a crown mold (I have to return in 2 wk for full installation).   I hope she stays. I have seen her at my last 2 visits there.   I have been going for my dental care at this office since 2016 and have seen dentists come and go.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Regina DeMonet
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been seeing Dr. Lindsay for years.  She is the absolute best there is, and such a delight. Love her!  She actually makes the dentist visit a breeze.  She’s done an extraction on me that was painless and healed beautifully with no pain involved.  Her staff is awesome as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: gloria Keeler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Tyler M. and his staff were extremely helpful, and caring. Dr.Tyler had a great personality, listening skills were outstanding, as well as the staff. They were very attentive to my needs. I'm so happy and pleased with my results. They also took care of my insurance needs.
Thank you all for your dedication, exceptional, and quality care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juliana Stowe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Wang was amazing! Great cleaning ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anastasia Keeler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Peterson and the entire staff here are amazing! They called every office in town available for a procedure I needed because I was only in town for a week. They truly go above & beyond and Dr. Peterson is so kind and truly wants you to have the best experience possible!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teagan Settle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Peterson is awesome!! I always have a hard time at the dentist but she’s so patient and understanding and makes the care you receive very personal. All the staff are so friendly and work to make the experience comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawn Valance
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always great service.  Comfortable easy going feeling before during and after procedures.  Clean and professional.  Never have I had a bad experience with staff. Always polite.  Recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcus Friberg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I meant to make this my go-to place for regular checkups and cleanings, but after the nightmare my wife has had dealing with this clinic, and especially their scheduling and billing team, I have reconsidered.

It can take 10+ calls and messages, and waiting for weeks to even talk to anyone. When you finally get something scheduled, they can cancel the appointment without rescheduling, and then it all starts over again.  The only time we’ve actually been able to get someone on the phone immediately was when we had an emergency and had to cancel an appointment. For some reason calling at midnight works perfectly to get someone on the phone to cancel an appointment.

It shouldn’t be this difficult to schedule an appointment at a dentist office, but until these guys get their scheduling figured out, I suggest looking for a different provider.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gregory Alderson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Josh Vinbaytel is awesome.
I came into the office with plenty of urgent dental work that needs to be done. I was in substantial pain, but my even more substantial fear and anxiety had kept me from seeing any dentist for years. And problems only worsened.
Josh and his staff were receptive to me expressing my fears and anxieties (even though much of it bordered on phobia and illogic). I was listened-to and accommodated in every reasonable way and I was never judged or made to feal like I was burdensome.
I am in the office right now, finishing up a crown delivery after a root canal. It has not been easy to cope with for me personally, due to my phobia & panic..  BUT there has been no pain and everything has gone according to plan and I have been able to make it through because Josh and the staff in this office are genuinely compassionate and want to help. I was happy enough to not be made to feel judged or burdensome... but they went above and beyond:
From the receptionist literally leading me through some mindfulness techniques to calm anxiety, to the dental assistant being a such a warm, calming presence and knowing when to explain things to me (and when not to lol) to Josh being a compassionate professional when working with an admittedly challenging patient.... I just cannot say enough accolades for this office and the people that work here.
I am really grateful and plan to continue my road to dental recovery here. Thanks, Doc. Thanks everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim Geeslin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Peterson and Paul were great!  Highly recommend Southpark Meadows Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gloria Velasco
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A coworker recommended this dentist a few years back, but it's gone pretty down hill since then. They have a problem retaining dentists, which means they frequently cancel appointments. I don't think I've ever been seen by the same dentist in more than 3 years coming here. The last straw for me deciding to switch dentists was when they (again) cancelled my appointment in March, citing they had no providers, and said I was on a waitlist for whenever they hired someone. Come May, I call to check in and they said their office no longer takes my insurance? Conflicting information here, but they should communicate that to their patients then so they're not just waiting around & can find another dentist.

Additionally, their front desk staff do not know how to accurately bill insurance. I've gotten checks from their office or refunds MONTHS later because turns out they consistently overcharged me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samuel Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My initial experience with this Austin dental office was disappointing. The scheduling of my cleaning was rescheduled four times, causing inconvenience, especially since it's now year-end and I have Christmas travel plans. The first attempt was supposed to coincide with my check-up, but there was no hygienist available that day. The second rescheduling was for December 13 at 2:30, only to be moved to 12:30 on the same day. Despite adjusting my schedule multiple times, the fourth rescheduling occurred the night before, moving my appointment to 10 am on the same day. Considering I have a job, this posed a significant challenge.

Upon reaching out to the customer service line (which operates when the office is closed and is outsourced), I was assured a callback that I'm yet to receive. This lack of follow-through has eroded my trust in their services. If anyone knows of a reliable South Austin dental practice, I'd appreciate your recommendations, as I'm now hesitant about continuing with this particular office.

Regrettably, my wife also had a negative cleaning experience. All things considered, I would advise looking into alternative dental offices for a more satisfactory experience.

My wife had a bad cleaning experience to boot. Honestly, pick a different office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Cooper
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a negative experience here.  I made an appointment because I was having some tooth pain and after a quick glance at a xray the doctor is telling me that she needs to extract my tooth.  When I said I wanted to get a second opinion she tried to bully me into booking an appointment to have the procedure done.  I am SO glad I listened to my gut because I went to another dentist who then sent me to a specialist only to find out that my tooth was in fact fine and that I just had a clenched jaw.  SHE WANTED TO REMOVE A TOOTH FOR A CLENCHED JAW!!  Absolutely beware of this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Warner
user_reviews_extended.Description: The only reason this place gets 2 stars is because their traveling surgeon is so good. Otherwise, their office is a complete nightmare to work with. Scheduling is the worst, follow up is horrible, they move appointments and nobody contacts you. When I speak with someone, they are always nice, but it's such a hassle to get anything officially booked. Save yourself some stress and find another office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna de la rosa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Peterson and her entire staff are so kind and patient, especially with my own dental crises recently.  I am so thankful! And totally recommend them for all! 👍🏽
Thank you so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary I Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: On my first visit my wait time was short. Paul completed my x-rays and cleaning with no issues. Dr. Peterson completed my exam and explained everything thoroughly. She answered all of my questions. The front desk staff were very friendly and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Faulkner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Peterson is very thorough, competent and very personable. She treats you like she would treat her family. I trust her with my teeth. The office has some of the latest tech to make it a one-stop shop.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alfred Vasquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dental experience I have had. Dr.Pederson and staff are great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tanooki Suit
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Josh, Michelle and Cam did an excellent job of taking care of me during my visit. The staff is great

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Bock
user_reviews_extended.Description: No judgment and down to business. It’s nice to be given grace and healthy encouragement in my dental health. Peterson is fantastic!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chynaa Pree
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love them, I got 4 wisdom teeth pulled today, plus a broken tooth. Front desk were nice and helpful. I was back there for my surgery on TIME. The lead assistant Tay was so personable which made my so comfortable and relaxed for the scary surgery. D which is his other helper was super sweet and cool. There was also one more but I can’t remember her name 😭 but she was also nice. Dr.YIN WAS so dope put on a playlist for me, answered any questions, and when I tell you I have NO PAIN OR SWELLING (everyone will be different) but I couldn’t thank him enough. He was born to be an oral surgeon, thank y’all ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rob
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first experience at this location and I can say that they are very friendly, professional, and thorough.  Dr Petersen took care of my needs and was very focused on making sure I was comfortable with the work to be done and explained things throughout. The entire team was great. 👍🏼

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wish that I could give a zero star review because this was the worst dental experience I've ever had in my life. Just like other reviews stated, the staff has no value for your personal time. I got there 5 minutes before my appointment time and waited 1whole hour in the lobby. Just to be put into a chair and told by the dentist that I needed $2,000 out of pocket worth of work done on my teeth without fully explaining to me what was going on. I then tried to clarify but any questions I had was answered with the most condescending responses I've ever gotten from Dr. Aamir. If I'm going to spend that much money at once then I want time to digest what is being told to me and think about it for some time and then decide. Instead I was pressured to make a decision on the spot and when I pushed back I was given the rudest treatment.

Someone needs to teach this dentist some bedside manners and customer service. The hygienist and the rest of the front staff were very friendly. But if the person actually working on your teeth acts like this then I don't want to be anywhere near that place. Which is why I simply got up out of the chair and left after telling the dentist how rude and condescending she was being.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jose Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic service and vibes all around! I felt at home and well taken care of after going in with an emergency. Highly recommend! I think I found my dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mallory Lumpkin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Peterson was absolutely amazing! She was strait forward, and really helped me in my situation out. I was in SOOOO much pain, and she was able to get to the root of the problem and didn't mess around or give me the run around. She had me taken care of and even called to follow up with how I was doing. The office staff was wonderful and were able to answer all of my questions. Thank you to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haden Bowden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got my wisdom teeth taken out about 10 days ago and I had some issues with payment and insurance. Thankfully Mary Lou helped me get it settled. She has been very kind and helpful, I really appreciate such great customer service! I will be sticking with this office for my dental needs from now on!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate W
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've had good experiences with the regular staff. Unfortunately the specialty doctor seems to think his customers time doesn't matter. When I scheduled my appointment I was told to keep my schedule completely open that day to accommodate the doctor- are you kidding me? Cause what my time is not as valuable! Incredibly rude and condescending policy to think that your CUSTOMERS can and should just accommodate your schedule at the drop of a hat. I told them then that it's unlikely I can up and change my schedule at the last minute.

Then I received a confirmation message a week before my appointment for my actual scheduled time and when I went into the system to confirm the appointment 4 days before the appointment it's been completely changed. No question or anything to confirm if I can even do it. Just assuming I can reschedule my entire day to accommodate him. Again incredibly condescending and disrespectful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shukriti Katwal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came for check up
Doctor is super nice
Hygienist were great did awesome cleaning

user_reviews_extended.Name: D G
user_reviews_extended.Description: It's like a whole new office with Dr. Peterson on board. She is amazing, her energy is contagious and her skills are top notch. The office staff are above the rest. The office is cutting edge with making crowns same day, 3D Xray imaging, clean, relaxing and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I felt like a cash cow walking in there. I scheduled due to a broken tooth. I went in to get the tooth pulled. One tooth turned into 2 needing to be pulled. I was first quoted $1735 out of pocket after insurance, then after refusing I was re-quoted at $907 out of pocket. Just ridiculous! I immediately left called another dental office. I was able to get in the next day, got both teeth pulled for $250 out of pocket after insurance. I really felt I would have been taken advantage of in a vulnerable painful situation. All I wanted was the tooth pulled and the dentist saw BCBS insurance and the opportunity to charge up a crazy bill.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Berg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Showed up for a first appointment/routine cleaning here and waited an hour before being seen. Overheard admin staff realize they forgot my charts..great start!

Not long after sitting down with dentist they ask if I've ever had a special deep cleaning...already feels like beginning of a sales pitch. And proceed to go over the ways in which my teeth are in dire shape and need new fillings etc. with absolutely no confidence in what they were saying. Oh and all for $2000+ out of pocket costs, weird!

Obviously got a second opinion (everything fine/normal) and cancelled the three follow up appts here. Listen to the reviews.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicholle Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Peterson is the best! I had a back tooth pulled and felt no pain at all. I felt safe and secure in her care. No worries  yay

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Vidrine
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is by far one of the best dentist office in Austin and I've definitely been to several over the years.   After searching for a good dentist for quite some time,  I finally found this group that is not only good, they are great! Very professional office that is friendly, efficient, and honest. I've had some really bad experiences with dentists in Austin so it is such a relief to know that I can count on this group for excellent dental care that is also affordable. Paige was my hygienist and did a fabulous job with my cleaning! Dr. Sirage is awesome - very friendly dentist that seems to be more conservative in his approach and doesn't use scare tactics to have unnecessary dental work. In fact, they recommended a prescription toothpaste that helps with reversing any signs of initial cavities. Fingers crossed it works! I just appreciate that they are not pushy with suggesting additional services if it is not necessary. Very happy with my experiences!

user_reviews_extended.Name: PixieDruid
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Peterson and Paul are very personable and friendly. However the office staff and Specialists do not seem so. I went there on March 19th to have bottom teeth removed. I got very combative and restless under the sedation so due to safety reasons the stopped. I understand  this. However it's been a week and no refund for work left undoneAnd the ydidn't bother to call to tell me that oralsurgeon refused to see me  they didn't even have referral ready  To be honest I think it is because  I'm in a wheelchair he refused at least give back the money in timely manner.  I already paid for the denture  as well now can't pick up and be fitted because I still have 4 teeth I am 58 years old havebeen in wheelchair most of my life don't usually  say this but I think these folks denied me continued service based on discrimination  and fear disgusting

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassandra Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best dental experience of my life. I needed an extraction and I barely felt it at all. Two days later and there's barely any pain and we have a great plan for moving forward. I'm actually excited to get my dental health on track. They are amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paula Gillaspie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience from time we walked in . Dr Peterson was Amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: anna S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a root canal several years back, worst dental experience. The Dentist left sores on the sides of my mouth after it was done and I just had a really bad feeling after I left. I switched dentists after this experience. The tooth continued to hurt and I had to have it redone at my new dentist within 2 years, they said it was not done well. I always felt off about this place and wish I'd had a second opinion because maybe I didn't even need it in the first place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryoko Mundine
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is by far the best dentist I have ever visited.

They were kind, knowledgeable, considerate, and expeditious. The front desk staff ensured that all of my billing and alternative options were explained, and worked with me on a payment plan. They were nothing but helpful and friendly throughout.

Dr. Lin has a masterful bedside manner. He explained the entirety of my procedure before hand so I could know what to expect and made sure I was as comfortable as possible during the whole thing. I have had two cleanings, a laser treatment, and three fillings here so far. I think I've found a place for all my future dentistry needs. Should anyone else in my life need dental services, you can bet your bridge I'm referring them here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rich Duquette
user_reviews_extended.Description: Convenient location and full dental services. They are very thorough and answered all my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Cordell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Josh did a great job with my filling!! I cant even tell there was a cavity. Everybody at the office was respectful and helpful great atmosphere!! Best experience I've ever had at a dentist!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: west kee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A very abominable quack. I went to see a doctor for toothache. After X-ray and examination, the doctor determined that the tooth needed to be extracted and filled with bone powder for fixation, and the price was $800.
I felt that it was just gum inflammation and there was no need to extract the tooth. So, despite the doctor's repeated advice, I refused her treatment. Then, I went to HEB store to buy a bottle of LISTERINE mouthwash, rinsed my mouth several times a day, and was completely cured after 2-3 days.
Fortunately, I didn't have this quack's words, otherwise I would not only lose $800, but also lose a precious tooth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doug Sibert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at this office is very friendly and they do a thorough job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: CG1006
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had my first visit with this office and it certainly won't be my last. Dr. Ferrante and her staff were amazing and treated me like I have been a patient there for 10 years. Everyone is very friendly there. From the front desk to the X-ray to the hygienist to the lead dentist. Each person was very knowledgeable and made sure I was comfortable at all times and answered any questions that I had. You can tell they really care about their patients here. Highly recommend to anyone searching for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kacie West
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Awesome place. You can watch TV in the exam rooms and waiting room. All of the staff is really nice and down to earth. The dentist I see is Dr. Johnson and she's great. Puts everything in laymen terms haha and just really nice and down to earth as well.

She had to extract one of my back molars with really long roots and explained to me everything to expect so I was never shocked or nervous. She told me we could take breaks if needed and always made sure I was OK. Told me everything to look out for/expect in healing process and how the process of getting the implant will go.

They called to check up on me a few days later which was nice.

Just overall a really great dentist.

Going to the dentist kind of sucks in general but this place makes it so much better.

I went to 2 other dentists to get an exam and quote before choosing this one and even though one of the others was a little cheaper, I'm really glad I came here.

I don't usually write reviews but they definitely deserve a great one.

Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ronda Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Gibbons was caring and compassionate with my mother. She made sure that we were comfortable with the treatment proposed. She took my mother’s health history into account and proposed a less invasive treatment than a previous dentist. During treatment she continually checked on my mother and made the treatment as pleasant as possible. The entire staff was kind and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Blue
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentists themselves are perfectly fine and the front staff that caused so many of my issues a year ago seem to no longer be working here. However, I am still receiving invoices for a procedure I was overcharged/refunded $500ish for and haven't received a call back from their Billing Department that I tried to reach out to 3 weeks ago. So. By all means go to this place but you may lose your sanity trying to get back off of their billing list.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Tague
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first appointment at Southpark Dental was great. The staff were friendly and very professional. I really like Dr Peterson. I will definitely keep going there as long as she works there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chasta Hicks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been to several dentist offices before and Southpark Meadows Dental Group and Orthodontics by far made my experience better. Their staff is great and works with you throughout your treatment. Dr. Sirage is great, address my problem and got me out of pain day of. I’ve been back several times now and feel great about stick with them. I had my cleaning with Paige and she was great as well. I know people always have that fear of the dentist is going to hurt with the drilling and poking at your gums, but they are very gentle with their process and patient. I definitely recommend Southpark Meadows Dental Group.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Castillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place! The staff is extremely sweet. The dentist’s are very knowledge. They were able to create a custom payment plan for the work I needed. Going to the dentist has never been fun for me but they have made it a pleasant experience! Can’t wait to come back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Britteny Evans
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter has a huge fear of the dentist. They made her feel comfortable and not worried about the upcoming treatments she is going to have done. They were very kind and helpful. They Dentist was super knowledgeable about everything. So glad we made the choice to come here. We have found the perfect place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: jake a
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Be very careful.

My wife and I moved to South Austin and decided to go here because there were so many great reviews. For the first visit they took comprehensive x-rays of my teeth. Before cleaning, the dentist came to consult me. She told me that I was in need of two crowns which would cost $1,700 (I have very good dental insurance and this would have been the out of pocket portion). I was at a different dentist last year and there were no issues or concerns that I would need crowns. I decided to get a second opinion and had them send me my x-rays so I could have another dentist take a look. The other dentist was shocked that I was told I needed crowns and said "it's actually a shame". It really is a shame that dentists can take advantage of people so easily like this... BE VERY CAREFUL AND ALWAYS GET A SECOND OPINION!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Ikonomidis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everything you would want in a dental practice. Friendly, efficient, courteous. Can’t say enough good things about Dr. Peterson. So happy to have found her again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaitlynn Freeman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Peterson makes my dental experience 10/10! The office is very informative and friendly, leaving me confident about my smile.

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Mendoza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Peterson and her staff help make routine dental exams and cleanings a seamless process... even at 7:30 in the morning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sip
user_reviews_extended.Description: Took 3 calls to get an appointment, then my appointment was cancelled less than 24 hrs before. They said they need me to be flexible. You all are not the only ones who work and have to schedule time off. Not sure why doctors and dentist think they are above their patients. Very unprofessional. Front office also needs to learn how to speak to patients. I called another dental office and got an appointment in 5 minutes. Would never recommend this place and I never even got in the front door.

user_reviews_extended.Name: trent spears
user_reviews_extended.Description: Phenomenal crew that makes you feel comfortable while also being efficient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savanna Mitchell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a really amazing experience with them today. I had neglected my dental health for a long time, as the experience I had when I was younger with dentists weren’t very fun. They were always mean to me about my teeth and I never wanted to go back. I’m glad my parents recommended me to this place. I went to the dentist for the first time in 7 or 8 years and they made me feel really comfortable. I’m glad to get my dental health in a better place. :) I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liz “liz” D
user_reviews_extended.Description: I will never go back , the front desk person who checked me in added fluoride to me and just tried to charge me. Scamming people out of money for sales isn’t selling. She was rude and said it was optional to get it but didn’t even bother on making it an option. I have made it an option not to return to this dentist after so long. My partner will also find another dentist. This location has to do better, but I won’t stick around to see it’s .Good riddance  to this location . To the girl in the front desk make getting a better attitude and not cramming fees to customers an option. Some people are not sales people , take it from someone who has done it for 15 years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Baltazar Camacho
user_reviews_extended.Description: AWESOME Place!  Got some Crowns Replaced (2 Front teeth). Felt right at home as soon as I walked in. Paige is Great , the receptionists are Great, Lisa is Great and Dr. Stanley Lin is awesome. Hadn't been to a Dentist in years. Super glad I hopped in here and got everything done.  All cash no insurance used, great work done in a super timely manner.  eVery happy overall with Staff and Dentist. THANK YOU Dr. Lin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pat Krouse
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is an absolute mess. Highly recommend avoiding until they get it together. The front office is extremely unorganized. I was told I needed to do a small procedure, but they were unable to schedule it as I was leaving my appointment because they didn't have their next schedule yet. I have proceeded to call 6 times over the course of 2 months with an inability to talk to anyone who can schedule it and I get a different excuse every time. Ive been told to call back on a certain date, that I'll be called by someone specialized on their team, that my request is being escalated -- All with zero response or follow up from them.

Be warned: often when you call the office, you actually don't talk to the office - You get sent to some call center completely disconnected to them where they just take messages that never get passed along.

And then there is the rudeness and snide comments I have received from the front staff when I didn't do everything in the online portal prior to arriving, but then the online portal doesn't do many of the simple things it should do - like scheduling.

It's really too bad the office is so terrible, because I liked the doctors when I was able to see them.

Edit: The irony of the canned response asking me to call them to discuss when the office never actually answers is rich!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would like to say how great my experience has been with Dr. Robison at South Park Meadows Dental Group!! She is a caring, friendly, kind and  thoughtful dentist. I have full trust in her dental recommendations and she is great at setting up an effective treatment plan. I have had a filling and cleaning from her. I wouldn't go anywhere else for my dental work! Do yourself a favor and go see her for any of your dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jess Does Lashes LLC
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the easiest experience with a dental office I have had. After calling around multiple places trying to see if my insurance was taken with no call back or any quick info from any other dental office, I reached Brooke at the front desk and she answered all of my questions immediately. The office visit was a breeze too. Staff is very friendly and fit me in for a cleaning. Thanks for the quickness and peace of mind!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Delikowski
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Peterson and her hygienist Anna were so sensitive to my needs and reassuring through the process of a typically painful procedure. Dr Peterson listened to my requests and I felt both informed of what was happening and relaxed throughout the process with no pain. I listened to a podcast and they gave me a blanket and stress ball - which I barely needed to squeeze. The receptionists Mary Lou and Carlos are kind and helpful, and Mary Lou walked me through the financing options with great care and support - making this part equally as painless as the procedure. I can’t recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Faulkner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ferrante did a great job of explaining what procedure she was going to do. She was very open to questions and I was extremely pleased with the procedure results. The office has been very welcoming in the four years we’ve been going here. Brook does a great job at the front desk scheduling and answering all of our questions as well as helping with financial concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Tofighi is the absolute best. Incredibly informative and very sweet. Danielle & clinical staff were incredibly professional . I however did not have such a pleasant experience when checking in. The young receptionist was rude and did not even acknowledge when I was first in line, she then proceeded to check someone else in that was not in line.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Korey Watkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Switched from a nearby dentist to this place, as the last place made some recommendations for extra services that were pricey and seemed sketchy. I really like it here and enjoy the warm greetings. Dr. Sirage definitely takes care of me and gives great advice/education. He seems transparent in his recommendations and I learn something new each visit. Needless to say, I won’t be going anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camille Guimond
user_reviews_extended.Description:
VERIFY YOUR INSURANCE BENEFITS BEFORE PAYING FOR ANYTHING!

I was quoted $695 for five composite fillings and a night guard and was told my insurance would not cover these items. I called my insurance after the visit and sure enough they do cover them. My copay should have been $340, not $695!

When I called the Dental Group back to confront them about the charges, the woman that answered pulled up my insurance fee schedule and said “we can honor your insurance rate, but we calculate our rates differently." I told her that they shouldn't have to "honor" a rate. If $45 per filling is the contracted rate that is agreed upon between the dental office and insurance company, they cant charge me a higher rate. She attempted to explain how they calculate their rates, which is essentially the cash pay rate minus the copay amount. She caught herself in a mistake because her math didn't add up to the quote I was provided. She then told me that its hard to explain, but said again she can honor the rate on my insurance fee schedule. You cannot make up your own rates if a patient has insurance!

I filed a complaint with the Better Business Bureau and my insurance company to which Sothpark Meadows Dental Group responded and said "sorry if she felt misled."

I went to another dental group shortly after to get a second opinion about the five cavities that Southpark Meadows Dental Group said I had. Turns out I don’t have any cavities. Not surprised.

Please be cautious when visiting this dental group, and always verify your benefits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlin Chapin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly team from front desk, dental assistant, hygienist and Dr. Ferrante were very personable and helpful recommending my dental treatment for next visit. Would definitely recommend to anyone new in the Austin area. Wait time was not long at all as well. Very pleased with my visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Spracklen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of y'all's for probably over a decade. When I started my gums were in bad shape. Over time with great recommendations and encouragement my gums went from bad shape to great shape. Your staff is always considerate of pain issues and never treat you as if you're making it up. You stop immediately to address the issues. Your front desk staff calls me by my first name when I walk in. You see hundreds of people but you make me feel like family. I am forever grateful for the smile I have now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Keysear
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter and I are super skeptical about dentists (we’ve been ripped off before and treated for unnecessary “cavities”). We came to Southpark Meadows Dental due to an emergency. Daughter desperately needed a root canal. Dr. Lin was gentle and compassionate but most importantly honest. Diana was kind and friendly. Since then I have needed dental work as well. They have been willing to work out a payment plan for my family. Overall they have made some very unpleasant moments...more enjoyable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lee O'Donnell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have had the WORST experience with this dental office and their periodontist. They recommend drastic, costly surgeries that other dentists/periodontists I have spoken with since going here would not have recommended. I wish I had gotten a second opinion before trusting their course of action.

Additionally, everything everyone here is saying is true about upselling treatments, constant cancelations, rotating dentists, and just a general air of disorganization in the office. Be careful with this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Salas
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys are AWFUL. Really nice staff, i'll give them that, but as far as their communication goes it really has been a horrible experience. My first appointment ever with them, I scheduled a dental exam and cleaning as I am a first time patient with them. The day of my appointment the wait in general was extremely long which gave me ample time to read up on their google reviews. One thing that caught my attention was people mentioning their attempt on upselling you this laser treatment. Sure enough when my dental exam was finally complete, I was recommended this laser treatment. No big deal, I politely declined. After already being in the office for an hour I am told that my cleaning will be scheduled for another day because their hygienist wasn't there. Soooo, what was I there for all this time then? Another red flag was that apparently their oral surgeon considers wisdom teeth extractions, surgery as well. I am in no means a dentist, but my dentist back in San Antonio was very thorough in explaining to me that my wisdom teeth are only extractions, no surgery required. Why on earth does this hygienist consider an extraction, surgery???? At this point I'm not really happy, but I am trying to make it work. This was back in January, it is now March and i have yet to be successful in scheduling my cleaning. First, a "scheduling coordinator" has to schedule you with the hygienist, and this person never got back to me. After multiple calls to them, I was told they do NOT have a hygienist, they did hire one, but HR was taking a while for all their info to be taken care of. I finally had an appointment scheduled for April. THEN, I get a call saying that the hygienist is out that week and we need to move my appointment. Apparently they used to have 2 hygienists, but they went down to only one and she only works part time. If there was one part time hygienist this whole time, why was I told then that there was NO hygienist and why couldn't they have tried to schedule me with them!? Oh and to top it all off, remember that laser treatment I politely declined? Well turns out they scheduled it for me anyway without letting me know. I hope people have a way better experience than I did. I will be going elsewhere and canceling my appointment. I have been extremely patient but I've basically had enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Sirage is awesome. Very caring. He replaced a crown for me due to a broken tooth and he would not accept anything less than a 9.8 on how it fit and looked. Although I was not able to tell it was obvious he knew what would look good. He is patient and pays attention to detail. His assistance was awesome as well. Very friendly, you could tell they work well as a team and have trust.  I am very happy. He took the time to ensure it was a 10. I am very satisfied with his work and how his team handled my situation. Thank you

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rogelio Rayos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Appointment at 10:45am …. It’s 11:45 and I still haven’t been seen by the dentist. I’m sorry but almost an hour to be seen is a little much to ask of your patients. I booked the appointment so I could get a quick screening during my lunch. Don’t schedule people if you can’t see them within 15-20 minutes (overbooking your staff/capacity). People have lives/work schedules they are working around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sam mayo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and helpful staff. Dr. Ferrante is an excellent dentist. She is highly skilled, attentive, and cares deeply about her patients.  Her quality of work is outstanding. She makes you feel comfortable and truly listens to your concerns. I highly recommend Dr. Ferrante and her team at Southpark Meadows!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Walter Cafaro
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Tarek and his team are incredibly welcoming, nice and transparent. I had to find a new dentist since moving to ATX and I am glad I picked them!

Fast and friendly service. Coming back next week for a couple of fillings and got my wife switched over to them as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in as a new patient today and had the most smooth process since booking the appointment online! Easy check in, friendly front desk staff. Everyone we interacted with was super friendly and knowledgeable! Definitely glad we are all new patients here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: gavin Louis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is one of the only dental practices covered by my insurance policy so I’m stuck being a patient here. They normally change appointments several times before you are actually able to be seen and usually within 24 hours of the appointment itself.

Today I received a phone call looking to reschedule my September Dental cleaning for the 4th time. The first time it was rescheduled by a month and most recently they’ve rescheduled me for times they are already overbooked.

When I called back today i was put on hold and then was told “sorry we’re too busy and may call you back later.” This practice is a literal joke

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Vu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
would 100% recommend Lindsay Peterson
great staff great service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theresa Wood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sirage  is such a great guy! He is wonderful with my boys and I and he really cares about the entire health of the mouth and creating a game plan for best practice.  Brook, office manager, goes out of her way to accommodate patients and is knowledgeable about insurance and plans to help patients save money. Overall, wonderful dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Malcolm Davidson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic.  Wonderful staff, patient, caring, very good at what they do. I am sold on the place. As a rule, I care little for dentists, probably because the idea of sticking my hand, or having another's hand in my mouth is repulsive to me. Yuck! Despite this, they do great work, know their job, explain things well, and I an so glad that I now gave them as my dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Lane
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming here for years. These ladies have been great through the COVID craziness, my pregnancy, and a few cavities (whoops). Remember to floss! Carol will give you the best teeth cleaning you’ve ever had. They are just amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Padilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sirage and Valerie have been great to work with in getting my teeth back healthy and have done a really great job since I have started going to Southpark Dental Group over a year ago. My teeth have needed a lot of repairs and Dr. Sirage's primary goal has always been to take the best approach for my teeth. I highly recommend them to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is the best in dental care. From the receptionist, the tech who took my impression and the Dr. The Dr does fantastic work her hands are magic. They explained everything they did and gave me numbing creame before the actual shot. I didn't feel a thing. Very professional, friendly and above all easy on the pocket. Come see them you will thank me later!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Merranda RIker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had shattered a front-facing veneer last week, while eating. I wasn't experiencing pain, but still wanted to get it replaced right away. I called the office and they got me in right away. The dentist I was used to seeing has left, but Dr. Sirage and assistants, Stephanie and Diana, were very friendly and patient with me throughout the appointment. I was impressed by how thoroughly they considered the shape, size, fit, and color of my veneer replacement BEFORE ever cementing it in place. They stayed late, gave me affordable payment options, and kept calm and professional when i asked questions or had concerns.
People of the internet:
This office is top notch!!! My smile is very important to me, as Im sure yours are too you. Don't settle for an uncomfortable, uneasy dentist! I hope this helps you find confidence in your smile, as it did mine!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Del Gaudio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Their prices are a lot higher than other dentists in the area.  Hard to get a detailed receipt copy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Riojas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Johnson is great!  The entire staff is extremely nice.  Brooke worked with me on payment plans when I had large balances to pay.  Appointments are usually on time. Never too long of a wait.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shirley Spears
user_reviews_extended.Description: My name is Shirley Spears and I have been going to Southpark Meadows Denal and Orthodontics for a couple of months now. I was having problems with my partials both top and bottom. I came back in had them adjusted and they still was very painful. I had to go back and Dr. Zhixin Guan adjusted my teeth and he even repaired the top when I was told that they couldn't be repaired.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Phipps
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sirage and his team are awesome. They are personable and professional. They work as a great team together. Also they are affordable and inform you and step by step of where you are with benefits and your treatment plan. Dr. Sirage does not rush and Is very thorough. I highly recommend his practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis Chance (PK Smash)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Amir and his people were like a pit crew in my mouth and fixed me up with my extraction so quick and clean! Coming back for my wisdom teeth next

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marie Leung
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming here for a while and love it! Dr. Shiraj and now Dr. Ferrante have been really great, professional, and honest with what I need to do with my teeth. I also love that everything is electronic here. It's super clean. No problems finding parking. I'm always tempted to go to Dunkin Donuts but my teeth just got cleaned!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angel Crespo-Galban
user_reviews_extended.Description: There is no doctor I would trust my teeth to more than Dr. Ferrante. From start to finish she was able to walk me through everything that I needed and made it less intimidating. I went in for a Smile Restoration and had all 6 of my front teeth crowned and my god what a difference it has made on my life. My smile now is straight, no gaps, and perfect. I joke that she gave me the Ferrari of smiles. Thank you so much again and I will be definitely be sending anyone I know straight to her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: logan mcjunkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: We went here for a look at what could be done in a short time before our coverage ran out. They were able to see us quickly and address the concerns we had almost immediately. Dr. Sirage let us know what are pressing issues to handle immediately and others we could postpone temporarily. I really would recommend this practice to anyone wanting caring personal attention.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dionysus
user_reviews_extended.Description: Unbelievably amazing service. I went in for an emergency appointment which led to an extraction. Dr. Peterson got it done in no time! I'm came in with the worst pain and I'm leaving with a mouthful of gauze and smile! Thank you so so much!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joycelyn Planta
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been searching to find Dr. Peterson! I was so excited when I found she was working at your office. Everyone was very helpful and polite. I will be recommending her to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awful planning strategies. They schedule a follow up for me and just days before the appointment front office called me and cancel my appointment, because they realized that a doctor need it to be present and they forgot about that small detail.  This time I schedule a dentist appointments ahead of time for my two kids and again just a few days before that appointment front office called to cancel on me. Sad to say, but I do recommend NOT to go to this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Vela
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been going there for over a year, there hygienist moved which was the beginning of me not wanting to come back. They have a really pushy office manager who was exerting herself over me "needing" to use there new laser cleaner they got even though my insurance didnt even cover half of it. I would need to come in for many periodontal treatments that would not be covered by my insurance who did cover a standard scaling and root planning not the laser. Lastly if I got the laser appointment I could be seen within the month. If I chose the standard scrap. They could only see me in 3-4 months -.-

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle A Kalbaugh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Horribly run practice. Have tried to be patient with them but they continuously reschedule rather than actually seeing their patients.
Most recently (but certainly not the only time) my husbands appointment was cancelled for the FOURTH time, and they couldn’t even bother to stay on the phone long enough to find a new time that works for him.
We will be finding another practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yessica Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I guess the front office and doctor are not good at estimating time needed with each patient. They rescheduled me twice and the 2nd time I asked "Why?" they said the doctor didn't have enough time to complete the examination. Then why do they reschedule for a day when they known it's not going to work out??!!  I called another dentist and they got me in that same week. Very poor service and front office is not professional at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dovid Paul
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Horrible Office, they don't provide accurate information about dental coverage before providing service, nor do they contact the patient in a timely manner when claims are denied. I saw them for a service in March 2022, for a service the Dentist said I needed and that it would be covered by Insurance. However a year and a half later in August 2023 they contacted me and said that Insurance would not cover it at all, and I therefore owed them, at the end I had to pay all out of pocket - more than a grand!!!!
They provide terrible service and don't work with you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karmy Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for 2+ years! They’re a very caring and patient team! Everyone is very sweet and make it their mission to provide you with a great dental experience! Very easy to schedule your appointments and very reasonable with pricing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very friendly staff, and Dr. Ferrante knows her stuff! Highly recommend. Easy visit.
Update: customer service has gone downhill at the front desk. No one should be treated so badly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Odom
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t recommend this place to anyone. The front desk staff is the worst part about this place. Rude and unwilling to help. This office is very difficult to get ahold of. Takes forever to get through to someone on the phone and even longer to get an email reply. The place takes every opportunity to sell you a service you don’t need. They also can’t seem to keep a dentist. With in the 2-3 years I’ve been with this officer they’ve had three dentists and currently don’t have one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Joshua was VERY thorough with my exam and VERY courteous. He's the best dentist I have ever had!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kristen Ferrante did an amazing job repairing my teeth. She is personable, funny, professional and a true artist. The rest of the staff is very friendly and professional. Excellent experience all the way around. Thanks all!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Rosario
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist is not one of those things I look forward to, but Dr. Ferrante was awesome. She was very diligent in the assessment and evaluation of my specific needs, and took the time to walk me through the different options. Very friendly and attentive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Curtis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had a much better experience here than at Castle Dental. The office staff is easy going & friendly. user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Genovese
user_reviews_extended.Description: Avoid this place. I called to make an appointment to get a retainer removed, as it does say Orthodontics in the name. They give me a price and say I will need to have a new retainer put in. I  say no thanks I don't want a new one. I just want broken one removed. They quote me a price, I say, "that includes EVERYTHING?" Yes everything. Nothing else will need done? No that is the price $60, and that is without the new retainer? Yes. I am greated by a Dr. She is very nice don't get me wrong. She repeats what I am in for I say yes. She says the new retainer will be $75. I say I am not getting a new one. Well i am just a Dr. Not an orthodontist.  I don't want you saying your teeth are ruined if they shift again. Why when I made an appointment for an orthodontic procedure am I just seeing a Dr???? Not feeling too great. Then an office worker comes in and quotes a price $99 for todays visit. Huh? I was given a $60 quote? Well it is $39 for the oral exam. Huh??? Oh you mean $39 for the 15 seconds she spent tapping my teeth and looking at my old retainer???  So not, being seen by an orthodontist, who by the way is only there 2 days a month,  and being charged an extra $39 for a 15 second "exam." And making me sign a waiver because she doesn't want me suing them because she is "just" a Dr,  not an orthodontist, which is what I should have had.Just please remove this retainer so I can leave. I don't recommend this place. Nice and shiny tv monitors everywhere you turn,  business ethics zip.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Pierce
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I saw Dr. Robison who did not inform me what she found during the examination and did not involve me in the treatment plan. I was surprised at this because other SPM dentists that have treated me told me their findings and involved me in my treatment plan. When examing a tooth I identified as having a hole in it, Dr. Robison said "a filling may have fallen out." My dental record was on the monitor right in front of her that she could see if there was a filling in the tooth before. She did not bother to verify that a filling fell out. I had to ask the dental hygienist if that tooth had a previous filing. When I asked about taking an x-ray of that tooth, Dr. Robison said my insurance would not cover it and if I insisted on having an x-ray done I would have to pay for it.  The dental hygienist then verified an x-ray of that tooth was covered by my insurance. Dr. Robison
makes decisions without having all the facts and did not include me in planning my treatment. When I received my financial arrangement document I discovered four fillings are needed which Dr. Robison never mentioned during the exam. I would be billed for the fillings without insurance coverage which I do have for the recommended composite fillings. An alternative of amalgam fillings was identified as being covered by my insurance.I question her proposed treatment since it is not covered by my insurance and she never discussed it with me. There was no consideration of me as a patient because I was not consulted about treatment options based on my insurance coverage and financial situation. I also question the need for four fillings since she never identified the cavities during the examination. I am returning to SPM dental to see a different dentist because my previous experience  there was with other dentists who shared their findings with me and involved me in the planning of my treatment. Dr. Robison is not a practioner caring for her patient that up to now had been the standard at SPM dental.
