I had an outstanding experience getting a crown done here. From start to finish, everything was handled with professionalism and precision. The team made sure I was comfortable the entire time, explained each step clearly, and answered all my questions without rushing me.

The procedure itself was smooth and surprisingly quick, and the final result looks and feels completely natural. You can tell they take pride in their work and genuinely care about doing things the right way.

If you’re looking for high-quality dental work and a team that actually gives a damn about your experience, this is the place to go. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erique Rocha
user_reviews_extended.Description: 4/1/26 was my first time with Dr.Wang and she was the best I love to go back with her on my next appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tayler Challis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Peterson and Paul were so kind. I had a great experience!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Surges
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I want to start by saying I absolutely LOVE Dr. Peterson. She is hands down the best dentist I’ve ever had; kind, patient, and genuinely cares about making sure you feel comfortable. I’m someone who has always been anxious about the dentist, and she completely changed that for me.

Most of the staff here are also wonderful. Unfortunately, it only takes one person to completely ruin the experience.

My recent experience with the front desk was incredibly frustrating and honestly disrespectful of my time. I called to schedule an appointment and had some back-and-forth about insurance. I was told to come in early to sort it out, which didn’t work for me, so I initially canceled. I called back shortly after, apologized, and confirmed my original 7:00 AM appointment.

Later, they called me back saying they had figured out my insurance and everything was good to go.

I showed up at 7:00 AM as confirmed. After waiting 45 minutes and watching multiple people who arrived after me get called back, I checked in again, only to be told my appointment had been moved to 8:25 without ever being communicated to me.

At no point during the phone call or check-in was this mentioned.

By that point, I had already been dealing with dental pain for a week and had rearranged my morning to be there at 7:00 AM. Being left waiting without any explanation or communication was incredibly frustrating.

I ended up leaving and canceling my follow-up appointment.

This review is not a reflection of Dr. Peterson. I want to reiterate that she is truly amazing and I would recommend her to anyone. But the lack of communication and professionalism from the front desk made me decide to seek care elsewhere. It's also sad to see there are SEVERAL reviews on yelp and google expressing their frustration about similar situations.

Sucks to have to write this as Dr. Peterson & her hygienist staff are one-of-a-kind, & i've had nothing but great experiences with them. They will be missed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerry Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Wang and Leticia were awesome during my last visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love coming here Dr. Wang is always so great with an awesome attitude!!! Had the pleasure of getting help from Leticia as well and she was great too!! Overall great experience every time I go in!!🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Chiu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great Dentist, Horrid staff (dont answer phones, cant get insurance right, automatically adds cost even after you deny it they try to add it, double check your bill, be on a constant look out for added services during your operations)

cant even get a person on the line

so try your luck somewhere else

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sumintra Roland
user_reviews_extended.Description: She’s very knowledgeable, kind & caring.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yohennys Lizarazo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Muy buen trabajo  la atención fue muy amable  hablan también español y estuvieron muy atentos en el proceso la experiencia relajada

title: Sunset Hills Dentistry
address: 1221 W Ben White Blvd #207a, Austin, TX 78704, United States

user_reviews.Name: Linda B
user_reviews.Description: I had a crown replacement done and I was surprised at how easy the process was and pretty seamless and it looks better than any of the others I've ever had. I've had this crown since I was 10 years old so I've replaced it a few times. Thank you to Dr. Ali and the staff and Jason for making sure it matched so well!

user_reviews.Name: Caroline Ruina
user_reviews.Description: Been to a lot of dentists in my life and am pleased to highly recommend this place.   Dr. Latif creates a warm and welcoming environment.  He’s clearly very skilled and  knows his stuff.  He really listens, takes his time to explain anything I have questions about (I find that relaxing since it can be a little scary).   He’s got a gentle and intuitive approach and a sharp eye and sense of detail and precision.   I really do feel like he and the staff care about the wellbeing and happiness of their patients.  Feel safe in his hands.  Not gonna lie, he’s kinda cute, too.  Thanks Dr Latif :) !

user_reviews.Name: Joshua Gatewood
user_reviews.Description: Sunset Hills Dentistry is top-notch! The staff is incredibly friendly, professional, and truly cares about patient comfort. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and at ease. The office is clean, modern, and well-equipped with the latest technology. Dr. Ali is highly skilled and takes the time to explain everything clearly, ensuring the best treatment plan for my dental health. The care and attention to detail are outstanding—I couldn’t be happier with my experience here. Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality dental care in a comfortable environment!

user_reviews.Name: Trupti S
user_reviews.Description: Sunset Hills Dentistry is one of the best dental offices in Austin. Dr Ali is trustworthy, honest , professional, warm, down to earth and only recommends treatments when necessary . It’s a rare find . I also can’t say enough about Sally , the long time dental hygienist at that office . I always look forward to getting my teeth cleaned and evaluated . Sally is detail oriented , personable and always manages to make you smile with her warm personality.  And of course , the front office is equally as spectacular. It’s rare to find an entire practice comprising of all the strengths all in the right places . Sandra handles the insurance claims and calls to patients . She is so thoughtful , accommodating , kind and patient ! Unlike many businesses nowadays , the practice is aimed to help and treat patients , as opposed to collect every cent at the expense of the patient . This dental office is special if you are looking for quality and good dental care . They will all make you feel like family . I’ve been part of this family for at least 8 years ! ❤️🌸

user_reviews.Name: Josette Thomas
user_reviews.Description:
After two years of not coming in for a cleaning, I was honestly pretty embarrassed about the tartar buildup and a few cavities. But from the moment I walked in, the entire team made me feel welcome, supported, and never judged. They’re truly there to help and care for you, not shame which is some dentists' strategy!

Sally  who took my X-rays and did the gum therapy, was energetic, fun, and made the experience feel way less intimidating. Everyone I interacted with was kind, gentle, and professional. They even offered to do extra work that same day to save me a future visit. Before proceeding, Jayda  clearly explained the additional charges, which I really appreciated. Every step of the way, they took time to inform me about what was being done and why.

Now, Dr. Ali Latif… wow. He had big shoes to fill after my previous dentist of 20 years retired—and he absolutely delivered. He went above and beyond in every way. Not only is he incredibly kind and gentle, but he also included a cancer screening (a first for me!) and found decay in a back molar close to my cheek—something no dentist had ever pointed out before. That level of attention to detail gave me full confidence that I’m in great hands.

I’m genuinely thrilled to say I’ve found my new dentist. Thank you to Dr. Latif and the amazing team—you’ve earned a lifelong patient!

user_reviews.Name: Suzanne Eisenhauer
user_reviews.Description: We were heartbroken when Dr. Castor had to step back from his practice but Dr. Ali has been wonderful. He's friendly, knowledgeable and does great work (he replaced two crowns for me). I particularly appreciate how he explains everything before he does it so you know what to expect. Dr. Castor's original staff has stayed on and they're an amazing bunch of ladies. It's comforting for those of us who have been patients for years to see familiar faces and feel confident in the staff's knowledge, experience, and demeanor.

user_reviews.Name: Guillermo Madrigal
user_reviews.Description: This office and team is simply tremendous. Not only is the quality of work extremely high and done with care, but they help you feel welcome and comfortable throughout your visit. They're also one of the more convenient and flexible offices to schedule visits with. I can't recommend them enough!

user_reviews.Name: Augie Seaman
user_reviews.Description: Dr Castor has been my dentist for over 15 years now. He and his staff are truly professional and caring people. They are also conscientious of cost. That is a rare combination in any business. This is truly the best dental office I've ever been to, and it will be a sad day for me when he decides to retire! They are simply fantastic. I could not recommend them any more highly. 2025 Update: Dr Latif is the perfect person to take over Dr Castor's practice, and all of the great staff are still there as well. We are still patients, and couldn't be happier =)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a crown replacement done and I was surprised at how easy the process was and pretty seamless and it looks better than any of the others I've ever had. I've had this crown since I was 10 years old so I've replaced it a few times. Thank you to Dr. Ali and the staff and Jason for making sure it matched so well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juju Requejo
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always Dr Castor and his staff did a wonderful job. A year ago i moved to another city outside of Austin, but the drive is worth my visits, time, and money. Dental assistant was professional, kind and customer oriented she made sure i was comfortable. The hygienist was very knowledgeable and explained everything in detail, she was very patient and gentle while doing an extensive dental cleaning. The front desk staff was friendly and made sure i was happy with the dates for another visit. If you are looking for a dentist to trust i recommend Dr. Castor and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Romy S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is lovely and the care is up to standard but I have one really big issue which I found bothered me more and more after my appointment .

Dr. Castor retired. I am sorry to see him go, he was great.  The office has been taken over by a new owner. He’s nice and I’m sure he does good work but it is not cool to send messages out from Dr. Castor’s office, let me make an appointment to see Dr. Castor and even sit me in the chair and put a bib on me before letting me know I will not be seeing the dentist I came to see. I felt a little manipulated when I left. I don’t understand why Dr. Castor’s patients aren not told when we schedule so we that we might come in prepared and feel well informed about the change of hand before arriving.

user_reviews_extended.Name: yolanda perry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Believe it or not, I have seen Dr. Castor for over 40 years!!! if that doesn’t say what exceptional dental care I had/have…! He is so nice, caring, professional, and, of course, sees to your dental needs to ensure you have good oral health and function. Over the years, he and his staff has always been friendly and accommodating and very helpful. It’s always a Pleasure to go to this dentist because you’ll come out smiling!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Kennett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven't been to a dentist in 20 years. Needless to say, I was pretty anxious for my first visit. Everyone here is so nice and caring. They really put me at ease. Sally, Jada, Dr. Castor and staff are all amazing. I'm actually excited to go to the dentist now. As long as I have teeth in my head, I'll keep coming back :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marty
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and professional staff! No one likes going to the dentist, but Dr. Castor and his staff make it a pleasant experience. They’re knowledgeable and take time to explain things while also listening to any questions you may have. Best experience I’ve had at a dentist’s office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber_MAGIC
user_reviews_extended.Description: I LOVE this dentist. Over the past few years I’ve started to get quite a bit of anxiety going to the dentist. Sally (dental hygienist) has helped changed that to confidence and less fear with her explanations and empathy. The dentist was kind and patiently answered all my questions. Excited to get to a point of having healthy teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Mason
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and knowledgeable staff. Very clear about pricing and options. I did a lot of research to find a new dentist that I can trust. I have had 3 appointments with Dr. Castor now, and I am very happy with my decision! I would definitely recommend him to my friends. He is so friendly, but most importantly, I trust him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Betina Foreman
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with this dental practice was great. They were professional and courteous. Normally not a big fan of dentists,  but Dr. Castor was well informed and listened to my concerns. My hygienist,  Sally was absolutely wonderful! If my previous dentists and hygienists had been this good, I wouldn't have avoided them. I  would give them 6 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Bothwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I walk in the door to the time I leave, everyone is great. The staff is friendly, helpful, and accommodating. Dr. Castor is incredibly nice and thorough in his exams. I never feel like he is trying to do more than necessary ( for the money) as you so often feel at other dentists. Thanks for being awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Starr Wen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ali is amazing! He was super thorough and took care to explain each step of the process. It's so hard to find a good dentist who doesn't just try to get you on the most expensive procedures, but Ali carefully listened to my issues and took the time to discuss the different options with me. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janie Contreras
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Dr. Castor for over 20 years. He has great staff. They always make me comfortable and at ease.  Sally really takes good care of me while I'm in the chair. I always get a good report on my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Dorsett
user_reviews_extended.Description: We’ve been seeing Dr. Castor for more than 12 years. He and his staff are wonderful! Always very polite and cheerful, we rarely have to wait more than a few minutes for our appointment, even our kids love going to the dentist! All three of our children have been patients since they were about three years old. They’ve never had a scary experience and don’t complain when it’s time for a checkup. Our family will continue to see Dr. Castor for as long as he’s practicing! Love love love him and his staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashton Leon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve gone to Dr. Castor for many years and always enjoy my visits. He is a great dentist that doesn’t try to upsell or price gouge! He has a gentle touch and is easy to communicate with. His staff is the best! Very helpful and sweet. Bonus - seeing what new southwestern art he has brought in since my last appointment! I’ve referred several friends and family that all feel the same.

user_reviews_extended.Name: S s
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental office ever. Was able to get me in to have my dental implant fitted and get a deep clean and assessment in time when my flexspend funds were finally released so I wouldn't lose them. I'm terrified of dentists and the dentist and dental hygienist and all the staff were so kind. I have an autoimmune disorder and they were wonderful making sure I was safe. It's a lovely office and sparkling clean.  They are absolutely awesome there. Thank you all so much. Seriously everyone if you are needing a dental treatment you should definitely come here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashton Alkire
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Dr. Caster for 8 years and adore he and his staff! They are professional, kind, welcoming and thorough. I always enjoy checking out his collection of Southwestern artwork. A real treat! I have referred many friends throughout the years. Never pushy and always consistent. Can’t recommend enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doreliz Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Castor and his staff are great! They are very helpful, accommodating, easy to work with and just plain awesome. They have a great reminder system in place so you don't miss your appointments. Their office is in a convenient location. And all the dental work I have gotten there has been top quality. I even learned how to use a tool called Super Floss which helps clean around the area of your bridge which I didn't know existed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Butler Family
user_reviews_extended.Description: WOW! 😄 I love this place! This office has such a nice welcoming, positive atmosphere to it. Very warm at home feel there. The front desk girls are very friendly. Dr. Castor has such a great attitude and I can tell really cares about me and is passionate about his work. I won't go anywhere else. Hands down the best dentist in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doni Marquart
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Fantastic!! Dr Castor was so careful not to hurt me! I was *very* satisfied - He’s my new dentist!

There was no wait time…they were ready when I came in. When I begged for “no shots” he looked dubious, but said he’d try. He succeeded! Painless dentist! Aaaah!

Thanks all y’all. The office staff are warm and friendly and I appreciated their care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Helen Dawkins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love going to see the dentist! Not many people say that but with Dr. Mark Castor and his friendly and knowledgeable staff, you too will say it! The care you get there is worth the peace of mind that everything will be fine when you leave. The staff is very friendly.
Helen Dawkins recommends Dr. Mark Castor to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: carl loschiavo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Castor has been my dentist for 20 years. I recently moved an hour away and make the drive rather than switch dentists. I trust him completely. The staff is very professional and friendly. Sally, the dental hygienist, is very thorough, knowledgeable and personable. I highly recommend Dr. Castor.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellen Prediger
user_reviews_extended.Description: (Below is my original review made 2 years ago - But I never completely posted it. Just back in the office after 2 years for a deep cleaning. Sally was fantastic, answering all my questions, anticipating my needs. And Dr Castor is likewise - very personable yet professional. Also really appreciate how the office works out insurance coverage for future procedures..) My first visit today as a new patient after several FB and Neighborhood friends recommended this dentist. I found Dr Castor and staff now only run a clean, efficient office, but were very sensitive to patients' concerns - for example about the amount of radation received from the xrays. Nicole was especially good about volunteering information she expected I would have questions about. And Dr Castor was willing to sit with me and answer all of my questions. All were very friendly and helpful. I am very happy to have found this group!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Lavornia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to see everyone at Dr. Castor's is always pleasant. Everyone from reception to hygienists to the doctor himself are friendly and genuine. I'm usually taken right on time, and the appointment is done efficiently and kindly. Having grown up the grandchild of a dentist, I can definitely say that you'll feel safe and taken care of here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: pinche_vote
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for years. The staff is always helpful and informative when it comes to coverage and estimated cost. I recently had 2 crowns put in and was surprised by how quick I could get it for my insurance cut off. Thanks for all you do Team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johnny Trevino
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Castor and his assistant Emma are the best dental team I’ve ever been to! They’re super friendly and professional, and really make you feel relaxed sitting in that chair. Not only that but Dr. Castor is a perfectionist and made a bad chipped tooth look perfect and flawless again.
I would highly recommend Dr. Castor’s office to anyone needing dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shantel Cannon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Castor and his staff are very friendly like family! It has always been a great experience and a pleaseure to see everyone. I have been going for years and have had many types of fillings and Dr. Castor is very gentle working with teeth and their hygienist does a great job with the teeth cleaning!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven S.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm very pleased with my recent visit. The office staff were able to fit me in within a few days after a semi-emergency. Dr Castor and his assistant were very cordial and worked with a great deal of care and coordination on my soon to be new crown. Dr Castor and all his staff are all very pleasant.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kirsten Nottleson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr..Castor for 25+ years. His staff has always been warm and accommodating. It's always been easy to make appointments that fit my schedule. When my children were babies I'd often have them lying on my chest during cleanings. As they got to the age of needing their own dentist appointments I tried a few pediatric dentists because I figured they'd have all the bells and whistles for kids (fancy offices,  toys, videos games in the waiting room, etc.) but I was always less than impressed and always came back to Dr. Castor. My kids wanted to come back to Dr. Castor. They can play games at our house.  They like the feel and familiarity at Dr. Castor's. They are now 15 and 21 and still go to Dr. Castor. Now they go on their own. My oldest makes his own appointments. And my youngest will start soon as he begins to drive. I have never felt pressured to do any dental work. Never felt like he suggested anything other than what was necessary. They explain exactly what's going on with my teeth and their health. I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Castor and his staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen Henderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with Sally and Dr. Ali.  I visited because of a toothache, and the staff at the front desk as well as back office was very kind and welcoming. Dr. Ali was knowledgeable, thorough, and took the time to explain everything clearly, which put me at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Greaney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Castor is one of the kindest dentists you will ever meet! This was my first time to go see him and his staff and they were all so caring and professional. He was able to help me get out of pain from a broken tooth and he and his assistant took time to go over several options with me on where to go from here - didn't rush me out. I definitely found my new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shy Hen
user_reviews_extended.Description: DDS Mark Castro has been my dentist since 2016. I have visited other dental offices, and none of them have provided customer service as excellent as DDS Castro's office. He enjoys what he does and his staff always treat me like family.  I highly recommend him for anyone looking for a dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Molli Newcomb
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this dentist and EVERY SINGLE staff member there! It is the most warm and welcoming office! I love how everyone is so down to earth, friendly and kind. Dr. Castor has such a wonderful presence about him. All my dental discomforts go straight out of the window when I go there. I went there the first time over 10 years ago as a young single mom. It took a while for me to get on my feet with going to college, finding a job with insurance, and making my way back to them. The only dental work I’ve been able to have since them were fillings from dental clinics that serve patients with little to no income. I finally could go anywhere and get any work done, and the first dental clinic I thought of was Dr. Castor’s!  I wouldn’t want to go anywhere else!  I’m so happy to be a patient of theirs. 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: LINDSEY HOH
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an emergent situation, the office was able to get me to see Dr. Castor in a very timely manner. The office is clean, the staff is friendly and knowledgeable. He was able to take care of my situation and make me comfortable. I was in acute pain at the time. I will continue to go there and recommend others. Dr. Castor also has a good bedside manner! Thanks to all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LaVern Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have been patients of Dr. Castor for over 25 years and have always been confident in his work.  His dental hygienists, dental assistants and the rest of the staff are consistently highly experienced, courteous and helpful. His practice is a great place for dental care with a personal touch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mrs.Princess
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr.Castro and his lovely staff. Been coming here for years. His work is fantastic and his hygienist is awesome. What's more important is that he cares about your dental hygiene, and his work proves it. Family oriented office. Each and everyone of his staff members are genuine and they treat everyone like family.  Keep up the great job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly 16
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time visit to Dr. Castor and could not be more pleased with the way he and his staff took care of me. Paloma at the front desk and Toana the dental assistant were very courteous and professional and made me feel like I have been a part of their dental family for years. Dr. Castor was extremely nice and gave me some sage advice on what to do about my dental issues. I think I just found myself a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Ramsey-Weems

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill
user_reviews_extended.Description: A couple years ago one of my molars developed a vertical crack and eventually the tooth split along the crack and a piece fell off. Fortunately, there was no pain, but I called Dr Castor on the weekend and asked what should be done. He scheduled me as soon as he could and built up the tooth to compensate for the missing portion. On my next cleaning visit he asked if I was ready to replace the temporary fix with a crown. I declined as I had no pain and the temporary fix was holding up very well. After a couple years, the junction between the temporary and the tooth reappeared. I knew this was going to happen eventually and it was a sign to me that it was time for a permanent repair. When I went in for evaluation Dr Castor agreed that the crown was the right solution and scheduled me for a week later. The office gave me a cost estimate and contacted my insurance company. When I had the crown installed, it was uneventful. No pain, and the cost was less than the estimate. Dr Castor is easy to talk to and he's very concerned with with the patient's comfort and well being. If you need dental work, give Dr Castor's office a try. BTW, his hygienist, Sally, is top notch too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ty Liddell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First I want you to know that I HATE going to the dentist. I haven’t gone in ~5 years because I needed a lot of dental work and dreaded having it done by my old dentist. Well, all that waiting and dread finally caught up with me in the form of severe tooth pain.

This past Sunday I bit down on some food and had a sharp pain on one of my molars. I looked around at dentists Monday and Dr. Castor was one of the dentists available in my network. I called and they were able to get me in THAT DAY for a quick exam of that one tooth. I had a filling that had cracked and was causing issues further down. They were able to schedule me in a few days later of that same week. The routine was to remove an old filling, refill it and have a crown put on it. I was nervous to say the least. Well all that worrying was for nothing. Dr. Castor and his assistant made me feel comfortable the entire time (plus some nitrous) and I never once felt pain or discomfort. Now I have plans to go back and have all my cavities fixed and don’t have a worry in the world about going.

Aside from Dr. Castor, his staff is AWESOME. The ladies at the front explain everything to you in regards to insurance and payment. They also are very friendly and make you feel comfortable. His dental assistants are very friendly and I can’t thank his staff enough for my experience.

You can’t go wrong going to this dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Dr. Castor for about 15 years.  I go every 6 months.  I have never had a problem with my teeth, was told they are very healthy. user_reviews.Description: These folks are the best dentists I've been to.  Everyone in the office is so kind and helpful.  The staff is so gentle and compassionate and the work done is excellent. user_reviews.Name: Spencer Hays
user_reviews.Description:
I've been a loyal patient at Grand Oaks Dentistry for several years, and I can't emphasize enough how much they've helped me and my family. While I know there have been some negative reviews regarding pricing, I want to share my perspective.

In my experience, they are not about upcharging or scamming; rather, they focus on preventive care that saves us from more serious dental issues down the line. They’ve always been honest with me about my treatment options and costs, and I’ve never felt pressured to accept unnecessary procedures.

The staff is incredibly friendly and supportive, making both my children and me feel comfortable during our visits. I’ve seen significant improvements in my dental health, and I truly appreciate the care they provide. I highly recommend Grand Oaks Dentistry to anyone looking for a trustworthy dentist who genuinely cares about their patients’. They are not corporate and I love that for them. They care about their patients.

user_reviews.Name: Alexa Kantzavelos
user_reviews.Description:
I waited to make this review after getting a second opinion. I had seen Dr. Sharma years ago after having some complications with a tooth pulling back in my hometown. She was great then, but times have changed. I went at the end of September for a new visit and cleaning after going to another dentist who was dishonest about charges and money. Turns out this office is even worse. I made the appointment and it was for 1.5 hours. I got text confirmations and then the last text said, “remember you won’t be getting your teeth cleaned today”. I called to ask why and see if I could still get a general cleaning at least because I had to take time off work just for this appointment. The receptionist told me to come in earlier and they would try.

I came in for the appointment, they spent so much time taking x-rays because they had to keep retaking them after not getting it right the first few times. Dr. Sharma comes in later and starts telling me how bad my teeth and gums are and that I’m on the road to losing my teeth because of bone and gum loss. I’ve known this has been gradually developing over years so it wasn’t anything new, but her catastrophizing of the situation was really off putting. Then she said I have sleep apnea because she’s a “sleep doctor” and I needed a $250 sleep study and her expensive mouth guards. She kept saying how I have amazing insurance because of my husband’s job and I could tell immediately that this was about money for her. She spent more time talking out of her rear, when she could have spent that time getting my teeth cleaned at this appointment.

Instead of a regular clean or even just a scaling they immediately said I need a deep clean. I hadn’t been to the dentist in a year, and have good general oral hygiene with brushing and flossing, but this seemed extreme. They also said after the deep clean I need 4x a year cleanings, something I’ve never had in my entire life, but all of a sudden needed here. One of her receptionists or helpers started going over my plan and I questioned why I was being charge for PPE for my 4x a year cleanings and she couldn’t answer. The dentist then says good question, insurance doesn’t cover it so the patient has to pay. PPE is a BUSINESS expense, there is no reason that charge should be put on the patient. There was also a suspicious irrigation charge that they couldn’t explain well either. Irrigation is water to me, so I’m charged $60 for them to clean my mouth with water.

I decided to get a second opinion and I am so glad I did. They did a scaling and then told me I can go back to my regular 6 month cleanings. The other dentist also said that while I have gum loss, my teeth look good and they’re not going to fall out of my head, opposite of what Sharma was telling me. If you want a dentist who is going to scam you and use fear mongering, grand oaks is your place. They are not conservative in their treatment plans at all because it’s all about money for them. Places like this are the reason people do not like going to the dentist in the first place.

user_reviews.Description: I highly recommend Grand Oaks Dentistry. When I needed help quick, they saw me right away. I scheduled an appointment in the evening on a Monday, and was seen Tuesday morning. The doctors and staff were all very caring and friendly. You really get the feeling that they are there for you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dave Mesa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have to preface this review, with the fact that I have a severe distrust of dentists.
That being said:
From the first time I entered their establishment, I felt welcomed and comfortable. Everyone has been super friendly and professional. I just recently got insurance again, after a long time. So I’ve had some pretty extensive work done here. Dr. Sharma and her staff have been incredibly accommodating, and I feel that they’ve gone the extra mile to help with all of my needs. 10/10 would recommend to anyone,  and already have to my friends and family.

I hope I don’t require their services again for awhile, but I’ll definitely be returning for my next cleaning. Thanks guys. You’ve turned a skeptic into a believer!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen Clyne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I strongly advise against getting your wisdom teeth removed at this office. They bring in a surgeon only once a month, and the entire process feels like an assembly line for extractions rather than personalized patient care.

My consultation was the same day as my surgery, and the surgeon failed to inform me about how complicated my extraction would be due to the position of my teeth. I also disclosed that I suffer from TMJ, yet I wasn’t warned about the risk of developing Trismus (lockjaw) post-surgery, nor was I prescribed any medication to prevent it.

After the surgery, no one from the office followed up to check on my recovery, and there was no post-op appointment scheduled. Unfortunately, I developed severe Trismus and had to see a different dentist to treat it. That dentist was shocked that I hadn’t been informed of this potential complication, hadn’t been given proper medication, and hadn’t been scheduled for a follow-up. He also pointed out that, given the position of my teeth, the procedure was as invasive as knee surgery—making the lack of post-op care even more unacceptable.

If that wasn’t bad enough, the front desk staff repeatedly mishandled my insurance claim and were incredibly rude when I called to resolve the issue. I eventually had to get on a three-way call with my insurance company and the office staff, who were also rude to the insurance agent. After a frustrating back-and-forth, they finally submitted the claim correctly—at least, I hope they did.

It’s disheartening how difficult it is to receive competent and compassionate medical care. I would never trust this office with a major dental procedure again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Georgia Ann Thomsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just love these amazing people! Dr. Sharma is the kindest person and her staff is lovely. My daughter had to have a few teeth pulled and was very scared. Dr. Sharma came in and held her hand the whole time. Just the best <3

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allie McGuffin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I usually don’t leave reviews, but my recent experience at Grand Oaks Dentistry prompted me to share my concerns. I chose this practice based on its high rating (4.5 stars), but encountered several issues that I feel are worth mentioning.

First, they required a consultation appointment before performing a cleaning. Although I understand the need to assess a new patient’s dental situation, this was the first time I had encountered this requirement. While not entirely jaded, I found it a bit inconvenient. During the consultation, I was told I grind my teeth and needed a $500 custom night guard immediately. They were quite pushy about purchasing it on the spot, and although they offered a payment plan, this felt unsettling given that it was my very first appointment and no cleaning or rapport had been established.

I was then scheduled for another appointment to address three cavities they deemed urgent, which was surprising considering my consistent dental care history. Additionally, I was informed that I might need a crown within six months. The projected $900 out-of-pocket cost (for the night guard and cavity fillings) was shocking, and this didn’t include the potential cost of a crown.

Feeling uneasy, I sought a second opinion from my previous dentist. After a thorough examination, my old dentist found no need for a crown and was unsure which tooth might require one. He also determined that my cavities didn’t need refilling and observed only minimal signs of teeth grinding. His recommendation was simply to wear my retainer, a much less expensive solution, without the pressure to buy a night guard unless more evidence of grinding appeared or if I experienced discomfort.

While I understand that different dental practices have varied approaches and that care decisions ultimately rest with the patient, the aggressive upselling and drastic recommendations at Grand Oaks Dentistry were unsettling. After reading similar reviews post-appointment, I felt it necessary to share my experience. I will be returning to my previous dentist, despite the 40-minute drive. I want to emphasize that the staff at Grand Oaks Dentistry, including Dr. Sharma, were very kind, and I believe she had my best interests at heart. However, the stark contrast between her recommendations and those of my trusted previous dentist raised significant concerns for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Suvia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Grand Oaks Dentistry for years and always appreciate the care I receive. It's always a pleasant experience. All of the staff from the moment you walk in the door is friendly, caring and helpful. The doctors and hygienists are great. It's a good sign when you look forward to going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Lombardi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is always so kind and professional! We enjoy going to the dentist! Thank you Dr. Ash!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carly Ek
user_reviews_extended.Description:
When I first booked my appointment I hadn’t been to the dentist in 5+ years so I was a little nervous. However, that went out the window pretty much right away. And I’ve been a patient for over 5 years now.

Everyone is extremely friendly, and before starting on anything, the office is very upfront and transparent about cost. Dr. Goel is seriously a rockstar! She’s so compassionate and friendly, and an amazing dentist on top of that! I will reiterate though, everyone at the office is amazing :)

user_reviews_extended.Description: A great office with professional staff! I couldn’t ask for a friendlier service. If you are looking for a great dentist in Austin, you can’t go wrong with Grand Oaks Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ѫаcк Бётн
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going here almost two years. When I first started, I had a wonderful experience. I didn't have insurance at the time and hadn't since childhood, and the staff and Dr. Sharma were wonderful and understanding. They didn't push me super hard to sell me extra stuff.
When I finally got insurance I started getting my deep cleanings and my cavities filled. Dr. Sharma is so sweet and kind and understanding to her patients. However, since I got insurance, their office has tried to upsell me every single time I go in, pushing sleep studies and night guards. After my teeth were back to a healthy state, they've insisted I come in for more cleanings than my insurance covers, but did not inform me ahead of time that my insurance was not going to cover the cleanings.
I have had a couple really bad experiences with some of my cleanings. The dental hygenists seem to be under immense pressure. During one of my visits I began crying (going to the dentist is very anxiety producing for me) and the hygenist stopped and attended to me with the utmost respect and kindness. This completely turned around my day and my mood, but then when it was time for me to see the dentist, Dr. Sharma chastised her sharply for "taking too long" on my cleaning. We literally only stopped for about five minutes. I had another experience where my hygenist was extremely stressed and rushed for time and therefore not attentive to me and the physical pain that I was experiencing during my cleaning.
I drive over 40 minutes to see this doctor and due to traffic i was 15 minutes late for one of my appointments and they made me reschedule.
I debated for a long time about leaving this review and about continuing my care. I was initially very very happy here and very happy with Dr. Sharma but it seems like the environment at the office is high pressure, possibly overscheduled, and a little toxic. I think the quality of my care has suffered as a result, so I will be exploring other dentist offices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kebbie Bee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this dentist for years. They are the absolute best. Considering how many dental problems I have had throughout my life, it's great to find a dentist that I can really trust.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alok Kumar Mishra
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the place. Interactions with Dr. Sharma and her staff were very engaging, connected and satisfying. user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Vick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sharma and her staff are incredible. They are all kind, compassionate, and honest. All I needed was one cavity re done due to its age. Love this dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Sharma is genuine and efficient. My teeth are always thoroughly cleaned and my dental pain is reviewed by the doctor herself. The staff is well trained, empathetic and friendly. The office itself is very clean and their practices make you feel safe. I highly recommend this practice if you want the best job done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Klein
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my first Google review, but I would be remiss if I didn’t give the business feedback and warn other dental patients. Ever since I first walked in as a patient a couple years back, this dental office offers increasingly worse service and increasingly more expensive upsells. When you first attend, you’re seen by Dr Sharma herself, who is very personable and persuasive. In order words, she’s the sell. From there, you pretty much never see her again. At this dental office, I’ve been told repeatedly that I need Botox (which no other dentist has ever told me), and I’ve had to come back for procedures that were botched while the technician laughs that I have to take more time off from work because they couldn’t get the job done right the first time. The only reason I’ve been coming to this office for years is because of the nuisance it is to find a new dental office, but I’ve finally had the last straw. Do not patron this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wish I could give a better review for this place because both the front desk and dentists are very nice and friendly. However, they ruined my teeth. It was just a very shallow, basic cavity (as diagnosed from my previous dentist before I moved to this new location) and it unnecessarily ended in a root cannel and crown. It wasted thousands of my dollars (even after insurance) and the worst pain I have ever had. I'm upset that I trusted this dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: D Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I, like many people, neglected dental care for a long time. Probably had been 10+ years since I had stepped foot into a dentist. Naturally, I was nervous because nobody likes getting yelled at but that didn't happen! The team at Grand Oaks were just stoked I was there taking care of it.

My time as a patient at Grand Oaks has been, ironically, pretty painless. Super friendly staff, flexible and easy going. Good explanation of treatment options and helpful with any questions you may have.

Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a new dentist office.

They also double as a sleep clinic and let me tell you, I thought I was so good at sleeping but turns out I've been sleeping like garbage! Got a sleep study done and a treatment plan from there without a CPAP which was a big deal for me. Luckily, my wife sleeps like a rock thru my 30+ dB snores but thanks to SleepWell and Gayle, it's quieting down.

Thanks y'all!
- Dan

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlyn Goodwin
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist left me in tears. The appointment I had with the dental hygienist before this last appointment today (1/16) was great, she was gentle with me. Today it felt like the dentist was taking what ever anger she was feeling out on me, and going too quickly. I read all the bad reviews on this place and they all express the same issues I've been feeling about this place. They say they have "proofs" their procedures work, good on them. They charge what should be a $60 (based on my previous work done at a place that really cares about you and your financial struggles) job at $400. I will not be going back to this place. Lesson learned, not all dentists care about their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: debbie s
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Sharma is so kind! She genuinely cares about you, your insurance situation and your financial situation. The staff is all amazing and they know their stuff. I can't tell you how many times I've called the office with questions (some silly) and they were nothing but professional and accommodating. I can't imagine going anywhere else. I love everything about this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rose Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is very clean. Staff is friendly and always professional. I am never disappointed with the personnel care this group provides to their patients. Gentle and caring about your teeth always! Thank you Grand Oaks Dentistry:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Conner McWilliams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommended this office! Not only are the dentists experts at the job but the staff they have in the office is always so warm and inviting! It’s the kind of staff that remembers you when you come back and make you feel welcomed. I would recommend anyone to this dentist, even if you are like me and the dentist gives you high anxiety they make you comfortable and relaxed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darren Scharf
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a great group of people! So friendly and receptive. No problem scheduling and ready for me when I arrived. I never felt rushed or pressured and felt they took extra time to explain everything and answer all my questions. I'm happy to call Dr. Sharma my new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Corbitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sharma and Dr. Farrel are very caring and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mario Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I trust the woman in this office so much, they are very knowledgeable and are happy to explain anything thoroughly with you if you have any questions. They make sure you understand your dental journey and have your best interest in mind. Thank y’all for making my dental journey so comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrian Barrera
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Sharma and her team are great, all of my appointments have been handled with a lot of care and attention. They are thorough and walk you through your treatment options upfront so you know what to expect from day 1. She is always straightforward and accommodating.

Excellent service from a local business; would highly recommend to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria A Ramirez Campos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So I am not a fan of dentists. I have avoided them and because of it my teeth are not doing well plus As someone with PTSD I really appreciated the all women team…Wow. I cannot believe I have been going to other practices that did not take the time to even know my name.
Dr. Sharma and Dr. Ashe were marvelous. The technicians and the front desk were friendly and knowledgeable. Everyone was transparent and very thorough, from the very beginning to the end. I learned so much about the health of my mouth! Thanks y’all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jawaher Al-Zibdeh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely love Dr. Sharma, her and the staff make me feel so welcome and comfortable when I go in for my visits. They also diligently make sure I actually make it in for my cleanings when i'm supposed to! Dr. Sharma goes above and beyond and her dental assistants are very kind, funny and easy to talk to. I would recommend to any and all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Sommers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sharma and the staff were all friendly, efficient, and helpful.  This was my first visit to a dentist based in Austin since I moved here.  From reception to responding to my dental needs I was impressed with their professionalism and concern for my health.  I am grateful for finding Grand Oaks Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mélanie Lamotte
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am giving them 3 stars because the dentists and staff at this facility are very nice and caring (and they are all women yeay!). However, if you are looking for non-invasive procedures, this is not the right place for you. They told me I needed a night-guard, 1 or more root canal(s), 3 crowns, 6 fillings and a deep cleaning. After getting the night-guard, one root canal and 1 crown, I went somewhere else to get a second opinion because I was scared to loose all my teeth! It turns out a deep-cleaning and a few fillings were enough. So I will be going to Aloha Dental instead from now on: the dentist there is more senior, traditional, and low-tech, which to me is actually a good thing. The crown I got from Grand Oaks dentistry is all pretty but very uncomfortable and it is starting to hurt!! Also, I honestly don't mind spending money on my teeth because this is so important, but it is interesting to note that Grand Oaks Dentistry wanted to bill me something like 2700$ for all this, and I only spent 300$ at Aloha Dental in the end. I also felt that I was not being judged at Aloha Dental, whereas the dentist at Grand Oaks Dentistry didn't seem to believe me when I said I was brushing my teeth 3 times a day and flossing everyday. Dentists really need to understand that genetics is a huge factor when it comes to teeth. Compassion is key with people like me who are just unlucky, really.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelo Mazziotta
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've never had a bad experience here. The doctors and staff are all incredibly knowledgeable, professional, and courteous. I live about 40 minutes away from this location yet still make the drive for the service. One of the few exceptional doctors I've had the pleasure of seeing. For real, @ me if you don't believe, I'm happy to answer any questions and boost this office and their phenomenal staff as much as I can.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Derek JP
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I arrived hoping to find a new dentist closer to home after moving 40 minutes away from my old dentist who has practiced for over 20 years in Austin, who has hygienists that have worked for him for 17 yrs.

Though she is friendly and her office staff is actually even friendlier, she really pushes a lot of unbelievably unnecessary treatments on your very first visit.

Would anyone in their right mind actually feel comfortable with a brand new dentist telling them not only do you need a crown for these reasons, but we are ready (and are very eagerly) wanting you to get this crown done Today.

How is she not aware that this could not be one of the reddest of flags?  I expect and hope she changes her for-profit business plan after reading this.  Note: never try pushing first time patients to have a crown done during their very first visit, while telling staff to ready the chair, and saying "did he say yes?" or discussing patient decisions in the lobby in front of the patients and people waiting.

2nd pt.

For major work, my old dentist has Never performed major work on the very same day of diagnosis. NEVER in 5 years of seeing him. This made her seem not busy or booked at all, to suddenly have plenty of free time to perform a $1,000 crown on the very same day as diagnosis?

Why even ask current or new clients to have Major work done on the same day of diagnosis?? How is this approach supposed to make patients feel she actually cares about them and not their bank account ?  Some people actually appreciate having time to look at their finances and see how they can afford the major work that she has chosen to diagnose as 100% "necessary" for their dental health.

Final pt.

Here's how the Out Of Pocket costs differ between my very first visit with Dr. Sharma, and my visit with the older dentist who has been practicing for over 20 years

$2,127.00     (after the $1,000 insurance max)
vs.
$50.00

My north Austin dentist visit went like this:
Note, he has practiced in Austin for over 20 yrs

normal preventative cleaning,
continued notes on which areas they will keep monitoring
ZERO recommendations in his professional opinion for any other work at this time. No cavities that actually needed work, no talk of a crown at all.

Why are these professional opinions from both very experienced dentists so drastically different ... ? How is that even possible.

Why is another dentist who's been practicing for over 20 years in North Austin, why is His professional opinion $3,000 less than your professional opinion of what is 100% needed for my dental health ... ?

When I move to Kyle, TX eventually, I will be going with my high school friend's recommendation to see Broberg, without hesitation. I cannot comfortably return to see you Dr. Sharma after you:

1.  formed a $3,000 professional opinion of what my dental health needs that ended up being unbelievably unneccessary relative to the work my old dentist said was needed based on his 20 years of experience and continuing education.

2.  tried to have major work completed on the very same day as the diagnosis, as well as within my very first visit to your office, how do these action decisions of yours help to create the best first impression, and to make new and current patients feel like they are truly being cared for? It came off as a Sales pitch.

3.  why do you discuss anything at all about patient decisions at the front desk which had one person waiting? And in front of the patient as well. I have never seen this behavior from a professional dentist!

Maybe when she was younger, and to all of her current and loyal clients, she is a great dentist. As another review said well, when she's not having a great day, it is as if she is taking it out on either the patient and/or her staff. Multiple reviews state this.

I pray she doesn't yell at her staff after reading this, they were the kindest and coolest part of the experience, truly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Guzman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where to begin?!? Dr. Sharma and her lovely team are amazing, I recently had to have some dental work done and I had to have the work done before I lost my insurance benefits for the year. Let me tell you ALL the ladies were extremely helpful and kind. I normally get super anxious when going to the dentist due to past experiences however Dr. Sharma and her team we so understanding and helped put me at ease. In regards to my insurance I had to go back and forth with my insurance provider and the dentist office A LOT, like no, not exaggerating it was A LOT. I was in the process of losing benefits so it was a use it or lose it situation. I mention this because ANY time I called into the dentist office and it was A LOT, whether I was speaking to the same person or some one different they were ALWAYS so pleasant and willing to help.  These ladies are the real deal, they helped with my insurance issues, were willing to help me with a payment plan, and helped explain and answer any questions about the procedures I was getting done. So if you live close or not they are worth it. Seriously I NEVER ever write reviews but they really helped me out.  One of the best experiences I have had with a dentist and their team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jewels S.
user_reviews_extended.Description: everyone was very kind and understanding🖤 i’m very happy with this dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary G.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
What can I say, I trust Dr. Sharma with all my dental needs.

The team at the South and North location are fantastic. They are upfront with costs and procedure.

I had to come in for an additional appointment for my procedure and she made the drive from the South location to the North to ensure I was being taken care of.

I highly recommend the Grand Oaks Dentistry

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Gaharan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Sharma and her staff are professional, thorough, and show true care and concern for her patients. Sometimes getting dental treatment can be a little stressful or uncertain - but under her care I feel so much more comfortable than any dentist I have seen prior,  Knowing I’m in good hands - Highly recommended!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A. A.
user_reviews_extended.Description: It's always a gamble when you change dentists. Dr. Sharma is my 3rd dentist in the last 3 years. I came across her on an Opencare promotional offer, but I have been pleasantly surprised with the level of service and pleasantness I have received. Dr. Sharma and her team are pleasant and knowledgeable, and their prices are reasonable even being out of my insurance network. It's not always fun to have to get your teeth worked on (and I've had a fair amount of work done by her in the last month and a half), but I trust her judgement and she answers my questions thoroughly. They are accommodating to changes in my schedule, and I think I will be a patient of hers for many years to come. Thanks for treating me with respect and for being very up front about my treatment plan and recommended dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yuko Yoshikane
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I get super nervous at dentist usually but not this dentist! Very friendly staff and doctor :) Very transparent and very clear pricing. Clean nice office too :)

EDIT: I’m adding this comment below because today confirmed this dentistry is the best. I made my husband switched his dentist to Dr. Sharma. She found problems that previous doctor had no idea but need to address ASAP.  I’m so glad he switched!

Also she referred me a great orthodontist to straighten my teeth ( I still go see Dr. Sharma for my teeth cleaning and regular stuff), I’ve been having nothing but positive experience since I started going to this dentistry!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abigail Monte
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing dentistry!! Our whole family goes here. All staff are warm, courteous, and have made us feel like family. Never have had a bad experience and it continues to get better with each visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebekah W
user_reviews_extended.Description: She is very kind and cares very much about how you're doing and feeling during procedures. She does a very good job. Wait time is almost non-existent, the rooms are very clean, and we'll kept. The rest of the staff are wonderful and pleasant to be around. My children have all gone here and love it. Ages 1 1/2, 4 and 6. Highly recommend going here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie Sprague
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr Sharma and her staff. First time at this dentist and she was amazing with my boys. Explained everything clearly and was very informative and gave so many recommendations to help with their oral health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Badejo
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best dental experience I’ve ever had hands down. We struggled to secure my insurance in the beginning but their team was intentional and thorough to make sure that we had it and were prepared and ready. I loved feeling cared for almost as if I’m family and this office provided that feeling. I was informed and educated through the process. I don’t think I’ll ever switch offices with this team around

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Doyle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved to Austin 2 years ago and tried a few dentists before I found Dr. Sharma and her team at Grand Oaks Dentistry. They are all super friendly and you can tell that Dr. Sharma really cares about her patients and her practice. I’ve recommended this office to all of my friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: When thinking of activities in my zone of comfort I would not pick a dental appointment. Yet,  I found Grand Oaks Dentistry to be extremely pleasant from the moment I stepped in the office. Dr. Sharma's assistants are gentle and highly communicative during the entire exam, as well as Dr. Sharma , who took time to walk me through my X-rays explaining what she saw, and if it was a concern or not and why. Her demeanor and respectful manner was greatly appreciated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyse Bolda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this office so much. I admit that I wasn’t the most faithful dental appointment patient Prior to Grand Oaks and I had a lot of anxiety around visiting the first time. They were so sweet, patient and understanding of the anxiety. I have honestly turned around my mindset around going to the dentist and can truthfully say that I look forward to the visits. The Staff recognizes you and welcomes you by name every single time. Also- they are taking every precaution possible to prevent COVID. If you are nervous about seeing a dentist and/or nervous about COVID do not hesitate to come here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DUSTY LUCY
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sharma's team is always so professional and inviting. I really enjoy Alex cleaning my teeth and her great personality. The office even help me laminate a piece of paper to save me a trip!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Whitney White
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went here after it being recommended from a friend.  Both experiences I had were pretty terrible.  I felt as though I was being shamed for any dental work that needed to be done, and like things were being pushed on me.  The quotes they gave me for what needed to be done were insane and my insurance seemed to barely cover anything.  I've since gone to a new dentist that has not pushed many of the things they wanted to do, and my insurance goes a lot farther there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bunnie Kelly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly, professional , experienced staff. Dr Sharma set a treatment plan and explained everything completely. Very affordable. Best experience I’ve had at a dentist in a long time. I will definetly be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Pollard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sharma and her entire team is absolutely amazing. I had not been to the dentist in over 18 years due to a very traumatic childhood experience. At 27, I finally decided it was time to make an appointment. From the moment you walk in, everyone is so gracious and kind that it makes it impossible for you to dislike them (lol!). Due to not seeing the dentist in years, my teeth had some cavities and two molars were cracked due to grinding (I had no idea I even ground my teeth at night). Dr. Sharma did not shame me for ignoring my dental health, instead she welcomed me with open arms and was able to give me a well thought out plan, all while keeping in mind that I am living on a budget. I almost cried when she was speaking to me about my dental plan, not because I was scared, but because Dr. Sharma was so incredibly sweet...almost like a living angel! Aside from the damage I had done, I also have a rare genetic condition that affects the enamel on my two front teeth. We are now in the process of placing ceramic veneers and as you may know, veneers are usually not covered by insurance, but the total price was honestly not bad at all. They already prepped one of the molars with a crown, and that was pretty painless as well! So far, I am extremely happy with this dental practice, and I know Dr. Sharma will be my dentist for life! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amena Sattar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was the FIRST time I felt So comfortable at a dentist office! Dr. Sharma defintely is the best dentist. I don't think I've ever met a dentist as sweet and caring as her. Aside from her personality, her work is extaordinary. She's very patient and takes her time doing her job. She took her time doing my fillings and made sure I felt comfortable before she started doing the fillings. Unlike most dentists who reccomend uneccesary treatments, she only reccomends what is needed. Also most dentists offices don't allow children, and when I asked her on the phone if it was okay to bring my kids since I had no one to watch them, she right away said yes and not to worry about it! I'm so glad I found her! Even my kids will be going to her now! Thank you Dr.
Sharma! Oh and I forgot to mention how clean her office was! And the staff was awesome! One of them even took care of my baby while I was getting work done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Mandel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Grand Oaks Dentistry saw me on short notice with only days left on my insurance policy. Dr. Dharma and her staff are courteous and professional. They answered all my questions and concerns and took care of my dental needs with true care and kindness.

user_reviews_extended.Name: frances patch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Sharma is very professional, personable. She takes the time to get acquainted, stays aware of individual needs. The hygienists are patient, kind, thorough. The space is spotless, the equipment up to date. We're so glad we found this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Kies
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Grand Oaks Dentistry for years and I Absolutely LOVE ❤️ Dr Z! She is Amazing and Everyone there is Super Friendly and Very Professional. I Highly recommend Grand Oaks Dentistry for ALL your pie 🥧 hole 🕳️ needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabrina Abdaishoo Kaldani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sharma is very kind and gentel with her patients. My 3/5 yrs old loves to coming visit Dr. Sharma. She is very thorough and provides excellent explanations. The office and the staff are very friendly and we love the environment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Krang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic group of people, very professional and easy going, the dental service is always great every time I visit and they do a thorough job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Saucedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sharma and the entire staff at the practice are beyond amazing. Dr. Sharma puts even me, the most anxious being, at ease. She is thoughtful and talks to me like another human, not just her patient. Cannot say enough good things about Dr. Sharma and her staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: JUDY MORENO
user_reviews_extended.Description: I like to thank Dr Sharma, for being caring and honest with me about my dental issues. a giving me advise on dental care options. The staff are professional and friendly🤗

user_reviews_extended.Name: M W
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The personnel of any business comprise its greatest asset.
Erica is a fine ambassador for this practice.  She is knowledgeable, has a gentle hand, and is possessed of good humor.  I look forward to the next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Darling
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at Grand Oaks Denistry for 10 years. The office is clean, organized, and communicates clearly. The care is caring and skillful. I highly recommend this practice!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sharma is kind, gentle and quick. I have been her paitent for 8 years and feel lucky and blessed every time she takes care of me.  I wish I could give more stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sue Simpson
user_reviews_extended.Description: First of all, all of the staff are very courteous and very nice!. Dr. Sharma is a very professional dentist. I moved to the area about two years ago and have been looking for a dentist. The last one I went to went thru the motions and at the end of the appointment handed me a treatment plan for over $18K. That turned me off until today when I went to see Dr. Sharma. X-Rays were taken and afterwards she checked my teeth. She showed me the X-Rays and explained to me what we were looking at. She explained some treatment options. There was no pressure, no scaring me into treatment, just true and honest assessment of my teeth health. Afterwards, the finance person came in and clearly explained the treatment and costs and again, no pressure to have it done. I really enjoyed this experience and will definitely be going to her for all my dental needs. Check her out, you won't be sorry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashvin Baru
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is gem of a private practice.  I have been a patient here for five years and always appreciate the detail of dental care I receive.

I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alice Katerina Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Sharma and the team always make you feel like your family. Their level of service and care will have you wanting to visit the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Arzaga
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sharma and her staff were great with my 2 year old daughter. They made her dental experience fun while providing great dental care. Keep up the good job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret Palanca
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a wonderful time with all the staff there!! They are so friendly,  professional,  and made me feel comfortable the moment I walked in!  Truly a top notch Dentist and staff,  all are amazing!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edgar Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Took all three of my kids, age 8, 4 and 3, The dentist and assistant were so patient and kind. Took time to explain procedures and was very kind to my kids. My two oldest did great, my 3 year old did not want anything to do with her teeth that day, and the staff did not force anything on her.  I loved that they were not money hungry. Definitely would recommend for kids dentry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: rebecca cantu

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonelle Feikis Cornelius

user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience I have ever had!😅

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Julian
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient here for a number of years now and love it! Dr. Sharma is very kind and professional and the staff is lovely. The treatment I have received has been outstanding, I would definitely recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ash Pulido
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely love coming here! They are such a beautiful team of women that always make me feel so safe and supported!

user_reviews_extended.Name: C. P.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sharma is the first dentist I have had who really took the time to talk through my dental health and treatment with me. The staff here are very kind and helpful, and I am so glad I found this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mandi Ruffin
user_reviews_extended.Description: The women at Grand Oaks are amazing.  They are ALWAYS on time; I don't think I've ever had to wait past my appointment time to get started.  They are courteous, COVID safe, and listen to my concerns when I have some.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Isaac
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Grand Oaks are extremely detail oriented and professional. Dr. Sharma is amazing with my little one and we all look forward to going to the dentist now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: RL
user_reviews_extended.Description: Grand Oaks Dentistry is a professional clean establishment,  business ready, customer friendly dentistry. Always make me feel  comfortable which made my visit a breeze thanks again for your service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Gardner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was skeptical about going to see the dentist during covid but I must say this office made me feel very comfortable with the proper ppe that the whole office was wearing, everything sterilized, and the proper social distancing! Thank you Dr. Sharma for making me feel safe. Great Office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Steans
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going here for a few years and this has been a great office.  Great team working here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lea Lalou

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been coming here for a couple years now and have been recommending Dr. Wong to friends. The waiting room, exam room, and bathroom are all wheelchair accessible (though the front door is a bit heavy, and the office manager offered to get it for me).

Dr. Wong actually read the best practices research I sent ahead, about my rare bone condition, and seemed to make a habit of reviewing it before my appointments. I wish that wasn't unusual but her thoughtfulness makes me feel a lot safer in her hands! I worked with Dr. Yi today and he was friendly and professional too. Both Dr. Wong and Dr. Yi listened to me and took my insight about my FD/MAS disability seriously. Such a relief.

(Please see update at end) Also, today I was thrilled to discover Avenue Dental has started using a new teeth cleaning device just this month, and it does NOT have that horrible loud noise! It was the easiest most relaxing teeth cleaning I've ever had! I asked them if they'd forgotten a step, and they laughed and said everyone has been asking that, but it's just the new device they're using is so gentle. I was amazed! I've got neurodivergent friends who really struggle with the unbearable sensory nightmare of teeth cleaning, and I'm going to tell all of them to come here!

I'm also remembering that they have mobile TV screens that they can place and put on Netflix to distract patients from difficult procedures. Last year I watched an episode of GBBO and it was soothing. Very helpful.

Update 6 months later: I worked with Dr. Leeson today and we tried to solve the mystery of what I experienced last time, because she wasn't aware of the gentle technique I described. Dr. Yi did not note anything unusual in my patient notes, and only stayed with the practice a short time. Dr. Leeson said it's still standard practice to use the cavitron (basically the sonic pick) to scrape off plaque. For the record she was kind, asked good questions, and was not dismissive at all, just not sure what I had experienced last time. I'll still be coming back here.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm always happy coming here! Dr Wong and her staff make me feel safe, even though I'm super anxious about going to the dentist, and have sensory issues around it. I wear headphones, bring a squishmallow, and wear my own sunglasses, and this is all totally fine with them. If you're scared to go to a dentist, this is the place for you.
