user_reviews_extended.Name: Resistakill
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m a disabled veteran who asked the VA to move from VA dental to community care. I think I’ll switch back because the VA may take a while to have an appointment, yet they do a thorough job.

The services I had done here were “in processing” to get into the Caras system and an exam to prepare for a cleaning. From what I understood from the person dealing with billing, there is a stack of paperwork trying to get approval for veterans to get work done. The many reviews seem to have a common issue revolving around billing. I’ll update next month after my cleaning is done, assuming it actually gets done.

There are two things that bothered me that aren’t ever issues I’ve had at the VA. First, the “need” for music/sound. Not only is it near impossible for everyone to enjoy ALL types of music, it’s distracting, similar to why listening to music (too loud) while driving can be dangerous. The second thing that I’ve never seen before (to memory) are the seemingly unnecessary posts about prices. The posts didn’t seem like they are for people to know what they’re getting into if they need something done. They seemed more like mostly advertising, for overpriced products that aren’t necessary, such as whitening kits. From the many reviews I read (some high stars, others low), it seems like billing and up-charging/over-charging are how this location does business.

Floss, a toothbrush, and mouth wash are all that are necessary to keep your teeth properly clean, as far as understand.

Currently, Megan serves as my hygienist, and Dr. Ryu as my dentist. Their intelligence, competence, and compassion have consistently impressed me. I wholeheartedly recommend both this facility, and these exceptional individuals for anyone seeking reliable dental care.

OK, I love this place & the dentists & everyone!
Here's a rough calculation for the amount of energy used when a space heater is run in an air conditioned space.
The amount of energy in 1 gallon of gas is about 33.41 KWH (kilowatt hours).  The space heater uses 1000 watts (or 1500 watts but 1000 watts is in the ballpark). If it is run for 8 hours, when it's warm out and the AC is on, it fights with the AC. Air conditioning is less efficient than heating so I want to say 1000 watts being burnt plus 2000 watts for the extra work the AC is doing. (This assumes some things about the circulation through the office). So in 8 hours maybe about 24000 watt-hours which is 24 KWH. It's about 2/3 of a gallon of gas.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient there for several years. My sister has been going for over a decade. They are all wonderful and work hard to keep their patients healthy. Everyone I’ve encountered there has been professional, knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Burns
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going there for many years and I always have great dental care and an overall great experience. The staff is friendly and they communicate well as they go through the cleaning procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Holton-Ewers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at Carus dental for about 6-7 years. The dentists, dental hygienists, front office and any other staff  I’m missing, are all wonderful. I’ve gone from panic stricken to looking forward to going to the dentist. I won’t go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Gunter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this office and Dr. Herndon! I happily drive 75 minutes to see them because they are really that good! I had a hard time finding a dentist I liked and could trust until my sister recommended Dr. Herndon. She is professional, kind, gentle, a perfectionist, and she explains everything as she goes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time patient at this location. Everyone was friendly and professional. Had reviewed all records that had been shared before my arrival. They were up to date with where I was and a current game plan! I couldn’t have been happier with how they took such good care of me. Megan did a great job! Met Dr Silvertooth and he was great. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gary Robertson
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife and I have been Carus Dental patients for over 20 years. Our hygienist is Christina and she is definitely a five star. She knows both my wife and I personally and always inquires of the other spouse whenever we are in for a cleaning. Dr. Silvertooth recommended a procedure for me that was thousands of dollars less than if I had gone to another dentist. Again, Dr. Silvertooth is a five star dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Floyd Hossick
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I first started going here the atmosphere was great and I had the same dental hygienist every time but since it has been bought out by another company the atmosphere isn’t the same and this last visit it felt very uncomfortable plus I had a new hygienist again and I felt very uncomfortable as it was obvious that she is new and I’m sure with time she will become more comfortable with people but this is also the first time I’ve had my teeth cleaned that when I left I didn’t feel like they were cleaned at all. I hope the atmosphere gets better and on my next visit I can get with a regular hygienist again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robyn Henley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a loyal client to Carus at this location for 8 years now. I debating updating this review for a few days but because of the emotional toll I decided it was worth it. I still think Megan is amazing and that is why I am so sad about what happened, I will truly miss her. Carus cancelled my appointment the day of due to an unpaid balance of $140. I had no idea about this, I checked back they sent me a single email last July about the bill. No letters, no phone calls just a call the day of my appointment 8 months later to cancel it. They said I could still come in that day if I could pay the bill, and I agreed. When I got there, they said they must add 20% for a collections fee. I said I wouldn’t pay that. She agreed they had only sent me one electronic communication about it. They spoke to the manager and said there was nothing they could do. Nothing they could do for a client that has been with them for 8 years and spent large sums of money the previous year. These are terrible policies and need to be adjusted. Do you due diligence. Be smart about your spending and shop around before stopping here. Carus is a corporation through and through.

Previous review:
I love my dental hygienist Megan! I used to hate going to get my teeth cleaned but ever since I found her I actually enjoy going. She's great 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always on time,  very thorough and professional. I have had the opportunity to work with both Christina and Jessica as hygienists. And, they are super thorough, yet efficient and very skilled at their jobs. I highly recommend Carus Dental North.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karista Flynn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Herndon has such great bedside manner. Both her & her assistant, Jessica, always leave me with a big (glistening) smile! I was lucky to find them when i had a dental emergency last year. They worked me in same hour as I called & were so kind, compassionate, & supportive! They are an amazing team! Thank you for superb service at your location!

user_reviews_extended.Name: R. D. Deni
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience.  Hygienist Christina let's me know that I need to step up my flossing game,  my hard head never listens.  She's so professional.  My Dentist, Dr. Silvertooth (great name) is so awesome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Warren
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was quite pleased with my visit. This was my first appointment after switching to Carus. Jessica was great. Very thorough. Dr Ryu did a checkup after the cleaning. I believe I make the right choice in choosing Carus.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Coral Estrada
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every experience and appointment I’ve had with the receptionist, check out, hygienist and dentist has been so personal and amazing. A coworker recommended Carus Dental and I have been going for years now. I absolutely love Megan my hygienist and love my dentist Christine Herndon, DDS! They always remember me and make my experience fun, enjoyable and special. My husband goes here too and enjoys it. He has only had 1 bad painful experience with Silvertooth DDS.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristine Catameo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff and service! We appreciate everything you guys do. Thank you! ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: AndrewTara FrancoSvehlaStefanacRiveraGonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the Staff from Carus Dental. They are always patient and always kind. Thank you Dr. Ryu and staff. Have a good day!

user_reviews_extended.Name: DS Ranger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Another dental visit to Dr. Herndon was perfect!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John DeLaPaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: My favorite dental team in Austin. My wife & I have been going here for years & they are excellent. Jess is AMAZING!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Carus Dental! The staff is very kind and professional, and they always give plenty of courtesy reminders about appointments which I appreciate. Megan and Jessica (dental hygienists) and Dr. Ryu are excellent at their jobs - attentive, proactive, and personable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James C
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient here for some years now, and it is nice to see no turn over with the staff as I have had the same who have worked with me, and I truly appreciate their service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m very happy to have found  Carus Dental.  Everyone was so attentive caring . This is a blessing to me. Thank you everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sally Mustacchia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I see Dr. Herndon and I think she has the best attitude. I really appreciate the way she cares about my overall well-being. The hygienist, Monica, also a super star. What a great team! So happy that I found this practice.  Only downside is they are booked far in advance but I think that's a great thing for the practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim Vanderploeg
user_reviews_extended.Description: My doctor's assistant was very thorough and friendly. Even though I arrived late, because of traffic and weather they were very accommodating. The Doctor was friendly and informative and took very good care of me. Excellent job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: gonutz99
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love both my dentist and my hygienist.
They are very caring, very friendly, and cherrie.  I used to really put off the dental visits until I found this team.  Now I really look forward to my dental visits and my teeth are in the best shape of my life.  I took my 92 year old mom there and she loves them as well. I HIGHLY recommend them to everyone.  My whole family uses them. Turn your dental chicken into a proud peacock.  My dental office is on Renfert, and behind the hospital on Mopac.  I drive down from Georgetown to see them-they are that good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karla Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Hygienist was friendly. However, was told I needed to pay extra for the cleaning due to gum swelling or something like that and when the cleaning was done they charged me $52.

I called my insurance afterwards because I have never had to pay for a cleaning, they stated I shouldn’t have had to pay and the amount charged didn’t even match any of the itemized charges. They’ve also mentioned seeing dentist offices charge clients similarly to see who calls their insurance and asks for a refund.

The insurance also has a call log of providers inquires. This office NEVER spoke to my insurance prior to my visit to verify benefits and had no reason to believe I should be charged. All the itemized charges matched their contracted amounts either BCBS. They have other clients with the same insurance as me so they have worked with BCBS.

I called Carus and asked for a refund and they said since I did not request a refund within 30 days of my visit that they will be sending the refund within 30 days.

So they never contacted my insurance to verify benefits before or after my visit and THEY incorrectly charge me. Never called me to inform me of THEIR mistake. I had to discuss with my insurance and verify then contact Carus. And now I have to wait two months until I receive MY money they took in seconds when they swiped my card.

Needless to say never going back, this is unacceptable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sally Loomer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Christine DDS and Christine Hygienist at North Austin Carus Dental have earned my trust over  the many years I have used them. Caring, professional, fun and skilled professionals.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valincia Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I all love this place. We see Dr. Silvertooth and Dr. Herndon and they are amazing. The whole staff is honestly. The women at the front desk I hate that I don’t know her name for this review but she always greets us with a smile and works the schedule out for us. For anyone looking for a Dentist don’t hesitate to come here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Day
user_reviews_extended.Description: Megan Hradek is an absolute gem.  I've been going to Carus for years and have always ensured that Megan remains as my dental hygienist as she has the attention to detail that surpasses everyone else.  I can't stand the high pressure water cleaning and she will still use the old school method if asked.  All the staff there at the North Austin site are great, but I can't speak well enough of Megan.  She is a true professional and deserves the utmost praise as she excels at what she loves to do.  I am writing this as my insurance is about to change and I'm worried that I won't get another chance to go back to have my teeth cleaned by the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience at Carus recently. The staff were all incredibly friendly and welcoming, from the receptionists to the hygienist and dentist. Overall, it was a positive dental experience. I recommend this office to anyone looking for a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Font
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional, caring staff.  Love Dr. Herndon!  She is fantastic and doesn’t pressure you into getting things done.  Tells you what’s going on, makes recommendation and then says whenever you’re ready, she’ll take care of it.   Love that!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Kelly Watson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff is wonderful. I’ve been coming here for years, with insurance and without. I feel seen and heard. I ask a lot of clinical questions and I always get an answer that I can understand. I’ve been Dr Herndon (and Dr. Silvertooth if it’s a Tuesday) and just think they are the best. They are honest without being harsh about proper dental care at home and what can or can’t be done without extra dental care in the office. I trust what they say and admire their ability to remember any little personal detail. Thanks y’all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori K
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would still recommend Dr. Silvertooth and Carus Dental North Austin.  He is a great dentist and the hygienists are awesome.
However I am removing stars due to how hard it is to book an appointment.  I see the dentist 4x year and if I have to reschedule (due to work), they are completely unable to accommodate for at least 5-6 months, which means I miss one of my visits that year.  If you are looking for flexibility, this probably won't work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Arroyo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best hygienist ever! Megan H is legit the reason why I travel 30 mins to this location! Time and time again. She’s amazing

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darnel Parrillo-Casper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff and technicians. It’s always a positive experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marlo Marion
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr Herndon.  She is the best.  I had a filling come out and they fit me in immediately.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khan Zoha
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had a great experience
Was diagnosed well by the doctor and the assistants.. the front desk is also very cheerful and helpful.
Highly recommended 🤩

user_reviews_extended.Name: Damaris Bode
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had some really bad experiences until I started going to Carus Dental. For me as someone who is traumatized by previous dentist experiences dr. Navid and Dr silvertooth are a amazing and since my son now goes there too as well as my husband i can say all of the doctors and staff are wonderful. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Landis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Carus Dental has been great to me , they have save my smile when I thought I was going to lose my teeth

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pam Yip
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would definitely refer this office to my friends.  Dr. Silvertooth and his hygienist Megan are both very professional and thorough.  Megan answered my questions about flossing and made good suggestions to help me with difficult areas to floss.  I am no longer nervous about going to the dentist because of my positive experience with their office.  Thanks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gilberto
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They left me in pain
I had an appointment for another reason
Another tooth had gotten an abscess
It was swollen big time
I was in a lot of pain
I called them and asked if I could get seen
They told me they would look at it in a couple of days when I had an appointment for my other tooth
When I showed up for my appointment they acted as if they didn’t know what I was talking about and only wanted to treat the other tooth that wasn’t in pain
Dr O was laughing and made fun of me right outside the exam door as if I couldn’t hear what he was saying
They said they could schedule me an appointment two weeks away
By then I had it taken care of
The day before the next appointment they called to remind me of the appointment and I told them I didn’t need it anymore then tried to charge me $75 for not canceling 24 hours in advance
It was 23 and half hours
I didn’t pay and I don’t plan to ever go back there again

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very professional.

I have been here twice now and am very pleased.  Dr. Emily Ryu is everything that a good dentist should be - friendly, professional, knowledgeable, and honest.

I had gone to Castle prior and was quoted an outrageous estimate whereas here at Carus, they only plan to treat the problem areas and charge for that instead of charging triple the  amount for work that really doesn't need to be done.

For great customer service, professional and honest staffing, and decent pricing - this is the place to go.

I have finally found a dentist I would like to stick with for a long time - Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Gravell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Megan is wonderful!  And Dr. Ryu is very pleasant, too.  Front desk staff are also warm and friendly.  I’m very happy with this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Armando Guerra
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came on a Wednesday afternoon. Waited 2 minutes and was admitted(I did have an appointment). Hygienist was nice and polite, efficient. Dr. Tea was also very friendly, informative and descriptive with the treatment plan. They verified my insurance and detailed the cost very well. Overall as a first visit it went pretty smooth. Have my next visit scheduled, will try to review again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristofer Coroalles
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called them and I thought I was talking to the office. I did not get their office despite calling during office hours but rather got their call center. The person was very nice on the phone and scheduled an appointment for me. They told me to go ahead and fill out the paperwork online before my visit. As soon as I completed all of the paperwork and they had all of my sensitive information they called me and said that they could not take me and needed to push my appointment back 2 weeks. When I asked if I could go to one of their other locations they said no they are all separate. None of this makes sense and I strongly advise staying away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yir I
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always had a good experiences each time I visited the office. Dr. Emily Ryu was always kind, friendly, and very very good doctor. Friendly and sweet assistance, Christina, wasn't there but I met Courtney, doc assistance , and she was very friendly and funny. All of the staff there were always friendly and had a good attitudes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen G.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m still very happy with the kind care and patient staff at Carus Dental. 3/26/24
All in my previous posts apply today. 😃

I recently began seeing Dr. Silvertooth at Carus Dental at the North Austin location.
From the moment I walked in for my first visit, the front desk receptionist was welcoming and helpful.  The technicians/hygienists who saw me to get Xrays and take pictures of my teeth and get medical history were also very welcoming and took their time with me and answered all my questions.
When I saw Dr. Silvertooth, I was made immediately comfortable by his warm, professional manner and noticed that he was a great listener.  I was impressed with his kind and soothing discussions and how he happily answered all my questions.  His upbeat nature was something that immediately set my mind at ease.
The hygienist who did my cleaning was efficient, professional, and took her time with every little detail.  I felt comfortable the entire time, as she measured my gums and did a thorough cleaning.
When I left and it was time to pay my bill, the Practice Manager was patient, even though several calls had to be made to our dental insurance company.  He did this as quickly as he could so we didn't have to wait a long time to check out for the day.
It's a breath of fresh air to have such professional, kind, warm, and knowledgeable people taking care of your dental issues; I would definitely recommend this practice to anyone seeking a dentist to try Carus Dental.
Thanks to everyone for taking such great care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ester Cridlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t usually have an issue with the Business Office at this location and love Dr Silvertooth however I have had a claim that was refused due to them not turning into insurance in a timely manner. That issue was resolved. Then I had a poor cleaning where the hygienist was interrupted multiple times and didn’t seem to have enough time to do a thorough job. Then that very appointment had not been scheduled in the appropriate timeframe for insurance to cover the free cleaning. An appointment had to be cancelled due to the office thinking my insurance had expired when it had not. When I called back to clear that up I rescheduled and then it had to be cancelled again due to my hygienist being out. I understand emergencies happen and hygienists can’t make it in but the late insurance verifications and charges for a mistake on their part I feel is unreasonable. When I voiced my concern with Marissa the business office manager she said emergencies happen and the appointments are estimated and the amount was my responsibility. When I explained what had happened I heard no empathy or apology for their part. I said I wouldn’t be coming back to that office she said ok and hung up. I guess after years of going to that office they no longer appreciate my business and I will be going elsewhere. I hope you do too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Bumpas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful practice Dr Silvertooth and Meagan, hygienist is very thorough and pleasant. Great dental experience!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ping Wu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service. Dr. Silvertooth tried his best to take me in for my dental emergency.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Noemi Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going here for a 3 or more years now and I love my doctor Herndon. She does amazing and she’s outgoing, I never have issues at this place and continue to keep going. Definitely recommend and also their dental assistants are so sweet and knowledgeable about what they’re doing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rocky Zepeda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff at all levels are very engaging with patients.  Techs take the time to inform you of procedures in the step by step process using common language.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Queen B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Christine is such a ray of sunshine!!! Always smiling. And Dr. Ryu is just as nice. Great office

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerry Michael
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had not been to the dentist in years but when one tooth started hurting I chose to go to Carus. Glad I did.  Needed a couple of crowns and they filled two cavities.

The procedure for the work was split between two sessions and was pretty painless.

I don’t regret choosing Carus.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been to this location twice so far and both times Dr. Herndon, C. has helped me. She's awesome and has great positive, smile-inducing attitude. I would recommend her to anyone in a heartbeat! Additionally the hygienist who attended to me in my most recent visit is a nice and helpful dude. 5/5!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raven Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had my first appointment with Carus and found the staff to be very friendly and inviting! I have a bit if a fear of the dentist but they made me feel comfortable and explained their processes & billing before they got started. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Constance Pechal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience with Jessica. She answers questions and provides good advice for dental health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Herndon is wonderful. I did see a dentist for many years and I wish I as dentist like her many years ago.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chat Merry
user_reviews_extended.Description: We are happy to say we end up in a good Dental Clinic. We are satisfied and happy that our Doctor and all staff is kind respectful and friendly

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience from start to finish. Staff seems happy to be there and very willing to assist with your needs and questions. Dr silver tooth was super thorough and made everything crystal clear. Cannot recommend this place enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental assistant and the dentist were both kind, clear on what they were looking at/doing, and efficient. This practice makes patient care its main focus, which I love!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pearl Stowers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Most people don't like going to the dentist including me but my experience with my dentist, C. Herndon, has been exceptionally pleasant.  One complaint they are not prompt in calling you back after leaving a message for a return call.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bonnie Sutherland
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve neglected my oral health for a while and was really nervous about going to the dentist again. Every staff member I interacted with was so kind and non-judgemental. They took time to explain things, go over a plan and prioritize treatment options and answer all of my probably dumb questions. Dr Silvertooth was incredibly kind and patient and made this process less intimidating and scary. I’m glad to find a dentist that I’m actually comfortable with seeing routinely.

(Also this is one of my first ever public reviews, that’s how impressed I was.)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Breau
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this practice for over ten years. During that time, the team has changed, but they have always had warm and welcoming service. The care is top notch, and the people are terrific. I would definitely recommend Carus to anyone looking for a dentist in our area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zy Bobbitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here since 2014 and I can say with pride, my dentist is the bees knees.  A super friendly team of proactive medical professionals who take pride in actually caring for people and not just treating patients.  Dr. Herndon has also helped educate me and Christina my hygienist is the bomb dot com.  Love my dentists!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johnny Patton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enjoy going to dentist, very nice ladies.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
the best dental visits ever! i had plenty of work to be done and being a scary cat was not happy. From my gentle tech to my excellent dentist i was happy leaving there with beautiful teeth and smiling like i hadn't done for years!
Tell them Pam sent you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suresh B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This appointment was for my elderly mother (67 yrs) for her annual examination and dental cleaning. Visited the office location at 21450 Kuykendahl road, Spring, TX 77379. We had our new patient documents filled out ahead of time. The check in process was seamless and was attended to within 5 minutes of registering at the desk and handing over applicable documents. Catherine- Dental Hygienist was really sweet and patient with my mother. She explained every step of her process. Dr. Tea was very nice dealing with my mother especially since mother doesn't like to visit Dr.'s office. The entire staff made it so easy for us to be in and out. Keep up the good work.
Best part was, when requested for medical records along with digital x-ray copies due to extend overseas travel, we received it via email within 10 minutes of submitting the record release . Elizabeth was very prompt.
I like this place, Staff & their efficiency so much that I have setup for visit as well.
Only request is to have more extended or weekend hours to help working folks to have easy access to such amazing dental practices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gloria Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Timely attendance upon arrival. Easy processing of new-insurance and change-of-address processing. Actual dental work was top quality!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie Benedict
user_reviews_extended.Description: Courtney was so helpful, professional and friendly... she’s a delight. My hygienist was also very good at her job, she took great care of me and made my teeth look and feel amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ester Cridlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always give Dr Silvertooth and his staff 5 stars. This time was different. The hygienist spent what seemed like only 20 minutes and did a cursory cleaning not like any cleaning I’ve had with them. I’m very disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dr. Mrs. Professor Chaos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have a deeply intense fear of dentistry. Absurdly intense. Dr Silvertooth has the best chair side
manner and his hygienists can't be beat. I'd recommend them but it's hard enough to get a time slot without adding new patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Milan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hygienist Jessica was outgoing, friendly and efficient. Dr Silvertooth was efficient, clear and reassuring as well. They also were transparent about costs before we got started.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa T
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are great! Best dentist ever. Never have to wait for my appt, super nice staff, clean and modern facilities, and great treatment. I would be sad to have to switch dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Tovar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not many people can say they enjoy going to the dentist!! Everyone of my dental appointments from cleaning to a procedure have been pleasurable.. the entire staff and Doctors are very friendly, caring and knowledgeable.. highly recommended!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry Holst
user_reviews_extended.Description: Megan is very professional, courteous and fast when she does my cleanings. I enjoy talking to her. Thank you Megan!  Also, Dr Silvertooth has done my preventive dentistry in the past and also has a great personality and makes me feel at ease.    Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Destinie R. Holcomb
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Emily Ryu (who isn’t my regular dentist) but has seen me a couple of times is an absolute sweetheart. So nice, understanding and really cares about her patients. She took the time to listen and give feedback and options to help my aching tooth. I have been a patient here for a long time and Dr. Herndon, Ryu and Silvertooth have been great. Art, the office manager is great too and has been nothing but helpful always.

Thank you guys for everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Valdez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Herndon and Amber G. Are absolutely amazing! I haven’t seen a dentist in almost 10 years because it gave me extreme anxiety, but they made sure I was comfortable every step of the way. They not only made my experience bearable, but they also made it enjoyable as well! Never seeing another dentist in Austin again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hosam Badreldin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I give 1 start not because of the dental service, service was OK. This review is 2 folds.

1. They will always want you to pay in advance. This is okay if they estimate things correctly. They will always over charge you, underestimate estimated charges, then bill insurance, if you assume the insurance overpaid them, they will not follow up to give you credit. So you will have to be really careful and check your account.

They will give you a proposal for treatment with money figures, watch out as they might later change their mind on what you have to pay vs. what insurance have paid them.

2. They will report you to the Credit Bureaus immediately if you did not pay them the due, this is fair and this is normal, if the dues have not been marked as zero in your account for long time. title: Austin Lifetime Dental
address: 2206 W Parmer Ln, Austin, TX 78727, United States

user_reviews.Name: Vickie Grier
user_reviews.Description: I am so glad a friend recommended Austin Lifetime Dental. I am a lifelong odontophobe, so writing a positive review the day after getting a crown and two fillings is a big deal for me.  I was very nervous about the procedure and Suzanne put me at ease right away. She got me a pillow and a weighted blanket and then talked me through the plan. She checked on me often to make sure I was okay and gave me breaks when I needed them. Dr. Lane has such a patient, calming demeanor (and that's not just the nitrous oxide talking). He was meticulous about making sure the crown looked and felt perfect. I have had dentists in the past who have been condescending or shamed me for my anxiety. I know that would never happen here. Every single employee has always treated me with genuine kindness and patience. I look forward to my cleaning with Vincent next month. Thank you all!

user_reviews.Name: Erin Warner
user_reviews.Description: I have been a patient at Austin Lifetime Dental for over 10 years and I’ve had nothing but excellent care. I consistently recommend them to friends. The staff is so kind and professional. They do little things to make you comfortable. They continually update with the latest technology. And they’re genuinely nice people. Gratitude to Dr. Lane, to Suzanne, hygienist Mary, and to Samantha on the office side of things.

user_reviews.Name: Amanda Brown
user_reviews.Description: Van is my favorite hygienist of my entire life and I am a person who is very panicky about the dentist! She does a great job and is so gentle. The office gets a lot of cool new gadgets and treatments to make the cleaning process faster and less painful. I have 1 very small start to a cavity that we’ve been watching for a few years now. Van and Dr. O were proactive to suggest a new treatment for it to hopefully help slow, stop, or even reverse damage so a filling is hopefully never needed. I researched the treatment in more depth and have a high confidence level that it will be effective.

user_reviews.Name: kayla matsuda
user_reviews.Description:
I am new to the area and I was looking for a dental office and always head to the reviews and check out the website of  any new medical office I plan to go to. I am so happy that I came here for my dental treatment! Like so happy haha and it seems that many others are as well. I have worked in  the dental field (orthodontics) for quite sometime , so my expectations are quite high when I a look for an office. From the initial call to the warmth and professionalism of the staff, this place exceeded all my expectations. I love that this is a private office, as my experience has been that the care is always much better. The office has 5 doctors and plenty of staff which I believe allows them to have more availability than most private offices.

When I called, I spoke with Katie, the front desk/new patient coordinator and she helped me schedule an appointment. She was very helpful , polite and even sweeter in person! This already prepped me for being excited for the first visit.  I have since been there twice now and both times I've seen her she greeted me with a smile and wholesome conversation.I also love that they have early morning appointments starting at 7:30am. This really worked with my schedule. Thanks Katie!

At my first appointment I was greeted by Sheri, the registered dental hygienist who took care of my initial exam ( xrays, periocharting, and cleaning). She was really kind and explained everything that was going to take place during the visit. She was knowledgeable and very friendly and easy to talk to. She was gentle with the cleaning and my teeth felt great after! After the dentist ( Dr. Toshiki Soejima) looked at my teeth, we agreed there was a couple of areas to be taken care of, so I scheduled to come back.

At my follow up visit I was welcomed by another dental assistant,  Susie. Once again I was just so impressed that 100% of the staff I met there so far has just been absolutely delightful. She made sure I was comfortable and had a very soft soothing voice that calmed me. She was a wonderful assistant to Dr. Toshiki while he was doing my treatment.

As for the treatment and my experience with Dr. Toshiki, I couldn't be happier. I guess it had been a while since I had any sort of treatment done at a dentist office, but I was blown away on how easy and efficient he made the process. I had a filling done for a developing cavity, a restoration from a molar fracture and a sealant on a back molar. I was in at 7:30am and  out about 8:30am. In no way did I feel rushed and I was made comfortable the entire time. I was properly numbed on the filling sites, and he made sure my bite was comfortable before I left and made any adjustments to the restorations before I left. Thank you so much, so glad to have these taken care of by you!

I am sure that the rest of the staff and the doctors are equally stellar and I highly recommend this office. Oh it's also a nice building inside and I like all the natural light that comes through.

Thank you Austin Lifetime Dental for making this such a great and unique experience!=]

user_reviews.Name: Aaron Burns
user_reviews.Description:
My recent visit to Lifetime Dental on Parmer was about as good as it gets for a dental appointment—especially when it involves something as unpleasant as a back molar issue.

After a quick and smooth check-in, I was politely reminded that I was well overdue for my follow-up appointment. The staff took the time to properly explain the importance of maintaining good oral health, which I genuinely appreciated.

Once the catch-up work began, the dental team performed several scans and thorough examinations. Unfortunately, it was revealed that one of my back molars could not be saved and required removal.

I was given the option to schedule the procedure for a later date or to move forward immediately. Based on their professional advice, I agreed it was best to take care of it right away rather than postpone it.

Overall, the staff’s professionalism, honesty, and clear communication made what could have been a stressful visit feel calm and well-handled. Aaron

user_reviews.Name: Lynn Riley
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been going to Austin lifetime Dental for many years. Always a pleasant experience. You can tell they take a wonderful care of their staff and their patients because everybody here is extremely happy and calming. I would hope I would never have to go anywhere else for my dental care as I started coming here I believe in my 40s and now I’m in my 60s. Great job Austin Lifetime Dental please continue to strive. You’re a wonderful bunch of people very professional and knowledgeable!!!!! Thank you for all that you do.

user_reviews.Description: Great experience.  From the front desk to checkout everyone was so helpful, professional and cheerful!  I have dental terror and they made me comfortable from the first step.  The dentist (Cabillo not sure of the spelling) was so gentle and understanding.  I will go back!

user_reviews.Description:

Can’t recommend these people enough!

Oh, and there was even a high table so I could do laptop work while waiting!

Only thing was please get rid of the profile pic- I hate taking pics!

My cleaning was amazing and I would highly recommend if you’re looking for a new dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mona T
user_reviews_extended.Description:
One star for the billing department.
I have been a patient at this office for over three years. At some point, the insurance policies they accept appear to have changed, but this was never communicated to me.
In early 2025, after a routine dental cleaning, I received my first bill. I was told my insurance had only covered a portion, but no explanation was provided. I assumed it may have been related to X-rays.
After my next cleaning, I received another bill. When I questioned this—especially since my insurance covers cleanings at 100%—I was again given the same vague response.
I called once more to confirm I had all the necessary information before contacting my insurance, and only then was I informed that the office is not contracted with any insurance providers.
This information should be clearly disclosed before appointments are scheduled. Failing to inform patients of such an important billing detail is misleading and unprofessional. Overall, this experience was very disappointing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Andersson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lifetime Dental has taken great care of our family! Dr. Shiki is a fantastic dentist who always goes out of his way to connect with us and even chats about our shared interests. Our hygienist Shari has been amazing especially with my kids! She takes extra time to make them feel at ease, and she made their first visits such a positive experience. My oldest even told my youngest how fun the dentist is because of her! I couldn’t ask for a better team to take care of our family’s dental health.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Dr. Shiki for a crown and was very pleased with the experience. Both Dr. Shiki and his assistant were friendly, efficient, and very competent. user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to ALD for over 15 years and I cannot recommend them enough.  They literally changed my life. They're always smiling, always accommodating, and they treat you like royalty.  I've worked with every dentist there and they're all fantastic. The front staff work together like a well coordinated team and they cover for each other like they could do it in their sleep.  Let's face it, no one likes going to the dentist but here, they somehow make it a pleasant experience every time.  And my smile has never looked better!
