user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Austin Lifetime Dental for over 20 years they have taken excellent care of me! The staff is amazing! I truly appreciate Dr. O for all the care he has given me in taking care of my teeth. My husband Tobin Cheatam goes here as well. We love our hygienist, Mary! She takes great care of our teeth cleaning. This office is a very calming place. You don't feel anxious and nervous. Everybody from the receptionist, billing dept., hygienist and dentist are so nice, knowledgeable and very caring!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Madera
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have gone to Lifetime Dental for a few weeks in a row to catch up on my dental hygiene. If you are looking for an awesome trustworthy private dental practice with all the same technology as larger corporate dentist, definitely go to Lifetime Dental! Don’t even read the rest of this review, just book it.

Unfortunately, I had an unexpected dental emergency and was looking to get help ASAP. I frantically called the practice early and let them know my situation. Ashley was calm and kind. She quickly set me up with a same day appointment.

I arrived into a chique and cozy waiting room and was greeted warmly by the receptionist. In the waiting room was nice decor and a big tv displaying neat and visually appealing dentist infographics on common dental procedures.

I was fortunate enough to be taken care of by Rebecca and Dr. Caraballo. They were both very kind and careful with all of my procedures. I had quite a it of work to catch up on, which initially made me nervous but they explained all of the procedures and made sure I was getting the treatment I needed and why I needed it. They were serious superstars and one of the main reasons I would return.

My typical dentist experience was the dentist and assistants just kind of go about their business and do not really communicate the process or forget about being careful. That was not the case here. It is clear they were professionals and I was very pleased with their attention to detail and willingness to share. Shoutout to Mary the dental hygenist for being so precise in cleaning without sacrificing being delicate.

The offices are quite close together so I could overhear a few words with other patients and was getting the feeling that mostly if not all the staff are courteous and treat their patients well!

Sometimes understanding billing, insurance, loans, and follow up appointments can be a drag and a little hard to deal with. Not at Lifetime Dental. Samanta made this headache go away. Despite sharing a lot of information, she was really clear and made it super easy to book and plan out my dental procedures.

So not only was it easy to book, a nice and comfortable place with good technology, each and every staff member I had the pleasure of interacting with was incredibly pleasant.

Seriously awesome place, filled with awesome people! Thanks for such a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alena Andryukova
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time here and ALL of the staff were so welcoming and warm. My hygienist and doctor explained everything to me and answered all of my questions. They really made me feel at ease and were so kind and non-judgmental. I felt right at home and am so grateful for such a warm, comfortable dentist office that I feel virtually no anxiety going to. I recommended 100%. 10/10 for me. 🙌🏻💪🏻

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am beyond grateful for what led me to Dr. Shikis team of professional dentistry. The consultation with Sherry was warm and inviting leading into some extensive dental needs performed by Dr. Shiki and his assistant Susie. From the time I walked in the door covering a two week period of exceptional communication exceeding personalized dental care was nothing short of phenomenal. I would without any doubt highly recommend Dr. Shiki and his team. Thank you for restoring my smile in a warm and inviting atmosphere with such demeanor of genuine care and professionalism. See you in six months for my regular maintenance. I will look forward to walking through the front door of this dental practice every time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marion Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t thank Dr. Olivares and Suzanne enough for the incredible care they provided during my mother's recent dental work. They did a fantastic job with her crown and creating a plan of action for her bridge reconstruction. Their calming presence truly helped ease her anxiety, making the experience so much more comfortable for her. Additionally, the front desk staff was incredibly sweet and accommodating, which added to the welcoming atmosphere. We are grateful to have such a wonderful dental team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bich Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lane and Suzanne are my favorite peoples every time I visit Austin dental. Suzanne is always welcome me with a big smile and treat me like family. And Dr. Lane always with care. Any questions and concerns he will give me great advice, and try to help me reduce costs so I can pay for my treatment. Austin dental make me feel very comfortable every time I’m here, and I always leave with a great smile on my face. Thank you Dr. Lane and Suzanne, and all the staffs at Austin dental.😁❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marshall Sales
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can't say enough good things about Dr. Shiki and Susie. From start to finish, they were incredible to work with. I initially came in for some dental work, and thanks to their care and expertise, my teeth now look better than ever. They were always prompt, kind, and extremely professional.

What really stood out was their responsiveness during a dental emergency. They got me in immediately and resolved the issue quickly and effectively. That level of dedication and urgency is rare and deeply appreciated.

Dr. Shiki is truly an artist when it comes to teeth. His attention to detail and skill are unmatched, and Susie’s warmth and support throughout the process made everything smooth and stress-free.

I would confidently recommend them to anyone looking for top-tier dental care. They’re simply the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maverick Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lifetime patient of Austin lifetime dental. Recently had a full dental exam with Suzanne and Dr Hoppy Lane, it's a great experience and they were both very friendly and helped make sure I stayed calm and relaxed during my visit. Would gladly return and refer others to this dentist and assistant.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Renfroe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a broken veneer which Dr Olivares, expertly assisted by Nico, were able to replace in one visit with excellent results

user_reviews_extended.Name: keith ferris
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been dealing with an issue with what appeared to be a tooth infection but needed a good dentist to help me sort out the details. I always take time to learn and understand what I can about any medical issue I’m dealing with so I have a better opportunity to chart a course of progress. I am not a fan of subjecting myself to the process and just hope for the best. My appointment with Dr. Lane and Suzanne was the remedy I was looking for. The time and attention they provided me, with all of my questions and examples, to walk and talk through all the various issues and protect the integrity of my mouth were so incredibly helpful!! The blanks they filled in to help clarify information and outline options to manage or eliminate the problem certainly served me justice. It was readily handled with care and the problem solved. I truly enjoyed and appreciated this dental visit. Thank you for all of your time and support to treat me, Keith.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geri Edens
user_reviews_extended.Description: The only dentist I would go to! My dental tech, Billie, is gentle and friendly and Dr. Lane cares about all of his patient’s too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sally Ma
user_reviews_extended.Description: I started coming to this amazing practice about three years ago after having a not so great experience elsewhere in town. I’ve never had a bad experience here. Everyone is wonderful and they’ve always been super honest about what procedures I actually need and what can be watched/reversed/prevented. Great doctors, amazing techs and friendly patient coordinators. I’ve definitely found my favorite dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Lipari
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love my new veneers! Dr. Lane and Suzanne did an amazing job making my teeth look not only better, but natural as well. 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Mamo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone here is fantastic. From the moment you walk in, Ashley at the front desk makes you feel welcome, and the entire team- Suzanne, Benet, Zanaib and especially Dr. Lane goes out of their way to ensure you are comfortable and well cared for.

Dr. Lane did an exceptional job with my Invisalign treatment. The results turned out even better than I expected, and I couldn’t be happier. He took the time to explain everything to me and made sure I felt confident and supported throughout the process.

f you’re looking for a place where you’re treated like a real person and not just another patient, this is it.!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nico Texas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got my first crown with Dr. Olivares and I still can't believe how fast, how easy and pain free the procedure was. Getting a permanent crown in 2-3 hours with no additional visits is the best. My bite feels perfect, like nothing happened. Thank you Dr. Olivares and Austin Lifetime Dental for your great work and professionalism!

user_reviews_extended.Name: samantha Aviles
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fascinating, easy and most importantly warm. Leo was incredible made me comfortable & explained her treatment before the doctor came in not to mention her warm personality. Dr.Caraballo is very polite and delivers information straight forward.  Mary was also fast and efficient. Overall great dentist client. Clean and welcoming. 10/10.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional staff, always smiling and welcoming. Vincent was very thorough, answered all my questions and left me smiling

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys are awesome! I’ve been coming to Jefferson for a little over a year now and I couldn’t go anywhere else! From the front desk to the doctors, it’s clear that everyone’s top priority is my health, not my money. I highly recommend visiting Jefferson Dental on Lamar.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maddox Hart
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m usually terrified of dentists but this office made me feel calm. Front desk was friendly, didnt make me wait too long. Dr. Kim was really patient and explained everything in simple words. Had 2 cavities filled and barely felt a thing. The assistant was great too, kept me relaxed. Office is clean and smells good, not like other dental places. I liked that they didnt try to upsell me stuff I dont need. Billing was accurate and they took my insurence. I already booked my next cleaning. Glad I found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andres Juarez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
BEST dentist experience I have ever had, by far! All of the staff here is exceptional; friendly, welcoming, supportive, experienced, and all other positive things. I could go on for days!!

Special shout-out to Krysten who was truly a gem, giving me clear and transparent information from the first phone call to the end. She is extremely knowledgeable and patient. She answered every question I had without ducking a single one (not the same experience at other dental offices). She is the best front desk person I’ve ever interacted with!

My procedure was carried out by Dr. Shiki and Zeyna (probably misspelling their names, sorry). They were like Kobe and Shaq in their primes! Working flawlessly together, they made sure I was comfortable and supported while doing an excellent job with the procedure. Both exhibited their vast knowledge, experience, and professionalism all throughout.

Darlenne and Vincent were also amazing in this experience as well!

Just a fantastic place to get dental any and all dental work done. 100/100 for all

user_reviews_extended.Name: Czar Stark
user_reviews_extended.Description: First off Everyone here has good customer service, no doubt about that. Problem starts with strange yet purposeful billing practices. They will say they accept your insurance but will neglect to point out they are out of network. My main issue was their deceptive billing practices, deceptive in a way that they will most certainly overestimate how much the insurance will actually cover in the first quote to reel you into the services. 3 of my friends also visited this place and it’s a theme here with how they bill. In my case less then half was actually covered by insurance. They will say it’s an “Estimate” but be sure it’s an Overestimate. They will avoid charging you the first visit but the bill starts as soon as you walk in. You might think it was part of preventative checkup but the bill has already started, I had 4 appointments here, but I didn’t truly realize what the actual bill was until the end and it was $2000 plus the payments I made every visit. Wouldn’t have done anything at this place if I knew I would be paying close to $3000 out of pocket for cavities and Plaque removal They kept charging reasonable amounts every visit until the very end when they will hit you with the biggest sticker shock, and it is surely done so that you don’t stop treatment in the middle. Be careful with this place. Sure they have great customer service and everyone is kind, but there’s a reason for it, to soften the blow at the end. Make sure you keep the first quote in hand as it will probably change by the end. This place will affirm that dentistry besides Auto Dealerships is the biggest Scam of this country. But hey, as long as they put a smile right.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan A. Bentley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Lifetime has been the best dentist I've ever had in my lifetime. I've been going to them for over 20 years now since moving to Austin. The staff is friendly, always helpful, very understanding to your wants/needs and even your wallet while they seem to go out of their way to make it the best experience possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Holmes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got my wisdom teeth out here (which I was terrified to do) but Rebekah was such a wonderful nurse and made me feel so safe and taken care of, every step of the way. Thank you to Rebekah and Dr.Caraballo for a great job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Solano
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is always very nice to me. They understand that the dentist gives me high anxiety and they make it as relaxing as possible for me. My hygienist Van is always nice to me as well and always gives me helpful tips to improve my dental health .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Nasr
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Fascinating, extra welcoming, and helpful staff and most importantly warm and friendly. I walked in with no appointment, explained what I needed and the staff managed to take me in.
My simple message to the staff & especially to Dr. Shiki and his assistant Zaynab;
Thank you for your kindness and understanding
Thank you for your skill ,lovely smile and for getting me in quickly
Thank you for your dedication and professionalism
Thank you for your exceptional care
This clinic will be without a doubt my family Clinic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tareq Ehinger
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would like to personally thank you Dr. Olivares and his staff member Zaina for doing such an outstanding job on my tooth. Prior to seeing them, I saw two other Dental practices that both seemed to want to just do the same thing, which was a root canal.

I didn't have the best experience at a different Dental office prior to coming to this one. Due to this, I already had anxiety coming in and have always had anxiety with Dentists. Dr. Olivares and Zaina completely proved me wrong, and the process was seamless.

Dr. Olivares not only explained everything with a calming manner but was very educating as well. He was able to find out that a root canal wasn't needed at this time and was able to save the tooth.

He was able to do the job with precision and before I knew it, I was out of his office in no time. Due to this reason, I will be definitely coming back to see him and his staff for all my dental care.

Thank you again Dr. Olivares and Zaina!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carmen Sotillo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
. I recently returned to Austin Dental after being away for a few years, and it felt like coming home. From the moment I walked in, the staff welcomed me with genuine smiles and remembered me like no time had passed. The office is just as high tech, clean, comfortable, and well-run as I remembered. My appointment with Mary and Dr. Olivares was on time, and everything was explained clearly and with care.

I’m so glad I came back—there’s nothing like the trust and comfort you feel with a team who knows you and truly cares about your dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debora B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment I entered Austin’s Dental practice I received the best treatment ever.
I am in my sixties and have been taking excellent care  of my teeth all my life and still, recently learned to my surprise under the care of another practice of some serious issues that needed urgent attention.I contacted Austin Dental and Dr Olivares seeking a second opinion and to re evaluate  the issues that came up.
The staff at the reception desk was very cordial and accommodating.
Ms Suzanne is a register dental nurse and was with me during the all time of the first visit that was more than an hour.She was very professional and has excellent social skills , listening to my concerns and answering my many questions with patience and good care.
Ms Mary did the periodontal panel, again excellent professional and caring person.
Dr Olivares, took all the time to review my issues , with great patience  looked up the first treatment plan I received elsewhere. He explained  all the details of the treatment plan, which were many. I feel that I can trust his judgment and professionalism.I am thankful.
I had a great experience as a patient.
I want to mention also Ms Nico’s h professionalism  and care ; the standard of care  at Austin dental is outstanding.
I recommend these professionals wholeheartedly.

Updating the previous information:  Following the treatment plan, extractions of two molars performed  by Dr Olivares and assisted by Ms Nico, and the post op were excellent. After a few months two crowns on molars were placed and the procedure was excellent as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: KW Morse
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a fantastic experience!  I came in with several issues.  Dr. Shiki and Susie, put my mind at rest, walked me through the procedures and took care of both issues quickly and painlessly.  It was remarkable.  I highly recommend that you visit this office and let Dr. Shiki and Susie take care of the issues you’ve been putting off.  I wish I’d visited sooner!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather White
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today, the dynamic duo (Dr. Shiki and Susie) extracted my broken tooth with minimal pain and discomfort in a very professional, and timely manner! It is evident to me that they actually care and have so much finesse with the needles and tools that the discomfort was overall very minimal! Plus, I have never experienced so much consideration from a dental team, or any doctor for that matter! I can’t thank them enough! I’ll be back…

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devin
user_reviews_extended.Description: All-around amazing! The entire staff is friendly and welcoming. Appointments are on time and move quickly; you don't even have a chance to get antsy waiting around. But with plenty of time for any questions. I went in recently as a new patient after a prolonged time not visiting a dentist. They have eased all of my worries and everyone has been positive and encouraging. I look forward to all my future visits! Thank you to this incredible staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just a very unusual and unpleasant experience.

I was excited to get my teeth checked, only to find out there was an additional catch that was never brought up to me despite having done the research before my visit. During my appointment, I spoke to a higher up(?) who was insanely condescending and calling me a liar. I was just so confused about the attitude here, it just came off as very unprofessional.

So, I did a deeper dive of the place, and found out the person I was talking to was someone named Samantha who basically just treats everyone like this and just belittles them.

I just want to get my teeth checked and cleaned up, but given the way I was treated, if it was something more serious I fear something could easily go wrong had I continued to see this establishment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Grace
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not a great experience. I have severe dental anxiety and experienced a panic attack my first visit. I was asked if I wanted to go over my estimate during this panic attack. Went back again for a follow up about the initial issue and was told pain medication just wouldn’t help me anyways, so keep trying a soft food diet a bit longer. I cannot eat anything without pain. Very disappointed in this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Astarita
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lane and Suzanne were wonderful. I came in with a broken crown and they made me feel so comfortable and at home. I didn’t even feel the Novocain. Suzanne is always so kind. Dr. Lane is very gracious and he is probably the best dentist I have ever seen. And I’ve seen a lot! I know the office will always call me back right away. Also, Samantha in billing is a joy. She made things very easy. I would highly recommend Austin Dental. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiera Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing!! I got my wisdom teeth’s removed here a while ago and it was such an easy experience ! Ashley at the front desk helped me along with others and dr. shiki was amazing! So professional and personable all around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aoife L
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole family sees Dr. Oliveras and he has always been very pragmatic, kind, and does good work. The dental hygienists are very good and efficient - I normally see Mary and she is speedy and tries to keep you comfortable. The office staff are responsive and good at processing insurance. Overall, a well-run practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edmond Siu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am retired and have visited many medical offices, but I must say that Dr.O's team stands out as one of the best I have ever experienced. From the moment I walked in, every member of the team demonstrated the utmost compassion, professionalism, and knowledge. Dr. O is an exceptional leader and is compassionate about providing top-notch care. The dedication and desire to do an excellent job were evident in every interaction I had, from the person I saw to when I left the door. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ivan Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful people and a perfectly cozy environment. Austin Lifetime Dental feel like a dental family that actively care for my dental with the best attitude and spirit. I've always looked forward to seeing everyone there for my appointments! Couldn't recommend anyone else :))

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassandra Arendt
user_reviews_extended.Description: This practice is modern and has "all the toys" but is still welcoming and friendly. I was a little skeptical about the deep cleaning that was recommended after my initial x-rays, but boy did it make a difference. I went from frequently bleeding to zero bleeding when flossing immediately after the treatment, and my gums continue to recover so well. I recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Huel Haynes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a tooth ache for over a week and called in to see if I could have the situation examined.  I was in the office in less than an hour. Awesome! The dentist I was was very professional and asked a lot of questions before explaining what the possible cause and what corrective action needed to be tried! Lots of patient care demonstrated!  Tge best dental team in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Greene
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update to the below. Today I had Benet do the teeth cleaning. She was very nice and I could genuinely tell she cared about how I felt and my experience. I would recommend this place to anyone with dental anxiety (like myself)!

—————-

Dr. Roland is great! He is very thorough, and professional. He was very helpful when I had some very serious pain, and got me referred to an oral surgeon the same day. I come here for all of my regular cleanings as well.

My hygienist is Billie, and she is fantastic! She is SUPER friendly, and always asks me what is going on with my family.

The administrative staff at the front are always nice, and very friendly. Plus, they helped me sign up to get text alerts for when my appointments are coming up, which is a service I love!

I always feel very well taken care of when I come to Austin Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darrin Ezell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been a patient for 10+ yrs. Good service, communication and wonder staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley M
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been nervous about getting my wisdom teeth out for years. Dr. Lane and Zainab made me feel so comfortable and at ease. I truly felt my worries were eased with their comfort and assurance. I highly recommend Austin Lifetime Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent! Highly recommend due to detailed explanations of current and possible future issues, the procedures and costs all out, nothing hidden.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a crown replaced and I received Excellent dental care from Suzanne and Dr. Lane. Both were very kind and informative throughout the whole procedure. At times when I would get a bit anxious, Suzanne helped with her calming voice. Knowing I was in great hands with these two definitely helped ease my anxiety.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Shah
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always love coming to Austin Dental! Benet is an amazing hygienist, always so friendly and she has a very gentle touch. Dr. Amaris Caraballo is always a joy to see. She is very knowledgeable, confident and always takes her time explaining treatment options. She is also very skilled and when I had a filling done the anesthesia was painless and the procedure was completed efficiently. Would recommend Austin Lifetime Dental to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gary Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: The price is far, far too high! I don't put that much faith in the pricy equipment or the degree of education. Folks should stand up to and defy the outrageously high cost of such health care! There's always a better way. It takes someone willing to make the effort to seek it out. We don't have to allow the medical profession to run roughshod over us. It's your money!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eugenio De Hoyos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Flawless experience from booking to checking in to xrays and cleaning!  I first came here about 10 years ago.  Super clean, everyone friendly and reassuring.  They even polished an issue with my retainer.  The sunglasses were sleek.  My dental hygienist today was great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tianna Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was amazing! They made sure I was comfortable and aware getting me in as soon as possible to take care of my needs. They were kind and reassuring the entire time. Thank you for the wonderful service Dr. Lane and assistant Suzanne. Super grateful for you both!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cathy Angell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I highly recommend Dr. Toshiki at Austin Lifetime Dental.

I have great anxiety about dental procedures, and I hadn't seen a dentist in over twenty years. When parts of a very old crown broke off and another very old crown came loose, I began looking for a new dentist. I'm very glad I found Dr. Toshiki and Austin Lifetime Dental.

Dr. Toshiki does excellent work. I appreciated that he was personable and professional, and that he answered all my many questions.

Everyone who worked with me and my teeth at Austin Lifetime Dental was very helpful and professional. I also appreciated the front office staff for being friendly and helpful. Thank you.

Everyone at Austin Lifetime Dental helped this anxious new patient get the information and help she needed. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benjamin Montero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Dental provides a positive dental experience for their patients. The staff was very welcoming and made me feel right at home. My dentist was very informing for my situation, and they gave great next steps for dental care and healthy teeth. I cannot recommend Austin Dental enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariel Miscavage
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super friendly and knowledgeable staff, hygienists, and dentists! The atmosphere is very modern and inviting. The appointments are quick too. From the time I got out of my car to when I got back in, it was only about 35 minutes for a full cleaning. My comfort is always a priority to them, as I’m usually offered water, a pillow, blanket, sunglasses. I highly recommend if you’re shopping for a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabby Marie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Did not inform me over the phone when making the appointment that I would be paying $100+ for an office visit. I did mention to them I do not have insurance and will pay out of pocket. Still nothing was mentioned. At the visit I only talked to the dentist assistant for majority of the time I was there (which was very short) and the dentist only looked at my concerned tooth with a mirror. No X-rays because I had those sent over from a different dentist who just did my crown at another location.
When the financial woman showed me the cost before having them do the procedure I saw $115 for office visit. I asked her ”I have to pay $115 to sit in a chair and chat with the assistant and then just to have the dentist look at my tooth with a mirror?” and with a condescending tone she said “ya thats an exam”. She didn’t try to hear me out or confirm with the front desk that I wasn’t told beforehand that I would be paying that amount. That was her only reply, poor customer service. I’ve been in customer service for years now and she didn’t handle that well at all. I already have a fear of the dentist, on edge and anxious (even have it in my paperwork how anxious I am at the dentist) and again do not have insurance so this can be quite costly for me. I’m upset at not being told the visit price before accepting the appointment wasting everyone’s time and how the financial woman handled giving the estimate with me. My partner handled the financial lady in a separate room because I was not going to sit with someone who had a tone with me like that in a setting where I am extremely overstimulated, I talked with the front desk girls and let them know no one told me beforehand I would be spending that amount which is important information. They said “oh I see why you’re upset” and apologized. I left and didn’t go through with the procedure because of it.
This review is only reflecting on how the staff handled it not the dentist. I saw great reviews about the dentists work on peoples teeth. Aside from the office visit the small cavity needing a filling was $336 so total was $451.
But just make sure to ask about pricing before even sitting in their chair if dental costs is important to you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailey Sklavanitis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very grateful for my dental office! Dr. Shiki and Shari, RDH always make my visits quick and seamless. They genuinely care about their patients and the health of their teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Banks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Paula and I had the same dentist for well over 10 years. When he retired, we began the search for another dental office. Paula’s yoga instructor recommended Austin Dental.  Best recommendation ever!  Paula and I are now patients…so is our youngest daughter. The staff and dentists at Austin Dental are so warm and welcoming…even while they’re drilling a hole in your head😊 my last dentist is a personal friend. If he came out of retirement, don’t think I could ever switch from Austin Dental 😎Nico, Denise and Dr C are the best!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sameer Zadran
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience at Austin Lifetime Dental.The clinic was clean, modern, and well-equipped. Zainab was incredibly friendly, professional, and attentive. Dr. Shiki was thorough and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire process. I highly recommend this dental clinic to anyone looking for excellent care and a warm, welcoming environment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Delgado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have not been to a dentist in a very long time as I have had awful past experiences with my previous dentist. Zainab and Dr.Shicki were both very pleasant and helpful. They helped ease my anxiety and assured me that they would help me receive the best possible treatment within my budget and schedule. The entire atmosphere was nice and everyone is very friendly! I look forward to future visits and will continue to see Austin Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Fleetwood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Huge THANK YOU for the calming support I received from Nico and Dr Olivares during my anxiety moments. I received my first crown and it feels so natural that I already forget it’s there. From the advanced technology, plentiful knowledge and overall kindness, it’s a great office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Twila Waters
user_reviews_extended.Description:
During my visit today,  Dr. Marino was super nice and took extra time to make sure that my night guard fit properly. I love the way he takes time make sure everything is just right.  He has a great sense of humor too.
Today I got my cleaning by Rene.  She was very patient with me.  She didn't mind all of my little time consuming issues and she was really nice.
I highly recommend the entire staff at Austin Dental.  Everyone is always very kind, professional and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben DeLaurier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Top notch. Dr Lane is the best dentist ever. Office staff is excellent. Not all dentist offices are the same, if you've had issues with your dentist or are looking for someone to be your dentist in Austin you just cannot go wrong here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelina Passione
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the most thorough appointments I’ve ever had at the dentist! The whole team at Austin Dental does a great job at making you feel comfortable and ensuring you have a great experience. Dr Shiki is very knowledgeable and professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Meehan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went to the dentist after 20 years and was very terrified and worried that I would feel shamed and would be told that all my teeth would fall out and be told I would have to spend thousands of dollars to fix them but had a really good experience and they get were very patient with me and didn’t make me feel bad about not going for so long and instead helped me plan out how to fix my teeth in the least stressful way as possible.  Everything there is really nice and communicated well with me through all my procedures.  Highly recommend for someone who is scared of the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Lifetime dental is a great place to go if you have anxiety about dental care.  The whole staff is great and really makes you feel comfortable.  A plus is their sedation dentistry!  Dr: Olivares is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Stang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff we're and are polite, obviously knowledgeable, caring, courteous, and take great care of the dental patients that come to their office. They go out of there way to concern themselves with your comfort during your appointment. If one can call going to the dentist a pleasant task, I would definitely recommend using the services offered at this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellie Braden
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very kind staff. I have had dental anxiety and some less than optimal experiences in the past and the staff here made sure to check in with me along the way and even had tools such as stress balls and a weighted blanked available if needed. Do be aware that they have no contracts with insurance companies, but they are very good about going over prices and estimates of what insurance will cover before providing care if you ask.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laneya May
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent customer service easy scheduling and phenomenal product. They were able to accommodate me last minute as a non-existing patient when my retainer broke while I was out of town. The new one fits like a glove. So glad someone recommended Austin Dental to me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. C & Suzanne helped me last year with a dental emergency that occurred over the weekend. By Monday morning before work, they accepted my appointment and fixed me right up. From the receptionist who took my desperate call, to Suzanne and her calming reassurance, to Dr. C who was empathetic and patient… WOW. What a team! I have my own dentist in the central area, but these ladies definitely swooped in during a time I needed assistance the most and made everything better (without judgement). Thank you to this team for allowing me to smile again, literally.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Andersen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Austin Dental for many years now and am always happy to come back. Bender was wonderful today, quick, thorough and informative. Dr Olivares has been overseeing my care for most of my time there,  always kind and efficient. thanks y’all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Gomez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to this place for about 10 years now and I'm never disappointed with their customer service, patient care skills, and professionalism. I absolutely love and appreciate my dental hygienist Mary. She does an amazing job everytime and super knowledgeable. The dentist are all great that I've seen but Dr. Olivares is extremely exceptional. If you need top notch dental care don't hesitate and go see them at Austin Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have a huge fear of the dentist and always get very anxious. I used to cry every time I went to the dentist. Since I've been going to Austin Dental, I've gotten so much better. The staff is incredibly kind and caring through every step of the process. The front desk staff always greets me as if I'm an old friend. I have been seeing Van for teeth cleanings 3X a year and she is careful but thorough. She gives me as many breaks as I need and always remembers details about my life and is gentle. She offers to use different kinds of instruments to make the cleaning go a little more quickly and we've tried a few different methods to see which one works best for me. She also always explains what she's going to do before jumping in so there are no surprises. When I get x-rays, I can see my own x-rays on the screen if I want to; we've been monitoring progress on the start of a very tiny cavity that they've offered to NOT fill as long as it stays as small as it is, which is great for me because of my anxiety. And I can see myself each time the comparison photos -- just very transparent practices & lots of honesty. I've also been able to get affordable prescription flouride toothpaste which has helped keep this cavity the same size for 2 years. Dr. O is also fantastic. He's been guiding me through the cavity conversations -- we were going to fill it, and they even let me bring someone to sit with me for it. I still ended up having a bad a panic attack day-of and Dr. O responded really empathetically and was immediately open to discussing other options. I refer everyone I know to this practice and at this point I literally wouldn't trust my teeth to anyone else. The billing department is also super nice and patient and helpful in walking through coverage and payment options -- very clear communication and I never feel like I'm hit with surprise bills. Austin Dental is truly a gem.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to Austin Dental for 7 years. Highly recommend. Always on time, easy to make an appointment and do not try to push procedures on me that I don't need. Shout out to Dr. Lane and Billi for keeping my teeth and gums healthy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaira Poole
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this dental office! I had extensive work done as a new patient, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with Zeinab, Rebecca, Katie, Samantha, and, of course, Dr. Caraballo! I would recommend this office to any and all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bacille Lana
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife was previously treated by Dr Shiki here at Austin Dental. She shared to me her good experience. Upon hearing the kindness and professionalism of the staff, I immediately requested for my 1st periodontal. I saw for myself their consistent outstanding dental services. On top of that, the office/clinic is very clean and well-maintained. Also, shout out to Cristin Kinn, my hygienist! You rock! I would definitely recommend Austin Dental in Parmer Lane to everyone I know.🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew X
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shiki and Susie were great! After losing a front tooth, Dr Shiki explained the process, the time frame, the work involved and within a few days he installed the implant. I was impressed with the lack of pain invloved. They made a temporary prosthesis and in a couple of months --- a new tooth! I am very grateful to both Dr. Shiki and Susie. I rate them an A+

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evelyn A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. The dental hygienist Violeta was awesome and super knowledgeable!  She did a great job and made me feel at ease during the entire process. The Dr. is very professional, friendly, and clearly cares for his patients. I live pretty far from Austin Dental but I am willing to make the drive because they are that good. Billing is very transparent and I know it may not matter much but love the layout of facing the window when you are on the chair. It’s pretty calming which is a plus. Highly highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Timothy Chittim
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Caraballo and her assistant Rebekah , excellent
Service, and their personal connection with the patient is extremely important, they made me feel very comfortable and confident that I was going to be okay, Thank you both for the professional support, 10 star review

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis Morgan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Without a doubt, the best dental office in Austin. I have tried 5 other dentists in recent years in Austin and this is so is far the best. I am giving them a 5 star rating based on their honesty, cleanliness, and quality of service. Sw*sh dental and 12 O*ks both suggested that I needed over 6k in dental work. Austin Dental examined my teeth and determined that there were no urgent issues that needed attention. I am rating them with high quality because their dental assistant, hygienist, and dentist each spent considerable time with me during the exam and cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Khanna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best cleanings ever for my 7yo and 4yo boys. Even better than pediatric specialty dentists we have tried in the past. Ask for Reena the hygienist. She put my older son at ease, she was very patient, and accommodated for his taste and mouth issues. I’m only ever taking my kids here from now on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Immy C.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was recommended to go to Austin Dental by a friend, and since they do take my insurance, I figured I would see why they rave about this clinic/office.

Since my first visit, I’ve always enjoyed my visits at Austin Dental. The staff is wonderful, prompt, and professional. The clinic is extremely clean, and every service is top notch. Benet is my favorite dental hygienist and I leave satisfied with my smile every appointment.

If you’re looking for long-term dental care, I’d highly recommend Austin Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shaida Yacoub
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin dental has been great! There is almost no wait time and they really care about your dental health. Dr. Lane is an excellent orthodontist. Suzanne is really sweet and professional. I enjoy doing my oral cleaning with Heather. She is the best :-) I highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: aime polivka
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Dental is awesome.  Their technology seems really up to date, they have equipment that makes the visits as fast and as comfortable as possible. They do a really good job and are happy explain what’s going on to me. I saw Dr. Lane and Suzanne today and it was a pleasure. A good dentist is a beautiful thing really, I recommend this place to people all the time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darrick Belle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have extreme anxiety when it comes to my teeth, and I absolutely dread the dentist office however, Rebecca made me feel quite at ease with her humor. She was extremely helpful and knowledgeable with what I had going on. Can’t wait to go back. Thank you

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Terry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at this office. My hygienist, Mary, was amazing. I was nervous and she helped me by just chatting while also being very thorough and knowledgeable. The dentist, Dr. Caraballo was very kind and thorough as well. I'll definitely be coming back. Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Ellsworth
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lane and Suzanne provided dental work for me at reduced cost for no reason other than just being extraordinarily compassionate people. Besides this act of kindness, I’ve gone to Austin Dental for 2 decades and have never had a poor experience with any doctor or staff member. The people here are truly incredible and professional, and certainly will cater to your needs at the best of their ability. Come here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gracie Fitch
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I have been with Austin Lifetime Dental for years and every time we go, they never disappoint! I had a mild emergency with a molar and they were able to fit me in. The dental assistant was super nice and very informative in what the appointment entailed.  Dr. Olivares is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nelson Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was beyond accommodating, friendly and professional.  From the joking and training support of each other at the front desk to dental assistant and her super friendly attitude, my visit was truly the best dental visit and experience to date.  They were all truly inviting.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Román
user_reviews_extended.Description: Big thanks to the entire team at north Austin Dental! The environment is great, and the staff provides excellent service to their clients. They always make sure you leave with a big smile, and sometimes even go the extra mile by helping you find your next trail hiking adventure : )

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Molina
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The crew at Austin Dental are fantastic on every level.  The receptionist, Diana, is absolutely phenomenal!  Her kindness and wonderful demeanor made me feel very comfortable and her friendliness assured me that I made the right choice in Austin Dental.   Denise, the hygienist, is also very accommodating, friendly and she made me feel at home. Her temperament put me at ease immediately. Dr. Marino also should also be mentioned for his kindness, professionalism and for his knowledge in the dental field.   I am extremely happy and I am more than satisfied with the care and service that I experienced. Never have I felt so at ease in a dentist's office.  The Austin Dental group is second to none.
Thanks!
Mike Molina

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaitlyn Magnuson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience here for my initial visit and cleaning. Everyone was exceptionally professional and kind. I really appreciated the time Dr. Olivares spent reviewing my x-rays and treatments, without any pressure. My hygienist, Benet, was also very personable and made sure I was comfortable. I'll be recommending to friends and family. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa S
user_reviews_extended.Description: > I was nervous because I hadn't had an appointment in a while, but my hygienist used a numbing gel on my gums. She was very gentle and didn't hurt me at all. Everyone was nice and friendly. They did a superb job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dale Lankford
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn't been to the dentist in over 30 years until I had to yesterday for severe tooth pain. I had known about Austin Dental when my son used them many years ago so I called them and they got me in right away! Everyone was so friendly and the office was very clean. I was very nervous about the visit but everyone made me feel comfortable and relaxed. Dr. Lane and Suzanne took very good care of me and pulled my cracked wisdom tooth. I have already made plans for them to do more work on me in a few weeks. I highly recommend Austin Dental for all your dental needs!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: samuelriley2
user_reviews_extended.Description: So far so good! First, Dr. Marino is a very nice guy. He is laid back and relaxed. He explained a lot more than I am used to hearing. He even told me what he was doing during the procedure. The whole team has been nice and friendly...all to make me feel comfortable. I was nervous about finding a new dentist since my previous dentist was pretty good. But, the reviews were true about Austin Dental. Check them out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt McCaslin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to Austin Dental for many years. Very nice and professional staff. Dr. Roland has taken great care of all the dental issues I have had and I have been very please with results! Thanks guys!!

Update 2018: Still a patient and I am very happy with all the services I receive at Austin Dental. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dr Dory Byrne
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been getting my implant preparation done with Austin Lifetime Dental. Last week,  Dr. Lane put the seating in, the one that stays in three months before you screw in the final crown implant. I just had to post because my dad was a dental surgeon - I was his chair side assistant for years in my teens and recognize precision and expertise when I see it. So I have immense gratitude for the accuracy of Dr. Lane’s work! He does such a great job giving the numbing shot, he does this thing where he wiggles your cheek meanwhile one of his professional staff, Suzanne, was holding my other hand to distract me. I have to admit… I took Tylenol and Advil as the pain block was wearing off the 1st night and did not need even a second dose… I am grateful; I just HAD to post!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly S
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was so nervous going in because it had been years since I had had dental insurance but left feeling excited and relieved. Reena & Dr. Marino were super nice and helpful, they made me feel comfortable and helped ease any anxieties I had about going to the dentist. Very happy I chose Austin Dental! 🦷🪥

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robin Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m new to town and was looking for my new (dental) home. Both my Hygienist, Reena, and Dentist were super friendly and knowledgeable. I appreciate their pragmatic, conservative, approach to care - they were honest and didn’t try to add services I didn’t need. Instead, they recommended at home solutions that are totally manageable for me. I felt welcomed and comfortable in their bright (and clean!) office. I’ll definitely return.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabiha Bandali
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always, the Austin Dental staff is amazing! From check-in to check-out, the service is professional, compassionate and excellent in every way. Dr. Olivarez is a wonderful doctor and his team is just as great. Special shout out to Billi and Sam! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana Hamdi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lane and his staff at Austin Dental are exceptional.  Dr. Lane's dental assistant is very sweet and easy to talk to when having work done. Heather is the most kind and patient dental hygienist that I ever met in my life. She cleans my teeth so well that I actually look forward to my check-ups and I try to floss more often! The woman at the front desk who schedules appointments is very sweet, too. She is especially helpful when trying to find a convenient appointment time. I recommend Austin Dental for anyone looking for an exceptional, professional, and caring dental practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve always considered myself lucky that I’ve encountered fantastic healthcare practitioners. Yet, Austin Dental has managed to set a new standard in care. From setting up my initial appointment with the front desk to discussing my treatment plan with Samantha, every individual involved in this journey has been both warm and professional. Dr. Lane inspires confidence like few other dentists have, while his assistant Suzanne sets one at ease with her effortless charm. I simply cannot imagine venturing elsewhere for my dental care needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Craig
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place always make you feel like home !
Every one is so nice and welcoming and if you’re a big baby like me going to dentist has always scared me but since I started coming
I almost fall asleep while I’m getting my teeth cleaned ….. recommend 10 times over !!!
Dr lane and his staff are the best of the best of the best ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monika Pitka
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely loved how hospitable this dentists office is! Cristina is incredible with her patients and so informative and knowledgeable! Samantha was a huge help in setting me up for future appointments as well! Definitely a well deserved five stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Strawn
user_reviews_extended.Description: This procedure for my root canal was awesome! They made sure I was numb and made sure I didn’t feel anything! Dr O was amazing! I’ve found my new home for my teeth! Mrs Nico the dental assistant was very nice and professional! She was really concerned about my pain I was experiencing! They got me in the same day!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kay Ghahremani
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dental practice in Austin. I’ve been seeing Dr. Lane for over 20 years. He is very skilled and ethical, and always cautious about recommending treatment unless you really need it. I’ve had some long-term dental issues that have required numerous visits over the past few years, but Dr. Lane and the staff at Austin Dental never give up on me. The staff are very knowledgeable and customer service oriented. They’ve worked together for years, and are a great team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kevin brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff! My 7 year old was in for a complex filling and he had never had any work done before. Suzanna took exceptional care to make him and myself comfortable and informed. Dr. Lane is a great doctor and I will continue to recommend him and Austin Dental in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geri Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Austin Dental since 2000.  I lived in Houston for a year but refused to go anywhere else so I made the drive to Austin for my biannual dental work.  My visits to Austin Dental are always pleasant from the moment I walk in the door.  The office staff is friendly and efficient.  Billie has been my dental hygienist for many years.  She is the best hygienist.  There is no discomfort and she as very thorough.  Additionally, she is absolutely kind and personable.   Dr. Willis is also very good.  I've had filling and crown work done with her and am always pleased with recovery and outcome.  I will continue to visit Austin Dental and always recommend them to friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: So I haven't been to the dentist in about 6 years so had no idea what to expect. The staff at Austin Dental have been so helpful getting my teeth back on track! The staff is super nice and I feel like I'm being taking care of. If you are looking for a dentist I would highly recommend here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica VanDyck
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every time I'm there everyone is always super nice and friendly! Amber has done my cleanings the last few times and she is great! I also had a cavity filled by Suzanne and Dr. Layne today and they made the whole process quick and painless. I would definitely recommend them- I am always pleased with my visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tia Gunn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just Amazing! Finally “Real” genuine customer service at Austin Dental! After all my experiences this place is Simply One of A Kind. Especially 5 stars to Dr. Olivares. He was so welcoming and caring, made sure I was comfortable after my four extractions Plus didn’t bother turning me away after my billing issue. Thanks so much Austin Dental. You guys Rock!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John D Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wish all my appointments were as ON TIME to the minute as my dental visits are. The service is great and thorough. And the staff is always friendly, professional, and skillful. My Dental Hygienist (Lindsay) - did a first  first rate job.

Amended.   Today’s checkup and cleaning with Violet - Dental hygienist. She was terrific too.   What a team.  Great job and service. Super thorough and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darlene DeVito
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Dental has been my dental home for over 9 yrs. I am a high anxiety person. My dental experience in the past has been traumatic growing up. My smile is very important to me.  I feel confident and relaxed  with Dr. Lane and Suzanne. I don’t feel judged or uncomfortable. 1 time I had to use nitrous. The 😀 gas! No more. I’ve  had to get new crowns this year. I love 💕 you leave with a permanent crown,  same day My schedule doesn’t allow for multiple visits.  My loved ones come to Austin Dental. They are truly our dental home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lymari Arzola
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at this office is ridiculously nice and helpful. From the receptionists to Dr. Willis, the staff is professional and made me feel comfortable from day one. I used to have dental anxiety, but after my visit at Austin Dental I can schedule my appointments regularly and worry-free. You can opt to get text reminders for your appointments and/or phone calls too. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality oral health care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Stanley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing!  Entirely professional. It was as though I'd never been to a real dentist office before. From start to finish,my visit was smooth and enlightening. I received the most thorough cleaning,  x-ray work and general poking and prodding that I have ever  experienced. Austin Dental is not cheap, but I feel that I certainly got my money's worth. And they are nice people

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ronnie Coronado
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience is one I wouldn't change. The staff at Austin Dental were very helpful and walked me through every step from procedure to payment. The ladies at the front desk were very sweet and made sure  my wife was comfortable while waiting for me. What can I say about Dr. Thomas Roland and his assistant Shay? Awesomeness! Shay was very sweet and put me at ease through every procedure and made sure I was okay. Dr. Roland took his time explaining each procedure, pros and cons. Was honest about what I needed done and what it would take to get my teeth to where they need to be. I have so much confidence and no longer ashamed to smile.

Thank you Austin Dental for giving me my smile back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Gelesko
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've never been one to enjoy the dentist, not sure really anyone does. However Austin Dental has been by far the most professional, clean, and kind dentist office I've ever been to. Dr Willis is super gentle and communicative throughout your visit, so you're never left feeling like your just a mouth being worked on. The front desk staff and assistants are top notch. I highly recommend Austin Dental for any service needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brianna Hinzo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Dental is Incredible! They made me feel like family from the time I walked in till the time I left.  The doctor was very good at explaining everything I needed done and how he was going to do it. The whole experience was top notch. I'm sad my new insurance isn't accepted there because I really want to go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dave Runion
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here for years and it has always been a pleasure to get my teeth checked here. Staff is very knowledgeable and friendly and take their time to talk with you about any concerns. Lindsay has been the one cleaning my teeth and she has been fantastic and does a great job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristóbal Almanza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Austin Dental for 8 years and have loved my experience with them. The staff is all very friendly and helpful. The dentists have all been very good to me through all kinds of treatments and have never made me feel like I should go somewhere else. I recommend them to all my friends in the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Zanders
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been serviced by Austin Dental for approximately twenty-two years. My daughter has also been serviced by this staff since she was a young child. I feel at home, comfortable, and well taken care of. The service has been consistent: courteous, hospitable, professional, caring, and flexible.  The staff is very knowledgeable, welcoming and follow up on making sure one gets his service done to maintain healthy teeth. This has been the best dental company in which I have had.  I highly recommend this company and always recommend it to persons who are looking for a dentist.  If you are looking for excellent dental care, this is the one to select.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynett Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Yesterday Dr. Lane and Suzanne filled several teeth for me, then Lindsay completed my plan with the cleaning; Diana topped it off with a much needed prayer...actually that's how my appointment began..with prayer. This place is utterly amazing. They are concerned with the WHOLE person. As a Nurse, I love that they report off to the next person who sees you. The staff is warm, kind, caring and extremely professional. This is not just a dental office, this is our Dental family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raul Machado
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Olivares and Mary provided an excellent experience. I have been coming here for years and they always take good care of my teeth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Austin Dental is amazing! I had my first appointment there today, and was highly impressed! I went in for a loose crown, and felt I was in great hands with Dr Lane!

Also, I cant say enough about Nico....she is great!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brent Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really enjoyed my first visit to this dentist office.  Very friendly and knowledgeable staff all around. The hygienist and dentist answered all my questions and seemed very thorough. The lady at checkout seemed to be aware of my obscure insurance plan and had great info about maximizing my benefits.  I recommend them if you are looking for a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny Luu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient with Austin Dental for about 20 years now. Dr. Willis, Susie, and Mary are so nice, professional, and courteous, as well as the sweet and helpful staff in the front. Always take good care of me every time. A few weeks ago, I had a tooth pain and they were able to fit me in within such a short notice with Dr. Marino since Dr. Willis was off that day. After the examination, I needed a specialist. They helped me to locate and even called around to find the earliest appointment for me, which they did. Thank you all!!! Very very pleased.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scottie Casey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first visit at Austin Dental today and had a great experience.  Had some prior unpleasant visits with other dentist but today made up for all of the bad ones.  Everyone was so friendly and compassionate.  I wish I had found Austin Dental sooner!  A special thanks to Denise for lowering my anxiety about my visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie Jannette Orozco
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best experience ever at this up-beat and positive dentistry.

Diana in the front desk is well-mannered, positive and highly proactive. My dental hygienist, Billi, and dentist, Dr. Lane, are wonderful folks and are highly competent in their roles.

I’m posting this review solely because of my wonderful experience here. I’ll be back in six months! 🦷

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony Nguyen_10
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a patient of Austin Dental for a few years. I first went to Austin Dental because I had issues with one of my molars. I had visited other dentists and none could propose a solution without removing the molar.

I met with Dr Lane, at Austin Dental, who said it was possible to save the molar. I think the difference was that Dr Lane is actually certified in dental surgery (his licensing and certification is on the wall).

It was a successful procedure and he was able to save the molar. That was several years ago. Dr Lane is a great dentist and dental surgeon who can solve tough problems with creative solutions.

I still go do Austin Dental for teeth cleaning and regular maintenance. The entire team is awesome, from the front desk and support teams to the dental staff, everyone is great.

I also have to give a shout out to Dr Lane’s dental assistant, Suzanne. She’s very professional, friendly, and informative. Suzanne is awesome.

I highly recommend Austin Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TheMrTslab
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Dental is very punctual. There was no waiting and reading magazines.  The assistant, Suzanne, made me feel at ease and explained what Dr. Lane was going to do to my teeth. Dr. Lane is so cool and confident, you know it's going to go well. And it did.                                     Sam, at the front desk, checked me out.  She is professional  but very personable and sweet.  The whole dental experience made  me want to give them a tip, but I didn't.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry C
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is always so pleasant and happy. I enjoy my visits as much as one can while having your teeth cleaned. The atmosphere is comfortable and welcoming.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rylie Harrod
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had Gum therapy treatment done this morning with Lindsay - I was hesitant and a little nervous about the process this morning thinking it would be really painful, but was pleasantly surprised at how easy of a process it was and how well the numbing gel worked!
Lindsay went back in a few times after double checking the xrays to make sure that I left with my teeth and gums in the absolute best shape possible, she was amazing and did a fabulous job. Really pleased with my experience this morning!!

- Follow up - My followup appointment with Lindsay was great - my gums have already improved and she gave me great tips for furthering my progress towards even healthier gums. My recent experiences at Austin Dental have really made my hesitation towards going to the dentist improve tremendously!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pam Shellenberger
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a part of this family for over 17 years.  From major dental work, to routine cleanings, to dental emergencies, they have been there for me. All of the hygienist's are gentle and friendly.

I've trusted them all with my three children their whole lives.  The office staff has always been very accommodating when scheduling the four of us.

I highly recommend Austin Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis Milne
user_reviews_extended.Description: After over 35 years there, I move from Dallas to Austin. I loved my dentist in Dallas and actually drove between Dallas and Austin to stay with him as I was having implants. I asked my Dallas dentist if he recommended anyone in Austin who equaled his standards and customer service, and immediately it was Dr. Hoppy Lane at Austin Dental. I had my first visit recently due to an infected tooth. Great experience! Everyone is so friendly, so customer service oriented and now that I'm paying out-of-pocket since I'm on Medicare...I thought the prices are very reasonable. I'm so happy to find such a good dentist and staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Malinda Baca-Price
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been coming to this office for over 20 years now. My kids have been coming here since their first dental visits. It is by far the most pleasant office of any kind we visit!  It  is professional, well staffed, friendly and consistent.

Recently I had an after hours emergency and Samantha, Dr. Lane, and assistant (I'm sorry that I can't remember her name. I was a bit traumatized coming in) treated me like it was just regular hours. Words can't begin to express how amazing they were as was my experience. I don't usually write reviews nor do I recommend anything or anyone with such confidence as I do this dental office. Austin Dental is amazing and feels like a wonderful family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia Olivares
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here since i was a baby because my dad is Dr. Olivares! Every year i consistently see the same familiar faces which is a testament to how passionate this community is for their job. I know my dad loves every minute of his job and really values his patients and how they feel before, during, and after their appointments. I’ve referred multiple friends here and they can attest!

user_reviews_extended.Name: C. Weaver
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Caraballo is awesome. I’ve been looking for a great dentist here in Austin for years, and she is it. I feel completely at ease in her presence and trust her expertise. Throughout my appointments, I even find myself laughing with her and the dental assistant. Normally I’m a pretty squirmy patient during a teeth cleaning, but not here. :-) I am impressed by Dr. Caraballo and the very friendly, welcoming staff of Austin Dental North. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Allgood
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at Austin Dental for close to ten years now. I’ve had countless cleanings, orthodontic work and a couple of crowns. I’ve seen several hygienists and a few dentists at this practice and have always felt the level of care was wonderful. Dr. Lane is my regular dentist, and he is fantastic! He is very thorough without sounding the alarm for unnecessary treatments. I always enjoy visiting with him, his team and the rest of the staff when I’m there.  Highly recommend Austin Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda O.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Olivares and his staff are amazing! Went in for a quick question and maybe set up and appointment for a second opinion. They were able to squeeze me in and see me within minutes. Not saying that this happens all the time, but the fact that they were willing to take me in for a quick consultation was great. I felt at ease and didn't feel overwhelmed by questions (insurance or personal). I was able to set up my appointment and I will definitely be coming back in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Hart
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Austin dental for over a year now  and they always do an amazing job! Violeta cleaned my teeth today. She is the sweetest! The staff is great and the prices are reasonable. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sepy Hahn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My front veneer fell out the previous evening. I called in early the next morning and Alissa (?) was able to schedule me in for 8:30.
Dr Caraballo came in and fixed the issue in no time. The care was absolutely brilliant!!!
Thank you!!!! You guys have always been there for me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: JOC
user_reviews_extended.Description: We LOVE Austin Dental.  ALL of the staff is sweet and professional.  We love all the dentists and have had an excellent experience. We have taken our four year old daughter to them as well.  Unfortunately, we no longer go to them due to issues with our insurance (so so sad!).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenedi Doucet
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Caraballo and Shari did a wonderful job with my teeth today. They are so kind and made going to the dentist fun! Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Albert Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr C & Rebekah we're absolutely wonderful. The dental work I had done was outstanding. I highly recommend this place for all your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: D ImsuchaG
user_reviews_extended.Description: My hygienist Violeta did an amazing job! She made sure that I was comfortable &  addressed all of my concerns throughout the cleaning. For example, I was having gum sensitivity so she adjusted the water temperature while cleaning and rinsing(big deal for anyone with sensitive gums!). My mouth felt so clean I didn't want to eat for the rest of the day!! She was professional and had a pleasant demeanor that made me feel welcome. user_reviews_extended.Name: Tera Collins
user_reviews_extended.Description:

Austin Dental has been my dental care providers across many stages of my life span, and I’m looking forward to them seeing me through many more years of care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Slevin

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nevaeh

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amarah Shakil
user_reviews_extended.Description: After a long time of searching for a good dental place and great and caring team of dentists, I found Austin Dental! I love how they truly care about your needs and want to help you. I love, love Violeta! My second time going to her and won’t be the last. I hadn’t been to a dentist in over 10 years.I neglect smiling with teeth showing !
