user_reviews_extended.Name: Helena Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went in with an idea of what I needed done. I even said so before I arrived.
I also had gotten X-rays thorough X-rays a year before. I was happy with the woman who took care of looking at my problem, but the price quote they gave me was outrageous. And they took a long time quoting me. The lady that quoted the price Sam was her name I think even said. Let me see if there’s anything I can do to get that down but not even a minute later said nope there’s nothing I can do
I was made also to sign every price quote. It made me sad because I feel like I wasted a lot of time and money on my day off. And I know that dentist office is great with the work they do. I just felt like just another number to them and they just seemed very corporate. I will most likely not be back.
The last Dentist I had before this last time was Dr O and I wasn’t even offered the chance to see him this time around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Louis koob
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at the office is friendly and professional. Since my first "accidental" visit , they have been so helpful and accommodating.  I changed to Austin dental because they treat their patients woth respect.  My family has also changed dentists to Austin dental. And hey, Mary is always awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Savina
user_reviews_extended.Description: It's always a pleasure to visit and speak with the staff at Austin Dental. They are very willing to listen and talk thru any decisions to be made concerning your care. I never feel rushed and always leave feeling better about anything discussed. I've been coming here many years and will continue to come here.  Thank You Austin Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pedro Limon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a pleasure to visit Austin Lifetime Dental. I've been with them since 1989 and they always make my visits comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Rohm
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been a patient at Austin Dental for the past 5+ years and have greatly appreciated the quality of the dental care I've had there. At my first visit, they diagnosed 4 cavities but understood my previous dentist had previously adopted a 'wait and see' prognosis and allowed that approach for three of the four cavities. The one that was filled immediately was done so quickly and with care - I love how fast Dr. Olivares works without sacrificing any of the quality.  Fast forward to 5 years later when I finally acquiesced and had the final two of the four cavities filled. The cavities were on opposite sides of my bottom jaw, and I was nervous about having my entire jaw numb. Dr. O listened to my concerns and suggested using a localized injection near the tooth as opposed to numbing the entire jaw. While there was a bit more sensitivity than normal, it was completely preferable to the alternative, and I'm so grateful they willingly worked with me on all accounts.

There are a few items worth mentioning to balance the review. Ideally, most of your time as a patient here will be spent in routine cleanings with the hygienists, and they have a pretty frequent turnover. I rarely see the same person twice, and I go for cleanings on a regular six month interval. The only other thing I would like to see improved is that the building and exam rooms are a bit older. Waiting room chairs look nice but do not feel nice to sit in. And occasionally they will run 10 mins or so late on 30 min cleanings. Finally, I've been asked to write a review for them at every appointment for the last few years. First it was the receptionist, then the hygienist then today, Dr. O requested one himself. I realize it's an accepted business practice, but it's just not typically at the top of my list unless I've had an really outstanding experience, which this is in certain aspects.

Overall, I would highly recommend Austin Dental based on the quality of dental care (especially for fillings and more extensive work) but amenities are a bit lacking.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Manning
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit to Austin Dental on Wednesday was very satisfying.  Staff is very friendly and  I am delighted with my new front crown.  When I pointed it out to a lady at work she wanted  to know the name of my dentist.  I believe she will look into becoming a patient of Austin Dental.  I am a long time patient of Dr. Roland--he is the best! Thanks, Shay, for assisting the doctor so ably.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Mills
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was my first visit and I have to say I was very pleased from the moment I walked in.  The office staff is very friendly and efficient.  They hand you an iPad to fill out the paperwork, which was great because it seemed to go so much faster!  Plus most of the information they already knew was pre-populated on the electronic forms.

I think I was the first appointment for the day, but I got right in to see the dental hygienist, Van.  She was extremely friendly, professional and put me at ease.  She was good to explain everything we were doing, without the information overload.  She was gentle and despite the whole process of X-rays, poking, prodding and cleaning over an hour-and-a-half, it was a pleasant experience.

I also met with the dentist, Hoppy Lane.  He was friendly, personable and I definitely got the sense he knew what he was doing.  He did a great job of explaining the X-rays to me as well as another issue I was concerned about.  Plus it is always nice to hear you are doing a great job, even though you know your routine could use improvement.

The billing/follow-up appointment staff was also nice and professional.  I was able to settle my bill and schedule a follow-up appointment within just a few minutes.

All in all, a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audra Kelley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I trust Austin Dental for my family’s dentistry needs. Their staff is friendly, courteous, and professional. Our middle child is autistic and nervous when visiting the dentist. They explained all procedures to him and were very patient with all of his questions. I highly recommend Austin Dental for your family too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terry Sortevik
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Without a doubt, the best dental experience I’ve had ever. (60+ yrs) You read these types of statements regularly, but if you’re looking for the best, you truly need not search any further.

From the front desk to every dentist, this team is the most customer focused I’ve ever seen with incredible attention to detail while using the latest technology. What it boils down too, I trust them. We won’t be using anyone else but Austin Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Lemke
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is an exceptional dental office.  It's taken me many trials and failures in other offices to finally find a dentist and staff and front office that have the professionalism and expertise to make me feel comfortable and satisfied.  They have the latest equipment and  procedures to assess dental problems, and were able to develop a very effective plan and timeline for me.  I recommend Austin Dental to anyone.  All of the staff are friendly and helpful, and that takes the anxiety out of the experience. They also have a wonderful introductory offer to get you on your way to oral health.   Whether your needs are simple or complex, this is the best place to get a beautiful smile! Thank you Austin Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wendy D
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to Austin Dental for about 6 years and Heather and Dr. Roland have always been very friendly and professional, as well as the office staff. Even after moving farther away, I continue to see them to keep my smile bright and healthy! Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff. Diana was very kind at the front office. Melanie was great with making the whole X-ray and tooth check experience painless. Dr. Olivares was incredibly informative and never made the visit feel rushed. I'm pleased to have found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammie Halfacer
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my 2nd time writing a 5 star review for Austin Dental because every single time I leave their office I’m in awe of how amazing they are! user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Hendricks
user_reviews_extended.Description: The experience and facility was nice. Doctor Jordan and Ashley were really nice and helpful. However I didn’t really appreciate or understand why I paid $142.00 for an 2 min procedure. I was there a total of 15minutes and paid that price. I had a permanent retainer bracket, just the bracket to be removed. (Took 20 seconds) and a polish on my lower side, that I also didn’t wanna do but Jordan said it was her gift to me. (45 seconds to polish) they claimed it was an emergency visit when I questioned the price because when I called a day ago 5/18/20 I was told if it was quick it could be considered a complimentary visit if I were to come back for a cleaning. I brought that up and it was turned down. I wasn’t bleeding or in pain at all. My tongue just brushed against the metal at most, I didn’t expect not to pay anything or accept a free visit. But a $142.00 is just highway robbery and unfair for the situation I was in. I would of came back for a cleaning since I’m due for one and my normal dentist is closed but I just don’t wanna get robbed again and have to accept it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carissa Sterling
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved it! I’m 23 and will admit that I had never been to the dentist before.... That being said, these guys were so amazing! user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Hagen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have a fabulous experience everytime I go to Austin's dental.  I told Billie today that she is the gentlest hygienist that has ever worked on me...ever.  And I never feel like I'm getting lectured about dental health.  Dr. Lane is pleasant, professional, and calm.  I plan to stay here for my dental care indefinitely.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael B
user_reviews_extended.Description: While I can't say I enjoy going to the dentist, I can say that Austin Dental has been the best dental-related experience I have had. They are always professional and friendly, they get you in on time and get you out relatively quickly. Very smooth operations!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Chau Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Dr. Lane for over 15 years, and he is the best dentist that I have ever had. The staff is top notch, and they are always on time. Thank you Austin Dental for making dental visits a wonderful experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Wells
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been going to Austin Dental for nearly 2 decades, and love all of the doctors & hygienists there! They are always friendly, professional, and respectful of our time. We highly recommend them to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krendon Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Austin Dental has the best staff to care for your teeth! I have been going to them for over seven years (I am 26) and in that time I have gotten a top and bottom permanent retainer, had my wisdom teeth removed, several Invisalign retainers made (I lost one to the dog and another to the dryer),  many semi-annual check-ups and cleanings, and a couple fillings.

Having my wisdom teeth taken out was something that I knew would be difficult going in since I have vasovagal syncope which causes me to overreact to certain triggers and faint; in this case lidocaine syringes. I had one near episode through no fault of Dr. Olivares (these episodes are hard to predict). He and Suzanne did everything they could to make me comfortable as my body calmed down such as escorting me to the bathroom to put some water on my face. As often happens at my appointments with Austin Dental, I was impressed.

Through all of that, Dr. Lane, Dr. Olivares, Suzanne, Diana, and Lindsay, as well the hygienists have been more professional and kinder than I could ever have expected. Despite myself not being the best at handling the more involved procedures, I always look forward to coming in to see how my teeth are doing and correct what could be improved upon. The front desk staff make scheduling appointments super easy and I am always called back promptly and on-time. Text and email appointment reminders and easy billing tops everything off.

Your teeth are in excellent hands and yes, I have a GREAT smile thanks to these people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jocelyn Bixler
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have used Dr. Willis and the other doctors at Austin Dental for over 20 years now.  We started going because my kids were very small, and Dr. Willis was the only doctor they were not afraid of .   In addition to routine check ups  and tooth extractions, Dr Willis has made my front for teeth look incredible with bonding and has done veneers on my son and my husband for various reasons. Not only is she a dentist, but also a "dental artist" and if you are afraid of dental pain, I highly recommend all of the dentist here. They are gentle and sympathetic  too nervous patients and the dental hygienist are as well. Both of my kids are now grown, but we continue to travel from the Dripping Springs area because Austin Dental  is worth it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kari Andreev
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experiences here. They do endodontic care in house which is nice.  Their billing department is compassionate and provides lots of options, which is important given the fact that dental insurance is never really that great.  The staff is kind and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dean Glenesk
user_reviews_extended.Description: From a 15+ year patient and household that has seen me, my wife and 3 kids from very young until off to college, I fully recommend Austin Dental. While we have been treated very well by Dr. Roland and Lane, I've recommended friends that have been have all good things to say about Dr. Lane and Olivares as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Mathias

Denny "DJ" Joe

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Fort
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a licensed and certified financial professional who deals directly with the public my teeth are very important to me. When I first came in for a routine cleaning years ago Dr. Roland recommended a number of complex procedures to improve the look and functionality of my teeth. Roland your expert work lives on in my mouth for all to see!

user_reviews_extended.Name: chris nemchik
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was so terrified of going to the dentist that I put it off for over a decade. I went to Austin Dental on a whim when I couldn't stand the pain any longer and they couldn't have been better. Every single person who works here makes me feel good about coming to the dentist and all of the hygienists and especially Dr. C. have helped me immensely with overcoming my dental anxiety. I am so happy I made the decision to come here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benjamin Rigsby
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've got to say, I believe I stand united with those who have an unrealistic anxiety about going to the dentist but, this is THE best experience I've had in any dentist chair (and oddly enough, this chair was super comfy).

From filling out all the new patient forms simply online, to Dianne giving me a homely welcome upon arrival, to being able to friendly chat with Melissa as all the procedures are happening around me, to Brittany helping me understand what the next steps are to get my wisdom tooth pulled, to Dr Albert Olivares doing what most doctor's don't seem to do enough- sit down and just...talk: talk about concerns and listening, not making it seem like they just want to get to the next patient. There was, at no time, a feeling of being rushed.

It really seems the staff and doctor's haven't gotten burnt out or jaded by their careers. Hands down, the best experience I've ever had at a dentist. Hell, I can't even say "probably will ever have" because I don't ever see myself going anywhere else after this.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Yarie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great care and service. Very personable!
Thank you lots. I was looking for a new dentist and finally found one l liked and to be honest l am not a tough customer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Derak Kilgo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I picked Austin Dental after reading a bunch of reviews just like this one.

I am/was a phobic patient who needs a lot of work done. Dr. Roland gave it to me straight which I appreciate and the staff have really taken care if me. Everyone I've met so far has been very nice. I've been up there so much they know my name.

If you're putting it off or scared of the dentist, give these folks a try and you'll be glad you did.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Harryman
user_reviews_extended.Description:

Dr. Olervera is by far the best I've ever seen. He's very good at what he does. His assistant Melonie was also very much a pleasure to work with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Yatim
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had my four wisdom teeth removed by Doctor Olivares, and couldn't have been any happier... He and his assistant  Melanie did a great job putting me at ease, explaining the procedure and care afterwards... I was given some 'Laughing Gas' to breathe, and before I knew it, it was over and I was walking out of the office with my wife...

The skill of Dr. Olivares was evident the next day, when I was able to join some friends for a dinner party; absolutely no issues eating solid foods!!!

Very, very happy with Austin Dental: great service from their staff, and very good care from their doctors!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenny Peters
user_reviews_extended.Description:
For this very terrified-of-dentists 55 year old, I have to say that if YOU fall into any of that category from fear or age or even embarrassment that you haven't gone in years, then look no further.  I was finding myself starting to have some problems from some issues that had gone unattended to in many years, and I chose this office partially because of listing within my area (close to home) and because of their participation in a very particular process that i've been looking at (PerioProtect) and made my appointment.  From the first visit, they went out of their way to make me comfortable and welcome, and Dr. O is a prime example of what you hope a dentist will be when it comes to not only explaining, in detail, what is wrong but also extremely informative with what needs to happen to make you well again.  We put a 3 phase approach into place, and today was day 1 of the first phase.  I made my decision to actually go forward simply on the strength of Niko's excellent and gentle manner in my initial consultation in combination of my first meeting with Dr. O.  Today was scaling & planing Part 1, and I was still scared, but that dissipated within minutes with Billie, my hygienist for this portion, and again, with Dr. O.  I was so very comfortable in the process I actually nodded off while the work was being done.  My fear of the shots needed was taken care of when I was given gel that numbed the inside of my mouth to the point where I did not feel them - after that, the rest was a piece of cake.

This is not just from the assistance of drugs or numbing agents; those things helped, but everyone in this office has made me feel like Patient #1 when I'm there, and I cannot express how this has made a difference in approaching this much needed set of procedures.  They make it apparent that they actually care about you, and there's not one ounce of phoniness or insincerity, and that is such a rare thing these days.

I can highly highly recommend Austin Dental to anyone looking to find a dentist.  Eight thumbs up.

**11/15/2020 Followup.
I've been going here for 6-7 weeks now (there's a lot of work to be done, lol!) and I'm so happy to update this menu with only that the service I raved about in that initial review wasn't a one-off.  I almost feel like I could hang out for lunch break with them - they're all so nice.  It's made a huge difference in my overall thoughts about my personal dentistry needs and I couldn't be happier.  There have already been several procedures that we've started in motion and I've felt good about each of them.  They were even able to fit me in within a days notice from notifying them on Sunday that there was something that needed adjusting.  Some places will put the "nice" treatment on you a few times to capture you initially but it usually seems that feeling or attempt goes away.  I have not experienced that in the least here and I think that you'd feel the same way too, especially if you started off as uncomfortable or downright scared to go to the dentist.  If you have problems and do not fix them, your overall health can really suffer - since beginning these needed treatments, I have physically also felt better than I have in a long long while.  It's all connected.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ron Green
user_reviews_extended.Description: Austin Dental is always professional, courteous and most friendly. Patient care and service is their primary concern. Our extended family has used Austin Dental for many years and I highly recommend their services and the special attention they give to all of the patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: stuart rorer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Couldn't be happier.  Have been going to Austin Dental over 16 years and staff has been incredible. Professional, thorough and gentle.  For someone who has to visit the dentist 3-4 times a year, those key characteristics.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremiah Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: So some of us remember back when most people didn't have medical or dental insurance. Now that most do, me and my wife didn't really know what to do with it. So after 25 years of decay we decided it was time to face that shame and every single person here made us feel understood and welcome. And that made the biggest difference. If you're like us, here's your place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sakib I.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A phenomenal dental experience - Austin Dental provides a comprehensive approach to diagnosis, prognosis, and post-op monitoring.

I had a fairly complex issue of a wisdom tooth (lower left, #17) lodged and entering diagonally, which was affecting and damaging the root/nerve of the molar beside (#18).

I was really fortunate and blessed to have a loved one with a personal connection to Dr. Caraballo - which greatly aided in ease of understanding as well as determining best of course of action for the prognosis.

With certain details of the dental issue kept discrete, Dr. Caraballo performed the following:
- Advanced imaging CBCT
- Oral extraction of 2 wisdom teeth
- Post-operative follow-ups in triaging symptoms that followed, they were advocative on prescribing medication
- Referral to Endodontist specialist in the area for a root canal
- Crown to improve structural integrity of affected tooth

Everything happened really swiftly which greatly aided me as the dental pain I was experiencing was at times preventing me from even sleeping - which was completely new kind of pain I've ever experienced.

All the assistants are kind, informative and proactive, in addition to the front staff who are accommodative. Highly recommend this clinic!

Now I'm pain-free and consider that a true blessing. Hope all folks have positive experiences here at Austin Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Griffin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Willis and Registered dental asst Susie were an awesome team. They were timely, considerate and professional. Ms Susie explained her portion in detail and Dr. Willis was extremely skilled in completing my procedure without pain and keeping me informed of their next steps which was helpful since I am apprehensive when it comes to dental care. Their bedside manner combined with their experience and skill made for as positive of a dental visit as possible. Thank you ladies!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steph G
user_reviews_extended.Description: First impression - 💯💯after the text to come in I was greeted right away & everyone was genuinely kind. The wait wasn’t long to see the people I needed to, location was covid cautious, and everyone was the upmost professional. I needed a dentist sooner rather than later so I called & came in the next day. I would recommend 100%.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Willa Rosen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had a Valentine's visit with Dr. Lane, by favorite dentist.  Here is a poem in his honor:

For Dr. Lane, so skilled and so kind,
A Valentine's limerick I've designed
With a caring touch,
He fixed my mouth so much
Leaving my smile health and perfectly aligned.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Berta Lincoln
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient since 1998. The staff has literally watched me grow up. They are extremely punctual. They get you in and out. The office is very welcoming and they keep up with technology. I've had the same dentist and hygienist since I became a patient. Dr. Liz Willis and Mary Dudar rock! I refer everyone I know to this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Burthia Booker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nothing but the highest recommendation for this practice from my sibling. Made an appointment with Aileen and she was professional, knowledgeable and helpful. When I called to reschedule, the staff member (not Aileen) bullied me into providing her my insurance info, despite me reiterating I knew that my insurance would not work at the practice. Aileen called to confirm my appointment and wanted to let me know that my insurance would not work at the practice (duh). I appreciate the COVID-19 precautions, but I was not called to enter the building for almost 10 minutes after my appointment time. While nice, my hygienist, Nan, was newly returned to the practice and unfamiliar with the new patient intake procedures. She's literally going to other hygienists looking for SOP paperwork on what photos she needs to take of me. We should have been next up for the panoramic X-ray, but the lack of knowledge delayed us to our turn, twice. In the meantime a pH test of my mouth leads to the first of many up-sell pitches, and no questions about what I'd eaten that morning (coffee, which is acidic and probably lead to the pH anomaly). Panoramic X-ray was considered clinically unhelpful because the images were so poor. Nan advised me to pin up my hair next time because it caused a problem (my teeth are in the front of my head, my hair, while large, is in the back) in taking the image. I have had this X-ray done before at other practices, and I've never had a problem. Up-selling again for deep cleaning and scaling. Finally met Dr. Olivares, and was advised that an anomaly on my X-rays will need to be remedied by a root canal and periodontics skin grafts. Interestingly enough, that anomaly is on x-rays at the two dental practices I've used in the last 13 years, and this is the first time I'd been advised to get a root canal. I concurred with the periodontal advice, but the urgency was concerning.  The information was interesting and I left with expensive treatment advise for a mouth that is "well taken care of and in great condition" with no reported problems. While I respect the expertise and the plight of small businesses in this COVID-19 environment, the relentless up-sell left me turned off. The fact that a new patient intake took 2 hours, unnecessarily, completed the experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connie Rackel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hoppy Lane is awsome. I have a rare condition with my jaw bones. I needed an extraction, not easy when dealing with the brittle bone I have. However Dr. Lane was exceptional at making sure I Was pain free. I never had any pain the next day or two and healed great.I feel very blessed to have Dr. Lane as my Dentist and tell anyone looking for A Dentist about him. The staff is also very nice and make you feel important.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a regular patient with Austin Dental for the past 2 years. They are very courteous, helpful and have a great follow-up system. Great staff and great dentists. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariana Tejado

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tatiana Napravnik
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a new patient, I felt very comfortable with all the procedures and the details of my clinical profile. The people who work there are very professional and kind, I love the way they took care of me, I’ll definitely be a regular patient now.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you want a dental cleaning do NOT bother with this place. They would rather milk your insurance company than actually clean your teeth.

They will schedule you for "cleaning" but instead just check your mouth and then try to schedule several follow up visits to treat whatever they might find.

I know this because that's what they did during my first visit a few years ago. I asked for a cleaning but instead got a check up and then had to go back for the cleaning. But that was my first visit here so no big deal, I assumed they just wanted to be thorough.

That was a few years ago. So when I scheduled another cleaning recently I made it clear that I wanted a CLEANING not just xrays and mouth poking. The scheduler assured me and said that I was scheduled with a hygienist for that reason. Wrong.

The hygienist spent an hour and a half taking xrays and pictures of my teeth, most of which she kept getting wrong and retaking. After she was done she said I'll need to schedule more visits for cleaning AND schedule more visits every 3 months to work on some "minor" gum issues. No way.

There was no disease or damage preventing them from cleaning my teeth today. The doctor and hygienist both said so. Just like there was nothing to prevent the cleaning during my first visit years ago.

They claim to be comprehensive and say this is all for patient's best dental health but if you want to be comprehensive, why not just clean my teeth while I'm already there at your office? Isn't that what's best for my dental health? How is making me wait for a cleaning good for my teeth and gums?

I took the day off from work and woke up early only for them to waste an hour and a half of my time. And the worst part? I still have dirty teeth.

title: Hapii Dental Austin
address: 9300 N Lamar Blvd Ste A, Austin, TX 78753, United States

user_reviews.Name: Reyna Shah
user_reviews.Description:
I had a fantastic experience at Hapii Dental! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and professional. The front desk staff was incredibly helpful and made the check-in process seamless.

The clinical team is top-notch. They took the time to explain every step of the procedure, ensuring I was comfortable and well-informed throughout the visit. It’s clear they prioritize patient care and use the latest technology to provide high-quality treatment.

user_reviews.Name: Isabelle Maiquez
user_reviews.Description: Hapii Dental is hands-down the best dental office I’ve been to. The staff is incredibly professional, kind, and organized, and they make sure you’re comfortable every step of the way. Dr. Tran is extremely kind, which helped the experience go smoothly. I really appreciated how attentive and detail-oriented everyone was. It’s rare to find a place that combines top-quality care with such a welcoming, stress-free experience. I would absolutely recommend Hapii Dental to anyone looking for a dentist they can genuinely trust.

user_reviews.Name: Matt Morris
user_reviews.Description: Since moving to Austin this is my new dentistry spot. So far I've been twice first visit was an exam and a tooth extraction the staff was very friendly knowledgeable and helpful and show that they cared about their patients. Dr was very efficient when extracting my tooth she was able to get it out in minutes with no pain and it healed up nicely. They very quick with getting you in on time with your appointment you don't have to wait half an hour just to get through the door I would definitely recommend to everyone especially if you have kids.

user_reviews.Name: Stephanie Cao
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely loved this office! Dr. Tran was so kind when going over my treatment and I enjoyed how nice the staff was during my visit! I usually am particular about my cleanings but found that the office did a thorough job with my cleaning and would recommend coming here.

user_reviews.Name: Quan Truong
user_reviews.Description: Hapii Dental is by far and away the most amazing dentist I have ever been to! The dentists there are just absolutely so caring and wonderful. The dental assistant Stephanie C. is very sweet and I would love to have her again. Must recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Mike Parreno
user_reviews.Description:
My kids and I made an appointment online for cleaning and check ups, I have to say I was very impressed with everyone from the intake service

To the dental work provided by Dr. Phan and my dentist Yvonne and assistant Ruby, Hapii Dental provides a friendly, clean and professional environment with flawless dental work at a very reasonable price in my opinion, we are going to be happy to refer friends and family to them We will also be following up with our annual check ups.

I highly recommend Hapii Dental

user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for a cleaning for the first time in a couple of years. Everyone was very helpful and nice. The part I was the most nervous about was not understanding my insurance and what would be covered. I was afraid that there would be surprise fees but everything was so clear. They really took time and explained what was covered and how my insurance worked. I felt very comfortable here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Madden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I genuinely enjoyed my experience at Hapii Dental. I was new to the area and was dreading going to a new dentist as some places seem a little more profit oriented versus patient centered. This is not the case at Hapii Dental and I am glad I found them. They are trustworthy and transparent. They break down costs (which are great), let you know why they are necessary and answer all questions. I would recommend this place to family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Vu
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit was great.  I came in for a routine clean and check up.  The staff and my dentist were friendly and made things comfortable.  They also did well explaining the issues I had with my wisdom teeth.  I would definitely recommend this office to my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susannah Osegi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend this office. The doctor is so sweet and her awesome staff always had a smile on thier faces from the waiting room and throughout my visit. Everyone was so knowledgeable and answered all of my dental questions (and I had a lot). My cleaning was quick and easy and I was educated on what I should be doing at home to keep up with my squeaking clean new smile. This place is great, I'll definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jc Rs
user_reviews_extended.Description: BEST EXPERIENCE EVER! I’ve tried so many dentists offices and none of them has made me feel more comfortable than Dr. Liu! She walked me through the whole process and didn’t make me feel ashamed after going so long without proper oral care! I loved it so much i just booked my kids appointments next!! So happy!!

user_reviews_extended.Description: It's an awesome place, I been here since I was a kid and I am still going. The nurses and Dentist did a great job you should come here.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Hapii Dental was very friendly and made my first visit to the dentist in years absolutely amazing! They were very fast and thorough, and I was able to get everything I needed taken care of on the same day as my first visit so it was very convenient. I’d recommend them to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I brought my kids here for years. The female dentists are amazing, they eventually got so busy, my kids started seeing a male dentist whom completely ignored my decision of getting my oldest one braces.

user_reviews_extended.Name: klarissa Bejaran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for a much needed cleaning; Olivia was the one performing my cleaning & she did such a great job!! Olivia explained to me in detail the treatment plan I was receiving & the benefits I got with my insurance plan as well. Loved her positive attitude & her warm customer service skills.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Manuel Castillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm very picky with dentists and as soon as I stepped in I could tell this place was going to be a pleasant experience, I brought my wife here for a consultation and cleaning in the same sitting. They let you watch Netflix while you lay back which is a plus. All their equipment is clean and the staff is amazing and have fabulous smiles showing that this dentist knows what she's doing :) it's also children friendly as they do have a few toys to play with and magazines, plus a comfy bench that can sit at least 12 people, the floor is marble and very clean. Wasn't crowded though I think they're new so wait time is very short. Even if you don't travel to these parts of Austin, I do recommend this place, you won't be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace I
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Came here for a cleaning, x-ray and two cavity fillings. Dr. Lu and staff were very friendly and professional. The entire process was quick, and painless and the Dr. was very thorough with my cleaning and exam.

I liked that their schedule was very flexible as I was able come in the same day and they were able to take care of my fillings quickly. Highly recommend. They are located at the end of the building as the google maps will tell you its some where else. I definitely will be coming back for my next appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sean Belverstone
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic time here, everyone was super helpful and kind and gave loads of very informative advice. Upon my first visit I even received a cup with a free toothbrush, floss and mouthwash! A very unexpected thoughtful gift. The prices were good and I will definitely return.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizbeth L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow just had the best experience at Hapii dental. This place is really nice. And all of the assistants and especially the doctor was so kind and gentle. They made me feel so comfortable. I got to watch my favorite Netflix show while I got my filling done so that distracted me. I would recommend this office anyone looking a new dentist! Two thumbs up and definitely 5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nydia Marston
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice! Very upfront and thorough regarding my care plan! I’ve never had a dentist ask to check my bite for fillings before and I really appreciate how my comfort felt like priority number 1!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thu Tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: My tooth has been bothering me and they were able to see me the same day.  The office was very clean and high tech and everyone was very friendly.  Dr. Phan did my exam and give me options on what to do with the tooth, I decided to have it pulled.  The process was painless and I didn't even feel anything when she took it out.  So glad I found this place, coming back for my cleaning next week and taking my kids in for check up before school start.  If you're looking for a dentist, give them a call, they treat both adults and children here, another convenient factor, can't recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had my braces removed after wearing them for two long years and wanted to get a good teeth cleaning,
and rightly so.
I made a first time appt with Happi Dental when I decided to switch from my old dental insurance policy to an Aetna dental savings plan.

My regular dentist (who is an exceptional practitioner), did cover this particular plan and so I would have been out of pocket for the tooth cleaning. Instead of spending $120 out of pocket expense, I decided to go with an in-network dentist. This was a BIG mistake.

First off, both on the phone and when I walked into the office, I mentioned that I did not want x-rays because I have a condition called mandibular tori (basically where there are exposed bones under the tongue from Jawbone stress due to teeth grinding and clenching or bruxism)

And also I did not want any out-of-pocket expense which would have been defeating the purpose of going there in the first place.

I was repetitive with my communication and I ​was VERY clear and up front about this and I mentioned several times (at least 4 or 5) that I did not want any x-rays. On the phone, to the receptionist, the dental tech and the dentist as well.
Epecially with the fact I was Not going in for any major or specific dental work  that day, it was only a routine teeth cleaning. Seems pretty obvious, reasonable and clear, right?

... But then the dentist and tech told me that they could not perform a cleaning without  taking x-rays.

Here is where they went wrong.
Not only did they take X-rays which, by the way she did a good job at not putting the mouthpiece in my jawbone and did the best job she could even with help from the dentist,  and yes they were diligent with that part of the experience.
As well as with the cleaning, they did a great job with the teeth cleaning itself, I do have to mention that part.

... However, they failed to mention that they were going to charge me $230 for this.

If I had known that, I would have walked out right then because I specifically said not only did I not want x-rays because they hurt, but also being as I did not want any out-of-pocket expense.
(I just spent thousands of dollars on my mouth with dental work and braces and I was not looking to spend any more for at least another 6 months)
... But did they listen to me and follow instructions? No.
Not only did they charge me over $230 for the visit, they also forgot to send me the x-rays to me email that I specifically asked for twice before I left.

And when I wrote them when they asked about my experience and explained what had happened, instead of offering a refund  they mentioned that it was " their company's policy"
(they did eventually apologize though saying they were very short staffed and busy though)

They failed to mention at the time of the appt before, during or after the cleaning.
Of course until it was time to pay. I didn't have the energy to argue so I just paid what was owed and left absolutely furious! If I had known this beforehand, I would have just stayed with my regular dentist who is just awesome, honest and always does great work.

And at least he does not take advantage of his dental customers either.

At least he had has the respect, professionalism and communication skills to inform me of any charges that will be made right up front!

If you are going to schedule with this office at Happi Dental, make sure you know it front any charges that are going to apply before scheduling the appointment or else they were certainly take advantage of you. And not tell you about the charges up front.

I would most definitely Not recommend this establishment and will not be going back again ever due to their lack of honesty, respect, communication and professionalism.
And oh by the way, I still have not received those x-rays in the email either.

title: Swish Dental - Domain
address: 3310 W Braker Ln #100, Austin, TX 78758, United States

user_reviews.Name: Ashley Geffert
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely amazing experience as always! From check in with Roberto to treatment in the back, the domain team made me feel so welcomed and comfortable!  Dr. Lawson did a fantastic job, got me numb and fixed me up with my temp crown! Super quick and easy, made it a very relaxing procedure! Natalie was my dental assistant and she was phenomenal! Sahra, my hygienist, as well as Jay, and Lucero also helped make the experience very comfortable and enjoyable!! Great team here!!

user_reviews.Name: Richard Reed
user_reviews.Description:
I was a patient at Swish Dental for several years.  In that time, I've seen dental hygienists and dentists come and go from that place like a revolving door.  You will be told that you will require treatments whether necessary or not.

In that time, my wife's been told she's had several cavities that require fillings, only to be seen by a different dentist at the same location months later that he only saw one.

My situation was worse.  For at least a year, I was told I needed a crown for a molar with a filling that was wearing down.  I finally agreed to get the work done and paid my portion of the treatment plan.  After a couple months, Swish billing told me I owed an additional amount, because insurance denied the claim.  It was denied because the documentation Swish provided showed less than the 50% tooth decay threshold to approve.  That immediately told me I was misled by Swish Dental's staff into believing that I needed this crown right away.

After that experience I decided to swap dentists.  During a recent check up, I mentioned sensitivity with the crown and they suggested I go back to Swish to have look at it. After an X-ray and cold test, a different dentist at Swish told me the molar next to the crown was infected and I required a root canal and crown!!!   I was blown away as I've never been told about any infection or issues with that molar until that moment.  After I was presented a $1300 treatment plan, I was told that dentist could perform that procedure later that afternoon.  I decided to pass and went back to my new dentist for a second opinion.

As expected, the new dentist told me he saw no evidence of infection with that molar.

In the end, I regret that I stayed with Swish Dental for as long as I did-- it's too corporate, unethical, and too "sale-sy".  If you are looking for a dentist, I would highly suggest finding a small practice that's been around for years with a stable staff and solid reviews from long time patients.

user_reviews.Name: Fernanda Keeler
user_reviews.Description: This was my first visit to Swish Dental office.  Upon arrival, I was warmly greeted and sat down to wait for my initial consultation. The consultant explained all the procedures that would take place before my teeth were cleaned.  He took x-rays and explained everything shown on the pictures.  After he finished with all the explanations, the dental hygienist cleaned my teeth.  She was very thorough and professional.  I was very pleased with my visit to Swish Dental and will certainly return for my six month cleaning.

user_reviews.Name: Grace Dawson Beatty
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Lawson and the team at Swish Dental Domain are fantastic. Each person I interact with is always smiling, has such a positive attitude, and makes going to the dentist fun. The teeth cleanings are well done. I’m currently going through an Invisalign treatment and really appreciate how Dr Lawson and her team take the time to explain each step we’re going through in order for me to be knowledgeable about the process.
I highly recommend this location if you’re looking for a dentist.

user_reviews.Name: Nathan Hernandez
user_reviews.Description:
I had a frustrating experience at SWISH Dental (Domain location) and wanted to share in case it helps others. Also, read Reddit for more honest reviews than are here on Google.

The day before my appointment, I called specifically to schedule a routine cleaning. I clearly asked, since I’ve never been to SWISH Domain, only the Downtown location, whether I would need to repeat an exam or if I could just get my teeth cleaned, because my first visit to SWISH previously took much longer than expected. I was told I could come in for the cleaning without needing another exam.

When I arrived for my 1:00 PM appointment, the front desk immediately recommended a fluoride treatment that was not covered by my insurance. When I declined, the response I received was, “If you can’t afford it, that makes sense,” which felt unnecessary and unprofessional.

After waiting, staff told me they couldn’t find my information, then later said the dentist required a full new exam because I had never seen that specific doctor before. I explained I had already completed an exam with SWISH and was already in their system, but I was told it was the doctor’s policy and could not be waived.

As a result, I was unable to receive the cleaning I scheduled and spent nearly an hour traveling and waiting for an appointment that could not be completed.

I called the downtown SWISH location afterward and was told this is not their standard process, and they are looking into it.

Overall, the experience felt disorganized, inconsistent, and frustrating. I will be returning to the downtown office for my cleaning, but I will not be returning to the Domain location.

user_reviews.Name: Noelia Root
user_reviews.Description:
Many negative experiences to recount. If you have a better dentist in the area, please contact me, because I am up to my eyeballs with frustration with this place.

The straw that broke the camel's back was showing up this morning at 8 AM for my cleaning... and they were literally not there. No one. A temp worker of some kind was also there but had no key and told me she was told to come in today. at 8:10 I call Swish and obviously get forwarded to more central offices because no one was there at the Domain location where she told me that that were closed until 11 AM today for weather. ??? When the heck were they going to tell me who reorganized her morning and work schedule for this?

They have also twice tried to upsell me to get Invisalign. There will be times when I am told that my bite is all out of wack and causing my bottom front teeth to grind on my top ones, and if I don't do Invisalign, it will cause irreparable damage. Then, mysteriously, in my next several appointments, it is never brought up again and I will be told that my teeth look fine. I have never had braces and don't plan to, and that is only because of dentists my whole life telling me that there was no need.

Not only that, but billing practices are incredibly opaque. Every time I get my bill, it goes through insurance as something completely different, or incredibly highly inflated. I have called 5+ times before to get no clarification on bills I have received with the advice always being "just wait for it to finish the billing process" (mind you these are from charges almost a year ago now) Not to mention how they botched my husband's cavity filling so that now he has constant pain in that tooth (never before was there any indication of pain or issues on this tooth- he filled it because they said to).

Staff is kind, tech is new, and there are abundant openings. It is not all bad, but these experiences lead me to try to find a new dentist ASAP.

user_reviews.Name: Mikey G
user_reviews.Description: Great place, very professional and nice people! Honored my insurance, and were very transparent from the time I walked into the door, from when I left. My hygienist was Billy very down to earth person, he was a pro when I came to the cleaning. Very light hand but also got my teeth very clean. The dentist was also very pleasant and professional. She gave great and honest advice. This is the best dentist office in Texas no bullshit! Thanks everyone for doing what they do.

user_reviews.Name: Emily T
user_reviews.Description:
While the hygienist and dentists are great, my overall experience with assistants and office staff has felt chaotic and very disorganized. They have high expectations from us as patients, but they also expect patients to be forgiving when they’re the ones at fault. I’ll go into detail below, but the easiest way to put it is — how can Swish have a Late/Cancellation Fee for customers, but nothing happens when they miss an appointment?

The details:

I was looking for a new dentist, and since the Swish Domain is near my work and had good reviews, I gave them a try. I went to get a cleaning first, and the hygienist was amazing. I needed a few fillings so I got those done as well, the dentist was amazing too. So much so that I decided to do Invisalign, but this is where things have gone wrong.

I paid for the entire cost of Invisalign up front since there was a discount for doing so. But  maybe that was a mistake, because now I feel like I’m being treated as an afterthought… perhaps I should have agreed to a payment plan so that Swish would WANT to provide me the service and collect the money.

My first Invisalign appointment was January 8 where I received the first 5 trays and had attachments bonded to some of my teeth. During this appointment, they also pre-scheduled my next appointment for February 12 to get the next 5 trays and do something to cosmetically reshape some of my teeth. This fell on the exact date I’d start tray 6 which was perfect. Or so I thought.

Since the January 8th appointment, it’s been a frustrating experience. I almost want to transfer the rest of my treatment somewhere else.

Issue 1: about an hour after I left the first appointment, 2 attachments fell off my teeth and I had to go back to get them redone. I’ve done Invisalign before and this has never happened.

Issue 2: a day later, I lost *another* attachment on a crown. This was the 3rd attachment I lost in less than 48 hours, so obviously they didn’t do something right. They couldn’t fit me in again for over a week. I had no other choice, so I made the appointment and showed up. I was there for maybe 3 minutes. They took me back, told they don’t put attachments on crowns and said “sorry for wasting your time”. I said it was fine (it wasn’t) but whatever. They said they’d see me on February 12 for my next trays and the reshaping teeth stuff. Cool.

Issue 3: it’s February 12th, the day I’m supposed to get my next trays, and suddenly they DON’T HAVE AN APPOINTMENT FOR ME. Usually this wouldn’t be a huge deal, but I finished tray 5 yesterday and should be receiving tray 6 today. Of course, they’re “booked solid” and can’t schedule me until next Monday. This will effectively put my treatment a week behind schedule. The craziest thing is that if I was the one who missed this appointment, they would have charged me $50. But since they’re the ones who missed it, I’m just supposed to accept an apology as payment.

I’m not sure what’s going on, but get it together. Please. Patients have to take time off of work to attend appointments. When your dental assistants do poor-quality work, it requires a patient to have to visit more frequently than should be required. Patients also have to plan for appointments. We expect the appointment we scheduled to, well, be scheduled. Your failure to properly do this and then expect us to wait for days to weeks later is a terrible customer experience. I love the hygienist (I can’t remember his name but he might be leaving soon anyway) and I love the dentist, but they’re not enough for me to stay is everyone else isn’t providing the same quality service.

What started out to be a good experience to get me in the door now has me questioning my decision to choose Swish at the Domain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Geffert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely amazing experience as always! From check in with Roberto to treatment in the back, the domain team made me feel so welcomed and comfortable!  Dr. Lawson did a fantastic job, got me numb and fixed me up with my temp crown! Super quick and easy, made it a very relaxing procedure! Natalie was my dental assistant and she was phenomenal! Sahra, my hygienist, as well as Jay, and Lucero also helped make the experience very comfortable and enjoyable!! Great team here!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Reed
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was a patient at Swish Dental for several years.  In that time, I've seen dental hygienists and dentists come and go from that place like a revolving door.  You will be told that you will require treatments whether necessary or not.

In that time, my wife's been told she's had several cavities that require fillings, only to be seen by a different dentist at the same location months later that he only saw one.

My situation was worse.  For at least a year, I was told I needed a crown for a molar with a filling that was wearing down.  I finally agreed to get the work done and paid my portion of the treatment plan.  After a couple months, Swish billing told me I owed an additional amount, because insurance denied the claim.  It was denied because the documentation Swish provided showed less than the 50% tooth decay threshold to approve.  That immediately told me I was misled by Swish Dental's staff into believing that I needed this crown right away.

After that experience I decided to swap dentists.  During a recent check up, I mentioned sensitivity with the crown and they suggested I go back to Swish to have look at it. After an X-ray and cold test, a different dentist at Swish told me the molar next to the crown was infected and I required a root canal and crown!!!   I was blown away as I've never been told about any infection or issues with that molar until that moment.  After I was presented a $1300 treatment plan, I was told that dentist could perform that procedure later that afternoon.  I decided to pass and went back to my new dentist for a second opinion.

As expected, the new dentist told me he saw no evidence of infection with that molar.

In the end, I regret that I stayed with Swish Dental for as long as I did-- it's too corporate, unethical, and too "sale-sy".  If you are looking for a dentist, I would highly suggest finding a small practice that's been around for years with a stable staff and solid reviews from long time patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fernanda Keeler
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit to Swish Dental office.  Upon arrival, I was warmly greeted and sat down to wait for my initial consultation. The consultant explained all the procedures that would take place before my teeth were cleaned.  He took x-rays and explained everything shown on the pictures.  After he finished with all the explanations, the dental hygienist cleaned my teeth.  She was very thorough and professional.  I was very pleased with my visit to Swish Dental and will certainly return for my six month cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany G
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am soooo grateful for Swish and the entire team there. Just a couple of days ago, I went in to extract both of my bottom wisdom teeth. I was terrified! The first one was out in maybe one minute while the second one…was not so easy. Sometimes, these things are just unavoidable. However, although I was struggling a bit, everyone was so caring, patient, and truly had my best interest at heart. The hygienist, I believe her name was T, went above and beyond. She got a fan for me, put a wet rag on my forehead, and simply did everything she could to help. Of course, the doctor was absolutely incredible too. I’d recommend Swish a thousand times. Now I’m healing, and I’m in almost no pain, barely any swelling, and I’m just so elated. What could’ve been a miserable experience ended up being so great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lillie Albadin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first visit with Swish Dental today and they far exceeded my expectations! Very impressive office with all the latest technology. Each team member is thoroughly trained and highly educated and takes time to explain everything in detail. Highly recommend them! Will be going back for my Invisalign treatment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patti Mokry
user_reviews_extended.Description:
There's a lot to be impressed by at this joint: open and airy, bright, clean, incredibly kind employees, state-of-the-art equipment, and the way they break down piece by piece what your bill(s) look like so there's no confusion as to what you are and are not responsible for. I'd been avoiding seeing the dentist for a while for mental health reasons, and by the end of my appointment I felt kind of silly for being so freaked out about going in the first place. I can't believe I'm looking forward to going back for my cleaning - bc who on earth get's stoked for the dentist?!
Seriously, if you're in North Austin and need a dentist - Swish is where you need to go.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Viviana Vazquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to get full exam and cleaning. Everyone was so nice and considerate. I am pregnant and they made sure we were both safe! I really like how they explained everything to me during my exam and cleaning. Roberto, my hygienist was great! I definitely would recommend this office to everyone looking for a good team to take care of you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon J Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I unfortunately forgot the dental hygienist’ name, though he did mention being a travel DH. He did a great job at explaining and individualizing my experience. 2nd year in a row coming here, always a good and smooth experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mychael Ball
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish dental always delivers!! I received excellent service from Dr. Lawson and the amazing staff. I had a cleaning and had been needing some fillings. They got me in same day for the treatment.  I have been a happy patient for overs 5 years!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Auslander
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I go here because it is close to my home and it is a nice office. The problem is, I get laughing gas each time I go to the dentist, even for a cleaning, because I have terrible dentist office anxiety. Each time I go for the last 3 times, I have multiple people from Swish try to convince me not to get laughing gas.

I do not do it for fun, I do it because I want to keep my teeth healthy, and if it is that miserable for me each time, I will not come in as needed. I have money set aside in my FSA specifically for purposes like this (which I have told them), and they still try to convince me not to.

It is becoming annoying frankly that I have to explain each time as to why I need it. Not that it is any of their business, but I am sober from drugs and alcohol, so it’s not like I’m using it for a fun time. Anyway, if you have dental anxiety and need laughing gas, prepare to be convinced not to get it for some reason I don’t understand.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Recipe for those with dentist anxiety: Sarah the hygienist + Dr Lawson for dentist. Both are super judgment free zone, light fast touch, in out and done ASAP. They both have dispositions that are perfect for people who hate being at the dentist. Friendly/happy, but also matter of fact and unphased by your dental problems/lazy flossing, and just kinda: let’s get to work and get you out of here.  Sarah especially is great at working quickly and gently. I actually think she likes the challenge of dental-anxious patients and calmly talking them thru the appointment. 11/10 recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madeleine Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just want to say this was the best new patient experience I have ever had at the dentist. The dentist has never been my favorite place to be since I am beyond sensitive- Robert was my dental hygienist and was incredible at the Domain location. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yolanda Howard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very personable staff. State of the art equipment. I was a little nervous in my search for a new dental home but those fears were allayed with the personalized attention. I love how they explained all of my treatment options not just ones that will bring in the most money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in for an emergency appointment and had a great experience. I paid cash price, and they were transparent about the cost, and everyone there was very friendly. I was a little nervous because I have tmj and issues with opening my jaw, but they were understanding and made sure I was as comfortable as possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Makungu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Do not recommend this practice at all. Dr. Lawson did a crown that was first not needed and second botched then did not even take the time to complete the work. When I complained and went back the second Dr said I need a second crown and asked me to come back when Dr Lawson was back. The practice wasted my time and the. Proposed filings just to bill insurance for treatment that were not even necessary. If you want healthy natural teeth don’t go here it’s a dentist business with no real pride in the dental practice nor the oath of being a Dr of dentistry. Very disappointed with the service and disregard to my concerns or questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darrius Simmons
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Never visit this Swish Dental location. I came in today because my face was severely swollen from a tooth abscess. When I called yesterday, I was told an extraction could be done today. At my initial appointment earlier today, I was again told the extraction could be performed and was instructed to return at 3:00 PM.

When I checked back in at 2:45 PM, everything suddenly changed. I was told the extraction could no longer be done, and it felt like that decision was made because I didn’t accept all of their recommendations. The staff then became rude and unprofessional and ultimately canceled my appointment, even though I have a serious facial infection.

I left feeling dismissed and unheard. Based on how I was treated, I can’t help but feel that bias may have played a role. I will never return and do not recommend this location to anyone seeking urgent dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish saved my elderly Dad's day and went above and beyond to help him with patience and kindness to cement a crown he had lost to tough Thanksgiving Day brisket.  It's not the first place you'd think of to take a 93-year-old, but they made him feel welcome and at home, and everyone from the front desk staff to the dentist and hygienist took amazing, professional care of him.  He made it to his bridge game with a big smile (back in place).  He even asked if they sold Swish t-shirts!  I could not recommend this practice more. Thanks, Swish and Swish staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anastasia Molchanova
user_reviews_extended.Description: Do not recommend this place. They always pressure you into procedures you don’t need, even after you clearly say you don’t want them. It’s almost impossible to just get a cleaning. They try to force every possible procedure just to charge your insurance as much as they can.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Fitch
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is a really good dentist and I had an exceptional experience…..staff are very nice and cordially friendly while simultaneously being very thorough with procedures. I can’t say enough good things to exemplify how impressive this team is.
I’m so happy I chose Swish Dental-Domain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: lauryn dunmyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved Swish Dental! I recently moved from Georgia to Texas, and this was by far the best experience I’ve had at a dentist’s office. From the friendly staff to the great music, everything made me feel comfortable and well cared for. I left feeling informed and confident about the health of my teeth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Relaxing Music
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely OUTRAGED.
I came to office in for cleaning nothing more. I take care of my teeth, and I’ve had regular dental check-ups my entire life without a single issue. Suddenly, this place tries to tell me I have a gum disease, bone lossand urgently need a deep cleaning
It was nothing short of a scare tactic. The pressure to agree to expensive procedures on the spot was completely inappropriate and felt like a money grab, not genuine care. Thankfully, I wasn’t naive enough to fall for it. I immediately reached out to a trusted dental professional someone who actually knows my dental history and guess what? My gums are in great shape.
This place is DANGEROUS. They are playing with people’s health and trust, just to boost their profits. It’s disgusting and borderline fraudulent.
Don’t fall for the fear-mongering. Avoid this place entirely

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jazz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an outstanding experience with Dr. Askari and Viviana, her assistant. From the moment I walked in, I felt genuinely cared for. Dr. Askari is not only highly skilled but also incredibly gentle and attentive she took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I was comfortable throughout the visit. Viviana was equally wonderful: kind, efficient, and reassuring, with a calming presence that made the whole process smooth and stress-free. Their teamwork and compassion truly set them apart. I highly recommend this practice to anyone seeking excellent dental care with a personal touch.

Janet M

Five Stars All Around!
I’m always anxious going to the dentist due to my pass experience it was a night mare incompetent dentist I had before. Finally, I have a go to dentist now Dr Patel.
Dr Patel is warmth and professional that instantly put me at ease.  He is not only highly skilled but also incredibly compassionate, taking the time to explain everything clearly and answer my questions. It's rare to find someone who combines expertise with genuine care like this.
The true standout, though, was my hygienist, Robert he was gentle, thorough, and somehow managed to make a cleaning feel relaxing! His attention to detail and friendly demeanor made the experience truly pleasant.
The entire team creates an environment that’s clean, comfortable, and stress-free. I left feeling confident in my dental health and grateful to have found such an amazing practice. Highly recommend!  Domain Location.

Janet M
07/08/2025

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nadia Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Billy, my hygienist, was awesome! Profesional and very friendly. Dr. Lawson was fabulous as usual. I’ve been seeing her for about five years and she’s consistently great. Always a pleasant experience going to the swish dental at the domain!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Terra
user_reviews_extended.Description:
DO NOT GO HERE, MALPRACTICE.

Went it for a regular cleaning, dentist told me I had $700 worth of cavities that needed to be drilled and filled. Dentist who looked fresh out of dental school did a poor job explaining where they were and what was going on.

Within 5 minutes I get presented with a treatment plan to drill my teeth and fill these "cavities" for $700.

I have never had a history in my adult life of cavities and never needed work done so I found this odd especially with the lack of information presented about the issues.

I then got a second opinion before getting work done at Horizon Dental just down the road, upon arriving I presented the X-rays Swish gave me and the Dentist said they were blurry and not usable, I got new clear xrays and after examining my mouth and the xrays she said it was just calcium build up and to floss better and nothing needed to be done.

Swish performed malpractice on me attempting to sell me irreversible treatments for an issue that dis NOT exist.

DO NOT GO HERE, Their dentist do not care about you and are incentivized by commission to sell and do treatments.

TL:DR Went to Swish, was told I had cavities that would cost $700 to fix. Got a second opinion at a individually owned practice and was told it was just calcium build up and that need to do a better job flossing.

Swish Dentistry, more like Scam Dentistry

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vica Mood
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Complete SCAM!!!!!!AVOID Dr. Elaheh Askari!!!  She  just finished school in 2025 and clearly lacks the experience. She diagnosed me with something I don’t  have.

I went in for a routine cleaning and check-up (with braces on), and they suddenly claimed I had bone loss, deep gum pockets, and "advanced gum disease." They pushed me to see a periodontist ( referral ) 🤣  and a deep cleaning. I was shocked haha.  I’ve had cleanings every six months my whole life and have never been told anything like this :)
I immediately contacted my orthodontist (who is also a periodontist) and told her what happened. She was just as shocked and confirmed that my gums are completely healthy.

. She told me “ I never have put braces on you if you had any sign of gum disease that would be illegal.”
This clinic clearly tries to scare patients into paying for unnecessary procedures. It’s dishonest, unethical, and DANGEROUS . They DONT  CARE about your health — only your money.
I’ve already reported them to the dental regulatory board and I strongly URGE anyone to AVOID this place. Do not trust your health with people who are only looking to profit off of fear!!!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassie Legaspi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is the third time we've experienced issues with what should have been simple dental care. While I want to acknowledge Anthony for his excellent communication—he was professional and courteous—the overall experience was once again disappointing.
I had a cracked tooth and contacted the office for assistance with getting an antibiotic prescribed, given the urgency of the situation and my status as a heart patient. Despite calling daily to follow up, nothing was done in time, and I ultimately had to cancel the appointment. As someone with a medical condition, the lack of urgency around preventing a potential infection was concerning and unacceptable.
This follows previous negative experiences at the Mueller location, including unnecessary X-rays. While a manager later admitted they were not needed and offered to comp services in exchange for removing a prior review, the pattern of poor service has continued—even after transferring our care to the Domain location in hopes of improvement.
We’ve given multiple chances, but the continued lack of reliability and follow-through has caused us to lose trust in this dental group. Disappointed overall and unfortunately cannot recommend based on our repeated experiences.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anita Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: They’re great! Super kind, helpful & professional!  I really appreciate the way they seek to do better. Dr Lawson and her staff go above & beyond to address my individual needs (medically and financially) and I can’t be more pleased with the relationship and the care I receive at Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Mitchell
user_reviews_extended.Description: All the staff was extremely friendly and helpful, and the office has a really nice setup that makes you feel comfortable right away. The only downside was that I had to wait a bit longer than expected to see the dentist, but once I did, the experience was excellent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AKC
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a very disappointing experience at Swish Dental North Austin Domain. I felt that pricing was not transparent — after insurance adjustments, the rates seemed inflated to offset the discounts. I initially had no pain or issues with my tooth, but after a filling was done, the tooth was ground down so much that I was later told I needed a crown. This felt unnecessary and left me frustrated.

When I returned for the same filling, it came out within a month, which makes me question the quality of the materials and the work done. Based on my visits, I personally do not feel confident in the level of care or experience here.

I am now looking for another dentist as I do not want to risk more unnecessary treatments. I also do not understand how this location has such high ratings online, as my own experience was very different.

For anyone considering this clinic: please be cautious and do your research before proceeding.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Atalie Crouch
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the second time my appointment was messed up by the receptionist. The first time I showed up to my appointment and they informed me that my insurance would need me to wait another month even though they were the ones who called me to make the appointment. The second time I arrived at 3:45 for my 4pm appointment and checked in with the receptionist, at 4:30 the receptionist comes by and said they didn’t see me walk in so now I didn’t have time for the appointment but I literally checked in with the man at the desk ! They gave me my cleaning but did not see the dentist or get any exams. The dentist’s here are great but the receptionist are not.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Kuschel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Lawson (Domain) and her team were friendly and helpful during my visit. It starts at the very warm welcome from Anthony at the front desk, continues with the knowledgeable techs, and ends with a doable strategy and great bedside manner with Dr. Lawson..Honestly, they are the best dental experience I've ever had. They told me things about the structure of my mouth and jaw that previous dentists had conveniently left out. I left the office feeling well-informed about the upcoming plan of attack and look forward to working with them to get my teeth tip top.

Major kudos to you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elissa Olivarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: There are not enough words to describe how awesome this place is!! Dr. Patel and his team made sure I was comfortable during every second of my extractions. I’m so uneasy & anxious at the dentist, but this was by far the best dental experience I’ve ever had. If you’re hesitant to seek dental care out of fear, come here- they truly care about you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Copeland
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place! Everyone there is very nice and helpful. I had a veneer pop off and needed an appointment asap and came in the next day. The dentist was able to help and did a perfect color match in one visit. She is a rockstar!! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Walters
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had not been to a dentist in way too long. My hygenist, Billy was awesome, we had a fun conversation while we did imaging and cleaning. Dr. Lawson clearly explained what additional treatments I need and which ones were priorities get done asap and which ones could wait for a little bit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Lindsley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Twenty stars.
The doctor was such a sweetheart.
It took some time for her to see me, but not terribly long, and her bedside manner and clear outcome made it well worth it.
