I haven’t been to the dentist in twenty years, I guess I’ll be back in two weeks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phyllis Dunmon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff. Good location but parking can be a challenge. They work well with insurance and offer their own pricing packages.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmine Atobajeun
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always loving coming to Swish! This was my first time at the Domain location because my unusual location was all booked up and I was happy to see the same cleanliness, attention to patients, and job well done. My hygienist not only did a great job with my cleaning, he was very transparent with what he was doing and why throughout the whole process. Dr. Patel was also very clear with my treatment plan and next steps. The timing was perfect too, started m and ended right on time. Overall awesome experience per usual and I highly recommend it for everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Kirn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone I interacted with was so nice! The staff very openly discuss your dental situation with you, and explain things in a way that is very easy to understand. So, so genuinely impressed with the people here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Luera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'd recommend Swish dental over any other establishment! Benefits included in Invisalign are charged as extra add ons in other places. Staff are friendly and helpful too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marina Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Swish at the Domain as a new patient and I was really impressed with the office and the staff. My dental hygienist, Billy, was very kind, did a thorough job and made me feel comfortable. Dr.Parth was very informative, friendly and was even able to get my filling done same day! Overall my experience here was very smooth and I will be coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nina Chhabra
user_reviews_extended.Description: My father had an emergency and Dr. Lawson was able to get him in the same day and she took such amazing care of him! My father is a retired dentist and he couldn’t stop raving about her bedside manner and etiquette. The practice is very inviting and while I was waiting, everyone who walked in was treated with such respect and care. Highly recommend Swish to anyone looking for a dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denice Richard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience for my first visit. Staff was great. Hygienist was fantastic and dentist very nice. Glad I found Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Prakash
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Awesome clinic, super nice staff. They took me in emergency for a broken crown got me out of pain with an hour.
The whole staff right from when you walk in all the way to the doctors makes you feel comfortable at this place.
Dr. Patel was just awesome!!! Not only was he incredibly professional and skilled, but he also made me feel calm and cared for throughout the procedure. He did an awesome job—quick, thorough, and with a great bedside manner. I’m truly grateful for how he handled everything. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: sydney sanders
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to have a cavity filled today and I’m terrified of getting fillings, today was PAINLESS! It was such a positive experience and it was so wonderful. Love swish!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lils
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have really bad dental anxiety and really struggle with sensory issues at the dentist. This appointment I felt the most relaxed I've felt going to the dentist. I'll never enjoy going to the dentist but this place makes me feel as good as I could be and I didn't feel like they were charging me for unnecessary things.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marina Werner
user_reviews_extended.Description: This one star has nothing to do with the doctors here. The front desk  blatantly lied to us about being in network with our insurance company, confirming it several times and then sending me a bill as an out of network provider several weeks later. They refused to do anything about it. I paid the bill but my family is not coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentistry I’ve been too! Was my first experience not feeling scared of the dentist and I’m 27 years old lol. I don’t usually look forward to appointments but now I don’t mind and actually want to go (they have Netflix)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candra Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the cutest little office, with the right amount of bougie. Location is convenient, staff super helpful and gentle. They explained everything and put together a personalized plan to deliver me, the smile of my dreams. Run 🏃🏾‍♀️ don't walk and make yourself an appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shaina McCullough
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lawson is the BEST! She’s funny, thorough, and a lowkey perfectionist with her work (which I appreciate). I know I’m in good hands with her! I trust her FULLY. I also have had the pleasure of being treated by an amazing hygienist there, she’s extremely knowledgeable and gentle, and has provided me with a lot of counseling and education on oral health every time I’ve seen her - I usually try to schedule on the days she works but honestly I’ve had good experiences with all the hygienists when she hasn’t been available. I live south but drive to the Domain to continue working with the same team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Javier Perdomo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience, they took my husband with an emergency in just 1 day, they also got me a cleaning appointment for the same day! Stephanie was incredible and she helped me with everything even with the Invisalign process! The hygienist i believe the only guy forgot his name 😅 he was incredible and it’s the first time i get a deep cleaning that didn’t hurt at all. Dentist was super funny and nice to talk with, she had really good recommendations and doesn’t seem like people that only want to get money out of you. Really good experience with all the front desk staff and can’t wait for my Invisalign treatment in couple weeks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Seth McKee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Swish Dental at the Domain truly sets the standard for exceptional dental care! From the moment I walked through the door, I was greeted by a friendly and professional staff who made me feel at ease. The office is modern, clean, and welcoming, creating an environment that feels more like a spa than a dental clinic.

The dentists and hygienists are incredibly knowledgeable and thorough, taking the time to explain every step of the process. I felt confident in their expertise and appreciated how gentle they were during my procedure. They also offer cutting-edge technology and services that made my visit efficient and comfortable.

What stood out the most was their attention to detail and genuine care for their patients. They truly go above and beyond to ensure you leave with a smile—both literally and figuratively! I’m thrilled to have found Swish Dental at the Domain and highly recommend them to anyone looking for top-notch dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blair Bravo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sarah my hygienist was so kind, and worked extra fast to get me out in a timely manner due to time constraints. Love swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Harrison
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Although the quality of their actual dental care (dentist and hygienist) are top notch, it is a poorly run administrative organization that is impossible to work with. Calls never returned; every request for the simple things like copies of records require multiple attempts. Multiple times, requests to speak with the dentist about a concern were never even conveyed to her. I learned later she'd never even know I'd tried to reach her, which she was upset about. I went to SWISH by referral for very high-cost procedures (Invisalign and veneers), but they delayed for so long in providing the formal treatment plan for veneers that I didn't get it until after they'd already ordered my Invisalign. I believed that the dentist's verbal estimate would be pretty much what the price was going to be, since she does this all the time. The treatment plan ended up being $2500 higher the verbal estimate and by that time it was too late to back out of the Invisalign. The practice manager never went over anything or asked if I had questions, I just received a link to their website to view it. When I asked for clarification on several proposed services I was told tersely, "That's just how we set our prices." They were asking for more than $9,000 then not willing to explain a single thing, nor discuss what elements might be flexible to make it more affordable. I went somewhere else for my veneers.
BOTTOM LINE: Wonderful dentistry if you have good teeth and don't need extensive treatments. Otherwise, be prepared for administrative problems.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jill Christy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Another great visit to Swish Dental at the Domain. Everyone who works there is always so friendly. Everything is so clean & efficient, and appointments always start on time. Lucero is great!  She patiently answered all my questions, and worked with me to get my services scheduled even though my schedule is kinda crazy. Totally recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andres Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Billy was fantastic—professional, thorough, and made the whole cleaning comfortable. One of the best dental experiences I’ve had. Highly recommend him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I enjoyed my visit here! The service was great and they really helped explain and break everything down. Definitely coming back

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Gil
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such wonderful people int he Domain office. Excellent service and welcoming atmosphere. Especially the guy at the front desk!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Unfortunately, I didn’t have a great experience. I wanted just to get my teeth cleaned, which I signed up online for as a new patient. I had to do this, do that, then they said I needed a deep cleaning of my teeth which is not covered by my insurance which out of pocket would be 150 dollars, then I can have a regular cleaning….8 weeks after.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Bartel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Domain is 100/10, especially for those of us who Hate the dentist. They are kind and informative. Answer every question with patience and are more than willing to walk you through X-rays and scans to thoroughly explain what’s going on. Ashley was incredible and we were laughing throughout the appointment. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Kluge
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience! I feel so educated and informed about my teeth after my first appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I typically love the service here, but went to get my teeth whitened and part of my gums were bleached. Wouldn’t be a problem (color will return) if it wasn’t so painful. They gave me a bell to ring, but it took them a while to respond. It couldn’t have been more than a couple minutes, but it’s tough to sit in a chair while the gums are burning even for a couple minutes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Mulcahy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had high hopes for Swish Dental at The Domain, but unfortunately, my experience was disappointing.

The front desk staff and hygienist were super friendly and welcoming, which I appreciated. I arrived right before my 3:00 PM appointment, and my cleaning was completed in about 35 minutes. After that, I waited another 20 minutes in the chair, expecting to see the dentist to review my X-rays and discuss any concerns.

At that point, I politely asked when the dentist would be able to see me, as I had a 4:30 PM appointment just five minutes away. Instead of offering a solution or apologizing for the delay, I was told I could just leave because "the dentist didn’t have to see me." This was incredibly frustrating—especially since I left work early to attend my routine 6-month checkup, expecting to get the full care I scheduled.

A dental visit isn’t just about the cleaning—seeing the dentist is an essential part of the appointment. The dismissive attitude and lack of concern from the dentist made it clear that my time and care weren’t a priority. I now have to schedule another appointment just to get the full service I should have received in the first place.

I won’t be returning to this location and wouldn’t recommend it to anyone looking for thorough, respectful dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jayne Mack
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit was excellent. The assistant,dentist and staff were very professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriela Valdez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had to call 3 times to get an email with a plan and prices of what I supposedly needed done. What they said I needed was about 2,400 usd and they said it was urgent or I would be in pain in less than 3 weeks. Went to México, 6 weeks ago, confirmed everything was fine, the mexican dentist didn’t even want to charge me because I didn’t need a thing. Thank God I saved that money.
Double check with another dentist before getting any procedure with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Izquierdo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t enjoy going to the dentist in general, but Swish makes the experience painless, quick, and very friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jalen Newell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Billy and Dr. Lawson were great! I appreciate the care they took for my teeth and their plan for me going forward to get the best smile. Thanks for everything!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Puru Shrestha
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent staff and doctor Arti Patel. Prompt service but prices for the procedure is in high end.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deijha Fields
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Today I went in for a wisdom teeth removal. I have a bit of a fear with dentists but I needed this tooth out ASAP lol. Doctor Patel and his tech assistant (she was so awesome, I apologize I couldn’t remember her name) were amazing. They were so kind and made sure I was comfortable every step of the way. The staff in general are all nice and friendly. My tooth was a bit stubborn coming out but we got it done. I definitely will be back :)
10/10 service

user_reviews_extended.Name: LEE Wen
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time at swish Dental. They did very thorough diagnostics in order to look at all current and potential issues. That process was easy and painless and we also spoke about any issues I had and they were able to propose possible solutions. Then they did a consult with me to discuss different potential options and costs. Once that was done I went to get a cleaning, which was my intention for going there. That went very well. The Hygienist was the most gentle I’ve probably ever had, which was great because at my previous dentist the hygienist was very rough. Also, my mouth doesn’t open that wide and this was the first time I have been told I could close my mouth. Usually I’m being asked to open wider than is possible for me. This dental cleaning experience was perhaps the best I’ve ever had in my entire life. This will be my go-to in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeri Michelle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel is so sweet and the dentist assistants are too! My tooth extraction was super painful, but he stopped many times to give me breaks & kept making sure I was numb enough. He had a lot patience with me as I was kind of being a difficult patient with my high pain level. He is professional, knowledgeable and explains things in a way that patients can easily understand the procedure/reasons for treatment. Truly angels here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia N
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My husband has gone here a few times and he likes the medical staff but we will find a new provider because they are bad at billing. His last visit, he asked how much the charges were for the day when he was handing over his credit card and the lady tersely responded "I don't know." So, they were charging him but didn't know how much. I checked the account and it was less than $30 but he doesn't know what the charge was for. (He just got a cleaning and we have insurance.) Then, 3 days later, he gets a text saying he owe $200+ more for the visit but no details. He's only been going here a few months and they can never tell him what he is being billed for. (The itemized bill we got previously showed charges for "credentialing positive adj" but they weren't able to tell us what that is.) I don't think it's a scam or anything but it feels like gross incompetence. We don't mind paying but it would be nice to know what we're paying for. They also try to do xrays every visit even if it's only been a couple of weeks.
No one should ever accept your credit card for payment unless they can tell you how much they are charging you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drew Helberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Actually one of the best dental visits I have ever had. Thanks to everyone who helped me out before the holidays!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raquel Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team here is always so nice! I looove Dr Lawson! She is so great! I have been making appointments here for what feels like close to a decade and continue to have consistently good experiences. ❤️ I want to recognize Anthony for being such a delight. He remembered my face and immediately got ahold of me when he saw my glasses left behind. I love him!! So many good experiences here. Ashley, my hygienist, made my cleaning fun too. The team also seems supportive of each other.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jacy jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was nervous about going here at first but due to an emergency situation this was the only option available. As someone who is very particular about my oral care, Dr. Arti exceeded my expectations! She was very knowledgeable, patient, and kind, working to meet all my needs and ensure I walked out satisfied.The front desk staff were also great - friendly, respectful, and informative.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Boush
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was overdue for a cleaning and needed to pick a new dental practice for my new insurance. I couldn’t be happier with my choice. They got me in the very next day, accommodated my deep cleaning and were super personable, jovial and thorough. Would highly recommend to anyone needing dental services. Special shout outs to Jay, Sarah and Dr. Lawson for making me feel so at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marta Munguia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am extremely scared and nervous of dentist and hygienist. I received the best care at Swish Dental that I have ever received before. They not only ease my mind and make my nerves a little less but they are so caring. I definitely recommend Swish Dental at the Domain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Summer Siddiqui
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been coming here for the past 9 months, after my husband’s recommendation and I couldn’t be happier! I had a few horrible dentist experiences and just stopped going for a few years. But there is hope now!
I love Dr. Mcghee, she is always so helpful, attentive, thorough in her explanations, and so pleasant. All of the assistants and front desk staff are also helpful. The environment is so calm, clean, and super high tech. The vibes are always nice, trendy/modern, and very comfortable. Definitely will be sticking to my Doctor and taking care of my dental health from now on!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmine Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at this location is seriously one of the BEST I’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting. I was informed every step of the way and everyone made sure I was comfortable the entire appointment. Going to the dentist is already a nerve wracking experience, but the Swish Domain staff will ensure you leave with a smile- pun intended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree Cortez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Swish Dental Domain for 3-4 years. I’ve always had a great experience with all staff members during my visits or on the phone. I’ve never waited too long, it’s always in and out quickly for each visit.

My only complaint is the location itself; there is never any parking since the small parking lot is shared with 4 other businesses.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcus Mora
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been to Swish a few times now and the visits have always been smooth. My new patient forms were sent to me via text which made it easy to fill out and convenient. When I was called back I was met with the assistant (forgot their name) but she was really knowledgeable and friendly. She took my X-rays and did a cool 3D scan on my teeth which was pretty awesome to see. I was then met with the hygienist and she cleaned my teeth. Literally the best cleaning I’ve ever had. I was then met by Dr. Lawson who did my exam and she was really pleasant and great bed side manner. There were a couple of things that came up in my evaluation but Dr. Lawson explained things in detail to me and gave me a plan. I’ve since completed all of my treatment with her. Front desk has been very helpful. They helped me apply for CareCredit which they offered me 12 months interest free so that I could afford my treatment in small monthly payments. Overall, I appreciate the entire Domain team and I would highly recommend  them. See yall in 6 months. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Billy and Dr. Palacios were wonderful! Amazing experience and I will be coming back, great staff and the music is good too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aileen Peralta
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've gone to Swish for 2 years now and they've done a great job. The front desk and staff are very nice. Appointments are easy to make/cancel/reschedule and they're response times are quick. Carlos was friendly and answered any questions I had. He cleaned my teeth really well and made sure I was comfortable during the cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Goodman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lawson is amazing! Super personable, friendly and knowledgeable. I’m one of her Invisalign patients and everything has been great! Friendly front desk staff and knowledgeable, efficient, thorough dental assistants. Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Manuel Sandoval
user_reviews_extended.Description: Way better this team here rocks Ian very happy with their service and knowledgement and experience my appointment was in time and don’t have to way a minute event front desk has a great service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was able to make an emergency appointment for next day to have a tooth extracted. It was about as pleasant as that sort of thing could be. No pain and the entire process of inspection, analysis, and extraction was less than an hour. Super friendly staff too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Esther Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience, This is what a dentist office should be. Smart, kind people, state of the art equipment, customized to your needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Sapp
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I moved to Austin about a year ago and I needed to find a new dentist. Living in the Domain area that is where I started my search and Swish Dental was the choice.

I went in and got a comprehensive exam and treatment plan as well as a deep cleaning today and it was nothing short of THE MOST AMAZING EXPERIENCE of my life!!!!

From scheduling to check in to dental work to payment, it was phenomenal. Ashley was the most detailed dental hygienist who was the best who explained everything and Dr Lawson was tremendous in her review and providing me with options in the treatment plan and a timeline to achieve the best possible dental health for me.

I'm still smiling about the experience and can't wait the next visit!! I love Swish Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby G
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updating my review to add- Dr. Lawson is amazing.
Still. She is an absolute gem and I am so grateful to have found her.
Absolutely love this location! The staff are fantastic. I came to Swish after a friend recommended and tried a different location near me in Cedar Park. I prefer to drive an extra 25 minutes for this location, worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Karides
user_reviews_extended.Description: Don't do it. Office failed to bill my insurance and will not return my calls to try to mediate the situation. ITS BEEN TWO YEARS. I had active coverage at the time and went to swish as they were in my network now my credit is being hit and when my insurance or I try to call the billing department never calls back or answer. It's so bad I have a 1000 bill and bad credit that is not even my fault as I had coverage, I've tried many times to get in touch with anyone and fail. My insurance says they never billed and billing continues to not return mine or my insurance calls.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia DESMAZES
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Awesome experience, I came on very short notice due to tooth pain.
The team at the Domain location was great, super friendly, helpful and took the time to finish my treatment without rushing and answering all my questions, even though doing so made then say after there normal closing time.
Special shout out to Ashley the dental hygienist, you where great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Korbe
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came back here to give them another try. They failed me once again. I was charged $250 for 2 x-rays and a 5 second exam & was told their X-rays were not advanced enough to see the problem and they need to refer me to another office. They don’t seem to know how to handle anything other than routine maintenance & then take advantage of patients by charging for useless services. Never again!
After receiving a second opinion, I did have an infection and did need antibiotics. The provider at Swish told me there was no infection present. I’m so thankful for My Dental at Tech Ridge! They got me in right away and started me on antibiotics and had me scheduled for treatment immediately.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Briana Hryniewicz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Hands down the most amazing dental experience I’ve ever had! As a new patient needing an appointment ASAP, I knew it might be tricky — but Adrian Gallardo made it happen. Adrian went above and beyond, providing every resource and option available, keeping me informed, and being incredibly accommodating while booking my appointment.

From the moment I walked in, the staff was so warm and friendly — I instantly felt at ease. And Dr. Loehr? Truly the most amazing and absolute best dentist I’ve ever met. He’s knowledgeable, honest, and genuinely passionate about helping his patients achieve their goals with ideal long-term solutions. He took the time to explain every option and process, answered all my questions with patience and kindness, and made sure I was comfortable every step of the way. I never felt rushed or judged, which is so rare and comforting in a dental experience.

It’s so hard to find a dentist like Dr. Loehr, and I am beyond thankful. If you’re looking for exceptional care, this is the place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tahnee Sauer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a SWISH patient for a few years now. Love the Domain location. My hygienist Fred was kind, friendly and did a great job - got my teeth clean nice & clean while still being gentle with the tools. 😁 The dentist was friendly and made me feel comfortable to ask any questions I had.
Happily recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlin Mattias
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience with so many hygienists at Swish, but Fred today was truly the gentlest I've had (and I did wait a while between appointments). All the dentists are prompt and professional. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Just Kisner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic dental care and service. Professional,  prompt and thorough. Always explains procedures and conditions. I had 4 front cosmetic crowns by Dr Lawson 7 yrs ago.  Beautiful and natural results. My dentist niece complimented the crowns.  Love this Domain location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: bob buehler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was very pleased with hygienist Sara(h)!! She not only provided a very thorough cleaning procedure but was also very gentle. In addition, she commented on some facial areas that might need a look from a dermatologist. That extra care for my health was so very thoughtful and very much appreciated!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Cole
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm not sure if I'm just an exhaust recent mom of two or if the service was just that good, but this was the most relaxed I've been in months! The service was friendly, quick and comfortable. Please keep up the great work, Milton, Dr. Lawson and Marnyce!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacque Mg
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a new patient at Swish. I made a great choice! It’s the most pleasant dentist office I’ve ever been to. Everyone on staff has been professional and friendly. The dentist and technicians are knowledgeable and share every detail about the condition of your dental health. Your suggested treatment plan is explained and options are presented. There’s none of the hard sell I’ve experienced in the past several years. (I actually boycotted all dentists for 2 years because of the unpleasantness and stress of office visits.) So far I’ve only had preventative services and the most thorough teeth cleaning I’ve had in decades. I’m looking forward to a long association with Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Belinda Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are so nice here, the dental hygienist was so professional and kind and the Dr was very communicative.  Front desk person has always been so welcoming also!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rove
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven’t been to the dentist in years and I faced no judgement about it. My initial appt for an exam and cleaning was clearly laid out, and done with all the accommodations I asked for (sunglasses and using my own ear plugs). For my second appt where I got a filling done Dr. Arti Patel was so clear with exactly what would happen, patient, and incredibly efficient. I didn’t specifically ask for a woman dentist but I’m so grateful that I was put under her care. My filling procedure was explained in detail and her assistant (totally forgot to get her name, she had long braids with a few highlights and wore it half up half down) was so sweet!! Having great care like this really eased my dentist anxiety. Oh and the front desk clerk is always so nice and for any tr4ns/NB ppl they get my name right every time even as I’m in the process of changing my name! Thanks yall!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cece Nev
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have a pleasant experience here. The hygienist and all of the staff are friendly to me and my family when we come in. I never feel super bad about the way the shape of my mouth looks like I have when going to other dentists. Nobody is judgmental or condescending, just friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith Rossman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Showed up one minute before the appointment due to traffic. Greeted and treated with friendly stress free care. Although the trip made for a rough morning it was still a great start to the day. Complete opposite review of my last dental review. Big thanks to all the team members at Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debra Carter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve never liked going to dentist,  I was very frightened of the thought of even going, well to my surprise I had no choice but to go,  I chose Swish dental.  Let me tell you, Dr. Patel and his assistant both made me feel so comfortable, and so safe.   They care. Thank you .  I suggest if you’re “ify”  about going to dentist,  Get with Swish.  🧡💛🧡💛🧡

user_reviews_extended.Name: dylan dupras
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was my first time going there where so nice and fast def will be back

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Swening
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is so nice and very professional. They take their time with their patients. Explain everything in a way I understand.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Somporn Suktua
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at the office today. I really appreciate how much the team values patients’ time; my appointment was prompt and well-organized. Everyone was attentive, knowledgeable, and made sure to communicate clearly about my care. It’s reassuring.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Cuellar
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first experience at Swish was wonderful, and first impressions are everything! It was easy to book my appointment online, and I was seen right on time. Everyone was friendly and professional, and I walked away with confidence in my smile. I'm already looking forward to my follow-up cleaning, and I don’t think I’ve ever said that about a dental visit before!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Priester
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental experience at Swish with Billy and Dr Fernandez. Thorough cleaning and great customer service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Holland
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Swish Domain for around two years now. I have a had a couple of frustrating experiences with them and some visits that were not 5 star. They seem to have either a large team or high turnover because I've seen a different hygienist and doctor every time. However, I wanted to write a review for my recent visit. My hygienist Ashley was great and very thorough. Her cleaning and exam made my prior ones seeming rushed. Even the fluoride was actually applied to my teeth and stayed on for hours instead of just flung all over my gums. Would recommend scheduling with her if that is possible. Dr Loehr was very friendly as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Porfie Diaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Other than the parking situation, which really is out of their control, I had a superb experience. I’ve been going to Swish Dental for over five years now. This was my first time at this location but the staff here were very welcoming, friendly and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Heath
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update:  Saw a doc here for TMJ.  Suggested conservative efforts first with a night guard.  Agreed with that approach.  Took over a month to get the night guard in from the lab.  Had to call several times to find out where the night guard was.  Front office staff never called back after stating they would.  Front staff appeared unconcerned about the delay.  Not a happy customer any longer.

Was beginning to waver when I realized every time I went in, I saw a different hygienist and dentist.  No consistency between visits.

Original review:  Very friendly staff.  Sarah, the dental hygienist was excellent.  Lots of cool tech - I love new gadgets.  Only disappointment was to learn they do not do Cerec crowns.  If I should need a crown, I will get it done by a DDS that does Cerec crowns.  Other than that, I will continue to use Swish.  These comments pertain to the Domain location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pea Body
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in immense pain for MONTHS after going to my last dentist office. I took a leap of faith and tried swish and they actually listened to me and followed up to check on me. They remember my preferred name and asked me my pronouns, I love this office with my entire heart and they will continue to get my business for as long as they’re open and hopefully that’s a long time. I will continue to recommend them to everyone I meet. Thank You Swish, yall are absolutely amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Black King
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was very comfortable and pleased with the outcome of my treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shavonne Maldonado
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely had the best experience at Swish Dental at The Domain! The entire staff from the front desk, to the dental assistants, to my amazing dentist Dr. Audrey Lawson were all so friendly, welcoming and knowledgeable. I am so incredibly happy with how my teeth/smile turned out after completing my Invisalign treatment! My teeth were VERY crowded and was not the easiest of cases, but Dr. Lawson put together a treatment plan for me and I trusted her - I am SO happy I did because I have never felt more confident with my smile! I would definitely recommend Swish Dental to family/friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annamaria Scaccia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Normally, the service is great, but my last experience didn’t meet expectations. I’ve had yet another new dentist, and the cleaning wasn’t as thorough as usual. I am hoping this is a one-off.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Kuenstler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a broken bridge, and needed an emergency appointment. I called at 8:15 am and got an appointment at 9:00. Everyone was friendly and helpful, from the receptionist, to the technician who took the x-rays, to the dentist who discussed my options for treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Forte
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updated 12/31/2024. Not a good visit this round. I arrived 20 minutes early and was taken back 10 minutes late. Waited for the dentist consult for another 10 minutes after cleaning. I was instructed to wait for cash out (another 5 minutes) after I already paid at the front desk, had to ask if I could go. I had a different hygienist and dentist on this visit, no clue why. Sorry Swish, not a terrific experience.

This was my first visit to Swish Dental as a new patient. Everyone involved in my dental visit was excellent. The team was very thorough and explained everything. Dr Lawson was great, she made sure I understood everything was ok. Teeth cleaning with hygienist was great, I was comfortable all the way through. Team offered multiple options for different potential dental issues. Great visit with Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Gasper
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience during my dental visit with Dr. Lawson and her amazing assistants at Swish Dental. The team was highly skilled and made me feel comfortable throughout the appointment. I greatly appreciated the time they took to educate me during my visit. It's always wonderful to receive informative and helpful insights from the dental team at Swish Dental.  I would definitely recommend their services!

user_reviews_extended.Name: cookie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ashley was very thorough and empathetic throughout my examination and cleaning. Dr. Parth gave clear and tailored advice about my wisdom teeth and frontbite. I am definitely making this my regular dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carla Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn’t been to a dentist in a few years due to a bad experience. The staff at Swish dental was very kind and caring.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sahil Bambulkar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was very friendly, informative and helpful! Would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shanna Schiller
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been getting my routine cleanings at swish for a few years and recently started my Invisalign treatment. I went in today for my routine cleaning and an Invisalign check in and had a dental hygienist I have never had before. His name is Fred and he is PHENOMENAL. He has incredible bedside manner and talks through every step of the way. Very thorough and takes his time to make sure you are having a great experience. I can not say enough good things about my experience there today. Highly recommend, and it you get Fred you are in for an extra bonus!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Kalapati
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Comply or leave.

If I could give Swish Dental negative stars, I would. Here's why:

I went for a dental cleaning this week and they asked me to get x-rays. I told them that I have never had a cavity in my life and I don't need them every year. It's a waste of money, time, and also unnecessary radiation. I was told that the office requires it at least once a year because it was their "standard of care" and there were no exceptions. I understand that most people would benefit from this policy, but it's not necessary in my case and they told me that I wouldn't be able to continue with their practice unless I received x-rays at least once a year. They also said the doctor wouldn't even do an exam because I didn't get x-rays. "There would be nothing to see..." As if you can't see any cavity or other dental/ oral health issue in your mouth with just your eyes.  This is absolutely ridiculous!

Dental care (like any medical care) should not be "one size fits all." It should be individualized for each patient's needs. Patients should be allowed to refuse treatments and tests without being kicked out of a practice. I was also told that I probably wouldn't find a dentist anywhere that would allow me to reject x-rays because all of them have the same policy.  Swish is clearly only concerned with making money and doesn't really care about the patient's individual needs. I guess they don't want healthy patients who only need routine cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edward Mckinley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I over slept for my appointment and the team was able to get me in with the same friendly service as if I was on time thank you for helping take care of my gum health I truly appreciate you ❤️🫡

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Malito
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent dentists office! Forms are easy to fill out. Staff are always on-time and helpful. Insurance and/or fee information are clear and concise. They use great technology, including 3D models/images of your teeth, so the hygienists and dentists can show you what the problems are and how to fix them. They also had a TV on the ceiling playing Seinfeld that I could watch while they were doing work on my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience is similar to that of the other 1-2 star reviews. Truly a terrible experience all around. Go here if you want rude receptionists, no parking, and extensive sales pitches.

I came in for tooth pain -- 3 appointments, over $600 in charges, with more being processed (and denied) by insurance by the day, I still have not received the care for the tooth that was bothering me -- though I did get a new chip in that tooth from the dentist. I had so many X-rays I finally had to ask "Is this really necessary?" to which they said, no we can skip them (???!!!)

I was told I would need a deep cleaning, only to have the "deep cleaning" take 10-15 minutes and be told by the hygienist how healthy my teeth were compared to others getting deep cleans. Naturally, much of the deep clean is not covered by insurance and is completely out of pocket expense.

Not only that, when I asked for a receipt I had 2 folks say they had sent it; it was not. Only for a third to say it took so long to send because they needed to "make sure it was correct" (After they had already charged my credit card, of course).

Rude, unprofessional, and expensive. The positives: the hygienist I worked with was polite and efficient. My teeth look better than before, but it came at a cost. (And critically, my tooth still hurts. A lot)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dawn K Bria
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lawson & staff made me feel comfortable for a procedure since I had recently had surgery on my back & being in the chair was causing some discomfort. They made a makeshift pillow for me to lay on. They always make sure I’m comfortable & taken care of. For someone that grew up in the 90s & has some dental PTSD, they are awesome & attentive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Winnie Magdamo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Swish Domain. They have a nice and friendly staff. So easy to book an appointment. Thank you, Ashley my hygienist for the day. I feel like a fresh, clean and shiny car again. Awesome job.😉🙌

user_reviews_extended.Name: FRAN COMO
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am new to Austin and everyone at Swish Dental was amazing and friendly! I met with DDS Larson and she was highly professional, knowledgeable and for the first time I didn’t fear the dentist!!! She and her dental assistant explained every step they were taking to help me in my time of need. The front desk receptionists were just as helpful with cost and procedure information. I would highly recommend Swish dental. I had a very positive experience and was happy to make my next appointment.Anthony was very professional and got me an appointment today! I saw Abigail again and she’s amazing and very thorough. She explained everything clearly and it shows that she cares for her patients. Glad I found Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JustAReviewer
user_reviews_extended.Description: As much as one can enjoy the dentist, I always do! Audrey and her team of hygienists are so personable, friendly, and knowledgeable. I've been going here for four years now, and I wouldn't go anywhere else. I also appreciate their team of insurance experts to help me understand and use my full benefit for a variety of services. Thank you ladies!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edna Duran
user_reviews_extended.Description: All the staff at Swish Dental are phenomenal. Dr. Lawson and her team are caring and provide education throughout the whole visit. Truly enjoyed my experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John & Michael Brancher
user_reviews_extended.Description: If I could leave a negative star review I would. This morning I showed up for my appointment after I had taken the day off from work, taken a Xanax and arranged transportation to and from the office only to get into the dental room and told the individual doing my service had called off. The staff told me they were aware of this at their meeting at 8:15. My appointment was at 9. They never attempted to contact me and let me know. Even when I walked in the door at 5 till 9, they didn’t let me know. I will not be booking again and will let the clients from my employer that come here know my experience. There was zero empathy or care. 10/10 would not recommend. I already have a distrust in dentists and this just continues to reconfirm it. They don’t give a single ounce of care when it comes to patients. Just a number and a wallet.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tatiana La Riva
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my first time at this dentist, and it went very well. I had a painless cleaning without getting my face dirty. The entire staff seemed very professional and friendly. The only thing is that I had to listen to many explanations from different people instead of just one person giving them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Sander
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was promptly welcomed into the office and immediately taken back for X-rays and a scan of my mouth.

Dr Lawson saw me a short while after those tests were done, and she carefully and thoroughly explained oral appliances for the treatment of sleep apnea. We discussed the price of the appliance she prefers to use and the reasons she likes it, as well as alternatives.

The presentation was clear, concise and informative. I learned a lot. I am grateful to all personnel I interacted with, and am seriously considering doing what has been suggested to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rani Spaulding
user_reviews_extended.Description: I know every time I go to see Sahra I am in great hands. She is amazing and knows how to care for my implants and very detailed. The staff is so friendly and welcoming. I enjoy going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: vishwas goel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently moved to Austin and have been searching for a good dentist. I am glad that a friend recommended me this place. I had the best dental service here. Ashley meticulously performed deep cleaning of my teeth and gums. Plus the entire process from checkin to treatment to checkout was very smooth without any wait or delays. I would highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: De'Night De'Night
user_reviews_extended.Description: I think it was a great experience and I look forward to future treatments and caring for my teeth there!

user_reviews_extended.Name: McKenna Dahlquist
user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved across town, but still come to this Swish because I love Dr Lawson so much. She’s tremendous at remembering details about my dental history.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Stenstrom
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first appointment at the Swish Dental Domain office this week.  I was a bit nervous as always about going to the dentist.  I had the most comprehensive dental exam that I’ve ever had….they made a 3-dimension image of my upper and lower teeth.  Dr Audrey Lawson was great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keely Patridge
user_reviews_extended.Description: My front tooth that has been bonded since an accident over 20 years ago broke over the weekend.  Swish Dental at the Domain was able to get me in on Monday. Dr Crystal did a really great job! She is a great dentist & also artist. I was worried it might look strange but it looks better than it did before the bonding broke.  I am very appreciative to both the dentist and the hygienist. They were both very nice and did a great job.  Everyone at Swish was very helpful and nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sterling Coker
user_reviews_extended.Description: The older I’ve become, the more nervous about finding a new dentist I’ve become. However, Swish has been an incredible experience! Every staff member there has been accommodating and extremely helpful in assisting me with understanding and discovering the best possible next steps for me in my dental journey. Honestly, I can’t say enough good things about the place! 🦷🪥

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Chang
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best dental cleaning at the Swish Domain office by Ashley. She really took time and effort to make my teeth exceptionally clean. I will definitely go back and request her again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erik Sharp
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place pays their customers with gift cards for their “good” reviews. Do not go here, it is a scam of a business. We had something done in May of 2023, insurance paid their portion and then we paid the remainder (our portion was several thousand dollars). We were notified last month (November 2024) that the insurance has changed what they covered and are demanding we pay over $800 or they will send us to collections…

Again, they pay for good reviews. I know we live in a world where scams are everywhere but it’s sad that dental offices are now being added to that list.

To avoid these kind of issues in the future find a local family dentist. This is the lesson we’ve learned. Do not go to any commercial dentist office (a chain or brand of dentist - if there’s a nespresso in the lobby or kombucha on tap, go somewhere else).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Ford
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time at Swish Dental and it was such a pleasant experience. Dr Magee was thorough in her assessment and so easy to communicate with. I look forward to having all my dental needs met at Swish Dental! If you are looking for a caring dentist in the Austin area I highly recommend! S Ford

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was so welcoming and efficient! It was a pleasant(!) dental visit!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karem Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place!  Nicole, the dental hygienist was awesome!  We had to do deep gum cleaning.  One day for the right side and another day for the left.  I got to put on some Netflix, and she only had to use the topical numbing solution, so not shots.  I was so relaxed both times that my Fitbit logged in my times there as sleep!  Anthony and the girls up front are very friendly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot speak highly enough of Swish Dental in the Domain! Every single person is extremely professional and personable. I can say it’s an absolute joy to go to this dental office!

From the receptionists to the billing staff; from the assistants to the hygienists; from the dentists to the orthodontists - I have not had a single bad experience in the year I’ve been going there.  And I have never waited more than five minutes for any one of my appointments!

Dr. Abigail is not only a phenomenal dentist, but she is an exceptional orthodontist; I have been blessed to be under her care for the past two years.

Not only is their technology in the office for dentistry and orthodontics stellar, but the text messaging reminders and pre-check in make the entire process seamless.

I am so glad I found Swish Dental, and I know you will be too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dave Archer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Went in with an infected mouth injury, they prescribed orajel that I can get over the counter. Said “if it still hurts in two weeks come back for a biopsy”. Totally missed the point.  Pain and infection present that day, I was already a week in.  I don’t need a biopsy, I need real medicine.

Saw my GP the next day who gave me antibiotics for the infection after looking at me for like five seconds.  If it wasn’t covered by insurance I’d be asking for my money back.  Total waste of time. One star for booking a same day appointment.  Otherwise no stars.

Wouldn’t have left a review except I got like four texts asking me to write a review.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reeve Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: They have great dentists on their roster, but they are too big for their own business model. I have quite a few dental problems, so I made some appointments and started taking care of it all. I had zero issues with scheduling appointments until you need to reschedule one. My schedule at work changed and I needed to change my “regularly scheduled cleaning” but they didn’t have any available appointments for 3 months. So I waited until they emailed me again, and I made an appointment. When I went to schedule my appointment, there were PLENTY of available dates to choose from. So I chose one. And then again, my work schedule changed, and I attempted to reschedule my appointment. Again, I’m told that there are no available appointments until December 6. They offered to send me to a different location, with a different doctor who has never met me or have any idea about the treatment plan that I laid out with my own dentist. So my question is this: How is a dentist office going to contact me to make an appointment for my semi-annual cleaning, and then tell me that there aren’t any appointments for 3 months? So I decided to cancel my appointment completely and find a new dentist. All of a sudden, they are very apologetic and are willing to squeeze me in on another day of my choosing. Seems like they don’t care about your scheduling needs until it interferes with the money they make. I don’t know. If you want the fast food version of dentistry, where no one knows who you are, and you see a different dentist every time you schedule an appointment, then this is the place for you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gregory Villareal
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is by far the best dental care I have ever gotten.  The environment is clean, their workflows are well organized, their technology is awesome, and Dr. Lawson is based! The whole staff is motivated and super friendly. I have not had any negative experiences in all of my visits over the past year. 10/10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jon Garrett
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Domain location is the real deal. Dr. Audrey Lawson powered through a mediocre LSU football season to deliver excellent service with immaculate skill.  Her team of dental assistants—not sure of the proper terminology, but I once dated a dentist (who, other than getting me stuck on a mountaintop in Arizona that one time, was pretty cool, so I wouldn't want to mess this up) —was on point: caring, inquisitive, and oh-so-gentle with the mouth tools. I'm not big on meds, but for those who live dangerously, I'm sure they're using the good stuff for the tough procedures. 11 out of 10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yolanda Robles
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I love coming to Swish Dental Domain for our dental work. The office is nice and always feels very clean. The amazing staff make for an enjoyable experience every time

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pal Pica
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love coming to this location. They’re always so quick and friendly. I had not been to the dentist since before Covid and I am amazed at how advances have been made especially in the Imaging of my teeth. Thank you for great service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amit Kanusing
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit at Swish was a wonderful experience. Everyone from the hygenist to the doctor were great. I felt I was in good hands. Everyone explained to me in a clear manner any of my issues or when describing the xrays and what I should be looking out for. I enjoyed my experience here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kayla Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my first visit at Swish Dental Domain, and I would highly recommend! All the staff I met were very friendly and helpful with all the questions I had. The office is in a convenient location and was very clean. I especially liked how they went over a detailed breakdown of my dental insurance coverage and were completely upfront about what costs I could expect, and walked me through my financing options. The hygienists and Dr. Lawson provided me care that felt very attentive and genuine. I’m so glad I found this dental office and look forward to my next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tori McClure
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t even begin to describe how wonderful my visit was— which is a sentence I never thought I would say about going to the dentist. I’m naturally an anxious person, and Dr. Magee was kind, patient, and answered all of my questions!! I never felt rushed, and I’ll never go anywhere else because of her. Loved!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Stepien
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you’re pregnant make sure you ask if you need a consent form from your OB. I wasn’t told this when I made the appointment, checked in online, or checked in day of. I was actually told that they had the office repainted so that would have gotten caught during their morning huddle, but rather had to spend time rehanging the artwork.

While I was in the chair, I was told that I had to get this form sent over or i’d have to reschedule. Luckily I was able to get this quickly. But because it “took so long” I potentially might not be able to get my cleaning done and would have to reschedule that. On top of all that, they didn’t have me registered in their system but actually had me listed at attending a different location. Which was untrue, so I had to prove that I actually went to this location. Even upon that, they were unsure why this would happen, regardless they didn’t have my previous records on file to compare this appointment to.

All in all, the appointment took 2 hours.

The dentist is amazing and I loved her energy and her ability to communicate what was needed with my hygiene and what should/shouldn’t be done. But the staff and front desk is yet to be desired.

Just come prepared for something to arise during your appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Seabolt
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is clean and with modern decor. The staff is friendly! They get you in and out. Robert the hygienist was wonderful and did a great job cleaning my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Faye Qin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I strongly advise against visiting this dentist. Their competence is lacking, as their treatments consistently result in excessive bleeding and discomfort. Additionally, they automatically schedule annual appointments without consent, imposing a $50 charge for cancellations. Even upon requesting cancellation, patients must annually call to ensure their appointment is canceled.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julianna Navarro
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the worst experience. I came in for a yearly checkup and a cleaning. They basically said they had to squeeze me in for the cleaning, and the hygienist Carlos was so quick I think he did the entire cleaning in 10 minutes. He barely touched my back teeth, he didn’t floss all my teeth and was careless in making sure I was comfortable - he was very rough and splashes water all over my face and could care less. He didn’t even do a complete cleaning and my teeth felt unclean walking out. Very disappointing. Terrible experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Swish for a few years and I'm always very happy with them. The service is top notch. Everyone is always friendly and answer all questions without making you feel rushed or taken advantage of. The dental hygienists are all great. Friendly, knowledgeable, quick, rarely any waiting.  They make you feel comfortable and I really find going to the Dentist a pleasant experience these days, one I no longer dread since switching to Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L Boyd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a filling come out at 2am. The nerve sensitivity was not fun. I am a patient of the Bull Creek location, but to be seen soon as possible I was sent to the Domain location. Dr. Abigail Gill DMD was great, and the office was very courteous, professional and friendly.They answered all my post procedure questions and explained my tx plan well. The entire process from scheduling, to checking in to checkout was a great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every bit of my visits have been wonderful! The entire staff is so nice and accommodating. The receptionist squeezed me in on very short notice and helped speed up my paper work process to ensure I was all good to walk right into my appointment. My hygiene assistant, hygienist, and doctor all formed great convo and showed genuine interest in me. Over all, the staff is very genuine and created an enjoyable experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Holladay
user_reviews_extended.Description:
]I had the pleasure of meeting the staff and getting acquainted with their practice at a local event and I am so glad I did. The entire staff is all young and really friendly.

I recently moved here from out of state and it is a big relief when you find an honest and trustworthy dental practice. Luckily, I found it at Swish!

Dr. Lawson is very attentive and helps explain their processes. I had my normal checkup, X-ray, cleaning done during my first visit at the Domain location. I also had them do the Boost teeth whitening. I am very happy with the results!

I highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Richàrd
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today I had my first visit with the staff at Swish Dental, and I have never had a better dental experience! The staff is incredibly hospitable, warm, and thorough. They are extremely tech-forward, and educate their clients about the metrics they use to help treat you. I have never felt more taken-care-of in a dental chair. They are just they best, and I highly recommend them for all dental and orthodontia needs. And a plus, the aesthetic of the office is so warm, modern, and cozy; it's a home. I look forward to my future of care with the amazing staff at Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynn Barstow
user_reviews_extended.Description: Last few times I came in for a cleaning, I couldn't tell one had been done, afterwards! Not the case today with Nicole. Good banter, real difference in post visit feel. Good experience. Also worth noting, on my last visit I left freaking out after an alarmingly high blood pressure check. Enough that I booked a physical the next week. All wound up being fine after my hair was on fire for a few days. Nicole didn't botch the reading. Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ronan Shackelford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sahra was the best hygienist I've every had. She made me fell comfortable by relating to my problems while being compassionate. Even though she was wearing a mask most of the time, I could hear the smile on her face. Never experienced care like this. What a wonderful person. Swish, you hit the jackpot when you hired this wonderful women. Thank you Sahra!

user_reviews_extended.Name: bob buehler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly business and great dentist. Try them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: West
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went here 6 years ago. They refused to clean my teeth because they said I needed a deep cleaning first.  They also diagnosed me with 3 cavities that need filling.

I left and got a second opinion. Long story short I never got a deep cleaning and have yet to have a single cavity filled. Just got another clean bill of health from my latest dentist.

These folks are liars just interested in coming up with fake diagnoses to rack up a big bill. Don’t trust them. Find a good mom and pop local place instead.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Spencer Harrison
user_reviews_extended.Description:
There were some delays (40 minutes between xray and cleaning). It sounds like it was because of a problem with some equipment. They made it up to me with a free teeth whitening appointment. I'm glad they made it up or else it probs would've been a 2 star because all the waiting.

But this dentist was the highest tech dentist I've ever been to. Good service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dustin Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a new patient to Swiss and very glad I made the switch here. The first thing I noticed is they are incredibly professional, very organized, and the facilities are very clean and modern and in a great location. Also, a great perk is new patients get Free teeth whitening! I have some work that needs to be done and I was surprised with how affordable my treatment plan is going to be. All in all I left there feeling very impressed and glad I switched to them. Keep up the impressive work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny Morales
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in for a cleaning and daily 6 month check up. Mind you that they called to remind me and were able to work around my busy schedule. The staff upfront were quick in checking me in a greeted me with with excitement. KC the dental assistant was very attentive and well prepared for my visit. The dental hygienist Dustin took his time and did a great job informing me on how to maintain healthy oral hygiene. Dr. Lawson has been great from the beginning, very responsive and detail oriented. She also took the time to provide options about my tendency to grind my teeth when I sleep at night. Overall my experience with Swish Dental has been nothing but exceptional. Would highly recommend to those looking for a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Saxon
user_reviews_extended.Description: After my first visit, I left this dental office really impressed. It’s clear that every member of staff at Swish strives to create a great experience, and everyone from front desk, to the doctors themselves seem genuinely happy to be at work and extremely friendly which is a nice change for a doctor/dental office where most people don’t even smile at you. Swish is efficient and seem to have some really cool, new, technology which makes the checkup a little more robust. Another thing I really liked was the fact that there was very little sitting around and waiting. After getting into the chair for my checkup, I had several different X-rays/images taken, a cleaning, general checkup, and treatment plan within an hour to an hour and a half....something that probably wouldn’t have been done in one visit at other offices. Glad I followed other good reviews and went to this office. It will definitely be my primary dentist now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristine Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental was more than I expected. Great front office, hardly any wait time, friendly staff... I felt welcomed and appreciated for choosing Swish Dental. My hygienist was friendly, easy going and made the exam and X-rays easy. I had no chair sitting time, waiting for someone to remember I was there. Every bit of time I was there was spent on my appointment. The dentist asked what was important to me for my treatment. She detailed what she believed should be addressed, when and how long it would take. The financial advisor explained the payment structure for each procedure I asked about. I am happy I found Swish Dental. I believe I will be in good hands for my dental health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LeeAnna L
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Swish Dental is amazing! Very professional, top tier customer service and they made me feel comfortable. I appreciate that everyone genuinely likes what they do and made sure to provide excellent experience for me as a new client. Highly recommend them

user_reviews_extended.Name: Herbert Blanco
user_reviews_extended.Description: After my second visit, I feel so happy about Swish Dental Domain. Great Service and friendly environment. I was a little afraid of the deep cleaning procedure but Meredith did an amazing job walking me through the process and actually it was not painful as I thought it will be. Great location and plenty free parking. I will only suggest to improve the lighting inside the rooms it looks a little bit too dark.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shaughnessy Herren
user_reviews_extended.Description:
AMAZING! I was thrilled to be greeted by a black dental tech (I think that's her title) to start. Then the hygienist was so gentle and kind; reminding me to focus on my breath and validating. Followed by the dentist, who was thorough in her explanation and what the treatment plan was. They listened, gave options and didn't make me feel like I HAD TO get services. I'm excited to go back again!
Would recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: B. Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for a routine cleaning, was asked at check in if I wanted the fluoride treatment, I declined. Was sent a link to my phone to check in, the first page of the online form would not let me proceed unless I consented to the fluoride treatment. I informed the front desk and they apologized and sent me a new link. Imagine if I hadn’t noticed that and just breezed through the paperwork without being thorough? Was asked during the cleaning if I wanted the fluoride treatment again. I declined again. Afterwards, the hygienist set a new appointment date for October and I asked if she could please not do that because my schedule changes every 6 months and it will be different by then. She refused to cancel the appointment and told me to just call later to change it. Imagine if I forgot to do that? I’d have to pay the cancellation fee. They are VERY intentionally tricky here. It’s evident that profit is the number one priority and not your dental health. The dentist looked at my teeth for about 13 seconds. I will not be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michaelanne Hurst
user_reviews_extended.Description: They got me in same day for tooth chip emergency and the staff were absolutely Ahhhhhmazzzing! I now have a new dentist in Dr. Lawson! I am extremely satisfied! I also am enrolled in their invisalign program and it is an amazing process.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ram
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The dental assistant was dangerously incompetent. During my first visit my blood pressure reading was 33/34. Clearly an error. The employee first said this was normal. But agreed to retry. Next it showed 171/85. Clearly a high reading. Again, the employee said it was “normal”.

The worst part was the same employee kept messing up the x ray scans so instead of taking 8 images she ended up taking closer to 16. Exposing me to unnecessary radiation.

X rays are meant to be taken for helping to diagnose specific issues not as a standard for all check up patients. I reported no dental issues or pain, yet was made to do 2 different x ray examinations, all so Swift could charge the insurance company.
I was also not given a led apron for the first 10 x rays, until I requested one.

Lastly I was quoted $400+ for a tooth night guard. I can get them online for $3. What a joke.

The actual dentists are really good though.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hao Xu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Not recommend this clinic. Had a very easy filling and after that I can’t floss my teeth. Getting busy with life and came in 4 months later, change to another dr. She examed and fixed this. After this is done, the billing department billed my insurance for the fix! Why?! They are just fixing the problem of the filling they made. Why my insurance or anybody else should pay for it? Shouldn’t Swish dental be billed to?

BTW, Dr Lawson helped me fix the floss issue. She explained things well and did the fix in less than 3 minutes. Totally wish i had seen her before.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeannie McLearen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience! Everyone was very friendly and professional. It all ran like a well oiled machine. I received a very thorough exam and cleaning. The tech, hygienist, and doctor each took time to explain everything and answer questions. There was no judgment and no pressure. They were very knowledgeable and inspired confidence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nina Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were especially awesome across the board. I'm old and had the best dental hygienist ever. No pain at all!! Very kind and patient and did an excellent job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Strachan
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first time to the dentist in forever and first time trying swish. Everyone was exceedingly nice and pleasant to talk to. Wait time was very short, the people were attentive and happy to talk to me. Being my first time in we had to do every check and they were quick as could be. Additionally, they have TVs with Netflix so you can entertain yourself while they work avoiding the dreaded talking with your mouth open awkwardness. Can’t really say anything nicer. I bought the membership (makes total sense if you don’t have dental insurance) so I will be going back every 6 months. Happy smiles!

user_reviews_extended.Name: RaQuel
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best experience I had at a dental office. The dentist was very informative and knowledgeable and great to talk with. The staff was very very professional pleasant and friendly as well. Felt like visiting a youre favorite  nail salon !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Inkyung Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called Swish Dental when my crown fell out. Originally my decision was based purely on location, but I'm glad I called.  I was able to get an appointment the very next day. I've been a little hesitant on seeing a dentist in the past, but everyone was very welcoming and friendly. Dr. Lawson is super sweet and gentle. Tasha was very friendly and calmed my jitters.  Everyone made sure all my questions were answered no matter how trivial they were. My cleaning appointment with Chris was great. He was efficient, through and friendly.   I'm happy I found a great dentist office so close to work. I'll be back for more regular cleanings and try to floss more.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Y M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place for all your dental needs! The staff is friendly and always respond to your requests whether via call or in person. Every visit involves a check up by a hygienist first which I appreciate as it helps me assess and learn more about my dental health over a period of time. The dentists are pretty good and will advice whatever is best for you without trying to sell you a procedure. I also like the fact that they bring to your notice what’s included in your plan which has helped me gain services that I didn’t know I had already paid for via my plan. Schedule ahead though as they have a lot of visitors!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsey Roslin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I used to really like swish and the doctor are good but that’s it. Getting Invisalign from swish has been the most frustrating thing and I can’t recommend it. A few months into my treatment one of the techs said it was looking great and they were happy with it and ready for me to be done if I was. I was only a few months into my 8 month+ plan at the time and only a few trays in. I was so confused. Then she came back said she was mistaken and thought it was funny. I’ve been sent between multiple offices since “my” doctor moved who I never see. Got stuck wearing the same last nasty tray for 3 months, waiting for a response to get an appointment. Got scanned at the south location for my trays I’d wear before my retainer and told I could pick them up at the domain. Get to the domain and they have my retainer, not the other ones. Told I’d have to wait and be in them 3 more months before getting into the retainer. Then in the middle of the visit they talked to a different doctor, who didn’t come speak to me at all so who knows, who said I could just wear the retainer. Doesn’t seem like they are concerned with the quality of your smile at the end, just getting the money for it and getting you out. I’ll come back for the free whitening I’m supposed to get but that’s it. No doctor has looked at my teeth the last two Invisalign visits, which I would think is important since it’s the final ones, just the assistants. They kept saying there’s miscommunication but it seems like a lack of care. Would definitely recommend getting Invisalign elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree Kostelnik
user_reviews_extended.Description: Prior to my visit at Swish, I had not been to the dentist in 5 years and was very nervous about my appointment. The entire staff made my feel at ease the moment I walked in and the entire experience was one of the best I’ve ever had at a dentist appointment.
