In fact, had my previous dentist experiences been as good as my most recent one at swish; I would have gone to the dentist more often! Highly recommended Dr. Lawson she was the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Harrell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very professional and knowledgeable! First time client experience was amazing.
It had been awhile, 2 years, since my last dentist visit and Christine explained how the X-ray machine was going to rotate and why they took more X-ray pictures later.
She also scanned my teeth for a free teeth whiting mold!
Daniella, my hygienist, was absolutely wonderful. She explained everything she was going to do before the Dentist arrived and answered all my, sometimes silly, questions.
Dr. Lawson gave some great insights into why I have been having so many headaches. She showed me on the X-ray divots in my molars where I have been regularly clinching my teeth and told me how to prevent them from getting larger and to reduce my headaches. I have a custom night guard on order to also help.
Will definitely be returning to Swish Dental and recommending to all coworkers and friends in Austin.
Thank you Swish Dental Team for a great experience and will be seeing you soon. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Brunson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Never thought I would like a dentist
Update:
I moved away 2.5 years ago (shortly after leaving my original review) and just moved back. Even though it’s a bit of a drive, I returned to Swish. Dr. Lawson and all of the staff are just the best. I legitimately enjoy my time in their office, and am almost a little sad that my next cleaning is 3 months away. Cannot recommend enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Hatton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wasn't  sure about the process when I showed up at my first experience. I was relieved to find those at Swish would completely go out of their way to make my experience the best ever in my dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sean Mullen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was great! Check-in process was easy and everyone was informative and easy going. A visit to the dentist has always brought with it a negative connotation, but my experience at Swish Dental Domain couldn't have been more pleasant!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carye Edelman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Emergency root canal done in a few hours. Great Dr and Tech. Made me feel very at ease …

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mashelle Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Won’t take my children or myself to any other office. I personally have really horrible anxiety about going to the dentist. I’ve had some really bad experiences and these doctors helped me so much. Understood my anxiety and helped me over the years to not be so scared. Always the best care and assistance with any l thing I’ve needed! The dental assistants are always so great, funny welcoming and great with my kids since they were toddlers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krystal Li
user_reviews_extended.Description:
*Be aware of the pricing*

When I got my quote, there is a “laser bacterial removal” thingy that costs 50 dollars per quad. Nobody told me that’s optional and nobody said anything about being able to perform cleaning without doing that. My $200 just 💸.

Also their price is way above average clinic price. Please be cautious and look at your quote carefully, understand which is necessary and which is not because they are just going to “encourage” you to do everything.

Other than that everything is great, dentists and hygienist are encouraging and professional.😸

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah McConnon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have come to this location for several procedures... cleaning, fillings, crowns, temporaries. Each time, the front desk team is quick, welcoming, and clear about pricing and scheduling. The techs and assistants are kind, funny, and very professional. Dr. Lawson is knowledgable, easy to talk to, and she is not afraid to give it to you straight. The whole Swish Dental Domain team is awesome and has provided a great experience over and over again for someone who used to hate going to the dentist. Highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: trevor labrie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental has always been amazing each time i visit. I am greeted with a smile, actively listened to and all my questions get answered. They got me a great smile! I have Invisalign through Swish and it was such a great choice. Would definitely recommend. Going on 4 years being with Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TrimTech284
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was satisfied with Ashley performing my cleaning, she was very careful with sensitive areas and actually showed concern. Would highly recommend setting appointment with Ashly

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lee Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: After not going to the dentist my whole adult life, I nervously decided to give my neighborhood dental office, Swish Dental Domain, a try. I never imagined I could enjoy a deep cleaning or having all four of my wisdom  teeth extracted, but...here we are! Every single person in the office makes you feel welcome and at home. The dental care is excellent and performed by consummate professionals. The office is hip and lively. You can even watch Netflix while your teeth are treated. I can't recommend Swish Dental Domain enough! Dr. Audrey Lawson really takes the time to explain treatment plans and provides non-intrusive advice. I love going to the dentist now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Schechter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I usually hate going to the dentist. My first visit to Swish may have been my best experience at a dentist's office ever. Despite the size of the operation I felt that they really took the time to listen to me, understand my concerns, and make recommendations that were not just "upsells". I will be very happy to continue treatments here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maegan Mitchell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Danielle was amazing started visit off great. Dr. Magee, Fred and Teanna took great care of me and my smile!! Recommend any one to come in and visit this establishment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Like others, my previous dentist stopped taking insurance all together so I was looking to switch providers. I chose Swish due to the location and the seemingly relaxing atmosphere. There were things that I liked about Swish: the more "private" rooms for procedures, the television, the tech, and everyone was very nice and a pleasure to deal with. However there were things that really bothered me. I saw 4 different people during my visit. The initial person that took my scans, then a hygienist came and introduced herself and took a look at my scans, then the dentist came in very briefly before my cleaning then I guess they switched hygienists on me as a second one came and introduced herself and actually did my cleaning. The dentist did not come look at my teeth after the cleaning which was odd.

Every one of the 4 people I saw tried to sell me the same things. "Are you happy with the color of your teeth?"  "are you interested in invisalign?" I wish they would just communicate to each other that I said no on the first round of the sales attempt. It really made me so annoyed that I almost wanted to leave before my cleaning even began. If I want a special procedure then I will book an appt for said procedure. I was there for a cleaning, not to be sold to. I will be going back to have a cavity filled and hope there are no sales attempts at this appt or I will be looking for yet another dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today I had my first new patient visit and it couldn’t have been better! I loved the vibe of the office. It was very clean and open. It didn’t feel like a traditional intimidating dental office which I liked a lot. They have nice updated equipment and offer Netflix during the services. The staff was also wonderful! They were all very kind and knowledgeable. I’m very happy I found Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just came back from Swish Dental (Domain location). The staff was super friendly, smart and all had great sense of humor. The atmosphere is hip and modern with a legit Spotify playlist going on. They also had Netflix, in the private patient rooms, at the ready so you can distract yourself once the drilling starts. I definitely recommend this place! Oh, and the imaging technology was that next level s***!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vishal Nehru
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Instead of meeting with 1-2 people, I ended up meeting with 6-7 people (various assistants, hygienist, account mgr etc), which was rather confusing, especially because everyone is giving you their dose of upselling treatments and quasi-scientific commentary on your dental health and situation.

I would much rather only get health advice only from the actual dentist, and have the assistants simply do their job efficiently without adding to the discourse.

I think the practice would simply do better by listening more to the patient’s needs vs their training or sales agenda.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Bond
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was friendly and the hygienist was super gentle, which i really appreciate. Didn't have much time to talk to the DR for questions + the prices for Invisalign are also steep relative to other brands. All in all, as far as staff, accommodations and patient care Swish delivers a great service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rani Spaulding
user_reviews_extended.Description: My hygienist Sahra is great. She takes great care of me especially the cleaning of my implants. The office staff at the front and check out are always very nice and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tell Ash
user_reviews_extended.Description: Omg! I am so afraid of going to the dentist. I especially never enjoyed my cleanings. They provide an extremely excellent service and Dustin who did my cleaning helped me not be afraid of them anymore. He was so gentle and made sure I was comfortable every step of the way. All staff was so very sweet and informative. They really show they care for their patients. I felt like a celebrity here today with the advanced technology and care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yesha Jhala
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here was so friendly and helpful. They explained every step before they started and made sure I felt super comfortable, which I found very nice as this was my first patient visit. I would recommend this place for anyone that’s looking for a dental clinic in the Domain area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebeca Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish dental was a great experience coming from my past dental office. The environment, the hospitality is phenomenal. Their main focus is helping you achieve what you need and want. Friendly assistants and an amazing doctor. The receptionist is pretty young lady who immediately greets you at the door. Dilila the office manager is sweet and genuine. Over all a GREAT place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabelle Feliciano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely hate the dentist, but I love this office even more. Have been coming here for years and everyone is so wonderful. Fun and trendy, too. Audrey will have you fixed up no problem.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bianca Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been seen twice here and it hasn’t been the best experience. The most recent experience was the last. I came in for a cleaning and was told it would be out of pocket. I don’t like surprise billings but apparently
Swish Dental does. I’m currently searching for another dentist because transparency is important to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paige Dickey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an incredible time as a new patient at this office. The office staff was super nice and brought me in right on time. My hygienist was amazing and did a really thorough job. He was gentle and played the office for me during my cleaning. Dr. Loehr was super energetic even at 9 AM and did a great exam on me. I felt like I could really trust him. These people were all so kind, and this was the best dental visit I have ever had. The office is beautiful as well. Definitely will be returning and I’m happy to say I’ve found my dental home. ((also some reviews mention being charged for covid procedures but that is not happening. I was only charged $19 for fluoride which I wanted & knew wouldn’t be covered on my insurance :) ))

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mari DuBois
user_reviews_extended.Description: Anthony was so helpful both visits, getting me scheduled for my next visit, grabbing me a water that was double-cupped so it wouldn’t spill, adoring my little pup and overall kindness, helpfulness and patience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Troy Gras
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would give six stars if I could.  This office is exceptional!  It was hands down the most comfortable cleaning and exam that I have ever had.  Both my hygienist and dentist were EXCELLENT—friendly, skilled, and efficient.  I’ll definitely be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily P.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel and her team are amazing! The office was very clean and modern. During my new patient check up, they took the time to explain my x-rays, and the hygienist was super gentle cleaning my teeth. I would highly recommend this office to anyone looking for dental services. I'll definitely be back again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ST
user_reviews_extended.Description: CHANGED TO ONE STAR! They sent the bill that they said was no cost to collections $35. Insane!! Website is misleading. I was in sever tooth pain due to a broken wisdom tooth and the website clearly stated emergency removal. I booked the appointment with the hopes of a swift removal and all they did was refer me out with meds. Not sure why they would advertise services they clearly do not offer. I could have went to my dentist to get the same service. Only good news was my insurance took care of the co pay. - This was also untrue, than they called me after leaving a review threating me to take it down. Told me that they could discount the amount I needed to pay, (i was there for five mins before they told me i needed to co somewhere else.)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Scharf
user_reviews_extended.Description: Billy Askari did a great job with my cleaning today!

user_reviews_extended.Name: cara mahan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to Swish for almost 4 years and recommend it to everyone! Everyone is always so friendly, from the front desk to the doctors! They always remember me and ask me about my baby, and when I got married about the wedding! Chris is my absolute favorite and I look forward to seeing him each time I visit! They also offer free whitening so my teeth have never been in better shape! 😬😬😬 Because of them I use a sonicare toothbrush and take the time to care for my teeth properly. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian A Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After having a crown fall off on a Friday night, I was able to make an appointment here for the following Monday morning. Dr. Lawson was incredibly helpful and confident in coming up with a plan to fix my tooth. Given that I needed a root canal re-treatment, she referred me to an endodontist for that, which happened on Tuesday.

By Wednesday, I was back at swish with Dr. Lawson getting fitted for my permanent crown and getting a temp. Her assistant Vicky literally stayed by me the entire time and explained the process step by step. They are the dream team!

Dr. Lawson let me know that I can call her anytime with questions or concerns, and even followed up with a call later in the week to see how I was doing.

I know this is a ridiculously long review for a dentist, but I grew up with a negative perspective of dentists. Coming from a low economic background growing up on Medicaid, dentists always treated me and my mom like trash and never bothered to explain anything to us in terms of treatment and procedures. They would just go into my mouth, complete a procedure and bill Medicaid. Never even went over X-rays, treatment plans, etc.

So that’s why I’m very thankful to Dr. Lawson and her team at Swish for being transparent, kind and very professional every step of the way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donita Nowlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time receiving service. The customer service was awesome .From the front desk, technician and dentist  was great with explaining procedures and plan service. I’m glad someone referred me to Swish

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raul Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel has been my dentist for the past year. I can say I am very pleased with her and her work. Her chair side manner is of quality and she is thorough with her dental work which I appreciate. Dental offices make me nervous but the relaxed, clean, and organized environment they uphold has made my experience much easier. From the moment you walk in the front office staff are warm and inviting to the clinical staff in the back who make sure you are at home and at ease! They have really changed the way I see dental offices. They focus on maintaining quality patient care and excellent costumer service. It is something I take into consideration when looking for a provider for my dental care needs.  I have definitely recommended Swish Dental to my family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Stuart
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fabulous experience at Swish Dental! Dilila was such a sweetheart helping me set an appointment over the phone and was impressively knowledgeable of my insurance! I was taken back almost immediately where the assistant, Daniel, took my x-rays. He was super personable and professional. Chris, the dental hygienist, was a big ball of energy and I could feel him paying close attention to detail in my mouth. Dr. Lawson’s bedside manner made me feel comfortable and I was relieved to learn I just needed a couple retainers and no work done. The office had a state-of-the-art scanning system that Kaycee, another assistant, used to digitally create my retainer impressions. Super cool!!  Overall, the process was smooth and painless. I’d definitely recommend Swish Dental!! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Asha S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved the service I received at Swish when visiting Austin! Dr. Patel is genuine, kind and professional. She made me feel comfortable as I usually am not a fan of going to the dentist. She answered my questions and took very good care of my teeth. The process is painless! I would highly recommend the staff here- you can't go wrong.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Trejo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It's simple people, we all just want a genuinely good experience with any service we try. My visit to Swish reminded me how simple it can be to be just treated right.

As you walk in you'll receive the right treatment, from the greeting and overall friendliness of the staff to the aesthetic of the room. Most importantly I felt like my visit wasn't just another ticket number and instead was treated like a damn human being.

Treatment was well done with ease and care and it didn't feel like I was being pushed to do anything I didn't want and received very helpful advice.

The bar was low to begin with based on the other practices I've been to but Swish excelled regardless.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sam lackey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a rough experience as a child that led me to have a lot of anxiety and fear of dentists. I had a break in a tooth that I let get to the point of infection. Swish was the first place I made an appointment for. There was no wait, they led me to take my first x-ray, took me to a private room where I took two more x-rays and pictures and asked more information about the tooth. Then the Dr. Lawson came in and suggested the best route to take which was an extraction and had already sent in pain meds to my pharmacy. She referred me to the Swish clinic in Pflugerville and sent me to the front where I was able to make an appointment with them the very next day. Everyone I spoke to was friendly and kind and now while still fearful of the dentist I know I will be in good hands when I go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gayla Beaver
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very relaxing considering you are at the dentist!  It was highly recommended by my daughter and now I am highly recommending it to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sawyer Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in knowing I was going to have to do a deep cleaning. I have periodontia and it’s miserable every time I go to the dentist, usually involving them shooting a needle in my gums to numb them, and it’s just awful. I have never had a better experience at the dentist. Everything was so fast. I was called back for my appointment on time, they ran through everything at a good pace so I understood, and didn’t try to sell me a bunch of stuff I wasn’t going to need. I am actually looking FORWARD to my appointment on Friday to get the other side done. They didn’t have to inject numbing agent into my gums, they used a topical gel, they were very courteous and took good care cleaning my teeth. Will definitely call this my dentist from here forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Zuniga
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hate every part of going to the dentist. You might too, but not as much as me. Except here. I love Swish and everyone there. They truly make the experience manageable for me. I appreciate how considerate everyone is.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaye Price
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved my experience at Swisher Dental! Excellent service! I went in for regular dental cleaning and consult over cosmetic dental work. They presented my cosmetic dental options and left me to make my decision with no pressure on how to proceed. I loved their conservative approach to my dental health. Highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Di Noto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish has been amazing!! I have NEVER been a fan of the dentist and have not been since I was a teenager! I was extremely nervous when I finally made it into Swish due to a toothache. Everyone was so awesome from the moment I walked in! I almost fell asleep during my procedure because it was so relaxing. I have been a few times and every time has been great! I will continue to choose them for my dental needs! Love them!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I gave this place a chance because my two previous dentists discontinued my insurance (Cigna) and this place had wide availability. Don’t be fooled. Read all of the 1-2 star reviews.

I scheduled for a basic cleaning, and I ended up coming into the office prepared to sit for 1-2 hours for the X-rays, cleaning, and post consultation. What I ended up receiving was 2 hours of what seemed like a time share presentation. They sit you down with what I thought was the DH; however, she ended up being some sales rep selling you on all of these procedures that you do not need for an hour. Fast forward, the “dentist” (Dr. Shadman) and the “DH” finally visit me and tell me the same sales pitch, but because my appt. ran over their scheduled time they need me to reschedule.Their finance rep also tried to close their sale at the end and offered me “deep discounts” on the recommend procedures and gave me a free teeth whitening. I scheduled for a cleaning the next day because I wanted to be over with this place.

The actual cleaning took an hour long, it was subpar, and there was nothing special about it. The dentist didn’t even come back to look at my teeth after the cleaning.

I have lived here for 20+yrs and this was one of the worst experiences with a professional medical service provider. Do not visit unless you want to sit in a chair and be sold on unnecessary procedures for 2 hours. They ended up tacking on a cleaning service that was not covered on my insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maggie Tam
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Swish Dental! The facilities are really nice, clean and high tech. Dr. Rose and the whole staff at Swish are all very warm, welcoming and they really try to make you feel at ease. Thank you for making my visit such a pleasant experience! I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gwen Bingham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience at Swish Dental!!  Timely, responsive and “gentle-touch” hands make me smile Brightly with every visit!!  Highly recommend Dr Lawson, hygienist Ashley and this Team of professionals—I absolutely Love Dr Lawson!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carole Griffin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Magee was excellent ! Made me comfortable and was very thorough and informative about my exam and dental treatment plan. The assistant was great and everyone at the Domaine office was friendly and professional. Great Dentist and great dental experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annalisa Yerena
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m really glad I chose this place. I haven’t felt so comfortable in a dental office since middle school when I had braces. They are so lovely and nice here I’ve never once felt judged or shamed for not having a cleaning in so long. I’ve been to some places that are just so rude and judgmental but this place is wonderful! They also give you freebies like a cute tote or toothpaste and a toothbrush!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mrignayni Chhotwani
user_reviews_extended.Description: The professionals here are very thorough and friendly. They walked me through every detail of my procedure and answered my infinite questions with patience. They made sure I was comfortable about what was being done to my teeth. Their technology is also up to date which i appreciate. Their process is very streamlined and Covid safe.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aimee Beckwith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have some anxiety around going to the dentist but this place has one of the best dental hygienists I’ve ever had clean my teeth. I had no reason to be stressed. Cheryl was friendly, efficient, and mindful of how the treatment felt. I would absolutely recommend Swish to anyone looking for a modern and comfortable dentist in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place. They make it so easy. My husband has a fear of the dentist. He also loves this place. The best dental experience we’ve ever had. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: T J
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would not recommend Swish Dental at the Domain. I recently moved to Austin and went to them for the first time for a regular cleaning covered fully by my insurance. Without informing me of extra cost, they gave me a flouride treatment not covered by my insurance, and I ended up receiving a bill for it. While the staff was generally friendly, one of the dental assistants was pretty outspoken and that person's comments made me feel a bit uncomfortable. I also felt that person exaggerated in order to make a sale. However, the ultimate reason I ended up switching to a new dental clinic was because of how money-driven this clinic is. It seems their priority is recommending the treatment that will earn them the most money. They told me that I needed a root canal and 2 crowns, but while I was waiting over a week for them to get back to me with the details of the specialist who could do the root canal for me, I got a 2nd opinion at another clinic. The dentist told me she would try to save the tooth. I ended up just needing 1 crown and no root canal.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Denman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been Dr. Patel’s patient for two years and every time I walk in, I am consistently greeted by the receptionist with a bottle of water and a friendly smile. Dr. Lawson is very easy to talk to and is very gentle which is great for those who have sensitive teeth like me. Chris and Daniel have great bedside manner and always do an excellent job. I have no favorites because they are all great!

I feel very comfortable there and believe my teeth are in the best shape they have ever been because of the work by the staff at Swish. I just finished my invisiline treatment and could not be happier! Dr. Patel has also referred me to other dentists (for cosmetic work) and I have been extremely satisfied with her referrals. Obviously, I highly recommend Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elle Lindig
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was very easy to schedule an appointment as a new patient, and when I had to reschedule, the staff was extremely accommodating and helpful. During my visit, everyone was friendly and professional, and each took time to answer any questions I had. I'm very happy I selected Swish Dental Domain as my primary dental/orthodontics provider.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Esquivel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Today, Robert (hygienist) took care of all the stains on my teeth (coffee) and gave me great advice on how to prevent the stains in the future.

My periodontal treatments have yielded tremendous results!  My gums are much healthier between the cleanings and the education they provide about brushing techniques is insightful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Louk
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so happy that I can call Swish dental my go-to dentist office! It had admittedly been a while since I had a cleaning, and I was nervous going into my appointment. Everything went so perfectly well and everyone made me feel so at ease. I definitely recommend Swish for anyone who has had traumatic dental experiences in the past, or is even just a little nervous about going to the dentist - they’ll take great care of you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mashelle Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I only trust Swish-been a patient here for 7 years! Dr. Lawson is amazing. Not only has she done back to back work for me. I recently needed an emergency root canal and the amazing staff was able to work me in on a fully booked day and Dr. Lawson was able to get me out of the incredible amount of pain I was in. Thank you all for always having amazing service from the front desk to your assistants and Doctors! I won’t go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AR (THE_SHE_BOSS)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn't been to the dentist in over two decades out of fear. I chose this office because of proximity to my home knowing nothing about the service. This was the best service I'd received in a while and have already recommended family members to this office! The staff was great and helpful and calming

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Stuver
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit to Swish was incredible! Everyone I spoke with at my visit, the dental hygienist, the dentist, front desk staff, etc. were all so kind and answered all of the questions that I had. The entire space is kept very clean, and they wipe everything down. I’m so glad I found Swish after moving down here. I’d definitely recommend to anyone looking for a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kayla Kindla
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far one of the best places in Austin for dental care. I have been seen by both Dr. Lawson and Loehr and they are both amazing to say the least. The staff here is all extremely efficient and pleasant to work with. Every hygienist I have been seen by are always so diligent and caring. The technology in this office is awesome as well. No clunky machines coming near your face. Very well organized and clean office with awesome COVID protocols in place. All in all excellent experience every time I come. Thank you all for my continued dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Gromik
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for a routine cleaning and everything was fab! Got checked in right away. The gal at reception was welcoming and friendly - she even made a playful joke about one of the chairs I was sitting on haha - got taken right back for my cleaning and the hygenist* was also very friendly! Had the right mix of conversation and storytelling as its nearly impossible to hold a convo when your mouth is open but she managed it well! I got really lucky and this is why im going BOLD 5 star - the Doctor came in for the final check and noticed an odd marking on one of my teeth TLDR: She suggested I consider getting a previous cavity cleaned and resealed to prevent a potential route canal. I said sure! when can I schedule it? She said 'how about right now?", an hour later, I left with my filling cleaned and filled saving my future self more time and agony. The next day the Doctor called to check in on me. Very firendly and effective staff at every corner. Oh I also was able to watch Great British Baking during my filling - love some good irony! but made the filling fly bye with ease. Thanks to all at the Domain office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental at the Domain is truly the place to go for excellent dental treatment. Dr. Patel and her staff are so friendly and welcoming. I've been to several dental offices and this is the best one I've ever been to. Dr. Patel genuinely cares for her patients and only provides you with what you need, nothing more and nothing less. I highly recommend this office. I look forward to my next appointment. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: eric curtner
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Edit: Swish reached out to me and scheduled me back into their office the next day to re-seat the crowns and alleviate my pain. I appreciate the Director's help and urgency.

I had two temporary crowns fitted and it was a painful and long experience. The dentist did accommodate my needs for more numbing agent and she was concerned about it but it doesn't take away from the experience. I also had issues with the work of the assistant. Too many too list. My two temporary crowns are still giving me a lot of pain and have come off twice and I don't go back for another 9 days.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dominic Randazzo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wasn’t happy with the handling of my dental records. Hygienist basically hung me upside down causing water to go into my sinus. repeatedly. Got my face soak and wet. Very flippant attitude. Didn’t ask me if I wanted fluoride treatment but did it anyways. I felt like I got scammed by the time I  left.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an immediate dental need, Swish Domain was able to get me scheduled within 24 hours for an evaluation. Text based form completion saved time and was convenient. Dr. Lawson was excellent getting my issue resolved!

user_reviews_extended.Name: NaKayla Voyles
user_reviews_extended.Description: My metal retainer popped off my tooth and the whole staff was very accommodating when I came back in. Dr. Parth Patel made room for me even though they had a room full of patients. I will definitely be going back!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jared Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: Incredible experience from start to finish! Going to the dentist is never fun but Swish is different. Friendly staff, great environment and top of the line technology. Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Sheel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Booked a cleaning appointment for my daughter well in advance that fit her work schedule. When she arrived they took X-rays then informed her that they had double-booked the hygienist and she would have to come back another day. Horrible experience, especially given that they texted nearly daily reminding her of the appointment. Somehow there was time to try to sell her services she didn’t need. Do not recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Rivkin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a Swish patient for over a year. They start appointments in time. Their rates are great if you go on the membership plan. The staff are friendly. And the care is good. Great place if you need a dentist or are looking to find a new one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Vincik
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was already pleased with Floss, but am even happier with Swish! The staff is very friendly and professional. Natasha is super nice and made the cleaning and xray process a breeze! Dr. Lawson was great and very informative. I look forward to continue coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Biosio Etim
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is the best service I've ever received from a dentist.
I was in severe dental pain for two days. Swish Dental was able to slot me in within 15 mins of calling. They had me feeling brand new  within and hour.
From the receptionist to the dental assistance, and doctor, I had nothing but a smooth experience. Definitely going back again with friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandy L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff. They are responsive, super helpful, and personable. They are detail-oriented and professional. I have been coming here for three plus years and during every visit, they have always been consistent in making me feel comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Manhar Chopra
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Veronica, Roshani and Dr.Abigail provided me with an excellent experience. This was my first time visiting them and I was visiting a dentist after an year. They provided great insights, took care of me, and provided me with a plan as well. Looking forward to future appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa McCarty
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven’t been to the dentist in 12 years and this staff at the Domain was so nice and helpful.  They never made me feel bad for not going sooner. And we came up with a plan to fix all my teeth. Would recommend the whole staff to anyone. So nice and informative.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Renee Stanley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went fir my second checkup at Swish Dental by the Domain. Fred was my hygienist and he was wonderful!!! Very professional and general on my gums. I am a big chicken when it comes to the dentist but Swish is wonderful. The dentist was also super nice and patient with me. I really like everyone from front office to checkout. Thank you guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen Carroll
user_reviews_extended.Description: If I could give a negative five star review I would. Not only did they mess up a filling on the right side of my mouth (that caused sharp pain) they also caused an infection in my gum on the left side which I had to get surgery for. I couldn’t eat or drink anything for days due to the pain I was in. Not to mention how expensive that was. I got on a call with the manager and explained the situation and all he had to say was “it’s not our fault”. I would not suggest swish dentil to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eboney Hills
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow! What a difference in service. Ashley was soo pleasant when scheduling my appointment and greeting me in person, absolutely amazing! Then meeting my hygienist, Meredith. She was so detail oriented, efficient and knowledgeable. The best experience I ever had coming to Swish &the Domain!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Betzabel Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always friendly and willing to help you out with your goals. The manager was great coming up with a plan to get me started with my Invisalign treatments. Thank you Swish for being amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica V
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Desai is very patient and nice. He cares about his patients and although he’s a little quiet anytime I complained about pain or being uncomfortable he stopped to make it right. The rest of the staff is super wonderful as well. Jennifer, Mariah, Kristen, Kaycee, and Dustin are wonderful. They make the experience so much nicer. I had a horrible dental experience before finding them and am so thankful to have made the switch! They’re willing to work with you and their customer service is top notch!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Bremer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Important details about my first visit to Swish: the wait was short, the place was clean, staff were nice and efficient, no one asked how often I floss (spoiler it's not as often as it should be), no one shamed me for not going to the dentist in over a year, everything was painless/discomfort was rare, staff made good conversation but never while their hands were in my mouth, and the visit was shorter than anticipated. Would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anish
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was a patient for the Invisalign treatment here over the course of about 7 months in 2019. I had a great experience in terms of the treatment and the care. There were a few things that came up along the way in regards to the payments and insurance plans, but I am thoroughly impressed at how well they handled the feedback and recommendations I had for improvements. Lots of practices may 'claim' that they put the patient first, but I can truly say that Swish Dental really does.

user_reviews_extended.Name: alex george
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Professional yet laid-back, which is good for a dentists office.
Has a great vibe, a felt comfortable with what they were doing.
Front office staff was great, and as an Native Austinite I support local!
I am glad to have Swish Dental on my health team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing first appointment at Swish dental! Everyone was so friendly and kind. They went out of their way to make me feel comfortable and explain everything to me ahead of time. All the staff and Dr. Lawson were wonderful. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Rocha
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Always enjoy my hygienists that I get to meet!
Especially this time, she was so great to talk to and actually I was really relaxed the whole time.
Anthony, I think is his name- is always great and on top of things. Appreciate that!

user_reviews_extended.Name: K P
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Staff at “Wish“ is very professional and knowledgeable about the hole dental experience.  I walked in today in pain without an appointment and they made room for me.  After my examination they explained to me what was causing the pain and came up with a plan to elevate my problem.  I will always refer anyone I know to them for any dental services needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JOPHI SINGH
user_reviews_extended.Description: Visited the Domain location of Swish Dental a few weeks ago and I was completely blown away by the experience. Not only is their staff extremely polite and courteous but also they are very professional and diligent about the health of your teeth and gums. I plan to make them my permanent dental health solution providers, already looking forward to my next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Phan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is as of December 7th 2021 and will update if my billed account changes randomly in 6 months.

First impression of this office is that it's stunning and everyone really does take their time to care for you. Huge difference from River Rock Dental (which I'm content with but this place is better). Office is super clean and everyone had their masks on.

You walk in and they will do a model of your teeth, oral imaging, x-rays and etc. I had a couple of billing questions in regards of some of the services because of my insurance and called billing to clarify on it (this is a big BIG factor on my review because I need 100% transparency on where the funds are going). If you are having issues with your bill, call this number and press option 3 to take you to billing.

Doctors and hygienists are all nice, they are not pushy with invisalign and other services like other reviews say. I was 100% honest throughout my appointment (I never floss nor wore my retainers after braces, sorry guys) and they are also honest on their end (had no cavities and etc).

Overall, I'm very pleased with my experience here and will continue to go to this dental office. I will eventually do invisalign with them but still determining on that or braces (which they were honest about with me on what to expect).

user_reviews_extended.Name: tony ciarletta
user_reviews_extended.Description: The hygienist was extremely thorough and very friendly; she really did a great job. The Dentist was awesome. I’ve always had a great experience coming to Swish and highly recommend it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: destine johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow it was absolutely a very well done process. I made an appointment for the same i day contacted the office. They were able to fit me in . We went over everything about what I was going through and was able to come up with a solution right then there not even an hour later I walked out of the office better than I had come in. This was great for me I can and will recommend this office to anyone who had ask. Everyone was so friendly and introduced themselves by first name. Just awesome!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sahar Toosi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm writing this review to recommend SAHRA if you're looking for a professional and friendly dental hygienist. She always makes my teeth cleaning appointments a pleasant experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nardeen Zaklama
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a great place!!! 😁😁😁. I came here to get a cleaning and whitening done and it was amazing! All the equipment was advanced and hi tech. My experience with Dr. Viraj Patel was very informative and laid back. She's very wise, sociable, and understanding. You can tell she REALLY cares about her patients! All her staff members are super friendly and knowledgeable. I couldn't have asked for a better location and better people. I'll definitely be going back again! For those who fear the dentist, this place will change your mind! Take my word for it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Lehmann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sahra did my cleaning. 10/10. Best experience ever. Dr. Lawson was amazing as well. I was very comfortable and she is a rockstar

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Gudzelak
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience of a bad situation ever yesterday. I was getting fillings done, which is not something I am used to. They were so helpful. I was open and honest and told them I was frightened and nervous. The wonderful staff from the receptionists, the dental assistants and of course, Dr. Lawson, just kept my mind preoccupied just enough to make it through a hard time. So I encourage people to 1) always be honest with the professionals you are working with, because only you know what you need and 2) be comforted knowing that these people will listen and take care of your need! Thanks so much, you guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katelynn Thain
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great visit! The staff was friendly and the accommodations make for a superb experience.  I watched Netflix, the chair was comfortable, and to top it off, I was even able to get a whitening treatment. Already looking forward to my next appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jada Evans
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lawson has made me very happy with my Invisalign plan so far and kept me in the loop every step. Natassia has been great assisting as well and answering all my questions!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jazmin Bustos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the place itself, all of the dental crew is super knowledgeable and friendly! My biggest issue is with the front office. Once you book, they’ll call you four times in the same day to confirm your booking. I called back and they still called me after I confirmed and asked me to confirm again! It’s ridiculous. They will also text you three times on the day of to remind you of the same appointment 🙄 my husband had to reschedule due to a work issue, but they called him, he told them he’d have to reschedule to a later date, and they still texted after, asking to reschedule. Can the front office people please get their stuff together? It doesn’t require unnecessary spam texts to get me to come in. I genuinely wouldn’t go there if it wasn’t for the dental staff itself.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaitlyn Pelfrey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Swish in the Domain this morning for the first time for a routine cleaning. Everyone I met was so friendly and helpful. The appointment started right on time and there was little to no wait time in between X-rays, cleaning, exam, etc. I’ve already recommended to a friend looking for a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tejal Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going here isn't like going to the dentist!  I hadn't been in for a cleaning in quite some time, came here because a friend suggested it and had a great experience.    The vibe is quite fun and everyone is very friendly.  Cleaning went well and Dr. Patel got my teeth back into tip top shape.  I have a bottom retainer that I've had for years that probably needs replacing and she took the time to walk me through my options.  If you're looking for a new dentist, definitely come here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jestina Adediji
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went to Swish today for the first time and was definitely impressed. I actually hate going to the dentist and had held off for a really long time just because of that. But everyone was really friendly and helpful. They explained my bill to me and didn’t shove any unnecessary procedures down my throat. Will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Rains
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had a lot of dental work done the first 20 years of my life - some pretty rough stuff and after all that I developed a pretty strong fear of going to the dentist. So much so, I put it off for many years until recently I knew it’s time to work through the fear and get my teeth back on track. I had heard of Swish through a health fair and the representatives were so awesome so I got signed up with them. I’m so glad I did! They were extremely caring to work around my fears and spend all the time needed to give me all the details to make me feel comfortable and offered all kinds of options for creating a calm experience. Every single staff person and the doctor were on top of everything from informing me and to scheduling and to anything in between - I was so impressed by all of them and the technology of the office and down to running it - I won’t go anywhere else now! I feel comfortable and not scared and I feel like I have a team of people who care helping me. I love Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary Nash
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent crew at Swish. I’ve been afraid of dental work for years, but they have been very attentive to my needs and compassionate in their care. Friendly, experienced, and well equipped with advanced tech, they get the work done efficiently and kindly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Agus Ara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff has a positive attitude but unfortunately I am having a bad experience over the last 4 years at this clinic by the domain. One of the doctors, I  believe her name is Lawson has not seeing me over the past year or so as she never checks in with me on my Invisalign. I  don’t recommend this place at all

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Artmann
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was incredibly kind & reassuring (I've had bad dentist experiences in the past). Each step of the process they made sure I knew what was going on & the office itself was very nice. Will definitely be staying here for a long time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you’re looking for a team that cares, Swish Dental is the place to go! I’ve had a great experience with the entire team each time I’ve gone. Everyone is so nice and knowledgeable. The facility is also very clean.
Couldn’t recommend Swish Dental more!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ginnie DeCambre
user_reviews_extended.Description: In the past I have absolutely hated going to the dentist but Swish has done a great job at making me feel comfortable. Chris and Dr. Lawson did an awesome job cleaning my teeth and answering all questions I had about sensitivity and other issues. I highly recommend Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kiana shanel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Didn’t think it was possible to actually like going to the dentist, but Swish makes it easy. They are by far the best dentist office I’ve ever been a patient of! The atmosphere is fantastic and the people a kind and super helpful! I always leave feeling great about my smile and dental health!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Naiman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Service here was really great and efficient. Billy took great care and made me feel comfortable during my appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Beels
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Swish Dental. Everyone is so friendly and welcoming. I have had a lot of dental work done and have been so impressed with the quality of the technology and service at Swish. I'm in the process of getting 22 year old bonding redone for permanents and I am blown away by the quality of the temporaries I have now. I cannot wait to smile now. GREAT work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Byron Ramos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just moved to ATX and randomly found swish and im very glad I did! I had to go multiple times for different reasons in a short amount time and each they people were friendly.

Each time I went, I met with Dr. Abigail who was great! I had some cosmetic changes done and I was really happy with the results Dr. Abigail provided. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cody Higdon
user_reviews_extended.Description: 2 stars because I initially liked this office, have been here a few times but they cancelled my appointment without informing me. I filled out my check-in form they sent, and had clicked confirm my appt on the email but I guess I didn’t reply to a text to confirm my appointment so they cancelled my appointment. They never communicated this to me until I walked in the door for the appointment they had already cancelled. I also work in an appointment based medical field so I get the need to confirm appointments but I filled out the electronic form, confirmed on the email, and more importantly they never informed me they were cancelling my appt.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ApolloBreed Fitness
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Although there were a few things that I was dissatisfied with, my overall experience was good.

The hygienist Dustin was professional and informative.

The atmosphere is always nice and the complimentary toothbrushes are also a nice touch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meleni
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATE:
I am updating my 1 star to 3 stars as I received a next day phone call from Michael (Operations Manager) at Swish.  Michael was courteous and professional.  He apologized for the unprofessional treatment I received over the phone and we had a good conversation about how unacceptable this was.  Michael offered me a free teeth whitening service, to be scheduled in December.  Thank you Michael for your follow up.  I will update my review again in December after my Swish Domain visit.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------I called Swish Domain on October 4th, 2022 around 12:10 p.m.  The answering service connected me to the Domain location, and said someone may or may not answer because 12-1 was their lunch hour.   I was transferred and Meredith answered.    I was calling based on information I saw on their website about oral appliance for Sleep Apnea and Snoring.  I spoke with Meredith who answered none of my questions and pushed me to come in for a free consultation.   I explained that I was looking for an approximate out of pocket cost for the oral appliance to assist with mild snoring.  She repeated that I needed to come in for a free consultation (typical sales move) and said she could transfer me to her manager.  I said, yes thank you and waited 10 minutes on hold.  The manager came to the phone and without greeting me or asking me for more information, repeated the same script Meredith did.  I explained I had been previously tested for sleep apnea and my current dentist recommended I see a dentist who specialized in oral anti snoring/apnea devices.  Her customer service skill were exceptionally poor.  And she kept repeating can I make an appointment for you?  Can I make an appointment for you? Over and over to which I responded, no thank you and that I would be writing a review and asked for her name.  As soon as I asked for her name SHE HUNG UP THE PHONE ON ME!!!  I called back 4 times, and all 4 times the phone was HUNG UP.  I would love to have a conversation with upper management about this lack of skilled client service.  At no point was I irate or disrespectful in my communication with either of the women.   If I could give SWISH 0 stars I would.  Again, the manager whose name she did not give me because she hung up on me was working on October 4th, 2022 and the time was around 12:15 p.m.  I work for a pretty large tech company and I'll be sure to let everyone know to take their business elsewhere because of the unprofessionalism of SWISH DOMAIN.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caleb Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you want a hygienist that is not condescending and makes you feel comfortable, Sam is the guy to have. This was my first time having Sam as my hygienist and he did a wonderful job with the overall experience. I will request him for my future visits!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Bunn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wish I had read these negative and lower reviews beforehand. Short version: these assistants seem fresh out of dental school but are incompetent with scheduling and/or kinda apathetic with patient care. I don't go for flashy equipment and office space. I want them to care about patients and schedule correctly.

My husband ditched Swish downtown after the first cleaning, where they kept texting him notifications of his appointment (which is annoying enough) but they delayed his appointment by an hour when he arrived on time. I will look for another dentist office after this crown I'll get in two days.

Here's what did it for me:
I was told I needed a root canal and crown and I finally got around to scheduling one. In one of Swish's intake forms online, I mentioned that dental appointments make me nervous and comfort mattered. Well, that info came of no use. I was surprised they gave me no literature or any other info whatsoever on the procedure, pre care, post care, nothing. But I sure was getting non-stop text notifications to confirm even after I confirmed in text. I called for more info, to confirm the date, and b/c I was very nervous about getting a root canal and the receptionist seemed to brush off my concerns but I never said I wanted to reschedule just that I want to know more because I was having second thoughts. And suddenly he says that that the dentist is actually not available and I need to reschedule. Weird.

So I reschedule for a month out (thankfully my tooth didn't hurt much) and I make one for root canal AND crown. They didn't bother to tell me until after the root canal was done when the crown would be put in. Since they offered this procedure three hours from when the root canal finished I didn't have much time to process this new information that they should have told me at least before the root canal. I needed to readjust my day. I told the scheduling guy I wasn't sure but if there was a way to put me down placehold and I'll call back in 15 minutes if I can't. He assured me that he'd hold my spot and that it would be a light day. When I got to the counter to pay, the guy told me he messed up so there was somehow no way to get it done that day. I called again to see if there was any available time that day but they didn't find any so I have to get it next week. Then I'm looking for another dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blair Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is friendly and helpful. Teeth cleanings are always painless and fast. I used to always hate going to the dentist, but with Swish I look forward to it. They are always accommodating and the office is clean and expanding.They now have Netflix which makes teeth cleanings and whitening treatments fly by!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vidya Nayak
user_reviews_extended.Description: Last time I visited I had a good experience here but the hygienist caused me so much pain during my cleaning. I’m someone who brushes/flosses regularly and typically don’t have pain at the dentist. This visit the girl who did the flossing was rushing and continued despite my indications that I was in pain. I’m genuinely still sore in a couple parts of my mouth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lonnie Bean
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic  experience at Swish today. I hate going to the dentist, but Christopher and Kayce were fantastic and made me feel extremely welcome. They even threw in a swag bag and free bleaching trays with beach included. I'd definitely recommend them to anyone and would suggest you go here if you are looking for a new dentist that will do a fantastic job while making you feel right at home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Mckee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dustin and Dr Lawson were absolutely incredible! I was super nervous to find a new dentist after moving to Austin and I was able to get an appt in 1 day. They were taking extreme precautions during the check in process because of COVID. Dustin was super personable and made me feel super comfortable through the whole appointment. Super easy first visit and cleaning- 100% recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: DJ Whaley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. McGee was PERFECT!!! She made me feel so comfortable and she is a PRO in my book,and everyone should go to Swish Dental if you want the very best…GO TO SWISH DENTAL!!! I’d give her a 10!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savannah Staley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was a little nervous about going to Swish Dental because in my experience, when there are multiple locations sometimes the priority is to get you in and out the door as quickly as possible. This was not the case at Swish! They took their time and thoroughly cleaned my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Suarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lawson is great and very fun to work with! However, my last visit with one of her team members in the front wasn't very pleasant. I received a call on 3/24/2020 to pick up my last sets of Invisalign trays. When I got in my car I noticed they were all missing a filling on one of the tooth spaces of the upper tray that I usually get. I went back to let the girl know if she could add the filling but she told me to wait outside for a moment. After waiting outside for about 15 minutes, she came back out to tell me that it was going to take them a couple of hours to add the filling and that I would have to come back later that day when they called me. It has now been 3 weeks and I have yet to receive a call.  I also recently received an invoice via e-mail, which I was not aware that I would be receiving. If it wasn't for this incident I would have given 5 stars, I also understand that these times are affecting everyone and I was willing to go back later that same day for curbside pickup but 3 weeks has been too long.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Cantu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was originally referred here by my sister, who was a past employee and enjoyed the people and care SWISH dental provided to myself and our family. However, recently I can say the care and customer service here has gone down drastically over the past two years. They no longer look at our family as a part of their SWISH family, but as another paycheck. Why do I feel this way? I took my daughter there last week to see Dr. Shadman, because she had swelling and her tooth was hurting. While in office, they convinced me that the best thing todo in that moment was to have my daughter's tooth removed. My daughter was very nervous and vocalized that they were hurting her during the procedure, they did very little to comfort her, let alone to allow me to comfort her. Needless to say, after they removed the tooth from my screaming daughter, they told me I should really consider taking her to a pediatric dental office. Which, I did in fact take the time to speak to another provider and they advised me that most doctors would have sent my daughter home on antibiotics and brought her back a week later, to get rid of her swelling and keep her from the pain that she was having from what they call a "hot tooth". I really wasn't trying to leave this review, as I asked my sister reach out to her previous manager to let them know about the experience I had that day. It is clear to me that they didn't really care about anything I had to offer, as it's now been a week since my sister reached out to them with my feedback and I haven't received a phone call to even check on how my daughter is doing. SWISH likes to paint themselves as a family oriented practice, but they clearly aren't.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blair Williamson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience I’ve had in a long time. The appointment was quite long (which is the only reason I’m not giving 5 stars) but it was very thorough and explained so well. For a person with anxiety about going to the dentist, they did a great job taking care of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandy G
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow!! From the time I booked the appointment until the time I walked out of the door, I was highly impressed. The staff is knowledgeable, courteous and they don’t make you feel like you’re at the dentist's office. I am having some severe tooth pain and need a root canal and they didn’t make it sound scary at all but I felt like I was family. Thank you so much for taking such good care of me and I will be back and recommend this office to anyone I know that needs it. You all rock! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Ramones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lawson and the rest of the team has been so wonderful! They always take such great care of me and make the experience as good as can be.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A-mo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don’t have insurance, go figure and I signed up for their Swish Plan. It actually was really helpful because my exam, xrays and cleaning were free. The doctor I had, Dr. Lawson and she went over my xrays, and my scan. I had two cavities that need taking care of. With the plan you get a reasonable discount. They explain everything in terms of payments and if you have any questions they go everything quite well, and I didn’t feel like someone was just trying to sell me something. Plan on going back, to fix the cavities and get Invisalign to help with my teeth grinding. Everyone was helpful and very warm
And welcoming. Everything was very clean, everyone wore masks, unless for the exam you could take yours off. Great office.

Update: have been back for Invisalign and got my cavities taken care of. Very good staff. Love Dr. Lawson.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brody Balinski
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Pros:  The doctors are amazing and very thorough in their explanations.  From your first visit, you get a treatment plan that they walk through with you, step-by-step.  Scheduling isn't far out, and checking in is super easy.  All forms are sent to your phone.  Rooms have TV's if Netflix is your thing during dental work.

Cons:  The dental assistants could use some further oversight and guidance, as they all seem fairly new.  You'll likely be in the office an extra half-hour or so as they fumble their way through x-rays, temporary crown shaping, etc.  Dental work is a bit unnerving as it is, so for me personally, I'd much prefer someone not so apparent in their lack of experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Mathew
user_reviews_extended.Description: Terrible experience. The founder reached out to me on LinkedIn encouraging me to check out her business. I made an appointment and figured it would be a good place to try, especially with my just moving to Austin, TX. Everything was going great right up until the time for my actual cleaning. The dentist walked up and slapped me with a $700+ bill, insisting that I needed a 'deep cleaning.' She refused to serve me unless I made this purchase. I was livid. Entitled to one free cleaning per my insurance, I complained, and essentially had to force them to provide my cleaning, which was sub-standard in quality at best. I won't be returning to Swish Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arian Ford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Robert was very nice and answered all of my questions! I also liked that my appointment started and ended on time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hope Bachman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is friendly and I end up getting the care I need - but the business model prioritizes quantity over quality and is inefficient.  It feels like a big chain.

It seems they always have several DAs on clock with 1 -2 hygienists and one dentist. The idea is to have DAs handle basic intake and care while hygienists and dentists slowly make their way around from patient to patient.

The problem is they schedule too many patients at once for this to work efficiently. Although the DAs are great people I find they are noticeably inexperienced/need more guidance. Every time I go for a cleaning I'm there for at least an hour, one time it was nearly two.

Once the the DA finishes their work you have to hope the hygienist is on time and then once they're finished you have to hope the dentist is on time - so far this has never happened for me. Today when the dentist finally got around to me (30+ minutes after the hygienist was finished cleaning my teeth) You could tell she was extremely busy/rushed, I felt like she was practically running out of my room.

Maybe I was just hangry but at previous dentist offices I was seen by the hygienist who handled basic intake, cleaned my teeth and then a few minutes later the dentist came in for a quick exam. It would take 40 minutes tops, which is what I'll be looking for in my next dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keelin Choi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had gum pain that was pretty bad so I went for a new patient exam. They asked why I had come and I said I wanted a cleaning and to have them look at my gums. They did x-rays and a doctor consult. The doctor advised I had a gum infection and needed meds and a deep cleaning. However, they sent me home without doing even a basic cleaning and didn’t give me any meds. They said the soonest they could get me in for treatment was almost two weeks from that day. I ended up going to H‑E‑B to buy an antiseptic rinse and gel to put on my gums to hold me over during the weekend until I can find a different dentist next week. I have never had a new patient exam at a dentist not include a cleaning and certainly have never had a dentist leave an issue untreated. They told me to expect my appointment  to take 1.5 to 2 hours. They even called me 40 minutes early to see if I could come early and I did. They also cut the inside of my upper and lower mouth trying to fit the X-rays into my small mouth. I will not be going back here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phill Simpson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update after a year (or two):

The multi-level cliche here would be "Service with a Smile". It's only just sort of Disney for the Happiest Place on Earth "crown" (another terrible one, okay I'll stop).

I've been coming here for a few years and I love how tech-savvy the business is, whether it's scheduling appointments via text or avoiding reams of paperwork when you arrive (Ipads, yay!), they just take the pain out of dentist-ing and I love them for it.

In addition to great cleanings, fillings and checkups, I've also been using them for invisalign and they didn't disappoint. They took care of all the insurance stuff and the price was far below what others were quoting and they throw in free stuff like whitening and gum surgery (which doesnt sounds too fun, but I'll keep an open mind there).

Overall, they're reliable, easy to schedule/reschedule, paperwork-savvy and make every interaction a joy. What more could you ask?

My original review:

I'm British, so am naturally trained to dislike the dental industry, its my countries cold war. That said, the fine folks at Swish are simply fantastic and make the whole process as painless as possible. From super-easy online scheduling to handling all the insurance paperwork transparently, they have brought dentistry into the 21st century. While I still wouldnt say I look forward to going to the dentist, they've converted me into someone who willingly goes twice a year which is something I'd say is harder to achieve than a Nobel Peace Price. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven Krikorian
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been in Austin for a few years and was always hesitant to find a dentist since I was familiar with my family dentist in Boston. Finally took a chance and went to Swish. I was truly blown away by the experience.

I was greeted with a smile and beverages while walking into a super modern office. We don't have this in Boston! Everything was on time too. I was greeted with a tour and had a TV to watch. Dr. Patel was great in explaining my treatment and the office manager explained my whole treatment with even options so I wouldn't have to pay too much. I'm excited that I found another dentist I can come to for a while.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucky
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am happy with the job but My insurance told me a few time that Basic cleaning is gonna be free but anytime I go there they charge me $50 for basic Cleaning, and every time I I mentioned that should be free they bring So Many excuse, that is Not basic I started cleaning my teeth from last year and every 3 Months, I clean my teeth how come it’s not  Basic cleaning . the first time I paid 600 dollar and I accept it but now I know my My gum has no problem but still charged me 50 dollar

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Baumann
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Swish last week as a walk in and everyone was wonderful! I had severe tooth pain and my regular dentist was closed. I knew it was a long shot to walk in and ask to be seen since I’m not a regular patient and they got me in immediately and did X-rays and got me antibiotics for my infected tooth! If I switch dentists they will be my first choice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient at Swish for about 3 years now and have consistently had good experiences. However, I recently decided to try the Boost Whitening, and it was not good.

It was a very long and painful procedure, and I wish I hadn’t done it. The person who did my whitening didn’t seem very experienced. My prep alone (just putting the gum barrier on) took 30 minutes. This was also painful, as she kept poking my gums with a sharp tool. During the procedure, I had to hold my mouth open and she would use the suction tool every few minutes. She often missed and different parts of my mouth got suctioned and hurt instead (the papillae under my tongue are still swollen from this). My bottom gums got burned from the bleach during this procedure and it hurt pretty bad. Not to mention the insane tooth sensitivity afterwards.

Overall, I would not do teeth whitening with Swish again, and I would advise others to stick to regular cleanings and other services with Swish like Invisalign. Maybe it’s my own fault for not doing enough research on the Boost Whitening procedure. But given the chance, I would NOT do it again. I don’t believe it was worth it, both in terms of time and money ($175).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittney Eguakun
user_reviews_extended.Description: My favorite thing about Swish Dental is that they do not judge unlike other dentists offices I have been too. When I first came here it was all about getting me on the right track to a cleaner mouth and better smile. The staff is so friendly and just so personable! I tell everyone all about this place! As long as I am here in Austin, I will always pick SWISH Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Padilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly, respectful staff. Dr. Lawson is wonderful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frank Frederick Robison, III
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ms. Roshani Patel is one of the best dental hygienists at Swish Dental Domain. Dr. Lawson is one of the best dentists at Swish Dental Domain. Ms. Sylvia is one of best managers at Swish Dental Domain. Please recognize and reward named employees with gift cards, pay increases, or promotions. Thank you for exceptional dental services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lawson filled a cavity for me. I felt discomfort so I went back. Then she ruined the filling making my tooth uneven. Here we are a few years later, and that tooth now needs a crown due to her failures. Now they expect me to pay for the crown I need. Hilarious, don’t allow her in your mouth or regret it forever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tarik Bekka
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with Carlos and the rest of the Swish team! Will definitely be returning for future visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arika Chennelle
user_reviews_extended.Description: EXCELLENT customer service from all points of contact (reception, dentist, dental assistants, and hygienist, and front desk, etc). Swish is mindful of appointment times, accommodating to patients, kind/informative review of procedures and always end with fantastic customer service from start to finish. I can't praise the Braker Ln. (Domain) staff enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: daisy barraza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience at Swish dental, everyone was so friendly and very helpful. I went in for my initial consultation for Invisalign and I felt very comfortable with the staff, which was the main reason why I came back and will start my treatment. So excited to start my Invisalign journey with Swish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becky Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved the experience so much! Everyone was so nice and they explained everything with ease and clarity ✨️ I'm so glad I found them as my new dentist! 🤍
