user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria C.
user_reviews_extended.Description: doctor was super knowledgeable and friendly.  and hygienist was AMAZING. really cared about my comfort and talked me through my routine. best dentist i’ve ever been to, won’t go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dinesh Sundar G
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Good experience and a seamless appointment system. The entire business model is targeted at the under 35 demographic and it works well.

Knocking of 1 star for the lack of visibility on the cost of procedure that they upsell. Would be better if they can first check the list of treatments and procedures that the insurance covers before making recommendations.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ute Cray
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly staff and providers. I enjoyed the pain free dental cleaning and the state of the art equipment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kent Nugent
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Nothing but good things to say from start to finish! A+ Service! 👍🏽👍🏽

The front desk staff is very warm and welcoming when you arrive. The dental assistants are very knowledgeable and friendly.

If you are looking for a place to get your dental work done, I 100% recommend this location. Plus, they have multiple locations around Austin! Another plus!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abbie Jenkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was so nice and friendly from the front staff to the dentist Abbie. And my hygienist Fred was one of the most kind and gentle hygienists I've ever had. I went to the domain location and highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elyse Cann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a cheerful and well run facility. Everyone is friendly and personable.  Both cleaning I have had done went really well and I felt good about the fees, even without insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cyndie Bubis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had not been to the dentist in quite a few years and I was worried I would get lectured.  Swish Dental was great and made me feel very comfortable. Everyone was super nice and professional. I definitely will be back in 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber_MAGIC
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first visit with Swish today and I can tell you that this will definitely NOT be my last visit. From the receptionist to the women who took my x-rays (Allie),  my dentist was absolute delight and was patient with explaining a complete overview of my mouth. The last woman (in charge of billing; Dilila), helped explain all of my charges. All of this was done while I had a chance to listen to light pop and watch Netflix. It was truly a memorable experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theresa L. Olaivar Modgling
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place with good vibes. It was clean and every staff member I encountered were very welcoming and patient with my questions. Highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emile Bassiouni
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Swish Dental since 2014.  Dr. Patel and the stuff have always been amazing.  And I have always felt comfortable in their care. Each time I visit, there is sense of care that I receive.  I will definitely recommend Swish Dental Domain to anyone looking for great dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexander Acevedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Check-in 10/10, dental assistant - 10/10, hygienist - 10/10, dentist - 10/10. Being comfortable at a dental office is unimaginable, but Swish made me feel like friends were telling me the truth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Gave this place a second try after they changed from Floss (Google it for entertainment). Waited for them to locate my insurance even though they had it on file. Didn't listen to what I was there for (routine cleaning) and insisted on X-rays. They did the X-rays and poked my gums. The doctor said my teeth were "good." After I flipped through Netflix for over an hour waiting for someone to clean my teeth, I left. I let them know that they had forgotten about me when I was leaving. They said , "goodbye." I'm curious to see how they bill my insurance. I wouldn't trust this place with my well being.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Holmes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Called Swish because of a Tooth ache and to discuss possible crowning. I was scheduled to come in on New Years Eve and did just that. After being told I needed a root canal and that the crown I needed would arrive in 2-3 weeks, I asked to make a phone call regarding my other options/finances. Not 2 minutes later an assistant came in asking for my payment information to order the crown. I just came in for a toothache but since she said the crown would arrive in 2-3 weeks I figured I should get it over with. Gave payment and was told I would have a root canal done and a temporary crown put on in the mean time. The Doctor who started my procedure went home half way through it without saying bye to patient. I get it was New Year’s Eve but have some professionalism.

Fast forward 3 weeks and the crown they ordered had not arrived yet. Plus my temporary crown never stay cemented on longer than 24 hours. I had to go back to office twice to have it recemented. Finally the crown came in at the end of January, but of course it was the wrong shade. After waiting 4 weeks without a front tooth, Im being told I will have to wait another 4 weeks for a new crown to be made. Price stayed the same and I had no choice than to stay with them because I had already paid and they had already filed down my tooth.

Well I finally got the correct shaded crown put on the last week of February! 2 months after my initial visit!
Crown shade was correct and assistant Ivan and Nancy were always nice to me. I am writing this review the first week of April, after having my crown for about a month.

Well the Tooth ache I originally called for is back now in the same tooth, as if I never went to the dentist in the first place! Unacceptable. I’m not sure if I was even given a root canal. I really just wanted to be treated like a patient instead of a customer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rohan Joshi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very easy to get an appointment, and super friendly staff..I had a swelling on the left side of my jaw, and the staff got me setup pretty fast. There are a few documents that you have to upload and once that's done the process is very seamless. Showed up at the clinic on time and was out in 15 minutes.
Will definitely recommend to friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Bradley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient for 3 years.  Swish dental makes keeping your teeth clean and healthy easy.  Scheduling is easy with automated reminders.  Dr.  Lawson is very knowledgeable and her staff all professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizzy Myers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t like going to the dentist and hadn’t been in about 2 years. Everyone at swish was extremely nice and welcoming. They made me feel comfortable and explained everything that was going to happen and again as it happened. You really feel like they care about you and your health. I won’t go to another dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassie Mulanax Jaster
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My interactions with everyone have been pleasant enough and the facility is really nice and clean. But, when I was sold Invisalign treatment with them I was told the premim difference between them and cheaper alternatives was that I would be seen by a dentist.

Well, that hasn't been my experience. 16 weeks into treatment and I have only seen the dentist when they told me I needed it and once when I complained about the buttons; they were jagged and sharp, and not previously discussed. When I threatened to cancel the treatment, the dentist was very kind and offered an alternative. No dentist checked the tech's work for glueing them into place, which took several uncomfortable tries.

I have been told that a dentist reviews my scans, but I do not see how that is any different than the competition that they told me was what made them different and worth the added expense.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacqui Zarka
user_reviews_extended.Description: Parking was atrocious. Staff was friendly but extremely condescending. I understand it's a dentist office but having four different people ask and lecture on daily teeth brushing seems excessive for a 90 minute intake

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ant M
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole staff is very friendly, welcoming, and funny. I would recommend them to everyone. There location is nice and the facility is very bright and friendly. Dr. Lawson is great, she is completely transparent while still being very nice and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was in for a yearly cleaning. Hygienist said he preferred to do xrays after cleaning rather than before. His demeanor throughout my visit was less than gentle. He admitted to been rough. He criticized my previous Swish cleaning 6 months ago and my previous orthodontics work. Dentist came in half way through cleaning, asked for images and hygienist told him he could review them later and maybe contact me after electronically. I didn’t know this was common practice at Swish. All in all, not a great visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vince Montalbano
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys are great- I had a very old filling replaced a little while ago and when something felt a little rough, I called them and they made time for me to come in and get it adjusted the same day. No charge. Amazing service!! Super clean and modern.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Britknee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place. I may or may not be moving soon but will be traveling down to Austin for my dental work if need be. WThey care bout what is best for you, not your wallet. Dr homsi is amazing. Sweet but firm. All the ladies and gentlemen there are so accommodating and understanding of my dental anxiety. I’m so happy I found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Josh is great!  He reviewed my current situation and advised me on how to make adjustments to prevent cavities!  Dr. Lawson is great as well!  She is really sweet and really gives you her time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ronny bracho
user_reviews_extended.Description: Paulina was amazing!!! She's so kind and lovely. Thanks a lot, I had fear about go to dentist and she helped me to go over it... it's an incredible team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jan D'Alise
user_reviews_extended.Description: My children and I have been going to Swish for 4 years now. Best staff, cutting edge technology, beautiful decor and highly skilled, compassionate dentistry. Dr. Lawson is awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came with tooth pain left with tooth pain. Did a root canal and the temp crown was put too high so was in severe pain for days. The acct manager refused to prescribe a generic lidocain mouthwash. She would only prescribe a $120 mouthwash NO INSURANCE takes. Then had a cavity filled that cracked 2x. My dentist was nice but I think they over book her. Anyways never coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LuAnn Pratt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had a 11:00 appointment arrived slightly early to allow time to fill out
The required paperwork. Waited 35 minutes in the waiting room as 4 people
That arrived after me were called in. No one gives me and information on why I am waiting, until I say that I want to reschedule because of the wait time I explain that I was a 72 year old with pre-existing condition and not
Comfortable with the Waite. I was told that they were running late and it would be another 5/10 minutes I said I would give them 2 minutes more.
Which the did call me in 2 minutes,but I was treated very rudely by the hygienist and by the dentist. I asked for a fluoride treatment which was not done with no explanation,hygienist wouldn’t even speak to me. In these Pandemic times I would have expected better understanding of the elderly
Especially when they have pre-existing conditions. If they would have told me that they were running late, I could have opted to wait in my car.

I have been contacted by Swish Dental with a sincere apology and told that  customer Service issues will be resolved. I will return to Swish Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scipio Sholars II
user_reviews_extended.Description:
One of the best dental offices I've been in and actually enjoy it. The place is very clean, comfortable chairs and include things to occupy your want such as Netflix.

My dentist reached out to me via professional social network and that nudge was enough to go visit. I need to invest in my oral healthcare and my teeth so, I'm happy to find a solid place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raquel Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is so friendly and helpful! My first time getting my teeth cleaned with Sam was so educational. Lol, “Knowledge is power!” Delilah and Dr. Lawson have also been gems. Shout out to Cheryl, my other fun hygienist! They made me feel comfortable and safe going in for my appt during COVID. Process was very seamless.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aidong Yin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would like to give zero star if I can.
I did a deep clean, and crown in this provider. I was asked to pay more than $600. Because I had two dental insurance at that time, the insurance paid full for all the service. However this provider still refuses to refund all the money I paid.
update review on July 17, 2019
The office manager of Swish Dental Domain audited my account and refunded me what should be. I am satisfied with this. However I am still surprised why Swish Dental has this kind of accountant who doesn't have common sense of refunding extra money to customer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valeriia Iakimenko
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everything would be fine if I wasn't pressured to buy

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deanna KC
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall good first experience. Location was clean and there was a minimal waiting time before I was called to the back. Diana was my hygienist and I'll definitely request her again in future if possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashlyn Kipp
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The hygienist and doctor as well as most other staff were incredibly helpful. Unfortunately I work in the dental field and know too much. The assistant touched literally everything before trying to put her hands in my mouth. She was getting ready to scan my teeth. She put on gloves, touched the chair, back counter, screen and handles for the machine. The cover for the image screen, placing the real one on there, the air water arm thing, screen again, and then wanted to put her hands in my mouth.
Everything else was good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Garrett Holden
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience I’ve had at a dentist! Super kind staff and everyone from the front desk to the dentist were attentive to my questions. I appreciated how they not only answered my questions but educated me as to why we were taking a certain action. They also have amazing technology to give you an incredibly deep look at your teeth patterns!

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Josma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great work as usual and they always fit me in my schedule and my insurance is accepted and covers majority of the bill.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Ramones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had another wonderful cleaning at Swish! I appreciate how Dr. Lawson always makes time to stop by and chat for a bit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: michael toups
user_reviews_extended.Description: First class experience every time.  Dr. Lawson and her group are as good as you will ever find in a dental group.  They take COVID-19 seriously so that we all can feel safe.  Pandemic or not, they always treat their patients with care and respect.

user_reviews_extended.Name: KD
user_reviews_extended.Description: I waited over a hour past my appointment time to be seen. Xrays were taken. Then I was told I would have to reschedule my cleaning and whitening because they were running so far behind. They were able to get me in at Mueller for cleaning and whitening but my experience there was bad too. Very rushed. Never got my whitening trays. $200 wasted on their dental plan.

user_reviews_extended.Name: G Holmes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Personally, I have had only superior service with this office and it's staff. They are all in sync in that place. This is not my primary dentist: invisalign only. However, I'd recommend them because they are very patient centered and they really do their best to take care of you. Please check them out.

~ Happy Patient

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikolas Suh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Greedy and deceitful. I came in for a cosmetic dental CONSULTATION last week. I highlight that it was a consultation because I had a routine cleaning/exam the week before coming in. *My insurance covers 2 per year. I was going to use the 2nd exam to cover my 2nd routine 6-month cleaning/exam for the year. I specifically asked the front desk whether this consultation would result in a claim to my insurance. They told me no unless an examination was required. But if an exam was required, I would be notified and we would have a follow-up appointment for an exam*. Great. So I come into my appointment, check-in, and ask again to confirm that my appointment was for a consultation and the front desk confirms it. Great. They call me in, take a look at my teeth, and they tell me that it would be useful to take an x-ray so they can have a better idea of the treatment options available to me. I respond by asking whether this would result in any charges or claims to insurance. *They say no*. So yeah, great, take some x-rays. They take a few x-rays, the doctor comes in to see me and tells me to go to another location because there is another dentist that can do it better. That's fine. I go to the other location and have a great talk about what I was looking for.

Just got a notification from my dental insurance saying this dental office made a claim. *They never at any point let me know that the consultation turned into an examination. I was told that if my consultation turned into an examination, I would be told to come in at a later date. This never happened.* I called the office to ask for justification on the claim and they said it was because of the x-rays and the doctor came to see me (she essentially just walked in and said I should go to another doctor because they would probably do a nicer job). So yeah, didn't even get a consultation at this location. What sucks more is that they just took away that second cleaning/exam covered by my insurance. A really scummy situation they put me in.

The lack of communication during my visit was infuriating. My mouth has enough issues... honestly, it felt like they only cared about getting my insurance money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Collins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Most bizarre dentist experience of my life, and such an utter disrespect of my time. I was texted at 4:30 pm the day of my 5:40 pm appointment, asking me to reschedule for an earlier time at 5 pm. I said I needed a little extra time but could come in at 5:15 pm. Arrived at 5:15 pm and sat in the waiting room without an issue until 5:40 pm. At 5:40 pm, I relayed my confusion to the people at the front desk, that I had been asked to come in for an earlier appointment, and it was now my original appointment time. One of them apologized and left to find someone. At 5:50 pm, she was still gone, and I hadn’t been acknowledged by anyone else, so I told the other front desk person I was leaving, and they just said, “Okay.” No explanation or apology. If they can’t respect my time here, I’m not letting them root around in my mouth 😅

user_reviews_extended.Name: Webster Mercado
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nicole, my hygienist, was great! And the doctor, I believe her name was Abigail, explained the procedures needed to get me back in good shape. Overall great experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Prokupek
user_reviews_extended.Description: Truly a great experience, and that's hard to say about a dental office. Very warm and welcoming staff. They explain everything too you and lay out the plans for a better smile. Didn't feel cold or clinical... I highly recommend those place if you are looking for a new dentist in the area... Even if you aren't. 🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie L
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first visit there the other day, and I was very impressed! The staff was very nice and welcoming, plus I didn’t have a wait. I saw Dr. Lawson she is great, answered all my questions and put me at ease. Scheduled my next appointment before I left.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pari Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Swish Dental Domain has been amazing. I have been on Invisalign for a couple months now and my teeth are looking better than ever thanks to the helpful and friendly doctor and hygienist! The doctor always makes sure to take her time to explain the process with Invisalign. She is very patient and understanding of every patient's needs and always makes me feel comfortable whenever I am visiting. By far the best dental experience I've ever had!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Mcclure
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are so awesome! Normally I don’t like going to the dentist but they make it so comfortable and easy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Went to the office about 2 weeks ago because my gum felt swollen ( didn’t have an appointment). The front office receptionist was kind of short seemed a little agitated, but none the less let me know the doctor could see me, but may take awhile due to Dr. doing surgery . I opted to wait.....
Once I was called back all I have to say is AWESOME EXPERIENCE, IMPECCABLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. Great vibes from start to finish. Natasha explained a lot as I was leaving very thorough.
I have been with my previous dentist for over 7 years, but when I tell you they have won me over.
In my Terminator voice: WE WILL BE BACK the WHOLE FAMILY.
Thank You Guys

user_reviews_extended.Name: S Longo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ashley was my dental hygienist this time. She did such a great job. Really felt like I got a thorough cleaning. Probably the best dental cleaning I’ve had so far

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Aries
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience at Swish. They dental hygienist and doctor were super friendly and made me feel well taken care of. The whole operation was clean, sophisticated, and very Austin. I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dewaine Pouncy
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience yesterday was excellent.  I really enjoy the feeling I get from the staff which is nothing less than top notched.  This was my second appointment and each visit "Chris"  has made it painless.  Excellent work and thank you Sir.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Sawyer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very poor experience as a new patient. I arrived early and was kept waiting for 15 minutes past the appointment time while several other people (who arrived after me) were seen.

I ultimately left since they could not keep a timely appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khai Le
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Not my best cleaning I have ever received. I didn't feel clean afterwards with stuff between my teeth and on the back of my teeth that I pointed out.

There was also a potential mishap that I would not have got my cleaning because it was my first visit and it wasn't planned in their system. Luckily for me, there was a cancellation.

Also, I booked the appointment online via their website with a dentist and was seen by a different one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marilyn Neal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was very impressed with the staff and the facilities in their office. I have never had such a thorough exam as I did at Swish Domain. They also offer a membership plan if you do not have dental insurance that was very affordable. I highly recommend this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Social Media
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and professional staff. They took really good care of me and provided a personalized first visit. Ask for Lucero and Dr. Larsen

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Sendejas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience  today. Everyone was very friendly and professional. I look forward to my next visits and will recommend  Swish dental to my friends and coworkers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrienne Reagins
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Domain office totally wasted my time. I went for a TMJ consultation and after two hours of waiting, X-rays, photos, and technicians coming in & out saying the dentist will be with you in a minute! I had no choice but to get up and leave without seeing the dentist. I’ll be checking to make sure my insurance company wasn’t charged for non-service! ☹️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Eisenmenger
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had intense pain in an upper molar and in the sinus cavity above it. I was able to schedule an emergency appointment yesterday with only 90 minutes notice. I was diagnosed with a major infection that required a root canal ASAP. They scheduled it next day (today)   The doctor and all support personnel were very professional and efficient. I'm very grateful for the care provided

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vincent White
user_reviews_extended.Description: A Wonderful dental office and staff as well as the experience of visiting the place.  I’ve never had a bad experience when it was Floss and now Swish.  The BEST dentist experience I’ve had in my entire life!  I always look forward to my next visit. Viraj Patel runs a great and professional business; keep up the excellent work Viraj & Team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Rogan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Disappointed with the service. I made an appointment and based on paperwork I could tell there were a few things that seemed not right. So I went in early to speak with the desk receptionist about my questions. I had issues with several policies.

The main issue I struggled to understand was that the employee straight forward told me that I did not have a say in what kind if treatment I would be receiving.

This not an acceptable anwser and I will be taking my business elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Webel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love going to Swish!  I love the modern feel, high-use of technology, doctors that speak in a way you can understand and don't push unnecessary procedures on you, experienced and gentle hygienists, current music playing in the background, and extreme care taken during this Covid-19 era.  I've been going for about 2 years and I'll be back for sure!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Summer Fall
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is a SCAM. I think the high reviews might be fake.
I went for a new patient appointment hoping they would clean my teeth on my only day off from work and address the pain I was having in my gums. Instead, they took x-rays, a bunch of photos, and 2d imaging of my teeth (which they're trying to bill insurance for) and then came up with a "treatment plan" ($10,000) telling me I need Invisalign and botox. 1 hour later they said they DIDN'T HAVE TIME TO CLEAN MY TEETH and that I would need to schedule for another day. The funniest thing was when they told me at the end that the doctor had time to come tell me about botox, but they didn't have time to clean my teeth. They're just trying to make money on other things, they are not putting patient care first. I only talked with a doctor or hygienist for maybe 2 minutes at most. The other people doing my scans and trying to sell me things were assistants.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathan Felts
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience here. Quick, easy cleaning, Ashley was a great hygienist. Dune 2 on the TV. It was great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Fisher
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish is my new favorite dental office.  The people are so nice!  The equipment is state of the art.  The whole team was efficient and friendly and took care of my teeth in a gentle way. Loved it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bo M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Growing up in a family of dentists, I am familiar with the operations side of dental practices.  I have to say, I was extremely impressed, they explained everything in terms of insurance payment and co-pays and the procedures that are needed.  They were patient, professional and thorough!  I was very impressed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Doll
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fun, modern office with high-tech equipment. The whole staff is very welcoming and Dr. Lawson and Daniel made sure I knew what to expect throughout the whole appointment. Will definitely be returning for all my dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Loghin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came here for an emergency crown repair, and ended my 6year dentist boycott. Tasha was an awesome dental assistant and she explained everything so well. The dentist was also wonderful. I think I’ve found my new dentist and I’ll have no problem coming back for routine care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Swish Dental are incredibly friendly. They really care about my smile and make me feel really comfortable discussing any concerns. If you’re looking for a dentist in Austin, I absolutely recommend Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rahul Bohara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dentistry I have been to. Staffs are very kind and the dental experience is pain free. Jerry is one of the most amazing person. Ask for her next time you go there. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aubony Burns
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an excellent experience at Swish Dental today!! They focus on not only your current issue but go over preventative measures too. I also like that they go over a plan on how and when to make preventative improvements. I would highly recommend them!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brianna Lockett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Each person who assisted me through the visit was kind and caring. My hygienist did a GREAT job with the cleaning. No more bleeding gums!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Jinks
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Modern Dental Office. Clean, friendly staff, updated tools and technology. Various available comforts, like Netflix, noise cancelling headphones, etc for those who are nervous about dental visits. 3D imaging with heat spots that the dentist goes over with you.
The receptionist explained the papers that required signing and indicated which were optional.

The dental hygienist gave me a brief tour of the office prior to seating me, and was one of the most gentle dental professionals I've received care from. She clearly communicated everything she was about to do, and took care around the gumline not to stab or poke harder than necessary. Definitely recommend her, and I'm terribly sorry but o forgot her name. I can only hope the rest of the staff treat their patients with the same care and attention.

The dentist was very friendly and took my concerns to heart. She explained the variety of options and gave a rough cost for each, then had the billing dept. run the options against my insurance. I then received an email with the quote.

Overall, I'm impressed with my experience and I'll happily go back for additional services (or maybe just my 6mo checkup from insurance).

One thing that does not detract from the rating:
If it's your first appointment, expect for it to take about 2 hours and for none of the online paperwork through LiveMed to count for anything. Not sure if the time taken was just because it was first or if it's because of the cleaning, but be sure to budget enough time for it. user_reviews_extended.Name: Just My 2 cents
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is a mixed bag..Communication is lacking for one. Also, they are kind of a money grab. They book unnecessary appointments. For instance, had my teeth cleaned in August. They brought me back early January for a pre-cleaning before booking me for another cleaning in April. My dentist prior to them would do two cleanings per year. Also, they scheduled me for more x-rays in April after they just did my x-rays in August. That is eight months. Dentist usually do x-rays every 12 to 18 months depending upon a your condition. So here they are trying to schedule me with pretty much three cleanings per year and two x-rays. My understanding is that the young lady who started this comes from big big money from India. And that’s fine. But I get the feeling it’s a little too crash and burn. And they’re just trying to pull in as much money as they can. They’re building too many too fast. And don’t have a Billing problem like I did. They charged me out-of-pocket when my insurance covered it. And it took them way too long to refund money. They should’ve never have charged me. Just very messy. Not sure I am going to be staying with them. I’m in my 50s and have been doing this for years and this is by far the messiest.

I explained all of my needs ahead of time and everyone was incredibly patient, accommodating, and so very professional. Roberto was the first person I made contact with and he was informed and caring. Sofia is a champion!! Sahra and Dr. Arty made me feel seen and important. If you have ANY qualms about going to the dentist, you don’t have to worry with Swish Dental Domain. They ROCK!!! 🤘🏼

title: Rose Dental Group - North Austin
address: 12601 Metric Blvd #2A, Austin, TX 78727, United States

user_reviews.Name: Brad Butler
user_reviews.Description: My first visit to Rose Dental today was fantastic. They were super nice, and very efficient. Kianna did my deep clean (10/10,) and Dr Mueller helped me come up with a plan to get me excited to smile again. Another one of the highlights was how well they explained my questions relative to my goals. Ive spent a lot of years being embarrassed to even go see a dentist again, but I'm glad I wound up here.

user_reviews.Name: Jennifer Montalvo
user_reviews.Description: I have been bringing my family to Rose Dental for a while and they are amazing. What I love most is that they treat you like an individual, not just a patient. The staff is warm and welcoming, and we’ve had great experiences across their different locations. They are very efficient with reminders and treatments. Truly a trusted, top-rated dental home!

user_reviews.Name: Elizabeth
user_reviews.Description: I have been seeing the dentists and dental hygienists at Rose Dental since 2020. The staff is very friendly and professional. I appreciate the options they presented me with when costly dental work was required. I’m pleased to say I have been back on the routine cleaning schedule (twice a year) for some time now after completing the required dental work on my schedule. I recommend Rose Dental.

user_reviews.Name: Rosi Schmachtenberger
user_reviews.Description: There is an open and bright atmosphere at Rose Dental that makes everyone feel welcome. Talented dentists and professional staff make a great team. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Patricia Bruce
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been with Rose Dental for several years at 2 other locations & the new office is by far the best! Clean, good location & good parking. I definitely appreciate the upgrade. And my Hygienist, Natalia, was just lovely. Kind & gentle as well as thorough. Thank you!

user_reviews.Description: The staff is so welcoming and kind here! So far i've received a standard cleaning and a filling replacement. My dental hygienist, Kianna, was absolutely amazing! user_reviews.Name: Selma Moreno
user_reviews.Description: I had been dealing with so much pain after having a root canal done this past January. The endodontist did an excellent job but for reasons I was not able to figure out I still had pain, sometimes unbearable. After a few visits with the endodontist, I finally went to see Dr. Mueller at the Rose Dental North location. I’ve known Dr. Mueller for a long time since he was at the south location. When he moved north I stayed at the south location. Dr. Mueller convinced me to not pull the molar (root canal) which was my intention. He did his thing and also figured out my mouth guard somehow had gotten misaligned. Today I have no pain at all!! Thank you Dr. Mueller.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been with Rose Dental for several years at 2 other locations & the new office is by far the best! Clean, good location & good parking. I definitely appreciate the upgrade. And my Hygienist, Natalia, was just lovely. Kind & gentle as well as thorough. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gar Fel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shelton and his staff have been taking care of my teeth for as long as I remember. Always happy to provide excellent service and treatment. You can never ignore your teeth if you do, they’ll go away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather W.
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is so welcoming and kind here! So far i've received a standard cleaning and a filling replacement. My dental hygienist, Kianna, was absolutely amazing! So gentle and was funny to boot. The filling process was also quick and painless, I love the doctors here. I found my new regular dental office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Selma Moreno
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been dealing with so much pain after having a root canal done this past January. The endodontist did an excellent job but for reasons I was not able to figure out I still had pain, sometimes unbearable. After a few visits with the endodontist, I finally went to see Dr. Mueller at the Rose Dental North location. I’ve known Dr. Mueller for a long time since he was at the south location. When he moved north I stayed at the south location. Dr. Mueller convinced me to not pull the molar (root canal) which was my intention. He did his thing and also figured out my mouth guard somehow had gotten misaligned. Today I have no pain at all!! Thank you Dr. Mueller.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Talley Spiller
user_reviews_extended.Description: A huge shout out to Xaviera who provided the best cleaning that I have ever had. She was professional, gentle, and incredibly knowledgeable. The advice on brushing and flossing was a game-changer. I really appreciate the excellent care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Chapa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience here at Rose Dental @ Metric. I was so nervous - Dr Mueller and Katherine were amazing! I had root canals done on both my front teeth and crowns all in the same day. The worst part of the whole visit was the numbing shot but even that wasn't bad at all. Dr Mueller told me my crowns were going to be beautiful and they are! I am so pleased with the outcome. Thank you Dr Mueller for giving me my smile back! Everyone at this office is so friendly and inviting from check in to check out. I will continue to trust them with my dental care and needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was pleasant and courteous. My hygienist did a great job. I highly recommend this facility.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Kralovetz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have since moved from Austin to Houston, but I still schedule all my dental appointments with Rose Dental. It's worth the drive to know my dental health is in excellent hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paula McCormick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mueller and Dr. Shelton are absolutely the best!  The hygienists are also highly trained and professional. They are all very conscientious about the patients’ comfort during procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marilyn Chapple
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Travis Shelton is the best!! I’ve had work from other dentists in the past but the crown he made/placed today was the most seamless/flawless yet. His expertise made my appointment nearly enjoyable and I was thrilled to get it all done in one visit. (Years ago my dentist husband shipped me out due to my bad behavior😱.—I’ll be forever grateful that he handed me off to Dr Shelton.) His assistant and staff worked efficiently and professionally, lowering my dental anxiety through out the visit. I’d actually give them all 10 stars, at least!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy Dahl-Burg
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would give this business 6 stars if I could.  Everyone in this dental office is so friendly and helpful.  My dentist, Kenneth Mueller DDS is wonderful and painless!  He takes care of my entire family.  They also have an affordable dental maintenance program that covers all of my routine preventive procedures.  Love their new location on Metric also.  Highly recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mortada Mohamed
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Mueller is extremely caring, highly experienced, and always makes me feel comfortable and confident in his care.
His assistance and the staff are very efficient and very friendly.   .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a eally pleasant visit at Rose Dental today. In the past I would be extremely anxious when going to see the dentist. No anxiety today. All of the staff was very nice and Dr. Mueller was very knowledgeable and explained things to me thoroughly and where I could understand them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hemanth Bhagawatula
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Muller and Catherine are amazing.  High tech, on site milling of crown, extremely friendly, and knows what they are doing. Conservative treatment and No upselling. One of the best dentist I have ever visited.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pat Hino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shelton and staff are very accommodating with scheduling and always very kind and professional. Dr. Shelton is excellent, very knowledgeable, and always comes up with a plan that is best suited for his patients. He takes the time to explain everything and  is an excellent dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristopher Chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is billing is the worst! We’re still waiting for a simple refund from them and they refuse to pay. Our insurance has been in contact with them about the funds since July and we still haven’t seen the funds even though they said it would take 6 weeks. What a joke at this point and very unprofessional

user_reviews_extended.Name: chuck crist
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife & I have been going to Rose Dental for over 10 years now. The staff is always friendly & helpful, & Dr. Shelton is a great dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patty Stroe
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I moved to Texas, I decided to observe the smiles of my friends and neighbors, and then I would ask the person with the nicest teeth who their dentist was. One of my neighbors had beautifully well cared for teeth that were all her own, and her smile was noticeably beautiful. I asked  who her dentist was and that’s when I decided to choose Rose Dental Group. My friend spoke very highly of them, and I agree that each, and every person in that office is patient, gentle, kind, and are highly experienced professionals. I Immediately felt comfortable with them and experienced no pain at all! I’m looking forward to the rest of my procedures with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ernest Hunter
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an another great visit to my dentist. I had a bridge installed for a missing piece. This was the second visit to actually put in the permanent bridge after have completed my first visit to prepare my support teeth to receive the bridge and install a temporary bridge. The entire process was painless, efficient and very skillful done. Dr. Mueller and Katherine are a great team and work well together on my dental work.

Likewise, the front office staff is also very friendly, helpful and efficient.

I highly recommend Rose Dental Group in general and Dr. Shelton and Katherine in particular.

user_reviews_extended.Name: brenda hunter
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My dental appointment today was the best!
My four piece bridge had fall out. Dr. Muller
Said he might be able to put it back, because he hadn’t seen it yet. After he examined it, he decided he could and did put it back.
The technicians working with him were excellent too. My bridge is perfect. The whole office staff is very caring.
Brenda Hunter

user_reviews_extended.Name: K Powers
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time visit with this practice for an assessment and action plan for extensive  restorative services that maximize my dental insurance and minimize out-of-pocket expenses. Dr. Mueller and his staff, (shout out to Enrique and Jessica), exceeded expectations and spent ample time explaining options, insurance coverage, and timeline. They went the extra mile to be sure that my new dental plan was active and checked coverage details prior to the appointment.  All the staff were very professional, patient, and were really focused on patient concerns and patient satisfaction. They felt like family on the first visit.  I highly recommend Dr. Mueller and Rose Dental Group/Parmer Lane office!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Quiter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mueller and Kathryn are the absolute best! I have been seeing this great team for 10 years. I always feel so cared about and important. The work done is top grade. The whole staff is very welcoming and everyone seems to be super efficient, which is always helpful with a busy life. If you are choosing a dentist, Dr. Mueller and his team will make you smile (brightly!).

user_reviews_extended.Name: LL
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This dental office has been incredibly disappointing to deal with. I went there for orthodontic consultation at the first visit for free, and I came back for root canal surgery and paid out of pocket for surgery without issue. During my third visit for a routine cleaning (which my insurance covers), they claimed I owed $338. After checking with my insurance, I discovered they had billed a duplicate service that was denied, and now they’re trying to make me pay for their mistake.

I’ve emailed and messaged them multiple times, but they’ve completely ignored me. While the staff, doctor, and hygienist are nice and professional during appointments, the billing practices are extremely disappointing. It feels like they’re trying to charge as much as they possibly can, regardless of insurance coverage or fairness.

I was considering recommending this office to my friends after my first visit, but now I never will. Avoid this place if you care about transparent and honest billing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lloyd Walls
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The doctors and Staff at Rose Dental are always professonal. What I appreciate most was that I was able to schedule an appointment and be seen my my doctor within several days of my call. I was very glad that my doctor was able to see me bcause delaying, ignoring or prolonging action most likely would have resulted in loss of my tooth.  My doctor also keeps up with the latest developments in technology and treatment and materials and is very knowledgeable about the advantages and disadvantages of each. It good to have a dentist I can trust.

l also like their new location which is very mordern and nicely arranged and furnished.

user_reviews_extended.Name: HM
user_reviews_extended.Description: It took me a very long time to go back to the dentist because it was something I truly feared—but I’m so glad I found Dr. Mueller. He is absolutely amazing: laid-back, kind, professional, and always has a smile on his face. His dental hygienist, Leslie, is outstanding! I highly recommend booking when she’s there—she’s incredibly personable, friendly, and does a fantastic job. The front desk staff is also warm and welcoming, which makes the entire experience even better. If you’re looking for a great dental office, this is the one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Renee Riffee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love all of the staff I've been in to see over the years but Leslie is by far my favorite. And of course the incredible Dr. Mueller. Leslie has such a friendly and wonderful bedside manner, not to mention she works quickly to get the job done well. Notice I said well, not just done, she takes pride in her work and it shows. I think that's the first time I've gotten a hug from the hygienist and that's awesome! Thanks Dr. Mueller for having such a great staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabrina Ann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shelton is excellent & sweetly patient. It's so appreciated.  The staff are also fabulous... Engaging, helpful, knowledgeable & reassuring on all things.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Lespron
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dental office is awesome. I’m actually intended on calling another office nearby but accidentally called Rose dental instead. I’m so glad I did because it truly feels like home here. Every member of the staff is super friendly and professional.  Dr.Mueller is the most chill and personable dentist I’ve ever met. He pulled my tooth quickly and with ease. I actually look forward to going back to complete the rest of the dental work that is needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barbara Burnett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Doctor Shelton and his whole office staff is top notch.
Each visit is always a pleasant experience, with every staff member I have had contact with.
They take you in right away..I have had minimal waiting period..
Dr Shelton is good with explanations and answering of questions. I have never felt rushed in anyway.
The office is clean and orderly.
I drive over an hour to my appointments, I feel it is well worth the drive. I have never felt more comfortable than I do with Dr Shelton and his staff.

Barbara Burnett

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The folks at Rose Dental are definitely on there A game. They are very timely, concerned with your comfort, and genuinely care about you through the complete process. From the Dental hygienist to doctor
Shelton they're the best in town.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Malcolm
user_reviews_extended.Description: Service was superb.Jessica, Leslie, Dr Shelton and the person who did my X-rays you were so patient and sweet. I am happy I chose this dental office. Will always be my place to go to for any dental work. And referring others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annette Ashcraft
user_reviews_extended.Description: My entire family goes to Dr. Mueller at Rose, and we couldn't be happier! He is truly the best dentist ever. His staff is amazing—everyone is kind, patient, and incredibly supportive. I’ve never encountered a dentist as wonderful as Dr. Mueller. I especially trust him with my daughter, who has a fear of dentists. He always takes the time to make her feel comfortable and at ease. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Prudhomme
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would recommend Dr. Shelton to anybody! Such a knowledgeable, kind and attentive dentist. Definitely helps put all my anxiety around going to the dentist at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: This afternoon was my first visit at Rose Dental.  I was greeted with a smile and a friendly face. Short time later, I was taken to the back for my consultation with Kianna and Dr. Muller. They were very Good at what they do.  Both were Professional and Knowledgeable. Great first visit = 5 the Best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jane Sterriker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a brand new patient and I could not be more satisfied! Every single person I interacted with was pleasant and professional. Every procedure and dental plans going forward were explained thoroughly.   I highly recommend.  Thank you Rose Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim P
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shelton is amazing! He is very knowledgeable, highly skilled, kind and professional. My damaged crown was replaced at one visit. The procedure was very smooth and comfortable. Lisa is so caring and professional. I was grateful knowing I was in good hands.  Highly recommend Dr. Shelton and the amazing team at Rose Dental Group!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Aragon-Long
user_reviews_extended.Description: Rose Dental is amazing; I highly recommend their Metric location. Everyone is fantastic. Dr Shelton, in particular, does exceptional dental work. I’ve been a patient for years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Hunter
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was very friendly and attentive. We’re very interested in making the experience easy. Dr Travis was very knowledgeable and thorough with my initial consultation. I moved forward with the dental plan he had for me. I recommend him to a friend right after my visit. I would continue to recommend Rose Dental to my friends and family. Great place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Schlitz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Edit: They pretty immediately reached out to me after this review was posted and fixed the issue. I'm a little frustrated that it took a public post to get a response after several calls but at least it's fixed. Would definitely still recommend them otherwise.

Original: I loved using this dentist but they keep billing me well over a year after I moved out of the area and paid for my final bill. I have called them multiple times to try to get this resolved and each time they say that it will be resolved and nothing ever gets done.

Long story short, great service, terrible administration. Don't go here unless you want bills from them for the rest of your life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Denison
user_reviews_extended.Description: Alex was my dental hygienist and was very thorough. Alex did the most thorough cleaning I have experienced with any hygienist in years. Dr. Shelton did an awesome exam and answered many questions. I recommend this practice and particularly Alex and Dr. Shelton!! Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carolyn Pils
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a dental cleaning, x-rays and exam by dental hygienist Kianna. I had visited her before and she has always been so professional, thorough, gentle, friendly and personable. She even remembered to ask me about my angel miracle kitty, Oreo. I highly recommend her. I am 82 years old and she is one of the best and nicest hygienist I have ever had. Thank you, Kianna. You're a wonderful representative for Rose Dental. My regular dentist, Dr. Shelton, was on vacation and Dr. Mueller did my exam. I mentioned that I had roughness on one of my teeth and he was happy to work with it until I was completely satisfied. I've been Dr. Shelton's patient for many years and he is caring and wonderful in every way. I am happy to say Dr. Mueller is equally as caring and wonderful. I have always had very satisfactory and thourough care at Rose Dental. I'm a happy and satisfied patient. I highly recommend the Parmer Lane Rose Dental location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Park
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Rose Dental on Parmer Lane after I broke an existing crown on one of my teeth. Dr. Mueller did a great job replacing my broken crown quickly and pain free. He fit it beautifully and had me back to normal in minimal time. Staff were all very friendly and efficient. They even dealt with my insurance to get the repair taken care of. Best dental care I’ve had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ken Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to get a damaged tooth extracted. I was in and out in 30 minutes! The staff was calm, courteous, and those who are tense at a dental office...relaxing. Dr. Mueller made it an easy experience and explained everything well in advance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kirk VanLaningham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Rose Dental on Parmer Ln is the best. I’ve had nothing but positive experiences there from all staff and my main dentist, Dr. Shelton. Recently needed an emergency appointment, and Dr. Mueller was available to take a look and took care of my issue.  Thanks to him, my weekend was manageable. I’m so glad I found this clinic. I’m never rushed and they always think about my needs. They never do more than is needed, only medically necessary procedures. 6 stars for Rose on Parmer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darryl Roberson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Mueller and his staff at Rose Dental has always been so knowledgeable and professional. If you want a dentist and staff who actually listens to your problem, your pain and solves it. Then please experience real dentistry, experience Rose Dental.Guaranteed satisfaction.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LakeGal411
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Rose Dental has been my dentist office for many, many years and are great—so great that we drive 100 miles round trip to keep them as our dentist.
I am doing “Invisalign” now although I am almost 78, to correct a gap in my front lower teeth and to stop the teeth from leaning.  We’re half way through but I can see a difference and very happy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: JLyn Carl
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a client of Dr. Mueller for years and years and would never even consider changing dentists. Even when he moved to a new location, I followed him. Not only is he very professional, but he is also kind, outgoing and has a great sense of humor. I don’t dread going to the dentist. It’s like visiting with an old friend - and a skilled practitioner. His staff - from front office to hygienist - is professional and accommodating. I highly recommend Rose Dental Group-Parmer Lane, and Dr. Mueller and staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience as always. My hygienist did a fantastic job!  Not only did she do a great job on my teeth but  I was very stressed out when I came in, and somehow she managed to completely relax me. I walked out with a brighter smile and in a much better mood. I’m sorry I feel terrible but I forgot her name.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Ashley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this dental office solely because of the transparency and quality of care & empathy I receive from staff!, Enrique and Dr Mueller make it Easy to understand, and you always leave feeling confident and assured you are taken care of. Highly recommend this dentist for anyone with past traumatic experiences with dentists!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dorothy Haywood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Mueller is the best Dentist I have ever been to.  He care about his patients and tell everyone that ask to go to him.  He is so Kind.  I am grateful he is my Dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: K P
user_reviews_extended.Description: Five stars just isn't enough! I've lived in several states in the past 40 years and I've had lots of dental issues, so I've been to a lot of different dentists. Sometimes the doctor was good but the office staff was problematical and sometimes the staff are good but the dentist was not. But I promise you, Dr. Mueller is by far the very best dentist I've ever had. Ever. The staff are truly great as well. I've never written a review about anything anywhere, but the opportunity to sing this man's praises was something I could not resist. If you're looking for a great dental office, do yourself a huge favor and see Dr. Ken Mueller at the Parmer office. They offer a degree of excellence that is truly unmatched.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiara Daena Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I never write reviews but just wanted to say I had the BEST experience with this team. They made me feel very comfortable and explained to me the processes as they were doing my cleaning and checking into my issues. From front desk staff, to the main dentist and dental hygienist, everyone was in good spirits and really took care of me. Thank you guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Azucena O'Dell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am so glad I found this dental office close to my house!
Everything and everyone there is far beyond what I expected, super friendly, courteous, helpful, knowledgeable, and very good at what they do!
I can’t say enough great things about Dr Mueller and his staff! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Dickerson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Rick Mueller is a 100% legit asset for Rose Dental. He is very
concerned about your well-being, always putting your needs first!  It might sound cliche but he treats his patients like esteemed members of his own family. He will always take good care of you. He will always shoot straight with you. Staff is ALWAYS pleasant and courteous. Highly recommend Dr. Rick Mueller for anyone looking for an outstandingly skilled and honest dentist!  As long as Dr. MuelIer practices at Rose Dental, I won't go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kip Kennedy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm thrilled to share my fantastic experience at Dr. Mueller's office! As a scooter user, I was blown away by the seamless accessibility - I was able to roll right up to the chair and scoot in with ease. Dr. Mueller was a total pro, explaining everything clearly and calmly while still delivering top-notch care with a warm, friendly touch. If you're looking for a dentist who truly cares about making you feel comfortable and at ease, look no further!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary P.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience with Rose Dental Parmer location! As a dental assistant myself, I know what good treatment is and the assistant Valerie was amazing! She was so kind, helpful, and gentle. I’m very nervous to get dental treatment, just like most people, and she was patient and understanding. Dr. Shelton was recommended to me by another dentist and WOW he was so great! He has a very calm demeanor, talked to me throughout the procedure (which I asked him to do), and was VERY gentle. I am very sensitive to pain with a very low pain tolerance and I did not feel any pain with the numbing injection- it was so easy- and no sensitivity at all when he was restoring my tooth. I had to get a partial crown and they did everything the same day and the work he did is beautiful! You can’t even tell I have a crown! Highly recommend this office and specifically the assistant Valerie and Dr. Shelton.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rubycat
user_reviews_extended.Description: Enrique was very helpful & patient with both billing questions & updating my medical history.  Kianna was the dental tech who cleaned my teeth, & her technique was flawless - so much so that I specified I want her to do my annual checkup in 6 months.  Dr Mueller has been my dentist for 6 years, & he fosters a teamwork-oriented & supportive atmosphere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carl Schock
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time for a teeth cleaning with Alex, and she was just wonderful. So thoughtful, kind, and clearly knows her job - offered many useful strategies to keep my teeth is good shape. And of course Dr. Shelton is so good - had him for many years and wouldn't go to anyone else. The whole clinic is top notch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mi-Ae Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shelton is a very professional, calming, informative, and experienced dentist. His assistant today was also very warm and kind to me. The front desk staff was also very supportive. I am very satisfied about moving to this Parmer location  from the Angus location. I've been with Rose Dental for more than 20 years!! 👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was very helpful and easy to make an appointment very quickly.  Dr. Mueller is a very caring and problem solving dentist. I highly recommend him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracey Carlile
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very good experience at Rose Dental Group  Everyone there was kind, courteous friendly and very communicative. They make you feel so  comfortable. The dentist is great!! He explains everything he is doing and does not mind showing you what he did via the computer.  He goes out of his way to help you. His assistant is very, very good. She makes you feels so comfortable before he gets in. I would go back there again. I recommend Rose Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clint Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shelton and Valerie were an excellent team. Casual yet professional conversation during my procedure made me feel very comfortable, in a situation where most of us feel uncomfortable. Throughout Dr. Shelton carefully worked toward the most conservative treatment possible, resulting in a best-case outcome for me, requiring less work resulting in reasonable charges. Prior I was made aware of all possible outcomes and worst-case fees, and I sincerely appreciated their "under promise but over deliver" approach vs the alternative. I've personally experienced 20 years of similar service from Dr. Shelton, and couldn't hope for a better dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Glenn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have an embarrassingly huge dental phobia and had no choice but to make an appointment for a broken tooth.  I was a wreck in the office for my initial consultation even before learning I’d need a root canal and two crowns.  I went back a week later and am delighted at how well Dr. Mueller and Catherine took care of me.  He was able to numb me up completely and I am thrilled to have had zero pain for the procedures.  I really needed this positive dental experience and am so grateful for Dr. Mueller.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin Bythewood
user_reviews_extended.Description: We chose Rose Dental ten years ago after meeting Dr.Mueller through a friend. He cares more about what’s best in the long term for your teeth than just the quick fix. Natalya is a wonderful hygienist who takes excellent care of my teeth and gums and is a lovely person as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ricardo Chavira
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mueller and Valerie and Lisa ( his Staff Assistants) are "GREAT" at Rose Dental...The dental team is very thorough..., and made me feel comfortable.....I have seen. Dr. Mueller for the past 3 years...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Neal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly Hygienist Xaviera cleaned my teeth well.  The new dental facility is fresh with nice updated decor. I highly recommend my dentist, Dr Mueller.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill O
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a severe toothache over the wkend and Dr. Shelton & the staff at Rose Dental was able to fit me into their busy schedule on Monday and immediately took care of it. Excellent care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlyn Bailey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Rose Dental! They always do such a good job and don’t try to charge you for things you don’t need! I once even switched my insurance plan just so I could keep going to them because any other dentists that I tried in Austin just didn't compare.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M Strauss
user_reviews_extended.Description: I didn’t have to wait once I arrived for my appointment.  Miriam, my hygienist is very friendly and gentle. She did a great job cleaning my teeth and answered all my questions. I had a very good experience. Dr. Shelton who is my dentist is excellent, and I can highly recommend Rose Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A P
user_reviews_extended.Description: Scheduled an appointment for 4 PM and have been waiting over an hour to be seen. The waiting room is empty and they still haven’t attended to me. I was given an electric toothbrush for my time however, so I do appreciate that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcy McNeil
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am a long-time patient of Dr. Mueller at Rose Dental Group.  Dr. Mueller is an excellent dentist.  He has provided thorough, yet conservative care of my teeth and gums for many years.  Dr. Mueller always explains my treatment options, he skillfully performs necessary procedures, and he stands by his work.  He has a positive nature and  a knack for making patients feel comfortable during the dental visit.  His dental assistant, Catherine, enhances the appointment with her professionalism, her  genuine kindness and her gentle nature.

Thank you Dr. Mueller and Catherine!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Photos by Marti[na]
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Rose Dental for years and they are professional, kind and caring. I recently had severe pain in my jaw for several days, I called Rose Dental and they were able to see me right away and diagnose the problem. I needed a root canal and they performed the procedure the following day with ease. Feeling much better now and so thankful for their help. I highly recommend them!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joan Eisinger
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm so lucky and glad Dr. Shelton has been my dentist for so many years. My family and I are following him at the Palmer lane office. user_reviews_extended.Name: Candy Phillips

user_reviews_extended.Description: Stopped in today for a teeth cleaning and exam with Nataliya and Dr. Mueller at the Parmer Rose Dental location. user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Kay Van Shellenbeck

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pam

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shárie D-Wiseman

He is a wonderful and compassionate dentist. Thank you, Dr. Mueller!

user_reviews_extended.Name: daphne koch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mueller is amazing! His excellent  bedside manner, professionalism and expertise go above and  beyond my expectations. I highly recommend  Dr. Mueller. Thank you so much for restoring my Faith and my pocket book. ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gloria A. Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Rose Dental for the longest time. Today I had a dental cleaning. Sam, the  dental hygienist, did a thorough job, very professional, friendly, I was very pleased.  I have enjoyed having Dr. Shelton as my dentist for 20+ years I highly recommend him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Wilkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Rose Dental on Angus Rd. for many years with Dr. Shelton, so when he moved to Parmer Lane I naturally followed. He and his staff are very nice and professional. My dental hygienist had a soft and soothing voice that relaxed me and she had a great personality. It was a pleasant visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rob Nammari
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My initial experience with the office in 2022 was great. Easy to schedule online and I was able to schedule all my appointments for the year in advanced. My only issue with scheduling was they did not receive the paperwork I filled out online before my appointment. I needed to fill it out in person. I spoke to someone before my appointment about my insurance because I wanted to confirm everything was going to be in-network. I was told I was and everything (cleaning and x-ray) would be covered by my benefits. When I arrived, the office is nice and everyone was friendly. Got my cleaning done and I was happy.

My first experience with billing was a nightmare. A couple weeks later, a got a bill for 100% of the cleaning and x-rays. I called and spoke to someone about it because my insurance is supposed to cover 100% and they told me it doesn't. I called my insurance company to confirm and I was told it does. Previous offices would check insurance coverage prior to performing service. This location did not. My insurance company had to call and speak to someone to adjust the price. My insurance company stated the they double charged the X-rays even though both X-rays they got were the same image. It took time but my insurance company got it straightened out.

I decided to go to a new dentist that was closer to work and I asked Rose dental to send my x-rays. They said I needed to fill out an online form. I did and a month later, my new dentist hasn't received my x-rays. I went to the office with my wife (for her appointment explained next) and asked why they haven't sent them. I was told they didn't get the document I submitted online (again) and I needed to fill it out in person. I filled it out and it my new dentist has not received it yet and it has been 9 months since I did the request. I gave up on it because I will be due for new X-rays soon and confirmed my new dentist knows how to bill.

When my wife went to this location for her cleaning in August 2023, I told her to confirm with the front desk that she will only be getting X-rays if it is covered by insurance. We got a bill in October showing charges for x-rays in the same fashion they charged mine. Double charges even though they should have been charged once. I called the insurance company and they said my wife got X-rays within the last 2 years so we would be responsible to pay but not for double because it was incorrectly billed. Insurance called and spoke to someone in October and it is now January with no resolution. The people at the front desk who answer phones are no help since they can't support billing. I asked to speak to a manager but one is never available and I never get a call back. Enrique from billing was rude to me when I was asking confirming questions about the bill but he was nice when the insurance company was on the phone. He stated that they were not aware of my benefits even though it was provided multiple times.

I do not recommend this office because they do not check patient benefits before offering service. They blindly do everything and charge you for everything. Every dentist I've gone to in the past checks my coverage before I walk through the door. Rose Dental doesn't. My experience showed me how greedy this dental office is and how fake their customer service is.

Update to my original review. The manager called me a few days or so after posting. The manager stated she called me back because I posted a bad review, not because I asked the front desk to have a manager call me about a week or so prior. Unacceptable. Things got sorted out for the cost and I got a refund, she asked me to remove the review. That is also not acceptable. Helping doesn't negate the bad experience I had and people should know about the experience. Rule of thumb for customer service, never ask for a review/tip. You're coming off as desperate because you/your team aren't doing your job right. If the customer service is at the right caliber, the good reviews will write themselves.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chiquita Board
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mueller and Catherine are fantastic! I have been a patient since 2017 and always leave with a better smile. I love Dr. Mueller’s sense of humor, his passion for what you actually want done, and how he’s a genius at perfecting the best in dental care. He’s a terrific listener and my absolute go to here in Austin for my dental health. These rock stars are deserving of 5 stars! I highly recommend Rose Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Lundy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to the Oak Hill rose dental for over 15 years, and I just recently moved up north and I went to the North Austin location for the first time. Granted, I have never had any issues with my teeth, so I can’t speak about their services other than regular cleaning and x-rays. I personally hate going to the dentist, but rose dental makes it easy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gerald Christian

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miriam Villegas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Mueller and his assistant Lisa did an amazing job today. I bit a piece of my back tooth off. user_reviews_extended.Name: cindy aaram
user_reviews_extended.Description: After a terrible experience with another dentist I went to Rose Dental, even calling to make the appointment I knew it would be different. Each person I spoke to explained everything and made me feel comfortable. Dr. Kenneth R. Mueller was one of the best dentist I have ever been too. He talked thru the the procedure and he and his assistant really cared about my experience and the look and feel of everything. I meant a lot after what I had been thru with the other dental office. user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Greenwood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mueller and the hygiene & assistant team are very thorough and professional! They do a great job of explaining things in a detailed manner. user_reviews_extended.Name: Tomi Coleman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I didn't have a great experience with Rose Dental. They bill incorrectly, they bill late and charge unnecessary fees for services you really don't need. He said I didn't need them removed and I shouldn't put myself through the pain if the teeth didn't bother me.  I paid a deposit for the surgery which Rose Dental won't refund. They are unprofessional thieves, and inexperienced in dentistry. Patient care is not their top priority.
