I highly recommend this dentistry office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bridget Lyons
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've always had a wonderful experience with Rose Dental on Parmer. The hygienists are always very friendly and comforting as well as the receptionists. Dr. Tjan is phenomenal. He took the time to explain the pain I was having and how to help remedy it. The hygenist that helped me was so kind.  She made taking the pictures of my mouth fun! Very knowledgeable. Love the late hours so I don't have to miss work. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Irma Salcedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Oh yes , Dr Mueller he is great! So as his assistants ! Very knowledgeable, Mrs Catherine , which is always there to assist him. Has alot of knowledge in her work. Mr.Enrique also is good in his work.ladies in front desk! Have GOODIES n Cafe! A very clean pretty DENTAL  OFFICE!  THANK YOU ALL FOR KEEPING CUSTOMERS HAPPY ! I APPRECIATE IT VERY MUCH!  GOD BLESS YOU ALL! AMEN🙏🙏

user_reviews_extended.Name: Red Pill MAGA
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mueller is a talented dentist and a perfectionist with his work (which is a wonderful trait for someone working on your smile/teeth)! Ashley is a kind and gentle dental hygienist who takes great care to ensure my comfort during teeth cleanings. Appreciate being in such good hands with these folks. :-) Thank you! Mica

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luisa Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very caring and knowledgeable staff. From the people that greet you and the financial person( Veronica and Enrique) to all the dental hygienists and of course Dr Muller! I took a friend today and she could not believe the level of service this place sincerely offers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Ann Jenkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the best dentist I have seen. The entire staff and Dr. Mueller were completely professional thorough and explained everything in detail. I’ve never felt rushed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John
user_reviews_extended.Description: I get it, nobody likes going to the dentist, however, the staff at Rose Dental not only make it tolerable, they actually make it enjoyable! Everyone greets you with their dazzling smiles (they work in a dentist's office afterall) and good cheer. They are always professional while also being personable. They mention their additional services but aren't pushy about it, and they are always up-front if a service will not be covered by insurance, so there's no unpleasant surprises when you go to check out. Additionally, I'd like to give a shout-out to my all-time favorite hygienist, Nataliya, who is absolutely wonderful and 100% deserves all of the praise 😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: shaun walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went here for a cleaning and exam.  The dentist who gave me my exam Mueller came across as arrogant and had an attitude.  He came in and looked at my teeth for a few seconds and just told me to come back in 6 months.  Not very friendly and seemed incompetent.  However, the dental assistant who did my cleaning was very good and friendly.  I checked the Tx Dental Board site and this guy has been in trouble with the Board.  I definitely will not be coming back here again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Er Di
user_reviews_extended.Description: Rose Dental does nearly everything perfectly.  When twenty years ago I began to really appreciate how great Rose Dental is.  After twenty years my teeth and I are still very happy with them.  Their dentists and hygienists are always top notch.  Love to get my teeth cleaned.  Business-wise, RD has always been fair and courteous.  Rose Dental helps make difficult dental decisions easier.  Their bills are clear and straightforward.  They help make difficult choices manageable.  Thoroughly professional and organized.  Rose Dental truly offers 5-star service and value.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Engroff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been seeing Rose Dental for my regular checkups/cleanings for about 10 years and this office for about 3.  Paulina is very friendly and does great nearly-painless cleanings (no dental cleaning is ever completely painless in my experience, but this is the closest to it I've ever had).  Can't speak to any further dental work as I haven't needed any, but based on friendliness and service I'd recommend this office to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Rose Dental for about two years and am really impressed with their cleanliness, professionalism, friendliness and skill-level.  Don't know how they do it, but they have a way of putting me at ease, even when  facing a difficult "session in the chair."   I plan to use Rose Dental forever!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife and I have been using Rose Dental for years. They are priced fairly for such high quality of service. The staff is always thoughtful and conversational. Rose Dental makes it a bit more enjoyable to visit the Dentist😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mueller has been my dentist for many years. I trust him implicitly with my dental health. He is kind and gentle. I also enjoy his sense of humor! Really great doctor. 5+ Stars! 🦷💯✔️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim Lancaster
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Mueller is the best dentist I have ever had. In fact, he changed my perception of the dentist practice as a whole.
My dental hygienist (Cassandra), was very professional and assisted me with care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phylicia Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very pleased with my experience at Rose Dental Group on Parmer. They were able to get me in quickly and address my issues on the same day, the staff was very friendly and you could tell they truly cared about the service they were providing. I will definitely be returning for my regular check ups.

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Medaille
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Beware of these guys. A lot of scam billing and fake statements.  Even if you document the charges are fake, they will apologize and remove them, and then simply re-bill you the next month. They are a complete scam.

After I posted this review, they admitted the charges were fake and dropped them. 3 weeks later they rebilled me for the same charge.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Litton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so Thankful to The Lord for this place being recommended to me.  I am a complete coward when it comes to dentistry.  When I finally got my nerve up enough to call, the staff made me feel comfortable even though they had to deal with me talking over them due to my nerves. (Sorry Ladies)  When I arrived, there was a little Grandma type lady in the waiting room. She told me Dr. Mueller had been her dentist for 25 years and she and her Husband just loved him and drove many miles to see him.  When I saw Dr. Mueller walk her Husband out to their car and spend a little time chatting with him (even though I'm sure he was busy) that told me all I needed to know.  I hadn't even met him and already his compassion was shining through. Every detail was explained to me. My own choices were given preference. There is no denying that dental work sometimes hurts, It's the nature of the beast when you don't take care of your teeth, but they truly do everything they possibly can, to see that you are as comfortable during your procedure as you can be..  There has never been a long wait to get me back in the chair.  I cannot even tell you the horrible experiences I have had over my lifetime.  That's over now.  Thank you to Dr. Mueller, his assistants, Jeanie and the amazing receptionist. (I'm sorry I haven't gotten everyone's names yet)  Each of you played a major part in making me feel comfortable and welcome. Customer for life!  #RoseDentalRocks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Berkeley Isbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came early to my appointment and they got me in right away. Ryan did my cleaning and my teeth get fantastic, had great chairside manner, and had me out really quickly. She also set up my appointment and checked me out all in the same room. So easy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Lam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kianna my dental hygienist has been absolutely wonderful!  She is totally patient focused, friendly, and courteous. As a hygienist, she is skilled, experienced, and shows great care. I could not be happier.  Kianna is simply the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm a long time patient of Rose Dental, years with my long time Dentist, he is a great friendly Dr. Respectful and gentle. The people are friendly l love them all . Great Job everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindi Dennis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always the best experience! Dr. Shelton and his team go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and taken care of. The office staff is welcoming and kind, always helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ann Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very warm, professional staff. Dr Mueller outlined the possible options for my dental care, giving the pros and cons of each option. He was supportive of my choice and did an excellent job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rita Romo
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at rose dental was exceptional all of the staff members there are very kind and professional most especially Dr Mueller as a matter of fact he came highly recommended by other family members I am very pleased with Rose Dental thank you Rose Dental for your services greatly appreciate you 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: We had an 8am appointment and was seen by 8:02! There is coffee provided in the lobby for the ones not seeing the dentist. The dental assistant we had was so sweet and our dentist is very personable and caring. Plus, the scenery while you’re in the chair is beautiful! 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susie Caraway
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I Love the Rose Dental on West Parmer Lane! Maryame was exceptional! My teeth feel so clean and it’s the First Time in a long time that I didn’t get zings from sensitive teeth!! She put on a special flouride paste before starting, and to my amazement, I was able to relax while getting my teeth cleaned. Also, Dr. Shelton is an Excellent Dentist who only suggests what’s needed. I also like Donna at checkout! Thank You!

Update: July 13th, 2002, I had another phenomenal experience! I highly recommend Maryame and Dr. Shelton at the Parmer location!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nadine Wade
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have using Rose Dental for a couple of years now and while everyone is very nice I find that the service is not as good as I had expected.  Every appointment I end up getting into the chair at least 30 minutes behind schedule and I often I offer to reschedule so that they can catch up, but then they say I'm heading back just then.  Also after my cleaning it takes on average another 30 minutes for the Doctor to come check me out, I understand that they are busy, but every time is annoying.  I also had a cavity filled last year that clearly left a pin hole on my tooth. Oh my next cleaning I ask if they could take care of that for and and the Doctor agreed that it was due to the  filling and fixed it.  When it came time for me to check out the assistant made it very clear that this was a one time fix and was honestly rude about it, like I was the bad guy and she even stated that they don't do cosmetic items for free.  This was not a cosmetic item, this was to fix a hole left in my tooth when my cavity was filled.  Now a year later that same tooth  is having issues.  I really had been giving them the befit of doubt and that is why I continued to use them as long as I did.

Update.  Rose Dental reached out to me after this post and was extremely understanding and wanted to address all my issues. We set up another appointment for me to come in.  While the delay for my appointment was only 7 minutes before I was called back, I was still upset over the delay and requested that they call me to reschedule.  The hygienist was very kind and apologized about the delay.  About 20 minutes after my leaving I was called by Donna.  Donna was extremely rude and sarcastic when she stated , "I am soooo sorry that we were SIX minutes late getting you back into the chair", and that I needed to see the FULL picture and understand that doctors offices always run late.  She also stated that there was 3 emergency and that people in pain needed to be seen before me.  Which I fully agree with, yet with that understanding after the second emergency that was putting them behind schedule I feel that it would  have been appropriate for them to call me and inform me that they were behind schedule and offer me the chance to decide to have my appointment time delayed or rescheduled.  Also if three emergence did actually exist wouldn't that had put them much further behind than 7 minutes.  I requested a set appointment, perhaps the very 1st one of the day, or the 1st one after lunch and was given push back from Donna.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Harden
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Rose dental is the best.
I have been seeing Dr. Shelton, for about 20 years.  Dr. Shelton and his assistants are the best.  They are family oriented,  friendly and always greet you with a smile.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Go to Rose Dental for your dental needs - It’s that simple.
Dr. Jeffrey Tjan and his assistants are very welcoming, professional and down to earth (I had Ryan and Olga). The facility is clean and even if it seems a little too fancy – they likely accept your insurance. They are open to any of your questions regarding your dental care and I believe Dr. Tjan to be one of the most caring and trustworthy professionals in the state. I had no trouble switching to Rose Dental and my appointment was right on time. A+

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ali Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love me some Dr. Shelton.. Lisa S. Taylor: she does the deep cleanings. Cassondra L. & there’s one other lady, we spoke about going to the castle here in Texas. I apologize for forgetting your name!

These ladies are very patient, understanding. I just absolutely love them.
Even the lady at the front desk is so cute & sweet!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Masoud Mojtahed
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist ever. Dr. Muller is a great dentist. He cares about patients. His quality of work is exceptional. He is been my dentist for the last 18 years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Hargrave
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this dentist office for 3 years and they are awesome. The nicest staff with professional assistants. The Dr is very friendly and a great dentist. They really appreciate their patients. I will always come here for all my cleanings and fillings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dorothy Haywood
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a terrible experience here in Bastrop with a Dentist.  I have been terrified of a dentist since that experience.  I started going to Dr. Mueller about 3 years ago.  I am getting better by going.  I have had a couple emergency and needing repairs ASAP he would take care of it immediately with no complaints.  I have referred him to my family and friends. Proud to call him my Dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: neva price
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Rose with Dr. Muller for over 5 years and he’s great! I love that he answers my questions and he’s honest. My experience with the hygienist, Ashley was awesome! She has great bedside manner and I’d recommend Rose Dental to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lily Neal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I switched locations from Round Rock to Parmer and OH BUDDY the difference is amazing. Dr Tjan is awesome. He is super friendly and makes sure you understand everything he is doing. He offered me a  fast and cost effective solution to a dental issue I’ve wanted to fix since I was a child. Almost 75% cheaper than offers from other dentists. He went over all the options available and helped me find the best one for my budget. The procedure was fast and pain free. I will continue to go to Dr Tjan and would recommend him if you are looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I took my three young children here yesterday, and it was a great experience. We interacted with four different staff members, and all were friendly and professional. The facilities were clean and very inviting. It was an all-around great experience. Highly recommend.

Update: I can't recommend Dr. Mueller enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Riaz Malik
user_reviews_extended.Description: Visiting clinic after eight months. The same excellent service and compassionate care. Very impressive Wonderful and competent team and cooperative staff. Dr Mueler is friendly, competent, and deliver excellent services based on knowledge, experience and professional ethics.

user_reviews_extended.Name: N Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shelton is one of the best dentists in Austin.  He provides excellent service for a fair price.  I wish Rose Dental starts accepting dental plans again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Chang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a difficult procedure on a back tooth that needed a root canal, filling and crown.  All while I under anesthesia.   In the end e everything worked out perfectly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connie Pardo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mueller is the best Dentist in town! I was going out of town and was having some dental issues.  He was very busy but he took me in between patients.  I really appreciate him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Langfeld
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m giving it a four only because it was a little noisier than either of the Palmer or Angus locations. But they’re just moving in and there’s not a lot of soft materials that can absorb some of the noise. Obviously all the professionals I’d rate far beyond five.!!! (28th year following Dr mueller! 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻 )

user_reviews_extended.Name: AC
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Tjan and dental assistant Olga are amazing! I’ve been living in Austin for a year. I was scared that I would have to see many dentist before finding my dentist, nope! Both make such a great team and I will never leave them. They all made sure I felt comfortable and the clinic is very clean.

I was in so much pain when I went to see them. Dr. Tjan knew that and took care of the situation fast. He is courteous, funny, positive, has great energy, and took his time to explain everything. I couldn’t have asked for a better dentist! I feel great, happy, and I highly recommend Dr. Tjan and Olga. Overall, great customer service from the staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liliana Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Shelton and Lisa are super wonderful. Matter of fact, the whole staff is just lovely. They are all friendly.
If you’re worried about going to the dentist, this is the place for you. They are so sensitive to your concerns

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cody Reese
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife recently went to Rose Dental and saw Dr. Tjan. She was incredibly happy with the staff and her treatment.  They always take the time to go the extra mile for their patients.  The whole family is thankful for Rose Dental keeping us smiling.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is very friendly and patient. I never felt rushed. The dentist not only took time to explain everything to me, he was very knowledgeable.  And I felt heard.  My concerns weren't dismissed but patiently addressed.  Very pleasant experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a good experience and tech did a good job with my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Willie Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Rose Dental was very, nice, helpful, courteous and professional. Nice new location and a great atmosphere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Otha Payne-Richey
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff are very professional and friendly every time I visit.  My dentist and  his assistant are very good at explaining and preparing me for any procedure I'm getting done.  I'm one happy client when I leave.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yvette Armani
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Rose Dental! They have always taken great care of me and work with me to get my procedures done that I need. Dr. Mueller does great work and makes sure I'm not in pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Levi Young
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was seen as a new patient on Parmer Ln for a routine cleaning per referral from a friend at church. My hygienist was Victoria. She was kind, informative, and skilled at cleaning my teeth. Dr. Tjan did a great examination and listened well to answer my questions. I highly recommend these two at Rose Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great team. Always feel like they are thorough, kind, courteous, and they do a fantastic job. I enjoy going to this location when due for appointments. Appreciate them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thien Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just got back from Rose Dental. I almost cancelled my today appointment because of all the 1 star review. I have a very good experience. They have free WiFi and the place looks amazing. My insurance covered all my annual check up. We both got the protective cover which cost $60. They let us know it was not covered but we got it anyway. I also learned about my deductable which is $50 and pay out of pocket 20%. Dental won't cause a lot if you do all the recommended flossing and brushing. New year resolution!

Paulina is a very friendly hygenist. She need a raise!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yogeesh Kori
user_reviews_extended.Description: Me and my Wife are with Dr. Shelton for a long time and followed him to the Parmer location. He is awesome and takes time to explain the options and lets you make an informed decision. Always had a great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrienne Manning
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Rose Dental for 10+ years. Dr. Mueller is amazing and today my hygienist Leslie was she was awesome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Reisman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Natalia is very professional as always.She does a great job in making suggestions on my oral care. She is definitly an asset to Rose Dental. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had a wisdom tooth removed.  Walking in I was so terrified because ive never had any dental work done other than routine exams. Dr Mueller and Eric were absolutely wonderful. They made it comfortable and the procedure was literally flawless, no pain whatsoever.  The staff there are very comforting and had no problem answering all my questions.   I was reffered to them by a family member and I will deffinitley refer them to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Provost
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited Rose Dental Group for a check up and was extremely happy with the service I received. The staff was nice, the office was clean, and I feel like the dentist was honest with me and didn't try and up-sell me on all of his services. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Shelton and his staff have taken great care of me and all my dental issues for several decades, I'm not going anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Ulbrich
user_reviews_extended.Description: The place is clean and nice, but I did not appreciate all the pressure sales to get a procedure done and use financing. They even tell you about financing options in the background while you are on hold! I told them I did not want to do a filling (which my new dentist says is completely unnecessary) while I was pregnant and was called 3 times to ask when I was going to schedule it. Seriously?? I love Dr. Koop at First Impression Dentistry. Very straight on what you actually need and nice staff. Only strayed bc of insurance issues but have 6 yrs of great experience there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got my wisdom teeth taken out here even tho they weren't bothering me. Gave me a couple numbing shots in my mouth then I had to hang on to the chair while they pulled 4 wisdom teeth out with pliers, breaking 2 wisdom teeth in the process.About a week after still had bad pain and swelling.  Went back in concerned about infection and pain.  Was told to keep taking store bought pain killers.  Infection got worse eventually they gave me antibiotics when my lymph nodes were very swollen.  Soon after that I had to go to the ER due to bad swollen neck, nodes, pain and impaired breathing.  So this went on for about 3 months. Lots of ER visits, lots of dentist visits. And around 3 weeks off and on of missed work, no compensation for that time.  9 months after all this they send me a bill with a late fee... I still can't pay these ER Bill's!  I was never notified of being charged for fixing my mouth. They claimed its because I had mono.  But that test came back negative. I've been to their office twice now to discuss this bill, was told a manager would call me, have not heard anything. Just got another bill with more late charges. Yall got my number. But let me give you my lawyers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: XuanJulie Dang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Do not come to rose dental On Palmer Ln
This office wants  patient pay out of pocket. I have dental insurance and my insurance covers 80% of filling,  This office told me that my insurance was not covered. I contact my insurance and my insurance said the rose dental never file the claims.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got to my appointment a little early and was in earlier then my scheduled time. The wait time was not even 5 minutes. Dr. Mueller and staff were great and very informative! I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: tom randolph
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hesitate to leave a review because wasn't pleasant and I feel you will not even consider it.  I know these are trying times and special precautions have to be made, but I feel used and lied to.

I have a temporary crown that was supposed to be made permanent in Mid-March.  The temporary has been in 6 weeks longer than planned.  Recently, it has begun to bother me, essentially unusable due to sensitivity and pain when chewing.  I called to see and was told to come in and it could be re-seated (re-cemented) to get me through until Rose re-opens.

The appointment was made on Friday and on Monday I go in and told nothing could be done unless it is life or death.

Staff spends 2 minutes x-raying and the dentist spends 30 seconds looking at the bite and 2 minutes telling me why they can't do anything.  Then I'm CHARGED for a "doctor consultation"!?!

I'm so upset, I took off, payed, and risked exposure for something I could have been told over the phone on Friday or even Monday morning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jimmy Kay
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Muller has been my dentist for over 25 years. I have never had a more professional and honest dentist in my 71 years of life. He is my dentist for life, and if you’re smart , he will be yours as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eva Busch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly Recommend! This is the best facility I have been to since I've been an adult. Other places hire trainees with no experience and could care less about your health. At Rose Dental that staff are always quick to help, and the dental assistants are well trained and super-nice. Dr. Balderas is so welcoming, and I trust that he is doing what needs to be done for my dental health. All of the equipment is state of the art with a 360 Xray, xrays while you sit in the comfy chair(did i mention it has a back massager omg!), and a tiny camera that can really capture the small stuff.  The office office is nice and new. At first I thought it would cost me a lot of money to go to this dentist; however, I have a pretty decent plan with United Healthcare (36$ a month)cleanings are free (2x yr) and the work is a reasonable cost. I would recommend this office in a heart beat (especially for Dr. Balderas) and his team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: B Rountree
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our girls are now 18 and 21 and they have never seen any other dentist. They started with Dr Shelton early on - probably between 3yo-5yo. He has always been so patient and caring. He talks to us in detail about any concerns and our options. He makes referrals when needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental services. I highly recommend them.  I drive from. Driftwood to North Austin because Dr. Shelton is the only dentist I trust!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olga P
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sam is great hygienist, she did a great job. And after moving from Austin,we still drive from Lubbock to see Dr.Shelton. He is amazing doctor.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Mauban
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mueller was incredibly patient and kind. You can tell he really cares about what he does and has incredible skills! Amy was so kind and amazing at what she does! Highly recommend them! 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: jay
user_reviews_extended.Description:
All office staff are polite and courteous.
Dr Mueller is the best dentist in Austin.
Thanks doc.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachael Courtney
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in to have a tooth extracted and Dr. Murller did an amazing job was quick and painless to didn’t even realize I was done that’s how quick it went. He always does such a great job and the staff are friendly and helpful .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Chin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful staff and always incredibly knowledgeable. I honestly always look forward to going to the dentist because it’s a great check-in and fresh new start to break bad habits. =)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sue my hygienist was very friendly and pleasant and did a wonderful cleaning of my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rani Kondawar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience at Rose Dental Parmer. Dr Shelton is always great but today I went to this location for the first time and had a great experience with front desk staff and the appointment scheduling personnel (Teena).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Chesak
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an infected tooth when I wasn't supposed to get any work done on my teeth after surgery on my knees. Dr. Shelton worked with my surgeon and found the best way to go about taking care of my teeth while avoiding any extra risk.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron E
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was a first visit for me as a needed a new dentist.  The dental tech that took my photos/x-rays was really kind and helpful.  The dentist went over what I needed, answered my questions, and didn't try to sell me something overpriced on my first visit.  10/10 will be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicholas Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Scam artist's! Don't go here. Very pushy and condescending staff. When you go to a doctor cause your arm hurts, the doc exams u first then decides if u need an x-ray referral etc..but here it's the reverse. Came here cause of pain near my tooth,  nearly $300 worth of procedure later finally got a dentist to look in my mouth only to be told "oh there's nothing wrong with your teeth, u just have a canker sore... should clear up in a week or so." user_reviews.Name: Tyler Watson
user_reviews.Description:
There’s a big disconnect between scheduling and the doctors. This office will waste your time and try to recommend treatments that are unnecessary and expensive. You’ll be lucky if you talk to the same doctor throughout your visits. Information is inconsistent with whom you talk to regarding your health in the office.

I had my first appointment in August for a cleaning and to get a cavity addressed I could feel. The tech scheduled me to come back in 2 weeks. When I came back they said it wasn’t necessary and that he was a temp so he didn’t know what he was doing and sent me home - a waste of my time. Came back in November for the second gingivitis cleaning. Then they finally got me an appointment for my filling. Through a series of reschedules that were both on my part and on theirs, I finally saw them in February. The Doctor comes in, whom I had never talked to before, immediately recommends a crown, when I had multiple conversations about it not being that. (I had just paid for the filling too when I had arrived.) The Doctor attempts to tell me that the cavity has progressed since August and the crown is necessary—keep in mind I’ve been there 3x since August for them to monitor the issue. A $300 visit was about to become a $1500 visit.

I collect my refund and leave to get a second opinion. The next day at a different clinic they were able to get me in the same day for the filling and didn’t recommend a crown-even though they acknowledged it could compound into one once they got into the tooth. Additionally, they addressed another filling that Parkerfield had mentioned was a concern in August, but didn’t surface when my appointment came.

The many 5-star reviews you see are because they offer a Starbucks gift card if you post one while finishing your appointment in the office.

Bottom-line: I wouldn’t recommend this clinic. I have felt confused and unsure what was happening over the past 6 months in my visits even after I had originally told them my main issue. They will recommend treatments that are costly and not always necessary.
I will not be returning

She is very soft spoken and very gentle with her tone of voice when speaking with the customers. I get nervous going to the dentist but with the great customer service I get there I forget I am at a spooky place where all they are doing is trying to help me with my teeth problems. Thank you everyone for your great customer service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Ginsberg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I found Parkfield Dental through my insurance. They were quick to respond and quick to get me in the office (I think I got in the net day). I had broken a tooth while eating a bagel. Only about a third of my tooth was left along with sharp metal filling. Many x-rays were taken. The staff was very kind and explained things well. They gave me this very detailed treatment plan with pictures and suggestions about continued care. They asked if I would be willing to stay for 3 hours to complete all the work that they were recommending. The work seemed like a lot since I was only coming in for a broken tooth, but I had not been to the dentist in a while, so I figured more work had to be done. Then they brought out the bill...
Even with my dental coverage I would be responsible for nearly $1500 of my dental work. All of which needed to be paid up front. I told them that is impossible. I don't have that kind of walking around money. I asked if there was a way they could do the emergency work today and schedule the other stuff for when my finances weren't so strapped. They did not seem to like my questions that would lead to less collection for them on that day.  I quickly felt like I was being pushed into doing something I wasn't sure was necessary. I told one of the employees that was handling my finances that if I pay them what they want today, my children don't get to eat tonight. She rolled her eyes. I don't even think she was aware of it, but I had no doubt.
I left the appointment with my treatment plan, my broken tooth and no scheduled appointments to do any dental work at Parkfield. I did wonder later that day what the cost would be to simply extract the tooth, so I called Parkfield to find out. The woman I spoke to said she was unaware of the cost but would talk to the dentist about my question and call me back. She didn't call me back. The next day I called again, spoke to someone in the office. Was told that they would speak to the dentist and get back to me. They never got back to me. I'm left with the assumption that they weren't super interested in the money made from a single tooth extraction.
I know that there are better providers in and around Austin, but I have no interest returning to Parkfield Dental nor would I recommend it to any of my friends and family.

I had to be away for work for over a year, and honestly, one of the things I missed most was my wholesome dental team at Parkfield Dental! Coming back this year was such a relief—I didn’t realize how much I’d missed the care and kindness from Dr. Johnson, Cynthia, Valenia and Kevin!

They always take the time to explain everything clearly and make sure I understand what’s going on with my teeth. I really appreciate how they work with you to align treatment with your dental goals and insurance, which takes so much of the stress out of it. It’s rare to find a dental office that feels this personal and thoughtful. So glad to be back in such good hands!

His thoughtful approach helped me feel confident about my decision.

The procedure itself took about three hours, and throughout the entire process, Dr. Johnson and Michelle, the amazing dental assistant working alongside him, made sure I was comfortable and well informed. Their genuine care, professionalism, and attention to detail turned what could have been a stressful experience into something much easier and more manageable.

I also want to mention the front office staff, who were always welcoming, organized, and helpful in coordinating appointments and answering my questions.

Best of all, the work looks great. I’m very grateful for the excellent care I received and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend their practice to anyone needing dental work, whether routine or complex.
