user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex LeBoeuf
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great team working here. Friendly office staff as well as knowledgeable dentists. Very caring. Dr. Patel has been great since I've been coming here & Dr. Castro was great this last time too. Every service I've received so far has been phenomenal!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Pérez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had Dr. Castro and Cynthia for my 6 month cleaning today and they were absolutely amazing. Definitely recommend them for your dental needs. They were so kind, extremely informative, and very thorough with my cleaning. Amazing experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daubie Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every appointment I have had has been a great experience. From those who attend the front desk, my hygienist who is amazing and my dentist who is equally amazing always makes me feel at ease and show they care about me the patient. I would definitely recommend this Parkfield Family Dental to a friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: The professionalism and friendliness of the whole team is outstanding. Very welcoming and skilled, top to bottom. Thank you, to the entire team for always making my experience at Parkfield Family Dental comforting and amazing. Cannot recommend them more highly.Great Team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Coach Amber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved getting to meet Dr Johnson and I love getting taken care of by the staff every time I am here - they are all so kind! Thanks for being such a great practice ☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tita Whitten
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been searching for a GOOD dentist office! Dr. Patel, his assistant, and Anna the hygienist made my visit incredibly comfortable. Dr. Patel was very thorough with his explanation, great bedside manners and made me feel comfortable in the chair. His assistant made sure I was comfortable while taking xrays, was fast & efficient. Anna, was AMAZING! Her technique was so gentle I almost took a nap. She was very thorough with her cleaning, made sure I was comfortable and offered me water while I waited for Dr. Patel to wrap up with another patient. This has by far been one of the best dental experiences I’ve had. Its weird to say, but I can’t wait for my next cleaning! Thank you Parkfield Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Padilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: I started my journey of taking care of my health since I’ve been lucky to get dental coverage. I was very nervous and anxiety ridden, because it had BEEN FOREVER. But this place and these people made me feel safe and okay. You want a dentist and staff you will actually like and want to see, then this is the place. 10/10 making sure you feel safe and actually want to give a shoutout to your dentist on instagram.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Ugalde
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here was so kind and welcoming! The staff all seem very knowledgeable and willing to answer any questions. My first time here but I’m excited to continue my dental journey with them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: DeShawn Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Patel provided excellent service along with good assistant. They were very professional and impressionable with my care and made sure that I was comfortable. Thank you for your service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A H
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming here for years and it's always a painless process with great customer service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meaghan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience, kind and knowledgeable staff. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Boehm
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hadn’t been to the dentist in a long time. Coming here, they made me feel comfortable and confident, and not ashamed. Then, they educated me on what they saw and even built out a step-by-step plan of attack for my issues and opportunities. They also carefully walked me through maximizing my benefits before the end of the year, and even called me directly when a last minute appointment to get the most out of my benefits opened up!

Not only that, but apparently they do crowns in-house, too, so no having to wear temporary ones.

They make me excited about my future teeth and health, and I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cameron Lagrone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Johnson was great! Very friendly and thorough. I also enjoyed my time with Cynthia, the hygienist. Will definitely be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: RL M
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here at Parkville dental is amazing. They actually work with the fi'm. Actually, these girls are great and the dentist is super gentle. She let you know what she's doing. How she's doing it and how long it might take pretty awesome in my book.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devon Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everything was great! The hygienist was super sweet and her and Dr. Patel both did a great job of explaining everything and creating a plan for my treatment. Everyone in the office was really nice and I will definitely be coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: michelle weydert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a filling for a front tooth that was chipped. Dr. Johnson with the help of Kristy his dental assistant matched the fill perfectly for my chipped tooth. It looks great!! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Nink
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had the best experiences I've encountered at a dental office at Parkfield Family Dental. My procedures have been quick and handled with all the precision and professionalism one would expect from a family dental office. The doctors there are knowledgeable and understanding of patients need. From the friendly and personable staff, inviting and casual atsmophere, this office had me feeling as comfortable as one possibly could. Thank you to all the staff. Keep up the good work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Damon Moseley
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Parkfield Dental has been exceptional. What I like most about them is the parking! They have their own lot with plenty of space. Dr Krishan Patel was really friendly, and the equipment is all new. I have been to my share of dentists and this experience was one of the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam H
user_reviews_extended.Description: My cleaning went really well and left my teeth looking spectacular! They not only do a great cleaning but do a good job at making recommendations on ways to improve your routine. Kristi was an amazing help!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description:
THIRD UPDATE:
After a year of seeing a new dentist, I’ve had to have every filling done by Dr. Patel replaced due to them failing. My husband is also having to get a new crown because the one they made was too big and has been causing him constant issues, including finding cement left behind. Even though a crown should last at least 5 years, there are no further adjustments they can reasonably make. We are both worse off for having allowed Dr. Patel to touch our teeth.

SECOND UPDATE:
I have “call logs” and emails too and no, they didn’t try to contact me. I can post screenshots of my unanswered emails if we want to go that route.

After seeing a new dentist for a year now, all of my supposed problems and alignment issues have magically vanished. Get a second opinion.

UPDATE: Shortly after this review posted I was contacted by the Parkfield office. They stated my refund was available and they had tried contacting us in September (we have no record of this and I contacted them in October with no reply). We have since been refunded over $700 from an appointment that took place more than a year ago. I’ve added 1 star since I appreciate that we actually got our money back, I just wish it hadn’t taken me posting this.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
I was a patient here for 5 years and will not be returning. For several years I saw Dr. Tijerina without issue and had an overall positive experience. I would have given 5 stars based on my experience with him and his staff. Once he left, the quality of care drastically declined and we had countless issues with quality of care, and billing and insurance.

After Dr. Tijerina left I saw at least 3 different doctors at Parkfield and had little continuity of care with numerous hygienists. Some were great, some were terrible. They seem to be having a difficult time maintaining staff. Dr. Patel did a horrible, rushed filling and every visit with him felt like he just wanted to get through it as quickly as possible. Dr. Riwari confirmed it wasn’t well done but would be “ok”; my new dentist fixed it. Then my husband received an ill fitting crown from Dr. Patel after being sent home mid-procedure with a filed down tooth because the mold machine broke. Dr. Riwari also had to try and fix that. It still required further attention from a new dentist because he had nerve pain from cement getting everywhere. Dr. Riwari is the only doctor I would recommend there but also appears to have left already.

They also started aggressively pushing me to get Invisalign when it was clear that was their new money maker. After over a year we are still trying to get them to reimburse a visit after they forced us to pay upfront (Dr. T always billed post-insurance) and if I didn’t constantly ask them we never got any updates. My latest request for an update went ignored because the final EOB shows we clearly owe less than we paid. I’ve given up on expecting to be properly refunded and I regret continuing to come here for as long as we did.

Also, they incentivize you to post a review while you’re there in their office. Last time I went the offer was for a free whitening pen and you have to show them the review to get it. I wouldn’t trust the majority of positive reviews because of this alone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Quinn Pallardy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cynthia, Josie, and Dr. Johnson were all AMAZING. I actually enjoy going to the dentist now. Every single person I encountered today was fabulous and welcoming! 10/10 recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrissa d
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I appreciate all of the hard work the Parkfield Dental Team puts in every time.
Ziri is always friendly when you call and when you are walking in.
Cynthia did a great job on my cleaning, Frank was super helpful in explaining my treatment plan to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Ramos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
* Lacking professionalism in the reception area *

I have had two dental cleaning / visits at Parkfield and had no issue with the Dr’…. He was great. The wait times were not an issue either.

Unfortunately, my overall positive experience has recently changed. I made an appointment to get my molars extracted in a months advance. (Note: Many times I had trouble contacting the reception…the phone would just ring and ring throughout this time). After having someone out of town take time off from work just to be with me (as I’d need a driver for that day) and after taking a day off of work myself, I was told my appointment 3 days prior to SX day that it had to be postponed. The surgeon is to have an “emergency” and be somewhere else. How is it an emergency if he’s planned out to be somewhere else days in advance? Somewhere there is a lack of communication and it’s very unfair to clients like me.
Although they did offer a 10% off if I rescheduled…..& I would have liked to take the offer; I cannot trust them to not do this again.

Update:
The surgeon himself, who’s on my case, went out of his way to rectify the the situation !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Pew
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit to get a second opinion on a crown. The office staff, the technician, and the dentist were all just great! I like this place so far, and will switch from my regular dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jose Govea
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to Parkfield Dental for about 3 years now I’ve done Invisalign, they have fixed a chip tooth, and had a wisdom tooth pulled and each time I’ve came for an appointment the visits have been wonderful, the team here is 100% professional from the front desk to the dental assistants to the Dr. If you are looking for a dentist check out Parkfield Dental. Trust me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luke McEneny
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Courteous and matter of fact.

I’ve found it hard to schedule dentist appointments in the past, and they were very different. Instead of creating many barriers they asked three general questions, what do you need, do you insurance, and when would you want to come in. They were courteous and got everything done in minutes. I’ve just not gone to the dentist in the past because getting appointment was like pulling teeth. I had to reschedule my initial appointment (over a week out) and there wasn’t a problem.

They took the time to confirm charges with insurance before they started doing work. For me most of the anxiety of getting any kind of medical treatment is the mystery of billing, so I greatly appreciated them developing a treatment plan.

The staff were kind and attentive. Dr. Patel was understanding while giving the reality of the situation; I may have skipped going to the dentist for awhile so I needed that.

I plan on Parkfield Family Dental being 6 month dental check up spot for the foreseeable future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Barry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Switched insurance and was looking for a new office. All of the tech is a little intimidating but both the hygienist, Kristie, and the doctor, Dr. Castro, went over everything and didn't make me feel like I was being over-diagnosed. The treatment coordinator, Franc, was very personable and added to the sense that the office is treating patients fairly and appropriately.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roberto Rosas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great cleaning, the hygienist cynthia is very friendly and knowledgeable

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savannah Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description:
One of the most frustrating dental experiences ever. I went in for a cleaning, only for them to tell me I needed a deep cleaning. They refused to just do a basic cleaning for me, even though I couldn't afford a $7k cleaning at that time.

I left the office having to pay narly $400 for the exam and visit, with no work being done.

Not only that, but they proceeded to have no regards for the fact I simply couldn't pull 7k out of my pocket then and there, and spam called me about booking my appointment- at least 2-3x a week, until I blocked them. They also sent texts, and I still get emails from them.

I've heard great things about this place, but my experience wasn't good at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Rovirosa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was incredibly nice, I had a great experience! They explained everything very detailed. I can wait to get my treatment done with this professionals.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Hopkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the minute I walked in the office, all employees were so friendly and kind! Heather was wonderful at explaining my insurance benefits to me and going over my bill in advance, which made me very at ease. Dr. Patel was so great, and he really took time to explain the ins and outs of the procedure and answer all my questions. The hygienist (Marie?) was super sweet and did an excellent job as well. Overall this was probably the best dental experience I've had so far! I plan to stay with Parkfield Family Dental for as long as I can! It is obvious that they genuinely care for their patients and want to make sure they are comfortable and at ease. It's great to have an experience where patients come first!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenn Proctor
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient for at least 8 years (probably closer to 10) and absolutely loved Dr. T and this practice.  I referred so many friends over the years because they have been kind, down-to-earth, and incredibly communicative.

Over the last year or two, the experience at Parkfield has been less... pleasant.  Everyone is still friendly, but I don't feel like the quality of care is the same.

Service now does feel more money-driven.  One of my teens, who had only one previous cavity (I think) in her entire life, suddenly had 6 or 7 between one 6-month visit and the next.  Both teens suddenly were heavily recommended $400+ Invisalign retainers, which we purchased, but we realized after getting them that one kid should really have been sent back to her orthodontist for an eval before committing to this.

And finally, when I went in for my cleaning, I was told I had an incipient (probable future) cavity on a back molar.  It wasn't actually a cavity yet, just was likely to become one.  Was recommended a crown as a preventative structural measure.

Crown process started out fine, but went downhill.  I was at the clinic for 3 hours while they attempted to get my crown seated correctly.   I left with a crown/tooth incredibly sensitive to cold and pressure. I returned a few days later to have this situation resolved, and was told the issue was likely extra cement which needed to be removed.  During this process my palate was sliced open and bled copiously.  I went home with an injured palate and remaining pain.  I returned for a follow up a week or so afterwards, where they attempted to remove the remaining cement.  It felt slightly better after this visit, but I still have pain when eating on that side of my mouth and when eating/drinking cold foods or beverages.  However, I really am anxious about trying again with Parkfield to fix this situation.

I am 50 years old and over my life have had other dental, oral surgery, and orthodontic procedures with various providers and various practices, but this experience was by far the most unpleasant.

Again, the **people** at Parkfield have always been friendly.  But I can no longer recommend their services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren James
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit was great! Everyone was very helpful and explained everything wonderfully. Would definitely recommend to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Geers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience for my first time visit. Doctor Johnson and my hygienist Cynthia were helpful and very knowledgeable, walking me through all options and treatments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Sikes
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was very friendly and accommodating to my needs. They consistently checked to make sure I was comfortable and explained what they were doing throughout the cleaning. They were even willing to take extra time to remove my bottom retainer without hesitation. I was very pleased with my experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Alcordo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love my dentist! They are so easy to work with and accommodate my schedule. The dental hygienists are always efficient and gentle when I am getting my routine cleaning and the Dr is prompt and attentive. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Zawaideh
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband an I had our first appointment at Parkfield Family Dental last weekend and we loved it there. Everyone is super friendly and the office is very clean. They took their time  to explain everything and made us feel very comfortable. Also we did not have to wait long at all before we were called in for our appointments. So that was a plus. Would definitely recommend Parkfield Family Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: D
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Parkfield Dental for a second opinion after my long-time dentist office recommended two crowns out of the blue. Dr Patel made me feel very comfortable and answered all of my questions in such a way that I actually understand what is happening in my mouth. He recommended fillings instead of crowns and provided me with a treatment plan that is much more conservative than my last dentist. This office has the latest technology - they took pictures of my teeth and showed them to me on a big screen TV. I wish my last dentist would have taken the time to do that. The entire team is super friendly and makes you feel at home. Highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shadman Chowdhury
user_reviews_extended.Description: Each visit here has been really nice from the time I've walked in to walking out. All the staff are very amicable, knowledgeable, and comforting throughout. As someone working in healthcare, I really appreciate the time that everyone has taken to thoroughly explain what is going on, and I'm also appreciative of not losing valuable time waiting to be seen. I have been recommending this place to my family and I definitely extend that to anyone in the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: nate eason
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in the most pain I think I have ever experienced! Dr. Patel had me up and ready to go in under 20 minutes. 3 hours later he checked in with me to see how I was doing and I felt so good I forgot it ever even happened! The staff was stellar and the office made me feel like I was visiting family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benjamin Hopkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Mary -Ann did a wonderfully job! They were so funny, incredible detailed and informed! Will be coming back to here and wonderful to be taken care of by their team and Valerie!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Rolston
user_reviews_extended.Description: Front house staff cheery, helpful, and communicative. Cynthia the hygienist was great to work with and put me at ease. Doctors and rest of staff have all been great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neisha Heinis
user_reviews_extended.Description: This has got to be the most comfortable dentist office I've been to in a long, long while. The entire staff is just great. Everyone is very friendly and welcoming. Dr. Patel is thorough, thoughtful, and listens to every concern you may have. He takes the time to address all your questions and his explanations are detailed and easy to understand.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve seen both dentists at this office and they’re both very nice and thorough. Super friendly front staff, as well, and in my last two visits have had the two friendliest hygienists I’ve ever had!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Watson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just left after my first appointment with Anna and Dr. T and wow! I have never enjoyed a dentist visit before this one. They are so kind and gentle and no nonsense. My previous dentist told me I had a couple of cavities and referred me to a specialist about a misshapen root. I’m glad I got a second opinion - Dr. T assured me everything looks fine. I HIGHLY recommend Parkfield Family if you are in the market for a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tung Duong
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! Dr.Patel, Michell, and Kevin were all super helpful with and taught me a lot along the way!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Cantu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
All the staff, from the front desk, to hygienists and dentists are excellent with patients. I’ve had a great experience at Parkfield.

Update: 2/19/2024
All the staff have been consistently exceptional and I’m happy with my treatment at Parkfield.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellen Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was really worried because it had been a long time since I had seen a dentist. Everyone was so nice - no judgment.  Hygienist Alex explained everything and was gentle as possible and quick. Dr. Patel explained the x-rays and pointed out some future risks and potential treatments. The office was clean and bright. I highly recommend this growing practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Enakai Deveraux
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience with a dentist I've ever had. Their hours are great, and their staff is friendly and accommodating. The dentist who worked with me was humorous and down to earth, and I never felt rushed or condescended to, like with most dentists. I will definitely be returning and referring my family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: KJ4ZOY
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My wife and I were new clients. We’re ‘seniors’ so we have experience with several dental practices.

Parkfield Family Dentistry is excellent. The front desk is polite, professional and efficient. Dr. T and the clinical staff are eminently qualified.

We recommend this practice without reservation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John King
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at Parkfield Family Dental since 2017.  Dental care has always been excellent. Staff always cheerful and competent. Recently I needed to have a crown replaced. The dentist made a new one right there while I waited. It was perfect.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shane Paris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The hygienist and receptionists were nice, but the overall service was subpar. I went in for a routine cleaning where I the hygienist did not offer a fluoride treatment (admitted she forgot to do it to my partner). Dr Riwari was exceedingly late, causing the appointment to take over 2h from start to finish despite having relatively clean and unproblematic teeth, and then she was almost callous in her approach to any concerns I had. After this, I was offered Invisalign and was told I shouldn’t need more than 3 months and was quoted nearly $6000 dollars for it. They also quoted my partner $2000 for a single crown, which is roughly double what it should be according to second opinion. Overall it felt like they were looking to make a profit, not be attentive and form a good relationship with their patients.

Edit: We did call to cancel the follow up appointment and explained that the reason was because the procedure was quoted for double what our home dentist quoted. When we said this, we were told that Parkfield could also do it for that price, making me wonder why they quoted so much in the first place. They also encourage fast decision making by offering discounts for scheduling procedures within a short period of time after your initial visit. (If we scheduled the appointment in the same week, we would have gotten a 10% discount).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Fine
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had 2 cavities filled this morning at Parkfield dental and the dental assistant, Kristy did the best job numbing up my gums there was NO pain, even with the shots they needed to do. In and out within an hour.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcel Guerrier Santana
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update June 2022: on my last cleaning visit the whole staff had changed. Instead of a cleaning other procedures were done and I was pushed to get fillings on all my mouth. I trusted the doctor and the work was ok but why did all staff and the Dr change? Why the change without explanation? I am concerned I was talked into more expensive medical procedures but not sure why and concern were not answered.

I can see this could be the right approach, but why where these changes not discussed at all?

Very nice first experience. Everyone was super nice and super helpful. Will gladly go back and recommend it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meesh Cameron
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are awesome they make you feel better, good with dentures,adjustments,  🫧 cleaning the dentist 🦷 is really good 😊 Josie is the best!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nelda Guerrero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Patel and Cynthia were amazing! I’ve avoided the dentist due to a bad experience and thankfully a coworker referred me to Parkfield Dental. Best dentist visit, ever!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cam Keif
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel is really friendly and took the time to get to know me and explain everything he was doing. He listened to my concerns about my tooth and fixed it and you can just tell everyone genuinely takes pride in their work. All the equipment is up to date and there are big TVs in the exam room. Great experience, will happily keep coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherri Sheffield
user_reviews_extended.Description: The friendliness and attentiveness of Ziri, Kevin, Adriana, Kristy and Dr. Johnson made my recent appointment much more bearable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Giorgi Nadiradze
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Nothing but good things to say! 5-star service, 5 stars in explaining the procedures needed to fix my issues, and they have awesome payment plans as well!

Very happy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Hull
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very friendly, personable staff.  I'm happy to have found an office that is willing to be conservative with treatment and truly do what is best for the patient instead of what brings in the most $$$.  I will definitely recommend this office to friends.  Thanks Dr. Tijerina!

Update:  We just had family preventative care visits again and I continue to be extremely happy with Dr. T and the staff at Parkfield Family Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: frank onuorah
user_reviews_extended.Description: On April 6, l went to this clinic for a routine dental cleaning appointment but a desk clerk at the front insisted that l would rather submit for a procedure that I had not booked for, or l would not be attended by their dentist. For more than 10 minutes arguing that my appointment was only for a routine cleaning, she maintained her ground,  and would rather be glad to see me leave. I left, even though my family has made this place our dental clinic before the current owners. I gave them 3 stars just because of the goodness of Dr. Tijerina. Whether my family will continue to use its services is still questionable for me now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Ciesielski
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a lovely time getting my X-rays and new patient exam with Kristi. The dentist’s chair can be daunting when you haven’t been for too many years, but the staff at Parkfield helped to put me at ease and got my plan to have my chompers healthy and happy again. Thank you Parkfield!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corrine Ritz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to this dental office since 2017, even after we moved all the way to Round Rock. I stayed because of the care and attention they always showed me especially having severe anxiety about going to the dentist. They even had me coming in every 3 months so we could stay on top of my care and it actually made going a bit easier since it was more frequent.

That all changed yesterday when I was assigned a new hygienist (C.H) who claimed she was new to the practice. She immediately launched into taking 3D images of my teeth without explaining why or what she was doing and it was so incredibly uncomfortable I asked twice (do we have to do this?) No idea if this was covered by my insurance or not either.

Then before even looking at my gums or teeth in detail she starts bringing up when my last deep cleaning was and starting to pitch that. And I calmly explain to her that usually I am able to come in and get my teeth cleaned and then leave since I have a lot of anxiety coming here. She was incredibly rude and told me "thats fine but i still need to do MY Job"

Then she measures my gums and then starts sending slacks about it. Meanwhile its been THIRTY MINUTES since i arrived and she hadn't even started cleaning my teeth. Then she starts saying my gums look swollen to which i replied yes i'm 20 weeks pregnant i'm aware my gums are sensitive can we please just get on with the cleaning. She goes back to writing things in slack.

I finally got up and left at this point. I have never been met with a hygienist at this office that was ever anything but kind and calming and respective of me wanting to just get the process done quickly and efficiently. This hygienist not only reduced me to tears over it but has made my husband and i decide we will no longer be patients here. Really sad as I loved everyone else at that office but this was a really rude experience for no reason.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lianna Mcdowell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience. Dr. Castro gave me some great insight on what my next steps are for my dental health. My hygienist was very personable and gentle. Would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Fischer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve had a fantastic experience with Dr. Patel, Angie, and the whole staff with multiple services lately. First, I’m not the biggest fan of dentists, I always feel grossed out and that the equipment is old but Parkfield has clean and new equipment that even my “germ-phobic” side was fine with. They also have advanced technology that made x-rays less uncomfortable than my past dentists. Thanks to this I was not only more comfortable getting scanned/x-rayed but I was able to get a night mouth guard made faster than any other dentist I’ve been to.

Also, I have had issues in the past due to one of my front teeth being a crown (knocked out in a fall) that is a different size than my real teeth around it. Over the years the crown stayed white and my teeth around it turned yellow. Long story short, I had no confidence in my smile, my front teeth were different colors and sizes. Dr. Patel and his team professionally consulted with me on options that were in my budget, best for my smile/health and now I love my smile!

A truly caring, advanced, and highly proficient office with great staff! I’ll never switch doctors even if I have to travel to this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Tex
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was super professional & very polite during my Dental Cleaning. Pakou & Dr. Rewari were excellent, very personable, & knowledgeable! This is rare to say about going to the Dentist… but I can’t wait to visit them again soon to get more work done & continuously get my Teeth to their healthiest form ever. 🙏😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mickey Shanahan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm elated I took the chance and switched to Parkfield Family Dental. My first visit was so much better than any experience I'd had with my former dentist that I spent a week telling anyone who'd listen. The office is clean and spacious, the staff is competent and experienced, and Dr. Patel is skilled and professional. Great experience. UPDATE: Dr. Patel has left the practice in the capable hands of his partner Dr. Tijerina, and this is still the best dental office I've ever visited. One of the best businesses in my 'hood.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Fabry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a GREAT experience here! Everyone was super friendly and fun- who knew the dentist could be fun?! Dr. Tijerina took the time to explain everything to me including an abnormality seen in my x-rays. Wonderful people doing a wonderful job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ali Griggs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was once a great practice when Dr T ran it, but now it's evident the new owners are trying to make money at the expense of the care for their clients and the well being of their staff.

They reduced the waiting room size by more than half, so even if you are trying to stay COVID conscious, you're forced to sit painfully close to others. They used the remaining space to cram another patient room into the building, and the chair in that room faces the window that looks out onto the entrance if the building with no blinds or privacy film, so when people walk up they get a full show of other patients' dental care. Awkward at best.

The doctors really push for Invisalign, whether you ask for it or not, but then ignore you for weeks when you tell them there are problems.

The technicians and staff are obviously understaffed, overbooked and unsupported. Over half of my appointments have been rescheduled because they didn't have enough staff the day of, or the doctor would not be in.  Staff seems increasingly frazzled every visit and can't take the time to provide care for patients. I recently went in for a check up, was shown to a room, asked if things were going ok, no one even looked at my mouth, and they said, "okay, thanks for coming in." Could have been a phone call.

Currently looking for a different provider.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeri Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Parkfield Dental is a great place. They are thorough, kind, compassionate and very knowledgeable team.  Josie, Cynthia, and Dr. Patel, you all rock! Glad to have you on my team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monna Lissa Raja
user_reviews_extended.Description: This family dental is a keeper. They are all very nice and they do not upsell anything just for profit. My family look forward to every visit. Dr. T and the rest of the folks there are really warm and friendly. The clinic itself has a home-like ambiance so that's a bonus. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gail Mobley
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here at Parkfield Family Dental are terrific!  Very friendly  and attentive. They always tell me what I need, no matter re and no less. My visit here was fabulous!😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fabrice raud
user_reviews_extended.Description: Both dentists that I had to deal with did an excellent job. Dr Tijerina gave me a shot and I did not feel anything at all. Dr Patel really provided me with the best advice on what to do with my bad teeth saving me tons of money and the cantilever bridges he put in my mouth are solid as rocks!  I am so pleased to have them friendly and dedicated professionals in my neighborhood.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsey Yerkes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dental care experience I’ve had.  I am admittedly very anxious with going to the dentist and self-conscious regarding my dental health.  The front desk was absolutely accommodating to my needs and were able to squeeze me into the schedule last minute due to my increased pain severity.  They explained my insurance benefits clearly and were very empathetic to my situation.  Dr. T is very personable and puts you at ease the minute you meet him.  He explained things very clearly and answered any questions/concerns I had.  His office even coordinated my appointment with the endodontist so I could have my symptoms addressed ASAP.  I cannot overemphasize how much I recommend and appreciate Dr. T and the Parkfield Family Dental staff.  Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: john mcclelland
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Parkfield Family Dental is the best dental office in Austin.  Every time I walk into their office Dr. Hector and his staff are always so kind and friendly.

I really like how this office uses some amazing, new technology that I've never seen before.  They're able to take computerized images of your teeth so you can actually see and understand the condition of your teeth.
Personally,  I want to understand why a service is needed and they are really helpful by showing you the pictures and explaining what is happening with my teeth.  I learned more about my teeth today than I ever have the past 40 years with other dentists.

My #1 reason why I like Parkfield Family Dental so much is because of Dr. Hector.  He goes to great lengths to make sure that I'm always comfortable while I'm in the chair.  He's incredibly patient and gentle and he makes sure that I'm not having any discomfort.  If you're looking for a Pain-Free Dentist then this is where you should go.

I also like their location because it's easy to get to and I appreciate that they are adhering to all Covid guidelines as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Manasa Murthy
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Parkfield Dental was great. Dr. Patel spent a lot of time talking to me and addressing my questions. The staff was also really friendly. The atmosphere is also very soothing and nice inside. I personally liked the TV's in the patient care areas.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christin Monts
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff as well as Dr. Tijerina are absolutely amazing. I always felt taken care of, had no waiting times whatsoever and every procedure from cleaning, filing to crown have been efficient, affordable and I had no issues with any of them afterwards. I have a fear of dentist but this practice puts me at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Yen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to Dr. Patel's dental office for the past five years and although I usually despise going to the dentist but I have found the experience here to be seamless. Dr. Patel takes time to answer any questions or address concerns; and also goes over the health of your gums and teeth to prevent future issues.

I began treatment for Invisalign earlier this year and the process could not be smoother! I highly recommend Dr. Patel and his team --they are knowledgeable, helpful, and extremely friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Doss
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Tijerina is hands down the best dentist I've ever had. I put off going to the dentist for about five years *gross* due to extreme anxiety. From the moment I walked in, I was put at ease by the adorable office manager who also worked as a dental assistant. They explained everything in great detail, starting with the x-rays and had me laughing and comfortable by the time I was in the chair. Dr. T is so personable and genuinely cares about his patients and their specific needs. It was super quick and seriously painless, these ladies and gents are truly artists! I couldn't say enough great things about this practice - I am so lucky to have found them and now I can enjoy my clean set of chompers. I'm actually looking forward to my next visit in six months!?! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adelia Wong
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience. Dr T is excellent, and every staff member I've interacted with has been friendly, competent, caring, and very knowledgable! The office itself is comfortable and clean, and their automated email/phone appointment reminders are helpful and never frustrating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rose Gierth
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with Dr Patel. I was really nervous and he made the experience comfortable and quick while I got my cavities filled. I’ve been going to this dentist for years and I can’t stay enough good things about him and his practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eugene Daley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't express enough, how appreciative and grateful I am, to Parkfield Dental. Dr Krishan Patel and his team, fit me in their very busy schedule. I am in town for a family emergency and had a dental urgency, Dr Krishan and his team took such good care of me. I am a dental hygienist myself of many years, and I recognize a talented, skilled dentist and a wonderful support staff! If you're  looking for a great Doc and office, you're search is over! Thanks again Dr Krishan! 😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffani Hammack
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Patel was wonderful, as were his assistants. Best teeth cleaning I've received since living in Austin. The office is clean, efficient, welcoming and in a very convenient location. Looking forward to finally finding a dentist I want to stick with!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eunice Labrador
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Patient care is phenomenal. All techs had gentle hands. The cleaning process was efficient.

Bow tie Franc at the reception desk was so personable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Kleifgen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sam, Dr Patel and the whole staff did a great job, and the pleasant office and his super friendly demeanor made going into the dentist after some time away as stress free and even pleasant.  I'm glad to have found such a great place to take care of my teeth in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Agustina Boffi
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is great! They discuss all treatment options with you and they really care about you and your teeth! I recommend it to anyone, and the receptionist Frank is amazing and super patient!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Elena Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so glad we have this kind of dental care in the neighborhood. I had a very pleasant experience. The personal is friendly, the office area clean, Doctor Tijerina took the time to explain the procedure that He was going to do , what a needed was done the same day. And one more thing that is going to keep me going back THEY ARE OPEN ON  SATURDAY !!!! No need to take a day off from work, I LOVE IT!!! Thank you, and Happy Holiday's.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Dominguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist has changed multiple times with no communication of said changes, I preferred Dr. T. I don’t like having a new dentist every visit. I’ve had 3 different dentist since becoming a patient and I prefer to have some kind of continuity of care. At first it was Dr. Patel and then years of Dr. T and then Dr. Patel comes back and now a brand new guy? The newest dentist seems to be more aggressive in his treatment plans, pushing fillings. I’ve never had a cavity and the dude barely looked. Not only that with new dentist looking to make $$$ hygienists are pushing FLUORIDE treatments. Fluoride is a neurotoxin and as a Hashimotos patient Fluoride causes damage to the thyroid. But they don’t care about that, more interested in making money now. I don’t trust the staff or the dentist. I came from having the same dentist for 25 years who had a more conservative approach to dentistry and more transparency with their patients

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casey Todd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend getting all your dental work done at Parkfield Family Dental. I really loved how friendly everyone was. They really took care of me. I really appreciate everything Parkfield has done for me. I can't wait to go back on my six month check up. Thanks again Parkfield Family Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A D
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Imagine a dentist who comes in and doesn't introduce herself, starts talking about your teeth using terms you may or may not be familiar with and doesn't bother to explain unless you ask. Only to quickly perform your dental exam to move on as quickly as possible to the next patient. Or imagine being a bit anxious about a procedure and then not being told that you'll be getting an anesthetic (Epinephrine) that will make your anxiety even worse. Or can you imagine the dentist having the nerve to come tell you, as your permanent crown is being fitted, that you're taking too long and other patients are wanting to be seen. Well, imagine no more; you too, could experience those and many more unpleasant experiences at the hands of Dr. Smita Rewari at Parkfirld Dental where she will make you feel like a product not a patient and mutilate you.

Reply to the Operations Director comment:

-The nerve that you have. By the way, it's been months now and I'm still waiting on a call back from YOU after I took you on the request to call you. If you think replying back with snarky comments instead of acknowledging the complaints in a constructive manner will attract people reading these reviews, you are wrong.

PS., my phone number is still the same; return my phone call anytime.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Lyn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
What more can I say, the reviews below are dead on!
This dentist office rocks!
My 3 yr old was in out and I appreciate how the dentists handled him.
You guys really do a great job, thanks for the future advice on taking care of his teeth and explaining it to him and myself!
Hilarious but look forward to his next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Martz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff was great! Wait times were kept to a minimum, which I really appreciate.

Dr. Patel took his time and explained what was going on, accompanied with pictures and offered me several different plans to get it accomplished. Not once did I feel like he was trying to "sell" me dental service.

Will be making this my new dentist in austin

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh P
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a new resident to Austin I found the task of finding a new dentist a bit intimidating since the one I went to in my previous city had been my dentist for 15 years. After getting a suggestions from some neighbors about Parkfield Dental I decided to give them a try. I found it very convenient that they offer appointments after 5pm, no more taking time off work to take care of my teeth. The check in process was very easy and quick, I got all my paperwork done, x-rays and was in a dental chair within 10 minutes of arriving. Dr. Patel and Heather was great walked me through everything that was going to take place and made me feel very comfortable. They have all of the latest dental technology which makes cleanings a painless and quick procedure. I am so glad I found a new dentist that is efficient and friendly, I wish all visits to doctors offices were as smooth as Parkfield.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristobal Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really nice and did a thorough job in the cleaning. Kevin did a great job breaking down the payment plan.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Dragonetti
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience there, friendly staff at front desk had already verified my insurance, hygienist and dentist gave great explanations of everything and were incredibly friendly as well. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Lahowetz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with Dr. Johnson and team. Such friendly and helpful staff. I feel in very good hands at every appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary C Lamb
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this dental practice! The dentists, hygienists, and staff are super friendly and supportive. I hate going to the dentist, but this has been the best experience; I cannot recommend them highly enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Inocencio
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at park field family dental is amazing. They are so welcoming, and care about you the entire time you there from the minute you walk in to the minute you leave. If you get a procedure done they ask you how your doing and care if they are hurting you. I recommend visiting this office. I think you will love it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tanya Haberman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been very happy with the personal service we have received at Parkfield Family Dental.  I was looking for a small business to support (verses a dentist that is part of a national or local chain) and found Parkfield to be clean, the staff friendly and knowledgeable, and easy to get appointments.  They are trying to grow an exceptional small family friendly business.  Great job, Parkfield Family Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: sangeetha murthy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Parkfield Dental for an Invisalign consultation. The doctor was very friendly and knowledgeable and explained the process in a way that I could easily understand. The entire team from the front desk to the assistant made my appointment seamless - there was hardly a wait! The payment options were great for me and I started Invisalign. If you are looking for a dentist to take your smile to the next level, I highly recommend Parkfield Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheri Kimes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff at Parkfield Family Dental is incredible. From the moment you walk in the door, you're greeted by their friendly staff who are thorough and knowledgable.

I've had very gentle cleanings, without any aches and pains, and final checks with Dr. Patel and Dr. Tijerina. Everyone is very personable and does everything they can to make sure you're comfortable with the experience. By some miracle they even remember what you spoke about the last time you were in the office!

I would highly recommend them to anyone who is looking for a dentist, unhappy with their current dentist, and even folks who love their current dentist, because I'm certain you'll receive equal or better care from Dr. Patel and Dr. Tijerina!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Parkfield when it first opened with Dr. T and Dr. Patel. (probably 6 years) Unfortunately, Dr. T and Anna (the awesome hygienist) are both gone. I went in for my 6 mo checkup this week and had a traumatizing experience. The temp hygienist Mikayla was awesome by the way - very professional and made an effort to get to know me and my teeth. The new doctor, Dr. Avi Patel, was not however. He spent 2 minutes with me, did not get to know me, did not get to know that I am extremely nervous about metal things poking near my sensitive right tooth. He poked around my mouth with a metal instrument and then used a percussion instrument in the tips of my teeth to see why I was sensitive. But there was no forewarning or anything. I am traumatized. I hated how I was treated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Diaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super nice staff! They explain to you everything in detail, about any procedure needed to be done. I truly enjoyed my very first visit here. Highly recommended! 🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Yu Barbera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience. From making the appointment, the follow up, the friendly staff, I can't say enough! Moved after bad experiences with other dentists and couldn't be happier.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every time I come in I am greeted with a smile. The staff is amazing. I’ve been coming here for a few years now and it is always an amazing experience for my and my son. 10 out of 10 I highly recommend so much so my sister now comes here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jon Wolf
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have referred dozens of people to this dental practice.  The staff are friendly and professional.  The doctors take time with patients and never shame you or recommend crazy expensive treatments as "the only option".  I always hear "Well, if these were my teeth, I would..." as well as all the options available (including the really expensive ones).
This is a rare gem of a dental practice.  My whole family goes here, as well as many people I have referred.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rupal Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Parkfield Family Dental was excellent! I used to go to a chain dentist, but wanted something like Parkfield - a comfortable, family-owned clinic. The staff is very friendly, making it a pleasant atmosphere. The dentist is timely, gentle, and explains everything perfectly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ann S
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit was awesome! Special thanks to Cynthia, Valeria and Kevin the coordinator for awesome professionalism and transparency!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Burkett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Parkfield Family Dental was the first time I had been to the dentist in around 9 years, so to say I was nervous would be an understatement. I could not imagine going to a place with a friendlier atmosphere and a vibe that puts you immediately at ease. I saw Dr. Patel who did not shame me for the time I had not been to the dentist, was super kind and friendly, and in general a great personality! Going to major dentist chains can put a bad taste in your mouth (pun intended) with their high prices and their extreme dental work recommendations. I truly trusted everything Dr. Patel said and believe that they would not recommend any work that isn't absolutely necessary. Thanks for easing my fear of the dentist a little bit Parkfield Family Dental! I would no joke drive across Austin to stay at this business! 100% recommended

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alma B Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I took my girls (12 yr old twins)two weeks ago for the first time to his office. My girls loved the way everyone treated them. Yesterday my husband and I went and same friendly treatment. We have decided to make this our family dental home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David DiStefano
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updating to give a special shout-out to Dr. Castro and team for giving me my best smile, thank you again!

Very professional, high tech and informative staff. Very satisfied with the care and recommendations I received

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Karah
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very friendly staff!
Teeth cleaning was thorough and painless.
Laura was efficient yet gentle.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ary Warbenjagermanjensen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had a lot of good dentists throughout my life, and they just blew me away at how much higher they set that bar. Everyone is amazing here, willing to work with me every step of the way, really careful and attentive. I'm just amazed at how far dentistry has come and they bring all of that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neil Labrador
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental office was clean and the associates were very knowledgeable. Shout out to bow tie Franc as well for thoroughly explaining the expenses and scheduling. Highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica Tula
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Parkfield Dental! I had an amazing experience with them. They take great care of their patients! Dr Patel and Hygienist Cynthia are awesome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
All of the other 5 star reviews are on point. I used them to choose this dentist and they did not disappoint.

Update - a year later: I am still happy here! Everyone is so kind and I feel well taken care of.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Swegan
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Parkfield Family Dental was friendly upon arrival. There was very little wait and they were efficient during my cleaning. The entire staff was welcoming, friendly and truly cared about my needs throughout my visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Palomera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place! Honestly the staff the dentist all of it! Super sweet! They explain everything in detail, they are honest and the choose the right options for you, and they seem to really care about their patients, I’m sad that I’m moving out of state because the are totally awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Green
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! Everyone in the office, including Dr. Patel, was friendly and accommodating. The office is decorated with beautiful art work, smells amazing, and is very clean. Will definitely use them again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaime Roble
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Parkfield dentist for a couple years now.  I have not had a bad visit until my last visit last week. Besides  running behind by 30 minutes and not communicating that to me, the hygienist Kat was so rough! This was my most painful experience at the dentist ever for me. Not to mention I felt like I was being waterboarded with the waterpik Kat used to clean my teeth. Most of the water was on my face! Not sure if she was just not paying attention,  or if she just didn't know how to use the tools. She also ended up cutting my cheek. Dr. Tijerina is fantastic, however I did not get the same feeling about Dr. Patel. I got the feeling he was just pushing more products and procedures to make money. Not sure how I could suddenly need so much work in just 6 months time. Hopefully they were just having an off day.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda P.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my first visit to Parkfield Dental.  It impressed me that they had newer software & equipment than my former Dentist. Also the Staff, Hygienist, & Dentist were so friendly & competent that I was very happy I chose Dr. Patel at Parkfield Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jake Bronson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to Parkfield Dental for a number of years and it's always a welcoming experience, and again today I had a fantastic appointment with Cynthia, Valeria and Dr. Johnson!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Pérez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely love Parkfield Dental!! I have been coming here since 2020 and they have always taken care of my dental needs. They always take the time to explain my dental services and are always so kind. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Giorgio Machnizh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing service! Very helpful from start to finish and will definitely be returning! 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Micallef
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm so very excited to work with Dr T and my new Invisalign Aligners. Been wanting to address this area my whole life and the entire staff here have made it seamless. My whole family gets great dental care here too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marrilee Archer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I could not be happier with my recent appointment and am scheduling visits for the rest of my family.  Friendly, overly competent, pleasant and a lovely, comfortable office - these fine folks may have turned around a lifetime of hating dentists' visits in an hour visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitchell Clanton
user_reviews_extended.Description: The majority of good reviews here are for a dentist and hygienist that no longer work here. I wish I had left when they did. Rewari is a prime example of why people don't like going to the dentist. She argued with me about my pain and told me that pieces breaking off of my fillings was normal. Now my jaw clicks, I have headaches and my teeth don't fit together comfortably when I bite down.

user_reviews_extended.Name: marvel duncan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I normally do not see any other dentist outside of my childhood Dentist. The only reason for not seeing my normal dentist was scheduling conflicts, but I must say I am glad that I picked Parkfield Family Dental. They were everything that was said in previous patients reviews. The staff are awesome! The office smells delicious! Dr. T was very informative and the dental hygentist was super nice. I will definately will be back! I highly recommend this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Wambold
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel and his team are great.  They spend time and treat you as an individual patient. I felt like I was getting true dental care and they were looking after my individual health. At some chain dental practices, I felt rushed through and upsold services I may not need. Dr Patel showed me all my X-Rays and reviewed my results.  Great team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Soper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sam was great and very gentle with my teeth! Office is very friendly and willing to work with me on finances which was most appreciated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Parkfield Dental. I’ve coming here a few years and they are very high tech, friendly and knowledgeable. I highly recommend if you’re looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monimala Dutta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent staff ! Dr T was my dentist and he did a small procedure on my daughter as well. We are extremely happy and satisfied with the service. Very very friendly and always ready to help .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suncerae Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Easy location with very helpful staff. My wait was only a few minutes. Dr. Tijerina sat down with me before finishing my cleaning to address any concerns, and he was genuine and easy to talk to. There are lots of distractions (music and a flat screen tv above the chair) which were overwhelmingly loud when I first arrived, but the volume was eventually turned down. I will be returning for future visits!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Briana Orosco
user_reviews_extended.Description: Could not stop talking about my dentist visit when I went to work. Everyone I met was friendly and made me feel so comfortable, especially for someone who hasn't seen a dentist in a few years. Definitely would recommend them to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marlena Griffin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental clinic. Staff is always friendly and positive. It’s modern looking and they offer the best in dental care. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We've been going to Parkfield Dental for a few years now. They are easy to schedule, low pressure and always friendly.

We also take our toddler to them. Dr. Tijerina talked us off the ledge when we found our toddler's first cavity and has been monitoring it closely but recommended our little dude not have any pediatric dental procedures unless absolutely necessary. We highly recommend him to other parents who want a second opinion on costly, scary dental work for their children. The whole team is very kid-friendly and gentle.

They also have TVs in each room so you don't have to spend an hour counting ceiling tiles.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura K. Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cynthia was extremely knowledgeable and thorough with the imaging and cleaning! Everyone in the practice was friendly and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mona Singh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Patel is friendly and does a great job building rapport and making you feel comfortable. The staff is friendly and cheerful and seem to genuinely enjoy working there. They have an x ray machine that is light and easy for you to get your xrays done. Per the tech - it also produces 75% less radiation exposure plus no more going to another room, posing and biting on those big trays. It's located in what looks like a ranch style home, with big screen tvs in the room for you to watch while you wait in the chair. One of the things I also appreciate about Parkfield Family Dental is that I get an e-mail reminder and call a week before my 6 month appointment. In my busy and ever changing schedule, it gives me enough time to move my calendar around if I need too or get rescheduled if it doesn't work. I recommend this spot to any newcomer in N. Austin area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vic R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited Dr. Patel's office for a second opinion. Being prone to cavities I wanted to verify I did not have cavities. Both the staff and Dr. Patel were very friendly. What I found unique with Parkfield Family Dental is the "hands on" care from Dr. Patel. He is the first dentist I've encountered to do the cleaning himself. Being a younger dentist, Dr. Patel embraces technology into his practice and while examining my teeth he photographed them in order to show me a small cavity he found. I appreciated this and felt confident that I had received a proper examination. He is now my dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jo HZ
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Getting my teeth cleaned is not on my favorite things to do list, and I take care of my teeth ... well, I don't floss EVERY day, but let's not get into that right now. No matter how many TVs you put up to distract me, I HATE getting my teeth cleaned. Dr. Patel proved me wrong. I'm not saying I love getting them cleaned now, but what I can say that Dr. Patel was fast, thorough, and for once in my life, the scraping and BZZZZZZZ sounds didn't bother me that much. Dr. Patel and his assistant were friendly, welcoming and created a warm and relaxed environment that before I could even start dreading about my bleeding gums, it was all over. The staff didn't push any extra dental work on me (which happened at my last dentist office. Got suckered/guilt-tripped into paying for another $150 "special cleaning".) Dr. Patel understood that not everyone has briefcase full of money to get the perfect pearly whites, and he was honest and practical about the status of my teeth and what I "could" do, and not what I "should do, or else..." I really appreciated that.

Long story short, Parkfield Family Dental is great. Stop procrastinating and get those teeth cleaned already.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
12 reviews
5.0 star rating 10/17/2016
My 21 month old took a nasty fall and hit her tooth causing it to bleed(I know- one of every parent's worst nightmares) so I called Parkfield and they scheduled us for an appointment within the hour! They didn't judge me about being nervous for her teeth even though it wasn't a bad fall. This was my daughter's first dentist appointment and I was a little nervous how it would go and if they'd get upset if she cried. As soon as we walked in all of the office staff was so nice and my daughter even hugged one of the ladies! Ok good start. We sat down to talk to Dr. Patel and my daughter was okay until it was time to check her teeth. She did cry, but Dr. Patel was awesome and totally understanding. He even checked her face to see if anything was hurt there. Long story short, my daughter is fine(she even got a sticker) and we will be returning every 6 months for my daughter's dental needs. I HIGHLY recommend them to any parents who are nervous or worried about their little people.

Once I actually went to the appointment and saw Dr. Patel and his staff, I immediately saw that all my anxieties were unfounded. The entire staff was friendly and professional. Dr. Patel performed a although examination and then using state of the art technology he both explained and showed me all of the work I needed to get done. Wherever there were options or various courses of treatment, Dr. Patel explained each one and let me know which course he would take if it were his own teeth needing the treatment. And last but not least we were able to come up with a treatment plan that satisfies my dental needs without affecting my wallet too much.

I highly recommend Dr. Patel and his staff to anyone out there searching for a new dentist for themselves or their family. I can assure you, once you visit Dr. Patel's office you'll be a repeat customer just like me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katryna Padilla
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update:

I want to make it known that when this happened, we did reach out and voice our concerns post procedure. No refund was offered like you’re claiming you do. The opportunity was given. I didn’t want you to work on my wife’s teeth again but she was nice enough to let you fix something that shouldn’t have been an issue to begin with. It wasted our time and money allowing that for subpar work. She still was in discomfort after the fact. And some time later on at a different dentist office, she was told she still had excess cement left in her teeth that y’all had left.

I explicitly remember what the woman at the front desk told me. She said to leave a five star review - keywords “5 star” - and you can get this whitening pen. Which I did do at the time. Wanting to still believe in this place I’d been coming to for so long and had told my wife who’s scared of the dentist to trust. The dental hygienists who would clean our teeth were lovely. The rest of this team I’m truly not sure about. Dr. Patel running it and the front desk team I would speak to who seemed to not take our concerns that seriously.

Yes, we have not been patients in years now. But I needed to update that 5 star review I had left so people know to maybe consider going somewhere where you’re valued as a patient, not just looked at as dollar signs.

——

Parkfield used to be good when Dr. T was there. After he left, completely downhill. They did a terrible job on my wife’s teeth that left her in pain for weeks after. I don’t feel like accountability is their strong suit. And I feel like they’re all about money now. Also let me not forget that they offered a tooth whitening pen in exchange for a 5 star review. You can ask for reviews from your customers but you can’t give something for a 5 star review specifically. Shady. Decided to never go back and never have.

*also, Invisalign is pushed pretty hard as well. Just something to take note of. It was recommended to me for the first time in my life here and it was just another thing making me feel weird.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have gone to this place for a few years, in the past they honored my needs, not this time. I have other dental needs that I don't wish to schedule currently. All I needed was preventative dental cleaning but the Dr. would not do this since I did not schedule for the additional work and he insisted that I have an xray. I have medical reasons why xrays every 6 months is not what I need. I am not at all happy as a result. You can see below the reply from the office. They say they only require xrays every year but i had them 6 months ago and they required me to have them again.

Here is there responce to my post:

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We take all patient experiences seriously and want to address your concern. Our practice requires updated x-rays every 12 months NOT every 6 months as you stated. This is a standard of care that we do not take lightly, given we have no idea what is happening under the surface of your teeth and gums without x-rays. That is like going to your medical doctor and asking for a check-up but then rejecting blood work. Without that data, we cannot do our job to the standard that is required of us. We wish you a lifetime of dental health and hope you find a dental office that accommodates your desires.

title: Galaxia Dental
address: 8764 Research Blvd suite d, Austin, TX 78758, United States

user_reviews.Name: Suleyma Aguirre
user_reviews.Description: I recently brought my 4 year old on the spectrum for her dental cleaning and first X-rays. I did mention on the phone that she had sensory issues and that I needed to be with her at all times because I wasn’t sure how she would react. They honestly were amazing with her. The lady who did her X-rays took her time in showing her everything she was going to be using and letting her feel comfortable ahead of time. This is so wonderful because she thrives with visuals and it went smooth. Same with the cleaning, I don’t think she would have been able to do it if it wasn’t for the extra help and understanding she was receiving from all of the team. Thank you all so much, this means so much to me.

user_reviews.Name: Araceli Gonzalez
user_reviews.Description: Great customer service! New to the clinic and my kids love it. We have had bad experiences with many other Dentist office which has caused anxiety on my oldest son. I really appreciate the patience and how they all work together so my kids feel comfortable. Very professional and easy to make appointments. The clinic itself is very nice, the games and the movies they have in waiting area are awesome. Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: Red Bulls
user_reviews.Description: Very professional and informative about dental treatment done and needing to be done.  I am a very busy mom and they always do any dental treatment same day. Nice clean environment. There aren't kiddos screaming making it scary for other children. Very happy with the services provided and my three children have been coming here for over 5yrs. Thanks team for always taking good care of my children's teeth and following up for the cleanings.

user_reviews.Name: Dioscelina Benitez
user_reviews.Description: The place is very clean very organized 👌 I love coming here bc the staff is always so nice and willing to help and answer any questions I have.

user_reviews.Name: Ruby Borrego
user_reviews.Description: “I want to come back” those were the words my son told me after his 1st visit! This meant so much as he has severe dental anxiety!! I am so glad to have found this place! They are the first ones to actually get my son to take his pictures and have him sit on the chair! So much progress!!

user_reviews.Name: Evelyn Vasquez-Olivares
user_reviews.Description:
Definitely recommend Galaxia dental ! Customer service always great :) Staff are always nice & respectful.I love bringing my kids here always do good work .
Thank you guys !

user_reviews.Name: Ashely Herrera
user_reviews.Description: My son and my self have been coming here for the past 3 years. The faculty looks very nice and in the beginning it was amazing. However for the past 2 and a half years. The staff changes every two months, and it seems like the new people hired don’t know what they’re doing. They schedule appointments wrong, no one ever knows what’s going on. They say one thing on the phone and then something different the next time you talk to them. Honestly, just chaos when you call to schedule an appointment somehow the appointment time/date changes after. Or they never scheduled your appointment. Don’t recommend coming here anymore. Definitely needs some proper employees with training.

user_reviews_extended.Name: isaiah sertuche
user_reviews_extended.Description: My Girlfriend & I came here 09/2/22 & I was told false information by a nurse at the front desk. I had asked her to ask the doctor & my girlfriend If I could go back there & she came back to tell me that “she said she’s fine & will let me know if she wants you back there” which seemed weird but okay… when my girlfriend comes out post surgery she tells me that the nurse only asked if she was okay, & hadn’t said a word to the doctor. So then I called the nurse out & asked what she really said when she owned up & told the truth that she just went back there and asked if she was okay & came back to tell me this. This seems like a BIG violation & we will be pursing this further.

He didn’t have any issues when we had the other side done. He’s now afraid of the dentist when he used to look forward to going. I’m heartbroken and feel scarred from our experience. So much so that it haunts me so many months after the fact. Please work on making the children more comfortable instead of restraining them, he constantly expresses to me how painful his experience was and that breaks my heart because I was not there for him, I was in the lobby letting them hurt him. Listen to them if they say they’re in pain instead of holding them down. These are our children, just because you don’t let us back there doesn’t mean our children won’t tell us what went on. I feel like they relied on me not asking to check and just did what they could to hurry it up. I now have a long term problem when I wish I had just taken him to our current place where they did his other side, our current place let’s us go back there and see that our children are comfortable during the procedure.
