user_reviews_extended.Description:
The doctor was great and I wish I could keep going here but the office staff makes it impossible. They should make a new slogan for the business. Galaxia Dental: obstructing YOU from receiving dental care!

First they told me I am not covered by my insurance because I'm over 26. This isn't old dental insurance I got from my parents, I'm a married woman in my 30s. They said they would look into it and call me back. Of course nobody calls me back. The next day at my appointment they claimed I should've been called back and been told I don't have dental insurance because I'm over 19. So now the age limit has changed? They insisted that I'm not covered at all due to my age, but then said the checkup and xrays were covered. But they just said I had no coverage?

The staff member that did my xrays did it wrong the first time so she had to do it again. So I got a double dose of radiation for my head.

The doctor was great, very explanative and answered my questions.

Afterward I contacted the insurace company myself and verified that my coverage is not age restricted, and they are in network. I cannot stress this enough: I do not have age restricted dental coverage.

Since I need to find another dentist as the office staff can't manage to figure out my insurance, I requested my xrays be transferred to another dentist. I was told they don't handle any of that, their corporate office in Dallas does, and to contact them by email with a release form. The staff I contacted by email said they'd inform the corporate office but they "take awhile" to send xrays and I apparently cannot contact them directly. It took almost 3 weeks and repeated emails to get my xrays sent to another dentist.

This has been such a frustrating experience with a staff that are too confused or cut off from different departments to be effective.

user_reviews.Name: Spencer
user_reviews.Description:
I can’t recommend Great Grins Dental enough! I’ve always had an amazing experience here and the entire team consistently takes such great care of me. Everyone is incredibly kind, professional, and makes every visit comfortable from start to finish.

I just had my teeth cleaned and bleached yesterday ahead of my wedding this Friday, and they did an incredible job. They made sure everything looked perfect and went above and beyond to help me feel confident for the big day.

If you’re looking for a dentist who genuinely cares about their patients and provides top-tier service every time, this is the place to go. So grateful for this team and the way they always take care of their patients!

user_reviews.Name: Kimberly
user_reviews.Description:
Great Grins is hands down the best dental practice around.  Meg is does a fantastic job of scheduling and managing the office. All of the dental team are top notch and Dr Fossum is incredible. They are all united in providing the best experience possible by being talented, kind and committed to doing the right thing.  Could not recommend more highly.  I will never go anywhere else.  Tell your friends.
And as a bonus they are quick to get you in for appointments.  So nice.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Fossum is a wonderful dentist. I wish there were some way to give him a sixth star!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Ellis
user_reviews_extended.Description: They definitely live up to their 5 star rating! I had a dentist phobia and avoided the dentist for 20 years. Now I can go without [as much] anxiety meds. I got lucky with only 4 cavities and some tarter buildup. Fancy vibrating tarter removal for teeth cleaning, cool teeth scanner for dental guards, cozy private nooks for services. Tinted glasses and fuzzy blanket given to me for comfort during the fillings. Meg at the front desk is the perfect person to greet you and make you feel at ease. The staff is very very kind and very considerate. And they truly did make it a pain free experience. I recommended them to all my friends and coworkers! I'm so excited to have conquered my phobia, thank you! 🙏🏻

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Rostron
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited Great Grins Dental for a routine cleaning, and I am thoroughly impressed with the level of service provided. The dentist demonstrated a keen attention to detail and took the time to discuss my dental health and answer all my questions. Overall, it was a positive experience, and I highly recommend this clinic for anyone seeking excellent dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Grins is a truly wonderful dental practice. I've recommended it a number of times, because they are simply the best. user_reviews_extended.Name: Munazza Khan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is very humble, welcoming and caring, but I would not recommend this place to those you are looking for a good hygienist. I decided to come here because of the reviews but I was so disappointed. My hygienist will insert the scaling tool between my teeth and take it out without scaling off anything. When the hygienist finished cleaning and was flossing, the floss was hardly getting through between the teeth, so she started scaling again for 15 seconds and that was it. I am extremely disappointed and will not go there again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Myira K (ChiChi)
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist I have ever gone to! And I've had major teeth problems since I was little. Dr.Fossum is extremely knowledgeable and makes sure you are comfortable during any procedure. Taylor is a fantastic caring dentist assistant and they both work together fantastically as a team. Meg is the bright sunshine with the biggest/brightest smile that greets you with positivity and is always there to make sure everything is set up and taken care with your needs in mind. And the whole place is so clean and decorated to feel comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vicki Dennington
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is seriously the best dental office I have been to. I was greeted with a lovely reception from Meg at the front desk and was given the choice of filling out forms on paper or and IPad. She then explained which areas of the firm were needed snd which were not necessary. I then waited about 2 minutes for my forms to be reviewed and was call back by the hygienist, Mitha. She did all the work herself. The x-rays were painless as they use a much softer film, the x-ray camera was hand held and no going back and forth to check on the results of each picture. She then used a “mouth” camera to take very close up pictures of my teeth and gums which were displayed on a monitor beside me. She then began the cleaning using an ultrasonic device first and then the tooth scaling instrument. As she worked, she explained everything before she did it. She was very informative and told me as she went along if she was seeing - or not seeing- any thing to be concerned about. Then she polished my teeth. The whole process was painless. Then, Dr Fossum was called in to check on my teeth and gave the green light.   I was set up for another appointment in 6 months as I waited in the dental chair. I was given a cute little clear purse with toothpaste, toothbrush and gloss, paid my bill ( they have a special for new patients) and left with a great grin.!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barbara Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Even though Great Grins is out of my network I really enjoy going; they are less than 10 minutes away from my home, so yay!  Meg at the front desk, she’s friendly a down to earth super person. The Hygienist (can’t remember her name sorry) was awesome! She did not poke at my teeth much and told me my gums looked good so I’m happy with that! And not to mention Dr Fossum, he is kind and friendly. He reassured me everything looked fine and if any concerns were to arise just to call. I recommend Great Grins!!🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Vorauer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience!  Meg has made everything so easy!  They take my insurance and really process it right then and you only have to pay what is not covered!  And their rates are so reasonable, I usually don’t owe anything after dental insurance.  This is rare especially here in Austin.  There are too many other dentists that charge you a high rate, and say, they will “send it off” to the insurance.  Then you end up paying 220 and getting back like 68 bucks from insurance.  Meg and Brett are great, they provide a great service at a reasonable price, which is important these days when you have a family of 5!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alison Richard
user_reviews_extended.Description: So quick background. I have never had a good experience at a dentist. I’ve had okay experiences but my teeth have a history of being high maintenance and most dentist and dental assistants have been dismissive and preachy. I developed dental anxiety and have been avoiding the dentist for years. I finally told myself that I needed to overcome it because I need to take care of my teeth regardless of the attitudes of the people in a dental office. From the moment I walked in, I was warmly welcomed and guided through the check-in process. Morgan was such a champ and really did the best job to clean my teeth. It was the best cleaning I’ve had in my life. Christina was amazing, very informative and helpful in laying out treatment options with attention to my concerns. At the end of the visit, I left with some recommended goodies. Even though my teeth situation isn’t the best right now, I left feeling confident that I am in good hands and can restore my teeth to their former glory. I never thought I’d say this, but I can’t wait to go back. Totally recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Blake
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this office!!  Our family was previously split between three different dentists for various reasons so was super happy to find a single practice that suited all of us.  Dr. Shaw is always thorough and informative and she takes great care of our mouths! The entire staff is friendly and professional yet comfortably laid-back!  It's actually enjoyable going to the dentist.  I highly recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Simpkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Fossum and his staff are exceptional. We have had nothing short of the best care. They make you feel at ease during dental visits and keep you well informed a long the way. If I could give more stars I would.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Felicia Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a situation with a crown that came out and the roots were still in there.  I was referred to Dr Trent for an extraction.

Meantime Dr. Fossum put me on a antibiotic so I wouldn't get an infection where my tooth was.

I have decided to take them as my primary dentist.

When I walked in their office I just felt so much positive energy and a calmness and peacefulness.

The staff is so compassionate and caring.

Thank you Dr. Fossum and staff !

You are the best  🥰❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniyar
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my first review but I just had to share my amazing experience. They have transparent upfront pricing and great knowledgeable staff. Meg, Taylor, Mischa, and Dr. Fossum are all super friendly and professional. Whether you need to get your cleaning done or to do your fillings, they will guide you and answer any questions you may have.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen Wang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shaw and all her staff are wonderful!  Morgan is a talented hygienist, and very gentle and thorough with my biannual cleanings and x-rays.  Elaine is always very sweet and helpful as well; last week I had to reschedule last minute, and she found me another slot right away.  I have also had a positive experience getting Invisalign done here, and they have cutting-edge scanning imagery technology, which is neat and much more comfortable than tray molds.  Dr. Shaw and her staff always do a great job explaining everything and taking the time to answer my questions.  100% recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anita Dodia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Fossum and his staff are absolutely amazing!! Always smiling and welcoming and happy to see you there. The team is always prompt and on time for the appointment. They have also been able to fit me in when I had an emergency. And didn’t feel like they were doing me a favor by doing so but truly wanted to help me. Amazing service and not pushy on products and/or procedures. Dr Fossum will explain everything really well and also his reasons for treatment plans and makes sure that you understand and agree with it too.
Keep doing the great work!! Makes it easy for us to continue with our routine care visits which many of us dread :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Araya Young
user_reviews_extended.Description: i absolutely love this place and the staff!!! from meg at the counter to my dental tech misha (i hope i spelled that right!!) everyone is so friendly. i have a very unnecessary fear of the dentist (and doctor, and eye doctor.. really anything regarding my health lol) but they always make me feel so safe when im in. i would absolutely recommend this office to anyone who is able to go!!!!!! thank you all so much for everything you do:)!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Robbins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Picking a new dentist is a daunting task. After I chose Great Grins, I worked with Meg. She has been fantastic to work with and made this transition super easy.

Misha did an excellent job cleaning my teeth and answering my questions.

Dr. Fossil exam was effective and efficient. He answered all my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Calvin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just an amazing experience for a routine cleaning! New in the area and was looking for a dentist to go in the Austin area. Everyone I interacted with in the office was super nice and really a breeze to setup an appointment + insurance check. Felt really comfortable in the office getting the cleaning. Will definitely go back for my dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Rico
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here is wonderful! From start to finish. Gentle hands, understanding, and efficient. As someone who's traumatized from childhood dentist visits its important to find the right dental office. This one does not disappoint.

user_reviews_extended.Name: maria garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to Great Grins Dental for a few years and highly recommend it.  Dr.  Christina Shaw is an excellent and very caring dentist. I like that she always takes the time to thoroughly explain every finding and treatment options with knowledge and clarity - Dr. Shaw listens and is never in a rush.
The staff at Great Grins is absolutely great!  They know how to create a very welcoming and soothing environment -  this is the best experience I've had with a dental practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: George Hansen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent dental care.  This was my second visit and I was very impressed by the profesional staff, friendly atmosphere and prompt service. I'm glad I chose Great Grins Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Crystal Pablo
user_reviews_extended.Description: My 5 year old had a wonderful appointment at Great Grins! From Meg at the front, seeing the hygienist Morgan. and to meeting the dentist; our experience was truly great!! (my daughter is already asking to go back) Thanks Great Grins to your amazing, welcoming & lovely team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carly Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been at this practice since Dr. Shaw took over several years ago. Although skeptical at first as I had been very happy with the previous owner, she truly is a fine dentist. All of the staff at the office are very accommodating and make you feel at ease. I will never go back to a large dental office and the patient mill experience - we need to keep the solo practitioners around for this level of extraordinary service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Daub
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Grins Dental is #1 in our book! Dr. Fossum and the entire staff are great! Come and check it out, you'll never go any place else for your dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Razieh Araghi
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dentist I have ever met in my life. I had a very traumatic experience before with my wisdom tooth so I used to be always very scared of dentists. But Dr. Fossum is such an incredible dentist that helped me forget about all my past bad dental experiences. The staff is amazing too, so friendly and so kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dale Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Grins Dental is very attentive and caring.  I highly recommend them.  I drive about an hour to be able to see them.  If you are in need of dental work, give them a try!  You will be glad you did!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Howell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Great Grins!! My family of 3 have all been a patients there for almost a decade. There have been some new dentists come and go in recent years but they have all been great. Elaine in the front office and Morgan the hygienist have been there since I started going there and are just the best!! I haven’t had any major work done so can’t review those services but for my biannual cleaning in check up I could not be happier!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Carver
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in for a cleaning   Morgan did an excellent job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenni C-W
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Shaw and her team are wonderful. They were all very kind and friendly and made me feel welcome and cared for. They have always responded quickly if I needed anything or had any questions. I definitely recommend Great Grins!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Satyajeet Dodia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The whole team is very friendly and professional. Always greeted with a
warm welcome and treated in a considerate manner. The hygienist takes time to thoroughly complete the cleaning and inspection. The doctor makes sure you understand the situation clearly and are comfortable with the treatment plan. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DPM
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Grins Dental is my favorite dentist ever. They are so graciously helpful to me navigating some complicated dental issues and have an awesome friendly staff, they're super gentle, very kind, and highly appreciated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Scudellari
user_reviews_extended.Description: A place that actually cares about their patients and will work with them to get them the best care possible!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margarita Rangel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am real happy with Dr Fossom and his staff. I will go with him anytime that I need his service. Dr  Fossom is very nice and understanding.He makes a patient feel safe and explains the procedure step by step. Taylor his assistant is so nice and explains all the  services step by step. No Pain!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessy Human
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shaw and her associates truly made me feel like family. I have not been to a dentist in many years and i had a emergency tooth extraction that required much more finesse then i originally thought. I was able to get in and get it taken care of the same day, truly amazing. They continued to check in on me and worked with me regarding my employment considering i spend all day on the phone at work. I would HIGHLY recommend Dr. Shaw and the entire staff at great grins dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelle Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Finally found my forever dentist!
I had the best cleaning I’ve had in years with Morgan, she is an amazing dental hygienist who takes pride in her work. Also, I was impressed with Dr. Fossum’s thorough exam following my cleaning. He is awesome! Elaine and Meg are super sweet and do an amazing job managing the office and scheduling. Oh and they are doing a great job taking all precautions with COVID. Needless to say, if you’re looking for a dental family, I highly recommend Great Grins Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Stensland
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the friendliness of the staff, their attention to safety during the pandemic, and the ease of scheduling my appointment. I’ve been a patient of Dr. Fossum since he arrived in Austin. He and his team helped my teeth recover from several years of smoking damage, and they’ve been very encouraging in my progress toward better dental hygiene. Great Grins is a nice, intimate office setting and easy to access off 183.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yuri Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Great Grins is consistently caring and attentive. They make sure patients feel comfortable during treatment and are committed to providing high quality service and patient satisfaction. I enthusiastically recommend Great Grin! YM.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arturo Cordova
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Fossum and staff are phenomenal. They're always considerate of my time and invested in my dental health.  The office is comfortable and the environment is soothing. I've been a patient here for many years. I also was a dental assistant for a long time, so I'm familiar with dentistry.
The care I receive is conscientious and appropriate. Morgan, the hygienist, is without a doubt one of the best I've ever known. She is always thorough and gives sincere and thoughtful feedback. Elaine has always been been stellar at her job and makes scheduling, insurance, etc, as easy as possible for patients.
Overall and without hesitation, I recommend them to family and friends.
Great job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aleah Blada
user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved from out of state and hadn’t established a local dentist, they saw me on short notice when I noticed some sensitivity and realized I was a bit over my 6-mos cleaning. The initial cleaning was great, Dr. Shaw reviewed my situation and options; they promptly scheduled me for necessary fillings and were available to adjust my fillings a week later when the bite wasn’t quite right. Friendly staff all around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roberto Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Fossum and his entire staff are professional, friendly and efficient.  I was well cared for and the diagnosis was accurate. They will work very hard to make your entire experience at Great Grins Dental a very pleasant one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Albert Dennington
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t generally have dental issues but I had a sore gun that would not go away. Between scheduled appointments Great Grins got me in the office on a timely basis and addressed the issue quickly and professionally. I felt like a patient and not another revenue generating book of business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ginger Salinas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always loving my dentist visits at GREAT Grins! The staff is friendly and professional that make you feel so welcomed. I get the best service and details on all recommendations. I know I’m in great hands as they always go above and beyond to keep their clients safe & informed. Highly recommend this family of wonderful professionals!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas OBrien
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great people who provide a great service and care at a great price!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ntizon tizon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Had a broken tooth and they took me in immediately as a new patient. I was very nervous and they were very kind and eased my nerves. Talked through everything. No pain during or after. Felt they really cared. One of the best experiences I’ve had at a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Talabay
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is an excellent place to have your teeth cleaned, maintained, fixed up, etc. Super friendly, their tech is impressive, the staff and doc are crazy good (knowledgeable and also actual human beings), it's exceptionally clean and they are accommodating in a variety of ways. While I won't give you my hygienist's name because I'm selfish, when you call and speak to Meg you'll instantly be very, very happy.

The doc can literally answer all my odd ball questions about what he's doing. My last cleaning, I asked what he was doing after he did his exam. He taps and sorta pings the teeth with those weird tools fairly quickly, but explained he's feeling for density and mobility and a couple other things. Unassumingly, he's got the skills and wisdom to be speedy, effective and has good bedside manner.

definitely go here! 🦷💚💙💖

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Carpenter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr. Fossum!  So glad he has purchased this practice.  Highly confident that any recommendations of treatment are necessary.  He has a great personality and takes time to get to know you and your family.  We've been so happy at this practice for over 20 years. They always find the most qualified professional to take over the patients.  So glad their long time receptionist, Elaine is still with them.  Would recommend them to everyone I know.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Molina
user_reviews_extended.Description: My boyfriend had some trauma with a previous dentist and hadn’t been to the dentist in a while. We saw the reviews for this office and I scheduled him a consultation to get to know the office prior to any services. He was blown away with the empathy and understanding of the office and is now ready to start his smile journey !! I was really glad with all the help we received scheduling this type of an appointment.I recently Changed Dentist and I am now going here as well excellent customer service was provided throughout the visit. The doctor and hygienist were very knowledgeable and comforting all Around great service and we would definitely recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krislena Weston
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and Dr. Shaw were wonderful! They were efficient but very nice and sweet being concerned about my comfort both physically and emotionally. For such an unpleasant reason to go to the dentist, they made it a pleasant experience. I would recommend them to anyone and everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Hamilton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great experience at Great Grins Dental! I hate feeling judged and lectured when I go to the dentist and this was the opposite. First, Meg and Andie at the front desk were so kind and helpful. Meg was super transparent with pricing, walking me through what my dental plan did and didn’t cover, which I’ve never experienced before. My hygenist Mischa was so knowledgeable and professional. What I thought was a cavity was a gum recession and she gave me some great tips on how to mitigate future recession in that area. She gave me the best cleaning I’ve had in YEARS, my teeth feel squeaky clean. She took the time to show me my x-rays and answered all my questions. Dr. Fossum was so nice and patient, taking the time to really listen to my concerns. I highly recommend Dr. Fossum and his incredible team to anyone looking for a judgement free, family feel dentist. I can’t believe I’m writing this, but I’m actually looking forward to my next cleaning! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Malek
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Great Grins!  I've been going there for a good 17 years now.  They are friendly, accommodating and gentile with your teeth (I have sensitive teeth).  I always refer my friends and family to Great Grins.  They even remember the conversations we had from my last visit which always impresses me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly DuVall
user_reviews_extended.Description: All of the staff was very nice and super thorough. Shout out to Taylor, my birthday twin! She was fantastic, awesome attitude. They all wore two layers of masks and switched out their gloves frequently. They were all really awesome to work with and I’m happy to finally have a regular dentist again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fahem Hamiche
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t usually write a review online. However, I personally asked the clinic to send me a link to leave a review and Dr Fossum and his stuff deserve more than a 5 stars review. First of all, Dr. Fossum is the best dentist in the world! Because I had received a treatment overseas, mostly in North Africa and Europe. Compared to DR. Fossum, the work he accomplished was successful and perfect. I have no regret of being his patient for more than one year. He is a very human being, he cares and listens to you, his focus is more to work than anything, his soft touch will heal you and he is very knowledgeable. Top of these, they made two huge discount without asking. The whole clinic is clean. You will get a warm welcome at the front door from Meg ! She is doing a fantastic job. A talented Taylor will kill you with her jokes and caring on you. Taylor works closely with DR. Fossum. I feel trusted and comfortable when they work together on you. Big thanks to Taylor!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ken Carver
user_reviews_extended.Description: I transferred to Great Grins after another dentist totally messed up a molar.  After two root canals and two crowns it still wasn't fixed.  Great Grins took the time to actually figure out what was wrong (the crown was too high) and fixed it (simply grinding it down was all that was needed).  I like the conservative approach they take to dental care, the office is super clean and convenient for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Goldin
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is wonderful. From the front desk to the dental assistant to the Dr. you feel cared for. Not only did they squeeze me in same day due to a dental emergency. The Dr. also answered the emergency line at 6:58 am... AND... They also honored a promotional price for me that I found that had been expired a year. They absolutely had no obligation to do that, but they did. Honest, Good people. I really feel like they care and they are kind to me which matters the most. I actually got dental insurance specifically so I could use their practice and I haven't gone to the dentist or had dental insurance in 5 years....  they make me happy lol

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia Hebert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I generally don’t like going to the dentist. I’ve been coming here for a while and I never dread it! Everyone that works here is so kind and genuine and does a great job. My cleaning and exam took 30 minutes with no wait time. I couldn’t recommend them more!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Merry Inglet
user_reviews_extended.Description: Greeted very warmly. After all this Covid 19 it was great to get in and see the dentist. My first time with Great Grins but really impressed. So friendly and so helpful. Each one explaining what they’re doing and then letting you know what they recommend needs to be done. I highly recommend Great Grins Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Kulpe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have needed a lot of dental work in 2024. The staff at Great Grins has been excellent in resolving my issues and providing prompt treatment due to pain levels. I recommend their dentistry services. And I have fun when I go there!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooks Glenn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Fossum and staff were kind enough to help me out in an "emergency" (emergency to me, anyway) over a holiday. Everyone was so nice and patient with me and my dental anxiety, making me feel comfortable and well cared for. Office is well equipped and attractive and well located. Would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wes Ogilvie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dental visits have never been a nightmare for me.  Likewise, they've never been something I've looked forward to.

I decided to change from my assembly line dental operation to Great Grins and Dr. Fossum after they took great care of a dental emergency for my mother.  When I sent an email to schedule, Meg called me back within moments -- and with an appointment about a week out as opposed to so many offices that are "scheduling for X number of months out."

When I came into the office today with the minimal paperwork they required, Meg greeted me and promised to scan in the forms quickly.  Before I even had a chance to get comfortable in the waiting room, Morgan (the hygienist) brought me back to get an exam and cleaning.  Morgan was beyond gracious and patient with X-rays considering my extreme gag reflex.  Furthermore, she gave a great and especially gentle exam and cleaning.  Dr. Fossum came by and gave me a thorough exam and clean bill of dental health, including screening me for oral cancer.

For the first time I can remember, I never felt pressured, upsold, or lectured about my teeth. That alone would make me come back, but the gentle and compassionate care I received today truly felt like a dental home.  (Hokey, I know, but it honestly describes how I felt.)

I'm looking forward to Meg's email and text reminding me to schedule for the next six month cleaning and exam.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Paul
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience with a team that communicates effectively.  Dental work becomes more concerning when you don't know what is happening.  The Great Grins team did a fantastic job keeping me informed throughout the procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jozette Poole
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were great!  They done actually what I wanted them to do and gave me the cheapest options.  I have been looking for a dentist like this for 2 years. I will use them faithfully.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Kwak
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone is so kind and accommodating. I'm someone who gets pretty nervous at the dentist, but the vibe really puts me at ease.
I would recommend this place to anyone. In fact, I even had my husband schedule his next cleaning here. That's just about the highest praise that I can give!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Ngai
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Megan always does a good job on cleaning teeth. My teeth sparkle.
Dr. Fossum is very kind and professional. Very good dentist.
Mrs. Fossum is very nice and helpful. We appreciate her assistance to reschedule appointments when we need it.  I have two chipped teeth recently past Sunday. Meg was so kind to schedule me for Dr. Fossum to fix my teeth in Monday. I appreciate this office so much to take care patient’s needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ed Greenberger
user_reviews_extended.Description: GREAT experience! They got me in immediately when I was having a lot of pain. Dr. Fossum diagnosed the problem in minutes and figured out the best treatment plan. HIGHLY recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shea Bryant
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been with great grins for almost 3 years. Super friendly, very family feel to the office. They see myself, my son, and husband. I have no complaints. They have always been helpful and inviting and it's a pleasure seeing them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was very happy with my Great Grins experience. As someone who doesnt enjoy going to the Dentist, I am excited to return here. The entire staff was friendly and accomodating and  Dr. Fossum offered invaluable wisdom towards providing a solution to my Dental issues. Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Kettler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went in to have a crown re-seated. I am without insurance at the moment but I had heard that this practice had great prices and quality work! I am very happy I knew about this Dr. everything went good and he answered all my questions and spent time going over my concerns.  Wonderful visit!
Tina Kettler

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tommy Belton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved my experience with Great Grins.  I recently moved to North Austin, and was looking for a dental office closer to home.  The staff was extremely nice, welcoming and knowledgable.  They called me by name when I walked in, and made me feel right at home.  I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a new dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Foster
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm an anxious patient but Dr Fossum and his team put me at ease and made my filling replacement very comfortable. I feel at ease here. no pain at all

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah-Marie Curry
user_reviews_extended.Description: My gums suck. The fine people at Great Grins Dental don't judge. They just help me make them better. I don't always floss or wear my mouth guard. They don't judge, they just remind me why it's helpful to my terrible gums and they help me to get better. I have to reschedule, they don't judge! They just work with me. They are kind and they check in with me and they get how weird it is to let a random person into your mouth with a pick. The dentist's office is a weird and scary place. Great Grins is WONDERFUL and I honestly look forward to seeing them. Even though my gums suck. I know they will be kind and help me to help myself and to help them. I LOVE THEM.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Humphries
user_reviews_extended.Description: Entire staff, not just the dentist, seems to love what they do and are extremely friendly. Props to the front desk lady for being extra kind and helpful. Dr. Fossum seem to remember who i was and my history, which I really appreciated. They have advance tech, their xray machine is hand held and was twice as fast as other ones. Only con is that it's an open floor plan so you don't have your own room. You can hear the other patient nearby, but wasn't a big deal. There's enough noise to block things.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description: So nice that they run on time and you do not have to wait around! Great thorough cleanings and soooo nice. Makes going to the dentist not so bad :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Burke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was super nice, my teeth felt great after :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: patrick Vuong
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental experience. It's so hard finding the right dentist much less one that is local! The ambiance of the practice made me feel so welcome. Staff was amazon and really answered every question I had throughout the appointment. The doctor had great bedside manner and really had me at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pat Guerra
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Fossum and his staff are awesome!!! They're very knowledgeable, friendly, and reasonably priced. They really get to know their patients and their dental needs. I highly recommend Great Grins Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jack Witt
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit, and I was very pleased.  Very friendly care team, in-depth dental exam explained carefully, a real feeling of focus on my well-being.  Looking forward to an ongoing relationship.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Shane
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great people! I came in for a second opinion because my first dentist didn't inform me of any reasoning behind their diagnosis and Dr. Fossum and co. were very helpful and clear on what they were seeing and what they thought about it and why. A great experience in comparison, I'm glad I found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Holliday
user_reviews_extended.Description: Meg is always friendly and everyone is very professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reynaldo Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It's hard to imagine having a better dental experience than what I had at Great Grins with Dr. Fossum, Elaine, Morgan, Taylor, and Meg. It had been a few years since I'd been to the dentist, and I had previously seen the same one my whole life, so of course I was nervous.

My nerves progressively melted away with every interaction I had with each of these great folks. High spirits all around, and Meg's playlist kept me grooving the entire visit.

My smile feels and looks great, and I actually find myself looking forward to my next visit. I definitely did not expect that!

If you've been putting off a dental exam out of fear or guilt,  I encourage you to take the first step by reaching out to Great Grins. Glad I did!

user_reviews_extended.Name: d frick
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My visit was great! Love all the people at Great Grins - Dr. Fossum, Elaine, Morgan and Taylor are the best. Thanks for being such a wonderful team!
Can't wait to see all them again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Rios
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I’ve ever been to! Meg, Elaine, Dr fossum, Taylor, they are all AMAZING! Taylor and Dr.Fossum are so gentle with whatever they are doing. 0 pain, and they explain everything. I moved away, but do not mind making the drive because they are worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole staff was very friendly and helpful.  Each step of the way they were concerned about my comfort.  Everything they did was explained before they did it. The required treatment plan was explained with supporting review of the Xrays and pictures. While a visit to the dentist is low on everyone's bucket list, this visit was very pleasurable and as pain free as possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lawrence Hartley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr. Shaw and all of her staff.  They go out of their way to make you feel like their most important client instead of like cattle - which I found to be common with the larger chain dentistry offices.  Great people giving outstanding service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: KRAIG HEINZEL

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rafique Sheikh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a good first visit.  The receptionist was very nice, she made me feel welcomed and comfortable by offering water.  After I filled out the forms I did not have to wait long to get my X-Rays done.  After a few takes though the X-Ray machine ran out of battery and had to be recharged which I thought was a bit odd but the tech recovered pretty well by doing exam and other work.

I was told about gum disease and bone loss and how my history of deep cleaning meant i might have to see the dentist every 3 months rather than 6.  She also suggested getting perio maintenance done at the first appt. but once I asked how much it would cost she said she would let me know.  Later on she said she will just do a regular cleaning which was covered by insurance and I was happy about that.

After the cleaning I got to see the dentist who was quite nice and sweet.  She asked me if I had any complaints or issues with my teeth.  She repeated what the hygienist had told me and recommended invisalign to straighten my teeth so I wouldn’t chip some of them away.  I mentioned to her that I don’t want to take out my wisdom teeth as they weren’t bothering me and I believe in “if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it”.  She talked about my history and assured me that I had good overall dental health and sent me on my way.

The receptionist was again very nice, gave me estimates on recommended services and sent me on my way.  An overall great first visit.  No upselling no questionable services, I left feeling satisfied.

user_reviews_extended.Description: We loved Dr. Imperial for always doing a great job and his professional but caring bedside manner. He chose a great successor in Dr. Shaw as she shares those same important qualities. I appreciate that her staff are friendly and helpful.
