user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabella Mann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Couldn’t recommend this place more! Holly, the hygienist, was awesome. Very thorough. The office was clean. The ladies at the front were so kind and helpful. Dr. Miriam was awesome too! Squeezed me in same day to get a filling.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Baber
user_reviews_extended.Description: New patient here. I was apprehensive about my visit due to my difficult dental history, but this office left a 10/10 first impression. The front desk staff were welcoming. Dr. Guirguis and Genai are professional, friendly and have a great sense of humor. For the first time ever, I’m looking forward to my next dental appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carlos Cantu
user_reviews_extended.Description: They saw me right away with waiting long. The staff and doctor were informative, nice, and professional. I would highly recommend someone to them if they are looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Cohorn
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist and staff are all very friendly and efficient. Dr. G repaired my broken filling(from another dentist) in just a few minutes with no discomfort and had me on my way back to work in no time. They seem to genuinely prioritize what’s best for the patient, I don’t think you’d ever have to worry about whether a procedure is actually necessary at this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Terra
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Saved me from $700 worth of fillings and drillings I didnt need, the BEST dentist Ive ever had.

I went to Swish Dental previously was told I had 6 surfaces ($700) worth of fillings on my back molars. This was very strange to me as I have NEVER had a history of cavities and haven't changed my dental routine. Never go to a franchised dentistry.

I got a second opinion at Horizon and she told me it was just calcium build up and that there was nothing of concern. The Dr was very nice and she answered my questions in detail, she knows her STUFF.

I CANNOT RECOMMEND THIS PRACTICE ENOUGH, GO HERE DO NOT RISK ANYWHERE ELSE!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khrystyna Oksina
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Miriam. She is very attentive, caring, and professional. I’ve had a filling, a crown, and an implant done, and I’m completely satisfied with the results and the overall experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: matthew tharp
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Miriam Guirguis is very sweet, gentle, and keeps the mood light. She got me in urgently for a broken crown. She is definitely my new go to dentist for everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jon Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist! They took amazing care of me and made sure my smile turned our perfect, it felt like they took the extra mile wherever they could.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lennye Tapia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I only have positive things to say about my experience today with Dr. Guirguis and her team. From the moment I stepped inside I felt at ease. The ladies up front were so kind and fun to chat with. The AMAZING Dental Assistant truly made my experience a 10/10. She made me feel comfortable and confident I could leave with everything I needed to rebuild a healthy smile. Not only were they open about pricing but they were genuinely kind, honest & knowledgeable about what we could do to correct any problems. I’m so grateful for their patience & kindness! I have a follow-up appointment and can’t wait to return to see this wonderful team. If you have had previous bad experiences with other dental professionals, don’t hesitate to see Dr. Guirguis and her team. They are truly transparent and willing to help you in any way they can. So thankful!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vlad Kalashnik
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a root canal and a crown done with Dr. Miriam Guirguis at Horizon Dental in Austin, and I couldn’t be more satisfied. Due to work, I was in a rush and had to leave town, but Dr. Guirguis and her team went above and beyond to accommodate my schedule. They got everything done quickly and efficiently — from the initial consultation to the final procedure. The crown arrived fast, they found time to fit me in right away, and the whole process was smooth and professional.

The care didn’t stop after the visit — they even called me the next day to check in and make sure I was doing well. I truly felt supported and cared for throughout the entire experience. This is definitely my go-to dentist moving forward. Highly recommend — 100%! Thank you so much for your help and kindness.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Тигран Мхитарян
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really love Horizon dental. Dr Guirguis and her staff are wonderful people and a highly professional team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonia Y. Bracey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very clean, very courteous office staff & helpful. The Dr is awesome & very thoughtful and caring.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow! Amazing experience! The entire team was enthusiastic and made me feel super comfortable when I arrived nervous! In and out! Even set me up with post op info to avoid infection! Huge thank you and Will definitely make them my #1 choice for dentist work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: C Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dentist in Austin. The whole team is professional, caring, and competent. You can tell that Dr. Guirguis cares about her patients and about doing good work. Being able to smile at others without self-consciousness is the best feeling in the world. Having a good dentist makes all the difference.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valeriia Haishenets
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best doctor in Austin! She fixed my problem that I had been suffering with for half a year. Other dentists gave me promises and did nothing. Dr. Miriam made me a new filling in 15 minutes. And she corrected it when I needed it. Thank you very much to Dr. Miriam and her team. You are the best!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Berry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've visited many dentists and undergone extensive dental work, but the care I've received here is unparalleled. Dr. G's meticulous attention to detail and remarkable efficiency truly set her apart! Additionally, her staff is incredibly welcoming and kind, creating a warm, family-like atmosphere. I highly recommend this office to anyone seeking exceptional dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: K.M.
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is so kind and welcoming! This was my first time here and I will be coming back. The doctor and hygienist explained all the procedures and the reason behind the issue as it came up. They are so professional and the service was amazing! Definitely recommend🦷🪥🌟

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Raoof
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don't think I can give this place justice. The staff is some of the friendliest that I have ever dealt with. They are extremely supportive and friendly and treat you like family. I just experience a very traumatic dental emergency and they were able to see me within 10 minutes of me calling and did their best to have me leave the dental office with a tooth while consoling me and helping me deal with what happened. They provided me with many options and went into detail on what each of them entailed. Dr. Miriam is one of the best dentist I have ever dealt with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Wosnig
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Horizon Dental for an emergency chipped resin crown with many negative experiences at other dental offices. The treatment both medically and emotionally was pleasant and thorough. Dr. Guirguis and the assistants were kind and helpful throughout the whole process and talked me through everything, calming what nerves they could. I look forward to my future experiences with this office and recommend anyone in the area consider them for your dental care needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isis Leal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient with Horizon Dental since 2017 and Dr. G and her staff are wonderful! Dr. G is very accessible, answering any questions over the phone whenever I call the office.

I decided to get Invisalign and Dr. G has been patient with my troublesome teeth. She has encouraged me to continue getting more trays to get the perfect smile, versus ending on the scheduled time and not being completely satisfied with the results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lance Milhime
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. G is totally awesome and the best dentist I’ve had in the past 10 years. I’m a huge baby when it comes to any dental work, and she makes me feel completely comfortable during the visit. I also have to commend her on the amazing work she’s done for me with absolutely no pain involved. She’s awesome!

The staff are also completely cool and nice to be around. When I head in with my boyfriend for his appointments, they always offer me water/coffee and we chat about music. Love this place and will always recommend my friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zamora Luis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience I have ever had! I would recommend Horizon Dental to anyone looking for a facility that has an amazing team of dental specialists! Miriam Guirguis went above and beyond to give me an amazing smile! I will forever appreciate it! Thank you Horizon for the amazing experience the care and attention to detail has changed the way I think of dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Payton Tully
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist is something painful, embarrassing and scary for me. But the staff here is incredible in every way. I was blessed to get an appointment same day with severe wisdom teeth and nerve pain. I walked in on the verge of tears in intense pain, but I left with a smile and peace of mind. Never going anywhere else unless I have to. Would give 6 stars if I could.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kay H
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr.Guirguis is the best Dentist I have ever worked with. She has been so patience with me and listened to my concerns I had during my first visit regarding how nervous I was and why. I had such various bad past experiences with other dentists growing up but Dr. Guirguis and her staff has completely changed that for me. I look forward to the visits now and feel immensely grateful to the work she has has done for me. I bring my kids here and they also look forward to visits, which is a huge plus for me. They have amazing communication and explain every procedure with alternate plans if needed.

Thank you so much!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma Halim
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went with Dr. Miriam Guirguis, Very profesional, kind, Caring and Honest which is hard to find this combination these days apart.
Totally recommended if you are looking for a trusted humanitarian dentist who knows what they do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fahad Alshehri
user_reviews_extended.Description:
well I wanted to take a moment to express my gratitude to Dr. Guirguis for the exceptional care you provided during my recent root canal treatment. Your patience in explaining the procedure and exploring various options based on my situation truly set my mind at ease.
Your dedication to going above and beyond is evident, and I cannot recommend you highly enough. Thank you for making a daunting experience much more manageable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Medhat Isaac
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had a fantastic dental experience at Horizon Dental Care/Domain dental with Dr. Miriam I was thoroughly impressed by her professionalism and kindness.

Dr. Dr. Miriam and her staff were welcoming and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. She took the time to address my concerns and explain the procedure in detail, showcasing her expertise and knowledge.

The clinic utilized advanced technology, which further enhanced my confidence in the quality of care provided. Throughout the procedure, Dr. Dr. Miriam displayed a compassionate and reassuring demeanor, ensuring a stress-free experience.

I appreciated Dr. Miriam’s patient-centered approach. She tailored the treatment to my specific needs and provided valuable recommendations for maintaining optimal oral health.

In conclusion, my visit to Horizon Dental Care/Domain dental and the care provided by Dr. Miriam exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend her to anyone in search of a professional and kind dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dave Macaulay
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This honestly has to be the friendliest and most professional dentist I've ever visited, all the staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming. My options were all explained to me in great detail along with the associated costs and potential issues. I'm glad to no longer feel super nervous and anxious when going to the dentist.

I had my first tooth extracted here and it was a much easier process then I originally had anticipated, if you want a friendly dentist go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TJ Egan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best Dentist office I've ever been to! I used to dread coming to the dentist, but the whole staff here is very talented and welcoming. I feel very at ease once I come in, and know that it will be a pleasant experience. Everyone is very happy to see you, and seems to be very happy with what they do. Keep up the awesome work, everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: RADHIKA SINGH
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience here at Horizon Dental care and Dr Miriam and staffs were great and professional.Thank you for the great service 👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arvin Poole
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had one of the best dental experiences as an adult. After switching insurance plans and dentist offices because of the distance, I was exhausted and overwhelmed through selecting a new dentist. I’ve has some bad experiences in the past, but Dr. Miriam Guirguis, Olivia and the rest of the staff were very accommodating with getting me in for some prior work that needed to be done. My cleaning/filling was a breeze and I’ve never anticipated wanted to come back before my next 6 month appointment until now 😊. They were all super nice and I look forward to my follow up.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrey Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always had anxiety about going to the dentist, but this practice just might be curing me of it! My hygienist, Cathy, is so sweet and so reassuring that I no longer need nitrous for my cleanings! And the dentist is terrific! She fixed a chip in the bonding on my front tooth and when it was done, it looked better than it ever had. What a relief to find a place I can trust!

user_reviews_extended.Name: E Macasadia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just had my first appt with Dr G for a normal cleaning and has a great experience!! And to say that about a dentist appt says a lot!! The entire staff was wonderful, kind, knowledgeable and caring. Starting with the staff in the front office - scheduling my appt was easy and they even let me know when an earlier appt became available so I could be seen a couple weeks earlier than my original appt. Then when I arrived to check in, they were kind and friendly and check out they were just as kind, helpful, and explained charges for a filling I needed. The dental hygienist, Kathy, was super informative!! I’ve never had a dental hygienist take the time to explain everything she was doing and what it meant and how a few changes in my home dental plan could improve my teeth! I was incredibly impressed with her knowledge and care throughout the process. My time with Dr G was fantastic too. She took the time to show me my x-rays and walk me through what they showed. She was incredibly knowledge, kind, and even funny! I don’t think I’ve ever had occasion to laugh in a dentist office and I did here! She was so personable and realistic with things that needed to be done or could wait.
Really, I cannot say enough great things about this experience! Thank you, Dr. G and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hitomi T
user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved to Austin and was looking for a dentist that I can trust and this Horizon Dental Care is beyond my expectations! Everybody there is super nice and friendly. Honestly I don’t like dentist but they comforted me very well, they played some music and I felt really relaxed. I recently had my wisdom tooth extracted there, this was my very fist time to extract tooth but Dr. G was great and I could trust her very well. I’m very happy and glad to find a great dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sylvia Samy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr.Guirguis is super professional and honest. I regret going to other dentists before. All the staff there are so friendly and patient.
It’s awesome to have a dentist you trust!!
Highly recommended!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blayre Hinojosa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a “scared of the dentist” kind of person. They put me at ease, were not judgmental, so kind, fast, and easy to schedule with. I might not be a “scared of the dentist” person anymore.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Alberto Rocca Vazquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole staff makes the dentist-going experience feel great. They are very thorough and professional. At the same time, the dentist and assistants are so confident about their expertise that they truly make you feel comfortable while performing a dental procedure. You get the feeling they are happy doing the work they do; they even have fun doing it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Prather
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. G and staff are the only ones I trust for my dental work. Every member of their team is kind, compassionate and approachable. The quality of the dental work performed by Dr. G is phenomenal, and the staff is super well versed in insurance billing which is such a huge help. I recommend her to everyone I know, whether they asked or not.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oscar Decker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very good visit recently at Horizon Dental in north Austin. My appointments are always handled in a timely manner. Dr. Guirguis has a professional, sensitive touch and I have a deep trust in her treatment of my dental needs. I also have to commend the staff supporting the Doctor in the various procedures required to maintain my oral health; their professionalism is always top notch. The front desk personnel keep me well informed regarding appointments and insurance matters via phone and email communications. I live in Canyon Lake, so I travel to Austin because Horizon Dental provides the best dental care I have found in Central Texas.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ronnie Darner
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience at Horizon Dental. Friendly staff and fantastic service. But the best is Dr. Guirguis. She is amazing!  She was able to save my tooth after another dentist said it was not possible.  Not only did she save my tooth and my smile, but she saved me money as well!  I just love her!!
I highly recommend this practice. 5 stars is not enough rating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachael Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing office!! They did my teeth composites and I get compliments all the time. Very flexible and accommodating for any concerns even after your first appointment. Highly recommend!! Thank you guys so much for everything you do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Lawson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for a cleaning after basically 3 years (partly due to pandemic), teeth in pretty bad shape. Kathy, one of the hygienists there, took care of me. I don't usually get emotional (or really write google reviews) but seeing the results of my teeth after she was done almost brought me to tears. Complete 180 degrees, I can smile with confidence again. The doctor and other staff were excellent too. I have my next scheduled cleaning in 6 months, couldn't be happier or more excited for the next one. Highly recommend this dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allan Hillman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
10/10!! AMAZING people, culture, and environment! Miriam the Dentist is absolutely phenomenal, the Dental hygienist Holle is wonderful.

This is the place you need to be if you want top-notch service and professionalism! They tell you truth about your dental health and they don’t sugar coat (pun-intended)!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got a tooth extracted last week. I've had one extracted by them before and it went really well. This time they were just as awesome. Very nice, not a long wait (I literally called that morning and they squeezed me in), and they could tell i was nervous so they suggested nitrous. They told me what all expenses would be before they started. They also ended up filling two cavities. Overall the experience was quick and easy. I hate going to the dentist, but I scheduled a deep clean for next month because they're so nice and I'm assured it will.be as painless as possible. Definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nadine Sewell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to clean my teeth at another dentist who sadly detach a bridge I had. I had to then fine another to have  it fixed. And what a blessing it was to find Horizon. From the moment I entered I felt cared for! Dr G's bedside manner is gentle, kind and reassuring. I felt totally taken care of. Not only was she kind, but is is clear she takes her time to hire her staff! Everyone was great.....I was going away on vacation and had a problem with a filling I had done long before, they where close and can you believe it,  Dr G came back and opened the doors for just me!!!!!! She fixed that tooth and Jamaica was amazing...I wish I could give this practice 100 stars...AMAZING SERVICE!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Dedeaux
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing dental work… I’ve been coming here the last three years since I’ve moved to Austin  Tx .. the staff is 5 star world class service..
The Dr. is 1st rate and understands the care of her patients needs…
I don’t recommend any other doctor office for dental care but Hozion!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Foarde
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have incredible anxiety with dentists, but this place impressed me from start to finish. The receptionist went above and beyond to help set up an appointment, and the dentist herself and her assistant were down-to-earth, efficient, and compassionate. I needed a root canal and in all honesty, yes it was painful at points (especially since I couldn't have good drugs due to pregnancy), but it was actually a good experience. Would definitely recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hoss Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: 10/10, 5 stars², huzzahs all around! I've been terrified of the dentist and hadn't been in several years. Dr. G. And her fantastic staff changed all that. The environment is professional and welcoming, everyone there has top notch communication skills. They listen to you and lay out a clear plan to get your smile looking like you want it to. I can't begin to express enough what a positive experience going there is. I can't imagine going anywhere else, never thought I'd be saying this but I'm excited to go back. Thank you Dr. G and all the people who work there, y'all truly made a huge difference in my life, I'm looking forward to smiling more. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabella GarciaJaeger
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love it here! I’ve been coming here for years and have always been so happy with the service! They’re kind, and Dr G has even honored an original quote of a procedure she had given me over a year prior, even if the price had gone up to about double. Awesome, honest, and kind practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martha Saman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have literally been passing out every time I visit a dentist, and for them to work on my teeth they have to put me under anesthesia.
After 36 years Dr. Miriam Guirguis, did the the miracle, managed my anxiety very well and did the job perfectly. I would 100 stars for the the office staff as well as the Dentist. THANK YOU
* This is not just adult-friendly dentistry, it's kids' best dental work visit (10 years old son perspective)

user_reviews_extended.Name: jayzion23 Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: This practice is by far the best dental practice I’ve experienced in Austin. The doctors all have a lite hand especially needed when getting my root canals and they are always positive and patient with you. They never make you feel like you’re in a rush and they even work with you on payment plans even though I didn’t have a credit card. They are simply amazing! Can’t recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rene Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dentist office in town!!!! Seriously there is no other place I would rather have work on my dental needs, from my first visit everyone there has been amazing, everyone there is happy to help you and I still can't believe that the moment I walk in whoever is at the front desk knows my name even if I don't have an appointment. Thank you so much for making my experience there a fun and happy one every time. I recently had four teeth pulled and still left with a smile, that's something to be proud of, my dentist is the best!!!!!! If you don't believe me, just scheduled an appointment, you'll see for yourself.

user_reviews_extended.Name: K Reese
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had some fillings redone and I could have fallen asleep in the chair. Dr. Guirguis and her team have excellent cair-side manner and are extreamly courteous, professional and caring. Wish I'd found them sooner!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Souza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient for over 2 years. I am extremely happy with all attention and impeccable treatment I have received so far. Hygienist, staff, assistants and specially Dr. Guirguis are friendly, professional and very qualified. Dr. G makes sure to make my appointment pleasant and on time.
If you are looking for a excellent professional and honest dentist, Horizon Dental Care is the right place for you and your family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chuck Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been part of the Horizon Dental Care Austin team for many years.
Dr. G and the staff are "EXTREMELY" nice to be around, make you feel like part of their family and do amazing dental work.

I love the technology used to confirm appointments via text and the way the staff takes personal interest in you as a patient.  I always recommend my family, friends and customers to Horizon dental.

Dr. G and staff will put a SMILE on your face!!!!  :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Pina
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found Horizon Dental on my list of preferred providers on my insurance plan. I was pretty nervous at first because I haven't seen a dentist in a while, and I was having issues with my wisdom teeth. I started having issues on a Friday, I called Horizon Dental (even though they were closed) and left a VM and my call was returned the next day, despite it being the Saturday of the month that they were off. I was so relieved, I was scheduled to come in early that next week. Beverly was so kind and she helped accommodate me with my work schedule. My consultation with X-rays and surgery went so smoothly, I've never encountered such professionalism and care at a dentist in a major city before. Dr. Miriam Guirguis did my wisdom tooth removal surgery, and she was extremely attentive to me and my needs. My boyfriend (bless his soul) stayed to watch/take me home and he was extremely impressed at how well they took care of me. All in all, I've never written an online review in my life but I felt compelled to share my experience because this office and staff is amazing! If you're nervous and need to see a dentist, call them! I live in north Austin now, the office is a convenient 5 minute drive from my apartment. I'm more than likely moving to south Austin in the next couple of months, but I am more than willing to make the drive across Austin to see these guys in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarai Angelle
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Horizon Dental is fantastic, everyone is so kind and friendly and they really try to help you with your dental needs in any way possible. They are always punctual and timely and can service a variety of issues, I was super happy with the partial they made for me and the quick turn around. I was also super happy with the root canal and filling work they did for me as well! Thanks y'all. :) - Sarai Angelle

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly McGrath
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had moved to Austin at the end of 2019, and the Covid situation was delaying my preventative dental care.   The staff at Horizon Dental were very accommodating and quickly fit me in with the dental specialists that I needed.    Their insightful counseling on my teeth care, and the services provided were the best that I have ever received. I can’t say enough both for the dental specialists and front office personnel.   Entering their office felt like family from the very first visit.   If you are considering a change in dental care, I 100% recommend that you look at Horizon Dental Care first!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victor Santana
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been able to say I enjoyed going to the dentist until I went to Horizon Dental. Dr. G and her assistant, Olivia, are the best, they both are very professional and a joy to be around. From the moment I went through the door to when I left, everyone took care of me. I went for an exam, and after exam, they layed out a plan and discussed what were my options, and what were the costs of each one. Highly recommend going to Horizon Dental in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Howard
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I really don't like leaving bad reviews but I feel this is necessary. The front desk is perfect, everyone there is very friendly to be honest. The problem comes with the doctor. I came here because I wanted to make sure my teeth were in perfect shape and if not, I wanted to receive the right treatment.

Everything was fine until Doctor Guirguis Told me I had a broken tooth which needed to be extracted, so I did. It was the worst experience I ever had, I have a jaw problem which does not allow me to open "big" like is needed. I told this to the doctor, by the time she was trying to pull my tooth out she was moving my jaw side to side in a way that I felt my jaw was about to break, I had to stop her several times.

The pain was awful since day one, I went a few days later because I had a dry socket, I was treated by another doctor, and he did not even clean the dry socket in the proper way. Two days later the pain was worst, and I decided to go back, and things started to get worst, she had to cut out the bone graft she previously put on the side, put a medicine and put stitches again. The pain never went away, at this point I was done with this dental clinic. I got my dry socket treated in another clinic, and the told me I would take a long time until is fully healed since they really injured my jaw bone.

I would not recommend this place at all, I am really surprise how they still have this 4.9 star.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Horizon Dental for over 10 years.  They are quick when it comes to routine exams.  That is the main reason I chose them, I am busy with work and I usually like to get it done within my lunch hour and they always have me ready to go with time to spare.  Dr.Guirguis (Dr. G) and all the staff there are very nice and super helpful.  I recently got veneers (for aesthetic reasons) and Dr. G did them for me and did a great job.  The process was explained to me properly-so I knew what to expect and reasonable payment plans are available if needed.  I was also able to call any time I had questions during the process.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Stephen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My Husband and I were referred to Dr G by a friend.
I can not say enough about Dr G and her staff.
I will never go anywhere else after going here.
Friendly, professional, clean, caring.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I never thought I would be giving a dentist visit a five-star rating - I mean, who looks forward to going to the dentists?  Well, that all changed yesterday! I had an exceptional experience at Horizon Dental, Austin office. From the moment I walked in, I felt comfortable. I was immediately greeted with a welcoming smile. I never had to wait long. Holly was my hygienist. She was wonderful. I had the best teeth-cleaning I have ever had. After my teeth cleaning, I met with Dr. Guirguis. She checked my teeth and then sat with me to throughly go over my X-rays and answer all of my questions. I never felt rushed.
I had been putting off going to the dentist ever since Covid-19 hit. I was impressed with the steps the office took to protect the patients as well as everyone working there. The office was very clean and everyone was wearing a mask.  Overall - Excellent experience!!! Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vinnie Guadiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is by far the best dental office I've been to since I moved to Texas. I feel like I'm spoiled with the way everyone in there treats their clients. Everyone is nice and helpful. I especially love the way they remind you of your upcoming appointments - it's not automated and impersonal, like most clinics are these days. They actually take time to contact you and work with you and your schedule.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Souza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am a patient of Dr G for over 6 years. She is kind, skilled and a good listener.
Last week she went above and beyond to accommodate me for an emergency procedure. I am very thankful for her care and attention. Anesthesia part was painless and easy. Honestly I didn’t even notice that I had a shot. Yay

Thank you Dr G and her whole team! Amazing work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: strrosenberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wanted to take a second and make a review for Horizon Dental. I’m not the type of person that usually goes online and write reviews about companies unless I really think that they have gone above and beyond. I just want to say how pleased I am with the way I’ve been treated here. The dentist office is not typically a place that you think of as “a happy place” but I can certainly say that going to Horizon Dental changed my outlook on that. Not only do they do exceptional work, but their staff is extremely helpful, friendly, and attentive. I highly recommend switching over to Horizon dental or at least giving them a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: mahjouba addoume
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I have ever been to. After going here, I won’t be going anywhere else. Dr Mughrabi is the most honest and kind doctor. Him and the staff always greet me by first name and they genuinely care about my well being. I’ve never had an issue going here. Check them out and you won’t be disappointed! Thank you Horizon Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Oshana
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shoutout to Dr. G and Cathy for their care, expertise, and kindness. The team at horizon is so professional and knowledgeable, and you can really tell how much everyone loves working there. All around a great place, and they have affordable care plans for people without dental coverage. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tera Collins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
DO NOT GO HERE IF YOU HAVE A FEAR OF THE DENTIST OR ANY ANXIETY ABOUT PROCEDURES. I was scheduled with Miriam Guirguos for two wisdom teeth extractions. I have always had a lot of anxiety regarding any dental issues stemming from bad childhood experiences. This procedure was very hard to do for me, but I needed it. When she entered the room, I had tears in my eyes from nerves, and she said “ do you even want to do this today?” In a very impatient, blunt way.. I said “I’m here and ready, I’m just nervous”.. to which she responded “you can just leave if you want to”….. that put a sick feeling in my stomach. It’s not an uncommon thing to be nervous about dental procedures, and the way she was talking to me seemed so rude and unsympathetic it was shocking. She then offered to reschedule and add sedation, but I really just needed to get it done then because I had been in pain for quite a while.
Overall I felt like she was rude, unsympathetic and unprofessional.
I would never recommend this place to anyone, especially if they have any anxiety about the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul sauer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I couldn’t be more happy with the customer service and work I had done at Horizon. I was visiting from out of town and managed to crack my temporary bridge. Horizon was booked solid, but managed to squeeze me in. They did such a wonderful job that I’m considering a return trip for the permanent bridge. thanks Verizon for your unmatched customer service!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonas N
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience there. Going to the dentist is completely underrated. It's not as bad as people make it to seem. I mean yeah there may be slight pain, but that's just typical with any bodily procedure. When it comes to teeth, I understand that could be scary, but Dr Gurguis and her assistant Olivia, were very helpful and made it rather entertaining with a little sense of humor. I'm glad I got to do my root canal, filling and cleaning for the first time ever here. Overall, good first time experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Kim
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horizon Dental Care is the best! I've never had to wait long for my appointments, even when arriving early, and have always had nothing but the best experiences with all dentists and staff. For regular teeth cleaning to tooth extractions and everything in between, I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dina Haines
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office was the best. Dr G was very sweet and patient with me. I can not express how happy I am to have met them. Staff are very personable. I can’t wait to go to dentist office now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: R M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Guirguis is amazing and so is her staff! Compassionate and affordable care. They have gotten me in same day for an emergency more than once. Great dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Destiny Olson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm beyond impressed with Horizon Dental! Dr. Mughrabi has an eye for detail! She was able to create a new partial for me that looks and fits better than anything I've had thus far. There was no need for any bite adjustments and the color matching is so natural. My partial was ready within two days and the office was accommodating to work me in as soon as they received it. The office staff is friendly and helpful. I haven't smiled this confidently in a long time. Horizon Dental has my business!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great first visit.  I feel bad, may have forgotten her name that did the cleaning (Holly maybe?) but I felt like she did it as if she was cleaning her own.
Dr. G took the time to walk through every X-ray, explained exactly what she saw and made sure I didn’t have any additional questions.  Very pleasant visit (bonus:: first time there and still got me in exactly at my apt time, all paperwork was done before arriving and they already contacted my insurance prior:: props to whoever did that, ty!)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: After years of not being happy with previous dentists work, after just a couple visits to Dr. Guirguis I am happier than I’ve ever been with my teeth. Horizon Dental truly takes care of their patients and make sure they leave with a smile:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Khursan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Mariam did a great job on my broken filling.
She gave me an urgent appointment and it was quick and very convenient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clifton
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a great, great place I came in on an Emergency  visit  with a missing tooth Dr. Guitarist and her team helped put my crown back in place. Everyone  here was so pleasant  from the front on the office  to the back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Farah Jaradat
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The whole staff is very professional and very friendly.  They got me in right away and explained everything very thoroughly.
Dr. Mariam is a very nice person and a professional dentist.
I would definitely recommend her to anyone who needs dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trey Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. G is a dentist I would highly recommend. I've referred her to friends or people new to Austin who are looking for a dentist. Always the same experience, which is excellent. I've had a few dental emergencies, and have been able to get an emergency appointment that day. She will be my dentist until one of us moves out of Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christin markous
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited Dental Care/Domain Dental and received exceptional dental care from Dr. Miriam. The clinic is clean, modern, and equipped with advanced technology. Dr. Miriam's expertise, professionalism, and compassionate approach made me feel at ease throughout the treatment. I highly recommend Dental Care/Domain Dental for top-quality dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenna Cummings
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don't usually leave negative reviews but my experience at this clinic in 2017 left me with dental issues that I'm still dealing with. The staff and the doctor are SUPER friendly, kind, etc. and I trusted them. I saw Dr. G and she was great with the interpersonal stuff, but she did told me I needed like 4 or 5 fillings in my teeth so I did them because I trusted her. Unfortunately she messed up my teeth so badly I had to go back three or four times just to get my bite correct and my teeth to stop killing me. After my fourth time going back for the same issue I realized I needed to see someone else. Two of the fillings Dr. G put in ended up falling out on their own.
About six months later I went to a different dentist who pulled out a piece of plaster that had been stuck down deep in my gums and helped correct my bite. My teeth will never be the same.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Dent
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horizon Dental in Austin is by far the best dentist I have been to!  Their staff is amazing and caring and always helpful!  The make sure your issue is a top priority and get you in asap.  Dr. G is so helpful and caring.  She came to my rescue on a Saturday to help me with a temporary crown when it wasn't even her work.  I am so thankful I found a great dentist because going to the dentist is stressful enough.  I highly recommend going to Horizon Dental in Austin!  I can stress enough how much you should see Dr. G for any dental needs!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sally Armenious
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Guirguis and the staff was phenomenal!! I went there several times. I had fillings and an implant done there. Dr. Guirgis made sure to carefully extract my tooth, and she later put in my implant. She made sure to follow up with me to make sure that I’m fine. Dr. Guirgis and the staff were very professional, they took care of my teeth in a manner that was very well pleasing. They answered all of my questions, and they always made me feel comfortable enough to ask anything. Every time I went there they made me feel very comfortable, and they wanted to make sure that when I left I was happy. I will continue to see Dr. Guirgis in the future, she’s amazing!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberlin Khan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I LOVE Horizon Dental! They're amazing and have the best staff! You'll be greeted (most likely) by Mrs. Bev who is always a joy to see, along with the rest of the staff that make you feel right at home. Dr. Guirguis is fantastic, she really cares about her clients and is also really entertaining to talk to. I never leave without a smile! I recently finished up invisilign with her, she did an amazing job and completely transformed my smile! I personally was very timid and didn't like to show my smile, but after Dr. G's hard work and dedication I'm now confident to smile and laugh around others without feeling self conscious. I highly recommend checking them out, you definitely won't be disappointed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lilian Cardim
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Horizon Dental Care looking for a second opinion. My son had cavities and Dr. Miriam Guirguis offered us a more safe and less invasive treatment. Our whole experience was great. The facility is clean, the staff is very friendly and Dr. Guirguis is awesome. She is very professional and has great bedside manners.. She took such a great care of my little one and I am extremely grateful. I highly recommend Dr. Guirguis.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raafat Iskander
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. G  is a great Dentist She did for me 3 implants few months ago. She did great job. She is the best Dentist. She also very compassionate and I feel so comfortable when I see her. I recommend her for everyone

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Small
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. G and her team are fantastic! Dr. G is open and honest about what your options are or if something absolutely needs to happen vs. it can wait. The staff is incredibly flexible, welcoming, and knowledgable. There was a scheduling snafu for one of my recent appointments where it didn't get scheduled, and not only did they find a way to get me in, they moved things to get me in at the time that was supposed to be scheduled. If that's not top tier customer service, I don't know what is.  If this isn't enough to convince you to go to Horizon Dental, then the spa like environment, good music choices, and the fact that they have toothbrushes ready to go in the bathroom for those of us that regularly forget to brush before heading in for a cleaning  should be reason enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maher Dakkak
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve visited Horizon Dental in North Austin several times now. What sets Horizon apart from other providers is the warmth and friendliness of everyone from the front desk to the dentists themselves. Dr. Mughrabi and Dr. Guirguis take the time to learn your name and history and also ensure you’re comfortable throughout your visit. The dental exam is thorough and the results are presented in a straightforward manner. Every time I’ve gone, they were ready for me the moment I walked in the door - no waiting whatsoever. It’s strange to admit, but I think I actually enjoy going to the dentist now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Moe G
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Guirguis is a Pro!! I have now been to both locations, and no matter which one I am at, they treat me like family. This time I had to get a root canal, and honestly, wasn't too excited. This, however, was a fairy tale, I didn't feel a thing! In and out in about an hour for both, was able to go straight back to work with no issues. They walked me through it, heard my concerns, consistently asked me about my comfort, and did the job right. Thanks to Dr. Guirguis and her staff for a wonderful experience! You make it easy to go to the dentist. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaklein Youssef
user_reviews_extended.Description: The service is great, everything was easy and fast. I can almost assure you that this place has no fault. The doctors are professional and give you very low prices compared to other dentists. Most importantly, they are very honest.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bagojfalvi Bagoj
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm not a review person, but I was promised they'll love me forever if I write one and that's a bargain so here we go. Dr. G and staff are professional and kind. They worked really fast as well. Place is chill. Extra point for remembering my name with correct pronunciation (not the one above, that would be ridiculous). I doubt that is due to my personal charm but to proper business practices. Small things like that helps you not run out of the world screaming at the idea of visiting the dentist. Appointment reminders for dummies! I should write something negative as an unbiased reviewer: Flimsy looking coat hanger. Does that count? (It did hold though.)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susie Goss
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always hated the dentist, which has prevented me from going for a while (this story is probably comparable to most). I would have dentists that would seem as if they were just wanting to get more money out of me and tell me about certain dental procedures that I never really had to get done. Horizon Dental is honest and kind. They give me tips and suggestions, but never leave me leaving the office worried or upset. I live SUPER south, but travel all the way north (which is a long long drive) to get their services. I recommend them to all my colleagues and friends because they're one of a kind. Amazinggggg people and service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aida Mojica
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went for a routine checkup and cleaning a few days ago. The front desk staff were friendly and helpful, however, my dental hygienist wasn't the best. She smelled of smoke and wouldn't stop bring up Invisalign. After I politely declined even fancying the idea she continued to bring it up. It really felt like I was at a rental car place getting pressed to buy their insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fernanda Bueno
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miriam Guirguis and all the staff are amazing people! I am a traumatized patient and finding Dr. Guirguis was a relief and a blessing! I'm not good navigating insurance, the office walked me through the details. Dr. Guirguis is beyond caring and careful. She plans what is the best approach in long term, coordinating with insurance possibilities. She warned me "this anesthesia will hurt," I felt no more than a pinch. Got home so excited that my husband is now her patient too, and as satisfied as I am.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cory Salter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horizon Dental Care is awesome! I went in for a cleaning and was extremely impressed with the service. All of the staff is genuine, thorough, and extremely personable. Very excited I found them. They're great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zach King
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Thanks to the great experience I had today with Dr. Guirguis, I will no longer be avoiding the dentist! My cavity filling was painless and easy, which wasn't the case the first go-around on that tooth a few years ago at another dentist. With Dr. Guirguis, I felt like I was in good hands, and her professionalism instilled a great deal of trust. Even so, Dr. Guirguis and her assistant repeatedly ensured they were not administering unwanted pain or discomfort. The routine teeth cleaning was also painless and I didn't feel like I was being tortured (presumably for not flossing). What I haven't mentioned is how kind and nice the entire staff is, and that's probably most important to me. Try them out, you'll see what I mean.

All around amazing. Would definitely recommend. 5/5 - perfect.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffanie Yero
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven't been to the dentist in years and I was scared to go but I cracked a tooth so I had to.  Marriah and the front desk staff were so nice and friendly.  Everyone there made me feel like I had been going there for years and we were all good friends.  I got the most AMAZING teeth cleaning from Cathy.  I have never had one that didn't hurt, which is kind of why I hadn't gone in so many years.   She numbed my gums with some ointment and I literally didn't feel a thing and she had to scrape a LOT because my plaque and tartar buildup was so bad.  Then Dr. Guirguis did my exam and gave me all the options.  Because I am about to be unemployed she let me pick the cheapest option first.  Explaining that it was a temporary fix but that for right now until my situation got better it would do the job.  They didn't try to pressure me into the biggest most expensive thing.  I really felt like they cared about me and not just trying to make as much money as possible.  I will recommend them to anyone and everyone I know.  Thank you Dr. Guirguis and the entire crew at Horizon Dental Care Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Battin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Guirguis is without doubt the best dentist I have ever had. The staff and hygienists are awesome as well. Everyone goes the extra mile to make sure you are comfortable and well informed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy S
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to the office needing to be seen for pain and it turns out I needed a root canal. Dr. Guirguis and her team fit me right in and went to work on me. I was a new patient so I thought I would have to wait a while, but I am so glad they took the time to squeeze me in.  I felt really comfortable and at ease. I was feeling better than I previously was in no time. Its even great that they are located near me and just conveniently located period.Thank you Dr. Guirguis, Ms.Beverley and Ms.Olivia for all your help on such short notice. I will definitely be making this my new dentistry and will definitely recommending them to people.

user_reviews_extended.Name: don drew
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you are like me you don't relish any visit to a dentist, but when all your excuses are gone you need to give Dr. Guirguis at Horizon Dental Care a call.

The Horizon staff is totally professional and at the same time they make you feel totally welcome and almost glad to be there,

Dr. Guirguis greets you with a smile that says I'm glad you are here and I am here help you, so lets get to work..and its obvious she takes her job seriously.  Her exams and explanations of the condition of your oral health are clear and concise and she  gives you the plan necessary to correct the problem(s) along with any alternatives that are available and she lets you make the decisions.

As I was being worked on I noticed that Dr. Guirguis and her assistant Olivia, a very gracious and capable young lady, work well with each other, quick to anticipate the others needs and the needs of the patient.

All in all, this was by far the most pleasant dental visit that I have ever experienced and I've had my share of the good and the bad.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arturo Nunez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miriam and her whole team are wonderful people. I’ve been seeing them for six years and every time is the same great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johnnie Mataska
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. G and everyone on her team are amazing. She’s done so much for me - I can’t thank her enough! I’m ex-Army so I’ve traveled a lot and had dental issues my entire life, so I have been to many different dentists and Dr. G is “hands-down” the absolute best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wendy LeFevre
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming here for years and I won't ever change them for any reason. Sure, the place is absolutely nice, but it's the beautiful staff what makes this place amazing. Unlike other dentists, they legitimately care about you, take their time to make sure their work is right, and always make you leave with a big smile.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan B (Daniel)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I admit it: I am not the easiest dental patient. Going back into childhood I have had a lot of dental work done and am sensitive to the pain. Additionally I ask lots of questions about what is being done. Dr. Guirguis and her caring team accommodated me wonderfully. Not once was I in pain and they explained everything in a way I could understand.

From appointment scheduling, to X-Rays and cleaning, examination, filling, and billing; everything went perfectly.  The X-Rays that were used even caught a moderate cavity that was between the teeth and not visible otherwise.  I am thankful for the care I received and will be back for future visits!

user_reviews_extended.Name: O
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow..10 stars to the team at Horizon dental. I arrived for my appointment to have SEVERAL teeth extracted(one being a wisdom tooth). I was greeted with hello's from everyone as I walked into the office for my 1:30pm appointment(out by 2:30pm). Dr. G & her assistant Olivia are what made the procedure go super smooth.. This is the first time I have EVER been to a dentist and laughed(no laughing gas)so hard during a procedure. I can't wait to go back to get my other procedures and a dose of laughter.....I'd be writing all day about how wonderful this place is. So do yourself a service and get to Horizon Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chakib tx
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place and nice office! The staff is always welcoming and very pleasant. Bev in the front does a great job scheduling my appointments and Olivia and Sheidy the assistants always take great care of me. I highly recommend Dr. Mughrabi, hands down the best dentist in town. And theyre close to my work by the domain. I never liked going to the dentist but they make it fun and enjoyable

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony Mancini
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely impressed with this dental office.  I can't ever recall any office where everyone was truly enjoying their roll at the office.  Very professional and laid back I would not hesitate to recommend anyone to visit to have their dental needs met.  On a side note they are also offer extremely affordable tooth replacement if you have a tooth missing and need it replaced!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mel Olstad
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horizon Dental is the first dentist that I’ve visited since moving to Austin and I had an awesome experience. Everyone on staff was friendly and easy-going. Thank you to Holly for answering all of my questions and for the thorough cleaning! Great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Kuhn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Extremely happy with the service I've received at Horizon Dental Care.  Every time I come in I don't even wait 2 minutes before being called back, the customer service is amazing, and the work is done extremely well.

5/5 I would recommend Horizon Dental Care to a friend or colleague.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Anne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place! The best experience I've ever had at a dentist. They do the work well, they're friendly and very reasonably priced. I need more work done and they will definitely see me again. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: D Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best Dental practice I've been to. The staff is always friendly and welcoming. A special thanks to Dr G. and Olivia for the pain free work I've recieved.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Stevens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just moved from Denver and had a chip in my bonding. I called 3 other dentist before finding this office and they were the only ones who didn't answer the phone and immediately place me on hold so I scheduled an appointment to have my binding fixed. They got me in the next day and worked quickly to have me in and put of the office... they did such a good job I'm going to make them my primary dentist and even scheduled a cleaning for the next day.. the ladies in this office are all sweet and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Rundblad
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Z and the whole Horizon Dental staff are amazing, always very helpful and able to fit my appointments in around my schedule. Great family environment, I have been coming to Horizon since they were located on Rutland Dr. and it has been the same awesome service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ophelia Simmons
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zeyad he made me felt comfortable with him, someone who I can trust to get the work done. I love the staff very friendly. I gotten to know Dr. Miriam also. I would recommend Horizon Dental Care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailey Watt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Horizon Dental!! Everyone is so kind and helpful here. My wisdom teeth removal and cleanings were top notch! I never get nervous going here; I trust them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AGJR Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely recommend this place! The service is great every time I go. From the front desk to the Dentist and assistants. Dr. G always makes sure your comfortable throughout any procedure. Extremely professional, and I am so glad this is my Dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was awesome and easy to deal with. Dental work was such a breeze and so painless I almost took a nap! Schedule your appointment with confidence you will be under great care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Lee-Kwan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr G was awesome.  She was friendly and explain everything to you before doing anything.  Top of the line service and very professional. She was very prompt and on schedule.   I highly recommend her.  All the other staff from receptionist to assistant was very friendly just like Dr. G.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Grasso
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horizon was recommended by a neighbor when we first moved in, and we have had extremely positive experiences with Dr. G and the rest of the staff. When I needed something outside of routine care they got me in and all fixed up within a day.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Espinor
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff at Horizon Dental are amazing! Dr.Guirguis is so considerate and chill. I've never felt stressed here but always welcomed and at home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaquan Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had both of my decade wisdom teeth pulled and what an experience. I actually had fun. Dr. G and Olivia are awesome. If i need any work done I will always come here from now on. This is now my dental home lol.

user_reviews_extended.Name: michael taddeo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. G is the best, as well as her staff members who never miss a beat. Top notch outfit 👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Morgan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really nice people.  Kind and caring, I felt comfortable.  They were able to work within the bounds of my dental insurance, which is huge.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Jarusinsky
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been to many doctors and dentists over the years and without a doubt, the staff and dentists at Horizon Dental Care are second to none. Clean facility, everyone is very courteous, and the even have an in-house insurance plan to save you money… 5 Stars PLUS!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing service! Very knowledgeable and straightforward. They were transparent in what I needs and it didn’t feel like they were trying to sell me on services I didn’t need.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Shaker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I could not be more pleased with my experience with Dr. Guirguis and her team. Excellent dental care and the most gracious and friendly service. Excellent from start to finish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mustafa Faris
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place. The entire staff is amazing and it makes going to the dentist a breeze. Dr. Guirguis is incredible and the best dentist I've ever been to. Thank you to everybody at Horizon Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Mendoza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Guirguis and her staff are very friendly and will make you feel at home. I have had several dentist through out my life and I would say for sure this one is the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Atindra Singh

Title: Exceptional Dental Care Experience!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I am absolutely delighted to share my recent experience with My Care Dental! From the moment I walked in, I felt embraced by the warm, inviting atmosphere. The reception staff greeted me with courteous smiles, ensuring a swift and seamless check-in process.

What impressed me most was the thoroughness of the dental professionals. The dentist meticulously explained the procedures, helping me understand the need for the fillings I received. Their approach was not only professional but also comforting, which significantly alleviated any anxiety I had initially.

The procedure itself was virtually painless, thanks to the expertise of the team and the state-of-the-art technology they employ. The fillings were done with such precision that I could hardly believe it when they told me they were finished!

In preparation for my upcoming tooth extraction and the placement of a crown, the dentist took the time to walk me through the entire process. They answered all my questions patiently and provided detailed aftercare instructions. Their dedication to patient education truly shines, and it's clear they prioritize patient comfort and satisfaction.

Another noteworthy aspect was the cleanliness and hygiene of the clinic. Everything was spotless, giving me confidence in their commitment to patient safety amidst the current health climate.

Overall, I am beyond satisfied with the quality of care provided by My Care Dental. Their team embodies the perfect blend of professionalism, skill, and genuine care for their patients. I look forward to my upcoming procedures, knowing I am in capable and caring hands. I wholeheartedly recommend My Care Dental to anyone seeking top-tier dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rickie Camci
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my 3rd appointment for a series of dental work. The first two went well and the first half of this one went well also. I thought he was going to get a drink or maybe use the bathroom. So 45 minutes later, I was still sitting in the room, no one had come back. I finally got up, used the bathroom and went back to the room. A few minutes later, I went to find someone. I let her know he said he was taking a break but it was coming up on an hour and I didn’t have time for that today as I obviously had not planned past the 2 hours it was supposed to be. Definitely not enough time for an hour+ break. When she came back she told me he was with another patient and he’d be back in soon. Nope. Not okay. That’s not a break, that’s leaving one patient in the middle of an appointment and going to another. Definitely not just a break. So I told her I’d like to end my appointment and ended up canceling all future appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kara gibson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Okay. It looks as if I'm in the minority in terms of dissatisfaction with services rendered. Let me tell you my personal experience, and you can decide.

I had put off going to the dentist for a little too long, just under two years, due to the ongoing pandemic. I love teeth cleanings (really!) and decided to book an appointment for a cleaning/consultation/x-rays through a $99 promotion MCD was running.

In terms of booking the service and greeting at the desk by friendly staff members, I was very happy with my choice. I met with the doctor, whose first general comment after a preliminary examination was: "well, you've had some work done." I am 52 years old and yes, I've had cavities and a couple of crowns over the last four decades. I take good care of my teeth,  brushing frequently and flossing daily, and I felt a little taken aback by how she said this. It set the tone for what was to come.

She then went through a careful categorization of everything in my mouth, rating the condition of each tooth and the level of its gum line. After x-rays were taken, the doctor reentered the room to tell me her prognosis: I would need a deep cleaning and a crown for a total of $2,034. Ouch!

As I was fully anticipating only a teeth cleaning, I was pretty shocked. I asked if I could do part of the work then, or perhaps have all the work done later.The doctor seemed very skeptical. She told me I probably had better not delay the work for too long, that maybe a month would be alright if absolutely necessary. The way this was put to me, I was terrified my teeth might fall out of my head on the way out the door.

In the end I asked to wait (upon the advice of my husband, who recognized there might be an element of up-selling to the $99 cleaning scheme) and just have the cleaning done for the moment. The doctor replied that she would NOT perform the cleaning because I was not accepting her prescribed treatment, ie, having the $2,034 of work performed on the spot! This would have been impossible for me in any case as I was leaving Austin that day and couldn't have returned for the crown to be put in, since I live abroad. They ended up charging me $79 instead of $99 for the x-rays and consultation only, and I left still needing a cleaning.

In the end, I went to a dentist recommended by my husband's coworker. I had a GREAT cleaning by the dentist himself, x-rays, consultation, the works for about $140. He even did a little extra stain removal on the lower teeth as an extra. He also told me I wouldn't need to come back for another 12 months as my teeth were in good shape.I asked him about the points brought up at My Care Dental and he said everything is stable, and no additional work would be required for the time being. Needless to say, I won't be going back to My Care Dental. Thanks for reading.

user_reviews.Name: Eldina Memic
user_reviews.Description: I had such a great experience here from start to finish. The entire staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, and Dr. Pandya took the time to explain everything so thoroughly, which I really appreciated. I hadn’t been to the dentist in a while, but they made me feel completely comfortable, at ease, and reassured the whole time. I’m so glad I came here and would definitely recommend them!

user_reviews.Name: Jordan D
user_reviews.Description: I cannot recommend this dentistry enough. The front desk staff was incredibly polite and professional and got me into and emergency appointment with ease. The dental assistant and dentist were kind and patient. I was able to form a plan of action for my future dental care without any stress or discomfort. Our community is very fortunate to have Forest Family Dentristry!

user_reviews.Name: Hannah Smith
user_reviews.Description: I had such a great experience with Dr. Gubin and Paige as well as the rest of the staff! Dr. Gubin is very warm and knowledgeable and explained everything in a way that eased my anxiety. The staff explained all costs and plans very professionally, and Paige was wonderful through my cleaning. I look forward to continuing treatment with everyone here. Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: Janis Fowler
user_reviews.Description: I love Forest Family. I started going to the Eastside location first. I needed a bunch of work done after avoiding the dentist during the pandemic and was so scared… I heard they were amazing with people like me from a trusted friend. It was true. I then moved and had to switch to the north location.  I hated that at the time because Dr Disla is so fun and kind and was the best dentist I had had to that point…. But it turns out the north location is also absolutely wonderful, and everyone has always made me feel welcome, calm, and cared for. It’s never that fun to go to the dentist, but since I’ve been going to FF I no longer dread it or avoid it altogether. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews.Name: Pam Rayborn
user_reviews.Description: Great dental experience. I was well taken care of as I needed to get in for a cleaning before a dental implant. They got me in and fixed another dental problem all in one day.

user_reviews.Description: I had a minor emergency and was seen the next day. Jisela, one of the assistance was fantastic. I was seen on time (unheard of), Jisela was friendly, efficient and professional. Dr Gubin came in immediately and clearly explained my situation. After she left the room, I had an additional question so Jisela went out to ask Dr Gubin. To my surprise Dr Gubin herself came in to answer my question. If you have any doubts, just go in, I don't believe you'll regret it!

After receiving a couple of procedures here at this office in the last year, I have nothing but good things to say about it!
