user_reviews_extended.Description: My cleaning today was great and I appreciate that Dr Pandaya is truthful and doesn’t try to sell you services you do not need.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mb Z
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience is from one introductory visit, so I can't speak too much in terms of procedures being done or after care, etc. But I can say, I showed up after 4:45pm today less than 45 mins before they closed with no appointment in slight distress as I had a tooth extraction completed last Friday (by a completely different dentists office, in the area but I'll leave nameless) that went horribly requiring a visit to the ER later that evening.

Fast forward to today, I visited FFD after being concerned that the blood clot may have dislodged and became a dry socket. Dr. Pandya and team were so kind and courteous, staying past 6pm (more than 30 minutes after scheduled closing) just to look me over, prescribe some antibiotics and make sure I was ok.

I sincerely appreciate yall for doing such spectacular work and picking up where the other dentist's office dropped the ball. Although after this last dental procedure and subsequent ER visit, I'm left with a new found fear of the dentists office and don't intend on ever going for anything other than 6-month cleanings (health permitting) again. I'm so appreciative to have found a dentist I have faith in and feel comfortable with providing good care in the first visit alone.

Thank you guys again so much for today! Great first impression! 🙏🏽

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Fess
user_reviews_extended.Description: Outstanding!  Austin vibe and excellence all around. As a long time Austinite I am so happy I found Forest Family Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mint.e Fresh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
What a super experience! I hesitantly called this dentist, not really wanting to make an appointment but knowing I really had to go — Its the dentist! Let's just say, it's no Disney. (no offense dentists)
That being said, I had a great experience making my appointment with Manny! He was such a wonderful guy—super friendly and really understanding about my fears of going to the dentist. I'm so glad I decided to book the appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evan Perkins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Last year, I engaged with Dr Rick and his team at Forest Family Dentistry North to completely revamp my smile. I had a sizable gap in my front top teeth and a tremendous amount of crowding in my bottom teeth (to the point that one tooth was getting gradually pushed out of my gums). I never had braces as a kid and always wanted straight teeth.

We did the whole shebang -- Invisalign, veneers, and a procedure to fix the dreaded "black triangles" that resulted from a couple triangular shaped teeth which did not touch at the gum line.

The transformation is unreal. Before and after picture attached. I couldn't be happier with the result.

I also couldn't be happier with the process at Forest Family North. Dr. Rick answered a ton of questions throughout the treatment plan. I had to go through a few revisions, I maybe panic'd a time or two...Dr. Rick and the rest of the staff were very patient, always answered my questions, and were very clear with how each step in the process would work -- I never felt like I was "putting them out" by having things explained to me until I understood them.

I've not ever experienced a kinder, more considerate medical professional team! They always ask if you're doing okay during a procedure which I always appreciate.

10/10 would recommend! I'd do it all again in a heartbeat, and will be a patient for years to come!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Christmas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We love Forest Family Dentistry!  We moved our children from their Pediatric dentist so that they could be at the North location with us.  Our appointments always run on schedule, staff is friendly and professional.
The doctors at extremely thorough, Dr. Pandya was extremely concerned for an issue my husband had been suffering from and receiving treatment for outside of dentistry.  Due to her insistence, it was discovered my husband had cancer and received treatment before it could spread further.  We will always be grateful for her thoroughness and care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: My fiance, stepdaughter, and I have all had our first visits with Dr. Pandya and Jisela and they have won us over as loyal patients. We were in need of a new dentist as we recently moved to Austin and feel like we’ve hit the jackpot. The staff are all very friendly and professional. Dr. Pandya was AMAZING. So thorough and really took the time to explain the treatment plans. Never thought I’d say I’m looking forward to my next appt with my dentist, but I am!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vonnie Wu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Forest Family Dentistry for two years and I have gotten excellent service every time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yuri Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Forest Family Dentistry has been dentistry for at least 7 years. The service is exceptional by the dentists, dental staff, and office staff! These reasons have kept me loyal and keep coming back. I’ve been to other dentist in the Austin area and this dentistry far exceeds others that I’ve experienced. I recommend 1000%

user_reviews_extended.Name: July Ann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Gubin is really awesome and made me feel safe and comfortable. She answered my questions thoroughly and I almost fell asleep while she was filling my cavities. (they also let you watch your favorite show which is a bonus). Thanks forest family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leticia Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone has been so friendly each time I’ve come. This dentist/team is the most efficient, organized, and thoughtful I’ve encountered. Also, some genius came up with the idea of putting a screen on the ceiling so I was able to watch Netflix to help me take my mind of f the fact that my teeth were even being worked on. The office is also lovely and modern. I’ll be recommending them to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Fitzgerald
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! All of the staff are extremely welcoming and helpful. They thoroughly explain each step of the process, and take time to answer any questions you have. Highly recommend FFD!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharyn Hyde
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot say enough positive words about Forest Family Dentistry.  I bit into something hard and lost my porcelain crown front tooth the day before my son’s wedding!! I knew it was a longshot cuz it was after 5:00 PM. I frantically explained the situation and asked if they could help me so I am not humiliated by having no front tooth in the wedding photos.
To my surprise, everyone agreed to stay and help, even though it was way past time to go home.
Seeing all of them huddle up to come up with a plan and implement it before noon the  next day was nothing short of a miracle!
Although no one from Forest Family Dentistry knew me,  I felt so loved and cared about. They truly saved the day for me on my only son’s wedding day.
I don’t know what I would have done without their professional knowledge, their willingness to help me and most of all, their care and concern for another human being!
If you are looking for a dental office that actually cares about their patients, please go to Forest Family Dentistry.  You will not regret it!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to Forest Family Dentistry for a few years and always have a great experience. Dr. Pandya is very attentive and receptive to any questions or concerns and the dental assistants, hygienists, and front desk staff are great! Would highly recommend.

The staff keeps getting better and my teeth have never been cleaner.

They make you feel like a patient and not a payday and ask you several times if you have any concerns to address.  They are consistent with this customer service across locations, too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Chiu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience with initial exam! Staff was friendly and explained things clearly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: PC Bentsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dentist and hygienist were personable and professional.  Will return

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Lombard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going here for a while for my regular cleanings which has always been business as usual. They did ask what I prioritize and I selected "mindful of time", and they respect that. I don't think I have waited more than 5 minutes before being seen. They also were able to squeeze me in when I chipped 2 teeth. Solid practice all around. Thx Dr. Gubin for fixing my chips! :-)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camille Nix
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Pandya is thorough and has wonderful bedside manner. She helped my young son manage his nerves with a dental procedure, and because of her, he did great! Additionally, my oldest had a dental emergency. Dr. Pandya was responsive and helped us get in quickly! This practice is AMAZING!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Hoyt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I used to love this place. I referred many friends and acquaintances to this office over the past 5-6 years because it was truly a pleasure to do business with them. I actually used to look forward to going to the dentist.

Not the case anymore. Over the past year this office has drastically declined. Front office staff is rude and poorly trained in communication and customer service; management does nothing to resolve issues or follow up; and they are inconsiderate of patient's time (the office called me to cancel my appointment TWICE within a half hour of my appointment time when I had taken the time off from work and rearranged my schedule to be available) and yet when needing to reschedule, can't fit me in for another 6 months.

The mouth guard they made for me and charged me $300 for broke within 6 months; they fit me for a new one and it's been 5 months since then and they do not follow up about when it's going to be ready. I've called to ask and it's still 'not ready'.

I've always liked Dr. Pandya but again, the past year she's had me bouncing back and forth between her and an endodontist and no one seems to be able to figure out what the issue is (thousands of dollars later). I've given up and just put up with the discomfort because I don't have the time or money to keep going back and forth and continuously not having answers.

I worked in customer service for a long time and it takes a lot for me to write a bad review based on customer service and bad experiences. This review only scratches the surface of what I've dealt with. I will be taking my business elsewhere once I get my mouth guard replaced.

user_reviews_extended.Name: caleczandre
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been coming to Forest Family Dentistry for a few years now and they've alway provided a good experience.

This last visit was no exception.  It is always a calming atmosphere. Everyone greats you with a smile, a real smile, like they are happy to see you!

Checking in, the receptionist was cheery and had a great conversation with me while she set me up for the day, as well as my next appointment on Halloween.

While Laura (Lori?) cleaned my teeth we just had a nice chat like we were old friends.  This was interspersed with guidance and direction on brushing and flossing processes.

Unlike some people, I never fret going to the dentist.  I am always leaving with a smile!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Gibson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Forest Family North will take great care of you. From the dentists, to the hygienists, to the office staff, they are always friendly and efficient without ever making you feel rushed. They all listen and take the time to understand your concerns, answer your questions, and in the years I have been bringing my family here I've never had a negative experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time, new patient. Great professionalism by Jisela and Dr Pandya. Super friendly and great informative, educational dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gj Mason
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great first appointment. They made feel at ease after not being to the dentist in a while

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dayva Beaudoin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Forest Family Dentistry is amazing and they see our whole family. We’re all time poor (especially during the work and school week), and they have weekend and evening appointments available. So convenient, so nice and professional. Our family highly recommends them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ren Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: the staff is so friendly, accommodating, and make me feel so comfortable. i used to hate hate HATE going to the dentist but the ppl here make it a better :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Esmeralda Arevalo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming here for a few years and have always had a gteat experience. Front desk staff is so friendly and always tries to accommodate scheduling dates. My hygienist Paige is so thorough and has given me great tips throughout time that have made my gums healthier. I try to schedule with her each time. Also, I appreciate that they have a membership plan for ppl without insurance. It's a great affordable option for preventative care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: RJ
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Paige is one of, if not the best hygienists that I've ever worked with. She is attentive, careful, communicative, and informative. The same can be said for Dr. Pandya, she has a knowledge base and tenure that is unmatched.

10/10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Weaver
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wouldn't recommend Forest Family to anyone. It's office and location is nice as someone who doesn't love doctors visits it was a calming atmosphere but their patient care lacks.
I had quite a few filling done and that went okay. They estimated my share with my insurance and had me pay approximately $700 for the procedure. That was all and well but about 6 months later in January I reviewed on my insurance's website the dental charges and they overcharged me and never called to tell me. I then called and prompted why they never called to tell me they were holding $400 of my money and they refunded. I didn't mind holding a balance but I had to call and find out myself.
With that filling appointment/procedure I had sensitivity after the fact which I have never had before, I waited it out and recently went in regarding such sensitivity. They took x-rays and fixed my bite. It's the exact teeth they worked on and the work caused the sensitivity, but they charged my insurance. I don't mind that they charged for the x-rays but why charge for the work on the tooth that they should fix that they already charged for the work originally. They then fit me in for a regular cleaning the next day took more x-rays and now my insurance is maxed out for the year on x-rays and I owe. Overall, I can't say I have any reason I'd go back. Never had these issues at a dentist before.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hoa Phan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have good cleaning experience and friendly staff members at Research Forest Dentistry

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Zinke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shannon, Bonnie, Dr. Gubin, and the hygienists are all amazing!!! I normally hate the dentist, but I’d come back here to hang out just for fun! Shannon and Bonnie went above and beyond to help make sure my insurance was working for me not against me, and Dr. Gubin and the hygienists took great care to explain everything they were doing while fixing a crown and made sure I was as comfortable as all the dental tools would allow along the way! I’m brand new to Austin and happy to make FFD my dentist here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kerrigan Bush
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to this location for a little over three years and it is truly the best! Everyone from the receptionists, hygienists, and doctors are all extremely kind. The hygienists are very thorough, gentle, and do an exceptional job. It’s always a pleasant experience and I would recommend this FFD to anyone in the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alejandro Ahuja
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had a great experience as a patient at Forest Dentistry - Research, and I can’t recommend Dr. Gubin highly enough. From the moment you walk in, the environment is calm, welcoming, professional, and the staff is very friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate B
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I have been going here for years. We always have a good experience. Everyone is very professional, we always get a great cleaning, and my kids love the television on the ceiling!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benjamin Murray
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist in Austin. I have been going here for over 9 years and have never thought about going elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Z Ocampo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
i came to this clinic years ago because of all the great reviews, and i haven’t yet been let down. from reception, to hygienists, to dentists, they’re all worth commending.
i have to make special mention of jisela who went above and beyond. she was so caring and made sure i was comfortable (back pain) and warm (cause im always freezing in that clinic!), and explained everything she was doing for my treatment. i’m so grateful.
also dr. pandya, was very professional and worked well and efficiently, she too made sure i was comfortable and kept asking if i was doing ok.
i would definitely recommend that you come here for all your dental work. you’ll be taken care of

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caroline Winchester
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going here for almost 8 years so this review is long overdue! The staff at this location is always so kind and thorough with my cleanings. I’m very picky about my teeth and I really trust their work. I can’t say enough great things about them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Naceanceno
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to this dental practice for a couple of years and have been so impressed! Their staff is very friendly and professional and the facility itself is clean, modern, and nicely designed.  Dr Rick is caring, professional, very knowledgeable, and does quality work. I’ve had several dentists in the 23 years I’ve been in Austin and can truly say that he is the only dentist I have trusted to look out for my best interest. My experiences have been great. I will continue going and highly recommend this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Havens
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit to Forest Family Dentistry went well. The staff were all friendly and helpful. The space is very calming. I’m glad I followed a friend’s recommendation to make an appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martin Sandoval
user_reviews_extended.Description: I say this wholeheartedly, each returning experience is just as welcoming as the last. Having had apprehensions with the quality and empathy of prior dental treatment, nothing comes to the degree of professionalism or interest in your well-being. Each staff member is supportive, engaging, and strives to ensure you understand how to take the dental care into your own hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jimmy Oldbikepunk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Rick was the best dentist I’ve ever had. He has now moved on to his own practice. I am well cared for by my  current care team. Dr Pandya and all the staff work hard to care for me and my teeth. They have inspired me to take better care of my teeth. It’s great to have such a great care team you can trust.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was very nice! First time going in a long time. Everyone explained what they were about to do before doing it. They also checked in multiple times during the cleaning to make sure I wasn't too uncomfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Capo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have to admit I dreaded coming in today because I slacked on taking care of my teeth for the last several months, but Kaleigh and Dr. Gubin fixed me right up and made me feel 100% better!  I highly recommend Forest Family Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie C
user_reviews_extended.Description: My 15 year old son had a new patient consultation today. The office was nice. The treatment rooms were spacious and  offered privacy when discussing options. The staff was accommodating and very welcoming. We enjoyed our experience from start to finish. I highly recommend Forest family dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley McGinnis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an appointment as a new patient and everyone was very friendly, especially the receptionist. This office has really cool technology I hadn't seen before where they can scan your teeth and show you a 3-d image. The dentist was kind of pushy with Invisalign and seemed concerned about the cosmetics of my teeth, she mentioned a few times that I had stains. Overall a good visit, I will not be moving forward with the $6500 Invisalign though : )

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chy C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Hailey from the front desk staff was extremely friendly and helpful. She made us feel very welcome and warm. She went through the payment plan with us very carefully.

Julie is a great hygienist. She listened to my mom’s concerns and made sure that my mom was fine before she started.  My mom was very nervous at first but she immediately gave Julie a thumbs up right after the cleaning. My mom did not feel any pain or discomfort at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Glenn Haluska
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff were very helpful with registration (l'm a Dell user), and Dr. Very  patient with my hearing loss. See you soon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Recently switched from Swish to this dental office and I love it. Always pleasant, communicative and on time. The dentists don’t try to hit you with an unnecessary high bill & the entire operation is organized. Best decision I could’ve made. I feel like this is how healthcare should be!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Malcolm H. Leslie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Today's visit was seamless. Checking in was very fast three minutes then Paige (I think) came out and introduce ced herself and took me back to the 'Bear'
room, all the rooms are named after forest dwellers
Get it?
Paige explained everything that was going to happen and very efficiently took a bunch of X Rays. Very efficiently and no effort on my part
Next the dental hygienist came in and again very succinctly told me all that was going to happen. Again very professional and caring. After a short while the Doctor came in studied the notes from the two ladies and then did his own examination again very gentle but thorough. Fortunately my teeth were in pretty good shape but he did recommend a follow up visit
scheduling that was a breeze. I had been to Forest a while back and had no challenges and when I came back this time I remembered why
Everyone there is very down to earth and caring for whole being most respectful
Believe it or not
'I am looking forward to my next visit to the Dentist??

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrena-Moi Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Gubin is Amazing and very knowledgeable. The made me feel comfortable and answered all my questions. I think I’ve found my forever home . Jisela was great kayleigh was also amazing

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liza Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super helpful and super friendly, first time here and was very pleased with my experience. Very pleased and glad i chose to come here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Hime
user_reviews_extended.Description: I adore this dentistry. Every team member I have interacted with has made me feel comfortable, valued and like a human honestly. I was very nervous to get shots in my mouth and get a tooth pulled but they were understanding, gentle and I didn’t feel a thing! After my first examination the team also made a very clear and easy follow up plan for me. They’re truly amazing and I would, have and will recommend them to my family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brigitte Le Vea
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am the BIGGEST baby when it comes to the dentist. My anxiety goes through the roof, so naturally when I had to have fillings done I was not very excited. Jessika and Dr.Pandya handled me with the such care. I felt seen and not condescended to. The procedure was better than I anticipated it to be. Very grateful for this team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Meyers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I never thought I would enjoy the dentist, but FF is an enjoyable experience. Amazing and friendly customer service. Minimal wait time. Thoughtful discussion around treatment plans. I’ve actually decided to continue with FF despite them recently moving OON with my insurance provider. They are the dentist I feel at ease with and trust. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Spencer Roy
user_reviews_extended.Description: PSA- I went to Forest Family Dental for the first time and it was a great experience! Research blvd location is super convenient and Breanna was very nice checking me in/out quickly.  Kayleigh was great helping take X-Rays and offered to put Netflix on the ceiling TV.  Never seen that!  Dr Gubin was so nice and probably the best dentist I’ve ever been to. She was very knowledgeable and told me what I truly need to do and how to prevent cavities!  Found my new spot!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pōmaika`i
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Jeff and team are efficient and friendly. I just realized this, but they have earpieces to communicate. Often times they’ll just dip out of the room without explanation, and I thought it odd but upon realizing they were needed elsewhere I thought it was quite efficient.

My experience here has been great.  I appreciate the level of technology they have and how Dr. Jeff uses the tech to explain treatment options and show status of teeth. They were quick to refer my daughter to a proper children’s dentistry after realizing they were not the best fit for her needs.

The folks at the front desk usually appear bored, but id look the same way after staring at the computer for hours lol.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Like many people, I am kind of afraid of the dentist as a concept and have avoided them since the pandemic.  Then this week i broke one of my front teeth and was recommended Dr. Rick by a new friend.  I was still hesitant, but Dr Rick texted me directly, had me come in the same day, and was legit the best doctor i've ever seen.  Him and his staff were so kind, easy to chat with, and open to helping me get through all the issues I was worried about with the utmost class and kindness.  I cant recommend them enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Antonio
user_reviews_extended.Description: I think they're somewhat unprofessional in how they treat patients. Perhaps they've gotten to be this way as a result of their success. I made an appointment and couldn't get a straight answer from them on how much they would charge me. I had gotten x rays from a different dentist and asked them if we could use these, as opposed to me being forced to take new x rays with them and being charged me for something I essentially already had. Try as I might, I could not get a straight answer from them on this. Why couldn't they just tell me what they would or wouldn't' have me do during the appointment, and how much they would charge me? They knew I didn't have dental insurance, and that I was concerned about the cost of the appointment. I just wish people in the medical industry would treat patients a bit more like human beings, with particular needs and requests which, if reasonable, should be accommodated, and not as mere customers whose last available penny must be ferreted out of their pockets.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor McKinney
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were very quick to take me and check out an issue I had with an old filling. They were even able to get me in at the same time to get it fixed. Everyone was very kind and understanding which I definitely appreciated as someone who has a history of dental trauma and anxiety. They made it super easy and pain free so I will definitely keep coming back for future appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori Pizarek
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our three year old had a great experience at Forest Family Dental Practice!  Dr. Pandya has a gentle manner with children and Taylor, the hygenist,  was wonderful at keeping our kiddo comfortable while getting his teeth cleaned.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Rich
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ali was fantastic!  The went in for a new patient exam and cleaning and he was super nice and personable, explained things clearly, and didn’t judge me or admonish me.  The cleaning was efficient and the staff was all very friendly.  We were looking for a new dentist, and this is it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan McCalmont
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr Rick has been wonderful. He is exceptionally professional and experienced. The staff was helpful and friendly. The new North location is comfortable and clean, also very convenient. I won't trust my teeth to anyone else! Great job, five stars!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sebastian
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Forest for many yrs. I am still amazed every time I visit at how good they are!! I had many bad experiences w dentists in Texas and NYC before finding Forest. At Forest I feel well taken care of, attended w honesty and respect . Many of the dentists now a days have become like infomercials for stuff we may not need. I have never felt like that at Forest . They are amazing from the front desk to every step of the process. Thanks for such good care !!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Fillare
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Forrest Family Dentistry for years. They are always great! They care about you as a patient. No one likes the dentist but this is the first dentist I have ever been to that I didn't have anxiety before I go in.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick K
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a terrible experience here and I recommend that everyone avoid this practice for anything beyond a routine tooth cleaning if you seriously care about your dental health. Forest Family (Factory) Dentistry is your typical practice that follows a generic script, which unfortunately makes them prone to making mistakes that can have a lasting negative impact on their patients. I had only had cavity in my life prior to my first visit here, and I was told that I needed a filling. That appeared to be the case but they managed to severely botch the filling by "drilling further than they thought they would." I have been in constant pain for over a month as a result of the filling while I was not in any pain beforehand. I returned for a follow-up to assess the issue and they told me I will likely need a root canal and tried to refer me to an endodontist. They also encouraged me to come back to get a crown put on so they could hopefully get their money's worth out of me. They didn't explicitly admit that they made a mistake and clearly did not take proper precautions before deciding to drill into my tooth. Needless to say, I will be seeking a second a opinion. Overall, Forest Family Dentistry is capable of providing a routine tooth cleaning and general exam, but I would recommend seeking a second opinion or going elsewhere for any major dental procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oscar Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Pandya has been amazing helping me with my Invisalign and my oral health. I’ve been coming for over 2 years now and I just love it. Great service and care every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haseeb Ansari
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Dave and Kayleigh were amazing today. It was a very comfortable and fun appointment and they ensured my questions were answered well. Overall excellent experience and I recommend coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Walcott
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great customer service! Alexander was very attentive in accommodating my scheduling needs and Daniella and Dr. Gubin were both very kind, professional, and gentle during my visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Neilan
user_reviews_extended.Description: So, i'm one of those people who sweats at the sight of any medical professional, and I hate needles, so needless to say, i'm not a fan of the dentist. I've had one traumatic dental surgery that has marked every experience thereafter, so when I tell you that i'm grateful to have met Dr. Ali...I really, REALLY mean it. If you have a fear of the dentist, go see him. He has such a calm demeanor and i felt like he was actually concerned about making me feel at ease. Also, i'd be remiss not to mention the wonderful hygienists and the "front of the house" of this office. Wonderfull all around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Griffith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had unpleasant experiences with dentists in the past and avoided them for too long. A few years ago I developed a cavity I couldn't ignore and found FFD from the great reviews on Yelp. Dr. Rick was so patient and gentle and helped me prioritize my dental needs. Now I go in every 3 months for my routine cleanings. Dr. Rick is an excellent, honest dentist and his entire staff is warm, efficient and professional. They are patient-centered and focused on making their patients comfortable. FFD and Dr. Rick are the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Nolan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My teeth suck, so I grew up loathing the dentist. When I moved to Austin two years ago and found Forest Family that all changed. I've had so many positive experiences here that I felt I finally had to write a review. The staff are all so friendly and helpful. Dr. Rick is by far and away the best dentist I've ever had. He knows his stuff, and you can tell he really cares about his patients.

Thank you guys for making going to the dentist no longer a pain!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ken Michaels
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Rick and his staff were amazing. Hate going to the dentist and they made it a great experience. Office is beautiful and friendly staff. Dr Rick walks you through every part while he works on your mouth. He follows up the day after to make sure you're doing well which my past dentist never did. I would highly suggest to use his practice!  You and your mouth can't go wrong.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pierce's Playground
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going here for 2 years and Dr. Rick does a wonderful job. I could've written a review for just how good his work is every time I went in but it would've been somewhat redundant. In all truth his work is superb and Forest Family is a fine setting. I'm glad he's been working on my teeth and I've had major work done here. (3 crowns, 2 bridges)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roopsi Chalana
user_reviews_extended.Description: Paige is a great hygienist. Staff is very friendly too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lim
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Forest Family Dentistry since 2014 (Anderson Ln location) and just had a cleaning at the Research Blvd location. Everyone on staff is always helpful and patient. Julie, the dental hygienist I had today, is very skilled, nonjudgmental, and efficient! Dr. Tjan was thorough and kind as well, allowing plenty of space for me to ask any questions I had. I'm grateful for the work everyone does here and will continue to recommend them to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana
user_reviews_extended.Description: First of all, I did not have the best experiences at the dentist growing up so I was very apprehensive coming here. From the get go, the staff and assistants were very friendly and made me feel comfortable. There was also Netflix so I was able to zone out during the cleaning. Dr. Latif was incredibly kind and took the time to listen and educate me while addressing my concerns. I am SO pleased and excited to not worry about going to the dentist! ☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kayla Stephany
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best dental experience I’ve ever had, I was very nervous about having to get fillings done but the staff and doctor made me feel comfortable and talked me through everything. Really enjoyed my experience  and will continue to come back for any future visits!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tejashree Uppala
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Always had a good experience with Dr. Rick.

He’s helped relieve me of tooth pain caused by receding gums with some simple but very effective fillings. Something no other dentist had suggested over the years of suffering I’ve experienced.

He’s advised me many times to get rid of my wisdom teeth since they’ve developed many cavities but I’ve chickened out every time even after meeting the surgeon he referred. But he never pushed me in a commercial way like some other dentists have done in the past. I’m now planning to get that procedure done soon from the surgeon he’s recommended (Dr. Kern). Because I trust them both to do a good job and truly care for their patients well-being.

user_reviews_extended.Name: steven attlee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently moved to Austin and was in search of a new dental office. A friend had reccomended Forest family north to me and it turned out to be an amazing find. From scheduling over the phone all the way up to my visit with Dr. Rick, I was absolutely blown away by the level of courtesy and professionalism. The facilities and equipment are top notch and Morgan and Tabitha, Dr. Rick’s assistants, were both friendly and efficient. I can’t say what a relief it is to have found such a great practice so soon after moving to Austin. I will definitely be recommending them in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis Dube
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cant thank this Team enough for what they did for me Saturday. Came in with an emergency required a root canal. Dr Ali moved things around to ensure I was no longer in pain. Try out this wonderful group of amazing people you will not be disappointed. Great location and friendly Staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Munson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was nervous about finding a local dentist after only seeing my hometown dentist all my life. Forest Family Dentistry made the switch easy! They’re knowledgeable, efficient, and welcoming! Highly recommend. Being able to watch Netflix during my visit is just an added bonus.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Capella
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Rick and his staff are simply amazing! I have been a patient along with my kids for several years. I’ve sent multiple referrals his way and EVERYONE loves Dr. Rick! His staff is friendly, the environment is excellent and Dr Rick himself is an excellent dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nayeli Miranda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve used their services for years. They are always be cordial, friendly, and professional. The office is very clean and the wait time is minimal.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Fisher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Rick is always friendly and communicates honestly his assessment of my dental needs. He seems truly care about his patience and their health.  He is great
to work with and is well thought of in Dental community.  I have referred both my wife and several friends to his office.  All of them have expressed the same gratitude for Dr. Rick.  He’s a good one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thuy Phi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been happy with Forest Family Dentistry North. But this time is a little difference. First, the Dr did the cleanup, not a hygienist. I don't have any problems with this. However, the floss and polish which were done by the assistant were not good. She couldn't recognize my bridge and thus kept pushing the floss in. For regular teeth, she did so gently that I didn't feel them clean. The polishing was not good either; she didn't do it thoroughly. I really felt it after my previous cleanings which had done with hygienists.
I notified the front desk, and they put that in my file so I won't encounter the same in the future. I hope something is done within the office so no one, not just me, will have the same issue.
Another issue is with future cleaning. I had to schedule my next cleaning 8 months out. That is too long to me. Maybe it's time to look for some other place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Terribly rude dentist, blamed their half done cleaning back in July on my using the wrong kind of floss. Nothing has a big of an impact on periodontal health as frequency of professional cleanings, so when can they schedule me again? December. What a joke. I'm finding a new dentist and you should avoid these people like the plague. Work with a dentist/dental hygienist that you can afford to see 3-4x a year for cleanings and that can book that frequency.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara R Dries
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven't been to the dentist in years and i finally decided it was time to go and i found forest family dentistry! Dr Greg is amazing and made everything feel so comfortable. Hannah and Yvette are so fantastic! Made me feel so comfortable and put everything at ease!!! I recommend this place to anyone who has a phobia of the dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nabeel Chaudhary
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to their office yesterday and had the best experience!!! Dr.  Rick worked on me and did an amazing job,  I didn’t feel a thing with all that dental work.  The hygienist who worked on me was very friendly and amazing as well.  I just moved from Boston and needed a new dentist and I’ve found him.  Would definitely recommend Dr. Rick to everyone!!! Definitely going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jody Yanes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a co- worker tell me his retainer snapped in half and wasn’t able to be seen until after New Years. I recommended he come here, they fit him in two days before Christmas and repaired his retainer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yu-Jing Chen
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my first time at this location. Somehow my gum hurts so much during cleaning, and I have never felt like this before. I can taste my own blood during the process and when I brushed my teeth that night. A bit traumatized but I am sure my teeth are indeed clean… was hoping it can be done more gently. Might not come back for cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eli S
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am deeply anxious about all medical stuff. The noises in the dentist scared me. But they were very understanding and patient. I told them the surprises make me anxious so if they can explain as they go it helps me contain me anxiety. They listened well to my boundaries both verbal and nonverbal. They didn't shame me for crying. They tried their best to get my name right which I appreciate. The technology is less loud. More sensory friendly and less claustrophobic feeling. I had been panicking about this all day but it went ok. And I'm really glad for that..

user_reviews_extended.Name: H N
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time going to this dentist for routine cleaning and was very disappointed. First they didn't even clean my teeth properly, only lightly polished my teeth, minimum floss so pretty much they did the bare minimum and I didn't even get mouth wash at the end. Second they don't have the conventional x-ray machine and used hand held x-ray had to open my mouth and close multiple times and was uncomfortable also the 3d scanner to show the image of my teeth was very uncomfortable cause it's a big device going inside your mouth. Third Dr. Purvi Pandya was trying to upsell all kind of service that I don't need, it felt like going to the car dealership ( How can I get the most money out of him). Overall stay way from this place, you have been warned! Don't let the 4 star google rating fool you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chisam Reiter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I very rarely write reviews, but I had such an incredible experience at Forest Family that I had to leave one! Everyone I encountered was extremely friendly and helpful. The front desk was very accommodating and patient while I struggled to get my insurance information together and Marissa and Valerie were some of the friendliest, sweetest, most genuine people I have met in a long time. I was truly blown away. As long as I am in Austin, I will be going to Forest Family. I seriously could not recommend them more highly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitchell Hopper
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to Dr. Rick initially to have my teeth cleaned. I pretty much fell in love with him and Forest Family Dentistry at that point. Dr. Rick and his team are friendly and extremely detail-oriented. We ended up discussing a veneer that I had put on when I was in high school that I wasn't really happy with. He suggested that a crown would be a better match and more in line with my desired look. Keep in mind that this is one of my front teeth so it's always been an issue for me. From the initial visit for the temporary, the color match visit at the lab, and the final install of my crown, Dr. Rick and the team were there to answer any questions and reassure me. The end result is fantastic. The color match and look of my front crown  is perfect and I smile wide now! I now live in NY state and will only let Dr. Rick touch my teeth and plan appointments around visits back to TX. If you're looking for a dentist, you won't regret Dr. Rick and Forest Family team. Also, their new location up North is really nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Andrews
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was in need of a dentist to get a filing fixed, and ended up choosing Forest Family Dentistry North based on the good reviews. I haven't been to a dentist in over four years because of a negative experience that I had with my previous dentist. I made an appointment for what I thought would be a routine cleaning and for the filling to be looked at. When I got there and checked in, the hygienist took x-rays and then Dr. Pandya charted my gums. After the charting, Dr. Pandya told me my gums weren't that bad considering it's been a while since I was last seen by a dentist. However, she did tell me I had bone loss, a tooth that "sunk" during the charting (huh?), a filling that was "leaking" (what?), and proceeded to ask me if I thought about veneers or teeth whitening (um, no). When I went to leave, I was given a laundry list of work that needed to be done (to the tune of over $2k out of pocket), scheduled an appointment for fillings (one of the reasons I made the appointment in the first place) and was a little confused that no cleaning was done. I ended up going back in and the receptionist told me that they tried to call me for two days to tell me there wouldn’t be a cleaning. The receptionist called my office number, which was closed for the holidays, and not my cell phone, so I never received the message. I scheduled the cleaning for a different day and left. When I got home, I get a call from the receptionist who told me that I couldn’t have a cleaning or fillings done until I had a deep cleaning. I questioned this and was told she’d call me back. When she called me back we tried to schedule a day that worked for the filling and deep clean and she continues to try and give me times for a date I told her no longer worked. I also asked about the cost of this deep clean and she said it would be two separate appointments at $299 each. Why? Why couldn’t I just get a routine cleaning and my filling done without the need for the deep clean. She proceeded to tell me that I have severe gum disease (what?! mind you, not one mention of this from the dentist) and I told her I wasn’t comfortable making any appointments, and would wait to hear from the dentist via email. I received an email from Dr. Pandya and was not confident in her explanation for the work that needed to be done. I did let her know that the receptionist said I had severe gum disease, and would be seeking a second opinion. This place only cares about money and not quality care. I'm giving three stars because the hygienist was nice and they sent me my x-rays on request, without issue.

P.S. More of my filling fell out since my initial appointment, so time was of the essence. I had my second opinion today, and the dentist was confident that I did not need a deep clean and didn't find any signs of bone loss! I was able to get the routine cleaning done and all fillings fixed (including ones that were about to be a future problem) in the same appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebekah Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just adore Family Forest Dentistry. And that’s saying a lot, because I hate going to the dentist. Every single staff member makes me feel comfortable and never makes me feel silly for being an adult who is scared of the dentist. They’re quick, efficient, and good at what they do. Special shout out to Paige, my favorite dental hygienist. She does such a great job on my teeth every time while always being so mindful of my sensitivity.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Glass
user_reviews_extended.Description: Forest Family is wonderful. The hygienists are incredibly friendly, very thorough, and clearly care about you and the health of your teeth and gums. Dr. Rick is a rockstar! I never feel rushed through and he takes the time to make sure I'm comfortable with everything in the check-up. The vibe is comfortable and cozy with a cute forest theme, and you can even watch Netflix during your cleaning. Best yet they follow standard pricing for cleanings, x-rays, etc. so I'm not paying anything more than what my standard dental insurance covers. Wouldn't want to go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Dean
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this office. I have been using them for the last 3 years since I moved to Austin. Bedside manner no is amazing and the front fest has been so helpful!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan Moran-Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I loved going to FFD for years, but lately the customer service at the front desks has been lacking.

I tried to get my son an appointment at this location, but the front desk rep said they wouldn't take him until we filled out the HIPPA forms. After asking why they needed me to possibly give up privacy rights (3rd box on the form) and getting the insurance co. involved, the front desk rep was combative with the Blue Cross rep and myself and excused herself from the phone call. Even the BCBS rep called her rude after that, so needless to say I'll have to make the appointment elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juergen A
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a kid I had horrible experiences with a dentist and that still gives me anxiety going to a dentist today. Dr Rick and his staff put those anxieties at ease. Dr Rick is patient, kind, and always explains what he is doing to avoid surprising me and he does excellent work. His staff is very friendly and helpful. I highly recommend Dr Rick and his practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Bonevac
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist and staff I’ve experienced in a long time—maybe ever. Even though I hadn’t been a patient, when a crown popped off, they saw me quickly, discovered the problem, took extra time to deal with it then and there, all without pain, even though a lot of drilling was required. This was more like a spa visit than a trip to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brei Cudworth
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in for a really bad toothache. Dr. Rick made the time to do an extraction right then and there. I had limited funds and my new dental insurance hadn’t kicked in yet so I nervous about the out of pocket costs. Emitt at the front desk was super understanding and walked me through my options until we found something that worked. They didn’t make me wait in pain until I could afford treatment. They always put their patients first. Dr. Rick is far and away the best, most considerate and knowledgeable dentist that I’ve had to date. I drive over 40 minutes to come to THIS office because you can’t beat the staff! 5 stars is not enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Genine Short
user_reviews_extended.Description: I *actually* look forward to going to the dentist. Dr. Rick is the best dentist I have ever had. He was able to take my difficult case and work it into invislign. I was told previously I would need to have four teeth removed+the use of traditional braces. He instead used a technique to slim the teeth to compensate for the overcrowding saving me sanity, time, and surgical intervention. He is a rare, authentic talent to be sure. Just as importantly- The staff is always kind, rising above average service 👏🏻every 👏🏻 time. The combination of a gifted dentist+courteous support staff is all too rare. I can’t recommend this practice enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was thinking I would be there for hours to replace a filling but left very satisfied in less than an hour. Very professional and great customer service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carl Eckhardt
user_reviews_extended.Description: After a rough start dealing with trying to prove I had insurance, it worked out in the end. I can’t leave a bad review the 2nd time, so here’s a new one. Everyone is very nice, professional and conscientious of any fears of pain you may have with overly sensitive teeth. I recommend this company when you want top care. That’s is my experience. Good job, guys(gals)!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barefoot Alley
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a first-time patient, I felt very welcomed! I haven’t been to the dentist in a long time, and I wasn’t shamed or anything of that nature. I am excited to know that I now have an established dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lina Rivas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Finding a great dentist is a challenge.  Look no further, as these guys are amazing!  They truly care about their patients.  I am not particularly thrilled about a trip to the dentist and tend to be a nervous patient.  However, every visit turns into a pleasant experience.  The staff at Forest Family Dentistry are cognizant of their patients’ needs and would make sure you are well looked after.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rajender Tella
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for years now. Always a great experience! All the staff members from front desk, hygienist and doctors are friendly and knowledgeable. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ginger bernartd
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everything about Forest Family is patient oriented.  Dr Rick and his staff have always gone above and beyond to ensure I always get the best care.
I don't hesitate to say he is absolutely the most talented and caring Dentist I have ever been to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Genie Maharaj
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experiences at Family Dentistry on 183 is always wonderful. The front desk associates are  helpful at all times .
It’s always a pleasure meeting BeeTu the hygienist She is friendly and very skillful . She has great patience and makes me feel comfortable with my cleaning.
Richard Donkersgoed is my Dentist. I would gladly recommend him to family and friends. He is an awesome and caring gentleman.He takes the time to get to know his clients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ruba Khan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient for almost 3 years. Everyone at the office is welcoming, understanding and great at what they do. The facility is very clean, and they let you watch Netflix while getting your teeth cleaned! Would recommend to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shayna Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super friendly staff and they're quick and efficient at what they do! During the cleaning, the hygienist asked several times if I was doing okay. They make sure you are comfortable throughout the appointment. I definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heidi Hinterlong
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was very professional and courteous and unlike previous dental offices , I felt encouraged by the treatment plan instead of dreadful. Looking forward to coming back for care

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rikki Gendron
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So many things to mention and since many businesses thrive on reviews, I’m here to give you the nitty gritty! So, my parents neglected my teeth while growing up, they are relatively straight and didn’t cause me problems. Fast forward to becoming an adult and not even knowing where to start I started looking up dentists, by reviews of course, and landed on Forest Family Dentistry. It was because of the rave reviews and convenience in location and hours of operation I decided to go for it!

I went in because I hadn’t seen a dentist since I was kid and the dentist came by the school to do cleanings. I was also experiencing extreme pain, like the kind when your teeth have been neglected for 20+ years. Dr. Rick and all of the staff at FFD were so kind and gentle. They didn’t judge me, they didn’t make snide comments, they never made me feel bad. Just so welcoming and genuine concern for the pain I was experiencing. After my exam and assessment Dr.Rick and his team came up with a dental plan and time frame to have it all completed.

I was seriously so impressed by all of it. The follow up calls, and even a call to tell me insurance covered more of my procedure and offered to refund me or keep the money in my account to use at a later time. Dr. Rick has squeezed me in last minute and even as late as 7pm on a weekday.

I could not be more fortunate to have been placed on Dr. Rick’s schedule my first visit. I count my stars every time I need dental work because I know I am in the best hands and care North Austin has to offer. The cherry on top of it all? They even take babies! So my 16 month old daughter and I get to see the same dentist. Saying I would be heart broken if I ever had to part ways with this office and staff is an understatement.

If you have dental anxiety, are nervous, worried it will break the bank, go to FFD! They will treat you like family and help you find the most cost effective procedures without compromising your care. I could go on and on and recommend this office to everyone. They are simply the best! We love you FFD thank you for being you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassie Caruthers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was a new patient who came in for an emergency appointment for a cracked molar and had a great experience! I was in and out very quickly, the doctor and assistant were great and the receptionist was very friendly! I will definitely be coming back for my routine dental work :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Erickson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a crown break on a weekend and emailed Dr. Rick. He emailed me back personally and within an hour he met me back at his office and fixed my crown! I’ve never felt more comfortable getting work done on my teeth. Not only is he very accommodating, but he’s super funny and kind. I feel very lucky to have Dr. Rick as my dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clean and the staff is amazing kind and take their time and always made sure I was comfortable. I had to get a crown and they made sure it fit just right. I recommend this place to anyone looking for a dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Terry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Rick and my dental hygienist, Jeremiah, gave me hands down the most enjoyable dentist appointment(or any medical appointment, really) of my life- and I'm saying this as someone who went years between dental appointments due to dreading the pain and lectures like I've had before. Jeremiah kept me laughing and at ease throughout the (gentle but thorough) cleaning, and Dr Rick is incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. I never thought I would say this, but I'm actually looking forward to my next appointment with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Prasanna Bhoompally
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a great dentist office. The staff are very nice and friendly. The hygienists are very gentle and made me feel comfortable during my cleaning, x-rays and exam. I highly recommend Forest family dentistry north.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Never Giveup
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was very lucky to have Anne cleaned my teeth tonight @6:20pm on 12/27/2022. She is the best so far I have so many clean teeth with other clinics. Thank you very much for your hard work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arbi Pulaj
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly staff. Dr. Rick will quickly become your friend, and lead you to the best treatment plan. Really liked the state of the art equipment, ceiling netflix, and the appointment process (such as being able to submit ALL forms online). Kudos to this establishment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anny
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just got my teeth cleaned by Hannah and exam done by Dr. Hanak. This office is amazing and the staff is so friendly. I think this is the most thorough dental exam I've ever had. Cant wait to go back and definitely recommending my friends and family here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Cefai
user_reviews_extended.Description: Odd to say this about a visit to the dentist, but I really enjoyed it!  The hygienist was pleasant, gentle AND thorough ( sorry I didn’t get her name), and Dr Pundya did a great job checking my teeth, but what I truly appreciated was her patience and expertise in  explaining what was happening with my teeth - along with my options.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DontHurtMe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven't been to the dentist in a while mainly because my experiences were never pleasant... I mean come on... dentists suck! But wow! When I came in for an exam and checkup I was blown away! The entire staff was awesome, I was completely distracted by the technology and netflix and before I knew it I was done! We went ahead and placed a filling and it was by far the most pleasant experience I have EVER had at a dentist! So much in fact... that I actually liked going and wanted to return! I have another appointment today and I couldn't be more excited to go to the dentist! Who would have thunk it :D

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pahala Hebert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just wow amazing experience! Went here and saw Dr. Rick again (my favorite) had another awesome experience. I was hit as a pedestrian by a car this Wednesday which knocked out my beautiful bridge :/and Dr. Rick made time to see me the very next day! :D I reccomend Forest Family to everyone and tell them about the service being absolutely exceptional. Thanks  again SOoo much for everything you do!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronika Quevedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a great environment! The dental cleanings are quick and painless, and the staff are wonderful. 10/10 would recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience at Forest Family Dentistry. I was in and out so fast. I was concerned about a tooth that might be cracked and Dr. Rick told me there’s nothing to worry about.  It’s nice to go to a dentist that does not suggest unnecessary treatments. Unfortunately those practices are out there.  I trust Forest Family Dentistry implicitly.  Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bethany Viteri
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always positive experiences here. The whole staff is wonderful and welcoming. The office and rooms are clean. They do great work. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paula Nicolini
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Rick is amazing !! Took a same day appointment for my visiting 88 year old mom. He fixed her temporary bridge and included that in the exam fee!! So helpful, gentle, reassuring! My mom called him a miracle worker!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathan Vargo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Forest family dentistry on Research Blvd in Austin is the absolute best. They are very gentle,  very efficient with your time and everyone on the staff is so kind. I switched to them a few years ago, and could not be happier. Most thorough exam and cleaning in the market today by far. Thank you Forest Family Dentistry on Research Blvd for all your help and hard work these past few years!

user_reviews_extended.Name: saranya priyadarshini
user_reviews_extended.Description: They’re great. Kind and professional staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Albert Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everybody was super friendly.  The Doctor was very knowledgeable and made me feel like she had my best interest in mind.  Best Dentist practice I’ve ever been to.  Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr. Rick at Forest Family Dentistry. He’s smart, funny, and cute. He is great during uncomfortable procedures in providing gentle reassurance. I feel that my dental care is in great hands with Dr. Rick. I recommend Forest Family Dentistry to all of my friends... and anyone who will listen.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Ojeda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place. I've been a patient at Forest  Family for over 10 years and I've never had a bad experience. Everyone on staff is friendly and accommodating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia Gagliardi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very pleasant experience here! Andrea, Dr. Pandya, and Gabriella were so helpful and amazing and I am very happy I decided to go to Forest Family Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kirk mancill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Paige did an awesome job cleaning my teeth and convinced me to start using an electric toothbrush!  Always a great experience at Forest Family Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anita
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super friendly staff, Dr. Pandya is the best, professional and I’m very impressed with the quality of material they use. I had some crowns, fillings and new night guard, I highly recommend. Unfortunately they’re not attending my Aetna insurance anymore and I will need to find a new place, I received this notification in the middle of my treatment and they guaranteed me that they would honor and finish according to the initial plan, which they did.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Murphy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had the worst experience I have ever had at a dentist at this location. It's a bummer because I had previously heard good things. The doctor was behind, which is no big deal, so they offered me free teeth whitening for the wait. 35 minutes later they forgot about me, and my gums started burning. I had to get out of my chair to find someone to remove the whitening, but my gums were already burned white with bleach. The doctor finally came in, didnt introduce herself or even greet me, and treated me like I was a number. She then left the room without telling me what work I needed done. Even the assistant seemed a little confused. It wasn't until I got to the front desk that I was told I had some cavities and needed fillings. I was quoted $4,000 for all the work I needed done.

I want to be transparent, I'm writing this post 2 years later only because I finally went back to a new dentist today after the sticker shock of all the work I needed done, covid, loss of job, you know the story. I only needed $1k of work done. When I told the doctor about my previous quote she almost lost it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tirajeh Saadatzadeh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m someone who loves going to the dentist but I really don’t like going to this dentist. The people checking you in are kind enough although it bothers me how pushy they can be about asking (and asking again) you to schedule treatments. That aside, my main issue is how frantic and busy it always feels. You don’t feel like you’re being listened to or taken care of. I’ll repeat the problem over and over to various techs and finally when the dentist comes in, it’s as if no one was listening or conveyed the message. One time I made an appointment for a cleaning and to speak with the dentist about a few things but was discharged without even seeing her because she was too busy. I’ve never had a tooth cleaning after which they dentist didn’t come see me and wrap things up. Maybe I was spoilt at other places and this is the norm? At another appointment I shared that a previous dentist and Endodontist had recommended a root canal on a tooth and asked for a referral (had just moved from another state and because of covid didn’t get a chance to fix it before moving). I felt dismissed when the dentist said that likely wasn’t the issue and more likely it was a bite issue. I actually appreciated that, because she wanted to take a conservative approach first, but the way she went about it was very dismissive of all those who had evaluated the tooth before her and of my specific complaints. Anyway, I ended up getting a root canal three weeks later, after the bite adjustment didn’t do anything, and am now pain free. As a physician I know the importance of listening to your patients and of feeling heard. I just don’t think they do that well here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tila Newbery
user_reviews_extended.Description: So glad to be back. Love this office!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kari Ledgerwood
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The short story: Dr Helmick is absolutely incredible! She’s patient, kind, and thorough.

The long story: I moved in 2017 and started seeing a new dentist (not at Forest Family) near my new house. I went in for a normal cleaning. I didn’t have any issues, so I was surprised to hear that the dentist thought I would need 3 crowns ASAP. I’m no dental expert, so I obliged. Shortly after, my mouth hurt so badly that I could barely eat. I returned multiple times per month for at least 6 months complaining about the soreness and pain. The [old] dentist kept saying the same thing; Everything looks fine. I learned to live with the pain, and got on with my life. Two years later, I was eating lima beans (arguably the softest food on the planet) and could barely chew. I had had enough! I searched Yelp for the best dentist in Austin, and found Forest Family. I made an appointment and was in the office within a few days. I met Dr. Helmick on my first visit, and she immediately made me feel safe and heard. She took the time to talk to me about my concerns. She laid out a treatment plan and was honest about my options. Last week, I completed the plan. This is the first time I’ve been able to chew on both sides of my mouth in over three years! I can’t describe the relief I’m feeling. Dr. Helmick is top notch. If you’re struggling with finding a dentist you can trust, look no further. She’s the one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suz Hindelang
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this dental office and Dr. Rick! It’s run very efficiently with minimal wait. I’ve been coming here for years and I am consistently pleased with the professionalism and courtesy of the experience, customer service, and of course the quality dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: HybridSymbiote
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've since visited a different dental office and they gave me a full check up and dental roadmap of the work I'd need to get into tip top shape. Forest would charge me 20k for everything including a lot of exorbitantly overpriced checkups and a heafty sum just for your dental records. Meanwhile my new dentist is charging me a quarter of what Forest is for everything, there was no egregious prices, they don't charge for your dental records, they didn't take a credit card hostage for payment plans. My previous reservations and fears were realized, and I certainly don't appreciate it.
-
My specific experience at this location that has prompted this review was that I was sent here because my usual doctor was on vacation, and this location was closer to my current home. Cool, more convenient. I went in and spoke with the doctor about a current and serious problem I was having, to which they didn't explain anything and prescribed me some pain medice with no plan on how to move forward- though she *did* give me an updated roadmap for my dental care that was *another* $8,000 on top of my already planned out $20k roadmap. She didn't even look in my mouth other than to look at the bump in my gums I went there for. I had to find out through a friend what it was- an abcess! user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am an older millennial so I will try and frame this review as an engaging description for the younger crowd in case moms and dads out there are trying to connect with their kids and keep teeth healthy.

What up fam! This dental office is really bussin'. Dr. Gubin really knows how to take care of those teeth 6-7 with the rizz. I went in with my insurance card and was told, "no cap" outside two cleanings a year. This morning I wasn't even feeling that skibity but Sabrina made an appearance IRL and really hit the griddy with some lessons on flossing.

In any case if you're feelin' shook about having your teeth looked at... oof, weird flex, but don't be salty. Yeet yourself into this office and keep your teeth looked after.

Ask about curodont (heal your early cavities), redoing your seals as an adult, and fluoride treatment. Take care of your teeth people.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Be cautious about unexpected bills due to out-of-network issues. We were told that basic dental services would cost $0, but later received an unexpected bill of $308 for our child. The office did not properly confirm coverage with our dental insurance before providing treatment. When questioned, their response was that since we signed as the child’s guardian, we are responsible for the charges. Please think carefully before choosing their services.
Response: Management misled us into believing basic services were free. We received a surprise bill, which they could have prevented by informing us of the true cost.

user_reviews_extended.Description: The Staff is friendly and professional!  The Dentist does an OUTSTANDING JOB the first time. I recommend all to come here because they do care about your teeth! Five Star RATING!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing service and very personalized! I appreciate the time given.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophea G.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot say enough good things about Smile Haus! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt welcoming and calming. Not at all like the typical “clinical” vibe you expect at a dentist office.
The staff here are absolute gems. They greet you with genuine smiles, make sure you’re comfortable every step of the way, and never rush you through the process. My dentist took the time to explain everything clearly, answer all my questions, and make sure I fully understood my treatment plan.
What impressed me most was their attention to detail and gentle approach. The entire procedure was pain-free. It’s rare to find a place that blends professionalism, skill, and warmth so perfectly, but Smile Haus does it effortlessly.
If you’re looking for a dental experience that actually makes you look forward to your next appointment, Smile Haus is the place. Five stars all the way!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in for a new patient appointment and had a bunch of checks that were very thorough —what stood out was Carolyn’s excellent dental cleaning. She has a very sure and steady hand which really calmed my nerves! Didn’t hurt a bit which never happens. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Robbins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
To be perfectly open and honest with this review, I came to get my teeth cleaning by the best hygienists I have ever had. She kind respectful and caring and professional in every way. I just would not want anyone else  taking care of teeth cleaning.
I also went in because I had issues with a tooth or two that was going to the skulls of a certified dentist , so I decided to take my chances with smile haus.  I am pleased to report that the dentist was amazing. He did all he could to prevent any stressful pain related to this procedure and was comforting me through the process. His assistant in training was very eager to learn and to make this process easier on me. I want to thank them both for the efforts in caring for my issues. Will be looking forward to my next visit. Thanks to all of you.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Levo and his team are so amazing. I had a great experience with Dr. Levo creating a dental bridge and multiple crowns. As someone who has a complex dental history, I am always very nervous about going to a new dentist. Dr. Levo immediately calmed my nerves and I will never go to anyone else!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Very wonderful kind and explained everything where I can understand. And I love they are open on Saturdays. They also listen to you as the patient as well
