user_reviews_extended.Description: I have dental anxiety; Smile Haus, with their kind and welcoming folks, make you feel comfortable from the waiting room to the final check by the dentist after a cleaning. I have never had an issue getting an appointment and they take really good care. Also I'm terrible at remembering my appointments and they offer text reminders which are a lifesaver!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MoGar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Smile Haus for the very first time, the staff was extremely friendly and willing to walk me through all steps for my first visit. My dental hygienes, Carolyn G. was outstanding and extremely professional. She made me feel safe and was very gentle while she was cleaning my teeth. I will continue to use Smile Haus as it's hard to find a dental hygiens, who is honest and not just out to make a book for the company. The treatment plan I was given is extremely reasonable as the last place that I had been to try to charge me $1600. Their charge was a $175.00 with my insurance that is. I was completely WOWED by the price and the service. Thank you once again, Carolyn, for making my teeth feel wonderful. SEE YOU SOON  TO COMPLETE MY TREATMENT PLAN..

user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an appointment for a root canal, filing and two weeks later my permanent crown. Office is very clean with friendly staff and competent dentists. Would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was a patient of Dr. Potter’s and decided to stay with your office after he retired. I’d really hope my records are still on file (Ashley Lee), considering I’ve had more than $3,000 worth of dental work done there. It’s disappointing to feel like that wasn’t even recognized.

I would give zero stars if I could. I went in for dental work and was never told that this office was out of my insurance network until after treatment had already started. While I was literally sitting in the chair, numbed and unable to really ask questions, I was told I needed over $3,000 worth of work. There was no clear communication or transparency beforehand about costs or coverage. I left feeling taken advantage of and completely blindsided.

If you value honesty and transparency about pricing and insurance, I would strongly recommend going elsewhere.

They kept on hygienists that have been cleaning my teeth for years and the dentists have been kind, caring, skilled professionals. I’ve been as pleased as you possibly can when it comes to having dental work done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Rendon Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very good customer service and explain all aspects of your appointment regarding your dental and plans.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Hutchison
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been to several dentists in Austin, and this is hands down the best. Everyone was kind and personable. And the dentist and hygienist were great—they provided top-level care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas McDonough
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Levo is the only dentist I will go to. I'm a tough case, needing implants, but without implant money. Even though implants are off the table for now, Dr Levo has come up with out of the box ideas to get me to a point where he would want to be, if roles were changed. He takes his time, he's realistic, and he won't push you out of the door if faced with a challenge. I have two partials that you can't notice. At least ten new crowns, not to say even more root canals, broken teeth, numerous bridgework that had failed. I'll stop there, because, yes, there's more lol. I am happy to say that through patience, love, and long bouts of healing, I walked out of my appointment yesterday and without thinking, smiled at my fiance and she broke down engulfed in happy tears. I was finally able to take the deep breath I never thought would happen! My fiance said that I look like a movie star, but with perfect natural teeth! Anyway, that's just one of my stories of how Dr Levo changed my life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Winfrey
user_reviews_extended.Description: My hygienist has been with the office for over 11 years so appreciate the consistency and professionalism.  Nice not to have rotating faces.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Claussen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service and staff. Everyone was so kind and explained everything they were doing each step of the way :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bart Dillard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent doctors and they awnsered all my questions and they even had my crown remain due to a flaw, but they fixed the problem and even gave me a $25 credit for my next visit. Love all the staff! Would definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phil Bui
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a good experience. The staff was friendly and I would definitely go back again

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dental office in the area. I recently moved to the area and was looking for a dental office closer than my previous one. I was a little nervous going in considering I have dental anxiety but I felt welcomed right as I walked in from the front desk. Dr. Levo is very easy going and knowledgeable in what he does which is comforting. Dr. Levo and his staff explained everything clearly and in a way I could understand. I had a great experience here and would highly recommend to anyone looking for a new dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jon Dingman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic experience! I walked right in, was taken care of, and left, efficiently. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neel Perumandla
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing dental office. Staff always made me feel comfortable and was ready to answer any of my concerns.

My procedure went smoothly and they always made sure I felt comfortable throughout the process. Would definitely recommend them to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmin Cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this location! The staff is super friendly, and the environment is comforting and welcoming! My dental hygienist, Nikki, was professional and kind and made my visit excellent and efficient! Meeting Dr. Amante was very pleasant, as he was caring, knowledgeable, and took his time with me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reagan Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was having severe pain in my wisdom teeth and had a friend recommend this location to get them taken out. Although I chose to stay awake for my removal (that’s the only method this place offers btw) I was extremely nervous but Dr. Levi was very comforting and got 3 of my teeth out in 15 mins! The recovery has been amazing with very little pain. Highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sierra South
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are communicative and effective. I appreciate the patience and willingness to adjust to my odd schedule! I’m picky and have been pleased with there services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Quan Ma
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an unexpected dental emergency when I chipped my tooth during a pick-up game. Without an appointment, I walked into Smile Haus, and their response was exceptional. The staff immediately welcomed me and managed to fit me into their schedule.

Dr. Levo provided excellent care, skillfully and kindly fixing my chipped tooth. The professional atmosphere and attentive service were truly impressive.

I highly recommend Smile Haus for anyone in need of urgent dental care. Their ability to deliver top-notch service promptly is commendable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: While I miss Dr Potter and was surprised to hear he retired, he sold his practice to very friendly owners. Finding a friendly, empathic dentist that helps you feel comfortable throughout your visit is not easy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kaylee lewallen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Despite having dental anxiety, my experience with Dr. Levo, his assistant Holly, and dental hygienist Carolyn was truly amazing. From the moment I walked in, they made me feel at ease with their friendly demeanor and professional expertise. Dr. Levo took the time to address all of my concerns. Holly was incredibly supportive throughout the procedure, ensuring I was comfortable. Carolyn provided the best cleaning I've ever had, leaving my teeth feeling amazing. She is gentle and thorough. It was a great experience and I highly recommend Dr. Levo and his team to anyone looking for dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiana Rendon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Smile Haus arboretum has some of the nicest staff. The dentist there are qualified, caring, and gentle. I got my wisdom teeth removed and my dentist was in contact with me throughout my recovery. I am currently doing Invisalign for a great price! Love this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Paddon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I drive all the way from Buda to go to Gateway Dental because they are worth the drive. I have been a patient there nearly a decade. Dr. Potter is always timely and professional. He is also very knowledgeable. Carolyn is also amazing. I don't think she ever has a bad day and if she does, she doesn't show it. She is always so sweet and pleasant. Dr. Potter and Carolyn are both very personable. I don't have a fear of dentist appointments, but if I did I know they would make me feel at ease. The only negative thing I could say was that I had a bad experience with the former office staff. I told Dr. Potter who appreciated the feedback and handled it. The current office staff is great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited Smile Haus Arboretum Dental for a routine exam, and I must say, I am thoroughly impressed with the level of professionalism and care provided by Dr. Levo. He explained each step along the way with clarity and answered any questions I had. Moreover,  the front desk staff were incredibly helpful and accommodating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Sabath
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to smile haus at a different location the one in Georgetown and it was closed so I called the emergency number and Dr. levo staff called me back right away squeezed me in the next day. I was in excruciating pain and they took such good care of me and made sure I was comfortable went at my own pace I don’t have insurance and they worked with me got me out of pain and got me in right away. They are truly an amazing dentist practice with a great staff with wonderful Doctors that are very skilled at what they do. I would highly recommend Smile haus to anybody, especially Dr. Levo . He is amazing thank y’all so much and I look forward to my next visit. I never thought I would say that about a dentist office until I went to a Smile haus!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the biggest toothache on a weekend, they were responsive when most dental offices are close, got me out of pain the same day so the rest of the weekend was not miserable! Forever grateful 🙏

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra F
user_reviews_extended.Description: All the staff are super nice. Dr. Saenz was so professional yet personable and took his time in answering my questions. And the dental hygienist is simply amazing. As I haven't had many dental issues and mostly go for cleanings, she's the main reason I love going to the dentist 😀

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Pothoff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Smile Haus staff has always been professional and courteous. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joelle Cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would give Gateway Dental Group & Dr. James Potter, 5 stars for consistently providing top quality, stellar dental craftsmanship service!  I have been going to Dr. Potter for several years now and he/his office staff operate in a compassionate and professional manner, always. In a single word, the entire staff is phenomenal. All patients are treated with a great sense of humanity and high standard of excellence--with caring, positive attitudes and genuine understanding.  In my particular, complicated case, Dr. Potter has never turned me away and instead, has patiently worked with me to resolve my dental issues. I truly don't know what I would've done without him; kudos to him for helping me when no one else would. His generosity alone speaks volumes about his character....another great feature about them is that: they are open on Saturday! Without reservation, I highly recommend this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raymond Black
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great dentist. Had a chip fixed from when I was a kid and it looks perfect. My wife is not fond of dentists and she likes Dr. Potter.

Update: Dr. Potter retired and sold the practice. The new employees were rude, inefficient, and a poor replacement for what was a great dentist and office staff. I hope Dr. Potter got a ton of cash in the sale.

We left and found a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristina Corbin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough good things about this practice. I had a broken tooth emergency and was in intense pain not responding to over the counter pain relievers. I called before they closed on Friday evening and although they were booked on Saturday they were happy to work me in the following afternoon. I called the following morning and asked them to call me if they had anybody cancel so I could get in earlier. They called me back within 10 minutes and said although they had no cancellation if I wanted to come down immediately they would work me in. Even though they were booked when I arrived at 9am they took me back immediately, did xrays to confirm issue and had the doctor step in to meet me. He immediately gave me a nerve block to stop the pain then had me return to waiting room until he could perform the extraction. They recognized I was in pain and addressed it immediately. Everyone I encountered on the phone and in person from receptionist to nurses and dental assistant was professional and helpful . Although I had never been to this practice Dr. Potter treated me like I was a long term patient. He was very warm and personable and I felt he was concerned about my situation. Everything was explained to me by either the nurse or Dr. Potter and they addressed all my questions. My overall experience was above what I would have expected at a dental office. Once again a good reason to avoid corporate cookie cutter businesses and go local. I will definitely use Gateway Dental as my permanent dentist from here on out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Mellem
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place was amazing! Dr James Potter was absolutely incredible, welcoming me and making me feel comfortable and like I was in good hands from beginning to end. I called for an emergency appointment at 2:30pm, I was in the office by 3:30pm and they had extracted the tooth that had been causing me such extreme pain and had me finished up by 5 o’clock without breaking the bank.
I highly recommend this place to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie LeBlanc
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shopping for the ideal dentist office is hard but I finally found the one! From the front desk, to the hygienist, to the dentist, they are all consistent in providing the best service. They show empathy & understand the importance of showing this trait in this setting. It speaks volumes & I now look forward to going to the dentist! Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kara Spears
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ok, so I just have to say most people hate the dentist. I love my dentist Dr. Potter & his staff. He has never hurt me. Most dentist I have been to when you express pain during a procedure they just keep on going. NOT Dr. Potter he stops gives another injections & then ask if it's better. I trust this dentist with all of my dental work, which is a lot. I've been his patient for several years & would never consider going to anyone else. Oh & did I mention the music his office plays is up to date. No elevator music here. I'm actually looking forward to my next appointment. I'm on my way to a beautiful smile makeover. If you are looking for a great dentist I highly recommend Gateway Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neda Mirmiran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Potter is highly respectable, highly ethical and gentle dentist. Sadly, my experience has been awful with his staff.  I called multiple times to schedule a visit and my call was handled poorly and wasn’t able to make appointment. I have started orthodontic treatment and everything was planned d precisely so I could have my braces placed in 4-7 days after my extraction. I requested time off (unpaid) from work for my extraction appointment at this office and found out they never scheduled me for extraction. My last visit was 7 months ago, they made the appointment for cleaning instead of extraction. The assistant insisted that I need x-rays every year. I keep explaining that it’s only been 7 months since my last cleaning and I don’t want x-ray. I had a comprehensive dental exam at my orthodontist office less than a month ago as well. I have already took time of work and hired sitter for my ortho exam which now has to be scheduled. No respect for my time and no apologies. Not hearing what I’m saying and just keep wanting x-rays. It could be staffing shortages after COVID but a dental office is only as good as it’s weakest staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updated Review: 4 stars
I'm still going here even though Dr. Potter is no longer with them. I miss Dr. Potter. The dental hygienist is awesome. I have a problem with my in-network insurance now, which clearly states that all preventative care is covered 100%. However, it doesn't cover periopicals. This place says they require them. They allowed me to forego them this time, but the expectation is that they're going to require them in the future which means I'll be stuck paying the difference for preventative. They really fought me last time for me to pay and I received some attitude. I said I'd pay, but I'd also leave. So they relented that one time.

Old review: 5 stars
I've been going here for I think ten years and it has been a great experience. He has even found a way to do something special for my newborn babies.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bayleigh Pennington
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is great and so is the staff! Love that they are open on Saturdays because that is usually the only time I am available. I am here for school so my primary dentist is back home, but I came here for the first time when I needed a (sort of) emergency dentist appointment. I now schedule regular cleanings here because this place is great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katelyn Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kwon is so friendly and he takes his time to fully explain next steps and recommendations. The hygienists were compassionate and gentle. The front desk is always happy to explain billing questions and is prompt to respond.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Wheatley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really sm most appreciative that the hygienists and doctor come in on Saturdays. For those of us with strict M-F jobs, that is extremely helpful. I also always know what the prices will be, so there are no surprises. Everyone there, that I have encountered, has been friendly and knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beverly Ferguson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you are looking for staff who genuinely care about your health, please try Gateway Dentistry.   I honestly believe it's because Dr. James Potter treats his staff well that it shows in the way clients are served.  From the moment I walked into that office, during my procedure until its completion, I felt right at home.  I have been a faithful patient for over 5 years.  No pain! No fear! Just sit back and relax.
Once you go, you're wonder why it took so long.  They have Saturday hours too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: rodnica ward
user_reviews_extended.Description: Woke up with a swollen face. I called Dr.Potter for an emergency appointment. The receptionist was able to squeezed me in the same day. He is now going to be my primary dentist. The staff was extremely nice. They made sure I was comfortable. The facility was clean. I am very pleased with the treatment I received.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harmonyjane Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called this office at 9am in the morning because I had just chipped my front tooth the night before, and they scheduled me at 2pm that same day on a SATURDAY. I had called probably 15 other ones before it and most if not all were always closed on Saturday, so getting in a quick appointment for such a cosmetic emergency was amazing to me. All of the staff was incredibly friendly, and while I usually can't stand going to the dentist's office, the doctor here knows what he is doing and how to keep you feeling comfortable. I will definitely be coming back here again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Lawall
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I will be recommending  this practice to everyone I know. Everyone from Dr. Potter to the receptionist was kind and immeasurably helpful. I’m traveling from out of town and my temporary bridge broke last night. I was devastated. They fit me in on Saturday morning 2 hours after I called. He cemented the broken bridge until I can see my dentist back home.
He was professional, reassuring, and it was a very fast procedure. As an added bonus, they accept insurance. Do yourself a favor and, if you’re looking for a dentist, come here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T M
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole office was AMAZING and clean!! Staff was professional, kind and helpful! Dr. Potter was so sweet, courteous, professional yet relaxed, and sincere! I HIGHLY recommend this office. They are open Saturday's which is awesome because I work during the week.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The most anxious patient and the most understanding dentist ever. Dr. Levo is truly amazing and that is short of what he truly is. I am lost for words due to his amazing patience and the true understanding of how dentistry made me feel. I have avoided the dentist for a very long time due to two traumatic services I had with two different dentist, whom I will not name.
I walked in to this lovely office with my nerves almost jumping out of me. I was happy to know that the only treatment I would need is to eventually replace all my amalgam feelings. Carolyn, the awesome hygienist, calmed my anxiety down and reported every second she could to tell me that everything was ok and that I didn’t really need any major treatment. She did my cleaning and had such an amazing ORA.
Then Dr. Levo was invited to my room so that we could chat about a broken filling I had. My anxiety spiked again. But boy, Dr. Levo’s up beat energy sure did calm me down. His bed side manner is immaculate and you do feel welcomed to this lovely family practice he has. He informed me of the treatment I would need for the one broken filling and I proceed to accept treatment right then and there. He made time for me in his short schedule….What Dentist does that?....Dr Levo does.
I explained to him how I have trouble with getting numb and how I have had to be held down for treatment because I could feel each bits of treatment done to me in the past. Dr. Levo said that if at any point I did feel anything he would stop and we would transfer me to his other office to finish treatment which has nitrous. Again….What dentist does that?…DR. Levo, that’s who. He gave my gums ample amount of time to get fully numbed. His Assistant coached me through while the numbing medicine did its thing. He took the time to explain everything as he worked on my mouth. Lest than 30 minutes later he was done. I walked out of his office saying,” I have finally found my dentist. The one who can do all my treatment and my anxiety level can calm down quickly”. He truly is God sent. And he is in the right practice. If you suffer from high anxiety, he is the dentist for you. He listens and does right by you.
Thank you Dr. Levo and Smile Haus Family. I’ll be seeing you in a couple weeks to continue dental work. From one happy and less anxious patient, Liz.

user_reviews_extended.Name: mark permenter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly people, but very efficient and got me out in an acceptable time period.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jazmine Lozano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Levo and team are the best ! They always make me feel at ease when I walk in the office. The comfort care that they give me is 10/10. I would recommend the whole family :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Armando Cardenas (The Moving Guys)
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a very cut rate small dental office.  The staff is quick to book appointments like a conveyor belt system.  That make agreements they do not keep, do not trust the staff. Honestly I mean no disrespect but the actual dentists are mediocre at best.  Very uncomfortable pressing against my lips and no apathy for patients comfort.   My last final appointment I was asked by the actual dentist that the procedure was going to take an hour and if I could come back on a later date!  I was in pain and needed a tooth extracted and I called 2 days in advance!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Volney
user_reviews_extended.Description: I like the staff and all the dental assistants and the lady who cleaned my teeth.  I like Dr Potter he is very kind and gentle.  The one thing I didn't like was they put a wrap around your eyes  so you could not see when the dentist was pulling a tooth.  If a patient says no i don't want that they should listen to the patient and not do it. I hated that and I will never do that again.  I think who ever said this is a good idea in the dental world is crazy.  So maybe if they read this they will listen.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven Grousnick
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found this practice online and was inclined to call in due to their flexible Saturday hours. I scheduled an appointment over the phone; it was a pleasant experience right from the start. On the day of my initial appointment, I was seen within minutes after filling out my paperwork and was very pleased with the entire experience. I am happy to say that this is now my primary dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Janes
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place was a lifeline! They squeezed me in on a Saturday for emergency dental work and were so kind and courteous and did great work. Thank you guys so much!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jean Scheid
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had some tooth pain on a Friday after 5:00 pm and called Gateway (Dr. Potter's office) and they scheduled me for an emergency appointment the next day--on a SATURDAY! First off, the front office staff was amazing and made me feel so welcome. The dental tech was gentle with the x-ray procedure and then when I met Dr. Potter, he was just so soothing. I am SO fearful of dentists and he made me feel not afraid right away. He examined me, found the problem and gave me the right meds to get rid of the infection. I already have a second appointment due for a teeth cleaning so that we can get my mouth healthy and I won't need to have an emergency appointment in the future!. Need a great dentist in Austin? Choose Dr. Potter and Gateway Dental! Oh, also very affordable if you don't have dental insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ethan Borchers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here with my family for many years. Every visit has been a great experience so far! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Crowson
user_reviews_extended.Description: great service with knowledgeable and friendly staff, I’d recommend if you’re looking for a dentist in north austin. 🙂👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brendon Hanly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Potter and his team are awesome!  I've gone to him for several years for regular cleanings and a couple of dental emergencies.  He and his staff have always taken great care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jared
user_reviews_extended.Description: We've been going to Gateway for many years and we've always been pleased by the great work performed by Dr Potter and hygienist Carolyn. From the extremely helpful frontdesk to the time and care they put into your procedure,  Gateway makes the dreaded dentist visit actually pretty decent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Sawa
user_reviews_extended.Description: While brushing my teeth on a Saturday morning I had a (front tooth) crown pop off. I called my dentist but he was out of pocket so I went to the internet. Although there were several dentists who claim that they work on Saturday there were very few who answered their office phones. Out of the few who did, none of them would see me; except one, Dr. Potter. The ladies at the front desk treated me like a million bucks and could not have been nicer or more friendly. Dr. Potter was outstanding!! Incredibly thorough and he treated me like I was most important patient that he ever had. I'm very proud to say I have new dentist; Dr. James  Potter!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shehab Almuslehi
user_reviews_extended.Description: This rate is not for the Dentist, he was great, and office opens Saturdays which is very convenient, the problem with his billing specialist, which keep making wrong estimate. Usually she come with estimate for me to sign and approve before any treatment! To show me how much I should pay for that visit. Out of sudden, I received 3 clams from my insurance with totally unexpected bill  of $ 716.51. which I should pay now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rey Aponte
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really appreciated the good work and experience of this group. Took me a long time to find a Dental place like this.

user_reviews_extended.Name: suha Qasas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been with this place for 7 years. Eventhough , they team has changed over a year ago I still feel comfortable going there.  Friendly team
A good dentist and a great communication 👌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deanna Batsoutenko
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Smile Haus and its staff was incredible!  They got me in quickly, were friendly and able to schedule an appointment for necessary work.  Highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessicea Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: This by far was one of my favorite experiences dealing with my dental needs.  Dr. Levo and his awesomely knowledgeable assistant, Sheena(I  hope I spelled it correctly) made me feel so comfortable and answered all of my questions. I really thought she was a dentist bc of her knowledge and confidence. Thanks again

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mesha G
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend. The staff was nice and kind. The environment was so welcoming. The dentist and assistants were awesome in explaining procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Wilder
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Potter’s dental team is patient and willing to listen to your concerns to make sure you feel as though you’ve been heard. They display professionalism, as well as charm and that’s what makes me return here over and over. Any procedure or major dental work I have received here has been comfortable and has eased my fears of the dentist all together lol. I used to hate going to the dentist. The people that work in this office have changed that for me, especially Dr. Potter. If you want to keep your teeth, I recommend Gateway Dental lol. And that’s to any and everyone! P.S. Melissa is crazy as h*ll. Schedule your appointment with her. LOL!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent service! Fast, no pain, informed me of everything, and worked to meet my schedule.

Cannot recommend them more! So thankful for the team and their help!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Kent
user_reviews_extended.Description: Did not feel any pain at all everybody was nice and professional

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Burns
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great location, plenty of parking. Nice and very clean waiting area. Have had the same gentle dental  hygienist last three visits. Quick and easy check-out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Silva
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff! Dr. Levo explains everything in great detail, and hygienist Carolyn is always very informative and friendly! Recommending Smile Haus to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clay R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have going here for a while now. Great staff that is always courteous and helpful. Dr. Potter is a real cool down to earth guy that does great work. Bonus they are open on Saturdays!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Foos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in with some problems, and Dr. Potter gave me some great options I hadn't heard elsewhere. Front desk, assistants, hygienists, all great, all have been there a while, must be a good place to work too. I'm back on track, and finally getting everything resolved.

user_reviews_extended.Name: José Laya
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and professional staff. Would recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ndidi Nwakalor
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t think doctors remember that as they are used to procedures; patients are not. I recommend Dr. Potter be more sensitive to reactions to pain. When I accidentally bit him: he jumped up and said “ouch” which shows me that he has a natural reaction to pain as well, as I was trying to explain just the minute before. So as calm as I was, I made noise & a small jerk. Now he understood how it felt. So if I’m in pain; don’t judge! I don’t even feel like going back honestly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Tops
user_reviews_extended.Description:
For all the fella’s if your scared of dentist, like I was. Hands down guarantee Dr. Potter will change your thoughts. Serious.. I made a huge mistake doing all my dental while on vacation in another country.
Yup, I’m doing it all over again now. There is no worrying about when will I feel pain, and getting all tensed up about it. Yeah, ok everyone gets nervous.. Here is a hint ... talk too Dr. Potter and he will take care of you.

I have been through lots of root canals, which I’m super happy his miracle hands could save them. I won’t go to any other dentist. Dr. Potter is the Best in my mind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ibrahim Allam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Potter and his staff are amazing. They do great work and are very attentive to all your dental needs. They make the dentist visit a breeze. I highly recommend.

title: North Austin Dentistry
address: 6850 Austin Center Blvd #310, Austin, TX 78731, United States

user_reviews.Name: Sylvia Stacy
user_reviews.Description:
I was so lucky to have found Dr. Logan Miller I just left his office great service!!!! Had my teeth clean staff is awesome all the staff! Very professional all of them❤️❤️❤️
Dr. Miller is great he takes he’s time listens to you and hears and answers all your questions! I’m out of words just so blessed to have finally find a great dentist! Everybody treats you like family and they know your name when you come in I love that the staff and Dr. miller takes the time to listen to your needs❤️I highly recommend Dr. Miller if your looking for a dentist go for a consultant meet him in person you won’t regret it he will listen to you answer your questions if he can’t answer your questions he’ll find a answer ! He will take good care of you and all your family❤️Thank you Dr. Miller see you in six months👍

user_reviews.Name: jay l
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been shopping for a dentist for years and finally found a home! I LOVE Dr. Miller’s office so bad! His entire staff is so friendly and welcoming. I’m extremely happy and confident in our future treatment plan, as well as with the work I’ve had done so far. 10/10 highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Missy Minjarez
user_reviews.Description: Considering going to the dentist is never fun, coming to North Austin dentistry has helped me with my fears of going to the dentist. The girls at the front are so nice and friendly and helpful. Savannah explained everything in detail and was very patient while I asked questions. Christine was very helpful as well. They just give you a nice calm welcoming vibe. The assistants will hold your hand and pat your shoulder or whatever you need to calm you while you're getting that numbing medication. Aliyah was my assistant and and make sure that I was very comfortable. That's the part that scares me the most and it wasn't that bad at all..  Dr Miller is exceptional. He takes his time to talk with you to develop a plan for your future needs as well as listen to all your concerns you have at the moment. He explains everything in detail and sits with you as long as it needs to make sure it all makes sense. I will continue coming back. Oh by the way, the lobby is beautiful, comfortable and I love the kids nook along with the beautiful views from the rooms.

user_reviews.Name: T. J. Wolfe
user_reviews.Description: The entire office staff and assistants are always friendly and helpful. Dr Small was knowledgeable, caring, and informative about current and follow up treatment. I can’t say enough about Dr Logan, who was the first dentist I had the pleasure of working with. He’s kind, funny and knows his dentistry. I highly recommend North Austin Dentistry. Definitely 5 stars to this Dental Office!

user_reviews.Name: Bev Ra
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been going to this dentist office for over 5 years now and they are wonderful. I found them when I was in an emergency situation with a broken tooth, and my teeth were a disaster overall. Dr Miller saved that tooth and fixed up a couple of others that were going south. I’m now settled in there with my regular hygienist, Leo, who really seems to care, offers great oral care advice, and is genuinely excited as my teeth have improved and are being well maintained. Their entire staff is very friendly. Thank you, North Austin Dentistry!
From Beverly B.

user_reviews.Name: Rotem Grinberg
user_reviews.Description: I had such an amazing experience at this dental clinic! Everyone was super professional, kind, and welcoming. Leo took care of me — he was absolutely fantastic! So gentle, patient, and made sure I was comfortable the entire time. It’s rare to find someone who combines skill and genuine care like that. Highly recommend this place and especially Leo — 10/10!

user_reviews.Name: Aliyah
user_reviews.Description: Most people think of the dentist as just another chore, but North Austin Dentistry truly changes that experience. From the moment you walk in, the team makes everything feel easy and welcoming. This was only my second visit with Kelyn for a cleaning, yet she still remembered me! She’s fast, thorough, and always makes sure I’m comfortable throughout the process. I also had the chance to meet Dr. Smalls today—friendly, skilled, and great at putting patients at ease. I really appreciate how calm the office feels and that I never feel judged for asking questions. Thank you for making dental care something I actually look forward to!

user_reviews.Name: Henry Shepard
user_reviews.Description: North Austin Dentistry offers surperb dental services with friendly staff. I experienced a dental emergency when my in-mouth retainer broke off and Dr. Miller squeezed me in with little hassle to fix it. Since then, I've been attending for my year check ups with Leo, my hygienist who is always friendly and helpful with reminding me to floss regularly. Very good service, I highly recommend.

Had to get a root canal (yikes) but had an absolutely stellar experience here. Have never felt more comfortable at a dentist prior to this, and this should be the standard of professionalism that every practice aims for. Shockingly affordable with my insurance too. 10/10 fantastic dentist, would highly recommend especially if you're getting something done that will take a few hours.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Always pleased w my visits to this dentistry! I had the privilege of meeting Leo & Deanna. Leo gave me very good advice of taking extra care of my teeth, which is a plus bc of all the years of done cleaning this was my first time receiving this advice and benefit to my health!
Dr. Deanna smalls is very kind and gives a welcoming heart. Thank you Dr. miller for your office and team, god has blessed you guys so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelton H Bloxham
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is amazing! From the front desk to the dentists, everyone is so kind, accommodating, and caring. They always keep patients’ well-being front and center. Leo, my hygienist, is the best — we always have great conversations! I’ll definitely be staying with this clinic as long as possible!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Navarrete
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have loved coming here. I have dental anxiety and they have done a great job. I had a good amount of typical work done and it’s been easy breezy. Leo has been a great technician and the dentists have been really nice and clear.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hadassah Lerner
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental clinic is in an excellent location with plenty of parking. It is beautifully designed and very clean. They are always on time (which is very important to me) and provide quick responses. The staff is extremely kind and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yessica Aranda
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a patient of Dr. Miller since 2019, I can always trust that me and my family are in good hands. Val is the sweetest and Leo’s demeanor will make you feel very at ease while getting your teeth cleaned!
And I can’t forget to mention Savannah and Lindsey, providing friendly service all around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just had some work done and those are never fun but the sweetest and most calming assistant, Aaliyah, made this appointment so much better. Dr Miller did great too :) next day I barely had any swelling and didn’t have to take meds the day after. Thank you Aaliyah for making a not so fun visit into a piece of cake ! 🥰

PS I love the playlists 🥰

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Connell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to North Austin Dentistry for the past two years and have always received excellent care. The office staff, hygienists, and doctors have all been wonderful. I have to rave about the results of the internal bleaching procedure Dr. Miller did! I have a front tooth with a root canal, it’s still my natural tooth, and it had started to darken again years after I had internal bleaching done the first time. I was starting to feel self-conscious of my smile, and especially in photos. But look at my tooth now! (Note: I’m an amateur phone photographer and I didn’t edit or alter these photos). Somehow all of my teeth look brighter in the after photo 😁

I’m just ecstatic that my two front teeth are matching again! The procedure was quick and painless and these incredible results were achieved with only with only one course of treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Archit Bhise
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Awesome experience with Leo and the team at North Austin Dentistry!

Everyone was super friendly and made me feel comfortable from start to finish. Leo was fantastic, thorough, and explained everything clearly.

The office is clean, modern, and runs on time. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ori Abesera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Don’t go near this place, I scheduled an exam and teeth cleaning, when I finished the exam they recommended to schedule a deep cleaning another time instead of regular cleaning today (my previous 2 dentist said I didn’t need it) after I refused and asked to do the basic cleaning today as scheduled the oral hygienist basically just brushed my teeth for 2 min and said we’re done, no teeth cleaning was performed

user_reviews_extended.Name: kenadie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wasn’t thrilled to find out I had a cavity because I have a HUGE fear of needles and I knew I would need a shot. Dr. Halloum and the assistant, Val helped calm my nerves and had some kind of trick that distracted me! It was literally the easiest injection I’ve ever had! I actually said “was that it?!” Also, thank you to Kerri and the front desk ladies who worked with my schedule as I had to come back from College Station to get treatment! Now, I’m not quite as nervous to get my wisdom teeth out! Thank you North Austin Dentistry!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Felicia
user_reviews_extended.Description: North Austin Dentistry is absolutely amazing! They always go above and beyond to make sure you are comfortable and that you understand everything happening. They are great at getting you scheduled and are always on time! Special thank you to Ms. Savannah for always being so kind, helpful and making me smile!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peace 1
user_reviews_extended.Description: I started going to this dentist about a year ago, I absolutely love this dentist, with my last dentist I would wake up dreading a simple death cleaning. North Austin dentist has helped me a ton with my dental anxiety, they take my anxiety seriously and don’t make me feel bad for feeling anxious, I highly suggest going to this dentist, Dr. miller is a very kind and considerate dentist. They also are very responsive about asking questions or needing to call for whatever reason -River aka Abigail Witt

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blaine MacMorran
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best dental experience I’ve had! The staff is friendly and personable. I’d especially like to thank Leo for always doing a great job! He makes sure I’m comfortable and well informed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalia Coronado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an easy and fast cleaning with Leo and could tell he genuinely cared about my teeth health! Kerri was also so great and helpful with helping me take the next steps in my appointments! All around great staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kennedi Laur
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was very clear and communicative and made sure I knew my options as far as sedation. They were accommodating and I would recommend them for your wisdom tooth needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren McLaughlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Started coming here when I had a tooth break almost two years ago, they were the first place I called and happened to have availability right away. The whole experience was great and I’ve been coming here ever since. Dr. Miller is great and ask for Leo to be your hygienist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: SangHyun Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best dental care at North Austin Dentistry! Dr. Miller and the team were very caring and accommodating with my situation of no dental insurance (but dental saving plan) when I visited there for wisdom tooth removal which was in urgency. Dr. Miller was very understadning about my situation and I was able to get a great discount for the wisdom tooth removal. Since then, I visited there until I left Austin for a new job and also recommended this place to friends. Every visits to here were very pleasant and welcoming. Thank you so much for great dental care experience for 5-6 years ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: A. “Locke” M.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful and caring, my dentist helps me feel less ashamed of my care and is helpful with tips in how to take care of my teeth - as I am not the best. Comfortable and safe, no judgement to any questions you may have it feels.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ahmed Jalil
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a very bad experience at this dental office. They extracted my tooth but left broken pieces/root fragments inside my gum, which caused pain and complications afterward.

The quality of work was very poor, with no proper care, responsibility, or follow-up.

I do not recommend this place to anyone. This review reflects my personal experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tristan Valadez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience at north Austin dentistry ! From the moment I walked in, the receptionist made me feel so welcome by the front desk Savannah and Christine . She was incredibly friendly, professional, and organized—answering all my questions with a warm smile and helping me through the check-in process quickly and smoothly. It’s clear she truly cares about the patients and keeps everything running efficiently. Her positive attitude set the tone for the entire visit. The rest of the staff was just as kind and helpful, making this one of the most comfortable dental appointments I’ve ever had. Highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zoe Kennedy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I definitely found my go to dentist - everyone was super friendly and Dr. Miller is very honest about what needs to be done. I have a lot of dental anxiety and they take all my concerns very seriously and provide some great options on care. Super nice staff all around, they definitely help me get into the office (which is often the hardest part for me)!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caroline Guérin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome service and staff, as usual! I'm always happy to come back and see Leo :) Today I got the time mixed up by accident but the receptionist was able to save the day by moving things around. Super friendly team. Can't recommend enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Grace
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love coming here because the environment is comfortable and the staff is friendly. Leo helps my dental anxiety and makes the experience great. Thanks North Austin Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Colleen Yard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place! Always efficient, friendly and I’ve never had any insurance/ billing issues. Larraine is the technician I usually see and she is always careful, kind and efficient. I’d give them 10 stars if I could!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachael Bullock
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Where do I start? My first visit here was for a teeth cleaning with Caesar, and he was absolutely incredible! We immediately connected and had a great conversation during one of the easiest and most gentle cleanings I’ve ever had.

When I discovered I had a small cavity, I returned for a filling with Dr. Halloon (pronounced like “balloon”), who was equally amazing. She was lighthearted and helped keep my anxiety low throughout the procedure. I would gladly recommend her for children as well—she has wonderful tips and tricks to keep kids comfortable and smiling. She completed my filling in just 15 minutes and did an excellent job.

This is, without a doubt, the best dental care I’ve experienced in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miso Phish
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been seeing Dr. Miller now for about two years and I am beyond satisfied. His entire team is always so nice. They’re good about scheduling everything and keeping up with your appointments. He’s replaced the crown on me as well as an implant both look great anytime there have been any concerns he addressed them right away. I highly recommend him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucas Chau
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved my dental office prior to moving to Austin and was pleasantly surprised to have stumbled upon one that I think I will love even more! Kelyn did my cleaning and was extremely thorough as well as gentle. She did a great job communicating what she was doing as well and made great suggestions regarding preventative care. Dr. Smalls was my dentist and was extremely welcoming. Will be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Leverett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience with Kelyn! She was incredibly kind, had great attention to detail, and made the whole appointment so comfortable. The cleaning was thorough and left my teeth feeling fantastic. I really appreciated her professionalism and how genuinely nice she was throughout the visit. Highly recommend seeing Kelyn if you’re looking for a great dental experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Blickman
user_reviews_extended.Description: North Austin Dentistry is the best, they’re always on-time, send text appt reminders, and my man Leo has the gentlest touch! Highly recommend if you’re new to town or looking for a new office that accepts BlueCross BlueShield (BCBS)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Timothy Broere
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here was amazing. I came here with extreme anxiety about my teeth and everyone was really patient with me. I also had a tooth infection and they took the extra time to get my the liquid version of my medication as I'm terrified of pills lol. Thank you all ♥️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zandra Araujo
user_reviews_extended.Description: North Austin Dentistry has the best staff. They are so kind even though Leo told me not so great news about my teeth he did it in the kindest way possible. ;)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Brewster
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional, prompt, courteous and polite, what more could you ask for from a dentist? From the front desk to the back office the service was impeccable. Hadn't been to the dentist in years so naturally I was beyond nervous about my first appointment, but Dr. Halloum and Jonalyn made everything so simple. They took me in, and within a week after the appointment their suggestions and recommendations led to a dramatic difference in my dental health. Can't recommend this practice enough. Thank you Dr. Halloum and Jonalyn!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barbara Moazzam
user_reviews_extended.Description: North Austin Dentistry is not the closest practice to where I live but it is worth the journey. The offices are beautiful and very relaxing, the staff are friendly and welcoming and the work I have had done is superior. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ja'Net Mitchell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is my second review for North Austin dentistry. This has been my dental home for over two years. I recently had 3 wisdom teeth removed, and when I tell you Dr. Miller's hands are blessed, they are. He is highly skilled in the art of dentistry.  I felt little to no pain during the procedure, and I am on day two of recovery, and so far so good. I highly recommend this dentist's office from the front door to the back office. This place is awesome! The front desk staff are very kind and ready to assist with payments promptly. Thank you guys!!!

Update: I still feel the same way. My teeth were cleaned today! No cavities thankfully. It was a pleasure seeing Dr. Miller today. He is always pleasant. Of course, the ladies at the front desk are always a delight.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Dang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been a patient at North Austin Dentistry with Dr. Miller since 2020, when I had my wisdom teeth removed, and I've continued to trust them for all my routine dental care ever since. My routine cleaning appointments with all the dental hygienists have been exceptional!
The new office space is welcoming, and staff is consistently friendly and professional. My recent visit with dental hygienist Leo was great! He is detail-oriented, thorough, gentle and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire visit. He explained everything clearly and took the time to make sure we have a good dental hygiene plan! My teeth feel super clean, and I truly appreciate the high level of care I always receive here.
Highly recommend this office for anyone looking for quality dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Ehmling
user_reviews_extended.Description: Leo is amazing! Very gentle but through cleaning. I would recommend North Austin Dentistry, especially since I am not a fan of going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carly Pinsonneault
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I originally went here to get a second opinion but will be returning for all future appointments!
Christine and Savannah at the front were super welcoming and helpful over the phone when scheduling and describing my issues.
Alia, my dental assistant was very communicative about what she was doing and why throughout the appointment. The team overall made it a very comfortable appointment and felt like I was hanging with friends and family. You can tell they all enjoy their job and the people they work with.
Dr. Mahmoud was also very thorough when looking at my teeth, she addressed all of my concerns and showed me pictures of my teeth to better explain these concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Vasquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great visit at the dentist today! Leo was awesome with my cleaning - definitely one of the best I've had in a while. Christine made dealing with insurance stuff actually painless (who knew that was possible?), and Kerri at the front desk was super friendly and helpful getting me scheduled. Really happy I found this place - the whole team made me feel comfortable and took great care of me. Definitely coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lina Alyse
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience with Dr. Mahmoud and the front desk/dental assistants for my wisdom teeth removal. From the moment I walked into the office, I felt welcomed and at ease. The staff was friendly and professional, Dr. Mahmoud took the time to explain the entire procedure in detail, making sure all my questions were answered. The surgery went smoothly and she made sure I felt comfortable the whole time. The recovery process was quick. I appreciated the post-op instructions, which made healing easier. The whole process exceeded my expectations, and I’m so glad I chose this practice for my dental care. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicholas Winborn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to this dentist for 5 years now and have always been very impressed with their service and staff. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Later
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My daughter who is 9 had a few cavities. She has a sensory disorder so I was a bit nervous but Dr. Miller made it extremely easy. She had an incredible experience. He communicated clearly the entire time and used fun phrases for her to understand. She experienced zero pain and had no complaints! Everyone was so patient and kind! I recommend 100%!

I also got my teeth whitened there with zoom and my teeth have never been whiter! Dr. miller even took time to follow up the next day with me to see how I was doing. Seriously, the best dentist and dental staff ever!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marina C.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Logan Miller is an excellent dentist, and he has the loveliest staff. The office manager Lindsey is fantastic, so are all his very kind and friendly dental assistants.

My husband and I have been patients at North Austin Dentistry since 2017. Over the past three years I needed one minor repair when I broke a small piece out of my front tooth, which you can’t tell at all that there has been any damage, because of the terrific job Dr. Miller did. I also see him for the regular cleanings, which are always done very thoroughly.

This time I had to get my first crown in a lower back tooth. Dr. Miller did a fantastic job! He uses state-of-the-art technology (Sirona), and therefore it is all done in one procedure. Not like in the old days when it usually took three visits for the preparation of the tooth, the dental casts (where you had to bite in that horrific paste) and then for the actual crown getting placed and fitted.

Dr. Miller uses a computer program that creates the model of the crown, then he makes it in his practice and fits it -- all in one visit! The crown itself is ceramic and fits so well that I can’t tell any difference in my bite. The new tooth/the crown itself actually feels super nice and smooth and looks much better than my own old tooth.

Dr. Miller makes sure you don’t experience any pain. Before the numbing a topical anesthesia is applied so that the injection is very bearable. The amount of numbness was perfect, too, since it already wore off on my way home. I didn't have any soreness the next day either. Believe me, I don't enjoy dentist visits at all, but Dr. Miller and his staff make it the most enjoyable possible. I really appreciate Logan’s friendly, calm demeanor, and he has a great sense of humor, too.

Best dentist and crew in town!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monique V.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at north Austin dentistry is so kind and happy to help with any questions or concerns you have. I had 3 of my wisdom teeth extracted today and was very anxious to have this done. I was awake for the procedure but was given medication beforehand to help my anxiety and it made me feel sleepy and relaxed. I was also given local anesthetic plus nitrous gas. The dental assistant was great and patted me to distract me from everything going on and it honestly helped a lot and was comforting!! She played music for me and made sure I was comfortable 100% of the time. She was so sweet! When Dr. Miller came in he was thorough and quick. I will admit, it did feel a little intimidating to feel a tool in your mouth prying and tugging but it was NEVER once painful. It was just a new feeling I hadn’t experienced before but it was over in just a few quick seconds. Dr. Miller was amazing at talking me through it and letting me know when each tooth was out. I did not need stitches and recovery has been great so far! I’ve just been at home taking naps on and off with no swelling. It was really no big deal and if I had to it all over again I would with this team bc I know I’m in good hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liandra
user_reviews_extended.Description: The hygienist definitely go above and beyond ! I’ve never had such thorough cleanings before coming to this office ! Dr. Miller is awesome and is very straightforward with any questions I have. I’ve only had a couple fillings done at this office and they did an awesome job. I did opt to get my wisdom teeth removed from a different facility due to pricing, but that may have been due to my insurance coverage. I highly recommend this office to anyone looking for an honest team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina “H.”
user_reviews_extended.Description: I needed an emergency appt on a Saturday and they were able to accommodate me quickly.  Dr Halloum was wonderful!  She went above and beyond to answer my questions.  I was in and out and was extremely happy with her work and the customer service of the office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor L
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve never had a more unpleasant dental experience than this one. I was searching for a practice that accommodated my work schedule. I visited for a filling in January 2023 and Dr. Miller removed a significant portion of my tooth. Upon returning to my car, I realized it didn’t resemble my tooth at all. I was upset and asked for  any possible solution.

Dr. Miller responded defensively, stating that I couldn’t expect to have a portion of my tooth removed and have it perfectly restored.

I told him that I would just go back to my former dentist ( Dr. Buckingham)  to have it repaired.

Dr. Miller eventually fixed the issue, he made it clear that I was the problem in this situation.

To be honest, I was traumatized by that dental experience. I’ve been going to the dentist my entire life and have never had a  bad experience until this one.

Upon returning to my former dentist (Dr. Buckingham), the  previously restored filling required further attention and repair.

Perhaps Dr. Miller was having a bad day, but it was an extremely distressing and traumatic experience for me. This encounter has left me with anxiety about having any dental work done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Dixon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience with Dr. Halloum and Larraine. I definitely have some dental anxiety and they put me at ease right away. Dr. Halloum is very thorough and gave me some thoughtful recommendations that I felt went above and beyond for my teeth sensitivity. I’m glad I have a team I can trust from here on out.

As a healthcare provider myself I was so happy that North Austin Denistry offers Saturday appointments. This was just what I needed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Gilbert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clean office, welcoming and friendly atmosphere. Dr. Miller is exceptional - so knowledgeable, attentive and genuinely caring. His Dental Hygienist Leo is amazing too - super efficient, friendly, personable and made sure I was comfortable! Recommend these two for anyone looking for top-notch dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Ulrich
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience here with Dr. Miller! The entire team was so caring and friendly. They made sure I was comfortable throughout my experience. I came in to check on my wisdom teeth and make sure there weren’t any major complications. I ended getting them removed that same appointment (numbing only, not anesthesia). Dr. Miller was just so thorough and so amazing. My teeth were out in 15 minutes. I’m so happy I found my new regular dentist here in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: sumedha ramanan
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is truly the friendliest dental office in Austin, and every visit is such a positive experience! From the moment you walk in, the receptionist greets you by name, instantly making you feel welcome. Dr. Miller always takes the time to have a personal chat before you leave, talking about more than just dental health, which makes every visit feel so much more personable. I’m especially grateful for my hygienist, Leo—he’s incredibly gentle, empathetic, and thorough with every cleaning. His non-judgmental and encouraging attitude really makes a difference, turning what could be a stressful experience into something I actually look forward to. It’s clear that everyone here truly cares about their patients, and it shows in everything they do! About the results, they go the extra mile. They know that patients don’t know what can and cannot be fixed, they’ll fix it for you without you having to ask.

user_reviews_extended.Name: SPAMMER SPAM
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The best dental care in and around North Austin. People are so friendly, welcoming, and especially they treat you like a child (very sensitive and caring), they do the work very patiently and Doctor Miller guided us really well. His expertise is really helpful.

I would definitely recommend and must visit them for your dental care. One stop solution for all your dental issues.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johnny
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had two deep cleanings with Leo. He is professional while at the same time personable. I trust his knowledge and attention to detail. Lindsey has been very helpful and communicative regarding insurance and treatment plans. I look forward to my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ian Wibbenmeyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Emma here, North Austin Dentistry SLAPS!!! no cap… Leo is Bussin😍🤓 my teeth are brighter and whiter now… 😬 Love y’all, Thank you!!! See you soon<3

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Fojtasek
user_reviews_extended.Description:
if you want professional dental treatment in a lovely place don’t hesitate to make an appointment. They are very accommodating to people with high anxiety & nervousness - they reassure you at all times & have several options. They can give you a comprehensive assessment and make a treatment plan. when you go, make sure you are prepared to find the building as it somewhat hides in trees especially if you have early dark hours appointment. a straightforward pleasant experience for what it was,

------
just wanted to review again and say, Leo has a very gentle mannerism compared to many others so I recommend him for cleaning and also for his cheerful demeanor and efficiency.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Breier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Leo as my hygienist is fantastic! Second time I have been under their care and the stain removal is impressive. It looks like I had an at home whitening treatment done with excellent results. Super happy with the new location as well- more modern.  Thanks North Austin Dentistry! Also appreciate the friendly receptionists- always welcome you by name- makes a person feel real special⭐️.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caiden Westphal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the staff and all the Dr.s. I feel comfortable knowing I’m getting the best care and service at North Austin Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arle Melo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Dr. Miller for years and he is a wonderful dentist. I’ve referred my family and friends and we all agree he’s the best in town.

Shout out to Leo the hygienist  as well. Every cleaning is thorough and discomfort free. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alanis Sakuma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Office is very clean and staff are very friendly! I had an amazing experience at my last cleaning with my hygienist Leo. Looking forward to my next cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Cortez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a root canal done with Dr. Miller back in December of 2018 (At that time yes I was an employee) He did filed the root canal to my previous employers insurance because at that time I was still covered. But he also filed a cleaning (which I never received) that he was paid for. Fast forward to now...I had to have a retreat done on that same tooth, because I developed an infection in it. Dr. Miller only filled 3 of the canals, not 4. And an instrument was also broken off in another canal. I do have X-rays of it. So just please be careful when choosing dentists!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Armando Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a four-root molar pulled-zero pain after. Walked out amazed and healing fast. Great doc, great team, and they treated me like a king, even though I'm just a regular guy. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor L
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had trouble finding a dental practice that I loved after moving to Austin, but North Austin Dentistry has surpassed my expectations. The staff are all friendly and welcoming. The place itself is such a clean establishment and even though I do self-pay, it’s inexpensive with great quality of work. The staff work with me to make sure I am aware of upcoming payments and will do everything to accommodate to my schedule. I would highly recommend this practice for people who are anxious, as they couldn’t be more comforting!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist in too the staff is great my hygienist Daniel is awesome and doctor miller never dose procedures he doesn’t think you actually need been coming for 8 years and will keep going

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lyla Shi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience, super friendly and professional staff! Leo was fantastic! He is gentle, patient, and thorough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yazzy
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are super sweet, and they take care of you well! 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia D
user_reviews_extended.Description: I thought the cleaning was gentle and they explained everything well, the appointments do run a little long but overall very happy with my new dentist !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Em Menou
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have a severe phobia of dentists. The entire staff was awesome. Everyone was kind and patient with me, and, most importantly, understanding. Dr. Miller was gentle and caring, and it's comforting to finally have found a dentist I genuinely like and trust. Highly recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlene Stewart
user_reviews_extended.Description: I felt so welcomed from the moment I walked in the building everybody was so nice and eager to help me when I met Dr. Miller amazing I knew I was in good hands thank you for all your hard work. I have a smile back now.Thank you for Helping me with my SMILE so amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alana Wilmore
user_reviews_extended.Description: My hygienist, Leo, is always very light-handed, and takes his time to clean my teeth. I always leave my appointments with a huge smile because of how amazing my teeth look after their cleaning. Dr. Miller always makes sure to thoroughly examine my teeth & cares to explain what he is seeing & what to do to care for my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathie Cude
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctors and staff at North Austin Dentistry make you feel comfortable, whether you are there for a routine checkup or need more extensive work. They also use the latest technology.  I had to have an old crown replaced and the entire procedure was done in a couple of hours.  There was no temporary crown and then make another appointment for the permanent tooth to be put on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Valadez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had not been to the dentist in years. My teeth have been a very sensitive subject for me since I was a young adult. From start to finish, the team at North Austin Dentistry has made me feel super comfortable and heard. Savannah and Lindsey the moment I walk in the door to Lorraine and Dr. Miller in the exam room have worked WONDERS for my comfort and SMILE. Two visits in and I am already seeing a major difference and am excited for the treatment plan they have set in place. The sense of urgency but calm and reassurance they provide has made me more enthusiastic about it all! Thank you to the wonderful team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went here because I'm new to town and they had hours that fit my schedule. Everyone was extremely nice, however, the skill and techniques here are not that great.

The hygienist was extremely rough with my gums. They did not polish the top of my molars (my old dentist always did). I noticed one of my veneers was scrapped from when they were cleaning between the teeth and scraping for plaque. I'm extremely mad about that. Like you can see the dent in between the teeth when you look at it and when flossing, the floss gets stuck in the dent. They also knew about the veneers because they took xrays and I told them about the veneers. The hygienist probably didn't even know they scrapped my veneers because they made my gums bleed a lot and didn't even both rinsing the blood off before letting me see my teeth. Like that was extremely shocking. I've never had that experience before in my life.

Also, when I got home the gum part of where my wisdom tooth would've been was scrapped on the bottom. They were working on repairing a chipped filling on my tooth... If they accidentally scrapped me while I was numb, they should've told me. I didn't notice it until I got home and numbness went away. For a while I thought it was just swore because of the intense cleaning that the hygienist did. It is a noticeable scrap and in a place where no work was done. Again, they should've told me and put ointment on it or something!

I also don't think the filling was done very well. It is fine for right now but it is shaved down right to my gum line. It seems more like a temporary filling rather than a permanent one.

Edit: It's been a week and the injury hasn't heeled and I haven't able to eat on that side at all...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lara
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently got fillings done here and now I cannot eat with the right side of my mouth, drink or eat anything cold. I had NO Pain in the area of cavities before hand. When I went back to get rechecked Lindsey was incredibly rude. She should definitely not be in healthcare. As someone who's been in healthcare for 13 years making the patients feel unwelcome and talked about is not best practice. The rest of the staff was very nice but I am still in pain and now feel I have to get another dentist to fix this. Really disappointed and should have never gotten the "cavities" filled as I am left in pain that did not exist prior.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Franklin
user_reviews_extended.Description: The new office is gorgeous and they have the best team ever. My insurance fully covers my visits but their cash prices for uninsured folks are very reasonable. I also love that Dr. Miller cares about health over everything else and doesn’t try to push unnecessary cosmetic procedures. Me and my spouse both get our dental care here and can’t recommend North Austin Dentistry enough:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Miranda Anders
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this dentist for almost two years now. I have never felt so comfortable and taken care of at a dentist. Leo has been my hygienist twice now, both times have left me feeling informed about my care and my teeth. From regular cleanings to having my wisdom teeth out, they have done amazing work. The whole team has succeeded in creating more than just an average, run of the mill dental practice. If you have any anxiety around dental work, I highly recommend them as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Bandy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
North Austin Dentistry is wonderful! Dr Miller and his staff are friendly, down to earth and professional. They asked me thoughtful questions and took time with my cleaning. Unlike my previous dentist they didn’t try to up sell me on anything and the whole experience was pleasant and relaxed.

Updated 10/2024:
The new location is easy to get to just off Mopac and has lots of free parking. Dr Mahmoud is kind and attentive. Her hygienist Leo is a pro! He’s efficient and has given me the most thorough cleanings I’ve ever had. I always leave with my teeth feeling great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Crespo
user_reviews_extended.Description: After years of not going to the dentist I had some anxiety and fear coming to the dentist. Sadly, I no choice but to come in because of tooth pain, I am glad I decided to come here! The hygienist Cesar was very friendly and caring. He insured me that I was in good hands and I had nothing to worry about. He was very professional and let me know what he planned on doing while taking x-rays and cleaning my teeth every step on the way.
