( A first time I experienced that going to the dentist, which I appreciated very much) Then Dr. Miller came in and seen me and he was also very caring and informative on my teeth situation, we came with a reasonable plan for my tooth recovery. I had such a positive experience here and it made my fear of going to the dentist go away a little less. In fact I can't wait to go back and get my mouth back to full recovery! 😁 Come here, like Cesar said to me, "You are in very good hands."

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ian Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Ah yes, the sweet sounds of dental tools. Why not soothe your nervous system with the wonderful faces and hospitality of Dr. Millers team.

I have had several fillings (all very quick and effortless) and had my wisdom teeth removed all 4 at the age of 32. Dr. Miller was able to extract all 4 with zero issues, in near record time. The whole process was very effortless.

I showed up one day with a mouth full of canker sores and Dr. miller was able to identify the issue, treat me and get me on my way. I will never forget the relief he provided for me.

Their new office, a wonderful and rewarding upgrade from the previous office leaves no stone left unturned. A well equipped office with a beautiful green belt setting to ease your eyes as you drift off into a dental abyss.

If I could make 10 profiles and review them 10 times I would, I’m just too lazy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Long Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Update i will definitely NOT RECOMMEND anyone to come here at all  bad service and not good people at all please don't waste money and find a better dentist to go to that actually knows how to do good cleaning/dentist services

user_reviews_extended.Name: CW Hoover
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service- was able to get me in on short notice (same day) when my regular dentist was closed and take care of my inflamed wisdom tooth. Very good people, good facilities. I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nina Posada
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had issues with finding a dentist that I was actually comfortable with and felt no judgment. My teeth weren’t the best but now they’re healthier than ever and it’s thanks to Dr. Miller and the hygienists that I have been working with. The front staff is very welcoming and I was surprised when they greeted me by name and made me feel like I’ve been coming there for years. I finally took care of my wisdom teeth and I couldn’t have had a better experience. Dr.Miller also recommended me to a great orthodontist so that I’m able to continue my journey to a better smile.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Wollaston
user_reviews_extended.Description: Leo,  my dental hygienist is super awesome! Gentle hand, very thorough cleaning job, super friendly and professional. I actually doze off during my visit. Dr Mahmoud is a great dentist very personable and patient, takes time to listen to concern's and proactive with care!  The front desk staff is very organized and friendly as well! Love this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jazmin Cuéllar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The hygienist Lynn was amazing! Great at answering your questions and cares about doing a great job!
Update: best dental clinic in Austin!!! Dr. Miller is amazing, funny and cares about his patients. Never had a dentist who cared about his patients. He takes pride in making sure his patients get the best care.
Honestly. I would recommend this place to everyone! I would trust them with my chompers again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cady McNerney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience at North Austin Dentistry! I was looking for a new dentist and looked at reviews of several dentists in the area and I’m glad I chose this office! Leo was an awesome hygienist! He was fun to talk to and explained everything going on with my teeth. I love how clean and pretty my teeth look after my cleaning! Dr. Mahmoud was also great. Looking forward to my next appointment in 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gus Hauge
user_reviews_extended.Description: No complaints here, just a really solid dentistry. Cleaning was well done and Leo was very personable. Dental exam was quick and easy. Receptionists were great and the entire building was clean and well kept.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dana Birnberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff are extremely accommodating and kind. Leo was fantastic - professional and welocoming.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracey Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff at North Austin Dentistry are exceptional.  I’ve had positive experiences each time I’ve been to their office or communicated via phone or text.  Dr. Miller is friendly and personable and most importantly honest and professional.  I’m so pleased with his work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: tomeka bryant
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter found this place because she had a toothache but could not take off during the week. We just knew it was going to be impossible to find a dentist on the weekend. She was totally ecstatic to find one. We was shocked about the prompt service. Like literally you walk in and next thing you know you're laid up in a hydraulic chair, So Amazing... So now me and my husband's are patients as well and we Absolutely love this place. Leo(Hygienist )is a doll and absolutely enjoy the conversations we have..and he's great at what we do. Dr. Miller(Dentist)makes me feel like he cares not just about my teeth but overall my health. All the staff is friendly. OMG,,, that's so rare to find this day. I truly can't say anything was wrong or bad about this place. No long wait, no sales pitch, just complete comfort. And love the 80s and 90s music as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome office!! The staff and Dr. Miller are always so friendly and sweet, the office is easy to find and I always can find parking (a usual source of anxiety for such kind of appointments). I moved here and needed a dentist and I’m so glad I picked North Austin Dentistry. You can call anytime and someone will help you with whatever you need. 10/10, thanks Dr. Miller and the rest of y’all (:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Miller and the entire staff at North Austin Dentistry are truly amazing! This was my first time at the dentist after 5 years without going and I was very nervous. The staff are very personable and made me feel comfortable for my first time back. They are very informative and go slow in telling you useful information. Lindsey at the front is super accommodating with getting patients set up for appointments.

I will continue seeing Dr. Miller and staff along with recommending to friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace
user_reviews_extended.Description: Definitely recommend this place. All of the staff are super nice and I appreciated that my hygienist Leo took the time to explain everything I needed to know about hygiene and taking better care of my teeth. I have only had positive experiences with North Austin Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Glendenning
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been seeing Dr Miller for a few years now and I am very satisfied. He and his team do a fantastic job! My Hygienist Kelyn and Dr miller make you feel comfortable and well taken care of. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Ulry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and the amazing staff at North Austin Dentistry are what excellence is supposed to look like in a dental practice, or any other business for that matter. I’ve had emergency situations come up on two occasions that required extensive repair work. Both times they were able to get me in the same day, and either resolve my issue, or come up with a plan to repair the issue as quickly as possible. Christine and Lindsey have been absolutely wonderful to work with, and Dr. Miller has a super cool demeanor and is so open, honest and friendly it doesn’t seem like you’re talking to a doctor at all. I couldn’t be happier with my choice to make North Austin Dentistry my dentist for as long as I live in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
North Austin Dentistry really just makes life easy. Dr Miller and team all make you feel at home and relaxed during every appointment. From routine cleanings to the less fun stuff, you can’t go wrong here. I used to have high anxiety for dental work, but that has mostly gone away since I made North Austin my primary dentist.

I have been coming here since I moved to Austin, and highly recommend it to any of my friends in the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vivian Pugh
user_reviews_extended.Description: We are really happy we switched over! It’s easy to get in… you don’t have to wait 6 months to get an appointment. Every staff member has been really kind. My kids and I have had a great experience and I would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynn Rovelstad
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super nice. Very clear pricing. Take my insurance. Great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morgan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to North Austin Dentistry for about 2 years now and have always had a great experience. I had a few really bad experiences at a different dentist office in Austin that have lead to some anxiety around going to the dentist. But North Austin Dentistry always puts me at ease. They are very ethical and don’t try to push excess or unnecessary procedures. Dr. Mahmoud is so personable, and I’ve had great visits with Dr. Miller as well. Everyone at the office is very kind and welcoming, and I’m so happy to have found them! Highly recommend for anyone looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linn Sheehy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow! Best teeth cleaning ever. Leo (my hygienist) was very thorough yet extremely gentle. I had some (lots) of stain and he got every tiny spot off. I look like I got my teeth bleached!  Dr Miller did an exam afterward and I felt like we could have talked forever.  Very open and easy to communicate with.  I can’t wait for my next dental appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J H
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommended this dental office. Everyone I’ve ever interacted with, whether it be the Doctor, the dental assistants or the front office, have been so kind and made my experience coming into their office feel rewarding. The dental assistants and doctors seem to really care about the work that they are doing. They have taken time to educate me on proper techniques for brushing and flossing which has lead me to seeing positive results when I come in for my routine cleanings. I have never felt that they were just trying to get money out of me. They take the time to explain what kind of treatment is recommended and why and I always walk away feeling grateful for the time I spent in their care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Hoes
user_reviews_extended.Description: This doctor needs his license revoked !!  I came in for an Emergency cracked tooth and he told me that he is "the Bus Driver and I have to trust him" and all that.  He said the process needs to be the way it needed to - and that I needed a debridement and total scalar/deplanings before he would do a root canal or anything else.  He did not care about my tooth pain or situation - only getting their money!!  They are completely unethical and the office manager/financial consultant is rude and condescending.  They have a 1-week cancellation policy , yet they sceduled me 3 UN-necessary visits all within a few days of each other (3 appointments in 7 days total time).  And they don't care about YOU at all - they sceduled me with 3 different oral hygenists, which I did not want.  They claim the anethisiologist will be $1000 per hour, and somehow I don't buy that.  But things got real nasty with Lindsay, the office manager, when I had tried to reschedule an appointment 2 days before a visit, because I had literally just then been notified that it would be with a 3rd oral hygenist in 7 days time.  I said I don't like these procedures beind done by a random hygenist every time and I'd like one of the 2 that I had seen before.  She didn't like this, but rather than have me cancel, she changed it to a person who had seen me 2 days prior.  But, she was so rude about it, so I asked....what if I did cancel.... what would be the cancellation fee?  She said, "A minimum of $200."  I asked.." A minimum?  Well. it's an hour and a half appointment - what would the exact fee be?"  She paused, and then finally said $250.  I really didn't like the way the Doctor had basically informed me of how he was "in charge" of everything, and the way the office manager was.  During all of this she made sure to put the blame on me and let me know twice what I had agreed to before with these visits.  BUT she never TOLD me it would be with 3 different hygenists in 7 days.  They strong-arm you at this dentist, and Lindsay was VERY NASTY and condescending.  I cancelled and then I talked to the doctor.  They are in cahoots there and it was the same rhetoric with him.  They are a corrupt business.  I wish I had read the reviews before going there.  They put cosmetic dentistry over emergencies and strong arm you the whole way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Precious Fowler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am typically extremely nervous and uneasy at the dentist, but I honestly look forward to my appointments with North Austin Dentistry. The staff are kind, attentive, and quick! Special thanks to Leo who made me feel like a person and not just another number. Dr.Miller was very kind and helpful without being judgmental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cate Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love North Austin Dentistry! I have severe anxiety when it comes to going to the dentist and they always put me at ease and make me feel comfortable. Everyone is so friendly and they do the best dental work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Irma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and staff are amazing! Colton, Christine, and Kenna were so attentive, kind, and courteous during my last visit. Dr. Miller has my trust 100% for any procedure or recommendation related to my oral health. He removed all my wisdom teeth and I received the best care. I am going in for a root canal next and I am confident I will receive the best attention. The staff at the office treats you with the utmost respect and they go above and beyond. Their communication is top notch. I used to have anxiety related to dental procedures, but I no longer do because I know I am in good hands when I come to North Austin Dentistry. I’ve never had a better dentist! I would recommend North Austin Dentistry to all my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Kuehl
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend! I saw Dr. Miller to get my wisdom teeth removed. He made me feel at ease the whole time. The entire staff at North Austin Dentistry is wonderful. The admin team is lovely (s/o to Lindsey & co.). All of the dentists/hygienists are professionals at what they do. Everyone here remembers your name and just makes you feel comfortable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bogdan Pantić
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller is amazing. Professional, caring, and does great work. I had my wisdom teeth pulled and was in my feet the next day. His entire office is filled with professional, caring people that want to make what is normally a terrible experience into as great of one as possible. Best Dentists office in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ThienSon Ho
user_reviews_extended.Description: Leo did my teeth cleaning and he was very friendly and also gave a lot of helpful tips to better maintain my teeth. He was very meticulous and thorough with the cleaning so I appreciated that as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aubrey Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kelyn and Dr. Miller are great- they always take care of whatever I need with ease! The office is also very accommodating in scheduling. Nice people all around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Lofgren
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to have multiple root canals a while ago and this endodontist took very good care of me. They helped me as much as they could with insurance and bills, and always gave the best most reliable healthcare and treatment. Ever since, they have been helping me get better at maintaining my dental hygiene to prevent the experience from ever repeating. Thanks for the gentlest, most pain free cleaning today, Leo :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Ton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly I didn't get a good feeling from anyone at this office  except my hygienist. She was kind, everyone else was terrible. I didn't really feel like the dentist cared about me, he was just trying to get me to do extra services. He came off like a used car salesman. The receptionist was SUPER RUDE and rushed me when I was waiting for my dental records to come in. She told me they have other patients to see, when I was struggling and trying to call my old dentist to get my records sent over so I could get treated here. First and last time I come here. AND their prices were 33% higher than my original dentist. This was my experience here. You can say that you rushed me on my visit because m y insurance was due to expire in one week, but what did that have to do with my visit that day? I was already there to be treated. You guys fell short - do better instead of making excuses.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon McGinnity
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best dentist I've ever been to. I really like Dr Miller and everyone in the office, they do great work. I recently had a dental implant done and it looks and feels great. I really appreciated how communicative he (and all the staff) was on the process, which with healing time in various stages took about six months. He really takes the time to answer questions and explain everything clearly. It's really nice how Dr Miller and all the staff seem to truly have time to take with my concerns, in a very personable, friendly way. And of course they do great work, I must reiterate! I'm very happy with the implant and the process as a whole has been as agreeable as I can imagine it being.

5/5 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabella Gipson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Miller and his team - special shout-out to Lindsey and Colton - are amazing! I had an emergency, and came in on a Saturday and got a root canal done. Felt so much better afterwards and been going there for a couple months now getting my other teeth fixed as well. Dr. Miller uses the latest technologies, very impressive and his team is super friendly and competent as well!
Adding to my review from last year. I got my first implant done this year and I am very happy with the process and the result. I agree: Dr. Miller is the best dentist! Him and his team are always friendly and very knowledgeable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Westlake Nation
user_reviews_extended.Description: Leo is just absolutely hands down, the best dental hygienist I’ve worked with. I found North Austin Dentistry in a dental emergency two years ago and the entire staff is at the top of their game. Dr. Miller and his team don’t just keep my teeth happy and healthy, they have a real plan for my teeth long term. I’m all about prevention over reaction and I just love North Austin Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Barnes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kate, Dr. Miller, and the whole team provided exceptional service for a cleaning and orthodontic consultation. I look forward to continuing my relationship with North Austin Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elliott Stanish
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff were great. Check in was quick and easy. The staff, dental assistants and billing representative were all helpful, polite and friendly. I felt supported and cared for. Dr. Miller was excellent- he put me at ease and explained clearly my care plan and future appointments. I sincerely appreciated his demeanor and willingness to help. I highly recommend Dr. Miller to anyone looking for an affirming dentist in the Austin area

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan McNeill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Miller helps my dental anxiety decrease tremendously. He has performed a root canal and a cavity on me and I have had no problems. I have had to go back in a few times due to discomfort and they have always fit me in same day. The entire dental staff is wonderful and I will continue to go to them as long as I am in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is very friendly and the dentists have always treated me well. I get great dental care every time I visit and even got a free zoom whitening as a first time patient. The intake and check in procedures are streamlined so I’ve never had any issues with paperwork or insurance. Strongly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Forest Pelton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller has an amazing staff at hand and an incredible bedside manner! I have never been to a dentist and was quite nervous, but after a few minutes both the doctor and the staff made me feel relaxed and at ease. I would highly recommend them as they take excellent care of you and put great effort put into making sure you are comfortable. As well as having quality equipment and being knowledgeable, this dentistry is leagues ahead of the competition. I can’t wait for my next appointment, and that’s not something you hear someone say about dentists often now is it?

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zach Gorowitz
user_reviews_extended.Description: NAD provides a fantastic experience every time I go in to get my cleaning! Every hygienist is personable, professional, and amazing at what they do. They are consistently coming up with different solutions to provide amazing care. The front desk is always super helpful as well. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: butterflyweed420
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller is a great dentist! His staff is beyond courteous and very helpful my daughter absolutely loved it. He won't make you feel better about not going  to  the dentist in a few years(which was my experience).  He's very kind has a great sense of humor and very professional highly recommended. Also I have to add my daughter has trust issues with men and she absolutely loved him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan McCabe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at North Austin Dentistry for a couple years now and cannot express enough how much I appreciate the service! Going to the dentist makes me verrry anxious, but EVERYONE on the team is so kind and compassionate that as soon as I get to the office, I feel better. When I first met Dr. Miller and the rest of the staff, I hadn’t been to the dentist in years and had done a poor job of taking care of my teeth; as a result, I’ve needed to have a slew of different procedures done, ranging from consistent straight-forward cleanings to root canals and the gauntlet that is the extraction/implant process. I never feel like I’m being judged or condescended to (exactly the opposite!) and I always leave more educated and with a healthier smile :) I recommend North Austin Dentistry to anyone who’s looking for a dental practice - they’ve improved my quality of life and the service and expertise is unmatched.

user_reviews_extended.Name: C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been coming here for about 2 years now, they are hands down the best dental practice I've been to.

Dr. Miller is great and his staff equally as talented at what they do. My most recent cleaning was with Malia, she is awesome!

Highly recommend, nobody likes visiting the dentist but they will make you feel comfortable and in good hands!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Burns
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my 4th visit to North Austin Dentistry and so far I’ve had a great experience. They have a seamless process for scheduling appointments to ensure they accommodate your schedule and the entire staff is super friendly which makes going to the dentist a great experience. My teeth are super sensitive and Kelyn did a great job of cleaning my teeth which was then followed by Dr. Miller who is also friendly. Overall, I’ve had an awesome experience and will continue to use NAD in the near future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Claye
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to Dr. Miller & associates for years and have the best experience I’ve had with a dentist. They’re warm, caring, and also discerning, upfront and honest about any work you may or may not need done. The family environment is so much better than a chain dentist. You will receive a personalized experience, help with payment plans if/when needed, and the joy of seeing familiar smiling faces every time you visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenetra Herring
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highest recommendation to Dr.Miller....  Excellent dentist very thorough an caring staff goes the extra mile to make you feel comfortable. I just love them my very first visit I was made to feel welcome an comfortable (BOTH) by the friendly competence. Dr. Miller took the time to explain every procedure which I didn’t experience with other dentist.  Any work that I have had an still getting is very satisfactory.  NORTH  AUSTIN DENTISTRY is a whole vibe  I love this place shout out to Dr. Miller my dentist an his staff especially Lenzy thank you again guys I look forward to my visit to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: megen mundy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am very grateful for Dr. Miller and his staff. I had a terrible experience a few years back with a dentist that caused me a lot of shame and anxiety, which made things worse bc then I avoided going in for way too long.

Dr. Miller has a really no-nonsense, yet very kind demeanor, and he really made me feel safe and gave me hope with a plan that didn’t seem overwhelming. Everyone on his staff from the hygienists down to the front desk staff are so friendly.

I’m normally too lazy/forgetful to write reviews, but I have had such a wonderful experience that I wanted to share. Great place, great people! Awesome for anyone with reservations or fears about the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Cueva-Luna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Miller and his staff are amazing. He is a great dentist; he takes the time to listen and addresses my concerns at every visit. I have had multiple root canals, and always makes sure I am comfortable and pain free. Scheduling is very easy and he and his staff are very professional and kind. 5 stars all around!

user_reviews_extended.Name: charlene jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Miller and his wonderful staff is a refreshing change from many horrible experiences with the Dentist. They are professional yet they make you feel like family. Any worries I had I was put to ease whether it was kind words or a blanket their goal was to make sure I was comfortable. I love that this office is very high tech and I even had a custom crown made for me in under a hour. I no longer have any fear of the dentist because Dr.Miller and his staff. If you are in the Austin area and need an amazing dentist please make an appointment you will not regret it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Malka (Red)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I saw Dr Miller for an emergency extraction of a fractured molar. The office is exceptionally clean and a very comfortable, relaxing atmosphere. Dr Miller was extremely polite, professional and patient. He explained every step of the procedure thoroughly during the process. I highly recommend North Austin Dentistry for your dental care needs.

6 month update- Dr Miller has been fantastic and has done incremental work over 6 months to complete our treatment plan today. My mouth hasn't felt this good in years. I still stand by my recommendation- you won't find a better dentist. Dr Miller is compassionate, intelligent and thorough, as is his entire staff. Do yourself a favor and go see them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: justin hendrix
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where do I begin? I have been there twice now, and both times was amazing. Dr. Miller has been a tremendous help to me with getting my teeth back on the right track to a clean and happy healthy smile. The staff there are truly warm welcoming and 100% a joy to be around and socialize with. I'm truly blessed to have found such a wonderful place for me to want to go get my teeth taken care of. I look forward to each and every appointment that I have and will have in the future. This is the dentistry for me, and if you haven't been your truly missing out on a magnificent experience. So schedule yourself a appointment and go check them out and see for yourself what I'm talking about. You won't find a better dentistry than North Austin Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aspyn satterwhite
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such kind and caring staff! I am new to Austin and am more than thankful I chose to be a new patient at their dentistry. Not only did they make me feel welcome, they genuinely cared to deliver the proper cleaning I needed and thoroughly explained to me what needed to be done as well as what I needed to do at home to follow. Amazing communication and patience! I highly recommend, and will be referring anyone I come across to become a new patient of theirs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Patterson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Quintana and the assistant were absolutely fabulous.  The wisdom tooth was removed painlessly, and they remained supportive, attentive, and professional.  It was *literally* the best appointment I ever had with the dentist.  SO GRATEFUL.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Furlong
user_reviews_extended.Description: NAD has been doing an excellent job taking care of my teeth for years. I love the new office space. Everything is clean and equipment is up to date. All the employees are very kind and considerate. I highly recommend NAD for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JYTW ST
user_reviews_extended.Description: Exceptional service! I had a broken tooth causing swelling and pain. The dentist promptly scheduled me for an appointment the next day. X-ray and extraction were swift, painless, and reasonably priced. Highly recommend for efficient and affordable dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Henson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the BEST experience here! When I needed them the most they came through. I was amazed at the excellent customer service, the thoughtfulness and care I received. Dr. Miller is by far the best dentist I have ever been seen by. He is SO SO SO kind. I would definitely recommend North Austin Dentistry to my friends and family. Thank y’all so much for giving me such awesome care guys!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea De La Cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Experience! I came a few weeks ago to get all 4 wisdom teeth taken out and everything went great! I loved them so much, that I scheduled a cleaning a few later. Linn did my cleaning and she was amazing, I highly recommend this Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaylie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller's office is incredible! I came here after a bad experience at another office in town and I am so glad I did. EVERYONE from the office staff to Dr. Miller himself was so kind and understanding. Dr. Miller made sure I thoroughly understood what all of my options for treatment were and why I would need them. I felt at ease with my upcoming procedure because of that even though I have terrible dental anxiety. Ariel, the dental assistant, also deserves a shoutout as she explained the terminology as well as my x-rays to me in a way I could easily understand. I am so glad I found this practice and greatly look forward to coming back in the future! Y'all definitely have a new lifelong patient in me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: karyn may
user_reviews_extended.Description:
During my initial visit (in 2020?), Dr. Miller was able to create a replacement for a crown that had never fit in my mouth properly, which brought me so much relief!  Dr. Miller and his staff members are truly legit.  The utmost in professionalism and courtesy.  They have gained a patient for life!

Update Oct 31, 2025 -- Still the best dentist EVER.  The quality of Dr. Miller's dental work is impeccable, and is accompanied by a sweet, comforting bedside manner. He thoroughly and continuously monitors the quality of his work during his procedures, and in the following weeks/months he checks to make sure all is going according to plan.

The members of his staff (especially Val 🥰) are all friendly and accomodating and make me feel comfortable each time.  The Melis(s)as at the front desk are also awesome.

I can never leave Austin now because I will not go to another dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Huber
user_reviews_extended.Description: I needed an emergency tooth extraction due to a painful infection and they got me in same day. On top of taking care of my dental emergency as gently as possible while communicating with me every step of the way, they made sure I was comfortable in every way conceivable, including providing me with sunglasses so their bright lights didn't hurt my eyes, providing a big TV with Netflix so I could watch a movie throughout most of my procedure, and even offering me water to drink. Tooth extractions suck, but I've got to say, if I ever need another, I'm having the ladies that did today's do that one as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin Nicole
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in earlier today for my first teeth cleaning since moving. The staff was super friendly, as was Dr. Miller! I usually have anxiety in these settings, and he was very reassuring. He gave a thorough explanation on future work I would need and I plan to return fairly soon. Overall a very awesome practice, certainly would recommend. Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Sheehy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always had great experiences with North Austin Dentistry.  Dr Miller is extremely caring and establishes great rapport with his patients. I loved the crowns he did and he makes your crown right in his own lab. No more temporaries that fall off and you having to go in for multiple visits. His hygienist is outstanding and will put you at ease, same with the rest of the staff. I highly recommend this office and Dr Miller for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacie George
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Miller is extremely accommodating!  Took me in at the last second on a Saturday for an emergency root canal!  Pain free, thorough, and excellent communication!  I really appreciate that he is conscientious of cost and time constraints as well.  I had such a great experience I brought both kids (11 and 13) as well and they were very happy as well!  considering they both had to have extractions, I would say that is high praise!  Will never go to another dentist again.  Highly recommend!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Demien
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff are amazing. I was having a dental emergency with some much pain and they were able to get me in and take care of the problem. I was so scared and terrified but the office staff  and Dr. Miller made me feel comfortable and made sure I was comfortable through the whole procedure.  I am so thankful I found them. I will be continuing my care with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Korina Skhinas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first great dental visit ever! I’m usually very nervous visiting the dentist because I have such sensitive teeth but for the first time ever I had a pain free clean! Shout out Linn who did an amazing job - she immediately noted my sensitivity issue and modified my cleaning to be less painful which I never knew was even possible! On top of that she gave me the most thorough clean possible and made me feel informed and at ease the whole time. Also something to note, was how quickly I was seen at arrival of my appointment. It’s super rare and greatly appreciate it. I’m excited for the first time to do my 6 month check up because I know I’ll be taken care of by a great team. Thanks again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rocio Jimenez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Miller and his staff are amazing!!
I came into their office with bad Wisdom Teeth pain and they were able to schedule me for an appointment that very day. Dr. Miller and his staff are so awesome, understanding, patient, and straightforward. Dr.Miller checked my teeth and immediately told me what was going on. That very day I scheduled an appointment for my 4 Wisdom teeth removal, which went out great. I suffer from anxiety and they knew exactly what I needed when it came to my wisdom teeth removal. They are also super gentle. They are the first office that I have gone to that doesn't pry mouth open to the point where it hurts. I 1000% recommend Dr. Miller and his amazing staff. First dentist I came to from moving to Austin from
California and I am glad I found their office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hays
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Miller is one of the best dentists in Austin. Recently had all of my wisdom teeth removed here. Christine, Lindsey, & staff have been unanimously kind & helpful.

The operation was painless, quick, & catered to my needs. All wounds have healed well. There have been no complications. Exceptional service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zelor Massaquoi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Once upon a time, I cracked my molar in half eating a taco. Dr. Miller fixed me up, noticed a few other oral issues I was having and created a plan for me. 2 years later, my teeth are happy & healthy. The entire staff at Dr. Miller’s is phenomenal. The admin team is lovely (s/o to Lindsey & co.). All of the dentists/hygienists are professionals at what they do. Everyone here remembers your name, your stories and just makes you feel comfortable. I live in South Austin now and happily make the commute to see them. 🎉

user_reviews_extended.Name: Malorie Layne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Haven't been to a Dentist in about 5 years thanks to snobby dentists that have shamed me for my teeth and recommending treatments that I did not need. This was NOT the case at North Austin Dentistry.
Dr. Miller is the first dentist I have seen in my 25 years of life that not only treated me like an equal but also commended me for taking good care of my teeth (despite the couple of cavities that he found) and actually took my pre-existing conditions into consideration before recommending my next treatments.
He and his staff are wonderfully fun and professional and I could not recommend him more than I currently do. One visit was enough to make me a long term patient.

A huge thank you to Dr. Miller and his staff for making me feel welcomed and at home in their office. Cannot wait for the next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah L.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for a routine teeth cleaning today.  At most places it’s just something perfunctory that has to be done.  You try to get in and out limiting your engagement as much as possible without getting caught in the many dysfunctional ways some offices run their businesses, sadly.  Hence I’m always impressed by the level of professionalism, efficiency, and like-ability the team at North Austin Dentistry exhibits.  They really go out of their way to make it easy for you the customer and a friendly experience each and every time.  Thoughtful text reminders… which I find very helpful.  Being greeted by my name at the front desk lets me know they were expecting me.  (What a novel idea?!)  Then there’s the friendly hygienist, who’s just delightful.  And last but not least, Dr. Miller… he’s a class act.  I’m so glad we found this group, I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori MacNeill
user_reviews_extended.Description: So thankful to have found Dr. Miller & staff! I’ve been a very nervous dental patient for decades & have recently had him do extractions, a crown and a bone graft after having such a positive deep cleaning experience. So knowledgeable, quick and caring. Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pauline Maldonado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m the typical “I hate going to the dentist” type of person but this office has changed my way of thinking. Appointments are always on time. I truly appreciate how the front desk takes the time to explain and answer questions about cost/insurance. Plus I love coming to the dentist and not getting a lecture about how many cavities I have. They tell me what I need to do, come up with a plan all while not making me feel bad that I have 13 cavities! Hands down best dental experience I’ve ever had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every time we visit the office staff is amazing to work with and very understanding. Coming from a place of intense fear of dentists in general this office has made up for it so much! I'm still nervous but they answer all my questions kindly and gladly. They also treat the experience in an educational way which has been such a big help to maintaining my health. I love working with everyone and have already made recommendations to friends in the area. We look forward to a lifelong relationship with everyone here

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scot Nelsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient of Dr. Miller since he came to Austin! Leo continues to do an amazing job keeping things clean, and I have no plans to go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such amazing staff. The front desk ladies are absolutely the nicest people ever. She offered me a blanket when she heard I get cold easily. 10 outta 10 recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Morrison
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dentist visits aren’t always the most fun, but Leo made it super easy. Kind, considerate, explained everything really well and ghastly a very gentle hand on a deep cleaning. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katy Cochrane
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller has created the best dental experience I’ve ever had! He is easy going and very knowledgeable. I was super nervous about going back to the dentist after a bad past experience elsewhere and COVID. I was put at ease by him and his wonderful staff! I feel like part of the family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: isaac Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time getting my teeth cleaned at North Austin Dentistry and they did amazing! My hygenist Alyssa was very communicative and for the first time I had no pain after a cleaning! Thanks for recommending this place Christine!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Itamar Shapira
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and effective. Great experience with Dr Miller, hygienists Kellen and Larrain

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barry Pape
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff are very warm and welcoming! I am one to DREAD the dentist office!! Just the thought of going to the dentist raises my anxiety!! I tend to prolong having visits, because in all honesty I get so nervous about getting my teeth worked on. For this reason, my teeth are not in the greatest shape. I am new to Dr. Miller’s office, and not once did I feel judged by Dr. Miller or his staff. I had a huge cavity to be filled and had to get a crown. My cavity was so large, and deep that initially they almost thought I would need a root canal. It wasn’t until Dr. Miller cleaned out the cavity that he felt confident that a filling would be all that was needed. I was anxious when he began the work, but almost immediately, just by his bedside manner, and the way he explains everything he is about to do, beforehand, my anxiety ebbed away, and I felt more relaxed than I have ever felt in a dentist chair. The whole procedure went smoothly!! Not once did I feel any pain or discomfort!! I was extremely relieved and grateful!! I have a follow up coming up in two weeks, to get my permanent crown put in, and a couple of fillings done, and I am actually not in the least bit afraid!! Dr. Miller and his staff are very professional, and friendly, and I highly recommend them if you are looking for a dentist!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joaquin Nunez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I initially scheduled an appointment with North Austin Dentistry to have my wisdom teeth extracted, but the team was so professional and nice that I decided to just turn around and make them the only dentistry office I go to! I would highly recommend them if you are in the market for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison O’Neil
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve now been in for some pretty serious work as well as a good old cleaning. The staff is friendly and makes me feel comfortable about finally taking charge of my dental health—plus they actually explain everything. I trust that Dr. Miller and his team have my best interests at heart. Excited to continue my treatment plan with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Duval Warren
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a bit of anxiety about going to the dentist to have some major work done. Dr. Miller and his staff are professional, friendly and immediately put me at ease.
I was given options, and a clear course of treatment. I was asked about my comfort level during every step of my treatment. 10/10 good experience for going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karmella Green
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff are always congenial and very informative about the procedure and process. I had my wisdom teeth removed and they walked me through the whole process, gave me resources and worked with me the whole time. I especially like their reminder system and follow up texts. Dr. Miller also called me that evening after my procedure and I thought that was such a nice gesture going that extra step. Would definitely recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Manser
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff are professional and enjoyable to be around.  I switched to Dr. Miller about 3 years ago and have always received the highest degree of attention and care...I won't consider any other office now. The office is exceptionally clean and organized and the checkups and cleanings are thorough with attention to the client needs. No upselling and scare tactics for needless services as I experienced with my prior office. Just honesty, great work, and great environment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dianelly Dodd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in to see Dr. Miller for the first time as an emergency case on a Saturday while we experienced the first shut down due to COVID-19. I was incredibly grateful he worked me in but even more grateful that he performed a root canal that was painless and the best experience I have ever had at a dentist office. His staff is wonderful and accommodating. In addition, he has treated my husband who also had a great experience getting a deep clean. Needless to say, I will not see another dentist now! I am getting implants placed by Dr. Miller and am looking forward to having a healthy and happy smile again :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Odilia Dauzacker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was genuinely amazed by the professionalism, competence and quality of the service I received by Dr Miller and his team. In less than 4 hours I had a diagnose and full treatment on a tooth that was seriously hurting for a month. That included a root canal and a crown, all done right there on site, with state-of-the-art equipment and  without a trace of pain, while the anesthesia lasted only the necessary time for the job to be done and was practically all gone when I left their office. In a sentence: best dentist experience ever!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany
user_reviews_extended.Description: Yesterday I got 2 mission teeth removed by Dr. Miller. He was extremely professional and very attentive to my level of comfort and minimizing my pain. The entire process took a couple hours, but that’s mostly due to waiting for the sedation to kick in enough as I was awake throughout the entire procedure. I honestly didn’t feel any pain- just pressure once the right amount of anesthetic was applied. Dr. Miller and his staff are great, wonderful people that truly care about their patients. I definitely recommend him for your dentist if you live in or near the Austin area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leesa May
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller’s office is the best! They are kind and truly care about their patients. I needed a lot of work done and Dr. Miller and his team has done a phenomenal job taking care of all my problems. Every staff member makes you feel comfortable and talks you through everything!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Omar Clinton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great service. Friendly staff!

Dr Miller is very thorough. Got my wisdom teeth removed and it went a lot better than expected.
Dr Miller reached out to check my healing process and to make sure I was taking my meds.

I now go there for teeth cleanings and it has been a great experience so far.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mikaela Murry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wish I could give more than 5 stars. Best dental visit I have ever had. Dr. Miller is so relaxing and I feel like I can trust him with my dental needs. He even took the time to answer my questions so I fully understood my dental treatment plan, as well as steps I can do to take care of my teeth longterm. My husband also had a great time and is very happy that they offer free whitening for patients. Actually looking forward to my follow-up care and next dental cleaning! Thanks for seeing us on a Saturday and for playing good music.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Caballero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Reason for the visit: root canal and a deep cleaning. I have not had a better experience at a dentist than I have had with Dr. Miller and his team. While I do not want to repeat the process of a root canal again, because of the overall experience I am happy I’ve found my new dental office of choice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Goldin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Last night, my tooth broke in half. I called up to the dentist office. They promptly answered and had me scheduled to come in within 2 hours. Dr. Miller was really really great. Quick and painless procedure. I was quite fond of the dental assistant I had, she was really caring and sweet. As well the front desk was warm, welcoming, and in general just really awesome to deal with. If you are looking for a dentist this is the one you wanna go to. If I could give 6 stars I would.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kara Scherff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every time I’ve come into the office to get work done I have been taken care of entirely! They definitely do what they can to make you comfortable and relaxed especially when you aren’t the biggest fan of the dentist in general. Also they do multiple types of dentistry which worked out well for me since I needed cosmetic work as well! My dad started going here and my boss and they love it. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennica Falcon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I never thought I would recommend wisdom teeth extraction, but here we are! I was so happy with my experience at North Austin Dentistry. I got all 4 wisdom teeth removed. The entire process was painless. Uncomfortable - sure! Painful - definitely not. Dr. Miller's staff is so warm and friendly. I felt truly cared about. Little things like Val pushing my earphone back in my ear when it fell out during the procedure - those little gestures of kindness make such a big difference and made me feel comfortable and relaxed during an uncomfortable situation. I'm now two weeks post-op and would do the whole thing all over again if I needed to! 5 stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Azalia Moreno
user_reviews_extended.Description: HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! love the hospitality and the attention to detail on my teeth - my teeth have never looked better and the staff is really nice! thank you for taking care of me and my teeth!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen J
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole team is awesome! They are great about making accommodations for emergencies. I usually get cold sores in the winter if I don’t apply, Chapstick appropriately and I called all over Austin nobody offered the laser service, or even knew what I was talking about. They were able to get me in quickly to do the soft tissue laser with Kelyn. This was really helpful because cold sores can be very uncomfortable and after just one treatment it stopped any further progress, which reduces the risk of scarring. I’m so thankful there, so progressive and accommodating. Thanks guys! See you for my cleaning soon!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Salinas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been coming here since 2011, and the practice has been sold twice since that time. Dr. Miller is the 3rd dentist I’ve interacted with, and I can say undoubtedly he is the best one of the three.

Furthermore, a good form of judgement is to examine who someone hires, and Dr. Miller has the best staff, and collectively they are always thorough yet friendly each time.

In short, the office is relaxing, and the quality of care is top notch. I cannot recommend enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carlos Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I originally came to North Austin Dentistry, because I moved to Austin and the reviews were great. Fortunately, the experience is even better!! Office is very clean. Ekna is AMAZING!!! She always remembers me personally and that’s cause I visit every 6 months. Dr. Miller himself is also fantastic. Couldn’t recommend this office any more!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Sullivan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Fantastic experience with Dr. Miller so far. All of the staff are friendly and helpful, and the office is very comfortable. My tooth broke and Lindsey answered my email after hours to schedule an emergency appointment the next day. I love how they have availability on some Saturdays. I'm needing root canal, crown, extraction and implant and it's awesome how I likely wouldn't be referred out because Dr. Miller does it all.
- Lauren Sullivan

user_reviews_extended.Name: neeti pandey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with tooth extraction and overall treatment with Dr Miller. I reached out with a request for wisdom tooth extraction on both the sides. I had an almost painless experience in the sense that even though the extraction was to impact both sides of my jaw, I could resume eating to normal in 5 days, with no pain. My extraction wound got healed really very soon. I would highly recommend Dr Miller to anyone who wants an honest consultation and opinion on dental issues. The staff members at the clinic are wonderful too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sirpa TN
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family loves North Austin Dentistry! Dr. Miller and his staff are the nicest people there are and always make sure to treat you with kindness and respect. As someone who used to feel anxious whenever it was time to meet the dentist I truly appreciate dr. Miller’s calm demeanor. Visiting here is almost like visiting a friend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Destiny Knoll
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to North Austin Dentistry to get my wisdom teeth removed. Dr.Miller and his team were so awesome!!! I had to get all four wisdom teeth removed but they walked me through the whole thing, making me feel so comfortable from start to finish. Coming from someone who isn’t too keen on going to the dentist, I highly recommend you visit them! Everyone was so friendly, I’ll definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Leo, Christina, Savannah are AMAZING!!! So helpful and sweet. They make me so comfortable coming here and I look forward to getting my teeth cleaned now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kalinka Woolford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Miller, front office staff and hygienist are very personable and friendly. They are also flexible with your schedule and insurance, and most of all really care about your dental needs. Come and have your treatment here. You won't be disappointed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: alisha pineda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to North Austin Dentistry for almost 2 years now and I love them. The staff are always super friendly and very helpful . My Hygienist Keyln is HANDSDOWN The Best I've ever had !

user_reviews_extended.Name: alan de leon
user_reviews_extended.Description: First visit today. Dental hygienist was super nice and was gentle on cleaning my teeth. Dr. Miller was awesome too, he answered all questions I had about my treatment plan, feeling confident about coming back. Receptionist Lindsey was super friendly too and also answered all of my questions at the end  :•)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristal v.b Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole staff is amazing! Dr.Groh and Val Helped with my anxiety and was patient with me. Made me feel very comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liam O'Neil
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was extremely pleased with my experience! Dr. Miller is a true professional and immediately diagnosed my pericoronitis and then performed emergency wisdom teeth surgery less than 24 later. Dr. Miller also gave me a call the day following surgery and checked in on me. I am very appreciative of his help and will be going to North Austin Dentistry for all dental issues moving forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: martin chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Miller and his staff are tip top. End of story.

I was a patient from aprx 2019-2023 and the only reason I stopped going was because I moved out of town in October; but I still made the effort to plan my cleanings for the end of 2022 and the beginning of this year. THAT is how good he is.

Since I moved to another town I asked if I could have copies of my dental records to give to my new dentist so they could be caught up, and they emailed them to me before I got to my car. Just amazing service.

I felt bad during my last visit because I was in a bit of a rush but they knocked out my cleaning ASAP like the pros they are.

Best dentist and staff in ATX in my opinion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rory Scales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff were the best team (in the Dental field) that I have ever been around.  They always had a great environment in the office, from the music to the good mood everyone was always in. Great man and a great Dentist.  Sadly I moved away from Austin and can no longer see him, but 10 out of 10 would recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hal Schroeder
user_reviews_extended.Description: First class facility and people.  Very professional, yet friendly.  Conservative approach, offered all their services without being pushy.  I actually had a pleasant time with my crown.  Clearly they care about their people and the quality of their work.  High fives!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roy Reyna
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to North Austin Dentistry for over two years since returning to Austin.  After meeting Dr. Miller and team, I was very impressed and brought my wife and our 8 year old son over as clients as well.  Today was my son’s and my first visit (routine cleaning) in 2020 and after seeing the care that he and his staff have taken due to COVID, I had to brag about them a bit.  They took many additional steps and explained why they were doing them, giving added comfort.  A dentist isn’t generally a place to get excited to visit, but the professionalism, patience, care, and friendly people make the experience very pleasant.   I highly recommend North Austin Dentistry for anyone and their family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liz Leiding
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Miller, Lindsey and the whole team at North Austin Dentistry. In October I cracked my tooth while eating a P. Terry's hamburger on a Friday night. Saturday morning I called several dentist offices to see if I could get in for an emergency exam before going on a weeklong vacation on Sunday. North Austin Dentistry got me in, did x-rays, tests, and were able to get me a filling with a follow up visit as soon as I returned from vacation. Upon my return I had another exam where Dr. Miller completed an exam, and went over treatment options for treating my cracked tooth. We decided to take a conservative approach (which I appreciated and led to increased trust with the team, because to me it showed there is not a financial motivation). Unfortunately, my crack did worsen a few weeks later. Dr. Miller got me in ASAP, and completed a root canal which allowed us to discover that the bed of my tooth was unfortunately cracked! I was presented with options and decided to pursue an implant. Throughout this entire process, Dr. Miller and his team went ABOVE AND BEYOND. I have never felt so comfortable in a dentist office. Dr. Miller always encouraged me to let him know if I ever felt even the slightest bit of pain. He gave me a personal call the evening after my extraction and bone grafting. There were times I emailed the team at 9pm at night and received a response! You will not find a team that cares more, is more available and accommodating than this team. I could go on and on, but I will spare you all the details. Go with Dr. Miller and his team, you won't regret it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeromy Hudson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have to say the previous review from DSS is absolutely a lie. As a patient sitting in the waiting room, I heard the 10 plus calls and the harassment that the staff was receiving and they handled it with care and the utmost professionalism. The dentist even took the time to talk with this customer. I have nothing but wonderful things to say about the amazing people who work here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peter Koester
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller is an excellent, caring dentist, he provides efficient cleanings with genuine consideration and utmost attention to your comfort and health. Easily the most amicable and trustworthy dentist I've ever had. I cannot recommend him highly enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: rox5858
user_reviews_extended.Description: For so many years I had a fear of dentist that was caused by a bad experience I had. I came to Dr. Miller’s office not sure what to expect. I was not disappointed. Dr. Miller was gentle and the dental staff is very friendly. Dr. Miller is open on some Saturdays which was great for my work schedule. Dr. Miller has done all my dental work and I am 100% satisfied with the results. I can smile with confidence now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Tester
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved being able to get my teeth cleaned on a Saturday. Dr. Miller was very nice and fast. For once i didn’t leave my cleaning in pain! He also filled my cavities and was able to get me to work on time. I will 100% be going back to have my teeth cleaned by him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melina Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a really great and painless experience having my wisdom teeth removed in Dr. Miller's office. The procedure was quick and he took extra care to make sure I was completely numb, adding localized anesthesia to the area if i showed any signs of pain . I highly recommend everyone go here. The place is super comfortable and everyone who works there is very nice and friendly. I was nervous because ive never had anything done at a dentists office before  (Im 34) but, Dr Miller and his staff made me comfortable right away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judith Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: So grateful for the team at North Austin Dentistry! Dr. Miller, Lindsey, Lynn, and  Bri are the kind of people I want taking care of my teeth: they are friendly, take the time to listen to and understand my dental history, and do an excellent job. I had many consultations about a particular tooth issue, and was SO glad to find the team at North Austin Dentistry. Dr. Miller took out a particularly gnarly wisdom tooth - he did an excellent job with the surgery and answered all my (frantic) questions day and night. Highly recommend - they’ll treat you like family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oh Jem
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Beware Greedy Business Practice:
This use to be my favorite dentist…. Now they’re just money and greedy business practice like everywhere else. BEWARE they will upsell you!!!! All dentists are businesses as dental health care system is awful.
Remember to say no to a lot of their up sale charges such as mouth guards and tooth whitening products. Do your research on what information they’re giving you!!!!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lee Kirgan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I discovered Dr. Miller and the team at North Austin Dentistry while searching for emergency dental services on a Friday evening. Even though I was not an established patient, Lindsay and Dr. Miller worked get me an appointment on Saturday morning. The whole team was welcoming and made me feel comfortable and my issue was quickly assessed. Treatment was thoughtfully explained and the work started within minutes.

Dr. Miller was personally engaging, before and during the procedure, and made sure my issue was resolved. On a Saturday.

Thanks, North Austin Dentistry! I greatly appreciate the service that you provided me and the willingness to make sure I was taken care of in a timely manner! I’ll be seeing you soon!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Howell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really do like Dr. Miller, i can be a challenge at times, especially when money is involved,  but him and his staff go out of their way to work with your insurance and really try to get coverage for you, but they are also upfront and tell you the truth about what's happening.   Going to the dentist isn't dreaded like it used to be,  I've had fillings to root canals and crowns (made in house) and it's all been great.  If you're looking for a new dentist, i definitely suggest Dr. Miller and his team at North Austin Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tae VT
user_reviews_extended.Description:
*2 year update review*

As a patient of Dr. Miller for over 2 years, I've had multiple different procedures ( extractions, cavities, cleaning, etc. ) performed by him and can attest that he has been one of the few, if not the only dentist who has remained consistent in his professionalism and care across the board the entire time.

For me, the biggest factor in choosing a long-term care physician ( whether a dentist, doctor, etc. ) is to make sure they are consistent in their integrity and are always putting their customers first - Dr. Miller passes that test.

I would genuinely recommend him and the staff at North Austin Dentistry to anyone who is looking for top notch care in this area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Max Lancaster
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient here for several years. The staff at North Austin Dentistry are warm, knowledgeable, respectful of your time and take great care of your teeth. I especially appreciate the ease of scheduling and the frequent appointment reminders. If you are looking for a new dentist office in North Austin, NAD is an excellent option.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rashad Fisher
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very good and precise people, Caesar very cool and did his job well thanks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Waleed Doany
user_reviews_extended.Description: I LOVE this office. From receptionists to hygienist to dentist. ALL are super caring, beautiful smiles, gentle, professional, thorough… can’t say enough great things about them. I always look forward to my appointment, I know I can depend on them to give me the best care. Keep up the good work. Until the next visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Neifert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had nothing but great experiences at North Austin Dentistry with Dr.Miller and all of the hygienists. They’re always kind, helpful, informative, and punctual. I’ve had everything from normal cleanings to fillings to crown procedures, and it’s always been a pleasant experience (as pleasant as having your teeth ground can possibly be).

user_reviews_extended.Name: zada zamorano
user_reviews_extended.Description: never have I ever had a bad experience at North Austin Dentistry within my 2 years of being a patient. Dr. Miller is wonderful and efficient. Etka is an absolute doll and I enjoy every second with her during my visits. 10/10 reccoment this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ross Arneaud
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller, Linn, Lindsey, Leo, and the entire staff are excellent! Friendly, kind, and great service. I’ve been coming here for several years and the experience has been stellar, highly recommend North Austin Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jean russo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough about the dentist and his staff. I needed a repair badly on my denture plate and just picked Dr Miller from a online Google search.  And what a great place I found....they repaired my denture in record time.without any issues. I decided to also get another denture made and so glad I did because it's with precision. I could not believe. How great they fit....they are my primary ones now....I'm so satisfied with all that I ask for, I am so fortunate to have found North austin Dentistry.  Thank all of you for your work well done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica de Jong
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome experience here 👍 Dr. Miller and his staff made me very comfortable while providing great care. I had chipped my bonding done by another dentist, but that office was closed today due to inclement weather. However, North Austin Dentistry was open! I called in the morning and they were able to fit me in an hour later for my bonding as a new patient, and even gave me a different and preferred solution to treatment than my previous dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlie Hegstad
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very poor dental service. I received a 'deep cleaning' also know as a full full debridement or root scaling and planing, but the service actually received was not close to that. I've had this same procedure done before and know what to expect. This time, it felt like a slightly more in depth regular cleaning. A little over a month later, and it's looks like my teeth haven't been cleaned at all. I went in for a check up 1 month after the cleaning (a few weeks ago), and Dr. Miller said it all looked good. I just switched to a new dentist and he said that it looks barely cleaned- a hunch I already head.

DO NOT go see Dr. Miller if you have any dental concerns beyond a regular cleaning. It's sad that dental is much less regulated than medical, because it allows for vastly different experiences.

The staff is also not friendly and is sketchy about payment. Avoid if you can.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tucker Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff are awesome! I had to find a new dentist in the Austin area and am very pleased I chose him. His staff is very welcoming and explain things very well. If you’re in the market for a new dentist who isn’t “corporate,” I highly recommend Dr. Miller.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Silvia Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: So I will start by saying, I have extremely bad anxiety and I have had bad dental issues this past year. This dental office has been absolutely amazing compared to the others. Dr. Miller warns you about the noise and sensation so you aren't surprised. The hygienists are also super kind. I recommend, especially those who may have anxiety when visiting the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melinda Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff!!! I'm so shocked at how fast they were able to take care of me this morning! I've had 2 teeth that have been rotten for years and hardly even had anything left of these 2 teeth. I started having pain that traveled from my jaw to my ear. I put it off for so long bc dental work can be costly. I called at 8:15ish was at the office shortly after 9am, had x-rays, my insurance looked at, talked to about next steps, got both teeth extracted, taken care of, and at work by 1030ish!!! Everyone was so comforting, welcoming, sweet, nice, and I could go on! Definitely coming back to get my smile back!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyla Doyle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller is THE dentist you look for and want in your “ever-on-going” health journey. I found him on Google when I was having pain from impacted wisdom teeth. From his staff, to his consultative, super friendly, but confident approach, I trusted him to take out my wisdom teeth. And the rest is history. Flash forward 2 years later, I’m so grateful I found him. I’m no longer terrified dentist appointments, I’m able to keep up with what’s needed to keep my oral hygiene on track and look forward to the office’s killer music selection. Don’t look any further.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Molina
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really wanted to like it here, but it was very disappointing. Please please save yourself the hassle. They lied to me and charged me for a service they did not provide. The dentist came in and she was very brief, rude, and distracted. The front desk may seem nice initially but all they care about is getting your money. I feel so used and unheard.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Hrubos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I felt taken advantage of and discarded for wanting a second opinion. Pretty sure they fired me when I asked for my X-Rays to be sent to another dentist, they hung up on me! On my first visit I was rushed into a procedure without more than 5 minutes of consultation and that was after I expressed my dental anxiety. The dentist talked a lot about himself and didn't ask me any questions other than if I had questions myself. Do not recommend unless you're wealthy and have perfect teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Belding
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am visiting from Nevada for a conference and my crown fell off. I called North Austin dentistry and they were able to get me in right away. From the front desk, to the assistant to Dr. Mahmoud I felt safe and cared for. They were able to put my crown back on and got me out and back to my conference so fast. I would highly recommend this office to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Staci Duhan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough good things about this practice. I had to take my daughter in for a tooth infection on a Saturday. Dr Miller and his staff were extremely efficient and thorough. The entire process was seamless... From intake to Xrays (with low radiation-emitting technology) to examination. Dr. Miller never rushed us and took time and care to listen and assess the entire problem.  We are very grateful that his office was both open and offered such quality care, especially when you have a child in pain. I even plan on personally moving over to his practice. THANK YOU!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony Kuss
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Miller and his team are phenomenal. I am a very nervous patient and have tried multiple dentists over the years, but my search is over.
I recently had 2 wisdom teeth removed and the procedure went fantastically well.
I will be a Dr. Miller patient for life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: r awk
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I never leave reviews but absolutely had to for Dr. Miller and staff. He is a skilled consummate professional as well as accommodating.

He was able to see me as soon as possible to correct a shoddy root canal performed by the prior dentist.

The staff is nice and the facility is clean/ sterile. I highly recommend North Austin Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deb Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love going to Dr. Logan Miller's office.  Today was a 6-month checkup and cleaning, I've posted before that the office is kind ,compassionate, and Doctor Logan is just a wonderful man.   My hygienist today was thorough and gentle, I'm 70 years old and this is the best dentist I've had in my life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cedar Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had a great experience with Dr. Miller. He removed my wisdom teeth last fall (which I had been TERRIFIED to have done for years) and made me feel extremely comfortable. I swore I’d never have them removed without being completely put under, but I had conscious sedation and it was totally fine. I’ll be seeing him for a long time. Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Glanzer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at North Austin Dentistry for about 5 years. I always trust Dr. Miller to be upfront and honest with treatment recommendations and suggestions. Since starting treatment I’ve moved south of Austin to the Buda/Kyle area and for me it’s worth the drive to be taken care of properly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Hurtado
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff follow all precautions needed to keep their patients safe during these challenging times when it comes covid 19. They are all very professional, take the time to listen to your concerns and are very knowledgeable about any action plans needed to keep your teeth healthy and clean. A big shout out to Lynn for being so gentle while cleaning my teeth and I would highly recommend North Austin Dentistry for your dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MM
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Logan Miller DDS at North Austin Dentistry for more than a year now. I've had a root canal, and crown placed on a broken back tooth, and cleanings, X-rays, exams. Absolutely the best crown I've ever rec'd! Every person and every procedure has been professional and friendly. They are good on patient education and don't grumble. I cannot recommend Dr. Miller's office enough. Very pleased indeed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teju Olawumi
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with hygienist Ekta has always been nothing shirt of amazing..she is very professional, our conversations are very encouraging and she does an excellent job of taking care of my teeth. The level of progress my gums have made since joining the practice only confirms the great level of care they receive!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel Rudolph
