user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Logan and the crew are good, honest people and a dedicated team. Dr. Logan takes his time explaining the condition of your mouth and I've never felt rushed to get in and get out when I'm there. I plan on remaining a patient of his for a long time and highly recommend you consider him for your dentist.

Also, as an added bonus, he plays the Beatles Pandora radio station in the office. Great dentist with a great taste in music.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kacnyca Guist
user_reviews_extended.Description: North Austin Dentistry is beyond wonderful. It’s like going to hang out with friends who happen to be dental experts. The experience is stress-free thanks to an incredible staff, clean office, and great music! Dr. Miller addresses questions/concerns openly and really cares about the interest of his patients. 11/10, would do dental stuff here again and again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pam Burton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Where do I start? Dr. Miller and staff are like family. I searched a long time to find a dentist who treats autoimmune patients with the specialty we need—
from pre-treatment with antibiotics to understanding pain and fear issues, they are the dentist family for me!

The dental hygienist, Linn Sheehy a seasoned pro is really the rock star of the family! I have issues with metal on my teeth. She uses ceramic tools and is gentle and pain free. She intuitively knows the problem spots and explains everything as she cleans my teeth as if they are expensive crystal. My fear of cleaning has been conquered and I can’t recommend her enough. Thank you Linn, for treating me as if I’m normal.

A big thanks to billing and front desk folks, they make the impossible happen (cancellation because of migraines, Lupus flare) with grace and understanding I will never achieve. The entire practice is patient-centric, which is Dr. Miller’s middle name. I can’t recommend this family dental practice enough!

PB

user_reviews_extended.Name: sara maitlen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently went to Dr. Millers office for new trays and whitener , the office was super easy and convenient to get to. Dr Miller and staff were very friends and comforting for someone who is afraid to go to the dentist.
They exceeded my expectations on how quickly my trays were made and i'll definitely be going back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: July Ann
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Not coming back. It seems like this dentistry is trying to upsell everyone to get a root canal. They will mess up your filling and leave you in pain, then when you complain of the pain, they will upsell you a root canal. Do not go here.
Also, the blond front desk is not friendly at all, even rude when you ask questions.
Even the replies on the bad reviews here were answered pretty rudely. Says a lot about this dentistry. Total red flag

user_reviews_extended.Name: Crista Beck
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller is truly committed to people having healthy teeth! I went in on his new patient special and not only did I leave with clean teeth, but free teeth cleaning! How amazing is that?! I had a positive experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joelle Nagel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best TMJ consult and treatment I have ever received. So much so that I am making them my regular dentist! Thanks for making me feel heard!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angel Del Mar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love coming here! I’ve had a lot of work done this past year, plus a bit of things on the list to take of this year.
I hate every bit of getting dental work done, so much so that my first visit I was in tears of fear. I know I know I’m a huge baby and I was psyching myself out. But for real, they were the nicest ppl that work there. I keep going back I think at least 4 or 5 times in 2020, and I LOVED it every time. Weather it was cleanings, or root canals, Even an extraction, Dr. Miller and the entire staff at North Austin Dentistry are the absolute best and I trust them when I walk in the door. I love coming here.
I still hate anything involved with my teeth, but I love coming. I’m not nearly as terrified as I always have been. Thanks you guys!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linn Sheehy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had the most relaxing and yet thorough dental cleaning of my life. Ekta (hygienist) took excellent care to note my sensitive areas and address and dental concerns that I had.  My X-rays were soooo easy. Usually they gouge and hurt but not at all today.  Dr Miller completed my exam and had great ideas to help my esthetic issue.  Best of all his knowledgeable diagnosis is easy and not a financial hardship.
I highly recommend this dental practice, they take the time to LISTEN to you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: London Anne Marie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a wonderful experience today getting a cavity filled, which is an odd thing for me to say!! I'm usually super nervous at the dentist, but here everyone makes me feel so comfortable and are amazing at what they do! 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arvind Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Logan Miller and his teammates including office staff are highly knowledgeable and very thorough in dental patient treatment. Installation of crowns for adjoining multiple implants 14 and 15 was done in one visit with an ease and minimum discomfort. Fitting and alignment of crowns with natural teeth is exceptionally precise.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Snizhana Yakhno
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first wisdom tooth removed last year at north austin dentistry and this year I came back for the rest to get them out. I had great experience both times. As I don’t have insurance, the prices are very reasonable here. Dr. Miller and other people who work there are so nice and professional. If you need to get your wisdom teeth get removed, I highly recommend dr. Miller.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Loc Le
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in for a deep cleaning. Very friendly and knowledgeable staff. Leo, my dental hygienist, was excellent! Dr. Miller was reassuring! Great and easy experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaleb Pereira
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend Dr. Miller! He is very easy going and always answers any questions or concerns I have about my teeth (even when it’s purely cosmetic!) Always a quick in and out and everyone working in the office is friendly - try to get Lynn to clean your teeth if you can, she’s super sweet and always offers good conversation (and even takes the tools out of your mouth so you can reply without awkwardly drooling, haha!)

user_reviews_extended.Name: mary lynn marinucci
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve trusted Dr. Miller for the past 10 years-he’s earned it. He’s knowledgeable, skilled, patient and kind. His team helps me feel well cared for. I especially appreciate that I can ask questions between appointments and get speedy, thoughtful responses.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best Dentist I've been to! Dr. Miller and his staff all do great work and really care about making their patients comfortable. And they give you cool shades to wear while you're in the seat getting work done 😎

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justine Ivory
user_reviews_extended.Description: Likely my best dental visit ever. Everyone was so friendly. I didn't feel like I was rushed through a process. Linn and Dr. Mahmoud were very gentle and thorough. Great practice!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neha Jamwal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very efficient and excellent care. I was in terrible pain due to wisdom tooth, the  staff at Dr Miller's gave me the appointment as soon as I called in. There was minimal wait time and Dr Miller took care of tooth extraction in no time. Staff at the practice was very polite and friendly. Highly recommend this Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meredith Hudson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love North Austin Dentistry and would highly recommend it to anyone who is in need of a Dentist! Dr. Miller and his staff are extremely professional, timely, and genuinely care about you as a person and patient! My husband and I have had wonderful experiences while going to North Austin Dentistry and really appreciate the care and attention we receive!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kent Yarborough
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was unhappy with my current provider so a friend suggested North Austin Dentistry.  I had an initial visit and was provided a treatment plan with the costs for the work.  I showed up at my appointed time and received "stellar" service and care.  Dr. Miller was excellent and took extra time to ensure my procedure was complete and met HIS personal standards.  I hate to say it but Dr. Miller is the rare professional that shows a professional care for his clients.  You would be hard pressed to find a better dental provider.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie S.
user_reviews_extended.Description: My boyfriend and I went here for check-ups/cleanings, and we both had really bad experiences. I had an extremely unpleasant hygienist, she was arrogant and had a terrible bedside manner. My boyfriend had poor dental work done that had to be re-done elsewhere. I've never had a bad experience with a dentist before, this was a first. I would not recommend this practice and I will not be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emmanuel Atenco
user_reviews_extended.Description: North Austin dentistry was super helpful! I had a tooth infection and they accepted me as soon as I needed. The staff was attentive and showed great hospitality. Dr. Miller is knowledgeable and helped with my issue.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Speyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to the Dentist today for my cleaning and polishing.   I was in and out quickly with everything being done well.   I have been at this office 3 times now.   Twice to have a crown replaced and once to have a root canal.  It was nice to have the crowns done in the office and placed in my mouth while I was in the office without having to go back to have it done at a later time.   Very good work

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Neumann
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and the whole staff at North Austin Dentistry truly deliver the best quality dental care in town. Leo has incredible patient-centered care and makes sure my teeth are healthy and clean. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lunden Hayes
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were very quick with helping me diagnosis and then treat my TMJ that has been bothering me. They gave me a detailed explanation of everything I would need, and the entire process was seamless. Will be going again for future needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Escalante
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and all of his staff are the best. So kind and so helpful every single time. Dr. Miller always takes time to answer any questions and is very thorough and personable. His staff always goes above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and are very efficient with any kind of paperwork involved. I’ve been coming here for years and so glad I found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcella Sellers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot thank Dr. Miller enough for the care he provided. I was experiencing excruciating pain in my molar that needed to have a root canal and rang Dr. Miller to see if he could see me ASAP. Not only did he squeeze me in that morning, but completed it in a timely manner. The procedure was also painless and he kept me informed of what he was doing along the way which was great. I cannot recommend him enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra Wenholz
user_reviews_extended.Description: So glad I found North Austin Dentistry! I received the best cleaning from Leo today and my teeth feel amazing! Friendly staff and great location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karma Marie
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this office! Dr. Mahmood & her assistant Ariel kept me calm, Dr. Mahmood was gentle & Ariel walked me through the process while Doc worked. I recommend this office to everyone! They are very caring & have a great team! Thank you Dr Mahmood & Ariel & all of Dr Millers team! -Haley

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We were looking for a new dentist when the practice we had gone to for years got a new doctor who insisted on x-rays every year whether needed or not. We initially chose N. Austin Dentistry because of the reviews and ability to opt out of x-rays.
As luck would have it, soon after we had a dental emergency and though we were new patients, Dr. Miller got my husband right in and fixed him up. When we needed help or had a question, he personally answered the phone or called us back even when the practice was closed.

My husband and I are pleased with the work they have done for us. Their prices are some of the best I've found in town and they actually care about their patients. X-rays when needed - not forced. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristine Lim
user_reviews_extended.Description: First dentist I’ve actually enjoyed going to! Super easy to setup an appointment, awesome staff and really enjoyed Dr. Miller’s conservative approach to my dental treatment (diagnosing a cavity could be fixed with just a filling first rather than a full on root canal right off the bat). Could not recommend more.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Sweeney
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit to Dr. Miller was just great. He and his staff explained everything very thoroughly with me. I came to the office with a serious issue, very painful, and they made me at ease and accommodated my very short requirement to get my immediate problems completed, which I was very impressed with. The cost estimate was much less than I anticipated also. I heartily recommend Dr. Miller.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacie George
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff are friendly, and very courteous.  We ( my teens and I) have had several visits there and they are always accommodating, and I believe Dr. Miller to be the best dentist I have been to.  Always leave smiling!  😊👍🏻

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon Schaffer
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a fantastic team of professionals! I had waited way too long to go to a Dentist for routine cleaning/checkup, etc. Dr Miller and his staff are super supportive and kind.  I will be making regular dental appointments with them, and referring friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Diaz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If kissing was an appropriate way to say thank you, I would have done it!
I had such a good feeling when walking through his door and he went above and beyond any and every expectation I had.
He took his time with me, apparently I don't take anesthetic very well, but it never phased or frustrated him. He got to the root of the problem (no pun intended). I had seen 1 General Dentist and 1 Endodontist prior to him, and they got me absolutely no where except to additional EXCRUCIATING PAIN. Dr. Miller did everything he could to keep me as comfortable as possible while waiting to go in for my procedure. He was super personable and adapted to my personality well. I will never see another Dentist as long as he is in business.
Thank you SO much, Dr. Miller!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan Habibi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Miller with gym line complain and food particles getting stuck between my crown and the tooth in front of it. Not only he didn't even examine the crown, he barely checked my gum and my mouth. He charged extra for deep cleaning which he didn't even do correctly in the first place and  I ended seeing another dentist, paying out of pocket since Miller's office had used up my insurance benefit for cleaning just to do a deep cleaning which alleviated pain and throbbing  I had. Save your money and see a real dentist north this dishonest money hungry joke!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anjelica F
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller did such a fabulous job! I had to get my wisdom teeth out and I couldn’t have found a better doctor!! All staff was friendly and I’ll definitely be making this my home office for further cleanings and such.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lee Pitts
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist, great staff! They were able to fit me in same day for some tooth pain I was having. Got everything taken care of quickly. Glad to have a new dentist that I like!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darby O'Shieles
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller is a great guy and a gentle dentist. I definitely recommend him to anyone who is a little nervous about going to the dentist. He has a specialty in pediatric dentistry but treats grown ups. The beauty of this is  that you get the gentle treatment for adults.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carl Canga
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Talking to the dentist before a procedure is the only way you can feel comfortable letting him use pointy tools in your mouth.  Doc Logan conveyed a thorough understanding of the tooth issue, he understood my pain and my concern about using a dentist I have never met.  He explained the procedure and shared a story about his own tooth issue in the past wich put me at ease to the point that we were soon laughing.

He called me the night after the procedure to ask about any issues (there were none)

All in all, I'm very happy with the way he does his job
Very professional and personable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Hennecke
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have been going to North Austin Dentistry over a year. The staff is friendly and very helpful. This is the first place where the dentist himself performs the majority of your teeth cleaning. He will discuss your goals for your teeth and go over how you can realistic achieve them. I would highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Buffaloe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff have been absolutely wonderful! From Lindsey at the front desk to every tech I've been with and of course, Dr Miller, this office clearly cares about their patients! So glad I found them!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Crouch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his staff are great. They are always friendly and social making you feel welcome. The service is great and you can always know that you are getting top level treatment. They are very attentive, open, and transparent. I cannot recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Deutchman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an amazing experience at this place. Everyone is so kind, incredible customer service. Dr made me feel comfortable and was very attentive. Will recommend 10/10 times!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alana Grohman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Their motto is "Treating you like Family" and that is the truth. My first visit was wisdom tooth pain. I called that morning being a new patient I was sure that I wasn't going to be able to get in to remove them for another week or so. Nope! They got me in within 2 hours! They pulled them, and Dr. Miller talked me through it. I have been on the hunt for a friendly, caring dentist for years, and Dr. Miller and his staff are it. I'm not going anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stefanija Bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller is amazing, I had dental implant done there and had no issues at all! Also had regular dental fillings done! I love that he gets teeth fixed in one appointment! Thank you

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Rigby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Miller is the best dentist.  He and his staff do an outstanding job.   They take the time to listen to your needs.   Provide excellent care.  Follow up with you after any procedure.   Always available to you.   Make the switch.   He’s worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelsey Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place, great staff, great experience and very transparent with plans, pricing, etc!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was great. Dr. Miller was awesome. He took the time with me and made sure I understood in detail. Dr.Miller even did the cleaning with a quick tool, Which I liked. That t cut my time, so I could go back to work.  I told everyone in my department about Dr.Miller.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: North Austin Dentistry is awesome. I wasn’t even looking for a new dentist when I stumbled on to them during an emergency situation when COVID shutdown first hit. Amazing service from Dentist, hygienist, and staff won me over immediately. Glad I found them and switched over to them. This team is great!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephan M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Place, doctors and staff were really friendly and understanding, I'm a little bit of a naturalist they listen and gave me the options on what medications I could avoid. I really would recommend them to anyone looking to get there wisdom teeth removed. Lastly thanks to the staff for being great and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ysabel Julia Mielcke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Miller is a gem, always listens to concerns, and definitely knows what he’s doing. There no crooked here! All of the staff are friendly and make you feel welcomed. Will be feeling confident in ur smile after the first visit 😎

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelina Tamayo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is extremely nice and helpful. I was having wisdom tooth pain and this office was the only one I found to get them removed in less than a week.  Dr. Miller did a great job removing them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leticia Cortez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Miller is the best! I’ve been going here for awhile now and am thankful to have such a good and caring dentist. I never feel judged here and I am also thankful for the awesome assistants and front desk staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Rapp
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great dentist and practice overall. Highly recommend.

Updated Review 11/19/2025
Many years later and still recommend this dental practice! Dr. Miller and Dr. Halloum are fantastic and absolutely love hygienist, Leo!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith Dowell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I so appreciate Dr Miller and all of his office assistants!  Staying at a surgicenter around a mile away from the office.   My wife having surgery the next morning.   Experienced severe pain from a broken tooth and my dentist was 100 miles away in Waco. user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Orellana
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This review is a bit overdue, but likely because I wouldn't even know where to start when raving about THE BEST DENTIST I'VE EVER HAD.

I recently moved to Austin and out of nowhere my wisdom teeth began to give me issues. I was freaking out and was uncertain where to turn to- as a temporarily uninsured person. I called a few other dentists, in the Austin area, to figure out what the appropriate steps to take would be; Some locations were rude over the phone, others were incredibly pricey (i'm talking 150+ for the consultation alone!), and the worst were the ones who were trying to sell me on some randooo yearly packages, because it "included the first consultation".

Meanwhile, my wisdom tooth is hammering its way out of my head! So, you can imagine my response. I was like...wut?

North Austin Dentistry had my business as soon as I called them and felt immediate reciprocity at my sense of urgency. They were able to book me in for a consultation and x-rays right away! The process of removing my wisdom teeth included a brief amount of time on anti-biotics, but the entire process looked a little like this:

-From the day I made my first call to the day I went home, post-removal of those little wisdom suckers (avg. 2 weeks)
-Post-op was another three days of napping and eating mashed potatoes...aka the typical hyrdrocodone'd adult-sized baby routine (+avg. 3 days)
-Tagged on was another few days of sporting the chipmunk look for instagram. (+avg. 3 days)

The entire process was suuuper swift, zero complications, stress free, and dare I say? ...incredibly pleasant!! I think my favorite part (besides getting treated by a MEGA RAD DENTIST, and his stellar staff: Linn, Brie, Lindsey, and his assistant Val) was getting to listen to some of the funkiest, feel-good tunes, as I'm getting my wisdoms removed! The procedure began, and for a a brief two seconds I started to get anxious, but that all changed course quickly----I was like hold up anxiety, BRB, because.... "Brass monkey, that funky monkey" ...beep-beep-beep-boop....
It was great.

Dr Miller is an incredible Dentist, and much like other reviewers, I would give North Austin Dentistry a higher rating than five stars if I could. However, the internet has determined that humanity, at its absolute best, can equal only a total of five blue stars....

So, to my fellow Yelpers and Googlers, I leave you with these golden words from a modern proverb (that I've just made up):

Always Trust a Dentist Who Can Rock A Great Playlist.

Cheers!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Miller is the real deal. He combines technical acumen without being an egoist prick. He cares/understands financial, pain-thresholds, and he's got a splash of "dark" humor that ironically lightens the mood <let's face it, teeth just aren't designed to last into the years we live today in modern living. Dr. Miller is there to ascertain and deliver>. And he can work under pressure! This guy Crown Prepped a freaking Molar (with all the molds and Temp crown completed) in 50 minutes so I could make it to work without having to ask precious time off! A secondary endodontist (who I saw unrelated to Dr. Miller's work) noticed the "margins" on the worked on molar in an x-ray and said they were "excellent.".

He also works/is cool with gold crowns for back-teeth/molars, and doesn't push this crazy fad of ceramic crowns for back teeth "for esthetics". They are molars! You don't see them when you smile and they are there to pulverize food, not make selfies on freaking Instagram! One Gold crown molar came in with the bite off, but he was able to mod/adjust it in order to avoid another 2-week crown development.

Oh, and did I mention...HE WORKS UNTIL 7pm ON WEDNESDAY! This Dentist Dr. Miller kinda kicks *ss.

user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hector Romero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Recently had the best dental experience here at North Austin Dentistry. I’m usually super anxious when sitting in the chair but Dr. Halloum and her team put a plan together for oral sedation on my treatment plan. My appointment was a breeze and I was able to knock out a same-day crown and a few fillings. The assistants were also amazing in making sure I was comfortable along the way and had a lot of patience with me. Dr. Halloum is awesome, she takes the time to understand the patient and has great empathy. Shout out to North Austin Dentistry for a job well done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc Halpin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Saved my life! 3 day trip to Austin, Massive chip front tooth within 1 hour of landing. Called N.A.D. and in the chair within the hour for consultation. Back the next morning all repaired by 1130 am. Crisis averted, super hero Dr Halloum saved my life, saved the day. Can't say enough about the care, empathy, concern and execution here. Only one experience but 10/10. Thank you so so so so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Salinas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always love my experiences here with Dr. Miller and team. I’ve been a customer here for a few years and the staff here (esp my hygienist Cesar) are some of the best. You can tell they enjoy their job and take the time to make sure you feel comfortable and confident about your dental visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Moehlman
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here is wonderful. I don't think anyone get's super excited to go to the Dentist, but they go out of their way to make sure you're comfortable at North Austin Dentistry. They really did a great job on my teeth, and were honest and upfront about pricing and expectations.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea F.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Miller and his team are amazing and incredibly kind. I’ve been going here since I moved to Austin 7 years ago, and even though I have since moved further away from this office, I will happily make the drive out here because it’s really hard to find a dentist that genuinely cares.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lloyd Cates
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a dental emergency recently. Dr. Miller worked me in quickly. His staff was very professional and made me feel at ease. The facility was very nice. Especially the window view of trees outside.
The 3D printer shortened the procedure to one sitting in the chair.
If you are looking for a dentist, I do recommend Dr. Miller.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khi Jameson
user_reviews_extended.Description: She got me in same day with a painful broken tooth. I went in scared and upset that I was going to have to have a pretty important tooth pulled. Not only was she able to fix my tooth, she was so good at talking to me and she does this thing to keep the shot from hurting. This is the best dentist office in Austin. Thanks so much. I am taking my ibuprofen and it feels perfect. Awesome staff as well. Thanks yall. Sorry I tried to call to get her name but couldn’t get through. If someone could let me know that would be great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Harper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Logan Miller is an expert at what he does, I've had a lot of dental work and from my experience today Logan tops the charts. He is precise, he communicates well, and his staff is nice and very accommodating. Five stars. Thank you for rescuing my tooth before I leave the country!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesus
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone if amazing and kind and caring which made it so helpful since I don’t like going to dentist and now I found a place that I can comfortably go to for help with my teeth

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Dugi
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dentist was thorough and was very careful with my teeth. My cleaning was a bit pricy, but overall it was a great experience! Everyone was very kind!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ignacio Losa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Tuve una experiencia horrible en mi visita a este dentista.

Tenia un problema bastante grave y fui a pedir que me observaran para determinar que me pasaba exactamente. Me tomaron radiografias y el doctor me examinó por encima sin apenas explorar en profundidad la zona afectada. Rapidamente me dio un diagnostico y me intentaron convencer de que empezara ya a tratarme sin darme tiempo para pensar en si era lo adecuado o pedir una segunda opinión, e intentando que firmara su inflado presupuesto.

Por suerte tome en consideración la opinión de otros dentistas de la zona a los que visité, y que si que se lo tomaron en serio. Ellos me exploraron en profundidad y coincidieron en un diagnostico concreto muy alejado del que me dieron en este lugar.

Siento que no me trataron como es debido, no fueron buenos profesionales y que con la salud no se juega.

Si eres de los que lee las reseñas antes de elegir un dentista, por experiencia te aconsejo que no visites este. Tu salud dental y tu bolsillo te lo agradeceran.

title: Parmer Lane Family Dentistry
address: 3704 W Parmer Ln, Austin, TX 78727, United States

user_reviews.Name: Lawana Gonzales
user_reviews.Description:
I Very pleased with Dr. Cindy  Garcia’s office. Staff Who are all? Very friendly,  peppy and chipper personalities. They are very thorough and their explanation of cost and insurance.
And My dental assistant,  is very sweet , Caring in a great explainer of the process and why certain treatments are needed. Plus, she’s a very good listener when I shared other personal medical issues going on in our family. Even their technician for that takes care of Invisalign orders was very thorough, In her explanations. I would recommend His office anyone that doesn’t have a dentist.

user_reviews.Name: Jordyn C
user_reviews.Description: In the past, I have had some pretty bad experiences going to the dentist which is why I tend to avoid them. Reading the reviews of Dr. Garcia’s office, I felt comfortable enough to do what I needed to do and make the appointment - also because I’m dealing with horrible wisdom tooth pain! There was a mix up with my appointment but Desi made sure I could still be seen which I am so incredibly grateful for! All the staff I came across were so warm and kind which immediately calmed my anxiety. Dr. Garcia made me feel relaxed and welcome. I cannot explain the happiness I feel to have found an office where I feel so comfortable and to be surrounded by such kind people! Thank you again, Desi, for making sure I was able to be seen! And thank you to Dr. Garcia and staff for helping me schedule an appointment with a surgeon so quickly! You guys are amazing!

user_reviews.Name: Amy Aguilar
user_reviews.Description: I can’t say enough good things about Dr.Garcia and her team. They are so friendly and always have a smile on their face. They try to help you out and work with you financially if insurance doesn’t fully cover. They follow up to make sure you don’t miss any appointments. Dr. Garcia is the BEST and kindest dentist I have ever had!!

user_reviews.Name: Lindsey Tschauner
user_reviews.Description: The staff at Parmer Lane Dentistry are amazing. Their warmth, compassion, and thoroughness made me feel so at ease as someone who is anxious about going to the dentist. I’m so happy I’ve established care with this clinic, and I’m grateful that I won’t have to dread dental appointments anymore!

I went to Parmer Lane Family  Dentistry last week after have a very bad experience at another dental office.  Dr. Garcis and her team are absolutely wonderful.  Everyone makes you feel at home and welcome at any time.
I am very satisfied with my decision to return ☺️.
Thanks to everyone for making my visit enjoyable.

user_reviews.Name: Rob
user_reviews.Description: The team that Dr Garcia has put together is fantastic. The cleaning was thorough and gentle and Dr Garcia was great at explaining my treatment options without any pressure I highly recommend Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for anyone looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews.Description: Great staff, great dentist, very professional and always willing to assist. I am blessed to have found Dr. Garcia

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamay Johnston
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been using this dental office for many years and their consistent excellence never ceases to amaze me. I wholeheartedly recommend Parmer Lane Family Dentistry, where you'll be treated like family and can trust that your oral health is in excellent hands.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I know that many people dread going to the dentist, but I can honestly say that this clinic is the best place I’ve ever been. From the moment I walked in, everyone was incredibly kind and made me feel at ease. They took the time to explain every step of the process, and I experienced only mild discomfort. My appointment was quick and relaxing, and I was in and out before I knew it. I will definitely be staying with this clinic for as long as I can. The entire team made me feel confident in their care, and I truly trust them. A big thank you to the doctor and staff for such a positive experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosie Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Usually the dentist is not my favorite, but this office has definitely changed my mind! Everyone is so friendly and it made my visit here so much smoother and fun! Love Dr Garcia and all her staff! Thank you to the lady at the front (sorry forgot your name), Lacy and Alma! You all make an amazing team!!! Thank you for the goody bag! 🤗

user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for a very long time. Unfortunately the distance is becoming an issue. Thank you Dr. Garcia i wish you and your staff the very best.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I always enjoy seeing my Parmer lane Family Dentistry friends! Actually they are more like a family. So friendly, kind, caring and truly extend love to their patients along with the most excellent, professional and honest dental care. Dr. Lucinda Garcia is a gem! She does beautiful work on my teeth. I’m so grateful for her and each one of her amazing staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Delfino Pozos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I appreciate the Professional and Positive Vibe at PLFD! Excellent establishment.  Thank You Dr.Garcia and Brandy!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Garcia is a very thorough and gentle dentist.  I just had a checkup and cleaning and my hygienist took her time and did a great job. Alma, the office manager and staff are always very friendly too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Friedrichs
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m so impressed by Dr. Garcia and all her staff.  Extremely knowledgeable and very helpful.  On my recommendation my brother’s family comes here too and is equally impressed.

user_reviews_extended.Description: What a unique find! I’m almost 60 years old and I don’t know why it has taken me forever to find Dr. Garcia and her practice. user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is truly welcoming if you're nervous or afraid everyone here will make you feel right at home. user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiona S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this office and all the people! My first dentist in Austin was a corporate one where it felt like they were over-diagnosing, very blasé about my care, and just overall not a great experience (they even sucked my uvula in that little vacuum and then gaslit me, saying it was my tongue🙄). Switched to this office and immediately felt at home. The people who work here genuinely care for you and your dental health, and are not just over-prescribing stuff to make a quick buck. 10/10 recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Yocum
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had a very complicated procedure done. The staff worked very closely with the oral surgeon  that did my care.Each step was thoroughly explained. I was given a payment plan which my daughter Rondella Hawkins is paying for me. Very sincerely Nancy Yocum a very satisfied customer I was treated with  great care and respect. Being a senior citizen often I have not  been given such  respect. Thanks so much Dr. Garcia  and  team .  Total surgeon Dr. Hinze is priceless.so sorry  I spelled his name wrong, He even called day after to check on me.  All was an affordable priced package for professional perfect care. Smiles to all of Parmer Lane Family Practice.🐈‍⬛🤗. Sincerely Nancy Yocum a very satisfied customer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TR Buck
user_reviews_extended.Description: Incrediblee family dentistry office!  you come out of there feeling like part of the family, and the work done is always tender, careful, and thorough!  out of all the dentists I have ever met with and gotten work done. These folks are the absolute best! I highly recommend Parmer Lane family Dentistry! You will be glad when you turn Dr. Garcia into your family dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was super helpful and so nice!  Really took time and explained my options and listened!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Top Notch! Excellent Dental Care! My husband and I have been going to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for 25 years. They are super friendly and make every patient  feel like you are the most important patient; while always providing excellence and professionalism in their work. At today's visit, Lacey was my hygienist and she was awesome! We are  very thankful for Dr. Garcia and her staff. If you are looking for a great dentist...come to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry!
