user_reviews_extended.Description:
Lucinda Garcia has been my dentist a long time. I was with another dentist after I moved to Round Rock in late 2000 & after a few years he retired. A friend recommended Parmer Lane Denistry to me and at the time the former dentist was retiring there so I got Dr. Garcia. It was great having a female dentist again, I’d had 1 in Denton where I’d moved from. But most importantly, you can tell that she cares about your mouth! And besides that, she has a much better chair side manner than my former dentist! LOL!
I highly recommend her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meredith Velasco
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been going to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for years. I go because of the atmosphere and service provided. Dr. Garcia herself is such a genuine person who cares about her patients. She is thorough, gentle and transparent when doing each dental exam or procedure. It is also evident that she cares about her staff and keeping the office environment special. All the staff (front desk, hygienists, dental assistants) are wonderful; they are always professional, attentive and welcoming as soon you walk through the door. If you don’t like going to the dentist, try this practice and you may just have your mind changed. They really are an amazing dental office team! (I could but I didn’t include specific names because I haven’t met any staff member who didn’t share in deserving the recognition and appreciation.).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abbie Gomez - Aurelius
user_reviews_extended.Description: The woman at the front desk was so awesome and the entire staff was so welcoming and nice. I just switched from a  pediatric dentist to this office and they made the transition easy and stress free. So happy to have found such an awesome place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clarissa Francis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great first visit to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry! As soon as I walked in the door they were so inviting and pleasant. The dental hygienist made me feel at ease and very thorough. Dr. Garcia was so nice and had a wonderful bedside manner. I am so glad I chose this office as my new dental provider.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Beth Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to this dental practice for many years because they are the BEST! I have had some dental emergencies and they were able to see me immediately and refer me to a specialist the same day. They are very friendly and upbeat and make you feel at ease. They are aways willing to work with their patients regarding scheduling and financial issues. Dr. Garcia is very gentle,  thorough and compassionate with her patients. This is the only dental office for me and I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Dailey
user_reviews_extended.Description: There are not enough stars for the level of genuine care and professionalism I could give this office. I’m terrified of dentists and I feel so heard,  respected and most importantly taken care of here. If you are seeking the top notch care for dental work this is your place. Dr Garcia and staff are the real deal :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melvin Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Parmer Ln Family Dentistry has the best ambience, and the best hygienist. It doesn’t feel like you’re going to the dentist, it feels like you’re visiting your family. The customer service is incredible. Starting with Alma and Denise welcoming and helping everyone feel at home- to Maloney, Brandi, Des and of course Leisy. Dr. Garcia and her team are the best. Thank y'all, for what you do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria
user_reviews_extended.Description: Y'all, this is a true family practice and a practical one at that. From my first phone consult to first cleaning, I felt so welcomed, heard, and valued. Relieved to mark "find a good dentist" off my list.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Lusby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Parmer Lane Family Dental has a family feel. You are the priority. I love the detail they put into your care plan. They are easy to work with financially with many options. Dental cleanings are easy and comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jen shugert
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My family loves it here! The staff is above and beyond friendly. The office has a very warm environment. We have been coming here for 3 years after another dentist rudely dismissed us for being late to an appointment. I have never had that experience here. They always call or text re: upcoming appointments. They are great at helping to coordinate when I prefer to bring all my kids at once or if multiple parties need to be called for an appointment. Just recently my daughter required a filling. She is very small and young. Dr. Garcia was wonderful. She was so tender and gentle by taking her time to explain every little thing to my daughter and she worked incredibly fast so my daughter would not leave with a negative dentist experience.
If you have children I highly recommend trying Dr. Garcia first.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LORI MOSLEY
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing! It’s difficult to find a good dentist. Dr. Garcia and her staff are the kindest, most caring, talented group of medical professionals I have ever interacted with. They have taken excellent care of me for years and even moved things around at the last minute to see me in an emergency.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen Hilton
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been going to Parmer FAMILY Dentist a few years; our recent experience has lead us to no longer value their services.  My husband had an absess on a tooth that had been worked on from this office a few months ago.  He emailed the office requesting an appointment 6-7 days ago and we still haven't heard back from them. I took him after hour to urgent care, a couple of days after he requested an appointment. the urgent care said we need to get him to the dentist ASAP! We called the after hours number, while still in the urgent care and 2+ hours later we received a call back.  We were told they didn't feel it was urgent and would work him Monday, this was Thursday evening.   Monday am, they text they could see him at 9am.  Great, well not really.  The billing person text him about 730am that he had a balance and that needed to be paid and the EMERGENCY visit would have to be paid in full prior to the appointment.  The billing person had sent the balance a month or so after the original visit but, when asked what this is for,  we received no explanation,  just its the balance.  How can one have a balance when you paid in full at the time of service?   This has happened a few times after procedures,  and no explanation is offered.  I don't understand their billing issues,  if they are quoting an amount,  and you pay it in full that should be it.  My husband went elsewhere,  was treated really well,  the tooth was removed and he is on the road to recovery. The new office showed him the breakdown of the cost, it was simple and efficient, and he paid it in full.  It is unfortunate that their billing is so incompetent and we have an incurred hidden costs at all procedural appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Morgan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been seeing Dr. Garcia since she bought Parmer Lane Family Dentistry from my previous Dentist.  My Son’s family has also been patients of Dr. Garcia for a number of years and they referred me to the Parmer Lane Family Dentistry office when I moved to North Austin.  Dr. Garcia uses current technology to treat her patients to provide the best care available and my dental reports have really improved under her care!  She and her staff are very professional and caring.  Thank you Dr. Garcia and staff!  Your the best!  Deb M.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kay Shears
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient at Parmer Lane Family Dentistry over 10 years.  Who can say you enjoy going to the dentist?  I certainly can because Dr. Garcia is a wonderful dentist who is very caring and takes the time to answer any questions or concerns you may have.  She and her staff are friendly and treat you like family.   It's always a joy to walk through their doors.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Fetter
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is Kathy Fetter, very professional and thorough, gentle and considerate of you as a person, not just a patient. Recommend this Doctor to anyone who asks me very satisfied yall are thebw
e
Best..thank you all.for a referance to finding a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time going to see Dr Garcia and she is amazing. She is unlike any other dentist I have been too. She treats you like family and genuinely cares about the best quality of care for her patients. The entire staff at Parmer Lane Family Dentistry are fantastic. I will never to anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a loyal patient at Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for close to 25 years. I have known Dr. Garcia and Alma for the entire time they have been with PLFD. Personally, I imagine like many people, I used to dread going to the dentist. My early-life episodes of rough dental handling and being chastised for not caring for my teeth properly made me feel ashamed, and not want to go to the dentist at all. So I didn't. It was a vicious cycle.

My teeth were in pretty bad shape when I first arrived to PLFD. From the moment I was first seen by Dr. Garcia, I felt cared for, I felt the empathy from the staff and Dr. Garcia, and I was educated on the proper way to manage my dental health. For the first time at a dental office, I was happy. With their encouragement and education, I have been able to sustain my self-care, and have been able to consistently rely on the love and support from Dr. Garcia and the staff in times of personal difficulty and in times of success.

I may sound like a broken record to the PLFD staff, but I actually look forward to going to the dentist. After my earlier experiences, that is a phrase I never thought I would utter, but thanks to Dr. Garcia, Alma, and the rest of the staff over the years, I can state that phrase with the same fervor as I did at the time of my first encounter at Parmer Lane Family Dentistry.

Without reservation, I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Garcia and her staff to anyone who is looking for the same superior level of care that I have had. Trust me, the experience has the power to change your life! You won't be able to wipe the smile off of your face.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Fraser
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My entire family has been going to Parmer Lane dental for at least 15 years.  Everyone from the hygienists to the front desk to Dr Garcia are extremely kind, knowledgeable and helpful. They are all so warm and welcoming to my kids that they 'almost' don't even mind going to the dentist. My husband and I actually get excited to go because we get to see the awesome staff!

The hygienists do an excellent job of introducing young kids to the process of getting their teeth cleaned.  My little one has never dreaded going to the dentist since they make him so comfortable!

I would highly recommend Parmer Lane Dental to anyone looking for a competent dentist that has a family type feeling that you know you can trust!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mia Spennato
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is THE BEST. First off, you are greeted by the most incredible people at the front who treat you like family. They know you by name and really make you feel at home. The lobby/check in area is always decorated so nicely and they have tea and water and magazines while you wait. The dental hygienists are always so friendly and get to know you as well as do a fantastic job cleaning. Dr. Garcia has done such a good job with my teeth, I have never gotten a cavity! Most people hate coming to the dentist but I love it because of these people! I always leave happy and with my mouth feeling super clean and fresh.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen May Petilo-Pernito
user_reviews_extended.Description: Felt so welcome here as always with all the amazing staff and Dr Garcia herself. I came to visit with my nephew today, and so grateful for his hygienist Brandy for making him so comfortable since  its his first time seeing a dentist here. She is so awesome in explaining everything that it was such a breeze.  Thank you everyone. Y'all are amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark W Lindgren
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient for decades and have always been taken care of very well. Dr. Garcia and all the staff provide the best dental care in a warm and friendly atmosphere. They have always gone the extra mile to make my experience easier and better. I am happy to call the folks at Parmer Lane Family Dentistry my friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Whoopti Do
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Parmer Lane since they opened. Has been very friendly, pleasant. They will work with you on payments have had many options in the past. Work is great, if you are sent to a specialist, they even check up on you to see if you are ok. They do take the time to get to know you and they make sure if it is hurting or not. Have not had much issue there. They even offer you options for basic insurance if you have none and it is reasonable. I am a veteran and do have the option for free dental but prefer to go to Parmer Lane Family Dentist DR. Lucinda Garcia is Excellent along with her staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin Butler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best place in North Austin to get your teeth cleaned or cared for. I have been a customer at this location for 25+Years, the friendly & fun staff has always kept me returning.  Dr. Garcia is amazing and she makes sure my teeth are super healthy. Alma and the front staff make sure I never miss an appointment. Love this place and the people that work here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alice Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: As soon as you walk into the office you are greeted by Alma who is the  sweetest person, and who is very knowledgeable when it comes to billing/insurance. My hygienist Brandi was amazing and very gentle. Thank you Dr Garcia for having such an awesome team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Colin Nix
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. Garcia and her wonderful staff for more than a decade.  In that time, I have seen them go through a remodel and expansion of the office, and make numerous improvements.  One thing has always remained a constant, though - the high level of care and the friendly atmosphere of everyone on the staff.  I started going to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry as I needed a regular place to do my cleanings.  I then did Invisalign through them, which I was very happy with.  I relocated to Dallas almost 8 years ago, but I continue to make trips to Austin for my dental needs.  That is how much I believe in and enjoy the care I receive at Parmer Lane, and from Dr. Garcia and her staff.  They always greet you with a smile and put you at ease, are very communicative, and always do a great job.  They've become my little dental family that I look forward to visiting.  I enthusiastically recommend them for all of my Austin friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobby Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Trusted Parmer Lane for more than a decade, great service and very friendly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Cantu
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Garcia is so gentle and caring, and her staff is fantastic.  My kids love her because she makes them feel so comfortable.  I truly feel like the people here care about my family's dental health.  When it came to my insurance, Alma, the office manager, helped me understand the ins and outs -- she took her time to explain everything. I would recommend this office to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Courtright
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was traveling for work this summer and desperately needed some dental work. I was recommended to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry and I must say it was a great experience. The ladies who work here are incredibly kind and Dr. Garcia is very straight forward with you which is nice. I had a great experience here and would recommend to anyone in the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicolette Hebert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for several years. From the moment you walk in the door, you are treated like family. Alma, Jessica, Monika, and Dr. Garcia are all amazing. I look forward to my appointments so much that I wish I was able to get my teeth cleaned more than twice a year …  just so I could come by and see all of them more often. Also, while you're getting your teeth cleaned, you may get a chance to see Dr. Garcia's two beautiful dogs running around out back! Thank you all for taking care of me and my smile!  :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Drumgole
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update 12/13/21: I was having issues with my wisdom tooth, and was able to not only schedule a last minute emergency visit, but Alma and the ladies at the front desk also made sure to schedule my emergency visit for the same day that their Dr. Was going to be I. The office to perform the extraction! Typically it’s hard to find a last minute appointment at the end of the year, but I was able to get my issue resolved.

I have been coming here for over 8 years, and all the receptionists at the front are awesome and welcoming! They’re really good of sending reminders for your appointments!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Savageau
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic dental facility!  I am in the medical profession myself, so I appreciate everything that goes into the experience .  Alma and Jessica both make me feel so welcome and special every time I call or come for my appointments.  They are little rays of sunshine (and models for what I hope my front desk staff can be).  Monika is a wonderful, and thorough hygienist who explains what she is finding as she goes and discusses different options in detail.  Dr. Garcia is kind and fantastic as well.  From front to back it is a great experience and makes me actually look forward to going to the dentist (shocking I know!).  Nicole Savageau

user_reviews_extended.Name: JC JayCee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here since mid 2021 and the staff is great’ super friendly, knowledgeable, everyone always has a smile on their face! and the dentist Dr.Garcia is awesome at what she does! Very thorough work and honest! Can not wait to get Invisalign next!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frank Clarkson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Garcia and everyone on her team (from the front desk- Jessica and Alma, to Deirdra behind the scenes) are consistently caring and attentive to details. I have been nothing short of pleased with their service and the dental work done so far.  Options are always presented in a manner that I can follow, and I truly feel that they care about my well-being.  I am loyal patient, and I would recommend to place to anyone looking for a great dentist with an amazing staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Holden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of parmer lane family dentistry for over 20 years. Dr. Garcia is wonderful as is staff. Highly recommend for all dental care. Lacey is excellent hygentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki Powell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I enjoyed my experience from the first phone call with Alma down to leaving my appointment! Alma is full of great energy. Originally I was booked out into march, but Alma had an opening and didn’t forget to give me a call!

I enjoyed my cleaning with Leisy, she made me feel comfortable as I haven’t had a cleaning since the pandemic.

It was also a pleasure getting to meet Dr. Garcia and getting to chat with her about all my concerns. I’m glad I decided to give them a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kendra Germenis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Automatically received good vibes when both ladies who answered the phone radiated positivity - refreshing. Same experience in person - super friendly staff. Dr. Garcia was very patient and helpful answering questions I had related to managing my toddler's teeth (and other random toddler topics of discussion). It never felt rushed. Overall I feel very comfortable using Parmer Lane Family Dentistry as our dentist of choice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Parmer Lane Family is AMAZING!  They truly do create the most welcoming and professional experience with a fun atmosphere.  Alma is the nicest person you will ever meet with an incredible energy to brighten your day!  Vince does a tremendous job and combines his professional expertise with laughs to make the experience even better.  Dr. Garcia is the best with thorough analysis and devotes however much time you need for questions.  Thank you Parmer Lane!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Gandin
user_reviews_extended.Description: As of today I'm a new patient of Parmer Lane Family Dentistry and will continue to be.  The entire staff, from receptionists, the hygienists, and the dentist were absolutely amazing!  I dread the initial appointment because it's very thorough.  While this was very thorough, they made it absolutely enjoyable.  I would recommend all my family and friends to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry.  Keep up the amazing work PLFD!

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Hohl
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going here for decades, and while I started with a now-retired dentist, Dr. Garcia has provided outstanding care for years. I would highly recommend the clinic for families, and their staff is very knowledgeable about the latest advances in dental care. I drive 87 miles to get there - Dr. Garcia is worth the drive!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rondella Hawkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Parmer Lane for 15+ years and will continue for as long as I live in the Austin area.  The reasons are the friendliness of all the staff, the quality of work by the hygienists and Dr. Garcia, and they offer the latest practices in care and technology.    I know it sounds crazy but I look forward to seeing the staff!  Alma and Jessica, at the front desk, are always smiling and laughing and it rubs off!  Dr. Garcia is gentle and explains her procedures.  I highly recommend anyone to give them a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Lindsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Phenomenal group of professional, friendly, amazing ladies! You feel like old friends in no time! Dr. Garcia and her wonderful team provide stellar customer service and the best dental services I’ve ever had. I’m NOW no longer terrified to see the dentist and my teeth are getting the care and attention they deserve. These women are GOLD!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Nipper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wish I could give more than five stars!! The entire team at Parmer Lane Family Dentistry is amazing. My husband & I have been going there for the last 8-10 years & they have taken excellent care of us. Everything from routine cleanings to cavity fillings to night-guard cleanings - they have us covered. We always feel like we're their favorite patients (which is likely not the case, but that's how they come across). We now bring our 4 year old & a 2 year old to the dentist, as well. Our kids are very cautious around doctors or strangers, but they absolutely LOVE going to the dentist. Our 4 year old gets a full cleaning (like a big kid!) & our 2 year old is still doing "happy visits." These have been awesome to provide a positive experience around visiting the dentist. We can't say enough good stuff about these folks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bahia Amawi
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is always welcoming and efficient. I rarely have to wait— always prompt. The hygienists are skilled and respectful. The dentist is wonderful, caring, knowledgeable and treats everyone with personal touch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael von der Gruen
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place has a great family vibe, everyone that works there us super nice and they all have great bedside manner. Lots of cool technology. They clearly take what they are doing seriously and I didn't feel like I was been taken for a ride the way I have felt at popular chain dentists. They've been my dental place for the last 15 years (even if I don't go as often as I should!)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kellie Wendt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for more than 25 years!  The staff always goes above and beyond.  They are amazing - they make you feel welcome and are very attentive.  Highly recommend if you want a dentist that makes you smile!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Galvis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely hated going to the dentist, that is until I became a patient of Dr.Garcia's. When you walk in you are immediately greeted with smiles and a warm welcome from Alma and Jessica. It's always Hey Christina how are you? followed by how's your family? Then Chris is my hygienist is amazing, she remembers every detail and makes my cleanings a breeze. Then Dr.Garcia she is hands down the best dentist I have ever had. She explains things so clear and puts you at ease. I will not go to another dentist. This office has truly captured what it means to serve their patients. From the moment you walk in its like you are with family. I highly recommend Parmer lane family dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Missy Sharpe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is always so friendly & knowledgeable. They make you feel so comfortable just like you’re family. I highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawn P
user_reviews_extended.Description:
When I was young I fell and ended up breaking two teeth pretty badly. I was rushed in to the dentist. There was a mix up and they started working on my mouth before I had been properly numbed / deadened. Eventually they discovered their mistake, but the damage was done.

Ever since then, because I was so young, I’ve had an extreme amount of anxiety when going to the dentist.

I tell you this so you know where I am coming from when I tell you that Dr. Garcia and her staff make me actually look forward to going to see the dentist. When you walk in you are warmly greeted by faces that have been there for a long time and have gotten to know you. The oral hygienists have always been aware of my discomfort and were gentle and understanding; they never rushed me and always made me feel like I was in control.

I have been going to see Dr. Garcia for over a decade now. The level of care has only improved. Every recommendation she has made along the way has been given with my best interest in mind versus what was best for her pocket book. This is a rare quality to find in others and speaks volumes about how her business is run; patients first.

You simply cannot go wrong by choosing Dr. Garcia as your dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: D Dukes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Garcia has to have one of the best practices in the area. There are few great dentists who care about their work so much that they will take the time to do everything right instead of lowering their quality for the sole purpose of trying to increase revenue.  I drive way out of my way to have Dr. Garcia do any of my dental work because I know no one else can do it better. Dr. Garcia is very professional and meticulous and seems to expect the same from her staff. Dr. Garcia appears to be a great leader as well as a great dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Roch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just completed another successful visit to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry. Dr Garcia and the entire team are just the best. I couldn't recommend them stronger. They make going to the dentist a pleasure. And as always Alma defies superlatives.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patti Donlon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient at Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for 20 years.  Dr. Garcia and staff are an awesome group to interact with.  If you are new to the area, or looking for a new dentist,  I highly recommend Parmer Lane Family Dentistry

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Freyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is going to sound weird, but I actually look forward to going to the dentist. It’s usually the brightest part of my day. I walk in and am greeted with the most friendly staff and hygensists who are always so positive and helpful. And Dr Garcia is awesome as well! They are always going the extra mile to help with insurance and they are super flexible and easy to schedule with. Love!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roland Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experiences with Parmer Lane Family Dentistry has always been a very good experience. I couldn't ask for a cleaner, friendly and professional investment to keep up with my dental needs. I highly recommend them for all your dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best customer service in Austin. If you are new to the city and are looking for a family or personal dentist, then please reach out to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry. Their staff is very helpful, professional and SUPER FRIENDLY. Dr. Garcia did an amazing job re-bridging my teeth from a previous dentist. You will not be disappointed if you choose Parmer Lane Family Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Valdez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been coming here for close to a decade and the staff and Dr. Garcia are always so nice and friendly and the type of positive energy we need more of in the world!
Clean facilities, on time appointments without long waiting times, and informative discussions with technology to support your dental history.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dirck & Diamond Gillam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here for years. Great atmosphere. Everyone is really welcoming and friendly at this point I consider them family. Alma has always been extremely helpful. My hygienist, Vince is awesome at his job. Everyone keep up the great work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raye Sansom
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for many years. Dr. Garcia and her Team are top-notch!!
They truly care about Each patient and the whole office has Terrific Energy and All positive vibes!! 😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jake L.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for about 20 years now and they are truly a pleasure to go to. Jessica and Alma up at the front are always very helpful with questions on financials. Dr. Garcia exemplifies professionalism and everyone from reception to the assistants to the dentists themselves treat you like a member of the family. 10/10 patients reccomend. 👌🏻👌🏻

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casey Morris
user_reviews_extended.Description: They treat you like family, and the positive energy is contagious!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leon
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time I went to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry I was a UPS driver and noticed how welcoming they would always be to me . At the time I needed a dentist and took a chance on them. It was one of the best decisions I have made. They are the best dentist in town! Been a patient since 2004!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Iv gotta say I regret not coming here for awhile. With all the bad experiences that I have had with previous dentist...I didn’t realize what I was missing at Parmer Lane Family Dentistry. The staff their have an upbeat positive attitude...especially the two front receptionist. They know me really well! Now as far as Dr. Garcia, Iv gotta say I am very impressed with the work she has done to my teeth, especially the top front teeth. She was able to figure out a solution to fix the damage that was done from previous dental work. And now I have confidence with my smile. Her kindness and Level of professionalism is what attracts me to keep my trust in her, for every dental visit. I would definitely recommend PARMER LANE FAMILY DENTISTRY to my family,friend’s, coworker’s, and to anyone that reads this review. I promise you won’t be disappointed!

Kevin

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenni Velazquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dental office! I've been a patient with PLFD for almost 5 years now and I wouldn't trust anyone else with my dental care! All of the ladies are super friendly. Love the ladies at the front office and of course Monika and Dr. Garcia! I love telling people about how great y'all are!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeanne Talerico
user_reviews_extended.Description: I never thought I would enjoy going to the dentist!  However, PLFD has totally changed my opinion.Dr Garcia truly cares about her patients & her staff.  She and the staff are all so kind & caring. I have gone from being terrified of every dentist...to being eager to go for my periodic appointments & a couple of "smash-your-face" emergencies.  Give them a try - you will never be disappointed!  THANK YOU LADIES!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddy Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: Outstanding customer service. They made me feel welcome and comfortable in a time that I normally very nervous. My daughter also went and she actually enjoyed her visit which says a lot about a dentist. Went for another visit today. Wow this place is amazing. I actually don’t mind going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Hilton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Where does one begin.
One word: INCOMPETENT
Assuming they share the cost prior to the proceedure you can count on the billing department to send you an addition bill.
The best experience is
having to endure the office gossip, I found this a painful way to pass your time.
The final nail in the coffin was when reaching out to them via their web site, for an assess tooth and attempted to schedule an appointment. I posted this request on 8.6.24 and as this review we have yet to be contacted.
I have found a wonderful dentist up the street and no longer will use the caotic services of Parmer Family Dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Mason
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a fun place. The ladies at the front desk are hilarious. They always make me feel welcomed and lower my anxiety level about coming to the dentist. I feel well taken care of and they never over recommend treatment. A conservative approach is taken, which is something I never got from my previous dentist. I’ve been loyal for over 13 years and counting!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittney Hestand
user_reviews_extended.Description: This staff is THE BEST!!! Dr. Garcia and her crew always accommodate my needs and deliver amazing results. My family and I have been coming here for years and they have always felt like a second home. 10/10 would recommend :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peter Gregg
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been coming here for years.  My wife, myself and both kids have had everything from cleanings to fairly major procedures done.  This team treats you like family, gets to know you and genuinely cares.  They are great about working in emergencies as well as communicating in general.  I would not go anywhere else for dental care.  Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Marrow
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lucinda Garcia's skill, attention to detail, and professionalism are top notch!  The staff are all very friendly, the technicians are great, and everyone makes you feel like you're part of the family.  I highly recommend Parmer Lane Family Dentristry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Mills
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient here for many years, and I always have a great visit. The staff are super friendly and fantastic. They will make you feel right at home as soon as you walk in the door. Dr. Garcia and her team will really take care of you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Howard Hestand
user_reviews_extended.Description: The friendliest medical/dental staff I know.  Very helpful. Dr. Garcia is an excellent Dentist that will take the time to know you and take very good care of your oral health.  She has done a great job in staff selection and growing her business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Grant
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently began seeing Dr. Garcia and had such a wonderful experience that I brought my wife and daughters to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry.  The staff, technicians, and doctors are second to none in Austin.  I continue to recommend them to my family and friends alike.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casey Bridges
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a client of Parmer Lane Dentistry for 25 plus years. You won’t find a better group of people anywhere. Don’t take my word for it, go see for yourself!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Sapieha
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They are the BEST!!! I have a severe dental phobia and they do a FANTASIC job going above and beyond to make my visits as stress free and pleasant as possible! The staff is incredibly friendly and make you feel like family the moment you call or walk in the door! They do a great job of explaining the procedures (and why they’re necessary!) and what is/is not covered by insurance. I wouldn’t imagine going anywhere else!

PS When I read the non-five star reviews, I feel like they’re talking about a completely different practice!! Definitely take with a grain of salt ;)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Youens
user_reviews_extended.Description: On the visit I wanted an estimate for some extensive dental work.  The price I was quoted seemed high.  I got another quote which was about half the price, so I went with the other dentist that was not as close.   They did great work, but I intended to stay with Parmer Lane Dentistry because they are close to my home.  I had an appointment I set the previous week and 30 minutes before the appointment they called and said they couldn't help me.  Retribution for not using them for the first procedure?  I am not sure, but cancelling 30 minutes before my appointment is not cool.  Beware!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sean Buck
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been with a Parmer Lane family dentistry for around 18 years now on and off. Everybody there is amazing and make you feel very welcome. They do great work! Can’t bring myself to go anywhere else even though I have moved an hour and a half away. I still make the trip. I never really took good care of my teeth but they drew up a plan and I have slowly taken care of what I have needed to all these years. I’m at the stage where I have Invisalign now so not too much longer and I’ll have a “ Hollywood smile“ as they would say lol
I’ve always hated going to the dentist getting extractions, feelings, having to get numb for whatever’s coming next. I now love going there and not nervous at all. Super excited about my smile now. Highly recommend giving them a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: D Arlyn Marks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Careful, efficient, professional staff. I’ve been satisfied with their dental work for seven years. Although my medical insurance doesn’t cover Parmer Lane, there is a reasonable monthly pay plan that covers two yearly cleanings plus some additional work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johanna Brooks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am from out of state and had an emergency while traveling. This team got me in quickly and were incredibly supportive and so kind given my situation. They front desk team was amazing and so fun. The Dentist and dental assistant were both the best I've even had. They were completely focused on my comfort level and making sure they took care of me completely since I was on the road. Could not recommend more!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Henning
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here for 10 years, had the same dentist and hygienist the whole time - very personal experience. Obviously, I was expecting to pay $850, not $950 + $220. I'm sure they didn't get as much from the insurance as they expected. They wouldn't even talk it through with me. Said I needed to pay, after a few months turned me into collections. It's a shame cuz I really did like this place and except for billing I always a great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Always refreshing and exhilarating front office and staff to greet me when I first arrive. user_reviews_extended.Name: Lanette Thaler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I CANNOT recommend PLFD enough.  Everyone - from the front desk staff, to the financial specialists, to the dental hygienists, to the doctors - are there for YOU.  You're not merely a dollar sign to them; you're a valued patient, a PERSON, and they take your needs and comfort into consideration with ALL they do.  I've been going to see Dr. Garcia and her staff for almost 10 years, and even though they are out of network for me, I will NEVER go to anyone else because once you find a doctor and a practice you can trust with your dental needs (and finances), you don't want to lose that.  I've personally had several interactions with Alma, Jessica, and Dr. Garcia and I am proud to call them friends in addition to providers.  Each dental hygienist I've had has taken care of my cleanings and xrays with the utmost respect for my comfort.  I'm never "oversold" on practices or needless accessories; in fact, Dr. Garcia has always taken a conservative stance with my case.  She is NOT about the dollar and always cares for her patients.  They helped me get a beautiful smile with Invisalign and kept it brilliant with Zoom whitening.  I only write reviews when I'm either really happy or really upset with something, and in this case, it's the former.  If you are in search of a dentist, go see Dr. Garcia and her staff at PLFD.  It will be the best dental choice you've ever made!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maree Scherwitz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this office and everyone in it! I have been coming here since I was in college and even though I have moved further south, it is well worth the commute. They are more like family now. Always professional and knowledgeable. Highly recommend, and will be taking my children here in years to come!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Griffith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The dentist office is very nice, the staff is incredibly friendly and I have nothing bad to say about that. However, I went in for a simple cleaning, I was a new patient so I expected to get xrays and everything done and was anticipating being there for a while. After I was there for two hours, or more, they told me I needed to get a deep cleaning done of my entire mouth. They did not do my basic cleaning, took me to an office and said I needed to schedule the deep cleaning ASAP and there was no point in doing the cleaning on this day. They never gave me the option. They did not say we would like to do a deep cleaning, but if you still want a cleaning today we can provide that, they did not provided me information on why the deep cleaning was needed, they just put me in an office and told me to schedule the appointment. They kept insisting this needed to be done, or I would start having severe pain. I was so turned off by the experience that I went to another office to get a second opinion. They did say I needed a deep cleaning, but it was not an emergency and it only needed to be the back of my mouth (also significantly less). And they actually did my cleaning since that is what I came in for.

I left the first dental office feeling pressured, and very overwhelmed, and felt that they were just trying to get me to go the more costly route. I felt like they were going to tell me I needed this procedure no matter what the xrays said. I was very disappointed because the staff was very friendly and I was looking forward to going to this office since it was so close to my home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Tex
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Garcia and staff have always provided excellent dental care for me. I got Invisalign here many years ago, and actually have been going here since before Dr Garcia took over the practice from the previous Dentist (been going here over 20 years).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Russell Stout
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a great office.  Staff is extremely friendly and they do awesome work.  I love my dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allen Gooden
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Sadly (or luckily) I don't have a full services review.  I was looking for a new dentist closer to my home and tried to choose Parmer Lane Family Dentistry.  Spoke to Jessica and was made aware they are "non-contracted with any dental insurance" and as such, I am liable for anything not covered by a simple cleaning.  I've had tooth cleanings done twice a year for 30 yrs and have never paid extra for cleaning.  However, I was told since Parmer Lane Family Dentistry is not contracted with any dental insurance program, I'm on the hook for whatever insurance doesn't pay.  Asked what a cleaning costs, and was told somewhere north of $300.
I'm sure they are a pretty good practice, but definitely got the feeling this was going to be one of the most expensive avenues for getting a simple cleaning, and likely any other services rendered for that matter.
Too many good practices in town, and close to my home, to risk being billed extra for a simple cleaning.  No thanks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Nichols
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have been with Parmer Lane Family Dentistry for years. Dr. Garcia is an excellent dentist and all of her staff are top notch. I wouldn’t want to go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Briana Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Austin native born & raised here, so listen: I will never go to any other dentist for as long as I live. The fact is, they really are family. I started going to Parmer Lane Family Dentistry (PLFD) after I got my braces off around 2014, had not been to the dentist in three years, and belived I had just chipped a tooth. They got me in quickly, fixed me up, and made me feel so comfortable that I didn't even realize I was at the dentist.
Fast forward to me leaving to finish college in 2017 and  everyone is crying as I leave, including me.
**Good part**
Fast forward, again, to me graduating last December, getting new insurance, and coming back to Austin. My insurance is only accepted at two facilities in Austin. So I go to the one that was not rated 2.3 stars on google. This is not thier review so I will just say I walked out with a numbed mouth, it was so traumatizing.
I called PLFD first thing Monday morning. I did not care what it cost. They got me in within the hour for my exam (mind you, my xrays were already done at the other facility). It was a party when I came back & like I had never left at all!!! And, I was told I would need 3 fillings LESS than what was going to be performed on me at the scary place.
Putting it on my carecredit it made it 18 months no interest. So really, it almost came out to a better deal than insurance to go to the best dentist in the WORLD (of Austin).
Dr. Garcia and her team are amazing!
Shoutout to Monika, Jessica, & Alma!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Looten
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wanted to love this place, but left with an understanding this isn’t the place for our family.  We moved into the neighborhood and were in search for great dentist.  The staff and dentist were over the top friendly both over the phone and in person.  I was very clear I didn’t want to be out of pocket in very much since we have dental insurance.  Their quote didn’t cover my costs out of pocket.  I asked lots of questions and got a quote.  They are out of network to everyone...period.  They don’t call your insurance company.  Their estimate has no true validity.  It’s a shot in the dark average at best.  They say they are clear but this is blunt.  They weren’t transparent.  I requested to not have a billion xrays upon my first visit.  I even thought I’d have xrays transferred from my old dentist.  They said some were needed to see what was going on with my teeth.  I’d had twins and knew my teeth had suffered through pregnancy so I went with needing a few xrays, but at least 20 xrays were taken.  My teeth were cleaned.  I saw the very sweet dentist 5 minutes and I don’t think she even looked in my mouth.  The visit took over two hours.  I remember thinking everything about this place is odd.  I feel like I didn’t even see a dentist.  My dental hygienist relayed everything about what was going on in my mouth to the Dr. Garcia. They were insistent I come back in the check my night guard that I’d forgotten.  I have young twins.  I cancelled the appointment and said surely it could wait until my visit in 6 months.  They didn’t agree but I haven’t been back.  I’ve had several charges at this point and they exceed what I’d initially been quoted.  It’s a great environment, pretty fancy , and remodeled, and very friendly staff.  If you are looking for transparent billing and less fancy, more simple, a few xrays to make sure your teeth aren’t falling out, a proper cleaning every 6 months, and a dentist you engage with one to one for 10-15 minutes or more...this is not your place.

title: Access Dental
address: 1923 E 7th St #120, Austin, TX 78702, United States

user_reviews.Name: Jimmy Baltierra
user_reviews.Description:
I had an amazing experience at Access Dental, and I have to give a special shoutout to Jaunita  for her outstanding customer service! From the moment I walked in, she greeted me with a warm smile and made me feel completely at ease. She was incredibly professional, patient, and went above and beyond to answer all my questions.

Jaunita took the time to explain everything clearly, ensuring I felt comfortable throughout my visit. Her friendly and caring attitude made my experience so much better, and I truly appreciate her dedication to excellent service.

If you’re looking for a dental office with a welcoming atmosphere and top-notch care, I highly recommend Access Dental—and be sure to ask for jaunita! She’s the best!

user_reviews.Name: quenae Brown
user_reviews.Description: They will have you sitting in the waiting room for an hour and a half even though they bothers you and blew up your phone to get you to waste your time and come down. DO NOT BOOK WITH THESE PEOPLE. I got here at 10:37 am for an 11:00 appointment. When I got here they couldn’t find my information even though they said they had it red flag number one I had to keep going up and bothering them to see what was going on with my appointment and they had Peopel that came after me going ahead of me red flag number two the third and final flag was me seeing  after an hour of waiting what was going on and them telling me they needed 30 more minute because they were waiting on a room because they let the people go ahead of me. If you have a whole day to waste then by all means come to this run down hole in the wall unprofessional place but if not avoid this place by any means necessary!!!!!!

user_reviews.Name: Vinit Shah
user_reviews.Description: Do NOT come here u less you have half a day to spent. Regardless of appt time you’ll be waiting an hour plus. They absolutely do not value customers time and book numerous appointments at the same time knowing they’ll only have 1 dentist available. Attempted to go twice but had to cancel both times after waiting too long. There are numerous other dentist places in the area, would highly recommended ANY other.

user_reviews.Name: Linda Clark
user_reviews.Description:
Lack of communication and lack of proper care.
I told to the front desk I am deaf I couldn't hear my name when called. Interpreter needed. Free interpreter that they could have gotten. Long wait.
I got mad I was frustrated and I was not patient. How awful.
I really wanted to stay nice.
I had drive a senior tranportation waiting one hour limit but I can ask for more time.
I didn't know the doctor's name but she did cleaned my teeth very good.
I think now I get tired of dentists, and doctors too.

user_reviews.Name: Kenneth Biddle
user_reviews.Description: If I could give less than one star I would. .01 star rating from me. I call it's my initial appointment. I've got a train wreck in my mouth and just bought this dental insurance Delta dental out of pocket and I called them and told them who I was and they asked me if I had insurance and I said yes and gave them all my insurance information and said this is an initial first appointment and they made me an appointment for like 2 weeks later which is today and I walk in and then say yes. I'm Kenneth. I have the 12:00 and I sit down and she said oh Kenneth we don't take your insurance. It's a PPO and we don't take those. I'm sorry. Excuse me!? You don't take my insurance!? Then why would you take my insurance information over the phone and make me an appointment and wait until I show up 2 weeks later to tell me? I've been looking forward to this and getting my mouth worked on for quite some time now. Oh man, I can't believe it!. So when I gave you my Delta dental insurance plan number, it didn't pop up that you don't accept that insurance when you're making my first appointment? Who's running this operation? Kindergarteners? Am I your first patient? I mean that's why you asked me if I had insurance, correct? And I said yes and that should have been the end of it right?. I mean why do you need to know my insurance ID number and who I've got insurance through? What does that matter?? You asked me if I had insurance and I said yes. Now make me an appointment. I have insurance okay. That's what happened in it when I told you I had Delta dental plan. My ID number blah blah blah what did you get distracted? While I was telling you all that information, you got something else you you are doing while I'm.. I mean I wasn't in there 5 minutes and they're like oh I'm sorry we don't take your insurance. You know. Sorry for the inconvenience. I had to get an Uber there and back and cost me like $40. Do not make an appointment with these people

user_reviews.Name: Alyssa Valdez
user_reviews.Description: Got several fillings done, checked in 30 minutes before and got seen hours later just to wait again. Filling just broke after feeling discomfort that the doctor said was just “enamel shortage to the tooth”. Very disappointed.

user_reviews.Name: Erez Porat
user_reviews.Description:
I would only consider going here in case of an emergency.
I went in for a routine cleaning, which felt very brief and rushed - it lasted only a few minutes. During the visit, I was told I had two cavities. I later decided to get a second opinion at another dental office, and was told I didn’t have any. This left me uncertain about the accuracy of the initial diagnosis. Overall, I left feeling like the focus might be more on insurance billing than on patient care.
I’m am giving two stars and not one because the reception service was very good.

user_reviews.Name: Sandi Zens
user_reviews.Description:
Lack of communication from the staff has resulted in an extremely disappointing experience. I scheduled my children's appointments for the week of spring break and ensured my schedule was clear, anticipating potential delays due to the reviews of them overbooking.
Unfortunately, for my appointment last week I ended up waiting nearly 4 hours.
Since I paid in full, switching to another office was not an option.
I am still awaiting their response regarding a necessary cap.  Today, both of my children had appointments scheduled just minutes apart. One child was seen by a doctor, while the other was supposed to see a different doctor.
After an hour, my daughter returned to our room to inform us that her appointment was complete.

However, after waiting an additional hour without any updates on my son, I inquired with the staff about the delay. The front desk informed me that the doctor would not be coming in today.
I asked why I was not informed of this sooner. The staff member replied that she was not at work the previous day and was unaware of the doctor's absence.
IThere was no apology for the inconvenience caused.
Ironically, just an hour prior, I received a text from the clinic reminding me to arrive early because the doctor would be waiting..
there’s other options to get treatment. Save the headache of being seen here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yanna “Yvnna” L.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I received a phone call from your office earlier today while I was at work. As I was unable to talk at the time, I had to end the call quickly. Shortly after, I received an extremely unprofessional and inappropriate text message from your office that read:

“A ‘NO’ WOULD HAVE BEEN GREAT IN A WORK OF ADULTS, I WILL DELETE THANK YOU.”

This kind of message is unacceptable coming from any professional setting, let alone a healthcare provider. Whether this was sent in frustration or poor judgment, it was disrespectful and out of line. I’m not sure who at your office thought this was appropriate, but I expect a higher standard from any medical practice I choose to deal with.

Please address this internally. I will be considering alternative providers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yessenia RaeAnn
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here is so friendly and welcoming. Sabrina took care of me today and made sure I was well informed of everything going on today. Dr. Loya is also super great! He always makes me feel comfortable and talks to me through every procedure that he’s done. And always gets me to laugh and feel relaxed throughout it all! 10/10 :)

user_reviews_extended.Description: Very bad - they make you wait for 2 hrs and dentist doesn’t even show up sometimes. Awful
