user_reviews_extended.Description: Too many people scheduled at the same time almost 2 hours to get the doctor started . We not coming back !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michel Costa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would like to take my one star away. I am a 51-year-old woman that had a tooth broke out at the roots. Mind you I have partials so that's messed up my whole top and bottom partials. I went to the dentist they did not care I need a tooth pulled up. They only cared about x-rays on my four freaking teeth and a cleaning for only 4 teeth, they must not be making any money anyway, I was treated horribly. I have been waiting since December to get my tooth pulled out. We are now in March. I have been going around without a smile thanks to his people I do not understand why they treat people with low income like they are nothing. I am very disappointed and very disgusted that these people could not help me with the pain I'm in and help bring a smile back to my face. I am so upset. I've been crying all day. I have waited since December. I knew my dentist was going to be out for a month but then again, this is March I am so so ashamed that I even quit my other dentist even go to you guys stay far far away specially if you're on Medicaid but I have a $5000 dental waiver and they want to give me caps on 4 teeth but they don't wanna pull my infected tooth out. And I am not writing this review out of anger, I am writing this review because say from January to March I'm sitting here with an infected tooth partials I cannot wear and they did not even care one bit. It's all about the money. I am so so sad about my mouth and the pain it has been in since December. I was not even allowed to change dentist. I was made to feel like I was a nothing. You guys are a real piece of work but I would like to say that my lovely dental assistant that I had the first time was a very sweetheart she needs to run for far away like she told me she was going to good day Acess Dental thank you for helping me feel better and thank you for helping me smile

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fern Butoryak
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place SCREAMS scam. They tried to charge me like $100 for a cleaning (which my insurance covers completely) and told me I had to come in for 2 visits for a basic cleaning and would have to pay both times? It seems they tried to charge me AND charge my insurance which is VERY suspicious. They tried to charge me for X-rays that were so low quality the new dentist I decided to start seeing couldn’t even use them as valid X-rays (the girl who took them at Access had to retake them 3 times and it was still so low quality). And on top of all of that, I asked to be removed from their call list and they proceeded to call me at least 10 times in one month trying to get me to reschedule and repeatedly asked why I am no longer using them as a dentistry. Very odd, very unprofessional. I would definitely not go here unless you’re ready for a big annoyance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Onyx Acheron
user_reviews_extended.Description:
idk try learning English???
You literally have what im talking about on your website yet you act like you don’t know what im talking about because you can’t even communicate properly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan Benitez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This location is my go-to and have never had any issues with them. Front desk, assistants and dentists are all great. I also appreciate the multiple reminder calls and texts that they send—makes it easy to not miss appointments you’ve made in advance.

I also appreciate the treatment plans that Dr. Shah has broken down for me, the steps I need to take, and every step of the way I truly feel like he has my best interests in mind. He’s great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Valle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been to this office previously with a not so great experience . But I hadn't gone in a while for a cleaning, so tried it again. The staff was really friendly. They were genuinely courteous & concerned of my well being. My Dentist was really interested in what I had to say. Very nice & professional. Going back again next week  to finish up.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Q
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I received 3 calls to confirm my appt. I confirm my appointment. Office opens at 9:00. I arrived at 8:55. A little bit of a wait to get called back.. I get it I work in the medical field too... But what's unacceptable is to be given lidocaine injections and told she'll be back in 15 minutes. Injections were given at 10:20
I waited over an hour. I asked around 11:15 if there was an update on how much longer; no one ever came back to update me.  My mouth was no longer numb. I canceled my appointment, got my refund and left at 11:30.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vernon Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Avoid this location.
I did not personally get work done here but my 68 year old mother did and the experience was horrendous for the both of us. I would not trust anyone in this office with her ever again. It took her literally seven (7) months to get dentures. She was promised that the procedure would be done by a certain time but it was not. It took four (4) more months than promised. During those seven months they removed more teeth than she went in with initially, the dentist canceled a number of times the day before her scheduled appointments (usually around 5p the day before), sometimes two appointments in a row, and they would repeat procedures over a number of visits. The dentist would only see her once a month. So if the dentist is canceling and when she does go in they're doing the same work they did the visit before, it's no wonder the procedure took so long. Then when you ask what the issue is they give you a generic, "dentist had an emergency" or "we didn't know it would take this long". This is a very unorganized office with a lack of people and communication skills. It is an office that will work on an elderly woman until they use up her insurance and force her to come out of pocket. This is an office where when you walk in you're greeted by cold receptionists who are there just to collect a paycheck. This is an office where the dentists do not care about their patients or the work they do. This is an office that will promise my mother that her procedure will be done before my wedding but then force her to show up at my wedding with missing teeth because they did not finish in time. This is an office that forces an elderly woman to struggle to eat solid food for months because they cancel appointments, repeat procedures and take advantage of elderly people.
Do not visit this location. I repeat. Do not visit this location. I do not care how simple of a procedure you are going in for. This office does not care and will try to get money from you someway, somehow. Avoid this location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan Benítez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I live right down the street from this place and it’s great! I’m a new patient here and I was able to call and within a few days I had my screening, a treatment plan, and was booked for a cleaning. It was super easy and I appreciated the front desk staff for making this process simple.

The calls to confirm my appointment were great! We’re all so busy that that simple call was a nice touch. I walked away feeling great and that this would be my go-to spot since it’s less than half a mile away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ahmed Mustafa
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is a disaster in terms of scheduling and time management. They can make you wait in the reception or on the dentist chair for hours, literally hours, without providing the required service and without even apologizing for their delay.  Unless you want to waste your time or elevate your blood pressure Do NOT go to this place. The most annoying thing after all is that their CEO is approving and encouraging their behavior !!??

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joan B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
While a little dingy, my experience here was fine. The people were nice. HOWEVER. I moved out of Austin over a year ago now. On my last visit when asked for a good date for a next appointment, I informed them I was moving and would not be able to visit again. Six months later, I get a call to confirm my appointment. I again inform them I do not live there and will not take that appointment. I continue to get calls, texts, and voicemails to this day, no matter how many numbers I block nor how many times I tell them I do not live there.

Do not visit unless you are prepared to get contacted by this office for the rest of your life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Glaze
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been seen close to my appointment time. Been coming here for at least 3 years. I’ve spent thousands of dollars out of pocket. I get called back about an hour after I arrive, every time. Why not just set the appointment time for an hour later? I will say My actual dentist is great. Idk what the issue is, maybe they don’t have enough staff to take care of the volume of clients? In addition, after I’m called back they switch between patients so much that you wait a long time in the actual chair. There is no appreciation for the fact that I have a job, and I have to take off work to come to the dentist. I shouldn’t be here for hours just to get a cleaning. I’m finding another dentist. The staff at the front couldn’t care less.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beto Cantu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had recently moved to Austin. I was there a year and a half ago for my first dental appointment and the service was great I had my x-rays done and a check up and they said I had to return, cause I had a couple of cavities. I had that done and a few weeks later I had a gap between those teeth and getting meat stuck in between them. I had went back to try to get it fixed and they said, "they could put a crown on it, but wouldn't recommend it because that would have my teeth shift more".  So I decided to just leave it as is.

I went for my 6 month cleaning and they took an hour and a half to call me back to a room and I waited another 45 minutes to get seen.  I thought maybe it was a busy day,  but when I went back for my semiannual check up again the same thing happened.  The wait was longer.

I dred making another appointment with them. I'm going to try a different location.  Hopefully it's not the same experience.🤞

user_reviews_extended.Name: Demos Then3z
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have never waited less than 45 minutes to see the dentist here. Other patents in the waiting room have waited for 2 hours or more. Because this is chronic with this practice, it's because they're overbooking patents, so by the end of the day, appointment overages stack up. It's extremely unprofessional and frankly, greedy. They have no respect for their patients' time. They call repeatedly the day before your appointment to ensure you show up, buy can't call when they're over schedule?

I got some periodontics done here and when I returned to my usual dentist, she showed me where Access Dental'd shoddy work would've caused me more pain later. Had I gotten the crown at Access as well, I would've never known until the problems started up years later.

After this dental work is done, I will never come back to this place. Dentists' time is not more important than patients' time, and it's a good indicator about how much they care about you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beverly b
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been bringing my kids here for years due to the location convience. We were here on the 9th with my daughter and today with my son. These two visits have been the best experiences we've had. I believe it's all thanks to Ms. Sabrina and Dr. A. Ms. Sabrina has been the best dental assistant here throughout our many years of visits. She's super kind and explains to my kids what she's doing as she goes along. I love that! Dr. A is equally amazing and the best dentist! She explained to my kids why they shouldn't eat candy and told them of some healthy alternatives to candy. My son will listen to her. Lol. She also answered all of his questions and he had a lot of them. I could go on and on about this wonderful experience. Thank you both for giving us a great experience! I also want to mention that these 2 visits have been the shortest visits ever. Thanks again. You two rock!

user_reviews_extended.Name: u williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very unprofessional service! I was scheduled at 4pm, waited at least 15 minutes before being seen. I came in for 6 month check up & cleaning. After doctor came in and  informed me of treatment needed, a guy comes in while I'm laying in chair with treatment paperwork. I asked about my cleaning and he stated you can get that done when you come back for treatment. All the previous times I have had X-rays and cleaning together. He then takes cloth napkin off of me. When I asked for further reasoning about why I had to come back for cleaning he then says the doctor doesn't have time. Also while I was laying in chair I could hear a conversation in next room about , getting things cleaned up so they didn't have to be there late until 7:30pm and asked other girl if she had her tent. The whole situation was unsettling. This use to be a good place. I notified my insurance company so they could not try and charge me for cleaning. I will  be looking for another dental provider. I have other friends that have complained about the UNPROFESSIONALISM and found new providers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gloria L Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just finished my appointment with Access Dental today and as usual, they were all terrific.  I spent 4 hours there because I had to get temporary crowns.  Dr. Shah was pleasant and persistent.  These temporaries look really good!  I won’t say that 4 hours in a dentist chair was fun, but the result was worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pink Cheetah21
user_reviews_extended.Description: I Hadn’t been to a dentist in years so hearing that I needed my tooth extracted gave me extreme anxiety. Front office was able to Fit me in so Quick and made me feel comfortable and told me not be worried about the procedure I was about to have that everything was gonna Be fine.  Very friendly and quiet atmosphere.  Pricing was right with in my budget too since I was a self pay patient. I was in pain just that day right after but the next day I was good and able to eat like nothing. The doctor did a great job on me ! Thank you guys for taking care of me in a very professional manner. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lund
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office has been extremely disorganized and chaotic both times I've visited and I will not return there for any reason. For my first visit, they handled a routine exam and filling decently...but the appointment ran about 40 minutes late and everything was extremely slow moving once I was back in the exam room as well. There seemed to be dozens of dental students running around who weren't quite up to par with procedures and keeping things straight. The staff was scatter-brained and not particularly friendly. I was informed by the dentist that I needed wisdom teeth extraction (which I was already aware of) and he seemed to imply that the procedure could be done that same day. I told him that was not possible as I needed to make arrangements for healing time and someone to help me. I was given a rundown on cost and advised to schedule an appt on any Wednesday in September when the Dr. would be present in the office. Somehow, that Dr. ended up not being in the office on the day I was scheduled for my procedure but I didn't get a call until 5pm the evening before trying to reschedule my appointment. I had my mother come in from out of town and had to request off of work several weeks in advance - there's no way I could reschedule, nor should I have to. They said they would schedule me with a different doctor and kept my appt time and location. When I arrived at my appt this morning, I was told the procedure could not be done and they gave me a piece of paper with oral surgeon references and expected me to remedy the situation myself. My mother came into town for nothing, I wasted a precious day off of work and barely anything was done to take accountability for this mess up. I insisted that they should help by at least coordinating so that I could get an appointment with an oral surgeon as quickly as possible...which they helped with, only at my demand. All around absurd and unacceptable experience with this office - do not waste your time here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pree Pree
user_reviews_extended.Description: I most definitely have to give the utmost rating to this entire establishment. From the very first time I met Dr. Shaw it just felt different and I’m glad I chose to have my case done here. The staff her and all employees are also 5 out of 5. As perfect as my teeth and my case turned out (well above even my expectations), I’d give my perfect teeth to someone else just because I wouldn’t mind going through this experience at Access Dental 7th St Austin,TX all over again!! Do yourself a favor and choose this doctor and the staff for your forever smile!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: b mh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Never had a cavity in my whole life. I go to the dentist 1-2 times per year for a regular check up and take good care of my teeth, I use an electric toothbrush, floss, mouthwash etc. Got a new job with different insurance so I couldn’t see my regular provider. Went to this place and suddenly I have 5 cavities that have developed in the 6 months since I saw my old dentist??? Foolishly, I let them fill them as they insisted I do it the same day. It was painful even with local numbing, they did a lot of drilling before they put the filling glue in. Two of the fillings popped out within a few months and caused SEVERE pain and sensitivity with the tooth exposed without the filling glue. Went to a different dentist to get it fixed and they remarked that the holes drilled to put the filling in were “very deep, almost to the root”. I have increased sensitivity on two teeth that I never had before. Also, this place was gross and visibly dirty (floors dusty in the corner of the rooms, grime on the dentist chair base, bathroom is gross and smelly I had plenty of time to look around since I spent so much time waiting) for a medical provider office - would be different/excusable if this was an oil change shop or something.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mel B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff and dentists. I have needed to have a lot of teeth pulled and have felt great and have been well taken care of here. Team of Dentists are very professional and knowledgeable And have helped me understand what my teeth need. I’m Needing denture work done and the team has been thorough with sharing various approaches, accommodating for needs and preferences. Wait time is often very short.

user_reviews_extended.Name: thomas peterson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I searched 20 different dentist and oral surgeons looking for a place that would help me. Within 15 minutes of taking my call the had me getting X-Rays. My tooth was extracted and my pain gone. Fabulous customer service and great prices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: bukowskish
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was seen by the female dentist and was told she could have a crown fitted for me for a thousand dollars less than at Swish Dental. She gave a copy of the cost and procedure and had me return 11/7/2023 to get the molding done. I was then called at my work to remind me that I had an appointment. I leave work early from Manor TX and arrive on time. After 20 minutes I was taken to a procedure room and waited. A short, bearded Latino male comes in and begins to inform me that the dentist has changed her mind and can’t go on with the procedure and to return to Swish dental to have it done. This is after x-rays and original consultation with her. I became upset because why didn’t they simply tell me over the phone earlier. I am an addiction counselor and my time could be better spent. The male bearded short latino male found it funny and would snickered and smile as he told me this. I am tempted to call my attorney over this. “ Do No Harm” is not practiced at Access Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Touchstone
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the customer service of Joe who calls to do the reminders. He is awesome. Also, I had an issue with my appointment time versus how long I had to wait and Kendy's explanation was both professional and compassionate.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabella Cowan
user_reviews_extended.Description: The receptionists are so kind and always so friendly! Ariana, she works at the front desk and she is always smiling and so eager to help patients and brings a smile to everyone’s face. the staff there are always willing to give the best possible service, i love it here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MELISSA RIVAS
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to a different dental office and the cost to get a crown was above my budget. So i tried Access and they saved me so much money. And i was even able to add a deep cleaning. Dr Loya was very friendly and made me feel comfortable. Ariana at the front desk was very professional and helpful in getting my appointments set, and checking me in.

user_reviews_extended.Name: charles king
user_reviews_extended.Description:
What a wonderful experience ,great service and all around warmth place to go to and get your SMILE 😃  back or  dental work. Thank you so much Doctor Shah and all of your  dental assistants, the office manager Kendy and all of her staff members and the  Access Dental  office are  professionals nice friendly greet you with a wonderful smile and  awesome
service. Doctor Shah was kind enough to walk me through the process step by step and now I'm smiling again well it's time for  a good steak it's been a long time since I was able to enjoy one again thank you for a great job

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Briones
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is really awsome! I would recommend it to everyone. Everyone is so helpful kind. As soon as you walk in the door is just a good vibe. All in all this is a place worth going too. The girls in the front have really great customer service, and the doctors in the back are really great as well. Every time I take my kids they are great with them. My kids don’t hate going to the dentist because of them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sofia Hyde
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was able to get my wisdom teeth pulled out the same day of making an appointment which was great. There was no wait and the dentist was very informative! I also loved that she wasn't pushy about me getting all 4 teeth out, which really made me comfortable to get it done here because it didn't feel like one big sales act. Another great thing is that I don't have dentals insurance and it was affordable for me! The only thing that kind of shocked me was that they only prescribed me ibuprofen afterwards. Once the numbing went away, the ibuprofen did not help at all and it was pretty excruciating. I did call afterwards and they were able to help me with the pain quickly, so overall I would highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Romanova
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went here a couple times, decided to stop being a patient after multiple 1 hour long wait times for my appointment. Now they won’t stop calling me to schedule another appointment even though i’ve asked to be removed from the patient list.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eleanor A.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
**Update to add that, amazingly, my experience continues to worsen with Access Dental without even having to step into the office again!! I have been continually contacted by this incompetent dental office every 4 months for nearly two years now. Not only do I no longer live in Texas, but I am flabbergasted that my *explicit* wishes to be added to a do-not-contact list have been blatantly ignored. How hard is it to delete my records and never contact me again?! I try blocking their numbers but they always seem to get a new one.

If there is a human reading this — REMOVE ME FROM YOUR RECORDS, I AM BEGGING YOU.**

Dr. Hwang at Access Dental has led me to believe that sadistic dentists actually do exist. I didn’t go into the dentist with any sore teeth for my regular checkup today, but I certainly left with some.

Not only did she scrape my gums to bleeding during the simple cleaning after I specifically asked her to be gentle (I winced and cried out in pain multiple times with zero acknowledgment from her), but she constantly knocked her tools all around my mouth as if my teeth and gums had no feeling at all instead of being some of the most sensitive areas of the human body.

As I’m writing this an hour+ later, several of my gums are still bleeding freely and multiple other areas of my mouth (under the tongue, below my lower lip) feel sore. Again, I have NO cavities and just went in for a routine cleaning. I’m baffled and completely disappointed at the “care” I received today.

To make matters even worse, water was constantly spraying into my eyes and all around my face during the cleaning. Once I even worried I might choke as the hygienist struggled to suck up the water Dr. Hwang kept spewing everywhere as she sprinted to finish scraping plaque off my gums (and teeth sometimes too when she could manage it). The “cleaning” must have been a record at 3 minutes or less—in my prior experience at the dentist it’s never taken shorter than 15 minutes.

She also barely glanced at my X-rays; all the professional opinion I got from her was a mumbled “you’re fine” before she went back to telling the hygienist what to do next.

And to top it all off? I patiently waited 45 minutes in the crowded lobby for my 10 minutes of terror with Dr. Hwang.

In summary: The back room was in shambles (broken tools, trash, and stains everywhere), the employees clearly hate their jobs, and the waiting room was beyond capacity by the time I left. If you’re looking to be treated like a human being at your 6-month cleaning, try somewhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Lynne Kelley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had good dentists all of my life, so my expectations are high. And I absolutely LOVE this dental staff. Dr Shah is so amazing and he's done a lot of work on my teeth. He pulled two upper molars that were bad, and at 70 I guess it's par for the course. He's fixing to set my crown soon as my temp is  in there now. I will be getting an implant next....one at a time. I trust this staff. They are SO professional and work hard. Also extremely friendly and answer all of your questions and cater to your pleasant stay! Try them and ask for Dr Shah. He's young and dedicated to your satisfaction. Lynne

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Salas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
There's a lot of things wrong with this place: timeliness, the un-informative front staff, the high turnover for dentists. I had a great time with Dr. Le but he has since left. I already started treatment, so I guess I'm stuck with this place till then. I recommend finding another dentist. Also, the doctor for implants is rude.

On average, I spend over an hour in the waiting room. 30 minutes is probably the shortest amount of time that I've waited.
I got a phone call earlier this week for a reminder about my appointment at the William Cannon location when in fact I had it for the 7th street location on a different day. I called to clarify because I know they'll charge me if I don't show up to this non-existent appointment. There was no parking so I called the 7th street phone number and the person on the phone isn't even at that office. I had a 17 minute phone call since she had to put me on hold to go and call someone from the 7th street location to answer her questions. Why have 2 separate phone numbers if the person on the phone knows nothing about that location. Why not have an option to choose which office you are calling so you can transfered at the beginning.

The stars are only for the dental assistants. They change every visit, but they all have been pleasant and accommodating.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anabel Noriega
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best service I’ve ever gotten from a dentist! I’ve always been very scared of the dentist but my dentist and the assistants were very sweet and assured me I hand nothing to worry about. I had a tooth extracted with no pain at all! I will definitely recommend this place to family and friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patsy Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff! Everyone was so kind and genuine. The Dr was so sweet and answered all of my questions and concerns. Their boss Kendy is phenomenal and did everything she could to help me out and meet my needs. Definitely recommend this place. Amazing team overall! 10/10 ⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandy Antunez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Loveeeee the staff at this location!
Dr. Sha and his DA Lili work really great together.
Dr. Sha was very kind and gentle with my daughter. While she was getting molars extracted, Lily would gently pad her on her shoulders to reassure her she was being taken care of.
Idk about all these low ratings… I didn’t pick up any bad vibes. I feel like everyone that was getting seen had good experiences.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelique Machado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was helped by Evelyn and Leslie they were very kind and friendly with my children. I appreciated the patience of taking care of us. Doctor Jain was very informative and made the experience that more of a breeze.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Kim
user_reviews_extended.Description:
7/26/2023 UPDATE: Believe it or not, I just received ANOTHER phone call today to schedule an appointment. This is now the 5th time I asked to be removed, called from yet another new phone number (blocked each number each time they've called). I submitted a complaint through BBB, and unsurprisingly Access Dental did not respond to it. Hilariously poor business practices bordering on illegal data privacy concerns.

Do not go here unless you want to receive phone calls for literally years even after asking 4 times to be removed from the call list and as a patient altogether. I went one time 3 years ago while I was temporarily living in Austin. It was a long wait, both after checking in and after being sat in the chair. Even if I did still live in Austin, I would not return.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juliet Sillero
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had a very awesome experience today had a extraction done I was completely nervous and scared to do all 4 wisdom teeth, however the Dr was very comforting and respectful, The two girls in the front I believe there name was (Juliette and Rosie ) made me feel like a part of a family member, From  been new to Austin Access Dental  made me feel comfortable and welcomed. I HIGHLY recommend this clinic \
The two girls went above and beyond to make me feel at ease they should be RECOGNIZED and appreciated

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isaac Akinboyewa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I received a pretty good service with the Dental office. Serah was very helpful. The staff are good at their jobs and highly interested in the treatments of their patients. Good communication and respectable approach. Prompt attention to patients and highly equipped for to get the job done. I would recommend the office to anyone needing dental services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yo Mama
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had the best experience at this office. During my pregnancy I went through 4 dentist trying to find the right one. This office was my 5th stop and I haven't went anywhere since. Everyone is so amazing! I went to my 100th appointment last week and decided to play a fun game with them. I hid little mini trolls all over the office for them to find. They have today found them and who left them lol 🤣 they sent me some great pictures that brought soooo much happiness to me!!! They took the best pictures holding all the trolls I'm hoping I'll get to load them with this review. They put them all over the Christmas tree now so if you visit don't forget to check the trolls out 😁❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: C
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had came in this place several times and the front desk lady very rude for no reason and she's the reason why I couldn't attend to my appointments. Again, I've called tried to make an appointment and told me to stop to call them? This place may get sued as well, you don't treat people like that and to disabled people as well they trying to get their teeth cleaning and stuff. I don't feel safe with those people playing people's teeth and mines. Every time I walked in, it's look like college kids trying to get certified by playing with people's teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaylee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came here, I’ve been going since I was 15. Honestly the workers are so nice. They really make me feel comfortable. Every time I come in they are so welcoming to me and it makes my experience a whole lot better. I definitely recommend if your looking to go somewhere that’ll get the job done and leave you smiling. (:

user_reviews_extended.Name: mayra benitez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent place & great staff! Very professional & accommodating from scheduling up to your appointment day. So glad I was able to find such a great dental place for my girls, Thank you Access Dental for taking care of us just right & meeting all of our expectations!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edgar Espinoza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an amazing experience at Access Dental, and I have to give a special shoutout to Sabrina for her outstanding customer service! From the moment I walked in, she greeted me with a warm smile and made me feel completely at ease. She was incredibly professional, patient, and went above and beyond to answer all my questions.

Sabrina took the time to explain everything clearly, ensuring I felt comfortable throughout my visit. Her friendly and caring attitude made my experience so much better, and I truly appreciate her dedication to excellent service.

If you’re looking for a dental office with a welcoming atmosphere and top-notch care, I highly recommend Access Dental—and be sure to ask for Sabrina! She’s the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brianna Quinteros
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend visiting Access Dental! They made me feel comfortable and confident during my appointment. The dentist was professional and explained what he recommended for my treatment plan. The front desk receptionists were also very friendly and patient while preparing me for my appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amarilis Cosme
user_reviews_extended.Description: They called to tell me I had an appointment, but when I got to the office they said there was no appointment registered in the system. That is not an adequate service to the client and made me waste my time. I got scheduled two other times and both times I was not tended to properly. The front desk staff is inefficient, as they called me multiple times to verify my appointment yet we’re not able to ask information about my insurance so that the day of the appointment everything would go smoothly. That should be the job of the clinic not the customer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marleh Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today my sister had an appointment for a wisdom tooth extraction at this location. As we walked in the front office lady was very rude and couldn’t even make eye contact with us when we spoke. They charged her $250 for the extraction then they “double” checked and all of a sudden it went up to $375.. like how does that happen ? We got there 15 minutes before hand to sign paper work. While filling out the ‘documents’ we started to read questionable things like some that read “ I understand that my doctor can’t promise that everything will be perfect. I understand that the treatment listed above and other forms of treatment or no treatment at all are choices I have....”  I don’t know about you but as a dental assistant myself, that makes me uncomfortable and less trusting towards their abilities. Well we were there so went through with the one extraction after waiting AN HOUR in the lobby for no reason. I counted 9 dental assistants walking in after lunch I assume and we still waited an hour. While waiting we heard the ladies up front argue with a pharmacist and then proceeded to hang up on them. We finally get called back and they ask me to leave the room for the procedure which I find VERY odd to say the least. I refused to leave because I wanted to make sure they were doing everything correctly and as clean as possible because they’re consent forms made me EXTREMELY untrusting of them. The assistant was fabulous and made my sister less nervous. Bino I believe was his name. The other assistant that was upfront arguing came to us to tell us the post-op procedures and I feel shallow to say this but I could see her stomach hanging from her scrubs. Her shirt was not a proper fit and the girls didn’t have their hair up and out of the way like a proper PPE protocol. Anyways we got it done but we will never be back here. Don’t even get me started on their customer service lines to even make an appointment..

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Verver
user_reviews_extended.Description: Took my kids in for their check up and the staff was great! Rosie in the front was helpful with getting their insurnace information and Marcia was so great at helping my kids remain calm during xrays and explaing to them what the doctor was going to do! My son enjoyed Sandra the dental assistants help and we will definately be returning! Awesome team 😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Fishbeck
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love Access Dental. I had dental problems for YEARS and thought there was just nothing that I could do about it. When I finally went in, and got an action plan, and realized, "I can actually afford this!," I was over the moon.
I've been working with Dr. Karnik Shaw, and he is amazing. He has spent more time explaining my situation, my options, and my procedures to me than anyone else ever did. He's kind (which is important when your getting scary information about your teeth. He did not judge me, he just met me where I was at and made a plan), and he's gentle when he's working on your mouth. And he's METICULOUS. He works so hard to get things just right. (I'm in the middle of the process of getting upper implants, and he's worked so hard to get them just right so that I won't have as many issues later on. I appreciate that.)
And I don't want to forget the staff! Every single person I've met here is so friendly, helpful and always smiling and in a good mood (I can't tell you how many Dr.'s offices have grumpy staff! Not this place!)  The dental assistants are just as kind and meticulous as Dr. Shaw. I usually have Sarah - and she's awesome. She's fun to talk to and chit chat with- but when she starts working she's great - always asking if I'm okay, and reminding me to breathe and making sure I'm alright (and she asks Dr. Shaw cool medical questions! Haha I always learn something.)
And the staff up front is great too - people  remember my name and are crazy cheerful - I adore these ladies. But most importantly, the front staff have done the work to help me figure out my insurance, my billing, my appointments, and all of the stuff that I'm terrible with. Seriously, if it weren't for people going over all my options and insurance with me, I'd still be walking around all snaggle-toothed. I honestly can't say enough good stuff about this place.
I promise they didn't pay me to say nice stuff - I'm a real customer - I'm just super stoked with this place. Glad I finally sat down and put in a review.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kimbocantdance
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really enjoyed my first visit here. Everything was explained quickly and with ease. Leadership at this office is great! I saw the manager working and helping out the supporting staff. Would totally recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Breazeale
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fraudulently billed my insurance for a cleaning I never received and called my emergency contact instead of me at least 15 times for appointment reminders and to discuss scheduling additional appointments, even after I specifically told them to stop calling that number.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alma Aviles
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would highly recommend every time my children have a dental appointment or a dental emergency they are seen very quickly and as for me I was in pain and I finally decided to get my teeth pulled out I had called and made an appointment and they scheduled it the same day . I was a little worried but the in the front desk( Jessica and Rosie) told me everything‘s gonna be all right . thank you for making me feel comfortable and I feel so much better.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Jaime
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an excellent experience at access Dental !! I usually have a rough time going to the dentist for a check up because I get anxiety but the staff makes you feel comfortable and calm about whatever it is you’re there for ! Evelyn was really nice and helped explain everything that was going on ! Most definitely recommend this location and will be coming here from now on

user_reviews_extended.Name: Osiel Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve always been nervous to go to the dentist but I had a good experience from the time I checked out to the time the doctor took care of my teeth. The treatment coordinator explained how to make good use of my benefits. The doctor was extra nice & answered all my questions. Definately reccomend this office along with Dr.Nguyen and her team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daisy Rodriguez

title: Forest Family Dentistry Eastside
address: 31 Navasota St #130, Austin, TX 78702, United States

user_reviews.Name: Angelica Le
user_reviews.Description:
I can't say enough good things about Forest Family Dentistry. Their reminder system is incredibly thorough; you'd have to try pretty hard to miss an appointment! What I also love is how easy they make communication. I can schedule appointments and ask questions via text or email instead of having to call in which is a huge plus for me.

The staff and my doctor Dr. Soomar are all professional and patient, taking their time to answer all my questions without making me feel rushed. They didn't pressure me into scheduling the additional treatments they recommended, which I really appreciate. When I needed a night guard for my grinding issue, they helped me navigate the insurance reimbursement process.

Their in-office system is very systemic. The team pages each other to coordinate patient flow, and you can tell they have their processes down to a science. It has a polished, corporate feel but without losing the personal touch. Plus, who doesn't love leaving with a goody bag?

Highly recommend Forest Family Dentistry if you're looking for a dental practice that combines great care with modern convenience!

user_reviews.Name: Kaitlynn Newman
user_reviews.Description:
I was honestly nervous about finding a new dentist after being with my previous one for so many years. I visited a few offices that just didn’t feel like the right fit — until I found this one.

From the moment I walked in, I felt comfortable and genuinely cared for. The office is welcoming, the staff is kind and professional, and everything feels organized and calm.

Dr. Soomar is thorough, gentle, and takes the time to explain everything clearly. I never felt rushed or pressured. I’m so relieved to have found a dentist I trust and plan to continue seeing long-term. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Kiala Britton
user_reviews.Description: Everyone at Forest Family Dental is so nice and welcoming! The doctors are very thorough and take the time to explain everything clearly. I especially love Dr. Disla — always professional, caring, and attentive. They are very prompt with appointments and I never have to wait. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Alexandria Yates (Allie)
user_reviews.Description: I cannot recommend Dr. Soomar enough! After visiting a dentist that was hard on my teeth and pushed unnecessary things, I did a lot of research on finding an honest and knowledgeable dentist and found Forest Family recommended by tons of people in the Austin area. Dr. Soomar takes a conservative approach, starting small with what's necessary and monitoring the teeth from there. She explains everything in depth and shows exactly what areas are of concern, and works out a treatment plan that works best for the patient. She is genuine and honest in her practice, and will take great care of your teeth! Her assistant was great as well with the cleaning and x-rays. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Taylor Wood
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been going to Forest Family for over a decade now! When Dr. Disla opened a location on the east side, I was THRILLED. He’s a ray of pure sunshine and soooooo knowledgeable. I’ve only ever had amazing experiences here and I trust any and all advice they give me. Before going here, I had about a cavity a year. The first time there, they told me some of my teeth could use sealants, I did it. Not ONE cavity in over a decade. Insane!

Everyone on the staff is phenomenal, caring and make my teeth feel sooooo clean!

I am also a sucker for the free teeth whitening with cleaning. Hope you love them as much as I do!

user_reviews.Name: Martha Aviles
user_reviews.Description:
Some might I may be slightly biased because I knew Dr. Disla in another life. But I don’t think so. Sometimes when you know the person, the expectations are higher and the whole team blew me away today. Not just the dentist.
Check in process, great. Dental assistant that did all my X-rays was so kind, thorough and roadmapped the whole process. She then did a thorough teeth polishing and told me the dentist would finish my cleaning. Wait, what? This has never happened before…Dr. Disla came in and was kind, clear and did the most thorough cleaning I’ve ever had. Fortunately I am someone like doesn’t mind the dentist anyway, but this experience was so great and thorough, I don’t know if I have enough words to express my gratitude. You know that saying, “never meet your heroes” - it doesn’t apply here. Everything exceeded my expectations beyond my imagination.
I currently don’t have dental insurance and I bought their annual plan. Thank you Jasmine for explaining that to me so well!

user_reviews.Name: Aleksa Diaz
user_reviews.Description: I love Dr.Disla! He’s the most friendly medical professional I’ve ever had the pleasure of being taken care by. Have been very happy with all of my experiences here, from routine cleaning, fillings, and Invisalign :) when doing a cavity fill on the bottom of a tooth, he shaped the filling to be slightly more fitting/straight as my surrounding teeth. Small detail but it really stood out to me that he did that.

user_reviews.Name: Maria Blattman
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Disla continues to be a truly great dentist. He is patient and kind, putting you at ease if youre a bit anxious. He explains procedures so you know what’s going on. I would definitely recommend him to all! Thanks Dr Disla for being my dentist.
