Whether I’m in for a routine cleaning or getting a cavity taken care of, he takes the time to explain everything clearly and makes sure I feel comfortable and well cared for.

I’m very picky about dentists, and when I first moved to Austin I visited several offices before choosing Forest Family Dentistry. So many places these days focus on being flashy, but lack genuine personality, attentiveness, and expertise. This practice is the complete opposite. They feel like a true family practice, with a team that’s personable, down to earth, and genuinely invested in their patients.

I’m really grateful to have found Dr. Disla and Forest Family Dentistry. They’ve earned my trust completely, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a dentist who combines skill, kindness, and real care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mindy Sheldon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was my 1st visit to this office as a longtime patient of Forest Family.  Everyone was super friendly.  They took me right on time.  The hygienist did an exceptional job and my teeth felt super clean.  He made sure I was comfortable the whole time.
Dentist gave me clear explanation of everything going on after reviewing my x-rays, and we came up with a plan going forward for repairs I will need.
I got lucky with parking out front, but you may want to arrive a bit early because it can be confusing down there especially with all the construction.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel McElroy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can not speak more highly than Dr. Disla. By far the best dentist I've ever worked with. Truly understands how to work with patients and kids. I bring my 8 yr old daughter to him as well. She LOVES him too. Highly reccomend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Peeks
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were able to fix my chipped front tooth right away! Everyone was super helpful squeezing me in, and the finished work is beautiful!! Pricing, financing options, and membership savings were all straightforward and gladly discussed before starting any treatment. Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deb Paris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been going to Forest Family Dentistry for 6 years now and was
already a huge fan of Dr Disla from my visits to the FFD Anderson Lane
location, so when I found out Dr. Disla opened a brand new office on
the Eastside I was beyond thrilled. FFD Eastside opened for business
yesterday so I went in today for a cleaning and was extremely
impressed. The FFD Eastside office suite is so sleek, professional and
state-of-the-art yet it still feels warm and comfortable inside with
soft lighting and a cozy waiting area. As expected the exam rooms have
all brand-new equipment and everything is very high-tech.

If you've never had the pleasure of meeting Dr. Disla he is in all
honesty, the best. He is highly skilled, thorough, prompt, and his
"bedside manner" is so calming. Dr. Disla explains everything he's
doing and will patiently answer all your questions. My teeth & gums
are hyper-sensitive when it comes to scaling & probing. Dr. Disla
completely took care of my needs, making sure I was comfortable and
pain-free during the entire cleaning. The entire FFD Eastside staff is
very welcoming, friendly and helpful.

This office building complex on Navasota was built just a few years
ago and FFD Eastside is located on the ground floor in Suite 130,
right next door to Afuga Coffee. Huge bonus is that it has a covered
parking lot for patients!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ATX Rexs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Feedback for Forest Family Dentistry – Navasota East Side

I’ve been a loyal patient at Forest Family Dentistry for over a decade, and I’ve always appreciated the care, especially from Dr. Disla, who is excellent with kids and higher-risk patients. The office vibe is great, and the new location is much more convenient than the Burnet location. However, my most recent experience was a bit disappointing.

While the hygienist did a fantastic job with a quick cleaning, there was a long delay after, as we waited 20 minutes for a dentist consultation. It would have been helpful if the hygienist had informed me about the wait time or the reason for it, especially since we were on a time crunch with a family.

Additionally, the overall attitude of some staff members seemed off. It felt as though there was an air of judgment and impatience, particularly when dealing with families and children. It's important for all staff to remember that families, including those with children, are a significant part of the practice. The nicest interactions I had were with the receptionist and the X-ray tech, who were both warm and understanding.

I also felt uncomfortable with some of the questions asked, which seemed unnecessary and invasive, especially in the context of a busy family appointment. It's crucial for the team behind closed doors to work on their approach and demeanor—kindness, patience, and professionalism go a long way, especially in a family-oriented practice.

This was surprising, considering the great service I’ve experienced here in the past. I hope this feedback helps the team refine their approach to better serve all patients, especially families who rely on this practice for care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: elise lockwood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this practice and especially Dr. Disla. He is by far the best dentist I’ve ever had-super competent, gentle, and kind. -And brings the positive energy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Turconi
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and dentists here are all so friendly and knowledgeable. Went above and beyond in helping explain some concerns and things I can change in my routine to help. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: I L G, that’s me!
user_reviews_extended.Description: When it comes to dentistry I would recommend anyone other than Dr Christopher Disla, DDS and his rockstar staff at Forest Family Dentistry. The hospitable environment brings you in and the excellent care & followup will keep you coming back….even if you have to drive all the way from San Antonio. This place is unbeatable!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sensei Walter Bera PhD
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I needed a new dentist and found Forest Family Dentistry near me. OMG! Their costs are typical, but their cutting-edge technology and people are extraordinary. Check out the photos I took. So cool.

Dr. Christopher Disla worked with Master Hygentist Kiana to assess, clean and fix a bad filling past dentist refused to acknowledge. While there, Dr. Disla didn’t like his first filling and redid it! At NO extra cost!

Jasmine, the Office Manager and Team members like Michelle are very personal and professional as well. Thank y’all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ReAnna Batiste
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a new patient at Forest family dental And words do not express how happy I am! The dental office was extremely clean, the team is very kind and efficient. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zhandra Andrade
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Disla is the best dentist. He cares for our family of four. I usually joke that his office is the only place I get to relaxed. I know my family and I will be well taken care of. Everyone from the front desk, billing, hygienist and his whole team are a pleasure to deal with. Thanks for being so caring and for always being on top of our dental issues. The office is beautiful decorated. Very modern. Love to come to this dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kelly bogdan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I like going to the dentist - I know, to some that is weird. But I especially like going to this dentist.
Dr Disla and his team are wonderful. He is personable, always greets with a huge smile, and makes sure to ask about and discuss any questions or concerns. Every person (hygienists, front desk, etc) I’ve encountered there is friendly and professional. It’s a good vibe and they do a great job. And as a bonus, I dig the office aesthetic - modern, comfortable, stylish, and clean. Recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meena
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can’t say enough good things about Dr. David and his team! From the moment I walked in, I felt completely at ease. The staff is warm, professional, and genuinely caring. They greeted me with a smile, made check-in a breeze, and created a welcoming environment that immediately put me at ease.

Dr. David is exceptional—not only in his skill and attention to detail, but in the way he communicates and truly listens. He took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions patiently, and made sure I felt completely comfortable throughout the process. It’s rare to find someone so knowledgeable and compassionate in one package.

The office itself is modern, clean, and equipped with the latest technology, which made my visit smooth and efficient. I left feeling confident in my care and grateful to have found such a trustworthy dentist.
It was worth driving from Houston to get my teeth cleaned.
Whether you need a routine cleaning or more involved dental work, I highly recommend Dr. David and his outstanding team. You’ll be in excellent handsw

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pablo Pequeno
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Disla, his assistants and the ladies at the front desk are all genuinely awesome.
Super helpful, super friendly, super patient!
And Dr.Disla is so talented and great with kids.
Great people, location and ultra clean and modern facility. Highly recommended!
Thank you for a fantastic experience every single visit my family and I have!
DO NOT GO ELSEWHERE!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseluis Perales
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife and I have been coming here for years, and more recently with our two little boys. We absolutely love how warm and friendly the staff is! They are wonderful with working with kiddos as well as with adults.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yingyi Cao
user_reviews_extended.Description: All the staff that have worked on me are really nice, thorough and happy to answer questions. I’ve gone to other dentists that gave me the impression that they were trying to upsell me on things/procedures I didn’t need and I don’t get that feeling here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Hawk
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have had a fear of going to the dentist my whole life. This whole experience has been life changing for me. The staff is super friendly, the office is well decorated ( I’m an Interior Designer) and Dr. Disla not only put me at ease but I could hear him talking to children in the next room having their first trip to the dentist.
He explained every single detail that he was doing as he did it.
He has a way of even making the shot not so bad.
There is screen above you with a travel slide show of calming beaches. He put a weighted blanket on me which helped my anxiety.
Every tool he uses is modern technology.
My kids have been going to see him for years.
I will now be making the hour and a half trip to see him as well.
You will not regret entrusting him to be your dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cat C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Disla and his team provide excellent, compassionate care during every visit. I'm consistently impressed with their attention to detail during exams and procedures, and the office is meticulously clean and modern. The front desk staff are amazing as well and you'll absolutely feel welcome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Crotty
user_reviews_extended.Description:
By far the best experience I’ve had at the dentist! The staff is friendly, approachable, and takes the time to explain things to you with verbiage a normal person can understand!
After having not visited a dentist in a year, I expressed some preexisting concerns around certain aspects of my teeth’s aesthetics. The team worked quickly and offered me multiple solutions, and I was able to walk out of my appointment with exactly what I wanted!! 😃

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pat Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Dr. Disla and his staff. They are all friendly, professional and knowledgeable. I always dreaded going to the dentist, but now I look forward to my every-six-month visits. Dr. Disla and Jenny, the hygienist, are very gentle and have established my favorite dental office ever! I now feel as though I am part of the “family!” I drive a long distance to their office, but it’s worth the time and effort for the good experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra Pierard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am SO thankful to have found Forest Family Dentistry! Dr. Disla and Jenny, the hygienist, are AMAZING. As someone with a lot of dental anxiety, I cannot imagine going to anywhere else. They are great at educating and taking things slow when needed. The front staff and dental assistants have always been wonderful as well! I truly cannot recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chloe Saunders
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have had a great experience at Forest Family! All of the staff are wonderful to work with. Dr Disla is warm and has been a great dentist for us! He always explains the why behind recommended treatments and is really detailed in going through x ray results which we appreciate. The hygenists have also been excellent — thorough and friendly!  It’s easy to communicate with the front office staff via text and the office design itself is the best I’ve experienced — modern and welcoming. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Gorman
user_reviews_extended.Description: After not keeping up with dental appointments the last few years, I have very bad anxiety about my teeth and visiting the dentist. Coming into my appointment I was very nervous (as noted by my elevated BP and heart rate). Dr. Soomar and the assistants working there made me feel relaxed and like I was being taken care of/all my needs were addressed. I left with a plan for treatment and a plan for maintaining my teeth health. I am looking forward to finishing up with treatment and getting my teeth health back in shape. Kudos to all the staff for making the office a friendly, clean, and welcoming place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Whitney McElwain
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr. Disla and the entire team at Forest Family in our Holly neighborhood. They've been open and warm, answered any and all questions, helped clarify the inevitable insurance questions, and taken great care of my teeth. I've gone to them for routine care and Invisalign and highly recommend for both.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gordon Smit
user_reviews_extended.Description: Incredibly friendly and professional staff! Highly recommend for anyone looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Kerkering
user_reviews_extended.Description: I travel across town to The east side location of Forest Family Dentistry because I know that Dr. Disla will provide great care.  He takes time to explain procedures and recommendations for care. He and his staff are really considerate and professional. The office is up to date and the treatment rooms seem to have the latest technology.  I really recommend this practice for anyone wanting to establish themselves with a great dental practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evie S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dave always takes amazing care of my teeth. I always leave feeling more confident. The entire staff is so knowledgeable and helpful with filing claims and scheduling. They are incredibly responsive. This is the third location of theirs I have visited and they are consistently amazing. I have been seeing their offices for about 5 years and won't be stopping!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at this office! I came in with a couple of routine questions during my cleaning, and the team took the time to answer them thoroughly. That means a lot to me because I really care about my health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juliana Maciel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place with a very knowledgeable and kind staff. From scheduling to post procedures, the team at FF has been amazing and made me feel confident about the results. They are very transparente about pricing so that’s always appreciated - I always know what to expect. The dentists are very kind and they really make sure you are doing well - I came up for a follow up appointment just to check and the team went above and beyond and answered all my questions. Highly recommend this place - it’s clean, full of parking, and also great coffee place just next and the street is super cute!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keren Ritter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist appointment I ever had. Crew is so professional and nice. Very much recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor-Paige Buchberger
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at Forest Family Dentistry Eastside for about a year now and I can’t recommend them enough. The staff is always friendly, professional, and welcoming. They’re accommodating with scheduling and make each visit easy and comfortable. It’s a well-run office with excellent customer service, and I really appreciate the care they provide.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
FFD- Eastside is the best dental experience I have had since moving back to Austin 11 years ago.  Highly recommended this location to anyone looking for a dental appointment.  Cute, clean office and waiting space.  Everyone there is super-friendly, and the Dr. Disla did great work.  My insurance was running out at the end of the month.  They went above and beyond to fit me in for a second appointment while I had the coverage.  This saved me a lot of $$$ and potential pain and I am very grateful!  They also offer payment plans through a program, Cherry, which is simple and affordable.

I believe this is a new location for FFD so it's pretty easy to get an appointment.  If you are looking for a great dental experience, stop here!  Give them a call.  You'll be glad you did!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mauro Fuentes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist experience ever! The office staff is super friendly and make insurance/payments/booking a breeze. The patient rooms are comfortable and have state of the art dental technology.  Dr. Disla, the hygienists, and all assistants are extremely knowledgeable and make every visit a pleasant experience while making it easy to understand what’s happening with my dental health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carlos Simental
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can't say enough wonderful things about The Forest Family Dentistry! From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and kindness by the front desk staff, making me feel right at home. The office is modern, clean, and designed to put patients at ease.

The entire team are incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and truly care about their patients. They took the time to explain every step of my treatment, ensuring I was comfortable and informed. Their gentle approach and attention to detail made my visit completely stress-free!

What really sets The Forest Family Dentistry apart is their commitment to patient care. Whether it’s a routine cleaning or a more complex procedure, they go above and beyond to provide exceptional service. I also appreciate how they use the latest technology to make treatments as efficient and painless as possible.

If you're looking for a dental office that treats you like family while delivering top-notch care, look no further! I highly recommend The Forest Family Dentistry to anyone in need of an outstanding dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Munguia (moongiia)
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time going to the dentist in a really long time and the team at Forest Family Dentistry made the experience a great one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camille Jamshidi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first visit here. They fortunately take my pretty mediocre dental insurance, which is nice. The woman greeting me at the front desk was so nice! The hygienist/tech was efficient and the dentist herself was great! Personable and took the time to show/explain things to me. I recommend! The office is clean and modern.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time picking out a dentist after going to the same one as my parents for years and I'm glad I chose Forest Family Dental! Easy to set up appointment, everyone was super friendly and made me feel at ease. Super up-to-date tech as well to get an idea of my complicated dental situation and a treatment plan! Great experience and highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m honestly so impressed by the dental staff here - It’s been hard to find a good dentist in Austin but i’m truly happy to have found this place! As someone who has a lot of anxieties with dental visits and negative encounters in the past, I left today actually feeling great. Can attest to all the positive things said in the reviews before me. Would highly recommend! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Returning to the dentist after a long time can be scary, especially when it’s for a problem that is causing a lot of pain. i sent an appointment request on a Sunday when the office was closed but i was responded to promptly via email Monday morning around the time they opened, with an extremely detailed and easy to understand email from Chloe about when i could schedule an appointment for an exam to be assessed. they were able to squeeze me in on Tuesday early afternoon and everything about the process from start to finish made me feel comfortable. Kiana was an efficient and knowledgeable dental assistant to Dr. Disla, who was extremely friendly and had great customer service and explained everything to me easily. I was referred to an endodontist by the Dr. Disla (and the endodontist was fantastic & knowledgeable as well). And even though no same day treatment could be guaranteed, i was prescribed the proper medication that day I was in, and advised how to ease my pain until i was able to get the proper treatment. Adrian was at the front desk and he was very patient and kind with assisting me with my payment. I don’t have dental insurance and had to pay out of pocket which i was nervous about but Adrian’s break down of the treatment options and payments was easy to grasp and he assisted me with additional options to help ease my financial burden. The whole experience makes me believe that Forest Family Dentistry truly cares deeply about all their patients. even brand new ones that just came in for the first time, like me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joyce Yoon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love this dentist office and have recommended all of my friends and colleagues here. All of the staff and hygienists at this location are so great! Dr Disla is also just a ball of joy and so kind. He always takes the time to answer any questions or give follow up information. More importantly they are very operationally efficient I’m never waiting for long between steps which at other dentist offices I have. They really do care and check in if you ever do have to wait bc I think that’s not the norm for them. They also tell me costs upfront and are very transparent about things if I have something come up in my routine cleanings which I really appreciate.

Other minor thing I appreciate is that the office is super clean and modern and as someone with OCD I feel comfortable here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Bridges
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dental experience I’ve ever had—I don’t typically leave reviews but this was warranted due to exceptional service. Dr. Disla was warm and informative, clearly explained everything, and made it clear that my oral health was the top priority. All aspects of the appointment were thoroughly explained, including cost. It’s also very clear all staff members are well trained in all aspects of care to ensure a comfortable visit from start to finish. An added bonus—the entire office is super cute :) It’s so difficult finding providers in a new city but I 1000% recommend Forest Family Dentistry Eastside

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mel G
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful staff, hygienist and dentist! I had a great experience and would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kory King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Disla and his team are excellent. From the moment I walked in to the moment I left, over 3 visits, I felt welcomed and well cared for!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gareth Marvel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very professional, and communicative staff.
Reassuring to have such graceful staff members caring for oral health!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really enjoyed my first visit with Forest Family Dentistry on the Eastside. They were friendly, attentive, and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Outstanding service from the moment I walked in the door! I have several issues that need to be resolved and the whole team was patient, thorough and knowledgeable. They developed a care plan to get me back on track and put my fears at ease. I trust them with my care and I'm looking forward to taking this journey to fix my teeth with this team. Dr. Disla is 1 of 1. You won't find a better Dentist anywhere. I wish I could give 10 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nico Silvian
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wonderful experience! I hadn’t been to a dentist in a few years so I was very nervous. But they made me feel very comfortable and made the whole process very smooth!

I would highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elena
user_reviews_extended.Description: I only had one appointment so far but, as someone with sever anxiety and general fear of going to a dentist, I was pleasantly surprised how good the visit went. Everyone was kind, patient, and understanding. I know that on my next appointments there will be dreaded needles involved, but I'm a little bit calmer now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mikayla Millard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a friendly staff, I felt so comfortable, it was quick and easy! 10/10 recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Byers
user_reviews_extended.Description: First dentist I’ve gone to that didn’t try to talk me into anything that would be a financial burden. instead they got straight to the reason I was there and gave me all of the solutions to fix it in less than 10 minutes. Everyone was also super friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: leslie lilly
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dental experience I've ever had.  I spent a long time resisting going to the dentist because I had a couple of not great experiences. But, I am so glad I found Dr. Disla. He and his staff are excellent. They all gave me lots of non judgmental support during my last couple of appointments and procedures, and it means so much to feel comfortable with someone while you're a little freaked out about getting your teeth worked on.  Also, the office is so beautiful, modern, and well designed while feeling really cozy.  I would give 6 stars if it was possible.  10/10 would recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Carr
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Soomar is one of the best dentists I’ve ever had. She’s professional, kind, and truly cares that you are satisfied with your smile. She is excellent at her craft!

Appreciate everyone in this office. They are all helpful, friendly and organized.

Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrés Espinoza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently moved to Austin and it was a real challenge to find a dental office that met all my requirements for my new place. After a lot of research, Forest Dental seemed like the best option, and they didn’t let me down! Everyone was super friendly and welcoming, the office looks great, and it was spotless. And as a tech-savvy person, I was impressed with all the technology they use during my consultation. I’m so happy with my choice and would highly recommend Forest Dental to anyone considering them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natasha Harper-Madison
user_reviews_extended.Description: So happy I found my new dentist! The experience was awesome from start to finish. Location was perfect for me, receptionist was sweet and professional, the hygienist was thorough and super pleasant. Then cam my new dentist full of bubbly, sweet, enthusiastic energy. My treatment was efficient, thorough and clearly a dental professional who loves his work and cares about his patients. The office was inviting, staff was pleasant and the process was smooth from pre appointment prep to execution. I’ve already referred several friends in less than a week. Excellent find!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Kerkering
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a great experience.  The office was built in the last two years so equipment is very up to date and the individual treatment rooms have sliding doors so privacy.  Location is easy to get to with plenty of street parking.  Staff members were all courteous and efficient and Dr.Disla is great…takes time to discuss treatment plans.  A great office, great staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Henley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was once a dental assistant, therefore I’m highly critical of dental offices. First of all, their staff is amazing, the office is clean and tidy, plus they play great music. I always have a lot of questions, so when the staff takes the time to answer all of them while not making me feel rushed, honestly makes me feel comfortable being there as well as heard.  I highly recommend this place! Lastly, there’s a cute coffee shop next door and the office is located in a nice friendly area, where you can see people walking their dogs and socializing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deon Hickey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great environment, everyone is very welcoming. Dr. Disla and his assistant Ceaser are amazing . I will definitely recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a dentistry location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jose Erbella
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dave saved me big time today! I had an excellent experience at the clinic today. It was my first time here and they were able to help me with my emergency. They were professional and compassionate and courteous. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaitlyn Sanback
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Disla and the staff are amazing!! Very nice and informative. Office is new and clean with modern decor. Parking was no issue. I was impressed with all the gadgets they have to do a thorough teeth cleaning and analysis. Definitely found my forever dentist in Austin! Recommending all my friends to go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Forest Family Dentistry made the entire process from scheduling to dental work quick, simple, and easy. Communication was great, pricing is clear and up front, none of the "we will reimburse you in a few weeks" garbage. My dentist did a great job as well, and I'll be a returning client. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and professional staff. Very nicely decorated location. Dental chairs are all in separate rooms with partially frosted glass sliding doors facing the windows. TVs mounted to the ceiling above dental chairs if you’re going to be there a while. My dentist did an excellent job and had excellent communication skills about what was going on and what needed to happen. Lots of scheduling options and I was called when other appointments fell through and able to move up mine. They also consolidated dental work needed into fewer visits costing me less money in off time and commute to location. Best dental experience I’ve had. Will continue to go here. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Lux
user_reviews_extended.Description: I never thought I’d enjoy going to the dentist… everyone I spoke to was incredibly friendly and very knowledgeable. I highly recommend Forest Family Dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rico Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great experience here! Chloe at the front desk was so welcoming and made check-in easy. Dr. Disla is amazing he really took the time to explain everything clearly and made me feel comfortable the whole time. Kiana, the dental assistant, was super kind and helpful too. Honestly, the whole team went above and beyond. If I could give them 10/10 stars, I would. Definitely recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T. Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My son and I have been going to Forest Family Dentistry for the last 5 years and we absolutely love it!

They have the kindest front desk staff who are always on top of their game. From letting you know if there’s an earlier opening to explaining your insurance benefits, they do it all with a smile.

But the main reasons why we love FFD is because of Dr. Disla. He is AMAZING! He is super friendly, knowledgeable, patient and has the best bedside manners. He actually cares about his patients because he remembers your name and what you spoke about on the last visit. He is a genuine person and my 8 year old thinks the world of him. My son has had two filling visits and each time, it was easy peasy. I was beyond nervous, but they did an amazing job each time keeping him distracted and making him feel comfortable during the whole procedure. Watching Dr. Disla and his assistant, Cesar (who is also amazing!) this last visit,  was like watching a well oiled machine - they were in sync with one another without even having to say a word.

Let me not forget to mention Sierra, our dental hygienist who is the best! She is the sweetest! Not to mention she is thorough and gentle when it comes to the cleaning. My teeth have never had so much attention during a teeth cleaning. I love that she takes her time and isn’t rough like some hygienist I’ve had in the past. My teeth always feel squeaky clean, and I can’t help but smile even bigger when leaving their office.

I would follow Dr. Disla and his staff anywhere; which I have! user_reviews_extended.Name: L Liu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updated review:
I had a conversation with the accounts manager. They explained the issue better and cleared the balance. I'm happy with how it turned out.

Original review:
I never thought I'd have to move on after my first visit to Forest Family Eastside as a new patient. My routine cleaning plus X-rays there went smoothly. Dr. Disla is professional and caring.

However, I ended up getting a surprise bill of +$100. It turned out my insurance did not cover the full-mouth X-ray. This was pretty unexpected as I discussed the cost upfront and made sure there would be no out-of-pocket payment except the fluoride treatment.

Although insurance estimates can be inaccurate sometimes, full-mouth X ray is a standard procedure for new patients and many insurance companies only provide reimbursement for it over extended times (even my costly insurance only allows it once every 60 months). If I can easily find this common knowledge on Google and Reddit, I have no idea why the experienced and professional staff there shared nothing about the risk.

Feeling this issue should not fall entirely on my shoulders, I attempted to negotiate. Unfortunately, the only option they were willing to discuss was a payment plan. Even more frustrating, they referred to the balance as "discounted," when it was a typical market price.

I suppose the lesson here is never lowering your guard down when dealing with medicare services, no matter how many good words you may have heard.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meredith Bradley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist! Dr. Disla is always so friendly, helpful, and efficient without ever feeling rushed. user_reviews_extended.Description: Truly so blown away. Came on a recommendation from a friend who works there, and I am SO glad I did!! I have been to some of the “trendy” new dental offices and seen how they can reel you in with free stuff and stick you with a $1000 treatment plan. That is truly NOT the case with these amazing people! Jasmin at the front was so quick and knowledgeable about my treatment plan, almost immediately after I left the room!! Mairany was my hygienist and has EXCELLENT chairside manner—so gentle, and quick! Dr. Disla also had the best energy—I had a lot of issues/concerns, and he took time to really educate me in a way that made sense to me! I am an anxious girly but this place took all my nerves away 🩷

user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best dental office that I’ve been to! I was told by a previous dentist that I needed $800 worth of work because they told me I had cavities. After a thorough exam by Dr Disla, he told me I had no cavities and referred me to have my wisdom teeth removed. The whole team from the front desk to assistants were awesome !

Dr. Disla is highly skilled, friendly , welcoming, gentle, and explains every step of the process. The staff is professional, friendly, and the office is spotless. I always look forward to every visit!!’
Hands down … you are truly one of the Best Dentist in Town..WE LOVE YOU DR. DISLA!!!!!!!

title: Sunny Days Dental
address: 1154 Lydia St #100, Austin, TX 78702, United States

user_reviews.Name: Diana Coker
user_reviews.Description:
Please improve your billing and insurance processing system! I had a cleaning all the way back in August 2024. I provided all of my insurance and personal information, before leaving my dental appointment I was told that everything was covered and good to go. More than 8 months later I received a text message for a $149 claim and a request to provide my personal information again. This request has been going on for months, I provide my information and then a month later I am reached out to by another person requesting my information again because of business/personnel changes.

I am now being asked to pay out of pocket or to contact my insurance company myself to get it resolved. Why as a patient should I have to do insurance billing for your office. It is not my responsibility that you don’t have competent people that can do insurance claims properly.

Update: 10/9/25 12:45PM I spoke with my insurance provider and confirmed that Sunny day dental is not processing the claim correctly therefore it keeps being denied. What has taken a year for sunny day dental to do took me 5 mins to call and confirm and find a resolution. Again passing off the cost to the patient for mismanagement of their claims is absolutely unacceptable

user_reviews.Name: Chris Alberts
user_reviews.Description: Sunny Days is great. A friendly team, efficient, very straightforward and transparent with treatment and treatment plans. No crazy upselling like I've experienced at other dentists.

user_reviews.Name: Robert Stevens
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been going to Sunny Days since 2018 and it’s always been a great experience! It’s the best dentist I’ve ever been to! Between prompt service, an incredibly nice staff and just good care, I always recommend Sunny Days to my co workers.

user_reviews.Name: Christina Hamm
user_reviews.Description: I would NOT recommend this Dentist. I have 2 cleanings covered a year with my insurance, confirmed for a third time after my arrival that it was covered, and almost 5 MONTHS LATER, I received an almost $200 charge on my cc on file saying that my cleaning was not covered. No warning, nothing. When in fact, my previous dentist from another state made a clerical error, my insurance paid them for my services and only returned HALF OF MY MONEY. They were NOT nice at all and handled everything extremely unprofessional when I did nothing but get a basic cleaning that was covered under my insurance. Oh, and they only are in the office 3 days a week which I definitely wish I was aware of before making my initial appointment.

Please be weary before scheduling an appointment with this office if you have insurance. They will tell you one thing and if you’re not covered you WILL receive a statement and the office will accept NO RESPONSIBILITY!!! RIDICULOUS!!! user_reviews_extended.Description: Beyond grateful to have found such a phenomenal dental office. The staff creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere that eases any anxiety. user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience here! I am new to Texas and am very wary of dental offices as I have almost been scammed in the past. Alyssa and Nick were the other people that I worked with, and I appreciated their communication before, during, and after the appointment. I already have my 6 month on the books, I will be back. user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going here for a couple of years now and I have nothing but great things to say. I was recommended to have a mouth guard for sleeping and it's been the best thing. Is it something you have to get used to wearing? Yes. user_reviews_extended.Name: Johanna Chu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm so thankful to have finally found a dentist in Austin! Dr. Shah is amazing at her job - skilled in dentistry, good listener, and knows how to encourage / calm your nerves. I felt very little discomfort during my fillings and Dr. Shah was great at walking me through the entire process. The office is located in one of my favorite parts of Austin (parking is easy & available) and the office itself is clean and inviting. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shah and her staff are top notch! From the booking of my first appointment to the cleaning to my exam by Dr. Shah, everyone was friendly, professional, and explained any procedures and costs clearly. I highly recommend Sunny Days Dental Practice!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love this office, and tell everyone about Dr. Shah and the whole team, they are really great.
I hadn't gone to the dentist for most of my 20's, and they brought my whole tooth/mouth situation back in line. Straightforward, non-judgmental, and incredibly helpful.

I had a standard cleaning scheduled during Covid-19 times, and from all my previous visits, I felt safe enough to come through to Sunny Days.
My feelings were correct, and the place was perfect. Everyone was very safe, and their protocols for the pandemic were both thorough and thoughtful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joanne Wagan
user_reviews_extended.Description: The appointment I booked on zocdoc was for dental cleaning so I expected to get my teeth cleaned. When I got to the clinic, they did imaging for 10 minutes and then wanted me to return on another day for the actual cleaning. I was already there, imaging only took 10 minutes but they won't accommodate me for the very reason I was there. Despite that, they still charged my insurance for $293, AND still want me to pay out of pocket for $46. So this is why they forced me to leave my credit card on file even when I didn't want to. They contacted me to settle otherwise they will charge the card on file. Not even an hour had passed and they had charged the card. I disputed this with my bank. All of that for wasting my day (I had to skip work) without cleaning my teeth which was the appointment I booked. This is not how you do business, and not how you provide healthcare! ALL MONEY!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brianna Hansen
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I always have a great experience at Sunny Days Dental. I just switched after finding my last Austin dentist to be very subpar. Sunny Dental exceeded my expectations and all of their staff were incredibly friendly and accommodating! They truly value your health and take their time explaining procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Brandt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely love this office!  The staff is incredibly friendly, my appointment was on time, I felt cared for and Dr. Shah was gentle and professional throughout the entire experience.  It has been really difficult to find a dental office I am comfortable with in Austin, I'm so grateful I found this one!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Geoffrey Belcher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Been a patient for 3+ years. The staff is kind and courteous and the office is comfortable.
Editing my review after a poor experience - They have started adding surprise fees to their services. Even if your insurance covers routine cleanings, expect extra charges. If you change insurance, that's at least a $75 charge for "processing". I had a routine cleaning after changing insurace and walked out with a $250 invoice after insurance. The total bill out of pocket would have been over $400

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Sexton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Shah and her entire team are true professionals. I've been going this office for the last 5 years and I cannot recommend this office enough. Dr. Shah is very informative and I appreciate her conservative approach to fillings and dental work - she doesn't just fill to fill but takes action when it's necessary.

Jahfi, the dental hygienist, is so gentle and just a kind person.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika Storli
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had one wisdom tooth taken out (because I’ve only had one come in, which got a cavity), and it was one of the most straightforward, quickest procedures I’ve ever had at a dentist. I was super nervous coming in because all my friends and family were telling me their horror stories of getting wisdom teeth extractions. But Dr. Shah was gentle and explained what I’d be feeling each step of the way. Emily at the front was awesome too, because I had called the day before my appointment to ask some more questions and she was very patient with me. I was in and out of the office in about 20-30 minutes, which was nothing compared to the four grown teeth I had to have removed when I was younger. Thank you for easing my worries over this procedure, Sunny Days!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Hale
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been here twice and was excited to make this my new Austin dentist (who likes searching for a new dentist?) but after my last trip there I think I'll need to start searching.

For some background info, my most recent visit in November 2020 (I'm writing this review very late!) , I was going for a routine cleaning as well as advice on an erupted wisdom tooth

First, I felt comfortable with how this office was following COVID guidelines, which is great. The reception team has always been friendly, talkative, and accommodating-- another great plus!

Their treatment rooms are bright and airy, but when I got back there I was surprised that the hygienist was wearing AirPods during my cleaning. I'm not sure why this bothered me-- this in no way impacted her work and may indeed help her focus-- but for some reason it made me feel like some busy work she was doing, not a real person receiving a service.

After my cleaning, Dr. Shah was in and out in what felt like 5 minutes. She was very professional and business-like, but I wouldn't say it felt like the "relationship-focused" approach touted on their website. I asked about my wisdom tooth and she advised that if it's not bothering me, It's really up to me when I want to get it out and gave me a referral to an oral surgeon if I decided to follow up. I 100% believe this is the right medical advice but as a (somewhat scared) person I sort of felt left exactly where I was when I came in-- not sure what to do about this wisdom tooth.

As I was leaving, there was an issue with charging me for x-rays that I didn't receive. This was cleared up very quickly, but this minor blip, combined with the rest of the experience left me feeling more like a number than a patient.

After my visit, I received an email survey asking me to rate my experience, give comments, etc. I completely filled out this survey with all the info and feelings in the review above and gave my contact info if the office wanted to reach out-- never heard back.

Overall, I might have just caught this practice on a bad day-- A pandemic is a stressful time for everyone and I completely understand that-- but I think I'm back to the drawing board in my Austin Dentist search.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Kuempel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Emily is warm and welcoming. Marissa is a sweetheart. Dr. Shah is accommodating and spends as much time as you need to answer questions and explain procedures. The office is gorgeous. Amazing experience. Can't believe I'm saying this, but I am looking forward to my next appointment!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachana P Shah
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in for a checkup and cleaning after having not seen a dentist in almost 2 years. I was anxious but Dr. Shah and her wonderful staff put me at ease! Started from the waiting room, to the X-rays, to the cleaning, the whole experience was very pleasant and serene (something you don't often equate with a dental visit!). Dr. Shah did a thorough job and explained each step along the way so I wasn't left wondering what was happening inside my mouth. I left with a concrete plan for my dental health going forward--one that works for my busy schedule as a stay-at-home mom of 2 small children. If you've been feeling guilty that you're not taking the best care of your teeth, visit Sunny Days Dental...for stress-free, kind, and patient service with lots of smiles, especially mine!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Davy Tolman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Shah and her team are amazing. She isn't like your regular dentist, you can tell that she truly cares about you and your well being. Has a calming atmosphere and vibe that make your dental appt easy and tranquil. Convenient to schedule, quick parking, everything is super smooth - get in get out and on your way. Will be coming to Sunny Days and Dr. Shah from here on out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenneth Skertchly
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update: My original review was 2 stars. After the first unpleasant experience, they called me and left a message apologizing. They also sent me a letter with a gift card, and offered to reschedule at my convenience. I still feel like the situation could have been prevented, but I'm glad to see that they made an effort to make things right. I've now had two appointments and I've gotten excellent service. Everyone there will take their time to explain anything you ask about, without feeling rushed. Also, they haven't tried to sell me things that I don't need (I'm looking at you, Castle Dental).

Original Review:
Got an appointment at 4:30. The receptionist was very pleasant. She told me the doctor was running a little bit late with another patient and I would have to wait for 20-30 minutes. That's fine. At 5:40 I was still sitting in the waiting room. Unacceptable. The receptionist asked if I wanted to reschedule. I told her I would go somewhere else. If you knew in advance that you were running late why did you not call me? Why did you waste my time? Their patient agreement even says that you can get penalized for missing an appointment. Where's my compensation?

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sergio Nicolas Amaya
user_reviews_extended.Description: Scheduled an appointment with them as a first time patient and one hour prior my appointment they texted me to say they can’t pull up my insurance. I tell them that I’m not willing to get the cleaning done unless covered my insurance (as I’m 100% confident that it is covered). They stopped responding and didn’t have the courtesy of even texting or calling to explain further. Don’t waste your time coming to this place… terrible customer service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Carney
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff are all very nice but they will not tell you upfront that your insurance is not in network and you will pay for it. My husband showed up for his routine cleaning appointment only to find out that he had been scheduled for an intial consult which he was then billed for. He had taken off work and nothing was even done. They looked at his mouth and got some xrays and then he had to schedule another appointment. Not only did this cost more but he missed work twice. We will not be returning to this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great location, easy parking access, right across food trucks/restaurants/shops. The office is well decorated and the staff is extremely friendly. They are doing a great job of making the space safe / clean for COVID by completing temperature checks, providing hand sanitizer and consistently disinfecting the office space.
Emily at the front desk is very thorough and ensure I was all set for my first appointments. She responded to my emails within the hour and was very helpful over the phone. Dr. Shah was sweet and very knowledgable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Gibson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I really wanted to love this dentist. Combo of genetics and poor decisions in my early 20s, I've got a TON of dental work done and a ton left to do, so it's important to me to find a dentist that isn't judgmental and will help me take care of it. Based on reviews I thought I'd find that at Sunny Days, but unfortunately didn't.

Dr. Shah sat down and immediately said, "so what the heck happened in there?!" Her demeanor throughout the appointment made me feel extremely embarrassed, honestly.

I was there to get a second opinion on a recc from another dentist, and ended up pursuing the treatment of either five or six new or replacement fillings at Sunny Days. Note for later: I had an initial exam appt, NOT a cleaning; I never got a cleaning at Sunny Days because that wasn't what I was there for.

I have never been in that much pain after a filling appointment in my life. I couldn't fully open my mouth for weeks after. Dr. Shah also was gossiping about her ex husband, her kids, her ex husband's girlfriend, and her boyfriend's ex-wife during BOTH of my appointments, which wasn't like a crazy big deal but it was kinda off-putting, and also at one point the hygienist was distracted by the conversation and stabbed my mouth.

At the end of my second appointment, Dr. Shah had left some residue on my teeth and was asking about whether it was there from a previous permanent retainer or if it was from that appointment, but they hadn't yet removed the bite guard or tubing from my mouth so I couldn't talk. She said "I can't floss, did you not get a floss when you came for your cleaning?" and I shook my head no, because I hadn't gotten a cleaning, so I hadn't gotten a floss. She then scraped it and realized that what was on my tooth was from that appointment and scraped it off, then huffed and said, "So you were wrong, you did get a floss" and then got up and left the room and I did not see her again at my appointment, which was honestly just really weird????

I already did not want to go back because of the treatment from Dr. Shah (the rest of the staff is honestly SO friendly though), but then on top of it they told me PPOs are in Network even though Delta Dental isn't, but then I still got slapped with a $650 bill a few weeks later lol.

IDK if this was just a weird set of peculiar circumstances at my appointments, but I was very off-put by Sunny Days.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Beaty
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been seeing Dr. Shah for several years now and I love her...she is very gentle and clear in her explanations and assessments of teeth and smiles...highly recommend her! Also, I really appreciate the comprehensive and educational aspect of her work. She takes the time to fully explain what is happening in your mouth, using video and other material so that you can make educated decisions about your oral health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joanna Fischer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a very unfortunate experience here. I was told I had gum issues and needed to move forward with an expensive, special type of cleaning that was not covered by my insurance. When I requested to move forward with a regular cleaning instead, I was told “it would damage my gums to do a regular cleaning.”

I left to get another opinion from a dentist (who went to Harvard Dental School) who said that there was absolutely no issue with my gums and no special treatment was needed. On top of that, he said it was completely untrue that a regular cleaning could have harmed me if I did even have that issue.

On top of this, there were other things about this experience that made me uncomfortable. For example, the office staff spoke in a way that belittled me about not being able to afford fancy out of pocket dental work (which I didn’t even need).

user_reviews_extended.Description:
EDIT: They claim that I did not visit this institution so I attached my invoice #16676. My bad, I mixed up $87 with $78. But YES, I did visit this dentist office, and YES I was charged $78 for < 1 minute of a "limited oral exam"

------

I had a silver filling that was catching on floss and wanted to get it fixed so I made an appointment here.

They told me to come in that day. The dentist looked at the tooth for not even a minute in a "limited oral exam" and charged me $87 (without insurance) for coming in.

That's not even the worst part: they told me to come back another day when they could find the time to ACTUALLY fix it into their schedule. This was unprofessional and uncalled for because I called and asked for my filling to be fixed and they scheduled me in... but only for a "limited oral exam" just to waste my time.

So I ubered there, only to get robbed of about $90, only to be sent away to come back another day. Really unprofessional and I would not recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Xiomara Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I 100% DO NOT recommend this dentist unless your child is older and they can absolutely advocate for themselves.

I'm sharing this in hopes it helps someone else make a better choice for their children's dentist. Maybe they can even change their policy on adults going back with their children.

I drove 4 hrs specifically for this dentist on a recommendation from a friend who loves this dentist.

This place is very clean and the front desk ladies are extremely nice. The dentist we was also pretty patient with my son, and I did appreciate that.

The part I did not like was the fact that when my son/daughter went back for their cleaning, the dental assistant/ hygienist came back out and informed me that he had started crying right away. She stated she "treated him like her kids" and talked to him to find out why he was crying. He said, "He was scared and didn't want to be alone." I informed her that he had an extraction done before. This was his second time, and he did amazing the first time. He had nitrous oxide the first time, which is what he was supposed to be getting along with a numbing shot in his mouth. This is what was requested by me. He did not shed one tear the first time he had an extraction done and left feeling fine. So my son was not new to the dentist. I told her he would be better if I was back there. She told me, "Well, we want the kids to detach themselves from the parents when they come in, so they get used to be alone back there." She told me if they needed me and he didn't do well that they would come and get me. That was a lie. That was red flag number 2. Red flag number 1 should've been the little girl my daughter and I saw coming out with tears streaming down her face while she looked scared. This was before the Dr came in and did our consult. So I knew I should've pushed to go back there with my son. But because it was their policy, I believed they knew what they were doing.

I was wrong.

You can't assume any/every child is going to automatically feel safe in a brand new environment. I understand children have to learn to be ok without their parents, but first, why not make it feel like a safe space? Let their parent join them for a couple of visits until they're comfortable. These people were strangers to my son, which is why he didn't want to be alone back there without me.

1.5 hrs went by before they brought my son out, and he was balling his eyes out while the Dr said, "He was a champion, and we didn't have any problems. We gave him some 'sleepy juice' to help with the pain, so he should be fine in a little while." Meanwhile, my son didn't look fine. He didn't look like a champ. He looked scared and traumatized.  As we got in the car, I asked my daughter if she was ok, and she said yes, but the lady was really rough with her, and she wasn't very nice. She told me that they actually weren't very nice to my son either. The entire time he was back there, he cried. He asked for me over and over, and all they kept telling him was to stop crying. This is not ok. If a child is crying for their parent, the smart thing to do would be to bring that parent back to help you. As I told them before, he did great when I was back there the first time he did an extraction at another dentist. I truly believe they take the kids back there alone so they don't have to treat the kids correctly and just get it done, and they can say whatever they want to the kids.

By not coming to get me for 1.5 hrs, I thought he was ok, I thought he was back there with some sedation, calm, watching a movie getting his teeth worked on. Instead, I learned he was crying for me the entire time, and the entire time, they ignored his request for me. Even though she stated she'd come get me if she needed me.

I 100% DO NOT recommend this dentist unless your child is older and they can absolutely advocate for themselves. I wish I listened to my gut and pushed to go back with my son.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joumana Accad
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been to dental clinics all over the world and this one was my best experience bar none. The clinic is located in the ground floor on the corner of a strip center with ample parking and easy access. I like the decor, with its giant crystal chandeliers , rugs , evergreen potted plants and big screen TVs as well as life-size game figurines; the seating is very comfortable with leather armchairs, giving off a sense of fun and party, totally unlike the cold uniformity of most other dental clinics. The TV screens are kept on showing reels of Disney cartoon productions to keep the younger patients entertained. As far as the actual medical and dental care, it was conducted very professionally with thoroughness and rigorous organisation . The X-rays, BP reading are done in a separate room with a dental technician; the actual consultation takes place in a large room with a reclining seat with Dr Siami. I found him to be very personable and very professional and he made the treatment  swift and painless. I feel like I have really lucked out and highly recommend this dental clinic to anyone, young or old.

title: The Local Dentist
address: 2023 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78702, United States

user_reviews.Name: Meech-a-ronie and cheese
user_reviews.Description:
They let me pick what ever movie wanted :)

With an extreme fear of previous childhood experiences I was very nervous.
I have avoided for years; and here at the local dentist, I have met my people,
they did not hesitate when I called 10 times in one day to go over the plan again. And again when I wanted to ask more questions with a mouth full of cotton swabs.
I got treatment without insurance and we came up with a plan that can work for my style;
I.e, what’s the priority, what needs to happen today and what can wait. Very informative.

And just maybe now I won’t cry during a simple cleaning :) thanks yall

Spooky, scary, for sure, because …dentist, but, I will speak on the staff is absolutely angelic, accommodating place for my big ol’ fears. Happy to be here

user_reviews.Name: Sarah
user_reviews.Description: I had some old childhood fillings that went bad and fixed by Dr. Trent Smith. Another dentist in the area said it needed to be a crown, but Dr Smith felt that he could save the tooth and tends to be on the conservative side of doing crowns. He filled it and a few years later I move out of state where two different dentists said my “Austin” dentist did a great job with that filling and that just by looking at it they couldn’t tell it was majority filling, only knew by looking at the x-rays. They were both impressed. A crown would’ve been very expensive, so he did me a solid by saving that tooth. I trust Dr Smith and the staff here - I know they care about their patients because they take time to get to know you and help you learn better hygiene habits. I miss vibing out to fun music at this dentist office so much!!

user_reviews.Name: Katie Wilcox
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been coming here for four years now and SO highly recommend this place. I’ve had to get a decent amount of dental work done through Dr. Trent after some years of stress and neglect. Not only does he never make me feel bad about that, but appointments here feel like a highlight in my day… wild thing to say about a dentist. I’ve never felt like he’s over-treating, ever, and it’s evident he puts a serious amount of care into the work without adding a hefty price tag. The front desk is accommodating and always let me know when an earlier appointment is available.

user_reviews.Name: Justin Harrell
user_reviews.Description:
I was able to get a last-minute dentist appointment with Danny and Dr. Gates, who were both incredibly professional and were very understanding of my pain threshold and even though they did the best that they could they were also professional enough and knowledgeable enough to know that they could only do so much.
At the end, they knew exactly who to send me to after two hours of working on me and so the next day I was able to get the tooth pulled that I needed.
Dr. Gates worked diligently for two hours to help numb my mouth enough (but then had to move on) I think I sang them about 5 songs in the process, but they didn’t seem to mind.
I definitely recommend this particular place for anyone needing teeth cleaned or anything dental. They were incredible to me and Dr. Gates talked me through the billions of questions I had and they used an analogy on me that made the rest of the information click! 10/10 service. I will see them soon for a tooth cleaning! Marvelous job all around!

Also I asked them to change the program on the tv to something more peaceful so we watched ocean videos and listened to mediation music. I was experiencing slight anxiety but then they listened to me and just like that I was able to calm down and not feel anxious. Bravo ladies!

user_reviews.Name: Jessica Griego
user_reviews.Description:
I’m so thankful for Dr Trent Smith and the caring, professional staff at The Local Dentist. My front tooth snapped in two after tripping and Superman-flying into my kid’s bed runner and Dr Smith made it to where it’s impossible to tell. The staff made me feel comfortable and career for.

Thank you!

user_reviews.Description: The Local Dentist has excellent customer service! Their individualized attention and approach to patient care is next level! They offer detailed and personalized treatment plans. They make dentistry fun and approachable.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience I’ve ever had at a dentist. Always good music playing and everyone working is super nice. He always takes the time to thoroughly explain what’s going on with your teeth and how and why he’ll be treating you. They also aren’t trying to charge you for everything they can by over diagnosing.
