user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to The Local Dentist as a new patient and can't speak highly enough about the staff. Every single person I interacted with was helpful, kind and professional. Since it was my first visit, I had a bunch of X-rays/measurements done and the staff communicated exactly what they were doing and how much it all would cost. Additionally, the cleaning was thorough and painless. I feel lucky to have found a really great local dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allen Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great first experience! It's been year's since I found a place like this. I've only had 2 dentist in my life I really liked and willing to stick with and they both retired year's ago. Had an emergency situation that got dealt with fast, efficient, affordable, and professionally. Very nice staff and such a cool atmosphere. I'm less of a nervous wreck now going to the dentist, due to too many bad experiences in the past.  Have hope now. Thank you Dr. Trent and staff.

8 days later I'm back and terrified of getting a back molar extracted. I was absolutely amazed at the comfort offered and the expertise Dr. Smith and staff had. He got that stubborn tooth out way faster than I expected and I felt no pain at all. To me that's very important, especially since the experience I had last time I had this procedure. I'm truly in awe and somehow I paid quite a bit less than was quoted. WIN WIN
Thank you again, Dr. Smith and all the staff. I'd give 10**********'s if I could.
Fast forward to today and I swear I've never had a better dentist and the staff is friendly and top notch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isaac Akinboyewa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I switched over my dental services to The Local Dentist about 18 months ago and I am very glad I did. The Health personnel in an admirable expertise were able to analyze my dental issues with ease and proffered a treatment path that I have followed to get almost all my problems resolved. Their fees are affordable and even discounted for qualified patients while accepting most insurance schemes without a problem. The staff are all very friendly with good communications. Appointments are prompt without delays to the extent that I have never waited in the reception for longer than 3 minutes before being attended to.
I will definitely recommend The Local Dentist to anyone for good Dental services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Hamilton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hope this helps others avoid the stress I went through:

I just moved to Austin and needed a new dentist, so I came here. My old dentist in California said last year that I had no cavities, just two teeth to keep an eye on. But at The Local, I was told my teeth were in really bad shape and that I had 9 cavities! When I asked how this could happen, the dentist asked if I drink sparkling water. I said yes, a few times a week, and he said that was likely the cause or maybe my diet (which is healthy and hasn't changed). He also said a bunch of alarming stuff about my bite and overall dental health, which left me feeling really upset and scared.

I go to the dentist regularly and had never heard any of this before, so I decided to get a second opinion. I made an appointment with another dentist in Austin and got another round of x-rays. The new dentist told me I have ZERO cavities. She said the two teeth my California dentist mentioned still need to be watched, but they aren't cavities or anything serious. She said my teeth are actually in good shape.

There was no sales pitch—just straightforward, professional care. This experience made me realize the importance of finding a "doctor dentist" and not a "business dentist."

I was losing sleep over the diagnosis and potential costs and amount of work from The Local. Please don’t let them scare you into getting unnecessary work done. Get a second opinion if something sounds off or alarming!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Tighe
user_reviews_extended.Description: We had been going to another local dentist for 30+ years in Round Rock. Mike Smith retired and we started to see his son, Dr. Trent Smith. He worked in the same office less than  5 minutes from our house. He moved to downtown Austin and we followed him. He’s excellent as a dentist and actually a better person. He’s kind, gentle and explains everything he’s going to do. He always includes you in his plans. “We” make the decision. His staff is also very nice and efficient/effective. It’s a comfortable place to be and All make it relaxed and enjoyable. Wait….the dentist can’t be enjoyable. Let’s say he’s a reliable dentist who treats his friends like family. His staff is  on the same page so be prepared  for a good dental experience. We highly recommend his office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judy Young
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Local Dentist is, hands-down, the best dental practice--ever! Dr. Trent Smith has incredible expertise, which he deploys to provide the best possible care for his patients at a reasonable cost. He and his staff are compassionate and thoroughly professional. My husband and I have always dreaded going to the dentist, but that is no longer the case!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madi Glemser
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This way by far the most pleasant dentist experience I have had!

I appreciated the attentiveness given to myself as the patient and my specific needs as well as the thorough explanations in response to my questions. It’s very clear that Dr. Smith genuinely cares about not only quality, to include things such as sustainability and longevity, but also the impact to the local community. The office serves to support local Austin artists and musicians which makes it feel more personal.

The chairs were comfortable, staff was friendly, and there is no lack of entertainment (TVs on walls and ceilings as well as music). I am happy to have found this office and will continue to see Dr. Smith, and I would absolutely recommend him to any friends or family in search of a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Calia Trammell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was very happy with the cleaning that the hygienist, Chris, gave me! Dr. Trent was also very good at explaining how I have a breathing issue and what are the steps we can take to fix it! I'm very excited to see them so I can improve my health and well-being and learn more about what else I can do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Palomares
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Trent Smith is great! I decided to book my appointment after our neighbor recommended him. He is kind and informative. I was nervous about my visit because I hadn’t been to the dentist in a while. He and his staff were kind and reassuring and went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable. He took the time to answer all of my questions. This was by far the best dentist experience I’ve had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrey Caricato
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As someone who tends to frequent the dentist about every 3 years, I have to admit my experience at the Local Dentist was the most pleasant I’ve ever had. I called the office yesterday complaining of tooth sensitivity and they were able to squeeze me into the schedule the following day. You can tell the staff really cares. Dr. Trent is super gentle, thorough, and made every effort to make sure I was comfortable. I ended up having a cavity and he fit me in same day so I wouldn’t have to schedule another visit which I really appreciated.

On another note, the office space is extremely clean and well decorated. 10/10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Swerdfeger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow. This place. Never wanted to stay at a dentists office so long as I did here! The connection with the local art scene is so cool, and so unique.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Never had a hygienist do such a thorough job on my teeth before, and Dr. Trent is great as well! The vibe of the office is nice and kind of cozy, and meeting Gwen was a great experience too :) I had a nice time here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madelyn Albracht
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is so cool! I have had such an excellent experience with Dr. Trent Smith. He goes out of his way to make sure you are comfortable and happy. He is meticulous and reassuring. Literally, how are more dentists not doing what he is? You will not regret making him you and your family’s Dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rahul Sonnad
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a super high-quality dental practice.  Dr. Trent is extremely professional and knows his stuff and also is compelled to do things in an extremely high quality manner.  The facilities are excellent and the overall process is well orchestrated.  I had an access fill completed with no pain in short order and it was a great dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: bouchardmusic
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Local Dentist is honestly the best dentist I’ve ever been to. As someone who has been terrified of the dentist since I was a kid, the amazing staff and Dr. Trent made me feel seen, heard, and as comfortable as possible. I could not recommend them more! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: A B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Trent Smith, DDS when he was at Round Rock Dental. He has a natural ability to make one feel calm, especially if you are terrified of visiting the dentist. I went to his new office today and was grateful I did. It was a better experience than when he at Round Rock Dental. The drive was worth it. The office is decorated in such a personal touch you feel like the dentist is in your house. Local art decorated the walls, tvs in front of the dental chairs and on the ceiling! Brilliant! You can stream a show and wear headphones for tv or music. Keep up the great work and I'll be back! Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alanna Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Trent and his staff are so thorough and so responsive to any questions that I have.  He explains dentistry in a way that is very easy to understand.  He personally cleaned my teeth and it did not hurt.  He loves what he does and truly cares about each of his patients.  Plus he has great taste in music. He's been my dentist for 4 years and I will definitely keep driving to his new practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Parmley
user_reviews_extended.Description: A fantastic dentist visit. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting: TV’s on the wall and ceiling, and really good music playing throughout the building. + Mood lighting makes it the coolest dental office IVE ever been to. The staff was very friendly and provided excellent service. I highly recommend for all your cleanings and teeth related things!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Hammond
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had an amazing experience!  My teeth felt wonderful when leaving.

The dental office is thoughtfully decorated.  Dr. Trent has TV's on the ceiling for you to watch during your cleaning.  He had it on Amazon Live Art when I went, and it was so relaxing.  He plays great music.  B

Best of all is all of the products he uses are sustainable made, and natural.  It is a great location.

100% recommend making an appointment for your next cleaning at The Local Dentist ATX.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tye Fussell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Continually, the best dentist experience I've ever had. I love the chill vibe, great lighting, the TVs and best of all, the tasty old school and 90's hip hop and downtempo music. Dr. Smith is low on ego and high on service. Super happy with him and his team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jack Frick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Trent has been my dentist for over 10 years.  He puts his patients first, knows and used latest technology, I never feel pain, and those who work with him are terrific.  He is reasonably priced and works with my budget. It is a pleasure to recommend Dr Trent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Smith is awesome. This was the most comfortable dentist visit ever. If you’re anxious about going to the dentist then this is the place for you. Everything is designed for the patient. The chairs are super comfortable. The mood lighting, TVs, and great music make you forget that you’re getting your teeth checked. The staff is great too. Dagon and Juany are excellent and keep you relaxed. I highly recommend The Local Dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: eugen onescu
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Since my regular dentist doesn't do extractions any longer I must confess I was apprehensive looking for another dentist. After calling a few dentists in town from an online list as well as weighing in other more affordable options I decided to give Dr. Trent a call given his perfect reviews. I wasn't disappointed. Firstly, as soon as I dialed the number a human voice actually answered the phone as well as all my questions truthfully and professionally. Secondly, I received a timely same day call from her letting me know they were running late with my appointment.
As soon as I got through the door I was taken care of promptly and courteously by the same receptionist I had spoken to earlier in the week, the very efficient Juany. Moreover Dr. Trent and his assistant Cindy were awesome and explained me in detail the entire procedure. I found Dr. Trent to be quite genuine, with a very pleasant manner and an excellent professional. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex S
user_reviews_extended.Description: $75 dollar cancellation fee seems a bit excessive. Also cancelled over the weekend and it didn’t help because it was “2 business days”

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alejandra Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love going to the dentist but Dr. Smith made me REALLY love going to the dentist. To start, the office is bright, modern, impeccably clean, and the staff is friendly. With increased social distancing protocols, I felt safe and was well informed about what to expect.

The appointment itself is more thorough than any I have ever had and really took into account the whole patient and the areas directly connected to your oral health. Dr. Smith and staff talks you through each step of the appointment and makes you feel comfortable. The Molekule air purifier, weighted blankets, Netflix, and wireless headphones are just bonuses.

I can't wait to go back. I just wish it was sooner than once every 6 months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Beecham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always have great experiences at The Local Dentist! This was my first cleaning with my new braces (which Dr. Trent recommended and has been good so far) so was a bit nervous tbh. I passed no problem and the staff was great! Even saw a friend there, hi RD!

user_reviews_extended.Name: G
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been blessed to be a patient of Dr. Trent Smith for over 7 years.  When he opened his own practice, I went with him because he is worth the long drive!  Dr. Trent is consistently and exceedingly kind and patient.  He truly cares and is the only dentist I've ever had that makes me happy to go for dental work!  I've broken two different teeth in the past couple of years as well as had a tooth that had special surgery on it 30 years ago fall out, (twice!) and he has always gotten me in ASAP for all of these!  His support staff from Dagan (his assistant) to Juany (front desk) are equally awesome!  His newest assistant Genia was a doll too.  If you hate going to the dentist, then start going to Dr. Trent Smith because his awesome, caring, down to earth demeanor makes going so much better!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Rojo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Starting with the office, high end chairs, state of the art equipment with latest technology and super friendly and attentive staff.  Dr. Trent Smith is an amazing dentist.  This is a new office conveniently located  near the downtown sector.  Easy to get to with plenty of parking. Couldn’t be more pleased.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Walter Rumpf
user_reviews_extended.Description: I used to drive all the way to Round Rock to see Trent. He wants to do things right and is creative in finding ways to put together a plan to get you the best treatment based on your budget (and your insurance). Now that he has his own place, he's more conveniently located and able to put his own high standards in place. He's invested in all the best technology and uses high quality sustainable materials. His office is the coolest dentist experience I've ever had from the TV's on the ceiling and headphones to enjoy while you're getting work done to the amazing art work on the wall and top of the line air filtration systems that keep the air free of any airborne pathogens.

user_reviews_extended.Name: bcw
user_reviews_extended.Description: 10/10!  Everyone at The Local Dentist is amazing.  Dr. Trent is personable,  knowledgeable and wants you to have the best dental health and treatment. I can't say enough about how great Dr. Trent and his staff have been to me and my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brett Neie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was hands down the best Dental experience I’ve ever had.

Staff is professional, safe and efficient, while Dr. Smith provides thorough and excellent work. Throughout the process I was relaxed and at ease.

It certainly doesn’t hurt they have the most comfortable chairs in ATX and the latest tech for an even smoother appointment.

10/10 recommendation!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anais B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Janelle was very helpful with making sure I understand what all would take place during my cleaning. Dr. Trent was great in explaining my x-rays and also recommending what steps to take for another procedure I’ll be looking into. Overall, the experience was amazing and s/o to my dentist who did the cleaning, I feel terrible for forgetting her name but she is AMAZING ✨

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom Engwall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Who knew a trip to the dentist could be so enjoyable? Dr. Smith and his team haven’t overlooked one detail in making the patient experience as comfortable as possible.  The multiple TVs, sound system hooked up to your favorite music and ambient lighting in each patient room will keep your mind occupied while Dr. Smith and his staff provide excellent dental work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candice M (Tater)
user_reviews_extended.Description: If anyone is in need of an amazing dentist and team... I found one! They were able to get me in on short notice; they accepted my out of state dental insurance (Guardian), they worked with my insurance and all the work I needed done to priorities the most important things to fix to where I could stay in my budget... TVs on the ceiling hooked up to YouTube or Netflix, with noise canceling headphones that the dentist can still speak to you through when needed. I barely even felt any of the work that was done. The dentist took his time, explained everything very thoroughly.. and did an excellent job. 10 stars and 4 thumbs up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gloria Lara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone from the staff to the doctor were all very kind, accommodating and professional. The doctor's manner of explaining what was to follow in my treatment process eased my anxieties. I hadn't been able to find a private dentist near enough and this practice is walking distance to my house. Perfect! Can't wait to begin the road to my smile.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allyson Maxey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The hygienist was so gentle and amazing. I was offered a “Menu of Comforts” from which I was able to order noise cancelling headphones (my hygienist was able to push a button in and talk to me when she needed to), I was able to choose from a dozen streaming platforms, and I had a very relaxing experience. The X-ray blew my mind - it was from the future. I didn’t even have to leave my chair for it.

I’ll never go anywhere else. Modern, fancy, hi-tech, friendly and affordable. Works with all insurance providers! Trentist is THE BEST!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan O'Neill
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just finished up straightening my teeth with Dr.Smith and my teeth look perfect!! I always enjoy going into the office, the staff is really friendly and helpful. He has TVs in each room and weighted blankets. Actually they have a whole menu of comfort items to choose from and always great music, they’ve somehow captured the Austin vibe in a dentist office! Haha highly recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Robert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Trent and his staff exceeded all expectations. I was brought in immediately, there was no wait. The doctor cleaned my teeth himself and was both gentle and meticulous. The office is modern, clean and comfortable.  I enjoyed chatting with the staff about our neighborhood - this truly is a ‘local’ dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Olsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is such an awesome office!! Everyone is super friendly. Dr. Trent was happy to answer all of my questions in ways that helped me understand even the most technical stuff. TVs and mood lighting are provided when you’re in the chair to help you feel as comfortable as possible, which is so nice. I had some cavities filled here and the experience was a breeze! Can’t thank you guys enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriel Burge
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Trent and his staff went above and beyond making me feel the most comfortable and relaxed as I was getting some fillings done. They also helped me work out the finances and spaced out the work that needed to be done so it wasn’t so expensive. I highly recommend going to see them if you have had bad dentist experiences in the past or are worried about cost. They will definitely take care of you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eva Valdez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love to come to my appointments with Dr. Trent Smith. I love the attention I get the minute I walk in the door. Once in the chair I feel so at ease. I like the fact I can watch TV or listen to music But, most of all no matter the question I ask, their quick to give me the answer Im expecting, no matter what I ask. His whole staff is just so wonderful. Keep up the good work. Can't wait for my next appointment

Thank you very much!
Ms. Eva

user_reviews_extended.Name: C J
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Such a personable dentist.  And it helps a lot that he is young - won't be retiring anytime soon - I'll have a stable dentist for years.
Discussion on my treatment was in depth, consise, and there is a detailed road map on getting a smile I can actually be proud of.
Past dental experiences have been rushed and impersonal - not this time.
Really really really happy with Dr. Trent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meg Durcan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a crown fall off and the team had it all taken care of for a super reasonable price within a day.  I was so impressed by the way they approach explaining what actions they are taking and making me feel comfortable.  It’s clearly a tight knit team who really care about their patients.  I’ve certainly found my new dentist and would recommend it to anyone who is ambivalent about getting something checked out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aimee Ryan
user_reviews_extended.Description: After not being in the dentist's chair for far too long and building up fear of finding a new dentist, I couldn't be more at ease and thankful to have found Dr. Trevor Smith and his excellent crew of assistants and hygienists. I highly recommend The Local Dentist. They have helped me overcome my fears of the dentist and I find myself being very trusting and confident while in their care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Hawley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been seeing Dr. Trent since before he had his own practice (15 years now). He is extremely good at his job and is very compassionate. I have been having some serious issues because of my orthodontist in the past and Dr. Trent has gone above and beyond helping me since he understands my situation. If you go see Dr. Trent you will be taken care of

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Hubbard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down best/coolest atmosphere for a dentist office I have ever been to, makes you want to visit again. Staff is very friendly and professional and Dr. Smith knows his stuff. Would highly recommend to friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Venancio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everything was great!!! It has been a couple years since my last visit so I was a little nervous but Dr. Trent made me feel very comfortable. His staff is super nice. The feel of the office is clean, modern and relaxing. I will definitely be back for my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robin Dahlheim
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always professional, courteous, and competent!  Dr. Trent Smith has all the latest tools and techniques for pain free dentistry.  The longest I've had to wait for an invisilign appointment has been 1 minute, very respectful of your time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Xavier Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wowsa! talk about a most excellent experience? I sure found one with The Local Dentist. Very smooth operation, excellent staff,and a totally cool place for anyone and everyone's dental needs. All I can say is these folks know what they're doing and they're doing it very well. Mind blown for sure. Many,many thanks and best wishes for continued success. Ciao, C'est Bon, and Merci beaucoup. lol......

Continued.....needed a bit more work done and it went very well. Glad I was able to address the issue. Doctor and staff were very cool and handled my issue extremely well. Major difference as night and day. Super cool 😎 Many, many thanks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Hodges
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience! The team got me in for an unexpected exam within a few hours of talking on the phone, explained every step of the process, and quickly and professionally resolved my dental issue. Also - the ability to watch Netflix is a nice distraction! All around excellent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lacey Monti
user_reviews_extended.Description: The most at ease dental experiences I have ever had. Cannot recommend Dr. Trent Smith and his team enough! Thank you for giving me reasons to look forward to my visits to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lillian Barnett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Trent is a miracle worker. After a previous dentist left cement between my teeth and botched a crown over a root canal, Trent thought through all of the viable solutions and remedied the situation with detail and care. I appreciate that Trent talks through all of the options and is candid about cost. On top of that, the weighted blankets, noise cancelling headphones, streaming options and artwork in the space more resemble a spa than a dentist's office. It is so refreshing to find a dentist and staff that are committed to patients' comfort.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yolanda Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is amazing. I highly recommend it to any one& everyone needing dental care. The staff is very kind& polite. Made me feel very homey& cozy. The experience was out of this world. Not like any other traditional dental office. A very relaxed atmosphere. I'm ready to come again. I had teeth that needed to pulled out. The dentist is amazing. I felt no pain what so ever.. Love this place!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: D M
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going here for a few years. They’re such good people. The office is great. The experience is top notch with awesome TVs and clean cutting edge equipment. All of my cosmetic work has been done with such precision and perfection. The staff is super cool and very much austin I pretty much feel like I’m with family when I’m at the LD!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: NorrinRaad1
user_reviews_extended.Description: I read about the great reviews this office had when I was looking for a new regular dentist and I was not disappointed. From the beginning of my visit today there was a mellow ambience to the waiting room, from the good music being played, the comfortable chairs and even the cool Superman artwork lol. The staff was very friendly and accomodating! The exam room I was in had a relaxing view of a fish aquarium being run on a t.v. mounted on the wall which could be seen in front of me as I sat down. I noticed that there was even a t.v. mounted on the ceiling so you could view it as you were laying back in the comfortable reclining chair! Dr. Trent explained to me all of the details for my appointment with the upmost precision and care. I will absolutely make this office my regular dentist! BEST DENTIST EXPERIENCE EVER!!! I give them 10/10 stars!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raj Ashwin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Trent is one solid dentist and has a great supporting crew with Juany & Genia!  I recently relocated to the area and was looking for a new go-to dentist.  Trent goes above and beyond with his service by providing a very comforting environment with mood controlled lighting, Netflix, refreshments, and many many other extras!  Definitely check out the Local Dentist if you’re looking for a new go-to dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Bergeron
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Trent is committed to providing the highest quality care while also being attuned to financial realities.  His staff is the best of the best- as he is!
Beautiful, thoughtful, and comfortable office environment is certainly icing on the cake.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ben Weber
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just moved to the Austin area from out of state and I was due for a check up and cleaning. I went to The Local Dentist after some quick research and finding numerous 5-star reviews. I had a GREAT experience with Dr. Smith and his staff. Everyone was a total pro. Will definitely be back in 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Mozley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Guaranteed to be your best dental experience. I have been seeing Dr. Trent for many years and have always referred everyone I know to him. The staff is wonderful and the atmosphere can’t be beat!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ben may
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Trent and The Local Dentist team have a great thing going up there -

Cool space with a nice Austin vibe that makes a typically unnerving experience actually enjoyable.

Lots of extra touches that are geared towards making your visit as relaxing as possible and super comfortable.

Go check them out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Gilani
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Fabulous experience. Dr. Smith's staff is very skilled, and makes you feel so comfortable. Dr. Smith has state of the art equipment, and the most comfortable dental chairs!!!
Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Hawks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly, professional and good at what they do. Dr Trent has a great team and a bonus that I enjoyed is the music they play at the office.  Pricing is excellent for services provided.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabelle Longley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely the best dentist that I have ever met, and every single staff member is fantastically kind and helpful. Every single person in this office cares about their patients and want to help them. I cannot remotely think of a single thing that i would change about this office. I will be flying back from my new house in LA to come here for dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Talia Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in today for the first cleaning I’ve had in 5 years so naturally was feeling a bit anxious about it. Stella and Dr. Smith took great care of me and made it a super easy experience. I can’t recommend them enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Kuo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super welcoming & friendly!! Very informative and they all walk you through the process and are very honest and real with you. They only want the best for their clients and you can tell. The office is super cute and clean, and they let you watch Netflix while they work on your teeth so that’s a plus!! 10/10 recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex McCormick
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the most professional and knowledgeable Dentist in the city. I've known Trent pretty much most of my life and he is not just passionate about his work but he also loves what he does. I would highly recommend him to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sammie Zonana
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a really great visit as a new patient and plan to keep coming back! The staff was super friendly, the Dr. Smith was awesome and very thorough during my exam and cleaning, and the office was trendy and clean. Would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stan Laird
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my wisdom teeth removed a few months ago and I asked Trent if he would do my cleaning since my mouth was still a little sore. He usually doesn't do cleanings, but he made an exception even with his busy schedule.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jose Ramos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing service every time. Dr Trent is a perfectionist and makes you feel extremely comfortable every time. His staff is also extremely helpful and the office is beautiful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsey Bond
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow wow wow! Great experience. The teeth cleaning was super non painful and they were incredibly helpful and informative. Love how much care and passion they put into the space and experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Farmer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Smith is a diligent dentist who works hard to make the patient comfortable while striving for excellence in caring for their dental needs.  I highly recommend Dr Smith and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eliza Kahn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience! Friendly staff and excellent advice on some cosmetic needs. I actually enjoyed the cleaning experience with good music and extra attention on my comfort level. They really went above and beyond.

user_reviews_extended.Name: michael sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service! The staff is friendly and professional. They care about making a trip to the dentist an enjoyable experience while also performing top-notch dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robin Dahlheim
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience and I love the results of the invisilign Dr. Trent inspects and adjusts all throughout the journey.  Thank you for all you patience as I have had to adjust schedules, very flexible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shira Goldberg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend! I’ve been with Dr. Smith since before this current practice and followed him here. He takes great care of my teeth and the office is so nice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Daniels
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been in Austin for 10+ years and The Local Dentist is hands down the best dental experience I’ve had. Super-clean, friendly and extremely professional service. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Aller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Trent is super thorough and made sure to explain everything in terms I would understand. The staff was also really friendly and didn’t make me feel rushed at all. Will definitely continue coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Guadalupe Vela
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience, the place is such a vibe too. And they made me feel welcomed from the moment I came in and to when I left. If you need a dentist you should go here. Everyone nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: clark russell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love local dentist. Kind, friendly and informative. Very professional and it’s always a pleasure going to them! Highly recommend for anyone looking for a dentist that cares :D

user_reviews_extended.Description: Followed Dr Trent Smith to his new private practice. Just blocks away from I-35 on Cesar Chavez. Fresh bright office with the same competent, calm care that I received from him in the past. Congratulations!

user_reviews.Name: Vicki Robles
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Largent and his incredible team are top-notch! I had two wisdom teeth removed, one of which was a real terror, so getting that out was pure relief. The entire process was seamless, and the staff made me feel comfortable from start to finish. My recovery has been surprisingly smooth—honestly no pain after the initial numbness wore off on day one. If you need oral surgery, this is the place to go!

user_reviews.Name: Jordin Cook
user_reviews.Description: I came in today from a referral from Dr. Salehi (also amazing) and I must say wow! Everyone was so kind! The Surgeon in charge of extracting my tooth ABSOLUTELY AMAZING! All of the staff were not only nice but really funny. The lady who prepped me was phenomenal too. After the week I had I needed the laughs. The front desk, the assistants everyone was sooo amazing! Even the gentleman in the room who was assisting with the surgery was kind. I recommended all of my family to come. Such a great place! Wow!

user_reviews.Description: Awesome place I got 4 wisdom teeth taken out and it took less than 15 minutes everyone was great I had forgotten my paper work and they emailed my dentist and got it for me so I was able to keep my appointment I was scared to get 4 teeth out but everyone there made me feel reassured and comfortable and Dr Largent walked me thru the whole process as he removed my 4 wisdom teeth. user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience at East Austin Oral Surgery. From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly fast at checking me in and very friendly. Everyone was professional and made me feel at ease right away.

Dr. Largent was amazing—fast, professional, and kind. He really helped make the wisdom teeth removal process a lot less scary than I expected. His calm and comforting demeanor created an environment where I felt safe and well taken care of.

Overall, I highly recommend Dr. Largent and the entire team at East Austin Oral Surgery. They made what could have been a stressful procedure smooth and easy.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Got all 4 of my wisdom teeth removed the same day. Amazing team, amazing surgeon. 10/10 would recommend to ANYONE!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Sanchez-Vega
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such an amazing doctor! Got all 4 wisdom teeth taken out. Process was fast, easy, and painless. Was so worried about the surgery but the doctor is fantastic at his job and took really good care of me. For any oral surgery’s definitely go here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Tate
user_reviews_extended.Description: The moment I stepped into the office, I felt rushed. I was handed paper work to fill out. When I sat down in the lobby to fill it out, I was immediately escorted to the back. They immediately numbed me while I was still trying to fill out the paperwork. After I was numb the doctor immediately wanted to get the job done. I had ALOT of anxiety about getting my tooth pulled seeing as they were using local anesthesia. There was no compassion there for that. They had an in and out work ethic. I can say that the doctor took all of 5minutes taking my tooth out. I didn’t feel any pain. He did let me know what he was doing while pulling the tooth. The and pain was minimal during healing as well. He is great at what he does! I can honestly say that. Please try to focus on customer compassion. I’ve had alot of surgeries. Nervous wasn’t even the word….

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daisy O.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came here for wisdom / molar teeth removal for my braces I got a lot of teeth taken out but it went by super fast! It felt like I was in surgery for 10 minutes max and they kept assuring if I was doing okay and how close they were to finishing. They even asked if I wanted music playing in the background to make me feel more comfortable and John made it seem like we’ve known each other for years he’s a very chill and friendly guy!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Conner Stephens
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience truly was above and beyond. For my whole life I’ve been terrified of any dental work, and doctor largent is by far the most professional and most down to earth doctor I’ve worked with. Had to get a back molar extracted and I was in and out of the office within 30 minutes. Speedy, professional, painless. If you’re looking for an oral surgeon who will take care of you with the utmost care, look no further. The staff is so friendly and kind, 10/10 experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: R B
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at East Austin Oral Sx were so welcoming and great to work with. Dr. Largent set my mind at ease from the moment we met. He explained what he was intending to do and next steps very thoroughly. I also loved the location and the space. I would highly recommend this practice and Dr. Largent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ingrid Jone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience!! The best oral surgeon I've ever been to. My general dentist referred me to an oral surgeon that quoted me $1,100 for a wisdom teeth extraction (with insurance!). I told them to refer me to this office, and I only ended up paying $50 here! Very friendly staff, transparent, and they break down each procedure and options you have. VERY quick extraction, probably 5 minutes, and straightforward instructions. It's definitely my new go-to oral surgeon from now on!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karin Murphy
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best place for your oral surgery. Matt Largent and his staff are exceptional.  He put my son at ease and made sure it was a very pleasant experience. Thank you!!!

user_reviews_extended.Description: The absolute best! I'm really anxious about getting dental work. The doctor and staff made sure I had the most comfortable experience as possible. They were very mindful of me being nervous. I didn't experience any pain for my extraction and wasn't nervous for my next visit. I would 100% recommend going here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Chen (NicksE)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a surgery with Dr. Mathew Largent on August 17th, and it was the smoothest operation! He removed two of my horizontal, gigantic wisdom teeth in 30 minutes. I did not take all the medicine, but I felt way better in 2 days. Also, I could start eating normally in about 1 week without any issue. My face was mildly swollen for approximately 10 days. After that, everything is great!

At first, I was scared about removing my wisdom teeth. But now, I kinda regret that I was not here earlier! They worked with my dental insurance well, and the whole process only cost me $50 for putting me into sleep.

I would highly recommend Dr. Largent and his team in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Willis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just had a lingual frenectomy performed by
Dr. Largent. It was a simple procedure but it was the staff that made it truly a smooth and easy process. Upon my arrival I was greeted by the front desk who kindly assisted me with paper work. I was seen by the doctor within 10 minutes. His explanation and understanding of what was to be done was clear and thorough. I felt comfortable and had confidence within my choice of coming here. I will refer others who are in need of an amazing oral surgeon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: chanandler bong
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Got all of my wisdom teeth removed earlier today after one of the roughest months of my life being ill (ultimately from a tooth infection but we didn't realise until this week!) - I seriously cannot recommend this location enough!!!! i've been terrified of this procedure for over a decade, and dentists in general, but from the moment i got in the door all of the staff were extremely comfortable, kind & compassionate. there was literally no wait (i'm used to turning up for appointments and waiting past the allocated time to be invited in - this was not the case), everything was extremely prompt and clearly laid out, the cost/prices are the best i've ever seen even without insurance & the team really made an effort (that paid off and helped me greatly) to talk and relate to me and to get my mind off of things while we were getting set up. i opted to go under and had absolutely no issues, sitting here now 9 hours later and feeling the best i've felt all year (after putting this off for ultimately no reason). Everything was really prompt, professional and painless & the people working here really are the best i've ever encountered in the industry.

if you have any doubts, hesitance, nerves, anything - just go here! you will not regret it

sincerely a huge thank you to doc & the team 💜

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wail A
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It was nice, quick and very professional.
I expected something else..
Thanks for this  😊🙏💐

**Update 10 days later all is good) just avoid the area of the operation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chrissy Poole
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough amazing things about this place. I have high anxiety with needles and dentists so I was very nervous for the extraction of an impacted wisdom tooth. I was having extreme pain and called every dentist and oral surgeon around around Rock, Austin and Pflugerville, I scheduled three different “consultations” with places that said on their website they extract teeth just like mine , just to be told I was being referred to another oral surgeon. Every place I called could not see me for at least a week and with the pain I was in I needed help. I called their office on a Saturday hoping that they could maybe get me in on Monday and to my surprise they told me they were going to pull a team together to help me. I was able to get my tooth extracted the same day within 15 minutes. The staff here is absolutely phenomenal. Everyone made me feel comfortable, they explain step by step exactly what they’re doing, I even had a moment when they pulled the needles out where I said I needed a minute to calm myself down and they were extremely respectful and reassuring. I cannot thank these people enough for relieving my pain when they certainly did not have to jump through the hoops they did to treat me on the same day. This team cares about their patients as people which is very hard to find. They all belong in this field of work, and I am beyond thankful to have found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janet Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Good care, quick and painless. But I do have a complaint with the billing. I chose them over the first folks I was referred to because the first folks were going to charge a consultation fee (which I suspected the insurance would not pay… which they did not). I was not told I would be charged one here. The doctor spent less than 5 minutes “consulting” with me before the procedure and charged an extra $100. I did complain and give the office a chance to reconsider but they declined.

He believed me when i let him know i was in pain, and would make sure I was ok. Thank you, I will come back when needed and know that I am in good hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Salinas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I'm not lying when I tell you that I have the worst & extremely severe anxiety & panic attack issues!!
I hesitated so very much with getting my teeth fixed since forever because I fear dentist offices even for cleanings.
Due to that fear of mine my teeth have gotten damaged to the point that some are having to get extracted and I've had to endure so much pain due to infections I've gotten.
I was no longer able to wait & as afraid & panicked as I was I had to do this extraction today & I got to Dr. Largent's office I wanted to back out & leave then I remembered how painful my tooth & gum was last night & I said a prayer & walked in.
Raquel, John & Dr. Largent were very reassuring & helped me through my fear today.
I would NEVER go anywhere else for my dental needs.  I will tell my family & friends all about this clinic & Dr. The BEST & I PUT THAT ON EVERYTHING. THE MOST PLEASANT & NON PAINFUL EXPERIENCE. I AM SO HAPPY I TRUSTED HIM & WENT ALONG WITH THIS.
THE MOST PATIENT & SWEET DR.
Couldn't be happier :) on my way home now to my kids to watch movies & relax PAIN-FREE

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beezlebubz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
* 3-Year Update: Still the Best in the Game!

My initial review from 2020 still stands, but after completing a 3-year journey with Dr. Largent and his team, I had to come back and give them the recognition they deserve. Simply put, my experience has only gotten better—if that’s even possible.

Dr. Largent is nothing short of incredible. When I first walked in, my teeth resembled a weathered picket fence on some abandoned property—not exactly ideal. The amount of work needed felt overwhelming, but Dr. Largent quickly put my worries to rest. His expertise is unmatched. He delivers pain-free, precise dental and surgical work with a remarkably quick recovery time, all while ensuring you feel comfortable before, during, and after every procedure. He goes beyond being just a skilled professional; he provides genuine moral support throughout the process. It’s clear he truly cares for every single patient.

Now, let’s talk about the staff—absolute rock stars. John, who has worked alongside Dr. Largent for over 15 years, is exceptional. He’s attentive, knowledgeable, and the kind of person you want around even if you’re unconscious. His professionalism and experience inspire complete trust.

Let me preface this by saying I can’t recall her name, but she was the nurse who assisted in several of my operations. Just like John, she is absolutely essential to a smooth experience and exemplifies the type of experienced talent that Dr. Largent has built this business around. It’s truly a stacked team of top-tier professionals.

And the front office team? They are the unsung heroes of East Austin Oral Surgery. Raquel and the entire front staff are the perfect blend of warmth and efficiency. Not only do they help you navigate the often confusing world of insurance and billing, but they also go above and beyond to advocate for you. They even managed to get some of my procedures covered that were originally denied by insurance—a huge relief!

Thanks to Dr. Largent and his team, my teeth went from looking like an old, broken-down fence to a brand-new, flawless pine picket. I couldn’t be happier with the results.

I can confidently say that Dr. Largent is the best specialist I’ve ever seen. From double extractions to several implants and follow-up care, his attention to detail, skill, and bedside manner are unmatched. If you need oral surgery done right, this is the place to go. You’ll be getting not only one of the best specialist I’ve seen but an entire team of highly trained and caring individuals.  I’ll continue to recommend East Austin Oral Surgery to all my friends and family without hesitation.

Thank you, Dr. Largent and team, for everything!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Bear O
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a young person who did not have dental insurance for many years, I finally landed a great job and needed to get my dental care back on track with the professionals. I was sad and scared when I was told I had a dental implant failing (placed when I was 15 by unknown dr in Dallas area) that needed to be removed. It was not giving me any trouble that i could notice, but the x-rays showed there was bone loss and it was either deal with it now or wait til it becomes a bigger problem. My awesome dentist, Dr Adrian Bernal referred me to Dr Matthew Largent as they have worked together. Not only was I pleased to see many other reviews of satisfied patients, my initial consultation with Dr Largent went great and I left with a reassured feeling. Having done a great deal of research pertaining to my situation, I knew the route I wanted to take, and Dr Largent really did explain each option that i had. The dental implant was to be extracted with a bone graft procedure to repair lost bone. His casual but professional approach to talking me through my situation put me at ease and I felt like I was in good hands. He is young with a bright and energetic personality but old enough to have 18 years of experience under his belt. My case requires technical sensitivity and he and his great assistant, John, executed my surgery in an hour. Like any other tooth extraction, I was condemned to chipmunk cheek, soup, and restraint from my tequila drinking and smoking vices for the weekend. Beyond the obvious initial discomfort on the first day, I barely needed my pain meds, and only used them for the first 2 days. I just had my 1 week follow up and I am healing perfectly. I'll get my stitches out in a couple weeks and a few healing months down the road, I will definitely consult Dr. Largent when it's time to get a proper dental implant replacement.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheila Burns
user_reviews_extended.Description: Those who know Dr Largent from Davis Lane can now find him in East Austin!!!!  Highly recommend Dr Largent as an excellent oral surgeon.  His staff is outstanding!  You will be in highly competent hands.  A+!

user_reviews.Description: This staff is the absolute best! Dr. Embry is fantastic. user_reviews.Name: Lucia De la Puente
user_reviews.Description:
My appointment was scheduled for 1:00 PM and I finished at 3:20 PM.  Over 2 hours and 20 minutes for a routine checkup, X-rays, and cleaning.

The actual time spent with the assistant and hygienist totaled about 25 minutes if not less. The rest of the time was waiting.

I had to approach the front desk multiple times for updates and was repeatedly told “10–45 minutes,” which is not a reasonable or professional estimate. At no point was there proactive communication or an apology that matched the length of the delay.

The hygienist and assistant were kind and professional, and I appreciate their effort.

However, the overall scheduling and time management was extremely disappointing. Being short-staffed is understandable, but overbooking patients and making them wait hours is not respectful of people’s time.

I work remotely and have flexibility but many patients would not have that luxury. So please keep that I mind. I won’t be returning.
