user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an appointment today at River Rock Dental on Pleasant Valley Austin Texas. I’ll tell you what the technician was amazing she got in my mouth did her work and I had no
Complaints. When Dr. R came in she checked everything out everything was good. We scheduled for potential appointments. I am totally impressed every time I go to this location. I’m very pleased at what everyone does for a patient. They have outstanding customer care bedside manner thank you for doing such a great job Job I’ll continue to be your patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ladaporn santichaikamonkul
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service with very clear and thorough dental consultations. I felt well informed and comfortable throughout.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittani Hammock
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven’t gone to the dentist for longer than I will admit on the internet, but after seeing Dr. Ramanathan I will be back every 6 months. She was friendly, knowledgeable, understanding and caring.. everything you could ask for in a doctor! Her staff was amazing as well. Appreciate everyone in the office for making the dentist a less scary place than it’s been for me in the past. Side note: they also have a ton of availability so you can get your visit scheduled sooner than later!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yanna “Yvnna” L.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Apparently this is not an appointment confirmation. You will waste your PTO and then when you check in they will say you’re not scheduled and then silence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: amy g
user_reviews_extended.Description: sometimes i forget what incredible service is like because it seems rare these days. thank you to the staff (michelle, dr estrada, front desk) for being so friendly and helpful and positive. it does not go unnoticed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lloyd Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was very friendly and timely. I got x-rays, teeth cleaning and dental maintenance plan in about an hour. So excellent efficiency. Also appreciates the dentist walking me through the X-rays and showing me some of the issues that needed to be addressed. I’d definitely recommend this dentist office to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luisa Lozada
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent staff and service. Always available to answer any questions I had. Dr. Estrada is a gentleman and a wonderful dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Bassett
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was my first time going to River Rock and the East Riverside location has incredible people and customer service. The dentist actually listened to my concerns, asked follow up questions, and gave helpful feedback. Everyone I interacted with was helpful and kind, it's been a long time since I've had this level of appreciation for a medical service. Would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After an initial visit to River Rock Dental that left me concerned, I want to share how positively the situation was addressed. The dentist took the time to apologize for the rough cleaning and made sure to remedy the tartar buildup I experienced.

The staff were exceptionally kind and gentle, which made a significant difference in my overall comfort. We reached a mutual understanding that I would communicate directly with them if any issues arise in the future.

Overall, I am very satisfied with how my concerns were handled and look forward to continuing my dental care with River Rock Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: medea bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Moved here from Oregon a couple years ago and absolutely LOVE THIS DENTIST OFFICE! They are so kind here and compassionate. They look out for you and make you feel very comfortable. Definitely recommend DR. ramanathan she is extremely warm and welcoming and fun! the office is clean.  And they go over your services and make a clear plan with you :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Lugo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Estrada and his team are amazing. They go above and beyond to make you feel at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Pink
user_reviews_extended.Description: Victoria was soooo nice and patient during my cleaning. She def went above an beyond

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mason Tucker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a filling appointment today 8/29/2025 done by none other than Dr. Ramanathan herself. I can’t stress it enough when I say zero pain zero problems, she is so great and the front office staff is so amazing as well. Thank you guys so much, see you again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Maggard
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at River Rock Dental on Riverside was wonderful. I needed a filling replaced last minute and everyone there took great care of me. The front office staff, assistants and Dr. Estrada made me feel very comfortable. Dr. Estrada did an impeccable job on my filling replacement. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Cervantes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Estrada is amazing!! He put my nerves at ease with his awesome bedside manner. I had to have fillings and a deep cleaning, but I barely felt anything, including the lidocaine injection as he was being very careful. The rest of the staff were also very nice! I wish I would’ve gotten their names, but thank you ladies so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Kyei Baffour-Frimpong
user_reviews_extended.Description: A versatile team with an outstanding customer experience! Kudos to all the River Rock Dental Austin - East Riverside team.💯

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica E
user_reviews_extended.Description: All staff was very attentive, nice and very helpful. Would highly recommend love how they broke everything down and explained what price would be expected.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Malcolm Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock Dental is that girl when it comes to dental care! Dr. R is amazing—super personable, explains everything clearly, and actually cares about giving you the best treatment, not just the most expensive one. Love that! The whole staff is friendly and makes the experience easy and stress-free. I got a root canal done here, and Dr. R handled it like a pro—no issues since! Definitely my go-to dentist from now on. 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zack L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service! Everyone was very quick, clear, and informed on dental matters. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: christina salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you for explanation on details of my dental concerns. As well as my cleaning experience with the dentist. Communication was awesome with all the staff that were involved. 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary S
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm So Happy to leave a Wonderful & Truthful Review!!  Everything was so easy, from the appointment, to not waiting long to seeing the Doctor.  Even check out was fast.  The Entire Staff was Wonderful!!  Plus easy access as well.  This will be My New Dentist Office.  Thank you all so much!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Han Ho
user_reviews_extended.Description:
When I received this request from River Rock, I jumped at the chance to offer my experience and my gratitude for making a typically stressful procedure into a happy event! Thank you!
For one, this post is for the next ambivalent, prospecting individual, needing to undergo a procedure, or just a routine check-up. You would be so lucky to ever find a place such as this.  Dare I say, of all my years I have not encountered one better. From introduction to consultation, thru to completion, it was seamless, and moved without so much as a hint of a glitch.
And secondly, the true intention of my post, is directly to River Rock employees, as a means to reaffirm whatever mechanisms already in place, that it's working. Don't change a thing. Sign me up! I want to be a member!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Martucci
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock Dental has been fantastic to work with.  They are very nice, accommodating and go the extra mile to make sure you’re taken care of.  Very friendly staff all around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Escobar
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock dental clinic on Riverside ROCKS 👏 from the minute you walk in the door you are greeted warmly and made to feel welcomed. Doc Estrada was very patient and explained what needed to be done and what could wait, so I appreciate that kind of honesty. I am an old lady with a mouth of bad teeth but I'm thankful River Rock dental is going to take care of me 🙏

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yashwanth Dhakshana
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been going to River Rock Dental since 2021 and have had nothing but great service. The dentists are all professional, the prices are fair and I appreciate how none of the dentists pressure you to take on any treatment.

They tell you the facts of not taking the treatment and leave it to you to decide. Which I like a lot  since it allows you to think carefully and make the best decision for your oral health.

Highly recommend River Rock Dental to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabrina Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I could’ve done a better job cleaning my own teeth at home.
I’ve only been here twice and will not be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dani Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic, kind, intelligent staff who take the time to explain. Significantly more affordable than my last dentist. Bonus- I didn’t see a single man the whole time I was there lol

user_reviews_extended.Name: corvette fever
user_reviews_extended.Description: Good dentists!  No up sales for work you don't need, and caring staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leigh Causey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this dentist office since 2021 and absolutely love the staff. Dr Estrada and team really are so amazing and worked with me with my dental anxiety! I also had my braces with the orthodontist they have on staff and was excellent service, they speak English and Spanish and are just all around lovely 💚

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dunia Vasquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wish I had found this place before, professional staff and Doctor explained every step of the process, easy check in and I did not have to wait for so long to get an appointment. Definitely be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Zepecki
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been my dentist office  for 14 years!! Love the new hygienist Victoria , very thorough cleaning

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fernando Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Estrada was very professional and very informative about the extraction i will need for my molar! I will make River Rock Dental my Dentist of choice from now on.  The staff was very kind and led me thru my xrays in a very polite manner.  Good looking out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nelda Aguero
user_reviews_extended.Description:
THANK YOU SO MUCH!!

The staff was very receptive and polite.  Everything was clearly explained to me from the moment I sat in the chair and Dr. Ramanathan is extremely kind and listens. I’ve never felt more comfortable at a dentist office. From the moment you walk in everyone is so friendly.  And I am a wimp when it comes to pain.  I highly recommend this location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elisa Belderol
user_reviews_extended.Description: Victoria is very professional and it’s evident that she has done the profession for a long time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: B. Abatar
user_reviews_extended.Description: 1st visit. Dr. Ramanathan They took pictures and explained that I was keeping up with my teeth. Took some pocket readings and cleaned my teeth. Everyone was very nice and explained any questions I had about my care. Already scheduled my next visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Cazcarro
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm lucky to still be alive. Moved up north and seeing new dental care team. Started feeling pain on upper right 2nd to the last molar (next to the crown and where I had my last root canal at River Rock Dental - East Riverside), maybe 9 years ago.My new dental care team got x-ray and told me I need to have another root canal. Lo and behold, when they started working on it, they found COTTON, left by the last dentist. I kid you not.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment you walk in to the checkout this place is great.   The receptionist was on the phone when I walked in she was alone she put the phone down and let me know she would be right with me   She check me in and took me to my room and said you get the chair of honor It gave me a good laugh.   I was nervous and her making cute jokes put me at ease. The technician was gentle   The doctor explained everything in detail.   I go back next week for my treatment.   I highly recommend this place.  Especially if you are nervous they will make you feel comfortable

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ajae N Alvarez-Tyler
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is amazing. I recently moved to Texas and had to find a place locally to do a Root Canal. I called them and they got me in the same day. Dr. K saw me and let me know that he could do the Root Canal the same day as well due to my pain levels. He was very quick, gentle with his hands, and extremely helpful throughout the entire process. He is great and all the staff throughout the office are lovely! Would definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jorge Gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everybody was extremely helpful and super friendly.I went in to make an appointment and they were able to see me that same day. I would gladly recommend this to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came here for the first time for 2 fillings and a cleaning. Had such a great experience I loved when they gave me a blanket to keep warm while getting the procedures done.  Will be coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrey Cleek
user_reviews_extended.Description: 3rd updated review: Still the most amazing best most affordable dentist and kindest staff as well. I could not recommend this dentistry office more!!!! Dr. Estrada, Melissa, Rosa are all wonderful and so are Raquel, Stephanie, Sarah, and Jodi and the front desk. I moved to Cedar Park area from riverside, and still continue to go here and refuse to see any other dentist or practice because of how amazing the entire practice is run. Appointments are easy and fast to schedule. Kuddos to the entire team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: PN Nourozi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is nice but after waiting for an hour my teeth cleaning felt rushed. I'm used to having cleaning done by a dental hygienist who takes their time and is somewhat gentle during the procedure. But to my surprise the Dr did the cleaning and he was a bit too aggressive for my liking. I understand they are understaffed but I'll go somewhere else unless the hire some dental hygienist by the time my next cleaning comes around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jill Frierson
user_reviews_extended.Description: this was the first time i ever had a great experience at the dentist!! I get major dentist anxiety and they kept me informed and involved with everything they were doing. they also offered nitrous for my cleaning, which was very helpful in calming my anxiety. Highly recommend going here!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Ingram
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited River Rock Dental on East Riverside for the first time this week and have nothing but positive and happy feedback! The office is clean and lovely. The front desk staff are helpful, efficient, and personable. During my exam, the dental hygienist was gentle and informative. Dr. Estrada is extremely friendly, while straightforward and informative when answering my many questions. I came in for X-rays, but at my request, the team was able to arrange a teeth cleaning, filling repair, AND making impressions for retainers (in addition to putting together cost estimates for me to review first). In my usual high maintenance way, I asked them to do extra work AND to do it as quickly as possible, as I was in a rush that morning. The team responded kindly and all were so thorough and efficient. Thank you so much, team River Rock and Dr. Estrada! See you next time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: billie ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was recommended by Ashley the hygienist about this office and I am glad I came. All the staff were very friendly and were happy to be there. I had my teeth cleaned by Ashley my hygienist, which she is amazing and would not have anyone else clean my teeth but her. She is very detailed orientated and she provides instructions on home care and home to maintain things. Plus she has a gentle hands which is much appreciative when having very sensitive teeth.  Dr Loghmanian is my dentist and she has great chair side manners and explained my treatment that I needed and where to start. She as well has very gentle hands. This office is full of wonderful staff and I trust them with my dental needs. I will defiantly come back for my routine exam and cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fernando Maldonado
user_reviews_extended.Description: Incompetent. I called to get a service done and double checked they were able to provided. The secretary confirmed and assured me they could do the work. I took time off work to come in just to find out they don't the service I needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place has the best vegetables and fruit! Straight from the farm. The only place I go to for my produce. Ask Raquel for more details…she is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chanel Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming here for 3 or so years now. It was walking distance from my last apartment. I loved the convenient location and when I went in for my first cleaning (after over a year of no dentist visits because of the pandemic) I felt so cared for. Cleanings, a mouth guard, and a minor procedure later and my teeth are in great shape. I’ve moved since, but they are worth the drive!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oscar Mendez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service the staff is friendly and helpful even when you have more questions than answers. The medical staff are highly trained and professional in every aspect of their interactions with clients. Looking forward to a long working relationship with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ky Burke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve gone here for a year and a half and always have stellar experiences. Special shout outs to Raquel, Jodi, Sydney, and Dr. Ramanathan for an awesome appointment today. They are great to interact with, thorough in their attention to detail, and find the best ways to offer flexibility around finances. I moved to a different neighborhood, but still find it more than worth it to make a trip over.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Carrasco
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first appointment with Dr. Ramanathan and her team was amazing! I was blown away by her communication and willingness to explain in detail what she recommended and why. I am super grateful for her and her team. I went to River Rock dental for a 2nd opinion and general cleaning. I had another well known dentist office tell me that I needed a more expensive cleaning and also told me shocking news about my dental hygiene.  This well know office made me feel bullied and pressured into spending more money because they told me it’s what was needed. I’m so glad I decided to get an 2nd option. After explain my experience to Dr. R and her team they weren’t quick to judge and I felt like her option was honest. They ended up saving me money!!! Dr. R was also able to help me with a long term annoying pain I had from the prior office. I’m 24-hrs in and have been pain free. I’m so glad to have booked my appointment with Dr. R and her team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: George Adeosun
user_reviews_extended.Description: Would definitely recommend. Showed up at 7:55 AM for an 8:00 AM appointment and was whisked in the back immediately. Extremely professional and courteous staff that was transparent about the process, what they were charging me for, and explaining what was wrong (and right!) about my teeth. Dr. Estrada was efficient in his cleaning procedure and accomodating the entire way. Got X-Rays, cleaning, and fluoride treatment in less than 50 minutes. Would recommend other people visit this office - I definitely will!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarita Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the atmosphere of the office. Up to date technology. Very friendly and informative staff! But most importantly, the dentist was concerned about my overall oral health. They gave me a treatment plan without me feeling pressure to get it done ASAP. They let me know it's only a matter of time before one issue could lead to another issue which I like! RIVER ROCKS!!!!! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rubi McLaughlin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to River Rock Dental for years! I used to go to a different location but am do happy I ended up at this one!
Ashley is the BEST! Makes teeth cleaning and deep cleanings much more comfortable and easy.
Great staff that doesn't try to push unnecessary work or products on you.
Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dumbo, me, let his dental equity lapse terribly but... HUZZAH quite possibly the best money I have spent, as well as the best thing I could have done for myself. No more funky pain, no more dinginess, drilled filled cleaned and crowned Dr. Estrada is something else. Pearlies are a natural narcotic folks lyin I'm dyin. Dr. Tim Estrada will getcha there, buncha smoothies him and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Dawson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After years of bad experiences with dentists in my younger years, I realized it had been 12 years since I had seen a dentist and decided it was time to bite the bullet and go. My insurance company recommended River Rock Dental, so I called for an appointment.

Steven, the office manager, took my information over the phone and was so very nice and professional, and told me if I had any issues during my visit to ask for him and he would be there in a flash to assist.

During my appointment, every staff member I encountered was nothing but polite and respectful, and prompt in my appointment time. The office was impeccably clean, and very comfortable. Brittany, the hygienist was very sweet and did an outstanding job with my cleaning. Dr. Meza was also outstanding, thorough in his exam, and gave me a plan for a few appointments for fillings. Everything was very transparent on the quotes and the pricing is more than reasonable.

Thank you to the River Rock team for a wonderful experience today! I’m glad to find that the dentist doesn’t have to be an unpleasant experience! 😂 Looking forward to working with you all in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Omar Urquidez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wow!! This place definitely gets 5stars from me. The staff was super friendly and helpful. I loved how they went over all treatment options with me and explained what my insurance would and would not cover before I made any decisions.

I went in for a routine check up and a teeth cleaning. I’m so happy they were able to see me for both on the same day after calling multiple offices that wouldn’t do it.

EMPLOYEE CALL OUT!!  Ashley is the girl that did the deep clean for me. Let me just say. It’s true what everyone else has been saying. She has the best hands in the business. I didn’t feel I thing the entire time she was cleaning my teeth and she left me with some great tips for preventative care.

I already have a follow up appointment scheduled and would definitely recommend this place to all of my friends and family.

Thank you River Rock Dental.
From: One satisfied customer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: SoulBeautiful
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a new dentist office for me, so far I love it! My last place was awful. I would like to recommend that you guys offer us chairs since outside is the “waiting area” due to cov-19. I came for my appointment this morning which was great by the way. The woman that tighten my braces was very respectful and warm. I just didn’t like standing outside for 20 min. Good thing I had on some comfy shoes though. Overall river rock dentist is great!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tricia Nicolosi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience here. I was scared to try out a new dentist after my prior one retired, but this whole team from the front office, x-ray techs, hygienist to the dentist are top notch. If I were going to describe them in one word it would be friendly.  They use the newest technology to care for your teeth and are very through. This was the first completely pain-free cleaning I’ve ever had. They even took pictures of my teeth to show me what’s happening. What!?! I didn’t even know that was a thing. It’s really empowering to have your dentist show you your teeth and what’s wrong. It made me feel fully confident that the care plan she worked out for me was the best way to go.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deana Selvaggio
user_reviews_extended.Description: First appointment today for my 19 month old and me. Staff was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. They were understanding of my needs and paused on my sons exam until I was done, so I could also be with him. Looking forward to carrying out my treatment plan with River Rock Riverside.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cas Bobel
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock is one of the most friendly places I've been to for taking care of my teeth.  The staff is always so kind, Raquel is absolutely amazing with notifying me of schedule changes and switch ups.  Dr. L. is so sweet and caring, and one of the first dentists to really listen and care about my needs.  Ashley is absolutely phenomenal.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dusty
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very disorganized, poorly trained, and unprofessional. On my first visit it took 3 different technicians to figure out how to operate their x-ray machines and they had to redo almost every x-ray at least 2-3 different times. After that they spent a while to find supplies, promised nitrous only to say oh nevermind we ran out of nitrous. Then rushed through my cleaning and on the way out gave me someone else's prescriptions. On my second visit they had me wait for at least 30-45 minutes in between my cleaning but at least they let the nitrous keep running, lol. I didn't mind that part but then my cleaning was rushed again to the point I had to ask if they may have skipped some of my teeth.  Now I have called there office at least 3 times to simpIy get a refill on my toothpaste prescription.  I played the messenger between pharmacist and office because they did not call it in.I am frustrated to the point I am switching dentists now. Would not recommend this dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clarke Cromartie (ClarkeySue)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was so friendly and have amazing patience with me as I haven’t been to the dentist in years. I had Dr. Estrada and he was very easy to talk to and personable. I was a little nervous about my deep cleaning and made me feel at ease! Thank you to everyone on the staff! :-)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lupe Pirul
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first time coming here and I was very impressed. So professional and very helpful with understanding the process of cleaning my teeth and different options for maintaining my condition. Gave me a breakdown on the procedures I needed done and gave me cost with my insurance. Loved my visit. I totally recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Z T
user_reviews_extended.Description: Incredibly friendly and knowledgeable staff!  The office atmosphere is positive and I felt comfortable the moment I walked in.  Any questions I had were answered thoroughly and any concerns were relieved. Several options were available under my insurance, but I’m happy I chose River Rock Dental - East Riverside branch and look forward to further establishing a relationship with them.  Also, they’re proactive regarding COVID-19 safety protocol and procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ronda Thiele
user_reviews_extended.Description: All the staff was very nice and made me very comfortable .My appt started on time but I wasn’t rushed through the visit either.The Dr.was very informative and I believe he gave me a fair and honest assessment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Box
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Let me just say, my experiences with this clinic are split. In terms of care for patients, the doctors (my doctor was Dr. L) and nurses were absolutely stellar. Always asked how I was doing, told me what they were doing as it happened, kept it very professional.
My issue is with the front desk. My first visit there was one woman who was very helpful with finances and the overall process of things. But my following experience the other staff there “helped” me; they didn’t give me any information about my finances and what the payment process was, vaguely answered my questions, and made me feel rushed. I also was given false information on how I was able to pay so I emailed them 3 different times. No answer. And I KNOW they were aware of my email because I called them to let them know I was emailing them my issues with them.

Long story short: doctors are the only saving grace here. Don’t expect good service out the gate from the clerks, and be very aggressive about getting answers. Otherwise you’re screwed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryana Rivers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just moved from California and was looking for a dentist close to me. I was really happy with the over all service and staff here. Dr. Estrada was my dentist for my visit and he was really kind and thorough. I’m excited to come back in 6 months for my second cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rubayiza Fidel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nurses and doctor are friendly and humble when talking to their patients about their health conditions and the appropriate treatment. I really recommend my relatives, friends and colleagues to visite River Rock Dental at East Riverside. No one will be disappointed

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I never thought I would give a dental office a rating above 1, let alone a 5.
Dr. Logmanian is amazing. She takes her time with patients and is incredibly kindhearted. Her gentle nature is great for folks who are terrified of seeing a dentist. Staff is super professional and down to earth. No complaints from me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: justine harding
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience. Wonderful doctors. Haven’t been to the dentist in 5 years and they made me feel welcome and safe. Very grateful for their payment plans and that they accept a wide variety of insurance plans! This will be my regular dentist as long as I live in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia Garcia Navarro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always so polite and kind to me and my little guy. Checking in is easy and the wait time isn't long at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Pankow
user_reviews_extended.Description: River rock had good yet reasonable Covid precautions. The team was super helpful and friendly when I was struggling to figure out my insurance information. They were also very upfront with pricing. Overall it was a very low stress experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was rude especially the dr. Felt like they tried to push on treatments that weren’t necessarily needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalia Angel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was very nice! I was helped right when I walked in and the cleaning was quick as well! Definitely recommend for any dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: SongsterATX
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going here for years.  Always a positive, friendly experience and they don't try to take advantage of you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ramanathan was extremely cold and rude to me when reviewing my options. I came in for a simple teeth clean and she refused to clean my teeth without making me pay over 3 thousand dollars in extra procedures. I do not recommend this place if you do not have insurance and are looking for a simple teeth clean.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wesley Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Let’s talk about Dr L (as she is known).

She has a gentle but firm touch and she moves quickly. She doesn’t waste time or money.

Let’s just say that she leaves me satisfied.

Dr L, if you’re reading this, you have my full consent to not only pull up my patient records to text me, but you also have my consent to ask me to do anything that you need me to do (for the purposes of my dental hygiene, of course).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anqi Zhang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I did my wisdom teeth extraction surgery here.

The service was quite satisfying. The information update was timely. I would receive text messages or phone calls about appointments. People there were kind and considerate.

The surgery was amazingly successful. Dr. Meza, who graduated at the University of California, San Francisco, conducted the surgery. I felt nothing painful during the whole process of the surgery and the recovery phase. Thanks very much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mataia Blackwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited River Rock Dental for the first time today and my experience was amazing honestly. The people working the front desk were super nice and helpful and everyone I encountered treated me so kindly and made me feel comfortable. The financial process was also very transparent and I thought pretty affordable. Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Jimenez
user_reviews_extended.Description: From Dr. Rosas and her dental assistant, Rosa, to the front desk staff, everyone was so unbelievably kind. They thoroughly explained the situation and what needed to be done. They were so comforting to my little girl and made the whole procedure easy! Dr. Rosas squeezed us into a busy schedule but never made us feel like we came second to any other patient there. Overall a great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonia Velasco
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone at this dental office was so kind and professional! The office is spacious and clean.

I was seen right away and taken care of well.

The only reason for giving it 4 out of 5 stars is that the equipment used felt a little dated.

That reads harsher than intended but, it’s not meant to be a negative comment.

It was an observation that I noted as I was getting my teeth x-rayed.

Again, the staff gave great customer service and the Dentist was friendly and very knowledgeable AND provided me with a great cleaning AND fixed my broken crowns (because of my teeth grinding) with virtually no pain and minimal discomfort.

Would I go back?

Yes, absolutely. I pre-booked 😃

Would I like them to have smaller mouth x-ray thingy-majigs?

Yes.

Am I being picky?

Probably.

Should you give it a chance?

Yes.

Formulate your own opinion based on your experience 🙂

user_reviews_extended.Name: nick ryan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr meza is wonderful,  not only did he fix my issue with my tooth( root canal). Great bedside manner, full of energy and a great personality.  He goes into grave detail about how he will fix the problem and prevent future issues.  I will be bringing my family to this doctor, he also called me three times to see “ how I was feeling”

P.S- office staff was great

Thank you

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Kamath
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m someone who hates going to the dentist and it still makes me nervous. But this is the best dental place I’ve ever been. The dentist I had (I think Dr. Ranganathan?) is the nicest dentist I’ve ever had, and relays information directly but kindly. Great service from the front desk too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Schultz
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at River Rock dental was great! I went in for a new patient cleaning and including X-rays I was out in less than an hour and a half. The staff and Dr were very nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob J.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My wife and I each visited River Rock Dental on Riverside on 12/08/2017 to get our teeth cleaned. We have both been going to this location for over a year.

A friendly assistant first performed a screening, taking my blood pressure and pulse, and asked about allergies. Then she took x-rays of my teeth.

The doctor came in and was very professional. He examined my teeth and then studied the x-rays. He discussed the condition of my teeth with me. He also described options that are available to me in case I would like to get a damaged tooth repaired.

My wife and I were especially impressed with the quality of the cleaning and service that we received from one their hygienists, Donna!

Donna took time to clean under my gumline, thoroughly scraped my teeth to remove plaque, and then polished my teeth. And she pointed out a troublesome spot and told me how I could keep it clean between visits. The cleaning was the most thorough cleaning that I've had in years!

The staff was very nice and professional.

I give everyone at River Rock Dental, and especially Donna, 5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gloria Ensinia
user_reviews_extended.Description: De. L is an amazing doctor! She is very honest and considerate when working on my mouth. I hardly ever trust dentist, but I trust her judgment always. Everyone I interact with at that office is very kind! Highly recommend her and the team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meg E
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. L and her entire staff are amazing! They take care of you as if you are family. They are focused on the patient and their needs, and what works best for the patient. Qualities that are hard to find in medical practices these days.

I highly recommend them, trust, you will not be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JoAnn Long
user_reviews_extended.Description: River Rock Dental is the best. From the time you walk in the door, until you leave. Everyone is so sweet and you can tell they really care.  I would give 10 stars 🌟 There care is awesome  Best dentist office ever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sierra Valdary
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got my wisdom teeth extracted and it was a very pleasant experience. Dr. Hijazi is amazing. I was a little nervous, but he made me feel at ease the whole time. I would highly recommend him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Halie Hudson
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time finding a dentist in Austin, and I couldn’t have had a greater experience! Everyone was so nice and welcoming, and they took care of what I needed so quick. They were very detailed on answers with the questions I had, and in giving the best recommendations on how to move forward with my teeth. Very much recommend anyone looking for a dentist to try this place as i’m sure you will not be disappointed!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcus Toudouze
user_reviews_extended.Description: Haven’t been to the dentist in a while but thankful I came here. They told me everything I needed and were very friendly and understanding about it. Great experience and will be coming back to get my work done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitch Asmus
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a great experience at River Rock Dental. Staff is kind, efficient and always gets me in on time. Highly recommend for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samir ali
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming here since a serious accident a few years ago to get various work done. I’ve seen both sides (ortho and general dentistry) across a gamut of services from general cleaning and filling cavities to a root canal, end to end Invisalign treatment, professional teeth whitening, temporary and permanent crowns and even referrals to other practices. Everyone from the front desk staff & dental assistants to the doctors are amazing! They are personable, organized, thorough and extremely knowledgeable. I’d recommend this clinic to anyone looking for top notch treatment by top notch people who have the patients best interest at the forefront of everything they do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: aimable vuningoma
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone was friendly! I like the service and recommend  everyone! The Checkin process is much more easier if you fill the forms online ahead of time . My appointment was so quick and I got what I wanted on my first visit .Looking forward for the next ones ! So far service provider of the year lol

To everyone again , I highly recommend the place .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Appointment time was at 12, was told to be there at 11:45 so I was. At 12:20 I was finally taken back. X-rays took 5 minutes. An hour later I was STILL sitting there waiting. I kept being told the "dentist was almost done" and she'd be in in "one minute". I finally told them I couldn't wait any longer and that I'd have to come back after work. They tried to schedule me for over 2 weeks later. The lady who took the xraya and took my information was as nice as could be, but I felt pretty disrespected and unimportant from anyone else, and considering I'm a return patient  that speaks volumes about how little they care. If they had told me it would be a while or that an emergency came up, that would be fine. But to keep telling me she was on her way for over an hour and just leave me hanging is unacceptable, ESPECIALLY with how much I was going to be paying. I would suggest tying a string to a door knob and slamming the door shut to take care of tooth problems before recommending ANYONE come here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gwendolyn Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my second visit and it was as pleasant as the first. The receptionist was friendly. The hygienist was also friendly and very knowledgeable. Both her and Dr. Tim Estrada were very patient and answered all my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree Esselman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to this dentist for several years now. They are efficient and reliable and I really like Dr. Estrada! Would definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zoey Elkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental care here is fine, however, every time I come here, I have to wait 30-45 minutes after my appointment time. The dentist also makes me feel very rushed when I am getting dental work done, which is awful. I am satisfied with the work I got on my teeth, but if you make an appointment for 1, prepare to be seen at 1:45. Don’t be in a rush when you schedule an appointment, and don’t think you are going to get top notch dental work when everyone in the place is trying to rush to get things done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zach Castaneda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was very friendly and professional. The Dentist and DA were very concerned about my comfort level during the procedure which was very helpful. They got me in early and the front staff were helpful and very transparent about breaking down the pricing before everything. Could not recommend this location enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kalandra Joyner
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dentist was nothing short of amazing she provided me with the Gucci shades to protect my eyes and plenty laughs and even with all the fun we were having I got great advice to better take care of my mouth and a great treatment plan Thanks to my Dr.Ramanathan and her assistant Cindy

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amburlyn Orozco
user_reviews_extended.Description: The women at the front desk were very kind and welcoming. The whole staff was sweet and informative every step of the way. Dr. L was AMAZING. I could’ve cried grateful tears at how personable she was, she really seemed to care and understand!

user_reviews_extended.Name: E C
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so glad I was able to get in to see the dentist today. I love this place, everyone was so friendly and helpful. Very reasonable price wise. The dentist was awesome and walked me through everything step by step. I definitely recommend this place. My whole family will be going here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sean Shirzadi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I wish 0  star was one of the options. In my experience, I think this dentist is one of the most horrible places in Austin, and it is also an expensive place. Of course, some of the staff members are nice; however, it is funny to write a comment just because the staff members are nice !!! But it is also correct to say, some of the staff attitudes were also horrible. Anyway, I was there for about 2 and a half hours to do a simple x-ray. I was in the room, like as I said for so long and the staff  just keep walking and they asked me: "Are you okay?" And I said: "NO, I AM NOT" because I'm here for so long." Later,  the doctor came in. OMG, in general, he was funny, but do not let his funny behavior give you a sense of confidence because, in my case, most of his suggestion was incorrect and also expensive because I went to another doctor. This place just wants to charge you, they just want to use your insurance, if you have one. I am happy because nowadays a comment on internet can change, and hopefully, in a positive way. I think people need to show them (to River Rock Dental) that they need to change the way they do their business. People need to act responsibly, remember, "Respect is Earned and Not Given". If I say that I do not care! The problem will never be solved and they will continue to do whatever they want.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James O’Connor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hadn’t been to a dentist in four years or so; went here, and my teeth have been fine ever since! More seriously, it’s a good place, they work quickly (or at least time passes quickly), the information for keeping my teeth together is extremely valuable, and Dr L is quite cute (which is always a plus).

user_reviews_extended.Name: DeNae Robbins
user_reviews_extended.Description: 5stars to everyone from the hilarious girls at the front desk, to Ashley who cleaning my teeth so gentle and thorough, to Doctor L who always making me feel like my teeth are the best teeth in the world and she can get them together if they aren't. I have been going to this locations for years after trying different dental offices where I felt uncomfortable or not important. I recommend this location 10x over!! Thanks girls!

user_reviews_extended.Name: megan
user_reviews_extended.Description:

There is music as well as a tv to watch during waits for the hygienist and dentist.

English and Espanol

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dorotel Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was very prompt.. my appointment was @ 12:30, I was taken to get xrays @ 12:35.. friendly and courteous.. great place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roman Coronado
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wow, what an experience!
First off, I was greeted right off the bat. Waited for only a few minutes but that was no big deal. The waiting room was comfortable and they even had a Street Fighter arcade set-up to play while you waited.
Jannet took care of my teeth like a boss! She knew what she was doing and kept me informed the whole time. Walked out of there with a proud smile.
I would recommend this place to all of my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Andes
user_reviews_extended.Description: The techs don’t know how to use the xray machines and refused to stop taking x rays when I started getting dizzy and asked them to wait. I called to cancel my plan and have records transferred when I moved now a year later I get a charge on my card find out the renewal alert emails were sent to my spam and when I call about having it refunded they refuse saying they have no record of me cancelling or calling and claimed their spam email was my of approval of the fraud charge

user_reviews_extended.Name: Latisha “Tish” Eggleston
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Estrada and his entire staff were great from start to finish. Very professional, courteous and attentive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: claire allard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m very happy with my experience at River Rock Dental. I feel like the doctor and hygienists are very good at what they do and very friendly. I also think their prices are considerate. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: sunshine anne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Y'all need to go give them a try I know the neighborhood is a bit busy but let me tell y'all how great they are. I am terrified of dentists I always have been but they made me feel so comfortable and at ease while I was there, and they actually listened to what I wanted they didn't try to push any products on me or sell me something I couldn't afford. They actually listen to what you want, I went in wanting my teeth bonded and that's exactly what I got they didn't tell me no and try to push veneers or try to put my in braces they said OK and explained the process to me fully and in ways I could understand

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hanifa Hotelwala
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is awesome! I have had about 4 cleanings here and i plan to continue coming here every six months. Everyone is super kind and respectful of the patients’s time. I am in and out in no time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Atteberry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome Dental services. Staff is very friendly. I, like others don't like dentist, but the the minute you walk in very fun and inviting environment. Highly recommend this office. The dentist is very friendly and makes you feel comfortable

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
TL;DR they seriously delayed care and cost me $2k

Lost $2k, but it’s worth it to be rid of them.
First, their billing system double charged me and it took months to correct the error. I decided to give them another chance, because it’s such a pain to find a new dentist. Big mistake. I’ve had a sensitive tooth for 10 years now; no cavity/obvious problem, just monitoring. In March, during a routine cleaning, they suggested braces to alleviate pressure and pain. This was the only recommendation besides ibuprofen at the time. With reassurance that it would help from the orthodontist, I decided to try invisalign and paid in full ($5600), because I didn’t want to have another billing mishap. They had a very hard time doing the impressions; the process was disgusting and painful for me, but that’s besides the point. Beginning of May, two weeks before my follow up to initiate Invisalign, they refer me to an endodontist. There was no explanation for the 2 month delay between my initial visit and my getting referred. It’s not like they had to wait for labs or imaging to process, they had all the info they needed at my March appointment. I call different endodontists and they can’t get me in before my Invisalign appointment. I call Riverrock back to let them know, and they tell me not to worry and just come to my appointment anyway. Apparently, the orthodontist really wanted me to see the endo after all, because he refused to start my treatment. Suddenly this was a matter of my safety. Mind you, this was not communicated as urgent or necessary prior to my appointment. Why is it urgent now, if you had months to inform me before and didn’t? Luckily, I was able to squeeze in to see an endo later the same day and, though there’s no cavity or abscess, they said root canal is recommended eventually. However, they can’t do a root canal until over a month later. I decided against continuing my treatment at river rock, as I can no longer trust them to take my care seriously. I’m out $2000 that’s not refundable, but I’m really just tired of dealing with this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice and explain everything to me about my teeth. And what is my insurance coverage before any procedure was done. Very patient with me before my procedure. Keep up the good work. 👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yolanda Solis
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dentist Mesa he was very awesome and good with my 4yr old who has issues letting anything being done and he was able to get her cooperation as she got work done on her teeth. He's funny and good with children I'd recommend him for children who have difficult times with the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauralee W
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to request a last minute appointment for (what I thought) was a chipped tooth. Even though I was a new patient, they were able to see me the same day. I called at 3:30 and they scheduled my appointment for 4pm. Everyone at the office was wonderful and so accommodating and understanding. I highly recommend coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: YOLANDA MARTINEZ
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is so nice here.  Been coming here every few years. All staff are friendly and really show they really care for you.  Definitely recommend.  Various payment options if you don't have a dental plan.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ciara Gibson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was recently in a very bad skating accident that left my jaw broken. I found this office on google while frantically looking for solutions after hours. First thing in the morning Tiffany called me and recommended that I come in right away! They were very gentle with my tender mouth and were able to still X-ray. They called all around the city to get me an emergency appointment on a Friday evening with an oral surgeon that took great of me. Also, Tiffany recommended a good dental plan to help pay for the exam which is helpful because my insurance had not yet kicked in. Basically, they saved me so much stress by helping me with many solutions as well as nurtured me and followed up with me afterward. When I called the next day to thank them they remembered my name and told me that they sent the surgeon tiffa treats for helping me 😭. If you’re looking for friendly staff and doctors that care, you have found it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Let me start by saying that I did make an appointment on the same day as my new patient call. And,I realize emergencies come up. I was told to arrive early to fill out paperwork. My appointment was at 2 and I arrived at 1:35. I waited patiently until I was told at 2:30 that I wasn’t going to be seen for awhile because the dentist was performing a procedure. I asked what awhile meant...an hour?I was told that they couldn’t say and that there’s a patient in front of me. So,2+ hours longer is what I read into that,especially with her body language. I left. I won’t be back. I need a lot of dental work. I’m sure I won’t have trouble finding another dentist. Take what you want to from my review.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellah diana
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service ,i was impressed. The office ladies and the doctor / dentist were amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Shamp
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is great! All around positive experience and I felt very comfortable the entire time. They clearly showed me what was going on along with a treatment path. Will be going back and recommend you check them out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Perry Saunders
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was on time for my appointment. After a few minutes of waiting I asked what the hold up was. I was told there were no rooms available. I asked to speak with a manager. The manager promptly got a room for me. I waited in the room, which was quite cold, for about 2 hours before the dentist came in. Dr. Meza himself seemed frustrated with the staff. I'll never come here again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Em C
user_reviews_extended.Description: As others have said, they are a little disorganised and have caused me minor scheduling inconveniences. But I am very pleased with their care and the dental hygienists that helped me. Dr. Meza has fantastic bed side manners for adults. The offices are well equipped with distractions like TVs in every room and a calm environment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super friendly and professional staff, they got me in fast, so happy with them will be back for cleanings

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabe Carnevale
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super young dentist. Didn’t properly anesthetize the area. Only after the procedure did I find out it was optional. So they cooerced me into getting bad dental work, drilling 3 holes and not properly filling. Turns out the cavities were surface level and fillings were unnecessary for the moment. These people will convince you something’s wrong just to take your money and operate on you with basically a medical student. Do not get work done here. Go to a expieriance professional instead. You can’t grow back your teeth. If I wasn’t a college student I would sue for malpractice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike S
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place!!  I've been here a couple times now and my experience has always been great.  Front desk was helpful and my cleaning always starts shortly after arrival.  Last hygienist (Marcy, I think) was excellent and very thorough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy Heaton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the entire staff at River Rock Dental!!  I have a severe anxiety about going to the dentist but everyone there makes my experience much more enjoyable. Patient Doctor, kind and friendly staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joanne Pham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is so friendly. Although, I’ve been here twice, and they do not do a thorough job of cleaning teeth - comparing to other dentists I’ve been to in the past.

Won’t be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every staff member I encountered was friendly and knowledgeable. Scheduling was easy, and after my exam, they gave me a very clear breakdown of costs for the recommend treatment plan. Excellent experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nichole Castillo-Hernández
user_reviews_extended.Description: The wait time was super short and the staff were very friendly. I got a thorough explanation of what was done and what was needed (including cost), and I was also able to schedule follow-up services within just a few days.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Horacio Zamora
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to this dentist office because it is close to home. I had my dental cleaning appt at 11:00 and arrived at 10:45 to fill paperwork. When I arrived the front desk lady asked if I had insurance and I said yes and she made a weird face. She said I didn’t provide it over the phone when I scheduled my appt and I said nobody asked for it. She said she knows they asked me because it was the manager who scheduled my appt and I just didn’t provide it. First of all, how are you so sure I was asked and didn’t provide my insurance information? And second of all, why would I not provide that information if I had it with me when I scheduled the appt? So then I gave her my insurace information. I waited in the lobby until 11:45 until she finally came out and said that she needed my xrays from my old dentist otherwise I wouldn’t be able to be seen and that I’ll have to reschedule my appt because it was already past 30 minutes from my appt time. Nobody told me when scheduling my appt to give them my insurance information or to bring in any xrays. So I ended up leaving without even being seen. I wasted 1 hour out of my day because the staff couldn’t be proactive enough to make sure that everything was in order before my appt. What frustrated me more was the fact that they placed the blame on me for not providing that information. I’ll be looking for another dentist office that is hopefully more professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Breve
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent
X Rays are always uncomfortable but the young technician was Very sweet and polite the young lady Doctor was Great 👍 super friendly, great efficiency and super professional
I live in Fort Worth but I am in Austin for few weeks and wanted to get my regular cleaning here, Great people

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Kneebone
user_reviews_extended.Description: So friendly, amazing staff that did a great job and made me feel at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimbyrle Braun
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and efficient staff. Made me feel super comfortable and got all my dental procedures done in one visit. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Latoya Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family’s experiences have always been pleasant at River Rock Dental on Riverside. The staff are very thorough and knowledgeable and seem to always have a sweet disposition! Regarding our family of 6 dental needs...it’s home

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Green
user_reviews_extended.Description: So happy with this place. I almost never do surveys. But I'm moved to after being treated so well by the staff and the Dr.  Wow.. Thank you!!! See you in six months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Alvarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a wonderful experience. The staff is extremely polite. My Dental Hygienist Ashley is amazing. I'm in Nebraska now but I'll be back this summer!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Rose
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve never been able to relate to people when I see bad reviews written for experiences with doctors, dentists, etc... that was, until the afternoon I visited River Rock Dental Riverside. After moving to South Austin, I sought out to find a dentist that was in close proximity to work and home. I was just looking for a general teeth cleaning so I only briefly researched the internet when I stumbled upon River Rock. Since all I was intending to get done was a basic cleaning, RR seemed suffice. Being a new patient, I arrived 15 minutes early to complete paperwork before my appointment. The waiting area was clean and pretty large, but there were only 4 patients (including myself). I waited about 30 minutes before being called back to do x-rays. When I was finished with the x-rays, they sent me back to the waiting room for another 30 minutes before being called back to the chair. When I was waiting in the chair, I was called again to do the x-rays (I didn’t ask why) before the assistant came over to the area mid-xray to tell the other assistant she had already done them - obvious lack of communication. The assistant apologized to me saying she didn’t realize my x rays had already been done. Fine. Walked me back to the chair room where I waited about 10 minutes for the dentist to come in only to tell me she would be back in a few minutes. At this point I started to get annoyed.

When the dentist came in, she inspected my mouth and found 3 small cavities to fill. Because of sensitivity, I agreed to have the dentist fill them. I was led to another room (not sure why I switched as the rooms and equipment were both identification) where I waited for about 25 minutes for the dentist to come back in. When she came in, she checked to make sure the saliva ejector/suction device was working - it was not. A couple different staff members were coming in and out of the room to see why it wasn’t working - this lasted another 15 or so minutes, before someone realized the switch just wasn’t toggled to “On”. Imagine that.

When the dentist began working on my mouth, the assistant had to keep running out of the room to grab the correct tools. The dentist herself was “nice” (at least kind), but the assistant was completely rude and had an attitude the entire time. The assistant who was using the saliva ejector and suction devices was too lazy to hold the device correctly with her wrist propped up that the device was pressed up against my bottom teeth and literally felt like someone was blending or shaving them. I had to stop them and ask the assistant to hold up her wrist bc the device was rubbing my bottom teeth and really hurt. This of course gave her even more of a reason to have more attitude. She only half abided. It’s now 6:30 pm (remember that my appointment was at 3 and I arrived at 2:45), so I told the dentist I was done for the day. The dentist knew I was in pain, so she insisted on taking my personal cell phone number so that she could text me the next day and check on me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hubert Jones Jr
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My son Eric is three years old and had multiple cavities that needed to be addressed last year. We went to River Rock Dental Southpark location for an exam on March 23, 2017 and received a proposed treatment plan on April 13, 2017 that included a recommendation for two filings and five crowns. We were told that we would have to take our son to the Riverside location for the procedure. From there we scheduled his appointment at St. Davids Pediatric to undergo anesthesia to complete the procedure. There, Dr. Jackson Booth, completed six filings, three crowns, and three root canals on April 28, 2017. After comparing the proposed treatment plan and the actual work done I found discrepancies that led me to question the work done since only three filings and one crown matched the original proposition. Eight months later on December 28, 2017 we brought Eric in for a routine cleaning at Lifetime Smiles with Dr. Shahram Arzegar and we were informed that Eric has cavities around all of his filings. From there we were referred to Longhorn Pediatric Dentistry & Orthodontics to get a second opinion. Dr. Reza Arzegar took x-rays and completed an exam concluding the same information, all of Erics previous dental work needed to be redone. The original procedure cost 587.70 for dental plus 800 anesthesia, the rework is totaled at 1313.70 plus estimated 825.00 for anesthesia. (The amount for anesthesia is an estimate as official pricing for anesthesia will not be released until two weeks prior to surgery) Last week I requested a refund from River Rock Dental of the original 587.70 which was honored by Office Manager Adrian Murillo and cosigned by his supervisor Ho Jang. Today, January 4, 2018 I have scheduled Eric's surgery to get the final costs of the procedure and returned to River Rock Dental to request the remaining 1417.50 difference be refunded. (One cavity costing 133.50 has been subtracted as it is not part of the original rework). This request for refund would cover the rework and anesthesia. Both Mr. Murillo and his supervisor Mr. Jang declined to reimburse anything further stating they are not responsible for my sons dental rework. I have advised them that this entire rework is the direct result of negligence on their part as every tooth that was "completed" in opposition to the original proposed treatment plan needs to be redone.

Outside of the massive dental rework that my son has to undergo let's keep in mind he is only three years old. Some of the risks of general anesthesia include: brain stem or medullary suppression which results in respiratory and cardiovascular collapse or even death. I have given River Rock Dental an opportunity to take ownership of this issue and they have refused.

user_reviews.Description: Wonderful dentist and dental office just south of downtown Austin. I’ve been very happy with my visits for regular checkups and dental cleanings. Special thanks to Dr. Nguyen, dental hygienist Noor, and the rest of the team for making every visit a great experience.

user_reviews.Name: Shalena White
user_reviews.Description: I have always felt welcome, safe and cared for in this office. I have gotten treatment from Dr Nguyen and a previous doctor that was there for a little while and I really appreciated both of them. I saw Dr Nguyen today and she's so compassionate. She treats me with kindness, respect and genuine concern. They do a great job with dental cleanings. I like the tvs with the nature videos because they really help me to feel calm.

user_reviews.Description: came in due to a broken tooth and wanted a secondary opinion. user_reviews_extended.Name: Crissa Toledo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Life got busy and I ended up going a year+ between cleanings—I was nervous to come back, but the doctor was so kind and immediately put me at ease. The office is modern, clean, and relaxing, with all the latest technology, convenient reminders, and even an app to manage appointments and uploads. I really appreciate not having to fill out paperwork every visit. She even put on music I liked to make me feel more comfortable. Even after moving farther away, I still choose to travel here because the care is that good. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Description: It was recommended by a friend andi was greeted immediately and given a very friendly vibe. After getting my concerns addressed by Dr. Nguyen, I decided that it was the right place for me and scheduled my next appointment. Competitive pricing and very friendly and welcoming staff, going forward this will be my new dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lupe Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Nguyen has been caring for my children since they were babies, and I can’t imagine trusting anyone else with their dental health. From their very first checkups to now as growing kids, every visit has been handled with incredible care, patience, and professionalism.

Dr. Nguyen has a wonderful way of making kids feel at ease—gentle, kind, and always explaining things in a way they understand. The staff is equally fantastic: friendly, organized, and genuinely caring. My kids actually look forward to their dental visits!

It means so much to have a dentist who has watched them grow and truly cares about their well-being. I highly recommend Dr. Nguyen to any family looking for compassionate, top-quality dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shaun Chesnut
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nice, punctual, and thorough. The staff works with patients who have a difficult time at the dentist (reflexes). They used stress balls, salt, sea-life TV, music, and conversation to help get me through it. The dentist has treatment plans. One better follow the plan, or else--

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beckie Lough
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so happy with the care I have received here. We’ve been coming for cleanings and filings for a few years, and I recently had a crown put on a front tooth. I was really nervous about it, but Dr. Nguyen went the extra mile to ensure I was happy with the result. She and her entire team are so kind and understanding of dental anxiety. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmine Castellanos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to The Tooth Inc. for a couple of years now and have had consistently positive experiences. Dr. Quyen Nguyen and her team are warm, knowledgeable, skilled, and very professional. There's something special about this cohesive team of women. I have felt their kindness, consideration, and attentiveness every time I've gone in for care. They take the time to answer my questions thoroughly and are responsive to my needs. For my cleaning and preventive care appointment last week, I was helped by Christina, Noor, and Dr. Quyen, each of whom were wonderful. I'd highly recommend this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Hernandez-Salinas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
5-Star Review for Tooth Inc. & Dr. Quyen Nguyen

I’ve known Dr. Quyen Nguyen for over 10 years, and from the moment I met her, she has always made me feel like family. She truly cares—not just about my dental health but about me as a person. She always remembers our last conversation, asks about my family, and makes every visit feel personal.

Most people dread going to the dentist, but with Dr. Nguyen, I genuinely look forward to my appointments. She is incredibly patient and understanding, especially when I feel anxious. She listens, never rushes, and makes sure I feel comfortable. Honestly, she’s like my therapist!

During a recent visit, I shared my concerns about job security while working for a nonprofit in this tough economy. Her response was beyond compassionate—she reassured me that no matter what happens, I should keep my dental appointments, and she would take care of me. I’ve never felt so supported by a doctor before.

The staff at Tooth Inc. is just as amazing! They are incredibly patient, always kind, and they remember who you are, making every visit feel warm and welcoming.

I’ve referred so many friends, family members, and coworkers to Dr. Nguyen, and every single one of them has told me how wonderful she is. If you’re looking for a dentist who genuinely cares, and makes every visit a positive experience, go to Tooth Inc. You won’t regret it! 💗

user_reviews_extended.Name: Buthainah Rawdhan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nguyen has been our family dentist for years, and we truly couldn’t ask for anyone better. She’s not only highly skilled and professional, but also so warm, patient, and caring. She always takes the time to explain everything and makes sure we all feel comfortable and cared for. Her team is just as kind and welcoming, and the office is always clean and inviting. We feel so lucky to have her. highly recommend this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Castillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I say Dr. Quyen Nguyen and her staff are the best in town it’s an understatement my whole experience was so welcoming and at ease, everything was explained perfectly I will definitely be a returning patient I can’t wait for my next appointment

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at Tooth Inc with Dr. Nguyen and the team. From the moment I walked in, everyone was super friendly and made me feel comfortable. The hygienist did an awesome job with my cleaning, and Dr. Nguyen took the time to explain everything in a way that actually made sense. I really appreciated how helpful and educational the care was. Overall, I left feeling good about my visit and confident about my dental health. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I was going to another well known dentist in Austin for 3 years and I can’t believe I didn’t make the switch earlier. The Tooth Inc was SO much nicer. user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim-Marie O'Driscoll
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr. Nguyn and her team. No sense of being rushed through our visits. Dr. Nguyn  takes  time to check in on my teeth/members of our family’s teeth and/or related dental concerns. Whereas some dentists in the past can be dismissive about concerns or try to sell us/market to us unnecessary treatments, Dr. Nguyn does not. She’s open to dialogue and down to earth. On top of all that, she seems to have a genuine interest in how our family is doing; has a remarkable memory for keeping track and asking about things happening in our life that we had shared from the last visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Candelaria
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was anxious all day before my appointment, I even rescheduled this appointment from the previous month because I was nervous. I was nervous for no reason because this was by far the best experience I’ve ever had at the dentist. Doc is very down to earth and takes the drama out of the ordeal. If I could give more than 5 stars I would.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Herrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love coming here! Everyone is so nice. Space is so clean. Very transparent with treatment and pricing! Recommend to all my friends and family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Iaccino
user_reviews_extended.Description: I returned for my 6 month cleaning which I was examined by Dr. Nguyen. She is extremely thorough and gentle. I was amazed at the time she took to review my overall health which was crucial to the dental issues I have been experiencing. Dr. Nguyen provided a detailed treatment plan verbally as well as through the app which I really enjoy referring to. My first visit was last year and unexpectedly pleasant. The office has a comfortable spa like feel. Most importantly the entire staff is organized, professional, and compassionate. The time Dr. Salinas spent with me was extremely thorough and not rushed. She also was very gentle throughout my exam.
