user_reviews_extended.Description: I love how friendly the staff is. They are very efficient and they make you comfortable. I especially liked how they took my attention off of the painful injection by simultaneously tapping my shoulders so that I did not feel the numbing medication going into my gums. They are extremely intelligent. I'm glad I found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing people with an amazing Dentist! Dr.Nguyen is very nice and really cares about you. I’ve had a front filling that has been bothering me and she’s helped me out last minute. I am very grateful to have met her and really respect her team! Well run business and highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Howard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I used to hate going to the dentist, but Dr. Nguyen has changed that! From the warm atmosphere to the friendly staff, every visit is a pleasure. Dr. Nguyen explains everything clearly and is incredibly gentle, making me feel comfortable and at ease. I look forward to my appointments now! If you're looking for a dentist who truly cares, I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always had very high anxiety going to the dentist, Dr Nguyen and her team were extremely patient, helpful and comforting. They helped me go step by step and were very reassuring. I was able to get nitrous gas and this made me extremely comfortable during treatment. I’ve never been able to be comfortable during a cleaning before this experience. This was a completely non judgmental very warm environment. There were movies, headphones, blankets, glasses, and music to help make patients at ease. You can tell this team is committed not only to helping make the appointment as comfortable as possible but also helping their patients overcome long time fears and aversions to care. So grateful to have found this office, excellent listeners, handled my anxiety with great care, and also helped educate me on a treatment plan to manage my anxiety during visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaszman Copeland
user_reviews_extended.Description: 10/10 recommend. Staff was friendly welcoming excellent customer service. Everything they offered to make me comfortable was amazing. They played music there was a display of like sea life on the ceiling for when they lay you back to work on you. Dr. Nguyen was very welcoming and very thorough

user_reviews_extended.Name: The Color Condition
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is most favorite Dentist that I have ever had.  I go there, my parents go there, the neighbors. They know what they are doing , so nice, they build a relationship with you and are easy to book an appointment, and if you're having an acute issue work to get you in quickly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vincent Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Nguyen and her staff take amazing care of their patients! I was looking for a private practice in Austin and they did not disappoint. I come here for my regular teeth cleanings and I never have to wait in the waiting room for more than 5 min. Everyone is friendly, professional, and efficient. Dr Nguyen definitely cares about giving you the best care she can.

I also came to Dr Nguyen for a second opinion for a tooth implant that was in trouble. user_reviews_extended.Description:
After my disappointing experiences with Brident Dental, my expectations for dental offices were LOW. Waiting for hours in the lobby, only to endure further delays and disjointed procedures, had become a frustrating norm.

However, Tooth Inc. was a game-changer. Encouraged by positive reviews, I decided to give it a try. Upon arrival, I was pleasantly surprised to be greeted by name and experienced minimal wait time – just five minutes in the lobby, if even that. user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Wheeler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was the best dentist experience I’ve ever had, and I don’t say that lightly. I -hate- going to the dentist, absolutely loathe the experience and have quite a bit of anxiety as well.
I specifically wanted to find a dentist with a therapy dog, as I’ve heard that is becoming more popular lately. I searched and searched before coming across Tooth Inc. and they did not disappoint. Not only did I get to have Nico the dog lay on my lap and pet him the entire time, but they also gave me noise canceling headphones and sunglasses to make the experience less of a sensory nightmare. Before beginning, the dentist asked me questions about my experiences in the past and what usually makes me not like the dentist, and then she did everything she could to mitigate those typical issues. I have sensory sensitivies and normally dentist visits are full of sensory issues for me. I thought that was just something I’d have to suffer through twice a year, but not anymore!
Everything went by so quickly that I was surprised when my cleaning was over. My teeth felt very nice and clean and it didn’t hurt at all. I will definitely be going back.

Never had I felt so comfortable and I generally terrified of of dental work but slowly with her I’m getting over parts of it. Thank you!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khaila Littles
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience at The Tooth Inc. for wisdom teeth extraction was deeply disappointing and concerning. Despite being aware of my severe anxiety, I was given valium for anxiety and laughing gas. (I did not have anesthesia) All four wisdom teeth were removed, with the bottom two being severely impacted and close to my nerves. Post-surgery, I was only prescribed ibuprofen for pain relief. When I requested stronger medication, I was told by Surgeon Dr. Martinez that opioids couldn't be prescribed due to pharmacy regulations, which contradicted the experiences of others I spoke to who had received stronger pain relief after similar procedures.

Days 1-3 after the surgery were a nightmare of excruciating pain, despite following all post-operative instructions diligently. When I asked for stronger medication again, the dental office refused and made excuses. Even after reaching out to the office on day 2, I was only prescribed prednisone, a steroid that can mask infection. This was alarming, considering the potential for infection post-surgery and the abrupt cessation of steroid use after a short period.

When I expressed my concerns to the owner, Dr. Nyguen, I was met with disrespect and unprofessionalism. She suggested that I was getting information from Google rather than seeking advice from trusted family members who have extensive experience in the medical field. Her dismissive attitude only compounded my frustration and led me to question the quality of care provided.

Overall my experience at The Tooth Inc. was far from satisfactory, and I would caution others to carefully consider their options before seeking treatment at this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathryn Rivas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went recently for the first time and everyone was super sweet. They all made me feel very comfortable, especially since I get so anxious when at the dentist. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carina Carinosa
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the nicest dentist's office I've had the pleasure to step foot in. All of the equipment is new, and while they work in your mouth, you get to watch scuba diving with turtles and fishies, which is exactly the kind of relaxation a person needs. Waiting in the chair has a lovely screen with ocean views or you can put on something of your own choosing. Her assessments and treatment plan were easy to come to an agreement on, though she did get a little nervous showing the bill. My insurance will cover enough for us to make a solid positive impact. Her prescriptions were on point, and even though I need to take antibiotics and am pregnant, i feel safe with what she chose for me. Now, the decoration. This woman's aesthetic is SO LUX. Her bathroom design, lobby design, treatment room design, secretary's station design- like out of the best HGTV episode ever. Book now before she becomes the best-known favorite Dentist for all women and children in town! The Tooth is the Truth!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Review for The Tooth Inc.
Rating: 5/5 Stars
I had another fantastic experience at The Tooth Inc. on Olfort Street. From start to finish, the visit was incredibly efficient and professional.
• Punctuality: My appointment started right on time. There was virtually no wait after checking in, which I really appreciated.
• Preparation: The staff was excellent at explaining the process. Before the exam, they walked me through each step—from taking vitals to signing consents—so I knew exactly what to expect.
• No "Chair Wait": One of the best parts was that the dentist arrived immediately after my preparation was complete.
• Quality of Care: The dentist was highly skilled and knowledgeable. She was very attentive, explaining everything as she worked, which made me feel at ease.
The results were excellent. If you're looking for a dental office that values your time and provides high-quality care, I highly recommend this location!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LE NGUYEN
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had a fantastic experience at The Tooth Inc. and cannot recommend them highly enough. From the moment I walked in, the professionalism was evident; the entire team, from the welcoming receptionists to the skilled dental hygienists, makes you feel valued and at ease.
The dentist is truly a standout, paying incredible attention to detail. They took the time to explain every part of the process and answered all of my questions thoroughly, ensuring I felt informed and comfortable with my treatment plan.
While the facility is humble, it is immaculately clean and very well-organized. The layout is efficient, and it’s clear their equipment is modern and up to professional standards. If you are looking for high-quality, patient-focused dental care, this is the place to go!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Neba
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to Dr Nguyen and I cant say enough amazing things about her and her whole team. Everyone made me feel well taken care of. She was very transparent and upfront about costs. Never once tried to upsell on unnecessary additional services like other dental practices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lyncia W
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Love Love this dental office… feels like a family setting and everyone is always so welcoming. I moved across town and tried a new office but the vibes weren’t the same so now I take that 30 min drive as needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Mitchell
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here are so sweet and understanding of my irrational dental fears- I know I'm not an easy patient!  I highly recommend them if you are nervous or haven't been in a while. They are honest and will always offer the most minimally invasive options and talk you through each procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suzie Plyler
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctor and the staff are very attentive to your needs. Dr. Nyguen Is very knowledgeable and Personable! She always caters to your needs. Her staff are kind and friendly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: marisa
user_reviews_extended.Description: wonderful services for a good price :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly (ThatReadhed)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
5 stars isn’t enough. I could not possibly endorse a business and a professional more highly. Dr. Quyen Nguyen is an absolute master of her field. She is the sole Dentist in her privately owned, high tech, aesthetically pleasing and calming office. Her crew is top of the line. I have a true phobia and even before the work was started, I had a full blown panic attack in the chair. Dr. Nguyen and her assistant were so patient and kind..They took such incredible care of me.. I absolutely adore this place and was so appreciative I sent them flowers and cake. I adore them.

In addition- I finished an Invisalign treatment plan and my highway sized gap is no longer there!! It was such a piece of cake and I actually looked forward to going to the dentist now. I look back at myself from before I met Dr. N and the crew at Tooth and I was so scared and ashamed and the anxiety took up such a huge space in my mind. In my wildest dreams I NEVER expected to LOOK FORWARD TO THE DENTIST. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
ALL THE STARS!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adiv Billauer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Would definitely recommend! 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pat Valls-Trelles
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was referred to Dr. Nguyen back in November by an acquaintance after I told him about the bad experience I had just had with a very corporate dental practice. Dr. Nguyen and her small staff were exactly what I was looking for and needed.

I have now seen her three times in the last four months. Two visits for four extractions and one visit for a cleaning later, I can now recommend Dr. Nguyen's practice, The Tooth, Inc., with no reservations.

user_reviews_extended.Name: scottie ward
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veen “Gaby” Yu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently decided to switch to a new, more local dentist and I genuinely could not be happier with my decision to come to The Tooth Inc. As someone who has a lot of anxiety around dentists, Dr. Nguyen has made me feel so safe and welcomed and the entire staff is very friendly. I had to reschedule my first appointment the morning of due to waking up ill and they were so accommodating and kind. They take the time to walk you through everything, are very upfront regarding costs, and don’t push you to get any unnecessary treatments, which is so refreshing. They even have TVs on the ceiling! If you’re looking for a new dentist, highly highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ilyass Asri
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing service ! I recommend it to anyone who want to get dental services !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon OConnor
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dentist I’ve ever been to. (And I’ve had a lot of dental work) They’ve done amazing things for me, so friendly and professional. My insurance recently changed and I was horrified they wouldn’t take my new insurance bc I did not want to leave them. My wife goes there now as well and some other friends. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jawid mirza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent experience overall. After moving to Austin, I needed to find a new dentist and chose this office based on my research. Scheduling the initial appointment was straightforward, and they provided an online portal to complete all paperwork in advance—saving the usual 30 minutes at the office.

On the day of my visit, everything was well-organized and on time. They performed full-mouth X-rays using a modern standing machine, and the team made every effort to keep the process comfortable and pain-free. They also offered helpful guidance on improving my gum health.

The staff was attentive, professional, and courteous throughout. I would highly recommend this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Ho
user_reviews_extended.Description: I chose The Tooth Inc for my first visit because it’s close to my work and has excellent reviews, and it definitely lived up to its  rating. The check‑in process was seamless since I was able to complete the paperwork online in advance, and I was seen in a timely manner. Dr. Nguyen and the entire team: the assistant, hygienist, and receptionist were professional, kind, and very detail‑oriented. They explained everything clearly, worked efficiently, and made my visit both smooth and pleasant. Highly recommend for anyone wanting efficient and  patient‑focused dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Manuel Madril
user_reviews_extended.Description: "I had an amazing experience at The Tooth! The staff was welcoming, the office was spotless, and Dr. Nguyen made me feel completely at ease. She explained every step of the procedure and answered all my questions thoroughly. My cleaning was gentle yet thorough, and I left feeling confident about my dental health. Highly recommend this practice to anyone looking for professional and caring dental care!"

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Dinnen
user_reviews_extended.Description: We’ve been going here since my daughter’s first dentist appointment. We love Dr. Nguyen and her staff. Such nice people and fabulous dentist <3

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cullen Darbonne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always top notch service, quick, efficient, and pleasant.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ryan knight
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really dope experience!  Super clean place with relaxing beach music videos in each room, not to mention all of the staff were super professional and diligent with their cleaning. My teeth look great!  Highly recommend to anyone in the central/south Austin area to check them out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madelynn Briggs
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to The Tooth for about 3 years now and they have been nothing but fantastic. They are women owned and operated (something I love to support) and the quality is unmatched. I got my first ever filling at The Tooth last year and they were extremely gentle and talked me through the entire thing. Every time I go in there they comprehensively review my past notes (not every place does this) and compares it to how I am doing now and asks proactive questions. They also won't push any type of treatment plan or product on you. They are super cost conscious and always let you know what they are doing, and what is and isn't covered before they do it. I would highly recommend anyone I know to go here! My fiance goes here now too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mars Aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Exelente servicio, mis niños aman su dentista la doctora es amazing!!! El lugar super limpio todas las chicas muy amables super recomendada no ahy más ⭐ si no le dava 10 ⭐ más 😉

user_reviews_extended.Name: Antonia Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Es una excelente clínica siempre nos atienden rápido y el ambiente es encantador

user_reviews_extended.Name: Georgette Benjume
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing!! 🤩 todo el trato y jamás había tenido una limpieza dental 🦷 como la que me hicieron excelente!! Thanks 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leticia Chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Todas muy amables y mis niñas están encadas siempre que van al dentista gracias a eso 🙏

user_reviews_extended.Name: Flor Quintero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excelente te atiende luego no tienes que esperar nada y son muy amable

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excelente lugar, nos atendieron en el horario que nos indicaron , nos explicaron los procedimientos a realizar y costos

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Súper increíble, todos muy atentos excelente servicio.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nan enri
user_reviews_extended.Description: excelente servicio desde que llegas el personal muy amable y el trato muy profesional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aurelio Planes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Muy buena la atención,,buenos  profesionales,Buen diagnostico ,excelente servicio.Muchas gracias

title: Airport Dental Care
address: 3851 Airport Blvd STE#105, Austin, TX 78722, United States

user_reviews.Name: Joe Jackson
user_reviews.Description:
The recession is that work in the front is very wicked and rude. I make an appointment three different times .when I got there ,she have excuses to send me away. I see if I don’t matter she’s telling me to go to a different location.Never get to see the doctor.. she’s not fitted to be a receptionist. She  bringing a bad name to the company ,and is a disgrace.
She does not have a tip scale and respect

user_reviews.Name: Maggie Davis
user_reviews.Description: Wow, what INCREDIBLE service!! I recently moved to Austin and was dreading having to find a new dentist. I could not be happier with Dr. LaBombard and his staff. My dental hygienist, Dylan was amazing! She was so kind and meticulous!  She listened, did not rush, and was very gentle. Dr. LaBombard spent time with me and was extremely thorough. I’m so relieved that I found them.

user_reviews.Name: Rebecca Geezy
user_reviews.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. L for over two years now and it has been a smooth experience every time! Dylon is my favorite Dental Assistant she’s always gentle, informative and kind! Great bedside manner. Shout out to the ladies in the front as well always kind and professional!

user_reviews.Name: Scott Lansing
user_reviews.Description: Fantastic dental experience. Nelda handled all the details with my insurance before my appointment so there were no surprises. Alex performed the X-rays quick and painlessly.  The dental hygienist was the best I’ve ever experienced. Super gentle. Dr LaBombard explained his findings with photos and understandable terms.  A++ Best dental experience.

user_reviews.Name: Genevieve Kent
user_reviews.Description: Dr. LaBombard is simply the best, and the only dentist I will ever go to. There was a period of time when I had to switch around dentists due to insurance coverage issues, and each time I was sorely disappointed. This culminated in the worst experience I've had in my life, when another dentist replaced a filling, cracking my tooth in the process, and telling me I must be "using my sensitivity toothpaste incorrectly" when I reported feeling stabbing pain every time I bit down. I RAN back to Nelda and LaBombard, who fit me in the same day, and IMMEDIATELY diagnosed the actual problem. With doc's advice I proceeded with a root canal and a crown, and the problem is resolved. Please go to Airport Dental - you won't regret it! LaBombard is the GOAT!!!

user_reviews.Name: Uri Stern
user_reviews.Description: Great experience! No wait, the support staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Dr. LaBombard was amazing. He was honest, friendly, and explained what he was doing and answered my questions. Best experience I have had with a dentist in years! I am happy to recommend Airport Dental Care.

user_reviews.Name: Margaret Rieley
user_reviews.Description: Dr. LaBombard is great! I have been seeing him for the last seven years and have always had a very positive experience with him. He has great bedside manner and helps me understand any issues I am having with my teeth. The staff is also a plus- Nelda and Dylan have been particularly wonderful to work with!

user_reviews.Name: Caroline V Morley
user_reviews.Description: I've been a patient with Dr. LaBombard since I moved to Austin 6 years ago. This is a great dental office -- easy to make appointments and very good dental work. He gives clear and useful explanations, and there's no shaming if you fall behind on flossing. The hygienists and front office staff are great too -- I go four times a year for a cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lorraine McChesney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved Dr. Labombard and his staff! He really is the best dentist who truly cares for his patients. I have had several cavities filled with him and each have been painless thanks to his attentiveness and skill. Unfortunately my insurance does not cover this office anymore, but it will be impossible to replace him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carolyn Jenkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard and the staff at Airport Dental Care are awesome. I went yesterday to have 2 fillings replaced, my appointment was at 9 and I was finished by 9:50. There was no discomfort when he numbed my mouth, the procedure went effortlessly, and I was very pleased with my appointment.   Great job guys, keep up the good work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Brian and the entire staff are fantastic to work with. So, honest and willing to work with you on making you feel comfortable and secure. I’ve been in Austin for 14 years and changed dentists a few times but this office is definitely the best team I’ve had and will be making this my primary.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elaine Murray
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Simply,  the best....
Absolutely the best care! I have experience with other dentists over the course of my 9 years living in Austin. Everything from when you enter the office - from the reception to dental cleaning through any dental procedures, all are excellent. Dr. LaBombard never rushes you through your appointment, explains everything in simple layman’s terms. He is committed to staying updated on the newest procedures. As a person who has had dental care for years and have seen many dentists, I’ve been a patient for five years. I highly recommend Dr. La Bombard!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Labombard and his team are great. They are friendly, gentle, and make scary dental work not so scary. Would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chadwick Salls
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Brian and Nelda are so personable and they are the reason I keep returning to Airport Dental! I have been getting my teeth cleaned there for years and I also used them to get my teeth straightened with Clear Correct (LOVED the results). The whole staff is professional and accommodating and they always get me in a timely matter! Try them out and I bet you will be so impressed with them that you will want to get the word out too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Siess
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a new patient but can already say that I’ve finally found my go-to dentist! Dr. LaBombard is thorough, friendly, and makes sure you know exactly what’s going on. His staff is wonderful as well, super personable and helpful with all of my questions. Basically, it’s the best experience I’ve had in a dental office in my 20 years living in Austin! 10/10 would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Hissam
user_reviews_extended.Description: I pretty much never write reviews but I just felt compelled to write that this is hands down the best dental office I have ever been to. The staff are SO nice (shout out to Dylan the hygienist and Nelda (I think!) at the front desk), they remember you, make you feel at ease, are great to talk to, and Dr. LaBombard is respectful, honest, and genuinely human. So, uh. Go get your teeth cleaned and support them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Morrow-Rainwater
user_reviews_extended.Description:
What a wonderful experience! I am very anxious about going to the dentist, I really did not want to go but a cracked tooth forced my decision. The whole process from the very first phone call to make an appointment, to paying my bill when it was over was an incredibly positive experience.

LaBombard and his technicians were so helpful and kind. They were all very good explaining what they were doing, and help me feel comfortable. Everyone had a smile on there face and great personalities. I feel less anxious about going to the dentist now, that's for sure!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ola Barcomb
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was excellent. I really don’t like going to the dentist, but I will go back to Airport Dental for any work I need. The entire staff was friendly and very kind. Dr. Labombard was very informative, calm and confident. He made me feel calm and comfortable, a first for me at the dentist. I would recommend this practice to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Courtright
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is wonderful! My 14 year old usually gets major dentist anxiety but after about one minute with Dr. LaBombard, he was totally fine and told me he wouldn't be anxious next time we came in. Dr. LaBombard has also seen my 5 year old and was amazing with him as well. This place does not harass you or constantly try to talk you into costly dental work. This is definitely our new family dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherri Mowry
user_reviews_extended.Description: An exceptional dentist who is highly skilled, attentive to every need, and genuinely cares about providing  the very best results for patients.  His staff makes you feel equally at home, and Nelda at the front desk couldn’t be more personable and welcoming.   I always leave feeling supported by Dr. Labombard’s pervasive positive energy along with being wiser with detailed  answers to my questions.  This is definitely the best dental office you will find in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Wow. Just Wow. Absolute exceptional service here both before and during my recent dental visit.

I simply cannot recommend them. Even before I was an actual customer there, Ms. Nelda took care of me by educating me on the phone about which dental insurance company I should choose based on my specific dental needs.

I have mandibular tori underneath the bottom ofu front teeth and bruxation (excessive teeth grinding and teeth clenching).

Because of this it is normally very painful to get the x rays and other dental procedures.
But Not here.

Dylan was awesome and just wonderful, she took extra care to make sure that the tool did not cut into my gums and protruded bones underneath and she was extremely professional, patient and kind.

The very same experience with Dr. LaBombard.

He was also super friendly, professional and he patiently answered all my questions.

I really liked how he was pretty much a straight shooter and he didn't over explain things or complicate anything when I had questions (and I had many).

You can't go wrong at all here, they are a true gem.
And this is coming from someone that
gets serious anxiety when it comes to dental visits.

Five stars is definitely just Not enough to describe or rate an experience here.
I cannot recommend them highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith Hunt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've always had a good experience with the team at Airport Dental. Everyone has always been friendly and welcoming and very helpful in answering questions or figuring out my insurance plans.

I appreciate Dr. Labombard's assessment of my dental needs, never feel pushed towards anything if it isn't a necessary step. Not every concern is sold as immediate and dire, I've always felt his feedback to be honest and trusted when he has said something is an immediate need versus a lower priority concern that can be monitored. I am wary of larger, chain-dental clinics and look for smaller, privately owned dental clinics such as this one. Have recommended without hesitation to friends seeking a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carolyn Moten
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit to Airport Dental Care and I couldn’t be more pleased with the experience.  Dr. LaBombard is professional, warm and personable.  He discovered an issue during my initial exam that potentially could have caused a problem with an upcoming surgical procedure.  He was kind enough to make a call to my surgeon to verify the need for immediate attention to the matter.  I am very grateful to him for that.  His dental assistant, Darin (Sp), put me at ease right away with her attentiveness and her pleasing personality.  She also provided me with helpful information regarding my future dental care.  The wait was short and the entire staff was friendly, and made me feel welcome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elsbeth Willis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just an incredible team! I have a lot of anxiety when it comes to dental care and the team was wonderful, trauma informed, and very helpful! First time at the dentist with no pain! Dr. Labombard is extremely kind, approachable, and knowledgeable. Would recommend this place to anyone! Prices are also very good!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Whitten Burdick
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first experience was with Remy, the dental hygienist. She was very gentle and thorough, and was using very modern machinery to clean my teeth and gums. A couple of days later, I was gifted with Dr. LaBombard. He thoroughly explained what had been found and what his plan was. I wholeheartedly agreed and was pleased with the painstakingly complete explanation of his plan. A couple of days later, the first part of the plan was executed. No pain. Very gentle work. Looks good, too! I have more to be done and am looking forward to it. Whoever heard of such a thing? Thus was the quality. Also the front desk folks were very friendly, and Nelda helped me with a plan on how to best use my insurance. Just an overall pleasant and satisfying experience. Of course I'll be a repeat customer on an as-needed basis.

user_reviews_extended.Name: mary pratt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard reviewed my situation, asked me my goals, and set up a good dental plan for the future for me. His staff is the most excellent dental care staff I've encountered: always kind, friendly, efficient. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Riedel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly, warm, helpful and responsive staff. Dental assistants are professional and caring and apply a gentle, non-intrusive touch while x-raying, cleaning and flossing. Everyone went out of there way providing great service and am thrilled with my experience. This comes from a person who seriously dislikes going to the dentist. The dentist himself even took the time to clean my teeth in order to support his staff. Who does that? Do not judge this dental practice by the appearance of the building or its surroundings. A great experience and I definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Swenson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Airport Dental is exceptional from checkin to check out.  The front office staff greets you as you enter.  The wait time is minimal.  The dental assistants and hygienists are thorough, professional and general.  Dr LaBombard is always timely and prepared.  I always leave the office feeling cared for.  Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophie Molinari
user_reviews_extended.Description: All of the dental assistants are always extremely nice and helpful as well as Kate at the front desk. Dr. LaBombard is the coolest dentist ever. Super friendly, silly, and patient. Helps with whatever you need. They’re always playing good music too. Never felt uncomfortable or annoyed or mistreated in any way here, and I’ve been coming here for about 4 years now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend this Dental office. The kindness and compassion they have for their patients is amazing. I came in feeling very nervous. They talked me through everything clearly gave me a plan and a timeline that would work for myself and my insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny Madison
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. L and his team are always friendly. They always provide the highest quality of services. I’ve been a patient at airport dental for over 5years and I refuse to go anywhere else. They always provide the best for health without over charging or abusing insurance. I have referred several friends and family members. I highly recommend him! Tell them Danny sent you, you won’t be disappointed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Penny Snyder
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist, very cheerful, attentive to taking care of your teeth, but not overly fussy. His practice was really upfront about giving me the estimated cost for a filling, which I so appreciated. Dr. LaBombard was also very responsive to me being a little anxious for a filling but it went totally fine! Definitely recommend. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Jemaa
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Airport Dental Care was 5+ stars!  I had an emergency so they made room for me at the end of their lunch hour.  By the way, there is online booking, plus you can complete the paperwork online saving you time in the office.  I was expecting to wait since I was getting squeezed in, however this was not the case!  I walked in, was greeted immediately, and taken straight back to get started.  The receptionist and hygienist were so kind to my daughter, even getting her crayons and a coloring book!  They also took the time to look up my insurance payment based on the work I needed done.  The hygienist was gentle and nice enough to help me keep an eye on my daughter since I couldn't see her.   Dr. Walton came in promptly, talking to me about my options and ready to help me right away.  Dr. Walton always remembers me and specific things about my family...it makes me feel so welcome.  She did the work and I was on my way!  Dr. Walton is efficient, works well with her hygienist, knowledgable, and cares about her patients.  I highly recommend Airport Dental if you want a friendly dental experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan Haynes
user_reviews_extended.Description: After ignoring dental visits for 18 years, I took a great recommendation & visited Airport Dental Care. They had me taken care of and back to a healthy mouth in just 2 very affordable visits! The office is so nice & clean. Nelda & the girls are so good with scheduling, communication & making you comfortable.  This business is very well run and will have you feeling like you’re part of their family. I highly recommend Dr. Brian LaBombard & Airport Dental Care

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Lancaster
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Outstanding!! Dr. LaBombard and staff have a top notch practice and I am very glad I found them. I have been going here for 2 years and each visit my appointment has started on time as scheduled. No waiting around, sifting through old magazines,  or being forced to listen to fox news like my last dentist. However, once the appointment begins I don’t feel like I’m being rushed out the door. They do a thorough job, answer all my questions, provide helpful dental suggestions, and make sure I am completely satisfied with my experience before sending me back out into society with my glowing smile!
I highly reccommend ADC to anyone who is looking to establish dental service or looking to find a new provider. Thanks for another great job!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pat Watson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I so appreciate Dr LaBombard and his staff. They care for their patients and make sure that everything is completed with excellence without doing unnecessary procedures. He has great communication skills. The dental specialist are the best as well. This is a top-notch dental practice I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candace Stinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Walton is hands down the best!!  Not only is she wonderful, fun, and friendly, she knows what she is doing and I wouldn't trust my teeth with anyone else.  She does a phenomenal job and always makes me feel comfortable.  The staff is extremely friendly, the office is clean and inviting, and they are always on time.  I HIGHLY recommend them to anyone looking for a new dentist and I won't ever go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Broussard
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dental clinic in Austin. The care is superb - everything from teeth cleaning to assessment of gum problems and cavities is easy-going and clear. I've been to clinics where I felt unsure if the dentists's recommendations needed to be followed... I didn't trust them. Airport Dental Care is nothing if not trustworthy. They've been good to me for over a year now. Everything is inexpensive - even out of pocket expenses. To top it off, the staff is kind and warm. I actually enjoy my biannual visits. On a side note, the location is awesome. Wedged in between Mueller and Cherrywood, it's accessible for a huge community of folks in E Austin. Love this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mason Bushard
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful and Dr . LaBombard is a very warm, professional, and always makes me feel at ease. I never feel like I’m trying to be upsold on services or products unlike other practices I’ve been too, and I feel like they’re very honest and direct with me at all times. I really like this practice and have recommended several of my friends to it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie El-Hajj
user_reviews_extended.Description: Show of hands, who enjoys visiting their dentist? Yeah, well, I do. Great team, friendly, and efficient, clear billing, digital, technically savvy (huge for me), and A+ solid work. The front desk is helpful, they're big on calling and confirming with insurance so nobody is surprised when bills come due and the dental assistants are some of the best. Heck, even the specialist they sent me to for the crown was great. I've sat through X-rays, fillings, cleanings, and a crown. My mouth should be insured by Lloyd's of London. I've had my share of dentists, some miles and away better than others, and this is one of the good ones.  ++ recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maryse Saffle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have severe dental trauma from childhood and this was my first visit, for a cleaning. Both the front office person and the assistant were very welcoming and put me at ease. And Dr. LaBombard continued in the same vein, putting me at ease immediately with his jovial manner and concern for my apprehension. I think I have found the dentist for the rest of my life; and am returning next week for a filling replacement, without the usual nervousness since I know I am in good hands. And the nitrous oxide helps tremendously!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabby Battaglia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at Dr. Lombard’s office! All of the staff was super friendly and supportive. Dr. Lombard took the time to explain any problems I had and gave me some recommendations on how to improve my dental health without blaming me for anything. The office took lots of COVID precautions and overall I felt very safe, respected, and taken care of.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Front desk staff was very organized, friendly, and clearly communicated plan for scheduling and what to expect at appt. Appt went exactly as expected. Like their focus on technology with quick sign in paperwork, x-rays, and even cleaning tools. The hygienists and Dr. LaBombard we're all very friendly, and clear in their plans. Had my teeth whitened as well - very impressed with how quick and relatively painless this was with their process (4 8-minute sits back to back). Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Broussard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Dr. LaBombard. He and his staff are friendly, professional and fast! I'm taken back to the room quickly and am seen almost immediately. They clearly explain all procedures and offer several options for course of treatment so that I can make an informed decision. I've had cleanings, check ups, a cavity filled and a take-home whitening kit made. Everything has been great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: R Lawson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Labombard (who replaced Dr. Walton) and his staff are all fantastic.  As a person who has always detested going to the dentist, I no longer have the same fear because he explains everything and is extremely gentle and patient. I highly recommend this office for all of your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Chan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard and his staff are super friendly and attentive. Kate (the receptionist I often see) and Darla (the hygienist I've seen at least the past couple times) are awesome. I really feel at home when I come. I had a root canal and new crown done maybe a year ago, and Dr. LaBombard and his staff did an excellent job. I've been to another dentist, where they put in an ill-fitting, rough-feeling crown, but this place got it right. I will continue to come here as long as I live in the area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Knaak
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was very tired of ‘hip’ dentist offices in the Austin area trying to wow me with Instagramable waiting rooms and endless TV during teeth cleanings. A friend recommended Dr L to me and I am so pleased with my experiences with him and his staff! This is a stellar dentist’s office - clean, friendly, and classic. No fluff or frills. Dr Labombard is very friendly and informative. He takes his time to check out your teeth and give you the best plan of care. I highly recommend him to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary Volta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not only was I comfortable. I felt like everyone in the office took their time to do a fantastic job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Francesca Lambert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Airport Dental and Dr. LaBombard are my favorite dental practice of all time. Having been to countless dentists in many major American cities over the past decade, I am hard pressed to recall any other office or dentist that shows as much attention to customer service and medical expertise.  The staff makes the booking, paying, and logistical aspects as easy and pleasant as possible.  The hygienists are kind, professional, and knowledgable.  Dr. LaBombard has wonderful bedside manner and is clearly very good at his job.  He cares about his patients and takes the time to explain everything clearly and work out appropriate treatment plans.  I have been with his office for about a year now and will stay with him for as long as I am in Austin.  Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience. The staff was very kind and welcoming. I felt comfortable from the moment I walked in and the staff followed all the necessary COVID-19 safety protocols to keep the office safe. I don’t always have a great experience at the dentist’s office but at Airport Dental Care everyone made sure I was comfortable throughout the appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Usha Vardhan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard takes a conservative approach and does what is needed and not do unnecessary work He takes the time to talk to the patient. His office staff are very helpful and great people. After my initial visit all of my family have him as their dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine K
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard is an excellent dentist and his support staff are seriously awesome. Of course I am not a fan of going to the dentist but any procedure you need to have done really is painless and quick here. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone needing a dentist in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natural Magick Shop
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had lots of dental trauma in the past...my teeth are just super super sensitive and dentists and hygienists have hurt me really bad. I can't say my visits have been pain free, but I get the numbing I need to minimize it, and Dr. LaBombard is a hoot, and keeps me distracted with conversation and his corny sense of humor. The whole staff is great, they make a trip to the dentist (almost) fun!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drew Edge
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit to this practice. It struck me as very well-run with good automation on collecting history and scheduling. Did not make me give the same information multiple times! Everyone I encountered was friendly, engaging, and knowledgeable. Dr. LaBombard was great and generous with his time. I felt none of that "upsell pressure" that I have encountered at some other dental practices over the years. Nothing but positive stuff to report so far!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ian White
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard is a consummate professional. He very clearly explained the what why and how of the procedure I underwent and all along was very courteous and compassionate, which put me at ease and made the experience a delight. His staff is also very kind and helpful. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis Read
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say I really ever look forward to going to the dentist, but as a first time patient here I can say that I won’t be dreading my next visit. Dr Labombard and staff were super friendly and professional. I just went in for a simple filling and it was fast, painless, and done well. Price seemed fair. Thanks guys, I’ve found a dentist office that I’ll actually look forward to going to in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Barr
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard and his staff were friendly and very good at their jobs.  I was worried going in because other dentists were never able to get X-rays due to a gag reflex but they got it done quickly.  Dr. LaBombard explained my situation to me and referred me to a great endodontic specialist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriela Alvergue
user_reviews_extended.Description:
BEST DENTAL EXPERIENCE OF MY LIFE. Honestly. I am one of those that detests the dentist because of past experiences and would avoid it at all costs if I could. The team at Airport Dental is incredibly friendly, professional, personable, and make sure you walk out with a smile (and better teeth lol).

Seriously, Dr. LaBombard takes such good care of you and your teeth. He walks you through the whole process, answers all of your questions, is super quick, is gentle on your teeth, and explains the procedure after he’s all finished so that you know how to take better care of your teeth.

If you’re looking for a great dentist in Austin, this is it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Weber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every single person I interacted with was a delight. The staff had a great energy about them; Dr. LaBombard, especially. I had a checkup/cleaning and was kindly advised how to maintain my teeth without a single service pushed on me. I then was able to come back within days to get a filling I'd been needing to get for some time. I left spending much less than I thought I would both times. I also left with the confidence that I will be coming back here regularly for cleanings and if I ever run into any future dental problems.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Manlove
user_reviews_extended.Description: So friendly and great communication. I never feel like I’m being pressured to do anything, and they always explain everything they’re doing to make sure I’m comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcia “Longtime Homeowner” M
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my second time to visit Airport Dental.  I continue to be impressed with Dr. LaBombard and his entire staff.  This time I had broken a tooth - yikes!  Kate was so helpful to explain billing (if and how much my Cigna dental savings plan was actually saving me for this work).  Dr. L and his staff made this as pleasant an experience as it could be. Highly recommend this office for good quality care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grayson Huskey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing Dental Care!!! I have been visiting Dr. LaBombard and his staff for almost 4 years now and they are amazing! I just had my front two teeth replaced and they turned out perfect! I would recommend Airport Dental Care to anyone who needs dental work. Dr LaBombard has you covered!

user_reviews_extended.Name: brandy savarese
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard and staff are super. I love supporting a local, honest, and friendly dentist. Their office has handled COVID-precautions really well, and I appreciate that my care was uninterrupted. Airport Dental has my loyalty and unqualified endorsement.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Crawford
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Airport Dental Care! I'm newer to Austin and was nervous about finding a good dentist. Dr. LaBombard and his staff are the best. They are some of the most relaxed/friendly yet still highly professional staff I've seen. Nelda at the front desk has such a sweet demeanor and is always in a good mood even when running from inside to people's cars to safely check people in during COVID times. She called me multiple times to schedule a follow up appointment and was really helpful with the insurance info. I had to have some dental work done (root canal & crown) and Dr. LaBombard's Endodontist recommendation was great and his part of the work was quick, efficient and done with care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband & I have been going to Dr. LaBombard for a very very long.  His staff is great.  Dillion is a wonderful hygienist the best I ever had.  Dr. LaBombard is great.  He exams my teeth and if any problems he finds come up he will find a solution or alternative that doesn't cost us too much or charge us an arm or leg if he finds anything.  I had nothing but a great experience and I strongly recommend them for any dental needs. Five Stars!! for Dr.LaBombard and his Staff!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rodolfo Barrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everybody always pleasant and understanding.  I was seen right away for an acute issue.  Dr. LaBombard has always been great in his care as well as explanations of my issues and what to anticipate after procedures.  Great Job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pastor Richard Mittwede
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doc. LaBombard and staff have excellent chair-side manner.  They explain procedure and outlook very well.  Professional, but friendly.  Besides getting successful work done, each time is a very pleasant experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marisa Fierle Hamvay
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I was referred here, I was told that Dr. LaBombard was kind, gentle and could be trusted. I was SO pleased to have the same experience. I trusted that the recommendations Dr. LaBombard had were in my best interest. I mostly appreciated that he didn't push any unnecssary or non-urgent procedures on me. Thank you SO much for gently re-introducing me to dental care after 4 years of absence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lyndon Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been using Airport dental for 5+ years. The staff is friendly and welcoming. One time I showed up a week early for an appointment I was recognized immediately and they knew my name. I recommend them to anyone who needs a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: F. M
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been going to Dr. LaBombard for over 5 years. Over the years we have moved to places far from Airport clinic but it's worth the drive to keep coming back here. It's hard to find any Dentist in town who is as skilled, thorough and kind as Dr. L. He just replaced my old silver fillings with white ones while catching and fixing some nasty cavities developing in the gaps.  He makes tricky procedures like breeze. Staff at the office are very pleasant too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Summer Copple
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard and the Airport Dental staff are amazing. I’ve had a great experience each visit. Dr. LaBombard and the staff always remember who I am and will talk with me the whole appointment. During procedures, each step is explained and I am asked if I’m comfortable. 10/10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marian Sears
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I haven’t been to the dentist in about 10 years and was overwhelmed with anxiety and fear.
Their front desk staff was so understanding and kind. They had me come in earlier to get X-rays and to talk with Dr L to get comfortable with him and the staff.
It was a pleasant experience overall. No cavities, YAY! I will be getting some gum work done but he put me at ease and told me next steps.
I am glad that I chose this practice to get my mouth in shape.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Dickerson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love Airport Dental Care! Such a great team :)

I haven't been to the dentist in 4 years since moving to Austin. Frankly, I have been dragging my feet since I'm a wimp. I have a pretty bad gag-reflex, too. But when a filling popped out I knew I couldn't wait any longer.

When I visited everyone put me at ease. Super friendly, super gentle, want to get to know you and listen to what you say. I didn't have to wait much at all to be seen. Can't wait to go back. For real! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Louise Bower
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard has a relaxed manner yet is efficient. He has gentle hands and pays attention to detail. He explained my x-rays to me so that I could understand what needed to be done next.  Nelda made the x-ray taking easy and quick. Thanks to both for a happy experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lamiyah Bahrainwala
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental practice in Austin after trying out far too many places. Fantastic place for those who haven’t been to the dentist in a while, or who have anxiety — Dr. LaBombard sets clear priorities and never insists on unnecessary procedures, and the staff make insurance and appointment set-ups a breeze. One million stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elle Roberson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jennie, Nelda, and Dr. LaBombard make going to the dentist fun and relaxing - shocking, I know! I honestly look forward to my dentist appointments because I 100% believe that the team at Airport Dental has my dental health (and my) best interests at heart. I've recommended Airport Dental to several friends and colleagues and they all LOVE going to the dentist now!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kristine reaume
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard is the best! His staff is top notch and are very professional and caring--I was nervous about my first appointment and they made me feel relaxed. They go out of their way to make me feel comfortable and Dr. LaBombard explains everything in a way I understand!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Tarbel
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have been going to Dr. Lambombard for several years now. The staff is always so helpful and provides exemplary support. Their hygienists are always kind and caring. We are patients of airport dental for life 😌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been seeing Dr. LaBombard for a few years now and I have no complaints!  He doesn't pressure you into getting work done unless you really need it. I'm a WIMP when it comes to going to the dentist but this whole office makes me feel really comfortable and at ease. I highly recommend Airport Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina DAllec
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a fantastic practice. Dr. Labombard is compassionate, careful and very kind. Raymie, is really careful, compassionate and  detail oriented. The rest of the Staff, Jenie and Nelda are always patient, warm and kind. They are all down to Earth and not scary at all. They don't rush you and listen to you. I strongly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JudithES
user_reviews_extended.Description: I could go into great detail on all the reasons why Dr. LaBombard and staff are the absolute best but I’ll keep it pretty brief. Dr L is honestly so kind, so incredibly thorough, and just a wonderful human :). He explains everything so well and does beautiful work. Same with Dylan...she is amazing and EXCELLENT at what she does (hygienist; hands down the most painless and just the best cleaning I’ve ever received.) Jennie is wonderful and was literally making me smile and feel so calm during my fillings lol...no joke, she’s the sweetest. Nelda keeps that place running sooooo fast and efficiently and is so helpful if I have any q’s. Honestly, me and and boyfriend are so grateful for airport dental and I already told him...if we ever move to a surrounding city (as we’ve been thinking about), we’ll be making the drive to stick with Dr. LaBombard. THANK YOU TO ADC staff!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holly Kuhn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard is a skilled dentist with an easy-going chair side manner. He has surrounded himself with a warm, professional team who puts the patient first. At the end of my appointments, I leave knowing I was well cared for.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicki Hollums
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really appreciate Dr. LaBombard and his staff. Never have a met a dentist or physician who practices with such care and honesty. I am glad that I found him and plan to be a loyal patient for years to come. If you are looking for a new dentist you have found a good one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Sarinana
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hi everyone,  throughout my life I've found that going to the dentist was really never a pleasurable experience , recently i was forced  to seek out a new dentist . .and i must say. Im so very happy with airport dental ..no more anxiety ,  lengthy visits or costly procedures and  dr brain lambombard. And his staff are truly awesome as well caring and ever so kind. And they are 100% professional now they. Have even taken all steps to ensuring a clean breathing inviorment , its like no other clinic the second you go in that door there taking care of you in the best way possible , oh and the doc wow!  I never felt the 2 filings they put in. From start to finish ....you rock doc👍 i urge anyone's out there that is not happy or not satisfied with there current dental clinic  or just needs work done to go check our dr labombard. And his staff , you'll be amazed and so happy you did..😁 thanks airport dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrina Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is so amazing. The entire staff goes out of their way to be kind and reassuring. They were able to get me in next day when I had a an issue with a crown! They are clear about your treatment options and transparent about cost upfront. They don’t try to upsell procedures and products. 14/10 would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amoretti Mares
user_reviews_extended.Description: As usual the staff brightens my day. It is so pleasant to see everyone at Dr. LaBombard’s office. I am always on the go and it seems like I walk straight to the back. This time I had two molars filled. The main focus was pain; Dr. LaBombard and his assistant made sure I was comfortable at all times. If you need anything drop by Airport Dental Care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frank Hoffman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A short story-we moved to Austin in July 2017 and had not been to the dentist since moving here. Prior to moving here, I diligently went to the dentist twice a year. As a Medicare patient, I thought it was past time to get back on track for dental health. Additionally, two of my teeth were causing me difficulties. Compounding all this, I lost or misplaced my insurance card.
So, first, Nelda at the front desk checked a portal confirming my coverage. Next, she fit me in the same week for cleaning, Xrays, and an evaluation. The hygienist, Raymie, was knowledgeable and gentle.
Dr LaBombard was thorough with his evaluation, his findings and the suggested course of action/game plan. I was scheduled for the first dental work within a couple of days and I was in and out after filling 2 cavities in less than an hour. We followed the game plan perfectly and so far so good.

I highly recommend the office and the professional team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: N. Pomeroy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our whole family uses Dr. Labombard.  We drive from Bastrop, but we wouldnt go anywhere else.  He is the best!  Everyone at his office is so nice and they make you feel relaxed.  Dr. Labombard explains everything and gives you your options.  He doesn't pressure you into anything.  He does a really good job at what he does!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rasheca Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was warm, welcoming, and friendly. I definitely enjoyed my experience. If you're looking for an amazing dentist I recommend you come to Airport Dental. They make you feel comfortable there. I loved it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauro davalos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard is awesome!  The care of the entire team at this office is phenomenal.  They really go out of their way to meet the needs of their clients.  I am totally please with their service.  I rate it a 10 out of 10.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie T
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely impressed with all the safety procedures Dr. LaBombard has in place. They go above and beyond by testing your oxygen level as well as taking your temperature with a no touch device. You can wait in your car so time inside is minimized too. And Dr. LaBombard and his staff provide top notch care with a calming presence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luvy Jenkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve loved going to Dr. Lobombard for the last few years! I always feel very comfortable in his office and love how easy going and genuine he is. His staff is also very kind- Nelda is very friendly and ensures that everything is running smoothly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristina Loh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have finally found a dentist that I trust! Dr. LaBombard and his staff are awesome.  My husband and I switched to Dr. LaBombard after going to Swish on S. 1st and wish we would have switched sooner.  Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edward Willis
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff were very assisting and accommodating to my needs. They were cautious, attentive and responsible when it came to cleanliness. The work was efficient and the quality was outstanding. I would recommend them to anyone searching for dental needs in the central Texas area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacqualyn Blizzard-Caron
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. LaBombard is super friendly and detail oriented. I really appreciate how through he is. Everyone in the office is very helpful and friendly. Booking is easy and appointments are efficient. Both my husband and I go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Eilering
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr LaBombard and staff have always been patient, gentle and awesome. I recommend them to everyone I know. They don't push for you to do al ot of cosmetic stuff unless you want to (though they can do it) which is really nice. Dr LaBombard talks through the options of treatment and really listens to you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Acosta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such professional and friendly service. Dr. Labombard and Kym are so knowledgeable and explain everything so clearly. I will definitely keep coming back here. Plus, I love the new patient goody bags with a toothbrush and toothpaste!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Crandell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Airport Dental has taken great care of me for years!  Dr. Labombard is very skilled and friendly.  The staff are all very caring and considerate.  I really appreciate their care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Upayan
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the most incompetent dentists I’ve met. I needed a crown replacement and Dr.  LaBombard ordered two faulty crowns from a lab (one simply did not fit). After having to go through the painful procedure of trying to have the crown screwed on 2 separate occasions, Dr. LaBombard simply gave up, shifted the blame to the lab, and issued a refund.

user_reviews_extended.Name: C F
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is awesome. Dr. B and the DHs are thorough and diligent when cleaning. I don't go anywhere else for my cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rod Merritt
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife and I have changed to another dentist. Neither one of us liked this guy for very long. He told me I waited too long to get a cavity filled and refused to fill it and just simply said I would lose the tooth. I went to another dentist two weeks later and he put a simple filling in, and now for a month I have had no problems at all. He said tre was no problem and it just needed a tiny filling. Also I finally realized when he was talking to me he was pointing at a video screen behind my head and never told me I could get up or turn around in the chair, he just kept talking while I was facing the wall the other direction.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Kerr
user_reviews_extended.Description:
LIFE SAVERS! Dr. LaBombard and his team were FABULOUS! Hours before a flight from the east coast, I chipped my front tooth. My regular dentist was closed, as it was 8:30p; flight leaving at 7a to Austin. Lucky enough to stumble across Airpot Dental on Google and beyond thrilled that I was able to book an appointment ONLINE (What? I know, right??) shortly after arriving in Austin. Confirmation received by email within hours. Landed at 11 and called to check in. Team was kind enough to recognize my horror and squeezed me in sooner.
I was taken ON TIME, he repaired my chipped tooth (legit, my bf couldn’t even tell which tooth had been damaged), and even emailed the pics, xrays, and color used to my regular dentist. The staff was kind, welcoming, and super helpful.
Dr. LaBombard was professional, talked and walked me through what he was going to do... great bedside manner... and is a talented dentist. He did an AMAZING job! I am so grateful!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmin Schoos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hardly ever write reviews, I read them... I barely write any, but today I had the most awesome experience with Dr. LaBombard and his assistant Tonya... actually with the entire office. I called in this morning to check if I could get a same day appointment for a crown prepping. Since I had so many bad experiences with other dentists I need to be in a certain mood to get my appointment scheduled...  I could come in today, I was there 30 minutes early and was still seen right away. The actual crown prepping was the easiest and funniest procedure I have ever experienced. My nervousness was completely gone even before he started. He numbed the area... even the injection was not painful at all, same thing the drilling and preparing... it was a piece of cake with many laughters and he took several short breaks to make sure I was doing ok. Tonya, his assistant who did my temporary crown, was also super sweet, fun and accurate... I am blown away by how thorough and professional the entire visit was. Also, they don't try to talk you into costly procedures. My previous dentist kept telling me that there was no way the tooth wouldn't break during the preparation and he would recommend an implant... Well, either Dr. LaBombard has the magic drill or he is just not trying to give you the most expensive treatment... nothing broke and my tooth is ready and waiting for the permanent crown. Thank you soooo soooo much. Also the front office... everybody there is just a pleasure to interact with.  Also, not to forget the most important part... Dr. LaBombard saved me several thousand Dollars. My previous dentist told me that a crown for this tooth was impossible because there wasn't enough tooth material left, the tooth would break while prepping for the crown and that would cause in more expenses and complications. I should just have it extracted and go with an implant for approx. $5000. What can I say.... the tooth is prepped, it did not break and obviously there was enough material left for a crown. If you have your dentist telling you that you NEEEED an implant, do yourself a favor and see Dr. LaBombard first... He's the most honest dentist I've seen in a long time. Thanks so much again!!! :)

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Added: They’re so patient with my babies! We also left our cup and they left it out so I could grab it after hours!!! (Upon my request!)

The dentist and his assistant were really thorough with their explanations of why we should avoid certain things. Overall, great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Our recent experience as new patients with Dr. Alzayat was incredibly disappointing. The most concerning issue was that fluoride was applied without parental consent. As parents, we should have been consulted beforehand, but that didn’t happen. When concerns were raised, instead of addressing the situation professionally, the staff became defensive and dismissive of our concerns and health care decisions.

When we requested copies of our X-rays. Rather than simply providing them, the dentist started asking unnecessary questions, making it feel like we were being challenged for wanting access to our own records. His tone implied that we were second-guessing him, which was both uncalled for and super unprofessional.

What made the visit even worse was his reaction when we mentioned that a family member in the dental field had advised us from a more holistic perspective. Instead of respecting our approach, he made inappropriate and dismissive comments about her, which felt completely unprofessional and unnecessary. For a dentist with more than 20+ years of experience, I expected a better sense of what should and shouldn't be said to patients.

Overall, this visit felt more about the dentist’s ego than genuine patient care. The lack of respect for our choices and the condescending attitude made for a pretty uncomfortable experience. We won’t be returning and cannot recommend this office.
