I had a complaint of my son David eating too much candies, however, I don’t want to make David feel bad but I did raise that question to the doctor: "if he eats a lot of candy, is that OK?" Dr. Sam didn't say yes or no first. He said, "Eating candy makes a person feel good." That response made my son not feel sorry to eat a little too much candies. After that, Dr. Sam said eating too much candy may potentially caused the cavity. Then he suggested my son David that he needs to work on his brushing skills. David gladly accepted the advice. Dr. Sam is wonderful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Saloni Asthana
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best service. It was my son’s first dentist Visit and everyone there made him feel so comfortable. From the moment you walk in to the front desk all the way through to the staff and Dentist herself, Everyone was so kind and so gentle with him. He had the best experience ever! I would highly recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: P.S. Ngondo
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and the doctors were wonderful! They made both my sons and me feel safe and well taken care of. The facility is clean, and they are transparent about everything they are doing and billing. 10/10 would recommend 👌🏾

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Chen
user_reviews_extended.Description: We had unpleasant experience with Dr. Alzayat. My son had several cavities. In a follow-up appointment, we thought the treatment would be done. Instead, he treated only half in 10 min or so and asked us to come back for another one. In the 2nd treatment, we had a disagreement with injection of local anesthesia without my consent. He declined the treatment. The office manger called and explained to have Derrick back for routine dental care. We won't return unless with another dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terry Motley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Raymond has been my daughter’s only dentist since she was three years old.  She loves the office and has always looked forward to check ups.  He is wonderful and caring and his staff is top notch!  Today was her last visit as she is twenty now and in college.  Sad to say good bye to such a wonderful team.  I highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Tcheung
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Was charged for a fluoride treatment that we did not received and was only offered credit for future use. Since regular maintenance is covered completely it will be a while before we could even use the credit.  They did not provide an itemized receipt of what was being charged until I went back to ask them about the charge.

It took 40 min for them to see my son. It’s frustrating since I had to pull my son from school early.  When we checked in they could have let us know they were running behind. Or even better called before the appointment so my son wouldn’t have to miss a portion of school.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Arredondo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been taking both of my children here for several years. I have always felt the professionalism and courtesy from the staff and Dr. Raymond. Today I experienced something that I had to make sure everyone was aware of.

My daughter was needing an emergency appointment with and Endodontist and I was having a very hard time getting in somewhere.
One of the staff was willing and able to help me locate an available opening. This was not a quick task though. She had to go above and beyond to assist me with my requests. Thankfully, to her, we were able to get something scheduled the same day. I can't express the amount of gratitude and I have for this young lady. She literally saved me from a straight catastrophe. My respect and loyalty will remain here at Dr. Raymond's office. Thank you so much (you know who you are).

Forever grateful,
Happy Customer

user_reviews_extended.Name: Guadalupe Escobedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is awesome. I definitely recommend Westlake Pediatric and Dr. Sam.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristy Ton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first visit was great. I have not received any service yet, it was just an evaluation for up coming treatment. The office was clean and very modern, also have a lot games and toy for kids while waiting. Doctor Raymond was very nice and seem very experienced. My 5yr. daughter had bad experienced with other dentist before, I hope we're in good hands now. Will give an update after her treatment.

Update: We got our first treatment yesterday. My daughter needed 3 silver crowns and a spacer and she was traumatized with other dentist; therefore we put her to sleep before the treatment. We were very nervous about it, but doctor Raymond and the Anastasiaologist was very helpful and put us at ease. Over all we're very happy with the visit yesterday. It took a few hours for the medicine die down, but she was back to normal after that. The office even called us in the afternoon to check on my daughter. Very nice peoples there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna Kurz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My two young children actually LOVE going to the dentist! Westlake Pediatric makes it a quick and painless process each time. The kids were actually disappointed that they were called back so quickly after arriving that they weren’t able to play any games (I was quite pleased with this -we were 15 minutes early to our appointment). The ladies cleaning teeth were friendly and explained what they were doing in simple terms while the kiddos watched a movie on the screen above. The dentist was quick and efficient, answering any questions I had. Kids received their fun toothbrushes and picked a toy from the prize box when all was said and done.

While our latest visit was a quick and easy checkup, we’ve also visited for X-rays and a filling. These visits were informative, easy, and my daughter was as comfortable as I could ask for.

Highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: rosalba Bee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been taking my kids here for over 10 years! It's amazing seeing the doctor age and still be the same nice person. He is a great dentist, amazing with kids and what I like the best is that he is straight forward, not alarmist, pretty laid back. Every time I come here there are always kids and he is always super nice with them. I can tell he has tons of experience with kids. I even changed my dental insurance recently so my little one could continue to come here. I recommend them to everyone, specially those who have had bad experiences before, he'll help you get through it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karma Girl
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank Goodness for this dental practice. They are so caring and compassionate. Dr. Sam and his team really took the extra effort to calm all my worries and answer all my questions... top quality care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: vidhya pai
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter broke her tooth during athletics and oh my! We can’t thank our stars for finding the absolute best doctor. Dr. Sam gave us a consultation appointment the same day and was able to assure my teenager that she is going to be ok. He fixed the tooth after 2 weeks and made it look just like her original tooth. You can barely even tell which tooth was broken unless you take a super close look. My daughter’s first reaction was priceless when she got to see it after being fixed. Both my kids have been seeing Dr. Sam for a while and we are really pleased to have not just the doctor but even their amazing staff at this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rham Ketmayura
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great overall experience from online scheduling and confirmation to in person reception and dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Xiomara Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: We've had Dr. Raymond pull 2 of our daughters teeth after getting two abscess and we just had our cleaning done today. He's a great dentist, kind, great with kids, knows how to speak to them so they understand what's going on. The assistants and hygienists are also great and very friendly and helpful. My daughter absolutely loves him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Barton (Andrea B)
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have always had a great experience visiting Dr. Raymond for regular cleanings. My children enjoy talking with him and I am able to schedule all three of my kids at the same time and we are in and out within 30-40 minutes. Beautiful, large office space with a variety of toys, movies, and video games available while you wait. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carly Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: We continue to choose this provider because they are timely, friendly, professional, and always make us feel safe.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Majewski
user_reviews_extended.Description: Office staff, hygienists & Dr Sam are incredible! Amazing & patient with my son! We drive 1.5 hours just to come to this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kali Valdez
user_reviews_extended.Description: We always have a good experience here. The environment and staff are comforting and great for kids of all ages. My daughter (8y/o) has always been a little hesitant/nervous at the dentist, but since going here, her confidence has gone up and her anxiety has eased. My youngest daughter(2y/o) had her first official teeth cleaning, and for a little girl usually super shy of men, I was shocked that Dr.Raymond actually cracked a smile out of her and got her excited to sit in the big girl chair and get her teeth cleaned. Both are excited to come back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juli Z Rivers
user_reviews_extended.Description: In the end, everyone we interacted with was kind, and the doctor was great, and we are choosing this dentist's office for treatment. I am optimistic for the future. But our visit yesterday was not okay; we were ignored for so long and they didn't even know why we were there. We arrived for our appointment 5 minutes late after driving from across town. We checked in a filled out the paperwork. We then sat in the lobby for close to an hour before being seen or talked to- during that time, 2 other parties came in and were seen and left. When it was finally our turn, they rushed my 5 year old into a teeth cleaning, except that wasn't why we were there. I let the tech know that he had a cleaning two months ago, and it became evident they did not know the reason for our appointment. After explaining that we were needing a consultation, we were sent back to the lobby to wait longer while our files were pulled. Ultimately, we were in the office on Halloween for 1 hour and 40 minutes for a 5 minute consultation with the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Raymond does an excellent job of providing a safe, healthy, educated and fun experience for children visiting the dentist. His office is up to date, exceptionally clean, and fun for multiple ages of kids. He does not overtreat and takes an age appropriate approach to services. His hygienists are the best and deserve tons of credit for how kid friendly the office is. I drive an hour out of my way for his exceptional service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raya S
user_reviews_extended.Description: We've been going to Westlake Pediatric Dentistry for almost 3 years. Dr. Raymond and his staff are amazing! Our kids had some work done several times, other than cleanings, and it went perfectly smooth. Dr. Raymond is very patient and he explains thoroughly everything. The office itself is very clean and cozy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ping Ye
user_reviews_extended.Description: So glad we came to this dentistry. Dr. Raymond was amazing. Saved a lot of unnecessary treatments on our six year old son that was suggested from our previous dentist. Office was really beautiful and clean, everyone was also friendly and helpful. Highly recommended! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deanna Ford
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Dr. Kyle Raymond and his office, we have been going there for years! Exceptional care is given. My son has sadly aged out of seeing a pediatric dentist (as far as insurance goes) and my daughter has 2 more years before she graduates high school. Everyone that works there is super nice and it's always a pleasure to go. I highly recommend Westlake Pediatric Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiersten Soderman
user_reviews_extended.Description: My kids love coming to Westlake Dentistry!  They know how to get the kids excited about taking care of their teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bahia Amawi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Raymond’s dentist is always exceptional from the minute we walk into the door until we leave. His staff are courteous, helpful, on time, and efficient. Dr. Raymond treats his patients as individuals instead of just an appointment. We live 50 minutes away but it is worth it. He is caring, professional, and takes time to explain everything really well. I highly recommend him especially if you have kids who are scared of going to the dentists. His office is child friendly with movies, videos games, and toys.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika B
user_reviews_extended.Description: The games in the lobby are a hit. All the staff was great and patient with my son.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Perri Beathard
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We had the absolute best experience today, our first visit, at Westlake Pediatric Dentistry. My child has some very special needs, and the extra level
Of care, kindness, and patience was above and beyond what I’ve ever received from a dental appointment for him. The hygienist, COURTNEY, should receive a gold medal for her above and beyond the call of duty today!! Much thanks and gratitude, Perri Beathard

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blair Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: We took my daughter for her first dental appointment & the entire staff couldn’t have been nicer. They made her feel as comfortable as they could and made her visit very quick & fun. So happy we chose this practice - we will be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Minerva
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family has been going to Dr. Raymond's office for over 10 years. We drive over an hour to his office. We have plenty of dentist offices where we live, but the ones we tried never made my children feel at ease.  Dr. Raymond and his staff are always so friendly and efficient. They make my kids feel so comfortable that they enjoy going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassandra Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond and his staff are the best. My kiddos love them. When your kids are excited to see the dentist it says something. I was referred to him after my oldest has a horrible experience at the dentist 17 years ago and was terrified, Dr Raymond put his mind at ease. He and his 3 siblings love him!! Thank you all for being amazing!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Hernandez-Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really recommend this place! the orthodontists are so great! AL and Malisa were a huge help today!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathan Myers
user_reviews_extended.Description: This by far has been an extraordinary group of individuals. They were extremely professional with both myself and my three boys. None of my boys (ages 9-14) felt uncomfortable. From a tooth extraction to simple cleaning the boys where comfortable. While they waited there as plenty of entertainment, video games, movies, books and toys. They staff is friendly and communicative with the parents. Thank you for making what is normally a fearful visit to a pleasant one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Shiflet
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is by far the best, dental office I have ever encountered! From the extremely, pleasant office staff, fun and friendly dental hygienists, all the way to the warm and efficient Dr. Raymond, we have never had a bad experience. My kids actually ask when they can go to the dentist, which is amazing considering one of them has had some uncomfortable procedures. Dr. Raymond has always made sure that the child's comfort and the parent's pocket book come first. We live in Southwest Austin and are more than happy to make the drive to Westlake for these experiences! Thank you!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Valdez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Raymond Kyle is so good with kids, he made my son very comfortable and was very good at explaining to him what tools he was going to use. He demonstrated how they sounded and talked him through each step of his procedure. Not to mention he was so fast. Everyone at this office is friendly and professional.

Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Schubert
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love the location and staff!
We have always been seen on time and the staff is so friendly. Courtney is the best!  She’s so sweet and patient with my kids!  I have one that is extremely nervous and now he’s totally at ease coming to the dentist bc of Courtney!  Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yusraa Sabree
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I'm extremely annoyed with this dentist office. My first visit was in October and they performed xrays, cleaning, and fluoride on my children. Upon checking out, I was told the fluoride for my teenagers was not covered by my insurance and that it would cost $50. I told them that typically if a service is not covered by insurance, I'm asked if I want to have the service done prior to the service being provided. They removed the fee and placed a note on my childrens' file to ask mom prior to fluoride treatment. Prior to leaving, their next six month visits were scheduled. Six months later, April, we arrive for the appointments and I'm told I have a balance because a few of the x-rays from October's visits were not covered. I've never even seen or received a bill, so of course I'm upset. The woman up front removed the charges but stated "It's a courtesy that we are billing your insurance because we don't have to". Ma'am, you are in-network, I'm not paying OOP to be reimbursed by an in-network provider, for that I will find another provider. A courtesy? LOL.
Finally, upon check out, I'm told that my son received fluoride and there was a cost associated. Was I asked if he could receive fluoride? No, certainly not.
Weeks later I receive a statement from my insurance saying they were not eligible for cleanings because the appointments were before the 23rd of April, and not quite 6 months. However, they specifically stated that it was 6 months and assured me because I called to ask about moving the appointments up and they told me they could not otherwise it would be under 6 months. I'm very annoyed, extremely upset, and I'm not paying a dime for cleanings while I have insurance that covers them at 100% of the cost that I pay a hefty monthly premium for. Avoid this dentistry and go somewhere else. The aesthetics of the office are great, movie playing, lots of toys, etc. The dentist is super personable, and kind. However, the front staff is incompetent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Dryer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had nothing but positive experiences with the entire staff. They are simply exceptional when dealing with my young kids. Even when you think your two-year-old won't open her mouth for an exam and fluoride application, the magic happens!! They are all-around patient, welcoming and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beauty In with Marissa Artistry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always amazing , highly professional Dr Raymond has been the best with both my boys since day 1 . From toddlers to now pre-teens . Never disappointed my kids never hesitate going to their dentist love it there . So comforting for every child .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elexa Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our family loves Dr Raymond! We have been coming to him for over 9 years! The staff is super friendly and great with the kids!! We always have very successful cleaning visits!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rita Cooper
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Dr. Raymond! We have been patients for over 15 years and we trust Dr. Raymond and his staff so much so that we are willing to make the drive from Round Rock! I always leave knowing that he has my kids' best interest at heart.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chrissy Grams
user_reviews_extended.Description: My son loves Dr Raymond. He is very caring and goes over everything for my son to make him feel comfortable.  He is totally worth the drive from where we live. The front desk is great as well. So happy we found this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sarah smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been with dr Raymond for almost 10 years.  He and his staff are so patient and sweet with my kids. We recently had an issue of needing teeth pulled and he was quick to get in touch with our orthodontist and then get in contact with us.  Awesome doctor and competent staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Callie Russo
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are amazing! We took our two daughters (18 months and 34 months) We we so worried they would lose it. Everything went so well and the staff is amazing. Our daughters are now asking when they can go back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin Schroeder
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s was amazing! My kids love going there ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: My son has special needs and the staff/doctors are beyond helpful and kind when it comes to meeting his needs at each appointment. They are very in tune to his struggles with teeth sensitivity, bright lighting, and wait time. Finding a dental practice who makes your special needs child feel safe and accepted is the best! We are grateful for everyone at Westlake Pediatric Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Amriel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond and staff genuinely cares about their patients.  I felt confident he has the expertise and knowledge to support my sons needs . Both my son and I had a positive experience. I would recommend him to anyone looking for a great dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Manuel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a positive experience here! The office is great, hygienists are extremely patient with little kids, and Dr. Sam is friendly and knowledgeable. Love coming here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Get Epic'd On
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this office!  This was our 4th attempt at getting some work done on my kiddos this year and finally found what we need here. The office is amazing and you can see the waiting room from the dental chairs so managing multiple kids is much easier. My boys loved the video games and actually had fun at the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A Sal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just gotta say that the staff definitely won my 5 year old over. He usually gives me a very hard time about going to the dentist and this time wasn't any different. However the staff was very sweet and talked him through the process every step of the way. For the 1st  time he had a pleasant dentist visit. Thank you to the staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Wa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We live in Harker Heights. We drive over 45 miles, for 60 + minutes, and through 3+ cities for our appointments. We have made this drive for 10 years....tried to find another dentist, but doc and his staff are just TOO GOOD!

Dr. Raymond will continue to be the twins first and only dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zack Morton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Kyle Raymond and his staff at Westlake Pediatric Dentistry are amazing. Honest, friendly, understanding, and informative. Our kids have actually never complained or been nervous even one time. And they have never left the office not wanting to go back. Best decision for our family and kids to see Dr Raymond since their early years. There is no other office we’d rather go to for pediatric dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeannine Duncan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Awesome, kind, and honest dental practice!!
We have been going to Westlake pediatric dentistry for over 5 years now. We were referred by my good friends because of a horrible experience we had with our last dentist regarding my son. I truly believe that we started seeing Dr Raymond, just in time before any more damage was done!! I highly recommend Westlake pediatric dentistry!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charmaine Hinahon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond has one of the best bedside manners of any dentist I have ever met.  He successfully filled 5 problem spots on my 3 yo daughter’s teeth (no GA needed).  His leadership and quick skill with the drill allowed my daughter to remain calm, cooperative and not feel any pain.  Dr. Raymond explained each step and stayed engage throughout.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laurie Soukup
user_reviews_extended.Description: My expectations were exceeded for our first timer to the dentist! The staff and Dr Raymond were so great with my daughter that they were able to do everything they needed on my strong-willed 2.5 yr old (that hates going to the dr). Thank you for starting out our dentist experience on such a positive note. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Cox
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lovely atmosphere with lots of toys and things for children to do while they wait. Staff were friendly and welcoming. Doctor exam was helpful and efficiency-answered all my questions. Appointment was on time. Open floor plan allowed for parents and children to see exams and cleanings going on, which created trust and transparency. My daughter of course loved getting a prize at the end of her exam and was helpfully distracted by the tv on the ceiling during her cleaning. 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My oldest who is now 20 saw Dr. Raymond throughout his childhood. Now my 2 youngest are patients. I’ll let their words speak for our experience.

My 9yr old : I had a lot of fun at the dentist today
My 7yr old: yeah!! Can we go back tomorrow?

🤣  strange but I’ll take it! Never any hesitation from the kids when we mention dentist appointments.
The entire staff at Westlake Pediatric Dentistry is kind, welcoming, and thoroughly helpful if you  have any questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maxx
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love them always quick and super nice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blair Dudley
user_reviews_extended.Description: We had a great experience at Westlake Pediatric Dentistry!  Dr. Sam and his whole team are patient, attentive, and helpful. Our girls love going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawna Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: We visited Westlake Pediatric Dentistry after having a very painful  and traumatic molar extraction experience at a different pediatric specialist. My daughter was understandably scared going in after her first one went sooooo badly. Dr.Raymond did an amazing job sedating her, and soothing her, and her second molar extraction was completely pain and trauma free! Highly recommend this practice for sensitive kiddos and all the small young ones. Staff is friendly and professional, and office environment is welcoming.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mayra Rosas
user_reviews_extended.Description: All of the people that work there are very sweet and attentive with you !! My daughter made a comment that she loved the way they treated her and are very careful with what they do. One of the best dentist !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc Wissman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond and his staff are top notch and always professional and thorough!  We are sad that our three sons are aging out of the pediatric practice.  It has been a joy to bring them twice a year for their annual dental checkups!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katrina Bayer
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff were incredibly helpful from Melissa persevering and calling my insurance back and getting the right information out of them to the staff the day of. My little one is cutting her molars and she did not make her first visit easy for anyone but the dental assistant and dentist were wonderfully understanding and she finally quit squalling when she got her toy proving that bribery works every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Nall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Westlake Pediatric Dentistry for your children's dental care.  They are very friendly and the facility is set up to welcome and comfort children who may be afraid of the dentist.  Dr. Raymond is also awesome with the kids.  He speaks to them as if he's a friend and he explains everything clearly to the parents.  You cannot go wrong choosing Westlake Pediatric Dentistry for your kids dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Addison G
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here for years! Excellent people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Masha Wheeler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful dentist! My son loves visiting!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Shinn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Raymond and staff were all amazing! I’m so happy to have found him for our 9 year old daughter who needed a pediatric dentist. Highly recommend! 5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margo Sbrocco
user_reviews_extended.Description: My boys have seen Dr. Raymond since they were toddlers and they are now teenagers.  He is great with kids of all ages and takes time to explain things to the kids at their different stages of development.  I highly recommend Dr. Raymond and his professional and friendly staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jemma has been going to Westlake since she was 1 years old. The staff is very frinedly and patient with her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: heather gibson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Dr Sam, he’s very friendly and great with my son. Can’t say enough good things about him and this office! Keep up the great job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ginny E
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Dr. Raymond and his team at Westlake Pediatric. They are always on time, professional, friendly and efficient. Our boys love going to the dentist. Thank you for making it easy to see the dentist! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janice Spence
user_reviews_extended.Description: Normally I would give them a five star review for WPD, but this time the front office staff was less than nice to my son and I. We were nine minutes late due to my son having a difficult time getting going that morning and traffic was horrible. The front office staff immediately said you are 15 minutes late. And I looked at my watch and we were 11 minutes late. She then said let me go see if the hygienist will still see you. Then she came back and said they will see you, but for future reference, to be this late, we can't see you. I have been coming to this dentist for 17 years and to be treated this way was totally rude. She never asked how are we doing etc. Like I said, normally this office is 5 star worthy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suketu Patel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been super good… great staff and care they provide…amazing facilities

user_reviews_extended.Name: josephine Vasquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: We had our semi annual checkup for our 7 year old. Courtney, dental hygienist was so positive and upbeat and made my daughter so comfortable. Great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Hearn
user_reviews_extended.Description: They definitely have an effective and efficient process down. The staff is always helpful. My kids love the games they have to play while waiting. It's a great system. Sometimes I wish they would spend more time with the cleanings but I guess that is indicative of clean healthy teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maggie B
user_reviews_extended.Description: My boys never mind going to the dentist when they go to Westlake Pediatric Dentistry and see Dr. Raymond.  Most of the time they are prompt in seeing my boys, they are thorough and never try to sell me on anything unnecessary and are accommodating when scheduling additional appointments.  We once moved away from here just to go to another dentist that was closer and of course we regretted it! Great for my boys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond and his staff have always been very kind, welcoming and overly competent in any of my children’s dental needs! Love this place and so happy I chose this for my kids over 10 years ago! Can’t say enough great things about Dr Raymond and his office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charles Divins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sam is a pediatric dentist whose cool and collected demeanor  turns dental visits into relaxed and positive experiences for our little one. We're grateful to have Dr. Sam's exceptional care in Austin keeping young smiles shining brightly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Westlake Pediatric Dentistry has a cheerful and calm office. There are nice decorations, comfortable areas to sit, a kid’s movie playing, and plenty of hands-on games (even a couple of video games) in the waiting area. Some of the treatment chairs are open (no walls between) and some are enclosed, and they have the same movie playing on the ceiling so kiddos can keep watching during their dental cleaning/exam/treatments. The staff were all wonderful and patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Iva Braun
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond and his staff are very friendly and kind with children. The office is large, very clean, and comfortable for kids. We have been driving from Pflugerville to Lakeway to see this dentist, and we never regretted it. Dr. Raymond is very honest with his services and treatments, which I have valued most.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Landin
user_reviews_extended.Description: If I could give no stars I would. Let’s start with the beginning. My son went in for a dental procedure and was given the wrong medicine to help calm him down with his anxiety. It was administered through an injection when it was supposed to be administered orally 30 minutes before the procedure.  My son has anxiety with the injections. So for it to be administered that way did not make sense at all. When I questioned it they told me that that is the way that medicine is administered. I later found out that is not the case and they administered the wrong anti-anxiety meds. My son had severe trauma from this experience.We had to go back to have his spacers put in. My son was very nervous about this appointment. Even though I assured him there was no pain, he did not trust me because I told him that the last time. So the anxiety was high. When’s the dentist came in and started messing with his mouth my son let out a nervous Yelp. Nothing loud or crazy.. Just a nervous sound.This dentist had the audacity to cover my son’s mouth  with his hands To be quiet. I was shocked at what I just witnessed. And then he proceeded to do it again. That is when I told him that I had an issue with him covering my sons mouth like that and he responded “If I did not like it we could leave” while He was in the middle of  putting the spacer in.  I was left with no choice but to sit there as he treated my son awfully. Once he left the room his assistant even apologize for his behavior. We will not be returning to this dental office and in fact I will be contacting the Better Business Bureau as well. This dentist is awful and should have his license taken away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ioana Fazio
user_reviews_extended.Description: My kids refuse to go to any other dentist but Westlake Pediatric Dentistry. I am living in Round Rock and there is a.long drive but they love it here. Dr. Raymond is amazing  and all the staff as well. My kids are not scared when they need to go to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zoe Skelton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My two kids, now 5 and 6, love Dr Raymond and his staff.  There are tons of toys and video games to play, plus  movies playing on several screens around the place.  Dr Raymond has been great at explaining things along the way and his hygienists do a great job of cleaning the girls' teeth quickly and efficiently.  We've been going here since my youngest was 2 and they could just get the quickest of peeks in of her mouth.  We've also had one dental semi-emergency on a Friday afternoon and the office was great about calling me back after hours.

My only criticism/bit of advise is that my youngest was very easy to sensory overload as a small child and the office the first couple of times was kind of crazy making for her.  Too many things to play with, too many things to look at, too many sounds.  She would be a little dervish by the time we left.  I learned to book appointments first thing in the AM when the toys are mostly away and it's calmer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kerry West
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I have ever met; and they couldn’t be more kid friendly! Dr Raymond is knowledgeable, kind, and has the most incredible bedside manner with children. Highly highly recommend the practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: shawnta jones
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We have been patients of Dr Raymond for several years now, but was disappointed with this visit. My daughter went in with pain to her jaw and not much worry or care was displayed. Her pain was disregarded and not much detail as to what could have been the cause. She is set to have her wisdom teeth removed and was told at the office to talk to the orthodontist about the pain. If knowing you were unable to address her issue for being seen, why have us come to the office, If that was the diagnosis before we had even been seen?
Like I stated in the beginning we have seen Dr Raymond for many years, and have always had good experiences, but really felt like our concerns/needs were not addressed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Chiang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My boys beg to go to the dentist!  Dr. Raymond and his staff are kind, personable, assuring, and patient.  The boys don’t even blink as they run/walk to the video games.  I love the open office layout.  I can see the boys as they are having work done, but also be at a distance because sometimes it’s better that way.

We’ve seen Dr. Raymond for years, but yesterday's visit is fresh in my mind.  My 6 year old had an abscess on his gums which was kind of not worrying me but kind of really worrying me.  I called at 9am and we were seen at noon.  Dr. R explained the situation and gave me options.  I chose to have the tooth pulled.

You would have thought my son was laying on the beach.  Sunglasses, watching Secret Life of Pets on the ceiling.  He was given laughing gas, some topical anesthetic, then before i could snap a pic (ugh!) the tooth was out!

We were in and out so quickly and grabbed PTerrys for the ride home.  You would have thought we’d just gone to the County Fair, but no, we went to the dentist 🤣

Now if the Tooth Fairy could just remember to come tonight.  She already owes double because she forgot last night 🤦🏻‍♀️.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I was blessed to find Dr Raymond 20 yrs ago and it has been the best dental care I have ever experience for all my children. The staff is very professional, courteous, and friendly. I would highly recommend to anyone in search of a pediatric dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: EM
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If I could give zero stars, I would.

I picked my son up from school on Wednesday & he told me his adult tooth was loose & there was root discoloration. I called the office right away but apparently they close at 3. I called the emergency number multiple times but it would just hang up on me. There is a gap in time where the dental office is closed and the emergency number is not taking calls.

Around 6pm the emergency line called me back & said since the dentist had already left I would need to wait until the next day. So there is no emergency services at this office.
I made an appointment for the next morning.

I got a call the next morning(Thursday) & was told the dentist was sick & couldn’t see my son until Monday. Apparently a dentist left and there is only one dentist now. She told me I could start calling around to other dentists and see if they can get me in. She couldn’t have cared less.

I called my dentist right away & explained the situation and they got my son in that day to save his tooth. I don’t know how Westlake Pediatric Dentistry ever going to handle emergencies if they have extremely limited hours, one dentist & don’t come in after hours.

user_reviews_extended.Description: My child with special needs was assigned to this practice through his insurance, and an appointment was made with the office months in advance (due to their packed schedule). I was assured that his insurance was taken by the practice at the time of scheduling yet received a call 24 hours before his appointment to say that they couldn't find him. They looked him up twice using two different misspellings of his name and were unwilling to call his dental insurance to investigate the issue. When I asked to speak with a manager or verify that they entered the correct insurance numbers (given the previous two errors in writing his name down), they said they were (suddenly) with a patient and hung up on me. There was no call back or effort to resolve the issue. Now my son will have further delays in his treatment, and I will have to restart the process of finding a special needs-friendly pediatric dentist. What a disappointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candace Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sam and staff are wonderful

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel A. Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Westlake Pediatric has never disappointed in the 4 years we've taken our daughters here. Professional staff, polite help, and awesome follow ups. My daughters always say, "5 Stars!"

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriella Rapp
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was my first time coming here, and I was a little anxious, but they were super nice and friendly. I do have to say that I do not reccomend the smores flavor, since that tasted like bourbon. And the doctor who checked me out last was also SUPER nice. Oh, and they played some cool movies. But overall, I recommend this place. 10/10. 🥰

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very fast service
and friendly employees recommend 100%

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Henderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: 5 stars!! Great office, & Erin is always so helpful & sweet! We love her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandi Meyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience overall! The staff was super friendly, and Erin at the front desk was especially great—very welcoming and helpful. The dentist was patient and made my child feel comfortable the whole time. Definitely recommend if you’re looking for a good pediatric dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brett Evans
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Westlake Pediatric Dentistry is located in the perfect location.
Once you arrive, you realize the dental practice is the first business in a wonderful complex and then you step inside and their offices are second-to-none when it comes to family-friendly environments.

The front office staff are veterans and incredibly resourceful on all subject matters and the hygienists are so inviting in addition to highly skilled at their craft so when Dr. Sam (our kids are under his care for years now) arrives and provides his analysis and advice for oral/dental care you know you are in good hands.

Give Westlake Pediatric Dentistry a try and you will be pleased in your decision for pediatric dentistry as well as orthodontia.

This dental practice has thought of everything and the staff provide a stellar experience.

B. Evans

user_reviews_extended.Name: Priya Desai
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff! Patient friendly answered all my concerns. Our boys loved our first visit

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a pleasant experience, no waiting and efficient. All are kind and pleasant.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always love Dr. Sam and the staff at Westlake Pediatric Dentistry!  We wouldn't go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juliet Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: La verdad el personal super amable la Clinica es un encanto para los niños con juegos la verdad quede encantada con la experiencia y el servicio del personal super amable se mira que aman lo que hacen

user_reviews_extended.Description: Todo el tiempo buena experiencia a mis hijos les encanta ir con ese dentista

user_reviews.Name: Rudolph Llanes
user_reviews.Description: I've found my dentist! Dr. Long and staff are really friendly and professional. Dr. Long was attentive to my concerns and provided some thoughtful insight. And she performed the most thorough dental examination I've ever experienced. I know my teeth are in good hands.

user_reviews.Name: Philippa Beaumont
user_reviews.Description: Just the best Dental Practice we have ever been to in all the places that we have lived in the US.   Dr Long and all her staff are extremely professional, personal and polite. The three P’s you don’t see very often in one office. I have never had to wait they take you on time and when I had some pain in my mouth before an international flight last year  they saw me immediately.  I have no hesitation in recommending Dr Long to anyone.  10/10 stars from me.  Philippa B

user_reviews.Name: Sharon Morrone
user_reviews.Description: I’m a real penny pincher, but I decided to return to Dr. Long for my dental needs rather than stay ‘in network’ and pay a lot less. The reasoning that swayed my decision is the expert care of the dental hygienist, Stella, the knowledgeable and experienced dentist, and the office staff who treat me like they really care about me. The whole atmosphere in the practice is calming and reassuring. For me, dental treatment is about as enjoyable as prepping for a colonoscopy, but Dr. Long’s practice makes the whole ordeal an experience not to be dreaded.

user_reviews.Name: Amanda Lipstein
user_reviews.Description: This is the best practice! They are organized, thorough, kind, warm, and very respectful of appointment times. I get plenty of reminders about my appointment, and they take great care of me. They have all the latest technology and tools, and whether they are performing a routine cleaning or any kind of dental work, they’re always professional and efficient. The office location is convenient, well maintained, & there is plenty of parking. Highly recommend Dr. Long and all of the office staff.

user_reviews.Name: Bonnie Pope
user_reviews.Description: I can’t say enough good things about Westlake Dental Arts. They were amazing. By far the best dental experience I have ever had. I’ve been putting off going for way too long and I am so glad I was referred to them. Dr. Long is amazing and thorough. I have already referred another family member to them.

user_reviews.Name: Julie Fleming
user_reviews.Description: You know how it is when you move and need a new dentist, so you ask people who they go to. Do you like your dentist? Do you love your dentist? Most people say they don’t. Well, I LOVE my dentist and her staff because they took the time to get to know me. They all have a gentle touch, and keep me well informed about what I’m doing well and not doing so well with my oral hygiene. And they always tell me what they’re keeping an eye on and what I can do to either improve the problem or at least slow down the progression. They help me avoid costly dental work through preventative care. I highly recommend Dr. Long and her team at Westlake Hills Dental Arts.

user_reviews.Name: Caleb Wood
user_reviews.Description: I hadn’t been to the dentist since I was a kid, aside from a root canal, and I was really anxious about going. Two friends recommended Dr. Long, and even though I was dreading it, I’m incredibly glad I went. The experience has been a complete 180 from any dental visit I’ve had before. Dr. Long and the entire team at Westlake Hills Dental Arts are kind, caring, and genuinely easy to work with. They made everything feel comfortable and stress-free, which I did not know was possible for a dental visit.

user_reviews.Name: Freddie Rios
user_reviews.Description: Thank you very much for all your nice work that you have done. I’ve had bad experiences in the past with other dentists from other places but this location is the best I’ve ever felt at!! I was a bit nervous at first but ever since I entered they have made me feel confident with them and my smile I would!! 100% recommend to anyone

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sue Parten
user_reviews_extended.Description: I continue to so appreciate the professionalism and great skills of dental team here. I had a crown come off and Dr Long worked me in the next day to replace it. Her team is all so fabulous and friendly.  And, with COVID, flu and other respiratory illnesses circulating the whole staff respectfully wears masks to keep a friend me safe while at appointments. The level of care and attention is always so appreciated.

user_reviews_extended.Name: fangyu
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff were so patient and friendly, and the dental care was excellent. Really appreciate the great service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Delacruz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
December 2023:

Christmas at the dentist is not exactly you may have asked Santa for but in case of an emergency Dr. Rebecca Long will be there to fix your teeth. She once again performed an excellent job to fix a crown.

March 2023:

I had been seeing Richard Jones for the past 15 years until he announced his retirement. But not to worry Rebecca Long took over the practice. She has brought a new perspective and atmosphere in taking care of your dental needs. The staff welcomes you and makes you feel comfortable where no one likes to go to the dentist with the presumption where there will be drilling and teeth pulling. There has been improvements with equipment and technology.

The dental assistant performs an excellent job cleaning my teeth where she makes me feel very comfortable and provides me with good knowledge in taking care of my teeth.

It’s easy to make an appointment and never had billing issues

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc Cannon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Westlake Hills Dental Arts has a great location (for us) and is an incredible practice. From the front desk to the practice owner, everyone is a consummate professional and expert in their craft. I have been going here for a very long time will continue to come back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie McKeon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Westlake Hills Dental Arts for several years. The staff is always professional and I feel like my teeth have never had better care. I highly recommend Dr. Long and her staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina H.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had my first appointment with Dr. Long, and I’m genuinely impressed. She gave me the most thorough review of my dental health I’ve ever received—taking the time to explain things clearly and thoughtfully. She addressed both functional and cosmetic concerns, and even recommended an excellent orthodontist with a clear plan forward. I felt listened to, respected, and informed every step of the way. Hands down the best dental experience I’ve had. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teddy Ivanova
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can't say enough positive things about Dr. Long and her team. From the moment I walked into the office, I felt completely at ease. Dr. Long is the epitome of professionalism—thorough in every aspect of her work, incredibly honest in her recommendations, and truly caring in how she treats each patient.

What impressed me most was the level of attention to detail. Every step of the exam was explained clearly, and I never once felt rushed or unsure. Dr. Long took the time to answer all my questions with patience and sincerity, offering advice that felt grounded in integrity.

It’s rare to find a provider with genuine compassion, but this office does just that. Highly recommended!

Teddy

user_reviews_extended.Name: 82 ENGR
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Long and her staff are very caring. I have been a patient with them for almost 20 years.   I have always been treated well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Pryor
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been going here for more than ten years, I started going here because of a recommendation for people who are terrified of dentists. Every experience has been fabulous, they are amazing and professional without fail.
Recently, Dr. Long was even responsive, and immediately, over the weekend when a family member had a dental emergency. So kind, so helpful, I cannot recommend highly enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Weissman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Long is definitely one of the better dentists.  Very thorough, and her manual dexterity is noteworthy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rusty Tally
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dental practice is terrific!  The staff friendly and very welcoming at every visit. I also really appreciate Dr. Long’s professionalism and that they run on time. It is great to have a dentist that respects their clients time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DM
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited Dr. Long's dental office, and I can't recommend it highly enough! Dr. Long is not only incredibly skilled but also genuinely cares about her patients. The front team welcomed me with warm smiles and made the check-in process a breeze. The dental team was fantastic, ensuring I felt comfortable and informed throughout my visit. If you're looking for a top-notch dental experience, this is the place to go! Thank you, Dr. Long and team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ale
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at the office was super nice and friendly.  I've never been to a dentist where everything was explained in such detail. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Faria
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff is always very warm and welcoming!
Dr Long is always kind, patient, and thorough. We were with her predecessor for close to 20 years so we were a little anxious when he retired but Dr Long has proven to be an outstanding dentist. We are happy to be her patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacie Brilliant
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Long and staff are so nice & always punctual, it makes going to the dentist, an absolute pleasure!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johnny Wright
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Long and her experienced team provide a level of care that I did not know existed in dentistry. They have the latest high tech equipment and the latest methodologies of care. They go above and beyond to make this a relaxing experience that I recommend to my friends and family. At my previous Dentist, I used to have pretty severe pain when getting a cleaning, where at Westlake Dental Arts every hygienist that I have had was extremely gentle and I no longer dread the dentist. As far as getting work done, Dr. Long is extremely talented and honest.They check all the boxes and I’ll say it again, they go above and beyond every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drex Earle, Ph.D.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Long and her team are indisputably the best dentistry office in Austin, hands down. It's not even close. From the initial consult (which lasted more than an hour one-on-one with Dr. Long), to the most gentle,  impressively comprehensive regular cleanings, to warm, well-timed communication before, during and after each visit, I've never felt more at ease, at-home and cared-for by a dentist in my life. As a preventative measure, I just had two mercury fillings replaced and it was the easiest, most painless procedure I've ever had with a dentist. There's a real artistry to excavating and restoring a filling, not to mention seamlessly re-building a tooth, but Dr. Long is supremely-skilled. You'd never know there was even a filling there to begin with. Can't say enough wonderful things about this place - if you're the least bit squeamish about going to the dentist or simply not enjoying the best possible experience with who you're seeing now, don't wait another minute - do yourself a favor and switch to Westlake Dental Arts!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olena Meilite
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went to Dr. Long with an acute toothache that had already turned into jaw pain. I was given an appointment for the nearest time at my request. From the very beginning of my communication with this clinic, I felt understood and supported. This is, although not the main, but a very tangible criterion when choosing a doctor for me. I was examined and, taking into account the complexity of my situation, Dr. Long provided the most understandable explanation of the processes taking place and found an appointment for the nearest day with the nearest and best doctor who could resolve my request. I am very grateful to you for your timely and quick work with me! I think that I will choose this clinic as my permanent one.

Dr Long truly knows what is she doing and really wants to help. I believe that it will cause a lot of another thankful patients and a great success for this clinic!

Thank you Dr. Long and Marie-Sol for your indescribable support!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellen Gernert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this place. I’ve been going here for a while now and they’ve always been kind, welcoming, and friendly. Their team is thorough with their work and very helpful when it comes to dental hygiene. Apart from being good at what they do, they’re just good people to be around! 10/10 highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitch Epps
user_reviews_extended.Description: Boutique-style dentist experience! The Doc and her entire team are amazing!! You will be spoiled and won’t want to go to another dentist ever. From Cathy and Marisol, to Madison and Dr. Long, their team is incomparable. Thank y’all for making dental care easy, approachable, and extremely comfortable! Kudos!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent care given by everyone in office. All options were explained as well excellent normal checkup care. I would highly recommend Dr Long

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeanette Carey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Long and her staff are not only skilled in dentistry, but also a pleasure to be around. I was nervous about getting a crown but there was no pain at all. Vicki made sure I was comfortable and Dr Long explained the process as she worked and made sure I was doing ok. When I had a gum line filling replaced, Dr Long took her time to make sure it looked natural. Madison is also wonderful. She does a thorough cleaning with no pain. I highly recommend Westlake Hills Dental Arts.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Romero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Long and her team work wonders! I came to Dr. Long with a very complicated case involving the replacement of 25-year-old veneers. They treated me with exceptional care and compassion. From start to finish, I was clearly communicated with and educated on the process, including potential roadblocks. They set clear timelines and expectations, consistently delivering amazing results while ensuring my comfort in the chair. I couldn't be happier with the care I received, and I will remain a lifelong patient. I love my smile! Trust the process. Go see Dr. Long at Westlake Hills Dental Arts!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jane Overall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn’t been to a dentist in five years but Dr Long came highly recommended so I made an appointment. I have very high anxiety due to some bad dental experiences in my past but everyone on staff is very friendly and quickly put me at ease. I’ve been there three times this month and each time has been pleasant and I’m conquering my anxiety at last. I’m very pleased with her attention to detail and have recommended her to my daughter.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sicilia chan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been coming to Westlake Hills Dental for three years now.  There were personnel  changes with Dr. Jones' retirement but the front office remains to be efficient and friendly.  It's important to me that the dental office doesn't make me wait.  Christina my hygienist, Dr. Long and my Periodontist have collaborated closely to devise a plan to treat my gingivitis. Christina had done an incredible job on the deep scaling and root planing services but eventually I needed "flap surgery" with Dr. Long's referral.  Dr. Long was the most patient and explained my condition in detail and easy to understand language.  She is warm and make me feel at ease. I love and trust this dental practice and would recommend them without reservation.

5/29/2025 updated with current review:
Dr. Long and her team are simply the best in quality care and customer service.  My latest experience... when I severely injured my tooth in a fall in June 2024, Dr. Long was incredibly thorough and explored all possible avenues to save it.  Although we ultimately had to proceed with extraction due to infection, the entire year-long process with specialists' coordination - from examination, treatment planning, extraction, implant and crown placement - was handled with exceptional care.  What truly sets this practice apart is the compassionate care; I never felt alone as their office director Kathy was consistently checking in on me and provided much-needed emotional support.  Beyond the super clinical excellence, Kathy's genuine emotional support made a profound difference during a challenging time.  Their blend of professionalism and empathy is truly remarkable.  I am very grateful for their comprehensive care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Yanz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Westlake Hills Dental Arts is the best place to receive dental care in Austin. Dr. Long and her staff are top notch in their field. They have the best customer service and really take great care of their patients. Your not just a number, you are treated like family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chad Karnes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fit me in last min with a crown fix. These ladies are awesome! Glad I go there!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Han Bunch
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been searching quite some time for new dentist after my move from New York City. And I couldn’t be more thankful to have found Dr. Long and her team. The process from the time I made an appointment to my arrival at the office was impressive every step of the way. The staff were professional, warm and friendly upon my arrival. I noticed the office has the latest technology which means they invest in their business and their patients. After my first visit with Dr. Long, I knew this was it. She was thorough, honest, straightforward and explained clearly the next steps. It’s so wonderful to work with a team of their caliber. Thank you for all that you do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chad C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a new patient exam and the care I received from Dr. Long and team was top notch, no doubt. In addition to the care being excellent, I also felt very welcomed and valued by the entire team.

We had a miss on insurance, and Kathy took it very seriously and exhibited professionalism and personalism to address the issue.

I regret that my insurance will not work with Westlake Dental Arts because they are a great practice. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Little
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Westlake Hills Dental Arts is without a doubt one of the most outstanding dental offices anywhere. From the moment you walk in you are greeted by extremely friendly, welcoming, and personable staff that take a genuine interest in who you are in a very caring and natural way. The office itself is clean, modern, and comforting to help keep you at ease throughout your visits.

Dr. Long provides state-of-the-art and transparent dental care, constantly going the extra mile to ensure your comfort and satisfaction. I recently had a filling break that Dr. Long replaced and throughout the procedure, she constantly checked in on me to make sure that I was comfortable throughout the procedure. It was the only time where I’ve had a filling where I didn’t feel any discomfort or pain during the procedure.

Beyond providing exemplary treatment, Dr. Long and the staff are there for you and will treat you with a level of kindness, respect, and welcoming that is extremely rare nowadays. I cannot recommend highly enough in trusting Dr. Long and Westlake Hills Dental Arts for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Dooley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Long and her team are amazing! They always manage to squeeze me in, in case of an emergency, and always assuage my concerns. They are professional, caring, conscientious, and great at what they do. Dr. Long is a fantastic dentist, and I recommend her, and Westlake Hills Dental Arts, wholeheartedly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joann Bentley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Westlake Hills Dental Arts/Rebecca Long DDS has become my new dentist.
My husband, 2 daughters and son in law (who are all picky people) are patients of Dr Longs. I had an emergency with 2 broken teeth!  Dr Long saw me the next morning without being an established patient!  I was very impressed that she came in early to treat my painful teeth. Her in office dental lab made the 2 permanent crowns during the same visit. This saved me an office visit because there was no need to first receive temporary crowns.  I was very impressed with this streamlined process.
I had no pain during this difficult procedure and the time flew by.  I even inquired if I should consider dental implants and she respectfully informed me that she would not recommend them for me.  I was very impressed with her honesty!  Dr Long & all the staff I met were both professional and friendly.  The office is extremely clean & comfortable.  Staff very courteous & friendly.  Easy parking with a good location. As a side note: My internal medicine physician from Westlake ADC even told me great things about Dr Long because he is a patient.
I was so happy to walk out with the permanent crowns from one visit and no pain. As a Registered Nurse & a person with an autoimmune disease, I am very particular about my healthcare providers & I had an excellent experience with Westlake Hills Dental Arts!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meghan Hughes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this dental office for 18 years. Dr. Long has brought a great energy into the environment. She is caring, kind, and professional. The hygienists are all top notching and really kind. I highly recommend Westlake Dental Arts.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margo Sbrocco
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clean, professional office with friendly providers.  Gentle cleanings, thorough exams, and excellent care.  I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandy Muller
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In all my years I have never been so impressed by a dental team as I am with Westlake Dental Arts. I’ve been a patient for 2 years. Every member of the staff is highly competent and personable. They explain what they’re doing or would like to do, various options and the pros and cons of each. Their equipment is state of the art. They’re  attentive to how I’m doing throughout my appointment. They offer many options to make sure the patient is comfortable throughout the appointment -  blankets, neck pillow, videos, headphones with many music tracts to choose from, and more.
Recently I had a scare and left a message on a Saturday afternoon, when the office was closed. Dr. Long returned my call within 5 minutes, listened carefully, asked questions, gave me her assessment and why, what to look out for, and assured me that if I became more concerned she would meet me at the office.
I’ve recommended Westlake Dental Arts to several family members, ages 25- 69, and their feedback is just as positive as mine.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Kidwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been with Westlake Hills Dental Arts for over 25 years. I loved Dr. Jones and love his successor, Dr. Long. The change was seamless. The office is always super courteous, friendly and prompt. They talk to you like a friend even if you just met. Always a positive atmosphere for an event no one gets excited about - dentist. 😊 They keep up with new innovations that make the experience better each time.  definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Xuereb
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Long and her staff are top notch. They consistently provide a very high level of care, utilizing the latest technology in the field of dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Inge Biosevas
user_reviews_extended.Description: A+… from the receptionist to the check out. I basically went for my 6 months cleaning. I usually dread them since I have sensitive gums. Their hygienist is very gentle and thorough. One of the best hygienists I’ve ever had. I hardly felt a thing. Dr.Long is Wonderful. Again gentle, caring and has done good dental work on me. Great location and staff:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: C T

user_reviews_extended.Name: Devan Brannan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
***EDIT 12/16/20***  I received a call early Wednesday morning, 12/16/20, from Lauren at Westlake Hills Dental Arts. She was incredibly apologetic and explained that they had been having some issues with their scheduling systems and, unfortunately, I was just a casualty of the overlapping of that system's problems.

She also took the time to move around what she could and fit me in for my appointment today, 12/16, when I was originally scheduled to visit. I was extremely grateful for all the effort she, and the rest of the staff put in to make that happen.

When I arrived at the appointment everyone greeted me warmly, I was taken back immediately and Kristina began working on my teeth. Once my cleaning was done, I met with Dr. Long to review my x-rays and discussed next steps.

Even though I knew that they had squeezed me in to, what I can only imagine, was an extremely busy day, I never felt rushed or hurried along. Everyone I dealt, or even passed in the hallway, took their time to introduce themselves to me, showed respect and took their time working with me, answering any questions I had and explaining what they had found on the x-rays or during the exam and made sure I completely understood.

I was extremely happy that I gave Westlake Hills Dental Arts a second chance and I will continue to use them as my dentist from now on!

**Original Post**
I called to make an appointment several weeks out for a basic cleaning. Everything went smoothly and the appointment was scheduled.

A week or two later I got a call saying there was more information I needed to provide (I wasn't told this in my initial call), but no problem at all. Unfortunately I am currently in the busiest time of my year and working 60-70 hours of week.

This makes if very difficult to both answer the phone during business hours (when they call) , as well as call back before their offices are closed.
I did receive a second call the week before my appointment but, again, I was in a meeting and then was working until 11-12 o'clock that night, so I was not able to return the call during the time anyone was in office.
After that second call I did call at a later date, later in the night and got their out of office voicemail.
I left a message stating who I was, that I was sorry I had been busy the two times they had called and hadn't had the ability to return their calls within working hours.
I received a call back the night before my appointment saying they had cancelled my appointment since they hadn't heard back from me. In order to re-schedule the only option was one 7 am appt a . Unfortunately that was  on a day I had an 8am meeting with my DVice president so I was unable to make that work.

I completely understand that they needed more information, that's not a problem at all, and I would have happily given it to them. However, nowhere in the call to schedule the appoint initially was I told they needed any more information. Nowhere in either of the two follow-up calls was I told that if they didn't hear back from me that they would cancel my appointment and offer the spot to someone else. They simply just canceled my appointment and gave it to another client with no notice that mine had been cancelled and replaced with a different client.

I feel it's common courtesy to at least give a warning that if a phone call isn't returned that would cause a forfeit of my scheduled and confirmed appointment before someone else is allowed to take my confirmed appointment I'd had schedule for weeks. When scheduling any sort of appointment or one-on-one meeting, or multiple person meeting

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Colpaart
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In a world of commoditized services, private equity roll-ups, and increasingly transactional care, my appointment with Dr. Long and her team felt… suspiciously different—in the best way.

From the start, Marisol—who handles the phone, text, and front desk—made me feel genuinely seen and heard. She was warm, responsive, and incredibly helpful, even getting me in three weeks early off the cancellation list.

Before I even sat in the recliner, they invited me into a consultation to review my dental history, discuss concerns, and actually get to know me. I wasn’t rushed or made to feel like just another appointment on the schedule. My records had been sent over in advance, fully uploaded, and clearly reviewed—homework done.

They asked about dental anxiety and committed to walking me through each step to help ease it. That level of care and awareness immediately stood out.

Once I was in the chair, Margo thoroughly walked me through the X-rays, and then Dr. Long joined to review every tooth—current health, gum condition, and future considerations. It was the most comprehensive dental exam I’ve ever had, which honestly made me question what I’d experienced in the past.

Beyond their clinical expertise, the team was warm, funny, and incredibly knowledgeable.

I’m weirdly excited to become a patient of Dr. Long—and very grateful to my orthodontist, Dr. Boss, for the recommendation (and for insisting I make the drive).

user_reviews.Description: The entire team is incredibly warm and kind, I was nervous going in because of general dental anxiety but the whole experience was wonderful. Ashley listened to my concerns and provided reassurance which I’m greatly appreciative of. I definitely recommend this group for dental care!

user_reviews.Name: Austi
user_reviews.Description:
Came for a cleaning. Got interrogated, ambushed, and grifted.

I scheduled a basic teeth cleaning. First, they said I had to do X-rays — fine.It started with “mandatory” X-rays — okay, whatever. But the tech doing them treated it like a weird first date. She aggressively asked about my hobbies, vacations, weekend plans, favorite restaurants — while jamming giant plastic bite things into my mouth. I finally had to say, “Can you back off a bit -- It's too much.” She was visibly annoyed, but backed off.

Then a dentist I never requested came in, told me I don’t have oral cancer (???), and started another personal interview and chatted about her in-laws. Still no cleaning.Eventually, I saw the hygienist — the only great part of the visit — Mandy - but she’s since retired. At checkout, I was charged almost 4x what I was originally quoted. For services I didn't ask for and are "mandatory for a first appointment". This place has no boundaries, and a masterclass in dental grifting.

user_reviews.Description: Dr. Jordan Slagter is the best dentist. Great attention to detail and very knowledgeable.  I followed her when she relocated here, and this office is great. Front desk staff super nice and attentive. I worked with hygienists Amy and Rebecca; they were so nice and ensured comfortable x-rays and cleaning. Clean, nice big windows for views to look out of, and they give you a TV above you to watch if you want. Great experience.
