I can't say enough wonderful things about this dental office, I highly recommend Dr. Horne and his great staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Cooley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a long time patient of Dr. Horne and I always have a pleasant experience. Everyone who works there is friendly and always seems to be in a good mood. I've never felt pressured to sign up for teeth whitening or receive unnecessary dental procedures. The office is clean and has a nice contemporary decor. I always recommend this practice when friends ask for a referral.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Swift
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was dreading finding a new dentist, but was very pleased after my appointment!  The staff is very friendly and knowledgeable.  I felt reassured during my cleaning because of the staff's communication and Dr. Horne is great.  They made going to the dentist not so scary!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rach Rach
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr Horne for a couple of years now. He and his staff are extremely nice and comforting. He recently did a bunch of dental work which my teeth now look fabulous! I love love love my smile. During the timeframe that my new teeth were being made, the temporaries were loose. I grind my teeth :( Dr Horne came in on off hours to repair the temporaries. Very flexible. I enjoy my visits but I still get nervous, just because I am that way. They are very reassuring. I see Dr Horne very time I go but you generally seen the technicians and admins more. - and they are super nice and friendly! They are like family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Braden
user_reviews_extended.Description: An incredible experience!  They seem to have figured out how to make every aspect of their operation incredibly efficient while also maintaining a uniquely personal touch.  I have found that to be pretty rare in any business to be able to combine real technical skill with service/hospitality.  Like most, I have not been a fan of going to the dentist as it usually involves discomfort.  Dr. Horne and his team seem to literally have the tools where that is no longer an issue!  So glad I finally found a permanent home for my dental needs.  Thank you Dr. Horne!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chanille Dunbar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really appreciate being able to go right back within 5 minutes of my appointment time every time, without having long reception waits. The staff is super-friendly and they know what they are doing. Dr. Horne is also really good. I had 2 cavities filled and it was the most painless and least stressful experience I have ever had with cavities.

user_reviews_extended.Name: stephanie sloss
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit to Dr. Horne's office was definitely a five-star experience.  There was a lot of work to be done on my visit and I had contact with Dr. Horne and several members of his staff.  They were all pleasant, precise and professional.  The dental equipment is state of the art and the crown Dr. Horne created for me was a work of art.  I most highly recommend Dr. Horne's office to anyone for both routine and more advanced dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Upshaw
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have both had bad luck with dental experiences and Dr. Horne and his team have been fantastic so far. The staff is all very knowledgeable and extremely kind and helpful. I have been impressed with everyone so far and am grateful we found such a wonderful dentist's office here in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lara Beck
user_reviews_extended.Description: Can't say enough good things about Dr. Horne and his team!!  Dr Horne is amazing, Rebekah is so adorable and the best dentist hygienist I've ever had, and Mia at the desk is always so welcoming as is everyone!!  When you go there you feel like part of the family.  I recommend Dr Horne and his team to everyone I know!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Olen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne and his excellent staff were very professional and friendly. I have high anxiety about dental visits, but his wonderful hygienist put me at ease and was very gentle.  I will continue to bring my family to this practice and highly recommend it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelli O'Donnell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Horne is friendly, professional, and caring about his patients. I went in for a small cavity filling and was out of the door in 15 minutes. The hygienists are very sweet and understanding, and the front desk ladies are great! The atmosphere is clean, warm, and inviting, and when you are in the waiting room, you almost forget you are actually in a dentist office.

If you are hesitant to go to the dentist or get nervous and anxious, don't be! Dr. Horne is the dentist you need to see. Him and his staff will treat you great because they are respectful of everyone's time and are more than accommodating. I appreciate that I finally found a dentist who makes me want to go back to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela McKay
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always been anxious about going to the dentist and have avoided it...to the point where my teeth were not as healthy as they should be.  The team at Dr. Horne's office has completely changed my outlook on dental care and I now have no anxiety about upcoming appointments.  Most importantly my teeth and gums are in great health.  I left there today and said "that was great". I never thought I would say that about a dental appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sue Richard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne and his staff are the best! They have treated me for years--always professional as well as kind, gentle, and helpful. I recommend Dr.Horne and his team to everyone who wants quality, up-to-date dental care delivered by an exceptional, caring dentist and well-trained staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eva Sheie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne has been my dentist for two years now, through several minor emergencies and for the usual 6 month checkups and maintenance. It's not the maintenance that matters - it's the emergencies - and if you have a problem, they'll get you in very quickly. The entire team communicates brilliantly and do their very best to make you feel comfortable no matter what you're going through. My VERY favorite thing about them is they have free teeth whitening for LIFE once you pay for your trays, as long as you make your 6 month checkups on time.  My teeth have never looked better!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy Schoonover
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is a total scam. They need to do a deep cleaning on my teeth and wanted to charge me $1500 for 90 minutes of work.  That’s more than I pay for my attorney. The funny thing is, they sat there and complained about dental insurance not paying for anything. Wanting to get paid for a hygienist $1000 An hour is why dental insurance is so bad

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audie Alcorn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently returned to Dr. Horne after going to another dentist closer to my home for a couple of years. But Dr. Horne and his staff and his great office digs are worth the drive. If you want a dentist you can trust completely and actually look forward to going to, choose the warm, cheerful, gentle, and highly skilled staff of Dr. Horne's. They'll treat you right.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blanca Snyder
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly welcome as I walked in then Rachel gave me a tour and guided me to dental cleaning area. Super nice as she took X-rays and prepped me for Dr. Horne.  A pleasure to meet Dr. Horne who examined my teeth. Plus great conversation.Thank your Dr. Horne and staff for making my first dental visit so pleasant.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allen Hah
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time trying a dentist in Austin and was a bit anxious about finding a new dentist. A good friend recommended this place, and he was spot on. It's a very sleek operation, and the layout of the space is efficiently tailored. Each person I interacted with was friendly, Dr. Horne was fantastic, and they explained in full detail how much was being charged and the anticipated coverage from insurance. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: monica gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first Austin dental experience, and it was wonderful! The staff is so friendly, in an un-smothering, natural kind of way. Beautiful office, great care. Dr. Horne is quick and efficient, and most of all, knows what he's doing.  Definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: McKinli Schroeder
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne and Kim helped me out amazingly. I am terrified of the dentist and they were able to reassure me and let me know exactly what they were doing throughout my procedure, talking me through it all. Hats off to them both, I have never trusted a dentist and I just found my one and only place!  Love the ladies at the front as well so helpful and kind! Thanks to all at Dr. Hornes office!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeanna and Justin Jette
user_reviews_extended.Description: My entire family loves Dr. Horne and Rebekah! They take good care of us and make us feel like part of the family. My children have gone from being extremely anxious about visits to the dentist to actually looking forward to them! I would highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our experience at Dr. Horne's office is ALWAYS one of excellence and ease. Our entire family enjoys going to their dental appointments, it is like going home to see family. From the minute you walk in the door until it is time to leave, we feel loved, valued, cared for even if it is going in for a cleaning. The expertise of the staff and how they perform their tasks is hands down the best dental care we've experienced. They know how to treat both children and adults no matter what the issue. Who ever goes to a dentist and walks out feeling encouraged about all areas of life? We do…whenever we go to Dr. Horne's office. How thankful we are to be your patients and for all you do for us.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A Embestro
user_reviews_extended.Description: I first came to Dr Horne's clinic in the summer of 2008 and have been very satisfied ever since for his competence and friendliness of his staff.  Dr Horne does not push for unnecessary treatments. I find his approach to be practical and cost effective. Both front and back office staff are fun to be around with, especially Renee and Mia whom I've known since my first visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nadia Pidgeon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne struck me as knowledgeable and provided practical solutions to problems during our brief introduction. Rachel was friendly, gentle, thorough, and took the time for extra precautions for my allergies. The office was well designed with a nice patient view and many amenities. I do expect to pay more for the amenities in this type of office but I was shocked when I received my bill. I received the recommendation to the practice from a co-worker who has the same dental insurance and he pays nothing extra for cleanings and X-rays after insurance. While I provided my insurance details at the time I scheduled the appointment, I was not informed until after services were provided that the practice was out-of-network. My insurance plan covered less than half of the bill and I paid, out of pocket, over $200 for standard services. This poor communication complicates the patient/doctor relationship in an otherwise professional and pleasant office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Barlow
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best. Dentist. Ever.
You won't find a better experience (in terms of both dentistry and customer service) anywhere. Dr. Horne is highly skilled (he works so quickly and effectively, he usually finishes before I know he's even started) and he has surrounded himself with hygienists and other technicians who consistently display a combination of technical ability and enthusiastic hospitality. I happily entrust our entire family's dental care to Dr. Horne. No matter where you live in Central Texas, it's worth the drive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Wang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hate dentists, I admit I have dentophobia.  Dr. Horne and his staff have both tremendously helped me with this.

Before moving to Austin, I had many a tooth pulled out in my lifetime, plus wearing braces for five years so I've seen my share of dental and orthodontic offices.

We found Dr. Horne online with very positive reviews, that was over five years ago, and we've been committed to going to him since then.

The staff at Dr. Horne are super nice and great with kids.  We brought our three year old son today for his first dental check up and he loved his first appointment.  Rebekah is fantastic, Mia and Renee at the welcome desk are accommodating, friendly, put you at ease, and this is important for me, because remember, I got that dentophobia.  I highly recommend Dr. Matthew Horne and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My Son was scared to death to visit the Dentist until we recently found Dr. Horne.
His office staff and Associates immediately made Jack feel comfortable and Dr. Horne was a perfect fit! I cannot tell you how happy my son was & I as his Mother am elated. The office equipment is cutting edge. I highly reccommend Dr. Horne & his staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne has been my dentist for a few years now, maybe 4. I needed a trusted Austin dentist when I moved here and was referred over here from a friend. I haven’t been happier with any other dentist. The hygienist are just as great. I had some poor gum health and after treatments with Dr. Horne I’m back to tip top gum health.I also did Invisalign with him and couldn’t be happier. The front desk staff, Mia and Sara, are great to talk with. They all have become “framily.” Get it? Friend and family put together?

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Wilson Vincent
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Loved it...as much as you can love a visit to any dentist :)  I've been a patient of Dr. Horne's for years and I am always pleased with the level of attention, and care that I receive from Dr. Horne and his entire staff.

They're the best!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Walters
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent care from front desk to doctor drilling a tooth. He explains everything. He also will work out what's needed most if you have more than one issue, but can't afford a ton of dental work at once. And they always give you quote for all the work you need. Plus he gives least painful novocaine shots I've had in 30 years.

Oh and they don't chastise and get super huffy with you for forgetting to floss regularly.  Dentist and technicians must realize most of us don't do it.  He also recommends excellent docs when othodonture and implants are needed.
Plus he, like his staff, are just genuinely a nice guy. Although he's so good I'd see him if he was rude and gruff...he's that good.
We even used him as our dentist when we had an HMO type dental policy that didn't cover his services. That's surely a sign of a good dentist. My only complaint is he is too far from my house.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wesley Lunsford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Are you looking for a dentist?? Go see Dr. Horne! My wife began going to him years ago and I made the switch shortly after. I am thankful that I did. They have a great spot on Bee Cave, super friendly staff, and offer a selection of drinks while you wait or after your visit. Dr. Horne does GREAT work. Make an appointment. You won't regret it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeri Jaggers
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Awesome dentist and staff.  Very friendly and professional.  I have been a patient there for years, and I have never had any pain while in the dentist chair.  I can sit back and relax and know that I am in very good hands!

I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Philip Gardner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been seeing Dr. Horne for about 10 years now; bar none the best in the business.  His staff is excellent and always a pleasure to chat with in the waiting area. Everyone is extremely nice and very professional, I've never left having a bad experience.  They are also very flexible as far as rescheduling.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marlon S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne's office is by far the best dental office I have ever been to.  I travel a pretty good distance, bypassing all other dentists in Austin for dental care at this facility.  From the front office to the technicians, they are the most caring, friendly, and professional medical staff I have dealt with in years.  Also, the office is modern, extremely clean and well-kept.  After visiting the office once, anyone would know keeping Dr. Horne as your dentist is a No-Brainer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Ryan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very efficient, thorough, and knowledgeable. I was very nervous to switch dentists after 20 years with the same one. Fortunately Dr. Horne has made the transition easy. I have complete confidence in him and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Todd-Goynes
user_reviews_extended.Description: It took me 8 years to go back to a dentist, and I'm happy to have found this place! Everyone was welcoming, very open about what they would be doing and when (I like to know what to expect), and I had a flawless experience with my cleaning + follow-up to replace a few old fillings. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike
user_reviews_extended.Description: Although I am having to switch dentists due to how far I live from West Lake, I can't speak highly enough of Dr. Horne or his staff (my hygienist was Rebekah and she is great).  The office is impeccable, they have TVs that they'll put on any channel for you, and they're always as nice as can be.  The view from the chair is pretty great too as you can see the whole city from the elevated position.  If you're looking for a new dentist, definitely give them a chance to earn your business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judy Hotard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I feel so grateful to Dr. Horne for his competent consultation and his referral to the excellent endodontist, Dr. McGuire.  So relieved to have the help of these two professionals.  We also appreciated the courtesy and kindness shown to us by Dr. Horne's staff.  I would recommend Dr. Horne to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Hand
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Horne and his team are terrific. Best Dental office I have ever been to. Professional , Courteous and treat you like family.

I highly recommend Dr Horne too everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt DeLorenzo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne is fantastic!    His staff is amazing and extremely friendly.   Always on time and the office is a technology haven as Dr. Horne has the most recent advances in Dental equipment.   Plus Dr. Horne is an avid LSU fan so what’s not to like!   🐯.  Highly recommend if you live in the Westlake area...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tatiana Claros
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'll briefly preface this by saying I was in an accident where 3 of my front teeth were badly chipped. I visted 5 different cosmetic dentist in Austin and finally found Dr. Hornes office thanks to a recommendation from a dental hygienist friend of mine. Naturally, I had a ton of anxiety getting dental work done. But EVERYONE in this office is so nice and extremely helpful. I had my temporaries put in and I've gotten so many compliments on how great they look (better than my actual teeth). I can't wait to see how the permanent ones turn out! If you're looking for a general or cosmetic dentist that gives it to you straight and truly cares about their patients, Dr. Horne's is your best bet.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Prudhvi Bongarala
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Got my dental implants done by Matthew Horne in March 2015. Now that i'm writing review after 15 months, I would like to personally thank Dr. Matthew Horne for making it look like natural teeth, giving me that confidence to smile and  feeling no difference while eating.
I'm 100% satisfied with the work and I would highly recommend Dr. Matthew Horne.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Kirkhart
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Warm, friendly, professional office with timely appointments and well trained staff.
Dr. Horne is highly skilled and is always pleasant and approachable. I highly recommend this wonderful family dental practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob Yang
user_reviews_extended.Description: The friendliest folks you will ever meet.  I've always been apprehensive about going to the dentist, but not here.  Very welcoming, comfortable and accommodating...it feels like Dr. Horne and his staff came to your house to provide dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mikey James
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is the greatest dentists office ive ever been to in my life!
everyone is so nice and understanding. The care and attention is so thorough . Just really comfortable and they’re so gentle. Im never scared to go.  the lighting is great and it just feels calm in there. Hope i never have to go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paula “Paulina” Pacotti
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne was referred to us by our orthodontist. I made an appointment for my daughter. I erroneously put the wrong date in my calendar. When we showed up on the wrong day, they were able to squeeze her in. What great service! We will definitely be using them as our family dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bridget Wille
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I actually don’t mind going to the dentist and especially since I started going to Dr Horne’s office
He is the best dentist I have ever been to and I have been to many..
He’s quick, painless and good at what he does. He’s also conservative which I appreciate. If you can wait on a procedure he will tell you instead of pushing you to have work done.
The staff always remembers me and not just my name. They’re true professionals
In my opinion you can’t find a better dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harlan Conkey
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is extremely well managed and customer relations are a high priority.  Dr Horne is an excellent dentist that is sensitive to the needs of senior citizens. The office is well equipped with modern equipment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description: I literally just left my appointment with Dr. Horne and had to pull over so I could write this review bc I’m so insanely elated that I couldn’t wait. I chipped my front tooth pretty badly a while back and it’s been repaired a few times bc the filling would chip/fall back off- always horrifying, always embarrassing, and the work done before was mediocre. This man is an absolute ARTIST!!! He really took his time and you can tell he’s a perfectionist that wants his work done right. It’s been SO long since I’ve been able to smile and feel this confident. I could honestly cry. I’m so grateful for him and his lovely staff as this was also an emergency since I’m in a wedding today and was mortified at how my tooth looked. I now can’t stop smiling in my rear view mirror- unreal. Thank you thank you!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brent Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best Dentist and Dental Office that I've ever been to. Every visit has been fast, fun, and comfortable. The entire team goes out of their way to give you an enjoyable dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ginger Craddock - Executive Coach
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent customer service from the front office, the dental hygienists and Doctor Horne. A friend referred us to Dr. Horne 9 years ago when we moved to ATX. If you are looking for a consistent 5 star experience at the dentist, I recommend  Dr. Horne and his team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Quinn Thompson (Quinn @ Seladex)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a pleasure to visit Dr. Horne and his team.  Friendly and amazing service!   Also, if you're concerned about COVID exposure, don't be.  They've got a lot of procedures and protocols to keep you safe.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharmon Votteler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tonya did a great job of cleaning my teeth today.  And  Dr. Horne is an excellent dentist - I have great confidence in his work and have been very pleased with him as my dentist and his staff for many years as his patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ted Cordin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thanks to Dr. Horne and his entire staff for a helping me out. I am traveling in my Motorhome around the country and had a crown fall out. So being from Newport RI what do you do to find a Dentist I went on line and started reading about "all" the dentist in the area, well I made 1 phone call at( 8am) and the person at the other end asked me if I could be there in a couple of hours, wow what a relief. The Dr's team was great, and I also got some free tour information as to what to do in Austin.  Thanks again

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Sander
user_reviews_extended.Description: From beginning to end my visits to Dr. Horne’s office are simply great(even when needing a procedure done) Dr. Horne and every single member of the lovely staff are attentive, kind and efficient. I can’t recommended them more!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristel Hayes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne and his team offer the best dental experience in town! Even though dental problems are a pain--literally AND financially--the team at Matthew Horne DDS make things pleasant with their expert care. Love these folks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Coty Melvin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne and his staff are wonderful. Everyone was so kind and he and the hygienists were very thorough. It was a great experience for our whole family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Gordon MD
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this dental practice! Dr. Horne and my dental hygienist, Rebekah, are the best. Mia, the practice manager, is always very accommodating and helpful. I always have an great experience here!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Brantley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very pleasant and easy experience. Dr. Horne and his staff were extremely comforting and welcoming.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Matthew Horne for all of my dental work for I think about 15 years now and I have always been happy with the service performed by Matthew. I'm not too picky about a lot of things, but I hate having to go to the dentist enough that I am very picky with dental service, and I am very happy to have found this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Glenn Starnes
user_reviews_extended.Description: An old molar crown popped out of my mouth late one night. I was able to see the dentist first thing the following morning to have it re-attached. They did this on a day when the dentist generally does not see patients. I was very grateful they saw me so soon and took care of the problem in a matter of minutes. Great service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Boris S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne is a very skilled professional and surrounds himself with a wonderful team. My wife and I are both patients here and we appreciate the way we are treated. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie McDonald
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne and his staff are like family to me. They are so friendly, helpful, knowledgeable, and experienced. I know I’m in the best hands and trust them with my smile completely.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Sprio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this dentist office! Previously the dentist was always my most dreaded doctors visit but when I found Dr. Horne's office, it changed my opinion! They are always so professional and friendly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Tumadottir
user_reviews_extended.Description: As painless an experience as one could hope for from a visit to the dentist! Prompt, friendly staff, and what seemed like a very organized, well-run practice. We'll be back in 6 months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Gaudet
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to Dr. Horne when I moved to Austin almost 12 years ago. Dr. Horne, his staff, and their technology,  are second to none. I've referred several co-workers and their families, and everyone raves about their experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alana Logan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this office! They are ALWAYS on time, so pleasant, caring and understanding. I just love getting my teeth cleaned. Looking forward to my next appointment. Who says that?

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Desmond
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne and his team are great. Extremely friendly and professional staff that make it apparent they actually care about you as a customer. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Descoteaux
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing!!! I just moved here and am having issues with a tooth from a previous problem.  I called at 1 and they had me come in at 2:20.
Don't even consider going elsewhere....and I'm a new yorker. .. these people care and are the best of Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annabelle Perdido
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always, visiting Dr. Horne's office is a pleasure :)  The entire staff is wonderful!!  It's like visiting friends, not visiting a dentist office.  Too bad I have to wait 6 months before I visit again :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaime Sutton Wells
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic experience - very thorough and very kind. I appreciated the way they explained my x-rays, photographs and what they were doing step-by-step. It was a great recommendation by a friend and I would do the same!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rod Crosby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly, thorough, and knowledgeable!! The office is ran very well, and it is comfortable and clean. Glad I took my friend's advice and went to see Dr. Horne and staff!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Covert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Horne was extremely attentive to our needs. He takes him time explaining what is necessary and cares for each of his patients individually.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Edens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hadn't been to the dentist in 15yrs and I gotta say Dr. Horne and his staff were incredible! Will def be recommending him to all my friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ara Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a temp bridge redone, old one shattered.  Rachell replaced it and she is wonderful. She took a lot of time replacing an fitting.  it feels soo much better than the first one.  good feelings from my experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan Salter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I required a minor repair and the team got me in the same afternoon and did the repair quickly and easily.  I appreciate their friendliness and attention to detail. The Westlake office is my new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: fred gonce
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Horne and staff has provided a great work helping me improve my dental issues.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Euphemia Edoghotu
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the staff here. Dr.Horne is absolutely amazing and professional. Simply the best dentist I've had thus far!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gary Stenberg

user_reviews.Name: P L
user_reviews.Description: Love Westlake Dental! Cynthia and Lei are wonderful, not to mention Denise, Dr. Ronci, and Dr. Nguyen! I am not a huge fan of the dentist but they renewed my faith in comfortable cleanings and treatment. My husband and I have been patients for years and would not go anywhere else!

user_reviews.Name: Doug Keenan
user_reviews.Description:
Our family has been a customer of this dental practice since the early 90s, through three (3) ownerships.  We have always had great dental care here, and my most recent experience was not different.  The practice has always kept up with technology and equipment to improve the care, as I noticed with my latest care.
I experienced a chip from my #14, molar which had an old filling – so I needed a crown to repair it. I saw Dr. Kimberly Nguyen to proceed with her recommendation, having a temporary installed 1st, then the permanent porcelain one mounted on this past Monday (~3 weeks later during holiday time).  During the permanent install process, I experienced some high sensitivity to water and air.  But Dr. Nguyen and her assistant Rebecca were quick to remedy this with more anesthetic and finish.  The permanent crown feels great and has “0” sensitivity at all – feels great to bite and chew!
Thank you, Dr. Nguyen and Rebecca for your attention and help on this past Monday!  And let us not forget the front office staff, Lei and Christina, who helped me when I had the chipped molar occur.  They helped me navigating the very busy schedule of the practice during the holiday time.  Cheers!

user_reviews.Name: Homero Gonzalez
user_reviews.Description: I have been a patient for years. It’s a very friendly atmosphere. Lei and Cynthia are always very attentive. Joy is a very professional hygienist and makes me feel at ease. Dr. Ronci is very easy to talk to. He makes you feel like you’re part of his family. Wonderful staff!

user_reviews.Description: From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. Every single member of the staff—from the front desk to the hygienists—is genuinely friendly and kind. They consistently go above and beyond. The entire team delivers exceptional patient care. I've been a patient for years and  can't imagine going anywhere else!

user_reviews.Description: West Lake Hills is an EXCELLENT dental office.  They are friendly, professional, and very thorough in the care that they provide. On my last visit, Dr. Nguyen and Rebecca were very patient with me, helping to calm me during the procedure.  I strongly recommend this practice to anyone needing basic or extensive dental care.

I am so grateful for EVERYONE at West Lake Hills Dental! Thank you for taking me in with such short notice, especially being a foreigner from Canada.

I met Dr. Aldo Ronci briefly after my cleaning and immediately felt his care and attention for his staff and patients.

My whole experience at West Lake Hills Dental was nothing short of incredible. I usually have so much dental anxiety but left with none. I would highly recommend going here if you live in Austin or passing through.

Respectful, affordable
family friendly office for all!

Thank you sooooooo much!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I used to go to this dentist office before I moved to Dallas because I worked at the animal clinic across the road and it was very convenient. I would highly recommend this dental office to anyone in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

The team is so caring and attentive, and they truly go above and beyond to make sure you feel comfortable and at ease during your visit.

Dr. Ronci is super knowledgeable and takes the time to get to know his patients on a personal level. He truly cares about their well-being and makes sure to provide the best diagnosis possible. I have had multiple cleanings and even had a chipped tooth fixed, and every time I left the office feeling 100% satisfied.

I'm so grateful to have found such a wonderful dentist and team. I will continue to refer everyone I know their way. Thank you, Dr. Ronci and team, for your exceptional care!

I have been going to this dental location for over 20 yrs. and have seen several different dentists at this same location.  Dr. Ronci is absolutely the best there is.  His staff love him because of his kindness and generosity.  Lee and Cynthia at the front desk are the friendliest and most helpful women you will ever meet.  You leave there feeling like you have wonderful new friends.  I cannot recommend this dentist enough.  Give them a call.  You will love them as much as I do!

David & Nancy
Georgetown, Texas

user_reviews.Description: Great experience throughout. The entire team is very kind and competent. I’ve had a cleaning here as well as a crown treatment. Dr. Burns’ injection technique for the local anesthetic block was the gentlest I’ve experienced, and the procedure went so smoothly. No complaints!

user_reviews.Name: Marsha Necco
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely LOVE Westlake Family Dental!!  Wanted to elaborate on what a remarkable business this is.  Finding a great dentist was a major concern of mine when moving to the area.  Lucky for me, my coworkers recommended Westlake Family Dental.  I have been a patient for almost 3 years now and would not go anywhere else.  The staff is EXCELLENT, scheduling is super-easy, reminders are sent, appointments are always on time, office is clean, equipment is state of the art and Dr. Burns is fantastic!  I would not go anywhere else.

user_reviews.Name: Marsha Necco
user_reviews.Description: Recently moved to TX from MA, the thought of finding a new dentist was terrifying, I LOVED my dentist in MA.  Coworkers at my office recommended Westlake Family Dental and Dr. Burns, I cannot express how happy I am that I took their recommendation and made an appointment.  From the moment I contacted the office I knew I made the right choice.  The staff is beyond friendly and knowledgeable.  I was in need of a crown, and the staff was super easy to work with on scheduling, the appointments were on time, pain-free and I am super-happy with the results.  I would totally recommend this office to anyone in need of expert, friendly dental care!!

user_reviews.Name: Greg Zygmont
user_reviews.Description: What a wonderful experience.  Upon entering Westlake Family Dental, you are greeted by the front desk team who are mother and daughter!  Those two are friendly and helpful, (they give the clinic an excellent first impression.)  Dr. Burns did a great job cleaning my teeth and is also a skilled communicator.  If you don't like going to the dentist, go here and you'll look forward to it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry De La Rosa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Westlake Family Dentistry! Dr. Núñez and Dr. Villarreal are exceptional dentists, with the expertise and caring personalities that let patients know they are receiving the best treatment. From the moment you walk in the door, the friendly front desk staff greets you with smiling faces, and that continues with the wonderful dental assistants. My dental visits are always as pleasant as can be, and my expectations are always exceeded! I especially loved the rose and cookies I received after my appointment this week. Thank you, Westlake Family Dentistry!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheslyn Garland
user_reviews_extended.Description: So I have some dental trauma from my youth, and I have a lot of sensory issues. Because of that, I didn't go to the dentist for many years. The caring and compassionate staff made it feel easy to get back into the swing of regular cleanings. They never judged me, and were considerate in their treatment plan. The receptionists are the sweetest people and always greet me by name. The hygienists are incredible, and understanding. The doctor herself is beyond words. Grateful for this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyona (Ginger)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The best experience I had in Austin with dental services! The team is so welcoming and supportive, the office is clean, everything organized well, no wait time.
Sonia did very thorough work with my dental hygiene, shared some helpful dental care tips along the way, and overall went above and beyond to make sure I was happy with the results!
I recommend Westlake Family Dental to my friends now, and will be definitely back for any of my dental care needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marky Barajas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall grate experience, good on time. They explained everything to me the best way they could. Will be making Westlake my permanent dental place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Forras
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience throughout. The entire team is very kind and competent. I’ve had a cleaning here as well as a crown treatment. Dr. Burns’ injection technique for the local anesthetic block was the gentlest I’ve experienced, and the procedure went so smoothly. No complaints!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry Keller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns and her staff are always kind, caring, professional, super skilled, and fun to be around. They always take great care of me, and I have lost a lot of the fear I used to have about going to the dentist. I definitely recommend them if you are looking for a fabulous family dental practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Juarez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The front desk is so welcoming and helpful. My appointments start on time with barely any wait. The office is clean. The dental assistants are professional and good at taking care of my needs. Dr. Angela Burns is so kind and concerned about evaluating my health to the best of her ability. The equipment and software they have is good too.

Thank you guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dalisa Gorthey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. Burns for many years.  I went in to have a crown replaced.  I was so nervous but there was no need to be.  They treated me so well the minute I stepped into the office so my nervous subsided.  Every step of the way, Dr. Burns explained what was going to happen next in the procedure.  I won't be nervous if I have to go through this again.  I also get my teeth cleaned there along with my family and couldn't be happier.  They really care about their patients in so many ways.  They treat me like family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dalisa Gorthey
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family has been patients of Dr. Angela Burns for the past 6 years.  I get my teeth cleaned twice a year.   Shirley is friendly, professional and thorough.  She gives great tips for healthier gums and teeth.  I had a crown that fell off on a Friday night.  I called Dr. Burn's cell number, she answered and gave me advice on what to do.  She offered to meet me on Saturday to put a temporary crown on.  She is great!  Dr. Burns has completed at least 2 crowns on me.  She makes it as comfortable as possible.  She is a very caring, professional and knowledgeable.  The whole staff  wants to take care of all of their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connor Burkhart
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient of Westlake Family Dental for the last two years. They are the best! All receptionists, assistants, hygienists and dentists are so nice and welcoming on the phone and in person. I will continue going here as long as I'm in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Draker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so pleased I decided to move my nine and ten year old to Westlake Family Dental from their former pediatric dentist. Not only did they receive excellent care but both children commented so positively about their experience. Dr. Burns and her staff have been excellent with my own personal dental needs and couldn't be happier that now my family is in such great hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacque Barton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Burns and her staff are fabulous!  They have performed some much needed dental work on me in the last year and I couldn't be happier.  Her cosmetic talent and attention to detail will leave your teeth as perfect as they can be.   She and her team always greet you with a smile and want only your 100% satisfaction.  I can't thank her enough for giving me my beautiful smile back.  :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Thornton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred by my son, who has used this practice for years.  The staff are all wonderfully friendly people.  Shirley, the hygienist is great about explaining what's going on in your mouth as she cleans.  Dr. Burns is the same - she spends time and energy to describe the situation in detail.  I never had the feeling of being rushed through.  In fact, I arrived early and was taken right back to get x-rays.  They have all the latest technology, which makes procedures easier and quicker.  The only downside is that I do not have dental insurance, so I will have to finance the work that is needed; but that would be the case anywhere.  Everything considered, I would have to say that my intro to this office was one of the best dental experiences I've yet had!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katharine Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a wonderful dentist and staff! I recently had a dental emergency where I cracked a tooth and needed to be seen, but didn’t have childcare for my newborn baby. I was apprehensive about bringing the baby with me, but Dr. Burns was so accommodating that she was able to fix my tooth while the baby slept on me. It was a stressful situation for a new mom and Dr Burns showed so much kindness and empathy. I recommend Dr. Burns and her staff not only for exceptional skill and care, but also for the wonderful people that they are.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Levi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would like to say this has been a very good experience going to Westlake Famiy Dental given the circumstances, COVID-19.  First of all, the staff greets you at the door with their protective gear and they go through series of per-screenings to see if the client is fine to step in which include: temperature check, questions, blood pressure readings, use of hand sanitizers, and finally they clean very thoroughly each seat with a disinfectant wipe. Not to mention, the patients are advised to wait in the car until it is time for their appointment to reduce the number of people in the office. The staff go through a series of steps to secure safety. This confirmed that I was in a place that cares for the well-being of everyone in the office and they keep the customer's as their top priority. Amazing! Second, I underwent a cleaning and the staff was extra careful at working under clean conditions through all the process. They answered all my questions and the service they provided was excellent. Third, I would like to thank all of the staff who was there that morning, 8:00 a.m. as they were very attentive and courteous. Dr. Angela Dawn Burns communicated the next steps very clearly and which made me feel like she cares about each patient. Under difficult times we are living, I would recommend Westlake Family Dental to anyone who cares about safety first to set an appointment here. I will keep going here for my future dental procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Colette Zygmont
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience at Westlake Family Dental yesterday. I had a simple dental issue and one more complicated that I was super worried about.  Dr Burns fixed the simple issue in 20 minutes and assured me that my fears were unfounded and that my molar was okay.  I was impressed she didn't try to gouge me out of money to fix something that maybe wasn't necessary.
Her staff was lovely and accommodating start to finish.  I will go back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Fowler
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The appointment was on time--no waiting. As usual Shirley gave a very thorough cleaning--lasted nearly an hour. I receive the most thorough cleaning at Westlake Family Dental of any dentist I have ever been to. Dr. Burns came in and checked my teeth and recommended a crown. Very pleased with the treatment I received.
David Fowler

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherry Keller
user_reviews_extended.Description: The professionals at Westlake Family Dental have been taking care of my teeth for over a decade, and have consistently provided superb service. I am one of those people who is pretty scared of dental work, but I have never been uncomfortable or in pain when Dr. Burns or any of the staff has been working with me. Whether it's a cleaning or a crown, I trust them implicitly to do a quality, pain-free job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: dessenne karine
user_reviews_extended.Description: My 9 years old daughter was very scared to go to the dentist to cure a cavity. DR Burns and her assistant Misty were amazing. They both took their time to explain everything they were doing to reassure her. They were very kind and patient, very professionnel and efficient. My daughter left the office with a big smile and only wants to see Dr Burns in the future. I strongly recommend Westlake Family Dental, especially for your kiddos

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabrielle Gonsalvez
user_reviews_extended.Description: During my two recent visits to Westlake Family Dental for a routine cleaning and a new crown, I was treated with the utmost courtesy and care.  I highly recommend Dr Angela Burns and her team for their excellent service and professionalism.  I especially appreciated the follow up phone calls post procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Baltazar Camacho
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place, had my first visit yesterday. Dentist is GREAT. Staff is GREAT. As an example the dental assistant that met with me had been working there 15yrs at the same office.  In addition to knowing that i'm speaking to and being treated by someone with experience. This also shows that the dentist is treating assistants and staff really well. (Which means she'll treat you well!).  Rishonda at the front desk was super nice as well on the phone and in person and was why I came here over a few other places I called that had good reviews. Overall there's probably not a better dental office in Austin....granted this is my first visit . But this is my new dentist, super glad I found this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nabeel Siddiqui
user_reviews_extended.Description: This has been the most pleasant dental experience I have ever had! I was in the market for veneers and did a bunch of research on the matter. I consulted with many dentists in the area and decided to go with Dr. Burns and staff. I was very nervous about getting my veneers and didn't want to get stuck with an unnatural looking smile. Dr. Burns and misty took the time to explain my options and made me feel at ease throughout the process. I was shown a model of what my new teeth would look like and I was blown away! The entire process was relatively painless. I think I actually thanked Dr. Burns for giving me my numbing shots because I couldn't even feel them. They even worked their magic and expedited the process because I was having trouble with the temporaries. Within two weeks, I had a smile I could proudly show off and it all went as smoothly as anyone could hope for.  I would highly recommend Dr. Burn.

user_reviews_extended.Name: amanda risch
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for a tooth extraction at Westlake Family Dental, Carlos and Dr. Burns made the experience pain-free and comfortable for me. They definitely have a knack for chair-side manner. They even called me the next day to check on pain management of the extraction site. I would recommend this place to anyone needing dental care. The staff was nice and accommodating, the facility was clean. The prize box for the kiddos is spectacular too! All over 5 star experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nisha Uprety
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Burns did 2 of my fillings. There was one that was the last in my lower jaw. She did a great filling job and the pain is gone. She even said ‘There is no point putting a crown on it, if it hurts again—we should just pull it out’— this is how honest and professional she is. Any other dentist would crown it to make a ton of money on it first. I used to be with Dr. Mathew Horne and got tired of being over charged for every cleaning and anything in between!

I am so happy I switched, the hygienist takes her time to clean and measured my gum level on all the teeth to compare a year later. I feel very well taken care of and as a medical professional—they took the utmost precautions for patient and worker safety. They are punctual and thorough with kindness and friendliness. I should have switched years ago!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Webel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an awesome experience.  From the moment I walked in until the time I left.  Everyone was so nice and each person took time to explain the procedures and techniques.  Most people do not like going to the dentist but they make it bearable and easy.  I would highly recommend Westlake Family Dental and will be returning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Landreth
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns and the staff at Westlake Family Dental treat you like a human being. Whether it's dealing with an emergency tooth infection, or taking the steps to make sure that a crown perfectly matches the enamel of the surrounding teeth, you can tell that there's real compassion behind their work. They really care about their patients, and they're good at what they do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marytza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this dentist! The cleanliness is unmatched! The staff is friendly, knowledgeable and very professional. The Drs are amazing, sweet and talented they took my smile from 6 to a 10. I highly recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patti Amaya
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven’t had the best experiences with Dentist in Austin. They have made so many mistakes that it affected my appearance and has halted me from approaching another Dentist. I came in reluctantly but my referral said only good things. I appreciated how relaxed and how informed and honest Dr. Burns was. I have teeth that need to be pulled and replaced. I am meeting two more dentists to get other opinions but my gut tells me I will be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dani Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been considering getting veneers for a very long time & interviewed several dentists prior to meeting Dr. Burns. Upon meeting her- she was very knowledgeable & addressed all of my questions and concerns regarding the procedure. I was a bit skeptical due to the fact that she didn't have pictures she could provide me with on her past work- however she was able to show me her work in person as two of her employees had had their veneers done by her previously. I decided to move forward & get the procedure done with her- full disclosure I am a DIFFICULT patient. I have lots of questions that popped up through the two week course of getting them done & am a perfectionist & she was there every step of the way. She provided me with her personal cell to call if I had any issues over the weekend & went above & beyond when I had issues with my temporary veneers (which is normal). Her staff was always warm & welcoming & remember you by name. She has been FANTASTIC & the results have been amazing! I highly recommend her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Dautel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I never leave reviews on companies. Maybe once every few years, but this companies service is so outstanding I had to post something. See Below:

I can't give enough praise to the quality of service they provide here. One of my teeth began to hurt horribly a week before my wedding. They saw me immediately, and found out I need a root canal (they had warned me of this before but I hadn't gotten it done yet). They referred me to someone in the same complex to get the root canal work, and have helped me get my crown just perfect so I won't have any issues going forward. I couldn't believe how fast and affordable the whole process was.

If you want to go somewhere where they aren't trying to nickel and dime you and where they really care about their clients, I highly recommend coming here. They've earned a customer for life out of me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcus Roper
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the staff, hygienists, and dentist and this amazing place. 10/10 and the location and parking are great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Reeves
user_reviews_extended.Description: Westlake Family Dental is like family! After trying out new dentists closer to my new house, I came back because they always provide a fantastic and very knowledgeable experience. From serving as my second opinion and saving me hundreds of dollars, to comforting me during my procedure fears, I know I won’t be going anywhere else for dental care!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Stepan
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Westlake Family Dental is top notch but more importantly they really care about you as a client / patient.  They take my care very seriously and are very professional in all aspects including insurance processing.  I have been a patient since moving to Austin in 1992 and they will  continue to be my ONLY choice for dental care

user_reviews_extended.Name: Derek Rollins
user_reviews_extended.Description: We are huge fans of Westlake Family Dental.  Dr. Burns is the perfect combination of professional, competent, efficient, and friendly.  Everyone on her team is welcoming and great to work with.  Very highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Summer Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: My fiancé and I went after not going to the dentist in a few years. It was a wonderful experience. Very professional and relaxing environment. The staff is outstanding, friendly, and knowledgeable. Would 100% recommend to anyone in Austin. Very thankful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Seybold
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been disappointed by Westlake Family Dental! The staff is wonderful, Dr. Burns takes the time to talk with you and explain any potential procedures, and they are always flexible with my schedule. Could not sing their praises more!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adri
user_reviews_extended.Description: 1st time visit and I would definitely recommend, the staff were very helpful and informative, Maria especially was amazing and attentive, also got to meet both doctors, very friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: esther royal-priest
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Ksenia is a phenomenal provider! She treated me so well  and fixed my smile with her invisalign training!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Its always a great experience at Westlake dental. The whole staff is incredibly kind and makes you feel like family. Shirley is a wizard and always gets me out of the chair with clean teeth in less than an hour!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Graves
user_reviews_extended.Description: 4 words describe Westlake Family Dental...PHENOMENAL, KNOWLEDGABLE, HONEST, AND FABULOUS! This is definitely the BEST dentist in Austin and the Westlake area! The staff was so friendly and professional and completely honest about my dental goals. It's rare you find a dentist that has a staff that really CARES about you. By the time I left, I was laughing, smiling, wanting to take them all home with me, and looking forward to going back. Also, the inside was spotless and had a very nice ambiance (worthy of the Westlake badge lol). I also loved the technology they use to clean your teeth. I've been to the dentist in The Woodlands, and Austin and they are by far the best. JUST BOOK YOUR APPOINTMENT WITH THE BEST "Westlake Dental" in Austin! Ill be driving from Houston just to come back :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joan Scheider
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Burns is a fabulous dentist! Every person in her office does an
excellent job of making you feel comfortable and at ease.  I have
never looked forward to "going to the dentist" but now I do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Noah Webster
user_reviews_extended.Description: Westlake Family Dental continues to amaze! If you haven't been here yet then you are missing out. They are the most friendly and caring group of people you will ever meet. I cannot recommend them highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Harrington
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place was excellent. I am new to the Austin area and a woman I work with recommended her dentist, Dr. Angela Bruns. I was in some pain when I called to make an appointment and they were able to see me that day! Rishonda and Tra were very professional and friendly. The gentleman assisting Dr. Burns was attentive and explained what was happening making me feel comfortable. Everyone there was wonderful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cordelia Keith-Verfaillie
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here is top notch. They always remember my name and make going to the dentist such a pleasant experience. They work with you on payment plans as necessary and are super friendly and accommodating. Cannot recommend them enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Schellhase
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a BIG fan of Dr, Burns and her staff.  The staff has worked together for a long time and it shows with precise handoffs and efficient execution.  They make it as close to a spa experience you can have with drills and xrays.   In particular, Dr. Burns has a very gentle touch and attentive demeanor that makes it go smoothly.   I am confident saying this place rocks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Grotefeld
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns and her staff are great. My family and I are long term clients in her practice. Over the years Dr. Burns has provided routine as well as emergency dental services to our family. I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janice Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hate going to the dentist (but do). When I broke a tooth, Westlake Family Dental got me in right away and fixed it. I admit I was having slight panic attacks, but Dr Burns was so calm and patient with me, that the procedure went really well. I still hate having dental work done, but I love going to see Dr Burns and her wonderful staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Page Ormbrek
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you are looking for a quality & caring dental office, then this is the right place!  Dr Burns is the best dentist around and all of her staff provide the most compassionate care possible. Excellent service and at reasonable costs, too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Soooooo impressed in every way! My wife had fairly major work done and was cared for so well, and then my daughter and I had a check and a full clean, and even with limited modern equipment use due to COVID restrictions, they were the best cleans we've ever had! Such a lovely team too

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Germann
user_reviews_extended.Description: The BEST treatment from staff and Dr. Burns. They are so personable and made the whole experience so nice from the moment I walked in the door. They really treat you like family. So glad to have found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Enriquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist office I've ever been to. The friendliest staff on earth, Dr. Burns is great, and my dental hygienist Shirley is the best! Thanks Westlake Family Dental for always being such rockstars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Martell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ya'll are wonderful! Our daughter had a great time visiting for her 3 year check up. You all make us feel so welcome. She was so happy to get a new blue toothbrush and big girl lip gloss! She is still talking about how much fun it was. - Big Thanks! - The Martells

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charrid Stone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend Westlake Family Dental. The team here are wonderful and I’ve always had a great experience. Dr. Burns does incredible work (got a crown and getting another one soon).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Blackburn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Shirley has been my hygienist for years, love her!  Dr. Burns is fabulous.  Visits are on time, quick, and staff always friendly :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen Barnes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love my hygienist and Dr.Burns.  Very welcoming from the front desk to the chair.  My visits are always through and pleasant.  I moved to the hill country and I still return to Austin for my dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J-P Cauvin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Office is very well run,. Dr. Burns and her assistants are all very courteous and take extra care in explaining all aspects of procedures.  They are excellently skilled in what thy do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kris Curtis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love these people and office!!! Not only do they keep my pearly whites looking healthy and beautiful.  I get Love, Laughter and Friendships that have lasted over 15 yrs.  It is a family and I am so lucky I am part of it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sherri
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had a deep cleaning that I was dreading but it was so easy and comfortable.  best dental office ever!  every person is great and Dr. Burns really cares!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Hollaway
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Westlake Family Dental! Their honest about treatments needed, clearly communicate insurance coverage/costs before doing procedures, flexible with costs/budgeting, and truly care about the well-being of their customers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Glencora Stewart Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: They have the most caring staff.  They are kind, patient and knowledgeable.  They even took care of my kids while I was getting my teeth cleaned!  Would highly recommend them to all of my friends and family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juliedyx7879 Purcell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Burns is very thorough and personable! The entire staff make you feel comfortable and are very accommodating. I would highly recommend Westlake Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Tudon
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I always have a pleasant experience here at Westlake Family Dentistry! The staff is very friendly and the doctors are amazing! I highly recommend this dental center for anyone looking for a good dental place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jj Good
user_reviews_extended.Description: They would not charge me the agreed fees as a network provider, even though i had a conference call with my insurance clerk and they were proven wrong, agreed with the fees on in the conference call, but my bill kept coming in the mail 2x - 3x higher. After 5 consultations with the insurance over a year, i have yet to see a correct bill. Also they tried to get me to fill 3 cavities which weren't there, as evidence by another dentist .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathan Heinsohn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the care and service my family gets at Westlake Family Dental!  They are top notch.  Do yourself a favor and book your next appointment with Dr. Burns and the wonderful hygienists at WFD.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeanne Chauvin
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dentist office for over 20 years! Consistent customer service, you actually get seen at your appt time! Knowledgeable about insurance and willing to help you make the best decision. Love this office!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marty Hand
user_reviews_extended.Description: If there is a more professional, friendly, and caring dental office anywhere in the world I need to see it to believe it. The team at Westlake Family Dental makes me feel like family. They actually give a damn about me as a person.

user_reviews.Name: Syed Zaidi
user_reviews.Description:
One of my teeth was shaking and it hurt when pressed. I could not chew food with that tooth getting in the way. I called Westlake Hills Dentistry.They were able to get me in for treatment quite soon which was very nice. Dr Ho examined my teeth and he extracted the problem tooth. Then he prepared two spots for implants and put the screws in. So in about 3 months I will have two completed implants.
They have all the modern equipment, the supporting staff is very pleasant and efficient. Dr Ho is certainly very skilled and experienced.

user_reviews.Name: Jaime Arteaga
user_reviews.Description: Recently move to Texas was looking for a new dentistry. This was my first visit I ended up with a bacterial infection. For a whole week I had soreness in my gum and tooth pain. Made a new appointment with another dentistry to find out the pain and swelling was from a bacterial infection. Kind staff but very concerned and not ideal at all!

user_reviews.Name: Mark Bernhardt
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been coming to Dr. Ho since forever. He is compassionate, attentive, candid, and intelligent. A good dentist to go to if you are looking for a dentist with a high baseline of care.

user_reviews.Name: Jason Ott
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Ho and his staff are the absolute best.  They are extremely knowledgeable and Dr. Ho is by far the best dentist I have ever had.  Five stars all day.

user_reviews.Name: Kay Perez
user_reviews.Description: Westlake Hills Dentistry is just amazing. Dr. Ho is knowledgeable and experienced. The staff is friendly and always happy to work with customers. The clinic has the latest equipment. I had an emergency a couple of months ago and Diane was able to scheduled me immediately. They care about their patients, and will go above and beyond for them.

user_reviews.Name: Dorianne Ortega
user_reviews.Description: If you’re looking for an implant dentist you don’t need to look any further. You have found the right place right here. Allow me to share my experience with Dr.Ho and his assistant Debbie. I came in to Dr.Ho’s office about a month ago, scared and concerned because one of my upper front teeth broke off at the gum line and could not be saved, I am a dental assistant myself so it is important that I look good and don’t have a missing front tooth. I know A LOT of dentist because I myself am in the field of dentistry. I tried finding a local dentist that could possibly do an implant for me and they all told me I would have to wear a “flipper” which is a removable appliance, so basically when I eat I’d have to remove the flipper and basically have a missing tooth while I’m eating. I became immediately defeated because if I’m out eating at a restaurant how embarrassing would it be to take a tooth out just so I can eat?! So I found Dr.Ho’s office (which is 1.5 hours away from where I live) and he told me he could use the crown I currently have, make that into a temporary, extract the tooth and place the implant all in the same visit. I’ve never in my 8 years of experience in the dental field, heard of a dentist being able to do that! Basically Dr. Ho told me he could do something that is very DIFFICULT and almost nearly impossible to do. Fast forward 3 weeks later to the day of my surgery , it was the easiest oral surgeries I’ve ever had and on top of that he did it QUICKLY and absolutely beautifully. I was even laughing with them during the procedure haha. He made it look like absolutely nothing happened. 3 days later post op surgery I’m feeling great! No pain , no sutures. His assistant Debbie was so knowledgeable and so gentle. When she was assisting it didn’t even feel like I was drowning in water. I would have drove 8 hours to see Dr.Ho if I had to. That’s how much he’s worth it, it was absolutely worth every penny, every mile driven and I am back to feeling happier and more confident than I ever have. Thank you so much Westlake Dentistry for taking care of me! Keep in mind every case is different depending on bone levels but for me I have been blessed to be able to smile with confidence once again! Thank you Dr. Ho for making the impossible, POSSIBLE.

user_reviews.Name: Mark G (ATX_MarkG_22)
user_reviews.Description: I can’t recommend this practice more. Everyone is so friendly and professional. The office is gorgeous with the latest technology and comforts. Dr. Ho and his assistants are fantastic. It is apparent that they love what they do when they passionately take the time to explain every detail about the patient’s dental health and in my case, a crown procedure. Lastly, I appreciate how they were compassionate about my situation of being recently laid off and advised only the most important work to be done for now (the crown). Again, i can’t recommend higher - by far  the best dentist I’ve ever had in my life and I am in my fifties. Thank you Westlake Dental.

user_reviews.Description: Lucked out today!  Had a toothache gradually getting worse hoping I could wait until my next scheduled cleaning to get it addressed.  Luckily for me, Diane was able to get me in due to a cancellation.  Dr. Ho and his staff are exceptional and provide stellar service.  Good standard practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Drianna Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dentist is a hack! He decided I had eight cavities which many other dentist would have said it was just staining. I’ve been going to the dentist as consistently my whole life. He then drilled in between my molars and I now have consistent pain. I’ve gone back multiple times to get it fixed— no resolve. forever  In pain when I floss now. Every time I come in, he tries to get me to get veneers and checks to see if my tooth “is dead.” I have a composite bond! It is stained, but he hasn’t offered any solution besides hacking away at my healthy tooth and giving me veneers. How can a good dentist, not realize it’s a composite bond and not a dead tooth? It’s really rude. He also tries to get everyone to get Invisalign, which I don’t need. I finally had to shut him down—  just condescending.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Pitre
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an incredibly disappointing and frankly alarming experience at this office. I went in for a simple cleaning in late January and was suddenly told I had 6 to 8 cavities—a claim I knew was completely false, as I’m meticulous about my dental hygiene and have never had issues like this before.

Like other reviewers have said, Dr. Ho might seem friendly on the surface, but his professionalism is deeply lacking. In just two days, he rushed through X-rays, a cleaning, and then supposedly filled 6 to 8 cavities—to this day, no one in the office, including the front desk staff (Diane), can tell me whether it was 6 or 8. That alone should raise major red flags.

What really pushed things over the edge was how aggressively both Dr. Ho and Diane tried to push Botox for TMJ—on the same day as the cavity work. I’ve lived in New York, Connecticut, and Massachusetts, and I have never encountered a dentist so forceful in upselling unnecessary procedures in such a short amount of time.

I refused the Botox and immediately started searching for a new dentist. When I left, I felt nothing but regret and frustration. Even worse, my mouth vibrated with discomfort for 2–3 weeks after the fillings, and I continue to experience pain in my molars, suggesting something was done improperly.

My advice: Avoid Dr. Ho. At the very least, do not proceed without getting a second opinion. Based on my experience, it seems like he’s more focused on maxing out your dental insurance than actually helping you. This place left me feeling completely taken advantage of.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patti Kelly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Incredibly impressed by and grateful to Dr Ho and his team for their fantastic care. I was a brand new patient who needed an urgent procedure and they got me right in — not just for an exam to assess what I needed, but were able to complete a crown for a tooth that was on the brink of needing a root canal. Everyone was very friendly, knowledgeable and transparent throughout the process. Truly grateful to the whole team. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Fredell
user_reviews_extended.Description: My whole family has been seeing Dr Ho for the past few years and everyone - from 10 years old to my 86 year old mom - loves him and his staff. The office is conveniently located and has hours that are easy to work with. We’ve had everything from routine exams to crowns to Invisalign to emergency chipped teeth, and everything is always competently and compassionately cared for! We’ve had so many dentists since we moved to Austin years ago and Dr Ho is the best one by far!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I could not recommend the team at Westlake Hills enough! Every person I interact with during visits makes the appointment that much better. Diane is so kind and makes sure you are completely set for your appointments so there are no surprises!

While going to the dentist is never something I have enjoyed, I never dreaded coming here. Cleanings, fillings, crowns - I've been able to have everything serviced here without the anxiety I normally have going to the dentist. Dr. Vincent Ho is great at what he does and takes the time to get to know you. You won't feel like just another patient here, you'll feel like a welcome member of their family.

Even going in for an appointment during peak-COVID, they were really diligent with their cleaning procedures. I never felt unsafe or worried. If you are looking for a dentist that will make you feel welcome right out the gate, this is the team for you.
