user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sakos is a great dentist and good friend. Only thing better is his team of welcoming staff and assistants😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: eddie n austin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent dentistry is something of great value to me as a patient with some dental issues that had to get worked out through the years in my lifetime.  I found the friendliness and communication and work performed to be outstanding. It’s a great combination when you get all 3. I feel very confident in recommending to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie M
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was one of the best experiences I have ever had at the dentist.  The staff is unbelievably warm and accommodating - they make you feel right at home.  They make sure you are seen timely and are flexible if you need to make a last minute appointment.  Dr. Sakos is extremely professional and personable.  He makes you feel like you are his only patient and never rushes you.  Will never go anywhere but here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mimi Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: My son came in for emergency chip tooth repair while traveling in Austin area.  The staff was extremely friendly and efficient.  We needed to see a dentist ASAP and Dr. Ho was willing to accommodate us.  Their facilities was very modern with state of art equipments and clean.  Most importantly Dr. Ho was able to put my 12 year old child at ease.  He has the BEST bedside manners of any dentist I've ever met.  Moreover his work was excellent - I couldn't tell where his front tooth was chipped after the repair.  Billing process was also excellent as the office staff checked and told me my co-pay before work was initiated - it was very reasonable.  (They are one of few dental offices in this area that take Dental insurance.) Since it was an emergency - at least my son thought so - I would have happily paid twice as much.  In the past whenever we visited Urgent Care or out of state healthcare we usually paid more than at home, but Dr. Ho seem to sincerely care about his patients and it cost less because he gave us first time patient discount even though he knew we didn't live there and wouldn't likely come back.  I only wish his practice was in my hometown.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chase Clear
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ho and the team are incredible! I’ve had several different dentists in Austin over the last 30+ years, but this team always makes me feel comfortable and talks me through everything (I’ve had a fair amount of work). They also use cutting-edge technology and are very progressive which I appreciate. My family will go here as long as we are in Austin!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosalyn Rosen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wendy, the dental hygienist, was amazing! Doctor Ho is always great! And so is Diane at the front desk. They are all amazingly gifted at what they do and are very kind people.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Francesca Lockhart
user_reviews_extended.Description: Stop your research and book an appointment at Westlake Hills Dentistry with Dr. Ho. He and his staff are so passionate and attentive to each of their patients. Dr. Ho always provides well-researched advice and takes extra time to ensure that you are comfortable and confident in your treatment plan. Over the course of over a year and a half of dental work, Dr. Ho always went above and beyond to walk me through my x-rays, explain the latest dental tools and research, and communicate in a timely manner with my orthodontist to ensure they were on the same page and I could get the most out of my insurance benefits. The rest of the staff—Diane, Debbie, and Wendy—are just as amazing, kind, and competent. I will never go to refer anyone anywhere else than Westlake Hills Dentistry. So glad I chose them for my many dental procedures!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Johnston
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have close family who are dentists, but they are too far away to consistently handle my care. Dr Vincent Ho and his staff are (mostly) new to me; I was a long time patient of Dr Sakos, who sold his practice to Dr Ho.  I needed 2 crowns and an extraction, and have had 2 followups. All handled with great care. I am pleased with this new relationship and recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I’ve ever experienced. Dr Ho is very knowledgeable, my hygienist is Wendy and she’s amazingly thorough but quick, and the entire staff is incredibly nice and fun (for a Dentist anyway). user_reviews_extended.Name: Constance West

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Howard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for a new patient appointment and had the best experience. user_reviews_extended.Name: Annabelle Lamy
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff is very welcoming and helpful! They helped me determine my coverage eligibility from the get-go. user_reviews_extended.Name: Traci Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love Dr. Sakos and all of the employees! I really do feel that i am a part of their family. I should know...i have spent a lot of time with them. I went to their office highly recommended by a friend. My previous dentist was asleep at the wheel and i needed a lot of dental work. They were very compassionate with me. They  were very up front about the cost.
I could go on and on about how great they are but i'm hoping that everyone gets the pic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Dean
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing front office, hygienist, and dentist. I have some anxiety and they always bring the calm and the peace. My teeth feel sparkling clean after a visit and the four cavities I have had drilled & filled settled nicely. Thank you to the whole team!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: CeCe Khor
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would recommend my dentist to everyone. Everyone here is very nice, organized, friendly and efficient. The office is well kept and clean. Did I mention that they hand you the remote, headset and place you in front of your own personal TV above you as you get cleaned? user_reviews_extended.Name: Brett Close
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Sakos and his staff are absolutely exceptional.  I am 51 years old and they offer the best dental care experience I have ever encountered.  I use them for standard and cosmetic dentistry, and I cannot recommend them enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Burns
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don’t ever write reviews but I felt it necessary for this. First of all, the cleaning is always very painful. I thought after a few years of consistent cleanings, it might get better but it did not. I know it’s supposed to be uncomfortable but I’m talking eyes watering, need to premeditate myself painful.
Additionally, they always come up with something new every time I go in. For example, they tried to convince me that I needed to laser my frenulum? When I saw a different dentist, he told me this was completely unnecessary and would be a painful healing process. But what really got me, is that I work night shift as a travel nurse and had an appointment scheduled for Monday. The receptionist cancelled my appointment on the Friday before my cleaning because I hadn’t confirmed yet. I called to confirm before they closed on Friday and she told me they had already given my appointment time away. She scolded me for not confirming the appointment yet and told me she texted me multiple times. I only received a text that my appointment was cancelled. I did receive two calls from her, but I was sleeping. I have discussed with them before that I am a night shift nurse and unable to take calls during the day but apparently they are so busy they can’t hold my scheduled appointment time. I have never missed an appointment or given them any reason to cancel my appointment. I gave this place one too many second chances and I will not be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: P Lafuente
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very pleasant and competent staff. Dr. Sakos was very friendly and recommended work that needed to be done immediately as well as pointing out what to keep an eye on. Unlike some dentists, I feel Dr. Sakos did not attempt to "sell me" anything unlike other dentistry outfits currently out there. The work he did seems excellent!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Bonner
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dentist our family has been to. The entire experience from Diana at reception to the knowledge of Dr Ho and technology of the equipment he used to find the cause of pain I have had for 10 years that no other dentist was able to find the cause of it. I would highly recommend Westlake Hills Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Ribb
user_reviews_extended.Description: Diane, Wendy and Dr. Ho are all a very welcoming and efficient team. I am happy I discovered Westlake Dentistry and feel encouraged to hopefully “not” have to come back more than once a year. Thank you to the great team there!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Carter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ho and his team are amazing.  This is the most positive experience I have had at any healthcare provider.  The whole team cares about doing what is best for you and your teeth!  Can't say enough good things about these folks.  I would highly recommend them to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlin Owen
user_reviews_extended.Description: LITERALLY the best care in the medical profession - Dr Ho is amazing and made my mouth surgery not a burden but absolutely painless. I highly recommend Westlake Hills Dentistry no matter what part of Austin you live in - make the drive, it is well worth it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Albrecht
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Ho is very thorough when doing his examinations. He pointed out areas where I may need a filling in a few years and how to better take care of my teeth. He is very conversational and really cares about his patients. Plus, he has a brand new state-of-the-art 3D x-ray machine and personally sits down with every patient and explains everything that he sees in the x-ray image (including some interesting things that don't necessarily relate to dentistry, such as clogged sinuses and constricted airways).

You will be in great hands when you go to Westlake Hills Dentistry

It was a simple re-cementing, I was in and out in under 30 minutes, so the additional fee is ridiculous and scammy since it wasn't mentioned or needed. I was also charged $45 for a film I did not receive. They did refund that charge after I called. Do not recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Floyd Crawford

user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Westlake Hills Cosmetic Dentistry makes going to the dentist easier. Their professionalism and calm work environment allows someone like me to relax and get the work done. I've been going to WHCD for three years and I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Downey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Sakos has been our family dentist for nearly 20 years.  The results of my visit for a bridge last week are an example of why I have such high confidence in his, and his staff’s, results.  In one appointment, I was measured for the bridge, waited for the bridge to be designed and manufactured in the office, and left with a bridge that was indistinguishable from my adjoining teeth.  One part of the process that nearly floored me was when he brought out a very tiny paint brush and added color to resemble natural shadows that appear between teeth, and duplicated a natural, slight variation in color from my teeth top to the bottom.  Afterward, my husband could not tell the difference between the bridge and my natural teeth, and had to ask whether the bridge was on the top or bottom.  It is the consistent, excellent work of Dr. Sakos and his entire staff that has made me a loyal patient for so many years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My wife and I have Guardian and we have been coming here since 2024. We previously had few dental offices that overcharged us on everything and focused too much upselling than the actual care. And then we found Westlake Hills Dentistry. I highly recommend you compare treatment plan with different offices to see how they charge you for the same procedure.

We have had other dentists quoting us ridiculous amounts for basic fillings. A few dental offices slap on mandatory add-ons like isov $10 and desensitizers $30 for each usage and operation,  which aren’t covered by insurance. And some even started pushing protection plans on their own fillings 😂. But Dr. Ho keeps it straight and just charges you for the operations. Everything else is just overhead. He gives you a bite block and some sedation and he’s ready to go. He’s also trained at UCSF 👀. I haven’t had to redo any fillings he’s done but I can’t say the same for previous dentists.

I also had all four wisdom teeth extracted here and Dr. Ho charged me half of what other dental offices quoted me for. He has a 3D X-ray that was included in my first visit and that was all he needed to operate on my teeth while other offices were going to charge me $210 for a CT scan. Others also were quoting $250 just for sedation. Though I’m at the age of peak bone density, Dr. Ho and Debbie did a great job extracting and stitching me up! I had almost no swelling with the wound dressing he performed after each extraction. In two days, I was playing sports again 🙃.

My wife had a tooth that was bothering her for a while. One office said she needed a root canal, one office said she needed a crown, and one said she needed a filling. None of these treatments would have been covered by insurance as they were preventative. And Dr. Ho said it looked fine in the imagery but just sensitive from grinding so she got Invisalign and that tooth has been fine since then. He saved us thousands from a tooth that just needed some love 🤭.

My dental hygienist Wendy is amazing and does a great job with cleaning each time. No pain at all and easy to talk to. And Dr. Ho checks on the cleaning as well.

Lastly, Diane, the office manager, is the champ and a gem. She is a sweet and kind lady who answers your calls, messages/emails you back, keeps the numbers straight for all the treatment plans, and deals with insurances and billing. She basically handles all the crap with the most grace! I’ve never received additional charges after I paid in this office unlike some other offices where I would get another $150 for no reason.

This is the kind of dental office we trust completely and we would confidently bring our future kids here 👶🏻

title: Westlake Pediatric Dentistry: Kyle Raymond DDS
address: 5656 Bee Caves Rd Suite B104, Austin, TX 78746, United States

owner.name: Westlake Pediatric Dentistry: Kyle Raymond DDS (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Jenny Benbrook
user_reviews.Description: We are new patients with Dr Raymond and couldn't be any more pleased with our experience. The front desk was pleasant and provided ease and flexibility with scheduling, and the Dr was timely on each visit. Dr Raymond is energetic and sends out such a good vibe to the kids and parents alike. He is thorough in his exams and explanations and made me feel comfortable with the work that needed to be done on my son. We had a filling, crown, and tooth extraction on a 6 year old and were in and out in 25 minutes. My son was happy and playing less than an hour later. Thank you Dr Raymond!

user_reviews.Name: Jessica Rodriguez Reyes
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Raymond is amazing!!! His office and practice as a whole have been absolutely perfection, since day one! My daughter is now 5 and has only seen Dr. Raymond and every visit is seamless. The office always runs on time, so we are in and out and the service is excellent! Every employee is so helpful, professional, and polite! We recently had a dental emergency and Dr. Raymond was available to help calm us at 10 p.m. and got us in for a visit first thing the next day! Seriously, the best in town folks!!!

user_reviews.Name: Bahia Amawi
user_reviews.Description:
Dr. Raymond and all of staff are amazing. They are accommodating, prompt, and caring. My kids aren’t just a patient, but they take their time to make the kids feel comfortable and explain information well.
My kids actually enjoy visiting the dentist. We have been with Dr. Raymond for almost 9 years and despite the fact he is 40 minutes from our house, we wouldn’t change him because he is worth the drive,

user_reviews.Name: Sally Vardys
user_reviews.Description: We love Dr. Raymond and his staff! The office is run very efficiently and we’ve never had to wait for our appointments, my girls get called back to the exam rooms right away. Dr. Raymond has a wonderful rapport with kids, making them feel at ease and comfortable. My youngest was deathly afraid of dentists, but after seeing Dr. Raymond she now looks forward to her appointments. My oldest had to get a tooth pulled and Dr. Raymond is so good, the tooth was out before my daughter even realized he had started his work! I can highly recommend Westlake Pediatric Dentistry. We moved about 30 minutes away from their office but never even considered finding a dentist closer to us. It is more than worth it to make the drive to stay with Dr. Raymond and his staff.

user_reviews.Name: Hope Lenaburg
user_reviews.Description: I have been bringing my kids to Dr Raymond since my oldest was a toddler, almost 10 years now! My kids LOVE the whole experience, and constantly ask when their next appointment is. I appreciate that Dr Raymond spends a few minutes with each child after they've had their teeth cleaned, asking if we have any concerns. Dr Raymond is very relatable, and shares solutions to issues based on his professional knowledge, and his experience as a parent. With the few dental problems my 5 kids have had, I've always felt that Dr Raymond has given very clear information to help me understand and decide what to do. I would give 10 stars if I could!

user_reviews.Name: Lisa Dyer
user_reviews.Description: I took my 11 and 6 year old kids to Dr. Raymond yesterday.  I was very pleased with the entire experience! The dentist and staff were all very friendly and professional.  The office was very nice and clean. My children were well cared for and also very comfortable and happy to be there. It is a super relaxed environment and very kid friendly! I would recommend to everyone.

user_reviews.Name: Susan Thompson
user_reviews.Description: We love going to see Dr Raymond and his staff. They are always on time and the appt is always quick. Nice location, fun games if you arrive early and Dr Raymond is great with kids!  We're still young, but the level of care is apparent. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Gwen Gonzales
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Raymond is amazing with kids, his whole staff is! They love what they do and it shows, they have taken great care in creating a welcoming environment that kids look forward to going to. We have never had a problem with getting the kids to sit through any needed treatments....they trust him because he is so gentle and patient. He's just amazing...even had my oldest son ask for a shot one time because he thought it was funny to have "bubbles" in his mouth (he had no clue he had been given a shot the previous visit)! I would not hesitate to recommend him to any parent in search of a wonderful pediatric dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is always super clean and has plenty of stuff to keep the kids and siblings busy while they wait (which is never very long!).  It is always easy to get an appointment quickly.  Dr Raymond and all the assistants and hygienists are amazing with the kids.  This is the only place that can get an X-ray on my kiddo without gagging and tears, and Dr Raymond makes necessary procedures lighting-fast while interacting with the child in an empathetic and soothing way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Cobbs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience with Dr. Raymond and his staff. Dr. Raymond is very friendly, explains things well and is quick and thorough (which is much needed when you are treating children). After my daughter went through a not so great experience with another dentist, Dr. Raymond was a breath of fresh air. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond is super friendly, great with kids, and his office could not be more efficient. My two kids are always in and out in under and hour (usually more like 30 minutes!) and everything is clean and inviting. My kids LOVE going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Toccara McNeely
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Dr. Raymond!! He started with my youngest when she was around 3 and has been her dentist, and now her sister's, since.  He is very knowledgeable and has a great way with the kids!  His staff is the best!  They are friendly and helpful all the time!  I have never had a problem in the decade we have been seeing him and we go on schedule!!!  They have never felt scared about going to the dentist because he makes it so easy and fun for them.  The best thing is that he takes Medicaid!!! That is how we found him!! A friend on Medicaid recommended him!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chrissy Stiefel
user_reviews_extended.Description: My children love to go to Dr Raymond, I had two bad experiences with my oldest child at different pediatric dentists.  Then, we discovered Dr. Raymond and have always been comfortable and happy during check ups and procedures. We live two hours away and the travel is worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellen A
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been seeing Dr. Raymond for 10 yrs now.  My kids love going to the dentist!  This is even after they have both had to have fillings and one had to have two teeth pulled in order prepare her for braces, (the orthodontist recommended that Dr. Raymond do this).  The entire staff is always very friendly, they run on time and he is great with children.  We have been very happy here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krista Jack
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Raymond and everyone at the office is wonderful, professional and helpful. My son has ADHD and is on the spectrum and so I shopped around for a good dentist. Their office is well-suited to kids, keeping them relaxed and entertained. Dr Raymond is excellent and takes the time to answer all my questions. He got back to me about a specific concern I had and did a thorough job researching my request. I highly recommend him and his office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: This whole office staff is AMAZING, I've been taking my children here for over 12 years now and I LOVE Dr. Raymond because my children LOVE him and get excited when it's time to go in for their check-up! He is amazing with kids, my youngest was VERY reluctant to let anyone even look in his mouth the first time he visited their office. Dr. Raymond told me it was fine and not to worry, that he could handle everything....and he did. He took the time to sit and talk to him and they got in to this whole conversation about Dora The Explorer. By the end of their conversation my son had no fears at all, they were old buddies as far as he was concerned, Dr. Raymond was able to check and then clean his teeth with no issues and we haven't had a single issue since. I highly recommend their office to anyone looking for a great pediatric dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elisa Jaramillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond is a great Dentist! His staff are amazing, friendly and quick. The office is very fit for children to play video games while they wait and watch movies anywhere and even when they go to a private room to get worked on. I recommend Dr. Raymond and his staff anytime, great experience every time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raya S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our 8 years old child has been a patient of Dr. Raymond for over 2 years and our 16 months old child recently became his patient too. Dr. Raymond is amazing! He explains everything in details and he is doing an outstanding job. We are so happy that we found his office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clarissa Ruiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: All three of my kids have gone here over the span of 18 years. Dr. Raymond makes you feel comfortable and answers all your questions. His office staff is friendly as well. The kids have always felt at ease when they were having their teeth worked on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Landry
user_reviews_extended.Description: They accept multiple insurances.  All staff has been very very nice.  Dr. Raymond has handled both of my kids cases conservatively.  Meaning a lower out if pocket cost for me, less stress on my kids, and a better overall visit experience for the kids.  The office is an open space which was different to me but the kids like it I guess.  There are private rooms for more detailed exams, procedures, fussy kids.  Games, toys, are available for all ages.  My 11 girl and 7 year old boy definitely do not mind going to see everyone at the office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Caglarcan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond is absolutely the best dentist I have ever seen. His kind and gentle bedside manner with kids and all his cute sayings that he has for his procedures as he performs dentistry enables children to be at ease but he also informs them of what he is doing as he navigates throughout the visit. He was finished with two cavities and sealing some back teeth in 15-20 minutes. It was unbelievable. He is a master of his trade and one of a kind. His staff are also a well-oiled machine that undoubtedly have the same passion he does. My daughter could not wait to go get her cavities filled after her 1st visit several weeks prior due to the rapport and good experience she had during the 1st visit. Their goal is to provide children with positive experiences at the dentist and my child has now overcome her fear of going to the dentist because of Dr. Raymond and his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Aaron
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have always had great experiences at Dr. Raymond’s office.  They are always running on time, the staff is friendly, and he always explains things thoroughly to us.  My daughter used to dread going to the dentist, But since we’ve been seeing Dr. Raymond she now loves going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Gabryluk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful hygienists and Dr. Raymond is awesome. He is always very thorough and explains everything. Everyone is always in an upbeat and happy mood. My kids love going there to play Xbox. They have TVs all over w good kid friendly movies always playing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love love love them!!!! Everyone is people and kid friendly! They are always clean and on top of their stuff! I would recommend them to anyone. They are the BEST!!!! They think of the kids. Also Dr.Kyle Raymond is awesome about explaining everything and making us parents and the children feel at ease. I love them and can’t wait to see them again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Trivitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond is a fantastic dentist and relates so well to children. My girls are excited to go to the dentist to get their teeth polished "like diamonds" and  pick a toy from the treasure chest. Appointments are always on time and the staff is warm and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Duffy-Dzubinski
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been patients for about 2 years and love this place. Dr. Raymond is great with the kids and very thorough. He takes time with his patients and explains everything to the parents without seeming rushed. We drive across town to go here and it's totally worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jodi Egerton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always impressed with the care my kids get at Dr. Raymond's office. Really detailed and thorough cleaning, swift attention to any issues, and amazing care. Everyone on the staff is kind and friendly, and make the whole experience really great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara McElroy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our second dental appointment ever (for my 2.5 year old) was yesterday and let me tell you, my son did not want to leave the dentist’s office when his appointment was done! We literally stayed at the office for a little while after our appointment was over at my little man’s request😆. There are toys in the waiting room for entertainment, and after each appointment the child gets to chose a little prize toy from a box in the corner. The hygienist and doctor were able to look in my son’s mouth more than he lets me do it. Dr.Raymond was so kind and of a perfect demeanor to interact calmly and confidently with children. I don’t often write reviews, but I would recommend this office to everyone with two thumbs up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krissy Hastings
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Love Love!!! This place. I've been bringing my kids here for about 11 years now and I would highly recommend. The ENTIRE STAFF are so awesome and if your kid or kids are scared of getting their teeth cleaned, they won't be after visiting Kyle Raymond and his staff. They also have orthodontic services available, you just have to ask about it whenever you visit. Overall great experience every time and excellent service!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Nuckolls
user_reviews_extended.Description: We’ve been seeing Dr. Raymond for over a decade with our kids. What I appreciate is that he is generous with his time, and answers all questions. He always explains the difference in what is actually really needed, vs what could possibly be done (cosmetically) if desired. He’s a thorough but practical dentist - just what you want for your kids.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Winter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond is great my kids. They actually like to go. I appreciate that I never feel rushed when I ask a questions about their care. The staff is also pleasant and helpful. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Slaughter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Raymond is very personable and explains his treatment plans with both the parents and kids. I appreciate the options he presents and clear explainations. After two bad experiences elsewhere, we plan on continuing to drive an hour and 45 minutes to a dentist we can trust!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tenea Harvey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been taking my children to Dr. Raymond for over 12 years. He and his staff are awesome! He is conservative in initiating treatments and thorough when treatment is needed. I can't say enough great things about Dr. Raymond and his staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taryn Wilmes
user_reviews_extended.Description: My kids and I love Dr. Raymond and his staff! Dr. Raymond is awesome, compassionate, always has my kids best interest at heart and my kids have been patients of his since their toddler years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeannine Duncan
user_reviews_extended.Description: We got a second opinion for my toddlers teeth. She needed work done we were not comfortable with, stated by our last dentist. Not only was less work needed, the cost was significantly less. To top it off everyone was so friendly including Dr. Raymond! So glad we listened to my friend's recommendation to see him for a second opinion!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jayda E

title: Austin Lifetime Dental
address: 8825 Bee Caves Rd e, Austin, TX 78746, United States

user_reviews.Name: Steve S.
user_reviews.Description: After delaying the placement of two dental implants for some time, I finally went in to begin the procedure with Dr. Olivares. The procedure was explained in great detail, and my expectations going forward were clearly set. The doctor took approximately 1.5 hours to place the two implants, and everything went exceptionally well. Dr. Olivares and the technician, Brandy, took excellent care of me. This morning, I experienced minimal residual pain and overall feel great. I will have additional appointments over the next few months to monitor my progress, with the new teeth expected to be in place in 3-4 months. Thanks to the entire team! Happy holidays 🎄 Steve

user_reviews.Name: Natalie Moy
user_reviews.Description: Austin Lifetime Dental takes care of all your dental needs plus plus! This past December was my routine cleaning but with a new (for me) Dental Hygienist.  During the cleaning she observed a small mole on my cheek, "looks suspicious."  Fortunately, I was able to get an appointment the next week with my Dermatologist and learned that small mole was a basal cell carcinoma! In January had Mohs procedure, which removed the skin cancer. Shout out to Van with a heart-filled thank you for your care, it went beyond a routine cleaning!  Thank you Austin Lifetime Dental for all your talented and caring dentists and staff!

Great experience..   i called yhem because i wanted a 2nd opinion.... I was up front with them about that.

. Got me right in for a (1) broken veneer.   They are not the orig dental office who did work.   Most everyone i called in town. Only will see you if your doing MULTIPLE veneers, and i get it. Hard to match etc...

I was looking for 2nd opinion. And to see if  a 2nd opinion aggreed with the (orig dentist) who I did go see to do the repair (on the veneer he installed).  But he was suggesting tons of other things...not just the 1 repair.    So I felt a bit anxious and concerned. I wanted a 2nd opinion.

Suffice it to say, after todays visit with Dr. Webb,  I have booked my appt for tomorrow 8am with her and the team at Austin Lifetime Dental to start the replacement on the veneer (and a gaurd! To protect my investment) which they advised and said they do normally with all new veneers.  (Smart move)... maybe had i been fitted with a gaurd originally it would not of broken. (Who knows).

Happy they were willing to see me and get me right in. Honest open, up front. Very refreshing. Did not feel I was being "sold" on doing tons of other work.

I highly highly recomend.  Dr Webb and Austin Lifetime Dental.

Other: very professional, clean, modern offices. Easy to get to. Great parking. SUPER great staff!!!!!

If you looking for honest, upfront, fair pricing, and only work that's needed.  I'm extremely pleased so far. Looking forward to seeing them tomorrow (and that's hard to say, when it's dental work :-) )

UPDATE:    Had  ( front) Veneer done- its looks great perfect match, Dr Webb is a perfectionist - really took a lot of time to get this right, I was expecting  ( 2) visits, wait for lab etc. NOT HERE- they do it all in house  ( 3D Digital veneers made right there, so I was ( 1) trip and done. I am very impressed. Very happy. Highly recommend.   Surpassed my expectations!

user_reviews.Name: Cynthia Barbarito
user_reviews.Description:
Writing a negative review is not something I take lightly, but I felt so strongly about being mistreated that I don’t want this to happen to anyone else. My husband and I have been patients at Avenue Dental (south) for years, and we were shocked to be denied my fully covered annual cleaning simply because I chose not to proceed with a deep cleaning, which Dr. Wong recommended during an earlier visit. I decided that I would think about it for maybe next year, since it wasn’t covered by insurance, and that I would still like to receive my general cleaning for the time being. This was refused. Basically, my routine cleaning was being withheld unless I agreed to an expensive upsell.

I called my insurance provider, who confirmed: “Any member on a dental plan has the right to choose the services they wish to have rendered. The provider cannot refuse to complete any services of the member’s choosing.”

We’ve requested our recent X-rays and will be finding a new dentist come the new year. Meanwhile, I’ve paid my insurance all year and  never received the minimum full mouth cleaning. Very disappointing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: bill vanderbush
user_reviews_extended.Description: Let me just start by saying that if pain is your thing, this is not the dentist for you. I hate going to the dentist and I know I’m not alone. The payoff may be fine but the process feels positively medieval. At least that has been my life experience until today. Avenue Dental features perhaps the most gentle practitioner of dentistry I have ever come across. The entire experience was professional and pleasant. As with any medical procedure, a gentle touch and careful hands make or break the experience. I once had a dentist who I swear slammed four shots of espresso right before I came in every time. I walked away from those visits feeling like I had been kicked in the mouth by a mule. Avenue Dental was the most painless dental visit I have ever experienced, and in 51 years of going to the dentist that is saying a lot. My only hesitation with recommending Avenue Dental would be that if every person who reads this review decides to make them their dentist, that means less openings on the calendar for me. But I won’t be selfish. I highly recommend Avenue Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evan Marlatt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Migraines were the last straw for me. I had to find a solution to the constant feeling that my head was going to fall off (which would have been welcome at that point). After seeking help from chiropractors, massage therapists, MD's, Dr. Google, acupuncture, yoga, and more I came across The Hills Dental Spa. By the time I came in I was desperate for relief and wanted to ensure I wouldn't have a migraine appear on my wedding day in 4 months. They gave me a clipboard full of symptoms to review - I lit up the 'TMJ' section like a Christmas tree! They were able to help with symptoms right away.

Overall, it was a journey, but I feel a night & day difference. No more clenching, teeth grinding, migraines, neck/traps pain, jaw popping, mouth breathing, discomfort lying on my back, stress dreams, or poor posture. Praise God!

Vikki is the greatest cheerleader I ever could have asked for and is the light that got me through the treatment :D (which was interrupted by covid office closures, a cross country move, and a chaotic work schedule.)

I've worked with over a dozen masseuses and as many dental hygienists.

Carol is the first masseuse I've ever really had a conversation with and we don't shut up when I have an appointment :)

Gen gave me the only cleanings of my life I've ever had that were 100% painless :)

I'll miss the whole team and thank you all for your help in screwing my head back on!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Salzgeber
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to The Hills Dental Spa for many years & I’ve never had a bad experience. The staff is very friendly and makes me feel at ease. Dr. Winters is a great dentist who has given me options to take the best care of my teeth over the years. The atmosphere is relaxing and I’ve even taken advantage of getting a massage after my teeth cleaning, which is amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis Lowe
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been coming to them for 10 + years , there is no other dentist and cosmetic team that can even come close to The Hills . I had Vaneers done and regular cleanings for not only did my smile turn out amazing my self esteem did as well . If you ever want to put your faith in a dentist and not have to worry. DR. Winters , is the choice for you.

I was going to try and do a separate post for their spa services,  but sadly Google would not let me ! For almost as long as I have been coming to The Hills Dental Spa , I would also get a massage. Being 6 foot 7 , is not easy to find therapist who know how to do it right . They have the most amazing massage therpist Jessi . As I right this post I had a massage from her that lasted 2 hours and I can feel the huge change for the better that she was able to achieve . It wasn't easy due to my size but Damn is she amazing . And the results speak for themselves .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blaine Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Hills Dental Spa.. and I’ve never loved a dentist before! They’re super accommodating, professional, and luxurious! They make each visit super comfortable (warm neck pillow, blanket, foot massage!) and are also knowledgeable about all things teeth! They made my teeth super beautiful and white for my wedding! Glad I finally found a dentist I enjoy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Whitney Fluty
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the most amazing experience at this dental office getting my cosmetic veneers. The staff made me feel so welcomed from the very beginning.  Meredith was so helpful and informative from the start. Bo was so friendly, detailed, and really laid out the process so I felt comfortable.  Christi was amazing with her chair side manor and really made me fell at ease. Dr Winters was beyond what I could have asked for. So knowledgeable, listened to what I wanted and gave me the teeth of my dreams. I couldn’t have asked for a better team and would highly recommend to all my family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savannah Biggs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATE: I just had my two front teeth pulled and replaced with a bridge. I was super nervous about the appointment, but it was completely pain free! I am so excited to finish the rest of my treatment at The Hills Dental Spa.

Being a patient at The Hills has been a great experience. I am usually very anxious about dental procedures, but Dr. Winters and his staff have been absolutely wonderful. I would recommended this practice to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Therese Morris
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had all of my crowns replaced by Dr. Winters and am very pleased with the outcome. They look great and my gums are healthier than they have been in a long time. Dr. Winters and his staff are wonderful to work with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: deborah loewe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place to go! its a spa feeling with a dentist, Dr. Winters is a kind person and always spends the time you need! they don't rush you out the door, and they try to make your experience a great one. They have all the latest tech! They have a laser that treats painful cold sores with great results, and they have a massage therapist on hand so you can get a foot and hand massage while you get a cleaning! so if you want a new type of dental experience that is actually pleasant this is the place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katelyn Boone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been a patient for years.   Love the atmosphere - very chill and spa-like as well as all the kind people that work there.  Getting a hand a foot massage added to your service is also a must and helps you look forward to your next dental cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ASHLIN LEBLANC
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Winters has been amazing to work with. I am doing clear liner braces with him, and he has been so accommodating. He truly cares about my desires for my end results and has gone above and beyond to ensure that I am happy with my smile.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie Fontaine
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at the hills dental spa for 12 years now and I love it! From the relaxing atmosphere to the great customer service, just an outstanding experience every time! The warm lavender neck wrap is my favorite! The care and attention to details from all the specialists and Dr. Winters is exceptional !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony M.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After an extensive absence to the dentist I have to say I was a little apprehensive going in to see ANY dentist!

I have to say, from the second I walked through the door, to the time the procedure was done, this has been one of the greatest experiences I’ve ever had!

You can easily see Dr. Winters passion exude for not only his craft, but the people he’s taking care of in his office.

When the procedure started they make you comfortable as possible. Offering so many things to you as soon as you walk in the door. The team and staff act as if they’ve known you for years. They’re compassionate about everything they do and that’s easy to see!

I cannot recommend this team and Dr. Winters enough!!!

Thank you to everyone at The Hills Dental Spa and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annesley Pulse
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Winters did an amazing job fixing my bite and helping with my TMJ. I first called because my jaw was locked and in awful pain due to TMJ. They were very kind and reassuring- offering next day services to ease the pain before my consultation appointment. My whole experience has been amazing and every employee has been so nice. I’m so glad I was able to take the non-surgical route to fix my TMJ. I’m lucky to have found The Hills Dental Spa and will continue to go here for cleanings and services even though my TMJ treatment is complete!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maggie Fuller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend! Been coming to The Hills Dental Spa for almost 10 years now. They have always taken great care of me and their entire staff are the nicest, most attentive people whose service never fails to impress me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keri Backus
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this place! The entire staff is friendly and helpful. The office is cozy and beautiful. I was offered a blanket and warm neck wrap just to get my teeth cleaned, while also listening to the music genre of my choice! My family has all had different dental issues, and we have all been overwhelmed and pleased with the knowledge and support and the great care we’ve received from everyone at The Hills Dental Spa.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutley love this place!!  I have been going here for years and the staff is amazing!! I was shocked at how easy it really was!   Dr Winters made them look so natural and I LOVE the results!!! I’m so happy I finally took the leap and decided to invest in myself!! I highly recommend Dr Winters and his team!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Cobb
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So happy that I found The Hills Dental Spa! The space itself is very beautiful yet homey (not to mention, extremely clean!), the staff is beyond helpful and welcoming, and the quality of work performed is incredible!

Dr. Winters is extremely talented at what he does and I completely trust his capabilities. He has years of experience under his belt and is always able to make his patients' "smile dreams" come true.

Vikki is amazing at her job as well! She is an extremely kind and caring soul who values her patients above all else. I've always felt at ease in her care and she makes getting any sort of dental work done fun! (Which can be a hard thing to do!)

And Meredith, who works at the front desk, is incredible at her job! She keeps the office well-organized, is welcoming to both new and returning clients, and is on top of it when it comes to scheduling and follow-ups.

Overall, an amazing team and office that I couldn't recommend enough! Five solid stars for The Hills Dental Spa! XX

user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t believe I’ve been going to Hills Dental Spa for 13 years. They are always so friendly. It is always very clean and easy and relaxing. Highly recommend this practice!

Dr Winters is a great dentist. Always does a great job! Staff is top notch and very friendly. Definitely recommend this dentist to friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynn Kee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Winters did a fantastic job on my new veneers. I love the way they look & feel. I smile often & laugh more. user_reviews_extended.Description: Six Stars! The service and the staff are absolutely outstanding! Friendly, professional, and knowledgeable.
