I can’t recommend them highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larry Warnock
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Hills Dental Spa for over 21 years.  Stayed with them even through a change of ownership.  Im a happy patent.  Have done the regular dental treatments as well as a full upper and bottom veneer cosmetic treatment.   Dr. Winters is always at the cutting edge of new technology and he has a great “chairside manner”.  Five stars for Hills Dental Spa.   BTW, the spa services are top notch as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Kingsbury
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is hands down the most professional, friendly, and amazing dentistry I’ve ever worked with. First off- it really does feel like a spa from the moment you walk in- drinks, plush seating, a massage room, amazing staff. Second - the services they provide are truly on the cutting edge. They have helped me to sleep on my back for the first time in my life by repositioning my jaw non-surgically. I don’t snore, my neck has never felt better. Lastly my smile has never looked better! I will recommend Dr Winters and The Hills Dental Spa to everyone I know!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kirstie Andino
user_reviews_extended.Description: I needed to have a really old bridge in the front of my mouth replaced and had put it off for a long time since I was nervous about what the change would look like. I finally worked up the courage and started shopping around for a dentist. Many dentists do this type of work but not as their primary offering. After meeting with the staff and reviewing a plan I felt confident that this was The Hills Dental Spa would be the place where I'd finally replace my two bridges which could be seen by everyone (They're my front top teeth!). Throughout the process the staff was great - I felt heard and all of my questions and concerns were addressed. I am super happy with the results and so glad that I went with this place. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kris
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t recommend Dr. Winters enough. I’ve been in TMJ treatment for several years now, and we had to unexpectedly move to Texas at the end of my treatment. He fit me in to his schedule, and went above and beyond to make sure that my bite was perfect after delivering a new implant crown. He triple checked everything to make sure it was correct, took an x-ray for proper placement, and He also adjusted my night guard so that all of my teeth would fit properly. On top of being an excellent dentist, he’s just an all-around really nice guy. His Staff is also kind and extremely welcoming. The essential oils being diffused all throughout the office are a very nice touch, as is the music you get to pick in your room. They even gave me this incredible aromatherapy hot neck pillow to lay on during my treatment. I have serious neck issues, and it’s the first time in my life that I have NOT left the dentist with my neck hurting. This was after a 4 1/2 hour drive to see him. Normally I would be leaving a dentist’s office with a migraine after a 4 1/2 hour drive and laying in the dentist chair. Not today! That pillow is a life saver. I will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: patty
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient for years amid the many changes the clinic has undergone, but they’ve stayed great. I’ve recommended to friends with dental anxieties to check them out. Highly recommend :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natasha Kingsbury
user_reviews_extended.Description: Start to finish, my experience at The Hills Dental Spa was incredible. It feels like an actual spa. The staff is friendly, the rooms are clean and cozy. And for the first time I feel like I was speaking to people who knew REAL dental health. I am so impressed! Could not recommend them more.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Carr
user_reviews_extended.Description: I received a full set of veneers from Dr. Winters about two years ago and I couldn't be happier. They look bright, beautiful, and extremely natural. I continue visiting the Hills for my routine cleanings because I love the staff. Everyone is professional and friendly and each experience is enjoyable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: April McNeely
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really can't say enough about Dr. Winters and his entire team.  Every service I've received from The Hills Dental Spa has been outstanding.  What brought me to them was severe TMJ pain.  I've been undergoing treatment and things are getting better and better week after week.  Not only have Dr. Winters and Vicky helped with the pain tremendously, the teeth cleaning and massage services are amazing as well.  Everyone has an admirable amount of dedication, expertise and professionalism.  I would recommend them to anyone looking for an excellent dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Nevaeh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love love love. The hills has taken care of me since early 2022. Was in so much pain before and had difficulty eating due to my bite. It took Dr. Winters zero time to find a solution and get me out of pain while correcting my bite. Meredith is amazing. So sweet! Sad to say goodbye, Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Northedge
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys are awesome, our family has been with the Hill Dental Spa for over 20 years. Never considered going anywhere else. In all those years and numerous visit and procedures I have never felt uncomfortable or experienced pain. Highly recommend as this is how dental treatment should be

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marlene Van Sickle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient for around 15 years, and can't imagine going anywhere else.  Caring staff, warm neck wraps, blankets, and hand & foot massages during treatments make for as pleasant of an experience as possible for something most people don't enjoy.  Or opt to have a full massage before or after treatment, or really anytime!  I appreciate the attention to details and careful discussion of treatment options/plans.  Dr Winters and the rest of the staff are truly Best in Class, in my opinion!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrey Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Delighted that I found the office of Dr. Kevin Winters. Read his bio, he is very talented at his craft. Dr. Winters performed a full mouth restoration with all new veneers for me due to declining health of my teeth. Benefitted also with an improved smile, better sleeping and overall health of my gums and teeth.  Perfection at its finest. Dr. Winters has a staff that starts at the front desk and includes the various assistants throughout the process who are kind, compassionate and very capable at their individual tasks.  Highly recommend The Hills Dental Spa.   A. Walker

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Dunham
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to the Hills Dental spa for years and have had the best experience. From the staff to the dental hygentists to the dentist, everyone is friendly and does an amazing job. The atmosphere is so comfortable, it is unlike any other dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Hills Dental Spa is THE place for all your dental wants and needs. I had a tooth partially break and the team got me in first thing to have it fixed. There was ZERO discomfort from discussion, numbing, repair, and completion. Thank you so much, Dr. Winters and Kristi! While my tooth repair was going on I choose to have a hand and foot massage done that lasted the whole repair. The perfect way to fully relax and actually enjoy your pain free dental work- thank you so much, Carol!   Luxury dental care at it’s best!! I highly recommend The Hills Dental Spa. ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Merritt
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient at the Hills since the beginning and they are always attentive, reliable, thorough and flexible.  Spotless, cutting edge equipment.  Friendly staff who know what they are doing. And the most gentle yet effective cleanings I have ever had! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kamille Babaran
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great office and staff! Excellent and warm service. I put my trust in their expertise that they will hopefully fix my TMJ issues and I know they will.

Update: 6 months in the treatment process and I now just occasionally experience minimal discomfort in my jaw. Thank you Dr. Winters and to his team for making this possible.  I made so much progress and will continue to follow your treatment plan and tips for me on the road to full recovery.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Berry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience with The Hills Dental Spa! It’s so unlike any other dental practice. Truly a unique environment with an exceptional dental staff. I thoroughly enjoyed my cleaning and Dr Winters has a great way of putting you at ease. If you’re looking for 5 star service, look no further!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kate george
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very clean and safe. The staff is very friendly and helpful. I love the relaxing environment- it makes going to the dentist that much more enjoyable. I also received a bite guard from Hills Dental Spa, and it is so helpful! The guard helps with recession and jaw clenching. I have noticed a huge difference! Thank you Hills Dental Spa for helping me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcey White
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the first day I walked in I knew I was in good hands! The vibe is very professional amidst a warm and caring environment.  The staff has been incredible through my journey—always supportive and helpful and I highly recommend Dr. Winters.  The investment in my TMJ treatment was significant but worth every penny!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Moira McCarthy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to the Hills for years and loved all of the past and current staff.  I just had a cleaning with Sierra for the first time.  She is awesome!  Such a gentle touch and positioned me in the chair so that the entire experience was comfortable and relaxing. I highly recommend her if you have a hard time with dental cleanings like I have had in the past.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca McIntyre
user_reviews_extended.Description: I started going to the Hills Dental Spa several years ago and I am so lucky I found them. This was the only dentist, out of several I had been to prior, that cared enough to take the time to figure out why my crowns were popping off all the time. Dr. Winters is exceptional providing top notch service and care. Jenavee has been my dental hygienist and I can not express enough how great she is. Very kind, genuine person, and you do not feel a thing while she is working on your teeth! I would not want to go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Traci Hughes Sigmon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Dr. Winters for bite correction and help with headaches and TMJ pain. I had read about neuromuscular dentistry and was hopeful he could help me. I’m so happy I did! The staff is friendly and communicative and the approach is very thorough. I had input every step of the way and ended up deciding on veneers which not only helped correct my bite but also look great! I love my new smile and my TMJ pain is gone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna Winters
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been to the Hills Dental spa twice now and I love going there! They pay attention to all the little details from start to finish. Like water, tea, and snacks in the waiting room and a hot pad for your neck to help you relax during your cleaning and dental services. I have been going to different dentists for years and have yet to find a dentist with excellent customer care and the latest in dentistry. The Hills dentistry team often goes to weekend trainings around the country to better their services. I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a new dentist or on the fence about getting dentistry services!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsey Serrano
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s always a great experience here!  I used to dread the dentist but it’s impossible to now. What’s better than a foot massage and fun music or Netflix while you get a cleaning. Plus their staff is so friendly and great company.  I recommend The Hills Dental Spa to everyone I know!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Marchioni
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came to The Hills Dental Spa not knowing much about TMJ/TMD nor how to alleviate the symptoms I was experiencing from it. I had originally sought help from my regular dentist and was recommended a night guard that only worsened my symptoms.

The staff there helped me easily identify my problem, understand my options, and chose a proper treatment (for me, day/night orthotics). To date, my symptoms have been significantly alleviated and I'm told it's only going to get better over time.

Special shoutout to Vikki, Meredith, Bo, Kristi, and Carol who directly worked with me in most visits. Additionally, I appreciate the expertise and patience of Dr. Winters while going through my treatment. The whole team is very kind, knowledgeable, and thoughtful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Goloweyco
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Dr. Winters and his team unconfident with my smile and hoping to get some veneers to cosmetically fix the things I didn’t like. They did a full consultation and we ended up deciding that going in and starting at the foundation was going to give me the best, lasting results that I was looking for. Adult braces was a big leap from what I had originally planned, but the entire team has been amazing and supportive and communicative the entire journey. We’re a little less than half way through but I couldn’t be more satisfied with my choice of skilled professionals or their informed plan of action for me. The results I’m already seeing are amazing. It’s a bonus that I feel like family every time I step into the office. Apprehensive about the dentist? Fear not because they’ve got weighted blankets at your request, or you can even schedule a hand/foot massage to keep you relaxed. They truly provide it all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: korie davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience here. The staff is really kind. I had only been here once and they remembered my name. Which always makes a person feel good. They offer a lot of services and go out of their way to make you feel comfortable during them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lainey Melnick
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to the Hills Dental Spa for almost 20 years. My whole family goes here too. Always great, love the warmed neck wrap. The best dental spa in the Westlake area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Yacktman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional staff, clean office, and have done a great job for the past decade+ of service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenzie H.
user_reviews_extended.Description: A truly incredible staff, office and service provider! I have never patronized a more proactive, and truly patient centered practice. Incredibly talented doctors, such as Dr. Winters, who instead of wanting to profit from what could have been multiple appointments,  went above and beyond in treating me with preventative measures the first time I came in. I have never been more impressed by a dental office or staff! I could not recommend The Hills enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Remington
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this dental office! The hygienists are both skilled and kind, the dentist does great work (my new bridge looks amazingly real!) and the office itself is calming and looks and smells so nice. I drive 80 miles round trip to get here, and it is completely worth it.  Many thanks to the Hills Dental Spa!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Goetz
user_reviews_extended.Description: After dealing with years of TMJ issues, dentists who couldn’t point me in the correct direction, and specialists who didn’t care to get to the root cause, I’m finally in good hands. From my initial consultation with Bo, to now my 6th week of treatment, I’ve felt very comfortable and my condition is steadily improving. Dr. Winters has been very upfront with me, and the treatment has been easy. Glad to have found this team of wonderful people. If you’re suffering from TMJ, I highly recommend The Hills.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Willi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Looking for an amazing dentist that will listen to your needs and work with you to address long term problems? Then this is the dentist for you.  Dr. Winters works with his staff as a TEAM to address your needs.  From his amazing hygienist staff like Olivia and Christie to his business office with Bo and Meredith your are in great hands!  And while you are there, book Carole for a hand and foot massage during your teeth cleaning. It's a win-win!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Hampton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I have ever been to! The staff here is very honest, kind, and patient. I don’t get anxious about going to the dentist anymore. Any treatment recommendations are just that - recommendations. I have never felt pressured into getting anything done. When recommendations are made I am presented with multiple treatment options and encouraged to ask questions and move forward according to my timeline. I seriously can’t imagine a better dental practice. Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joanna Chicola
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Jenavee is great! She has done half my cleaning already and had no issues at all. Easiest dentist cleaning I have ever had and it was for a deep clean! No sensitivity and though it’s def not my fav thing to get done, I am very happy I came here. Thanks again.

Update: I am now just starting to get my Invisalign and I have to say they have been so patient with me I’ve had to reschedule for a year and I am beyond thankful for them willing to work with me. Thanks you for always being A+ customer service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Fikes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Winters helped my jaw pain immensely. I went in with chronic and debilitating tmj pain that I wasn’t sure could be fixed without jaw surgery. But Dr. Winters and his staff offered a solution that completely eliminated the issues I was having. They are thorough, detail oriented and I couldn’t be more grateful to this place. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sung Park
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff with a comfy atmosphere. Only place I gone to where the cleaning was basically pain free. Vikki was dedicated and awesome and with Dr. Winters, helped me get rid of my jaw pain.  I would recommend this place for just basic cleaning or other advanced procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Douglas Moran
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They are, quite simply, the best. The staff, the hygienists, the dentists, and the facilities are all excellent. I haven’t had dental care this good since I was a small boy and dentists had their practices in their own houses. This is not an exaggeration, and I am extremely hard to please. I simply do *not* give out five-star reviews.

The one down side is that you must pay in advance, and be reimbursed by your insurance. But they file the paperwork for you, and can “roll” your reimbursement  payments into future care if you like. And IMO the level of care is absolutely worth it.

This is the gold standard of dental care in Austin, in my opinion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabel Keddy-Hector
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came to their office for help on my TMJ pain and to receive guidance on next steps for treatment. They told me over the phone that I would start out by talking to their "patient advocate" when I arrived at their office. I thought this sounded nice, but it turns out she was really just their glorified saleswoman. I spent an hour in the office with her- she clearly had a sales pitch that was designed to scare me into paying for whatever service they could recommend to get the most money out of me. I told her my goals were pain management, she starts her shpeal saying my main goal was 'protecting my smile'. She tells me she is going to list my options for me, then spends 15 minutes talking about option 1: "Do Nothing". I know I can 'do nothing'- I didn't come to you for medical advice for you to offer me a non-plan. I told her I wanted to do research, she asks "well why do you need to do research?". As if getting second opinions and doing your research is not a good idea for major medical decisions.

At the end of the day, I can't even tell you if the care they offer is good- but my experience here was not a good one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: anna haynes
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Hills Dental Spa Staff are professional, friendly, thoughtful and knowledgeable. Dr Winters and his team have always done a great job from cleaning to cavities and I always recommend them when anyone asks for a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Murphy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental experience! The practice is really set up like a spa, it's very comfortable and relaxing. The staff is so professional, courteous and does such an amazing job explaining everything throughout your visit. I highly recommend Hills Dental Spa!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Analis Bellew Hendry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Serene Hills Dentistry!! Starting with the welcoming reception walking through the front door throughout my visit, everyone makes me feel welcomed and cared for until I have left the building. I am one who does not particularly like going to the Dentist and they always make sure that I am comfortable while being treated. From TV's overhead to distract you from your service and massaging chairs to ease you. I just came from there thinking I had 2 old fillings to be replaced (so my last Dentist was going to have me do) but was told it was not at all necessary at this time. I cannot say enough how appreciative I am for not making me have treatments not needed. They even have options to work with you if you do not have insurance. All big SMILES from me for providing me with such excellent care & being honest.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allen Green
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sad day of disappointment.  Years of suffering TMJ issues led me to recently learn of neuromuscular dentistry. Extensive research led me to believe Dr Kevin Winters could help. Unfortunately, I was not allowed to even meet Dr Winters unless I committed to spending between $9,000.00 and $65,000.00.  Was told I had extensive problems by an assistant who never explained her credentials.  I appreciated The Hills Dental Spa not charging me for the 2 “consults”  with the assistant but I just feel it would be worthy of meeting and consulting with the actual Dr / dentist prior to spending that much money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Hasse
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Winters and his team have been great in helping me resolve my tmj popping. I was having popping 24/7 in my jaw so I made a free consultation where they provided me with different treatment plan options so I could decide what I was most comfortable with going forward. They were always available when I had questions or concerns throughout my treatment plan. Staff and Meredith at the front desk were always helpful and respectful. I definitely recommend seeing Dr. Winters and his team for any tmj related issues!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christel Grall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never had a more pleasant experience at a dental office before. I mean it when I say that every single person in that office was friendly and helpful. My teeth cleaning was by far the most comfortable one I have ever had. All of my concerns were addressed and I left feeling confident in the future of not just my dental health, but my overall health as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jane Burson
user_reviews_extended.Description: For years I had intermittent jaw popping and clicking which finally culminated in a TMJ disorder so bad I could barely open my mouth. After speaking to two other dentists - one who told me I just needed a bite guard (he had already sold me one less than 3 months earlier) and one who told me I would need jaw surgery without even seeing me in person - I contacted Dr. Winters' office. They an did an impressively extensive bite and jaw analysis process before finalizing a recommended treatment plan focused on addressing the underlying cause and not just the symptoms. Incredibly friendly and attentive staff (s/o Vickki!) who care about patient comfort and long-term dental health. I'm about halfway through my treatment and I literally tell anyone who mentions they have TMJ issues to come here, if I could give more than 5 stars I would! ❤❤❤

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ted Newman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had been struggling with TMJ, grinding and clinching for years. I lost my front tooth about 5 years ago on a fishing trip. I went through the implant process with another dentist but ended up breaking the titanium post that held my tooth in. I then spent another year grinding my teeth down to the pulp. Now I needed much more work than I anticipated, and I realized I needed help with the underlying problems before I could fix my teeth. I tried to find a new dentist that would take my case without having to operate on my jaw. After extensive research, I came across Dr. Winters and his team.  From the first consultation with Bo, I felt I was in the right place. She made me feal at ease with a process that was going to take at least 9 months. Not to mention the cost.  On my return visit I sat down with Dr. Winters to review my ex-rays and go over the next steps. Little did he know what he was getting into. I spent the next year and a half with Dr. Winters and his team.  He would fix something, and I would break it. I became known as the one percenter, but Dr. Winters refused to give up.  I can’t thank Dr. Winters and his team enough for getting my jaw fixed and giving me the smile I have always dreamed about.  Dr. Winters and his team at the Hills Dental Spa in Westlake are amazing.  They fixed my Jaw and gave me my smile back. I would recommend them to anyone and everyone that needs help with a perfect smile.  Thank you to Dr. Winters and your amazing staff.
July 5th, 2024
Ted N.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vinay George
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at the Hills Dental Spa were great. I had gone there for a second opinion and they took the time to look at my case.  The office itself has a warm, welcoming environment and seems to be run very professionally.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristian Dobre
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always great service and a lot of attention to detail. Been using the Hills Dental Spa for well over 10 years and all the work held up great. Also great with my anxiety

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoire Curiel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Viki is amazing! She has been here throughout my whole orthodontics treatment and I have rarely seen someone so passionate, kind and putting patients first. Her knowledge and energy are impressive. The team is lucky to have her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Rupert
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Five Stars for the Hills Dental Spa.  I was a dental assistant years ago and have always been picky about my dentists and my cleanings.  The Hills Dental Spa has three wonderful dentists, three fabulous dental hygienists, a massage therapist, and a full office staff.  From the moment you walk into their beautiful facility, you are treated like royalty.  They don't get in a rush to do anything as they want to hear all your thoughts and concerns.  The teeth cleaning was hands down the BEST cleaning I have ever received!

I am so excited about the Hills Dental Spa that I have been telling all my friends and family about them!  Call the Hills Dental Spa and tell Amie that Mary referred you-you won't be sorry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony L. Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: AMAZING!!! Dr. Winters and his staff are very knowledgeable and friendly. They made me feel comfortable, answered my questions, and customized the experience just for me. I was reluctant to travel to Austin, TX for a dental visit, but I'm so glad I did. The experience made the travel worth while and I will definitely be back. I would highly recommend Dr. Winters to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shaun McDuffee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at the Hills Dental Spa is amazingly friendly and professional.  From the time you walk in the door through any procedures they make you feel like family and you know you are in good hands.   I would highly recommend them for any of your dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brick Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went here because I had extreme jaw pain, so bad that I couldn't live a normal life. I previously went to about 20 other doctors trying to resolve this issue. They were able to immediately see the problem and cause of my pain, get me into a temporary device to stop my pain, then started on a long term solution. It's been about 4 years now and I'm 100% pain free and have not have to worry once about being in pain and can now live a normal life.
Hands down best doctor and dentist I've ever been to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wilson Giraldo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Winters and his team have gone above and beyond to make all of my appointments very comfortable and stress free. I am not a fan of going to the dentist and I know I show it haha, but going to this dental office makes it so much easier and they truly are a pain-free dentistry. A huge plus at this office is that they have a spa which I always get a massage from Carol after my appointment and it's amazingggg. Definitely recommend going if you're looking for a place to go.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gustavo Santos
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a great dentist. Great technical depth, technology, and talent, with people who cares to provide not just a great dental service but create an amazing and relaxing experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Purcell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough about Dr. Winters and his staff. Amazing!!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Faldyn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been with the Hills Dental Spa since 2003 and this group has been nothing but stellar.  Experienced and very professional staff.  I would recommend The Hills Dental Spa for anyone seeking basic dental services to Cosmetic procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lance Cooley
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Hills Dental Team is amazing.  They make you super comfortable and their work is outstanding.   Highly recommended going here for all your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Avery Toomes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have extremely bad jaw pain and have seen many doctors and dentists. The hills is the first place to take my pain seriously and give me an honest and accurate solution to my pain. They are extremely kind, and I have felt very welcome at the Hills Dental Spa. I look forward to continuing my treatment there over the next few months to reduce my jaw pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Tomlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Winters and his staff are amazing. He is a perfectionist and does truly excellent dental work. The single-sitting crown procedure minimizes the pain and trauma of getting major work done. They are also understanding of my sensory issues and keep objectionable materials away from me. Highly recommend this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Brainin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to The Hills Dental Spa for over 15 years. It is generally a very good experience. This week I had a great cleaning with Jenavee. She is skilled, kind, and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: K Schneider
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience here is always great!  Vik is very welcoming and knowledgeable in my treatment plan and always takes time to answer my crazy questions!  Meredith even looked for a hidden stash of the fresh baked cookies for me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fedekiko G
user_reviews_extended.Description: Last Tuesday, I had a fantastic visit to the Hills. I feel very  lucky to be provided with such personalized treatment. Sierra, my new hygienist was excellent and I  would recommend her to anyone with a past history of anxiety.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Snyder
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had another good experience at The Hills Dental Spa.  I have been getting cleanings here for 2 years.  I book the hands and feet massage to be performed during my cleaning and it really helps reduce anxiety during the process.  All staff is friendly.  COVID check-in procedure was to text from parking lot.  I immediately received a text to come into the office, there was no additional wait time.  Completed typical temperature and questionnaire screening upon arrival.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mindy Sheldon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don't have anxiety going to the dentist, but if you do, you will understand why the word "spa" is in their name.  Great staff that keep appointment times which is really appreciated if you're a working parent.  They really go over and above in service and quality of work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaitlyn Brueske
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In Feb 2021 I woke up with my jaw completely unable to open (turns out I wore my TMJ down to the bone, my disc was almost slipped out of place, and my bite was completely off to the right side). I never had any jaw problems before that, so it was a complete surprise to me, and absolutely debilitating. I had appts with other dentists without the care or results I was hoping for and was finally referred to Dr. Winters and told he was “the best TMJ specialist around”. That was 100% the truth!! The staff worked with my budget and talked me through a variety of options until I found something I was comfortable with, laid out a plan of action, and got my treatment started immediately. The jaw orthotic he made for me has changed my life, I’m back to where I was before the incident and I will be making Dr. Winters my forever dentist, even for routine appts (even though he’s a 45 min drive each way for me!). Not only is he the best, but every member of his staff are a reflection of him as well. Carol, who performs the neuromuscular massages, has improved my posture- my neck and back feel brand new leaving my appts with her. I work in a hospital so it’s very important for me to feel my best physically to keep up, and Dr. Winters and his staff have proved time and time again that they can and will take amazing care of me. Will never be able to thank you all enough!!

Edit Aug 2022- I accidentally warped my jaw orthotic (totally my fault) and Hills Dental Spa was able to fit me in same day, somehow salvage the old splint and make it fit like brand new in a matter of minutes! I am so dependent on this splint since it has completely changed my life, and to know that even a year later they drop everything to take care of their patients in a time of need, plus save me the money and hassle of starting over with a new splint really reinforces my first review- that they are THE BEST!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Woolford
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Bite adjustment follow-up.

As always, today’s visit was very pleasant
Everyone tries to make you very comfortable and relaxed

The doctor and all his technicians and assistants detail the problems, recommend solutions, and the high quality standards of the doctor, the tests, the procedures, the equipment, and the materials they use all reassure me of the true value of what I receive.

This is the most informed, detailed, and comfort-focused dental practice I have ever found

user_reviews_extended.Name: CG Austin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. Winters for over  four years now and could not appreciate him more. He really is an artist and the dental makeover I received was much more than I could’ve hoped for!  But actually, I’m even MORE most grateful that he cured the chronic headaches I’ve been struggling with for years… He determined quickly the misalignment of my teeth and that my grinding down of molars was the trigger for them.  I had never associated my  frequent tension headaches with any dental problem…. But they  were actually jaw pain that radiated.  I was thrilled with the cosmetic result but the functional Improvement has been nothing short of a  miracle!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooks Blakemore
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife developed debilitating TMJ symptoms during her pregnancy that continued to worsen into postpartum. She tried physical therapy, Botox, etc and nothing worked until she found The Hills Dental Spa. They are warm and welcoming, remember you by name and care about your well-being. They did an in-depth evaluation and laid out all the options for her, with recommendations. She ended up going with a daytime and nighttime orthotic appliance, as recommended and within 48 hours of wearing she noticed significant improvement and relief in her symptoms. Especially in the overwhelming pressure/pain in her temple area. She’s been wearing the orthotic for 1.5 months now and her symptoms are pretty much gone. She can’t thank Dr. Winters and his staff enough. They drastically improved her quality of life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: E Avellan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had 2 appointments with Dr. Winters at the Hills Dental Spa and he and his staff are friendly and professional.  Dr. Winters is very professional and was able to replace a broken crown that same day and it fits PERFECT!  I will continue to be a patient and recommend them highly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Hills Dental Spa has to be hands down the best place for dental work! Dr. Winters is a master of his craft and his top notch team help to make the experience relaxing and comfortable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: karizmatic5
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been seeing Dr Benjamin Nemec for 10 years now, and there is no secret why.  I have never been disappointed with his work, his knowledge and ability to explain and execute a plan to give me the best results regarding all things my teeth.  He knows his stuff and I can tell he loves what he does.  His staff is consistently professional, kind, and try to anticipate your needs.  Like most people, I hated going to the dentist.  Now, I don't even think twice.  Don't even get me started on all the gadgets and latest technology they employ to make it all happen.
If you're thinking of switching your place of dentistry, PLEASE consider The Hills Dental Spa.  And tell them Kris sent you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Guzman
user_reviews_extended.Description: ALWAYS a pleasure to visit Dr. Winters and his team! My son and I drive from DFW to Austin every 4-6 weeks for our orthodontics and that is a very conscious choice. There are hundreds of dentists in Texas that can “straighten” your teeth and we drive right past them because Dr. Winters not only continues to educate himself as well as his team, he educates other dentists and his patients to understand how your smile is WAY MORE than just straight and white teeth. His philosophy of orthodontics has helped relieve a lifetime of pain in neck, back, shoulders and headaches for me and I am so grateful to have a partnered with The Hills Dental Spa to achieve and maintain my health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dominika D'Agostino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience overall. A very wholistic and long-term approach to dental care vs. fixing as-hoc problems. Everyone is super friendly. Shoutout to Meredith, Bo and of course the incredible dr. Kevin Winters.

user_reviews_extended.Name: George Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a customer for over 15 years and highly recommend The Hills Dental Spa. The care and service has always been incredible. The definition of pampered dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Merritt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Winters and the Entire team are amazing! Professional, welcoming and knowledgeable. Fantastic dentist and crew!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donita Ortega
user_reviews_extended.Description: Vikki is amazing. Going to a dental office is never much fun, but knowing that Vikki is on the job I don’t mind - I actually look forward to seeing her and getting the work done! Highly recommend the Hills Dental Spa!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Vinklarek
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have happily used THDS for 10+ years, and I met a new hygienist this week, Daniell. You always wonder with new people in your mouth?! However, Daniell was beyond experienced and very personable!  We had fun, she cleaned my pearly whites & we held conversations easily. When she was done, I hardly knew I had my teeth cleaned. It was truly wonderful experience!  Highly recommend Daniell & THDS!!! ~ Steve V

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jocelyn Tramp
user_reviews_extended.Description: Before going to The Hills, I suffered from migraines and teeth grinding/clenching in my sleep. With the help of Dr. Grahl and the entire staff they helped me get the sleep appliance that I needed to fix not only my teeth grinding but also the way I sleep. I breathe easier, I sleep completely through the night with no teeth grinding to wake me up. The staff at The Hills Dental Spa goes above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and so welcome. They truly want to help and improve your health for the long haul. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Cisneros
user_reviews_extended.Description: The lady who assisted me spent more than 1.5 hours with me to answer my questions and showed me details on what issues I had with my teeth. However, I was a little shocked at how much the cost would be to realign my jaw and build my teeth back up. The solution proposed did not include correcting my crowded teeth by widening my jaw. I did a search for dental airway and central Texas. I found a dentist that helps to correct more of what I am interested in and for almost half the price. I would assume that this proposed solution is just a different way of fixing my issues, but I feel correcting the crowded teeth would be better, in my situation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Douglas Kaufman

user_reviews_extended.Description: Well I guess am the odd one out on reviews.  I had such high hopes for my TMJ treatment.  In fact I was told "this never happens." And even wore it at night because the night appliance they provided was super uncomfortable. I was told it wasn't molded correctly so I never even used that (which I wasn't reimbursed for).  I mananged to get a little of my money back, but it was not a good experience. I am still wearing the day piece at night to protect my gums from the clenching, but now I am waking up with horrible pounding headaches on the side of my head where the jaw as popping. user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to The Hills Dental Spa after suffering from TMJD for over 20 years. The team here was different - they clearly specialize in this area, walked me through exactly what was happening with my jaw, and fitted me with a custom oral appliance. The pain I’d lived with for two decades is now gone and I’m getting the best sleep I’ve had in recent memory. If you’re dealing with unexplained jaw pain, clicking, tension headaches, or are just looking for some answers, please give them a visit. I wish I’d found them sooner.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Lynn Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m SO GLAD I chose this place to do the cosmetic bonding to my upper two teeth. I had a slight chip from a small accident years ago and wanted the front teeth to be evened out so my bite and smile were more symmetrical. I had considered going to my regular dentist but chose The Hills Dental Spa instead as I wanted someone with more expertise in this area and a detailed eye for what looks good.  The dental assistant was so warm and kind as was the dentist. They offered to numb me since my teeth are sensitive and it made the procedure really comfortable.  He was meticulous in shaping and contouring the bonding of the teeth until we got them just right.  I’m so happy with how they turned out and I will definitely recommend this place!  There is definitely a creative and artistic component to this kind of procedure and they got it just right! 😁

title: Masterpiece Smiles
address: 5656 Bee Caves Rd #B-100, Austin, TX 78746, United States

user_reviews.Name: Adrienne Bartkowiak
user_reviews.Description: I came to the office looking for teeth whitening but I got so much more. First, the whole staff, from the front desk, to the Doctor had such an uplifting and great attitude. Before we whitened, the Doctor inspected my teeth and even showed me photos of areas I should be concerned with or address eventually before he gave me the green light to treat. The woman who did my treatment made sure to keep checking on me throughout the whole process and also explained what she was doing and why, she was incredible. Finally, my results were stunning! Absolutely will be coming back here.

user_reviews.Name: Kirsha Del Pino
user_reviews.Description:
I've referred everyone in my family to Dr. Schmidt at Masterpiece Smiles because he and his staff are wonderful! And they have been quite pleased with him as well. The West Lake Hills office is very convenient as it is right of 360. The staff are great and I feel very welcome and well taken care of from the time I arrive throughout treatment.

Dr. Schmidt is patient and thorough. He has a very pleasant, friendly demeanor and has completely earned my trust. Probably also important in a dentist, he has a gentle touch! I never feel like he is doing more than necessary. Another important thing, unlike some dentists, he never has to "fix" something that has gone wrong during treatment. I definitely appreciate that I've never had to go back in twice for the same problem!

All-in-all, this is a wonderful office that I regularly recommend to my friends, family and co-workers. Masterpiece Smiles definitely deserves positive reviews!

user_reviews.Name: Brad Yeager
user_reviews.Description: I have been going to Masterpiece Smiles for several years now, I get a zoom whitening about twice a year and my teeth definitely have seen a big improvement. Dr. Schmidt and his staff have helped me really improve the health of my gums they have worked with me to discuss options and come up with an affordable treatment plan.  Great staff that always goes the extra mile.  Very happy with Dr. Schmidt and Masterpiece Smiles family, my whole family goes here now!  Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Leigh
user_reviews.Description: This entire practice, with Dr Schmidt at the helm, is fabulous.  Every aspect, from scheduling, experienced staff, excellent doctor, a state of the art office, and even the music makes this my favorite dental experience of my life.  Dr. Schmidt and the entire staff are so incredibly nice and helpful and did an outstanding job.  I recommend this practice to ANYone looking for a great dentist, and a great dental experience.

user_reviews.Description: I received a Zoom! Teeth whitening treatment here, and the experience was amazing! The dentist, Joseph Schmidt, and his dental assistant were extremely welcoming. They explained the steps of the whitening process and regularly checked in on me, to ensure I was comfortable. My first teeth whitening experience went extremely well, and I plan on coming to Masterpiece Smiles regularly :).

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Schmidt is one awesome dentist! As a performer my smile is very important to me. And he always comes through.  Nobody ever likes going to the dentist but he is always so careful and calming. He and his staff are extremely professional and willing to go beyond mere cursory service and really go that extra step.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kellie Roop
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Schmidt has been my dentist since I moved to Austin and he was a great find! When it comes to your teeth, you want someone who is thorough and knowledgable and takes pride in their work/practice and Dr. Schmidt does. I have anxiety about dental procedures and he's very patient with me, explains my options, never pressures you but lets you know what is necessary and what isn't, which I appreciate.

If you need a dentist, stop looking and make an appointment today!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika Castillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. Schmidt for over two decades.  I send all my family and friends to him because he and his staff are the best in town.  Dr. Schmidt and his team are the most kind and comforting people you will come across as soon as you step foot in that office.  Dr. Schmidt really cares about his patients and there isn't anything he can't fix when it comes to dental issues or concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Troy Cameron
user_reviews_extended.Description: Looking for an all around great dental experience? This is the place! I visited Dr. Schmidt, after my fiancée insisted I try them out. I ended up getting Invisalign as I have always been uncomfortable with my smile. I really thought I would never be able to fix my teeth without spending a fortune and having to endure braces. I cannot say enough good things about the care and attention Dr. Schmidt and his staff showed me. Even when I had the slightest concern, the staff was there to answer all of my questions professionally! No matter the situation, they always went out of their way to make sure I achieved my goal.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Tran
user_reviews_extended.Description: No one enjoys visiting the dentist but the entire staff at Dr. Schidmt’s office have made it the best possible experience one could imagine. The receptionist was friendly and knowledgeable. The hygienist was patient and kind. Dr. Schmidt made me feel comfortable the entire time and I never felt judged. I couldn’t recommend him enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erica Keoughan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Spring 2011

A couple of years ago i fell in the bathroom (i had a seizure)and landed just under my nose upon the porcelain pedestal upright sink. busted out all my front teeth out. Dr. Joseph Schmidt was able to see me on a weekend (Sunday morning) to give me a temporary, and then i spent the next year with him creating my new smile, which looks better than ever, and i'm so happy i went to him. Though for me it was tough, Dr Schmidt kept my spirits up through his promises, promises that he made come true, and that year was very worth it in the end. Thanks Dr Schmidt, i owe my new gorgeous smile to you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Strmiska
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited Masterpiece Smiles for my first time a few weeks ago and had the best dental experience of my life! I'm usually very afraid to even have cleanings done, but the hygienist was very knowledgeable and kept me very comfortable during the cleaning. She used the hand-scaling technique, which I have found to be very uncommon (since it's more time consuming and ultimately more work for the hygienist) so that I would not experience all of the normal nerve-pain from the scaling device that shoots cold water out. The front office staff were very polite and professional. They were very accommodating to also get my impressions for a night guard I've been needing for years instead of making me return for multiple visits. I would definitely recommend MPS to anyone looking for a great dental practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Callie G
user_reviews_extended.Description: i have been going here for probably 10 years and its been consistently great. i have had everything from teeth cleaning to root canals here and Dr. Schmidt always does a great job and has a flexible schedule. Dentistry work is no fun but if you gotta do it...i would recommend this place. i feel comfortable leaving my teeth in this teams hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The people here are REALLY nice and my cleaning was good (first visit), however I absolutely do not recommend for anything beyond a standard cleaning.

It was recommended that I get I believe there fillings and two of the three have caused me pain ever since. I now have to eat soft foods and it's still very painful. The first one came out in less than a week and the second failed after three weeks.

I've had filling before but not of this gritty and painful material used by this dentist.  I gave an opportunity for him to  repair to work because it's the fair thing to do. After a second failed attempt at a routine filling, I think it's fair to advise others to proceed with caution! I am healthy and before this, I never ever had dental problems. In fact, I used to LOVE going to the dentist and now I'm extremely nervous about ever going again. Save yourself the trouble and go somewhere else. Again, nice people - the whole office - but by far has been the worst dental experience of my life - I am 45.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Schmidt is excellent at what he does and I have confidence in him when he is working on my teeth.  He hires a very friendly staff who knows how to be gentle with your mouth.  Only interested in regular dental cleaning, but he offers cosmetic dentistry as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Wardle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had two great experiences at Masterpiece Smiles this week. Dr. Schmidt and the techs all seem to genuinely listen and care about your needs and concerns. The office is clean and comfortable and they even treated me to a little freebie for having to wait a few extra minutes, even though I didn't complain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elaine Casados
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a dental hygienist that has previously worked in the office of Dr. Joseph Schmidt.  I have worked in the dental field since 1974 and have seen a lot of dentistry.  He is one of the most talented dentists I have known.  You will definitely get superior dental treatment from Dr. Schmidt.  I would and have recommended him to my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caroline Limaye
user_reviews_extended.Description: All the staff and Dr. Schmidt are great in helping my 90 year-old mother with her cosmetic procedures as well as attending to her dental health. They are very accommodating, respectful and understanding of her needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Jaeger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Schmidt is a great technical and cosmetic dentist.  The three crowns I have are holding up well over time.  The ultrasonic hydro pics used by the hygenists leave a very clean mouth feel.  Appointments are generally on time with little waiting.  Do your own insurance and price research before getting work done instead of counting on the office generated treatement estimates.  It would also help if the office participated in more dental insurance plans.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yuma Landing
user_reviews_extended.Description: Do not let this dentist do anything more than a cleaning (If even that). I had 2 root canals in two molars performed by him and was not even advised to place crowns on the teeth. The teeth crumbled after 2 weeks. I was left with two spaces revealing only the roots.  The pain was severe and the gums near the root canals were blistered as if a  chemical type burn. I had sedation dentistry performed and was  completely knocked out so i am not sure what it was that caused the burns/blisters. . I paid  over $4,000 for the shoddy treatment and 4 years later had the roots removed. I have since gone to a better doctor and have had implants placed. I would not let this dentist do anything more than a routine cleaning and maybe even not that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fara Sams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Schmidt and the staff were very friendly and welcoming. And they take an extra effort to get to know you and to address your dental concerns. They were very thorough with their examination.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Asim Dhital
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is super friendly and Dr. Schmidt is just a joy to work with. He's extremely caring and honest. Having gone through a number of dentists I can finally say that I've found one that I can trust.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariana Calderon
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here were great, very welcoming and efficient. The office staff is   always able to get a convenient appointment time set up for me. I am seen, shortly after I come in and  spend little to no time in the chair. The exam and cleaning are very thorough and whitening trays are ready quickly.  I will be back the next time I am due for a checkup!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Tolly
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always enjoy my dental visits. Dr. Schmidt and his team are very knowledgeable and friendly. I highly recommend you schedule your next cleaning/procedure with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Tompkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Masterpiece Smiles was good from what I remember.  I have panic attacks when the word dentist is even mentioned to me but the staff and Dr. Schimdt were great in helping with this.   I have much more work to be done and will follow with him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Barclay
user_reviews_extended.Description: $800 for one with whitening session. Either criminally overpriced, or abject liars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jane or john doe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I did the Zoom teeth whitening. It is normally $600, but there was a groupon for $106! I called the receptionist, and she told me they would honor that price whether I went through Groupon or not. 1 point. I got there, and the receptionist asked me if I was excited. She instinctively knew that for a lot of people, teeth whitening is an "extravagance" or a 'treat' that comes dearly. I felt special that she understood this. 1 point. They have single-use "pre-loaded" toothbrushes in the bathroom for patient use. (They already have toothpaste on them.) 1 point. The general ambiance of the office was pleasant. The staff joked with me, and they ooohed and ahhhed after my successful treatment was complete. -MY TEETH LOOK AWESOME!!! ...1 point. i'm starting to feel a little throbbing, but I've got my tylenol, oragel, and a shot of vodka - so I'm set! And 1 last point b/c they have these cool ceiling tiles to look at while reclining. They have swallows flying in circles imprinted on them. ='s total 5 POINTS! ... Zoom is effective, but  i have a feeling it's like what Bette David said about aging: "It's not for sissies" -meaning, Zoom might be a bit much for sensitive mouths. YEA!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor K
user_reviews_extended.Description: Bought a Groupon for teeth whitening and didn’t make my appointment. They redeemed it without me being there so I was unable to trade it in. Also was unable to leave a review on the Groupon app because they blocked me from doing so. Scammers

user_reviews_extended.Name: richardjrenteria
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Schmidt , and all of the staff were very professional, and welcoming. They made me feel at home, were thorough with their work, and genuinely interested in getting to know me. I recommend visiting the crew at Masterpiece.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trang Le
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our family has been going to Dr. Schmidt for 20 years and we love his team and his care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Floyd
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very clean and professional environment. Everyone was very friendly, and welcoming. They were on time, and my teeth look amazing! I will definitely be going back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience at the office today. Courteous and professional staff, clean facility, great location. Dr. Schmidt  was very friendly. Will return.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alejandra Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and helpful staff, I did not feel like I was being rushed during the appointment. My teeth look amazing too. I will definetly be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haifa Hammami
user_reviews_extended.Description: On every account, the most professional and exceptional dentistry staff in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Gauthreaux
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had to have same filling re-done twice. In addition, also had a crown re-done twice because it was not put on correctly the first time. but Very friendly staff...

user_reviews_extended.Description: The best

user_reviews.Description: They were very friendly and Dr. Mendez was someone that made u feel very comfortable and just very easy to talk to. user_reviews.Description: Had a really great visit! Dr. Mendez did my fillings and also took care of a filling for my son, He was patient and made both of us feel comfortable. 10/10 Recommend!

user_reviews.Name: wynnie denny
user_reviews.Description:
I had to get 3 cavities, a crown, and a cleaning. Lots of work and a variety.

The communication from the doctors and hygienists was abysmal. They did not tell me what to expect during any of the work. No instructions on caring for a temporary crown. No communication about the process, the actual work it entails, or about follow up. Chat gpt had to answer all my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is fantastic. I came in for one problem and they spotted another and took care of me without having to come back again. I really appreciated that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabel Yuan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Even though dental appointments make me anxious, Dr. Mendez and his team are always so kind and gentle that each visit is a breeze. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aspen Gray Woodell
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental care I receive here is always the best! Dr.Mendez is amazing and always checks in to make sure no problems arise after any treatment. Front desk ladies and dental assistants are always so sweet as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ilena Goodkin
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time.  They were really nice and also very efficient. I felt comfortable and well-taken-care-of.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yifat Cohen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Let's start with the fact that my son's afraid of densists. He tries to avoid them as much as he can.

We came for an emergency treatment for him and the staff was super nice, friendly and professional.

We laughed, the doctor eased his mind and my son left feeling more confident and ready to return for the full treatment the next week.

I only wished they accepted my insurance too. 😉

user_reviews_extended.Name: Misty Woodell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Mendez and Michelle. If you’re searching for a top-tier dental experience in Austin, this is the team to trust.

From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and genuinely cared for. Michelle is incredibly gentle, thorough, and has a calming presence that makes cleanings surprisingly enjoyable. She explains everything she’s doing and gives helpful tips by just being organic, supportive and knowledgeable.

Dr. Mendez is an exceptional dentist—professional, attentive, and clearly dedicated to patient care. He takes the time to walk through your treatment plan, never rushes through appointments, and is always focused on long-term oral health, not just quick fixes. His attention to detail and steady hand are exactly what you want when it comes to dental work. His personality is aces too!

The office is spotless, modern, and runs smoothly. The front desk staff are super friendly and efficient, and it’s easy to see that the whole team works well together. They genuinely care, and it shows in every aspect of the patient experience.

I’ve recommended Dr. Mendez and Michelle to family, friends, and coworkers—and everyone agrees: this is the best dental care in Austin. If you want a dentist you can trust and a team that makes you feel like more than just a patient, look no further.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark McCarthy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wait was long, staff was nice. But they tried to charge me for services I did not ask for. Or the prices suddenly lowered when I declined the ones they did ask for. I also always remove one star for businesses that pester me for reviews.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Owen Powell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Pretty good. Love Randy and Dr. Mendez. Looking forward to them having the trial size goodie bag next time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheri minett-jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place. Soo friendly and love the dentists. Highly recommended

user_reviews_extended.Name: Priscilla Ortega
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about this dental office. After a traumatic experience at another clinic, I was extremely nervous about going back to the dentist. But from the moment I walked in, I was met with professionalism, kindness, and understanding. The entire staff was incredibly thorough and took the time to explain everything to me, which helped ease my anxiety. They made me feel genuinely cared for and comfortable every step of the way. I’m so grateful to have found a place where I finally feel safe and confident getting dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly staff, Dr. Mendez was phenomenal, anytime I felt pain he was very attentive to making sure that it was painless throughout the whole root canal process. They also make sure that the atmosphere is comfortable (as much as it can be haha) during the whole process. They were also very clear and concise about the dental plan, and according to my wife they're actually very inexpensive compared to a lot of other places. I work at an automotive dealership, so my dental insurance is probably the worst on the planet, and I still got a very low price for a root canal and crown.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Desiree Cadena Granados
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a pleasure coming here! Now my coworkers come here. Wonderful staff, wonderful service

user_reviews_extended.Name: B BS
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was different but they did a great job!! Thanks to all who were so friendly, polite and thorough. The only hiccup was I scheduled clean and check and initially they were doing just X-rays and exam. Hopefully that won’t happen next time .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shana Young
user_reviews_extended.Description: The whole team was friendly and accommodating.  I'm a "nervous" patient but was immediately at ease and had a relaxing exam and consultation with no pressure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tulsee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment I walked in everyone was incredibly friendly, office was spotless, and they were ready to help me right at my appointment time.

Big highlight to Dr. Desai for my Invisalign consult. I just knew I wanted straighter teeth, but he shares way more than what I knew about my teeth and its alignment and what it would look like in the long run. It helped solidify my decision then not only for aesthetics but preventative maintenance as well.

Can’t wait to see the results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brelyn Youngblood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is so nice and made me feel super comfortable when I was embarrassed about my teeth after pregnancy! Amazing place

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dusty Friday
user_reviews_extended.Description:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a great experience at Ideal Dental in Round Rock. The dental assistant who helped me, Aly (apologies if I’m spelling that wrong), was incredibly kind, gentle and attentive. She really listened to my concerns and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the entire visit. The dentist was also wonderful, very kind, patient, and took the time to explain what was going on with my teeth and helped me feel understood and heard. Overall, I’m extremely satisfied with my first visit here and look forward to coming back to get the rest of my dental work taken care of! Highly recommend, very professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: CLAIRE CHEN
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The dentist initially told me I had tooth decay deep inside and might need a root canal. But in the end, they only placed a crown — no root canal was done.

After the crown was placed, my tooth — which wasn’t bothering me before — suddenly became very sensitive and painful. When I went back, the dentist said it might get better over time… or it might just keep hurting. If the pain continues, they said I would need a root canal after all.

Their explanation? The cavity had been drilled too deep.

This approach really concerns me. First, they said I might need a root canal, then skipped it. Now that the crown is in, I’m told I might still need one — which would mean cutting off the crown I just paid for and making a brand new one.

It makes me feel like I’m stuck in a cycle of treatment that benefits the clinic more than the patient. I’d strongly recommend asking detailed questions before agreeing to any irreversible work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucky McGee
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was my first appointment with Ideal Dental. They were very thorough. I've never had so any scans and images taken of my teeth. The staff was welcoming.  My dental assistant (Ally?) was very caring and explained the steps she was taking.  Dr. Menendez addressed my concerns and came up with a priority list of actions.  Thank you Ideal Dental- Round Rock.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven Jackman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely recommend very friendly staff and very informative. Enjoyed my time there for yearly check-up and all of the staff attends to your needs. Customer service shows their number one priority.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theresa Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was so friendly, prompt and accommodating. I usually dread dentist appointments but they treated my 4 year old and I like family. They took their time going over my concerns and were empathetic. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kayla Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely horrible!! I called the day before and set up my appointment and gave my insurance. I have two broke teeth and came in 8 am to make sure I could get fixed (haven’t ate in two days). I came in and the front desk said in a very smart attitude, “you don’t have dental you have medical” I let her know nicely that wasn’t true and asked for her to check again. She said “well that’s the number you gave us to call they said it why don’t you call them”.
I showed her my work app that said I have dental and asked why they asked for the information last night if I had to do it and she rolled her eyes with a grin. Never have I ever been to an office where people are normally in pain and had such a rude person be who welcomes you in the door. She will kill this business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ram Chavarria
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff/ customer service. I’m very pleased!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mthiengkt Mendy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to this location for almost 3 years now and I can confidently say that they have the best customer service and dental care. The staff is amazing as a whole. Definitely makes my visit to the dentist a lot more comfortable!

It’s super clean and a great place to go to

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ed2015 D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice staff. I was told everything that was going to be done before they did it. Pricing was upfront so no surprise cost. Dentist explained everything in terms I could understand. She was very thorough and made sure that I knew everything that was going on. Very relaxing setting. State of the art imaging. I came here for emergency appointment but I will be making this place my permanent dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dylan Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: i left a local dentist after a very bad experience and drove straight here with no appointment and they addressed my problems and concerns immediately. all of the staff and doctors are absolutely amazing. they will for sure be my new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ezra Rex Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: The experiences here get better + better. Staff takes the time to listen to your perspective + will do their best to be proactive about any event.
