user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Fletcher
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kim & Miguel were awesome at making me feel comfortable. I hadn’t been to a dentist in over 10 years and had some anxiety about it. They were concerned with my safety and comfort the whole time. The office personnel is also top-notch!! So helpful and nice. Thank you for the amazing service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Izzy Gambino
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a chipped filling from another dentist. Ideal had me in and tooth fixed the same day. They were super friendly, really efficient, had me in and out in an hour with no discomfort or feeling like I was being rushed. Pricing was very reasonable. I'll be going here for my regular cleanings as well. For all the dishonest dentists out there, these guys are legit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Guadalupe Becerra (Lupita)
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not only do I go here but I’m also taking my mom here now too. Another dental office was trying to charge my mom a lot of money for a specialized deep dental cleaning although she takes immaculate care of her teeth. The dentist here agreed and said it wasn’t necessary. My mom is happy going here now. I’ve been going to this office for years and have always had a good experience too, both with the dentists and orthodontist. The staff is always friendly and the providers are  knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mrs. Dee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Recommended 100%. Amazing service. Staff super friendly. Place clean & smelled great. They explain services with detail & help you select the best way fot you to pay. Always w a smile.

Stop your search for a good dentist office ITS HERE IN IDEAL DENTAL for sure!!!!  Thanks for such amazing service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlie Lonidier
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at the Round Rock office of Ideal Dental are amazingly awesome. Dr. Kevin Mendez is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MR McKinnon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with going back to a dentist after years of avoidance for fears/bad service in the past. The staff and appointment notifications made it extremely easy to get in when it was convenient and to get insurance information sorted. I'd like to mention Raquel for her professionalism and outstanding attention to detail. The office is clean and welcoming. My procedure went super!! Cleanliness procedures in order. X-Rays and cleaning were quick, gentle, painless, and done with care. They really do care about your smile, made sure to ask multiple times if I had any questions or concerns and if there was anything else they could do and I felt so good I already booked my follow up! Highly recommended for any one left with a sour taste in their mouth (lol) from previous dental experiences. Great Job Dr Shyani I have found my favorite Dentist  <3

user_reviews_extended.Name: Farrar Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service, very able to work with you on payments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alejandra Ramos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Receptionist was welcoming and so nice! Raquel was great and fun to have help Dr. Dr Shyani has a great staff. They made the appointment run smoothly and great rapport! So great I’m moving my daughter to this practice ! 10 out of 10! Great customer service! Definitely coming back!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yairee Chavarria
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had great experiences at this location. They have been extremely helpful in assisting with my entire dental plan, financing issues and my overall concerns. I’ve recommended this location to my cousin and my mom and they are both very satisfied with them as well. Thank you so much to all the doctors and staff for being so patient and helpful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Ybarra
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time visit here today and staff was very friendly. They answered all my questions and made me feel really comfortable. They helped me out with treatment plan options as well over all great visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! We were new patients, they got my daughter in same week for a chipped tooth. They took care of that and a cleaning. The staff was friendly and professional and the office was very clean. I’ll be bringing both my kids back and coming her myself as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marisa Ceja
user_reviews_extended.Description: Visited this location recently for my 6 month check up & loved it! The location is very clean & welcoming. The staff was friendly & very professional. While you wait to see the dentist you can watch TV, definitely helped with the wait and is great distraction for anyone nervous about the dentist. I recieved x-rays & Dr. Dawson went into great detail about what I was seeing & how I could improve my oral health. I did receive 2 fillings which went very smoothly and was handled with great care. Dr. Dawson has great hands when it comes to dentistry. I would love to continue being treated at this location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sukanya Dave
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a smooth experience. Great people, they patiently explain everything. I liked how they provided tips to avoid gagging while getting X-rays done. Dr. Shyani is great with her advice and procedures, smooth hand, precise work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: elaene abella
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love going to dentist and letting someone else take good care of me and I am so glad I went to the perfect place! They have showed me the things that are going on inside my mouth during the initial visit and have proposed treatment plan that will work on my schedule and finances. The professionals in Brush32 are very friendly and accommodating. The moment you entered in their office, you will be welcome with smile and enthusiastic. I love it here and highly recommend to everyone!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frank Cheng
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was originally referred to this office by my kids pediatrician and it has definitely been the right fit for us.  The front staff is very personable and friendly and the dental staff made my daughters first dental appointments smooth and not terrifying at all. I myself am not a fan of the dentist, but after seeing how well my kids did I scheduled an appointment for myself. They are very courteous, professional and make you feel very welcome.  I highly recommend making this office your permanent place for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: carlos correa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mendez performed an outstanding service, very gentle and at all times making sure I was not in pain, I get extremely nervous going to the dentist and had to get more than normal dose of anesthesia but Dr. Mendez made sure to take care of me and Lupita did an amazing job as well assisting him throughout the whole process also making sure I was doing good. If you need someone who really cares for you and does an over the top job, this is the place you want to come!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve W
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in, convinced me to sign. up on their monthly dental plan to reduce prices.   After xrays received advice to pull tooth and they will only do it if i take gas for a $900 additional charge, i dont need gas so recommend out and scheduled for a deep clean.  No reminders sent for appointment or call the day before, missed thinking it was a week later and explained was I received no notification.  Rescheduled another week out, reminders came this time.  Worked my schedule to fit in the appointment.  At 8 am - an hour before appointment they call me to cancel due to plumbing issues.  Im done, front office nightmare here, cancelled my monthly membership will find a reliable dentist in area without the new hookm sign up for the club style, “ pay us every month, and one that can do what they say they will do.   Oh , found they sent me a reschedule at 3 am in the morning for my 10. am appointment.  ( you have to be kidding me!  OMG). - 4/18. ANOTHER OMF-  the tooth they wanted to pull for $1890, my new dentist said thats CraZy! The tooth is fine!  Disgusted by Ideal, found a reliable busy dentist, no winder they’re busy!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Mendez is very knowledgeable and explains in detail what he sees in the X-rays so you can really understand what’s going on.  He is very gentle and funny. I definitely recommend him and the RR office.  His staff is also very friendly.  Thanks Dr. Mendez ☺️

user_reviews_extended.Name: TCA Operations Manager
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had an appointment at this location, this was my third time here and I just wanted to take the time to provide some feedback. First the office is very clean and welcoming from the minute you walk in, someone is there to greet you with a smile. Most importantly, I had a last minute change in my work schedule during my last appointment. Both Anthony and Karina who I ended up speaking with that day, were very understanding about my situation. I went from having an 8 o’clock appointment, to calling them at 7:30 AM and been able to move it for the same day at a time that was convenient for me. I am not sure how they did it, been that it was super last minute, along with the fact that they are normally booked. But that to me was exceptional customer service, it will keep me loyal to Brush 32 for years to come! Highly recommend 🤓

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oscar Strong III
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience during my first visit was fast and meaningful. The staff was nice, and i was in and out no hassle!

user_reviews_extended.Name: laura sandoval
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I thought I mentioned the darling receptionist in my review but maybe took it out because I forgot her name....but it's Carina and she's awesome. She goes above and beyond.
I hate going to the dentist!! About 4/5 years I started having problems after not going for 26 years. I have been going every 6 months now (sometimes sooner if something comes up). Love everyone here! I highly recommend asking for Dr. Shyani she is awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Summers
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Did a great job with my Dental Anxiety. Very welcoming and Dr. Dawson went above and beyond to connect with me and make me feel as comfortable as possible. They did a great job of taking care of my teeth and helping me get back on track for healthy teeth and gums.

Dr. Dawson is no longer with Ideal dental, my experience has not been the same since she left.

user_reviews_extended.Name: lauren rifenburgh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have extreme dental phobia. Thousands have been spent on various therapies. I HAD to go see a dentist. My daughter said this office was great. She said they were kind, compassionate, and would respect my directives as needed. Well-she was right. I had called around and had some snarky receptionists- Ideal Dental have fantastic staff from reception through treatment. Every staff member was very considerate and oozed genuine care.  My tech (forgot name- was busy breathing & doing biofeedback) was exceptionally compassionate & thouroughly explained my needs, choices, and assured me she would stop any time I needed.  The DDS was equally kind. No judgements (and I can spot judging & fake concern from a mile).  In fact I did not feel any of my regular anxiety. I was amazed at their handheld x-ray that was non-intrusive. I really felt like I would not have a problem there at all. The consultation was the smoothest I’ve had ever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelina Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update: currently went back for a crown and I have to say it was the best experience. Way better than my other crown that was placed in a different location. Again Dr. Halloum was great she talked thru everything she was doing and after it was all done and healing I didn’t feel pain it was a wonderful experience! I am glad I found Dr. Halloum!

Great experience. Everyone was very nice. Loved how the Dr. Halloum explained everything and went into detail about what to do next. I been to other dental offices and never had a doctor be so thorough about my dental work. It was really nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: mia phipps
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at my first visit at Brush32 in Round Rock! Nathalie was super sweet and made me feel really comfortable. I had to have a filling done and was a little scared of the shot but it wasn't too bad and the dentist had it done really quickly. I would definitely recommend this dental office to anyone that might be worried about going to the dentist. They were amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kortney Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have to share my experience with Brush32 of Round Rock, because it isn't often you find such great care all around in the medical world. I had a few procedures done and the care team was so gentle and always checking on me to make sure that I was comfortable and not in any pain. They made the entire (long!) process much more enjoyable than I could imagine dental care ever being. They also have little TVs in the exam stations, so it's not your typical boring dentist visit! I can't rave about the care enough, but what really makes this place stand out to me more than anything is their front desk team, specifically Ashley. They are so kind and prompt, and make your appointments seamless from beginning to end. Ashley specifically gets a shout out from me, because I had some confusing billing questions and she was SO patient and kind with me the whole time. I knew there was something I wasn't understanding (turns out my insurance was providing me the wrong EOB, so I had incorrect information from them), but she never made me feel like she was annoyed to walk through everything with me, she emailed me all of the paperwork they had, and provided the best customer service I've had in a very long time. If you're looking for a dentist in the Round Rock area, you can't go wrong here, they are truly amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Raquel is patient and gentle, and explains what she's doing. SUCH a better experience than the first time I started invisalign !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really liked my experience here. Brush 32 was recommended to me by 3 people. Everyone is so friendly here. My old dentist’s office was very pushy on trying to sell me extra treatments I didn’t need, but no one tried to solicit me for anything here. In fact, I received free whitening trays for life as a new client.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maliyah Acuna
user_reviews_extended.Description: Definitely would recommend! Dr Mendez put my favorite jams on during my visit, my tech Raquel was an amazing! Front office explained everything as for my insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jimmy Ruzicka
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dawson and the front desk staff are an exceptional team! Dr. Dawson took great care of my  neglected teeth after not going to the dentist for about 3 years.. very pleasant experience and will accommodate to whatever it is that you are experiencing as far as dental hygiene. Great location, great experience, great price.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Destiny
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is great,I found them online and I'm glad I choose them. Upon going to Brush 32 in was very nervous  because I hadn't been to the dentist in years.  I went in for tooth pain and right away Jasmine made me feel relaxed! She assured me everything would be fine.After discovering that I needed two teeth pulled Jasmine helped me find a financial option that suited me! I didn't have to choose between my health and being over changed.  My nurse was Shanon  she is great,she walked me through everything she was doing. Dr Wang is very gentle and she got the two teeth causing me pain out in the same day! I love this place and I will return for future dental work! If u don't know where to go ,go to Brush 32 it was my first time but definitely not my last!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea Summers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Brush32 in Round Rock has been a terrific experience for my entire family. My husband and I have been seeing them since we moved from Washington 3 years ago. Recently I decided that I had had enough with our pediatric dentist due to recurring issues with one of my kids. In addition, my youngest would never let the pediatric dentist work on her teeth. She was terrified of him so we could never do a full cleaning. It took just one trip to Brush32. They were patient with my littles (6 and almost 4) and worked with them in a way that made it easy for them to accept the entire cleaning process. When we got home my youngest couldn’t stop talking about how much she loved going to the dentist and insisted on brushing and flossing even more. They are wonderful there. I could not recommend them enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margo Limon-DeAnda
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Awesome dentistry!! From the moment we walked in, to the moment we walked out, we were completely satisfied with our first visit. The staff were all very sweet, going beyond our expectations. Lakeshia the receptionist is absolutely wonderful! The dental assistance were fantastic and treated us with top notch service. Dr. Wong was amazing and explained our services thoroughly. I am moving over the rest of my family members to this particular location. We look forward to our next appt!! THANK YOU Brush 32 Round Rock for your superior service!!

6/28/18...Came back for my kiddos dental cleanings and again received high superior assistance!! This place totally rocks!! They are super sweet and go way & beyond for your dental needs. They are up front about the services rendered and cost before exercising. They really care about your dental health but at the same assist you on the financial behalf. My family and I look no further for any other dentist. We are one happy, satisfied family!  :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mindy Glaze
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As a new patient, I expected there to be more of a wait and paperwork hassle involved to get an appointment. I was pleasantly surprised that I was able to get in right away and the paperwork was minimal.

Everyone was very friendly and made sure that I was comfortable throughout the entire visit. I've never been to a dentist that actually showed me xrays and/or pictures taken of my teeth, so I enjoyed finally getting to see what the dentist / hygienist sees. It made my curious, nerdy brain happy. I look forward to my next appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Howlin' Waters
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Halloum is exceptionally thorough and knowledgable at her job, and very much aware of making the patient comfortable throughout the procedure - so glad I switched dentists and found her.

The staff are concientious and considerate and very attentive during the visit/appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Guerra
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was looking for a dentist close to home when I came across this office. The location is extremely convenient, but better than that, the entire staff is wonderful! Dr. Kennon Koenig was amazing and I'm looking forward to continuing my treatment under his care. He even followed up with me after my visit to ensure I was recovering just fine! The receptionist staff is extremely welcoming and makes you feel right at home. As far as insurance, I know I can't be the only one who gets stressed and doesn't understand everything. The staff made sure to break everything down for me so that I understood the billing of all the work I had done. They also helped me find affordable ways to receive the care I need. I HIGHLY recommend this dental office! You truly won't regret it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmine Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down my favorite place to go get dental work done. Thankfully my teeth are healthy and they help me keep them clean. Their communication is great and they’re customer service is warm and welcoming. The precautions they are taking due to COVID-19 are great and really appreciated. If it weren’t for their procedure to keep their patients safe during these times, I wouldn’t have gone in to get my cleaning. I’ve switched to them a year ago and I haven’t regretted it thus far!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jayden
user_reviews_extended.Description: Angela and karinna were amazing! Angela went out her way to get me in asap. My 2 year old done swung his head back and cracked my front tooth. I called around Rock Ideal Dental and Angela was able to get me in right away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: k “kYptory”
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone was so kind and patient and compassionate! From my 1st phone call to my visit. I have alot of work that has to be done and a deep fear of going to the dentist, they listened to me, asked me how I felt and why and let me know all my options and that I am in control. If I'm freaking out or uncomfortable or in pain we can stop at any point and figure something out. They work with you on your treatment plan and explain everything.

As I have alot that needs to be done I will be going back again in the next 2 weeks.

I would definitely recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tressa Paddock
user_reviews_extended.Description: WOW!!!!!!!!! I just had the BEST experience EVER at Brush32 in Round Rock, TX!!!! My dentist Alyssa C. Dawson made me feel so comfortable. I was so embarrassed because I needed so much dental work done and she made me feel like I was at home. She also helped me with a VERY affordable  package because she knew I was on a budget!!! All of the staff were amazing too!!!!!!!!!!!!! Thank you Brush32!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nina B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Halloum is SO SWEET and more importantly, patient which was very key for me when I brought my 11 yr granddaughter in today for her cleaning.
She was a happy camper and as a parent I’m very happy to finally find a dr who knows how to speak to kids and makes them feel comfortable for there future appointments.
Thank you Dr Hollloum and everyone on staff!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been going to another dental place for over 6 months and was unable to get my issue resolved. They also didn't seem to know what was going on or how to fix it. I would make an appointment and have to wait for over an hour to even be called back, then I would have to wait even longer to be seen. They were the hardest place to get ahold of as well. They didn't do any treatments on Saturdays and with my work schedule I always had to take time off. I decided to look into a different dentist, when I called Brush 32 in Round Rock i got through to someone right away and was able to get an appointment that week that worked with my schedule. When I got there the front staff was extremely nice, attentive, and just absolutely amazing! I was seen right at my scheduled appointment time too! The dentist and the dental assistant addressed all my concerns and were able to find the problem I was having and able to fix it. I've gone back since then and it has been nothing but a great experience. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ViTina Whalon Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Soo first off let me say I don’t like dentist after past bad experiences… This dental office was awesome 🤩, all the staff was professional, personable, and welcoming. The dentist did a great job observing any discomfort I had and adjusted his work accordingly, addressed reasons for concerns I have with sensitivity, gave me a plan of action that is attainable. Most importantly they informed me my teeth are in good health and here to stay😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bal Krishna
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience have been great with Ideal Dental Round Rock clinic, the staffs are friendly and easy to work with. A special mention Dr Dharti Shyani who looked into my case, she is quite efficient with her work, I do not have any complains after the treatment. Thanks for a wonderful service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Gardner
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the office staff, to the dentists, hygentists, and the office itself, everyone and everything here is wonderful. I first went here off the recommendation of a co-worker, I previously hadn't been to the dentist in years after moving to Texas and didn't know where to go. The staff is beyond friendly and very considerate, the office is clean and modern, and they do amazing work on your teeth. I have never been surprised with a bill or in pain from a procedure. I would recommend them to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leela Uppuluri
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited a few weeks back for my dental cleaning. All the staff members were so generous and took very good care of me during my visit. I was having an ease of mind with the treatment. Dentist Dharti Shyani helped me to know better about my teeths condition. Since I'm getting all my treatments done here from the last 1 year, everything seems to be normal and easy. I really appreciate and thank for all the help I'm getting from the nurses and the dentist Shyani for their tireless hardwork to put me healthy and safe. I definitely recommend this clinic as a one stop destination for all your dental issues.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Gonsalves
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would recommend this place to anyone and everyone. Had to get some emergency work done on my tooth and was so impressed I had to write a review, something I never do. They fixed my crackhead smile perfectly and efficiently. You can come here and not have to worry if your dentist learned from watching YouTube. Everybody here was very helpful and welcoming. If I had to come here every day I wouldn't mind lol. Anyways everybody should check it out. You won't be disappointed. Also Carina was really pleasant talking to on the phone :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Gholston
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was able to get in on a Saturday! Got in quick, got out and was pain free. Dr. Wang was great! Perla was great! The two girls at the front desk were great! Everyone was so friendly, caring and knowledgeable. I highly recommended Brush32 Dental in Round Rock! Thank you all so much! I will be returning for future dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janet G
user_reviews_extended.Description: My initial visit with Dr. Shyani was very good. She was so patient and answered all of my myriad of questions. My previous dentist didn't really explain well enough why certain dental work was necessary. But, after taking additional pictures of my teeth, Dr. Shyani was able to show and explain to me why the dental work would help keep my teeth healthier. Her assistants and front staff were friendly, knowledgable, very patient and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jewels Wellman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm so glad I found this place! They were able to get me in same day on a Saturday, which is incredibly convenient. I had a chipped tooth that they were able to repair immediately, without having been to the office before. Dr. Wang is fantastic and Perla, Jasmine and LaKesha had me worked up and in the chair in no time. I would definitely recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathan Vargas
user_reviews_extended.Description: In and out real easy, gave everything to me straight, and Dr. Halloum was excellent at making my feel comfortable and working on me teeth quick, without issue. Also shoutout to Sian as well for backup and finishing the cleaning. Teeth look and feel great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Murillo Resendez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was nice and professional. Kevin Mendez was awesome! This was my first time visiting Ideal Dental and plan to come back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M Essex
user_reviews_extended.Description: I normally dread dental cleanings but this experience was actually quite relaxing! Within an hour, I walked out of the office  with squeaky clean teeth and no discomfort.  The staff was incredibly pleasant and kind.   I definitely recommend this office!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eba Bejarano
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently relocated to the area and was searching for a great dentist. I lucked out finding Brush32 of RR! The entire staff was accommodating and very knowledgeable making my experience a great one. I have to go back to actually get some work done- this is the reason I've given 4 stars). I'll follow up my survey after having a crown replaced.

So far they've done a cleaning w/initial consultation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JC Falcon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Brush32, let me start off by saying that I like this establishment, its clean, the staff are very friendly and nice and they have very good prices or deals for the services they offer, the ONLY reason I'm not giving 5 stars is because of the quality of the service I received. I went in today to get a teeth cleaning, the staff were friendly and attentive so my experience started off great, once my cleaning started I noticed that it started to feel a little rushed and that some of the things I would expect to be done during a cleaning weren't. For example, I have a permanent retainer for both my top and bottom teeth so I need a special flossing tool, during the flossing phase, to get in to the crevices where the metal covered. Or even a probing of my gum lines, to make sure my gums are healthy.  By the time the cleaning was done I left feeling like "yes, my teeth were cleaned, but they didn't feel as clean as I have gotten at establishments like castle dental". Upon further examination once I got home, my teeth had just an "okay" clean look, and not that "deep clean" type of look you could expect after receiving a good cleaning. I've been getting dental work done on my teeth for years, so I know what a good teeth cleaning looks like, and as I previously stated, I like this establishment because of the atmosphere and good customer service, they just need to amp up their quality of the service being given, and my review will instantly be 5 stars.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Acacia Douglas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and knowledgeable staff, always a great experience here. I've visited multiple times for various work done and no issues at all. They work with you and care especially if you start feeling any pain, most other dentists would just have me run with it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobby Davidson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have known Dr. Caballero and her staff for many years and this is what I have experienced. Basically its ALL FIRST CLASS from newly built facilities to state of the art equipment to the smiling faces of the staff.

Its high tech teeth stuff with high touch care. It's a new approach to dentistry. It's a new and better experience in dental care. Their prices are in line with market, if not better, delivering excellent value. Ask for the cleaning & whitening package. It is the best value in town, really! And above all, selecting a dentist in some ways is no different than selecting a new mechanic, you've got to be able to trust their work and I have the highest regard for Dr. Caballero's integrity.

It's an impressive family business. Give them a try. Your smile will be grateful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: C P (Baba Yaga)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Military family and new to the area. First thing I always ask is if they are in my Network of care so I don’t get a surprise bill. I called all three Brush 32 looking for an oral surgeon for my son and every facility was SUPER NICE on the phone. They made me smile over the phone. user_reviews_extended.Name: Vikki Tippins-Watters
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Terrible place with those who have dentist anxiety. Was denied treatment.

I had an awful first experience at Brush 32 today ans would give no stars, if I could. I made an appointment via ZocDoc, for x-rays, an exam and a cleaning. To say that I get anxious at the dentist would be an understatement. Even with nitrous, my last dentist prescribed 2 valium (lowest dose, just 5mg each) before each visit, so I looked for a dentist that advertised anxiety and pain management options, and specifically asked about it in the initial inquiry. Brush 32 called fairly quickly, saying they had to reschedule me to a later appointment, but were good at working with people who have anxiety at the dentist. I let her know I would be bringing a current valium prescription to use if needed, and agreed to the $70 nitrous fee for the actual cleaning. Upon arrival, I was reminded of the $70 nitrous, signed a form saying I would pay it and checked the box for having anxiety. So far, the staff had been very understanding, and I really appreciated it. But that’s when it all went downhill.

The assistant discussed my past bad dental experiences at length as she did my x-rays. I let her know I was doing fine so far, but would take a valium if I needed it later. Their x-ray procedure uses a hard, domino-sized digital camera that you hold inside your mouth at various angles.  It was okay at first, and then the assistant needed to put it in diagonally and sideways, which gouged the side of my gums, digging painfully into my tongue and the roof of my mouth. After a while of that, I was in pain and getting anxious, so she offered an alternate x-ray method and I decided to head the anxiety off at the pass, and took two with a cup of water she gave me. A few minutes later, the same front desk woman came over, asking if she had remembered to tell me that the nitrous was an extra $70. Yes, she had. “Are you sure? It is $70 and insurance won’t cover it…” Huh? Do people usually try to run out on the nitrous fee or something?

The dentist comes in, scrapes my teeth a little, looks at the x-rays for a minute and says I need a very deep cleaning, which requires shots in the gum, or they can try a topical. I said that I REALLY preferred nitrous, but if she could give me another few minutes or so, the valium would take full effect and I’d be willing to try it with only the topical anesthetic and we could go from there. She leaves and after a moment, a completely new woman comes in and tells me that now that I’ve taken valium, the dentist (who has spent maybe 3 of the 45 minutes I’ve been there with me) refuses to treat me, and that I should really just leave and find another dentist or better yet, a periodontist, who could sedate me.  She says that they *would* have treated me, but I took valium to calm down, which could slow my system too much, so no. Seriously? After checking with people at every single step of the way about this issue, NOW they’re going to tell me that it’s a problem?? I understand they could have concerns about interactions, but that’s why I had been so sure to be completely transparent about my anxiety level, and need for assistance. If anyone at any point had said that I could only use one method of anxiety management and not both, I could easily have found another dentist, or simply chosen to hope the topical anesthetic and nitrous would be enough and not take the valium at all. But instead, I sat there, wasted my afternoon, got skin scraped off of the inside of my gumline from their x-ray camera, and was made to feel like I had done something shameful by taking legally doctor-prescribed medication. I was shown out of the office and left to sit outside waiting for my ride, in what was by then, a pretty altered state. Now, I get to start all over again, with another bad dentist experience under my belt.

Brush 32 really dropped the ball on this one.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been a fan of dentists but going here changed my mind. They were so nice and understanding and didnt make me feel bad about how many cavities I had. Anytime someone asks me a good dentist to see I will be recommending brush32.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gildalorena Martínez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
[En español abajo]

Warning: This has been the worst experience in my life at a dentist’s office. In short, I ended up losing a tooth and this clinic denied responsibility.

I didn’t have any pain when I visited them for the first time to replace an old crown. But from the moment the dentist Mr. Kevin Kim treated me, I had pain.

Kim told me it would go away and placed the permanent crown. But it didn’t go away and he ended up telling me to visit a specialist (note: if you need an endodontics specialist, this clinic admits it doesn’t have them). This clinic failed to solve the problem it had caused, and its office staff treated me with indifference and little empathy.

I spent months without being able to chew with the right side of my mouth. My current doctor couldn’t see the root of the problem in the X rays because the crown Kim had placed blocked the view of what was happening underneath. It wasn’t until the crown was removed that I learned that my tooth was fractured. The crown was covering the fracture. My doctor had to remove the pieces of what remained of my broken tooth. I lost my tooth and had to pay $6,000 for an implant.

The clinic thinks we’re even because they reimbursed me for the cost of the crown. But the implant I ended up paying for was much more expensive than the crown I initially went for. They didn't assume responsibility because they said the crown looked just fine in the X rays. But they can’t explain why I went into their clinic without pain and left with pain that lasted for months and led to the loss of my tooth.

So who pays for those months of pain and the tooth I lost? Before being treated by Kim or this clinic ask yourself: How much is a tooth worth to you?

Update: The clinic responds below expressing concern and promising to escalate my case. To be clear, I spent weeks of back and forth with a regional manager. She told me their clinical team had discussed my case and decided not to take any further action. She did not give me a clear explanation why so she promised she would put me in touch with their clinical team. She never did. In their below response, the clinic promises they will reach out to me; they haven’t either. This clinic takes great care in showing concern publicly but doesn’t follow up in real life.

*****

Advertencia: Esta ha sido la peor experiencia de mi vida en un consultorio dental. En corto, terminé perdiendo un diente y esta clínica se negó a hacerse responsable.

No tenía ningún dolor cuando visité esta clínica por primera vez para reemplazar una corona vieja. Pero desde el momento que el señor Kevin Kim me practicó la endodoncia, presenté dolor.

Kim me dijo que pasaría y me puso la corona permanente. Pero no pasó. Terminó diciéndome que no podía resolver el problema que había creado y me dijo que buscara a un especialista (subrayo: si necesitas un especialista en endodoncias, esta clínica reconoce que no los tiene). No sólo nunca tuve solución por parte del consultorio, sino que recibí indiferencia y poca empatía.

Pasé meses sin poder masticar con el lado derecho de mi boca. Mi doctor actual no podía ver el problema en los rayos x porque la corona que Kim me había puesto no dejaba ver lo que estaba pasando abajo. No fue hasta que me quitaron la corona que me enteré que mi diente estaba fracturado. La corona estaba tapando la fractura. Tuvieron que extraer los pedazos de lo que quedaba de mi diente destruido. Perdí mi diente y tuve que pagar $6,000 por un implante.

La clínica piensa que estamos a mano porque me regresaron el costo de la corona. Pero el implante que terminé pagando fue mucho más caro que la corona por la que fui inicialmente. La clínica no asume responsabilidad porque dicen que la corona se veía bien en los rayos x. Pero no puede explicar por qué entré a su clínica sin dolor y salí con un dolor que duró meses y terminó con la pérdida de mi diente.

¿Quién me paga por los meses de dolor y el diente que perdí? Antes de recibir servicio con esta clínica o este señor Kim pregúntate: ¿cuánto vale para ti uno de tus dientes?

user_reviews_extended.Name: maria magdalena meza mejia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excelente servicio, mui amables todos .la chica de recepción super paciente😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lorina Rangel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Personal eficiente y muy amables

title: Maple Dental
address: 275 SE Inner Loop Suite 105, Georgetown, TX 78626, United States

user_reviews.Name: Jeanie Whatley
user_reviews.Description:
I've never been to a dentist office like this in my four decades thus far. Sure, the interior looks standard, but that's not why it's so different, so special even.
Living in Georgetown, I was so excited to have a non franchise practice so close to where I live. I literally watched the practice get built and officially open their doors. I walked in, and they did not disappoint.

This perfectly sized healing hub is run by TWO of the most absolutely incredible women I will ever meet. They set a high bar with genuine warmth, kindness, compassion, knowledge, confidence, patience, competency, efficiency. Their communication to the patients,  and just as important, to each other. They're thoughtful, your level of comfort is always monitored, your understanding of what's going on, and answering your questions with honesty and with clarity without that feeling other dentists give of rushing and not listening.
They are both extremely thorough and helpful.
These two women are inspiring to watch. The teamwork is unmatched and builds patient confidence.

Come on over and see what two women can do that MANY fully staffed big clinics can't and couldn't do. Its beautiful really.
They are in constant communication with one another. On the same team. Helping each other. Respectfully speaking to one another. Like two seasoned bartenders during St. Patrick's Day where no one is Irish. Irish can hold their liquor 😉

From front desk responsibilities to physician assistance to patient associate to xray tech, to hygienist, and never shows that she doesn't actually love doing it.
THAT'S a real gift, a welcomed change of pace, and something I do not take for granted. Plus, it's fun to see and hear in action. Well oiled machine 🤘
The doctor is in a class of her own. So sharp, kind, humble, astute, shows genuine care and concern for your well-being beyond your dental health. Makes sure your comfort is maintained throughout. She does the most loving extras steps just to make you feel better.
She's extremely knowledgeable, skilled, confident, thorough, attentive, and patient.
She's a dreamboat. They both are.
OR, the Dental Goddess Dentya or the Dental Goddess Peridontia 😉😁

They both go out of their way to be of any help possible in every area possible. And never, ever, make you feel like a burden.

I find them both inspiring as individuals, darn proud and grateful to be under their care. Welcome to Georgetown. I'm glad you're here 🫶

Book 'em now. Thank me later.

user_reviews.Name: Ozair Tariq
user_reviews.Description: The staff at Maple Dental are amazing and very accommodating. I had 3 cavities removed today and it was chilly in the office for my liking. So they even brought be a blanket to wear during the procedure. No other place is like this place. 5 stars all the way.

user_reviews.Name: Sarah Lynn
user_reviews.Description:
I went to Dr. Kumar for a cleaning and whitening before my wedding, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. She and her assistant, Stephanie, are both so friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. They take the time to listen, explain everything clearly, and make sure you’re comfortable every step of the way.
After working in the dental field for 12 years, I know a great dentist when I see one, and I’m thrilled to have found my new dental home here. Dr. Kumar not only got me wedding-ready in a short time, but also helped create a plan for achieving the smile I’ve always wanted. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Daisy De La Cruz
user_reviews.Description: If you haven’t been to a dentist in a while, this is the place you want to be! The staff is just so wonderful and Dr. Kumar is thorough, patient and non judgmental. Looking forward to my next cleaning! (Who says that) lol

user_reviews.Name: D Mugica
user_reviews.Description: ​"Maple Dental is hands-down the best experience I’ve had. After visiting three different dentists in the last six months, I only wish I had come here first. The entire team attended to me from start to finish, and their prices are very reasonable. The office is incredibly clean, and the staff is both knowledgeable and friendly. Most importantly, they made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire visit. The doctor clearly knows exactly what she is doing. I’ve already recommended them to my parents—thank you, Maple Dental, for the awesome service!"

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Brannon
user_reviews.Description:
The dentist who operates this office is top notch. At first I was reluctant because during a checkup she identified more issues than I thought I could possibly have. So I went to get a second opinion. But she was right on and her prices were much lower than the local competition.

The Doctor is fast and thorough. She is professional and believes in gentle dentistry. The ambient music, the cool air, and good anesthesia made my visit go so smoothly! And I had a lot of work to do.

user_reviews.Name: tia beam
user_reviews.Description: From the start the Kelsey at the front desk offered amazing customer service. She was friendly, knowledgeable and efficient. The assistant who took x-rays was thorough and very personable. Dr. Kumar was amazing with being detailed in explaining what the process was for a new patient exam, did a thorough exam and cleaning SAME DAY. no sales pitch, no up selling and by far the most professional, positive experience I’ve had in Georgetown. I highly recommend to everyone this is the place to go. Her team was amazing!

user_reviews.Name: Rachel Stern
user_reviews.Description: Dr Kumar ans Stephanie are great. They are kind and patient. They have done a great job on my teeth. I also bring my toddler here too and they take time to help her feel comfortable.  Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: patrice parma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Kumar is a good DDS and is way more thorough than my previous DDS. The X-rays they took in her office were better and more conclusive than the prev DDS I went to. I highly recommend her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely amazing team! Best dentist I have been too in years.

Staff is nothing but nice and make you feel welcomed. I have very bad anxiety and they made be feel safe and cared for.

If I could rate more than 5 stars I would.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janis Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First Visit today.
ALL the staff & Dentist were wonderful.
Cordial, Friendly, Explained all procedures.
Discussed billing before procedures.
Could’ve ask for a better practice.
Glad I found them!
Definitely will be returning &
taking my family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karisma Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.kumar is very nice, very professional and very thorough. She has me in and out in a timely manner. All of the staff is amazing and friendly, always great service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sevara Sobhani
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing dental care and honest, transparent pricing. It's a wonderful local business, they make you feel cared for and remember important details about you (including your children's and your husband's name) and treat you like family.

Thank you, Dr. Kumar and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Coleman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Literally the best experience I've had at a dentist's office. The staff was so kind and welcoming. Dr. Kumar was professional, attentive, and she explained everything clearly. The entire visit was efficient without feeling rushed. I'm so glad I found my new dental home!"

user_reviews_extended.Name: T G
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Kumar is very sweet and she really takes her time explaining the procedures. I am very surprised she does her cleanings herself!
I will definitely come back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Virginia Leo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kumar and Stephanie went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable during all of my visits! They're not only highly professional but also super welcoming, friendly and caring people. They are my absolute go to for any dental care, thank you so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: sara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Every part of Maple Dental has been amazing from the moment I walked in the door, and I’ve spent A LOT of time with them over the past year haha. Stephanie, the hygienist, is so thoughtful and kind and remembers so much about her patients that it’s impressive. She makes it feel like I’m hanging out with a friend who happens to just be really great at dentistry too 😂. Dr. Kumar is also fantastically kind, she has such a calming energy and such an amazing ability to read body language and adjust to make you more comfortable. Her skill and educational background are extremely apparent in the work she does, from the start Ive felt very comfortable trusting her recommendations and being under her care. The team here really has taken me from having extreme dental anxiety and a past of being shamed by dentists for the state of my teeth to not minding being in the chair (even almost falling asleep during several visit lol) I’d highly reccomend them for any service!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ivonne Tostado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an extraction and my experience has been wonderful.  Great staff and very professional.  Highly recommend Maple Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent care! I had a wonderful experience here. Very exceptional staff and thorough treatment. Would definitely recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabrina Khan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Maple Dental has a magician for a dentist! Dr. Kumar has transformed my teeth and restored them to health. We found this charming dentistry to be wonderfully situated, exceptionally clean, and offering exemplary service for both myself and my children. For our kids, they offered gentle care and helped put the girls at ease.

For me, I was just as nervous as the girls and they offered no end of comforts such as blankets and gentle inquiries as to how I was feeling which made the procedure pleasant. I felt I was in not only in very capable hands but also very kind and compassionate ones.

They have excellent customer service and responded immediately to any concerns that arose, resolving them efficiently and with great kindness. I highly recommend Dr. Kumar and her team, as they bring all the warmth of a small town dentistry merged with the skill and expertise of a highly professional and capable dental team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gil Salazqr
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very punctual. Duration of deep cleaning went as stated. Very professional team. Will go back again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neha Rathi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Meenal Kumar was very patient with my 6 year old. She recommended the best options for him & provided everything in great detail. The staff is very friendly especially Stephanie. She made sure my son was comfortable as it was his first time at the dentist. Would highly recommend Maple Dentistry

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tahlea Wetherby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kumar and Stephanie are awesome! I was just in for a couple of fillings and this is the best my bite has ever felt after a filling and I was in and out in 40 minutes. They are warm, friendly and incredibly professional! Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Dominguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I started going to Maple Dental almost a year or so ago now.  Since then, my daughter’s family and my parents have started going based off my referral.  The staff are so sweet and helpful each and every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Hlavin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very efficient and welcoming. Dr. Kumar is an excellent clinician and technician. I had tooth pain and got in to see her the same day along with extensive treatment. I am grateful to her and Stephanie for the wonderful care. I am now a patient of the practice :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casidy Creed
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have never felt more safe and secure at a dentist office. They take time to listen to you and actually care for you as a patient. They accommodated to my schedule to get me an appointment and helped me understand the best hygiene practices! Highly recommend.
Update: been with them over a year and they treat me like family. Love this group.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chanelle J Flood
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had my first dental cleaning and treatment plan at this office recently, and I have to say, it was a surprisingly positive experience. Unlike some past experiences, I didn't feel the least bit uncomfortable.

What truly stood out to me was the non-judgmental and caring approach of the provider. Their sweet spirit and genuine concern for your well-being shine through. You can tell that they truly want what's best for you, and that made all the difference.

I can confidently say that I won't hesitate to continue coming to this office for my dental needs. They've won me over as a patient, and I genuinely appreciate their approach. If you're someone who, like me, experiences anxiety when it comes to healthcare checkups, please don't worry. Trust that you're in exceptionally good hands here.

This recommendation comes straight from the heart, and I can't emphasize enough how positive my experience was. They have a loyal patient in me, and I'm sure you'll feel the same way. ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: ford vantyle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Stephanie and Dr. Kumar were awesome!  I’m a new patient and found the office to be very welcoming!  I went in for a teeth cleaning and upon finding some issues, which they showed me images of, they addressed them right there on the spot.  They even helped explain my insurance coverage before doing any work which was a huge plus to me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shantell Hadley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is my dental office of choice.  I recommend Maple Dental in Georgetown, TX.  The team is attentive, personable, thorough, and provides great customer services.  The office is clean, organized, and comfortable.

The lobby gives you an at home vibe.  It is quiet and comfortable.  You don’t have to wait hours to be serviced and each visit is catered to your comfort level and educating you on better dental health and the importance of managing your dental care effectively.

user_reviews_extended.Name: the hoff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic staff and the dentist They spent so much time explaining everything to me. So many dentists are more concerned with the business aspect of their practice and here, it's is all about patient care. Easy location, clean office and I finally found my new dentist after relocating from a different state. They do Amazing Crown Work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Javier Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is great! The whole staff was a pleasure to work with. Shout out to Stephanie for going the extra mile to make sure I was comfortable and relaxed throughout my procedure. I highly recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leigh Ann Frank
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Kumar & Stephanie were great on my 1st visit yesterday.   Thank you ladies for a wonderful job!  I will be back soon.  The dental office was very cleaned!!  Both ladies take time & patience with your service.  They Don't over book appointments to give enough time to assist your dental needs.  Thank you!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marla Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: My appointment was easy to schedule and I am happy to find this dental practice in Georgetnot not too far  from where I live. I liked that they gave me a squeeze ball for stress relief without me asking. Receptionist and dentist are great and personable. I liked the music feed and the fact that the dentist asked if I still wanted it on or not. Of course, I wanted it on. The big screen to look at my pictures and x-rays was very helpful for me to be able to understand the issues. They were patient with me even though I was a bit late to the appointment. I like that for the next appointment the receptionist set the time for it to be 10 minutes earlier than the actual appointment because I had mentioned to her that I run late a lot. So she said my appointment starts at 1:20 p.m. rather than 1:30 p.m. That way there will be time for the numbness to take effect and my appointment not run into other appointments after that. Overall good experience. I am only disappointed that this practice has not been approved as  a dental HMO provider yet even though they have applied quite awhile back. I hope that the approval will come sooner than later!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephenie Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Maple Dental with Dr Kumar was absolutely excellent. She is much more involved in the cleaning, polishing, and overall visit than compared to my experiences at other practices. She is reassuring, efficient, attentive, and gives excellent patient education during all procedures. My cleaning was easy and my fillings were uneventful - I couldn’t ask for better. Thank you for a wonderful experience during a chore that is usually dreaded. I will be a long term patient and am completely happy with all things.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam J
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! Dr. Kumar and team answered all my dental questions and got me taken care of.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizzy Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful experience! The entire staff was so friendly and personable! Dr. Kumar was so gentle during my cleaning! She made sure to explain everything she was doing and I was completely at ease. 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Cantalupo
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit to Maple Dental and I was truly impressed by Dr. Kumar and her assistant Stephanie.  After a bad experience at another local dentist I was not excited about getting dental work done.  Stephanie assured me I would be in good hands.  She helped me with paperwork and answered all my questions.  Dr. Kumar was professional, knowledgeable and kind. She explained everything she would be doing and even showed me a short video about the procedure I needed.  I am happy to have found a dentist I trust!

user_reviews_extended.Name: P of 4 Family Vacations
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m so glad to have found Maple Dental. They are conveniently close to me. They are gentle and very attentive and make sure you know exactly what they are doing and that you are comfortable. I’ve been to dentists where they don’t care that you are hurting. In fact they use your chest as resting place for their elbows. Simply ridiculous. Anyway, if you are looking for very good dentist, a clean and modern dental office, give Maple Dental of Georgetown a try.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rings of Saturn Band Official
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kumar and Stephanie at Maple Dental were very kind, professional, and honest about the procedures that were needed. The exam, X rays, and cleaning were all very skillfully done. The prices were reasonable, and each step of the process was thoroughly explained to me beforehand. This was honestly the best experience I have had with a dentist, and I would highly recommend Maple Dental to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney Rinker
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a wonderful experience! The team at Maple Dental made me feel right at home. Thank you Stephanie & Dr. Kumar! Dr. Keenan Kumar is incredibly knowledgeable and friendly. She took her time with me and made me feel comfortable. She was filled with helpful recommendations. Thank you!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Bača
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kumar is great! I like that you get to sit in the chair for an X-ray instead of going to another room. The regular cleaning was quick and done extremely well. All of the staff is also very friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcus Fields
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my 3rd visit to this dental office and each visit has been great. Dr. Kumar and her staff have been very receptive and helpful on each of my visits and for all of my questions. 10/10 I’d recommend Dr. Kumar for all of your dental needs. And the office is very clean. They play relaxing music for me each session.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Mims
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kumar and Stephanie are great! I’ve always received excellent care at Maple Dental, never have to wait long for an appointment and they have always make me feel so comfortable in their office. My husband has recently switched to Dr. Kumar also and is very happy with the care there as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sylvia Pedley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved Dr. Kumars' personal care and attention to her patients, and my teeth have never felt so clean!! The office was so immaculate and almost new. It was easy to find and get to, so I would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Simonds
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first appointment with Dr. Kumar yesterday and it was really great. The office was nice and very clean. I completed all the forms on their website and it was extremely easy. Took a bunch of x-rays, examined my gums, did a cleaning, and even filled a cavity on the spot. prices were very good and can’t wait to start the rest of the treatment plan we made!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Autumn Melton
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time here and loved it! Very welcoming!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steph
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I'm a new patient and came in today for a routine cleaning. I actually arrived earlier than expected and they were still able to accommodate. Calling to set up an appointment date with Stephanie and filling out new patient forms online were a breeze. She's very responsive.

Dr. Kumar did a meticulous examination and addressed areas of concern without being judgemental or condescending. Another thing I also really admire is that she doesn't place the burden of advocacy on the patient. A lot of other offices will only take more detailed photos or scans once a patient complains about specific problem areas.

I especially recommend this place for anyone with dental anxiety or sensory issues. The team explained everything in detail (and consulted my insurance policy) before performing any procedures. They also gave me a heads up for any grating noises that may naturally come from any of the dental equipment. The dental equipment itself is very up-to-date, which speeds up the whole process.

Some other things to note:

- Great hospitality. They offered refeshments before and after my treatment.

- Advertised additional services like whitening or orthodontics without being pushy

- Oral cancer screening was much more thorough compared to some other places I've been to

- Calming music

- Cozy lobby. Doesn't feel cold and medical.

- Building is easy to locate and has ample parking

Excited to return!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: capzaleksys
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This will be our new family dentist.
New technology, gentle and friendly,
also thorough. Pain free deep cleaning without the shots! Just saying, you’ll be glad you checked them out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haj
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First experience was nice. Dr Meenal was nice and looked/ checked every tooth I was concerned about. She addressed every issue and walked me through the process.
Cleaning was smooth and fast

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dustin Amy
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Maple Dental is committed to transparency and patient comfort. I was very pleased at the effort taken to make me comfortable and at ease. Everything was explained simply and efficiently. They have my recommendation if you are looking for a new dental practice.
