I very rarely post reviews on google but the Old Settlers dental certainly deserves more stars than is allowed.

I have been seeing Dr Zavala for nearly fifteen years and he has always exceeded my expectations. On occassion I have seen Dr Lewcock and he is a great dentist as well.

If you are looking for compassionate and comprehensive dentistry this is the place for you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Molly
user_reviews_extended.Description: We absolutely adore this office! We have been patients here for  six years, and the experience has consistently been exceptional. The entire team is professional, kind, and truly makes you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in. They take their time explaining everything and never make you feel rushed. My son just started Invisalign here, and the process has been seamless and encouraging. We couldn’t ask for a better dental experience. Highly, highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronika Pachunuri
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient of Dr. Lewcock at Old Settlers Dental for the past 2.5 years, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. I’ve had extensive dental work done, including crowns, veneers, implants, and regular cleanings, and every single procedure has been top-notch. Dr. Lewcock is highly skilled, thorough, and genuinely cares about his patients’ comfort and results. The entire staff is professional, kind, and consistently makes each visit smooth and stress-free. I truly trust this team and highly recommend them to anyone looking for exceptional dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica Ortega
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for 15+ years! Dr. Zavala & his team are amazing! Jessica who is my hygienist, is so amazing! Always makes sure I am comfortable and does her job well! Will continue to be seen by them and recommend them to my Family & Frinds!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meredith Nidoh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hate going to the dentist and have horrible dental anxiety due to poor experiences at other places. But the dental hygienist Alyssa and Dr Lewcock are phenomenal. They make me feel so comfortable. They are understanding of my anxiety and do what they can to help me. I have always had great experiences with them and I think anybody would be lucky to have them as part of their dental team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charles Pribble
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We had our six month checkups and cleanings at Old Settlers Dental Office in Round Rock this week.  We truly love the practice.  When we moved from The Round Rock area a couple years ago, we tried a different dentist in our new community.  It just wasn’t the same!!!

We are so happy to be back.  Everyone is so professional and fun.  The hygienists and dentists are fabulous and very experienced.

Thank you to everyone at Old Settlers for making our dental visits comfortable and enjoyable.

Chuck P.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentists in Round Rock! I have never had a more gentle dentist than Dr. Lewcock, and Jessica has been keeping my teeth clean for years! Love these guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Morrow
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly. Knowledgeable. Tenured employees which to me means great leadership. Dr was kind, precise, personable. They had a great plan for me. Not over diagnosing anything or requiring care that was unnecessary. Made me feel at ease and thankful for me trying them. I drive an hour to their office and it was well worth the miles.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sai Kiran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely the worst dental experience I’ve ever had. There is zero transparency in billing—they do not provide an estimate upfront and keep adding services without informing you of the charges. The entire process feels more like a sales pitch than a dental visit. After my appointment, I checked reviews and saw many similar complaints about unethical billing practices. The staff is rude and unprofessional, and customer service is terrible. Never go here. This is the worst dental office I’ve encountered.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bako
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hate going o the Dentist but Old Settlers Dental made it the most pleasant experience.  Very nice staff from start to finish and had modern tools that made the procedures tolerable, lol. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ian Ellis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience, lovely service from friendly and knowledgeable staff! Great communication, insight, and individual care. They listened to my questions and provided valuable feedback resulting in a painless, calming, and enjoyable experience. Highly recommend! Thank you to Hayley, Alyssa, and Dr. Lewcock for the considerate care and attention!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raul Vargas
user_reviews_extended.Description: My personal experience with Old Settles Dental is quite pleasant, the entire team is amazing. After talkin to Dr. John Zavala and his team. I realize I was in good hands. Alyssa did an amazing job on taking care of my teeth. Hayley took very good care of me on the concerns and questions I had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Inez Cardoso
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love the service that I receive from my hygienist Lisa. I have been coming to her for  the past 10 years and I would highly recommend her. Every visit is filled with a welcoming atmosphere and the sense of security. Thank you to Dr Lewcock! He has always been amazing and taken good care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wendy Robbins
user_reviews_extended.Description: First impressions were great. Beautiful facility, and the dentist and hygienist were both great. I predict having positive experiences with this choice for my new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luke heiman
user_reviews_extended.Description: one of the best dental experiences I’ve had. Everyone was super nice and made the whole thing feel really easy. What I appreciated most was how clearly they broke down what my insurance covered and what I’d have to pay… no guessing or awkward surprises when it’s time for check-out. I actually left feeling educated about my teeth & my dental insurance coverage, which never happens at the dentist. Highly recommend OSD!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessi Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: I remember absolutely nothing about walking into the building before having my wisdom teeth pulled because of the medication I had been prescribed, but I was told it went smoothly, and I am experiencing no pain (not on painkillers)And minimal bleeding even on day two!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana Garduno
user_reviews_extended.Description: The gentlest cleaning I’ve ever had! I needed to have my new porcelain crown set today But before I could do that, I need to get a cleaning done. I get so nervous going into procedures, but everybody made me feel so comfortable from the friendly front staff Alex and Yari, to the hygienist Jessica to the assistant Sarah It was the smoothest dental visit I’ve had in years!! Dr. Lewcock is a perfectionist and made me love my teeth again! I highly recommend coming here! You won’t regret it! 😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was the best dental filling experience that I have ever had.
Dentist took his time to make sure the numbing agent was working.  Once everything was good to go - he was fast and efficient  - I think the filling took 10 minutes - my jaw DIDN'T hurt after the procedure.
The entire process took 30 minutes and NO PAIN!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sunny Wren
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t recommend Old Settlers Dental enough!!! Whether it’s a routine check up or facing hard decisions, the staff is highly skilled, caring and compassionate.  I am grateful to have found this team years ago and feel so fortunate to have Dr. Lewcock leading my plan!   10/10 recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Moe
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have a long history and many services with Old Settler’s Dental. They are excellent, caring, and professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Austin George
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My previous dental office had 3 different doctors the last 3 times I went and the last one scared me away. So I went here and they confirmed my suspicions of my previous dentist.

The cleaning was very thorough and they took the time to listen to and address all of my concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joanne Boudreau
user_reviews_extended.Description: Another great experience! We have been patients here since arriving in Round Rock & are 100% satisfied.  Caring & skilled hygienists.  Dr Zavala listens and communicates well and all of our dental care has been excellent!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen Led
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best dental office I have found in Texas.  But more importantly the staff is always so friendly and helpful.  I especially could not have asked for a better hygienist.  She always takes the time to ensure everything is taken care of and goes above and beyond to protect my teeth to staying strong and healthy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Jaksik
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service! I broke a crown yesterday morning, and they got me in and fixed it before lunch. Dr. Leacock and his dental assistant Jasmine were both very professional and concerned for my comfort during the procedure. I highly recommend this dental office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the staff they are wonderful and so nice.   Dr Lewcock and Laurie are great ‼️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Klunk
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The team at Old Settlers Dental is amazing! From the front office staff, to the dental hygienists, the dental assistants, the dentists… they all have the needs of the patient at heart. They are responsive, helpful and know how to prioritize the patient insecurities or needs.

Can’t recommend Dr. Zavala and his team enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: christopher vasquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience this round was top tier. Went in for a overdue cleaning. I happened to mention a slight discomfort that I thought was no biggy but turned out to be an issue. They jumped right on it and fixed me right up. Every experience has left me more confident in my dental health and i couldn't be happier.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven Collins
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone was so nice. Dr.Lewcock was very informative and helpful. I’ve done loads of restorative work and 6 extractions so far and it was been wonderful. I highly recommend. I will definitely keep updating as I visit more. (Update)
Just got my posts in for my implants yesterday and have absolutely no pain. Took about 30 minutes to do. Absolutely amazing. Definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L C
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been going to Dr. Zavala for over 20 years now. He and his staff are absolutely top notch. We get personalized care with the same dental assistant every time. Staff turnover is extremely low and we know the names of several employees that we see year after year. Lisa gets my teeth amazingly clean with no pain. This is an amazing place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Hanner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming here for 12 years now.  My appointments always begin on time, the transactions at the desk are always quick and easy, and the hygienists are wonderful and easy to build a great rapport with. Never left sore or in pain of any kind and never been attempted to upsell me on anything. Highly recommend, I'll not go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Wyatt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
By far the VERY BEST experience I have ever had at a dental office. Everyone is incredibly nice! The work they all do is nothing short of perfection. I’ve had some horrible experiences before with bad dentists and I feel so blessed to finally have found a place I can trust with all my dental needs. Old Settlers Dental is the VERY BEST. The ONLY place I recommend!!!!

Also to the lady that posted that they were not clear on billing …. I highly disagree…. They are 100 percent transparent on the price of everything and explain everything! They are also very fair in pricing! I’ve gone to dentist that made me pay upfront for an entire treatment plan months in advance before the work was done- they do not do this!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were so nice! From the front desk, to the doctor, everyone greeted me with a smile. Will highly encourage anyone who is looking for a new dentist to check this place out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ash Ram.C
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first experience at Old Settlers Dental I loved it so much! They made me feel so comfortable. I was a bit nervous from previous experiences but they were so comforting and didn’t make you feel bad about your teeth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Want to give this place 5 stars. The dentist and staff were very nice and friendly. Unfortunately, I had a couple poor experiences that make me hesitate to go back.

I called the office and scheduled an appointment for a comprehensive exam. I was told this would cost about $80.

On the phone I was told I would receive new patient forms to fill out prior to my appointment. Morning of my appointment I had to call and confirm since I never received a confirmation email or the forms to fill out.

Arrived a little before my scheduled appointment and had to spend 30 minutes filling out the forms that were supposed to be sent days prior.

The hygienist then called my name and told me we will be doing a cleaning and I sat down in the chair and she performed the cleaning. I want to note that the hygienist was very nice and friendly.

After the cleaning was done I then met with the dentist. He was very thorough with the exam and very kind. I felt like I was in a very professional environment and the dentist was honest.

When my exam was over, I went to pay and was expecting to pay $79 for the exam. The bill was $209. I asked why it was so much when I was told it would be $79 for the exam. They then explained that the cleaning was an additional $130.

The issue is that I was never asked if I wanted a cleaning for an additional cost, had no idea it wasn’t included in the comprehensive exam since this was my first visit. If I had known it would be that much I would have rejected the service.

Felt very deceptive. Since I received the cleaning, I decided to just pay but felt uneasy about the situation. The hygienist should have asked if I wanted an additional service and explained how much it would cost before performing those services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Casanova
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve had my fair share of dental experiences over the years, but none have come close to the level of care and professionalism I received at Old Settlers Dental. From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel welcome and at ease. The front desk team was friendly, efficient, and helpful with all the necessary paperwork.

What stood out most was the clear and compassionate communication. The dentist took the time to explain every procedure thoroughly, answered all my questions, and never made me feel rushed. They were honest about what I needed—and what I didn’t—which I really appreciated.

Another huge plus: the pricing. Everything was outlined clearly before any work was done. No surprises, no hidden fees. They provided a detailed breakdown of costs and were upfront about what my insurance would cover. That level of transparency made it easy to trust them.

The care itself was excellent. Gentle, professional, and clearly focused on patient comfort. I left feeling confident about my treatment and very well taken care of.

Alyssa, my hygienist, was absolutely amazing. She was thorough, friendly, and made the cleaning process comfortable and informative. Her passion for patient care really shines through!

If you're looking for a dental office that genuinely prioritizes your health, comfort, and peace of mind, I can’t recommend Old Settlers Dental enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Makarczyk
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zavala has worked on my teeth on an emergency basis 2 separate times - once due to a broken front tooth and once due to a crown coming off.  He could not possibly have done a better job.  The care that he shows to his patients and the quality of his work is something you rarely see.  I’ve been to dozens of dental offices and never have I been as impressed as I have been with Dr. Zavala.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keri Abernethy
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I sought out Old Settlers Dental after having a horrible experience at a larger practice. It was a relief get such great service. All the staff were welcoming and kind. Dr.Zavala was personable and friendly. The other place I went to said I needed more work than I actually did. So glad we found our new dentist! Thank you guys! We love you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Old Settlers Dental is the best by far.  Very professional and go out of their way to make you as comfortable as possible.  I’ve been to over eight different practices in the Austin area and stopped switching after going here.  You wont find a better dentist in the Austin area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Caskey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can recommend Old Settlers Dental without reservation. John, Charee, and Lisa are the best.  Front desk staff are very cordial and efficient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Bearden
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the best dentist experiences I have ever had. I do get very anxious about the dentist and going to a new place but the staff was incredibly nice and compassionate. I felt comfortable the entire time and my teeth feel so much better compared to when I first came in.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Machicek
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an immediate concern appear in my gums / tooth. I called Old Settlers Dental at 9:30am and they worked me in at 2pm that same day so I wouldn't have to wait until Monday.  My dentist was out of the office, however, his partner was very accommodating and kind enough to take a look at my 'emergency'. All of the healthcare professionals,  from the phone call / front desk to the clinical staff, were very compassionate and showed top-notch patient care. One of the many reasons I love Old Settlers Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: diane byram
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Old Settlers Dental. Dr. Zavala is a wonderful dentist. He explains treatment plans, is compassionate and caring. The entire staff is so kind to each and every patient. So thankful to have been recommended to them by a friend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LittleKitty7244
user_reviews_extended.Description: It took me almost 2 years to find a Dentist that would work with my Autistic son. We had an consolation appointment and everything went great. They where able to find an amazing Anesthesiologist to do sedation. They listened to everything I was concerned about and did everything I suggestion to get my son sedated in the dental chair. I would highly recommend this Dental office to anyone who ask me. Thank you Old Sellers Dental for your compassion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Wacker
user_reviews_extended.Description: So impressed with this outstanding dental office.  From the moment you walk into the office you are greeted with friendly, professional staff!  Dr Leacock is amazing in how he explains what needs to be treated with your dental care and listens to what you as a patient also are wanting.   His assistant, Lori could not be more friendly, caring, informative and Old Settlers Dentists are lucky to have her!  Highly recommended this office for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elvira Chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Disappointed in front office staff more so the office manager. Very unprofessional on how they approach you about billing. She could not even show me why they were billing me and blamed it on previous staff. I had my text from 2022 on what they were supposedly billing me for. So sad as my experience with the dental hygienist, assistant and Dr. Zavala were great and friendly. Sad to say I chose to not return because of front staff and office manager. Fighting cancer was much easier than dealing with the experience yesterday. It is OK there are plenty of great dentists here in Austin to choose from.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina R
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a first time complimentary visit with Dr. Lewcock himself. I was so very impressed with the office, staff, atmosphere and most notably Dr. Lewcock himself. His experience and approach to my dental issues were prompt and detailed yet provided me with possible options as to what my next step could be. I’m looking forward to viewing my treatment plan and his recommendations and most especially a new smile soon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Parshotam Dhaliwal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my tooth extracted here yesterday. Dr Zavala is excellent in describing as well as in performing his job . His assistant Ms Sarah is equally good and supportive. The front desk staff is too nice. Full credit to them for painless service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Belinda Frye
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zavala and his assistant Sarah were great. Dr. Zavala answered all my questions in a very friendly kind manner. And I didn't feel like he was rushed to go see another patient. The staff was also very friendly and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: wangu ngari
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have always had a great experience at this dental practice. The whole team is courteous, professional, and very friendly. I love that they pair you with same dental hygienist every time. Lisa is gentle, patient, and very kind. I will add the names of my family’s other DH as soon as I get the names because we are one happy family. My whole family has been going there for almost 2.5 yrs now, and we have no complaints. My kids dentist (Kids dentistry in RR) referred us here for a procedure they couldn’t perform for my daughter at their clinic, and we haven’t gone back to their practice since we stepped foot at Old Settler’s Dental. Both dentists are very patient with exceptional bedside manners. Thank you for all that you do.
Irene Angwekwe

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc Addona
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Thank you Old Settlers Dental!!!
I had the Greatest experience in my life.
I had to get 3 teeth extracted and was put at ease by a Wonderful Dentist. His name is John Zavala and his assistant Sarah. He listened to me and answered all of my questions. I really never even felt the needle to numb my gums. Yes people,  he's that good. Thank you John and Sarah for your professionalism and I will be back again to have more work done.My wife's friend  also recommended Dr. Zavala. The staff was Awesome too. I am so glad I chose Old Settlers Dental,  never been so excited to go to the Dentist . Imagine that. If you want the best, go to Old Settlers Dental.  I promise you will have the best experience ever. Thank you .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony W
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office staff are amazing. The dentist was so knowledgeable. Not to mention everyone in there had amazing looking teeth. Lisa is one of the main reasons we are loyal patients because she is an expert at what she does. Alyssa and Jessica are awesome and very welcoming when it comes to children. They treat us like family and make it a joy coming to our appointments!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chuck Clayton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zavalla and his staff always do exceptional work.  They are professional, caring, listen carefully and helpful.  They truly are 5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ruby Payne
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient @ old settlers for a minute. I guess that's why I still come and have a great relationship there.  Great staff and dentists . You can't go wrong.  Make an appointment and see 👀 for yourself.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan McGowen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff are amazing in this office.  It is like going to a relative's you only see twice a year.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Graves
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jessica is #1 in my book!  She is my dental hygienist and cleans my teeth.  Dental scaling is a professional procedure that she does to remove plaque and tartar from the surfaces of the teeth and along the gumline.  She is an outstanding professional and very skillful in her dental work.  KUDOS for Jessica!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hongliang Tong
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had awesome experiences with Dr. Lewcock and hygienist Jessica as well as front desk staff! They are all so very professional, friendly and considerate! user_reviews_extended.Name: Hari jayaram
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to Dr. Zavala for several years. An amazing dentist with a very calm and professional demeanor. Takes his time to talk to his patients and addresses their concerns and walks them thru options for treatment.
Dental hygienists - fantastic and know what they are doing.
Front office staff are amazing, very professional and helpful. Good system to help patients find appointments and proactively help when appointments open up.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ken Peterson
user_reviews_extended.Description:

Ken Peterson

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Lenz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and welcoming! I am editing my review to say how comforting they were to me during some fillings I had to get done. user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandria Lugo
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is AMAZING!!!! Jessica is very gentle and her chair is a massaging chair which I loved while getting my cleaning. I’ve seen both of the doctors before and have nothing but great things to say about them. I would recommend Old Settlers Dental to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: janet boswell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Truly the best dentist office I’ve ever been to. I have extreme dental anxiety and as a result, I have neglected my teeth for awhile and so I need a lot of work done.  From the moment I walked into the office Dr.  Lewcock and Jasmine made me feel at ease. They are both so incredibly patient with me and go above and beyond to make sure I am okay and comfortable with everything that is being done.  Dr.  Lewcock is attentive, easy to talk with and very compassionate.  Dental assistant Jasmine is wonderful, she is so understanding and is always there to hold my hand. Jasmine is an angel in disguise! Office manager Hayley made sure everything was submitted and filed with not only my primary dental insurance company but also with my secondary policy as well, making my experience even better.
This office truly cares for their patients and it shows in everything they do. I would recommend Old Settlers Dental to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Lietz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had Dr. Frederick and his awesome assistant Jasmine. I wish I could give these guys more stars. Doc was super informative and thorough and did a beautiful job with Jasmine at forming my first ever crown from a cracked and broken molar. Highly recommend them

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: don't go to old settlers dental!!! poor customer service, horrible billing department, they are not completely honest with you and then try to make excuses after the fact. There are much better options in Round Rock for a dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dale Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Been looking for a good and proper dental experience for awhile and found it here.
