I was comfortable and and knew exactly what was happening. The work done allowed me to smile for pictures again. Everyone there has been a delight to work with!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lewcock is the best! He has been our dentist for years and we wouldn’t consider going anywhere else. He is knowledgeable, painless, and cares deeply for his patients. Congratulations, you have found your dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Macquer Oney
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff are great, informative and help with various plans, financing and appointments. Dr. Lewcock is great and thorough on every visit, often answering questions and providing guidance when needed. I look forward to my cleanings and invisalign updates. Cant wait to do other smile related procedures :D

Just a follow up to my hygiene appointments. They're always a nice experience with Jessica, my homegirl. I still love this practice as my one and only dental care

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pauline Enssle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Zavala explains the procedure as he is performing it.  He is always concerned about the patients comfort, and I really appreciate that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TJM3RoundRock
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Old Settlers Dental for over 25 years. Dr Zavala is caring, informative, and has superb dental skills.  The staff is supportive and friendly.  I have referred friends and all have reported a similar positive experience.  It’s July 2025 and the report is the same: 5 stars true and true.

user_reviews_extended.Name: McCall Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zavala is hands-down the best dentist I’ve ever been to. Not only is he honest and conservative in his treatment recommendations but he’s great at educating patients. He also is super gentle and where I normally get very anxious when going to the dentist, overtime almost all of my anxiety has subsided because it just doesn’t hurt as much. After waiting years to get a crown on a tooth, literally the same day that he placed the crown my tooth feels better than it has in as long as I can remember. I can’t say enough good things about him as a dentist as well as all of his office staff. You’re in great hands at old settlers dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobbi Jarrin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Old Settlers Dental is not only professional, but warm and friendly.  They go out of their way to make your dental experience comfortable and stress free.  I cannot say enough about Dr. Zavala.  He is genuinely caring and also an excellent listener.  His priority is for you to be happy with the outcome of your dental treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelley Carr
user_reviews_extended.Description: The BEST dental practice ever!!!!  Everyone at Old Settler’s is so friendly, kind, and compassionate!  I’ve spent years and years at various practices, and I can tell you that this is the best of the best. The staff is incredible, and Dr. Lewcock is so very kind and a true professional. Thank you Old Settler’s!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Farr
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lewcock and his team are the BEST! Even from BEFORE your appointment even happens their communication, scheduling, and coordination is so easy. I have a busy schedule and they were able to make adjustment and make it easy! All of his staff is very knowledgeable and goes above and beyond - couldn't recommend his office more!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Lewcock
user_reviews_extended.Description: My routine visit for teeth cleaning went well. My dental hygienist, Alyssa was a pleasant surprise. She did an excellent job cleaning my teeth. Over the years, I have had extensive dental work making my cleaning a little more difficult. Alyssa did an excellent iob cleaning all around several crowns and bridges. Her hands have a soft touch which resulted into a pain free visit. She also took the time to explain everything that she was doing which I really appreciated. I believe Alyssa has a bright future in dentistry and I would highly recommend her to anyone. THANK YOU ALYSSA for such great work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LAURAN SERAFY
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Welcomed by a professional, friendly staff who explained exactly what would occur during my first visit as a new patient.  Was delighted with the visit and will return in three months for another cleaning.  Wonderful experience!*

*Wrote this first review 18 months ago and still agree with everything....am having a crown replaced.  All was explained in detail....no pain....have been back every three months for cleanings......would highly recommend Old Settlers Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rob D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Old Settlers Dental is great to interact with.  I am greeted with enthusiasm and everyone is also very professional.  On my last visit, the hygienist and Dr. Zavala were terrific.  I highly recommend OSD for your dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Juarez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and doctors are great! Jessica is such a great dental hygienist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Young
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just moved to Texas and needed to have very old fillings replaced. I appreciated Dr Zavala’s detailed explanation of the preparation steps and describing the process as he works. It’s been over 30 years since I have had fillings so old memories weren’t good of grinding noises, struggling to keep your mouth open while trying not to swallow junky materials. Well! Let me tell you things have changed for the better. They wrap the other teeth not involved with a protective stretchy shield blocking any materials going down your throat and let you bite on a thick wedge to keep your mouth open so you don’t have to on your own. After the numbing wore off, no soreness. Dr Zavala is very gentle and efficient. His assistant is spot on working cohesively with his every move. Thank you Old Settlers Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sunny Pachunuri
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff, team and doctors.  Lisa my hygienist was amazing. Took great care. Doctor was pretty cool and very easy to talk. Staff was very informative explaining every step of the way. When i left i mnow everything about the condition of my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margie Craig
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time changed to this dentist because my 89 year old neighbor loves him & she is a tough critic! Staff was fantastic, friendly, hygienist gentle, friendly, efficient,  detailed! the only thing they could do better would be shorten the wait to be seen- I filled out paperwork prior a day ahead at home before my appointment & had to wait 35 minutes to go back. I liked them so much moving my entire family over to see Dr Lewcock.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larry Treible
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lisa is the gold standard when it comes to teeth cleaning and peridontal maintenance. She is highly skilled, professional and a pleasant person to talk to. She does a great job. I would highly recommend her for any of your dental hygiene needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debra Heater
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is friendly and professional and Dr. Lewcock is a pro! Always greets me with a smile and makes sure I'm OK. And I have a lot of dental anxiety. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been seeing Dr. Zavala and his team since they were on Sam Bass Road many years ago, and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my dental health! I’ve always love my hygienists as well; Jessica is my current hygienist and she’s just an all-around wonderful lady! Love this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Solange Calo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going to Old Settlers  Dental for about 10 + years.  Awesome experience and treatment. Dr. Zavala is a great doctor.  Will not change him for nothing, the staff is very friendly and always there to help. Kudos to my favorite hygienist Lisa. Love her, so professional and friendly.
My five stars goes to all the staff and Dr. Zavala!!!!! Keep up with your excellent and professional work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Salazar
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I have been Dr.Zavala’s patients for a very long time. I appreciate his thoroughness anytime there is any dental work that needs to be done. Most of all his staff is always so kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Reid
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found Old Settlers Dental by searching online and reading the reviews. Everything positive I read was completely true. I just had a cavity filled by them and it was the best cavity filling experience I've ever had. They were so kind and gentle. I never felt pain and I have very sensitive gums. Everyone in the office is amazing. They even called me the next morning just to see how I was doing and that my teeth and bite felt just right. I am so happy I found Old Settlers!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: O. Nell Osmar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I took my daughter to Dr. Zavala when she was 2 years old, she’s now 24 and we still go to Old Settlers Dental.  I really can’t imagine going anywhere else. Dr. Zavala and his staff have always gone above and beyond to make sure we are comfortable and get the best care. I always recommend Old Settlers Dental! They are so professional and willing to help and offer suggestions for amazing tooth care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental assistats are great - I've has the same one for years and it's been fun getting to know each other.  I've never had serious dental work done, so my interaction with the dentists is minimal, but the are extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and gentle.

user_reviews_extended.Name: McCall McPherson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I could not have had a better dental experience anywhere. Not only is the staff incredibly kind, the doctors are honest, compassionate, checked on me constantly and despite having the biggest dental procedure I’ve ever had, the whole process was painless. Old Settlers does a fantastic job emphasizing the comfort and care of its patients, and it shows from staff to finish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul LeBlanc
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had two old fillings replaced after 25 yrs. Dr John Zavala and a wonderful Dental Assistant did the work with no pain, anxiety or fear. Not once did I have any pain or discomfort. Having this work done was the last thing on my list to do At Christmas time. I can’t say enough good things about my experience there after not having any dental work needed in past 20 years. His practice is a 5 Star rating. Old Settlers Dental in Round Rock, Texas. Try them; you’ll be glad you did!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marsha Royder
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my initial appointment. The front desk staff, Tiffany, was welcoming and very pleasant. My initial exam and cleaning was great! The hygienist, Lisa, was very meticulous. Dr. Lewcock was very personable and reviewed his exam findings completely. If you are looking for a dental office  I would highly recommend Old Settlers Dental!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dale Roe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zavala and his team are amazing. Who goes to the dentist for an emergency and ends up relaxing? Me, apparently. Painless dentistry is real.

user_reviews_extended.Name: bill and chris Loechel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First time at our new dentist and we were both pleased. Dreaded finding a new dentist after having such a wonderful one for the past 20 years before we moved. We feel we have found the right place for excellent care and our next long term relationship!
Feel the same after 6 month check-up too. Great place!
Still feel they are terrific on our next semi-annual visit again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon Scott Music
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Zavala has excellent bedside manner constantly ensuring you know all details with all your mouthcare options.  My family has used him for over a decade and we just love him!   His assistant is also a sharp cookie.  They are a seamless team!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Dunne
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This group is really great! Everyone from the people working the desk to the Dentists are all very professional and helpful in getting you in and out with a minimum of hassle and time.
I also appreciate that they recommend needed work, but they don't pressure you on making a decision. Dental work can get expense and they are sensitive to that.
Lastly they come with a lot of modern amenities as well, TV's for the patient,  water drills for cleaning, and a full suite of modern services on offer.
Great group, and I would hearty recommend that you give them a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jo Anne Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I find the doctors incredibly handsome. The office is nice and the staff is OK but their billing practices are highway robbery. They may be doing their job but they’re definitely not there to help you. I’m completely disgusted for someone who’s been going to a dentist since I had teeth I know getting customer care and to charge as much as they do and to not take insurance is completely unconscionable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jae Seo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The best dentist in the Round Rock area.

The staff is always nice and easy to work with!

Dr. Lewcock really knows dentistry and I would not go anywhere else, unless I moved to a different city.

Think of it this way. It is like finding a nice barber/salon and sticking with them. Once you find the one, you never go to anyone else!

There is a reason why Old Settlers Dental has a 5 star rating. Excellent service and clean establishment.

I absolutely recommend going here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sebastian Cabrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great communication, friendly staff, and high quality work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Beach
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Old Settlers Dental.  Dr Zavala is a true professional.  He has always been honest and kind. His staff will accommodate to your needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carita Forte
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a great dental office.  Great service. This appointment was not a frightening place. Wonderful staff and wonderful service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chuck Clayton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a minor dental emergency in July 2024 and Old Settlers got me in quickly and took care of the issue.  First class assistance!  Dr Zavalla and his team do a great job consistently! Everyone at Old Settlers Dental is professional, knowledgeable, caring and helpful. Chuck Clayton

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenn I
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are quick and thorough! Everyone working here is amazingly nice. When i first called, the lady i talked to was so nice that i stopped calling other places because i knew this was my dentist! They have an awesome deal for first time patients with no insurance as well. They have the top of the line technology and do everything they can to make you comfortable. There is a flat screen TV in every room and you can watch anything you want while they work and it does relax/distract you. I couldn't ask for a better Dentist i only wish i would have found them sooner. I have already recommended my friends and family. A+++

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana Zaytseva
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very nice place, always very clean and efficient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andi Dandi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very helpful, pleasant staff. They are out of network for me, but I am very satisfied with their care and decided to stay. Dr. Lewcock is very thorough with his procedures and I have always felt better about my teeth after leaving. Even his referral dentist was amazing! Great place all around.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kacee Hurford
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist office is not a place most people enjoy going to but Old Settlers Dental makes it enjoyable! I’ve been coming here for 7 years now and every time I do I feel welcomed and invited. Dr. Zavala is wonderful and generally cares about your concerns and doesn’t just brush them off. Also, the hygienists are so gentle I always almost fall asleep while getting a cleaning haha! The office is always clean and smells nice (which is a must for health related things) and the front desk staff are very knowledgeable and always there to help.  I’ve been to a lot of different kinds of dental offices in the past and this one is by far the best and why I keep coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fred Strietelmeier
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always, the staff was very friendly and Lisa did a great job on my cleaning and kept me informed during the process. Always a pleasure. I definitely recommend Old Settlers Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ann Deno
user_reviews_extended.Description: Delightful dentistry. The staff members were all incredibly patient with my scheduling challenges. At the visit Cheri and Dr Zavala were very kind and genuine. The office setting is immaculate, warm and tasteful. Options and costs were clearly outlined, with an emphasis on my freedom of choice. The equipment and technical expertise were “state of the art.” The morning was relaxing and pleasant. Directions during the procedure were wonderfully reassuring, and guidelines for follow up were clear and perfect. So very grateful for Old Settlers Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Becky Laswell
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have been to this office for a few years and we've been treated very well -- for routine cleaning as well as fillings. We brought our daughters to this office (switching from a pediatric office) and it went so well! I feel that they're getting good dental care, not just a quick tooth brushing and toys (though there were toys and new toothbrushes after the visit!). I had been afraid of dentists for a long time before I came here -- that fear is now gone thanks to the staff's wonderful attitudes and careful approach. Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Huyser
user_reviews_extended.Description: Honestly, always such a great experience! I used to get so anxious about going to the dentist, but every time I'm here it's such a positive experience that I look forward to future visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Craig
user_reviews_extended.Description: Donna Craig, Christopher Craig and John Peterson, the family, is very happy and pleased with all Services provided by Old Settlers Dental. The staff is always helpful, friendly and competent. Dr. Lewcock anticipates his patients needs and provides excellent care and can think outside of the box if necessary. In short ... we love all Services and Personnel at OLD SETTLERS DENTAL. Thanks to all! 💖

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deepika Deol
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband had an appointment at old settlers dental Round rock dentist. when he came home, he said he had the worst experience he's ever had at a dentist office. He is most easy going non complaining person. He was treated so poorly. People are rude there. They just waste your time by photography. very bad service. Worst staff ever. Won't recommend for anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: shawna Naizer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Old settlers dental is happily my new dentist! I went to another dentist that was going to charge me thousands of dollars but here they are able to do all the same work for under $300!  The office staff was very courteous and the Dentist was kind and gentle!  Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Cardwell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We have been going here for almost 3 years and have nothing but good things to say! One time they made a minor mistake and as soon as we let them know they were very apologetic, helpful, and assumed full responsibility!

Another time I had my 2 month old and had to go in for a quick visit. I explained I’d have to reschedule since I couldn’t find a sitter and they said to come anyways as long as I was comfortable with that! She slept in her car seat and they were so sweet about it.

The dentists here seem to have great character and nearly all the office staff and hygienists are very kind!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clean, professional no pressure office with friendly staff. Our appointments are always on time!! We love our hygienist, Jennifer, who was wonderful with my VERY hesitant 9 year old (he hasn't been to the dentist in over 2 years because he was so afraid). Dr. Zavala is kind and is very knowledgable. I highly recommend Old Settler's Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martha Randolph
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team here at Old Settlers Dental is friendly, professional, experienced, and kind. I’m not one to relax at the dentist but I leave there feeling like I’ve been in good hands. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori Cashman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a very happy dental patient of Old Settlers Dental for years, and I could not be happier about my recent teeth alignment experience with Dr. Zavala. He has truly gone above and beyond in making my teeth look beautiful. I am so glad I chose to be treated by him and his staff because they take such good care of me and my teeth look awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Herbrich
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is warm and welcoming.  My appointments have always been on time and they work with my schedule when setting up future appointments.  Dr. Zavala is wonderful and always answers any questions I may have.  I have been recommending their dental clinic to all of my friends and co-workers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barbara Bittner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Lisa is great.  Love her. So impressed with Dr. Lewcock.  Takes time to explain things,  very pleasant .Everyone is always very friendly and helpful. Something you don’t see everywhere anymore. All about patient satisfaction. Keep it up!!!!! Dido!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Ross
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great dental office! All of the staff here are very friendly and professional. Dr. Zavala is great and took the time to chat with me about any dental issues or concerns I was having before getting started. Both he and the hygienist took the time to explain to me what they were going to do before they did it. And then they checked in with me a lot throughout the exam/cleaning process to make sure I was ok with everything as it was happening. If you want a distraction, they have a ceiling mounted TV you can watch/listen to while they work and the chairs have a relaxing massage feature.

They're prompt with getting you checked in and back into a chair as scheduled. My appointment began on time and took exactly 1 hour - much better than some other dental groups I have been to in RR in the past. I will be back and would highly recommend to others!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love it here! Everyone is so nice and the process for me to get my filling was so smooth. I I had no discomfort during the process of getting my filling. When I left, I almost forgot I just had my teeth worked on...(except for the awkward smile I'd give to others because my face was still numb). Best dentist I've ever been to by far.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JoAnne Dutton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I do not mind going to the dentist at all. I have been a patient for over 5 years. From the receptionists to the dental hygienist to Dr Zavala- I never have to wait more than 5 minutes- I am treated with respect and everyone is so courteous and professional. My teeth are well cared for. I highly recommend Old Settlers Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rogilyn Boggs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is always friendly! My family and I have been going to see Dr. Zavala for over 13 years.  The hygienist are thorough and take their time to listen if you have any concerns.  I wouldn't go anywhere else for my dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Keever
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at this office is amazing!!! From the front desk, to all the Dental Assistance/Hygenist, to Dr. Lewcock! They all have a great attitudes and a smile every time I've made contact with them. Very helpful w/any concerns to include insurance. My whole family loves them all because their all so friendly and most importantly they spoil us all while there, always checking we are comfortable during procedures and they are all very gentle. My kids are not afraid of dentists thanks to this office. Never thought I'd find the perfect place for my family and I. Totally recommend it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shanti Lund
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been afraid of the dentist for years. I avoid going unless it is absolutely necessary. Well, it became very necessary (silly tooth ache). Like most of us I looked for somewhere with good reviews.

I ended up getting a root canal which is usually very painful (at least last time I got one). Leading up to the appointment I was so anxious about the procedure. Fortunately for me, it was all for nothing. All of the staff was very comforting and the atmosphere was very relaxing. I was given a nice comfortable blanket and my choice of tv show. The show must of have been boring because next thing I remember was getting ready to leave. I highly recommend this place to anyone like me that has had horrible experiences in the past. The doctors are very gentle and good at what they do. I’ll actually go back before another tooth ache forces me to the dentist. That in itself says a whole lot.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Brock
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I think Old Settlers Dental is the best ever!  Everyone who works there is outstanding.  Their customer service promotes an interested and understanding work ethic.  The  dental approach to procedures are off the chain.  I know, because I am a big chicken when it is time for dental services.

Thanks,

Becky

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Castro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Scheduling an appointment is easy with their online tools and quick response. The office is very nice and the staff certainly go out of their way to make you feel comfortable. This is the first dental office I’ve been a patient at that I don’t have one single complaint. I’m very happy my family and I are patients here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Thetford
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is amazing! I am new to RR and had chipped a filling. Old Settlers Dental got me in with a day of requesting some help. They also offered a promotional rate of only $79 for the first examination/treatment plan and X-rays. I had the filling fixed the very next day. I HIGHLY recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MARY HICKMAN
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love these people!  Dr. Lewcock explains everything before during and after.
My procedure (for caps) was painless.  I love the up-to-date equipment he has so you can see what he is talking about without leaving your chair.
Staff is also great!!!
I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kari Matney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zavala and his staff are fantastic. He is thorough and concerned. He always explains everything he is doing in great detail and makes sure his patients understand and are comfortable with his procedures. The office is ON TIME! This is a wonderful blessing, as my days are very packed and my schedule is very tight. I had to have a crown replaced, and Espie was my primary go-to assistant. She is WONDERFUL! Not only is she skilled, but she is very cheerful and accommodating. My temporary was compromised, and she met me on her DAY OFF (Friday) and made sure I was taken care of for the weekend. I can't say enough good things about Old Settlers. My whole family (six kids, hubs, parents, sister) all use Dr. Zavala, and we have been going here for years. We have always had the most positive experiences! I never do reviews, but I could not NOT do one on Dr. Zavala and his whole office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Meler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been taking my entire family to see Dr. Zavala for almost 7 years.   We always have a great experience. The entire staff is amazing with my small children and when we come in they always greet us like family. I have had cosmetic work done and I truly love the results.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Werchan
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience here was the best that I've ever had. From the front desk all the way to the dentist everyone was very caring and did their jobs well. I was very nervous going in because I was in a lot of pain and needed a root canal. They were able to get me in and get it taken care of. I'm happy to say that the Conscious Sedation that they used on me was well worth the little bit of money it cost. Any negative reviews on here has to do with money. I found them to be comprable to everyone around me and I was a cash-pay patient. You definitely get what you pay for and they are worth every penny! I would recommend them to all of my friends and family.  You can't put a cost on good care and good dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ke Mo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nan and I had semi-annual appointment Wednesday.  Had our usual excellent experience.  Staff are professional.  Facilities clean and comfortable.  We highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: damion dunn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to old settlers dental for almost 7 years and they haven taking good care of my personal hygiene. The co workers are very nice and always and good and positive attitude towards their patients. I'm very humble I get to be part of their organization that they have built. So now I can walk outside and give a big smile to the people so they can see how much of an excellent job they have done for me😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jared Burck
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zavala is one of the best Dentist I have ever been to!!! The whole staff really cares about their patients. Overall, it is a wonderful experience and recommend Old Settlers Dental to anyone that asks. Thank you for caring for my teeth as much as I do!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alivia Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just moved to Austin about a year ago and I'm so glad I found a great dentist in the area!  The office is clean, professional, and efficient. They responded to my emails very quickly and worked with my schedule when I was trying to figure out when to book my appointment. Very easy and pleasant to work with, I'm so thankful I found this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A Park
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have trusted my dental health to Dr. Lewcock/Old Settlers Dental since moving to Round Rock 12 years ago (he is wonderful, by the way).  The staff go above and beyond to make patients comfortable and relaxed...the front desk staff are highly professional and welcoming.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laurie canepa
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best !!! Our whole family goes here including my 12 year old. I recently utilized their sedation dentistry option for 2 tooth extractions and it was a great experience. The post treatment plan and follow up were excellent as well. Both Dr Lewcock and Dr Zavala are the best, you can’t make a bad choice with either one. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Craig
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am truly phobic about the dentist.  Anxiety, tears, raised pulse, it's terrible.  But Dr. Zavala and his staff are fantastic.  He and his team have been completely considerate, patient, and calm every time.  They have been supportive and very helpful to me.  I highly recommend their care and services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Viviana Vega
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lewcock and his team are great! I've only had two visits so far but both were beyond my expectations. The entire team is welcoming, kind, and friendly. They explained all parts of my visit from payment breakdowns to future visits and even what they were doing to my teeth during my visit. Dr. Lewcock is a great dentist and made sure I was comfortable during each visit. I highly recommend this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jameela Picas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dental cleanings have always been something I had anxiety over because of past bad experiences but Jennifer at OSD put my fears to rest. She is calm and gentle with your teeth, especially if they are super sensitive. Dr. Z is also very nice and makes sure you understand the procedure. The front staff-end staff are always friendly and welcoming. My whole family goes to OSD now and we highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel W
user_reviews_extended.Description: It has been a great experience working with Dr L and his team at Old Settlers Dental. They are friendly, professional and made the whole process easy. I’d highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Padilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family moved here from the Galveston area and I did not think I would be able to find the combination of professional , yet cozy comfortable feel I got from my  old dentist, Dr. Sueme in Dickinson. Fortunately I was wrong. The staff here is nice and Dr. Zavala has a great personality to go with his professionalism and the caring feel that he presents. I feel very lucky to have Old Settlers Dental take care of my family's teeth. It will be very hard to find a replacement should we have to move away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m in the process of having two dental implants performed. After the implants were inserted, I had a follow up visit to make 3D Images to fabricate the two teeth or prosthetics for the dental implants.  I had my two prosthetics attached by Dr. Lewcock and his assistant, Laurie who are a great team. A little fine tuning was needed but the implants felt natural and fit perfectly from Day 1.  The facility is nice, modern and easily assessable from major roadways and the staff helpful and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: spham mam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is super nice and sweet but my braces quote(for regular silver braces) was too excessive compared to every other quote I got, & the other quotes were for gold braces. perhaps they could find a way to make their costs more competitive. Also, the $75 rescheduling fee within 24 hours of your appt is too much! especially for students or people with busy lives that may forget they have an appointment. If people just went to the Dr. For customer service & facilities, they would be 5 stars hands down. But price point could be better.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Dempsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: We always have a great experience at Old Settlers Dental. My kids love it and think going to the dentist is a really fun experience. I have had cavities filled, teeth cleaned & veneers done. Dr.Zavala is amazing and Jen the hygenist  is so patient and great with my two girls.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Lauer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Simply the best.....i would have never wrote a review for a dental place untill i went to old settlers dental. The staff is great and the docs are better. Have had a crown, some fillings and cleaning done never once left in pain, always checked with me to make sure i was good. I would recommend this place  to everyone and anyone. Great job old settlers dental!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ilissa Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been with Old Settlers Dental for 2 years now and i love it! It a small, quiet office and they get you in and out every time. I like how they keep you with the same dental hygienist and dentist too! Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Liles
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just left the office and couldn't be happier with the staff or Dr. Zavala! I've been a patient for over 5 years now and have needed a lot of extensive work done. Each time they explain what's needed, what will happen and let you know what to expect, so you're never left guessing. The Dr. and his assistant will ask several times through out the procedure if you are doing ok and that makes me feel cared for. They will also try and help you connect with a credit card company if you need help paying. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Casual- Beast
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient at Old Settlers Dental for 5-6 years now and they are great! The facility is nice, the staff has always been great, and the dentist is great as well. They almost always get me in on time which is also great. I've referred everyone I know to them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terry Breidenstein
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am ALWAYS pleased with my treatment at Old Setters Dental, specifically Dr Zavala and his staff.  I have had problems with some very extensive dental work I have had done in the past and Dr Zavala is who I wish I had known my entire life.  I recommend him highly.  Most recently I had a thorough cleaning and was very pleased with the care and new recommendation received for maintaining my gums and teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Schneider
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jessica and team are amazing. I can’t recommend highly enough. I’m undergoing a rather serious cleaning from neglect and she’s incredibly kind, thorough, and informative. As is the gentleman who gave my anesthetic. I’m actually excited for regular visitation and ongoing care. So glad I found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Domingo Salerno
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and professional people, who provide an excellent service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gina Avvakoum
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would never have believed that a visit to the dentist could be a pleasure, but the staff at Old Settlers Dental are amazing -- professional but friendly and so very competent -- and Dr. Zavala performed a modern miracle, extracting a tooth without causing any pain!  My only regret is that we didn't find them years and years ago.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Max Weaver
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just finished my Invisalign treatment at Old Settlers Dental and I could not be more happy with the results! Dr. Zavala and his staff were wonderful in helping me throughout the process to ensure I was fully satisfied with my teeth. They are a top dentist in the Austin Metro and I recommend him to anyone in the area in need of dental work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LANA STUBBLEFIELD
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would love to say something good about '' THIS PLACE'' ......  but really have nothing.....It is so sad when people going to any med facility to get help and instead getting bad experience. Very disappointed in front office staff. And if you have a billing questions first you will NEVER GET THE RIGHT ANSVERS and second they make you feel like you wasting their time.

Customer service      D-------
Communication         D-------
Professionalism        D--------
Job Quality                 C

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nell Osmar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Old Settlers Dental office for almost 20 years.  I took my daughter there for her first visit when she was 3, and we haven’t been anywhere else for our dental care.
The staff has always been friendly and concerned, and after going there for so long, you feel like part of their family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jade Wren
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always an amazing experience! I will continue to rant, rave, and refer everyone I know. Thank you to my hygienist, Lisa, Dr. Zavala, and all of the girls at the office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Iris Jerke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently moved to RR and needed a new dentist.  I absolutely had the best for 18 years, but after my office visit today I know I found a match!  Very professional, friendly, comfortable, and assuring visit! I am happy to go back ... If one can say that of a dentist visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Indira Gibby
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love Old Settlers Dental. Jennifer always takes great care of us during our routine visits. She thoroughly cares for me and my children. My children look forward to their regular visits. Our teeths shine brighter as a result of her genuine efforts. Thanks Jennifer. And Thanks to Dr. Zavala for hiring such wonderful people.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chuck D
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Zavala and his staff are genuine, caring and interested. For me, this is best dentist and associates I have ever experienced. IF a dental visit can be top shelf, this IS. They have met every dental need I had. I trust their expertise, knowing that my needs are important to them also.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TheGuelichs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff at Old Settlers is Amazing!
Great dental staff!! It was my first time having cavities filled in over 10'years and I felt cared for by the dentist and staff. Always been nervous about the dentist but Old Settlers has helped put my nerves to rest.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wan Wan L.
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at this dentist practice are very friendly and always greets me with a smile. The dental hygienist, jessica did a terrific job on my cleaning. She took the time to clean my teeth thoroughly. The many times I have seen Dr. Zavala, he was courteous and attentive to my concerns. Thank you for making my teeth clean guys!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Old Settlers Dental for almost two years now. I have very much enjoyed having Lakyn as my hygienist and Dr. Zavala as my dentist. Lakyn is very personable and always makes feel relaxed during visits. Dr. Zavala is always very friendly during his reviews. The front office has always been helpful helping me sort billing and appointments. Would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gregg Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everything but the work of the dental hygienist  was quite unsatisfactory. I saw an ad in a local paper for new patients at an introductory price of $91. I stopped by the office, told them I was a new patient and wanted to take advantage of the $91 "new patient" pricing. I made an appointment for a week later and got there early to fill out the new patient forms. They asked for my ID and insurance information, I assumed this was normal to complete my file. To my great surprise they charged me $204 for the visit and put it on my insurance. I explained I was a new patient, they didn't care. I later called the billing department who gave me the same answer in a very rude manner. Zero customer service and rude to boot. Go elsewhere...I know I will.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Uriah Shadle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Old Settlers for over 5 years, and have to say that they are excellent. Dr. Lewcock and his staff are the nicest people always, and bend over backwards to help their patients. I recently had a crown dislodge while I was at the hospital having a new baby. With spring break coming up, Dr. Lewcock was going to be on vacation for the next week and I would have to wait almost two weeks to get my crown fixed. Instead, he came in on his day off and fixed it for me. Now that is the dentist I want.

user_reviews_extended.Name: julie wolber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had a crown done. The treatment was excellent! My time was valued as they were on time, efficient and finished well ahead of schedule. Every step was simply explained to me and I was asked regularly if I was ok. This constant communicative care and "kid glove" treatment is rather intriguing to me. So many people are deathly afraid of going to the dentist! I am not but I do think having patients well informed and regularly told what is happening during a procedure goes a long way in calming the nerves! No pain during or after the procedure. Cherie and Dr. Zavala are great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: R Cal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Zavala  is still the best at fillings, making the experience as relaxing and comfortable as possible. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James White
user_reviews_extended.Description: I chose this office based on on line reviews.  I was not disappointed.  The staff (front desk, hygienist, dentist) were all friendly and professional.  The office is clean and modern and the work performed was thorough and well explained.  I would recommend Old Settlers Dental to anyone looking for a dentist office in the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie Dobbins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lewcock and his staff at Old Settlers Dental are the best!  They put  me at ease right away with their calm and caring manner.  Dr. Lewcock was very conscientious, explaining everything involved in my procedure. He was also the most gentle dentist that I have ever encountered.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Wiles
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just wanna say that I’ve been going to them for over 15 years and I absolutely love DR.Zavala He goes Above and beyond for his patience, highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Kulas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm an original patient when Old Settlers Dental first started. I think the staff is great there always, and of course Dr. Lewcock. I used to live in Round Rock. Now I live in Circle C  (way south Austin) but I still come north for my every 6 month's checkup, which tells you how much I like Old Settlers Dental! P.S. I am happily their most boring patient :-)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Morris
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff! Never have to wait long, even at the end of the day. Very comfortable setup with massaging chair and TV screen. Dentists seem very competent and trustworthy and my hygienist is exceptionally gentle!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raad Altaie
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a cleaning there, and it was honestly one of the worst dental experiences I've ever had, despite their assurances that my insurance would pay for it. however, a month later, a $455 charge that the insurance doesn't pay arrives.
I called the office and they essentially said I was lying when I said "their office said insurance will pay for it."
I thought they were quite sneaky with payments and nasty with the overcharging.
btw, cleaning costs $455. How much do they charge for a filling a "kidney"?

Edit: The owner lies I asked about whether there was an out-of-pocket expense, and the front desk said that insurance will cover it, as it does in all dentist offices except this one.
The staff said that they received extensive training in how to speak "legally"? who does that? but someone who wants to engage in shady business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blaize Justice
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is by far the greatest dentist in Austin area. The most friendly staff and atmosphere. I recommend this place to all my friends. I used to not like going to dentist, but now I actually look forward to it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary E. Duval
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zavala has been my dentist for about 10 years.  I wouldn't go anywhere else.  Yesterday, I was called into the treatment room on time as usual.  I had 1 molar pulled and 2 old crowns (15-20 years old) removed, cavities in the base teeth filled and temporary crowns installed.  One of the many things I like about Dr. Zavala is he tells me every step he is taking and continually makes sure he is not hurting me.  He does NOT suggest treatments I don't really need and he explains why I need certain treatments in a way I can understand.  He will take the time to sit down with me and answer questions.  I trust his integrity and have full confidence in his work.  I highly recommend him.

user_reviews_extended.Name: rodney miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best dental office with professional staff I have been associated with.  Not the least expensive, but the best for quality and support.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lou McKinley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The office staff here is phenomenal! I am truly thankful that I found Dr. Zavala several years ago. My most recent visit occurred after my second Retainer also broke. I remembered from the last time when my other one broke how important it is to get it replaced quickly before my teeth begin to move around and ruin all of the hard work done to get them straightened.

When I called I had the pleasure of speaking with a beautiful soul named Crystal. She could hear the panic and worry in my voice and she quickly calmed me down and told me not to worry and that they would take care of me, and that they certainly did. Crystal explained to me that all that may need to be done would be something quite simple and that she would verify things and get back with me to let me know. One thing to understand is that they really weren't even open for normal business as when I called it was still part of the Christmas holiday and they were only in the office taking care of some administrative duties. Crystal called me back quickly to inform me that I could come in and get seen with Espy.

When I got to the office I was met and welcomed in by Crystal and Brittany and then by Espy. Espy took me back, explained to me that all she needed to do was to get a quick scan of my teeth so she could get me set up with another Retainer. She was quick, gentle and explained every step of the way, in addition to consistently checking on me to make sure I was ok which I was. Espy is so friendly and easy going and she maintains an admirable level of professionalism at the same time.

It's difficult for me to express the caring and the kindness of all of these ladies. This meant so much to me and the importance of being able to get in and be seen so quickly in what was a dental urgency to me meant even more. The actions of everyone here speaks volumes as does their dedication to service.

Dr. Zavala gave me my lovely smile and he has passed on his expertise in caring for his patients to the rest of his staff. The atmosphere here is warm and I felt welcomed, wanted as a patient and cared about. Kudos to Crystal, Espy and Brittany!! [and you too Dr. Zavala :)!!]

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis Benefield
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am usually horribly afraid of the dentist. I had an absolutely pain-free experience I was in their chair for 2 1/2 hours. Not once did I feel pain not once did I feel like I was not taken care of. Everything was exactly like what it was supposed to. The best dental experience I've ever had I recommend these people to anybody Dennis

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor T
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Old Settlers Dental. I've been going to these guys for 4 years now. Everyone who works here is always nice and very accommodating. If you live in the area you should definitely go see these guys.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Chizek
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The entire office staff is so friendly, helpful and always ready to answer questions and resolve concerns!  Dr. Lewcock,  is outstanding! Always friendly, informative and quick to accommodate my needs.
If you are looking for a great, caring, welcoming, dentist, look no further!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zach Howell
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best dentist I have ever been to!!  I have been a regular at dentist offices since I was a teenager.  I have broken my front teeth multiple times from various sports injuries.  I enjoy the dentist office but have never had an experience as wonderful as this.  Every person on this staff very welcoming and seemed to make things very personable.  You never feel like "that other patient".  The second time I came in I was greeted like family and by name.  On top of all of that it is a very state of the art office.  I was able to watch tv while having all the work done which is always great.  Dr. Lewcock is awesome at explaining what he is doing and why he is doing it that way.  He was replacing the veneers that were broken on my front teeth.  He was very quick but was also very thorough about what he was doing. On my third visit to have the finished product put in I was greeted again with smiles.  The job was done quickly as usual and the new ones were a perfect match and fit.  When I left that day and got to take the time to look at the teeth I shed a tear.  Never have I felt so proud and confident in my smile.  I have absolutely found a dentist for life.  Even if I moved I would drive all the way back here to have work done.  I have already recommended Dr. Lewcock to everyone that I know.  Does not matter if you love or hate the dentist Old Settlers Dental is absolutely the place for you

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicholas Jensen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very good experience using Old Settlers Dental. Experienced staff top to bottom. Doctor Zavala is extremely good at his job, particularly administering shots. Very gentle, pain free experiences, every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Misty Chichurka
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a place you can trust for excellence. The staff is very personable, but more important, Dr. Zavala and Dr. Lewcock are perfectionists! I have had both dentists work on my teeth, and I can't say I have ever been happier with the results. Coming from a person who has had several bad dentists in life, they have changed my outlook on what a dentist should be. I used to be scared just to get my teeth cleaned, now I look forward to it. They are even good with bad patients, lol, meaning, we are not always the best patients when we are scared of the dentist. These two wonderful men will turn you into a great patient. I highly recommend them for any work. I have sent several people there, and without a doubt, they have been very happy patients and will not go anywhere else. I would give them 10 stars if that were an option. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Crum
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lewcock and Michelle were absolute professionals, and put me at ease about the treatment for a very painful tooth. Their office personnel worked with me since I do not have dental insurance and the end result was very doable. I would highly recommend the wonderful staff at Old Settlers Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathleen Stull-Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: not a good dentist office to go too, poor customer service, lack of transparency with their billing, very shady, MUCH better options available in the Round Rock area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elio Camey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been going here for years.  both my wife and I have had braces, teeth work and our smiles have never looked better.  Fantastic staff, friendly, professional, awesome!  Dr. Lewcock is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Gemma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Zavala and his staff are amazing!  My kids even want to go back, and considering past experiences from other dentists this speaks volumes.  We highly recommend Old Settlers Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lira
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Old Settlers for 2 years now. Dr. Lewcock, Dr. Zavala, and The entire staff are informative, caring, and welcoming!

I recently had a dental implant placed by Dr. Lewcock. I was knowledgeable on what all was involved in the procedure. Although, I was nervous about what to expect as In discomfort or pain.  I must say, Dr. Lewcock deserves 5  Plus stars! I didn’t have any discomfort, pain or soreness during; nor after the procedure. He explained every step and made sure I was comfortable. His assistants Michelle and Laurie were amazing as well! :)

I highly  recommend Old Settlers Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Dash
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went to Old Settlers Dental for 2 fillings and a crown.  They were very caring and I am absolutely satisfied with the work done.  They have the latest technology and never kept me waiting.  It was all pain free.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kalista Tamez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been getting dental work done by Dr. Lewcock since I was a child and I am so thankful! He is a MASTER with veneers- I cannot emphasize this enough. Mine blend in soooo well with my natural teeth. 10/10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Forbes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It's easy to commend Old Settles Dental; they are fantastic! I'd recommend them to anyone, especially to those of you who (like me) have severe anxiety issues regarding even simple dental procedures.

My dentist is Dr. Zavala. For my treatments, he works with one of his wonderful and knowledgeable assistants, Cheri. Dr. Zavala is soft spoken, an excellent listener, very gentle, highly skilled, and will thoroughly work with you to maximize your dental health with the least invasive procedures necessary unless you request otherwise. He treats and educates. His attention to detail is impeccable. He listens to his patients, he asks questions, and reiterates your own, so he can best understand your needs. During every exam or procedure, he will frequently check with you to ensure your comfort. There are many treatment methods and medications avaiIable to ensure your complete comfort during your visit. I wish every Medical Doctor would share Dr. Zavala's demeanor and professionalism.

I had major dental work done at this practice, over the course of six months (for personal reasons). It has now been three years since the work was completed. My root canals, crowns, and fillings are all still in perfect shape. Dr. Zavala will express any concerns he has and identifies the areas that should be treated first, but he will not push for a procedure you'd like to avoid. He and Cheri are very honest, realistic, and optimistic. I have never been treated so respectfully, kindly, and earnestly at any other practice during the the last forty years.

Each staff member, from the patient coordinator to the Doctors, are patient, friendly, and skilled in their craft. About the only thing they can't do is hold your hand and drive you to the office.

If you've been postponing or avoiding a 'dreadful' dental visit, no matter how long it's been since you've seen a dentist, I would strongly encourage you to visit them. They are supportive and understanding in every possible way.

And just to note, the rooms are bright and clean, relaxing, have tv's and cozy blankets, and an abundance of smiles. Do yourself a favor and get checked out. You deserve it!  I know I wrote a lot, but my enthusiasm is authentic!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Damon Dunn
user_reviews_extended.Description: My entire experience for the past 10 plus years with Old Settlers Dental has been great. They made me and my two son’s feel so comfortable every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Nagai
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've felt comfortable with they work they've done every appointment I've been here.  They've caught problems other dentists have missed and I never feel like I'm being rushed over or talked down to.  Finally found a dentist I'm going to stay with, would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Boone
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a great group to work with. Always friendly and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy Terrel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Most dentist offices that I've been to have no respect for your time and
herd you like cattle. Old Settlers is a much friendlier place with great
service and a customer focus. They explain what they are doing without you
having to ask and don't push upsell products. Definitely my favorite
dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zavala is the best dentist I've ever been too. He is so kind and really cares about you having no pain. I've been there a few times now and he and his staff are the best!! Thank you Dr. Zavala. Jessie L.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eduardo Marquis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Our family was recently in need for urgent dental work and we are so glad for Doctor Zavala whom is a real expert.
He quickly diagnosed and solved all our aches. His staff at Old Settlers is friendly and professional and are genuinely interested in your well being.
Thanks for everything you do Dr. Zavala!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blanca Zamarripa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Walking in there and getting treatment is like having a one on one experience  every single time! They always make sure that the patient comes first. Our family will continue to highly recommend Dr. Zavala and his staff to every family member, friends and any acquaintances!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: lYn vIg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I select dentists extremely carefully and am obsessed with my teeth...I have been known to not want to move if I cannot continue seeing the dentist I have found.  I moved to TX 3+ years ago, and thank goodness I found Dr. Lewcock!!  He is amazing, and truly, without question, the MOST SKILLED cosmetic dentist I have ever been to!  Just today, he fixed my front tooth...how scary to have that done, and it is LITERALLY PERFECT!!!!!  It is indiscernible from the other tooth, truly magnificent!  I was so happy with it, I got emotional in the dental chair.  Thank you Dr. Lewcock and staff.  Best dental office, ever!!!!!
My dental hygeniest is amazing, she is incredibly thoroughand meticulous hygeniest and an overall great person!!! I always feel welcomed and cared for by her, but she's super smart, down to Earth and funny...always a great experience!!
The dental assistants are amazing also, and just patiently made me a retainer that works really well for me.  They are very skilled and so personable.
The office staff has been nothing but beyond friendly, professional,
knowledgeable and informative.
Thank you sooo much for your incredible care, you are very appreciated!
Lynda John :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Holly Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the best office I have ever visited. They truly care about your dental health.  The rates seem to be comparable to other dentists I have been to. And if they are a little higher, so be it. You get what you pay for. I am so thankful for all they did for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony Alonzi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Forget what you know about a visit to the dentist. The staff is competent and empathetic...like they drank from the same cup of human kindness. If you have to invest a thousand dollars in dental work and not feel like you've been tortured or robbed, this is where you'll come.

Update: Had an old cavity refilled yesterday. Possibly the most professional and patient-friendly procedure I'd experienced. Hardly noticed the numbing injection. It went quickly. Kudos to Dr. Zavala and Esmeralda.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Moving On&Beyond
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient of Dr. Zavala’s for a very long time. I had an appt the other day and haven’t been in a long while. When I made the appt, I gave my insurance info (was told they take it) and expressed my concern w/ a crown and also needed an exam and cleaning. The girl also didn’t mention the crown issues in her notes so Dr Z didn’t know about it. I’m not very happy after the appt when I’m told they don’t take my insurance and I’m stuck w/ a $455 for my cleaning. My card doesn’t mention HMO. First of all, when I’ve made appts anywhere in the past from dental to medical they at least tell me if I’m in/out of network. They should of ran it prior to me coming in. Their answer is..I guess you’ll just have to get care credit. I’m already struggling right now financially and trying to keep my CC score up. I can’t be applying for care credit right now. I’m really turned off now from visiting this place other than that Dr. Zavala you’ve been great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Sun de la Cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife doesn't have a gmail account but really needs to give you guys a great review: the entire team is awesome: kind, honest, skillful, patient, and considerate. She got 6 fillings down this year and will be back for deep cleaning. She was so comfortable that she fell asleep during her fillings. Thank you once again dr. Frederick, Michelle, and Cynthia!

user_reviews_extended.Name: james sybesma
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lewcock and his assistant were fantastic. I had some.bad experiences when I was younger that had caused me to avoid the dentist. Dr Lewcock had a very calm demeanor and really put me at ease. I needed novicain and I can honestly say I didn't feel anything, not even the injections. The root canal went very well and aside from my shoulder hurting (the chair doesn't offer much support to tall guys :) it was painless. Old Settlers Dental and Dr Lewcock will always be where I recommend anyone who is looking for a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Abshagen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doc was great.  He was efficient and caring.  Glad my wife recommended him.  Sherice (sp) was awesome as well.  While nobody likes visiting the dentist, the staff here makes it worthwhile and as pleasant as a dental visit can be!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anand Gupta
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Always a great experience.
For 10+ yrs I have received excellent care here!
Thank you so much “Old Settlers Dental @ Round Rock”

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jade
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I put a 4 star review 8 months ago with them being the only dentist I've known as an adult, and going to a new one now I can say they miss the mark in terms of quality of care for the patient both physically and empathetically.
Physically: their office is rather old & not as updated, & going to a new dentist I was told I had calcification happening on my back teeth that the doctor & hygienist here couldn't see or just didn't tell me about just three months prior to the new doctor telling me I had it.
Empathetically: there's a $75 rescheduling fee within 24hrs of your appt which is ridiculous because people have lives & my new dentist has nothing like that. & when I got quotes for adult braces at this location, their silver braces quote was higher than a gold brace quote with newer high tech equipment at a different office. When I told the dentist at Old Settlers I was going with a different ortho, he basically seemed mad that I wasn't proceeding with them & left quick.
Everyone is perfectly nice but it's the little details that matter foremost.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Omar Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: My regular hygienist at Old Settlers Dental that I've been seeing for the past several years moved away, but the new one I saw yesterday was just as good if not better.  Dr. Zavala and staff continue to provide excellent service in a professional, friendly atmosphere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jamie gray enfinger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sadly I have edit the original review to state not to go here unless you're comfortable going to an office that is run by a dental support organization that pushes production rather than individualized care. I had to change dentists, because I have no desire to be treated like a number and not an individual. Further, I actually asked straight out if they were privately owned or owned by a corporation and they lied to me about it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Powanda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a new client at Old Settlers Dental Care. My experience on both of my recent visits has been incredible!
