user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Hatch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome place

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Matthews
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny O
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is always friendly and welcoming. I always receive excellent, quality care no matter what procedure is being done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pam Hammond
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very Professional practice.  Excellent staff and Dentists

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Cloud
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the front office staff to the dental assistants to Dr. Zavala everyone is very welcoming.  And this is coming from someone who is very scared of going to the dentist.  I wouldn't go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annette Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Lewcock and the staff are always welcoming and mindful of my sensitivities. They are cheerful, professional, gentle, and knowledgeable. I’m very happy with their service!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Don Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very clean and very friendly. The only reason I didn't give it a 5 star review is they don't contract with insurane companies, meaning your out of pocket is high

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Krieger
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As an Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon myself, Dr. Lewcock is the Dentist I trust with the care of my family.

As a practitioner, I can tell you that Dr. Lewcock and his team have done what is very difficult to do in dentistry: Create an exceptional patient experience!

They have gone above and beyond to create a beautiful, clean office that is incredibly professional yet also warm and welcoming, with wonderful team members making you feel like part of their family.

While the experience is top-notch, the real reason I take my family to Dr. Lewcock is the level of dental care that he provides.

It is difficult to find a dentist who has taken the time and investment to perfect their craft through the extensive additional training that Dr. Lewcock has pursued. He is truly on the cutting edge and provides the highest-quality care available in dentistry today.

He also personally prides himself on the quality of his work and on doing the “little things” that matter, even if you won’t always see them as the patient. Unfortunately, this is simply not the case in many dental offices today. Rest assured, however, that you will receive unparalleled attention to detail and exceptional care from Dr. Lewcock - even if it is not the norm in dentistry anymore.

As both a colleague in the dental field and a patient, I cannot say enough about Dr. Lewcock and his team.

This is where “dentists go for their dental care”.

Sincerely,
Matt Krieger DMD
Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mikaela Neill
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Lewcock and his team are fantastic. We had Alyssa as our hygienist. She was a natural with kids. Kind and gentle. Lots of fun flavors for kids, a tv to keep them occupied, and really appreciated the patience they both had for our 2 year old. It takes a few extra minutes of explaining and showing her tools before she was open to them doing anything. The fluoride application at the end was a breeze too!

Dr Lewcock went the extra mile to make sure our daughter felt comfortable when doing the exam. He was also happy to spend extra time chatting though our questions and best practices to keep her teeth strong and healthy.

The office was clean and inviting and the kids corner in the waiting area was a nice touch.

Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ivan Petrusic
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Polson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always a good experience. My dental hygienist is really awesome. Would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittney Janda
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter’s front teeth were knocked in from a softball accident. They took excellent care of her, calmed her, and were able to save her smile. We couldn’t be more thankful. Dr. Lewcock and his team were amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Carley
user_reviews_extended.Description: This week I went in for my annual dental cleaning. She did a great job. No cavities found. She commented that my gums looked good. She was friendly and professional.  I highly recommend Old Settlers Dental - Round Rock

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Heye
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is friendly and efficient . the hygienist I saw, did an excellent job cleaning my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Brenner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Became a new patient here recently and everyone here was so nice and helpful. Usually get a little nervous about going to the dentist but everyone here was so over-the-top kind I felt comfortable and at ease

user_reviews_extended.Name: luis g
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service the personnel working here . Attentive, kind, professional attitude.  The equipment is modern top of the line .The place is nice and clean.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandi Cherry
user_reviews_extended.Description: State of the Art Dentistry. Professional, Caring and I must say “Gentle”  employees I have experienced in a Dental Office. Jessica- Hygienist “The Best” !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Alaniz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have dental anxiety and they have been so kind and gentle while getting my teeth in great shape. Thank you Dr: Lewcock and team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul McCartney
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very attentive, informative and professional.  It's a pleasure to have such care from the entire staff.
Highly recommended!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick N
user_reviews_extended.Description: Jessica is the best! Great dentists here for basic cleaning or even reconstructive surgery. Plenty of options for whitening or Invisalign offered as well. Everyone at reception is super nice and cordial. Great crew ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elle Annee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming here since I started high school now I’m in my mid 20s and the services and communication still hasn’t changed by far my favorite dentist I’ve had

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Soriano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Profesional and detailed

user_reviews_extended.Name: CODY BLANCHARD
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Zavala and the entire team are fantastic! The office is welcoming, professional, and they make every visit comfortable and stress-free. Dr. Zavala takes the time to explain everything and truly cares about patients. Highly recommend if you're looking for a great dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charmayne Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lewcock is an amazing dentist!! It doesn't matter how extensive your appt may be, there will be no pain during or after!!! Couldn't have a better experience!!

title: Round Rock Dental Group
address: 151 Deep Wood Dr, Round Rock, TX 78681, United States

user_reviews.Name: Arin Krauss
user_reviews.Description: We absolutely love coming to the Round Rock Dental group! Everyone here is so kind between the front desk, to the hygienist and the dentist! Devann is our hygienist and has been cleaning our teeth for years! She is gentle, caring, and informative. I love that her and the dentist make action plans for our teeth and are communicative about things we need or don’t need. I have never once felt like the price gouge and they always let me know what is truly necessary or what can wait and keep my budget in mind. I have never had a dental office be so thorough, accommodating, and honest. If you haven’t checked them out, you should, your family won’t regret it!

user_reviews.Name: Nick Perry
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Fogarty was absolutely fantastic. She took the time to explain everything in detail, answered all my questions, and made sure I was at ease throughout the entire procedure. The professionalism and care were evident in every step of the process. I had some fillings that needed to be re done since they were 10yrs old and it was honestly pain-free and quick! She was gentle, and the whole appointment went smoothly.  I cannot recommend her enough

user_reviews.Name: Kyle Cuenco
user_reviews.Description:
I highly recommend Dr. Fogarty. She is the most caring, knowledgeable dentist I have had. I am certainly not a big fan of going to the dentist but, Dr. Fogarty puts me at ease and makes me feel as comfortable as possible during my visit. She took the time to explain the procedure clearly, and was genuine about the treatments that I needed.  Fantastic experience all the way around.

10/10 recommend Round Rock Dental Group!.

user_reviews.Name: Ian Hutchinson
user_reviews.Description: As someone who used to dread dental visits due to fear of lengthy procedures and high costs, I can confidently say that Round Rock Dental Group completely changed my perspective. Dr. Fogarty has made every one of my visits over the past year incredibly easy and comfortable. She crafted an excellent treatment plan and worked with me to ensure it aligned perfectly with my budget. Now, instead of being scared, I actually look forward to my appointments with her, knowing I'm one step closer to a fantastic smile! If you're in the area and searching for a new dental office, I highly recommend scheduling a consultation with Dr. Fogarty. Thanks again!

user_reviews.Name: Brandon Muston
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough great things about my experience with Dr. Fogarty and the Round Rock Dental Group team. From the moment you walk through the door, you’re treated with warmth, professionalism, and genuine care. Dr. Fogarty is not only incredibly skilled but also takes the time to explain everything clearly, making you feel comfortable and confident in the care you’re receiving.

If you’re looking for a dentist who combines expertise, compassion, and a top-tier patient experience, look no further. Dr. Fogarty is absolutely outstanding!

user_reviews.Name: Teri Krauss
user_reviews.Description: I have been going to Round Rock Dental Group for 8 years and Dr Fogerty is the best dentist I have ever been to.  I have stage 4 cancer so that means a lot of extra attention is required for even the simplest procedures and I always feel confident in the Dr as well as the entire staff.

user_reviews.Name: Paul Krauss
user_reviews.Description: Folks I gotta tell you Dr. Fogarty is absolutely amazing! I have been coming to her for over 7 years and an old filling from childhood finally needed to be replaced. I have to say I am amazed! Dr. Fogarty was so careful and gentle that I literally never experienced ANY pain during or after the procedure. Thank you for taking such care Dr. Fogarty, you’re the greatest!

user_reviews.Name: Madison Stathos
user_reviews.Description:
Shady is all I can say.
Was referred here by my “grandparent in laws” who are long time patients at this practice and the visit was AMAZING! However, Dr Fogarty and I talked about a scratch on a tooth I had rebuilt in the front of my mouth out of composite filling and she offered to fix it while I was laying in her chair! She even added “I’ll do it for free”…I guess no good deed goes unpunished because now my tooth has a chip at the bottom of it.
I called the other week to schedule an appointment to get my tooth fixed and wanted to make sure I was not going to be charged for this visit as I’ve had these teeth for 10+ years and never had an issue of breakage until she touched my teeth. The staff told me they were going to do X rays and submit to insurance!!! WHAT? I know for a fact I don’t need X rays because it’s literally the surface of my tooth? And the staff also told me that she put in my clinical notes that I am the one who requested for her to buff my tooth, ABSOLUTELY NOT. I just think now that it was done on purpose so my tooth would break and then she’d get to redo my teeth with veneers.
Also at mine and my fiancés visit, they didn’t even do everything they were supposed to for my fiancé because Dr Fogarty left half way through his appointment that they made for us so we can knock our yearly out together in one appointment and STILL filed insurance and took his $100 copay.
Super sad they don’t honor THIER mistakes and simultaneously commit insurance fraud. Will never be coming back to this practice. Hopefully they learn how to take better care of their patients after the fact.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Longjas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm very happy with my dentist, Dr. Fogarty! She is personable, takes the time to explain dental procedures thoroughly, and you can tell she truly has your best interest at heart. Her professionalism and genuine care make each visit comfortable and stress-free. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon Schubert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing dentist office!! They have such a professional staff that really care about every person that walks in their front doors and take the time to make sure each understands the procedures that they need. They really want to make sure you feel secure in your decision and above all the work performed is done to perfection!!  I had a crown done and walked out, same day, with my new crown, the fit was incredible, I had no pain and it looks amazing!! What more can you ask for!! They even followed up to see how I was doing!! I would highly recommend Round Rock Dental to anyone looking for a new dentist!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Moehle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dental care at RR Dental is exceptional! They make a complicated procedure look easy and feel even better. All executed with a smile and friendly conversation!
I have been going there for 16 years and most of the folks feel like family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James theYounger
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love coming to Round Rock Dental Group. They are always friendly and compassionate to any situation I have when there is a dental emergency.  Dr. Fogarty is the best dentist I've had in my forty seven years on this earth. She is always nice, makes me laugh, and I've never had pain during the multiple visits I've had with her. All in all she is just good! I have recommended RRDG to all of my friends, my friends friends, my friends friends friends, and so on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Outstanding, Impeccable and Trustworthy! My wife and I Love Devann and Dr Hoffman along with all the staff. Congratulations!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Teter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Makayla and Dr. Adams were absolutely wonderful.  I had not been in a long time and needed some work done.  My first visit with these two was awesome.  They made every effort to make sure I was comfortable.  I will definitely schedule with them again.  Thank you for a good experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Collins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Round Rock Dental.  Dr. Murphy and his team are professional and considerate.  They take the time to explain procedures.  I never feel rushed!   Carla is always great at starting the visit off.  Carolyn is very detailed when cleaning your teeth.  Round Rock Dental is an honest and caring practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jon Henny
user_reviews_extended.Description: Another pleasant experience at Round Rock Dental. I've been a customer for nearly a decade, and I've never been disappointed. Dr. Bez and Gracie took great care to make my procedure as comfortable as possible. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: twyla weaver
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a traumatizing dental experience several years ago and when I went in to have a crown replaced, I was so nervous. The dentist was patient, he talked me through the procedure and gave me plenty of breaks to breathe. He made me comfortable and took his time which helped ease my anxiety. Although the procedure took 3 hours, it was painless and low stress. Would highly recommend Round Rock Dental Group for all dental care needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dylan Litherland
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience as a new patient. All the staff was very friendly in a very cozy building. Dr. Hoffman advised me on my wisdom tooth needing to be pulled, I said I don't wish to do that. That was it. There was no trying to sell me anything, just respect on his great experience and on my decision. He even had time to quickly polish off one tooth with a bond that had stained quite a bit more than the rest. Awesome service, can't wait to get my cleaning next week.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Ramos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Fogarty is always so knowledgeable and caring. I've had a lot of dental work done and she always keeps my best interest in mind. It's hard to find such a good dentist! My kids and I enjoy coming to see her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jan Gunter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I could not be more pleased with my experience with Dr. Fogarty and her team. I had some unhappy dental experiences in the last few years, and since coming to Round Rock Dental Group, I walk out happier than when I walked in because they treat me with such care and goodness. Excellent dental care and the most gracious and friendly service. Excellent from start to finish!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martha Randolph
user_reviews_extended.Description:
New patient but I can tell this is my long-term dental group from now on. Mary, Rachel, Dr. Adams, nice lady at checkout (sorry I didn’t get your name). They made me laugh, they got me in and out quickly, very professional, and willing to discuss options without making me feel rushed.
Thank you all - nice job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patti Kent
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental assistant and the dentist were superb in their gentle approach to address my sensitivities. I spent 3 hours in the chair for in-office crown replacement and it was as nice as it could be. I cannot recommend  this dental group highly enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lance Barnett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round rock dental is a superior Dentistry Facility. I have been going for 10 years and I will not see another dentist other than Dr. Murphy, and if he were to retire I would choose another one of their fine dentists.  It’s not hyperbole,  I moved 2 1/2 hours away and made the commute today to have work done with a dentist I trust unequivocally. When I initially went I had crowns exploding and cavities busting, and I couldn’t have had any better experience all the way around. Their knowledge, professionalism, integrity, friendliness and concern are off the charts. A great group to say the least.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marina Onorato
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am new to Texas and had a dental emergency. A friend recommended RRDG and it did not disappoint. Dr. Adams and his assistant went over everything clearly with me and tried there best to do the least expensive options first. Very thorough team and office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Whitson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went here for years without issue, albeit have never had anything other than routine cleaning required.

I have to say that the continued challenge has been inflexibility of scheduling. Last time I was scheduled for a cleaning, I had one of my kids in the hospital out of state. I didn’t keep up with the appointment on my calendar and missed my scheduled time. They ran the visit through insurance and billed me the out of pocket amount. The time before that, I needed to reschedule and the next available was months away.

I do understand the need to run a business, yet somehow have found other providers that are flexible to “life” happening. I’ve been unable to return since the last occurrence where I felt unseen and like a number on the books.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Stroberger
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent service and top notch work!!

Dr Strong and Percilla were very very good

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Blank
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Dr Hoffman for over 20 years. My experience yesterday is the best example of caring I can share.  Dr H was booked but I was able to get late spot of another doc. Dr Z was excellent and had me down the path but as soon as Dr H finished his last patient he came over and took care of me.  How many doctors will stay after hours to help a patient. Normally I’d be quick to say zero, but dare I say two cause that’s what I got at Round Rock Dental yesterday.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Rathnam
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fast service, friendly staff and work well done.  They fit my daughter in within a couple of hours to fix a tooth she broke on the day of her first dance!  She left feeling her confident self again :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Adediji
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have to say that this was the best experience I had in an emergency. My filling broke off on Sunday. I called in Monday and they were very accommodating to help me come in. What surprised me even more is that they were able to fix my tooth without me having to come back for a second visit. The staff was awesome and so accommodating. I will recommend you to others. Thanks for helping me in a very very desperate situation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Merima Kulosman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I wish I could give more than 5 stars. I have never felt so heard and welcomed and taken care of at a dentist before!! I felt comfortable and NO anxiety. I needed 7 fillings and the Dr. Adams walked me through each step of the process and made me feel so comfortable. Thank you thank you thank you.

Shoutout to Dr. Adams for being so kind and gentle!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carolyn Toth
user_reviews_extended.Description: RR Dental is outstanding, Dr. Eric Hoffman which is my dentist to both of his assistants, to the hygienist, to the front desk receptionist are all professional, compassionate, but most of all each and every employee truly cares about each patient individually. I highly recommend RR Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brianna Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the  Doctors and staff at this office . Everyone is so friendly, from  Zoë , to my hygienist Erin , to Dr. Fogarty to Dr. Burden . Everyone is so helpful and makes me feel absolutely comfortable. They always get me in & out quickly as well . The overall experience is great .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Smoking with Bush
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Scheduling was easy.  Able to get a last minute appointment 2 days prior.  The dental hygienist was incredibly nice and had amazing bedside manner.  Dr Bez checked me out and it's looking like I have a cracked tooth.  They set up the Endodontics referral immediately.   Will definitely be coming back for any follow-up and my routine cleanings.
Bush

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Gaspard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m extremely pleased with Round Rock Dental.  Dr. Hoffman and Alyssa made my recent procedure almost painless!  Every staff member I’ve interacted with has been very helpful and friendly, and the office itself is beautiful.  ⭐️⭐️⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Berry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience on some dental work with Dr. Hoffman and his dental assistant. Dr. Hoffman was gentle and I felt no pain. It's been years since I've had a dentist this good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Boston
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hoffman was excellent. He is carring, understanding and very easy to talk too. He takes the time needed to understand your dental needs. His is the first Dentist since I have moved to Austin who showed he cares about me as a patient. The office staff is pleasant and attentive. I would give the 10 stars if I could.  Great Dentist Office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Ferens
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve moved around a lot therefore I’ve had many dentists and this is by far the best place I’ve experienced. Christy is always so sweet and helpful at the front/check out. And every hygienist I’ve had is amazing. I used to experience a lot of pain at the dentist but the girls here are very gentle and super sweet. Every one makes you feel comfortable here. Dr. Hoffman is also always very nice, gentle, and educational at each visit. Love this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Icee Curry
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit, I’ve had the unfortunate experience of dealing with not so caring dentist here in Texas.  However, that changed when a friend referred me to Round Rock Dental.  When I called, the receptionist was extremely kind and empathetic towards my needs.  She (very slim and jazzy, worked in banking years ago). set my expectations and nailed it with Dr Dawes.  He was kind, caring and understanding.  My second visit is next week I’m looking forward to seeing how this continues.  Thank you so very much for the kindness and care!  You guys were awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Glahn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can see why 90+ neighbors recommended Round Rock Dental Group. The staff is friendly, efficient and the care and concern was apparent with everyone I came in contact with.  The DDS's were both energetic, personable and had a genuine friendliness and not just because we were patients for the day.  Being opened on emergency basis only, I'd had no difference in the way I was treated when I brought in my kiddo.  Great team.  We may be considering being patients there full time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terri McDaniel
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit was prompt and on time.  I did not have to wait.  Cleaning was done quickly and efficiently.  It was the best one I have had yet.  I hate going to the dentist (who doesn't, right?) and I appreciate a dental hygienist who can get through it with me without pain and without taking a long time. She certainly accomplished that for me in this visit.   But then again, this visit was indicative of every visit here. I can say I enjoy seeing my dentist.  Dr Hoffman is friendly, attentive, and very good at what he does.  I have been coming to Round Rock Dental Group for a very long time.  I love the staff.  They are friendly and attentive.  You can tell they love their jobs.  That says a lot.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have needed urgent care twice since coming to this office and have never been disappointed.  Dr Fogarty is competent, caring, and able to ascertain my problem quickly and explain clearly the how and why of my treatment.  I feel fortunate to have found this office.
I cannot forget to include the front scheduling office in my appreciation as well.  This is a top notch place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah York
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been using Round Rock Dental services for over 10 years. We have always been satisfied with the dental care we received. All the staff are accommodating, skilled in their niche, and very friendly. I was really happy with the new X-ray technology that took the “bite down” pain out of the procedure. My hygienist explained some changes in my teeth and made recommendations to avoid future issues. My dentist also made recommendations to protect the areas around my caps. My overall experience was very pleasant, even for being in the dental chair.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rollings Family
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've gone to Round Rock Dental Group for years.  Love them!  I won't go anywhere else.  They're always easy to work with, friendly, professional and I don't remember ever having to wait more than a few minutes for my appointment.  I recommend them to all my friends and coworkers.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rex Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Murphy is the best. I have been going to him for well over 10 years and he is thoughtful and to the point. I can't rave enough about him and the staff. My wife has been going to him even longer. I would say 15 years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Ryan
user_reviews_extended.Description: First of all..I’m TERRIFIED of going to the dentist, even for cleanings! The staff is so friendly and follow my specific requests (needing nitrous, not using the ultra-sonic cleaner, not putting water directly on  my teeth during my cleaning). They put my comfort first. I trust them with their diagnosis and plan to get all my treatment done. Special shout out to Ally, my hygienist, she is so sweet and so gentle! I felt safe and comfortable. Just the way I want to feel when going to the dentist. 😀

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barnes Barnes
user_reviews_extended.Description: The best reputable dental office. My husband and son went to 2 other Round rock dental practices that found multiple cavities. We got a second opinion at Round Rock Dental group. The "cavities" were just stains they polished out. My son's orthodontist confirmed. He has no cavities. If not for round rock dental my kid would have had 4 holes drilled in his teeth 5 years ago. To this day he's never had a cavity. Get a second opinion when they want to do dental work. You'll be very glad you did.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Munley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love my hygienist, Erin. They are always on time, caring & makes sure I am comfortable since I hate going to the dentist. I had Dr. Adams today who was new to me and he was super nice. Overall just a great place to take care of your teeth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dana Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ally was my hygienist  and she was just very gentle, very thorough, and very informative. Dr Murphy is an excellent dentist who takes great care of you. He did a complete check of my teeth, gums, glands, and bite. The receptionist was welcoming and friendly. I’ve been going there for years. I’m a very happy customer!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheryl Small
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first time using the Round Rock Dental Group, from the person on the phone to the visit with the dentist this team was kind, professional &  courteous. The energy in the office was welcoming and I had a great experience. Would recommend and will be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joyce Lowden
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my first visit with Round Rock Dental Group today. I was met with friendly smiles and warm hellos.Dr. Hoffman has a nice chairside manner, very friendly and experienced. Lori handled my cleaning and she is so pleasant and very gentle. So happy to have found this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doe Bellows
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was recommended to Dr.Murphy DDS by my Sleep Apnea Dr. I made the decision to drive ‘1hour for my next scheduled exam and cleaning.  So glad I did. Front staff is friendly, Dr.Murphy was very knowledgeable about my dental health.  Hygienist(Devon) was amazing.  She had to schedule two different cleaning appointments for me due to the lack of care that I have had in the past. The only downside is the traveling in traffic but with the three appointments that I have had so far it has been worth it.  Thank You Round Rock Dental-you guys ROCK!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Coy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The best dental experience ever!
Dr Forgerty, Alyssa, Erin and McKenzie were great! I brought my 10 mo old and he started getting fussy so the team stepped in and helped keep him calm until my fillings were done! The care and love for their patients is something rare.

user_reviews_extended.Name: R Y
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Round Rock Dental Group. The staff is very friendly especially the hygienist, Carolyn. She cleans my teeth very clean and carefully so that I don't feel hurting whenever the tool touches my teeth and gums. I have visited her for more than 10 years. When she left RR Dental, I missed her. I am so glad that she is back. 😊👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: cwj3rd
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Murphy is an excellent dentist. He’s been my dentist for over 20 years and I have never had a bad experience.  He takes the time to explain every procedure he was doing. For example, when I cracked my crown, Dr. Murphy was very supportive, and thorough when explaining the process to fix it. He is a professional and has a wonderful personality, which is his nature.  He is second to none. I have and will continue to recommend Dr. Murphy to everyone. He is the Best!
Loyal Customer,
CJ

user_reviews_extended.Name: M&M Mason
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round Rock dental group is the absolute best. The staff is so kind and friendly. The office is CLEAN and very comfortable. Dr. Trevino was wonderful and explained everything to me in full detail to ensure I was aware of the issue and the treatment plan to fix the problem. I can't say enough about them, other than I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Jordan
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a great cleaning I had today with Erin!  I was  apprehensive at first going in for my cleaning but knowing  Lori my regular awesome hygienist would be there all was good.  Surprise, a new person Erin, she was great with explanations, new ideas and motivation to floss, floss floss.  Dr. Murphy was his usual fun loving self.  I have been a patient of his since the 80's. thank you Round Rock Dental! .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen Grunewald
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is everything you could want in terms of communication. Email, phone - it's wonderful. They also listen to you and address your concerns. I had an issue during my service and they so kindly and respectfully addressed it. Also their communication about insurance is great. Unfortunately they can't take my insurance for the time being but they notified me right away. I'm not sure I've ever had that happen before. I hope they can figure out the issue so I can go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Craig Geurin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is friendly and courteous, from the time I check in til I’m stepping out the door.  Lots of space in the waiting area to maintain social distancing.  My dental hygienist, Shari, is fantastic!  Dr. Hoffman is top notch!  Always a great experience at Round Rock Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbi Woodward
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always been impressed with the way Rond Rock Dental Group is run. Very efficient from check- in to check-out. Everyone is friendly and welcoming. Ii have always received excellent dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pamela Carlson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had my teeth cleaned by Lorena this morning. She was friendly, thorough, informative, and very patient when my anxiety interrupted. I could not believe how great my teeth felt after she was done. I was super happy with the job she did. My teeth have never ever felt this good, and I go twice a year, every year! She said my compliment made her day, but her attention and effort made mine. I will definitely recommend her to my friends and family!
My apologies if I misspelled her name.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert D Micks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am 51 and I’ve been seeing Dr Murphy since I was 16 and lived in NJ no less (I moved to Austin at 30). I trust him more than any medical professional in my life. He is exceptional in every imaginable way. Now I trust my children to him fully, and he has more than earned that trust with his care. The hygienists are also spectacular, they treat my autistic son with patience and love. This is the practice you want.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eugenia Hastings
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love how caring the entire staff is.
I needed a new front partial in an urgent situation. They got me in and processed my partial in a timely manner.
I am not happy with partial...
Still happy with Round Rock Dental. I am sure they will make it right.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Bissonett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just a teeth cleaning, as usual an excellent experience!  Shari is the best, easy going and sweet always.  Dr. Hoffman is a great guy too, always remembers me and my family.  The ladies at the front are top notch as well. Highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Nichols
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a longtime client of Dr. Joe Murphy and I have never been disappointed by his highly skilled dental care and service. Even when he was not there, his office recently provided care for a presumed root canal issue. Thanks to the expertise of Dr. Hanson, I was professionally provided the emergency care I needed. Thank you Round Rock Dental Group for always being there for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve McGarel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dawes is awesome. I was a patient of Dr. Smith for many years until his retirement. On my first visit Dr. Dawes was very friendly and approachable and very understanding about dealing with some unusual medical issues. On the medical side he explained what was going to happen every step of the way, making me aware of exactly what to expect. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Guillermo Cabrera
user_reviews_extended.Description: In my 20 years visiting dentists in the various states I have lived in, I find Dr. Hoffman and all his team to be the best dental group I have ever been at. Their professionalism and and attention to detail is remarkable. Great spacious waiting area, top of the line equipment, appointments on time, all the time. Looking forward to keep visiting for years to come.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nate Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Hoffman and his staff are incredible!!!  I am terrified of going to the dentist and while I’m not over that I will go back to him.  They really took care of me and were very gentle and accommodating.  Its the next day and I am in NO pain!  Great job!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Johanns
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Cleaning with Karen

It is always a pleasure to visit the Round Rock Dental Group and spend time with Karen.  I am always greeted warmly by the front desk staff, and the intake process is quick and easy.

Karen is always punctual and pleasant.  It is a time to get my teeth checked and cleaned and to connect with Karen every six months.  I always get feedback on my dental health practices and practical tips on how to improve dental hygiene.

Thanks for a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Chambliss
user_reviews_extended.Description: I LOVE Round Rock Dental Group. Their office staff is some of the friendliest around and every hygienist I have seen has been great. Dr.Trent is the best and very personable. They are always very upfront and honest and make going to the dentist a positive experience. I wouldn’t go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Having suffered from severe anxiety surrounding dental visits for many years, I was unsurprisingly very nervous to go to the dentist, knowing I needed to have some work done. During my initial exam, Dr. Hoffman was able to establish trust and truly put me at ease with his attention, thorough explanations, and overall demeanor.

His team was then able to work with the schedule so I could have everything done in one visit! Dr. Hoffman (along with the other dentists at RRDG) offers different sedation options, which I highly recommend discussing if you have anxiety when it comes to dental procedures. (I chose oral sedation - pills taken 1 hour before appointment).

Throughout my entire appointment, Dr. Hoffman and his team made sure I was comfortable and gave me updates on where we were in the process (but without any overwhelming details, which I appreciated).

The day after my appointment, I received a call just to check in on me to see how I was doing - a service and gesture I haven’t received before and truly appreciated!

Overall, I can’t recommend this practice enough, especially Dr. Hoffman! He truly goes above and beyond to make his patients comfortable and feel cared for. Thank you, Dr. Hoffman and RRDG!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Bippert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Orlich was wonderful during my visit. I was really nervous about having a tooth extraction, but he put my mind at ease before, during and after the procedure.  Everything has gone smoothly, and I am grateful for Dr. Orlich’s expertise!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Colette Clarke Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Murphy, my sister & Mom's dentist was the only dentist in NW Austin that returned my call on a long holiday weekend when my tooth split. I called over 25 offices. Dr. Murphy was kind enough to explain what he thought had happened and why it could wait until their office opened on Monday. (My dentist was in Houston and many dental offices I tried weren't opening until Wednesday!) He checked on me again on Sunday and told me that his office would call early Monday. They did! And I had appointment that afternoon. Dr. Murphy was actually out of town. What a guy to help me out when he was enjoying his holiday! I ended up seeing Dr. Monell. After the great Rachel took my x-rays, Dr. Monell confirmed that Murphy had been right. I am terrified of dental work. Somehow Rachel's kindness kept me calm throughout and Dr. Monell 's work was gentle and swift. Every staff person was kind, caring & informative. I will be a lifelong patient at Round Rock Dental Group. I hope I will get the chance to thank Dr. Murphy in person. I am especially grateful to Rachel and Dr. Monell for helping me have an easy day at the dentist. Everyone I met today was kind and helpful but those 2 went above and beyond. I highly recommend Round Rock Dental Group & hope that if you call, it won't be because of an emergency. But do call! You'll be so happy that you did!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Flower Junkie Love
user_reviews_extended.Description: Even though it is a large practice, I feel like part of the family here.  From the moment I walk in, I feel the warmth, and feel relaxed. Everyone is kind and friendly.  They are always knowledgeable and skilled in the latest and best treatment options, yet they try to save you money if they feel something isn't necessary.  I absolutely love my hygienist, April, and Dr. Dawes.  Dr. Dawes has savrd the day by seeing two of my family members for dental emergencies.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony Befi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Fogarty is an excellent dentist with a gentle, caring, and friendly approach. She and her team always put patient care first. I recently  had my bridge come loose right before a long vacation trip. Dr. Fogarty came up with a creative solution and modified her schedule to fit me in before the trip. I would highly recommend her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frank Stahler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience starting with making the appointment, greeting by the receptionists, extremely pleasant dental assistant, and Dr Adam was fantastic.  He answered all my  trivial questions.  He explained the whole process in a way my simple mind could understand. This group was highly recommended by several friends and they were spot-on!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Felib Iskander
user_reviews_extended.Description: The front-desk staff is always smile and welcoming patient.  The hygienists doing such marvelous job in cleaning and the dentist always doing a very detailed oral exam.  My wife and I have been patients there  from the time the office open it’s door in Round Rock.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina P
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Murphy has provided great dental care to me and my family for many years.  Dr Murphy is very thorough in clinical judgment and procedures.  I always have great experience visiting Dr Murphy. My dental hygienist Devon at Dr Murphy’s office is also very considerate and thorough. His office staff is caring and polite. Recently I had dental procedure with Dr Monell as Dr Murphy was out. I was very nervous about getting done the procedure. Dr Monell and his assistant were very kind and considerate. They made me very comfortable about the procedure. Dr Monell was very thorough. It was great to have Dr Monell to Dr Murphy’s team.
Thank you Dr Murphy for providing great dental care for many years.
Thank you Dr Monell

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zak Quinn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Trevino and the rest of the dental group are the best. When I was younger I wasn’t very keen on dentists and my oral care. Recently I went to get checked out. Few cavities here and there and Dr. Trevino was able to repair and fix my teeth. Erin the hygienist is amazing too. Overall an amazing group of people up there. Can’t wait to finish my bottom set of teeth and to fix my oral health for months to come. Love this group!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bonnie & Mike Visnius
user_reviews_extended.Description: Even though they had several changes in doctors, we still remained faithful clients until the day I was told that they would contact my insurance to be sure they will cover my daughters regular cleaning visit and never updated me on the insurance response.  I offered to contact my insurance, they told me "no need to, we will contact them for you".  I gave them instructions to inform me if my insurance will NOT cover the visit.  Since no one from the Dental office called, my daughter went ahead with the regular cleaning.  Upon checkout, I was told that nothing will be covered by insurance and I had to pay the entire visit out-of-pocket.  Furthermore, the nasty attitude at the front desk was, "you should have contacted your insurance yourself."  We never returned.  They lost our entire family's business.  No one should be surprised about a bill.  Billing should be discussed prior to services rendered especially if you expect the customer to pay out-of-pocket!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katherine Wallin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Yesterday I had a work-in appointment with Dr. Murphy and his staff because of a broken tooth.  I was able to have a new crown made and put on in one visit.  We have gone to Dr. Murphy for years and always had excellent care.  I highly recommend Round Rock Dental Group.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erik Bruce
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Round Rock Dental Group for 7 years with an overall wonderful experience.  They are very friendly and professional.  I am in the medical profession and have a difficult time with scheduling.  They are very accommodating with my time constraints.  Dr. Eric Hoffman is very thorough and gentle during the evaluation.    I would highly recommend this dental facility.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Stratton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank goodness for RRDG.  I have been neglecting my dental health due to bad experiences with other dental offices in the past.  Unfortunately, I was experiencing some pain, so I made an appointment with Dr. Hoffman at RRDG.  WOW!  What a completely comfortable and positive experience.  Dr. Hoffman was very detailed in his exam and went out of his way to make me feel comfortable after hearing of my negative experiences in the past.  I truly appreciated his bedside manner and the care and concern to make me feel as comfortable as possible.  Also, my dental hygienist (Sheri~not sure of spelling) was AMAZING!!  I just loved her.  Again, her care and concern was so appreciated and she went above and beyond to be gentle and make me comfortable.  I highly recommend this team and since my experience was so positive I have re-committed to take back my dental health since I finally have a place that cares about their patients.  Thank you so much to all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phillip South
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round Rock Dental Group has been consistent over the years.   I never feel starved for face-time with the Dentist, even though the Dentist is the smallest part of the visit.  The staff is universally competent while still being friendly.  They have been good to me, and to my family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheryl Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been going here probably almost 20 years. I drive past numerous chain dental facilities in order to see the doctors here and be treated as a person and not just a number. In this day of companies pushing productivity over developing a relationship with a patient I will hands down stay with Round Round Dental. My regular dentist is Dr Trent Smith but I was having pain over the weekend and they worked me in with Dr Trevino on Monday. He was as outstanding as Dr Smith and I was very pleased with his professionalism and personal care and attention. HIGHLY recommend this dental group whenever anyone is asking.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori Holden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have seen various dentists over 9 years of having my routine dental cleanings and x-rays at Round Rock Dental.  I have not had issues with them trying to sell me unnecessary services, or any issues with the hygienists or dentists.  Fortunately, I have not needed any emergency care, so I cannot share any experiences with those needing urgent dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carla Andrews
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you work outside the home, this place gets you in and out quickly.  Dr. Hoffman, my dentist, is wonderful, caring and great at his work. I had an emergency and called after hours.  Dr. Murphy returned my call and assisted Dr. Hoffman with my plan of treatment. Dr. Hoffman immediately called my prescription in.  This was all done before 10 p.m.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS DENTAL GROUP!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Pollok
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist experience I've had.  I went in for a cleaning and exam.  I liked the openness of the office and it did not feel stuffy, boring and quiet like a normal dentist. The hygienists were super friendly and that helped me relax as I had not been to the dentist in quite a few years!  Dr. Trent was nice and to the point and even quickly polished a filling that had been bugging me for a long time.  The hygienist who cleaned my teeth was very chatty and I didn't mind that.  Seems like they try to make a connection with the patients and make it a decent experience.  They were very understanding that I was apprehensive about being there and explained the tools and what they were doing as they were doing it.  Will be back in 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dayna Collings
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a client of Round Rock Dental Group for about 14 years. They have always been professional and helpful to me. I mostly recently saw Dr. Torres for a jaw joint issue and I was very impressed with his exam. He was through and explained, in detail, all that could be going on as well as making recommendations for treatment. I highly recommend Round Rock Dental Group.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always efficient when you arrive for an appointment. Actually enjoy cleanings from Lori...good conversation though mostly her as you might guess. Scheduling next appointments and check-out is a breeze! Dr. Dawes good also...friendly, efficient and practical. I definitely recommend these folks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Bagheri
user_reviews_extended.Description: A visit to this dental practice is always pleasant. It is relaxing as they put you at ease and the environment is beautiful. The staff have a lot of tenure, so you have an opportunity to get to know everyone over the years.  I realize I am perfectly spoiled to have the good fortune to be a patient at Round Rock Dental,  Dr. Murphy and my hygienist, Tricia, are both exceptionally personable, professional and competent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lockwood Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I like the place.  I like the staff:  they are friendly; have a good sense of humor; and are willing to engage in conversational banter.....I actually had fun, which for a dentist's office is quite extraordinary.  Who would have thought such a thing.  Shari is an excellent hygienist.  I will continue to be your patient as long as she works there, so take care of her, she is a keeper.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leigh Anne Wojcik
user_reviews_extended.Description: Patty did a great job cleaning my teeth.  I already made my next appointment with her.  Dr. Foggerty did wonderful job fixing my teeth.   Both were personable and cared for my welfare and wanted to make sure everything was great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerome Frigillana
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm glad to return to Round Rock Dental Group after a long absence from visiting a dentistry.  I contemplated finding a practice near my residence in Buda, but didn't take long to make up my mind and return to them.  They've always had a good staff.  The facility is nice.  It's convenient from where I work.  Thank you Round Rock Dental Group for getting me back on track!  See you soon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aspen Dog
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve known Dr. Murphy and staff for over twenty years.  They always get to me in my created emergency situations. Their overall service is the best that I have ever been to.  They are compassionate and very caring. I am very proud to be their client.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Hammar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have always felt very welcomed when I arrived at the office.  The dental hygienists always are very comforting and caring.  Just love Dr. Murphy.

It's a shame to think someone has not had a pleasant experience at Round Rock Dental Group.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather H
user_reviews_extended.Description: We’ve been going to Round Rock Dental for years! Dr. Hoffman is amazing and our Hygenist Trisha makes going to get our teeth cleaned such a joy! The whole staff is always very friendly. Would definitely recommend to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Erskine
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A very professional setting and I like that they are so responsive to my questions and concerns.  I normally only need cleaning, but recently had a tooth extracted and they provided me with excellent services.

March 2020 I had a tooth break and lost a filling.  I Especially love the team they have built to bring highly qualified experts to complete every service their clients need.  Nicoleta built my crown using computer technology and explained everything she was doing which put me completely at ease with  a procedure I wasn't looking forward to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Choquette
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I initially gave a bad review due to a very unfortunate series of events.  Today, Round Rock Dental made everything right, and restored my trust.

If you encounter a problem of any kind, and you called,  but nobody returned your call, please keep trying,  because they are willing to correct less than satisfactory experiences.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shirley Hinds
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round Rock Dental is the best.  Dr. Hoffman has been my dentist for years, and I couldn't be happier.  So nice to have a Dental Office that is not a chain.  The experience and knowledge can't be beat. Everyone is so nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Blair J. Beard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round Rock Dental got me in for a fast appointment for a root canal as a first time patient. They not only completed the root canal on my visit but also set me up with my crown in the same visit. The staff was great and I appreciate them getting me in at the last minute.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Blackledge
user_reviews_extended.Description: As I write this, I've been with RRDG for around 12 years.  All of the staff are experienced, well-trained, friendly, positive, and take as much time with you as needed to discuss what needs discussing.  Dr. Murphy, the only doctor I've seen there, shares these characteristics.  He gets the right things done in the proper amount of time.  All of my appointments have started on-time.  One other great thing is that (forgive me if I misspeak) they create crowns in-house.  They are also very good at fitting their dental work and mouth appliances.  I'll never willingly go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mrs. V X
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Based on the reviews on google I anticipated that my visit would be a great experience. While it wasn’t the worst experience... I will not return as a patient or refer others for a few reasons:
1. I completed all my patient forms prior to my visit and when I arrived they did not have or use any of this information, the receptionist didn’t even know my name! She called me by my husbands name. 2. My insurance wasn’t verified prior to arrival and (I provided this when I made the appointment). No one contacted me prior to my appointment to communicate this so I could look into it. 3. Since my insurance hadn’t been verified my appointment was cut short the dentist barely examined my mouth and didn’t even offer to prescribe antibiotics for the infection he told me I had! I had to request this of Dr. Adams! Highly disappointed with this entire situation. If I’m a patient and in pain, why wouldn’t  you want to provide support in helping the patient reach a point of resolution? Is this not why you become a doctor to help people?! The most professional staff member I came in contact with was the finance person-Keisha. She was kind, professional and informative. Kudos to Keisha!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abigail Jensen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have been going to this office for many years and always have amazing service! Lacey does an amazing job and is very personable. The office staff are always helpful!  My dentist moved out of town recently but the new one hired seems very knowledgeable and very friendly! Recommend to everyone looking for a dentist !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa V
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My whole family goes to this dental clinic.  Mind you, I'd rather have a baby naturally than go to a dentist but this place is awesome!
The atmosphere is beautiful, everyone is professional, timely, efficient, and the dentists are knowledgeable and personable.  I love the text message confirmations and reminders! I have nothing bad to say at all! Kudos to your company and we will be patients for life :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reauxdom
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an issue that was quickly addressed with the most conservative approach first and foremost.  Round Rock Dental Group is truly customer oriented, which is one of the many reasons my wife and I have been customers for over 20 years.  Great staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariano Gomez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dental hygienist Lori at RRD is the absolute best as is the staff and Dr. Murphy. I get the best cleanings and treatment with awesome results that  reassures me I am in great hands and am getting the guidance I need for long term healthy teeth. I highly recommend this office if you are seeking new dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theresa Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Round Rock dental group are amazing and friendly. My daddy had 7 teeth pulled yesterday and they were so kind and caring with him and talked him through every step of the way. Our family will continue to be patients here for as long as they are open!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nan Bulla
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round Rock Dental Group helps me keep my teeth healthy! Dr Murphy and his staff are always professional and personable whenever I have a visit. Recently, I called with a painful gum problem and was seen within 24 hours. I appreciate them very much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent staff!! Dr. Fogarty and her team absolutely calmed my fears and explained each step to me. Most importantly, she did not try to talk me into an expensive procedure that could be delayed. The cleaning experience was pleasant, as much as I dread going to the dentist- I will only go here! Wish I had found her years ago!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Edgin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I saw Dr. Bez Yousefi. I was told I needed a root canal even though I had no pain or issues with tooth. After undergoing root canal i experienced pain on a scale of 7/10 to the point where it was keeping me up at night. He refused to prescribe me anything to help even after  coming into office and examining the tooth and obviously seeing how sensitive it was while examining.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LaToya Shepard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Narra was very thorough when explaining a procedure I would need, and was accomodating with scheduling the procedure as far as payment. I had two problem teeth in the back on which I needed a second opinion , and I am glad that I got one, because it turns out that they weren't the problem at all. The people there are nice, and Amy, the hygienist has a fun personality. Would recommend highly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Delenela
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very impressed with the care I received at Round Rock Dental. Huge thanks to Dr Murphy for making the time to call me on an emergency with my temporary crown on a Saturday to make arrangements to be seen the next day  on a Sunday morning. Huge thanks to Devann who volunteered to make repairs on my crown that morning. Thank you for going above and beyond to help me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Hayes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't speak highly enough of this dental group. My coworker recommended them to me since I have been hesitant to go to a dentist after a previous bad experience about 10 years ago. I shouldn't have been so nervous, because Dr. Narra is amazing. He has been so patient with me and helped me deal with my dentist anxiety to the point that I'm not nervous at the dentist anymore after three visits. Go see Dr. Narra and help him build up his practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Bagheri
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Dr. Murphy since I was a kid (20+ years). My entire family sees him, as well. He’s the best dentist and such an awesome person. The dental hygienists are all great. Never once a bad experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Evelyn Burns
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Trevino and Gracie are the best!!  Same goes for the entire front office staff!!  Dr. T. is extremely knowledgeable, professional & caring.  He explains exactly what procedures will take place and why.  Gracie is also professional, caring and friendly.  I've told several people about Round Rock Dental....so very glad I found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gail Tigue
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The dentist I saw was awesome. The way he spoke to me and the questions he asked me made it obvious he is there to enhance not just oral care but the person's whole well-being, body, mind, and spirit.
My hygienist, Lacey, is terrific and not only is great as a hygienist but we really connected person to person.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ken ofunrein
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always, the hygienist and Dr Murphy were at their best.  They answered all the questions and provided the resources needed to make you have a good experience.  Round Rock Dental COVID-19 protocols were very good and it ensures that no patient or staff is exposed.  We all have to do our part to stay healthy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Round Rock Dental Group for 20+ years! They are absolutely amazing people! I would recommend them to everyone!  My last visit was truely wonderful during a very rough week in my personal life. Thank you Round Rock Dental Group! 💕

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabi L
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to this office for 10 years. Love it! Clean, friendly and informative on what I need to keep my teeth and gums healthy. Dr Dawes was my dentist for 9 years and he was AWESOME! I have a new dentist and hes great, too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley M
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to RR Dental since I was 18 (now 43)!! Loved all the hygienists over the years but love Lacey as my primary! After Dr. Nast retired (awesome and miss him), began using Dr. Trent Smith...he is fabulous and so personable. These two truly care about you and they let you know it :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gordon Preecs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Murphy has been my Texas dentist since we moved here at the outset of the pandemic with a crown that popped off. Saw me as a work in emergency and has done all my work since then including 2 new crowns. Kind and genial, great staff, everything I could want in a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debra Gordon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Trevino and all the staff at Round Rock Dental have been wonderful.  When I came into the office, I was still a little shaken from having fallen in my home and having chipped a front tooth.  Dr. Trevino was calm and reassuring and very quickly confirmed that he could effect the repair with dental bonding and completed the process in about an hour.  I was incredibly relieved to have my tooth back and to know that that was one less thing I had to worry about in terms of my recovery.  Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was the best! I have had sores in my mouth for two years and three different doctors couldn’t diagnose what was wrong. Today two different dentist at round rock dental confirmed the same condition and it made a great deal of sense. I would say this is one of the best dentist I’ve ever been to and I’ve been to a lot of Dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Fernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Chipped my front tooth over the weekend. Called Monday to make an appointment. Went in Tuesday morning. Dr. Bez repaired my tooth in about 20 minutes. Completely painless, and he did a fantastic job!! My tooth looks even better than before I chipped it! To boot, Dr. Bez was confident, caring, and funny. And, the staff was friendly and courteous every step of the way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Magui Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist has always given me anxiety. However in the past years that I have been attending Round Rock Dental group, my anxiety has dissipated enormously due to the caring staff they have;  starting from the smiley lady at the front, the hygienist, the entire staff and of course the dentists (my old one left, but the new one so far has been extremely caring).  I am grateful to have found them  and to continue having them now.  Thank you guys and Happy Holidays.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynette Dahmer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I chipped a front tooth over the weekend.  They got me in quick.  Cost effective.  Dr Hoffman and staff were great.  Thank you Round Rock Dental group.

user_reviews_extended.Name: SY Simpson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was disappointed that I went to get my front tooth fixed and left with an apt a month away and talk of my back molars. My molars do not hurt. None of my teeth hurt. I just want my front tooth fixed nothing else.

1 year later I still do not have my front tooth fixed. Keep getting rescheduled. Not all Dentist are there at the same time. This place does Not pay attention to patient needs only their office needs. What a sham!!!

Dr. Bez has very rude patient manners.when having anxiety  his response was " you need to hurry up and make a decision your out of time" what the heck! Seeing as many patients as he can in one day is
more important than patient care. So over this place. Cant wait to be done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hollister Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you need dental services, run, don’t walk, to Round Rock Dental Group. They are so knowledgeable, professional, friendly snd efficient. And their equipment is state-of-the-art. I had a pain in a molar which turned out to be cracked. They were able to do a crown same day, which i had never heard of before. (Like i said, state-of-the-art since they make the crowns right there)..They explained everything and showed me the x-rays. I never had a moment of discomfort! Dr. Hoffman was the best!
The whole staff was great. No billing problems whatsoever.
Apparently there is another dental family practice by a similar name, so be sure to go to the one on Deepwood drive in Round Rock.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Myra Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Couldn't have asked for a better experience, especially given the circumstances. Woke up with an awful toothache. The receptionist was very understanding and quick to get me in. Dr. Trevino and his assistant were so kind and genuinely concerned; they didn't make me feel ashamed or embarrassed. They took care of my problem, were very encouraging about the outcome, and explained everything in a clear and easy to understand way. He called the following day, as he said he would, to check up on me. I definitely didn't feel like just another patient, even though it'd been months since my last visit. If you have any anxiety about going, I'd highly recommend Dr. Trevino and the Round Rock Dental Grp.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Seignious
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had to visit another dr then my regular and had the worst experience.  Was in the worst pain and in tears and was shamed for asking for something stronger than the Tylenol that I was taking.  Was told I won’t be in pain anymore after the numbing and that was huge lie as I was in worse pain before.  They also told me verbatim “Sorry I worked through lunch to make you feel better and you’re not appreciative” lol isn’t that the doctors job! Plus shame me for asking for Tylenol 3! Worst bedside manner from DR. Monell! He was arguing with me during the surgery! I was tears from pain and the treatment I experienced.

user_reviews_extended.Name: RaeAnna Sprague
user_reviews_extended.Description: I manage a large plumbing service company in Round Rock and I a  firm believer in good customer service. I must say that the dental service I received here was top notch! My Dental problem was pretty extreme. I had 4 bad teeth extracted with minimal pain. Unfortunately the people outsourced to make the partial had made an error in the design of the partial. It didn't fit properly at first but the doctor skillfully worked on the partial until it fit properly. When I looked in the mirror I saw a beautiful smile that I have never experienced in my life.  My wife and children loved the results. I was able to eat food that evening with minimal pain. On top of that they made a new mold and sent off for a new improved partial immediately. They will be fitting the new improved partial in a few days at no charge. In a situation that could have potentially gone very bad they skillfully pulled off a miracle and made it right. They have my business for life and I will recommend them to all of my coworkers and friends.Their old school service and caring for the customer at all costs will never be forgotten.These people genuinely care about the customer first!! You earned  my 5 stars today. Thank you!!  Jerry Sprague

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martin Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round Rock Dental Group is awesome.  Really like the collaborative professional team they have there to make diagnoses and provide best service options.  Many thanks Sheri and Dr. Adams.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bart Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Nobody enjoys going to the dentist but the Round Rock Dental Group have done an axcellent job at lessening the pain. We have used Dr Hoffman for years now and are very pleased with his demeanor and ability to get through a procedure quickly and with out complications. Having a wife who has been terrified of the dentist will now go to her appointments without stressing out prior.

The office does an excellent job of notifying you more than once of an upcoming visit. I have never had to wait more than 10 minutes for an appointment. The office is very clean and inviting.

I guess this is about as good as it can get for a dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Round Rock Dental Group for 30 years. I have seen multiple dentists and hygienists over the years and all have provided excellent services. I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yancy Wehmeyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: In the midst of obtaining a tooth implant I was to have another appointment just to get impressions of my teeth. Fortunately, Dr. Narra happened to be in the building and was able to finish the impressions without me having to have another appointment. I think it was his day off. Great service and fine dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Sato
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ally do a fine job cleaning my teeth and she had asked if I had any changes regarding my teeth and I mentioned I experienced a little sensitivity in the upper molar area. She then decided to take an X-ray and it was discovered I had a crack which could have become a serious issue if she wasn’t proactive. I am very appreciative of Ally and Dr. Hoffman’s practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judy Wade
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Fogerty and her assistant were awesome today.  I was so appreciative of their concern, care, and explanation of the treatment options.  They made time for me in order to assess my emergency needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Mann
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Round Rock Dental Group for several years, seeing Dr. Hoffman for all my dental work. I have been seeing Dr. Platson for my Invisalign for a little over a year and Dr. Burden removed my wisdom teeth this past year. All of the dentists/oral surgeons, assistants, and hygienists are awesome and my experiences have always been nothing short of great! The friendly staff makes going to the dentist enjoyable and stress-free!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Hibbard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have always had a good experience with Round Rock Dental Group. They have taken time to discuss my teeth and best options for me. They have always worked with me on   insurance options and the lowest cost out of pocket. One hygenist even called me to tell me she would be out of the office for a while due to surgery. She wanted to ensure me that I would be taken care of. I can't recommend enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Phil Welti
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent visit as usual. Paperwork taken care of ahead of time. Short wait on appointment. Extremely knowledgeable  and efficient dental assistant (Erin?). And Dr. Ohrlich was great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heathor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place - kind and professional staff, explained everything to me and offered to answer questions, overall a great experience. I was nervous to go to the dentist after letting my care lapse due to COVID and they helped set my mind at ease. If you haven’t been to see a dentist in a while, don’t wait any longer!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Cardwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: No one enjoys going to the dentist but this (my first visit) was great. Dr. Fogarty, Kristin, Ally and Carlin made me feel not just welcomed but comfortable and confident in them. Highly recommend this group.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler de Jong
user_reviews_extended.Description: The building is very nice, feels much more homey than a regular dentist's office.  Dr Fogarty and her assistants are awesome at what they do.  If you live in the Round Rock area, this is the place to go!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Vedrode
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time there and they were amazing. Took me right in for an emergency.  So so thankful they were open during this time and took all safety precautions they could to insure the patients safety.  The staff was amazing.  I hate going to the dentist and they made it comforting for me and did an amazing job.  Would it be weird to say I'm looking forward to the next visit lol.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Tungol
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ryan Trevino and my hygienist Erin Power were both 10/10. Nice office with friendly staff. Clean environment. Thorough and efficient service. Go to this office if you are looking for new place for treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Walt Moeller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Per usual, hygenist Carolyn is very methodical and gentle, does a good job. My first visit with Dr. Trent Smith, went well. Only entailed inspection of glands, tongue, teeth, he spent some time explaining a few things that could be helpful. I appreciated his time doing that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: bill kratz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Having a dental "emergency" and Round Rock Dental Group go hand-in-hand.  My dentist was closed Friday, my daughter recommended Round Rock Dental Group. I called and got an immediate appointment. Within 2 hours my "emergency" had come to a painless resolution.
Thanks to Dr. Chris Adams and the entire staff.  Professional, caring and a pleasure doing business with.  They now have a new patient ...Me!

user_reviews_extended.Name: brenda savage
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was worked in after a crown had come off so of course it was recommended I get a new crown!
After the crown I had A lot of sensitivity to that tooth which I did not have before. After getting my teeth cleaned a dentist sent someone in while I was in the chair and said that Dentist had time to pull that tooth that I just got the crown on! I said no thanks and knew it was time to get a new dentist! When I called about a credit to be mailed to me from months before the office manager talked me into coming back to see the original dentist that had done the crown! Shame on me! The next recommendation was root canal and he could not find One of the roots after drilling through the crown! When checking out they recommended 2 crowns!
Needless to say I never went back! I found Dr. B and Oakwood Endodontics that retreated the uncompleted root canal and also did another and save 2 teeth that would have been pulled here! Always get a second opinion Dentist are no different than Other Doctors there are good ones and ones that want to make money!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawn S
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'd recommend Round Rock Dental off Deepwood in Round Rock, TX to anyone seeking Dental advice or help. Been going here for 30 years. The staff, front desk make you feel welcome and their work is the best in the business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura
