user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and Doctors are always professional and polite.  I have been going to Dr. Conquest for 30+ years.  The longevity of the patients shows the quality of care RR Dental Group gives.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johney Moran
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As Dr. Conquest, whom I would always give 5 stars, is retiring, I met my new dentist, Dr. Chris Felicetta for the first time.  I was impressed by Dr. Chris.  He was quite friendly, answered the few questions that I had, and proceeded to replace the filling that I had lost the previous day.  The procedure was totally pain free, and I did not even feel the needle stick for numbing.

Dr. Chris took the time the next day to telephone me to ask if everything was okay and did I have any problems, questions or concerns with my new filling. I appreciated the thoughtfulness behind that gesture.

Here is hoping that I have a long term experience with Dr. Chris.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jm Ma
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been using this office for over 10 years back when they were off of Hwy 79 and Sunrise.  I have to say that they have turned into this big machine and although they are all nice and give you big smiles their #1 driver is now revenue.  This office is way too big and busy now and all the things that made it a great intimate office with great customer service have declined.  I will be moving my family to another dentist.  I also agree with another poster that all they do there is try to up sell you on everything.  Their support staff also needs stronger direction.  These doctors tend to side more with their support staff on issues of customer service rather than with the customer.  They need to get in the trenches more so that they can see that their support staff can be rude and unprofessional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eileen Taing
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to RR dental group for the past 7 years and I love them. They're all friendly and I don't know about others, I love my dental hygienist. I see Dr. Dawes and he's pretty great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Boswell
user_reviews_extended.Description: RR dental has been my dentist office for 21 years. Great people. Shari is awesome too. Carlin always greats you with a smile. Does not get any better.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Richard
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going here for years. Clean atmosphere, Professional staff, convenient location. This review is to point out one off their employees in particular. Roni assisted me with some frustrating circumstances that had to do with my insurance provider making changes and not telling me which ultimately ended up with me getting billed. Roni was a breath of fresh air with her knowledge about her position and walked me through the how and why it happened, she even offered some ways to prevent the mix up in the future. The point is though she clearly was a professional who KNEW her job inside and out, this is a rare quality nowadays in my opinion!

Instead of the back and forth finger pointing of the other party or simply dismissing me to figure out the issue on my own she identified and comprehensively taught me the ways of the insurance claiming world. I enjoy employers who retain qualified and competent employees!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bloozby Blueballs
user_reviews_extended.Description:
THESE PEOPLE ARE FRAUDS AND BUTCHERS, STAY AWAY.

I was told I needed a root canal for a shallow cavity and I asked if instead of a crown I could just have the tooth removed and maybe replaced with a gold tooth at a later date and was lied to in order to get me to do the more expensive procedure.

They tried to do the same thing to my stepmother, luckily she thought to call my father who'd had extensive dental work in the past and ended up going to a REAL dentist who confirmed her suspicion that these people are SCAMMERS.

The tools seem to be from the 70's, absolutely unacceptably out of date equipment, and it shows in the work they do. My crown is not shaped like a tooth, it is shaped like a stick of butter, and there's an enormous gap that collects food more efficiently than these scam artists collect checks from your insurance company by lying to you.

Miss an appointment? They'll charge you upwards of $300.00. That's right, I missed an appointment in 2019 due to early stages the pandemic leading me to believe they were closed and they're still under the impression I'm going to pay them something for it emails, regular mail, calls to my phone still to this day over 2 years later.

In summary I would recommend you smash all of your teeth out with a hammer before I'd recommend you even throw a rock in the vicinity of this circus.

Edit in response to owner response, I can assure you it is the correct office, this is the goober that picked his ear while doing my root canal, see newly attached image.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candace J. Banks
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Rachel Fogarty is the bomb!!! I have had much anxiety due to prior bad dental procedures and had been avoiding the dentist for several years...and then I went to Dr Fogarty. ♥️ I fully believe that the Lord led me to Round Rock Dental Group...and they have been a Godsend.

Dr Fogarty is exceedingly kind and gentle. She, unlike prior dentists I have seen, absolutely does no shaming for having dental anxiety. She is an answer to prayer a and is redeeming past negative dental experiences. I literally cannot recommend her enough.

If I could give her a million stars, I would. ♥️⭐♥️⭐♥️⭐♥️⭐♥️⭐♥️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Stone
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been a patient with this organization for 20 years. My Dentist ,Dr Conquest ,was excellent and then retired. All the personal at RRD are perfessional , experienced and friendly.
However when I was assigned to Dr. Fogarty my Dental experience entered a whole new dimension.  Rachel has shown not only knowledge but mad skills I have never before enjoyed.
Whoever you experience at RRD as your Dentist will be great. If you are lucky and get Dr. Fogarty you will agree with this review.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Billie J
user_reviews_extended.Description: Knowing every appointment at Round Rock Dental will be on time, with my Dental Hygienist, Lacey, starts with a friendly welcome and my insurance will be billed for the services I need is second only to knowing my dental health is in the hands of the most capable team of dental professionals. My favorite take away is how my teeth feel after Lacey finishes a cleaning/polishing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Scharn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Saw Dr. Dawes today. An emergency appointment, they took me almost immediately. I hate those Novocaine needles, but he had a pain distraction technique and I didn't feel  a thing. This doctor is professional and friendly. I will never go back to one of those corporate places. This group is a great place for dental chickens.

Thanks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terry Swenson
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience has always been the best with Dr Murphy, unfortunately I am one of those patients that avoids things until everything falls apart- He is very forgiving of the past & works to devise a plan than will work to get you back to looking & feeling your best while building a plan of future care to get you where you need to be. Once done, communicates with you & discusses what is the best course for you taking into account finances, time, & your own personal factors/needs. Bottom line is guys, Dr Murphy is one of the greatest DDS I have ever had the experience of knowing- Just know dental work can be costly, but having someone that treats you as a person is worth more than anything- Give him a chance at your smile & you will never be sorry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: rh112734
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have not been to a dentist since before COVID. Had to get a crown replaced. The entire process from initial phone call to scheduling and completion of the dental work was a pleasure and I will be going back for all future work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Biscomb
user_reviews_extended.Description: As usual Karen is the best Dental Hygienist in the World.  She is very meticulous and explains exactly what you need to do about your dental hygiene.   Additionally, I met Dr Trevino who will be my Dentist after the retirement of Dr Conquest.  I have all the confidence that Dr Trevino will give my teeth the same great care  that they got from Dr Conquest for the past many many years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charly Flagg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful experience!! Dr Bez and Grace made me feel completely at ease as I am all full of anxiety due to previous terrible dental experiences elsewhere. Very happy to find a dentist that listens!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Strubbe
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Our family has been coming to Dr. Smith's team for fifteen (15) years.  Originally three of us then added our fourth from the family.  My two sons sees one particular hygienist Trisha while my wife and I have used several there hygienist.

We all started with Dr. Smith but as a particular need or procedure, we are allocated that best fits our needs.  We have had our company insurance as well as direct out of pocket due to job displacement.

Overall, we have not had or experienced issues like other had nor have seen this.  So for us, we are very comfortable continuing to visit Round Rock Dental Group as our prefer Dental Services...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monte Osburn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dentist and his services were great.  Back office interaction was not so great.  I had dental insurance and paid my part upfront.  Later they call and want me to file a medical claim and send them an EOB from medical that will take 30 days.  During that time I will be billed for the amount insurance said it would cover when they pre-approved the service and told me it was covered.  They could not tell me the amount I owed if I didn't want to spend my time doing office work for them.  They should have told me all of this prior to my consent for service.  Of course, Jeanie made sure to tell me it was my duty and my fault this occurred because Humana Dental insurance is not good and they "don't do that".

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rosie T McCall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a pleasant experience and Erin took very good care of me and Dr. Adams was very comforting. I had a very great experience, as always when I visit this office, everyone is so kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Davey Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going to the same office for over 15 years. Staff is incredible! If you're looking for dental care, you really should consider the Round Rock Dental Group.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Gear
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here for years, always great dental care and appreciate always being seen on time- never once have I been delayed. I have had routine cleanings every 6 months, emergency care on Christmas for an abscess and an implant done at this office- all professionally done- couldn't be happier!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Naylyn
user_reviews_extended.Description: My hygienist is the absolute best ever.  I highly recommend her. RR Dental Group is always there for me and my family in emergencies and general check ups. Great people.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gary Flynn
user_reviews_extended.Description: RR Dental is the best. Dr. Trevino is a total pro: Knowledgable, personable, and he explains the procedures clearly. The hygienists and other folks are super cool and make you feel at home. I've been to other dental groups in the area, but I think I'll stay with RRDG.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ricky Soto
user_reviews_extended.Description: I couldn’t be happier with the service and staff. They were not only helpful in answering the 100 questions I had they made me feel comfortable and at ease. I would recommend this place to anyone who is looking for dental care in the Austin and Round Rock area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Henry Guzman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
RR Dental Group Office always provide excellent dental care service
This time they gave me same day priority for an urgent broken tooth, it is a gesture any patient always appreciate specially for the outcome of my absolutely beautiful new front tooth

New Visit: New front tooth crown, keeping most of my original teeth, perfect match and color, improving my smile feels always good. I highly recommend RRDG.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judith Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been using RRDG for many years though I'm bad about going as regularly as I should but they don't make you feel bad they just take care of you. Dr Murphy is beyond awesome and recently I have been seeing Shannon as my hygenist and she is GREAT!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rene Hibbard

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roy Faltesek
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Feels like a well oiled machine to separate you from your money. They convinced me to do "deep cleaning", which I didn't thoroughly understand. I said OK, but then learned I had to return every 3 months and pay quite a bit that wasn't covered by insurance. I stopped going for the deep cleaning, then twice after that I tried to get just a normal cleaning, but they said once the deep cleaning was started, I could not stop it, so even if I only went in once or twice per year for cleaning, it would be charged as a deep cleaning, costing me significantly more. I made the appointments for a normal cleaning, but was charged for deep cleaning. The billing person then said if I have something wrong, they can work on it and charge me without my approval. Amazing!

Moving my family to another dentist. I recommend finding a dentist in a smaller organization that is more focused on Dentistry than on buying a bigger boat.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Hakkola
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great dentist’s office. I like this place much more than my old dentist in Austin.

I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim Beckett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been very pleased with the results I received with the Invisalign through Dr. Michele Platson of Round Rock Dental Group.  Little by little, my teeth had gotten out of line, and I began to notice that chewing was becoming painful.  I decided to check into Invisalign, and since I’d been pleased with Round Rock Dental Group, I learned that Dr. Platson in that group was able to provide this service.  She helped me understand how the treatment would work, knew from using Invisalign on her own teeth that it was an effective treatment, and so it was easy for her to answer all the questions I had.  I carefully followed her instructions, and am now enjoying the results.  My teeth are straight, and chewing is no longer a challenge.  I highly recommend Invisalign and Dr. Platson!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

He should have asked performed the job he was originally going to do which was a patch

user_reviews_extended.Name: DAY LITE
user_reviews_extended.Description: A person or business is only as good as their word, they pulled a bait and switch scam, I described exactly what I needed with one tooth and needed a quote fixing another, on the phone before the appointment they gave me a quote of about $3,000 for the tooth I described and talked me into a worthless discount card at $118 that would knock the price down to under $2,000 and they said they did all the work I described at that location. They said I needed exactly what I described over the phone minus a root canal and that they only did about half the work at that location and told me their part was about $3100 after the discount card and referred me to an other outside dentist that would also cost just over $3000 so it was over 3 times the quote they gave me over the phone. and charged me $81 for the visit so straight off the bat they swindled me out of $199 knowing there was no way I could afford over $6000 then they offered me a payday loan scam from Wells Fargo saying no interest for a year but didn't say that after the year I'd have to pay interest on all money starting at time of service at a high interest rate. on top of that they said their service would do nothing for the pain and they didn't give me a quote on the second chipped tooth which they said would be easy to fix. Don't let them swindle any money out of you as well, The $118 discount card would have helped if they didn't lie to me about the cost which went from under $2000 to over $6000 and doing less work and doing nothing for the pain.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
They did their best to work me in as early as possible which was appreciated as a new patient.  But even though I provided my insurance information beforehand and was told I was approved a staff member came in DURING my dental cleaning (the hygienist was knee-deep in my mouth), asking me to confirm the primary on my insurance and the last four digits of the primary's ss# WHILE I was in the chair with my back facing her (she didn't have my name right either so I didn't even know she was addressing me).  When I went to check out it was with a different person and they seemed confused about why I was asked this as well.  Eventually I got an answer but it was really weird because I've never had that happen before.

I wanted to know about how they could help me with sleep apnea but forgot to ask.  I don't think any medical team actually looks at the intake forms that you fill in anyway but I think I had indicated on there that I was having trouble with sleeping and snoring.

The first chair I was in for the exam was really uncomfortable but that's just a minor detail.  I Still don't know why I keep getting cavities when I'm doing everything on my end to care for my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Assistant Rachel was awesome! I was made comfortable & kept updated through the treatment of what step they were at and how long til completion.
The cleaning was also gentle and calming and comfortable.
I usually have soreness after a dental visit but not since going to Round Rock Dental Group.
5 stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebekah Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient at Round Rock Dental Group for over 10 years, but I’m now leaving due to ongoing communication issues. About a year ago, my text/email reminders were turned off which I did not do or request to have done, and despite being told it was fixed, I’ve barely received any reminders since. I’m now being charged a $50 missed appointment fee for an appointment I was never reminded about, the last reminder I received was in November 2024. While both Dr. Smith and Dr. Fogarty have been great, the administrative side has been frustrating. It took multiple calls and emails to receive incomplete dental records, and one receptionist I spoke with was notably rude. It’s disappointing after so many years, but the lack of communication and follow-through has made it impossible to stay.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Estoy en muy buenas manos con el Dr Eric Hoffman y todo el personal, son muy atentos en Round Rock Dental Group, me siento agradecida de tenerlos, Dios los Bendiga 🙏.

Gloria N.

title: Clearview Dental
address: 3200 Greenlawn Blvd #180, Round Rock, TX 78664, United States

user_reviews.Name: Patricia Andreina Medina Sira
user_reviews.Description:
I had a great experience at Clearview Dental. The office is very clean, modern, and welcoming. The entire staff is extremely friendly and professional, and they make you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in.

The dentist and dental assistants take the time to explain every procedure and answer any questions you may have, which really helps reduce any anxiety about dental visits. They are very patient, gentle, and truly care about their patients.

I especially appreciated how organized and efficient everything was. The appointment was on time, and the team made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire visit.

I highly recommend Clearview Dental to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring dental office. Excellent service and a wonderful t

user_reviews.Name: Louie Trujillo
user_reviews.Description: I had a wonderful experience at Clearview Dental. My 3‑year‑old had an accident that caused a loose tooth, and Dr. Yoon handled the situation with exceptional patience and skill. He was gentle, reassuring, and truly great with children. Even though my daughter was fussy, he managed to keep her calm and successfully remove the tooth. I’m very thankful for the care and professionalism we received.

user_reviews.Name: YaelG
user_reviews.Description:
We all want to avoid dentists, but this attitude changed for me after I found Dr. Yoon. He is by far the best dentist I have ever had. His gifted hands combined with genuine care for his patients and an obvious strive for excellent treatment put him high above others.

I am leaving the country and, as I told him, I wish I could take him with me… If you need a dentist, don’t even think twice, go there!

user_reviews.Name: Prince Imo
user_reviews.Description: I had an amazing experience. They got rid of my plaque and really broke it down to me on how to keep up with my oral care. Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Kaley
user_reviews.Description: I was nervous coming in but Dr. Park and Annette made the visit very comfortable! They taught me the right way to floss based on my teeth shape! Now I am feeling more confident 😊 highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: David Smith
user_reviews.Description:
My wife and I visited Clearview Dental in Round Rock, TX a few days ago for our semi-annual check-ups and cleaning.  This was our first visit to Clearview. First a tech took thorough x-rays of my teeth for Dr.  Yoon to review. Subsequently hygienist Sierra cleaned my teeth and did a fantastic job. She took her time and first carefully measured my gums and then slowly and methodically cleaned my teeth. Sierra has a very pleasant personality and patiently listened to my concerns and extemporaneous remarks. Dr. Yoon came in and discussed the results of my x-rays, highlighting a couple of areas for us to watch. Dr. Yoon is very conservative and does not perform unnecessary work. He is very focused and calm which inspires confidence in his patients. My wife had a similar positive experience during her cleaning and exam. We highly recommend Clearview Dental and have already scheduled our next cleaning and exam with Dr. Yoon a few months from now.

Sincerely,
David and Thanh Smith

user_reviews.Name: Dylan Ceslak
user_reviews.Description: Phenomenal dentist experience. Dr. Yoon and his staff were able to get me in and out in an hour during my work lunch break. They were extremely efficient and knowledgeable. Clearview will certainly be my dentist moving forward.

user_reviews.Name: Hanjin Lee
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been going to Clearview Dental since they opened in 2016, and every visit has been fantastic. Dr. Yoon and the team are amazing! They handle everything professionally and with care. When I needed a crown fixed urgently, they took care of it quickly and smoothly (no panic, just perfect care 😄). They also reply super fast to texts, which makes everything so convenient. Friendly, professional, and reliable! I highly recommend Clearview Dental! Big thanks to Dr. Yoon and the whole team for keeping my smile happy and healthy! 😁
