user_reviews_extended.Description: Coming here for almost 4 years and the quality of people and service is fantastic. Dr. Nguyen and Yoon are true masters of their craft. Very punctual too, no long waits. They have good reminder texts and all that so I've never missed an appointment due to forgetting. Front desk staff is very professional and friendly. Everything I've done here so far has been smooth and pain-free.

user_reviews_extended.Name: April Jensen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clearview has been a 10 out of 10 experience for me. I cannot recommend them enough! They work with me to create a straightforward plan to fix all my dental issues. They are awesome and super flexible when it comes to scheduling. The front office staff is super friendly and helpful with any insurance or scheduling questions you might have. I feel truly cared for at this practice and I’m so glad that I found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sungju Kang
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So good. Dr. Yoon is perfect in everything. He is kind even though he treats well. He does not recommend unnecessary treatment. He also clearly tells you that it is difficult to treat.
I got treatment for implant treatment three years ago. However, I couldn't finish the treatment due to personal reasons and revisited last month. I've received good treatment at the moment and I'm satisfied

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Rogers
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Highly recommend Dr. Nguyen and the entire staff at Clearview Dental! 10/10.

I avoided the dentist for years and finally decided I needed to get the work done. I left wondering why I waited so long. They are friendly, accommodating, professional, empathetic, efficient, and all in all just really good at what they do.

10 out of 10 experience (which I’ve NEVER had at any other dentist office).

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juliana Montel
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Clearview Dental has been nothing but amazing! Since living in Texas I needed a new dentist and found this place based off the reviews and so happy I found Clearview! Dr.Nguyen is amazing and makes sure you are comfortable and understand the whole process of whatever your situation is along with her amazing assistant Annette! I got my wisdom teeth removed through Dr.Brazil and was extremely nervous and they made the process nice and smooth! Highly recommend Clearview Dental if you are looking for a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: diana reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I want to express my heartfelt gratitude for the exceptional service I received from Dr. Yoon and his team.

Since moving to Texas last year, I’ve always felt at ease in their practice, despite my initial apprehensions about dental procedures. The teeth whitening experience was phenomenal; I achieved the desired results with minimal discomfort, thanks to the team's precision and care.

I particularly appreciate how Dr. Yoon explains each step, ensuring I feel informed and comfortable. This level of dedication is rare and speaks volumes about the high standards of care at his practice.

Thank you, Dr. Yoon and team, for your outstanding dental care and for creating a welcoming environment. I trust my dental health is in the best hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andre ya
user_reviews_extended.Description: They always take good care of me and make me feel at ease. Annette is always so sweet and males great conversation💕 Everyone is so kind and helpful 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donggeun Park
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve lived in Austin for 7 years and have been to several dental offices, but I finally settled on Clearview Dental with Dr. Yoon—and I couldn’t be happier. Dr. Yoon has never once disappointed me. Every visit, he truly puts himself in the patient’s shoes, carefully considers the best outcome, and shows such genuine care and concern. It’s honestly moving to see a dentist who is this dedicated.

I’ve proudly recommended Dr. Yoon at Clearview Dental to many of my friends, and now so many of them go here as well. Because of that, it’s not as easy to get an appointment as it used to be—but to me, it’s absolutely worth it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bridgette
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clearview dental has been my go-to dentist for years. Kind people, thorough service, clean environment, and the timeliness of their cleanings have all been reasons I keep going back. I would recommend them to anyone looking for a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LaDonna Latterman
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been going to this dentist for years. They're great! They're even good with my daughter. She was two when we first took her to see the dentist. They made it a fun and relaxed environment and she wasn't afraid at all

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Ayala
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in for fillings and the doc and assistant were very patient. They let me go without the mouth guard, which I couldn’t tolerate. The office is clean, they got me in and out quickly, and I look forward to trusting them with my dental care long-term.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Calvin Chang
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been to Dr. Yoon several times now, and each visit just reinforces why I keep coming back. He’s patient, truly listens, and takes the time to understand what you need. It’s rare to find a dentist who’s both passionate about his work and genuinely compassionate toward his patients, and Dr. Yoon nails it. Every appointment has been pain-free, and he’s great at getting me in and out efficiently. From booking to check-in, the reception team is friendly and organized, and the dental hygienists are just as welcoming and professional. Top-notch care all around — I highly recommend Dr. Yoon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey King
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am an anxious person, and the assistant, Annette, and Dr. Park really helped with the anxiety of going to the dentist. They were kind and explained everything well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Simply the Sacs
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found Clearview dental because I need restrotive treatment for a tooth and I’m so happy to found my new dental home! Dr. Yoon is a phenomenal dentist and takes his time to education his patients on treatment plans. He takes a conservative approach to treatment which I’ve never experienced before. The office staff was so friendly and made me feel so comfortable! Love how clean it smelled and the music was a vibe! definitely recommend coming to them 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thomas Granado
user_reviews_extended.Description: If birthday celebrations end up yielding chipped teeth, this is the team to call. If you have reckless poolside etiquette, you should have Clearview's number handy. I chipped my tooth because of poor decision-making and thanks to Dr. Nguyen, I had a full tooth to account for during my Monday afternoon meeting. It wasn't noticeable, however, because it was hidden behind a mask. Thank you, Clearview!

user_reviews_extended.Name: KWANGKEUN JI
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a mature patient with many root canals, crowns, and braces with previous dentists in many different countries. I came here with recommendations from my friends and the Korean community. The process of my first implant took almost a year. It could have been faster, but I requested a year-round treatment, given my insurance. At first, I needed to have surgery to remove the cracked moral with the previous root canal, leading to infection. After having an implant post, I had the crown on it. My conclusion on Dr. Yoon is meticulous, faithful,  and considerate as a professional. It is said that knowing a good dentist is a value in life. I am pleased to find my family dentist in Austin. Not to mention a reasonable price!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angilada_84
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely amazing experience! Came on a whim to assist with what I thought was tooth decay, but it was just staining. Dr. Nguyen was absolutely AMAZING! She was honest, patient, and walked me through everything! My teeth are back to beautiful. Open mouth smiling again.
Annette (assistant) was so gentle and patient with my cleaning. She helped with flossing and cleaning questions. 10/10 recommend!

Front desk staff beyond helpful and kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Rocha
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went to Clearview Dental for the 1st time today and the experience was fantastic! The staff was great and Nicole was the best Dental Hygienist I’ve ever had! I will definitely be going back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Huynh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience with Dr. Nguyen. So sweet and so kind. Got some cleaning done and it went smooth, no pain whatsoever. And Annette, my dental assistant, was great as well walked me through the X-rays, flossing, and polishing. 10/10 experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JR Castillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I want to say thank you to your entire staff. They made my dental experience a great one! In the past I have hated going to the dentist. From start to finish I felt really good about my expierence. Thank you guys for the professionalism and caring about my needs. I will definitely make clear dental my choice for my dental needs!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vintique Mall
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I completely understand the fear of going to the dentist, but for me, it was so intense that it kept me away for over ten years. During that time, I endured constant pain and saw multiple dentists just to get antibiotics for infections, but I never followed through with treatment. Eventually, I reached a breaking point and decided to find a highly rated dentist. That’s when I discovered Dr. Yoon at Clearview Dental, who had perfect reviews. From my first visit, I was impressed by the exceptional staff and how positive the experience felt. I was extremely nervous leading up to today’s appointment, but Dr. Yoon’s gentle bedside manner made a world of difference. He’s truly a great person, and I’m relieved to have finally had my tooth roots extracted. I’m looking forward to continuing my dental care with Dr. Yoon and would highly recommend him to anyone in need of dental services. Ashley the assistant was also extremely friendly and professional!
- Michael Van Jones

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy Flower
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff were professional and caring. Able to attend to my dental needs quickly and efficiently. Highly recommend for quality care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctors gave a good explanation of my dental health.Sierra did a great job with the cleaning. I was able to get in and out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: chantal servidio
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently went to Clearview Dental for the first time for a check up and cleaning. I was really impressed with the level of care that I received. The front staff was great upon entering and leaving.  Nicole was super sweet and did a very thorough  job cleaning my teeth. She really took the time to go the extra mile. She was very gentle. For the first time ever I didn’t feeling like my mouth was getting cut up when she took my X-rays and my mouth wasn’t sore at all after my cleaning! Dr. Yoon was very personable and was very genuine. He took the time to talk with me and instead of the usual lecture about not drinking soda he told me how to drink soda to do the least amount of damage to my teeth.  I have been to several offices looking for a good fit. For the first time in a really long time I felt like I was a person instead of a client that offices are trying to see how much money they can get through selling treatment plans. No one was pushy and the pricing was reasonable. I will definitely be going back and making appointments for my family as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: YT_ CISCOKIDFURY
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nicole has taken such good care of me, professional but makes me feel like a part of the family! Gentle hands and knowledgeable planning has my smile better than ever walking out of Dr Yoon’s office! 10/10 recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie Sandoval
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great and friendly staff! Very welcoming and great patient care. Dr. Yoon is  honest and takes his time to explain his findings and recommendations for treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Kryder
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm very glad that my family found Clearview Dental. Appointments are quick, easy, and painless, and the staff is friendly and professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Han
user_reviews_extended.Description: Up until now, I never went to the dentist. Mostly because of how expensive it was. However, after having a bad cavity, I went to see Dr. Yoon. My experience was so great. The environment is very calming and clean, staff is very fast and polite, Dr. Yoon was very professional, knowledgeable, and he saved a teeth that I thought i was going to have to get root canal for. He saved me a lot of money by saving my teeth. They followed up and told me if I had any problems or pain come up in the following weeks, to follow up and they indeed made sure I was taken care of properly throughout the whole process. I already have future appointments set along with routine checks so I can get caught up on all my dental work i've been putting to the side for the past few years. Thank you and I will be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa S
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a new patient but so far I am completely happy and reassured. I made the right choice. The doctor takes his time explaining everything that is  needed i’ve never felt rushed or not heard . I’ve also brought my children and happy With their treatment as well. The Staff is also professional and awesome along with a clean friendly environment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandra Bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’m a new patient, and here are a few reasons why I highly recommend Clearview Dental:
1. They provide an extra level of care by involving the patients primary care provider PRIOR to treatment regarding anesthesia, and medication etc. I’ve never had a dental office be that thorough. My physician also appreciated their thoroughness.
2.Professional and friendly Doctors and Staff. I felt listened to and at ease in their care.
3. I had a cleaning today and Nicole was great! She was friendly and explained everything. I felt more involved in my own care.
PS: I went first to try it out and now all my family are new patients too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan West
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dentist office is different from the others I've been to in recent years. In a good way! The cleaning was gentle and did not hurt. They did not try to sell me cosmetic work I didn't need. They were kind and attentive when I said I was very anxious. Dr. Nguyen was very patient and answered all of my questions during and after the visit. My hygienist was very friendly as well. There is a reason for all of the five star reviews!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is probably the best dentist I've ever been to. They're all so kind! They are very transparent about what they do and explain anything you ask. I've had horrible dental experiences in my life, and coming here has helped erase some of those horrible memories. The best part, they don't judge me for my horrible gag reflex, they work with me around it.

I recommend this place 100%

user_reviews_extended.Name: J. W
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first dental check up and cleaning  at this location. Jessica, my dental hygienist, had an unmatched level of professionalism and empathy for my concerns. She was so friendly and also did an amazing job with my cleaning. I didn’t feel rushed but she was also time conscious. Dr. Nguyen and the staff all made this a great experience. I can see why they have such good ratings and I would highly recommend giving them a try before going to any other office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy Lawrence
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clearview Dental is by far the greatest experience I have ever had. From the receptionist to the dentist has been absolutely amazing. The atmosphere is amazing and I could tell and feel that Clearview Dental genuinely cares about you and their services to their patients. I strongly recommend you to pay them a visit. You absolutely will be completely satisfied.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Muñoz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Such a great experience at Clearview Dental!!!
I am one that typically gets anxious before seeing the dentist due to previous bad experiences.
But at Clearview, my views completely changed!!
The entire staff was very professional and friendly which made the overall experience feel like I truly was being taken care of. They helped alleviate concerns without judgment and went above and beyond to give me a quality but comfortable experience!
Definitely recommend Dr.Nguyen because she is the sweetest! She truly seems to care for her patients and went to great lengths to give me the best smile possible!! The best environment! Would give it more stars if possible

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Dininger
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have always hated going to the dentist, almost scared of it. Dr. Yoon is amazing and I cannot recommend him enough. Firstly, I have a unique issue with having way too many baby teeth with no adult teeth to replace them. I truly believed my teeth were doomed.

Dr. Yoon set up a plan to get my mouth back to healthy. He listened to my concerns along the way and was able to answer my questions clearly so I could understand. During procedures he was great at giving me a heads up for what I would feel and when. In the end, I'm finally feeling better about myself and am able to smile without being self conscious about it.

The hygienist team for regular cleanings are also great as they are super friendly. No matter what you are in good hands here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Mojica
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience at Clearview Dental. I came in for a regular cleaning and found out I had a few cavities. I am a little anxious when visiting the dentist. They were very understanding and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire procedure. They also have the best bedside manner I’ve had at any Dr. Office. The entire staff was friendly and energetic. Overall it was a great experience and I highly recommend making an appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Avery
user_reviews_extended.Description: In town visiting from out of state and I broke a tooth. My experience was nothing short of wonderful even though I had to have a tooth extracted. A big thanks to Dr. Yoon, Rayza, Hari, and Ashley! I highly recommend Clearview Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome experience at Clearview Dental today! The front desk staff was friendly and accommodating. I had the pleasure of speaking with Dr. Yoon which was great, he kindly took the time to address all my concerns and explained everything very well. Best dental experience I've had by far and looking forward to the next one. Easy 5/5

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dominic Mena
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came here after too many bad experiences at another dentist and was pleasantly surprised. Dr. Yoon and his team are extremely friendly, kind and attentive; you can tell he cares about your dental health and has your best interest in mind. I’m happy with the choice to come here and will continue to be a patient. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jantel Hope
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time going to this dentist office and I was truly so impressed with how nice and welcoming everyone is, from the front staff to the dental hygienists, to the doctors. The office is very clean and not crowded at all. Dr. Yoon was very thorough with his dental plan for me and he provided great options. The doctor and hygienist gave me an exceptional cleaning. I will be returning FOR SURE!! A++

user_reviews_extended.Name: An Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience at Clearview Dental! The office is very clean and well-decorated. I was welcomed and assisted all way through my procedure by friendly staffs. Dr. Nguyen did my exam and cleaning, she explained thoroughly what treatments I need and gave candid advices regarding when each should be done. Plus, Dr. Nguyen and her assistant worked very gently on my teeth. Dr. Yoon is also friendly and personable. I’d definitely come back here in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janie Ziebell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional and wonderful staff, every experience has been great.  I never wait too long, my dental hygienist is thorough and gives me recommendations.  My dentist is always polite and clearly explains best practices for me to incorporate in my cleaning routines.  I never have any pain and I am never anxious about my appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Myers
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Nicole my dental hygienist was amazing. Made me feel so comfortable and asked questions throughout the entire experience. I felt like I was hanging out with a good friend my entire visit. No surprise costs (what a relief! 😂) Front desk staff were very nice, fast, and professional.  Dr. Yoon was also very nice also! I haven’t been to a dentist in about 5 years so I was very nervous but they made me feel at ease. Happy to establish my care here!!

I also thought it was very convenient I was able to book my appointment completely online without having to call them. They responded fast and made everything simple.

Thanks so much!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janie Frieberg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This entire dental office team is amazing! From the moment I walk through the door to the moment I leave, I am treated with professionalism, sincerity and kindness. Each team member I have encountered is top-notch, both friendly and professional.

Dr. Nguyen, is without question, the best dentist!  She CARES. She is thorough and has high standards— clearly loves what she does— ensuring comfort from start to finish and that her work is done right. I don't care where I live, I will drive or fly to ensure she remains my dentist.

Don't hesitate for one moment.  Pick up the phone and schedule your next dental appointment with Clearview Dental, you will not regret it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: V. V.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In general, I hate the dentist. Seriously. Not because my teeth are bad (they’re not). Just because it always hurts. So typically I go every 4-6 yrs. No cavities. No braces. Nothing. Genetically blessed with great teeth. But I hate the dentist. Until now.

These folks are simply amazing. I told them “I hate this chair, I hate the high pitched noise when my teeth are being cleaned, & I have zero pain tolerance.”

While they can’t replace the chair, they did give me earplugs, over ear headset, sunglasses for the overhead fluorescent lights, and were very gentle with my teeth.

Nicole - you did a great job, listened to all my concerns, and validated them by providing amazing support. Thanks for being super gentle. Thanks for explaining why my gums bleed. Cause I need to see you more. Noted.

Dr. Yoon - thank you for explaining that in 30-40 yrs I might need to get my wisdom teeth removed. I got a huge kick out of that. Hopefully at that point they won’t be the only teeth in my head.

TLDR: Great place. Gentle souls. Will be back in 6 months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeanie Whatley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I normally have bad experiences at the dentist, but not today. Everything and everyone from the wonderful souls at the front desk, to the amazing team around my chair.
My intake was seamless, drama free, and met with urgency. She took care of everything from getting me an appointment very quickly to dealing with my weird insurance with kindness and patience, already taking away some stress.
On arrival, and in a LOT of pain, everyone was delightful, caring, and on the ball. Once back, the tech was amazing. Gentle, attentive, on point, and kind. The doctor was absolutely stellar with his professionalism, kindness, patience, genuine concern, thoroughness, communication, skill and speed.
Everyone was professional and organized yet laid back and fun, making a very uncomfortable situation much, much easier. I can't brag about this experience enough. Thank you to everyone who helped me so wonderfully, from parking to payment, during a very stressful time. This spot has an amazing team in place. I'll definitely return for this kind of care and service.
Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ashutosh pal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After having four visits in a month (one for myself and three for my family) I can say confidently that:
I and my family received excellent care without pushing for anything extra.
All of the hygienists we came across are very good and friendly.
Front office staff is super helpful and try their best to accommodate you based on your availability.
Now, cherry on the ice is Dr Yoon. She is a true professional. I found that she examined all of us very well and provided detailed feedback. I never felt that we have been rushed or pushed for anything extra.
I am highly impressed and confident that my family's dental care is in good hands 😃

Thank you Clearview team and Dr Yoon!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Masuccio
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nguyen was absolutely the best. I had a bad experience with a previous dentist and she was completely understanding and actually listened to me and worked with me to overcome my apprehension. She was able to do some extensive dental work on me without hurting me and has made me not fear coming to the dentist to keep my oral health what it should be. The staff is also wonderful and helped put me at ease as well. I cannit thank Clearview enough for the dedication to providing excellent care and showing compassion to someone who had developed an intense fear of the important work they provide. Thank you so much!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had an outstanding experience with Dr. Yoon, a dentist known for providing exceptional service and genuine care for patients. From the moment I walked in, the welcoming atmosphere and friendly staff made me feel at ease. Dr. Yoon's expertise was evident throughout the thorough examination, and their personalized approach to dental care left a lasting positive impression. I highly recommend Dr. Yoon for anyone seeking exceptional service and a patient-centered experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marco Crisologo
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dental office is very clean and cozy. The staff are all very friendly and accommodating!  They were able to fit me in last minute in their busy schedule. I had some severe pain on my tooth and Dr. Yoon was able to address the problem instantly and fixed the fractured tooth in a timely manner. Very excellent and pleasant first time visit. Glad I found an exceptional dental practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trung Do
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dental office.  The staff is always friendly and professional.  I’ve been going to this places for years.  Today Niki cleaned my teeth and I was in shock on how painless it was.  I was anticipating on some pain since I haven’t gotten my teeth clean for 10 months.  To my surprise Niki knew what she was doing.  She got my teeth cleaned and I didn’t even have any pain it was a fantastic experience.  Niki is the only one that I will allow to clean my teeth from now on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Magan Blasig
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The practice is brand new and I loved the aesthetic - very clean and modern.

I had a negative experience at my previous dentist office and was overdue for my checkup so I was a little nervous I’d be chastised for waiting, but Dr. Yoon was very kind and personable and answered all of my questions with so much patience.

Since their practice is new, he reviewed the x-rays the technician took and then also did my cleaning himself. He was very efficient and made me feel comfortable.

I look forward to building a relationship with this practice - everyone was very kind and welcoming!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerry
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a very special, dedicated and respectful staff. I appreciate the care and treatment. Everyone there was sweet and dedicated to resolving my issue. I want to thank Dr. Yoon, Teresa, Hari -and Andrea thank you all greatly!! Best dentistry in Austin!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Yoon Is the very best!!!  I always had a gap between my 2 front teeth that has always bothered me for my whole life. He helped close it perfectly and it looks so natural. Plus the cost of the whole procedure was so affordable!  I will never go to another dentist again.  He’s manners, true care and attention to detail is beyond superb.  I’m so grateful to him and staff, just an overall awesome experience for me.  Thank you so much🤗

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophia Clayton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr .young is the best dentist I ever met. He is very honest and patient , very well manner.  I didn’t feel much pain at all when I got injection. He told me what is my option and he didnot want me to do some treatment because he recommended just watch it. He could easily tell me let’s fix it. I would still do it. But he chose to tell me the truth. He is also one of my friend recommended to me. He is absolutely a wonderful doctor. I highly recommend this doctor.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Addabbo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Meant to leave this review a while back but just wanted to say how much I enjoyed my experience with Nicole when getting my teeth cleaned. She's very personal and made me feel comfortable. Clearview has always been great and I definitely recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Pappas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommended. Dr. Nguyen is very nice and professional, always willing to answer all of my questions and hear my concerns, and does incredible work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Diaz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Relocated to Austin 2 years ago and was in search of a dentist. This is the best dental office I have been to. All the staff including front desk are nice and professional. The office is clean and modern. I don’t have to request off of work or use my sick leave due to them being super efficient (as well as thorough) . I typically do my cleanings during my lunch break and always end up leaving on time. The dental hygienist Stephanie is super friendly and does a great job. I always see the dentist, Dr. Yoon, at the end of my cleanings. He is professional and down to earth. I have recommended this office to a few of my colleagues and they also love it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcus Mathis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I will first preface this by saying I hate going to the dentist. When I found out I needed two teeth extracted I was less than thrilled. However this was the best dental experience I've ever had. The staff is extremely nice and knowledgeable. Dr. Yoon made my experience very pain free and quick in a relaxing atmosphere. I would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gustavo Maldonado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I tried Clearview Dental for the first time and am blown away by level of service.  The staff at front was super friendly.  Stefanie, the dental hygienist was really amazing and gentle and accommodating during my cleaning.  Dr. Yoon was very nice and explained everything to me during my check-up.  I never felt rushed or in a hurry.  I definitely recommend Clearview to anyone looking for great dentist location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eisy Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clearview dental is definitely a nice and clean dental office, Dr Yoon ans his assistant Alex did a great job with my teeth. Dr Yoon took the time to explain the importance of oral health. Thank you Dr. Yoon and Staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Hulme-Lippert
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really, really great experience here after a bad one elsewhere. So grateful to have found a dentist and team who takes the time to listen and figure out what’s wrong and who aren’t out to push unneeded treatments. They took excellent care of me and are much more trustworthy than prior dentist I went to. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Lara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend this office in Round Rock. First and foremost, the facility is modern and extremely clean. The entire staff is friendly from the front desk to everyone in the back (including the manager). The woman who prepped me asked what music I preferred and quickly prepared me and put me at ease. She didn’t necessarily rush but she performed the X-rays gently and talked me through it all. I don’t have anxiety about the dentist but I always find it difficult to relax - that was not the case here. I was VERY pleased with Dr. H Nguyen. She is the first female dentist that I’ve encountered and it honestly made a difference. Dr. Nguyen was careful and thorough in her exam and patiently explained what she had found. The cleaning was so easy compared to other places. I definitely plan to continue coming here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ivy S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My family and I just moved to Austin and found Clearview dental online. We're so glad we picked Clearview. The staff is amazing and do an amazing job at making us feel comfortable and makes sure we know what procedures will be done and how they're done. Chris and the front office staff are very helpful and patient with me when I'm trying to schedule an appt. Dr. Yoon is very informative and doesn't make us feel rushed. I love Stephanie,  she's very informative and very honest, she tells it like it is.

I could go on about how much we love our dental team but you have to check it out for yourself. I will definitely recommend Clearview Dental to anyone looking for a good Dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: V LARSON
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my first visit. First impression is very clean and attractive waiting room. Met by office manager who checked me in and made sure I was welcomed and comfortable. The hygienist was friendly, professional and did a great job. Dr Yoon did an examination and explained a few concerns to keep aware of. He took his time to get to know me and made sure that all questions were answered. I am very happy to have found Clearview Dental and I plan to be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia DeMott
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was traveling and asked for an appointment because my temporary filling had come out after a root canal a couple weeks ago. The doctor took the time to look at a full mouth x-ray and gave me excellent dental advice. He also placed a post and build up around my root canal tooth so it was ready for the crown when I returned home. I wish I could have done the crown with him but unfortunately I wouldn’t be in town that long.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Thach
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely happy I put my trust in them.  I have been terrified of the dentist after several bad experiences, but I needed a tooth looked at.  From the beginning the staff was friendly, the appointment was quick and Dr. Yoon was fantastic with explaining how he could save my tooth.  Special shout out to Theresa who kept me calm and talking, and to the assistant who is my daughter's new best friend, you ladies rock!  Thank you Dr. Yoon for being honest and trustworthy, I will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shaneza Powell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was recommended by Singh Orthodontics for teeth whitening and honestly it was the best decision! Very clean and organized office! From the front desk ladies-techs-dentist, everyone was very sweet and always making sure I wasn't uncomfortable; not to mention- very informative and patient with all of my questions! I am SO pleased with the whitening treatment and already have received compliments! During the process, they would put on whatever music I wanted to listen too and checked up on me to make sure I wasn't hurting! I honestly would recommend them to anyone. They make such a fluid and an amazing team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: bunnyvenom
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the dental assistants, Niki, was amazing at making me feel comfortable. Her and Dr. Nguyen were very fast and efficient with getting me all cleaned up. Not to mention, the front desk employees were super duper nice! This place is amazing and they really do care about their clients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beverly Rush
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first visit to Dr. Yoon is the best dental experience I have ever had.! He was gentle with the cleaning, explained everything I need to be aware of, and he is VERY friendly!  He uses new technology and the office is very nice.  His staff is just awesome!  I love each one of them!
I highly recommend Dr. Yoon!  You will not be disappointed!
I am very happy that I discovered this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ting kang
user_reviews_extended.Description: My teeth feel so clean! This is my first cleaning in a while, I don’t like going to the dentist normally, but it was about time. The staff as Clearview was amazing, made me feel very comfortable. Dr Yoon was very clear with my treatment options, and didn’t make me feel pressured. My hygienist Stephanie was super friendly, very aware of how uncomfortable I was and made it a very pleasant experience for me. I won’t wait so long for my next cleaning next time. Thank you Clearview!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Duane Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Annette was amazing, friendly, professional and made the visit a pleasure. Definitely will request her in the future. Jessica (hygienist) was really nice, very friendly and she took her time to do an excellent job, for once I didn’t feel like a number but a person with the hygienist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Flowers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nguyen did a phenomenal job filling a cavity, cleaning and polishing my teeth. She is the most professional and personable Dentist I’ve ever had the pleasure of having dental work performed. In fact, the entire staff was AMAZING, from the reception personnel, (Gentleman & Young Lady), throughout the procedure. Special shout out to Teresa, as well. SUPER HAPPY!! 5 star ⭐️ experience. Thanks, Dr. Nguyen :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alison
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am so happy I chose to go to Clearview Dental! Everyone is so nice/helpful and Dr. Nguyen is the best! She always makes sure you are comfortable during your procedure and really helped me with my dentist anxiety! Now I feel almost as if I am going to visit a friend!
They also give you treatment plans which really helps you plan for your dentist appointment money wise and also understanding what your getting done.
Won’t go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Porter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for a cleaning and exam. They were so so nice from welcome to checkout! I would highly recommend this dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Walsh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have gotten extractions and root canals done at clearview and could not ask for better care! The staff is very friendly and does a great job letting you know what needs to be done now and what you can afford to wait on. I can smile again for the first time in years and on top of that, it was not as expensive as most other places. They do their best to ensure you aren't in any pain and I never felt uncomfortable like I have at literally every other dentist I've been to! I will not be going anywhere else in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: emmanuel sandoval
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Going on two years of being a patient at Clearview Dental. Great work, i get info of how im keeping up and clear instructions on what i can do better, always in good hands. Almost feels like family when i go in.
Michelle recently helped out and amazing.
Dr. Yoon’s practice here is awesome.
Thank y’all as always

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jen Y
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really appreciate the staff at Clearview Dental. They were very attentive and made sure that I understood the interventions and  costs attached. Unlike other dentists I've been to, Dr Yoon explains very clearly dental issues and how he intends to provide care. Professional and understanding, I was offered dental plans that are way cheaper than other dentists I've been to previously. Highly recommend their services to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linh N.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quick and painless dental exam & cleaning. It was a great first visit with Dr. Nguyen and her dental assistant. Bonus points for the goodie bag given.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mollie Kelsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Clearview is friendly and helpful! I hadn’t been to the dentist in a very long time and was very nervous for my appointment. They took the time to make sure I was comfortable, explained everything, and made sure I was doing ok every step of the way. They make you feel like you are their number one priority! They are down to earth and personable, which made me feel less nervous. I would highly recommend to anyone

user_reviews_extended.Name: Y Fin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just had my first cleaning with Dr. Yoon.
He listened, addressed any concerns I had and educated me before getting started.
His staff was personable, professional and very friendly. I am extremely pleased with his service and  plan on making him our family dentist! Highly recommend him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emmanuel V
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently got a cleaning and exam at Clearview and was extremely impressed with quality of the service provided. Everyone is very friendly, and the office has a clean and modern aesthetic. I especially appreciated Dr. Yoon explaining my plan of care going forward and truly being honest with me about my current dental health. Thank you Clearview! I will definitely be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Boles
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had to use this establishment a few times in the last 2 years. And I have to say they really break the stigma on how painful and expensive dental care is. They treat you so welcoming.  The staff is ready to help you out and answer any questions you may have. The office is so clean and comfortable. I absolutely love Clearview dental. Keep up the great work yall!! I'm gonna miss yall when I move away from Central texas❤️ I would highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Acosta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommended. From Dr. Yoon to the dental crew, everyone is skilled and experienced. Going with someone who finds going to the dentist's office unpleasant. We were both at ease. From making an appointment to checking in and exiting, they are all welcoming, informative, and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannen Kern
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone I have encountered here is beyond pleasant. I have had numerous horrible experiences from multiple different dentists so I was quite nervous to start again. They made me feel very comfortable and having my tooth pulled was actually (especially compared to my past) a pleasant experience. It's a calming environment and very clean. They've got a patient for life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Latimer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Where to begin? This place has been AMAZING ever since I reached out on a whim to get a crown put on last summer. They were able to fit me in almost instantly and solve my problem. Ever since then they have done a few procedures for me and have always been very patient with myself and kind. I previously came from Castle Dental where you couldn't get someone on the phone at all, but here you get it on the first ring.  They even follow up with you before and after an appointment and they are genuinely nice people. Castle also had me waiting up to 45 minutes after my appt time to be seen, here at Clearview I am seen on time and sometimes EARLY which I have never experienced! Yes there is a worker shortage but people work where they want to, and it is obvious why they work here. The office is sooo clean and modern, comfortable, and just a joy to be in. Nobody enjoys going to the dentist but you'll love it here, there is a reason why they are 5 stars. Truly an amazing establishment run PERFECTLY.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandy Butcher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is by far the best dentist I have been to, hands down (and I have been to a lot). All of the staff is just wonderful, not a bad thing to say about anyone there.

The fantastic ladies up front will go out of their way to work with your schedule and are nothing but understanding when you need to reschedule. The hygienists are extremely gentle, efficient and take the time to make sure you understand everything they are doing.  The assistants that help Dr. Yoon during procedures are all great too. Friendly, caring and really seem to know their stuff!  Then there’s Dr Yoon, who just couldn’t be a nicer guy.  He is extremely knowledgeable, very attentive and truly cares about how his patients are doing.  He takes the time to walk you through his diagnosis – complete with pictures so you are able to look at the same thing he is.

I felt comfortable with him immediately and I am so thankful I found Clearview Dental!  If you are shopping around - give this place a try.  You won't be disappointed!

"Thank You!" to all of the Clearview Dental staff.  Really appreciate all of you!  See you next year!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Korie Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Clearview dental! Dr. Yoon is great. He always takes time to talk to me and answer my questions about my treatment and I never get the feeling he is rushing me. The office is clean, the staff is professional and friendly. The hygienist is the bomb! Most importantly, the office manager Stephanie is wonderful. She is the reason I am a patient. I needed a cleaning before I had my baby a few months ago, was searching and calling for an appointment to dental offices in my network and she was THE ONLY one who called me back, remembered my name and got me a cleaning that week with the hygienist. Im so glad I stumbled upon this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trina Lacey
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is AMAZING! the staff are very friendly and accommodating. I was able to get in on an emergency basis and had work done the following days. Sunshine, Gaby and Teresa were super nice and Dr. Yoon had a wonderful bedside manner, he's was very professional and made me feel very comfortable.I had major work done and I was very scared and nervous to say the least, the staff made me feel at ease. The office is very clean and easy to get to with plenty of parking. Highly recommend!! A+++

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yon Kim
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and Dr. Yoon are very friendly! I received a warm welcome when I walked in and felt calm the whole time. I didn't have a great experience with my past dentists, so I was always nervous, and I never went back to do anything, but once I went into Clearview, I wanted things done quickly. Dr. Yoon was really friendly, and I felt very comfortable. For the first time, I was thanked for being a teacher by Dr. Yoon, and it took me by surprise. So much that it made me appreciate my job even more than I already did. I highly recommend everyone to go, and now I have a place to refer to when anyone asks me about a dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leah Kimball
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clearview dental cares about their patients. When I was having bad tooth pain they made sure to get me seen as soon as possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kisha Patton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just got my teeth cleaned today and I am very happy with the results.  My teeth look great and feel great.  He was also very good during the cleaning.  I hate the scrape part and it did not hurt at all.  This was my first visit and I will definitely be coming back for continued cleanings.  He also had some good advice for me on my daily dental care that I did not know and will be putting into practice for not only me but my whole family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon Artman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never experienced such warm and caring people.  Dr Yoon and his staff were so kind and he did a fantastic job on such such notice.  I'm  happy to say he is my dentist.  I would recommend Clearview Dental to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Hughes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience!! Everyone was so friendly and helped keep my little one occupied while I had dental x-rays.  Teresa did a great job taking my dental x-rays and my impression for my custom bleach trays. The Dr. was awesome he took his time while cleaning my teeth and made sure I was comfortable. I highly recommend Clearview dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sierra J
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If I could leave 10 stars for Dr H. Nguyen I would! I have an extreme amount of anxiety when it comes to the dentist from a prior experience. Dr Nguyen has truly truly changed that. I needed to get a wisdom tooth and a dead tooth extracted and you would have thought she was taking my whole mouth away from me with the way I was breaking down. Teresa was very calm and understanding with me about how I was acting and when it did come time to get things started….
1. Thankful Dr. Nguyen valued my budget and still made it possible for nitrous gas
2.I would say I felt the slightest discomfort when receiving the numbing and again Dr Nguyen listened when I told her to keep me oblivious
3.The procedure itself, Teresa was a prime time hand holder when my partner had to leave the room, Dr Nguyen has magic hands because she did everything and I felt nothing but the minimal VERY minimal pressure of the pull to get 1 tooth out
I cannot recommend clear view dental enough

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very pleasant experience in Clearview today. The staff were all friendly and my dental hygienist, Stephanie, did an excellent job. Dr. Yoon was very thorough when he examined me and I was very satisfied. Thank you Clearview. I look forward to seeing you again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darrell Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff!!! Doctor Yoon is the complete professional . His staff is very attentive and polite. They go all out to make you feel right at home. They are not all about money. My Dental  needs were met  far beyond my expectations. You are missing out by not checking out Clearview Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: greg torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife referred me to clearview and I was not disappointed.  I had a cracked tooth and they got me in the same day. The minute I walked in they made me feel welcomed. They are super friendly and very efficient. The dentist was amazing as well. He made me feel very comfortable about what he was doing. I would highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jackie Santana
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff here is amazing!!!  I am terrified of the dentist and they make me feel so comfortable.    The setting is warm and inviting!  And who doesn’t love your favorite tunes played just for you??!!!  I had a root canal done so far and will be back for more services now that I feel comfortable for the first time in my life!!  Thank you Clearview Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bear Bustillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the best experience I have had with a dentist office. Like most, going to the dentist is usually scary or uncomfortable, but the staff and Dr. Yoon made it really easy and comfortable. Even more, I didn't feel a thing and wasn't sore after the treatment at all. Everything was explained & shown to me in a way that I understood (treatment plan & prices). If you're searching for a great office to have a long term relationship with; Clearview Dental is perfect. They keep me smiling.

user_reviews_extended.Name: W C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Couple of years back, my right lower molar tooth needed some treatment, root canal. It hurts when I had cold stuff.  I visited several dentists and they referred me to endodontists. The root canal costs from them were expensive even after the insurance. Dr. Yoon at Clearview Dental suggested me a crown first and do the root canal if the problem still exists. After more than 2 years of Dr. Yoon's careful crown work, I do not have problems having cold food.

And the fee for the crown was within my budget. Hope the tooth is good for a long time. I personally appreciate kindness of Dr. Yoon and all his staffs especially Ben.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie conley
user_reviews_extended.Description: My front teeth were all wormed, I went a to have them filled in where they were worn and walked out with new looking teeth.  The staff is great and they make you feel at ease.  I never felt comfortable at any dentist office but I do here.  Dr Yoon did a great job with making me have a smile!  Thank You!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karley Millender-Morris
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Clearview Dental for my first visit 2-27-18, it was one of my best dental experiences I've ever had. The staff was great and Dr. Yoon is amazing. The office decor is beautiful! I will be returning and I'm thankful that I have found a new dentist. Thank you Dr. Yoon and team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J T
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist office in Austin. The entire staff are professional and friendly. Most importantly, they care for their patient's health more than making money for themselves. I trust any recommendations they make.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kerry Sippel
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love coming to this office. My hygienist is amazing, thorough and makes me comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marina Irfan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my cleaning done at Clearview Dental and couldn't be happier with my experience. The staff went above and beyond even texting me before my visit to ensure my insurance was verified.I also like that this office is one of the few that is open on Saturdays making it convenient for those with a busy work week. I was greeted by Clarissa at the front desk who was professional and their paperless check in was quick and easy. The dental hygienist, Teresa, was sweet and very attentive to my comfort level while taking  x-rays . And they played a relaxing Beatles Pandora station in the room which was a nice distraction. Dr.Yoon was friendly and very straightforward which I appreciate. Everyone was so pleasant and it made my visit a positive experience. I'll definitely be recommending them to people and am relieved to have found a practice I love since I'm new to this area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savannah Azize
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just moved to the area and needed to find a new dentist and I’m so glad I chose Clearview! I was nervous to pick a new dental office, but my hygienist, Michelle, was so nice and so was the dentist, Dr. Nguyen, and they made sure I had a good experience. Can’t wait for my next cleaning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Michelle Hunt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
LOVE this dental office!! I mean, who really says that?? But, it's true! The entire staff is great! Super down to earth, friendly, and easy to speak with. It was a great experience for both my husband and I! We have now found our dentist! Dr. Yoon is extremely knowledge, very currently tech savvy, which was neat to see! The office is very relaxing, you can even listen to whatever you want to via Pandora!

My husband got his teeth cleaned while listening to Metallica, true story! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arwa Dabbakeh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really the best dentist and staff ever! We've had some horrible experiences with some dentists. It's very difficult to find a trustworthy dentist and Dr. Yoon is very trustworthy even my 5 year old loves them. Also we love Stephanie she is the best! If I could rate this office higher I would.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Schneider
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Yoon and his staff are awesome. He solved a problem I’d been obsessing over *for years* in less than 5 minutes! I have gum recession over a particular tooth exposing its dentin. My last dentist told me the only solution was a tissue transplant - very painful and expensive. Since there was no discomfort I left it alone but cosmetically it always bothered me. Dr. Yoon suggested a cap and had it done perfectly in 5 minutes, not exaggerating. With insurance I walked out at $78, my regular cleaning included. Amazing! I loved the tech who did my cleaning, too. His entire staff are fast, kind, and efficient. We all laughed quite a bit and it was very relaxing.

I also love how convenient the location is, so smart! Awesome to have a dentist as close as my grocery. Now there’s no excuse not to make regular appointments. Bonus: the office is clean, modern and fun. Highly recommend.

Thank you, Dr. Yoon!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thùy Vương
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my best dental experience at Clearview Dental. It was so comfortable and stress free. Whenever I went there, I just sat back relaxed knowing that I'd be well taken care of, which is a big deal for someone who had extreme anxiety with dental visits. I'm so glad I found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Wilson (Joe)
user_reviews_extended.Description: We recently found Dr. Yoon's practice after moving back to the area and couldn't be happier.  Dr. Yoon and his staff are super nice, caring and thorough.  The office is very clean with office hours that allow me to find the time to go to the dentist.  I had a weekend tooth problem once and waited in pain until Monday to call.  Come to find out I could have called over the weekend as they were open on that Saturday.  We trust Clearview Dental for our entire family.  We highly recommend him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessenia Delcallejo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Cannnot recommended Dr. Yoon and his staff enough! They are the best everytime. Their professionalism is unmatched and we can always trust them to lead with our best interest at heart. My husband and I have been patients since the start and will never stray. We drive from Burnet to every appointment without a second thought.  I truly wish every medical appointment were this seamless.

Personally, my smile has completely transformed! Words can’t express how over the moon I am with the outcome and how grateful I am to this amazing team.

This is a one stop solution for your dental care. Hands down the last time you’ll have to search for a practice or second guess a visit. They’re it.

Thank you Dr. Yoon and staff for everything you do!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Prude
user_reviews_extended.Description: Attention high anxiety people: Clearview Dental is 100% the place for you. I’ve put off going to the dentist for FAR too long. Embarrassingly long. Irrational fears kept me from getting routine cleanings but I read reviews on about a dozen dentists and this place stuck out to me for being sensitive to people with high anxiety. Dr. Yoon personally did my cleaning. He and his dental hygienist talked to me about my fears before performing anything and helped ease my mind. They told me what they were going to do before they did it and checked in with me many times throughout. If you’re like me and put off going for a long time, this place will not make you feel shame or embarrassment for having put it off for so long:) Also, I don’t have insurance and that was a major factor in choosing a place. When I spoke to a receptionist over the phone about the cost of the services I needed, that’s precisely what I paid at checkout. No hidden fees and a VERY affordable for option for those without insurance. 100% recommended Clearview Dental! Ps. It’s super cool they have TVs in each room to help keep you distracted:)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Cisneros
user_reviews_extended.Description: GREAT staff all around. Dr. Yoon is very informative and I’ve learned things about teeth that I’ve never known in my 37 years on this earth! Haha His staff is great, friendly, and no BS. They’re honest and will tell you what issues are more pressing when it comes to work on your teeth. They’re hands down the best dentist office I’ve been to and if you really want to know how at ease I was while getting work done on my teeth, I fell asleep getting a root canal! Seriously, who does that? Book your appointment now. You won’t regret it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Pressler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic experience. The staff is so friendly and professional. I would highly recommend this practice to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura V
user_reviews_extended.Description: My mother speaks Spanish only and she felt right at home with Clearview Dental.  Dr. Yoon clearly explained issue that was causing the pain and infection, and why he would move forward with the recommended procedure. The staff was great in interpreting for my mother and making sure she understood all details.  Overall, we are very happy with the attention my mother received  and very impressed with Dr. Yoon's expertise. Highly recommend Clearview!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katya Tinmey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Yoon is a true professional as well as a caring doctor. After orthodontic treatment, the bone on my lower and front teeth was resorbed, and I also had a set tooth that darkened significantly over time. I started to feel embarrassed about my smile. Initially, I came for a regular cleaning, but then I decided to ask if it was possible to somehow fix my problems. Dr. Yoon corrected all the problems that bothered me in a few visits. I didn’t even think that it was possible to fix my smile with anything other than veneers, but Dr. Yoon found a solution with the help of fillings and extra whitening of the dead tooth. I'm happy to smile again. I recommend Dr. Yoon to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jing Zhang
user_reviews_extended.Description: This newly opened dental place is awesome. The put me on the same day appointment when I called. I can do the paperwork online beforehand. The doctor and staff are very nice. They did the cleaning job very carefully and thoroughly. We also had very good conversation. One of my best cleaning experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dianne Hillhouse
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fairly new dental office in Round Rock - staff is extremely welcoming and accommodating.  The office is very clean and modern.  I appreciate all the latest dental technology they employ.  Dr. Yoon was clear and practical on the current state of my dental health and provided a short and long term plan of necessary and elective treatment.  I'm happy to have found a new dentist in my North Austin/Round Rock area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ranae Seestadt
user_reviews_extended.Description: What an excellent experience! My six-year-old son, Maks, accidentally got hit in the mouth with the door while playing tag with his siblings on a later Friday afternoon. Two of his baby teeth and his gums had considerable damage, and I called Clearview (as a new patient) to see if they could get us in. Even though their office was closing, they were so compassionate and told us that we could come in right away. The entire staff was incredibly friendly, and the doctor took great care of my son (making extra certain that he felt relaxed and not scared, even though he needed to have a tooth removed). They thoroughly explained everything and then performed the minor procedure right then. What's more, they gladly worked with us on discount pricing because we are self-pay. I would highly recommend this dental office; we will absolutely be going back for all of our dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mymotherskeepa
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I tell you this whole Dental Office is so amazing. I love them all so if your scared to sit in the dentist chair dont be they got you! If you need to get in they will do their best to accommodate you! Shout out to the front office and Nicole as well as both amazing dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Antoinette Burley
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was our first visit to Clearview, Dr. Yoon and the whole office were great (and polite) from beginning to end.  We just moved here and it's always nerve-wracking going to a new dentist for the first time.  Everyone there made sure we were comfortable and made the entire experience great!  I go to the dentist for cleanings regularly and this was the most thorough cleaning I've had, and "gentle" if you will, I left feeling refreshed.  My partner hates going to the dentist and he walked out of there and said "ok, that wasn't so bad." - I think that's a WIN! We made our appointments for 6 months from now for our next cleaning, we will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ken Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first review was 2 years ago and is posted below.   Since that time, this is my primary care for dental care and moreover my wife calls this home as well.   Dr. Yoon has done minimally 2 crowns and corrected any number of other issues including fillings and gum decay.   As many others can likely attest, dental visits can be painful, in over 5 to 10 visits in the two years since my first visit, I can truly say there has never been a bad or painful experience.   While I have talked about the good doctor, he is assisted by a very proficient and warm staff of administrative to dental hygienists and assistants.

Long as I live in Georgetown and long as he is there, Clear View Dental will be my home.

From 2 years ago:
Called this morning with what turned out to be a chipped crown.  The team was able to get me in at a moments notice.  A  small new office brimming with huge helpful personalities that provide the utmost in customer care.

Now, you are relaxed with music while Dr. Yoon goes to work...relaxing.  Dr. Yoon, top notch service from taking time to explain the problems to you making sure you understand the problem and your resulting options .   I was skeptical, five stars...I am a convert now.

PS. I also snuck in a much needed cleaning...mouth feels brand new.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sheila whittington
user_reviews_extended.Description: very good, quick and very kind.  clean building and very friendly nice clean customer bathroom. I loved it there on my first visit and will be sure to get my teeth cleaned again. The dentist will explain what ever questions you have and will give you some options without pushing. You can decide if you want to take it to the next level with your mouth. and the pricing is very  fair. I highly recommend you to check them out.lol

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clearview Dental is hands down the best dental office I have ever been to! The entire staff is so friendly and helpful. Everything was thoroughly explained every step of the way. Everyone does a great job of making sure you are comfortable and informed. I highly recommend this office to anyone considering it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oma Lepp
user_reviews_extended.Description: I feared to have work done on my teeth. I moved to this area and chose  Dr. Yoon to be my dentist. I am so happy I did. He is the best dentist. I  am so lucky and safe to be his patient. I had a permanent crown today. He made my smile beautiful again .THANK YOU, Dr. YOON

user_reviews_extended.Name: L
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Yoon is easily the best dentist I've ever had. He was the only one that has ever taken the time to explain how's and why's of flossing. As a visual learner, it's incredibly informative to have color photos of my teeth when he is explaining his recommendations. It helps me understand why the procedures are necessary and lends to a level of transparency I've never seen in a dentist. He is knowledgeable and clearly enjoys what he does. It's also clear he cares about his patients. He was happy to work with me as a poor graduate student. In the intake forms (online) there are thorough questions to allow Dr. Yoon to customize your experience at his office (ex: whether or not you become nervous at a dental office). On my first visit with him, it was clear he actually reviewed the forms and addressed listed concerns. MOST IMPRESSIVELY, the evening of my filling, he personally called to ask how I was doing after the procedure. I was shocked!

If you are a patient who enjoys being well-informed about your health or if you want a genuine caring, dentist, Dr. Yoon's office is for you.

The office itself is tastefully decorated and well kept. The staff is always very friendly and welcoming. The location has plenty of parking and is very easy to find.

Overall, even though I will be moving to ft. Worth, I don't want to switch dentists and would happily return for my regular appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wendy Yew
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Customer Service and dentist ! I'm a new patient, I emailed them to ask several question about insurance coverage, procedure that they do and the price of it. They replied my email in less than an hour with a clear response to all my questions. Dr Yoon and his assistant also have been very patient with me and making sure I am comfortable all the way. Plus, I get to listen to my favorite Pandora radio songs during the procedure. Thanks ! ^^

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eze Iheanacho
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have truly enjoyed every interaction and experience with Clear View Dental. All of the staff goes above and beyond to make sure you are comfortable and educated on procedures and process. I want to give a huge kudos to the entire staff for how you have cared for my wife and I. Highly recommended!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LaRhonda McBeth
user_reviews_extended.Description: Tiffany, Juliana and Dr Yoon are the best. I’ve been with them since they opened and they have made me feel comfortable getting dental check ups and dental work done. The environment is awesome and professional and I absolutely love them. Use them I highly recommend it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Arnett
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a great dentist! Dr Yoon is gentle, professional and amazing! The staff is so helpful and amazing! I couldn’t say enough positive. If you need a dentist this is definitely the place and these are your people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Averie Walther
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Love it here! It’s the only place that has ever taken my dental anxiety seriously and taken extra steps to help me be calm
I have had multiple visits now and each one gets easier!
They are also very straight forward with price which were very reasonable

I would highly recommend for people who are nervous to start getting their dental hygiene in check!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laurie Woodel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Clearview Dental has been a great experience.  The staff are friendly, professional and always greet you with a smile. Dr. Yoon takes his time to explain procedures and is willing to answer any and all questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Seeman
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and Dr. Yoon were amazing!!  They put me at ease and made the process stress free.  Everything was explained to me before they did the work and made sure they put me first.  I was very impressed with the dental assistance as well.  They know their stuff!!   I have found my "go-to" dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Helen K
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hadn't been to the dentist for my yearly checkup and cleaning in over 2 years since I moved. I received an advertisement in the mail for Clearview Dental which reminded me I needed to be responsible and finally go. Since I liked there advertisement and Clearview Dental is right down the street from me I though I would take a chance.

I am glad that I did! The staff are friendly and welcoming. The front of the office is minimal and tidy. Theresa was my hygienist and she did a wonderful and professional job. She was very kind and patient with me even though I was a little bit grumpy that day!

Dr. Yoon was very professional and efficient. He is also a very kind man with a great beside manner which I really value on a medical professional. The mantra on the Clearview Dental website is "promoting transparency in dentistry," which I totally agree is accurate to how they conduct their business at Clearview.

I did have quite a few cavities. I was giving a treatment plan which showed where the cavities are in my mouth along with pricing. Dr. Yoon was very honest with me in telling me which cavities are urgent and where I can wait to have filled. I booked to get my most troubling cavity filled right away.

When I came back for the appointment, I used my CareCredit card which was not reading that day.  They told me I could settle up next time when I came back to have my other two cavities filled which I thought was very considerate since using CareCredit is very convenient for me at this stage in my financial life.

Overall I am very impressed with Dr. Yoon, the hygienists, and staff. They even let you select ypur own music for the appointment which I think was a nice touch. I hope to see this business thrive here in Round Rock!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Hefets
user_reviews_extended.Description: DDS Yoon initially appears very appealing due to his explaining in clear language the next steps based on X-Rays. However, slowly I started to be suspicious: Following an extraction Yoon wanted to do grafting along with surgical placement of implant without stating the high cost of such placement. Later I received two different estimates for implants, within minutes from each other, whereas the second estimate was $900 lower than the first. Recently, Yoon demonstrated that he is a control freak by interrogating me about my appointments with his office and wanted to see the calendar on my phone. Very recently, Yoon was upset that I decided NOT to do root canal on a tooth with a cavity. His position was that I should have texted him the night before about my decision. When I explained why I decided against root canal, due to no pain, no infection and no sensitivity, he relied on an X-ray that allegedly showed that the cavity reached the canal. He threw at me that he does not lie to his patients, that he practiced for many years, that the board will revoke his dental license for doing a filling of that cavity without a root canal. Basically, Yoon argued with me and I just left his office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ash Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m very scared of dentists and have high anxiety. I’m so glad I found Dr.Yoon and his staff! He made sure to keep me feeling relaxed and explained everything to me so well, I left feeling good and brand new! I found my new dental home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L Nutkin
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff is exceptionally professional, pleasant, and accommodating. If you have any dental phobias, this is the place to come. They are gentle and thorough. I was so happy, I made an appointment for my husband too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isaiah Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Yoon and his staff were amazing. Scheduling the appointment and the time he took during the consultation for a "normal check-up" were impressive. He gets to know you and identified with me, some issues that my previous dentists didnt take the time to mention. Thanks Dr. Yoon, if you are looking for the best Dentist around, ease of service and a super flexible schedule with Saturday appointments just give them a call.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victoria Machado
user_reviews_extended.Description: After reading great reviews of Dr. Yoon I called for my father who has no dental insurance and was in a great amount of pain. Both receptionist that I spoke to were amazing and help clarify what we needed to know. After getting us in right at the closing time, Dr. Yoon gave him his exam, was in no rush even after it being closed, and made sure we both knew what was the best option for his teeth. Being that my dad doesn’t have insurance he worked with us. Dr. Yoon and his team are exceptional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: wynnie denny
user_reviews_extended.Description:
When I see this many solid 5 stars my assumption is the company is paying for people to rate them.  This is definitely NOT THE CASE here.

My first visit here yesterday was the best experience I've had at a dentists office.  The staff was so nice!  Dr. Yoon informed me that the procedure my previous dentist wanted to do didn't actually have to be done (but it might if I'm not careful).  When he saw my teeth he noticed two chips in my teeth.  they've been there for years and other dentists told me its not a huge deal because the chips were small.  Dr. Yoon fixed my chipped teeth FREE OF CHARGE.  I have never heard of that!  They want to keep you coming back and will work for it.
