user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I can’t say enough how thankful I am for the staff and dentist.

I arrived at the office two hours before my appointment because I was in so much pain that I couldn’t wait until 4 PM. From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly friendly and kind. I shared that I had been dealing with severe anxiety, and the tooth pain was making me hyperventilate and feel very uneasy. The dentist took the time to explain my options clearly and reassured me that everything would be okay.

I followed the dentist’s recommendation and had the tooth extracted. During the procedure, I started to panic, but Lorena, the dental assistant, and the dentist stayed right by my side, talking me through it and reminding me to breathe and stay calm. They were both so patient and understanding.

Lorena even put on my favorite music to help me relax and kindly offered her hand for me to squeeze if I felt overwhelmed again. That small gesture meant so much to me.

I truly can’t thank you all enough. As someone who used to avoid going to the dentist, I now actually look forward to continuing my treatments. I also want to mention how wonderful the front staff was—they made my 5-year-old feel so welcome while I was being treated.

I’ve finally found a dental office that feels like family.

Muchas gracias,
y también hablan español.

user_reviews.Name: Sonjia Goodwin
user_reviews.Description:
My experience with myDental in Round Rock was more then expected.

I deal with dental anxiety making it hard to go in for appointments. I had a tooth that was giving me some problems and dealing with Angie with scheduling was great. She answered all my questions upfront and was able to get me set up quick and gave me comfort with my anxiety.

Meeting with Jaycee today, taking my Xrays, I explained my anxiety (and where it stems from) and he was amazing. He explained everything before proceeding, explained what to expect and talked to me respectfully and without me feeling rushed, pushed around, or surprised.

The staff after was just as great. Cheyanne did the same explaining the process of the tools she was using and what to expect it to feel like.

Dr. Iqbal was amazing. He assessed my concerns, explaining everything so I understood and gave me option on how to proceed.

They worked with me as I have no insurance and gave me a few payment options to help out.
They always asked if I was ok, if I needed anything or even if I wanted to watch something on Netflix. I would HIGHLY recommend this location if you too suffer with dental anxiety. The staff is amazing. Even more so if you are lucky enough to get Jaycee, Cheyanne and Dr. Iqbal.

user_reviews.Name: Stephanie Escobar
user_reviews.Description: I have been to many many Dentists, and by far this was the most pleasant experience I have had. I have a lot of problems and the hygienist Cheyenne was extremely gentle. The Dentist listened and was very friendly. I also heard him calming a child in a nearby room successfully, so that was impressive as well. Thanks- I have found my new dentist.

user_reviews.Name: lynette quiceno
user_reviews.Description: Great experience, every single person I interacted with was very calm and after introducing themselves immediately provided a detailed explanation of what to expect next and talked through every step of the process in order for me to feel comfortable. This has been my best experience at the dentist since I was a child!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place and the staff! Very professional and down to earth! Will definitely recommend 😍

user_reviews_extended.Name: xavier cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Dang and her assistant Esther helped me with a small filling, and the service was great. Highly recommend coming here always an easy process. They make sure that you’re doing ok throughout the whole process.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ESTOCK Q60
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place clean environment awesome people

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Renee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sweet and quick staff answered the questions I didn’t know I had

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristy Thornton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I moved from out of state and searched and searched for a new dentist. This location is close to my house and convenient.
I made my first appointment at the beginning year. I went in and did X-rays and had the exam done. They told me my ratings of my gums and said that they aren’t very healthy. I’ve never been told that about my gums. Then another person comes in for me schedule an appointment to get a cavity filled. I asked about my cleaning that I was supposed to also get and was told that the hygienists have been double booked and that they wouldn’t be able to fit me in for that, but would be able to schedule me for that. They made me pay for at least half of my filling before they would schedule to fill my cavity. I am one for second chances. So I went back for my cleaning, the girl try to floss my gums in the back of my mouth. When I went to check out, they asked how my visit went. I simply said that it went how I expected. They tried to pressure me into leaving a 5 star review….
I also asked for a referral to have my wisdom teeth removed, never got that.
Onto the next appointment that I had already paid half for, my cavity filling. They tell me I had a second cavity that needed filling as well and asked if I wanted to fill it then. I said no. They never mentioned a second one before this visit. They tried to give me “sun” glasses that had already been used. When I asked them about it, they said they wiped them off. I refused them.

They made a 6 month appointment for another cleaning without my knowledge. Called me last week to confirm and I told them to cancel it. They asked if I wanted to reschedule, I said no.

Now today….they called me to try and schedule another one. I clearly cancelled the one they made for me without my knowledge and said I don’t want to reschedule. They are pushy for reviews, they only want to do work that insurance doesn’t cover. They don’t want to do cleanings but are more than happy to make time for cavity fillings and other things that you don’t go to them for.
I DO NOT RECOMMEND this place.
I have found another place I am much happier with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marcy Munoz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Dane and Jenna as well as all the front desk staff are amazing and so kind . Our 10 year old felt safe and comfortable! Thank you all! We will continue to come back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Perry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a horrible tooth ache. They got me in same day and took care of it all in one visit. Very friendly and the procedure was easier then I thought.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana Echeverría
user_reviews_extended.Description:
MyDental got my whole dental health in danger. I’ve even thought of lawsuit them.
For starters, I went for a cleaning and they ended up recommending a filling for one of my molars. I accepted thinking it was right. Then their unknowledgeable dentist ended up removing THREE of my crowns at once! And placed crowns of her liking. All the molars together, I ended with terrible pain and it was such as unnecessary thing since I did not even had pain.
Later in the week I had more pain and kept calling them without getting an answer. Ended up emailing other location, and finally someone called me just to tell me as a justification, that they had fired the dentist and the front staff. They were very good at charging both of my insurances even so they did not complete the job.
Not being able to put up with the pain I showed up there and they finally decided to schedule me with another dentist, an Indian lady who supposedly owns the place. She was nice and tried to fix the mess from the other dentist (which I heard had messed up other two people’s teeth that week). However, my pain never stopped and this new dentist told me it was “sensitivity” and told me to brush with Sensodyne. That did not solve the problem, and today, a year later, I yet am suffering from pain in my molars thanks to this bad practice.
They are unethical, unprofessional, and a danger to the community, more worried about making a quick buck than providing a good service. I told my spouse to never ever come back too.
As I write this review, I am dealing with pain that has never gone away since they messed up with my teeth and which I had never had before. I am about to schedule an appointment in a more decent practice.
This practice and dentists should have their license removed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jo Arzola
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time visit here was nothing short of relaxing and very educational. Staff is wonderful and attentive. The doctor took her time and explained everything thoroughly with me. I didn’t feel rushed at all. Great experience and service overall!

user_reviews_extended.Name: a
user_reviews_extended.Description: It had been a while since I’d been seen, and I’m so glad I chose this location. I definitely look into ratings and what people say when it comes to finding really great care. I read the reviews and I was sold. Check in process is smooth, especially with friendly staff. I learned a lot more about what was going on with my teeth in my one visit than I had with other places. It was just an overall great experience, and hopefully it’s the same for everyone else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J E
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment I walked in I was greeted with a smile and a warm welcome. Diana the hygienist gave me the the most thorough cleaning I've had in a long time. If I wasn't moving out of the area soon, I would make this my preferred dental office.
They're all great here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Simona Avalos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I Simona Avalos, rate MyDental a 5. They went beyond and their service is great. I really like all the employees that assisted me. I would highly recommend this dental office to anyone needing dental service. Thank y’all so much for the work y’all did on me. They are very patient and explanatory with what they will be doing. Very well recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Estrada
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to My Dental - Round Rock for years now and always have a great experience. Diane is the dental hygienist and she is amazing. She is caring and very knowledgeable. The front office staff is always helpful and friendly

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fatima Campos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love coming to this practice everyone is very attentive and respectful. They answer any concerns or questions i have. I want to especially give a shout out to Ana one of the DAs here, she was very kind and made me feel welcomed.  10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie's Haven
user_reviews_extended.Description: MyDental Round Rock was amazing. First time coming here and they were so friendly and knowledgeable. Really knew what they were doing. Answered all my questions; loved how they explained the process and went over everything. Felt well taken care of here. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: yelimar rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very good experience, quick and easy to make an appointment the staff is very friendly and helpful. Place looks amazing and it's very clean. They were quick and efficient, also they walked me through every part of the process very modern equipment. Leslie was very delicate and patient. Loved it!

And they speak Spanish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlotte Dixon
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire team is absolutely amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danish Ahmed
user_reviews_extended.Description: Brenna and Dr. Doleski were great! This office is always very accommodating, and they do an amazing job making sure you’re comfortable throughout your whole visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikita Novikov
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've had several dental treatments, each time receiving a paper to sign with the treatment cost. This went on for 3 months, then I unexpectedly received an email saying I owed an additional $500. During my next visit, I inquired about it and was told it was a mistake they would resolve. Later, my wife, who hadn't even been to the clinic that year, received an email asking her to pay $500, citing insurance not covering it. Couldn't they have resolved this in 3 months instead of waiting for such a large amount to accumulate? Be prepared for unexpected charges.

You've lost a loyal customer.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Talk2C
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I were very pleased and impressed with the level of service we received. We were able to get in appoitnments quickly and serviced promptly.  My kids kept saying how nice everyone was.  The offices are new with state of the art equipment. Fr. Patel is very through and pleasant. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corey Z
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We loved this dental office because they were friendly and nice and everything went well. My little one needed a filling replaced and they did a great job!
2/1 Dr. Dang and Esther were both amazing! So professional and sweet.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Back 'n Place Chiropractic
user_reviews_extended.Description:
DO NOT GO HERE!!!  These guys told my spouse that his out of pocket was $120 at time of service for cleaning half of his mouth and then 3 months later they turned around and billed him for another $190. (They sent a random text with a pay link to pay, without any explanation of why he needed to pay $190.)  Mind you he has not gotten the other half of his mouth cleaned and won't because he is afraid of getting another $300 bill, that he was told at the time of service that he would only have to pay $78 to do the other half of his mouth.

These guys are not very upfront with their pricing and that is not fair for the patient.

He wanted to do the cleaning that his insurance covers, but they CANNOT do that for some reason! They also stated that the insurance doesn't cover the kind of cleaning that hey HAVE to do!!   INTERESTING!

Beware: these guys claim that they have to x-rays on you every 6 months.  (Which is way too much!)

One last thing to put the cherry on top of how wonderful these guys are, if you are a self pay patient you will have to pay $1,200 for a cleaning!!  That is impressive!!  I can only imagine what it will cost to fix a cavity or do a root canal!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Stehling
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely terrible management. Go here if you want to book an appointment weeks out, wait 1 hour to start your cleaning and then be charged $130 without even getting a cleaning. I told them I didn't want to do x-rays because I had already been there and they had x-rays on file. They said it's standard after so many months and I had to do them again, which of course I was charged for. They were under staffed, but the manager should have re-scheduled instead of expecting people to spend 2 hours at the dentist. What a waste of time and money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dane Stull
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hate going to the dentist but myDental RR made it very painless. They were quick to get me in, extremely efficient during the cleaning and cavity fill, and took my insurance. Overall really liked this dentist they were the best I've been to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany E
user_reviews_extended.Description: Diane cleaned my teeth 2 weeks ago, my teeth still feel extremely clean a long with brushing and flossing. I didn’t need topical numbing, I personally don’t get sensitive or sore, but the option is available if you do! She’s friendly, very knowledgeable and taught me how to floss the correct way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: maryssa ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I LOVE this place been coming for about 5 months and it’s AWESOME!! The front desk people (Joann, Alexis) Are So cool and will get you checked in quick. And the Dr, Dr.Kimia is so chill does a great job at cleaning my teeth and making them PEARLY WHITE I support them 100%!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicc E
user_reviews_extended.Description: They was fast and amazing.and always great customer service and everyone is nice and pleasant and welcoming can’t ask for a better dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cricket T
user_reviews_extended.Description: This team has been through my dental nightmares through thick and thin. They’re all so incredibly personable, keep the facilities safe and clean, and remember who I am lol. Diane did an amazing job with my cleaning, and they’re all very kind and patient when I tell them I a wuss/sensitive. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krystal Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely 5 star service!! Thank you MyDental for making my visit so wonderful!! From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with a smile! After expressing concerns that my 7 month old daughter wasn’t going to cooperate with my appointment I was reassured by the staff they would help me out!! And help me out they did!! From playing with my baby during my x-rays, to the dentist talking to her during the exam and the front office staff bringing me a baby toy for her, they all went above and beyond to make my visit go smoothly.  I have never had such a wonderful calming dental visit! Thank you to each and everyone of you for making my visit fantastic! I will recommend this office to everyone I know!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alondra Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit was a wonderful experience with great staff and Leslie was very helpful. She knew what she was doing  from the start, and answered all of my concerns. Not to mention, she made sure I was comfortable through my session. Which I really appreciate because I’ve had horrible past experiences with other dental facilities. So far it’s the best dental place I’ve been and will most definitely 10/10 recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: M.Victoria Ceja
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really had a good experience. Staff are very professional and thoughtful. Dr. Geske was very helpful and answered all my questions. Thank you very very much and I certainly will let others know about my great experience here at my dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. Appreciate the help from Victoria. Everyone here always makes the place feel like home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: darian ward

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonny Sin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Doleski and Brenna helped me today and they were super sweet and made my dental visit less anxious. Also, having private room all by myself is always great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ty Roder
user_reviews_extended.Description: Diana did a terrific job on my teeth. I had sensitive gums and she used gel to help numb them while she cleaned. Absolutely wonderful. Mouth feels so fresh!

user_reviews_extended.Name: christy aguilar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here is so sweet and knowledgeable. The dental assistant I had was awesome! Definitely will be making this my new dentist moving forward

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sindy Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Last visit we had an amazing dentist and DA help us. Today we were rushed out and they were not patient with us. Second child did not get a cleaning, fluoride or even X-rays (only tried less than 30 seconds and gave up). They gave us a referral for both kids even though my other child didn’t need it.
I am thankful that in the last visit they didn’t separate us since the kids are under 5. This time they had us in separate rooms which is silly since the other appointment was scheduled 40 minutes afterwards.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin West
user_reviews_extended.Description: I gotta give credit where it's due, the staff here is fantastic, as is the level of care. The doctor is patient but direct, and takes extra care to make sure you're comfortable at all times. As a person who's always been anxious about going to the dentist, to say that I have no anxiety about visiting should say a lot. Highly recommended!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Canseco
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place great , great help amazing experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had Dr. Dang and Victoria  , did an amazing job of making me feel comfortable, and were very nice and polite. Also Jade was extremely nice she helped answer some of my questions when calling in and helped clear up any miscommunication.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dominic Mena
user_reviews_extended.Description: Terrible waste of time.  Went in for the first appointment, got my x-rays and then was told about my teeth by a hygienist and a doctor.  Great.  Then right after was told a treatment plan person would come in to discuss further treatments.  I asked about my cleaning and the tech said "We only do those if we have time".  I said "Okay well I'd love to get that done", to which she responded "I'll let the treatment person know".  The treatment person came in and made no mention of a cleaning at all, just what was recommended and then that she'd walk me out.  Why in the world would I spend my time going to the dentist for an xray and to only get my teeth cleaned "if they have time"?  Why would a hygienist spend time looking at my teeth, telling me about how often I'd need my teeth cleaned, and not actually clean my teeth? Such a frustrating experience to walk away from.  They lost me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Efren Bermudez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I got two fillings done with Dr. Iqbal. The preparation and job was done amazing and incredibly fast. Very happy to be a patient of myDental at Round Rock!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiera Wolfe
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dental office has a very modern, comfortable feel. All of the staff was very warm and friendly. Micah took my x-rays and was very quick and efficient. He then led me into the exam room and would always explain what he was doing and what I could expect next. Dr. Patel was very professional and willing to listen. Overall a very good experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabella
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome assistance, the dentist was super nice and helpful, Victoria was a really sweet and nice assistant. She helped me a lot and was super supportive. I love this place I totally recommend going here!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ray Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description: very nice and wonderful people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: talahi yrrebwarts
user_reviews_extended.Description: Diane was amazing during my cleaning I felt zero pain at all! The girls at the front made me feel welcome, I’m usually scared to go to the dentist but Alexis made me feel better! I would definitely recommend MyDental!!! If I could give 10 stars I would!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle McCall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my top wisdom teeth removed and a deep cleaning done over two days. I had little to no pain at all after without any pain relievers. The staff was in great communication, hospitable, kind, knowledgeable, and made the experience as best as possible. I actually look forward to coming back here again in the future!

user_reviews_extended.Name: R Romo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very happy with my first experience here! Front staff was very nice and so helpful. My dental assistant was patient and explained everything beforehand and I really appreciate that. Dr. Patel was very attentive, patient and so caring. I will definitely make this my and my families place for all our dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Curtis Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience! Quick, efficient, and painless!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Cornelius
user_reviews_extended.Description: The customer service was EXCELLENT. Everyone was nice and friendly and moved me through each step quickly. They did a thorough job explaining what was happening, results and the costs. I truly appreciated this visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emely van der Westhuizen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Updated Review September 2021: If I can still do a 0 start I would! My nephew had an appointment at 4:30 pm. We called at 4:25 stating we are 7-10 mins away as we moved on the other side of town. The gentleman was extremely rude and said they are cancelling the appointment. If they waited for us the Dr. would be behind when every time we are there for an appointment it takes 30 mins before someone comes to see us. We always pay in advance for the procedures and we have been loyal to this place since they opened. We are taking our business elsewhere. I’m honestly not sure what happened to this place. Everyone was super nice and attentive at the beginning. So disappointed

Updated Review June 2021: Changed the rating to 1 star. Not sure what happened to the original staff from 2 years ago. But the front desk is so rude! I called to cancel an appointment and the lady hung up! You can head the phone being slammed. I called back and said hi’ sorry I think our call got disconnected it was the same lady to answered. And with a very rude tone she goes how can I help you. The whole time on the phone was just rude!

Review from 2019:
My husband and I recently moved to Round Rock and the location was just perfect for us! Everyone in the office is super friendly from Lola to Dr. Patel. Thank you for making our visit comfortable. I highly recommend this team and location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zion Life
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After calling a few dental clinics I finally landed on Mydental. Lily’s welcoming vibe persuaded me to make an appointment. Most of my questions about pricing for a cleaning, X-rays, and fillings were answered by phone and she made me aware of their payment plan, as I’m uninsured.

Diane the hygienist was very gentle and thorough with the cleaning. Great job!

Josh gave me the low down on what needs to be done and how much it will cost. He explained the payment options in detail along with the available discounts through their in-house dental care plan, which is actually a decent deal at $19 per month. He was kind and patient during both visits. Spinning the gift wheel was fun - loved the chill vibes in this office!

Dr. Dudeen provided much needed insight as to why my two back teeth only hurt once in a while.  Many dentists have been dismissive when I ask for such explanations but he was informative and created a plan to address the issue during a future visit. On to the fillings… so far, so good. My bite is even and my teeth feel better!

Ed the dental asst did a great job checking on me throughout my procedure. Thanks for everything!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dylan Romero
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was a great experience overall. Doctor as well as all the staff were great. I don't remember the name of the tall girl with glasses, but she was very nice and kind. I am just very greatful 🙏  for the way I was treated. Thank you. BTW, this is my son's Google, but I am Ms Merith.

user_reviews_extended.Name: stephen glass
user_reviews_extended.Description: These are the nicest people at this office. They helped me with a very sore back tooth. It’s a great place to get dental work done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judid Jaimes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Kimy and her assistant Victoria were a great team today for my fillings service. Kept me well informed at all times about the process they were both super comforting and gentle. So glad I found Mydental since I have always had bad experiences with dentist visits this office has never once let me down and I will continue to use them for our dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaitlynn Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very efficient and kind. Not to harsh when cleaning and they communicate clearly

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Di Marco
user_reviews_extended.Description: MyDental in Round Rock TX is absolute TRASH! I’ve had so many issues with them and I’ve only been there 2-3 time. They are totally unprofessional. Whoever handles their scheduling needs to be re-trained or fired. I’m not the only one who had a bad experience. In the middle of the hygienist cleaning my teeth, one of the girls came in and says her truck was being towed so she panics and runs out without a word. Only did half of my teeth. They told me to go home and she told them her work was complete even though it wasn’t. My teeth/gums are killing me. 100% would not recommend this place to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Alvarado

user_reviews_extended.Name: M R
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The office was clean, the front staff, dental assistants and office manager were so NICE! THEY were very attentive and personable. Unfortunately, that's only a fraction of what a dental experience should be. They're the only reason I'm adding a star.

My real issue is with Dr. Lalezari's bedside manner and the lack of treatment that lead to me in the ER mere HOURS after seeing her.

I'd come in for an emergency/dental pain appointment and was told it was caused by an infected tooth that needed extraction. As my appointment was the last one available for the day, I understood that the extraction would have to be scheduled after the new year. What I do NOT understand is why I was not given any antibiotics or instruction on how to manage pain until then. So I left without relief for the intense pain that necessitated the visit in the first place. Only when I asked about it was I told to take ibuprofen at home (Bonus: I now have gastritis from relying too heavily on it for pain relief.)

6 hours and $600 later- I'm in the ER, with an extremely swollen face and in so much pain that I'm sobbing. The ER doctor gave me penicillin, pain medication and told me to STOP taking ibuprofen. This helped IMMENSELY over the course of the next few days the infection would have brewed and endangered me.

I wasted so much time and money seeing a doctor who had NO bedside manner and seemed inexperienced and flatly unempathetic. I did not go back for fear of not being taken seriously if I communicated my concerns before, during or after the procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Description: When considering this dental office for your dental care I recommend that you make sure that you get everything and writing upfront that way you don’t have any hidden cost once your work is all completed unlike my experience. Once the work was done, I ended up get another bill which I had no clue about. I was told that I only had one out of pocket cost, which wasn’t true. I don’t mind paying for what I owe but that me up front what that cost is and give me the choice to make a decision if I want to pay that much. Just make sure that before you do any work ask the question and maybe even get it in writing are they in network. I had to get back to work so I couldn't stay for a cleaning or even for anyone to explain to me what was happening, although they tried to tell me I needed to stay longer so they could, even though I told them I was already late for a meeting because no one had been to check in on me for over an hour. They gave me a print out of the plan and the cost was *coincidentally* exactly what my insurance would cover for the year. I wanted to get a second opinion, and since I had to pay for it out of pocket I wanted my x-rays, I had to call 3 times before someone would send them to me, even though each time I was told I should be receiving them shortly. And now they won't stop emailing me even though I unsubscribed, they just keep adding me to different lists, the account they have isn't associated with google so this review probably won't stop them either, but the email I received today, 4 months after my interaction, and unsubscribing at least twice, is what prompted me to write this. And when I got a second opinion I was told I had one very minor cavity, not 8.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I set up an appointment for an Invisalign consolation, but when I got there they started to do a full dental cleaning and work up on me. My mom actually had to go back there and tell the dentist herself, and when she was informed, we Didn’t ever see an orthodontist, in fact all we saw after that was the receptionist. They took X-rays and my insurance only allows those once a year. My mom asked them not to charge our insurance for this service because we didn’t even need the X-rays and when we were there they said they wouldn’t charge insurance. However, today when we called to make sure they didn’t charge us they said that they already did because “They would have to take them for Invisalign anyway” which is a total lie. We went to another orthodontist and they said they would have to take 3D imaging but they shouldn’t ever take X-rays. Invisalign doesn’t take X-rays and they never even took 3D imaging. All in all they are very rude and I feel that they don’t care truly about their patients, they’re just trying to make money. Not accommodating and I highly don’t recommend this place as a good orthodontist. Plus they said I would have to wear a retainer 24/7 for 3 years after my Invisalign treatment, but today the other, better, orthodontist I went to said I would have to wear a clear retainer for 90days after my Invisalign treatment and then only at night. I don’t recommend this place, it gives me bad vibes

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Sami Iqbal came to me as a referral, and my goodness, was I lucky. His business card says “Keeping your smile beautiful,” and he truly lives up to that promise.

I’m currently going through the process of getting upper dentures and am wearing my temporary denture right now. You have no idea how such a small procedure can make such a big difference. I’m smiling again instead of covering my mouth when I talk, and I feel so much more confident about my appearance.

Dr. Iqbal has done an amazing job so far, and I’ll be getting my permanent dentures soon. The entire process has been handled with care and professionalism, and I couldn’t be happier with how everything is going.

I also want to recognize the wonderful staff. Zai and Angie are always so professional, kind, and caring. The warm welcome patients receive when they walk in is like no other, and they truly make you feel comfortable from the moment you arrive.

Thank you to my amazing and talented dentist, Dr. Sami Iqbal, and his incredible team for helping me smile again. I’ll continue to keep everyone posted on my dental journey, but I’m already so grateful for the difference they’ve made.

user_reviews.Name: Mamta Mahimtura
user_reviews.Description:
I absolutely love Sam! She’s not only amazing at what she does, but she’s also become a real friend over the years. She’s so caring, gentle, and always makes me feel completely at ease. I actually look forward to my cleanings because I know I’ll leave with super clean teeth and a smile on my face. Truly one of the kindest people you’ll ever meet. My entire family goes to see her because she’s THAT good Thanks, Sam! 🩷
I highly recommend her! 🦷

user_reviews.Name: Jonathan
user_reviews.Description:
Strongly recommend coming here! I had an emergency appointment, after neglecting to go for some time, in which they did a fantastic job! I’m so glad I went here and thankful of their outstanding care!

I really do owe them for a fantastic experience, no judgement care, expert treatment, and being able to work around my busy schedule. Thank you so much! Special thanks to Michelle for making me feel so welcome and making sure everything went smoothly.

user_reviews.Name: Zachary Hardin
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely the Best Dental Experience I’ve Had in Years!

I can’t say enough great things about Advanced Dental Care of Round Rock. This was hands down the best experience I’ve had at a dentist in years. From the moment I walked in, the staff was welcoming, professional, and genuinely caring, which immediately put me at ease.

The team took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire visit. The level of care, attention to detail, and professionalism was outstanding. It’s clear they truly care about their patients and take pride in their work.

If you’re looking for a dentist you can trust, I highly recommend Advanced Dental Care of Round Rock for all dental work.  Ask for Michelle!! Five stars without hesitation — I won’t be going anywhere else!

user_reviews.Name: Sandra kessemtini
user_reviews.Description: I always have an amazing experience with Samantha! She did a thorough teeth cleaning and took her time to make sure everything was perfect. My teeth feel so clean and fresh, and the entire process was gentle and comfortable. The staff was friendly, professional, and made me feel completely at ease. I’m really happy with the results and highly recommend this dentist to anyone looking for great care and excellent service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: shubham goel
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The dental care itself has been good, and I truly appreciate the quality of service from the dentists and hygienists. However, I’ve experienced repeated issues with the billing process for the second year in a row.

During my recent visit, I had confirmed that the hygienist would perform a regular cleaning. However, after the procedure, they mentioned that the system recorded it as “periodontal maintenance,” which caused confusion and led to a higher charge. It was clear that the procedure performed was a regular cleaning, but due to some system or coding error, it was categorized incorrectly.

Additionally, the front office staff requested a significantly higher upfront payment than what my insurance later indicated I actually owed—about one-third of the amount. When I asked them to file the claim first, they were insistent on collecting the payment upfront and provided an inaccurate explanation about my deductible without verifying it with the insurance company.

It would be greatly appreciated if the front office and hygienists received more training on insurance processes and billing accuracy to ensure a smoother, more transparent experience for patients.

Make sure to understand the proceduce and expected bill before the service.

However, it caused an infection and bone loss so I looked for a second opinion and another endodontist found gauze (which should have been taken out) still left in there. user_reviews_extended.Name: Shareen Adair
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Google Review

Please make sure to ask for an itemized bill from this establishment. My experience here was disappointing due to added charges that were not valid.

After a cleaning service, I was presented with a bill for $276, which I paid but felt uneasy about. When I returned to request an itemized breakdown, the front office manager claimed she couldn’t provide one because the service was already completed. This seemed highly questionable, and I pressed further.

She then informed me that $125 of the bill included two no-show fees: $50 for me and $75 for my husband. The $50 fee was for an appointment I actually showed up for, but due to their office not having my insurance information (even though my husband provided it a week earlier), I had to reschedule. The $75 charge for my husband’s “no-show” was unclear and never explained.

After questioning these charges, $75 was refunded, but the $50 was not, despite it being their error. When I asked for a manager, I was given only a first name, “Rhonda,” with no contact information—an apparent privacy violation.

Both my husband and I cancelled future appointments. No apology was offered for the misrepresentation or inconvenience. I cannot recommend this office due to their poor billing practices and lack of accountability.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Emerson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful office!!!  Samantha and Dr. Miranda take their time, office is very calm and runs smoothly and on time.   They don’t try and push anything on you - just looking out for your oral health and they do a great job keeping you on track!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Farinazo
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental hygienist was so sweet. She was very calm and relaxing, which is a nice approach when working in a dental office. (It can be a very high anxiety place for some). The dentist explained very simply and clearly what needed to be done and wasn't too pushy about care. I think I'll definitely return for future treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Stevens
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff here were excellent, from front desk to dentist. I have significant dental phobia and everyone was incredibly understanding and worked hard to make me feel as comfortable as possible. This staff easily earned my trust.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Dudek
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We love everyone at Advanced Dental
Care. From Haley at the front desk to Dr. Widdison himself, everyone is funny, nice and courteous. The office is cozy and inviting. Some dental offices lately have been pushing unnecessary treatments or procedures, which is why we left our last dentist. We’ve had nothing but positive experiences here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Sawyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have some serious dental problems but they were really good at responding to my needs and made me feel really comfortable. I am actually looking forward to my next appointment. Dr. Widdison was outstanding, he listen to my concerns and was able to workout a solution for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wade Walker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
After a couple of appointments with Advanced Dental Care, I'm really impressed with the whole operation. Everyone (front desk, hygienist, and Dr. Widdison)  is friendly, efficient, and very thorough. Highly recommend!
Adding how great Samantha is at Advanced Dental. A fantastic hygienist with a warm chairside manner.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sudeshna B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is one of the cleanest dentist office I have ever been to. They are amazing people from the receptionist to the hygienist and also the dentist himself.
The hygienist was very patient with me, and listened to whatever I had to tell her. Did a great job cleaning my teeth.
Dentist himself was great and was very to the point. Loved it here and I’m definitely going back for my next checkup in 6 months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carla Maria
user_reviews_extended.Description: I LOVE this office and the staff. I am one of those people who has quite a bit of anxiety when It comes to dental work. I’ve had many dentists in the past make me feel embarrassed or ashamed but I have never felt more comfortable than I do in this office. All of the staff is professional and welcoming. Dr. Widdison has a great sense of humor and is very personable. 10/10 would recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: sale4izzy kim
user_reviews_extended.Description: They have changed their staff since the last time I was there. I’ve done a cleaning before and everything was fine. This time was different. The hygienist was very rude and had an attitude. She doesn’t have basic manners and doesn’t know how to communicate with the customers. I don’t think I’ll be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Ferebee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely friendly staff with wonderful bedside manner. This was our first visit but front desk staff knew other patients’ names as they walked in which speaks to their customer service and dedication to their patients. Did not have to wait long at all to be seen and the appointment moved along efficiently. We are able to bring our whole family here which makes it super easy and is much appreciated when you have small children who need dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Glenna Gorske
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and professional staff. They made me feel relaxed and took good care of my concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Duval
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit - to deal with a broken front tooth and repair my partial.  I'm normally very nervous at the dentist but this was a pleasant experience.  All the staff  were very pleasant, professional and kind and I left happily with my problem fixed.  There'll be no more reluctance to make another appointment in the future

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny Zepeda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a lot of dental anxiety coming into this appointment, but the team made me feel welcomed and calm. Highly recommend this location and is great staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dave Chase
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental care and very personable staff! I had not been to the dentist in several years, and everyone was more than accommodating and understanding of the situation. The appointment was seamless from the moment I walked into the door to the moment I left.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pretty PSD
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit to Advanced Dental Care of Round Rock. My check up was quick and easy. Dr. Miranda and her staff were very friendly and professional. The front office ladies are nice and helped me with all my questions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Rebisz
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the place for phobic patients! The entire staff is warm, welcoming, and put you at ease quickly. Dr. Joe Widdison has a fantastic manner and provides the most positive experience I've ever had a dentist's office. My husband and I so glad to have become patients, especially as our aging teeth begin to fail us.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Key
user_reviews_extended.Description:
What a great dental experience I had at Advanced Dental Care of Round Rock today! Professional and courteous from the entire staff from check-in to excellent cleaning to dentist evaluation. Thank you!

Love the new dentist Dr. Miranda!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jose Bayona
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent timely and quality service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Aleman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a regular cleaning done and I have to say from the front office to the rest of the staff was amazing! Such nice and caring people. I highly recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Dial
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love this office! So convenient and wonderful staff and doctors. We’ve also been to their Hutto office, this one is so much more convenient for us.

Highly recommend.

—-
Updating the review since the office got back to me and helped resolve the issue.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki Washburn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always an easy process and quick, friendly service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rex Henry

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dave Eichler

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Bray
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys are great. Let's be honest, no one 'likes' going to the dentist, but I can say after having gone here for a few years now, its no longer a dread. Everyone is super nice and gentle.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Souhir Ben Hsan
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the first time I have written a Google review for anyone but it is deserving. I had nothing but great experiences while going to see Dr. Widdison. user_reviews_extended.Name: Bette Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently moved to Texas. My first visit to Advanced Dental Care was really great. Samantha, the hygienist, and Dr. Miranda were professional, thorough, and kind. I am definitely returning for dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always friendly and full of helpful information! They are also patient and kind with someone who has high dental anxiety!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Simmons
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was unhappy and frustrated with my previous dentist and decided to try Advanced Dental Care of Round Rock. Detailed explanations regarding my care were provided by everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caynan Picard
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We love Advanced dental, they genuinely care and you can feel it the second you arrive. We will never go to another dental practice again. Our whole family goes there and we all feel the same way!

user_reviews_extended.Name: sirisha Reddy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Myself and two of our children see In advance dental care Roundrock. Every time I have made my appointments they have been flexible with my schedule and have accommodated all of my changes. We are a busy family and our schedules are always changing. Thank you Advance dental care roundrock Doctor for always helping us with everything, nothing but the best experiences and we have recommended several friends and will continue to do so !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edina Morrison
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was greeted warmly and checkin as a new patient was a breeze. The patient chairs are very comfortable and love that I got to get in some tv time while my teeth were cleaned. The doctor was friendly and thorough, just as the hygienist was. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Bowen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great office environment. Clean very professional. Able to navigate around the insurance coverages quickly and efficiently. Glad to find a dentist which does most all services with in network so close to my area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Autumn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Addison and Mar were so professional and caring.  My whole experience, from Theresa at the front desk to my cleaning and exam in back, was delivered with professionalism.  I really appreciate the genuine attitudes and communication from all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarsey Dyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time here and I had an amazing experience!  Everyone was so nice and caring. user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan McDorman

user_reviews_extended.Name: K Jones

user_reviews_extended.Name: karen fields
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dental practice is excellent. Dentist is experienced.  I do trust her expertise and the staff is great too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JTSwagger

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cheyenne King

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Brian
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time going to Advance Dental and they were very polite and welcoming. I feel like they did an extremely thorough job with the cleaning but were also efficient. Definitely recommend and will be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Sampson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Widdison is awesome and truly cares! All of the staff is great. I got lucky after moving here finding the best dentist on my first try. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Hansen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have a bad history with dentist and am terrified of them.. this is the ONLY place I feel comfortable and they will never make you do something you don’t want to, but they will recommend the best option and health for your teeth. user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Morrison
user_reviews_extended.Description:

Staff was polite and friendly.
I’ll be back here for my next cleaning.
Thumbs up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gerald Bailey

Definitely going to stick with this dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: linda ridge
user_reviews_extended.Description: Advanced Dental always sees me on time…no waiting past the appointment time.  Everyone in the office is friendly, helpful and professional.  I am very happy with all dental procedures I have had there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shiri Breslow

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone here is AMAZING! From Theresa at the front desk to Sam and Mar the entire experience was so cool!

I highly recommend anyone to go here if they want excellent dental services and amazing people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alice Kibler Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Leave your nerves in the car!

user_reviews_extended.Name: cynthia florvil

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yeci L.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiki Mukai
user_reviews_extended.Description: Consistent, good and friendly service through the years. The space is always clean and the staff is professional. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yerram Srilakshmi

user_reviews_extended.Description: First time here and let me say it won’t be the last. I had the pleasure of receiving top tier care from the staff. I will be back

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Martin

user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this office!   Samantha Hernandez did my X-rays and dental cleaning.  Experience was pleasant and informative.  Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Calise
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Widdison was excellent and efficient. I left office feeling such confidence in my smile and teeth. Never wait to take care of them. Very convenient location located on 1431 and Sendero Springs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monica Gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an issue with one molar and swollen gums with a lot of pain… they were able to fit me in same day and Dr. Miranda was fast on her diagnosis and work done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Hood
user_reviews_extended.Description: My whole family has been going to Advanced Dental Care for 5-6 years. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carl Robertson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have the utmost respect and debt of gratitude to Dr. Miranda and this office. Dr. Miranda took over the practice two years ago and has helped with my very extensive dental work. Recently I had an emergency infection, massive toothache which threatens an upcoming heart surgery. Dr. Miranda and staff pulled out all the stops, identified the problem and made emergency arrangements with other specialists, and they were able to resolve it the same day.   I am very grateful to Dr. Miranda and the whole crew.  I mean that seriously. I feel I can trust my life and health to their expertise, and that is not something I say easily.

Also, on a more routine note, the hygienists have made a huge difference to my dental care habits, for the first time in about 30 years I've been able to keep my bridge clean.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience at Advance Dental Care in Round Rock. The entire team was friendly, professional, and made me feel comfortable from start to finish. Everything was handled smoothly, and I really appreciated how attentive and thorough they were throughout my visit.

The staff clearly cares about providing excellent service and making sure patients are well taken care of. I felt confident in the quality of care I received and left with a very positive impression.

I’d definitely recommend Advance Dental Care to anyone living in or working around Round Rock who’s looking for reliable, professional dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff!! Actually enjoy going to dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Description: My dental issue was attented very friendly and professionaly. The enviroment of the whole vidit was confortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chuckie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Miranda and the dental staff have great bedside manor and I would recommend this place to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Simon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quickly got me on the schedule. Front desk was very courteous and helpful. Dentists has an excellent bedside manner and thoughtful to the patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Hutyra
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly,  courteous and professional

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abraham Charron
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Before this place I dreaded going to the dentist.  I’m 48 and I’ve had issues with my teeth since I was a kid and had some pretty bad experiences with dental visits.  Dr. Miranda is the best dentist I’ve had.  It’s such a relief to have a dentist who you’re comfortable with and takes the time to really address the issues.  The staff is also amazing.  From the front desk to getting your teeth cleaned everyone is very pleasant.
Also I have extremely sensitive teeth and hated getting my teeth cleaned.  Today I got my teeth cleaned and despite me giving her them plenty work to do, she cleaned my teeth with minimal discomfort.
This place is the best.  I’m going to recommend this place to all my family and friends!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan McNamara
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This dental practice is the best!  I found out about Advance Dental care of Round Rock through my insurance provider's directory and my son and I had a great experience!  The staff are all super nice and they took great care of us!  Sam is so caring and makes me look forward to going to the dentist.

Updated to say we had another visit today and everyone is wonderful and they make going to the dentist a pleasant experience. Keep up the great work!

My son and I had another appointment today, and as always, the hygienists are amazing!  This is the first dentist that I look forward to going to visit and I am not afraid of. Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cliff Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have used Advanced Dental Care of Round Rock approx. 4 times.  I initially chose this dentist because of it’s very convenient location to my home.  But so far, I feel I’ve made a good choice.  The entire staff are very friendly and relaxed.  The dental plan we will embarked upon makes sense for my needs.  And they've worked smoothly with my insurance and schedule.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Excelente atención y muy buenos profesionales

title: Round Rock Comfort Dentistry
address: 1715 S Mays St # E, Round Rock, TX 78664, United States

user_reviews.Name: Pamela Gray
user_reviews.Description: I recently visited Round Rock Comfort Dentistry. I had extensive work done, and I couldn't be more pleased. Everyone in this office is friendly and greets patients with smiles. The work took two and one half hours. I was asked many times if I was all right, and was given several mini breaks making sure I was comfortable. I have every confidence in this office. Dr. Indu and staff are phenomenal! I will continue to visit this office. You are in great hands should you decide to visit.

user_reviews.Name: Katie M
user_reviews.Description:
This team is wonderful! Extremely kind, non-judgmental and more than willing to give you any information you would need. I hadn’t been to the dentist in years, and I’m pleasantly surprised with how great my experiences have been. Dr. Indu and Iesha performed my initial intake, deep cleaning, and fillings.  They did a wonderful job!
Today I had Erin and she went above and beyond, explained how to properly floss, gave me tips and recommendations to better my oral health. Despite the office being busy she did not rush and took great care of me.
Highly recommend round rock comfort dentistry!

user_reviews.Name: Mireya Uribe-Warren
user_reviews.Description: I had multiple fillings, a deep cleaning and a crown done these past 3 weeks.  I had not been to a dentist since I was a child, so I was apprehensive to say the least.  The whole team was very nice and made me feel  at ease....from making the initial appointment and setting up financing with Violet, going through the initial assessment including dental X-rays, with Jennifer and dental hygienist, Erin...to the fillings, deep cleaning and crown with Iesha and Dr. Indu.  They were all very professional, friendly, and explained what was about to happen... which put me at ease.  They even had upbeat pop music playing while getting my dental work that had me "singing" with my mouth open and tapping my feet.  Iesha even asked me if I was singing and Dr. Indu said, "Yes, she sure is."  I am so happy to have found this dental practice.  I am now on track with my dental health.

user_reviews.Name: Andrea Garcia
user_reviews.Description:
I came here because my sister highly recommended it, and I’m so glad I did. I hadn’t been to the dentist in about five years, and I recently noticed small holes on the sides of two teeth—most likely from not flossing when I was younger. I knew it was time to take better care of my teeth.

At my first visit, I got a cleaning and planned for fillings. Dr. Indu and the staff were incredibly kind and patient, and they quickly created a treatment plan. During my second appointment, they made sure I was completely comfortable—offering a blanket, breaks, and even a stress toy. The fillings turned out great, and the staff was wonderful the entire time.

I’m coming back next week for more care, and I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a gentle, professional dental team!

user_reviews.Name: Wisest Owl
user_reviews.Description:
I had been putting off going to the dentist because I had been experiencing some tooth sensitivity. But thankfully, I had a positive experience and my sensitive tooth feels better after the flouride they gave me. Erin was the dental assistant who cleaned my teeth and I was impressed with how thorough she was. I also appreciated how before she did something, she would tell me what was going to happen or what she was going to do. This really helped put my mind a little more at ease. She also took time to answer questions that I had if I wasn't clear on something she said. I will feel confident going in for my next checkup because of my experience with Erin.

Violet was professional, accomodationing and very helpful during the process of getting me into their office and after when I needed to get the fillings altered that I got done there.

Thanks Dr. E and all the staff at RR Comfort Dentistry!

user_reviews.Name: Jo Hardin
user_reviews.Description: Round Rock Comfort Dentistry staff always take very good care of me and my husband when we have our appointments.  They are very quick and efficient and we are glad to have a dentist close to our home.

user_reviews.Name: Carrie Thornton
user_reviews.Description: Went in for free consultation. Everyone still was very polite. Dr. Indu and asst. Ieasle talked with me as if I was a paying customer. After consulting with doctor, I explained what I wanted it was an okay I can do this (I had been to two other dentists and both wanted to take ALL top teeth out. But not Dr. Indu we can save teeth if possible and go from there. I had an engagement and needed a quick fix. It was done the same day. It was fantastic!!! I can smile now and it looks great.

user_reviews.Name: Aswini M
user_reviews.Description: Excellent dental care for the whole family! The team was friendly, professional, and made sure we felt comfortable throughout our visit. Dr. Indrakanti explained everything clearly and gave great attention to detail. Dental Hygienist Erin was wonderful — she talked through each step, and my teeth felt and looked fantastic afterward!
