user_reviews_extended.Description: My wisdom tooth extraction by Dr. Indumathi Kirupalan went very well. I did not feel any pain from beginning to end. She is AWESOME at numbing and spoke each step to me as she was pulling the tooth. Her assistant Jenny was   patient and kind. The post-op instructions were given with care and I definitely recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As someone with dental anxiety, sensory processing issues, and a terrible gag reflex, this is the best dentist I’ve ever had. Dr. Indu and Assistant Iesha had so many tricks up their sleeves to help me feel more comfortable, and they worked with me to make sure I could get my dental work done. They were so understanding, giving me breaks when needed, and they were so flexible in finding workarounds when something they were trying to do was too much for me.

Getting dental work done is never fun, but this office goes above and beyond to make sure the experience is as painless as possible!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vira C
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my first time visiting Round Rock Comfort Dentistry. The staff and doctor are very friendly,  caring and helpful in answering all my questions.  The wait wasn't long. My teeth cleaning went smoothly.  I definitely will recommend this place to my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charles Del Dotto
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This past Tuesday, 8/12/2025, I went to Round Rock Comfort Dentistry for my semiannual dental cleaning appointment, and I was pleasantly surprised that a dentist, Dr. Indumathi Kirupalan, was going to clean my teeth because the dental hygienist was off that day. I cannot recall the last time, if ever, a dentist personally cleaned my teeth. She was very friendly, professional, and highly proficient in treating me.  She demonstrated a sincere concern for my dental heath.  I am very pleased with the outstanding service I received from Dr. Kirupalan. Additionally, the administrative staff at Round Rock Comfort Dentistry was also very cordial, professional, and helpful in serving me. I highly recommend Round Rock Comfort Dentistry to anyone seeking a truly outstanding dental clinic.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
On 2/16/2026, I had my semiannual dental cleaning appointment at Round Rock Comfort Dentistry, and once again Dr. Indumathi Kirupalan treated me.  As before, Dr. Kirupalan did a superb job throughout the entire cleaning procedure, always making sure I was not in any pain and was comfortable.  She is to be commended for her professionalism, dental expertise, and outstanding commitment to providing excellent service to her patients.  Thank you, Dr. Kirupalan!

Also, I would like to thank the staff who waited on me the day of my appointment.  As always, they were professional, friendly, and helpful.

Thank you Round Rock Comfort Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Barbee Tunnell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Round Rock Comfort dentistry! I have been several times in the last few years as I needed extensive dental work done. I have walked out pleased every time. Everyone is friendly and caring about my comfort and experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Winkelman
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first dents appointment evee. I am 8 years old. Dental Hygienist Erin was nice and worked really well with me. She made me feel comfortable. Dr. Indu was very nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Don Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had a root canal then and the staff is very friendly and caring the Doctor David did an excellent job. Farewell taken care of. I would highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret Lozano
user_reviews_extended.Description: The girls are always so professional and kind at Comfort Dentistry.  Erin did a great job cleaning my teeth.  Thanks for always taking care of me and really caring too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandy Burke
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire experience from start to finish was really great. The front office helped with my new insurance. They were also able to get me in quickly. The dental assistant was super sweet and calming. Dr. Indrakanti's numbing injection was painless and her work on my crown was gentle and stress free. The office is family friendly, welcoming, and clean. My husband was also able to get a cleaning while I was getting my crown work done. He does not like dental cleanings. He was very happy with his cleaning. I'm so glad we found Round Rock Comfort Dental. Highly recommended. Thank you again for taking care of us!

user_reviews_extended.Name: TENCHO CALDERON
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is always taking good care of me the staff is very helpful. Jenny is always a blessing, so kind and helpful she does a great job here. Come check them out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: danielle woods
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The entire office is so kind. My children and I have sensory issues and are on the spectrum. Dr. A took the time to get to know us and ease our minds. I had to have some work done and they took the extra mile to provide me with a blanket, stress balls and a massager. I was so comfortable that I fell asleep. I used to have so much anxiety surrounding coming to the dentist so this was huge for me. My kids have been coming here and seeing Dr.
I since they were babies. They love the dentist and look forward to their visits. A huge thank you to both Doctors and their assistant Aisha for all you do to keep our teeth healthy. Love the Dydell family

user_reviews_extended.Name: T Bahe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hygienist does a great job, is very knowledgeable. Dentist also does well at exploring options to consider. They don't try to over sell their services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jan Madderra
user_reviews_extended.Description: Erin, dental hygienist, was great. She explained everything as she did it and my teeth felt & looked great when she was done. I give her an A+.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hali Josephine Ybarra
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round Rock Comfort Dentistry truly lives up to its name. From the moment you walk in, the entire team makes you feel welcome and at ease. They go above and beyond to ensure you’re comfortable every step of the way, whether you’re there for a routine cleaning or something more involved. You can really tell they care about their patients—not just their dental health, but their overall experience. It’s rare to find a dental office where you feel genuinely looked after, but this place is one of them. I’m so grateful to have found a dentist that puts compassion and comfort first!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keertana Sanjivi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an exceptional experience at this facility. The doctor and staff were highly professional, making sure I was comfortable and informed throughout the entire procedure. I experienced no pain, and the level of care provided was outstanding. I highly recommend this hospital for anyone seeking reliable and skilled dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jullianesse Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently went to Round Rock Comfort Dentistry based off of the reviews I read up on. I had to get a few fillings done and I have terrible anxiety from past bad experiences at the dentist. However, Dr. Indu and the entire team made me feel comfortable by providing anxiety/stress relieving measures. I really liked that they explained everything that would be done and during the procedures they asked if I was doing okay several times. This was the first time going to the dentist where I left telling myself it was not as bad as I thought it would be. I did not experience any pain due to the numbing medication given. Front desk receptionist was kind, friendly and welcoming. While Dr. Indu's dental assistants were very helpful and eased my nerves with conversation. I was so relieved to have such a good experience for once at a dentist office. I look forward to coming back at the end of the year for my follow up/cleaning. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaedyn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr I got me in with very little notice. She was compassionate and there to help me get my wisdom tooth out i really appreciated the easy and smooth process even though i was terrified

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eleana Padilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Round Rock Comfort for a couple of years. Everyone is very kind and welcoming. Went in today for a crown and had a great experience. They made sure I was comfortable and consistently checked in with me. Would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Rangel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Erin Vaughn was so thorough with my deep cleaning. I felt relaxed about the procedure. She was awesome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: durga mahalakshmi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to  comfort dentistry to get my wisdom tooth removed and the whole experience was very good.  The staff were kind and made me feel relaxed from start. The dentist explained everything before starting and made sure I didn't feel any pain during the extraction. It didn't hurt and I felt well taken care of. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: niezha harris
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience with this practice. From the welcoming environment starting at the front desk staff all the way to the end of the appointment and treatment. Dr. Indu and Ieasha are the best. Ieasha calmed my nerves and helped me relax . Assured me that everything would be ok. Answered all my initial questions, she was super patient and professional with me. I loved that. Dr. Indu was very nice and knowledgeable. She explained everything clearly and gave me a straight forward dental plan that fits my needs. Very nice, very clean and very professional. My whole family will come here from now on. Keep up the good work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddy Iglesias
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here for a few years now. The entire staff is very kind, courteous, and extremely professional! I always enjoy my visits, and I’m thankful for all they do! Highly recommended this place for fast and very affordable dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aron Merrell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Erin the hygienist was excellent!  I appreciated the cleaning and expertise.

The office and walls seem to be a little on the older side.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aura Winters
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about my experience! I had a surgery coming up and needed my dental crown taken care of quickly; and my dentist went above and beyond to make it happen. Not only did they fit me in on short notice, but they made sure everything was done with care, precision, and compassion. The crown feels perfect, and I left feeling genuinely supported. It's rare to find a provider who’s both skilled and thoughtful, and I’m so grateful to have them in my corner!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krista Clement
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great visit at Round Rock Comfort Dentistry! From the moment I called to schedule an appointment to the check out and everything in between, I had excellent customer service. The person that made my appointment was incredibly helpful in letting me know my options for care and the coverage. She was very kind and patient in explaining how everything works. The staff were super nice and friendly. The dentist explained everything that was happening as it occurred and I left with nice clean teeth and a great experience. Thank you for your great customer service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: erika romero
user_reviews_extended.Description: Coming to Round Rock Comfort Dentistry is always a pleasure!  Dr. Indu is very professional and very understanding to all my dental needs. Ieasha is very polite and  gentle when assisting. Thank you ladies for making my experience at your clinic an amazing one! Will definitely recommend! 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: B B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow! Best dentist office I've ever been to! Very caring and honest people, you can tell they aren't like so many other dentists that are just there to collect your money and they truly want to help their patients. Remarkable staff and management.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leydjenne Carter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience at Round Rock Comfort Dentistry! The staff were incredibly professional, kind, organized and welcoming - a special thanks to Leslie for my cleaning and Erin for her assistance and patience! Dr. Kirupalan was thorough and explained everything clearly - she recommended a custom night guard to preserve my smile (surprisingly, it was affordable)! I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for top-notch dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oliver Marx
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Erin was awesome and made me feel
Super comfortable. Thanks team!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrianna Ramsower
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had my wisdom teeth removed here and the assistant and doctor were absolutely amazing! Dr.Indra kanti was so sweet, kind, and fast!!
She really cared about my comfort and whether I was okay.
I really appreciate all of the staff here for being so attentive to my needs.
I definitely recommend.
I generally have a lot of anxiety when it comes to the dentist, but here that is not the case!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelina De Carlo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful staff from the front desk to the dental staff working on teeth. They did accommodate my needs and made me feel comfortable during the whole process. Iyesha or Ayesha (I'm sorry if I butchered your name spelling) was very pleasant and upbeat. Dr. Indu was very professional and got an extra tooth she didn't have scheduled for that appointment taken care of because it was causing my tongue pain. The lady at the front desk wearing purple today was also very clear and concise with answering my questions with the financing and getting me taken care of promptly. I look forward to coming back for more of my appointments and would highly recommend coming to this dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gettis Ministries
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were compassionate and very detailed about my bridge/crown treatment

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Kinsley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in the worst pain I’ve ever felt! Dr. Indu got me in quick on a 4th of July week! Dr. Indu and her assistant Ieasha were very sweet and quick to get my problem tooth out! Very nice dentist office and very friendly and helpful staff!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tonya Kubecka Crain
user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall experience has been 5-Star! All of the staff--from the receptionist all the way up to the doctors-- are warm, welcoming, caring, compassionate and work with every patient to develop best treatment plan for their dental needs.  And with keeping the patient's budget and insurance coverage in mind.  Additionally, they ensure every patient is comfortable and that every procedure is as pain-free as possible.  I highly recommend RR Comfort Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanderbergh Paiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: It has been a few years since I had been to the dentist. I called to get a filling fix and from the first hello everyone has been super nice and helpful.  Dr. Indumathi Kirupalan and Dustee helped me feel relaxed and comfortable (As best you can at the dentist). They answered all my questions and we came up with a plan that I was happy in. Glad I found it this place and I’m actually looking forward to my checkups.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alejandra Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough great things about my recent dental visit with Dr. Indu and Ieasha! From start to finish, they provided exceptional care and professionalism. I had a root canal, crown, and fillings done, and the entire process was seamless. Ieasha made sure I was comfortable and well-informed every step of the way, while Dr. Indu was incredibly skilled, gentle, and thorough. Their attention to detail and compassionate approach made what could have been a stressful experience completely painless. I left feeling confident in my dental health and grateful for such an outstanding team. Highly recommend—5 stars all the way!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Holston
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great experience. Erin, who performed my dental cleaning, was fantastic. She was thorough and gentle. Dr A was great as well. I had easily one of the best experiences with this dental practice that I've ever had. The office is also nice and clean and the front desk staff is very sweet. You won't be disappointed!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sangeetha Kumar
user_reviews_extended.Description: It is a fantastic experience there. Professional, welcoming and friendly and was immediatly attended too per my appointment time. I like everyone and their treatment too. I highly recomment Dr. Indu and team!! Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ruben Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Do not go to this Dental office. They charged my wife for a deep periodontal cleaning and pinched a nerve. Note, they only did half of the work due to time constraints on their schedule .When we asked for pain medication, they refused. Got a second opinion, and the Periodontal cleaning was done sub par. We will be filing a complaint with our insurance and the ADA.

user_reviews_extended.Name: rich11d1
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office staff were extremely pleasant and informative.  My appointment was timely and the dentist displayed extreme care.  The most pleasant dentist visit I I have ever experienced.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Choate
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here for almost 20 years. Always been trustworthy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frequently Cynical
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had to do something about the continuing decline of mostly the teeth in my jaw.  Yeah, years of neglect.  I am on a Medicare Advantage program which gives me so good dental benefits, so it was time to bite the bullet.

I picked Round Rock Comfort Dentistry for two reasons.  It was close, why drive more than you have to.  And in a modest building and office, so I knew their costs were much lower than those dentist palaces.  Sure enough, other than a one time $50 copay, they have lived with whatever Humana is paying.  I just referred a friend because his dentist was exactly that, paying for a palace.

In my four months of treatment, I found everyone pleasant and competent.  The women at the front desk are treasures.  Wait times for the most part have been minimal.  Of course, the most important question is how was the care?

On my initial visit they did a thorough exam and printed out a suggested course of action.  I'll point out that my previous provider wanted to do a full upper and lower denture thing.  RRCD blew right past this seeing only partials needed.  This allowed me to review the plan, and reprioritized and delete items, and we had to coordinate with annual benefits.   The whole journey to a lower partial appliance was as good as I think it can get.

Only once before in my long life have I found a dentist that I could so recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been going to this office for regular check ups and cleanings for the past 5 years and have always had a very good experience.

Yesterday I had 2 wisdom teeth taken out, which was an unplanned event for that day.  Being the somewhat anxious person that I am, I hesitated on such short notice, but Dr. Kaur put me at ease and assured me we would go at my own pace and comfort level and that it would be a very easy & simple procedure, at least for my case.

I did request the the nitrous oxide, which I had never had before, and that took the edge off of my nervousness. She checked in with me every step of the way for each tooth to make sure I was doing ok.  Overall the entire appointment went much better than I anticipated and I realized my worries were unfounded.

I was give pain medication & antibiotic prescriptions after the appointment as well as aftercare instructions.

It's been less than 24 hours & I've had zero pain and the swelling is already pretty much gone.

Thank you to Dr. Kaur and the assistant for making the entire experience easy and comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Naazcorner
user_reviews_extended.Description: My mom has several health issues and she has also had a hip replacement surgery. After 20+ years the need did arise to go to the dentist and with her insurance plan it is not easy to find a dentist, but this location takes all types of insurances which is awesome! They were amazing about faxing the forms to her PCP to get my moms health information and approval, and they were amazing about getting everything set up or her appointment all within one day. My mom saw Dr. Rashmi Indrakanti and she was outstanding. Took her time and did thorough cleaning, and also filling since my mom had cavities. She did not rush and she was so gentle that my mom was able to get the filling done without needing any numbing shots. Which was awesome. My mom has several lung problems which is why is always scared of doing any type of numbing medications. The staff was also amazing. The nurses were really sweet but need more practice taking x-rays. They took too long and ended up cutting my mom's lip. That wasn't good but the overall experience was still amazing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Pisz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Went in to schedule an appointment. Asked about X-Rays.

It is becoming a trend these days for dentists to require huge amounts of X-Rays, and refuse you service unless you comply. They will tell you that they need them to evaluate you properly. Sure, a few per year.

This office, requires 18 X-Rays for a new patient. I don't even have that many columns of teeth. I've got 14 top and 14 bottom. You don't need one x-ray per tooth. You surely, don't need multiple X-Rays of a single tooth, in a healthy mouth.

6 is a "full set of x-rays" and adequately shows each tooth. one for molars, one centered on canines, and one for the front. Anything beyond that is for profit purposes only. Unless you have an root canal or something that required them to look at roots.

The ADA itself, scorns offices that insist on x-rays, as policy. Instead, x-rays should be taken on the basis of some condition where they are needed. Otherwise, a set every 3 years is adequate.

Not more than a decade ago, dentists were able to do their jobs just fine with 4 X-Rays per year. Did eye sight get worse, world wide? No, greed increased. Dentists offices make most of their money billing insurance for X-Rays.

They'll all give you a song and dance about radiation being lower than a trip on an airplane. Well, they've more than made up for it by increasing the frequency and quantity of your X-Rays.

Each bitewing x ray is around 0.005 mSv of radiation. The panoramic x-ray is double that. Multiply that by 18, and then multiply that by 10 unless they do it perfect, with the best equipment available on the market, every single time. Because 0.005 mSv is what was submitted by the equipment manufacturer, so you can be sure it was under optimal conditions.

There is no amount of ionizing radiation that is "safe." All of it accumulates throughout your lifetime and all of it will give you mouth, thyroid, salivary gland, throat, and brain cancer later on in life. Look at the white papers on the topic yourself. There are plenty finding increased cancer risks, none that concluded dental x-rays are "safe."

Stand up for yourself. Find a dentist that will operate on 8 X-Rays or less for new patients, and less than 6 per year after that, unless you have some pre-existing damage that actually needs to be looked at. then by all means, take a look. One for molars, one for canines, and one for the front. That's all they need for a regular checkup. The ADA knows it, dental schools know it, so why have a policy otherwise?

They are out there. I found one within 5 minutes of calling around. There is no reason to expose a healthy mouth to that much radiation, except for the sake of billing the insurance for extra profit.

user_reviews.Name: Alder Gonzalez
user_reviews.Description:
I recently visited this dentistry after a few family members highly recommended it to me, and I can honestly say they were right it was absolutely worth the 5-hour drive! From the very start, my experience was great. The woman I spoke with over the phone, believe her name was Suzette was so kind and helpful.She really made scheduling and getting everything set up super easy, which I appreciated a lot.When I got there, Dr. Strong and his assistant Emily were both so friendly and made me feel really comfortable during my procedure. I've had some bad experiences at other dental offices in the past, so I was pretty nervous going in, but they made me feel completely at ease and took great care of me.Dr. Nguyen did an amazing job putting on my crown she checked on me throughout the whole process and made sure I was comfortable every step of the way. She had such a positive attitude and really made the experience smooth and stress-free.The front desk team was just as great! Nayeli was super communicative and had such a positive attitude while going over my estimate, and the manager, Nely, made sure everything went smoothly with my insurance so l didn't have to worry about anything.
Over all, I couldn't be happier with my visit. Everyone was so kind, professional, and genuine. You can really tell they care about their patients. I'm so glad I made the trip I definitely found my new go-to dental office!

user_reviews.Name: itzel olalde
user_reviews.Description: I went in for my appointment today at Round Rock Dentistry! I was a little nervous going in because I don’t trust a lot of doctors but as soon as I walked in, I was greeted by this super sweet girl at the front desk Nayely! She noticed I was nervous and she was super patient with me! I had the pleasure of being treated by Dr. Nguyen today! She was able to answer all of my questions and very kindly proceeded with my treatment! I have nothing but amazing comments to say about my doctor! I will 100% recommend to all of my family and friends!!

user_reviews.Description: I had a really good experience at Round Rock Modern Dentistry.  I have been going there for years.  The Drs. and staff are all very friendly.  I am very busy so it is hard for me to come in.  I love that I was able to get my fillings the same day as my cleaning.

user_reviews.Name: Sarah A
user_reviews.Description: I absolutely love this dentist! Everyone is incredibly kind and patient throughout the entire process. The front desk team is always helpful, welcoming, and super communicative. I was seen by Dr. Liu, who was not only extremely knowledgeable but also so kind and approachable; she answered all my questions and made me feel completely at ease. The whole office treats you like family, and every visit is genuinely comfortable. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: A.B
user_reviews.Description:
The front desk staff was kind and welcoming, and I appreciated that.

I first interacted with the staff member who took my X-rays. She appeared to be in a bad mood, and when I thanked her multiple times during the process, she did not respond at all. That lack of acknowledgment made the visit feel uncomfortable from the start.

The dentist herself, however, seemed warm, nurturing, and genuinely concerned during the exam, which I valued.

Unfortunately, the tone shifted again when the treatment plan was presented. I was quoted $4,792 for scaling and root planing along with localized antibiotic irrigation, laser bacterial reduction, and additional add-ons. My out-of-pocket portion was quoted at $1,285. The plan felt excessive, and I did not feel the necessity of all the add-ons was clearly justified.

There also seemed to be pressure to begin treatment that same day. The two staff members who reviewed the treatment plan came across as aggressive, and the urgency felt more sales-driven than patient-centered. I want to be clear,  I have the financial ability to move forward with treatment. Cost is not the issue. Feeling pressured and taken for granted is.

I sought a second opinion at Clearview Dental and was quoted $1,587 total, with $675 out of pocket, without the additional procedures that were included in the original plan.

A difference of over $3,000 in total cost is significant. Based on both the experience and the dramatic pricing difference, I chose to continue my care elsewhere.

Patients deserve respectful communication, transparency, and time to make informed decisions without pressure.

user_reviews.Name: Maia K
user_reviews.Description: This was my first time in a long time not having a dentist. I was recommended by my job and I loved my first appointment! If you are shy, scared, or worried about the dentist you should come to Dr.Nguyen! She will get you right and you will walk out feeling amazing and educated!

user_reviews.Name: Dillon Cat
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Nguyen has been my dentist for over 5 years now and I only have praise for her skill and technique.  Not only is she competent but she's a fun and lively person with lots of positive vibes. She honestly cares about her patients. She is the ONLY dentist that I know of who gave me her home phone should something need immediate attention. The hygienists  are highly competent as well. I don't know about the other offices in the RRMD network, but I've had nothing but great service here!

user_reviews.Description: Dr. Nguyen, Dr. Liu, Khanh, and the entire staff is incredible! Front desk staff quickly checked me in, and walked me through the entire process for my tooth extraction. They helped me set up a treatment plan and my different payment options I’m eligible for. I will be coming back for continuing care in 3 months!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a great experience at Round Rock Modern Dentistry during my recent visit for deep cleaning and two wisdom tooth extractions. Like many people, I was nervous going in because it had been a couple of years since my last dental visit so I was aware I would need some work done, but the staff doctor Nguyen as well as the assistant Ruby went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable every step of the way.
The front desk team Maddie, Nelly and Suzette were kind and efficient, and got me checked in quickly. The hygienist who did my deep cleaning was gentle, thorough, and explained everything as she went so I understood exactly what was happening. She made sure I was comfortable the whole time, which really helped ease my nerves.
For the extractions, the dentist Dr Nguyen was incredible- professional, reassuring and very skilled. She explained the procedure beforehand, answered my questions, and made sure I was completely numb before starting. The extractions themselves were much faster and smoother than I expected, and felt well cared throughout the process.
What stood out the most to me was the attention to detail and the genuine care from the whole team. After the procedures, they gave me clear instructions for recovery and even checked in to make sure I was doing okay. I felt like they truly cared about my comfort and health,not just getting the job done.
I can honestly say this was the best dental experience I've ever had, if you are looking for a place that's professional, compassionate, and skilled, I highly recommend Round Rock Modern Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adriana Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've always had fears about going to the dentist, especially for a root canal/chipped tooth!!  But this office completely changed that for me from start to finish young girl Lexi that made my appt over the phone and verified my insurance great customer services skills calling me back when I let them know my tooth chipped Yikes, she asked if I was in pain to get me in sooner thank God no pain, other young lady smiling and friendly at check in/ Suzette at check out making sure all went well and even had me laughing with the small talk.   Nelly explaining in thorough my financial portion that is due and when, was well versed on my Dental Plan, gave me time to ask any questions or concerns that I had, reassured me the doctors are great and I was in good hands.  Her smile and small talk relaxed me she even stopped by when I was in the dentist chair checking in on me.  The dentist first time seeing her was amazing, Dr Linh Nguyen her soft touch with the shots are nearly painless you actually don't even feel the sting nor pressure of the needle, her care for the patients is awesome she knew my shot fears and made sure I never saw that needle coming near me. The crown WOW, perfect fit.   My endodontist Brett Strong my fear was gone, and no pain afterwards at all he was gentle and took the time before procedure to see if I had any questions on procedure and during the procedure my infection was deep, he would ask me often if I was ok!!  At one point I was falling asleep lol that's how comfortable this office made me feel.  Last step crown to have it put in same day was amazing.   I will continue going to this office and refer family and friends as it was an AMAZING experience. Thank you all for the SUPERB customer service from start to finish.   Adriana

user_reviews_extended.Name: Funmilade Oladimeji
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very good customer service.
Esther is exceptionally good, she loves her job, hence she does it with enthusiasm. She is very professional, courteous and provides empathetic listening. Esther explained every steps of the procedure, she educates me on how to keep my gum healthier. She is awesome! We need more of her in the clinic for good patient outcome.
Thanks for all you do Esther! I will definitely come back for all my dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Z Peiterbarg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In short, it's so called 'deep cleaning' SCAM place.
Avoid this place at any cost, otherwise expect to loose your time and money.
In more details:
I wanted to make just simple cleaning. According to other reviews, I was aware that this place is trying to sell you procedures that you don't really need,
but this place located very close to my apartment and I was sure that I can stand the pressure and will be able to get what I need.
But it was much worse than I expected!!
Instead of getting simple cleaning with $0 out of pocket, their dentist aggressively tried to convince me that I need $900 cleaning and REFUSED to perform just a simple basic one.
And I know that I don't need what they trying to sell because I visit dentist regularly, I know exactly what is the state of my mouth and no previous dentist suggested to make this super expensive cleaning.
So I spent 2 hours and 1 annual exam from my insurance and didn't get just  basic cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Catherine Scabora
user_reviews_extended.Description: Y'all.  When I say I detest going to the dentist, I mean with every fiber of my being, I HATE going to the dentist. I don't numb on my left side, so they have to drill a hole into my bone to inject the medicine that way. It's terrible. Dr.Nguyen and her team actually listened to me, and heard how anxious I was and made sure that I was taken care of. I had to have a crown but it was quite literally the least stressed I have ever been at the dentist. I will actually keep my next appointment instead of avoiding it. Thank you, Dr.Nguyen!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy Burchett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Liu and Emily were fantastic! Thanks for excellent service and attention. Dr Liu did a great job with deep cleaning. I appreciate how she explained every step and made sure I was comfortable and there was no pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Comstock
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I did not feel this office practices conservative, patient-centered dentistry. I was presented with an expensive treatment plan that included multiple add-on services presented as necessary, but which appear to be optional or unsupported by standard periodontal guidelines.

After reviewing my X-rays and periodontal chart with another provider, I was told my condition was early-to-moderate and did not justify the scope or cost of the treatment proposed here.

Patients should ask detailed questions, request evidence for each recommended service, and strongly consider getting a second opinion before proceeding.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Unnasch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nguyen is a true hero to me!  I came to Round Rock Modern Dentistry after having extreme problems at another practice with another dentist.  When I came to Round Rock Modern Dentistry, I could tell right away that my experience would be better as all the staff were professional, competent and professional.  Thank you so much to Dr. Nguyen and Round Rock Modern Dentistry!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph Bellard
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are the best! Been coming for years. Hi highly recommend Dr.Nguyen and Dr. Liu are amazing at explaining the treatments you need with great details. The manager Nelly is very good at the procedure cost break down for everyone. Very family friendly and great overall 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Mendez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming here for years and I refer friends and family to this dentist office all of the time. The staff is very friendly and helpful with everything you need. Dr. Linh Nguyen is the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: King Kiwi
user_reviews_extended.Description: The experience I had here was nothing short of amazing. I had to fix my crown and the staff here was able to help me right away. They are quick, professional, and made the entire process smooth and stress-free. From the moment I walked in, I felt taken care of. Highly recommend this place for anyone needing quality dental work and outstanding service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: brenda molinar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had such a great experience at Round Rock Modern Dentistry! From the moment I scheduled my appointment to checking in and seeing the dentist, everything went smoothly. My hygienist was incredibly informative and took the time to explain each step throughout the visit, which I really appreciated. The front desk team was so welcoming and made sure to ask how my appointment went when I checked out. I left with my follow-up appointments already scheduled and felt very well taken care of. Highly recommend!

⸻

Let me know if you want it to sound more formal, more casual, or short and sweet!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ana Maya
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nothing but an amazing experience with Dr. Varun Kulkarni and his team.  Everyone in that office is so nice and helpful.  I was really anxious going into this appointment and they were so understanding.  During the procedure they were making me laugh through all the pain.  It was such an amazing experience.  If I could give them more stars I would.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Albert Chang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thanks, Dr. NGUYEN, for the outstanding dental works on recovering my crown as well as the regrowth of the lost bone tissue. All of the staff and professional assistants are very helpful and friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mariana Flener
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Please don’t go to this office.

I can’t speak for the doctors because I never even made it that far. But the front desk staff is completely unprofessional and disorganized. They seriously need customer service training.

I called on Tuesday, July 29th to schedule a root canal for my mom, who is in pain. I had already confirmed with the insurance that Dr. Brett Strong is in-network. They told me I had to send her insurance card and referral with X-rays. I asked if they could request it directly from the dentist’s office—they refused. I emailed everything the same day and was told I’d get a call back. I didn’t.

I followed up multiple times over the next week—at least 8 calls. Each time I got a different answer:
•	They had the documents but couldn’t verify them until Friday
•	The scheduler wasn’t in
•	Then anyone could schedule appointments
•	Then suddenly they said my mom’s insurance wasn’t accepted (even though I reconfirmed it with the insurance provider)

They even told me they couldn’t hear me unless I spoke louder, and then told me not to yell. I stayed calm as long as I could, but after all that—they still denied my mom service.

The last person I spoke to confused the doctor I asked for, made me repeat all my information again, and then said my mom could come—but would have to pay full price.

Update: They finally call me back and said they can schedule my mom after I posted this review. I don’t want their awful service, TY!

This office completely failed to provide care or basic communication. Do better.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Forrest Parton
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Super disappointed with my experience here. I came in for some tooth pain and was seen by the doctor. She was great, and prescribed some antibiotics. That’s where the good service ends. I was told I would receive a treatment plan with pricing so I could schedule the work I need done. Never did, so I went back in two days later and spoke to the girl at the desk and let her know I was still waiting on a treatment plan. She said they would send it by end of day, but all I got was a text to pay almost triple what I was quoted for the visit and no treatment plan ever came thru. I have tried multiple times to call and can never get thru to anyone. Then I get a call from a collections company trying to collect the bill. I am happy to pay what I was told the charge would be prior to seeing me, but I am not gonna pay three times that amount!!! It’s ridiculous that they can’t return a call or answer the phone, but will send me to collections!!! Poor communication, poor billing practices, and zero help planning future services. I won’t be returning, and hope someone from this office and not a collections agency can call me to straighten this up.

Edit: It took me physically going in to speak to someone to straighten this out. Nelly the operations manager was able to fix the issue, and I’m happy they were willing to look into it. Gave them a couple stars back, but can’t get it to 5 as this really could have been solved weeks ago by returning a phone call.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Kim
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been to a few dentists in the area for general cleaning and checkups. Had a bad experience with the last dentist due to price increases on a quote that i was given weeks earlier. Wife has been to RR Modern Dentistry before for work and told me how great Dr. Nguyen was. I made an appt and was seen a few days later. Overall, fantastic experience. Modern equipment. Super friendly staff and clean office. Dr. Nguyen and team were excellent. The best part was that I got a crown put in the same day. Its been a few weeks now since the visit and ive had no issue. I held off on the review to see how it held up. 5 stars, highly recommended Dr. Nguyen and her team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It was a HUGE blessing in disguise to find Round Rock Modern Dentistry. We had been going to the same dentist for 20+ years and he retired. We didn’t want to change providers at that time.  They were cleaning our teeth and not letting us know we had problems beyond basic cleanings.  They stopped taking our insurance so we were forced to find another provider.
I googled dentists that took our insurance and Round Rock Modern Dentistry was 1 of 2. They were close to the house so I said a prayer and made an appt.

My youngest child is deaf so that adds an extra element to things.  I have to sign to make sure he knows what is going on.

I was nervous going in but the front office staff welcomed us and they were so nice.  We were called back and everyone that took care of our son that first visit was wonderful.  They spoke clearly so he could read their lips and used some simple signs he could understand.  The dentist was so nice and good with him I was beyond elated.  The dentist didn’t act rushed and that was a welcome sign too.  It was like a breath of fresh air.

When my turn came everyone was again really wonderful. The dentist said I was in desperate need of having my gums cleaned.  He referred me to their periodontist for a visit. The nice thing was he is at their office on Thursdays so I didn’t have to drive to a different office.  He suggested the care I needed and I elected to proceed.  I immediately started feeling better even as far as my general health.  The gum disease was causing other problems with my health.  The periodontist and his assistant were as wonderful as everyone else was.  I have been nothing but pleased about going to this office for dental work for myself and my family.

Dr. Nguyen is wonderful. She goes out of her way to make us feel that our needs are important. She tries to keep us from having more expensive procedures if she can do something different. She and all the staff take such good care of my son and my husband and I!

Nellie, the office manager is beyond wonderful. She has always been so nice and thoughtful as far as our care and discussing payment and options. Most of the staff know us by name and I feel like family when I’m there.  I tell anyone I can they should come try this office for themselves!

If u are needing to have dental work done and are hesitant about whom to choose, why not give Round Rock Modern Dentistry a try! I did and have been blessed beyond measure!

user_reviews_extended.Name: End Crys
user_reviews_extended.Description: Got my fillings done within less than an hour, everything went smooth, doctors were incredibly nice and coordinated, would definitely recommend Dr. Nguyen

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Murphy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nguyen and her team are fabulous! They are gentle, kind and informative. This is the first dentist that I feel like I can truly trust. I have been a patient here for a little over a year and am hoping to continue coming here for a long time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Chin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Liu took the time to explain everything to me in a way that made me feel informed and comfortable, not rushed. I really appreciated how gentle and thorough they were during my cleaning and check-up. You can tell they genuinely care about their patients and love what they do. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a friendly, no-stress dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesua Calhoun
user_reviews_extended.Description: Linh Nguyen is a great dentist she has done very well in making me feel comfortable before any visit. Love this dentist would recommend to any one wanting to come for dental work

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor N. Rains
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time returning to the dentist since covid times so I was quite anxious going into the appointment but had a great experience. Dr Liu and Kathy both had great bedside manner! Will definitely be returning for routine exams and cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Quyen Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the most amazing experience with Dr. Linh Nguyen and Round Rock Modern Dentistry. The atmosphere was inviting and the staff are so friendly in the front office and back office. They explained everything perfectly and answered all of my questions. I felt as if they cared about me as an individual person and not just a patient in their chair. I appreciated that the front desk explained my insurance benefits so I wasn't surprised about my bill. I would definitely recommend Round Rock Modern Dentistry for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Schwartz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was very friendly.  Dr Strong did an excellent job on my root canal.

user_reviews_extended.Name: tbh kbh
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Nguyen is the best doctor at Round Rock Modern Dentistry! Highly recommend scheduling any and all appointments with her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charles Stair
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've had a lot of dental work in my life and Round Rock Modern Dentistry has earned my loyalty. They're professional, efficient, kind and compassionate. Dr. Linh Nguyen has been my dentist for several years now and is simply the best. She's extremely thorough, knowledgeable, skilled, and easy to talk with. She truly cares and someone I consider a friend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sravan Kumar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been visiting Round Modern Dentistry for three years. The service used to be good, and the providers were excellent. However, this year’s experience has been disappointing. During my recent general checkup, they changed my provider without any prior notice. After the inspection, they mentioned that I had very light black spots on my teeth that required filling. They informed me that, after insurance coverage, my out-of-pocket cost would be only $19.20.

Trusting their estimate, I agreed to proceed with the treatment. A week before the service, they updated my insurance information. On the day of the treatment, they collected the $19.20 as stated. However, a few days later, I started receiving unexpected bills. When I contacted the clinic to clarify, they claimed that my insurance didn’t cover the full amount and insisted I work with my insurance provider to resolve it.

My concern is why they quoted $19.20 as my total cost if they were uncertain about the insurance coverage. Despite multiple follow-ups, I never received a proper explanation or resolution. Every time I called, I was promised a callback, which never happened. This has been extremely frustrating and a complete waste of my time.

It genuinely feels like they are engaging in unethical billing practices. Due to this experience, I am revising my rating to 1 star.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisaleigh10
user_reviews_extended.Description: My insurance put THEM AS primary and they booked me and waited until I took a half day at work and showed up to cancel my appointment. I've gone here in the 3 years past with my entire family on a PPO, but switched to DHMO as my benefit costs went up, we've had problems with the front and other staff trying to upcharge us so I stopped going last year, but I need a cleaning badly &  my Insurance as of last week told me they were my primary so I went back for another round of horrible service. Never again! They waited for me to show up to tell me they couldn't see me...probably saved me alot of unnecessary upcharges plus I wanted cosmetic and whitening. I'll go elsewhere to spend my money. EDIT called my insurance company & they confirmed they spoke with & confirmed I was indeed their primary, and office still wouldn't see me because they are not taking any "new patients" on DHMO. I'm happy though, I really didn't want to go there & they gave me other options & I let Cigna know they refused their insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melva Mollohan
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was painful..the assistant Sylvia was Rude and loud..shouting in my ear calling her coworkers..I felt pain..im considering not going back..it was a Bad Experience..

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If I could give them zero stars, I would. They are the worst dentist I've ever been to. They tried to quote my husband and I $700 for a cleaning WITH insurance and tried to say we both had the same issues with our teeth which is completely false after seeing a different dentist. When they charged me for my son's cavities they over charged me by double than that it was supposed to be and I had to be the one to show them my explanation of benefits and get over half of it refunded. I wouldn't trust them at all, they are super shady. Do yourself a favor and go somewhere else.

I have no interest in discussing how you can be better. I stated my issues with the clinic and you can address that with your staff.  I corresponded with the dentist I was seeing and tried to see if we could go a cheaper route to keep me as a customer and she made it very clear that wasn't going to happen. I don't know what speaking to me would help with, I would speak with the staff there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bianca Charles
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love round rock modern dentistry. The staff are pleasant. The specialists are very knowledgeable and talk with you throughout the procedure. They make you feel very comfortable. The check and check in out process are always so quick. This will be my home dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Nicole
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love working with Dr. Nguyen. I have had some really bad, dishonest and money hungry dentists in the past. Dr. Nguyen takes most insurances, even my not-so-great plan. She is very personable, thorough and professional. I have been recommending her to my friends and family. I am someone who’s had to have a lot of dental work over the years and I can always trust her to help.

user_reviews_extended.Name: MaryJane MJ Ashmore
user_reviews_extended.Description: Can’t say enough positive things about Round Rock Modern Dentistry. I had to experience a couple of not-so-good Dentists/clinics experiences before finding this top notch group. Dr. Liu, Sai, Nayley and the front desk receptionist were outstanding. I’ve had two appointments and they are consistently professional, thorough with communication regarding insurance coverage, scheduling and tend to be on the conservative side which I appreciate. I’m a happy patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nichole Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went for a cleaning today and Christy was the one who helped me out. I have to say it has been a very long time since I’ve had someone be so thorough and meticulous about the whole process. Usually people rush thru it to get you in and out but I had to give her a shout out for doing such a phenomenal job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Ardoin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Place was great for a while but a couple weeks ago I was recommended a night guard even though I know I don’t grind my teeth. Unfortunately I agreed and was charged 350$ on the spot. I had to call them for 3-5 days to get the mouth guard after it had come in.

When I picked it up. It didn’t fit right so they filed it to make it fit better all the while giggling in front of me. Front desk staff is lost half the time and the assistants have no idea what they are doing. I won’t be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going here the last 10 years. Seen a variety of different dentists since then. I had paid a lot to get some work done they suggested in the past. Every visit it just seems like they offer less and want more money. Not sure how the average American can even hope to afford the work suggested. Anyways they are good for regular cleanings but if you need work done be prepared to pay top dollar or maybe seek a clinic thay can offer more than just a credit card to put you thousands in debt.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Kanode
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First time Patient.
Had a bad tooth emergency, went to the ER and was told I needed to see a dentist. My sister had high praises for the entire staff and made a call on my behalf. I was amazed when they said could fit me in asap. One tooth extraction, and  maybe an hour and a half later I was pain free. From reception to my dentist, everyone was polite, welcoming and dang good at what they do. As someone with a real fear/issue with dentists, they were perfect. That’s not something I ever say in reviews. High praises to this amazing staff!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Holleran
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had an amazing experience here as a new patient today! The whole process was smooth, and I left feeling great about my teeth. Dr. Nguyen is so kind and easy to talk to, and everyone that works here is friendly and helpful! Very glad that I found an awesome new dentist so close to my house!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Latif
user_reviews_extended.Description: BEWARE!  This place is terrible.  Went in for my normal checkup and cleaning.  I got X-rays and apparently a CT scan.  The CT was not covered by insurance, but they failed to tell me that.  They just run you through the X-ray procedure like they do at all dentist offices.  Thought I would get a cleaning, but when checking my teeth was told I need a deep cleaning and it was gonna cost 880 dollars.  I said no thank you.  They said they couldn't clean my teeth because insurance wouldn't cover if I need deep cleaning.  They then told me I had to pay 44 dollars for the visit.  I pushed back, Ive never paid for preventative care as it is usually covered 100%.  They said they'd just bill insurance.  I got my EOB and Im on the hook for 280.40.  Total rip off.  This place is shady and pathetic.  Very dishonest.  Go here only if you enjoy being ripped off.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Ohaechesi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at Round Rock Modern Dentistry. Everyone who works here is so kind and caring! My dental hygienist Esther was AMAZING! She did such a great job at keeping me comfortable & explaining what she was doing so I felt in the loop during my whole appointment. Dr. Wang was so nice & very informative!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Archer
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family has been with Modern dentistry for 6 years. We love the staff. They've been so good about working with our insurance and correcting claims as needed. They've also been really great about working with last minute rescheduling. The dental hygenists are thorough and identify issues on the spot. Dr. Nguyen is fantastic! She so knowledgeable and truly cares about her patients. I highly recommend Modern Denistry in Round Rock.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Domel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had ok experience here but the front desk people are helpless and useless.  Couldn’t check in for me said I had to do it online.  Rude.  Cancelled my appointment on a different occasion with only one phone call a few days prior.  I recommend you find a dentist with excellent and not just ok customer service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis A. Rios
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was very respectful and kind. They were very welcoming when I entered the office. There was very little wait time and I was taken care of fast. The front desk lady (Nelly) did a fantastic job getting my information and explaining the payment plan. I was in a good environment. I felt very comfortable being there. The dental assistant did a good job taking x-rays. She explained the process before performing them. Dr. Nguyen came in with a big smile which enlightened the mood of me being nervous. My procedure made me feel kinda scared but she made me feel the opposite. Overall this is the best dental office I’ve been too coming from another city.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Want to take this moment to say that Dr. Nguyen was awesome Dentist, also Nelly Villafranca for being Súper patient with me…..really recommend RoundRock Modern Dentistry. The hospitality was amazing and everyone was very professional. Thank you Dr. Nguyen once again! Will definitely keep coming back!!!! See y’all soon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I usually get super anxious at the dentist office but I recently had a wonderful experience at Round Rock Modern Dentistry and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for exceptional dental care.

Dr. Nguyen was fantastic. She was friendly, knowledgeable, and took the time to listen to my concerns.

I left feeling confident in my teeth and grateful to have found such a great dentist. 5/5

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Do not do business here. Do not trust RRMD with your dental care.  I had come here for many years (6+) and was content with service and price but the last 3 years I have seen it fall off drastically.  There is a revolving door of dentists here for a reason. It is clearly a temporary stop until they can find something better. The front desk receptionist is unprofessional to the point of being rude. Save your time and money.  Find a professionally run dentist office who care more for patients needs.   Good Luck RRMD... I hope you get it figured it out before everyone else does.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ronnie Rocha
user_reviews_extended.Description: Esther was great made me feel comfortable. In a few words, it was a great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LGT Assistant
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr nyugen is an outstanding Doctor. Christy Devon can clean some teeth she is amazing. Ester Gonzalez’s and Krystal are phenomenal assistants. Dr chui the best oral surgeon in the Austin area!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Leese
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Cainsford is absolutely wonderful! She explains everything super thoroughly and is always willing to answer questions. I have a needle phobia and she went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable during my filling procedure.

EDIT March 2025: I have now been using this dentist office for two years, and have also had checkups and treatment with Dr. Nguyen. She is the fastest and most precise dentist I've ever had! Would literally trust her with my life.

Also, the receptionists and support staff are lovely. When I got my checkup/cleaning the other day, I informed them I had an important meeting to attend right after, and they got me in and out in half an hour.

Finally, their pricing for nightguards is surprisingly affordable. I paid about half what I expected for a custom nightguard.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valeria Duffield
user_reviews_extended.Description: Haven’t been to a dentist in over 15 years. I finally got some good insurance and knew it was time to go. Always have had dentist anxiety but everyone was super nice and comforting. I can’t wait to continue my treatments

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Upson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have nothing but positive words for Dr. Nguyen and the care she's provided me at Round Rock Modern Dentistry. As life has brought challenges and changes, she has listened to my dental concerns; provided quick and comfortable treatment; complimented me when my progress has been positive; and kept me informed of ways to improve and maintain my care. She is gentle, peaceful and kind - and with each visit, I know that I am in good hands and cared for :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Geick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Do not do business here. The dentists are very rude. All they see in your mouth is dollar signs. When asked why I hadn't gotten the crown REPLACEMENT I was told I needed, I let them know I did not have 1000 dollars. The dentist huffed and stood up and walked out of the room. He didn't even do my oral exam. They change your appointment time and leave you a voice mail and without confirmation. So when you show up to your original appointment time they say you missed your appointment. Save your money and time and go to a dentist who actually cares to about their patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lee Ann Dublin
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I walked in the door I was greeted with a smile and felt right at home. All of the staff from the front to the back were professional and answered all my questions.  Nelly the office manager took the time to explain all my benefits and pricing, providing me with the best options possible.  This was the easiest dental visit I have had in a long time. Dr. Nguyen was extremely nice, and made me feel very comfortable. I am glad I have chosen them as my new dental provider.  If you are wanting a friendly easy experience at the dental office I would recommend visiting Round Rock Modern Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trista Richmond
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this dentist for yearsss and let me tell you the staff is amazing, the absolute best office person is Nelly. She’s a busy woman but if you can get a hold of her she’s the one to talk to. And as for doctors, Dr.Nguyen is the most hard working amazing dentist you will ever get! She’s so honest and caring for her patients! She is also a very busy woman but definitely puts in the time and effort.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Hall-Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: After my husband had a positive experience with Round Rock Modern Dentistry, I decided to make an appointment for myself. I was very impressed with the x-ray technology and high quality dental photos. Dr. Nguyen and staff were caring and took their time. I've never been asked before if I was pleased with the results of my teeth cleaning, which I appreciated. Also the prices seem were surprisingly affordable. Great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariel Hodges
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Round Rock Modern Dentistry recently and I was very impressed with the office and it's staff. The check-in process was seamless thanks to Audrey. My x-rays were done very well and Diana was super nice and accommodating! I was very impressed with Dr. Nguyen and she explained everything clearly and was very professional. Very clean office and good selection of songs playing! 10/10 recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ty Nugent
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my first review for anything. I just wanted to say Dr. Nguyen is a pro. She is very good at what she does. I was expecting some pain for my procedure, but Dr. Nguyen made it painless and finished in shorter time than I expected. I would highly recommend her to my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist in  town moved from out of state  need come work done l. Got me in best experience with the dentist I’ve had thanks Linh Nguyen, DMD and her assistance were amazing work and taking care of my teeth thanks again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dental office that I have ever been to. I've been a patient for a little over a year & Dr. Megens has taken very good care of my teeth. Not only is he thorough, he's very gentle. I got 2 fillings done this morning & I didn't even feel the needle. Give the is place a try! You won't be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ashley
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was my first time going here today, and it was a very pleasant experience! The staff were all very kind and social. I felt comfortable during the whole appointment. I had a cleaning done by Dr. Nguyen which did not hurt and was very gentle. My past dental offices were quite rough with the cleaning but it was very different here. Would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: LIFE's POET
user_reviews_extended.Description: She's very nice, sweet and straightforward.  Love it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Len Cilliers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly, warm environment. Dr. Linh Nguyen and her expert assistants and hygienist did a terrific job. I had a root canal done by Brett Strong, an Endodontist, and a new crown by dr Linh. All in all the work done on my teeth was expertly done with the minimum of fuss.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Barho
user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone who experiences so much anxiety around going to the dentist, this place truly is helping me get over my fear and gives an experience that’s not only not negative, but actively positive. The people working the front desk were helpful and efficient, the x-ray tech made me laugh, as did my dentist. Dr. Nguyen made sure I was comfortable and did her best to be careful with things that make me nervous and checked in on me consistently. Overall a super accommodating place that I happily drive over an hour to visit when I need my cleanings done, because it’s a place I can rely on!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Derek Irish
user_reviews_extended.Description: The overwhelming positive reviews led me to choose Round Rock Modern Dentistry for a much-needed root canal.  My experience thus far has been impressive, and I'm glad I chose to have my procedures done here.  Nelly & the rest of the front office were friendly and knowledgeable, and clearly explained pricing & documents.  Dr. Nguyen and Dr. Strong were both kind & highly skilled.  Priscilla made sure I was comfortable, explained the procedures, and made sure any questions I had were answered.  I'll continue booking appointments here; they're a great team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mia Alvarado
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are always welcome and greet me with a positive attitude. They make me feel comfortable, and nothing is rushed nor do they ever make me feel rushed. They’re very sanitary and keep everything organized. They work around my schedule, and always give me reminders when my upcoming appointment is near.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather House
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Megens is the guy you want to go to every single time! He's an amazing dentist and honestly if I have my way, my family will stick with him as our dentist for life! Also, I Love this practice. They take great care of you and are beyond professional and efficient. Prices are excellent. They work well with you too. So glad we met this team and happy all the way around with the services offered/rendered.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Neomi O'Hara
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hygienist Maria Esther is the best hygienist I’ve ever had. She is well experienced, efficient, & gentle. She truly cares for her patients’ well being.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Rios
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was anxious coming into my visit being that I hadn't been to a dentist in a couple of years. But I was put at ease with how smooth and quick my cleaning went. Dr. Nguyen answered the questions I had and was very thorough with her work. I also liked how professional Suzette and Nelly were at the front desk. I really felt like my needs were taken care of and I would recommend this office for anyone looking.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Herwitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team who cared for my wife and myself communicated well, we're kind, professional, and I would recommend them. Dr.Nguyen and Emily did an excellent job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sparkle & Shine
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely love this business and Dr. Megans, Professional and friendly. I have received 4 of the 5 crowns needed and although going to the dentist is not my favorite thing to do, they take good care of you and are genuinely interested in your comfort while receiving care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very positive experience with this dental office. The front desk ladies were personable and kept my appointments and billing straight.  I enjoyed talking with them each time. Dr Rhodes and I had really cool, surface conversation each time I was there and I really enjoyed him as a person.  Dr Nguyen took over for him after he relocated to another office.  She was super caring and even took an issue I was having home with her to figure out how to best approach the problem I was having with a post for an implant.  This really meant a lot to me because I recognize this "extra mile" was not something she was required to invest time on. She worked hard and even solicited another dentist to ensure that I got exactly what I needed.  After figuring  out the best approach she even ordered the needed part and never charged me for any of this additional effort or the item she ordered. I discovered just how caring she was by listening to how important it is that her patients are satisfied with her AND her work. I had several appointments with her and grew to appreciate her as a professional dentist and as a caring human being.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hiba Burhan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Poor communication and waste of time! Dr Linh keeps pushing on doing ( deep cleaning) even though  I brought to her my history record from my previous clinic that proves  I already did my deep cleaning. They waste my time!! Two months for waiting for my normal routine cleaning! Two months for nothing! Its totally unprofessional clinic! I am very disappointed that I waited all that time for nothing. There is no way I’m coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Sitton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Getting a crown can be nerve-wracking, but I was in great hands.  Doctor Liu and nurse Sai made the procedure so comfortable.  Pain-free dental work is the best kind of dental work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Legh L
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had nothing but great experiences every time I and my family visit RR Modern Dentistry! Everyone is extremely courteous, polite and professional. Dr. Nguyen is an awesome dentist and goes above-and-beyond scheduling me in, even at the last minute—thank you! Nayely Is the best assistant, always makes me feel at ease and is extremely warm and professional. She gets the job done and time-flies when she’s working because she’s extremely personable and has awesome energy!! Thank you all for your excellent care 💜!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Henry King
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are the best! Always nice and they really care about the patient. I started coming here years ago after not taking care of my teeth well enough. They created a plan and took care of me, and now I look forward to my 6-month cleaning and a nice chat with my doctor! Highly recommended

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elle Lynn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff! I've been coming here for years and shouldn't trust anyone else with my dental health. Dr. Nguyen, Megens, and  Strong are patient, knowledgeable, and prioritize patient comfort. Nelly and Suzette make checkin and billing a breeze with their helpful attitude and friendly smiles. Love this place and will come back for many more years. 💚

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taryn J
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely LOVE Round Rock Modern Dentistry. My fiancé and I recently visited the office to start back up getting our cleanings done, seeing that we hadn’t been in a couple years. All of the staff helped us out every step of the way! Dr. Nguyen was amazing, not only did she properly educate us on our dental hygiene but she also made us feel so comfortable. The ladies at the front desk were so helpful! Especially when it came down so doing the digital paperwork. Nelly was able to explain exactly what we needed to do. Our hygienist was super funny and got our cleanings done quick. I’m making this office our permanent dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tim K
user_reviews_extended.Description: By far the best dentist I've been to. Very professional and friendly. I've had several crowns and an implant and have had good experiences with them all. They really care about making everything look and feel great. Their crowns are made in house so you don't have to wait days for some 3rd party to ship them. For my implant, the process had several stages, which were explained up front, and due to that level of attention, my implant looks great (no purple gums whatsoever that you see from a lot of other implants). Dr. Nguyen and her team did an awesome job! Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aubrey Santos
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Linh Nguyen, DMD. After a long search of a dentist where I’ll feel safe and comfortable with, I finally found one. She cares for her patients and listens to them.  The staff are equally great as well from the front desk to the techs! Been a patient for almost 3 years now and still loving it

user_reviews_extended.Name: Belinda Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with everyone in the office. Dr. Nguyen did an amazing job and the assistant Roger was so sweet and nice. The lady at the front desk (sorry I didn't get her name) was so welcoming and nice. Everyone seemed to care about your needs and made you feel welcome and comfortable.  I would refer them to anyone. Thank you for everything.

user_reviews_extended.Name: thuy Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am been coming to Round Rock Modern Dentistry for a few years now. They have been taken cared of me with my root canal, extractions and cleanings. I have been extremely satisfied my experience there. The doctors are knowledgeable and gentle. The check in process with front desk staff was swift and easy.  I would definitely recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristy Denison
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office has been absolutely awful to deal with. They charged my son way more on both occasions of having dental work done and required the money up front. When I got my EOB from my insurance, it was clear we were owed money back. They gave him money back from the first but on the 2nd transaction after numerous calls and the receptionist saying they will call me back, I have never gotten a call back or the money back. Disgraceful. If I have an EOB in hand saying exactly what I knew because my insurance company lines out what is and isn’t covered and they won’t give us our money back. Wow just wow!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savannah
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Round Rock Modern dentistry was overwhelmingly positive. I recommend this office to all my friends and family, and have received quality work and timely responses every time. Dr. Nguyen is such an excellent dentist and her team and Daisy were really helpful to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kairiduke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Definitely recommend this place with Linh Nguyen as your doctor! She always makes me feel welcomed and has a great attitude that keeps the atmosphere comfortable. She constantly asks if I’m okay or if there’s any pain to ensure you’re comfortable the entire time. Best place I’ve been to so far. The staff is great and friendly and always inviting.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joey Saladino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round Rock Modern Dentistry has by far the best staff I’ve ever met. Nelly and Alicia in the front will always greet you with a smile and a warm welcome, making you feel comfortable in the office whether it’s your first time there or as a returning patient.
