The dental assistants Nayely and Diana are always polite friendly, and make you feel like your dental concerns are really being addressed. The hygienist Nicole is by far the most cheerful person I’ve ever met. Whether you’re having a great day or an awful day, she’s sure to make you laugh at least once during your visit. And last but certainly not least, the dentists Dr. Nguyen and Dr. Rhodes provide the best dentistry I’ve ever seen. They consistently show genuine compassion and care for their patients, making you feel more like family than just another customer. If you’re considering this office for any kind of dental work, I cannot recommend it enough. The entire staff is incredible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sabrina B
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the receptionist to the dentist, this team is wonderful. Dr. Nguyen gave me great tips for maintaining my dental health and took the time to hear my dental concerns and show that she was sensitive to those concerns. When performing my cleaning, extra care was taken with my permanent retainers which I greatly appreciated. After having a bad experience with a different dentist’s office a few years ago, I’ve now found a dentist that I feel I can trust.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lee Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don't ever write a review on anything unless if it is really good or really bad.
I took my wife to Round Rock Modern Dentistry today to get her molar looked at because she was having pain. They did the x-ray and told her she have a cavity and needs root canal. They gave her a cost estimate and it came to $3020 out of pocket. We discussed it and wanted to get a 2nd opinion of the cost. They tried to get us to go with them by saying no other dental practice will do this and the next appointment this office will have is in July and other stuff (Just trying to scare us into doing it today).
We came home and checked the charge schedule the insurance company has avilable for us, which tells you how much you will pay out of pocket after whatever the insurance will pay. when we compared what this dental practice charged us to what the insurance company has assigned for us to pay, the dental practice overcharged us by $1391. of course we are not going to go with them to get my wife's tooth fixed.
My wife also mentioned that the dentist did not even spend much time with her to find out what is going on or even ask about the pain, but told her that she looked at the x-ray and she need root canal for them and if you can pay the amount, she can fix them today. Will not recommend this dental business (not a service or practice).

user_reviews_extended.Name: PN Lizama
user_reviews_extended.Description: Convenient location in RR. Front desk is always nice. Dr. Nguyen is great and personable. Her assistant Tiffany is also pleasant every time. Love that they use an app you can see your appointments and schedule if you want. Recommend if you’re looking for a dentist in RR.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clarisa Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just got my first cleaning and exam here and I'm really pleased. Super clean and safe office! Little to no wait, excellent care. The front lady Nelly made me feel so comfortable and explained my treatment plan in detail. For sure referring my family and friends to visit this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Cardenas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience with Dr. Nguyen, she is a wonderful doctor. However, the receipt I received for the flouride treatment was not sufficient for my Health Equity account. They did not accept it. I tried calling and couldn’t get anyone to answer the phone at different days different times, much else get an itemized  receipt for the fluoride. Needless to say I will not be getting any fluoride treatment paid out of pocket in the future. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mel Rumsey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff here is awesome. I just had a great experience with Nicole the dental hygienist. She kept me laughing the whole time. Now that I think about it that was a great tactic to get me keep my mouth open.
This was also my first time with Dr. Rhodes. He was kind and attentive to my concerns.

Thanks for the good experience y'all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Quinn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am TERRIFIED of the dentist and I had not gone for 5 years. But I had some dental issues and had to go. Round Rock Modern Dentistry was so cool to me about everything. Dr. Rhodes was super great and made me feel super comfortable. They are super flexible with scheduling and transparent with payment. They really care and they really give you the health care you need. Joey, the receptionist is great as well. He is always so helpful with scheduling and they are super flexible and try to be understanding. Roger was super great as well!!! He is the assistant and I was super scared on my first visit and Dr. Rhodes let me play music and Roger sang with me while they were working on my mouth. This place is amazing. 20 out of 10 would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best experience I've had at the dentist since I was a kid! Dr. Rhodes explained my treatment wonderfully and was able to get 3 of my fillings done in the first visit! My Hygienist Nicole did an amazing job cleaning my teeth, she was quick and made sure that I was 100% comfortable! Best dental team EVER! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judy Wayman
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I are rather new clients of Round Rock Modern Dentistry, a member of Smile Generations company.  A friend recommended them and now we know why.  The team is friendly and gracious.  The work done is professional, using modern equipment and tools.  I went in for a cleaning, discovered I needed a crown, and because of Smile Generations annual service event, was offered a special rate.  This is a great place for dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Robrom
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in today and really enjoyed my experience! Emily was super helpful and Dr. Nguyen answered all my questions with ease. They were all very patient with me while I figured things out. My teeth feel great! I’ll definitely be back for my next cleaning

user_reviews_extended.Name: Courtney tuttle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ive been coming here for the past 5 years. Dr. Nguyen has always been the best and treated me super well informing me in detail about whats going on with my mouth. It’s a super sweet and caring environment. 10/10 would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrian Nesbitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: EXCEPTIONAL!!!  I wish I could give more stars!  Everyone was highly professional, answered all my questions from dental work to payment/insurance concerns, and the office is immaculate!  Doctor Nguyen took time with me as a patient explaining her recommendations for me.  I felt like she genuinely cared for what was best for my oral health.  The x-rays and cleanings were done very gently, kindly.  The office staff, particularly Nelly and Shane, went above and beyond for me, handling all my insurance and payment questions.  If you’re in need of a new dentist, you want to go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Good experience, Dr. Khimani was friendly and explained everything well. The only thing that was off-putting was that I had to hold the suction thing in my mouth while she cleaned my teeth, which seemed odd. But other than that it was a great experience and I didn’t have to wait too long to see the dentist. I was also able to schedule an appointment within less than a week. I love that she went through all of my X-rays with me, I’ve never had that experience before. I asked her about my concerns with my teeth being more yellow than normal recently, so she suggested the in office whitening (I’m going to have it done once I can afford it soon). But she was able to scrape off some of the yellow stains, which was wonderful.

Update: when I emailed their office to schedule the in-office teeth whitening, they never called me back. So I called a few days later, sat on hold for 8 minutes, finally someone answered and I told her what I needed. She put me on hold for about 5 minutes, came back and said she couldn’t schedule it but would have someone call me back shortly. Never heard back, so I called their office again the following week. Sat on hold for a few minutes; the person who answered said I must have gotten their answering service the previous week, and that’s why they couldn’t schedule an appointment for me.  So we’ll see how the teeth whitening experience goes…

user_reviews_extended.Name: Thi P Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Khimani and Diana were super sweet and attentive. I have a fairly low pain tolerance and had to stop frequently during the procedure and both were very patient and understanding of my pain during the process. I originally came in for a check-up/routine cleaning but once they found out I had a cavity, they managed to get me in the same hour for a filling. Prices were reasonable (with insurance). Even though I always dread going to the dentist, the team at RR Modern Dentistry made it a comfortable experience. 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aivy Hoang
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nguyen and Sai were wonderful, and they provided great care for my dad during his visit. I understand that conveying dental progress and health information to patients can be challenging, but Dr. Nguyen did an awesome job of keeping us informed and educating us on what the potential next steps could be. I am grateful for the attentive care provided by both Sai and Dr. Nguyen. My dad and I thank you both!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori G.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would recommend round rock Modern dentistry to anyone that is looking for dental work. The entire staff was super nice. Very knowledgeable and super patient. Nelly is so nice and on all of my appointments she is always wiling to help. Every time I come in  I am treated with respect. I can’t say enough about the staff! thanks so much- Suzzette, Nelly and Audrey. I drive almost An hour to come to this office, but I don’t mind it because THEY ARE THE BEST.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cory Springer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The “Dentistry” less than 24hours told said they are not accepting new patients of my insurance even though I had them as my primary Dentist, for over 2 weeks. I had to take a day off work to go to the appointment, so not only have I lost a day of work, I lost the opportunity to fix my teeth.

They showed no remorse or care about it and took no blame. This is gross negligence by the management staff. I would have hated to have had my hopes of finally getting a chance to see a dentist and it be pulled out from under yourself. I’m sure they’re great dentists which is why I choose them but for them to do something like that and have no remorse or care is cruel. I hope they update and who they are accepting new patients from and display it on their website to be very transparent so no one else is blindsided.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in as a new patient and was told I would need a deep cleaning, costing nearly $800. I later called back to schedule a standard cleaning, because that's what *is* covered by my insurance, and was told that I had to do the deep cleaning and they wouldn't schedule anything else. Completely feels like a money grab. The dentist was nice, but the fact my only option for dental care was shelling out hundreds and hundreds of dollars before I could even access the care that is covered by my dental insurance is ridiculous. Doing standard cleanings is the bare minimum I expect from a dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: alisa beyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family and I love going to Modern Dentistry! The attention to detail is spot on especially with Esther Gonzales. She is amazing and very detail oriented in her cleaning, gum checks and all. Customer is friendly and courteous

user_reviews_extended.Name: G Mac
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATE: Everything was going fine until they got me going regularly. Going in today Nicole (the hygeinist) had added on several extra procedures to my cleaning to the tune of $140+ above what my insurance would cover. I had not been aware of this until I had taken time off work and arrived for the appointment. I am in disbelief that they would loose a customer over this...but they did. They said I could cancel my appointment, which I did. Classic bait and switch. I am really at a loss to find any dentist that cares about the customer.

I wanted to leave a note to applaud the hygienist Nicole at Round Rock Modern Dentistry. I hadn't been to the dentist for a number of years and was worried that it would be uncomfortable (on many levels) to get back to a regular dentist habit. I wish I hadn't waited - Nicole did an awesome job on my teeth and made me realize how far dentistry has come. If you're hesitant about getting back into the habit of going to the dentist you should definitely see the folks here, Nicole especially, but the whole staff does an excellent job. No high pressure sales or fear mongering just superior dental service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeanette Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist office experience I have ever had. Both Dr. Nguyen and Esther are so informative and caring, which makes the visit so much more calming. I also appreciate the front desk for their great customer service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you Dr Nguyen for her amazing dedication.  My veneer was broken just when I have an event coming up the next day.  She was able to squeeze me in with her busy schedule of patients.  She removed old veneer, scanned it, milled it and cemented in less  than an hour.  The best part is All done without SHOT with needle and paintless and very comfortable .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adriana Ribeiro
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been seeing Dr. Linh for about 3 years now and I have a phobia of dentists. She is kind, professional and her bedside manner is 10/10. She has fit me in for countless dental emergencies and went above and beyond and provided me with dental cleaning even at the end of the day when her staff had already left for the day. I choose Round Rock Modern Dentistry because of Dr. Linh!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Zamansky
user_reviews_extended.Description:
1) Got very strong feeling that this place makes their profits on 'deep cleaning' - so they strongly will push you to do it when you don't need it. (2 other dentist didn't recommend this procedure).
So if they recommend it - most likely you will just waste your money.
2) Their 'digital x-ray' didn't detect cavities.
3) They don't run predetermination with your insurance.
4) They aggressively convince you to put more expensive crown even if you don't need it.
Bottom line - if you don't have particular reason (like friend or family relative working there), just consider another place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: toy zombie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Careful... I went there one time and i was told the x-rays were free. They gave me a quote on the work i needed done on my teeth.  I setup an appointment but ended up canceling the appointment. 3 months later they are emailing me that my insurance sent me a check for $300 and they want me to forward that check to them??? I explained i never got any work done and was told it was for the x-rays and they were going to contact my insurance to reissue a check to them?. A year later i get a bill that i have a past due balance of $118? I called and was placed on hold for a bit then they hanged up.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhonda Howell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing place! Everyone is kind, patient, knowledgeable, and very professional. Suzette was especially knowledgeable and explained things so well. Dr Strong was very gentle with my 13 year old and made her feel at ease with her procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Spencer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nguyen is great, she's always been friendly and professional.  I've been seeing her for my dental needs since she took over the practice and I couldn't be any happier.  I even had work done by her contract oral surgeon, Dr. Biyati (sp?).  He is great too.  The front office staff has been good to me and the only issues I had was due to my insurance company error.  The front staff was very professional and helpful with everything.  Alicia was very helpful in making sure that the charges were covered by insurance and what was not.  She outlined the exact costs I would pay.  Nelli has been there for a long time too, she's the front office manager and she has always been helpful with my file.  I see some of the negative reviews, and I can say that that doesn't even add up with anything I've ever witnessed.  I am suspicious of those reviews.  As a very picky person for my medical and dental care, I highly recommend Dr. Nguyen and her staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just moved to town and needed to find a dentist to establish care. I am so glad I found RR Modern Dentistry. I have a full time job as well as reserve military obligations, and every time I have a change in my schedule this dentist office is so friendly and efficient when working with me to reschedule. I want to thank the front office for being so patient with people like me who have extremely busy schedules that can change a lot. If I need to I can usually see my dentist the same week. Highly recommend! Thank you RR Modern Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nor B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Esther is a delightful person, cleaning was smooth and well made, I felt like talking to a friend. She's very sweet and helpful. Also front staff is very attentive and informative, if you have any questions about fees and insurance just ask them, they will give you all the info needed in a very polite way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Florinda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an appt on 12-1-2021 with Dr Linh Nguyen. When I arrived for my appointment the front office staff was amazing I was greeted with smiles, checking in was so easy my nervousness was calmed, Suzzette had my insurance verified and she was very informative with everything. My assigned DA was friendly also she made sure to give me every details regarding the X-ray it she made it very comfortable, she walked me to my room and sat with me until the Doctor came I thought that was very sweet of her. Dr Nguyen examine the area of concern in my mouth, she has very good beside manners  also very sweet and educated me on what she needs to do. I’m so impressed with Modern Dentistry and so happy I chose them for my dental clinic, I had a hard time trusting dentists because of the bad experiences I had in the past. I have received the best care and treatment I’m so happy !!!!!!! Thank you Round Rock Modern Dentist🦷❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica Arriaga
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Refused service
Called into customer service last night to get help with temp cap that had falling out explained in detail so they  schedule me an appointment at the office on palm valley.
I had seen another dr at another location the first time. Dr Nguyen came in said she was following state policy and would not work on my issue because another dr started it I explained I would rather see a dr here and she said by state policy dentist don’t work on things other dentist start?? She called her District manager Amina And she said same thing. When I asked for all documentation on policy and my medical records the front desk lady got mad and made a comment that she wished she knew where I worked?? Is this also a threat? No service and get threats?? The whole team came to hear what was going on like a bunch of school girl gossip. The front lady insisted on letting me know then my dates I had medical treatment I gave her where wrong and she was right at this point my response was we are not here to argue who is wrong or right I just need my medical records…never again and do not recommend this place…what a joke

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Huang
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just wanted to express my great gratitude for the way I was treated on my appointment. Dr.Nguyen and Sandra made my dental experience spectacular! I couldn't be more happier with their services. Everyone is so attentive and nice that I would recommend this office to all my peers and family members! Thank you so much to Dr.Nguyen and staff for being so attentive and caring to all my dental needs. If I could give them a 20 star rating I would!

user_reviews_extended.Name: erika zambrano
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had a great experience, and have had an amazing treat meant every time in my appointments. They have a very welcoming environment, and I always feel confortable in the place. Always getting amazing results leaving satisfied.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hana Piwowar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a WONDERFUL experience today at Round Rock Modern Dentistry. I am usually so afraid of the dentist, but I was experiencing some severe pain and needed to make an emergency appointment. Dr. Nguyen did an amazing job at making me feel comfortable and the office staff was so friendly. Can't wait to go back for a cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Day
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely the best dentist I’ve ever been too!
The staff is amazing and truly care.  I got to witness the Dr take time to help a new patient understand the paperwork and make them feel comfortable!  Truly an outstanding place.

This is coming from someone who usually gets anxious at the dental office!

Thanks for everything you all do!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hai Le
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Jason and his staff made me feel comfortable about the implant process when i was very nervous. He took his time to make sure my teeth fit properly with proper bite. Now I have beautiful teeth, my confidence is back and i have no worries about my smile any longer.Dr. Jason and his staff are kind and treated me like family. I couldn’t be more appreciative of the office staff and Dr. Jason’s skill.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Kearsing
user_reviews_extended.Description:
update- TO THOSE LOOKING FOR A DENTIST THAT ACTUALLY CARES TO WORK WITH YOU AND DOES NOT HAVE DECEPTIVE BILLING PRACTICES, FIND ANOTHER DENTIST.

I'm thankful that we called ahead to confirm our appointment and the amount they intended to charge. Elise and Alicia (Ally) were extremely rude and ignorant. The fee schedule they were working from was incomplete and stated so at the top of the sheet. Upon trying to get them to actually do their job they chose to interrupt and be disrespectful. They were attempting to charge adult fees for our child (and yes, on the sheet it discloses the age difference between adult and child, which our child is two (2) years under the adult age limit. They would not tell us the type of cleaning our child was to receive, and upon asking for more clarification Ally hung up. We called back and treated as if we were in the wrong for trying to get a complete picture of the fees they were trying to charge.
DO YOURSELF A FAVOR, DO NOT PATRONIZE ROUND ROCK MODERN DENTISTRY!

update- RESPONSE TO YOUR COMMENT BELOW
If providing outstanding service was actually something you took serious, then the more appropriate approach to handling questions about fees would have been to work with the client. Interrupting and being disrespectful serves no purpose. When I called in you/your staff continued to be rude and interrupted me. I was very pleasant and was trying to work with you to show you were you had made the mistake. I hope others who read this and see your attempt to mitigate the bad exposure don't experience the same results after 4 calls to your office trying to work with you and help you see the correct fees for a minor. After all this, my opinion of your company still remains the same.
TO THOSE LOOKING FOR A DENTIST THAT ACTUALLY CARES TO WORK WITH YOU AND DOES NOT HAVE DECEPTIVE BILLING PRACTICES, FIND ANOTHER DENTIST.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leroy Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nguyen is a solid dentist. I’m sure her other dentist are good as well, but I always go with her because she makes me feel better despite my anxiety and bad nerves about going to the dentist. I highly recommend this place. Her assistants are great as well! In all out very group of people.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Hanson
user_reviews_extended.Description: After not having gone to the dentist in years due to anxiety and depression, this place and its staff were so warm and welcoming from the moment I stepped in. My hygienist Nicole was so lovely and hilarious, she created an amazing atmosphere and made me forget about my nervousness. They are incredibly accommodating and professional, I’ll be a regular as long as I don’t move away :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Waller
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Round Rock Modern Dentistry for about 5-6 years now and I cannot complain! The staff is great - Nicole and Alicia are so nice and helpful! I’ve gotten my cleanings, fills, and wisdoms teeth done here and I am very pleased. They are great to work with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Socip63
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very good and pleasant visit , terrified of shots but Dr. Megens took time to make sure that I was comfortable and not too feel any pain would highly recommend staff is amazing! Dr Nguyen is amazing also followed her from Pflugerville to round rock .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I get a call 20 minutes before I had to leave for my appointment , that I had set over three weeks ago, to verify my insurance. Seems a little last minute… Couldn’t you have done that Thursday or Friday of last week since a lot of people had Monday as a holiday?

I then walk in at my appointment time and there’s no friendly greeting or acknowledgement of my presence. I waited patiently for Them to sort out insurance for the lady in front of me and another person came in after me and they called him over to the side to assist him. I continued to wait after they helped him and finally somebody came out from around the corner to assist me.

I got checked in and waited only a few minutes and was taken back to get x-rays which worked out fine. The x-rays only took 10 minutes maybe 15 at the most. I was then taken back to an exam room where I waited over 30 minutes for anyone to come in.  The hygienist finally came and measured my gums about 10 minutes and then I waited again for the doctor. The doctor came in examined my teeth for about 5-10 minutes Said there was nothing major to worry about and then left.

I sat there not really knowing why no communication like “the hygienist (or whoever)Will be in shortly to clean your teeth.”  My appointment was at 9:45 AM I was at the office at 9:30 and it was already 11 AM. I need to get back to work at this point and It didn’t sound like the hygienist was even remotely done with the patient prior. A woman came in finally from the front desk and said some thing about my insurance was approved, which they told me when I checked in and that there was zero co-pay which they told me when I checked in. As a matter fact the same person told me. At that point I was kind of like how much longer? I’m like I didn’t anticipate us taking this long and that I probably need to go and reschedule.   she’s like I can walk you to the front but I can’t check you out because I have another patient..I’m  like I need to go I’m sorry how much longer is it gonna take? She’s like well don’t worry about checking out we can reschedule and There will be no co-pay on your return.  It’s just that I didn’t want to have to wait even longer for an unnecessary check out.

I don’t feel like I was being overly inpatient but it just seem like nobody was really communicating what was going on or apologizing for how much longer I had to wait. maybe I would’ve been a little more sympathetic If there could’ve been a little more communication. I wanted to like them they had good reviews on Google which is how I ended up choosing them from my insurance. I hate being one of those people!  I just feel like I’ve had better customer service experience even a castle dental who sucked.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leann Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is so amazing! I had been going to another dentist for quite sometime and was never really satisfied with my experiences, but when I came here and saw Dr. Frank it was completely different. He had very good bed-side manner, he was genuine and very trough. The last dentist I went to never took their time with me and it seemed I was just rushed out the door, but here Dr. Frank and his staff went above and beyond to meet my needs and I never felt like "just another patient".  I also love that they do everything out of their office. Meaning, I went in there and found I had 5 cavities and they took care of everything that day. I didn't have to wait for them to have a crown made for me, they do it there in the office. So a process that normally takes a week or more only took 3-4 hours at Modern Dentistry. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone I meet!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Opeyemi Sofolahan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very clean and serene environment.
The staff are nice are courteous.
Dr. Rhodes was so nice and friendly,  he did my cleaning gently and perfectly. I have not had a perfect and smooth dental experience as this. I would give 10 star and highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diana Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family needed a new dentist after 20+ years. I found Round Rock Modern Dentistry was close to our home and decided we would make an appt and see how it goes. From the moment my son and I walked in the front desk staff were so friendly and helpful. When I met Dr. Megens he was absolutely wonderful and a breath of fresh air. He immediately referred me to Dr. Kulkarni the Periodontist. He found I had a severe gum infection and I scheduled surgery with him as soon as I could. Nelly was so wonderful to help us with the finances of the surgery. She was very helpful as to options and explained everything so that I understood it. Dr. Kulkarni and his staff were excellent when I had the surgery. I am on the road to getting my mouth healthy again. I would recommend Round Rock Modern Dentistry to anyone who needs great dental care. I have met all the dentists and find them all to be so wonderful and caring. I give Round Rock Modern Dentistry a 5.0!

user_reviews_extended.Name: HOUMPHANH VILAYSOM
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had my crown done recently. I am so satisfying with the service that I received. All of the staff and doctor are so friendly and performing the job with the latest skill and technology that I have ever seen. I got my crown same visit and it's so perfect. No issue,no adjustment needed after. Will always keep the place in mind for next services in the future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arlen Morlett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently became a patient of Round Rock Modern Dentistry. I honestly had been avoiding going to  the dentist for the past couple of years, since it causes me so much anxiety. However,  I am so glad & relieved I decided to give this dental office a try! Every one from reception, dental assistants (Diane & Sandra), operations Mgr. Shane, and Dr. Lynh Nguyen are absolutely amazing! Dr. Nguyen is a wonderful and patient dentist. It’s obvious that she truly cares about her patients and is a joy to know. I highly recommend this dental office and will be a loyal patient forever!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nguyen is truly an expert in the field. Of course by the time you are needing a dentist, it is good to know that someone as experienced and has knowledgable as she is, to you have a safe feeling that you are in good hands. I will be having appointments set up for both of my sons after this visit and continue treatment. Thank you for service you provide and extra attention to detail and care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mohmin Khan
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the best dental offices with grade a service. I was seen by Dr Nguyen a few months ago for a checkup after a few years of dental neglect, and was given excellent treatment. Today I came in for another regular checkup and was served with the same excellent service by Dr Nguyen as well as her assistant Michelle. I cant recommend this establishment enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pam Mullen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Round Rock Modern Denistry for 2 years and I think it’s a great dentist office!
The front desk staff, Alicia and Joey, are friendly and always helpful. Roger, one of the dental assistants is friendly and helps you to feel comfortable getting dental work done. Dr. Rhodes is kind and understanding and helps you find solutions when you are having problems with your teeth. I highly recommend this dental office! The hygienist is great too!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: STELLA HINOJOSA
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time at a Modern Dentistry, loved the service and my new Dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Shell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I could not be happier with my visit.  They took care of me and made sure to educate me on the processes along the way.  Their staff was friendly and made me feel very comfortable.

Dr. Rhodes was a rockstar.  This was the first dental procedure I've ever had where I wasn't in pain during the procedure itself.  He went above and beyond to ensure I was safe and pain free.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gerald Hamar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
THE BEST! Dr. Ellen Cainsford has the highest possible review from me - I couldn’t imagine better dental care.

She was gentle, extremely detailed, straightforward and honest - I love someone who tells it like it is! The method she uses to give shots is a game changer in reducing pain!

Shots to the roof of your mouth are painful - she used this numbing gel on the front, waited about 3 minutes, then gave the shots - I couldn't feel anything, and then she waited a few minutes - when it was time to give more shots to the roof of my mouth, I couldn't feel a thing! I have had dentists who give you shots and make you feel like jumping and running - with her, not the case at all - she made the part I dreaded the most a cake walk!

I didn’t want to give her a review because she will get too busy to see me - but I am compelled to give her the highest possible reference!

No, I am not a friend or family member - this is just the truth!

Also - kudos to her supporting cast - very friendly and efficient!

Dr. Ellen Cainsford made my dental dreams come true!

Update: Dr. Cainsford went to practice dentistry at a different office - so I had a crown put ion by Dr. Jason Megan’s - he was outstanding!

2 have the best two dentists of my life in a row at the same practice - seems unheard of - it it a testimony to the caliber of dentists that are hired by Round Rock Modern Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: ana acevedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I decided to check them out for their amazing initial exam price. I have been a Dental Assistant for 8yrs. They took a pano X-ray which is essentially used for diagnosing sinuses, wisdom teeth and jaw bone not great for diagnosing cavities or tartar. They did the exam with only that X-ray and said I had no cavities but I needed a deep cleaning. In my mind I was like wow is this a joke? However they still charged the complete $59 even though they didn’t preform a regular cleaning because I needed a “deep cleaning” however everyone was very nice. But I will not be returning due to their poor diagnosis. And they’re very extensive and expensive treatment plans

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryce Vega
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone here was extremely friendly! I felt welcomed by the people in the front when I came in. Nicole did an awesome job cleaning my teeth and somehow kept me entertained the whole time!
I’ve met both Dr Nguyen and Dr Rhodes and they are both the coolest dentists I’ve met

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenn M
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Nguyen is absolutely amazing!!!! She has taken such great care of me!! I am very thankful and blessed for her!!! I have had some extremely bad experiences in the past with other doctors and she has taken such great care of me along with her team!!!! Thank you so much Dr Nguyen and team!!!

Jennifer Moreno

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ovidio Garza
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I walked in the door I felt welcomed and comfortable. Definitely the most pleasant dental visit. Nelly was very informative, Dr. Nguyen was great she explained the process and very gentle. Will be a patient for life and would recommend friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie Freeman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Nguyen is amazing! She is gentle and very detailed! She always exceeds  expectation! Most dentist will do what ever work is needed and then it’s see ya till ya need me again, not Dr Nguyen, she wants to pop her head in and at least say hi even if your in the office for a cleaning. Don’t look any further than Dr. Nguyen for all of your dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexander Botello
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came here for a routine cleaning and had a very smooth experience and everyone I interacted with was very friendly and welcoming.

I’ve had experiences at other places where getting X-rays was highly uncomfortable, but Nayeli was gentle as could be and did a great job.

Nicole, who did my cleaning, also did a great job even though she had to put up with my bad jokes.

Finally, Nelly, the office manager, was a huge help and set me up with an orthodontist appointment when I expressed my interest about Invisalign.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madeline Enriquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in as a new patient and was so nervous. Everyone said hello and welcomed me. Dr. Jason Megen was great. He told me what to expect after discovering I needed to have teeth pulled. He fit me right in, and he kept checking to see if I was ok through the whole process.   I recommend this office wholeheartedly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Logo1356
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to see Dr. Nguyen for over 2 years now and have always had a great experience. They’ve always double checked if I was uncomfortable during procedures and show me the problem before trying to fix it. I don’t think I’d use any other dental professional unless Dr. Nguyen recommends them personally. Thanks for the years of good oral care and fixing my toothaches without trying to force me to do procedures when I’m not ready! Couldn’t be happier with the services by the whole staff, they're not perfect (nobody is), but it’s dang close!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Philip Leung
user_reviews_extended.Description: I made an appointment online on 10/8 for a new patient cleaning. I received a voicemail on 10/19 at 5:30PM stating that they could not verify my insurance and to give the office a phone call. So they sat and waited over a week to tell me they could not verify my insurance. I received an email the next day, 10/20, at 8:45AM stating that because I did not respond with my insurance information and that I scheduled an online appointment as a new patient when I should've scheduled as an existing patient, that they will cancel my appointment. The office closes at 5PM and opens at 8AM on those days, so they gave me 30 minutes of open office time to respond before cancelling my appointment. Additionally, I have been to the Plfugerville location; however, I have never been to the RR location. I called the office and they confirmed that I signed up as a new patient correctly. Due to the time it takes to verify insurance, they could not guarantee it would be verified by my rescheduled appointment for the next day, 10/20, at 8AM. I asked 3x and the receptionist confirmed that she will call me back by COB to confirm whether my insurance has been verified for me to go in for my appointment. It has now been two weeks and I have yet to hear back from the office...

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Quiroga
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing staff! I can proudly brag my dentist and her dental assistant are gorgeous and are gentle and definitely cater to scaredy cats! I will be back to being my smile back and I’ll have to show you before and after pics! I recommend them 100%!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harmony Carroll
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very RUDE & UNPROFESSIONAL PERSONNEL working in their front office. Audrey and Suzette both have been rude since I have tried to schedule an appointment at this office.

My biggest complaint is one this office or the personnel refused to provide upfront cost of the oral surgery I was scheduled to have and I was not going to go through with a procedure without being provided upfront costs and verifying with my insurance. WHO WANTS SURPRISE BILLING?

Next, you MUST fill out information PRIOR to your appointment with the oral surgeon. Cool, they email over the paperwork. It is not through a DocuSign or similar app that allows the user to sign and send over. As a patient who does not have a printer/fax, I could not fill this information via computer. Again, my previous office did not have this issue it’s 2022. Who is sending paperwork to be filled and signed without an application for the client to do so???

I call and let the front office personnel know this and I was told I’d have to come in and fill out the paperwork. The absolute audacity of them to be rude and condescending when I told them I would fill it out and be back AFTER being told the day I wanted to book my appointment was no longer available.

I am at the location and AUDREY brings me paper copies to fill out. Mind you from the time I step in she is rude with a blank stare and says these must be filled out prior to us scheduling the appointment. That is fine. But once I’m told there isn’t any availability until the next month I ask for the oral surgeons other options so I can see if he has an earlier appointment elsewhere. I decide I will be back.

Now, Audrey then tells me to give the BLANK paperwork back that I would need to fill out prior to a future appointment. She does this in a condescending matter and tries to rationalize it because “other patients will need those papers and you aren’t scheduling an appointment so you can’t take those copies”. I came down to this location for this paperwork. It is BLANK. They have an office printer and can print more copies. Just because I’m not scheduling an appointment and will be verifying with other offices if the oral surgeons has a sooner appointment available means I can’t take a BLANK copy of a health questionnaire. Absolutely ridiculous.

She refused to give me the office managers name and contact information but I’ll be back on Monday to file a formal complaint. I cannot believe these front office personnel think they have the authority over patient care and how it should be conducted. I do not see how the doctors allow such unprofessional personnel to represent their office and treat future and existing clients this way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Quang Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend this office. Dr. Linh Nguyen and Emily were personable and exceptionally attentive to details. Throughout my dental procedure, they consistently made sure I was as comfortable and pain-free as possible

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyla Young
user_reviews_extended.Description: An unexpected pain had me stop in for a unscheduled visit.  I was very thankful they were able to fit me in.  Dr. Nguyen was able to identify the source of my pain and treat it.  She gave me a thorough explanation of the possible treatments and the preventative measures I should take.  The overall experience and professionalism was exceptional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mr.L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ruby and Dr. Nguyen assisted me today, real quick and easy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Faria Khimani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great location and very friendly staff. Dr. K was very thorough and took her time in every aspect of my treatment. She answered all my questions and made sure that I understood next steps. She and her staff worked with my busy schedule to get me in promptly. Great service and all around experience, will definitely be returning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: justin gross
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was a patient there not to long ago, by far one of the best experiences I’ve had with dental work. Nicole the hygienist was absolutely phenomenal! Felt zero pressure, and I didn’t have to tell her at all about spots that where sensitive. She was very informative for what she was doing and I walked away knowing that I’ll come back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Laforteza
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve waited to write a review of this place until I went to another dentist for a second opinion. Over two years ago a dentist here (don’t remember her name) did x-rays of my teeth and told me I had EIGHT cavities. I had never even had one in my life so I found this very unlikely. I questioned the dentist and she got extremely defensive and was pushing me to get them taken care of immediately. I turned down all services from them even though everyone kept trying to get me to schedule my next appointment. Fast forward to today where I got x-rays and surprise, not a single cavity. I told the new dentist my story about this place and he was blown away. Said there was not even one spot they wanted to monitor over time!
My problem with this place was because I had a DHMO at the time I believe they were just trying to get money out of my insurance by pretending I needed more work done than just a regular cleaning. Please be careful when you have this type of plan. If they’re suggesting something that doesn’t sit right with you maybe get a second opinion first.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David J
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Linh Nguyen and staff are very courteous and caring. I went in for a regular check up and cleaning, and out of pocket costs were clearly explained to me beforehand. This was by far, the best and most careful/gentle cleaning I’ve had. Office is short staffed due to pandemic but wait time and service were very reasonable!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda From Austin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great practice! Dr. Marcy J. Watson, who works there periodically is a GREAT Periodontist !!! I got a front tooth extracted and a dental implant. Dr. Watson  was sweet, efficient, cheerful and went out of her way to make me comfortable and at ease. I went to Round Rock Modern Dentistry to see her (she travels around) and their staff was outstanding. A day later I was pain free !  Dr Nyugen was a wonderful dentist who followed after the dental implant surgery and was very kind. Make sure to ask what kind of pain killers they are sending you home with and if you want something than ibuprofen, ask for it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeanine Renfro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is so nice. Very easy appointment. Able to fix me up fast.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Collin Rogers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctor Nguyen is my favorite dentist I’ve ever had. She helped me with a crown that had been done by a previous dentist and was very happy with the results. You can tell she has a personal interest in her patients and goes the extra mile.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura C
user_reviews_extended.Description: The hygienist was amazing. The dentist spoke much less this time around, that was a bit unusual. But the hygienist made this visit great. She was patient and communicated everything well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Betsy Barry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist is never a fun thing but the doctors at Round Rock Modern Dentistry are so incredible at making their patients feel comfortable and they are the best docs around for getting you numb while you barely feel it. I would recommend anyone coming here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Realized that the provider I had made an appointment with was not the preferred rate provider at that location for my insurance, so called to cancel. Receptionist said "on no its fine he is accepted by your insurance." I pulled up my price options and determined it was different between providers according to my plan.

I said I would feel more comfortable canceling my appointment and if she could go ahead and see what my insurance would charge because I'm not sure what the dentist would be billing me for.

Her response? "Well honestly ma'am it is not worth my time because that is time consuming." Oh. Ok. So because it's easier for you to tell me everything is good and then charge me whatever you want is better for you. Sure. Ok. Let's definitely cancel that appointment.

Feel like I dodged a bullet on this one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carlos Campos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Linh Nguyen Is very friendly and really awesome. She is very detailed when going over what she recommends and what is needed. Deff recommend her to anyone looking for a dentist. Been seeing her for a few years now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelisa Pope
user_reviews_extended.Description: I finally found an office that I am completely comfortable with!! I’ve struggle with fear from a previous experience and Dr Nguyen has helped me over come that! She is gentle, friendly and goes above and beyond! Her staff is equally fantastic! You won’t be disappointed!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Villafranca
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for over 3 years and I always get the best service. All staff including manager Nelly, Doctor Nguyen are extra friendly and great at what they do. Highly recommended this dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: claudine cooke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Megens and his assistant were excellent.  I was in a great deal of pain after getting a crown in Oct from another dentist.  My husband suggested I get a second opinion from Dr. Megens and I am so glad I did! They were able to get me in quickly. Dr. Megens was able to determine the issues with my crown and recommend a course of treatment to get me out of pain.  Dr. Megens and his assistant made sure I was comfortable and informed during the entire procedure.  After the numbness wore off, I could not believe the difference.. amazing the pain was gone!  Dr. Megens is a very kind, compassionate and knowledgeable dentist that I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aldijana Ajanovic
user_reviews_extended.Description: If I could I would give this place -5 stars I would. The Dentist that did my root canal was so rude. When I called to complain they told me the Dentist that worked on my teeth is no longer there and they could not help me with anything.I paid out of pocket almost over a $1000 dollars.  On top of that I was in pain for almost 5 days after they did work on my teeth. Never offered me anything for pain and when I asked she gave me over the counter ibuprofen. It has been 3 months since I did work with them and I am still having problems with the crown its bleeding nonstop and it does no look right at all. I have done over 5 crowns in my upper mouth at a different dentist office and never had problems like this before.  The only reason I decided to go to them in the first place because my dentist moved and this place was next to my house. Worst mistake ever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kendra Scott
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been seeing Dr. Megens this year and really like him. However, the billing practices of this office are a bit deceptive in my opinion. I noticed a large discrepancy between what I paid for a crown versus what my insurance EOB explained that I should have paid. When I called to clarify, I was told that the ceramic crown that I got in office was not covered by insurance (an upcharge to the standard porcelain crown). This was never properly explained to me in the office or else I would have never opt'd for something that was not covered under my insurance. Especially which such a huge price difference. I was told a note would be placed in my chart to only offer me standard procedures in the future? Whatever that means. Honestly, I am a disappointed that this was my experience. I thought I finally found my dental home and have recommended so many people to them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Holland
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have followed Dr Nguyen around the Central Texas area.. She does amazing work and made it so I could smile again.. Not only is she an amazing Dentist… she is an amazing person!!! The staff at this facility are by far the best… Always polite and accommodating.. I won’t go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly

user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cody Strickland
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The moment I stepped in this office I felt like I had entered heaven. It's been a good 15 or so years since I've been treated like a human at the dentist office. Everyone was friendly and helpful. As others point out, the dentist has a good bedside manner.

Being a new patient, I underwent the standard x-ray and exam. They use digital x-rays here, which sped up the process. The dentist found a few teeth that were starting to decay - due to past cavity fillings that were starting to break down. I thought I would need a few more appointments to get this issue remedied but they were able to do it in a couple hours!

As far as price, they do a good job of delineating what your insurance pays and what you owe out of pocket; it's very transparent.

I can't believe I'm saying this but I can't wait to return to the dentist! Definitely recommend for anyone in the Austin/Round Rock area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenneth Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Normally going to the dentist isn’t an “Oh S__t!!” moment but it was for the first time!!! Somehow they got me in the next day, pulled my tooth. user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Cox

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update:  (RRMD sent me another person x-ray...no surprise again!!! I would give them a zero if I could.  I'm fortunate to have found another Dentist office who was willing to do a FREE x-ray)

So I called RR Modern Dentistry requesting my x-ray to be sent to an oral surgeon. A week past and they failed to send it. So I called a 2nd time, he said sure I will send it, 2 days later still no show. Made a 3rd attempt, spoke to receptionist and asked her to email it to me. I even verified the correct email address, you guessed it "no show". So I left a 4th message stating that I would stop by in the morning.
This morning the receptionist said she sent my x-ray and that it's probably in my spam folder. Well I mentioned that other emails from you guys Don't go into my spam folder, but let me check it on my phone... Not in my spam folder, no surprise there!!

I asked her can I sign a waiver to have my x-ray sent to another dentist. She proceeded to tell me that they don't send records to other doctors and they don't have a form authorizing my record to be forwarded to another doctor. She stated we have a "new policy" now (which started at the time I entered the office) Wow!!! Really...What happened to Honesty!!!....I wonder what the Board of Dentistry would say about that.

I asked, Can you send it to me? She stated it would take a while. I told her I can wait to make sure I get it.....  After receiving it, I decided to get ALL my records.

I had intended to visit them for other dental work, but they blew that... I will NEVER visit or recommend this place.  Spend your $ somewhere else where Professionalism and Honesty is a High Priority!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had been using Smilewell (going on two years) until recently.  I gave my insurance information to their dental office, but she insisted I pay for the services. I gave her the number on the card to call the call center to verify my coverage.  A week later, she asked for the insurance again the day before and cancelled my appointment, not offering to make another one. In the US, we are fortunate to have options.  Thus, I asked Smilewell to close my account because respect matters. Cancelling the appointment was the last straw.- Who is the customer?

user_reviews.Name: Catherine Rice
user_reviews.Description: I could not be happier with my first visit here today, and I am excited to start bringing my family here as well. The office was high-end with the latest technology that made diagnosis easy and smooth. Dr. B was extremely knowledgeable and I appreciate that he speaks to you as an equal, and cares enough to take his time to thoroughly explain to you as detailed as possible. Leah at the front was wonderful, and she worked hard getting my insurance information straightened out. Definitely 5/5 and absolutely recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Megan
user_reviews.Description:
The office itself is high-end, clean, and inviting, with premium rooms that feel more like a luxury space than a typical dental office. The advanced technology they use is impressive and really sets them apart.

What stands out the most is how much my teen son loves coming here, which says a lot. He’s genuinely impressed by the high-tech equipment and always feels at ease with the team.

Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Emre Gezgin
user_reviews.Description: The entire team was genuinely attentive to us in every aspect and throughout the entire process. My wife was generally afraid of the dentist. They were very sensitive about this issue as well. Everything was wonderful. We will definitely consult them again for any issue. We will definitely recommend them to our friends and family.

user_reviews.Name: KJ reviews 2026
user_reviews.Description: It’s been a long time since I have had a cleaning, and I was very nervous as I have permanent retainers and I know I had buildup. I’ve had some scary cleanings in the past and this was the opposite. Everyone was so genuinely nice and approachable; they asked for consent and communicated what they were doing, and they had a lot of fancy tech to diagnose. They offered numbing gel (amazing) and two people cleaned my teeth. They were so efficient it took hardly any time at all, and there was no scary scraping with the pick. Happy to schedule my next cleaning and get back on a regular schedule.

user_reviews.Name: Denice
user_reviews.Description: I enjoyed my experience. I’m a person who doesn’t care for dentist. Everyone was very nice. They talked in a very calm voice. They appreciated you.  They accommodated you with your needs. I will be back to get my dental work done.

user_reviews.Name: Elena Dileo
user_reviews.Description: All Season Dentistry was a very positive experience. All staff and doctors friendly, efficient and professional. Offices also very clean with state of the art equipment. I came to them through a friend and after a bad dental situation. What a difference!!

I really appreciate the quality of care I received and would definitely recommend All Seasons Dentistry to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caleb Ho
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They saved me 2 grand! Other dentist told me I had 5 cavities and needed sealants across my whole mouth even when I just had some local sensitivity. Got a second opinion at All seasons. dentist looked at my xrays and informed me that there was no cavities they could find. They also did new xrays to just to be safe and check.

I ended up just needing a night guard and different toothpaste. Highly recommend and trust them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dora Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can’t say enough good things about All Seasons Dentistry. The staff was incredibly kind and patient. After a bad experience elsewhere where I was told I needed expensive treatment, coming here was such a relief. They were honest, thorough, and confirmed I only needed a regular cleaning. I truly trust them and am so happy I found my dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Willie Morales
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Where to start,  first when you enter the receptionists are very welcoming, they are very responsive to any questions you have. They Also take most Major insurances, but call the office to confirm they take yours before driving down.

Regarding The office it is very modern looking and super clean, the rooms are comfortable, they even have TVs mounted on the ceilings for viewing, also headphones music. Anything to calm your nerves. the equipment is very state of the art, 3d imaging so they can see your teeth in a way that can reveal things you didn’t know existed, like hairline cracks to chipped enamel, etc.  they also do all major dental work from root canal’s, crowns, teeth whitening also dentures and implants (if needed).

The doctors are super informative, they don’t just dive right in, they actually educate you on all aspects regarding your personal dental hygiene. They also take time to set up a plan for your future care which is not necessarily another visit but rather what you can do holistically from vitamins you can take to routine maintenance you yourself can do on for healthier teeth/gums

As a person who doesn’t like dentists because of horrific past experiences (made them aware of it).  I can say this, All seasons dentistry change my perception of a dental office and dentists.  They not only understood my concerns they made sure I felt comfortable and pain free during my visit.  The doctor and his assistant ensured I was numb enough before performing any dental work and they even offer calming gas(aka laughing gas) that smells like bubble gum.  If you’re the type that feels some sort of anxiety about dentists, I’m with you but at this place I did not feel that way one bit.

Simply put I highly recommend you come check out for yourself All Seasons Dentistry in Round Rock.

P.S.  I did not receive discounts or anything for this review this is simply a happy customer with nice fresh clean teeth.  ✌️

Dr. Beerpur took his time explaining and answering any and all questions I had before starting the procedure. Throughout the procedure he made sure I was okay and gave me breaks for comfort. The assistant was super kind and encouraged me through the procedure as well. All 4 teeth came out with little to no pain from the actual extraction.

Would 100% recommend this clinic and I’m really grateful for the staff and doctor who guided me through the procedure.

Six-month follow up (05/27/2025): quick but thorough visit that covered x-ray, cleaning and fluoride treatment. Dr. B did the cleaning, says it gives him more time to check patients’ teeth and make sure they’re okay. I have only praise for this dentist and his practice.

user_reviews.Name: Courtney Thomas
user_reviews.Description: Theresa took my X-rays in the beginning. She was very sweet and made the x-ray portion move quickly. Dr. Megans was great. He completed my exam very quickly and painlessly. He offered advice to prevent any future issues and let me know which floss options were the best. Denise then helped me with the floss, polish, and fluoride and was very kind and helped make then end of my appointment just as painless. I would highly recommend this office for any dental needs.

user_reviews.Name: Brandy LeCesne
user_reviews.Description:
I have to say every experience at this office has been disappointing.  I continued to get my 6 month checkup there due to convenience.  Every appointment they have tried to get me to spend money out of pocket… I just would decline and get my regular cleaning and check up.  EXAMPLE: Telling me I need to remove old silver fillings that give me no issues.
I went for my 6 month checkup  yesterday and they refused to give me a regular cleaning due to they said I needed a deep cleaning because of bacteria.  However,  I have had no issues in the past or present, no pain, no bleeding of the gums, no bad taste.  I am very diligent in brushing and flossing.  My bottom front teeth did have the regular build up, this has always been the same in all my 6 month appointments.  They refused to clean these teeth as well unless I agreed to the out of pocket deep cleaning expenses.  I ended up walking out and calling later for my records and X-rays.  I will not return!
Please be sure to get a second opinion if they are trying to bully you with additional dental services.

user_reviews.Name: Sylvia Castanon
user_reviews.Description:
I brought my dad here a couple of months ago, but this was my first appointment. I’ve always found the front desk staff to be pleasant and professional but had no experience with the rest of the staff.
For my visit, Theresah, the DA, was patient, kind, and professional. Dr. Farrar was very reassuring and easy to talk to. And Chrissy from the front was friendly, thorough and clear in communications about plans and costs. Thank you for making the dentist visit an easier experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Xi Z
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I originally had no issues with this dental office, but their phone customer service feels like talking to a robot with no flexibility. I had orthodontic treatment there a few years ago, and my retainer is now slightly damaged. I called to ask how to handle the situation. Since they still have my records, I asked whether I could purchase a new set and have it mailed to me. I repeatedly emphasized that I have moved and now live very far away, so I cannot come in for an appointment.

However, the phone representative kept saying the only thing she can do is making an appointment for me  and offered no other options. I kept explaining that I live far away and cannot go in for an appointment, but she just repeated the same response. I asked to speak with someone else because I needed advice tailored to my situation (specifically, that I cannot go in for an appointment). She told me that everyone else would say the same thing.

Is this really the case? Was this a misunderstanding from the customer service representative, or is this truly their policy? If a customer wants to purchase a replacement retainer, is it really impossible? If so, this seems very unreasonable to me. Also, I was talking to a real person not a robot, I hope you can understand my situation and show some empathy, rather than repeatedly suggesting something I am simply unable to do currently, which feels robotic and unhelpful.  What frustrated me the most was that she kept asking, “Is there anything else I can help you with?” I said yes — I asked if I could speak to someone else, because she kept repeating something I simply could not do. She said no, and that the only thing she could do was schedule an appointment for me. Then why keep asking if there’s anything else she can help with? I truly cannot understand such illogical and empathy-lacking customer service.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Great customer service. Staff is very friendly and extremely helpful. Everyone makes you feel comfortable from the Dr, staff upfront and the techs. Willing to work out payment plans that fits your budget. Will return for all of my future appointments. Dana and Christina very helpful. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: soumya Mohan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was very disappointed with my new patient dental cleaning visit today. Dr Jason Megans  turned me away after saying that my teeth needed deep cleaning and other dental work up when I went for a regular dental  visit today .  I have been seeing regular dentist for the last 17 years and nobody told me that I needed $800+work up out of pocket. He refused to do routine cleaning and I had to leave the office after spending almost 2 hours just  for x rays. Now my  annual x ray coverage is exhausted for my upcoming visits with new dentist. I cannot express enough gratitude for Dr. Megens and his assistant for the exceptional care I received at this office. Dr. Megens was incredibly patient and understanding, reassuring me that my child was okay while I was getting my procedure done. He even shared stories about his own children, remembering what it was like when they were that age. His kindness and ability to make me feel at ease during such a stressful time meant the world to me. The office staff was incredible too, they gave my child a toy and let him be a child without scolding him. They made conversations with him as their mama was on the chair getting her procedure.

More importantly, Dr. Megens made it clear multiple times that his priority was to get this procedure done right so that I would not have to come back in pain. He truly listened, acknowledged my situation, and showed genuine compassion—something I deeply appreciated after suffering for so long.

Thanks to his expertise and care, I woke up pain-free for the first time in months, and every day since, I have felt nothing but gratitude. Dr. Megens is not only an incredibly skilled dentist but also a kind and compassionate professional who truly cares about his patients. If you are looking for a provider who will take the time to do things right and treat you with empathy, I highly recommend him!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chichi Yu Zhong
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Beware of Round Rock Dentists on University – Especially Dr. Jason Megens

My husband and I had been loyal patients at Round Rock Dentists for years. We always had great experiences with Dr. Dyke, who was honest, kind, and professional. He took excellent care of us and consistently confirmed that our dental health was in great shape.

Unfortunately, Dr. Dyke left the practice, and during my recent visit, I was seen by Dr. Jason Megens. The experience was shocking and upsetting. Despite taking meticulous care of my teeth—brushing with an electric toothbrush, flossing, using a water flosser and mouthwash daily—I was suddenly told I had gum disease, bone loss, and needed an expensive deep cleaning that would cost me over $1,200 out of pocket, after insurance. When I asked for a regular cleaning instead, Dr. Megens refused and claimed insurance wouldn’t cover it due to the “serious condition” of my teeth.

Something felt off. Dr. Megens came across as pushy and sales-driven, not someone I could trust with my health. I decided to get a second opinion at Paramount Dental—and I’m so glad I did. They gave me a full exam and confirmed that my teeth and gums are in excellent condition. No signs of gum disease, no bone loss. Just keep up the good work, they said.

I left feeling furious and deeply disappointed. This experience felt like a blatant attempt to upsell unnecessary procedures and take advantage of patients.

If you’re considering this practice, especially under Dr. Megens’ care, I strongly recommend getting a second opinion before agreeing to anything. It could save you a lot of stress, time, and money.

user_reviews_extended.Description: If I could give zero stars I would. These people are SCAMMERS. I happen to not notice  this so I researched with my new dental HMO plan for places to go and this place pop up and was recommended by my coworkers who have the same plan as me.  I went to this office and was told that i had stage two gum disease and that i needed a crown on one of my back teeth. Interesting, as my previous dentist that i have seen for years, would of said something about this when i saw them back in Oct 2024 when they filled my cavities. I'm 25 and regularly go to dentist every 6 months to a year. With my previous dentist i have gone to them for 10 years and they told me i have great tooth structure and did not need any crowns at all.  Magically at this place i now need all these services. The female dentist at this place recommended a deep cleaning, then she refused to do a regular cleaning , and said her assistant would only do a polishing free of charge ( as it should be because yall wasted my time). So i got the "free" polishing done and then the front desk lady came to explain the cost of deep cleaning and crown which in total was $1200 dollars, and the lady was like we do the deep cleaning and then use a laser to get rid anything the dentist can't see, and its priced by teeth quadrant. I said well what is the price for deep cleaning without the laser, she said with a attitude that "we don't do that" and 'I have never priced it without the laser". Ummm if your stating to a patient that the deep cleaning consistent of the dentist scraping  under my gums to get bacteria out and then she uses a laser then deep cleaning and laser are separate from each other, you should be able to price them separately. Its funny because she had the laser priced out by quadrant and then the deep cleaning price on paper and i thought it was stupid that she told me that i didn't have the option of not doing the laser with the deep cleaning. Mind you I work in healthcare and I know how services and pricing works. As a healthcare worker and patient i know that with certain service you can denied the option to do certain services and do others. Also i don't think they even ran my insurance correctly, my plan is HMO so basically an office can't charge my insurance a high amount, there are set prices for all services with my insurance. The prices she gave were not even accurate when i left and called my insurance ( total sure be $300-400 all together for both). In addition, my appointment was at 9am and i didn't leave until 12 noon which is unacceptable. I sat in the dentist chair waiting for 2 hours just for her to say she wouldn't do a basic cleaning. Also another thing, as i waited for two hrs i was able to hear the dentist tell 4 patients in the role that they all have bad stages of gum disease, and that they needed the same treatment plan, a deep cleaning and getting crowns. I thought well ill give her the benefit of doubt and see what she'll say about me since with my previously the only issues i have ever had were cavities from drinking sweet coffee. i literally just wanted my basic cleaning but no i had to deal with this crap. They did do xrays on my teeth which i sent to my previous dentist and ill be going back to my previous dentist as a self pay patient cuz i will not go back here and i don't recommend this place at all. I DO NOT recommended them at all, save yourself and find someone else they suck.
