user_reviews_extended.Name: Jody Venable
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office was fantastic! Very welcome space. The ladies at the counter were very friendly and welcoming. Chrissy & Mariah are assets to the practice and were an absolute pleasure to deal with. Dr. Shabnam Farrar was so sweet and comforting. She was concise and thorough with everything she was doing. Her assistant Conner was awesome and a pleasure to meet. Overall, everyone at RR Dentist was amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alan King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Over the years, I have visited many dental offices and had good and bad experiences. I also have high dental anxiety. This office by far is one of the best. They got me in fairly quickly and everyone I encountered was very kind. The dentist, Dr. Farrah, was very knowledgeable and caring and explained everything in great details. I felt that she was very honest and wasn’t trying to sell or being pushy which I really liked about her. I will return for additional treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: E. M.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had my doubts because dentist in a (newish) strip mall? But they took my ins (few do) and seemed way better than those horrid chain places that my ins. also takes.

But Dr. Farrah is a doll. SO SWEET. Loved her.
And a guy named Connor who did my x-rays was amazing. He moved so fast I had no time to gag. And I always gag!

They have some cool technology I have NEVER seen before. Lupe (?) and Melissa are great with cleanings; I’m a sensitive bleeder. They give me some numbing gel which helps. And my gums are not sore the next day.

Practice seems a LITTLE bit salesy lol with the laser bacteria killer lol, but hey, I did it; my final bill for ALL I did that day (routine) was less than $200.

I’ve had insurance hassles, some of it NOT THEIR FAULT, and some preventable on their end (a little!)

I have DeltaCare USA and overall it stinks except for very routine stuff. That’s unrelated to the practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AIG
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dyke and Dental Hygienist Melissa and staff are great! Me and my adult kids have been going there for a few years. Melissa is very compassionate when doing the cleaning for my gum disease, she is the nicest person. So far no issues with billing. I'm happy with this dental group and do recommend it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cendall Busby
user_reviews_extended.Description: The visit made me feel comfortable and I thought the exam was thorough at first. I tried following up with questions about what order I'd like to do things in and still haven't received an answer. They said I had an infection yet gave me no antibiotics and wanted to do a $2000 periodontal cleaning BEFORE taking care of the apparent infection and 2 broken teeth I have. They never replied to my messages and I'll be finding a new dentist outside of this monopoly of Smile Generation. I feel like they were just trying to get money out of my insurance and because I asked for antibiotics then to remove my broken teeth first, they just decided to ignore me. Maybe others had a good experience, but I think they were trying to take advantage of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: pori deh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would highly recommend this dental office to my friends and family. I was in a lot of pain and they were able to give me an appointment pretty quickly. They addressed my toothache on the same day and I scheduled to go back for more treatments. My dentist, Dr. Farrar, was very caring and professional, and made sure I was comfortable during the procedure. Also my hygienist, Melissa, did an amazing job with my cleaning. The front desk ladies and the assistants were very friendly and helpful as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marilyn Beets
user_reviews_extended.Description: I needed a new dentist and found my first visit at Round Rock Dentists with Dr. Jason Megens and his staff to be very positive.  Dr. Megens is very caring, experienced and knowledgeable.  He has been a dentist for many years and also taught dental classes so he really knows his stuff!   I needed 4 new crowns and my case was a little challenging but his work was exceptional and he explained everything throughout the process and helped put me at ease.  I feel blessed to have found Dr. Megens and if you’re looking for a good dentist, go no further!  He’s the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Herald
user_reviews_extended.Description: WOW !!!!! What can i say awesomeness comes to mind Dr. Megens and his staff ( asst. ) were great i hope this is the only Dentist i have from here on out these people made me feel relaxed and at ease during procedure . I am telling you i had a great exsperiance and very happy i chose this Dentist highly recomend  Round Rock Dentist's you will be happy to if you chose this place . Thank you Round Rock Dentists .....Scott Herald

user_reviews_extended.Name: jane Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first visit to this dentist office was very satisfactory.
The staff I had that day were nice & friendly. My preventative treatment was great! Dr. Dyke was great that he even did my teeth cleaning along with minor filling. I’ve never had a dentist do both treatments.
I recommended my daughter to go see Dr. Dyke as she’s looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Glenn A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional and detail oriented approach. All procedures were explained when performed and options were discussed for follow-up treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doug Denham
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visits to Round Rock Dentists have always been positive. Dr. Farrar has been friendly, professional and willing to accommodate my schedule if they can. Dr. Farrar and Denise work well as a team and I’ve been pleased with what they have been able to do for me. This includes a crown that they made for me recently, and it is working quite well for me. I would definitely recommend Dr. Farrar, to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: S Tookes
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been coming here since we moved to Texas in 2020. They always take good care of my family and me when it comes to scheduling and getting treated. The beautiful Dr. Farrar and Denise are awesome.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zach Hagan
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming to this Dentist for almost 15 years and never once have I thought about going anywhere else. The patience, expertise, and professionalism from Dr. Farrar, Conner, and Kyshia was absolutely exceptional, I could not ask for a better experience. Will 100% be coming back for all my future dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Goldfinch
user_reviews_extended.Description: Melissa is great! She’s thorough yet has an easy touch. I felt very confident in her knowledge and ability. The office staff are helpful and very congenial. Definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jupiara McDonald
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love my dentist Dr. Farrar and the DA Danielle.  They make sure I’m comfortable and okay at all times during any procedure I’m having done.  They make my appointments more pleasurable. They do a great job every time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Loren Webb
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an amazing experience with this dental office today. I originally made an appointment here because of their new client special. I paid $59 for a full exam (x rays too) and a cleaning. The hygienist was fast and did a great job. The dentist was so kind and explained everything clearly. He also complimented my teeth which made me feel good! I didn't have to wait at all. They got me right back and I went from X-ray to exam to cleaning without any wait.

I highly recommend Round Rock Dentists and Dr. Dyke. I will be back and refer friend and family here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittney Reynolds
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Green exemplifies professionalism, patience, and expertise as a dental physician. I truly appreciate the kindness and warmth of the staff. I will certainly be recommending her office to both friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AFROOZ EHRAMI
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend this clinic! Staff are very welcoming and kind. Dr.Farrar is very knowledgeable and  incredibly patient and thorough. She takes the time to explain everything clearly, and I highly recommend her to anyone seeking excellent dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peter M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Katrina was great! Very friendly and knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Olfers
user_reviews_extended.Description: The overall experience from front desk, dental assistant, hygienist, my dentist, to the coordinator was smooth. The hygienist and dentist were very personable and informative about reviewing my X-rays (discussing what they look for), and some valuable suggestions for how I can continue to improve my overall oral hygiene. This was my first experience at this location and I was highly satisfied.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Mongaras
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was looking for a new dentist because of insurance.

The appointment lasted 1:40.  The reason for this is a bunch of waiting.  The only thing that happened in the first hour was x-rays. It took 20 minutes before they even pulled me into for those, but after the x-rays I waited another 30 minutes with no updates in a space.  After I had been there an hour, I peaked out and asked what was going on.  It seemed like they had forgotten about me.

The service was less than average.  The doctor that did see me was not the one I had an appointment with.  Apparently, she was not there.  So, I am not sure who saw me.  There was not a dental assistant that did work on me.  It was all done by a dentist.

I was not told the cost of the service before it was done.  That is not really an issue for me, but that really should not be done.

There were issues when I was leaving with taking my payment and even with printing the receipt.

The experience was not good and as a new patient, I do not think that my family and I will be coming here again.

Update #1:
Once the owner responded, I called them back.  Apparently this was an automated response and they had no idea what i was talking about.  It was actually on the same day that the issue occurred.  They had no idea about the post.  They also did not remember me being in there even though it was the same day.  So, I can only assume that they are having many issues today and I was not an exception.

I really would not recommend becoming a new customer here.  It appears they are too busy to deal with the new business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Olfers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience with a quick and easy check in process, friendly greeting by the staff, and clean waiting areas. Dr. Megens and his assistant, Kyshia, was very helpful and knowledgeable. He had me in and out in an hour. Will continue to come back for my six months appointments and refer friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My whole family uses this practice and I have nothing but good things to say about both the adult and pediatric side.

My personal experiences with Dr. Ferrar and Denise has been amazing and they have been very understanding of my past dental traumas.

user_reviews_extended.Name: The WorthWhile Group At Keller Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were great from check in to the Dr visit and check out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rudo Nyamapfumba
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dyke is great and the hygienist are amazing as well. The customer service with front desk could be better. They never follow through when they say they will reach out to you with something or follow up information. You almost always have to keep calling and being run in circles. It really shouldn’t take that for basic customer service. We truly go because the care providers are amazing if it wasn’t that, would have left a long time ago because of the frustrations with front desk staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ARASH ESLAMY
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with Dr. Farrar and her team at Round Rock Dentists recently. Everyone seemed to really care about me as a patient. Also my hygienist Melissa did a great job with my cleaning.Would definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Purple cat
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing experience. Both Conner and Dr. Farrar are amazing at what they do and they make sure to answer any question you have. I will definitely recommend Round rock Dentistry and Dr. Farrar and Conner to my family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: j t
user_reviews_extended.Description: They weren’t terrible; good enough. First, they inputted my information wrong several times. Also, I feel like this dentistry is very quick to recommend high-cost services that are unnecessary (I always get a second opinion and they confirmed that the procedure they recommended was unnecessary and could pose unforeseen risk). I don’t know how to feel about their business, but it seems like a degrading service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ivan Adams
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience was informative, thorough, and pleasant. The staff was patient, professional, and helpful.  Melissa (Hygienist) and Denise (DA) were outstanding.  I am so grateful for their wonderful care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corey Robinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am giving kudos to Round Rock Dentists for helping me resolve a pain issue that I was dealing with. It turned out that I needed a root canal to resolve the issue and they were able to get me an appointment with an endodontist in another office on the same day. I was not expecting that as those appointments are never on the same day and I was going out of the country in a little under two weeks

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chandler Bass
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Megens and DA Danielle were so friendly and kind. They were gentle and explained everything to me before working on my mouth. 10/10 would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Barrientos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dyke and his crew are very friendly and professional. This dental practice comes with lots of recommendation from myself. The only main issue I have is the traffic bc of the expansion near the location. This appointment, I had Kiesha as my dental assistant who took me in from beginning to end. She was respectful and had consideration on my assistance I needed. She communicated with the other assistant that was treating my husband to help me. Kiesha took the time she needed to treat and see I had no other questions. Great job Dr. Dyke for having such a great staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evelyn Zamarripa
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Dr. Farrar and Dr. Strong and their team. They were super professional and very kind. They encouraged me to ask questions and made sure I was comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sierra Tupolo
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience here was great. It started from the moment I walked in the door. I did my echeck in the day before my appointment, so check in was really fast and easy. When I was taken back for x-rays, Alexandra was very kind and informative. Following the x rays, I had my exam and cleaning with Dr.Farrar. It went well; she was very efficient and gentle. Moreover, I was even able to get a consult for ortho with Dr.O. All in all it was a great visit. I will be recommending them to my friends and family that live in the Roundrock area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Salar Yazdanpour
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my initial visit with Dr.Farrar(a very kind, knowledgeable and professional doctor)a few days ago at Round Rock Dentists. Everything was good and professional. Great staff, easily scheduled and they accepted my insurance, no waiting time and Dr. Farrar followed up with me after my treatment. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lily ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went for a dental cleaning and the dental hygienist named Tysha was extremely rude since the moment she saw me. I asked a question, and as the visit progressed her attitude got worse and worse. It got to the point where she was actually hurting me and I could taste the blood in my mouth (even tho I regularly floss) because she was too rough. When I told her that it was painful she got really upset and for a moment I thought that she was going to slap me. After that the dentist got to the room and I mentioned to him what she did, but he didn’t seem to care. I have had many dental cleanings but never a bad experience like this. I would never return or recommend this clinic to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: shawn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Arava and DA Danielle did an outstanding job with my exams and temporary work before my root canal appointment. Danielle was exceptionally attentive and focused throughout the process, and Dr. Arava was incredibly thorough and detail-oriented, ensuring everything was done perfectly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Russell Marwitz
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everyone from entering the door to having the procedure done to paying and out the door was courteous and happy to answer any questions I had.

Dr Sara Herman was exceptional/outstanding.  She did a very good job of alleviating my anxiety about being at the dentist. Dr Herman did this with her step by step approach to explaining the procedure.  She also kept me in the loop as to what was going on during the procedure.

Costs covered and not covered by insurance were discussed after the exam/analysis.  It was made clear how much the out of pocket would be.  Payment options were discussed as well.

Despite my anxiety when visiting the dentists' office I was extremely happy with my visit.  Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shubhra Wahi
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Should have read review here because other people had the exact same experience.

TL;DR: Expect a huge out of pocket bill for teeth cleaning

All these years, I have never paid for getting my teeth cleaned outside of my insurance coverage. I did not have any teeth problems, wanted dental cleaning for my oral hygiene. After 1 hour of XRays and doctors examination, they told me they dint have time the same day for cleaning and gave me a bill of $500+ saying I needed deep cleaning which is only covered 80% by my insurance. When i said I’m not paying that much for cleaning and if i could just get the regular cleaning, their staff said its a disease and this is the cure, we won’t do regular cleaning.

I had them email me all the x rays and took it to another dentist who happily cleaned my healthy teeth at no cost to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bishop Gorman
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time going to the dentist in 5 years. Everyone from Dr. Farrar, her da, to the Hygienist Lupita I applaud y’all. Got me cleaned up, didn’t cut corners, didn’t oversell anything. Solid team. I highly recommend everyone to this dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Agustin
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It really makes me sad to write this review because I don’t ever like to put businesses down, but I am really disappointed in the amount I’m paying for a procedure I need to have done now as a complication from a filling that was done at this office.

In November last year, I switched to a dentist ant this office after already getting my annual exams and fillings elsewhere because I needed help with some tooth pain from prior. While I was there, the dentist (who is no longer there) did some X-rays and said I needed a filling on a different tooth. I had no pain on that tooth but agreed because I trusted her medical opinion. She did the filling and for days after, I noticed worsening pain and temperature sensitivity. I followed up a month later as my symptoms were getting worse. At my next appointment (the dentist who did my filling already left the practice at this point), I was told that the cavity and filling were pretty deep and I probably needed a root canal. I was frustrated to find this out and proceeded to schedule a root canal (at a different office because their endodontist only comes once a month) which I had done without complications. However, I did need a crown on this tooth following the root canal. I went back to Round Rock Dentists to be evaluated for the crown and I was quoted $855.  It’s unfortunate that I have to pay this amount for a complication from a procedure I had at this office. I am in the medical field and understand complications can happen from procedures, but having to pay for it is a whole other issue.

Hoping I can save someone else from this nightmare. Will update later after I’ve had the crown done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eduardo L. Garcia, Ed.D.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Decided to try this office since my spouse selected the wrong insurance plan and we could not see the dentist that we have seen for the past 10 yrs. Figured this would only be for a cleaning twice this year and then that would be it since everything else has checked out with my teeth.

First issue was that I had an appointment at 9:30am. I did not leave the office until 11:30am. Two hours for what was suppose to be a routine dental cleaning. It ended up being xrays and a "review" with the dentist.

Second issue, this felt like a sales place more than a place that practices dental care. I was informed I needed 7 crowns, which was interesting. No teeth pain, no issues, just old previous fillings. Since I had no intention and completing any of the recommend work, I listened. Sadly, I was not given a coherent reason as to why this needs to be done. Was the tooth structure not solid? Did I have pain? None of this was addressed or mentioned. I was told this was to be proactive, 7k proactive I might add. Why would one want to shave my tooth for a crown when the structure seemed to work instead of replacing a filling?

After I received what felt like a sales pitch and offered options for financing. That might be a hint when an office offers this that you might be about to be gouged for money.

Once I politely declined, knowing the dentist I had been with for the past 10 years has monitored my teeth, the next step was to wait for the cleaning.

The cleaning and water from it seemed to be done from a mobile cart. The water used to clean my teeth was absolutely the most horrendous tap water I have had in my mouth.

Sadly, this place seems concerned about making money. The reasons articulated to me for 7 new crowns, despite no concerns or issues was not substantial and informative.

I had not had a dental experience like this for quite some time and this makes me realize how thankful I am for my previous dentist that I will return to in January 2025 once we change insurance plans. Until then, I will see them again in 6 more months for a tooth cleaning and hope the tap water does not gag me in the process and I will pass on the 7k mouth remodel and wait for my dentist that I have seen for the past 10 years to assess the situation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Harrington
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Farrar and Theresah are the absolute best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fredrik Spanhak
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was friendly and efficient. Had my teeth checked and cleaned with one problem found.  An old bridge was removed and a temporary one put in place. The temporary has come off twice but was reinstalled quickly. The staff got me in very quickly

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mackenzie Justice
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nicole my hygienist is so amazing. She talked and laughed with me when I was feeling uneasy and worried. She connected with me on a more human level and I am thankful to be in her care. Lucky to have her!(:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vinh Pham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Dyke was amazing. He thoroughly explained the procedure (getting a new crown) and friendly throughout. Melissa the dental hygienist did an amazing job with all of my tarter build up. I actually had a phobia of the dentist prior to this appointment. Perfect staff. Would definitely recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: jazamiine Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I high recommend the traveling specialist Dr. Strong & his right hand lady his dental assistant, Ms. Stephanie PAINLESS root canal from start to finish 5 days post procedure! Round Rock Dental in general I’d recommend especially with the new professional staff/ front office personnel.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Mair
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have significant Dental Anxiety, and it is hard for me to get numb.  I have never spoken of this, but from the encouragement of my wife, I decided to discuss it with Dr. Reema Dhanani.  She was compassionate and professional and did not make me feel like an idiot for discussing my concerns.  She offered up a solution that worked much better than what I had experienced throughout my life.  I have found my new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Amorestrella
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was suggested that I need a deep cleaning. The dentist office refused to schedule a regular cleaning until this was done. I’m sure it’s ‘required’ since it cost $1400 and isn’t just my regular cleaning that would not make them any money. Especially after they already billed insurance for the 5 year X-rays… so disappointed after hoping for a good experience. Finding a new dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Curt Romig
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The dentists were nice and good. But I was often upcharged with mysterious charges, and had to argue with them to prove what services were covered. CHECK YOUR BILL CLOSELY. I would've been ripped off even more if I wasn't hyper-vigilant on some billing issues. I even had to convince them that my 8 year old is not an "adult" by insurance standards. Definitely not going back.

UPDATE: I called the office this morning, as they requested, and was put on hold for 10 minutes and then it went to voicemail. I will wait for a call back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: shari misler
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dentistry office has highly qualified, personable, Caring, doctors and Dental assistants.  I have Always been given the best care and am grateful for them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Noah Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Staff was all very kind and nice, the dentists and hygienist took the time to sterlise everything and make sure that everything was very clean! They both also showed interest in our own lives aside from just our oral health, and treated us very nicely. My hygienist even asked if I wanted mint or cherry flavoured stuff to clean my teeth with (sorry, i forgot what it was called). They addressed my questions and concerns very well and it was overall a very pleasurable experience.
The bill is rather expensive that is true, but what else do you expect from dental care? Free service? Then our taxes would be astronomical.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Su Ki
user_reviews_extended.Description: Don’t know how to say but, if you’re already here, for sure go for a second opinion. I’m sure you will save thousands. Don’t think people here are interested in helping with your oral health but rather are interested in your $. At, first they seemed like sales representative who are in dire need to make money. Have never such disastrous experience in the past.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nabis Loacat
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dyke is an exceptional human and exceptional at his job.  Getting unperfect teeth perfect is an uncelebrated achievement!  This office definitely goes the extra mile to correct what we were born with, as well as their own human mistakes.  In my experience, I had to return a few times to get things right and the staff and Dr. Dyke were great each time!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pepper Jimenez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My 8 year old son had his first appointment with Dr. Stone and his assistant Marie. My son has gotten to a phase of craving increased independence and he really wanted to go back by himself. I hesitated because he has some sensory issues and scaling could be a challenge. Before they took my son back I was able to speak to both Dr. Stone and Marie and they both assured me they would go at his pace. When my son came out from his cleaning he was all smiles! He told me they were very kind and listened to everything he had to say. The scaling was a success! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joy Masters
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Wang, Alex and Sylvia are a fantastic TEAM!  Lexi & Chrissy are fantastic!! VERY welcoming

user_reviews_extended.Name: jarvis lincoln
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a wonderful office and the best staff ever! The entire experience was great from check in to check out! Come and see Dr. Green, she's the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jayden Dunn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
They have called 1 hour before my last 3 appointments to cancel. After sending 4 confirmation texts.

Steer clear if you value your time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: After I asked if I was done with payments they sent me another bill. $1200 for a crown repair with insurance. I can't believe I went back to schedule a cleaning... they wanted $800 with insurance. Treatment plan contained needless filling "redo's" & other frivolous "lets just do it" work. There are plenty of dentists in the area that can take care of you with better financial awareness of others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vivian Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called into the clinic and spoke with the Benefits coordinator named Amber. I simply received a billing detail late last night and thought I'd call in to understand what exactly the detail were about as there. I have 4 children who I have brought to the place plus two of them who received past orthodontist work. I've been coming for years and knew calling shouldn't be difficult. Amber answered and pulled up my son's name - one of the kids who received ortho work in the past as he was the latest family member who was seen there. She sated she couldn't find details. I tried to give her my name however she began to be rude , short , snippy and not listening. I asked her to please stop speaking over me and I could help her understand we are a big family and it may be under my name. I guess she felt defensive in me asking her to allow me a moment to speak and help and she HUNG UP IN MY FACE!! Of course I called back because I didn't receive an answer , just an inpatient member of staff. I received another young lady who was very patient and explained exactly where the billing detail came from. I advised her Amber hung up and she said she would advise her manager and she apologized. I decided to go else where for my cleanings since Amber will be here. I called back to ask about my records and Amber answered. I advised to her that I wanted to speak back with Emilia . She said she knows I was speaking to Emilia and that she will not tolerate me yelling at her. I laughed and said no I was not yelling and it is comical you'd say this to justify your impatience and reasoning for hanging up on a customer. Can I please speak with her. She denied me speaking with her an said she will have her call back. I never received the call back. I am not surprised. HORRIBLE STAFF member. HORRIBLE service. I hope this is not overlooked by someone claiming she hung up due to a false claim of a customer yelling!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathryn Sonoda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my crown fall out on a weekend, but my wonderful dentist, Farrar, was kind, quick, and explained everything ahead of time. Amazing experience! Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brent Porter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Now I remember why I shouldn't ever go back to this place. Took off work to get a simple cleaning, they do the X-rays, have the dentist come in to discuss, then followed by the person that tries to up sell you. I said I just need a cleaning, I took the day off today to get it done. They tried saying that they'll see if they can do the cleaning today. I said again, well I took the day off for it, scheduled it and confirmed my appointment for a cleaning. I haven't gotten them cleaned in a couple of years because of Covid. They ran my insurance said I don't have coverage. This is incorrect, my insurance coverage hasn't changed in 7 years, I have dental coverage. They then hit me with $960 for a cleaning. I said I just need a simple cleaning, put the paste on the tool, scrape some plaque and shine them up. user_reviews_extended.Description:

I called and mentioned the discrepancy and they then gave me the contracted price my insurance said it should Be. I was also told by two people I would receive $200 off as they were running a promotion,  for my dental work.  Then when I show up to have the work done, I am told that I cannot use this promotion and that my bill would now be $642.
When going with my daughter, I arrive early with our four kids, including my newborn, in the pouring rain to be told they had changed my appointment to a different day bc the dentist had to work at a different location on fridays bc they were short staffed. The kicker is they changed my appointment WITHOUT NOTIFYING ME!! I had to reschedule.
Then I come again with my second daughter to arrive in the parking lot two minutes before my appointment time. I unload all the kids and walk in five minutes late. They again said they called me bc I was five minutes late. I had no record of a phone call nor did my husband on his phone. We live almost thirty minutes away, so to make this trip and be told twice they canceled without notifying me is horrible customer service and public relations. I did not reschedule this time as I am NOT going back. If you want a place that quotes you one price and then charges you another or changes your appt time without notifying you, then this IS the dentist office for you.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to see Dr. Gorham and his staff for 8+ years. He's the best dentist I've ever had and when I moved from Round Rock to Central Austin, I kept him as my dentist. I would rather travel to see a good dentist that I trust than choose one closer that may not be up to standard. His staff of also amazing! They become almost like family. I Highly recommend giving them a visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie McBride
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love RR Family Dental. I have been a patient for 20+ years. I had a cleaning today and my hygienist was so soft spoken and kind. She was so meticulous, but gentle at the same time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerry Spataro
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been seeing Dr. Gorham with Round Rock Family Dentistry for several years and have always been impressed with the professionalism and customer service shown me at every appointment. They are always on time and never rush you through especially if you have questions. I have always been happy with the dental care given and would definitely recommend this dental practice to anyone looking to make a change in their dental care and needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Boehme
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round Rock Family Dental is awesome! I've been going there for over 5 years and have seen Robin every time I go. She does a great job cleaning my teeth and is very personable. Dr. Gorham is thorough and competent. Office staff provide friendly service. Highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Bynum
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a client of RR Family Dental since moving to the area in 2000. Thankfully, I haven't needed any major dental work. All their staff has always been friendly and professional.  Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darrein Grimme
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is SO friendly and really cares about you ! My husband and I have been coming here for years after a recommendation from a former Co worker of his. I’m so glad we have been coming here, because I have been to some bad dentist places and this is far from it ! Everyone REALLY cares about you and understands the “dentist” is not for everyone, so they make you feel as welcoming as can be. Highly recommend if you are looking for a place that really cares about you and your teeth !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebekah R.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I like that the staff knows me by name here. I have a favorite hygienist (hi Robin!) and they consistently do a good job with my teeth.

I also like how Dr. Gorham goes out of his way to save me money - we thought I needed a crown at one point, but he kept examining the x-ray and couldn't find what he was looking for, so instead he opted to re-do an old filling I'd had done at a different dentist. It worked great!

He's also great about keeping you informed and I've had great experiences with him and the staff treating me with respect. I've recommended this dentist to a friend and would do so again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oliver Harbison
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Round Rock Family Dental are fantastic! They are interested in my comfort as they are “playing around” in my mouth! I’ve been seeing dentists since I was around 5 or 6. I’m 72 now. Some of my early experiences were not very good. I was literally afraid to go to dentists. Since finding RR Family Dental a number of years ago, I’ve lost that fear! The hygienist today was great! She cleaned my teeth painlessly! Dr. Gorham was too! If you need a dentist, come see these guys!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Jennings
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very welcoming, courteous and professional staff. Was seen promptly and the Dental Hygienist (Francesca) did excellent job of cleaning my teeth today. Great Dentist (Dr. Gorham), family had been going here 5 years now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shandel Anselmo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Round Rock Family Dental is so friendly and welcoming!   I don't stress over going to the dentist anymore and absolutely love Robin.  From the time you walk in the front door until you leave,  you are treated with respect and every employee is happy to see you and genuinely cares about you.  If you are the type of person who is afraid to go to the dentist, I highly recommend Round Rock Family Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: brady bonario
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have avoided the dentist for a long time, and after finally caving to my wife, went to round rock family dental. The staff were very kind and welcoming, and made me feel comfortable even though I was extremely nervous. I am having extensive work done, and Dr. Gorham has been great! He made sure I knew what was happening and that I couldn't feel any pain during the procedures. The ladies in the office are great too, and have treated us like family every time. I really cant thank this practice enough for helping me finally get this work done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bri Bailey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Haven’t been to the dentist in many years due to putting my kids first of course but because my smile is my biggest insecurity (and I finally have a job that has decent benefits) I took the first step in getting my smile back. The staff was very welcoming, explanatory, and comforting. Looking forward to smiling again. Thank you Round Rock Family Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelley J
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was delighted to find this dentist when I moved to the Austin area a few years ago. Not only go they do quality work, they're super friendly, it's ready to get an appointment when I need one, and they're very reasonably priced! The only way they could be any better is if they were closer to my house, haha! But I still drive out of my way and pay told to get here, because I love this dentist so much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Terry Larsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Round Rock Family Dental for years, and will continue to go there for all my dental needs. Dr. Gorham is great and so are all who work there. All are very friendly, courteous, and professional. I had a dental emergency, and called in on a Sunday while the office was closed, but I left a message. They called me back first thing the next morning and were able to squeeze me in that day. They completely took care of me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Duke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming to Round Rock Family Dental for years. From basic cleanings to more advanced work (and I’ve had a lot - bonding teeth, crowns, fillings), I’ve never had a bad experience. The staff has always been so friendly and Dr. Gorham does great work. If you’re looking for a dentist in the Austin area, give them a try!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Benita Echels
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a happy, satisfied customer of Round Rock Family Dental for YEARS! Cleaning and a health check of my teeth comprise my usual visit with Dr. Jansa and the staff, but even when the visit calls for more extensive dental work, it has always been a pleasant visit. Add to the office's friendly and professional atmosphere the "no surprises" handling of billing, I am indeed glad they are there.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karon Henderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just returned to the Round Rock area and remember Dr. Gorham doing a crown for me back in 2010. That crown is STILL in tact with no problems the last 9 years so I hoped they would take me back. They did and treated me so well. I had just completed 5 months of chemo treatments and they were sensitive to my situation and took great care in cleaning my teeth, taking x-rays, and showing me before and after pictures of my teeth during my cleaning. Dr. Gorham came in after the cleaning and was friendly and thorough with his examination. This is a rockstar group of professionals that will take of all of your family’s dental needs. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Flynn
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm in my 40s and have been to more dentists than I care to recall, and Dr. Gorham is by far the best I've used. Typing this on my phone so will be short, but what I like most is that he takes time to explain the issues and my options, discusses pros and cons of each, then we make a decision together. It's pretty refreshing and I wish all our doctors were more like this.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kai L.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This dental office is amazing! Everyone is so friendly, informative, and kind. The work done is top notch and they are very sensitive to any discomfort a patient may face during procedures.

If you are a person who struggles with dental fears, this an excellent practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Overfield
user_reviews_extended.Description: Round Rock family dental makes me very comfortable. Dr. Chris Gorham and the staff make you feel right at home, very friendly and eager to please. I'm always pleased with the time they take to answer any questions or concerns I may have.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jan Gunter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Finally left this practice last year after a few bad experiences with the dentist. I’ve found a fabulous one nearby, and I wish I had left sooner. Staff was always very nice and good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Lyman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have nothing but bad experiences with Round Rock Dental, the hygienists are kind and the dentists are fine too but the way the office is run and the dishonesty when it comes to insurance usage has been mind blowing.   I was new to the area, looked up dentists called a few and was looking who would accept my insurance and who was in network.  At no point did the office advise me that although they would bill our insurance they were not in network and all costs not covered would be our responsibility.  I am an educated individual who is aware of how the system works and would not have selected an out of network provider.  Taking advantage of new patience and not advising them that they are not in network is dishonest in my opinion.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yon V
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a client of Round Rock family dental for over 4 years and I can only say good things about them. I remember one time they actually gave me a ride back to work! Their customer service is excellent and their equipment/office is very nice.
Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mel Everett
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to ROUND ROCK FAMILY DENTAL for like forevever. Dr. Gorham now and Dr. Jansa in the past. Never disappointed, always painless.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joey Ramos
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Well Folks, Round Rock Family Dental
Is MY GO TO from now on! The people there are Awesome! They all work together and get you right in and out AFTER doing an Amazing Job! Couldn’t think of a Better Dental location to get the job done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nick Grobelny
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great folks working here, they’re always  pleasant, expeditious and down to earth.  Their reservation system makes it easy to keep up with my appointments, too.  They also seem to keep up with the latest tech, the office always has the latest gadgets to help things go smoothly.  😁  thanks guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca James
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always on time. Rarely, if ever, have to wait more than a couple minutes. Everyone is so friendly and they remember my name. Love my hygienist! Such a nice person and takes very good care of me and my teeth! Thank you for all the years of excellent care and service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corina Mancilla
user_reviews_extended.Description: Robin + Kristi are the best. They always take care of me and make me feel comfortable. The Dr. is always on top of my teeth care and making sure they get the care and procedures I need done right away. Love this practice !!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: AJ
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Gorham and his staff are awesome. They work with me and my work schedule and they’re always very friendly. They make me feel very comfortable when I come in for my appointments. Really glad I came here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: cecil latham
user_reviews_extended.Description: Routine cleanings are done in a timely and professional manner.  Dr Gorham has done extensive restorative procedures on my wife and we are very satisfied with the results. Highly recommend this service where the patient is always their first concern.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tony Greenman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in for my initial visit today, everybody was super friendly and knowledgeable. As far as trips to the dentist go, I can't imagine how it could have been any better. If you're looking for a dentist, definitely check them out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carlos McKnight
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dental equipment is older than the building itself. Everything in the facility is outdated. The monitor where u look to see images of your teeth fades in and out and has lines through the screen. It seems like the dentist doesnt really want to be there. He is just there bescause its a paycheck. Trust me. This office feels like I went back in time to 1950.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bianca Talabis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you're like me, there are few things worse than going to the dentist. Among them would probably be stepping on a Lego or stubbing your pinky toe (the two worst sensations known to man). But this dental office is honestly the best one I've been to!

Dr. Gorham and his team have a very relaxed environment that calms the nerves of having to go to the dentist. The hygienist I had was super funny and talkative (in a soothing way), and she put me at ease while I was getting my cleaning done. The rooms also have overhead TVs, so you can zone out and watch morning news while your hygienist agrees with you that Thor is definitely the hottest Avenger!

Dr. Gorham also took the time to answer all my concerns with patience, and he even used the small camera to show me what he was talking about on the overhead TV. He's very kind, and I bet he also thinks Thor is the best Avenger! I'll have to ask the next time I go, 10/10 for sure

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jake snake
user_reviews_extended.Description: Literally the greatest hygienist I've ever had. Every person In there is incredibly nice and make you feel as at home as can be while at the dentist. I'll never go anywhere else as long as I live in the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Napolitano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kristi is always a pleasure to visit. She has such a relaxing persona about her. Great personality, remembers everything about you and pick up the conversation as if you saw her yesterday! oh, and did I mention she does excellent work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dan Bockmann
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As a doctor myself, I am not immune to the "fear of the dentist", and when it became clear that I would need a root canal procedure, I have to be honest -- I was truly dreading it.  I've never had a root canal before, but I know they are generally considered to be the most painful of dental procedures, and I was dreading the experience.

I really couldn't have been more pleasantly surprised with entire experience, however.  A colleague of mine recommended Dr. Gorham at Round Rock Family Dental, so I scheduled an appointment with them.  Dr. Gorham was relaxed, informative and reassuring, which helped ease my anxiety quite a bit, and amazingly, I had almost no sharp pain throughout the entire procedure -- or even afterward!  I have been very impressed with Dr. Gorham's technical skill, and I have since begun recommending him to my own patients with dental needs.

Much appreciation for making my experience much better than I was expecting!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madeline Yannuzzi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Dr. Gorhams for a number of years and I feel fortunate to have found him. After experiences  with several dentists, I can say without reservation that he is the most competent, capable, skilled and honest dentist I have EVER encountered.   He is always  as concerned with the comfort of the patient as he is with the quality of his work.  I LOVE his staff too!    I refer all of my friends & family to Dr. Gorham. My mother lives two hours away but refuses to be treated by anyone else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nichole Ringler
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love this dental office! The hygienists along with the doctor always make my family and my children feel at ease while getting their teeth cleaned. Friendly staff! I would definitely recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leigh Walinski
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was super warm and kind, and helped ease a nervous kiddo’s fears. The office is practical and fair, and they all seem genuinely happy to help. So glad we found this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andie Tolentino
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Love Love this place!!! I was visiting from Hawaii and needed emergency dental care. I was a crying mess, but the experience here was wonderful from start to finish. Super top notch bed side manner and the staff is super friendly and put me at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bonnie Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful experience for the first checkin to perform initial X-ray and cleaning. All staff members are very helpful and friendly. The Dr. is great also.

user_reviews_extended.Name: tori parra
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming here for about 3 years and I have always been treated like family! They always get me in on time and are always helpful and tell me what is going on with my teeth! Great environment and awesome people at the front and cleaning my teeth!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: They may seem great up front but after a year you start to see the disorganization. They filed for services that were not completed and it took me a month to update those records. The actual dentist themselves are great but the office staff is lacking. The office managers personality is as numbing as Lidocaine. I honestly cannot believe she/office policy was so unaccommodating. If you have a large family and/or small children this is not the place for you. Find a dentist office that updated account notes and invoices. At the very least has a office manager that help to ease your anxiety while visiting the dentist. I asked them to send me my records so I can change dentist, I'm pretty sure I'll need to call three times before that happens. On the positive side, I just singed up with a professional dentist group.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffani Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience here! There’s a tv above you while you get your cleaning done, and the hygienist was able to occupy my mind while getting my teeth super clean!! I’ll definitely be having them as my regular dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ace Gibbs
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone that works here is so sweet, helpful, & fun. (Yes I said that about a dentist office). Karen is so incredible, she helps out with insurance and billing & is the most thourough person I have ever met. I thank the stars for her!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy Pogue
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going to Round Rock family Dental for well over 20 years. All of the staff is friendly and treat us like family. I have moved several times over the years and now it is a bit of a drive but we wouldn’t think of going anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cory W
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just completed KöR teeth whitening and Dr. Gorham was very detail oriented and meticulous. I was impressed with how he was always on time with my appointments. And they have T.V.'s in each room, which was a nice touch. After using a couple different Round Rock dentists, Dr. Gorham is definitely the best. Very highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leilani Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: This practice is the greatest!!  The staff is friendly, professional, and from the moment I walk in I know that I will be taken care of.  I've been going to this practice for 28 years.  I would highly recommend them to my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Skawin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Being going here for years. Dr. Gorham is great as usual and the new dental hygienist , Alycin, is wonderful. All very professional, knowledgeable , and affable! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hilaire Ridlon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Good service and no upsell! I returned to Dr Gorham after a few years of wandering in the franchise dentist wilderness and I appreciate the time he spent with me and his knowledge and experience. I will be there as long as I can be to meet my dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel Lipe
user_reviews_extended.Description: Myself and family have used Dr Gorham's Round Rock Family Dental practice for many many years and have always had a great experience.  Highly recommend!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrey Denman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kristi was very professional and friendly. She explained what was going on with the inside surfaces of my teeth. Then she got a device that showed me those surfaces. Impressive. Disappointing that I have old lady teeth. But she had a very nice way of breaking the bad news.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Meghan Whalen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is always friendly. They are flexible with my hectic schedule. I’ve been going to them for 3 years and always receive great care! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sue roberts

Dr. Hersheal has been excellent throughout the process—very knowledgeable, professional, and attentive. Brooke, the dental assistant, is absolutely amazing and truly goes above and beyond. I really appreciated the transparency around the treatment plan and costs. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a friendly, professional dentist in Round Rock.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucy Castaneda
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Edit 1.19.2026:
Imagine paying $3,000+ for Invisalign only to find out the office skipped you from tray #6 to tray #10 and physically placed it in your mouth. When you raise concerns, you’re told it was just a “human error” and gently nudged to move on.

No — that’s not a silly mistake. That’s carelessness in medical treatment.
The result? Immediate, significant pain, treatment halted, and hours of stress trying to get straight answers in writing. Instead of proactive accountability, everything feels reactive and defensive — as if the priority is minimizing liability, not patient safety.

Aligner treatment relies on precise, controlled movements. Skipping trays is not trivial. Teeth, nerves, gums, and bite alignment are not things you gamble with.

If you’re considering orthodontic treatment here, ask yourself whether you’re comfortable trusting a process where critical checks fail — and where transparency only comes after repeated escalation.

Invisalign is expensive. Dental health is permanent. Choose accordingly.

Feedback: Invisalign is not invisible at all, not their fault, but please know that it will be noticeable until the teeth are kinda fixed. It will hurt. It will be uncomfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I first brought my whole family here for their annual checkups, and it was such a positive experience. From the super friendly front desk to the sweet, professional hygienist, everyone went above and beyond to make us feel cared for.
Dr. Hersheal Aggarwal took his time with each of us, gave honest feedback, and communicated clearly. The detailed imaging and cleanings were thorough and gentle. My kids felt completely at ease.

Later, I came in for two crowns, and this is what I truly want to highlight. Dr. Aggarwal’s skill, confidence, and detail-oriented approach stand out.
He skillfully removed my old onlays, treated the cavities underneath, and scanned, milled, and placed two new crowns, all in one visit, in under two hours.

When I saw my new crowns, I was speechless. The fit and color were flawless, perfectly natural and seamless, aesthetically pleasing like real teeth.
No surprise bills. Everything was explained upfront.

Dr. Hersheal Aggarwal is a dentist who truly knows his craft and invests in his team and tools to deliver exceptional care.

I’m writing this review with no financial interest or prior connection, just honest appreciation for outstanding work and an excellent experience.

Highly recommended 👌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Panelo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
TLDR: 100% no hesitation, be a patient here. I promise you will not find a better team, doctor, office (the vibes are immaculate) or overall experience *anywhere* else.

Alright, buckle up. This is - without question - the most wonderful dental office I have ever been a patient of.

I hadn't found a dentist that I was comfortable with since moving to Texas. I'm weird and I've always been a big fan of dental offices, but when I came in for an exam, cleaning, and suspicions of (first ever) cavities, I was nervous for the first time in my life for a dental visit.

Every. Single. Person. In Here. goes above and beyond for their jobs. From the phone call with Lala alone I was so appreciative of the friendliness I was met with. My first appointment, Brooke and Brandy, as well as Dr. Hersheal Aggarwal, were so kind, personable, and patient. They answered any questions, took their time, and made sure over and over again I was comfortable. Brittney was kind through the checkout process, made sure I had everything I needed, and again made sure that all my questions had been answered.

Yesterday, I had my follow up appointment and my first experience getting fillings for what ended up being two cavities. Again, nervous. This time, Miriyam assisted Dr. Aggarwal with the process. They checked with me to make sure I was comfortable and not in pain throughout the whole procedure, didn't rush any part of it, and were patient with me with any questions I had. I was in the office for less than 30 minutes, and woke up this morning feeling like I didn't even have dental work done yesterday.

This office. This is the office you want to go to. There's a huge difference when you can tell that the people who work there LOVE. THEIR. JOBS. 11/10 would recommend.

Thank you all for the most lovely experience I could ask for at a dental practice. You have a patient/client for life <3

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rajesh Kumar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The first thing you’ll notice when you walk in is “Buy Now, Pay Later” signs everywhere—on your table, at the front desk, and throughout the office. That alone should signal that you’re dealing with salespeople, not just clinicians.

Next,  they will waste your time to present you with a list of “recommended” add-on services—what they call a treatment plan (a practice that regulators should seriously crack down on). They will not perform the procedure you originally came in for unless you agree to purchase these additional services.

They will also refuse to provide a written explanation for why they didn’t do what they were supposed to do. Instead, all you’ll get is a sales pitch—rebranded as a treatment plan.

Before moving forward with any dental work, make sure you get an opinion from a qualified dentist who is not acting as a salesperson. This review exists only because they refused to put their verbal statements in writing. Ask them to write why they are refusing to do what you came in for so that you can share with your Insurance Company & Legal counsel.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ngoc Huynh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been going to Serenity Dental in Round Rock for about two years now, and it’s easily one of the best dental offices I’ve been to. The space is always super clean, and the staff are consistently friendly, professional, and welcoming. They make what is usually a stressful experience feel calm and manageable.

Dr. Hersheal Aggarwal has been wonderful from the start. He’s warm, approachable, and has a gentle way of encouraging better dental hygiene without making you feel judged. Switching to a new dentist can be nerve-wracking, but he made the process easy and comforting.

Over the years, I’ve had cleanings, fillings, and teeth whitening done here. When I was nervous about whitening for the first time, Dr. Aggarwal checked in with me afterwards and helped eased a lot of my concerns. The results turned out great, and I felt well taken care of the entire time.

One thoughtful touch I really noticed is the personalized welcome message with the patient name on the TV every time I come in. There have been a few times they misspelled my name, but they were always receptive and quick to fix it when I brought it up.

Earlier this year, I shared that I had been furloughed, and Dr. Aggarwal generously comped my fluoride varnish. It was such a kind gesture during a difficult time, and it meant a lot more to me than he probably realized.

There’s plenty of parking since it’s located in a large shopping center, and they’ve got a reliable system with email and text reminders that makes scheduling and keeping track of appointments super easy. If you’re looking for a new dentist in the area, I highly recommend Serenity Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hall Patricia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
WOW.... I recommend Serenity to everyone. They understand their assignment from the receptionist , assistant and the dentist. When I'm not treated correctly from the beginning I walk out regardless. I was welcomed in without hesitation or from a rehearsed script. The receptionist asked if I wanted any of their complementary items. The assistant explained everything before,during and after. She was very gentle and took her time without rushing. The Dentist was very informative and took the time to show me a variety of ways we can do things. The Dentist was not concerned about making more money, but what was best for me. He also suggested where to buy my items to save money.

Everything was clean. The complimentary beverage area, refrigerator and coffee machine was clean and well organized not just thrown in. They put effort into the presentation. The presentation was welcoming, represented they care and take pride in all they do. Items were turned forward where I could read them inside the refrigerator. The x-ray coat they put on me, dental chair and the glasses to protect my eyes from the light were clean. The computer key boards were clean in the front and back. The 3D machine was clean and at the bottom where people usually don't clean. The rugs on the floor and the floor was clean even in the high traffic areas and the walls. They treat each other with respect and you can tell the Dentist treats his staff properly. The body language spoke volumes. The Dentist wanted another picture and he did it himself. This showed me he is a team player and not a dictator. They go the extra mile. I can't wait til my next visit. They even welcomed me on the TV screen. That was my first time seeing that personalized with my name and not being generic. They have the updated equipment and that's very important. I was concerned about something and I mentioned it at the end. The dentist said I already have that in my plan. When you find someone who is a perfectionist and about quality work YOU CAN'T GO WRONG IN TRUSTING THEM. There is more I can say but, like I said from the beginning they understand their assignment. I worked as a RDA and being in the office after all these years made me miss being one.

This will be my permanent Dental family. To be honest I felt like I was apart of the family for years. It was only my first time. I don't even write reviews, but this was exceptional service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith Glass
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Serenity Dental is excellent! My first experience began with a simple but extensive online form that eliminated the tedious "in the waiting room, pen and paper" process. I recieved several gentle reminder texts about my upcoming appointment, which was a nice and helpful touch.
Once I arrived at the office,  I was welcomed by a polite receptionist who quickly checked me in. The wait was short and rather relaxing with a comfortable chair and soothing music.
Shortly after settling down in the waiting room, Dr. Aggarwal came out into the lobby to personally greet me and introduce himself. He was welcoming, and made me feel comfortable. Quite unusual for a dental, or any medical practice.
The technician brought me back to the examination rooms and took a battery of xrays and other images. This took a while to complete but was never uncomfortable and resulted in some extremely cool technology.
Using the AI generated images, the  Doctor could quickly see exactly what was going on in my mouth on an easily viewable computer screen.  He was able to move, zoom and rotate the 3D image of my mouth and point out the issues and and quickly assess and precscribe a treatment plan.
In all, Dr. Aggarwal spent more that 50 minutes to explain the issues in layman's terms, and why he was prescribing the specific treatment plan. This enabled me to make an intelligent, informed decision about my care.
Before I left the office, I knew exactly what the treatment process was, and why we were should proceed that direction.  I also understood the approximate out of pocket costs.
Overall, the best "dentist" experience I've had. Very happy so for.

His non-frill comfortable office, warm personality and welcoming staff has just earned 4 new patients. Also, his honest approach and affordable pricing of dental work earn our trust and loyalty!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Story Zanetti
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am TERRIFIED of the dentist. Truly a lifelong fear that has caused a lot of strife throughout my life. So much so that I neglected to go to any dentist for about 4 years, until a few weeks ago I had to schedule an appointment in a hurry for an extremely painful tooth. I was able to get an appointment ASAP at Serenity Dental Studio, at which point I found out I needed a root canal that they were able to perform that day.

Everyone who works there is so kind and so patient. Before my procedure, Dr. Hersheal sat down with me and talked through what they were going to do and how they could keep me comfortable. Just because of the way my mouth is, I ended up needing about 6 total numbing shots before I actually felt numb, but Dr. Hersheal was incredibly patient and attentive the entire time and he made absolutely sure I was completely numb and as comfortable as possible before proceeding. Plus, he checked in with me many points throughout the procedure to make sure I was still doing okay.

They also go over all of the pricing and insurance information with you before performing any procedure, which is truly amazing and something I've never seen anywhere before. They came up with a plan, then showed me exactly how much my insurance would cover and what I would have to pay, before I decided anything.

Honestly, I can't recommend Serenity Dental Studio and Dr. Hersheal enough. I've already switched to have them as my permanent dentist. I'm still pretty terrified of the dentist (I'm not sure that's ever going away), but I'm so grateful to know I'm in good hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Carpenter
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hersheal and his staff are amazing!  Super friendly accommodating and knowledgeable.  My wife and I were extremely happy with the services provided and they really took their time explaining our future treatment plans.  Highly recommended!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone with a lingering fear of dentists, let me just say that they live up to the name. Dr. Hersheal explains everything clearly and simply, he treats patients as individuals with unique roadmaps to health as they define it, and the staff is genuinely kind. I've gone from someone who once avoided any dentist for 10 years and later had only one dentist for over 20 years for fear of change, to trusting Doc enough that I actually dozed off during a procedure. I'm so glad I made the leap to try Serenity. And given my particular goals (mostly around avoiding pain), they have been extremely accommodating to my needs. I may have found my forever dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Distefano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Serenity Dental Studio may have been the actual best experience I’ve had at a dentist office in a long time. They were able to see me last minute on a Saturday for an urgent situation. The staff was so kind and welcoming. Dr. Aggarwal was able to fix the problem immediately. The office is very clean. The visit was efficient. As someone who gets major anxiety going to the dentist, I felt very safe and comfortable with the entire experience. 10/10 recommend and I’ll def be coming back for more dental work!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Eutsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I believe Dr. Hershel was rude and arrogant when I questioned him about the treatment plan that I wanted.  When I made the appointment, I told his staff my main concern was saving my tooth that had a crown. They asked me 2 times why I was there after I arrived including Dr. Hershel. Dr. Hershel looked at the x-ray and said that the decay was too deep and he could not put a crown on it. He said that he recommended pulling the tooth.  I told him that I didn't want implants. He said that was fine. He told me to leave the tooth in and eventually it would cause me pain and have to come out anyway.  I told him that I was going to get a second opinion.  Then, he went over the treatment plan and started trying to talk over my head. I asked him what was the periodontal treatment was.  He went on explaining what I knew about my gums basically needing treatment. Finally, I asked him again to explain the periodontal treatment was and he finally say "in layman's terms a deep cleaning". I was wiling to do the deep cleaning but he started talking about a maintenance plan every 3 months instead of six. I said what if I could not afford that, he told me that was not his concern. I asked him why he could not put a deep filling in the tooth and put on a crown and he told me that eventually I would still have to have the tooth pulled.  I told him that at least I would have my tooth longer.  He told me that that was inferior treatment and we were not a good fit.  I believe what is inferior treatment is being rigid in your thinking and suggesting that I just let my tooth decay until it caused me pain and then pull it instead of removing the decay and filling it so that I could keep it longer without pain.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gerald Carter
user_reviews_extended.Description: We were greeted by the friendly staff and felt welcome as soon as we walked in. Dr. H is great and very professional. I highly recommend this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
An absolutely wonderful, definitely the best dentist I’ve ever been too! If you are looking for someone, please see Dr. Hersheal Aggarwal at Serenity Dental. Truly amazing and here is why-

I recently had the pleasure of receiving dental care at Serenity Dental, and I must say that my experience exceeded all expectations. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and professionalism by the friendly staff, setting the tone for a truly exceptional visit every time.

It's clear that the dentists at Serenity Dental prioritize excellence in every aspect of their work.

Moreover, the team at Serenity Dental, managed to alleviate any concerns I had about the cost of the procedures. They helped me navigate through the financial aspect of dental care, ensuring that I felt comfortable and confident in my investment in my oral health.

In conclusion, I wholeheartedly recommend Serenity Dental to anyone in search of top-notch dental care. Their friendly and helpful staff, commitment to excellence, and personalized approach make them a standout in the field. My experience at Serenity Dental was nothing short of exceptional, and I am grateful to have found a dental office that I can trust wholeheartedly with my oral health. Thank you to the entire team for the outstanding care!

Dr. Hersheal Aggarwal, you are amazing! Special thanks to you for your amazing work and professionalism. Beautiful job on every tooth you worked on. I am truly grateful to have a cavity free healthy smile now thanks to you 😁❤️

I recommend him and his team be your first choice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaliyah Noble
user_reviews_extended.Description: I took my son to Serenity Dental Studio on a Saturday, for a dental emergency. Im we were seen immediately and the staff was all so nice and comforting to him. The dentist was not a pediatric dentist but he was so great with him! He had a marvelous way of exposing to him everything he was doing and putting him at ease! I reccomend making serenity your family dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Description: If you're looking for a skilled, compassionate, and trustworthy dentist, I highly recommend  Dr. Hersheal and his entire team at Serenity Dental Studio !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marissa Pineda
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently took my teenage daughter here, and I must say, it was a truly remarkable experience. user_reviews_extended.Name: Swaiba Hamid
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a routine cleaning appt in October where they spent quite a lot of time talking to me about my teeth, how I need invisalign, need to get teeth removed, and how I need Periodontal Laser Therapy. I've had cleanings every 6 months and no dentist has ever told me that. They spent 2.5 hours with me and went on and on about how good my insurance is and how it covers 50% of orthodontic work and how my teeth aesthetically look fine (l've had braces) but functionally are not and how I could benefit from invisalign. They wanted me to schedule the extraction and the invisalign appts the same day. I told them no l'll scheduled them at a later time.

After leaving this money hungry place I booked a second invisalign consult with a well known orthodontist in the area and she told me I do not need any orthodontic work and my teeth are functionally fine. She also informed me about a cavity I had but the dentist never told me.

Also they have this policy if you book an appt but do not confirm via text or verbally afterwards then they give your appointment to someone else AND charge you a missed appt fee if you don't show up. And if you do show up, they then try to accommodate you and make you wait. They tell you that you don't have a confirmed appt but also charge you a cancellation fee if missed. Make that make sense.

Stay away from this money hungry dentist and practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leland Unruh

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassie Marenco
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing dentistry! The ladies at the front desk are incredibly professional and caring. The office is clean and modern. I highly recommend this place to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evan Varty

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Northup
user_reviews_extended.Description:

Austin you have a great  asset to your community!!
