user_reviews_extended.Name: Emely Carbajal
user_reviews_extended.Description: A great dental clinic with an even greater doctor. I am very pleased with my first Serenity visit, the doctor was very thorough and knowledgeable. The staff was very kind and made my overall experience the best.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cesar
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was there this past Tuesday you feel like in family and they are really professional!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Needah
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is unnecessarily expensive. I went for a limited exam and was charged an outrageous amount, despite their website advertising a first-time patient discount, which they neither mentioned nor honored. I had maxed out my insurance benefits, and because of that, they charged me excessively, even though they are in-network. This seems like a clear example of shady business practices, charging inflated amounts because they aren't bound by insurance limits due to my maxed-out benefits.

Additionally, I requested sealants for a specific part of my tooth and clarified this with both the assistant and the dentist. However, the dentist sealed the entire tooth, claiming it was a legal obligation. There is no such law. Instead of disregarding my request, he could have had me sign a form specifying the surfaces I wanted sealants on. They keep sending me texts asking for reviews, so here is my review.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronika Steele

user_reviews_extended.Name: Saad Q
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update: The pain went away after 3 weeks which the doctor explained can happen some time. I went back to get a filling done. The Dr. took his time and did a great job.

———————
I went in for a simple tooth extraction but the Doctor was struggling to get the tooth out. He tried with lots of force and digging but couldn’t get it out due to tooth being broken. After 15- 20 mins of trying really hard to get the tooth out he decided to section the tooth which worked. It’s been 9 days since and I am still in pain in the gums and also the tooth next to it hurts when I bite down. When I went to the Doctor to ask for prescription pain killer he said to use the over the counter pill.

Details:
I went to Serenity due to pain in one of my tooth. The doctor recommended crown or extraction. The estimate for crown was $2200 while the extraction was ~$500. I decided to get the tooth extracted. Doctor did a great job with numbing the area as I did not feel any pain during the process. However he struggled to get the tooth out and had to use a lot of force and digging causing the gums and the tooth next to it to get damaged and inflamed. It’s been 9 days since the procedure and I am still in constant pain. Tylenol helps for a little bit but not for long. I have a follow up appointment tomorrow.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Rome Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved my visit; the amiable employees, as well as the dentist, were friendly. They were telling me about payment plans. user_reviews_extended.Name: nikoleta konstantoni

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Dr.Hersheal provides patients with advice to be trusted & longevity dentistry to every patient. His passion for helping his patients is apparent with every greeting. As a new dental assistant entering the field 4 years ago, myself was lucky enough be put under Dr.Hersheal’s wing. Secondly, he shared with me some techniques to be conscious of my jaw and how it was opened while brushing that allowed me (probably for the first time ever) to reach some difficult to reach spots on my back teeth. This is huge! He's helping me to have less cavities on those very back teeth. Thirdly I loved how Mikayla flossed my teeth. She was so gentle and didn't take the floss down below the gum line. user_reviews_extended.Name: tanya ibarra
user_reviews_extended.Description:
THE BEST DENTAL EXPERIENCE EVER. Coming from someone who’s only been to the dentist a handful of times and only goes when the pain can’t be ignored. I can honestly say the whole entire team I worked with yesterday at Serenity Dental Studio eased a lot of the anxieties and I am now looking forward to completing my treatment plan ☺️

It was the most thorough and educational exam I’ve ever received. They made sure I understood why the treatment I needed should be done. But there was no pressure, this wasn’t a sales pitch.
They even had time to schedule me in for the first half of my treatment plan the same day I had my new patient exam! (root canal, filling, SRP and gum therapy treatment). I come back next week for the last half of my fillings and I’ve basically knocked out the major parts of my treatment plan in a little over a week. Which is amazing because taking off of work multiple times a week is challenging.

The other concerns I had were payment plans and anxieties around the pain during certain procedures.

- I expressed that my previous dentist doesn’t offer any payment plans which was a big thing for me because I couldn’t afford it out of pocket all at once. Serenity does offer payment plans and they helped guide me through the sign up process which was quick and easy. Phew!
- I requested the nitrous gas just to help calm myself down during the appointment. No pain at all and was so relaxed the whole time! I was in the chair for about 3.5 hours and honestly could have kept going 😂

Thank you so much Dr. Hersheal + team! Every person I interacted with was so warm and welcoming. Everything was 10/10 and I will refer everyone I know looking for a dentist to your office 🪥🦷

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitchell Bowman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hersheal saved me from two root canals!  I went to him for a second opinion after my dentist at a corporate chain told me I needed one, and I wanted to make sure I did, since it's expensive and I had a lot of pain when I had the procedure before.  Dr. Hersheal takes time to explain everything and show you what's going on, discuss options, and is very kind and gentle while doing it!  Thanks to his good work, my teeth are in better shape, I saved loads of money, and didn't have to go through unnecessary procedures that other clinics might recommend because of corporate quotas or incentivization.  It's rare to find a clinic, with doctors who take the time to treat you like a person and not just a number.  I highly recommend Dr. Hersheal!

From the front desk staff, dental assistants and especially Dr Hersheal Aggarwal, everyone is so kind and professional. They work with you on where you are at and don’t push things that are unnecessary.

I had fillings, root canals, Invisalign, crowns, and cleanings here. Dr Hersheal Aggarwal is amazing, he does high quality work and it shows. I had my front 4 teeth redone because they were in such bad shape and honestly I was embarrassed of them for years. Now I have 4 new crows on the front teeth and no one can tell they are not real. He made sure they were good quality and looked perfect.

I highly recommend him to all of my friends/co-workers and anyone who asks about my teeth. If you are looking for a dentist who is honest, personable, and strives for perfection you should switch to this dentist.

I am switching dentists after 30 years! Round Rock is a drive for me but the care at Moment Dental is soooooo worth it!

I highly recommend this practice to anyone in search of a new a new dentist!

user_reviews.Name: Marci
user_reviews.Description: I'm new to Texas, and this was my first dental checkup. Everything about the visit was wonderful! The staff members are warm, patient and very friendly. They work together as a very efficient team, explaining each step in the process and what to expect. Nothing felt rushed. As a first exam, Desiree took 18 X-rays besides a panoramic. I have TMJ and a pretty small mouth, and she was very careful and patient with the process. When I mentioned my concern that my insurance might not pay for such a thorough exam (I've been billed before...)-- and she assured me that I would not be charged above what the company reimbursed them. Emily was meticulous yet gentle cleaning my teeth. I'm sure I've never had a better one! Dr Phan is very friendly. He listened patiently and attentively as I recounted my (rather long-winded) recent dental history. He explained his interpretation of my x-rays and addressed my questions and concerns very thoughtfully. For all the careful attention, would you think I might have been told I needed a bunch of dental work right away? No-- the plan is to watch and wait. My whole mouth is carefully documented, and I'm super happy to have found such a wonderful team of professionals who I can trust, and actually look forward to seeing in six months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caedran Yeidel
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I first came in today, I made mental notes of the names of a couple staff members who I believed deserved some positive recognition, but as my appointment progressed, I found that the amazing care I was receiving seems to be the standard here! Every single person I interacted with today was kind, respectful, and caring. I was seen in a very timely manner, and was even able to do a same day filling. I felt comfortable asking questions and voicing concerns, and the staff addressed me sincerely every time. I would highly recommend Moment Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amira Lambertis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is one of the best dental facilities/dentist I have been to! I've only had positive experiences here. The staff are super friendly and attentive to your needs. They always send out appointment reminders/confirmations which is super helpful. Scheduling is also very flexible if you do need to adjust appointments.

I also got Invisalign through Moment Dental and I am super satisfied with the results! Very excited to have found a place that I can continue to return to for my routine check ups and cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abby Olurin Dames
user_reviews_extended.Description: My concierge booked this Round Rock location in error, but I was pleasantly surprised. I really enjoyed this dentist and the team. The staff was attentive and also gave us grace to get to Round Rock from Manor. The receptionists were also amazing. They were comprehensive and worked with our insurance company and my concierge to sort everything out prior to my arrival. We will likely continue services with them. I would definitely recommend to anyone in the area looking for a great dental team, especially if you have small children.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sydney Kornman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot say too many positive things! I was sent by my regular dentist for a tricky procedure. I was nervous about the whole thing but Dr. Wharton and her staff immediately calmed me, even stopping for a break in the procedure when I felt sick.
Gentle, compassionate, able to explain medical complexities in layman's terms, they even called me the next day to make certain I was okay.
I am switching dentists after 30 years! Round Rock is a drive for me but the care at Moment Dental is soooooo worth it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: J M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely friendly staff, and also very professional. Certain doctor's offices you feel like it's just a business that takes your money and sends you on your way. Moment Dental is nothing like that! They are very patient, and seem like they genuinely care about your dental health and well being. I highly recommend this practice to anyone in search of a new a new dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marci
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm new to Texas, and this was my first dental checkup. Everything about the visit was wonderful! The staff members are warm, patient and very friendly. They work together as a very efficient team, explaining each step in the process and what to expect. Nothing felt rushed. As a first exam, Desiree took 18 X-rays besides a panoramic. I have TMJ and a pretty small mouth, and she was very careful and patient with the process. When I mentioned my concern that my insurance might not pay for such a thorough exam (I've been billed before...)-- and she assured me that I would not be charged above what the company reimbursed them. Emily was meticulous yet gentle cleaning my teeth. I'm sure I've never had a better one! Dr Phan is very friendly. He listened patiently and attentively as I recounted my (rather long-winded) recent dental history. He explained his interpretation of my x-rays and addressed my questions and concerns very thoughtfully. For all the careful attention, would you think I might have been told I needed a bunch of dental work right away? No-- the plan is to watch and wait. My whole mouth is carefully documented, and I'm super happy to have found such a wonderful team of professionals who I can trust, and actually look forward to seeing in six months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: eduardo sandoval
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience as a new patient. The office is very modern and clean, front desk girls are friendly and greet you with a smile, the hygienist was super thorough and personable and Dr. Wharton was very informative and professional. Highly recommend this office for all dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bri Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first visit today after chipping a tooth. They got me scheduled for an appointment within 30 minutes! The reception staff had already verified my insurance upon arrival- so no lingering questions about coverage or costs when I was ready to be seen. Dr. Wharton was amazing. I had expressed a degree of dental anxiety and she went above and beyond in explaining all of my options, what to expect, everything that she was doing, and next steps. I had such a great experience I scheduled a routine appointment in 2 weeks. All of the staff I had contact with were exceptionally kind & knowledgeable. Highly recommend Moment Dental & Dr. Wharton!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Regine
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendliest dentist/dental office l've ever been to! I've been seeing Dr. Phan for Invisalign treatment for the past few months and every visit, the staff have been so friendly. Each of my visits have been quick and efficient and I've had minimal wait time between check in to seeing the doctor. I've never felt rushed during my appointment and always left feeling like I had sufficient time to ask questions about my treatment. I'm very happy with my Invisalign results!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trey Carmichael
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Do not recommend.

Did not get the dentist i had requested which already made me feel uneasy out the gate.

Dentist cut my gum while examining me.

Went ahead and scheduled next steps anyways and they needed to reschedule me to figure out which drugs I needed for a CLEANING. This was frustrating to begin with as I had already organized with my work to make the appointments work.

When I spoke to the front desk about rescheduling I felt they were extremely condescending about it and I will not be returning to this dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linh Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was super nervous for my fillings appointment today . Doctor Phan and especially his assistant were very gentle. They made me feel very comfortable
I also made an appointment to come next week to fix my other fillings that I had years ago from other offices
I also have to mention that the staff are very nice, polite and friendly
I highly recommend Moment Dental. I would give them 10 stars if I could

Thank you doctor and the staff were helping me today!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane J Albright
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had my first dental visit at Moment Dental this morning.  I would give more stars if I could.

All of the staff are friendly and helpful. Best ever hygienist, Emily, I’ve ever had.

Dr Pham was super nice and explained where to focus.

I come back in two weeks to get my night guard. Very cool. They take a scan, creates a 3D picture to make the mold.

My entire fist was pain free!!!

Thank you!
Diane A
♥️♥️♥️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ellis S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
FINALLY found a dentist I liked🙏! Dr Phan took the time to explain everything in detail, ensuring I understood the procedures I needed and felt comfortable throughout the process. Their gentle approach and attention to detail truly made my visit stress-free.

If you're looking for a dentist, I HIGHLY recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cyanide
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience here! These ladies are super kind and friendly to their patients and they always do their best to work around difficulties. It really feels like they genuinely care about the health of their patients teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Prather
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ok..  Let me be honest.  Like many, I didn't used to like going to the dentist.  Notice that is past tense.  Me and my family all now go to Moment Dental and I finally like going to the dentist.  Super convenient location, with a very clean office / waiting area and friendly staff.  Scheduling is really easy and they have great parking.  Pricing was up front and I never felt like they were pushing things I didn't need.  Their staff are great with adults and kids.  I have full confidence that my families dental needs are being taken care of and that gives me a great peace.  Thank you to the Moment Dental Team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Escalante
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter recommended me Moment Dental and today was my first visit at Moment Dental. I went in for a limited consultation because I was having pain on my upper right side. Karina is the front desk dental assistant and she does an amazing job with translating paper work, and speaking fluent Spanish. The assistant Desiree, took my X-rays and was very gentle while doing my X-rays, I felt no discomfort even though I was having pain. Dr.Wharton introduces herself after the X-rays we’re done being taken, and she informed me that I needed extractions, I agreed and luckily they took care of the extractions that same day! Dr.Wharton was very gentle, and careful with my teeth being in pain. Dr. Wharton is the sweetest dentist that I can trust for dental needs. Overall, the staff, and service are great and professional! Moment Dental is well organized.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kev “Kev”
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't thank Dr. Trung Phan and his team enough for the amazing work on my cracked front tooth. I had a pretty rough PK while visiting my friend in Austin, and I was worried about how my smile would look. Dr. Phan was not only professional and skilled but also incredibly kind and reassuring throughout the entire process. My tooth looks as good as new, and I couldn't be happier with the result. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victor Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time patient, went in for a tooth extraction back in January. Dr. Wharton aka Dr. Angel Hands, was phenomenal! Catering to my dentist anxiety, she was super sweet and comforting before, during and after my procedure. Highly recommend...hands down one of the best dentists I've ever visited. Also thanks to all the staff, you all are awesome! See you soon!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Ochoa
user_reviews_extended.Description: As someone who’s always been self conscious about my teeth I was hesitant to visit the dentist. I finally decided to give it a shot and chose Moment Dental. From the very beginning this place has made me feel so comfortable. I’m terrible with names, but from the front desk, to the assistant and hygienist, and the doctor who work here are extremely professional. I am so glad I came here to get the treatments I needed. I would recommend everyone to give this place a visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yuli Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've always had a fear of dentist visits, but my experience at Moment Dental with Dr. Phan has completely changed that. The care and professionalism I received were top-notch, and I left the clinic feeling relieved. I can honestly say that my fear of dentist visits is a thing of the past, thanks to Dr. Phan and the wonderful team at Moment Dental 🥹!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Pham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
As my primary dental provider I trust Dr. Phan with my oral health. He does a great job explaining scans and suggestions to improve my overall dental health and hygiene. Emily cleaned my teeth, she was very gental and routinely checked in with me about how I was feeling 🙂 I really love how friendly the staff is, from the front desk to the doctors.

I reccomend Moment Dental to anyone that’s looking for a new dentist 🦷

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Camargo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience here. The lady named Celine, I hope I spelled that correctly did my 6 month check up and cleaning today. Super friendly and very professional. Had a positive energy and made my teeth look great. Gave me helpful recommendations for my teeth and provided excellent service. She should definitely open her own practice one day!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Art Sketchbooking and Stuff
user_reviews_extended.Description: My youngest had a tooth that needed emergency care. From beginning  to end I was supper impressed. the Staff was soooooo great.  Even thou he had never come to this practice they went out of their way to help. They acted like he was the child in need of care that he was. The dentist was great  with my 8 year old. By the time the visit was over my kid's tooth was fixed. My child was happy talking to the dentist about baseball totally happy and at ease. I was so impressed that we made appointments to have him become the dentist for all my kids.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Martha Studer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred by my Orthodontist for wisdom teeth extraction. The staff was so pleasant and comforting. The office was very clean and nicely decorated. My oral surgery went so fast that when I thought we were just getting started with the extraction I was already done. It was fast and painless. I experienced minimal swelling and very little post op pain. I highly recommend Texas Total Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeniffer Escobedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time patient and I give it a 5 star review. Receptionist, dental assistant, and dentist were very friendly. They made me feel comfortable. My 6 month check up took less then 40 minutes. Their office was nice and clean. I’m glad I found this great place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bradley Duong
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff at Moment Dental is very kind and professional. Dr Phan made the process of getting Invisalign easy and I’m satisfied with the results so far! 10/10 highly recommend for all your dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dewt V
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was due for a cleaning and decided to make my appointment with Moment Dental. It was super easy to schedule over the phone and the front desk lady was so sweet! My first impression of the place is that it is spotless and HUGE. I was escorted inside after filing some paperwork and they got started on me right away! My hygienist was also sweet considering it had been a while since my last cleaning and she was gentle around my problematic areas. I was greeted with Dr. Wharton and she was sooo nice! She took the time to understand my concerns and spoke with such care that I immediately knew I was in good hands. She looked over my root canal that I previously had with another doctor a few years back and reassured me to keep doing what I was doing (yay!)
I scheduled another appointment the following week to restore a cavity and this time I was greeted with Dr. Phan who was equally as sweet and professional. He took the time to fill in my cavity and had a light hand. He and his assistant periodically checked up on me to make sure I was OK and everything went smoothly. Overall, I definitely would recommend Moment Dental to anyone looking for an effiecnt office and doctor who prioritize your concerns!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Gaspard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience today at Moment Dental.  Celine, the hygienist, was friendly, thorough, and gave me several helpful hints for keeping my teeth healthy.  This was my first time to see Dr. Wharton, and I was very pleased.  Overall, an excellent visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ruby Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very pleased coming to Moment Dental. The staff are always friendly making great conversation. My first visit was earlier this year, Karina informed me about their In House Plan, which was very convenient for me since I do not have insurance. The hygienist Celine did a good job on cleaning my teeth.Meeting Dr.Phan on my first visit was a pleasure, very comforting to talk too, very attentive & will go above & beyond regards to your dental health. He informed me I needed some treatment & I came back the next following week. Dr. Phan has a very unique style of dentistry & has the advanced technology such as the digital intraoral scanner that creates 3D dental images of your teeth within minutes! He has such a light hand as he is doing treatment, even during the numbing process I felt nothing! The assistant Desiree did great with making sure I was okay, & she is very friendly. Today I went for my recall, and Emily was my hygienist, she is such a sweet girl & very gentle with cleaning my teeth, I enjoyed talking to her about anything. Dr. Phan comes in to do my check-up & everything looks great yay!! I highly recommend Moment Dental & you will not be disappointed with staff & service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Zhou
user_reviews_extended.Description: Sooo happy I found this clinic to do my Invisalign treatment! I’m really pleased with how it’s progressing. I’m normally scared to go to the dentist but staff was so nice and professional here. I highly recommend this place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A D
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just had my first visit! The staff is patient, kind and knowledgeable. I highly recommend Texas Total Dental!
ONE YEAR LATER: My husband is very pleased with the service he received. The doctor was very patient and caring. The staff was EXTREMELY patient and kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elena Ladd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called as a new patient and they was able to schedule me at same day for my cleaning appointment. Dental hygienist, Leslie is thorough, along with being gentle in her check-ups and cleanings. Dr Gulati, not only explained each step of my dental priority but also recommended me natural treatment for my high blood pressure. I highly recommend Texas Total Dental in Round Rock.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Gardner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Dr. Wharton for years and she's the best dentist I've ever had -- warm, caring, and incredibly competent. When I told Dr. Wharton about my refugee friends in dental pain, she did not hesitate to help. She and Dr. Phan helped four refugees with all their fillings dental pain pro-bono. They were so patient and kind to the patients. And they ended patients' pain and infection. Our community is lucky to have these heroes!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Liliana Varone
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am new to the area and was having a hard time finding a new dentist while having tooth pain, especially during the Covid-19 pandemic. They got me in right away and helped me get my insurance figured out and get started with a root canal and establishing future dental care. The staff is so helpful and kind. The doctor is very gentle and kind as well. I am very happy I came across Texas Total Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: E T
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office was clean and welcoming, making me feel comfortable throughout the visit. Highly recommend for anyone looking for top-notch dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dr A
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dabney is an amazing Dentist. He is a highly experienced dentist who is excellent at diagnosing and planning treatment. He is also a very caring and honest man. I brought my Mom who had sensitivity in some of her teeth. Dr. Dabney diagnosed the problem and explained it very well. He also recommended the best treatment. My Mom and I were so happy with him. His staff was also very nice and understanding. I highly recommend Texas Total Dental to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danyel Cake
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to Dr. Paul Dabney with my daughter for a second opinion on a treatment plan another Dentist had put together. He was very helpful & kind. He told me what he would do if she were his daughter. It was a great first impression of him & the ladies who worked in the office as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Langley
user_reviews_extended.Description: Celine gave me the best teeth cleaning I’ve ever had! Thank you, Celine! Dr. Wharton was thorough and offered options for further dental care to address my needs. Super nice front office staff. Great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allan Recto
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience. Went for dental cleaning and oral exam. Emily, dental hygienist, was excellent. Dr. Wharton, dentist, did comprehensive exam and discussed treatment plan well. Front desk staff are very friendly. Highly recommend Moment Dental. Exemplary service, caring staff, clean and very nice dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zakariah Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience.  The hygienist, Leslie, was GREAT!  She explained what she was doing, was reassuring, and took time to answer any questions.  The Dentist was also fantastic!  For once I did not leave the dentist hating it and dreading going back in 6 months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angela Bryant
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Paul Dabney is awesome very down to earth dentist that seem to really care about his patients. Very humble and kind. Dr. Dabney and his staff are great people! Great environment.  Very nice and polite I'm usually nervous going to dentist but, felt comfortable at dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jasmine Stelker
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was wonderful.  My kids were seen quickly with almost no wait.  The dentist and hygienist treated my children with wonderful care.  My kids actually enjoyed going to the dentist and loved all of the friendly team members!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ye Eun Oh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I definitely recommend here. Staffs are so kind. My 6years old son hates to go to the dentist. But he was totally fine this time because Dr.Dabney was so nice to him and did good care. I already recommend to my friend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maxwell Kaiser
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys rule. Had a root canal scheduled but I was going through too much pain so Dr. Trang (sp?) came in ON HIS DAY OFF to do my procedure a few days early. Hygienist and reception were also very friendly and informative. Awesome membership plan saves you a bunch of money as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been to a better detail office. They worked with me on my specific needs. I had both cleaning and treatment done, and I will never go anywhere else. I don't feel like a number in the Texas Total Dental. All the staff are caring and thoughtful. They do excellent work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hoang-Anh Levo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm terrified of dental visits but Moment Dental makes these visits so easy and enjoyable. Staff is top notch and Dr. Wharton and Dr. Phan are both thorough and gentle. Thank you for making over my smile with gorgeous veneers!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie H
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just got my root canal done here and everything went great. The Dr. made sure the root canal went perfect, and the dental assistant helped make me feel comfortable. I have no plans on finding a new Dentist any time soon for sure!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hated any type of dentist visit. No matter what the issue was.. Dr Gulati and his assistant by the name Leana were by far amazing. Changed my whole outlook and gave me the best care. For comfort Dr. Gulati put on J.Cole for me to listen to while he did what he needed to do. Made sure I was well taken care of. I highly recommend this place for they actually care for you and want you to be as comfortable as possible. Thanks guys. Really.

user_reviews_extended.Name: clarrissa carrillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Gulati and his staff are the best. I had a great experience at their office.  Leslie the hygienist is very gentle, thorough and has a kind and lovely demeanor.  I highly recommend Texas Total Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edward W
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fastest most efficient care I have recieved from any dental office. The staff was very courteous and took the time to explain the costs and insurance coverage. I was impressed with the quality of care and I will return for future services.

user_reviews_extended.Name: dixi leigh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. LaPratt was my first dentist here and he wasn’t amazing nothing ever went wrong. In october i went and there was a new dentist, very young Dr. Gulati i think? he was very nice but i had two cavities that he fixed and put fillings in, numbed me up real good but left the biggest bruise ever (i’ve never had a bruise inside my mouth from getting cavities fixed) put the needle between my teeth which i’ve never had done before either. i was in pain for about a week and went back so he could file them down (which i’ve never had to go back to file a filling down) two months later and i can’t chew on the left side of my mouth, i haven’t eaten anything on that side for two months, i reached in my mouth and pulled the entire filling out (which is now causing more pain)
my sister also had a chipped tooth and got it fixed, she bit into a soft pizza after two months and it came out as well..

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalia Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Unfortunately I’ve had my fair share of dental work done over the years.  However, my experience with this dental office has been the very first and only experience where I left in worse shape than I came.  Every tooth this doctor touched is now useless to me. It’s been two weeks and i can’t even eat a sandwich without irritating the teeth he worked on.  I went in for 7 teeth fillings and left feeling like I had just gotten 7 root canals.  I can appreciate confidence in any profession, but the doctor at Texas Total Dental is instead very arrogant,  added to the fact that he is clearly young and inexperienced. I ended up in The Emergency room days after my visit, where i was then advised to Followup with the dentist.  The follow up was pointless as he dismisses any chance that something he did , or failed to do, was the cause of the tremendous amount of pain I’m in, after FILLINGS.  His assistant focuses on being quick versus being careful. I still have hanging pieces of my gum just from her not being able to wait for me (numb) to fully open my mouth before yanking the tools out.  Also, it’s no suprise to me that I’m experiencing severe pain in the areas where I had to be numbed.  The doctor would insert the needle into my gums and then look away. Look away At god knows what, but everytime he looked away the needle shifted, leaving me in the position to either risk moving to tell him it shifted or stay still don’t say anything to make sure it doesn’t shift any more. Here we have an office full of amateurs who operate as if they have the entire scope of dentistry mastered.  I hope if anything this review helps them to tighten up on the minor things so that the big things don’t go wrong. It is unfortunate that I feel I am one of those big things because honestly I can’t eat anything without sharp pain in my teeth that I DIDNT experience before visiting Texas Total,  and I’ll likely be on pain medication long term.  I do not recommend this office to anyone needing serious dental work until they get the minor details under control.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Barber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place and service. The staff is insanely polite and are very sweet. The dentists doing my procedure was swift, effective and gentle. They are very well experienced and clean.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A. Saint
user_reviews_extended.Description: Beyond amazed!! The staff was the sweetest and the Dr was so down to earth. They made us feel comfortable cuz let be honet usually dentist make you feel intimidated. But not here. Will be coming here as long as he is in practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariel Kao
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently had an emergency dental issue that left me in severe pain.  Dr. Wharton was incredibly thorough in assessing my condition and literally saved me. Thank you sooo much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Appointment started on time.  Staff was great.  Quick and comfortable.  Myself and my husband have been very happy with Texas Total Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhema S.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in early in the morning for a routine check-up and the staff was very nice, quick, and very professional. I was a little nervous about my teeth, but they gave great information!

user_reviews_extended.Description: What my kids got referred over here by a family member this is my son's second time appearing at this dentist place and he needed his teeth fixed really bad so this time he went in there they fixed half of his mouth and Lord Jesus I cannot recognize my son mouth at all that woman Emily she paid attention in class the people there are so nice respectful but that girl Emily I had to tell her I love her she hooked my son all the way up so y'all need to go there if your mouth is jacked up Emily will fix you up the doctors will fix you up I praise this place this is the best dentist that I have ever been to the staff are very nice I mean very very nice you can hook up to free Wi-Fi well spending time there and they take new patients they do not turn no one away love this place love love love this place the Dr name is Trung Phan

user_reviews_extended.Name: Judith Avent
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dentist is friendly, competent and professional.  Office staff is great.  I have had no problems and prefer them over my prior dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joana S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everybody is very friendly.  The Dr and dental hygienist were very helpful and patient.  I'm definitely going back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Rolph
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have yet to meet the dentist, but the hygenist is brilliant, the best I've ever had. She assures me the dentist is very good and she's worked with him for 15 years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Tribett

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonia Maldonado

user_reviews_extended.Description: The process for fillings was quick and painless, and Dr. Phan made sure I was comfortable every step of the way.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rusty Wood
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Texas Total Dental is amazing. They were able to work me in. Super friendly staff. Love the doc’s demeanor.

Great place

user_reviews_extended.Name: Victor Calzada
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Came in and found out is no longer Texas Total Dental, went in anyways for a quick clean service. $149.99

user_reviews.Description:

user_reviews.Name: tiffany hubert
user_reviews.Description:
I have been going to The Smile Spot with my children for many years, and I honestly can’t say enough good things about them. My journey with this office started over 10 years ago, during a very difficult time in my life. I was a single mom, in pain, and not taking care of myself the way I should have been. I truly hated my smile back then.
From that first visit, The Smile Spot helped change everything. Through treatment, long-term support, and eventually Invisalign, they didn’t just fix my teeth — they helped me rebuild my confidence. Today, I smile freely and proudly, something I never thought I’d say.
Walking into this office feels different. Being greeted by name, sometimes even with a hug from my dentist and the team, means more than I can explain. There is no fear, no shame — just kindness, compassion, and genuine care.
Dr. Vuu and Ms. Theresa deserve the highest praise. I’ve known them for years, and their warmth and understanding carried me through some of my hardest days in ways they may not even realize. They truly healed more than just my smile.
Thank you to The Smile Spot and the entire staff for creating such a welcoming, supportive environment and for helping me love my smile again. I’m forever grateful. 💙

user_reviews.Description: Excellent staff and dentist. Dr. Ahmed is excellent and makes sure to explain the treatment plan very well. He's efficient and quick and the visits are never too long. 10/10 recommend.

Dr.Sam & Vanessa were wonderful! They did an excellent cleaning and offered solutions to problems that may affect me in the near future. Definitely would recommend to friends and family!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an absolutely fantastic experience with Dr. Sam and his team at this dentist office! The entire staff exceeded all my expectations in every way. From the moment we walked in both dental assistants, Anna and her teammate, were incredibly accommodating, understanding, and patient, especially considering the fact that I had four energetic children with me. They effortlessly managed to see all of my rambunctious little ones at the same time, which was truly remarkable.
Not only was I impressed by their ability to handle multiple children simultaneously, but I was also thrilled that they accept new patients with Medicaid. This made the whole process so much easier for me. The staff truly goes above and beyond to make their patients feel comfortable and well-cared for.
One thing that really stood out to me was the extra effort they put into keeping my children entertained. Gina had thoughtfully prepared goody bags, balloons, and even brought out a microphone which instantly put smiles on my kids' faces. It made the dental visit feel like a fun and exciting adventure for them.
Furthermore, Carina made the scheduling process an absolute breeze. She was prompt and efficient in finding a suitable appointment time, and thanks to her excellent communication, there weren't any hiccups or confusion on the day of the appointment.
Overall, I can't recommend this dentist office enough. The staff's amazing attitude, their willingness to accommodate my children, their acceptance of new patients with Medicaid, the thoughtful entertainment they provided, and their smooth scheduling process all combine to create a truly exceptional dental experience. I am beyond grateful to have found such a wonderful dental practice for my family!

I cannot say enough about our positive experience and we have now found a new dentistry home.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am beyond thrilled to have found Smile Spot after a disappointing experience with another dental office. My journey to Smile Spot was prompted by a series of frustrations – from a previous dentist's delayed response and inflated pricing to a lack of organization and an arduous process for obtaining my records.

Enter Smile Spot – a true breath of fresh air! From the moment I spoke to their receptionist, Alexis, I felt assured that I was in capable and caring hands. Alexis effortlessly guided me through the process, leaving no room for hidden costs or confusion. The professionalism and hospitality they exhibited were truly remarkable.

Upon my visit, I was pleasantly surprised by the minimal wait time, a stark contrast to my previous ordeal. The office ambiance was inviting, coupled with the latest technology, including their efficient messaging system for appointment reminders.

Dr. Anna, my dentist at Smile Spot, embodied a wealth of knowledge. What impressed me most was her ability to communicate findings and recommendations without any sense of pressure. This aspect was refreshing and truly appreciated.

I'm excited to declare that I've not only found a dental office I can wholeheartedly trust, but one I'm enthusiastic to recommend to my friends and family. Smile Spot's attention to detail, commitment to a clean and appealing facility, and dedication to cutting-edge technology have won me over completely. Thanks to the entire team at Smile Spot, dental visits have transformed from a chore to an experience I look forward to.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Our visits today was awesome! I see why The Smile Spot has 5 star reviews. They continue to give you courtesy reminder calls for your scheduled appointment. user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie D
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Saw Dr. Costa as a new patient needing a routine cleaning and received a suggested treatment plan that was completely excessive.  I was told I needed 6 fillings, a crown, and a deep cleaning (not a regular cleaning).  Oh, and I should consider getting my wisdom teeth pulled (I'm in my 40's and haven't had anyone recommend I have them pulled before).  I told Dr. Costa I was quite shocked with his assessment as I go to the dentist twice a year and up until this visit, thought I had relatively healthy teeth.  He stated dentistry is subjective and some dentists are more cautious.  I asked him to work up the pricing for his plan and that I would consider it in the future, but that today I just wanted a regular teeth cleaning.  He said OK and left the room. Fast forward 30 minutes and I'm still sitting in the chair, waiting.  I ask the guy who did my x-rays when we were going to begin and he said someone needed to come in and go over the treatment plan.  Tired of waiting and wondering what in the heck is going on, I finally got up and walked out to the front desk and the office manager, Megan, informed me that unless I would do the deep cleaning, they were not going to perform any work on me "due to malpractice concerns."

I told her I had concerns about the treatment plan and wanted to simply have a regular cleaning.  I told her I had already discussed this with Dr. Costa, so she said she would go talk to him, but when she came back her answer was the same.  They would not treat me unless I did a deep cleaning.  I informed her I was not doing the deep cleaning and inquired as to what she was going to do about processing a claim since I was now going to have to find another dentist and start the process over, and she told me "WE WON'T BE SUBMITTING A CLAIM FOR YOU."

Fast forward to today when I saw another dentist (who was wonderful, by the way and who didn't recommend anything other than I come back in 6 months for my next cleaning.  Incredible, huh?  You would have thought my teeth were falling out after what Dr. Costa came up with.)  The new dentist informed me I was going to have out of pocket expenses since there was a claim filed for x-rays and an exam within the last 6 months by Smile Spot. I called Smile Spot and spoke with Megan.  I reminded her what she told me about not filing a claim, and she stated I had been asking about the charges for the cleaning (Umm, no.  There wouldn't have been any charges for a cleaning SINCE YOU DIDN'T PERFORM ONE.  Why would I have asked about that???).  She apologized that she gave me misinformation but said Dr. Costa decided to process the claim.

Here is the biggest Red Flag ever.  I asked to speak with someone in charge of the practice who could get involved to reverse that decision under the circumstances and reimburse my insurance company.  Megan tells me there are 4 owners and they all have to be in agreement.  She also tells me I can't speak to any of them about this because they don't get involved in financial conversations with patients.  I told her this was really a customer service conversation since the practice did not do what I was told they were going to do.  She said she would pass my request along about speaking to someone, and MAYBE Dr. Costa would decide to call me back.  Folks, if a business owner won't engage his/her customers and actually talk to them when they raise concerns, this shows you they don't care about you and just want your money.  If Dr. Costa really cared about me as a patient, he would have had a discussion with me about my concerns face-to-face.  He had two opportunities when I was in his office to do just that and he shuffled me off to the office manager who couldn't medically speak to my concerns.  And now that we've determined they lied (or at the very least, misled me) about the claim processing, I get screened out and can't even talk to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience from the front desk Gina, to the back staff Anna/Jorge . Dr.Vuu was awesome. Explained everything and answered all my questions. My kids for once said they actually liked going to the dentist!

Dr. Andy Yassa muy profecional y amigable staff, siempre satisfecha con el servicio otorgado por esta oficina dental  los recomiendo ampliamente.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Barbosa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Este lugar es divino mi hija viene aquí desde que tiene 2. Años  y ha sido increíble

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raquel González
user_reviews_extended.Description: Muy buen servicio, muy amables y con facilidad de dejarnos satisfechos con lo que yo acepte en hacer el tratamiento, todos desde que se registra hasta el dentista y su ayudante🥰🙏🏻

title: University Dental
address: 200 University Blvd #340, Round Rock, TX 78665, United States

user_reviews.Name: Sheila Jones
user_reviews.Description: Come here if you want dentists who truly care, take time to explain everything in a way you can understand, and make every visit a pleasant experience. They always make sure I’m comfortable and at ease (I have a very low pain tolerance), and they consistently make me feel like my experience genuinely matters. From start to finish, the whole team is kind, patient, and professional. I've had many dentists throughout the years and have NEVER been treated this way. Dr. Naik and Dr. Angela Niknam are rare gems!

user_reviews.Name: DD's House
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been going to University Dental for over 10 years, and they are absolutely the best! The whole team is friendly, straightforward, and honest. They always take the time to listen to what I want and make me feel comfortable. I couldn’t imagine going anywhere else.

user_reviews.Name: SkyeArte (Skye)
user_reviews.Description: My parents, myself, and now my spouse have been getting work done here for as long as I can remember. This practice puts you and your comfort first, not their bottom line. I was genuinely shocked seeing how people were being treated elsewhere due to how amazing the staff here has been to me on every visit. I highly, *highly* recommend this office to anyone looking for a long-term dentist. For the procedures they cannot do, they have equally amazing practices they refer to.

user_reviews.Name: Don Zuckerman
user_reviews.Description: Have a long dental history with lots of ups and downs, psychologically hate going to Dentist.  Dr Nikam's friendliness, warm demeanor and honest approach to things made my visit great.  My first visit was thorough, with a full discussion of my history and a detailed professional exam that included me in as a participant.   Even with work to be done was a very relaxed experience.

user_reviews.Name: ABHIKALP M
user_reviews.Description: Very pleased with our visit.  The entire staff is very patient and hospitable. Dr. Angela is extremely polite and helpful. She is very knowledgeable and straightforward. We felt we were getting a genuine advice on every step. They made us feel very comfortable. Highly recommend for those looking for great care and attitude. Thank you University Dental team !

user_reviews.Name: Tina Auer
user_reviews.Description: Everyone, from the receptionist to the hygienists and dentists themselves, is incredibly friendly and professional. They take the time to explain everything clearly and answer any questions you might have. Both dentists are knowledgeable, gentle, and truly care about your dental health. Dr. Niknam is amazing!! She discovered an issue that many other dentists had missed. For that I am truly grateful! I highly recommend this dental practice.

user_reviews.Name: Sarah Garza
user_reviews.Description: I'll start by sharing that I've hated going to the dentist my whole life; I've been known to cry at teeth cleanings. I told all of this to the team when I first came to University Dental and they went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable. I thought maybe I received special treatment that first time but I've been going consistently for a few years now and every visit has been just as good. The entire staff just seems happy with what they do every day. I would highly recommend University Dental.

user_reviews.Name: Sabine McCalla
user_reviews.Description: University Dental is fantastic. My dental hygienist, Shermance, is upbeat and fun and makes a "not so fun" experience much less daunting. The dentist himself is friendly and makes you feel comfortable. I was afraid of going to the dentist most of my life - not anymore, thanks to the friendly and empathetic staff. And one thing I appreciate as a professional: Their time management. I barely have to wait.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nolan Baack
user_reviews_extended.Description: I loved my experience at University Dental. Natasha was my dental assistant, and I cannot praise her enough! Super friendly and personable, as well as knowledgeable and professional. Excellent service, I 100% recommend University Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaelie “Kae”
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can say enough incredible things about this office! I stayed away from dentists for 10 years out of fear but found these amazing people four years ago, they make me feel so comfortable and actually excited about going in whether it's a routine checkup or fillings/something bigger. I know that they will take care of me and the costs are extremely reasonable! I highly recommend University Dental to anyone when they mention needing a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very good dentists.  Angela Niknam is my dentist and I consider myself fortunate.  She always takes the time to explain everything and gives you all of the appropriate options.  She does quality work and the staff are friendly and professional.  Really could not ask for more.  I look forward to my visits here. I consider them to be friends as well as my dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marilyn Landes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely wonderful experience here today! My husband has been a patient here for years and today was my first visit. Great bedside manner from the dentist and her assistant. She was very  gentle when performing the periodontal cleaning. I’m extremely happy with the service and outcome today! I highly recommend going to University Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Chaney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Found University Dental after I was referred there by a family member. Which in itself is a review. The office is clean, the staff is attentive, and there is no crazy wait times, and everyone is very friendly. When they set up my appointment I think I waited maybe 5 minutes before they called me back. They will even put on a cancelation list so if an opening comes open and you can get in earlier they will let you know! The hygienist was very thorough and friendly, and the doctors there are very friendly and take their time answering any questions you may have. They are very good with my children too, which is a big plus!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doctor_KM
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire family has been going here for 7-8 years now, since we moved to the area, and not once have we ever left feeling anything other than respected, appreciated and supported. While other dentists might make you feel like they need you to supplement their vacation home, I've never felt pressured to do work that didn't actually need to be done, and in fact they've suggested not doing work at times, until it's really necessary. Throw in the fact that everyone there is pleasant and delightful, and I can't recommend them more highly. I even talked other local family members into going there, when there are dentists much closer to their homes, and they've been nothing but happy as well.  100% recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kate Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description: Can't say enough good things about University Dental!! I've been going here for years now and everyone is super friendly and they have always made me feel very comfortable. Mackenzie specifically is awesome and had me cracking up the entire time I was there! She was very personable and it felt more like I was catching up with a friend than getting my tooth fixed. Although Dr. Naik and Dr. Niknam are both incredible and have always done great when taking care of me, I still get a bit nervous when going to the dentist (it's not you, its me lol). But Mackenzie made me feel very at ease and helped me enjoy my time there even more! Thank you all for everything you do :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wendy Foley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this group! I initially came in after being new in town and having a nightmare experience with another dentist in Austin. Everyone on the staff was very kind, understanding & professional... and they remain to be so. Everyone is great at what they do, don't push unnecessary services, and give you a ton of options that allow you to make an informed decision on any major work/procedures. My husband and I recommend them to everyone in town, and will continue to be patients of theirs so long as they continue to practice. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Love
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I love this place!! Who says that about a dental office?

I’ve had the worst luck with dentist over the course of 20+ years. Until now… Dr. Niknam and her team (shout out Natasha) are the best.  My dental anxiety is gone!

Thanks for being the best!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Barkley
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I have used University Dental for several years now and highly recommend them. Both dentists are honest, helpful, kind, personable, and I trust their treatment recommendations. The staff is friendly and helpful as well. Great place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeff Naugle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this Dental practice.  My dental hygenists, Amber is not only great at cleaning teeth, but is super personable and educates you so nicely on caring for your gums and teeth.  Their Dentists are conservative and don't push you into crowns and fillings.  They're all great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny Cable
user_reviews_extended.Description: University Dental is the best I have ever experienced in my 71 years.  As a retired military member, of course, I used the military dental facilities until my retirement and then used a couple civilian facilities before I moved to Georgetown.  My first experience with Dr. Naik was when one of my teeth broke while eating out.  They took me right in and built an overlay while I was in the chair.  I have since required another overlay and they took me in again on short notice.  I have also had two implants with them.  They are super friendly, polite and efficient.  They always asked about my wife since she is also one of their patients.  I think I make my previous dentist mad when I told him how great University Dental is (too bad).  Obviously I recommend them to anyone needing dental care.  Also, Scarlet is a great office manager and you have got to love her!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Suresh Pen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Though I am on and off to visit this place so far, my family goes here for the last 10+ years. I went today after 4 years gap, I got my appointment real quickly and when I went their I got a very good service. Hygienist Amber did an awesome job. She was patiently (close to an hour) addressed all my dental needs. I recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: maryann (Maryannofgeorgetwn)
user_reviews_extended.Description: The doctors and dental assistants alike are kind and seem genuine in their concern about your wellbeing.  I highly recommend University Dental for any people who have been "oversold" on getting teeth fixed that don't necessarily need fixing.  They make you feel very comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alisa Tate
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an emergency situation a cracked front tooth, and a toothache. They were able to schedule me the next morning. I end up needing root canal and a filling. They were able to do it all in the same day ,fast pain free and now I have my front tooth back and it looks amazing! I am so grateful to the whole team staff and doctor Naik. One of the best dentist experiences.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marlene Vidal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Postpartum depression had me not being able to complete proper dental hygiene. I used to go to another dentist complaining about teeth pain for 2 years & he kept telling me I had no cavities. When a tooth broke in half, I knew it was time to change Dentist. I feel so lucky to have found Dr. Niknam. She has been so kind and fixed all of my dental issues. I don't feel judged when I'm in her care. Her staff is nice as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shreha Mittal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I needed immediate treatment for my tooth, and Dr. Nicknam and her staff were amazing. They were really warm, patient and explained everything to me really well. They extracted my tooth and it was done in no time. I felt very relaxed under their observation. Thank you so much Dr. Nicknam and staff for your help and for treating me so well. 😊🤗

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to University Dental for many years and have always had a good experience. The staff and the dentists are always courteous and seem to enjoy what they are doing. I always feel like I'm a patient and not a sales opportunity for them like I've felt at other dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabelle Tolbert
user_reviews_extended.Description: They did a wonderful job with my five year old daughter and made her appointment a great experience. I think she might want to be a dentist now! They even managed to get myself in before the end of the year. Friendly staff and doctors. Simply can not recommend enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheri Rumsey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never found a dental office that I would return to until I found University Dental! The people that work there are so down to earth and inviting, I just don’t dread going in for my cleanings and check-ups! I recommend them to everyone who is looking! From the from check-in to check-out everyone is so kind and you feel like they care, and they genuinely do❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Weber
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found University Dental about 5 years ago.  I was looking for a near by dentist with a good reputation.  A friend of mine that is a dental technician who builds crowns, bridges, etc. for local practices suggested I try them out.  I have been very pleased with every visit.  Fortunately I have pretty healthy teeth for a guy my age.  Most of my appts are simple cleanings.  I always have the same hygenist who is friendly and welcoming.  They have always been on time with my appointment where I have never waited for more than a few minutes to be called back.  Both of the dentists are friendly and informative about what's happening with my dental health and ways to insure I keep my teeth for a very long time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gilbert Traverse
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred here after having some issues with my previous dentist and my first time coming to the office was to have a very deep cavity filled. I was really nervous and was dreading it all week.  Dr. Angela Niknam and Tammy were fantastic! I didn't feel a thing...not even the numbing shot. And to top it all off,  the cost was very reasonable. Much better than my old dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael P. Forbes
user_reviews_extended.Description: The finest dentists I or my family have ever engaged. Both Dr.Niknam and Dr. Naik are truly wonderful and their expertise far outweighs many others in the field. They are up-to-date and well-educated in the modern practice of dentistry. The staff are welcoming, friendly and very professional. A shout out especially to Scarlett, as part of a proficient and accommodating front office. We love everything about University Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shahed Zaman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going here with my family for 10 years. Dr. Naik & Dr. Niknam are excellent dentists. They are always available for any emergency.  Dental hygienists are always friendly and do a great job.  They have Keurig coffee flavors (pre-pandemic), WIFI, and a spacious office.  Scarlett at front desk is very approachable and easy to work with.  You are in good and reliable hands here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elmira Richburg
user_reviews_extended.Description: Let me start off by saying that I have high anxiety when it comes to going to the dentist. I absolutely hate it... with a passion. Like, hate it. Dr. Naik has been so great in taking that into consideration and helping me try different things to calm me down. I had a lot of work that needed to be done. He laid out a plan and worked with me on putting that plan into motion. I’ve been a patient of his for 2 years, now going to the dentist isn’t awful for me. I no longer break into sweats and get nervous. From his front office ladies, dental hygienist, dental assistants... they are all great! Thank you for easing my fears of going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danny Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: I arrived a little and was met with  friendly faces and smiles and I had my paperwork already done so I took a seat in the very clean waiting area.  I was taken back right on my appointment time so no unnecessary siting around.  Tech was awesome she explained all she was going to do while taking my Xrays and taking vital signs.  Doctor came in very friendly and explained all he was going to do and the experience was excellent.  Nice easy going explain all they are going to do and did it in a timely manner.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elissa Frias
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I tell you I HATE the dentist I actually hate the dentist. For years I put work off because I just don’t like going. My mom & brother both recommended University Dental and I had a chipped tooth so I had no choice but to go. I’ve been to 3 separate appts so far with another happening soon. Everyone here is amazing!!! Dr. Nicknam has given me a root canal & fillings. She’s been fast & efficient. I truly LOVE this dentist. Thank you for the amazing service!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Allison
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough good things about this dentist office from the staff to the doctors everyone is wonderful! I will forever recommend them to anyone who asks for a dentist. You won’t find a better office, I promise. Love these folks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Landes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming here for years. Dr. Naik and his team are the only ones I trust to work on my teeth. I have been to other dentists in the past that tried locking me into ridiculous plans or weren’t as thorough with cleanings. Not here. They are honest and I always leave knowing everything was done correctly and that I’m not being sold procedures that I really don’t need. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karyn Tham Desai
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Niknam & Dr. Naik are awesome! My dad was here visiting from out of state and had issues with his dentures. They were able to fit him in and address his issues right away. They are kind and super caring and made my dad feel at ease. Love that team and their office staff - they’re great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mark Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been seeing dentists at least every 6 months for 60 years.  I've had good dentists and bad, but I have found the dentists at University Dental to be friendly and professional and great at their craft.  They've been straight shooters and honest with me.  When work has been required, it has been painless.  I have never had any reason to feel the slightest bit of mistrust . . . a first for me after seeing dentists for 60 years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina Jeffcoat
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Restored Faith!!
I have had some pretty awful experiences with dentist and dental offices in the past.  The staff and dentist at University Dental completely restored my faith in how a dental office should treat their patients.  Every staff member greeted me with a smile and hello, even if they were just walking by.  The assistant, dentist and insurance lady were extremely knowledgeable.  I was't made to feel bad about myself or my teeth.  They actually listened to me, guided me and we came up with a plan TOGETHER! I didn't feel any pressure!  Thank you University Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lilia Macon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the relaxed, client centered, highest quality care, this practice provides.  I have had major and extensive dental work throughout my lifetime and my visits here are much less tense, and at times the staff makes them a bit fun.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Bostick
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot sing the praises of these wonderful dentists and staff enough!  After an accident over 35 years ago, I have had my share of dental work.
Along with the shaming and anxiety associated with major work.  I have never felt pressured or uncomfortable in their office.  Dr Naik has taken the time to explain every procedure and answer all the questions I have ever had.  I am so grateful for the kindness that accompanies the amazing skill in this office.  It is a rare find to have both qualities in one place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have had to try out several different dentists within the past 1.5 years because of Covid and insurance changes, but tried this place and loved it! The staff is super friendly, office is clean, and no crazy wait times. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kat
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the staff here! Both dentists and all of their hygenists have been great. My husband and I both go, and began taking our daughter here about a year ago after an unhappy experience with the pediatric dentist we were using. My daughter had a cavity in two teeth that were very crowded and touching. Dr. Niknam did an amazing job, especially considering that my daughter waa 4 abd a total wiggle worm. Kelly cleans my daughter's teeth and is AMAZINGLY patient and informative to her. In fact, my daughter even left her last cleaning telling me how she now had a job at the dentist's office. Her new favorite game is to play dental hygenist and pretend to clean my teeth. The dentists are always very knowledgable and helpful. They have patients for life with us!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bernice Ermis
user_reviews_extended.Description: So I've had some medical things going on for like two years and forgot to go to my appt and then rescheduled and canceled again.  Anyway, I finally went today to get my cleaning and felt so good to see everybody again.  The whole office is just wonderful people that feel like your best friends.  I'll be going back in Nov to get some things done and then cleaning again in May of 2018!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hal Shackelford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was able to schedule an appointment at my convenience, arrived on time and hygienist put me in the dental chair immediately.  No waiting whatsoever!  Complete set of X-rays were taken, all fillings were checked for any deterioration since last visit (one year ago) , no new cavities discovered by the dentist and out the door in less than one hour. Paid a reasonable fee which included a "Mature American Discount"...LOL!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki DeLeon
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dentist had to close and referred me to Dr Niknam. I didn't expect to go so soon, but they were able to work me in, and re-seat my crown. Everyone was friendly, and made sure I felt comfortable. I would highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Kaiser
user_reviews_extended.Description: After my husband and I started going here over 5 years ago, we moved the rest of our family, too. The entire staff is courteous and so easy to work with. They even do well with our disabled daughter's check-ups.

user_reviews_extended.Name: raghu jadala
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hello, I have been seeing doctor Nayak for more than 6 years.  I really like him and his staff.  He always takes time to listen to your concerns and explains in detail treatment plan.  I really like office Front Desk staff Miss Scarlett.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Gibson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist experience I've ever had.  Reasonable, top notch quality, and pain free!  I would highly recommend University Dental -- they really know how to treat customers right.

user_reviews_extended.Name: karin lester
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never had a dentist i loved but I love the whole staff at University Dental! They were so welcoming and nice. I have always had a fear of the dentist and this visit took it all away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Kroyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I 10/10 recommend this dental office.  I would give them 100 ⭐️’s if that was a google option.  If you’ve been hesitant about going to the dentist, make an appointment and let Dr. Niknam work her magic (but all of the dentists are wonderful there)!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mandy Voth
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Naik was awesome! Very informative and helpful. Gave me preventative options and recommendations as how to provide better care for my teeth. First dentist I’ve trusted here in TX and wouldn’t go anywhere else now. Thank you

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Biddle
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Our family has been with University Dental for 3-4 years now, and have never had a problem, and always enjoyed going there - as much as anyone can enjoy going to the dentist. :)

This past Saturday, our daughter was playing softball, and took a ball to the mouth, breaking her two front teeth, and shifting a few of the bottom teeth.  We rushed to the ER.  The ER dr did what he could to stabilize the bottom teeth.  We called the dentist and left an emergency msg for Dr. Naik - he met us at their office in 20 minutes.

We could not be more thankful for the care that he took for her.  These two doctors understand that unfortunate stuff happens, and God forbid, if this happens again - they will be our first call!

Thank you!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christy Abrahamson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is so friendly and helpful. The dentists are awesome! Shermance is a wonderful hygienist. The office and lobby are clean and the wait times are not long at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carolyn Mabarak
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had two cleanings and one crown done at University Dental.  Everyone there is professional, friendly and very skilled.  It is a great place to have dental work done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mitch Deck
user_reviews_extended.Description: Doctors Angela and Ashish have both provided me with excellent care and their staff is top notch! My appointments are always a pleasant experience. Highly recommended.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sally aveni
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is very professional, friendly, prompt.  Been going to University Dental for in excess of five years now and always receive great care and concern for my particular issues.  Cleaning is a breeze!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom Owen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Naik and the whole staff at University Dental is Awesome.  Always friendly and make me feel comfortable.  Couldn’t be happier.  I highly recommend University Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aubrey Ramos (The Dusty Robot)
user_reviews_extended.Description: These guys saved the day. I had an emergency and they got me in same day despite being booked solid. The doctor and staff were so sweet and caring my wife and I have definitely found our new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Grantham
user_reviews_extended.Description: University Dental does a great job from the initial greeting to the preventive service an care they provide. Honest and up front I love that they provide tough love in a gentle way!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nedra Hutton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love these guys!! Their entire staff is awesome and the doctors are exceptional. You will not be disappointed at all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peech Satyanarayana Reddy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent dentists , highly knowledgeable, extremely friendly and professional staff. Highly recommend if you are looking for a dentist. Convenient Appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Leyden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am always so comfortable when visiting.  From the front office staff , hygienist to dentist they are fabulous and have been for year!! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Calvin Harrison
