title: Martin Dental Group
address: 16 Chisholm Trail Rd, Round Rock, TX 78681, United States

user_reviews.Name: Ramiro Dominguez, Jr.
user_reviews.Description: We took our daughter for her first dental visit and had a wonderful experience. Dr. Montalvo and Laney were incredibly kind and patient, making her feel completely comfortable. Eliah at the front office was also very welcoming and helpful. The entire visit was smooth and positive. Highly recommend, especially for families with kids!

user_reviews.Name: Caitlin Leys
user_reviews.Description: The staff at Martin Dental Group is so friendly and down to earth. It really makes you feel comfortable. I really appreciate that the office is welcoming and has a homey feel. It’s so much more pleasant than the stark white, fluorescent lighting, clinical feeling offices I’ve been to in the past.

user_reviews.Name: Kristen
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Montalvo is an incredible dentist! The procedure I had completed was quick and completely painless, and his calm demeanor made the entire experience stress-free. Plus, his assistant was super sweet and kept me entertained through the whole appointment. I couldn’t have asked for better care.

user_reviews.Name: Erin C
user_reviews.Description: Eliah and Dr. Montalvo are amazing. They took great care and answered all of my questions. Eliah at the front desk explained the insurance thoroughly. I would definitely recommend Martin Dental Group 10/10!

user_reviews.Name: Lisa Cazacu
user_reviews.Description:
Can’t say enough good things about Martin dental. Their staff is stellar and they deliver such a high level of Customer Service. Dr. Martin also is upfront with you about your dental needs. He’s not trying to sell you anything or upgrade you he gives you all the options.

In addition to being such an outstanding restorative Dentist, They also take insurance. If you’re looking for a new dentist or one that takes insurance, I highly recommend Martin Dental.

Also, when you’re in the chair, they have huge picture windows That look out over a little oasis of trees and birds and plants. It’s such a glorious, relaxing thing to look at, As we all know, no one loves going to the dentist. It’s just an added bonus.

user_reviews.Name: laurlaur
user_reviews.Description: I met Dr. Gavin at a previous practice and actually followed him to his new practice! Dr. Gavin takes the time to explain everything clearly, always answers all my questions, and makes me feel at ease, which is not easy to do at the dentist! The care and attention to detail are outstanding. I will always rave about my experience with Dr. Gavin!

user_reviews.Name: Thy Owens
user_reviews.Description:
We had an amazing experience at this dental office! My son had an accident and injured his two front teeth on a Sunday. I called Monday morning, and they fit him in the same day as a new patient. The entire visit — including x-rays, an exam, and a thorough explanation from the doctor — took only about 30 minutes. Everything was efficient, but never felt rushed.

The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming. A special shoutout to Myah, the practice manager, who truly wears many hats. She took my initial call, scheduled our same-day appointment, checked us in, helped with the x-ray alongside another staff member, checked us out, and even set up future appointments for our whole family — all with a kind, calm, and professional attitude.

Dr. Martin was fantastic — very personable, kind, and clearly skilled. My son felt completely at ease, which meant the world to us given the situation.

I’m actually looking forward to my own appointment later this week. It’s rare to feel that way about going to the dentist, but this team truly sets a high bar. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Nicole Cross
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely 10/10 experience!! All of the staff were extremely thorough and kind. I felt very well taken care of and I’m very satisfied with my experience. I would recommend this dental office to anybody!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christi Finley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I hadn’t been to the dentist in 10 years, and with that came a lot of shame, guilt, and what felt like insurmountable fear about finally going back. From the moment I walked into Dr. Martin’s office, I felt welcome, safe, and completely at ease. His staff made me feel at home right away.

I was able to be honest and vulnerable about how long it had been and why — and instead of judgment, I was met with kindness, understanding, and real knowledge. They took time to sit with me one-on-one, listen to my concerns, and explain my x-rays and treatment plan in a way that actually made sense. They were also very straightforward about cost and worked with me to build a plan that felt doable — helping me catch up on 10 years’ worth of dental work over the next few months.

I’m genuinely so grateful to have found a dentist where I feel seen, heard, and cared for on a human level. Thank you to Dr. Martin and your whole team — I appreciate all that you do!

user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I had appointments at the same time with different staff members to establish care but we both experienced the same level of professionalism and detail! I love this office, they’re so incredibly caring and attentive. I cracked a tooth and was in horrible pain, they got me in next day and to be seen and come up with a treatment plan. Squeezed me in twice more in the same week to get my issue resolved and out of pain.

Just went back for my permanent crown. They’re amazing! Definitely found my dentist in Dr. Montalvo and team!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my first time visiting Martin Dental. April helped ease my anxiety. She did a great job! It was a pleasure meeting Dr. Montalvo. I found my new dental home.

I would recommend Dr. Martin as a highly qualified dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Montalvo was absolutely amazing. Very first time being here and from the moment of walking into the practice and meeting the doctor I felt 100% welcome. Would recommend For anyone looking for a caring, great dentist

I’ve never been made to feel bad or embarrassed about my teeth ( I’ve had TONS of work done) and I would recommend them to everyone.

Dr Martin and the team are personal, professional and knowledgeable about their work. I highly recommend! Thanks again to the team.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience overall! Dr. Martin truly listened to my concerns and delivered outstanding results. Highly recommend to anyone looking for exceptional care and expertise!

user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband and I just moved here from out of state, and we are so glad to have found our dentist! Everyone at Martin Dental was so friendly and welcoming! My husband also has dental anxiety, and they went above and beyond to put his mind at ease. Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valencia Blanks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a wonderful experience at Martin Dental very kind  and friendly service very personable  Dr. Martin made Me feel very comfortable made sure my mouth was good numb before he started the procedure or the work on my crown. I appreciate that,I didn’t feel a thing, very gentle. My husband went to see him first and then told me about him and if he passed my husband‘s test, I said that he’s a good Dentist and a great guy my husband even said that Dr.Martin called to check on him to see how he was feeling after he had saw him for the very first time and that really made an impact on my husband, My hygienist was amazing. She was so gentle kind,front office lady was very kind friendly. The dental assistant was very kind and friendly. It was just a friendly place with good professional service, very happy to have found them, definitely recommend them I’ll be going back again and give them five stars +5 more ⭐️ star ⭐️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Truong
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came as a new patient to get a crown because previous dentist was quoting me a very high price. Dr Nick at Martin dental group was fantastic and had the best bedside manners. He explained to me everything he needed to do and was not the type of doctor to try and suggest a bunch of things to be fixed just for the money. My crown procedure was not painful at all and Dr Nick made sure I was comfortable the whole time. In addition his staff were incredibly kind and accommodating. Finally the prices are very reasonable.  I really enjoyed my experience here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Hampton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m very happy that I chose this dentist. Haven’t been to a dentist in 5 years and I would highly recommend not waiting that long. I had some issues with my gums and I finally made the call to schedule an appointment. They recommended that I do a deep cleaning which was more out of pocket but I was expecting that considering how long I’ve waited since my last cleaning. They were up front about the costs and that it would be 2 appointments. I agreed and they immediately began with the deep cleaning.  They make you feel very comfortable and offered a numbing gel before cleaning. They explain everything they’re doing and what products they use which I really liked. It was a great experience and my family will be sticking with Martin Dental as long as we live here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: cheesy bo beezy
user_reviews_extended.Description: my teeth cleaning was very pleasant. Obviously this will vary depending on what state your teeth are in but the staff are very kind either way 🙂‍↕️

user_reviews_extended.Description: First timer great experience! Mouths numb crowns fixed. I really feel like I made a grown up decision today! Until next time, Doc keep are smiles bright.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Martin Dental is tooth-ally amazing! 🦷 The team is so friendly, they make you forget you're at the dentist. Dr. Martin is a pro, and my teeth have never felt better. Highly recommend for anyone looking to smile brighter!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the Martin Dental Group team! I leave smiling brighter every visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hunter Maurice
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Martin Dental Group was amazing. Katie at the front desk was incredibly nice and helpful as soon as I walked in the front door, making me feel very welcome. My Dental Hygienist Bentley also did an amazing job at not only cleaning my teeth but assuring that I was relaxed and comfortable during the process. Overall, everyone I interacted with at Martin Dental Group seems to prioritize the comfort of the patient above all us. Exactly the place to go to if you are nervous at all about going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Trevor Woolsack
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and cozy environment. The entire staff made me feel very welcome and comfortable. Dr. Martin made me feel really certain about what needed to be prioritized to keep my teeth and save money. Loved my visit, can't wait to go back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Vanlandingham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My son is 7 years old doesn't go to the dentist very often. He was nervous about going and when he got there he was scared to get in the chair. They were very patient with him and didn’t rush him.  He gave the following review:
“They were very kind. They were really nice. Every time I looked at her she smiled back at me. They made me feel good. I’m not nervous about going back at all.”   It was the end of the day and they should have been a little irritated but they weren’t. I’m thankful that the staff at Martin Dental Group treated my son with patience and respect.  My son had great experience and isn’t scared of the dentist anymore.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexa De Peña
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am deathly afraid of going to the dentist. I came in as a new patient with a dental emergency. Dr Martin was so friendly, kind and soothing that I was able to relax some and not be so anxious. It was a great experience considering I absolutely avoid going (sadly 🙁).

Have to also point out that everyone in the office was so friendly and patient. So understanding of my fears and made all efforts to put me at ease. So glad I found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leo Torres
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff! Definitely recommend they do really good work.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved to Austin about a year ago & I have been searching for a great dentist & I have definitely found the best!  Everyone in the office made me feel welcome from the time I walked in the door by offering me beverages & the atmosphere was just welcoming. The receptionist Katie was so nice and informative when I scheduled my appointment. The hygienist took great care of me & she went over my x-ray pictures and explained everything to me thoroughly.  The dentist Dr. Martin was very kind and informative as well. I had a great experience & I will be coming back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Harrison
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Martin Dental is the best place for dental care! Dr. Martin goes above & beyond to answer all your question (he really listens) and gives excellent advice. Bentley was the person who did my cleaning this morning. I was impressed with her gentle, but thorough job of cleaning my teeth.
I highly recommend Martin Dental!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gordon Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was impressed with the care I received from the staff (Joe) that took my call, and the dental assistant (Laney). I highly recommend the Martin Dental Group.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a good initial X-ray, teeth cleaning experience. Bentley the Hygenist was professional, knowledgeable and an asset to the clinic.

user_reviews_extended.Description: We’ve been to Martin Dental several times now, after my first appointment I immediately changed my husband’s dentist to Dr. Martin, and shortly after moved my daughters (they are minors) to Dr. Martin (they loved it and ate my greatest critics). Consistently every member of my family has had the same professional, caring, educational experience. You don’t feel rushed, every single staff member we encounter have been wonderful, they work with you to get timely follow ups, and are knowledgeable of the varying needs for each person in my family. I’m going through the clear correct aligners process and it is going great! As always highly recommend Martin Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hayley Lynn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome staff when you walk right in the door. Very friendly and calming. Bentley, hygienist is excellent! She talked me through everything.  I was worked in due to pain. Dr. Martin personally called me before even seeing me in the office.  THAT says alot to me, considering I have severe dental anxiety.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am terrified of going to the dentist! That being said, Dr. Martin put my fears at ease. He seemed to care a lot about what I was hoping for in the treatment of my teeth and made it easy to understand how he would achieve it. He has a sharp wit that brought a smile to my face.:) I can't say enough good things about my dental hygienist! Bentley did a wonderful job telling me about how she would clean my teeth. She was professional with an easy going, friendly attitude and went out of her way to make me calm. She was patient and allowed me to rest when needed during  the procedure to make sure I was comfortable. My teeth looked so much better! The staff and Katy were very friendly. I will definitely recommend this place to my friends, family and co-workers. Thank you😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arizona Higuera
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have had dental anxiety, so I was very nervous before even walking in. The entire staff made me feel very welcome. I recently had the pleasure of visiting Martin Dental Group and receiving treatment from Dr. Nick Martin, and I must say that my experience was absolutely outstanding. In addition to the exceptional dental care, the office staff was friendly, efficient, and accommodating. They went above and beyond to assist me with scheduling appointments and handling insurance matters, making the entire process seamless and stress-free.

Truly

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josh Young
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just left this dentist office and just kinda wanted to brag about them for a minute. I'm new in town and have been shopping for a dentist my aunt recommended Dr Nick Martin at Martin Dental Group. The first time I saw Dr Martin he gave me a FREE exam and told me what I needed done, but I didn't have the money together yet, so I didn't get anything done. That was about 2 months ago...

Now I tried another dentist in town who recommended all these unnecessary procedures to the tune of $1,700  for what I thought would just be a filling for one tooth... As soon as I left Town Dental, I had remembered about Dr Martin. So I scheduled an appointment at Town Dentals parking lot and Martin Dental Group got me in within 2 days and sure enough I got my filling!!!

The procedure itself was fast and the work looks great... way, way better than what I was expecting and at the cost of $408. I mention cost because, I was/am a cash patient who has to watch those pennies. Now I don't care who you are but Dr Martin was a pretty straight shooter, he told me what I needed and how much it would be WITHOUT TRYING TO BREAK ME FINANCIALLY....No muss, no fuss!! I was in and out of his office in about 40 minutes, PAIN FREE and with a brand new filling.

HERE'S WHAT I LOVED ABOUT THIS EXPERIENCE

He just straight up told me exactly how much it would be, because if you don't have insurance all these other dental offices like to play games when it comes to money. They won't give you a price list or anything like that at all. That was not the case with Dr Martin. There was no surprise charges and he didn't recommend any unnecessary procedures or equipment! The office staff was very professional and friendly and really gave me the 5 star treatment at a 3 star price. Honestly it was a great experience and if you're looking for a new dentist you should definitely check out Dr Martin at Martin Dental Group.

If you're in the Austin, Leander, Cedar Park or surrounding areas I would highly encourage you to see Dr Martin at Martin dental group.

PS. he wasn't stingy with the lidocaine... as a matter of fact I still can't feel my face.

I have experienced a positive working environment from you, Dr. Martn, and from your staff. I had to have an old silver filling removal and a crown put in place. Ron Rowell

title: Buttercup Dental
address: 901 Cypress Creek Road #203, Cedar Park, TX 78613, United States

user_reviews.Name: Priscilla Sanchez
user_reviews.Description: Everyone was wonderful. My hygienist was awesome, played some wonderful tunes to calm me during the cleaning, talked me through and Dr Vy gave it to me straight! Super informative ! I felt more than “just a patient” I appreciated all the compassion and kindness throughout from front desk to checkout. I definitely felt part of the family and I will be bringing my husband in to create another wonderful experience for him!!!! Thank you buttercup!!! Exceptional!

user_reviews.Name: Jay Hernandez
user_reviews.Description:
I had an amazing experience at Buttercup Dental! I came in last minute and they were kind enough to work me into their schedule without hesitation. From the moment I walked in, the front desk greeted me with the sweetest attitude and made me feel so welcome.

Dr. Kaur was incredible — she filled my tooth quickly and efficiently while still doing a very thorough and extensive exam. I can’t say enough good things about the hygienist, Thy. She is hands down the best hygienist I’ve ever had. She was so gentle, incredibly thorough, and explained every single step along the way. She even went out of her way to show me areas of concern and walk me through my X-rays so I truly understood what to focus on.

This office is truly a hidden gem. The care, kindness, and professionalism from everyone made such a difference. I highly recommend Buttercup Dental — everyone needs to come here!

user_reviews.Name: Kari Cooper
user_reviews.Description: 5!!! My dentist Darrell Park was the most compassionate man when it came to my dental implant consultation. Marcia and Dr. Park were so kind during an extremely vulnerable moment for me and I'm forever grateful to have found people that truly care and want to help me get my smile back. I felt no judgment and I can't express to you how vulnerable people feel when getting these consultations. Today was my dad's birthday in heaven and he sent me somewhere where I'd be taken care of! Thank you!!!🙏

user_reviews.Name: Kyra Seay
user_reviews.Description:
I had my first appointment at Buttercup Dental today and was genuinely impressed. As a new patient, I was expecting the usual separate visits for X-rays, consultation, and then a cleaning, but they were able to do everything in one appointment. As someone with a packed schedule, that meant a lot.

Dr. Harneet Kaur was incredibly informative. Instead of just telling me what procedures I “should” do, she walked me through the why behind each recommendation and even encouraged me to research on my own. That level of transparency built instant trust and made me feel like a long-time patient, not someone there for the first time.

The front desk team was warm, upbeat, and seemed genuinely happy to be there—which sets the tone right away. And my hygienist was fantastic. She had great timing with conversation (never asked me an ill timed question that's an art since 90% of the cleaning time I obviously can't respond), made the cleaning comfortable, and the fluoride treatment left zero gritty aftertaste—which I really appreciated since I’m sensitive to textures.

Overall, a 10/10 experience. I’m really looking forward to continuing my care with them and would highly recommend Buttercup Dental to anyone looking for a thoughtful, efficient, and truly patient-centered clinic.

Accessed the reason I was there, gave me options, took care of immediate issue & scheduled additional work needed for a couple of days later...to meet my scheduling needs.  Friendly & professional.  Found my new long-term dentist office.

Marcia and Dr. Park were so kind during an extremely vulnerable moment for me and I'm forever grateful to have found people that truly care and want to help me get my smile back. I felt no judgment and I can't express to you how vulnerable people feel when getting these consultations. Today was my dad's birthday in heaven and he sent me somewhere where I'd be taken care of! Thank you!!!🙏

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyra Seay
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had my first appointment at Buttercup Dental today and was genuinely impressed. As a new patient, I was expecting the usual separate visits for X-rays, consultation, and then a cleaning, but they were able to do everything in one appointment. As someone with a packed schedule, that meant a lot.

Dr. Harneet Kaur was incredibly informative. Instead of just telling me what procedures I “should” do, she walked me through the why behind each recommendation and even encouraged me to research on my own. That level of transparency built instant trust and made me feel like a long-time patient, not someone there for the first time.

The front desk team was warm, upbeat, and seemed genuinely happy to be there—which sets the tone right away. And my hygienist was fantastic. She had great timing with conversation (never asked me an ill timed question that's an art since 90% of the cleaning time I obviously can't respond), made the cleaning comfortable, and the fluoride treatment left zero gritty aftertaste—which I really appreciated since I’m sensitive to textures.

Overall, a 10/10 experience. I’m really looking forward to continuing my care with them and would highly recommend Buttercup Dental to anyone looking for a thoughtful, efficient, and truly patient-centered clinic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Larsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was an emergency appointment. They got me in same day.  New to the area. They were amazing. Accessed the reason I was there, gave me options, took care of immediate issue & scheduled additional work needed for a couple of days later...to meet my scheduling needs.  Friendly & professional.  Found my new long-term dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Evie Ellis - ATX Home Realty
user_reviews_extended.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Great experience from start to finish! I was seen right on time for my 6-month cleaning, and the staff was friendly, professional, and welcoming. The office has state-of-the-art equipment, and my cleaning was thorough yet very gentle. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jean Olson
user_reviews_extended.Description: After nearly 50 years with another dental group, today I had my first appointment with Buttercup Dental.  What a great office of professionals!  From the receptionist, dental assistant, doctor and hygienist, everyone attended to me kindly and welcoming.  I’ll be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Audrey Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful staff! Everyone is so very kind and genuine, from the front desk to the back (shoutout to hygienist Sarah, she's so sweet and compassionate), my experiences here have always been positive  :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Dellario
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was a very unique experience for me. For four months, I have had a dental implant molar that was wobbling and cutting into my gums. I didn’t realize how much I let it continue. I went to a different dental group and they were not able to help me. In fact they said they couldn’t and Said I should try another office. I did some research and found Buttercup dental with very high reviews. I gave them a call told him my situation and they got me in within a couple days. I expected on my visit that I would get a quick exam and a future date to solve my problem. Instead, they identified the problem immediately went into repair mode and fixed it. I’m eternally grateful for the staff for Dr. Park and their immediate resolution. I didn’t realize how much pain I had been in and they saw it immediately and fixed it. If this is how they treat their patients in a normal way, I’m there for life. Thank you so much Buttercup  Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassia Jimenez
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff are excellent, everyone is so nice and efficient!  I’ve seen Dr Stancey for over a decade and he has been an amazing dentist to me. Annie is so sweet and her cleaning is amazing!!! I feel that I’m relaxing while she is cleaning my teeth because the time goes by so fast! I’m happy I found them 👏🏻

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theo Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I get overwhelmed easily and am prone to panic attacks when I go to the dentist but I have to say, this dentist is full of very kind nurses, receptionists, and doctor. I had my teeth cleaned and a cavity filled. Everyone made sure I was alright throughout the whole experience and I was allowed to wear earbuds the whole time. I got a little overwhelmed but this was the first time I didn’t have a panic attack.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth “Lisa” Noriega

Buttercup Dental has always provided me with excellent dental care.  I highly recommend them!

I highly recommend Buttercup Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient at Buttercup Dental for over 10 years, and their service has always been exceptional. I arrived 15 minutes early for my appointment and was called back immediately. After taking X-rays to check for any other issues, the inlay was reattached. Dr. Dona Halloum was thorough and fun during the process! I will continue to make the drive from Georgetown to Cedar Park for this level of service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Troy Nissen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The proposition of finding a new dentist in a new area can be a bit challenging, particularly when you really liked your previous dentist office.  It was very important to us to find a dentist office that provided a personal touch, a caring feel, and offered services like  Sedation Dentistry.   We found Buttercup Dental online, near where we live.  We booked our appointments and waited for the day to come.  When we arrived, we were welcomed with a warm greeting from the reception staff.  After filling out the requisite paperwork, we didn’t wait terribly long to be seen.  They took care of X-rays and health history right away and then both my wife and I were seen by Dr. Kaur.  She was so pleasant and super nice.  Made me feel comfortable right away, and took a little time to visit and get to know me.   My hygienist was probably the best I’ve ever had.  She was also very nice and very personable.  She was so careful while cleaning my teeth and took her time and great care to ensure I was comfortable.  My wife and daughter both indicated that they had similar experiences.   It was a positive dental visit all the way around.  If you’re new to the Cedar Park area or are just looking for a new dentist, I highly recommend giving Buttercup Dental a try.  You’ll be glad you did.

user_reviews_extended.Name: karen shives
user_reviews_extended.Description: If I could give more stars I would. To say everyone at Buttercup genuinely cares is an understatement. I have not been to a Dentist in 7 yrs, I have an unrealistic fear of going and only go if I am in so much pain I can’t stand it. When I called the girl was very kind who answered and was able to get me in quickly. Marcia who was the dental assistant, was fantastic and handled my anxiety and tears when they surfaced (upon realizing I was going to have to come back) with such maturity and was very professional. She stayed calm, which in turn helped me. When Dr Smith came in, he was beyond calming and very straight forward in a very gentle manner while explaining what was going on in my mouth and what steps I realistically needed to do. Not once did he make me feel bad for my tears and fears, not once did he push procedures at me. He simply talked and presented options. Realistic options!!  I am one who usually cancels the next appointment (once the pain is gone) and never goes back. However with Dr Smith’s caring nature and the kindness from his Staff, I can actually see myself going. Highly recommend Buttercup Dental 🥰

user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: HOT
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first visit was an emergency re-seat of a crown and they did a good job. My second visit was a cleaning and exam by the doctor which ended up being a cleaning / short lecture by the hygienist for the stains on my teeth and no exam by the doctor. I just had my third visit yesterday and it did not turn out how I had expected.
My “Greeting” from the receptionist was, “Can I get your name?”, no hello. I waited a moment and the hygienist opened the door and said greeted me with, “Come this way”. I stood up and said “Hello!”, which seemed to catch her off guard by the surprised look I received. The cleaning went fine and she did a good job. However, my exam consisted of Dr Smith coming in for about 30 seconds. He said hello to me, looked in my mouth, asked if a tooth was bothering me, then told the hygienist to keep an eye on it for the next visit. I guess by the way that he didn’t introduce himself to me, prompted the hygienist to ask if I had met him before. I simply replied, “Nope”.
To conclude the appointment, the hygienist gave me a toothbrush, walked me to the front desk, and walked away. (No thank you, see you next time, or any form of salutation).

Maybe I’m just spoiled with someone greeting me and thanking me for my patronage by my previous dentist, the cashier at HEB, and the clerk at the county tax office.
I’m pretty sure I’ll be looking for another dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m always pleased with my experience here. Annie and Dr. Stancey make me feel very comfortable which says a lot about a dental visit!

I found Dr.Smith a few years ago and am so impressed with his expertise, kindness, and overall demeanor. He is extremely smart and a wonderful dentist. He provided great insight and knowledge for my dental issues. He also has a wonderful staff that is caring, patient, and helpful. He has definitely turned around my fear of going to the dentist and makes me feel comfortable. Thanks for being awesome! Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: rosie jimbo
user_reviews_extended.Description:
amazing customer experience !! Answered all the questions I had plus then some!!   Thanks Kerri sooo much!!  She is always helping and guiding me on any prevention especially on how to use my water pick !! Crazy as it sounds!  I thought I knew how to use it , little did I know !!
she showed me the proper way.
have a great the rest of the week!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Katrompas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been with Buttercup Dental for 10 years or more.  Everyone is amazing! The doctors and staff really do care about their patients.  I can't say enough nice things about the entire staff.  Dr's. Smith and Stancey have given me a beautiful smile and I'm so grateful to them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbi Weaver
user_reviews_extended.Description: Extremely satisfied! My referral was spot on. Environment was clean and nice. Staff is friendly and warm. Provided all my services needs now and in the future. Looking forward to my future appointment and receiving more services when needed. Great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bethany Townsend
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this office and it’s crew. I have been a patient over 10 years and ALWAYS receive amazing care. My hygienist, Laura is always there with a smile on her face (behind the mask). She gets my teeth shiny and gorgeous and Dr. Smith keeps an eye overseeing my care. Thank you for all you do!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beth Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love the staff at Buttercup Dental!! Everyone is so polite & gentle!! Gentle Dental is the way to go!!! Dr. Oster is a fabulous dentist & put me at ease when pulling several teeth at one time. And let me add, Kim Courtney is the best Dentist Hygienist ever created. She’s so patient & sweet & good at what she does! I won’t go anywhere but to Buttercup Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa O'Brien
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going to buttercup for a few years now, great dentist and enjoy seeing the same hygienist each visit too. Annie is the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Boyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: After 45 years of searching for a dental practice that I could completely trust and believe in, I finally landed at Buttercup Dental. It takes more than dental school to become a truly great dentist and Dr. Smith and Dr. Park set the highest bar for competence, knowledge, craftsmanship (missing in many dentists), integrity (also questionable, in my experience with many), and patient care. They are the very finest example of what I think dentistry should be and both are truly passionate about what they do. You will not find better results anywhere when it comes to your dental care. Also, the staff is truly wonderful throughout; everyone there is always engaged, patient focused, and cheerful. Wow! I thank you all profusely at Buttercup Dental for providing such exemplary service – you have changed my life in a big way!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robin Ritter
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am a 35+ year patient and in my upper 60s...my teeth are in great shape thanks to Staff at Buttercup Dental.  Regular cleaning and checkups make huge difference for oral health.  They have always been very accommodating, prompting and willing to explain procedures and options.  I have had a few cavities and procedures; rarely experienced pain and Dr. Smith always calls to check up on you either that evening or in the following morning.  A model of care!!

The wife agrees 100%.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ucky Brandt
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Awful experience. I had to take care of a crown and Dr. Stancey did it, yeah the one that I believe has a God complex and treats patients horrible. Long story short he then told me my other crown was “patched up” but that he had seen that before done by doctors “from those countries” I guess he thinks in Latinamerica we take care of our health by some river. Je said it was time to change the filling, I trusted him and agreed. My mistake. He even after having my X-rays, knowing that the root was very close he simply drilled his way into the tooth. He drilled so deep that he damaged my tooth. He was very rude as I told him he had to fix it and I was not paying for his mistake.

Dr. Park, super professional impeccable. He said to me “0k, it’s done (the root canal) let’s wait a few days and when you’re comfortable Dr. Stancey will put the crown.

As planned I called to make the appointment and surprise, Dr. Stancey was on vacation or so I was told. They didn’t replace the doctor and he was gone. I waited several days too many, and so the filling of Dr. Park fell a little because I was using that tooth to eat. Finally the permanent crown was in the right place but I have a sensation everytime I use the tooth I strongly believe he waited too long to put the permanent crown.
After he finished with me he got up from the chair and left without saying a word . Nothing, nada like O wasn’t there. Silent rudeness? He never acknowledged he made a mistake. Terrible! I would never go back.
Please avoid this place at all cost. Having a professional mistreat you and be rude is not what patients are looking for. Professionals leave their personal feelings at  home so they can work emotionless with a steady and mature character.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Rose Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came into office today and was just surprised and disappointed that my gums had digressed and that I would need another root and scale perio. I have decided to go with an in network dentist for delta dental since it will be about $350 cheaper. I'm on a tight budget these days and am retired and older so I need to make a change.  Otherwise it's been great. I had been going to buttercup about 35 years.  Best wishes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karin Pereira
user_reviews_extended.Description: Conservative and safe environment with skilled professionals, but I was a bit confused how they presented the estimated bill, thus I had to call back and requested some answers.  Understand it all depends on the insurance claim in the end, but I wanted to make sure how I have to pay my part. The person I dealt with was a bit impatient to my cause. No problem, in the end, I certainly will pay my dues.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Carrell
user_reviews_extended.Description: We had a great experience on our first visit. The front desk reception was great and personal. The pre-examine hygenist was very efficient and friendly. I was very pleased with Doctor Park.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Oscar Moreno
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s always a pleasure to have my dental work done with Buttercup!  They are on time and do great work. The staff is friendly and always willing to help make the experience pleasant.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kristal pendleton
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love every single one of you at Buttercup Dental. It’s evident that you genuinely care about your patients. Dr Smith is a very compassionate Dr and he cares and wants to inform his patients of the TRUTH not what they want to hear. I love this most of all!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Annie did an excellent job on cleaning my teeth.  She went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable.   I was very pleased with her work. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: robt927
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Park and his team at Buttercup Dental are some of the best service providers in any industry. They are true professionals and take care of their patients with the highest level of care. I do not usually recommend doctors, but in this case this practice is too good to not share. I highly recommend Buttercup Dental, I am confident that you will be happy you trust your teeth to this great practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt C
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m very happy with this dentist office after going to a different one for many years. They are efficient getting you in and the experience getting cleanings has been pleasant (as much as it can be). They aren’t pushy about making you think you need to get work done (when it isn’t necessary) I’ve been to those kind of dentists before so I’m glad I’ve found this one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luciena Case
user_reviews_extended.Description: My 11-year old daughter was referred by Texas Tooth Fairies to Craig Knell at Austin Oral Surgery in Cedar Park to remove 4 baby teeth. Granted my daughter is very anxious but neither of the dental practices cared to help her. In fact, Dr. Knell insisted to do an inpatient surgery in the hospital after she refused to do an in-office procedure that involved an IV - she was terrified and had a panic attack. This created a lot of anxiety for our whole family, including my daughter's inability to eat and teeth pain. Enter Buttercup Dental - the orthodontist Dr. Steven Stancey was a savior! He advised that doing less medication would be better for anxious patients; also, he was easy-going and respectful towards my daughter, and told her she would be in control during the procedure, including how many teeth to remove at a time. On the day of the procedure, everyone was very welcoming and patient - including the dental assistants who allowed my daughter to hold on to their arm when she was scared. My daughter was amazed at how fast Dr.Stancey removed the first 2 teeth and had no reservations to continue with the other 2. We ended up using the laughing gas and the gum numbing injections - those were the worst part. We were in and out within an hour. I am genuinely grateful to Dr. Stancey and the dental staff - everyone more than exceeded our expectations! We are switching both of my daughters to Buttercup Dental where dentists actually care, and also because it's a one-stop shop for all your dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Crane
user_reviews_extended.Description: 5 Stars all the way. I travel 40 minutes to go to Buttercup because I know they will be honest, the front desk folks are wonderful, the waiting room is comfortable, the hygienists are gentle, and they have Wi-Fi which my data plan appreciates.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Bonsall
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m so grateful for Buttercup Dental and Dr. Oster! They fit me in the next day for a second opinion (free of charge) after receiving a very questionable and pricey treatment plan from another office. They were able to ease my nerves and give me practical advice moving forward, not to mention save me from getting about $500 of unnecessary dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Amell
user_reviews_extended.Description: My hygienist Christine is mindful of my comfort at every visit. She is personable and engaging. Dr. Smith has always put me at ease. I appreciate everyone from reception through check out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jade
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My whole family has been seeing Dr. Smith for years.  He takes a conservative approach which I prefer.  For example, while some dentists jump right to the root canal option, Dr. Smith won't.   He will only recommend that approach if absolutely necessary.   He gives you options, if available.  And, if you have any procedure done other than a cleaning, he always calls you in the evening to make sure all is well.  I love this - I have never had an issue, but it's nice to know that he makes this call just in case.

In addition, the hygienists are very good and the office staff are always cordial and efficient.   My 10 year old daughter loves her hygienist, who specializes in working with kids.  I also have a regular hygienist that I like.  And, my husband has another regular hygienist that he really likes.  I like that the office staff are the same good people that I've seen for years.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin Crozier
user_reviews_extended.Description: Terrific service, easy to work with and they take great care of our teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juliana Deshkevich
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you are looking for a perfect dental team, this is it! The whole experience was just great. Dr. Steven Stancey was able to fit me in the last second. I was in a lot of pain and very afraid to go in,  but everyone there really made me feel at ease. The staff there was also so amazing! Hands down the best!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dani Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolute BEST dental service I’ve had since moving to the Austin area 15 years ago!  Highly recommend this office to anyone looking for a professional, but laid back, dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonya Underwood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff, front desk clerk’s,Kerri my  hygienist’s is the best and Doctors are all top notch.  They genuinely care about you and your needs.   I wouldn’t go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy McWaters
user_reviews_extended.Description: Outstanding dental practice from the welcoming team that greets you and checks you in to the dental hygienist (Sarah) and the dentist(Dr Smith). They are very caring professionals and very knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sommerly Hegar
user_reviews_extended.Description: Buttercup Dental is BY FAR the BEST there is! I’ve been going since 2017 and I just love them!! The doctors are absolutely amazing! The staff/team are are very friendly and professional! If anyone ever asks me if I know of a good dentist… I send them a link to Buttercup Dental’s website and tell them they won’t be disappointed! Look no further, make your appointment now! 🤩

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was enjoying the scenery of the tree & squirrels & birds through the big window in front of me and all of a sudden my dentist was working on my teeth. I was having a pleasant experience because he numbed my mouth so he could work. He fixed everything that needed fixing & sent me on my way to go home. I haven’t ever enjoyed getting dental work done in the past. This dentist provided a pleasant experience. That really made my day.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Holder
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Buttercup Dental! They are courteous, on time, and care for your overall health. Our hygienist is amazing and the doctor we see will make sure of the right plan you need before work is done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Christianson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Buttercup Dental was amazing! Staff is very polite and helpful Doctor explained everything and was super personable. I got great service and Laura my hygienist was awesome very gentle and careful made sure I was completely comfortable at all times. I would recommend Buttercup Dental!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jama Zam
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a pleasant experience from start to finish. Everyone was so very nice.  Ngh was so pleasant and explained every step of the X-ray experience so well.  I feel confident that any possible conditions were thoroughly examined by Dr Parks and that the hygienist, Kerry, did an excellent job of cleaning without causing pain. The massage chair was a very special perk for helping to relax. The rooms are very private and sounds from other rooms are not heard. The exam room has a wonderful view of the trees outside. For being a busy dental office, the patient care was very individualized and top notch cleanliness was practiced at every station. I found my née dental clinic!  Thank you Buttercup Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie Cannon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I work in the dental space and therefore probably have a heightened awareness (and higher expectations) when I’m at the dentist myself. In my opinion, Buttercup Dental checks all the boxes. The office is well-appointed and cozy, with a thoughtful spot for kids to play. Their team is well-staffed, and everyone I’ve been in contact with is professional, friendly, competent, and understanding. The last time I was there, I had all 4 of my kids, with 3 of them being seen for appointments. Everyone went out of their way to make it smooth and pleasant for us, especially for my kids (one of whom was there for their first visit to the dentist). We see Dr. Park for regular visits and Dr. Stancey for ortho, and they're both great. I highly recommend the practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Willard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Carey takes great care with her patients! She has educated me about my dental health to help improve my overall health! I love Carey and everyone at Buttercup Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittanie Buckley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found this office a few years ago when I needed a broken wisdom tooth taken out during my lunch break. I had a horrible experience at a dentist in San Antonio when I was younger, and avoided them all like the plague. This office changed it all! Seriously. The office staff is amazing and will work with you. The hygienists are super sweet and gentle. The dentists are really friendly and relaxed. They aren't out to get your money, they want to earn your trust and your business. They won't recommend any procedure unless you absolutely need it, and will try other paths before a big procedure. We have made them our family dentist (Dr. Park is ours) and will use them as long as we live in this part of Texas. Even though this practice is an hour from our house, it is totally worth the drive. Love them!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Fitzwell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Terrible!! I was basically tortured in the chair for over an hour! Started out a couple of weeks ago when I went in for a cleaning and the dental hygienist said that I still had a temporary crown in my mouth. She asked the assistant to go check and sure enough I did have a permanent crown there from February!

So doctor Stansky tried to pop off my “temporary crown” and he tried everything for about 25 minutes to get it off and it wouldn’t come off. So he finally decided he needed to cut it off. Long story short..he cut off a real enamel crown!!! How in the heck that is even possible I have no idea!! So I have spent the entire weekend in some pretty severe pain from him being in my mouth so long and messing with my tooth for so long! Very disturbing that there was a breakdown from not only the hygienist but the dentist as well!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Gaston
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was "worked in" Thursday due to pain and received exceptional treatment as has always been my experience at Buttercup Dental.
I saw a new dentist for this urgent visit.  I was extremely satisfied with the care I received from the doctor and staff.
I am happy to give 5 stars for Buttercup Dental's consistent level of care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience with the dental hygienist - she was very friendly and informative but Dr. Kaur is the worst dentist I've ever had. She was rude, disrespectful, and had no bedside manner. I will not be returning to this clinic for further dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Lyles
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My whole family has been going to Buttercup Dental every 6 months for over 10 years until COVID.  I finally felt comfortable going back to the dentist post COVID and I was treated so disrespectfully.

I waited 30 minutes to be taken back.  They did my X-rays and the dentist came in.  I waited for the hygienist and an hour after my appointment she came in.  She told me before ever looking in my mouth that I would have to come back for a cleaning.  I told her my appointment was for a cleaning and she said we ran out of time and she had to go to her next person.  I told her the next person should wait and my cleaning needed to happen as I had been there an hour.  She then looked at my mouth and said oh this is going to be a longer cleaning after the dentist said my teeth were in great shape.

I told her I was not coming back.  I got up and went to the front desk.  I told them they didn't do my cleaning and the first person I talked to didn't know why.  The officer manager offered her apologies and a new appointment time which was just not acceptable. I had taken off work and had been there an hour.  She said sometimes cleanings just take longer.  This was not obviously not the reason I needed to come back.  They clearly mismanaged their schedule.  They had worked a patient in and I heard the front desk say they had one dentist there.

I feel so disrespected and my family will never go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danna Lindsay
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental hygienist was super nice and friendly, but she was very rough and I don’t feel like she cleaned any is the back teeth. I walked out of the office feeling like my teeth didn’t get cleaned. I’ve been going there for years and this was the first time I felt this way. I also found out she was a temp.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Z
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to Buttercup Dental with an emergency dental need after a recommendation from a friend. I am extremely glad I did. The staff were extremely professional and nobody was judgmental. Their goal is to get you the care that you need and to provide it to you. Not to try to sell you on some dental procedure. They were out of network for my insurance plan but their prices are extremely reasonable and not the gouging you see from other dentist practices.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gregory Weeks
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Smith and his excellent staff are the best in the Austin area.  So very convenient to the north Austin, Cedar Park, & Leander areas.  He takes pride  in his work and stands behind it.  He has been my only dentist now for over 30 years.  Chewing great steaks now for 62 years…..onward sir!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Kiggins
user_reviews_extended.Description: The procedure was not something I would ever willingly sign up for. So I rate that a -10. However, Dr. Stancey knows his trade! Staff is wonderful and kind. Have been coming to Buttercup Dental for over 10 years, tried and true. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mackenzie Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to Buttercup Dental for about a year now. I have a great dental hygienist named Elizabeth! She is so knowledgeable and gentle handed. This place will take very good care of you and your family!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Kennard
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Office staff was hostile when I ask why I am being balanced billed.  I was answered with a hostile answered that my insurance company is not paying the dental office enough.  I will need to make up the difference.  I have Delta Dental Premium and I have not been notified by Delta Dental that any negotiations have taken place.  Under this tier of insurance I am not to be balanced billed.  I do not appreciate your office staff taking the tone with me.  I am a customer.  If you have a problem with the insurance company take it up with the Delta Dental.  Do not take it out on a paying a customer.  I travel 30 minutes to your office.
I take time away from work to have my dental needs met with your office.  This is not professional and this is not the kind of service I am use to experiencing at your office.  I am considering shopping around for a dental office closer to my new home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deb Sarosdy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental practice from the check in, to most of the hygienists, to Dr Scott Smith (dentist extraordinaire), and to the check out. Long time client as I recognize a great thing when I see it. Please clone Sarah, the best hygienist on staff!  Not kidding.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wulf Sullivan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a cleaning with Kerry.  She was thorough, gentle, and engaging.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim McDougall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kerri did a great job, always does.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a “surgical extraction” on 9/28 by Dr. Oster. He was able to remove my tooth without having to do anything surgical. In doing so he chipped a large piece of the tooth next to it off. That tooth does need a root canal and that is scheduled so I feel like it wasn’t a big deal to him at all. Well that tooth is not feeling great at this point. I have no insurance (told him on my consultation visit) so I asked the lady up front when I was paying if she was going to adjust the price since it was a regular extraction (I’ve had them done before) and about that time the dr walked up and she asked him and he rudely looked right at me and said NO and walked off. NO explanation, just looked at me like i was crazy. So i paid 388.00 for a regular extraction and ended up having damn near half a tooth chipped off. I had read such great things about Buttercup online. I won’t be coming back to have my other procedures done. Reception and Starla were wonderful. I’m just blown away by the lack of compassion from a Dentist. No wonder people wait until it’s too late to have dental work done. I feel like i was ripped off and treated like a number.AND after sending this this exact email 2 days ago I have not had any reply. Nice way to treat a patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy Howard
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a toothache that got exceptionally bad at the end of last week. I called the main office number on Saturday morning hoping somebody might be there. I left a message, and within a few minutes Dr Park called me back on his personal phone. He couldn't get to me at the moment, but instructed me to call in Monday morning and I would be taking care of. He was certainly correct. Another of the doctors on the team looked me over and referred me to an endodontist who could see me almost immediately. He also was quite exceptionally good and gave me a root canal while I was there. Awesome people at every step of the process.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Hellinger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Stancey never showed up to my exam (which was scheduled for before my cleaning). I waited and waited while I could hear him talking in the hallway and in another patient's room. My exam was scheduled for 10:50AM. I left at 12:40PM without ever seeing Stancey. This rating is only a two (and not lower) because Laura does a great job with my cleaning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Yamanaka
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Buttercup Dental for a very long time!   They've always taken very good care of me!   I'd definitely recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erin Brady
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a person who is utterly frighten of dentists...not any more! I expressed my feelings and everyone who worked there made me feel safe. Found out my insurance wasn't excepted there, after they thought they did....told me they would see me and write off the x-rays because i came in on good faith and needed to be seen!* I instead went on to compete what was needed w/o using my insurance...I received a discount for cash...very fair! But more importantly I felt safe and well cared for! Thank you from the bottom of my heart!! Dr Oster thank you for you care, thoughtfulness and best experience you could have in a dentist office, you sir are my dentist...Thank you again Erin

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Strmiska
user_reviews_extended.Description:
10/10 recommend! Front of house, doc, hygienist -
All amazing!!! Best experience I’ve ever had at a dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cliff Nelson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't imagine any dental practice that gives better care than Buttercup Dental. From the front desk staff, to the assistant, and then Dr. Oster, my experience during a horribly painful tooth ache was outstanding, kind and compassionate. They were able to fit me in, diagnose the problem and get me pain free in a short period of time. I know why my wife loves this place and now I wouldn't dream of going anywhere else, thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sue Fitzpatrick
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was very pleased with the atmosphere of the office, and the politeness of the assistant. Dr. Smith was very attentive and knowledgeable and came up with an agreeable plan. Would be happy to refer Buttercup Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Buttercup has a highly skilled and friendly staff. My dental hygienist Laura is amazing. I look forward to getting my teeth cleaned.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Timothy Grimes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff, knowledgeable staff. Always a pleasant visit ( even though it’s the dentist.) they explain everything they are doing, ask if you have any questions. Very professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tatiana Valle
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is Attentive, Kind, Professional and it’s very beautiful & clean! Happy to have found my dentist here in Austin. I moved here from Houston last year in March, I’ve been searching for the Best Dentist for me, and I’m excited to be taken care of by Buttercup Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bettina Nielsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Buttercup dental for years. All the physicians are great, but Kerrie DeJesus is the best dental hygienist there is!! Always on time, super nice and thorough! The check in and Check out is very friendly and fast as well!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randall Bonebrake
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Park and his staff made me feel relaxed and one of the family. My first visit exceed my expectations and would recommend Buttercup Dental to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jessica loftis
user_reviews_extended.Description: As some one who has not had the best experience with dental offices, this was the most amazing office! Everyone was so accommodating and friendly. Laura did my cleaning and she was great! Will definitely be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dental hygienist had called in sick, but they were able to book me with another one just 15 minutes later.  And she was great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Butler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am amazed at the patience that Dr Smith has shown for me and my problems. I have had a hard time with my temporary bridge. The bridge continues to come out of my mouth and I have had to go back 4 different times to have it repaired and reglued. Each time the bridge was put back in the dental assistant was very patient and understanding. They are amazing people over at Buttercup Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dianna Amescua
user_reviews_extended.Description: Even though we have moved three hours away, my husband and I came back to Buttercup for our scheduled dental exams and as always Laura did an excellent and thorough job cleaning our teeth. Buttercup also went above and beyond to adjust their scheduling in order to extract my husband’s sudden problematic tooth during our visit so we wouldn’t have to make a return trip.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ronda Nielsen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to the dentist has always been a severe anxiety for me. Not anymore! The doctor and staff were amazing! Gummers can't be chewers! So I choose Buttercup Dental, so I can smile again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin Piller
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Buttercup dental for over 30 years!!  Kerry is the BEST hygienist!!! Of course Dr Smith is great too!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tri Nguyen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Place is one of the first dental scam I have ever been too.  We are cash patient that cancel our dental insurance last year.  We initially set up three $ 99.00 cleaning.  Dentist told me I basically had gum disease which I already knew.   When dental hygienist told me I should get scaling which is basically deep cleaning under the gum line.   I ask her how much it cost.   She said 1000.00 or 900.00 for cash.   When I told her I just needed a basic cleaning,  she stated that I don’t qualify for a basic cleaning.  Who don’t qualify for a basic cleaning?  She stated that “. I will just polish and leave everything else there”.  They did talked my wife into a scaling that she probably didn’t need without going over the price with her.  So basically, Our three $ 99.00
Cleaning ended up costing $798.00 and that’s because we paid cash.  And I didn’t even qualify for a basic cleaning.  ⚠️ warning!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nathan Zal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a root canal done at Buttercup two or three months ago, and as time goes on, I only feel worse and worse about the experience. Overall it seems the procedure was successful, but the process itself was wrought with awkwardness and uncomfortability.

For one thing, the dental assistant was obviously new and was having issues getting her x-ray machine to work (maybe not her fault) but I had to get up and walk down the hallway to another room with a file sticking out of a hole in my tooth being careful not to bite down accidentally on it which would wreak havoc. Meanwhile, the doctor and assistant are talking about how difficult a tooth this is to work on the entire because of its location (back most tooth on the upper side). I get that, but maybe save that discussion for when I'm not sitting in the chair.

Seems like things are finished up but then doctor starts drilling some more and asks me if I'm planning to get a gold or porcelain crown because he needs to know now. I manage to get them to take all of the equipment out of my mouth so that I can speak. I tell him I was planning to get the crown installed at somewhere else, where I usually get crowns done (Buttercup quoted me $1300 or 1400, so I figured I'd save myself several hundred dollars.) He tells me "that would have been nice to know beforehand because we just ground down your tooth to prepare it for a crown." I apologized for the lapse in communication, but honestly, it seems really unprofessional to just go to town drilling someone's tooth, or to do any medical procedure, without even a brief discussion of what is planned. At no point did anyone tell me "this is what we are going to do today," nor did the doctor even greet me with a "how are you today" when he came in, for that matter. After this super awkward moment, which the doctor lets me take the blame for, he says it will be okay they can finish building up the tooth and I can get the crown done elsewhere. They ended up charging me $300 or $400 for this process, which other facilities include in the price of their crowns. On top of this, he asks me where I'm planning to go for the procedure so he can tell me that "the cheapest job is not always the best." Thanks pal, but I didn't ask for your opinion

Finishing up the appointment, I'm going to pay and I was asked about the invoice because it seemed very low. "Oh you didn't get a root canal today, they just did root canal prep" the person working the desk tells me. This was startling because I was sure they had just done a root canal on me, but after everything that just happened, I don't feel safe assuming anything. After some discussion we figured it out, but this was just another awkward moment on top of everything that had just happened.

So overall, the work that was done was fine but the experience left much to be desired. I went to Simply Crowns for the crown where I was treated with much more professionalism and respect.

user_reviews_extended.Description: When I say I’ve never had a better experience at a dentist office I mean it. I have a ton of anxiety around getting dental work and struggle with feelings of shame when my teeth are less than stellar. This was my first appointment at Buttercup and everyone at this office was so nice and professional. My dental hygienist, Sarah, was absolutely outstanding. I didn’t know how much I needed the care she gave. She was so supportive and  kind it literally made tears well up in my eyes and I had to tell the dentist how great she was. People don’t get enough attention for being great at their jobs and Sarah was great! For the first time in my life I left the dentist feeling positive and hopeful.  I have more work scheduled to be done here, but if this first visit is what I can typically expect from this office this will become my permanent practice I go to for all my dental needs.

title: Town Center Dental Cedar Park
address: 905 E Whitestone Blvd Suite D, Cedar Park, TX 78613, United States

user_reviews.Name: Paul Patel
user_reviews.Description:
I can’t say enough great things about Dr. Samir Momin and his entire team. From routine cleanings to more complex dental procedures, the level of care, professionalism, and attention to detail is truly exceptional.

Dr. Momin takes the time to thoroughly explain every diagnosis and treatment option, making sure you fully understand your dental health and feel confident in the plan moving forward. He never rushes appointments and is extremely patient when answering questions. That transparency and honesty really build trust.

Whether it’s preventive care like cleanings and exams, restorative work such as fillings, crowns, or root canals, or cosmetic treatments, his work is meticulous and high quality. He focuses not just on fixing the issue, but on long-term oral health. His precision and gentle technique make procedures as comfortable and pain-free as possible. If you’re someone who experiences dental anxiety, you’ll appreciate how calm, reassuring, and attentive he is throughout the entire visit.

The office is clean, modern, and well-organized. The staff is welcoming, professional, and efficient—from scheduling appointments to handling insurance and follow-ups. They make the entire process seamless.

What stands out most is how much Dr. Momin genuinely cares about his patients. You never feel like just another appointment on the schedule. He takes pride in his work and truly wants the best outcomes for your smile and overall dental health.

If you’re looking for a dentist who is knowledgeable, trustworthy, detail-oriented, and committed to comprehensive dental care, I highly recommend Dr. Samir Momin. You will be in excellent hands.

user_reviews.Name: Evelyn Aki
user_reviews.Description: Dr. Momin is an excellent dentist who is very knowledgeable, listens to patient needs, and provides professional care in a gentle caring manner. Visits are not rushed, provides information in an easy to understand language, he values your time, and easy to get appointments. Would highly recommend for all your dental work. The office staff are great,  caring, and demonstrate professionalism.

user_reviews.Name: MTB
user_reviews.Description: My husband has been an established patient here, and he always tells me how awesome the team is—and he is absolutely right. From the front desk to the dental staff, everyone is friendly, professional, and truly caring. They make you feel comfortable and well taken care of every visit. We’ve had a great experience as a family and highly recommend Town Center Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent experience at Town Center Dental! I went in for dental work and to get fixed dentures, and everything went smoothly from start to finish. user_reviews_extended.Description: Town Center Dental in Cedar Park is excellent—the staff is warm and professional, the office is modern and spotless, and Dr. Momin takes the time to explain everything clearly while making sure you’re comfortable throughout your visit; overall, they make dental care easy, efficient, and stress-free, and I’d highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abidali Dhukka
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very impressed with the high standard of care provided by Dr. Momin and the office staff. They are professional, knowledgeable, and ensure every patient feels comfortable and well-informed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: The ultimate price gouging dentist. Nearly $400 for X-rays & a cleaning. Also wanted a quote on a partial. I've had one in the past that I misplaced, which I paid $3,000 for. So I was expecting something in that general ballpark. Town center dental quoted me at $14,000. I was told I needed a variety of things that were completely unnecessary. On top of all that, I was told that I had a cavity & would need a filling for an outrageous price. I'm writing this review from the chair of another dentist. When I told them about the $14,000 quote for a partial - their jaw nearly hit the floor. And, guess what? I have no cavities, and therefore do not need any fillings. They overcharged me, over diagnosed me, and did it all with a smile on their face. Beware, sometimes nice people are only being that way to take advantage of you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Arufa Karovaliya
user_reviews_extended.Description:
So I went here to get my check up done for my invisalign, they did excellent job with deep cleaning, scanning and gave the best advice for what I should do.
Dentist Mr. Momin was very professional and very friendly.
Plus point: Office was very clean and neat.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Akib Maredia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Samir is a true artist. He didn't just see me as a set of teeth; he took the time to understand my goals and designed a treatment plan that was tailored perfectly for me. The entire process was smooth, and his team was there to support me at every check-in.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristy C
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place! I’ve been to a lot of dentist trying to find the right one, my original dentist retired. And this is it! I have been pleased each time and each service I have gotten. Very very great place. Always considering my feelings.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience during my recent dental visit. The entire process was smooth, professional, and surprisingly comfortable. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made sure I felt at ease every step of the way. The dentist was highly skilled and explained everything clearly, which gave me great confidence in the treatment. I’m truly impressed with the level of care and precision. Highly recommend town center dental  to anyone looking for top-quality dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: daemyn chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow. What can I say. Dr.M is genuinely the greatest dentist in the face of the planet. The teeth cleaning he gave me? Out of this world. I wouldn’t just recommend this place to family and friends, If you are ever and I do say EVER in the Cedar Park Area I BEG of you to visit this dentist office. Julie and Melanie instantly made me feel welcomed and at home, including other assistants as well. This is the best place of dentistry ever opened and I wish nothing but the absolute best for everyone who works here.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Momin is so friendly and we have been going to him from past 5-6 years. We never had any issue with him. His staff is so friendly. Dr. Momin is so caring, compassionate and accommodating dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christian Krahenbuhl
user_reviews_extended.Description: My wife and I have been going here for years for regular cleanings and an occasional filling. Dr. Momin has been great with us both during every visit. The staff is always pleasant, their facility is clean, and we really enjoy the decor of the place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abdul Umatiya
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thanks a lot to Dr. Momin and staff, For getting me in as an emergency patient this morning on such a short notice. And  getting me out of excruciating toothache.This was my first visit at Town Center Dental and my experience has simply been amazing. I highly recommend this office to each and everyone who requires a dental treatment. The staff is friendly, and Dr. Momin is very patient and extremely nice, and explained me the root canal procedure.most importantly I’m out of pain and I can finally catch some sleep. Thanks a million again Dr. Momin and staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tajdeen Maknojiya
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to this office as a new patient in severe pain . They got me in fast and handled my emergency with great care . I knew I needed significant work done in my mouth . After my initial visit, I knew I could trust them with the rest of the work that I needed. We came up with a plan and Dr.Momin explained me in detail about my dental treatment with detail and he also drew the pictures and showed me the model so I can understand the treatment he is planning to do . I couldn’t be happier with the results and how they handled the process from beginning to end. Extremely happy with the front desk and the staff . They are  good at their jobs, kind, and comforting to someone like me who hates being in that chair. I can’t speak highly enough about them and I’m grateful for all of their hard work. Reception/scheduling/ were very thorough and friendly. They were on top of their game and kept me well informed about my appointments to keep it all running smoothly. This is a great office and I feel like I received the best care possible. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shehla Ali
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience at my recent dental appointment! I needed a tooth extraction, but the entire process was seamless and painless. Dr. Samir Momin had a very gentle technique - I barely felt anything during the procedure! The extraction was done so quickly, I couldn't believe how easy and smooth everything went. On top of that, the entire appointment was incredibly convenient; I was in and out in no time, and they made sure to accommodate my schedule without any issues. Highly recommend this office for anyone who's looking for top-notch care with zero stress. Thank you for making what could've been a nerve-wracking experience so comfortable!

I highly recommend Dr. Momin for anyone seeking a knowledgeable and caring dentist! I also highly recommend them for anyone looking for a reliable, top-quality dental office in the Austin area!
