My teeth feel amazing after the cleaning. If you hate going to the dentist, this place might actually change your mind!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yan Ning
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Not going to use Town Center Dental in the future. Their staff are very impatient. I felt their impatience from previous phone calls but did not have a solid case. Now I got solid evidence.

I called to cancel an appointment due to travel and the staff said they would send a text message to confirm the cancelation. Since I didn't receive the message, and called back two days later to double check. Then they said they do not send cancellation confirmation, and the appointment was cancelled two days ago on their record. That was find so far. Then they added if I don't receive appointment reminder that means I do not have an appointment. I was to said that I would have an international trip around the original appointment date, ... (and therefore I couldn't receive any reminder on my phone. That's why I called again to confirm the appointment was cancelled). But before I finished talking, the staff lost her patient and just said "ok, bye, have a good trip." Not professional and lack of respect.

I'll share some concerns about their treatment another time.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and at ease. The staff is professional, friendly, and highly attentive to my needs.

He truly cares about his patients' well-being, and it shows in the way he approaches care—whether it’s a routine check-up or something more complex. The office is clean, modern, and equipped with the latest dental technology, which really sets it apart. - Giovanni

I couldn’t be happier with my experience and would highly recommend Dr. Momin and Town Center Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment that I called to schedule an appointment, the staff made me feel like I was high priority. They were able to squeeze my son for a last minute emergency tooth extraction. Dr. Momin was very knowledgeable and had a very gentle hand. My son felt very comfortable under his care. His team is very dedicated and will go the extra mile to meet your needs. Beautiful and clean office, I highly recommend this dental practice. 😊

user_reviews_extended.Description: I went here for a few years and the service was okay. Aggressive upselling always occurred and when I declined Invisalign the dentist became obstinate about fixing a chip.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and personable dentist and staff who will tailor services to your needs.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Town Center Dental accomodated me as an emergency walk-in. Had good experience and Dr.Samir was diligent and helped mitigate the pain.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Amin is such an awesome Dentist, I never had one so accurate and methodical before. And he has a nice office and well trained staff. No one go wrong in selecting this office for dental treatment. The hygienist who did the cleaning did a wonderful work. Very professional and sincere. Next I visit, I will make sure to have more time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bobert
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've always had significant dental anxiety, which has led me to avoid the dentist unless absolutely necessary. However, Dr. Momin and his team were exceptionally patient and kind, making me feel truly valued as a patient. Getting my cavities filled was surprisingly easy and completely painless. Thanks to this experience, I no longer feel as stressed about visiting the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeramie Spence
user_reviews_extended.Description: 1st time here, Great staff and Dentists. Making this my primary dental location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Graham
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just moved into the area, and needed to establish Dental Care. I had a great experience at Town Center Dental for an exam and cleaning. Dr Momin has a gentle, calming presence and cleaned my teeth with skill and confidence. I am definitely coming back, and wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie M
user_reviews_extended.Description: When flossing my teeth a filling fell out. My dentist was out-of-town all week. The dentists he refers to were also out-of-town. I saw the good reviews for Town Center Dental and gave them a call hoping they would be willing to help me. They were and they did. The ladies at the front desk were kind, efficient and thorough in making sure all the necessary information was obtained. The dental assistant and dentist answered my questions, did a beautiful job of fixing my tooth and were clearly experienced at what they were doing. I am SO thankful for their help. Five star review for sure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Mcdowell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Outstanding. Woke up in severe tooth pain. Same day appointment.  The staff is very professional and very friendly.  They accompany all your needs. Wish I could give a 10 star review. The dr amazing and very knowledgeable.  Best dentist visit I've had and looking forward to continuing to get treatment there. Thank you so much

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bernadette Bile
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dentist himself is great , very knowledgeable. The hygienists don’t always do a good job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dr. Elena Zinkov, ND
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been to many dentists, and I appreciate the expertise and care the team at Town Center provide. They are encouraging, compassionate, and provide very helpful and simple strategies to improve dental health—without the fear mongering that I’ve experienced with other dentists! Highly recommend them, and my family comes here too.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan A Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent and thorough dental services at Towen Center.  My dentist DR and hygienist explain details to promote excellent dental health and always offer recommendations to follow.  Thank you all

user_reviews_extended.Name: ali i
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came to this office and they provided exceptional care and helped me overcome the pain caused by my gum infection. Not only did they reduce my discomfort, but they also enhanced the appearance of my teeth. the staff is very professional and treat their patient like family. They give you compassion throughout the entire process. I have went to 2-3 offices but when I went to Dr. Samir he fixed my problem immediately. I am immensely grateful for their skill and would highly recommend their services to anyone in need. This is the best dental clinic in Austin.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sherie Zepeda
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very impressed with Dr. Momin.  He cares and makes you feel comfortable.  I liked his sense of humor. The staff are very nice and very helpful.
I live out of state and I'm happy we found this dentist to go to while I am here.  I would definitely recommend my family and friends to this dentist.
Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harold Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been to several Dental Clinics over the years and none have treated me as well as this clinic. The staff was very professional while at the same time treating me as though I was family. There was no hard sell of any procedures or products only care and concern and a lot of smiles from the moment I entered the clinic. I cannot say enough about Dr. Momin. His bedside manner was excellent! I am truly impressed with him and his wonderful staff. After going to several other dental clinics I have found the one to take care of my dental issues which I hope are few and far between.

user_reviews_extended.Name: sandi whiton
user_reviews_extended.Description: My son was in town for Christmas from grad school in Paris, and we realized that we needed to get him in for a cleaning. They called us back to schedule almost immediately and were able to accommodate us quickly. His teeth look great and are healthy. Everyone at the clinic was wonderful and the dentist super professional and efficient. We highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dwight Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description: 5 + years coming here, and I still have zero issues. I mean let's be real. Going to the dentist is still on my top  5 least favorite things to do, but since I really do need to go twice a year this is my place. The girls up front are great, and the doc is super cool. While I may not look forward to someone having their hands in my mouth for 40 minutes, I no longer hate going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: What an amazing visit I had today. It was my first time here and everyone in this office was absolutely wonderful. I felt so relaxed, comfortable and welcomed the whole time I was here. The office is clean, bright and open which just made me feel good. The Dr. was so calm, kind and informative as was his assistant and the two women at the front desk were friendly and easy to talk to. Before I left, I was taken to a room to discuss my dental treatment plan and what insurance coverage etc. The man who helped me knew exactly what he was doing and made sure I was comfortable with the plan/ route that I chose. He made everything as easy as he possibly could for me. I don’t always right reviews but I felt it was necessary because this was the best trip to a dentist I’d ever had! Ha! I look forward to continuing business with them and switching my family and friends over to them as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aarif Manasiya
user_reviews_extended.Description:
TLDR; If you are looking for a great place for your dental treatment, STOP right here!

Excellent facility and staff. I am yet to see a place where people enjoy so much at work. Always left the place with a better smile!

The hygienist here is awesome! Did a great job and explained me every detail along side ensuring the experience was nothing but best. Clear and simple instructions for what to do, how to do and when to do. It speaks of nothing but her solid experience.

I have seen many doctors over last 2 decades from New York to Texas. I can surely say it’s one of the best in terms of treatment, service, communication, and greeting.

Can’t ask for more. It simply full of experienced staff from top to bottom.

Thank you Dr. Samir and Town Center Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charles Enosa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Thank goodness. I  looked up this dentist on google when I tried to find one with the same day appointment. I called the office immediately I got appointment at 10:00 am. I had my consultation and scheduled for the procedure. Day of the procedure was excellent than I expected. Extractions done very quickly and I worked out with my new teeth and my another look of smile.
I highly recommend any one in and around Austin to visit Town Center Dental cedar park.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fayza
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came across Dr. Momin during my time in Austin for college, and I'm thrilled with the excellent service. Needed a local dentist while away from home, and he turned out to be the best choice. Remarkable care, and he even promptly scheduled me in the following morning. Highly recommend for those in the area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edna Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been here twice now and the staff and dentist are really great. They are easy to talk to and understand concerns. Going to the dentist isn't easy for me but, I'm grateful to have found these folks. The office is also very nice, modern and comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Been going to the dentist for over 4 years now and I am just as happy as I was with the first visit. Town Center Dental has found a good middle ground of being both professional and friendly. I have my teeth cleaned multiple times a year and have also gotten new crowns for my front teeth. With more simple stuff or more complicated procedures I’ve always been happy with the results. Of course going to the dentist is not the most fun thing in the world but I would recommend them without any doubts and that’s the biggest test of being a happy customer to me.

Update: Been coming here since close to when they first opened and I'm still very pleased with their performance. After having all my immediate family move to Town Center Dental between all of us we've pretty much had almost every kind of dental work done. The prices have always been competitive and the dental work has been excellent. Whether we have general preemptive care, emergency work or cosmetic dentistry we've all been happy with the results. What keeps me a loyal customer is everything is modern and well maintained. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable and quick to take care of any issues. Going to the dentist will never be my favorite thing but they make it much less of a chore.

I am grateful for the exceptional care provided by Dr. Momin and his team, and I highly recommend their services to anyone seeking top-notch dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christy Pickett
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have gone to Town Center for several years, and it’s always a top end experience (as dentists go!). Staff is friendly and kind, finance folks very helpful, and the care/dentist is great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raquel Cardozo

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonny Z
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If you are looking for a new permanent dentist, do not take your business to Dr. Momin at Town Center Dental.

I received multiple fillings by Dr. Momin and immediately afterward could tell they were done poorly, so I went to another dentist for a second opinion.

The other dentist was surprised at their poor quality and pointed out to me why:

1). The size of the fillings done by Dr. Momin are excessively large, deep, and dangerously close to the root - about 15-20% of my teeth were removed for what was a small cavity.

2). Dr. Momin failed to connect the filling to the central grooves of my teeth - essential for preventing decay underneath the filling, which would require a root canal.

Either Dr. Momin is incompetent and cannot perform routine fillings, or he knowingly did a poor job, hoping they would lead to future decay and more profitable procedures for himself down the line.

Whatever the case, neither is good for YOU, the person reading this review. Do not be fooled by the 4.9/5 star rating, if you dig a deeper you'll see most of them are fabricated.

If you are a floater or new patient with no connection to Dr. Momin, please avoid this place at all costs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Stilley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Searching for a new dentist is always a fairly stressful event. You don’t want to end up in some dingy hole in the wall place or right next to an HEB. At the same time, as an adult, you don’t want to go somewhere with elephants holding balloons painted all over the walls. I was looking for something that felt bright, clean and 21st century. Not trendy, just professional. That’s when I found Town Center Dental, and I am so glad I did.
To start, after I made an appointment, I received a text message confirming the appointment. The day before the appointment, I received a text reminder about it. Very helpful.
When I arrived for my appointment I was immediately greeted by the receptionist. Since they don’t stack 30 appointments on top of each other, I was greeted by my name as she knew exactly who the next patient was. Impressive. She handed me the paperwork to fill out and I took a seat in the waiting area. The waiting area is bright and white and clean with just enough color to make it feel comfortable.
My appointment was at 12:30. I arrived at about 12:15, filled out my paperwork and was preparing for the 30-45 minute wait that always happens at doctors’ and dentists’ offices. At 12:28, the door opened and the dental assistant called me back to be seen. Wow, how many times have I had an appointment at a doctor’s office, gotten there on time, and had to wait an hour to actually SEE the doctor. Impressive again!!
Once inside I was amazed at how modern the equipment was. This is not your dentist from when you were a kid, this is state of the art stuff. Digital x-rays with the x-ray out on the TV that was attached to the chair.
Dr Momin came in to explain to go over the x-rays with me and what options we had to fix my root canal gone bad from another dentist. I loved the fact that he thoroughly explained exactly what was currently happening with the tooth and what the different scenarios were for treatment. Ultimately, we decided on extraction.
I have never had such large dental work done with so little pain (none) and with so little ancillary damage done to my mouth. Usually, dentist will chew up your tongue, the insde of your cheeks, and anything else that gets in the way of doing what they need to do. I assume that they just think it is part of the “healing process”. Well, let me tell you, Dr. Momin was so precise that nothing else in my mouth was damaged (and he had to do some serious drilling!!) He was so precise that the next morning after my procedure, there was NO SWELLING in my mouth and I was seriously considering not taking any pain medication.
If you are looking for a bright, state of the art facility with the a dentist that is professional, transparent and REALLY good at what he does; if you are looking for a dentist that you won’t have to worry about pain or if there was another route to take for treatment, a dentist that does a great job AND relieves anxiety, then RUN to Town Center Dental. You won’t be sorry.

title: Cedar Park Dental Wellness
address: 251 N Bell Blvd Ste 106, Cedar Park, TX 78613, United States

user_reviews.Name: Kate Pashuk
user_reviews.Description: Very friendly and attentive staff. From the very first moment, you feel calm and well cared for. All procedures were performed very gently and carefully, with great attention to comfort. The doctor thoroughly explained every step of the visit and all necessary procedures, and patiently answered all of my questions. The clinic is very clean and welcoming, making it a comfortable place to be. I would also like to highlight the high level of professionalism of the entire team. I left with only the most positive impressions.

user_reviews.Name: G Gungor
user_reviews.Description: Scheduling went smoothly, and the dental office welcomed me warmly right away. Dr. Regina and her team were kind and really helped ease my dental anxiety. I had different procedures done, including a root canal, and had no pain afterward. One of the best dental experiences I’ve had.

user_reviews.Name: Erin Johnson
user_reviews.Description:
I hadn’t been to the dentist in 4 years and was really nervous about going back. When part of a tooth broke (it ended up being an old filling), I finally made an appointment with Cedar Park Dental Wellness — and I’m so glad I did.

Everyone was incredibly kind and welcoming, and they never made me feel embarrassed about the gap between visits. They use GBT for cleanings, which was much faster and way more comfortable than the traditional scraping I’ve had before. Such a great experience! Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: A K
user_reviews.Description:
I really enjoyed my experience at Cedar Park Dental Wellness. I had several procedures done here, including a professional cleaning, fillings, tooth extractions, and dental treatment. Everything was handled very professionally, carefully, and with great attention to my comfort.

The doctors and staff are true professionals who genuinely care about their patients. Scheduling appointments is quick and easy, and they are always flexible and willing to accommodate your schedule. The clinic is clean, modern, and welcoming.

I am very satisfied with both the results and the overall service. I highly recommend this dental clinic to anyone looking for high-quality dental care and a professional, attentive team.

user_reviews.Name: A Google User
user_reviews.Description:
We had a wonderful experience at this dental clinic with our child. The staff was incredibly kind, patient, and professional, which made the visit very comfortable and stress-free. The dentist explained everything clearly and treated our child with great care and attention.

We are very grateful for such a warm approach and excellent service. Highly recommend this clinic to families and children!

user_reviews.Name: Megan Puglise
user_reviews.Description: I came here because the reviews were so good and from the moment I called to schedule an appointment, I have been blown away with my experience from start to finish. They are so kind, communicate well and have a gentle approach to dental care. Tatiana has done my deep cleaning and has been unbelievable with how gentle she is and I love how she talks me through the whole process (including some of my anxieties). Dr. Regina is amazing too and I’m so excited she’s my dentist. If I ever move to another city, I’m flying back to continue my dental care because they are unmatched by others in the dental field.

user_reviews.Name: Yevheniia Omelnytska
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been a patient of Dr. Regina at Cedar Park Dental Wellness for three years, and I couldn’t be happier with the care I’ve received. She is truly dedicated to her work — very detail-oriented, professional, and always striving to achieve the best possible results. I’ve had several procedures done, including crowns and general treatments, and everything was done with great precision and care.

Dr. Regina has an amazing team of professionals as well. Tatiana, who takes care of my cleanings, is always gentle, attentive, and thorough. The whole staff is friendly and makes every visit comfortable and stress-free.

I highly recommend Cedar Park Dental Wellness to anyone looking for a trustworthy, skilled, and caring dental team!

user_reviews.Description:
Extremely high quality and absolutely no rush during the appointment.
Worth every penny!

Happy that we found a dentist who cares not only about the money but a true perfectionist who strives to get her job done in the best possible way!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A S
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently visited this dental office and was greeted by the friendliest Dr. Regina Yunusov and her husband imaginable. Their advanced equipment, like Gentle wave for root cleaning and robot hand for implant placement, ensures top-quality care with maximum comfort. Every patient is treated with warmth and professionalism from start to finish. As a dentist myself, I can say this place truly stands out. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking exceptional dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tolgonai Seker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted by the kind and professional front desk team. Sasha and her colleague are truly amazing, caring, and precise in everything they do.

Dr. Yunusov is a highly skilled specialist who uses the latest technology and works under a microscope to ensure every treatment is performed with absolute precision. Her professionalism and genuine care for patients are unmatched. I have truly never experienced a dental office that excels in every single aspect.

I also want to highlight the incredible dental assistants. I mostly worked with Yan, who is one of the most compassionate, caring, and knowledgeable professionals I’ve ever met. And Tatiana, the hygienist, is simply the sweetest. She makes the cleaning appointment comfortable and thorough, and you can tell she truly loves what she does.

I’m so grateful to have found such an exceptional dental provider. Highly recommend Cedar Park Dental Care to anyone seeking top-quality dental care and a team that genuinely cares about their patients!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yuriy Kharko
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at this dental office. The entire team was professional, friendly, and very attentive from the moment I walked in. The staff made the check-in process smooth and comfortable, and the clinic itself was very clean and well organized.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steven Wheeler
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would give 10 stars if I could. Everybody was amazing. Good vibes in the office and Dr . Regina was amazing. She has a way of making you feel comfortable. I broke a tooth and have a couple other issues and it can be a little embarrassing. Didn’t feel uncomfortable at all, every thing was positive and no pressure. I am definitely going back to see them again. Steven W.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cole McDonnell
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at CPDW truly is the best when it comes to making me feel safe and comfortable. My technician is always so kind and explains every step of what’s going to happen during my cleaning, and I truly feel healthier after leaving the office. Thank you so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eric Woodward
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently went to Cedar Park Dental Wellness and was impressed by their new robot implant technology called Yomi. It’s a modern tool that seems to make the implant process more precise and straightforward, which I appreciated. The office staff was also a highlight—friendly and welcoming, making the visit comfortable from start to finish. Overall, it’s a solid dental practice, and I’d recommend it to anyone looking for quality care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Woodruff
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in to this dental ofc as a new patient, needing a cleaning.  The dental hygienist was the most gentle, knowledgable and professional one I have ever been to.  I have large mandibular tori behind and in front of my bottom teeth, which make putting in a tray or x-ray apparatus  very painful but they did such a compassionate job.  The dentist was very professional also.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brenda Roemer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Regina and her professional and friendly staff were amazing again! Dr. Regina takes meticulous care while providing excellent dental services. I had a tooth chip that had a 50 year old filling in it. She removed the old filling and placed a crown. Again, she is the only dentist I've ever had to place a perfect crown. I also had a tooth extracted and received excellent care from every member of her team. She checked the next day on me and how I was doing. I've never had a dentist do that. I highly recommend Dr. Regina for all dental care. She is the Best dentist I've ever had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gennadiy Belikov
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Best dental office i've ever been to. Would recommend to anyone.

Everyone makes you feel comfortable, and they do extremely high quality work.

Dr. Regina takes a lot of time and care to make sure everything is perfect.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valentina Degtyar
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I waited a little before writing this review because I wanted to truly evaluate the care I received. My case is very complex, the result of brutal malpractice. I actually found this clinic by miracle: crying and desperately typing my case details into a search engine, just hoping to stumble on something and I did. When I discovered this clinic, I realised it was three hours away, but I didn’t hesitate. I drove the distance, and I am so glad I did.
I had my first surgery here on Friday, and I cannot describe how grateful I am. It went better than I could have imagined: no bruising, very mild swelling, and just one tiny stitch. I am not an average patient; I have been through nightmares under the care of American medical professionals but this clinic is different. They are beyond competent, with the latest technology, and qualifications, and most importantly - high morals. If you are desperate for real answers and want to become healthy again, go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiger Safarov
user_reviews_extended.Description: I work in the industry and can tell this practice is going above and beyond for their patients! During my visit yesterday, hygienist (Tatyana, who is awesome) asked if I would like to have a worm water for the cleaning procedure, since I have very sensitive teeth. I was blown away! I can't imagine this kind of service at the big/corporate name brand dental practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madison Scout
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing and kind dental staff! They fit me into their schedule extremely last minute when I was in a lot of pain and I couldn’t be more grateful. They really eased my dental anxiety, and having the sedation option was a great benefit. I’m really glad I found this office

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anastasia Beckman
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you are looking for a high quality service, attentive and knowledgeable specialists and caring professionals, this is definitely the place to go. Previously I had a lot of negative experiences with dentists and have anxiety to have any dental work done, but this place never fails me. It has the modern robotic equipment for complicated and precise work and top notch specialists. Can’t recommend it enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie
user_reviews_extended.Description: We just had our 1-year-old’s very first dental check-up here, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The entire staff was so kind, patient, and gentle — they made what could have been a stressful visit into such a positive one. They took the time to explain everything and helped our little one feel comfortable. Highly recommend for families with young kids!

user_reviews_extended.Name: I B
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love this practice!! The best doctor and staff in taking care of my family's most complicated cases. I truly feel very fortunate to have found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: T McClain
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to come in for a dental emergency and Dr. Yunusov and her team were amazing. Super kind, really listened, and made me feel so comfortable the whole time. I walked out feeling so much better. I am grateful to have found such a caring dentist! Highly recommend her and her entire team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Siranush Ghazanchyan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a wonderful experience at this dental office. The clinic is super clean and equipped with advanced technology, which made the entire process smooth and efficient — even though I had a very challenging case. They were able to schedule me the same day and truly went the extra mile. Such caring people!

The staff is well-educated, professional, and very knowledgeable, which made me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in. The doctor is absolutely perfect — skilled, gentle, and genuinely caring. The atmosphere even reminded me of my amazing previous DDS in California, which says a lot!

I left feeling confident and grateful. I highly recommend this office to anyone looking for top-quality dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sandy Pollard
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dental office was top notch. Very knowledgeable and informative about my care. I am usually full of anxiety at dentist appointments but they made it so easy. I would recommend them highly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Swabb
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for an emergency visit and I am 100% sure I’m going to end up switching dental care to this facility. From the 1st phone call, initial visit to the treatment plan (willingness to provide care same day) on a Saturday was amazing! The entire staff made me feel so comfortable. 10 out of 10 service!! Would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rushma khatri subedi
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Cedar Park Dental Wellness! They are efficient, professional, and truly seem to care about their patients. They have helped my husband and I with multiple dental procedures as well as routine cleaning, and we’ve always found that they do great work while minimizing the usual discomfort that sometimes comes with dental procedures… Plus they have a very positive attitude and have created a warm, welcoming environment that makes me not mind going to the dentist so much :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jill Cipriano
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Regina and her entire staff have been absolutely amazing with my daughter who has struggled with multiple dental issues. They are always so caring and careful with her and it shows how much they truly care for their patients. I cannot say enough good things about this staff from the front desk to the back office. They have been wonderful! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: elaine brendler
user_reviews_extended.Description: This team is genuinely kind and caring from office staff to dental assistants to Dr Regina Yunusov and for sure she is incredibly highly skilled. They can also do everything on site which is so helpful..

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joel Mitchell
user_reviews_extended.Description: After a few poor experiences at Swish Dental, I was referred to CPDW and couldn't be happier. The team is welcoming, thorough and did an excellent job. I've found my new dentist and couldn't be happier.

user_reviews_extended.Name: kearakashay
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came in yesterday to get my wisdom teeth removed and let me tell you, I love this place so much! Everyone is so nice, even the receptionist! :) I’ve been self conscious about my teeth for years because of the cavities and crooked smile, but they made me feel comfortable and no judgmental whatsoever! They also had a tv on the ceiling, provided a Roku remote, and headphones to occupy me while get my procedure done! I couldn’t afford to the bill right now, so they came up with a treatment plan and a payment plan and my mouth is on a journey to recovery! can’t wait to reach the finish line!  Thank you Cedar park dental wellness!
- K Paige 🦷 ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexander Hall
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a patient at this dental office for the past three years since moving to Austin, and I genuinely couldn’t be happier with the care I’ve received here. From the moment you walk in, you can feel how warm, clean, and welcoming the office is. The atmosphere instantly puts you at ease, something I truly value in a dental office.

Dr. Regina and her entire staff are absolutely amazing! They’ve consistently gone above and beyond with their attentiveness and ability to make every visit pleasant. They are always friendly, professional, and kind, treating you like more than just a patient. Their level of communication is excellent as well—everything from scheduling appointments to explaining procedures is handled seamlessly and efficiently.

I feel incredibly fortunate to have found this dental practice. It’s clear they care deeply about their patients, and that’s evident in every interaction. If you’re looking for a dental office where you’ll feel valued, comfortable, and in great hands, I can’t recommend Dr. Regina and her team enough!

Even when I moved from Cedar Park to South Austin, I still drove all the way to the office because their care is unmatched. I will truly miss their service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elina
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very happy I found Dr. Regina and her staff. Everyone in the office is extremely knowledgeable and helpful. The complex procedures were completed perfectly. Yes, the equipment is state of the art, but the equipment is nothing without a doctor who knows what they are doing. Dr. Regina is one of those doctors who is a perfectionist and a great diagnostic specialist. I would highly recommend this office to anyone who is looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Gonzalez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've had an outstanding experience at this dental office! I've received two cavity fillings, and I'm extremely impressed with the results. Dr. Yunusov uses GrandioSO filling material, which is superior to traditional options, and she takes exceptional care in perfecting both the function and appearance of each tooth.

What really stands out is her attention to detail - my appointment lasted about 2.5 hours because she was meticulous about ensuring everything was done perfectly. I actually appreciate that she doesn't rush through procedures. You can also watch on the screen as she works on your teeth which is actually pretty cool to see.

The overall experience is excellent:
• The office is immaculately clean
• The staff is friendly and welcoming
• They provide headphones to watch Netflix during procedures (a great feature for nervous patients like myself)

If you're looking for a dentist who prioritizes quality work and patient comfort, I highly recommend Dr. Yunusov.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Entire staff is helpful, knowledgeable,  and were very patient with my 92 year-old dad! And when you call their office, a real human will answer the phone and talk to you! That's a personal touch that you don't see very often. We even had a chance to meet the surgeon and she gave us several options. The front desk staff provided us with copies of all of our x-rays and visit notes. I would definitely feel comfortable going there for any type of dentistry needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anton Lieman
user_reviews_extended.Description: They are truly the best at what they do! The entire team is professional and incredibly friendly. I’ve had multiple dental treatments done here, including orthodontics, and I’m absolutely thrilled with the results! After every visit, I feel like leaving them another great review. I 100% recommend this dental clinic if you value top-quality dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Ludlum
user_reviews_extended.Description: I visited Dr Regina today for an emergency and it was the greatest dental experience I've ever had. The entire staff was welcoming and friendly and took their time to explain my options for a treatment plan. The facility is wonderful and impressively up to date with the latest technology. I even had a wonderful Americano.  Dr Regina was warm and efficient but never rushed. I would wholeheartedly recommend this office for anyone, of any age, of any state of dental health.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wenlan Wei
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an amazing experience with Cedar Park Dental Wellness. When I was in extreme pain, suffering from a fever and needing two root canals, I couldn’t find any dentist available. However, Dr. Regina and her team went above and beyond to help me, even offering treatment on the weekend. I am incredibly grateful for their dedication and care.

Not only was the root canal treatment handled professionally, but the follow-up check-ups have also been thorough and reassuring. Dr. Regina is incredibly gentle and kind, making the entire process much more comfortable. Their dental cleaning services are also excellent, with a very gentle and caring approach.

I highly recommend Cedar Park Dental Wellness to anyone looking for a skilled, compassionate, and professional dental team. Thank you again for your amazing work! 🙏💖

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Good dentist is so hard to find and I am so glad that I found Dr Regina. I was shocked at how many of my old fillings were in need of replacement, because of the thorough comprehensive exam with modern scanning equipment we caught several that would have needed a root canal if left untreated. I’m shocked my previous dentist missed them all.

From the very first visit the entire team worked really hard to make sure I was comfortable (even put on my favorite show on the ceiling-hung TV), they kept me well informed with photos and digital scans, and made sure I was happy with the results. Dr Regina was amazing, from painless shots to spending a lot of time getting my teeth looked and feeling perfect. I can’t thank her enough!

To top it off, Cedar Park Dental Wellness clinic has a very modern feel, all the equipment they have at this location is cutting edge and it gives me confidence that they care about results and their patients, you can tell right away they work to a higher standard. My only regret is that I haven’t found them sooner!

user_reviews_extended.Name: victoria gidey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had my wisdom tooth removed and I couldn’t be more impressed with the care and professionalism of the entire team. From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel comfortable and at ease. The front desk was friendly and efficient and great communication. They call and or text you regularly to answer any questions you may have about the procedure you’re going to have.
The Dr. was absolutely amazing  She took the time to explain the procedure clearly, answered all my questions, and made sure I felt confident and relaxed before getting started. During the extraction, everything went smoothly and much faster than I expected. I felt no pain, just some mild pressure, and the doctor and her staff continuously checked in to make sure I was okay.
Post-op instructions were clear and easy to follow, and they even followed up to check on how I was healing. I can’t recommend this clinic enough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cedar Park Dental Wellness was an amazing experience. Dr. Regina and her staff are all kind and knowledgeable. The X-rays and dental equipment are technologically advanced. My left jaw has been swollen not tooth related and she knew immediately what it was and explained fully what was happening. She and her staff coordinated with my physician for follow up care and options.

user_reviews_extended.Name: oscar german
user_reviews_extended.Description: A most professional and pleasant experience. Ana at the front desk was excellent with explanations and coordinating my appointment. Tatiana’s dental cleaning and oral care instructions were the best I’ve ever received, she’s very knowledgeable and skilled. Ultimately the entire staff I interacted with were accommodating and lovely while the clinic was very nice and welcoming. Very much looking forward to doing all my dental work with the masterful Dr. Regina from here on now.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camryn McLaughlin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience with cedar park dental wellness. They were very informative and took the time to answer any questions I had and to clarify anything I didn’t understand. Thank you so much for the great experience

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marlen Espinosa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had my first appointment today and was impressed by the high level of professionalism of the Dr. Regina Yunusov and the advanced technology used to reach a diagnosis. The front desk staff and technicians were very friendly and knowledgeable. I'll be back in two days for treatment and will update my review then.

"I had a crown on tooth #7, and it broke very close to the gumline, leaving only the root with a previously done root canal.
I went to a clinic to see how they could help me. They gave me two options, but both required extraction.
I decided to go to another clinic and found Dr. Regina Yunusov. Through advanced technology, she measured the tooth's root and considered saving it. With the required procedure, she placed a new crown. In 4 hours, they completed the process and placed the crown on the same day.
Dr. Yunusov went above and beyond. She is very professional, competent, and highly skilled, as is her team, which ensured I was informed throughout the procedure and made me feel safe and comfortable.
Ana, the front desk assistant, was very kind and knowledgeable in her job. I appreciate her great help with the documentation, payment process, guidance, and with the Spanish language.
Cedar Park Dental Wellness clinic has advanced equipment, is modern and kept very clean.
If you are looking for a highly skilled doctor in complex and advanced dental procedures with a fantastic team, this clinic is for you. I highly recommend it.
I live far away, but it's worth the drive to receive high-quality treatment with comfort, kindness, and honesty."

I’m updating my review because I’ve continued my treatments with the doctor, Regina Yunosov and this time I had a dental implant. From the very first moment, I felt comfortable and in great hands. The whole process was clear, clean, and very professional, and the result was simply excellent. I’m so grateful for the doctor’s dedication and outstanding work.

I also want to highlight the kindness and professionalism of the entire team. The staff at the front desk are always welcoming and took the time to clearly explain all the financing options, which made everything easy to understand and stress-free.

If you’re looking for a place that offers quality results, professionalism, and truly caring service, I highly recommend this clinic!

user_reviews_extended.Name: C W
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I highly recommend Cedar Park Dental Wellness. It is by far the best experience I’ve had at any dental office I’ve been to. Excellent, professional, hardworking staff, comfortable, organized and friendly environment. Dr.Regina is very professional and it shows that she cares about her patients and her profession. If you want the best go to this office.
CW

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harper Stevens
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first time visit was excellent. Everybody there is knowledgeable, kind and good at their job.
They were SO gentle without me even asking and as someone with pretty high dentist anxiety, I very much appreciated that. Additionally, they always explained everything they were doing before they did it.

Great experience! Looking forward to future visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeremy Robins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kind, courteous, and professional! They were thorough with my assessment and treatment plan. They made sure I was comfortable and felt no pain throughout the procedure. I cannot recommend these guys enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: tromuh tromuh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been going to this dental clinic for over a year and a half now, and after trying quite a few others before, I can say this one sets a high bar for quality. The doctors and personal here are extremely professional, and what I really appreciate is how they take the time to explain everything — both in simple terms and with all the technical details if you're curious.

So far, I've had fillings, a crown, and orthodontic treatment done here, and every step of the way I felt well taken care of. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aleksandra Crabtree
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is by far the best dentist practice our family has been to. They use the latest technology and all the staff are really knowledgeable especially Mrs Tatiana. Recently, our 6 year old son had teeth extracted and Dr Regina removed it without our son even noticing. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Thornock
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Regina’s techniques and care to try to save tooth structure are impressive. Her techniques seem very similar to biomimetic techniques, even using dental dams for all work in order to keep everything contained. Wonderful experience going for my initial exam.

I found her through the gentle wave provider list and noticed she is also a general dentist, which saves on having an extra appointment with an endodontist if needed (she is an endodontist…gentle wave is a specialized root canal treatment).

Regina was thorough in doing the thermal test on several teeth by applying a cold stimulus to the tooth to check for sensitivity. If the tooth hurts longer than 5 seconds after the cold stimulus (if I’m remembering right), then it indicates a root canal would be needed).

Before coming to Regina I had a big piece of tooth that came off, but it passed the thermal test. She will do the filling in layers with curing time, etc. Even though it will take longer, it will last longer, and hopefully help keep my tooth from ever needing a root canal.

I wonder if that is what her patients have found to be the case (the fillings being stronger, more minimal, and lasting much longer), and what it is about her techniques in layering that is different than a typical dentist in order for it to last longer than a filling from other dentists. She does have very clear Instagram videos showing her techniques. I’m still trying to learn where she is on the spectrum between typical dentistry and biomimetic dentistry. It seems her techniques may even be more thorough than some biomimetic dentists. I’ve been to one before in Dallas, but that was much farther from where I live, and I don’t know that he was as thorough as Regina may be. From the biomimetic dentist in Dallas (not Regina) that I went to 2 years ago, the two teeth he ‘saved’ from having root canals have sensitivity now, which is why I’m looking for another biomimetic dentist. Granted, they were teeth that any average dentist could not save and would have went straight to a root canal.

I am very grateful they had a professional available to speak with me after to answer more of my questions. He was very easy to talk to. I was wondering at first why Regina didn’t speak more with me, but then realized there was another professional who was able to answer the other questions I had. I’m glad, so that Regina could have more time with patients.

Even more, it was neat to learn that even in the last year there has been upgrades in the robotic technology to be able to accurately place implants on the very back molars if needed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Knight
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The absolute best in Austin. This dentistry practice is employing the newest and highest-quality technology. If you have money, go here.

I spent many hours researching the highest quality possible way to perform a tooth extraction and implant, and then trying to find the person who most closely matched the theoretical optimal in the greater Austin area.

Of course, it’s possible I missed a place, but to my knowledge this is the ONLY dentistry practice in Austin which performs implants using all four of the following advanced methods:

1) Use of the YOMI robot to perform implants which has been proven to be the most accurate and safest possible way to perform an implant which exists today. I am not allowed to leave a link, but google, “Accuracy Comparison between Robot-Assisted Dental Implant Placement and Static/Dynamic Computer-Assisted Implant Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of In Vitro Studies”

2) Use of PRF to improve healing.

3) Incorporation of autograft (incorporating your own bone to perform the bone graft, which decreases risk of rejection and improves healing), as opposed to exclusive use of allograft (donor bone, which is what virtually everyone else uses).

4) Places an immediate temporary crown when possible to help maintain the gumline.

The in-house technology is tremendous. The ability to make their own crowns and they even custom made me a retainer in one day designed to not put pressure on the temporary crown.

I went to two other consultations, a prosthodontist and a periodontist, so you know I don’t just haphazardly accept even highly qualified people. I can confidently say, Dr. Regina Yunusov is the absolute highest-quality option in Austin. If you have money, go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Louis Capps (zPianodude)
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently started with Dr. Yunusov and team at Cedar Park Dental Wellness to have two implants installed.  Unfortunately my extra two baby teeth that have survived decades finally gave out :) These implants are my first and after researching the latest, best approaches, found Cedar Park Dental Wellness through reviews and learning of new robotic technologies being used to improve this procedure.

The experience overall has been great and Dr. Yunusov has an outstanding team working here from the front desk to the assistants during the procedure.  She has been extremely helpful and patient on any questions asked and her team has walked me through any details I've asked.  I would recommend to others looking to do this or other procedures and looking for a friendly and experienced team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My wife and I have been going to Cedar Park Dental Wellness for the past few months, and the experience has been exceptional from day one.

What really stands out is the level of care and attention. It never feels rushed or impersonal. Everything is explained clearly, and there’s a genuine focus on making patients feel comfortable and taken care of. The atmosphere is calm, relaxed, and welcoming, which makes a huge difference compared to typical dental visits.

You can also tell the dentist is deeply committed to continuous learning and improvement, which gives a lot of confidence in the quality of care. Combined with their state-of-the-art equipment and overall professionalism, it truly feels like world-class dentistry.

The entire team is friendly, professional, and highly attentive. We’ve always felt well taken care of, and it’s clear they genuinely care about their patients.

We’ll definitely continue coming here and highly recommend Cedar Park Dental Wellness to anyone looking for a top-tier dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: AheLiLi M
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have a lot of anxiety and had an attack during my appointment that caused me to start crying, but every single person (including Dr. Regina, of course) were patient,  informative, and comforting (much appreciation to Jafi and Arat) throughout my visit. I'm grateful for their understanding towards my general fears of going to the dentist, and I feel like I'm in good hands trusting them on my journey to get my teeth back to a healthy state.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is so very kind and knowledgeable! Very fair pricing, same day service. Would certainly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grisha GA
user_reviews_extended.Description: Отличная стоматологическая клиника! Очень внимательный и профессиональный персонал, современное оборудование и комфортная атмосфера. Врач всё подробно объяснил, приём прошёл спокойно и без стресса. Остались только положительные впечатления — рекомендую!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ирина Данелюк
user_reviews_extended.Description: Супер круті майстри!! У мене були складні 2 зуба, з лікуванням , рут каналями та коронкою. Доктор Регіна та інші лікарі все зробили самим найкращим способом!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Viktoriia Gerg
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Хочу выразить огромную благодарность стоматологической клинике Cedar Park Dental Wellness  за их профессионализм и внимательное отношение к пациентам. Недавно я обратилась сюда с проблемой зубной боли, и уже с первого визита ощутила высокий уровень сервиса.
Весь персонал клиники, от ресепшн до врачей, был очень приветлив и заботлив. Доктор  подробно объяснил все этапы лечения, ответил на все мои вопросы и провел процедуру максимально аккуратно и безболезненно. Особо хочу отметить чистоту и современное оборудование клиники, что внушает дополнительное доверие.
Спасибо за вашу работу и заботу о пациентах! Буду рекомендовать вашу клинику всем своим друзьям и знакомым.

С уважением,
Виктория.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zoia Kotiai
user_reviews_extended.Description: Я давно являюсь постоянным пациентом в этой стоматологической клинике, и могу с уверенностью сказать, что они - настоящие профессионалы. Врачи здесь всегда внимательны, заботливы и очень квалифицированы. Я чувствую себя комфортно и уверенно, приходя на прием, и мои стоматологические проблемы всегда решаются на высшем уровне. Кроме того, клиника чистая и современно оборудована, что тоже важно. Я благодарен за отличное обслуживание и рекомендую эту клинику всем, кто ищет качественный стоматологический уход.

user_reviews_extended.Name: natasha sokolova
user_reviews_extended.Description: Мне очень приятно ходить в эту клинику. Прекрасное отношение к клиентам. Всё очень профессионально, современно и дружелюбно. Доктор Регина слушает клиентов очень внимательно и отвечает на все волнующие вопросы  убедительно и спокойно. Я сделала имплант в этом офисе, залечила несколько зубов. Все прошло легко и безболезненно. Очень рекомендую этот офис.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Артем Товпеко
user_reviews_extended.Description: Здравствуйте, волею случая попал на прием в стоматологическую клинику к доктору Регине и ее команде! Все мои несколько посещений прошли быстро и качественно! Ребята делают свою работу хорошо, всегда стараются пойти на встречу, найти индивидуальный подход и максимально комфортно сделать все процедуры! Спасибо за помощь в лечении и успехов вам!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Альона Малиновська
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Я считаю, что моему ребенку очень повезло попасть в Америке к такого уровня доктору как Регина.
У моего сына 11 лет была очень сложная ситуация связанная с рут  каналами. И только эта клиника из 8 других смогла взяться и спасти мне ребенка. В прямом смысле спасти.
Я очень благодарна, что Регина смогла добиться результата и вылечить зуб. Спасибо что в критической, экстренной ситуации были рядом и спасали. 🙌
Рекомендую !
Очень рекомендую !

user_reviews_extended.Description: Замечательный и профессиональный коллектив!!! Уютная клиника. Все оперативно, объяснили доступно, предложили варианты лечения. Очень удобный режим работы и не нужно ждать очереди месяцами. Рекомендую!!!

user_reviews.Name: Alicia Stennett
user_reviews.Description: The staff here are all friendly, kind, and efficient.  The hygienist, Debbie, is very knowledgeable and did a great job cleaning my teeth today.  I have always gotten the best dental care here and would definitely recommend this dental practice.

user_reviews.Name: Alexis Panther
user_reviews.Description: If you love the feel good experience of going to Chik fil A, then this is the dentist office for you! This dental office is nothing but pleasant from start to finish. They understand that there is so much anxiety around dental appointments, and will do everything they can to make sure your appointment is nothing but a happy one. All of the staff are lovely and you feel like you’ve walked into a space full of friends. I have nothing negative to say. Only good!

user_reviews.Name: Yazmeli Ascencio
user_reviews.Description: I have dental anxiety and had a really bad experience at my last dentist. I moved with Cedar Park Premier dentistry almost a year ago, and they are absolutely amazing! Dr. Jesko and Rachel have made me feel so safe and taken care of! Neisha is also so sweet and explained all my benefits ( which can be overwhelming and confusing) they are honest genuine  people and if you want your teeth to SLAYYYYYY come here!!

user_reviews.Name: Brad Collard
user_reviews.Description: I love Cedar Park Premier Dentistry.  After bad experiences with upselling dentists, I put off going to the dentists for years, and the COVID year just gave me more of an excuse to wait longer.  I needed some work done, and while I was hesitant of going back to a dentist, I decided to just be honest with them about what I expected from my dentist.  They understood. Got my checkup and cleaning. They put together a plan to fix my teeth, went through 2024 using my annual benefits, and finished the plan earlier this year. My teetj are better than they've been in years, and even had a 15 year old crown replaced that broke earlier this year. They hygienists are the best.  Oh, they are sensitive to those of us with gag reflexes and they also cater to cowards.  Gas me up!

user_reviews.Name: Ryan Watts
user_reviews.Description: Clean comfortable setting and super friendly and professional staff! They have the latest technology and a highly skilled team to implement it. Best hygienists I’ve ever had! Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Description: Certainly miss Dr. K. Dr. Jesko is also fantastic. The staff all is super efficient and friendly. Feel like Cheers where everyone knows your name. Fantastic with insurance and their oral surgeon referral was spot on (Dr. Naples).

user_reviews_extended.Description:
I visited Cedar Park Premier Dentistry on an urgent basis, and I’m so grateful I found this clinic. As soon as I walked in, I was warmly welcomed by Niesha, who immediately stepped in to help even though the office was about to close. She provided me with an oral rinse and made sure I was scheduled for the very next day. Her kindness and professionalism made all the difference.

Everyone at the clinic is incredibly friendly and helpful, and Dr. Jesko is absolutely amazing. You can tell the team genuinely cares about their patients. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a compassionate and skilled dental team.

user_reviews_extended.Description:

My first procedure was a deep cleaning.  I loved that Debbie explained everything .  My mouth feels wonderful- no pain!

user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a wonderful experience at my cleaning today. Everyone is so friendly from front office staff to the hygienists, assistants, and Dr. They even have unique fluoride flavors like cola lime, caramel, and melon. Thank you!
