user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional advice and help with my dental problems. Friendly staff and clean facility as well. Recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: amy gardner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience at Cedar Park dentistry! The entire team is incredibly professional, friendly, and attentive to patient needs. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and cared for. The staff took the time to explain every procedure clearly and made sure I was comfortable throughout my visit. The doctor was thorough and gentle, ensuring that my dental work was done with great precision. The office is clean, modern, and equipped with the latest technology. I highly recommend Cedar Park dentistry to anyone looking for excellent dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shawn Slaughter
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Cedar Park Premier Dentistry, and I can confidently say that they transformed not just my smile, but my overall confidence as well. From the moment I walked in, the welcoming atmosphere and friendly staff made me feel at ease.

Dr. Kondoff and her amazing staff took the time to explain my treatment options and listened to my concerns. Their expertise in restorative dentistry was evident, and I felt assured that I was in good hands. The procedure itself was smooth and comfortable, and I was amazed at how quickly I saw results.

Now, my smile looks fantastic, and I find myself smiling more often without hesitation. This experience has truly revitalized my self-esteem. I wholeheartedly recommend Cedar Park Premier Dentistry to anyone seeking compassionate care and exceptional results. Thank you for restoring both my smile and my confidence!

user_reviews_extended.Name: M F
user_reviews_extended.Description: This post is overdue but I definitely want to shout out to Dr. Tiffany Kondoff and Rachel (dental assistant). I got a crown put in back in November 2024 and they made the experience as smooth as possible. I have some trauma from a previous dental experience that resulted in immense pain on the same tooth that they were working on. As a result, during my visit, my anxiety and fear were at an all time high. Both Rachel and Dr. Kondoff were really kind and did everything -and then some- they could to help me manage my anxiety and I’m forever grateful. This week, months later, I actually had some pain again for that same tooth which thankfully only ended up being a simple bite issue. Again, my anxiety was ridiculous but Rachel and this time a new doctor (I didn’t catch her name!) made me feel comfortable and taken care of. I’ve never left a review for a dental office before but I have to say that the team at this office really do care about their patients. I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was nice and helpful, when figuring out insurance. Dental assistant did a great job removing buildup on my son's teeth. Both dentist and dental assistant were very kind and reassuring with my boys. My boys had a good dental visit and their teeth looked great when we left. They even referred us to an orthodontist for early referral on possible spacers. Overall they were very thorough and I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Carman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a wonderful experience today with the entire staff at Premier Dental. They were so efficient and detailed every step as a new patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jon Payne
user_reviews_extended.Description: Seriously, this is The Best Dentist that I’ve ever been to in my life. The entire staff is incredibly knowledgeable, professional, and so much fun to visit with every time.  I never give perfect ratings, but they have earned a perfect 10/10. Straight and perfect teeth and they even stopped my snoring!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Ladd
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had serious dental anxiety for many years. I feel like I am finally working through that here.. today I got through the entire appointment without medication or major tears! The staff is amazing, helpful and so kind. I’ve had only positive experiences and am so grateful to have found them. I recommend them whole heartedly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dianna Gratehouse
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Staff are so kind and welcoming. I am always so pleased with the services they have provided. I would recommend Dr Jesko and their group to my family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quick same day appointment for a chipped tooth at a very reasonable price! Very personable and kind care from the dentist and assistant. Thanks Premier dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Chavez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
1st time visit to Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. Everyone was so nice and helpful.
X-rays, cleaning and exam was very thorough. I couldn't have expected anything more. I even got a little treat at the end of my visit. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia Jane
user_reviews_extended.Description:
2025 Update: This is still the best dental office in the Cedar Park and Leander area. I have been coming here for several years now and love the personal care and attention they have given me.

Moved into the area didn't know where to go for dental care, referred by my sister to Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. Best thing that ever happened to my teeth! They are caring, professional and communicate with you every step of the way with every process. I had a mouthful of problems, they worked out a plan to get them fixed in order of priority and made sure I was taken care immediately when a tooth decided to cause me a lot of pain and grief. I have experienced their dental cleaning, root canal, implant, crown and cavity services. Best dental office I've ever been to, one visit and you won't be dental shopping ever again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jack
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire office at Premier in Cedar Park is amazing. For anyone with anxiety look no further, Premiere takes good care of you and makes sure that you're comfortable the entire time, it's an easy decision to always come here for any issues I'm having with my teeth. Making an appointment is easy and Neisha or Quinn are always so extremely helpful, it makes a world of difference. I've never been to an office that focuses so much on the small things that make the world of difference for comfort and ease, you can tell they are truly a team and a family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Regan Monteverde
user_reviews_extended.Description: I chipped my tooth and they got me in the next day and fixed it within 20 min. So friendly and nice! Would highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janet Faz
user_reviews_extended.Description: The experience was great from start to finish. Everyone is friendly and very knowledgeable. I found things out that my previous dentist had never even mentioned. I feel more confident moving forward with what I need to do to keep my chompers healthy. Pricing was given to be before I left so I could prepare in case I wanted to move forward with treatment. It was a very positive experience. I’m really happy I switched to them😊.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika Sainos
user_reviews_extended.Description: Updating my review to 5 stars! Dr. Kondoff and her team went above and beyond to make things right after my last visit. They took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I was completely satisfied with my experience and how my teeth felt. I truly appreciate the care and attention they provided!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jan Peoples
user_reviews_extended.Description: So happy with the entire staff! Highly recommend for your dental needs!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jill R
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here is so welcoming, knowledgeable and friendly. Their first priority is making sure you feel comfortable and I really appreciate that. I’m so glad I found this dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joanne Swandt
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! The x-ray technician was very kind and explained everything clearly. She made me feel very comfortable. My teeth needed some cleaning up and the dental hygienist did an excellent job. They were also very thorough in their check up. I’m very pleased with this place. Definitely would recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frank Artuso
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It was my first visit to Cedar park premiere dentistry.The staff greeting me was friendly.The dental hygienists were very nice and friendly.Everything was explained to me in detail.
Due to Weather and traffic I was late for my appointment.They were understanding and friendly and worked me in which was very nice. I hadn't been to a dentist in quite some time and everyone at premiere.Dentistry made me feel comfortable and at ease.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Perry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I go to CP Premier for my teeth cleaning. I highly recommend Maryland for your teeth cleaning needs. She’s gentle but does a thorough job cleaning. She also doesn’t make you talk when you’re in the middle of a cleaning lol, which is a big deal to me and why I now only go to her.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Barstow
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quick and efficient and very friendly...great place to go for your dental needs

user_reviews_extended.Name: hbell1111
user_reviews_extended.Description:
11/25 just had a partial adjusted.  Their customer service is outstanding. They are juggling their schedule to fit me in for a cleaning and xrays before the end of the year due to insurance restarting Jan. 1st.

2024 I have not been to see them for 2 years.  I had a crown pop off.  They were still willing to help me!  They are high tech and caring.  Thank you Cedar Park Premiere Dentistry!  Excellence is their goal and they surpass it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carl Luo
user_reviews_extended.Description: It is my first visit. It is great, people are nice and professional, explained all my questions in detail with patience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa R.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend this practice. Every person on staff that I have encountered has been extremely helpful and so friendly and Dr Williams was everything I hoped for- so knowledgeable and patient. He took the time to explain my issue and his plan to help. He was very reassuring and kind. They have a sign on the front door that says welcome to our home and that is exactly the feeling I got while there, very comfortable- 10/10 would recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: cutechickie waffles
user_reviews_extended.Description: CPPD did a great job! They started by properly verifying my insurance to make sure I'd be covered (thank you!). They also got me in right away...same day for my husband, next day for me. They didn't keep me waiting long in the waiting room. The staff were very friendly. They have a small mouth piece especially for people with extra bone growth (Tori), like me, and it made x-rays WAY more comfortable! It usually hurts quite a bit. But this was the best experience I've had. The hygienist & dentist were caring and courteous.  I'll be back for sure!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Orenstein
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My first visit to this dentist was really great. I found out that they don’t have rotating dentists coming from other places to work a shift, they have the same dentists, the same hygienist, the same folks, which is important to me.     Plus if I when I had questions they provided answers I could understand.

The professionalism was great.  Everyone was smiling.  Didn’t try to sell me anything I didn’t need.

Debbie and Rachel treated me very well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: suzy laku
user_reviews_extended.Description: It is a fairly new place for my family. So I think the staff are nice and welcoming. But, today I was late for my son’s appointment and I felt like I kept apologizing more than once. One of the staff members made it seem like she was not aware I was late and that made me feel a certain way. And also, I don’t think my son really got his teeth cleaned well because, I asked how long it was going to and I was about 40 minutes but, it didn’t even seem 30 minutes. And I get it i was later about 8 minutes and that might have taken time away from the appointment time but, still it didn’t seem okay. Overall, I think it is a great place to get dental care. This is just my honest review.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angie Mcdonald
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very personable, knowledgeable, and professional staff! I appreciate their efficiency with exams and procedures. They always ensure my comfort at every step in the exam chair, starting with a personal greeting upon arrival and continuing through the check-out process. It's a great place to go if you're at all apprehensive about visiting the dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andy Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was great at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. They were punctual, very informative and by far the smoothest transaction ever. I was in & out in no time at all!! Thank You, Cedar Park Premier Dentistry for a fantastic experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaye Scales
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was a new patient about two years ago and the staff, Debbie the hygienist and Doctor Williams made me feel so welcomed and was very informative. Now I feel like one of the family. They know your name when you walk in, they take you in quickly, no lengthy waiting and thorough when they service you. Cedar Park Dental is highly recommended for your dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frank K. Gilmore III
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient of Cedar Park Premier Dentistry for several years now. The staff here is friendly and very professional. They’ve mastered the art of painless dentistry which is a major concern for individuals such as me. I would definitely recommend this dental office for minor or major dental procedures.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Ottis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist office in the state of Texas. They are so nice and everyone there is always smiling. I used to hate the dentist but I honestly look forward to going now that I found this place. I needed a root canal and crown and hadn’t been to the dentist in a while. They made the whole experience incredible, they even printed the crown in the office right next to me. I recommend this place to all of my regulars. I’d give this place 10 stars if I could. Highly highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael
user_reviews_extended.Description: Don't often submit reviews, but this service was incredible! Non-patient with a crown that came off. Somehow they were able to work me into the schedule the following day! Staff, Doctor, hygienist, literally everyone were exceptionally nice, professional and provided great care! Will be a patient for life and couldn't recommend a better dentistry! 10 out of 5 stars in my book!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dawn Doleh
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Tiffany Kondroff is such a wonderful, caring and skilled dentist. This is a very well run office. I appreciate the calm and clean environment. The staff here makes you feel relaxed and comfortable. It's nice they take the time to explain everything and answer your questions. They are all so friendly and courteous.
Highly recommended! Thanks y'all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashlyn
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Every aspect of my visit was great! All the staff are extremely friendly and explain everything very well and they gave me great tips to keep my teeth cleaner!

Also I’ve never waited longer than 2 minutes before getting taken back for my appointment, they definitely have their process down here!

I highly recommend seeing Lisa and Debbie they are great :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: iris hickenbottom
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't say enough great things about this place.  The office is incredibly clean and inviting.  The staff is always so nice and makes sure to take care of you during and after your visit.  Going to the dentist is never fun but this is the best place to go. I recommend to all my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dawn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful office. Very knowledgeable and friendly staff and dentists. Clean and inviting. I'm glad our family was forced to find a new dentist due to our previous one no longer accepting our insurance. Feel blessed to have found CP Premier Dentistry! Best part is you're given a treatment plan in writing outlining costs with line items for everything recommend and your cost and what insurance pays. There are no surprises. Y'all can't recommend them highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lucy C.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going here for a few years now and this is by far the best staff and great service. Ive done cleanings, teeth whitening, and Invisalign with them. Not sure if it is women-owned, but definitely women dominant and they are all so awesome!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patrick Odell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Cedar Park Premier dentistry now for four years. Their entire staff is super friendly and professional. the front staff always greets you with a warm smile and a hello. they always put you first. They listen to your wants and needs and help you make the right choice. You will always see the  Dentist one on one during your visit that’s a plus in my book.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent patient care, always on time and polite. Work with me with payments. Best dentist I have ever had. I can’t recommend them highly enough!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Mann
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an ok experience. I went for a consultation for some extensive cosmetic dental work I need to have done. The estimate for the work was what I expected, but I felt rushed through the appointment, especially knowing how much money I might be spending with the office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marilyn Wiggins
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experiences have always been positive. All the staff are always very helpful, professional and friendly. They always provide a detailed service plan for future dental care. It’s easy to make appointments and get service in a timely manner.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Huggins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent as always. Easy to book, very professional, great front office staff. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew G
user_reviews_extended.Description: They're hands down the best.  I love Niesha she's awesome. The whole staff here is amazing, Rachel, Nicole, and Dr S.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Krista Mejias
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first visit at this office was fantastic. Everyone was super nice and accommodating. I’m glad that I found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: L B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very pleasant experience! Dr. Williams seems to be very kind and sincere. His staff is friendly, professional, and very efficient. They were punctual and precise and took the time to elaborate on their diagnosis of my dental needs. They were recommended to me by a friend, and I feel confident in recommending them to my friends and family as well. I’m so happy to finally find a dentist I can trust.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alicia Heredia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Literally my whole experience was IMMACULATE! The lady doing my X-Rays told me everything she was going to do, before she was going to do it. The hygienist cleaned every nook and cranny and my teeth feel brand new! VERY thorough! And loved the Dentist! She was very sweet and gentle with me! The Receptionist was very patient and professional! Overall as a whole, the best dental experience I’ve ever had!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelia Leath
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely, the most positive dental experience I’ve ever had.  Staff were all very professional and compassionate.  Office is modern and clean.  Dentist designs a clear plan with only positive comments.  I’m very thankful and felt a great weight of anxiety lifted off my shoulders when the Doctor said, “I treat people the way I want to be treated “.  What a great idea!  Thank you, I did not leave this office with a big fear and dread cloud hanging over me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TriTon
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Best Dentistry I never ever had experienced with . From the Doctor to Hygienist ( Marilyn )  to front desk ( Finace office ) your staff go  above and beyond . Thanks so much for taking care good of me

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Wilkes
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I absolutely LOVED my experience here! The WHOLE staff was so sweet, polite and professional!! They treated me with all the respect in the world and took great care of me! I throughly enjoyed them! I’ve switched my dentist multiple times! I have found the dentist I’d like to call home!
Dr. Williams is AWESOME AWESOME AWESOME!
I 100% recommended them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailey Morse
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cedar Park Premier Dentistry is by far the best dentist I have been to. They are always extremely nice and there is always a positive atmosphere in the office. From routine cleanings to fillings and crowns, they have been the best! They are also reasonably priced without insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candace Cawood
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I just love Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. Debbie the hygienis is so Wonderful, kind and patient.   She really explains what is going on and the best treatment plan.  They do not do things extra and surprise you at check out with huge bill. All the staff is fabulous, and so happy to see you, they go out of there way to make you comfortable.

Candace

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Freeney
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this dentist office! Debbie is so fun and sweet. I appreciate the fact that she recalled my last dentist visit and told me how much better my teeth looked! Flossing works folks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Constance Solorio
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am always so thankful for Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. They always take care of me and I walk away knowing I received the best service. The hygienist, Debbie, was very meticulous about the cleaning and also extremely informative. I’ve never had anyone explain things to me the way she did and I could tell it was all very important to her which I can’t describe how much that means to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonda Anderson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Marilyn was wonderful and caring. She explained everything she was going to do. The doctor was very nice and kind. He answered all of my questions. The office staff were very friendly and helpful. I will continue to drive long distance for my appointment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: tami daniels
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience ever. My 60 year young teeth are clean, white and feel great . Friendly smiles from everyone in the office. This is the best place to care for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today I only need to have my teeth cleaned. Debbie did a wonderful job. Take care of my dental hygiene. She checked all my teeth make sure they were in good shape walked out the door with a better smile than I came in with.

user_reviews_extended.Name: fernando Gutierrez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Unfortunately, I had an uncomfortable experience during what should have been a routine cleaning. I was in constant pain throughout the procedure. It felt rushed and careless. I don’t usually leave this type of reviews, but wanted to express myself

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melinda Stallings
user_reviews_extended.Description: 100% professional and courteous treatment from intake to treatment plan explanations.  Lisa was thorough and efficient taking X-rays. My hygienist was the best I’ve had in years- my teeth feel and look fabulous. Doctor Amy was thorough and spent time learning about my history and discussing my oral healthcare plan. And Miss Neisha courteously provided options for future care based upon my treatment plan.  It’s a 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟recommendation here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: M D
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend this place. My doctor was amazing and everyone that works there is very kind and professional. Don't go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Fabre
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ms. Debbie the hygienist will make your teeth feel as smooth as glass and as bright and shiny as ever.  She's a real treasure in this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Crystal Califano
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely LOVED my experience with CP Premier Dentistry. I dread the dentist, I would rather do anything else. The staff made me so comfortable, talked me through all the steps they were taking, showed me additional methods for oral hygiene. They were professional but down to earth and friendly. Each member truly took their time and made me feel like a priority. For once, I pre-scheduled my next appointment because of my positive experience! I'll happily be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hanna Son
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone here is super nice and friendly! Ms. Debbie did such a wonderful job comforting and guiding my 3.5 year old in checking out and cleaning all his teeth. Dr. Kondoff was amazing too! I felt like she actually cared about my son and took her time explaining things for us. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Fall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience as usual. On time, not rushed, genuine and smooth operations. I highly recommend Cedar Park Premier Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: ShantWhite
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I first called to schedule to the day and moment I left, my experience was nothing but positive!! I got lost getting there and Lindsey was very patient and positive in helping me find my way! The hygienist, Christina was excellent and very detailed in caring for my teeth on this first visit. She made me feel absolutely comfortable. And Dr. Kondoff was totally cool! She seriously greeted me with the best upbeat attitude and actually listened to my concerns while educating me on the best solution going forward. Lindsey wrapped it all up with explaining the expected plan with all the kindness and compassion she showed from the start!! I must say I’m very impressed and look forward to going back for all my dental needs!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Debbie Rohrer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am now recommending this dentist office to others.  I had to have a broken tooth removed and prepped for an implant, almost including the shot, painless.  She took her time moved precisely which caused so little trauma healing took no time at all.  The temporary bridge I was given looked wonderful, even though I couldn't stand it in my mouth, so the companies they contract with take pride in their work.  The support staff are funny, kind and seem to do their best to put patients at ease.  For the first time in years, I'm not dreading going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J Jayaprakash
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to this location for my routine dental care for about a year now. I am happy with the treatments and service provided during my visits. Recently put a crown on of my tooth about a month ago and so far it is good and very comfortable. Overall happy with the treatment and service provided here for far.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sudhakar Reddy Bumireddy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was my first appointment at this clinic and had great service at the reception, nurses and doctor. Staff have very well explained what it covers from insurance and how much we have to pay from the pocket. Doctor check up and deep cleaning services are great.
Treatment room doors were kept open throughout the service and staff and other patients walking in the hallway are watching the patient. When I was walking in the hallway, I have seen doors are open for other patients too. I felt discomfort and it doesn’t meet patient privacy. I would recommend to close the treatment room doors for patient privacy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shirley Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had the best experience of dentist visit so far in my 32 years live in the US. I was relaxing during the whole times. Everybody who works here is friendly and professionally. Everything is super clean too. My husband made his deep cleaning appointment for next week also. I am so happy to find this place and we are going to come here for life because it is close to our home.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Small Batz
user_reviews_extended.Description: All of the staff are so nice and helpful. I asked a lot of questions during my appointment and everyone was more than happy to answer them. The front desk staff went above and beyond to help me figure everything out before my appointment. 10/10 I love the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Huggins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent experience all around. They were very accommodating to my schedule. Staff was courteous and pleasant to interact with. My hygienist, Nazia, was great.  Dr Williams precisely explained a comprehensive treatment plan and had a great demeanor. I would highly recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maggie Prather
user_reviews_extended.Description: So my crown replacement was difficult. Although the team was not up in your grill friendly, like talking you through the procedure or introducing themselves, they were super professional and got the job done. Lauren the doctor assistant stood out as a real on task champion with great knowledge and capabilities. They are my go to dentist from now on.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelley M.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I needed an appointment and they accommodated me very quickly! Friendly and so helpful! The hygienist was so thorough and so kind! The dentist was amazing! I am so happy and will be a patient for many years to come!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kat Gold
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to CPPD for a couple of years. I am very thankful to have found such a great dental office. The staff members are so friendly, professional and always make the experience stress free and very comfortable. Dr. Williams is a great dentist who really cares about his patients. He’s very personable, has a great sense of humor and is very good at what he does. I highly recommend making an appointment with the team, they will take excellent care of you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Thola
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had not been to the dentist in (too many) years and had some pretty major anxiety about my first appointment. The staff at Cedar Park Premiere Dentistry were informative and kind from reception all the way through check out! My hygenist was patient with me and talked me through each step of the cleaning process in order to make me feel calm. And Dr. Williams was so sweet and knowledgeable as well! I’m glad to have found this place, and will definitely return.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matt Elkjer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Other than the fact that I have multiple issues that need to be addressed, I had a fantastic experience.
- I was able to get an appt in less than 24 hours from when I called.
- They were prepared for my visit when I arrived with follow up based on the information I provided over the phone.
- Everyone was courteous and understanding of my situation.
- They took the time to clearly explain their diagnosis and recommendations, and provided a detailed treatment plan based on what was most important to me.
I am very thankful for the treatment I received and attention placed on making my visit as pleasant as possible. I am genuinely grateful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Cottrell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been a big fan of going to the dentist.  I would avoid it as long as I could. My wife encouraged me to go check out Cedar Park Premier Dentistry and I am so thankful I did.  They create the most comfortable and professional experience. The team is hyper focused on the success of my dental health while making me feel comfortable and safe.  If you, like me, are afraid of the dentist, I encourage you to check them out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kondoff is the most unprofessional dentist I have ever witnessed or dealt with. Absolutely horrible behavior and no one should be talked to or treated in the ways I observed her talk to people. Do not come here if you value informed consent and patient care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
EVERYONE was so pleasant and the rooms have TVs :-)
My appointment was for analysis of pain possibly due to TMJ.   Dr. Williams was so kind and listened to me.   I felt the exam was very thorough and he explained what I would feel with TMJ.    I still have some work to do, but I left my appointment thinking "WOW I really love this Dentist office and the staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Simbran Momin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cedar Park Premier Dentistry was great! I felt very welcomed and it was a great environment. Everyone was very friendly. My dental hygienist, Nazia, made me feel a lot better about my appointment. She really took her time cleaning my teeth. I felt leaving very confident with my smile! I would highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update 2: I am still a satisfied patient, I’m so glad I got Debbie again. She’s so skilled and I’m grateful my dental health is in her hands!

Update: I still LOVE this dental practice! My dental hygienist Debbie was the most thorough and educational of all my dental cleanings. And as always, Dr. Kondoff was helpful and gracious. I really enjoy my dental appointments.

First Post:  As a new patient, I had a wonderful experience at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. The website is detailed and user-friendly, the office is beautiful, my dental assistant Morgan was so pleasant, and Dr. Kondoff was just wonderful - thorough, helpful, and happy.  I can’t wait for my next appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauree Kiely
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend Cedar Park Premier Dentistry!  My experience here has been excellent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cathy Oshel
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry were all super nice. I really like that they have the latest in equipment. They were wonderful and Dr. K is super friendly and great! I will definitely keep them as my dentist and be back in 6 months.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffany Collier
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Williams and his staff are top notch! My fears of going to the dentist have finally disappeared....
Dr. Williams is hilarious, knowledgeable and has the best bedside manner! His entire staff was knowledgeable, clean and super quick. They also exceeded my expectations on their COVID preparedness, making me feel very safe. Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Bischoff
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this office! They are so sweet and funny. Rachel in the front had me laughing from the time I walked in made me feel like I was visiting family. And then the dental hygienist Paige was wonderful! Usually when I got to the doctors office I have to be super serious the whole time, but here they accepted me for my goofiness, while being goofy themselves! As well as making sure I was well informed of what was going on, what they were doing, why they were doing it! Dr. Williams was great, came in checked a couple things out. To the woman who checked me out. I haven’t had a dentist in a LONG while but I definitely found a new home for my teeth and gums! Thank you SO much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wendy Orantes
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been to many dentist offices and I’ve always either not liked the dentist or the hygienist, or the office staff were cold and uncaring. But Cedar Park Premier Dentistry has literally exceeded all expectations of “going to the dentist”. It’s not the most thrilling time for us needing to go, but honestly they make it so comfortable and everyone there is extremely friendly and caring. I’ve been taking my daughter since she was 7 months old is almost 4 now. She loves Dr. Kondoff and Alyssa who cleans her teeth. Everyone there is so sweet with her and she absolutely loves going (and getting all the attention!) I can’t recommend the staff and office here enough. They feel like family and I’m treated as such.

user_reviews_extended.Name: R Brightwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is so well-managed. They’re wonderful about sending you all of the information ahead of time that you can fill out all paperwork and insurance information ahead of time. My favorite part of it all is Dr. Tiffany Kondoff, I have followed her for about five or six years at different offices. This is her private practice and I am excited that she is at such a beautiful location with easy access. She is a very gentle and thorough dentist, which is wonderful because I am a very terrified patient that has been through the ringer with heavy handed dentist. I am actually excited to go to the dentist when she’s there!

user_reviews_extended.Name: R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Kondoff, Dr. Williams, Debbie, Lisa, Neisha, and all the other office staff at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. Service, care, and genuine smiles laughter are a regular part of the experience. My extended family. I feel very fortunate to have found them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Whittington
user_reviews_extended.Description: I truly felt so cared for at this office. I just moved to the area and was in search of a good dentist to do a filling on me. The office was so clean and actually smelled really good as weird as that sounds. They have diffusers everywhere! They were so nice and accommodating. Dr. Kondoff was very kind and made me feel comfortable. Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darla Atkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was warm and Professional. Love the Doc. & The Nurse. Lobby was warm and inviting. If your looking for implants give them a call, First. My husband uses them now. They are warm and inviting. They make you feel comfortable. DPA

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stefanie Raya
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was very thorough kind and courteous. Paige did a great job on my cleaning and took extra time to explain everything she was doing. The doctor had great input and recommendation for treatment. Very happy overall

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Curtis
user_reviews_extended.Description: I need a tooth removed but we had to evacuate due to Hurricane Laura. I called on Monday, they scheduled me for Tuesday and had the tooth removed in 10 mins with literally no pain. The whole staff was accommodating and so nice. All of this for a new patient that probably will not become a regular due to location. I highly recommend these guys.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rafa Oquendo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Because of my insurance, I had to change to a new Dentist recently.   I decided to try Dr. Dale Williams and I do not regret it.  His staff is friendly and they all made me feel welcome.  Dr. Dale is very professional, he performed 3 procedures in the last two months and it all workout great.  I am very please with him and his team. I highly recommend Dr. Williams.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Rhine
user_reviews_extended.Description: I chipped my front tooth pretty bad, and was very self-conscious about speaking at work. I called the office and they were so kind to get me in so quickly! The office staff was lovely and Dr. Kondoff was amazing. My tooth looked better than before! Highly recommend Cedar Park Premier Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: William Heelan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have to say it was the best dental experience of my life. From the minute you walk in to the minute you leave everybody makes you feel so welcome. Taylor clean my teeth and it was the best cleaning I have had. I will never go to another dentist again. Thank you very much Cedar Park Dentistry. I will see you next month.  You truly take the worry out of going to the dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassidee Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a dental office that makes you excited for your dental appointments! Never have I had any pain, through cleanings, cavity fillings and 6 new gorgeous veneers! My veneers look so natural. I used to never smile with my teeth, and now get complimented with how happy I look. Dr. Williams is so skilled at what he does and I’m so thankful to have found him! The office makes you feel like family, and so welcomed! This will be the best dental service you will ever receive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ginny R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have a positive experience at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry! The staff are friendly and welcoming, the quality of care is excellent, and the variety of services are broad. It is honestly a pleasure to go there. How many people can say that about their dentist?

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rodney Labrie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional, organized office with friendly staff.   They communicated effectively before each step of the appointment and they had excellent handoffs when moving from X-rays to cleaning to dentist exam to checkout.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cedar Park Premier Dentistry is truly awesome! All of the staff was wonderful, helpful and put me at ease during my cleaning. They were always checking in on me to make sure I was comfortable. You can tell they really care about what they do! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: R L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Since being here in Texas, this is my favorite dental office. Finding a good dentist is not an easy task and they have raised the bar!! They take good care of my teeth and are very thorough with our exams and cleanings. The entire staff is friendly! The office is always clean and not crowded. My 7 year old daughter and I  Iook forward to our dental visits which is a definite plus!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: RoxAnne Parker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very good to see the team again. Dr. Jenson very nice as well as the team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cassandra Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have to give huge praise to Dr. Williams!  He is an amazing dentist!  I have never had a cavity, so I am one of those people that LOVES the dentist.  I have huge pearly whites and was shocked when I bit into hard candy Sunday to have my FRONT tooth split in half horizontally.  I am still not sure why this happened, but I called CP Premier first thing Monday morning at 730 and they answered right away.  The offered to get me in at 840 AM and I could not get their in time because of work meetings, so they immediately offered 1:30 PM.  I arrived at 1:35 PM (sorry) and they called me back by 1:45.  The Dental Assistant (also amazing) took pictures and did the exam.  Dr Williams came in and said no problem at all!  He did amazing work and without even needing numbing he created a beautiful tooth and I was out of their by 2:25!  HOW!  He is amazing.  My teeth look amazing.  You cannot tell at all that there was ever any issue and I was back home by 2:40!  The service of his office and the magic and skill of Dr. Williams cannot be praised high enough!  THANK YOU DR WILLIAMS & CEDAR PARK PREMIER DENTISTRY!  I highly recommend this office and Dr. Williams!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eddie Mendiola
user_reviews_extended.Description: The cleaning and teeth whitening was amazing! The staff walked me through the process and did an excellent job. The results were unbelievable, so much that I am sending my wife to get the same services! Thank you to Cedar Park Premier and their staff! You guys knocked it out of the park!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karrie De Mascio
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am so pleased with Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. The staff is always polite, very helpful and cheerful. I went in for a crown which I was totally dreading and within 2 hours I had a custom designed porcelain crown- permanent with a perfect fit, no return visit, no waiting for the permanent crown, no pain. I’m exceptionally pleased and have referred as many new patients as I can as they are very wowed by this process and the ease of it all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly RN
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been seeing Dr. Williams for at least 10 years now, and he is the best dentist who has ever cared for me. He is very good at what he does; he offers the best sound advice for my teeth; and he certainly doesn’t try to update or pitch anything at me. He tells me like it is, and what I need to have done, and that’s it. That’s just one of the many things I like about him! Sometimes when I go in for a cleaning, and if it hurts too much, he will numb the area so I don’t have to feel it. He has an amazing bedside manner and makes sure I’m always comfortable. At my age, while needing some work done on my teeth and gums, he truly cares about my body image and my comfort level. I will never go to anyone else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nora Roberts
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very  attentive and knowledgeable with dental care. They care about their patients gums and teeth.  Very  Awesome place to go to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Wanda K
user_reviews_extended.Description: I fell and chipped my tooth on Friday afternoon. Cedar Park Premier Dentistry was able to give me an appointment for Monday morning. Dr. Williams was able to fix my chipped tooth quickly. He was very gentle with my stitched and sore lip. His dental experience made my tooth look better than it had before! I would highly recommend this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joseph
user_reviews_extended.Description: from making the appointment all the way through checkout, everyone was pleasant, accommodating and thoroughly professional. I was fully informed of the process and feel fully confident in the staff and Dr. In helping me get back on the right path to a healthy smile. 😁

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Vrazel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kondoff and her staff are absolutely wonderful! They are prompt, and work with you. Definitely recommend them for anyone looking for a great dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Eboni Tate
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love my dental office!  The staff is always friendly and welcoming. My hygienist Mary and my dentist Dr Kondoff are fantastic.. They make going to the dentist easy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Traci Spencer
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a fantastic experience!   Dental offices have always sent my anxiety through the roof!  Though at Cedar Park Premier Dental my entire experience was wonderful and relaxing.  From the reception gals, hygienist and the wonderful Dr. Williams ... we have found our family’s Dental home.   Big thanks to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Keith LeBlanc
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly staff, very organized. Made my first appointment go very smoothly. I was really impressed with everyone and how well they treated me and how knowledgeable they were.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lindsay Ridenour
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would like to take a moment to share my experience with you. I want to first of all THANK Dr Williams and his entire team for such a wonderful experience. I was extremely anxious and nervous to trust anyone with such an important and vulnerable part of myself. My smile. The first thing everyone notices about you. However, from the moment I stepped in to the office, the team was sensitive to my anxiety and did everything they could to make my experience a great one! And after speaking with Dr Williams I knew I was placing my trust in the right hands. He and his team were so thoughtful and gentle with the procedure. And my smile has never looked better. I can honestly say, I have never had a better dentist, and I've seen MANY in my lifetime! (As a military family that has moved around the world over the past two decades!) Thank you Dr Williams for changing my life! I literally think about you guys every single day when I see my gorgeous smile! And I'm thankful for all of you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khan Rental Properties LLC
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service, smiling faces, on schedule, answered all my questions, no pressure into treatment or purchasing things, they educated me on request. Hygienist was very pleasant. Skilled, efficient, communicative and happy to see me! Assistant was a pleasure as well. Got everything done with a smile and was quick! Everything from beginning to end of my appointment was a breeze. This was a no judgement zone! Thank you Cedar Park Premier Dentristry

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelo Santillo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience. A welcoming & kind crew. Gave me the help & details I needed and had me on my way efficiently. Definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jolene Eagle-Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my first visit today and was very pleased with the facilities, staff, and doctor. I was in dire need of a cleaning and this was by far the most pleasant and painless cleaning I’ve ever had. The hygienist was thorough and made me feel very at ease as she was doing her cleaning job. Not once did she jab/stab my gums or pull my mouth in ways which it does not wish to stretch. The Dentist, Dr. Williams, was also kind and made me feel at ease with the future course of action needed.  He explained everything in detail leaving me with no questions or concerns on what is next. I’d very much highly recommend this facility to anyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: CHRIS
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I finally came to get my teeth cleaned after 2 years and waiting for 3 months for this appointment. I come in, Expecting my teeth to be cleaned,and, they do an Invisalign estimate FIRST , and tell me I have to come back in 2 days for my Actual Teeth Cleaning. Not happy. If this would have been explained to me from the beginning I would have specifically told them to clean my teeth first, first. I am looking for an honest, referral, dentist. Hopefully, I will not have any other issues when I come in to get my teeth cleaned 2 days from now.
Looking for another dentist . Everyone seems phony, plastic to me . Go figure......

user_reviews_extended.Name: Preyas Bhanderi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. William was able to fix locked jaw within minutes. Dr. and his staff is so kind and very understanding. I recommend Dr. William very highly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophonia Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was amazing! Very professional yet welcoming. They really made me feel comfortable. Also, I love Dr William’s bedside manner. He’s very knowledgeable, caring and kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Luis Rueda
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome job. We have struggled for years looking for a reliable and professional dentist, and we finally found one. Very communicative and friendly staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Dawson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Amazing service and super fast! Everyone there was amazing, the front office staff was so knowledge full and helpful with paperwork. I went to another dentist before them and told me I had 4 cavities,  I came here (and as I thought) no cavities and was even told I have great teeth (still need a cleaning but it was def needed)

10/10 will come back, they got my vote!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Theodore Alfano
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This crew has amazing chemistry.
If you enjoy getting drilled, or carved by the finest, I would totally recommend Cedar Park Dentistry.
My smile has improved ten folds thanks to them. 🙌

user_reviews_extended.Name: Charlene Jeanette Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dentist took the time to sit down and show me everything that needed to be done which is greatly appreciated. They are always so patient, understanding, and kind!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dr. Chris Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff are real professionals and they are committed to my family’s dental health. They make you feel welcome from the first moment you enter the office and provide outstanding service every step of the way. Dr. Williams is a true craftsman with excellent manner and a practiced touch. I couldn’t feel the needle.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Harding
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a cleaning with Paige today, and she did an awesome job! She was super sweet and very thorough. She also made sure to explain everything she was doing as she went, and was very informative. Definitely one of the most easy going dental visits I've ever had!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve never left the dentist and thought, “I look forward to coming back here in 6 months”, until today. I called this morning and was given an appointment right away. Every person I spoke with or interacted with was very kind and patient. I normally leave the dentist feeling a little stressed, but that was absolutely not the case today. I’m so glad to have found them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Kruse
user_reviews_extended.Description: Premier is awesome!  Handles insurance with ease, great dental team, and top notch care! So happy we are found this team! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I adore this place. The service is top notch.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Arnold
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place! Everyone is so kind and treat you like family. Dr. Williams is seriously the most down to earth and sweet people I’ve ever met. Their pricing is very good and honestly I would expect it to be higher. Everyone really cares about you and how you feel here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Peterson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this place. I always feel very comfortable and relaxed when I go there. Everyone is so nice and works diligently. It also feels great when I leave with the cleanest smile in cedar park!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Szoboszlay
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time here, found from google. Everyone I interacted with was extremely helpful and polite. Hygienist was very detailed in her explanations, and Dr. Williams was very understanding and helpful. Highly recommend for first time patients, especially those with dental anxiety, they did a great job of making me feel comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Muneerah B
user_reviews_extended.Description: Polite, and compassionate staff right from the front desk to Dr. Kondoff! Dr. Kondoff is the absolute best- explains everything in detail and always patiently answers all my (numerous) questions. She is like a motherly figure offering comfort all the way through the treatment. The entire staff is very respectful and professional! Love 💕 Cedar Park Premier Dentistry, would give them 10 stars if I could! Highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anu Joseph
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very unpleasant experience here yesterday. Only half of the work that was scheduled could be done. The doctor explained she had to pick up her kids which I can understand since it was 3.30 pm. But there was this other nursing staff who kept adding sarcastic remarks like “oh, we can just stay here and do your dental work and the doctor can be late to pick up her kids”. I would expect people in health care industry (or any other) to be a little more professional. Very disappointed since last time I met Dr Dale Williams who’s very professional, skilled and kind. Sad to see this change.

user_reviews_extended.Name: McKelly Thomas
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry are absolutely amazing! They’re always so Friendly, Personable, Professional , and make you feel like family. I would not go anywhere else for dental treatment. I Highly Recommend Cedar Park Premier Dentistry to everyone on the Austin, TX and surrounding areas. They really are the BEST!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haleigh Helen Hoebener
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Kondoff and the entire team have always treated me right for well over a year now. I came in with my teeth literally falling apart and they got me back on track quickly and attentively. I am so appreciative of them—can’t ask for a better dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Whitney Brown
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dental experience by far! The office is clean and they use the most up to date equipment. The staff was wonderful, so friendly and positive. Never felt more comfortable during a cleaning before, definitely recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jules Levy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nice place, great staff, and great care. I actually look forward to going. This is the first practice in all my years that I feel comfortable going to that is caring and works to help me make the most of my insurance to fit my true needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: B Fisher
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am highly satisfied with Cedar Park Premier Dentistry.  The staff is highly professional, friendly, and top notch.  Dale came highly recommended by a family member who had been using him for years in Waco.
I am new to the area, and when I had a sudden gum inflammation problem, I didn't hesitate to call and make an appointment.  As soon as I walked in the door, I knew I made the right call.  From the receptionist to the hygienist to the dental assistant, all were great at letting me know exactly what my particular issues were and giving me treatment options.
I will happily continue to use Cedar Park for my dental needs.  Thanks for your service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vanessa Kipp
user_reviews_extended.Description: I started going to Cedar Park Premier Dentistry when I needed a crown adjustment and the dentist who placed the crown couldn't find time to adjust it. I have going there ever since.  My experience has been great. The services are clearly explained, everyone who works there is friendly, and they get you in right away of you need dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Geiger
user_reviews_extended.Description: I felt very comfortable from the moment I walked in the door. Staff was great and helpful. The dentist put me at ease during the exam and was very informative about what needed to be done. I have a follow up appointment to discuss all my options. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lara Labbe-Maginel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Highly recommend especially if you have anxiety about coming to the dentist. Cedar Park premier dentistry puts my mind at ease and helps to make me feel comfortable each and every time I come in.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raymond Medina
user_reviews_extended.Description: Walking in was a lil uneasy, but as soon as the door opened everything felt right. Everyone from the receptionist to the Dr. was very welcoming and made you feel like there was no worry in the world and that they had your back and were there to give you the best possible solution to your needs. Thank you for making this an easy decision to come here!! Keep up the great work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Will Carey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am extremely fortunate to have found Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. The entire staff has been excellent in all areas, very personable and professional... they truly care about their patients. My entire family now goes to Cedar Park Premier Density and couldn't be happier!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cathy Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been using Dr Kondoff as our Dentist since    Returning to the US in 2016 , even going so far as following her to Cedar Park Premier Dentistry.  Everyone on the staff is outstanding but we would particularly commend Dr. Kondoff, Dr. Williams, Neisha & Rachel!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer McClure
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry is always a pleasant one. Even on visits where I've had to have extensive work done, the entire staff made me feel comfortable and relaxed. Both doctors, as well as the hygenist do an exceptional job! After three years of looking for a dentist since moving here, finally found a one that doesn't sugar coat what needs to be done and let's me decide my own dental decisions.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda McKinsey
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went to this office my first time. I have to say they are the friendliest dental office I have ever gone to. Very professional and personable.

I was very much at ease and they did an amazing job. The hygienist that worked with me was amazing.

Needless to say I will be going back there.

March 28 Update

For more than 20 years I have hidden my smile because one tooth sat back from the other and in pictures appeared to be black because it would have a shadow.  Dr Hagan said she could fix my smile. In less than one hour she and her team worked their magic on my tooth and after more than 20 years I can smile.  My daughter is getting married in a few weeks and for the first time in a long time I will have a big smile on my face.  I was so excited when I left the office I actually cried. Thank- you, you have no idea what this means to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Labrie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Loved the hygienist she was very thorough and kind. The dentist was great. She made me feel at home and treated me like a friend not just a patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ivana Everts
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Cedar Park Premier Dentistry for 5+ years. The staff and support are second to none. They are friendly and always professional. The level of service my family and I receive consistently exceeds expectations.

user_reviews_extended.Name: James Gioia
user_reviews_extended.Description: I like to work with Dr. Dale Williams.  I have nothing against the other dentists, but I feel I can relate better with him.  We are closer in age and that makes a big difference to me.  The practice is not cheap.  That said, Dr. Williams made a new crown (replacement actually) for me yesterday and it’s perfect.  I will leave you with one last thought here.  It’s hard to recognize BAD dental work until you’ve had GOOD dental work.  Dr. Williams showed me what GOOD dental work looks like.  I hope he doesn’t retire.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Corey Monroe
user_reviews_extended.Description: The ladies here never disappoint and always give the best service there is around. I’m always happy to see them and I wouldn’t dream of going to any other dentist office. No matter where I move to I’ll always go out of my way to go to their office. They genuinely care about their patients and always make sure you are comfortable. Thank you guys for all you do!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jo Tooley
user_reviews_extended.Description: They got me in immediately after I called.  Everyone was very friendly and attentive.  It’s always a great experience dealing with this office.  The Doctors and staff are wonderful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashlee Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Hagan and her staff at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry facilitated a fantastic experience for a teeth cleaning. They provided affordable service as I did not have dental insurance. Everyone was very nice and educated and Dr Hagan did a great job at making me feel comfortable. Thank you for the great experience and for the invitation for my little one and I to visit your Easter gathering for the kiddos... looking forward to it!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Pollard
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic practice. Dr. Williams and his staff are up to date on the best practices and products on the market for our specific needs. We have been at this office for over 6 years and are very pleased with the service provided. For any new families moving to Cedar Park, look no further than Cedar Park Premier Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cisc0 Ssb
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was very friendly and helpful regarding any questions or concerns I had through out my visit. Have a couple appointments coming up and I'm looking forward to seeing everyone again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: The PDR Shop Charlie Molina
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff at Cedar Park Premier dentistry is fantastic and professiona!  After recently moving to this area, we spent a lot of time looking for a new dentist and could not be happier with Cedar Park Premier Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ola Thompson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Hands down best chair side manner in town!!
I was greeted with a smile, no wait time. Very clean environment. Front desk staff was friendly and efficient. Referred by a friend, my entire family is here now.
I recommend this place.. They brighten your smile!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Light
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place!  Ladies are friendly; they acknowledge you promptly. They make eye contact. They didn't judge me. I love it. Them and Dr. Williams are awesome people. I can't wait to have a new face!!!  Love you guys!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: kris arrieta
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had such a positive experience at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry!  The office is clean and beautiful, Dr. Williams is amazing, equipment is cutting edge and all the staff is really great.

I had a crown that needed to be replaced and I have been putting it off for about 10 years. It was in the back and not causing trouble also I was really dreading the two visit process of replacing it. Plus working in the industry, I’ve seen lots of bad dentistry and I hadn’t found a dentist that I really liked since moving to TX.

That all changed about a year when we had a small emergency  on a Friday . I knew I didn’t want to go back to our dentist in lakeway & they were the only ones willing to fit us in as a new patient.  They had glowing reviews so what the heck. CPPD did a great job patching my son up immediately. Since then we’ve been going there for cleaning & of course that crown came up.

I’m so glad I waited.. Dr. Williams had me in & out of his office with a new crown in two hours!  He has all the newest equipment to make porcelain crowns right there in office. He took the old crown off with minimal discomfort, took a digital mold,  made a porcelain crown, fitted it, fired it and cemented it in all in a two hour appointment. The crown looks & feels great.. I couldn’t be happier!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mekhi Steen
user_reviews_extended.Description: This office is so amazing!! The actual office is beautiful, they have wall size windows in the rooms so you almost feel like your outside not in a dentist room. I had Lindsay as the dental assistant and she was so warm and comforting!! She let me know everything she was doing before she did it. The Dr. exceeded my expectations he was nice funny and most of all honest about my treatment. I felt like I had been a patient for a long time!! And it was only my first initial visit as a new patient which I must mention was FREE! The consult included a full panaramic X-ray! The day before I went to Round Rock family dental and they were horrible!!!! The worst experience and charged me $85.00 for ONE X-RAY! And a whole lot of rudeness from not only the office manager Terri but the Dr. as well! A day and night difference in care. I feel so happy and grateful to have come into this office I left with all my questions answered and my anxiety is gone about my dental needs!!! Thank you Cedar Park Premier Dentistry for everything you did for me today it was above and beyond awesome care! I can't wait to get my teeth fixed and done!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abraham Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Excellent and professional care!  Enjoyed it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Levy
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is my favorite dentist practice I have ever been to. The staff has always been very friendly and their work is top-notch. I would highly recommend Cedar Park Premier Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lea Szczerba
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the best dentist office's I have taken my kids. They always do their best to make sure everyone is comfortable and well cared for. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Delware

He does not do
TMJ problems but
help by giving me
another Dentist that
may help. Very
good first visit and will continue with them.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Incredible staff and doctors.
