I felt very comfortable the moment I walked through the door until I left. Highly recommended!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roy Ayers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I served as a military preventive dentistry specialist and worked with many different dentists in all specialties. Dr Williams and Dr Kondoff are superb dentists. Their staff are awesome! This practice is extremely professional and competent. I can get free dental care at the VA but choose Cedar Park Premier Dentistry because I know I'm getting the best care from caring and competent people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jillian Stach
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is super cute and clean. Everyone was nice and accommodating. Nazia did an amazing job cleaning my teeth and making sure I was comfortable.  Dr Williams is a delight. Overall great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dora Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were very accomidating for an emergency visit. The staff was super friendly. Dr Williams was very kind, nonjudgemental, informative and helpful. The only downside was being referred to another office that was not in-network on my insurance. I wasn't aware until i was given my statement estimate and was not prepared for the cost. Very appreciative for the prompt and friendly treatment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Li
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just had recommended it to my husband, urged him to change to this office immediately. During Covid19, they still maintain the same excellent level of service. While compared to my husband's other dentistry, he only got half of the cleaning service, he told me. But my regular cleaning was just like before the Covid-19. Same clean, professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica McCraw
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in with jaw pain not knowing what to expect. Had read online that it could be TMJ but self diagnosing offline is not usually accurate. Everyone was really friendly and nice. Met with Dr. Williams and he was extremely knowledgeable and nice. Made me feel comfortable. Looking forward to the pain relief from our treatment option.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Korie Stewart
user_reviews_extended.Description: So happy I went to this place for my treatment. They went above and beyond to make sure I could get all my treatment done after helping me find the right dental insurance. All the ladies in this office are super nice and genuinely care. Also a big plus is that they talk and joke and laugh with you since they know the dentist is not the most fun place to be, they make it fun. I won't be going anywhere else for any of my dental needs, only here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ari Granger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was super friendly, Dr. Williams was so sweet and made me less embarrassed I hadn’t been in, in a while. Very affordable for the great service you get. 10/10 would recommend to anyone needing a cleaning, procedures done, etc.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul takemoto
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Have only gone for a consult at this point!
Booking the appointment thru online service was very easy and was quickly confirmed thru e-mail.
My wait time was nonexistent upon arrival . I was given X-rays and scans and was looked at by Dr Williams shortly after . The staff was friendly and scheduled me for a second visit to discuss my options moving forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin P.
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Hagen and Caroline were such a breath of fresh air compared to the typical dentist office experience. I had 4 fillings done today, and it was painless.

They are genuinely caring people and have you in and out comfortably and quickly. I would recommend Dr. Hagen and her staff  to anyone looking to avoid the traditional dental expreience.

These folks rock!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Ann Elekes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Both Dr. Kondoff and Morgan were incredibly caring, professional, personable and did everything they could to make my visit as pleasant as possible. Dr. Kondoff took the time and understood how my complex medical conditions play into my dental issues and concerns with treatment. I felt very at ease and in capable, compassionate hands.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Constance Solorio
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this dental office. From the receptionists at the front, the assistant that gets the appt started, the awesome dental hygienist, and the oh-so-kind and warm dentist—everyone makes the experience so comfortable. I have never been so pleased with my dentist office and will never go anywhere else!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connor Black
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been going here for a year and a half and I’ve still had a better experience here than anywhere else I’ve ever gone. I’m generally kinda freaked out by dentists and going to appointments but they’ve done a great job making a very welcoming and friendly atmosphere. All of the staff is very easygoing and professional. Would recommend this dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin M Meadows
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional, thorough, and great visit. It’s been too long since my last dental visit and everyone there was very nice and created a plan to get my issues resolved. Very satisfied with my initial encounter with Cedar Park Premier Dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Clint Wood
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Williams was extremely professional. In my situation, I was between doctors on my restoration. He evaluated me and knew my situation required a higher level surgeon to repair implants from the previous dentist. He could have easily took my money and tried to make it work. But his honesty prevailed and I know he is a doctor that really cares about the treatment of his patients.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis Hartwell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was one of the best dental experiences ive had, and ive had a lot! Everyone in the office is so nice, and thry even went out of their way to help me when i needed it! Dr. Williams did an amazing job, replacing two lost veneers, was very concerned and took great care of me! Ill be a lifer with them for sure!!!

Thanks to the entire staff and Dr. Williams for the great care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jerry Schroeder
user_reviews_extended.Description: As luck would have it, I awoke with tooth pain right after moving to Austin...without a dentist. Luckily, I discovered Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. Dr. Williams and his staff are incredibly kind, courteous and professional and were able to get me in for an appointment immediately. Looking forward to seeing them for years to come. Thanks again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tabitha Ambrose
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently was referred to Dr. Williams by my mom and I absolutely love him and his staff. They made me very comfortable and eased my anxiety about dental work. I definitely won’t go anywhere else from now on!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sophonia Martin
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s always a pleasure to visit Cedar Park Premier Dentistry! Great staff and excellent service. They go above and beyond to help meet the needs of their patients!

user_reviews_extended.Name: MHEAS MHEAS
user_reviews_extended.Description: I do not know where to start, but it seems that communication between the dentists and staff at this location is lacking. They seem unresponsive and only reach out after many follow-up calls. On two occasions, the front desk committed to scheduling an appointment for me, but they failed to follow through. Despite receiving fillings and bite adjustments, my teeth still hurt. I am relieved that I will not be returning to this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: William May
user_reviews_extended.Description: Review, short version:  Simply the best dental practice around.  Dr. Williams has been practicing for many years, yet he keeps up with the very latest technologies.  His staff are efficient and charming; his office is beautiful and spotless; and the atmosphere in his practice is quiet, calming, and restful.  It is easy to get an appointment here. If you need a dentist, this is the place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connie Robertson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience with Dr. Williams and staff. A crown on my front tooth came off and I needed a dentist to replace it quickly, so that I could go on to work. Fortunately, I called this office and they got me right in. Everyone was professional  and friendly, and I had very little wait time. My smile looks great again and I plan to go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ranee Reyes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Williams and his crew are awesome. I got my 2 crowns done today. Two hours passed by like a breeze because of his warm and yet professional atmosphere. Thank you Dr Williams and his crew😘

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Stanley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m not fond of going to the dentist, but I have to say this was the best experience I have ever had! The staff were very accommodating, the equipment state-of-art, and Dr.Williamson was knowledgeable and down-to-earth. I would definitely recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sara Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very pleased with the service I received. The office staff was very nice. Dr. Williams was very friendly, knowledgeable and patient. The facility was pretty and the equipment modern. Glad I chose this office!  Thank You!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kimberly Domke
user_reviews_extended.Description: New to this dentist office due to insurance change. Everyone is very knowledgeable and helpful. Would recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Don Loving
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderful staff—-from the second we walked through the door everyone was  so welcoming and friendly. The office is so comfortable and clean, and they are so professional and efficient—— overall a great experience. So happy to have found y’all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can't begin to say enough about Dr. William's and his amazing staff. After years of less than pleasant dental work, including failed root canals and multiple extractions; I was left feeling self-conscious about my smile resulting in me not smiling much anymore. That all changed the day I met Dr. Williams...he took the time to go over various treatment plans and allowed me to pick one I felt was best for me...no pressure was ever felt to choose one over the other. Niesha, the patient care coordinator was great! She drafted up my treatment plan and sat down with me to discuss everything in detail and we even set up payment and treatment dates and times...all on the first visit! Viki assisted w/ each appointment and really helped to ease my fears and comforted me while in the chair. I can't Express how happy I am to finally have my beautiful smile back again! I will never go to another dentist again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Whitney Bofferding
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have biiiig anxiety when it comes to go going to the dentist. It’s never been an enjoyable experience for me. The staff at the front desk, Neisha and Cortney were both so precious, welcoming and accommodating! The dental hygeniest Robin and Dr.Williams were so calm, nurturing and explained everything with detail and patience. I will be back!! Thanks for taking care of this nervous lady without a hitch!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fernando Matas
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service, no wait. always on time, good suggestions on care without preaaure on non necessary treatments,  happy that they are my dentist

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelli Cottrell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Williams and his staff are amazing. I had a dental emergency and they quickly scheduled me an appointment and took care of me that same day. My previous dentist had retired and I was so hesitant to try someone new, it took an emergency but I’m so pleased I found them!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: The Leisings
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was very impressed by the entire staff. Everyone was welcoming and friendly, and each person did their job very well. All procedures were clearly explained. I couldn’t be more pleased.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Shaw
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Williams has been my family dentist for 20 years.   He was formerly in the Waco area.   He started the Cedar Park practice in 2015 around the same time I moved to the Austin area.  You won't find a dentist that loves his work and patients as much as Doc.  Last weekend, on a Saturday,  one of my front veneers popped off and I couldn't find it.   I called him on his emergency number crying.  A missing front tooth isn't attractive.    He scheduled me on the phone to come in Monday morning.   I had a new veneer by lunch time.  Everyone in his office is super sweet and helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeanne Williams
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome dentist, friendly and professional. Dr. Hagan explains everything so it's easy to understand. And I have not experienced a more gracious and exceptional team. Everyone is so welcoming from the time you step foot in the door to the time you leave. If you need a dentist, this is the place to go!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: A C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great front office staff!  2 reasons I recently left the practice. 1.  Called the office a few months ago regarding a tooth ache that had a long history of issues and treatments. It was on a “watch list” for potential problems.  All issues in the past had been resolved with a course of antibiotics.  Front office staff advised Dr. Williams of my issues. He advised me to rinse the tooth with salt water.  So I called again the next day and spoke to Rachael. She was to communicate my continued issues again and was to ask for some antibiotics at my request. There was No follow-up call or response to my request. Forced to see a oral surgeon who identified the infection, ordered antibiotics, extracted the tooth due to failure to resolve the infection and I was prepped for a tooth implant.  Needless expense and pain that could have had an early intervention. 2.  Dr. Williams does not believe in  pain/anxiety management. Very old school. He placed a implant for me last year and never once
asked about pain.  Bad experience. I will not return to this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gaytha Braun
user_reviews_extended.Description: I I’m a new patient at Cedar Park Denistry and have found it to be a very friendly and pleasant office to visit.  They are competent and professional.  Paige, my dental technician, goes above and beyond to make me feel comfortable.  I would definitely recommend it!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sunny Lancaster
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional, organized,   knowledgeable and all around genuine people, but most of all it is the comfort in knowing they have your best interest in mind. Honestly I would not waste my time anywhere else. In my experience in Austin, this is the only place I would recommend my family to go. Thanks Premier!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kaylea dubelbeis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone in the office is so friendly and extremely patient with my anxiety at the dentist! They are understanding and able to calm my nerves. So thankful for this dental office!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Palladino
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the moment I walked in the door, the front desk personnel, the x-ray technician, the teeth cleaning technician and Dr. Williams himself conveyed outstanding customer service, made me feel comfortable and every single one of them thanked me for being there. By far the best dentist office experience I’ve ever had! I’m so thankful I decided on Cedar Park Premier Dental

user_reviews_extended.Name: monica morales
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Love Love!!! All the staff at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry are wonderful, I hate going to the dentist it gives me such anxiety but the staff here always manages to help relieve my stress. Dr. Hagan always takes her time explaining every step throughout the process, which helps me out with my anxiety tremendously.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anthony Patek
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first experience using this Premier Dentistry. What a great experience. Staff was great and the doctor did an awesome job. Had a broken tooth. Was out of the office inside of two hours with a new crown.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place and staff that are friendly and welcoming. Dental hygienist did a great job cleaning my teeth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Babilonia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I typically had been flying back and forth to my dentist in CA to have my annual prophy and any needed dental work completed...well, not anymore!  I had my first appt w/Dr. Williams and his staff today and I feel truly blessed that I found this professional, yet friendly group of professionals who have a practice that put me at ease immediately!

From the moment you walk in you can see how clean, organized and state-of-the art this office is. I highly recommend Dr. Williams who is kind, gentle and knowledgeable and look forward to a lasting relationship w/this practice.

Thank you Dr. Williams, Paige, Neisha and staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon Holland
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Dale Williams has been my dentist for many years.  He is an excellent dentist and a very ethical man who really cares about  his patients. It was like a breath of fresh air to walk into his beautiful new office and be greated by his professional staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea M.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was so lucky to have found Premier! Broke my front tooth in half last night and called the emergency number after 9pm.  Dr. Williams personally answered the phone and instructed me to call the office first thing in the morning. when I called they already knew my situation and had me come right in and by 9 a.m. my tooth was good as new! Dr. Williams has a gentle touch and an artistic hand. He treated me as if I were a long time patient even though he never saw me before. I will definitely trust my dental care to Dr. Williams going forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Slim
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had my first visit yesterday, which was lovely In every way. It started even before the actual visit when the staff was very willing to work with my insurance, as they were not in my network, and arranged it so I would not have to pay anything out of pocket.
The staff, from the receptionist Courtney to Neisha, who took care of my insurance issues so well, all the way to Dr. Helmick were friendly, caring, knowledgeable and passionate about what they do. Parvis, the Hygenist, took time to explain what he was doing and how I could take better care of my teeth and was gentle and efficient with the cleaning. The dental assistant, Vikki, was very friendly and answered all my questions. Dr. Helmick was personable, has a great sense of humor and spent a long time with me educating me about the care of my teeth and was thorough In her examination.

In general, it was the best experience I had had at a dentist. Clean and airy office, caring and knowledgeable staff, focused on being a service versus a sales office that pushes procedures and products on you. I wish I had found them earlier.
I will be happy to go back for my next cleaning. I left with a smile in my face. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Apostle Jackie Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Staff is so friendly and knowledgeable. I had an awesome visit and recommend this Dentistry to everyone I know.  I am excited for the opportunity to meet and be served at this location.  I look forward to having a better smile in the near future.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy McClanahan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a nervous person when it comes to the dentist. Not only did they comfort my fears I couldn’t  get enough of how much detail they put into the office. The essential oils, the blankets, tvs, it’s almost like your not in a dentist office at all. The windows allowed in a lot of natural light. I feel sometimes a dentist will over treat, I did not feel this way. I felt they cared about getting my teeth healthy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jose Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description: Alyssa is always very polite and explains exactly what she finds throughout the dental cleaning. I can definitely relate to her and would not want any other dental hygienist cleaning my teeth. I also appreciate the free whitening.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Quach Hiep V
user_reviews_extended.Description: Good experience with my first time visiting

user_reviews_extended.Name: Reid Mendez
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is the best all around. Best staff, and super fast. Superior work and would recommend this office hands down over any other office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Money
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Cedar Park Premier Dentistry. I’ve been a patient for over 2 years and every experience is as friendly and wonderful as the first.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Scarlett
user_reviews_extended.Description: From the front office to chairside the Doctor and TEAM were amazing! They greeted me at the door walked me through the appointmnet every step of the way and made sure I was very comfortable. I would recommend them to my family and friends for sure!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rachel Neyland
user_reviews_extended.Description: Paige, at premier dental, was AMAZING! The last dental office I went to was very rough, so I haven’t gone to the dentist in 3yrs! Paige was gentle & very kind! I will definitely stay with premier dental & I recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katlyn White
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have terrible anxiety when it comes to the numbing portion of the visit. The needle is the worst part for me and they made sure to make that as simple and painless as possible. The entire staff is amazing!!! I can not say enough great things about them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brandon Akins
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very detailed took their time and addressed all of my concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: D Beyer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always amazing experience, the best Dental Business I’ve ever been to! Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tara Thatcher
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been having some tooth pain and wasn't able to get it taken care of for another month. We called them this morning and we were able to be seen this afternoon. Super friendly and helpful. Not only were we able to save my tooth we were able to get the pain manageable and in the same visit. My new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shincy Abraham
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is wonderful, going the extra mile to make you feel comfortable. They did a very thorough cleaning, truly Premier.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an emergency while I was out of the country and they were able to squeeze me in the morning after I returned. I'm very happy with the treatment I've been given.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zoey Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dentist I have found by a long shot. Trust me, I have looked.

user_reviews_extended.Name: June B
user_reviews_extended.Description: I waited a bit, sometimes the person before you has more damage than the doctor can see. Then there were pictures to take after deciding what to do next according to the file, I joked with the Doc and dental assistant through most of the visit. I had a cap put on and it went very well, quick and perfectly fitting, also got a my 7th invisiline which fit also. I was leaving with a smile. The office staff is always busy but not busy enough to make sure your happy and healthy.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Harr
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was the first visit for our 2 kids, who previously saw a pediatric dentist. We changed for convenience to home as well as insurance.  The staff was very friendly. Great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alma Malocalaj
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a new patient of Dr.Williams and I had a great experience! Everyone was very friendly and made me feel comfortable. They explained each step thoroughly. I will be back! :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: K Balint
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been coming here for several years and can’t say enough great things about this Dental Office. Everyone is amazing. Very understanding, professional and kind.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Jarvis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dale and Vicky (the DDS and Dental Tech) do a great job.

Had to give this place one star for the bozos working in the front office.  You'll get barraged with texts and emails about appointment reminders if you go there.

There's a $50 per hour cancellation fee if you change an appt. within 48 hours.

Amazingly, they changed my appointment times last minute themselves.  When I jokingly, pointed out the hypocrisy, they didn't understand.

I let them know I didn't like harassment on my calendars, texts and emails ... They continued anyways ... like 10 year olds pulling a prank.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Bible
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my teeth cleaned and the personnel were all very friendly and professional. I would recommend them to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Peterson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely loved this place. The got me in when I needed to be seen. My dentist explained to me what was going to happen and all the extras. Her and the entire staff was so nice. I love this place and will continue to be using them

user_reviews_extended.Name: rebecca reeves
user_reviews_extended.Description: Should be called "Cedar Park SUPERSTAR Dentistry" I was very nervous but they made me feel so comfortable. Extremely friendly and "Doc" is incredible! I got a cavity filled and absolutely NO PAIN! I couldn't believe it, highly recommend

user_reviews_extended.Name: Whitted Family
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a customer for the last year with this office. Due to COVID restrictions surrounding our lives, I was not able to make a scheduled appointment. I did in fact call to cancel the appointment almost three hours prior. A staff mmeber named Courtney was quick to tell me she would charge me $50.00 more because I cancelled and they had a doctor there for me only. Basically "price gauging me". Courtney also claimed I signed that agreement in the beginning. I went back and reviewed their aggreement that is not written with clarity. Nothing in the agreement talks about charging their clients $50.00 more for a out sourced doctor if you cancel. I did in fact call to cancel. Courtney's tone with me was very unprofessional. I asked if her supervisor could call me back? She claimed she would let the doctor know because he's the owner of this clinic. Courtney also said to me it wasnt his style to call the customer back about a complaint. Now being the doctor is the business owner how odd is that? I've been a paying customer to this clinic and planned on spending allot of money here to get work needed done. I'm in the middle of a root canal process and still have not seen or heard a phone call back. NOT HAPPY, My next call is the Texas Attorney General for depective trade practice, on price gauging customers and performing medical work incomplete.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beccy Hambright
user_reviews_extended.Description: Finding a new dentist can be overwhelming, but the staff at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry quickly eliminated any doubts I might have had about choosing them for dental care both now and in the future.  Everyone at Cedar Park Premier is professional, friendly, and extremely thorough and knowledgeable. If it is possible to actually ENJOY a visit to the dentist, this is most assuredly the place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Billups
user_reviews_extended.Description: Cedar Park Premier Dentistry and Dr. Williams did not honor their new patient free cleaning. They claimed I didn't qualify after I was already in the chair because they said my gums weren't healthy enough. I just verified with my dentist in Colorado of 14 years, and they agreed many dental offices use this bait and switch kind of practice. (And my gums were fine a year ago.) It's the dentist's choice to say I don't qualify for a regular cleaning, but they should then discount the new patient visit. Now I know why they say you pay for the x-rays and the exam and the cleaning is "free." With this arrangement, they can just force an upsell to a $750 cleaning. Or in my case, they get the same fee, but without having to do the cleaning (which is the reason I went to the dentist in the first place). If they were really concerned for my dental health, they would have ensured I at least had a regular cleaning by honoring the new patient special.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Carter
user_reviews_extended.Description: My partner and I went here for about a year and had a lot of dental work done, including root canals, fillings and an extraction. Almost everything we had done there has had to be corrected by another dentist. We started getting suspicious when we had to have multiple emergency dentist visits (sometimes when we were out of town), even for something as simple as a filling. Additionally, they never sent records to our new dentist despite multiple calls. Wishing we had caught on earlier instead of pouring thousands into bad dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick Hull
user_reviews_extended.Description: My 6 month cleaning went well.  The staff is professional and very helpful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tiffani Wampler
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Kondoff and the staff at Cedar Park Premier Dentistry were all wonderful!  They got me in on an emergency visit and very gracious!  I will definitely be back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Peterson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Ok, so going to the dentist may not be your favorite thing, but you've got to go so you might as well go to the most pleasant office possible. Cedar Park Premier Dentistry is that office. The staff and dentists are delightful, knowledgeable, patient in explaining insurance benefits, and efficient! I wouldn't go anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alyssa Shorey
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was a great experience from the moment I stepped through the door. I was greeted warmly by everyone and loved every one of the ladies I met. I couldn't be happier that I chose to try Cedar Park Premiere Dentistry. Love it!

I called again, but the person who knows the information isn't there on the weekend. I also asked IF I WAS IN NETWORK. I had a week off before I started my new job. Which means PTO for dental work was not in the near future.  I showed up for the appointment and they told me I had to pay the $825 in full that day or they wouldn't do it. So, I said okay. Three months later I get a $515 bill because I am out of network. The lady I spoke with has always been gracious, but I don't like how things were handled. Don't make the assumption that no news is good news. I hope by posting this someone else can avoid being upset. I will not be going back.

user_reviews_extended.Description: From the very first appt. My experience wasn’t “premier” I should’ve known then, to go somewhere else…But I didn’t. The next couple were ok but never great and absolutely not one that validated the “Premier” name! This last time was the worst even the actual Dentist was rude. Nesha while doing her clean up job had to explain what the Dentist should have done. Things have change drastically after their last Dentist suddenly passed:( After my last visit I had to go somewhere else to get another cleaning since the last one was so bad.  But overall the customer service was horrible. My x ray experience was horrible as well the dental assistant shoved the x-ray plate in my mouth in the worst way ever. I was with my last dentist for 15yrs and it was always great, unfortunately he retired and the office personal changed. Hopefully I found a good one with my new dentist.

title: Whitestone Family Dentistry
address: 908 W Whitestone Blvd #400, Cedar Park, TX 78613, United States

user_reviews.Name: Ari
user_reviews.Description: What great experiences my son has, each time I take him to Whitestone Family Dentistry!! An extremely clean establishment, very friendly staff and a comfortable environment!! Michelle, Amy, Taylor and Rachelle are all very kind, caring and compassionate… And, of course, Dr. Andrew has a gentle and loving approach, when taking care of my son’s dental needs… They treat my son as one of their own family members and I just can’t recommend this dental practice enough!!!!

user_reviews.Name: Svetlana Peskova
user_reviews.Description:
This was my first visit to this dental clinic, and I was truly impressed! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the entire staff made me feel very well cared for from the moment I walked in. You can immediately tell they treat each patient with genuine care and attention.
The front desk team was also exceptional. They walked me through my plan in detail, answered all of my questions patiently, and made sure I felt confident about what’s next. I’ve honestly never felt so seen and understood in a medical setting before.

Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for professional, transparent, and compassionate care. I’m so glad I found them!

user_reviews.Name: Dilbar Sulaimanova
user_reviews.Description:
Whitestone Family Dentistry – Exceptional Care in a Friendly Atmosphere

I can't say enough about the wonderful experience my husband and I had at Whitestone Family Dentistry in Cedar Park, where Dr. Andrew Jung leads an outstanding team. From the moment we stepped in, we felt genuinely welcomed and cared for. Michelle’s warm smile at the front desk made an immediate impression, and she took the time to provide us with detailed consultations, answering all our questions with such kindness and understanding.

Amy, the office manager, was fantastic! She walked us through the dental costs and helped us prioritize the treatments we needed. Her clear explanations and patience made what can often be a confusing financial process feel so much easier.

Dr. Jung is a true professional, and his skill shines through in every procedure. He takes the time to explain everything in a way that's easy to understand, making sure you feel comfortable every step of the way. I appreciated how he took complex issues and made them simple to grasp without making me feel rushed.

I must give a special mention to Rachelle, Dr. Jung's assistant, whose delightful sense of humor creates an atmosphere that puts you at ease right away. She truly makes visiting the dentist a pleasant experience!

The hygienists, Taylor and Laura, did a phenomenal job with our check-up and cleaning. They were incredibly thorough, gentle, and attentive to our needs—my teeth have never felt better!

Overall, the entire team at Whitestone Family Dentistry works in harmony to provide not only exceptional dental care but also a warm and inviting environment. I wholeheartedly recommend this fantastic clinic to anyone looking for a dentist in Cedar Park!

user_reviews.Name: Gabriella Stark
user_reviews.Description: These guys are a true family practice! My kiddo has never had a bad experience and looks forward to going to the dentist. The fact that my entire family can go to one place makes it much easier. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Guillermo Gonzalez
user_reviews.Description:
Beginning with Mahogany’s greeting extending to Rochelle and her knowledge of procedures to finishing up with Dr. Jung and his explanation of what needs to be done and the procedure he’s going to follow and then his attention to every detail.
The whole experience is Five Star

user_reviews.Description: Great first visit today! The hygienist is so gentle and the dentist and assistant were so kind. Front office staff are helpful and sweet. I will refer people to this practice!

user_reviews.Description: Everyone was friendly, knowledgeable and willing to explain when I asked questions. The dentist was very thorough and he took the time to educate with imaging which I found to be very informative. I had a very positive experience and will definitely continue to go. Thank you guys!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: E T
user_reviews_extended.Description:
In a hunt for affordable quality in dental care i came across Whitestone Family Dentistry on Google search for affordable dentist in Austin.
What i like:
My call was answered right away and after the detailed explanation of my financing options i decided to start with a basic evaluation of my problem. I was offered an appointment within 2 hours to fit in my schedule. I received the link to an online intake form which was easy to fill on my phone.
The entire visit took about 30 min. I was offered a few financing options, which seems to address the strain from different angles.
What i didnt like:
Although very detailed and longer lasting solution was offered, it wasn’t what i was hoping to get done. Which leads me to seek a second opinion. Sure thing, i am not a dentist, but i had enough dental problems to know that often there are more practical solutions which can be sacrificed for a better profit over the patient packet.
Still, overall, the price was in a mid range for the offered solution with helpful financial arrangements.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A Truly Exceptional Experience at Whitestone Family Dentistry!

From the moment I walked through the doors of Whitestone Family Dentistry, I knew I was in good hands. As someone with high anxiety about dental visits, I was immediately put at ease by the caring and professional team. Dr. Andrew Jung and the entire staff took the time to walk me through every step of my treatment plan, making sure I fully understood each procedure. They were incredibly thorough in explaining my options, which helped calm my nerves and gave me confidence in the decisions we made together.

The atmosphere is so welcoming, and everyone at Whitestone goes above and beyond to ensure comfort. I never felt rushed, and they truly listened to my concerns. It’s clear they prioritize the well-being of their patients in a way that’s both compassionate and highly skilled.

I couldn’t be more pleased with my experience, and I will definitely be recommending Whitestone Family Dentistry to my tias, tios, and close family and friends. This place is a gem, and I’m so grateful to have found such a wonderful dental practice that genuinely cares about its patients.

If you’re looking for a dental practice that treats you like family and makes you feel comfortable, no matter your anxiety level, look no further than Whitestone Family Dentistry. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristin Heinze
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Jung and his whole staff are pretty incredible. I normally don’t go here regularly (first time) but I wasn’t accommodated quick enough by my current dental office I’ve been going to for 10+ years (somewhere else) after my crown had broke in half in my mouth. Left with an open, sharp tooth area. I sensed that it was pretty urgent so I saw some amazing reviews on Google about Whitestone Family Dentistry so I decided to give them a call. Not only did they fit me in same day, but was greeted with the nicest office staff and had the greatest experience with Amy, and then Dr Jung! They are both trustworthy, kindhearted, welcoming and very good at what they do. He got my temp crown in, and had my next appt the very next day to do the crown fitting. His hygienist Richelle was awesome! She kept me laughing, comfortable and happy throughout my whole appt. They efficiently handled my insurance with no problems, and quickly! Dr Jung did a fantastic job with the temp/prep crown process so far and really looking forward to calling this office “my new dentist” I’ll be returning to! I love his humor, knowledge and incredible work he does! They were thrilled when I told them that!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda Vega
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down the best dental establishment I’ve been to where my anxiety was dropped to a zero shortly after sitting in the chair. Dr Andrew Jung & his staff were so sweet, gentle, and very girl about what to expect during my visit as well as with the plan. I will definitely be returning and sending my friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathryn Azevedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I 100% recommend this office. As soon as I walked through the door I felt a positive vibe. The ladies at the front greeted me with a warm smile, Amy was so kind and caring; she took extra time to explain things, Melissa was awesome-I will be back for that cleaning, and Dr Andrew really is amazing; he was warm, kind, and professional; he took the time to really assess things and gave me a variety of options for my plan of care.  Thanks team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darya Green
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been a patient at Whitestone Family Dentistry since 2023, and overall, it’s been a great experience. Today, during my regular check-up (with a wonderful new hygienist), I was examined by a new doctor who informed me that I need several more crowns (surprise!).

What’s most concerning is that I have cavities near a new implant that was placed just a few months ago. It raises a serious question: why weren’t these issues addressed before the final implantation was completed?

To make things more confusing, the treatment plan I received today includes a bone graft for a tooth that has already undergone full implantation. The doctor I had previously is no longer there, and now I’m left unsure about continuing my care at this office. It might be time to find a new provider.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Spiars
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had to get a crown and filling today and Dr Alan and Amy were amazing. They helped me feel comfortable and made sure that I was heard when I had questions or needed a break. I get serious anxiety at the dentist but they really made it an easy as can be experience. Front desk staff were also extremely kind and welcoming. The rooms are comfortable and clean and they have good music/TV as well. I highly suggest going to Whitestone Family Dentistry!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott B
user_reviews_extended.Description: As a new patient I was not sure how it would go. I experienced an authentic welcome by all the staff and was impressed by the up to date technology used during my visit. The staff, equipment and thoroughness of the visit were welcomed. I plan to return in the fall for my semi annual cleaning and checkup.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mathew Montgomery
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Okay! So, I hadn’t been to the dentist in about 10 years, and needless to say, I was pretty nervous going in. I was absolutely blown away by the professionalism, hospitality, and kind explanations to my many questions and concerns. I had two cavities that needed work and the work was nearly painless, and way quicker than I had anticipated. I almost hugged the team in gratitude for their excellent work. I am so appreciative for making the experience as pleasant as can be.
THANK YOU!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lesly G
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and professional from the moment I walked in. I felt truly cared for and never rushed. Highly recommend this office if you’re looking for quality dental care with genuinely nice people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Wade Dalton
user_reviews_extended.Description: New dentist, new staffs almost every visit. The quality of service has declined over the time. Time to look for a new place that has the same dentist at least five years and staffs who are committed to the same job and workplace. Wish Dr. Megha Bassi never left.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sheridan Hartman
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had such a great experience at Whitestone Family Dentistry! The staff is incredibly helpful, kind, and caring. They were very efficient and answered any questions I had. I would absolutely recommend anyone to go here if they are looking for a great dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marc Zawrotny
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was my first experience here and at was excellent.  They have all the latest technology, but most of all they have a wonderful staff.  Dr. Johnson is great and easy to talk to.  Heather was equally great as my hygienist and gave me good pointers on how to take even better care of my teeth.  Jackie walked me through all my x-rays and scans with a great sense of humor.  Last but not least, Megan helped me set the appointment, square insurance, and made me feel at home when I arrived.
Excellent experience.  Excellent people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great first time experience, from the front desk to the dentist to the hygienist and the assistant. Everyone was super nice and explained everything without me having to ask any other questions. I world definitely recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelica Vega
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am beyond grateful to have found Whitestone. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warm smiles and a welcoming atmosphere. The staff—Brenda, Amy, Melissa, and Dr. Alan—were absolutely phenomenal. They took their time, made sure nothing felt rushed, and provided exceptional care throughout my entire visit. I’m so happy to be part of the Whitestone family and would highly recommend them to anyone in need of quality dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexis Ryan
user_reviews_extended.Description: the BEST dentist in cedar park, after going to a different dentist I came to Whitestone to get a second opinion and was blown away by the level of care and attention! They got me in so fast & fixed a problem tooth in literally less than 24 hours. From the front desk, to the dentist assistants, to Dr. Alan, I have never felt so cared for about my teeth! Everyone is so amazing and nice. Would 100% recommend if you are looking for a dentist in the area!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Phillips
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for a new patient exam and cleaning. The dentist was very nice and didn’t make me feel rushed. My hygienist Marisa was so sweet and very thorough. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Randy Swank
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and courteous staff. Quick appointments. 100% go out of their way to make you feel comfortable at a dentisits office. 10/10 would recommend and will be coming back for all my routine cleanings.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lovelyhomy Homy
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office staff wonderful with clear info and estimates. The doctor very gentle and made me comfortable. This was my first visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelli V
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nicest people ever. I stopped in while I was on a work trip from VA because my temporary veneers came off my front teeth. They were so pleasant and extremely helpful. Thank you so much again!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zubin Sanjana
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Alan and his team are very diligent and hard working. they made every effort to ensure my crowns fit properly and don't adversely impact my bite.
I would recommend them for any dental work to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: A. C.
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am very happy with this dental office. Dr. Johnson is very professional, skilled and honest. I had a few concerns and he didn’t push me into any unnecessary procedures like other dentists do. Meghan, the front office representative is very sweet as well as Dr. Johnson, Jackie and Rose the dental hygienist. I highly recommend Whitestone Family Dentistry to whom who looks for honesty, reasonable pricing, professionalism and TLC.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Megan Redman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Update: I'm back in their chair a few years later, and they're still wonderful!

First comprehensive exam went well.  It’s been several years since I have visited a dentist and while I didn’t expect the news to be good, I was impressed with the way Dr. Hsu reviewed the steps I needed to take and were able to get me scheduled for my procedure the next day!  Dr. Hsu was extremely gentle, friendly, and knowledgeable.  Allie and Amber were super personable and walked me through the whole process and reviewed prices with me to make sure I was comfortable proceeding.  The facility is welcoming, clean, and modern.  The location is super easy to get in and out of with ample parking.

*Update* I had my first root canal here yesterday and I was a little nervous when I arrived.  It was a STELLAR experience.  The specialist was so sweet!  I felt a little pain at ONE point and raised my hand.  He immediately numbed it more and I was golden for the rest of the visit and through the crown fitting.  They also have Netflix on a TV on the ceiling and hand you a remote for it.  Boy does that make the time fly!!!  I wasn’t even paying attention to what they were doing.  Genius, simple solution.  Wonderful experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deb Hardway
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr Allen is amazing!!! Gentle, great “bedside” manner. Always making sure I was comfortable!
Amy, his hygienist, was fantastic!!’ They were so comforting, gentle and calming…. Izzy and the receptionist incredibly welcoming and makes you feel at home.. only giving 5 stars because it doesn’t allow me to  give 10!!!!  Hands down the best!!!!!! Deb-Lago Vista

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vicky Bledsoe
user_reviews_extended.Description: They’re great!  I was there for a new patient exam and they were aLeo able to squeeze me in for my dental cleaning. Everyone was so friendly and nice!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Caitlin Elledge
user_reviews_extended.Description: I hadn’t gone to the dentist in years due to financial reasons, so I was super anxious to go. I was very relieved when I was greeted by a friendly and warm receptionist and had the best dental cleaning ever. They were super gentle and very informative about everything they were doing. They made sure I was comfortable and would check in regularly during the cleaning to make sure I was okay. It was overall a great experience and I’m happy to say that I’m no longer afraid of the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chris Hoehne
user_reviews_extended.Description: The entire team does a great job. Everyone was very professional and friendly.  They run a very efficient schedule where you get in at the exact time of your appointment.  The work is explained and done very well. A follow-up call was done the next day, checking on me to see if everything is OK. I was very impressed and highly recommend this dentistry to anyone looking for a great dentist office.  A Big "Thank You" to everyone on this team for doing such an exceptional job!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Moriah Frias
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I absolutely adore this office and the staff. Amber is amazing, very helpful, thorough, and kind.

My kids love Cynthia and Dr.Hsu. They are very gentle, kind and very good at explaining things to myself and my kids. My kids were extremely comfortable with everyone.

I just had my wisdom teeth extracted by Dr Mun. Everything was great, and recovery so far has been going smoothly.

10/10 highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina G-AVILA
user_reviews_extended.Description:
3 appointments in a row...let me tell you they where absolutely awesome with my children, my kids where completely comfortable. They took their time explaining things to the kids so they felt at ease. Everyone made us feel so welcomed and answered questions we had, very
informative. We definitely found our family dentist and would recommend to anyone looking for one. Thank you Whitestone family dentistry.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Goss
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was able to be taken on short notice, and even squeezed in for a filling after my consultation so I'd have a sensitivity free holiday. Much appreciation for Dr. Alan and the whole staff!! I struggle at the dentist, and they helped me to stay calm and feel okay with what needed to be done

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Brophy
user_reviews_extended.Description: I used to love this office but every visit for the last 2 years I have had an entirely new care team. I understand that offices go through transitions but it became too inconsistent. Even the office staff is entirely new. I miss knowing the people when I visit. I also feel like the previous dentist's took more time with me. Our family found a more established office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Joy
user_reviews_extended.Description: A terrific dental experience from beginning to end! Everyone in the office is so helpful and kind. Both the hygienist and Dr. Hunter were gentle and thorough and made sure I was comfortable each step of the way.  Both acknowledged and validated my concerns as well as my Hashimotos disease and how it affects my health and teeth. We have definitely found our dental team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: L G
user_reviews_extended.Description: Easy scheduling , very efficient and love the Staff.  I take the entire family there and we are all very happy.  Son just had his wisdom teeth removed and they were with us every step of the way on the recovery. Thumbs up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rhonda Utley
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great and engaging staff. Dr. explains everything clearly. They worked to get my procedure visit asap.
*update - had another issue come up and they took me right in, got it taken care of, pain free, and on my way - thanks!
** update 2024 - Loved my hygienist and besides being very thorough - everyone if so friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Alaniz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was very professional and friendly! Since I had a pretty bad experience with my last dentist, my husband was able to schedule an appointment at the same time as mine which helped so much! They listened to me as I explained my concerns, and doctor was very thorough about explaining what I needed based on my exam and x-rays. I know we will be well taken care of here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: katie rooke
user_reviews_extended.Description: Such a warm and inviting atmosphere. Since my last dentist moved out of state I have had trouble finding one that was patient, informative and not pushy. I decided to try Whitestone after reading some good reviews and I’m so glad I did! Dr. Hsu was fantastic! He made me feel comfortable. He handled my concerns and eased my nerves. I’m so glad I found my new dentist!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laci B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This was my first time using this dentist and I will definitely be back.
I first brought my 3 kids here and was super worried they would be scared or the staff wouldn’t have enough patience and I couldn’t have been more wrong.
Kim is THE SWEETEST, KINDEST, and most PATIENT hygienist I have ever met. Dr. Johnson was also sooo patient with my kids and all around a cool guy.
I went back for myself and had Jackie. I ABSOLUTELY LOVED HER AND HER PERSONALITY. She’s honest, kind, and very knowledgeable.
You won’t regret coming here. Megan up front is also super sweeet and always makes us feel welcomed❤️❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chelsea
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in for an appointment today and the staff was wonderful! They were friendly, welcoming, and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the appointment. A good dentist can be hard to find but Dr. Hsu is the best. He is professional, gentle, and I know my teeth are in great hands when I go into that office. I would recommend him to anyone looking for an amazing dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Whitestone Family Dentistry has changed dentists 3 times in the last few years. I almost left and didn't go back bc of the last dentist they had. She was terrible. BUT, they now have a new dentist to rave about! Dr. Hunter Johnson was awesome. I went in for a cleaning with my daughter and he did a great job and gave us good advice about keeping our teeth white. He is very meticulous and makes sure he inspects every nook and cranny of your teeth. I love that he cared about my my teeth like they were his own. I would highly recommend this dentist. The staff is great too. His dental hygienist was caring. The front desk staff is very friendly and show they care about you too. Great place.
Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tracy B.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Fantastic!! I was having some pain during work and I didn't have a current dentist. So I literally just called the first one near to me. I described my pain and explained I had never been seen there before. And within 20 minutes from my call I was sitting in a examination chair! I was very pleasantly pleased with the care I was given and the extremely friendly staff. And in my opinion I would give them 10 stars!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katychka
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am amazed how wonderful and calm I feel after seeing dentist! That never ever happens unless I got nitrous. Office was clean. Quick. They had the lasted tech. Very very nice. Told me exactly what was going on. I haven’t met the owner because he was out, but Dr. B was the sweetest woman. Ali and Cynthia were both awesome as well. Both very sweet and kind. I would give this office more stars if I could. I felt so well taken care of by this office. Thank you everyone!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy V
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love this dental practice, they made me comfortable with explaining the procedure to be done. The office is exceptionally clean and the staff , they all are so nice, Dr Johnson is so personable and professional.. I was referred to this practice and I wish I hadn’t waited so long to go see them .. I’ll be a regular from now on .. thank you all for your amazing attitudes and smiles.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob Jerre
user_reviews_extended.Description: Another great visit to Whitestone Family Dentist on Whitestone. My cleaning was done by a new-to-me hygienist, Sam, who is a very good communicator.  He answered all my questions at a level I could understand, and he did a very good job on the cleaning. I recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sonia Michniewicz
user_reviews_extended.Description: After almost getting scammed at my last dentist, I was very nervous heading into my appt at WFD. But those nerves went away almost immediately. The whole team was very kind and professional and Dr. Johnson was honest and trustworthy. 10/10 would recommend. Faith restored in dentists!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amanda White (Amanda)
user_reviews_extended.Description: I booked an appointment based off an advertisement and I’m so glad it arrived at the right time. I got an appointment ASAP. The entire staff is so kind and ready to help. I have nothing negative to say about my experience. No critiques to give. I cannot adequately  express my gratitude and appreciation for such a wonderful dental experience! I do not like going to the dentist. I feel like I’ve let every dentist down by not taking care of my teeth but there was nothing uncomfortable about my visits here. user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a comprehensive exam last week. Came in today to get two root canals and two crowns.  Needless to say it was a long appointment. user_reviews_extended.Name: Kirstin Sahagun
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I visited Whitestone Family Dentistry today as a new patient, and my experience was quite disappointing. I had high hopes for my visit based on previous Google Reviews, but left feeling unsatisfied and concerned about their approach to patient care.

Upon my arrival, I underwent a series of x-rays, digital scans, and oral examinations from a very sweet dental hygienist. However, my experience took a disheartening turn during my conversation with the dentist. She asked a series of questions regarding my diet, I explained I have a pretty boring diet that follows a meal plan, if I suffered from acid reflux, which I said no, and how much coffee I drank (2 cups a week), all which seemed reasonable at first. However, she then proceeded to ask (in front of two other hygienists in the room) if I had/previously suffered from an eating disorder. This question was not only inappropriate but also unprofessional. What if I had indeed been suffering from such an issue? This insensitive approach made me uncomfortable and left me with a negative impression.

Moreover, the dentist informed me that she had "good news and bad news" and that the good news was that my teeth look good, no cavities, no major issues or concerns. However the "bad news" was that I needed a "deep cleaning" due to plaque buildup under my gums in a few spots which she pointed out on the x-rays, a procedure that would require numbing and a substantial amount of time. I inquired about a regular cleaning as an alternative, given the high cost associated with the deep cleaning. To my surprise, the dentist dismissed this as against her "professional advice" and insisted on the deep cleaning, stating she would be doing me a "disservice" by just doing a standard cleaning vs. a deep cleaning on my teeth. This inflexible approach felt more like a sales pitch than genuine patient care. She would rather I leave with no dental cleaning, than a basic cleaning, claiming it would be MORE of a disservice?

The final blow was the cost estimate for the deep cleaning—$792, even with insurance. I found this to be excessive, considering the dentist stated there were no major concerns about my teeth other than some spots which needed a deeper clean. It seemed as though they were focused on financial gain rather than my well-being. Even after I expressed my concerns, they were not willing to provide a regular cleaning option.

Ultimately, I left without any dental cleaning, feeling that their priorities were more aligned with their own financial interests than with my dental health. I have insurance, yet the cost for a deep cleaning was exorbitant, and their refusal to consider a more affordable option left me disillusioned.

I have decided not to return to Whitestone Family Dentistry. I believe that a dental practice should prioritize patient care and well-being over financial gains. I will be seeking a more professional and patient-centered dental office that truly has the best interests of its patients at heart.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Sterba Sr
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had an extraction done by Dr Yang that was practically painless.
They numbed my gums with a gel that was spread on my gums near the tooth.
He numbed me further with several needle injections, then had me sit for 20 minutes to make sure I was numb.
For the extraction, there was a lot of firm pressure, but zero pain.
Dr Yang asked me multiple times if I was comfortable and if I felt any pain.
I was also told to raise my hand if I felt any pain and they would give me more pain shots.
Sasha helped Dr Yang with the procedure by rinsing and suctioning out my mouth as needed.
Post operation pain was controlled by OTC acetaminophen and ibuprofen we already had at home.
I was able to stop taking the medicine after three days.
I was very nervous about pain during and after the extraction, but I really had nothing to worry about.
I was in good hands with Dr Yang and Sasha.
