user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Groft
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hands down, best experience in many years. Doctor Yang is extremely competent, very friendly, and does a great job of educating the patient. Excellent overall atmosphere. The staff is amazing, from their flexibility in booking appointments to the explanation of any extra charges if necessary. Everyone is friendly and thorough, all around supremely professional as well as warm and friendly. Can't recommend highly enough!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dom Mcc
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience all around. The front office staff, hygienists and Dr all did an incredible job. Dr. Yang is more on the conservative/realistic side of dental care recommendations. He gives all the options and assists with making the best decision for the patient. The hygienist (Sarah) was relatively new but did a great job all around. Will happily come back to this location and recommend them to everyone I can.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathan Arauco
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience here! The staff was very knowledgeable and skilled while the assistant was very good at calming any nerves and assuring me the process. Overall I received superb care at a very fair price and was confident and happy waking out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: luciemy Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always, hygienist and doctor are gentle and friendly . I have not interacted with reception staff so I can’t comment on that

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kait Alzuru
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went in with some tooth and jaw pain. I was so nervous I was in tears. The lady at the front desk Miss Amy was amazing and supportive and so loving I honestly felt like family immediately. Then the dental assistant (I wish I could remember her name) who greeted me was also sweet and warm welcoming and treated me as if I was her own daughter. Again sobbing the whole time she comforted me and let me know I was in good hands. Dr. Yang came in and explained everything to me so well and made a plan for me to get started on my process to getting everything I needed done! I was so lost and didn't know where to start. He made me feel better by explaining how everything was going to go and that he was able to refer me to the specialist and gave me some peace of mind. After my visit I went back to the front desk and Miss Amy took the time and wrote down in detail all the information I would need to help me look for good affordable insurance. She then hugged me on my way out the door and said everything was going to be fine. I honestly can't say enough great things about my experience here at family dental. Once I'm all fixed up I will definitely be making this my regular dentist for myself and my kids. Thank you so much for everything you guys did for me to make me as comfortable as possible through the whole process! I am forever grateful ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Hamby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and professional. They were able to squeeze me in for an extra procedure and did a good job. Highly recommended

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tyler Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is an amazing dentist. Dr. Yang and the whole Staff is incredible and I could not say enough nice things about them. Kylie was my hygienist and was great! They were very attentive to all the details of my cleaning and were so kind. I would highly recommend this dentist for you and your family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hira Khan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I absolutely loved my experience at this place. The staff was very friendly and cooperative and the dentist was skilled and efficient. The atmosphere was very pleasant and welcoming, too! To top all that, they even worked with me regarding the pricing since I'm currently a student!

I had cavities filled, three crowns put in, and a root canal, and I can confidently say it was the best experience I've ever had at the dentist.

I look forward to seeing them again, even if it's just to stop by and say hello :D

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Eilertson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
October 2023 update: Another teeth cleaning and seriously, Kylie is amazing. Dr. Yang is super nice, rates are reasonable, office is clean and pleasant and office staff are the best! Thanks yall. I'm beyond relieved and grateful to have found this practice.

March 2022 Wonderful, caring, friendly staff! Explained everything thoroughly. Painless exam. Looking forward to next visit. (Really.)

December 2022 update: I have now had 2 fillings and my teeth cleaned 3 times. Every visit is better than the one before. My dental hygenist, Kylie, is thorough, patient and kind. Dr. Yang is great, seriously - no pain. The staff in the office are funny and friendly. The rates are reasonable. I am amazed and grateful to have found this dental practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan Nielson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Madden was great! Over the weekend I had a broken filling and was able to get in first thing Monday morning and see them. The staff was very friendly and attentive. They were short staffed that day, so I was there for longer than I would have liked to have been- but Dr. Madden did all he could to get my tooth fixed and my temporary crown set up as quickly as possible.

Edit: Dr. Yang is the doctor who now works out of this office- and he is amazing as well! The staff are still great, and I am very happy with all the work they've done to help me take care of my teeth!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Camay Jennings
user_reviews_extended.Description: The expertise and service are always exceptional. Whitney does a great job cleaning my teeth and Dr. Yang is a really good dentist. Samantha at the front desk was very accommodating and friendly!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donalee Harmon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great group of people.  Very professional.  Recommend highly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Steve Rogers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Daniel Yang performed a root canal and temporary crown for 2 molars that were cracked.  His work was well done, he was thoughtful and concerned to keep me as comfortable as possible.  Waiting now for my permanent crowns but am extremely excited to recommend Dr. Yang I’d you are looking for a family dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Yang
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently switched to Family Dental of Cedar Park after they got a new dentist, Dr. Yang. The office staff are super nice and they got me into my cleaning within minutes of my arrival. Whitney, the dental hygienist, was awesome and made me feel at ease. Dr. Yang patiently explained what he saw in my x-rays and provided clear options for treatment (cavity fillings). He even helped fix an old filling that needed attention! I highly recommend Dr. Yang and his staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mohan N
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had scheduled an annual dental check-up for my wife, ensuring beforehand that our insurance details were provided and understood to cover all associated costs. Despite this, and my explicit written statement on the day of the appointment refusing any out-of-pocket expenses, Family Dental Care of Cedar Park has proceeded to bill us for additional charges.

This lack of transparency and honesty from the staff is unacceptable. I had clearly communicated that we would not consent to any extra charges not covered by insurance, yet they have disregarded our agreement. It is disheartening to see such practices in place, where unnecessary additional checks are performed, leading to unexpected costs for patients.

I strongly advise against using the services of Family Dental Care of Cedar Park due to their disregard for patient agreements and the financial burden they impose without prior consent.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Chad S.
user_reviews_extended.Description: The hygienist and Dr. Yang are really awesome! Timely, relaxed, comforting and thorough. I’ve been coming here for a while, the previous two dentist went near As good as Dr. Yang. Dr. Yang has been here about three years now. I trust him, he’s predictable and super nice! I recommend fully!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ziria Maldonado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to Cedar Park Dental with Whitney & Dr. Yang for the better part of 3 years now and they are always friendly, professional, helpful and very accommodating. The front office clerks are always smiling and kind and I love getting my teeth cleaned here. Would not hesitate to recommend to anyone looking for a dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary Tedtaotao
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to this Dental clinic for 3 years and they are ABSOLUTELY the nicest and friendliest staff I've encountered. Amy the head receptionist is on top of everything as far reminders. Whitney my regular Dental Hygienist is always of course always taking of my oral hygiene as well my questions and concerns and she always has an answer and solutions.  Dr. Yang answers my major concerns and issues and always has the best advice. I LOVE this Dental Clinic and will always be a regular patient as long as possible!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dove Browder
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Yang, Kylie and Gabby were amazing. I was able to get my cleaning and treatment for cavities in one day. I was floored by their level of professionalism, cleanliness and patience with my anxiety.

I came here after a terrible experience elsewhere and I was scared of bad outcomes but Family Dental of Cedar Park assuaged those fears and left me healthier and happier after the visit.

Thank you, Dr. Yang, Kylie and Gabby! You are awesome!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Senior
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Yang and his whole staff of hygienists and office personnel offer a friendly and relaxing environment for a visit that can be rather stressful for many people.  I am a returning patient, and I recommend Family Dental of Cedar Park for your dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Govender
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Yang and his staff are amazing! I would recommend all my friends and family to use Family Dental of Cedar Park. They are professional, knowledgeable and caring.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julia Richards
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is nice and welcoming! Dr. Yang is very good at explaining what he is doing and why.  That is very important at the dentist office as it can be anxiety producing for me. They have a great team and I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a new dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary Tedtaotao
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amy the receptions is very very understanding and cooperative when rescheduling your appointments. Whitney my hygienist is thorough and detailed when giving feedback regarding my dental treatments.  And Dr. Chang is just a patient and great doctor when providing dental treatment.  I have been a patient for 2 1/2 years and love the staff. I would not want to go anywhere ever because great hospitality Family Dental of Cedar Park offers. Ya'll are AWESOME!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samin Ahmed
user_reviews_extended.Description:
BE AWARE OF THESE SCAMMERS.

Dr. Yang and the hygienist are great. But their admin and billing department are filled with incompetent scammers. They did calculations for a while and said our treatment plan will cost a specific amount and our insurance would cover this much and we would owe a specific balance. I paid everything and was square. Then months later I get a bill and notifications of balance due. I inquired what this is about and why there is now a balance. They had communicated with my insurance provider at the time of the appointment so not sure what changed. When I was trying to inquire and in discussion with the admin team via chat. I’m Canadian and this is a new process I was trying to understand as they provided contradictory information. Now in middle of communication via text, they sent this amount to collections.

BEWARE OF THESE SCAMMERS.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Alvarado
user_reviews_extended.Description: 1st visit done today in a long time and Kylie, the dental hygienist was so sweet & did a great job with my cleaning. Gave me some tips and was straight up about my next steps! Hoping next visits will be just as great

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ll give 3 stars mostly for staff friendliness and will dock it the other 2 stars since this place lacks the proper consultation when you get any service treatments. I went in today to get a cleaning and I love Whitney who is the dental hygienist - but I left today not knowing what my current dental health condition was and any improvements or concerns. Dental health is so important and when one gets good consultation during your service then you know you went to the right place. Needs improvement in this area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christina G
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I spoke to them about some concerns I had they basically said well it sounds like the doctor isn't a good fit. They were nice when I had paid for my services with no questions from me but the second I had a concern there was absolutely no compassion and were defensive. I surely will not ever be back here or recommend to anyone I know.
Edit: I wanted to add the person I spoke to who was not the dentist kept trying to tell me that bone loss is periodontal disease.
When looking it up and speaking to the specialist it is very clearly not what periodontal disease is.
Update: I guess they don't like it when a patient is unsatisfied and expresses their concerns seeing that they sent an official letter of terminating patient relationship. I had already stated I wasn't going to return. What a waste of paper!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gary Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience -- appointment was on time and the examination was complete.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Tankersley
user_reviews_extended.Description: From start to finish it was a very positive experience.   The women at the front desk are friendly and helpful....  The dental assistant who took care of me was great....Eva, I believe.  Amy from the front desk, who took me back to the procedure room gave me a blanket because it was chilly.  The xrays were quick and painless with the most modern of equipment.  I can't say enough about Dr. Manning.....he was very kind and gentle and obviously cares about how you feel .  He even called me the next morning to see how I was.  Dr. Manning and Eva were a great team .  I had a very difficult extraction....and they could not have been more caring and careful.  I felt very safe  and would go back to them for any problem I have in the future.  Thanks to everyone there for the excellent care.  It is a nice office with really nice people.  It was the best experience I have ever had at  the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Saul Calderon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love the staff! Very professional and super kind

user_reviews_extended.Name: Natalie Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love this place! Wouldn't even dream of going anywhere else. Everyone is nice, friendly and performs outstanding service. Here, you are family! Highly recommended❤️❤️❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pam McGuire
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Yang and staff are wonderful, caring, considerate of patients feelings and just overall great!  So glad I found them and would recommend to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michele Nazak
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am very happy with Family Dental of Cedar Park. Daniel Yang DDS is very good, he is knowledgable, very gentle and very pleasant. I recently had my first root canal and was total a mess about needing one. He numbed me up good, amazingly the only pain I experienced after the procedure was where the injection went in, nothing else! The staff is always friendly and very helpful. I highly recommend Family Dental of Cedar Park.
Michele N

user_reviews_extended.Name: LEE S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Yang put me at ease during my three hour ordeal.  I had had poor dental experiences in the past, so I was apprehensive about today’s procedure.  His craftsmanship impressed me, and everyone in the office seemed to be quite caring.
I hope the final appointment in three weeks goes as well. It is a very important one.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bruce & Kathy Hozeski
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Yang and Whitney, the hygienist, are great, but the two in the front office should be fired. We had an appointment a week ago and got an email confirming our appointments. When we arrived, we were told we had been assigned a new dentist, Dr Yang--we should have been informed of this before our arrival--and that our appointments had been cancelled because we had not confirmed. We had received nothing telling us to confirm. We had 2 active emails and my wife's cell on file at the office. Yes, we did eliminate our land line and got a new number for my cell, but there were still 3 ways to contact us. I was very angry about this, but we rescheduled. When we arrived for our appointment this morning, I told the 2 in the front office that I had checked deleted emails and verified we had received nothing telling us to confirm. The one who had cancelled us, turn her back and walked away. The other person said she did not want to discuss any of this and returned to her desk. We have been patients of this practice for 4 + years, never missed an appointment, and always paid what we owed immediately. The two in the front office should be fired!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Herbert Heyman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent from check in to checkout.
Hygienist was 100% thorough.  Did a great job.
Dr. Yang checked and double checked my x -rays and teeth.  Very professional and very pleasant.
I am completely pleased with Family Dental and the staff. I highly recommend this dental practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Madalyn Rivera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amy, Whitney and Dr. Yang are always welcoming and happy. Whitney does an amazing cleaning and is very thoughtful. Dr. Yang is very thorough, caring and explains his care well. I always enjoy coming in, I never thought I would say that about going to the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Partin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Family Dental of Cedar Park has a very professional and polite staff!  They reviewed my options with me and explained in a non aggressive manner to use their services or not!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leonard Perry
user_reviews_extended.Description: Professional, Courteous, Clean..It didn't take long to be seen. Once I seen by the doctor, He went right to work. Excellent staff, that were knowledgeable about the process, as well with the assistance with the procedure. I will definitely be going back again. This time on a regular basis. If you want the best check them out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shauna Glee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had extensive work done over the past couple of months. I have been pleased with everyone in the office and the services provided. I think one of the best parts of my experience is my dentist calling the day after a major procedure to check on me. That personal touch let me know that I made the right choice in dentists.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki Gomez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I truly did have a great experience with them. From the front desk, hygienist and the dentist they were all very nice. I’m an anxious person but they really did help me calm my nerves. I would recommend them in a heartbeat!

user_reviews_extended.Name: v l
user_reviews_extended.Description: Can't say enough good things about Family Dental of Cedar Park. I had extensive dental work here. Teeth extractions, implants, denture work. Wow, do I have a wonderful smile now. Now for my experience at this dentist office. I will start with Amy at the front desk;  truly professional and her kindness was astounding! Her attention to detail,  it was  a pleasure to see her every visit. What a true asset to this office. Then for Andrea the Dr.'s assistant, the patience and genuine care was incomparable to any other experience I've ever had. Her kindness and thoughtfulness was commendable. Then for the Doctor, Dr. Yang -impeccable, and I do mean impeccable. During teeth extraction he had a partner come from San Antonio, Dr. Moorehead, what a pleasure to have Dr. Moorehead there to assist in the surgery.  Back to Dr. Yang, I had many appointments for this procedure.  Dr. Yang always cared about my welfare. Dr. Yang really knows his profession and could answer any questions that I had.  I highly recommend this office to anyone for any dental care. From teeth cleaning all the way to implants and dentures. If you choose this dentist you will be very pleased . Whitney, the dental hygienist is also five star.  In summary,  I really want to applaud Dr. Yang and his staff. Dr. Yang was exemplary and his staff are truly one of a kind in service and care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Katie McCarley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always had a great experience at this practice. I am veeeeeery nervous for dental work and have had a LOT of it over the years but this staff was always friendly and made me feel like it was okay to be nervous. Better even, I had a crown that they replaced that fell out. I wasn't able to go back to them and had to go to another doctor for the replacement and this office, without any contract to do so for me-refunded me what I had to pay at their office to help with the cost of what I paid for the replacement. I was shocked and know several other dental offices that would not do the same. It's good people running a good business. I felt inclined to share.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Justin Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I came in today with a very painful impacted wisdom tooth. Everyone was super helpful and empathetic. I called before coming in and Amy took my insurance information prior to my arrival. Courtney helped me with some paperwork during my visit. Dr. Yang was really knowledgeable and answered all my of questions. The dental hygienist (I failed to get her name) that took care of me was really sweet and caring.
Everyone did a fantastic job on getting me the help I needed and I look forward to visiting again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carol Hillis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Showed up several minutes early for a new patient appointment and parked in the parking lot as directed by a sign. Then phoned the number on the sign to let them know I had arrived for my appointment and was put into voicemail with a “we’ll call you back” message.

Waited 10 minutes and after no response my husband phoned them and got the same recorded voicemail message. Waited five more minutes with still no response. Left them a second message to let them know we tried and we give up.

After getting home found it really odd that we got a text asking for a survey about their services. Seems like this is a totally automated dentist with no actual people inside the building.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Gordon
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you’re looking for a good dentist, I highly recommend Family Dental of Cedar park. We have been going there for 7 years and have been through 3 different dentists. We did not like the last one bc he pushed unnecessary procedures on us and wasn’t friendly or nice to his staff. But Dr Yang is there now and he’s awesome! I went in for a cleaning today and I had 2 small cavities! (I blame covid for my excessive candy eating 😂) they were able to fill them right away and only took 10 minutes! Excellent covid protocols too. All the staff is also very welcoming and do a great job!

user_reviews_extended.Name: R1S3_0F_D3ATH
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Good service and compensates for my disability and overall oral sensitivity
Dr. Yang has gentle hands and Simone is a fast worker w/o missing out on precision.
Very knowledgeable and in depth with details.
Also reasonable pricing for dental work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Worley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I haven't had great experiences with dentists in the past. That changed today. Everyone in the office is very pleasant, helpful and patient.  I have an extraordinary fear of going to the dentist but these people were able to put me at ease very quickly. I will be returning for future work. I highly recommend this office to anyone who gets anxious about dental visits.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DeeDee Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our family has been going to Family Dental of Cedar Park for years and they have always done great work. From fast and efficient cleanings to correcting the mistakes of past dentists, FDCP does an excellent job.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Virgie Therrell
user_reviews_extended.Description: A coworker referred me to Family Dental, she had such a good experience there, so I decided to make appointment since I was looking for a dentist, and I’m so very glad I did Dr Yang is very pleasant and very caring. The office staff are all so very nice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Monique Denby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Madden and his staff is amazing.  Only way to describe his service is that he is an AWESOME and CARING dentist. My entire family uses his service and many of my friends. The best service I have EVER received.  He has left me with a beautiful smile. I had not smiled in a long time my teeth were so bad and now I can't stop smiling. I get many compliments now on my teeth.  I can't stop thanking him and his staff..They are like family now.  I had 6 root canals done at same time I did not have to take any medication afterwards no pain what so ever.  Dr. Madden and his staff ROCK!!!#

user_reviews_extended.Name: amanda sterba
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Family Dental of Cedar Park. They are always transparent when it comes to the health of my mouth and the prices of my appointments. I have been using them for about 9 years and I don’t plan on leaving them anytime soon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kevin King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very friendly and professional. Katie took care of my insurance forms and made calls. Made experience easy. Dr. Yang and his assistant made the extraction seem like a walk in the park.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Miller
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff is friendly and knowledgeable. Dr. Yang is kind and friendly and has a great “bedside manner”. They always make me feel comfortable and cared for from the minute I walk in to the minute I walk out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bryan Barker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
These people that work there are very friendly and helpful. I went in for a cracked tooth and, as circumstances had it, I had my 1 year old daughter with we. Normally a calm content child, she was anything but at this moment. One of the hygienists? Whitney, really helped out by holding her, read a book and showed her cartoon videos. I really appreciated how they went out of their way to calm the situation. Thank you guys very much.

Bryan

user_reviews_extended.Name: Waliur Rahman
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great dentist, very knowledgeable and friendly.
The hygienist is not so good, she did not even clean my teeth, it was a cleaning appointment. Her name was Kylie. She was rushing me to take all the X-rays and has not done any cleaning, she ran out of alloyed time I assume. She referred me to an orthodontist for full mouth examination. She should have cleaned my teeth then refer for orthodontist.
I called my insurance company to see what they charged, the bill was not there yet, I called the office and the person was telling me they billed for cleaning.I asked the billing specialist to call me tomorrow to make sure, if they charged for cleanings or anything else I might have to charge for fraud.
My previous dentist was good, they clean properly my teeth and referred me to orthodontist or solutions for long term preventive measures of bone. My insurance changed, thus I had to select a different dentist. I might have to find another dentist or go back to my previous dentist and pay out of pocket.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Johnny Snow
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Dentist and staff was courteous and professional. They were very kind . The hygienist  made me feel very relaxed and pain free. I will be using this business for a long time. I definitely recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Hale
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would never recommend Family Dental of Cedar Park to anyone.  Dr. Santana told a family member that they needed a enormous amount of work done.  She then convinced them to move forward with it.  After the first appointment it became clear that she did not know what she was doing.  This individual was in tremendous pain, and the filling areas in the front did not match their teeth.  We then went to two other dentist for a second and third opinion.  Both looked at the X-Rays and said that there was work done that was unnecessary, and that most was not done to the standard a patient should expect by any means.  Now they are trying to bill us for work that was never done.  They are not worthy of being allowed to business anywhere!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Mota
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at this office was super nice and pleasant. I was having an issue with one of my teeth being sensitive, and Dr. Hardenbergh was incredibly gentle and professional. And also really funny! I definitely recommend this place!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Moreno
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is great. Dr. Yang is really professional and does work quickly. His staff is very friendly, too. I was hesitant to go because it's so far but it was worth the drive. I will return again.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jan Coffey
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had a wonderfully caring experience with staff and Dr. Madden. The staff are attentive and timely with scheduling my appointments and meticulously identifying insurance responsibilities, as well as out of pocket costs. Dr. Madden is a constant trusted professional that has beautifully changed my smile and the health of my mouth and gums. I wish they were closer to Pflugerville!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Evans
user_reviews_extended.Description:
UPDATE: Went to another dentist and have NO cavities, unlike the 9 cavities that Family Dental of Cedar Park told me I had.

ORIGINAL REVIEW: Went here after receiving a mail-out with their $59 promotion.

Went in.They had me take one digital x-ray and 18, yes EIGHTEEN regular x-rays. I've been going to the dentist practically every 6 months since I was a child and have never had so many x-rays taken.

At Family Dental of Cedar Park, the dentist came in and said that I had 9 cavities. (It seems to be the trend lately that dentists will over-diagnose in order to make more money.) He was pretty rude telling me that I must be eating too much sugar or drinking too much soda. He had nothing kind or friendly to say to me.

They gave me a price breakdown to fill 4 of my cavities. It was $1100. I told the receptionist that I knew that was not the going rate for fillings... she kind of "uh..... oh. Well we have a discount plan." She gave me the printout of that plan. The pricing for the fillings were still slightly above average.

I cancelled my husband's appointment for later that day and scheduled him a new one at another place. I also scheduled an appointment for myself for a second opinion at another dentist.

It wasn't worth the cheap appointment to be lied to about how much dental work needed to be done and to be treated so poorly by the dentist himself.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Johnston
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service from friendly staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Bell
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time ever having a tooth break and Family Dental was able to get me in next day! Everyone is so kind and accommodating to the best of their ability! The repair was excellent!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Fagrelius
user_reviews_extended.Description: I put off going to the dentist, as I'm sure some parents do while making sure their children go instead. Dr. Yang and his team made me feel welcome and comfortable, and treatment was made painless for a root canal and crown. Grateful for their high level of care and professionalism.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dale Hunter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going here for the last 3 yrs. Staff is always very friendly and helpful. Good follow up when making appts.  Teeth cleaning is very thorough and never any discomfort at all.  Dentist is friendly and not in a rush.  They moved the offfice on me so I have to drive a little farther but it's definitely worth it. Thanks y'all!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John
user_reviews_extended.Description: Whitney Morgan is the best! Everyone I've been to before her just did a routine cleaning and told me everything was ok when it was clearly not the case and my gums are no longer irritated. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: George Martschenko
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff. Front desk very friendly and know what they are doing. The dental assistant completely explained what was going on and what she was doing. Very friendly and efficient. Dr Yang was detailed, quick and friendly. Highly recommend the clinic.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kierstie Steevens
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing experience at this office. Booking my appointment with Amy, she was very informative & put me at ease about meeting the Doctor. Ava (or Eva?) Was the assistant who took my xrays, sat & chatted with me during my wait times, and her compassion about my tooth pain put me even more at ease, Dr. Madden was wonderful, making sure I wasn't in pain & discussed some further treatment options with me that I didn't know I had needed. The front office worked with my discount plan & there was no excessive talk about money, they allowed me to pay what I could. The biggest relief from this office is that it was judgment free! I've visited many dentist offices over the past few months only to beet with judgment & disdain for the state of my teeth. I feel like ive finally found a dental home that i can continue to get treatment at. I have nothing but positive things to say about Dr. Madden & his staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aaron Dennington
user_reviews_extended.Description: EVERYONE at Family Dental of Cedar Park were very welcoming and kind.  My 9 year old had no fears or worries at all during her visit.  She asked if we could please come to this dentist all of the time.  My daughter actually ended up having an issue that only a specialized pediatric dentist should handle, but Dr. Madden made sure he took all pictures and x-rays necessary to be very clear and certain of that diagnosis.  But, on the same note, they did NOT in anyway build up charges against me for all of those x-rays and pictures.  It was still the price quoted on the phone prior to our appointment using one of their amazing online coupons.  We will most certainly be back!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kerri Renee
user_reviews_extended.Description: Bedside manner and customer service were top notch. They were very attentive and made sure my tooth extraction was as painless as possible. Everyone was very friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: I chipped a tooth and had unbelievable pain, I could not wait a week to be seen at my regular dentist, so I called at 7:30 this morning and they were able to see me by 10am! The staff behind the counter greeted me with a "Hello, and you must be Jessica?" That was impressive, I work in a pharmacy and I understand it takes just one extra second to make a person feel welcomed instead of just the next file on the counter. My wait was quick, the nurse followed me into the room and got started on my issue right away, after my xray was finished, I was meeting Dr. Tjan and he very carefully explained to me what my options were to fix my tooth. I say very carefully, because I am TERRIFIED of dentists! I told him right away that I had a fear and he kept that in mind throughout my whole visit. We decide on a course of action and now its time to do the money part, another woman comes into the room with a print out of everything we just discussed, what my insurance will cover and what my portion will be. Very happy with my treatment plan and price, I pay and immediately he begins working on me. Throughout my entire procedure both the doctor and his assistant (Im sorry I dont remember her name) were making sure i was comfortable and letting me know to raise my left hand if i felt any pain or anxiety or needed to stop. He kept me updated step by step so I knew what was happening and when I would be finished. Here's the BEST part, when I was all done he said "Ok, I have some good news" I didnt need to do as much as I anticipated I would have to and he refunded me 86.00$ right on the spot! I know this review is long, but I wanted to be very detailed. I read some of the other reviews and its like we were at completely different places. I had one of the best experiences at a dentist's office ever, I will be happily moving my family to Dr. Tjans office! One more thing, tonight while eating dinner at 7:15pm my phone rang and it was the doctor himself asking me how I was feeling! Doesnt get much better than that folks!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Then the doctor came in and told him he had 16 cavities, needed a crown on his front tooth, and that he had periodontal disease. The dentist also said he should just get crowns on all of his front teeth so they would look the same. He as well scheduled him for two deep cleanings the following week for 574.00 each. He gave him an estimate of 6,000 of dental work that needed to be done over the next year. So when my husband came home I told him to get a second opinion. He did that and the dentist he did see said he didn't have this disease or 16 cavities. This dentist just seems like a scam. title: Bowcutt Dental
address: 2501 S Lakeline Blvd, Cedar Park, TX 78613, United States

user_reviews.Name: D E
user_reviews.Description: Amazing dentist with nice staff and office. They have been completely transparent and on point with my insurance. The improvement in my oral health over the last three years has been phenomenal. I can't recommend them enough!

user_reviews.Name: Haley Carter
user_reviews.Description: I’ve had the best care at Bowcutt Dental. I do not like the dentist and before becoming a patient here avoided going! Emily takes her time and is thorough, explaining things along the way. Dr Bowcutt is kind and present when he meets with patients and isn’t overly aggressive in treatment like many other dentists. If you’re looking for a good, honest, and trustworthy dentist office, I’d recommend Bowcutt.

user_reviews.Name: taylor Elrod
user_reviews.Description:
We had such a wonderful experience at this office! My daughter gets pretty anxious about going to the dentist, and the entire team could not have been more patient or kind with her. From the moment we walked in, the staff helped her feel calm and safe, talking her through every step and never rushing her. The dentist was incredibly gentle and reassuring, and you could tell they truly care about their patients.

I’m so grateful for how they handled everything — it made a huge difference for her confidence and comfort. If you get nervous at the dentist, this is definitely the place to go!

user_reviews.Name: Donna Alexander
user_reviews.Description: I have been going to this dentist for many years. He is consistently the best.  Dr. Bowcutt and his staff provide exceptional dental care and combine professionalism with genuine compassion, which really sets them apart. The office is modern, clean, and beautiful. When I needed a procedure, Dr.Bowcutt explained all my options clearly, ensuring I understood everything before proceeding. The results were fantastic, and I couldn’t be happier. I’d recommend Bowcutt Dental to anyone who wants quality care and a positive dental experience.

user_reviews.Name: Stephen Crawford
user_reviews.Description: I always enjoy my experience at Bowcutt. Professional service, caring staff, and friendly smiles always make my visits super enjoyable. And I love the sunglasses during the exam and background music! I would highly recommend Bowcutt if you are looking for professional service with a human touch!

user_reviews.Name: Paul Mallet
user_reviews.Description: I relocated and left this practice for a few years, but always missed the excellent care. I would say it’s worth the drive even if coming from far away. I have never waited past my appointment time — they are very respectful and prompt, so I haven’t ever felt like my time was wasted. Additionally, I once needed a filling and Dr Bowcutt was able to accommodate me that same day, no need to come back! That was a huge convenience. I met a new hygienist today, Jen, and she was great! To be fair, every staff member has been courteous and professional. I look forward to my routine exams because everyone here is just that wonderful.

user_reviews.Name: Travis and Jenny
user_reviews.Description: We had an amazing experience for our three kids from beginning to end. First, they worked to get all of our kids scheduled at the same time. Each one got great personal attention and care for their needs. Everyone we encountered was so nice and answered all our questions. The facility is comfortable and beautiful. We all left happy with our experience and already scheduled for the next one! I highly recommend and feel so confident with their care moving forward.

user_reviews.Name: Julia Genin
user_reviews.Description:
Untrustworthy. Profits driven pushy sales tactics. Will try to sell you dental work that's not needed or even not likely to work.
Bowcutt: "would you like to try Invisalign?"
Me: "I've been told by other dentists, including the one who owned this practice previously, it wouldn't work for the type of misalignment I have, and would cost a significant amount."
Bowcutt: "Yes, it would be challenging, but I'm willing to take on the challenge."
Me: 😑 Yeah, because you get paid whether it works or not. Thanks, but I'd rather keep my money.

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just had another great appointment with Bowcutt Dental. Each Bowcutt member is interested in taking care of all my dental needs. They always take time to answer my questions about dental care and offer helpful suggestions. Thank you Bowcutt Dental. 🦷

Love my dental team, Bowcutt Dental!
When Dr Jordan announced his retirement several years ago, I was concerned I would not receive  the same quality of care I had come to know. Dr Bowcutt and team have put all my concerns to rest. I trust him with my dental care and highly recommend him and his team. They’re like an extended family of care givers. You should give them a try too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Sparks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I didn't grow up being taught the importance of oral care. They didn't make me feel bad and they took me seriously. I now have a routine, and am proud of my smile. The office is super clean, the staff truly makes you feel comfortable, and it's actually affordable. When choosing whose hand you want in your mouth, choose Bowcutt.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Weed
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is amazing!  I highly  recommend Dr.Bowcutt’s office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juan Vega
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been my dentist of choice for over 20 years. Always a pleasure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Breona Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: After five years of searching for the right dentist, I have finally found the one. Dr. Bowcutt is personable, kind, and non-invasive. His staff is so friendly and kind as well. Life-long patient here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Sparks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an excellent first experience here. Jennie  explained everything as she did it and was considerate of my comfort level. Dr. Bowcutt was very nice and made me feel comfortable in their plans for my dental health. My favorite thing is that the facility is very clean and pretty. Not overdone with flat screens and like pinterest made its home there. Would recommend to everyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joann Albert
user_reviews_extended.Description:
What I loved about my experience was the staff.
From my first contact with Debbie via phone, I knew I had chosen the right place. Yesterday I saw Jazmin, the dental assistant,  who was wonderful and made me feel comfortable.  Then I saw Dr.  Bowcutt, who was friendly and gentle while removing my tooth.  I feel great, and have had no pain!  I am so happy I chose Bowcutt Dental. Thanks guys!! ❤

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marco Avila
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve been a patient for 5+ yrs with Dr. Bowcutt. Best dentist in all of Texas! Him & his team are very professional, friendly, and caring! Always make your visit very comfortable! Highly recommend to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claudia Loewenstein
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Bowcutt  and the entire staff make you feel it’s a family business. He is skilled and very careful with multiple complex procedures I have had to undergo . The staff is courteous, friendly and helpful— and while it’s never fun going to your dentist- everyone is pleasant and makes my experience there better

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike Ames
user_reviews_extended.Description: My dentist was on vacation, and his office recommended that I schedule an appointment with Dr. Bowcutt’s office for a minor emergency concerning a crown falling off. Dr. Bowcutt was professional, efficient, and provided the highest quality dental service. He successfully reattached my crown and took the time to ensure that my bite was just right—actually better than it was before the crown fell off. I was so happy to receive that level of service from someone who wasn’t my regular dentist. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a new dentist or who is unhappy with their existing dentist. You won’t be disappointed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stefanie Braun
user_reviews_extended.Description: Bowcutt Dental was recommended to me by a friend when  I moved to Austin 3 years ago.  I’ve been going here ever since and have had great experiences every time.  My dental hygienist, Sonya, is wonderful- very gentle, knowledgeable, and friendly.  Dr. Bowcutt is fantastic- he gives you all the options, takes the time if you have questions/has never made me feel rushed, and never talks down to me.  I had to get my first crown last year and I was pretty nervous about it.  Dr. Bowcutt did an amazing job, he explained everything, and the procedure went incredibly smooth.  Highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denis Sokolov
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not only do they do quick and quality work, but everyone at Bowcutt Dental treats you like family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Melanson
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been to Dr. Bowcutt for a few years now and have the best experiences. His office is so pleasant. Everyone who works there is kind and professional. I have been to many dentists in my life, and Dr. Bowcutt is certainly among the best. I highly recommend Dr Bowcutt!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Bryan
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been a client for almost 26 years.  I love everything about this dental office.  The staff are all so friendly and professional.  The office is always so clean and comfortable too.  They truly treat me like family.
I think it's important to be able to reach the office easily to make appointments, etc.  I have found it very easy to reach them on the phone, and I also easily reach them by email, which works well for me.  Insurance claims are always handled efficiently and professionally by Debbie and Mary.  They've been in this office for years and years and they really know what they are doing - which is refreshing!  Dr. B is so friendly and he clearly knows his stuff.  I recommend Bowcutt Dental to everyone that asks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jehan Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was so nervous going to the dentist since I hadn't gone in a very long time (2004!) But the whole staff was very nice. The dental assistant that helped me was amazing. She made me feel comfortable and my nerves eventually went away. As for Dr. Bowcutt, I couldn't be more pleased. He actually cares and patiently goes through with what you're dealing with and the solutions for it. No one likes going to the dentist, but I actually look forward to my next appointment. I highly recommend this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Uncensored Faith
user_reviews_extended.Description:

These folks are great! Called me to remind me when I was late. Fit me in anyway. Did filling in about 15 minutes. They are a pretty happy team->seem to like each other too! low turnover. Try ‘em out! They take care of my whole family of 4.

Continue to have great experiences here... They take care of my kids and don’t suggest unnecessary procedures. Our favorite is Emily... Super friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Jansen
user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gerritt Eitelbach
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is always friendly, skilled, and helpful. Dr. Bowcut It has amazing skills.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ryan Cruz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely loved it here. After the previous office that I went to, I swore I was done with Dentists. The Bowcutt family really put an emphasis to treat me without feeling pressured into anything. They truly had my best interest at heart. Dr. Bowcutt is a knowledgeable Dr. and humble at the exact same time. He knew exactly what he was doing and had great cohesiveness with his team. Communication was great and they didn’t do anything unless everyone agreed on the best treatment. Jenny my hygienist was amazing! She made sure I was comfortable the entire time. I put in my AirPods and almost fell asleep on the chair during my deep clean. Hands down best dental office I’ve visited.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lily Matocha
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The staff here is so friendly! Everyone goes out of their way to make the dental experience a positive one. I have no complaints.

Dr. Bowcutt seems like a genuinely nice guy. He is also knowledgeable and takes his time.

The ladies in the front are wonderful! They have helped work me in when my schedule was tight and I was having major issues with a root canal (done by another endodontist).

Everyone else has been so pleasant too. My teeth cleanings are always gentle, efficient, and thorough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harley Pennington
user_reviews_extended.Description: I first went to Dr. Bowcutt’s office for a second opinion on several fillings and I was honestly really happy with that appt that I transferred all of my care there. I have been looking for a dentist in the Cedar Park area and his office has really exceeded my expectations. Today I went for my routine cleaning and he answered all of my questions, explained the cause of my bone loss, and certain things I should change in my routine. Jeni? performed my cleaning. She explained everything and made sure that I was comfortable throughout. When I left they gave me a really spectacular new patient gift that was impressive. I have really been impressed with this dental clinic and his staff! Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone is friendly and caring.  Have used this practice since 1990 and wouldn’t go anywhere else

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hayley Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My husband started going here so I did also. The hygienists are usually pretty great but the past few times my husband has gone have been less than pleasant.
Main reason for the this is because when my husband started going they told him they take insurance as well as when I started, however they don’t actually take insurance. We have amazing insurance yet constantly are being billed for this that or the other when we have two dental insurances and should have no costs.
Along with that they’re charging me a cancellation fee when I canceled my appt a week in advance due to having a baby. When I got the bill and asked them about it they said it was my husband bill and they don’t charge cancellation fees. The bill does not say my husbands name, it says mine and says “canceled appointment (no bill ins) $24”.  Yet they claim it’s my husband bill and when I  asked for the bill in his name with explanation of charges they ignored me. My husband called today with proof of what the bill they sent said and asking for his bill instead they couldn’t explain charges, wouldn’t send the bill and threatened to call the cops on him for harassment.
Highly recommend not going here unless you want to be scammed out of money and lied to about it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: MMisztal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am really disappointed with dr Bowcutt’s office and the way his staff treated me and my kids. We had great experiences with dentists before but as we moved I wanted to find a dental office in my neighborhood.
During my daughter’s first appointment the hygienist took my daughter to take a picture (ct scan?) to find out 2 minutes later that she already had it in her previous office and that the insurance will not cover it. My daughter therefore got unnecessary radiation x 2 because the X-ray had to be repeated without earings. Dr Bowcutt who was very kind to my daughter said that she needed sealants on 2 of her teeth, which the front desk said we could do the same day and I paid a copay of $150 before the second appointment. I was quite surprised with the amount I paid as we have a good insurance and usually everything is covered but I paid. 6 weeks later, after my appointment, I was informed that I have a bill to pay of $359! What bill I asked? For your daughter’s last appointment, doctor put medicine on her teeth the office lady said. I asked her how come as I had already paid $150, and the rest was supposed to be covered by my insurance. She was trying to say something but finally said: M’am we are actually out of network. I was in shock! So overall I paid $509 for my daughter’s appointment. I didn’t get any explanation why I got another bill and why it was so high. I was so confused that when I got home I called the office and was trying to receive some explanation but instead the lady became rude and said that I signed to pay (?!)
I still don’t understand that. I only went to this place because I was told they accept my insurance so I understood they must be in network with my insurance. I called a few offices which were out of network and they were always honest about that so I kept looking and got scammed by Dr Bowcutt’s office.
There is no information on their website that they are out of network and the front desk informed me about it only after my family (me and my 2 kids) had already 5 visits. My husband who was never in the clinic, just got an invoice to his name to pay $1047 for apparently my and my other daughter’s visits.
I felt completely misled by the office staff regarding the insurance and procedures and not telling about the cost estimates before the procedures as I would not have agreed since our insurance mostly covers 100%.  I have been living in Texas for 5 years and have never had a situation like this with any doctor’s or dental office.
I do not recommend this experience to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jane Mahmoud
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot say enough good things about my experience with this dental practice, beginning in the early 80’s with Dr Jordan and then with Dr Bowcutt. I have referred many friends, family, and co-workers to them over the years. Very professional, and everyone treats you like family.  I always feel like I’m in good hands with them, including those at the front desk. Bowcutt Dental is the best!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Slater
user_reviews_extended.Description: My family started using this clinic in the early 80's, maybe before Dr. Bowcutt was born.   I have always felt welcomed and well taken care of by all who work at the clinic.   When Dr. Jordan retired I was cautious of the new 'young' Dr. Bowcutt but he has not disappointed.    The atmosphere of friendliness, caring, and professionalism is still the same as well as the excellent dental evaluations and work.   Kudos to the entire staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrew Bain
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was a fantastic experience from the prompt initial appointment to the final results. A genuinely friendly staff (including Dr. Bowcutt) who made me feel welcome from day one. Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been attending this office for the better part of 10 years, back when Dr Jordan ran the practice. user_reviews_extended.Description: Such an amazing place with such kind staff!! Always get my teeth so clean!

I have been coming to this dental office for over 16 years, and Dr. Bowcutt is amazing and always friendly. The entire staff makes you feel like family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brooke Peterson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my new patient appointment this morning and I will never go anywhere else. The hygienist, Jennie was very gentle and was well experienced! user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Woodruff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bowcutt and staff are amazing. I've been coming to his practice for years and have never had an experience that was bad. They are all so friendly, knowledgeable, and safe...plus, their office is beautiful. I know they have my best interests at heart and I would highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dionne Carter
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love everyone and everything about Bowcutt Dental!! My husband and I have been going here for 6 years. Our oldest son started going last year after aging out of the pediatric dentist. It’s rare to have front office staff, dental hygienists, and the dentist Dr. Bowcutt so focused on providing exceptional customer service. They are professionals, accommodating, and extremely nice. It’s a pleasure to call this our dental home!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Claire
user_reviews_extended.Description: Their caring & compassionate staff went above and beyond to comfort me when I had anxiety about my insurance/finances. Dr. Bowcutt’s office does everything they can to make your visit a pleasant experience that stands out from the rest. I truly appreciate the way they treat their patients!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenna Lemons
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I'm a retired dental hygienist and have been looking for a dental office for the past few years.  I've tried a few around my area but never had the feeling it was "the place" for me.  Having worked in the dental field, I have high expectations when it comes to finding a dental team I want to be part of my healthcare team.  The atmosphere of the office as well as the personality of the staff plays a part in my decision.

This was my first time at Bowcutt Dental.  Pre-visit communications with Cori were great whether over the phone or over texts.  She texted me when an earlier appointment became available so I was seen a few weeks sooner than expected!  I knew what to expect as far as payment of services go and how they would handle my insurance.  Darlene was the dental assistant who started my appointment by taking all the x-rays and intra-oral pictures with a digital camera. I appreciated her efficiency because, for me, the x-ray sensors can be uncomfortable in the mouth.  Next, Emily was my hygienist.  Excellent care and technique with the probing of the gums (measuring the pockets around each tooth), and with the hand scalers as well as the ultrasonic instrument.  I have a retainer on the backside of my lower front teeth that is hard to keep clean.  There was a layer of cement-like tartar that needed to be removed and Emily got the job done without overexerting pressure on my teeth or jaw.  I didn't feel like I was hit by a train afterwards (no headache or jaw pain)!  The teeth felt smooth and will be easier to keep clean. Lastly, Dr. Bowcutt came in to finish the appointment by doing his exam and going over the x-rays and pictures.  He said my teeth and gums look great and I just need to keep up with my cleaning every six months.  No high pressured sales for teeth whitening, night guards, special toothbrushes, or any other extra services.  I love the relaxed vibes of the entire office and the staff is super friendly.

I was given a goodie bag at the end of the appointment.  I don't know if established patients get all the goodies but the one thing I liked the most was the almond butter chapstick!  It is silky-smooth divine!  Good stuff!

Highly recommend this office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candiss Farrington
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is the best dental practice in town. My whole family has received the most excellent care for over 25 years. Dr. Bowcutt and his staff are the most compassionate, friendly, gentle, and happy souls... I love each and every one of them. 🥰 I have referred many of my friends to Dr. Bowcutt and they all feel the same way. If you have a dental phobia or fear of needles, etc.... they will work with you and calm you. I have had my hand held several times. It doesn’t get any better than that. I would not go anywhere else for my dental needs. Love, love, love Bowcutt Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Has done a good job to take ownership in his field and I appreciate them all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mia Mann

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kim Kolhagen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bowcutt and staff are absolutely wonderful!! When I moved from Houston to Austin I had a difficult time finding a new dentist. user_reviews_extended.Name: Norma G

I got an appointment same day and as soon as possible. The whole staff was pleasant, professional and I was very pleased with the service and quick process. It only took about 15mins. I have already set up an appointment for my 1st cleaning after check out. I highly recommend this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lloyd Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bowcutt and his entire staff are awesome!  I have had an implant and two crowns during the last year, and the procedures have actually been easy compared to what I expected based on past experiences with other dental professionals. I highly recommend this group, and have to several friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fatema Rasul
user_reviews_extended.Description: It has been a wonderful experience.  The staff are very friendly,  you feel like you are with family. Jenny attended me. Dr. Bowcutt came after that, and further checked my mouth and both Jenny and Dr Bowcutt made sure to address all my concerns.  I am completely satisfied with my visit there. Will be back again for future needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Webb
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very friendly staff, clean, comfortable waiting area with high-end massage chair, easy check in, got seen in under 5 minutes, and my Hygienist, Sonya, D

user_reviews_extended.Name: E Ak
user_reviews_extended.Description: I honestly hate going to the dentist I’ve always had bad experiences. After visiting Dr.Bowcutt I completely changed my mind. They made me feel so comfortable, kept me informed with every single detail, and came up with a game plan right away to help me have healthier teeth and gums.
