She is amazing and very helpful and she knows what she is doing. She even has a magical numbing gel which is a plus for someone who gets scared from a dental visit like me. lol

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alison K
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Bowcutt and his staff provided excellent service as usual at my recent visit. They are knowledgeable, friendly, caring, pay attention to details and excellent dental professionals. I’ve been a patient for years and highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Talitha Wheatley
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going here for years for my dentistry needs. Emily is the best dental hygienist in the world &  Dr. Bowcutt is amazing as well! Both are very gentle with my sensitive teeth/gums & are so super sweet! The front desk staff are so very kind and helpful!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Walden
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Dr Bowcutt since he began his practice in Cedar Park. The work environment is professional and friendly. This time I broke a tooth ystrday and Betty had me in 30 minutes after I called. I have never had an issue with any of the dental work he has done. The work in precise and impeccable. It's great to have a dentist I like and one who cares about his patients!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Eulie
user_reviews_extended.Description: Best dentist I have been too. Hygienist are very skilled and doctor Bowcutt is great. My last dentist the hygienist would be painful during teeth cleanings and the doctor had me back every day for a fillings. Complete opposite at bowcutt. Thanks!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ken Zapalac
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience this morning with the x-rays, cleaning, and checkup. Sonya always does a wonderful job and Dr. Bowcutt did a very thorough followup check. The entire office staff is always so nice. The Christmas decorations were beautiful.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Nelle
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an emergency and they squeezed me in to get my crown reset. I love how they are  ready for an emergency by having the staff on hand to help.  Even if they didn't I sure didn't know!?  And especially, thanks to Deb and Corie for running the office so smoothly!!  Dr. Bowcutt I love your team!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hailey Winemiller
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My family has been coming to this office for years, before they were even at this location. My kids were not afraid of going to the dentist, as long as it was to see Dr. Jordan and his staff. We felt like we were loosing a part of our family when Dr. Jordan retired. We were wary of the new doctor in town, and have not been disappointed. Dr. Bowcutt is attentive and knowledgeable, and my kids will not go anywhere else. Even the ones away at college plan to see Dr. Bowcutt when they come home.

The staff is amazing. Appointments and insurance are efficiently managed. Cleanings, dental work, and preventive care continue to be top notch. We are glad we gave Dr. Bowcutt a shot.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jenny Black
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to this place longer than I haven't been. I've seen the same friendly faces for 2 decades. The staff is always very friendly and compassionate. Dr. Bowcutt is so kind and gentle. I have nothing but great things to say about the facility and the staff. I highly recommend Bowcutt Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gabriel Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Quality staff and if you have anxiety about dental work this is your home. They have gotten me over my anxiety over dental work and actually care about my health. 5 star service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Rice
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been going here for 8 years.  I love it!  The ladies up front are so friendly and accommodating.  The dentists and hygienists/assistants are very professional.  They are not only warm and welcoming but knowledgeable as well. They do not go beyond what is needed unless asked to do so. The dentist always discusses the pros and cons of any work needed to be done and gets your consent as to how you would like to proceed.

I highly recommend this amazing team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Valerie Frazee
user_reviews_extended.Description: First of all, I hate going to the dentist. I am not blessed with good teeth and genetics are not on my side. So when I started seeing Dr. Bowcutt for my dental work, it was a very good experience. Sonya is my hygienist and she is full of knowledge and lots of love. I love going to this office. Everyone from the front desk on all give great service. They’re just a fantastic office and they do everything they can to take care of my teeth.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Bullard
user_reviews_extended.Description: The hygienist Emily was very pleasant and amazingly gentle while still being efficient.  Dr Bowcutt and his customer-centric staff have maintained the exceptionally high standard that Dr Jordan set in his previous ownership.  I highly recommend this practice as this is best I’ve experienced.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Pelletier
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been coming to Dr. Bowcutt for dental services for years. Now my three year-old is also a patient there. The staff is professional and friendly, and Dr. Bowcutt does great work and is very honest. He does not try to push unnecessary dental work just to make extra money. My child and I actually enjoy going to the dentist thanks to this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janice Vanzura
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you're looking for a dentist who puts you at ease, is extremely thorough, kind, and easy to talk to, then Dr. Bowcutt is the dentist for you! I've been going to him since he took over Jordan Family Dental and I have never been dissatisfied with the service and treatment I've received. Every person that works at Bowcutt Dental is friendly, personable, and professional. Give them a try! You'll be glad you did.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vicky W
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to this practice for over 20 years!!!!  When Dr Bowcutt took over, the transition was seamless. Things are just as wonderful as they were before. Everyone is so pleasant and nice. The front office staff has been there for as long as I've been a patient, and that has something to say about the environment of the office. I'd recommend anyone to go there (and I'm super picky!). :-)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Diane Hanks
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have had a challenging implant procedure...Dr. Bowcutt and staff have been incredible during this process.  Last year Dr. Bowcutt replaced and old crown and it was the best crown and placement I have ever had.  The office staff is awesome and I couldn't have gone through this process without all of them.  Our whole family sees Dr. Bowcutt.  The best bedside manner of any dentist in all my life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patty Huber
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our family has been coming to this practice for YEARS and have always been very pleased.  When you walk in you'll be greeted by Mary and Debbie who are always smiling and very helpful with insurance questions and scheduling . From there you'll be put at ease by all of the staff. I usually see Sonya who's very informative and tons of fun to boot. Then you'll meet with Dr. Bowcutt to review the exam.  He will explain any questions or suggested treatments. I've referred several people to this office!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roby Roberson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist and staff, quick appointment too. Def recommended

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rebecca Powers
user_reviews_extended.Description: This dental practice infuses kindness into every aspect of care—from the moment you walk in the door you are greeted by name and your appointment starts on time! Dr. Bowcutt is an exceptional dentist, and each member of the team is professional and friendly in an unusually authentic way. Bowcutt Dental does not disappoint!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynda Decker
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient of Bowcutt Dental for about 20 years.  Like many people I hate going to the dentist but Dr Bowcutt and ALL of his staff make me very comfortable and I always leave their office feeling great about my visit.  I have referred multiple friends to their practice and they all love Bowcutt Dental just as much as I do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica O
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I've been a patient at this practice since Dr. Jordan was practicing,  about 23 years.  They are amazing at what they do! They see you as a human being, treat you with the utmost respect and care and work with your independent needs to the best of their abilities.  It doesn't get any better than this when it comes to dentistry.

If you are looking for a practice you can trust,  you've found it at Bowcutt Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob Ugiansky
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always professional, and prompt. I never have to wait past my appointment time. The staff and Dr. Jordan are super personable but all business when it comes to taking care of your teeth. I'm also amazed how often they get new lab technology, which often means it's not only more efficient - but safer for patients too, rather than relying on old outdated equipment and methods. I would highly recommend this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Christine Wilson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can highly recommend Bowcutt Dental - all of the staff are great!  It took me a long time to find a dentist and I am lucky to have found them.  The staff is pleasant and friendly and provides great service!  Great dental care and the best teeth cleaning experience I have had - very gentle!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Hawes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Bowcutt Dental is so friendly.  I had to have impressions taken and I have a very sensitive gag reflex. Jasmine was so patient with me and helped me through the whole process.  Dr Bowcutt is just as understanding and explains everything thoroughly.  I am so glad to aveh found this dentist office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: donald stotts
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Bowcutt and his entire crew, ofice and chair-side, are top notch professionals.  I and my family have benefited from his predecessors and now his dental care since the 1980's.  Many of the staff have been there since then.  I recommend them with absolutely no hesitation.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jody Kirkland
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was in pain and they worked me in right away! I could'nt be more pleased with them!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lynda Farrow
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don't know about you folks out there, but going to the dentist always scares the heck out of me....but not today. Today I went to see Dr. Bowcutt and was pleasantly surprised. He is so knowledgable and explains everything in detail so you can understand it...and so friendly you almost feel like you've known him your whole life...and his staff is just as wonderful and helpful. If you are looking for a new Dentist in the Cedar Park or surrounding area, do yourself a favour and make an appointment with Dr. Bowcutt...he is just wonderful!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: K Spain
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've never had an unpleasant experience as long as I've been coming to Bowcutt Dental! The staff at the front are exceptional at customer service and the technicians & dentist are welcoming, efficient & thorough. My adult children continue to go here when they could choose anywhere else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Hermes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Bowcutt and his staff are wonderful! They are very thorough, and efficient. Everyone is very nice and truly has the patients best interest at heart! I recently started Invisalign, and everything has gone very smoothly. I highly recommend Dr. Bowcutt and all of his staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob St John
user_reviews_extended.Description: Have had five appointments with this group.  Very happy with the professionalism, skills, facility and the empathy and care taken to make sure I have as good an experience as possible ... and this impresses me because I am a difficult patient. So, special kudos to the doctor for his sincere interest in my progress, well being, and satisfaction, and also Amy the excellent job she has done for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Gauspohl
user_reviews_extended.Description: We have been with the staff for the last 9 years. When Dr Jordan retired we remained regular patients when Dr Bowcutt came on board. We could not be happier. The atmosphere is the same, friendly,  considerate and very helpful. I would recommend to anyone.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brad Roden
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bowcutt and the amazing staff do a wonderful job taking care of my entire family.  If you or your kids are anxious about the dentist they do a great job making you comfortable.  Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: tony ledvina
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great experience from the time I show up to checking out. Everyone is very good at their job. I have been seeing Dr. Bowcutt since he started. I recommend every chance I get.

May 30th

Had to get a couple crowns put in. For a procedure that isn’t that fun to begin with they did a great job. Jazim was the assistant and did an amazing job. Just a top notch staff. Dr. Bowcutt is running a great business.

Always 5 stars!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doug Fountain
user_reviews_extended.Description: Was in need of dental work and Dr. Bowcutt was able to work me in.  Since have gone back for a cleaning (which I had been ignoring).  Both experiences were great and all work has exceeded my expectations.  Dr. Bowcutt and his staff are wonderful and would highly recommend!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was the first time I have ever enjoyed a teeth cleaning. I didn't even know that was possible. Emily was careful and kind. This was a wonderful experience. Everyone I have worked with in this office is friendly and professional. Thank you Bowcutt Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Catherine Hawes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went to Dr Bowcutt on the recommendation of a friend when I had part of a tooth break off.  I have always been anxious about going to the dentist, which is why I have been putting it off. Dr  Bowcutt and his entire staff have been amazing.  They have all helped in reducing my anxiety and have treated me with such great care and understanding.  Everything has been explained at every step, so that my anxiety was reduced and I was able to have the necessary dental work done without a problem.  I can't thank them enough for the care and attention that I have received and I really recommend them highly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessi Alexander
user_reviews_extended.Description: I really love this dentist office. I’ve got to work with Sonya who is so kind and genuine. She is very informative and both her and the doctor get to the point. They have highlighted issues with my teeth that I’ve never been highlighted before and helps me engage in preventative Practices. They make the whole ordeal simple and straightforward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Carreon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience every time I visit!  The staff is always friendly and make it fun during my visit!  Sonya has been my hygienist for many years and is awesome!  Dr. Bowcutt and his team are top notch!  I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Duane at Salty Six Homestead
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I’ve been to several dental offices where I only been there once... with either a poor hygienist with heavy hands & no bedside manner, or a dentist wanting me to personally finance his retirement in one sitting.

Bowcutt Dental is the exact opposite... with GREAT hygienists (especially Gracie) and a dentist who wants to do what’s right for the patient!  Case in point, this last year I had to get a crown, and when I went to have it put on it fit pretty good... but Dr Bowcutt wasn’t satisfied so he made another one for me that fit perfectly.

Highly recommended (well worth the $ even if you have to pay for their services “out of network”)!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: leonor lewis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just went to Bowcutt Dental for a six month check up. Emily, the Hygienist,  cleaned my teeth.proficiently and quickly.  Emily is very nice and friendly!  It's always  good to see smiling Dr. Bowcutt as he checks to make sure my teeth are good to go until next year.

Leonor Lewis ......Aug 19, 2019.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paula Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I go to Bowcutt dental because the whole staff make me feel like family.

Sonja truly cares about the health of my teeth by cleaning them thoroughly but in a gentle way.  She is extremely knowledgeable and advises me and my kids on best practices to keep them clean  between visits.

Dr Bowcutts work is impeccable and always done with a smile and appreciation.

Cedar Park is so very lucky to have a service like Bowcutt Dental in their community.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deb Lohman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been a patient of Dr. Jordan since 2011 and he was an excellent dentist with an outstanding team of very professional staff.  When Dr. Jordan decided to retire, he took great care in his selection of the next dentist to take over his practice.  He eventually chose Dr. Bowcutt who is also an excellent dentist and takes a great interest in his patient's dental care and well being.  Dr. Bowcutt is professional, has great integrity, and demonstrates the same ethical standards set by his predecessor.  The staff have stayed to be a part of Dr. Bowcutt's team which reflects a wonderful sense of familiarity, continuity, and great professional care.  I highly recommend Dr. Bowcutt as your dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Sheridan
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my teeth cleaned today by Emily Vixie. I could not be more pleased. I have worked in dentistry for 25 years and this is my favorite office for multiple reasons!!! Top to bottom and hands down~ this might be one of the only family owned and operated dental practices left on Earth, and you can feel it. 5 stars all day long. Dr. Bowcutt is on the cutting edge of technology and will make you feel like a member of this dental family. Thank you to the entire staff for an awesome, professional and painless appointment. I have been a patient for over 4 years. All of the dental hygienists are EXCELLENT!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Beckie Strnad
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wonderfully run office with such kind people that do great work!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Robertson
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am picky about my dentist and the office. To me, the overall experience is important.  Dr. Bowcutt is approachable and thorough and the staff is amazing.  I'm really comfortable there!  I highly recommend them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lara Henry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient here for years and having nothing but wonderful things to say. The staff goes above and beyond to help with insurance. And Dr. Bowcutt is a great dentist. He practices conservatively which I really appreciate because it saved me from a root canal today. If you are looking for a very friendly, helpful office with an above average dentist then look no further!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Coale
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office space is stylish and very comfortable. Staff is top notch, welcoming and friendly. The hygienist and dentist do not make you feel like they're rushing you out to get to the next patient. They are thorough and attentive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Boo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome visit today with Sonya and Dr. Bowcutt. I walked in and both Mary and Debbie were extremely nice and helpful, introduced themselves and put me at ease. Getting my teeth cleaned never felt so good! (Nice meeting Wendy during cleaning) Afterwards I met with Dr. Bowcutt to go over findings with Sonya- everything was explained in detail . It was great to be understood with what I was describing. I definitely will be referring people to this office!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lori Kolb
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I got an immediate appointment. Office staff was very courteous. My hygienist wad Erica and she was great! It was my first visit for a cleaning. I am usually a bit of a wiggler.
The staff made it very pleasant, and I was especially pleased that the staff or doctor did not try to recommend any unnecessary additional procedures!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jarod Morse
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Bowcutt sets the bar high and they deliver.  I’ve never had a better experience going to the dentist.  Everyone from the first phone call to the final procedure is amazing.  They don’t preach, oversell, or make you wait too long.

The open areas make you feel comfortable and is such a difference from being in a room by yourself looking at all the strange metal devices lined up and waiting to enter your mouth.

A+++ keep doing what you are doing and I’ll see you all in less than 6 months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Craig Toole
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had the best experience during my initial visit today. Everyone was absolutely amazing to work with. The entire staff was incredibly personable and made me feel welcomed and appreciated. Would highly recommend this practice to everyone!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ias Funderburk
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Bowcutt Dental (previously Jordan Family Dentistry) for  many years and the experience has always been very good. The staff are helpful and friendly, and I know they value my time because my appointments always run on schedule!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis McQueen
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr. Bowcutt and his staff is always positive.  They provide consistently outstanding dental care.  Me and my family are blessed and happy to be associated with them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Candy Hood
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love Amy. She is the best for me. The staff is great too. They are always very friendly  and professional. I feel like they care. They never pressure me into dental procedures.  They discuss what needs to be done and leave it up to me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cameron Corbin
user_reviews_extended.Description: EXCELLENT Customer Service!  This dental practice is AWESOME!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret Bohls
user_reviews_extended.Description: When I first started going to Dr. Bowcutt's, I was terrified of the dentist. But now, I don't mind. They not only have a gentle touch, they are warm and friendly. I hadn't been to the dentist in years. Now, I look forward to my check ups every 6 months. I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tay
user_reviews_extended.Description: My first time ever going to the dentist was when I was 21. Yes. 21. I know... This awesome staff made it the best experience by far and I could not imagine going anywhere else. They are all so educated, friendly and really care about you as a person.They always ask about your family, job, life, etc. and truly care, while doing an amazing job on your teeth. Any ways, I could write a full blog about this place. 5 star+!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Don Dempski
user_reviews_extended.Description: Always on time. Provides an excellent human service. You’re never just a number for the day.  You are always treated with the utmost respect by every staff member. Dr. Bowcutt is as personable as he is a skilled professional.  Would definitely recommend to others.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Claire Powers
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been coming to this dental practice for over 20 years, first when it was lead by Dr. Jordan and now Dr. Bowcutt. Everyone is the office is incredibly nice and helpful, and the cleanings are quick and painless! I strongly recommend this practice to anybody and everybody!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kara Dennis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bowcutt's office is great.  His staff is friendly and so knowledgeable.  I have gone to other Dentists who try to upsell you on lots of unnecessary services and products and make it sound like it is a complete necessity.  Doctor Bowcutt offers these same services where necessary but is very clear about what is a nice to have vs. what is a have to have.  I highly recommend Dr. Bowcutt and his team.  They are the greatest!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joanne Saccone
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Dr Bowcutt's office for several years before Dr Bowcutt took over the practice and I always find I am greeted with such professionalism by the staff.  The reception area is open and very inviting and the hygenists are all amazing and caring.  If there is ever an conflict issue with my appt I can feel at ease that I will be rescheduled at a time suitable for my needs.  Can't say enough about how pleased I am to be a patient.

user_reviews_extended.Name: London Beal
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr.Bowcutt was so nice and accommodating. They really helped with my dental anxiety and made me feel like a part of the family!
10/10 would recomend, they are the best!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan O'Reilly
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Bowcutt and the team provide excellent dental care with attention to detail in an aesthetically pleasing welcoming environment. The office is patient centered and efficient. I also always appreciate the great teamwork.

user_reviews_extended.Name: The Foodie Crusader
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr.Bowcutt is very good, everything else, is bad for me.  However, I don't like going to Dental offices that sell you on services, like teeth protection and stuff, and tell you are covered but then you get a bill that you can't dispute.  Don't tell me stuff is covered and I get a bill for $3k.  Nickle and dime ya, go here if ya want, but not for me and my family.   Will definitely NOT come back here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angel Aponte
user_reviews_extended.Description: Our daughter just moved to Austin, we met her here from Fla. Toothache was not on the menu!! Went to google and trusted the reviews!!! Wow!! If I could of given them 100 stars I would. Needed root canal. Dentist was caring, gentle and made a horrific experience okay!!! Thank you Dr Bowcutt and thank you to your spectacular staff!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Kincaid
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is as good as it gets for going to the dentist! They do everything but give you nitrous in the waiting area before going in to make you feel comfortable and appreciated. From greeting you by name, to taking extra time to do the procedures as carefully and painlessly as possible, to helping you with long term dental hygiene advice, this place is top shelf in every way! And this is from a person who hates going to the dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Matthew Normand
user_reviews_extended.Description: Bowcutt Dental has a wonderful staff who have excellent customer service skills. Sonya Frazer has been my hygienist for several years and always has a friendly smile on her face. She takes her time on my teeth and pays attention to detail so my teeth always turn out clean, fresh, and shiny!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah S
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Emily is an excellent hygienist. She is mediculous and gentle, making the entire experience pleasant.
All the staff at Bowcutt Dental are professional, friendly and efficient.
Great family business.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Allen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Bowcutt Dental is the best! Their staff is extremely personable and professional. Dr. Bowcutt and his staff go above and beyond to provide a personalized and comfortable experience each and every time. I look forward to my visits at Bowcutt Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Glenda Carl
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have terrible dental phobia, and everyone here is so kind and supportive that I'm not afraid to come. For me, that's a miracle! I get a pillow and a blanket and nitrous oxide even just to have my teeth cleaned. They don't scold you if you don't floss, and Dr. Bowcutt is always kind, cheerful, and reassuring. Really, it's the best experience I've ever had at any dentist, and, in fact, better than I ever dreamed possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nancy Nordyke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I immediately felt right at home, and am very thankful for the excellent dental work and friendly atmosphere.  Already, I have had some fairly serious dental episodes, and each time I was pleased with results. When I moved to the area, I was really doubtful that I could find a dental office like the one "back home".   I was really blessed to find two amazing, gracious, and very competent dentists here….to say nothing of the kind, attentive, very friendly dental staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lily Mitchell
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an amazing visit today! The hygienist was super friendly and very knowledgeable. Dr.Bowcutt was very helpful and kind as well! I would definitely recommend checking them out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anne Tisdale
user_reviews_extended.Description: We've been using this dental practice since 2010. They are first rate in every way. We have appreciated their care and support through everything. They are able to work us in when we have a broken tooth and take care of it immediately. We appreciate them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tom
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was very reluctant to go in and have a painful tooth looked at because I do not have dental insurance. It had been well over 5 years since I last visited this site. Dr. Bowcutt had taken over the office from my previous dentist.

I had a filling that had partially broken out 4 1/2 months ago. It was very painful. I had expected to have X-rays completed and to be presented a treatment plan to be started at a later date. That did not happen. My tooth had decayed to the point I needed a root canal and a cap.

I had applied for Credit Care that morning to cover the cost of the dental work and Dr. Bowcutt did all the reparative work immediately.

I am no longer in pain and I can pay my bill over time without interest provided I meet all my monthly payments.

I should have gone in earlier and not have been terrified by the cost. I am retired and my teacher pension has barely covered the rising cost of living.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bailey Kramr
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great first visit! Darlene and Emily were so sweet. They explained each step and were very thorough. Loved Dr. Bowcutt - personable and smart!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Erika A. Subieta
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great staff and patient care.  Office always runs smoothly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mel Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Most pleased with dental care and experience. Emily is the best. Professional, communicative, and gentle, and informative. Dr Bowcut is a great person and very knowledgeable and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melanie Busby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome staff with smiles and positive attitudes.   Dr.  Bowcutt is very professional and great doctor.  Office is very comfortable and home like.  Try it out-you will have a great experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sharon McNair
user_reviews_extended.Description: Going to Bowcutt dental for many years.  Staff is friendly and Dr. Bowcutt is amazing.   The staff makes going to the dentist a pleasure.  They are friendly, kind and treat every one as family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karlyn Dunn
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is so incredibly friendly and informative. My entire family has been going to them for years! Even when I moved down to San Antonio I still make the drive back up here because I trust them so much! And they have payment plans available if needed

user_reviews_extended.Name: Doug Reitmeyer

I did my cleaning, then fix the tooth and place the crown. All weren’t painful at all. And doctor described every crucial step during the appointment.
But next day when I drink my usual coffee my teeth became brown in some places. So, first I thought it's some chemicals after cleaning. I scheduled an appointment in a few days and asked the doctor and he said it's not possible and I must just changed the coffee I drink, that I didn't, it was right next morning, same coffee. In a month situation only got worse. So I went to another doctor and he confirmed that that is possible that cleaning could do that to my teeth and that there is no ways to fix it. Enamel could recover in those parts of my teeth but it's going to take time. They probably damaged top layer of my teeth with sandpaper, so only in 8 month there is only 2% of browniness left and my teeth almost normal.
And while I was at that second doctor, he also noticed that my crown isn't placed tight to my tooth. There was a big gap on one side. And that the tooth next to was damaged, most likely during the process of putting crown.
Good news, Bowcutt Dental agreed to fix a crown and tooth right next to it that they have damaged just by mistake at no cost for me.

But what if I have never went for the second opinion? In a places when I work for such mistakes - people get fired right away. So, probably this dental has very low standards. Crown cost me 3000$, so it must be responsible work.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael B
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Why would someone fly from Florida to see Dr. Kevin Bowcutt?

The reason as to why would someone fly to Austin for dental care has to do with the failure of an "award winning" dentist in Florida to diagnose a major dental issue, much less make so many mistakes trying to correct the issue.  Background: Our daughter went to her Dentist in Florida for her checkup and to examine a discolored bump in one tooth.  She was told it was fine. She flew out to visit us and we immediately saw the issue she was talking about.  We said,  “Why not check in with Dr. Bowcutt while you’re visiting?”  She called Mary in Dr. Bowcutt’s office to set up an examination for a second opinion.  Kevin examined her tooth and said immediately that he suspected root resorption. This is a very big issue left untreated. Dr. Bowcutt suggested a plan to correct the situation.  This was relayed to the Florida Dentist.

Our  daughter flew back home and her dentist  says, “Dr. Bowcutt is correct!” (How was this missed the week before?). After gum surgery and receiving a crown, which should have been a filing as suggested by Bowcutt, more issues began.  Four failed attempts over 2 months  involved the color of the crown, incorrect sizing …. It just continues…

We arranged an appointment with Dr. Bowcutt's team to correct all the mistakes.... After he inspected her teeth also found 3 small cavities that were totally missed by the Florida Dentist... She now sees Dr. Bowcutt and is very happy with the health of her teeth thanks to Dr. Bowcutt and his team.

The atmosphere in the office is very chilled out and relaxing; you always feel like family because that’s the way folks are treated.
If you ever want to find a Dental team that is thorough and gets things right the first time from patient care to corrective and cosmetic dentistry, go to Cedar Park and see Dr. Kevin Bowcutt!  They are absolutely wonderful from the front office to the back.

This is why our daughter now flies from Florida to Texas for dental health care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Z
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Practice, great staff and great Dentist. I have been to practices whose sole goal is to upcharge and drain as much money as possible. I didnt get that impression from Dr Bowcutt. It starts with the front desk staff who answer all the questions that you have. If they cant they find the answer. They want to make sure you have a good experience from start to finish. I met everyone who is assigned to my treatment team. All are well qualified and empathetic. Dr Bowcutt is knowledgeable, experienced and has that confidence you want in your dentist. I felt that all of the interventions such as xrays and photos were  useful and were utilized to develop and further my understanding of my condition and the plan that was taking shape. There is a rationale and reason that makes sense. The hygienist and the assistant were fully vested in my care and my overall health within thier scope of practice. Even their swag bag is impressive. Go see Dr Bowcutt and his team, you will not be dissapointed.

user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly and comfortable atmosphere. Received a thorough cleaning of my teeth by Christy. When Dr. Bowcutt came in, we talked over one issue that he noticed on the x-rays and by actually inspecting my teeth. No pressure from him as to whether or when it should be dealt with. Pleasant change from other dental offices I have been to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bob Stjohn
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been going to Bowcutt Dental for several years. Clearly i am satisfied or i would not repeat. But I am more than satisfied. I sm  delighted with the skills, professionalism, judgement, and focus (because I AM the focus) of Dr. Bowcutt, the staff both cle rical and dental personnel. My health and situation, priorities, and so forth, are taken into consideration by everyone regarding everything. nothing happens until everything has been explained, discussed, and i have decided how i want things prioritized and executed. this is true of exams,  simple procedures, complex procedures, and work which may involve significant time and expense. I always feel we are all on board with what is best for me.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allie Alomari
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Absolutely amazing staff! They are absolutely the best!

I am absolutely terrified of the dentist. I didn’t go for years because of how terrified I am from them. I called Dr Bowcutt’s office and asked if they can help me and told them how terrified I was. From the minute I got on the phone with them they brought my anxiety down. They brought me in for a consultation and set up a plan to get my teeth healthy again!! I HAVE NOTHING BUT AMAZING THINGS TO SAY! I AM SO THANKFUL FOR ALL THERE SUPPORT AND CARING AMAZING STAFF!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis Clapp
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been coming for over ten years now.  A great dental office and love the staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aron Kloesel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Timely, smooth process. Accurate. Friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Yuki Snedaker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr.Bowcutt and every staff there are awesome, kind and professional!! Highly recommend😊
技術もさることながら英語が拙いわたしにも優しく親身に対応してくれます。今まで行った歯医者さんの中でダントツ1位でオススメ！

title: Ideal Dental Cedar Park
address: 1201 N Bell Blvd UNIT 102, Cedar Park, TX 78613, United States

user_reviews.Name: The Sterlings
user_reviews.Description: Going to the dentist is never fun. However, everyone at Ideal Dental made it better.  The receptionist is extremely polite and kind. She keeps her promise on callbacks, and she does her best to fit my schedule.  She is a fantastic first contact with excellent customer service.  Both the dentist and the dental assistant were extremely polite. They made sure I was comfortable through the procedure, and explained everything as they were doing. And I've had no issues with the work that has been done. I highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Camille Mayers
user_reviews.Description: I had a wonderful experience at ideal dental! Dr. Lauren Conway is kind, knowledgeable, and seems to actually care about her patients. I was really nervous as I hadn’t been to the dentist in over 10 years and she didn’t make me feel bad about it at all and was very welcoming. Everyone else I met in the office were really nice as well and seemed to be enjoying their job. They were extremely transparent about pricing as well and let me know the pricing and insurance coverage on everything before proceeding with any of the work. The office is clean and comfortable. Most importantly, my teeth look great and I left with more confidence and knowledge on how to take care of them. I’m excited to come back instead of dreading the dentist. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Donna Cagle
user_reviews.Description: The hygienist and front desk are extremely helpful.  The dentist, Dr. Conway was thorough and knowledgeable. My only complaint is that she was a bit rough and aggressive with the cleaning and my mouth is stll sensitive 2 days later.

user_reviews.Name: Evelin Cabot
user_reviews.Description: Ideal Dental is the best Dentist in Cedar Park. I always feel welcome. The staff is nice and very professional. They have been my family dentist for over 10 years.

user_reviews.Name: Donna Garza
user_reviews.Description:
My husband and I have been going to Ideal Dental for three years and have never had any complaints from their dentist. However, they recently hired a new dentist and she was extremely pushy. She told my husband and me that we both needed deep cleaning and follow-up visits every three months.
She wouldn't do a regular cleaning because she insisted our gums were too badly infected. I have never been so insulted by a dentist. We will definitely NOT be returning.

user_reviews.Name: Richard Clark
user_reviews.Description: Very careful, thoughtful, and complete evaluation. The hygienist does all the questions/answers, X-rays, and polishing, and the dentist spends a lot of time documenting your mouth, and then comes back after the polishing to do some cleaning, with cavatron and hand tools. Mouth felt clean and fresh!

user_reviews.Name: Cassandra Hansen
user_reviews.Description: Was very happy with this place. Everyone was very nice and welcoming. From what I could tell, all women staff (unless males were off that day), which is nice to know if you ever have to be knocked out.....ya know...

user_reviews.Name: joey andruzzi
user_reviews.Description: The people are tremendously friendly! They make you feel comfortable and explain everything they plan to do. I can’t say enough about Ideal dental. I’m just very happy l found an awesome Dentist and friendly staff.❤️🔥🙏🤠🐾🏑🦷😁
