user_reviews_extended.Name: Bhavdeep Singh
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an awesome experience as a first-time patient here. All the staff including the doctor, dental assistant, and the receptionist were very professional and prompt. Ideal Dental took care of some really painful dental issues for me including deep cleaning, periodontal treatment, and fillings and made my dental health better almost instantly. I would recommend them fiery highly based on my experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Cicone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! Dr Conway was kind and worked quickly, always making sure I was comfortable. The entire team was very friendly and professional

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kiya Foster
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first dental appointment on my own without my mom! I booked my appointment online the staff was very professional Dani my assistant was very funny and sweet! Gigi called my insurance and made sure everything was covered with my insurance. Thank you to the doctor as well! ♥️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Chapdelaine
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service very friendly and quick. Made me feel very comfortable and the work was great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Olivia Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went for my check up and cleaning it’s been a while since my last appointment. The lobby is different than the picture shows. Gg said they are in the process of remodeling can’t wait to see the new look! Everybody is nice and friendly, the Dr is very knowledgeable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Longfellow
user_reviews_extended.Description: All staff were very friendly, the establishment was very clean, and I was able to be seen the same day I called. Ideal Dental was great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Imani
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was one of the best experiences I've had at the dentist  everyone was super  welcoming but it was Gigi that really made me comfortable answering  all my questions and just her very kind demeanor on the phone and in person 10/10 would recommended! She was able to get me in same day and they were able to come up with a plan to fix my problems

user_reviews_extended.Name: Irek Witek
user_reviews_extended.Description: Super professional facility. The staff is extremely pleasant. The care provided is high tech and thorough.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isabella Figueroa
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place is a money grab.

I normally never leave reviews but I was scrolling through the reviews and noticed a person named Michael Q had the exact same experience as me.

First off I want to say despite my experience, everyone at the office was very welcoming and nice to me.

I walked in to this appointment expecting an exam and a clean. After what felt like an hour, I was told that the exams were done. The doctor took one quick look at my gums and told me I needed a deep cleaning done because my gums were inflamed and they want to prevent any further damage. Prior to the exams, I disclosed to them that I hadn’t been to the dentist in 5 years. Despite this, I know my teeth were still in very good condition. They took advantage of this and recommended the deep cleaning to take my money. Once they told me it was going to be over $300 to get this done I knew I was never going back.

I booked an appointment at Walden Dental and they confirmed that my teeth and gums were healthy and that a deep cleaning was not necessary at all.

It’s really disappointing that I wasted my time there just to be told that they wouldn’t even do the cleaning and that I would need to come back 2 more separate times and pay hundreds of dollars.

I highly recommend Walden Dental. Do not go to Ideal Dental.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Page
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is very friendly and thorough.  They know they are doing for sure, lol. I would go more often if I were rich. Lol.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emma Putnam
user_reviews_extended.Description: I received amazing service here. Everyone was so friendly and attentive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: h t
user_reviews_extended.Description: The clinic office is clean and bright. Both dentists and clerk are nice and friendly. I am very happy for my first visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Derek Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been a patient at this dental practice for a few years and am pleased to note that they have recently added Dr. Lauren Conway to their team, who is truly exceptional. Dr. Conway exhibits a high level of professionalism, thoroughness, and possesses a calming demeanor. I highly recommend and will continue driving in from Llano County for my dental needs!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Deborah Liles-Shelby
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a tooth that had bothered me. Ideal was quick and friendly. Had an appointment the next day . The tooth I thought was giving me problems turned out to not be the tooth but I chose to have both extracted. Both teeth were removed and it has now been over 24 hours and it was easy and comfortable afterwards. I would highly recommend. Everyone was wonderful and concerned for my comfort.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kathy Lanfer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Staff was reasonable. I had to wait 25 minutes to be taken to a dental chair and finally stood just outside the front door to try and warm up. The office temperature was COLD and I had to ask for two blankets to try not to shiver. Had one filling done and she said we could wait 5 minutes to do the other side. I waited 35 min. for her to return to finish. The guy in the next bay brought his pet and talked to the dog the entire time. This was not an emotional support animal. I found it unsanitary to let the dog run around the patient area. Gross and inconsiderate. For an exam and two fillings it took three hours and fifteen minutes.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alisa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a great experience at my last dental cleaning. First time with Dr. Shyani and all went well, she was very friendly and thorough. I also want to shout out Destiny!!! Absolutely love her positivity and she made sure I was comfortable the entire time. Lastly, thanks to Gigi for checking me out and for getting me up to date on appointments.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Peach R
user_reviews_extended.Description: Left sitting here waiting for over an hour, numbing is wearing off still haven’t received any service. This is distressing for a patient with a phobia of the dentist as is and I know I heard your staff talking and doing nothing not even checking in. Unprofessionalism at its finest. We will be checking with our insurance to swap businesses if possible. Disgusting.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshua Flores
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I went here for the first time to get a X-rays and teeth cleaning. They did a horrible job at cleaning compared to other dentists I’ve been to. They also said I had three cavities and overall six fillings that needed to take place.

I didn’t feel right about it, so I decided to go to another dentist who did scans and said I had no cavities and no fillings needed. They also cleaned my teeth as they should.

Seems like Ideal dentist are just trying to lie and get as much money as they can out of you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darwin Oviedo
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm giving one star because the system doesn't allow zero stars. This place definitely treats patients like just another number. The service is terrible. They make excuses just to get money from you. They give you the prescription, and when you get to the pharmacy to get the medicine, they tell you they can't sell it to you because the doctor's signature is missing. Run away from here. They don't care about you as a patient; they just want your money.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Aurora Rosewood
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Corporate dental chain money grab. I first went to a different Ideal Dental location, which I liked overall but they told me a deep cleaning of my gums was needed, so there was an upsell/extra charge there. The dentist there also noted a slight overlap in my bottom teeth and wanted to sell me on Invisalign (I already have and wear a retainer). I informed her that I had braces as a kid/teen and am not interested in any more orthodontics, nor does it bother me in any way. Dentists prior to this had NEVER mentioned it to me before. After informing her of that, I expected it to be noted in my file and not brought up again. At this location, however, the dentist noted it again and once again recommended (attempted to upsell) Invisalign. I was not happy. At the dentist office that I moved to after deciding I was done with Ideal Dental period, the dentist told me it was not a concern at all.

They also offered a further upsell of an oral cancer check, which I’m annoyed that I took them up on. Again, something like that had never happened at other dentist’s offices I’d been to. I also just didn’t get a good vibe from this place period and wanted to leave almost as soon as I got there, even though the staff seemed nice (just obviously corporate has instructed them to upsell, upsell, upsell). I do not recommend any location of Ideal Dental (formerly Brush32) and suggest that anyone reading this finds a less corporate dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Henrickson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Wow out of all the orthodontist I have been to thru the years this is by far the worst ever. They treat you like a number rather than an important patient.  Very inconvenient no one is ever available for ortho care. Then if something happens to your braces they don't have anyone trained to help. They tell you to wait. Not even offer to schedule you at another clinic. Horrible service.  I wish I would of never taken my son here. So dissatisfied. I would never recommend it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Subramanya Raju
user_reviews_extended.Description: The online check-in process at Ideal Dental was frustrating, requiring repeated entries of personal details. When I expressed my dissatisfaction, the receptionist was rude in stating that It doesn’t matter I have to still fill all the forms. I didn’t like it , then in a calm tone, I said that I might have to take my business elsewhere due to the inefficiency, the receptionist rudely replied, "You should." We were so taken aback by her response that we just walked away. Very disappointing experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michael Q
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Useless.
I went here thanks to my insurance. It was a waste of time. To be fair, the staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. The dentist had some good advice and explanations I had not received before.

But it was all a waste of time. I called for a last minute cleaning. They got me in. But after I spent 1+ hours there, they recommended a deep cleaning for several hundred dollars for "early peridontal issues." They got me in so quickly just to try to take my money through other procedures.

Went to Walden Dental on Lakeline. Same day, same cleaning. Even out of network, I will go there over here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: LadyScorpio Demus
user_reviews_extended.Description: My kids have been going here for years. I had to change dentist, so I gave Ideal a try. Great Great experience. From scheduling the appointments. Front desk were awesome (Sara) made my appointments talk to me explained everything went over insurance and prices very pleasant. Dr. Emma very nice talked to me explained and got my cleaning done. Most of the hygienist(James) was super comforting very detailed explained as he went along made me super comfortable I hate going to the dentist and he made it a very  peaceful comforting experience. Definitely a great experience and will be here for now on. THANK YOU ALL.....See you all Friday for my 3 kids appointments all in one day AWESOME!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Roman Pena
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at this dental office was wonderful in how they handled my appointment and teeth cleaning. Nadine was so helpful and highly knowledgeable in the overall operation and order of things. She got me checked in and taken to the dental chair in no time! The doctor and back staff were super friendly and helpful, answering all my questions and also addressing my concerns about the past dental work I’d had. Dr. Parekh was very thorough throughout my cleaning. I highly recommend setting up your next dental appointment at this office. I will definitely be back for another appointment in a few months!

user_reviews_extended.Name: D'Ashley Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description: The facility is delightful, featuring a pleasant atmosphere that is exceptionally clean and secure. I would like to extend my gratitude to Genia for her warm and kind welcome. I highly recommend this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Parker _
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience at Ideal Dental was that of a Gladiator or Knight most decorated. From the moment of my arrival, I was greeted with the utmost excellent hospitality. The price I paid in comparison to the service I received was fantastic. If you are on a budget or do not have insurance, I recommend this place wholeheartedly. I will be returning soon.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Enrique Haro Marquez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience. The staff was very kind and was very quick. I had a procedure done that was supposed to take over three hours and left after just two. Will go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: dominique hanson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
i If you’re looking for the perfect dentist to go to, look no further than Brush32! I started my treatment in Cedar Park a few months back and returned a separate time, only to receive great service yet again.

Their staff is friendly, genuine, knowledgeable and transparent and it makes all the difference. This is definitely a place that you can trust. With many great options to ensure the customer is taken care of in the easiest, most financial way, Brush32 is the perfect place to go. As a young college student working two jobs, I’m sure many people can be thankful for a place like this. Thanks again for the outstanding service ❤️

user_reviews_extended.Name: Don Atkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is very unprofessional. Equipment is undependable and had to change rooms due to equipment not working. I had a root canal that I’m not sure was needed and the crown wasn’t installed to fit my partial which made the partial not fit any longer. I went to another dentist that made a new partial that fits. I was generous with the two stars because effort was made to correct the fit even though that wasn’t successful. I would recommend anyone going there to get a second opinion before having any work done. It might save you un necessary expenses and get a better result.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Gjovik Perkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: I like this dentist office. I've always got ahold of someone when I call, and they always have options for my appointments that do not mess with my work schedule too much. They've always been up front and so far, haven't had any surprise bills. The staff has consistently been friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My last visit to this office was not the best. I’m not sure if the woman who led me back was a dental assistant or hygienist, but it was clear she was very very new. She didn’t really know why I was there, almost performed an Xray I didn’t need, didn’t know how to use a handheld xray machine, and was awkward with other tools like the polisher, water, and suction. There were others around her who helped and guided her at times, but it would have been helpful to have someone talk to me before the appointment so I’d be aware, or at least have a supervisor with her through the whole appointment. I think it would have brought me comfort as well as the dental assistant/hygienist. I don’t mind helping others to learn, but I prefer a heads up maybe even a choice.

The dentist performed the cleaning and was knowledgeable, kind and welcoming. However, she was a sub from another office.

This is nit-picky, but the cushions in the waiting room were not as clean as I’d seen in other dental offices.

I hate to leave bad reviews, but hoping this feedback will be constructive to the future of this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Leisy
user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the best offices around! I had such a different perception of larger companies until I actually came in for a cleaning. The staff is warm and welcoming. They never make it feel like business, but more of a memorable time. The team all strive to provide the best care and are clearly succeeding at it. I’m some one who is terrified on needles and or doctors, but this place was a piece of cake. It’s always a good time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savana Autrey-Hjort
user_reviews_extended.Description: My husband was so fearful of going back to the dentist after a long period of time, but the staff was so warm and welcoming which made his experience so much better! As for me, I would come here for regular cleanings when it was Brush32 but then moved out of town. So glad to be back in this area and call this my dentist office again! Thanks so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Anna Wolf
user_reviews_extended.Description: They always greet me with a smile and I feel appreciated as a patient. They always answer all my questions and they are happy to answer them all - no impatience and feeling like I am wasting their time. I never feel rushed through the appointment either and each visit is a great one. The dentists are all great and so are the technicians. This is a really great place to get your teeth cleaned and they will take great care of you! 😁👍

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gene Kinde
user_reviews_extended.Description: Been a while since I've been.  Complete staff and Dentist change.  Very polite, professional and pleasant.  More work to come, stay tuned.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kitty Cat
user_reviews_extended.Description: My goodness! I was referred to Ideal Dental by a friend for braces.  But the way that they were so kind and welcoming, made me change all of my dental work to this location.  After having a less than friendly experience at the dentist near my home, my experience here so far has been so refreshing. :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: MaKesha L Curry
user_reviews_extended.Description: What a lovely team! A beautiful office  very kind staff, and several options,  both financially and days for services.  My family and I are looking forward to a great relationship.  Thanks again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savannah Cameron
user_reviews_extended.Description: First time there and very impressed. Facility was superclean, everyone says hi to you, very welcoming! They explained everything to my daughter and i to help us understand things and cover information thats important in a very easy way. Loved the staff, the sweet lady at the front desk was extremely nice and was fast and on top of giving information and booking appointments. The doctor and the rest of the team were very nice and amazing. Tons of smiles under the mask 😷 They made us feel really comfortable. They should get 6 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

user_reviews_extended.Name: Protein Kinase
user_reviews_extended.Description:
ALL OF THEIR BAD reviews are being REMOVED!! I looked at this offices reviews about 7 days ago, and all of the newest reviews were saying that their credit cards are being charged with fraudulent charges, over and over again. Multiple people said they are being charged thousands of dollars after not visiting the office for years. I have horrible experience with this company in another location doing the same thing as well.

Ever since this place switched from Brush32 to Ideal Dental, it’s gone downhill. I thought I had found a great dentist in Cedar Park. I don’t know what happened to them but I advise you to STAY away. Do not give these crooks any more money

user_reviews_extended.Name: matthew sommers
user_reviews_extended.Description: Went in to have my teeth checked out having not been to a dentist since a child. Everyone was super friendly and helpful. After the initial checkout and x-rays the dentist came in to go over the work needed. She was super friendly and descriptive of all the work and why it was needed. She also made sure throughout our conversation that I didn't have any questions. I would recommend anyone to come here and have work done.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alex Bennett
user_reviews_extended.Description:
A truly excellent dentist’s office! Very kind and friendly staff, but there’s one hygienist who stands out in particular. James literally cleans your teeth better and more gently than anyone else I’ve ever seen, to the point where my wife and I honestly don’t want anyone else to clean our teeth. He explains every step of the process as it happens, he lets you know when you can close your mouth a bit to prevent strain, and he even adjusts the seat height throughout the cleaning to get every spot from the best angle possible. He also doesn’t ask you questions you can’t answer because hands are in your mouth.

Seriously, he’s so good he makes you wonder why you were ever okay with any other dental hygienist. He is clearly a master at his craft.

user_reviews_extended.Name: being honest here!
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My experience was amazing they were all very welcoming and had amazing service/attitude!
My hygienist, James was amazing! I was very nervous but he made me feel comfortable and as he was working on my teeth he was updating me throughout the process His work was above and beyond. Overall I highly recommend this place! 🤩

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shantiel Gipson
user_reviews_extended.Description: Transferred from the Round Rock location and honestly I’m so happy I did cause the people here are awesome!!! I forgot the name of the woman who cleaned my teeth, (I will update when I find out) but she was great and was actually providing me with lots of useful information that I wish I would’ve known a long time ago.. Dr. Kondoff was an absolute gem!! She’s so bright and friendly and just heart warming she makes you feel so comfortable and welcome. The ladies at the front desk were great too. Keep it up guys!! You don’t get service like this anywhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Belinda Hargrave
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Ideal Dental have been going there for years.  They have always  been very  professional  and never have to wait. The staff are AWESOME  and my Lead Dental  Assistant  Beatrice  did such a Great  Job....Thanks once again  Ideal for a job well done!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cathryn Cole
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Typical “corporate type” facility. Really liked the dentist. Hygienist had “technical” issues with keeping the polisher going, so don’t feel that my cleaning was as good as I have received at other dental offices.
Ideal Dental is part of my dental plan and “in network”. It’s a “good enough place” if you need a “go to facility”.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Harsh Shah
user_reviews_extended.Description: I would have given 0 stars if it was possible. They automatically make 6 month appointments without even asking you and send you email to confirm appointments. They seem desperate to get appointments even at the end of the year. They could not find insurance info for my wife so left a voicemail to reschedule and then started forcing her that my son and she had to come in some other time same day otherwise they will charge same-day cancellation fee. They wasted 1 hour of our time in the morning on back and forth - I should be charging them for that. People (Jennifer and Sarah) who call to make/verify appointments are rude and unprofessional. Reviews on Yelp seems more real and talk about their horrible scheduling experience. Nothing to say about the dentists but if your front office doesn't know how to work with clients, dentists don't matter - there are plenty good ones around. Needless to say I am never calling them again and you should also save your time and energy and look elsewhere.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nat Mazon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was skeptical at 1 st like any new place. I had cavity and they fit me in same day.
I never expected that ! but im so glad I started feel hopeful about my situation and mouth issuse. I  wouldn't be able wait much longer to fix , or coulda wrosen ,I love options and payment plans without those I wouldn't of been able fix my teeth

only complain  is the whole process  toke almost 4 hours i wish they would engaged  better on one person at time instead hoping around  toke most my
whole  work day away

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Perez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had really bad tooth ach. I found Brush32 close to where I live and open on Saturdays. When I scheduled my appointment they were very helpful and friendly. When I went in the next day I saw Dr. Dang, she is so nice and awesome. She examined me and stated I needed a Root Canal and a Crown. She was booked for the rest of the day but, she still did my procedure, I didn't mind if it had taken all day I understood that she was very busy. She was also considerate about my feelings and pain. She asked if I minded if she went back forth with me and other patients she had to see. I did not mind at all. The procedure really did not take too long even though she was back and forth. I love the atmosphere of the facility and the staff, I will continue to go back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cristin Ray
user_reviews_extended.Description: I've been going to Brush32 for a couple of years now and have always had a wonderful experience.  The staff is super helpful, friendly, and caring.  I like Brush32 so much that I take both my children to get their teeth cleaned here and have also referred my husband and both my parents.  Brush32 is awesome. Keep up the good work guys!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Karen Davia
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I am new to Austin (moved here in March 2020) and this is a really friendly dentist office. There was a small hiccup with my first appointment; I received a call and set the appointment, but then when I called back because I didn’t receive confirmation, they said they had no record of my appointment. I had taken off that morning for work, so that was quite frustrating. Despite that, the staff is very welcoming, and I liked how the dentist really took the time to explain what my options are for my treatment. The only disappointment is that I have to wait (3) business days for my treatment plan to be emailed to me. They did call me to give me an update, which I appreciate, but I would have preferred to get it the same day or next business day at the latest.
I plan to keep them as my dentist office and I would still recommend them to anyone who is looking for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first visit to Brush 32 in Cedar Park and by far, the best dental experience I've ever had.  The staff were great, especially John Singleton, the dental assistant.  He was very nice, professional, and considerate.  Dr. Geoff Mateo was awesome!  He fixed a previous filling from a different dentist and gave me two new ones.  I never felt any pain or discomfort.  I had my x-rays, exam, cleaning and fillings done in under 2 hours!  This is my new dentist in Cedar Park.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gyanesh Sharma
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Never had any issue with the actual treatment me or my family received with this location. However I am rating 2* mainly for the following 2 reasons:
1. They failed to get pre-auth for Invisalign from my insurance and after 1 year, I was told I own them extra $2000 after I had already paid $4500. We didn't have any emergency situation here. We could easily have waited a month or two if needed. Throughout the treatment, I was told that $4500 was the only amount we would ever pay and we had paid that in advance.
2. After having my insurance updated in Jan 2023, I was told my insurance has been "verified". After this, I got some dental exam and cleaning and also I was recommended to get a crown on one of my teeth. I rushed to get the crown-work done and currently I am waiting for the permanent crown to arrive. Then again, I was told this morning that, the information I had been given that my insurance had been verified was incorrect and now I am responsible for all the expenses for the new crown that I am yet to receive. They reminded me that if I failed to make the payment, I would get reported to the collection agency. Thankfully they said they are not going to charge me extra for the cleaning and x-ray that was done in my first visit.
While I really appreciate the quality of work and service I received at this facility, the handling of insurance and billing was really poor and you could be held accountable for a lot more than what you are initially told that you will have to pay.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This is the most unethical dental office EVER! They asked me to take my review down below because I told the truth.  Who does that?! Then sent me a nasty email afterward saying I can no longer see the dentist.  Jennifer is unprofessional and so is the assistant I tried to console. 👇🏾My last review.

Love the dentists! Every dentist I have seen at this location has been efficient.  I feel really bad for the staff that are forced to work on weekends though.  The dental assistant told me multiple times, ‘I just want to go home,’ and ‘I just want to get out of here.’  I gave her resources to an assessment called the STRONG so she can take to find her passion and dream job because saying this to patients is extremely unprofessional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Droppin_sik_Beats
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is amazing!Very impressed and I feel a little better about going to the dentist knowing how much they care. Beatrice is absolutely amazing. She is so friendly and caring. Thanks for all you do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cody Redfern
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely fantastic! Everybody was very patient and supportive of me and it felt like they truly wanted what was best for me. They understood my concerns, and did everything they could to make me feel comfortable and at ease. I will definitely be going back regularly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jim Jenkins
user_reviews_extended.Description: our family has known and been with Dr. Stella Caballero and her wonderful staff since 1994. I had some major work done that brought me into see her and she made us feel at ease with the work I needed done.  Our children grew up with her as their 1st dentist at ages 2 years old. we are so pleased with everyone at Brush 32 Dental. we as a family enjoy the ease of appointment making & scheduling. we also look forward to cleanings and check-ups! as my wife says, it's like going to the Beauty shop and getting made beautiful! the staff makes you feel like family and is always willing to help with insurance questions and educate us on new things happening in the dental field. Thank you Brush 32! sincerely, The Jenkins family

user_reviews_extended.Name: Whitney Etchison
user_reviews_extended.Description: The facility was clean and  the staff was nice. I really appreciated Genia working with me as it took me time to finally commit. I would definitely recommend the location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michelle Zamora
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everybody was so kind. Made me feel at home from start to finish. I never felt judged or anxious about any of the things we spoke about. I felt like they genuinely cared and am happy to continue my care here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nikki brickner
user_reviews_extended.Description: the experience here was more than excellent! right away i was greeted and help at the front desk,and there was hardly a wait. everything was nice and neat,clean and the staff was friendly. everyone here made me feel very comfortable and relaxed. i recommend this dental office to all my family and friends.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Shearer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Love Dr. Parekh. I have a nerve condition in my face and she has been so accommodating. The staff is wonderful and always quick. I will stay with this group as long as possible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tweet Fancy
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have remained an ongoing patient with this practice primarily because of James Cho, the hygienist!  He is professional, honest, incredibly skilled, and very pleasant.  He communicates throughout the process and most importantly, cleanings are quick and painless!
I met Dr Zahawi today and I was very impressed with him as well.   I look forward to continued great care from this team and I highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carrie Page
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love all of the staff! Everyone is super professional, informative, kind, and easy to work with. I've been using this dentist for over 2 years and there's nowhere else I'd rather go for my dental work.  When getting a crown is virtually painless, that's skill and expertise! Thank you all for your awesome work and attention to detail.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scotty Noble
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had a lot of dental work due to various mishaps and generally have rarely if ever had a pleasant experience. Well that changed today. Went in with severe pain thinking my crown was loose as I had no swelling. Got there and it was found I had an abscess which immediately rolled into a root canal. Joy… I’m bad with names but everyone in the place were delightful to say the least! Also, the dentist was a rock star dealing with all my neck and jaw issues. Completed the work without a single nick!!! Then after the facts hey had trouble with my pharmacy. However Sara called multiple times, left messages and finally got me my prescriptions. She also called back to check on me to insure the pharmacy got the correct information. This all around was an excellent experience! Thank you all.

user_reviews_extended.Name: L P-Rez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly, courteous, and professional staff. Tara, at the front desk, was so helpful. The doctor, dental hygienist, and dental assistant helped me, knowing my intense anxiety of the dentist office. They were kind. They used humor. They were patient. I felt safe because of the respectful and kind way I was treated. The visit was intense as I need two fillings, a root canal, and a crown. They walked me through the entire process, both medical and financial. For the amount of work I had done, it was affordable. I have found my new, local and regular dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Daniel Doc Leisy
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was wonderful and billing was well explained in advance.  Feel like the wirk was excellent.  Sarah in front perfect.  Dr Dang the best.  Claudia was very sweet efficient and did great. THIS IS AN AWESOME OFFICE.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Pilar Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: My daughter went here and they attended us super quickly and amazingly! Such nice staff! Thank you so much!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Andrea Taylor
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and doctor are absolutely wonderful. Very friendly and thorough. I especially like that they have Saturday appointments and everything is easy to book online. All around a great place and I’m happy I found it as I just recently moved to the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Vela
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I HATE GOING TO THE DENTISTS......BUT NOT THIS ONE. I HAVE HAD ONE OF THE BEST EXPERIENCES EVER FOR JUST A SIMPLE TEETH CLEANING......
The hygienist, James Cho, did exactly as he promised, I have SUPER ANXIETY due to past experiences, but James is a teeth angel. That's no lie! He not only comforted me, he said "you should always feel like it is a spa day when you get your teeth cleaned".....I didn't sweat, clinch or freak out as I normally would.
JAMES IS AMAZING! BEST DENTAL PLACE I HAVE EVER FOUND!!!

The staff is awesome and welcoming and they play great music louder than others places..... and I LOVE IT! FUN PLACE!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Girisha Pillai
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This review is for the Brush32 @N Bell Blvd location.
I typically NEVER leave a bad review for anyone but this is one of the worst experiences I have ever had.
The front staff Manager Sarah has been very unprofessional and rude.  Lies Lies Lies!!!!! She would just lie straight on your face just to hide her mistakes. Every time I spoke to her about my payment questions, I always felt hurried and never given proper response. She expects the patients just to pay whatever number she shows you on the paper without even asking a question about it. When I once asked her about $ from my estimate, she literally gave me an outdated piece of paper and told me to refer it by myself. She claims herself that she is busy enough that she can't spend a minute for any question. I wonder why being in the front desk when one cannot answer a valid question.  My payment plan ran past the scheduled time. When asked about it, she simply told that she had no idea why it happened. No apology or nothing. She wouldn't even let you to talk, simply raises her voice and treats very low of any patients. I had multiple instances where in I felt very discriminated. I am not sure if she did this to me due to any racial differences or she is plain rude to everybody. It boggles my mind that one could continuously mistreat a customer in this 21st century where customer service is hailed so high. I regret the decision to go with Brush32 leaving out from my regular dentist.

They are all about money. Right at the first appointment, they gave me an estimate for multiple procedures. I decided to go with the treatment plan based on their estimate but they kept changing it and finally I ended paying more than I expected. They tend to hike up their estimates so extra money is always laying at their end.  Even after my insurance overpaid for my procedure, I had to remind them through multiple calls just to get my balance corrected. When it comes to payment from the customer, they charge it on point (in my case they even let my payment plan run past the schedule time) but when it comes to refunds, they say that it is not in their control and always points at other departments for it to be reviewed. I have been waiting for months to get my refund.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Pope
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dental office staffed with people who truly love their job! The front desk is welcoming and they get you settled in for your appointment in a timely manner.  The assistant and hygienist were extremely knowledgeable about my procedure and walked me through every step.  Dr. Kondoff is fantastic! She was friendly and extremely caring when working on my teeth.  Dr. Kondoff certainly knows her stuff!  Great Dentist and great staff made for a very pleasant dental appointment!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jill Salinas
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Had an emergency, and as a new patient not only were they able to do a walk in consultation with a short wait, but I was also able to get a same day appointment too. Staff was beyond great, everyone was genuinely nice and caring, really helping ease my anxiety. Dr. Mateo did a great job and made sure to explain everything. Thank you!

Edit 1/2020: Just wanted to give a shout-out to Huda, she was super friendly and really helped calm my anxiety before some extractions. Dr. Dudeen was also great during the procedure and made sure that I was comfortable, but also made it quick and painless. While it's at first daunting having new staff, they've done a great job at making my experiences positive. One last note, Bertha is the sweetest and always makes sure to say hello when I'm in.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Angelina Reiter
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been going to Ideal Dental for a while now and have always had an amazing experience. Everyone is so kind and cheerful! Anytime I have a questions it’s always answered respectfully. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Asia Askew
user_reviews_extended.Description: Just had my first appointment with Ideal Dental at Cedar Park. The staff was super friendly and made me feel comfortable the entire time. Prices were discussed beforehand and made very clear. I definitely recommend them as your local dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Michayla Wallace
user_reviews_extended.Description: WORST experience ever. I have had tooth pain for the last month and decided to go to Ideal today. My relative works there and recommend them, so I decided to go in. I was a little embarrassed to go because it’s been a while since I’ve been to the dentist but I needed help. I started by getting scans done with the assistant, Kathy (whom of which is the ONLY reason this review has one star because she was amazing). Dr. Zahawi came in after the scans to let me know of cavities needing to be filled along with a few other things and stated that he could fill them and clean my teeth today as well. Kathy got everything together to get started, applied a numbing gel and went to grab the dentist. After sitting for 15 minutes, the assistant came back in to let me know the dentist was refusing to treat me. I’m not sure if it was because of the relationship I have with another staff member but I am sure that it was VERY unprofessional. I have never left anywhere feeling so low about myself and embarrassed. Dr. Zahawi didn’t even have the professionalism to tell me himself that he was refusing to help me, EVEN AFTER he had told me previously he would. I don’t know what happened in those 15 minutes he left me sitting and waiting. I had to leave with my mouth numb, no cleaning, and no fillings… completely uncalled for and still in pain. I highly recommend you do not see Dr. Zahawi for any kind of dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cecile Hampton Clark
user_reviews_extended.Description: It was a wonderful experience. All staffs were very helpful. My hygienist James is amazing. He made my day by giving me a nice and clean smile today! Thank you James and thank you Brush32 of Cedar Park.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sue Kunz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great facility from the reception to the hygienist to X-ray  to the doctor! Top notch all staff and processes! Safe and clean! Free whitening on each cleaning! Customer service is exceptional! And, they don’t recommend treatments you don’t need. Customer for life!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Veronica Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Sarah at the front desk is pleasant. Check in and out is smooth.
I was called back by Sylvia- I’m guessing a dental assistant. Sylvia is absolutely lovely. We instantly had a conversation going. I don’t have much time left at this dental clinic and I’m glad that I got to meet her at todays visit. The dentist is also fabulous and will be missed.
Todays visit is 5 stars because of Sylvia.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dashonna Leal
user_reviews_extended.Description: Entire staff was super nice and personable! It’s very rare to find good customer service.... from scheduling to front office checkin to the X-ray tech and dental assistant ...to the doctor ... everyone was super friendly and helpful. Loved my experience! Thanks ladies keep it up!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Garcia
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone there was SO nice and down to earth. This goes from the front desk, to the technician, the dentist and the hygienist. I felt so welcome and at ease. No pressure from anyone and everything was laid out and explained to me. Just found my new dentist! Thank you ladies for making it such a pleasant visit!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Clarke
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am terrified of the dentist. So much so, I haven't been in 10 years. The entire staff here put me at ease, understood my anxieties, and made sure I was well taken care of. James was patient, gentle, and walked me through the entire process. My teeth look and feel so clean! I won't go to another dentist and HIGHLY RECOMMEND this team. THANK YOU!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dawn Cypert
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great, friendly, professional Denistry.
I always leave after an appointment feeling like I was well taken care of.
The front desk staff are always busy, but do not hesitate to help me with any questions or concerns.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Turner
user_reviews_extended.Description: The quality of service is ALWAYS great, however I've had multiple issues with the explanation of billing of services rendered, what's included and not included. Dentist billing invoices are not the easiest invoices to make sense of. This resulted in me being unexpectedly charged an additional 200 plus dollars for something I was VERBALLY told would be included and had been paid for previously.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Hansen
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dissapointing experience after leaving the office. Their estimates of cost are grossly below what they actually charge. When I asked for details on why there was such a large bill a month after service, they said they would email an explanation to me and instead sent my account to collections with no further details or requests for payment. Initially very nice people who either don't know how to do their jobs or are running some kind of scam. The filling broke less than two years after work was done as well, when they are expected to last closer to ten. There are better options in Cedar Park, for sure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marilyn Baker
user_reviews_extended.Description:
If I could give this dental office zero stars I would.  Initially, a few years ago, I gave them 5 stars and wrote a glowing review.  Because of their friendliness and service all of my family started going here.

Then the problems started.  Our initial visit to this dental office involved a mouth injury that my son had and resulted in a crown to his front tooth.
Dr. Kondoff (who is no longer there) was super friendly but suggested that we replace both front teeth so they matched.  So we did.  Months later the teeth turned blue (leaking) so the crowns had to be redone.  She was super apologetic and put another set on.  Months later the teeth turned blue again.  This time Dr. Mateo replaced them.  They were better but still not great.  Over the course of the last several months, one of the front teeth has been turning blue again.  Went to a new dentist to have them look at it.  They said the crown was leaking and had been for quite some time due to the amount of decay.  Now the crown has to be replaced AGAIN.  A 4th time - and of course, insurance doesn't cover because it hasn't been 10 years.  So here I am stuck with a $2100 dental bill correcting the consistent mistakes that were made at this office.

My husband also had to have work that was done and re-done because it wasn't done properly the first time.

This dental office has always friendly and as long as you are getting a simple teeth cleaning, they are fine.  But if you require anything else, I would NOT RECOMMEND THEM!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Gargas
user_reviews_extended.Description: I  experienced top-notch care with Ideal Dental. They thoroughly and accurately explained the best course of action for removing my tooth, and everyone from the Oral Surgery Coordinator, the Oral Surgeon, the team that assisted with the surgery to the team member that walked me in the building were friendly, patient and professional. I was with the same Dentist for over 20 years and decided to make a switch in 2021. I am impressed with the level and quality of care I received with Ideal Dental and will recommend them moving forward.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Garred
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Great people to work with. I love the fact that they can do every procedure I need right there in the office. Looking forward to seeing them again for my beautiful smile.
.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maria Sorensen
user_reviews_extended.Description: We love our experience at Brush 32 Dental in both Round Rock and Cedar Park.  My three daughters have been seeing Dr. Stella and her staff for many years.  Dr. Stella is professional, kind, and very knowledgeable.  She gives us great advice and direction on dental hygiene.  We always feel welcome, and we love the staff!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ariana Estrada
user_reviews_extended.Description: They were amazing, sweet, and fast! I was in and out of there within an hour and a half! They gave me detailed instructions and they let me know every detail of what they were doing to make me feel comfortable :) I really enjoyed my experiences there !!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bill Faulkner
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service, prices seems bit high, but quality of staff is amazing

user_reviews_extended.Name: Maurine Frost
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have never been to a friendlier office than Brush32Dental.  The dentist and dental assistant made certain at every step that I could ask questions and made certain that I understood the procedure. My comfort was assured.  Since the procedure-preparation for a bridge- took longer than I had anticipated, my ride home was not available. But the dental assistant Huda quickly insisted that she drive me several miles home.  Never before have I experienced such caring treatment.  I definitely will be returning to Brush32Dental in Cedar Park for future dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Sanchez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called Brush32 Dental because they where in my insurance network .I had a severe tooth ache and was told to come in as soon as I could and they would treat me . I had called three other dentist  was told it would be next week before they could see me . From the person I spoke with on the phone to all those involved with my treatment  where outstanding !!! Liz took care of the financial part and gave me more than one option for payment, which made it very affordable . Tiffany Kondoff is the dentist that treated me , along with dental assistants (who where great as well ) .  I HIGHLY recommend this dental office ! FYI I am switching my daughters dentist of 6 years, in order for her to see  Tiffany. I also feel 100 percent better today , Thank you Tiffany and your staff for taking care of me : ) !!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Shaw
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great Experience every time we come in and when there is a bump in the road they make sure to clear it up quickly and make sure we are happy when we leave. They even got us a little gift considering we are getting married in a few weeks, it was so thoughtful I really appreciate it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Josie Soto
user_reviews_extended.Description: All staff is so friendly and welcoming.  Very thorough with cleaning and X-rays.  I would recommend this location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Isa Bustamante
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have been to several dentist and this has been by far the best experience ever! Dr Shah made me feel very comfortable with my treatment and her assistant Perla was friendly and very knowledgeable. They both explained the treatment I was about to receive and made sure I was doing ok during the whole procedure. The office is well kept and modern. I will be recommending Brush 32 to all my friends and family. I even got a free Invisalign consult!

user_reviews_extended.Name: D Weiss
user_reviews_extended.Description:
start off by saying the staff is nice and the dentist herself was very nice. Personality aside I’d rather see anybody else for dental or healthcare. Anything over a cavity is beyond the scope of this place. They have an oral surgeon who visits 2 times a month. Hope you have an issue around just those times. They only see consults for oral surgery after they finish so if they finish fast they will just try to cancel your appointment or move it. Because oral surgery is a hobby they practice. It’s your fault for not being flexible enough to change with 18 hr notice.

Just save yourself time, pain, and headaches and chose anyone else.

user_reviews_extended.Name: David Hammons
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a very bad experience here and would not recommend going here for your dental work. I needed a root canal and after two long appointments sitting in the chair being drilled on the dentist gives up and states she can’t do it! I was never consulted that this was a maybe I can or maybe I can’t do it proposition. I was given a referral to endocrinologist to finish the job. I have already missed two days of work and now another day missed? I don’t want to spend my vacation time in dental chair! Ok they credit my insurance and charge me $700. Then they send me bill for an additional $1200. All for a failed attempt at a root canal! When I called to discuss the billing they informed me I would not be receiving a full refund but if I came in person to the office and filled out a BS form of theirs I would get a partial refund in 3 or 4 months! Don’t Go Here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Worst customer service I have recieved ever!
Dr. Mattling was great, explained the procedure well.
The front desk and management are HORRIBLE.
I have called since Monday June 24, requesting for a call back regarding a recent visit. I have called and spoken to the front desk manager who decided to not call in my pain prescription, and to which she later lied stating she did.
All I want is a simple call back to file a former complaint against the front desk manager and no one wants to assist me. To take my procedure money everyone was quick to assist me, but now since a complaint arises no one wants to show face. Highly recommend going elsewhere. I will be reporting a complaint with BBB next.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sam Davis
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone at Brush32 Dental has been wonderful, I love my Dentist Dr. Tatyana and Hygienist Laura, I've had dental work and teeth whitening done there and all have been 5 stars. The front staff is also very friendly and welcoming and make you feel special, everyone there has been great.

user_reviews_extended.Name: PSKR Motwani
user_reviews_extended.Description: I do not like visiting a dentist. I found my old doctor - Tiffany Kondoff who was earlier at Avery Ranch dental, and she has been really great about calming me down and helping me with the entire process. Today for my routine cleaning I was seen by John and Dr. Mateo. I was initially worried as I am only comfortable with Dr. Kondoff but Dr. Mateo took care of my anxiety. Brush 32 at Cedar Park is a clean location. I did not have to wait at all, everything went smooth and fast. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Venice
user_reviews_extended.Description:
WORST billing department, actually there's no billing department, that I've experienced in my lifetime. After spending thousands of dollars on a service performed in March of 2022, they are now billing me for an additional $1000 for that same service. And actually trying to rebill the insurance company that I'm no longer with.

Unless you want invoices sent year(s) after your service, I would recommend that you stay away from this place.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ish Miles
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office is very clean and the employees are very attentive. Doctor Kondoff was detailed, gentle, and made sure I was comfortable throughout all of my treatment. They were very affordable stayed within my budget. I haven't been to the dentist in years and now I look forward to my next appointment. I would defiently recommend this office to anyone who hasn't been to the dentist in awhile. They do not judge and genuiely want to help. Overall outstanding customer service.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amber Rae
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a horrible experience. They took a ton of x-rays because they kept messing up. The girl taking my x-rays was rude. They told me I had 10 cavities (AFTER I ASKED) and never even showed me the x-rays. I have NEVER even had that many total in my life, so pretty hard to believe. I got my teeth "cleaned" and after I got home and looked in the mirror, I realized that the lady that cleaned my teeth did a horrible job. I was able to scrape off plaque with my fingernail (I hadn't consumed anything after the teeth cleaning either). I will never ever EVER go back to this place!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Paul Hastings
user_reviews_extended.Description:
We had a very poor customer experience here. A filling they gave me fell out before even 2 years had passed. Another dentist then examined the filling that I had been given and said that the work had been done very poorly. He said as a dentist himself he would re-do any of his fillings that fell out before 2 years, free of charge, since the lifespan of those fillings is supposed to be 2-5 years.

When I called Brush 32 with this information they refused to repair the filling for free.

To make matters worse, after switching our dental practice we discovered that a supposed "cavity" they said my wife had (and that they wanted to fill) was *not* actually a cavity and did not need filling. Thankfully we did not follow their recommendation at the time. 3 years have now passed and her teeth are still as fine as ever.

I would strongly discourage people from using this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dylan Sipple
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Everything started out great during all the minor services.
Now that I had something major done it has gone horrible.  First off if you research cost a root canal is about 900-1100 with insurance. I was charged the same price out of pocket with insurance for my root as they quoted 1500$. Fine maybe you get what you pay for right? Wrong! So I have my root canal done they put the temp crown on great. I come back for the permanent and im too sensitive so they send me home with antibiotics, thats fine.  They call a day before my next appoint and cancel x-ray equipment is down. Ok fine.  So now my appointment is another 2 weeks out.  My temp crown falls off 3 days before appointment for permanent to be installed.  I called asked if i would be ok for 3 days they said no we will schedule you for monday to have put back on. Which i think is the dumbest think because the appointment is the next day.  Not taking another day off of work the day before.  This is all because on saturday thier internet was gonna be getting fixed.  I recieve all my appointment reminders for my scheduled appointment. So i take off from work come in and they have no record of my appointment.  They tell me they will work me in and do my cleaning while i was there. I was on time for my 12:50 appointment.  So 30mins goes by i finally go back. They start with my cleaning that takes 45 mins.  About 10 mins goes by after she finished lady comes in saying she is gonna put my temp back on.  I said no. Im hear for the permanent install.  So then they move me to the otherside of office. 30 more mins goes by. They say they cant do the permanent today i have to come back because the need at least 2 hours scheduled. Which i was already scheduled for.  They ask when i want to come back i demanded a saturday because i couldnt take off from work anymore.  They said they dont do on saturdays usually but will see what they can do. So 30mins goes by why they try to confirm this.  They said yes they can do this saturday.  Now they install my temp which took 20 mins and the lady installed incorrectly, i coulnt close my teeth all the way which i could before with the temp.  So a different lady installs it another 20 mins goes by.  “”Could have had my permanent installed and done by now with how long i was there””””.  So i leave with my temp now installed.  I get home and the temp falls off again.   I called 3 times they finally answer and i am going in tomorrow before they open to have the temp reinstalled so now i get to go into work late.   I am not sure i see the extra premium over other offices after this experience.  I am not happy ive lost out on work and been over charged and have not recieved the services to match the cost.

user_reviews.Description: Always a great experience.  Wonderful cleaning & never try to tell me I need work done that is unnecessary like previous dentists I have seen.  Really like this office and every single person I have dealt with so far!! Very kind, and professional.

user_reviews.Name: Amanda Hollen
user_reviews.Description: Love this office! They are very sweet to you and never wait by the door to leave. They answer all your questions and never make you feel little. And give great advice on how to take care of all your teeth needs. I need a lot of work done and they have payment plans that  work ! Looking forward to having my teeth back in great shape! Thanks Swish me and my family ❤️ you

user_reviews.Name: John K
user_reviews.Description: Went to Swish for the first time a few days ago because I needed a new dentist in the area. They are the best! I am older and my teeth are sensitive. They are very gentle and took good care during my cleaning. (Thank you Blair). Kennedie is the first person you meet, and she does the X-rays. They have a modern stand-up machine that goes around your head and takes pictures. Kennedie explains everything and makes it very easy. At the end of your cleaning appointment you meet the Dentist. Mine was Dr. Shruthi. She is very kind and knowledgeable. This office is very thorough and does not try to rush your appointment. If it's your first time be prepared to be there about 2 hours, and that's a good thing. They take very good care of you.

user_reviews.Name: Danton Gutierrez-Lemini
user_reviews.Description: I am delighted with Swish Dental.  Everyone, there, is extremely helpful and friendly.  The dental higienista and doctors are not only very capable but personable.  This time around, my  hygienist was Jacklin, and aside from being happy and careful, is very thorough.  Thank-you Swish Dental, for having such great employees.

user_reviews.Name: Jessica Lyons
user_reviews.Description: I really wish I could give this place more than 5 stars. I hadn't been to a dentist in years, because I'm terrified of them because I've had horrible experiences in the past. They were able to get me in the same day I called for an exam, on that Monday. I had to have some dental work, so I started with the priority one, the tooth extraction. On Friday, 4 days later, I got the extraction. 2 days later on Sunday, I started experiencing HORRIBLE pain. 1st thing Monday morning, I called them to see if they could see me, and they were more than willing to and said as soon as I can get there, they will gladly see me. I ended up dislodging the blood clot, which was leaving it open for infection. So, they had to numb me up, so she could clean out the hole of the infection, and put some ointment on it, to allow it time to start to heal. Dr. Farhin Sunesara and her assistant Lahari were AMAZING all 3 times I had to go. They both made my fear of the dentist lessen up with their compassion and sincere understanding that I was terrified. I feel like I acted worse than my 9 year old son does at the dentist 😂 Every time I went, they listened to my concerns and answered any questions I had. Another thing that I noticed about the Dr., she was very patient with her Assistant. One time she slipped and moved something out of the way in my mouth, and the Dr was very calm and nice about it. I've seen Drs in the past get irritated and rude with their assistant when something has happened. They really are the best dental office I have ever been to! And I also want to give a huge shout out to the ladies at the front desk too! I forgot to get their names, but they were amazing. They answer the phone and greeted me so nicely and sincere too! The front desk is more important than you know. Because they are the "First Impressions". This place was amazing from beginning to end! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!!

user_reviews.Name: amy siebert
user_reviews.Description: I can’t begin to express my appreciation for this entire office staff and the way they conduct themselves as well as backing that up with AMAZING work! I have been struggling to find the perfect fit for my dental needs and I am so happy to have found this place. Special shoutout to my doc Dr. Farhin, Greta, Kennedie, Ashley, and Daisy! Thank you all ladies so much for helping me start the journey to boosting my confidence back up with a great smile. ❤️

user_reviews.Name: Michael Callan
user_reviews.Description: I am giving this dental office four stars because the dental assistant and dentist were very pleasant and explained everything that needed to be done. In my first appt i went through the whole evaluation procedure and got the emergency situation taken care of in that one visit. Otherwise I would have only given three Stars. The concern I have is with the billing dept. The teeth I had extracted did not have any underlying issues that were treated, no infections, they were fully exposed, no cutting or breaking of the teeth was required yet I was charged for surgical extractions. This ate most of yearly limit for my dental insurance leave me only about $100 of the $1500.00 I started with. I believe this has become common practice with dentist and no extraction is ever labeled as simple extraction.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DingDongBell
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Cheaters, Stay Away – Serious Concerns About Billing Practices

To be clear, I have no concerns about the doctor or the clinical care. My issue is entirely with the billing department, which has been nothing short of unacceptable.

Despite being covered under Delta Dental, they repeatedly sent me incorrect bills, including one showing a balance of $1,260. Every time I tried to call to resolve it, the line was busy, and no one ever returned my voicemails.

After getting completely frustrated, I decided to just pay the balance and deal with insurance separately. When I went in, I was suddenly told that the correct amount was around $690, and that the $1,260 bill was wrong.

This is not a small “mistake.”
In my opinion, this pattern of:

Sending inflated, incorrect bills, and Being unreachable and unresponsive is abusive, misleading, and feels like an attempt to overcharge patients who trust them.

I have proof and documentation of the bills and communication trail to back this up.

Until this office fixes its billing practices and starts treating patients honestly and respectfully, I strongly recommend staying away, especially if you are insured under Delta Dental. Always double-check every bill you get from them.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marshall Gingold
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Earlier today, I completed my 6 month routine dental cleaning and periodic X-rays at SWISH on Palmer in Cedar Park. My Hygienist, Taylor, was excellent.  She was thorough, gentle and efficient. Hanna (the Doctor) was also very kind, courteous and professional. SWISH is a modern dentistry with all the latest equipment. I highly recommend giving SWISH  a try if you are looking to make a change from your current dentist or new to the neighborhood.

Update: April 28, 2025

Today I returned to SWISH Dental (12160 W Parmer Ln, Ste 110, Cedar Park, TX) for my six-month cleaning and exam—and it was another fantastic visit. Here’s why this office remains my top pick:

Convenience & Comfort
•	Perfectly located with plenty of free parking
•	Professionally decorated, clean and bright work spaces with windows for plenty of natural light
•	Bright, spotless waiting area complete with complimentary refreshments
•	Modern equipment and digital technology
•	They accept all major dental insurers (I’m with Guardian Dental)
•	Friendly, professional staff from check-in to checkout

A Spa-Like Cleaning
My hygienist, Taylor, is a true gem. Over the past year I’ve come to appreciate her gentle touch and warm demeanor. Today she:
1.	Carefully measured gum-pocket depths—so gently, I almost forgot I was at the dentist.
2.	Captured digital X-rays with crisp, painless “film” technology.
3.	Scanned my bite with a 3D imaging wand—no sticky molds, just an instant, full-color digital model of my upper and lower arches.
4.	Performed a thorough sonic scaling (cool water flow kept sensitivity at bay), followed by polishing and flossing to leave my teeth sparkling and smooth.

Final Check
Dr. Hanna popped in for a concise but comprehensive exam, confirming that everything looks great—no surprises, just peace of mind.

If you’re looking for top-notch care in a welcoming, high-tech environment, SWISH Dental in Cedar Park is worth every minute. I always leave feeling confident in my smile—and I think you will, too!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent service. The visit is for an emergency dental issue after biting a hard candy on my front tooth. Dr. Patel and her assistant were very patient with me until I explained why I was there. Though it was for me after two days since it was the weekend in between. Means I tried to schedule my appointment on Friday night online (very convenient scheduling system) and got an appointment first thing on Monday morning which is today. I don't know if we can get the same day appointment that I don't know. I also want to tell that the front office person is very helpful too. She explained my treatment plan slowly and clearly. Over all I am really pleased with my first visit with this new dental office Swish. Now my emergency visit made my whole family schedule an appointment with Swish.  I will update here how the suggested treatment plan goes. Is it as easy as today's visit or lots of discomfort so on.

Stay Tune!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Beware—this office prioritizes profits over patient care!

09/14/2021
Just left the practice from my second and last filling on the lower right side, once again Dr.Tarek Sirage was super professional and informative through the entire procedure, the assistant was constantly asking if I was ok, overall I had an excellent experience, no pain felt at all during the entire procedure, I also have not had any issues with the previous filling, I also got my chipped front tooth fixed at the same time, you can't even tell it ever chipped it's unreal how far technology has come over the years, I hope I can keep Swish Dental as my primary practice for ever, thank you Swish Dental for everything!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dessmer “Dez” Mims
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I don't usually give 5 Stars. I figure if 5 is the max then 5 should be truly exceptional. My standards shouldn't just be met, they should be 100% exceeded. This is why I'm giving the Palmer Ln, SWISH Dental in Cedar Park 5 stars.

I don't have a single complaint or suggestion for improvement. Every staff member I've interacted with has been exceptional, including my dentist Dr. Davis.

The entire team goes above and beyond to make sure you're comfortable and most importantly aren't experiencing any pain. Treatment plan, costs, potential issues, aftercare...everything is well explained and clear.

SWISH Dental Cedar Park seems to be single-handedly on a mission to change one's opinion of what a dental visit should be. From anxiety-inducing to pleasantly bearable.

The facility is nice and clean with ample parking. Additionally, it seems like they have all new, modern equipment and tools.

If you're uninsured, like I am, strongly consider SWISH. They actually seem to care about getting you treatment because they care about doing the right thing, not just getting paid. Not only does SWISH offer an annual membership for a reasonable cost which covers basics, but they also work with several different third-party financing providers to cover extras.

If you need additional help on top of those options they have an amazing Office Manager (named Alexis, I believe) who will work with you to schedule out your treatments and find a way to get you cared for.

How incredibly refreshing!
