user_reviews_extended.Description: One of the best dentist experiences I've ever had! The entire staff is very kind and welcoming. The place was clean, and they got me in and out pretty quickly. 10/10 recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cynthia Almanza
user_reviews_extended.Description: The service provided was exceptional and welcoming. The staff demonstrated a gentle approach, particularly beneficial for those with TMJ conditions. I highly recommend their services, as all team members were professional and attentive.

user_reviews_extended.Name: micaiah higginbotham
user_reviews_extended.Description: I genuinely enjoy the level of technology they use, it did seem like the tech may not have had enough experience using the technology to get a great scan of my teeth. Any time I go anywhere medical or dental I always want to at least be aware of what is happening next and so forth. Checking in with patients more could be helpful. And when I did the initial x-ray it’s very open and there is not as much privacy as I would have liked. The tech was super sweet. The hygienist is where it is at, if you want your teeth cleaned, she will go at it and not hold back, but let me tell you I have NEVER had such a good teeth cleaning in my life. My teeth literally looked brand new. Only thing is that dentist gave me about 5 minutes if her time, she seemed super busy so I don’t blame her. Times are tough with staffing so I get it. Just would have appreciated a more individual experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lizbeth Serrano
user_reviews_extended.Description: If you are looking for a good dentist who is compassionate too. Swish dental is where you should go I love the attention they gave my kiddos and how nice the doctor was. The assistant Greta was very welcoming and nice too. Loved swish I definitely will come for my dental needs too!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darlene Calfee
user_reviews_extended.Description: A crown fell off my tooth at 12:25pm on Friday.  My regular dentist is out of town.  I found Swish Dental on Google search and was in their office at 1:00pm.  Special thanks to Daisy and the Team!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Campbell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today’s visit was one of the best dentist visits I’ve ever had. The hygienist flossed, polished, and rinsed my teeth. The doctor looked everything over, evaluated the current issues, and asked about my dental hygiene habits but there was NO direct encouragement to “do better”. The encouragement was subtle and indirect. I appreciate that.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marie Jensen
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff was super helpful, attentive and friendly!  Receptionist, Danelle was extremely welcoming and courteous.  I never visited  such a positive dental office.  Everything is brand new in the dental office, it is pristine, it has the latest technology and a very soothing environment.   Alex, the tech that took exams was very skilled and very careful taking exams.  Alex was pleasant and had a very positive attitude.  The dental hygienist, Dustin, had a wonderful bedside manner, very gentle, loved his job and made me feel very comfortable.  He did an excellent job of cleaning my teeth.  I had a very positive experience my first time at Swish.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Samantha Show
user_reviews_extended.Description: I always have a wonderful experience here at Swish. I have always been super nervous about the dentist and never felt taken care of until making this my dentist office. Erica did a great job talking me through what was going on and gave me great advice on taking better care of my teeth. I also love that it’s a woman dominated staff.

user_reviews_extended.Name: jsatot
user_reviews_extended.Description: I came in with a serious dental emergency that was causing me excruciating pain. The dentists I saw at Swish were neglectful, they gave me zero treatment, and charged me several hundred dollars for a short consultation. I was told by the dentist here that my problem would not get worse, however over the next few days it got SIGNIFICANTLY worse and more painful. I had to go to a different dental office to get treatment, and was told that I needed emergency surgery due to bone loss. Terrible and traumatic experience. If you want treatment from a medical professional who cares about your health and safety, spend your energy elsewhere. These people want nothing more than your money in their pockets.

user_reviews_extended.Name: DeEtte Whitaker
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my second visit, different dentist and staff.  This visit didn't go very well, to say the least!  Malfunctioning equipment that leaked water; I was drenched!  And assistant that couldn't manage to take x-rays, nor work the equipment needed.  A dentist that fumbled with the equipment as well.  This kind of experience doesn't inspire return visits!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melissa Gaber
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The great: The hygienist did an excellent and thorough job. My teeth feel amazing!

The not great: Each visit feels like it’s an opportunity for them to sell me on something. I got a crown from them previously but it wasn’t a good experience. I told them that I didn’t want to do anything else until September but he still printed out a quote and wanted me to sign off on it. I didn’t.

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Paul Evangelista
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m a type of person who is quite afraid going to dentist, but after going to Swish Dental I am not anymore worried not scared cause I assure you they have the most nice and caring staff and doctors, I highly suggest to go to Swish Dental.🫶🏻

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Berry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have really bad dental anxiety and this place is a sanctuary! I’ve had anything here from cleanings, fillings, a root canal, to Invisalign. Everyone here is always so nice, you get checked in and taken back so fast, and I feel really taken care of and supported.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Scott Werth
user_reviews_extended.Description: Nice, friendly dentist and staff. Have had cleanings done in the past. Today, I went in for a few fillings. All nicely done in about a half an hour. Very good experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Greg Castro
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish in Cedar Park REALLY took care of me. I had been neglecting my teeth for years and had been avoiding going to the dentist because of a bad experience in the past. The whole staff as Swish made me feel super welcomed, never shamed me for missing so many years, laid out a clear and simple treatment plan with transparent pricing, and their work was beyond gentle and thorough. I would recommend anyone stop by here for any of their dental needs, and even set an appointment for my daughter in a couple of weeks.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Khristian Green
user_reviews_extended.Description: Kennedie Guerrero was amazing!! She was very informative, gentle, and just such a beautiful soul. Thank You for allowing wonderful experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Denise Treadwell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Swish Dental in Cedar Park went out their way to get me something that was out of stock at this location. They sent someone to another location and brought it to Cedar Park so I could get it before leaving town. Amazing customer service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jason Mirini Kim
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! The staff was extremely friendly and the office was very modern and clean.  It was easy to schedule, check-in, and everything was automated.  I appreciate their use to technology and how it makes this much easier and quicker.  I'd highly recommend it.  They also were very helpful in making sure I got my Army dental requirement completed which they didn't have to do.

user_reviews_extended.Name: J J
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a less than satisfactory experience here. Dental hygienist did a good job but overall it just seemed like moral was low, people didnt want to be there, and they were more interested in giving me xrays and pitching invisiline. I was really hoping to be treated like a patient and not some factory part on the production line.

user_reviews_extended.Name: CC
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This place was spamming me on Facebook ads. I was like ok, let me give them a shot. They obviously invested a ton of money into their ad campaign. New insurance, need new dentist. So, let me try these guys out.

Big mistake! They were crazy flaky on the phone and their reminders were threats to charge me 50 dollars if I didn't show up to my initial appointment. Whaaaaaaat?

No no no. Absolutely not!

They need to spend more of their advertising budget on customer service and they might be getting somewhere! The current business model sucks massively.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abigayle Hoeft
user_reviews_extended.Description: I rarely leave reviews, but this dental office is amazing. I’ve always had issues with the numbing for fillings; my whole childhood I felt every filling, and it led to a very intense fear of the dentist. Here, I was listened to, they used different techniques to numb my mouth and I had the most painless dental experience I’ve ever had. Really a great place!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Knight
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My initial visit was great, the dentist was friendly and honest, his assistants told me they did in house financing if my insurance didn’t work for this specific dental office as well as other financing options. I called my insurance multiple times verifying I have implant coverage and that swish would work. Swish kept telling me my insurance wouldn’t work so I would have to pay out of pocket. I accepted it since the first visit was very good and decided to move forward.   They sent me a quote for a 1000$ dollars a month to pay toward my implant.  I responded with telling them they told me at our first visit they had told me they did in house financing and would “find a payment plan that works for you we have multiple options” I responded to her saying that with “somewhere around 200 or 250$ a month” she replied “oh of course somewhere around there”

They did not honor there word, I understand not every place does financing and that’s alright, but the way they made me feel safe and comfortable, welcomed and respected and then to be turned on and made a fool like I can afford a 1000$ a month. Is a slap in the face.  They don’t have financing and they lied about my insurance not being covered and compatible.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Millie Eberl
user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved to Texas a year and a half ago and I’m so thankful I found Swish! I have been lucky enough to have Jess do my my cleanings and X-rays each time and she is the best. She is very thorough and knowledgeable and makes sure I am comfortable every step of the way! The office is clean and modern. And I never dread going to the dentist anymore.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rozina Vastani
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very poor customer service. Seemed more like they were pushing for things to do for higher price. They refused regular cleaning and insisted deep cleaning and quoted me about $700 out of pocket after insurance. I left and then got a call from someone in operations that they will bring the price down to approx $250. Lost trust, so fees doesn't matter at this point.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dylan Buck
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff at Swish dental were so helpful and compassionate towards me and my dental needs. I would 100% recommend them to anyone in need of a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elizabeth Rodriguez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great office! Loved the care the staff provided me they were very warm and welcoming. I would definitely recommend my friends and family yo visit Swish Cedar Park for all their dental needs.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Savannah Greer
user_reviews_extended.Description: Literally the best dentist appointment I have ever had. Front desk was pleasant. The staff was so nice and shout out to Beth for being so kind and knowledgable. She really took her time and got excited when i had questions. My doctor was quick, efficient, super nice as well. The payment gal(i dont know her name) was so sweet and hooked me up with a pretty nice electric tooth brush which was such a nice surprise i wasn’t expecting. She was patient while explaining payment options. I was a little confused and overwhelmed and she made me feel heard. Def coming back and telling all my people about this office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: tcstanier
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’ve had a great experience with Swish. Dr. Farhin, Lahari, Blaire, and Daisy are all very friendly and professional. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kenneth Moore
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Hannah and Ashley were absolutely AMAZING!!
They were both very informative and accommodating.What a great team!!!

I am now looking forward to my next extraction. lol

Seriously though, they are the best ever!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mike
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. BRIGGS is the absolute best knees! I went in for wisdom teeth extraction -unsure if I was going to get all 4 pulled or simply the ones causing me pain.
Once she talked with me and took look at everything she was confident and inspired that same confidence in me toove foward extracting all 4.
Dr. Briggs is as professional and talented as any surgeon comes. I'm very grateful to have been under her care and have her as my Doctor. She went above and beyond her line of duty to also reach out to ensure I was doing okay hours after I had left the clinic. I'm very thankful for Dr. Briggs!!!!!!!!! God bless her!!!!! Her compassion is a thing of beauty.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Foster McKeon
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First, they were available much sooner than I expected- only 3 days out for a non-urgent appointment. Then, about an hour prior to my appointment, I received a text letting me know that they were running ahead of schedule, if I might like to come in early. I happened to be close by and available, so I went early.

I was immediately taken to the back, no waiting. The first professional to see me explained the outline of what to expect for this visit, including who else would be in my mouth that day. Everyone was very warm and friendly, including the person who came to my chair as soon as the dentist was finished and explained, with an iPad as visual aid, what the options were for my treatments, with my insurance coverage included in the prices.  The treatments discussed were organized by priority, as well, and then she emailed me all of that info on the spot, and then scheduled my next appointment, all while I was still in the chair. Also, at no point was I ever asked a redundant question- no telling anyone my insurance info after my pre-registration over the phone, no asking my email address before sending me the pricing info. So refreshing!

Every professional who worked with me gave me their full attention and offered multiple opportunities for me to ask questions.

10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather Fisher
user_reviews_extended.Description: I usually like my dentist but had a horrible experience today. One of the assistant’s was rude and they didn’t explain what they were doing.  I was in pain  with my mouth open for close to an hour when I was only supposed to get my permanent cap placed on. She seemed irritated it was hurting me and kept saying we will have to numb you if you can’t handle the pain. She was also talking about me slobbering like I had an option to turn off my saliva. I have to go back to get the permanent cap on but I will not be going back after I get it. It’s already paid for so I have to go back. It’s unfortunate because I did like the dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Cozza
user_reviews_extended.Description: New patient emergency: Dr. Davis did a pulp cap. In my head I was thinking worst case scenario bc of previous shoddy dental work as a child that has now cost me 3 root canals. 5 days later molar feels great with temp cap  (the pain lasted 3 days just sore easily taken care of with ibuprofen). Going in October for the permanent cap but for once I felt heard and confident. They not only saved me money but saved my tooth. Since I am in network and researched within my beam app insurance went smoothly. I wasn’t surprised at all and front desk is fantastic ( I left relieved because I always go worst case scenario).  Excited to get the permanent cap and looking forward to actually signing up for yearly cleanings X-rays etc as long as I stay in the area.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jennifer Jones
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had Dr. Veronica Puzio see me for an exam and some fillings and she was so kind and personable. I have always had dental anxiety and she was very gentle and put me at ease. Not only was the dentist great, but the front staff was also kind and took their time in explaining the finance portion and working with me. I very highly recommend this office!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: T M
user_reviews_extended.Description: Not returning.  Very disappointing experience and I have been going here for over 2 years now.  The dental hygentist was very green, fumbled with all of the tools, got water in my face and even wiped my teeth off with a cloth or tissue.  VERY not OK!  Her flossing skills were fat fingered and I would tell you their name but she didn't tell me.  I wish I had read the other reviews on here, as I have never seen the same dentist twice, except once.  Same situation with the hygentist.  Other reviews state the same experience or worse.  This must be a practice clinic for new dentist and hygentist.  They also require x-rays 2x a year....very odd.  I have been blessed with great teeth but I don't trust their care.  I will be seeking a dentist office that has a dedicated and consistent staff.  Wish them all well, but this should have been made clear from the beginning.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren D
user_reviews_extended.Description: It’s always a fun time here, which is not expected on a dentist office! LGBT friendly, everyone is kind, they do what they can to work around your budget, they are VERY transparent, and you get to watch Netflix while you get a filling. I mean… that’s amazing. I’m honestly amazed at how great the quality of service and especially how hi-tech this office is. I’ve gone to dentists who were very traditional, which is fine. But, being able to have so much more info about your health due to better equipment and resources has been refreshing. It’s also nice to go in for multiple fillings and barely spend more than an hour doing so. I really thought it would be so hard to find a place I love, but I’m definitely a client for good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mackenzie Paige
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just recently found Swish, out of the blue when I was driving home, I needed a new dentist too and was having terrible mouth pains. I was hoping they’d have availability soon since my teeth were hurting and I got an appointment for the VERY NEXT DAY. It was easy filling out paperwork, very easy overall exam and the SAME DAY, they got two of my procedures done!! They are so professional, nice, and comforting especially if you don’t like going to the dentist in general. Lol I’ve been recommending this place and will continue to!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joey Lopez
user_reviews_extended.Description: At Swish Cedar Park, I’ve had the absolute best dental experiences. The staff are all very nice and make every visit comfortable and easy. I’ve been to other local dental offices and left feeling in the dark and to be honest, taken advantage of financially. Not here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Fco Villa
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great service and the best team in the area!. Highly professional with really nice equipment to take care of you. Thank you and Kudos to the Swish Dental team at Cedar Park!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Heather ODaniel
user_reviews_extended.Description: Really great experience with the dental assistant Jay. He made me feel really comfortable and took the time to explain proper hygiene. Will definitely be coming back.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vincent Baltz
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time at Swish. I came in for a simple teeth cleaning and xrays. The facility was very clean. Equipment seemed brand new and high end. I loved all the special 3D imaging they used to show the health of my teeth and gums. The staff was very friendly and professional. The dental hygienist wasn't rough during the cleaning like I have experienced in the past at other facilities. So ask for Jess because she was thorough but delicate. Definitely coming back and scheduling an appt for my wife.  Overall great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sofia Castaneda
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff is so incredibly friendly. I have a fear of the dentist and the dental assistant made sure to walk me through everything and make sure I was as comfortable as possible. The front desk staff were also incredibly kind, and the Doctor was super awesome in settling my nerves and having a plan of action to get my teeth’s health back on track! Can’t wait for more visits (:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Zisman
user_reviews_extended.Description: I chipped a tooth at 9pm. I went online and was able to get an appointment for 8am the very next day. They are busy but they fit me in and I was able to get the process started for a crown in under 12 hours from chipping my tooth! Couldn’t ask for a better solution. The team at Swish is awesome. Go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephen Luera
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr Mayuri is very knowledgeable and took the time to explain every step of the treatment needed to care for my teeth. Her staff Erica, Carlos, Kayce are incredible, the entire staff will definitely make you feel very comfortable. If I talked their Team listened to my concerns. I recommend if you need anything done SWISH is a 100% place to get your teeth cared for!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: StAFFORD TRENDS
user_reviews_extended.Description: I went to the dentist’s office in Cedar Park with a severe toothache. After taking X-rays, the dentist kept tapping on my tooth, almost like she was trying to test my tolerance for pain. Eventually, she confirmed there was an infection, but instead of offering any immediate relief, she just handed me a referral to an endodontist, basically washing her hands of it. I had to press her to even get antibiotics for the infection, and when I asked for just two pain pills to manage the pain until the antibiotics started working, she brushed me off, saying to take Tylenol and Ibuprofen. When I reminded her I’m allergic to Ibuprofen and that Tylenol wasn’t helping and that the pain woke me up in my sleep,she coldly dismissed my pain, saying it wasn’t serious enough to bother a colleague for a simple prescription, showing zero regard for what I was going through.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tuesday Becker
user_reviews_extended.Description: Came in for a consult for Invisalign the other day and had a great experience. The front-desk, staff, dental hygienists and Dr.Byrne were all helpful, knowledgeable, and friendly. Looking forward to continuing my treatment here!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shannon Burkhart
user_reviews_extended.Description:
First impressions are key and Swish exceeded that today. Everyone that works there is knowledgeable. I definitely would recommend them for so many reasons. I walked in doubtful and unsure. Today, I left with more confidence that my overall dental health goal can be reached!

:) Shannon

user_reviews_extended.Name: Teresa Baião
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This location is very different from the South location where I used to go. They didn’t take that long to call me when I did the check-in. The nurse that saw me explained what would be the steps during my visit and even asked if there was any additional concern I would like to mention to the Dr., which I also explained.

However, I feel like she could be more gentile while using the little device to take the X-ray. That thing is very uncomfortable on some spots and it really made very difficult for me to hold for a long time. But she didn’t seem to concern about it and kept going. The other thing that I would mention is that, she could mention during the procedure, what was she doing and instruct me on how to let her know that something was hurting me or was uncomfortable. I had to find my own ways to let her know that at some moments I was having a little bit more pain. So for sure, there was some lack of communication during my procedure.

I thought she would inform the Dr. the concerns she initially asked, but no; I had to repeat them again.

Other than that my visit was good. People in general are very friendly and it was a quick visit as well. The procedure itself was about 35-40 min.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittany Duffy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Very professional and detailed staff. Alexis and Kennedie did an amazing job explaining my plan of care. I recommend anyone looking for a great dental experience to visit this modern office. This staff is off the chain!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abhishek Iyer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Came for a standard cleaning but even after an hour no cleaning happened. Lots of delays. Had to reschedule for next week..

Update: the rescheduled cleaning went off without a hitch! Have been going to Swish Dental for a long time and their service is generally very good.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Morelia Mack-Orona
user_reviews_extended.Description: I have truly NEVER been to a clinic with such phenomenal staff through and through. I mean from the moment I walked in until the second and even afterwards they reached out. I was treated like a human. Conversed with as an adult so any other places beat around the bush and try to push products on you. This staff was phenomenal but all my concerns and insecurities at ease and set me up for success and I am sending everyone I know there. Truly amazing experience all the way through. Their priority is definitely YOU. The patient

user_reviews_extended.Name: Abigail Jimenez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Space was clean. And drs/ assistants were fast. HATED that they kept trying to upsell me. I went in to get a referral for an oral surgeon for my wisdom teeth. And I told them I had X-rays from 3 months ago. They had me take new ones and the dr spent less then 5 minutes looking at my tooth and new X-rays and she was out. I basically paid $250 for them to tell me what I already knew.

ALSO legally they should have taken my old X-rays. The law says they have to expect X-rays that are less then 6 month old. They however did not tell me this and I felt like they took advantage of me not knowing.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Hill
user_reviews_extended.Description: GO ANYWHERE ELSE! I went here because they said they were an emergency dental office. As soon as I got there, the girls at the front desk seemed annoyed that they had to do their job to even check me in. I finally got in and talked to someone just to end up not even being treated because they don’t have a doctor there that can even do a procedure AT A EMERGENCY CLINIC. So I wasn’t even able to get treated today. And worse than that, they are so impersonal. You can be in pain trying to figure out what’s going on and people just keep demanding that you pay right then and there and hounding you about it. So if you are looking for an emergency dental care go anywhere else because they are way overpriced and they care more about money then actually helping you with anything, so instead of you leaving better you will end up leaving the same way you came in or worse.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kranti Kumar
user_reviews_extended.Description: A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Farhin and Lahari for the smooth and comfortable dental treatment. Your kindness and gentle care made the experience completely pain-free.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sean O'Connell
user_reviews_extended.Description: Arguably the best dentist visit I’ve had in a while.  Everyone took their time to explain the concerns and issues with my exam.  I did not feel rushed or like another appointment that needed to be completed before the next.  I would highly recommend this specific Swish location for anyone shopping around for a new dentist.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mary Lundin
user_reviews_extended.Description: Horrible experience. My appointment lasted an hour and a half. It seemed like there was only one hygienist on staff. He was very rushed and not thorough (only flossed 1/3 of my teeth). Everything was very slow and inefficient. Frustrating experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Alexandra Tarango
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you Valerie and everyone at Swish for a smooth visit from the moment I was looking to schedule til now. Valerie was very helpful with checking my insurance to see what was covered and what I could be looking at to pay out of pocket before scheduling. When we got there, the staff was quick to get me and my husband back. I like that they tell you what needs to be done and show you the break down cost of everything before leaving. The vibe was a total game changer and made it super chill and laid back! I highly recommend Swish in Cedar Park. I will be referring my friends and family to y’all! I am no longer dreading the dentist office!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Vivian Lee
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at Swish! Everyone was super lovely, the place is new and clean, and the dental technology and care is top notch. Love the membership option too and think it's a great deal for those of us who don't have dental insurance.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Bruce Ngo
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great experience! Everyone is great and professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: JoEllen Goldsberry
user_reviews_extended.Description: I moved to Austin in 2009 and have been unsuccessful in finding a dentist office that I felt comfortable and received quality service. After my visit with Swish Cedar Park, I’ve finally found a dentist I can come back to! Everyone from the office manager to the dentist was so kind, welcoming, and extremely knowledgeable (but in a way where they don’t make you feel dumb!). Thanks for the great experience!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sarah Boothe
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was overly impressed with my visit to swish dental. I have avoided the dentist for way too long because of bad experiences and I wish I had come here sooner. Truly, they were fast, efficient, courteous and professional. My visit was thorough and educating and for the first time I felt like I was in control of my dental appointment. I will be referring everyone I know.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Melody McDurham
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great first visit! Everyone was friendly and professional, and they made me feel comfortable, physically and mentally during my exams and cleaning. They offer a wide array of medical and cosmetic procedures, but I did not feel pressured to consider and any work right away.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ed Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: This was my first time at this dentist. The office is impeccable, everything is new.  It looks more like a boutique than a dentist office, which may be a little weird to older clientele.  But all the employees are great! Everyone made me feel welcome and explained every process.  The only thing I found strange was that I came in for a cleaning and I got everything but a cleaning. I got a consultation of what was needed but I didn’t get a cleaning.  I setup my next appointment to get my cleaning and some minor work, but that’s more time I have to take off from work.  Just interesting that I didn’t get what I went to their office for.  Then again I may have messed up the appointment process they have online.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annastasia Kohen
user_reviews_extended.Description:
My visit today was with Dr. Loehr. He was absolutely amazing! His energy was very calming and very welcoming. He’s also insanely knowledgeable and doesn’t try to push other services on you that you don’t need. Unfortunately, he isn’t my primary dentist, but after that visit, I wish he could be. I’ve never felt that at ease in the presence of another dentist. Seriously, they freak me out. I hope cedar park keeps Dr. Loehr around 👌

I also really enjoyed my time with his assistant! She was so welcoming and made me feel right at home. She talked me through the entire process, she was very gentle, and she even asked permission before using any kind of dental tool on me. I’ve honestly never experienced this kind of service inside of a dentist's office, ever. It was truly next-level. user_reviews_extended.Name: Christopher Ortiz
user_reviews_extended.Description: First off, if I could give double the stars on this rating I would. I have lived in Cedar Park for 17 years and only had 2 dental places I have ever provide treatment. But there is saying: “Third time is a charm”. The number one thing that matters to me when I select an orthodontist is friendly staff & consulting. This place went above & beyond from the minute I walked in. Dental Assistant guy was awesome. The dental hygienist was the kind of guy you want to have a beer with. And of course the billing person - Valerie is the woman you want to bring home to mom and dad. The entire staff including the doctor who attended to me was class act staff. Thank you for making my choice easy—-and honestly when it comes to my dental health, it’s never negotiable. I pay for dental services to those you can trust. Thank you again everyone. Look forward to be a client for life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Juri Miyamoto

Took so much longer, too, because of it. I will not go back.
Their doctors are constantly changing too. I have been there 3 times, and all 3 times, I had different young doctors.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacy Tezol
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was seen quickly and my tooth was extracted with no complications. I was able to be seen the same day and the staff are very professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Slimane Lassaker
user_reviews_extended.Description:

They both deserve the Nobel Prize for Dentistry !!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Annie Villasana
user_reviews_extended.Description: I called regarding my daughter  with an injury (chipped tooth), and they got us an appointment same day. The staff was also very friendly and patient with my daughter who had some anxiety about certain parts of the procedure.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Julie Petrovic
user_reviews_extended.Description: Friendly, professional care. Great communication as well.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Lerma
user_reviews_extended.Description: I absolutely love Swish Cedar Park! I usually am not fond of the dentist, and I did not feel a bit of stress or anxiety here. The staff is kind and explains everything they are doing each step of the way!

user_reviews_extended.Description:

Highly recommend Swish Dental. Thank you so much.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joelisa McKnight
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is one of the most top dental offices I have been too . I love the atmosphere, it makes you feel like home. The office staff is super super amazing especially Ms Kennedie . I would recommend this place to anyone hands down amazing place to go for your teeth

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brittney Alvarado
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm not one to go to a dentist and it's been awhile since I've gone to one. They were very helpful with the breakdown of what needed to be done with my teeth. user_reviews_extended.Description: Overall, it was not a good experience. user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Chateau
user_reviews_extended.Description: They took me in at short notice.  All the people were friendly and professional.  I felt very comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Connie Nagy
user_reviews_extended.Description:

user_reviews_extended.Name: Hannah Abraham
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Just ok experience. Continue reading if you’re interested in the negatives: The receptionist said she needed to confirm my insurance and that she would do so and take care of it. I called back next day to confirm and it hadn’t been done much less even started.

I was sent texts (way too many times) asking me to complete an intake form. I did, which was more time consuming than it should have been, and none of the four employees I had contact with read it. I disclosed the reason for my visit in paragraph form and no one read it haha. I indicated several times that I’m pregnant and I was directed to take an x-ray (big no no), which is problematic.

I was also asking about a specific issue and the dentist told I’d be given a list of providers to treat me, this did not happen.

Overall, my recommendation is that you don’t visit this location if you’re considering it for a cleaning. It’s not terrible and the cleaning was fine. Not worth going when there are many other options. The dentist seemed competent and thorough when evaluating my teeth health and the patient next to me. Oh yeah, they don’t put you in rooms, just a small wall divider between patients. If you’re worried about others hearing all your business then this isn’t the place to go.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor Gaunce
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had such a great experience at Swish dental could not recommend them enough, my assistant Greta was awesome and Dr. Hannah was TOP notch !!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dustin Almaraz
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love this office! This is definitely not your average dental office, it’s so much better! The entire staff is very attentive. When going in, they welcomed me basically with open arms. The back staff was so friendly and honest. Dr. Sirage was so personable and made me feel comfortable.  I would definitely recommend this office to anyone looking for a new dental office!

user_reviews_extended.Description: My whole family is cared for by the amazing and nice team at Swish Dental and everyone is very gentle, kind and very friendly. I fully recommended Swish. Thank you.

user_reviews_extended.Description: I was a first time patient today with a cavity in a back molar. They took the necessary X-rays and and they were able to fit me in for the filling. user_reviews_extended.Name: Jessica Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I chipped my front tooth and was able to get in first thing on Monday. I wish I recalled the dentists name who helped me. She was very attentive and it looks great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: stephanie King
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great office! Everyone that works there is super friendly and welcoming. The office is beautiful and very well maintained. The cleaning was one of the most comfortable I’ve had and I’m super happy with my continued treatment plan. Highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jacob Gonzales
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is a great dentist! Very clean and Modern. They were all nice and did a great job! Made me feel really comfortable and walked me through the entire process. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ry Struck
user_reviews_extended.Description: I don’t think anyone enjoys going to the dentist. However, at Swish Dental Cedar Park everyone from their front desk associate to Dr. Puzio herself make you feel as if you’re not just a patient,  but a part of the Swish family. They always call and text to remind you of upcoming visits and I have never waited over 5 min before being seen. Dr. Puzio is very precise in her procedures and consistently ensures your ok throughout each step.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Janet Poling
user_reviews_extended.Description: The dental hygienist did an excellent job on my teeth. They people who work there are friendly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Emily Harris
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I was a Swish Domain patient, so I was excited to hear that Swish Cedar Park opened just this week. Everyone at the CP office was so nice during my visit.

I got a full tour of the office, which was a nice touch. They're still working on getting the space totally filled out, but it already looks great. The patient exam and cleaning rooms are on the side of the building where there's a huge window, so you can look outside while you're in the chair. Most of the space is very open concept; you can hear what's going on in the station beside you, but there is some wall between you. There are also screens with Netflix if you'd like to watch during your appointment.

The dental assistant and dentist were awesome. They went over my x-rays and scans basically tooth by tooth; I've never gotten so much information and explanation about everything, and I really appreciated the level of detail I received. The hygienist was great, very thorough but gentle.

Even though I was a patient at the Domain, I got the new patient exam for CP, which was scheduled to take about an hour and a half. I also ended up needing a filling replaced, and they were able to do it then and there. Very good filling experience, barely felt a thing. I also have Invisalign currently, and everyone who worked on me was very attentive of my buttons and asked lots of questions to make sure they didn't disturb anything.

Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely recommend this Swish location.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Amy Pack
user_reviews_extended.Description: We’re retired with no dental insurance. Paid in advance for a year’s preventative care via their membership program. When my husband, who has always taken great care of his teeth, decided against their initial recommendation for a $1000 deep cleaning, they refused further treatment with no explanation, costing us most of his prepaid money and a year’s worth of preventative care. Very disappointing and unacceptable experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: theodorah ndhlovu
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff members are friendly and knowledgeable, from the front desk lady to everybody I interacted with, and the rest of the staff members I saw helping others. l've learned so much about dental care in one visit. I found my permanent dental care spot and I recommend Swish Dental, Cedar Park, to everybody.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Donna Schultz
user_reviews_extended.Description: Today was my first visit at Swish Dental. They were super nice and the Dr was very good at explaining everything to me. It was a really good visit.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Makayla Smith
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had a wonderful experience at Swish today. I made an appointment last night ~9pm for today at 1pm because I thought I was getting a cavity, had free time to get checked out today, and remembered seeing an add for swish that promised a free swag bag (I love free things okay?)

The whole appointment process was so smooth, Cassie was wonderful with the imaging and Dr. Sirage was very thorough in explaining everything that was going on, and how to prevent my cavities - since this was a recurring issue for me - something no dentist has done yet. He then looked at his schedule and said “well I can get started on some of those today if you’d like”. Again, an experience I’ve never had.

I opted to not have nitrous, as I’ve started to get over my fear of needles, and both Dr. Sirage and Cassie made it a great experience by never letting me see the needle they used in my mouth, and holding my hand when I was getting the shots themselves. The procedure went faster than I thought, even though we had to stop twice to numb the bottom of my mouth even more. I’ll be back in a month to tackle the rest of my cavities, and then hopefully be cavity free for a while!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Taylor R
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a much better experience at the Cedar Park location than the domain. The facility was clean and I was in and out in 30 minutes. Staff was friendly and the cleaning was gentle. I will now come here regularly.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Marco C

user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred from Swish Mueller to go to this location because their orthodontist only works from Cedar Park. This is extremely far and inconvenient. user_reviews_extended.Name: Tina Rülke
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I would strongly recommend being extremely careful with your billing and insurance claims at this location. While the dental work itself might be okay, the administrative management is an absolute disaster.

For months, I tried to resolve an insurance discrepancy and was ignored by the local office. It was only after months of silence and escalating the issue that the Regional Manager finally stepped in to provide clarity. However, even then, the internal lack of coordination was beyond belief. On the same day the Regional Manager reached out, the Practice Manager sent a conflicting message stating they still needed "more time" to review the account.

It is staggering that it takes months and the intervention of regional leadership to get basic answers that the local office should have handled from day one. The communication is unprofessional, inconsistent, and lacks any credibility. If you value your time and peace of mind, double-check every bill you receive from Swish Dental and keep a meticulous paper trail.

Dr. Ardita Ormeni and her entire team do an absolutely outstanding job taking care of my family’s dental needs. user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeffrey Fite
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I have been seeing Dr. Daniel Ormeni, DMD, since late 2022 and feel blessed to have found him.

At the time, I was experiencing severe sepsis and had been in ICU and repeated visits to ER, yet no other oral surgeon had been able or willing to help me.

After months of serious illness and mounting medical bills I was giving up hope, but my regular dentist (Dr. Joseph Johnson, DDS) found Dr. Ormeni who agreed to take on my case. Not only did Dr. Ormeni see me, but he provided nothing but thoughtful, smart, and kind care since we first met.

Because my infection was so severe, and slowness with which my body heals, it was a long process, but Dr. Ormeni stood by me every step of the way.

If you are seeking a bright and caring oral surgeon - and one who will really listen to your needs and not give up on you - go to Dr. Ormeni. I can't thank him enough.

UPDATE DECEMBER 2025:

After Dr. Ormeni worked so diligently to reconstruct my lower left jaw and install a cutting-edge implant device, I am now seeing Dr. Ardita Ormeni, DMD to seat what will be permanent teeth for me.

Like her husband, Dr. Ormeni is super smart, skilled, and kind. From my first appointment, she's treated me like a long-time patient. She too cares about her patients in a way that you will hear in her words and see in her behavior.

The Ormenis have had a profound impact on my life and health. I can't emphasize enough what it's meant to me to find them when I was in such bad shape mentally and physically. They are nothing less than professional but at this point they feel like family to me.  Their staff are also top notch - always kind and very professional. Highly recommended!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jamie Simpson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Today could have ended in an ER visit, but thanks to the quick teamwork between our orthodontist, Dr. Despot, and his phone call to Dr. Ormeni, we were seen right away.

We are very grateful to Dr. Ormeni and his team for their swift action and help to calm our son during a very scary moment, and it’s clear they genuinely care. My husband pointed out  Dr. Ormeni’s compassion, and the entire team shares that same commitment. In a moment of uncertainty, they provided safety and comfort for my son. From intake to aftercare, the experience felt very supportive.

Dr. Ormeni: your calm, thorough, patient-centered care made all the difference for our 9-year-old boy who is terrified of needles. We’re incredibly grateful.

If you’re looking for top-tier expertise with real compassion, this is the place. Highly recommended.

Gratefully, from a very thankful mom,

The Simpson Family

user_reviews_extended.Name: Adam Lauer
user_reviews_extended.Description:
tl;dr - best Dentist experience I've had in years.

I have nerve damage in my mouth so going to the Dentist is always anxiety ridden for me and I often switch or skip due to bad or neutral experiences. Park Family is the first Dentist practice where I am not dreading going back. They were super attentive and actually listened to my concerns and were able to give me advice and answers where I needed them. It didn't feel like a rush job or like they were in a hurry to move to on to another patient.

The Dentist was able to diagnose my tooth pain based on my bite and give suggestions on how to mitigate it, but also give a full solution of corrective surgery if I was interested. I never felt pressured into a procedure and was always given options.

My hygienist was super thorough and very delicate. I opted for the numbing gel and the nitrous oxide gas which was the perfect combination for my comfort during cleaning.

Overall a very good experience. It was actually much longer than I expected (over an hour), but that was because of the comprehensive service and that is a tradeoff I am willing to make.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Zachary Ramirez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had a great experience at Park Family Dental. The staff was welcoming and made everything feel easy and comfortable. My hygienist was kind and thorough. I drive 1 hour to come see them! I got my implants and crowns here. The color match was spot on. My wife was also very pleased with it and that’s all that matters. I can’t say enough good things about them. Come check them out for yourself. I have spent a lot of money on my dental care, I wish that I know about them much much earlier. user_reviews_extended.Description: Visiting Park Family Dental office for the first time provided an exceptional level of care that far exceeded my expectations. The hygienist and dental assistants were gentle yet thorough, taking the time to explain each step of the cleaning process and addressing any concerns I had. user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Shantz
user_reviews_extended.Description: 5 stars doesnt do enough justice in my opinion, these guys are by far the best staff all around that I have ever delt with.  I have been in so many different dentists/surgeons offices over the years.. now at 37 years old I finally had an opportunity to get work done that I never had growing up.  I had 4 wisdom teeth and 4 others pulled all at once, little daunting for some, was a piece of cake for this place.  During my recovery I got calls from Dr. Ormeni himself to make sure all was going well and to see how I was feeling, even on the weekend when we had questions about how I was feeling he made himself available.  I went to a post op appointment and I had no choice but to bring my two very young daughters and the front desk staff gave them toys, turned on cartoons and kept an eye on them for me while I was being checked out.  I dont trust hardly anyone with my kids but from the moment you walk in the door youll know you're in the right place, these guys are incredible!  If your "older" like me, and thought there was no way you could get work done at this point in your life?  Wrong, Dr Ormeni and his entire staff here are amazing!   There was only ever one thing I would have ever changed about myself... not to be taller, not to be rich. It was to have a smile that I could finally show my teeth and not be self conscious about. Thank you guys, so much!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Laura Daniel

Dr. Daniel Ormeni made my son feel very comfortable and ensured everything went smoothly during the extractions.  He even called him later that day to check on him.  Definitely recommend Park Family Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Description:
