I love Park Family Dental! The entire office staff is so friendly and welcoming.
I had one of the best teeth cleanings ever!!  Hanna was very thorough and worked hard to clean behind my lower permanent retainer.
Dr. Ormeni was so sweet. She gave me an amazing comprehensive exam, explaining what she was checking for and is an advocate for helping her patients understand the importance of preventative care along with early detection of cancer. Her care and knowledge about good oral health are exceptional.
And Sara took great x-rays!!
Wendi at the front desk and Alexis were also genuinely sweet and helped with scheduling my next appointment.
The office was clean and beautiful. It was truly an amazing experience, and I highly recommend Park Family Dental!!🩵 Thank You!!🥰

user_reviews_extended.Name: claire
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had my wisdom teeth taken out and the people at Park Family Dental were really nice and helpful. They ensured both my consultation and extraction were clear, straightforward processes.  They answered my questions and made sure I was comfortable. Thank you to Dr. Ormeni and the nice ladies who work there!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sunita Khoja
user_reviews_extended.Description: Exceptional dental experience! The staff were warm, welcoming, and put me at ease. Dr. Ardita and Dr. Daniel Ormeni were incredibly knowledgeable, gentle, and took time to explain everything. The office was clean, modern, and well-organized. Highly recommend for quality care and excellent customer service!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Endri Krasniqi
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had my wisdom teeth removed at the clinic recently, and the surgeon Dr. Daniel Ormeni and his Wife Ardita were nothing short of spectacular throughout the whole process! Great people and even better dentistry, very much recommend to anyone in the area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Leslie Castaneda
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Our 19 year old son had all 4 wisdom teeth extracted on Wednesday. His procedure lasted 30-45 minutes start to finish.  He left with excellent after-care instructions, was pain-free, and he had no evident swelling as in the “old days”.  Dr. Daniel Ormeni called to check in on our son at the end of the business day, which was much-appreciated.

He returned to work two days later with an excuse the team emailed the day of surgery.

We couldn’t have asked for better care or service (as usual)!  Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle Tomlinson
user_reviews_extended.Description: This place is amazing, went in worried about getting a wisdom tooth pulled and all of that worry immediately went away. The receptionists were amazing, made sure I had everything I needed. The dental staff was also amazing, answered all of my questions and made me feel comfortable. And Dr. Ormeni was out of this world. He answered every single one of my questions, made sure I was comfortable and when it came time to for the procedure I didn’t feel thing. When I came to everyone made sure I was ok and ready to go. This place is easily a 10/10

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tripp Penner
user_reviews_extended.Description: I cannot highly recommend this place enough! Everyone was so kind and patient and aware! This was truly the best experience at a doctoral level I have ever had! I could go on and on beacause there are too many good things to say about this team!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Al Gj
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Five stars aren’t enough for Ormeni’s Dentist!

From the very first visit, my family and I—my wife, our two kids, and I—have had nothing but amazing experiences. The entire team is incredibly welcoming, professional, and caring. They make every visit smooth and stress-free, whether it’s a routine checkup or a more involved procedure.

Dr. Ormeni’s are truly exceptional! Not only highly skilled and knowledgeable, but also takes their time to explain everything clearly and ensure we’re comfortable. Our kids actually enjoy going to the dentist, which says a lot about how great the staff is at making patients feel at ease.

The office is modern, spotless, and equipped with the latest technology, making appointments efficient and painless. We’re grateful to have found such a fantastic dentist for our whole family, and we highly recommend Ormeni’s Dentist to anyone looking for top-notch dental care!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Martha L
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This office is so kind and positive that I enjoy coming to the dentist ! Imagine how good they are!
Every visit for the past year, I feel valued as a person, not only a patient.  Both doctors Ardita and Daniel Ormeni are very knowledgeable, they have answered my questions, suggested procedures, worked with my budget, everything I needed was resolved ... it is just so easy and pleasant to come here.

Their hygienist is so good too. Soft with the hands, if you know what I mean.
The entire staff is amazing!

HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PRACTICE !

user_reviews_extended.Name: Danielle Bayer
user_reviews_extended.Description: We had an absolutely amazing experience at Park Family Dental. We called needing to get our whole family in quickly due to insurance reasons. They got us in same day for our youngest and we were all seen the same week. They did a fantastic job on everyone’s teeth and made each of us leaving with a smile and happy. My husband, who is a man of few words, called me on his way home and was raving about how absolutely amazing everyone was. I have recommended them to many people I’ve spoken to.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Carlo Domondon
user_reviews_extended.Description: Park Family Dental was able to get my periodontitis issues under control without going way overboard on expensive treatments. I really do appreciate this because it exemplifies their integrity to their customers while getting their dental challenges back in track. Definitely would recommend Park Dental - a family practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Frances Orta
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am an extremely nervous dental patient. I felt catered to my nervousness instead of feeling like a burdensome patient. Everything was explained to me and told before anything was done. This was tremendously helpful. I was offered noise canceling headphones, a stress ball, warm blanket, and to watch something on the television. From the front desk, dental hygienist, dentist to the surgeon, Dr. Ormeni , the whole team is excellent! I had a dental implant that I had put off, Dr. Ormeni made feel comfortable and at ease. My search for a dental office for my fit as a nervous patient is over! Thank you Park Family Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tate Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I suffer from pretty severe dental anxiety, and had procrastinated my wisdom teeth removal for years due to the fear of the procedure. After a single checkup and cleaning with Park Family Dental, I was immediately convinced that this was the place to have some bones pulled from my face.

The professionalism and confidence exuded by this group is amazing and comforting. I will send anyone that ever asks me where to get their dental work done here, and my family and I will continue driving a full 45 minutes from far-south Austin, passing what feels like 100 other dental offices, just to work with Park Family Dental.

If you are still reading my review, go ahead and book your appointment, you've found your spot!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Selia Vite-Seiffert
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Ardita Ormeni is truly an exceptional dentist, and my experiences with her and her team have been nothing short of remarkable. From the very first appointment, it was clear that her expertise and kindness are not just professional traits but integral parts of her practice. Every interaction with Dr. Ormeni reflects her genuine care for her patients, making me feel valued and understood.

I have complete confidence in her abilities, knowing that my entire family is in such capable hands. The atmosphere in her office is welcoming and warm, which eases any anxiety that often accompanies dental visits. From the moment we walk through the door, we are greeted with friendly smiles and a sense of true care and support that lasts until we leave.

Dr. Ormeni and her team excel at being attentive listeners, taking the time to understand our concerns and preferences. Their effective communication ensures that we are always informed about our dental health and the procedures we may need. Each staff member contributes to this positive environment, greeting us with enthusiasm and a can-do attitude, which makes every visit enjoyable.

What stands out the most is how they consistently check in on our well-being throughout our appointments. They keep us updated on what to expect next, which helps to alleviate any apprehensions we might have. We feel like active participants in our treatment plans, and the recommendations they provide are not only practical but also easy to follow. This collaborative approach empowers us to take charge of our dental health.

Thanks to Dr. Ormeni and her wonderful team, my teeth and gums have never been healthier. Their dedication to outstanding care and patient satisfaction is evident in every aspect of their practice. I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Ardita Ormeni to anyone seeking a dentist who combines skill, compassion, and a commitment to excellence.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristiana Lingurovski
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I highly recommend Dr. Daniel and his wife Dr. Dita. They are both so professional and great doctors. I went in for my wisdom teeth removal which was a procedure requiring anesthesia. The entire procedure took less than an hour and the recovery was easy thanks to the support I was offered. They went over any questions and were available the next days that followed for the questions that I had.
I really like their new office, it is so clean and modern.  Also, it is located in a great area!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Destini Ratliff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Beautiful and clean office. Everyone was so kind. The office manager was amazing dealing with my multiple rescheduling requests. The hygienist really took her time and was genuinely worried about my comfort. The dentist took time to go over everything with me and never seemed rushed.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Cindy Green
user_reviews_extended.Description: I found Park Family Dental to be a very great place to have dental work. The doctors and assistant are very welcoming and pleasant to talk to. Their overall performance relating to the dental procedures are very thorough and done with much care. It makes going to the dentist less stressful and while waiting one can enjoy a nice cup of flavored coffee. The dentist’s office has a very professional and homey presence and you just feel at ease! I highly recommend.

user_reviews_extended.Name: lanae hall
user_reviews_extended.Description: Having never been to the office or met the doctors prior to my son’s consultation for his wisdom teeth extractions, we were very pleased with the staff, care, surgery, doctor’s instructions, and post care/concerns we had.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Henry Martinez
user_reviews_extended.Description: Truly amazing experience!!! Everyone was super friendly!  Dr. Ormeni listened to all of my concerns and was genuinely caring.  Clean and modern office!  I will be recommending all of my friends and family here!  They even have an oral surgeon who can remove my son's wisdom teeth when he is older.  10/10!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jonathon Maat
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I cannot recommend the Ormeni's and Park Family Dental enough! From start to finish, the entire experience was exceptional. The office was clean, the staff was friendly and knowledgeable, and Dr. Ormeni provided excellent care.

Before Park Family Dental, I had been putting off getting a cavity filled and fixing a chipped tooth. Well, I’m glad I went!

Dr. Ormeni explained everything clearly, filled my cavity painlessly, and fixed my chipped tooth better than I could have expected! I’m really happy with how everything turned out!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jaclyn McDuff
user_reviews_extended.Description: Park Family Dental has been wonderful throughout the process of fixing an impacted tooth for my daughter. In the beginning, Wendi in the front has been incredible with communication with us, keeping us updated throughout the entire insurance approval process. I’ve never had a doctors office communicate so well. Dr. Ormeni was kind and knowledgeable and calmed our nerves throughout the procedure. His wife is also a dentist there and both are so personable. We couldn’t be happier to have chosen this practice.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ilir Brovina
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an outstanding experience at Park Family Dental with Dr. Daniel Ormeni for my dental implant. The entire process was smooth, quick, and handled with the utmost professionalism. Dr. Ormeni's expertise and attention to detail made me feel confident and comfortable throughout the procedure. I highly recommend Park Family Dental for anyone seeking exceptional dental care.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Rick
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Excellent experience!
I am new to Austin and needed a dental exam and cleaning.
The Dr, hygienist and staff were enthusiastic, polite, professional.
The Dr was informative and affable, the hygienist thorough and gentle and the receptionist enthusiastic and prompt.
The office and equipment were state-of-the-art, clean and comfortable.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jeanne Falvo
user_reviews_extended.Description: The Armenia’s are very welcoming! They are very professional and caring. They explain your procedure in full and make sure you understand, giving as many options as possible.  They also are an incredible couple and make a great team working together! Also Wendy and the rest of the staff were great!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Susan Croll Zegub
user_reviews_extended.Description: Thank you Park Family Dental for your kind and excellent service! Everything was top notch! In and out with wait or issues. Definitely a great dental experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Allison Boudreaux
user_reviews_extended.Description:
New patient at Park Dental and this will be my new dentist! Dr A and Hannah were great! Very professional! Wendy at the front desk was very clear with payments and benefits, and Alexis was very helpful as well.
I highly recommend this practice!

user_reviews_extended.Name: John Craite
user_reviews_extended.Description: I am a new patient at Park Family Dental and I must say I was pleasantly surprised at the level of care I received. From the front desk, hygienist, and Dr. Ormani herself I was treated like they had known me forever. They are very gentle and thorough in both the examination and cleaning. If you are looking for a dentist, this is the place you want to be! Five stars!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Richard Southwick
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was referred to Park Family Dental by a friend. This is a wonderful dental practice! The dentists and the rest of the staff are highly professional, go out of their way to explain their services, are friendly, and just provide a nice experience for their patients. I highly recommend them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Besnik Berisha
user_reviews_extended.Description: The clinic is highly recommendable. It has a very professional and welcoming atmosphere. The staff and the doctor make you feel very comfortable and help you forget the fear of the dentist that I always had before whenever I visited. On top of everything I am very satisfied with the quality of the treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TaNia White
user_reviews_extended.Description: Found my new dentist!! I absolutely love Blooming Dental. From the staff, to their professionalism and overall how knowledgeable they are and their willingness to explain things. I’m pretty sure this review will beef up their clientele, which will keep them fully booked.. but no worries. Great businesses should be acknowledged and commended. Well Done Blooming family! Y’all have a client for life.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lauren Lane
user_reviews_extended.Description: Amazing practice- I had an emergency front trauma thanks to my baby and they got it fixed the same day! Conservative treatment plan and super kind. Already referred them to multiple people (it’s only been 1 day!) Thanks for fixing my smile!! 😊

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joe Jackson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
It's too easy to speak highly of every one here. Were there any opportunities for improvement I would gladly offer them. Everyone is so kind,  they are a great team and really took care of me. After 10 years of not going to the dentist they made going back a little nicer.
Having a sense of connection as well now I've recomended friends and co-workers here. Everyone comes back smiling.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Haley Cox
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Dr. Ardita Ormeni's dental practice, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. As someone who often feels anxious about dental visits, I was immediately put at ease by the calming atmosphere of her office.

During my consultation with Dr. Ormeni, it was evident that she is not only highly skilled but also genuinely cares about her patients' well-being. She took the time to listen to my concerns and thoroughly explained the treatment plan she recommended, answering all of my questions with patience and expertise. Throughout my treatment, she was always attentive and very gentle.

Overall, I cannot recommend Dr. Ormeni highly enough. If you're looking for a skilled dentist who prioritizes patient comfort and satisfaction, look no further. Dr. Ormeni and her team provide exceptional dental care that is second to none.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ishika Roy
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great place and warm people. Got treated for tmj pain and masseter hypertrophy and already see a drastic improvement within a month. All the doctors and staff are extremely patient and thorough. It's definitely my new place for regular dental upkeep

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dezy Cardona
user_reviews_extended.Description: I had an emergency extraction of my wisdom tooth, EXCRUCIATING pain. They squeezed me in bright and early next morning! Very fast extraction, staff was very helpful for my nerves and made it as comfortable as possible! Highly recommend coming here :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Shelby Hernandez
user_reviews_extended.Description: I was a patient before the Ormenis acquired the practice, so I was a little hesitant to see how it was after ownership changed. But it was AMAZING! Everyone was so friendly - from the front desk (Wendi) to my hygienist (Hanna) to Dr. Ormeni. Dr. Ormeni did the most thorough exam I've ever had and took time to get to know me and discuss my dental health. There was no wait at all either. A very warm atmosphere and honest people!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dennis Dube
user_reviews_extended.Description: The team at Park Family Dental is nothing short of exceptional. The care, the communication, and end product is amazing. Please do yourself a favor and check them out.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Palmer
user_reviews_extended.Description: My experience with Dr Ardita and Dr Daniel Ormeni has been exceptional . They are professional, kind, empathetic and extremely communicative. Their team is very proficient and have such warm and kind demeanor. Past experiences with other dentists have been less than stellar -to put it mildly, which has made me terrified of “going to the dentist” . Dr Ardita , Dr Daniel and their team have changed all that. I received All on 4 implants and the results were life changing. My smile is healthy and beautiful once again.  I couldn’t be happier with Park Family Dental. They build a relationship with you. They truly care and go the extra mile to be sure you understand, feel comfortable and are happy with your experience.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Margaret Marquez
user_reviews_extended.Description:
The office staff as well as the Dentist and assistants have been great to work with!  From scheduling to insurance, to getting in and out in a timely manner, it has all been very easy and without hassle!  I am still in the middle of my treatment, but my son is nearly done.  We are very pleased with how quick things are moving along for him!
Dr. Lee has really taken his time to explain every aspect of our treatment plans.  We are very happy!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ashley Hufford
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lee and his staff are wonderful! My son was very anxious about getting his braces on and they made him feel at ease. He has a great experience everytime he goes into the office. We are so happy we chose Blooming Dental!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stephanie Scaff
user_reviews_extended.Description: I love coming to see the Ormeni’s! Very knowledgeable and takes time to make sure all of your questions are answered. My daughter had her wisdom teeth removed with Dr. Ormeni and very little pain and down time, he even takes time to call and check to make sure everything is going well after surgery!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Raidan Jawhary
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Ola is really good at what she does, she will explain everything in detail and keep you comfortable. Her aid Mariam was top in customer service and very caring, I honestly felt at home. Yes I was in little pain but not something that was not handled with profession, I am indeed impressed  with the level of service and happy my pain is over. Thank you guys again, I will most definitely come again!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Robert Gerace
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everyone was very nice and went well, ex rays, cleaning & exam. Special shout out to Dr Ormeni for a pain less extraction of a large molar in the back of my mouth with injection only. If looking for a great dentist go here.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Nicole Hovey
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everybody here was just amazing, super friendly and understanding! I had dental anxiety for my wisdom extractions and they made me feel very comfortable. I definitely recommend this dental office.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Gretchen Thonus
user_reviews_extended.Description: Awesome dental office. I was able to schedule an appointment quickly and easily. Kerri was my hygienist and she was fabulous. Very through with my cleaning and explained everything she saw and did while still making me feel comfortable. The doctor’s exam was quick and painless. No high pressure treatment pitch. Just sensible, healthy recommendations. I will definitely be returning!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Grace Averitt
user_reviews_extended.Description: The staff and office were so inviting at my first visit to Park Family Dental. Dr. Ormeni put me at ease from the get-go. Highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Lisa Gillmeister
user_reviews_extended.Description: My visit with Park Family Dentistry was just as wonderful as I expected. Dr Dita’s chair side and eye for detail are top notch.  I would highly recommend this office for the entire family. I am SO excited to continue with my treatment.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Stacey Widdecombe
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Dr. Lee and the staff at Blooming Dental have been amazing!!  They have made my daughter's experience with braces fast and affordable.  I would recommend this office to anyone.  Its conveniently located, and everyone always has a smile on their face when we walk through the door.

Thank you Dr. Lee and your staff for a great job!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Joshalyn Stone
user_reviews_extended.Description: Since I’ve become a patient at Blooming Dental, I’ve seen so much improvement with the my teeth’s health. Dr. Ola is very welcoming and walks you through the process each time you visit. Unlike most dentist, Dr. Ola reaches out with 24-48 to ask about any pain or discomfort. She has a patient in me forever.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kyle K
user_reviews_extended.Description: I recently got my braces done with Dr. Lee and I'm so glad I did. My braces only took 5-6 months and my teeth look much greater than they did before. Not only is he a great dentist, but he's a humble and generous person. And his staff was just awesome. I highly recommend if you need a dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jordan Richert
user_reviews_extended.Description: The filling on my back molar kept breaking. My previous dentist tried multiple times to fix it but I was experiencing pain for years. It wasn’t until Dr. Ormeni placed a crown on that tooth  that I was finally able to find relief. I am very grateful and happy that I found such a kind a competent dentist!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ken S
user_reviews_extended.Description: Drs. Ardita & Daniel Ormeni are very good at what they do. Very caring and patient. Put me at ease for the procedures that I was having done. I highly recommend both for your dental needs

user_reviews_extended.Name: Larry Steger
user_reviews_extended.Description: Hospitable welcome : professional: telephone follow-up after treatment: definitely 5 star service

user_reviews_extended.Name: Dayoon Song
user_reviews_extended.Description: I can say that blooming dental is the best dental clinic in this area! Clean and comfortable atmosphere make me feeling relaxed. Dr. Lee and his staffs are so nice and I felt free to ask about the symptoms and also insurance issues. The dentist has a great skill to extract the teeth, it was easy and quick.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edward C
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Very polite and friendly dental team! I used this dental facility out of network with my dental insurance, but I loved the vibe.

If it’s in network for you, I recommend taking advantage of it, especially in this neighborhood.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Linda Johnson
user_reviews_extended.Description:
This practice is amazing.  They can get you in quickly and you can trust them to tell you the truth.  I had work done at a different dentist (due to insurance issues) and I was constantly pressured to get extra procedures and told that my gums were in such bad shape that I was close to needing a gum graft.  After a visit to Blooming Dental, I found out that that's simply not true.

Being able to trust your dentist is really important.  I've had several over the years and Dr. Lee is one of the few I've found that I trust completely.

user_reviews_extended.Name: TK
user_reviews_extended.Description:
Both of the doctors there are amazing. My mom and wife have had dental work done by both of the doctors and we could not be happier.
Next time we need a dentist, theres no doubt we would go to Park Family Dental. Oh, and I love the fact that theres a dentist and an oral surgeon all under one roof. Cant beat it.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Darren Carlisle
user_reviews_extended.Description: This is one of the best dental offices I’ve ever been to. They make sure you are comfortable at all times!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Edgar Malave
user_reviews_extended.Description: Great dentist, very patient and professional. Had a root canal done with minimal pain and discomfort. Wisdom tooth extraction was well executed with minimum pain. Would definitely let my peers know to come here. Very professional on all their staff members. Great facility.Update: 1/9/22-  Got a tooth infection from a root canal that wasn't cleaned out properly . Would not go to this dentist anymore.

user_reviews_extended.Name: KJ Singleton
user_reviews_extended.Description: Had a wonderful experience here!  I’ve been several times and the staff is so friendly and does a great job taking care of my teeth. Spotless office and always on time.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tamara Alexander
user_reviews_extended.Description: From Braces to implants to cleanings this place is amazing, friendly and always do an amazing job! Kerri cleaned my teeth and it was awesome and I’m all fresh and clean! She is friendly and makes you feel like a friend :-)  I would give 12 stars if I could for the staff and Dr. Lee

user_reviews_extended.Name: Sue Holmes
user_reviews_extended.Description: Everything was explained up front. The dentist and her assistant have excellent chair-side manner. They explained everything and where constantly asking if I was ok. I'd recommend Blooming Dental to all friends and family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Elicia Morales
user_reviews_extended.Description: I just got a tooth implant done by Dr. Lee today, and it was so nice. I was really scared, but he and the nurse there were so nice. They even let me listen to music while we did the procedure! Definitely will be coming back again :)

user_reviews_extended.Name: Travis L
user_reviews_extended.Description: Absolutely love Dr. Lee.  I had a root canal and a crown placed and the entire process was one of the most pleasant experiences Ive had in my 42 years.  The crown doesnt feel like a device in my mouth, it blends seamlessly with the rest of my teeth.  I will not be going anywhere else for any dental work!  Thanks Dr Lee, you and your staff are amazing!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Jesse Woodward
user_reviews_extended.Description: After 15 years without seeing a dentist I had multiple broken teeth to deal with. Dr Lee has an excellent bedside manner and the staff were all extremely helpful. I dreaded getting a molar extraction and bridge on one side plus root canal and crown on other side all in a single visit but it went quickly with minimal discomfort. As far as dentist experiences go, this was definitely one of the best I've had and I'll be referring the rest of my family.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Brian Huh
user_reviews_extended.Description: The office was clean and staff and doctor made me feel welcome and warm. I like that this place has an oral surgeon to take care of any extractions too. I would highly recommend!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kristen Mtjoy
user_reviews_extended.Description: As always, the team at Park dental is incredible!  They clean teeth thoroughly and with no aggravation or pain! Friendly and detail oriented!  Thank you!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Kelly Cannon
user_reviews_extended.Description: I highly recommend Park Family Dental!  My teeth cleanings and X rays are so thorough, and they do such a great job taking care of my teeth. They truly go above & beyond for their patients. Go see them!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Mizzu Cho
user_reviews_extended.Description: loved loved loved the service here!!!! I went with getting an implant since I had the infection that seemed to be getting worse and might prevent me from even getting an implant in the future. I loved how Dr Lee didn't force any choices on me and offered all choices i had cuz a lot of dentists these days are all about the money but Dr. Lee truly cares about his patients. my implant happened so fast and im so satisfied with the turnout. like It looks so real. best dental clinic in Austin!!!!!!!!!!

user_reviews_extended.Name: Regan Fruge
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lee and blooming dental's hygienists were all so kinda and helpful with finding what kind of braces would best fit my situation. user_reviews_extended.Name: Maritza Edwards
user_reviews_extended.Description: I'm really happy with this clinic! The staff is very friendly. The doctor helped me with an emergency very quickly. I highly reccomend this clinic because they are very professional.

user_reviews_extended.Name: Patricia O'Neal
user_reviews_extended.Description: I’m so thankful for Dr. Lee and his wonderful staff! user_reviews_extended.Name: Adrian R.
user_reviews_extended.Description: Dr. Lee has been treating me for braces, great dentist. Always to the point and does not waste time. All employees are very welcoming and helpful. Definitely a great place to receive treatment

user_reviews_extended.Name: hemina nagindas

If you need braces his the right person to go and will take good care of you .

user_reviews_extended.Name: Tammy Chervenka

user_reviews_extended.Name: Ward Wolfram
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I did a some research for crown work as my teeth were running thin from acid erosion. The team at Park family dental provided me the most information along with recommendations and options while I was doing my homework. Park Family Dental is very knowledgeable and was patient with many of my questions.
I ended up choosing Park family dental for my work which was 16 total crowns... Pretty much a full mouth rework as my teeth were eroded. I am extremely happy with the results. The team at Park Family Dental explained each step being taken and valued my time and ensured I was comfortable every step of the way. I highly recommend you take a look at this team when you are putting together a dental plan. I highly recommend this exceptional team.

user_reviews_extended.Name: maddie bates
user_reviews_extended.Description:
I had such a great experience with this dental office. From the moment I walked in, everyone was incredibly friendly and welcoming.

One thing I really appreciated was how upfront and transparent they were about costs. They took the time to explain everything clearly and offered very easy payment plan options, which made it possible for me to get all the work I needed done without the stress of paying everything upfront.

I had quite a bit of work done here, including cavities filled, deep cleanings, teeth whitening, and my wisdom teeth removed. Every step of the process was smooth and seamless, and the team made sure I felt comfortable the entire time.

I truly can’t recommend this dentist enough. If you’re looking for a caring, honest office that makes dental care easy and stress-free, this is the place to go!
